translations.（電話だけで、すぐ採用されてしまった）:
(I've only called, but they
accepted my application right
away.)
translations.（春はやっぱり人手不足なんだな……）:
(I guess they're really
short-handed in spring...)
translations.（ファミレス『デキシーズ』●は今日からここで働くんだな……）:
(Family Restaurant "Dixie's".
I'll be working here from
today on, huh...？)
translations.さて……まずはどうしたら……。:
All right then... What should
I do first？
translations.お客様、おひとりでしょうか？:
Mister, are you here by
yourself？
translations.（うわ、キレイな人だな。大人っぽいけど、大学生か？ じゃなくて！）:
(Whoa, what a beautiful girl！
She looks mature... Is she a
college student？ No！ This is
not the time for this！)
translations.えっと……●、今日からここでバイトを……。:
Um... I will be working
part-time here from today
on...
translations.え、あぁ。新人さんね？:
Eh？ Ah, are you a new
employee？
translations.従業員は、表の入り口から入っちゃダメよ。:
Employees are not allowed to
use the customers' entrance,
you know？
translations.ふふ、いいわ。初めてなんだもの。:
Hehe, it's all right. After
all, it's your first day.
translations.私は姉ヶ崎 寧々（あねがさき ねね）、よろしくね？:
I'm Anegasaki Nene, Pleased to
meet you.
translations.▲苗字▲ ▲名前▲です。よろしくお願いします。:
I'm ▲苗字▲ ▲名前▲.
Pleased to meet you, too.
translations.私はここでも学校でも、あなたの１年先輩になるのかな？:
In school and at work, I'm
both a year older than you,
right？
translations.なんで学校……●、転校してきたばかりなんですけど……。:
In school...？ But, I have
just transferred here. How do
you...
translations.ふふ。ごめんね、店長から聞いたの。私と同じ高校の１年後輩が来るって。:
Hehe. Sorry, I heard from the
manager that a junior from my
high school would come to work
here.
translations.ん～っ……ちょっと他人行儀かな？:
Hmm... I guess you're still
nervous？
translations.敬語。たった１歳しか違わないのに、それだとすごく年上扱いされてるみたいで、ちょっ:
The way you speak to me. Even
though I'm a year older, you
don't have to be too polite,
okay？
translations.すいま……いや、ごめん。ちょっと緊張してて。:
Excuse... No, I'm sorry. I
guess I'm still a bit nervous.
translations.うん、それそれ。でも、お客様には敬語だよ？:
Ah, it's all right. But don't
forget to be polite to the
guests.
translations.うちのお店、そのあたりは厳しいから。ね？:
This restaurant is very strict
when it comes to manners,
okay？
translations.ふふ。じゃあ私は戻るから、ここにいて？ もうすぐ店長が来るはずだから……。:
Hehe. Alright, I'm heading
back for now. Can you wait
here？ The manager should be
here soon.
translations.（このバイト、楽しくなりそうだな……）:
(Looks like this part-time job
will be fun...)
translations.（初日から遅刻なんてしたくないし、暑いけど、少し急ぐか……）:
(I don't want to be late on my
first day at work. It's hot,
but I must hurry...)
translations.えっと、バイトは確かここから入って……。:
Um, I guess this is the
employees' entrance...
translations.ふぅ……暑いなぁ。こんな日にゴミ出しなんて、もうやんなっちゃう……。:
Hahh... It's so hot. I can't
handle any more garbage
disposing on a day like
this...
translations.あ……もしかして……今日から入る新人さん？:
Ah... Could you be... The new
employee？
translations.（キレイな人だな……大人っぽくて……じゃなくて！）:
(What a beautiful person...
She looks mature. No！ This is
not the time for this！)
translations.はい。▲苗字▲ ▲名前▲です。:
Yes. My name is
▲苗字▲ ▲名前▲.
translations.ふふ、愚痴ってるところ聞かれちゃった。:
Hehe, I guess you overheard me
mumbling.
translations.あ、私はあなたの指導係も頼まれてるから、よろしくね？:
Ah, I was asked to give you
guidance. Let's work hard
together.
translations.バイトも初めてだし、引っ越してきたばかりでわからないことだらけだけど、よろしくお:
This is my first job and I've
just moved in. I will have to
learn a lot from you. So
please take care of me.
translations.お客様に敬語を使うのは当たり前だけど……私に対しては普通に話してくれる？:
You should be formal to the
customers. But you can talk
normally to me, okay？
translations.そういうの、ちょっとね。ほら、私って大人びて見えるでしょ？:
If you say that, I... Look！
Do I look very old to you？
translations.だから、近い歳の人に敬語使われると、何だか……ね？:
When someone near my age talks
to me too formally, it just
makes me feel... You
understand, right？
translations.姉ヶ崎さんって、何歳なんですか？:
How old are you then,
Anegasaki-san？
translations.あなたと同じ高校の３年生。店長から聞いたの、同じ学校の後輩が来るって。:
We go to the same high school.
I'm in 3rd year. The manager
told me that a junior from my
school was coming to work
here.
translations.えっ、高校生!?:
Eh？ You're a high school
student！？
translations.……そうよね。うん、わかってる。みんな必ず驚くもの。:
...Yeah. I know. Everyone
reacts like that.
translations.いえ、そんなこと……じゃなくて、そうじゃないよ。その、キレイだから、ついすごく年:
No, it's not... I mean you're
so pretty. That's why I
thought you were much older...
translations.じゃあ、今後は敬語禁止ね。それなら許してあげる。:
Okay, from now on, don't be
too formal. Then, I'll forgive
you.
translations.ふふ。これからよろしくね。さっ、中に入りましょ。いろいろ説明するから。:
Hehe. Let's work hard
together. Now, let's get
inside. I'll explain to you
what we do here.
translations.（ちょっと涼しいな、体あっためるためにも、少し急ぐか……）:
(It's a bit cold today. I'd
better hurry.)
translations.（たしかバイトはここから入るんだったな……）:
(I guess the employees'
entrance is here...)
translations.ん～、やっぱり着慣れないな……。:
Hmm, I guess I'm not used to
wearing this...
translations.今日からバイトか……●にできるのか、ちょっと不安かも。:
A job, huh...？ I feel a bit
uneasy. Can I really do this？
translations.あ、いたいた。あなたが新しく入った人？:
Ah, there you are. Are you the
new employee？
translations.（うわ、隣に。……キレイで大人っぽい人だな……じゃなくて！）:
(Wow, this girl... She looks
beautiful and mature... No！
This is not the time for
this！)
translations.えっと、▲苗字▲ ▲名前▲です。よろしくお願いします。:
Um, I'm
▲苗字▲ ▲名前▲.
My pleasure to meet you.
translations.あなたの指導係だけど、敬語は無しよ？ １歳しか違わないんだし、ね？:
I'll be looking after you, but
you don't have to be too
formal, okay？ I'm just a year
older.
translations.高校生なんですか？:
Are you a high school
student？
translations.だって、すごくキレイだし……大学生ぐらいじゃないかって……。:
Well, you're really
beautiful... I figured you
were a college student...
translations.ふふ。お世辞は上手なんだ。じゃあ、フロアを任せても平気かな？:
Hehe. You're good at flattery.
I guess you'll be fine to take
care of the customers, huh？
translations.もぅ……本気にしないの。でも、歳の近い人の敬語がイヤなのは本当よ？:
Geez, don't be so serious. But
I really don't like people
near my age to talk to me too
formally, okay？
translations.もちろん、お客様には敬語で話して貰わないといけないけど。:
Of course, you need to speak
formally to the customers,
though.
translations.ふふ……じゃあ、さっそくだけど、仕事の説明するね？:
Hehe... Then I'll start
explaining the job right away,
okay？
translations.秋は季節のメニューも多くて大変だけど、頑張って。:
We have many special menus in
the fall, so it might be
difficult to remember. You'll
have to do your best.
translations.あ、はい……じゃなくて、わかった。:
Ah, yes... I mean... Sure, I
got it.
translations.そんなに引っかかるなら、敬語でもいいよ？:
If it's so much of a burden,
just speak to me formally
then.
translations.ううん、●も引っ越してきたばっかりだから、気楽に話せる人、欲しかったところだし。:
No, Since I just moved here
recently, it's nice to have
someone who I can talk
casually with.
translations.そうなんだ……じゃあ、まずはお友達から？:
Is that so...？ Let's be
friends then.
translations.うん。先輩後輩じゃなくて、友達ってことで。:
Yeah. We're not senior and
junior, but friends.
translations.（う……寒い。初日から遅刻もしたくないし、急ごう……）:
(Urgh, it's cold. It's my
first day so I don't want to
be late. I'll hurry...)
translations.うぅ、寒っ……早いとこ中に……。:
Brrr, it's cold... I need to
hurry inside.
translations.うう……冬の外掃除なんて罰ゲームみたいなものじゃない……もぅ……。:
Urgh, cleaning outside in the
winter is like being
punished... Geez...
translations.あの、すいません。この店の人ですか？:
Um, excuse me. Do you work
here？
translations.あ、はい。入り口はあちらになっています。:
Ah, yes. The entrance is right
over there.
translations.（大人っぽくてキレイな人だな……じゃなくて！）:
(What a beautiful person...
She looks mature. No！ This is
not the time for this！)
translations.いえ、●、今日からここでバイトを……。:
No, I'll be working here
starting from today.
translations.え……あぁ、新人さんね？ じゃあ、こっちに。:
Eh？ Ah, you're the new
employee？ Then come over
here.
translations.……ここ、店のスタッフルームか……。: This is the staff room, huh...
translations.同じ高校の３年生なんだけど、知らないよね？:
I'm a third year at our high
school, but you don't know me,
right？
translations.はい。最近引っ越してきました。２年の▲苗字▲ ▲名前▲です。:
That's right. I moved here
recently. I'm a second year,
▲苗字▲　▲名前▲.
translations.えっと……１年先輩なんですか？:
Umm, so that makes you my
senior by one year？
translations.もぅ……どうせもっと年上なんだと思ったでしょ。:
Geez, I bet you were thinking
I was much older, right？
translations.すごく大人っぽいから、つい……。: You look mature, so I just...
translations.敬語をやめるなら、許してあげる。:
If you stop speaking formally,
I'll forgive you.
translations.だから、敬語をやめるの。だって、１歳しか違わないのに敬語だなんて……。:
I said, stop speaking
formally. After all, there's
only one year difference
between us...
translations.すごく年上扱いされてる感じがして、ちょっとイヤなの。:
I don't like being treated as
if I'm a lot older.
translations.そうなんだ……わかった。じゃあ、敬語は無しで。:
Is that so...？ I got it. Then
I'll speak casually.
translations.じゃあ、さっそく新人指導、始めちゃうからね。:
Then I'll start training you
right away.
translations.ふふ。ビジネスはスピードよ？:
Hehe. Speed is everything for
business, you know？
translations.そっか……じゃあ、いろいろと迷惑かけると思うけど、よろしく。:
I see... I might cause a bunch
of trouble, but let's get
along.
translations.さて、今日も頑張って働きますか！:
All right, I'll work hard
again today！
translations.といってもまだ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に教わりながらじゃないとな……。:
Although I say that,
I still need
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
guidance...
translations.（うーん、覚えることがたくさんあるな。えーと▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は……）:
(Hmm, there are a lot of
things to remember. Umm,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is...)
translations.姉ヶ崎さーん！ これってどうするんでしたっけー？:
Anegasaki-san！ What was I
supposed to do with this？
translations.はいはい、今いくからね。:
Yes, yes. I'm coming right
over.
translations.大変そうだな……って、●以外の面倒も一人で見てるのか……。:
It looks hectic... She has to
look after people other than
me. It must be tough.
translations.お疲れ様、どう？ 仕事は。: Good job. So, how is work？
translations.情けないけど、結構大変かも……。:
It sounds pathetic, but it's
pretty hectic...
translations.ふふ、でも入ったばかりにしては頑張ってるよ？:
Hehe, but you're doing pretty
good for someone who just
joined, you know？
translations.そうかな……ところで●以外にも新人っているの？:
Is that so...？ By the way,
there are a lot of newcomers
other than me, I guess.
translations.ううん、他のスタッフはみんなそれなりに長くやってるよ、どうして？:
No, the rest of the staff has
all been here for a while.
Why？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、●以外の面倒も見てたじゃん、あの人たちは？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
has to look after many
people, so I thought...
translations.うん、彼女達も仕事は覚えてきたし、基本的には自分だけでこなせるんだけど……。:
Well, they know what to do and
can do the basics on their
own, but...
translations.うん、少しトラブルが起きたり、わからないことがあると、私に聞いてくるの。:
Well, if there's some trouble,
or something they don't know,
they always come to me...
translations.私だって、一年くらい先輩なだけなんだけど……。:
Even though I'm only a year
older than them...
translations.ねぇ、なんでだと思う？:
Hey, do you know why they
always come to me？
translations.（でもなんとなくは、わかる気がする……）:
(But somehow, I think I know
why...)
translations.お客様、申し訳ございません。お召し物やお荷物は大丈夫ですか？:
Our apologies, ma'am. Are your
clothes and belongings all
right？
translations.すぐに片づけて代わりをお持ちいたします。まことに申し訳ございません。:
We'll clean it up right away
and bring out a new order. We
are truly sorry.
translations.え……？ ああ、気にしない気にしない。:
Eh...？ Oh, don't worry, don't
worry.
translations.でも……やったのは●なのに、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲まで謝って……。:
But...
I was the one who did it.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
shouldn't have to apologize...
translations.それは違うよ？ ほら、お客様から見れば、私もあなたも同じ店員でしょ？:
That's not right, you know？
From the customer's
perspective, we're both staff,
right？
translations.もぅ……これくらいで落ち込まないの。:
Geez... Don't get depressed
over this.
translations.誰だって間違いのひとつやふたつ、必ずやるものでしょ？:
Everyone always makes a
mistake or two, right？
translations.ふふ。あなたはまだ新人なんだから、いっぱいミスしていいのよ。:
Hehe. You're still new, so
it's okay if you make lots of
mistakes.
translations.でも、そこから学ばないとダメよ？:
But it's no good if you don't
learn from them.
translations.ミスをしていいのは、成長してくれるって周りが信じてるからなの。:
It's okay to make mistakes but
you have to learn from them,
okay？ Everyone here believes
in you.
translations.もちろん。私もあなたの素直なところ、高く評価してるもの。:
Of course. You are always
obedient, and that is very
nice.
translations.私が教えたこと、素直にやってくれるでしょ？:
Whatever I teach you, you
always follow me obediently,
right？
translations.それって本当はすごいことなんだよ？:
That's an amazing thing, you
know？
translations.うん。保証する。お姉さんの言うことなんだから、信じてＯＫ。:
Yup. You can trust this big
sister's words, believe me.
translations.そっか……うん、信じるよ。それに、もう迷惑かけないように頑張る。:
Yeah, I believe you. Anyway,
I'll try my best so that I
don't cause you any more
troubles.
translations.ふふ、そうこなくちゃ。: Hehe, that's how it should be.
translations.店の前で……交通事故!?:
In front of the store...
There's been an accident！！
translations.どうしよう。お客様も動揺してるし。店長は打ち合わせで出掛けてるし……。:
What should we do？ The
customers are making a
commotion, and the manager
isn't here...
translations.大丈夫。今、救急車、呼んだから。:
It's all right. I just called
for an ambulance.
translations.えっ？ あ……ケータイ？:
Eh？ Ah... With your cell
phone？
translations.うん。厨房に飛び込んで咄嗟に……勝手にやったけど、マズかったかな？:
Yeah. I ran right away into
the kitchen... I did it on my
own. Was that bad？
translations.ううん。いい判断。さすが私が見込んでるだけあるね。:
No. That was a good decision.
It's just what I hoped would
happen.
translations.ふぅ……これで終わりかな？:
Phew... I think this is it,
then.
translations.あ……さっきは、ありがとう。もう、どうなるかと思っちゃった。:
Oh... Thanks for earlier. I
wasn't sure what was going to
happen.
translations.ううん。でも大した事故じゃなかったんだよね？:
No problem. Fortunately, it
wasn't a serious accident.
translations.でも、さすが男の子。ちょっと感心しちゃった、かな？:
But just what I'd expect from
a boy. I guess I'm a bit
impressed.
translations.●、もう……“男の子”って歳でも……。:
I'm a bit old to be called a
"boy"...
translations.そっか。うふ、ごめんね。立派に“男性”だもんね。:
I see. Hehe, sorry. You're a
fine man, aren't you？
translations.そんなふうに言われるのも……。: If you say it like that...
translations.じゃ、閉店時刻までもうちょっと、頑張ろっか。:
Let's work hard for a bit
longer until closing.
translations.ふう……お疲れ様。ピーク、やっと過ぎたね。:
Whew... Good work. The peak is
finally over.
translations.今日は多かったな……あ、そっちの下げモノ、●がやっとくよ。:
There were a lot of customers
today... Ah, I'll bus that
table.
translations.仕事、だいぶ憶えてきたね。レジ打ちも、ちゃんとしてるし。:
You've memorized most of the
jobs. You can even use the
cash register.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のおかげだよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is to thank for that.
translations.そう？ じゃあ、そろそろ私もお役御免かな？ お姉さんちょっと寂しいなあ。:
Really？ Then I wonder if my
help will no longer be needed.
This big sister will be
lonely.
translations.ふふ、うそうそ。早く一人前になってくれないと困るもんね。:
Hehe, Just joking！ It'd be a
problem if you didn't quickly
become independent.
translations.あ、そうだ。ねえ、一人前のお祝いしようか？:
Ah, I know. How about we
celebrate your becoming
independent？
translations.今日、同じ時間にあがりでしょ？ その後時間あったら、ご飯でも、どう？:
We get off at the same time
tonight, right？ If you have
some time after, how about
getting some food？
translations.……●と、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の２人で？:
...It's going to be just
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
and me？ Just the two of us？
translations.イヤならいいんだけど……ごめん、ちょっと調子に乗っちゃった？:
It's fine if you don't want
to... Sorry. Did I get ahead
of myself？
translations.イヤ……とか、そういうのじゃなくて。: No, I didn't mean that at all.
translations.ふふ、よかった。じゃ、決まりね。:
Hehe, I'm glad. Then it's
decided.
translations.ごめんね、こんなとこで……。:
I'm sorry we ended up in such
a place...
translations.はぁ……お気に入りのお店の定休日を勘違いするなんてなぁ……。:
Hah... To think I would
mistake the regular holiday of
my favorite place...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、意外にドジなとこもあるのかな……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
might have a surprising clumsy
side...)
translations.ん？ 憐みの視線を感じる……。: Hm？ I feel a pitying gaze...
translations.さて、じゃあ今日はお祝いだから、ここは私のオゴりね。:
Well then, since today is a
celebration, this will be my
treat.
translations.え、いいよ、そんなの……。:
Eh？ It's fine. You don't need
to...
translations.遠慮しないの。バイトでも、学校でも、あなたは後輩なんだから。:
Don't hold back. Whether it's
at work or school, you're my
junior.
translations.いいけど、\n次はこっちがオゴるから:
Sure. But next time I'll
treat you
translations.じゃあ、お言葉に甘えて……:
Then I'll take you up on
your offer...
translations.先輩といっても、歳はひとつしか違わないし、同じ学生なんだからさ。:
Even if you're my senior,
we're only a year apart. And
we're both students.
translations.そんな、茶化さないでよ……。:
Don't make fun of me like
that...
translations.ううん、そうじゃないの。素直にそう思っただけ。:
No, I didn't. It's just what I
honestly thought.
translations.あー、カッコつけちゃって。: Ah, he got to show off.
translations.ふふ。じゃあ、そのうちいつか、ね？: Hehe. In due time then, okay？
translations.そうそう。お姉さんには素直に、ね？:
That's right. Obediently
listen to this big sister,
okay？
translations.もう、謝るようなことじゃないでしょ？ ふふ、カワイイ▼:
Geez, it's not something you
need to apologize for, right？
Hehe, so cute▼
translations.今日はありがとう。それに、ごめんね。こっちから誘ったのに、こんなバタバタで。:
Thanks for today. And sorry. I
was the one who invited you
and we ended up in this noisy
place.
translations.ううん。こっちこそ、ありがとう。:
Don't worry. I'd like to thank
you.
translations.ふふ。だって、一人前のお祝いじゃない。:
Hehe. Well, we're celebrating
your becoming independent
after all.
translations.あ、いけない、時間……今日は楽しかったよ、ありがと。じゃあ、またね。:
Ah！ Oh no, the time... I had
fun today. Thanks. See you
later.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲とふたりでご飯か……ファーストフードだけど）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
and I had a meal together,
eh？ It was just fast food,
but...)
translations.さて、今日はバイトもないし、何をしようかな……。:
Okay, I don't have work today.
What should I do...？
translations.ゲーセンか、本屋で立ち読みか……家で寝るのも有意義だな……多忙だ。:
Go to the arcade, or the
bookstore...？ Or go home for
some sleep？ What should I
do...？
translations.いいですいいです、お礼なんて……うん、じゃあね、お婆ちゃん。:
It's fine, it's fine. I don't
need anything... Yeah.
Bye-bye, grandma.
translations.うん、お婆さんに道を聞かれたから、案内してあげたところ。:
She asked me for directions,
so I guided her there.
translations.へぇ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲らしいね、なんとなく。:
Hmm, that's what I
would expect from
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.うん、デキシーズでも街中でも、頼れるネネさんって感じ。:
Yeah, whether it's at Dixie's
or downtown, you're very
dependable.
translations.そっか……その前は外国の人にシャッターを頼まれるし、その前は迷子の子に裾掴まれち:
Hm... Today, a foreigner asked
me to help taking a picture.
And before that, a lost child
grabbed onto the hem of my
skirt...
translations.……そこまでくると、マンガみたいだ……。:
...It's like in a comic book,
with all that happening...
translations.人に頼られたり、誰かのために何かするのは好きなんだけど。:
I like being relied on and
doing things for other people,
but...
translations.……私、ほんとはそんなにしっかりした人間じゃないのに……。:
...I'm not even that reliable
of a person...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も、たまには誰かに頼りたい？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you occasionally want
someone to rely on？
translations.もしそうだったら、だけど、人から頼りにされることに疲れたら、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も誰かに:
When you're tired from
being relied on so much,
wouldn't it be okay for
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
to rely on others too？
translations.●は……●じゃ、力不足かもな。はは。:
I... I might not be of any
help. Haha.
translations.でも、そうだね。私にそんなこと言ってくれたの、あなたが初めてかも……。:
But, you know. You might be
the first person to say that
to me...
translations.じゃあね、私はここで……。:
I'm going this way. See you
later...
translations.ごめん。ちょっといいかな？: Sorry. Do you have a moment？
translations.うん、ちょうど休憩に入ったところだし。なに？:
Yeah, I was just about to go
on break. What is it？
translations.うん……実はね、店長から新メニューのアイディアを出してくれって言われたの。:
Well... The manager asked me
to come up with ideas for a
new menu.
translations.バイトだからよ。ほら、私も一応、高校生でしょ？:
Because I'm a part-timer, that
is. After all, I'm a high
school student, right？
translations.ああ、高校生に受ける新メニューってこと？:
Oh, so a new menu that's
popular with high school
students？
translations.そう。男子も女子も、どちらも惹きつけるようなメニューはないかって。:
Right. A menu to attract the
younger crowd.
translations.両方か……難しいね。:
Both boys and girls...？ Might
be hard.
translations.それでね、私１人じゃ難しいって言ったら……ね。:
So I was thinking... This
would be hard to do by myself,
right？
translations.そう、協力して？ 早速頼っちゃおうかなって、ふふ。:
Yup. Could you help me out？ I
was thinking I could already
rely on you. Hehe.
translations.とりあえず、高校生の間で流行ってるものを食べて……うちの店で出せそうか教えてほし:
We can eat at places that are
popular with high school
students, and decide if there
is anything we can put on our
menu.
translations.ちゃんと、そのためのお金も出してくれるみたい。:
It looks like they'll give us
the money for it, too.
translations.報告は私からすることになってるから、あなたは正直に感想を言ってくれるだけでいいの:
I'll take care of reporting
it, so all you need to do is
give your honest opinion.
translations.食べて感想言うだけか……やってもいいかな。:
I just need to give my opinion
on the food...？ Why not？
translations.もぅ、一応、仕事よ？:
Geez, this is for work, you
know？
translations.ふふ、次の日曜だけど、大丈夫？:
Hehe, are you free this
Sunday？
translations.詳しいことはまたあとでね、じゃ。:
I'll tell you the details
later then. Bye！
translations.（日曜に、ふたりで……これって？）:
(This Sunday... Just the two
of us...？)
translations.へぇ……この桜餅、そんなに甘くないね。:
Hmm... This rice cake isn't
very sweet...
translations.でも、薄味ってわけでもないでしょ？:
But we can't say that the
taste is bland, right？
translations.うん、口の中で香りが広がって。こう……春って感じ？:
Yeah. When it got into my
mouth, I could feel the flavor
melting out... It tastes like
Spring.
translations.ふぅ、こんなものかな？: Phew, I think this should do.
translations.本当に食べて感想言っただけなんだけど、いいのかな。:
I gave my honest opinion. I
wonder if it was okay.
translations.いいのいいの、あとは私に任せておいて。:
It's okay, it's okay. I'll
take care of the rest.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、やっぱりひとつしか違わないっていう感じには見えないな……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you're really good at
everything. I've never seen
you not being able to do
anything.
translations.うん。知識も行動力もあるし、バイトへの取り組み方もさ、同じ学生バイトとは思えない:
You know lots of things, have
the ability to act, and can
handle everything better than
a normal high school student
can do.
translations.ねぇ、あなたから見て、私ってどういう人に見える？:
Hey, what kind of person do
you see me as？
translations.人に尽くす女性かな:
Someone who is devoted to
others
translations.ふうん……そうなんだ。そんな風に尽くされるのが、好み？:
Hmm... I see. So you like
someone who's devoted to you？
translations.あ～、心外だなあ。優しく接してるつもりなんだけどなあ。:
Ah... That hurts. I'm supposed
to be kind, you know？
translations.仕事中は結構厳しいしさ、そういう面も結構あるよね……。:
You're really strict at work,
but sometimes you spoil me...
translations.そんな風に言って、なにか企んでるでしょ？:
Saying that... Are you
scheming something？
translations.今日はおかげで助かっちゃった。:
Thanks for today. You really
helped me.
translations.そんな、たいして役に立ってないし。:
No, I didn't do anything at
all.
translations.なんか今日……デート、みたいだった？:
Somehow, today was like... a
date, huh？
translations.じゃあ、もう行くね？ バイバイ……。: Now I have to go. Bye-bye...
translations.（それにしても質問したときの悲しそうな顔、なんだったんだろう……）:
(Still, when she asked me that
question earlier, she had such
a sad face. I wonder what that
was...)
translations.しかしラーメン屋に偵察とは思わなかった……。:
Anyway, I wouldn't have
imagined that we would
investigate a noodles house...
translations.うん。冷やし中華がすごく美味しいんだって。:
Well, their chilled noodles
are very delicious.
translations.たしかに美味い……、美味いラーメン屋が真剣に冷やし中華作るとこうなるんだな……。:
It's really delicious... So,
this is what one can expect
from a famous noodles shop, I
guess...
translations.ふふ、ウチのお店じゃ、真似は難しいかな？:
Hehe. It must be hard for our
restaurant to imitate the
taste, right？
translations.でもね、工夫次第で……。:
And to think about the cooking
equipment...
translations.●よりずっと年上かも、って思っちゃうな。:
It's just so obvious that you
are really older than me.
translations.うん。知識に行動力に、今日の調査もさ、学生バイトとは思えないって。:
Yes, you know a lot and you
can do so many things. The way
you investigated that shop was
way beyond a highschooler's
ability.
translations.ねぇ、私って、どんな人間だと思ってる？:
Hey, what kind of person do
you see me as？
translations.尽くしてくれそう:
Someone who is devoted to
others
translations.そうなんだぁ。そんな風にされるのが、いいんだ？:
I see... So you like someone
to be devoted to you？
translations.そ、そういうわけじゃなくて。: T-That's not how I meant it...
translations.え～？ 私、あなたには優しくしてるんじゃない？:
Eh？ I thought I've been very
kind to you all this time.
translations.でも仕事となると厳しいし、ちゃんと叱ってくれるよね。:
But you are strict when it
comes to work and you scolded
me a lot.
translations.ふふ。甘えたいんだ……？: Hehe, you want to be spoiled？
translations.今日はありがと、おかげでちゃんと報告できそう。:
Thanks for today. Because of
you, I could get the report
done.
translations.ふふ、ちゃんと働いてくれたよ？:
Hehe, you really worked hard,
you know？
translations.そういえばこういうのって、デートっていうのかな？:
Somehow, today was like a
date, wasn't it？
translations.あ、もう行かなきゃ……またね？:
Ah, I have to go... See you
later.
translations.ここ、旬の素材を使ったパスタが有名なの。今は秋だから、キノコがおいしいみたい。:
This place is famous for
making pasta with seasonal
ingredients. Now it's Fall, so
mushrooms would taste great.
translations.……あの、さ。もしかして●たち、場違いなんじゃないかな？:
...Say. Do you think you and I
are a bit out of place here？
translations.そうでもないよ？ うちの高校の生徒、意外とこのお店、使ってるから。:
That's not the case, you know.
Surprisingly, students at our
school come here quite often.
translations.さすがというか、なんというか……これは参考にならないんじゃ？:
If I say I don't know how to
describe this dish... it's
probably useless as a
reference...
translations.ん～、でもなんとか、雰囲気だけでも出すには……。:
Hm, somehow, it's also about
the atmosphere...
translations.どうしたの、突然。:
What are you saying all of the
sudden？
translations.一緒にいると、●が子供に見えるっていうか……。:
When we're together, I might
look a bit like a child...
translations.いろいろ知ってて、行動力もあるし、バイトだって高校生って思えないぐらいにこなして:
You know lots of things, have
the ability to act, and handle
everything better than a
normal high school student can
do.
translations.あなたからしたら、どんな人なのかな、私って。:
From your perspective, what
kind of person do you see me
as？
translations.尽くしてくれる:
Someone who is devoted to
others
translations.ふぅん、そういう願望があるんだね。:
Hmm, so you have such a
desire.
translations.そ、そんな意味じゃ……。: T-That's not how I meant it...
translations.ひどいな、これでも優しくしてるはずなんだけど？:
How cruel. I'm supposed to be
kind, you know？
translations.でもケジメあるし、仕事ではきちんと厳しく出来る人だよね。:
But you know right from wrong.
At work, you are precise,
strict, and competent.
translations.もぉ、甘えたかったのか……ふふ▼:
Geez, have I been spoiling
you...？ Hehe▼
translations.ありがと。おかげで報告もちゃんとできると思うな。:
Thanks. With your help, I
think I'll be able to write a
good report.
translations.ふふ、役に立ってくれたよ？:
Hehe, you were some help, you
know？
translations.なんか今日って、デートみたいじゃない？:
Somehow, do you think today
was kind of like a date？
translations.へぇ、こんなところがあるんだ……。:
Wow, so there was a place like
this...
translations.いい雰囲気でしょ？ 湖のほとりのレストラン。このラザニアは冬季限定なんだって。:
There's a good atmosphere,
right？ It's right on the
lake's shore. And you can only
get this lasagna during the
Winter.
translations.冬の湖を眺めながらあたたかい料理……ふふ、素敵。:
Eating warm food while gazing
at the winter lake... Hehe,
how wonderful.
translations.うん、美味い。これはまた来たいかも……。:
Yeah, the food is delicious. I
sure want to come here
again...
translations.この味がファミレスで真似できたら、すごいよね。:
If we could reproduce this
taste in a family restaurant,
it'd be amazing.
translations.やるとすれば、そうだなぁ……。:
If we want to reproduce the
taste, then...
translations.今日、改めて思ったけど……。:
I just thought about it again
today...
translations.なんでも知ってて、行動力もあって、仕事っぷりも社会人顔負けだよ……。:
You know everything; you have
the ability to act; your work
ethic would put most members
of society to shame...
translations.……私って……どんな風に見えるの？:
What kind of person do you see
me as？
translations.ひたすら尽くすタイプ:
Someone who is devoted to
others
translations.もぉ、甘えたかったのか……ふふ。:
Geez, have I been spoiling
you...？ Hehe.
translations.そういえばこれって、デートなのかな？:
So I wonder... Was this a
date？
translations.私は休憩だから、少し外の空気を吸いに……ね、少しいい？:
I'm on break, so I thought I'd
get some fresh air... Say, do
you have a minute？
translations.うん、●もこれから休憩だから。休憩室行こうか。:
Yeah, I'm also going on break
now. Want to go to the break
room？
translations.この前はごめんね、変なこと言って……。:
Sorry for asking you a strange
question last time...
translations.店長からの依頼で、新メニューの調査に行ったとき。:
When we were out investigating
for the new menu at the
manager's request.
translations.自分のことどう思う？ なんて、困る質問だよね、よく考えたら……。:
"What kind of person do you
see me as？" As if. It's a
bothersome question, isn't
it？
translations.忘れていいよ？: You can just forget about it.
translations.……●はそれよりも、その質問したときの▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の顔が悲しそうだったのが気にな:
I was more concerned about
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
sad face as you asked that...
translations.何か悩みがあるなら……。:
If you have anything worrying
you...
translations.もう！ 調子にのらないの！:
Geez！ Don't get ahead of
yourself！
translations.だってあなた、困らせるとすごくカワイイ顔するんだもん。:
After all, you make the cutest
faces when you're troubled.
translations.そう、その顔。ふふ、カワイイ▼:
Yes, that face. Hehe, so
cute▼
translations.あ、もう戻らなきゃ……。: Ah, I have to get back...
translations.●じゃ頼りなくて、役に立たないかもしれないけどさ。:
I don't know if I'm reliable
or helpful at all.
translations.一方的にお姉さん扱いされるのが辛いんだったら……。:
If being one-sidedly treated
as mature is tough...
translations.……もぅ、カワイイ顔してそんなこと言うんだから……。:
...Geez, saying that with such
a cute face...
translations.（悲しそうな▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と今の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……）:
(The sad
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
and her attitude just now...)
translations.暇だから駅前まで来てみたけど、特に面白いこともないな……。:
I came to the station because
I was bored, but there isn't
anything interesting here...
translations.あ、そういや、店長から試写会のチケットもらったんだっけ……。:
Ah, that's right. The manager
gave me a ticket to a movie
premiere...
translations.偶然。やっぱり、見たことのある後ろ姿だと思った。:
What a coincidence. I thought
I recognized this person from
somewhere.
translations.えっと……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も試写会？:
Er... Is
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
here for the premiere too？
translations.うん。私も観てたの、店長がチケットくれたから……ってまさか。:
Yeah, I watched it too. The
manager gave me a ticket...
Wait, did he？
translations.そう、●も店長から……。:
Yeah, I got mine from the
manager too.
translations.ふふ、なんだ、じゃあ偶然でもないかな。:
Hehe. Well, I guess it wasn't
a coincidence then.
translations.そうかも。映画は、どうだった？:
Guess so. What did you think
of the movie？
translations.そうなんだ、これ、ホラーだけど……。:
I see. But this is a horror
movie...
translations.……女の子がホラー好きなのって、変かな……？:
...Is it strange for a girl to
like horror...？
translations.そう？ ならよかった、もう一度観ようと思ってたから。:
Is that so？ Then good. I was
thinking of seeing it again.
translations.そんなに？ たしかに面白かったし、もう一度観る価値はあるかも……。:
You liked it that much？ Well,
it was interesting. It might
be worth watching again...
translations.あ、ねぇ。だったら、ふたりで観ない？:
Ah, hey. In that case, how
about we go see it together？
translations.あ、イヤ、かな？: Ah, do you not want to？
translations.じゃあ、いいかな。映画、一緒に……。:
Then how about it？ Seeing the
movie together...
translations.今度はバイト帰りのついででもなく、仕事でもなく、だね？:
This time it's not on the way
home after work or for an
errand, right？
translations.あ、ごめん、もう行かなきゃ。……じゃあね？:
Ah, sorry. I have to get
going. ...See you later.
translations.（これは、今度こそ、デートなのかも……）:
(This time, it might really be
a date...)
translations.ねぇねぇ、もうすっかりベテランさんだよね？:
Hey, so you're already a
veteran, aren't you？
translations.そんなことあるよー、わかんないこと教えてねー？:
That is the case. Help me if
there's something I don't
know, okay？
translations.もう、アンタは人に頼り過ぎ。:
Geez, you rely on people too
much.
translations.だってー、最近は寧々さんかまってくれないしー。:
But Nene-san hasn't paid
attention to me lately.
translations.このあと休憩だよね、ちょっといい？:
You have a break after this,
right？ Can I have a moment？
translations.ね、次のオフの日、どうする？:
Say, what are you doing on
your next day off？
translations.ほら……この前の試写会の映画。あれ、もうやってるよ？:
You remember？ That movie
premiere from before. It's in
theater now, you know？
translations.あ、そうなんだ？ じゃ行かなきゃ。:
Ah, is it？ Then we have to
go.
translations.うん。だって、ほら。約束したじゃん？:
Yeah. After all, we promised
to, right？
translations.ううん……、そうだね。約束したもんね。行かなきゃ。:
No... That's right. We
promised, so we have to go.
translations.じゃあさ、次の日曜は？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も休みだよね。:
Then how about next
Sunday？ It's
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
day off too, right？
translations.うん、大丈夫。そうしよっか。:
Yeah, right. Let's go with
that.
translations.おっけー。さて、それじゃ、もう一仕事しますか。:
Okay. Well, then let's get
back to work.
translations.えっと、Ｄ列の……Ｄの１５・１６……あ、あった。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ここ。:
Er, row D... Our seats are D15
and D16... Okay！
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
over here.
translations.内容はもうわかっちゃってるけどさ、映像も結構面白かったし、また楽しめそうだよね。:
We already know the plot, but
the visuals were good too. We
can enjoy it again.
translations.あの子たちとは、よく話すの？: Do you often talk with them？
translations.あぁ。うん、そうだね。割と、かな。:
Ah. Yeah, I do. Relatively
often, I guess.
translations.学校は違うけど、同学年だし、色々さ。授業どこまで進んでる？\nとか。:
We go to different schools,
but we're the same grade. We
talk about our classes and
stuff.
translations.ねぇ、あの子たちのこと、どう思う？:
Hey, what do you think of
those two？
translations.少し面倒かな:
I think they're a bit
troublesome
translations.可愛いよね。クラスメイトみたいで、話しやすいし。:
They're cute. They're like
classmates and are easy to
talk to.
translations.……そっか、可愛いのがいいんだ……。:
...I see. So you like cute
girls...
translations.あ、いいとか悪いじゃなくってさ……守ってあげたくなるというか……。:
Ah, it's not about if I like
them or not... Should I say I
feel like I want to protect
them...？
translations.いい子たちなんだけど、少し面倒かな。他人頼りなところがあるし……。:
They're good girls, but they
can be a bit troublesome. They
like to rely on others...
translations.そっか、自分からぐいぐい動いちゃう人の方がいいってこと？:
I see. So you prefer people
who work hard on their own？
translations.そうかもね。周りを引っ張っていくのってカッコいいかも。:
I guess so. I think people who
can handle their surroundings
are pretty cool.
translations.いい子たちだけど、同い年にしては少し子供っぽいかな。:
They're good girls, but for
being the same age, they seem
a bit childish.
translations.ふぅん、大人っぽい方が好みなんだ？:
Hmm, so you like girls who are
more mature？
translations.どうだろう……何でも許してくれる優しさみたいなのに憧れるかな……。:
I wonder... I might hope for a
girl who is nice and forgives
me for everything...
translations.やっぱり面白かったね！:
As I thought, that was really
good！
translations.うん、ここでくる！ ってわかってても身構えちゃうよな。:
Yeah, and even though I knew
what would happen, I still got
pretty scared.
translations.ふふ、やっぱり誘ってよかった。: Hehe, I'm glad I invited you.
translations.こっちこそ。: I'm glad to have been invited.
translations.ひとりで悩んじゃって、バカみたい……。:
I feel stupid for worrying
about it...
translations.ねぇ、今日の……デート、楽しみにしてくれてた？:
Hey, for today's ...date, did
you enjoy it？
translations.そう、それならいいの……じゃあね。:
I see. That's good then...
Bye.
translations.でさ、そのときの先生の顔ってのがさ……。:
So then, the teacher's face
was like...
translations.ねぇ、そろそろ休憩時間終わりだよ？:
Hey, isn't your break almost
over？
translations.さて、●も行かなきゃ。:
Well then, I have to get going
too.
translations.ああ……、洗いたてのお皿って、滑るから気をつけなきゃ。:
Ah... Be careful. Newly washed
plates are usually slippery.
translations.ううん。もう、あなたの方が、しっかりしてるなあって。:
Nothing. I'm just thinking
that you might be the more
reliable one now.
translations.それは▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の指導がよかったからだよ。:
That's because of
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
good leadership.
translations.っと、それより割れた皿を片付けなくちゃ……。:
Anyway, we need to clean this
up...
translations.あ、私がやっとくんで、大丈夫。:
Ah, I'll take care of it. It's
fine.
translations.寧々さんがお皿割るなんて珍しいですね、大丈夫ですか？:
It's rare for Nene-san to
break a plate. Are you all
right？
translations.そうだよ、怪我は？:
That's right. Did you get
injured？
translations.顔色悪いよ、無理しない方が……。:
You look pale. Don't overwork
yourself...
translations.……そう、だね。少し休ませてもらおうかな。でもすぐ戻るから……。:
...That's right. I think I'll
rest for a bit. I'll be right
back...
translations.ねぇ。今日、すっごく熱い視線を感じるんだけど？:
You know. Today I felt an
extremely hot gaze.
translations.あーぁ、お姉さん失格だな、心配させるなんて。:
Ah, I'm a failure as a big
sister to let you worry about
me...
translations.もぅ、謝るようなことじゃないのに。:
Geez, it's not something you
should apologize for.
translations.私ね、気にしないことにしたの。:
I decided to stop worrying
about them...
translations.あのね、私、いろいろ悩んじゃったの。:
You know, I had a lot of
things to worry about.
translations.だけどね、そのいろんなことを、もう気にしないことにしたの。:
But you see, I've decided to
stop worrying.
translations.気にしてもムダだったことに気づいたから。:
Because I realized it was
useless to worry about them.
translations.だって、私は私、あなたはあなた、でしょ？:
After all, I'm me, and you're
you, right？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、●は●……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
and I'm me？ Is it a personal
philosophy of some sort？)
translations.悩んでたっていう話……。:
That you were worrying about
something...
translations.あぁ、あれね。気になる？:
Ah, that. You care about
that？
translations.それはね、あなたとの……デートのこと。:
Well, it was about... the date
with you.
translations.私、すごく楽しみにしてたの。なのにあなた“行かなきゃ”、“約束だから”って。:
I was really looking forward
to it. But then you said "We
have to go" and "Because we
promised."
translations.まるで義務みたいに、仕方なくって感じで……。:
As if it was an obligation,
and that it couldn't be
helped...
translations.ごめん、そんなつもりじゃ……。:
Sorry, I didn't mean it like
that...
translations.うん、それはわかってるの……でも、それにその……。:
Yeah, I understand that...
But, well... Um...
translations.あの子たちと楽しそうに、してるし。同学年の、あの子たちと……。:
When you were having fun with
those girls, the girls who are
in the same grade as you...
translations.だよね、そんなの当たり前のことなのに……。:
That's right. That sort of
thing is quite obvious...
translations.でもね、それが私なの。: But you know, this is me.
translations.あなたの何気ない言葉一つで、ものすごく心が揺らいだり。:
With just one of your casual
words, my heart greatly
wavers.
translations.あなたが、同い年の子と楽しそうにしてるのを見ると、嫉妬でたまらなくなったり。:
When I saw you having fun with
someone of the same age, I
became jealous.
translations.でもね、そんな自分を受け入れることにしたんだ。:
But you know, I decided to
accept that part of myself.
translations.だって、それが私なんだもん……。: After all, this is who I am...
translations.あぁ、あれ……気になるんだ？:
Ah, that. You care about
that？
translations.あれはね、デートのことだよ、あなたとの。:
That was about the date...
with you.
translations.だって、私はすごく楽しみにしてたのに。:
I was really looking forward
to it.
translations.あなたったら“行かなきゃ”、“約束だから”なんだもん。:
But then you said "We have to
go" and "Because we
promised"...
translations.もぅ、義務じゃなくて、行きたいから行ってくれるんじゃないの？:
Geez. It sounded as if it was
an obligation that you had to
go with me.
translations.同学年のあの子たちと楽しそうにしてるのがね、イヤだったの……。:
When you were having fun with
those girls, I didn't like it.
translations.だよね、そんなの当たり前。:
That's right. I should've
realized that...
translations.だけど、それが私なんだよ。: But, this is what I am.
translations.私、あなたを他の誰かにとられるのが、イヤみたい。:
I'd feel bad if someone else
had taken you away from me.
translations.ふふ、あれね？ 気になるの？:
Hehe, about that？ You care
about it？
translations.デート……のことだよ、あなたとの。:
It was about the date... with
you.
translations.だって私、すっごく楽しみにしてたのに。:
Because I was really looking
forward to it.
translations.あなたは“行かなきゃ”、“約束だから”なんて言って……。:
And then you said "We have to
go" and "Because we
promised"...
translations.ただ行きたいから、“行こう”って言ってくれないのかなって。:
If you wanted to go with me,
you would've said "Let's go"
but you didn't.
translations.あなたが同学年のあの子たちと楽しそうにしてるのを見たら、なんかね。:
I saw you enjoying your time
with those girls who are in
the same grade as you...
translations.だからね、それも気にしないことにしたの。:
But, now I don't care about
that anymore.
translations.あなたに何を言われても、あなたが何をしても、全部自分で受け止めればいいんだって。:
Whatever you say, or whatever
you do, I won't be caring too
much about it anymore.
translations.今話しても平気？: Can I talk to you now？
translations.うん、平気。それで……ふふ、どうしたの？:
Yeah, fine. Then... Hehe.
What's up？
translations.●だけど、今、話しても平気？:
It's me. Can I talk to you
now？
translations.うん、大丈夫。その……なにかな？:
Yeah！ It's fine. hmm, what's
up？
translations.●だけど、今、話しても大丈夫？:
Hello. It's me. Is it okay to
talk now？
translations.▲月▲▲日▲、▲デート場所▲に行くなんて、どうかな？:
▲月▲▲日▲ is a holiday.
Shall we go to the
▲デート場所▲
together？
translations.週末、▲デート場所▲に行くなんて、どうかな？:
This weekend, shall we go to
the ▲デート場所▲？
translations.もし暇なら、今から▲デート場所▲に行くなんて、どうかな？:
If you're free now,
shall we go to the
▲デート場所▲？
translations.うん、ちょうどその日は空いてるから……でも、空いてなくても空けちゃうかも、ふふ。:
Yeah, I'm free on that day.
...Even if I'm not free, I'll
do something so that I can go
with you. Hehe.
translations.うん、いいよ。あなたに誘われて断れるわけないもの。ね？:
Yeah, okay. I can't possibly
reject your invitation, can
I？
translations.うん、週末なら大丈夫。:
Yeah, this weekend is fine for
me.
translations.ふふ、もちろんＯＫ。本当は誘ってくれるの、待ってたの。:
Hehe. Of course, it's okay.
Actually, I've been waiting
for you to invite me out.
translations.うん、ちょうど暇してたの。行けるよ。:
Yeah, I'm free. I'll go with
you.
translations.その日は……ごめんね、ちょっと用事があるから、無理かな？:
That day...？ Sorry, I have
something to do. I can't go.
translations.週末？ んー、残念……週末はいろいろあって……ね？:
This weekend？ Ah, too bad. I
have a lot of things to do...
translations.え、週末？ ごめん、ちょっと無理なの。:
Eh？ This weekend？ Sorry, I
can't.
translations.え、今から？ ごめんね、今からは急だから……。:
Eh？ Now？ Sorry, I can't.
It's so sudden...
translations.えっと……今からは難しい……かな？:
Hmm... I don't think I can go
now.
translations.別の場所だともっと嬉しいんだけど……どうかな？:
I'd be happier if we went to a
different location. How's
that？
translations.んー、別の日だったら、どう？:
Hmm... Can you pick a
different day？
translations.タイミング、あわないね……今回はやめとく？:
Our timings don't match...
Let's forget about it this
time.
translations.残念だけど、仕方ないか……。:
What a pity. But, it can't be
helped...
translations.じゃあ、待ち合わせは何時にする？:
Then what time shall we meet
up？
translations.じゃあ、待ち合わせは▲時刻▲に▲デート場所▲で決まりかな。:
Then at ▲時刻▲,
we'll meet at the
▲デート場所▲.
translations.うーん……それだと少し遅くないかな？ すぐ帰らなきゃいけなくなっちゃうよ？:
Hmm... Isn't that a little bit
too late？ We'll have to hurry
home if we decide on that
time.
translations.それじゃあ、もう少し早くするとして……。:
Then, I should make it
earlier...
translations.早すぎだよ、私にも準備があるんだから。:
It's too early. I have to get
ready before going out.
translations.そう？ じゃあ、もう少し遅い時間として……。:
Really？ Then I'll make it a
little later than that.
translations.ふふ、楽しみ。あなたも楽しみにしてくれる？:
Hehe. I can't wait for it. Do
you feel the same？
translations.うん、これで決まり……かな？ 今からちょっと楽しみかも。:
Okay, it's decided. I can't
wait for our date.
translations.週末か……ふふ、前の日は早く眠るんだよ？ 遅刻なんてしたら、許さないからね？:
This weekend, huh？ Hehe. You
have to go to bed early the
day before, okay？ I won't
forgive you if you're late！
translations.うん、わかってる。じゃあ、週末。:
Okay, I know. See you this
weekend, then.
translations.うん。それじゃあ、準備するから……遅刻したら、泣いちゃうからね？:
Okay, I'll be prepared for
that. If you're late, I'll
cry, you know？
translations.泣かせないよ。じゃあ、またあとで。:
I'd never make you cry. See
you soon.
translations.ごめんね、せっかく誘ってくれたのに……。:
Sorry. You took the trouble to
call me, but...
translations.ううん、仕方ないよ。また今度、誘うから。:
No, it can't be helped. I'll
invite you again later.
translations.……また今度誘ってね？:
...You have to invite me
again, okay？
translations.そっか……ごめんね、いろいろ無理言っちゃって。:
Well, sorry that I can't go
this time.
translations.ううん、誘ったのはこっちだから。また今度、誘うからさ。:
No, I'll invite you again
later, okay？
translations.えっと、ごめん。やっぱなんでもないや、はは。:
Hmm, sorry. Actually, I don't
have anything to say. Haha.
translations.え……あ、そう？ なんでもないんだ。うん……。:
Eh？ Ah, really？ There's
nothing then. Well...
translations.えっと、ごめん。やっぱりなんでもない。:
Well, sorry. Actually, I don't
have anything to say.
translations.もぅ……そういう時は、嘘でも気の利いたこと言ってくれないと、ダメよ？:
Hey, don't joke with me like
this, okay？
translations.デート、本当に楽しみにしてるんだからね？ じゃあ、また。:
I'm really looking forward to
our date. See you then.
translations.デート、今から楽しみだよ。じゃあ……おやすみ。:
I can't wait for our date.
Now, good night.
translations.せっかく誘ってくれたのに……ごめんね。じゃあ、また……ね？:
You took the trouble to invite
me... Sorry. See you later,
okay？
translations.うん、気にしないで。じゃあ、また。:
Ah, don't worry about that.
I'll see you later.
translations.せっかく誘ってくれたのに……ざんねん。じゃあ、おやすみ。:
You took the trouble to invite
me... What a pity. Now, good
night.
translations.ふふ……どうして切らないの？:
Hehe... Why don't you hang
up？
translations.どうしてって……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲こそ、どうして？:
Why...？ How about
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Why don't you？
translations.どうしてだろ？ いいな、この時間……。でも切るね、このままじゃ、あなたのこと困ら:
Why is that？ A moment like
this is nice, but I have to
hang up now. Otherwise, you'll
start to feel burdened.
translations.そんなことないよ。でも、また会って話せるし。:
No, I won't. But, we can talk
later.
translations.……じゃあ、一緒に切る？\n……３、２、１。:
...Then let's hang up at the
same time. ...3, 2, 1.
translations.もお！ おしおき、私の方から切っちゃうから。:
Hey！ Cheater. I'll hang up
first, then.
translations.もぅ……あなたが切らないと、このままいつまでも浸っちゃうよ？:
Hey... If you don't hang up,
how long do you intend to keep
this on？
translations.ふふ。例えば一緒に住めば、こういうのも無くなるのにね。じゃあ、切るね。バイバイ。:
Hehe. If we lived together, we
wouldn't have a chance to do
this, right？ Now, I'll hang
up. Bye-bye！
translations.（もっと▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと、考えてあげないと……）:
(I should be more
considerate of 
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.（誘う場所、もっと考えないとダメだ……）:
(I should've thought about the
location more...)
translations.うん、私。ちょっと話したいんだけど、迷惑だった？:
Yes, it's me. Can I talk to
you now？ Am I bothering you？
translations.まさか、大丈夫だよ。: Not at all. We can talk now.
translations.うん、私。今、平気？:
Yes, it's me. Can we talk
now？
translations.うん、私だよ。今大丈夫かな？:
Yes, it's me. Are you free to
talk now？
translations.もし時間があるならでいいけど……今度、デートに行かない？:
In case you have time, shall
we go on a date？
translations.ふふ。そっちが誘ってくれないから、こっちからデートのお誘い、しちゃおうと思って。:
Hehe. Since you didn't ask me,
I decided to ask you out on a
date.
translations.今度、デートに行かない？ 二人だけでどこかに……ね？:
Shall we schedule our next
date？ Is it okay？
translations.週末、デートに行かない？ あなたの予定、空いてるといいんだけど。:
Shall we go on a date this
weekend？ Do you have free
time？
translations.週末、一緒にデートしたいな……って。どうかな？:
I'm thinking about us going on
a date this weekend... How's
that？
translations.私からデートのお誘い。待ち切れなかったんだもの。:
I couldn't wait, so I decided
to ask you out on a date.
translations.予定が空いてれば、だけど……今からどこか行けないかな？:
If you're free, how about we
go somewhere now？
translations.もし暇なら、今からどこかに行かないかなって。ふふ。どうかな？:
In case you're free, shall we
go somewhere now？ Hehe. What
do you say？
translations.今からどこかにいかない？ 二人で……ね？:
Shall we go somewhere now？
Just the two of us, okay？
translations.ここ……なんて、どうかな？:
What do you think about this
place...？
translations.うん。どこか行きたい場所、ある？:
Well, do you have a place in
mind that you wanted to go
to？
translations.じゃあ、どこがいい？: Then where do you want to go？
translations.うーん……どこか行きたい場所、ある？:
Hmm... Do you have a place in
mind that you wanted to go
to？
translations.そうね、いいわ。そこにしましょう？:
I see. It's good. Let's go
there.
translations.んー、悪くはないんだけど……。:
Hmm, I think it's not bad,
but...
translations.うーん……そこ、今回はちょっと、ナシかな？:
Well... That place... I don't
think it's good.
translations.うーん、どうしても……そこがいいの？:
Well, do you really want to go
there？
translations.あとは……いつがいい？:
Then... What time shall we
meet up？
translations.じゃあ、いつにする？:
Then what time shall we meet
up？
translations.んー、いつがいいかな？:
Hmm, what time should we meet
up？
translations.これで、あとはデートするだけよ？ ふふ。:
Now, we just wait for our
date. Hehe.
translations.ふふ、誘ってよかった。: Hehe. I'm glad I asked you.
translations.ごめんね、こっちから誘ったのに、決めてもらっちゃって。:
Sorry. I was the one asking
you but I let you decide
everything...
translations.ふふ。今度は行き先だけじゃなくて、最初からあなたに誘って欲しいかな？:
Hehe. I'll be happy if you ask
me out for a date next time.
translations.うん、できるだけそうする。: Okay, I'll try to do that.
translations.あなたが行き先、決めてくれたんだもの。きっと楽しくなるね？:
I'm glad you've decided the
date and time for our date.
translations.ごめんね、急にお願いして。私はできるだけ予定、空けておくから……ね？:
Sorry for asking you so
sudden. I'll try to keep my
schedules free, so...
translations.誘ってくれたのに……こっちこそ、ごめん。:
I'm the one who should say
sorry to you...
translations.そっか……残念だけど、仕方ないね。デートはまた今度ってこと、かな？:
I see... What a pity. I have
no choice. Maybe we can go on
a date later then.
translations.今度は●から誘うよ。今日は、ごめん。:
Next time, I'll be inviting
you. Sorry about today.
translations.仕方ないよね……うん、急なお願いだったし、いろいろあるよね。:
It can't be helped then...
Yeah, I know it was sudden.
You've got many things to do,
right？
translations.ごめん。デートはまた今度……●から誘うよ。:
Sorry. Let's go on a date next
time. I'll be the one inviting
you then.
translations.ごめん。待たせちゃった……かな？:
Sorry. Did I make you
wait...？
translations.全然。いいタイミングだよ。:
Not at all. You arrived right
on time.
translations.ふふ。今日はちゃんと、遅れずに来られたんだ。:
Hehe. Today, I tried not to be
late.
translations.あれ、待たせちゃったのかな？: Eh？ Did I make you wait？
translations.全然。●もちょうど来たところ。:
Not at all. I also have just
arrived.
translations.ごめん。暑いのに、待たせちゃった？:
Sorry to make you wait for me
in this hot weather.
translations.ううん、こっちもちょうど来たところだから。: No, I also have just arrived.
translations.ふふ。暑いのに、ちゃんと時間通りだね。:
Hehe. It's hot today. I'm glad
you're right on time.
translations.おっす。確かに今日はちょっと暑いな。:
Yo. You're right. Today is
quite hot.
translations.もしかしてお姉さん、暑いのに待たせちゃった？:
Did I possibly make you wait
in this hot weather？
translations.ううん、●もちょうど来たところだから。: No, I also have just arrived.
translations.私、待たせちゃった？ 寒いのにごめんね。:
Did I make you wait？ It's so
cold. I'm sorry.
translations.寒さに耐えて恋人を待つのもいいかなぁって、思ってたんだけど？:
I was thinking that it'd be
nice to test my lover by
letting him wait for me in
cold weather.
translations.そんなこと、させられないよ。: Please don't do that to me.
translations.ふふ、時間ぴったりだね。寒いのに、えらい、えらい。:
Hehe. You're right on time
even on such a cold day. Very
good, very good.
translations.あ、いたいた。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、待たせちゃった？:
Ah, you're here.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
did I make you wait？
translations.ううん、私もちょうど来たところ。: No, I also have just arrived.
translations.おしいなぁ、あと２秒で遅刻だったのに。:
Too bad. Just 2 more seconds
and I would say that you were
late.
translations.ふふ。冗談よ、冗談。ちょうどぴったり。:
Hehe. Just kidding. You're
right on time.
translations.こっちにいたんだ。ごめん、もしかして待たせた？:
You're right here. Sorry. Did
I make you wait？
translations.ふふ。心配ご無用。お姉さんもちょうど来たところだから、ね？:
Hehe. You don't have to worry.
I also have just arrived,
okay？
translations.あ、汗。暑かったでしょ？ ハンカチ使う？:
Ah, you're sweating. It's
quite hot today. Use my
handkerchief then.
translations.ふふ、ちゃんと来たね。暑いから、すっぽかすかと思ったのに。:
Hehe, you're here. I thought
that you might stand me up on
such a hot day.
translations.来た来た。暑かったでしょ？ 汗拭いてあげようか？:
You're here. Are you tired？
Shall I wipe your sweat for
you？
translations.ふぅ……寒いのに待たせてごめん。:
Phew... It's so cold. Sorry
for making you wait.
translations.ううん、ちょうど来たところ。じゃあ、行く？:
No, I've just arrived. Shall
we go？
translations.いたいた。もしかして待たせちゃった？:
You're here. Did I make you
wait？
translations.ふーん。寒い中で待ってたのに、抱きしめてくれないんだ？ なんてね、ふふ。:
Hmm... I was waiting in this
cold weather and you didn't
hug me. Just kidding. Hehe.
translations.あ、ふふ。寒いのに時間ぴったりにきたご褒美、ほしい？:
Ah, hehe... You're here on
time in such cold weather.
Shall I give you a reward？
translations.ううん、そんなに待ってないよ？:
No, I haven't waited that
long.
translations.あ、来た。ちょっととはいえ、遅刻だよ？ ふふ。:
Ah, you're here. You're really
late this time. Hehe.
translations.ごめん、待たせちゃった？: Sorry, did I make you wait？
translations.ちょっとだけ……ね。でも来てくれたから、お姉さん、許しちゃう。:
Just a little bit... But since
you're here, this big sister
will forgive you.
translations.ごめん。暑いのに、ちょっと待たせちゃった？:
Sorry. It's so hot today, but
I made you wait.
translations.そんなに待ってないけどね。でもちょっと汗かいちゃったな。:
I haven't waited that long.
But I'm all sweaty now.
translations.ちょっとだけど遅刻。暑い中、カノジョを待たせたカレシはどうするべきかな？:
You're a little late. What a
boyfriend should do when he
makes his girlfriend wait in
such hot weather？
translations.ごめん。暑いのに、待たせちゃって。:
Sorry. It's very hot but I
made you wait for me.
translations.ふふ。今度からは、遅れちゃダメよ？:
Hehe. Next time, don't be
late, all right？
translations.ごめん。寒いのに、ちょっと待たせちゃった？:
Sorry. It's very cold. Did I
make you wait？
translations.ちょっとだけね。寒いし、早く行こう。:
Just a little bit. It's cold.
Let's get going.
translations.ごめん。寒いのに待たせちゃって……。:
Sorry. It's cold but I made
you wait for me...
translations.ちょっとだから許してもいいけど、次もこうだったら、私、泣いちゃうよ？ ふふ。:
You were just a little late,
so I'll forgive you. But if
you do this again, I'll cry,
okay？ Hehe.
translations.ごめん。寒いのに、待たせちゃったかな？:
Sorry, it's so cold but I made
you wait for me...
translations.もう……今後こういうことはなしだよ？ ふふっ。:
Geez... Don't do this again,
okay？ Hehe.
translations.ごめん。出るのが遅くなって……。:
Sorry. I left home late today,
so...
translations.カレシを待つのも悪くないけど……今日だけにしてほしいな。:
It didn't feel bad to wait for
a boyfriend, but... You
shouldn't do this again.
translations.ふぅん、わざと焦らしてるのかなって思ったけど……そうじゃなかったんだ。:
Hmph. I was thinking that you
might want to upset me...
Guess I was wrong.
translations.もぅ、私はカノジョだからまだいいけど。でも、ちゃんと反省すること。ね？:
Geez. You're lucky to have me
as your girlfriend that I
didn't mind this. But you must
reflect on it, okay？
translations.ただの遅刻だったの？ 今日は暑いから、いろいろ心配しちゃったんだよ……？:
So, nothing happened, right？
Today is very hot. I was
worried that something might
have happened to you...
translations.もぅ、こんなに暑いのに……今日はちゃんと楽しませてくれないと、許してあげないから:
Geez, it is very hot, you
know...？ If you don't make
this a very fun date, I won't
forgive you.
translations.もう！ 私がいないとダメなんだから。……ほら、まずは汗を拭かないと。:
Geez！ You're totally helpless
when I'm not with you... Come
on. Now, wipe off your sweat
first.
translations.寒いからあまり出たくないのもわかるけど。でも次は、ね？:
I know it's so cold that you
might not want to go out. But
don't do this again, okay？
translations.もぅ……寒いのにカノジョのこと待たせるなんて……私じゃなかったら、怒って帰ってる:
Geez... You made your
girlfriend wait on such a cold
day... If this were some other
girls, they would've left you
already.
translations.ごめん。こんな寒い日に大遅刻しちゃって……。:
Sorry. Today's very cold but I
arrived very late...
translations.……謝ってくれたから、許すけど、次からはちゃんと来て。ね？:
...Since you apologized, I can
forgive you. But you should be
punctual, okay？
translations.実は、約束してたデートの日に他の予定が入ってさ。キャンセルしていいかな？:
I happen to have an
appointment on the day that we
scheduled our date. Can I
cancel it？
translations.え……あ、うん。急用なら、仕方ないよね。:
Eh？ Ah, okay. If it's an
urgent business, then it can't
be helped.
translations.ごめん。今度、埋め合わせするから。:
I'm sorry... I'll make up for
it next time.
translations.ううん、いいの。気にしないで。じゃあ、また今度ね。:
It's okay. Don't worry. I'll
see you later then.
translations.もしかしてデートのこと？ 急用でキャンセルなんて言ったら、泣いちゃうよ？:
Could it be about our date？
If you say that you have to
cancel it due to an urgent
business, I'll cry.
translations.ごめん……。今度、埋め合わせするから。:
I'm sorry... I'll make up for
it next time.
translations.ふふ。気にしないで。デートは他の日にもできるんだし。じゃあ、また今度。ね。:
Hehe. Don't worry. We can go
for a date later. Well, I'll
see you later then.
translations.●だけど。実は約束してたデートの日に他の予定が入ってさ。キャンセルしていいかな？:
It's me. I have an appointment
on the day that we scheduled
our date. Can I cancel it？
translations.……うん。どうしても外せない用事なんでしょ？ だったらそっちを優先させなきゃ。:
...Hmm. It must be an
important appointment, right？
Take that as your priority
then.
translations.ふふ。お姉さんは心が広いから、許してあげる。そっちの用事、しっかりこなしてくるの:
Hehe. This big sister is very
generous, so she'll forgive
you. You can go take care of
what you have to do. See you
later then.
translations.うん、●。今日のデートのことでちょっと……。:
Well, it's me. About our
upcoming date...
translations.あ……なにか急用、入っちゃった？:
Ah... Do you have an urgent
business？
translations.ごめん。どうしても外せなくて。今度埋め合わせするから……いいかな？:
I'm sorry. I really can't
postpone it. I'll try to make
up for this date next time. Is
that okay？
translations.うん、そういうことなら仕方ないよね。じゃあ……また。ね。:
Well, it can't be helped then.
See you later. Bye.
translations.はい、もしもし。どうしたの？ 今日のデートのこと？:
Yes. Hello. What's the
matter？ Is it about our
date？
translations.うん……ごめん。どうしても外せない用事が入っちゃって……。:
Yes... Sorry. I have an
appointment that I can't
postpone...
translations.本当にごめん。どうしても外せないんだ。今度、埋め合わせするから。:
I'm really sorry. I real can't
postpone it. I'll make up for
our date next time.
translations.……ふふ。冗談よ、冗談。じゃあ、デートはまた今度。期待してるからね？:
...Hehe. I was just kidding.
We can have our date later
then. I'll be waiting, okay？
translations.ごめん！ 緊急の用事で……。:
Sorry！ I got an urgent
business...
translations.もぅ……今日は仕方ないけど、今日だけだよ？:
Geez... It can't be helped
then. I'll let you off just
this time, okay？
translations.あ、もしもし。私、もしかして待ち合わせ場所間違ってた？:
Ah, hello. Could it be that I
have been waiting at the wrong
place？
translations.ごめん、連絡が遅れちゃって。実は急に、どうしても外せない用事が入って……。:
I'm sorry for calling you so
late. Actually, I have an
urgent business to take care
of...
translations.あ……そうだったんだ。よかった……あなたのこと、待たせてるんじゃないかって、それ:
Ah... Is that so？ What a
relief. I was worrying that I
might have made you wait for
me.
translations.本当にごめん。もっと早く連絡しないといけなかったんだけど……。:
I'm truly sorry. I should have
contacted you earlier...
translations.ううん、いいの。あまり、気にしないでね……。:
No, it's okay. You don't have
to worry...
translations.なにかあったの？ 約束の時間、過ぎてるけど……？:
Did something happen？ Our
appointed time has already
passed...
translations.もぅ……それならそうと、事前に連絡くれればいいのに。:
Geez... If that's the case,
you should have called me
earlier.
translations.本当にごめん。今度、埋め合わせするから。:
I'm truly sorry. I'll make up
for it next time.
translations.次のデートは、ちゃんとしてくれないと許さないから。じゃあね。:
If this happens again on our
next date, I'll never forgive
you. Bye.
translations.あ、もしもし。デート、今日だったよね？ 場所、間違えたかな？:
Ah, hello. We have a date
today, right？ Did you go to
the wrong place？
translations.そういうことなら、仕方ないけど。じゃあ……デートはまた今度ね、お願いよ？:
If that's the case, then it
can't be helped. Let's have a
date later, okay？
translations.髪、切ってみたんだけど……どうかな？:
I had my hair cut... What do
you think？
translations.さっぱりしてるのも悪くないでしょ？:
It's good to change your look
sometimes, right？
translations.ちょっと冒険してみました。どうかな？:
I thought I'd take a risk.
What do you think？
translations.やっぱりこれくらいの長さのほうが……どう、かな？:
I hoped you would like this
hair length... What do you
say？
translations.あなたから見て、これぐらいの長さって、どう？:
From your point of view, what
do think about my hair
length？
translations.じゃーん。髪型を変えてみました。新しいお姉さん、どうかな？:
Tada！ I changed my hairstyle.
What do you think about the
new Nene？
translations.髪、伸ばしてみたんだけど……どう、かな？:
My hair is longer now... What
do you think？
translations.男の子って髪の長い子が好きだって言うけど……ふふ、どうかな？:
Guys like girls with long
hair, right？ Hehe. What do
you think？
translations.ねぇ、ロングヘアーって、好き？: Hey. Do you like long hair？
translations.良かった……ありがとう、気に入ってくれて。: I'm glad you like it. Thanks.
translations.そんなこと言って、髪型なんてどうでもいいって思ってない？ ふふ。:
I thought you would say that
you didn't care about my hair.
Hehe.
translations.ふふ、良かった。いろいろ悩んだけど、大丈夫だったみたい。:
Hehe, I'm glad. I had been
worrying about this. Now, I'm
relieved.
translations.えっ……あ、うん……私の勘違いだったんだ……。:
Eh？ Ah, um... I probably made
a mistake...
translations.そうなんだ。せっかく頑張ってみたのに……。:
I see... I really tried my
best though...
translations.あ、そうなんだ……。じゃあ、次はもっと気合い入れちゃうから、ね？:
Ah, I see... Then I'll try
harder next time, okay？
translations.髪型、変えちゃった。おかしくないかな？:
I changed my hairstyle. Do I
look weird？
translations.どう？ 新しい髪型。気に入った？:
How is it？ Do you like my new
hairstyle？
translations.うん、素直でよろしい。:
Um, thank you for being
honest.
translations.やった、思い切ってよかった。:
Yay！ I'm glad I decided on
this.
translations.今日はちょっとイメージを変えてみたの。:
I just thought about changing
my image today.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!? その髪の色……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！？
The color of your hair...
translations.かなり頑張ってみたよ。まだちょっと恥ずかしいけど……どうかな？:
I've tried my best. This is a
little embarrassing, though.
...What do you think？
translations.服、いつもと違う感じにしてみたんだけど……変じゃないかな？:
I changed my clothing style
today... Do you think I look
weird？
translations.いつもと違うイメージの服を試してみたの……笑ったら怒るからね？:
I changed my image with a
different clothing style
today... Don't laugh at me or
I'll get mad, okay？
translations.私だって、たまにはこういう服を着たい時が……ね？ ふふ、でもちょっと落ち着かない:
Occasionally, I also like to
wear this style of clothes...
Hehe, I feel really nervous
though.
translations.ちょっとおとなしい服にしてみたけど……やっぱり変？:
I'm wearing formal clothes
like this... Do you think I
look strange？
translations.今日のテーマは清楚な年上の女性……ふふ。ご感想は？:
My theme for today is the neat
and tidy "older woman" look...
Hehe, what do you think？
translations.ちょっと清楚なお姉さんを目指してみました。どうかな？:
I tried this neat "big sister"
look for today. What do you
think？
translations.女の子らしい服にしてみたんだけど……どう？:
I tried this feminine outfit
today... How is it？
translations.女の子っぽいイメージにしてみたの。ふふ。どう？:
I tried to look more feminine
today. Hehe. What do you
think？
translations.今日は女の子っぽくしてみました。こういうの、どうかな？:
I tried a feminine look today.
What do you think？
translations.今日は動きやすい格好でまとめてみたんだけど……どう思う？:
I tried this active style
outfit today... What do you
think？
translations.こういう格好じゃないと、年下の元気に負けちゃうような気がしたの。ふふ。どう？:
This style of outfit makes me
look as energetic as younger
people. Hehe. What do you
think？
translations.今日は、動きやすい格好にしてみました。ふふ、どうかな？:
I'm wearing active style
clothing today. Hehe, what do
you think？
translations.あの、こういう格好、好きかと思って……どう、かな？:
Um, I wonder if you like my
outfit today... What do you
say？
translations.今日はちょっとイメージを変えてみたの。男の子って、こういうのが好きなんでしょ？:
I changed my image a little
bit today. Guys like this
style, right？
translations.良かった……変だって言われたらどうしようって、それだけが心配だったから……。:
I'm glad. I was worrying about
what I should do if you said I
looked weird...
translations.ふふっ、ありがとう。似合わないなんて言ったらおしおきだったよ？:
Hehe. Thanks. If you said I
didn't look good, I would
scold you.
translations.ふふ、ありがとう。頑張ったかいがあったな。:
Hehe, thanks. This is worth my
effort then.
translations.あっ、ごめん……今度は違うの、着てくるね……。:
Ah, sorry... I'll try wearing
something else next time...
translations.そうなんだ……ちょっとがっかり。でも、次の参考になった、かな？ ふふ。:
I see... I feel a little
disappointed. Anyway, I can
use this as a reference. Hehe.
translations.あっ、こういうのは嫌いなんだ……うーん、人の好みって難しいよねぇ。:
Ah, so you don't like
something like this... Okay,
it's difficult to understand
your taste.
translations.あ、そう……つまらない話しちゃって、ごめんね。:
Ah, okay... Sorry for asking
such a boring question.
translations.もぅ。ちゃんと答えてくれないと、私だってすねちゃうかもしれないわよ？:
Hey. If you don't answer me
properly, I'll start to pout,
okay？
translations.もう、興味なし？ ……まあ、今日のところは許してあげるけど。:
Hey, you're not interested？
...Well, I'll let you off
today.
translations.あっ……ううん、なんでもない。うん。なんでもないから。:
Ah... Never mind. Yeah...
Never mind.
translations.ふーん……女の子の服のことなんて、まだ気にならない年頃なんだ。:
Hmm...？ So, you're not old
enough to care about how girls
dress yet, huh？
translations.もぅ……今日は許してあげるけど、無視しちゃダメ。ね？:
Hey... I'll forgive you this
time, but it's not good to
ignore me, okay？
translations.ねぇ。いつもこういう感じの服だけど……変えたほうがいいと思う？:
Hey, I've been wearing this
style of clothes for quite a
while. Do you think I should
change？
translations.いつもこういう格好だけど、私って……清楚ってイメージ？ 変えたほうがいいと思う？:
I've been wearing this kind of
clothes with neat and tidy
image for a while. Shall I
change？
translations.私、いつも……清楚？ そんな感じにしてるけど、こういう服、どう思う？:
I've always been wearing neat
and tidy clothes. What's your
opinion about this clothing
style？
translations.今日も女の子っぽい格好にしてみたけど……変じゃ、ないよね？:
I tried this feminine outfit
today... Is it weird？
translations.今日も女の子っぽい服装でまとめてみたけど、どう？ やっぱり変だって、思ってる？:
I tried wearing this feminine
outfit today. What do you
think？ Do I look weird？
translations.最近は女の子らしさ、大切にしてるんだけど……こういう格好、カレシとしてはどうなの:
I've been wearing these
feminine style clothes for a
while... I wonder what my
boyfriend would say.
translations.最近はね。こういう動きやすい服装も好きなんだけど……どうかな？:
I started to like active style
clothing lately. What do you
think？
translations.うん、●は好き……かな: Yes, I think I like it
translations.この服、どう思う？ こういうカジュアルな感じ、もしかして嫌い？:
What do you think about my
clothes？ Do you hate this
kind of casual wear？
translations.最近、動きやすい服が気に入ってるの。こういうの、カレシとしてはどう思う？:
Lately, I started to like
wearing active clothes. I
wonder what my boyfriend would
say.
translations.……うん、ありがとう。いつも迷ってるけど……この服にしてよかった。:
...Okay, thanks. I can never
decide what to wear... I'm
glad I chose this one.
translations.ふふ。似合わないなんて言ったらおしおきだったのよ？:
Hehe. If you said that I don't
look good, I would scold you.
translations.ふふ、ありがとう。これからも張り切ってお洒落しちゃうね。:
Hehe, thanks. I'll try to keep
myself updated about fashion
from now on too.
translations.えっ……あ、うん。ごめん。次はもっと気に入ってもらえるようにする……ね。:
Eh？ Ah, um... Sorry. I'll try
to pick something that you
like next time, okay？
translations.……ふふ。曖昧にごまかさなかったから、今日のところは許してあげる。:
...Hehe. Your answer is really
vague. Anyway, I'll let you
off today.
translations.あ、そうなんだ……失敗したなぁ。あなたの好み勘違いしてたみたい。ごめんね。:
Ah, I see... What a failure. I
made a wrong guess about your
taste. Sorry.
translations.あ……ごめん。つまらない話しちゃった……かな？:
Ah... Sorry. You probably
don't like to talk about it, I
guess.
translations.もう……真剣に考えた？ よそ見してたら、置いていくよ？:
Hey... Could you at least
think about it？ You haven't
even looked at me.
translations.ふふ。女の子の服なんて、まだ興味が無い？ んー、ちょっと残念……かな？:
Hehe. Not interested in your
girlfriend's clothes, huh？
Hmm... This is a bit
unfortunate...
translations.ふぅ、今日もバイト終了っと……。:
Phew, I've finished my work
today...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲からだ。先にあがったはずなのに、何か忘れ物かな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
sent me a message？
She's just left. I
wonder if she forgot
something here.
translations.学校の校舎裏に来てください。\nネネ:
"Please come to the school's
backyard. - Nene."
translations.（メールで呼び出しなんて……）:
(She sent me a message asking
me to meet her...)
translations.どうしたの、いきなり。しかも、なんでわざわざ学校に……。:
What's the matter？ Why did
you message me all of a
sudden？ And why at
school...？
translations.うん、デキシーズでもいいかなって思ったんだけど。:
Well, I was thinking that
Dixie's might be okay, but...
translations.もし、もしね。私があなたと同じ学年だったら……。:
Supposing... Just supposing
that we were in the same
grade...
translations.学校で出会うこともあったのかな、って。: We could have met at school...
translations.同じ時間を、学校で一番多く過ごすこともあったのかな、って。:
And we could have spent most
of our time together at
school...
translations.そんなこと考えてるうちに、ここに来ちゃった……。:
When I thought about that, I
just chose this place without
realizing...
translations.あのね、初めて出会ったときのこと、覚えてるかな？:
Hey, do you remember the first
time we met？
translations.うん、●、間違えて店の表から入っちゃって……。:
Yes, I made a mistake by
entering Dixie's from the
front door...
translations.この子、いきなりドジして、この先大丈夫かなって、ほんのちょっとだけ思っちゃった。:
Actually, I was thinking, "If
this kid was such a burden
like that, it might be hard
for me to work with him."
translations.ふふ、春の陽気のせいだったのかな？:
Well, blame it on the nice
Spring weather, hm？
translations.暑かった。そしたら、ほんとに暑そうな▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が荷物抱えて、頑張ってた。:
It was really hot. And
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you were carrying a large
bucket. You seemed to be
working hard.
translations.ふふ、ちょっと愚痴ってたんだよね。聞かれて恥ずかしかったんだよ？:
Hehe. And I was grumbling. It
was really embarrassing that
you heard it.
translations.暑さと仕事で、少しまいってたのかな……。:
I'm not quite good at working
under the heat...
translations.秋の涼しい日だったな、初めてのバイト先に行ったら、キレイな人がいてびっくりした。:
It was on a cool day in the
Fall. I was about to go to
work and was surprised to meet
such a beautiful girl.
translations.そう、会っていきなりそんなお世辞言うんだもん。びっくりしちゃった。:
Right, and you flattered me at
the first moment we met. I was
also surprised.
translations.お世辞じゃないんだけどな、そのときも言ったけど。:
I didn't flatter you. And I
told you that already.
translations.調子のいい子なのかなって、そのときは誤解しちゃった。:
That caused me some
misunderstanding and I even
doubted whether or not you
would be a nice kid.
translations.すごく寒い日で、そんな中、店の前掃除してたよね。:
It was a very cold day. You
were sweeping in front of the
restaurant, right？
translations.うん、辛かったなぁ、あれは……。:
Yeah, that was such a painful
work...
translations.実はね、あの日はひとりお休みしたスタッフがいて、私が代わりに外の掃除をすることに:
Actually, another staff member
was absent on that day. That's
why I had to sweep out there.
translations.あのときね、考えてたんだ……。:
What I was thinking back then
was that...
translations.新しい子が入ってきて、指導役をすることになって、しかもそれが学校の後輩で……。:
...The new employee had
arrived and I had to give him
guidance. He happened to be a
junior at my school, so...
translations.きっとまた頼りにされちゃうんだろうな、って。:
He would surely rely on me a
lot.
translations.ううん、違うの。ただ、そうなるんだろうな、って思ってたの。今までがそうだったから:
No, you didn't. That was just
the feeling I had back then.
But...
translations.でもね、違ったの。裏切られちゃった。:
But, I knew I was wrong.
You've betrayed me.
translations.うん、たしかに頼りないところもあって、年下っぽいな、って思ったけど、それだけじゃ:
Yes, you're still not quite
reliable and you still act
childish, but it's not just
like that.
translations.辛かったら頼って？ なんて、そんなことまで言っちゃう男の子。:
"You can rely on me." You're
the kind of guy who said that
to me.
translations.いつか言ったっけ、ほんとの私は、そんなにしっかりした人間じゃないって。:
I've told you before that I am
not as strong as I look.
translations.……好きな人がいたの。: I had a person that I liked.
translations.年上の人……私、その人に相応しくなろうとして、目一杯、背伸びし続けたの……。:
He was an upperclassman. To be
a girl that'd be suitable for
him, I tried my best in
everything...
translations.その結果、頼れるみんなの寧々さんが出来上がっちゃった。:
As a result, I've become this
reliable Nene-san that
everyone knows.
translations.でもそうじゃないの、私はただ、好きな人に気に入られたいの。:
But I'm not that reliable... I
just want the person I love to
like me.
translations.好きな人にそばにいてほしいの……。:
I want the person I love to be
by my side...
translations.私を……あなたのそばにおいてほしいの……。:
I... want you to be by my
side...
translations.ああ、●も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にそばにいてほしい。:
Yes, I also want
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
to be by my side.
translations.カノジョになってほしい。:
I want you to be my
girlfriend.
translations.そばに、いっていい？: Can I get closer to you？
translations.ずっと、こうしたかった……。:
I've always wanted to do
this...
translations.ごめんね？ こんなキスで……。:
I'm sorry. Our kiss was like
that...
translations.あとでもう一度、謝るから……。:
We can make up for this later,
right...？
translations.●は、そんな風には考えられないよ……。:
I don't think of you that
way...
translations.それは違う意味だから……だから……。:
It's not the same feeling that
you have for me, so...
translations.ううん、いいの……ありがとう、話、聞いてくれて。:
No, don't worry... Thanks for
hearing me out.
translations.謝らないで、私が言い出したことだもの。:
Don't apologize. I was the one
that called you here.
translations.でも、どうしよう……これから。:
But, what will we be after
this...？
translations.できれば、このまま好きでいさせて……。:
If possible, can I keep having
this feeling toward you...？
translations.うん、●も友人として、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のことは好きでい続けるよ……。:
I'll also continue liking
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
as my friend...
translations.ありがとう、でもいいの。好きでいることを許してくれさえしたら、たとえ友達じゃなく:
Thanks. I'll keep on loving
you, even though my feelings
for you are more than feelings
for a friend...
translations.電話……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ 先にあがったはずだけど……。:
Telephone... From
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Although she has just left...
translations.電話で呼び出しって、どうしたの？:
Why did you call to ask me
out？
translations.だって……、デキシーズには、あなたとの思い出がたくさんあるけど、欲しいのは今まで:
Because... There were a lot
things happened between us at
Dixie's, but that's not what I
want us to be.
translations.ねぇ、初めて会ったときのこと、覚えてる？:
Hey, do you remember the first
time we met？
translations.●……従業員用じゃなくて、表の入口から入っちゃって……。:
Ah... I went in Dixie's front
door instead of employees'
entrance...
translations.ふふ、そうそう。これは教育し甲斐のある子だなって思ったの。春の陽気で頭がぼーっと:
Right. I doubted if I could
train you. That clumsiness was
because of Spring's joyful
atmosphere, huh？
translations.暑い中。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が汗流しながら頑張ってた……。:
It was in the
middle of the Summer.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
was sweating while working
hard on her job.
translations.もぅ、そんな恥ずかしい格好、忘れてもいいのに。:
Geez, you should've forgotten
about that embarrassing
moment.
translations.恥ずかしくなんか……一生懸命だなって。:
Embarrassing...？ I was just
thinking that you were really
working hard.
translations.涼しい秋の日で……、バイト先で美人に会ったんだよな。:
It was a cool day in the fall.
I went to work and met a
beautiful girl.
translations.もぅ、初対面の女の子にそんなことばかり言ってると、ダメな大人になっちゃうよ？:
Geez, if you keep saying this
kind of thing in front of
women, you won't grow up to be
a good man, you know？
translations.ばかりって……あれは咄嗟に口から出て……。:
"Keep saying"？ I had only
said it once...
translations.すごく寒かったね。外の掃除が大変そうだった。:
It was on a very cold day. You
were sweeping outside. It
seemed like a tough job.
translations.うん、あれは辛かったな、手がかじかんじゃって。:
Yeah, it was so painful. My
hands became all numb.
translations.でもあれは、お休みしたスタッフのヘルプだったんだよね……。:
But actually, I was helping
out because of an absent staff
member...
translations.あのときね、すこーしだけユウウツだったの。:
At that time, I was a little
depressed.
translations.だってまた新人の指導役、おまけに同じ学校の後輩……。:
Because there was a new
employee that I had to train.
To make the matter worse, he
was my junior at my school...
translations.ふふ、謝らなくていいの。イジワルしちゃった。:
Hehe. You don't have to
apologize. I was just teasing
you.
translations.でもね、面白かったからいいの……。:
But he turned out to be
interesting, so it was fine...
translations.そう。新人のくせに、年下のくせに。自分を頼ってくれなんていう生意気な男の子。:
Right. He was a newcomer, and
younger than me, yet he asked
me to rely on him. Such a
cheeky guy.
translations.すごく面白くて……嬉しかったんだ、そんな風に言ってくれて。:
That was very interesting. I
was really happy when he said
that to me.
translations.いつか言ったよね、私、ほんとうはしっかりした人間なんかじゃないって。:
I've told you before that I'm
not as strong as I look.
translations.私ね、好きな人がいたんだ。: I had a person that I liked.
translations.私は、がんばって、無理して、その人の隣に立っていようとしたの。:
I always tried my very best
just to be able to stand by
his side.
translations.思い返すと、そんな自分は正しかったのかなって気持ちもあったんだけど……。:
To think back, I'm not sure if
that was the right thing to
do...
translations.今のあなたを見てたら、あのときの自分は間違ってなかったんじゃないかって思えるの。:
Now that I'm looking at you
here, I really doubt that what
I had always done might be
wrong.
translations.だって、頑張ってるあなたは純粋で、可愛くて、魅力的で……。:
Look at how you've always
tried your best... You're
innocent, cute, and
charming...
translations.私は、好きになっちゃったんだから……。:
And, I have fallen in love
with you...
translations.うん……●で良かったら、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のカレシにしてほしい。:
Yes...
If you think I'm
good enough for you,
I want to be
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
boyfriend.
translations.……カノジョだよ？ お姉さんじゃないからね？:
...Then I'll be your
girlfriend, not your big
sister, you know？
translations.そっか、今からあなたがカレシなんだね。:
I see. Then from now on, you
are my boyfriend.
translations.●は、そういうのじゃなくて……。:
I don't think of you like
that...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと好きだけど、たぶん▲姉ヶ崎＊▲とは違う好きで……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I like you, but it's not the
same feeling as what
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
has toward me...
translations.残念だけど、しょうがないよね……。:
This is too bad, but it can't
be helped...
translations.もう、謝らないの。そういうとこも、好きになったんだけど……。:
Don't apologize anymore. One
reason I love you is because
you're like this...
translations.ね、これから避けたりしないでね？:
Hey, from now on, you won't
try to avoid me, right？
translations.これからも、よろしくね。:
Please continue to be nice to
me, okay？
translations.ふぅ、もう少しで終わりだ。もうひと踏ん張りするか！:
Phew, just a little bit more
until today's job is done.
I'll just hang in there！
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……そっか今日は早あがりだっけ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Did you finish your
work early today？
translations.（バイト終わったら話したいって、なんだろう……）:
(She said she had something to
talk to me after I finished my
work. What could it be...？)
translations.どうしたの、話があるって。:
What's the matter？ Why did
you want to talk to me？
translations.それもデキシーズじゃなくて、学校でって……。:
And why not at Dixie's, but at
school...？
translations.だって、デキシーズだと邪魔が入っちゃうかもしれないじゃない。:
Because we might be
interrupted if we talked at
Dixie's.
translations.ふたりっきりで、話がしたいの。: I wanted this to be private.
translations.ううん、ふたりきりじゃないと、話せないこと……。:
No, I mean, this is a very
private business...
translations.待ってる間にね、あなたと初めて会ったときのこと思い出してたの。:
While I was waiting for you, I
thought about the first time
we met.
translations.ねぇ、あなたは覚えてる？:
Hey, do you still remember
it？
translations.働きに来たのに、普通に正面から入っちゃったんだよね、●……。:
I came to work at Dixie's but
I entered from the front
door...
translations.ふふ、あれじゃお客様だって思っちゃうよ。:
Hehe, that's why I thought you
were a customer.
translations.ぽかぽかした日だったし、そのせいだったりして？ ふふ。:
The weather was kind of warm
outside. Maybe you could blame
it on that. Hehe.
translations.暑い日だったけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は一生懸命働いてた。:
It was such a hot day, but
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
was working very hard.
translations.あのときは……正直まいってたの……。:
That time... To tell you the
truth...
translations.暑いし重いしで……見られてちょっと恥ずかしかったな。:
It was really tough working
like that and it was
embarrassing that you saw me.
translations.秋の涼しい日で……応対してくれた▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が美人でびっくりした……。:
It was a cool day in the fall.
I was really surprised when I
saw the beautiful
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そんなお世辞まで再現しなくていいの。:
You don't have to repeat that
kind of flattery.
translations.もぅ、恥ずかしいなぁ。:
Geez, don't make me feel
embarrassed.
translations.店の外の掃除してたね、すごく寒い日だったのに。:
You were sweeping outside on a
very cold day.
translations.あれは辛かったなぁ……なんでよりによってこんな日に！ って思ってた。:
That was really painful... I
was thinking why I had to do
it that day.
translations.お休みしたスタッフのヘルプだったから、余計にね。:
I was helping out because a
staff member was absent, but
that job was too much.
translations.あのときは、こんなことになるなんて、思ってもみなかった……。:
At that time, I didn't think
that things would turn out
this way...
translations.学校の後輩相手に指導役、きっとまた頼りにされちゃうんだろうなって。:
I had to train someone who was
my junior at school. I was
wondering if I could turn him
into a reliable staff.
translations.……その通りになって、ごめん。:
...Sorry that I turned out
like this.
translations.ふふ、いいの。そこまでは予想通りだったんだけどね。:
Hehe, don't worry. That part
was something I had expected.
translations.慣れない仕事に一生懸命なくせに、先輩に、自分のこと頼ってもいい、なんて。すごく可:
For a guy who couldn't even
take care of his own job, it
was cute when you told me that
I could rely on you.
translations.新人には早く一人前になってほしい、って思うけど、あなたは違った。:
It's good if a newcomer can
work on his own without my
help, but with you, I felt
different.
translations.いつまでも面倒見ていたいな、このまま離したくないな、って。:
I want to continue taking care
of you, and I don't want to
part with you.
translations.前に話したよね、ほんとうの私はしっかりした人間じゃないって。:
I've told you before that I am
not as strong as I look.
translations.あのね、私、好きな人がいたの……。:
Well, I had someone that I
loved...
translations.私はその人に支えられるだけなのがイヤで、自分も大人になろうってがんばったの。:
I didn't want to rely on him
too much, so I tried my best
to act like an adult.
translations.それで今の私が出来上がったんだけど、その人から見たら、やっぱりただ可愛いだけの年:
Even now that I've become like
this, from his point of view,
I'd still be just a cute
underclassman to him.
translations.でもね、そのことはもういいの。:
But I don't care about that
anymore.
translations.今はとにかく、あなたが可愛くてしかたないの。:
Now that I've met you, you're
just so cute. It really can't
be helped.
translations.可愛くて、離したくなくて……つまり……好きなの。:
You're so cute and I don't
want to lose you... In other
word... I love you.
translations.私の……カレシになってほしいな……。:
I... want you to be my
boyfriend.
translations.ほんとに？ お姉さん扱いなんて、ヤだよ。:
Really？ I don't want to be
your big sister, you know？
translations.うん、そうじゃなくて、女の人として、好きだよ。:
I know. Not as an older
sister, but as a woman.
translations.うれしいな、それ……そっちに行っても、いい？:
I'm so happy... Can I go
there...？
translations.ね、キスしてあげる……。: Hey, I'll give you a kiss...
translations.うん、私がしたいから、するの。: Yes, I just want to do it.
translations.●はそういう風に、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を見てたわけじゃなくて……。:
I don't think of
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
that way...
translations.好きなんだけど、やっぱりそれは意味が違って……。:
I like you, but it's a
different kind of feeling...
translations.やっぱり年上はダメ？ 同い年がいい？ それとも年下？:
An older girl is no good,
huh？ So you like a girl in
the same grade, or in a lower
grade？
translations.年齢は、関係ないよ……。:
The age isn't the factor
here...
translations.でも、私のことはお姉さんみたいに思ってる？:
But, you think of me as your
big sister, right？
translations.そっか。それならそれで、いいんだ……。:
I see. Then I think it's fine
like this...
translations.これからも、お姉さんでいさせて……？:
Will you let me be your big
sister from now on...？
translations.イヤなら断ってくれてもいいんだけど……これからあなたのこと、下の名前で呼んで……:
If you don't like it, I won't
do it, but... From now on, can
I call you by your first
name？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。その、よろしく……。:
▲主人公＊▲.
Please be nice to me...
translations.あ、うん、そうだよね……わかった。:
Ah, okay. I see... I
understand.
translations.返事くれないけど、いい、のかな？ 呼んじゃうからね？:
If you don't answer, it means
okay, right？ I'll call you by
your first name then.
translations.ねぇ、これからあなたのこと下の名前で呼ぶけど、いいでしょ？:
Hey, I can call you by your
first name from now on,
right？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。これからよろしくね？:
▲主人公＊▲.
From now on please
be nice to me, okay？
translations.え、そう……？ なら、しばらくこのままでもいいけど。:
Eh？ Really？ Then I won't
change how I call you. For
now.
translations.黙っちゃうんだ、照れてる？ ふふ、呼んじゃうからね。:
You didn't answer. Are you
embarrassed？ Hehe, I'll call
you by your first name then.
translations.これからは、あなたのこと下の名前で呼べると、嬉しいな。どう？:
I'd be happy if I can call you
by your first name from now
on. How's that？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。よろしくね？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Be nice to me, okay？
translations.残念……でもわかった。しばらくはこのままね。:
Too bad... But I understand.
Then I won't change how I call
you for now.
translations.あれ、どうしたの？ ……下の名前で呼んじゃうからね？:
Eh？ What is it？ ...I'll just
call you by your first name
then, okay？
translations.迷惑じゃなかったら、だけど。今度の日曜日、デートしてくれない、かな。:
If it doesn't trouble you, I
wonder if we can go on a date
this Sunday.
translations.ほんとに？ うれしい……約束だね。:
Really？ I'm so happy. It's a
promise, okay？
translations.そっか……残念だけど、仕方ないね。:
I see... Too bad, but it can't
be helped, huh？
translations.やっぱり……迷惑だよね、いきなり。:
As I thought... It troubled
you, right？ I asked you too
suddenly.
translations.あ、違うんだ。ぼーっとしちゃって。デートね、大丈夫だよ。:
Ah, no. I spaced out for a
bit. A date, right？ Okay.
translations.ね、せっかくなんだから今度の日曜日、デートして？:
Hey, how about we go on a date
this Sunday？
translations.ふふ、いいお返事。約束ね？:
Hehe, nice reply. It's a
promise, okay？
translations.ふぅん、そうなんだ。……いいよ、また今度ね。:
Hmm, I see. ...Fine, maybe
next time.
translations.もぉ、断られるかと思っちゃった。ふふ。:
Geez, I thought I was turned
down for a bit. Hehe.
translations.今度の日曜日に、あなたとデートできたらなって……。:
I was wondering if you would
go on a date with me this
Sunday...
translations.え、そう……。うん、わかった。また今度ね？:
Eh？ Really...？ Um, I
understand. Maybe next time,
okay？
translations.ごめん、ちょっとぼーっとしちゃって。デートね、了解。:
Sorry, I spaced out a bit. A
date, right？ Okay.
translations.やった、うれしい。じゃあ、お願いね？:
Yay！ I'm glad. Then, you'll
go with me, right？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。これから、その、よろしくね。:
▲主人公＊▲.
From now on...
I'll be in your care.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。これからも、よろしく。:
▲主人公＊▲.
From now on, I'll
be counting on you.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。これからも、よろしくね？:
▲主人公＊▲.
From now on, I'll be
counting on you, okay？
translations.私のこと、そばにおいてくれて、ありがとう……。:
Thank you for being by my
side...
translations.これからは一緒だから、覚悟してね？:
We'll be together from now on.
Are you ready for that？
translations.これからは、ずぅっと……一緒だよ？:
From now on, we'll always be
together.
translations.きれい……。ピンク色のトンネルみたい。:
Beautiful... It's like we're
walking through a tunnel
painted in pink.
translations.知ってる？ 桜って酔っぱらっちゃう何かを出してるんだって。:
Did you know？ There's
something in cherry blossoms
that makes people get drunk
easily.
translations.酔っ払っちゃう物質。だからお花見って、盛り上がるんだって。:
It's some substance that makes
you get drunk. That's why
people are in such high
spirits during flower viewing.
translations.その話、前にも聞いたような気がするけど……。:
That story, I feel like I've
heard it before...
translations.んーと……よく憶えてない。:
Hm... I don't remember too
well.
translations.ほら、木陰に入ると涼しいよ。:
Hey, it'd be nice to be under
the shade of that tree.
translations.うん。私ね、小さいころ、これが不思議だったの。中は空っぽだし、動かないし。:
Yeah. When I was a child, I
thought this thing was
mysterious. It was hollow and
it didn't move.
translations.セミが羽化するのを知らなかったってこと？:
You didn't know that the
cicada had grown up and left
the shell？
translations.そう。だから、物凄くよく出来たムシのオモチャが、割れちゃったから捨ててあるんだと:
I didn't know that. I thought
they were toys shaped like a
bug that some kids broke them
and threw them away.
translations.こんなにたくさん？ しかもわざわざ木にくっつけて？:
lthough there were a lot of
them and they were attached to
the tree？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がミステリーの主役だったら、片っ端から迷宮入りだね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
if you were a leading
character in a mystery novel,
every case would remain
unsolved.
translations.もう。だから小さいころだって言ってるのにい。:
Geez. I only thought like that
when I was a child.
translations.凄いね。一面、まっ黄色だ。:
This is amazing. Everything
has turned into yellow.
translations.まっ黄色っていう言い方はあんまりな感じがしない？:
There's nothing as impressive
when everything is yellow like
this.
translations.でもこれこそ秋って感じじゃないかな？:
But this is what we feel
during the fall, isn't it？
translations.あっ。そうだ。秋といえば小さい時、イチョウの木の下で銀杏とか拾わなかった？:
Ah, speaking of fall, when you
were a kid, did you like to
pick up ginkgo nuts under
ginkgo trees？
translations.なんだか懐かしい。やっぱり秋って昔を思い出させるのかな。郷愁っていうくらいだし。:
I miss doing that. Fall is the
season that reminds you of the
past, huh？ It's nostalgia.
translations.こうして並んで歩いたことも……いつかは思い出として思い出すことがあるのかな？:
Now, we're walking together
like this... I wonder if we
will think about this day some
time later...
translations.いつかまた、こうやって一緒に思い出話ができるといいね。:
It'd be nice if, some day, we
can be together like this and
think about the past.
translations.すっかり葉が落ちちゃったね。:
All the leaves have fallen
down.
translations.こんなになっちゃっても、本当はちゃんと生きてるんだから、凄いよね。:
Even though they look like
this, they still live on.
That's why I think they're
amazing.
translations.植物の生命力って凄いよな。:
Plants' life forces are really
amazing.
translations.うん。冬眠してた生き物が地上に出てくるより、雪割草の方が先だしね。:
Yeah. Among perennial plants,
mealy primrose would be the
first one to go above ground
after winter.
translations.忘れちゃったけどさ。ちょっと春が待ち遠しくなっちゃったよ。:
I can't remember it, though.
Anyway, I'm really looking
forward to the spring.
translations.うん。くっついてると、あったかくてキモチイイもの。:
Yeah. I can keep adhering to
you to get warm. It feels
