translations.あ、ううん、なんでもない。なんでもないの。:
Ah, no. Never mind. Never
mind.
translations.とにかく、たいしたものじゃないけど、ちゃんとお返しするよ。:
Anyway, I know it's not a big
deal, but I'll give you a
return gift.
translations.う、うん。でも私、プレゼントよりはあなたが隣りに居てくれるほうがうれしいから……:
O-Okay. But, instead of a
gift, I just want you to be
with me. ...Just remember
that, okay？
translations.もうすぐ……ホワイトデーのこと？:
Coming soon... You mean White
Day？
translations.もぅ、そこはとぼけるふりとかしないとつまらないじゃない。:
Geez. If you don't play dumb
along with me, it's not fun.
translations.謝るのもダメ。謝るくらいなら、ホワイトデーにいろいろとするべきじゃない？:
Don't apologize. Instead of
apologizing, you should plan
for a lot of things on White
Day, right？
translations.弱ったな。いろいろと言われても……。:
I'm beat. If you say a lot of
things, I...
translations.ふふ。冗談よ、冗談。:
Hehe. I was just joking. Just
joking.
translations.期待しない程度に期待してるわね。でも無理はダメ。背伸びとかもダメよ？:
I won't be expecting anything
much, so don't overdo it and
don't do something
unreasonable, okay？
translations.そのつもりだよ。最初から。: Okay, I'll keep that in mind.
translations.ふふ。今から楽しみだわ。あなたが何を贈ってくれるか。:
Hehe. I'll be looking forward
to it. I wonder what you'll do
for me.
translations.あ、そういえばそろそろホワイトデーか……どうしよう？:
Ah, it's almost White Day...
What should I do？
translations.もぅ、私にそういうこと聞いても仕方ないでしょ？:
Geez, you shouldn't have asked
me that, right？
translations.ふふ。３倍返しが常識だものね。期待してるわよ？:
Hehe. It's common sense to
give me something 3 times more
valuable than what I gave you.
I'm looking forward to it.
translations.３倍か……小遣い、足りるかなぁ。:
Three times...？ My pocket
money is probably not enough.
translations.ううん、お金じゃないの。大切なのは、どれだけ気持ちを込めているか……そこだから。:
No, not something you buy with
money. It can be something
filled with your feelings...
okay？
translations.つまり……気持ちの３倍返し？:
Then... I have to give you
back 3 times more than your
feelings？
translations.ええ、そう。それに……私の場合、分割払いも受け付けているから、ね。:
Yes, right. And... I can
accept it if you want to give
it to me in installments,
okay？
translations.ふふ。だから手数料は簡単でいいわ。期日はもちろん、１４日よ？:
Hehe. I'll only charge low
handling fee. And the
settlement date is on the
14th, okay？
translations.もう桜の季節ね……。:
It's already the cherry
blossom season...
translations.知ってる？ 桜って、人が手をかけてあげないとすぐ枯れちゃうんだって。:
Did you know？ If you don't
take care of cherry trees,
they'll wither in no time.
translations.育てるのがたいへんなんだ。: They must be hard to grow.
translations.それって、人と人のつながりと一緒だと思わない？:
It's just like relationships
between people, don't you
think？
translations.だから私、桜は好きよ。春の桜も、夏の桜も、秋の桜も、冬の桜も。:
That's why I like cherry
blossoms. I like them in
spring, in summer, in fall,
and in winter.
translations.春以外の桜か……記憶にないなぁ。:
I can't think of cherry
blossoms in other seasons
except the spring.
translations.普通はそうよね。でも桜は春に突然現れるものじゃないのよ？:
That's common. But it's not
like cherry blossoms appear
out of nowhere in spring,
right？
translations.ふふ。私も、いつもここにいるわよ。あなたがそう望む限り。:
Hehe, I'll always be here,
too, as long as you need me.
translations.そろそろＧＷだけど、なにか予定立ててる？:
It's almost Golden Week. Do
you have any plans？
translations.なにも。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
None at all.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
how about you？
translations.私も全然。このままだとずっとバイトかしら？:
Me, neither. I'll probably
spend my time working at a
part-time job.
translations.じゃあ、●もそうしようかな。:
I should probably do that as
well, then.
translations.あ、別にわざわざ付き合わなくてもいいのよ？:
Ah, you don't have keep me
company at work, you know？
translations.バイト代も稼げるし、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒にいられるんだから一石二鳥だよ。:
But I'll earn money from work
and be able to be with
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
It's like killing two birds
with one stone.
translations.もぅ……そんなにお金稼いでどうするつもり？:
Geez... Why do you need so
much money？
translations.私？ 私は……その……デート費用とか……。:
Me？ I... Well... For when we
go on dates...
translations.だ、だから、女の子はいろいろとお金がかかるものなの！ ……もぅ。:
B-Because girls need money for
a lot of things！ ...Geez.
translations.わかってるくせに……ほら、もうすぐ体育祭でしょ？:
You know... Come on. It's
almost the sports festival,
right？
translations.運動、苦手だったっけ。: Are you not good at sports？
translations.体力には自信があるのよ？ でも走ったり、跳んだりって……はぁ。:
I'm confident with my physical
strength. But if I have to run
or jump...
...Hah.
translations.大丈夫。きっとなんとかなるって。:
It's okay. You'll be able to
do it somehow.
translations.……なんとかならなかったら、八つ当たりするんだから。:
...But if I can't do it, I'm
gonna be very frustrated.
translations.ごめん。\n気が付かなくて。:
Sorry. Even now, I'm still not
used to wearing the summer
uniform myself.
translations.他に言うことは？:
Do you have anything else to
say？
translations.似合ってる。似合いすぎてて\n違和感が無かったのかも。:
You look good in it. You look
so good that I kind of feel
nervous now.
translations.ふふ。ありがとう。\nお世辞に免じて\n許してあげる。:
Hehe. Thanks. I'll forgive you
for the flattery part then.
translations.……許してないでしょ？:
...You didn't really forgive
me, did you？
translations.許してるわよ？ ただ、\n少し意地悪してるだけ。:
I already forgave you. I'm
just teasing you a little bit.
translations.ふふ、ちょっとぐらい\nいいでしょ？:
Hehe. Just a little bit is
okay, right？
translations.そろそろ七夕だけど……七夕の伝説、どう思う？:
It's almost Tanabata... What
do you think about the
Tanabata story？
translations.うん。恋人が再会できる話だからロマンチックといえばそうなんだけど……。:
Yeah. The story about the
lovers' reunion is quite
romantic...
translations.でも、再会したあと、また離ればなれになるでしょ？ 会えるのは７月７日の夜だけ。翌:
But after they reunite,
they'll have to be apart
again. If it's not July 7th,
they can't meet each other.
That's very sad.
translations.うん、でね。バカみたいだけど、あなたに会った日も家に帰ったら思うの。次に会えるの:
Well, this might sound stupid,
but after we met and I got
home, I always wondered when
I'd be able to see you again.
translations.一年に一回じゃなくて、良かったよな。:
It's good that we can meet
each other more than once a
year.
translations.ふふ、その前の期末テストについては考えないことにしてるの？:
Hehe. But shouldn't you be
thinking about the final exams
first？
translations.今さら慌ててもね。:
It's too late to worry about
it now.
translations.それって自信の表れ？ それとも投げやりになっているだけ？:
Which means you're really
confident with it, or is it
totally hopeless？
translations.ふふ。テストが終わったら、夏休みのこと、いっぱい話しましょ？:
Hehe. After the exams, we can
start talking about the summer
break, okay？
translations.ほどほどなら話してもいいわよ？:
We can talk about it
moderately.
translations.話してもいいんだ。: So, we can talk about it？
translations.だって、話したくなるじゃない。今年の夏を楽しめるのは今年だけなんだもの。:
We'll surely want to talk
about it, right？ We'll be
having a lot of fun during
this summer.
translations.そういえば海開きって、いつ頃だったかな？:
Speaking of which, I wonder
when we can start swimming in
the sea.
translations.ん……聞いても、笑わない？:
Hmm... Don't laugh if I tell
you, okay？
translations.あのね……ちょっとだけなんだけど、その……私、太ったかも……。:
Well... It's just a little
bit, but... I gained some
weight...
translations.そうかな？ ●にはそう見えないけど……？:
Really？ I can't really tell
just by looking...
translations.私、ダイエット頑張る。堂々と水着が着られるように！:
I'll try my best to diet in
order to look good in my
swimsuit！
translations.よーし、頑張っちゃうんだから。:
All right. I'll really do my
best.
translations.そうだ。もうすぐ花火大会あるね。:
Right, it's almost the
fireworks festival.
translations.男の子って、女の子の浴衣姿、嫌いじゃないっていうけど……あなたは？:
Boys usually like it when the
girls are wearing a yukata...
How about you？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の浴衣……うん、いいね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
in a yukata...？ Yeah, that'll
be nice.
translations.じゃあ、花火の時には着ていこうかな。:
Then maybe I should wear it to
watch the fireworks.
translations.ううん、あなたはいつも通りでいいの。:
No, you can wear your usual
clothes.
translations.その、なんていうか。浴衣を着てる私を……見て欲しいだけだから……。:
Just that... I want you to
keep looking at me when I wear
a yukata...
translations.ふふ。あなたと一緒だと、時間があっという間にすぎちゃうみたい。:
Hehe. When I spend time with
you, time flies by so fast.
translations.楽しい時間は早く終わるって言うからね。:
Time always passes by fast
when you're having fun.
translations.こうやって、この先もあっという間に時間が過ぎていくのかしら……。:
If it's like this, our time
after this will pass by very
fast then...
translations.だとしたら、それだけ楽しい思い出が増えていくってことだね。:
Even so, we've already had a
lot of memorable moments,
right？
translations.これからも、たくさん楽しい思い出、作っていこうね。:
And we'll create a lot more
memorable moments from now on,
right？
translations.そろそろお月見の季節ね。:
It's almost the moon viewing
season.
translations.お月見か。ウチではあまりやらないなぁ。:
Moon viewing？ I don't usually
do that at home.
translations.ねぇ。月にウサギがいないって知ったの、いつの頃だった？:
Hey, when did you know that
there wasn't really a rabbit
on the moon？
translations.私はね、ずっと小さい頃なの。月は空気も水もないからウサギもいないって。:
For me, I knew since I was a
little kid. There was no air
and no water on the moon, so
the rabbit couldn't be there.
translations.可哀相だと思ってたの。だって月のウサギはお餅ばっかり食べてるでしょ？ ウサギとい:
Before that, I thought it was
pitiful. Because the rabbit on
the moon could only eat rice
cakes and couldn't have
carrots.
translations.ああ、なるほど。好きでもないものを食べるしかないって思ってたんだ。:
Ah, I see. So, you thought
that it couldn't eat its
favorite food.
translations.うん。だから、安心したの。もしかすると月のニンジンがあったかもしれないのにね。:
Yeah. That's why I was
relieved. I was wishing there
could be some carrots on the
moon.
translations.うちの学校、夏服より冬服のほうがいいと思わない？:
Don't you think our school's
winter uniforms look better
than the summer uniforms？
translations.うーん。どっちも悪くないと思うよ。特に▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、両方似合ってるし。:
Hmm, I think both of them
aren't bad. And
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
looks good in both.
translations.もぅ……そんなこと言って。どうせ、薄い夏服のほうがいいとか思ってるんでしょ。:
Geez... You said that. Anyway,
you might prefer me wearing
the thin summer uniform,
right？
translations.ふふ。じゃあ、ずーっと夏服でいたほうがいい？:
Hehe. Shall I keep wearing the
summer uniform？
translations.それだと風邪ひくよ。: But then, you'll catch a cold.
translations.その時は看病してくれるんでしょ？: Will you be nursing me, then？
translations.その時でなくても、風邪をひいたら看病するよ。約束する。:
If you catch a cold, even if
it's not because of the
uniform, I'll surely be
nursing you. I promise.
translations.あ、ううん、いいの。風邪、うつしたくないし……。:
Ah, no. It's okay. You'll get
a cold from me then...
translations.……それに私、熱出すと子供っぽくなるってよく言われるし。:
...And when I have a fever, I
usually act childish. That's
what people tell me.
translations.ううん、お見舞いだけで充分よ。看病は……その……恥ずかしいから……ね？:
Never mind. You can just visit
me if I get sick. It's so
embarrassing to let you nurse
me... okay？
translations.そういえばもうすぐ文化祭だよね。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はなにやるの？:
By the way, it's almost the
culture festival. What will
you do,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.どこかの手伝いをするかもしれないけど、特に予定はない……かな？ あなたは？:
I'll be helping around, but I
don't have any plans for it.
How about you？
translations.だったら、一緒に回る？:
How about we go around the
festival together？
translations.いいのかな。どこも手伝わないで遊んだりして。:
Will that be good？ To just
walk around without helping
others.
translations.お祭りなんだもの。見て回る人がいないと、盛り上がらないでしょ？:
But if there aren't many
people walking around the
festival, it'd look boring,
right？
translations.たしかに。なんかずるい気もするけど。:
Right. Although I still think
it's unfair to others.
translations.いいわよ。あなたと楽しめれば、少しぐらいずるくても。:
It'll be okay. I don't mind if
it's a little unfair as long
as I can make you happy.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、冬のスポーツもやっぱりダメ？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you aren't good at winter
sports, right？
translations.無理ならそう言ってね。無理なのに誘ってイヤな思い、させたくないから。:
If you don't like them, you
must tell me, okay？ I don't
want to force you to come with
me.
translations.ううん。あなたと一緒ならどこに行っても楽しめるから。:
No. As long as I can be with
you, it doesn't matter where
we go.
translations.えっと……スキーなら、少しだけ。:
Well... I can ski. Just a
little bit though.
translations.田舎のおばあちゃんちがね、雪国なの。だから小さい頃に、少しだけ。:
My grandma's hometown has lots
of snow. That's why I skied a
little bit when I was a kid.
translations.へぇ。じゃあ、今年の冬はスキー場かな。:
Eh？ Then we can go skiing
together this winter, right？
translations.うん。それでおっきな雪だるま、ふたりで作ろうね。:
Yeah. We'll be making a big
snowman together, okay？
translations.あ、うん……前にＴＶでやってたの。ひとりっきりのクリスマスは寒いけど、好きな人と:
Ah, well... I saw it on TV.
It's cold to be alone on
Christmas, but if you have
someone with you, it'll be
warm.
translations.それでホットなんだ。:
So, they called it "Hot
Christmas," huh？
translations.うん。あなたと出会ってからは、私にとってもね。:
Yeah. I've always felt warm
ever since I met you.
translations.そしてもちろん、●にとっても。:
I feel the same way, too, of
course.
translations.私が、暖めてあげる。だからあなたも、私を暖めてね？:
I'll always make you feel
warm, so you have to do the
same for me, okay？
translations.もちろんホテルのスィートルームだよね？:
Oh yeah. We'll have a night
cruise in a helicopter, too.
translations.そうだ。ヘリコプターでナイトクルージングなんていうのもどうかな？:
Oh yeah. We'll have a night
cruise in a helicopter, too.
translations.ふふ、冗談に決まってるでしょ？:
Hehe. I was just joking, of
course.
translations.私の理想は、どこでもいいからふたりっきりで、静かにすごすことよ。:
My ideal Christmas is that we
can spend our peaceful time
together, anywhere, just the
two of us.
translations.プレゼントもいいの。あなたが一緒にいてくれるだけで、私は充分。:
A present might be nice, but
just being able to be with you
is more than enough for me.
translations.ふふ、ごめんね。ついイジワルしたくなっちゃって。:
Hehe, sorry. I just felt like
teasing you a bit.
translations.ふふ。この季節って、ひとりの人にはすごく残酷だと思わない？:
Hehe. Do you think it's cruel
if you have to be alone during
this season？
translations.だって、日本だとバレンタインに並ぶ恋愛イベントみたいなものでしょ？:
In Japan, it's another
occasion for lovers besides
Valentine's, right？
translations.だからずっと、残酷な季節だなぁって思ってたの。:
That's why I had always
thought of it as a cruel
season.
translations.今でもそう思ってる？:
How about now？ Do you still
feel the same？
translations.ううん。だって、あなたがいるもの。:
No. Because I already have
you.
translations.うん。●も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいれば、あったかいよ。:
Yeah. Me, too. It feels so
warm to be with
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ふふ。今年のクリスマス、お姉さんがもっとあっためてあげる▼:
Hehe. This Christmas, this big
sister will make you feel even
warmer▼
translations.今年一番の出来事ってなに？ あなたにとっての。:
What was the most important
thing that happened to you
this year？
translations.やっぱり、付き合い始めたことかな。:
Of course, it was our first
date.
translations.……本当はね、ＯＫしてもらえるなんて思ってなかったんだ。:
...Right. I still can't
believe you said "Okay" to me
back then.
translations.とにかくモヤモヤした片思いを終わらせたいって……それだけ考えてたの。:
I always felt depressed and
thought that it would end up
as my unrequited love...
translations.終わるつもり？:
You thought it'd end up like
that？
translations.うん。だから驚いたの。だって、終わるつもりが、始まりになっちゃったんだもの。:
Yeah. That's why I was
surprised because what I
thought would end turned out
to be a new start.
translations.……来年も、よろしくね。:
...Please take care of me next
year, too.
translations.こっちこそ、よろしく。:
Same here. Please take care of
me.
translations.付き合い始めたこともそうだけど、●としては……ほら、初めてのキスかな。:
Since we started dating, it's
that thing... I mean, our
first kiss.
translations.あっ、うん……私もそうかな。それに、ちょっと不思議だった……。:
Ah, yeah... It's the same to
me. It was really
mysterious...
translations.たったあれだけのことで……唇が触れ合っただけなのに、あなたのことがすごくわかった:
Because it was just that...
The moment our lips touched, I
felt like I had known you ever
since a long, long time ago.
translations.よくわからないけど……すごく、嬉しいの。そう感じたことが。:
I don't really know, but... it
was such a pleasant feeling.
translations.うん……だからあの瞬間は、きっと特別なのよ。:
Yeah... It was a special
moment.
translations.二人だけの特別か……。:
A special moment for just the
two of us...
translations.あん……だからあ、ほら、あれ。:
Hmm... It must be... Come on,
that one.
translations.今年もいろいろあったね。:
Many things happened this
year, huh？
translations.うん。来年の今頃になっても、またこうしていられればいいんだけど……。:
Yeah. It'd be nice if we can
still be this way next year...
translations.いられるかな？: Will you still be with me？
translations.いられるよ。きっとまた、いろいろあったなー、って言い合ってるよ。:
I will. And we'll talk about
what happened in the past
year, like this.
translations.いろいろ、あるのかな。:
I wonder if there will be a
lot of things to talk about.
translations.来年もふたりでいろいろしようね。約束よ？:
Let's do a lot of things
together next year, okay？ Can
you promise？
translations.ふふふ。もうじき春だもの、当然よ。:
Hehehe. Spring is coming, so
it's natural.
translations.春だからって、寝坊の常習犯になったらダメよ？:
Don't keep your habit of
oversleeping even in spring,
okay？
translations.大丈夫、大丈夫。: I'll be fine, I'll be fine.
translations.春だけは別って人もいるみたいよ？:
There are people who always
get sleepy in spring.
translations.ふふ。お昼寝にもいい季節だから、膝枕なんてのもありかもね。:
Hehe. It's a nice season to
take an afternoon nap. I can
let you sleep on my lap.
translations.それは眠くなくてもお願いしたいかも。:
In that case, I'd like to do
that even when I'm not sleepy.
translations.うん、ちょっとだけ……やっぱり春だからかな？:
Yeah, a little bit... Maybe
because it's spring.
translations.ううん、そこまで眠いわけじゃないの。なんていうか……ポカポカしてて、いい感じ？:
No, I'm not that sleepy. How
should I say this...？ The
weather is just so warm that I
feel relaxed.
translations.ふふ。それにあなたが隣りにいるから、かな？:
Hehe, and because you're near
me, I think.
translations.うーん……私にとっての、ネコの日溜まりみたいな感じ？:
Yeah... To me, you're like the
sunny spot for a cat, you
know？
translations.安心できる場所ってこと？:
You mean a place where you can
feel at peace？
translations.うん。……あなたにとっての私もそうだといいんだけどな。:
Yeah... I hope you feel the
same way with me, too.
translations.ちょっとずつ暑くなってきたね。:
It's getting warmer and
warmer, huh？
translations.うん。あ、上着脱ぐ？ 今日も少し暑いし……。:
Yeah. Ah, do you want to take
off your jacket？ Today's
quite warm...
translations.大丈夫。●より▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？ 暑くない？:
I'm fine. And how about you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Is it too hot？
translations.今は平気。ただ日差しの下は……。:
I'm okay for now. But if I'm
directly under the sun, I...
translations.あ、暑いわけじゃないの。紫外線対策、全然してないから少し心配で。:
Ah, it's not about the heat. I
just haven't applied any
sunblock today, so I was a
little worried.
translations.弱くはないけど、そんなに強くもないの。お姉さん、もう歳だから。:
Not that it's sensitive, but
strong sunlight isn't good for
my skin. My skin is aging, you
know？
translations.それだけピチピチの肌なのに？:
But your skin still looks very
nice.
translations.もぅ……冗談なんだから、軽く受け流すのっ。:
Hey... I was just joking. Can
you take it less
seriously...？
translations.うん。でも、心頭……なんとかすれば火もまた涼しって言うでしょ？:
Yeah, but if you train your
mind to... something, even the
fire will feel cool, right？
translations.心頭……なんだっけ？:
Train your mind to...
something？ What's that
missing word？
translations.うーん……め、で始まった気がするんだけど？:
Hmm... I think it starts with
a "t."
translations.心頭め……め……メラニン？:
Train your mind to t...
transparent？
translations.ああん、そうじゃなくて、め……め……めん？ めんなんとか？:
Aaah, that's not right. T...
T... Tree？ Tree something？
translations.そういえば熱いラーメンを食べれば逆に涼しくなるって言うけど、本当だと思う？:
Anyway, I heard that if we eat
hot noodle soup on a hot day,
it would feel refreshing. Do
you think it's true？
translations.なんか、頭働かないね。:
.......Somehow, our brains
aren't working today, huh？
translations.最近、朝とか夕方とかになると急に肌寒くなってこない？:
Do you think it's getting
chilly in the morning and
evening lately？
translations.でも、まだ秋って感じじゃないよね？:
But it still doesn't feel like
fall at all.
translations.ふふ。そういえば秋といえば、なにを連想する？:
Hehe. By the way, what do you
think when you talk about
fall？
translations.うーん……もみじ、かな？:
Well... Leaves changing
colors, I think？
translations.そうじゃなくて……いろいろあるでしょ？ 読書の秋とか、スポーツの秋とか。:
Not just that... People
usually say "Fall is for
reading" or "Fall is for
sports" or something like
that.
translations.もちろん、ロマンスの秋。寒くなってくるから、腕を組むのも普通でしょ？:
Of course, fall is for
romance. It gets cold during
fall, so it's natural to link
arms with each other, right？
translations.（暑くても組んでくれていいけど……）:
(I don't mind doing that even
if it's warm...)
translations.ねぇ、なにか食べたいものある？:
Hey, is there anything you
want to eat？
translations.食べたいもの？ 今は特にお腹は空いてないけど。:
Something I want to eat？ I'm
not really hungry right now,
though.
translations.もう、そうじゃなくて。ほら、秋っていろいろと美味しいものが旬になる季節でしょ？:
Geez, I didn't mean that. Come
on. There is a lot of
delicious food that's only
available in fall, right？
translations.ああ、食欲の秋か。:
Ah, people say "Fall is the
season for a good appetite,"
right？
translations.うーん……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒に食べれば、なんでも美味しい気がするんだよね。:
Hmm... When I'm with
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
anything I eat becomes very
delicious.
translations.もぅ……嬉しいけど、それじゃ何すればいいかわからないじゃない。:
Geez... That makes me happy,
but now I can't decide what to
do.
translations.どこかに美味しいもの食べに行ったり、それとも……作ってみたり。:
I want to go eat something
with you... Or maybe cook
something for you.
translations.お、期待していいのかな。: h, can I look forward to it？
translations.うう……さすがにそろそろ冬かな。:
Urgh... I'm sure winter is
coming soon.
translations.平気。●より▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
I'm okay.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
how about you？
translations.私、寒さには強いから。それより本当に平気？:
Me？ I'm okay with cold
weather. But are you sure
you're okay？
translations.へえ、寒さに強いんだ。:
Hehe. I'm good with cold
weather.
translations.あ、うん。それに四季の中だと、一番好きなの。落ち着いた感じがして。:
Ah, okay. Winter is the season
I like most. It makes me feel
calm.
translations.年末年始も含めて？:
And we'll have long holidays
on New Year's, right？
translations.せわしないのは苦手かな。だって師走って、先生も走っちゃうのよ？:
I'm usually busy around that
time and I'm not good at doing
things in a hurry.
translations.今年は、あなたとゆっくりできればいいかな。:
Maybe I should just relax with
you this year.
translations.寒いのは苦手？ 使い捨てカイロあるけど使う？:
Are you not good with cold
weather？ I have this
disposable hand warmer. You
wanna use it？
translations.もぉ、もっとあったかい格好しなきゃ。:
Geez. You should wear
something thicker than this.
translations.風邪なんかひいちゃダメよ。:
It'd be bad if you caught a
cold.
translations.私は大丈夫、ほんとに寒くないから。少しはお姉さんの言うこと聞いてちょうだい。:
I'll be okay. I'm not cold.
Just listen to this big sister
for once.
translations.もぅ……少しくらい自分から甘えてくれてもいいのに。:
Geez... It's okay to behave
like a spoiled child
sometimes, all right？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、本当は……キス、嫌いだったりする？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you actually... hate to
kiss？
translations.なんとなく、キスする時に緊張してるっぽいから……。:
Somehow, you always seem very
nervous when we kiss...
translations.うん……だから、本当はイヤなんじゃないかなって。:
Yeah... So I think that you
might hate it.
translations.そんなことない！ そんなこと……ただ、ちょっと……。:
That's not the case！ It's...
It's a little...
translations.だから……ちょっと……その……ちょっとだけ、恥ずかしいから……。:
It's... a little... Well...
Just a little embarrassing...
translations.ちょっと訊きたいんだけど……キスって……どう？:
I just want to hear your
opinion. What do you think
about... a kiss？
translations.どうって……私は好きよ？:
What do I think...？ I like
it.
translations.ふふ、そうよ。でも……好きっていうより、安心するかな。:
Hehe, really. But rather than
like, it makes me feel
relieved.
translations.ひょっとしてイヤなのを我慢してるんじゃないかなって。:
I was thinking that you might
hate it but just tried to bear
with it.
translations.そっか……そうだとしたら、どうする？:
Really？ ...If that's the
case, what would you do？
translations.あなたにキスされると……とっても気持ちよくなって、幸せな気持ちになるのよ？:
It feels really good when you
kiss me. It really makes me
happy, okay？
translations.そうなんだ……。なんか照れるな。:
I see... Somehow, this is
embarrassing.
translations.ふふ、ふふふ。今のあなた、とっても可愛い顔してる▼:
Hehe. Hehehe. Your face now is
very cute▼
translations.突然だけど……●とキスするのって、どうかな？:
It might be sudden, but...
What do you think about my
kiss？
translations.どうって……何か心配？:
？*What do I think？ Are you
worried about it？
translations.もしかしてイヤじゃないかなあって……。:
I wonder if you might hate
it...
translations.そんな、どうして？ イヤじゃないよ？: What？ Why？ I don't hate it.
translations.なんとなく。気にしすぎかな。:
Okay. I probably think too
much.
translations.そうね、気にしすぎ。たしかにムードやタイミングも大事だけど、あんまり縮こまってち:
Yeah, you think too much.
Anyway, the mood and the
timing are very important, and
you must not rush it, okay？
translations.そうよ、お姉さんも応援してあげるから▼:
Yeah. This big sister will be
rooting for you▼
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、どう思ってるのかなって。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What do you think about it？
translations.えっと……その、正直に言って……いい？:
Well... Hmm... Can I tell you
frankly？
translations.そういうのはちょっと……よくわからない、かな。:
I still don't know about
something like that...
translations.……ごめん、変なこときいて。:
...Sorry for asking such a
weird question.
translations.ううん。こっちこそ、ちゃんと答えられなくて。:
Don't worry. I'm sorry that I
can't give you a proper
answer.
translations.あ、ううん。キスする時って、なに考えてるのかなあ、って……。:
Ah, no. I wonder what you were
thinking when we kissed...
translations.何か考えてる余裕が無いっていうか……。:
I mean I didn't feel calm
enough to be thinking about
anything else...
translations.えっ!? それって唇の……とか？:
Eh！？ You mean our lips... or
something like that？
translations.そういうのもあるけど……好きだって感じとか、そういうのを。:
That, too... But I could feel
your love. I could tell that
you love me.
translations.私!? あ、えと……同じ、かな？ うん。同じ感じ……かな。:
Me！？ Ah, well... Same, I
think. Yeah, it's the same...
I think.
translations.ひょっとして答えにくいかもしれないけど……私とキスするのって、好き？:
This might be a little
difficult to answer, but... Do
you like it when we kiss？
translations.んー……あんまり好きじゃなかったら、しなくてもいいよ？:
Hmm... If you don't like it,
we don't have to kiss.
translations.だってあなた、物凄く覚悟決めてからキスしてくるでしょ？ だから……。:
Because you always take your
time until you kiss me,
right？ So...
translations.違うよ。●も、好きだからしてるんだ。:
No. I kiss you because I
really want to.
translations.イヤなわけないよ。でも、あんまりしたら、逆にイヤがられるかなあって……。:
I don't hate it. But if I do
it recklessly, I'm afraid that
you might not like it...
translations.じゃあ、あれは緊張してるんだ？:
Then that's the reason why
you're nervous.
translations.うん……していいか、ダメなのか、迷ってるんだ。:
Yeah... I can't decide if I
should kiss you or not.
translations.そっか……ふふ。そうなんだ。: I see... Hehe. So, that's why.
translations.ごめん、変なことに気をつかわせて。:
Sorry to make you worry about
this.
translations.ううん、そういうことなら。あとはタイミングだけは選んでね。:
No. If that's what concerns
you, just try to choose the
right timing, okay？
translations.ねぇ。私とするキス、好き？:
Hey, do you like it when we
kiss？
translations.気になるの。おねがい、教えてくれる？:
I'm worried. Please. Can you
answer me？
translations.私は言えるよ？: I can tell you, all right？
translations.うん。私はあなたとキスするのが好き。大好きなの。:
Yeah. I like it when we kiss.
I love it.
translations.ふふ。あなたが上手に説明してくれたら、答えてあげるね。:
Hehe. When you can answer my
previous question clearly,
I'll tell you.
translations.答えが見つかるまで……またキスしてもいいから。……ただし、いつでもどこでもってわ:
Until you find the answer, we
shall keep kissing. But,
remember. It's not something
you can do anytime, anywhere,
okay？
translations.（これは……からかわれてるのかな）:
(I wonder... whether she's
teasing me now.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、●に告白した時のこと、思い出すことある？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you remember when you
confessed to me？
translations.怖かったと言えば……ね。でも、言わないでいる方が、もっと怖いと思ったの。:
I was scared... But, I'd feel
more scared if I didn't get it
out.
translations.だって……もし私が黙ってる間に、他の誰かがあなたに告白したら……。:
Because... If I kept quiet and
someone else confessed to you
before I did...
translations.そうなったら、私、多分だけど自分のことが許せなくなると思うの。:
If that happened, I probably
wouldn't be able to forgive
myself.
translations.だから、ダメならダメでいいから、この想いだけは届けなきゃって。そう思ったの。:
That's why I made up my mind
to confess to you. If you
rejected me, that would be
fine.
translations.そうだったんだ……でも、ダメじゃなかったよね？:
I see... But I didn't reject
you, okay？
translations.うん。私の想いに応えてくれて、すごく嬉しかった。:
Yeah, you accepted my
feelings. I was very happy.
translations.●だって……。: I was the one who was happy...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が●に告白する時って……やっぱりドキドキした？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
were you nervous when you
confessed to me？
translations.え!? な、なに、いきなり!?:
Eh！？ W-Why do you ask all of
a sudden！？
translations.うん、少し気になって。: Well, I just want to know.
translations.ええっと……うん、そうね。ドキドキは……しなかったかな？:
Umm... Well. I wasn't
nervous... I think.
translations.ドンドンドンって感じだった。:
It's more like I was in a
panic.
translations.心臓が破裂しそうだったの。息も苦しいし、落ち着こうとしても落ち着けないし……。:
It was like my heart was about
to explode and it was
difficult to breathe. I looked
calm but I wasn't calm at
all...
translations.だから、ドキドキじゃないのよ。そんなレベルじゃなくて、もっとすごかったのよ？:
So, it wasn't nervousness. It
was something much worse,
okay？
translations.うん。やっぱり、聞かないとわからないものだね。:
Yeah. If I didn't ask you, I
wouldn't know this.
translations.ふふ。だったら私もいつか、急に質問するから覚悟してね？:
Hehe. Then you should be
prepared that I might ask you
some sudden questions later
too, okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って●に告白した時、どういうこと考えてたの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what were you thinking when
you confessed to me？
translations.誰かに告白するって……すごい勇気だなぁって。:
To confess to someone, you
really need a lot of courage,
right？
translations.ふふ。それ、勇気じゃないわよ？:
Hehe. It's not courage, you
know？
translations.うん。私……本当は終わらせたかっただけなの。自分の気持ちを。:
Yeah. I... actually just
wanted to end my anxiety. So I
made up my mind.
translations.勉強もあるし、バイトも楽しいし……もっといろいろなことをしたいって思ってたけど、:
I had to study, to work, and
to do a lot of things. But no
matter what, I couldn't stop
thinking about you. That was
bad.
translations.そう。すごく怖かったけど、なにもしないで立ち止まってるほうがイヤだったし……。:
Yeah. I was really scared, but
it would be worse if I
didn't...
translations.自分でも、ちょっと冒険しちゃったなって思ってるのよ？:
It was like an adventure for
me somehow.
translations.それに……そこまで思い切れたの、きっと相手があなただったからだって……。:
And... I knew I dared to do
that because the one I fell in
love with was you...
translations.また告ってみました。ふふ。:
It's like I'm confessing to
you again now. Hehe.
translations.例えば●が▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に告白するとして……。:
What if I want to confess to
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...？
translations.例えばの話。あくまで、例えばの話だから。:
Just a what-if. Only a what-if
situation.
translations.あ、例えば……？ そっか……うん、そうよね。:
Ah, a what-if...？ I see...
Yeah, right...
translations.ううん、なんでもない。それで、もし告白するとして？:
No, never mind. So, if you
want to confess to me？
translations.うん。告白するとして……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だったら、どういうのが嬉しい？:
Yeah. If I want to confess to
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what should I do？
translations.うーん……あくまで私の場合だよね？:
Hmm... So, it's from my point
of view, right？
translations.そう。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だったらどうかって話。:
Yeah. What kind of confession
would
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
want to hear？
translations.私だったら……真っ直ぐな言葉で、ちゃんと言ってくれた方が嬉しいな。:
If it's me... I'd like to hear
a straightforward confession.
Just get it out.
translations.そうなんだ……うん、そういうことはちゃんと伝えないとね。:
I see... Yeah, it's better to
just get it out.
translations.え？ あ、ううん。なんでもないの。うん、なんでもないから。:
Eh？ Ah, no. It's nothing.
Yeah, it's really nothing.
translations.●達って、これからどうなるのかな。:
What do you think we will be
like from now on？
translations.なんとなく将来のことが気になって……。:
Somehow, I'm just worrying
about our future...
translations.考えたことなかったけど……うん、そうだね。どうなるんだろう？:
I've never thought about it,
but...
translations.いつか別れるようなことも、起きるのかな？:
Yeah, now I wonder how we will
be. Will we break up sometime
later？
translations.ん……でも私、あなた以外の人と付き合ってる自分、想像出来ないな。:
Hmm... But I can't think about
dating anyone else except you.
translations.だったら、それでいいのかもね。:
Then it's fine like this,
right？
translations.考えなくてもいいってこと。:
You don't have to worry about
it.
translations.うん。私ね、あなたのこと好きよ。きっと、これからもずっと。:
Yeah. I love you, okay？ I'll
always love you.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は●に告白したこと、後悔してない？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you regret it that you
confessed to me？
translations.●……いいカレシなのかな？:
...Am I a good boyfriend？ I
wonder.
translations.あ……もしかして私が年上だってこと、気にしてる？:
Ah... Are you worried because
I'm older than you？
translations.どうかな……自分でもよくわからないや。:
I'm not sure... I really don't
know why I'm worried.
translations.気にしてるよ。だって私も、自分が年下だったらよかったって思うもの。:
I'm also worried and I wish
that I could be younger than
you.
translations.でも、あなたが年下だから頼りないとか、そんなふうに思ったこと、一度もないの。:
Even though you're younger
than me, it's not like you're
not reliable.
translations.だから……うん、気になるのは周りの目だけで、それも些細なことよ。:
So... Yeah, even though I
still care how people would
see us, that's just something
trivial.
translations.だったら、いいんだけど……。:
But, even if you're okay with
it...
translations.もっと自分に自信持っていいのよ？ だって、あなたは私が好きになった人だもの。:
You should have more
confidence in yourself. You're
the person I love, okay？
translations.……うん、そうだね。ごめん、変なこと言って。:
...Yeah, you're right. Sorry
for being weird.
translations.ふふ。しっかりしてね、カレシさん▼:
Hehe. Pull yourself together,
my boyfriend▼
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は●と付き合ってて楽しい？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you enjoy going out with
me？
translations.えっ!? いきなりどうしたの？:
Eh！？ What is this all of a
sudden？
translations.ん……●、年下だし、子供っぽいって思われてる気がして……。:
Hmm... I'm younger than ,you,
so you might think that I'm
childish...
translations.……うん、確かにちょっと、子供っぽいかな？:
...Yeah, you're actually a
little childish, I think.
translations.でもね、そういう質問をするところが子供っぽい気がするの。:
Yeah, I feel like you're
childish to ask me such a
question.
translations.私はあなたが好きで、だから告白したの。わかる？:
I love you. That's why I
confessed to you. Got it？
translations.あなたがあなただから、私は好きになったのよ？ 子供っぽいところも、そうじゃないと:
You're like this, and that's
why I love you, okay？ The
childish part, and the other
parts, I love everything in
you.
translations.だから変に気を遣わないで、甘えたい時は甘えてもいいの。ね？:
So don't worry, okay？ When
you want to act spoiled, I'll
let you. All right？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……やっぱり年上の人だなぁ）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
You really are more mature
than me.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、自分のこと、ヤキモチ妬く方だと思う？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you think you easily get
jealous？
translations.どうかな？ あなたはどう思う？:
I'm not sure. What do you
think？
translations.うーん……想像できないね。:
Hmm... I can't imagine you
getting jealous.
translations.私のこと、信じてくれてるんでしょ？ だったら私、ヤキモチ妬かないから。:
I can trust you, right？
That's why I don't get
jealous.
translations.でも、それはそれで寂しいかな？:
But I'm a little sad that you
wouldn't get jealous for me.
translations.じゃあ、わからないようにする。でも……そうならないようにしてね。:
Then maybe I will. But...
don't intentionally try to
make me get jealous, okay？
translations.●が他の女の子と仲良くしてたら、やっぱりヤキモチ妬いたりする？:
If I get close to other girls,
will you be jealous？
translations.例えば……●と▲姉ヶ崎＊▲くらい。:
For example... As close as
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
and me.
translations.それってもう付き合ってるってことでしょ？ つまり私は捨てられているわけだから、ヤ:
If you're that close, you must
be dating her, right？ That
means you already dumped me. I
wouldn't have the right to be
jealous.
translations.ううん。私も変な答え方して、ごめんね。:
No, I'm also sorry for giving
you such a weird answer.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、ヤキモチ妬かない感じだよね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you don't easily get jealous,
right？
translations.ふふ。妬いた方がいい？:
Hehe. Do you want me to be
jealous？
translations.だから、例え他の女の子と仲良くしても平気なの。:
Then even if you get close to
other girls, I won't be
jealous.
translations.うーん……でも、少しは妬いて欲しい気も……。:
Hmm... But maybe you should
get jealous a little bit...
translations.カレシとしては？ ふふ。じゃあ、今度から女の子と話しているところ見るたび、妬いて:
A boyfriend's request？ Hehe.
Then I'll be jealous whenever
you talk to or look at other
girls, okay？
translations.それはそれで……。: But that's not what I want...
translations.もぅ。だったら、時々、ちょっとだけ妬いてあげる。それでいい？:
Geez. I'll be jealous
occasionally then. Are you
satisfied now？
translations.……そのままでいいよ。ごめん、変なこと言って。:
...You don't have to. Sorry
for asking such a weird
question.
translations.ううん。そういうふうに気にしてるってわかったから、少し嬉しいくらい。:
Don't worry. To think that you
wanted me to do something like
this, I'm a little happy.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、自分はヤキモチ妬きだと思う？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Do you think you usually get
jealous？
translations.ごめん、変な質問して。なんとなく気になって。:
Sorry for asking something
weird. I'm just curious.
translations.そうね……私、すごいよ。ヤキモチ。:
Well... I can get very
jealous.
translations.ううん。黙って思い詰めて、そのまま溜め込んでいっちゃうタイプ。:
No. I'd be very quiet and
brood over it. My jealousy
would pile up then.
translations.カレシが浮気なんかしたら、もうダメかも。:
If my boyfriend betrayed me,
I'm probably done for.
translations.なんてね、本当のところはわからないの。実際に体験してないもの。:
...That's what I think. I've
never experienced it myself,
so I still don't understand
that feeling.
translations.ふふ。でも実際どうなのかな？ 自分でも知りたいような、知るのが怖いような……。:
Hehe. But I wonder how it
would feel. I'm not sure if I
want to know it or not. It can
be scary...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、ヤキモチ妬いたらどうなるのかな？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what are you like when you get
jealous？
translations.えっ？ どうって……前にもそんな話したかもしれないけど……うーん。:
Eh？ What...？ I think we've
talked about this before...
Hmm.
translations.うん。ちょっと想像つかないの。でも、妬かないんじゃないかな……？:
Yeah, I can't picture it.
Maybe I don't get jealous...
translations.もし妬いたとしたら？:
Then suppose that you get
jealous...？
translations.うーん……きっと、それより先に泣いちゃうかな？:
Hmm... I think I'll be crying
first.
translations.だって、ヤキモチを妬いちゃうような何かがあるってことでしょ？:
There has to be the reason
that makes me get jealous,
right？
translations.私のこと、泣かせてみたいの？: Do you want to make me cry？
translations.ふふ。その言葉、ずっと信じるからね？:
Hehe. I'll trust you with your
words, okay？
translations.あのさ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がヤキモチ妬くようなことって、どのあたりから？:
Well,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what will you be like when you
get jealous？
translations.前にもそんな話したよね……。どのあたりって……だいたいのことは平気だと思うけど…:
We talked about this before,
right？ What will I be
like...？ I think I can stay
calm...
translations.知らない女の子と話をしてるのは？:
What if I talk to a girl you
don't know？
translations.ご飯を食べるのは？:
What if I have dinner with
her？
translations.ちょっと引っかかるかな……あ、でも、気になるのは特別扱いしてるかどうかだから。:
I'd probably get a little
irritated... Ah, but I'd have
my special measurement in the
case.
translations.私にしかしないようなこと、その子にもしてたら……妬いちゃうかも。:
If you do something that you
should only do to me to that
girl, I'll get jealous.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にしかしてないことって……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what do you mean by "something
I should only do to you"？
translations.いろいろしてるよ？:
There are a lot of things,
right？
translations.んーっ……ごめん、よくわかんない。:
Hmm... Sorry, I really don't
know.
translations.ふふ。いいの、私がわかってれば。:
Hehe. It's okay that I'm the
only one who knows what they
are.
translations.仮にだけど、●が▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にヤキモチ妬かせるようなことしたら、どうする？:
Just for example, if I make
you jealous, what will you be
like, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そんなこと訊いて、どうするの？:
Why do you ask me that
question？
translations.そんなこと訊かれたら、そういうことするつもりなのかなあ……って、思っちゃうよ？:
With that question, you make
me doubt whether you've
cheated on me.
translations.少しくらいなら……私、見逃してあげるよ？:
If it's just a little bit, I
can try to overlook it.
translations.しなくていいよ。絶対、しないから。:
I didn't do anything. Really,
it's nothing.
translations.ふふ。だったら聞かなくてもいいじゃない。:
Hehe. Then you didn't have to
ask me that question.
translations.（うーん、かわされた？）:
(Hmm, did she try to avoid
answering it？)
translations.本当のところ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はスキンシップって好き？:
Tell me the truth.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you like skinship？
translations.えっ……急に、なに？:
Eh？ ...What is this all of a
sudden？
translations.あ、うん。あんまりベタベタし過ぎるのも、よくないのかなって。:
Ah, well, I'm afraid that I'm
clinging to you too much and
that might not be good.
translations.もしかして私……イヤそうにしてた？:
Could it be that... I make you
feel bad？
translations.今も、少し緊張しちゃうけど……それだけなの。イヤがってるわけじゃないの。:
Even now, I'm still a little
nervous. ...And that's the
reason. It's not because I
hate it.
translations.それに……本当にイヤだったら、ちゃんと言うから……。:
Plus... If you made me feel
uncomfortable, I'd tell you
honestly...
translations.つまり……少しはベタベタしても？:
Which means... sometimes I
cling to you too much？
translations.少しよ？ あ、でも、どうしても、そうしたいって言うなら……。:
Just a little bit. Ah, but I
still want you to be close to
me, no matter what...
translations.じゃあ。少し、ずつ……。:
Then let's try to progress a
little bit at a time...
translations.うん……そうね、少しずつ……。:
Yeah... That's right. A little
bit at a time...
translations.ほら、中にはベタベタするのが嫌いな人もいるって言うし。:
Come on. There are people who
don't like others to cling
onto them too much.
translations.そう……かな？ そういう人のほうが珍しいんじゃない？:
Is... that so？ I think it's
rare to find anyone like that.
translations.私の周囲だと、少数派かな？ あなたはどうなの？:
Maybe I don't know that many
people. What do you think
then？
translations.●？ ●は……相手が▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だったら、好きなほうかな。:
Me？ For me, if it's with
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I think I like it.
translations.じゃあ、おあずけ。しばらくスキンシップ禁止。:
Then we're not gonna do it.
Skinship will be forbidden for
a while.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はベタベタされるのって、どう？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what do you think about people
who are clinging to you？
translations.スキンシップ？ イヤじゃないけど、どうして？:
Skinship, you mean？ I don't
hate it. Why？
translations.積極的にして欲しいとか、そこまでじゃないんだ。:
But you don't like it when the
guy is being too assertive,
right？
translations.もう少し積極的なほうが好きなんだ。:
So, you mean you're the
assertive type, huh？
translations.女の子はもっと優しく、壊れ物を扱うつもりでいないとダメになるよ？:
Girls are vulnerable, so you
have to be gentle and handle
them with care, all right？
translations.ふふ。でもね、空気を読んでくれれば、お姉さん、けっこう心が広いのよ？:
Hehe. But if you can read the
mood well, this big sister is
very generous, you know？
translations.ムードが大切ってこと。私も女の子だから……ね？:
The mood is very important.
I'm also a girl... okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はスキンシップって、どう思う？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What do you think about
skinship？
translations.えっ？ 急になに？:
Eh？ Why do you ask all of a
sudden？
translations.なんとなく気になって。ほら、人によって、それぞれだし……。:
Somehow, I'm just curious
about it. Well, people have
different opinions, right？
translations.私は……相手によるかな？:
For me... It depends on my
partner, I think.
translations.そっか。例えば付き合ってる相手だったら、ある程度は、とか。:
I see. For example, if you're
dating a guy, it'd be okay if
he touches you, right？
translations.うん、そうだよ。相手が大事。:
Yeah, that's right. It's all
up to him.
translations.そうだよね、●もそうだな。: I see. I think I get it.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はさ、●のスキンシップって、どう思う？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what do you think about my
skinship？
translations.イヤじゃないけど……うん、前よりもっとイヤじゃない、かな。:
I don't hate it... Hmm, I
think I like it more than
before.
translations.そっか。いつも●の方からだし、どうなのかなって……。:
I see. I wonder if it's okay
that I always do it...
translations.なに？ 本当は嫌なんじゃないか、とか？:
What？ Do you mean you
actually hate it？
translations.ふふ。あのね、あなたが触れてくれる時、やったって思うこと、あるよ。:
Hehe. Well, there are times
when I feel very happy that
you touch me.
translations.うん、嬉しい。恥ずかしいのも、あるけど。:
Yeah, I'm very happy. But
there are times when I feel
embarrassed, too.
translations.恋人ってスキンシップが大切だっていうけど……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はどう思う？:
People say that skinship is
important for lovers...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what do you think？
translations.とっても大切だと思うけど……どうかしたの？:
I think it's very important,
but... What's the matter？
translations.うん。こう……どういうのが、好きなのかなって。:
Well... I've been wondering
what kind of skinship you'd
like.
translations.こうして手を握ったり？:
If I grab your hand like
this？
translations.もっと……近づいてみたり？:
Or... Should I get closer to
you？
translations.頭を撫でられたり、耳元くすぐられたり、頬を撫でられたり？:
What about when I pat your
head, or when I tickle your
ears, or when I pinch your
cheeks？
translations.ほんと、からかいがいがあるわね▼: It's really fun to tease you▼
translations.（うぅ、完全に遊ばれた……）:
(Urgh, she was just toying
with me...)
translations.●の……スキンシップって言うのかな。それって、どう思う？:
About my skinship... I wonder
what you think.
translations.触れられたり、撫でられたり、囁かれたり、抱きしめられたり……。:
When you touch me, or caress
me, or whisper something in my
ears, or hug me...
translations.声を聞いているだけでも、私、すごく幸せな気持ちになるの。:
Actually, I feel very happy
just by hearing your voice.
translations.自分でも危ないって思うけど、きっと、もう手遅れなのね。:
I know it's bad, but I think
it's too late to do anything
with it.
translations.彼氏中毒。あなたがいないと不安になるけど、いるだけで幸せになるの。:
I'm already addicted to my
boyfriend. I feel uneasy when
you're not around, and I feel
very happy when you're with
me.
translations.だったら●は彼女中毒かな？:
Then I think I'm also addicted
to my girlfriend.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、テレビは観る方？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you like to watch TV？
translations.ということは、あんまり観ない方なんだ。:
Which means you usually don't
watch TV, huh？
translations.うん。あとは、本読んでるかな。:
Yeah, and sometimes I like to
read books.
translations.そっか。でも、そんな感じだよね。:
I see. I guess that's what I
picture you'd do.
translations.あ、でも好きな番組もあるよ。:
Ah, but there's a TV program
that I like.
translations.深夜の洋画番組。たまに古い映画が観られるから、楽しいのよ？:
The late night Western movies
program. Sometimes they show
very old movies. They're very
good.
translations.あ、これも映画ね。うん、やっぱり私、テレビより映画みたい。:
Ah, you'd call it a movie,
huh？ Yeah, but for me, I
prefer watching movies rather
than watching TV.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、特に好きな食べ物ってなにかある？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What is your favorite food？
translations.なんでも好きだけど……強いて言えば……のど飴？:
I love everything, but... If
you ask what I like most, it's
gonna be cough drops.
translations.ううん、普通のものは特別好きってわけじゃないの。:
No, not regular candies in
general.
translations.のど飴が特別なんだ。: So, it has to be cough drops？
translations.多分、癖になってるのかな。:
Yeah. It has become a habit of
mine.
translations.ううん、そういうわけじゃないけど。一時ハマって、そのまま。:
No, that's not the case. I
started to like cough drops
some time ago, and it's just
continued.
translations.たしかに、飽きはこないね。:
You haven't gotten bored of it
yet, huh？
translations.ふふ、そんな感じ。ごめんね、つまらない回答で。:
Hehe. That's right. Sorry, my
answer is just so plain.
translations.そういえば▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って好きなスポーツあるの？:
Speaking of which,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, do
you have any sports you like？
translations.え？ あ……どうして？: Eh？ Ah... Why do you ask？
translations.ちょっと気になって。なにかある？:
I'm just curious. Are there
any？
translations.ううん、私って根っからのインドア派だから。:
No. I'm an indoor type by
nature.
translations.夏に泳ぎに行くってのは？:
Do you go to swim in summer,
at least？
translations.え!? あ、うん……あんまり、かな？:
Eh！？ Ah, hmm... Not much, I
think.
translations.海とかプール、行かないの？:
You don't go to the sea or the
swimming pool？
translations.行かなくはないけど……笑わないでね？:
Not that I don't want to go,
but... Don't laugh, okay？
translations.私、泳ぐのは、ちょっと……。あぁ恥ずかしい。:
I... can't swim. Ah, this is
embarrassing.
translations.（そこまで気にしなくても……）:
(You don't have to be that
embarrassed...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、音楽はよく聴くほう？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you often listen to music？
translations.ううん、あんまり。たまに聴くのも映画音楽ぐらい……かな？:
No, not quite often. Usually,
I listen to movie soundtracks,
I think.
translations.気に入った映画のサントラ、よく買っちゃうの。意外といいのよ？:
I bought many CDs of my
favorite movies' soundtracks.
They are very good.
translations.もしかして観ない映画のサントラも買ったり？:
Could it be that you also buy
soundtracks for the movies you
haven't watched？
translations.マイナーな映画だと、どうしてもそうなるかな？ こっちで上映してくれないんだもの。:
For some indie movies, that's
pretty much the case. They
aren't showed in the theaters
here.
translations.へぇ、マイナーな映画にもサントラってあるんだ。:
Eh？ Even indie movies have
soundtracks, too.
translations.ふふ。映画の世界って、奥が深いのよ？ 例えば……。:
Hehe, the movie world is much
more profound than you might
think. For example...
translations.（なんかスイッチ押しちゃった……？）:
(I feel like I've just turned
on a switch...)
translations.そう言えば▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、ホラー以外で何か趣味ってある？:
Speaking of which,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you have other hobbies
besides watching horror
movies？
translations.ホラーは……趣味といえば趣味だけど、そういう意味じゃないでしょ？ うーん。:
Horror movies for me... You
can say that it's my hobby,
but it actually isn't. Hmm.
translations.自分でもよく判らないけど、食べたあとに捨て忘れること多くて、つい集めちゃったの。:
I didn't intend to, but many
times, I forgot to throw them
away after I finish eating.
Now I have them in 4 file
folders.
translations.ファイルに……。:
You put them in file
folders...？
translations.もちろん真剣にやってるわけじゃないんだけど、でも、なぜか続いちゃって。:
It's not like I'm very serious
about that. But somehow I just
continue collecting them.
translations.うん、趣味というより癖ね。ここまできちゃうと。:
Yeah, it's more like my habit
rather than a hobby. I've been
doing it for quite a long
time.
translations.うん。たいていはね。ウシとウマは、ちょっと苦手だけど。:
Yeah, most of them. But I'm
not very good with cows and
horses.
translations.あのヨダレが、ちょっと……ね。:
They're usually drooling. And
that's... Well...
translations.じゃあ、好きな動物は？:
Then how about your favorite
animal？
translations.うん。あの丸っぽい感じが好きなの、愛嬌もあるし。あと親近感っていうか。:
Yeah, they look cute with
round shape and I feel like I
have an affinity with them.
translations.私、ちょっと抜けてるし、タヌキっぽいかなって。:
Somehow I can picture myself
as a raccoon dog.
translations.聞いたかもしれないけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の将来の夢って、なに？:
I might've already asked you
this, but
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what is your dream for your
future？
translations.ふふ。誰かさんのお嫁さん……なんて言って欲しい？:
Hehe. "Being someone's bride."
...Is that what you want to
hear？
translations.言われるんじゃないかって、少しだけ思ってた。:
I was expecting a little that
you'd say that.
translations.でも……お嫁さんかな。やっぱり。:
But... Actually, I really want
to be a bride.
translations.ううん。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の花嫁姿って……きっと、すごく似合ってるよ。:
No. I'm sure
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
will look great in
a wedding dress.
translations.ふふ。私が着たいのはウェディングドレスじゃなくて、エプロンのほうなの。:
Hehe. What I want to wear
isn't a wedding dress, but an
apron.
translations.台所に立って、赤ん坊をあやして、帰ってきた旦那様を出迎えて……そういう感じの。:
Cooking in the kitchen,
raising a baby, welcoming a
husband from his work...
Something like that.
translations.……そっちのほうが似合いそうだね。:
...I can picture that those
things suit you.
translations.ふふ。何年か経ったら見られるかもしれないわよ？:
Hehe. If you wait long enough,
you might be able to see it
with your own eyes.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は将来の夢って、ある？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you have a dream for your
future？
translations.ホラー作家になりたい、とか？:
Do you want to be a horror
novel writer？
translations.それは無理。私に作家なんて無理よ。:
That's impossible. Being a
writer is impossible for me.
translations.そう？ 本もたくさん読んでるのに？:
Really？ But you read a lot of
books.
translations.ううん。たくさん読んでるから逆にわかるの。:
No. The more I read, the more
I realize it.
translations.私には創作意欲って、あまりないみたい。:
I don't have the creative urge
for writing.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にはないの？ こういうホラーが見たいとか、そういうの。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
really？ But you also watch a
lot of horror movies.
translations.無いわけじゃないけど……。:
It's not like I don't want to
write, but...
translations.それを作ろうとは？:
Or do you want to make
movies？
translations.うーん……やっぱり、そこまでは思えないな。:
No... I've never thought about
that.
translations.そっか、ちょっと残念かな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の作るホラー、興味あるのに。:
I see. But that's too bad. I'm
very interested in
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
horror movies.
translations.ふふ。そんなに興味があるなら、私のと言わずに、どう？:
Hehe. If you like to see
horror movies this much, how
about watching some that are
already made？
translations.（う、やぶをつついてしまった）:
(Is she going to force me to
watch them？)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は誰か憧れる女の人って、いる？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you have any female role
models？
translations.んーっ……そういうことは考えたこと、ないから……。:
Hmm... I've never thought
about that...
translations.自分に自信があるってこと？:
So you have confidence in
yourself, huh？
translations.ううん、そんなことない。ただ……。:
No, that's not the case.
But...
translations.ほら、誰かに憧れるってことは、自分にないものを相手の中に見ているわけでしょ？:
Come on. If you set anyone
else as your role model,
you'll try to become someone
that's not you, right？
translations.うん、そうなの。だから私の場合は、そのないものをどうやったら自分のものにできるか:
Yeah. For me, if there's
something in other people that
I don't have, I'll think about
how I can achieve that by
myself.
translations.だから憧れる人がいない？:
That's why you don't have a
role model？
translations.うん。人ではなく、その足りない何かに関心が向いちゃうから。:
Yeah. It's not about a person.
If there's something I lack,
I'll just try to work my way
toward it.
translations.ううん。この人をカノジョにして正解だったなあって。:
No. I'm just thinking that I
made the right decision to
have you as my girlfriend.
translations.もぅ……不意打ちは卑怯だよ？:
Geez... Don't spring stuff on
me, okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が憧れる女性って、誰かいる？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Do you have any female role
models？
translations.同性と異性はちょっと違うし。誰かいる？ あんなふうになりたいって思う女性。:
It's different, right？ I just
wonder if there's any woman
you want to be like.
translations.うーん……そういうのはいないかな？:
Hmm... I don't think there's
any.
translations.むしろ私は私以外にはなれない……ちょっと気取りすぎかな。:
Rather, I don't want to be
anyone else but myself.
...Does that sound a little
smug？
translations.ほら、よく本当の自分がどうのってあるでしょ？:
Come on. There are people who
like to say they want to find
their true selves, right？
translations.今とは違う本当の自分を探すとか、本当の自分に目覚めるとか……。:
They keep searching for
something different or trying
to wake up their different
selves...
translations.うん、そういうのあるよね。:
Yeah, I think I've heard about
that.
translations.それって、今の自分に対して、すごく無責任だと思わない？:
But isn't that very
irresponsible to their current
selves？
translations.私は私のままで頑張りたいの。でも、それって簡単に見えて難しいから……そういう私が:
I want to do my best as what I
am right now. That might sound
complicated, but my role model
is myself, I think.
translations.今の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ちょっとカッコイイね。:
I think
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is very cool.
translations.例えば……女性のホラー作家とかで憧れてる人とか。:
For example... A female horror
novel writer or something.
translations.そうね……尊敬してる人ならいるけど……憧れるっていうのではないかな。:
Well... There are people that
I admire. However, I don't
really have a role model.
translations.でも、どうして気になったの？ こういう質問、相手のコンプレックスを探る質問だって:
But, why do you ask？ I read
from somewhere that people ask
this question to find out
about others' thought
processes, right？
translations.そうなの？ そんなつもりは全然。:
Really？ I didn't have that
kind of intention.
translations.ううん、気にしていないよ。それにあなただったら、例えそうでも許してあげる。:
Okay, don't worry then. Since
it's you, I don't mind being
asked this kind of question.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って\nどんな映画が好き？\nやっぱりホラー？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what kind of movies do you
like？ It must be horror
movies, right？
translations.もちろん！ でも、最近のホラーってあんまり面白くないのよね。:
Of course！ But, recent horror
movies aren't that good.
translations.ＣＧが増えて映像が軽くなってるの。少しずつ良くなってきてるけど……。:
They're using more CGs, but
the picture quality is getting
worse...
translations.ＣＧって、映像が軽くなるの？:
With computer graphics, the
picture quality is getting
worse？
translations.うん。昔の映画と見比べると……空気感っていうのかな？ それが違うの。:
Yeah. Compared to old
movies... I think it's the
atmosphere that feels
different. Don't you agree？
translations.じゃあ、ＣＧを使わないほうが好きなの？:
Well then, you like movies
without CGs better？
translations.うーん、ＣＧじゃないとできない映画もあるけど……私はやっぱりアナログな感じが好き:
Yeah, CGs are necessary for
some kinds of movies, but for
me... I prefer analog.
translations.アナログか……。なんか▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、機械にも弱そうだしね。:
Analog...？
Somehow I feel like
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
might not be good at using
technical stuff.
translations.あ、もう！ それ気にしてるのに！:
Ah. Geez！ I'm really
concerned about that！
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って本を読むの、速いよね。どのくらい読むの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You can read books very fast,
right？ How fast are you？
translations.読むペース？ １ヶ月で１０冊くらい……かな？:
My reading pace？ I can read
about 10 books in a month... I
think.
translations.３日で１冊？ すごいなぁ。:
So you can finish a book in 3
days？ That's amazing.
translations.私なんて、少ない方よ？ すごい人は１日に３冊とか読むもの。:
I think it's not fast at all.
Some people can read 3 books
in a day.
translations.そこまでいくと未知の領域だよ。:
You should try. Maybe you can
reach that level, too.
translations.私はそこまでは無理かな、映画も観たいし。:
That's impossible for me, I
think. I also have movies to
watch.
translations.うん。……それに最近は、他のことで時間もとられてるし。:
Yeah... And lately, I've been
spending time with something
else, too.
translations.ううん、なんでもない。こっちの話。:
No, never mind. I was just
talking to myself.
translations.ねえ。例えばの話ね？ 私がイメージ変えるとしたら、どんなのが似合うかな？:
Hey, for example... If I want
to change my image, what would
suit me？
translations.服装？ んー、そうだね……。:
Do you mean by changing your
clothing styles？ Well...
translations.たまにはサッパリしてみるのもいいかも知れないね。:
Occasionally, I think trying
some casual clothes would be
nice.
translations.そう？ イメージ違い過ぎない？:
Really？ Isn't that too much
of a change？
translations.そんなことないよ。ね、試してみない？:
No, I don't think it's too
much. Why don't you try it？
translations.んー、そうね……ふふ、ちょっと冒険してみようかな？:
Hmm, well... Hehe. Maybe I
should take the challenge.
translations.カワイイ系って、似合うかもね。:
The cute style would suit you,
I think.
translations.それって、フリルだったり、レースだったり、そういうの？:
You mean something with frills
or laces？
translations.うん。意外と似合うと思うんだけどな。:
Yeah, I think something like
that will really suit you.
translations.でも、私って年上に見られがちだから……そういうのは。:
But, I'm older than you. Will
it be okay if I wear something
cute？
translations.やっぱり、清楚なのが似合うと思うな。:
I think something neat will
suit you best.
translations.私って、そういうイメージなの？:
Do you think it will suit my
image？
translations.うん、●にとっては。自分では、そう思わない？:
Yeah, that's what I think.
Don't you think it'll suit
you？
translations.んー、自分ではちょっと……。:
Hmm, I don't really think
it'll suit me...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は清楚な美人って感じだと思うけど？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I think you're a beautiful
woman, so the neat style suits
you.
translations.時にはさ、こう……あぁいうのもイイんじゃない？:
Occasionally, you should try
something different... That
kind of style would suit you.
translations.んー、もう少し隠さない方向というか……布の節約？ 環境派、的な？:
Hmm, like, something that
reveals more of your shape...
and doesn't use so much
fabric. It's good for the
environment, too.
translations.ミニスカートにチューブトップとか、そういうの？:
A mini-skirt or tube top, or
something like that？
translations.そう、ね。時にはそんな感じに。:
Yeah, right. You should try
wearing them.
translations.ふふ。そういうの、好きなんだ。:
Hehe. You want me to wear
them？
translations.嫌いな男はいないと思うよ。それに▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は美人だから似合いそうだし。:
I don't think any guys hate
them. And you're so pretty,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
so you'll look good with them.
translations.もぅ……結局調子のいいこと言って、そんなこと言われると、その気になっちゃうかもよ:
Geez... You're getting ahead
of yourself again. If that's
what you want, I'll probably
wear them.
translations.んー、ごめん。思いつかない。今の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、似合ってるし。:
Hmm, sorry.
I can't think of anything
else. I think the current
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
already looks good.
translations.もぅ……こういう時は自分の好みでいいから、なにか言うものよ？:
Geez... You can just tell me
what you like. Why did you say
that？
translations.でも……うん……。ふふ。このままでいいんだ。:
Anyway... Okay... Hehe, I'll
keep wearing this style.
translations.例えばだけど、私がイメージ変えちゃうとしたら、どんなのが似合うと思う？:
Just for example, if I want to
change my image, what would
suit me？
translations.サッパリしてみるとか。例えば、ちょっとボーイッシュに。:
Simple clothes would be nice.
Like something a little
tomboyish.
translations.ふーん、そういうヒトに、からかわれてみたい？:
Hmm？ It sounds like you're
making fun of me.
translations.その、ふと思いついただけで……。:
No, it just came up to my
mind...
translations.ふふ。ごめん、わかってるから。でも、そうね。そういうのもアリかな？:
Hehe. Sorry. I know. But, I
wonder if that style will suit
me.
translations.そっか……じゃあ、少し考えてみるね。:
Really...？ Then I'll think
about it.
translations.どうって……そういうの、私が着ると笑われるんじゃない？:
Hmm...？ If I wear that style,
aren't you gonna laugh at me？
translations.そんなことないよ。絶対似合うって。:
I'm not going to laugh. I'm
sure it'll suit you.
translations.あ……ひょっとして、私が年上に見えるのがイヤだとか……。:
Ah... Is it because you hate
it that I usually look older
than you...？
translations.違う違う。そういうつもりじゃなくて、単純に似合いそうだと思って。:
No, no. That's not the reason.
I just simply think that it'd
suit you.
translations.ふふ。うん、わかった。考えてみるね。:
Hehe. Okay, I got it. I'll
think about it.
translations.清楚な感じで攻めるってのは？ もっとお嬢様っぽい感じで。:
How about the neat style？
Something that makes you look
like a lady.
translations.いつもの私は、清楚に感じられないか。:
So, I usually don't look neat
too you？
translations.まさか。もともと清楚な感じがあるから、それを強めるってだけのことだよ。:
No way. You already look neat
and graceful, but the neat
style clothes will emphasize
that even more.
translations.ふふ。お嬢様っぽい感じで？:
Hehe. You want me to look like
a lady？
translations.うん……そういうのが好きなら、試してみるのもいいかな？:
Hmm... If you like it like
that, maybe I should give it a
try.
translations.思い切って変えるなら、こう……子供ではない、というか。:
If you want to change your
image... How about something
more adult-like？
translations.うーん……少し違うかな？ 大人だったら地球環境のことも考えて、布も少なめにして…:
Yeah... We have to concern
more about the environment and
the resources that were used
to make clothes...
translations.あぁ、胸の谷間が見えてたり、スカートがすっごく短かったり？:
Ah, like, a shirt that shows
some cleavage, or a skirt
that's very short？
translations.そうだね、さすが。アカデミックに考えると、そうなるよね。:
Yeah, to think about it
academically, those are good
choices.
translations.こら、調子にのらないの！\n……でもまぁ考えておくわ、\nアカデミックにね。:
Hey, don't get ahead of
yourself！ ...But, I'll think
about it, academically, okay？
translations.（学問の勝利……!?）:
(Should I call this an
academic achievement...！？)
translations.んー、今の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が一番だと思うけどな……。:
Hmm, I think the current
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
looks best...
translations.そう？ ふふ、ありがとう。じゃあ、いいわ。:
Really？ Hehe, thanks. Then
it's fine.
translations.ねぇ、もし私がイメージを変えるとしたら、どんなのが似合うと思う？:
Hey, if I want to change my
image, which style would suit
me？
translations.さっぱりした感じは？ 例えばボーイッシュに。:
How about something simple？
Maybe the style that looks a
little tomboyish.
translations.ふふ。もしかして、そんなヒトに甘えたい？:
Hehe. So it'll make you feel
like you want to spoil me？
translations.ううん、いいの。考えてみると、そういうのもアリかもしれないし。:
No, never mind. To think about
it, that might be good.
translations.うん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲なら絶対似合うよ。:
Yeah, I'm sure it'll suit
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ふふ。じゃあ、試してみようかな。:
Hehe. Then I might give it a
try.
translations.えっ……あ、もっと女の子っぽい感じってこと？:
Eh...？ Ah, you want me to
look more girlish？
translations.うん。少女趣味っぽい服とか、意外と似合うんじゃないかな？:
Yeah. I think you'll look good
with some girlish clothes.
translations.……あなたより年下っぽく見える服ってこと？:
...Something that makes me
look younger than you？
translations.ううん、そういうことじゃないよ。純粋に似合いそうだって話で。:
No, that's not the reason. I
just simply think that it'd
suit you.
translations.ふふ。うん、そういうのも悪くないかも。ちょっと考えてみるね。:
Hehe. Okay, I think it's not
bad. I'll consider it.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲なら、清楚な感じが一番かな？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I think the neat style suits
you best.
translations.それって……清潔感あふれる感じってことかな？:
You mean... Something that
looks elegant？
translations.んー、上品なお嬢様っていうか、そういう感じ。:
Hmm, it'll make you look like
a refined lady, I think.
translations.そうそう。お嬢様、お茶の用意ができましたって言われるような感じの。:
Yeah, yeah. You're a lady. I
can picture you in the formal
tea ceremony already.
translations.ふふ、何それ。でも、あなたのアドバイス、考えてみるね。その時は私のこと、エスコー:
Hehe, what is that？ But, I'll
consider your advice. You'll
have to escort me when I wear
those clothes, okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ってスタイルがいいから、こうさ、あまり服に頼らない方向もありなんじゃ:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is very stylish, so I think
you don't have to rely on
clothes.
translations.あぁ、飾りっ気をなくすってこと？ ナチュラル志向で。:
Ah, you mean I shouldn't put
on so many accessories. Like,
to dress in natural style？
translations.それとは別の視点でさ、布を少なめに素材で勝負！ みたいな。:
No, that's not what I meant. I
think you should wear
something that doesn't use so
much fabric.
translations.あぁ、おヘソとか？ 胸の谷間とか？ それともスリット入りのスカートで太股？:
Ah, like, something that shows
my belly button or cleavage？
Or a skirt with very high slit
that shows my thigh？
translations.そうね、素材の持ち味を存分に……。:
Yeah, that way, you can show
off your assets...
translations.もぉ、妙にオジさん臭いこと言うのね？:
Geez, you sound like a dirty
old man.
translations.叶えてあげたいけど、そう簡単には実現できませんからね？:
I want to grant your wish but
it's not something easily
done, okay？
translations.（これは……実現するかな？）:
(I wonder if this will come
true...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は今の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のままが一番だよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
looks good already.
I like the current
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
the best.
translations.あなたの好みも知っておきたいけど……ううん、あなたがいいなら、それでいいの。:
I just wanted to ask for your
opinion... Okay, if you like
it like this, it's fine.
translations.ちょっと髪型、変えてみようと思うんだけど……どんなのが似合うかな？:
I'm thinking about changing my
hairstyle... What would suit
me？
translations.思い切って、切っちゃう？ ショートカット。:
If you want to cut it, then
cut it short.
translations.あ、うん。悪くないかな？ もしかしてそういうの、好き？:
Ah, okay. That doesn't sound
bad. It's what you like, huh？
translations.うん。ちょっと年上のお姉さんって感じで。:
Yeah. It'd make you look like
an older woman.
translations.それって……年上好みってこと？:
Which means... you like older
women？
translations.……どうなんだろ？ 年上好きっていうより▲姉ヶ崎＊▲好きっていうか。:
...Well, what should I say？
It's not that I like older
women in general. I just like
my
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.……もぅ、またそんなこと言って。:
...Geez. You're saying
something like this again.
translations.やっぱり、なんだ。長いのが好き？:
As I thought. So you like long
hair？
translations.どうかな？ でも男って、さらりと流れる長い髪に憧れるっていうからね。:
Well. I think most guys like
sleek, silky long hair.
translations.でも、私の髪って、そんなにキレイじゃないし……。:
But my hair isn't that
beautiful...
translations.そうかな？ サラサラしてて、さわり心地良さそうだけど。:
Hmm？ But your hair is silky
and feels really nice when I
touch.
translations.……うん、ありがとう。じゃあ……伸ばしてみようっかな？:
...Okay, thanks. Well... I'll
try to grow it longer.
translations.長からず短からずのセミロングあたりは？:
Not too long and not too
short. How about the semi-long
length？
translations.そういうのが好きなんだ。……うん、ありがとう。ちょっと考えてみるね。:
So you prefer that length,
huh？ ...Hmm, thanks. I'll
think about it.
translations.うーん、今の髪型が一番かな？:
Hmm, I think your current
length suits you best.
translations.そう？ じゃあ、このままで……。:
Really？ Then I'll keep it
like this...
translations.あ、でも、他が良かったら、ちゃんと言ってね？:
Ah, but if you have any
preferences, let me know,
okay？
translations.私、あなたの好みに合わせてみたいから……。:
I want to do the style that
you like...
translations.髪型、変えてみようかなって思うんだけど、どう思う？ どんなの似合うのかな？:
I'm thinking about changing my
hairstyle. What do you think？
Which length would suit me？
translations.うん。けっこう似合うと思うけど。: Yeah, I think it'll suit you.
translations.ふふ。男の子ってロングのほうが好きだとばかり思ってたけど、あなたは違うんだ。:
Hehe. I thought boys would
like girls with long hair.
But, you're different, huh？
translations.純粋に似合いそうだから……。:
I think you'll look innocent
with short hair...
translations.うん、ありがとう。考えてみるね。:
Okay, thanks. I'll think about
it.
translations.やっぱりロングが似合いそうかな？:
I think long hair will suit
you.
translations.でも髪が長いと、見ていてうっとうしくないかな？:
But long hair will be a bit
troublesome.
translations.そうかな？ 伸ばせば、いろんな髪型に出来るし、悪くないと思うけど。:
Really？ If you have long
hair, you can try different
hairstyles. It's not bad, I
think.
translations.長くなくても、いろいろ工夫はできるわよ？:
I can also do different
hairstyles without having long
hair, you know？
translations.ふふ。でもいいわ、覚えておくから。:
Hehe. But that sounds nice.
I'll keep it in mind.
translations.長からず短からず……セミロングが一番似合ってるんじゃないかな？:
Not long, nor short. Semi-long
is the best. I think it'll
suit you.
translations.ちょっと肩にかかってる程度……かな？:
About shoulder length would be
nice, I think.
translations.そか、セミロングが……ふふ。ありがとう、考えてみるね。:
Well, semi-long, huh...？
Hehe. Thanks. I'll think about
it.
translations.んー、今のままのほうが一番じゃないかな？:
Hmm, I think the current style
looks good already.
translations.ふふ。それって今の私があなた好みってことかな？:
Hehe, that means you like me
the way I look right now？
translations.じゃあ、このままにする。ふふ。ごめんね、変なこと聞いて。:
Then I'll keep it like this.
Hehe. Sorry for asking a weird
question.
translations.ねぇ、私が髪型を変えるとしたら、どんなのがいいと思う？:
Hey, if I change my hairstyle,
which style would you like？
translations.ショートって、意外とイケるんじゃない？:
Short hair will suit you, I
think.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って大人っぽいから、そういう落ち着いた感じも似合うはずだよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is mature, so short hair would
make you look calm and
composed. It'll suit you.
translations.そっか……ショートだからって、ボーイッシュに見えるだけじゃないものね。:
I see... But short hair will
also make me look boyish,
right？
translations.その気になったら、試してみてよ。:
If you're curious, why don't
you try it？
translations.ふふ。そんなこと言われたら、そうしないといけないみたいに聞こえちゃうけど……考え:
Hehe, if you say so, I feel
like I should really try it.
...I think about it.
translations.強いて言うなら……ロング、かな？:
If you ask me... I'd pick long
hair.
translations.ふふ。やっぱり長いのが好きなんだ。:
Hehe. So you prefer long hair,
huh？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、ロングが似合うよ。でも、長いと長いなりにいろいろ面倒じゃない？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
will look good with long hair,
I think. But isn't long hair
very difficult to take care？
translations.そのあたりは慣れの問題かな？:
I think it's the matter of
experience.
translations.へぇ、慣れの問題なんだ。:
Hmm？ So it needs experience,
huh？
translations.うん、だからこのまま伸ばすのも、特に問題なしかな。:
Yeah, but I think I don't have
any problem. I can grow my
hair long.
translations.長すぎず短すぎずってこと？:
Something not too long and not
too short？
translations.うん。似合うと思うんだけど……どうかな？:
Yeah. I think it'll suit you.
What do you think？
translations.ふふ。あなたがそうして欲しいっていうなら、それもありかな？:
Hehe. If you like it like
that, maybe it'd suit me.
translations.●が決めるの？:
Can I make a decision for
you？
translations.どうかな？ でも、ちょっと考えてみるね。そっか、セミロングか……。:
What should I say？ Well, I'll
think about it. Hmm.
Semi-long, huh...？
translations.んー、思いつかないなぁ……そもそも●、今のままが好きかも。:
Hmm, I really can't think of
anything else. I like your
current hairstyle.
translations.そう？ でも思いついたら言ってね。カレシの好みにあわせるのも、女の子には楽しいこ:
Really？ But let me know if
you have any preferences,
okay？ It's enjoyable to
change myself to suit your
taste.
translations.そう言えば食べ物の\n好き嫌いってある？:
Do you have any food you like
or dislike？
translations.嫌いなものは特にないけど、\n好きなものは……。:
I don't have anything I
dislike in particular. But
what I like is...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいつも\n持ち歩いてるから、\nつい●も買うようになって。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
always has them, so I ended up
buying them, too.
translations.それで……\nハマっちゃったの？:
Are you... getting addicted to
them？
translations.もぅ……のど飴なんて、\nどうやったって\n無理じゃない。:
Geez... It's impossible for me
if you like cough drops.
translations.ううん、なんでもない。\nこっちの話だから。:
No, never mind. I was just
talking to myself.
translations.玉子焼きとか、\nおひたしとか？ \nあと……んー、肉じゃが？:
Like tamagoyaki with some
vegetable side dishes, or...
Ah, nikujaka？
translations.そっち系？ \nうん。\nそっち系も嫌いじゃないよ。:
Those dishes？ Hmm, I don't
hate them at all.
translations.嫌いじゃないんだ……\nじゃあ、特に好きな和食って、\nなに？:
You don't hate them...？ Then
is there any Japanese food
that you like in particular？
translations.えっと、和風っぽい味付けが\n好きってことだから……\n難しいなぁ。:
Hmm, I just like something
that's full of Japanese
seasoning... It's difficult to
choose.
translations.そうなんだ……\nもしかして和風にすれば、\n洋食でもありなのかな？:
I see... There are also
Western style dishes that have
Japanese seasoning, right？
translations.でも、それがどうかしたの？:
Anyway, why do you ask me this
question？
translations.ううん、味の好みって\n人それぞれでしょ？ \nだから気になったの。\nうん、そ:
No, I just thought that people
have different tastes, so I
was curious. Yeah, that's all.
translations.洋食かな？ \nハンバーグやオムライスとか。:
Western food, I think. Like,
hamburger, or omelet rice, or
tonkatsu.
translations.へぇ……ちょっと意外かな。:
Eh...？ Somehow, I didn't
expect that.
translations.そう？ \nもしかして和食派に見える？:
Really？ Do I look like
someone who'd prefer Japanese
food？
translations.うん。でも、洋食は洋食でも\n日本的な洋食が好きなんだ。:
Yeah. But the dishes you
mentioned are actually Western
style Japanese food.
translations.んー、そういう意味だと\n家庭料理……かな？:
Yeah, I think I just prefer
homemade food.
translations.そっか……\nハンバーグ、オムライス。\nうん、ぜんぜん大丈夫。:
I see... Hamburger, omelet
rice, and tonkatsu？ Um, these
are okay.
translations.ううん、こっちの話。:
No, I was just talking to
myself.
translations.中華料理。自分でも\n不思議だけど、けっこう\n癖になるよね、中華って。:
Chinese food. I'm a bit
surprised myself, but I often
eat Chinese food.
translations.んー、それって\n春巻きとか、ギョーザとか、\nそういうこと？:
Hmm？ Something like spring
rolls or dumplings？
translations.（ラーメンが嫌いって\nわけじゃない、よな？）:
(She doesn't mean that she
hates noodles, right？)
translations.ねぇ、例えばだけど……デートするなら、どんなところがいい？:
Hey, for example... If we go
on a date, where would you
like to go？
translations.デートで行きたいところか……。:
Where do I like to go on a
date...？
translations.落ち着けるところかな。のんびりできるような。:
Calm and quiet places where I
can relax.
translations.うん、そういうところ、いいよね。デートって感じがするし。:
Um, that sounds nice. It must
be great for our dates.
translations.２人っきりになれるところじゃないと……ね？:
We can spend some private time
together, right？
translations.体を動かせるところだな。そんなに激しいスポーツとかしなくてもいいけど。:
Anywhere I can exercise... But
I didn't mean that we have to
play intense sports or
anything.
translations.具体的に言うと、たとえば、どんなところ？:
For example, what kind of
place？
translations.たとえば……こう……軽い運動になるような。:
For example... Places where we
can do some light exercises...
translations.ふふ。特にコレっていうもの、ないんだ。:
Hehe. So, it's opposite to
what we are doing now.
translations.うん。でもまあ、たまには運動するのもいいかなって。:
Yeah. Exercising is nice, you
know？
translations.流行のところかな。雑誌やＷＥＢに載ってたりするような。:
Fashionable places, I think.
Like places that get featured
on the web or in a magazine.
translations.あ、そうなんだ……ちょっと、意外かな。そっか。:
Ah, is that so...？ It's a
little unexpected. I see...
translations.そうかな。でもそういうとこ、気になるんだよね。:
Unexpected？ I enjoy visiting
fashionable places, you know？
translations.そっか。ふうん、結構いろいろ考えてるんだね。ふふ。:
Really？ Hmm... Then you have
to take me there, too. Hehe.
translations.どうせなら遊べるところがいいな。:
If I have to choose, places
where I can play around would
be nice.
translations.遊べるところって……カラオケとか、そういうところ？:
Places where you can play
around... A karaoke box or
something like that？
translations.カラオケに限らないけど、盛り上がりたいかなって。せっかくのデートなんだし。:
Not just a karaoke box.
Anywhere that I feel like we
can have fun during our dates
will be okay.
translations.ふふ。そうだね。せっかくのデートなんだし、楽しい時間を過ごしたいよね。:
Hehe. You're right. It's our
long-awaited date, so we
should enjoy it to the
fullest.
translations.そうそう。どうせなら賑やかで楽しいところがいいかなって。:
Yeah. Somewhere with lively
atmosphere would be nice.
translations.ねぇ、デートで行きたいところってある？ 教えてくれるなら、そのうち考えてあげても:
Hey, do you have any specific
places you want to go during
our dates？ If so, can you
tell me？
translations.うーん、デートで行きたいところか……。:
Hmm... Places I want to go
during our dates...？
translations.ふふ。ちょっと大人っぽい自分を演出しようとしてない？:
Hehe. Are you trying to act
like an adult？
translations.もぅ、本気にしないの。それに、私も好きよ。落ち着けるところ。:
Hey, don't take it seriously.
I also like calm and quite
places.
translations.そうなんだ。うん、●も覚えておく。:
Really？ Well, I'll keep that
in mind.
translations.体を動かせるところだな。:
Places where I can exercise
will be nice.
translations.デートでスポーツするの？ そういうの好き？:
You wanna play sports on our
dates？
translations.見るのは構わないけど……でも、あなたがかっこいいところみせてくれるなら、そういう:
I don't mind watching... But
in that case, maybe I can see
how cool you are when you
play.
translations.まあ、軽く体を動かす程度でいいんだけど。:
Well, just some light
exercises will be adequate.
translations.へぇ……あなたって流行に流されちゃう人間なんだ。ふーん。:
Eh？ You like fashionable
places, huh？
translations.いいなりになるわけじゃないんだけど、ちょっと気になるって言うか……。:
It's not like I'm obsessed or

them...
translations.ふふ、冗談よ、冗談。私もそういうデートは嫌いじゃないから。:
Hehe. I was just kidding. I

translations.遊べるところ……ふーん？:
Places where you can play...
Hmm...
translations.ふふ。そうやって遊び回ってたら、ダメな大人になっちゃうよ？:
Hehe. If you keep playing
around, you won't grow up to
be a good adult.
translations.例えばだけど、デートするならどういうところがいい？ 教えてくれると……ね？:
When we go on our dates, what

Can you tell me？
translations.デートで行きたいところ？ えっと……。:
Places where I like to go on
our dates...？
translations.ふふ。じゃあ……お姉さんの部屋に行こっか。:
Hehe. Then how about you come
to my room？
translations.でも、せっかくのデートなんだから、やっぱり外に行きたいよね？:
But it's a date, so we'd
better go outside, huh？
translations.体を動かせるところだな。そんなに激しいことはしたくないけど。:
Anywhere I can exercise... But
I didn't mean that we have to
play intense sports or
anything.
translations.じゃあ、私は応援してるね。:
In that case, I'll be cheering
for you.
translations.ふふ。運動部のマネージャーみたいなこと、一度やってみたいなぁって思ってたの。:
Hehe. I'm more like a sports
club's manager. I might want
to try playing sometimes.
translations.ああ、なるほど。でも、できたら一緒に楽しみたいかなーって。:
Ah, I see. But if it's
possible, we should enjoy
playing together.
translations.そっか……そういう最近のもの、好きなんだ。:
Really...？ So you enjoy the
latest trends, huh？
translations.ふふ、気になっちゃうんだ？ カワイイ……。:
Hehe. Pretty much, huh？ So
cute...
translations.ふうん……お姉さんと一緒に、遊びたい？:
Hmm... You wanna play around
with me then？
translations.ふふ。じゃあ一緒に遊んであげるからね？:
Hehe. Then I'll play around
with you.
translations.そういえば、ひとりの時って、どういうところに行ってるの？:
I wonder what kind of place
you like to go when you go out
alone.
translations.ひとりの時？ そうだな……。:
When I go out alone？ Let me
see...
translations.静かで落ち着けるところに行くかな。:
Calm and quiet places. I
think.
translations.そっか……静かなほうが、好き？:
I see... So you like quiet
places？
translations.静かっていうか、のんびりできるようなところ……かな？:
I can relax at such places.
That's why I like to go there.
translations.ふふ。うん、なんとなくわかる。お昼寝ができるような場所ってことでしょ？:
Hehe. Okay, I think I
understand that feeling. They
are places where you can nap,
right？
translations.そうそう。そんな感じ。:
Yeah, yeah. That kind of
places.
translations.体を動かせるところに行くかな。:
Anywhere I can exercise. I
think.
translations.あ、スポーツとか？:
Hmm, like, places where you
can play sports？
translations.そこまではいかないけど。軽い運動になるような。:
Not necessary. Places where I
can move my body would be
fine.
translations.でも、テニスなんて似合いそうだよね。:
But I think tennis would suit
you well.
translations.そりゃね、テニス部だし。:
I'm a tennis club's member,

translations.どうせなら人気のある流行りの場所に行くかな。:
Famous and fashionable places
would do for me.
translations.流行りの場所に、ひとりで？:
You like to go to famous
places by yourself？
translations.うん。ぶらっと見に行く程度だけど……。:
Well. It's fun for me to go
around those places...
translations.そうなんだ。もし寂しかったら……ね？:
I see. But if you ever feel
lonely, you know what to do,
okay？
translations.やっぱり遊べるところに行くかな。: Anywhere I can play. I think.
translations.そういうところは、ひとりで行くより……ね？:
Instead of going alone, maybe
you should... You know？
translations.そうだ。ひとりの時って、どこに行ったりしてるの？:
Right. Where do you usually go
when you go out alone？
translations.そんなこと言って、ぼーっとしたいだけなんじゃない？:
For such places, will you be
there and space out all day？
translations.ふふ。でも、ちょっとわかるな。私もたまに、ひとりでのんびりしたくなること、あるも:
Hehe. But I understand that.
Sometimes, I like to be alone
and relax, too.
translations.そこに▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいれば最高、なんだけど。:
If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
goes with me, that would be
best.
translations.体を鍛えるの？ まさか、ダイエット？:
To train your body？ Or
perhaps are you on diet？
translations.まさか。軽い運動ぐらいはしたいかなって。:
No. I just like to do some
light exercises.
translations.ふふ。冗談だよ、そんなの必要ないもんね？:
Hehe. I was just joking. You
don't need to diet, okay？
translations.流行りの場所って……そうか、そういう場所でナンパとかしてるんだ。やっぱり若い子の:
Fashionable places... Right,
there will be some girls you
can flirt with. After all, you
like young girls, don't you？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいるのにそんなことしないよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I already have you. I won't do
that.
translations.……もぅ、素で返されるとイジメられないじゃない……ずるいなぁ。:
...Geez. If you say that, I
can't continue teasing you.
...You're so crafty.
translations.やっぱり遊べるところに行くだろうな。: Anywhere I can play, I think.
translations.へぇ、意外と遊んだりするほうなんだ。そっかー。遊んじゃうんだ。ふーん。:
Hmm？ I don't know that you
like to play around. Hmm...
translations.でも、本当にひとりで遊ぶだけだから。:
I usually go out to play
around by myself.
translations.ふふ。どうして言い訳なんかしてくるのかなー？:
Hehe. What shall I say about
that？
translations.あ、そうだ。ひとりの時ってどういうところに行くの？:
Ah, right. Where do you like
to go when you go out alone？
translations.それじゃあ、家でのんびりしてるのと変わらないんじゃない？:
That's not different from
relaxing at home, right？
translations.んー、でも外に出たいって思うこと、ない？:
Yeah, but sometimes I just
feel like going out somewhere.
translations.あ、うんうん。そういうのあるよね。急にあなたの顔、見たくなる時とか。:
Ah, okay. Sometimes that
happens to me too. And
sometimes I want to go to see
you.
translations.そっか……じゃあ私はマネージャーだね。あなた専属の。:
I see... Then I can be your
manager, right？ I can take
care of you.
translations.そういうところって、ひとりじゃ寂しくない？:
Don't you feel lonely to be
there alone？
translations.ふふ。寂しくなったら、ね？:
Hehe. You know what to do when
you feel lonely, okay？
translations.え？ ひとりで行くの？:
Eh？ And you go to such places
alone？
translations.ひとりだと気兼ねなく本気で遊べるからね。:
When I go alone, I can play as
much as I want.
translations.あ、そっか……ふふ。つまり本気で遊ぶために、わざとひとりでってこと？:
Ah, I see... Hehe. So, when
you really want to go all out,
you just go alone, huh？
translations.そうそう。修行じゃないけどさ。:
Yeah. Although sometimes it's
not that fun.
translations.そうだ。あなたって、もともとどういうタイプの女の子が好きだったの？:
Right. What type of girl do
you like？
translations.●の好きなタイプ？ んー、一言で言うと……。:
The type of girl that I like？
Hmm... If I have to say,
then...
translations.知的で強気なタイプって、けっこう好きかな。:
I think I like the
intellectual and strong type.
translations.頭がよくて、言うこともはっきり言って？:
Like a smart girl who likes to
say what she wants？
translations.そう、それ。そういう感じ。: Yeah, yeah. That kind of girl.
translations.たまには、いじめられちゃったりとか？:
Who sometimes likes to tease
you？
translations.へぇ、そうか、いじめてもいいのね。:
Hmm？ I see. So some teasing
would be fine, huh？
translations.優しくて積極的なタイプ、かな？:
The kind and positive type, I
think.
translations.……ねえ。私、もっと積極的な方がいい？:
...Hey, so you think I should
be more positive, right？
translations.だから、こうやって……。: Then what if I do this...
translations.私の方から、手を繋いじゃうとかさ。:
Do you like it when I'm the
one who reaches for your
hand？
translations.ふふ。こういう感じね？:
Hehe. So, it's something like
this, huh？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、かな？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is my type, I think.
translations.●のタイプ。今の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、そのままがそうなんだ。:
For me, the current
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is the type that I like.
translations.あ……うん、そっか。わかった。ありがと。:
Ah... Um, I see. I got it.
Thanks.
translations.……ごめん、ちょっと自分でも恥ずかしかった。:
...Sorry, I feel a little
embarrassed to say that.
translations.ふふ……私も、ちょっと恥ずかしい……かな？:
Hehe... Me, too. I think I
feel a little embarrassed,
too.
translations.ところでさ、本当はどんなタイプの女の子が好みなの？:
By the way, can you tell me
honestly what type of girl you
like？
translations.本当って……うーん、好きなタイプか……。:
Honestly...？ Hmm, the type
that I like is...
translations.優しくて大人しいタイプかな？ あんまり騒々しいのは、ちょっとね。:
The kind and obedient type, I
think. I don't like a
boisterous girl.
translations.そっか……騒々しくはないと思うけど、優しいかどうか、自信ないな……。:
I see... I think I'm not the
boisterous type, but I'm not
sure if I've been kind to
you...
translations.そうかな？ ●、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は優しいと思うけど。:
Really？ I think you've been
very kind to me,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あなたがそう思ってくれるのは嬉しいけど……。:
I'm glad to hear you say that,
but...
translations.そんなに弱気にならない、というのも追加かな？:
Should I add that I like girls
who are not so timid？
translations.ふふ。それだとお母さんみたいじゃない？:
Hehe. Is it because you feel
like she's your mom？
translations.もしかして……女の子に甘えたいとか、そういう感じ？:
So... You like girls who let
you act as a spoiled child？
translations.うーん……それとも少し違うような？ いや違わないのか。:
Hmm... That's a little
different. No, probably not
different.
translations.そっか……やっぱり男の子って、甘えたいんだ……。:
I see... So boys really like
to be spoiled...
translations.だから、今の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が、そのままが好みのタイプなんだ。:
The current
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is exactly my type.
translations.もぅ……そんなこと言われたら恥ずかしくて、どうしようもなくなるじゃない……。:
Geez... You make me feel so
embarrassed. Now I don't even
know what I should say...
translations.そう言えばあなたの好きなタイプって、どういう感じ？:
By the way, what type of girl
do you like？
translations.●の好きなタイプ？ んー、そうだなあ……。: My type？ Hmm, let me see...
translations.優しくて、それでいて大人しい子が好きかな？:
The kind and obedient type, I
think.
translations.ううん。意外と、主導権握りたいほうなんだなあって。:
No, I've just never imagined
you as the type that likes to
take the lead.
translations.ふふ。優しくて大人しい子でしょ？ あなたがリードすることになるんじゃない？:
Hehe, kind and obedient, huh？
Like a girl who always follow
your lead？
translations.でも……そういうのも、いいかな？:
But... Is it really okay like
that？
translations.知的で強気……かな？:
The intellectual and strong
type, I think...
translations.……私よりクールな女の子が好き？:
...So you like some girls that
are cooler than me？
translations.違う違う。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲で……。:
No, no.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.ふふ。うん、わかってる。距離感の問題だよね？:
Hehe. Hmm, I understand. I'm
just not so cool, huh？
translations.だから、そうじゃなくね……。:
No, I didn't mean it like
that...
translations.ううん、だから本当にいいの。好みって微妙なものでしょ？:
No, it's really okay. Everyone
has different taste.
translations.でも……そっか……もう少しクールか……。:
But... I see... I should be a
bit cooler...
translations.やっぱり今の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が理想的かな。:
Of course, the current
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is my ideal type.
translations.もぅ……そんなお世辞いっても、仕方ないんだからね？:
Geez... Why are you flattering
me like that？
translations.お世辞じゃないよ。●は、その……。:
I'm not flattering you. I
just...
translations.ふふ、ありがとう。お礼に、これあげる。はい。:
Hehe, thanks. I'll give you
this. Here.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、家ではいつもどうしてるの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what do you usually do at
home？
translations.え？ 特別なことなんて、別にやってないけど……？:
Eh？ I don't have anything to
do in particular, though...
translations.●と会ってない時の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、どういう感じかなぁって気になってさ。:
I'm just curious what
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is
like when we're not together.
translations.あ、うん……でも、今と変わらないんじゃないかな？:
Ah, hmm... I'm not different
from when I'm with you now.
translations.じゃあ、家で暇を潰す時とかは？:
Then what do you do when you
relax at home？
translations.家にある本とかＤＶＤとか……あと家事の手伝い、それくらいかな？:
I read books or watch DVDs.
Sometimes I help with
household chores, too.
translations.そうかな？ 私なんてまだまだだと思うけど……。:
Really？ I don't think I do
anything much at home,
though...
translations.まだ学生なんだから、当然だよ。:
You're still a student, so
that's natural.
translations.……うん、そうよね。お嫁さんになるのも、まだ先だし……先、だよね？:
...Hmm, right. It'll still
take a while until I can
become a housewife... A while,
okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、家ではなにしてるの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what do you usually do at
home？
translations.普通よ？ 一人で本読んだり、ＤＶＤ観たり。:
Just normal stuff, like
reading books or watching
DVDs.
translations.うん。たまにＳＦとかミステリとか……特にＤＶＤはいろいろかな？:
Yeah. But sometimes I watch
Sci-Fi and mystery movies,
too... I got a lot of DVDs.
translations.でもホラーが多いんだ。:
But most of them are horror
movies, right？
translations.自然とそうなっちゃうの。あ、でも、ホラーはホラーでもスリラーとかも多いのよ？:
Yeah, that's true. Ah, but
some horror movies are
categorized as mystery, too.
translations.そういうの、一人だと怖くない？:
Aren't you scared when you
watch them alone？
translations.怖いよって……そんな笑顔で言われると、逆にこっちが怖いかも。:
You're scared...？ You say it
with a smile on your face. I
think it's the opposite then.
translations.ホラーだもの。怖くないとホラーじゃないでしょ？:
A horror movie that can't
scare people wouldn't be
called horror movie, right？
translations.ところで▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、家で暇な時ってなにしてるの？:
Speaking of which,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what do you do when you relax
at home？
translations.普通よ？ 読書にＤＶＤに、勉強とか。:
