translations.いただきます。おかわりしたかったら、言ってね？:
Let's eat. Let me know if
you want seconds, okay？
translations.うん、そこでね。おじ様からいい話を聞いたの。:
Yeah, just over there. An
older gentleman told me
something interesting.
translations.熱海港から船で初島っていう島に行けるのね。:
You can take a boat from
Atami Port to an island
called Hatsushima.
translations.そこには誰も辿り着いたことがないビーチがあるんだって。:
He said there's a beach
there that no one has
ever been able to reach.
translations.でね、そこで愛を誓い合った二人は永遠に幸せになれるんだって。:
And if two people swear
their love there, they'll
be happy forever.
translations.（どこかで聞いたような話だな……）:
(I feel like I've heard
this story before...)
translations.おっけー。じゃあ明日は伝説のビーチ探しだ。:
Okay. Then tomorrow we'll
search for the legendary
beach.
translations.ところで、おじ様って？:
By the way, who was this
older gentleman？
translations.ダンディでステキなおじ様だったよ？:
He was a very dapper and
handsome older man？
translations.歳は……７０歳ぐらいかな？:
He was... probably around
70 years old？
translations.ねえ、またあそこに行くのは、どうかな？:
Hey, how about we go
back there again？
translations.あそこって……例のビーチ？:
Back there... You mean
that beach？
translations.そう、あのときの思い出の場所……。:
Yeah, the place where
we made those memories...
translations.そうだな、また探してみるか……。:
Good idea. Let's try
looking for it again...
translations.ここ、卓球台があるんだって。やってみない？:
They have a ping-pong
table here. Wanna play？
translations.まさか……本気は出さないよね？:
You're not... gonna go
all out, are you？
translations.いじめ、ひどい……。:
You're so mean...
Such a bully.
translations.もう、汗かいちゃった。またお風呂、入ろうかな……。:
Jeez, now I'm all sweaty.
I might need another bath...
translations.うん、それもいいんじゃない？:
Yeah, that sounds
like a good idea.
translations.元気出して。たまたまだから。:
Cheer up. It was just
a fluke.
translations.めんどくさいから、パスで。:
Sounds like a lot of work.
I'll pass.
translations.そう？ それなら、いいけど。: Really？ Well, if you say so.
translations.（あ、露天風呂あるのか。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も誘って行ってみようかな）:
(Oh, they have an open-air
bath. Maybe I should invite
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.（さっき入ったし、風呂はもういいや）:
(I just took one earlier.
I'm good on baths.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、露天風呂入ろう！:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, let's hit the
open-air bath!
translations.露天風呂？ 気持ちよさそうだけど……お風呂入っちゃったから。:
The open-air bath？ Sounds
nice, but... I already
took a bath.
translations.そっか……。じゃあ、●もやめよ。:
I see... Then I'll pass
too, ●.
translations.露天風呂？ 気持ちよさそう、行こ行こ。:
An open-air bath？ Sounds
amazing, let's go!
translations.（雪が積もってる……気づかないうちに降ってたんだな）:
(The snow is piling up...
It must have been snowing
without me noticing.)
translations.うん、ステキ。そっちの景色も見たいな。:
Yeah, it's beautiful.
I wanna see the view
from over there.
translations.うん、じゃあこっちに……ってダメ！ 来ちゃダメ！:
Yeah, come on over... Wait,
no! You can't come here!
translations.うん、いい眺め……。来て良かったね！:
Yeah, it's beautiful...
I'm so glad we came!
translations.おう、兄ちゃん！ なに騒いでんだ!?:
Hey, kid! What's with
all the racket?!
translations.はは、気にすんな！ アツアツだな！:
Haha, don't sweat it!
You two sure are cozy!
translations.（怖いし、恥ずかしい。そろそろ出よう……）:
(That was scary and
embarrassing. I should
get out soon...)
translations.貸切のお風呂があるの、知ってた？ 入ってみない？:
Did you know they have
a private bath?
Want to try it out?
translations.ふふ、じゃあ決まり。先に行ってるね？:
Hehe, then it's decided.
I'll go on ahead, okay?
translations.（貸切の風呂って、家族風呂ってやつだよな。……どうしよう）:
(A private bath... That
means a family bath.
...What should I do?)
translations.ここは男らしく……: I should be a man and...
translations.（これが家族風呂か……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？）:
(So this is the family
bath... Where's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲?)
translations.あ、ああ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も入りなよ。:
Y-Yeah. You should
come in too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.えっと……風呂気持ちよさそうだよ？ 入ってきなって。:
Um... The bath looks
really nice, you know?
You should get in.
translations.ふふ、背中流してあげる。やってみたかったんだ。:
Hehe, I'll wash your back.
I've always wanted to
try doing that.
translations.（よかった……あやうく変態扱いされるところだった）:
(Thank god... I was almost
branded a total pervert.)
translations.ばか、調子にのらないの！ 反省しなさい！:
Idiot, don't push your
luck! Think about what
you've done!
translations.ごめん、悪かった。今から行くから、話を……。:
Sorry, my bad. I'm coming
over, so let's talk...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、わかって言ってるんだよな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ definitely knows
what she's saying...)
translations.（そういや▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、夜の景色はキレイだろうなって言ってたな）:
(Come to think of it, 
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ said the night 
view would be pretty.)
translations.夜の散歩に誘う: Invite her for a night walk
translations.（もう暗いし、やめておこう）:
(It's already dark out, 
I'd better not.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。夜の散歩、行かない？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Wanna go for 
a walk tonight？
translations.今日さ、街を見渡したとき、夜になったらキレイだろうなって言ってただろ？:
When we looked over the 
town today, you said it'd 
be pretty at night, right？
translations.覚えててくれたのは嬉しいけど……もう遅いよ。やめとこ？:
I'm glad you remembered, 
but... it's late. 
Maybe we shouldn't？
translations.そっか……そうだな。わかった。:
I see... you're right. 
Got it.
translations.うん、行きたい……。でも大丈夫？ もう遅いよ？:
Yeah, I'd love to... 
But is it okay？ 
It's pretty late.
translations.平気だって、●がいるんだから。行こう。:
It's fine, I'm with you, 
●. Let's go.
translations.こんな遅くに散歩って、ドキドキする。手、つないでて？:
Walking this late makes 
my heart pound. 
Will you hold my hand？
translations.ちょっと歩くけど、いい？:
It's a bit of a walk, 
is that okay？
translations.うん、キレイ……。あ、あのホテルの前、ステキ……。:
Yeah, it's beautiful... 
Oh, the front of that 
hotel is gorgeous...
translations.あそこ。ヤシの木かな、ライトアップされてる……。:
Over there. I think those 
are palm trees, they're 
all lit up...
translations.▲主人公＊▲。花火始まるんだって。:
▲主人公＊▲. I heard the 
fireworks are starting.
translations.そっか。夏で、海辺だもんな。:
Oh, right. It's summer, 
and we're by the sea.
translations.んー、ごめんパス。やめとこう。:
Hmm, sorry, I'll pass. 
Let's skip it.
translations.やっぱとわのの花火とは違うな。:
It really is different 
from the Towano fireworks.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ムーンライトビーチに行かない？:
▲主人公＊▲. Wanna go to 
Moonlight Beach？
translations.サンビーチのこと。夜になると名前が変わるんだって。どう？:
It's Sun Beach. 
They say the name changes 
at night. What do you say？
translations.青く光るんだね。キレイ……。:
It glows blue.
It's so pretty...
translations.夜、こんな風になるんだな。誘ってくれて、サンキュ。:
So this is what it looks
like at night. Thanks for
inviting me.
translations.うん……二人で見たかったから。:
Yeah... I wanted to see it
with you.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、そろそろ部屋戻ろう。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, let's head back
to the room soon.
translations.（なるほど、たしかにちょっと緊張するな）:
(I see, this is definitely
a little nerve-wracking.)
translations.そろそろ、電気消すね？:
I'm going to turn off
the lights soon, okay？
translations.私……一日中一緒にいたのに、まだ足りないって思ってる。:
Even though we've been
together all day... I still
feel like it's not enough.
translations.じゃあ、もう寝るね？: Well, I'm going to bed, okay？
translations.さっきはこんなに近くなかったよね？:
They weren't this close
earlier, were they？
translations.おはようございます。昨夜はよく眠れましたか？:
Good morning. Did you sleep
well last night？
translations.ええ、とても。ごめんなさい、起こしてもらってしまって。寝過ぎちゃいました？:
Yes, very well. I'm sorry
for making you wake us.
Did we oversleep？
translations.……あら？ 申し訳ありません。時間を間違えていたみたいで。:
...Oh？ I'm so sorry.
It seems I got the time
wrong.
translations.（早く起きてよかった。昨日、ちゃんと寝たからな）:
(I'm glad I woke up early.
I got plenty of sleep
last night, after all.)
translations.（しばらく見てようかな……）:
(Maybe I'll just watch
for a little while...)
translations.ふふ、カワイイ寝顔。:
Hehe, such a cute
sleeping face.
translations.いいよ。寝顔もカワイかったから▼:
It's okay. Your sleeping face
was cute, too.▼
translations.そうだ。ちゃんと起きられたご褒美に、ぎゅってしてあげる。:
Oh, I know. As a reward for
waking up properly, I'll give
you a big hug.
translations.ふふ。じゃあ、ご飯行こう？:
Hehe. Well then, shall we
go get some food？
translations.やっぱホテルの朝食といったらビュッフェだよな。:
When it comes to hotel
breakfasts, it's gotta be
a buffet.
translations.うん、でもとり過ぎちゃった……。:
Yeah, but I took a little
too much...
translations.どうぞ。食べ過ぎないようにね？:
Here you go. Make sure you
don't eat too much, okay？
translations.大丈夫だって。あ、デザート追加された。いる？:
I'll be fine. Oh, they added
more dessert. Want some？
translations.慌てないの。ゆっくりしなさい？:
No need to rush. Take your
time, alright？
translations.よし、行くか。そろそろ出る準備しよう。:
Alright, let's go. We should
get ready to leave soon.
translations.うん、また来られるといいな。:
Yeah, I hope we can come
back sometime.
translations.今日は初島だな。伝説のビーチ、見つかるかな。:
Today's Hatsushima. I wonder
if we'll find the legendary
beach.
translations.うん、見つけたい。: Yeah, I want to find it.
translations.また行けるかな。私たちの、思い出の場所。:
I wonder if we'll go back
someday... to our special
place.
translations.初島までは、ここから船だな。:
We'll have to take a boat
to Hatsushima from here.
translations.うん、船旅って新鮮。短い時間だけど、楽しみだな。:
Yeah, a boat trip feels
so fresh. It's a short ride,
but I can't wait.
translations.ふーん、中はこうなってるのか。:
Hmm, so this is what it
looks like inside.
translations.船中泊できる船も、面白そうだよね。:
A boat you can sleep on
sounds like fun, doesn't it？
translations.乗ったことあるの？: Have you ever been on one？
translations.ないけど、よく映画の舞台になったりするでしょ？:
No, but they're in movies
all the time, right？
translations.ああ、あるね。何等船室～みたいな。:
Oh, yeah. With first-class
and second-class cabins.
translations.それそれ。みんな毛布にくるまってるの。:
Exactly. And everyone's
wrapped up in blankets.
translations.で、乗客が次々に殺人鬼の被害に？:
And then the passengers get
picked off by a killer？
translations.おー、結構速い。気持ちいいな。:
Whoa, it's pretty fast.
Feels great.
translations.天気がいいから、遠くまでよく見えるね。:
The weather's so nice, you
can see really far.
translations.うん、熱海港、もうちっちゃいな。:
Yeah, Atami Port looks
so tiny already.
translations.ねえ。写真撮ってもらおうか？:
Hey. Should we ask someone
to take our picture？
translations.うん、周りの人もみんな撮ってるよ？:
Yeah, look, everyone else
is taking them too.
translations.じゃあ、頼んでみよう。すいませーん。シャッターお願いできますか？:
Let's ask, then. Excuse me!
Could you take our picture？
translations.こんな近くにアイランドリゾートがあるって、ステキ。:
It's so nice having an
island resort this close.
translations.リゾートもいいけど、まずは食事かな？:
The resort is great, but
should we eat first？
translations.ここ。ネットで調べたら評判よかったの。:
Here. I looked it up online
and it had good reviews.
translations.ゲソの肝焼き、美味しい……。:
The grilled squid with
liver is delicious...
translations.よし、サザエもいっとく？ サザエ！:
Alright, should we get some
turban shells too？
translations.さて、見つかるかな。伝説のビーチは。:
Well then, I wonder if we'll
find that legendary beach.
translations.お、なんか伝説が書いてあるぞ。:
Oh, it says something about
a legend.
translations.ここには詳しいことは書いてないね。:
It doesn't go into much
detail here.
translations.うん。ビーチの伝説とは関係ないのかな。:
Yeah. I wonder if it's related
to the beach legend.
translations.灯台……。上に登れるんだね。:
A lighthouse...
Looks like we can go up.
translations.そんなに高くないね。登ってみようか？:
It's not that high.
Want to climb it？
translations.はりきるのはいいけど、置いてかないでね？:
It's fine to be excited, but
don't leave me behind, okay？
translations.おー、すごいな。全方位見渡せるぞ。:
Whoa, amazing. You can see
in every direction.
translations.えっと……熱海港は向こうだ。こうして見ると結構遠いな。:
Let's see... Atami Port is
that way. It's pretty far
when you look at it like
this.
translations.ここから伝説のビーチは見えないかな？:
Can we see the legendary
beach from here？
translations.んー、それっぽいものはないな……。:
Hmm, I don't see anything
that looks like it...
translations.そう？ 無理はしないでね。:
Are you sure？
Don't push yourself.
translations.伝説のビーチ、見つからないね。:
We can't seem to find
the legendary beach.
translations.そんな顔しないの。少しは残念だけど、伝説よりもあなたとの思い出の方が大切だもん。:
Don't make that face. I'm a
little disappointed, but my
memories with you are more
important than a legend.
translations.一緒にここに来られて、うれしいと思ってるよ。:
I'm just happy that we could
come here together.
translations.聞こえるよ。こっちの方。: I hear them. Over this way.
translations.伝説のビーチ、ここでよかったよね？:
The legendary beach was
around here, right？
translations.伝説のビーチ、どこだったかな？:
Where was the legendary
beach again？
translations.ここらへんだったと思うんだけど……。:
I thought it was
around here...
translations.……。しょうがないね、伝説だもん。:
...Oh well. It is a legend,
after all.
translations.また行けたら、よかったな……。:
I wish we could've gone
again...
translations.ほんとにあったんだ。伝説のビーチ……。:
It really does exist.
The legendary beach...
translations.ああ……ほんとに地図に載ってない。:
Wow... it really isn't

on any map.
translations.キレイ。現実じゃないみたい……。:
It's so beautiful. It

doesn't even feel real...
translations.こんなビーチが知られてないなんて。:
I can't believe a beach

like this is a secret.
translations.本当のことにするには、愛を誓い合わないと。:
To make it come true,

we have to swear our love.
translations.私、姉ヶ崎寧々は一生あなたを愛することを、誓います。:
I, Nene Anegasaki, swear

to love you for all my life.
translations.▲苗字▲▲名前▲は、姉ヶ崎寧々を一生愛することを誓います。:
I, ▲苗字▲▲名前▲, swear to

love Nene Anegasaki forever.
translations.来て良かった。来なかったら……。:
I'm so glad we came.

If we hadn't...
translations.この景色、見られなかったんだね。:
We wouldn't have been able

to see this view.
translations.こんなに長い時間、一緒にいて。:
We've been together

for so long...
translations.今日だけでも、どんどん好きになってる。:
Even just today, I've fallen

more and more in love.
translations.これからも、もっともっと好きになっちゃうなんて。:
To think I'll keep falling

even deeper from now on...
translations.だから、抱きしめて。また、抱きしめて。:
So hold me.

Hold me again.
translations.大好きだから、ずっと大好きなままでいるから。:
I love you, and I'm going to

keep loving you forever.
translations.これが、伝説のビーチ……。:
So this is the

legendary beach...
translations.うん……。あ、もう。私、変な顔してたでしょ？:
Yeah... Ah, geez. I was

making a weird face, wasn't I？
translations.……。伝説の話、したでしょ？:
...I told you about

the legend, right？
translations.愛をね、誓い合うの。: We have to swear our love.
translations.私、姉ヶ崎寧々は一生あなたを愛します。:
I, Nene Anegasaki, will

love you for all my life.
translations.▲苗字▲▲名前▲も、姉ヶ崎寧々を一生愛することを誓います。:
And I, ▲苗字▲▲名前▲, vow to
love Nene Anegasaki
for all my life.
translations.もう帰らなくちゃ……。: We have to head back soon...
translations.こんなに一緒にいたの、はじめてだけど。:
This is the first time we've

been together this long,
translations.早いな、あっという間。もっと一緒にいたい。:
But it went by so fast.

I want to stay longer.
translations.変だね、二人とも同じ気持ちなのに。:
It's strange. We both feel

the exact same way,
translations.なんでかなわないのかな。:
So why can't we have

what we want？
translations.帰りたくない。: I don't want to go home.
translations.ワガママ言いたくなっちゃった。:
I just felt like being

a little selfish.
translations.今、このときを、絶対忘れないようにさせて。:
Make sure I never forget

this exact moment.
translations.１０年後も２０年後も一生、忘れられないように。:
Not in 10 years, 20 years...

or for the rest of my life.
translations.伝説のビーチ……。キレイ……。:
The legendary beach...
It's so beautiful...
translations.ねえ、見とれちゃってるところ、悪いんだけど。:
Hey, sorry to interrupt
your staring, but...
translations.誓い、したいな。:
I want us to make
our vow.
translations.姉ヶ崎寧々は、一生あなたを愛することを、誓います。:
I, Nene Anegasaki, vow to
love you for all my life.
translations.今日もずっと一緒だったね。:
We spent the whole day
together again today.
translations.こんなのはじめて……。:
I've never felt like this
before...
translations.もっと早く、こうすればよかったな。:
I wish we'd done this
sooner.
translations.今は、いつ何をしててもあなたのこと考えちゃう。:
Now, no matter what I do,
I'm always thinking of you.
translations.好き過ぎて、そればかりになっちゃって。:
I love you so much, it's
all I can think about.
translations.いいの。二人で色々経験して……。:
It's okay. We'll experience
all sorts of things
together...
translations.もっと色んな事、できるもんね。:
We'll be able to do so
much more.
translations.でも今は、抱きしめて。それから、キスして。:
But for now, hold me.
And then, kiss me.
translations.キスして。好きなだけ。:
Kiss me. As much as
you want.
translations.また来られた……。二人の思い出の場所。:
We're back... Our special
place of memories.
translations.やっぱりキレイ。思い出の景色とおんなじ。:
It's just as beautiful.
Exactly as I remembered.
translations.前に来たときと……。:
Compared to the last time
we came here...
translations.私たちは何か変わってるかな？:
Do you think we've
changed at all？
translations.もっと好きになってる。: I love you even more now.
translations.次また来られたら、そのときは今より……。:
If we come back again,
will I love you...
translations.今よりもっと、好きになってるのかな。: Even more than I do now？
translations.もっと好きになっても、いい？:
Is it okay if I fall
even more in love with you？
translations.んーっ。旅行もそろそろ終わりか。:
Nnn. I guess our trip is
almost over.
translations.お別れか……この島とも。:
Time to say goodbye...
To this island too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、大丈夫？ 疲れたんじゃ。:
Are you okay, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
You must be tired.
translations.大丈夫。おばさん扱いしないの。:
I'm fine. Don't treat me
like an old lady.
translations.電車の時間までは、もう少しかな。:
We still have a little time
before our train.
translations.そうだな、ちょっとゆっくりするか。:
Yeah, let's just relax
for a bit.
translations.あ、お土産、買わないと。:
Ah, we need to buy
some souvenirs.
translations.学校の友達と、お隣さんと、家族ぐらいかな。:
Just some school friends,
my neighbors, and family,
I guess.
translations.そこだよね……。二人して休み取った時点で、あやしまれてるんだけど。:
That's the thing...
They're already suspicious
since we both took time off.
translations.割とね。……やめておこっかな。あえて秘密、ふふ。:
Pretty much... Maybe I
shouldn't. Let's keep it
a secret, hehe.
translations.うん、かさばるものってもらう方も困っちゃうでしょ？:
Yeah, it's a pain to get
bulky souvenirs, right？
translations.さすが、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。お土産選びも隙がないね。:
Just what I'd expect, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You're flawless even when
picking souvenirs.
translations.そんな評価いりません。:
I don't need that kind
of praise.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲さ。結構焼けた？:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Did you get a tan？
translations.そうだね……。これはきちゃうかも。:
Yeah... I think
it might really show.
translations.さすがに疲れたな。寝ちゃうかも。:
I'm actually pretty tired.
I might fall asleep.
translations.うん、無理しないで寝ていいよ？\n起こしてあげるから。:
Yeah, don't push yourself,
go ahead and sleep.
I'll wake you up.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だって疲れてるだろ？ アラームセットして、一緒に寝よ。:
You're tired too, right,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲? Let's set an alarm
and sleep together.
translations.結局▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に起こしてもらっちゃったな。:
I ended up having you
wake me up after all,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.こういうときって、時間になると勝手に目が覚めちゃうの。いいのか悪いのか。:
At times like this, I just
wake up naturally when it's
time. For better or worse.
translations.おかげで助かったから、よし。:
Well, it saved me,
so it's all good.
translations.帰ってきちゃった、いつもの駅に。:
We're back...
at our usual station.
translations.ここまで長く一緒にいたの、はじめてだよね？:
This is the first time we've
been together this long,
isn't it？
translations.そうだな……。普通にしてたら、こんなにずっと一緒にいるなんて、ありえないもんな。:
Yeah... Normally, we'd
never be able to stay
together this long.
translations.うん、そう。普通じゃありえないこと、しちゃった。:
Yeah, exactly. We did
something that's normally
impossible.
translations.旅行に行く前の私たちと、今の私たち、何かが変わってるかな。:
I wonder if something's
changed between us from
before the trip and now.
translations.たぶん、変わってる。一歩先に進めたっていうか。:
It probably has. Like we've
taken a step forward.
translations.うん、じゃあ……ほんとにこれで、旅行は終わりだな。:
Yeah, well... I guess the
trip is really over now.
translations.もう一回、いい？:
Can we do that
one more time？
translations.ねえ、大事なことまだだよね。:
Hey, we haven't done
the important thing yet,
have we？
translations.（旅行の後の、一人の帰り道……なんか切ない）:
(Walking home alone after
a trip... It's kind of sad.)
translations.うん、ごめんね。あの、あなたが家に着くまで話してていいかな？:
Yeah, sorry. Um, is it okay
if we keep talking until
you get home？
translations.特に話すことはないの。なんでもいいから。:
I don't have anything in
particular to talk about.
Anything is fine.
translations.もしあなたが、帰り道寂しいなって思ってたら……。助けてあげたいなって。余計なお世:
If you were feeling lonely
on your way home... I wanted
to help. Is that too nosy？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……。ううん、ありがとう。本当に、そう思ってた。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... No, thank you.
I really was feeling that way.
translations.じゃあもう、切るね。きりがないから。:
Then I'll hang up now.
Otherwise we'll never
stop.
translations.今度こそ、バイバイ。またね？:
Bye-bye for real this time.
See you later, okay？
translations.新婚でしょ？ キスすんの当り前じゃん。:
We're newlyweds, right？
Kissing is a given.
translations.ふふ、隙あり。新婚だもんね？:
Hehe, you left yourself
open. We're newlyweds,
right？
translations.退屈だな……なんて、思ってないよね？ ふふ。:
You aren't thinking...
'this is boring,' are you？
Hehe.
translations.よかった。二人で来られて。:
I'm so glad we could
come here together.
translations.私ばっかりじゃなくて、少しは景色も見るの。ふふ。:
Don't just look at me,
look at the scenery a
little too. Hehe.
translations.写真、いっぱい撮って帰ろうね。:
Let's take lots of pictures
to bring back with us.
translations.時間、止まっちゃえばいいのになぁ。: I wish time would just stop.
translations.温泉巡りもよさそう。:
A hot spring tour sounds
nice too.
translations.熱海の花火大会って、有名だよね。:
Atami's fireworks festival
is pretty famous, isn't it？
translations.ねぇ、ほらあそこ。行ってみない？:
Hey, look over there.
Wanna go check it out？
translations.ほら、見て。桜……きれい。:
Look, see？ The cherry
blossoms... they're
beautiful.
translations.気持ちいい……晴れてよかった。:
It feels so nice... I'm glad
it cleared up.
translations.やっぱりとわのより暑いかな？:
Is it hotter here than
in Towano, you think？
translations.日陰、あるかな。:
I wonder if there's
any shade.
translations.紅葉がキレイだね。:
The autumn leaves
are so pretty.
translations.旅行にはぴったりの季節だね。:
It's the perfect season
for a trip, isn't it？
translations.寒いね……カイロくん、こっちおいで？ ふふ。:
It's cold... Come here,
my little hand warmer？
Hehe.
translations.ね、雪、降らせて？ ふふっ。:
Hey, make it snow
for me？ Hehe.
translations.夜景も、ステキだよね……。:
The night view is
gorgeous, too...
translations.色んなお風呂があるんだね、全部入るのは無理かな。:
There are so many baths.
I don't think we can
try them all.
translations.１泊じゃもったいないね？:
Just one night feels
like a waste, doesn't it？
translations.ここでお土産も、買えるかな。:
I wonder if we can buy
souvenirs here, too.
translations.自分たちだけの旅行って、大人になった気分。:
Taking a trip just the
two of us makes me feel
all grown up.
translations.ちょっと緊張してる……なんて、似合わないかな？:
I'm a little nervous...
Does that not suit me？
translations.肩の力、抜いて？ ふふ、カワイイ。:
Relax your shoulders,
okay？ Hehe, so cute.
translations.お茶いれるから、のんびりしてて？:
I'll make some tea,
so just relax, okay？
translations.お風呂、何度入っちゃってもいいよね。:
We can take as many
baths as we want, right？
translations.さっき、仲居さんに羨ましがられたの。ふふ。:
The maid was jealous of
us earlier. Hehe.
translations.冷蔵庫のものには触らないように。ふふ。:
Make sure you don't touch
the minibar. Hehe.
translations.なにかやり残してること、ないかな。:
Is there anything else
we haven't done yet？
translations.……なんだっけ。何か用あった？:
...What was it again.
Did you need something？
translations.用ってほどじゃないけど……ほら、今日は……ね？ 迷惑じゃなければ……。:
I wouldn't call it a
need, but... you know,
today is... right？
If it's not a bother...
translations.あっ、これ、チョコレート？ ありがとう！:
Ah, is this chocolate？
Thank you!
translations.ちょっと失敗したかもしれないから……もし、美味しくなかったら、ごめんね。:
I might have messed up
a little... so if it
doesn't taste good,
I'm sorry.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が作ったんなら、美味しいに決まってるよ。:
If you made it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
it's guaranteed to be
delicious.
translations.だから……ちょっと、失敗しちゃったの。味見してみたけど、あなたの舌にあうかどうか:
But... I messed it up
a little. I tasted it,
but I'm not confident
you'll like it at all...
translations.いいや、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のチョコレートは絶対美味しいね。そう決めた！:
No way, your chocolate
is definitely delicious,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I've decided!
translations.あーん、もう、いじわる……でも、ちょっと嬉しいかも。ふふ、ありがとう。:
Aw, jeez, you're mean...
But maybe I'm a little
happy. Hehe, thanks.
translations.……ふーん。そうなんだぁ。やっぱり忘れてたんだ。:
...Hmm. I see.
You really did forget.
translations.私、お付き合いしている人に手作りチョコレート、あげるつもりだったんだけど……人違:
I was planning to give
handmade chocolates to
the guy I'm dating...
Do I have the wrong guy？
translations.今日はバレンタインデーか！ ごめん、思い出した！:
Today is Valentine's Day!
Sorry, I remembered!
translations.無理して受け取らなくてもいいよ？ 他にも受け取ってくれる人、どこかにいるかもしれ:
You don't have to force
yourself to take it, you
know？ There might be
someone else who will？
translations.ください！ ごめんなさい！ お願いします！:
Please give it to me!
I'm sorry! I beg you!
translations.ふふ。素直に謝ってくれる可愛いカレシには……はい、ご褒美。:
Hehe. For my cute boyfriend
who apologizes so honestly...
Here, a reward.
translations.可愛い男の子限定のスペシャルなチョコレートがあるんだけど……どうする？:
I have some special
chocolates exclusively
for cute boys...
What do you say？
translations.……あ、今日、バレンタインデーか。ありがとう、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
...Ah, today is
Valentine's Day.
Thank you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.でもその前に……今年、他の子からもらった？ 今のうちに白状するなら、大目に見てあ:
But before that... Did you
get any from other girls
this year？ Confess now,
and I'll let it slide？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に言われるまで忘れるぐらいだから……。:
I forgot all about it until
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ reminded me, so...
translations.……じゃあ、今年のチョコ、私の１個だけ？:
...So, is my chocolate your
only one this year？
translations.じゃあ……こほん……いつも一緒にいてくれて、ありがとう。いーっぱいの愛を込めたチ:
Well then... *Ahem*...
Thanks for always being by
my side. Will you accept this
chocolate filled with all my
love？
translations.うん……ありがとう、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。すごく、嬉しいよ。:
Yeah... Thanks, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I'm really happy.
translations.今日は私たちがお付き合いを始めた日かあ……早いねぇ。:
Today is the day we started
dating... Time flies, huh.
translations.うん。なんだかあっという間だったよね。:
Yeah. It feels like it went by
in a flash.
translations.あの日、勇気を出してよかったな……あ、でも、本当に迷惑じゃなかった？:
I'm so glad I gathered my
courage that day... Oh, but,
was I really not a bother？
translations.まさか。すごく嬉しかったよ。: No way. I was really happy.
translations.記念日だから……プレゼント用意したんだけど……。:
Since it's our anniversary...
I got you a present...
translations.ほんと、嬉しい。じゃあ、交換……。:
I'm so happy. Well then,
let's exchange them...
translations.わあ……ありがとう！ また、あなたとの思い出、ひとつ増えちゃった……。:
Wow... Thanks！ Now I have
another precious memory
with you...
translations.ありがとう。私、こういうのもけっこう好きよ。:
Thanks. I actually quite like
this kind of thing.
translations.……うん、２人の記念の品だもんね。大切にするね。:
...Yeah, it's a memento of
our anniversary. I'll be sure
to treasure it.
translations.毎年……これからも毎年、お祝いしたいな……。:
Every year... I want us to
celebrate it every year from
now on...
translations.この日が来るたびに、また私たちの仲が深まってくんだね……。:
Every time this day comes,
our relationship grows even
deeper...
translations.私たち、この日に付き合い始めたんだよね……ふふ、思い出すだけでドキドキしない？:
We started dating on this
day, didn't we... Hehe, doesn't
remembering it make your
heart pound？
translations.あの時、勇気を出してよかったな……こんな年上のイジワルなお姉さんなんて、相手にし:
I'm so glad I gathered my
courage back then... I thought
you wouldn't give a mean
older girl like me the time
of day.
translations.ふふ、ありがとう。これからもずっと仲良くしようね。:
Hehe, thanks. Let's stay
close forever, okay？
translations.あと私から、記念日のプレゼント。:
Also, here's an anniversary
present from me.
translations.うん、ありがとう。●からも……。:
Yeah, thanks. Here's one from
●, too...
translations.わぁ……ふふ、私の喜ばせ方、わかってきたんだ。これだともう少し優しくしてあげない:
Wow... Hehe, you're learning
how to make me happy. Does
this mean I need to be a
little sweeter to you？
translations.……この様子だと、まだまだいろいろ教えてあげないとダメかな。:
...Looking at this, I guess
I still have a lot to teach
you.
translations.だって、毎年お祝いしたいでしょ？:
I mean, you want to celebrate
it every year, right？
translations.ふふ、だから今から楽しみなの！:
Hehe, that's why I'm already
looking forward to it！
translations.今日は私たちが付き合い始めた記念日……今年もあなたと一緒に過ごすことができて、私:
Today is the anniversary of
when we started dating... I'm
so happy I get to spend it
with you again this year.
translations.あの時の私、すごく勇気を出したんだから。自分でも信じられないくらいに。:
I really gathered a lot of
courage back then. So much
that even I couldn't believe
it.
translations.おかげで一緒にいられるんだから、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の勇気に感謝しないとね。:
Thanks to that we can be
together, so I have to thank
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ for being so brave.
translations.よろしい。これからもその気持ちを忘れないでね？ ふふ。:
Good. Don't forget that
feeling from now on, okay？
Hehe.
translations.あとね……私から記念日のプレゼント。:
Also... Here's an anniversary
present from me.
translations.ありがとう。●からもあるよ。:
Thanks. I have one from
●, too.
translations.わぁ……ふふ、私の好きなものをお見通しなんだ。嬉しいなぁ……ふふ。:
Wow... Hehe, you saw right
through to what I like. I'm so
happy... Hehe.
translations.あら、素敵。ありがとう、大切にするね。:
Oh, how lovely. Thanks, I'll
treasure it.
translations.……うーん……まあ、いいかな。うん、ありがとう。:
...Hmm... Well, I guess it's
fine. Yeah, thanks.
translations.素敵……今から楽しみだな。:
How wonderful... I'm already
looking forward to it.
translations.なーに、あなたがリードしたいの？:
What, do you want
to take the lead？
translations.そんなことしたら眠っちゃうよ？:
Do that, and
I'll fall asleep？
translations.くすぐったいだけじゃ、ないよ。:
It's not just
ticklish, you know.
translations.何をうかがってるのかなあ？:
What are you trying
to see？
translations.相手があなただと、敏感になっちゃう。:
When it's you,
I get so sensitive.
translations.こーら、何考えてる？:
Hey, what are you
thinking about？
translations.離れたくなくなっても、知らないぞ？:
Don't blame me if you
never want to let go？
translations.ほら、こないとおしおき！:
Come here, or else
I'll punish you!
translations.嫌いになっちゃったのかなあ。:
I wonder if you've
grown to hate me.
translations.もうメロメロです！ ふふふっ。:
I'm completely head
over heels! Hehehe.
translations.私も焦っちゃった、かも？:
I might have gotten a
little impatient too？
translations.まあ、いっか。楽しみはとっておかなきゃ。:
Oh well. Gotta save
the fun for later.
translations.ふふ、もうちょっと。ね？:
Hehe, just a little
more. Okay？
translations.ねぇ、カレーライスにソースって、かける？:
Hey, do you put sauce

on your curry rice？
translations.たまに聞くけど……お客さんでそういう人いた？:
I hear about it sometimes...

Did a customer do that？
translations.うん……ちょっと不思議、って。:
Yeah... I thought it was

a little strange.
translations.甘味が出るのかな、まあ人それぞれだよな。刺身にマヨネーズって人もいるし。:
Maybe it makes it sweeter.

Well, to each their own.

Some put mayo on sashimi.
translations.それは不思議じゃないかも。だって、ほら、カルパッチョみたいなものでしょ？:
That might not be so weird.

I mean, it's kind of like

carpaccio, right？
translations.イタリア料理。牛肉が基本だけど、お刺身系も多いから。:
Italian. It's usually beef,

but they use raw fish

a lot, too.
translations.マヨネーズソースね。だから、マヨネーズ自体お刺身に合うのかも。:
Mayonnaise sauce. So mayo

itself probably goes well

with sashimi.
translations.●は……刺身は醤油がいいけどな。:
I don't know about ●,

but I prefer soy sauce

with sashimi.
translations.カレーライスにソースって昔は普通だったみたい。:
Putting sauce on curry rice

used to be normal, apparently.
translations.そうなの？ 昔ってどれくらい前？:
Really？ How long ago

is 'used to be'？
translations.あれ、どうだったかな。こういうの、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の方が詳しくない？:
Huh, I wonder. Aren't you

more familiar with this

kind of thing, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.それ、私がおばさんってこと？:
Are you calling me

an old lady？
translations.ひとつしか違わないじゃん！ ほら、昔の映画とかでさ。:
We're only one year apart!

I mean, like in old movies.
translations.映画……そういえば……『三丁目の墓場』の食事シーンで、カレーにソースかけてたよう:
Movies... Now that you

mention it... didn't they

do that in Graveyard on

Third Street？
translations.それっていつの映画？:
When did that movie

come out？
translations.ほら、やっぱり昔のことに詳しい。:
See, you really do know

a lot about the past.
translations.それ、本当にほめられてるのかなあ。:
I'm not sure if that's

actually a compliment...
translations.カレーにソースもそんなに意外じゃないかも。フラッペにコーヒーだってあるんだし。:
Sauce on curry might not be

that surprising. I mean,

there's coffee on frappes.
translations.フラッペ……かき氷にコーヒー？ 氷が溶けちゃわない？:
Frappes... Coffee on

shaved ice？ Wouldn't

the ice melt？
translations.ホットじゃなくて、シロップになってて……もう、わかるでしょ。:
Not hot coffee, it's made

into a syrup... Come on,

you know what I mean.
translations.アイスコーヒーが凍ったようなもんか。かき氷だったら、●は何かけるのがいいかな。:
So it's like frozen iced

coffee. If it were shaved ice,

what would ● put on it？
translations.ふふっ、子供はみんなイチゴシロップが好きだよね？:
Hehe, all kids love

strawberry syrup, right？
translations.そう？ じゃあ、醤油かければ大人かな。:
Yeah？ Then I guess putting

soy sauce on it makes

you an adult.
translations.フラッペに、お醤油？ ふふっ。:
Soy sauce on a frappe？

Hehe.
translations.前に、かき氷の話出たけどさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は何シロップが好きなの？:
We talked about shaved ice

before, but what kind of

syrup does ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ like？
translations.ふふっ、なんだと思う？ イチゴじゃないよ？:
Hehe, what do you think？

It's not strawberry.
translations.レモン、メロン、青リンゴ、グレープフルーツ、パイン、ブルーベリー、宇治茶、……あ:
Lemon, melon, green apple,

grapefruit, pineapple,

blueberry, matcha...

What else is there？
translations.数撃てば？ 残念だけど、どれも外れ。:
Just guessing everything？

Too bad, they're all wrong.
translations.オレンジ、ラムネ……一般的なのもマイナーなのもみんな言ったよ。降参。:
Orange, ramune... I've said

all the common and rare ones.

I give up.
translations.あ、忘れてた！ でもさ、それって……。:
Ah, I forgot about that!

But wait, isn't that...
translations.何、不満そう？:
What, you got a problem

with that？
translations.イチゴより子供っぽくない？:
Isn't that more childish

than strawberry？
translations.動物の保護色ってあるじゃない？:
You know how animals
have camouflage？
translations.ああ、環境に溶け込むようにってやつ。:
Yeah, the stuff that lets
them blend in.
translations.あの白黒模様って、何に似せたのかな？:
I wonder what that black
and white pattern mimics？
translations.白と黒って……なんだ？ そんな場所あるのか、あ、シマウマも白黒か。:
Black and white... what is it？
Is there a place like that...
Oh, zebras are black and white too.
translations.あのストライプ模様は木と木の間だと保護色になるんだよ。:
Those stripes act as
camouflage when they're
between trees.
translations.ストライプ模様じゃないからそうはならないと思うけど。:
They don't have stripes,
so I don't think that's it.
translations.パンダの模様に似ているもの、思いついたの。:
I just thought of something
that looks like a panda's
pattern.
translations.おお、あの白黒は何に似せてるんだ？:
Oh, what does that black
and white mimic？
translations.下のほうだけに海苔が付いたおにぎり。コンビニのスタンダード型、わかるでしょ。:
The kind with seaweed just
on the bottom. The standard
convenience store type, you know？
translations.パンダ、遠目から見たらおにぎりに見えない？:
Don't pandas look like
onigiri from a distance？
translations.でも、おにぎりだったらよけい他の動物に狙われるような……だって食べ物なんだし。:
But if they look like onigiri,
wouldn't they be targeted more...
I mean, it's food.
translations.狙うとしたら肉食の動物だろうからおにぎりは食べないんじゃないかな？:
The ones targeting them would
be carnivores, so they wouldn't
eat onigiri, right？
translations.パンダって中国にしかいなくて、おにぎりって日本の物で……混乱してきた。:
Pandas are only in China,
and onigiri are Japanese...
I'm getting confused.
translations.パンダの模様に似ているもの、また思いついたの。:
I thought of something else
that looks like a panda's
pattern.
translations.はは。もう、何がなんだか。:
Haha. I don't even know
what's going on anymore.
translations.パトカーなら密猟者だって近づかないでしょ。:
Even poachers wouldn't go
near a police car, right？
translations.えっと、中国のパトカーも白黒のツートンなのかな？:
Um, are police cars in China
two-tone black and white too？
translations.調査が甘いんじゃない？ 不合格、なんつって。:
Isn't your research a bit lacking？
You fail! Just kidding.
translations.『パンダ四十七匹、呪いの討入』っていうホラー映画があるの。:
There's a horror movie called
'47 Pandas: The Cursed Raid'.
translations.よくわかったね。その映画でね、雪の中をパンダが行進して来るんだけど……。:
You guessed it. In the movie,
pandas come marching
through the snow...
translations.きっと討ち入りのシーンだな。: That must be the raid scene.
translations.そう。パンダの白い部分は、雪と一体化して、黒い部分はただの影だと思われて……誰も:
Right. The white parts blend in
with the snow, and the black parts
look like shadows...
so no one notices.
translations.その説は、おにぎりやパトカーよりも説得力があるな。:
That theory is more convincing
than onigiri or police cars.
translations.うん。白黒ってそういう保護色なんだと思う。映画も役に立つよね。:
Yeah. I think that's how black
and white camouflage works.
Movies can be helpful, huh？
translations.うん、役に立つな。ところでそのパンダ、どこに討ち入りするの？:
Yeah, very helpful. By the way,
where are the pandas raiding？
translations.（……その映画、やっぱ参考にならない）:
(...That movie really isn't
helpful at all.)
translations.「野菜屋さん」や「果物屋さん」じゃだめなのかな。:
Why not just call them 'vegetable
shops' or 'fruit shops'？
translations.魚は「魚屋」だし、肉は「肉屋」だよな。八百屋だけ……なんでだ？:
Fish is at a 'fish shop',
meat is at a 'meat shop'.
But 'yaoya'... why is that？
translations.八百種類あるから？ 野菜と果物の数が。:
Because there are 800 kinds？
Of fruits and vegetables,
I mean.
translations.数で言うなら魚もけっこうあるよな。肉は数えられそうだけど。:
If we're talking numbers,
there's a lot of fish, too.
Meat seems countable, though.
translations.ビーフ、ポーク、チキン、あとはマトン……。馬や猪を入れても数えられる範囲かな。:
Beef, pork, chicken,
and mutton... Even with horse
and boar, it's countable.
translations.この前、スーパーでカンガルーの肉って見た。:
I saw kangaroo meat at the
supermarket the other day.
translations.どの動物だって、命は等しいはずだけど……。それでも……ちょっとショック。:
All animal lives are equal,
of course, but...
It's still a bit shocking.
translations.前に言ってた、「八百屋」って呼ばれる理由、わかった？:
Did you figure out why
they're called 'yaoya'
like we talked about？
translations.私、考えてたの。野菜は、古くから日本人に親しまれてたよね。:
I was thinking about it.
Veggies have been close to
Japanese people for ages.
translations.それは世界中どこでも……。:
I think that's true anywhere
in the world...
translations.日本人は特に！ 農耕民族なんだから。:
Especially for Japanese！
We're a farming people.
translations.野菜と人との密着、生活との一体化、必然的に煩悩がうまれて……。:
The close bond with veggies,
becoming one with our lives,
creates worldly desires...
translations.それを打ち払うってことで同じ数にしたの。除夜の鐘みたいなもの。:
So they made it the same
number to drive them away.
Like the New Year's bell.
translations.もう、それはいいの。それより、野菜の効用に関係があると思うの。:
Jeez, forget about that.
I think it has to do with
the benefits of vegetables.
translations.効用……温泉みたいだ。:
Benefits... Sounds like
a hot spring.
translations.ビタミンＣ、ビタミンＡ……そういう栄養とダイエット効果みたいな効用が八百あって。:
Vitamin C, Vitamin A...
There are 800 benefits like
nutrition and diet effects.
translations.ああ、名前の由来？: Ah, the origin of the name？
translations.八百万から由来してるんじゃないかな。:
I think it comes from
'yaoyorozu'—the 8 million.
translations.そう。要するに、たくさんありますよってこと。:
Right. Basically, it just
means there's a whole lot
of them.
translations.ふーん、それっぽいな。そろそろちゃんと調べて、答え合わせしてみる？:
Hmm, that sounds plausible.
Should we look it up and
see if you're right？
translations.いいけど……それじゃつまらないよね。:
We could... but that'd
be boring.
translations.そういうもの。二人で色々考えるのが、楽しいんだもん。:
That's how it is. It's fun
to think about these things
together with you.
translations.とわの市って、どこかの姉妹都市になってるんだよね。:
Towano is sister cities
with somewhere else, right？
translations.聞いたことあるな、どこの国だっけ、ヨーロッパの……。:
I've heard that. What
country was it again？
Somewhere in Europe...
translations.どうして「姉妹都市」って呼ばれるのかな？:
I wonder why they're
called "sister cities"？
translations.やっぱり、仲がいいから？:
Is it because they get
along well？
translations.それだったら親友都市でもいいよね。:
If that were it, they could
just be "best friend cities."
translations.都市同士が似てるから？ 面積とか環境とかあとエコ対策とか。:
Because the cities are
similar？ Like in size,
environment, or eco policies.
translations.それはあるかも。だけど、「姉妹」なのはどうして？:
That might be it.
But why "sisters"？
translations.……なんでだろ。世界七不思議？:
...I wonder why. One of the
Seven Wonders of the World？
translations.そうだ、姉妹都市の「姉妹」のことだけど……。:
Oh right, about the "sister"
part of sister cities...
translations.ああ、世界七不思議。:
Ah, the Seven Wonders of
the World.
translations.違うよ。「姉妹」なのは、そっちのほうが世界標準だからだと思うの。:
No. I think they use "sisters"
because that's the global
standard.
translations.ほら、世界の名作って「姉妹」ばかりじゃない。:
You know, all the great world
masterpieces are about
"sisters."
translations.ノレノワーノレの姉妹の絵とか。:
And the painting of the
sisters by Norenoir.
translations.そんな理由で、「姉妹」は世界標準なの。:
For those reasons, "sisters"
is the global standard.
translations.（標準にしては、例がふたつしかないな）:
(For a standard, she only
has two examples...)
translations.前に、世界の名作は「姉妹」ばかりって言ってただろ。:
You said before that all the
great world masterpieces
are about "sisters," right？
translations.ふふっ、ムキになっちゃって。調べたんだ。:
Hehe, you got so defensive.
You actually looked it up.
translations.図書委員だからさ。:
I'm on the library
committee, after all.
translations.でもその話の兄弟って仲良くなくて、重いし、暗いし。:
But the brothers in that story
don't get along. It's so
heavy and dark.
translations.都市と都市が、そんな兄弟みたいになりましょう、って言うと思う？:
Do you really think cities
would say, "Let's be like
those brothers"？
translations.『干し草物語』みたいな姉妹にならない、って誘われたらワクワクしない？:
Wouldn't it be exciting to be
invited to be sisters like
in "Little Hay"？
translations.たしかに……って、そういう問題だっけ？:
True... wait, is that really
the issue here？
translations.姉妹都市の話。そういえば台風も女だったなって。:
The sister cities thing.
It reminded me that
typhoons are women too.
translations.スージーとかカトリーナとか怒った▲姉ヶ崎＊▲とか。:
Like Susie, Katrina, or
an angry ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.はは、まあそんなわけでさ。こういうのってやっぱ男より女の方がしっくりくるよね。:
Haha, well, you know.
I guess women just fit better
for these things than men.
translations.それはあなたが男の子だからかもよ？:
Maybe that's just because
you're a boy？
translations.男の子はみんな可愛い女の子好きだもんね？:
Boys all love cute girls,
don't they？
translations.女の子から言わせちゃ、ダメでしょ？:
You shouldn't make a girl
say it, you know？
translations.ほら、甘えさせてあげる。:
Come here, let me
spoil you.
translations.よし、くっついちゃうよ？:
Alright, I'm gonna
snuggle up to you？
translations.うん、したいんでしょ？:
Yeah, you want to,
don't you？
translations.実は待ってました。:
I was actually
waiting for this.
translations.やめなくて、いいんだよ？:
You don't have to stop,
you know？
translations.これ以上は……私も。:
Any more than this...
I might...
translations.ねえ、あなたは平気なの？ こんなの……。:
Are you really okay
with this...？
translations.私のこと、こんなにしちゃうなんて……バカ。:
Making me feel like this...
you dummy.
translations.また、あなたのこと好きになっちゃった。:
I just fell in love with
you all over again.
translations.こんなに満たされちゃって、いいのかな。:
Is it okay for me to feel
this satisfied...？
translations.私の全部が、あなたになっちゃう……。:
My whole being is
becoming yours...
translations.ドキドキするのに、落ち着く……。:
My heart's pounding, but
I feel so calm...
translations.好き……まだ足りない。:
I love you...
it's still not enough.
translations.いつもの仕返ししようとしてる？:
Are you trying to get
back at me like usual？
translations.キス、してほしい。お願い。:
I want you to kiss me.
Please.
translations.キス、していいんだよ？:
You know you can kiss me,
right？
translations.お願いしなきゃ、ダメ？ キスしてほしいの。:
Do I have to beg？
I want you to kiss me.
translations.遠慮してるなら、いらないよ。キスして。:
If you're holding back,
I don't want it. Kiss me.
translations.何度でも言うから。キス、して？:
I'll say it as many times
as it takes. Kiss me？
translations.もう怒った。キスしないと、許さない。:
Now I'm mad. I won't forgive
you unless you kiss me.
translations.チョコだけじゃなくて、キスももらってくれたね。:
You accepted my kiss along
with the chocolate.
translations.ふふ。チョコだけじゃなくて、うれしい？:
Hehe. Are you happy to get
more than just chocolate？
translations.チョコだけじゃなくて、キスにも愛情こめたんだよ？:
I put my love into the kiss,
not just the chocolate.
translations.記念日の思い出、増えちゃった。ありがとう……。:
Another anniversary memory
made. Thank you...
translations.今日のキスは記念だよ。忘れちゃダメだからね？:
Today's kiss is to celebrate.
Don't you forget it, okay？
translations.この歳になって、はじめてのキス……。: My first kiss at this age...
translations.ふふ、この誕生日のキス。覚えててあげる。:
Hehe, this birthday kiss.
I'll remember it for you.
translations.今年の誕生日、忘れられなくなっちゃったな。:
I won't be able to forget
this year's birthday.
translations.あなたの誕生日にこんな……うれしい。:
Doing this on your birthday...
I'm so happy.
translations.キスのプレゼントも、ちゃ～んと感謝してね？ ふふ。:
Make sure you appreciate
your kiss present, okay？ Hehe.
translations.あなたがこの歳になって、はじめてのキスだよ？:
Your first kiss at this age,
right？
translations.思い出のクリスマスになっちゃった……。:
This turned into a Christmas
to remember...
translations.うん、今年のクリスマスは合格。ふふふ。:
Yep, this year's Christmas
gets a passing grade. Hehe.
translations.これもお姉さんサンタからの、プレゼントだよ？:
This is a present from your
big sister Santa, too.
translations.また次の記念日も……キスしたいな。:
I want to kiss you again...
on our next anniversary.
translations.今回の記念日も、いい思い出になったよ？ よろしい。:
This anniversary is another
good memory. Good boy.
translations.記念日にキスするの、何度目かな？:
How many times have we kissed
on our anniversary now？
translations.ずっとがまんしてた。:
I've been holding back this
whole time.
translations.今日は、甘えちゃうんだから。:
I'm gonna let myself be
spoiled today.
translations.今日は、離してあげない。:
I'm not letting you go
today.
translations.もう離したくないよ。:
I never want to let you
go again.
translations.熱海よいとこ一度はおいで。:
Atami's a nice place,
come visit sometime.
translations.男は目で恋をして、女は耳で恋に落ちるの。:
Men fall in love with their
eyes, and women with
their ears.
translations.もー、こぼしちゃ駄目って言ったのに。:
Jeez, I told you not to
spill it.
translations.それがあなたのいいところ。:
That's what I like
about you.
translations.ちゃんと狙いなさい？:
Make sure you aim
properly, okay？
translations.大丈夫、こんなこともあろうかと！:
Don't worry, I came
prepared for this!
translations.電子オルガン、うまみ調味料、マグロ油漬け缶詰……はあ、窮屈な世の中。:
Electronic organs, MSG,
canned tuna... Sigh, what
a restrictive world.
translations.毎日あなたに会いたいな。:
I want to see you
every day.
translations.あなたじゃなきゃ、やだよ。:
I don't want anyone
but you.
translations.でも、いじわるされるのきらいじゃないよ▼:
But I don't hate it when
you tease me.▼
translations.クラウドってＩＴとは違うの？:
Is the cloud different
from IT？
translations.こんなところにホクロあったんだ。:
I didn't know you had
a mole here.
translations.海の向こう、全米が震撼してる……。:
Across the ocean, all of
America is trembling...
translations.快刀乱麻、さすがだね♪:
Swift and decisive,
just like you♪
translations.できることと、できないことがあるよ。:
There are things you can do,
and things you can't.
translations.今日こそ早く帰るぞ！:
I'm definitely going home
early today!
translations.壁に耳あり、障子にメアリー。:
Walls have ears,
shoji have Mary.
translations.名言の時間だよ。:
It's time for a famous
quote.
translations.この番組は姉ヶ崎寧々の提供でお送りしました。:
This program was brought to
you by Nene Anegasaki.
translations.耳たぶくらいの硬さでね♪:
About as soft as
an earlobe♪
translations.あの犬のように自由に飛べたら。:
If only I could fly freely
like that dog.
translations.賞味期限の遡及適用を提案します。:
I propose the retroactive
application of expiration
dates.
translations.アスパルテームは愛の呪文▼:
Aspartame is the spell
of love.▼
translations.ちょっとジャンプしてみて。: Try jumping for me a bit.
translations.折鶴に、雌の折り方があるの。知ってた？:
Did you know there's a way
to fold a female paper crane？
translations.先手必勝、やっちゃえ～！:
Strike first to win,
go for it!
translations.私は車輪の音が聞きたいのに。:
But I wanted to hear
the sound of the wheels.
translations.失敗は成功のマザーだよ。:
Failure is the mother
of success.
translations.あなたさえいてくれれば、いいよ。:
As long as I have you,
I'm happy.
translations.もちろん、攻撃力に全フリ。:
Obviously, I put all
my points into attack.
translations.唇荒れてない？ リップ使う？:
Are your lips chapped？
Want some lip balm？
translations.こんなところに弱点発見！:
Found a weak spot
right here!
translations.あ、私のこと見てた？: Ah, were you looking at me？
translations.まーたそんなことして、駄目なんだからね。:
There you go doing that
again. You're so bad.
translations.今日の天気は晴れ！ どうあたってた？:
Today's weather is sunny!
Was I right？
translations.今日の天気は雨！ どうあたってた？:
Today's weather is rainy!
Was I right？
translations.今日の天気は曇り！ どうあたってた？:
Today's weather is cloudy!
Was I right？
translations.今日の天気は恋模様！ どうあたってた？:
Today's weather is love!
Was I right？
translations.えっと……リーチ、トイトイ、白発中かな？:
Umm... Riichi, Toitoi,
Haku, Hatsu, Chun？
translations.どっちかというと大反対かな。:
If anything, I'd say
I'm completely against it.
translations.無病息災、元気が一番だね。:
Good health is the most
important thing.
translations.興味津々、私の何が知りたい？:
So curious. What do you
want to know about me？
translations.今日は眠そうだね？ 最近寝不足？:
You look sleepy today.
Not getting enough sleep？
translations.ドリンクバーで、ミックスジュース。:
Mixed juice from
the drink bar.
translations.やだ！ すご～い５身合体！:
No way! An amazing
five-part combination!
translations.ウエハース３ダース、ジャージ。体育館シューズは何ダースだっけ？:
Three dozen wafers,
a jersey. How many dozen
gym shoes？
translations.あなたと一緒なら、四畳半一間でも。:
As long as I'm with you,
even a tiny room is fine.
translations.面目躍如、頑張ったね♪:
You really proved yourself.
You worked hard♪
translations.自然体が一番。:
It's best to just
be yourself.
translations.ネネニウムを補給する時間だよ。:
It's time to replenish
your Nenenium.
translations.一目瞭然、わかりやすいね。:
It's obvious at a glance.
You're so easy to read.
translations.まんじゅうよりも、あなたが怖い。:
I'm more afraid of you
than manju.
translations.野生のアライグマってあんまり物を洗わないらしいよ。:
Apparently wild raccoons
don't really wash things.
translations.狸寝入りって英語だと……誰か来たみたい。:
Playing possum in English is...
Looks like someone's here.
translations.やった、大漁だね？:
Yay, a big catch,
isn't it？
translations.やった、大安だね？:
Yay, it's a lucky day,
isn't it？
translations.やった、一番だね？:
Yay, you're number one,
aren't you？
translations.やった、１００点だね？:
Yay, a perfect score,
isn't it？
translations.やった、いい夢見たね？:
Yay, you had a good dream,
didn't you？
translations.やった、友だち増えたね？:
Yay, you made more friends,
didn't you？
translations.やった、大成功だね？:
Yay, a huge success,
isn't it？
translations.やった、やったね？:
Yay, you did it,
didn't you？
translations.やった、笑えたね？:
Yay, that was funny,
wasn't it？
translations.もうすぐお正月。やっぱり最初のデートは初詣が定番かな。:
New Year's is coming up.
A shrine visit is a classic
first date, isn't it？
translations.二人の新しい一年がよくなるように、きちんとお参りしたいな。:
I want to pray properly
so that our new year
together is a good one.
translations.初詣行きたいけど……大丈夫かな、カレ。:
I want to go to the shrine,
but... I wonder if he's
up for it.
translations.もうすぐバレンタイン。どうしよう。:
Valentine's Day is coming
up. What should I do？
translations.カレへの愛情、ちゃーんと届けるんだ。:
I'm going to make sure
my love reaches him.
translations.私の気持ち、送りたいけど。ちゃんとカレまで届くかな。:
I want to send him my
feelings, but... I wonder
if they'll get through.
translations.もうすぐホワイトデー。気にしないのは、無理だなあ。:
White Day is almost here.
It's impossible for me
not to care.
translations.カレのこと、信じてるもん。きっと素敵な日になるだろうな。:
I believe in him. I'm sure
it'll be a wonderful day.
translations.大丈夫、信じてるもん。忘れてなんか……ないよね。:
It's okay, I believe in
him. There's no way he'd
forget... right？
translations.もうすぐエイプリルフール。何か言ってくるかな。:
April Fool's is coming up.
I wonder if he'll say
something to me.
translations.カレの嘘だったら、信じたくなっちゃうな。ふふ。:
If it's a lie from him,
I might just want to
believe it. Hehe.
translations.どうだろ。あまり、気にしてないな。:
I wonder. I'm not really
worrying about it.
translations.もうすぐゴールデンウィーク。何があるかな。:
Golden Week is almost here.
I wonder what'll happen.
translations.楽しく過ごせるといいな。もちろん、カレと一緒に。:
I hope we have a fun time.
Together, of course.
translations.予定……何かあるのかな。:
I wonder... if he has
any plans.
translations.もうすぐ学校のプール開き。私を見たら、カレどんな反応するんだろ。:
The school pool opens soon.
I wonder how he'll react
when he sees me.
translations.自信ないけど、やっぱり見て欲しい気持ちの方が強いな。:
I'm not confident, but...
I want him to look at me
more than anything.
translations.他の子に目移りしちゃったら、どうしよう。:
What should I do if his
eyes wander to other girls？
translations.もうすぐ七夕。カレはどんな願い事するのかな。:
Tanabata is almost here.
I wonder what he'll
wish for.
translations.私がお願いするのは……もちろんカレと、ふふ。:
My wish is... about him,
of course. Hehe.
translations.うーん。私がはしゃいでも、カレは付き合ってくれるかな。:
Hmm. Even if I get excited,
I wonder if he'll tag
along.
translations.もうすぐ水着コンテストだって。男の子、好きだよね。:
The swimsuit contest is
soon. Boys love that stuff,
don't they？
translations.カノジョが優勝したら、喜ぶのかな？:
I wonder if he'd be happy
if his girlfriend won？
translations.はあ……。他の子の水着、じろじろ見るのかな。:
Sigh... I wonder if he'll
stare at other girls in
their swimsuits.
translations.もうすぐ体育祭。カレのかっこいいところ、見たいな。:
The sports festival is
soon. I want to see him
looking cool.
translations.がんばってるカレを応援するのが好き……ふふ。:
I love cheering for him
when he's trying his best...
Hehe.
translations.思い出できるかな。気にしてくれるといいんだけど。:
I wonder if we'll make
memories. I hope he cares
about it.
translations.もうすぐハロウィン。カレと二人で過ごすなら、どうするのがいいかな。:
Halloween is coming up.
If we spend it together,
what should we do？
translations.カレのことビックリさせる、いい機会かも。:
It might be a good chance
to surprise him.
translations.カレ、興味もってくれるかな……。:
I wonder if he'll be
interested in it...
translations.もうすぐ文化祭。カレと過ごせれば、きっと楽しいな。:
The culture festival is
soon. I'm sure it'll be fun
if I spend it with him.
translations.カレと二人でロマンチックに過ごせないかな……ふふ。:
I wonder if we can spend
it romantically together...
Hehe.
translations.予定あわなかったら、どうしよう。ふう……。:
What if our schedules
don't match up？ *Sigh*...
translations.もうすぐクリスマス。イヴは絶対、カレと一緒に……。:
Christmas is almost here.
I definitely want to spend
Eve with him...
translations.カレのことだもん。きっと一緒にいてくれる。:
Knowing him, I'm sure
he'll be with me.
translations.もし一緒に過ごせなかったら、私……。:
If we can't spend it
together, I'll...
translations.私たちは「前からの付き合い」なの。ね？:
We've been 'dating for
a while' now. Right？
translations.私たち「今回からの付き合い」なんだよ？:
We're 'just starting to
date' now, you know？
translations.うふふ、聞いて？ あのね、お泊まりしたんだ。カレと▼:
Hehe, guess what？ I went
on an overnight trip.
With him.▼
translations.私は、カレと一緒にお泊まりしたいって、思ってるんだけどね。:
I've been thinking I'd like
to go on an overnight trip
with him, though.
translations.カレと出かけたら日焼けしちゃって。もう水着の跡がすごいの。:
I went out with him and got
a tan. My swimsuit marks
are crazy.
translations.カレと一緒に泳いだんだけど、日焼け対策はちゃんとしたんだ。:
I went swimming with him,
but I made sure to use
sunscreen.
translations.やさしいの、すっごく。そこがカレのいいとこ。:
He's so sweet.
That's what's so great
about him.
translations.カレってクールで。そこがまたかっこいいんだ。:
He's really cool.
That's what makes him
so handsome.
translations.カレ、年下なのに。私のことリードしてくれることもあるんだ。:
Even though he's younger,
he still takes the lead
sometimes.
translations.カレってちょっぴり受け身だから。やっぱりお姉さんがリードしないとね。:
He's a little passive,
so his big sister has to
take the lead, you know？
translations.カレが「大きな画面でよく見えるようになった」って。なんのことだろ。:
He said, 'I can see you
better on a big screen.'
I wonder what he meant.
translations.カレがね「もっと大きな画面がいいな」って言うの。うーん、なんだろ。:
He said, 'I wish I had a
bigger screen.'
Hmm, I wonder why.
translations.カレとサヨナラしても、またすぐ会いに来るの。甘えん坊なの。:
Even when we say goodbye,
he comes right back to see
me. He's so clingy.
translations.一旦サヨナラするとね、次になかなか会えないんだ……。:
Once we say goodbye,
it's hard to see him again
for a while...
translations.あ、呼び方知りたいな。カレのこと、なんて呼んでるの？:
Oh, I'm curious.
What do you call him？
translations.ねえねえ。カレのこと、何て呼んでるか、教えて欲しいな。:
Hey, hey. I want you to
tell me what you call him.
translations.苗字かあ、なるほどね。:
His last name, huh？
Makes sense.
translations.ふふ、やっぱり名前？ そうなんだ。:
Hehe, his first name？
I see.
translations.そっちの呼び方は？ どんなの？:
What about you？
What do you call him？
translations.それじゃあ、あなたはなんて呼んでるのかな？:
Well then, what do you
call him？
translations.困ったことがあったら、言ってね？:
If you run into trouble,
just tell me, okay？
translations.一緒にいても、いい？:
Is it okay if I stay
here with you？
translations.一生懸命なあなたが……好きだな？:
I love how hard you work...
You know that？
translations.ふふ、ちゃーんと見てるよ▼:
Hehe, I'm watching you
very closely.▼
translations.学校でもビシビシ指導するよ？ な～んてね。:
I'll be super strict with
you at school too？ Kidding!
translations.勉強もいいけど……私も、ね？:
Studying is great, but...
make time for me too, okay？
translations.んー、私はダメだな。こういうのはあなたに任せる。:
Hmm, I'm no good at this.
I'll leave it to you.
translations.ほーら、もうちょっとがんばる！:
Come on, just push
a little harder!
translations.難しかったら、諦めちゃうのもありだよ？:
If it's too hard, it's okay
to give up, you know？
translations.無理してないなら、応援するよ。:
As long as you don't
overdo it, I'll cheer you on.
translations.教えられるとこもあるけど、自分でやった方がいいよね。:
I could teach you some,
but it's better to do it
yourself.
translations.間違えるたびにお仕置き！ なんて言ったら、もっとがんばれる？:
A punishment for every
mistake! Would saying that
make you work harder？
translations.どれどれ？ 見せてみなさい？:
Let's see.
Show me what you've got？
translations.集中してると疲れるよね。飴食べる？:
Focusing makes you tired,
huh. Want a candy？
translations.うーん。私にアドバイスできること、あるかな。:
Hmm. I wonder if there's any
advice I can give you.
translations.んー？ 私には見せられないのかなあ？:
Hmm？ Is it something
you can't show me？
translations.これがあなたの描く絵か、ふむふむ。:
So this is what you draw.
Hmm, hmm.
translations.あなたのやりたいようにやれば、いいと思うよ。:
I think you should just
do it however you want to.
translations.邪魔じゃなければ、見ててもいいかな？:
If I'm not in the way,
can I watch？
translations.隠さないの。ちゃんと見せて？:
Don't hide it.
Let me see it properly？
translations.最後までがんばって。ね？:
Do your best until the end.
Okay？
translations.そうやってがんばって、またかっこよくなっちゃうの？:
Are you going to get even
cooler by working so hard？
translations.ここにいるよ。邪魔はしないから。:
I'll be right here.
I won't get in your way.
translations.失敗しても、慰めてあげるから。:
Even if you mess up,
I'll comfort you.
translations.あ、私が見てると緊張するとか？:
Ah, does me watching
make you nervous？
translations.あ、教室移動？ 何気なく会えるのって、うれしいな。:
Ah, changing classes？
It's nice running into you
like this.
translations.なんでもがんばっちゃうあなたが好きだな。:
I love how you always
give everything your all.
translations.ふふ、ちゃーんと見ててあげる。:
Hehe, I'll keep a close
eye on you.
translations.うまくできたら、褒めてあげるから。:
If you do well, I'll make
sure to praise you.
translations.同じ学年だったら、一緒にできるのにな。:
If we were in the same
grade, we could do this
together.
translations.調子はどう？ 無理しちゃダメだよ。:
How's it going？ Don't push
yourself too hard.
translations.ほら、もっと！ あなただったら大丈夫だよ。:
Come on, a bit more!
You'll do just fine.
translations.終わったら、いいこいいこしてあげる。:
When you finish, I'll give you
a nice pat on the head.
translations.さっ、元気よくね。:
Alright, let's keep that
energy up.
translations.そっちやってくれたの？ 助かるー。:
You took care of that part？
Thanks, that's a big help.
translations.もう終わったの？ えらいえらい！:
You're already done？
Such a good boy!
translations.休憩までもうちょっと。がんばれ！:
It's almost time for a break.
Hang in there!
translations.こらこら、しゃんとする。……うん、オッケー！:
Hey now, stand up straight.
...Yep, perfect!
translations.あなたと一緒だと、働くのも楽しいな。:
Working is actually fun
when I'm with you.
translations.ごめんね、色々任せちゃって。あなたにはつい頼んじゃうな。:
Sorry for leaving so much
to you. I can't help but
rely on you.
translations.忙しくても笑顔、ほら！:
Keep smiling even when
we're busy. Come on!
translations.いいよ、レジは私が行くから。あなたは無理しない。:
It's fine, I'll take the
register. Don't push
yourself too hard.
translations.うん、いいぞいいぞ。その調子。:
Yeah, looking good.
Keep it up.
translations.あのね、私風邪ひいちゃったみたいで。:
Um, I think I might've
caught a cold.
translations.ううん、そんなに。心配しないで。:
No, not really.
Don't worry about me.
translations.でもバイトとかは無理そう。だから知らせておこうと思って。:
But I don't think I can
work. I just wanted to
let you know.
translations.そんなのは気にしなくていいよ。早く治して。:
Don't worry about that.
Just focus on getting
better.
translations.（お見舞い、行ってみようかな）:
(Maybe I should go
check up on her.)
translations.ふふ、そう。もうあなたの誕生日になったんだよ？:
Hehe, yup. It's officially
your birthday now, you know？
translations.遅くにごめんね。おめでとうだけ、すぐに伝えたかったの。:
Sorry it's so late. I just
wanted to be the first
to tell you.
translations.いいよ、ありがとう。うれしい。:
It's fine, thanks.
I'm really happy.
translations.遅くにごめん、切るね。ちゃんとプレゼントも楽しみにしてて？:
Sorry for calling so late,
I'll hang up now. Look
forward to your present？
translations.もしもし。どうして電話したか、わかる？:
Hello. Do you know why
I'm calling？
translations.もう、こんなに経ったんだね……。:
It's already been
so long, huh...
translations.この一年色々あったよな……。:
A lot has happened
this past year...
translations.ごめんね、遅くに。声、聞きたくて。:
Sorry it's so late.
I just wanted to hear
your voice.
translations.いいよ、気にしなくて。:
It's fine, don't worry
about it.
translations.ふふ、初電話。ううん、初会話でした。:
Hehe, our first call.
No, our first conversation
of the year.
translations.あ、ごめんね遅くに……。もう切るね。:
Ah, sorry it's so late...
I'll let you go now.
translations.うん、今年もよろしくね。:
Yeah, here's to another
great year together.
translations.（●と▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の新しい一年が始まるな……）:
(A new year for ●
and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ begins...)
translations.（０時過ぎたな。今日は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日だ）:
(It's past midnight. Today
is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s birthday.)
translations.何番目に言えたかな。:
I wonder what place I'm in
to tell you that.
translations.ふふ。大丈夫、あなたが一番。:
Hehe. Don't worry,
you're the first.
translations.電話くれてよかった。ちょっと待ってたんだ。:
I'm glad you called.
I was kind of waiting
for it.
translations.ごめん、遅くに。そろそろ切るよ。:
Sorry for calling so late.
I'll let you go now.
translations.うん、ほんとにありがとう。うれしかった。:
Yeah, thank you so much.
That made me really happy.
translations.（おめでとうが言えて、よかったな）:
(I'm glad I got to wish
her a happy birthday.)
translations.（０時過ぎたな。今日は●と▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の記念日だ）:
(It's past midnight. Today is
● and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s anniversary.)
translations.ふふ、うん。私たちの記念日。ちゃんと覚えてたね、合格。:
Hehe, yep. Our anniversary.
You remembered! You pass.
translations.もう随分経ったんだね。私たちが付き合い始めてから……。:
It's been quite a while now,
hasn't it？ Since we started
dating, I mean...
translations.うん。また、これからもよろしくね。:
Okay. Let's keep making
great memories together.
translations.まだ……寝ないよね？:
You're not going to
sleep yet... right？
translations.いい子は早く寝るんだよ？ いい子はね。:
Good boys go to sleep
early, you know？
Good boys do.
translations.私の顔、ちゃんと見える？:
Can you see my face
clearly？
translations.ふふ、温泉効果♪:
Hehe, it's the hot
spring effect♪
translations.まだ話足りない……よね。:
We haven't talked
enough yet... have we.
translations.うん、まだ寝ない。:
Yeah, I'm not going
to sleep yet.
translations.こっちも、ドキドキしてるんだけどな？:
My heart's pounding
over here too, y'know？
translations.こうやって見るあなたの顔も、いいな。:
Your face looks nice
from this angle, too.
translations.あっ……。ふふ、今の見てた？: Ah... Hehe, did you see that?
translations.ごめん、足あたった？: Sorry, did my foot bump you?
translations.うん、いいの。冷たかったから、びっくりしただけ。:
Yeah, it's fine. It was cold, 
so it just startled me.
translations.私があっためてあげよっか？:
Want me to warm them 
up for you?
translations.えっ？ ……それだと▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が……。:
Huh? ...But then 
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ will get cold...
translations.ふふ、気にしないの。えいっ。:
Hehe, don't worry about it. 
There.
translations.（あったかいっていうか、柔らかい……）:
(Warm isn't the word... 
more like soft...)
translations.手……ずっと握ってる。:
You've been holding my hand... 
this whole time.
translations.離しちゃ、だめ。:
It's bad... 
if you let go.
translations.ふふ。朝までずっと握ってたいな。:
Hehe. I want to hold hands 
until morning.
translations.ねえ、もっとそっちに行ってもいい？: Hey, can I move a little closer?
translations.くっつきたいな？:
I want us to be 
pressed together.
translations.いいよ。でも変なこと考えないでね？:
It's fine. But don't get 
any weird ideas, okay?
translations.ねえ、私の浴衣、踏んじゃってるよ？:
Hey, you're stepping 
on my yukata.
translations.もう……わざとでしょ？:
Geez... You did that 
on purpose, didn't you?
translations.ふふ、慌てちゃって。浴衣直すから、見ないでね？:
Hehe, you're so flustered. 
I'm going to fix my yukata, 
so no peeking, okay?
translations.ねえ、向こう向いて？: Hey, can you face the other way?
translations.ふふ、あなたの背中独り占め。:
Hehe, your back is
all mine.
translations.しばらく、こうしてるね……。:
I'm gonna stay like this
for a little while...
translations.ねえ、お願いがあるんだけど。:
Hey, I have a favor
to ask you.
translations.腕枕、してほしいな？:
Can I use your arm
as a pillow？
translations.じゃあ、お邪魔します。: Don't mind if I do, then.
translations.憧れだったんだ、これ。:
I've always dreamed
of doing this.
translations.朝になったら、きっと腕痺れてる。ごめんね。:
Your arm will probably be
numb by morning. Sorry.
translations.いいって、気にしないで。:
It's fine, don't worry
about it.
translations.電池が切れちゃうよ？ ほら、充電、充電。:
Your battery's gonna die？
Here, time to charge it.
translations.そういうのは、聞いちゃいけません。減点で、お預け！ ふふ。:
You're not supposed to
ask about that. Penalty!
No treats for you! Hehe.
translations.だーめ。いい子にしてたら、考えてあげる。:
No way. If you're a good
boy, I'll think about it.
translations.そんなに慌てないの。ふふ。:
Don't be in such a rush.
Hehe.
translations.いってらっしゃいのキス、してあげよっか？ ふふっ、今日も１日、がんばって。:
Want a goodbye kiss？
Hehe, do your best today.
translations.▲主人公＊▲、いってらっしゃい。早く帰ってきて？:
▲主人公＊▲, have a good day.
Come home early, okay？
translations.忘れ物だよ？ ……はいっ、ちゅっ。いってらっしゃい▼:
You're forgetting
something？ ...Here,
*mwah*. Have a good day.▼
translations.▲主人公＊▲、お帰りなさい。疲れたでしょ？ ゆっくり休んでね。:
Welcome home, ▲主人公＊▲.
You must be tired, right？
Get some rest.
translations.▲主人公＊▲、お帰りなさい。今日もいい１日だった？:
Welcome home, ▲主人公＊▲.
Did you have a good day？
translations.▲主人公＊▲、お帰りなさい。お風呂？ ご飯？ それとも……ふふふ！:
Welcome home, ▲主人公＊▲.
Bath？ Dinner？ Or maybe...
Hehehe!
translations.はい。ちゃんと噛んで、ゆっくり食べようね？:
Here. Make sure to chew
properly and eat slowly？
translations.ふふ、いいなぁ、お姉さんも食べたい▼:
Hehe, looks so good.
I want some too.▼
translations.今度は、何か作ってあげたいなぁ。:
I'd love to make you
something next time.
translations.本当においしそうに食べるよね？ ふふ、カワイイ▼:
You really make it look
delicious, huh？
Hehe, so cute.▼
translations.はい。後片付けも、がんばって！:
There. Do your best with
cleaning up, too!
translations.ちょっと休んだら、歯磨きしようね。:
Let's brush our teeth
after resting a bit.
translations.はい。おいしかった？:
There you go.
Was it good？
translations.おやすみなさい。明日は寝坊しないようにね？:
Good night. Make sure you
don't sleep in tomorrow？
translations.寝させてなんかあげないよ？ ……ふふ、冗談。おやすみ。:
I won't let you sleep,
you know？ ...Hehe, just
kidding. Good night.
translations.おやすみのキス、してからだよ？ ふふっ。:
Not until you give me a
goodnight kiss？ Hehe.
translations.最近、何かに興味、持ったりした？:
Has anything caught your
interest lately？
translations.うんうん。今度、見てみようかなぁ。楽しそう。:
Uh-huh. Maybe I'll take a
look sometime. Sounds fun.
translations.ないんだ。ふぅん……じゃあお姉さんと２人で、何かしよっか。ね？:
Nothing？ Hmm... Then why
don't you do something
with your big sister？
translations.そうなんだ。うん、そういうのもありだよね？:
Is that so？ Yeah, I guess
that works too, right？
translations.最近はどんな音楽が好きなの？:
What kind of music do you
like these days？
translations.あっ、まねっこしたな？ ふふ。:
Ah, you're copying me,
aren't you？ Hehe.
translations.実は、私もなの。ふふっ、お揃いだね。:
Actually, me too. Hehe,
we match.
translations.私のオススメ、聴いてみる？ 気に入るといいな。:
Wanna listen to my
recommendations？
Hope you like them.
translations.最近は、どういうテレビ番組、見てる？:
What kind of TV shows are
you watching lately？
translations.あっ、それ、私も見たよ？ ね、今度、一緒に見よっか。:
Ah, I saw that too! Hey,
let's watch it together
next time.
translations.私もテレビより本とか映画だからなぁ……わかる気がする。:
I prefer books and movies
over TV too... I think I
get how you feel.
translations.ふぅん……いろいろあるんだね？ 私もチェックしてみようかな。:
Hmm... There's a lot out
there, huh？ Maybe I'll
check it out too.
translations.ねぇ、私のチャームポイント、言ってみて？:
Hey, tell me what my best
feature is？
translations.あっ、嬉しい。でも、もっと言ってくれてもいいんだけどな？ ふふふ。:
Ah, I'm glad. But you
know, you could compliment
me even more？ Hehehe.
translations.……ごめんね、聞こえなかったらもう１回言って？ ふふ。:
...Sorry, I couldn't hear
you. Say it again？ Hehe.
translations.ふふ、照れ屋さん▼そういうところも、好き。:
Hehe, you're so shy.▼
I love that about you too.
translations.私の今の髪型ってどう？ 好き？:
What do you think of my
hair right now？ Like it？
translations.ふふ、よく出来ました。のど飴あげる。ふふ。:
Hehe, good job. Here's a
throat drop. Hehe.
translations.もぅ、そう思ってたならちゃんと言わなきゃ。ね？:
Jeez, if that's what you
thought, you should've
said so. Right？
translations.あなた好みに変わる自分って嫌いじゃないの。だから、いつでも言ってね？:
I don't mind changing to
suit your tastes. So tell
me anytime, okay？
translations.ね、今の服の趣味ってどう？ あなたの好み？:
Hey, what do you think of
my outfit？ Is it your type？
translations.そう？ ……よかったぁ。安心しちゃった。ふふ。:
Really？ ...I'm so glad.
That's a relief. Hehe.
translations.そっか。ごめんね、私、もっとちゃんと考える……。:
I see. Sorry, I'll put
a bit more thought into it...
translations.いつか、あなたをコーディネートしてあげたいなぁ。ふふ。:
I'd love to pick out an
outfit for you someday. Hehe.
translations.じゃあ、本読みながら待ってる。終わったら、声かけてね。:
I'll read a book while
I wait, then. Let me know
when you're done.
translations.そう。ほどほどにしないとダメだよ？:
I see. Just make sure you
don't overdo it, okay？
translations.私より大切なこと？ ……ふふっ、冗談。イジワル言いたくなっちゃった▼:
Something more important
than me？ ...Hehe, kidding.
Just wanted to tease you.▼
translations.最近、眠れないのって、あなたのせいかなぁ。:
I wonder if you're the
reason I haven't been
sleeping well lately.
translations.自覚あるんだ？ 私も、仕返ししちゃおうかなぁ。ふふ。:
Oh, so you're aware？
Maybe I should get you
back. Hehe.
translations.ふぅん、自覚、ないんだ？ 少しは、手加減しようね？:
Hmm, so you're not aware？
Go a little easy on me, okay？
translations.だって、私の中があなたでいっぱいなんだもん。……眠れない。:
It's just that my head is
so full of you...
I can't sleep.
translations.ねぇ、またお泊り、行きたいね？:
Hey, we should go on
another overnight trip,
shouldn't we？
translations.楽しかったもんね？ ……お互いの、いろんなことがわかって。ふふ。:
It was so fun, right？
...We learned so much about
each other. Hehe.
translations.照れちゃうんだ？ もぅ、カワイイ▼:
Aww, are you blushing？
Jeez, you're so cute.▼
translations.また行こうね、２人で。ゆっくり。:
Let's go again, just the two
of us. And take our time.
translations.ね、私、あなたにべたべたしすぎ？:
Hey, am I being too clingy
with you？
translations.よかった。これからも手加減なしで行っちゃうから、よろしくね？ ふふ。:
Good. I'm not gonna hold
back from now on either,
so you better be ready. Hehe.
translations.そう……。少し、考えないといけないね？:
I see... I guess I need to
rethink things a bit, huh？
translations.いつだってあなたの体温を感じてたくて……なんて言ったら、困っちゃうかな？:
I just always want to feel
your warmth... Would it bother
you if I said that？
translations.ねぇ、今、私のこと考えてたでしょ？:
Hey, you were just thinking
about me, weren't you？
translations.私もあなたのこと考えてたから。ふふ、当たっちゃった▼:
Because I was thinking about
you, too. Hehe, guess I hit
the mark.▼
translations.ふぅん？ 嘘、ヘタなんだ。可愛い▼:
Hmm？ You're a bad liar.
So cute.▼
translations.私はいつでも、あなたのことでいっぱいなんだけどなぁ……ふふ！:
My mind is always completely
filled with you, though...
Hehe!
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ねぇ、あなたにとっての幸せって？:
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, what does
happiness mean to you？
translations.私にとっての幸せは、あなたです。ふふ。:
To me, happiness means you.
Hehe.
translations.ふふ、そうなんだ。もぅ、可愛いなぁ。:
Hehe, is that so？
Jeez, you're so cute.
translations.私は、こういう時間が過ごせることだなぁ……ふふ。:
For me, it's being able to
spend time like this... Hehe.
translations.ねぇ、幸せって、こういうことだよね？:
Hey, this is what happiness
feels like, isn't it？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。私のこと、好き？\n……私は、大好き。ふふ。:
▲主人公＊▲. Do you like me？
...I love you. Hehe.
translations.ねぇ。私のこと、離しちゃイヤだよ？:
Hey. Don't you ever let
me go, okay？
translations.あなたといると、落ち着く……。:
I feel so at ease when I'm
with you...
translations.一緒にいようね？ ずぅっと。:
Let's stay together, okay？
Forever and ever.
translations.一日中、あなたとのーんびり、したいなぁ……。:
I just want to spend all day
relaxing with you...
translations.▲主人公＊▲。おいでおいで▼ちゅっ。ふふ！:
▲主人公＊▲. Come here,
come here.▼*Smooch* Hehe!
translations.お姉さん、寂しいなぁ……。かまって光線、効いた？ ふふ。:
Your big sister is feeling
lonely... Did my notice-me
beam work？ Hehe.
translations.ね、なでなでして？ はい、上手に出来ました。ふふ。:
Hey, pat my head？
There, you did a great job.
Hehe.
translations.あ、髪に何かついてるよ。取って上げるから、こっちおいで？ ふふ。:
Oh, you've got something
in your hair. I'll get it
for you, so come here？ Hehe.
translations.ねぇ、私に触って？ もう少し、このまま……ね？:
Hey, touch me？ Let's stay
like this a little longer...
Okay？
translations.おなかが空いちゃったなぁ……何か、軽く作ろうかな。:
I'm getting a bit hungry...
Maybe I'll whip up a little
something.
translations.……あっ、ごめんね。あったかいし、気持ちよくてつい……。:
...Ah, sorry. It's so warm
and cozy, I just...
translations.日向ぼっこ、したいなぁ。:
I kinda want to bask
in the sun...
translations.今夜も寝苦しいのかなぁ。:
I wonder if it'll be hard
to sleep tonight too.
translations.だいぶ、緑が多くなってきたね？:
It's gotten a lot greener
out there, hasn't it？
translations.イチョウの木が、すごくキレイだったよ？:
The ginkgo trees were
really pretty, you know？
translations.だいぶ、過ごしやすくなってきたね。:
The weather's gotten a lot
more comfortable.
translations.本を読むのに、いい季節になったよね？:
It's a great season for
reading, isn't it？
translations.あったかい飲み物でも飲んで、暖まろっか。:
Let's get a hot drink
and warm up.
translations.こんなに寒いと、余計に外に行きたくなくなっちゃう。:
When it's this cold, it
makes me wanna stay inside.
translations.ねぇ、あんまり寝てないんじゃない？ 大丈夫？:
Hey, you haven't slept much,
have you？ Are you okay？
translations.早起きだなぁ……お姉さん、まだ眠いよ……。:
You're up early...
I'm still sleepy...
translations.ん、まだちょっと早いね……二人で二度寝、しちゃおっか？:
Mmm, it's still a bit early.
Wanna go back to sleep？
translations.まだ眠い？ 起こしてあげるから寝てもいいよ？:
Still sleepy？ I'll wake you
up, so you can sleep more.
translations.朝ごはんはちゃんと食べないとダメ。わかった？:
You have to eat a proper
breakfast. Got it？
translations.おはよう。夢の中でも、ちゃんと私とラブラブだった？ ふふ。:
Morning. Were we lovey-dovey
in your dreams too？ Hehe.
translations.ほら、顔を洗って、スッキリしてらっしゃい。:
Come on, go wash your face
and freshen up.
translations.そんなにゆっくりしてて大丈夫なの？ ふふ、もぅ……。:
Are you sure you can take it
this easy？ Hehe, jeez...
translations.今日はどうする予定？ 私？ あなた次第。ふふふ。:
What are your plans today？
Me？ I'm up to you. Hehehe.
translations.お出かけするなら、早めに準備しないと。:
If we're going out, we need
to get ready soon.
translations.さてと、お家の中のこと、やろうかな。あなたはゆっくりしてて。ふふ。:
Alright, guess I'll do some
chores. You just relax. Hehe.
translations.なにか飲む？ 一休み、しよ？:
Want something to drink？
Let's take a break.
translations.ちょっと、おなかすいたなぁ。飴、なめる？:
I'm a little hungry.
Want a piece of candy？
translations.今日のランチは何にしよう。ん～。:
What should we have
for lunch today... Hmm.
translations.さて、何食べようかな。お昼。:
Now then, what should we eat
for lunch...
translations.ご飯はちゃんと、ゆっくり噛んで食べなきゃダメだぞ？ ふふ。:
Make sure you chew your food
slowly and properly. Hehe.
translations.午後もがんばろうね。:
Let's do our best this
afternoon too.
translations.ね、今ちょっと眠いでしょ。そんな顔してる▼:
Hey, you're a little sleepy,
aren't you？ It shows.▼
translations.お昼寝するんだったら、膝、貸してあげる。ふふふ。:
If you want to take a nap,
you can use my lap. Hehehe.
translations.おやつの時間。甘いもの、食べよっか。:
Snack time. Let's have
something sweet.
translations.一息入れて、午後の効率アップ。こっちおいで▼:
Take a breather to boost your
efficiency. Come here.▼
translations.今日の晩御飯は何にしようかなぁ……何がいい？:
What should we have for
dinner... Any requests？
translations.夕焼けがキレイなら、明日は晴れだよ、きっと。:
If the sunset is pretty,
it'll be sunny tomorrow.
translations.夕ご飯の支度、そろそろはじめようかな。お手伝いする？ ふふ。:
I should start making dinner
soon. Wanna help？ Hehe.
translations.ね、あなたの手作り料理、ご馳走して？ いつかでいいから。ふふ。:
Treat me to a home-cooked
meal sometime？ No rush. Hehe.
translations.毎日、ご飯作ってあげられたらいいのになぁ……。:
I wish I could make meals
for you every day...
translations.今日はのんびり、湯船に浸かりたい……。:
I want to take a nice,
long soak in the tub
today...
translations.さて、洗い物しよう。あなたと▼ ふふ。:
Alright, time to do
the dishes. With you,
▼. Hehe.
translations.ふぅ。ちょっと落ち着いたね。ゆっくりしよう？:
Phew. Things have
settled down a bit.
Let's relax, okay？
translations.お風呂に入って、キレイキレイ、した？ ふふふ。:
Did you take a bath
and get all squeaky
clean？ Hehehe.
translations.ね、テレビで映画、やってない？ やってたら一緒に観よう？:
Hey, is there a movie
on TV？ If there is,
let's watch it together？
translations.明日の準備は済んだ？ 眠くなる前にやるように。ふふ。:
Are you all ready for
tomorrow？ Make sure you
do it before you get
sleepy. Hehe.
translations.ちょっと、眠くなってきたかも……。:
I might be getting a
little sleepy...
translations.歯磨きはちゃんとした？ まだならいってらっしゃい▼:
Did you brush your
teeth properly？ If not,
off you go, ▼.
translations.寝る前に、戸締り用心、火の用心、だよ？:
Before bed, make sure
to lock the doors and
check the stove, okay？
translations.おねむの時間？ ふふ、カワイイ▼:
Is it sleepy time？
Hehe, you're so cute,
▼.
translations.寝るんだったら、おやすみのキスをしてから。ふふ。:
If you're going to
sleep, you have to give
me a goodnight kiss
first. Hehe.
translations.眠れないなら、おしゃべりしよっか。ね、今日は何かいいことあった？:
If you can't sleep,
let's chat. Hey, did
anything good happen
today？
translations.夜更かしして……明日、一人で起きられる？ もぅ。:
Staying up so late...
Will you be able to wake
up on your own tomorrow？
Geez.
translations.眠いなぁ。一人でお布団に入るの、イヤだなぁ、まだ寝ないの？:
I'm sleepy. I don't want
to get into bed all by
myself... Are you still
not going to sleep？
translations.そろそろ寝ないと、本当に明日が大変だよ？:
If you don't go to sleep
soon, tomorrow's really
going to be rough, you
know？
translations.仕方ない、付き合ってあげる。映画でも観よっか。:
I guess I have no choice
but to keep you company.
Shall we watch a movie
or something？
translations.もぅ……夜更かしもほどほどにしないと、ダメだよ？:
Geez... You shouldn't
stay up too late, okay？
translations.ずいぶん早起きだね？ ふふ、いいよ。私も起きるから。:
You're up awfully early,
aren't you？ Hehe, it's
fine. I'll get up too.
translations.今日だけでもう何回目？ そんなに私のこと、好きなんだ？ ふふっ。:
How many times is that
just today？ Do you
really like me that
much？ Hehe.
translations.毎日、私に会いに来てくれるのって、本当に嬉しい。ありがとう。:
I'm really happy that
you come to see me every
day. Thank you.
translations.ねぇ、私のこと、ずっと見てるの？ ふふ。:
Hey, are you going to
keep staring at me？
Hehe.
translations.いつも、この時間に会いに来てくれるでしょ？ だから待ってたんだ。ふふ。:
You always come to see
me around this time,
right？ That's why I was
waiting. Hehe.
translations.二人の思い出、たくさん。もっともっと、重ねていこうね……。:
We have so many memories
together. Let's keep
making more and more...
translations.最近、他の女の子と会ったり……してないよね、あなたに限って。ね？:
You haven't been seeing
other girls lately...
have you？ Not you.
Right？
translations.ねぇ、何となくだけど、広くなった？ ふふ、いいと思うよ。:
Hey, is it just me, or
did it get wider？ Hehe,
I think it's nice.
translations.夢に出てくるくらい、私のこと、好き？ ふふ、私も。だからちゃんと最後までがんばっ:
Do you like me enough
that I show up in your
dreams？ Hehe, me too.
So make sure you do your
best until the end,
okay？
translations.目標達成まであと一歩だね。２人でがんばろ？:
We're just one step away
from reaching our goal.
Let's do our best
together, okay？
translations.ダメって言ったよね？ 悪いコには……ふふふ……。:
I told you no, didn't I？
Bad boys get...
hehehe...
translations.今日からいろんなことができるようになったみたい。楽しみだなぁ。:
It looks like we can do
all sorts of new things
starting today. I'm
looking forward to it.
translations.ほら、いろいろできるようになったでしょ？ 感想、聞きたくて。どう、楽しい？:
See, we can do a lot
more now, right？ I
wanted to hear your
thoughts. Well, is it
fun？
translations.新しいこと試してみた？ ふふ、だって気になるんだもん。:
Did you try out the new
stuff？ Hehe, I'm just
curious, that's all.
translations.ね……最近会ってくれないのは、どうして？:
Hey... why haven't you
been coming to see me
lately？
translations.……怒ってる。だって最近、キス、してくれない……。:
...I'm mad. Because
lately, you haven't been
kissing me...
translations.私のこと、もう必要じゃないって……思ってる？:
Do you think... you
don't need me anymore？
translations.あなたがいないと、ダメなのに……。:
I can't go on without
you, though...
translations.離れたくないよ……。:
I don't want to be
apart...
translations.ごまかそうとしてない……？:
Are you trying to 
change the subject...？
translations.もう一人にしないって、約束する？:
Do you promise not to 
leave me alone again？
translations.じゃあ、指きりげんまん。嘘ついたら、針千本だからね？:
Then, pinky swear. 
If you lie, it's a 
thousand needles, okay？
translations.うん、信じてあげる。私をひとりぼっちにするなんて、もうダメだよ？:
Okay, I'll believe you. 
You can't leave me all 
alone anymore, got it？
translations.うん、これならカワイイ……かなぁ。:
Yeah, this looks 
cute... I think.
translations.ヘンじゃないよね？:
It doesn't look weird, 
does it？
translations.あ、待って……こっちもいいかも。:
Ah, wait... 
this one's nice too.
translations.星座ランキング、見なくっちゃ。:
I need to check the 
horoscope rankings.
translations.いいことありそうだな、今日は。ふふ。:
Looks like good things 
will happen today. Hehe.
translations.普通、かぁ。もうちょっと……んー。:
Average, huh. 
Just a little more... 
Hmm.
translations.今日はおとなしくしてようっと……。:
I guess I'll just take 
it easy today...
translations.カレの運勢、いいんだ。会ったら教えてあげなきゃ▼:
His fortune is good. 
I should tell him 
when I see him.▼
translations.カレ、今日は割りといい運勢みたい。うんうん。:
Looks like he's got 
pretty good luck today. 
Yep, yep.
translations.カレは、可もなく、不可もなく……普通だね。:
His is neither good 
nor bad... Just average.
translations.カレの運勢は……ん、黙っておこう。落ち込んだりしたら、かわいそうだし……。:
His fortune is... Hmm, 
I'll keep it a secret. 
I'd feel bad if he got 
depressed over it...
translations.いい香り。これならカレも……ふふ。:
Smells good. 
I'm sure he'll like it... 
Hehe.
translations.この辺、もう少し……。:
Just a little more 
around here...
translations.お背中、流しましょうか？ ……なんちゃって。ふふ。:
Want me to wash 
your back? 
...Just kidding. Hehe.
translations.今夜もぐっすり眠れそう……。:
Looks like I'll sleep 
soundly tonight too...
translations.次の入浴剤はカレと選びに行こうかな……。:
Maybe I'll go pick out 
the next bath salts 
with him...
translations.あれ……食べ過ぎちゃった？:
Huh... 
Did I eat too much?
translations.やっぱり引き締まるなぁ。ふふ。:
It really does 
tighten things up. Hehe.
translations.んー、もう少しがんばらないと、ダメ？:
Hmm, do I need to 
try a little harder?
translations.どれくらいがいいか、今度聞いてみようかなぁ。:
Maybe I'll ask him 
what he prefers 
next time.
translations.これ、ちょっと子どもっぽい？:
Is this a little 
too childish?
translations.これは、ちょっと派手……？:
Is this one 
a bit too flashy...?
translations.……そのうち好み、聞いてみちゃう？ ふふふ。:
...Maybe I'll ask him 
what he likes soon? 
Hehehe.
translations.カレ、どんなのが好きなんだろ？:
I wonder what kind 
he likes?
translations.やっぱり大きいほうが好きなのかなぁ、男の子は……。:
I guess boys really do 
prefer them bigger...
translations.リサーチして、好みに合いそうなの買っちゃおうかな……。:
Maybe I'll do some 
research and buy one 
he'd like...
translations.えぇと、レシピ、レシピ……。: Let's see, the recipe, the recipe...
translations.おいしくできるといいなぁ。: I hope it turns out delicious.
translations.カレ、喜んでくれるよね？: He'll be happy with this, right？
translations.コップは、冷蔵庫にまとめてしまう……。:
I'll just put all the cups
in the fridge...
translations.二度寝したら、起きられなく……なっちゃう……。:
If I go back to sleep, I
won't be able to...
wake up...
translations.んー……動きたくない……。:
Mmm... I don't want to
move...
translations.夢……カレもいた気がする……。:
I feel like... he was in
my dream, too...
translations.おはよう……あれ？ あ、カレ、いないんだっけ……。:
Good morning... Huh？ Oh
right, he's not here...
translations.おはようコール、してきてもいいのに……。:
He could have given me a
wake-up call...
translations.朝ごはん、どうしようかな……。:
What should I have
for breakfast...
translations.カレの声で起きたいなぁ……。:
I wish I could wake up
to his voice...
translations.イケナイ子は、お仕置きしちゃうぞ……？:
Naughty boys get
punished, you know...？
translations.今日は……どうするんだっけ……。:
What was I supposed to do
today again...
translations.シャワー浴びたら、目が覚めるかな……。:
Maybe a shower will
wake me up...
translations.おはようの、ちゅ……してくれなきゃ起きません……。:
I won't wake up without
a good morning kiss...
translations.布団って、どうしてこんなに気持ちいいんだろ……。:
Why is my bed so
incredibly comfy...
translations.どうだった？ 今年は。お姉さんに教えて？:
How was your year？
Tell your big sister？
translations.私？ 一緒にいるのに、わからないの？ ふふふ。:
Me？ We're together,
but you don't know？ Hehe.
translations.あっ、もう５分前。早いなぁ。:
Ah, five minutes left.
That went fast.
translations.あと１分。いよいよだね？:
One minute left.
Here we go？
translations.３０秒！ １０秒前からのお約束、わかるよね？:
30 seconds! You know what
we do at the 10-second mark,
right？
translations.今年もいっぱい、２人でいろんなこと、しようね？:
Let's do lots of things
together this year too,
okay？
translations.ん？ 私に何を選んで欲しいのかな？:
Hm？ What do you want
me to choose？
translations.じゃあ、私の右側と左側に選んでほしいものを分けて置いて？:
Then put the things you want
me to pick on my left
and right side？
translations.うーん、じゃあ、これで決めようかな？:
Hmm, maybe I'll go
with this one？
translations.はい、こっちになりました。ふふ。:
Okay, I pick this one.
Hehe.
translations.こんな選び方でよかった？ ふふ。:
Was that a good way
to choose？ Hehe.
translations.あくまで参考だよ？ 大事なのは、あなたなんだから。:
It's just a suggestion, okay？
What matters is what
you want.
translations.私の直感は当たるよ？ ふふっ。:
My intuition is spot on,
you know？ Hehe.
translations.また、何か迷ったりしたら相談して？ いつでも聞いてあげるよ。:
If you're ever unsure again,
just ask me？
I'm always here.
translations.どうしたの？ いやなことでもあった？:
What's wrong？
Did something bad happen？
translations.あなたががんばってるって、私は知ってる。だから、自信持って？:
I know how hard you're trying.
So have some confidence,
okay？
translations.気にするな、って言っても、気になっちゃうよね？ わかるなぁ……。:
Even if I say not to worry,
you still do, right？
I get it...
translations.きっといい方向に向かうって、信じよう？ ね？:
Let's believe things will
turn out for the best？ Okay？
translations.どう？ 少しは気が楽になった？:
How's that？
Do you feel a little better？
translations.視線が下がると気分も沈んじゃう。ほら、顔、上げてごらん？:
Looking down just brings
your mood down.
Look up, okay？
translations.あなたが笑ってるほうが、私、好きだな？:
I like it much better
when you smile, you know？
translations.涙って、心を強くするの。男の子だからって、我慢することないと思うよ？:
Tears make your heart
stronger. You don't have to
hold them back just because
you're a boy？
translations.時間は大丈夫だから、ゆっくり話してね？:
We have plenty of time,
so take it slow, okay？
translations.それは、仕方ないんじゃないかな……。:
I think that just
couldn't be helped...
translations.時間が解決してくれることもあるから……ね？:
Sometimes time is the only
thing that can fix it...
right？
translations.私がいつも傍にいる。だから、何も心配要らないよ？:
I'm always right here
with you. So you don't
need to worry？
translations.どういたしまして。……ん、いつものあなただね？ お姉さん、役に立てて嬉しい。:
You're welcome. ...Mhm,
there's the you I know？
I'm glad your big sister
could help.
translations.何でも自分の中に溜め込んだりしないで、いつでも言うんだよ？:
Don't keep everything
bottled up, okay？
You can always tell me.
translations.ねぇ、隣……いいかな？ 添い寝してあげようかなって……。:
Hey, can I... lay next to you？
I thought I'd sleep
beside you...
translations.ゆっくり眠れるように、傍にいてあげるね？:
I'll stay right by your side
so you can sleep peacefully？
translations.今日も一日、お疲れさま。ゆっくり休んで。:
Good work today.
Get some rest.
translations.緊張して、眠れないの？ ふふふ。:
Are you too nervous

to sleep？ Hehe.
translations.ふふっ、かわいい寝顔▼:
Hehe, such a cute

sleeping face▼
translations.怖い夢でも見てた？ もう、大丈夫？:
Did you have a bad dream？

Are you okay now？
translations.大丈夫。また眠るまで見ててあけるから、安心して？:
It's okay. I'll watch over

you until you fall asleep,

so don't worry, alright？
translations.添い寝は、刺激が強かった？ ふふふ。:
Was sleeping next to me

too much for you？ Hehe.
translations.……あっ。あなたの体温が気持ちよくて、つい……ふふ、おはよ。:
...Ah. You were so warm,

I just... Hehe, morning.
translations.ストレッチ？ 付き合ってあげちゃおうかな？ ふふふ。:
Stretching？ Maybe I'll keep

you company. Hehe.
translations.ね、ちょっと付き合って？ 運動不足気味だから、ストレッチ。ね？:
Hey, keep me company？

I'm a bit out of shape,

so let's stretch. Okay？
translations.そう、残念。また今度ね？:
Aw, that's a shame.

Next time, then？
translations.足を肩幅に開いたら、左手を腰に。右手は、耳の横につけて伸ばして？:
Feet shoulder-width apart,

left hand on your hip.

Right arm up by your ear,

and stretch it out？
translations.こんな感じで、私が１、２、３、４って言ったら、その後に５、６、７、８って続けるこ:
Like that. When I say

1, 2, 3, 4, you follow up

with 5, 6, 7, 8. Got it？
translations.こら。もっと大きい声、出せるでしょ？:
Hey. You can be louder

than that, right？
translations.ちゃんとホラ、お腹から声、出して。:
Come on, project your

voice from your stomach.
translations.次は反対側。いい？:
Next is the other side.

Ready？
