translations.ん？\n自分もしたいなってアピール？:
Hm? Is that your way of
saying you want to, too?
translations.そういうわけじゃなくて……\nただ、ほら、どうしても目につくじゃん。:
That's not it at all...
It's just, y'know, hard
not to notice.
translations.ショーウィンドウを\n見てると、たまに中の\nマネキンが動いたように\n感じるこ:
When you look at store
windows, do you ever feel
like the mannequins inside
just moved?
translations.私だけなのかな？\n今にもこう、\n手が伸びてきて……。:
Is it just me? Like they're
about to reach out and
grab you...
translations.どこかの家で練習してるんだな。:
Someone must be practicing
in their house.
translations.私もね、一つくらい楽器が\n弾けたら楽しいかもって思うんだけど。:
I think it'd be fun to
know how to play at least
one instrument, too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が楽器か……\nなんか保育園でピアノって感じがするな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ playing an instrument...
It feels like you'd play
piano at a daycare.
translations.私が先生？\nそれも楽しそうだね。:
Me as a teacher?
That sounds fun, too.
translations.ね。あなたにとって\n理想の女性ってどんな人？:
Hey. What's your ideal
type of woman?
translations.そんなの▲姉ヶ崎＊▲以外、\nあり得ない！:
There's no one else for me
but you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.必死になっちゃって。\nカワイイ▼:
You're trying so hard.
So cute, ▼.
translations.こうやって歩いているときに\n前から突然ゾンビが現れたら\nどうする？:
What would you do if a
zombie suddenly appeared
in front of us right now?
translations.え？ うーん\nまずは▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を守らないとな。:
Huh? Hmm...
First, I'd have to protect
you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ふふ、じゃあ後ろからも別のゾンビが！:
Hehe, then another zombie
appears from behind!
translations.ええっ？\nうーん、素直に逃げた方がいいのかな……。:
What? Hmm, maybe it's best
if we just run away...
translations.ほらほら、早くしないと囲まれちゃう！:
Come on, hurry or we'll
get surrounded!
translations.（何が試されてるんだろう……）:
(What exactly is she
testing me on...?)
translations.ほら、道路の向こう側。\nあっちも高校生カップルかな。:
Look, across the street.
Think they're a high school
couple, too?
translations.みたいだね。\nははっ、あんなに\nくっついて……。:
Looks like it. Haha,
they're so close to each
other...
translations.私たちももっと\nくっついてみる？:
Wanna try getting a little
closer ourselves?
translations.そんなに驚かなくてもいいでしょ？\nね、くっつこ？:
You don't have to be so
surprised, you know?
Come on, let's get close.
translations.あっ……今日ってスーパーで\nタマゴの特売なんだった。:
Ah... Eggs were on sale at
the supermarket today.
translations.もしかして、今すれ違った人が\n持ってたスーパーの袋見て\n思い出した？:
Did you just remember that
from seeing the grocery bag
that person was holding?
translations.……高校生っぽくないって\n思ったでしょ？:
...You're thinking that's
not very high schooler-like
of me, aren't you?
translations.もうっ！\nお菓子でも作ろうと思ってたのに。\nあなたの分、どうしよっかな？:
Jeez! I was planning to
bake some sweets, too.
Maybe I won't make any
for you?
translations.この前ね、この先に住んでる\n男の子と仲良くなったの。:
The other day, I made
friends with a boy who
lives down this way.
translations.うん５歳だって。\n結構ませてて、カワイイの。\n「お姉ちゃん好き！」って。:
Yeah, he's five. He's
pretty mature and so cute.
He said he likes me!
translations.なんだ……\nそんな小さな子か。:
Oh... So it's just a
little kid.
translations.あ、ヤキモチ？\nそういえば５歳じゃなくて、\n１５歳だったかも？\nね、もっと:
Aw, are you jealous?
Actually, maybe he was 15,
not 5? Are you even more
jealous now?
translations.ん、ああ小さいし平気だよ。\nほら、もう向こういっちゃったから。:
Oh, it's small, you're fine.
Look, it already hopped away.
translations.……う、うん。\nあなたがいてくれて、\n今ほど心強いと思ったことないかも！:
...Y-Yeah. I don't think I've
ever felt more reassured
to have you here with me!
translations.ねえ、\nこうやって二人で並んで歩くの、\n何度めかな。:
Hey... I wonder how many
times we've walked side
by side like this.
translations.どうだろう。\nさすがに数えてないなあ……。:
I wonder.
I haven't exactly been
keeping count...
translations.手をつなぐのは？\nデートしたのは？\n一緒にご飯を食べた回数は？:
What about holding hands？
Going on dates？
How many times have we
eaten together？
translations.はは、覚えきれないな。:
Haha, I can't remember
all that.
translations.全部数えておけばよかったな～。:
I should have kept track
of everything~.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。\n今日、なんだか機嫌がいいね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You seem to be in a really
good mood today.
translations.カレとのデートで\n機嫌の悪いカノジョなんていません。\nそれに……。:
No girlfriend is in a bad
mood on a date with her
boyfriend. Plus...
translations.今朝の占いで、大切な人との\n関係がさらに深まるでしょう、って。\nラッキーアイ:
My morning horoscope said
my bond with someone special
would deepen. And my lucky
item is rice bran paste!
translations.もう、気をつけて？\nお姉ちゃんがおてて引いてあげましょうか？:
Jeez, be careful, okay？
Do you want your big sis
to hold your hand for you？
translations.最近、ジョギングする人、\n多いみたいね。:
It seems like a lot of
people are jogging lately.
translations.……私もはじめてみようかな。\n……ダイエットにもなると思うし……。:
...Maybe I should start.
...It'd be good for a diet,
too...
translations.それはいいんじゃない？\n別に太ってないし。:
That sounds like a good idea.
Not that you need to lose
any weight, though.
translations.はあ……\n女の子はね、見えないとこも大変なの。:
Sigh...
Girls have it tough in ways
you can't see, you know.
translations.（深くは聞かないでおこう……）:
(I'd better not ask any
more about that...)
translations.いつも雑誌の特集で\n紹介されたところばっかり\n連れていくカレシってどう思う？:
What do you think of a guy
who only ever takes his girl
to places featured in
magazines？
translations.それは……\n多少は仕方ないと思うけど。:
Well...
I think it can't be helped
to some extent.
translations.そうよね。\n友達はそれが不満だなんて\n言うんだけど。\n問題はそこでどう楽し:
Right？
My friend was complaining
about it, but...
The important thing is how
you enjoy your time there.
translations.あ……お金おろすの忘れちゃった。\nコンビニ寄っていい？:
Ah... I forgot to withdraw
some money.
Can we stop by a convenience
store？
translations.いいけど。\n別に慌てなくてもいいよ。\n今、それなりに持ってるし。:
Sure.
But there's no rush.
I've got enough on me for
now.
translations.かっこつけないの。\n二人とも高校生なんだから。:
Don't try to show off.
We're both high schoolers,
you know.
translations.ほら、コンビニ。\nちょっと行ってくるね。:
Look, a convenience store.
I'll be right back.
translations.私のクラスにね、双子の子が\nいるんだけど、\n本当にそっくりなんだよ。:
There are twins in my class,
and they look exactly alike.
translations.一卵性だとなかなか\n見分けられないよな。:
Identical twins can be
pretty hard to tell apart.
translations.実は私も……双子の妹の方で、\n姉ヶ崎奈々って言うんです。\nほら、ホクロの位置:
Actually... I'm the younger
twin sister, Nana Anegasaki.
See, my mole is on the
opposite side as Nene's!
translations.えっ!?\n……あれ、同じじゃん。:
What!?
...Wait, it's on the same
side.
translations.なんてね？\nほんとだったら面白いのにね？:
Just kidding？
It'd be pretty funny if it
were true, wouldn't it？
translations.何か新しい趣味でも\n始めてみたいんだけど……\n何がいいと思う？:
I kind of want to pick up
a new hobby...
What do you think would be
good？
translations.新しい趣味、難しいな……\nどうして●に？:
A new hobby, that's tough...
Why the sudden interest,
●？
translations.なるべく一緒にできるものが\nいいなって。\n意外に共通の趣味ってないじゃない？:
I was thinking it'd be nice
to find something we can
do together. We don't really
have shared hobbies, huh？
translations.たしかに……\nでも無理に合わせなくてもいいと思うけどな。\n長く一緒にいれば、:
True...
But I don't think we need
to force it. If we're
together long enough, we
might pick one up naturally.
translations.長く一緒にいれば？\nふふ、そうね。\nいいこと言った！:
Together long enough, huh？
Hehe, you're right.
Well said!
translations.もしかして、私って\nクジ運ないのかな……。:
I wonder if I just have
bad luck with raffles...
translations.宝くじでも買ったとか？:
Did you buy a lottery ticket
or something？
translations.ううん。\n商店街のくじ引きで全部\n残念賞のティッシュだったの。\n２０回引い:
No. I did the shopping
district raffle and got
nothing but tissues.
All 20 times.
translations.あなたと出会って、\n幸運使いはたしちゃったのかな。\n責任とってね？:
Maybe I used up all my luck
when I met you.
You'd better take
responsibility, okay？
translations.あ、あそこの横断歩道、\n信号ができたんだ。:
Oh, they put a traffic light
at that crosswalk over there.
translations.そういえば、前はなかったかも。\n押しボタン式か。:
Now that you mention it,
it wasn't there before.
A push-button one, huh.
translations.前にね、お年寄りが\n渡れなくて困ってたことがあったの。\nここって意外と車が通:
I saw an elderly person
struggling to cross before.
There's surprisingly heavy
traffic here, isn't there？
translations.どうだろ……良いことだけ\n信じるのがいいのかなって思うけど。:
I wonder... I think it's
best to only believe
the good ones.
translations.やっぱりそれがいいよね。\nうん、そうしよう。:
That really is the best way.
Yeah, let's do that.
translations.雑誌の占いでちょっと……\nうん、気にしないでいいよね！:
I just read a magazine
fortune and... Yeah,
I shouldn't worry about it!
translations.昨日の晩、すごい\n星空だったの、知ってる？:
Did you know the starry sky
was amazing last night？
translations.たまたま窓を開けたら一面星空で……\n教えてあげたかったんだけど、\nもう遅かっ:
I happened to open my window
and the sky was full of
stars... I wanted to tell
you, but it was already
late.
translations.へえ、たしかに見たかったかも。:
Wow, I definitely would've
liked to see that.
translations.うん、一緒に見たかったな……。:
Yeah, I wanted to see it
with you...
translations.どうしたの？\nもしかして……楽しくない？:
What's wrong？
Are you... not having fun？
translations.あ、そうじゃなくて……\nえっと、少し言いづらいんだけど……。:
Ah, it's not that...
Um, it's just a little hard
to say...
translations.無理にとは言わないけど……。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が困ってるなら\n相談に乗るよ。:
I won't force you to say,
but... If you're troubled,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I'm here to listen.
translations.体重が１キロ増えてて……。\n……あ、もうっ！\n女の子にとっては深刻なんだから:
I gained a kilo...
...Ugh, jeez!
This is a serious issue
for a girl, you know.
translations.友達がね、カレシに毎日\n“愛してるよ”って\n言わせてるんだって。:
A friend of mine makes her
boyfriend say 'I love you'
to her every single day.
translations.ね。あなたは私のこと、\nどう思ってる……？:
Hey. How do you feel
about me...？
translations.もし魔法が使えたら、なんて\n思ったことない？:
Have you ever wondered what
it'd be like to use magic？
translations.そうだな……\n瞬間移動なんて便利だよな。\nどこでもデート行き放題！:
Let's see...
Teleportation would be
handy. We could go on
dates anywhere!
translations.あは、それもいいね。\nでも私はやっぱり恋の魔法かな？:
Aha, that sounds nice too.
But I think I'd have to
choose a love spell.
translations.使えてるじゃん、●に。:
You're already using one
on me, ●.
translations.まだまだ足りないの。\nもーっと、メロメロにしたいんだから。:
It's still not enough.
I want you to be completely
head over heels for me.
translations.あのさ、今度デートで\n行くとしたら、どんなとこに\n行きたい？:
Say, if we go on a date
next time, where would you
want to go？
translations.うーん、海外なんていいよね。:
Hmm, going overseas would
be nice.
translations.え、それはデートっていうか……。:
Uh, I'm not sure that counts
as a date...
translations.旅行だね。\nすぐには無理でも\n行けたらいいと思わない？:
It's a trip, isn't it.
Even if we can't go right
away, don't you think
it'd be nice to go？
translations.すみませーん、\nボール取って\nもらえますかー!?:
Excuse me!
Could you get our ball
for us!?
translations.結構距離あるよ？\n大丈夫？:
That's pretty far, you know?
Are you sure?
translations.すご～い、やっぱり男の子だね。:
Wow, you really are
a guy, aren't you?
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にいいところ\n見せられたかも）:
（I might've just shown off
a little for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.）
translations.ねえ、メールの着信音って\nどんなのにしてる？:
Hey, what kind of ringtone
do you use for your texts?
translations.あっ、ありがとう。\n気がつかなかった……。:
Oh, thank you.
I didn't even notice...
translations.せっかくのオシャレしてるのに、\n泥水が跳ねたら大変だしね。:
You dressed up so nicely,
it'd be a shame if you
got splashed with mud.
translations.ふふっ、気配りのできる\nカレシって素敵だね。:
Hehe, an attentive boyfriend
is so wonderful.
translations.友達がね、カレシと\n歩くときはいつも手を繋ぐんだって。:
My friend told me she always
holds hands when she walks
with her boyfriend.
translations.そう。\n……ちょっとうらやましい、\nかな。:
Yeah.
...I'm a little jealous,
I guess.
translations.そういうときは\n照れないで、“繋ごう”って\nリードして欲しいかな。\nほら、:
At times like this, I want
you to take the lead and say
"Let's hold hands" without
being shy. Come on, okay?
translations.あ、ちょっと早く\n歩きすぎた？:
Ah, was I walking
a little too fast?
translations.ううん、これくらいなら大丈夫。\nついて行けるから。:
No, this pace is fine.
I can keep up.
translations.ごめん、気をつけてる\nつもりなんだけど……。:
Sorry, I was trying to
be careful about it...
translations.うん、それは感じてる。\nいつもあわせてくれてるよね？:
Yeah, I can tell. You always
match my pace, don't you?
translations.そりゃね。\n一人で歩いてるわけじゃないんだから。:
Of course.
I'm not walking alone,
after all.
translations.うんうん、ポイント高いよ？:
Uh-huh, you're scoring
some major points here.
translations.あれ？ ちょっと雲行きが\n怪しいかな。:
Huh? The clouds are looking
a little suspicious.
translations.天気予報、どうだったかな。:
What did the weather
forecast say again?
translations.せっかくのデートだから、\n降らないといいんだけど。:
We're finally on a date,
so I hope it doesn't rain.
translations.でも、カフェで雨宿りしたり\n……一つの傘に入ったり、\n雨の日のデートも私は\:
But taking shelter in a cafe
...or sharing an umbrella...
I actually really like
rainy day dates too.
translations.お、姉ヶ崎か。\nあんまり遅くまで出歩くなよ。:
Oh, Anegasaki.
Don't stay out too late.
translations.あ、先生。\nはい、暗くなる前に帰ります。:
Ah, sir.
Yes, I'll be home
before it gets dark.
translations.……ビビった。\nさっきの、３年の学年主任だっけ。:
...That startled me.
Was that the head teacher
for the third years?
translations.ふふっ、恐い顔してるけど、\n結構優しい先生なんだよ。:
Hehe, he looks scary, but
he's actually a pretty
nice teacher.
translations.あそこの道路、子供達\nだけで渡るのは危ないよね。\n……ちょっと待ってて。:
It's dangerous for kids to
cross that road by themselves.
...Wait here a second.
translations.さ、みんな。\n横断歩道を渡るときは、\nちゃんと手をあげましょうね。:
Okay, everyone.
Make sure you raise your
hands when you cross.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ってさ、保母さんとか\n向いてそうだよね。:
You know, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I think you'd
make a great preschool teacher.
translations.そうかな？\nたしかに子供は好きだけど……。:
You think so?
I do like kids, but...
translations.昨日の怪奇特番観た？\nふとした拍子に空間の歪みに\n入り込んで、妖怪たちに出会:
Did you see that horror
special yesterday? The one
where they slip into a spatial
distortion and meet yokai...
translations.観た観た。\n実はそんなに期待してなかったんだけど、\n面白かった！:
I did!
I wasn't expecting much
from it, but it was
actually really good!
translations.うん、一応チェックはしておこうと思って。\n古典へのオマージュが感じられたよね！:
Yeah, I figured I should
check it out. You could
really feel the homage
to the classics!
translations.へ、へえ……\nでさ、その次にやってた番組で……。:
O-Oh, yeah...
So, on the show that
aired right after...
translations.あん、ちゃんと聞いて。\nあのね……。:
Hey, listen to me.
So anyway...
translations.（しまった。\nなんでこの話振っちゃったんだろ……）:
(Crap. Why did I even
bring this up...?)
translations.深夜にＢ級ホラー映画を\nたまにやってるでしょう？:
You know how they show
B-movie horror films
late at night sometimes？
translations.うん、ああいうのも\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の守備範囲なんだ？:
Yeah. Are those kinds
of movies in your
wheelhouse too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うん。\nＤＶＤになってない作品も放送されるし、\n掘り出し物があるんだから。:
Uh-huh. They broadcast
stuff that isn't on DVD,
so you can find some
real hidden gems.
translations.へえ、結構遅くにやってるけど、\n眠くならない？:
Wow. They're on pretty
late, though. Don't you
get sleepy？
translations.眠気は大丈夫なんだけど……\n美容にはね、ほら、クマとかできちゃうし。:
I can handle the sleepiness,
but... it's bad for my skin,
you know？ I get bags
under my eyes.
translations.友達が、旅行に行くからお土産買ってくるって。\n気をつかわなくてもいいのにね。:
My friend is going on a trip
and said she'd buy me a
souvenir. She really doesn't
need to go out of her way.
translations.へえ、ただ観光地のお土産って\n微妙なのも多いような……。:
Huh. A lot of tourist trap
souvenirs can be pretty
hit-or-miss, though...
translations.そこが腕の見せ所なんじゃない？\nその子のセンスだったら期待できるかも。:
That's where she gets to
show off her skills, right？
With her taste, I think I
can expect something good.
translations.ね？\n私もお店にたくさんのお土産が並んでると\n“どうしよー”ってなっちゃうも:
Right？ When I see a store
full of souvenirs, I always
end up thinking,
'What do I do~?'
translations.さっきから●のこと見て、\n笑ってるけど……なにかついてる？:
You've been looking at me
and smiling for a while
now, ●... Is there
something on my face？
translations.あ、ごめんなさい。\n変な意味じゃなくて……\n笑わない？:
Ah, sorry. I didn't mean
anything weird by it...
Promise you won't laugh？
translations.あなたの耳の形っていいな～って。:
I was just thinking you
have really nice ears.
translations.……やっぱり変だよね。\nうん、この話やめ。ごめんね。:
...That is pretty weird,
isn't it. Yeah, let's drop it.
Sorry.
translations.昨日、怖い夢見ちゃった。\nベッドに寝てる私の\n目の前に吸血鬼が……。:
I had a scary dream last
night. I was sleeping in bed,
and right in front of me
was a vampire...
translations.はは、映画の観過ぎじゃない？:
Haha, maybe you've been
watching too many movies？
translations.でもね、よく顔を見たら、あなただったの。\nだったら……血を吸われてもいいかな～:
But when I looked closely,
it was you. So I thought...
maybe I wouldn't mind
having my blood sucked~
translations.うん、結局途中で\n目が覚めちゃったんだけどね。\nなんだかドキドキしたな……。:
Yeah. I ended up waking up
halfway through, though.
It got my heart racing a bit...
translations.最近、とわの市の都市伝説が\n話題になってるの知ってる？:
Did you know Towano City's
urban legends have been a
hot topic lately？
translations.へえ、そんなのあるんだ。:
Wow, I didn't know we
had those.
translations.雑誌にも取り上げられたみたい。\nたとえば高速で走る……\nお婆さん……とか……:
They were even featured in
a magazine. Like the old
woman who... runs at
super speed... or something...
translations.な、なんでも。\n見間違いだと思うから。\nお婆さんが自転車\n追い抜けるわけな:
N-Never mind. I'm sure my
eyes were playing tricks
on me. There's no way an
old lady could outrun a bike...
translations.クラスにね、カノジョに\n耳かきしてもらうのが\n夢だっていう\n男子がいたんだ:
There was a boy in my class
who said his dream is to
have his girlfriend clean
his ears. Do you feel
the same way？
translations.それは……ちょっと\nやって欲しいかな。:
I guess... I wouldn't mind
you doing that for me.
translations.ふうん……耳元でふう～って\nやって欲しいとか？\nどれどれ？:
Hmm... You want me to blow
softly in your ear, too？
Let's see here...
translations.昔に戻りたいなんて\n思うことある？:
Do you ever wish you could
go back in time？
translations.そうだな……あんまり勉強\nしなくても怒られなかった頃とか、\nいいよね。:
Hmm... It'd be nice to go
back to when I wouldn't get
yelled at for not studying.
translations.ふふ、そうなんだ。\n私はあまり戻りたいとは\n思わないんだよね。:
Hehe, I see. I don't really
want to go back, myself.
translations.だってあなたと出会ってない頃なんて、\nつまらないでしょ？:
Because the time before I
met you was so boring,
right？
translations.カレシって大変だなって\n最近思うの。:
I've been thinking lately
that being a boyfriend is
hard work.
translations.なんで？\n●、そんな大変かな。:
Why's that？
Do you think it's that
hard, ●？
translations.友達のカレシがいつも\nカノジョに振り回されてる感じなの。:
It just seems like my
friend's boyfriend is
always getting bossed
around by her.
translations.ああ、そういうカップルいるね。\nでも当人同士は幸せだったりするんじゃない？:
Ah, there are couples
like that. But maybe
they're happy that way？
translations.ふふ、幸せはカップルそれぞれ？\nそうかもね。:
Hehe, every couple has
their own kind of happy？
Maybe so.
translations.あの雑木林……\n小さい頃に探検ゴッコとかしたなあ。:
That thicket over there...
I used to play explorer
in it when I was little.
translations.あの頃はすごく広い森だと思ってたけど、\n今見るとそうでもないのよね。:
I thought it was a huge
forest back then, but
looking at it now, it's
not that big.
translations.あるある。\n成長したのがわかって、\nちょっと寂しくなったりね。:
I know that feeling.
You realize you've grown
up, and it makes you feel
a little sad.
translations.あと十数年経ったら、\nまた違う感想になるのかな。:
I wonder if I'll feel
differently about it in
another ten years or so.
translations.昔と比べると、\nこの街の風景も結構\n変わったなあ。:
Compared to the past,
the scenery in this town
has changed quite a bit.
translations.そうなんだ。\nこの街の昔は知らないからな。:
Is that so. I don't know
what this town used to
look like.
translations.ずっと住んでる人が言ってたけど、\n前はもっと自然が多くて、\nホントに田舎だっ:
People who've lived here
forever say there used to
be a lot more nature, and
it was really rural.
translations.へえ、今はすっかり\n新興都市って感じだよね。:
Wow, now it totally feels
like a booming new city.
translations.きっとこれからも\n変わっていくんだろうね……。\nあなたもいつか、この風景を\:
I'm sure it'll keep on
changing... Someday,
you'll probably feel
nostalgic for this view
too, you know？
translations.今すれ違った人、\n店長かと思って。:
I thought the person who
just walked by was the
manager.
translations.そんなに似てたんだ？:
Did they look that much
like him？
translations.ううん、そうでもなかったみたい。\nよくある顔だしね。:
No, I guess not really.
He just has a common face.
translations.デキシーズの近くに\n新しくファミレスができるみたい。:
Looks like a new family
restaurant is opening up
near Dexee's.
translations.そうなんだ。\nまあ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいる限り、\nデキシーズは負けないな！:
Is that so. Well, as long
as they have you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
Dexee's won't lose!
translations.私だけじゃダメだよ。\nみんなでがんばらないと。\nもちろん、あなたもね？:
I can't do it alone.
We all have to do our
best. And that includes
you, of course？
translations.あ！ ねえねえ、\nあの運送会社の車のナンバーを\n全部足した数が偶数だと、\n:
Ah! Hey, they say if you
add up all the numbers on
that delivery truck's
license plate and it's
even, your wish comes
true.
translations.女の子ってそういうの好きだよね。:
Girls really love that
kind of stuff, huh.
translations.あー、バカにしてる。\nいいもん、あなたとのことお願いしたのに、\n叶わなくてい:
Aw, you're making fun of
me. Fine, I wished for
something about us, but
I guess it won't come
true.
translations.もう、情けない顔しないの。\nカワイイんだから。:
Jeez, don't make such a
pitiful face. You're so
cute.
translations.あ、キャンピングカーが止まってる。\nああいう車での旅行、してみたいな。:
Oh, there's an RV parked
over there. I'd love to
take a trip in a vehicle
like that.
translations.へえ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って意外と\nアウトドア派？:
Oh, are you surprisingly
outdoorsy, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そうでもないけど、\nなんだかワクワクしない？\nちょっとした秘密基地みたいで。:
Not really, but doesn't
it kind of excite you？
It's like a little secret
base.
translations.秘密基地か～。\nそう思うとたしかにワクワクするな。:
A secret base, huh...
Thinking about it like
that is pretty exciting.
translations.ご近所から逃げ出した猫に\nそっくりだったの。\n……捕まえたかったな。:
It looked exactly like a
cat that ran away from my
neighborhood... I wish I
could've caught it.
translations.仕方ないよ。\n猫は逃げ足早いから。:
It can't be helped.
Cats are fast runners.
translations.……そうね。\nせめて飼い主さんには\n教えてあげなきゃ。:
...Yeah. I should at
least let the owner know.
translations.あ、あの赤ちゃんかわいい！: Aw, that baby is so cute!
translations.ほんとだ。\n１歳ぐらいかな。:
You're right. Maybe about
a year old？
translations.いいな……\nやっぱり赤ちゃんほしいな。:
How nice... I really do
want a baby.
translations.……道路凹んでるね、危ないなあ。\n大丈夫？:
...There's a dip in the road.
That's dangerous.
Are you okay？
translations.……はは、大丈夫だよ。\nちょっとつまずいただけ。:
...Haha, I'm fine.
Just tripped a little.
translations.怪我には気をつけてね。\n一緒に遊べなくなったら、イヤだもん。:
Be careful not to get hurt.
I'd hate it if we couldn't
hang out together.
translations.なんだ!?\n上から水が降ってきた……。:
What the!?
Water fell from above...
translations.たぶんマンションの上の人が\n水を捨てたんだと思うけど\n……危なかったね。:
Someone in the apartment
above probably dumped it...
That was close.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が教えてくれなかったら、\n頭からかぶってたかも……。:
If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ hadn't warned me,
I might've gotten soaked...
translations.なんだろ、\n人が集まってるけど。:
I wonder what's going on.
There's a crowd forming.
translations.“突撃いつもの商店街”？\nテレビの撮影かな。:
'Shopping District Surprise'？
Must be a TV shoot.
translations.いいよ、だって……。\n二人でいるとこ映っちゃったら、\n恥ずかしいでしょ？:
No thanks, I mean...
It'd be embarrassing if they
filmed us together, right？
translations.えー、今更じゃない？:
Aw, isn't it a bit late
for that？
translations.そうだけど、\nそれとこれとは違うの。:
I guess, but that's
totally different.
translations.こうしてデートしてるとこ\n知り合いに見られると、\nちょっと気まずいよね。:
It's just a little awkward
if someone we know sees us
out on a date like this.
translations.ほら、次の日に\n冷やかされたりするしさ。:
Well, you know, they might
tease us about it the next day.
translations.悪いことしてるわけじゃないし、\n堂々としててもいいと思うな。:
We aren't doing anything
wrong, so I think we should
just hold our heads high.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ほど\n堂々とはできないよな……）:
(I definitely can't be as
confident as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.さっきショーウィンドウの\n中にあったドレス、見てた？:
Were you looking at that dress
in the shop window earlier？
translations.……気づいてたんだ。\nキレイだったけど、\n着る機会ないよね。:
...You noticed.
It was pretty, but I'd never
have a chance to wear it.
translations.そうだね、高校生には\n縁がなさそうなドレスかな。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に似合いそうだ:
Yeah, it didn't really seem
like a dress for high
schoolers. It'd look great
on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.それって、\n私が老けてるってこと？:
Are you saying
I look old？
translations.えっ!?\nえっと、そういう意味じゃなくて！:
Eh!?
U-Um, that's not what I meant!
translations.そうやって可愛く慌てるから、\nたまにイジメたくなっちゃうのよね……。:
You get so cute when
you panic. It makes me want
to tease you sometimes...
translations.……ウソ。\nたしかに誰かに名前を呼ばれたのに。:
...That's weird.
I definitely heard someone
call my name.
translations.恐いこと言わないでよ。: Don't say scary things like that.
translations.んー、気のせいかな。: Hmm, maybe it was my imagination.
translations.また引っ越し屋さんの\nトラックが止まってる。\n最近、引っ越してくる人が多いね:
There's another moving truck
parked over there.
Lots of people moving in
lately.
translations.とわの市って、\nまだ発展してるんだな。:
Towano City is still
growing, huh.
translations.どんどん変わっていっても、\n私はこの街のこと、好きだな。:
Even if it keeps changing,
I really love this city.
translations.●も、引っ越してきたときは\nまだわからなかったけど、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に出会って:
● wasn't sure about it
when first moving here,
but after meeting ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I think I've come to love
this city.
translations.もう、うれしいこと\n言ってくれちゃって。:
Jeez, you're saying such
sweet things.
translations.友達がね、カレシに後ろから\nギュッてされたいんだって。:
A friend of mine said she
wants her boyfriend to
hug her from behind.
translations.うん……\nあ、本当に友達だってば。\n“私”のことじゃないよ？:
Yeah...
Ah, it really is a friend!
I'm not talking about 'me',
okay？
translations.はは、そっか。\n友達の話は、\n自分の話って言うからさ。:
Haha, right.
They say when you talk
about a friend, you're
really talking about
yourself.
translations.……そりゃあ私だって\nギュッてされたいけど……。:
...Well, of course I'd love
to be hugged like that too,
but...
translations.……今の車、見た？\n中で運転してた人……。:
...Did you see that car
just now？
The person driving it...
translations.見てないけど……\nはは、気ぐるみでも着てた？:
I didn't, but...
Haha, were they wearing
a mascot costume
or something？
translations.……狼男だったと思う。\n助手席には\nフランケンシュタイン。:
...I think it was a werewolf.
And Frankenstein was in
the passenger seat.
translations.……まじで？\nなんかのアトラクション？:
...Seriously？
Is it for some kind of
attraction？
translations.うん、たぶん。\nでも捕まっちゃうんじゃ\nないかな、あれ。:
Yeah, probably.
But I wonder if they'll
get pulled over for that.
translations.可愛いと思うけど？: I think you look cute, though？
translations.もう▼\n……あ、そうじゃなくて。\nお肌の調子、悪いかなって。:
Jeez...▼
Ah, wait, not that.
I meant my skin.
Does it look bad today？
translations.そうだよ。\nなんだろ、夜更かし？\nビタミン？ え、ストレス!?:
Yeah.
I wonder what it is.
Late nights？ Vitamins？
Wait, stress!?
translations.あ……あそこにあった木、\n切られちゃったんだ。:
Ah... the tree that used to
be there got cut down.
translations.そう言えば、結構古い木が\n立ってたっけ。:
Come to think of it, there
was a pretty old tree there.
translations.うん。\n当たり前にあったものが、\n急になくなると、\nちょっと寂しくなるかも:
Yeah.
When something that was always
there suddenly disappears,
it makes you feel a little
lonely.
translations.形あるものはいつか\n……ってやつか。:
Nothing lasts forever...
I guess that's how it goes.
translations.いつもさりげなく\n守ってくれるじゃない。:
You're always casually
protecting me, you know.
translations.さりげないかな、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲といるときは、\n割と必死なんだけど。:
I don't know about casual.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲When I'm with you,
I'm actually trying pretty
hard.
translations.謙遜しちゃって。\nそれを相手に感じさせないのが\nポイント高いよ？:
So modest.
Not letting the other person
notice is what gets you
high points, you know？
translations.あっ、飛行機雲。\nたまに見つけると\nうれしくならない？:
Ah, a contrail.
Doesn't it make you happy
when you spot one sometimes？
translations.なるなる。\n子供の頃は見つけて\n大騒ぎしたなあ。:
It really does.
When I was a kid, I used to
make a huge fuss over them.
translations.もしかして、私のこと\n子供っぽいって思った？:
Did you just think I was
being childish？
translations.いいよ、おばさん扱い\nされるよりずっといいもん。:
It's fine, it's way better
than being treated like
an old lady.
translations.（子供扱いはいいのか……）:
(So being treated like a kid
is fine...)
translations.……今の自転車もだけど、\n最近無謀な運転する人が\n多い気がするなあ。:
...Like that bicycle just now,
I feel like there are a lot
of reckless drivers lately.
translations.通学路とか、危ないよな。:
School routes and stuff
are pretty dangerous, huh.
translations.もちろん。\n……と言いたいけど、\nたまにスピード出しちゃうな。:
Of course.
...Is what I want to say, but
sometimes I go a little fast.
translations.こら。\n事故起こしたら悲しむカノジョがいること、\n忘れちゃダメよ？:
Hey.
Don't forget you have a
girlfriend who'd be
heartbroken if you got into
an accident, okay？
translations.友達がね、よく一人で\nカラオケに行くんだって。:
A friend of mine said she
often goes to karaoke alone.
translations.ヒトカラか……\n友達とは行かないの？:
Solo karaoke, huh...
Doesn't she go with friends？
translations.みんなで行く前の練習だって。\n私も練習しに行こうかな。:
She said it's practice for
when she goes with everyone.
Maybe I should go practice
too.
translations.それじゃヒトカラじゃないよ。\n練習の意味ないでしょ。:
Then it wouldn't be solo
karaoke. That defeats the
whole purpose of practicing.
translations.ねえ、もしこの世から\n携帯がなくなっちゃったら、\nどうする？:
Hey, what would you do
if cell phones just
disappeared from the world？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と電話できないし、\nメールもできないし、\nデートの情報にも困る…:
I wouldn't be able to call
or text ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, and I'd have
no way to look up date spots...
translations.駅前のカフェに新しい\nメニューが増えたらしいの。\n特にミルフィーユが\n美味:
I heard the cafe by the
station has a new menu.
Their mille-feuille is
supposed to be amazing.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、\nそういう情報早いよね。:
You're always so quick
to catch onto things
like that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.趣味と実益を兼ねてますから……\nデキシーズでも新しい\nスイーツ出せたらいいな:
It's a mix of business
and pleasure... I hope we
can add some new sweets
to the menu at Dexee's.
translations.（趣味と実益、\nどっちが大きいんだろ）:
(I wonder which one
she cares about more...)
translations.最近ね、近所に\nクレープ屋さんができたんだけど、\nその前を通るといつも\n甘:
A new crepe shop opened in
my neighborhood recently,
and it always smells so
sweet whenever I walk by...
translations.今日も危なかったんだから。\n……いつまで耐えられるかなあ。:
I barely held back today.
...I wonder how much longer
I can resist.
translations.（そんなに無理\nしなくてもいいのに……）:
(She doesn't have to push
herself that hard...)
translations.公園でちっちゃい子達が遊んでる。\nあの声聞くと、こっちも楽しくなっちゃうね。:
Look at the little kids
playing in the park.
Hearing them makes me
feel happy, too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は子供好き\nだからなあ。:
Well, you've always
loved kids, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.それもそうだけど、\nなんだか元気をもらえる\n気がしない？:
That's true, but don't you
feel like they just give
you energy, too？
translations.たしかに小さい頃って、\n元気が有り余ってたからなあ。:
Yeah, I definitely had
way too much energy
when I was little.
translations.オジサンみたいなこと言わないの。\nほら、私たちも元気にいくの。:
Don't sound like an old man.
Come on, let's show them
how energetic we can be.
translations.あそこの店、やめちゃうんだ。\n閉店セールやってる。:
Looks like that store is
closing. They're having
a closing down sale.
translations.ふふっ、あなたも\nそう思った？:
Hehe, is that what
you thought？
translations.あそこのお店ね、\nいつも閉店セールやってるの。\n安く買えるから、\n誰も文句:
That store is always having
a closing down sale. Nobody
complains since you can get
things for cheap, though.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nやっぱり最近も外食が多いの？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Have you been eating out
a lot lately, too？
translations.うーん……そうだ、\nレシピ作ってあげよっか？\n簡単に作れそうなメニューの。:
Hmm... Oh, I know!
Want me to write down
some easy recipes for you？
translations.●にできるかなあ。:
I wonder if you can
actually pull that off,
●.
translations.大丈夫、デキシーズで\n作ってるじゃない。ね？:
I'll be fine! I cook at
Dexee's all the time,
don't I？ See？
translations.あ、ペットショップの前を通ると、\n飼いたくなっちゃうよね……。:
Ah, walking past a pet shop
always makes me want to
take one home...
translations.なるべく目を\n合わせないようにしないと。:
I have to try my best
not to make eye contact.
translations.目が合ったら最後？:
Because it's game over
if you do？
translations.そう。絶対連れて\n帰りたくなっちゃうもん。:
Exactly. I'd definitely
want to take them home
with me.
translations.うん、ご近所さん。\nそろそろひと月ぐらいかな。\n順調に続いてるみたい。:
Yeah, they're a neighbor.
It's been about a month now.
Looks like they're keeping
at it.
translations.ジョギングかあ……\n●は続かなそうだな。:
Jogging, huh... I don't think
you'd last very long, ●.
translations.部活もやってるもんね。\n私はなあ、三回しかはいてない\nランニングシューズがあ:
You have your club,
after all. As for me,
I have a pair of running
shoes I've only ever
worn three times.
translations.あ、こんにちは。\nいつも大変ですね。:
Oh, hello.
Thanks for your hard
work as always.
translations.今の配達の人、知り合い？:
Was that delivery guy
a friend of yours?
translations.知り合いってほど\nじゃないけど、\nあいさつはよくするかな。:
Not really a friend,
but we greet each
other a lot.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って\n友達だけじゃなくて、\n近所に知り合い多いよね。:
You know a lot of
people around here,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, not just friends.
translations.そうなのかな、普通だと思ってたけど。\nあなたも知り合い増やしてみたら？\nご近:
Really? I thought it
was normal. Why don't
you try meeting more
people too? Getting to
know your neighbors
is fun.
translations.今……足もとを、\nさ～って。:
Something just...
brushed past my feet.
translations.あ、ネコか。\nこら、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を\n驚かせたらダメだろ？:
Oh, it's a cat.
Hey, you shouldn't go
scaring ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ like
that, okay?
translations.いいよ、怒らなくて。\n悪気はなかったんだもんね～？:
It's fine, don't be
mad. You didn't mean
it, did you~?
translations.あそこの茂み、何か光った？:
Did something shine
in those bushes?
translations.ネコにしては大き過ぎて\n……ライオン？:
It was too big for a
cat... A lion?
translations.今考えてること、\n当ててみようか？:
Want me to guess what
you're thinking about
right now?
translations.自信ありげ？\nさあこい！:
You sound confident?
Let's hear it!
translations.ふふ、“私と手を繋ぎたい”？:
Hehe, "I want to hold
her hand"?
translations.はは、正解。\nなんでバレた？:
Haha, spot on.
How'd you know?
translations.私も同じこと考えてたから♪:
Because I was thinking
the exact same thing♪
translations.私ね、ペットを\n飼い始めたの。:
I actually just started
keeping a pet.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の家って\nペット飼えたっけ？:
Are you allowed to have
pets at your place,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲?
translations.ううん、ダメなの。\nだから、携帯で飼う電子ペット。\n結構かわいいんだから。:
No, I can't. So it's a
digital pet on my phone.
It's actually pretty cute.
translations.これからハマっちゃうかも。\nだんだん懐いてくるのがいいのよね。:
I might get hooked soon.
I love how they gradually
get attached to you.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に可愛がられるペット、\nちょっとうらやましいな……）:
(I'm a little jealous of
a pet that gets doted
on by ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.コンビニって長くいても\n飽きないよね。:
You never really get
bored staying in a
convenience store,
do you?
translations.雑誌コーナーで、\nつい長居しちゃったりね。:
Yeah, you end up staying
too long in the
magazine section.
translations.私はお菓子かな。\nいろんなのど飴があって、\nどれにするか考えるのが楽しいの。:
For me, it's the snacks.
There are so many throat
drops, it's fun deciding
which one to get.
translations.へえ、毎回考えてるんだ。:
Wow, you think about it
every time.
translations.お気に入りのもあるけど、\n気分で変えたりしたいじゃない。\n晴れたからレモン、:
I have my favorites, but
I like to change it up
based on my mood.
Like lemon because it's
sunny, or plum because
it's Monday, you know?
translations.やっぱり不思議よね。:
It really is strange,
isn't it?
translations.出会った頃は、\nこんな風に並んで歩いてデートなんて、\n想像もできなかったのに:
When we first met,
I never could've imagined
us walking side-by-side
on a date like this.
translations.そんなときのこと\n思い出してたんだ。:
You were thinking about
back then?
translations.たまーにね。ふっと、\n最初に会った時を思い出すの。\nもう忘れないだろうな。:
Just occasionally.
I suddenly remember when
we first met. I don't
think I'll ever forget it.
translations.ファッション誌って、\n眺めてるだけで楽しいよね。:
It's fun just flipping
through fashion magazines.
translations.女の子ってファッション\n好きだからね。:
Girls just love fashion,
you know.
translations.それだけじゃなくて。\nやっぱりカレシがいると、\n雑誌の見方も変わってくるし。:
That's not all.
When you have a boyfriend,
you look at magazines
differently.
translations.そう。カノジョは\nがんばってるんだぞ？:
Yep. Your girlfriend's
working hard, you know？
translations.学校のあなた、\nデキシーズのあなた、\n今のあなた……全部違うね。:
You at school, you at
Dexee's, you right now...
They're all different.
translations.それがわかりやすいけど、\n表情とか雰囲気もちょっと違うよ？:
That's the obvious one,
but your expressions and
vibe are different too.
translations.そっか……でもそれ、\n●から見た▲姉ヶ崎＊▲\nだって同じだよ。:
I see... But that's the
same for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ from
●'s perspective.
translations.……あ、そうか。\nなんだか面白いね。:
...Ah, I guess so.
That's kind of funny.
translations.う～ん、おまじないか。\n女子は好きだよね、\nそういうの。:
Hmm, love charms.
Girls really love that
kind of stuff, huh.
translations.男子はあんまり信じないか。\n私もやってるんだけど……。:
I guess guys don't really
believe in them. I've
been doing one, though...
translations.ナイショ。\n口に出したら効果がなくなるの。\nでもね、効果は出てるよ？:
It's a secret.
Saying it out loud ruins
the effect. But you know,
it's already working？
translations.ね、知ってる？\nこの前、学校の裏に\nツチノコが出たんだって。:
Hey, did you know？
Someone saw a tsuchinoko
behind the school the
other day.
translations.ほんとだってば！\n友達の友達の……友達？\nが見たって言ってたんだから。:
I'm serious!
A friend of a friend's...
friend？ They said they
saw it themselves.
translations.ニュースでやってたけど、\n山から猿が迷い込んだんだってね。:
I saw on the news that a
monkey wandered down
from the mountains.
translations.あー、見た見た。\nすごい騒ぎになってたね。:
Ah, I saw that too.
It caused a huge uproar.
translations.まだ捕まってないみたい\nだけど、今目の前に\n現れたりして……。:
It seems they haven't
caught it yet. What if it
showed up right here...
translations.あん、もう、捕まえなきゃ。:
Oh, geez. I guess I have
to catch it.
translations.ねえねえ、\n今ポスターが貼ってあったんだけど、\nドラマのエキストラ募集してる:
Hey, hey. I just saw a
poster saying they're
looking for extras for
a TV drama.
translations.学園物の１シーン、としか。\nもしサイコホラーで、\n犯人に追われる女性Ａ\nみ:
It just said a scene in
a school drama. But if it
was a psycho-horror, I'd
wanna be 'Woman A fleeing
from the killer'.
translations.（さすがにそれは\nエキストラの範囲を\n越えてると思うけど……）:
(I think that's a bit
beyond the scope of an
extra, but okay...)
translations.友達にね、\n“あなた達って姉弟みたいね”\nって言われたんだけど。:
A friend told me,
'You two look like a
brother and sister.'
translations.●達？\nそんなことないと思うけど……。:
● and me？
I don't think so...
translations.私もそう思うけど、\nそうじゃないって人もいるのよね。\nうーん、もっとあなたを:
I agree, but some people
see it that way. Hmm,
maybe I should let you
take the lead more？
translations.うん、いいかも。\nあなたももっと、\nどーんとかまえててね？:
Yeah, that might be good.
You need to act more
confident and dependable,
okay？
translations.ねえ、\n道に水たまりがあるときって、\n飛び越えたくならない？:
Hey, when there's a
puddle in the road, don't
you just want to jump
over it？
translations.なるなる。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も飛ぶの？:
Totally.
Do you jump too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私は思うだけ。\n想像でぴょーんって飛び越えて、\n実際は迂回するの。:
I just think about it.
I imagine myself going
'boing!' over it, but I
actually just walk around.
translations.あ、バカにしてる？\nいいもん。:
Ah, are you making fun
of me？ Fine, then.
translations.（可愛いって\n思ったんだけどな……）:
(I was actually gonna say
I thought it was cute...)
translations.メールたくさん送るのって、\n迷惑かな？:
Is it annoying if I send
you a lot of messages？
translations.一人でいると\nどうしてもね……。:
When I'm all alone,
I just can't help it...
translations.寂しかったら教えてよ。\nガマンされる方がいやだしさ。:
Tell me if you're lonely.
I'd hate for you to hold
it all in.
translations.うん……うれしい。\nガマンしないようにがんばる！:
Yeah... I'm glad.
I'll try my best not to
hold back!
translations.そういや、そうかも。\n不思議だな、よく通る道なのに。:
Now that you mention it,
yeah. It's weird, since we
walk this way all the time.
translations.うん……ちょっと急ごうか。:
Yeah... Let's hurry up
a little bit.
translations.あれ、怖い？\nこういうの苦手？:
Oh, are you scared？
Not good with this stuff？
translations.こういう、わかりにくい\n怖さってちょっとね。:
This kind of subtle
creepiness is a bit...
translations.なんだか今日の道、\nいつもよりキレイに見えない？:
Doesn't the street look
prettier than usual today？
translations.そう？\n今日はステキなデートに\nなる気がする！:
Really？ I have a feeling
we're gonna have a
wonderful date today!
translations.はは、まあ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が\nそう思うならそうなるって。:
Haha, well, if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
thinks so, then it will.
translations.ダーメ、デートは\n二人で楽しくするの。\n協力しなさい？:
No, silly. A date is about
both of us having fun.
You gotta cooperate, okay？
translations.手を繋ぐ、腕を組む……\nあとは、肩を抱く、とか？:
Holding hands, linking
arms... What about putting
an arm around a shoulder？
translations.恋人同士が歩きながらすることって、\n何があるかなーって。\n他に思いつく？:
I was just wondering what
couples do while walking.
Can you think of anything
else？
translations.そうだな……\n腰に手を回す、とか？:
Let's see...
Putting my hand around
your waist, maybe？
translations.えっ？ ……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!? そっちこそ、小さくなっちゃって……。:
Huh？ ...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!? You're the one
who got all small...
translations.私、ちっちゃくないよ。もう大人なんだから。:
I'm not small.
I'm already a grown-up.
translations.（そういえば……こんな状況、前にも……）:
(Come to think of it...
I've been in a situation
like this before...)
translations.（でも、前に会った小さな▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、もっと活発な雰囲気だったよな。たしか……:
(But the little ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
I met before was a lot
more energetic.
If I remember right...)
translations.そう呼べって言ってただろ。それに●のこと家来にするって。:
You told me to call
you that, remember？
And you said you'd make
● your servant.
translations.……そうだった？ そんな昔のこと、忘れちゃった。:
...Did I？ I forgot all about
stuff from that long ago.
translations.ほら、“ネネ様、バンザーイ！”ってさ。:
You know, 'All hail
Lady Nene!' and all that.
translations.もう、やめてよ、そんなの子供みたい……。:
Jeez, stop it.
You're acting like a kid...
translations.みたいって、まだ子供じゃ……。:
Like a kid...
Aren't you still one...?
translations.私はもう大人だよ？ もうすぐ中学生だもん。:
I'm a grown-up, you know？
I'll be in middle
school soon.
translations.……なあに？ 人のこと、じろじろ見て。:
...What is it？
Stop staring at me.
translations.それじゃ、もうオレサマなネネ様は見られないのかなって。:
I was just thinking
I guess I won't get to see
the bossy Lady Nene anymore.
translations.そんなの……ただの遊びじゃない。いつまでも子供じゃいられないんだから……。:
That was...
just playing around.
I can't stay a kid
forever...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、さっきとは雰囲気が違う……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ has a different vibe
from before...)
translations.私だって、好きで他の子より早く、大人っぽくなったわけじゃないよ。:
It's not like I wanted
to look more grown-up
than the other kids.
translations.もっと前みたいに遊びたいって、そう思うことだってあるけど……。:
Sometimes I do think
about how I want to play
like we used to, but...
translations.そんなわけにはいかないじゃない……。:
I can't exactly do
that anymore...
translations.だからね、もうああいうのは卒業なの。:
So, you see, I've graduated
from all that.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ほんとに大人みたいだ……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really does seem
like an adult...)
translations.●はあのネネ様も好きだったけどな。:
● really liked that
Lady Nene, too, you know.
translations.うん、可愛くて、ちょっとかっこよくて、楽しくて。一緒に遊んで面白かった！:
Yeah, you were cute,
a little cool, and fun.
Playing with you
was a blast!
translations.ほんとに、子供なんだから。女の子への好きって言葉は、そんな意味で使うんじゃないの:
You really are a kid.
You shouldn't use the word
'like' with a girl
to mean that.
translations.そのうち、教えてあげる。あなたも、私も、もっと大きくなったら……。:
I'll teach you what
it means someday.
When you and I are both
a little older...
translations.それまで……待っててね？:
Until then... you'll wait
for me, right？
translations.うん、待ってる……待ってるよ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！:
Yeah, I'll wait...
I'll wait for you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.小さい▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、可愛くて……やっぱり、キレイだったな……。:
Little ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was so cute...
and still so pretty, too...
translations.（“ネネ様、ばんざ～い！”って言ったら思い出すかな？）:
(I wonder if she'd remember
if I said, "All hail
Lady Nene!"？)
translations.マイクに向かって“ネネ様、ばんざ～い！”と声を出そう:
Say "All hail Lady Nene!"
into the microphone.
translations.行って欲しくないなんてわがまま、言ってはいけませんよね……。:
I shouldn't be selfish
and tell you not to go...
translations.もちろん戦場へです。……許嫁の私を残して。:
To the battlefield,
of course. ...Leaving me,
your fiancée, behind.
translations.許嫁!? あれ、●、いつの間に軍服なんて……。:
Fiancée!? Wait, ●,
when did you put on
a military uniform...
translations.うぅ……こんなに急に……。まだ心の準備も出来ておりません。:
Ugh... so suddenly...
I'm not emotionally
prepared for this yet.
translations.そうか……●はこれから出征するんだっけ……。:
Right... ● is deploying
to the front lines now...
translations.明日からあなたに会えないと思うと、涙が止まらなくて……ううっ……。:
Just thinking I won't see
you tomorrow makes the tears
pour out... *sob*...
translations.結納もお式の準備ももう済ませて、あとは当日を待つばかりだったのに……。:
We finished the engagement
and wedding preparations...
We were just waiting
for the day...
translations.もしあなたが帰らなかったら、私、もう生きていけない……。:
If you don't come back,
I won't be able to live
anymore...
translations.あなたのいない世界なんて、私には何の意味もありません。:
A world without you
has no meaning to me.
translations.だから……だからどうか無事で。あなたの帰りを待ち焦がれる女がいることを、どうか忘:
So... please be safe.
Please don't forget
that there's a woman eagerly
awaiting your return.
translations.肝に銘じる。……だがこちらにも、一つ頼みがある。:
I'll keep that in mind.
...But I have one request
for you, too.
translations.ええ。私に出来ることなら、一つだなんて言わずにいくらでも。:
Yes. If it's something
I can do, ask as many
as you like, not just one.
translations.一つでいいんだ……笑ってくれないか？:
Just one is fine...
Could you smile for me？
translations.笑顔が見たい。: I want to see your smile.
translations.こんな時に、無理です……。:
At a time like this,
I can't...
translations.最後に見るのが泣き顔なんて、寂しいじゃないか。:
It'd be lonely if the
last thing I saw was
your crying face.
translations.そんな、最後だなんて言わないで。:
Don't say it's the
last time.
translations.ああ、そういう意味じゃなくて……。困ったな。ただ、泣き顔より笑顔を見てから、行き:
Ah, I didn't mean it
like that... This is tough.
I just want to see your smile
rather than tears
before I go.
translations.……ふふ、子供をあやすみたいに……。:
...Hehe, you're treating me
like a child...
translations.●にとっては似たようなものだ。:
For ●, it's pretty much
the same thing.
translations.……ああ。やっぱりその顔のほうが、ずっといい。:
...Yeah. That face is
definitely much better.
translations.お帰りを待っています。いつまでも、いつまでも……ずっと……。:
I'll be waiting for
your return. Forever,
and ever... always...
translations.あなたが帰って来てくれるなら……。: If you come back to me...
translations.帰って来てくれるなら……。それなら……たとえゾンビになったって！:
If you come back to me...
Then... even if you become
a zombie!
translations.大丈夫、昨日映画で観たんだから。悪魔に魂を売った博士が、死者を蘇らすの！:
It's okay, I saw it in
a movie yesterday.
A doctor who sold his soul
to the devil resurrects
the dead!
translations.不安なら、今予行演習してみよっか？:
If you're worried, want to try
a practice run right now？
translations.まずはね、たしか……患者を拘束して。:
First, let's see...
we restrain the patient.
translations.え……うわ、体が動かない？ 金縛り!?:
Huh... Whoa, I can't move？
Sleep paralysis!?
translations.それから電気ショックで気絶させて……うーん、でもそんなもの今の時代にはないし、パ:
Then we knock them out
with an electric shock...
Hmm, we don't have that
nowadays, so skip！
translations.次はいよいよ体を……。:
Next, we finally get to
the body...
translations.ちょっと、パスって!? せめてもっと真面目にやって！:
Hey, what do you mean skip!?
At least take this seriously！
translations.聞いておらんかったのか？ わらわはここ大奥で御年寄をつとめる寧々局と申す。:
Were you not told？ I am
Lady Nene, serving as the
senior lady of the Ooku.
translations.年寄りではない！ それに、寧々局様と呼ばぬか！:
I am not a senior！ And you
will call me Lady Nene！
translations.御中臈の高嶺小路と申します。よろしゅう。:
I am Takanekoji, serving
as an Ochuro. A pleasure.
translations.へー、やっぱ▲高嶺＊＊▲は上品な感じだな。:
Wow, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ really does
have an elegant vibe.
translations.高嶺小路殿はお公家の出じゃ。:
Lady Takanekoji comes
from a noble family.
translations.そないお見つめなさるな……。:
Please do not stare at me
so intently...
translations.へえ、▲小早川＊▲はそのまんまの名前なんだな。:
Huh, ▲小早川＊▲'s name is
exactly the same.
translations.無礼な！ 小早川家を愚弄するか！:
Insolence！ Are you mocking
the Kobayakawa clan!?
translations.小早川殿は武家の出じゃ。:
Lady Kobayakawa comes
from a samurai family.
translations.これ！ 勝手に鈴を鳴らすでない！:
Hey! Do not ring the bell
without permission!
translations.で、そなた。上様はどのような女性なら、お気に召すとお思いか。:
Now then. What kind of woman
do you think would please
the Shogun?
translations.は？ ではない。上様の女性嫌いは周知の事であろう。御渡りがないばかりか、奥の規模:
Do not 'huh' me. The Shogun's
dislike of women is well known.
Not only are there no visits,
but we have been ordered to
downsize the Inner Chambers.
translations.このままでは幕府存続の危機じゃ。そうは思わぬか？:
At this rate, the shogunate
itself is in danger.
Do you not agree?
translations.はっきりせぬの。なんのために男子禁制の大奥にそなたを迎えたと思うておるのじゃ。:
Speak clearly. Why do you think
we brought you into the strictly
women-only Inner Chambers?
translations.えーと、つまり、上様の好みを知りたいんですよね？:
Uh, so basically, you want to
know the Shogun's type, right?
translations.（上様の好み、上様の好み……。……そもそも上様ってどんな人だっけ？）:
(The Shogun's type, the Shogun's
type... Wait, what kind of person
is the Shogun anyway?)
translations.困ったの……それならば、そなたの好みでも良い。申してみよ。:
This is troubling... In that case,
your own preference will do.
Tell me.
translations.●の好み？ そんなものでいいんですか？:
●'s type?
Are you sure that's okay?
translations.せっかくの男の意見、ないよりはマシじゃ。ほれ、たとえばこの高嶺小路殿と小早川殿な:
A rare male opinion is better
than nothing. Here, what about
Lady Takane-no-koji or
Lady Kobayakawa, for example?
translations.そなた、覚悟はできているのであろうな？ この寧々局を愚弄した罪、重いぞ。:
You are prepared for the
consequences, I assume? The crime
of mocking me, Lady Nene,
is a heavy one.
translations.愚弄などしていません！ ●は本当にあなたが好きなんです。:
I'm not mocking you!
● really likes you.
translations.小早川殿、寧々局様もあんな顔するんですね。:
Lady Kobayakawa, I didn't know
Lady Nene could make a face
like that.
translations.へへ、案外コッチが素だったりして。:
Hehe, maybe this is
her true self.
translations.も、もうよい！ やはり上様のお世話はそなたが行うのじゃ！:
E-Enough of this! You will be
the one to care for the Shogun
after all!
translations.そうじゃ、上様はネコ目イヌ科タヌキ属……丸みがあり尻尾がふわりとして、とても愛き:
Indeed. The Shogun belongs to the
order Carnivora, family Canidae,
genus Nyctereutes... Round, with a
fluffy tail, and quite charming.
translations.ちなみに奥の法度により、そなたはこれより上様以外の人間との接触を禁ずる。生涯、上:
By the way, according to the laws
of the Inner Chambers, you are
henceforth forbidden from contacting
anyone other than the Shogun.
You shall spend your life caring
only for the Shogun.
translations.ええ、そんな決まり、大奥にあったっけ!?:
Huh, did the Inner Chambers
really have a rule like that?!
translations.心して、おつとめするように。:
See that you serve with
all your heart.
translations.大丈夫、さっきの言葉、うれしかったから……。私もちゃーんと会いに行ってあげるから:
Don't worry. I was happy to hear
what you said earlier... so I'll
make sure to come visit you, too.
translations.あーんもう、やめてったら！ ほら、行きましょう！ 一緒に上様のところへ……。:
Aw geez, cut it out!
Come on, let's go!
To see the Shogun...
translations.……なんか、すごい夢見ちゃったな……。:
...Wow, I just had
a crazy dream...
translations.豪華な着物の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……いいな……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in a gorgeous
kimono... Nice...
translations.（この鈴を振ってみたらどうなるかな？）:
(I wonder what happens
if I ring this bell？)
translations.ふふふ……とうとうこの日がやってきたんだ！:
Hehehe... The day has
finally arrived!
translations.世界に名高い双子山。この頂きに挑戦する日をどんなに心待ちにしたことか……登るぞー:
The world-famous Twin
Peaks. I've waited so long
to climb them... Let's go!
translations.今何か聞こえたような。気のせいか？ まあいいや……。:
Thought I heard something.
Just my imagination？
Oh well...
translations.それにしても柔らかい地面だな……よし、ピッケルを刺して……。:
The ground sure is soft...
Alright, time to plant
my ice axe...
translations.気のせいか……まあ、なしでも大丈夫かな。:
Must be hearing things...
Guess I can do without it.
translations.ここまでかな……よし、今日はここでビバークしよう。:
This is as far as I go...
Alright, I'll bivouac
here for the night.
translations.えっと……火をおこして……。:
Let's see... Time to
start a fire...
translations.あれ急に視界が開けて……。:
Whoa, my field of vision
suddenly opened up...
translations.……これは見事な双子山…………え、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が巨人に!?:
...These are some amazing
Twin Peaks... Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is a giant!?
translations.もう、さっきから何やってるのよ。こんなときに！:
Jeez, what've you been
doing this whole time？
At a time like this!
translations.何って、そこに山があるからさ！:
What do you mean？ Because
it's there!
translations.？ そうじゃなくて……もう、助けに来てくれたんでしょ？:
？ No, not that... Jeez,
you came to save me,
didn't you？
translations.（はりつけられた捕らわれの巨人……そうか……これって……）:
(A captive giant tied
down... I see...
This is like...)
translations.えっと……そうだったそうだった！ 助けに来たんだよ！ なんだよ、登山って、ははは:
Uh... Right, right!
I came to save you!
Mountain climbing, what
was I thinking, hahaha!
translations.ありがとう……でも気持ちは嬉しいけど、今すぐ逃げて。みんなが戻ってこないうちに。:
Thank you... I appreciate
it, but you need to run.
Before they come back.
translations.私、とうとう認めてもらえなかったね。あなたに私はふさわしくないって……。:
I guess they never
accepted me. They said I
wasn't good enough for you...
translations.●に▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が？ 誰だよ、そんな勝手なこと言うの。:
● isn't good enough
for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Who'd say
something so selfish？
translations.だからみんなよ。世界中のみんな。:
Everyone. Everyone in
the whole world.
translations.そう、今や世界中が私たちの敵だもの。:
Yeah, the whole world is
our enemy now.
translations.世界が●の……。なんでそんなことに……。:
The whole world is against
●... Why did it come
to this...
translations.やっぱり私がこんなに大きいのがいけないんだね。:
I guess it's my fault
for being so big.
translations.そんな……。●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と別れる気なんてないぞ！:
No way... ● would never
break up with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.ダメ。こんなキツキツに縛られちゃって、全然動けないの。:
I can't. I'm tied up so tight
that I can't move at all.
translations.このままじゃあなたも捕まっちゃう。今は一人で逃げて。:
If you stay, you'll get caught too.
You have to run away on your own.
translations.そんな状態の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を置いてくなんて、出来るわけないだろ！:
There's no way I could just leave
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ behind like this!
translations.私なんかより、今はあなたのほうが危険でしょ。裏切り者は処刑されちゃうんだよ。:
You're in much more danger
than I am right now.
They execute traitors, you know.
translations.そんなの！ ●は絶対▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を見捨てないからな！:
I don't care! ● would never
abandon ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.……その気持ちだけでもう十分。あなたのおかげで私、すごく幸せだったよ。:
...Just hearing you say that
is enough. You've made me
so incredibly happy.
translations.あなたと過ごした時間は短いけど、でも、一生分幸せにしてもらったから。だから私、怖:
Our time together was short, but
you gave me a lifetime of happiness.
So I'm not scared.
translations.あなたがもし捕まっても、私のことなんて嫌いって言えばいいから。それであなたは助か:
If you get caught, just tell them
you hate me. That way,
they'll spare your life.
translations.あなたを捕まえに来たの。今はみんな興奮してて、話にならないだろうから……逃げて。:
They've come to capture you.
They're too worked up to listen
to reason right now... Run.
translations.えっ？ 待てよ、●は一人じゃ……。:
Huh？ Wait, ● can't just
do this alone...
translations.世界中が敵に回っても、●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の味方だからな！:
Even if the whole world turns on you,
● will always be on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s side!
translations.どうしたの、疲れちゃった？ 式場から直行だったものね。:
What's wrong, are you tired？
We did come straight from
the wedding venue, after all.
translations.ハネムーンでこの国に来るのがずっと夢だったの。叶えてくれてありがとう、アナタ▼:
It's always been my dream to come to
this country for my honeymoon.
Thanks for making it come true, darling▼
translations.ううん、急に実感がわいてきたっていうか……。:
Nothing, it's just suddenly
starting to feel real...
translations.今になってやっと？ カワイイんだから、もう。:
Only just now？
You're so cute, honestly.
translations.ここ、いいお部屋ね。家具も、照明も、匂いも、このベッドも……。:
This is a nice room. The furniture,
the lighting, the scent, this bed...
translations.うん、いいよな。この花びらのウェルカムサービス。:
Yeah, it's great. Especially this
flower petal welcome service.
translations.崩しちゃうのが、勿体ないね。:
It'd be a shame to 
mess it up, wouldn't it?
translations.（……なんか緊張するな。何かしゃべらないと……）:
(...I'm getting kind of 
nervous. I should say 
something...)
translations.この国にくるのがずっと夢だったって言ってたけど……。:
You said it was always 
your dream to come to 
this country, right...?
translations.定番だもん。小さな頃から、ハネムーンは絶対ここって思ってたの。作文にも書いたんだ:
It's a classic! Ever 
since I was little, 
I knew I'd honeymoon 
here. I even wrote an 
essay about it!
translations.夢が現実になっちゃった。ステキな旦那様のおかげだね▼:
And now my dream has 
come true. All thanks 
to my wonderful hubby.▼
translations.そっか。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がそんなに喜んでくれるなら、ここにして良かったよ。:
I see. If you're that 
happy about it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, 
then I'm glad we came.
translations.（……って、ここなんて国だっけ？ えっと……）:
(...Wait, what country 
is this again? Um...)
translations.ちょっと待って、心の準備が！:
Hold on, I need to 
mentally prepare myself!
translations.どうしたの？ 儀式はもう始まってるよ？:
What's wrong? The 
ceremony has already 
started, you know？
translations.ポコリン王国のハネムーンの儀式に決まってるでしょ。はい、ポンポコリーン！:
The Pokorin Kingdom 
honeymoon ceremony, 
of course! 
Now, Pon-Poko-Rin!
translations.（なんか前にも同じようなことがあったような……）:
(I feel like something 
like this has happened 
before...)
translations.いくよー！ あと１００セットー！:
Here we go! 
Just 100 more sets!
translations.なんだ、夢か……。:
What, it was just 
a dream...
translations.……いい夢だったと思ったんだけどな……。:
...And here I thought 
it was a good one...
translations.それでは今日の予報です。とわの市は夕方から崩れ始め、夜には各地でにわか雨が降るで:
And now for today's 
forecast. Towano City's 
weather will worsen by 
evening, with scattered 
showers tonight.
translations.（あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だ。なんでテレビに……）:
(Huh, it's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. 
Why is she on TV...)
translations.ボンヤリしてる場合じゃないですよ！ 今日の視聴率１％切ったら、俺たちクビなんです:
This is no time to zone 
out! If our ratings drop 
below 1% today, we're 
all fired!
translations.ああっ、今１．７％です！ もうおしまいです！:
Ah, we're at 1.7% now! 
It's all over!
translations.そんなこと急に言われても！:
You can't just spring 
that on me!
translations.次は気象予報士ゲロ丸くんの、お天気下駄予報コーナー！:
Next up is meteorologist 
Geromaru-kun's Weather 
Geta Forecast Corner!
translations.ゲロ丸くんが下駄を飛ばして予報してくれまーす。:
Geromaru-kun will predict 
the weather by kicking 
his geta sandals!
translations.（あれ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ってカエル嫌いだったような……あれはいいのかな）:
(Wait. Didn't ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ 
hate frogs...? 
Is she okay with this?)
translations.今日は、私もゲロ丸くんと一緒に、靴を飛ばしてみますね。がんばろう、ゲロ丸くん！:
Today, I'm going to try kicking
my shoe with Geromaru-kun.
Let's do our best,
Geromaru-kun!
translations.昨日飲み過ぎちゃって。もうオジさんも歳だね……。:
I drank too much yesterday.
This old man is showing
his age...
translations.……視聴率取れないの、このキャラのせいなんじゃないのか。:
...Isn't this character
the reason our ratings
are tanking？
translations.ゲロ丸くん、がんばって！ それじゃ、いっくよー！:
Do your best, Geromaru-kun!
Alright, here I go!
translations.……あっ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、そんなに足を上げたら……。:
...Ah. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, if you lift
your leg that high...
translations.姉ヶ崎さんが足上げた瞬間、バーンと上がりましたよ！ 一瞬だけ５％を超えました！:
The moment Anegasaki-san
lifted her leg, they shot
right up! We broke 5%
for a second!
translations.……なるほどそういう手が……。いやいや●のカノジョをそんなことには……。:
...I see, so that's a tactic...
No, no, I can't use ●'s
girlfriend for something
like that...
translations.……ですよね、プロデューサー見直したっす！:
...Right! I've got newfound
respect for you, Producer!
translations.私、この番組が好きなの。あなたと一緒に作り上げたこの番組が！:
I love this show. The show
that we built together!
translations.私、がんばれるから！: I can keep doing my best!
translations.そう！ それなら自然だから、大丈夫！:
Yeah! That way it's natural,
so it'll be fine!
translations.（風か……じゃあ息を吹きかけて……）:
(Wind, huh... Then I'll just
blow some air...)
translations.（風を起こすには、息を吹きかけないと……）:
(To make wind, I have to
blow into the mic...)
translations.うん、いいよ！ もう一息！:
Yeah, that's it!
Just a little more!
translations.まずい、吹きすぎた！ これじゃ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のスカートが！:
Oh no, I blew too hard!
At this rate, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
skirt will...!
translations.何があっても、カノジョのことは大切にしてやんな。じゃないと……一番大事な物を見失:
No matter what happens,
take good care of your girl.
Otherwise... you'll lose sight
of what's most important.
translations.へっ、カエルが柄にもないこと言っちまったな。:
Heh, guess a frog just said
something out of character.
translations.とんでもない！ ありがとう、ゲロ丸くん！:
Not at all!
Thank you, Geromaru-kun!
translations.おう、どうした！ 君もなあ、一番大事な物、ちゃんと守るんだぜ……。:
Yeah, what is it! You make
sure to protect what's most
important to you, too...
translations.視聴率、０％です……ゲロ丸くんがＮＧ出した直後に。:
Ratings are at 0%... right
after Geromaru-kun's NG.
translations.本日は、局地的な豪雨が予想されます。バケツをひっくり返したような雨には、じゅ～ぶ:
Localized heavy rain is
expected today. Please be
ve~ry careful of sudden
torrential downpours.
translations.……夢か、なんだ。……なんか……冷た……。:
...A dream, huh. ...Wait,
why is it... so cold...
translations.（大きく息を吹きかけて風を起こすぞ！）:
(I'll blow hard into the mic
to make some wind!)
translations.こっちこっち！ ほら、いい眺め！:
Over here! Look,
what a great view!
translations.はは。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、あまり急ぐと危ないぞ～。:
Haha. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, it's dangerous
if you rush too much~.
translations.傷が紫色に……。これは毒かも……。:
The wound is turning
purple... It might be venom...
translations.しっかりするんだ！ こんな時は……えーと、傷口から心臓に近いほうを縛って、それか:
Hang in there! In times like
this... uh, tie off the side
closer to the heart, then...
translations.そうだ、それだ！ いくぞ！: Right, that's it! Here I go!
translations.いいの。大丈夫だから、続けて……。:
It's fine. I'm okay,
so keep going...
translations.（感触が柔らかい……ダメだダメだ！ そんなこと考えてる場合じゃない！）:
(It feels so soft... No, no!
This is no time to be
thinking about that!)
translations.（思い切り吸ったら、痕になっちゃいそうだ。でも毒を完全に吸い出さないと……）:
(If I suck too hard, it'll
leave a mark. But I have to
get all the venom out...)
translations.……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、大丈夫か？ 結構吸ったけど……。:
...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you okay？
I sucked out quite a bit...
translations.しっかりしろ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!! 寝ちゃダメだ！:
Hang in there, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!!
Don't fall asleep!
translations.もうダメ、すごく眠い……。ここで寝たら、もう二度と目覚めないのかな……。:
I can't... I'm so sleepy...
If I sleep now, will I ever
wake up again...？
translations.気をしっかり持つんだ、絶対助かるから！:
Stay with me! You're
going to make it!
translations.ごめんね、せっかくのデートだったのに……。:
I'm sorry... Our date was
supposed to be special...
translations.だから、そんなの気にしなくていい！ デートなんかいつだって……。:
I said don't worry about it!
We can have a date anytime...
translations.どういうこと？ 待ちに待った、あなたと私のデートじゃない！ それをそんなのとか、:
What do you mean by that？
I've been looking forward
to this date! And you just
brush it off like nothing!
translations.いやっ！ そんな軽い気持ちでデートしてただなんて……。私、耐えられない……!!:
No! I can't believe you took
our date so lightly...
I can't take this...!!
translations.ええっ!? だから、●はそういうつもりで言ったんじゃ……。:
What!? No, that's not what
● meant...
translations.うぅ、この恨み、晴らさでおくべきか～……がくり。:
Ooh, I shall not leave this
grudge unavenged... *thud*
translations.……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は怒らせちゃいけないな。些細な言葉にも気をつけないと。:
...I shouldn't make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ mad.
I need to be careful about
the little things I say.
translations.（早く傷口から毒を吸い出さないと！）:
(I need to suck the poison
out of the wound, fast!)
translations.どうしたの、ぼーっとして。危ないわよ？:
What's wrong, spacing out？
It's dangerous, you know？
translations.なあに、まだこの呼び方慣れないの？:
What, are you still not used
to me calling you that？
translations.（そっか……今の●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と新婚生活真っ最中じゃないか……）:
(Oh right... ● and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
are right in the middle of
our newlywed life...)
translations.アナタ!? 大丈夫？ 見せて。:
Honey!? Are you okay？
Let me see.
translations.大丈夫大丈夫、水で軽く冷やしておけば。:
I'm fine, I'm fine. I just
need to cool it with water.
translations.こら、まだ早いよ。: Hey, it's too early for that.
translations.（こんな可愛くて優しい奥さんがいて……●は世界一幸せ者だ！）:
(With such a cute and sweet
wife... ● must be the
happiest guy in the world!)
translations.うん、こんな感じかな……。ねえ？:
Yeah, I think this is about
right... Hey？
translations.味見、してくれないかな。:
Could you give this
a little taste？
translations.熱いから、冷ましてから味見してね？:
It's hot, so blow on it
before tasting it, okay？
translations.このままだと熱いから、冷ましてね？:
It's hot like this,
so let it cool down, okay？
translations.（冷ますには、フーフーすればいいよな……）:
(I just need to blow on it
to cool it down...)
translations.ふふ。もう、わざとやってるでしょ。:
Hehe. Jeez, you're doing
it on purpose, aren't you.
translations.キッチンでふざけたら……危ないでしょ？:
Messing around in the kitchen...
it's dangerous, right？
translations.美味い！●の奥さんは最高だ！:
Delicious! ●'s wife
is the absolute best!
translations.ほんとに？ ちゃんと味見した。:
Really？ Did you actually
taste it properly？
translations.したした！ でももっと味わいたいから、もう一口！:
I did, I did! But I want to
savor it, so one more bite!
translations.ふふ、それはちゃんとできてから。あとは盛り付けるだけだから、アナタは座ってて。:
Hehe, you can have more
when it's done. I just need
to plate it, so go sit down.
translations.はーい、いい子にしてまーす: Okaaay, I'll be a good boy.
translations.はーい、いい子にしてまーす。: Okaaay, I'll be a good boy.
translations.よしよし、いい子いい子。もうすぐできまちゅからねー？:
There, there, good boy.
It'll be weady weal soon, okay~？
translations.もう、この甘えんぼ▼:
Jeez, you're such a big baby,
▼.
translations.…………ん…………あれ、ここ●の部屋。じゃあ、あれは……夢？:
...Nn... Huh, this is
●'s room. Then, was that...
a dream？
translations.ばぶーって……●、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に甘え過ぎなのかな……。:
Goo goo... Is ● acting
too spoiled with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.（耳たぶを触ればいいんだな……）:
(I just need to touch
her earlobe...)
translations.（息を吹きかけて冷まさないと……）:
(I need to blow on it
to cool it down...)
translations.お客様～、寝ちゃいましたか？ ふふっ。:
Sir~, did you fall asleep？
Hehe.
translations.（この声は、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ ここは一体……）:
(Is this voice... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Where on earth am I...)
translations.（なんだ、顔にタオルがかかってる……）:
(What the, there's a towel
over my face...)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……ここ……美容院？）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Is this...
a hair salon？)
translations.（せっかくの貴重な▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ちゃんと見てたいもんな）:
(I want a good look at ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ 
while I have the chance.)
translations.シャンプー、もうすぐ終わりますよ～。かゆいところはないですか？:
I'm almost done shampooing~. 
Are there any itchy spots？
translations.えっと…………かゆいところはないですか？: Umm...... are there any itchy spots？
translations.（“大丈夫です”って言わないと、いつまででも洗われちゃうぞ……）:
(If I don't say "I'm fine," she'll 
keep washing my hair forever...)
translations.それじゃ、流しますね～。: I'll go ahead and rinse it now~.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に髪洗われるの、気持ちいいな……それでさっき寝ちゃってたのか）:
(Having ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ wash my hair feels so good... 
No wonder I fell asleep earlier.)
translations.（ああ、気持ちいい……また寝そう……）:
(Ah, that feels so good... 
I'm gonna fall asleep again...)
translations.よいしょっと……いかがですか～？: There we go... How is it~？
translations.えーと、いい眺め、かな……。: Umm, it's a great view, I guess...
translations.えっ？ お湯加減ですよ？: Huh？ I meant the water temperature.
translations.ああ、そっちか！ うん全然大丈夫！ パーフェクト！:
Oh, right! Yeah, it's totally fine! 
Perfect!
translations.ふふっ。お客様、面白い人▼: Hehe. You're a funny one, sir.▼
translations.もうすぐ終わりますからね～。痛かったり熱かったりしたら、遠慮なく言ってくださいね:
We're almost done~. If it hurts or the 
water's too hot, don't hesitate to tell me.
translations.（はぁ……最高の美容院だな。でもこれを他の客にもやると思うと、複雑な気も……）:
(Ahh... Best salon ever. But thinking about 
her doing this for other guys makes me 
feel kinda conflicted...)
translations.呼んでも返事しないんだもの。ふふ、そんなに気持ち良かったですか？:
You weren't answering me. 
Hehe, did it feel that good？
translations.そりゃもう！ 極楽ってのはこういうことを言うんだなあ。:
You bet! This must be what 
they call paradise.
translations.やだもう～、お客様ったらうまいんだから▼: Oh stop it~, you're such a flatterer.▼
translations.はい、洗髪はおしまい。次はマッサージしますね？:
All right, all done washing. 
I'll give you a massage next, okay？
translations.すいませーん、マッサージお願いしまーす。: Excuse me~, I'd like a massage please~.
translations.お客さん、はじめて？ サービスするよ～。:
First time here, sir？ 
I'll give you some special service~.
translations.……あ？ 俺の部屋……夢か。: ...Huh？ My room... It was a dream.
translations.いて……首寝違えたかな……。:
Ouch... I think I slept on 
my neck wrong...
translations.見て見て、こんなにいっぱい♪: Look, look, I got so much♪
translations.（●たちがこの島に流されて、もうどのくらい経っただろう……）:
(I wonder how long it's been
since ● and I washed up
on this island...)
translations.（最初は二人して戸惑うばかりだったけど、やっぱりというか、先に島の生活に順応した:
(At first we were both just
confused, but as expected,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was the first to adapt
to island life...)
translations.（今日もこうして、果物をたくさん採ってきてくれたんだ。それに引き換え……）:
(She went and gathered all
this fruit for us again
today. Meanwhile, I...)
translations.ごめん、今日もダメだった。魚一匹も獲れなかったよ。:
Sorry, no luck today either.
I couldn't catch a single
fish.
translations.そっか……仕方ないよ。魚は果物と違って動くんだもん、慣れが必要だから。:
I see... It can't be helped.
Fish move around, unlike
fruit. It takes some
getting used to.
translations.ごめんな、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にばっかり……。:
Sorry for making you do
all the work, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.もう、気にしないの。この服のヤシの実と葉っぱは、あなたが取ってくれたんじゃない。:
Jeez, don't worry about it.
You got the coconuts and
leaves for this outfit.
You do plenty for me, too.
translations.……いつも、いい天気だね。:
...The weather is always
so nice here.
translations.ああ、水平線がよく見えるな。:
Yeah, you can see the
horizon so clearly.
translations.……私たち、二人きりなんだね？:
...It's just the two of us,
isn't it？
translations.ううん。あなたさえいれば、一生二人きりでも構わない。このままずっと、死が二人を別:
No. As long as I have you,
I wouldn't mind being alone
together forever. Just like
this, until death do us part...
translations.……なんてね？ ちょっと縁起悪かったかな。:
...Just kidding？ Maybe that
was a little ominous.
translations.まぁ、これだけ待っても助けが来ないとなると、悪いことの一つや二つ考えちゃうよな。:
Well, when we've waited this
long with no sign of rescue,
it's hard not to think about
the worst-case scenarios.
translations.こんな時に不謹慎かもしれないけど……。私ね、今すごく幸せなんだ。:
It might be inappropriate to
say at a time like this,
but... I'm actually really
happy right now.
translations.そう。心のどこかでくすぶっていたものが消えて、スッキリした気分。:
Yeah. It feels like
something smoldering in
my heart has finally
cleared up.
translations.この島から出られないなら、あなたがどこかに行っちゃう心配、しなくていいもの。:
If we can't leave this
island, I don't have to
worry about you going
somewhere else.
translations.うん。ただの私の妄想。:
I know. It's just my own
silly delusion.
translations.いつかあなたが私の前からいなくなるんじゃないかって……急に理由もなく不安になって:
I'd suddenly get anxious for
no reason, thinking you might
disappear from my life some-
day... It kept me up at night...
translations.あなたのことが好きで好きでたまらないから、もしいなくなったらどうなっちゃうんだろ:
I love you so, so much...
that I get scared thinking
about what I'd do if you
were gone.
translations.そうじゃないの。……そうね、自分に自信がないのかもしれないな。:
It's not that... I guess I
just don't have much
confidence in myself.
translations.それを言ったら●だって……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は●の自慢のカノジョだ:
If you say that, then ●
is the same... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is the best girlfriend
● could ask for.
translations.だから自信がないなんて言わないで。どこにいたって、周りに誰がいたって、●には▲姉:
So don't say you lack
confidence. No matter where
we are or who's around,
● only has eyes for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.うん……ありがとう……やだ、もう。:
Yeah... Thank you...
Jeez, stop it.
translations.やっぱり、あなたがいればずっとこのままでもいいな……。:
I really wouldn't mind
staying like this forever,
as long as I'm with you...
translations.ねえ、こんな、教会も役所も何もないところでは意味がないことなのかもしれないけど。:
Hey, this might not mean
much in a place like this
with no church or city
hall, but...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、最後になんて言おうとしてたのかな……夢でも気になる。:
I wonder what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was
trying to say at the end
there... Even if it was
a dream, I'm curious.
translations.それじゃ、▲デート場所▲で。:
Alright, let's meet at
▲デート場所▲.
translations.うん、すぐ行く。電話ありがとう。:
Okay, I'll head over right now.
Thanks for calling.
translations.今はちょっと……。ごめんなさい。: I can't right now... I'm sorry.
translations.そっか、急だもんな。また誘うよ。:
I see, it is pretty sudden.
I'll invite you again.
translations.うん、ありがとう。ごめんね？: Yeah, thank you. I'm sorry, okay？
translations.●だけど。今から会いたいなと思って。:
It's ●. I wanted to see
you right now.
translations.どうしても会いたい？:
Do you really want to see me
that badly？
translations.素直でよろしい。じゃあ会おっか。:
I like your honesty.
Let's meet up, then.
translations.やった。じゃ、すぐに▲デート場所▲で。:
Yes! Let's meet at
▲デート場所▲ right away.
translations.ふふ、遅れたら帰っちゃうからね？:
Hehe, if you're late,
I'm going home, okay？
translations.ごめん、今はちょっと無理かな。:
Sorry, I don't think I can
right now.
translations.もしもし、●だけど。今、会えないかな。:
Hello, it's ●.
Can we meet up right now？
translations.良かった。じゃ、今から▲デート場所▲で。:
Great. Let's meet at
▲デート場所▲.
translations.どっちが先に着くかな？ ふふ。:
I wonder who'll get there first？
Hehe.
translations.ああ、残念。今は行けないの。:
Aw, what a shame.
I can't make it right now.
translations.せっかくなのに、ごめんね？: I'm sorry to turn you down.
translations.今から？ えーと……うん、大丈夫。:
Right now？ Um... yeah,
that's fine.
translations.良かった。それじゃ、▲デート場所▲で。:
Great. Let's meet at
▲デート場所▲ then.
translations.今は難しいかな……。: It's a bit difficult right now...
translations.そっか、残念……。それじゃ、また。:
I see, that's a shame...
Well, see you later.
translations.うん、会ってあげてもいいかな。:
Yeah, I suppose I could
make time for you.
translations.んー、今からはちょっと……。: Hmm, right now is a little...
translations.●だけど、今から会えるかな。:
It's ●. Can we meet up
right now？
translations.やった。▲デート場所▲でどう？:
Yay. How about we meet
at ▲デート場所▲？
translations.うん、わかった。慌てて転ばないようにね？:
Okay, got it. Don't trip
and fall in a rush, okay？
translations.●。今から会えないかな。:
It's ●.
Can we meet up right now？
translations.こんな気持ちのままじゃ……。じゃあね。:
Not when I'm feeling
like this... Bye.
translations.もしもし、●だけど。今から会わない？:
Hello, it's ●.
Want to meet up right now？
translations.そんな気分になれると思う？ じゃあね。:
Do you think I'm in the
mood for that？ Bye.
translations.●だけど、今から会えないかな？:
It's ●, but...
can we meet up right now？
translations.こんなこと言いたくないけど、それ、ちょっと考えなしだよ？:
I hate to say this, but...
isn't that a bit thoughtless？
translations.もしもし、寧々です。今から会えるかな。:
Hello, it's Nene.
Can you meet up right now？
translations.急にごめんね。わがまま言っちゃって。:
Sorry for the short notice.
I'm being a bit selfish.
translations.いいってそんなの。それじゃ、またあとで。:
It's totally fine.
I'll see you later, then.
translations.じゃあ、待ち合わせは▲時刻▲に▲デート場所▲で。:
Then let's meet at ▲時刻▲
at ▲デート場所▲.
translations.●も遅れないよう行くよ。じゃあ、またあとで。:
● won't be late either.
See you later.
translations.残念、今はダメなんだ……。: Too bad, I can't right now...
translations.……そっか。忙しい時にごめんね。:
...I see. Sorry for bothering
you when you're busy.
translations.いいって。こっちこそごめんな。:
It's fine. I'm the one
who should apologize.
translations.もしもし。寧々からお誘いの電話です。:
Hello. This is Nene, calling
to invite you out.
translations.うん。電話切ったら、ダッシュね？:
Yeah. Once we hang up,
you'd better dash, okay？
translations.はは、全速力で行くよ。: Haha, I'll run at full speed.
translations.１秒も遅れちゃダメよ？:
Don't be even a single
second late, okay？
translations.はは、肝に銘じておきます。: Haha, I'll keep that in mind.
translations.んー、ホント残念。また今度ね？:
Hmm, that's a real shame.
Next time, then？
translations.もしもし、私。今から会いたいな。:
Hello, it's me.
I want to see you right now.
translations.うん。戸締りはちゃんとして来るのよ？:
Okay. Make sure you lock up
properly before you leave？
translations.うん、決まり。早く時間にならないかなあ。:
Yeah, it's a date. I can't
wait to see you.
translations.そっか……。また誘うから、ね？:
I see... I'll invite you
again later, okay？
translations.天気の良い日は公園で\nのんびりするのが、\n気持ちいいよね。:
It feels so nice to just
relax in the park on
a beautiful day like this.
translations.これで▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が\n膝枕でもしてくれたら……。:
If only ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ would let me
rest my head on her lap...
translations.そういうのは\n二人っきりのときにね？:
Save that for when
we're all alone, okay？
translations.この噴水公園って\n通り道にもなってるから、\nなんだか馴染み深いな。:
This fountain park is
on my usual route, so I
feel pretty attached to it.
translations.ああ、デート以外でも\nお世話になるもんな。:
Yeah, we end up passing
through here a lot even
when we aren't on a date.
translations.付き合う前は、\nこんな風に誰かとお散歩\nするなんて思わなかったけど。:
Before we started dating,
I never thought I'd be
taking walks with someone.
translations.そうやって同じ場所に別の\n思い出が増えていくんだろうな。:
I guess that's how we keep
making new memories in
the exact same places.
translations.ふふ、かっこよく話そうとしてる。\nでもわかるな……。:
Hehe, you're trying to
sound cool. But I get it...
translations.ここの公園ってやっぱり\nカップルが多いよね。:
There sure are a lot of
couples in this park.
translations.デートスポットだしね。\nほら、向こうの芝生の方\nなんか……。:
It is a date spot, after
all. Look, over there on
the grass...
translations.こら、あんまりジロジロ\n見ないの。それとも、\nあんな風にラブラブしたい？:
Hey, don't stare so much.
Or do you want to be all
lovey-dovey like them？
translations.もうっ。\nお行儀良くしてたらね？:
Geez. If you behave
yourself, maybe？
translations.昔、ここの境内でよく\nかくれんぼしたな。\nね、あなたもやった？:
I used to play hide-and-seek
on these shrine grounds
a lot. Did you do that too？
translations.やった、やった。\n●が住んでたとこにも、\n小さな神社があってさ。:
You did, huh？ There was a
small shrine back where
● used to live, too.
translations.……童心に返って\nやってみよっか？:
...Want to feel like a kid
again and give it a try？
translations.ね。私のこと\n……つ、か、ま、え、て▼:
Come on. Try and...
c-a-t-c-h m-e, ▼.
translations.ね。せっかく神社に\n来たんだし、\nおみくじ引いて\nみよっか？:
Hey. Since we're at a
shrine and all, want to
draw a fortune？
translations.な、い、しょ▼\nいい結果だよ、私にとっても。\nきっと、あなたにとっても。:
S-e-c-r-e-t▼
It's a good result for me.
And probably for you, too.
translations.神社の境内って独特な\n雰囲気があると思わない？:
Don't you think shrine
grounds have a really
unique atmosphere to them？
translations.神聖な？\nじゃ、こんなところで\nデートなんかしてたら、\n神様に怒られるかも:
Like they're sacred？
If we're on a date in a
place like this, the gods
might get mad at us.
translations.悪いことはしてないよ？\nでももしかして神様も\nヤキモチ焼いてるかもね。:
We aren't doing anything
bad, you know？ But maybe
the gods are getting a
little jealous.
translations.はは、神様相手でも\n見られてると思うと\nちょっと恥ずかしいな。:
Haha, even if it's the
gods, thinking we're being
watched is a little
embarrassing.
translations.前評判通り、良かったね。:
It was just as good as
the reviews said.
translations.よかった。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もいいと思ったんだ。\nほっとした。:
I'm glad. You thought it
was good too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I'm relieved.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、映画には\nこだわりあるからさ。\n世間の評判がいいからって\n安:
You're pretty picky about
movies, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Just because
the reviews are good
doesn't mean I can relax.
translations.そんな風に思ってたんだ。\n映画は好きだけど、\nそんなに口うるさいつもりは\n:
Is that what you thought？
I like movies, but I don't
mean to be that critical.
translations.うーん、私は\nまあまあだったかな。:
Hmm, I thought it was
just okay.
translations.そうなんだ、まあまあ\n面白かったってこと？:
I see, so you thought it
was somewhat interesting？
translations.うん、そう……かな。\nうん、そう。\nまあまあ面白かったよ？:
Yeah, I guess...
Yeah, that's right.
It was somewhat
interesting, you know？
translations.（色々言いたいことは\nあるんだろうな……）:
(She probably has a lot
she wants to say
about it...)
translations.でも、しょうがないよね。\n私も退屈だったもん。:
I can't blame you, though.
I was bored too.
translations.そんなことないよ……\n……ちょっとだけ、だから。:
No I wasn't...
...Just for a little bit.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？\nずっと黙ったままだけど、\nもしかしてつまらなかった？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
You've been quiet for a bit.
Was it boring？
translations.面白かったよ。\n……２人の再会のシーンで\nちょっと感極まっちゃって……。:
It was really good.
...I just got a little emotional
during their reunion scene...
translations.あんまり見ないの。\nいいじゃない、\n感動しちゃったんだから。:
Don't stare at me.
Come on, it's fine.
I was just really moved.
translations.アクション映画って、\nモヤモヤしてるときに観ると\nスカッとするね。:
Action movies are great.
They really clear your head
when you have a lot
on your mind.
translations.ほんとほんと。\n……あれ、もしかして\nモヤモヤしてたの？:
They really do.
...Wait, did you have a lot
on your mind？
translations.ううん、言葉のあや。\n私は大丈夫。:
No, it's just a figure
of speech. I'm perfectly fine.
translations.今日のは特に面白かったね。\n一番は、あなたの噴き出した顔。:
Today's was especially funny.
The best part was when
you burst out laughing.
translations.ごめん。でも\nコメディなんだから、\n笑っても構わないと思うよ？:
Sorry. But it's a comedy,
so I think it's perfectly
fine to laugh, you know？
translations.それはそうだけど……\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の前では\nカッコつけたいじゃん。:
I know, but...
I want to look cool
in front of you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.背伸びしないの。\nいいじゃない、\n私の前でくらい、\n子供でいれば。ね？:
Don't try so hard.
It's fine, isn't it？
You can just be a kid
when you're with me. Okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n楽しめなかった？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
did you not enjoy it？
translations.ううん、楽しかった。\nでも少し消化不良な感じがして。\n解決されてない問題が\:
No, it was fun.
It just felt a bit unresolved.
There were a few loose ends
left hanging, weren't there？
translations.ああ、ひょっとしたら\n原作小説でしか説明\nされてないのかもね。:
Ah, maybe those parts
are only explained
in the original novel.
translations.やっぱそれかあ。\n原作も読まないとダメかな。:
I figured as much.
Guess I'll have to read
the novel too.
translations.ＳＦってこういうこと\nあるから大変だよな。:
Sci-fi can be tough
when it does stuff like this.
translations.ほんとに。\nもうどうしても気になっちゃう。:
Tell me about it.
Now it's going to bother me.
translations.どうしたの、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。\nなんか無表情。\nつまんなかった？:
What's wrong, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
You're totally blank.
Was it boring？
translations.そうじゃないの。\n気にしないで？:
No, it's not that.
Don't worry about it, okay？
translations.そう言われても気になるよ。\n変だし。:
I can't help but worry.
You're acting weird.
translations.あのね、\nすごく面白かったの。:
Well, you see...
It was really interesting.
translations.そうなの？\nじゃあなんで……。:
It was？
Then why are you...
translations.きっとあなたが引くぐらい\n語っちゃうから、内容に\n関しては何も喋らないように:
I knew I'd talk your ear off
and creep you out, so I
decided not to say anything
at all about the plot.
translations.（じゃあ何も\n聞かないでおこう……）:
(I guess I'd better not
ask any questions, then...)
translations.映画も面白かったけど、\nグッズ売場もすごかったね。:
The movie was fun, but
the merch shop was amazing.
translations.限定フィギュア付\nパンフレットだってさ。\n会場でしか買えないみたい。:
It says there's a pamphlet
with an exclusive figure.
Looks like it's only sold
at the venue.
translations.並んで買ってきて\nあげようか？:
Should I line up and
buy it for you？
translations.いいよ！\n欲しいわけじゃないし。:
No thanks!
It's not like I want it.
translations.そう？ 子供のために並んで\nオモチャを買うって、\nちょっといいなって。:
Really？ I thought it'd be
nice to line up and buy
a toy for my kid.
translations.すごーい。\nまたストライク！\nボウリングの才能あるのかも。:
Wow!
Another strike!
You might be a bowling
prodigy.
translations.そんなことないよ。\nまぐれまぐれ。\nさっ、今度は\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の番だよ。:
No way.
It was just a fluke.
Alright, it's your turn now,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は\n意外にドジっ子の才能が\nあるかも……？）:
(Maybe ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is
actually a prodigy at
being clumsy...?)
translations.少し休憩にしよ？\n意外に体力使うもんね。:
Should we take a break？
This takes more energy
than you'd think.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、\n尻上がりに調子出てくるよね、\nスロースターターっていうか:
You really pick up the pace
as you go, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Like a slow starter.
translations.そう、かな。\nたしかにスポーツで\nそういわれること、多いかも。:
You think so？
I do get told that a lot
when it comes to sports.
translations.じゃあやればやるほど、\n高得点が！:
Then the more you play,
the higher your score!
translations.でもね、調子が出てきても\n体力がもたないの。\nだから結局はいいところなく\n:
But even if I get into it,
my stamina doesn't last.
So I usually just finish
without doing anything cool.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、さっきから\n球に向かって、何してるの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what've you been doing
to the ball this whole time？
translations.イイコだから、まっすぐ\nピンに向かってくださいって\nお願いしてるの。:
I'm asking it to be a good
boy and go straight for
the pins.
translations.はは……成功したら\nすごい能力だけどね。:
Haha... If it works,
that's an amazing ability.
translations.なんかありえない\n曲がり方した気が……。:
I feel like it curved
in an impossible way...
translations.こういうところって\n来る前はちょっと\n身構えちゃうけど、\nいざ来てみるとや:
I always get a little
defensive before coming
to places like this,
but once I'm here, it's fun.
translations.その場のノリみたいな？:
Like you just go with
the flow？
translations.そう、流されちゃう感じ。\nそのうちなんでもいいや！\nって気になっちゃうの。:
Yeah, like getting swept
away. Eventually I just
feel like 'whatever works!'
translations.はは、そういう▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も\n普段と違って面白いよね。:
Haha, it's fun seeing you
like that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
It's different from usual.
translations.ふぅ……少し疲れちゃった。\nでも気持ちいい疲れかな。:
Phew... I'm a little tired.
But it's a good kind
of tired.
translations.スポーツとも\nちょっと似てるかも？:
Maybe it's a bit
like sports？
translations.そうかも。\nこう、なんか出てる感じ。:
Maybe. Like, something is
being released.
translations.そう。\nだから疲れも\n心地良いんだろうね。:
Yeah. That's probably why
the fatigue feels so good.
translations.……ごめん。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、苦手だった？:
...Sorry. Was this not
your thing, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ううん。酸欠気味なのかな。\n少しゆっくりすれば\n大丈夫だから。:
No. I think I'm just a
little short on oxygen.
I'll be fine if I rest
a bit.
translations.ほんとごめん。\n無理に動かないで。:
I'm really sorry.
Don't push yourself.
translations.そんなに謝らないの。\n余計に落ち込んじゃうでしょ。:
Don't apologize so much.
It'll just make me
feel worse.
translations.すごい人気だったね。\nチケットがなかなか取れない\n理由、わかった気がするな。:
They were super popular.
I think I understand why
tickets are so hard to get.
translations.私もファンになっちゃうかも。\nほら、アンコールで\n歌った……。:
I might become a fan too.
You know, the one they sang
during the encore...
translations.男性なのに、女の子の心が\nよくわかってるなあって、\n参考になったりして？:
Even though he's a guy,
he really understands
a girl's heart. Maybe you
could learn from him？
translations.（うーん、\n歌詞まで覚えてない……）:
(Hmm, I don't even remember
the lyrics...)
translations.ふぅ……なんだか\n完全燃焼って感じだね。:
Phew... I feel completely
burned out.
translations.まさか▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が\nライブ中にジャンプし出す\nなんて思わなかったな。:
I never thought you'd start
jumping during the live,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.だって……自分だけ\nおとなしくしてたら、\nかえって変でしょ？:
Well... it'd be weirder
if I was the only one
being quiet, right？
translations.そうだけど、\n結構▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が\n率先して騒いでたような？:
That's true, but it seemed
like you were leading
the charge, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そんなこと……\nもう、そんなに私のこと見てたんだ。:
That's not... Jeez, you were
watching me that much.
translations.……こういう大人の\nムードのライブもいいね。:
...A live with this kind of
mature mood is nice too.
translations.うん、なんだか\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もいつもより\n色っぽく見える気が！:
Yeah, somehow you look even
sexier than usual, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.どうかな。\nでも二人してちょっと\n大人になれた気分が味わえたね。:
I wonder about that.
But we both got to feel a
little more grown-up, huh？
translations.ライブどうだった？\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が気に入るか\nどうかわからなかったけど。:
How was the live show？
I wasn't sure if you'd
like it or not, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ラップって、\n短歌みたいで面白いよね。\n韻を踏んでてリズムがあって。:
Rap is pretty interesting.
It's like tanka, with all
the rhymes and rhythm.
translations.たしかにそこだけ\n聞くとそんな気も……。:
I guess if you put it
like that, maybe...
translations.してきた？\nじゃあラップのルーツは短歌！\nね？:
You think so？
Then rap's roots are in
tanka! Right？
translations.声優さんも歌が上手なんだね。:
Voice actors are really
good at singing, huh.
translations.どっちも声の仕事だしなあ。\nやっぱ発声とかあるんじゃない。:
They're both voice jobs.
It probably comes down to
vocal training.
translations.そっか……。\n人気もすごかったね？:
I see...
They were really popular
too, weren't they？
translations.そうだな。ファンの人達、みんなすごかったな。:
Yeah. The fans were all
really intense.
translations.みんな？\nあなたは？:
All of them？
What about you？
translations.言葉だけであんなに観客を\n引き付けるって、すごいね。:
It's amazing how they can
captivate the audience
with just their words.
translations.普段テレビなんかで見るのと\nぜんぜん違うよな。:
It's totally different
from what you usually see
on TV.
translations.テレビだとそこまで面白いと\n思わなかったんだけど……\n印象変わっちゃった。:
I never thought they were
that funny on TV... but my
impression totally changed.
translations.ライブじゃないと\n伝わらないネタ多かったもんな。\nテレビだと損してるかも。:
A lot of their jokes only
work live. They might be
missing out on TV.
translations.映画もそうだけど、テレビで\n観るだけじゃできない\n体験っていっぱいあるね。:
Just like with movies,
there are so many things
you can't experience on TV.
translations.デートにも使えそうなものって、\n他にもあるかな？:
I wonder if there's
anything else like that
we could do for a date？
translations.舞台観に来て良かったな。\n実はね、ちょっと落ち込む\nことがあったんだけど……:
I'm so glad we came to see
this play. Actually, I was
feeling a bit down...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が落ち込む？\n何かあったの？:
You were feeling down,
