translations.ううん、わがまま言ってもしょうがないもの。我慢するね。:
No, being selfish won't
help anything. I'll just
have to bear with it.
translations.ごめん。急ぎの用事ができちゃって……。:
I'm sorry. Something
urgent came up...
translations.えっと、今日のデートはキャンセルさせて。ごめんなさい！:
Um, please let me cancel
today's date. I'm sorry!
translations.……うん、わかった。でも、今回限りにしてね？:
...Yeah, I understand.
But make this the only
time, okay？
translations.どうしたの……なんだか暗いよ。何かトラブル？:
What's wrong... you sound
kind of down. Any trouble？
translations.うん。ちょっと急用ができちゃって……今日のデート、中止にしてもいい？:
Yeah. Something urgent
came up... is it okay if we
cancel today's date？
translations.どうしても外せない用事なんだ。ごめん、必ず埋め合わせするから。:
It's something I absolutely
can't miss. I'm sorry, I'll
definitely make it up.
translations.何かあったのかと思っちゃった。大丈夫、デートはまたできるよ。:
I thought something had
happened to you. It's okay,
we can date another time.
translations.もしもし、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ ごめん、連絡が遅れて。実は急用ができちゃって……。:
Hello, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Sorry for
the late notice. Actually,
something urgent came up...
translations.急用……？ じゃあ、来られないの？:
Something urgent...？
So, you can't come？
translations.そうなんだ……。絶対、今度埋め合わせする。ごめん。:
Yeah... I'll definitely make
it up to you next time.
I'm sorry.
translations.いいよ。私、お姉さんだもん。今回だけ許してあげる。ちゃんと用事片付けるんだよ？:
It's fine. I'm the older
one, so I'll forgive you
this once. Finish up, okay？
translations.やっと電話くれた。今どこ？:
You finally called.
Where are you now？
translations.え？ そうなんだ……。うん、わかった。:
Huh？ I see...
Yeah, I understand.
translations.予定空いちゃった。仕方ないけど、さびしいな……。:
Now my schedule is wide
open. It can't be helped,
but I'm a bit lonely...
translations.●が悪い。謝るよ。:
This is all ●'s fault.
I'm sorry.
translations.もしもし？ 私、もう来てるよ？:
Hello？ I'm already
here, you know？
translations.ごめん！ 突然用が入って、そっちに行けなくなっちゃったんだ。:
Sorry! Something suddenly
came up, and I won't
be able to make it.
translations.えっ……本当に急ね。よくわからないけど、大丈夫？:
Huh... That's really
sudden. I'm not sure
what's going on, but
are you okay？
translations.こっちのことはいいから。私にできることがあったらいつでも言ってね？ じゃあ……。:
Don't worry about me.
If there's anything I can
do, just let me know,
okay？ I'll let you go...
translations.ふぅ……あ、ごめん。今日のこと思い出してたらボーッとしちゃった。すごく素敵な時間:
Phew... Ah, sorry. 
I spaced out a bit 
thinking about today. 
It was such a lovely time.
translations.今日のデートは満点、花丸あげちゃう。……もう、ケチのつけどころないんだもん。:
Today's date gets a 
perfect score, with a 
gold star. ...I mean, 
I can't find a single flaw.
translations.はぁ、もうデート、終わっちゃう……。こんなに夢中にさせちゃうなんて、ずるい▼:
Sigh, our date is 
already over... 
Making me this crazy 
about you, so unfair▼
translations.……なんだかあったかい気持ちになっちゃった。冷めないうちに、また……。気が早すぎ:
...I'm feeling so warm 
and fuzzy inside. 
Before it fades, let's 
do it again... Too soon？
translations.今日が楽しかったから、次はハードルあげちゃうかも。もーっと幸せにしてくれてもいい:
Today was so fun, 
I might raise the bar 
for next time. 
You can make me even 
happier, you know？
translations.楽しいデートをありがとう。またこんな時間をちょうだいね。私も協力するから。:
Thanks for the fun date. 
Give me another time 
like this, okay？ 
I'll do my part, too.
translations.デートも経験……なのかな？ たくさんすればいいってものじゃないけど、今日みたいな:
I guess dating takes 
experience... Not that 
more is always better, 
but dates like today 
are nice.
translations.ん～、楽しかった。次はもっと楽しいデートになるよね？:
Mmm, that was fun. 
Our next date will be 
even better, right？
translations.今日はありがとう。今度のデートはもっと楽しもうね、二人で一緒に。:
Thanks for today. 
Let's have even more 
fun on our next date, 
just the two of us.
translations.今日、がんばってたね。私ももっと盛り上げなくちゃ……ね。:
You tried really hard 
today. I need to do 
my part to liven 
things up, too...
translations.せっかく二人でいるんだから、もっと楽しくしたかったな。次回に期待すればいい？:
Since we were together, 
I wanted to have a 
little more fun. 
Can I count on next time？
translations.ちょっぴり物足りなかったかも。今度は反省をいかしてね？:
I feel a little 
unsatisfied. 
Make sure you learn 
from this for next time？
translations.今日のデート……なんだったのかな……。でも私、気にしてないから。:
What was up with our 
date today... 
Well, I'm not letting 
it bother me.
translations.……今日、あなたはどうだったの？ 私は疲れちゃった。:
...How was today 
for you？ 
I'm just tired.
translations.……できればやり直したいなあ、今日のデート。:
...I wish we could 
do today's date 
all over again.
translations.ねえ。こういう髪型……好き、かな？ 短くしちゃったんだけど。:
Hey. Do you like...
this kind of hairstyle？
I cut it short.
translations.短めにカットしてもらったんだけど、どう思う？:
I got it cut a bit short.
What do you think？
translations.ショートにしてみたの。感想ほしいな。:
I tried out a short cut.
Tell me what you think.
translations.ね、新しい髪型……気づいてるよね？ これぐらいの長さ、どう？:
Hey, my new hairstyle...
You noticed, right？
How's this length？
translations.何も言ってくれないの？ せっかく長さ、変えてみたのに。:
You're not gonna say
anything？ Even though
I changed the length.
translations.ねえ。セミロングもいいかなと思ったんだけど、あなたはどう？:
Hey. I thought a medium
length would be nice,
but what about you？
translations.ロング、好きかなと思ったんだけど……合ってる？:
I thought you might like
long hair... Am I right？
translations.この髪、あなたのために伸ばしたの……気に入ってくれた？:
I grew my hair out just
for you... Do you like it？
translations.ふふ。髪の長い私、どうかな？:
Hehe. What do you think
of me with long hair？
translations.うれしい……あなたの好みにもっと近づきたい。:
I'm glad... I want to get
even closer to your ideal.
translations.私も日々、愛される努力してるんだから。ふふ、よかった。:
I put effort into being
loved every day, you know.
Hehe, I'm glad.
translations.ねえ……私のこと、もっと好きになってもいいからね。:
Hey... it's okay if you
fall even more in love
with me, you know.
translations.新しい髪型、どう？ 気に入ってくれるとうれしいな……。:
How's my new hairstyle？
I'd be happy if you
liked it...
translations.イメチェンに挑戦してみたんだけど……成功してる？:
I tried changing up my
look... Was it a success？
translations.このヘアスタイル、あなたはどう思う？ 感想聞きたいな？:
What do you think of this
hairstyle？ I want to hear
your thoughts.
translations.あ、惚れ直しちゃった？:
Ah, did you fall in love 
with me all over again?
translations.せっかく変えたのに……もう。:
I went through the trouble 
of changing it... Jeez.
translations.ねえ、色変えてみたんだけど、前と印象変わったよね？:
Hey, I tried changing 
the color. It gives off 
a different vibe, right?
translations.髪、染めてみたの。カレシとしてはどう？:
I dyed my hair. 
What does my boyfriend 
think of it?
translations.じゃーん。この髪の色、かわいい？:
Ta-da! Is this hair color 
cute?
translations.髪……こういう色もアリかなって思ったんだけど……。:
I thought this hair color 
might be a good look...
translations.あはは、ちょっと冒険しすぎたかな？ どう、この色？:
Ahaha, did I go a little 
too wild? How's this color?
translations.冒険は失敗だよ: The wild look is a fail.
translations.髪、思いきっちゃった。さらに思いきって感想聞いちゃう。どう思う？:
I took a leap with my hair. 
Now I'll take a leap 
and ask: what do you think?
translations.ちょっと、服装を変えてみたくなって。ダメじゃないといいんだけど。:
I felt like changing up 
my outfit a bit. 
I hope it's not too bad.
translations.いろんな私を見てもらいたくって。服のイメージ変えてみたんだけど、気に入ってくれる:
I want you to see 
different sides of me. 
I changed my style, 
do you like it?
translations.服の印象変えてみました。こんな感じの私もいいでしょ？:
I tried changing my look. 
This side of me 
isn't bad either, right?
translations.服変えてみたの。清楚な感じを目指したんだけど……。:
I changed my outfit. 
I was aiming for 
a neat and tidy look...
translations.ちょっと失敗かな: It's a bit of a fail.
translations.おとなしめの服装でまとめてみたの。似合うでしょ？:
I put together a more 
subdued outfit. 
It suits me, right?
translations.今日は清楚な寧々さんです。お気に召しまして？:
Today I'm a neat and tidy Nene.
Do you like it？
translations.今日の服、どうかな？ こういうかわいい系って……。:
How's my outfit today？
This kind of cute style is...
translations.かわいい服にしてみたんだけど、正直どう思う？:
I went for a cute outfit today.
Honestly, what do you think？
translations.ふふ。かわいいでしょ、今日の服。:
Hehe. Cute outfit today,
isn't it？
translations.似合わない気がする: I don't think it suits you.
translations.……ちょっとラフすぎるかな？ こういう服装はイヤ？:
...Is it a little too casual？
Do you dislike this look？
translations.どう？ こういう、カジュアルな服のカノジョも悪くないでしょ？:
How is it？ A casual girlfriend
isn't so bad, right？
translations.ねえ。今日みたいなカジュアルな格好も、新鮮な感じしない？:
Hey. Doesn't a casual look
like this feel fresh？
translations.この服、少し大胆だけど……あなたのために用意したんだよ？:
This outfit is a bit bold...
but I got it just for you, y'know？
translations.この服。あなたが喜ぶかな～って。さあ、どう？:
This outfit. I thought it might
make you happy. So, how is it？
translations.今日はセクシーな服にしてみました。あなたの好みに合ってる？:
I tried wearing a sexy
outfit today. Do you
like it？
translations.ありがとう……。ふふ、ドキドキしちゃった。:
Thank you... Hehe, my heart
is pounding a little.
translations.よしよし、いい返事ね。私もこの服、気に入っちゃった。:
Good, good answer.
I've grown to like this
outfit a lot, too.
translations.そう……。じゃあ、今度はもっと頑張るから。:
I see... Well then, I'll
try harder next time.
translations.……残念。もう、次こそ見とれさせちゃうんだから。:
...Too bad. Jeez, next time
I'll make you swoon.
translations.違った？ そっかぁ……あなたの好み、もっと研究しなくちゃ。:
Not your style？ I see...
I'll have to study your
tastes a bit more.
translations.ふーん……いろいろ悩んで決めたのにな……。:
Hmm... And after I spent so
much time deciding, too...
translations.こら、適当に返事しない。次そんな言い方したらお仕置きよ？:
Hey, don't brush it off.
Next time you say that,
I'll have to punish you？
translations.あー、いけないなあ。カノジョの服にはもっと関心持たなきゃダメ。ね？:
Ah, that's no good. You
need to pay more attention
to what your girlfriend
wears. Okay？
translations.……もういい。もっと私のこと見てもらえるように頑張るから。:
...Fine. I'll just have to
try harder so you'll look
at me more.
translations.もう……まだまだ勉強が足りないよ。:
Jeez... You still have a lot
to learn.
translations.ほんとに興味ないの……？ もっと関心もってほしいな。:
Are you really not
interested...？ I want you
to pay a little more
attention to me.
translations.いつも清楚な感じの服を選んでるけど……どうなのかな？:
I usually pick out neat,
modest clothes, but...
what do you think？
translations.このままがいいんじゃない？: I think it's fine as is.
translations.ねえ、私の服装、どう思う？ 違う格好の私も見てみたい？:
Hey, what do you think of
my clothes？ Do you want to
see me in something else？
translations.違う格好も見てみたい: I'd like to see other styles.
translations.最近、気分転換に服を変えてみるのもいいかなって……私の今のファッション、あなたは:
Lately, I've been thinking
of changing my clothes for
a change of pace... What do
you think of my fashion？
translations.ねえ、今日みたいな服、あなたは気に入ってくれてる……？:
Hey, do you like clothes
like the ones I'm wearing
today...？
translations.最近こういうかわいい系の服で攻めてるわけですが、あなたにはちゃんと届いてる？:
Lately I've been going for
these cute outfits, but...
is it working on you？
translations.ね、今日みたいな服ってどうなのかな？ あなたの理想に近づいてる？:
Hey, what do you think of
today's outfit？ Is it getting
closer to your ideal？
translations.少し遠ざかってる、かな: It might be a bit further.
translations.今日みたいな服、あなたは好き？ だったらいいんだけど……。:
Do you like outfits like
the one I'm wearing today？
I hope you do...
translations.好きでも嫌いでもないなあ:
I don't really love it
or hate it.
translations.最近、こういう動きやすい服もいいなって思ってるけど……カレシとしてはどうなのかな:
Lately I've been thinking
clothes that are easy to
move in are nice, but...
What does my boyfriend
think？
translations.ちょっとひっかかる……: I'm not so sure about it...
translations.好きに決めたらいいよ:
You should wear
what you like.
translations.こういう格好の私、あなたはどう思ってる？ あなたの好みに近づきたいもの。:
What do you think of me
dressed like this？ I want
to match your tastes.
translations.そう？ だったらいいの。あなたがそう言ってくれるなら。:
Really？ That's good.
As long as you say so.
translations.うん、わかった。あなたの表情でだいたいわかってたけどね、ふふ▼:
Yeah, I get it. I could
mostly tell from the look
on your face, hehe.▼
translations.了解。ふふ、あなたが喜んでくれるのが一番だもの。:
Got it. Hehe, making you
happy is what matters
most.
translations.そうだったんだ……。私、もっと頑張るから、期待してて。ね？:
I see... I'll try harder
next time, so look forward
to it. Okay？
translations.ふーん……わかった、今後の参考にするね。:
Hmm... Got it. I'll keep
that in mind for next time.
translations.正直でよろしい。あなたの好み、覚えておくね。:
I appreciate the honesty.
I'll remember your tastes.
translations.もう、生返事？ よくないよ、そういうの。:
Jeez, a half-hearted
answer？ That's not good,
you know.
translations.もう少し私のこと、興味持ってほしいなあ……。:
I wish you'd take a little
more interest in me...
translations.今日はいい１日だったね……。: Today was a really good day...
translations.またこうなるといいな。: I hope we can do this again.
translations.ほんとはまだ帰りたくないけど……バイバイ。: I really don't want to go home yet, but... bye-bye.
translations.バイバイ。またデートしような。: Bye-bye. Let's go on another date soon.
translations.今日はありがとう、こんなに楽しくしてくれて。: Thanks for today. You made it so much fun.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のためなら、これくらい……。じゃあね。: For you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, this is nothing... See ya.
translations.ここでお別れだね。ちょっとさびしい？: This is where we part ways. Are you a little lonely？
translations.うん……だからまた誘うよ。: Yeah... That's why I'll ask you out again.
translations.じゃあ、あなたも気をつけて帰ってね。: Well, be careful on your way home, okay？
translations.こんなの、今日だけにしてよ……？: Let's make sure this is only for today, okay...？
translations.あ、まだいた。じゃあね。: Ah, you're still here. See you.
translations.もう一度、顔見ておこうと思って。: I just wanted to see your face one more time.
translations.あと少しだけ、そばにいたいから……。: I just want to stay by your side a little longer...
translations.さあ、こういうときはどうすればいい？: Now, what are you supposed to do at a time like this？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。やり残してることない？: ▲主人公＊▲. Is there anything you forgot to do？
translations.これ以上は、キリがないから……。: We have to stop, or we'll be here forever...
translations.ふぅ……胸がいっぱい。: Phew... My heart is so full.
translations.うん、マイペースマイペース。:
Yeah, just take it at
your own pace.
translations.頑張りすぎたら、ダメだよ？:
Don't push yourself
too hard, okay？
translations.あ、結構できるんだ。見直しちゃった。:
Oh, you're pretty good.
I'm impressed.
translations.疲れたら、寄りかかってもいいからね？:
If you get tired, you can
always lean on me, okay？
translations.たまには先輩に相談してほしいな？:
I'd love it if you came to
your senpai for advice
sometimes, you know？
translations.真剣な顔……。ふふ、教科書に嫉妬しちゃいそう。:
Such a serious face...
Hehe, I might get jealous
of your textbook.
translations.集中力が切れたら、ゆっくり深呼吸３回ね？:
If you lose focus, take
three slow, deep breaths,
okay？
translations.こら。わからないところを、そのままにしないの。:
Hey. Don't just ignore
the parts you don't
understand.
translations.大丈夫。あなたは出来る子だもん。:
You'll be fine. You're
a smart boy, after all.
translations.予習も大事だけど、復習もしっかりね。:
Prepping is important, but
make sure to review, too.
translations.それなら教えてあげられるよ。何でも聞いて？:
I can help you with that.
Just ask me anything, okay？
translations.わからない問題があるなら、一緒に考えてみない？:
If there's a problem you
don't get, want to figure
it out together？
translations.そこで諦めちゃうのかなぁ？ もう少し頑張ってみて？:
Are you giving up already？
Just try a little harder？
translations.勉強ばかりしてると目が疲れるでしょ？ 時々遠くを見ること。いい？:
Your eyes get tired from
studying so much, right？
Rest them by looking into
the distance sometimes？
translations.オススメの参考書、教えてあげようか。:
Want me to recommend
some reference books？
translations.わぁ、それ、力作じゃない？:
Wow, you put a lot of
work into that, didn't you？
translations.個性的な作品だね？ あなたらしいっていうのかな。:
It's a very unique piece,
isn't it？ I guess you
could say it's very 'you'.
translations.ほら、手を抜かない。最後まで頑張れ。:
Hey, no slacking off.
Do your best until the end.
translations.あなたの作品を見てると、なんだかホッとする。:
Looking at your work
somehow puts me at ease.
translations.独特だね？ もちろん、いい意味で。:
It's unique, isn't it？
In a good way, of course.
translations.ふふ、気持ち良さそうに歌うんだね。:
Hehe, you look like you're
having fun singing.
translations.クラス全員で歌ってても、あなたの声、わかるよ？:
Even with the whole class
singing, I can still pick
out your voice, you know？
translations.合唱、他のパートにつられたりしてない？:
Are the other parts
throwing you off in the
chorus？
translations.あ、私もそれ歌ったよ。懐かしいな。:
Ah, I sang that one too.
Brings back memories.
translations.楽譜の音符をずっと見てると、動きだしそうな気がしない？:
If you stare at the notes
long enough, don't they
look like they're moving？
translations.ファイト！ しっかり！:
You can do it!
Stay focused!
translations.これから体育館？ 行ってらっしゃい。:
Heading to the gym now？
Have fun.
translations.こらそこ、列を乱さない！ なんてね。:
Hey you, stay in line!
Just kidding.
translations.忘れ物はない？ タオル貸そうか？:
Did you forget anything？
Want to borrow a towel？
translations.ふざけて怪我なんてしないようにね？:
Don't fool around and
get yourself hurt, okay？
translations.今日も一緒に頑張ろう？:
Let's do our best together
again today, okay？
translations.そっち、大丈夫だった？ 手が足りない時は言ってね。:
Are you doing okay over
there？ Let me know if
you need a hand.
translations.ほら、髪はねてる。身だしなみに気をつけなさい？:
Look, your hair's sticking
up. Pay a little more
attention to how you look？
translations.さっきの対応素早かったね。感心しちゃった。:
You handled that really
quickly. I'm impressed.
translations.そろそろ休憩でしょ？ お客さん少ないから、もう入っちゃっていいよ。:
It's almost time for your
break, right？ It's slow,
so you can go ahead.
translations.ふぅ、今日は回転が早いね。頑張ろ。:
Phew, tables are turning
over fast today.
Let's keep at it.
translations.あなたが頑張ってるのを見ると、すごく励まされるんだ。:
Seeing you work so hard
is really encouraging.
translations.こら、レジでこっそりあくびしてたでしょ。気合でガマンしなさい？:
Hey, I saw you yawning at
the register. You've gotta
power through it, okay？
translations.ほら、笑顔笑顔。あとちょっとだから、ね？:
Come on, smile, smile.
Just a little longer, okay？
translations.そこ、任せてもいいかな？ うん、助かる。:
Can I leave that to you？
Yeah, that helps a lot.
translations.私たちの相性、バッチリだね？:
We're a perfect match,
aren't we？
translations.クセになったら、責任とって\nもらっちゃうから。:
If I get addicted to this,
you'll have to take
responsibility.
translations.あなたの手、安心する。:
Your hands make me feel
so safe.
translations.もっと、してもいいのに。ううん、してほしい、かな。:
You can do it more, you know.
Actually, I think I want
you to.
translations.もう、どんな顔していいかわからなくなっちゃう。:
Jeez, I don't even know what
face I should be making.
translations.いいね、こういうの。恋人って感じがする。:
This is nice. It really
feels like we're a couple.
translations.ふぅ、またドキドキさせられちゃった。:
Phew, you made my heart
race all over again.
translations.残念。もう一息？: Too bad. Just a little more？
translations.あなたの隣、落ち着く。: I feel so calm next to you.
translations.気分良くなっちゃった。: That put me in a good mood.
translations.もう少し近くに感じたいな。:
I want to feel you
a little closer.
translations.んー、今日は調子が悪かったのかな？:
Hmm, were you feeling
a bit off today？
translations.少し、物足りないかも……。:
I might be feeling
a little unsatisfied...
translations.んー、ちょっと寂しいなぁ。: Hmm, I feel a little lonely.
translations.もう……そうじゃないでしょ？:
Jeez... that's not right,
is it？
translations.まだまだ努力が足りないかな？: Do I still need to try harder？
translations.他のこと、考えてたでしょ。:
You were thinking about
something else, weren't you.
translations.私のこと、ちゃんと見てる？: Are you really looking at me？
translations.待ってたのにな？:
I was waiting for it,
you know？
translations.帰るとこ？ 一緒にいい？:
Heading home？
Mind if I join you？
translations.お誘い、謹んでお受けいたします。ふふ▼:
I humbly accept
your invitation. Hehe▼
translations.せっかくだけど、今日は用事があって……。ごめんなさい。:
I'd love to, but I've got
things to do today...
I'm sorry.
translations.そっか……。それじゃ、また。:
I see...
Well, see you later.
translations.ふふ、冗談よ。一緒に帰ってあげる▼:
Hehe, just kidding.
I'll walk home with you▼
translations.んー、バッドタイミング。今日はダメなんだ。:
Mmm, bad timing.
I can't today.
translations.うん、行こう。ふふ、グッドタイミング。:
Sure, let's go.
Hehe, perfect timing.
translations.ごめーん、用事があるの。また誘って？:
Sorr-y, I've got things
to do. Ask me again, okay？
translations.今日はちょっと……。ごめんなさい。:
Today's a bit tough...
I'm sorry.
translations.そうね……。どうしてもって言うなら、いいわよ？:
Well... If you insist,
I suppose I can？
translations.ちょっと寄らなきゃいけないところがあるの。ごめんね。:
There's somewhere I have
to stop by first. Sorry.
translations.もう、不安そうな顔しちゃって。もちろん、いいよ？:
Aw, look at that worried
face. Of course I will？
translations.今日はダメなの。また今度ね？:
I can't today.
Maybe next time, okay？
translations.そうしたいけど……今は、無理。:
I'd like to, but...
not right now.
translations.よーく考えて、出直してらっしゃい。:
Go think long and hard
about it, then come back.
translations.今帰り？ 一緒に帰らない？:
Heading home now？
Want to walk together？
translations.悪い子とは嫌です。:
I don't walk home
with bad boys.
translations.いい子にならなきゃ、帰ってあげない。:
Unless you're a good boy,
I'm not walking with you.
translations.もう帰っちゃったかと思ってた。よければ一緒に帰らない？:
I thought you'd already
left. Want to walk home
together, if you'd like？
translations.もちろんいいよ、一緒に帰ろう。:
Of course. Let's walk
home together.
translations.ねぇ、私と一緒に帰りたくない？:
Hey, don't you want to
walk home with me？
translations.もちろん、一緒に帰りたい。:
Of course, I'd love to
walk home with you.
translations.うん、それなら帰ってあげるとしますか。:
Hehe, well then, I suppose
I can walk you home.
translations.そうなの？ 寧々さんと帰れないなんて、もったいないなあ。:
Really？ Missing out on
a walk with Nene-san...
what a waste.
translations.会えちゃった。一緒に帰りましょ。:
Look who it is!
Let's walk home together.
translations.うん。ふふ、嬉しそうな顔しちゃって▼:
Yeah. Hehe, look at that
happy look on your face▼
translations.あん、残念。次はきっとね？:
Aww, what a shame.
Next time for sure, okay？
translations.おはよう。調子はいかが？:
Good morning.
How are you feeling？
translations.よかった。それじゃ、行きましょ。:
Glad to hear it.
Well then, let's go.
translations.こら、眠そうな顔してるぞ。:
Hey now, you look
awfully sleepy.
translations.そうだよ。シャキッとなさい。:
You do!
Snap out of it now.
translations.さて、今日も張り切って行きますか。:
Well, let's give it our
all today too, shall we？
translations.セーブせずに電源切ったんだ……。残念。:
So you shut it off
without saving...
What a shame.
translations.セーブせずに電源切ったね。それがいけないことだって知ってた？:
You turned it off without
saving, didn't you？ Did you
know you shouldn't do that？
translations.こら。セーブせずに電源切ったらダメじゃない？:
Hey now. You know you
can't just shut it off
without saving, right？
translations.セーブせずに電源を切らない。一度言われたらわかることでしょ？:
Don't shut it off without
saving. You should know
better after being told once,
right？
translations.……セーブせずに電源を切るような人、嫌いになっちゃうかもな～？:
...I might stop liking
someone who shuts it off
without saving, you know~？
translations.またセーブしないで電源を切るなんて。勘違いじゃ済まされないよ。:
Shutting it off without
saving again... You can't
pass it off as an accident.
translations.自分が何をしたかわかってる、よね？ 何回もセーブせずに電源切るなんて……ひどいよ:
You know what you did,
don't you？ Shutting it off
without saving so many
times... That's mean.
translations.セーブしないで電源切らないでって、何度も言ったよね？:
I've told you so many
times not to shut it off
without saving, haven't I？
translations.またセーブしないで電源切って……こんなに悲しいこと、しないで。:
Shutting it off without
saving again... Please don't
do things that hurt me.
translations.そう、だな……「もうしません、許してください」って言って、そしたら、許しちゃうか:
Let's see... Say,
"I won't do it again,
please forgive me." If you
do, I'll let you off.
translations.どうしても許してほしかったら、「もうしません、許してください」って、本気で言って:
If you really want me to
forgive you, say, "I won't
do it again, please
forgive me." And mean it.
translations.いい？ 「もうしません、許してください」って言うの。そしたら、許すから。:
Listen, okay？ Say,
"I won't do it again,
please forgive me." Then
I'll forgive you.
translations.だんまりは通じません。:
Staying silent won't
work on me.
translations.「もうしません、許してください」。本心からね。:
"I won't do it again,
please forgive me."
And really mean it, okay？
translations.「もうしません、許してください」。もう、私が言ってもしょうがないでしょ。:
"I won't do it again,
please forgive me." Jeez,
it doesn't count if I say
it, does it？
translations.「もうしません、許してください」、でしょ？:
It's "I won't do it again,
please forgive me," right？
translations.ごまかされないよ？ はい、もう一回。:
You can't fool me, you
know？ Come on, one more
time.
translations.ダメダメ、そうじゃないでしょ？:
Nope, nope! That wasn't
it at all, was it？
translations.……びっくりしちゃった。そう来るなんて……ね。:
...You took me by surprise.
I didn't expect you to
say that...
translations.そう来たか……。仕方ないなあ。:
Oh, that's how it is...？
Guess I have no choice.
translations.もう……参っちゃうなあ。私の負けかな？:
Geez... You're too much.
I guess you win this round？
translations.その言葉を待ってたの。:
That's what I wanted
to hear.
translations.よしよし。ちゃんと言えたね。:
There, there. You said it
properly.
translations.二度としないで。私だって、こんなこと言いたくないから。:
Don't ever do it again.
I don't like having to say
these things either.
translations.次こんなことがあったら……わかるよね？:
If this happens again...
You know what'll happen,
right？
translations.反省したら、きちんと行動で見せてね。:
If you're really sorry,
show me with your actions,
okay？
translations.私を悲しませないで。セーブせずに電源切らないで……。:
Don't make me sad.
Please don't turn it off
without saving...
translations.セーブしないで電源切った、そこのあなた。お仕置き、クセになっちゃった？:
Hey you, turning it off
without saving. Did you get
a taste for punishment？
translations.信じてたのに……。もう、セーブせずに電源切ったりしないって。:
And I trusted you...
When you said you wouldn't
shut it off without saving
anymore.
translations.ね……こう言ってくれたら許してあげる。「ネネが一番大好き」。ちゃんと言える？:
Hey... I'll forgive you
if you say this: "I love
Nene the most!" Can you
say it properly？
translations.許してほしい？ なら……「ネネが一番大好き」って言うこと！:
You want my forgiveness？
Then... say, "I love Nene
the most!"
translations.本当に反省してるなら、「ネネが一番大好き」って言って。じゃないと、ダメ。:
If you're really sorry,
say "I love Nene the most."
Otherwise, no deal.
translations.あなたが強情だと、私も許せないじゃない……。:
If you're going to be this
stubborn, I won't be able
to forgive you either...
translations.自分が悪いって、わかってるんでしょ？:
You know you're in the
wrong, don't you？
translations.ごめん、よく聞こえなくて……。:
Sorry, I couldn't
quite catch that...
translations.違うでしょ？ はい、もう一回。:
That's not right, is it？
Alright, one more time.
translations.もっとハキハキと。もう一度お願い。:
Speak up clearly, okay？
One more time, please.
translations.えっ……ごめん、よくわからない……。:
Huh...？ Sorry,
I didn't quite get that...
translations.どういうつもりなのかな？:
What are you trying to do,
hm？
translations.もう……何たくらんでるの？:
Geez...
What are you plotting now？
translations.ちゃんと言ってくれたね。私もひと安心。:
You actually said it.
Now I can breathe easy.
translations.うんうん。それでいいんだよ？:
Mm-hmm.
That's more like it, okay？
translations.今の声、しっかり胸に届きました。:
I heard that loud and clear,
straight to my heart.
translations.あとは「好きだよ」って３回言ってくれたら、ぜんぶ水に流してあげる。:
Now, if you say 'I love you'
three times, I'll let you
off the hook completely.
translations.その調子で、今度は「好きだよ」って３回言って。:
Just like that!
Now say 'I love you'
three times for me.
translations.次は「好きだよ」って３回言って。恥ずかしがらず、真剣に。:
Next, say 'I love you'
three times. No being shy—
I want you to mean it.
translations.これで最後だから……。:
This is the last time,
okay...？
translations.待たせるなんて、失礼じゃない？:
Isn't it rude to keep
a girl waiting？
translations.言ってくれないと、泣いちゃうかも。:
If you don't say it,
I might just cry.
translations.けじめはつけなきゃ。:
You have to make this right,
you know.
translations.ちゃんと言えるまで、ね。:
Until you say it properly,
okay？
translations.そんな謝り方じゃ、機嫌は直りません。:
An apology like that
won't cheer me up at all!
translations.ありがとう。じゃあ、仲直りしよ。:
Thank you.
Now, let's make up.
translations.今の言葉、本心だって信じてるからね？:
I'm trusting that you
really meant that, okay？
translations.あなたのしたことなら、私は受け止めるつもりだから。もう、やめてね。:
I'm willing to accept whatever
you do, but... please,
don't do that again.
translations.思い出を消したら後悔が残るの。そんなのイヤでしょ？:
If you erase our memories,
all that's left is regret.
You don't want that, right？
translations.二度と、二人の思い出を消したりしないで。約束。:
Don't ever erase our memories
again. Promise me.
translations.信じてるんだよ？ あなたのこと……。:
I really do believe in you,
you know...？
translations.ちょっと。あなたのカノジョ、怒ってます。:
Excuse me.
Your girlfriend is mad right now.
translations.あんまり反省してる感じが伝わらないなぁ。罰として、愛情たっぷりの言葉をたくさん言:
I'm not really feeling
your remorse here.
As punishment, you have to say
lots of sweet, loving words!
translations.そうねぇ……“あいしてる”っていっぱい言って？:
Let's see...
Say 'I love you' over and
over for me, okay？
translations.誠意を込めて“ゴメンなさい”って言うこと。:
Say 'I'm sorry,'
and really put your heart
into it this time.
translations.じゃあ……“ねね様ばんざーい”って言ってもらおうかな？ ふふっ。:
In that case... how about
'All hail Lady Nene!'？
Hehe♪
translations.ほら、ちゃんと言えるでしょ？:
Come on, you can say it
properly, can't you？
translations.うん、上手に言えました。ほめてあげる▼:
Yep, you said that so well.
Good boy▼
translations.反省してるなら、それを文章で見せてもらおっかな。:
If you're really sorry, maybe
you can show me in writing.
translations.そんな字じゃ伝わらないよ……。:
With handwriting like that,
I can't feel your sincerity...
translations.頑張って書いて。:
Come on,
do your best to write it.
translations.できたね♪ 反省してるって信じてあげる▼:
All done♪
I'll believe that you're sorry.▼
translations.あっ！ 新記録が出たよ。すごーい♪:
Ah! A new record!
That's amazing♪
translations.ダメ、反省が伝わらない。ほんとに反省してるなら、私の目を見て気持ちを伝えてくれる:
No good, I can't feel it.
If you're really sorry,
look into my eyes and show me
how you feel, okay？
translations.そう、もっと見て。:
That's it...
Look at me some more.
translations.あなたの瞳に、私が映ってる……。:
I can see myself
reflected in your eyes...
translations.あ、こらぁ。動いちゃダメでしょ。:
Ah, hey now!
No moving, okay？
translations.まばたきも禁止！ ……は、さすがに冗談だけどね。:
No blinking either!
...Just kidding, of course.
translations.はい、ちゃんと伝わりました♪:
Alright, it came through
loud and clear♪
translations.ねえ、新記録達成だよ！ これからも、もっと私を見てね？:
Hey, that's a new record!
Keep looking at me like that
from now on, okay？
translations.ギブアップだなんて……もう。もうしないって約束してね？:
Giving up already...？ Geez.
Promise you won't do it
again, okay？
translations.時間切れだけど……今回は許してあげる。もうしちゃダメだからね？:
Time's up, but...
I'll forgive you this time.
Don't do it again, okay？
translations.楽しいと、いつの間にか着いちゃうな。:
Time flies when you're
having fun, we're here.
translations.本当ね。でもいいことじゃない？:
It really does.
Isn't that a good thing？
translations.あわてなくていいよ、時間はまだあるから。:
No need to rush,
we've still got time.
translations.まだ一緒にいたいけど、そうもいかないよね。:
I want to stay together longer,
but I guess we can't.
translations.●もだけど……そろそろ帰らないとね。:
Same here, ●...
but we should head back soon.
translations.もっと一緒にいたいけど……もう時間なんだ。:
I want to stay longer too...
but it's time.
translations.ごめん、聞こえてた。もう……残念。:
Sorry, I actually heard you.
Aw... such a shame.
translations.このへんで帰らないと。:
We should head back
around now.
translations.そうなの？ あーあ……あっという間だね。:
Really？ Aw, man...
That went by so fast.
translations.あ……もうタイムリミットかな？:
Ah... is our time
up already？
translations.あ、そうよね。行きましょ？:
Ah, you're right.
Shall we go？
translations.そうね。今日はここまでにしておかなくちゃ。:
Yeah. We'd better wrap
things up for today.
translations.あのさ、そろそろ帰る時間なんだけど……。:
Hey, it's about time to
head back...
translations.わかってる。さ、帰りましょ？:
I know. Come on,
shall we head back？
translations.私、あなたにリードしてほしいな。:
I'd love for you to
take the lead.
translations.じゃあ、あなたの選んだところにしよ？:
Then let's go wherever
you pick, okay？
translations.どこがいいの？ 言ってみて？:
Where do you wanna go？
Tell me？
translations.迷っちゃうな。決めてもらっていい？:
I can't decide.
Could you pick for us？
translations.こうやって考えるのも楽しいね。:
Just thinking about it
like this is fun, too.
translations.うん。その調子で優しくリードすること。:
Yeah. Keep leading me
gently, just like that.
translations.ほかの場所にも行ってみない？:
Want to check out
somewhere else？
translations.二人で楽しめるなら、どこでも。:
Anywhere's fine, as long as
we have fun together.
translations.えーっと、次に向かうのは……。:
Let's see, where we're
heading next is...
translations.カレシの腕の見せ所。:
Time for my boyfriend
to show what he's got.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、次はどこに行きたい？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, where do you want
to go next？
translations.じゃあ……あなたの選んだ場所に行きたいな。:
Well then... I want to go
wherever you choose.
translations.いいのある？ どれがいいかな。:
See anything good？
Which one should we see？
translations.どれ観るか、迷うな……。:
Hard to choose which one
to watch...
translations.私も。ここはあなたが男らしく決めちゃって。ね？:
Same here. How about you be
a man and make the call？ Okay？
translations.どの映画がいい？:
Which movie
do you want to see？
translations.どれも面白そう。あなたの好みで選んで。:
They all look interesting.
Pick whichever you like.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はどれが観たい？:
Which one do you
want to see, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私はいいよ……選んで？:
I'm fine with whatever...
You choose, okay？
translations.●が観たいのは……。:
The one ●
wants to see is...
translations.どれ？ 私の好みも考えてくれた？:
Which one？ Did you think
about what I'd like, too？
translations.どの映画が面白いかな……。:
I wonder which movie
would be good...
translations.じっくり考えてから決めてね。:
Take your time and think
about it before deciding, okay？
translations.観たい映画はある？:
Is there any movie
you want to see？
translations.いいよ……どれでも。:
I'm fine either way...
Whichever you pick.
translations.つまんない映画だったら、お仕置きだから。:
If it's boring, though,
you're getting punished.
translations.早く決めてほしいなあ。:
I kind of hope you
make up your mind soon.
translations.ふぅ……。やっぱり面白かったな。:
Phew... That really was
a lot of fun.
translations.もう１本観たくなっちゃったかな。いい？:
I think I kinda want to
watch another one. Can we？
translations.うん、もう１本観ちゃおっか！:
Yeah, let's watch
another one, then！
translations.私も。……もう１本観て行く？:
Me too. ...Wanna stay
for one more？
translations.もう１本、観たくなってきたな……。:
Now I'm starting to feel
like watching another one...
translations.あのさ、どうせだからもう１本……。:
Hey, since we're here,
how about one more...？
translations.そう？ じゃ、観ちゃおっか。:
Really？ Well, let's go
ahead and do it, then.
translations.もう１本観て行くっていうのは？:
How about staying to
watch another one？
translations.しょうがないなあ。付き合ってあげる。:
Oh, all right.
I'll keep you company.
translations.うん、私もそこがいいなって思ってたの。:
Yeah, I was thinking
that'd be good, too.
translations.賛成。楽しめそうだよね。:
I'm with you.
Looks like it'll be fun.
translations.うん、私もそこでいいと思う。:
Yeah, sounds good
to me, too.
translations.ちょっと……ううん、行ってみようか？:
That's a bit... No,
let's give it a shot？
translations.そこ？ 別にいいけど……。:
There？ I don't mind,
I guess, but...
translations.……期待はしていいのかな。:
...I can get my hopes up,
right？
translations.あ、私も。お昼にしよっか。:
Oh, me too.
Wanna get some lunch？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。そろそろランチタイムじゃないかな？:
▲主人公＊▲. Isn't it about
time for lunch？
translations.じゃあ、いったん休憩。ご飯食べに行きましょ。:
Let's take a quick break,
then. Time to get some food.
translations.お腹すいてない？ 食べに行く？:
Aren't you hungry？
Wanna go grab a bite？
translations.ストップ。もうお昼なんだからそろそろ食事にしよ？:
Hold on! It's lunchtime,
so let's go eat, okay？
translations.ごめん、今、お腹鳴ったかも……。:
Sorry, I think my stomach
just growled...
translations.仕方ないなあ。じゃあお昼ね。:
Guess there's no helping it.
Lunch it is, then!
translations.ひと休みして落ち着きたいな……。いい？:
I want to take a break
and catch my breath... Okay？
translations.いいよ。じゃ、喫茶店かな。:
Sure. Let's find
a cafe, then.
translations.ね、のどかわかない？ ちょっと休みたいし。:
Aren't you thirsty？
I'd love to rest a bit, too.
translations.喉かわいてきちゃった。あなたは？:
I'm getting kind of thirsty.
How about you？
translations.そうだな……お茶にしようか。:
Yeah... Want to grab
a drink somewhere？
translations.ああ、お茶にしよっか？: Yeah, want to grab a drink？
translations.……お茶にしたいな、私。:
...I'd really love
to grab a drink.
translations.……ふう。ちょっと座って落ち着きたいな。:
...Phew. I'd love to sit down
and relax for a bit.
translations.あ、じゃあ喫茶店行こうか？:
Oh, want to head
to a cafe, then？
translations.ね、そろそろお腹すいたんじゃない？:
Hey, aren't you getting
hungry by now？
translations.今日は二人で夕食、って思ってたんだけど？:
I thought we'd have dinner
together today, though？
translations.ところでね、夕食はどこにしよう？:
By the way, where should we
go for dinner？
translations.もうそんな時間？ じゃ、行こう。:
Is it that time already？
All right, let's go.
translations.あのね……今日はご飯食べないの？:
Um... Aren't we having
dinner today？
translations.ねえ、何か忘れてない？ 時計、時計。:
Hey, aren't you forgetting
something？ Look at the time!
translations.えっと……夕食だよね。食べて行こっか。:
Um... dinner, right？
Let's go grab a bite.
translations.お腹がすいたまま帰るのはイヤだな……。:
I'd hate to head home
on an empty stomach...
translations.しゃべってると、すぐだね。ほら、もう到着。:
Chatting makes the time fly.
Look, we're already here!
translations.着いたね。なにを頼むか決めてたりする？:
We're here. Do you know
what you're getting？
translations.このお店？ 入ろう？:
This place？
Shall we go in？
translations.お腹すいちゃったね。:
We've gotten pretty hungry,
haven't we？
translations.わがまま、言ってもいい？ デート、もっと続けたい……。:
Can I be a little selfish？
I don't want our date to end...
translations.ね、私はもう少し時間作れるよ？:
Hey, I could stay out
a little longer, you know？
translations.まだ、離れたくないな……ね？:
I don't want to leave you
just yet... Please？
translations.ね……まだ、どこかに連れてってくれる？:
Hey... Will you take me
somewhere else, too？
translations.あら。時計、止まっちゃったみたい。まだきっと時間あるよね？:
Oh my. Looks like my watch
stopped. We still have time,
right？
translations.いいよね、もっと一緒にいても。:
We can stay together
a little longer, right？
translations.●、もうちょっと▲姉ヶ崎＊▲といたいな。:
●, I want to stay
with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ a bit longer.
translations.かわいいこと言っちゃって。じゃあ……付き合っちゃう。:
Look at you, being sweet.
Well... I guess I'll keep
you company.
translations.とりあえず、場所を移そっか。:
For now, let's head
somewhere else.
translations.デート……続けてもいい？:
Can we... keep
our date going？
translations.もう。あなたのわがまま、断れるわけないでしょ？ どこ行くの？:
Geez. Like I could ever
turn you down？
Where are we going？
translations.……そうだよね。都合あるもんね。:
...Right. You've got
things to do, after all.
translations.……困らせちゃった？ だったらいいよ。:
...Did I put you
on the spot？ Don't worry
about it, then.
translations.了解。楽しい時間にしてね？:
Got it. Make sure you
show me a good time, okay？
translations.任せといて。よーし、出発！:
Leave it to me!
Alright, let's head out!
translations.ここだと遅くなるか……。こっちこそごめん。:
Going there would take
too long, huh...
Sorry about that.
translations.そこは……今日はおあずけかな？:
Maybe we should save that
place for another day？
translations.あ……時間か。もう遅いもんな。:
Ah... the time, huh.
It's already pretty late.
translations.そうね……あ、でも時間……。:
That's true... Ah, but
the time...
translations.あっ……そっか、ここだと遠いな。:
Ah... right, that place
is pretty far.
translations.……ごめん。やっぱり私、帰らないと。:
...Sorry. I really do
have to head home.
translations.そこ？ ……悪いけど、さっきの話、ナシにしていい？:
There？ ...Sorry, but can we
call off what I just said？
translations.うーん……やっぱり今日は帰ろうか？:
Hmm... Maybe we should
just head home for today？
translations.待たせちゃったね。雨、濡れてない？ 大丈夫？:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Did you get wet in the rain？
Are you okay？
translations.待たせちゃった？ 雪の中、寒かったでしょ？:
Did I keep you waiting？
Must've been cold out
in the snow, right？
translations.ううん。今来たとこだから。: Nah, I just got here myself.
translations.時間ぴったりだね。偉い偉い。:
Right on time.
Good boy, good boy.
translations.雨の中で待たせるわけにはいかないからね。:
Couldn't make you wait
in the rain, after all.
translations.良かった、時間通りだね。雪だから少し遅れるかもって思ってたんだ。:
Glad you made it on time.
I thought you might be late
because of the snow.
translations.ちょっと早めに出といてよかったよ。:
Glad I left a little early,
then.
translations.ごめん、お待たせ。濡れなかった？:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Did you get wet？
translations.ううん、大丈夫だよ。雨、嫌いじゃないし。行こう。:
No, I'm fine.
I don't mind the rain anyway.
Let's go.
translations.雪の中待たせちゃって、ごめん。:
Sorry for making you wait
in the snow.
translations.ううん。雪を見てたから、飽きなかったよ。:
No, it's okay.
I was watching the snow,
so I didn't get bored.
translations.ごめん、雨の中で待たせちゃって！ ……怒ってる？:
Sorry to make you wait in
the rain! ...Are you mad？
translations.うん、すごく怒ってる。……嘘、事故とかじゃなくて良かった。:
Yep, furious. ...Just kidding.
I'm just glad you didn't get
in an accident or anything.
translations.遅いよ。寒かったんだから。雪に埋もれちゃうかと思った。:
You're late! I was so cold.
I thought I was gonna get
buried in the snow.
translations.ほんとにごめん！ 寒かったよね。:
I'm really sorry!
You must've been freezing.
translations.（あ、そういえば今日ってデートじゃないか！ まさか……）:
(Wait, wasn't our date today？！
Don't tell me...)
translations.私、遅いから、心配になって来ちゃった……。ねえ、どうしたの、大丈夫？:
You were so late, I got
worried and came over...
Hey, what's wrong？ Are you okay？
translations.今日は何の日でしょう？: Do you know what today is？
translations.ごめん……すぐに準備するから！:
I'm sorry!
I'll get ready right away!
translations.いいよ、あわてなくても。でも次からは気をつけること。ね。:
It's okay, no need to rush.
Just make sure you're more
careful next time, okay？
translations.ほらほら。寝癖がついてるよ。:
Look at you.
You've got bedhead.
translations.ごめん。もう出られるから。: Sorry. I'm ready to go now.
translations.うん、大丈夫。じゃあ行こっか。:
Yeah, all good.
Shall we go, then？
translations.（ちょっと早かったかな……あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、もう来てる）:
(Maybe I got here a bit early...
Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s already here.)
translations.（●を待ってる▲姉ヶ崎＊▲か、なんかいいな。少し見てよう）:
(Waiting for ●...
Seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ like this is
kind of nice.
I'll watch for a bit.)
translations.やだ、笑顔の練習見てたの？:
No way, were you watching me
practice my smile？
translations.（そんなことしてたのか……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、かわいいな）:
(So that's what she was doing...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is so cute.)
translations.すいません、アンケートにご協力いただけませんか？:
Excuse me, would you mind
filling out a quick survey？
translations.えっと、今、待ちあわせを……。:
Um, I'm actually waiting
for someone...
translations.あちらでもう少し詳しいアンケートを……。:
We have a more detailed survey
just over that way...
translations.いや、待ちあわせをしてるので……。:
No, really, I'm meeting
someone here...
translations.すみません。これから出かけるので、失礼します。さ、行こう！:
Sorry, we're on our way
somewhere. Excuse us.
Come on, let's go!
translations.……助かったよ。丁寧に頼まれると断りにくくて。:
...Thanks, you saved me.
It's hard to turn them down
when they're so polite.
translations.もう、人がいいんだから。……それもあなたの魅力だけど。:
Geez, you're way too nice.
...Though that's part of
your charm, too.
translations.お待たせ。行こうか。:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Shall we go？
translations.うん。あれ？ あそこにいるのって……生活指導の大山先生？:
Yeah. Huh？ Isn't that...
Mr. Oyama, the guidance
counselor, over there？
translations.ごめん、人違いだったみたい。そんなにびっくりしなくてもいいのに。:
Sorry, looks like it was
someone else. You didn't
have to freak out so much.
translations.心臓が止まるかと思った……。:
I thought my heart was
gonna stop...
translations.もう、何も悪いことなんて、してないでしょ？:
Geez, it's not like we're
doing anything bad, right？
translations.同時だね。先に着いて待ってるつもりだったのにな。:
Right at the same time, huh？
And here I wanted to get here
first and wait for you.
translations.遅れないでよかったよ。: I'm just glad I wasn't late.
translations.ふふっ、……最近は面白い着こなしが流行ってるの？:
Fufu... Is that interesting
new look in style these days？
translations.素早い返答、よろしい。よし、許してあげる。:
Quick answer, very good.
Alright, you're forgiven.
translations.いえ、こちらこそ……って、あれ？:
No, I'm sorry too...
Wait, huh？
translations.なんだ、ふたりとも遅れてたんだね。ふふ、おかしい。:
What do you know, we were
both late. Fufu, that's funny.
translations.どっちも待たなくてすんだんだし、結果オーライかな？:
Neither of us had to wait,
so all's well that ends well,
I guess？
translations.お待たせ！ あれ、どうしたの？:
Sorry I'm late!
Wait, what's wrong？
translations.もしかして、泣いてる？ えっと、遅れて本当にごめん！:
Wait, are you crying？
Um, I'm really sorry for
being late!
translations.やだ、もう。目にゴミが入っただけ。そんなにあわてちゃって……かわいいんだから。:
Oh, stop it. I just got
something in my eye.
Freaking out like that...
You're so cute.
translations.遅刻した天罰かな？:
Divine punishment for being
late, maybe？
translations.ごめん、待たせちゃったよな。:
Sorry, I kept you waiting,
didn't I？
translations.もう、そんな顔して。お説教って思ったけど、無理みたい……。:
Geez, look at that face.
I was gonna lecture you,
but I just can't...
translations.（やばい！ 急がないと……急いでも遅刻だけど）:
(Crap! I have to hurry...
Even if I do, I'm still late,
though.)
translations.チャイムを鳴らそうと思ったら……。:
I was just about to ring
the doorbell, and then...
translations.だめ、大丈夫じゃない。: Nope, not all right at all.
translations.ふふ。今日は罰として、いっぱい楽しませてもらうよ。:
Hehe. As punishment, 
you'd better show me 
a really good time today.
translations.（うわっ、もうこんな時間か！ やばい！）:
(Whoa, is it that late already?! 
Crap, this is bad!)
translations.カノジョを待たせる、極悪非道なカレシの顔を見に来ました。:
I came to see the face 
of the terrible boyfriend 
who kept his girlfriend waiting.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ ごめん！ すぐ用意するから。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲! I'm sorry! 
I'll be ready in a second.
translations.しょうがないな。罪を憎んでカレシを憎まず。ね。:
Oh, all right. 
Hate the sin, not the boyfriend. 
Right？
translations.せっかくのデートなのに曇り空か。ちょっと残念。:
It's our date, and it's cloudy... 
Kind of a bummer.
translations.ごめんね、待たせちゃった？\n紫外線対策してたら、時間なくなっちゃって。:
Sorry, did I keep you waiting？
I ran out of time 
doing my UV protection.
translations.ううん。全然待ってないけど、紫外線対策？ 曇りだよ？:
No, not at all, but... 
UV protection？ It's cloudy though？
translations.紫外線量は晴れてても曇ってても、同じなのです。:
Sunny or cloudy, the amount 
of UV rays is the same, you know.
translations.あ、ごめんね。ちょっとびっくりしちゃって。:
Ah, sorry. 
I just got a little startled.
translations.お待たせ。急に雨が強くなってきたな。:
Sorry to keep you waiting. 
The rain's really picking up.
translations.何？ 雨の音で聞こえにくいよ。:
What？ It's hard to hear you 
over the rain.
translations.そんなに近寄らなくてもっ。: You didn't have to get that close!
translations.うん、ありがとう。服……濡れちゃったね。:
Yeah, thanks. 
Your clothes... got wet, though.
translations.平気平気。ちょっとだけだよ。すぐ乾くって。:
I'm fine, really. Just a bit. 
It'll dry in no time.
translations.雪ふってるし、さすがに冷えるね……。:
It's snowing out, 
so it really is chilly...
translations.うん、私はこたつで丸くなる猫派。あなたは？ 犬派？:
Yeah, I'm team cat, 
curling up in a kotatsu. 
How about you？ Team dog？
translations.●？ ●は……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒にこたつに入ってたいな。:
●？ ● would rather... 
be in the kotatsu with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.もう、調子いいぞ。……でも、模範解答かな。:
Geez, smooth talker. 
...Still, full marks for that answer.
translations.お待たせ……口開けてどうしたの？:
Sorry to keep you waiting... 
Why's your mouth open？
translations.せっかくの雪だし味見でもしようかなって。:
It's snowing, so I thought 
I'd try catching some on my tongue.
translations.はは、赤ちゃんみたいな怒られ方だな。:
Haha, you're scolding me 
like a little baby.
translations.あなたが、子供みたいなことするから。雪がきれいなのは見た目だけなの。すぐお腹壊し:
Because you're acting like a kid! 
Snow only looks clean on the outside. 
You'll get a stomachache!
translations.（やけに実感こもってるな。さては……）:
(She sounds like she's speaking 
from experience. Don't tell me...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、お待たせ……。すごい風だね、大丈夫？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, sorry to keep you waiting... 
The wind is crazy, are you okay？
translations.びっくりした。……今、何か期待したでしょう？:
That surprised me. 
...Were you hoping for 
something just now？
translations.残念でした。強風対策はばっちりです。:
Too bad for you. 
My wind protection is flawless.
translations.（まあいっか。他の男に見られるのはイヤだからな）:
(Oh well. Not like I want 
other guys looking anyway.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、お待たせ。:
Sorry to keep you waiting, 
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.風でハンカチが飛んでいっちゃった……。:
The wind blew my 
handkerchief right away...
translations.はあ、はあ……はい、見つかったよ。:
Hah, hah... 
Here, I found it.
translations.ごめん、汗かいちゃったね。拾ってくれたハンカチで……、あ、今汚れちゃったよね。:
Sorry, you worked up a sweat. 
Here, use the handk—wait, 
it just got dirty, didn't it.
translations.気にしないで。今日は風が気持ちいいからさ。:
Don't worry about it. 
The breeze feels nice 
today anyway.
translations.ふーん……すぐに感想言えないんだ？:
Hmm... Can't even tell me 
what you think right away？
translations.どうかと思うな: I'm not so sure about it
translations.いいよ、もう。ごめんね、困らせちゃって。:
Never mind, then. 
Sorry for putting you 
on the spot.
translations.これ、ありがとね。さっそくつけてみたよ。:
Thanks for this. 
I put it on right away.
translations.これ、覚えてる？ 今はもう私のお気に入り。:
Do you remember this？ 
It's one of my favorites now.
translations.少し雰囲気を変えようと思って。どう……かな？:
I thought I'd change up 
my look a bit. What do... 
you think？
translations.もう、おおげさだよ。でも……うれしいな。:
Geez, you're exaggerating. 
Still... it makes me happy.
translations.そっか、ありがとう。うれしい。:
I see, thank you. 
I'm really glad.
translations.全然、興味ないんだ。残念。:
Not interested at all, huh. 
Too bad.
translations.どうしたの？ 黙っちゃって……。:
What's wrong？ 
You went completely quiet...
translations.なに、どうかしたの？: What is it, did something happen？
translations.違う髪型に変えてみない？: Why not try a new hairstyle？
translations.違う髪の色もいいんじゃない？: How about a different hair color？
translations.髪の長さ、変えてみたら？: How about changing your hair length？
translations.そうだね。あなたがそう言うなら、変えてみようかな。:
Yeah. If that's what you say, 
maybe I'll change it.
translations.今の髪、けっこう気に入ってるんだけどな……少し考えさせて。:
I actually really like my hair 
right now, though... 
Let me think about it.
translations.気になることがあるんだったら、遠慮しないでね？:
If there's something on your mind, 
don't hold back, okay？
translations.どうしたのかな？ 言いたいことははっきり言うの、ね。:
What's the matter？ 
Just say what's on your mind, 
okay？
translations.変えたばっかりなんだけどな……まさか気づいてないとか？:
I just changed it, though... 
Don't tell me you didn't notice？
translations.言いにくいんだったら、無理しないでいいよ？:
If it's hard to say, 
you don't have to force yourself, 
okay？
translations.ね、髪伸びたと思わない？ 切ろうかどうか迷ってるんだけど、どうかな？:
Hey, don't you think my hair's 
grown？ I'm torn on whether 
to cut it, what do you think？
translations.切らないでほしい: I'd rather you not cut it
translations.切ってほしいかな: I think you should cut it
translations.そう？ あなたがそう言うなら、このまま伸ばそっかな。:
Really？ Well, if you say so,
maybe I'll keep growing it out.
translations.うん、わかった。なんとなく、そんな気がしてたの。:
Yeah, got it.
I had a feeling you'd say that.
translations.どうしたの？ 私に興味ない？:
What's wrong？
Not interested in me？
translations.髪型変えてみたんだけど、どうかな？ よく見てほしいな。:
I changed my hair,
what do you think？
Take a good look, okay？
translations.髪の色変えたの気づいてくれた？ じゃあ、感想、聞かせてほしいな。:
Did you notice I dyed my hair？
Come on, tell me what you think.
translations.その色は似合わないな: That color doesn't really suit you.
translations.ちょっと、冒険してみました。どうかな？:
I went a little bold with it.
What do you think？
translations.失敗でしょ……: It's kind of a fail, isn't it...
translations.良かったぁ。ちょっと心配だったの。:
Whew, good.
I was a little worried.
translations.そっか……残念。でもありがとう、はっきり言ってくれて。:
I see... Bummer.
Thanks for being honest
with me, though.
translations.……そんな困った顔しないで。ごめんね。:
...Don't look so troubled.
Sorry about that.
translations.ねぇ、お昼ごはんにしよ。もう、おなか空いちゃった。:
Hey, let's get some lunch.
I'm already starving.
translations.もう、こんな時間、晩ごはんどうしようか。:
It's this late already？
What should we do for dinner？
translations.そういえば、おなか空かない？:
Come to think of it,
aren't you hungry？
translations.うん、私もそこがいいと思ってたの。:
Yeah, I was thinking
there too.
translations.うん、そうだね。軽く。:
Yeah, good idea.
Just something light.
translations.あ、ほら。空が明るくなってきたよ。:
Oh, look.
The sky's brightening up.
translations.あれ、曇ってきちゃったね。雨にならないといいけど。:
Huh, it got cloudy.
Hope it doesn't rain.
translations.あ……雪。冷えると思った。少し得した気分だね。:
Ah... snow.
No wonder it felt so cold.
Feels like a nice little treat.
translations.あれ、雨降ってきたみたいだよ。:
Huh, looks like it started
raining.
translations.ほんとだ。しょうがない……行き先変えようか。:
You're right. Oh well...
Should we go somewhere else？
translations.あなたがそこがいいなら……いいよ。:
If that's where you want...
Sure, okay.
translations.もしかして？ ふふ、言わなくていいよ。:
Could it be？
Hehe, you don't have to say it.
translations.ダーメ……なんて言わないよ。:
Nooo way... Just kidding,
I won't say that.
translations.ふーん。そうなんだ？ でも今はダーメ。:
Hmm. Is that so？
No way, not right now〜
translations.残念、今はダメ。また今度ね。:
Too bad, not right now.
Some other time, okay？
translations.うん。でもね、ほら、人が見てるから……ね？:
Yeah. But look,
people are watching...
okay？
translations.あー、もしかして……でもダメ。人が見てるでしょ。:
Ah, you don't mean...
Nope, not happening.
People are watching.
translations.ほら……人が見てるよ。よい子は我慢、ね。:
Look... people are watching.
Be a good boy and wait,
okay？
translations.ごめん。そういう気分じゃなくて……。:
Sorry. I'm just not
in the mood...
translations.今？ ちょっと気分じゃない……かな。:
Right now？
I'm not really in the
mood, I think.
translations.どうしてもなの？ でも、ダメ。またね。:
Do you really have to？
Still, no. Next time, okay？
translations.ごめん、雨に濡れちゃうから……。:
Sorry, but we'll get
wet in the rain...
translations.こら、雨に濡れちゃうでしょ。おあずけ。:
Hey, we'll get wet in
the rain. You'll have
to wait.
translations.もう、だめでしょ？ 傘からはみ出ちゃうよ。:
Geez, cut it out.
You'll stick out of
the umbrella.
translations.ごめん……だめ……また、今度ね。:
Sorry... no...
Some other time, okay？
translations.うーん……気分じゃない、かな？ ごめんね。:
Hmm... I'm not really
in the mood, you know？
Sorry.
translations.うーん……少しは私の気持ちも、考えて欲しいな？:
Hmm... I'd like you to
think about how I feel a
little, you know？
translations.うん、いいけど……ちょっと、恥ずかしいかな。:
Yeah, sure...
It's a little
embarrassing, though.
translations.いいけど、キレイに撮ること！ わかった？:
Sure, but make sure
I look pretty！ Got it？
translations.かわいく撮ってくれなかったら……わかってるよね。:
If you don't make me look
cute... you know what
happens, right？
translations.ごめんね……、今じゃなくてもいいよね？:
Sorry...
Does it have to be
right now？
translations.ダメ。また、今度にして欲しいな。:
Nope. I'd rather wait
for next time.
translations.今じゃなくてもいいでしょ？ ね？:
It doesn't have to be
right now, does it？
Please？
translations.小腹が空いたな……何か食べようか？:
I'm a little hungry...
Wanna grab something to eat？
translations.昼、食べに行こうか。腹減っちゃったよ。:
Let's go get some lunch.
I'm starving.
translations.もうこんな時間か。ごはん食べに行かない？:
Is it that time already？
Wanna go eat something？
translations.賛成。実は私もおなか空いてたんだよ。:
I'm with you. Honestly,
I was getting hungry too.
translations.えっと……、私はまだいいかな。:
Um... I think I'm
okay for now.
translations.もう着いちゃった。一緒にいると、時間が経つの早いね。:
We're already here.
Time flies when I'm
with you.
translations.ほんと、あっという間だったな。:
Yeah, it really went by
in a flash.
translations.ほら、着いたよ。思ったより早いね。:
Look, we're here.
That was faster than
I thought.
translations.傘、持ってるのか……。相合傘、できないね。:
Oh, you have an umbrella...
Guess we can't share one.
translations.どうして傘持ってるかなぁ……。:
Why'd you have to go and
bring an umbrella...？
translations.え、まずかった？: Wait, was that a bad move？
translations.あーあ、せっかく傘、入れてあげようと思ったのにな。:
Aww, and here I was
hoping I could share
mine with you.
translations.ねぇ、濡れちゃうよ。はい、どうぞ。:
Hey, you'll get soaked.
Come on, get under.
translations.傘、忘れたの？ じゃあ……はい、一緒に入いろ。:
Forgot your umbrella？
Well then... come on,
let's share.
translations.よかったね、優しいお姉さんがいて。はい、一緒に入ろ。:
Aren't you lucky you have
such a sweet older girlfriend？
Come on, let's share.
translations.傘、忘れるのもいいな。:
Forgetting an umbrella
isn't so bad after all.
translations.●、傘持ってるから、一緒に入ろう。:
● has an umbrella,
so let's share.
translations.ごめんね。でも……忘れて良かったかも。ふふ。:
Sorry about that.
Though... maybe forgetting it
was a good thing. Hehe.
translations.傘あるから。一緒に入ろ。:
I've got an umbrella.
Come share with me.
translations.あ、気がきくんだ。ありがとう。:
Aw, aren't you thoughtful.
Thank you.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が傘を忘れるなんて。ほら、もっと、こっち。:
Can't believe ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
forgot an umbrella.
Here, get in closer.
translations.じゃあ、お言葉に甘えて。たまにはうっかりするのもいいかも。:
Don't mind if I do, then.
Maybe slipping up once
in a while isn't so bad.
translations.傘ないから。走ろう！:
We don't have an umbrella.
Let's run!
translations.ごめんね、忘れちゃった。急ごう。:
Sorry, I forgot mine!
Let's hurry.
translations.ねえ、もう少し近づいても……いいかな？:
Hey, can I... get a little
closer to you？
translations.ねえ……こういうとき、わかるでしょ？:
Hey... you know what to do
at times like this, right？
translations.ねえ、もっと、近づいちゃおっかな……うれしい？:
Hey, maybe I'll get even
closer... Would you like that？
translations.もっと、ぴったりくっついてあげる……ふふ▼:
I'll snuggle up extra close
to you... Hehe▼
translations.あったかくていいな、こういうの。:
It's so warm...
I really like this.
translations.ん？ 今日のデートは……ここにするの？:
Hm？ Is this... where we're
having our date today？
translations.あれ？ ……ごめん、間違えたみたい。:
Huh？ ...Sorry, looks like
I went the wrong way.
translations.んー、ならここで遊ぶことにする？ せっかくだし。:
Hmm, want to hang out
here instead, since we're
already here？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいいなら、それでいいか……）:
(If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s fine with it,
I guess that works...)
translations.あれ……ねえねえ、こっちでいいんだっけ？:
Wait... Hey, are you sure
this is the right way？
translations.え？ ……あ、道間違えた。:
Huh？ ...Ah, I took a wrong
turn.
translations.今から戻ると時間もったいないし、ここにしよっか。:
Going back now would waste
time, so let's just stay here.
translations.色々あるね。あなたのオススメ、教えて欲しいな？:
There's so much here.
Care to show me your favorites？
translations.ねえ、どれが面白いのかな？:
Hey, which one do you
think looks fun？
translations.たくさんあるね。で、どれがいいの？:
There are so many.
Which one do you want？
translations.すごく面白かった。ねえ、もう少し遊ぼうか？:
That was so much fun!
Wanna play a little more？
translations.ふーん、結構面白いんだね。もう少し、遊んでみたいかな？:
Hmm, that's pretty fun.
Wanna keep playing
a bit longer？
translations.あ、それ、面白そう。やってみたいかも。:
Oh, that looks fun.
I'd love to try it.
translations.強いんだね。でも……もうそろそろ、ね？:
You're really good at this.
But... it's about time,
don't you think？
translations.もう、いいんじゃないかな、ね？:
I think that's enough
for now, don't you think？
translations.ねえ、よかったら……お弁当食べない？ 作ってきたんだけど。:
Hey, if you'd like...
wanna eat lunch？
I made us some.
translations.ふふ。今日はお弁当があるんだけどな。:
Hehe. I actually brought
lunch today, you know.
translations.今日は、私の手作り弁当です▼:
Today, it's a homemade
lunch by yours truly▼
translations.じゃあさ、●の家に来る？:
In that case, wanna come
over to ●'s place？
translations.そこはあんまり……かな。今日は帰ろう、ね。:
Not really feeling that spot...
Let's head home today, okay？
translations.うん……残念だけど、そうしようか。:
Yeah... bummer,
but let's do that.
translations.あなたの家？ そうね……行きたいかな。:
Your place？
Hmm... yeah, I'd like that.
translations.ねえ、あそこにいるカップルって、デキシーズの。:
Hey, isn't that couple
over there from Dixie's？
translations.ほんとだ、あいつら付き合ってたのか……。:
You're right.
Those two were dating...？
translations.そういえば私たちが付き合うようになって、バイト内恋愛が増えてきたって店長が言って:
Come to think of it, the
manager said more people at
work started dating after us.
translations.さすが、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の影響力。:
That's the power
of ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ for you.
translations.ふたりのでしょ？ 模範カップルにならなくちゃ、ね？:
You mean both of us, right？
We have to be a model couple,
you know？
translations.なんか、それ、健全な感じでつまんないよ。:
That sounds way too wholesome.
Kinda boring, honestly.
translations.こら、不健全なカップルなんていけません！:
Hey now! Being an unwholesome
couple is strictly forbidden!
translations.髪になにかついてるよ。ほら……。:
You've got something in your hair.
Hold on, let me...
translations.えっ？ ごめん、髪の毛も一緒に抜いちゃった。痛かったよね？:
Huh？ I'm sorry!
I pulled a hair out with it.
Did that hurt？
translations.ありがとう。お、見たことないやつだ。:
Thanks. Oh, I haven't seen
this kind before.
translations.新商品見つけたの。ほら、このマスコットキャラがかわいいの。:
I found a new one!
Look, isn't the mascot
character so cute？
translations.（なんかタヌキみたいな……可愛いかな）:
(Kinda looks like a raccoon...
Is that really cute？)
translations.最近、うちのクラスでダイエットが流行っててね……。:
Lately, dieting has been
all the rage in my class...
translations.私もしたほうがいいかな？:
Do you think I should go
on a diet too？
translations.全然必要ないだろ。今のままがいいよ。:
You don't need to at all.
I like you just the way you are.
translations.そう言ってくれると思った。みんなにも今の台詞教えてあげよっと。:
I knew you'd say that!
I'm totally telling everyone
what you just said.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲らしいかも。: That kinda sounds like you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.この間ね、外国の人に道を聞かれたの。:
The other day, a foreigner asked me
for directions.
translations.ちゃんと教えられた？: Were you able to tell them？
translations.うん、日本語も英語も通じなかったんだけどね。目を見て話してたらなんとかなったの。:
Yeah, though neither Japanese
nor English worked.
Looking them in the eye while talking
somehow got it across!
translations.あとでＤＶＤレンタルしたいの。覚えててくれる？:
I want to rent a DVD later.
Can you remind me？
translations.そう。ずっと前に観たやつなんだけどね、ときどき無性に観たいなぁって思うときがある:
Yep. I saw it a long time ago,
but every now and then I get
this huge urge to rewatch it.
translations.そんなに気に入ってるんだ？ 一緒に観てみたいな。:
You like it that much？
I'd love to watch it with you.
translations.あっ、今よそ見したでしょ。どこ見てたのかな？:
Ah, you just looked away!
Where were your eyes wandering, hmm？
translations.私の目はごまかせないよ。今度、女の人に見とれたりしたら……怒るよ？:
You can't fool me.
If you get caught staring at
another girl again... I'll get mad, okay？
translations.あのね、この間、いい勉強法思いついたんだよ。:
Hey, I came up with a great way
to study the other day.
translations.なになに、教えて！: Ooh, what is it？ Tell me!
translations.それはね、一気に頑張らないこと。グンと一気にあげちゃうと、その後はなかなか厳しい:
Well, it's not pushing too hard
all at once. If you spike it up
too fast, keeping it up is tough, right？
translations.ああ、まあわかるけど、なんか消極的な感じだな。:
Ah, I get it, but that feels
a little passive, doesn't it？
translations.そう？ 専門家が言ってたよ、ダイエットは少しずつが基本だって。:
You think？ An expert said
the golden rule of dieting is
taking it slow and steady.
translations.どうした、ぶつけたの？: What's wrong, did you bump yourself？
translations.うん……それが、わからないの。いつの間にかアザができちゃってて……。ぶつけたのか:
Yeah... Well, I don't really know.
I just noticed a bruise popped up...
Did I bump it somewhere？
translations.腹減ってきたな……。晩ご飯食べない？:
I'm getting hungry...
Wanna grab some dinner？
translations.今日はね、お弁当作ってきたの。喜んでもらえると、うれしいんだけどな。:
I actually made us lunch today.
I hope you like it.
translations.まだ早いし、もう少し遊んでいこうよ？:
It's still early,
wanna hang out a bit longer？
translations.まだ時間大丈夫だよね、もう少し遊びたいんだけど。どう？:
We've still got time, right？
I'd love to hang out some more.
What do you think？
translations.時間大丈夫？ もう少し一緒にいたいんだけど。:
Do you have time？
I want to stay with you
a bit longer.
translations.うん。私も、もっと一緒にいたいから。:
Yeah. I want to spend
more time with you too.
translations.そうね。もう少しなら、大丈夫かな。:
Sure. A little longer
should be fine.
translations.ほんと？ じゃあどこで遊ぼうか。: Really？ Where should we go, then？
translations.そうしたいんだけどね、このあと用事があって……ごめんね？:
I'd love to, but I've got something
after this... Sorry, okay？
translations.私も一緒にいたいんだけど……時間が。ごめんね？:
I want to stay with you too,
but... I'm out of time. Sorry, okay？
translations.ダメか……。じゃあまた今度にしよう。:
No good, huh...
Let's do it next time, then.
translations.……ごめん、やっぱり今日は帰ろうかな。:
...Sorry, I think I should
just head home today.
translations.今日はちょっと……あ、時間も遅いから、ね。:
Today's a bit... Ah, and it's
getting late anyway, you know？
translations.ちょっとだけ疲れちゃった……。あのね、肩、いいかな？:
I got a little tired...
Um, can I lean on your shoulder？
translations.あのね、こっちからお誘い。肩、いい？:
Hey, how about an offer from me？
Can I borrow your shoulder？
translations.ちょっとだけ……甘えちゃおっかな？:
Maybe I'll spoil myself a bit...
and lean on you？
translations.あったかいね……うん、気持ちいい。:
You're so warm...
Yeah, this feels nice.
translations.ねえ……あなたからも、もたれていいんだよ？:
Hey... You can lean on me too,
you know？
translations.こういうの、して欲しかったんじゃないの？ ふふ▼:
Isn't this what you wanted？
Hehe▼
translations.もう着いちゃうの？ ずっと乗ってたい気分だな。:
We're there already？
I feel like staying on forever.
translations.もうすぐ着いちゃうね。残念だったりして？:
We're almost there.
A little disappointed, maybe？
translations.ふぅ……。少し、疲れたちゃったかな。:
Phew...
I guess I got a little tired.
translations.ね、もう着くよ？: Hey, we're almost there, you know？
translations.ん……あっ。いつのまに寝ちゃってたんだろ……、ごめんね。:
Mmh... Ah. I fell asleep before
I even realized... Sorry.
translations.疲れてない？ 肩、よかったら貸すけど。:
Aren't you tired？
You can lean on my shoulder
if you'd like.
translations.あ、かっこいいこと言っちゃって。……じゃあ、お言葉に甘えようかな？:
Oh, look at you being so smooth.
...Well, don't mind if I do？
translations.うん……なんだか、落ち着くね。:
Mm... It's really
calming, isn't it？
translations.……男らしいって思う、かな？:
...I guess that's pretty
manly of you, maybe？
translations.そう言ってもらえると、うれしいな。:
Hearing you say that
makes me really happy.
translations.ふふ▼ 顔、赤いよ。:
Hehe▼ Your face is
all red.
translations.●の家、来る？ もうちょっと、一緒にいられたらいいなと思ってさ。:
Wanna come to ●'s place？
I thought it'd be nice if
we stayed together longer.
translations.うん、行く。私だって……一緒にいたいから。:
Yeah, let's. I want to
be together, too...
translations.ごめんなさい……。今日はもう……いいかな。:
I'm sorry... I think I'll
pass for today.
translations.あなたの家に、行っちゃダメかな？:
Could I maybe come over
to your place？
translations.ほんと？ なんか、緊張しちゃった。:
Really？ Wow, now I'm
getting kind of nervous.
translations.ははっ。じゃ、早く行こう。:
Haha. Let's head over
right away, then.
translations.あ……急だもんね。うん……また今度で大丈夫だから。:
Ah... it was sudden, huh.
Yeah... next time is
totally fine.
translations.今日、プレゼント持ってきたんだ。喜んでくれるといいけど。:
I brought a present today.
Hope you like it.
translations.なぁに？ まったく……甘えん坊なんだから。:
What is it？ Honestly...
you can be so clingy.
translations.もう、今日はおしまい。じゃあ、また今度ね。:
We're all done for today.
See you next time, okay？
translations.あのね、離れたくないなって……。:
You know... I really
don't want to leave you.
translations.（ああ……せっかく、いいムードだったのに）:
(Man... and the mood
was so good, too.)
translations.姉ヶ崎さん。家族が増えるなら、もう少し広い部屋が空いてるよ？:
Anegasaki-san. If your
family's growing, I have
a bigger room open,
you know？
translations.やだ、気が早いですよ。まだそんな話はないです。:
Oh stop, you're getting
way ahead of yourself!
Nothing like that's
happening yet.
translations.あのね、もし、時間大丈夫なら寄っていかない？:
Hey, if you have time,
why not stop by my place？
translations.もしよかったら、あがっていかない？:
If you'd like, why don't
you come on inside？
translations.ほんと？ じゃあ、ちょっとだけ待っててね。お部屋チェックしてくるから。:
Really？ Wait just a sec,
okay？ I'll go check
my room first.
translations.はは、気にしないでいいのに。:
Haha, you don't need
to worry about that.
translations.今日はありがとう。とっても楽しかったよ。またね。:
Thanks for today.
I had so much fun.
See you later!
translations.えっと……今日は楽しかったよね？ それじゃあ、また。:
Um... We had fun today,
right？ Well then, see you.
translations.あの……なんだか、ごめんね。ムリに引き止めたみたいで……。それじゃあ。:
Um... I'm sorry.
It feels like I held you
back... Well then, bye.
translations.ねえ。この間ケンカしたこと、怒ってない？:
Hey... You're not mad
about our fight the other
day, are you？
translations.怒ってないよ。もう気にしてないから。:
I'm not mad.
I'm totally over it.
translations.優しいね……。じゃあ、今日から元通りでいこうね。:
You're so sweet...
Then let's get back to
normal from today, okay？
translations.ねえ。私たち、仲直りできたよね。:
Hey. We're all good now,
right？
translations.あなたのことはもう許してるよ。私のことも許してくれる？:
I've already forgiven you.
Will you forgive me, too？
translations.今日はあなたと仲直りできて、うれしかったよ。:
I was really happy we could
make up today.
translations.●も。もうケンカはこりごりだな。:
● too. I'm definitely
done with fighting.
translations.これからもっと仲良くなっていこうね？:
Let's get even closer from
now on, okay？
translations.今ここであなたに会えたら、午後のテストでいい点取れるかも、なんて思ってたの。:
I was just thinking if I ran
into you here, I'd get a good
grade on my test this afternoon.
translations.いくいく。なんだか力が湧いてきたみたい。:
It will, it will!
I feel like I've got
a burst of energy now.
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。何やってんの？:
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What're you up to？
translations.……あれ？ 私、いつの間にこんなところに……。:
...Huh？ When did I
wander over here...？
translations.いい匂いがするから、何の匂いだろうって追ってたの。んー、消えちゃったみたい。:
I smelled something yummy,
so I was following it.
Hmm, guess it's gone.
translations.はは、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、腹減ってるんだろ。:
Haha, you're just hungry,
aren't you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.もう、そんなんじゃありません。確かにしたと思ったんだけどなぁ……。:
Hey, that's not it!
I could've sworn I smelled
something, though...
translations.●は特に用もなくブラブラ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も？:
●'s just wandering around.
You too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ううん、先生におつかい頼まれちゃって。化学で使う実験道具を取りに行くところなの。:
Nope, a teacher gave me an errand.
I'm on my way to grab some
lab equipment for chemistry.
translations.へぇ、重いんじゃないの？ ●も一緒に行くよ。:
Huh, sounds heavy.
●'ll come with you.
translations.でも……。うん、手伝ってもらっちゃおうかな。ごめんね、休み時間に。:
Are you sure...？ Well, maybe
I will take you up on that.
Sorry during your break.
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。何か読もうと思うんだけど、オススメない？:
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I'm looking for
something to read.
Any recommendations？
translations.そうね、いろいろあるけど……。どんなのがいい？:
Well, I've got plenty, but...
What kind of thing are you
looking for？
translations.何でもいい……なんて言うと、ホラーになっちゃうかな？:
If I say "anything"...
am I gonna end up with horror？
translations.もう、私だってホラーばっかりじゃないよ？ もちろん、ホラーがいいって言うなら、夢:
Hey, I don't only read horror!
Though if you want horror,
I can give you a lineup
that'll haunt your dreams ▼
translations.……トイレに行けなくなったら困るから、遠慮しとこうかな。:
...I'd like to be able to
use the bathroom tonight,
so I think I'll pass.
translations.ちょっと気晴らしに。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
Just taking a breather.
How about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私も気晴らし。昨日ちゃんと寝たはずなのに、さっき授業で寝そうになっちゃって。:
Same here. I thought I got
plenty of sleep last night, but
I almost nodded off in class.
translations.うん。でも、あなたの顔見たら元気出ちゃった。んー、この後も頑張ろうっと。:
Yeah. But seeing your face
perked me right up.
Mmm, time to power through!
translations.……う、仕返ししてやる……。:
...Ugh, I'm gonna
get you back for that...
translations.あん、ごめんなさい。許して？ ね？:
Aw, I'm sorry.
Forgive me？ Pretty please？
translations.ごめん、友達と一緒だったんだろ。邪魔したかな。:
Sorry, you were with friends.
Did I interrupt？
translations.ううん、大丈夫。いつだって、あなたに呼ばれて迷惑なんてことないよ。:
No, not at all.
It's never a bother
when you call for me.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。それがね、調べ物してたんだけど、わからないことを調べるたびにわから:
▲主人公＊▲. Well, I was researching
something, but every time I look
up one thing, another pops up.
translations.そうやってどんどん調べてたら、最初に何を調べてたのかわからなくなっちゃったの。う:
I went so far down the rabbit
hole that I forgot what I was
even looking for. Mmm...
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ねえ、さっき渡り廊下を通ってたでしょ。:
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, you walked
through the breezeway earlier,
didn't you？
translations.ああ、教室移動で……。って、よくわかったな。こっからだとほとんど見えないだろ。:
Yeah, moving classrooms...
Wait, how'd you know？ You can
barely see it from here.
translations.あなたなら、顔が見えなくてもわかるよ？ 輪郭っていうか、雰囲気で。:
If it's you, I'd know even
without seeing your face？
By your outline, or maybe
just your vibe.
translations.……ああ、そっか。●もそうかも。待ち合わせの時とか、遠くからでも▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って:
...Ah, yeah. I guess it's
the same for ●, too.
When we meet up, I can spot
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ from way off.
translations.ボーッとしてるから、目を覚まさせてあげようと思って。起きた？:
You were daydreaming, so I
thought I'd wake you up.
Awake now？
translations.起きた起きた。はぁ、びっくりした……。:
Wide awake! Whew,
you startled me...
translations.慌てちゃって。周りには誰もいないから、安心して？:
Look at you all flustered.
There's no one around,
so don't worry, okay？
translations.（クラスメイトとかに聞かれたら、さすがに気まずいもんな……）:
(If our classmates heard that,
it'd be pretty awkward...)
translations.和英辞書持ってない？ 午後の授業で必要なんだけど、家に忘れちゃって……。:
Do you have a Japanese-
English dictionary？ I need it
this afternoon, but I left
mine at home...
translations.いいよ、ちょっと待ってて。今持ってくる。:
Sure, hold on a second.
I'll go get it.
translations.良かったぁ、ありがとう。英語の先生、怒ると怖いから……。:
Whew, thank goodness! Thanks.
The English teacher is really
scary when she gets mad...
translations.（学年違うと教科書の貸し借りってないけど、辞書ならあるんだな。なんかいいかも）:
(Different grades mean no
borrowing textbooks, but
dictionaries work. Kinda nice.)
translations.ふふ、先生かと思った？:
Hehe, did you think
I was a teacher？
translations.ううん、すぐ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ってわかったよ。:
No, I knew it was ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
right away.
translations.じゃあ、どうしてそんなに驚いたの？ あ、もしかして私に怒られるような、心当たりが:
Then why were you so jumpy？
Ah, don't tell me you did
something to make me mad...？
translations.（声が大きくて驚いただけなんだけどな……）:
(It was just really loud,
that's all...)
translations.見つけたと思ったら、どんどん先に行っちゃうんだもん。:
Just when I spotted you,
you went walking right on
ahead.
translations.だって少し距離があったから。校内で大声で呼ぶのは、さすがに……ね？:
Well, you were pretty far.
Shouting in the hallway
is a bit much, you know？
translations.（イジワルな▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のときは、それぐらいしそうだけど……）:
(When ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s in a teasing
mood, she totally would...)
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。数学だったかな。なんで？:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Math, I think. Why？
translations.面倒くさいな～って顔して歩いてたから。:
Because you were walking
around with a total 'what a
pain' look on your face.
translations.そんな顔してた？: Did I really look like that？
translations.してたしてた。あ、トボけた顔しちゃって。ふふ。:
You totally did! And now you're
playing dumb. Hehe.
translations.●は返却だけ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
●'s just returning a
book. What about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.昨日、ドラマの最終回だったの。録画しててまだ見てないのに、みんなが先を話しちゃう:
The drama finale was yesterday.
I recorded it, but everyone's
talking about how it ends...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だ。よーし、驚かして……）:
(There's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
All right, time to scare her...)
translations.ふふ、寧々さんを脅かそうなんて、甘いんだから。:
Hehe, trying to scare Nene-san？
You've got a lot to learn!
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。寝てないよ？:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I wasn't sleeping, okay？
translations.うそ。頭グラグラしてた。:
Liar. Your head was
bobbing all over.
translations.ふふ、可愛いんだから。あと少しなんだから、頑張って。:
Hehe, you're so cute.
Almost done for the day,
so hang in there!
translations.うん。もしかして、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も？:
Yeah. Are you doing
that too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うん。一緒だね。:
Yup. Look at that,
we match.
translations.……あっ、焼却炉のところに置いてきちゃった！:
...Ah! I left it
by the incinerator!
translations.（バイト中だとこんなミスしないのにな……）:
(She never makes mistakes
like that at work, though...)
translations.（えーと、あの本はどこだったかな……）:
(Let's see, where was
that book again...?)
translations.あ、すみません。……なんだ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲か。:
Oh, excuse me.
...Oh, it's just you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.もう、なんだってことないんじゃない？:
Geez, what's that supposed
to mean, 'just you'？
translations.えっ？ えーと……。やった、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の手に触れちゃった！:
Eh？ Uh...
Score! I touched
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s hand!
translations.ふふっ……もう、可愛いから許してあげる▼:
Hehe... Geez, you're
so cute, I'll let it slide▼
translations.どうしたの？ ボーッとしちゃって。:
What's wrong？
You're totally spaced out.
translations.うん……。日本経済と地球温暖化と政治における問題点について、深く考えてたんだ……:
Yeah... I was deep in
thought about the Japanese
economy, global warming,
and political issues...
translations.ふふ、ウソばっかり。時間があるなら、ちょっとおしゃべりしない？:
Hehe, big fat liar.
If you've got time,
wanna chat for a bit？
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。もうすぐ鐘鳴るよ？:
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
The bell's gonna ring soon,
you know？
translations.うん。次はそこの音楽室なの。:
Yup. Next period's in
that music room over there.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、授業中に▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の歌声が聞こえるかな。:
I see. Maybe I'll hear
you singing during class,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そんなに大声出しません。ふふ、じゃあね。:
I won't be that loud!
Hehe, see ya.
translations.（こっちには全然気付いてないみたいだな。気持ち良さそうに歌ってる……）:
(Looks like she hasn't
noticed me at all. She's
singing happily away...)
translations.やだ、もう。いつからいたの？ もうっ……。:
No way, seriously？
How long were you there？
Geez...
translations.（……恥ずかしがることないのに）:
(...She doesn't need to be
so embarrassed.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、何してんの？ きょろきょろして。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what are you
doing？ Looking around
everywhere.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。今度、美術の授業で写生があるから、今のうちにいい場所を探しておこう:
▲主人公＊▲. We have sketching
in art class soon, so I'm
scouting out a good spot
while I have the chance.
translations.へぇ、美術でそんなのやるんだ。描きやすい場所見つかるといいな。:
Oh, you do that in art？
Hope you find a nice spot
to draw.
translations.うん。いい場所発見したら、教えてあげるね。:
Yup. When I find a good one,
I'll let you know!
translations.しーっ。友達と一緒なの。すぐ行かなきゃ。:
Shh! I'm with friends.
I've gotta go right away.
translations.もう、そんなにしょんぼりされたら離れたくなくなっちゃうじゃない。またね？:
Aw, don't look so bummed!
You'll make me not want
to leave. See ya later, okay？
translations.わぁ、今日は人が多いね。:
Wow, there are so many
people out today.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。そうだな、天気がいいからかな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Yeah, probably
because the weather's so nice.
translations.こんな日はお弁当持って、のんびりハイキングでもしたいなあ。あ、山登りもいいかも。:
On days like this, I'd love to
pack a lunch and go for a hike.
Oh, climbing a mountain sounds fun too!
translations.え～？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、すぐ疲れちゃうだろ。:
Huh？ But ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you'd get tired right away.
translations.言ったな！ 優しいカレシがエスコートしてくれたら、ちゃんと頂上まで頑張るんだから:
Now you've said it! With my sweet
boyfriend escorting me, I'll make
it all the way to the top, you know!
translations.……あ、いたみたい。どうもありがとう。:
...Oh, there he is.
Thank you so much!
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。うちの教室で何やってんの？:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What are you doing in our classroom？
translations.通りかかったから、覗いただけなの。そうしたら、気を利かせてくれた子があなたを探し:
I was passing by and peeked in.
Then someone was nice enough
to go look for you...
translations.うん、そう。私たち、あなたの友達公認なんだね。:
Yep. Looks like we're official
in your friends' eyes, huh？
translations.（まぁ、全然隠してないしな）:
(Well, it's not like
we're hiding it anyway.)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。単語のテストがあるから暗記中なの。教室だと集中できなくて。:
▲主人公＊▲. I have a vocab test,
so I'm memorizing words.
I just couldn't focus in class.
translations.そうなんだ。ごめん、邪魔したかな。:
Oh, really？ Sorry,
did I interrupt you？
translations.そんなことないよ。そうだ、問題出してもらっていい？ 単語帳のここからここまで。:
Not at all. Hey, could you quiz me？
From here to here in my vocab book.
translations.オッケー。よし、ビシバシいくぞ？:
Okay. All right,
I'm not going easy on you？
translations.あ、ちょうどいいところに。ねぇ、水色のハンカチ見なかった？:
Oh, perfect timing! Have you seen
a light blue handkerchief？
translations.見てないな……。落し物なら一緒に探そうか？:
Haven't seen it...
Want me to help you look？
translations.ありがとう。友達のなんだけど、窓際で干してたら風で飛んじゃったみたい。:
Thanks! It's my friend's.
She had it drying by the window,
and the wind blew it away.
translations.……ん？ あれじゃないか、ほら、木の枝に引っかかってる。:
...Hmm？ Isn't that it right there,
caught on that tree branch？
translations.あっ、ホントだ。わぁ、お手柄！ えらいえらい▼:
Ah, you're right! Wow, great job!
Good boy, good boy, ▼!
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。うん、やって帰ろうと思ってさ。:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Yeah, thought I'd
finish it before heading home.
translations.そうなんだ。私もそうしようかな。隣、いい？:
I see. Maybe I will too.
Mind if I sit next to you？
translations.もちろん。やった、ちょっとここ教えて。:
Of course. Sweet, can you help
me with this part right here？
translations.あ～、調子いいんだから。ふふ。:
Ah, look at you taking advantage.
Hehe.
translations.あれ、いたんだ。声かけてくれればよかったのに。:
Oh, you were here？
You should've said something.
translations.うん、でも、お友達が一緒だったから。: Yeah, but you were with your friends.
translations.あ、そういうこと言うんだ。……ふふ、仲良しなんだね？:
Oh, listen to you.
...Hehe, you're really close, huh？
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も職員室に用だったの？:
Oh, did you have business
in the staff room too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うん、集めたプリントを届けに来たの。あなたは？ 悪いことして呼び出されちゃった？:
Yeah, dropping off some handouts.
What about you？ Get called in
for being naughty？
translations.違うって。鍵返しに来ただけ。: No way. Just returning a key.
translations.ふーん。まぁ、そういうことにしておきますか。: Hmm. Well, let's just go with that.
translations.うん。座るところ探してたでしょ。隣にどうぞ。:
Yeah. You were looking for
a place to sit, right？
Have a seat next to me.
translations.サンキュー。ついでに読書の邪魔していい？:
Thanks. Mind if I interrupt
your reading while I'm at it？
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ こんなとこでどうしたの？:
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
What're you doing here？
translations.今日からテニス部に入ることになりました。:
I'm joining the tennis club
starting today.
translations.もう、そんなに驚いちゃうかなぁ。冗談です、ちょっと友達を待ってるだけ。:
Geez, did you have to look
that surprised？ Just kidding,
I'm only waiting for a friend.
translations.だよなぁ、まさか▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が……なぁ？:
Thought so. No way ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
would... right？
translations.なぁに、それ？ 私がテニス部に入ったら、おかしい？:
What's that supposed to mean？
Would it be weird if I joined
the tennis club？
translations.あれ？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ここの掃除当番？:
Huh？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you on
cleaning duty here？
translations.うん。今月はうちのクラスが担当。:
Yep. It's our class's turn
this month.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、今月はポイ捨てしないようにしよう。:
Gotcha. Guess I won't litter
this month, then.
translations.うん。……って、今月じゃなくてもポイ捨てはダメ。:
Good. ...Wait, no littering,
even when it's NOT this month!
translations.はは、冗談だって。お疲れさま。:
Haha, just kidding.
Good work today.
translations.んー、これも読んじゃったし……。:
Hmm, I've read this one
too...
translations.▲主人公＊▲。長く読めるシリーズもので、おもしろそうな本はないかと思って。オスス:
▲主人公＊▲. I was looking for a fun
book in a long series.
Got any recommendations？
translations.うーん、オススメがあったら、とっくに話してると思うしなぁ。:
Hmm, if I had any, I think
I'd have told you by now.
translations.そうなのよね……。じゃあ、新規開拓してみますか。:
True enough... Guess I'll have
to venture into new territory.
translations.うん。いいの見つけたら、●にも教えて。:
Yeah. If you find a good one,
let ● know too.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。音楽の高橋先生知らない？:
▲主人公＊▲. Have you seen
Takahashi-sensei, from music？
translations.見てないなあ。音楽室にいないの？:
Haven't seen them.
Aren't they in the music room？
translations.ううん。音楽室の鍵を持ったまま、行方不明なの。中に筆箱忘れちゃって、入りたいんだ:
No. They disappeared with the
music room key. I forgot my
pencil case in there, and I need
to get it...
translations.職員室に行ったら購買じゃないかって言われて、購買に行ったら屋上で見たって言われて:
The staff room said to check
the store, the store said the
roof, and on the roof, they said
back toward the music room...
translations.たらい回されちゃったか。とりあえず筆記用具貸そうか？:
Got the runaround, huh？
Want me to lend you some
pens for now？
translations.うん、ありがとう。はぁ、後でまた探さなくっちゃ……。:
Thanks, that helps.
*sigh* I'll have to go look
again later...
translations.あ、いたいた。ねぇ、写真撮ってもいい？:
Ah, there you are.
Hey, can I take your picture？
translations.友達の携帯にカレシの写真がたくさん入ってて、羨ましくなっちゃって。昼休みにノロけ:
My friend had tons of photos
of her boyfriend on her phone,
and I got jealous. She was
bragging all lunch break.
translations.いいけど、ここって人目もあるし……。:
I don't mind, but there are
people watching around here...
translations.？ ヘンなの。おかしなことじゃないのに。:
？ You're silly.
It's not like there's anything
weird about it.
translations.ふふ、ちょっと顔が見たくなっちゃって。:
Hehe, I just wanted to see
your face.
translations.ううん、ホントにただ顔が見たかっただけなの。何ていうのかな、ちゃんとした理由があ:
No, I really just wanted
to see your face.
How should I put it...
It's not like I had
any real reason for it...
translations.そっか。いいよ別に、理由なんて。●も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の顔見れたら嬉しいし。:
I see. That's fine,
you don't need a reason.
●'s happy to see
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s face, too.
translations.おに～さん、ちょっといい？:
Excuse me, mister~
Got a minute？
translations.ふふ、誰だと思ったの？:
Hehe, who did you
think it was？
translations.勧誘みたいに話しかけてくるからさ……。:
You sounded like you were
trying to solicit me...
translations.学校で？ あんまりボーッとしてると、本当に引っかかっちゃうわよ。気をつけなさい？:
At school？
If you space out like that,
someone really will scam you.
You'd better be careful, okay？
translations.すいません、ボール取ってください！:
Excuse me!
Could you grab our ball？
translations.あなただったの。建物の影になってて、わからなかった。:
Oh, it was you!
You were in the shadow
of the building, so I couldn't tell.
translations.バレーボール？ 突き指しないようにな。:
Volleyball？
Be careful not to jam a finger.
translations.ふふ、はーい。ボール、ありがとう！:
Hehe, will do!
Thanks for the ball!
translations.（真剣な顔して読んでる。邪魔しちゃ悪いかな……）:
(She's reading with such
a serious look. Maybe I
shouldn't bother her...)
translations.ふふ、視線がね？ チクチクって。:
Hehe, I felt your gaze,
you know？ All prickling.
translations.……ふぅ、風が気持ちいいね。:
...Whew, the breeze
feels nice, doesn't it？
translations.なあに？ なんだかバイト中みたい。:
What's that for？
You sound like we're on shift.
translations.学生にとっては、勉強も仕事みたいなもんだからな。:
Well, for students, studying
is pretty much our job, too.
translations.生意気なこと言って。それじゃ、もう一働きしますか。:
Listen to you, talk about cheeky.
Well then, shall we put in
another shift？
translations.ツバメを見なかった？ 窓から教室に入ってきちゃって、みんなで外に出そうと思って追:
Did you see a swallow？
One flew into the classroom
through the window, so we were
chasing it to get it out...
translations.廊下のほうに逃げちゃった？ こっちでは見てないな。:
Did it flee down the hall？
I haven't seen it around here.
translations.そっか、うまく外に出たのかな……。わかった、ありがとう。:
I see, maybe it made it outside...
Got it, thanks!
translations.友達がコンタクト落としちゃったの。:
A friend of mine dropped
her contact lens.
translations.ここで？ ●も手伝おうか？:
Right here？
Want ● to help too？
translations.ありがとう。もう手遅れかもしれないけど、実物を見ないと諦めきれないって言うから。:
Thanks. It might already be
too late, but she won't give up
till she sees it for herself.
translations.入り口横のポスターがはがれかかってるんだけど、ちょっと届かなくて。直してもらって:
The poster by the entrance
is peeling, but I can't
quite reach it.
Could you fix it for me？
translations.オッケー。あ、じゃあ今来たお客さんのオーダー、お願いしていいかな。:
Sure thing. Ah, could you
take the order for the customer
who just came in, then？
translations.ああ、やっぱり計算ミスだったみたいだな。お釣り、正しく渡してたって。:
Oh, looks like it really was
just a calculation error.
They gave the right change.
translations.そう、よかった。あ、それとあっちは……。:
I see, that's a relief.
Oh, and what about that other...？
translations.来月からの新メニュー？ 印刷遅れてるけど、店長が明日には届くだろうって。:
The new menu for next month？
Printing got delayed, but the
manager said it should be
here by tomorrow.
translations.寧々くん、休憩中ごめん。ちょっといいかな。:
Nene-kun, sorry to interrupt
your break. Got a second？
translations.うーん……。何かっていうと、店長が頼るのは▲姉ヶ崎＊▲なんだよなぁ。:
Man... Whenever anything happens,
the manager always relies on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そうかな。じゃあちょっと行ってくるから、いい子で待っててね？:
You think so？ Well, I'll be
right back, so be a good boy
and wait for me, okay？
translations.（……はっ、何素直にうなずいてんだ。これだから●は……）:
(...Wait, why'd I just nod along？
That's ● for you...)
translations.……今の団体さん、大学のサークルだって。:
...That group just now, turns out
they're a college club.
translations.そうなんだ。ずいぶん大人っぽく見えたけど。:
Really？ They looked pretty
mature, though.
translations.私も大学生になったら変わるのかな。:
I wonder if I'll change
like that once I'm in college, too.
translations.そうだとしても、多分気付かないだろうな。いつも一緒にいたら。:
Even if you did, I probably
wouldn't notice. Since we're
always together.
translations.ねぇねぇ、今日、バイトの後に食事が出るって。:
Hey, hey! They're feeding us
after work today!
translations.サンプルメニューの試食会。今日シフトが入ってるスタッフ全員でも、食べきれないくら:
A sample menu tasting! Apparently
there's more food than everyone
on shift today can possibly eat.
translations.……あっ、いけない。お客様がいるところで、ため息なんて……。:
...Oops, bad habit. Sighing right
in front of the customers...
translations.大丈夫だよ、誰も見てないし。: It's fine, no one was looking.
translations.ダメダメ。たるんでるぞ、寧々。:
Nope, no excuses!
Get it together, Nene.
translations.（そういうとこ、真面目だよな……）:
(She's really serious about
stuff like that...)
translations.ねぇ、あそこに座ってる子、幾つくらいだと思う？:
Hey, how old do you think that
kid sitting over there is？
translations.お子様ランチを頼んだから、もっと小さいみたい。多分、小学校３、４年くらい……。:
They ordered a kids' meal, so they
must be younger. Probably third or
fourth grade in elementary school...
translations.そうは見えないけど……。: They really don't look it, though...
translations.オマケのおもちゃにすごく喜んでたし、きっとそのくらいだと思う。最近の子は大人っぽ:
They got super excited over the toy,
so I'm sure of it. Kids nowadays
look so mature.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が言うと実感あるな……）:
(Coming from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
that really carries some weight...)
translations.大変、タオル、タオル！: Oh no! Towel, I need a towel!
translations.うん、お客様が水を倒して、全部自分がかぶっちゃって。:
Yeah, a customer knocked over their
water and got it all over themselves.
