translations.ううん、大丈夫。お騒がせしました～。: No, I'm fine. Sorry for the fuss~!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、こういう時のフットワークは軽いな……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is always so quick
on her feet at times like this...)
translations.姉ヶ崎さん、店長が呼んでます。:
Anegasaki-san, the manager
is calling for you.
translations.ずっとつかまってたみたいだから。: Looked like you were trapped there.
translations.うん、常連のお婆さんなんだけどね。ちょっと話が長くて、よくつかまっちゃうの。:
Yeah, she's a regular, but she talks
for so long that I always get stuck.
translations.（いつもつき合っちゃうあたりが▲姉ヶ崎＊▲らしいな……）:
(Always listening anyway is so like
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.すいません、５番テーブルお願いします。:
Sorry, could you take
table five, please？
translations.あ、待って。私が行くから、こっちをお願い。:
Oh, wait. I'll go instead,
so take this one, okay？
translations.だってあそこのテーブル、きれいなお姉さんばっかりなんだもの。:
Because that table's full of
pretty women, that's why.
translations.……ねぇ、このディスプレイ、どうかな？:
...Hey, what do you think
of this display？
translations.もう、感情こもってない。:
Geez, you don't sound
like you mean it at all.
translations.そんなことないって。いいよ、すごく。●大絶賛！:
That's not true! It's great,
really. ●Rave reviews!
translations.もう、わざとらしいなぁ。:
Geez, now you're just
laying it on thick.
translations.（どう言えばいいんだ……）:
(What am I even supposed
to say...？)
translations.あと少しで休憩だから、頑張って？:
Break's coming up soon,
so hang in there, okay？
translations.そっか。ごめん、仕事中に。:
Do I？ Sorry, right in the
middle of work, too.
translations.ううん、私にしかわからない程度だから大丈夫。:
No, only I'd ever notice,
so you're totally fine.
translations.お疲れさま。紅茶いる？ ティーバッグだけど。:
Good work. Want some tea？
It's just a tea bag, though.
translations.うん、ありがと。仕事の後の一杯ってたまらないねえ。:
Yeah, thanks! Nothing beats
a cup after work.
translations.はは、オヤジみたいなこと言ってる。:
Haha, you sound like
an old man.
translations.ドリンクバーの備品補充、お願いしていい？:
Could you restock the drink
station supplies for me？
translations.ごめん、今こっちも手が離せないんだ。後でも大丈夫？:
Sorry, my hands are full
right now too. Can it wait？
translations.うん、あと少しなら。この時間はいつも忙しいね。:
Yeah, if it's just a bit.
It's always busy at this hour.
translations.全然話せない時もあるもんな。……っと、やべ。お待たせしました！:
There're times we don't get
to talk at all. ...Whoops!
Sorry for the wait!
translations.▲主人公＊▲、コーヒーに詳しい？:
▲主人公＊▲, do you know
much about coffee？
translations.うーん、美味いか不味いかくらいは。:
Hmm, just whether it tastes
good or bad, pretty much.
translations.そっか。うちのドリンクバーのコーヒーって、ちゃんと豆を挽いてるでしょ？ 今度その:
I see. Our drink station's
coffee actually grinds the
beans, right？
Apparently they're switching
the beans, so I just did a
taste test, but...
translations.へぇ、そうなんだ。ちょっと楽しみだな。:
Oh really？
I'm looking forward to that.
translations.うん、でも、私にはよくわからなくて。どっちも苦いってことくらいしか……。:
Yeah, but I couldn't really
tell. All I know is they
were both just bitter...
translations.おはよう。早く止むといいな……。:
Good morning.
Hope it stops soon...
translations.雨、イヤ？ ……たしかに靴が汚れて困るよね？:
Don't like the rain？
...It's annoying when your
shoes get all dirty, right？
translations.それもあるな……でもなんか、気分的にさ。:
That's part of it...
but it's more a mood thing.
translations.ならきっと、気の持ちようでイヤじゃなくなるよ。ね？:
Then I bet if you change
your mindset, you won't mind
it at all. Right？
translations.雨、少し憂鬱だね。ねえ、どうにかして？:
The rain is a little gloomy.
Hey, do something about it？
translations.ふふ。困った顔。その顔見たら、気分も晴れちゃった。:
Fufu. Look at that troubled
face. Seeing you like that
cheered me right up.
translations.髪がまとまらなくて、大変だったの。跳ねてないよね？:
My hair wouldn't behave,
it was such a pain.
It's not sticking up, is it？
translations.大丈夫、どこも跳ねてないよ。:
Don't worry,
it's not sticking up at all.
translations.……ついでになでなでしてくれてもいいよ？:
...You could always pat
my head while you're at it,
you know？
translations.今日はいい天気だね。崩れそうにないかな。:
It's so nice out today.
Doesn't look like it'll turn,
either.
translations.この感じなら、大丈夫かな。:
Looking like this,
I think we'll be fine.
translations.天気がいいと気分もいいね。:
Nice weather always puts me
in a good mood.
translations.あぁ。快晴って感じだね。:
Yeah. Clear skies
all the way.
translations.今日は晴れてほしかったから、うれしいな。:
I really wanted clear skies
today, so I'm glad.
translations.そうなんだ。よかった。: Is that so？ I'm glad then.
translations.雨が降らなきゃいいんだけどな。:
As long as it doesn't rain,
I guess.
translations.曇ってるね……どうなるかな？:
It's pretty cloudy...
Wonder what it'll do？
translations.晴れてくれたらいいんだけど。: It'd be nice if it cleared up.
translations.曇ってるねー。今日ずっとなのかな。:
Sure is cloudy.
Wonder if it'll stay like this
all day？
translations.んー、晴れてほしいな。:
Yeah, hope the sun
comes out.
translations.雨、上がるといいね。: Hope the rain lets up soon.
translations.放課後までには晴れて欲しいかな。:
I'd love for it to clear up
by after school.
translations.学校終わる頃には晴れてくれないかな。:
Hope it clears up
by the time school's out.
translations.学校さぼって、今からデートに……。:
Maybe we should ditch school
and go on a date right now...
translations.……ごめん、冗談。もう少しの辛抱だもんね。:
...Sorry, just teasing.
We only have to hold out
a little longer, right？
translations.そうだよね、びっくりした……。:
Right...
You surprised me for a second.
translations.さ、授業に集中しなくちゃね。:
Alright, gotta focus
on class now.
translations.気合入ってるな。: Look at you, all fired up.
translations.デートが近づくと、集中力落ちちゃうの。だから自分に言い聞かせておかないと。:
When a date gets close,
I lose all my focus.
So I have to remind myself.
translations.珍しいね、遅刻なんて。:
That's rare for you,
running late.
translations.深夜の映画観ながらそのまま寝ちゃったみたいで……。:
I fell asleep watching
a late-night movie, I think...
translations.はは、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲らしいな。:
Haha, sounds just like you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.もう、だらしないんだから。起こしてもらわないとダメ？:
Jeez, you're so hopeless.
Do I need to wake you up myself？
translations.（う……子ども扱いだな）:
(Ugh... she's treating me
like a kid.)
translations.家のカギ、掛けたような\n掛けてないような…………\nうん、掛けた、大丈夫。:
Did I lock the front door,
or did I leave it...?
...Yep, I locked it. All good.
translations.ごめんね、ありがとう。つまずいちゃったみたいで……おはよう。:
Sorry about that, thank you.
Looks like I tripped...
Good morning.
translations.おはよ。こっちに倒れてくれてよかったよ。:
Morning. I'm just glad
you fell my way.
translations.今日ね、あなたのニセモノが出る夢を見たの。腕をつねったら正体をあらわして……。:
So today, I had a dream
about a fake you.
When I pinched his arm,
he revealed his true form...
translations.大丈夫、本物だから！:
Don't worry,
I'm the real deal!
translations.今日もお弁当用意してきたの。どこで食べたい？:
I made us lunch today, too.
Where do you want to eat？
translations.じゃん、お弁当。どこで食べるのが一番おいしいかな？:
Ta-da, lunch!
Where do you think it'd
taste the best？
translations.▲飲食店＊＊＊＊＊▲で食べるのはどう？:
How about we eat
at ▲飲食店＊＊＊＊＊▲？
translations.ごめんね。今日、お弁当ないの。:
Sorry. I didn't bring
lunch today.
translations.そっか。じゃあ学食にする？:
I see. Want to hit
the cafeteria, then？
translations.あ、いいね。まだ一緒に行ってないもんね。:
Oh, good idea.
We haven't gone there
together yet, have we？
translations.今日はお弁当用意できなかったの。がっかりした？:
I couldn't make lunch today.
Are you disappointed？
translations.しょうがないよ、じゃあ学食行く？:
Can't be helped.
Wanna hit the cafeteria？
translations.それいいね。まだ一緒に行ってないし。:
Sounds good.
We haven't gone together yet,
anyway.
translations.あのね、実は……お弁当、忘れてきちゃった。:
So, actually...
I forgot our lunch at home.
translations.そうなんだ。じゃあ学食行ってみる？:
Ah, gotcha.
Wanna try the cafeteria？
translations.うん。そうしよう。そういえば、一緒に行ったことないね。:
Yeah, let's.
Come to think of it,
we've never gone together.
translations.今日のお昼、学食でいいかな？:
Are you okay with the
cafeteria for lunch today？
translations.今日は学食がいいな。あなたは？:
I'm in the mood for the
cafeteria today. How about you？
translations.今日は学食に行きたいな。いい？:
I'd like to go to the
cafeteria today. Is that okay？
translations.うまそうだな。いただきます！:
Looks delicious.
Time to dig in!
translations.ごちそうさま。おいしかったね。:
Thanks for the meal.
That was delicious, wasn't it？
translations.ごちそうさまー。いやー、食ったなぁ。:
Thanks for the food!
Man, I am stuffed.
translations.ふふっ。次の授業で居眠りしないように、ね。:
Hehe. Make sure you don't
doze off next period, okay？
translations.しまった、食べ過ぎると眠くなるよな……。:
Shoot... Overeating always
makes me so sleepy...
translations.もう、ほんとに気を付けてね。:
Jeez, you really need
to be careful, okay？
translations.ごちそうさまでした。お腹いっぱいになった？:
Thanks for the meal.
Did you get full？
translations.うん、満腹。眠くなってきた。:
Yeah, totally stuffed.
I'm getting sleepy...
translations.ちょっと食べすぎじゃない？ 最近お腹回りが……。:
Aren't you eating a bit
too much？ Lately your waistline's
looking a little...
translations.う・そ♪ 目、覚めた？ 午後の授業もがんばろうね。:
Just kid-ding♪
Did that wake you up？
Let's hang in there this afternoon.
translations.ごちそうさま。おいしそうに食べてたね。:
Thanks for the meal.
You looked like you really
enjoyed that.
translations.ガツガツ食べてるところ、男の人って感じでかっこいいね▼:
The way you scarf it down
feels so manly.
It's pretty cool▼
translations.傘ないけど、どうしよう……:
I don't have an umbrella...
What should I do？
translations.濡れるのイヤだしな、持っててよかった。:
I hate getting soaked.
Glad I brought it.
translations.うん、そう。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も？ 傘持ってる？:
Yeah. You too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Got an umbrella？
translations.じゃあ私、忘れちゃったの。一緒に入ろ？:
Well then, I forgot mine.
Wanna share？
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。帰ろっか。:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Ready to head home？
translations.そうだね。傘持ってる？: Yeah. Do you have an umbrella？
translations.面倒だし、走って帰るか……。:
Too much hassle.
Guess I'll just run for it...
translations.傘忘れた子、見ーつけた。:
Found a boy who forgot
his umbrella~
translations.そのまま帰ろうとしてたでしょ。かわいそうだから、私の傘に入れてあげる。:
You were just gonna run for it,
weren't you？ Poor thing...
I'll let you share mine.
translations.どういたしまして。風邪引いたら大変だもんね。:
You're welcome.
Can't have you catching a cold.
translations.うう、結構降ってるな……ま、いっか、走ろう。:
Man, it's really coming down...
Oh well, time to bolt.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ここでクイズです。私がさっき受けた授業はなんでしょう？:
▲主人公＊▲. Pop quiz!
What class did I just have？
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……いい匂い。家庭科実習？:
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Smells good.
Cooking class？
translations.ピンポーン♪ 正解者にはプレゼントです♪:
Ding-dong!♪
Here's a prize for the winner♪
translations.くれるの？ じゃあ遠慮なく、いただきまーす。:
For me？ Don't mind if I do!
Down the hatch!
translations.味はどうかな？ 自分ではおいしく出来たとおもうんだけど。:
How does it taste？
I thought it turned out
pretty good myself.
translations.ふふ、お口に合うかな？: Hehe, is it to your liking？
translations.（おいしい……デキシーズで出せるんじゃないか、これ？）:
(It's so good...
Could this be served at Dixie's？)
translations.気に入ってくれるとうれしいんだけど。: I really hope you like it, though.
translations.ちょっと失敗してる？: Did I mess it up a little？
translations.（失敗ってことはないよな、普通かな）:
(Not really messed up.
Just... average, I guess.)
translations.あの、もしおかしな味だったら、ごめんね。:
Um, if it tastes weird,
I'm sorry, okay？
translations.（う、たしかにちょっと……）:
(Oof, yeah, it really is
a little...)
translations.ひょっとしたら口に合わないかも。:
Maybe it's just not
to your taste.
translations.実はちょっと自信なくて……あはは。:
Truth is, I wasn't too
confident about it... Ahaha.
translations.まだ起きないのかな？ 困ったお寝坊さん……。:
Still not waking up？
Such a sleepyhead...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ あれ……夢？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Wait...
Was that a dream？
translations.夢じゃないよ、起こしに来たの。おはよう。:
Not a dream. I came to wake
you up. Good morning.
translations.おはよう……。あぁ、朝から夢心地だ……。:
Morning... Ah, waking up
like this feels like a dream...
translations.なんか……すごい勢いでほっぺをツンツンされたような……。:
I felt like... someone was
poking my cheek like crazy...
translations.面白い夢見てたんだね？ ほら、早く支度しなくちゃ。:
Must've been a funny dream,
huh？ Come on, you have to
get ready.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……今、ほっぺに……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Did you just,
on my cheek...？
translations.（こんなの、一発で目が覚めるって）:
(Something like that would
wake anyone right up.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……おはよう、来てくれたんだ。すぐに起こしてくれたら良かったのに。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Morning. You came!
You should've just woken me
right away, though.
translations.面白い寝言だったから、起こすのがもったいなくなっちゃって。:
Your sleep-talking was funny,
it seemed a shame to
wake you.
translations.大丈夫、私の胸にしまっておくから。誰にも言わないよ。:
Don't worry, my lips are
sealed. I won't tell a soul.
translations.（変なこと言ってないよな、●……）:
(I didn't say anything weird,
did I, ●...？)
translations.おたまでフライパンを叩いてみたの、マンガみたいでしょ。効果抜群だね？:
I banged a pan with a ladle,
just like a cartoon! Worked
like a charm, didn't it？
translations.その様子だと夜更かし？ 早くしないと遅刻するよ？:
Up late last night,
by the looks of it？
Hurry or you'll be late,
you know？
translations.大きな口開けちゃって、子どもみたいなんだから。着替えさせてあげましょうか？:
Yawning with your mouth wide
open, just like a kid.
Want me to dress you？
translations.それはいいって！ 起きるから……。:
No way, I'm good!
I'm getting up, I swear...
translations.おはよう。いいタイミングだね。ごはん、出来立てだよ。:
Good morning. Perfect timing.
Breakfast is fresh and ready.
translations.ありがとう……。こんな朝メシ、久しぶりだよ。:
Thanks... It's been so long
since I had a breakfast
like this.
translations.よかった。ほら、顔洗ってきて？:
I'm glad. Now go wash
your face, okay？
translations.おはよう。起きたね。朝ごはんが冷めちゃう前に食べちゃおう？:
Good morning. You're up!
Let's eat before breakfast
gets cold, okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……おはよう。ありがとう、朝メシ作ってくれたんだ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Morning.
Thanks for making breakfast.
translations.私もあなたと食べたかったから。どうぞ、召し上がれ。:
I wanted to eat with you,
too. Here you go, dig in!
translations.（これって新婚みたいだよな……）:
(Man, this really feels like
we're newlyweds...)
translations.どう、ほっぺた落ちちゃうでしょ？:
Well？ Delicious enough
to make your cheeks fall off？
translations.落ちる、落ちる！ うまい！:
Totally falling off!
It's so good!
translations.実はちょっとだけ、満足いってなくて。:
Truth is, I'm not totally
satisfied with it.
translations.大丈夫大丈夫、十分だって。:
It's fine, it's fine!
It's plenty good.
translations.少し自信なくて……ダメかな？:
I'm a little unsure of
myself... Is it no good？
translations.はは……まあ、ちゃんと食べるよ。:
Haha... Well, I'm definitely
gonna finish it.
translations.うん、あなたと一緒に食べたくて。:
Yep, I wanted to eat
together with you.
translations.パンがいいかなって思って。いっぱい食べてね。:
I thought toast would be
nice. Eat plenty, okay？
translations.おはよう。朝ごはん、一緒に食べよう？:
Morning. Let's eat breakfast
together, okay？
translations.おはよう、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。あぁ、パンのいい匂い……。:
Morning, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Ah, that toast smells
so good...
translations.朝はしっかり食べて元気つけなくちゃね。おかわりも用意してあるから。:
You need a solid breakfast
to get your energy up.
I've got seconds ready, too!
translations.今朝のごはんは会心の出来だよ。どう？:
This morning's breakfast
turned out perfectly.
How is it？
translations.朝からこんなにおいしい食事ができるなんて……●の幸せ者！:
Getting to eat this well
first thing in the morning...
● is one lucky guy!
translations.急いで作ったから、味つけが十分じゃないかも。:
I made it in a rush, so
the seasoning might not be
quite right.
translations.そんなことないって、結構おいしいよ。:
No way, it's actually
pretty good.
translations.少し焦って作っちゃったかも……。:
I think I rushed through it
a little too much...
translations.う……。大丈夫、食べられないわけじゃないから。:
Uh... Don't worry,
it's not like it's inedible.
translations.ねえ、今日って夕食どうするの？ 特に予定がなかったら私が作りに行こうかなと思うん:
Hey, what are you doing
for dinner tonight？
If you don't have plans,
I could come cook for you.
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も？ だったら一緒に帰ろう。:
Oh, you too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Then let's walk home together.
translations.それはもちろん。それとね、今日は私があなたのお家でご飯を作ってあげようかな、なん:
Of course. And, you know,
I was thinking maybe I could
cook dinner at your place tonight.
translations.いいわよ♪ ところで今晩……私がご飯作りに行ってあげるって言ったらどうする？:
I'd love to♪ By the way...
what would you say if I came
over to cook you dinner tonight？
translations.そっか……残念だけど、また今度にするね。:
I see... That's too bad,
but let's do it next time.
translations.ほんと？ よかったぁ、それじゃあスーパーでお買いものして帰ろうよ。:
Really？ Yay!
Then let's hit the supermarket
on the way home.
translations.ここのスーパーは、私の冷蔵庫みたいなものなんだから。:
This supermarket is basically
like my own fridge, you know.
translations.男の子と一緒だと、たくさん買い物しても楽ちんだね！:
Shopping with a guy makes
buying a bunch of stuff so easy!
translations.えっと……ああ、任せろ。: Uh... yeah, leave it to me.
translations.このスーパーってね、結構珍しい調味料なんかも置いてるんだよ。:
You know, this supermarket
actually carries some pretty
rare seasonings.
translations.で、今晩はなにが食べたいのかな？:
So, what do you feel like
eating tonight？
translations.今日は▲メニュー▲を食べたい気分だな。:
I'm kind of in the mood
for ▲メニュー▲ tonight.
translations.それ私の得意料理じゃない。バッチリ、任せといて♪:
Hey, that's my specialty!
Leave it all to me♪
translations.うん、それなら大丈夫そう。: Yeah, I think I can handle that.
translations.えっと……なんとかなるかな？: Um... I think I can manage？
translations.それじゃあ、材料揃えよっか。:
All right, let's grab
the ingredients.
translations.少し買いすぎたかな？ 持って帰るの大変そう。:
Did we buy a bit too much？
It looks like it'll be tough
carrying it all back.
translations.お疲れさま。結構時間かかっちゃったね。:
Thanks for carrying that.
That took quite a while,
didn't it？
translations.着いたー。あんま片付いてないけど、気にしないでくれよ。:
We made it. It's not really
cleaned up, but don't mind
the mess.
translations.いろいろチェックしちゃおうっかなぁ。:
Maybe I should inspect
every little corner~
translations.やっと着いたな、お疲れさん。:
We're finally here.
Thanks for hanging in there.
translations.あなたのほうこそ荷物いっぱいで大変だったでしょ？ お疲れさま。:
You're the one who had all
those heavy bags, right？
Good job, you.
translations.学校帰りに▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がご飯作りに来てくれるなんて、新鮮だな。:
Having ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ come over
to cook after school...
It feels so new.
translations.ほんと、考えてみたら初めてだね。:
Really, come to think of it,
this is the first time.
translations.ただいまぁ……あっ！ あなたの家なのにね、ふふ▼:
I'm home~ ...Wait!
This is your house, though.
Hehe▼
translations.さぁて、それじゃあ早速食事の支度するね。:
All right, I'll get started
on dinner right away.
translations.お腹空いたでしょ？ 急いで作るから、少し待っててね？:
You're hungry, right？
I'll hurry and make it,
so wait just a bit, okay？
translations.それじゃあ材料も揃ってることだし、始めるね。:
Well, we've got all
the ingredients, so I'll
get started!
translations.今日はありがとう。おかげで大満足！:
Thanks for today!
That totally hit the spot!
translations.どういたしまして。また作りに来るね？:
You're very welcome.
I'll come cook for you
again, okay？
translations.うん。それじゃ、今日は遅くなったし送ってくよ。:
Yeah. Well, it's late,
so I'll walk you home.
translations.ひとりで帰れるから気にしないで。じゃ、またね。:
I can get home on my own,
so don't worry. See you later!
translations.今日は楽しかったな。ご飯も美味しかったよ、ありがとう。:
Today was a lot of fun.
Dinner was delicious too,
thanks!
translations.いえいえ、どういたしまして。いい子にしてれば、また作ってあげるから。:
No, no, you're welcome.
If you're a good boy,
I'll cook for you again.
translations.じゃあ、いい子だから送ってくよ。:
Then since I'm a good boy,
I'll walk you home.
translations.いいのよ、気を遣わないで。あなたはこのままゆっくり休んでて。じゃあね……バイバイ:
It's fine, don't fuss.
You just rest up, okay？
See you... Bye-bye.
translations.あー、今日はいい日だった！ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のおかげだよ。:
Man, today was great!
All thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.どういたしまして。またいつでも作りに来てあげるからね▼:
You're welcome.
I can come cook for you
anytime▼
translations.ありがとう。……さ、じゃあ行こうか。:
Thanks. ...All right,
shall we head out？
translations.あ、送らなくても大丈夫。そんなことしたらまた疲れちゃうでしょ？ それじゃあ、ここ:
Oh, you don't have to walk me.
You'll just tire yourself out,
right？ So... bye-bye!
translations.落ち着いた？ 今日はやっぱり送っていくよ。:
Feeling better？
I'm definitely walking you
home tonight.
translations.うん……甘えさせてもらうね。:
Yeah...
I'll take you up on that, then.
translations.私が日記付けてることって話したっけ。:
Did I ever mention
that I keep a diary？
translations.あー、どうだったかな。:
Ah, did you？
I can't remember.
translations.割と面白いのよ？:
It's actually pretty fun,
you know？
translations.そう。しばらく経ってから読み返すと、ちょっと客観視できたりして、新鮮なの。:
Yeah. Reading it back later
gives you perspective,
so it feels fresh.
translations.へえ、どんなこと書いてるの？:
Huh, what kind of things
do you write？
translations.（……なんだ？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の日記か、気になるな……）:
(...Wait, what？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s diary...
Now I'm really curious...)
translations.鳴かぬなら 代わりに鳴くね▼ ホトトギス:
If you won't sing,
I'll sing instead,▼
little cuckoo.
translations.あんじょう、おきばりやす。:
Hang in there, now.
Do your best~
translations.いつも開幕直後は調子いいのね。:
You're always on a roll
right out of the gate.
translations.『おあしす運動』。おはよう。ありがとね。失礼しちゃうわ。好きよ。:
The 'Oasis' campaign.
Good morning. Thanks.
How rude! ...I love you.
translations.飴の匂いがするからアメンボって言うんだよ。:
Water striders are called
'amenbo' because they smell
sweet like candy, you know？
translations.タヌキの目の周りの模様って、つながってないのね……。:
The rings around a tanuki's
eyes don't actually connect,
do they...？
translations.色は匂えど散りぬるを。:
Even blooming flowers
must scatter and fade...
translations.やっほー！ ……あれ、どうして返ってこないのかな？:
Yoo-hoo! ...Huh, how come
it's not echoing back？
translations.草葉の陰から見守ってるからね。:
I'll be watching over you
from beyond the grave~
translations.お手！ お座り！ 三回まわってワン！:
Paw! Sit! Turn around
three times and bark!
translations.ウニが食べたいの……お腹壊すぐらいたくさん。:
I want sea urchin...
So much that it gives me
a stomachache.
translations.こんなに育って……。もっと大きくなぁれ。:
You've grown so much...
Grow even bigger now~
translations.新種発見、アライグマングース！:
New species discovered:
the Raccoon Mongoose!
translations.罪な男を愛しすギルティ▼:
Guilty of loving
such a wicked man▼
translations.イヤ！ 貝殻だけは絶対にイヤ！:
No! Anything but seashells,
absolutely not!
translations.蛇口から絞りたて豆乳!?:
Fresh soy milk
straight from the tap!？
translations.たわわに実ったカブトムシ♪:
A bountiful harvest of
rhino beetles♪
translations.通販番組にカメオ出演ですって!?:
A cameo on a shopping
channel, you say!？
translations.じゃあ、そろそろドロンするね。:
Well, time for me to
vanish like a ninja~
translations.婚約指輪がチクワか……。:
An engagement ring made
out of chikuwa, huh...
translations.極度のマヨラーなんです。:
I'm an extreme mayo addict,
you know.
translations.最終回は２時間スペシャルだったの？:
Was the finale
a two-hour special？
translations.よく見たら、菩薩のようなキス顔。:
Looking closely, that
kissing face looks like
a Bodhisattva.
translations.すごいよ！ その秘めたポテンシャル。:
It's incredible!
That hidden potential
of yours.
translations.その拳、毘沙門天みたい。:
Those fists of yours
look just like
Bishamonten's.
translations.りんご飴、青と赤どっちが好き？:
Candy apples...
Do you prefer blue or red？
translations.最近、恋人の癖が気になるんです。それよ、それ。:
Lately, I've been noticing
my boyfriend's habits...
Right there, that's the one!
translations.いらっしゃいませ、何名様ですか？ 申し訳ありません、お帰りくださいませ。:
Welcome! Table for how many？
I'm terribly sorry,
now please leave.
translations.あれ、同じ靴下が３足ある。:
Huh？ I have three pairs
of the exact same socks.
translations.来年の今日は何曜日？:
What day of the week
will it be today next year？
translations.おそろいの髪型にしてみない？ 似合う似合う、絶対……無理。:
Wanna try matching hairstyles？
It'll look great, totally...
Never mind, no way.
translations.後ろ回りなんて絶対無理！:
A backward roll？
No way, totally impossible!
translations.新しい紙飛行機の折り方、発見したの。:
I discovered a new way
to fold paper airplanes!
translations.なんで日本海側まで来ちゃったの!?:
Why did we end up all the way
out by the Sea of Japan!?
translations.明日はどっち？ こっち？ ……え、そっち？:
Which way is tomorrow？
This way？
...Wait, that way？
translations.ねえ、頭から煙出てるよ？:
Hey, there's smoke
coming out of your head, you know？
translations.長ネギダイエット、あなたも試してみない？:
Wanna try the green onion diet
with me？
translations.しょうがないから５点あげる。:
Fine, I'll give you
five points.
translations.月まであと３００メートル……。:
Just three hundred meters
to the moon...
translations.目玉焼きにもマヨネーズなんだ……。:
Mayonnaise on fried eggs,
too, huh...
translations.いまならネギがもう一本ついてくる！:
Act now and you'll get
an extra green onion!
translations.しょせんイワシよね……弱いわ。:
They're just sardines, after all...
So weak.
translations.地下２階から目薬。:
Eye drops from the second
basement floor.
translations.まさか地下鉄の中で迷子になるなんて……。:
I never thought I'd get lost
inside the subway...
translations.この流しそうめんから逃げられるかな？:
Think you can escape
from this flowing somen？
translations.丑三つ時に宅配ピザ？: Delivery pizza at the witching hour？
translations.私の家だけ集中豪雨……。:
It's a torrential downpour...
only over my house...
translations.布団が離してくれないの。彼は見捨てられないよ……。:
The futon won't let me go.
I can't just abandon him...
translations.そんなにこんにゃくばっかり食べさせてどうするの？:
What are you trying to do,
stuffing me with so much konjac？
translations.コーヒーにあんこは無理……。でもカフェオレにだったら……。:
Red bean paste in coffee is a no...
Wait, in a cafe au lait, though...？
translations.ちょっと細胞分裂していい？:
Mind if I do some cell division
real quick？
translations.私の超能力で、豆大福の豆を２倍にしてあげよっか。:
Should I use my psychic powers
to double the beans in your daifuku？
translations.Ｂ級グルメ、食べ尽くし！ Ａ級グルメ、食べ残し！:
Ate all the cheap eats!
Left the fancy stuff behind!
translations.ホット中華、はじめました。:
Hot Chinese noodles,
now being served!
translations.いい方の噂と悪い方の噂、どっちが先がいい？:
Good rumor or bad rumor,
which one do you want first？
translations.ツインテールじゃなくて、ツーテールって言うのよ？:
They're called two-tails,
not twintails, you know？
translations.メンマと穂先メンマとザーサイ、全部入れてください。:
Bamboo shoots, tender tips,
and zha cai—put them all in, please.
translations.温泉の素を３つブレンドして入れて？:
Could you mix three kinds
of bath salts together for the tub？
translations.体脂肪よ、燃え尽きろ～！:
Burn down to nothing,
body fat~!
translations.医療用包帯でターバン。カレー。:
Medical bandages for a turban.
Curry.
translations.身分証明書は、このレシートだけ。: My only ID is this receipt.
translations.なんて、商売っ気のない人なの！: Talk about someone with zero business sense!
translations.ローマ字入力派？ かな入力派？:
Are you team Romaji,
or team Kana？
translations.ぽんぽん、おなか痛いぽん！: Tummy, my tummy hurts so bad!
translations.あなたの物は私の物、私の物はあなたの物。:
What's yours is mine,
and what's mine is yours.
translations.どうしたの？ 藪からスティックに。:
What's got into you？
Talk about out of the blue... stick.
translations.同化しちゃいそう……。: I feel like I'm blending right in...
translations.イエスかはいかノーかいいえで答えて。: Answer with yes, yeah, no, or nope.
translations.あなたはカレシのミラーだね。: You're a real mirror of a boyfriend, huh.
translations.絶対なんて絶対にないよ。: There's absolutely no such thing as an absolute.
translations.御用だ御用だー。私用だー。算用だー。:
Official business!
Personal business! Counting business!
translations.若気の至りね、私にも覚えがあるわ。:
Youthful folly, huh...
I know the feeling.
translations.寝言は寝てから寝てね。: Save your sleep-talk for after you fall asleep, okay？
translations.ううん、知らないけど絶対そう。よくわからないけど、絶対そう。:
Nope, I don't know,
but it definitely is.
I don't really get it, but totally.
translations.サルもツリーからフォールね。: Even monkeys 'fall' from the 'tree', you know？
translations.ひとなみにおごってちょうだい？: Treat me to something decent, won't you？
translations.しっぺ、でこぴん、膝カックン。:
Wrist slap, forehead flick,
and a knee buckle.
translations.おかえりなさい。水攻めにする？\n兵糧攻めにする？:
Welcome home.
Would you like a water siege？
Or a starvation siege？
translations.あ、枝毛につぼみが……。: Ah, my split end is budding...
translations.カロリーそのまま、おいしさオフ。:
All the calories,
none of the flavor.
translations.赤カピバラ青カピバラ黄カピバラ。:
Red capybara,
blue capybara,
yellow capybara.
translations.だるまさんが転んだ！ しかし立った、立ち上がりました！:
Daruma fell down!
...Wait, he's up!
He's back on his feet!
translations.おとといもまた見てね！:
Be sure to tune in
the day before yesterday, too!
translations.いや、見ないで！ 大塩平八郎の乱。:
No, don't look!
The Rebellion of Oshio Heihachiro.
translations.うーん、そのウォーキングはギリギリアウト。: Hmm, that walk is just barely out.
translations.弁慶の泣きボクロってなに？: What in the world is Benkei's beauty mark？
translations.長いものにはマカロニ、マイケルが勝ち、メイドのもみあげ！: Yield to macaroni, Michael wins, a maid's sideburns!
translations.寝起きに麻婆茄子が食べたいなあ。: I really want some mapo eggplant right when I wake up.
translations.今日は雲一つない良い天気。絶好の雨乞い日和♪:
Not a cloud in the sky today.
Perfect weather for a rain
dance♪
translations.炭酸飲料にのど飴……やっちゃだめだよ？:
Soda and throat lozenges...
You'd better not try it,
okay？
translations.白雪姫と七人の…………侍？:
Snow White and the Seven...
Samurai？
translations.おばあさんが川で洗濯をしていると、川上から大ーきなネネがどんぶらこ、どんぶらこ…:
As grandma was washing
clothes in the river, a huuuge
Nene came bobbing down the
stream, tumbling along...
translations.ねーねー、ネネ、ねむっていいよね？:
Hey, hey... Nene can go
to sleep now, right？
translations.ランナー走ったー！ 走ったー！\nセカンドに……抱きついたー！:
The runner goes! He goes!
And dives into a hug with
second base!
translations.私の背後をとったのは、あなたがはじめて。今日からあなたが私の背後霊ね？:
You're the first one to ever
get behind me. Guess you're
my haunting spirit starting
today, okay？
translations.速すぎて見えなかったパンチが今は見えるの。次にやったら、負けないわ。:
I can see those punches now
—the ones that were too fast
before. Next time,
I won't lose.
translations.小学校のときに足が速い子って、それだけでもてるよね。:
Kids who were fast runners
in elementary school were
always popular just for that,
weren't they？
translations.うーん、そこのキミ、採用！ おとといから来てね。:
Hmm, you over there, you're
hired! Report for duty
the day before yesterday.
translations.官製はがきに、住所・氏名・年齢・誰にも知られたくない秘密を書いて第三者に送ってね:
Write your name, address,
age, and deepest secret on
a postcard, then mail it
to a stranger, okay？
translations.ニンジンは？ この辺にぶら下げとけばいいの？:
What about the carrot？
Should I dangle it right
around here？
translations.入部の記念品は酢酸ビニル樹脂エマルジョン接着剤です。:
Your welcome gift for joining
the club is polyvinyl acetate
emulsion adhesive.
translations.やけぼっくいに火がついたのね？:
So an old flame has
rekindled, has it？
translations.廊下に立ってなさい！ あたたかくして風邪なんてひかないようにしなさい！:
Go stand in the hallway!
And bundle up so you
don't catch a cold!
translations.ワンス・アポン・ア・タイム・イン・とわの。:
Once Upon a Time
in Towano.
translations.一発屋の座右の銘「継続は力なり」。:
A one-hit wonder's motto:
'Persistence pays off.'
translations.ご飯のおかずにたらこ、これでがんばれる？:
Tarako to go with your rice.
Will that keep you going？
translations.晴雨兼用折りたたみ傘、これでがんばれる？:
A folding umbrella for rain
or shine. Will that keep
you going？
translations.プリンの牛乳１．５倍、これでがんばれる？:
Pudding with 1.5 times the
milk. Will that keep you
going？
translations.店内ＢＧＭがロックンロール、これでがんばれる？:
Rock 'n' roll playing on the
store BGM. Will that keep
you going？
translations.シャッフル再生で奇跡の並び、これでがんばれる？:
A miraculous track order on
shuffle. Will that keep
you going？
translations.雑誌の発売が１日前、これでがんばれる？:
Your magazine out a day early.
Will that keep you going？
translations.ケーブルの長さがぴったり、これでがんばれる？:
A cable that's the exact right
length. Will that keep you
going？
translations.二度寝三度寝四度寝五度寝、これでがんばれる？:
Snoozing, then snoozing again,
and again, and again...
Will that keep you going？
translations.ブルーレイ化、これでがんばれる？:
Getting a Blu-ray release.
Will that keep you going？
translations.目と目で通じ合ったら、これでがんばれる？:
Locking eyes and understanding
each other... Will that keep
you going？
translations.うん、私もそうしたいなって思ってたの。思いが届いたのかな？:
Yeah, I was just thinking
the same thing.
Did my thoughts reach you？
translations.家に帰ってから用事があるの。一緒に帰るだけにしよ、ごめんね。:
I've got things to do once
I get home. Let's just walk
back together, sorry.
translations.わかった。じゃあ、行こうか。: Got it. Shall we head out, then？
translations.うん、いいところだよね。そこで決まり。:
Yeah, that's a good spot.
It's settled, then!
translations.うん、いいよ、そこで。: Yeah, that sounds good to me.
translations.大丈夫、きっと楽しいって。:
Don't worry,
I'm sure it'll be fun!
translations.そうね。せっかく誘ってくれたんだもん、行こうかな。:
You're right. Since you took
the time to ask, let's go!
translations.用事あるから、ごめん。一緒に帰るくらいはできるけど。:
Sorry, I have errands to run.
We can at least walk
home together, though.
translations.じゃあ、今日はそれで我慢するよ。:
Guess I'll settle for that
for today.
translations.ふーん、そこで来ましたか。いいよ、合格。:
Hmm, that's what you picked？
All right, you pass.
translations.そう？ よかった。じゃあここで。:
Really？ Good.
Let's go with that, then.
translations.うん、そこが無難じゃないかな？:
Yeah, seems like a safe bet,
doesn't it？
translations.行ってみようよ、な。: Come on, let's give it a shot.
translations.どうしてこのタイミングでそんなこと言えるのかな？ 私、帰る。:
How could you say something
like that right now？
I'm going home.
translations.まっすぐ帰っちゃうの？ ねえ、もしよかったら、どこかに遊びに行かない？:
Heading straight home？
Hey, if you'd like, wanna go
hang out somewhere？
translations.そういう気分じゃないから: I'm not really in the mood.
translations.本当？ よかった。急だったから。:
Really？ Yay!
I know it was short notice.
translations.●はいつでもＯＫだよ。さて、どこに行こうか？:
I'm always free for you,
●.
So, where should we go？
translations.そっか、急だったもんね……。一緒に帰るのはいいかな？:
I see, it was pretty sudden...
Can we at least walk
home together？
translations.あ、いた。遅いから、心配しちゃった。:
Ah, there you are.
You took so long,
I was getting worried.
translations.もうこんな時間か。ごめん。:
Is it that time already？
Sorry about that.
translations.カノジョに足を運ばせるなんて、どういうつもり？:
Making your girlfriend come
all the way to you...
What's the big idea, mister？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……。ごめん、用意が遅れて。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Sorry,
I was running late getting ready.
translations.こら。まだ準備できてなかったの？ 早くしなさい？:
Hey, now. Still not ready？
Hurry it up, okay？
translations.わざわざ来てくれたんだ。ごめん。:
You came all this way.
Sorry about that.
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ わざわざ来てくれたの？:
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Did you come all the way
here for me？
translations.このほうが長く一緒にいられるから。:
This way, we get to be
together a little longer.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ 言ってくれたらこっちから行ったのに。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ If you'd told me,
I would've come over to you.
translations.いいの、私が来たかったんだから。:
It's fine. I wanted to
come see you anyway.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。迎えに来たよ、待ちきれなかったから。:
▲主人公＊▲! I came to get you
'cause I couldn't wait.
translations.ありがとう。すぐ準備するから。:
Thanks. I'll get ready
right away.
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、迎えに来てくれたんだ。:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you came to meet me.
translations.……あの子、うちのクラスの子にしつこく迫ってたから、ちょっと。それだけよ？:
...He wouldn't leave a girl
in my class alone, so I...
had a little talk with him.
That's all, really？
translations.どうも。ふーん、かわいいねー。:
Hey there. Hmmm,
he's pretty cute.
translations.ダメよ、取っちゃ。私のなんだから。:
Hands off, now.
He's all mine.
translations.（あれ？ いない。確かに声が聞こえたよな？）:
(Huh？ She's not here.
I'm sure I heard
her voice, though...？)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。どこにいたの？ ●のこと、何度も呼んでたよね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Where were you？
You kept calling out
for ●, didn't you？
translations.？ ううん、一度しか呼んでないよ？:
？ No, I only called
for you once？
translations.後ろ姿が似てたから……ごめんね。:
You looked so similar
from behind... Sorry about that.
translations.（たしかにみんな同じ制服だけどね……）:
(I mean, we do all wear
the same uniform, but...)
translations.なあ、この人がお前のカノジョなんだよな。:
Hey, this is your girlfriend,
right？
translations.こんな美人のお姉さん、どうやってゲットしたんだよ！ 教えてくれー！:
How'd you score such
a gorgeous older girl！？
Tell me your secrets!
translations.どうやってゲットしたんだっけ？ 教えてあげたら？:
How did you "score" me,
again？ Why not tell him？
translations.ねえ、あの子達、あなたの噂してるみたいね？:
Hey, sounds like those girls
are gossiping about you？
translations.●じゃなくて、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のだろ。:
It's not about ●,
it's about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ なにしてたの？:
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
What were you doing？
translations.……うん、あそこにいる二人ね。うちのクラスの仲良しカップルなんだ。:
...See those two over there？
They're a lovey-dovey couple
from my class.
translations.えっ!? 違うのよ、ちょっと、ほら参考にしたいって思って……。:
Wh-What!? No! I just,
you know... thought it'd be
good reference...
translations.あそこの男子、なんかこっち見てるよな？:
That guy over there...
Is it just me, or is he
looking this way？
translations.あっ……この前、告白されたの、あの人に。:
Ah... He actually confessed
to me the other day.
translations.もちろん断ったよ。だって、私にはあなたがいるんだから。でしょ？:
Of course I turned him down.
After all, I have you. Right？
translations.あ、来た来た。わたしの勝ち。: Ah, there he is! I win.
translations.また、負けかー。じゃあね、そっちもデート楽しんで！:
Aww, another loss! Well,
see ya, have fun on your
date too!
translations.友達とね、どっちのカレシが先に来るか、競争してたの。:
My friend and I were racing
to see whose boyfriend would
get here first.
translations.そうなの、ペンケースに付けてたマスコット。気に入ってたのにな。:
Yeah, the charm from my
pencil case. I really liked
that one, too.
translations.探しても見つからないなら、職員室で聞いてみたら？:
If you can't find it, why not
check the staff room？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ ただ、誰のかなって……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ I was just
wondering whose it was...
translations.あ、それ私のです！ よかったぁ、見つかって。:
Ah, that's mine!
Thank goodness it turned up!
translations.はい、どうぞ。のぞき屋の魔の手から、守っておいたから。:
Here you go. I kept it safe
from this peeping Tom's
clutches.
translations.あれ、ハンカチ落としたかな？:
Huh, did I drop my
handkerchief？
translations.お待たせ。ハンカチ、あなたのじゃない？:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Isn't this handkerchief yours？
translations.ああ、それ！ よく●のだってわかったね。:
Ah, that's it! How did you
know it was ●'s？
translations.あなたの持ち物はぜーんぶ覚えてるんだから。:
Because I've memorized ev-er-y
single thing of yours.
translations.何か予定あったの？:
Did you have plans for
something？
translations.……うーん、あなたとのデートは手帳に書いてるし……きっとなんでもないよ。大丈夫。:
...Hmm, our date is in my
planner, so... it's probably
nothing. All good.
translations.メールだ、ちょっと待ってね。……ふふっ。:
Got a text, hold on a sec.
...Hehe.
translations.駄菓子屋のおばちゃんから。「このあめ玉、まだ知らないでしょ？」って、写真付きで。:
It's from the candy shop lady.
She sent a photo saying, 'I bet
you haven't tried this candy!'
translations.（駄菓子屋さんから新商品の連絡が来るのか……）:
(She gets updates on new
sweets from the candy shop...？)
translations.どう、びっくりした？ 注意をそらす作戦♪:
Well, did I get you？
Operation Distraction♪
translations.（歩きながら本読んでる？ にしても、すごい集中力だな……）:
(Is she reading while walking？
Talk about intense focus...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ そっち、壁！:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ Look out,
that's a wall！
translations.……危なかった。ありがとう、声かけてくれて。:
……That was close.
Thanks for warning me.
translations.歩き読みはやめといたほうがいいよ……危ないから。:
You shouldn't read while
walking... It's dangerous.
translations.マグレだけど……愛のなせるワザ、かな？:
Total fluke, though...
Maybe it's the power
of love？
translations.ごめんなさい。購買部にカツサンドが残ってるの見つけたから、つい……。:
Sorry! I saw a katsu
sandwich left at the school
store and I just had to...
translations.カツサンドが？ いつも昼休みのあいだに完売しちゃうのに。:
A katsu sandwich？
Those always sell out
during lunch break, though.
translations.ね、ミラクルなの。あの味を再現できたらデキシーズの新メニューに出せるかも。:
Right？ It's a miracle.
If I can recreate it,
maybe Dixie's could add it
to the menu.
translations.いいなそれ。: I like the sound of that.
translations.帰り際、一緒に買い物行こうって誘われちゃって。:
Someone invited me to go
shopping on my way out.
translations.そう、女子の友達です。……もしかして、心配してくれた？:
Yep, a girl friend.
...Wait, were you worried
about me？
translations.まあね。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を狙ってるヤツ、多そうだから……。:
Kind of. Seems like a lot
of guys have their eye on
you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.カノジョ待ち？ きれいなカノジョだよねー。:
Waiting for your girlfriend？
She's really pretty.
translations.だって、女の子と楽しそうに笑ってしゃべってたじゃない？:
Well, you looked pretty
happy chatting and laughing
with that girl, didn't you？
translations.誤解だって、誤解！:
You've got it all wrong,
seriously！
translations.ああ、バイバイ。お待たせ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
Yeah, bye.
Sorry to keep you waiting,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.私が先に声かけたのに、お友達のほうに先に返事した……。:
I said something first,
but you answered your
friend before me...
translations.……私、あなたのことだとムキになっちゃうみたい。だめね、反省します。:
...I guess I get worked
up when it comes to you.
That's no good,
I'll reflect on that.
translations.びっくりさせてごめんね……。さっき読んでた本に感動して……。:
Sorry to startle you...
I was just so moved by
the book I was reading...
translations.うわ、あいつ女泣かせてる……修羅場か？:
Whoa, he made a girl
cry... Trouble in paradise？
translations.それじゃ、行こうか……あ！:
Well then, shall we go...
Ah！
translations.野良タヌキがいたの。あーん、写真撮りたかった！:
There was a stray tanuki!
Aw, I really wanted to
take a picture!
translations.（タヌキ……見間違いかなあ）:
(A tanuki... Was she just
seeing things？)
translations.この匂いは……カレーかな？ 料理部が作ってんのかな……。:
That smell... Is it curry？
Wonder if the cooking club
is making some...
translations.こんなところで油売ってちゃだめでしょ。もう待ちあわせの時間だよ？:
You can't be dawdling
around here. It's already
time to meet, you know？
translations.いやあ、カレーの匂いに誘われちゃって。:
Haha, the smell of curry
just lured me in.
translations.え？ ……本当。美味しそうな匂い。ちょっと覗いてみる？:
Huh？ ...You're right.
Smells delicious!
Want to take a peek？
translations.はは、今日はデートだろ？:
Haha, we're on a date
today, remember？
translations.ごめん。本当に、ごめんね。……ちょっと相談されて、なかなか切り上げられなくて。:
I'm sorry. Really, I'm so
sorry. ...Someone came to me
for advice, and I just
couldn't cut it short.
translations.そっか、でも、誰だよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲をこんなに引きとめて……。:
I see. But who was it,
keeping ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ for so long...？
translations.うちの先生、話が長いから……。:
My teacher talks forever,
you know...
translations.（先生にまで相談されるのか、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……。）:
(Even teachers come to
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ for advice...)
translations.（……あそこにいるの、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だよな。なんでこっち来ないんだ？）:
(...That's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ over there,
right？ Why isn't she coming
over？)
translations.「校門で待ちぼうけになってるカレシ」の観察。かわいかったよ。:
Observing 'my boyfriend
waiting alone at the gate.'
You were adorable.
translations.（待ちぼうけって……どれくらい待たせるつもりだったんだろう）:
('Waiting alone'... How long
was she planning to keep me
waiting？)
translations.プリントなら、全員分集めて、職員室の机の上に置いておきましたよ。:
If it's about the handouts,
I collected everyone's and
left them on your desk in
the staff room.
translations.そうだったか！ いやあ、助かったよ！:
Oh, right!
Man, you're a lifesaver!
translations.（びっくりした。先生も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に頼りすぎだろ……）:
(That startled me.
Even teachers rely on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
way too much...)
translations.なんか、あっちでケンカしてるみたいだな……。ちょっと離れよう。:
Looks like there's a fight
over there...
Let's move away.
translations.なんとか巻き込まれずに済んだな。:
Glad we didn't get
dragged into that.
translations.暴力って、苦手……。見てるだけで怖くなっちゃう。:
I really hate violence...
Just watching it scares me.
translations.はいっ、じゃあ、気分変えて、楽しもう！:
Alright! Let's shake it off
and have some fun!
translations.●もいつかあんな風にスーツ着て働くのかな……。:
I wonder if ● will wear
a suit and work like that
someday, too...
translations.なんで、そんなつまらなそうに言うの？:
Why do you say that like
it's such a bummer？
translations.じゃあ、そのときは私がネクタイ締めてあげる。:
Well, when that time comes,
I'll tie your necktie
for you.
translations.ほんと？ 急に楽しみになってきた。:
Really？ Now I'm actually
looking forward to it.
translations.●たちの他にもカップルがいるな。:
Looks like there are other
couples besides ●
and me.
translations.そうだね。でもちょっと微妙な距離じゃない？ まだ友達関係かな？:
Yeah. But isn't their
distance a little awkward？
Maybe they're just friends？
translations.いやあ、あの距離感はカップルでしょ。:
Nah, at that distance,
they've gotta be a couple.
translations.じゃあ私は友達同士に１票。:
Then my vote goes to
just friends.
translations.……あのカップル、こんなとこで堂々とキスしてる……。:
...That couple is really
making out right in public...
translations.じろじろ見ちゃダメ。もう……マナー違反だよね、ああいうの。:
Don't stare. Jeez...
doing that in public is
really bad manners.
translations.そうだな。人目があるとか思わないのかね。:
Yeah. Don't they care
that people are watching？
translations.あなたも気をつけてね。すぐ周りが見えなくなっちゃうでしょ？:
You watch out too, okay？
You tend to get totally
lost in the moment.
translations.見て、あの人、なんとなくあなたに似てる。:
Look, that guy kind of
looks like you.
translations.似てるよ。鼻のあたりとか。口のあたりとか、目も？:
He does! Around the nose...
and the mouth...
and maybe the eyes too？
translations.それって、もう何となくじゃないんじゃ。:
That's way more than
just 'kind of', isn't it？
translations.ううん、それでもなんとなくだよ。こうやって比べたら、あなたの方が断然素敵だから。:
Nope, still just kind of.
Comparing you two, you're
way more handsome anyway.
translations.……あの男の人、さっき校門前で走ってなかった？ こんなところまできたのかな？:
...Wasn't that guy running
by the school gate earlier？
Did he run all the way here？
translations.そっか、男の人もダイエットするのね。うんうん。:
I see, so guys diet too.
Mm-hmm, makes sense.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はジョギングはダイエットと直結なんだな……）:
(To ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, jogging always
means dieting, huh...)
translations.おねえさーん。今、一人？:
Hey, miss!
You by yourself right now？
translations.守ってくれてありがとう。カッコよかったよ。:
Thanks for protecting me.
You looked really cool.
translations.（……うわ。あの女の人、すごい格好……）:
(...Whoa. That woman's
outfit is something else...)
translations.私もあんなセクシーな服、着てみようかな。:
Maybe I should try
wearing something sexy
like that too.
translations.そしたら、あなたが他の女の子をチラチラ見なくなるかなーって。どう？:
I just thought that way
you'd stop sneaking peeks
at other girls. What do you say？
translations.あれ、あそこの物陰に何か……。:
Huh？ Is there something
in the shadows over there...？
translations.きゃっ！\n幽霊だったらどうしたらいい？ 十字架とか？:
Eek!
What if it's a ghost？
A crucifix or something？
translations.（それは違う気が……）:
(Pretty sure that's
not how it works...)
translations.ごめんね、デート中に。急いで終わらせるから。:
Sorry, in the middle of
our date. I'll make it quick.
translations.え？ 間違い電話だったんだ？: Huh？ It was a wrong number？
translations.うん。また電話してもいいですかって言われちゃった。お断りしたけど。:
Yeah. He even asked if he
could call again.
I turned him down, though.
translations.（間違い電話でナンパか……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲モテ過ぎだよ……）:
(Hit on via wrong number...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is way too popular...)
translations.あの人、お腹に赤ちゃんがいたんだよ。:
She has a baby in her
tummy, you know.
translations.えっ!? わかんなかった、体型かと……。:
Huh!? I had no idea,
I thought it was just her build...
translations.こら！ そんなデリカシーがないこと言わないの。:
Hey!
Don't say such insensitive things.
translations.今日、スーパーで半額セールの日だったの……。しょうがないか。:
Today was the half-off sale
at the supermarket...
Oh well, can't be helped.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、節約術もばっちり心得てそうだな……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seems to really know
how to pinch pennies...)
translations.さっきすれ違った女の子、爪にバッテン描いてたの気づいた？ あれは恋が実りますよう:
Did you notice that girl
we just passed had an X on her nail？
It's a little charm to make
your love come true.
translations.へえ……女の子ってそういうの、好きだよな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もやったりする？:
Huh... Girls really love that
kind of thing.
Do you do stuff like that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私はやらないよ？ 必要ないでしょ？:
Not me？
I don't need to, do I？
translations.そうだ、ＡＴＭ寄ってもいい？:
Oh, do you mind if I stop by
the ATM real quick？
translations.もちろん。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って預金の管理しっかりしてそうだよな。:
Sure. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you seem like
you're really on top of your savings.
translations.そんなことない、普通よ？ 家計簿はつけてるけど。:
Not at all, I'm pretty average.
Though I do keep a budget book.
translations.（家計簿つける女子高生は普通なのかな……）:
(Is it really normal for a high school
girl to keep a budget book...？)
translations.あ……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、こっち。生活指導の先生がいた！:
Ah... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, over here.
It's the disciplinary teacher!
translations.ふーん……。悪いことしてないのに、どうして隠れるの？:
Hmm... We're not doing anything
wrong, so why are you hiding？
translations.そういえば……なんでだろ。なんとなく……。:
Now that you mention it...
Why am I？ Just instinct, I guess...
translations.あっ、はい。その、お邪魔しましたー！: Ah, right! Um, sorry to interrupt!
translations.どうしたのかな？ 逃げるみたいに……。:
I wonder what that was about？
It was like he ran away...
translations.明日、学校で会えるのに……寂しいね。後で電話かメールしてもいい？:
Even though we'll see each other
at school tomorrow... I still feel lonely.
Can I call or text you later？
translations.さよならだけど……でも、また明日会えるもんね。:
It's goodbye for now...
but we'll see each other again tomorrow.
translations.明日もあなたに会いたいな。休みなんだし、ずっと一緒にいられるよ。:
I want to see you tomorrow, too.
It's our day off, so we can be
together the whole time.
translations.じゃあね。明日お休みだけど、ダラダラしちゃダメよ？:
Bye-bye. It's our day off tomorrow,
but no lazing around, okay？
translations.わかってるって。じゃあ、またね。: I know, I know. See you later.
translations.じゃあまた、休み明けに……。: See you after the break, then...
translations.また連絡するよ。それじゃ。: I'll be in touch. See ya.
translations.ね、ここで食べよっか。ほら、ゆっくりできそう。:
Hey, let's eat here.
Looks nice and peaceful.
translations.お弁当、ここで食べる？: Want to eat our lunch here？
translations.和風にしてみたんだけど、どうかな？:
I made it Japanese-style.
What do you think？
translations.いいね、お袋の味。いただきます！:
Awesome, home-style cooking!
Let's dig in!
translations.じゃーん。和風にしてみました！:
Ta-da!
I went with Japanese style!
translations.いいね、やっぱり和食だよな。いただきまーす！:
Sweet, you can't beat
Japanese food. Let's dig in!
translations.はい、お弁当。これでも頑張ったんだよ。:
Here's your lunch.
I worked pretty hard on it,
you know.
translations.すごい。洋食屋みたいだ。:
Whoa, awesome.
Looks like a Western diner.
translations.洋風のお弁当です。今日は彩りに凝ってみました……どうかな？:
Western-style lunch today.
I focused on the colors...
What do you think？
translations.へー、食べるのもったいないくらいだよ。……食べるけど！:
Whoa, it almost looks
too good to eat.
...Not stopping me, though!
translations.今日は中華風なんだけど、大丈夫だった？:
I went with Chinese today.
Hope you don't mind？
translations.全然問題なし！ いただきます！:
Not at all, love it!
Let's dig in!
translations.今日は中華です。たーんと召し上がれ？:
It's Chinese today.
Eat up, okay？
translations.はい、お弁当。愛情のスパイスきかせてみたよ▼:
Here's your lunch.
I seasoned it with lots
of love▼
translations.お弁当を食べてもらうのって、何度経験してもちょっと緊張するな。:
Having you eat my lunch...
No matter how often I do it,
I still get nervous.
translations.そうなの、美味そうじゃん。いただきまっす！:
Really？ It looks great,
though. Let's dig in!
translations.じゃあ、恋人同士のお約束……食べさせてあげよっか？:
So, couple tradition...
Want me to feed you？
translations.恥ずかしがらないで、口を開けるの。はい、あーん。:
Don't be shy, open wide.
Say ahh~
translations.ふーん、じゃあ、もうしてあげない。:
Hmph. Fine, I won't
do it anymore then.
translations.断るんだ。ふーん、だったらいいもん。:
Turning me down, huh？
Hmph, fine, be that way.
translations.そんなの認めません。はい、あーん。:
I'm not accepting that!
Now, say ahh~
translations.しょうがない。恥ずかしがりやさんだもんね。:
Oh well. You've always been
such a shy boy.
translations.ふーん、そうなんだあ。……いいよ、自分で食べるから。:
Hmph, is that so...
Fine, I'll just eat it myself.
translations.ごちそうさま。うますぎて、もう、なんて言っていいかわかんないよ。:
Thanks for the food!
It was so good,
I don't know what to say.
translations.もう、そんなに喜んでくれると嬉しいっ！:
Aw, you make me so happy
when you love it that much!
translations.ごちそうさま。やっぱり▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理は最高だな。:
Thanks for the food.
Your cooking really is
the best, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ほんと？ じゃあ、これからは最高の上を目指さなきゃいけないね。:
Really？ Then I guess I have
to aim higher than
'the best' from now on.
translations.うん、うまかった。ごちそうさま。:
Yeah, that was great.
Thanks for the food.
translations.よろこんでもらえたかな？ また作るね。:
Glad you liked it!
I'll make it again, okay？
translations.ごちそうさま。えっと、面白かったよ。:
Thanks for the food.
Um... it was interesting.
translations.それって、ほめてるの？:
Is that supposed to be
a compliment？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理の腕……まだ荒削りなところはあるかな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills...
Still a bit rough around
the edges, maybe.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理の腕……そつなくこなしてる感じだな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills...
She handles it all pretty
smoothly.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理の腕……上手くなったよな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills...
She's really gotten good.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理の腕……カレシとして自慢できるレベルだな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills...
Good enough for a boyfriend
to brag about.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理の腕……もう素人とは思えないな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills...
Doesn't even feel like an
amateur made it.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理の腕……人に教えられるレベルだろうな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills...
She could totally teach
other people by now.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理の腕……一流シェフ並だな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills...
It's on par with a
first-class chef.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理の腕……三ツ星レストランの料理かってくらいだな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills...
Feels like something from
a three-star restaurant.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理の腕……世界一ってレベルだな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills...
This is seriously
world-class.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理の腕……人類史上最高だな！）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking skills...
The best in human history!)
translations.じゃあ、今度は何を食べたい？ ご注文、承ります:
So, what do you want to eat
next time？ I'm ready to
take your order!
translations.和食の気分だな: I'm in the mood for Japanese.
translations.ジャンルはわからないけど…… ※未使用: Not sure what genre, but... ※ Unused
translations.承りました。それ、私の得意料理だよ♪:
Order received! That's
actually my specialty♪
translations.わかった。それなら大丈夫だと思う。:
Got it. I think I can
handle that fine.
translations.うん。でも……あんまり自信ないから、期待はしないで？:
Sure. But... I'm not super
confident, so don't get
your hopes up, okay？
translations.……実はそれ、作ったことないんだ。でも、がんばってみるね。:
...Truth is, I've never made
that before. But I'll do
my best, okay？
translations.初めてだね、このお店。当たりだといいんだけど。:
First time here, huh？
Hope it turns out to be a hit.
translations.ここ、おいしかったよね。けっこうお気に入り。:
The food here was really good,
wasn't it？ I'm pretty fond
of this place.
translations.そうなんだ？ じゃあ大正解だったな。:
Really？ Then coming here
was definitely the right call.
translations.まぁ、とりあえず入ろう。:
Well, let's just head inside
for now.
translations.私たちも、すっかり常連さんだね。:
We've practically become
regulars here, haven't we？
translations.「店長いつものヤツ」みたいな感じだよな、はは。:
Yeah, like 'give us the usual,
boss!' Haha.
translations.このお店、好きなんだね……。ううん、いいんだけど。:
You really like this place,
don't you...？ No, I don't
mind at all.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は微妙？ まぁ、今日はここにしとこうよ。:
Not feeling it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Well, let's just stick with it
for today.
translations.どう？ 何にするか決まった？:
How's it looking？ Decided
what you want yet？
translations.おなか空いてるから、迷っちゃうな……。:
I'm so hungry, it's hard
to choose...
translations.うーん……、どうしようかな。あんまりたくさんは無理そうだし……。:
Hmm... what should I do？
I don't think I can eat
a ton, so...
translations.●は▲生成選択肢１▲に\nするけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
●'ll have the ▲生成選択肢１▲,
what about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私が？ そうね、じゃあ……これは？:
Me？ Let's see...
How about this one？
translations.▲生成選択肢１▲か……いいかも。:
The ▲生成選択肢１▲, huh...
Sounds good.
translations.▲生成選択肢２▲ね。\nじゃ、店員さん呼ぼうか。:
The ▲生成選択肢２▲, got it.
I'll call the waiter over.
translations.▲生成選択肢２▲ね。\nうまそう。:
The ▲生成選択肢２▲, right.
Looks delicious.
translations.違う髪型も見たいな: I'd like to see a different style
translations.出会った頃の髪型が良かった: I liked the style from when we met
translations.え？ それは反則だよ。しょうがないなあ。:
Huh？ That's totally unfair!
Honestly, you're impossible.
translations.初めて会った時の髪型が見てみたいなって。:
I'd kind of like to see
how your hair was when we met.
translations.そうなの？ うん、いいよ。あなたが見たいって言うなら。:
Really？ Sure, why not,
if that's what you'd like.
translations.そうしてあげたいけど……今の長さだとね。しばらく待ってくれる？:
I'd love to, but with my hair
this length... Can you wait a bit？
translations.わかった。楽しみにしとくよ。: Sure. I'll look forward to it.
translations.考えてみるけど……うーん。:
I'll think about it, but...
hmmm.
translations.（乗り気じゃなさそうだな、残念）:
(She doesn't seem into it.
Too bad.)
translations.違う髪型、見てみたいなと思って。:
I was just thinking I'd like
to see you in a different style.
translations.いいよ。ねえ、雑誌見ながら二人で決めようか。:
Sure! Why don't we look through
a magazine and decide together？
translations.そうなの？ うーん、けっこう今の、気に入ってるんだけどな……。:
Really？ Hmm, but I actually
like it the way it is now...
translations.その髪型いいよね。しばらくそのままがいいなって。:
I really like this hairstyle.
I hope you keep it for a while.
translations.ほんと？ 良かった。私も気に入ってたから。:
Really？ I'm glad.
I really liked it too.
translations.そうなんだ……。私はそろそろ変えたかったんだけど。:
Is that so...？ I was kind of
thinking of changing it, though.
translations.少し切ってみない？: How about trimming it a bit？
translations.ばさっとショートにしない？: How about cutting it all short？
translations.それだと、今と変わらないよね。:
Wouldn't that be pretty much
the same as it is right now？
translations.そっか。ごめん、じゃあそのままで。:
True. Sorry, keep it
like that then.
translations.そのほうが好きなの？ ふーん、なら、変えてみようかな。:
You like that better？ Hmm...
Maybe I'll switch it up then.
translations.やった。絶対似合うと思うよ。:
Sweet! 
I know it'll look great on you.
translations.女の子が髪型変えるのって、簡単じゃないんだよ？:
You know, changing up our hair 
isn't that simple for a girl？
translations.そうだよな……、変なこと言って、ごめん。:
Yeah, you're right... 
Sorry for saying something weird.
translations.今日のそのアクセサリーだけどさ。:
About that accessory 
you're wearing today...
translations.その髪につけてるやつ、すごくいいね。:
That thing in your hair 
looks really nice.
translations.ネックレス、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にぴったりだと思ってさ。:
I just thought that necklace 
is perfect for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.その腕につけてるやつ、似合ってるなって思って。:
I was just thinking that 
thing on your wrist looks great.
translations.その指輪だけどさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にぴったりだよね。:
That ring, it's just 
perfect for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そのメガネ、似合ってるよね。いい感じ。:
Those glasses really suit you. 
Looking good.
translations.ほんとかな？ ウソでもありがとう。ふふ。:
Really？ Even if you're just 
flattering me, thanks. Hehe.
translations.ほんとだって！ 本当によく似合ってるよ。:
I mean it! 
It really looks great on you.
translations.そのヘアアクセサリー……あんまりかな。:
That hair accessory... 
doesn't quite work.
translations.そのイヤリング、あんまり似合ってないかも？:
Those earrings... maybe they 
don't really suit you？
translations.そのネックレス……、いまいちかも。:
That necklace... 
might not be the best.
translations.腕につけてるやつ……ごめん、あんまり似合ってない。:
That thing on your wrist... 
sorry, doesn't really suit you.
translations.その指輪、イマイチかもね。:
That ring might not 
be the best on you.
translations.今かけてるメガネ……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲っぽくないかな。:
Those glasses you're wearing... 
don't really feel like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そう、なんだ……。しばらく着けるのやめよっと。:
Oh, really...？ 
Guess I'll stop wearing it 
for a while.
translations.そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲っていつもどうやって服装決めてるの？:
By the way, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, 
how do you usually decide 
what to wear？
translations.やっぱり形って重要だよな。:
The cut really is 
important after all.
translations.じゃあ。ちなみに、あなたはどんな形が好きなのかな？:
Then... what kind of cut 
do you like, by the way？
translations.なるほど、そうなのか。じゃあ……次のデートはお楽しみに。:
I see, so that's it.
Well... look forward to
our next date then.
translations.そうなんだ。でも、どうするかは、当日の気分次第かな。:
Is that so？ But it'll depend
on how I feel that day.
translations.確かに色で印象は変わるよね。あなたはどんな色が好き？:
Color really changes things,
doesn't it？ What kind of
colors do you like？
translations.そうだな……明るめであったかい感じかな。:
Let's see... Bright and warm,
I think.
translations.●は明るい寒色系がいいかな。:
Bright, cool colors sound
good to ●, I guess.
translations.うーん、暗めのあったかい感じかな。:
Hmm, darker and warm,
I think.
translations.うーん……暗い寒色系がいいかな。:
Hmm... Dark, cool colors
sound good, maybe.
translations.そういう感じが好きなのね。次のデートはあなたの好みに合わせてみようかな。:
So that's what you like.
Maybe I'll match your taste
on our next date.
translations.楽しみにしてます！:
I'll be looking forward
to it!
translations.そうなんだ……、私の好みとは、ちょっと違うね。:
I see... That's a little
different from what I like.
translations.やっぱ清楚な感じが、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲には一番だよ。:
A neat, clean look suits
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ best, after all.
translations.じゃあ、今着てる感じでいいってことかな。:
So you like what I'm wearing
right now, then？
translations.そっか……うん。よく似合ってると思うよ。:
I guess so... Yeah.
I think it really suits you.
translations.ふふ、わかった。次のデートはそうしてみようかな。:
Fufu, alright. Maybe I'll try
that for our next date.
translations.絶対似合うって！:
It'll definitely look
great on you!
translations.ごめんね。私、最近、そういうのダメみたい。:
Sorry... Lately, that style
just doesn't feel right for me.
translations.そっか。こっちこそ、なんかごめん。:
I see. Sorry for bringing
it up, then.
translations.あのさ、●の呼び方、変えてみない？:
Hey, how about changing
what you call ●？
translations.いいけど……どう呼んでほしいの？:
Sure, but... what do you
want me to call you？
translations.今の呼び方、イヤ？ 私は気に入ってるんだけど……。:
Don't you like what I call you？
I actually really like it,
though...
translations.そっか。だったら無理は言わないよ。: I see. Then I won't push it.
translations.……それなら今の方がいいんじゃない？ 他に候補はある？:
...I think what I call you now
is better. Any other ideas？
translations.▲新主人公▲、って呼んでほしいんだけど。:
I'd really like you
to call me ▲新主人公▲.
translations.どう、かな……？ 気に入ってくれたらいいけど。:
How does that sound...？
I hope you like it.
translations.▲新主人公▲って呼んでほしいな。:
I'd love it if you
called me ▲新主人公▲.
translations.こんな風に呼んで欲しかったんだ？ ふーん、もっと早く言えば良かったのに。:
So that's what you wanted me
to call you？ Hmm, you should've
told me sooner.
translations.いいんじゃない？ なんだかカワイイし。私も気に入っちゃった。:
Sounds good to me！
It's kind of cute.
I've gotten fond of it already.
translations.うーん……やっぱり今のままでいいんじゃない？:
Hmm... Maybe we should just
leave it the way it is？
translations.そうだな。残念だけど……。:
Yeah, I guess so.
Shame, though...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の呼び方、変えてみようと思うんだけど……。:
I was thinking about changing
what I call you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.そうなの？ なんて呼んでくれるのかな？:
Is that so？ What are you
gonna call me, then？
translations.そうなの？ 別にこのままでいいんだけど。:
Oh, really？ I'm fine with
how things are now, though.
translations.そっか……じゃあやめとく。: I see... I'll leave it, then.
translations.▲生成選択肢５▲って呼んでもいい？: Can I call you ▲生成選択肢５▲？
translations.それはちょっと……。もっと別のにしてくれない？:
That's a little...
Could you pick something else？
translations.もちろんいいよ。私もその呼び方、好きかな。:
Of course you can.
I think I like that one, too.
translations.▲生成選択肢５▲って呼びたいな。: I'd really like to call you ▲生成選択肢５▲.
translations.仕方ないな。特別に許可します。:
Guess I have no choice.
Special permission granted！
translations.あ……それ、いいじゃない？ 私も気に入っちゃった。:
Oh... that's pretty good！
I really like it too.
translations.もうおしまい。やめとこ？:
That's enough for now.
Let's leave it, okay？
translations.そろそろ髪型変えてみようかな……。ねえ、一緒に選んでくれる？:
I've been thinking about changing
my hair... Will you help me pick？
translations.変えなくてもいいよ: You don't have to change it
translations.今の髪型、気に入ってくれてるのかな？ だったらやめておくね。:
Do you like my hair right now？
In that case, I'll keep it as is.
translations.うん。今のままがいいと思う。:
Yeah. I think it's best
the way it is.
translations.どんな髪型がいいかな……、あなたはどれが好き？:
What kind of style would look
good...？ Which one do you like？
translations.●の好みだと……、そうだな、このあたりかな。:
Going by ●'s taste...
Yeah, probably around here.
translations.このあたりから選んでみる？: Want to pick from around here？
translations.うん。あなたの意見、聞かせてね。: Sure. Let me know what you think.
translations.このあたりから決めてみようよ。: Let's pick one from around here.
translations.なるほどね、こういうのが好きってことか。いいよ、選んでみよっ。:
I see, so this is what you like.
Okay, let's pick one out！
translations.うん、どれがいいかな。: Yeah, which one should it be？
translations.このへんから選んでみようよ？:
Why don't we pick
from around here？
translations.いいよ。お姉さん、何でも似合っちゃうんだから。:
Sure thing. Your big sis
looks good in anything,
after all.
translations.どれがいいかなあ。:
Now, which one should
I pick...
translations.うーん、私に似合うかな。:
Hmm, would that look
good on me？
translations.こういうのが好きなんだ？:
So this is the kind
you like？
translations.ちょっと自信ないかも……。:
I don't know if I can
pull that off...
translations.うーん、色々あって迷うなあ。:
Hmm, there are so many,
it's hard to choose.
translations.私は……こういうのかなあ。:
For me... maybe
something like this.
translations.これだと、髪切らないとね。:
If I go with this,
I'll have to cut my hair.
translations.長さが足りないから……すぐは無理かなあ。:
My hair isn't long enough,
so not right away, maybe.
translations.私も好き……うん、それで決定！:
I like it too... Yep,
it's decided!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だったらきっと似合う思うな。:
I'm sure it'd look
great on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ねえ、じゃあ、カラーはどうする？:
Hey, so what should we do
about the color？
translations.髪の色で印象変わるもんな。:
Hair color really changes
your whole look, huh.
translations.あとは……、カラーを決めなくちゃね。:
Next up... we have to
decide on the color.
translations.髪の色も変えるの？:
You're changing your
hair color too？
translations.変えるとは限らないけど、考えないと。そこまで含めてヘアスタイルでしょ。:
Not necessarily, but I've
got to consider it. That's
all part of the style, right？
translations.そっか、じゃあ、●も一緒に考えるよ。:
Got it. Then ●'ll
think about it with you.
translations.髪の色も一緒に決めてくれる？:
Will you help me pick
the color too？
translations.いいよ。どんな色がいいのかな……。:
Sure. Wonder what color
would be best...
translations.大丈夫、ちゃんと考えるから。:
Don't worry, I'll take it
seriously.
translations.自然な感じで、いいんじゃないかな。:
A natural look might be
really nice.
translations.その色か……、あなたがいいって言うなら……。:
That color, huh... Well,
if you say so...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ならいけるって。:
You can totally pull
it off, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.じゃあ、近々、新しい私を披露します。乞うご期待。:
Then I'll unveil the new me
sometime soon. Stay tuned!
translations.楽しみに待ってるよ。:
I'll be looking
forward to it.
translations.お待たせいたしました。ごゆっくりどうぞ。:
Thank you for waiting.
Please enjoy your meal.
translations.美味しそう。じゃあ……いただきます。:
Looks delicious.
Well then... let's eat.
translations.これ、すごくおいしい。ねえ、あなたも食べて？:
This is really good.
Hey, you try some too？
translations.おいしそうに食べるね。なんだか私も食べてみたくなっちゃった。:
You make it look so good.
Now you've got me wanting
to try some too.
translations.ちょっと驚いちゃった……。こんなにおいしいなんて。:
I'm kind of surprised...
I didn't expect it to be
this delicious.
translations.おいしかった。また来ようね。:
That was delicious.
We should come back again.
translations.うん、合格かな。: Mm, it gets a passing grade.
translations.ちょっとね……この料理、もっとおいしくできると思うんだけど。:
Well... I feel like they could
make this a lot tastier.
translations.選択ミス……。苦手なものが入ってて。:
Bad choice...
It had something in it
I really don't like.
translations.（喜んでくれてる……。いい店選んだな）:
(She's so happy...
Glad I picked a good place.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の苦手なものか……気づかなかったな）:
(Something ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ doesn't like...
I had no idea.)
translations.もう大満足。おいしさに油断して食べすぎちゃったかな？:
I'm totally satisfied.
It was so good, I might have
let my guard down and overeaten？
translations.おいしいし、量もちょうど良かったね♪:
It was delicious, and the
portion was just right♪
translations.おいしかったけど、もうちょっと頼んでおけば良かったかも。:
It was good, but maybe we
should've ordered a bit more.
translations.お腹いっぱい食べちゃったけど……、味の方はもうちょっとだったかな。:
I ate till I was full,
but... the flavor could've
been a little better.
translations.ボリュームあったけど……、味が少しね。:
It was plenty filling,
but the flavor was a little off.
translations.量も足りなかったし、味も……失敗しちゃったね。:
There wasn't enough food,
and the flavor...
Total miss, wasn't it？
translations.ゆっくり休憩できたね、落ち着いた店でよかった。:
We got to take a nice break.
I'm glad it was such a calm,
relaxing place.
translations.うーん……なんだか落ち着けなかったね。:
Hmm... It was kind of hard
to relax in there, wasn't it？
translations.店内がおしゃれだったね。少し見とれちゃった。:
The interior was so stylish.
I couldn't help staring a bit.
translations.もうちょっとお店の雰囲気がよかったらなあ。:
If only the atmosphere
had been a little nicer.
translations.この店、今評判だよね♪:
This place has a great
reputation right now, doesn't it♪
translations.うそ、すごい……。いただきます。:
No way, this is amazing...
Time to dig in.
translations.ちょっと……口に合わないかも。: This is... not really to my taste.
translations.ふふ、やっぱり成功。:
Hehe, turned out great
after all.
translations.んー……次はもっとがんばらなきゃ。:
Mmm... I'll have to
do better next time.
translations.さすが評判になるだけはあるね。おいしかった♪:
It definitely lived up
to the hype.
That was delicious♪
translations.なんだか……期待してたほどじゃなかったな。:
Somehow... it wasn't
as good as I'd hoped.
translations.それなりにおいしかったね。:
It was decent enough,
I suppose.
translations.ねえ、飴ちゃんあげよっか。:
Hey, want a piece
of candy？
translations.そうだ、昨日あなたが夢に出てきたの。:
Oh, right! You showed up
in my dream last night.
translations.いくら話しても、話がつきないって……不思議だね。:
No matter how much we talk,
we never run out of things
to say... It's funny, huh？
translations.あなたの顔って、ずっと見ていたくなっちゃう。:
I feel like I could look at
your face forever.
translations.あなたに会ったら話そうと思ったことがあったんだけど……なんだっけ。:
There was something I wanted
to tell you when we met...
What was it again？
translations.あ、あの子のバッグ、かわいい……。:
Oh, that girl's bag
is so cute...
translations.髪おかしくなってないかな？:
My hair doesn't look weird,
does it？
translations.髪に何かついてるよ？ はい、取れた。:
There's something in your hair...
Hold on. There, got it!
translations.昨日はドキドキしてあまり眠れなかったの。子供みたいでしょ。:
I was so excited yesterday,
I couldn't really sleep.
Just like a little kid, huh？
translations.今日のあなたの運勢は……ふふ。:
Your fortune for today is...
Hehe.
translations.ねえ、もっとあなたのこと話して？:
Hey, tell me more about
yourself？
translations.やだ……。私の顔、にやけてる。あなたのせいだよ。:
Oh no... I'm grinning.
It's totally your fault.
translations.この間ね、あなたへのメールを友達に送りそうになっちゃった。:
The other day, I almost sent
a text meant for you
to one of my friends.
translations.えーとね、……なんだっけ？ あなたの顔見たら、忘れちゃった。:
Umm, let's see... what was it？
Once I saw your face,
it totally slipped my mind.
translations.この時間がずーっと続けばいいのにな……。:
I wish this time could just
last forever...
translations.今は携帯電話禁止。デートが終わってから、ね？:
No phones right now.
Wait until after our date,
okay？
translations.デートしてるとこ見たよって友だちに言われちゃった。:
A friend told me she saw us
out on our date.
translations.明日も、明後日も、毎日デートできたらいいのにな。:
Tomorrow, the next day...
I wish we could go on dates
every single day.
translations.ふふっ。……はぁ、今日は笑ってばっかり。:
Hehe... *sigh* I've done
nothing but laugh today.
translations.今、楽しい？ うん、それならいいの。:
Are you having fun right now？
Yeah？ That's all that matters.
translations.一人占めしてるのに、もっともっとって思うの。ゼイタクだよね。:
I have you all to myself,
yet I still want more.
Pretty greedy of me, huh？
translations.さっきから何笑ってるの？ あ、自分で気付いてないんだ。:
What've you been smiling about？
Oh, you didn't even notice.
translations.私のことだけ考えて。今だけは、ね？:
Think only about me.
Just for right now, okay？
translations.あなたのことなら、何でも知りたいの。:
When it comes to you,
I want to know everything.
translations.もう、かわいいんだから？ ちゃんと自覚してる？:
Geez, you're so adorable...
Are you even aware of it？
translations.……今ね、幸せだなって思ってたの。あなたに会うたび思ってる。:
...Just now, I was thinking
how happy I am. I think that
every time I see you.
translations.楽しい……ふたりってだけで、楽しいな。:
This is so nice... Just the
two of us is all it takes.
translations.私たち、仲良しカップルに見えてるかな？:
Do you think we look like
such a close couple？
translations.受信メール、あなたの名前ばっかりだよ。:
My inbox is full of nothing
but your name.
translations.さっき隠し撮りしちゃった。ふふ、見せませーん。:
I secretly took a picture of
you earlier. Hehe, nope,
I'm not showing you~
translations.ふたりの世界って感じだね？:
Feels like our own little
world, doesn't it？
translations.甘えていいよ？ うん、よしよし▼:
You can lean on me, you
know？ There, there▼
translations.寂しいな～、つまんないな～、構ってほしいな～。うそ♪:
I'm lonely~ So bored~
Pay attention to me~
Just kidding♪
translations.寄りかかっちゃお▼ うん、ラクチン♪:
I'm gonna lean on you▼
Mmm, so comfy♪
translations.今日はいつもより積極的？ ふふ▼:
A bit bolder than usual
today, aren't you？ Hehe▼
translations.あなたのその仕草、好きだな。:
I really like when you
do that.
translations.もう、そんなに見つめないの。どんな顔していいのかわからないから。:
Jeez, don't stare at me like
that. I don't know what kind
of face I'm supposed to make.
translations.ねえ、好きって言って？ ……うん、何度聞いても嬉しい。:
Hey, tell me you love me？
...Mm, I'll never get tired
of hearing that.
translations.今日はもう言ったかな？ だーい好き▼:
Did I tell you yet today？
I loooove you!▼
translations.ね、いつもみたいにして？ ぎゅって。:
Hey, do what you always do？
Hug me tight.
translations.こうしてあなたと一緒にいるだけで、私、十分満たされてる。ホントよ？:
Just being with you like this
is more than enough for me.
I really mean it, you know？
translations.もっとくっついちゃおうかな。えいっ▼:
Think I'll snuggle in closer.
Hup!▼
translations.今日は学校で面白いこと、あった？:
Did anything fun happen
at school today？
translations.早くあなたに会いたくて、授業中からソワソワしてたの。:
I couldn't wait to see you,
so I was fidgeting all through
class today.
translations.学校にバイトにデート……。毎日がすごく充実してる。:
School, work, dates...
Every day feels so full
and rewarding.
translations.あ、見て。あそこにも高校生カップル。:
Oh, look. There's another
high school couple over there.
translations.今日は少し宿題が多いの。あなたは大丈夫？:
I've got quite a bit of
homework today. Are you okay？
translations.放課後だけじゃ、時間足りないね。:
Just after school isn't
nearly enough time, is it？
translations.学校がある日は、一日が長く感じるな……。:
On school days, the hours
just seem to drag on...
translations.大学生になったら、もっと長く一緒にいられるのかな。:
Once we're in college,
I wonder if we can spend
more time together？
translations.こんな風に平日デートできるのって、学生のうちだけなのかな。:
I wonder if going on weekday
dates like this is something
we can only do as students.
translations.もっと時間があればいいのにな……。休日に期待▼:
I wish we had more time...
Can't wait for the weekend!▼
translations.今日は紫外線が強そう。対策した方がいいかな。:
The UV seems pretty strong
today. Should I put on some
sun protection？
translations.光合成できちゃいそうなくらい、いい天気。:
The weather's so nice,
I feel like I could almost
photosynthesize.
translations.今日は気持ちよく晴れたね。:
It's so clear and pleasant
out today, isn't it？
translations.風がさわやか……。気持ちいいね。:
Such a refreshing breeze...
It feels wonderful.
translations.空気が澄んでる。明日も晴れるかな。:
The air is so clear.
I wonder if it'll be sunny
tomorrow, too？
translations.わあ、見て。雲があんなに速い……。:
Whoa, look. The clouds are
moving so fast...
translations.雲が出てきたね。洗濯物、入れてくればよかったかな。:
Clouds are rolling in.
Maybe I should have brought
the laundry inside.
translations.降りそうだね。あなたってもしかして、雨男？:
Looks like it'll rain.
Could you be a rain magnet,
by any chance？
translations.すっきりしない天気……。帰るまで降らないといいけど。:
Such gloomy weather...
I hope it doesn't rain
until we get home.
translations.よく降るね。洗濯物たまっちゃうかな。:
It's really coming down.
My laundry's going to pile up
at this rate.
translations.そろそろ止むのかな？: I wonder if it'll stop soon？
translations.水たまりを見るとジャブジャブしたくなるね。もう、ほんとにはしないよ？:
Seeing puddles makes you
want to splash around, right？
Geez, I won't really do it!
translations.こんなに暑いと、冬が恋しくなっちゃうね？:
When it gets this hot,
you really miss winter,
don't you？
translations.夏はマメに水分補給しなくちゃ。ね？:
You've got to stay hydrated
in the summer. Right？
translations.ふう、ちょっと歩いただけで汗かいちゃう。:
Phew, I'm already sweating
after walking just a bit.
translations.一年中このくらいの気温なら、勉強もはかどるのにね？:
If it was like this all year,
studying would be so much
easier, wouldn't it？
translations.んー、気持ちいい。この時期の空気っていいな。:
Mmm, feels so good.
I love the air this time
of year.
translations.この時期の服装って難しいよね。:
It's so tricky figuring out
what to wear around this time.
translations.息が真っ白……。あ、あなたの鼻は真っ赤。:
Our breath is so white...
Ah, and your nose is bright red!
translations.ねえ、くっついてもいい？ ふふ、寒さのせいだけじゃないよ？:
Hey, can I cuddle up to you？
Hehe, and not just because
it's cold, you know？
translations.手、冷たくない？ はーってしてあげようか。:
Aren't your hands cold？
Want me to warm them up
with my breath？
translations.わあ、すごい人。離れないようにくっついてなくちゃ、ね？:
Whoa, what a crowd!
We'd better stick close so we
don't get separated, right？
translations.すごい人出。みんな、考えることは一緒なのかな。:
What a huge turnout.
I guess everyone had
the same idea.
translations.こんなに混んでると、帰りたくなっちゃう。……ふふ、冗談。:
When it's this crowded,
it makes me want to go home...
Hehe, just kidding.
translations.思ったほど混んでないみたい。良かった。:
Doesn't seem as crowded
as I thought. What a relief.
translations.そんなに混んでないね。これならのんびりできそう。:
It's not too crowded.
Looks like we can take
things nice and slow.
translations.あまり混んでないし、いちゃいちゃしちゃおっか？:
It's pretty empty...
Wanna get a little
lovey-dovey？
translations.人、そんなにいないね。二人きりになれそうじゃない？:
Hardly anyone around.
Feels like we could get
all alone together, huh？
translations.もしかして、すいてる？ みんな私たちに遠慮してくれたのかな？:
Is it really this empty？
Did everyone clear out
just to give us space？
translations.空いてるね。なんだか得した気分。:
It's so quiet.
I feel like we caught
a lucky break.
translations.えい、隙あり。びっくりした？:
Gotcha! Wide open!
Did I startle you？
translations.あ、こら。何か狙ってる？:
Hey now...
Are you up to
something？
translations.んー、じらしてるのかな？:
Hmm, are you keeping
me waiting on purpose？
translations.……ねえ、誰もいないってことにしちゃわない？:
...Hey. Want to pretend
we're the only two here？
translations.ここでキスしちゃう？ ふふ。:
Should we kiss right here？
Hehe.
translations.少しなら誰かに見られてたって……それは無理か。:
Even if someone saw us
for a second...
No, that's no good.
translations.キス……あ、口に出しちゃった。:
A kiss...
Ah, did I say that out loud？
translations.今日はまだこれからだよ？:
The day's still young,
you know？
translations.まだまだ時間はたっぷりあるね。:
We still have plenty
of time left.
translations.まだこんな時間。なんだか得した気分。:
It's still so early.
Feels like a bonus.
translations.あなたといると、あっという間に時間が進んじゃう。:
Time really flies
when I'm with you.
translations.あれ、いつの間に。早いなあ……。:
Huh, already？
That went by so fast...
translations.この時計、進んでる？ もうこんな時間……。:
Is this clock fast？
It's this late already...？
translations.そろそろ……。ううん、まだ大丈夫だよね？:
Is it almost time...？
No, we still have a bit,
right？
translations.……時間、もう少しなら平気かな。:
...I think we can stay
just a little longer.
translations.まだ帰りたくないな……。もうちょっといいよね？:
I don't want to go
home yet...
A little longer is fine,
right？
translations.ずっと一緒にいられればいいのに……。:
If only we could just
stay together like this...
translations.さてと……これからどうする？:
Well now...
What should we do next？
translations.やりたいことがたくさんあって、困っちゃう。:
There's so much I want to do,
I can't even decide.
translations.次は……そうね、あなたに任せる。:
Next... well,
I'll leave it to you.
translations.私の行きたいところ？ ふふ、あなたとならどこでも▼:
Where do I want to go？
Hehe, anywhere is fine
as long as I'm with you▼
translations.はぁ、楽しかった♪ 次はどうしよっか。:
Ah, that was fun♪
What's next？
translations.この後、何か決めてる？:
Do you have anything
planned after this？
translations.まだどこかに寄るのかな。:
Are we stopping by
somewhere else, I wonder？
translations.さてと……やり残したこと、ない？:
Now then... Did we leave
anything undone？
translations.ふふっ、さっきの話、思い出しちゃった。:
Hehe, I just remembered
what we talked about earlier.
translations.こら。今、一人の世界に入ってたでしょ。:
Hey. You were off in your
own little world, weren't you？
translations.……起きてる？ 目がトロンとしてたから。:
...Are you awake？
Your eyes looked
a little glazed over.
translations.あ、私の速さに合わせてくれてるんだ。ありがとう。:
Oh, you're matching my pace.
Thank you.
translations.前ばかり見ないで、こっちも見て欲しいな？:
Don't just look ahead...
Look at me too, won't you？
translations.あなたとこうして一緒にいるだけで、楽しいな。:
Just being together with you
like this is so much fun.
translations.……私たち、少しくっつきすぎかな？ いいよね。:
……Are we walking a bit
too close together？
It's fine, though, right？
translations.どうしよう、私、今すごく幸せ……。:
What am I going to do？
I'm just so happy right now...
translations.今日はもうオシマイかぁ。次のデートはどこがいいかな？:
Today's already over, huh...
Where should we go
for our next date？
translations.今、あくびしたでしょ。お疲れだね。:
You just yawned, didn't you？
Looks like you're tired.
translations.今日はよく歩いたね。足がパンパン……。:
We walked so much today.
My feet are killing me...
translations.次はどこ行く？ 考えておいてね。:
Where should we go next？
Give it some thought, okay？
translations.はぁ、楽しかった。また行こうね。:
Whew, that was so fun.
Let's go again, okay？
translations.たくさんお話しすぎて、思い出せないくらい。:
We talked so much,
I can barely even remember
everything.
translations.少しゆっくり帰ろっか？ もったいないから。:
Should we walk back slower？
It feels like a waste
to end the day so soon.
translations.もうすぐ着いちゃうね。このままずっと一緒にいられればな……。:
We're almost there, huh.
If only we could just stay
like this forever...
translations.帰っちゃダメって言ったらどうする？ ……困った顔しないの。:
What if I told you
you can't go home？
...Don't look so troubled.
translations.送ってもらうの、嬉しいけど。いつかは、一緒に……。:
I love you walking me home,
but someday... together...
translations.楽しいね。あなたと来られて、よかった。:
This is so much fun.
I'm glad I came with you.
translations.ここ、意外な発見があるね。:
You really find unexpected
surprises here, don't you？
translations.ねえ、二人でもっといろんなところに行こうね。:
Hey, let's go to all kinds
of places together, okay？
translations.ねえ、とわの市のデートスポットを制覇できるかな。:
Hey, think we can conquer
every date spot in Towano？
translations.地元なのに、知らない場所がまだあるのかな。:
Even though I live here,
there are still places
I've never been to, huh.
translations.あなたとなら、どこに行くのも楽しい。ホントよ？:
As long as I'm with you,
anywhere is fun. I mean it！
translations.あ、今あくびしたでしょ。疲れたんじゃない？ 大丈夫？:
Ah, you just yawned！
Are you getting tired？
You doing okay？
translations.なんだかカップルが多いみたい。私たちもだけどね？:
There seem to be a lot
of couples here.
Well, so are we, though？
translations.あなたってアウトドア派？ 私は……わかるよね。:
Are you the outdoorsy type？
As for me... well, you know.
translations.ここ、ちょうど来たいと思ってたの。:
I was actually just thinking
I wanted to come here.
translations.着いたばかりだけど、一休みしちゃう？:
We just got here, but do you
want to take a quick break？
translations.さっき見た双子の赤ちゃん、かわいかったな～。:
Those twin babies we saw earlier
were so adorable~
translations.友だちがいるかも。今日ここ来るって話してたから。:
A friend might be around.
She mentioned coming here today.
translations.二人っきりになるのって難しいね。:
It's pretty hard to get
alone together, isn't it？
translations.今日、風がほとんどないね。:
There's barely any wind today,
is there？
translations.紫外線には一年中気をつけなきゃ。夏だけじゃないんだよ？:
You have to watch out for UV
all year round.
Not just in summer, okay？
translations.この辺り、季節によって景色が全然違うんだろうな。:
I bet the view around here
looks completely different
depending on the season.
translations.どこか座れそうなところ、ないかな。:
I wonder if there's somewhere
we can sit down.
translations.んー、深呼吸してみて、気持ちいいから。:
Mmm, take a deep breath.
It feels so good.
translations.時間がゆっくり流れてるみたいだね。:
It feels like time is just
flowing so slowly here.
translations.あ、今何かいたよ？ タヌキかな……。:
Ah, something was just there！
Was that a raccoon dog...？
translations.こういうところ、よく来る？:
Do you come to places
like this often？
translations.知ってる？ ここ、前にとわのウォッチャーで特集してたの。:
Did you know？
Towano Watcher did a feature
on this place a while back.
translations.ここ、昼と夜は雰囲気が変わるんだって。:
I heard the atmosphere here
is totally different
between day and night.
translations.こんなにいろいろあると、目移りしちゃう。:
With so much variety,
my eyes just keep wandering.
translations.これ、流行ってるんだ。よく見るよね。:
This is really trendy right now. 
You see it everywhere, don't you？
translations.あ、これいいなあ。セールするかな……。:
Oh, this looks really nice. 
I wonder if it'll go on sale...
translations.ねえ、これどう？ 私じゃなくて、あなたにだよ？:
Hey, what do you think of this？ 
Not for me, for you！
translations.ふふ、ちょっとはしゃいじゃった。: Hehe, I got a little carried away.
translations.ここ、楽しいね。あなたと一緒だから余計に。:
It's so fun here. 
Even more so because 
I'm with you.
translations.盛り上がってるね。こっちも楽しくなっちゃう。:
It's so lively. 
It makes me feel cheerful too.
translations.ふぅ、落ち着く……。あ、おばあちゃんみたいって思ったでしょ。:
Phew, so relaxing... 
Ah, you just thought I sounded 
like an old lady, didn't you？
translations.あそこ、人が集まってる。:
There's a crowd gathering 
over there.
translations.メニューが変わるから、何度来ても飽きないね？:
The menu always changes, 
so you never get bored coming here, 
do you？
translations.んー、追加オーダーしちゃおうかな。:
Hmm, maybe I should order 
a little something extra.
translations.あ、これ美味しい▼ 少し食べてみる？:
Oh, this is delicious▼ 
Want to try a bite？
translations.ふーん、こういう味付けもアリかも……。:
Hmm, this kind of seasoning 
works pretty well too...
translations.ねえ、私のと何か交換しない？:
Hey, wanna swap something 
with me？
translations.急いで掃除したでしょ？:
You cleaned up in a hurry, 
didn't you？
translations.ふーん、いい香りがするね。: Hmm, it smells really nice in here.
translations.へえ、こんな本も読むんだ。ふーん……。:
Huh, you read books like this？ 
Hmm...
translations.キッチン、片付いてるけど、まさか外食ばかり？:
Your kitchen's so neat... 
Don't tell me you just eat out 
all the time？
translations.模様替えする時は教えて？ 手伝ってあげる▼:
Let me know when you redecorate, 
okay？ I'll help you out▼
translations.押し入れ開けたら、なだれがおきたりして……。:
If I open the closet, 
is an avalanche gonna tumble out...？
translations.眠くなっちゃった……。私、リラックスしすぎかな。:
I'm getting sleepy... 
Maybe I'm relaxing a bit too much.
translations.壁一面に私の写真を飾っちゃおうかな。ふふ、冗談。:
Maybe I should cover an entire wall 
with photos of me. 
Hehe, just kidding.
translations.このカーテン、私も同じ色にしちゃおうかな……。:
Maybe I should get curtains 
in this color too...
translations.男の子の部屋だなあ……。当たり前だよね。:
It really feels like a boy's room... 
Well, of course it does.
translations.いい部屋だね。居着いちゃおうかな。:
It's a nice room. 
Maybe I'll just move in.
translations.ねえ、もうちょっと、そっちに行ってもいい？:
Hey, can I scoot a little closer 
to you？
translations.本当の二人きりだね、今。:
It's really just the two of us 
right now, isn't it.
translations.いつかこんな風に一緒に……。ううん、なんでもない。:
Someday, like this, together... 
No, never mind.
translations.帰りたくないな……。でも、帰らなくちゃ……。:
I don't wanna go home... 
But I have to...
translations.お菓子、たくさん食べてね。残ったら、私が食べることになっちゃうでしょ。:
Eat lots of snacks, okay？ 
If there are any left, 
I'll end up eating them all.
translations.なあに？ 何か気になるものがあった？:
What is it？ 
Did you spot something interesting？
translations.玄関の鍵、閉めたかな……。うん、大丈夫。:
Did I lock the front door...？ 
Yep, all good.
translations.こら、勝手に開けちゃだめでしょ？:
Hey! You can't just go opening things 
without asking！
translations.いつもより大人しいんじゃない？:
Aren't you being quieter 
than usual？
translations.黙らないで、なんだか……。そうだ、ＤＶＤでも観よう。ね。:
Don't just go quiet, it's... 
I know, let's watch a DVD! 
Okay？
translations.のどかわいた？ お茶にする？:
Are you thirsty？ 
Want some tea？
translations.緊張してるの？ 肩揉んであげるね。リラックスリラックス。:
Are you nervous？ 
Here, I'll rub your shoulders. 
Just relax, relax.
translations.どうしたの？ ソワソワしちゃって。:
What's wrong？ 
You seem so restless.
translations.そこにあなたがいるの、新鮮だな。なんか変な気分。:
Seeing you sitting right there 
feels so fresh. 
It's kind of a funny feeling.
translations.あなたがここにいるの、なんだか不思議。くすぐったい気分。:
Having you here feels so unreal. 
It gives me butterflies.
translations.なんだか、眠そうね。泊っていきますか？ ふふ、ウソ。:
You look kind of sleepy. 
Wanna stay the night？ 
Hehe, just kidding.
translations.ねえ、ずっとここにいよう？ ……困らせちゃった。:
Hey, let's just stay 
here forever... 
Did I put you on the spot？
translations.……帰ってほしくないな。:
...I don't want you 
to go home.
translations.ダメよ、そんなの。: No way, you can't do that.
translations.そうは思わないけど……。:
I don't really think so, 
though...
translations.そんなことないんじゃない？:
I don't know, 
is that really true？
translations.それはわからないかな。: I'm not sure about that one.
translations.ちょっとわからないかも。: I might not really get that.
translations.ありがとう！ すごくうれしい。:
Thank you！ 
That makes me so happy.
translations.もう、そんなこと言って……。:
Geez, don't go saying 
things like that...
translations.全然、聞こえないよ。: I can't hear you at all.
translations.あなたしか見えない……。: All I can see is you...
translations.あなただけなの。: You're the only one for me.
translations.もう、心配症なんだから……。:
Geez, you worry 
way too much...
translations.大丈夫だから、心配しないで。:
I'll be fine, 
so don't worry.
translations.もう、仕方ないな。:
Oh, honestly... You're
hopeless, you know that？
translations.それって……はあ、しょうがないな。:
Wait, does that mean...
*sigh* You're impossible.
translations.え、今のどういう意味？:
Wait, what do you mean
by that？
translations.ごめんなさい、ちょっとわからないかも。:
Sorry, I'm not really sure
what you mean.
translations.それ、本気で言ってるわけじゃないよね？:
You're not being serious,
are you？
translations.……私、聞こえなかったから。:
...I'm just gonna pretend
I didn't hear that.
translations.そんなこと言う子は、お仕置きなんだから。:
Boys who say stuff like that
get punished, you know.
