translations.しー。小さな声で、ね？:
Shh. Keep your voice down,
okay？
translations.あ、それ前にも言ってた？:
Oh, did you mention that
before？
translations.うん……ちょっと考えてみるね。:
Yeah... Let me think about
it for a bit.
translations.私にしか話せないこと？:
Something you can only tell
me？
translations.きゃっ！ もう、耳に息が……。:
Eek! Jeez, you're breathing
right on my ear...
translations.焦らないで。ゆっくり、深呼吸。:
No rush. Take a slow,
deep breath.
translations.なんだか……、久しぶりだね。:
It feels like...
it's been a while,
hasn't it？
translations.ずいぶん久しぶりなんじゃない？:
Hasn't it been
a really long time？
translations.久しぶりだね。もう、待ってたんだよ。:
It's been a while. Geez,
I've been waiting for you.
translations.さ、あがって。ゆっくりしてね。:
Come on, come in.
Make yourself at home.
translations.いらっしゃい。もう、帰さないから……なーんてね。:
Welcome. I won't let you
leave today... Just kidding.
translations.したいことか……特に考えてなかったな。:
What to do, huh...
I didn't really have
anything in mind.
translations.実は私も。こうしてるだけで幸せだから……。:
Honestly, me neither.
Just being like this
makes me happy...
translations.あ、先週のドラマ見た？ 月曜の。:
Oh, did you watch that drama
last week？ The Monday one.
translations.見た見た。主演の女の子がかわいくて……。:
I did, I did. The lead girl
was really cute...
translations.うん？ かわいくて、その続き、言ってごらん？:
Hmm？ She was cute, and...？
Go on, finish that sentence.
translations.そうだ。旅行雑誌、買ったんだ。:
Oh, right. I bought
a travel magazine.
translations.旅行行くの？: Are you going on a trip？
translations.ううん、眺める用。楽しいよ、見てみる？:
Nope, just to browse.
It's fun! Want to see？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。子どもの頃はどんな子だった？:
▲主人公＊▲. What were you like
as a kid？
translations.●は……そんなに覚えてないよ。まあ、普通の男の子？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はヤンチャなんだ:
● don't really remember.
Just a normal boy, I guess？
Weren't you pretty wild, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.その話……したっけ。うん、ガキ大将……みたいな。:
Did I... mention that before？
Yeah, kind of like
a neighborhood kid boss.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がガキ大将か、ガキ女将じゃなくて？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, a kid boss？
Not a kid boss lady？
translations.何それ、ガキ女将？ ふふ！:
What's that, a kid boss lady？
Hehe!
translations.ね、あなたの将来の夢ってなに？:
Hey, what's your dream
for the future？
translations.もう、真面目なんだから……、そんなに重たく考えないで。:
Geez, you're so serious...
Don't overthink it so much.
translations.じゃあ、デキシーズを日本一のファミレスにする！:
Then I'll make Dixie's
the number one family
restaurant in Japan!
translations.ほんとに？ うちのお店が日本一になっても店長が喜ぶだけよ。:
Really？ Even if our place
became number one, only the
manager would be happy.
translations.たまにあるよな。その場が一瞬シーンとなる瞬間って。:
It happens sometimes.
That moment when everything
just goes totally silent.
translations.霊が通った、とか言わなかった？:
Didn't people use to say
a ghost was passing by？
translations.えっと……どうだったかな。: Uh... how did that go again？
translations.もしかして、ジェネレーションギャップ？:
Could this be...
a generation gap？
translations.なんかいいね、こういう時間。ほっとする。:
I really like times like this.
It's so relaxing.
translations.うん、ちょっとドキドキもするけど。:
Yeah, though my heart's
pounding a little too.
translations.時間が止まればいいのに……って思うよね。:
...Makes you wish
time would just stop,
doesn't it？
translations.ね、もし今日が地球最後の日だとしたら、残りの時間、何をして過ごす？:
Hey, if today were
the end of the world,
how would you spend
what's left？
translations.そうだなぁ、●はこのままがいいかな。:
Well, ●'d want to
keep things just like
this, I guess.
translations.……もう、うまいこと言っちゃって。:
...Jeez, look at you,
being all smooth.
translations.……私も。絶対、あなたを帰さないよ。:
...Me too.
I'd never let you go
home.
translations.（今日で終わりなら、帰らないでいいのか……）:
(I guess if today's
the end, I wouldn't
have to go home...)
translations.楽しい時間はあっという間って、本当ね。:
Time really does fly
when you're having fun,
doesn't it？
translations.うん、授業はなかなか終わらないのにさ。:
Yeah, even though class
takes forever to end.
translations.じゃあ、ここで授業を始めれば、いいんじゃない？:
Then how about we start
class right here？
translations.姉ヶ崎先生の個人授業、不満？:
Got a problem with
private lessons from
Ms. Anegasaki？
translations.（……そういう言い方されると、アリだな）:
(...Put that way,
it actually sounds
pretty good.)
translations.ね、勉強がんばってる？:
Hey, are you keeping up
with your studies？
translations.えっと……まあまあかな。どうしたの？:
Uh... pretty well, I guess.
Why do you ask？
translations.ちょっと気になっちゃったから。もし私のせいで成績が落ちたりとか、そんなことない？:
Just got to thinking.
Your grades aren't
slipping because of me,
are they？
translations.大丈夫。そんな心配いらないよ。:
I'm fine.
You don't need to worry
about that at all.
translations.そう？ ならいいけど……。:
Really？
Well, if you say so...
translations.（次のテストは頑張って、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を安心させるか）:
(I'd better ace the next
test to put ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
mind at ease.)
translations.あれ？ 目の下、クマできてない？:
Huh？ Don't you have
dark circles under
your eyes？
translations.無理しないでね。少しここで寝ていく？:
Don't push yourself.
Want to take a nap
here for a bit？
translations.はは、大丈夫だって。なんかお母さんみたいだな。:
Haha, I'm fine, really.
You sound like my mom.
translations.コラ、お母さんはないでしょ。せめてお姉さんに……ううん、それもイヤ。:
Hey, 'mom' is going too far!
At least say big sister...
Wait, no, I hate that too.
translations.ごめん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はカノジョだよな。:
Sorry, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s my girlfriend,
after all.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。夜中にふっと寂しくなることってある？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Do you ever get lonely
out of nowhere at night？
translations.夜中に？ どうかな……。:
In the middle of the night？
I wonder...
translations.私は時々あるかな。そんな時はあなたのことを考えます。:
I do sometimes.
And whenever that happens,
I think about you.
translations.そう、するとどうでしょう、寂しさが消えて、ぐっすり眠れるのです。:
Yup. And wouldn't you know
it, the loneliness fades
and I sleep like a baby.
translations.（●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと考えたら、眠れなくなりそうだな……）:
(If ● started thinking
about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I don't think
I'd get any sleep...)
translations.そういえばこの前、パトカーのサイレンが近くでしたんだけど、事件だったのかな。:
Come to think of it, I heard
police sirens nearby the
other day. Wonder what
happened？
translations.よろしくね、ナイトさん。:
I'm counting on you,
Sir Knight.
translations.あ、肩に髪の毛ついてるよ。:
Oh, you've got a hair
on your shoulder.
translations.ん～ほんとに私の髪かなぁ？:
Hmm... is it really
my hair, I wonder？
translations.決まってるだろ。ここ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の部屋なんだし。:
Of course it is.
We're in ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s room,
after all.
translations.ふふ、あわてちゃって▼:
Hehe, look how flustered
you are ▼
translations.軽くお香を焚いてみたんだけど……。:
I burned a little incense,
just a bit...
translations.ああ、そういえば、かすかに。これくらいならいいよね。:
Oh, now that you mention it,
faintly. It's nice like this.
translations.あ、今時計見たでしょ。:
Ah, you just checked
the clock, didn't you？
translations.え、特に意識しなかったけど。:
Huh？ I didn't even
realize I did.
translations.ほんとに？ ならいいけど。帰りたくなったら、ちゃんと言ってね。:
Really？ Okay then.
If you ever want to leave,
just say so, okay？
translations.帰りたくなくなることはあっても、帰りたくなることはないって。:
I'd never want to leave.
If anything, I never
want to go home.
translations.もう、またそんなかわいいこと言って……本当に帰さないよ！:
Geez, there you go being
adorable again... I really
won't let you leave!
translations.そうだ。ＤＶＤ借りたんだ。いっしょに観ようよ。:
Oh, right! I rented a DVD.
Let's watch it together.
translations.とにかく最高の恐怖が味わえるって評判なの。短編だから大丈夫よ？:
They say it's pure terror!
Don't worry though,
it's just a short film.
translations.う、そっか……、わかった。:
Ugh, really...？
Alright, let's do it.
translations.やった、じゃあ、じっくり鑑賞しようね。ふふ。:
Yay! Let's get cozy
and watch it. Hehe.
translations.あ、そういえば……。新しくオープンするスーパーのチラシが入ってたんだった。:
Oh, come to think of it...
A flyer came for that new
supermarket opening up.
translations.へえ、やっぱりそういうのチェックするんだ。:
Huh, you actually
check that stuff？
translations.もちろん！ ……あ、ごめんね、なんだか所帯じみた会話で。:
Of course! ...Ah, sorry.
Sounds a bit domestic,
doesn't it？
translations.謝ることないよ。いいじゃん、所帯じみてても。:
No need to apologize.
Domestic is nice, honestly.
translations.でもチェックするのは、さすがにあなたが帰ってからにするね。なんだか恥ずかしいから:
Still, I'll wait until
you leave to look.
It's a little embarrassing.
translations.だめ。じゃあ、フィクションでいいから。:
No excuses! You can make
something up if you want.
translations.ええっ、いきなりそんなこと言われてもさ。:
Whoa, that's really
putting me on the spot!
translations.じゃあ、次来るときまでの宿題。忘れたら、廊下に立っててもらうから。:
Then that's your homework
for next time. Forget, and
I'll make you stand outside!
translations.なんだか、眠たくなっちゃうね。:
I'm starting to feel
kind of sleepy...
translations.ううん、そうじゃなくて安心して……気が抜けちゃう感じ？:
No, not at all! It's just...
being with you is so safe,
I totally let my guard down.
translations.ふふ。もう何十年も一緒にいるみたいな気持ち。:
Fufu. Feels like we've
been together for decades.
translations.（何十って……、●たち高校生なんだけどな）:
(Decades...？ But ● are
only in high school...)
translations.なあ、アルバム見ない？:
Hey, wanna look
at the album？
translations.今は……そういう気分じゃないかな。:
Right now... I'm not really
in the mood, honestly.
translations.これちょっと懐かしいね。:
This one brings back
some memories.
translations.あのときの……撮ってたんだっけ。懐かしいね。:
From back then...
Did we take this？
Brings back memories.
translations.ああ、これ、結構前のだよね。:
Ah, this was quite
a while ago, wasn't it？
translations.この頃は若かったな……なーんてね。:
We were so young back then...
...Just kidding!
translations.これ、懐かしい。ちゃんと覚えてる？:
This brings back memories.
Do you remember it？
translations.あ、この間の写真だね。:
Oh, that's from the other day,
isn't it？
translations.これは……この間のか。いつだっけ。:
This is... from the other day,
right？ When was it again？
translations.最近の写真ね。そのうちこれも、思い出の写真になるのかな。:
A recent photo, huh.
I wonder if this'll be a fond
memory someday, too.
translations.この間の写真だ。まだよく覚えてるよ。:
From the other day.
I still remember it really well.
translations.あー、こんなのもあったね。: Ah, look, there's this one too.
translations.ふふ、こんな写真あったっけ。: Hehe, did we really take this？
translations.よく覚えてるよ、この写真。: I remember this photo so well.
translations.こんなの撮ってたんだね。ふふ。: You took one like this？ Hehe.
translations.あ、これ、いつの間に。: Oh, when did you sneak this one？
translations.たまにアルバムを見るのって、楽しいね。:
Looking through our album
every now and then is fun,
isn't it？
translations.いい写真。カメラマンの腕かな？:
Great shot.
Must be the photographer's skill？
translations.あ、私好きだな。これ。: Oh, I really like this one.
translations.うん、すごくよく撮れてる。: Yeah, it turned out really well.
translations.私、この写真、けっこう好きかも。:
You know, I think I really
like this one.
translations.初詣の時の写真。すごい人だったよね。:
From our New Year's visit.
It was so crowded, wasn't it？
translations.バレンタインデーのだよね。あのときは喜んでくれてありがとう。:
This is Valentine's Day, right？
Thanks for being so happy
with it.
translations.ホワイトデーのだね。あの時のこと、忘れられないよ。:
This is White Day, isn't it？
I'll never forget that.
translations.これ、クリスマスのだ。……これからも、毎年一緒にいられるといいな。:
This is from Christmas...
I hope we can spend it together
every year like this.
translations.……私の誕生日のだね。ちょっと照れるかな。:
...That's my birthday, huh.
It's a little embarrassing.
translations.この写真は、あなたの誕生日のだね。ふふっ、もう一回、おめでとう。:
This one's from your birthday.
Hehe, happy birthday once more.
translations.この写真……私たちにとって大切な日だね。:
This photo...
It's from a really special day
for both of us, isn't it？
translations.ああ、あの時の。素敵な時間だったね。:
Ah, that day.
That was such a wonderful time.
translations.この写真、撮っててくれてよかった。すごく特別な日だったから。:
I'm glad you took this photo.
It was such a special day.
translations.ねえ、この時のこと覚えてる？ 楽しかったよね、私は忘れないよ。:
Hey, remember this day？
It was so much fun...
I won't ever forget it.
translations.これからも、たくさん思い出作ろうね。:
Let's make lots more memories
together from now on, okay？
translations.またいっしょに写真、見ようね？:
Let's look at photos together
again sometime, okay？
translations.ふふ。いろんなこと思い出しちゃった。:
Hehe. So many memories came
flooding back.
translations.どんどん思い出が増えていくのって、いいな。:
I love how our memories
just keep growing like this.
translations.ふたりだけのアルバムがあるって、うれしいな。:
Having an album that's just ours
makes me so happy.
translations.ちょっと恥ずかしかったけど……またいっしょに見てくれる？:
It was a little embarrassing...
but will you look through it
with me again sometime？
translations.はい、おしまい。楽しかったね。:
All right, all done.
That was fun, wasn't it？
translations.写真撮るの好きだね。これじゃ、どんどんアルバムが増えちゃうかも。:
You really love taking photos.
At this rate, we'll have albums
piling up everywhere.
translations.写真だけじゃなくって、実物もちゃんとみるようにね？:
Don't just look at photos—
make sure you look at the real me,
too, okay？
translations.これからも、写真撮ってくれる？ 楽しみだな。:
Will you keep taking photos
of me？ I can't wait.
translations.あのさ、たまには勉強しない？: Hey, want to study for a change？
translations.勉強？ いいよ。お姉さんが教えてあげる。:
Study？ Sure thing.
Big sis will teach you.
translations.うーん、そういう気分じゃないんだけどな……。:
Mmm, I'm not really in the mood
for that right now...
translations.そっか……じゃあ、やめとくよ。: Oh, okay... We don't have to, then.
translations.あの、さ……写真撮ってもいい？: Um, hey... Can I take your photo？
translations.ここで？ ちょっと恥ずかしいけど……いいよ。:
Here？ It's a little
embarrassing, but... okay.
translations.ダーメ。ここは撮影禁止です。:
No-ope. Photography is
strictly forbidden here.
translations.ね、アルバム見みようか？:
Hey, wanna look through
the album together？
translations.そうだ、一緒に勉強しようか。:
Oh, I know! Why don't
we study together？
translations.ダメ？ ん……そうね。:
No good？ Hmm... yeah,
you're right.
translations.ねえねえ、カメラって今も持ち歩いてる？:
Hey, are you still carrying
your camera around？
translations.もちろん。ちょっと撮らせてよ:
Of course. Let me snap
a picture of you.
translations.あ、飲み物……いれなおしてくるね。:
Oh, let me go... pour us
some fresh drinks, okay？
translations.（カノジョの家に一人か……。なんかドキドキするな）:
(Alone at my girlfriend's
place... My heart's racing.)
translations.さっき知らない男の人が、入ってったみたいだから。:
I thought I saw a strange
man go inside just now.
translations.あ、大丈夫です。学校のお友達ですから。:
Oh, it's fine! He's just
a friend from school.
translations.あらいやだ、ごめんなさい。でも最近物騒だからね、気を付けて。:
Oh goodness, I'm sorry!
Things have been unsafe
lately, so be careful, okay？
translations.はい。ちょっと買いものに。:
Yes. Just running out
to do a little shopping.
translations.残念、一緒にお茶でもと思ったのに。:
What a shame, I was hoping
we could have tea together.
translations.あ、すみません。今、友達が来ていて。:
Ah, sorry. I have a friend
over right now.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、近所のおばさんと仲いいんだな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s on great terms
with the neighbors.)
translations.あ、お姉さん。新聞はどことってます？ 一ヶ月試してくれるだけでいいんですよ。:
Excuse me, miss! Which paper
do you read？ You only need
to try it for a single month!
translations.じゃあ、洗剤と……あ、商品券の方がいいですか？ それとも野球観ます？ チケットも:
How about some detergent...
Or maybe gift certificates？
Or baseball？ I've got tickets!
translations.失礼します。私こういう者ですが、この写真に見覚えはありませんか？:
Excuse me. Police.
Does this photo look familiar？
translations.そうですか。もし見かけることがあれば、ご一報ください。:
I see. If you happen
to see them, please
let us know.
translations.ああいえ、大したことじゃないんです。それでは。:
Oh, no, nothing serious.
Well then, excuse me.
translations.ねえねえ、それよりちょっと聞いてくれる？:
Hey, listen, can you
hear me out for a second？
translations.え、おばさん、私今ちょっと……。:
Oh, um, I'm actually
a bit busy right now...
translations.（おばさんの世間話に巻き込まれたか……）:
(Looks like she got roped
into some small talk...)
translations.お姉ちゃん、どこかお出かけ？:
Big sis, are you
going somewhere？
translations.あたしもママのおつかい。ね、いっしょに行こう！:
I'm running an errand
for Mommy! Hey, let's
go together!
translations.そうだね。いっしょに行こっか。:
Sure. Shall we walk together,
then？
translations.（さすが▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、近所の子供に好かれてるな）:
(Just like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
The neighborhood kids
really love her.)
translations.あれ、お姉ちゃんのお家、電気が点けっぱなしだよ。:
Huh？ Big sis, you left
the lights on at your place.
translations.今、お客さんが来てるからね。:
That's because I have
a guest over right now.
translations.ふふ、アタリ。お姉ちゃんの恋人だよ。でも、みんなにはヒミツだからね。:
Hehe, bingo! He's my
boyfriend. But it's our
little secret, okay？
translations.（恋人……いい響きだ）:
('Boyfriend'...
I like the sound of that.)
translations.颯子？ 今日、約束してたっけ？:
Satoko？ Did we have
plans today？
translations.ううん、近くまで来たから。よかったら一緒にお茶しない？:
Nope, just in the area.
Wanna grab tea together
if you're free？
translations.ごめん。今日はちょっと……ほら。:
Sorry. Today's a bit...
well, you know.
translations.あ、そういうこと……、はいはい。また今度ね。:
Oh, gotcha...
Say no more. Next time, then!
translations.（学校の友だちか。●のことも知ってるのかな）:
(A school friend, huh.
I wonder if she knows
about ● too.)
translations.おばさん。荷物、大丈夫？:
Are you okay with
all those bags？
translations.安売りしてて、つい買い過ぎちゃったみたい。:
They had a sale, and I went
and bought way too much.
translations.貸してください。手伝いますから。:
Here, let me take that.
I'll help you.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ご近所の人にも好かれてるんだな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is really popular
with the neighbors, too.)
translations.あれ、寧々ちゃんひとり？ さっきの男の子は？:
Huh, are you alone,
Nene-chan？ Where's that
boy from before？
translations.ばっちり。ありゃあ寧々ちゃんにベタ惚れだねぇ。:
Clear as day! He is totally
head over heels for you.
translations.そう……だといいですけど。どっちか言うと私の方が……。:
I... hope so. 
Though if anything, 
I think I'm the one who's...
translations.（……気になる会話だな）:
(...Now I'm really curious 
what they were talking about.)
translations.ごめんね、遅くなって。一人で大丈夫だった？:
Sorry to keep you waiting! 
Were you okay on your own？
translations.もう、次やったら……怖いからね。:
Geez. Do that again... 
and you're gonna get it.
translations.あのね、今度のデートで着る服、ちょっと悩んでるの……。:
So, um... I'm having trouble 
deciding what to wear on our date...
translations.もう。彼女の相談には乗るものよ。:
Geez. You're supposed to help 
your girlfriend out, you know.
translations.（何着てくるかって考えるのも楽しいんだよな……）:
(Thinking about what she'll wear 
is half the fun, though...)
translations.うん、ありがとう。待っててね、すぐ戻るから。:
Hehe, thanks. Wait here, okay？ 
I'll be right back.
translations.じゃーん。どう？ 似合うかな？:
Ta-da! How is it？ 
Does it suit me？
translations.そう？ ありがとう。でも、ほかの服も見てもらっていいかな？:
Really？ Thank you! 
Could you take a look 
at another one, too？
translations.そう……これはあんまりか。じゃあ、違う服にするね？:
Oh... Not feeling this one？ 
Okay, I'll go change 
into something else, alright？
translations.じゃあ、こんな感じは……どうかな？:
Then... how about 
something like this？
translations.かわいいのが見たいな: I'd love to see something cute.
translations.良かったぁ。うんうん、これか。:
Whew, good! 
Mm-hmm, so this is the one.
translations.そっか……なら、どんなのがいいの？:
I see... Then what kind of style 
would you like to see？
translations.パンツ系が似合うと思う: I think pants would suit you.
translations.わかった。待ってて、着替えてくるから。:
Got it. Wait here, 
I'll go change.
translations.……そういうのが好きなの。探してはみるけど。:
...So you like that style. 
I'll see what I can find.
translations.もう、冗談ばっかり。……でも部屋の中でだけなら……。:
Geez, you're always teasing. 
...Though if it's just 
inside my room...
translations.お待たせ。これはどう？:
Thanks for waiting! 
How about this？
translations.最初のが一番だった: The first one was the best.
translations.ひとつ前のやつに一票: My vote goes to the last one.
translations.やっぱりお任せで: Actually, I'll leave it to you.
translations.やっぱりね、こういうのが好きなんだ。:
I knew it! 
You really like this kind, huh？
translations.そうなの？ ……うーん、少し考えてみるね。:
Really？ ...Hmm, 
let me think about it 
for a bit.
translations.もう、せっかく……。また、当日まで悩んじゃう。:
Geez, after all that... 
Now I'll be fretting 
over it until that day.
translations.あ、もうこんな時間だよ。:
Ah, look at the time 
already.
translations.ほんとだ。そろそろ帰るかな。:
You're right. 
I should probably head 
home soon.
translations.ごめんね、こんな時間まで。:
Sorry for keeping you 
so late.
translations.ううん、名残惜しいけど、さすがに帰らないとな。:
No, I hate to leave, 
but I really should get 
going.
translations.もう少しいっしょにいたいと思ってるのは……私だけ？:
Am I the only one... 
who wants to stay 
together a little longer？
translations.●もそう思ってた:
● was thinking the 
exact same thing.
translations.ごめん、今日は帰るよ:
Sorry, I should head home 
for today.
translations.ふふ。以心伝心だね。:
Hehe. We're totally on 
the same wavelength.
translations.はあ、フラれちゃったら、しょうがないか。下まで送るね。:
Haah, can't be helped 
if I get turned down. 
I'll walk you downstairs.
translations.今日はありがとう。寄り道しないで、気をつけて帰って。:
Thanks for today. 
Head straight home, 
and get back safe, okay？
translations.まぁ、遠慮なく上がってよ。:
Come on in, make 
yourself at home.
translations.うん。それじゃ、お言葉に甘えて。:
Thanks. 
Don't mind if I do, then.
translations.どうぞ。あんまり、自慢できる部屋でもないけど。:
Come on in. 
Not that it's much to 
brag about.
translations.お邪魔します。ちゃんと片付いてるかな？:
Excuse me. 
Did you tidy up properly, 
I wonder？
translations.到着。どうぞ入ってよ。:
Here we are. 
Come on in.
translations.お邪魔します▼ カレシのお部屋チェックしちゃおうかな？:
Excuse me, ▼ 
Maybe I'll inspect my 
boyfriend's room？
translations.うちに遊びに来たのって、初めてだっけ？:
Is this the first time 
you've come over to my 
place？
translations.そうね。こんなふうに来たのは初めてかな。:
Yeah. Coming over like 
this might be a first.
translations.あんまりキレイじゃないけど、ゆっくりしてよ。:
It's not that clean, 
but make yourself at 
home.
translations.ただいま▼ って言いたくなっちゃうな。:
It makes me want to say, 
'I'm home, ▼'
translations.どうしてだろう。自分の部屋じゃないのに、なんだか落ち着く。:
I wonder why. 
It's not my room, but it 
feels so relaxing.
translations.そりゃ●が隣りにいるからでしょ。:
That's 'cause ● is 
right next to you.
translations.あー、調子に乗らないの。でも、ほんとにそうかも。:
Hey now, don't get 
cocky. ...Though you 
might actually be right.
translations.●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が隣りにいてくれると、元気が出るな。:
Having ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ right beside 
● always gives me 
energy.
translations.私はあなたのサプリかな。１日１錠、忘れずに。:
Am I your daily vitamin？ 
One tablet a day, 
don't forget.
translations.はは、これからも毎日よろしく。:
Haha, keep 'em coming 
every day, then.
translations.男の人の部屋って、やっぱり違うね。:
A guy's room really is 
different, isn't it？
translations.うん。四角いものが多い気がする。女の子の部屋は丸いものが多いでしょ？:
Yeah. Feels like there's 
lots of square things. 
Girls' rooms have more 
round things, you know？
translations.なるほど……そうかも。:
I see... 
You might be right.
translations.でしょ？ この部屋ももっと丸くしちゃおっかな。:
Right？ Maybe I should make 
this room a little 
rounder too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がしたいなら、いいけど。:
If that's what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ 
wants, I don't mind.
translations.そんなこと言うと、だんだん私好みにしちゃうぞ。:
Keep that up and I'll 
gradually turn it into 
a room to my own tastes.
translations.こうしてると、帰りたくなくなっちゃうね。:
Being like this makes me 
not want to go home, huh.
translations.もう帰る時間？:
Is it time for you to go 
already？
translations.ううん。帰る時間が近づいてくるのが寂しいなっていう話。:
Nope. I just meant
it's sad knowing the time to leave
is getting closer.
translations.ふふ。本当に帰らないって言ったら困るくせに。:
Hehe. As if you wouldn't panic
if I really said I'm not leaving.
translations.さて、と。それじゃあ、改めてお部屋のチェックしようかな。:
Well now. Time to give
your room a proper inspection,
I think.
translations.あー、なんだか怪しい反応。見られたらまずいものがあるのかなぁ？:
Ooh, that's a suspicious reaction.
Got something here
you don't want me seeing？
translations.ないない。いくらでもチェックしていいよ。:
No way! Check as much
as you like.
translations.冗談。ちょっと彼女っぽいこと言ってみたかっただけ。:
Just kidding.
I just wanted to sound
a little like a girlfriend.
translations.（やましいことがなくても、ドキドキするんだな……）:
（Even with nothing to hide,
my heart's pounding...）
translations.あなたは、部屋で独り言って言う？:
Do you ever talk to yourself
when you're in your room？
translations.独り言？ うーん、たまにかな。:
Talk to myself？
Hmm, once in a while, maybe.
translations.私もたまに、かな。:
I guess I do too,
once in a while.
translations.そうだな、電話してくれてもいいけど。:
Well, you could always call me
if you want.
translations.ありがとう。でもそんな理由で、電話してたら、歯止めがきかなくなりそうだから。:
Thanks. But if I called you
for stuff like that, I don't think
I'd ever be able to stop.
translations.そういえば、布団、干してる？:
Speaking of which,
do you air out your futon？
translations.ダメだよ、ちゃんと干さないと。:
No good!
You have to air it out properly.
translations.布団干しは面倒なんだよな。そんな時間あったら▲姉ヶ崎＊▲とデートするよ。:
Airing it out is such a hassle.
If I had time for that,
I'd rather go on a date with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.それは……うれしいけど、やっぱりダメ。ちゃんと干さないと。:
I mean... that's sweet,
but still, no!
You have to air it out properly.
translations.今日のおひつじ座の運勢は、最高だったの。:
Today's horoscope for Aries
was the absolute best!
translations.そっか、で、実際はどうなの？:
Oh yeah？
So how is it actually going？
translations.あれ？ 彼女の気分がわからないような彼氏じゃ、困るなあ。:
Huh？ You're no good as a boyfriend
if you can't tell how
your girlfriend is feeling.
translations.だって、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はいつもニコニコしてるしさ。:
Well, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is always
smiling anyway.
translations.あなたと一緒に居るのに、ムスッとしてるわけないじゃない。でしょ？:
I'm with you, so of course
I'm not gonna be sulking.
Right？
translations.（機嫌よさそうだし、当たってたのかな）:
（She seems in a good mood,
so maybe it was right.）
translations.ね、あなたは自炊する方？:
Hey, are you the type
who cooks for yourself？
translations.料理できる男の人ってモテるらしいよ。:
Apparently guys who can cook
are pretty popular with girls.
translations.私は料理や家事が得意な男の人より、苦手な方がいいな。だって、手伝ってあげられるで:
I actually prefer a guy
who isn't great at cooking or chores.
That way, I can help out, right？
translations.ね、あなたの部屋で、\n一番高価な物ってなに？:
Hey, what's the most expensive
thing in your room？
translations.なんだろ……パソコンとか？\n他には……うーん。:
Hmm, what could it be...
My computer, maybe？
Other than that... beats me.
translations.じゃあ一番大切な物は？: Then what's the most precious thing？
translations.……それは、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。\nカノジョだよ。:
...That would be
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
My girlfriend, of course.
translations.じゃあ、すっかりくつろいじゃってるのかな？:
Then I guess you're just
completely relaxed？
translations.それはあるかも。隣に▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいるし、何もしなくてもいい感じ。:
That could be it.
With you next to me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
even doing nothing feels nice.
translations.またうまいこと言って。でも……こういう過ごし方も悪くないかな。:
There you go, sweet-talking me.
Still... spending time like this
isn't bad at all.
translations.（これで、膝枕なんてできたら……）:
（Now if only I could rest my head
in her lap...）
translations.ね、\n部屋を選ぶときの決め手って\nなんだった？:
Hey,
what made you decide on
this apartment？
translations.家賃と学校までの距離とかかな？:
Probably the rent and
how close it is to school？
translations.私はね、\nそこに住んでる自分が\n想像できるかって考えたの。:
For me,
I thought about whether
I could picture myself
actually living there.
translations.そこに住んでる自分か……\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲みたいな\nカノジョがこの部屋に\n来て:
Picturing myself living here,
huh...
I never could've imagined
having a girlfriend like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
coming over, though.
translations.こーら、\nまたかわいいこと言って♪:
Hey now,
there you go saying
cute things again♪
translations.あれ？ 机の上のペン、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の？:
Huh？ Is that your pen
on the desk, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.少しずつ私の物を増やしてみよう作戦、失敗。:
Operation: Slowly leave
more of my stuff here...
officially a failure.
translations.なんだ、こっそりやらなくてもいいのに。:
Come on, you didn't have to
sneak around to do that.
translations.こっそり進めるのが楽しいの、こういうのは。:
Sneaking it in is the fun part
for things like this.
translations.（じゃあ、今度は気づかないふりするか？）:
(Guess next time I'll pretend
I didn't notice？)
translations.なんでこんなに、くつろげるのかな？ 私って変なのかも。:
Why do I feel so at home here？
Maybe I'm just weird.
translations.ははっ、変なことはないよ。でも、たしかに●の部屋に馴染んでるね。:
Haha, not at all.
Though you really do look
right at home in the room, ●.
translations.あなたも私の隣でくつろげてる？:
Can you relax
next to me, too？
translations.うん、そりゃ、ちょっと緊張はしてるけどさ。:
Yeah. I mean, I'm still
a little nervous, though.
translations.そうよね……、やっぱり私が変なのかも。安心して、眠くなっちゃうくらいだもん。:
Right...？
Maybe I really am weird.
I feel so at ease,
I'm getting sleepy.
translations.あなたの部屋って広いよね。うらやましいな。:
Your room is pretty spacious.
I'm jealous.
translations.そうかな？ まあひとり暮らしには十分だよな。:
You think so？
Well, it's plenty for living alone.
translations.読むよ、少女マンガとか、レディコミとか。:
I do. Shoujo manga,
ladies' comics, that kind of thing.
translations.レディコミ……ってどんなの？:
Ladies' comics...
What are those like？
translations.どんなの……うーん、男の子には説明しづらいかな。:
What are they like... Hmm,
kind of hard to explain to a boy.
translations.あれ？ 床にホコリが溜まってるね。:
Huh？ There's dust gathering
on the floor.
translations.ホントだ。掃除したつもりなんだけどな。:
Oh, you're right.
And here I thought I cleaned.
translations.あなたがひとりで掃除してるの想像すると、なんかかわいいな。:
Picturing you cleaning all by
yourself is kinda cute, though.
translations.どうしてかは分からないよ。でも、不器用に掃除機かけて……、ふふっ、ほら、かわいい:
I don't really know why.
But clumsily vacuuming away...
Hehe, see？ Totally cute.
translations.あ、また。この辺、ノラちゃんがいるみたいね。:
Ah, again. Looks like there's
a stray around here.
translations.……野良猫か。誰かが餌付けしてるのかも。:
...A stray cat.
Someone might be feeding it.
translations.私、ごはんあげたくなる気持ちわかるな。:
I can totally understand
wanting to feed it.
translations.ああ、動物園とか餌あげたくなるよな。:
Yeah, like wanting to feed
animals at the zoo.
translations.（●は野良猫といっしょか……）:
(So to ●, I'm the same
as a stray cat...？)
translations.さっき、キッチンにカップラーメンの買い置きあったけど。:
I saw a bunch of instant ramen
stocked in the kitchen earlier.
translations.ああ、夜食とかで食べるから。:
Oh, yeah, for late-night
snacks and stuff.
translations.インスタントばっかりじゃダメだよ。:
You can't just live on
instant food, okay？
translations.あとカンヅメもたくさんあったね、ほどほどにね。:
And you had tons of canned
food, too. Don't overdo it,
okay？
translations.わ！ ははっ、なにすんだよ！:
Whoa! Haha, what are you
doing?!
translations.急に緊張してきちゃって……ほら、笑うと緊張がほぐれるって言うでしょ？:
I suddenly got nervous...
Laughing is supposed to help
you relax, right？
translations.押し入れがある家って、減ってきてるのかな？:
Do you think fewer homes
have traditional closets
these days？
translations.どうだろ？ 今っぽいおしゃれなマンションには無いのかも。:
Maybe？ Modern, stylish
apartments probably don't
have them.
translations.私ね、結構押し入れ好きなんだ。暗くて……静かな感じとか？:
You know, I actually really
like closets like that.
All dark and... quiet, maybe？
translations.さすがホラー好き。: Spoken like a true horror fan.
translations.それは関係ないよ。小さい頃ね、お仕置きで押し入れに入れられても、実はちっとも怖く:
That's got nothing to do
with it! When I got shut
in the closet as a kid,
I wasn't even scared.
translations.ちょっと分かるかな、暗くて狭いところって、入りたくなるよ。:
I kind of get it. Small,
dark spaces just make you
want to climb inside.
translations.でしょ、今度二人で入ってみる？:
Right？ Want to try squeezing
in together sometime？
translations.あのさ、新しいゲーム買ったんだけど、一緒にやろうよ？:
Hey, I bought a new game.
Want to play together？
translations.なあ、ゲームでもやろっか？: Hey, feel like playing a game？
translations.ゲーム？ うん、いいよ。どんなの？:
A game？ Sure, sounds fun.
What kind is it？
translations.ゲームか？ う～ん、また今度にしよ？:
A game？ Hmm, maybe some
other time, okay？
translations.そっか。ま、気にしないでよ。:
Gotcha. Well, don't worry
about it.
translations.このゲーム、私にもできるかな。:
I wonder if I can play
this one too.
translations.それか……いいよ。負けないから。:
That one, huh... Sure!
I'm not gonna lose, though.
translations.あ、それね。結構慣れてるんだから。:
Oh, that one! I'm actually
pretty good at it, you know.
translations.うーん、ちょっと、気分が乗らないかな。:
Hmm, I'm not really in the
mood for that right now.
translations.私が苦手なの知ってて？ イジワルなんだから。:
Knowing full well I'm bad
at it？ You're such a meanie.
translations.そうだ、新作のＤＶＤあるんだ。一緒に観ようよ？:
Oh yeah, I got a new DVD.
Want to watch it together？
translations.一緒にＤＶＤでも観ようか？: Want to watch a DVD together？
translations.うん、いいよ。なにが観たいの？:
Sure, sounds good!
What do you want to watch？
translations.……今は遠慮しよっかな。ごめんね。:
...I think I'll pass for now.
Sorry.
translations.ほんと？ 私もそういうの観たかったの。:
Really？ I was actually
hoping to watch that too.
translations.あなたが観たいなら、それにしよ。:
If that's what you want to
watch, let's go with that.
translations.そっか、うーん、他のじゃダメ？:
I see... Hmm, can we pick 
something else？
translations.期待通りだったね。夢中になっちゃった。:
Just as good as I hoped！ 
I got totally sucked in.
translations.そうね……、こういうのも、たまにはいいかも。:
Yeah... Something like this 
is nice once in a while.
translations.ちょっと、私には合わなかったかな……。:
I guess that one just wasn't 
really for me...
translations.新しいＣＤあるんだけどさ。聴かない？:
I've got a new CD. 
Want to listen to it？
translations.音楽あったほうがいいよね。なにかＣＤ聴く？:
Some music would be nice. 
Want to put on a CD？
translations.いい曲ね……。私、ファンになっちゃったかも。:
What a great song... 
I think I might be a fan now.
translations.ねえ、ゲームしよっか？: Hey, want to play a game？
translations.あのね私、映画観たいな。:
You know, I'd really love 
to watch a movie.
translations.断られちゃったか……。ううん、いいの。気にしないで。:
Turned down, huh...？ 
No, it's fine. Don't worry.
translations.あなたといる時間って、いつもあっという間。不思議だね。:
Time always flies with you. 
It's funny, isn't it？
translations.●も。だけど、やっぱりそろそろ帰らないとな。:
● feel the same. 
But I really should head home.
translations.私、そろそろ失礼するね……。: I guess I should get going...
translations.うーん、そろそろよね……、どうしよう？:
Hmm, it's about that time... 
What should we do？
translations.もう少しなら平気じゃない？: A little longer should be fine？
translations.遅くならないほうがいいね: Better not make it too late
translations.引き止めてくれるんだ？ もう、カワイイんだから▼:
Trying to keep me here？ 
Geez, you're so cute, ▼.
translations.ありがとう……でも、今日は帰るね。:
Thank you... but I think 
I'll head home for today.
translations.そう、よね。じゃあ、今日はありがとう。:
You're right. 
Well, thanks for today.
translations.そうなんだけど……もう少しだけ、一緒にいたいな。ワガママ、聞いてくれる？:
I know, but... I still want 
to be with you a bit longer. 
Can I be a little selfish？
translations.ね、お腹はどう？ 空いてない？:
Hey, how's your stomach？ 
Aren't you hungry？
translations.ほんと？ 私ね、レパートリーが増えたんだ。:
Really？ I've added some new 
dishes to my repertoire.
translations.じゃあ、私が作ろっか？:
How about I cook 
something, then？
translations.そっか、じゃあなにか食べに行く？:
I see. Want to go grab 
something to eat, then？
translations.作ってほしいなぁ: I'd love it if you cooked...
translations.そんなに喜んでくれるの？ よっし、はりきっちゃう▼:
You're that happy about it？ 
Alright, I'll go all out, ▼！
translations.いいお返事。おいしいの、作ってあげるね。:
Good boy. 
I'll make you something 
delicious, okay？
translations.買出しでも、なんでも手伝うからさ。:
I'll help out with groceries 
or whatever you need.
translations.しょうがないなぁ……。それじゃあ、少し待っててね。:
Can't help it, then... 
Wait just a bit, okay？
translations.そう言われても、なにも準備してないし……。:
Even if you say that, 
I haven't got anything 
ready, you know...
translations.そっか……。残念だけど、あきらめて食べに行くか。:
I see... Too bad, 
guess we'll just give up 
and go eat out.
translations.もぅ……わかってないんだから。:
Jeez... 
You really don't get it.
translations.それじゃあ、どこで食べる？:
So, where do you 
wanna eat？
translations.これでよし。さぁ、腕によりをかけて、作るからね。:
There we go. 
Alright, I'll put my heart 
into making this!
translations.ちょっと気分変えてみたくて……このままお料理しよっかな。:
I wanted a change of pace... 
Maybe I'll just cook 
dressed like this.
translations.ご注文はお決まりですか？ リクエストがあるなら、どうぞ。:
Have you decided on 
your order？ 
If you have a request, 
go right ahead.
translations.お客さま、お目が高い！ そちらは当店のイチオシメニューとなっております♪:
You have great taste, sir! 
That happens to be 
our top recommendation♪
translations.それは……少々お時間いただきます。:
That one... 
might take a little time.
translations.えっ!? それは……頑張ってみるけど、ちょっと不安かも。:
Huh!? That... 
Well, I'll do my best, 
but I'm a bit nervous.
translations.料理はリズムが大事ですよ、っと。:
Cooking is all about rhythm, 
and... there!
translations.お待たせしました▼ おいしくできてるといいんだけどな。:
Thanks for waiting▼ 
I hope it turned out tasty.
translations.うんっと。ダマにならないように……。:
Alright... 
Making sure there are 
no lumps...
translations.お菓子作りって、体力勝負なのよねっ。:
Making sweets really takes 
some stamina, doesn't it!
translations.いいにおい。はい、召し上がれ！:
Smells so good. 
Here you go, dig in!
translations.同じ食卓に、お揃いの食器。まるで……夫婦みたいね？:
Sharing the same table, 
matching dishes... 
Almost like we're 
married, aren't we？
translations.次回のご注文は？ ご予約承ります。:
What's your next order？ 
Now accepting reservations!
translations.ごめんなさい！ あの、蛇口、壊しちゃったみたいで。濡らしちゃった。:
I'm so sorry! Um, 
I think I broke the faucet... 
I got all wet.
translations.びしょびしょ……シャワー借りてもいいかな？:
They're soaked... 
Could I borrow your shower？
translations.うん、どうぞ。自由に使って。:
Sure, go right ahead. 
Make yourself at home.
translations.なんだろう寒気が……。:
I don't know why, 
but I feel a chill...
translations.顔色悪いよ。風呂場使ってもいいけど。:
You look pale. 
You can use my bath, 
if you want.
translations.ほんと？ じゃあ、お言葉に甘えて。:
Really？ Then I'll take you 
up on that.
translations.思い切り降られちゃったな。風邪ひくから、シャワー浴びてきなよ。:
We really got poured on. 
You'll catch a cold, 
go take a shower.
translations.そうする、服も乾かさないと……。:
I will. I need to dry 
my clothes, too...
translations.うん、えっと……着るもの借りられない？:
Yeah, um... could I borrow 
something to wear？
translations.サイズ、大丈夫かな……とりあえず、それで。:
Hope the size is okay... 
Wear that for now.
translations.えっと……。もう少し、普通のないかな。:
Um... Don't you have 
anything a bit more normal？
translations.……だよね。用意するよ。:
...Yeah, fair enough. 
I'll find something else.
translations.もぅっ……。なにこれ？ 怒るよ。:
Geez...! What is this？ 
I'm gonna get mad.
translations.ふぅ、ありがとう。さっぱりしたよ。:
Phew, thanks. 
I feel so refreshed.
translations.すっごく気持ち良かったよ？ 助かっちゃった。:
That felt amazing. 
You really saved me.
translations.自分の家以外でお風呂に入るのって、ドキドキしちゃうね。:
Taking a bath at someone 
else's place really gets 
your heart racing, huh？
translations.ちゃんとイイ子にして待ってた？:
Were you a good boy 
while you waited？
translations.なーんだ。待ってたのにな。……なんて、うそ▼:
Aww. And here I was 
waiting for you... 
...Just kidding!▼
translations.お先にいただきました▼ 温まったよ。次、あなたも入ってきて？:
Thanks for letting me 
go first▼ I'm all warmed up. 
Your turn now, okay？
translations.ねえ？ あなたのことをもう一度ちゃんと知りたいな。:
Hey... I'd love to get to
know you all over again.
translations.あなたの苗字って……ちょっと意識しちゃうかな……ふふっ。:
Your last name...
It makes me a little
fluttery... Hehe.
translations.はい、お名前をどうぞ。:
Alright, go ahead and
give me your name.
translations.誕生日も、ちゃ～んと覚えてるからね。私のも覚えてくれてる？:
I'll definitely remember
your birthday, too.
You remember mine, right？
translations.血液型占いって、気にするタイプ？ 私はＯ型、わかってるよね？:
Do you check blood-type fortunes？
Mine's O, you know that, right？
translations.読み方もちゃーんとね。: And how to pronounce it, too.
translations.あなたが生まれ育った場所って、きっと素敵なところなんだろうなぁ。:
The place you grew up...
I bet it's a really lovely place.
translations.あだ名みたいなものね。ハンドルネームって、意外とセンスが出たりして。:
It's like a nickname, huh？
A handle name can really show off
someone's personality.
translations.ねえ、あなたのことはどうやって呼べばいい？: Hey, what should I call you？
translations.ふふっ、いいよ。そう呼んであげるね。:
Fufu, all right.
That's what I'll call you, then.
translations.私のことはなんて呼びたい？ リクエストしていいよ。:
What would you like to call me？
Go ahead, take your pick.
translations.これで間違いはないかな？ しっかり確認しておいてね。:
Is everything right？
Be sure to double-check, okay？
translations.これでオッケーね？ あなたとまた距離が近づいた気がするな。:
All good, right？
I feel like we just got
a little closer again.
translations.このゲームは、ニンテンドー３ＤＳ本体の時計に連動して進みます。時間がずれていない:
This game progresses in real time
synced with the Nintendo 3DS
system clock. Please make sure
the time is accurate before starting.
translations.もし時間がずれていたら、一度電源をＯＦＦにして、ニンテンドー３ＤＳ本体の時計を正:
If the time is incorrect,
please turn off the power and set
the Nintendo 3DS system clock
properly.
translations.ゲームを開始すると、ゲーム内の時間は変更できないので、慎重にお願いします。:
Once you start the game, the
in-game time cannot be changed,
so please check carefully.
translations.それでは、このゲームの時間をあなたの生活に合わせて設定してください。ずらすのは、:
Now, please adjust the in-game
clock to match your schedule.
Please only shift the time if
your daily routine strictly requires it.
translations.はい、これで設定は完了です。お疲れ様でした。:
All right, setup is complete.
Thank you for your time.
translations.ふふ、待たせちゃったかな。いい子にしてた？:
Hehe, keep you waiting？
Have you been a good boy？
translations.あ、もしかして……こんな風に並んで歩くの、久々かもしれないね。:
Oh, you know... It might've
been a while since we walked
side by side like this.
translations.寂しかったな～。お仕置きとして、これからはたくさん構ってね？:
I was pretty lonely~.
As your punishment, give me
lots of attention, okay？
translations.思い出を再生中……一緒に、熱海に行ったときのこと。:
Replaying my memories...
Like when we went to Atami
together.
translations.熱海ね……ああ、いい思い出だった……。:
Atami, huh...
Yeah, that was such a great time...
translations.なにを思い出してるのかなあ？ 私はね、最初から最後まで全部思い出せるよ？:
I wonder what you're
remembering？ As for me,
I remember everything
from start to finish.
translations.だって、ずーっとあなたと一緒だったんだもん。どんなことだって覚えてるよ。:
Well, I was with you the whole
time, after all. I remember
every single thing.
translations.それはこっちの台詞。ジロジロ見て、なにが気になるの？:
That's my line.
Staring like that...
see something you like？
translations.別に……見てないけど？:
Not really...
I wasn't staring, was I？
translations.あ、ひょっとしてキレイになったお姉さんに、メロメロになっちゃってる？:
Oh, could it be you've fallen
head over heels for your newly
gorgeous older girlfriend？
translations.コラ、冗談なんだから本気にしないの。そんなに真剣な目して。:
Hey, I was just teasing, don't
take it so seriously. Giving me
such an intense look...
translations.そんな目してるかな？: Do I really look that serious？
translations.してるでしょ。ほらほら、顔、よ～く見せてごらん？:
You definitely do. Come on,
let me get a good look at
your face.
translations.正面から、ちゃんと見て。:
Look right at me,
from the front.
translations.離れちゃイヤ。もっとこっち、ね？:
Don't pull away.
Come closer, okay？
translations.もう、近寄り過ぎ。めっ。:
Geez, that's too close!
Bad boy.
translations.そうそう、よく見えるよ。そのまま笑って～？:
There we go, I can see you
well. Now give me a smile~？
translations.うん、いいスマイル、１００点！:
Yep, great smile!
A hundred points!
translations.ん？ 恥ずかしがってる？ まあカワイかったからいいけど。:
Hm? Are you embarrassed？
Well, you were cute,
so that's fine.
translations.なんか誰もいないかもなーって……。:
I was just thinking...
There's really nobody around...
translations.それで、どうしたいの？:
And what do you want to do
about that？
translations.今は、ここまで。: That's as far as we go for now.
translations.これから、もっといろんな思い出作れるじゃない。だから、ゆっくり、ね？:
We've got plenty more memories
to make from now on.
So let's take it slow, okay？
translations.ねえ、のど乾かない？ 何か買ってこようか。:
Hey, thirsty？
Want me to grab us
something to drink？
translations.何でもいい？ 少し待っててね。:
Anything's fine？
Wait right here, okay？
translations.ふふ、ヘンな返事。:
Hehe, what a weird
thing to say.
translations.休んでていいのに。:
You could've just stayed
and rested, though.
translations.いいの、離れたくないんだもん。:
It's fine. I just don't
want to be away from you.
translations.あ、ベンチが空いてる。少し休まない？:
Oh, a bench is open.
Want to take a short break？
translations.ふぅ、結構歩いたね。:
Phew, we've walked
quite a bit, haven't we？
translations.よし、少し休んだら行くぞ！:
Alright, once we rest up,
we're back on the move!
translations.私に気つかってる？ 大丈夫だよ、少し休めば。:
Worrying about me？
I'll be fine once
we rest for a bit.
translations.いいって、脚疲れたでしょ。:
It's fine, your legs
must be tired, right？
translations.もう、気付かれないようにしてたのにな。ありがとう。:
Geez, and I was trying
so hard not to show it.
Thank you.
translations.はいはい、元気だね？:
Yes, yes, look at you,
full of energy.
translations.頼もしいんだ。じゃあ、私が疲れちゃったらおぶってね？:
How dependable. Then if I
get tired, you'll carry me
on your back, right？
translations.ふぅ、少し暑くなってきちゃった。一枚脱いじゃおうかな。:
Phew, it's getting warm.
Maybe I'll take off
a layer.
translations.日焼けには気をつけないと:
Better watch out
for sunburn, though.
translations.なんだか、そういう言い方されるとなあ……。まあ、いっか。:
Somehow, hearing you say
it like that...
Oh well, whatever.
translations.いいな、涼しそうで。●も脱ごうかな。:
Looks nice and cool.
Maybe ● should
take something off too.
translations.はーい。色白なほうが、好き？:
Okay. Do you prefer
fairer skin？
translations.そういうわけじゃないけど、たまに気にしてるだろ？:
Not necessarily, but you
worry about it sometimes,
don't you？
translations.お肌の大敵ですから。ふふ、気をつかってくれるんだ。:
It's the enemy of good
skin, after all. Hehe,
so you do care.
translations.今日は少し寒いね……。:
It's a little chilly
today, isn't it...？
translations.……勝ち負けってあるの？ まあいいや、えいっ！:
...There's winning and
losing in this？
Oh well, take this!
translations.あ、お店が出てる。少し見てきてもいい？:
Oh, there's a stall set up.
Mind if I go take a look？
translations.じゃあ、行ってくるね。いい子で待ってなさい？:
All right, I'll go look.
Be a good boy and wait here, okay？
translations.お待たせ。いい子にしてたから、ちゃんと買ってきてあげたよ。:
Thanks for waiting!
Since you were such a good boy,
I brought you a treat.
translations.んー、買い過ぎた？: Hmm, did we buy too much？
translations.どうかな……大丈夫、男の子でしょ？:
Who knows... But you'll be fine.
You're a boy, after all, right？
translations.あっ、子猫。見て見て、かわいい～▼:
Ah, a kitten! Look, look,
it's so cute~▼
translations.なあに？ 子猫に嫉妬しちゃった？:
What's this？ Are you getting
jealous of a kitten？
translations.もう、しょうがないなあ。じゃあ、あなたにも言ってあげる。かわいい～▼:
Oh, you're impossible.
Fine, I'll say it to you, too.
You're so cute~▼
translations.わあ、日差しが強いね。焼けそう……。:
Whoa, the sun's really strong.
Feels like I'll burn...
translations.サンオイル塗ってあげる: I'll put tanning oil on you
translations.そうね、しっかり紫外線予防しなくちゃ。:
Good idea. I really need to
protect against the UV rays.
translations.自分で塗れます！: I can put it on myself!
translations.小麦色の肌がいいんだ、ふーん。:
So you like tanned skin, huh？
Hmm...
translations.景色、きれいだね……。ねえ、写真撮ろっか。:
The view is so pretty...
Hey, want to take a picture？
translations.誰かに撮ってもらおう: Let's ask someone to take it
translations.うん、ありがとう。私はオマケでいいからね。:
Yeah, thanks! I can just be
an extra in the background, okay？
translations.何言ってんの。オマケは景色だって。:
What are you talking about？
The scenery's the extra here.
translations.二人で一緒に？ うん、それがいいね。:
The two of us together？
Yeah, that sounds great.
translations.よし。じゃあ……すいませーん！:
All right. Here goes...
Excuse me~!
translations.わあ、すごい人混み……。人気の場所なんだね。:
Whoa, what a crowd...
This place must be really popular.
translations.みんな考えることは同じだな: Guess everyone had the same idea
translations.わざわざ人に揉まれに来るなんて……:
Coming all this way just to get
shoved around in a crowd...
translations.そうだね。デートの定番ってことなのかな。:
True. I guess it's just
a classic date spot.
translations.まあ、少し賑やかなくらいの方がいっか。:
Well, a lively vibe
isn't so bad either.
translations.私たちも同類だよ？:
Aren't we doing
the exact same thing, though？
translations.みんな同じようなこと思ってるのかもしれないね。:
Maybe everyone else is thinking
the exact same thing.
translations.なんだか閑散としてるね。あまり人気がないのかな？:
It's pretty deserted here.
I wonder if it's not
very popular？
translations.いい日に来たな、ラッキー！:
Picked a good day!
Lucky us!
translations.そうね。二人きりになれそうだし？:
Yeah. Feels like we can
be all alone together, too？
translations.考えることは一緒だね。:
We really think alike,
don't we？
translations.私はあなたがいれば、十分。:
As long as I have you,
that's enough for me.
translations.いっそ、二人しかいないほうがいいかもね？:
Honestly, maybe it's even
better with just us two？
translations.雨、残念だね。晴れますようにってお祈りしたんだけどな……。:
Too bad about the rain.
I even prayed for sunshine,
too...
translations.雨でいいこともあるよ:
There are good things
about the rain, too.
translations.元気だね。その元気で雨吹き飛ばしちゃえ！:
Aren't you energetic!
Go blow the rain away
with all that pep!
translations.そうだな、えっと、相合傘とか？:
Well, um... sharing
an umbrella, maybe？
translations.ふふ。そうね、素直でよろしい。:
Hehe. Very true.
Good boy for being honest.
translations.ねえ、今日、あなたの家に寄ってもいい？:
Hey, can I drop by
your place today？
translations.嬉しい。それじゃ、お邪魔します▼:
I'm so glad. Well then,
don't mind if I do, ▼
translations.はは、大したもんじゃないけど。:
Haha, there's really
not much to see, though.
translations.わかった。散らかってるんでしょ。:
I get it. It's a mess,
isn't it？
translations.もう、そんなの気にしないのに。じゃあ、次の機会にね？:
Geez, I wouldn't mind that!
Next time, then？
translations.ねえ、占いやってる。相性見てもらわない？:
Hey, look, fortune-telling!
Want to have our
compatibility read？
translations.別にいいよ、信じてないし:
I'll pass.
I don't really believe in it.
translations.そう？ あなたがそう思ってるなら、いいけど。:
Really？ If that's what
you think, that's fine, but...
translations.そうそう。いまさら必要ないって。:
Yeah. We don't really
need that at this point.
translations.二人の相性は最高、明るい将来は確実です！:
Your compatibility is the
best! A bright future is
guaranteed!
translations.すごい、最高だって！ 将来かあ……。:
Wow, the best!
A future together, huh...
translations.二人の相性はいいほうです、きっと上手くいくでしょう。:
Your compatibility is quite
good. Things should surely
work out fine!
translations.うん、上手くいくって。……でもちょっと物足りないかな？:
Yeah, it'll work out.
...Though isn't that
a little underwhelming？
translations.いいほうなんだから充分だって。●たち次第だからさ。:
Hey, 'quite good' is plenty.
It's up to ● anyway.
translations.……ねえ、どういうことかな？:
...Hey, what is that
supposed to mean？
translations.こんなところに花が咲いてる。かわいいね。:
Look, there's a flower
blooming here. It's so cute.
translations.うん、呼ばれたみたい。目立たないところに咲いちゃって、寂しかったのかな。ねー？:
Yeah, felt like it called to me.
Maybe it was lonely blooming
out of the way. Right？
translations.かわいいと言えば……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の方が。:
Speaking of cute...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s way cuter.
translations.ふふ、言いながら照れてる。もう、どっちがかわいいのよ。:
Hehe, you're blushing!
Jeez, which of us is the
cute one here？
translations.あれ？ あっちから来る子……クラスメイトだ。:
Huh？ That girl coming this way...
she's in my class.
translations.もう、恥ずかしいじゃない。……知らんぷりしちゃお。:
Jeez, that's embarrassing!
...Let's just pretend
we didn't see them.
translations.照れなくてもいいのに。向こうに行っちゃったみたいよ？:
You didn't have to be so shy.
Looks like they went
the other way, though？
translations.ねえ、お掃除してあげようか？:
Hey, want me to tidy up
for you？
translations.お客様にそんなこと……: I can't make a guest do that...
translations.気をつかってくれるのは嬉しいけど、お客様扱いは寂しいな。じゃあ、そのうちね。:
I appreciate the thought,
but being treated like a guest
makes me a little lonely.
Maybe some other time, then.
translations.ごめん、そういう意味じゃなかったんだけど……。:
Sorry, I didn't mean it
like that...
translations.もう、遠慮がないね。それでいいんだけど▼:
Jeez, you really don't hold back.
Not that I mind, though.▼
translations.居心地のいい部屋だね。ずっといたくなっちゃうな。:
This is such a cozy room.
Makes me want to stay forever.
translations.ずっといれば？ 遅くなっても、ちゃんと送るからさ。:
Why not stay, then？
Even if it gets late,
I'll walk you home.
translations.……もう、無邪気なんだから。一瞬ドキっとしちゃった。:
...Oh, you're so innocent.
You made my heart skip a beat
for a second.
translations.もう、本気にしないの。私だって、あなたのこと困らせたくはないし。:
Jeez, don't take me so seriously.
I wouldn't want to put you
on the spot, anyway.
translations.ねえ、本棚見てもいい？:
Hey, can I look at
your bookshelf？
translations.どうぞいくらでも: Go right ahead, take your time.
translations.あっさりオーケーしちゃうんだ。慌てると思ったのになあ。:
You agreed so easily!
I thought you'd panic a little.
translations.（慌てる必要はない……はず）:
(I've got nothing to panic
about... right？)
translations.あなたが小さい頃のアルバムとか、見たいなー。ダメ？:
I'd love to see albums from
when you were little. Can I？
translations.（そういうの、なんか恥ずかしいんだよな……）:
(That kind of thing is kind of
embarrassing, though...)
translations.自分の家だと思って、くつろいでね。:
Make yourself at home, okay？
Just relax.
translations.だらしなくしなさいって意味じゃないですからね？ ふふ、子供みたい。:
I didn't mean lounge around
sloppily, you know？
Hehe, you're like a little kid.
translations.いつも通りでいればいいの。ほら、怖くない、怖くない。:
Just act like you always do.
There, there, nothing to
be scared of.
translations.あなた専用のもの、色々必要かな？:
I wonder if we should get
some things just for you？
translations.わざわざ、悪いよ……:
You really don't have to
go out of your way...
translations.そういうのいいね、カップルっぽくてさ。:
I really like that.
Feels like a real couple.
translations.っぽいじゃありません。でしょ？:
Not 'feels like.'
We're a real couple, right？
translations.そう？ 私は楽しいのにな……。:
Really？ I think it'd be
lots of fun, though...
translations.無理しなくても、いいからさ。:
I just don't want you
pushing yourself, okay？
translations.ごめんなさい。散らかってるでしょ。:
Sorry. It's kind of a mess
in here, isn't it？
translations.思ってたよりずっとキレイ:
It's way cleaner
than I expected.
translations.これで散らかってたら、●の部屋は……。:
If this counts as messy,
●, your room must be...
translations.こら、だらしない生活してると、押しかけちゃうぞ？:
Hey, if you live like a slob,
I might just have to
barge in on you, you know？
translations.思ってたより？ ひどいな、どんな想像してたの？:
Than you expected？ How mean!
Just what were you imagining？
translations.今日が私の誕生日って、知ってて来てくれたのかな？:
Did you come visit me 
knowing today's my birthday？
translations.今日は期待していいんだよね。だって私の誕生日だもん……ふふ。:
I can get my hopes up today, 
right？ After all, it's my 
birthday... hehe.
translations.ねえ、今日は私の誕生日だから……ふたりっきりで過ごせるよね？:
Hey, it's my birthday, 
so we get to spend it just 
the two of us, right？
translations.お誕生日おめでとう。ちゃんとお祝いさせてね？:
Happy birthday. 
Let me celebrate properly 
for you, okay？
translations.お誕生日おめでとう。今日はなんでも言うこと聞いてあげようかなぁ？:
Happy birthday. 
Maybe I'll do whatever 
you ask of me today？
translations.ハッピーバースデー！ 今日は思う存分甘えさせてあげるね。:
Happy birthday! 
I'll spoil you as much as 
you want today.
translations.ふたりが初めて会った日のこと覚えてる？ 今日はその記念日だよ。:
Do you remember the day 
we first met？ 
Today's our anniversary.
translations.今日はふたりが初めて出会った記念日。もちろん覚えてるよね？:
Today's the anniversary of 
when we first met. 
You remember, of course？
translations.今日はお祝いしちゃう？ ふたりが初めて出会った記念日だもんね。:
Should we celebrate today？ 
It's the anniversary of 
when we first met, after all.
translations.今日は……ふたりが恋人同士になった特別な記念日▼:
Today is... the special 
anniversary of when 
we became a couple▼
translations.今日は私たちが恋人になった記念日。もちろん覚えてたでしょ▼:
Today's our anniversary of 
becoming a couple. 
You remembered, right▼
translations.ねえ、今日は私たちが恋人になった記念日だから……特別なお祝いしようか？:
Hey, today's the day we 
became a couple... want to 
have a special celebration？
translations.さて、月曜日。１週間の始まり始り～。:
Well, it's Monday. 
And so a brand-new 
week begins~
translations.火曜日だね。ほらほら、気合い入れなくちゃ。:
It's Tuesday. 
Come on, we've gotta 
give it our best.
translations.ん～、まだ水曜日かぁ。あ、ちょっと気がゆるんじゃった。:
Mmm, only Wednesday, huh. 
Ah, I let myself slack 
a little there.
translations.木曜日。１週間の山を越えたって感じかな？:
Thursday. Feels like we've 
made it over the hump 
for the week, doesn't it？
translations.ようやく来ました金曜日。少しワクワクしない？:
Friday's finally here. 
Doesn't it make you 
a little excited？
translations.土曜日だよ？ なんだかほっとするね。:
It's Saturday, you know？ 
It's such a relief.
translations.待ちに待った日曜日。ダラダラ過ごしたら許さないよ？:
The Sunday we've waited for! 
I won't let you just laze 
the day away, okay？
translations.昼間は暖かいけど、朝晩は冷えるから体調管理はしっかりね。:
It's warm during the day, 
but mornings and nights get 
chilly. Look after yourself.
translations.これだけ暑いと、水分と栄養補給は大事だよ？:
When it's this hot, staying 
hydrated and well-fed is 
super important, okay？
translations.今朝は秋の匂いがしたの。ふふっ。:
It smelled like autumn 
this morning. Hehe.
translations.寒いね。くっついちゃおうか？:
It's cold out. 
Want to snuggle up？
translations.なんだか嬉しくなっちゃった……ふふ。:
I just felt so happy 
all of a sudden... hehe.
translations.よかった。会いに来てくれた。:
I'm so glad. 
You came to see me.
translations.あなたが来てくれるの、待ってたの。:
I was waiting for you 
to come by.
translations.早く早く。ふたりの時間は少しでも長く、ね？:
Hurry, hurry! We want 
as much time together 
as we can get, right？
translations.あなたに会えると、嬉しくなっちゃう。:
Seeing you always makes me 
so happy.
translations.ねえ、どのくらい私に会いたいと思ってくれた？:
Hey, how much did you 
want to see me？
translations.あなたのいない時間は……心細いよ。:
When you're not around... 
I feel so lonely.
translations.もっとたくさん会える方法ってないかな？:
Isn't there some way 
we could see each other 
even more？
translations.ふふ……これからのご予定は？:
Hehe... so what are your 
plans from here on？
translations.これから何をする予定なのかな？:
What are you planning 
to do now？
translations.こんなに待たせて、悪いコね。:
Making me wait this long... 
you're such a bad boy.
translations.そろそろ来るんじゃないかなって思って、準備してたの。:
I thought you'd come soon, 
so I got all ready.
translations.私に会えて嬉しいって言ったら、いい子いい子してあげよっかな。:
If you say you're happy 
to see me, maybe I'll pat 
your head like a good boy.
translations.よしよし、私に会いたかったの？ 私もあなたに会いたかったよ。:
There, there. Did you miss me？ 
I wanted to see you, too.
translations.少し待ちくたびれたから、そのぶん甘えちゃおうかな？:
I got a little tired of 
waiting, so maybe I'll act 
a little spoiled to make up for it？
translations.待ってるあいだ、ずーっとあなたのこと考えちゃってた。:
While I was waiting, I couldn't 
stop thinking about you.
translations.ハッピーニューイヤー！ 今日からまた、ふたりの１年が始まるね♪:
Happy New Year!
Another year together
starts today♪
translations.初夢ってすぐ忘れちゃうから、今年はメモしておいたの。見ちゃダメだよ？:
I always forget my first dream,
so I wrote this year's down.
No peeking, okay？
translations.あなたの初夢に私が出てきたら……責任もって幸せにしてあげるからね。:
If I'm in your first dream...
I'll take full responsibility
and make you happy.
translations.初夢に出てくると縁起がいいものって、あなた以外になにがあるかな？ ふふ。:
Besides you, what else is
lucky to see in a first dream,
I wonder？ Hehe.
translations.今日はなんの日かわかってるよね？ 私もワクワクしてるの。:
You know what day today is,
don't you？
I'm so excited, too.
translations.２月１４日といえば？ ふふ……期待してるでしょ？:
What comes to mind on
February 14th？
Hehe... you're hoping for
something, aren't you？
translations.ハッピーバレンタイン！ たっぷり甘えさせてあげようか？:
Happy Valentine's!
Should I spoil you
rotten today？
translations.今日は３月１４日……。あっ、催促してるわけじゃないの。:
Today's March 14th...
Ah, not that I'm trying to
drop hints or anything!
translations.ホワイトデーのプレゼントは……私の命令になんでも従うこと、なんてどう？:
For my White Day gift...
how about you do whatever
I tell you to？
translations.今日はホワイトデー！ カレシに期待しちゃおうかなぁ？:
Today is White Day!
Maybe I'll expect something
from my boyfriend？
translations.私がウットリしちゃうようなウソ、ついてみて？:
Why don't you tell me a lie
that'll make me swoon？
translations.エイプリルフールだし……上手にだまされてあげようかな？:
It's April Fools', so...
maybe I'll let you fool me？
translations.私、実は留年してて……。なんて、今日はエイプリルフールだよ。:
To tell the truth,
I got held back a year...
Just kidding! April Fools!
translations.みんなで遠足って、いくつになってもワクワクしちゃうな。:
A field trip with everyone
is always so exciting,
no matter how old you get.
translations.合唱コンクール、上手く歌えるかな？:
I wonder if I'll sing well
at the choir contest？
translations.七夕だね。もし、私と年に１度しか会えなかったら……どうする？:
It's Tanabata.
If you could only see me
once a year... what would you do？
translations.十羽野祭りだね。私が浴衣着たら、嬉しい？:
It's the Towano Festival.
Would it make you happy
if I wore a yukata？
translations.今日は体育祭だよ。精一杯頑張ってみようかな？:
Today's Sports Day.
Maybe I'll give it
everything I've got？
translations.トリック・オア・トリート！ ここにも悪戯っ子がいるみたいね？ ふふ。:
Trick or treat!
Looks like there's a little
troublemaker right here, too？
Hehe.
translations.今日の文化祭、面白いイベントもあるみたいだよ？:
Looks like there'll be some
fun events at the school
festival today, you know？
translations.今日はクリスマスイヴだよ。ふたりで一緒にいたいね……。:
Today is Christmas Eve.
I really want us to be
together, just the two of us...
translations.今日の予定考えてる？ イヴだもん、もちろん私と過ごすよね？:
Have you thought about plans
for today？ It's Eve, so of
course you're with me, right？
translations.きっと楽しいよ、私と過ごすイヴ。ほら、想像してみて？:
It'll definitely be fun,
spending Eve with me.
Go on, picture it？
translations.１年って早いね。あなたと一緒だから早く感じるのかな？:
A year goes by so fast.
Is it because I'm with you
that it feels that way？
translations.試験の結果、どうだろ？ ああ、緊張しちゃうなぁ。:
How did the exams go？
Aaah, I'm so nervous...
translations.もうすぐ私の誕生日……プレゼントはあなたがいいな……ふふ、意味がわからないね。:
My birthday's coming up soon...
For my present, I want you...
Hehe, that doesn't make
much sense, does it？
translations.もうすぐ誕生日でしょ？ 楽しみだなぁ。早く大人になってね。:
Your birthday's coming up soon,
right？ I'm so excited.
Hurry up and grow up, okay？
translations.もうすぐ、私たちの関係が恋人になった記念日だよ？ ……今、幸せ？:
It's almost the anniversary
of when we became a couple.
...Are you happy right now？
translations.バレンタインが近づいてきたね。かわいいチョコが多くて目移りしちゃう。:
Valentine's is getting close.
There are so many cute
chocolates, I can't decide!
translations.んーっ、もうすぐホワイトデーか。春も近いね♪:
Mmh, White Day is almost here.
Spring's right around
the corner, too♪
translations.もうすぐエイプリルフールだよ？ どんなウソをついてほしい？:
It's almost April Fools',
you know？ What kind of lie
do you want me to tell？
translations.遠足の日が近づいてきたね。楽しみで、前日眠れなかったりして？:
The field trip is coming up.
Will you be too excited to
sleep the night before？
translations.もうすぐ合唱コンクールでしょ？ どんな歌を歌うのかな……。:
The choir contest is almost
here, right？ I wonder what
song we'll sing...
translations.もうすぐ七夕だから、あなたのお部屋に飾りつけしようか？:
Tanabata is coming up soon,
so should we put some
decorations in your room？
translations.近々十羽野祭りがあるでしょ？ あなたとお祭りデートしたいなぁ。:
The Towano Festival is
coming up soon, right？
I'd love to go on a festival
date with you.
translations.そろそろ体育祭だね。あなたの活躍、期待してるから♪:
Sports Day is almost here.
I'm expecting big things
from you♪
translations.ハロウィンが近いけど、仮装する？ 私は……ん？ してほしいのかな？:
Halloween is coming up,
are you dressing up？
As for me... Hm？ Do you
want to see me in costume？
translations.いよいよ文化祭が近づいてきたね。準備、頑張ろ。:
The school festival is
finally getting close.
Let's do our best preparing!
translations.恋人たちの一大イベント、クリスマスが近づいてきたね……ふふ♪:
That big event for couples,
Christmas, is getting closer...
Hehe♪
translations.今年もあとちょっとだね。ふたりでカウントダウンなんて、ステキだな。:
Not much left of this year.
Doing a countdown together
sounds wonderful, doesn't it？
translations.もうすぐ試験だね……はあ、がんばろっと。:
Exams are coming up soon...
*Sigh*, better do my best.
translations.ねえ？ 明日、楽しみにしててね。:
Hey？ Make sure you look
forward to tomorrow, okay？
translations.明日はたしか……。ううん、なんでもないよ。:
Tomorrow is... wait,
never mind. It's nothing.
translations.明日はなんの日でしょうか？ ふふ。:
Guess what day tomorrow is？
Fufu.
translations.今日のデート、準備はＯＫ？ 遅刻厳禁だよ。:
Ready for our date today？
No being late, okay？
translations.ほら、デートの時間だよ！ 早く早く♪:
Come on, it's date time!
Hurry, hurry♪
translations.明日のデート、楽しみだなぁ。ふふ。:
I'm so looking forward
to our date tomorrow. Fufu.
translations.今、一番食べたい料理ってなに？ リクエストがあれば聞いちゃおうかな？:
What do you feel like eating
most right now？
I might even take requests？
translations.この街もどんどん変わっていくね。変化って、楽しさも寂しさも両方感じちゃうね。:
This town changes so fast.
Change brings excitement,
but it feels a little
lonely, too, doesn't it？
translations.そういえば、新しいお店ができたんだって。ふたりで行ってみない？:
I heard a new shop opened.
Want to go check it out
together？
translations.今人気のスポットってどこかわかる？ 一緒に調べてみよっか。:
Do you know any hot spots
right now？
Let's check together.
translations.最近メールくれてないの気づいてるよ？ 寂しいな……。:
I've noticed you haven't
texted me lately...
It's pretty lonely...
translations.どうして最近メールしてくれないのかな？ なにか拗ねてるの？:
Why haven't you texted me
lately？ Are you pouting
about something？
translations.ねえ、私にメールするのイヤ？ 最近全然送ってくれないから。:
Hey, do you not like
texting me？ You haven't sent
a thing lately.
translations.近ごろ私たち全然会ってないよね。恋人同士なのに、ヘンじゃない……？:
We haven't seen each other
at all lately. Aren't we
dating... isn't this weird...？
translations.最近全然会ってないのに、あなたは平気なの？:
We haven't seen each other
lately, but you don't even
seem to mind？
translations.こんなに会う回数が少ないの……私はイヤだなぁ……。:
Seeing each other this
rarely... I really hate it...
translations.最近キスが減ったのは……私のせいなのかな……？:
We haven't been kissing
much lately... Is it
my fault, I wonder...？
translations.どうしてキスしないの？ 私たち、恋人同士だよね？:
Why won't you kiss me？
We're dating, aren't we？
translations.私とキスするの、嫌い？ 私はあなたのキスが……。:
Do you not like kissing me？
Because I... your kisses...
translations.具合悪いの？ 心配……無理はしちゃダメよ。:
Are you not feeling well？
I'm worried... Don't push
yourself, okay？
translations.最近、勉強も順調みたいね。感心、感心。:
Looks like your studies are
going well lately.
I'm very impressed.
translations.知識欲満タンって感じかな？ カノジョについてのお勉強も忘れないでね♪:
Full of curiosity, huh？
Don't forget to study up
on your girlfriend, too♪
translations.トレーニング頑張ってるの？ 少し男らしくなったみたい。:
Working hard on workouts？
You seem a little more
manly lately.
translations.なんだか体の調子がいいみたいだね？ 体力がある男のコって、魅力的かも。:
You look like you're in
great shape. A guy with
good stamina is pretty
attractive.
translations.センスが良くなってるね。友達にカレシ自慢しちゃおうかな？:
Your taste has improved!
Maybe I'll brag about my
boyfriend to my friends？
translations.なんだろう、感性が研ぎ澄まされてる感じ？ いいと思うな。:
How should I put it... you
seem really perceptive？
I like it.
translations.魅力的になるのはいいけど……目移りしないでね。:
It's great you're getting
so charming, but...
don't go looking at other
girls, okay？
translations.どんどんカッコよくなっちゃって。ふふっ……大好き♪:
You just keep getting
cooler and cooler. Hehe...
I love you so much♪
translations.ふふ。まだ２月なんだから、いいでしょ？:
Fufu. It's still February,
so that counts, right？
translations.私たちに会えるの、ちゃーんと楽しみにしてくれてた？:
Were you really, truly
looking forward to
seeing us？
translations.ねえ、今日は服を買いたいんだけど。いいかな？:
Hey, I'd love to go clothes
shopping today. Is that okay？
translations.今日は服を選びたいの。付き合って？:
I want to pick out some clothes today.
Will you come with me？
translations.今日はね、服を買いに行きたいの。いい？:
You know, I want to go clothes
shopping today. Okay？
translations.他のことしない？: How about we do something else？
translations.やった。じゃあ、行こ？: Yay! Well then, shall we go？
translations.そう？ じゃあどこに行こっか？: Really？ Where should we go, then？
translations.アクセサリーショップに行こう: Let's go to an accessories shop.
translations.コスメショップに行こう: Let's go to a cosmetics shop.
translations.私にどんな服が似合うか見立ててくれる？:
Could you help pick out what looks
good on me？
translations.じゃーん。さあ、どう？: Ta-da! Well, what do you think？
translations.これなんか、割といいんじゃない？: This one's pretty nice, don't you think？
translations.あなたがいいなら、こういうのでも……。:
If you like it, maybe something
like this could work...？
translations.色々試してみないとね。: Gotta try out all kinds of styles, right？
translations.まあ、こんなのもアリ……かな？:
Well, I guess this kind of thing
works too... maybe？
translations.最初の服が似合う: The first one suited you best.
translations.ありがとう。やっぱりあなたに付き合ってもらって正解。:
Thanks. Having you come along
was definitely the right call.
translations.じゃあ思いきってこれにするね。自分じゃなかなか踏ん切りつかないから、一緒に選べて:
I'll take the plunge and get this one, then.
I can never make up my mind on my own,
so I'm glad we picked it out together.
translations.そうだ……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にあげようって用意したプレゼント、どうしようかな。:
Oh, right... What should I do
with the gift I brought
for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.はい、これ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にって思って、買ってみたんだ。:
Here you go.
I picked this up
thinking of you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.プレゼント？ なんだろう♪ 開けてもいい？:
A present？ I wonder what it is♪
Can I open it？
translations.ああっ、これってすごくいいものでしょ？ 香りが違うもの。ありがとう▼:
Ah, this is really high quality,
isn't it？ The aroma is so
different! Thank you, ▼
translations.あ、よさそう。これだといろんなお料理に使えるかも。:
Oh, this looks great!
I can probably use it
in all sorts of dishes.
translations.そのいろんな料理を期待してるよ。:
I'll be looking forward
to all those dishes!
translations.これ……独特な感じだね。上手く使えるかわからないけど、ありがとう。:
This is... pretty unique.
I'm not sure if I can cook
with it well, but thanks!
translations.じゃあ、今度はこれを使ったお料理をご馳走しなくちゃね？:
Then next time, I'll just have
to treat you to a meal
using this, won't I？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲なら美味しいの作ってくれそうだな。:
I bet you'll make something
really delicious, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.これさ、この間見つけた本なんだ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にあげるよ。:
Hey, I found this book
the other day. It's for you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.わぁ！ この本ね、欲しいなと思ってたの。ありがとう♪:
Wow! I was actually hoping
to get this book!
Thank you♪
translations.嬉しいなぁ。これがあればもっと色んなお料理が作れるようになるね。:
I'm so happy! With this,
I'll be able to cook
all kinds of dishes now.
translations.期待して待ってるよ。: I'll be looking forward to it!
translations.もしかして……私がこのジャンル苦手なの気づいてた？ これ見てしっかり勉強しなくち:
Could it be... you noticed
I'm not good at this kind
of cooking？ I'll study up
with this. Thank you!
translations.そうだったのか……役に立てたってことかな。:
Is that so... Glad I could
be of help, then.
translations.こんなのプレゼントしてもらっちゃったら、ご馳走しないわけにはいかないね？ ふふ▼:
After getting a gift like this,
I'll just have to cook
something for you, won't I？
Hehe▼
translations.それは楽しみだな、よろしく！:
I'll look forward to that!
Much appreciated!
translations.突然だけどさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にプレゼントしたいものがあるんだ。:
Out of the blue, but... there's
something I wanted to give
you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.はい。これ、きっと似合うと思うよ。:
Yeah, here. I think
it'll really suit you.
translations.ほんとにもらっていいの？ なんだか悪いなぁ……。:
Can I really have this？
I kind of feel bad...
translations.いいんだって。それより、開けてみてよ。:
Don't feel bad!
Come on, open it up.
translations.わぁ！ これ素敵♪ 私のために選んでくれたんだね、ありがとう。:
Wow! This is wonderful♪
You picked it out just for me,
didn't you？ Thank you!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にピッタリだと思ったんだ。:
I thought it'd be
perfect for you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あ、私こういうの好きよ。ありがとう。:
Oh, I love things like this.
Thank you!
translations.これが……私のイメージなんだ？\nありがとう……。:
So this is...
how you see me？
Thank you...
translations.私のこと考えてくれてたのが一番嬉しいな。いい子いい子▼:
Just knowing you were thinking
of me makes me the happiest.
Good boy, good boy▼
translations.じつは▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にもらってほしいものがあるんだ。:
Actually, there's something
I'd like to give you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あっ、なんだろう？ ドキドキするじゃない。:
Oh, what could it be？
You're making my heart flutter!
translations.これ、この間ひとりで出かけたときに見つけたんだ。部屋にでも飾ってよ。:
I found this while I was out
by myself the other day.
You could put it in your room.
translations.ほんとにいいの？ あまり気を遣わないでね。:
Are you sure？ You really don't
have to go out of your way.
translations.気を遣ったんじゃないって。それよりさ、早く開けてみて。:
I didn't go out of my way!
Come on, hurry and open it.
translations.あのさ。これ、前に見つけて買ってきたんだけど……。:
Um, so... I found this a while
ago and bought it, but...
translations.日記帳。前に付けてるって言ってたからさ。:
A diary.
You mentioned before
that you keep one.
translations.あ、うれしい。ありがとう。:
Aw, I'm so happy.
Thank you.
translations.詳しくはよくわからないけど、なんだか特別な物らしいよ。:
I don't know the details,
but it's supposed to be
something special.
translations.特別……そうね、なんだろう、不思議な雰囲気……。:
Special... Yeah.
There's definitely a
mysterious feel to it...
translations.というわけで、悩んでるんだけどさ、図書委員推薦図書。どうするかなぁ……。:
So that's why I'm stuck on
the library committee's
recommendation. Hmm...
translations.“あぁ、高校時代にあの本を読んだなぁ”って、みんなの思い出になるような本を選べば:
You just need a book that
everyone will look back on
and remember reading
in high school, right？
translations.まあね。でも、好き嫌いもあるし、そう簡単にみんなの思い出になる本なんて――:
Well, yeah. But everyone has
different tastes, so finding
a book like that isn't—
translations.はい、はぁい！ わたしにいいアイディアがあります！:
Ooh, me, me!
I have a great idea!
translations.あ、あった！ ほら、これこれ！:
Ah, here it is!
Look, this one, this one!
translations.えぇと……魍魎の匣（もうりょうのはこ）、京極夏彦（きょうごくなつひこ）か……。:
Uh... Mouryou no Hako,
by Natsuhiko Kyogoku, huh...
translations.うん、面白そうだね。でもさ……すごく分厚いよ、これ？:
Yeah, looks cool. But...
it's super thick, isn't it？
translations.そうなの！ だから、最後まで読んだら、ゼッタイ忘れないと思う。あぁ、高校時代に読:
I know! That's why if you
finish it, you'll never
forget. Like, 'Ah, I read
that in high school!'
translations.ちょっと意味が違うような気も……。その前に、ありなのか？ これ、ミステリーだよね:
I feel like that's missing
the point a bit...
Can we even pick this？
It's a mystery, right？
translations.“じゃないの”って……読んだことあるんじゃないの？:
Wait, 'isn't it'...?
Haven't you read it？
translations.すごく怖そうだし、分厚くて読みごたえもありそうだなって、買ったんだけど。:
I bought it thinking it
looked super spooky and had
plenty of meat to it, but...
translations.一度本棚に入れちゃうと、なんか満足しちゃって。そのまま、なんとなぁく、ね？:
Once I put it on the shelf,
I felt satisfied. And then
it just sat there, y'know？
translations.ね、これにしよ？ ふたりで一緒に読めば、きっと頑張れると思う。いいでしょ？:
Come on, let's do this one!
If we read it together,
I know we can power through.
What do you say？
translations.一緒に、か……。うん、いいなっ！ それじゃあ頑張って読んでみよう！:
Together, huh... Yeah, okay!
Let's tackle it together!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は……あ、いた。:
Where's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Ah, there she is.
translations.これからさ、読みに行かない？ 魍魎の匣。:
Wanna go read Mouryou no Hako
together now？
translations.わたしも、一緒に読もうと思って、持ってきてたの、今日。:
I brought my copy today too,
hoping we could read it
together!
translations.もし誘ってみて、あなたが持って来て無かったらどうしようかと思って。重いの頑張って:
I was worried you wouldn't
have yours if I asked... After
I lugged this heavy thing here!
translations.良かった。かさばるしね……。よし、行こう！:
Glad I did! It's so bulky...
All right, let's go!
translations.これからさ、本読みに行かない？: Wanna go read that book now？
translations.ふふっ、いいよ？ 行こう。つづき、気になるもんね！:
Hehe, sure! Let's go.
I really want to see what
happens next anyway!
translations.だって、いつぶり？ 急に言われても持って無いよ。重いんだもん……図書室で借りられ:
Well, how long has it been？
I don't have it on me out of
the blue. It's so heavy...
Can I borrow it in the library？
translations.（ちょっとサボり過ぎたか……）:
(Did we slack off
a little too much...？)
translations.そうだ、魍魎の匣、読まなきゃ！:
Oh, right, I've gotta read
Mouryou no Hako!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲いるかな？ 電話してみるか……。:
Wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s around？
Guess I'll give her a call...
translations.これからさ、一緒に読まない？ 例の、魍魎の匣。:
Wanna read together now？
You know, Mouryou no Hako.
translations.今から？ えぇと……うん、いいかも。おいでよ、家に。:
Right now？ Um... yeah, why not.
Come over to my place!
translations.いいの？ それじゃ、すぐ行くね？:
Really？ All right, I'll be
right over, okay？
translations.じゃあ、お菓子用意して待ってる。あとでね？:
I'll get some snacks ready
and wait for you. See ya soon？
translations.そうだ、魍魎の匣のつづきでも、読むかな！:
Right, maybe I'll keep
reading Mouryou no Hako!
translations.時間あったらさ、魍魎の匣のつづき、一緒に読まない？:
If you've got some time,
wanna keep reading Mouryou
no Hako together？
translations.ふふっ、わたしも今、電話するところだったの。つづき、気になるもんね！:
Hehe, I was just about to
call you! I'm dying to know
what happens next, too！
translations.だよな！ これから、そっち行っていい？:
Right？ Mind if I head over
to your place now？
translations.いけねっ！ 魍魎の匣のつづき、そろそろ読まなきゃな……。:
Shoot! I should probably
get back to reading Mouryou
no Hako soon...
translations.これからさ、本のつづき、読まない？:
Wanna keep reading that
book together now？
translations.魍魎の匣……忘れてた？:
Mouryou no Hako...
Did you forget about it？
translations.だって、いつぶりだっけ？ まだ間に合うかな……。:
Well, how long has it been？
Can we still finish in time...？
translations.頑張れば、きっと……。: If we really try, I'm sure...
translations.よし。じゃあ、頑張ってみよっか？ 急いで家においで？:
Alright. Let's give it our all,
then？ Hurry on over to my place,
okay？
translations.ねぇねぇ、ちょっと考えたんだけど、いい？:
Hey, I had an idea,
can I tell you？
translations.せっかくだから、この本を読むときはいつもこうして一緒に読むことにしない？:
Since we're doing this, why don't
we always read this book
together like this？
translations.そうすれば、読んだところまでの話とか、その先の予想とかも出来るし、それに、ほら…:
That way we can talk about what
we've read, predict what happens
next, and, you know...
translations.途中で投げ出しそうになっても、支え合えるでしょ？ この本すごく厚いじゃない？ …:
Even if one of us wants to quit
halfway, we can support each other,
right？ It's super thick... right？
translations.でしょ、決まり！ じゃあ、用意、スタート！:
See？ Settled!
Alright, ready, set, go!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はどこまで読んだ？: How far did you get, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.「ほう、」のとこが終わって、本編が始まったところ。:
Right after that 'Oh,' part
ends and the main story begins.
translations.加奈子と頼子が湖に行こうって……。それで……木場刑事に取り調べ受けてるところ。:
Where Kanako and Yoriko were
gonna go to the lake... and then...
Detective Kiba was questioning her.
translations.なんかね、こういう女の子同士の憧れってあるのよ……。うん、わかる。:
You know, girls really do have
that kind of yearning for each other...
Yeah, I get it.
translations.木場刑事が色いろ思い出して、それで、病院に着いたとこ。:
Where Detective Kiba remembers
a bunch of things, and then arrives
at the hospital.
translations.もう、犯人って登場してたりするのかな……。:
I wonder if the culprit has
already shown up...
translations.絹子とか増岡とか、あと誰だっけ……あ、雨宮とか。大勢出てきて、病院を変えようって:
Kinuko, Masuoka, and who else...
Oh, Amamiya. A bunch of people show
up to move her to another hospital.
translations.それで、またあの気持ち悪い箱の人の話になった。いやぁ、この人……。:
Then it goes back to that creepy
box guy again. Ugh, this guy...
translations.作家の関口と「奇憚月報」の中禅寺敦子と、あと、「実録犯罪」の鳥口が出てきて、クル:
Sekiguchi the writer, Atsuko
Chuzenji from Kitan Geppo, and
Toriguchi from Jitsuroku Hanzai
all head to Lake Sagami by car.
translations.あ、久保っていう嫌味な作家の人もいた。これ以上登場人物が出てきたら、わたし憶えら:
Oh, and that nasty writer Kubo, too.
If any more characters show up,
I don't think I can remember them...
translations.ぐるぐる回って、けっきょく相模湖じゃなくて、大きな箱のビルに着いたところ……。:
They drove around and wound up
not at Lake Sagami, but at this
giant box of a building...
translations.それでまた、あの気持ち悪い箱の人の語り……。もう、やだこの人……。:
And then more monologue from
that creepy box guy... Ugh, I really
can't stand him...
translations.御筥様がお祓いに来て、それで……頼子が「犯人を見た」って言いだして……。美馬坂近:
Onbako-sama comes for an exorcism,
then Yoriko says she 'saw the culprit'...
and goes to Mimasaka Modern Medicine
Institute to see Kanako.
translations.うん……。風雲急を告げますな。嫌な予感……。:
Yeah... 'The plot thickens,'
as they say. I've got a bad feeling...
translations.加奈子が消えたとこ。頼子が会った後すぐ……。うん、ミステリーっぽくなってきた。:
Right where Kanako disappears.
Right after Yoriko sees her...
Yep, feels like a real mystery now.
translations.で、またあの箱の人の話。「きれいに外れた」って……。もう嫌、この人！:
And then the box guy again.
'It came off so cleanly'...
Ugh, I can't stand him!
translations.関口君と鳥口君が、京極堂に来たとこ。霊能者と予言者の話して……「秘密の解明」、か:
Where Sekiguchi and Toriguchi
go to Kyogokudo. They talk about
psychics and prophets...
'Unraveling the mystery', huh.
translations.京極堂って、お店の名前だったんだね、なるほど……。:
Turns out Kyogokudo was the name
of the shop. Makes sense...
translations.まだ、ずっと京極堂で三人で話してる……。:
They're still just talking,
all three of them, at Kyogokudo...
translations.鳥口君って、けっこうスゴイ人なのかも。それに引き換え関口君は……。:
Toriguchi-kun might actually
be pretty amazing.
Though Sekiguchi-kun,
on the other hand...
translations.まだまだ、三人で京極堂。鳥口君の話で京極堂さんが御筥様のインチキを当てちゃうとこ:
Still the three of them
at Kyogokudo. Kyogokudo-san
exposes Onbako-sama's scam
from Toriguchi-kun's story.
translations.すごいよね……。あ、また箱の人……っていうか、久保竣公の「匣の中の娘」が出てきた:
He's incredible, isn't he...？
Oh, the box guy again...
or rather, Shunko Kubo's
"Girl in the Box" came up.
translations.わかっちゃった。もうゼッタイ犯人は――あ、ゴメン。:
I figured it out!
The killer is definitely—
Ah, sorry!
translations.なんだか急に展開が速くなって来たとこ……雨宮が消えちゃって、須崎が死んじゃって、:
Things are moving so fast
all of a sudden... Amamiya
vanished, Suzaki died,
and a blackmail letter came...
translations.でも、犯人もうわかっちゃったからな……。:
Though I already know
who the culprit is...
translations.木場刑事が捜査してるとこ。里村って監察医が出てきて……人体実験か……ホラーっぽく:
Detective Kiba's investigating.
A coroner named Satomura
showed up... Human experiments？
It's getting kind of horror-ish.
translations.でも、こけしみたいな青木君ってちょっとカワイイよね？:
Though Aoki-kun looks like
a kokeshi doll, which is
kinda cute, don't you think？
translations.榎木津っていう人が出てきた。変な人……それで柴田財閥と柚木陽子のことがわかったと:
This guy named Enokizu
showed up. Such an oddball...
And now we learned about the
Shibata zaibatsu and Yoko.
translations.榎木津さんの幻視って超能力ってこと？ 千里眼みたいな？ ふぅん……。:
So Enokizu-san's visions are
like psychic powers？
Clairvoyance, maybe？ Hmm...
translations.また京極堂に集まったとこ。鳥口が調べてきた御筥様の報告して、関口君と榎木津さんが:
Everyone's back at Kyogokudo.
Toriguchi reports on
Onbako-sama, and Sekiguchi-kun
and Enokizu go to Yoriko's...
translations.よりによってこの二人か。これは危険かもよ……。:
Of all people, those two？
This might be dangerous...
translations.凸凹コンビが頼子のお母さんの自殺を止めたとこ。おかしかった。:
The oddball duo stopped
Yoriko's mom from suicide.
That was hilarious.
translations.でも、「おわび状」の告白が本当なら……うぅん、本格的に分かんなくなっちゃった。:
But if the confession in
that apology letter is true...
Hmm, now I'm completely lost.
translations.木場さんが陽子のところに行ってちょっといい感じになって……。そうそう、手袋の怪人:
Kiba-san went to see Yoko
and things got a little sweet...
Oh right, and lots of rumors
about the gloved monster.
translations.頼子ちゃんの噂をクラスメートがするところ、なんか妙にリアルで、可哀想になっちゃっ:
Her classmates gossiping
about Yoriko-chan felt so
real, I felt awful for her...
translations.みんな集まって、京極堂さんが御筥様と久保の関係を推理してバラバラ殺人の犯人の名前:
Everyone gathered, and
Kyogokudo-san deduced the
link to Kubo and named the
dismemberment killer.
translations.でも、そんなのもうとっくに分かってたしなぁ。う～ん……。:
Though I already figured
that out ages ago. Hmmm...
translations.京極堂さんが頼子ちゃんが加奈子ちゃんを襲った時の推理をしてて、それで、またバラバ:
Kyogokudo-san is deducing
when Yoriko attacked Kanako,
and then, another severed arm...
translations.この腕ってもしかして、もしかしなくても……。あ～あ、こうなると思ってたのに……。:
Could this arm be... wait,
no, it definitely is...
Aww, I knew this was coming,
but still...
translations.とうとう御筥様と京極堂が対決したところ。榎木津さん、けっこう役に立ってるね♪:
Onbako-sama and Kyogokudo
finally faced off. Enokizu-san
is actually super helpful♪
translations.そうそう、「匣の中の娘」の後篇が出てきた。これ、日記だって知っちゃうと、もう、怖:
Oh yeah, the second part of
"Girl in the Box" came up.
Knowing it's a diary makes it
way too creepy...
translations.久保と御筥様が親子だってわかって、それで青木君が箱の家に乗りこんで……。:
We found out Kubo and
Onbako-sama are parent and
child, and then Aoki-kun
stormed into the box house...
translations.“みっしり”って。ハァ……今晩夢見ちゃうかも……。:
"Crammed in tight"... *sigh*
I might have nightmares
about that tonight...
translations.久保もバラバラになっちゃって、京極堂さんがみんなと箱のビルに乗りこんで……。:
Kubo ended up chopped up too,
and Kyogokudo-san raided the
box building with everyone...
translations.本当に分かんなくなって来た。陽子が博士の娘だったのがわかったって、結局、犯人は久:
Now I'm really lost. Even if
Yoko's the doctor's daughter,
Kubo's still the killer in the
end, right？ Hmm...？
translations.加奈子の父親は、本当は別にいるってわかって、ビルが大きな人工の身体で、ってとこ。:
Kanako's real father is
someone else, and the building
is a giant artificial body...
translations.そっかそっか……。あれ、じゃあ加奈子の父親って？ う～ん？:
I see, I see... Wait, then
who is Kanako's father？
Hmm...？
translations.加奈子が消えたトリックと、雨宮さんが須崎を殺したって推理があって、加奈子は父の子:
The trick to Kanako vanishing,
Amamiya killing Suzaki, and
Yoko saying, "Kanako is my
father's child"...
translations.つまり加奈子は本当に陽子の妹だったんだ。なんだかすごく、フクザツ……。:
So Kanako really was Yoko's
sister. Wow, this is so
complicated...
translations.久保を持って博士と陽子が――待って、もう後少し……クライマックスのところ……。:
With the doctor and Yoko
holding Kubo— Wait, just a bit
more... It's the climax...!
translations.わたし？ わたしはもう読み終わったよ？ 今は誰かさんが読み終わるのを待ってるとこ:
Me？ I already finished, silly.
Right now, I'm just waiting
on a certain someone.
translations.あ～あ、先を越されたか……。: Aw man, she beat me to it...
translations.どんなもんだ、エヘンっ！ ほら、早く早く！ ラストのとこ、教えちゃうよ？:
How's that, *ahem*!
Come on, hurry, hurry!
Or I'll spoil the ending for you~
translations.いま、どのへん？: Where are you at right now？
translations.いまどこ？ もっと進んじゃった？:
Where are you now？
Did you get further ahead？
translations.まだまだ。初めのほうだな……。:
Still a ways to go.
Just near the start...
translations.中盤。折り返し地点かな……。:
In the middle.
Around the halfway point...
translations.もう終盤。いよいよ佳境だな……。:
Toward the end.
Right into the climax...
translations.えぇと……あ、わたしの方がちょっと早いかな？ よし、ゆっくり読もっと……。:
Let's see... Oh, am I a bit
ahead of you？ Alright,
I'll just take my time...
translations.あ、わたしの方がちょっと早い。ふふっ……。:
Oh, I'm a little bit ahead.
Hehe...
translations.ふぅん……読むの、けっこう遅い？:
Hmm... Are you a pretty
slow reader？
translations.そっかそっか。まあ、がんばってくれたまえ。:
I see, I see. Well,
keep at it, young man.
translations.ということは……あ、わたしの方がちょっと早い。よし、がんばろ……。:
Which means... Oh, I'm
a little ahead. Alright,
gotta keep at it...
translations.じゃあ……あ、わたしと同じくらいだ。うん、この調子でがんばろっと……。:
So... Oh, we're at about
the same spot. Yep, gotta keep
going at this pace...
translations.あ、同じくらいのとこ。ふふっ、気が合いますねぇ。:
Oh, about the same spot.
Hehe, look at us, in sync.
translations.ということは……うん、同じくらいね。先、行っちゃダメよ？いい？:
Which means... Yep, about
the same. Don't go running
ahead, okay？ Got it？
translations.じゃあ、わたしと同じくらいのとこね。うむ、よろしい。:
So you're around the same
spot as me. Mm, very good.
translations.じゃあ、だいたい一緒かな。よしよし。ちゃんと、ぺース合わせようね？:
So we're pretty much tied.
There, there. Let's make sure
to keep pace, okay？
translations.あ、わたしも同じくらい。さっすが、ラブラブ▼ふふっ！:
Oh, I'm around the same
spot. Look at us, all
lovey-dovey. ▼Hehe！
translations.えぇ、もう？ そっかぁ……よし、わたしもがんばろ。:
Huh, already？ Oh well...
Okay, I'll do my best too.
translations.（もうちょっと、ゆっくり読むか……）:
(Maybe I should read
a bit slower...)
translations.そっかぁ……集中集中。寧々ちゃん、がんばれ。:
I see... Focus, focus.
You got this, Nene-chan.
translations.あ、わたしより先？ ダメ。ちょっと待って。:
Ah, you're ahead of me？
No fair. Wait up a sec.
translations.もう、早い。先行っちゃダメって言わなかった？:
Jeez, you're so fast.
Didn't I tell you not to
read ahead？
translations.えぇ？ もう……先行っちゃダメだってば。:
Huh？ Geez... I told you
not to read ahead.
translations.なぁに？ ちょっとくらい先行ってるからってさフンだ……。:
What？ Just 'cause you're
a little bit ahead of me...
Hmph.
translations.いま、どこ読んでる？: Where are you at right now？
translations.よし、今日はこの辺にしとくか！:
All right, guess I'll stop
here for today!
translations.えっ、なに？ もうおしまいなの？:
Huh, what？ Are you done
already？
translations.えぇ、そうなの？ う～ん、いいとこだったのに……。:
Aww, really？ Mmm, but it
was just getting good...
translations.ん？ うん……そうしよっか？ わたしも、けっこう読めたし。:
Hmm？ Yeah... let's do that.
I got through plenty, too.
translations.さてと……よし、おしまい。ねぇ、今日はそろそろにしない？:
Well then... okay, all done.
Hey, want to call it a day？
translations.ハァ……読んだ読んだ、疲れちゃった、今日はそろそろにしない？:
Phew... I read so much,
I'm beat. Shall we stop
for today？
translations.ねぇねぇ、今日はどのあたりまで行った？:
Hey, hey, about how far
did you get today？
translations.じゃあ、わたしの方が、先、進んじゃってるかな。:
Guess that means I'm a bit
ahead of you.
translations.遅い。ちゃんと、集中してた？:
Slowpoke. Were you really
staying focused？
translations.ということは……よし、寧々ちゃんのリード。ふふっ！:
Which means... alright,
Nene-chan takes the lead!
Hehe!
translations.うん、同じくらいのとこ。一緒に読んでるんだもん、こうじゃなきゃ、ね？:
Yep, right around the same
spot. Since we're reading
together, it's gotta be
like this, right？
translations.じゃあ、私と同じくらい。よし。ちゃんと集中出来たもんね？ エライエライ、ふふっ！:
Then you're about where I am.
Nice! You stayed focused too,
right？ Good boy, good boy!
Hehe!
translations.あ、わたしも同じくらい。うん、わたし達ってやっぱり、似た者カップルだね？ ふふっ:
Ah, I'm around the same spot.
Yep, we really are two of a kind
as a couple, aren't we？
Hehe.
translations.ハァ……。わたしって、読むの遅いね？ やんなっちゃう。:
Sigh... I'm a slow reader,
aren't I？ It's so frustrating.
translations.あのね？ こういうのは、ペース合わせた方が楽しいの。お子サマなんだもん……。:
Listen, okay？ Reading together
is way more fun when we match
pace. You're such a kid...
translations.負けたか……。でも、早く読めたらエライってわけじゃ、ないよね？ そうそう。:
I lost, huh... But it's not like
reading faster makes you better,
right？ Yeah, exactly.
