translations.やった。魍魎の匣、とうとう読み終わっちゃった……。長かったぁ……。:
Yay! I finally finished
Mouryou no Hako...
Phew, that was long...
translations.魍魎の匣、全部読んじゃった……。やればできるもんだ、うん……。:
I actually finished all of
Mouryou no Hako...
Guess I can do it when
I try, huh...
translations.読み終わっちゃった……。なんだか、マラソンした後みたい。:
I finally finished it...
Whew, I feel like I just ran
a whole marathon.
translations.えぇとね……やっぱり言わない。自分で読んだ方がいいもん、きっと。:
Well, umm... on second thought,
I won't tell you. It's definitely
better if you read it yourself.
translations.ねぇ、なんか……難しいよね？ 言葉遣いとか、字とか……。わたし、最後まで読む自信:
Hey, isn't it... kind of tough？
The wording, the kanji...
I'm not sure I can make it
all the way to the end...
translations.あぁ、怖かったぁ……。でも、ここからどうなるのか、すっごく楽しみね？:
Aah, that was so scary...
But I'm really looking forward to
seeing what happens next,
aren't you？
translations.京極堂ってアタマ良すぎて、ときどき付いていけないよね……。えっ、わたしだけ？:
Kyogokudo is way too smart,
I can barely keep up with him
sometimes... Wait, is it just me？
translations.ねぇねぇ、わたし、犯人わかったかも。ふふっ……教えないよ？:
Hey, hey, I think I figured out
who the culprit is!
Hehe... but I'm not telling？
translations.いよいよクライマックスかぁ……。当たり前だけど、ハッピーエンドはもうないよね。悲:
It's finally the climax, huh...
I know it's obvious, but there's
no way this gets a happy ending.
Too many people have suffered...
translations.初めの方は、なんだか古文の教科書みたいで、うわぁ、失敗したぁ！ って思ったけど―:
At first it felt like a classical
Japanese textbook, and I thought,
'Ugh, huge mistake!' but—
translations.その後、急に幻想的な感じになったでしょ？:
—it got so fantastical out of
nowhere after that, didn't it？
translations.わたし、想像してたのとずいぶん違って、びっくりした。:
It was so different from what I
imagined, it really took me
by surprise.
translations.一種のレトリック\nなんだろうね？:
Some kind of rhetorical
device, I guess？
translations.さすが京極夏彦だよね？:
That's Kyogoku Natsuhiko
for you, right？
translations.あえて冒頭で多様な筆致を見せることで、読者を眩惑するという、一種のレトリックなん:
It's probably a rhetorical device,
deliberately using various writing
styles at the start to dazzle
the reader, right？
translations.ふぅん……。よくわかんないけど。なんだか難しそうね。ハァ……。:
Hmm... I don't really get it.
Sounds pretty complicated.
Sigh...
translations.そうだったでしょ？ もう……ちゃんと読んでた？:
It totally was! Geez...
were you actually reading？
translations.冒頭のところだけで、グッと引きつけられちゃう。さすが京極夏彦だよね？:
Just the opening alone completely
draws you in. That's Kyogoku
Natsuhiko for you, right？
translations.そう、そうなの！ 手ごわいぞこれは……。ふふっ、楽しみね？:
Yes, exactly! This is going to be
a tough one... Hehe, exciting,
isn't it？
translations.旧仮名遣いとかわからない言葉がたくさん出てくるだけでも大変なのに……。:
Even just dealing with all the old
kana and unfamiliar words is hard
enough, but...
translations.人がたくさん出てくるでしょ？ 名前、覚えられる？ 例えば、ほら、なんだっけ、こけ:
There are so many people in it,
right？ Can you remember all their
names？ Like, um, what's his name—
the guy with the kokeshi doll face.
translations.じゃなくて！ えぇと……あ、そうだ青木！ なんか、気になるのよ。:
Not him! Umm... oh, right, Aoki!
I don't know, he just sticks
in my mind.
translations.そうそう！ さすが、よく覚えられるね。集中力かなぁ、やっぱり。:
Yes, him! Impressive, you remember
names so well. I guess it's that
focus of yours after all.
translations.それは、あの嫌味な作家。そこ間違うかな、もう！:
That's that obnoxious writer.
How'd you mix those two up,
geez!
translations.ねぇねぇ、トリックわかった？:
Hey, hey, did you figure out
the trick yet？
translations.ほら、加奈子が消えちゃったじゃない？ 衆人環視の中、忽然と。:
You know how Kanako vanished？
Right in front of everyone,
out of thin air.
translations.あぁ、あそこか。それはきっと……。:
Oh, that part. That's
definitely gotta be...
translations.加奈子なんて最初から\nいなかったんだよ:
Kanako was never there
in the first place.
translations.箱だよ。ヒントは、箱……:
The box. The clue is
the box...
translations.そういう▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は\nわかったの？:
Did you figure it out,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.加奈子なんて最初からいなかったんだよ。:
Kanako was never there
in the first place.
translations.だって、ちゃんと見たよ？ 木場も頼子も。あ、もしかして……当てずっぽ言ってるでし:
But they both saw her, didn't
they？ Kiba and Yoriko.
Wait... you're just guessing,
aren't you？
translations.箱だよ。ヒントは、箱……。:
The box. The clue is
the box...
translations.箱が、なぁに？ もう！ 思わせぶりに言ってるだけで、本当は分からないんでしょ？:
The box, what about it？ Geez!
You're just trying to sound
mysterious, aren't you？
You don't actually know!
translations.そういう▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はわかったの？:
Did you figure it out,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うん、多分ね。でもそれが当たってたらかなり嫌かも……。:
Yeah, probably. But if
I'm right, it's gonna be
pretty awful...
translations.やっと登場したね。京極堂こと中禅寺秋彦さん。:
He finally made his entrance.
Akihiko Chuzenji, aka
Kyogokudo.
translations.うん、もう出て来ないんじゃないかと思った。:
Yeah, I was starting to think
he'd never show up.
translations.ふふっ、すごく頭が良くてちょっと意地悪で、女子に人気があるのわかる。:
Hehe, super smart and kind of
mean... I can totally see why
girls love him.
translations.わかる。●みたいな感じだよな:
I know. Kind of like you,
●.
translations.女子って、\n暗い奴が好きだもんね:
Girls always love
brooding guys, huh？
translations.でも、きっと真犯人だよ？:
I bet he's the real
killer, though？
translations.わかる。●みたいな感じだよな。:
I know. Kind of like you,
●.
translations.そうなの？ ふぅん……まあ、可愛いかったので許します。:
Is that so？ Hmm... well,
that was pretty cute,
so I'll let it slide.
translations.女子って、暗い奴が好きだもんね。:
Girls always love
brooding guys, huh？
translations.陰があるっていうの、そういうのは。……ん、妬いてるのかな？:
They call that 'brooding',
thank you very much.
...Wait, are you jealous？
translations.えぇっ！？ まさか……ないない！ ぜったいウソ！ ……嘘だよね？:
What!？ No way... No, no!
You're totally kidding!
...Right？ You're kidding, right？
translations.美馬坂博士は、不死の研究をしてたんでしょ？ それにどうやら、バラバラの犯人て――:
Dr. Mimasaka was researching
immortality, right？ And it
looks like the dismemberment
killer is—
translations.ほら、もうあの人じゃない？ ということは、この二人って実は――:
You know, that person!
Which means the two of them
are actually—
translations.バラバラの身体でフランケン\nみたいなの作ってるってこと？:
Making a Frankenstein
out of body parts？
translations.バラバラの身体でフランケンみたいなの作ってるってこと？:
Making a Frankenstein
out of body parts？
translations.そうかなぁ、って。だってみんな同い年くらいの女の子でしょ？ あ、もう……笑わない:
That's what I thought. I mean,
they're all girls about
the same age, right？
Hey... stop laughing!
translations.え？ それは、考えなかったな……。ちょっと強引過ぎない？:
Huh？ I hadn't thought of
that... Isn't that a bit of
a stretch, though？
translations.かもしれないよね？ 実験のために必要な身体を……とか。う～ん、違うか……。:
Could be, right？ Like,
gathering bodies for experiments
and all... Hmm, maybe not...
translations.ねぇねぇ、榎木津って出てきたでしょ？:
Hey, Enokizu showed up,
didn't he？
translations.うん、メチャクチャな探偵でしょ？:
Yeah, that totally wild
detective, right？
translations.そうそう。理路整然とした京極堂と正反対で、ちょっと悪者っぽいでしょ？:
Yeah! He's the exact opposite
of Kyogokudo's cold logic,
kind of like a bad boy, right？
translations.どっちかって言われたら、どっちが好き？:
If you had to choose,
which one do you like better？
translations.そっかそっか……ちょっと意外な感じがする。:
I see, I see...
That's kind of surprising.
translations.だと思った。やっぱりアンチヒーローみたいな方が、男子的にはカッコいいよね？:
I figured. Boys always think
anti-hero types are cooler,
right？
translations.わたし？ わたしは……榎木津さんかな。なんかほっとけない感じだから。誰かさんみた:
Me？ I'd say... Enokizu-san.
I just can't leave him alone.
Kind of like a certain someone.
translations.ねぇ、榎木津さん達が喫茶店で加奈子ちゃんの写真を久保に見せるでしょ？:
Hey, remember when Enokizu-san
and the others show Kanako-chan's
photo to Kubo at the cafe？
translations.その時久保がすごく驚いて、捜してあげる、なんて急に親切になるけど、あれ、怪しいよ:
Kubo acts so surprised and
suddenly gets all helpful, offering
to find her. Fishy, right？
translations.「箱の中の娘」では、主人公は一目見たきりの箱の女の子を捜してたのよ？ ということ:
In 'The Girl in the Box,' the
hero was searching for a girl in a
box he saw just once, right？
Which means...
translations.久保は箱詰めの\n加奈子ちゃんを見たってこと？:
So Kubo saw Kanako-chan
packed in a box？
translations.加奈子ちゃん誘拐犯は\n久保ってこと？:
So Kubo is the one who
kidnapped Kanako-chan？
translations.次の被害者は\n加奈子ちゃんってこと？:
So Kanako-chan is
the next victim？
translations.つまり、久保は箱詰めの加奈子ちゃんを見たってこと？:
You mean Kubo saw Kanako-chan
packed in a box？
translations.なぁんてね。う～ん、ちょっと考え過ぎかなぁ？:
Just kidding! Hmm, maybe
I'm overthinking it？
translations.つまり、加奈子ちゃん誘拐犯は久保ってこと？:
You mean Kubo is the one who
kidnapped Kanako-chan？
translations.ん？ そういう風にも考えられる？ そっか……う～ん。:
Huh？ Could it be that too？
I see... Hmm.
translations.つまり、次の被害者は加奈子ちゃんってこと？:
You mean Kanako-chan is
the next victim？
translations.……ん？ そうなる？ 加奈子ちゃんがまだ無事ならそうなのかな……。:
...Huh？ Would it be？ If she's
still safe, I guess so, but...
translations.頼子ちゃん、なんで久保に付いていっちゃうんだろ？ だって、いかにも怪しい人でしょ:
Why did Yoriko-chan go with Kubo？
I mean, he's obviously super
suspicious, isn't he？
translations.確かに、遺書だとその辺が曖昧だよね。:
True, her suicide note
is pretty vague about that.
translations.えぇ……違うよそれは。もう、乙女心もストーリーもなんにもわかってない。０点です。:
Whaat... No, that's not it.
Geez, you don't get a girl's
heart OR the plot. Zero points!
translations.そういう風にも取れるよね。でも、それだけなのかな？ う～ん……。:
You could see it that way.
But is that all it was？
Hmm...
translations.そうだよね、きっと。でも、そこのところが今一つわからなくない？ う～ん……。:
That's probably it. But isn't that
part still a little unclear？
Hmm...
translations.もう……。どういうこと？ ホントに分かんなくなっちゃった……。:
Jeez... What's going on？
I'm totally lost now...
translations.だって、バラバラ殺人の犯人はやっぱり久保だったでしょ？ なのに、本人がバラバラな:
I mean, Kubo was the dismemberment
killer after all, right？ But then
he's the one chopped in pieces!
translations.まあ、ミステリーだからそんなに簡単に犯人がわかってもつまんないよ？:
Well, it's a mystery. It wouldn't
be fun if the culprit was that
easy to figure out, right？
translations.ねぇ、そろそろ教えっこしない？ 真犯人、誰だと思ってる？:
Hey, let's share our guesses.
Who do you think the real
culprit is？
translations.不思議なことなど無いのだよ、\n寧々君:
There is nothing strange in this
world, Nene-kun.
translations.実験のためでしょ？ それしか考えられないもんね？ じゃあ、他の複雑な伏線は意味が:
For his experiments, right？
That's the only explanation!
So all the other clues were pointless？
translations.……もういい。独りで考える。:
...Fine, whatever.
I'll think about it myself.
translations.不思議なことなど無いのだよ、寧々君。:
There is nothing strange in this
world, Nene-kun.
translations.京極堂の真似してもダメ。ズルい、ちゃんと教えて！:
Impersonating Kyogokudo
won't work! No fair,
tell me for real!
translations.全ての真相がだんだん明らかになって来たでしょ？ それなのにまだ、わからないことが:
The whole truth is slowly
coming to light, right？
Even so, there's still
so much I just don't get.
translations.美馬坂親子が遺産をだまし\n取ろうとしたってことでしょ？:
So the Mimasakas tried to
swindle the inheritance, right？
translations.研究所は巨大な\n人造人間ってことだよ:
The research lab is basically
a giant artificial human.
translations.こんなに複雑なのに、\n黒幕が居ないんだよね:
Even though it's so complex,
there's no real mastermind.
translations.結局、美馬坂親子が遺産をだまし取ろうとしたってことでしょ？:
In the end, it just means the
Mimasakas tried to swindle
the inheritance, right？
translations.結果はね？ でも、計画的なようで本当は偶然が重なってそうなったのよ。そこが、よく:
That's how it ended up, yeah.
Even though it seems planned,
it was really just a chain
of coincidences. That's the
part I don't quite get.
translations.つまり、研究所は巨大な人造人間ってことだよ。:
In other words, the lab is
a giant artificial human.
translations.もう……それはお話の一部でしょ？ 張り合いが無いなぁ。:
Geez... that's just part of
the story! You're no fun.
translations.つまり、こんなに複雑なのに、黒幕が居ないんだよね。:
In other words, despite being
so complex, there's no real
mastermind.
translations.そうなのよ。こんなミステリー初めて。不思議な感じ……。:
Exactly. I've never read a
mystery like this before.
It's such a strange feeling...
translations.やったー！ オメデトー！ ふふっ、長かったもんね？:
Yay! Congrats~!
Hehe, it was pretty long,
wasn't it？
translations.あ～ん、もうちょっと待って。わたしも、読んじゃうから！:
Aww, hold on a sec!
I'm almost done too!
translations.「魍魎の匣」か……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、読み終えてどう？:
"Mouryou no Hako", huh...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what did you think？
translations.うん……。すごく面白かった。面白かったんだけど――:
Yeah... It was really good.
Really good, but—
translations.やっぱり、わからないことだらけ。例えば、“魍魎”ってなんだったのかな？:
There's still so much I don't
get. Like, what even was the
"mouryou" in the end？
translations.それに、このお話って、犯人らしい犯人が居ないでしょ？ 真犯人とか黒幕みたいなのが:
And in this story, there isn't
really a clear culprit, right？
No true culprit or mastermind.
translations.すごく不幸な人達がいて、みんな、悪気は無いのに、何かのきっかけ――:
There are these terribly unlucky
people, none of them meaning harm,
but then something triggers it—
translations.京極堂風に言えば、“モノが通った”時に、それぞれ、別々に、恐ろしい事に巻き込まれ:
Or as Kyogokudo put it, when
"something passed through", they
each got swept into horror...
completely separately.
translations.でも、外からは全体が一つの事件にしか見えなくて……あ！:
Yet from the outside, it looks
like just one single incident...
Wait, ah!
translations.全部でもあり別々でもあり、悪意のようで事故のようで、もしかしてそれを……。:
It's all connected yet separate,
like malice yet like an accident...
Could that be what...
translations.“魍魎”って表現してる！？ お？ なんかそれ、そのまま推薦文に使えそう！:
...the "mouryou" represents！？
Oh? Hey, that could actually work
as our recommendation blurb!
translations.うんうん！ いいかも！ じゃあ、書いちゃおう？:
Yeah, yeah! That sounds great!
Let's write it down, then？
translations.「魍魎の匣」か……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、読み終えてどう？:
"Mouryou no Hako", huh...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what did you think？
translations.うん……想像していたのとはちょっと違ったけど、面白かった。:
Yeah... It was a bit different
from what I expected, but I really
enjoyed it.
translations.う～ん、一言でいうのは難しいけど……。:
Hmm, it's hard to put into
words, but...
translations.ほら、普通のミステリーみたいに、一人でもチームでも、真犯人や黒幕が全てに繋がって:
You know, unlike normal
mysteries, it's not set up where
a single culprit or team is
connected to everything, right？
translations.一見一つの事件に見えて、実は全部別のお話で、更にみんなそれぞれ連鎖してるっていう:
It looks like one case at first,
but they're all separate stories
that ended up chaining together—
translations.すごいよな……よくこんなストーリー考えられるよ。:
It's incredible... I can't believe
anyone could think up a story
like this.
translations.京極夏彦先生って、やっぱり京極堂さんみたいに頭がいいのよ、きっと。:
Natsuhiko Kyogoku-sensei must
be just as brilliant as Kyogokudo
himself, honestly.
translations.そうだろうな……お？ なんかそれ、そのまま推薦文に使えそう！:
Probably... Oh? Hey, that could
actually work as our recommendation
blurb!
translations.ふふっ、もう！ 調子いいんだから。よし、じゃあ書いちゃおっか？:
Hehe, jeez! Always taking the easy
way out. Alright, shall we write
it down then？
translations.うん……すごく面白かった。予想よりぜんぜん。……ねぇ？:
Yeah... It was really good.
Way more than I expected.
...Hey？
translations.やっぱり、心って脳のことなんだと思う？:
Do you really think the mind
is just the brain, after all？
translations.まあ、身体だけじゃ何も考えられないし……。:
Well, your body alone
can't do any thinking,
so...
translations.身体と頭を比べたら、確かにそうよね？ でもね、京極堂さんが言ったセリフ、ほら……:
Compared to the body,
sure, that makes sense.
But remember that line
from Kyogokudo？
translations.脳は身体を映してるだけの鏡、だっけ？:
Wasn't it... the brain is
just a mirror reflecting
the body？
translations.みんなそれぞれの身体で経験するからそれぞれの心があるってことでしょ？:
Meaning everyone's mind
is different because
they experience life
through their own bodies,
right？
translations.ということは、脳みそだけになったら、本当にコンピューターと同じになっちゃう。:
So if it were just a brain
all by itself, it'd really
be no different from a
computer.
translations.なるほど……うん。なんかこのまま、推薦文が書けそうな気がしてきた。:
I see... Yeah.
I feel like I could write
the recommendation blurb
right now.
translations.本当？ よし、じゃあ忘れないうちに書いちゃおっか？:
Really？ All right, let's
write it before we
forget, okay？
translations.へぇ、京極夏彦の魍魎の匣か。難しい言葉がずいぶん出てきたろ？ 確かページ数もすご:
Huh, Natsuhiko Kyogoku's
'Box of Goblins', huh？
Had a lot of tough words,
didn't it？ And the page
count's huge, isn't it？
translations.はい。まあ、なんとかなりました。ね？:
Yes. Well, we managed
somehow. Right？
translations.……なんだ？ 青春の思い出もバッチリってワケか？:
...What's this？
Making some sweet youth
memories while you're
at it, huh？
translations.はい。誰かと一緒に読んで、一緒に推理しながら読むとすっごく、楽しいです。ね？:
Yes! Reading with someone
and trying to solve the
mystery together is super
fun. Isn't that right？
translations.あ、そう。そりゃ良かったね……。とにかく、お疲れさん！ 心して書評を読ませてもら:
Ah, is that so？
Good for you two... Anyway,
good work! I'll be sure to
read your review with care.
translations.ハァ～～！ やり遂げたって感じだな！ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のお陰で、なんとかなったよ。:
Pheeew! Really feels like
we accomplished something!
Thanks to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
we pulled it off.
translations.ふふっ、わたしは、一緒に読んだだけだよ。:
Hehe, all I did was
read along with you.
translations.書評、みんな読んでくれるといいね？:
Hope everyone reads our
review, don't you？
translations.うん。それで、本を読みたくなってくれるともっといいけどな！:
Yeah. And it'd be even
better if it made them
want to read the book!
translations.ゼッタイ読みたくなるよ、あの書評を読めば。なんていうのかなぁ……。:
It definitely will!
Once they read that
review... How should
I put it...？
translations.これを書いた人は、すごく楽しく読めたんだなっていう、説得力があるもん。うん。:
It really gets across
how much fun the person
writing it had reading it.
Mm-hmm.
translations.そっか……。じゃあ、やっぱり、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のお陰だね。:
I see... Then that's
really thanks to you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そうなの？ じゃあ、お礼にもっともっと厚いやつ、一緒に読んでもらおっかな？:
Is that so？ Well then, as
thanks, maybe I should make
you read an even thicker
book with me？
translations.厚いの、ね……ドンと来いっ！:
A thick one, huh...
Bring it on!
translations.ふふっ、ウソだよ！ でもね、これからまたこうやって一緒に本、読んでね？ 図書委員:
Hehe, just kidding!
Still, read with me again
like this, okay？
Mr. Library Committee.
translations.はい。あの、途中で色いろ調べたりして、なんとか頑張ったんだよね？:
Yes. Um, he worked hard
looking things up as he
went, right？
translations.ん？ まあよし、お疲れさん！ 書評、読ませてもらうぞ。:
Hm？ Well, alright. Good
work! Looking forward to
reading the review.
translations.ハァ……結局、最後まで▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に頼っちゃったな。:
*sigh* In the end, I relied
on you the whole way
through, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ホント。わたしが選んで、書評まで書いちゃったんだもん。反省して？:
You really did. I picked
it out and even ended up
writing the review. Reflect
on what you did, okay？
translations.ふふっ。でもね、ホントはちょっと楽しみなの。:
Hehe. But truthfully,
I'm actually a little
excited.
translations.だって、わたしの書評を読んで、魍魎の匣を読んでくれる人、いるかもしれないでしょ？:
Because someone might read
my review and actually pick
up 'Box of Goblins', right？
translations.それで、その人がわたしみたいに、京極夏彦のファンになったら、嬉しいなって。:
And if they become a fan
of Natsuhiko Kyogoku like
me, I'd be so happy.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ファンになったんだ。:
So you're a fan now,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.へへ。実は、もう次のを読んでます。今度はなんと、１５００ページ！:
Hehe. To tell the truth,
I'm already reading the
next one. And this one is
a whopping 1,500 pages!
translations.（●も、がんばって読んでみるかな、魍魎の匣……）:
(Maybe ● should buckle 
down and read Mouryou no Hako, 
too...)
translations.え、え、どういうこと？:
Wait, wait, what does 
that mean？
translations.えぇ……古文みたいなんですけど……。:
Wait... This reads like 
classical Japanese...
translations.やっと出た……この人がそうか……。:
He finally showed up... 
So this is the guy...
translations.なになに、この四角！ ちょっと、やだ～。:
Wait, what's with this square!？ 
Come on, ew~.
translations.えっ、加奈子も？じゃあ……。:
Wait, Kanako too？ 
Then that means...
translations.えっ！？ そうだったの頼子ちゃん……。:
Wait!？ So that was it, 
Yoriko-chan...？
translations.あ、相模湖行ったことある～。: Ah, I've been to Lake Sagami~.
translations.やぁ～、逃げて～、ダメだよ～。:
Nooo, run! 
You can't do that~.
translations.あっ――わたし、犯人わかっちゃったかも……。:
Ah—I might know who 
the culprit is...
translations.“猿じゃないんだ”って、ひどい！:
“He's not a monkey!” 
That's so mean!
translations.今度ね、デキシーズの近くに新しいファミレスが出来るらしいの。: Apparently, a new family restaurant is opening near Dixie's soon.
translations.へえ、ファミレスか。どこの店だろ。: Huh, a family restaurant？ Wonder what place.
translations.最近日本に進出してきた、アメリカのチェーンらしいよ。たしか、アイーシャダイニング: It's an American chain that just expanded to Japan recently, I hear. I think it's called Aisha Dining.
translations.ふーん、そうなんだ……って、心配じゃないの？: 'Huh, no kidding' ...Wait, aren't you worried at all？
translations.別に心配なんてないけど……むしろそれでお客さんが減れば、仕事が楽になるかも！ な: Not really, no... If anything, fewer customers might make work easier! Just kidding.
translations.（さて、今日もアルバイトすっかー！）:
(Well, time for another day
at work!)
translations.いや、ちょっとね……はあ、学生バイトは気楽でいいよな……。: Oh, nothing, just... *sigh* Must be nice being a student part-timer with no worries...
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。今日、なんかお客さん少なくない？: Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Isn't it kinda slow today？
translations.今日はほら、例の新しいファミレスのオープンだから。: Well, you know, today's the grand opening for that new family restaurant.
translations.ああ、それで店長暗かったのか。たしか……なんとかダイニングだっけ。: Ah, that's why the boss was so gloomy. It was... Something Dining, right？
translations.アイーシャダイニング。さすがに今日はそっちにお客様とられちゃったね。: Aisha Dining. Looks like they really stole all our customers away today.
translations.そっか、てことは向こうは繁盛してるのかな。: I see. So I guess business is booming over there.
translations.ねえ、仕事終わったら、行ってみない？: Hey, want to check it out after work？
translations.お、敵情視察ってやつ？: Oho, scouting out the enemy, huh？
translations.そうじゃないけど…………ううん、そうなのかな。やっぱり気になっちゃって。: Not really, but... Well, maybe. I just can't help being curious.
translations.そうだな。●もどんな店か気になるし、行ってみるか！: Yeah. I'm curious what kind of place it is too, ●, so let's go!
translations.ここか。へえ……。: So this is the place. Huh...
translations.なんだか楽しそう。\nライバルなのよ？:
You look pretty excited.
They're our rivals,
you know？
translations.ライバルなんて大げさだって。\nそれに、初めての店って\nなんかワクワクするじゃ:
'Rivals' is exaggerating.
Besides, going somewhere
new is always exciting.
translations.活気はあるけど……\nちょっとうるさいね。\n私はもう少し落ち着いた\n雰囲気の:
It's lively, sure, but...
it's a bit too noisy.
I prefer a calmer
atmosphere myself.
translations.うん……でもさすが、\nアメリカのチェーン店って\n感じだな。:
Yeah... but it definitely
feels like an American
chain.
translations.そうね、開店間もないのに、\n店員の教育も行き届いてるし。:
Yeah. They just opened,
and the staff is already
really well-trained.
translations.わかるでしょ？ \n自分だって\n同じ仕事してるんだから。:
Can't you tell？
I do the exact same
job, after all.
translations.ははは……。\nえっと、ほら注文注文。:
Hahaha...
Uh, come on, let's order.
translations.……メニュー、\nかなり豊富だね。\nんー……。:
...There's quite a
lot on the menu.
Hmm...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nほんとに敵情視察に\n来たみたいだ）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really looks
like she came here
on a recon mission.)
translations.う～ん、安くてボリュームあって\n……こりゃ、流行るわけだな。\n味もそこそこだ:
Cheap, huge portions...
No wonder it's popular.
Tastes pretty good, too.
translations.うん、ホント。\nさすがアメリカのチェーン。\nでも、これじゃ……。:
Yeah, really.
Just like an American chain.
Still, at this rate...
translations.あれ？ \n君たち、来てたのか！:
Wait, what？
You two are here, too？
translations.なんだか挙動不審ですよ。:
You're acting pretty
suspicious, you know.
translations.だって、一応競合店の\n店長なわけだし……。:
I mean, I *am* the
manager of a rival
store, after all...
translations.別に今はお客なんだから\n堂々としてればいいと\n思いますけど。:
You're just a customer
right now, so you should
act confident, though.
translations.あら、デキシーズの店長さん？:
Oh, aren't you the
manager of Dixie's？
translations.申し遅れました。:
Pardon me, where are
my manners.
translations.私、このアイーシャダイニング\n新とわの店のマネージャーを\n務めております、\:
I am the manager of this
Aisha Dining,
Shin-Towano branch.
My name is Yarisawa.
translations.デキシーズの店長さんに\nお越しいただけるなんて。\n私どもの店はいかがですか？:
To think Dixie's manager
would pay us a visit.
How are you finding
our establishment？
translations.そ、そうだね……\nうーん、寧々くんは\nどう思った？:
R-Right... Um,
what did you think,
Nene-kun？
translations.姉ヶ崎さんでしょ？ \nええ、知ってます。:
You're Anegasaki-san,
aren't you？
Yes, I know of you.
translations.もちろん。それで？ \nいかがでしたか、うちは？:
Of course. So？
What did you think
of our restaurant？
translations.そうですね……内装はきれいで\n明るい雰囲気ですし、スタッフが\n充分いるみたい:
Well... The interior is
clean and bright, and you
seem to have plenty
of staff.
Even though it's packed,
we barely had to wait,
so it was comfortable.
However...
translations.細かいところが少し。\nメニューは豊富ですけど、\nその分選びづらく感じました。:
Just a few minor things.
The menu is huge, but
that makes it harder
to choose.
As for the taste and
presentation...
it feels like the staff
isn't fully used to
things yet...
translations.ううん。\n的確な指摘だと思うもの。\n貴重なご意見、\nありがとうございます。:
Not at all.
Your points were spot-on.
Thank you for the
valuable feedback.
translations.ライバル同士、\n末永くよろしくお願いします。:
As fellow rivals,
here's to a long
relationship together.
translations.末永くはおかしいか……\nうちとしては出来るだけ\n短いおつきあいにしなきゃね？:
Though 'long' might
be the wrong word...
For our sake, we ought
to make it as brief
as possible, right？
Hehe.
translations.短いって、つまり……\nあっ！ じゃあ、やっぱり\nうちの店を潰すために――:
As brief as... Wait!
So you really are
trying to put us out
of business—
translations.ね、寧々くん、どうしよう？ \nアイタタ、また胃が……。:
N-Nene-kun, what do
we do？ Ow-ow-ow,
my stomach again...
translations.（ライバル店か。\n店長だけでいったら、\n勝てる気がしないぞ……）:
(A rival store, huh.
If it's just based on
our managers, I don't feel
like we have a chance...)
translations.アイーシャダイニングの\nマネージャー、\nなんかすごい人だったな。:
That Aisha Dining manager
was really something else,
wasn't she.
translations.ウチの店長とは大違いだよな。\nいかにも、やり手！\nって感じでさ。:
A far cry from our
manager. She had that real
go-getter vibe to her.
translations.大丈夫かな、ウチのお店……。:
I wonder if our restaurant
is gonna be okay...
translations.大丈夫だろ。お客さんはたしかに減ったけど、そんなすぐに潰れたりしないって。:
I'm sure it'll be fine.
We've lost customers, sure,
but it won't go under so fast.
translations.……ほんとにそう思う？\nウチ、結構危ないのよ？:
...Do you really think so？
We're actually in pretty
serious trouble, you know？
translations.そうなの？\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、そんなことまで\n知ってるんだ。:
Really？
You know that much
about it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.えっと……ほんとは知ってちゃダメなんだけどね。私、店長や社員さんの話を聞かされる:
Well... I shouldn't really
know this, but the manager
and regular staff vent to me.
translations.うーん、そっか……今のうちに他のバイト先探した方がいいのかな？:
Hmm, I see... Maybe I should
look for another job
while I still can？
translations.……なに、それ？\nどういうこと？:
...What's that supposed
to mean？ What do you mean？
translations.だって……この店がなくなっても、バイトはしないと……。:
I mean... even if this
place goes under, I still
need to work...
translations.それはそうだけど……でもこの店は――:
Well, yes, but...
this place is—
translations.私たちが出会った、思い出の場所じゃない。:
It's where we met...
It's full of our memories.
translations.だから、そんな風に言わないで。:
So please don't talk
like that.
translations.（●たちの思い出の場所がなくなるかもしれない、か……）:
（The place full of memories
for ● and me might
disappear, huh...）
translations.（こっちまで暗くなるからやめてほしいなあ……）:
（I wish he'd stop.
He's bringing my mood
down too...）
translations.（暇だ……お客さん、おじいさん一人だけだし。ほんとに大丈夫かなこの店）:
（So dead... There's only
one old guy here. Is this
place really gonna be okay？）
translations.なんか最近ヒマだねー、なんでだろ。:
It's been so slow lately.
I wonder why？
translations.そうだね……アイーシャダイニングができたから、お客さんとられちゃってるのかなあ。:
Yeah... Aisha Dining opened,
so maybe they're taking all
our customers？
translations.そっか！ のっち頭いいね～。:
Oh, right!
Nocchi, you're so smart~
translations.（ん？ あのおじいさん、なにキョロキョロしてんだ？）:
（Hm？ Why is that old man
looking around so much？）
translations.お客様。どうかなさいましたか？:
Excuse me, sir.
Is everything alright？
translations.……店員さん、あの女の子達は新人アルバイトかな？:
...Excuse me, are those
girls new part-timers？
translations.……いえ、新人でもないんですけど。申し訳ございません、騒がしくて。:
...No, not really.
I'm terribly sorry about
the noise, sir.
translations.ホットコーヒー、お待たせいたしました。:
Here's your hot coffee.
Thank you for waiting.
translations.あー、やっちゃった……。申し訳ありません。:
Ah, I messed up...
I'm so sorry!
translations.もっとちゃんとしてくれないと困るよ、この大変なときに。:
I need you to pull
it together, especially
in tough times like this!
translations.店長、お客様にも聞こえますから、やめてください。:
Manager, the customers can
hear you. Please stop.
translations.まゆちゃん、手伝うから、すぐ片付けよ。:
Mayu-chan, I'll help.
Let's clean this up
right away.
translations.二人で大丈夫。あなたは７番テーブルお願い、オーダー待ちだから。:
We'll be fine. Could you
take Table 7？ They're waiting
to order.
translations.お客様、申し訳ございません。お召し物は大丈夫でしょうか。:
Excuse me, sir, I am so sorry!
Did anything get on your clothes？
translations.すぐに片付けますので。:
We'll have this cleaned up
right away.
translations.さっきは丁寧にありがとう。お嬢さん。:
Thanks for being so polite earlier,
young lady.
translations.いえ、お騒がせして申し訳ございませんでした。:
Not at all, and I'm very sorry
for the commotion.
translations.いやいや。それじゃあ、ごちそうさま。:
No, no, it's fine. Well,
thanks for the meal.
translations.ありがとうございました。またのご来店をお待ちしております。:
Thank you very much.
Please come again!
translations.うん……気のせいかもしれないけど。あのおじいさん、店内のことを観察してなかった？:
Yeah... It might just be
my imagination, but didn't it
seem like that older man was
observing the store？
translations.ああ……たしかに、店員のこと質問したり、妙だったかな。:
Yeah... Come to think of it,
he was asking about the staff.
That was kind of strange.
translations.やっぱり。それに、どこかで見たことある気がするのよね……。:
I knew it. Plus, I feel like
I've seen him somewhere before...
translations.んー、そうじゃなくて。もっと……写真かなにかだったような。:
Hmm, not that. More like...
maybe in a photo or something.
translations.おお、いたいた。ちょうどよかった。: Oh, there you are. Perfect timing.
translations.今日、みんなに話があるから、少し残って。:
I need to talk to everyone today,
so please stick around after your shift.
translations.話？ はあ、いいっすけど。: A talk？ Uh, sure, I guess.
translations.ああ、来たか。……今の時間はこれで全員？:
Ah, you're here. ...Is this
everyone on shift right now？
translations.はあ……話っていうのはこの店についてなんだけど……。:
*Sigh*... So, what I need to
talk about is this store...
translations.やっぱり潰れます？ それ、困るんですけど～。:
Are we going out of business？
That'd really suck for me~
translations.だって、アイーシャ出来てからお客さんぜんぜん来ないし～。:
I mean, ever since Aisha opened,
we get like zero customers~
translations.あ、ああ。真友子くんが言った通りだ。業績悪化が本部でも問題になっていて……。:
Y-Yeah. It's just like Mayuko said.
Our declining profits have become
a serious issue at headquarters...
translations.少し前に本部から覆面で査察が入ったらしいんだ、それで……はあ……。:
Apparently headquarters sent in
an undercover inspector
a while back, and... *sigh*...
translations.ねぇ、もしかしてこの前のおじいさん……。:
Hey, do you think that older man
from the other day could be...？
translations.“ささつ”ってー？ よくわかんないですけど～。:
What's an 'inspection'？
I don't really get it~
translations.要するに……社員の人がお客のふりしてスパイしに来たってこと。:
Basically... corporate had someone
pretend to be a customer to spy on us.
translations.評価は、どうだったんですか？: So... how did they evaluate us？
translations.散々だよ……まず従業員のモラルが低いって……。:
It was terrible... First off,
they said employee morale was
in the gutter...
translations.まあ僕の評価も最低だったけどね……僕だってさ、がんばろうって気はなくはないんだよ:
Well, my own rating was rock bottom 
too... It's not like I don't 
wanna try, you know? 
And yet... this is so harsh...
translations.このまま閉店になった時は、君たちアルバイトは、一部、近くの支店に異動出来る……か:
If we do end up closing down, 
some of you part-timers... 
might be able to transfer 
to a nearby branch.
translations.一部って……全員じゃないってことですか？:
'Some of us'...？ 
Does that mean not everyone？
translations.まあね、一部有能スタッフだってさ。:
Pretty much... 
'Select capable staff,' they said.
translations.そんなぁ！ じゃあ、まゆとのっちは無理じゃん！:
No way! 
Then Mayu and Nocchi 
don't stand a chance!
translations.ま、まあ、そういうわけだから！\nとりあえず今日はここまで！:
A-anyway, that's how it is! 
That's all for today!
translations.えー、店長、困るんですけど～。:
Aww, Boss, what are we 
supposed to do then~？
translations.アイーシャで働けばいいんじゃない？ 新しい仕事覚えろって言われても困るし。:
Why not just work at Aisha？ 
It'd suck having to learn 
a whole new job anyway.
translations.そっか……似たような仕事だろうしね。:
True... 
It'd probably be pretty much 
the same kind of work.
translations.あなたはどうするつもり？: What do you plan to do？
translations.●は選抜に入れるかどうかもわかんないからなあ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は確実だろうけど。:
● might not even make 
the cut, honestly. 
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ definitely will, though.
translations.●も選抜に入って、一緒の店に行けたらいいよな。:
It'd be great if ● made 
the cut too, so we could go 
to the same store together.
translations.離れ離れになるのはイヤだもんな。:
I really wouldn't want us 
to be separated.
translations.うん、離れたくない……。:
Yeah... 
I don't want to be apart either...
translations.よかった、そう思っててくれて……。:
I'm glad... 
that you feel that way too...
translations.でも、思い出の場所で働けなくなるのは、悲しいね。:
Still, it's sad to think 
we won't be able to work 
at a place full of memories.
translations.閉店せずに済むのが一番なのに……。:
If only the restaurant didn't 
have to close down...
translations.あの、どのようなご用件でしょうか。: Um, how can I help you today？
translations.そんなに身構えないで。今日は、客として食事に来ただけよ？:
Don't be so on guard. 
I only came to have a meal 
as a customer today, you know？
translations.席へ案内して下さる？: Would you show me to a table？
translations.はい、失礼しました。こちらへどうぞ。:
Oh, forgive me. 
Right this way, please.
translations.（やっぱり店内を観察してる。様子を見に来たってことか……）:
(She's definitely scoping out 
the place. Came to size us up, 
huh...)
translations.お客様。お水のおかわりはいかがでしょうか。:
Excuse me, ma'am. 
Would you care for a refill 
on your water？
translations.……ええまあ、そこそこですね。それではごゆっくりどうぞ――:
...Well, for a while now. 
Please take your time—
translations.ウチの店で働く気はない？:
Interested in working 
at my place？
translations.彼女……姉ヶ崎さんは、欲しいな……なんてね？ これも冗談よ？ フフ。:
I really would like her, though...
Miss Anegasaki, I mean.
Just kidding？ That was a joke
too, you know. Hehe.
translations.（なんか嫌な感じだな……）:
(Man, she rubs me
the wrong way...)
translations.槍沢マネージャーと、なにか話してたの？:
Were you talking to
Manager Yarizawa about something？
translations.ウチの店で働かないか、って。:
She asked if I wanted to
work at her place.
translations.冗談だってさ。人が悪いよな？:
She said it was a joke.
Pretty mean-spirited, right？
translations.そう……うん、ホント、嫌な感じ。:
I see... Yeah, that really
is in bad taste.
translations.今日、話があるから……あとで。:
I need to talk to you today...
later on.
translations.……やっぱりこの店、閉店することになったんだ……はあ。:
...As feared, it's official.
The store is closing down...
*sigh*
translations.僕だってがんばるつもりはあったんだけど、上の決定じゃね？ 色々あるんだよ……まあ:
I wanted to fight for it too,
but it's corporate's call,
you know？ A lot went into it...
Not like we're closing
tomorrow or anything.
translations.さあ、一ヵ月後か、半年後か……。:
Who knows, a month from now,
maybe six months...
translations.いやだからさ、色々あるんだって。じゃあ、お疲れ様！:
Look, like I said, there's a lot
going on. Anyway, good work!
translations.これはいよいよアイーシャかな。:
Guess it really is time
for Aisha, then.
translations.こんなの、納得できないよ……。:
This... I just can't accept
this...
translations.（さて、今日もアルバイトすっかー！ と言ってもお客さんいないけど……）:
(Alright, time for work!
Not that there are any
customers, though...)
translations.あ、いたいた。おーい、ちょっと！:
Oh, there you are. Hey,
c'mere a sec!
translations.実は、例の有能スタッフ選抜の話だけどね……。:
So, about that shortlist
for the top-performing staff...
translations.その……君は入れなかったよ。: Well... you didn't make the cut.
translations.君なんて学生バイトなんだからまだいいよ！ 僕なんて、このご時世に職を失いでもした:
At least you're just a student
working part-time! If I lose my
job in this economy, I'm...
*sigh*... Well, do your best
until we close, okay？
translations.（ダメだったか……そりゃ、●くらいじゃな……）:
(Didn't make the cut, huh...
Well, with only ●,
I guess it makes sense...)
translations.どうしたの、元気ないぞ？:
What's wrong？
Looking a little down there.
translations.ああ、例の選抜の話、ダメだったよ。:
Yeah, that transfer selection...
I didn't make it.
translations.ごめん……●も選ばれれば、またデキシーズで一緒に働けるのに……あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は:
Sorry... If ● got chosen,
we could've kept working together
at Dixie's... Wait, what about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
You made it, right？
translations.うん、そう言われた。希望すれば、十羽野店で働けるって。:
Yeah, that's what they said.
Said if I want to, I can work
at the Towano branch.
translations.だよなあ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲なら当然だな！:
Figures! It's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
of course they'd want you!
translations.こっちこそ、ゴメン……近所で一緒にバイトできるとこ、探さなきゃな。:
I should be sorry...
I'll have to find another job
nearby where we can work together.
translations.離れ離れになるのイヤだもんな。:
Neither of us wants to be
separated, right？
translations.……そ、そうね。また一緒に働くなら……デキシーズ以外のバイト、探さないとね。:
...Y-yeah. If we want to work
together again... we'll have to find
something outside of Dixie's.
translations.（といっても、じきにやめることになるんだよな……）:
(Even if I'll have to quit
before long, though...)
translations.ほら、そんな暗い顔してたら、お客様に失礼だよ。:
Come on, you can't be making
such a gloomy face in front
of the customers.
translations.うん……せめてお客様の前では元気、出していこうね。:
Mm-hmm... At least put on
a cheerful face for the customers,
okay？
translations.あー、つかれた。暇なはずなのにな……。:
Man, I'm beat.
And it wasn't even busy...
translations.よっ。落第組ってなんだよ。:
Yo. What's that supposed to mean,
'reject club'？
translations.選抜の話。この３人とも選ばれなかった落第トリオだよ～。:
The transfer picks! None of us
three made it, so we're
the Reject Trio~
translations.わたしはいけると思ったんだけど……。:
I really thought I had a shot,
though...
translations.おっちょこちょいののっちじゃ無理っしょー。:
Clumsy as you are, Nocchi？
No way in heck~
translations.えっと……なんで？ あれ……どうして無理なの？:
Um... why？ Wait...
why wouldn't I be able to？
translations.それよりさ。アンタたち、どうするの？ 寧々さんは選抜入りでしょ？:
More importantly, what're you two
gonna do？ Nene-san made
the cut, didn't she？
translations.そうなんだよな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲には悪いけど、一緒になにか別のバイト探すしかないかな:
Yeah... Hate to make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
deal with it, but I guess we'll just
find another job together.
translations.それもそっか。せっかく同じバイト先なのに、離れるのはイヤだよね～。:
Makes sense. Working at the same
place is special, so who'd wanna
be split up, right~？
translations.あれ、でも姉ヶ崎さん。十羽野店に行くって店長が言ってたけど。:
Huh？ But the manager said
Anegasaki-san was going to
the Towano branch.
translations.しかも向こうではいきなりバイトリーダーになるって……あれ、わたしの勘違いかな。:
And that she'd be shift lead
right off the bat, too... Huh,
did I get that mixed up？
translations.あ、ああ、なんでも。●、そろそろ休憩終わりだから行くわ。じゃあな。:
O-oh, it's nothing. ●,
my break's almost over, so I'm
heading back. See ya.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……選抜の話、受けたのか？）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Did you take
the transfer offer？)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が十羽野店に行くっていう話、ちゃんと聞かないと……）:
(I need to ask ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ about
going to Towano properly...)
translations.十羽野店に行くって、ほんとか？:
Is it true you're going to
the Towano branch？
translations.でも、一緒に働けなくなるのは▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もイヤだって……。:
But ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you said you hated
the idea of not working together...
translations.それは……バイトリーダーならやりがいもあるし、それに、信用されてまかされた事には:
Well... Being a shift lead would be
really rewarding. Plus, when people
trust me with responsibility,
I want to take it seriously.
translations.だからって、何も言わずに決めなくても……。:
Even so, you didn't have to
decide without telling me...
translations.……ごめん。色々考えたんだけど……上手く説明できないような気がして……。:
...I'm sorry. I thought about
it a lot, but... I just felt
like I couldn't explain it...
translations.ごめんね。私だって、一緒に働けなくなるのはイヤ……それは、本当よ？:
I'm sorry. I hate not being
able to work together, too...
That part really is true, okay？
translations.そうだよな……●が選抜入りできればよかったって話だもんな。:
Yeah, you're right... It really
just comes down to wishing ●
could've made the cut too.
translations.ううん、私こそ、ずっと考えてたこと、ちゃんと言えば良かった……。:
No, I should have been honest
about what I was thinking
the whole time...
translations.そっか……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がちゃんと考えて決めたことなんだよな？:
I see... It's something ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
thought through and decided on,
right？
translations.なら、いいよ。いつまでもワガママ言ってちゃ、情けないもんな。:
Then it's okay. It'd be pathetic
of me to keep acting so selfish
about it.
translations.ワガママ言ってくれて、ちょっとうれしかった。別の場所で働くこと、イヤだって言って:
It actually made me happy that
you were being selfish. That you
didn't want us working apart.
translations.そこは、同じ気持ちでいたいから。それは、本当だから。:
Because I want us to feel the
same way about that. Because
that part really is true.
translations.（……あと何回ここでバイトできんのかな……）:
(...I wonder how many shifts
we have left here...)
translations.ほら……この場合の発注ってどうやるんだっけ？:
Hey, uh... how do I place
an order in this case again？
translations.ええ？ いや、そんなの●に聞かれても……。:
Huh？ Even if you ask ●,
I've got no idea...
translations.えぇ？ しょうがないなぁ……あ、いたいた！ 寧々くーん。:
Eeeh？ Guess you're no help...
Oh, there she is! Nene-kuun!
translations.ちょっとこれ見て、なんかエラー出ちゃってさ。:
Take a look at this, I'm getting
some kind of error.
translations.ああ、これは新規じゃなくて、追加で処理しないと……。:
Ah, this isn't a new entry,
you have to process it as
an addition...
translations.ん？ そっかそっか！ ははは、忘れてた！:
Hm？ Oh, right, right!
Hahaha, I totally forgot!
translations.ごめんごめん。いやー、助かったよ！ ありがとね、寧々くん！:
Sorry, sorry! Man, you saved me!
Thanks a bunch, Nene-kun!
translations.どういたしまして。それじゃ、戻ります。:
You're welcome. Well, I'll get
back to it.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、やっぱり店に無くてはならない存在なんだな……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really is indispensable
to this place...)
translations.いやぁ、しかし……寧々くんがいないと、どうにもならないな、全く！:
Man, though... We'd be totally
helpless without Nene-kun!
translations.やることないのも疲れるもんだな……。ハァーア！:
Having nothing to do is tiring
in its own way... *sigh*
translations.その……なんか、だらだらしちゃって。:
Well... I've just been kind of
slacking off.
translations.なぁに？ そんな、急にあらたまって。:
What's this？ Why so serious
all of a sudden？
translations.さっきの店長とのやりとり見ても、ホント、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に頼りっきりだったんだなって:
Seeing how you handled the boss,
I realized how much everyone
really relies on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あれは、店長いつまでたっても覚えてくれないから、それでなんとなく……。:
Oh, that's just because the boss
never remembers, no matter how
long it's been...
translations.でもさ、そういうのが、有能っていうんだろうなって、そりゃ選抜に入るわけだよな。:
Still, that's what being
competent is. No wonder you
made the cut.
translations.ごめん……なんか愚痴みたいになっちゃったな？:
Sorry... That kind of sounded
like whining, didn't it？
translations.ううん。……私、もう行くね。:
No... I should probably get
back now.
translations.（はあ……なんでこんな風になっちゃうんだよ……）:
(Sigh... Why does it always have
to end up like this...？)
translations.（さて、買い物して帰るか……）:
(All right, time to pick up some
groceries and head home...)
translations.（カップ麺とパンと……牛乳まだあったっけ）:
(Cup noodles, bread...
Did I still have milk？)
translations.いらっしゃいませー。お惣菜いかがですかー。:
Welcome! Would you like some
fresh side dishes today？
translations.どうぞ、いかがですか？:
Come take a look! Anything
catch your eye？
translations.（たまにはこういうのもいいかな……）:
(Something like this might be
nice for a change...)
translations.学生さん、独り暮らし？ ちゃんと手作りのもの食べてる？:
Are you a student living alone？
Getting enough homemade food？
translations.え？ はい、あの……ぼちぼち。:
Huh？ Yeah, well...
More or less.
translations.ふふ、コンビニのお弁当もいいけど、ちゃんと手作りもね？ ここのは、おばさん達が毎:
Hehe, convenience store meals
are fine and all, but you need
home cooking too! We ladies
make all of ours fresh daily.
translations.そうなんですか……お、サバうまそう。:
Oh, really...？ Ooh,
that mackerel looks good.
translations.でしょ？ 今日のおすすめだもん。鯖みそだったら、そうね、バランスを考えて、ホウレ:
Doesn't it？ It's our special
today! If you get the miso
mackerel, how about some spinach
and bean sprout namul to keep
things balanced？
translations.あとは、そうだな、おばさんだったら――あ、ネネちゃん。:
And if it were me,
I'd say— Oh, Nene-chan.
translations.……やだ、なんで？ なんで二人一緒なの？:
...No way, what？ Why are
the two of you together？
translations.いや、なんでって言われても――: Wait, even if you ask why—
translations.やだ、じゃあ、え？ もしかして……えっ？ そうなの？:
Oh my gosh, wait, huh？ Could it
be... wait, really？ Him？
translations.うん……もう、やだぁ～。:
Yeah... Ugh, give me
a break~.
translations.紹介するね？ 私の母です。:
Let me introduce you.
This is my mom.
translations.いつもネネちゃんがお世話になってます。……お姉さんかと思ったでしょ？:
Thank you for taking care of my
Nene-chan. ...Thought I was
her older sister, didn't you？
translations.もう、余計なこと言わないの。:
Jeez, don't say weird things
like that.
translations.はは……あの、●、▲苗字▲▲名前▲といいます。:
Haha... Um, my name is
●, ▲苗字▲▲名前▲.
translations.ネネちゃんからいつも聞いてます。だから、そんなに硬くならないで？:
I hear all about you from Nene-
chan. So there's no need to be
so stiff, okay？
translations.ふふ……でも、思ってたよりカワイイ感じ。ネネちゃんの自慢話だと、もっと二枚目な感:
Fufu... But you're cuter than
I expected. The way Nene-chan
brags about you, I pictured
more of a dashing pretty boy.
translations.お母さん、もう～……カレ困ってるでしょ？:
Mom, seriously~...
You're putting him on the spot!
translations.そんなことないわよね～？:
Oh, you're not troubled at all,
right~？
translations.ほらほら、お母さん仕事仕事！ いいの？:
Come on, Mom, back to work!
Aren't you on the clock？
translations.いけない、そうだった！ じゃあ、これサービス。持って行って。:
Oops, that's right!
Here, this one's on the house.
Take it with you.
translations.どうぞ。つまらないものですが、お近づきのしるしに。:
Go ahead. It's nothing fancy,
just a small token to mark our
getting acquainted.
translations.すいません、それじゃ、いただきます。:
Thank you so much,
I'll gladly take it.
translations.はい終わり、じゃあもう行こう？:
Alright, that's enough!
Let's get going, okay？
translations.ふふ、じゃあね？ 今度はおうちに遊びにきてね。それで、ネネちゃんのとどっちが美味:
Fufu, see you later! Come visit
our house next time, okay？ And
tell me whose cooking tasted
better—mine or Nene-chan's？
translations.もう、お母さん！ ほら早く。:
Mom, seriously!
Come on, let's go.
translations.あ、ああ。じゃあ、失礼します！:
Y-Yeah. Well, thank you very
much! Goodbye!
translations.はぁ～もう、びっくりした。:
Haaah... That really caught me
off guard.
translations.●も……でも、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲があんなに慌ててんの、初めて見たきがする。:
● too... But I don't think
I've ever seen ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
so flustered before.
translations.もう、うるさい。でも……考えてみれば近くのスーパーだし、今まで会わなかったのが不:
Oh, hush. But... thinking about
it, it's the local supermarket,
so it's almost weird we haven't
run into her until now.
translations.たしかにな。でもさ、お母さん、名前も聞かないのになんですぐその、ほら、●が……。:
True. But your mom didn't even
ask my name, so how did she
know right away that ● was...
translations.それは……だって、親子だもん。やっぱりバレちゃうよ。:
Well... we are mother and
daughter, after all.
She was bound to find out.
translations.それに、うちはほら、女二人だからどうしても、そういう相談とか？ 普通の親子よりは:
Plus, it's just the two of us
women at home, so I guess we talk
about that stuff a lot more
than most families do...
translations.そっか……仲いいんだな？:
I see... You two are
really close, huh？
translations.まあね？ お母さんじゃないけど、ホントにちょっと姉妹みたいなとこあるかも。:
I guess？ Even though she's my
mom, we really are kind of like
sisters sometimes.
translations.そういえばさ、お母さんって専業主婦じゃなかったっけ。:
Come to think of it, didn't you
say your mom was a housewife？
translations.あっ……ああ……うん、そんなこと言ったっけ。:
Ah... oh... Yeah, did I say
something like that？
translations.えっと……。少し、話そっか……。:
Um... Can we talk
for a bit...？
translations.話って？: What did you want to talk about？
translations.うん、\nさっきのお母さんの話……。:
Yeah...
About what you said
about my mom earlier...
translations.私ね……今、\nお母さんと二人で暮らしてるの。:
You see... right now,
it's just my mom and me
living together.
translations.二人ってことは、\nお父さんは――:
Just the two of you？
Does that mean your dad is—
translations.お父さんもいるよ。ただ、\n単身赴任であっちこっち\n行ってて、年に何回も\n帰:
I have a dad, too. It's just,
he gets transferred around
for work so much that he
barely visits a few times a year.
translations.うん。それでね、\n母と二人暮らしで私が\nアルバイトしてるって言うと、\nよく:
Yeah. And whenever I tell people
that I live with just my mom
and work part-time,
they always say the same thing.
translations.「大変だね」\n「偉いね」って……。:
'That must be tough,'
or 'You're so admirable'...
translations.たしかに、お父さんと\n離れて暮らすのは心細いし、\n収入も決して豊かじゃないけ:
Sure, living apart from my dad
gets lonely, and we're definitely
not rich... but everyone's
healthy and we get along, so...
we're plenty happy as we are.
translations.そういうこと、上手く\n伝えられるか自信がなくて、\n今までつい……ごめんね。:
I wasn't sure if I could
explain that properly, so I just...
kept it to myself. I'm sorry.
translations.いいよ、\nこうして話してくれたんだし。\nちゃんと、伝わった。:
Don't worry about it.
You're telling me now.
And I really do understand.
translations.それでね。進学して\n勉強したいことがあるから、\nその分は自分で\nバイトして:
And, well... There's something
I want to study in college,
so I've been saving up for it
with my part-time job.
translations.私ね、将来、お母さんと一緒に\n小さなレストランをやりたくて\n……そのためにき:
Someday, I want to open a small
restaurant with my mom...
So I want to study accounting
properly for that.
translations.はじめて、だよね。\nこの話するの。:
This is the first time
I've told you this, isn't it？
translations.うん、はじめて聞いた。\nレストランか……。:
Yeah, first time I've heard it.
A restaurant, huh...
translations.ホントに、そんな立派なのじゃ\nなくていいの。席なんかもね、\n少しだけで。でも:
It really doesn't have to be
anything fancy. Just a few
seats, you know？ But the kind
of place where regulars always
gather... Besides, there's still
so much undecided right now,
like where I'll go to school, right？
translations.そっか……\n色々、考えてるんだな、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
I see...
You've really thought
all this through, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.うん。だから、ね。\n選抜のことも……。:
Yeah. So, you see...
About the selection, too...
translations.デキシーズのバイトは、\n長く続けてるから待遇もいいし。\nそれにバイトリーダー:
I've been working at Dixie's
for a while, so the pay is good.
And if I become shift leader,
my hourly wage goes up, plus it'll
be good practice for the future.
translations.だから、\n他のバイトには変えたくないの。:
That's why
I don't want to switch to
a different part-time job.
translations.そう、だったのか。\nごめん、●……。:
Is that how it was...
I'm sorry, ●...
translations.私が言わなかったんだもん。\nあなたは悪くないよ。:
I'm the one who didn't say
anything. You didn't do
anything wrong.
translations.高校生のアルバイトでも、\n精一杯自分ができることをする。\nそれで人に喜んでも:
Even if it's just a high school
part-time job, you do your best
to make people happy.
Mom told me that's what taking
your work seriously means.
translations.高校に入って私がアルバイトを\nやりたいって言った時、\nお母さんにそう言われた:
When I started high school and
told her I wanted to get a job,
that's what she asked me.
'Can you do that？'
translations.だからバイトリーダーの\n話を聞かされたとき、\n素直にうれしかった。:
So when they told me about
the shift leader position,
I was honestly so happy.
translations.自分が真摯に取り組んで\nきたことが、ちゃんと\n認めてもらえたんだって。:
Because it felt like taking my work
seriously had actually been
recognized.
translations.私、デキシーズで\n働き続けたいの。:
I really want to keep
working at Dixie's.
translations.（そっか……\nこれが、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が\nデキシーズで働いてる\n理由なんだな）:
(I get it now...
So that's why ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
works at Dixie's.)
translations.●、もっとがんばってみようと思う。:
● want to try
pushing myself harder.
translations.一緒に働きたいって言ってくれたのに、●のせいで無理なんて、情けないし。だからって:
You said you wanted us
to work together, so it'd
be pathetic if we couldn't
just because of ●.
But there's no way I want
to get in the way of
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s goals, either.
translations.すごくうれしいけど……無理、してない？:
I'm really happy, but...
are you pushing yourself
too hard？
translations.無理でも●、そうしたいんだ。店長に頼んでみるよ。ダメだって言われたら……それでも:
Even if it is, ● want
to do this.
I'll ask the manager.
If he says no... I'll still
give it everything I've got
right to the end.
translations.●も、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲みたいに、真摯に取り組んでみようと思う。:
● want to take this
seriously too, just like
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.少しお話があるんで、後でちょっといいですか？:
There's something I'd like
to talk to you about. Do
you have a minute later？
translations.話？ ああ、すぐ済むならいいけど。:
Talk？ Ah, sure, as long
as it doesn't take long.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。今日店長に、選抜の件頼んでみるよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I'm gonna ask the
manager about the transfer
today.
translations.うん、わかった。私も一緒にお願いする。:
Okay, got it. I'll ask
along with you.
translations.はい。すいません、時間いただいちゃって。:
Yes. Sorry to take up
your time.
translations.うん。で、なに？ 僕も忙しいからさ……。:
Yeah. So what is it？
I'm pretty busy, so...
translations.はい。選抜の話なんですけど……●も、十羽野店で働かせてもらうこと、できないですか:
Right. It's about the
selection... Is there any
way ● could work at
the Towano store too？
translations.えー？ でももう決まっちゃってるしな……困るよ。:
Huh？ But that's already
been decided... That kind
of puts me in a spot.
translations.そこをなんとか！:
Please, there must be
something you can do!
translations.まだ閉店の時期、未定ですよね。だったら、大丈夫じゃないですか？:
The closing date hasn't
been set yet, right？
So wouldn't it be okay？
translations.時期のことを言えば、そうだけど。あれも一応、ちゃんと選定基準があるんだよ。たしか:
As far as the timing goes,
sure. But there are actual
selection criteria for that.
If I recall... length of
service, and performance.
translations.あと高校生だとどうしてもね……。特例は寧々くんぐらいか。:
Besides, with high school
students it's tough...
Nene's pretty much the
only exception.
translations.かなり特殊なケースだけどね。正直、バイト以上の仕事頼んじゃってるからなあ。:
She's a pretty special
case, though. Honestly, I've
been asking her to do work
way beyond a part-timer.
translations.じゃあ……たとえば姉ヶ崎さん並に仕事ができれば、●も選ばれますか？:
Then... for example, if I
can work as well as
Anegasaki-san, could
● be chosen too？
translations.まあ、そうとも言えるけど……。:
Well, I suppose you could
say that, but...
translations.うーん、まあ、一応聞いてはみるけど……。でも、君が？:
Hmm, well, I'll ask,
just in case... But you？
translations.そ、そう……なら、がんばって。:
I-Is that so... Well,
do your best, then.
translations.なんとかなりそう、かな。:
Looks like it might
work out, maybe？
translations.ああ、がんばってみる。それでさ、お願いあるんだけど。:
Yeah, I'm gonna give it
my all. So, um, I have a
favor to ask.
translations.仕事、いろいろ教えてくれないかな。結局、いきなり頼っちゃうけど……。:
Could you teach me the
ropes？ I know I'm relying
on you right away, but...
translations.ううん。頼ってくれてすごく嬉しい。私も、なにか手伝いたいって思ってた。だって……:
Not at all. It makes me
so happy that you're
relying on me. I wanted to
help too. After all...
it's for the two of us.
translations.ふふ！ でも、店長、あんな人だから、難しい仕事をどんどんやってアピールしないと、:
Hehe! But knowing how
the manager is, unless you
tackle the hard tasks and
really show him, he'll just
sweep it under the rug.
translations.こら、しっかり！ 今日から、寧々先生がビシビシいくからね？\nいい？:
Hey, pull yourself together!
Starting today, Miss Nene's
gonna be strict, okay？
Got it？
translations.バイトで勉強したいことがあってさ、教えてもらいたいんだけど。:
There's some stuff about work
I'd like to study, so I was
hoping you could teach me.
translations.うーん。だったら……家に来ない？:
Hmm. In that case...
want to come over to my place？
translations.そう。スタッフ用のマニュアル、家にも置いてあるし。それに、自分なりに気付いたこと:
Yeah. I have a staff manual
at home, too. Plus my own
notebook with tips I jotted down.
translations.さすが！ いよいよ特訓ぽくなってきたな。:
That's awesome! Now it really
feels like special training.
translations.そう。これは特訓よ？ ほら、駆け足！:
That's right. This is special
training! Come on, double time!
translations.あ、どうも。お邪魔します。:
Ah, hello. Thanks for
having me.
translations.あれ、言ってなかった？ 今日は棚卸しだから、スーパーお休み。:
Oh, didn't I tell you？
Today's inventory day, so
the supermarket is closed.
translations.あら、お母さん、邪魔？ 出かけたほうがいい？:
Oh dear, am I in the way？
Should I go out for a bit？
translations.ヘンなこと言わないで。:
Don't say weird things
like that.
translations.冗談よ。じゃあ、お母さんも話に混ざっていい？:
Just kidding! So, can Mom
join the conversation too？
translations.ダメ。今日は勉強だから、邪魔はしないで。:
No. We're studying today,
so please don't interrupt.
translations.あら、真面目なのねえ……。じゃあ、勉強が終わったらね？:
My, how diligent...
Well, after you finish, okay？
translations.うん。聞きたいのはレジの特殊コードと……あとは発注とか伝票処理とかかな……。他に:
Yeah. I wanted to ask about
the special register codes, and
ordering, processing slips...
Is there anything else you do,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そうね……備品管理とか、バイトのシフト作成とか……あ、電話対応とかも。:
Let's see... supply management,
making the part-timer shifts...
Oh, and answering the phones.
translations.そっか……いろいろありそうだな。:
I see... Sounds like there's
a lot to cover.
translations.……どうする？ やめとく？:
...So, what do you think？
Want to back out？
translations.お疲れ様。あとは、そうね、実際にやってみないとっていうこともたくさんあるかも。:
Good job. After this, well...
there's still plenty you'll
have to learn on the job.
translations.だよな。それはまたバイトのときにやってみる。:
Yeah. I'll give it a shot
during my next shift.
translations.もう、お母さん！ ノックしてって言ってるでしょ？:
Jeez, Mom! I told you to knock,
didn't I？
translations.だってー。なにしてるか気になるじゃない。:
Come on, I was just curious
what you two were doing.
translations.もう、だからヘンなこと言わないでって。:
Geez, stop making it sound
so weird!
translations.だって寂しいんだもん、お母さんも混ぜてよ。:
I was lonely, okay？ Let Mom
hang out with you two!
translations.ねえ、ご飯食べていくでしょ？:
Hey, you're staying for
dinner, right？
translations.でも……いいんですか？:
Wait... are you sure that's
okay？
translations.いいに決まってるでしょ、そのために作ったんだもん。:
Of course it's okay!
That's why I made it.
translations.じゃあ、遠慮なく！: Then don't mind if I do!
translations.そうそう、男の子はそうでなくちゃ。ねぇ？:
That's the spirit!
Boys should eat up. Right？
translations.すごい食卓ですね……さすがプロ……。:
This spread is amazing...
You can tell you're a pro...
translations.ふふ、たくさん食べてね？:
Fufu, eat as much
as you like, okay？
translations.はい、はかどりました。寧々さん、教えるの上手いですから。:
Great, we made a lot of
progress. Nene-san is
really good at teaching.
translations.へえ。でもネネちゃん、そんなに勉強できないでしょ。いくら後輩相手だっていっても。:
Really？ But Nene-chan,
you're not that good
at school yourself, even
helping an underclassman.
translations.あ、今日のは学校の勉強じゃなくて……。:
Ah, today wasn't about
schoolwork, actually...
translations.前に話した、バイト選抜の話。あれの特訓なの。:
It's for the shift selection
I told you about before.
We were training for that.
translations.ああ、一緒に働けるように。ふふ、ねえ聞いて。ネネちゃんたらね？:
Ah, so you can work
together. Hehe, guess what？
Nene-chan here...
translations.あなたと一緒の店で働けなくなるってなったとき、すごかったのよ？ 泣きながら「どう:
When she thought you two
couldn't work together,
she was a total mess!
Crying, 'What do I do...'
translations.泣いてません。もう、大袈裟なんだから。:
I wasn't crying!
Geez, you're exaggerating.
translations.でもご馳走になったんだし……。:
But you treated me
to such a nice meal...
translations.いいの。それより話し相手になってちょうだい。:
It's fine. Just keep me
company instead.
translations.お母さん……ヘンなこと言わないでよ？:
Mom... don't say
anything weird, okay？
translations.さっきの話、本当よ？:
What I said earlier
was true, you know.
translations.寧々が泣いてたって話。あの子があんなに悩んでるの見たの、久しぶり……。:
About Nene crying.
It's been a long time since
I've seen her so troubled...
translations.だからね、あなたが選抜に入るためにがんばるって決めたときは、すごく喜んでた。:
So when you decided to work
hard to make the cut,
she was thrilled.
translations.そっか……ありがとう、嬉しい。:
I see... Thank you,
that makes me happy.
translations.お母さん？ なんか余計なこと言ってない？:
Mom？ You're not saying
anything you shouldn't,
are you？
translations.ふふ……寧々のこと、大切にしてあげてね？:
Fufu... Take good care
of Nene, okay？
translations.よし……あ、そうそう選抜だっけ？ そっちも！:
All right... Oh, right,
the selection, was it？
Give that your all too!
translations.大切なのは、精一杯出来ることをやるってこと。そうすれば、いつでも胸をはっていられ:
What matters is giving it
everything you've got.
That way, you can always
hold your head high. Got it？
translations.ごめんね。遅くまでつき合わせちゃって。:
Sorry for keeping you out
so late.
translations.ううん、楽しかったよ。: Not at all, I had fun.
translations.ホントに？ お母さん、変なこと言わなかった？:
Really？ My mom didn't say
anything weird, did she？
translations.うちのお母さんってホントに、あけすけに何でもきいたりするから、ほら……。:
My mom's so blunt about
asking anything,
you know...？
translations.なんだよ？ 気になるな……。:
What is it？
Now you've got me curious...
translations.いいの！ もう、意地悪……ふふ、バイバイ。:
Drop it!
Jeez, you're mean...
Hehe, bye-bye!
translations.（気になる……とにかく、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も協力してくれてるんだ……やるぞ！）:
(Now I'm curious... Anyway,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is helping out too...
Time to do this!)
translations.ん？ なにやってんだ、レジ？:
Hm？ What's going on
at the register？
translations.ええ～？ なんでぇ？ 困るんですけど～。:
Huuuh？ Why isn't it working？
What do I do～？
translations.ちょっとー、いつまでかかんの？:
Excuse me,
how long is this gonna take？
translations.失礼しました。小毬さん、ちょっと代わって。:
I'm very sorry.
Komari-san, let me take over.
translations.大変失礼いたしました。こちらクーポン分の返金でございます、お確かめくださいませ。:
Terribly sorry about that.
Here's your refund for the
coupon. Please check it over.
translations.すご～い……どうやったの？:
Whoaaa...
How did you do that？
translations.解除キー押しただけだよ。あのクーポン、ＰＯＳがまだ対応してないからロックしちゃっ:
I just hit the release key.
The POS can't handle that
coupon yet, so it locked up.
translations.なに言ってんのか分かんないけど、助かった～！ サンキュー！:
I have no idea what that means,
but you saved me! Thanks!
translations.店長。それ、一度前の発注をキャンセルしないとエラー出ちゃいますよ。パソコン、触っ:
Boss, that'll throw an error
unless you cancel the previous
order first. Can I use the PC？
translations.あ、ほんとだ！ あー、そうだったそうだった。ありがとう、助かったよ。:
Oh, you're right!
Ah, that's how it worked!
Thanks, you really saved me.
translations.勉強の成果、出てるみたいだね。:
Looks like your studying
is really paying off.
translations.ああ、自分でもこんなにすぐ役立つなんて思わなかったよ。今まで知らないことばっかり:
Yeah, I never thought it'd
help out so fast. Guess there was
so much I didn't know.
translations.知らなくても、普段のほとんどの仕事はどうにかなっちゃうから。:
Most everyday tasks can get by
without knowing that stuff,
after all.
translations.この調子で、認めてもらわなきゃ。ね？:
We've gotta keep this up
and make them recognize you.
Right？
translations.どうしてもダメかしら？:
Are you sure you won't
reconsider？
translations.ウチで働かないか、って。本気だって。:
She asked me to work for her.
Said she was completely serious.
translations.もちろん断ったけど……この店は沈みかけた船、だなんて……失礼しちゃう。:
I turned her down, of course,
but calling our store a sinking
ship... How rude is that？
translations.当たってるところが、また情けないな……。:
The pathetic part is,
she's not entirely wrong...
translations.あーもう！ なんかアイーシャに一泡ふかせらんないかな。:
Man! Isn't there some way
we can knock Aisha down a peg？
translations.うん……引き抜きにくるなんて、完全に見下されてる。:
Yeah... Coming to poach me
means they're totally looking
down on us.
translations.私たちのデキシーズにだっていいところはたくさんあって、ずっとお客様に喜んでもらえ:
Our Dixie's has so many great
things, and I thought our customers
were happy with us...
translations.このまま閉店なんて……くやしい。:
Going out of business like this...
It's so frustrating.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。今度のスイーツフェア、お客さん来るかな。いつもなら、かなり忙しくな:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Do you think customers
will show up for our sweets fair？
Usually we'd be super busy, but...
translations.告知もしっかりしたし。アイーシャはそこまでスイーツに力を入れてるわけじゃないから:
We promoted it thoroughly.
Aisha doesn't focus that much
on sweets, so we'll be fine.
translations.うん、きっと忙しくなるよ。:
Yeah, I'm sure we'll be
plenty busy.
translations.そういえば、アイーシャも同じ時期にスイーツフェアやるんですね～。それ、困らないで:
Come to think of it, Aisha's doing
a sweets fair at the same time~
Won't that be a problem？
translations.昨日アイーシャ行ったら、告知が出てましたよ。メニューもかなり増えるみたいで。:
When I went to Aisha yesterday,
there was an announcement. Looked
like lots of new menu items, too.
translations.まゆ、またアイーシャ行ったの？: Mayu, you went to Aisha again？
translations.いやー、結構気に入っちゃって。:
Well, you know,
I've kinda taken a liking to it.
translations.そのフェアって、こっちの時期を狙ったんじゃ……。:
Do you think they timed their
fair to target ours...？
translations.そんな……考えすぎじゃないかな？:
Come on... Aren't you
overthinking it？
translations.アイーシャのスイーツフェア、今日からみたい。:
Looks like Aisha's sweets fair
starts today.
translations.そっか……ほんと、ウチと丸かぶりだな。:
I see... Wow, it completely
overlaps with ours.
translations.また、お客様とられちゃうね……。:
They're going to take all
our customers again...
translations.あのさ、アイーシャ見に行ってみないか？:
Hey, why don't we go check out
Aisha？
translations.そのフェアってのがどんなもんなのかさ。なにか対策とか、考えられるかもしれないし。:
To see what their fair is like.
We might be able to come up
with some countermeasures.
translations.やっぱり繁盛してんなあ……。ウチとは大違いだ。:
They're really packing them in...
What a difference from our place.
translations.ホント、結構待つみたい……。:
Seriously, looks like
quite a wait...
translations.あ！ あの私たちべつに……。: Ah! Um, we're not here to...
translations.そう、スパイとかそういうんじゃ――:
Right, it's not like
we're spies or anything—
translations.そうそう。お待たせしてごめんなさい。当店のスイーツフェア、ゆっくり楽しんでいって:
Right, right. Sorry to
keep you waiting. Please,
enjoy our sweets fair at
your leisure, okay？
translations.ぎゃふんと言わせてやろうな……。:
We're gonna take her
down a peg...
translations.すごい数のメニューだな……。:
That's a crazy amount
of items on this menu...
translations.これ、アイーシャのフェア以上のメニューが載ってる。:
This has way more items
than Aisha's normal fair.
translations.アイーシャのスイーツフェアについて調べたんだけど、こんなにはなかったはず……ほら:
I looked into Aisha's sweets
fair, but they shouldn't
have had this many... Look,
it says store-exclusive.
translations.こりゃ、ほんとにウチの店へのあてつけなのかも……。:
Man, they really might be
doing this just to spite us...
translations.でも、これだけのメニュー用意するなんて、大丈夫なのかな。:
Still, offering this much,
I wonder if they can manage？
translations.種類を増やせばひとつひとつのコストも増えるし、スタッフも調理を覚えるのが大変よね:
More variety means higher
costs per dish, and the
staff has to learn so
many new recipes, right？
translations.お待たせしました。ご注文のお品です。:
Thank you for waiting.
Here are your orders.
translations.……見た目、けっこう地味だな。なんか見本と違うような……。:
...It looks pretty plain.
Doesn't really match the
picture, does it...？
translations.……ねえ、そっちのケーキも食べていい？:
...Hey, can I have a bite
of your cake, too？
translations.お、じゃあ、そっちのパフェも一口。:
Sure, then give me a bite
of your parfait.
translations.んー、普通……。っていうか、盛り付けが違うだけでよく見たら内容同じだな、これ。:
Hmm, pretty average...
Actually, looking closely,
it's the same ingredients,
just plated differently.
translations.そうね。やっぱりメニューを増やしすぎたのかな、細かいところに手が行き届いてない気:
Right. They probably bloated
the menu too much, so the
attention to detail is
really slipping.
translations.これなら、ウチのスイーツの方がひとつひとつに手間をかけてるよね……。:
In that case, our sweets
definitely have way more
care put into each one...
translations.でも、これだってそこそこ美味いんだから……お客さんはきっと、メニューが豊富なアイ:
Still, this tastes fine too,
so... customers will probably
just go with Aisha for the
huge selection, huh...
translations.スイーツフェア、やっぱりいつもと比べると、お客さん少ないな……。:
Even with the sweets fair,
there're definitely fewer
customers than usual...
translations.そうね……なんとかしないと。:
Yeah...
We have to do something.
translations.うん……盛況みたいだね。すごい種類のメニューがあるって。:
Yeah... Seems like it's
a hit. Heard they've got an
incredible variety.
translations.はい、なので、こちらも店舗オリジナルのメニューを用意して対抗できませんか？:
Right, so couldn't we fight
back by offering our own
exclusive store menu？
translations.でもこのままじゃアイーシャにやられっぱなしです。:
But if we do nothing,
Aisha's just going to walk
all over us!
translations.だけど今からって……許可も出ないだろうし、間に合わないよ。:
Still, starting now...
We wouldn't get approval,
and it'd be too late.
translations.それはやってみないとわかりません。:
We won't know that
unless we try!
translations.いやそれに、もうすぐ閉店するんだし……今さらジタバタしたってしょうがないよ……。:
Besides, we're closing down
soon anyway... There's no point
flailing around this late...
translations.話、それだけ？ じゃあね。: Is that all？ See ya, then.
translations.まだあきらめなくてもいいのに……。:
He doesn't have to give up
already...
translations.またバイトで教えてもらいたいことがあるんだけど、いいかな？:
There's something else I'd like
you to teach me about work,
if that's okay？
translations.いいよ、もちろん。私も相談したいことあったし、また家でやろっか。:
Sure, of course! I had
something I wanted to talk to you
about too, so want to head over
to my place again？
translations.今日はなにをするの？ もう私が知ってることは大体教えたと思うけど。:
So, what are we doing today？
I think I've taught you pretty
much everything I know, though.
translations.細かいことがほとんどなんだけど……あとは最近、他のバイトから質問されることも多く:
It's mostly little details...
Plus, the other part-timers have
been asking me questions lately,
so I figured I'd learn how to
teach people, too.
translations.そっか……そうだね。もう人に仕事教えられるくらい成長したもんね。じゃあ、研修用の:
I see... That's true. You've
grown enough to start teaching
others now. Well, we've got the
training manual, so—
translations.はい、こんなところかな。:
Alright, that should about
cover it.
translations.あれ、お母さん帰ってきたんだ……もうそんな時間。:
Oh, Mom's home...
Is it really that late already？
translations.そっか、じゃあそろそろ●、帰ったほうが――:
Right, then maybe I should
head home soon, ●—
translations.いらっしゃい。今日もバイトのお勉強？:
Hello there!
Studying for work again today？
translations.お邪魔してます。勉強は終わったところです。:
Pardon the intrusion.
We just finished studying.
translations.あらそう。じゃあお茶いれてくるから、お話しましょ。ね？:
Oh, is that so？ Well then, I'll
make some tea so we can chat.
Okay？
translations.このレシピ……一人で全部？:
These recipes...
Did you come up with all of
them on your own？
translations.そう。店長には却下されちゃったけど、具体的にメニューも全部考えて提案すれば、考え:
Yeah. The manager shot me down,
but I thought if I planned out
a concrete menu and pitched it,
he might reconsider.
translations.じゃあ、相談って言ってたのは……。:
So that thing you wanted to
talk over was...
translations.そう。出来ればこれ全部、来週から出せるようにしたいんだけど。:
Right. If possible, I'd like
us to start serving all of
these next week.
translations.でもこれ、ウチの店でできるかな。種類も多いし、凝ったのばっかだよね……。:
Do you think our shop can pull
this off, though？ There's so
many, and they look pretty
elaborate...
translations.実はそうでもないの。手間がかかってるように見えて、手順は簡単なようになってて。:
Actually, not really. They look
labor-intensive, but the steps
are surprisingly simple.
translations.これ、デキシーズのお客様に喜んでもらえる？:
Will this make Dixie's
customers happy？
translations.もちろん……だって実際お客様はメニューが豊富なアイーシャにとられちゃったんだから:
Of course... After all, Aisha
stole our customers away with
their huge menu.
translations.ネネちゃんいつも言ってるよね。デキシーズのスイーツは、お店でひとつひとつ手間をか:
You're always saying it,
Nene-chan. That Dixie's sweets
are made by hand with care in
the shop, and that you're
proud of that.
translations.アイーシャのスイーツ、美味しくなかったって言ってたじゃない。あなた達はそれで嬉し:
Didn't you say Aisha's sweets
weren't even good？ Did that
make you two happy？
translations.ネネちゃんは大好きなデキシーズがアイーシャに負けたと思うのがイヤなのよね。:
You just hate the idea of your
beloved Dixie's losing to Aisha,
don't you, Nene-chan？
translations.じゃあ勝ちって？ 大勢お客様が来て、大して嬉しくもなさそうに食事をすること？:
Then what does 'winning' mean？
Having crowds of customers come
in and eat without looking
remotely happy？
translations.デキシーズをよくしたいなら、デキシーズに来てくれるお客様に喜んでもらえるようなこ:
If you want to make Dixie's
better, you should do what brings
joy to the customers who come.
If you lose doing that, well,
there's no helping it.
translations.（さて、今日も\nアルバイトすっかー！）:
(All right, time for another
shift at work!)
translations.あ、いたいた。\n二人ともちょっと！:
Ah, there you are.
You two, got a second？
translations.前に言ってた\nオリジナルメニューを増やす件、\nやっぱり却下されたよ。:
About expanding the original
menu like we talked about...
It got rejected after all.
translations.あ……本部に\n申請してくれたんですか？:
Oh... You submitted a request
to headquarters for us？
translations.まあ、一応ね……\n僕だってアイーシャに\nひとつでも仕返しできるなら、\nやっ:
Well, sort of...
I figured if there was even
one way to get back at Aisha,
I'd give it a shot.
Didn't work out, though...
translations.ありがとうございます、\n店長……。でも、ごめんなさい。\n実は、他に試してみた:
Thank you so much,
Manager... But I'm sorry.
There's actually something else
I'd like to try.
translations.お母さんに言われてから\nずっと考えてたの。\nわたし達に出来る精一杯の\nこと:
I've been thinking ever since
Mom said that to me.
Wondering what the absolute
best we can do really is.
translations.精一杯のこと、か……。: The best we can do, huh...
translations.うん。それはやっぱり、今でも\nデキシーズのスイーツフェアを\n楽しみにしてくれ:
Yeah. I think it comes down
to making the customers who
still look forward to Dixie's
dessert fair even happier.
translations.なるほど……うちのお客は、\n手間をかけたスイーツが好きで\n来てくれてるわけだ:
I see... Our customers come
here because they love our
handcrafted desserts, right？
So then...
translations.そう。種類は少なくても、\nもっと手間をかけて美味しく、\nその代わり全スタッフ:
Right. Even with fewer
options, we can put more care
into making them delicious,
tweaking the recipes so all
our staff can learn the steps.
So right up to our last day,
people will be glad they
came to Dixie's.
translations.そうか……うん、\nアイーシャができてからも、\nずっとウチに来てくれるお客様も:
I see... Yeah, even after
Aisha opened, we still have
regulars coming back...
translations.なるほど……。\nうん、わかった……\n僕は許可を出すことしか\nできないけど、:
I see...
Yeah, all right...
All I can do is give you the
green light, but give it your all.
translations.さて、それじゃあ、\nはじめよっか。:
All right then,
shall we get started？
translations.えっと、店長から\n姉ヶ崎さんたちが、スイーツの\nレシピの改良をするって聞いて:
Um, the manager told us that
you and Anegasaki-san were
reworking the recipes...
so I wondered if there's
anything I could do to help.
translations.それで来てくれたの？ \nありがとう！:
That's why you came？
Thank you!
translations.ああ、いえ、\n最初に言い出したのは、\nまゆなんです。:
Oh, no... Mayu was the one
who suggested it first.
translations.だって、\n寧々さんはもちろんだけど、\n最近はアンタにも\n結構お世話になって:
Well, obviously Nene-san,
but you've been helping me
out a lot lately, too.
I'd hate for us to close down
without me even getting to
thank you properly...
translations.（自分に出来ることを精一杯、\nそれでお客が喜べばいい。\nうん……）:
(Do our absolute best with
what we can do, and make our
customers happy. Yeah...)
translations.（レシピを改良してから\n少し経ったけど、\nわかってもらえたのかな……）:
(It's been a little while
since we reworked the recipes.
I wonder if people noticed...)
translations.（すごい、\nお客さん増えてる……）:
(Incredible...
There are so many more
customers...)
translations.今日は、忙しくなるね。:
Looks like we're gonna
be busy today.
translations.ごきげんよう、姉ヶ崎さん。\nスイーツフェア、\n盛況みたいね？:
Good day, Anegasaki-san.
The dessert fair seems to be
quite a hit, doesn't it？
translations.はい、お客様にも\nご好評いただいています。:
Yes, our customers have
really been enjoying it.
translations.そう、それはよかったわね？:
Is that so？
How nice for you.
translations.あの、お席にご案内します。\nこちらへどうぞ。:
Let me show you to a table.
Right this way, please.
translations.結構よ、もう帰るから。\nねぇ、姉ヶ崎さん？:
No need, I'm leaving already.
Tell me, Anegasaki-san？
translations.メニューの豊富さも価格も\n全て勝っているのに\n客を取られるとしたら、\nどう:
If our menu and prices
beat yours in every way,
yet you're taking our customers,
what do you think we should do？
translations.あの……私には、難しいことは\nわかりません。精一杯、\nお客様に喜んでもらえる:
Um... I don't really get
complicated things like that.
All I do is try my hardest
to make our customers happy.
translations.ハァ……もういいわ。\nロジックが通用しない相手とは\nケンカしないことにしてる:
Haah... whatever.
I make it a rule not to fight
with people who don't use logic.
See ya. Best of luck trying
to get by on pure sincerity.
You too, over there...
what's-your-name.
translations.お、いたいた。ちょっといい？:
Oh, there you are.
Got a second？
translations.後で話があるから、いい？:
I've got something to talk to you
about later, okay？
translations.ああ、待って。いい話だよ？: Oh, wait. It's good news, okay？
translations.うん、話っていうのは君たち二人になんだ。:
Yeah, what I want to talk about
is for the two of you.
translations.この前の、スイーツフェアの件、ありがとう。感謝してる。:
Thanks for all your help with the
sweets fair the other day.
I really appreciate it.
translations.いえ、あれは▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が……な？:
Oh no, that was all ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
right？
translations.ううん、あなたが――: No, you were the one who—
translations.んっ、まあ君たち二人のおかげだ。:
Haha, well, it's thanks to both
of you.
translations.閉店するのは残念だけど……最後に一矢報いることができたって感じだよ。僕も気分がス:
It's a shame we're closing down...
but it felt like we got in
one last good strike.
It really lifted my spirits.
translations.まあ、これはどちらかというと、僕個人からのお礼かな。もう一つはちゃんとした話。:
Well, that was more of a personal
thank-you from me.
The other thing's official business.
translations.君の選抜入り、認められたよ。ここの閉店後も、十羽野店で働ける。:
You made the cut.
Even after we close down here,
you'll get to work at Towano.
translations.フェアの件もそうだし、最近は他のバイトに仕事教えてくれてるし……これならってダメ:
Between the sweets fair and how
you've been training the others...
I figured it was worth a shot, so
I recommended you. And it passed.
translations.うん。まあ、そういうわけだから。細かい書類とかは、また後で。じゃあ。:
Yeah. So anyway, that's the news.
We'll do the paperwork later.
See ya.
translations.ありがとう、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のおかげだよ。:
Thank you. It's all thanks to you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ううん、そうじゃない、あなたが……よかったあ……。:
No, that's not it, you did it...
Oh, I'm just so happy...
translations.（やった……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もこんなに喜んでくれてる……）:
（Yes...! ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is so happy
for me...）
translations.そう。選抜入りのお祝い。よくがんばってたもん。:
Yeah. To celebrate you making the
cut. You worked so hard, after all.
translations.うん……じゃあ、そうね。二人がまた一緒に働けるお祝い、かな。:
Mm... well, yeah. A celebration
that we get to work together
again, maybe.
translations.前にもこんなことあったな、バイトでのお祝い。一人前になったから、って。:
We celebrated like this before,
didn't we？ For work, when I finally
learned the ropes.
translations.うん……出会ってすぐの頃。覚えててくれたんだ。:
Yeah... right after we met.
I'm so glad you remembered.
translations.そっかそっか……ふふ。ねえ、今度は私の家でのお祝いにしない？:
Right, right... Hehe.
Hey, why don't we celebrate
at my place this time？
translations.家で？ いいの？: At your place？ Are you sure？
translations.腕によりをかけてご馳走するから、期待してて？:
I'll pull out all the stops
and make a feast,
so look forward to it, okay？
translations.頑張ってくれたのは、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もだろ？:
You worked really hard too,
didn't you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.お母さん！もう、はしゃがないの。子供じゃないんだから。:
Mom! Geez, don't get so
worked up. You're not a child.
translations.いいじゃない、ねえ？ はい、あがってあがって？:
Oh, what's the harm？
Come in, come on in!
translations.もういいの？ こっちのお肉、もう少しどう？:
All done already？
How about a little more
of this meat？
translations.なぁに、お母さん。さっきからニヤニヤして……。:
What is it, Mom？
You've been grinning
this whole time...
translations.ねぇ、知ってる？ ネネちゃんって、小さい頃ホントに男の子みたいだったのよ？ おま:
Did you know？ When Nene was
little, she was such a tomboy.
Even when I tried to teach
her to play house, she had
zero interest.
translations.いいの、知らなくて。: You don't need to know that.
translations.ふふ、それが今じゃ、“お肉どう？”だって。もう、お母さん心配して損しちゃった。:
Hehe, and now look at her:
"How about more meat？"
All that worrying Mom did was
for nothing!
translations.お母さん、最近、昔話ふえてない？ もう歳かもよ？:
Mom, haven't you been reminiscing
a lot lately？
Maybe you're getting old？
translations.そうよ？ じきにおばあちゃんだもん。孫とおままごとしたいなぁ……ね？:
Of course I am! I'll be a grandma
soon enough. I'd love to play
house with my grandkids... right？
translations.お粗末さまでした。ごめんね、お母さんが。:
You're very welcome.
Sorry about Mom.
translations.本当。なんか、気に入ってもらえたみたいだしさ？:
Really. Plus, it seemed like
she took a liking to me, you know？
translations.うん……その点はバッチリ、かな。:
Yeah... You definitely passed
with flying colors there.
translations.そっか……あ、ここまででいいよ。今度はそっちの帰りが心配になるし。:
I see... Oh, you can stop here.
Otherwise I'll worry about you
walking back alone.
translations.ありがとう、お母さんも好きになってくれて……。: Thanks for liking my mom, too...
translations.あ、店長。今日もよろしくお願いします！:
Oh, Manager! Ready for another
good shift today!
translations.ああ……うん、よろしく。: Ah... Yeah, good to have you.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。今日もがんばろうな！:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Let's do our best
today, too!
translations.なに？ 張り切ってるね。:
What's this？ You're really
fired up today.
translations.選抜入りの話聞いてから、ますます仕事が楽しくってさ！:
Ever since I made the cut,
work's been even more fun!
translations.もう、はしゃぎすぎて、ミスしないでね。:
Geez, just don't get so excited
that you make a mistake.
translations.（よーし、仕事終了！ 帰るか）:
(Alright, shift's over!
Time to head home.)
translations.ああ、悪いんだけど、ちょっといい？:
Ah, sorry, but do you have
a minute？
translations.えっと……ごめん。君の選抜入り、白紙になったんだ……。:
Um... sorry. Your spot on
the selection team...
it got scrapped.
translations.突然、とわの坂上支店から十羽野店にアルバイトが一人、異動することになって……。:
Out of nowhere, another
part-timer is transferring
from the Towanosakagami
branch to the Towano store...
translations.そんなの、突っぱねてくださいよ！:
Can't you just push
back on that!?
translations.ごめん、僕の権限じゃどうにもならなくて……僕をうらまないでくれよ。:
Sorry, it's out of my
hands... Please don't hold
it against me.
translations.（どうしよう、せっかくまた▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と働けることになったのに……）:
(What do I do? We were
finally going to get to
work with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ again...)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。もう、上がれるんでしょ？ 一緒に帰ろ？:
▲主人公＊▲. You can clock out
now, right？ Want to walk
home together？
translations.（選抜入りがダメになったこと、言わないと……）:
(I have to tell her
making the selection team
fell through...)
translations.●の選抜入りの話……なしに、なったって……店長が。:
The manager said...
about ●'s spot on the
team... it's been called off.
translations.本部の判断で、決まったことらしい。店長じゃどうにもならないって。:
Apparently corporate
made the call. The manager
said it's out of his hands.
translations.（さて、今日もアルバイト。正直、つらいけど……）:
(Well, time for work.
Honestly, it's rough, but...)
translations.（自分に出来ることを精一杯、だよな……よし、がんばろう！）:
(I just have to do my best
with what I can...
Alright, let's do this!)
translations.私……十羽野店に行くの、やめる。:
I'm... not going to the
Towano store after all.
translations.やっぱり、今よりあなたと遠くなるのはイヤ……そんなの我慢できないもん。:
I just don't want us to be
any farther apart...
I couldn't bear that.
translations.でもさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だって色いろ考えて受けることにしたんだろ？ それなのに――:
But ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you thought
about it so much before
accepting, right？ And yet—
translations.そんなこと、わかってる。何度も考えた……。:
I know that.
I thought about it
over and over...
translations.平気！ もう、アタマ切り替えたから。うん……じゃあ、先に戻るね？:
I'm fine! I've already
switched gears. Okay...
I'm heading back, alright？
translations.ほら、元気ないぞ？ \n最後の一日まで笑顔でいこう？:
Come on, why the long face？
Let's keep smiling until
our last day, okay？
translations.ああ、その話だけど\nやっぱり――:
Yeah, but about that,
I really think—
translations.いいの、もう。\nさぁ、今日も一日がんばろう！:
It's fine, really.
Now come on, let's do our
best today, too!
translations.今日、寧々も\nバイトだったと思うけど……\n一緒じゃないの？:
I thought Nene worked
today too...
Aren't you two together？
translations.ごめんね。急に。:
Sorry to stop you
out of the blue like this.
translations.選抜の話、ダメに\nなっちゃったんだってね。:
I heard that selection thing
fell through.
translations.もう……\nそんなに大したこと？:
Good grief... is it really
that big of a deal？
translations.でも、●のせいで\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲まで……。:
But it's ●'s fault
that ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ had to...
translations.あの子ね、昔からそうなの。\nなんでも引き受けて、\n我慢して我慢して、\n最後:
She's been that way
ever since she was little.
Takes on everything,
bottles it all up,
and completely wears
herself out in the end.
Then she hides and cries
all alone until I find her.
She's so stubborn, really...
translations.でもね、きっともう、\n隠れて泣いてるあの子を\n見つけてあげるのは\n私の役目:
But you know, I don't think
finding her when she's
hiding and crying
is my job anymore.
translations.……誰の役目か、わかる？:
...Do you know whose
job it is？
translations.よし……やっぱり\nあなた、いい子ね。さすが、\nしっかり者のネネちゃんが\n好:
Good... You really are
a great kid. No wonder
my sensible Nene
fell for you.
translations.いい子よ。寧々も本当にいい子\n……親馬鹿だと思うだろうけど、\n本当よ？ だか:
You are. And Nene's
such a good girl too...
Call me a doting mom,
but it's true, you know？
Things might get tough
sometimes, but please keep
looking out for each other, okay？
translations.（●の役目か……\nちゃんと果たさなきゃな。）:
(●'s job, huh...
I need to step up
and do it right.)
translations.なぁに？ ……恐い顔して、どうかした？:
What is it？ ...Why such
a scary face, did something
happen？
translations.もう……言ったでしょ？ 決めたの。わたし平気よ？:
Come on... I already told
you, didn't I？ I've decided.
I'm fine, really.
translations.どうしたの？ 今日のあなたちょっと強引みたい。:
What's gotten into you？
You're being kind of pushy
today.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はさ、やっぱり十羽野店に行かなきゃダメだよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you really need
to go to the Towano store.
translations.二人の時間なら、●がなんとかする。バイト先が違っても近くのコンビニとかさ、少しで:
As for time together,
● will make it work.
Even with different jobs,
we can meet by the convenience
store, just so we can be
together as much as possible.
translations.学校でもたくさん会いに行くし、デートももっとたくさんしよう？:
I'll come see you at school
all the time, and we can go
on way more dates, okay？
translations.ありがとう……でもね、やっぱり私が――:
Thank you... But really,
I should be the one—
translations.●、年下だし頼りないかもしれないけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を泣かせないようにするのが、●:
● might be younger
and not that reliable,
but making sure ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
doesn't cry is
●'s job, I think...
translations.好き……大好き。: I love you... I really love you.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。今日は、少し忙しいね。:
▲主人公＊▲. It's a little busy
today, isn't it？
translations.ああ、なんだかお客さんが戻ってきた気がするんだけど……。:
Yeah, feels like the customers
are finally coming back...
translations.そうね。スイーツフェアの件もそうだし。あとね、最近お客様の意見を聞くと、従業員の:
Yeah. The sweets fair
is part of it. Plus, customer
feedback on the staff has
been really good lately.
translations.あなた一人ががんばっただけじゃなくて、あなたがまゆちゃんやのどちゃんを助けてあげ:
It's not just that you've
been working hard, either.
I think it's also because
you help out Mayu-chan
and Nodo-chan.
translations.ううん、おかげでずいぶん働きやすくなったもん。あなたに余裕ができれば周りにも余裕:
No really, you've made
working here so much easier.
When you're at ease,
it puts everyone around you
at ease, and that spreads.
translations.自覚ない？ ならいいよ、それでも。私は認めちゃうから。:
No clue？ That's fine then. 
I give you all the credit 
anyway.
translations.今日もアツアツだねぇ～、お仕事の方もビシッと頼むよっ！ ハハハッ！:
All lovey-dovey today, eh？ 
Put that same fire into work, 
all right？ Hahaha!
translations.なんだか、ずいぶんご機嫌ですね……。:
You're in a surprisingly 
good mood today...
translations.言いたかないですけど、浮かれてる場合じゃないんじゃないですか？:
Hate to burst your bubble, 
but is this really the time 
to be celebrating？
translations.えっ？ ああ、閉店のこと？ あれ、無くなったから！:
Huh？ Oh, the store closing？ 
Yeah, that's cancelled!
translations.そりゃそうさ！ お客さんもしっかり戻ってきたし、アイーシャもさすがに前ほどの勢い:
Damn right! The customers 
are back, and Aisha's finally 
losing steam! Corporate even 
wants us as a model case!
translations.そういうわけだから、これからもよろしく！:
So that's the deal! 
Keep up the good work!
translations.え、え～？ 寧々くん、なんで怒ってんの？:
H-Huh？ Nene-kun, 
why are you mad at me？
translations.（でもこれで、またこの店で▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と働けるんだな！）:
(Still, this means I get to 
keep working here with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!)
translations.もう店長っ、どうしていつもバタバタになっちゃうんですか！:
Honestly, Boss! Why does it 
always end up such a scramble？
translations.だ、だって、急に決まったことだし！:
B-But it was all decided 
at the last minute!
translations.まゆは新しい制服着れてラッキーだけど。:
Mayu's just happy she gets 
to wear a new uniform, though.
translations.まあね。それにしても、閉店間際だったこの店が、リニューアルのテストケースに選ばれ:
True. Still, crazy that 
a store about to close got 
picked as the renewal model.
translations.世の中どうなるか、わかんないねー。:
You really never know 
how things will turn out.
translations.まゆちゃん、のどちゃん！ ほら、ちゃんと開店準備！ お客様並んでるんだから。:
Mayu-chan, Nodo-chan! 
Finish up opening prep, okay？ 
There's a line outside!
translations.もう……なぁに？ 似合わない？\nこの制服。:
Geez... What is it？ 
Does it not look good on me？ 
This uniform.
translations.まさか！ よく似合ってるし新鮮だし……女子制服のリニューアル、成功だな！:
No way! It looks great, 
and super fresh too... 
The new uniforms are a hit!
translations.えぇと……制服が新しくなったからついでに髪もリニューアルしてみました♪ おかしく:
Um... with the new uniforms, 
I gave my hair a renewal too♪ 
Does it look weird？
translations.ぜんぜんっ！ 新しい制服にも合ってるし新鮮だし……。女子制服のリニューアル、成功:
Not at all! Fits the uniform,
