feels totally fresh... 
The girls' update is a hit!
translations.まゆ達も一応、新制服なんですけどー。:
Um, we're wearing the new 
uniforms too, you know~
translations.どう思います、この公衆イチャつきカップル。こういうの困るんですけど～。:
What's with this PDA couple？ 
Flirting like that in public 
really cramps our style~
translations.よくないですねー、職場の風紀を乱しますよね。:
Not good at all. 
Completely ruins workplace 
discipline, honestly.
translations.やだ、違うのっ！ もう……。:
No, that's not it at all! 
Geez...
translations.ほら、店開けるよ！: All right, time to open up!
translations.（やべえ、むちゃくちゃ忙しい……リニューアルセールだからって、太っ腹過ぎたんじゃ:
(Crap, we're crazy busy...
I know it's a renewal sale,
but maybe we went too big？)
translations.いらっしゃいませ。ただ今、店長を呼びますので。:
Welcome. I'll go get
the store manager
right away.
translations.あなたに用があるの、姉ヶ崎さん。:
It's you I'm here to see,
Anegasaki-san.
translations.単刀直入に言うわ。うちの店が、あなたを今の倍のお給料で雇いたいって言ったら、どう:
I'll cut to the chase.
What would you say if my
store offered to hire you
for double your current pay？
translations.きっと、お断りすると思います。この店のお客様と、わたしの大切な人のために、精一杯:
I'd definitely turn it down.
Because I want to do my
absolute best for the
customers here, and for
the person I cherish most.
translations.ハァ……ふられちゃった。それじゃ、帰るわ。さようなら、姉ヶ崎さんと、えぇと……。:
*sigh* Rejected.
Well then, I'll be going.
Goodbye, Anegasaki-san,
and, uh...
translations.そうそう。せいぜい君はふられないようにね？:
Right, right. Make sure
you don't get dumped, okay？
translations.最後まで名前覚えてもらえなかった……でも、槍沢マネージャーってやっぱりただ者じゃ:
She never did learn my
name... But that Manager
Yarisawa is definitely
something else, huh？
translations.うん……うちも、もっともっと頑張らないとね！:
Yeah... We've got to work
even harder ourselves!
translations.あ、新しい制服、カワイイ！:
Oh, the new uniforms
are so cute!
translations.リニューアルだっていうから、見に来ちゃった。仲良くやってる？:
I heard about the remodel,
so I came to see.
Getting along well？
translations.え、姉ヶ崎さんのお母さん？ あ、似てる……。:
Wait, Anegasaki-san's mom？
Ah, they really do look
alike...
translations.ちょっとそれより、公認だよ公認、親公認！ キャー！:
Wait, more importantly,
it's official! Approved by
the parents! Eeek!
translations.いやー、とぼけたカレシだと思ってたら、抜け目ないね～。:
Man, I thought he was just
a clueless boyfriend, but
he doesn't miss a beat~
translations.お客様、申し訳ございません。ただいま混雑しておりますので、しばらくお待ちいただく:
We're so sorry, but we're
quite crowded right now,
so there will be a bit of
a wait.
translations.ほら、あなたたちはちゃんと仕事！:
Come on, you two,
get back to work!
translations.ハァ……ようやく午後のピークが終わった……。:
*phew* The afternoon rush
is finally over...
translations.うん……すぐまたディナータイムだけどね……。:
Yeah... Though the dinner
rush will start before
we know it...
translations.自分たちががんばったからお店が生き残れた、なんて、全部がそうじゃないことはわかっ:
I know it's not like the
shop survived entirely
because we worked hard, but...
translations.それでも、少しは役に立てたと思う。:
Still, I feel like we were
able to help a little.
translations.私たちがやってきたことが、なにかの役に立って……。それが色んな人に認められて……:
Everything we did
actually helped...
And so many people
recognized that...
It makes me really happy.
translations.そうだな。仕事って一生懸命やると、楽しいんだな。:
Yeah. When you give work
your all, it really is fun.
translations.それになにより、また一緒にこの店で働ける。あなたと出会った、この場所で。:
And best of all, we get to
keep working here together.
Right where I met you.
translations.ああ……●たちの思い出の場所で。:
Yeah... In the place full
of memories for ●
and you.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。リニューアル効果もそろそろおしまいみたいだな。アイーシャが出来る前:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Looks like the rush
from the remodel is over.
Feels like before Aisha
opened, huh？
translations.うん、それもそうなんだけど、私が気になるのはみんなの働きぶりが――いけない。:
Yeah, that's true, but what
bothers me is how everyone's
working—wait, oh no.
translations.ねえ……今入ってきたおじいさん。:
Hey... That elderly man
who just walked in...
translations.ん？ あ、本部の！:
Hm？ Oh, that's the guy
from headquarters!
translations.ちょっとまゆ、なにやって――きゃっ！:
Wait, Mayu, what are you—
kyaah!
translations.寧々くーん。僕、胃が痛いんだけど……早退していい？:
Nene-kun... My stomach is
killing me. Can I head home
early？
translations.（この店、ずっとこの調子のまま続くといいな……）:
(I hope this place stays
like this forever...)
translations.参考までに聞かせてほしいんだけど。:
Just for future reference,
can I ask you something？
translations.朝食はパンとごはん、どっちが好き？:
For breakfast, do you
prefer bread or rice？
translations.そうなんだ。作り甲斐があるなぁ。:
Is that so？ That really
makes it worth cooking.
translations.え、もしかして朝ごはん作ってくれるの？:
Wait, are you gonna
make me breakfast？
translations.じゃあ、朝に焼きたてのパンをふるまっちゃおうかな？:
Then maybe I'll treat you
to freshly baked bread
in the morning？
translations.朝はごはんかな。: Rice in the morning, I think.
translations.あれ、パンは飽きちゃった？:
Huh, did you get
tired of bread？
translations.今はね。パンって感じ。:
Right now, yeah.
I'm feeling bread.
translations.そっか……ご飯炊かなくていい分、他のものに手間をかけられるかな。:
I see... Well, if I don't
have to cook rice, I can
spend more time on the rest.
translations.あなたの食事の好み、教えてくれる？ 和食とか、洋食とか、中華とか。:
Could you tell me what you
like to eat？ Japanese,
Western, Chinese...？
translations.和食、ね。うん、ヘルシーだしおいしいもんね。:
Japanese, huh？ Yeah, it's
healthy and delicious.
translations.そうですか。よりにもよって、和食ですか。:
Is that so？ Out of all
things, Japanese food？
translations.なんでもないよ。んー、修行しなくちゃ……。:
It's nothing. Mmh, I'll
have to train hard...
translations.好物が多いのは洋食かな。:
Most of my favorites
are Western food, I think.
translations.洋食が好きだな、どっちかというと。:
I prefer Western food,
if I had to choose.
translations.そうなんだ？ 洋食は苦手だな……。:
Really？ Western food's
not my strong suit...
translations.えっと……じゃあ、和食でも中華でも！:
Uh... then Japanese
or Chinese is fine, too!
translations.ごめん、気にしないで。大丈夫、練習するから。:
Sorry, don't worry about it.
It's fine, I'll practice.
translations.んー、中華料理が好きだな。:
Hmm, I think I like 
Chinese food best.
translations.よしよし、中華ね。だったら任せて。:
Alright, Chinese, then.
Leave that to me!
translations.ううん、好きだよ。……食べるのはね。:
No, I like it.
...Eating it, at least.
translations.好きなジャンルは、もっと別のなんだよね……。:
What I really like is
something a bit different...
translations.変わった料理が好きなのかな？ うん、色々考えるの楽しそう。:
Do you like unusual food？
Yeah, thinking up recipes
could be fun!
translations.●が好きなのは、今の中にはなかったな……もっと違う感じ。:
What ● likes wasn't
on that list...
It's a bit different.
translations.となると……ちょっとイメージしにくそう。:
If that's the case...
it might be a bit hard
to picture.
translations.まあ、深く考えてないかな。:
Well, I haven't really
thought that deeply about it.
translations.でも考えなきゃ、作れないしな……。:
Still, if I don't think of one,
she can't make it...
translations.最近好きな食べ物、ひとつだけ言ってみて。何が好き？:
Tell me just one food you've
been liking lately. What is it？
translations.なるほど。じゃあ、それもレパートリーに入れておかないとね。:
I see. Then I'd better add
that to my repertoire, too.
translations.やった！ 期待してるから。:
Sweet! I'm really looking
forward to it.
translations.そんなに好きなんだ。こだわりがあるのかな？:
You really like it that much？
Are you picky about it？
translations.そういうわけじゃないけど、特に変わってないからさ。:
It's not that, it's just that
my tastes haven't changed.
translations.前は違う答えだったよね。そっちも好きになったの？:
Didn't you answer differently
before？ Did you end up liking
that one too？
translations.まあね、今はこっちが好きかな。:
Yeah, I guess I prefer
this one right now.
translations.ねえ、ちょっと変わったこと聞くんだけど、女の子の靴下の長さに好みってあるかな？:
Hey, random question...
Do you have a preference for
how long a girl's socks are？
translations.似合ってればいい: As long as it looks good
translations.短めにしてみたら？ 活発な感じが出ていいんじゃない？:
Why not try shorter ones？
It gives off an energetic vibe,
don't you think？
translations.ふーん、そういうのが好きなんだ？ そっか。:
Hmm, you like that kind？
I see.
translations.まあ普通の長さがいいんじゃない？:
Well, normal length seems
best, don't you think？
translations.そうね。おかしな感じにはならないだろうし。:
True. That way it won't look
weird, at least.
translations.長いのがいいかも。なんとなく。:
Maybe long ones.
Just kind of a hunch.
translations.そうね。いろいろ凝った感じのものも多いし、楽しそう。:
Right. There are lots of fancy
designs, so that could be fun.
translations.服と合わせて、似合ってるのがいいんじゃない？:
Whatever matches your outfit
and looks good on you seems best,
don't you think？
translations.お願いがあるの。もし私に言いたいことがあったら、正直に言って。:
I have a favor to ask.
If you have something to tell me,
please just say it honestly.
translations.私、ケンカしたときに色々言ったでしょ？ だから……。:
I said a lot of things when we
fought, didn't I？ So...
translations.気にしてないって: I told you, I don't mind
translations.ねえ、正直に言ってくれてもいいんだよ？:
Hey, you can be honest
with me, you know？
translations.ケンカしたときにきついこと言ったと思うから……。:
I know I said some harsh things
when we fought, so...
translations.あれで良かったと思う: I think it was for the best
translations.私ね……反省してる。:
I've been...
really feeling bad about it.
translations.この前のケンカで、嫌な思いをさせちゃったから。:
Because I made you feel awful
during our fight the other day.
translations.むしろ嫌じゃない: I didn't mind it at all
translations.いいじゃん、ケンカ。: Fights aren't all bad, you know.
translations.えっ!? いいって……。:
Huh!? What do you mean,
not bad...？
translations.あとで仲直りできればそれでいいしさ。ケンカできる関係って、やっぱいいって思うし。:
As long as we make up afterwards,
that's what counts.
Being close enough to fight
is a good thing, really.
translations.そうなんだ……。そんな風に思ってくれてたんだ。うん……。:
I see...
You really felt that way about it？
Yeah...
translations.あれで良かったと思うけど？: I think it was for the best, though？
translations.そう。おたがい本音が言えてさ、距離が縮まった感じ、するじゃん。:
Yeah. We both spoke our minds,
and it feels like it brought us
closer together, don't you think？
translations.やっぱり……そうなのかな。あまりしょっちゅうはイヤだけどね。:
I guess... maybe you're right.
Though I wouldn't want it
happening too often, okay？
translations.むしろ嫌じゃないよ。だから反省しなくていいって。:
I didn't mind it at all, really.
So you don't need to feel bad.
translations.だって……そんなわけにはいかないよ。:
But...
I can't just let it go like that.
translations.ケンカするのは嫌だって二人ともわかったんだからさ、それでいいじゃん。:
We both learned that we hate
fighting with each other,
so that's enough, isn't it？
translations.……もう、気取っちゃって。優しいなあ、私のカレシは。:
...Look at you, acting all cool.
My boyfriend really is so sweet.
translations.気にしてないから、いいよ。: I'm not bothered, so it's fine.
translations.それだけ。●はなにも怒ってないよ。:
That's all. I'm not mad
at ● at all.
translations.……優しいね、本当に。これからも、よろしくね。:
...You really are so sweet.
Let's keep being good together,
okay？
translations.まったく気にしてないってことは……ないんじゃない？:
Not minding at all...
That can't be true, can it？
translations.ほんとだって。だから▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ももう気にするなよ。:
I mean it. So don't worry about it
anymore either, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.……わかった、そう言ってくれるなら、そうする。ありがとう。:
...Okay. If you say so,
I'll take your word for it.
Thank you.
translations.もういいよ。お互い充分反省したと思うし。:
It's fine now. I think we've both
learned our lesson anyway.
translations.ああ。●、気にしてないし。だからさ、これからもよろしく。:
Yeah. I really don't mind, ●.
So let's keep taking good care
of each other, okay？
translations.……はい、喜んで。これからもよろしくね。:
...Gladly!
Let's keep taking good care
of each other, okay？
translations.実は、ちょっとだけ辛かったんだ。:
Truth is, it was a little rough
on me.
translations.……うん、そうだよね。ありがとう、言ってくれて。:
...Yeah, of course it did.
Thank you for telling me.
translations.ただ、傷つけあってもしょうがないし、さ……。:
Still, there's no point
in hurting each other, so...
translations.そう……ありがとう。私、もっと優しくなるから……。:
I see... Thank you.
I'll be gentler with you,
I promise...
translations.そりゃ、ちょっとは傷ついたけどさ。:
Well, it did hurt a bit,
sure, but...
translations.だからって、蒸し返しても意味ないって。付き合ってれば、そういうこともあるよ。:
But bringing it up again
won't help. Things like this
happen when you're dating.
translations.ポジティブなんだ。うん、よろしい。じゃあ、もう聞かない。:
Look at you being positive.
Mm, good boy. Then I won't
ask about it anymore.
translations.あのときはたしかに嫌な思いしたけどさ……。:
I definitely felt awful
back then, sure, but...
translations.もういいよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だって嫌な思いしたんだから、おあいこみたいなもんだろ？:
It's fine now. You felt bad
too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, so that makes
us pretty much even, right？
translations.……わかった。このことはもう言わないね。元気出さなきゃ。:
...All right. I won't say
another word about this.
Time to cheer up！
translations.聞いておきたいことがあるんだけど。:
There's something I've been
meaning to ask you.
translations.やっぱり……カレシとしては、カノジョの手料理はおいしいほうがいいよね？:
I mean... As a boyfriend,
you'd want your girlfriend's
cooking to be good, right？
translations.そりゃ上手なほうがうれしいよ。おいしいもの食べるの、好きだし。:
Well, I'd definitely be
happier if it's good.
I love eating tasty food.
translations.だよね？ じゃあ、これからはもっとがんばるね。:
Right？ In that case,
I'll try even harder
from now on.
translations.まあ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理ならなんでもおいしく食べる自信はあるけど。:
Though I'm confident I'd
enjoy anything you cook,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.大丈夫、心からおいしいって思える料理を作ってあげるから。:
Don't worry, I'll make you
food you can honestly say
is delicious.
translations.●、カノジョの手料理が食べられるってだけで十分幸せだからさ。贅沢言ったら申し訳な:
●, just getting to eat
my girlfriend's cooking is
plenty. I'd feel bad asking
for anything more！
translations.……ありがとう。そう言ってもらえるとうれしいな。:
...Thank you. Hearing you
say that makes me really
happy.
translations.下手でもいいんじゃない？:
Even if it's bad, wouldn't
that be fine？
translations.●がうれしいのは、料理が上手とか下手とかじゃなくて、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が料理を作ってく:
What makes ● happy
isn't whether the cooking is
good or bad, but that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is making it for me.
translations.……そんなこと言われると、なんだかくすぐったいなぁ。:
...Hearing you say that
makes me feel all ticklish.
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ 何やってんの？:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
What are you doing here？
translations.私はお散歩。あなたは？:
I'm out for a walk.
What about you？
translations.●も、なんとなく。:
● was just wandering
around too, kind of.
translations.噴水の前で出会う二人……なんだかいいね。:
Two people meeting by
a fountain... There's
something nice about that.
translations.そんなにびっくりして……私に会うとまずかったとか？:
You look so surprised...
Was running into me
a bad thing？
translations.そんなことないよ。ちょうど▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと考えてたからさ。:
Not at all! I was just
thinking about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そういえば、外国にそんな噴水の話あったような。:
Come to think of it, I think
there's a story like that
about a fountain abroad.
translations.へえ。じゃあ、恋人達が出会うシチュエーションとしては、最適ってことか。:
Huh. So that makes it the
ideal spot for lovers
to meet, then？
translations.そうね。うん、最高のシチュエーション。:
That's right. Mm, the
absolute best setting.
translations.ほんと。どう、一緒に散歩でも。:
Really. Want to go for
a walk together？
translations.もちろん！ って言いたいんだけど、友だちと買い物中で。:
I'd love to! ...Is what I'd
like to say, but I'm out
shopping with a friend.
translations.そっか、じゃあしょうがないか。:
I see. Can't be helped,
then.
translations.あれ、あなたも観たの！: Oh, did you see it too!？
translations.ううん、●はこれから。:
Nah, ● was just about
to watch it.
translations.そっか。面白かったよー、あらすじしゃべっちゃいたいくらい！:
I see. It was so good,
I almost want to spoil
the whole plot!
translations.ふふ、ウソ。楽しんできてね。:
Hehe, just kidding.
Have fun watching it!
translations.私のオススメは、こっちかな。:
My recommendation would
be this one, I think.
translations.えらいえらい。ちゃんと声だけで気づいてくれたね。:
Good boy. You recognized me
just from my voice, huh？
translations.そりゃわかるよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も今から？:
Of course I would.
Are you about to watch
something too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ううん。残念だけど、もう観ちゃったの。:
Nope. Sadly, I already
watched mine.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、後で感想話そうよ。:
I see. Then let's talk
about it afterwards!
translations.えっ？ ……はは。そんな勢いよく返事されると思わなかった。:
Huh？ ...Haha. I didn't
expect such an energetic
reply.
translations.こら、もう。感動の余韻に浸ってたから、びっくりしちゃったんだもん。:
Hey, stop that! I was still
basking in the emotion,
so you startled me!
translations.へー、そんなに面白かったなら、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が観たのを観ようかな。:
Huh. If it was that good,
maybe I'll go see what
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ just watched.
translations.あなたと一緒じゃ、楽しくて、遊んじゃいそうでしょ？ それじゃダイエットにならない:
If I'm with you, it'd be
too fun and we'd goof off.
That won't help my diet!
translations.▲主人公＊▲。うん。たまには体を動かさないとね。:
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah. Gotta move
around once in a while.
translations.デキシーズの仕事も結構な運動量だと思うけどな。:
I feel like working at
Dixie's is plenty of
exercise, though.
translations.うーん、確かに立ちっぱなしで疲れるけど、運動とは違うでしょ。:
Hmm, being on your feet all
day is tiring, but it's not
the same as exercise.
translations.●はたまにミスして、走り回ってるけどね。:
●, you do mess up
and run around sometimes, though.
translations.そうね……。ふふ、あれは運動に入れてもいいかも。:
That's true... Hehe, maybe
that does count as exercise.
translations.今からなら空いてるんじゃないかな？:
It should be pretty empty
if you go right about now？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、今出てきたんだ。惜しかったな。:
You just came out, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
What bad timing.
translations.そうね、一緒に行けばよかった。:
Yeah. We should have
gone together.
translations.んー、ダメ。もうヘロヘロだもん。これから運動なんてしたら、倒れちゃう。:
Mm-mm, no can do.
I'm totally wiped out.
If I work out now, I'll collapse.
translations.そっか、じゃあ無理しない方がいいか。:
I see. Better not push yourself
then.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。たくさんの人の中で会えると、運命感じちゃうな。:
▲主人公＊▲. Running into you
in a crowd like this makes me
feel like it's destiny.
translations.もう、本気で言ってるのに。だって、こんなに騒がしいのに、あなたの声が聞こえたんだ:
Jeez, I'm being serious!
I mean, even with all this noise,
I could still hear your voice.
translations.そっか、じゃあ、あまり変なこと言えないな。:
Really？ Guess I can't say
anything weird, then.
translations.あ、こら、変なことってなに？ もう。:
Hey! What do you mean 'weird'？
Jeez.
translations.お客様のお呼び出しを申し上げます。姉ヶ崎寧々様、姉ヶ崎寧々様、お友達が１階迷子セ:
Paging customer Nene Anegasaki.
Customer Nene Anegasaki.
Your friend is waiting for you
at the 1st floor lost child center.
translations.あ、やだ、集合の時間過ぎてたみたい……。私行かないと。じゃあね。:
Oh no, looks like I'm past
our meetup time...
I gotta run. See you later!
translations.もう、なんで迷子センターなのよ……。:
Jeez, why the lost child
center of all places...？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の友達、面白いことするな……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s friend sure has
a funny way of doing things...)
translations.あなたもお買いもの？\nカノジョへのプレゼント\nだったりして？:
Out shopping too？
Maybe looking for a present
for your girlfriend？
translations.うそうそ、\nそんな困った顔しないで。\n友達待たせてるから、ごめんね？:
Just kidding, just kidding!
Don't look so troubled.
My friends are waiting,
so sorry, okay？
translations.そうだよね。私も気になってたから。:
Right？ I was pretty curious
about it myself.
translations.そうね。……じゃあ今度、もう一回一緒に来よう？ ね？:
Yeah. ...Then next time,
let's come back together, okay？
Deal？
translations.うん。お買い物の帰り。なんだか、デートの待ち合わせしてたみたいだね。:
Yep. On my way back from shopping.
It kinda feels like we were
meeting up for a date.
translations.そうだな。じゃあデートにしちゃうおうか？:
Yeah. Wanna just make it
a date, then？
translations.だーめ、デートは約束するところから味わいたいの。……なんてね、これから用事なの、:
No way. I like savoring dates
from the moment we make plans.
...Just kidding, I've got errands
to run, so sorry!
translations.あ、一人で何してるの？:
Oh, what are you doing
all by yourself？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ 別にこれといって……、そっちこそ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Not much, really...
What about you？
translations.友達のお手伝いなの。アルバイト。:
Just helping a friend out.
A part-time gig.
translations.え、バイト？ デキシーズは？:
Wait, a job？
What about Dixie's？
translations.もう、そんな顔しないの。人手が足りないからって、会場の売り子さんのお手伝いしただ:
Come on, don't make that face.
They were short-staffed, so I
just helped sell stuff at the venue.
translations.なんだ、そっか……びっくりした。:
Oh, okay...
You had me worried for a second.
translations.クレーンゲームに夢中の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……。なんか新鮮だな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ totally glued to a claw
machine... It's kind of fresh.
translations.……お店の前通ったらあの犬と目があって。だって、ひっくり返って首が曲がってるのよ:
...I walked past the shop and
made eye contact with that pup.
I mean, he's upside down with
his neck bent!
I just had to rescue him!
translations.そういう理由か……、じゃあ協力するか。:
So that's why...
Guess I'll lend a hand, then.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ゲームセンターに行くの？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Are you going to the arcade？
translations.あんまり熱中しすぎて、無駄遣いしないこと。ね？:
Don't get too carried away
and waste your money, okay？
translations.そうだね、ほどほどにするよ。: Yeah, I'll keep it in moderation.
translations.そうそう、熱中するのは私だけでいいよ▼:
That's right, the only thing
you should get hooked on is me▼
translations.さて、まずは何から……。:
Now then, what should I
start with...？
translations.ひとりぼっちの少年を補導します。:
Taking a lonely young boy
into protective custody!
translations.一緒に遊んであげたいところだけど……、ごめんね、向こうに友だち待たせるから。遅く:
I'd love to hang out with you,
but... sorry, my friend is waiting.
Don't stay out too late, okay？
translations.わかった。補導されないように注意するよ。:
Got it. I'll make sure not
to get taken into custody.
translations.お客様、何かお探しですか？:
Excuse me, sir,
can I help you find something？
translations.店員さんかと思った？: Did you think I was a clerk？
translations.声ですぐ分かったって。:
I recognized your voice
right away.
translations.うーん……これってどう違うんだろ。:
Hmm... I wonder what the
difference is between these.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。いいところに。ね、どっちのほうがいいかな？:
▲主人公＊▲. Perfect timing.
Hey, which one do you think
is better？
translations.うーん……、そうだな、安い方かな？:
Hmm... Well, maybe
the cheaper one？
translations.えー、でも、こっちの方がカワイイよ。: Aww, but this one is way cuter.
translations.あ、今、すごくテキトーな感じがした。:
Hey, that sounded completely
half-hearted just now!
translations.（あ、もう新製品出たんだな……）:
(Oh, the new model is
already out...)
translations.ずいぶん真剣に見てるね。:
You're looking at that
awfully intensely.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、偶然。買い物？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, fancy meeting you here.
Shopping？
translations.うん。そうなんだけど、なかなか踏ん切りがつかなくって。:
Yeah. I want to, but I just can't
bring myself to take the plunge.
translations.だよな。どんどん新製品が出るし。:
I get that. They keep releasing
new models, after all.
translations.そうよね、買ってすぐ安くなったりしたら、ショックだし……、どうしよう。:
I know, right？
It'd be such a shock if
the price dropped right away...
What should I do？
translations.（この調子だと、買いそうにないな……）:
(At this rate,
she's not gonna buy anything...)
translations.どうしたの、懐メロ探してる？:
What's up？
Looking for some oldies？
translations.そういうわけでもないんだけどさ、懐かしいと手に取っちゃうなーって。:
Not necessarily,
but when it's nostalgic,
you just gotta pick it up.
translations.わかるな、そういうの。音楽って、記憶と結びつくよね。:
I know what you mean.
Music really ties back to
memories, doesn't it？
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もＣＤ探しに来たの？:
Huh, are you here
looking for CDs too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ううん、私は映画のＤＶＤ。でも探してるのが置いてなみたい。別のとこに行こうかな。:
Nope, movie DVDs for me.
Doesn't look like they have
what I want, though.
Maybe I'll try elsewhere.
translations.へえ、ここ以外にもあるんだ？:
Oh？ There's another place
besides here？
translations.うん。こわ～い映画の専門店があるの。一緒にいく？:
Yep. There's a shop that
specializes in scary movies.
Wanna come with？
translations.えっと……●はもう少しここを回る予定だから……。:
Um... ● was planning
to browse around here
a bit longer, so...
translations.はい、かわいい鼻歌聴いちゃいました♪ 何かいいことあった？:
Yep, I heard that cute
little hum♪
Did something good happen？
translations.うん。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に会えた。: Yeah. I got to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.え……もう、鼻歌はその前からでしょ。誤魔化されないから。:
Wha... Oh, come on.
You were humming before that!
You can't fool me.
translations.発見！ なに見てるの？:
Found you!
What are you watching？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ ちゃんと見てたわけじゃないけど、アニメが流れてたから、なんとなく:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I wasn't really watching,
an anime was just on,
so I was just glancing at it.
translations.かわいい女の子がいっぱいだね？ あなたはどの子が好きなの？:
Sure are a lot of cute girls.
Which one's your favorite？
translations.特にどの子とかはないけど……。:
I don't really have
a favorite or anything...
translations.ふーん、お姉さんのキャラクターじゃないんだ？:
Hmm... None of the
older-sister characters？
translations.ふふ、無理矢理言わせちゃった。:
Hehe, I totally made you
say that.
translations.あっ……これは、違うよ？:
Ah... This isn't
what you think, okay？
translations.誤解しないでね。端っこの人が、あなたに似てるなーって思ってただけだから。:
Don't get the wrong idea.
I just thought the guy on
the edge looked like you.
translations.私、もう行くから、じゃあね。:
I'm gonna head out now,
see ya!
translations.（端っこの人って……、●こんな王子様みたいじゃないけど……）:
(The guy on the edge...
●'s not like a prince
like that at all, though...)
translations.あまり無駄遣いしちゃダメだからね。:
Make sure you don't
waste your money, okay？
translations.大丈夫だって。それにほら、趣味にお金使うのも大事だろ？:
I'll be fine. Besides,
spending money on hobbies
is important too, right？
translations.それはそうだけど。ちゃんと考えてるならいいの、ごめんね、うるさいこと言って。:
Well, that's true.
As long as you've thought it
through. Sorry for nagging.
translations.（こうやって世話焼かれるのもいいけどな）:
(It's kinda nice having her
fuss over me, though.)
translations.びっくりした？ なかなか様になってたでしょ。:
Surprised？
I looked pretty good in
character, didn't I？
translations.こんなかわいいメイドがいたら毎日通っちゃうよ。:
If there were a maid that
cute, I'd come every day.
translations.じゃあ、転職しちゃおっかな。:
Maybe I should change
jobs, then.
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。珍しいとこで会うね。:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Fancy running into you
in a place like this.
translations.うん、そうね。こんなところで……ねえ？:
Yeah, it is.
In a place like this...
right？
translations.もしかして▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、なんか怒ってる？:
Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
are you mad about
something？
translations.別に、怒ってませんよ？ じゃあね。:
I'm not mad at all？
See you.
translations.新しいバイト探し？:
Looking for a new
part-time job？
translations.ここの時給、デキシーズよりいいね。いっしょにここで働く？:
The pay here is better
than Dixie's. Want to work
here together？
translations.もう、なんでそうなるの。あなたは……なんだろう、執事さん？ うん、いいかも！:
Geez, why would it be that？
You'd be... what, a butler？
Yeah, I like that!
translations.今日は本当に神様がいるみたい。願い事かなっちゃった▼:
Looks like God really does
exist today. My wish came
true ▼
translations.そう、あなたに偶然会えますようにって。叶ったでしょ？:
Yep. To run into you.
And it came true,
didn't it？
translations.はは、じゃあ神様にお礼言わなきゃな。:
Haha, then I'd better go
thank the gods.
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。散歩？:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Out for a walk？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。今日はお守りを買いに来たの。:
▲主人公＊▲. I came to buy
a charm today.
translations.そうなんだ。お守りって、なにかあったの？:
Oh yeah？ A charm,
did something happen？
translations.うん、親戚に赤ちゃんが生まれるから、安産祈願。じゃあ、買ってくるね。:
Yeah, a relative is having
a baby, so for safe delivery.
Well, I'll go buy it.
translations.（……さすがに一緒に安産祈願のお守り買うわけにはいかないか）:
(...Then again, buying a safe
delivery charm together
might be a bit much.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。フラッと来ただけだよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I just came by on a whim.
translations.そうなの。私は、ときどきお願いごとしにくるよ。学校のこと、バイトのこと、それに…:
Is that so？ I come make
wishes sometimes. About school,
work, and also...
translations.一緒に付き合いたいところだけど。残念、もう行かないといけないの。:
I'd love to join you,
but too bad, I have to
take off already.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、今度▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と来るときカッコいいとこ見せられるように練習しと:
I see. Then I'll practice
so I look cool next time
I come with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ふふっ、期待してまーす。:
Fufu, I'll be expecting
big things~
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、偶然。よかったら一緒にボウリングしない？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what a coincidence.
Want to bowl together
if you'd like？
translations.うーん、せっかくだけどこれから家のことやらないといけなくて。:
Hmm, I'd love to, but
I have some chores to do
at home now.
translations.そっか、じゃあまた今度誘うよ。:
I see. I'll ask you
again another time, then.
translations.ごめんね。わたしボウリングしてるあなたも好きよ？:
Sorry. But you know,
I like you when you're
bowling, too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。なにしてんの？: ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What are you up to？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。あのね、クラスでボウリング大会しようってことになって、下調べ。:
▲主人公＊▲. Well, my class is
having a bowling tournament,
so I'm scouting it out.
translations.へえ。それで、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が幹事？:
Oh. So are you in charge
of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そういうこと。これからまだ回らなくちゃいけないところがあるから、行くね。:
That's right. I've still got
a few more places to check,
so I gotta run.
translations.（やっぱ頼りにされてるんだな……）:
(People really rely on her,
don't they...)
translations.ふ～ん。それじゃ、待ち合わせしてるんだ？:
Hmm. Meeting up with
someone, then？
translations.えっと、一人なんだけど……ヘン？:
Uh, I'm actually alone...
Is that weird？
translations.そうじゃないけど、できれば付き合ってあげたかったな。今からは無理なんだけど。:
Not at all, but I wish
I could've joined you.
Can't right now, though.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。うん、友達と待ち合わせしてたんだけど、ここじゃなくて別の店だったみ:
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah, I was meeting
a friend, but turns out
it was a different place.
translations.さっき連絡付いたから。もう、ホントおっちょこちょいだよね。やんなっちゃう。じゃあ:
We just got in touch.
Ugh, I'm such a klutz.
It drives me crazy. See ya!
translations.（時々うっかりしちゃう▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、かわいいよな）:
(It's pretty cute when ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
has her clumsy moments.)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。やっぱりそうだ。: ▲主人公＊▲. I knew it was you!
translations.今は帰るところ。この後、少し家の用事があって。:
Just heading home.
I've got some chores
to take care of after this.
translations.そっか。一緒にカラオケでもどうかと思ったんだけど、また今度だな。:
I see. I thought maybe we
could do karaoke together,
but some other time, then.
translations.そうね、残念だけど。じゃあね、悪いお姉さんについてっちゃダメよ？:
Yeah, too bad. Anyway, bye!
Don't go following any
bad older girls, okay？
translations.（悪いお姉さんってなんだろ……）:
(What does she mean by
'bad older girls'...？)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ なんでこんなところに？ 一人？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What are you doing
here？ Are you alone？
translations.私は近くで用事があったから、少し寄ってみただけ。あなたは一人じゃないの？:
I had errands nearby, so I
just dropped in. Aren't you
by yourself, too？
translations.なーんだ。じゃあ、最初から二人で来れば良かったね。:
Aw, really？ We should've
just come together, then.
translations.こんな場所で会うなんて不思議だね？:
Funny running into you
in a place like this, huh？
translations.ここで待ち合わせしてたみたいだな。:
It's almost like we
planned to meet here.
translations.ほんとね。でも残念……。さっき店長から連絡があって、今からヘルプなの。:
Really. But too bad...
The manager just called, so
I've gotta go help out now.
translations.今から？ ●も行こうか？:
Right now？ Want me to
come along too, ●？
translations.大丈夫、一段落したらすぐに帰らせてくれるみたいだし。それじゃ、行ってくるね。:
I'll be fine. He said I can
go once things settle down.
Well, see you later!
translations.カノジョに会っただけで、そんなに驚くことないんじゃない？:
No need to jump like that
just seeing your girlfriend,
is there？
translations.そうだけどさ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は驚かない？ 偶然会ったとき。:
Well, sure, but aren't you
surprised when we run into
each other, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.でも今は先に見つけられたから。ちょっとあなたを観察できて楽しかったよ。:
But I spotted you first.
It was fun watching you
for a bit, honestly.
translations.私と一緒にお茶しない？:
Wanna grab some tea
with me？
translations.ナンパだと思った？:
Did you think you were
getting hit on？
translations.今は用事があるからもう行くけど、今度は本当にナンパしちゃおうかな。:
I've got somewhere to be,
so I have to run, but...
maybe next time I'll really
hit on you.
translations.（なんだか、楽しみだな……）:
(Somehow, I'm kinda looking
forward to that...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。ちょっとお茶でもと思って。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Yeah, just
thought I'd grab a drink.
translations.いいなぁ。私も時間があったら一緒にお茶するのに。:
Must be nice. If I had time,
I'd join you for one.
translations.明日までに今月の行事予定表作って欲しいって、先生に頼まれちゃって……。じゃ、行く:
A teacher asked me to finish
this month's event schedule
by tomorrow, so...
Anyway, I've gotta run!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。うん、ちょっと休憩。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Yeah,
just taking a little break.
translations.コーヒーのお代わりは３杯までね。飲み過ぎはよくないから。あ、紅茶もよ。カフェイン:
Only up to three refills on
coffee, okay？ Too much is
bad for you. Oh, tea too!
Tea actually has more
caffeine, you know.
And with green tea...
translations.わかったわかった。そんなに気になるなら、一緒に入ろうよ。:
Alright, alright. If you're
that worried, come on in
with me.
translations.それができれば、口うるさく言わないよ。これから用事なの、じゃあね。:
If I could, I wouldn't be
nagging you. I've got
things to do, so see ya!
translations.（今のはお姉さん通り越して、お母さんみたいだったな……）:
(That went way past big-sis
straight into mom mode...)
translations.あ▼ すごい偶然だね。今からお茶するの？:
Ah, ▼! What a
coincidence. Grabbing a
drink right now？
translations.そのつもり。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
That's the plan.
What about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私はテイクアウトでお菓子を。これからお出かけだから。:
Just getting some takeout
sweets. I'm on my way out
somewhere.
translations.へえ、そんなことできるんだ？: Huh, you can do that here？
translations.うん、結構便利。じゃあね。:
Yup, it's pretty handy.
See ya!
translations.そのお店に入るんだったら、耳寄りな情報があるよ。:
If you're going in there,
I've got some good info
for you.
translations.ここのお店ね、実は裏メニューがあるらしいの。:
Rumor has it this place
actually has a secret menu.
translations.裏メニュー？ どうやって注文するの？:
A secret menu？
How do you order off it？
translations.たしか合言葉があるんだけど、えーっと……忘れちゃった♪:
I think there's a password,
but, umm... I forgot♪
translations.もう少し早かったら私が作ってあげたのに……残念。:
If it were a little earlier,
I would've made you
something... Too bad.
translations.えっ？ じゃあここで食べるのやめる！:
Wait, really？ Then I won't
eat here!
translations.ごめんなさい、もう友達の家で食べる約束しちゃったの。また機会があれば作ってあげる:
Sorry, I already promised to
eat at my friend's house.
I'll cook for you another
time, okay？▼
translations.そっか……。楽しみにしとくよ。:
I see... I'll be looking
forward to it, then.
translations.（……なんだか、すごく損した）:
(...Man, I feel like I
really missed out.)
translations.これから食事？ だったらオススメのメニューがあるんだけど、教えてあげようか？:
Getting food？ If so, there's
a dish I recommend.
Want me to tell you？
translations.あ、やっぱりやめた。今度私が作るから、ね？ ふふ▼ 楽しみにしててね。:
Ah, on second thought,
never mind. I'll make it
for you next time, okay？
Hehe, ▼ look forward to it!
translations.（なんだか……損したのか得したのか……、よく分からないな）:
(I can't tell if I missed
out or got lucky...)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。うん。これからね、友達のお家でたこ焼きパーティー。:
▲主人公＊▲. Yep! I'm on my way
to a friend's house for a
takoyaki party.
translations.へー、いいなぁ、楽しそう。:
Ooh, nice.
That sounds like fun.
translations.それはどうかな？ 女子だけのたこ焼きパーティーは甘くないよ？:
Are you sure about that？
An all-girls takoyaki party
is serious business, you know？
translations.それは女の子の秘密。じゃあね。:
That's a girl's secret.
See ya!
translations.外食ばっかりしてたら、体によくないぞ。:
Eating out all the time
isn't good for you, mister.
translations.ちゃんと栄養のバランスとれてるか、ちょっと心配。:
I'm a little worried you're
not getting balanced meals.
translations.大丈夫だよ。なるべく野菜も摂るようにしてるしさ。:
I'll be fine. I make sure
to eat my veggies, too.
translations.そう？ 気をつけてるならいいけど。:
Really？ Well, as long as
you're being careful.
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も食事？:
Oh, are you getting
something to eat too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ううん、私はもう帰るところ。:
Nope, I was just about
to head home.
translations.そっか、まだだったら誘おうと思ったんだけどなぁ。残念。:
I see. If you hadn't eaten,
I was gonna invite you.
Too bad.
translations.うーん、私も残念。もう少し食べるの我慢してればよかった……。今度また誘ってね。:
Yeah, such a shame...
I wish I'd held out a little
longer... Ask me next time, okay？
translations.ふふ、運命なのかな▼ それとも偶然？:
Hehe, is it fate, ▼？
Or just a coincidence？
translations.んー、会えたんだからどっちでもいいよ。:
Hmm, we got to meet,
so either works for me.
translations.もう、適当。:
Geez, you're so casual
about it.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。こんなところでなにしてるのかな？:
▲主人公＊▲. What are you doing
around here, I wonder？
translations.って、どういう意味なんだろうね。この場合、使い方間違ってる？:
Wait, what does that even
actually mean？ Did I use it
completely wrong just now？
translations.うん、お気に入りのヘアピン落としちゃって、探してたの。:
Yeah, I dropped my favorite
hairpin, so I was looking for it.
translations.そっか、よかったな。: I see, glad you found it.
translations.待ち人と失せ物が同時に現れちゃった♪:
The one I was waiting for
and the thing I lost both
showed up together♪
translations.ふふ、こうやって会えるのって嬉しいね。:
Hehe, it makes me happy
bumping into you like this.
translations.行動も似てきたのかな、●たち。:
Maybe our habits are starting
to align, ●.
translations.そうかも。いつかはデートの約束しなくても、デートできるようになるかも。:
Maybe so. Someday we might
even be able to go on dates
without planning them.
translations.あのね、友達と一緒にいたんだけど、はぐれちゃって。どうしよう。:
Well, I was with a friend,
but we got separated.
What should I do？
translations.え？ 携帯つながらないの？:
Huh？ Can't you reach her
on your phone？
translations.えっ!? ……あ、そうそう、今かけようと思ってたの。ほんとよ？\nじゃあね！:
What!? ...Oh, right, right,
I was just about to call her.
Really!
See you later!
translations.（携帯の存在忘れてたのか……）:
(Did she totally forget about
her phone...？)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、なにしてんの？:
What are you up to,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私は、これからお買い物。:
I'm just heading out
to go shopping.
translations.お、付き合おうか？: Oh, want me to come along？
translations.うーん、今日はご近所のおばあさんと一緒なの。お孫さんへのプレゼント選びなんだって:
Well, I'm with an elderly
neighbor today. Helping pick
a gift for her grandchild.
translations.さすがに大丈夫だと思うけど……ありがとう。優しいカレシさん。:
I'm sure we'll be fine,
but... thank you.
Such a sweet boyfriend.
translations.ふふ、走っちゃった。: Hehe, I kind of ran over.
translations.そんな慌てなくてもいいのに。大丈夫？:
You didn't have to rush.
Are you okay？
translations.あなたの顔見たら嬉しくって。……なんだか私、犬みたいね。:
Seeing your face just made
me so happy...
I'm like a puppy, aren't I？
translations.実はね、友達とケンカしちゃって……。その帰り。:
To be honest, I got into
a fight with a friend...
I'm on my way back now.
translations.そっか……何が原因だったの？:
I see...
What was it about？
translations.友達が“年下は興味ない”なんて言うから。そこからエスカレートして……。:
She said she has no interest
in younger guys, and it kind
of escalated from there...
translations.（そっか、●も友達に“年上興味ない”なんて言われたら……）:
(Right... If a friend told
● they're not into
older girls, then...)
translations.やっぱりいた▼ こういうのも虫の知らせって言うのかな？:
I knew you were here▼
Is this what they call
intuition, I wonder？
translations.気配というか、空気というか……いるって感じがしたの。:
Your presence, the air...
I just had a feeling you
were around.
translations.そんなことで落ち込まないの。カワイイ▼:
Don't get down over
something like that.
You're so cute, ▼
translations.（ひとりでいるのも、気楽で楽しいな……）:
(Being by myself is pretty
relaxing and nice...)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ぼんやり何考えてたの？:
▲主人公＊▲. What were you
daydreaming about？
translations.じゃあね。あんまりボーっとしてちゃダメよ。:
See you. Don't go spacing
out too much, okay？
translations.（……前言撤回。やっぱり▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒の方がいいや）:
(...I take that back.
Being with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is
way better after all.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。●、充分待ったよな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. ●,
I've waited long enough,
right？
translations.待ったら教えてくれるって言ったじゃないか。好きって言葉の意味……。:
Didn't you say you'd tell me
if I waited？ What you meant
by 'I love you'...
translations.だから、小さい▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がさ！ ほら、もう子供じゃないんだから！:
I mean, little ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲! Look,
I'm not a kid anymore!
translations.女の子に強引に詰め寄らないの。子供なんだから。:
Don't corner a girl like that.
You're still just a kid.
translations.（やっぱり子供扱いされるんだな……）:
(I guess she still treats me
like a kid...)
translations.やめて！ ●の体で実験はやめてくれ！ ちゃんと生きて帰ってくるから！:
Stop! Don't experiment on
●'s body! I swear I'll
come back alive!
translations.ふう、なんか体がだるいかも。:
Whew, my body feels
kind of sluggish.
translations.年寄りだもんな。: Well, you are an old lady.
translations.あ……ごめん、違う！ 御年寄だった！:
Ah... sorry, no!
I meant Senior Lady!
translations.……じゃなくて！ ほらあれ、大奥の！ お局様！ 夢で……。:
...No, wait! You know, in the
O-oku! The head matron!
In my dream...
translations.ねえ私、友達に背が伸びたんじゃない、って言われたんだけど、そんなことないよね。:
Hey, a friend told me I might
have gotten taller, but that
can't be true, right？
translations.わかんないぞ、ほんとに伸びてて、そのまま巨人になっちゃうかも。:
You never know, maybe you did,
and you'll turn into a giant.
translations.ええ？ もう、なにそれ。:
What？ Come on,
what's that supposed to mean？
translations.そしたら、●が▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の体を登るよ。ビバーク！ なんつって！:
Then ● can climb up
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s body. Bivouac!
Just kidding!
translations.……なんだかよくわからないけど……エッチ。:
...I don't really get it,
but... you pervert.
translations.ねえ、行ってみたい国ってある？:
Hey, is there any country
you'd like to visit？
translations.国……国か、ポコリン王国以外ならどこでもいいよ。:
A country... Hmm, anywhere's
fine, as long as it's not
the Pokorin Kingdom.
translations.あ……えっと、はは！ なんだっけ、マンガに出てきた国だったかな、ははは！:
Ah... er, haha! What was it...
I think it was from a manga,
hahaha!
translations.なあ、やっぱり男は仕事よりも愛する人を選ぶべきかな。:
Hey, should a guy choose
the person he loves over
his work after all？
translations.たとえ番組の視聴率が落ちてクビになりそうでも……カノジョをダシに使っちゃダメだよ:
Even if the ratings tank
and I'm about to get fired...
using my girlfriend as bait
is wrong, right？
translations.視聴率……テレビ業界人になるの？:
Ratings...？ Are you going
into television？
translations.ああ！ 一緒に最高の天気予報番組を作ろう、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！:
Yeah! Let's make the best
weather show ever together,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.なんだかかゆくて……何かに刺されちゃったのかな。:
It's kind of itchy...
Wonder if something bit me.
translations.毒蛇!? いけない、毒を吸い出すから！ ほら、ふとももを早く！:
A venomous snake!? Oh no,
I'll suck out the venom!
Quick, show me your thigh!
translations.……かゆいのは腕です！ もう、エッチ！:
...It's my arm that's itchy!
Jeez, you pervert!
translations.最近ご近所さんに赤ちゃんが産まれてね、かわいいの。ばぶーって♪:
A neighbor of mine just had
a baby, and it's so cute.
Going 'goo-goo'♪
translations.うん、そうよ。かわいいでちゅねーって。……なあに、あなたもしてほしいの？:
Yep. Like, 'Who's a cute
widdle baby?' ...What,
do you want that too？
translations.……はっ！ ははは！ 冗談だよ、でちゅー……なんつって！:
...Ack! Hahaha! Just joking
about the 'too-wub' part!
...Just messing around!
translations.あはは。やだ、びっくりしちゃった。:
Ahaha. Geez, you totally
startled me there.
translations.うん、ちょっと寝違えたみたいで……。:
Yeah, think I slept on it
funny...
translations.大丈夫？ マッサージしてあげようか？:
Are you okay？ Want me to
give you a massage？
translations.うん……あ、ごめん、やっぱりいい！ 筋肉男はもうやだ！:
Yeah... Wait, actually, no!
No more muscle men for me!
translations.なあに？ キョロキョロして……。:
What is it？ Looking all
around like that...
translations.そう？ あのね、私と…………忘れちゃった♪:
Really？ Well, will you...
......actually, I forgot♪
translations.そうだ、せっかくだし記念写真撮ろうよ。:
Hey, since we're here,
let's take a photo together.
translations.写真？ ん、いいよ。撮ろっか。:
A picture？ Sure!
Let's take one.
translations.はい、どこからでもどうぞ。かわいく撮ってね？:
Go right ahead, any angle's fine.
Make sure I look cute, okay？
translations.いいけど、早く終わらせてね？ 恥ずかしいから……。:
Sure, but make it quick, okay？
It's a little embarrassing...
translations.浴衣もちゃんと撮ってね？ あまり着る機会がないから。:
Get my yukata in the shot too,
okay？ I don't get to wear
it very often.
translations.ねぇ、髪乱れてたりしてない？ 急いできたから。:
Hey, is my hair messy？
I kind of rushed over here.
translations.トリックオアトリート、いたずらしちゃうぞ～。なんてね▼:
Trick or treat!
Or I'll play a trick on you~.
Just kidding!▼
translations.十羽野高校文化祭にようこそ▼ ……こんな感じでどうかな？:
Welcome to the Towano High
Cultural Festival!▼
...How was that？
translations.旅行先の写真っていったら、やっぱりパネルから顔だけ出すアレだよね。:
When you travel, you just have to
do those cutout photo boards,
don't you？
translations.メリークリスマス▼ ロマンチックな写真にしてね？:
Merry Christmas!▼
Make it a romantic photo, okay？
translations.ねぇ、いつもよりおしとやかに見えるかな？ どう？:
Hey, do I look more ladylike
than usual？ What do you think？
translations.あなたと一緒に過ごす誕生日……。幸せな気持ち、写真でもわかっちゃうかな。:
Spending my birthday with you...
I wonder if my happiness will
show right through in the photo？
translations.この写真を見るたびに、今の幸せな気持ちを思い出すんだろうな……。:
Every time I look at this photo,
I bet I'll remember
how happy I feel right now...
translations.大自然と私、絵になってるかな？:
Me surrounded by nature...
Does it make for a good picture？
translations.わぁ、屋台がたくさん出てるね。いい匂い……。:
Wow, so many food stalls!
Smells so good...
translations.どこか寄りたいとこ、ある？:
Is there anywhere
you want to stop？
translations.どうしようかな。……じゃあ、あれ▼:
Hmm, let me see...
How about that one？▼
translations.ふふ、屋台と言えばこれよね。:
Hehe, you can't have a festival
without this!
translations.実際に美味しいよ。食べてみる？:
It really is!
Want a bite？
translations.ね？ ほら、美味しいって顔しちゃうでしょ？:
See？ Look at your face,
you love it, don't you？
translations.いろんな屋台が出てる。ほら。:
There are so many stalls out.
Look!
translations.ホントだ。目移りするな……。:
You're right.
Hard to pick just one...
translations.あ、さっそく選んでる。どれにしようか？:
Ah, checking them out already？
Which one should we get？
translations.これこれ。屋台と言えばこれだろ。:
This is the one.
The festival classic.
translations.好きなんだ。ふふ、幸せそうな顔しちゃって。:
You really love this, huh？
Hehe, look how happy you are.
translations.お弁当作って来たの。はい。:
I made a lunch box for you.
Here!
translations.よかった、喜んでくれて。嫌いなものが入ってたら残していいからね？:
I'm glad you're happy!
If there's anything you don't like,
feel free to leave it, okay？
translations.はい、お弁当。よーく味わってね。:
Here's your lunch!
Savor every bite, okay？
translations.がっつかないの。お弁当は逃げないんだから、ちゃんと噛んでゆっくり食べなさい？:
Don't wolf it down!
It's not running away, so chew
properly and eat slowly, okay？
translations.お弁当作ってきたの。一緒に食べよ。:
I made us lunch!
Let's eat together.
translations.どういたしまして。栄養と愛情満点だよ？:
You're welcome.
It's packed with nutrition
and love, you know？
translations.急にごめんね。これ、どうしても渡したくて。:
Sorry to spring this on you.
I just really wanted to
give this to you.
translations.遅くなったけど、誕生日プレゼントなの。本当は当日に渡したかったんだけど……。:
It's late, but here's your
birthday present. I really wanted
to give it to you on the day...
translations.記念日のプレゼントなの。少し遅れちゃったけど。:
Here's an anniversary present.
Even if it's a little late.
translations.メリークリスマス。サンタが遅れてやってきました。:
Merry Christmas!
Looks like Santa ran
a little late this year.
translations.これ、バレンタインの。できれば当日に渡したかったな。:
Here, for Valentine's Day.
I wish I could've given it
to you on the actual day, though.
translations.ありがとう。じゃあ●からも……。:
Thank you. Then here's
something from ●, too...
translations.わぁ、ありがとう。嬉しい……。:
Aww, thank you!
I'm so happy...
translations.わざわざありがとう。: Thanks for coming all this way.
translations.うん。やっぱり渡しに来てよかった。:
Yeah. I'm really glad
I came to give it to you.
translations.じゃあね、プレゼント渡したかっただけだから。来年は当日一緒にいられるといいな。:
Well, see you! I just wanted
to drop off the gift. Next year,
I hope we're together on the day.
translations.●も気をつけとくよ。今日はありがとう。:
● will make sure of it.
Thanks for today.
translations.これ、ホワイトデー。遅くなったけど。:
Here, for White Day.
Sorry it's late.
translations.ううん。ありがとう、嬉しい。:
Don't be! Thank you,
I'm so happy.
translations.よかった、喜んでくれて。ごめんな。:
Glad you like it.
Sorry about the delay.
translations.いいの。来年は一緒に過ごそうね。:
It's okay.
Let's spend it together
next year, all right？
translations.（ホワイトデー過ぎちゃったけど、今からでもなにかできないかな……）:
(White Day's already passed,
but isn't there something
I can still do now...？)
translations.ごめんな、当日に渡さないと意味ないのに。:
Sorry... Kind of defeats the point
if it's not on the actual day.
translations.そんなことないよ。でも、来年は一緒に過ごせるといいな。:
That's not true at all.
Still, I hope we can spend it
together next year.
translations.（そういえば▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日過ぎちゃったけど、今からでもなにかできないかな…:
(Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
birthday already passed... Isn't
there anything I can still do...？)
translations.付き合う前のことだけど、いいよね。せっかくの恋人同士のイベント、逃したらもったい:
It was before we started dating,
but it's fine, right？ It'd be a
shame to miss a couples' event.
translations.次のイベントは来月のホワイトデーかな？ ……ふふ！ じゃあ、またね。:
I guess the next event is White
Day next month？ ...Hehe!
Well, see you later.
translations.（付き合う前のことなのに、ちゃんとチョコくれた……。ホワイトデーのお返しも考えて:
(She still gave me chocolate even
though we weren't dating yet...
Gotta think of a White Day gift.)
translations.来週は記念日だよ。覚えてる？:
Next week's our anniversary.
Do you remember？
translations.もちろん。何かやりたいこととか、食べたいものとかある？:
Of course. Is there anything
you wanna do or eat？
translations.それだといつものデートと変わらないじゃない。何か変わったことがしたいなぁ。:
That wouldn't be any different
from our usual dates, though.
I wanna do something different.
translations.記念日らしい何か。凝ったことじゃなくていいの。ただ、いつものデートとはちょっと違:
Something anniversary-worthy.
It doesn't have to be fancy,
just something that feels special.
translations.いつもと違うか……。じゃあ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がデートを完全プロデュースしてくれるとか:
Something special, huh...
How about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ plans the whole
date from start to finish...？
translations.んー、すぐには思いつかない。まだ日はあるし、ちょっと考えてみるね？:
Hmm, nothing comes to mind
right away. We've got time,
so I'll think about it, okay？
translations.（うーん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が喜ぶ記念日にしたいけど……）:
(Hmm, I want an anniversary
that'll make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ happy,
but...)
translations.明日の記念日だけど、ショッピングモールに行かない？:
About our anniversary tomorrow—
wanna go to the shopping mall？
translations.記念になる何かを買おうと思って。二人で。:
I thought we could buy something
to remember it by. The two of us.
translations.そう。どこかに行ったり、美味しいものを食べるのもいいけど、それだとあとに残らない:
Right. Going somewhere
or having good food is nice,
but nothing really lasts
afterwards, right？
translations.あとに残るものか。……うん、いいかもしれないな。:
Something that lasts, huh...
Yeah, that might be nice.
translations.じゃあ決まり。どんなのがいいか考えておいてね？:
Then it's settled. Think
about what you'd like, okay？
translations.二人で考えなくちゃ意味ないだろ？:
What's the point if we don't
figure it out together？
translations.そうでした。明日一緒に考えようか。:
Good point. Let's figure it
out together tomorrow.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。待たせてごめんなさい。:
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry to keep
you waiting.
translations.ううん。●も今来たとこだから。:
Not at all. ● just
got here too.
translations.よかった。今日は何を買おうかなって、昨日からずっと考えちゃって……。:
I'm glad. I've been thinking
about what to get ever since
yesterday...
translations.ううん、やっぱりあなたと一緒に考えたいもの。だから来る途中、考えちゃわないように:
Nope, I really wanted to
figure it out with you.
It was so hard trying not to
think about it on the way
here, you know？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、待った？ ごめん。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, did you wait long？
Sorry.
translations.大丈夫、まだ時間前だから。それで、何買うか考えて来た？:
It's fine, we're still early.
So, did you think about
what to get on the way？
translations.一緒に考えるんだろ？:
Aren't we supposed to
figure that out together？
translations.そうそう。抜け駆けは許さないんだから。:
That's right. I won't let
you get a head start on me!
translations.今来たとこだよ。それじゃ行こうか。:
I just got here myself.
Shall we get going？
translations.記念品、どんなものがいいかな。飾るのもいいし、使えるものでもいいし……。:
I wonder what kind of
keepsake we should get.
Something to display, or
maybe something practical...
translations.何でもいいよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の好きなもの。:
Anything's fine. Whatever
you'd like, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.二人の好きなもの、でしょ？ ふふ、何がいいかな～。:
Something we both like,
silly. Hehe, I wonder what
it'll be~
translations.ねぇ、どのお店がいいかな？:
Hey, which shop looks
good to you？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の好きなところでいいよ。:
Wherever you'd like is fine,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.私はあなたの好きなところがいいな。:
I'd rather go somewhere
you like.
translations.じゃあ、せーので行きたい店を指さそう。:
Then on the count of three,
let's point to the shop
we want to go to.
translations.ふふ、急ぐ必要ないし、ゆっくり決めよう。:
Hehe, there's no rush,
so let's take our time.
translations.うん。見るたびに今日のこと思い出すんだろうな……。:
Yeah. Every time I look
at it, I bet I'll think
of today...
translations.じゃあ、片っぱしから見て行こっか。:
Then let's just check them
all out, one by one!
translations.ブツブツ言わないの。あれもいい、これもいいって言いながら見ていくのが楽しいんじゃ:
Stop grumbling. Isn't it fun
looking around and saying
'this is nice, that's nice'
together？
translations.……あ。あの店頭のコロン見て。入れ物がかわいい～。:
...Oh. Look at the cologne
by that shopfront.
The bottle is so cute~
translations.端から順番に見て行くんじゃないの？:
Weren't we supposed to
go in order from the edge？
translations.順番になんて言ってないでしょ？ ほら、ブツブツ言ってないで歩く。:
I never said anything about
order, did I？ Come on,
stop grumbling and walk.
translations.いいじゃない。……うん、いい記念になりそう。:
That looks great. ...Yeah,
this'll make a wonderful
keepsake.
translations.ねえねえ、この帽子あなたに似合うかも。ほら。:
Hey, hey, this hat might
look good on you. Look!
translations.なあ、さっきから●のばっか見てない？:
Hey, haven't you only been
looking at stuff for ●？
translations.だって、あなたに買ってあげたいものばかり目に入るんだもん。あ、そこの腕時計も……:
I can't help it! I keep
spotting things I want
to buy for you. Oh, that
watch over there too...
translations.隣にコスメショップがあるよ。ああいうの、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲好きじゃない？:
There's a cosmetics shop
next door. Don't you
like that stuff, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.良くないよ。●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の喜ぶ顔が見たいし。:
No, it's not fine. ●
wants to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
smile, too.
translations.もう見てるじゃない。あなたと一緒にお買い物してるだけで、すごく楽しい。:
You're seeing it already,
aren't you？ Just shopping
with you is so much fun.
translations.ふふ、しょうがないなぁ。わかりました、じゃあ隣のお店も見てみようか？:
Hehe, you're impossible.
All right, shall we check out
the shop next door, then？
translations.うん、それにしよ。いいのが見つかったね。:
Yeah, let's go with that.
We found a great one.
translations.今日のこと？ それなら●も……。:
For today？ If so,
● should thank you, too...
translations.今日だけじゃないの。あなたに会って、つき合い始めてから今までずっと、あなたには感:
Not just for today. From the
moment we met and started
dating, I've been grateful to
you. I just wanted to tell you.
translations.今日みたいに、つき合い始めた記念日を大事にしてくれるのも嬉しい。私にとっては何よ:
I'm so happy you treasure
our anniversary like this, too.
It's the most precious
day in the world to me.
translations.●も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と同じ気持ちだから。:
Because ● feels
the exact same way as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.……うん。やだ、涙出そう……。:
...Yeah. Oh gosh,
I might start crying...
translations.（今日の気持ち、これからも大事にしていこう……）:
(I'll cherish how I feel
today from here on out...)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。私ね、あなたに会えてよかった。:
▲主人公＊▲. You know,
I'm so glad I met you.
translations.どうしたの？ 急に……。: What's this all of a sudden？
translations.いいじゃない。ねぇ、あなたは？:
Can't I just say it？
Come on, what about you？
translations.もちろん、●も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に会えてよかったよ。:
Of course. ● is
so glad to have met ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, too.
translations.それ、心からだよね？ 私が無理に言わせてるわけじゃないよね？:
You really mean it, right？
I'm not forcing you to say
it, am I？
translations.当たり前だろ。●が信じられない？:
Of course I mean it.
Don't you trust ●？
translations.わかってても確かめたくなるものなの。こんないい子が私を慕ってくれて嬉しいなー。:
Even when I know, I still
want to be sure. It makes me
so happy that such a good boy
adores me so much~
translations.あなたも幸せを噛みしめなさい？ 私、本当にあなた一筋なんだから。:
You'd better appreciate
your luck, too! I'm completely
devoted to you, after all.
translations.もう十分、感じてるよ……。: Believe me, I feel it plenty...
translations.呼んでみただけ。ねぇ、名前を呼んだら当たり前のように返事が返ってくるのって、幸せ:
Just wanted to say it. You
know, having you answer like
it's the most natural thing...
It makes me really happy.
translations.まぁね。どうした？ 寂しくなっちゃった？:
Yeah. What's up？
Did you get lonely？
translations.今、甘えたいモードなの。いつも甘やかしてあげてるから、たまにはね？:
I'm in the mood to be spoiled
right now. I pamper you all
the time, so I get a turn
once in a while, right？
translations.●、そんなに甘えてるかなぁ。:
Does ● really get
pampered that much？
translations.あ、自覚ないんだ。あなたのそういうところが、カワイイくて仕方がないのよね～。:
Oh, you don't even realize it？
That's what makes you so
irresistibly cute, though~
translations.……真面目な話。私が今こんなに幸せな気分でいられるのは、全部あなたのおかげよ。あ:
...All joking aside, though.
Being this happy right now
is all thanks to you.
Thank you.
translations.●だってそうだよ。ありがとう、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
That goes for ●, too.
Thank you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ねぇ、来週のビッグイベントは期待しててね。:
Hey, make sure you look
forward to the big event
next week, okay？
translations.ビッグイベントって……もしかして●の誕生日？:
Big event... Could it be
●'s birthday？
translations.ピンポーン。当日はちゃんと空けておいてね？ 全身全霊でお祝いしてあげる。:
Ding-dong! Keep that day
open, okay？ I'm going to
celebrate with all my heart.
translations.気合い入ってるな……。わかった、楽しみにしてる。:
You're really fired up...
Got it, I can't wait.
translations.とは言っても、今はまだ企画段階なの。特別な演出って難しいのよねぇ。:
That said, it's still in the
planning stages. Planning
special surprises is hard,
you know？
translations.無茶はするなよ？ 気持ちだけで嬉しいんだから。:
Don't go overboard, okay？
Just the thought makes me
happy.
translations.そのへんは大丈夫。お金じゃ愛は買えないって知ってるもの。: No need to worry about that. I know money can't buy love, after all.
translations.そうよ？ あなたのお誕生日会。お花を飾って、ケーキを用意して、２人でお祝いするの: Yep？ A birthday party for you. We'll set up flowers, get a cake, and celebrate just the two of us.
translations.いろいろ考えたんだけど、特別なことはしないで二人だけでゆっくり過ごすのもいいかな: I thought about it, and I figured it'd be nice to just relax together instead of doing anything crazy. I'll even make dinner. How's that sound？
translations.どうって、●はもちろん大歓迎だよ。: What do I think？ ● would love that, of course.
translations.ふふ、じゃあ決まり。お買い物して行くから、何も用意しなくていいからね？: Hehe, then it's settled. I'll pick up groceries on the way, so you don't have to prepare a thing, okay？
translations.（カノジョが家に来て、ご飯作ってくれて……それで充分特別だよ）: (Having my girlfriend come over and cook dinner for me... That's already special enough.)
translations.……はぁ、いろいろ買いすぎちゃった。お邪魔します。: ...Phew, I bought way too much. Coming in~
translations.重かっただろ。やっぱり●も手伝えばよかったかな。: Must've been heavy. Maybe ● should've come along to help.
translations.今日の主役はゆっくりしててくれればいいの。じゃあ、さっそくお台所を借りるね。: Today's star just needs to kick back and relax. Well then, I'm taking over the kitchen!
translations.もう夕飯の準備？ 来たばかりなんだし、ちょっと休めばいいのに。: Dinner already？ You just got here, you should rest a bit.
translations.ありがとう。でも、あとでのんびりさせてもらうから大丈夫。: Thanks. But don't worry, I'll take it easy later.
translations.小さなブーケを買って来たんだけど、どこに飾ろうかな……。: I bought a little bouquet, but where should I put it...？
translations.誕生日なんだし、このくらいは当たり前よ。あなたは王様気分でいてくれればいいから。: It's your birthday, so of course! All you need to do is feel like a king.
translations.（気持ちは嬉しいけど、やっぱり気になっちゃうな……）: (I really appreciate it, but I still feel bad just sitting here...)
translations.お腹すいたでしょ。おかわりもあるから、どんどん食べてね。: You must be hungry. There's plenty of seconds, so eat up!
translations.お邪魔しまーす。お買い物に時間かかっちゃった。: Coming in~! Shopping took longer than I expected.
translations.いらっしゃい。何か飲む？: Come on in. Want something to drink？
translations.ううん、お腹をすかせた子が待ってるし、先にご飯の用意をしちゃおうかな。: Nope, I've got a hungry boy waiting for me, so I think I'll make dinner first.
translations.子って……。●も今日、ひとつ年を取るんだからな。: 'Boy'？ Come on... ●'s turning a year older today, you know.
translations.あ、抵抗しちゃって。ふふ、かわいい～。: Aww, talking back？ Hehe, so cute~
translations.なるべく早く用意を済ませるから、いい子にしてて。ね？: I'll have it ready as fast as I can, so be a good boy, okay？
translations.完全に子供扱いだな……。: You're totally treating me like a kid...
translations.あなたがそんな風にかわいいからいけないの。何か飲み物を用意するから、それ飲んで大: It's your fault for being so adorable. I'll pour you a drink, so sip on that and behave.
translations.（なんだかんだ言って、いたれりつくせりだ……）: (Say what you will, she's really spoiling me...)
translations.はい、できました。残さず食べるのよ？: Here you go, all done! Clean your plate, okay？
translations.ふふ、そんなに慌てないの。料理は逃げないんだから、ね？: Hehe, don't rush so much. The food's not going anywhere, okay？
translations.はは、おかえり。\n何か飲む？:
Haha, welcome back. 
Want something to drink？
translations.それは私のセリフでしょ。\n何が飲みたい？ \nさっそくご飯の用意をするから、\:
That's my line, silly. 
What would you like？ 
I'll get dinner going right away, 
so drink that while you wait.
translations.いいよ、\nそれくらい自分でするから。:
I'm fine, 
I can get it myself.
translations.ダーメ。\n今日はあなたのお世話を\n焼きに来たんだから、\n思う存分焼かせてち:
Nope! 
I came here today 
to take care of you, 
so let me spoil you 
to my heart's content. 
Because that's what I want.
translations.じゃあ、お言葉に甘えて……。\n紅茶いれて？:
Well, if you insist... 
Could you make some tea？
translations.はい、どうぞ。\n苦手なものがあったら\n残していいからね？:
Here you go. 
If you don't like something, 
feel free to leave it, okay？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。プレゼントがあるの。: ▲主人公＊▲. I have a present for you.
translations.えっ？ もういろいろしてもらってるのに……。: Huh？ But you've already done so much for me...
translations.ふふ、はいこれ。誕生日おめでとう。: Hehe, here you go. Happy birthday.
translations.なんだか悪いな。: I feel kind of bad taking this...
translations.私からも、今日は一緒に過ごしてくれてありがとう。: And thank you, too, for spending today with me.
translations.うん。喜んでもらえてよかった。: Yeah. I'm glad you like it.
translations.はい、プレゼント。何にしようかすごく迷ったんだから。: Here's your present. I had such a hard time deciding what to get.
translations.ありがとう。何かな……。: Thanks. I wonder what it is...
translations.いいな、これ。大切にするよ。: This is great. I'll treasure it.
translations.うん。さてと、やるべきことはこれで全部終わりかな。: Mhm. Well now, I guess that takes care of everything on my list.
translations.そんな情けない顔しないの。ギリギリまで一緒にいてあげるから、ね？: Don't look so pathetic. I'll stay with you until the very last minute, okay？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。いいものあげる。: ▲主人公＊▲. I've got something good for you.
translations.ジャーン、誕生日プレゼント。お誕生日おめでとう。: Ta-da! Your birthday present. Happy birthday.
translations.いいな、これ。どうもありがとう。: This is great. Thanks so much.
translations.あなたの笑顔を見てたら、嬉しくなってきちゃって。私ね、今すごく幸せだよ。: Seeing you smile just made me so happy. You know, I feel really happy right now.
translations.今日は最高の誕生日になったよ。: Today was the best birthday ever.
translations.よかった。また来年も、その次も……。ずっとこうしてお祝いできたらいいな。: I'm glad. Next year, and the year after that... I hope we can celebrate like this forever.
translations.……来年もご飯作ってくれる？: ...Will you make me dinner next year, too？
translations.あなたがそうしてほしいなら、喜んで。でもあなたにお夕飯を作るのなんて、そのうち当: If that's what you want, I'd love to. But making you dinner... feels like it'll become second nature before long anyway...
translations.ううん、なんでもないの。誕生日じゃなくてもご飯を作りに来てあげたいなって。: No, it's nothing. Just thinking I'd like to come make dinner for you even when it's not your birthday.
translations.そんなのいつでも大歓迎だよ。今日は本当にありがとう。: You're welcome to do that anytime. Thanks so much for today.
translations.準備する時間は長いのに、本番はあっという間に終わっちゃった。: It took so long to prepare, but the actual day was over in a flash.
translations.お疲れ。今日は最高の誕生日だったよ。: Thanks for everything. Today was the best birthday ever.
translations.あーあ、次の誕生日は１年先かぁ。あれこれ考える時間も楽しかったのにな。: Sigh, your next birthday is a whole year away, huh. Thinking up all the plans was so much fun, too.
translations.はは、イベントは他にもいろいろあるだろ。: Haha, there are plenty of other occasions, you know.
translations.あなたの誕生日と他のイベントを一緒にしないの。私にとっては最上級のイベントなんだ: Don't go lumping your birthday in with other events. To me, it's the most special occasion there is.
translations.そっか。……今日は本当にありがとう。: I see. ...Thanks so much for today.
translations.終わっちゃったね……。: It's all over now, isn't it...？
translations.楽しかったよ。今日は最高の誕生日になった。:
I had a great time. Today was
the best birthday ever.
translations.それならよかった。来年もその次も一緒にお祝いしようね？:
I'm glad. Let's celebrate
together next year, and the
year after that too, okay？
translations.ふふ。……ねぇ、最後にもうひとつプレゼントがあるの。:
Fufu. ...Hey, I have one last
present for you.
translations.お誕生日おめでとう。あなたが生まれてくれて本当によかった。:
Happy birthday. I'm so truly
happy you were born.
translations.私の気持ち。受け取ってね？:
It's straight from my heart.
Please accept it, okay？
translations.……うん。今日は本当にありがとう。:
...Yeah. Thank you so much
for today.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日まであと少しだな。:
Your birthday is coming up
soon, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.まだまだ先よ。再来週だもの。:
Oh, it's still a ways off.
That's not till the week
after next.
translations.あと１ヶ月先……ううん、せめてゴールデンウィークの後くらいに生まれればよかったの:
I wish I'd been born a month
later... or at least after
Golden Week, you know？
translations.私の誕生日は４月２０日でしょ？\n学年が変わってやっと友達が出来る頃で、いつも誕:
My birthday is April 20th,
right？
It's right when the new school
year starts and you're barely
making friends, so I always
missed out on presents.
translations.それにこの時期はみんなゴールデンウィークの話ばっかりで、私の誕生日どころじゃない:
Plus, everyone only talks about
Golden Week around now, so no
one cares about my birthday.
translations.でもいいんだ。今はぜーんぶあなたに祝ってもらうから▼:
But that's totally fine now.
Because now, I have you to
celebrate all of it▼
translations.来週の誕生日だけど、どこか行きたいところはない？:
About your birthday next week...
Is there anywhere you want to go？
translations.わぁ、連れて行ってくれるんだ。どこでもいいの？:
Ooh, you're taking me out？
Anywhere at all？
translations.うん。あ、でも、あまり大変そうなところは……。:
Yeah. Ah, but maybe not
anywhere too intense...
translations.わかってます。そうね……じゃあ、遊園地がいいな。:
I know, I know. Well...
how about an amusement park？
translations.遊園地？ いいけど、なんか意外だなー。:
An amusement park？ I'm down,
but that's kind of unexpected.
translations.そう？ 誕生日だからこそ、童心にかえって遊びたいの。大人になればなるほどそういう:
Really？ Because it's my birthday,
I want to feel like a kid again.
The older you get, the harder
that is, don't you think？
translations.なるほど……。わかった、当日は思い切りはしゃぎまくろう。:
I see... Got it, then let's
go all out and have a blast
on the big day.
translations.お手手つないでランララン、みたいな。ふふっ。:
Holding hands and skipping
along, la-la-la! Fufu.
translations.（ちょっと早く来すぎたかな……）:
(Maybe I got here a little
too early...)
translations.家でじっとしていられなかったんだもの。でもびっくりしちゃった。絶対に私が先だと思:
I just couldn't sit still at home!
Though you really surprised me.
I was sure I'd beat you here.
translations.今日だけは絶対に▲姉ヶ崎＊▲より先に着こうと思ってたから。:
Today of all days, I was
determined to get here before
you did, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そんなに気合い入れてくれてるんだ。嬉しいな。:
You're that pumped for today？
That makes me so happy.
translations.そりゃ特別な日だし。それじゃ、行こうか。:
Well, it is a special day.
Shall we head out？
translations.そうだ、最初に言っとかなきゃ。:
Oh, right, I have to say this
first.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、誕生日おめでとう。一緒にお祝いできてよかった。:
Happy birthday, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I'm really glad we get to
celebrate together.
translations.ありがとう。……もう、最初から飛ばしすぎよ？ いきなりメロメロにしてどうするつも:
Thank you. ...Jeez, you're
coming on strong right away!
Trying to make me swoon already？
translations.よーし、遊ぶぞー！: All right, let's have some fun!
translations.お、いきなり全開モードだな。:
Whoa, full speed ahead right
from the start, huh？
translations.もちろん。最後までちゃんとついてきてね？:
Of course! Make sure you keep
up with me till the end, okay？
translations.……じゃあ、次はメリーゴーランド！:
...All right, next up is
the carousel!
translations.こら。今日は誰のお祝いだったかな？:
Hey now. Whose celebration is
it today, mister？
translations.はーい。喜んで乗らせていただきます。:
Okay, okay. I'd be honored to
ride it with you, ma'am.
translations.ふふ、よろしい。ねぇ、二人乗りできる白馬があるの。あれがいいな。:
Hehe, that's what I like
to hear. Hey, look, there's a
white horse for two!
I want that one.
translations.あ、そんな顔するんだ。あれがいいのにな～。ネネ悲しいな～。:
Aw, look at that face.
And here I was really
hoping for that one~
Nene is so sad~
translations.うぅ……喜んで乗らせていただきます！:
Ugh... It would be my
absolute honor to ride it!
translations.やったぁ。じゃあ、あなたが前ね。ほら、早く早く！:
Yay! You're in front, then.
Come on, hurry, hurry!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、子供みたいにはしゃいでるな。来てよかった）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is so excited,
just like a little kid.
I'm glad we came.)
translations.あのね、実を言うと少しだけ、誕生日なんて来なければいいのにって気持ちもあったの。:
You know... truth is,
a tiny part of me kind of
wished my birthday
wouldn't come.
translations.私は年上なんだなって思い知らされるから。あなたより先に卒業して、あなたより先に大:
Because it just reminds me
that I'm older.
I'll graduate before you,
and become an adult first.
translations.普段からそう気にしてるわけじゃないのよ？ ただ、あなたと一緒ならもっとよかったな:
It's not like I dwell on it
all the time, you know？
I just wish I could have
done it all with you.
translations.●もそう思うことがないわけじゃないけど……。:
It's not like ●
hasn't felt that way
sometimes too, but...
translations.その分、こうして一緒にいる時間をたくさん作ろうよ。:
All the more reason to make
lots of time to be together
like this.
translations.あー、疲れた。筋肉痛になっちゃいそう。:
Aah, I'm exhausted.
I bet I'm gonna be
sore all over tomorrow.
translations.マッサージしてあげようか。:
Want me to give you
a massage？
translations.親切で言ったのに……。:
And here I was just
trying to be nice...
translations.そう？ じゃあ肩くらい揉んでもらっちゃおうかな。:
Really？ Well then, maybe I'll
let you rub my shoulders.
translations.ふふ、今日はサービス旺盛なんだ。これなら毎日が誕生日でもいいかも。:
Hehe, you're really spoiling
me today. I wouldn't mind if
every day was my birthday.
translations.毎日はちょっと……。:
Every day might be
a bit much...
translations.私は、ほんとに毎日でもいいな……それくらい、今日はうれしかったから。:
I really wouldn't mind it,
honestly... That's just how
happy you made me today.
translations.はぁ、楽しかった……。ごめんね、振り回しちゃって。:
Phew, that was so fun...
Sorry for dragging you
all over the place.
translations.全然。もっと振り回されてもよかったくらい。:
Not at all. I wouldn't have
minded being dragged around
even more, honestly.
translations.ううん、誕生日じゃなくても。:
No, even if it weren't
your birthday.
translations.ふふ、優しいんだから。今日はあなたが頼もしく見えるな～。:
Hehe, you're so sweet.
You seem especially
dependable today~
translations.そう？ というかいつもは？:
Really？ Wait, what about
normally, then？
translations.いつもはかわいい▼:
Normally, you're just
my cute little ▼.
translations.そういうところがかわいいの。もちろん、かわいいだけじゃなくて……。:
That right there is what's
so cute. Of course, you're
not just cute, though...
translations.かっこよくて……やさしくて……それから、大好き。:
You're handsome... sweet...
and best of all, I love you.
translations.プレゼント。改めて、誕生日おめでとう。:
A present for you.
Happy birthday, again.
translations.わぁ……。さっそく開けてみるね？:
Wah... Can I open it
right now？
translations.ねぇ、ずーっと隠してるものがあるでしょ。:
Hey, you've been hiding
something this whole time,
haven't you？
translations.バレてたか……。はい、プレゼント。:
You caught me, huh...
Here, it's a present.
translations.ありがとう。ふふ、忘れてるのかと思っちゃった。:
Thank you. Hehe, I was
almost worried you forgot.
translations.そうだ、忘れないうちに。はいこれ。:
Oh right, before I forget.
Here you go.
translations.わぁ、なんだろう……。: Wah, I wonder what it is...
translations.こんなにしてもらっちゃっていいのかな……。ありがとう、大事にするね？:
Are you sure it's okay to spoil me
this much……？
Thank you, I'll treasure it, okay？
translations.わぁ、あなたってこんなにセンスよかった？ 最高……ありがとう。:
Whoa, did you always have
such great taste？
It's the best…… Thank you.
translations.やっぱり私のことわかっちゃうんだ……どうもありがとう。:
You really do know me best,
don't you…… Thank you so much.
translations.どうもありがとう。大切に使わせてもらうね？:
Thank you so much.
I'll take good care of it, okay？
translations.あ、いいかも。やるじゃない。:
Oh, this is nice.
Not bad at all.
translations.ふふ、あなたらしい。どうもありがとう。:
Hehe, that's so you.
Thank you so much.
translations.あ……うん、悪くないと思うよ？ うん、多分……。:
Ah…… Yeah, I think it's not bad？
Yeah, probably……
translations.ふーん……なるほどね。ある意味あなたらしいとは思うけど……。:
Hmm…… I see.
I guess it is like you in a way,
though……
translations.え？ これ私にだよね？ うん……ありがとう。:
Huh？ This is for me, right？
Um…… thank you.
translations.私、今日のことは一生忘れない。:
I'll never forget today.
Not for the rest of my life.
translations.そんなことないよ。それくらい楽しかったから。:
Not at all. That's just how much
fun I had.
translations.そっか。……来年はハードルが高いな。:
I see. ……The bar's gonna be
pretty high next year then.
translations.来年は今日より楽しくなきゃ満足できないだろ？:
Next year has to be even better
than today, or you won't be
satisfied, right？
translations.もう来年のことを考えてくれてるの？:
You're already thinking about
next year？
translations.ああ。来年も一緒にお祝いしよう。:
Yeah. Let's celebrate together
next year, too.
translations.……うん。それ、今日１番のプレゼントだよ。今日は本当にありがとう。:
……Yeah. That's the best present
I've gotten all day.
Thank you so much for today.
translations.うん。残念だけど、ダメ出しする隙はないみたい。:
Yeah. Sadly, you didn't leave me
any room to nitpick.
translations.だってこんなに今日が楽しいと、明日は反動で寂しくなっちゃいそう。心配だなぁ。:
Well, today was so much fun,
the rebound tomorrow's gonna make me
so lonely. I'm actually worried.
translations.また来年があるよ。一緒にお祝いしよう。:
There's always next year.
Let's celebrate together again.
translations.１年も先じゃない。: That's a whole year away, though.
translations.１年後もまたあるって思えば、寂しくないだろ？:
If you know it's happening again
in a year, you won't feel lonely, right？
translations.口がうまいんだから……。でも、そうね。それでだまされてあげる。:
Look at you, smooth talker……
Well, all right.
I'll let you sweet-talk me.
translations.今日ももう終わりだね。帰りたくないな……。:
Today's already almost over.
I really don't wanna go home……
translations.困らせちゃった。言ってみただけだから、ね？:
Did I put you on the spot？
I was just teasing, okay？
translations.来年の誕生日もお祝いしよう。二人で。:
Let's celebrate your birthday again
next year. Just the two of us.
translations.来年かぁ。その次の年も、そのまた次の年も一緒？:
Next year, huh…… And the year after
that, and the year after that, too？
translations.そんなこと言われたらますます帰りたくなくなっちゃう。……でも、嬉しいな。:
If you say that, I'll want to go home
even less. ……Still, I'm really happy.
translations.じゃあ、最後にもう一度。誕生日おめでとう。:
Then, once more before we go.
Happy birthday.
translations.うん。今日は本当にありがとう。: Yeah. Thank you so much for today.
translations.ねぇ、笹の葉ってどこで手に入るのかな。お花屋さん？:
Hey, where do you think you can get
bamboo branches？ A flower shop？
translations.笹？ ああ、もうすぐ七夕か。: Bamboo？ Oh, Tanabata's coming up, huh.
translations.そう。あなたと私の短冊を飾ろうと思って。:
Yep. I was thinking we could hang up
wishing strips for you and me.
translations.そうよ。お願い事、何かあるでしょ？:
That's right.
You've got something to wish for,
don't you？
translations.まぁ、ないことはないけど……。: Well, it's not like I don't, but……
translations.笹は私が用意するね。そうだ、確か学校の裏庭に竹が生えてたような……。:
I'll get the bamboo.
Come to think of it, isn't
there bamboo growing
behind the school...？
translations.……勝手に取っちゃダメだぞ？:
...You can't just swipe it,
you know？
translations.取りません。もう、人を子供扱いして……。そんなことより短冊忘れちゃダメだからね？:
I won't! Geez, treating me
like a kid... Anyway, don't
forget your wish strip, okay？
translations.今日は晴れてよかったね。お願い事をするなら、天の川が見えるほうがいいもの。:
I'm glad it's clear today.
If you're making a wish,
it's so much better when
you can see the Milky Way.
translations.やっぱり雨だと願い事は叶わないのかな。:
I wonder if wishes really
don't come true if it rains.
translations.効果が薄れそうじゃない？ それで、短冊は用意した？:
Feels like they'd lose power,
doesn't it？ So, did you
bring your wish strip？
translations.あ……。やだもう、私とほとんど同じじゃない……。:
Ah... Oh no, this is almost
the exact same as mine...
translations.短冊、１枚でよかったかもね？:
Maybe one strip was enough
after all？
translations.ん……えっと、この１枚だけ？ 他はないの？:
Hmm... Wait, just this one？
Is there anything else？
translations.そんな欲張りじゃないよ。１枚で十分だろ？:
I'm not that greedy.
One is plenty, right？
translations.ふーん……これがあなたの願い事なんだ。:
Hmm... So this is
what you wished for.
translations.しょうがないなぁ。じゃあ、今すぐ書く。:
Guess I've got no choice.
I'll write one right now.
translations.わぁ、天の川がよく見える。今日は空気が澄んでるね。:
Wow, the Milky Way looks
so clear. The air's really
crisp tonight.
translations.今ごろ織姫と彦星が会ってるんだろうな。:
Orihime and Hikoboshi are
probably meeting right about
now.
translations.会えない時もずっと相手のことを考えてるんだろうね。あと半年で会える、あと１ヶ月で:
I bet they think about each
other the whole time they're
apart. 'Six months left,
just one month left'...
translations.１年に１回なんて、私には絶対無理。そんなことになったら私……。:
Once a year？ I could never
do that. If that happened
to us, I'd...
translations.……うん。もしって考えただけですごく怖くなるの。私もう、あなたなしじゃいられない:
...Yeah. Just thinking about
'what if' scares me so much.
I really can't be without
you anymore.
translations.……ねぇ、せめて七夕は毎年晴れるといいのにね？ 織姫と彦星が毎年必ず会えるように:
...Hey, don't you wish it'd
be clear every Tanabata？
So Orihime and Hikoboshi
could always meet.
translations.商店街に十羽野祭りのポスターが貼られてたよ。もうそろそろだね。:
They put up Towano Festival
posters down at the arcade.
It's almost time, isn't it？
translations.８月の第１日曜日から始まって、最終日曜日が本祭り。今年は今までで１番屋台の数が多:
It starts the first Sunday
in August, and the main
festival is the last Sunday.
They say there'll be more
stalls this year than ever!
translations.へぇ、すごいな。２人でどこまで回れるかな？:
Whoa, nice. Wonder how many
we can check out together？
translations.そのことだけど……やっぱり一緒に行くよね？:
About that... We're still
going together, right？
translations.そのつもりだけど。……もしかして誰かと約束しちゃった？:
That's the plan. ...Wait,
did you make plans with
someone else？
translations.ううん、まさか。でもね、十羽野祭りには恋人同士で行かないほうがいいってウワサがあ:
No, not at all. But there's
a rumor couples shouldn't go
to the Towano Festival
together...
translations.十羽野神社は恋愛の神様が祀られていて、恋人を見ると嫉妬して別れさせるんですって。:
Towano Shrine honors a love
deity, but they say the god
gets jealous of couples and
breaks them up. Sounds like
a real jealous god.
translations.（それ、恋愛の神様じゃなくて破壊の神様なんじゃ……）:
(That sounds less like a god
of love and more like a god
of destruction...)
translations.今日から十羽野祭りが始まるね。:
The Towano Festival starts
today, doesn't it.
translations.一緒にお祭りに行きたい気持ちはすごくあるのよ？ でも、どうしても十羽野神社の神様:
I really, really want to go
with you! But I just can't
stop worrying about the god
at Towano Shrine.
translations.恋愛の神様か。●はそんなウワサ聞いたことなかったけど。:
The god of love, huh？
● never heard of
any rumors like that.
translations.ホント？ 教室でもデキシーズでもウワサしてるよ。:
Really？ People are talking
about it in class,
and at Dixie's too.
translations.私の友達のお姉さんの友達は、十羽野神社に二人で初詣に行ったすぐ後に別れちゃったん:
My friend's sister's friend
went to Towano Shrine for
New Year's together, and
they broke up right after!
translations.うーん……。でも縁日に行くくらいなら構わないんじゃない？:
Hmm... But just going to
the festival stalls should
be fine, right？
translations.そうかな。……うん、本祭りはまだ先だし、縁日だけなら。:
You think？ ...Yeah, the
main festival's later on,
so just the stalls is fine.
translations.お待たせ。どう？:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
How do I look？
translations.お、浴衣だ。バッチリ似合ってる。さすが●のカノジョ！:
Ooh, a yukata!
It looks amazing on you.
That's ●'s girlfriend
for you!
translations.調子いいんだから。……ねぇ、恋愛の神様に嫉妬されないよね？ 大丈夫だよね？:
Oh, you flatterer...
Hey, the god of love won't
get jealous of us, right？
We'll be okay, right？
translations.ね、次は何しよっか。飴クジ？ 型抜き？ ハッカパイプ？:
So, what should we do next？
Candy lottery？ Katanuki？
Peppermint pipes？
translations.え～、どれも定番なのばっかりよ？ あ、それとも射的がいいかな。ほら、そこでやって:
Aw, those are all classics!
Or maybe the shooting
gallery？ Look, over there!
translations.ほら、走ると転ぶぞ。: Hey, you'll trip if you run!
translations.あー、子供扱いしたな。ナマイキだぞ！:
Ah, treating me like a kid!
Pretty cheeky of you!
translations.（はは、はしゃいでる。恋愛の神様のことは忘れたみたいだな）:
(Haha, she's having a blast.
Looks like she forgot about
the god of love.)
translations.十羽野祭り、今度の日曜日で最終か。●たちも行くよね？:
Towano Festival ends this
Sunday, huh. You and ●
are going too, right？
translations.そのつもりだけど、神社に近づくのはやめておこうね？ 手前までにしとこう？:
That's the plan, but let's
steer clear of the shrine,
okay？ Just stop before it？
translations.なんで？ ……あ、もしかして恋愛の神様？:
Why？ ...Ah, don't tell me,
the god of love？
translations.そう。ヤキモチ焼かれたら困るもの。どんなカップルも破局を迎えるってウワサなんだか:
Yeah. We can't have them
getting jealous! Rumor has it
every couple breaks up!
translations.私たち、絶対に目をつけられると思うの。だから……。:
I know we'll get targeted.
That's why...
translations.●たちは大丈夫だよ。どんな試練にも負けない！:
You and ● will be fine.
We won't lose to any trial!
translations.そうね、あなたがそう言うなら。……今のちょっとカッコよかったよ？:
Right, if you say so.
...That was actually pretty
cool just now, you know？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は……。あ、来た来た）:
(Wonder where ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is...
Ah, here she comes!)
translations.（いつ見てもいいなぁ、浴衣姿。周りに●のカノジョだって自慢したくなるよ……）:
(She always looks so good
in a yukata. I want to brag
to everyone that she's
●'s girlfriend...)
translations.もう、ボーッとしてどうしたの？:
Geez, spacing out already？
What's up？
translations.あっ、ごめん。えーと、行こうか。: Ah, sorry. Um, shall we go？
translations.あのね、手繋いでいい？ その……これから神社に向かうんでしょ？:
Um, can I hold your hand？
Like... we're heading toward
the shrine now, right？
translations.いいけど……もしかして恋愛の神様が怖い？:
Sure... But are you scared
of the god of love？
translations.ううん、あなたがいれば怖くない。……でも少し心細いから、ね？:
No, not when I'm with you.
...Just a little uneasy,
so please？
translations.中途半端なことお願いするより、きっぱり宣言しといたほうがいいと思って。恋愛の神様:
I thought a firm declaration
beat some halfhearted wish.
The god of love might be
testing you and ●, right？
translations.彼のこと大好きなんです。私、幸せになります！:
I love him with all my heart!
And I'm going to be happy!
translations.やっぱ夏は花火だよなー。:
Summer's just not summer
without fireworks.
translations.……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、またお参りのこと思い出してるだろ。:
...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're thinking
about our shrine visit
again, aren't you？
translations.だっておかしくて。周りの人たちも不思議な顔して見てたね。:
I can't help it,
it was just so funny.
Everyone around us gave us
such puzzled looks, too.
translations.そりゃね……。あれなら神様も呆れて嫉妬なんてしないよ。:
Well, yeah... Even the gods
would be too dumbfounded
to be jealous after that.
translations.嫌だ、それが狙いだったの？ もう……。:
No way, was that your plan
all along？ Jeez...
translations.私ね、あなたのカノジョで本当によかった。あなたになら、私……。:
You know, I'm really glad
I'm your girlfriend.
If it's with you, I...
translations.ううん、私たち最強カップルだねって言ったの。:
Oh, nothing! Just saying
we're the ultimate couple.
translations.クイズです。夏の風物詩と言えば？:
Pop quiz! What screams
summer more than anything？
translations.花火かな？ ……あ、もうすぐ花火大会だっけ。:
Fireworks, maybe？
...Oh, isn't the fireworks
festival coming up soon？
translations.ピンポーン、よくできました。ねぇ、行くでしょ？:
Ding-dong! Spot on!
Hey, we're going, right？
translations.もちろんいいよ。でも混みそうだな……。:
Sure, of course.
Though it's probably gonna
be pretty crowded...
translations.しょうがないわよ、とわの市の一大イベントだもん。もみくちゃになりながら見るのも醍:
Can't help that, it's one of
Towano City's biggest events.
Isn't getting jostled by the
crowd part of the fun？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲をもみくちゃにするわけにはいかないよ。:
I can't let ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ get
tossed around in the crowd.
translations.頼りがいのあるカレシが守ってくれるんでしょ？:
My dependable boyfriend'll
protect me, won't he？
translations.じゃあ安心して特攻できるね。ふふ、楽しみだな。:
Then we can charge right in
without a worry!
Hehe, I can't wait.
translations.（特攻って……。下調べしといたほうがよさそうだな）:
(Charge in...？ I'd better
scout things out beforehand.)
translations.お、浴衣だ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は和装も似合うなぁ。:
Ooh, a yukata! ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looks
great in traditional clothes.
translations.そうかな？ ありがとう。今日は混みそうだから、洋服のほうがいいかと思ったんだけど:
You think so？ Thank you.
I thought regular clothes
might be better since it'll
be crowded today, but...
translations.ふぅ、帯が苦しくなっちゃった。:
Phew, my obi is starting
to feel tight.
translations.ううん、ちょっと緩めたから平気。そろそろ花火が始まるね。:
No, I loosened it a bit,
so I'm fine.
The fireworks are starting
soon, aren't they？
translations.●につかまって。はぐれないように。:
Hold onto ●.
So you don't get separated.
translations.ちょっと押されただけだから。はぁ、見る前に疲れちゃいそう……。:
Someone just bumped into me.
Phew, I'm gonna be exhausted
before they even start...
translations.きれい……だけど、前の人の頭がちょっとだけ邪魔かな？:
Pretty... but the head
in front of me is kind
of in the way？
translations.終わっちゃったね。人も多いし、早めに移動しようか。:
They're over already.
It's so crowded, so let's
get moving early.
translations.この辺、人があまりいないけど……。:
There aren't many people
around here...
translations.ここならゆっくり見られると思って。:
I figured we could take
our time and watch from here.
translations.こんな穴場があったんだ。さすが、よく知ってるね。:
I didn't know this secret
spot existed! As expected,
you really know your stuff!
translations.お、そろそろ始まるみたいだぞ。:
Oh, looks like they're
about to start.
translations.きれい……。すごい、ここ特等席だね。:
It's so pretty...
Wow, these are the best
seats in the house！
translations.意外と知られてないもんだな。:
Guess not that many people
know about this spot.
translations.こんなにゼイタクな景色を二人占めしちゃっていいのかな……。:
Is it really okay for just
the two of us to keep such
a view all to ourselves...？
translations.……あっ、今の見た？ 花火がハート型だったよ。:
...Ah, did you see that？
That firework was
heart-shaped！
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、喜んでくれてる。下調べしといて正解だったな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s having a blast.
Doing my research beforehand
definitely paid off.)
translations.はぁ、満喫……。やっぱり夏は花火だね。:
Haa, I loved every second...
Fireworks really are
what summer's all about.
translations.そうだな。ここからならそう混まないだろうし、散歩でもしながら帰ろうか。:
Yeah. It shouldn't be too
crowded leaving from here,
so want to walk home？
translations.余韻に浸りながら、ね。:
While soaking up
the afterglow, right？
translations.花火が終わると、夏が終わった気がするな……。:
Once the fireworks end,
it really feels like
summer's over...
translations.ちょっとね。でも秋は秋で楽しいことが待ってるから。:
A little. But fall has
plenty of fun things
waiting for us too.
translations.楽しいこと……焼き芋とか？:
Fun things...
Like roasted sweet potatoes？
translations.そうそう……そうじゃなくて。:
Yeah, totally... Wait,
that's not what I meant！
translations.はは、元気になった。:
Haha, that perked
you right up.
translations.もう……あなたには敵わないな。:
Geez... I really can't
win with you.
translations.今日はどうもありがとう。花火、また来年も行こうね。:
Thanks so much for today.
Let's go see the fireworks
again next year, okay？
translations.今朝のホームルームで、体育祭の出場種目が決まったの。:
In homeroom this morning,
we decided what events we're
doing for Sports Day.
translations.●もだよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は何に出ることになったの？:
So did ●.
What did ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ end up
entering？
translations.プログラムに沿って種目を読みあげたり、選手に集合を呼びかけたり……。:
Reading out events from
the program, calling the
competitors to assemble...
translations.それはわかるけど……。運動種目には出ないってこと？:
I get that, but...
You mean you're not doing
any athletic events？
translations.アナウンスが忙しくてとてもとても。しょうがないわよね。……それで？ あなたは何に:
I'll be way too busy with
announcements for that！
Nothing can be done.
...So？ What are you doing？
translations.わぁ、ハードだね。じゃあ騎馬戦のアナウンスには気合い入れなくちゃ。:
Whoa, intense！ Guess I'll
have to put extra passion
into your announcement, then.
translations.（嬉しそう……運動苦手だもんな）:
(She looks thrilled... Well,
she's not great at sports.)
translations.あーあー、ただいまマイクのテスト中～。:
Testing, testing...
Mic check in progress~.
translations.これでも体育祭の練習中なのよ？:
Believe it or not, I'm
practicing for Sports Day,
you know？
translations.バカなことやってるなーなんて思ってるでしょ。:
You're thinking I'm doing
something totally silly,
aren't you？
translations.思ってないよ。むしろ当日はずっと本部で待機してなきゃならないから、大変じゃない？:
Not at all. In fact, since
you have to stay at HQ
all day, won't it be tough？
translations.友達はみんな、アナウンスは楽でいいね、なんて言うのよ？ 誰も候補者がいないから率:
My friends all say things like,
'Announcing must be nice and
easy,' you know？
Even though I stepped up
because nobody volunteered!
Don't you think that's mean？
translations.（まぁ、普通は競技に出たいよな……）:
(Well, normally people
would rather compete in
the events, though...)
translations.明日の段取り確認と、これから設営を手伝うことになってるの。あなたは騎馬戦の練習？:
Confirming tomorrow's plans,
and I'm helping with setup
next. Cavalry battle practice？
translations.うん。最後の作戦会議中。:
Yeah. We're having our
final strategy meeting.
translations.ふふ、気合い入ってるね。ハードな種目なんだから、ケガしたりしないようにね？:
Fufu, you're really into it.
It's a rough event, so make
sure you don't get hurt, okay？
translations.はーい。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もノド大事にな。:
Got it.
Take care of your voice
too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ありがとう。のど飴常備だから大丈夫。:
Thanks. I keep throat drops
handy, so I'll be fine.
translations.……あ、呼ばれてるから行くね？ 騎馬戦、頑張って。:
...Ah, they're calling me,
so I gotta run, okay？
Good luck in the cavalry battle.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、おはよう。いよいよだな。:
Morning, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
The big day's finally here,
huh？
translations.……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、表情が硬いぞ？:
...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're looking
a little tense？
translations.少し緊張しちゃって。これから開会宣言でしょ？ 声がひっくり返ったらどうしよう……:
I'm a little nervous.
The opening speech is next,
right？ What if my voice
cracks...？
translations.それはそれで、かわいくていいんじゃない？:
Wouldn't that be kinda cute
in its own way？
translations.もう、他人事だと思って……。:
Geez, easy for you to say
when it's not you...
translations.練習、頑張ってたじゃないか。大丈夫、大丈夫。:
