You practiced so hard.
You'll be fine, seriously.
translations.うん……。そうだね、あなたにそう言われたら大丈夫っていう気がしてきた。:
Yeah... You're right.
Hearing you say that makes me
feel like I'll be okay.
translations.そうそう。失敗したらなぐさめてあげるから。な？:
That's the spirit. If you
mess up, I'll comfort you.
Deal？
translations.もう。せっかく大丈夫な気がしてきたのに、またプレッシャーかけないの。:
Geez! Just when I was
starting to feel better...
Don't go putting pressure
on me again.
translations.今日は晴天に恵まれ、絶好の体育祭日和となりました。練習の成果をしっかり発揮するこ:
Blessed with clear skies,
today is perfect weather for
our Sports Day.
While showing the results
of our practice is important,
please take care not to get hurt.
Let's do our best today!
translations.それではこれより、十羽野高校体育祭を開始します。:
And with that, the Towano High
Sports Day officially begins!
translations.（……ちょっとハラハラしたけど、完璧な開会宣言だったな）:
(...I was on edge for a sec,
but that was a flawless
opening speech.)
translations.（よし、●も頑張るぞ！）:
(All right, I'll give it my all
too, ●!)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。もしかして応援に来てくれた？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Did you come to
cheer me on？
translations.うん。放送席からもこっそり応援してるから。頑張って！:
Yep. I'll be secretly
cheering for you from the booth,
too. Do your best!
translations.次は午前最後の種目、２年生男子による騎馬戦です！:
Next up is the final event
of the morning: the second-year
boys' cavalry battle!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の声、心なしか気合い入ってた……かな？）:
(Was it just me, or was
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s voice extra fired up
just now...？)
translations.（よし、やるぞ。作戦通りやれば勝てるはず！）:
(All right, let's do this.
Stick to the plan, and
we should win!)
translations.止まるな、一気に攻めろ！:
Don't stop!
Charge 'em all at once!
translations.見てたよ、おめでとう。強かったね。:
I saw! Congratulations.
You guys were so tough!
translations.まあな。作戦勝ちってとこかな。:
Heh, yeah. Guess our
strategy paid off.
translations.えばっちゃって。本当にお疲れさま。:
Look at you, all proud of
yourself. But really, great
job out there.
translations.お腹すいたでしょ？ お弁当作って来たから、一緒に食べよう。:
You must be hungry, right？
I made us lunch, so let's
eat together.
translations.惜しかったね。ほんのちょっとの差だったよ。:
That was so close!
It was really down to
the wire.
translations.かっこいいとこ見せたかったんだけど……。:
I really wanted to look cool
for you, but...
translations.時の運もあるもの。ね、気分切り替えなくちゃ。:
Sometimes luck just isn't on
your side. Come on, let's
shake it off, okay？
translations.お弁当作って来たの。一緒に食べよう？:
I made us lunch.
Want to eat together？
translations.体育祭の最後は、全学年参加のフォークダンスです。:
The final event of our
Sports Day is the folk dance,
open to all grades.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、まだ本部にいるのか。フォークダンスにも参加しないのかな……）:
(Is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ still over at HQ？
Is she not going to join
in the folk dance...？)
translations.（……あ、向こうに▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいる。この分だと回ってきそうだな）: （...Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s over there. Looks like she'll rotate to me at this rate.）
translations.アナウンスの後、急いで輪に加わったの。よろしくね？: I rushed to join the circle right after the announcement. Be nice to me, okay？
translations.こんな風に踊るのって、なんだかくすぐったい感じがするね。: Dancing like this feels a little ticklish, doesn't it？
translations.きゃっ、ごめんなさい、踏んじゃった……。私、緊張してるのかな？: Ah, I'm sorry! I stepped on your foot... Am I nervous or something？
translations.気にするなって。いてて……ははは。: Don't worry about it. Ow, ow... haha.
translations.ふふ……やだ、楽しい。: Hehe... oh gosh, this is fun.
translations.これで、体育祭の全プログラムを終了します。みなさん、お疲れさまでした。: This concludes all events for the sports festival. Thank you everyone for your hard work!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、お疲れさま。最後まで大変だったな。: Good work, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. It was hectic right to the end, huh.
translations.思ったより忙しかったけど、やり終えたって感じがする。体育祭もいいものだね？: It was busier than I expected, but it feels like an accomplishment. Sports festivals aren't so bad, are they？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が珍しいこと言ってる……。: That's rare coming from you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.もう、どういう意味？ ……あなたもお疲れさま。今日はゆっくり休んでね。: Hey, what's that supposed to mean？ ...Good work to you too. Make sure you get plenty of rest today, okay？
translations.今月末に学校でハロウィンパーティがあるの、聞いた？: Did you hear there's a Halloween party at school at the end of the month？
translations.ホームルームでそんなこと言ってたな。自由参加だっけ？: They mentioned that in homeroom. It's optional, right？
translations.私もあなたが行くならって思ってたの。じゃあ、さっそく仮装の準備をしないと。: I was thinking the same thing—only if you go. Then we'd better start getting our costumes ready right away!
translations.やるからには本気で臨まなくちゃ。ハロウィンならやっぱり……。: If we're doing it, we have to go all out! For Halloween, it's gotta be...
translations.仮装ってどんなのがいいと思う？\nいろいろ考えすぎちゃって、\n決め切れなくて。:
What costume do you like？
I've been overthinking it,
and I just can't decide.
translations.そうだな、●の好みとしては……。: Let's see, my preference for ● would be...
translations.そっか、そういうのがいいんだ。うん、参考にさせてもらうね？: I see, so that's what you like. Okay, I'll definitely keep that in mind, okay？
translations.（どんな格好をしてくるんだろう……）: (I wonder what kind of costume she'll wear...)
translations.なあに、その反応。この格好でここまで来るの、すごーく勇気が必要だったんだから。: What's with that reaction？ It took a looot of courage to come all the way here dressed like this, you know!
translations.それはそうだろうな……。でも、よく似合ってる。: I bet it did... But it really suits you.
translations.ありがと。あなたもすっごく素敵▼: Thanks. You look really great too, ▼
translations.あまり思い切った格好はできなかったけど……。: I couldn't really bring myself to do anything too bold, though...
translations.あなたのそういう姿、滅多に見られないもの。それだけで得した気分。: I hardly ever get to see you dressed up like that. Just seeing it feels like a real treat.
translations.あとでちょっとメイクしてあげる。どうせならもっと本格的にね？: I'll do your makeup a bit later. If we're doing this, we might as well make it look authentic, right？
translations.ねえ、見た？ 先生もみんな仮装してるの。: Hey, did you see？ Even the teachers are all in costume.
translations.見た見た。校長先生もしてた。: I saw! Even the principal had a costume on.
translations.仮装は自由って言ってたわりに、生徒もみんなしてるね。うちの学校ってノリがいいみた: Considering they said costumes were optional, pretty much all the students dressed up too. Guess our school really knows how to get into the spirit.
translations.●たちもその一員だけどな。: We're definitely part of that crowd too, though, ●.
translations.ホントだ。……あ、ごめんね。呼ばれてるみたい。: That's true. ...Ah, sorry. Looks like someone's calling me.
translations.また写真じゃない？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、さっきから引っ張りダコだな。: Another photo, maybe？ You've been in high demand all day, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.このコスチューム、そんなに珍しいのかな……。ちょっとだけ行ってくるね。すぐ戻って: Is this costume really that unusual...？ I'll go check it out for a second. I'll be right back.
translations.（かわいいからだと思う……）: (Pretty sure it's just because you look so cute...)
translations.ふーん、やっぱり夜の校舎って雰囲気あるわね。: Hmm, the school at night really has an atmosphere, doesn't it？
translations.ハロウィンのイベントで肝試しっていうのも珍しいよね……。: A test of courage for a Halloween event is kind of unusual, though...
translations.楽しいからいいじゃない。でも、こんな格好じゃお化けが驚いちゃうんじゃないかな。: It's fun, so why not？ But dressed like this, we might end up scaring the ghosts instead.
translations.どうせなら、みんな出て来ちゃえばいいのにね？: Since we're here, wouldn't it be fun if they all came out？
translations.うん。この格好なら仲間に入れてくれて、一緒に遊べるかもしれないじゃない。: Yup. In these costumes, maybe they'd let us join in and hang out with them.
translations.でも日本のお化けって仲良く遊ぶイメージじゃないわよね。一緒にうらめしや～っていう: Then again, Japanese ghosts don't seem like the friendly type. Though chanting 'curse youuu~' together could be fun...
translations.どうして？ ……あ、もしかしてあなたは怖いんだ？ もう、かわいすぎるぞ▼: Why would I be？ ...Wait, don't tell me you're scared？ Jeez, you're just too cute, ▼
translations.（こういう時の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は頼りになりすぎる……）: (▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is way too dependable at times like this...)
translations.文化祭の準備、そろそろ追い込みだね。あなたのクラスは喫茶店だった？: Festival prep is really coming down to the wire, huh. Your class was doing a café, right？
translations.うん、それが準備大変そうでさ。: Yeah, and getting everything together has been pretty rough.
translations.みんな気合い入ってて、内装凝りすぎちゃって。: Everyone got way too fired up and went overboard on the decor.
translations.心配だな……。身体、こわさないようにね？: Now I'm worried... Don't go working yourself sick, okay？
translations.ありがとう。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のほうは？: Thanks. How about your class, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うちのクラスも喫茶店なんだけど、私はメニュー作成と買い出し担当だから、当日は一日: My class is doing a café too, but I was in charge of the menu and shopping, so I'm completely free on the day.
translations.そうなんだ。じゃあ一緒に回れるといいな。: Oh, nice. Then I hope we can look around together.
translations.そうね。でも忙しいんでしょ？ 無理しないでいいから、ね？: I'd love that. But you're going to be busy, right？ Don't push yourself too hard, okay？
translations.（前準備さえしっかりやっとけば、大丈夫だよな……）: (As long as we prep properly beforehand, it should be fine...)
translations.（文化祭まであと１日……。\nやっぱり徹夜だな）:
(One day till the festival...
Looks like an all-nighter
after all.)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nクラスの出し物の準備、\nまだ終わらない？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Still not done setting up
for your class？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。\nうん……。\nやっぱり男子だけ\n全員泊まることになりそう。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Yeah... Looks like all
the guys are going to
have to stay the night.
translations.そうなんだ……。\n少しでもいいから\n睡眠は取ってね？ \nあとでメールするか:
I see...
Make sure you get some
sleep, even just a bit,
okay？ I'll text you later.
translations.●のことは\n気にしなくていいから。\n今のうち頑張っとけば、\n明日は一緒にま:
Don't worry about me,
●.
If I push through now,
we can hang out tomorrow.
translations.明日のことは明日考えましょ。\nそれより夜は冷えるから\nちゃんとあったかくする:
We'll worry about tomorrow
tomorrow. More importantly,
it gets cold at night, so
make sure you stay warm.
If you get lonely or it
gets too tough, you can
call me anytime, okay？
translations.もう、\nカノジョに向かって\n母親はないでしょ。:
Geez.
Calling your girlfriend
your mom is just wrong!
translations.はは、ごめん。\n心配してくれてありがとう。:
Haha, sorry.
Thanks for worrying
about me.
translations.（眠い……でもなんとか間に合った！）: (I'm so sleepy... but we made it in time!)
translations.ああ、なんとかね。わざわざありがと。:
Yeah, somehow.
Thanks for checking in.
translations.ごめんね、忙しいときに電話して。できるだけ休むのよ？:
Sorry to call while
you're busy. Make sure
you get some rest, okay？
translations.そうする。モーニングコールありがと。●は今から寝るんだけど。:
Will do. Thanks for the
wake-up call. Even though
●'s heading to sleep.
translations.ふふ、そうだね。じゃあ、またあとで。:
Hehe, that's true.
See you later, then.
translations.合宿用の毛布借りてきたぞー。:
I borrowed some camp
blankets for us!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も心配してくれてるし、なるべく睡眠とっとくか……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s worried about
me too, so I should try
to get some sleep...)
translations.おはよう。少しは眠れた？:
Good morning.
Did you get any sleep？
translations.うん。午前中は時間が空いたから、一緒に回ろうよ。:
Yeah. I'm free this
morning, so let's check
things out together.
translations.あ、映画研究会も出てるんだ。何やってるのかな……。:
Oh, the Film Club has an
exhibit too. I wonder
what they're showing...
translations.なんだか面白そう。ねぇ、入ってみようよ。:
That looks like fun.
Hey, let's check it out.
translations.はぁ、堪能……。まさか学校の展示でアリオ・ダルジェントにスポットを当てるなんて、:
Ah, so satisfying... To
think a school exhibit
spotlighted Ario Dargento!
They really get it.
translations.ホラー映画特集って……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のための展示みたいだったな。:
A horror movie feature...
It was like an exhibit
made just for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そうよね。もう、なんで早く教えてくれなかったんだろ。知ってたらいろいろ協力したの:
Right？ Jeez, why didn't
anyone tell me sooner？
If I'd known, I would've
helped them out.
translations.さてと、次はどうしようか。:
All right, where should
we go next？
translations.ここ、何だろう。世界記念写真コーナーって書いてあるけど……。:
I wonder what this is.
It says 'World Souvenir
Photo Corner'...
translations.写真部みたいだな。入ってみるか。:
Looks like the Photo Club.
Wanna go in？
translations.いらっしゃいませ、ようこそ写真部へ！:
Welcome! Welcome to the
Photography Club!
translations.あれ？ ここ、スタジオっぽいような……。:
Huh？ This place looks kind
of like a studio...
translations.じゃあさっそく選んで！:
All right, go ahead and
make your pick!
translations.オッケー！ じゃあ彼女はこっちで着替えて！:
All right! Miss, you go
change over here!
translations.君はカメラ持って待っててね！:
You hold the camera and
wait right here!
translations.撮影は１枚までね。どうぞ！:
You only get one photo.
Go ahead!
translations.ありがとうございましたー！ また来てねー！:
Thanks for stopping by!
Come again!
translations.……嵐のようだった。でもいい記念になったな。:
...That was a whirlwind.
Made a great keepsake,
though.
translations.もう、私ばっかりあんな格好させて……。どうせなら同じ格好したあなたの写真も欲しか:
Jeez, making only me dress
up like that... I wanted
a photo of you wearing it
too, you know.
translations.お、そろそろ時間だ。ごめん、クラスに戻るよ。:
Oh, looks like it's time.
Sorry, gotta get back
to my class.
translations.思ったより回れたね。じゃあ、午後も頑張って。:
We saw more than I
thought we would.
Good luck this afternoon!
translations.あ、いたいた！ 悪い、クラスの方が色々トラブっててさ。手伝ってくれよ！:
There you are! Sorry, but 
things are a mess with our 
class. Come help out!
translations.……残念。仕事、入っちゃったね。がんばれ！:
...Aw, too bad. Duty calls, 
huh？ Hang in there!
translations.もうちょっと回れると思ったんだけどな……。ごめん、行ってくるよ。:
I thought we'd get to look 
around a bit more... 
Sorry, I gotta go.
translations.お待たせしました。アップルパイ２つとレアチーズケーキ、ホットコーヒー、アイスコー:
Thank you for waiting! 
Two apple pies, one rare 
cheesecake, hot coffee, 
iced coffee, and lemon tea.
translations.（喫茶店なんていっぱいあるから暇だと思ったのに……なんかめちゃくちゃ忙しいぞ!?:
(With so many cafes around, 
I thought we'd be dead... 
Why are we so crazy busy!?)
translations.あっ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。今何か……。:
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. 
Did you need something...？
translations.いいの、忙しいんでしょ？ 適当に座ってメニュー見てるから……。:
Don't mind me, you're busy, 
right？ I'll just find a seat 
and look at the menu...
translations.ご注文を繰り返します。ケーキセット２つで、レモンパイとチョコレートシフォン、ホッ:
Let me repeat your order. 
Two cake sets: lemon pie, 
chocolate chiffon, and two 
hot coffees. Is that right？
translations.ふぅ。ようやく落ち着いたね。:
Phew. It's finally calmed 
down, hasn't it？
translations.ごめん、まさか最後まで手伝ってもらうことになるなんて……。:
Sorry about that. I never 
thought you'd end up helping 
until the very end...
translations.私のほうこそ勝手にごめんなさい。あなたと一緒にできると思ったら、楽しくなっちゃっ:
I should apologize for 
butting in! But working 
together with you was 
just so much fun.
translations.みんな助かったって言ってるよ。上級生だからって少し恐縮してたみたいだけど。:
Everyone said you were 
a huge help. Though they 
seemed kind of intimidated 
by an upperclassman.
translations.すっごく優しくていい先輩だよってアピールしておいて？ ふふ。:
Make sure you let them know 
their senpai is super sweet 
and kind, okay？ Fufu.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。反省会やったら終わりかな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. 
Just a wrap-up meeting, 
and then I'm done.
translations.じゃあ夜は大丈夫なんだ。ねぇ、一緒に花火を見ない？:
So your evening is free! 
Hey, want to watch the 
fireworks together？
translations.後夜祭の？ みんなでグラウンドで見るんじゃないの？:
For the after-party？ Aren't 
we supposed to watch from 
the field with everyone？
translations.二人きりじゃないと意味ないじゃない。……ね？:
There's no point unless 
it's just the two of us. 
...Right？
translations.静かだね。さっきまであんなにたくさん人がいたのに、なんだか不思議……。:
It's so quiet. There were 
so many people just a bit ago, 
it feels so strange...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が二人きりで見たいって言うからさ。:
Well, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ wanted to watch 
them just the two of us.
translations.まあね。昨日からずっとアタフタしてたし。:
Well, yeah. I've been 
rushing around like crazy 
since yesterday.
translations.よしよし、大変よく頑張りました。:
There, there. 
You did such a good job.
translations.ほら、花火もお疲れさまだって。:
Look, even the fireworks 
are saying 'good job' to you.
translations.ご褒美がいっぱいだな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に、花火に。:
That's a lot of rewards. 
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, the fireworks...
translations.私もなんだ。本当にお疲れさま。:
Same for me. 
You really worked hard.
translations.最近ね、気がつくとクリスマスソングを口ずさんでるの。:
Lately, I catch myself 
humming Christmas songs 
without even realizing it.
translations.わかるわかる。あちこちでかかってるしな。:
I get it. They're playing 
everywhere, after all.
translations.……去年のこと思い出しちゃった。もらったプレゼント、ずっと大事にしてるんだよ。:
...It made me think of 
last year. I still treasure 
the present you gave me.
translations.それ、今年のハードルを上げてる？:
Are you raising the bar 
for this year？
translations.そんなことないわよ？ あ、もう何か考えてくれてるんだ。:
Not at all! ...Oh？ 
Does that mean you're already 
thinking of something？
translations.とぼけちゃって。プレゼントなんてなくてもあなたがいればいいの。: Playing dumb, are we？ Even without a present, having you with me is plenty.
translations.（やっぱりハードル上げてる気がする……）: (Yep, definitely feel like she's raising the bar...)
translations.ここにクリスマスツリーがあれば、もっと盛り上がるのにね？: Wouldn't it feel so much more festive if we had a Christmas tree here？
translations.まだ早くない？: Isn't it a little early for that？
translations.そんなことないよ、私の教室にも、もう飾ってあるのよ。先生がモミの木をもらってきた: Not at all! Our classroom has one up already. Our teacher brought in a fir tree, so we all decorated it together.
translations.すでに毎日クリスマス気分♪ 家にも小さなツリーを飾ってるの。それと、ドアにはリー: I've been in the Christmas spirit every day already♪ I put up a little tree at home, too. And a wreath on the door.
translations.すごいな。うちは何もないよ。: That's impressive. We don't have anything up at my place.
translations.そうなの？ せっかくのクリスマスなのに、もったいないなぁ。: Really？ But it's Christmas, that's such a waste!
translations.●は１人見るだけだし、別に……。: I mean, ● would be the only one seeing it anyway, so...
translations.ないよりあったほうがいいじゃない。帰りにでもお店に寄ってみない？ こういうのは楽: Having something is way better than nothing, isn't it？ Why don't we stop by a shop on the way home？ With this sort of thing, the one who has the most fun wins!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は全力で楽しんでるな……）: (▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ sure is going all out to enjoy it...)
translations.もうすぐクリスマス本番だね。: It's almost Christmas for real, huh.
translations.イブは学校でパーティがあるんだっけ？: There's a party at school on Christmas Eve, right？
translations.そうね、ゲームの企画なんかもあるみたい。どうしよっか。: Yeah, looks like they have games planned and everything. What should we do？
translations.どうしようって、せっかくなんだし行こうよ。: What do you mean 'what should we do'？ It's a special occasion, let's go!
translations.私は２人きりのクリスマスもいいと思うんだけどなぁ。: I kind of thought spending Christmas just the two of us would be nice too, though.
translations.２人きりは、パーティの前にどうかな。: How about just the two of us before the party？
translations.もちろん。じゃあ、ちょっと早めに待ち合わせだな。: Of course. Let's meet up a bit early, then.
translations.うん▼ クリスマスはずっとあなたと一緒だね。なんだか一足先にクリスマスプレゼント: Yay▼ I get to be with you all through Christmas. It feels like I got an early Christmas present.
translations.メリークリスマス。じゃあ行こうか。: Merry Christmas. Shall we get going, then？
translations.さすがに今日は人が多いな。ここでよかったの？: There sure are a lot of people today. Are you sure this place is okay？
translations.クリスマスデートの定番でしょ？\n本当は夜のほうがきれいだと\n思うんだけど。:
It's a classic Christmas date,
right？ Though I think it'd be
prettier at night, really.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいいならいいよ。寒くない？: If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is happy with it, then so am I. Aren't you cold？
translations.寒いよ。だから……ね？: I am cold. So... you know？
translations.あったかい。……ベイブリッジの下、寄りそうカップル。これも定番だね？: So warm... A couple snuggling under the Bay Bridge. That's another classic, right？
translations.定番にこだわるなぁ。: You're really into the classics, huh.
translations.定番って意識しないとなかなか実行しないものよ？ どうせなら定番って言われてるもの: You never actually do classic stuff unless you make an effort, you know？ If we're doing this, I want to try all the classics!
translations.そろそろいい時間だね。: It's getting to be about that time, huh.
translations.行くか、学校。: Shall we head to school, then？
translations.ふふ、しょうがないなって顔しちゃって。もっと２人きりがよかった？: Hehe, look at that reluctant face. Did you want more time just the two of us？
translations.結構参加者が多いんだ。あ、クラスの友達もみんな来てる……。: There are quite a few people here. Oh, my classmates are all here too...
translations.ま、あんまり邪魔しても悪いか。じゃあね。:
Well, I'd feel bad getting
in the way. See ya.
translations.……なんか緊張したな。何か飲む？:
...Man, I got so nervous.
Want something to drink？
translations.いやあ、カノジョの友達ってなんかさ。上級生だし。:
Well, it's your friend...
Plus she's an upperclassman,
and all.
translations.ふふ、ヘンなの。堂々としてればいいのに。:
Hehe, you're silly.
Just act confident!
translations.あとでビンゴ大会をするので、カードを１枚とってください。:
We're holding a bingo game
later, so please take a card.
translations.じゃあ、私も１枚。何か当たるといいな。:
I'll take one too, then.
Hope I win something!
translations.それじゃ、なくさずに持っててくださいねー。:
Make sure you don't lose it,
alright？
translations.それではこれからお待ちかね、ビンゴ大会をはじめまーす！:
And now, the moment you've
all been waiting for...
Time for bingo!
translations.こういうの、ろくに当たったためしがないのよね。クジ運悪くて。:
I never really win at these.
My luck's pretty terrible.
translations.今日は当たるかもしれないよ。:
Maybe today'll be your
lucky day.
translations.どうかなぁ。私が当たるより、あなたが当たって喜ぶ顔が見たいかも。:
I wonder. But honestly, I'd
rather see you win and look
all happy.
translations.あれ？ あ、ビンゴ！ 私ビンゴです!!:
Huh？ Ah, bingo!
I got bingo!!
translations.へぇ、▲アイテム名▲か。結構いいもの用意してるな……。:
Oh, ▲アイテム名▲？
They've got some pretty
nice stuff...
translations.それではこれでビンゴ大会終了です。みなさん、お疲れさまでした！:
And that wraps up our bingo!
Thanks for playing,
everyone!
translations.クリスマスパーティ、楽しかったね。プレゼントも当たっちゃったし。:
The Christmas party was fun,
wasn't it？ And we both
even won prizes!
translations.ねぇ、時間、まだ大丈夫でしょ？:
Hey, you don't have to
head back just yet, right？
translations.せっかくのクリスマスだもの。ギリギリまであなたと一緒にいたいな。:
It's Christmas, after all.
I want to stay with you
until the last second.
translations.わぁ……。クリスマスはやっぱり夜が本番だね。:
Wow... Nighttime is when
Christmas really starts, huh？
translations.最近のイルミネーションはすごいなぁ。:
Christmas lights these days
are really incredible.
translations.もう、オジサンみたいなこと言って。:
Geez, listen to you talking
like an old man.
translations.はは、最近の若者にはついていけませんよ。:
Haha, I just can't keep up
with the youth these days.
translations.やだ、もう。そんなこと言ってるとホントにオジサンになっちゃうんだから。:
Oh, stop it. If you keep
saying that, you really will
turn into an old man.
translations.あのね、プレゼント用意してるの。:
You know... I actually
got you a present.
translations.ねぇ、クリスマスと言えば？:
Hey, what comes to mind
when you think of Christmas？
translations.当たり。もちろん、用意してるんでしょ？:
Bingo. You've got one ready
for me of course, right？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も？ じゃあ、交換しようか。:
You have one for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ too？
Then let's trade.
translations.お、サンキュー。●もあるんだ。:
Oh, thanks! ● have
one for you too.
translations.あ、用意してくれてたんだ。: Oh, you got one for me！
translations.わぁ、これ欲しかったの。言ったことあったかな？ どうもありがとう。:
Wow, I really wanted this!
Did I mention it before？
Thank you so much!
translations.こんなにいいものもらっちゃったら、素直に喜ぶしかできないじゃない。ありがとう。:
When you give me something
this nice, I can't help but
be thrilled. Thank you.
translations.素敵……。あなたのセンスに感心させられてばっかり。大事にするね？:
It's lovely... I'm always
so impressed by your taste.
I'll treasure it, okay？
translations.わぁ、どうもありがとう。大事にするね。:
Wow, thank you so much.
I'll treasure it.
translations.あ、これいいね。どうもありがとう。:
Oh, this is nice!
Thank you so much.
translations.あなたが選んでくれたっていうだけで嬉しい。どうもありがとう。:
Just knowing you picked it
out makes me happy.
Thank you so much.
translations.これ、私にだよね？ そっか……。ううん、どうもありがとう。:
This is for me, right？
I see... No, thank you.
translations.……これ？ ありがとう……。欲しいもの伝えておくべきだったかな……。:
...This？ Thank you...
Maybe I should've told you
what I wanted...
translations.これ……。あなたって時々びっくりするようなものくれるのね。:
This is... You really give
me surprising things
sometimes.
translations.その、交換とか、しない？:
Um... want to, like...
exchange anything？
translations.ううん、いいの。こっちのことだから……。:
No, it's nothing.
Just talking to myself...
translations.（……もしかしてプレゼント？ 用意しとけばよかったかな）:
(...Could she mean presents？
Maybe I should've
gotten one...)
translations.え？ パーティには行ったし、イルミネーションは見たし……。:
Huh？ We went to the party,
and we saw the lights...
translations.（何か用意するべきものがあったような……）:
(Feels like there was
something I was supposed
to have ready...)
translations.はは、いい子にしてたら●たちもサンタさんにもらえるかな。:
Haha, if we're good, maybe
Santa will bring ● and
you a present too.
translations.時間、遅くなっちゃったな。ごめん、気付かなくて……。:
It got really late.
Sorry, I lost track of time...
translations.大丈夫よ。あなたが送ってくれるじゃない。:
It's okay. You're walking me
home, aren't you？
translations.そうだけど……。次からはちゃんと気をつけるよ。:
I am, but... I'll make sure
to be more careful next time.
translations.本当にいいんだったら。あなたと会うと、最後はいつも帰る時間を気にしてばかりでしょ:
I really don't mind.
Whenever we're together,
you always worry about
the time at the end, right？
Just for Christmas, I wish...
translations.……困らせたいわけじゃないの。ただ１分でも長くあなたと一緒にいたいだけ。:
...I don't mean to
trouble you. I just want
to be with you for even
one minute longer.
translations.●もそうだよ。今日はいつもより長く一緒にいられたかな。:
● feel the same way.
At least we got to stay
together longer today.
translations.うん。だからもう帰らなきゃね。:
Yeah. So I guess I really
have to head home now.
translations.いつか帰らないでもいい日がきたら……。:
If only a day would come
when I didn't have to
go home...
translations.……ううん、今日はありがとう。メリークリスマス。:
...No, never mind.
Thanks for today.
Merry Christmas.
translations.クリスマスまであと何日って数えるのが楽しかったのに、もうおしまいかぁ。:
Counting down the days to
Christmas was so much fun,
and now it's all over, huh.
translations.明日からまた数えればいいんじゃない？:
Can't we just start counting
down again tomorrow？
translations.次のクリスマスまで、あと３６５日？ もう、気が長すぎるよ。:
365 days until the next
Christmas？ Geez, you have
way too much patience.
translations.はは。でもそんなに楽しみにしてたんだ。:
Haha. But you were really
looking forward to it
that much.
translations.本当かなぁ。やっと終わったーなんて思ってるんじゃない？:
I wonder about that~ Aren't
you secretly thinking,
'Finally, it's over'？
translations.できれば別れたくないなって思ってる。:
Actually, I wish we didn't
have to say goodbye.
translations.……もう、最後にそんなこと言うなんて反則だよ？:
...Geez, saying that at the
very end is foul play,
you know？
translations.……サンタさん、飛んでないね。:
...No Santa flying through
the sky, huh.
translations.結構いい時間だし、もう帰っちゃったかな？:
It's pretty late, so maybe
he already went home？
translations.私はもうプレゼントをもらったからいいんだ。クリスマスにあなたをくださいってお願い:
I already got my present,
so it's fine. I asked Santa
for you this Christmas.
translations.あれ、じゃあ●のとこにもサンタが来たんだ。:
Wait, so Santa came to
●'s place, too.
translations.じゃあ、持って帰っていいよ。:
Well then, you're welcome
to take me home with you.
translations.最後にびっくり顔をプレゼントされちゃった。メリークリスマス▼:
I got to see your surprised
face as a parting gift.
Merry Christmas, ▼.
translations.知ってる？ イベントホールで年越しのカウントダウンがあるんだって。:
Did you know？ Apparently
they're having a New Year's
countdown at the event hall.
translations.どうして？ 一晩中一緒にいられるチャンスでしょ。そんなの、カウントダウンっていう:
Why not？ It's a chance to
spend all night together.
We'd need an excuse like
a countdown anyway, right？
translations.●はまぁいいけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が怒られるんじゃない？:
● might be fine, but
won't ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ get in trouble？
translations.そうね、バイトのシフトは確認しておかないと。:
Good point, I'll need to
check my work shift.
translations.いやいや、それより親を……。:
No no, I meant with your
parents...
translations.そうだ、あなたのシフトも確認しなくちゃ。それから防寒対策をしっかりして……。:
Oh, and I have to check your
shift, too. Then we need to
bundle up really warm...
translations.（本気で行くつもりだ。大丈夫かな……）:
(She's dead set on going.
Is this really okay...？)
translations.あのね、大晦日行けそうだよ？:
Guess what？ Looks like I can
go on New Year's Eve！
translations.イベントホールのカウントダウン？ ホントに？:
To the countdown at the
event hall？ Really？
translations.ホントだったら。冗談だと思ってたの？:
Really really！
Did you think I was joking？
translations.そりゃまあ……。●も大丈夫だよ。:
Well, yeah...
● is good to go, too.
translations.じゃあ一緒に年越しカウントダウンだね。わぁ、ドキドキしてきちゃった。:
Then we get to ring in the
new year together.
Wow, I'm getting excited！
translations.それじゃ、当日は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の家まで迎えに行くよ。夜遅いし。:
Then I'll come pick you up
at ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s place that day.
Since it'll be late.
translations.ううん、私があなたの家に行く。年越しソバを作ってあげたいし。:
No, I'll go to your place.
I want to make New Year's
soba for you, after all.
translations.うん。夕方ぐらいにお邪魔するね。:
Yeah. I'll come over
around evening, okay？
translations.（やった！ 大晦日、楽しみになってきたぞ）:
(Yes! Now I'm really
looking forward to
New Year's Eve!)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、待ってました。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I've been
waiting for you!
translations.私を？ それとも年越しソバを？:
For me？ Or for
the New Year's soba？
translations.あ、ずるいんだ。ふふ、じゃあさっそくお台所借りるね？:
Ah, cheater. Hehe,
can I borrow your
kitchen right away, then？
translations.ジャーン、お待たせ。:
Ta-da! Sorry to keep
you waiting.
translations.年越しソバですよ？ さ、あったかいうちに食べましょ。:
It sure is! Now, let's
eat while it's hot.
translations.おそまつさまでした。……残念、あまりゆっくりする時間はないみたいね。:
You're very welcome.
...Too bad we don't have
much time to relax.
translations.そうだな。あ、皿はそのままでいいよ。:
Yeah. Oh, you can
leave the dishes.
translations.いいわよ、ササッと片付けちゃうから。私が洗うから拭いてくれる？:
Nonsense, I'll clean
up quick. I'll wash,
will you dry them？
translations.すごい人……。この人たち、みんなカウントダウンに行くのかな。:
So many people... Are
they all heading to
the countdown, I wonder？
translations.そうみたいだな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、はぐれないように……。:
Looks like it. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
stay close so we don't
get separated...
translations.うん。あなたにしっかりつかまってるね。:
Yeah. I'll hold on tight
to you, okay？
translations.あと少しで今年も終わりだね。:
This year is almost
over, isn't it？
translations.今年もいろいろあったなぁ。:
A lot's happened this
year, that's for sure.
translations.そうね。あなたと会う前の私がどんな風に過ごしてたのか、もう思い出せなくなってきち:
Yeah. I can't even
remember what my life
was like before I met you.
translations.そこまで昔じゃないのに？:
Even though it wasn't
that long ago？
translations.それくらい、あなたと会ってからが充実してるってこと。:
That's just how fulfilling
things have been since
I met you.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と会う前の●……どんなだったかな）:
(Before meeting ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what was ● like...
I wonder.)
translations.イベントホールにこんなに人がいるの、はじめて見たかも……。:
I don't think I've ever
seen the event hall this
crowded before...
translations.これが全員同時にカウントダウンするんだな……。:
And all of them are gonna
count down at once...
translations.……あ、今のうちに言っておこうかな。今年は大変お世話になりました。:
...Ah, maybe I should say
this now. Thank you for
everything this year.
translations.いえいえこちらこそ。来年もよろしくな。:
No, thank you. Let's make
next year great too.
translations.うん。来年もいっぱいよろしくね▼:
Yeah. Here's to another
great year together, ▼
translations.今年とももうすぐお別れかぁ。……なんだか緊張してきちゃった。:
We're almost saying goodbye
to this year, huh...
I'm getting kind of nervous.
translations.ご来場のみなさま、本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。カウントダウンは１分:
Ladies and gentlemen, thank
you all for coming tonight!
The countdown begins at
one minute to midnight, so
please wait just a moment!
translations.今年最後のキス、しない？:
How about our last kiss
of the year？
translations.え？ 今年最後って、もう……。:
Huh？ Last of the year？
There's hardly any...
translations.……今年最初のキスになっちゃったね。:
...Looks like that turned
into our first kiss of the
new year.
translations.２年越しのキス、か……。:
A kiss spanning two years,
huh...
translations.うん。去年から今年まで、あなたとずっとくっついたまま……。:
Yeah. Stuck right to you,
from last year all the way
into this one...
translations.……やだ、感動してきちゃった。この瞬間をあなたと一緒に迎えられて、嬉しい。:
...Gosh, I'm getting all
emotional. I'm so glad
I get to welcome this
moment with you.
translations.●もだよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、あけましておめでとう。:
Same here, ●.
Happy New Year, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。あけましておめでとう。今年もよろしくね。:
▲主人公＊▲. Happy New Year.
Here's to another great
year together, okay？
translations.あなたと一緒に新年を迎えられて、嬉しい……。:
I'm so happy I get to
welcome the new year
with you...
translations.●もだよ。今年もよろしく、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
Same here, ●.
Here's to another great
year, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.カウントダウンは１分前から行います！ みなさんよろしく！:
The countdown starts at
one minute to midnight!
Get ready, everyone!
translations.きれい……。あなたと一緒に年を越して、一緒に初日の出を見て……なんだか幸せすぎて:
It's so beautiful... Ringing
in the new year and seeing
the first sunrise with you...
I'm so happy it's almost
scary.
translations.……な～んてね？ これくらいまだまだなんだから。:
...Just kidding？
We're only just getting
started, you know.
translations.今年は去年よりもっと一緒にいよう。一緒にいろんなところに行って、いろんなものを食:
Let's spend even more time
together this year. We'll go
all kinds of places, eat all
sorts of food, and talk about
everything under the sun.
translations.わかった。初日の出に誓う！:
All right. I swear it
on the sunrise!
translations.嬉しい……。こんなにきれいな初日の出だもん。きっと効果絶大だよ？:
I'm so glad... A sunrise
this gorgeous is bound
to make it come true？
translations.おっ、晴れ着だ。着るの大変だったんじゃない？:
Ooh, your New Year's kimono.
Was it tough to put on？
translations.自分１人じゃ無理かな。……どう？:
I couldn't have done it
on my own. ...How do I look？
translations.ああ、すごく似合ってる。隣で歩く●も鼻が高いよ。:
Yeah, it looks great on you.
Walking next to you makes
● proud too.
translations.もう、褒めすぎだよ。……でも、ありがとう。:
Oh, you're laying it on
thick. ...Thanks, though.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。何をお願いしたの？:
▲主人公＊▲. What did you
wish for？
translations.ナイショ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
That's a secret.
What about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.じゃあ私もナイショ。あのね、叶ったら教えてあげる。:
Then mine's a secret too.
Tell you what, I'll let you
know if it comes true.
translations.あ、おみくじ。ねぇ、引いてみようよ。:
Oh, fortunes!
Hey, let's draw one.
translations.オーケー。いいのが出ますように……。:
All right. Here's hoping
for a good one...
translations.よし、大吉だ。今年はいいことありそうだぞ。:
Nice, Great Blessing!
Looks like this year's
gonna be a good one.
translations.やったぁ、私も大吉。二人でいいことありそうだね？:
Yay, Great Blessing for me
too! Looks like good things
are in store for both of us？
translations.吉か。まぁ、悪くはないってことだからいいのかな。:
Blessing, huh. Well,
it's not bad, so I guess
that's fine.
translations.んー、私も吉。ふふ、おそろいだね？:
Mmm, Blessing for me too.
Hehe, we match, don't we？
translations.あん、私も……。今年はお互い気をつけなくちゃね？:
Oh no, me too... We'll both
have to be careful this
year, won't we？
translations.私ね、おみくじはどんな結果でも枝に結んじゃうの。あなたはどうする？:
I always tie my fortune to
the branch no matter what
it says. What about you？
translations.じゃあ●もそうしようかな。:
Guess ● will do
that too, then.
translations.何かお守りを買おうかな。あなたも買わない？:
I think I'll buy an amulet.
Want to get one too？
translations.そうね、身体は大事。あなたが病気になったりしたら私も悲しいもの。:
Yeah, health is important.
I'd be so sad if you got sick.
translations.もう成就してるのに？ これ以上距離が近づいたらくっついちゃうかもね。:
Even though it already has？
If we get any closer,
we might just stick together.
translations.あ、真面目なんだ。私もあなたを見習おうかな……。:
Oh, so studious！
Maybe I should follow
your lead...
translations.ご利益あるかな？:
Think it'll bring us
good luck？
translations.あるわよ。私が保証しちゃう。:
Of course it will.
I guarantee it personally.
translations.お願いします、ネネ大明神様。:
I'm in your hands,
Great Goddess Nene.
translations.うむ、かなえてしんぜよう。ふふ。:
Mmh, thy wish shall be
granted. Hehe.
translations.私ね、小さい頃に、お父さんにもらったばかりのお年玉をおさい銭箱に入れちゃったこと:
When I was little, I threw
my New Year's money from Dad
right into the offering box.
translations.あらら……。結構ショックだったんじゃない？:
Uh-oh... That must've been
quite a shock, huh？
translations.うん、すごく。自分でもどうしてそんなことをしたのかわからなくて。すぐに神様に返し:
Yeah, totally. I didn't even
know why I did it. I was crying,
begging God to give it back.
translations.はは、神様も困っただろうな。:
Haha, even God probably
didn't know what to do.
translations.ふふ、そうね……。そのまま泣き疲れて眠っちゃって、家で目が覚めたら、手にお年玉が:
Hehe, right？ I cried myself
to sleep, and when I woke up,
the money was right in my hand.
translations.おお、願いはかなったんだ。:
Whoa, so your wish
actually came true.
translations.うちの神様は優しいの。だからね、いつ会いに来ても大丈夫よ。:
The god at my house is sweet.
So you're welcome to come
meet him anytime, you know？
translations.えっ？ えっと……そのうちな？:
Huh？ Uh... one of these days,
I guess？
translations.そうだ。そういえば面白いメールが届いたんだけどさ。:
Oh right. Speaking of which,
I got an interesting email.
translations.写真コンテストの案内だって。よかったらさ、挑戦してみない？ もちろん▲姉ヶ崎＊▲:
About a photo contest.
Want to give it a shot？
With ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ as the model,
of course.
translations.モデルって……そんな急に言われても。:
A model...？ That's a bit
out of the blue.
translations.頼むよ、●の腕を試すチャンスだし。協力してほしいなぁ。:
Come on, it's a chance to test
●'s skills.
I'd love your help.
translations.ん～、そう言われちゃうと……。しょうがないなぁ、協力してあげよっかな？:
Mmh, well, put that way...
Guess I have no choice.
Maybe I'll help you out then？
translations.また写真コンテストがあるんだって。挑戦しようよ。:
There's another photo contest.
Let's give it a shot.
translations.そうね。楽しそうだし、いいよ。:
Sure. Sounds like fun,
so why not？
translations.また写真コンテストの案内が来たよ！:
Another invite for a photo
contest just came in！
translations.ふふ、モデルでしょ？ もちろん、いいわよ♪:
Hehe, with me as your model,
right？ Of course I'd love to♪
translations.また写真コンテストがあるんだって。挑戦したいから、協力してくれる？:
There's another photo contest.
I want to enter, so will you
help me out？
translations.え……うん。あなたのお願いじゃあ仕方ないね……。:
Oh... sure. If you're asking,
I can hardly say no...
translations.じゃあ、今回もよろしく！:
All right, I'm counting on you
again this time！
translations.素敵な写真、期待してるからね。:
I'll be expecting a wonderful
photo, you know.
translations.モデルの良さをちゃんと引き出さなくちゃダメよ？ ふふ。:
You have to bring out the best
in your model, okay？ Hehe.
translations.あまりモデルに期待しすぎちゃダメだからね……。:
Just don't expect too much
from your model, okay...？
translations.この前応募した写真コンテストの結果が出たよ。:
The results came in for that
photo contest we entered.
translations.その顔は……もしかして、いい結果だったのかな？:
That look on your face...
Could it be good news？
translations.ギャラリーに展示してあるらしいから、見に行こうよ。:
It's on display at the gallery,
so let's go check it out.
translations.うそっ……最優秀賞だって。おめでとう！ モデルのおかげもあるかな？ ふふ♪:
No way... It says Grand
Prize! Congrats! Could the
model have helped, too？
Hehe♪
translations.すごーい、最優秀賞だって。おめでとう、よくできました▼:
Incredible, Grand Prize!
Congrats, you did such
a good job, ▼!
translations.見て、優秀賞だって。よかったね♪:
Look, an Award of
Excellence! Good for you♪
translations.優秀賞だって、おめでとう。結構腕のいいカメラマンさんだったのね、ふふ♪:
An Award of Excellence,
congrats! Turns out you're
quite the photographer,
hehe♪
translations.見て！ 優秀賞だよ。ふふ、いっぱい褒めてあげなくちゃね♪:
Look! An Award of
Excellence! Hehe, I'll have
to give you lots of
praise, won't I？♪
translations.入選おめでとう。いい評価してもらえてよかったね。:
Congrats on getting
selected! It's great you got
such good recognition.
translations.入選しただけじゃ不満なのかな？ ふふ。:
Not satisfied with just
being selected？ Hehe.
translations.入選なんて立派じゃない。写真、向いてるんだよ、きっと！:
Getting selected is a
big deal! You've got a
real talent for this,
I'm sure of it!
translations.今回の結果はほんと▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のおかげだよ。モデルお疲れさま。:
This result is really all
thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Thanks for
being such a great model.
translations.どういたしまして……なんてね。あなたの腕がよかったからだよ。:
You're welcome...
Just kidding. It's all
because of your skill.
translations.ありがとう。これからも協力よろしく！:
Thanks. I hope you'll
keep modeling for me!
translations.いい結果を出せたのも▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の協力のおかげだよ。ありがとう。:
I only got such good
results because of your
help, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Thank you.
translations.こんなに素敵な写真を撮ってもらえるなら、また協力しちゃおっかなぁ？:
If you take such lovely
photos of me, maybe I'll
model for you again？
translations.それはぜひ、よろしく！:
Please do,
I'd really appreciate it!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の協力あってこその結果だなぁ。やっぱモデルは大事だよ。:
I couldn't have done it
without ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s help. The
model really makes all the
difference.
translations.ふふ。そんなに褒められたら、また協力してあげたくなっちゃうじゃない▼:
Hehe. If you praise me
that much, I'll just have
to help you again, ▼
translations.この前の写真コンテストだけど……入賞できなかったんだ。:
About that photo contest...
I didn't place.
translations.そっかぁ。やっぱり、そんなに簡単にはいかないよね。:
I see. Well, it's not
always that easy, is it？
translations.うん……もっとレベルアップしなきゃダメだな。:
Yeah... I really need to
step up my game.
translations.コンテストは今回だけじゃないでしょ？ 私も協力するから、また挑戦しようよ。:
It's not like this was
the only contest, right？
I'll help, so let's try
again!
translations.この前応募した写真……入賞できなかったよ。:
That photo I submitted...
It didn't place.
translations.あ、落ち込んでるんだ？ ほら、元気だして。:
Aw, feeling down？
Come on, cheer up.
translations.せっかく▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に協力してもらったのにさ……なんか申し訳なくて。:
You went out of your way
to help me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
I just feel bad.
translations.そんなに簡単に入賞できたら面白くないでしょ？ またチャレンジすればいいじゃない。:
It wouldn't be any fun if
winning were that easy,
right？ You can always try
again.
translations.そうだな、ありがとう。ちょっと元気でてきた。:
You're right, thanks.
I'm feeling a bit better
already.
translations.この前の写真コンテスト……落選だって。:
That photo contest...
Looks like I didn't make
the cut.
translations.そうなんだ？ モデルとしては、少～し複雑な気持ちになっちゃうね。:
Really？ As your model,
that gives me a biiit of
mixed feelings.
translations.ごめんな……●の腕が足りないばっかりに。:
I'm sorry... It's just
because ● wasn't
skilled enough.
translations.ううん、また応募しようよ。私ももっと上手くモデルができるように練習するから、ね？:
No, let's enter again!
I'll practice so I can be
a better model, okay？
translations.ほんと？ よし、やる気出てきたぞ。:
Really？ Alright, now I'm
feeling motivated!
translations.ねえねえ、ひとつ聞きたいんだけど。:
Hey, can I ask you
something？
translations.バレンタインのチョコ、どんなのがいいかな。:
What kind of Valentine's
chocolate would you like？
translations.お、くれるんだ。:
Ooh, so you're giving me
some？
translations.そんなの、当たり前でしょ？:
Well, of course I am,
aren't I？
translations.えっとね……バーンとゴージャスのがいいとか、むしろシンプルなのがいいとか……それ:
Like... would you want
something super lavish,
or really simple...
Or maybe kinda unique？
translations.さっすがネネちゃん。女の勘が冴えわたってるんです。:
Good old Nene-chan!
A woman's intuition is
sharp as ever, you know.
translations.あ……まさかもう考えてたとか？:
Wait... You already had
it planned out？
translations.ふふ、それはもらってのお楽しみ！:
Fufu, you'll just have to
wait and see when you
get it!
translations.（これは期待してもよさそうかな……）:
(Guess I can really look
forward to this...)
translations.ううん、こっちの話だから大丈夫。:
No, don't worry about it.
Just talking to myself.
translations.なんかまずいなら、無理しなくても……。:
If it's an issue, you
don't have to push
yourself...
translations.そんなこと気にしなくても大丈夫。:
You don't need to worry
about that at all.
translations.やっぱり聞いといてよかった。どうしよっかな……。:
I'm glad I asked after
all. Now, what to do...
translations.（どんなのくれるんだろう……）:
(I wonder what kind she'll
make for me...)
translations.あれ、都合悪い？: Huh, is it a bad time？
translations.そっか、ならしょうがないな。残念。:
I see, nothing to be done
then. Too bad.
translations.ふふ、残念がらなくてもいいと思うけどな。:
Fufu, you don't need to
be disappointed, though.
translations.今からチョコの材料を買いに行って、試作開始なの。:
I'm off to buy ingredients
now to start making trial
batches of chocolate.
translations.そういうこと。だから今日はガマンして。ね？:
That's right. So bear
with it for today, okay？
translations.（んー、なんか今日はザワザワしてるような……）:
(Hmm, everyone seems kind
of restless today...)
translations.ちゃーんといい子にしてて待ってた？:
Were you a good boy
while waiting for me？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲か。モテてるってなに？:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What do you mean, popular？
translations.だって今の人からチョコもらってたんでしょ？:
Well, that girl just gave
you chocolate, didn't she？
translations.いけないんだー。カノジョが泣いちゃうよ？:
Ooh, you bad boy.
Your girlfriend's gonna
cry, you know？
translations.ええ？ だからこれは……。:
What？ Like I said,
this is...
translations.そうよね、悲しむよね。もし私がカノジョで……カレシが他の女の子からチョコをもらっ:
Yeah, she'd be sad.
If I were your girlfriend...
and my boyfriend got
chocolate from another girl...
translations.ふふふ、そんな顔しないの。そうだな……誰か他の人に渡してくれって頼まれたとか？:
Hehe, don't make that face.
Let's see... She asked you
to give it to someone else？
translations.やっぱりね。おかしいと思ったんだ。:
I knew it.
I thought that seemed off.
translations.おかしいって……ふーん……そういう▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はさ、●にチョコくれないの？:
Off, huh...? Hmph.
So what about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Aren't you going to give
● any chocolate？
translations.え、ほんとに欲しいの？ カノジョ以外からのチョコ！:
Wait, you really want some？
Chocolate from someone
who's not your girlfriend!
translations.……今の……なにか誤解させちゃったかな……。悪いことしちゃったよね。:
...Did I... give you
the wrong idea just now...？
That was mean of me.
translations.いいよ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が悪いわけじゃないし。:
Don't worry about it.
It's not ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s fault.
translations.（でも誤解は解いておかないとな……）:
(Still, I'd better clear up
the misunderstanding...)
translations.えっとね、ちょっと渡すものがあるの……。:
Well, you see... I have
something to give you...
translations.はあ、そんなわけないでしょ。:
*sigh* Of course not.
There's no way.
translations.チョコはカノジョからのだけで充分、じゃないの？:
Isn't chocolate from your
girlfriend enough for you？
translations.もう、調子いいんだから。ほんとかなあ。:
Jeez, always so smooth.
I wonder if that's true.
translations.ほんとだって。で、渡すものって？:
It is true!
Anyway, what was it you
wanted to give me？
translations.そうそう。デキシーズで使うバイト用の研修資料。ちょっとバイト中に渡しそびれちゃっ:
Oh, right. It's the training
materials for Dixie's.
I missed the chance to give
them to you during work.
translations.ああ、そうなんだ。わざわざありがと。:
Oh, I see.
Thanks for going out of your
way to bring them.
translations.はい、じゃあ渡したから。ちゃーんと勉強するのよ？:
There, all delivered.
Make sure you study them
properly, okay？
translations.（さて、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誤解をとかないと……）:
(Now, I've got to clear up
the misunderstanding
with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.はあ、探したよ。:
Phew, I've been looking
all over for you.
translations.バレンタインだから、カノジョを探してたんだ。:
It's Valentine's, so I was
looking for my girlfriend.
translations.バレンタインだし！ ってそうじゃなくて！:
Because it's Valentine's!
Wait, no, not like that!
translations.機嫌悪くしたなら謝るよ。さっきはごめん、その▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のことほうっておいて、他:
If you're upset, I'm sorry.
Sorry for earlier... leaving
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ behind to be with
another girl...
translations.……やっぱり、ほうっておかれたんだ。:
...So you really did
leave me all alone, huh.
translations.そんなに。カノジョに誤解されたから？:
Very. Did your girlfriend
get the wrong idea？
translations.うーん……別にやましいことなんてないんだから、正直に話せばいいと思うけど。:
Hmm... It's not like you
have anything to hide, so
just talk to her honestly.
translations.話しにくいなら、ついていこうか？ ほら、誤解させちゃった原因は私にもあるんだし。:
If it's hard to talk to her,
want me to come along？
I'm partly to blame for her
misunderstanding, after all.
translations.……いいよ、自分で説明する。:
...No, that's okay.
I'll explain it myself.
translations.大丈夫？ もしダメそうなら、協力するからね。:
Are you sure？ If it doesn't
go well, I'll help out,
okay？
translations.あのね、さっきの資料、そういえば補足があって――:
Um, about those materials
earlier, I just remembered
there was something to add—
translations.なんだか元気ないみたいだけど。: You just seem kind of down.
translations.ああ……それがさ、さっき▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に物渡されたとき、カノジョが見てたみたいでさ:
Ah... well, when ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
handed me that stuff earlier,
my girlfriend saw us.
translations.なんか……誤解されちゃったみたいでさ。ほら、今日、バレンタインだろ。:
Seems like... she got the
wrong idea. You know, since
today's Valentine's Day.
translations.もしかして……チョコもらってると思われちゃった？:
Did she think... you were
getting chocolate from me？
translations.そっか……ごめんね、私のせいで。:
I see... I'm so sorry,
it's my fault.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のせいじゃないよ、ただの誤解だって。:
It's not ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s fault.
It's just a misunderstanding.
translations.そうは言っても……。カノジョには説明したの？:
Even so... Have you
explained it to her yet？
translations.私も付いていこうか。: Want me to come along too？
translations.いいよ、そこまでしてもらわなくても。それに一緒に行ったら、ますます誤解されるかも:
No, you don't have to go
that far. Besides, if we go
together, she might just get
even more the wrong idea.
translations.気にしなくていいよ。きっと簡単に誤解とけるって。:
Don't worry about it. I'm
sure it'll be cleared up
in no time.
translations.……でも、私、今はちょっと……。:
...But right now, I'm
just not really in the mood...
translations.だって、バレンタインだろ。今日じゃなきゃ意味ないじゃん。:
I mean, it's Valentine's Day.
It has to be today, or
it doesn't mean anything.
translations.……わかった……私も、このままバレンタイン終わるのはいやだから。:
...All right... I don't want
Valentine's to end like
this either.
translations.ありがと。さっきは、ごめん。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲との話の途中だったのに。:
Thanks. And sorry about earlier.
Leaving right in the middle
of talking to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.チョコ、渡そうとしてくれたんだよな。:
You were trying to give me
chocolates, weren't you？
translations.うん……そう。ねえ、あの後、あの子とどんな話、したの？:
Yeah... that's right. Hey,
what did you talk about
with that girl after that？
translations.ああ、全然たいしたことじゃなくて……。:
Oh, it really wasn't
anything major...
translations.そっか……ほんとに、たいした話じゃないね。:
I see... It really wasn't
anything at all, was it.
translations.ほんとだよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲からチョコもらうことの方が、ずっと大事なのにな。:
Told you. Getting chocolate
from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is way more
important to me anyway.
translations.ううん……くだらないことで怒ってるのは、自分でもわかってるの……。:
No... I know I'm being silly,
getting mad over something
so dumb...
translations.ただ、こう……ちょっとしたことで不安になったり、怒っちゃったり……そんなこと、あ:
It's just, you know...
little things can make me
insecure, or upset...
That just happens sometimes.
translations.ごめんね。せっかくのバレンタインなのに:
I'm sorry. Even though
it's Valentine's Day...
translations.もしかして、バレンタインだからこそ……なのかもな。そういうの。:
Maybe it's precisely because
it's Valentine's Day...
Feelings like that.
translations.こういう恋人同士のイベントってさ、もちろん楽しいのが一番だけど……逆に不安になっ:
Couples' events like this,
having fun is great, sure...
but I guess they can make
you anxious sometimes, too.
translations.あ……そうね……私が、まさにそうかも。:
Ah... yeah...
That might be exactly
how I feel.
translations.なんだか貧乏性だなあ……せっかくのイベントなんだから、ハッピーハッピー！ ずーっ:
I'm such a worrywart...
It's a special day, so I
should just be happy-happy
and think about fun stuff.
translations.うん、でも、そういうのも▲姉ヶ崎＊▲らしさのひとつだからさ。:
Yeah, but that's part of
what makes you ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.それ、喜んでいいのかなあ？:
Should I take that as
a compliment, I wonder？
translations.あとは……もうひとつ、受け取って？:
And now... will you take
one more thing from me？
translations.お話聞いてあげよっかな……どうしよっかな。:
Should I hear you out...
or should I not...？
translations.●は聞いて欲しい。●の話。:
● want you to listen.
Hear ● out.
translations.さっきは私の話、聞いてくれなかったのに？:
Even though you wouldn't
listen to me earlier？
translations.それって、ちょっと自分勝手だと思うな。:
Don't you think that's
a little selfish？
translations.やっぱり聞いて欲しい。せっかくのバレンタインなのに、このままじゃ……。:
I still want you to listen.
It's Valentine's Day, so
we can't just leave things
like this...
translations.まあ……そうよね。で？:
Well... I guess so.
So, what is it？
translations.うん、ありがと。さっきは、ほんとごめん。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、チョコ渡そうとしてくれたん:
Thanks. And I'm really
sorry about before. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you were trying to give me
chocolates, right？
translations.はあ、反省してくれたならいいよ。:
Sigh. Well, as long as
you learned your lesson.
translations.そういえば、あの後、あの子と何話してたの？:
By the way, what were you
talking to that girl about
after that？
translations.ほんと、どうでもいい話。:
Really, nothing that
matters at all.
translations.そんなことのために、私がチョコ渡すタイミングとられちゃったんだあ。:
So that's what made me
miss my chance to give you
my chocolates, huh.
translations.チョコを渡すのって結構、タイミングや雰囲気が大切だと思うんだけどな。:
When giving chocolates,
the timing and mood are
pretty important, you know.
translations.もちろん。そこでヘンに慣れちゃって、なあなあにしたくないでしょ。:
Of course. You don't want
to get too used to it and
stop caring, right？
translations.なるほどって……もう、ほんとにわかってるのかなあ？:
'I see'？ Geez, do you
really get it, I wonder？
translations.例えば……こうやってカレシを見つめて……。:
For example... looking into
my boyfriend's eyes
like this...
translations.私の愛情たっぷりのチョコレート……受け取って？:
My chocolates, filled to
the brim with love...
Will you accept them？
translations.ふふ。はい、ちゃんと受け取れました。:
Hehe. There, you took them
nice and proper.
translations.じゃあ、よくできたご褒美。:
Now, here's your reward
for doing such a good job.
translations.さっきはごめんね、突き放すような態度とって。:
Sorry about earlier,
brushing you off like that.
translations.あの後すぐ、反省しちゃった。お姉さんなのに、情けないなあって。:
I felt bad right after.
I'm the older one, so it
felt pretty pathetic.
translations.でも、もとはといえば、●が悪いんだし……。:
Then again, ● was
at fault to begin with...
translations.そんなに悪いこと、したっけ？:
Did I really do something
that bad？
translations.さっき……チョコ渡そうとしてくれてたんでしょ。なのに●……。:
Earlier... you were trying
to give me chocolate, right？
And yet ●...
translations.なんだ、ちゃんとわかってくれたんだ。:
Oh, so you figured it out
after all.
translations.まあ……ね、後から気づいたんだけど。:
Well... yeah.
I only realized afterwards,
though.
translations.もう、ちゃんと前からチョコの調査したり、アピールしたつもりだったんだけどなあ。:
Geez. And here I thought
I'd done my research and
dropped hints beforehand.
translations.ねえ……あの後、あの子と何話してたの？:
Hey... what were you
talking to that girl about
afterwards？
translations.そんな用事だったら、そのまま押し切って渡しちゃえばよかったかな。:
If it was just that, maybe I
should've pushed my way in
and given it to you anyway.
translations.もう、笑い事じゃないのに。女の子にとっては、大切なことなんだからね？:
Geez, it's not funny.
It's a really big deal
to a girl, you know？
translations.だよな。ごめん、ちゃんと●が話聞いてれば。:
You're right. Sorry...
If only ● had
listened properly.
translations.まあ……こういうのも、アリかな。:
Well... I guess this kind
of thing has its charms too.
translations.こう、恋愛のスパイスっていうの？ 誤解やすれ違いがあって、山や谷があった方が恋人:
Like spice for romance？
A few misunderstandings,
some ups and downs...
It makes couple events
way more exciting.
translations.もう、そんな情けない顔しないの！ カワイイんだから！:
Geez, don't look so pathetic!
You're way too cute!
translations.その可愛さに免じて、チョコあげちゃう！:
Since you're so cute,
I'll give you your chocolate!
translations.ちゃんともうひとつあげるから、拗ねちゃダメよ？:
I'll give you another one,
so no pouting, okay？
translations.ホワイトデー、楽しみだなあ。:
I'm really looking forward
to White Day.
translations.ちょっと、どうして驚くの？ 楽しみにしちゃダメ？:
Hey, why are you surprised？
Can't I look forward to it？
translations.そうじゃないけど……いきなりだったからさ。心の準備ってのがあるじゃん。:
It's not that...
It was just so sudden.
I need to mentally prepare!
translations.心の準備？ 準備するのは心だけなのかな？:
Mentally prepare？
Is your mind the only thing
you need to prepare？
translations.そりゃあ……もちろんお返しもな！:
Well, of course...
A return gift too, of course!
translations.はは、まあそんなに期待しないで。:
Haha, don't get your hopes
up too high, though.
translations.ヘンに無理はしなくてもいいけど……さりげないセンスとか気づかいには期待しちゃうか:
No need to go crazy, but...
I might expect a little
subtle taste and thought.
translations.そう、さりげないカッコよさに、女の子はメロメロになっちゃうんだから。:
Yep! Subtle coolness is what
makes girls totally melt.
translations.もちろん、これ。お返し。:
Here, of course.
Your return gift.
translations.んー、まだいいかな。やめておく。:
Hmm, not just yet.
I think I'll hold off.
translations.じゃあ、また後で。バイバイ。:
Well then, see you later.
Bye-bye!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、なんで受け取らなかったんだろ……）:
(Why didn't ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
take it, I wonder...)
translations.（まだいいって言ってた気もするけど……どういう意味だ？）:
(I think she said 'not yet',
but... what did she mean？)
translations.ふふ、ちゃんとまた会えたね。:
Hehe, you managed to find
me again, didn't you？
translations.会えたねって、なんでさっき受け取ってくれなかったんだよ。:
What do you mean 'found you'？
Why didn't you take my gift
earlier？
translations.もらったら、そこでホワイトデー終わっちゃうじゃない。:
If I took it, White Day
would be over right then,
wouldn't it？
translations.そんなことで悪かったわね。:
Well, excuse me for
'just for that'!
translations.こういうイベントは、自分たちで楽しむ努力が大切なの。:
For events like this, it's
important to make an effort
to have fun, you know？
translations.あなたが一生懸命、私にお返しを渡そうとするカワイイ姿を想像するのが楽しいんじゃな:
Isn't it way more fun
picturing you trying so hard
to give me your gift？ It's cute.
translations.だから、また後で。私のこと、ちゃーんと探してね？:
So, see you later!
Make sure you search reeeally
hard for me, okay？
translations.（うーん、なんかの罰ゲームみたいだ）:
(Man... this feels like
some kind of penalty game.)
translations.（とにかく見つけて、お返し渡さないと……）:
(Anyway, I've got to find
her and give her the gift...)
translations.そりゃあ、せっかくのホワイトデーなのに、お返し受け取ってもらえなかったら台無しじ:
Well yeah, it'd totally ruin
White Day if you didn't take
my gift after all that.
translations.でも受け取らないわけないよ。言ったでしょ、また後で、って。:
There's no way I wouldn't take
it, though. Like I said,
'see you later', right？
translations.そうだけどさ……で、満足したの？:
I guess, but...
So, are you satisfied now？
translations.うん。おかげで、この時間、すごく楽しかった。:
Yep. Thanks to you,
I had a lot of fun.
translations.なんだか……恥ずかしくなってきちゃった。私、子供っぽかったね。:
Now... I'm starting to feel
embarrassed. I was being pretty
childish, wasn't I？
translations.そういうところもカワイイかも！:
You're pretty cute like that,
too, though!
translations.そういうのは、私の台詞なのに。:
Hey, that's supposed to be
my line.
translations.いいじゃん、たまには。こっちにもカワイイって言わせてよ。:
Come on, once in a while is
fine. Let me call you cute, too!
translations.もう……ほんとに、バカ。: Geez... You really are an idiot.
translations.ねえ、そっちに行っていい？:
Hey, can I come
over to your side？
translations.ふふ……あはは、情けない顔してる！:
Hehe... Ahaha, you're
making such a pitiful face!
translations.ごめんごめん。ほんとに楽しくなっちゃって。:
Sorry, sorry! I'm just
having way too much fun.
translations.遊ばれてる気がする……。:
I feel like you're
just playing with me...
translations.だって、しょうがないじゃない。それだけカワイイんだもん。:
Well, I can't help it.
You're just that cute.
translations.もう、褒めてるんだから、喜んでいいの。カワイイカワイイ▼:
Come on, it's a compliment,
so you should be happy.
My cute, cute ▼.
translations.あ、それで、お返しは？:
Oh, so what about
my return gift？
translations.やっと渡せた。:
Finally managed to
give it to you.
translations.ふふ、よくガマンしました。:
Hehe, good boy.
You were so patient.
translations.じゃあ、がんばったごほうびあげる。:
Now then, I'll give you
a reward for trying
so hard.
translations.そうよね、そろそろもらってあげないと可哀想よね。:
You're right, I'd feel
bad for you if I didn't
take it soon.
translations.泣いちゃうかもしれないよね？:
You might even start
crying, right？
translations.あなたのお返し、ほしいな？:
I'd love to have your
return gift, you know？
translations.思い出し笑い、慌ててるのがすごくカワイかった▼:
Just thinking back.
You getting all flustered
was so cute, ▼.
translations.ダーメ。もう記憶しちゃったもん♪:
No wa~y. It's already
locked in my memory♪
translations.そういうカワイイ顔するたびに、私の思い出ギャラリーが増えてくの。:
Every time you make a cute
face like that, my memory
gallery gets a new entry.
translations.あるよー。あなたのカワイイ顔とか、かっこいい顔とか、いろーんなものが記憶されてる:
Sure do~. Your cute faces,
your cool faces... I've got
all kinds of them saved.
translations.もっと恥ずかしいのもあるよ？:
I've got even more
embarrassing ones, you know？
translations.あなたの、キスするときの顔。:
Like the face you make
when we kiss.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、どんなネタだったらだまされるかな……）:
(I wonder what kind of prank
would fool ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.えっと、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って結構ダイエットとか気にしてるよね。:
Um, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're pretty
concerned about dieting,
right？
translations.なあに、いきなり。失礼しちゃう。:
What's that all of a sudden？
How rude.
translations.あ、っと、ごめんごめん。よく話題にしてる気がするからさ。:
Ah, sorry, sorry! It just
feels like you bring it up
a lot.
translations.そうだけど……あなたから言われると少しショック。:
I mean, yeah, but...
hearing it from you
stings a little.
translations.ああ、最近噂で聞いたんだけどさ、十羽野神社の神様にはダイエットのご利益があるんだ:
Well, I heard a rumor
recently that Towano Shrine's
gods grant diet blessings.
translations.そんなの聞いたことないけど……あ！:
I've never heard of that
before... Wait!
translations.なあ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。さっき話したダイエットの話なんだけど。:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. About that
diet thing we talked about
earlier.
translations.またそんなこと言って。エイプリルフールの嘘でしょ？:
There you go again. That's
an April Fools' lie, right？
translations.ほら、神社まで付き合ってよ。:
Come on, just walk with me
to the shrine.
translations.……美への信仰。美容への感謝……本当だったんだ。:
...Faith in beauty.
Gratitude for beauty...
It really was true.
translations.うん……前からあまり節操のある神社じゃないと思ってたけど……色々あるのね。:
Yeah... I always thought
this shrine had no shame,
but they really do have
everything, don't they.
translations.●もびっくりだよ、まさか本当に……。:
You're surprised too,
right, ●？ To think
it was actually...
translations.そう？ じゃあお参りしてこよっと。:
Really？ Well, I'm gonna
go say a prayer, then.
translations.（ただのでまかせだったけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が喜んでくれたから、それでいいか……）:
(It was totally made up,
but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s happy, so
I guess it's all good...)
translations.どうだった？ ご利益ありそう？:
How was it？ Feel like
it's gonna work？
translations.そうね……ダイエット以外にも肌や健康にもいいらしいし、通っちゃいそう。:
Let's see... Apparently
it's good for skin and
health, not just dieting.
I might become a regular.
translations.ごめんね、エイプリルフールだなんて疑って。ありがとう、教えてくれて。:
I'm sorry for suspecting
it was April Fools'.
Thanks for telling me.
translations.（嘘ついた手前、なんとなく神社まで来ちゃったけど……）:
(I lied about it, so I kind of
wandered over to the shrine,
but...)
translations.（まあ、ここにそんなご利益ないよな……）:
(Well, there's no way it actually
has those blessings...)
translations.どうしたって、あなたが教えてくれたんじゃない、神社の話。:
What do you mean, 'what's up'？
Didn't you tell me
about this shrine？
translations.さて、せっかくだからあなたに案内してもらおっかな？:
So, since we're both here,
maybe you can show me around？
translations.ほら、ここにご利益あるんでしょ？ 説明して？:
Come on, there's a blessing
here, right？ Explain it to me？
translations.さあ、どうするの？ どこかに説明あるのかな。:
Well？ What's the plan？
Maybe there's a sign somewhere？
translations.あれ、嘘だったんだ……。: Wait, so it was a lie...？
translations.嘘じゃすまされないわよ。:
'Just a lie' won't cut it,
you know.
translations.女の子の純真な願いを踏みにじるなんて許さない。:
Trampling all over a girl's
pure wishes like that...
I can't forgive that.
translations.ねえ、あなたも、私ダイエットした方がいいって思ったの？:
Hey, do you think I should
go on a diet, too？
translations.（そっか、それを気にしてたのか……）:
(Oh... So that's what was
bothering her...)
translations.違うよ。: No, that's not it at all.
translations.うん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が興味ある話題の方が、信じやすいかなって思って……それだけで。:
Yeah. I just thought ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
would believe it if it was
something you cared about...
That's all.
translations.いつも▲姉ヶ崎＊▲からダイエットの話聞くたびに、そんな必要ないのにって、そう思っ:
Whenever ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ talks
about dieting, I always think
you don't need to at all.
translations.今の私でも……いい？:
You like me...
just the way I am？
translations.もう、許してあげる……こんなイタズラ、もうダメよ？:
Geez, fine, I forgive you...
No more pranks like this, okay？
translations.ふふ、よしよし。もう怒ってないから、悲しそうな顔しないで、ね？:
Hehe, there, there.
I'm not mad anymore,
so don't look so sad, okay？
translations.（慰められちゃった、これはこれで……）:
(She ended up comforting me.
This isn't so bad either, though...)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に嘘ついちゃったけど、なんかバレてるみたいだったな……）:
(I tried lying to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
but it felt like she saw right
through it...)
translations.（まあいいか……さて、どこに行こう）:
(Oh well... Now, where should
I go？)
translations.（……特になにもないな。ここにいてもしかたないか）:
(...Nothing special here.
No point hanging around.)
translations.（とりあえず来てみたけど……まあお参りでもするか）:
(I came here just because...
Guess I'll pray at the shrine.)
translations.（美への信仰、美容への感謝……これって！）:
('Devotion to beauty,
gratitude for radiance'...
Wait, this is...!)
translations.（まさか本当にこんなご利益があるなんて……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に教えてやろう）:
(I can't believe it actually
has blessings for that...
I should tell ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.)
translations.学校合同遠足の話。全学年で高原に行くって。:
About the all-school field trip.
Every grade is going to
the highlands together!
translations.ああ、聞いた聞いた。学校合同って、珍しいよな。:
Yeah, I heard! It's pretty rare
for all grades to go together.
translations.ふふ、私たちにとっては、願ったり叶ったりよね。:
Hehe, for the two of us,
it's a dream come true, right？
translations.一緒に行動できるかな……。:
I wonder if we'll get
to stick together...
translations.自由時間はそんなにないみたいだけど……。:
Doesn't look like we'll have
much free time, though...
translations.じゃ、お弁当は絶対一緒に食べよ。ね？:
Then let's definitely eat
lunch together, okay？
translations.ほんと。これじゃ学校合同の意味ないよ。:
Seriously. What's the point
of an all-school trip if
we can't even be together？
translations.颯子、どうしたの？ 今私――:
Satoko, what is it？
Right now, I was just――
translations.これからカレシとイチャイチャするの……って？:
About to go get all lovey-
dovey with your boyfriend...？
translations.そう、だから邪魔しないで。: Yep, so don't get in our way.
translations.相変わらずだね、アンタ……。でも悪いね、それは無理。:
You never change...
Sorry, but that's not
gonna happen.
translations.今からアタシたちは、３年クラス対抗の鬼ごっこに参加する。:
Right now, we're doing
the third-year class tag match.
translations.なにそれ、イヤよ！: What？ No way, count me out!
translations.食券かかってるんだから。運動音痴のアンタでもいないよりマシ、ほら！:
Meal tickets are on the line!
Even clumsy you is better
than nothing, so come on!
translations.カレシくんも悪いね、こいつは借りてくよ。:
Sorry, Mr. Boyfriend!
I'm borrowing her for a bit!
translations.（そろそろ弁当だな……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は……）:
(Lunchtime soon...
I wonder where ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。さっきは大丈夫だった？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Were you okay back there？
translations.いいのよ、あの子強引だし。いいから、お弁当食べよ？:
It's fine, she's always pushy.
Come on, let's eat lunch, okay？
translations.焦らないの。ちゃんと持ってきてるから。:
Don't rush.
I made sure to bring it.
translations.おい、あの野郎。堂々とカノジョと弁当なんて食べやがって……。:
Look at that bastard,
brazenly eating lunch
with his girlfriend...
translations.（むちゃくちゃ聞こえてるっつーの！）:
(I can totally hear you guys,
you know!)
translations.なあ……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は気にしないの？:
Hey... doesn't that
bother you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.いいじゃない、見せ付けてあげれば？:
Who cares？ 
Why not show off a little？
translations.これみよがしに見せ付けやがって！:
Look at him flaunting it
right in front of us!
translations.俺も姉ヶ崎先輩の弁当食いてー！:
I wanna eat
Anegasaki-senpai's
boxed lunch too!
translations.（うう、後が怖い……）:
(Ugh, I'm gonna pay
for this later...)
translations.はあ、やっと二人になれた……。:
Whew, finally just
the two of us...
translations.そうね。でもさっきみたいにみんなに見せつけるのも楽しかったけど。:
Yeah. Though showing off
for everyone like that
was pretty fun too, you know？
translations.なんだか、ちょっと不思議。デートしたことがある場所に、学校行事で来るって。:
It feels kind of strange.
Coming to a place we've dated
on a school trip, I mean.
translations.デートしてるのか、遠足してるのか、わかんなくなっちゃう。:
I can't tell if we're on a date
or a field trip.
translations.ねえねえ、今度はここ、デートで来てみよっか。:
Hey, how about we come here
on a date next time？
translations.そっか……そういえば、ここ来たことなかったな。:
True... Come to think of it,
we haven't been here before.
translations.色々遊べそうじゃない？ 今日はそんなにゆっくりできないし。:
Looks like fun, doesn't it？
We can't really take our time
today, anyway.
translations.（そうだな、デートで来るのもありかな……）:
(Yeah, coming here on a date
sounds nice...)
translations.ほんとに二人っきりだね……。:
It really is just
the two of us...
translations.遠足始まって、ようやくちゃんと二人っきりになれたんだよ？:
The trip started, and we're
finally alone together,
you know？
translations.はーい、それじゃあ帰りますよー。:
All right, time to head back,
everyone~
translations.（遠足もこれで終わりか……）:
(Guess that's the end
of our trip...)
translations.ああ、雰囲気あるよな……どうかした？:
Yeah, it's got atmosphere...
Something up？
translations.うん……最近ここに怪談の噂があるみたいで。:
Yeah... Apparently there's
a ghost story going around
about this place.
translations.詳しいことはまだ調べてるんだけど……。:
I'm still looking into
the details, though...
translations.（洋館の怪談ねえ……）:
(A ghost story at the Western
mansion, huh...)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の学年もいるかな……）:
(I wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s grade
is out here too...)
translations.なにキョロキョロしてるのかな？:
What are you looking for,
hmm？
translations.もう、やめて。こんなところで。:
Oh, stop it.
Not right here in public!
translations.しょうがないなあ。:
What am I gonna do
with you...
translations.うーん、でもやっぱり他の水着姿も見てみたくなるよなあ。:
Mmm, but now I really wanna
see you in other swimsuits, too.
translations.それって、海やプールでってこと？:
You mean, like,
at the beach or pool？
translations.そっか……たしかに新しい水着買おうかなあって思ってたんだけど……。:
I see... I was actually thinking
about getting a new swimsuit,
but...
translations.うん、どんなのにするかは迷ってるんだけど。:
Yeah, but I haven't decided
what kind I want yet.
translations.じゃあさ、一緒に買いに行かない？:
Then why don't we go shopping
for one together？
translations.え、二人でってこと？: Wait, just the two of us？
translations.そう、迷ってるんならさ、●に選ばせてよ。:
Yeah. If you can't decide,
let ● pick one out!
translations.んー……それはさすがに恥ずかしいかも……。:
Hmm... That might be a little
too embarrassing, though...
translations.……もう、そんな風に言われたら……いいよ。行こ？:
...Geez, if you put it like that...
All right. Let's go？
translations.ふふ、喜んじゃって。:
Hehe, look at you
getting all excited.
translations.はりきりすぎ、恥ずかしいなあ。:
You're way too eager,
it's embarrassing.
translations.じゃあ、ちょっと選んでくるね。:
All right, I'll go pick
a few out, okay？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に似合う水着は……）:
(The swimsuit that'd look best
on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is...)
translations.まずこれが目に付いたから着てみたけど……どう？:
This one caught my eye first,
so I tried it on...
What do you think？
translations.そっか……じゃあ、他のも試してみようかな。:
I see... Maybe I'll try
another one, then.
translations.こういうのは……好み？:
Is something like this...
more your type？
translations.いい！ いい！ いい！: Love it! Love it! Love it!
translations.今着た中だと……どれが一番好み？:
Out of the ones I tried on...
which did you like best？
translations.了解。それじゃあ、買ってくる。:
Got it.
I'll go buy it, then.
translations.でしょ？ あとはデート本番！:
Right？ Now all that's left
is the actual date!
translations.あ……でもこれだと、新しい水着で新鮮！ っていう驚きはないね。:
Ah... but now there won't be
that fresh 'New swimsuit!'
surprise, will there？
translations.大丈夫だって。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の水着姿は何度見てもＯＫ！:
Don't worry about it!
Seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in a swimsuit
never gets old!
translations.（水着、楽しみだな！）:
(Man, I can't wait to see
that swimsuit!)
translations.あのね、私の気のせいかもしれないんだけど……。:
Hey, um... It might just be
my imagination, but...
translations.最近メールが少ないような気がするの。私のこと、避けてる？:
I feel like you haven't been
emailing much lately.
Are you avoiding me？
translations.……もしかして私たち、倦怠期ってやつ？:
...Could we be going through
what they call a rut？
translations.え!? ●はそうは思ってないけど？:
Wait, what!? ● doesn't
think that at all, though？
translations.私だってそうだよ？ でも、最近あんまりメールくれないし。:
Neither do I, you know？
But you barely send any
emails lately.
translations.そうなの。もう、しょうがないな。:
I do. Jeez, what am I
gonna do with you.
translations.あのね。メールの数、減ってきてるような気がする……。:
Hey, um... I feel like the
emails have been tapering off...
translations.私、毎日待ってるんだから。もっとメールくれないと……すねちゃうよ？:
I'm waiting every day,
you know. If you don't
write more... I'll pout, okay？
translations.もうすねてるような……。:
Seems like you're already
pouting, though...
translations.私のこと……飽きちゃったわけじゃないよね？:
You haven't... gotten tired
of me, have you？
translations.そんなわけないだろ!? どうしたの？:
Of course not!?
What brought this on？
translations.ごめんね。なんだか……キスの回数が減ってきたような気がして。:
Sorry. It's just... I feel like
we haven't been kissing
as much lately.
translations.……そうかな。キスしてないからって、好きじゃないってことにはならないよ。:
...You think so？ Just because
we haven't kissed as much
doesn't mean I don't love you.
translations.ねえ、最近冷たくない？:
Hey, haven't you been kind of
cold lately？
translations.え、そんなことないと思うけど……。:
Huh？ I don't really think
I have, though...
translations.でも、最近あんまりキスしてくれないじゃない。:
But you barely ever kiss me
these days.
translations.それとも、私に何か不満があるの？:
Or is there something about me
that's bothering you？
translations.ねえ、気づいてる？ 近ごろの私たちに足りないもの。:
Hey, have you noticed？
What's been missing
between us lately.
translations.……キス。あんまりしてくれないよね。:
...Kisses. You barely give me
any lately, do you？
translations.こんなことあんまり言わせないで……。:
Don't make me have to say
stuff like this, okay...？
translations.何度かデートの約束破ってるよね。どうして？:
You've broken our date plans
a few times now. Why？
translations.私と会うの……イヤなわけじゃないよね。:
It's not like you don't wanna
see me anymore... right？
translations.（少し機嫌悪いな……）: (She's in kind of a bad mood...)
translations.私ね、ちょっとだけ怒ってるんだけど。:
You know, I'm actually
a little bit mad.
translations.デートを何度もすっぽかして、なんとも思わないわけないでしょう？:
You stood me up so many
times... Did you really think
I wouldn't care？
translations.ちゃんと反省してるのかな？ ん？:
Are you really reflecting
on what you did？ Hm？
translations.（さすがに少し怒ってるか）:
(I guess she really is
a little mad...)
translations.ねえ、話があるんだけどいい？: Hey, can we talk for a sec？
translations.この頃、約束をきちんと守ってくれないよね。デート、毎回楽しみにしてるのに。:
Lately, you haven't been
keeping your promises.
And I always look forward
to our dates, too.
translations.できればこんなこと言いたくないの。わかるよね。:
I really don't want to have
to say this. You get it,
right？
translations.（これ以上怒らせないようにしないとな）:
(I'd better not make her
any madder...)
translations.ねえ、少し話したいんだけど。:
Hey, could we talk
for a minute？
translations.この間のデート、ほうっておかれちゃったから。……何かあったの？:
You kinda ignored me on our
last date... Did something
happen？
translations.……もうしないでね。悲しくなっちゃうから。:
...Don't do that again, okay？
It makes me sad.
translations.（機嫌損ねちゃったみたいだ、そりゃそうだよな）:
(Looks like I upset her...
Well, can't blame her.)
translations.……何も言ってくれなかったね。:
...You didn't say a word
to me, you know.
translations.この前のデート。ずっと黙ってたじゃない。:
On our last date. You were
quiet the whole time.
translations.どういうことなのかな？:
Care to explain what
that was about？
translations.どうかしました。デート中、ずっとカノジョのことほうっておいて。:
Yes, something is wrong.
Leaving your girlfriend
all alone during our date...
translations.私がどんな気持ちになったか、ちゃんと反省しなさい。:
You'd better reflect on
how that made me feel, okay？
translations.最近……私たち、あんまり会えてないね。:
Lately... we haven't seen
much of each other, have we？
translations.あなたは平気なの？ 私は……もっと、会いたいな。:
Doesn't it bother you？
Because I... want to see
you more.
translations.ねえ、どうすればもっと会ってくれる？:
Hey, what should I do so
you'll see me more often？
translations.（少し寂しい思いさせちゃったみたいだ……）:
(Looks like I've been making
her feel lonely...)
translations.近ごろの私たちのこと、どう思ってる？:
How do you feel about us
lately？
translations.どう思ってるって……どういうこと？:
What do you mean,
how do I feel...？
translations.あんまり会えてないように思うな。:
I just feel like we haven't
been seeing each other much.
translations.私は、できればもっと会いたいって……そう思ってるよ。:
If it were up to me,
I'd want to see you more...
That's how I feel.
translations.あのね……もっと会いたいの。:
You know... I want to see
you more.
translations.今こうして会ってるでしょ？:
Aren't we seeing each other
right now, though？
translations.そうだけど……最近会うこと少ないから。:
Well, yes, but... we haven't
hung out much lately.
translations.こんなのさびしいよ。もっともっと会いたい……。:
It gets lonely like this.
I want to see you so much
more...
translations.（寂しい思いさせちゃったか……）:
(I really made her feel
lonely, huh...)
translations.さっきの女の子……友達？:
That girl just now...
is she a friend of yours？
translations.まあ、普通の友達だけど。気になった？:
Well, just a regular friend.
Did that bother you？
translations.ちょっとだけ。でも、ちょっとだけだから。気にしてないよ。:
Just a little bit.
But only a little, really.
I'm not worried about it.
translations.（ちょっと気にしてるみたいだな……）:
(Seems like it kind of
bothers her, though...)
translations.さっきの人と、ずいぶん仲良しだね。:
You seemed pretty close
with that person just now.
translations.そうかな？ 普通の友達だけど。:
You think so？
Just a regular friend.
translations.そう……私が気にし過ぎなのかな？:
I see...
Maybe I'm just overthinking it？
translations.今の女の子は誰かな？ 仲良さそうだったけど。:
Who was that girl just now？
You two looked pretty close.
translations.ただの友達だけどで……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、もしかして妬いてる？:
Just a regular friend...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you jealous,
by any chance？
translations.そんなのじゃないけど……気にはなるじゃない。:
It's not like that, but...
it's hard not to wonder, you know？
translations.うん……。ありがとう、心配してくれて。:
Yeah...
Thanks for worrying about me.
translations.だってその風邪、●からうつったんじゃないか？:
Didn't you catch that cold
from ●, though？
translations.うーん……わからないよ。気にしないで、そんなこと。:
Hmm... I don't really know.
Don't worry about that.
translations.そんな顔しないの。ちゃんと休めば治るから。:
Don't make that face.
I'll be fine once I get
some good rest.
translations.もしかしたらそうかもね。でも、そんなの気にしなくていいよ。:
Maybe so. But really,
you don't have to worry
about that.
translations.その風邪返してくれ: Give that cold back to me
translations.平気……休めばすぐ治るから。:
I'm all right...
A little rest and I'll be
good as new.
translations.ごめん。その風邪、●からうつったんだよな？:
Sorry. You caught that cold
from ●, right？
translations.謝らないで。あなたのせいだなんて思ってないから。:
Don't apologize.
I don't blame you at all.
translations.責任取りたいんだ。その風邪、●が持って帰るよ。:
I want to take responsibility.
● will take that cold back.
translations.格好つけてる……その言葉で十分だよ。:
Always trying to act cool...
Just hearing you say that
is enough.
translations.その風邪、返してよ。そしたら元気になるだろう？:
Give that cold back to me.
Then you'll feel better, right？
translations.もう。きりがないでしょ、そんなことしたら。:
Jeez. There'd be no end to it
if we did that, would there？
translations.●にもうつしてよ。●のせいで▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が……。:
Pass it to ●, too.
Because of ●, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is...
translations.……却下。あなたが苦しむなんてイヤよ。私がきちんと治せばいいんだもん。:
...Rejected.
I don't want you suffering.
I just need to rest up properly.
translations.悪いと思ってるよ……。: I really feel bad about it...
translations.謝ることないのに……でも、なんだかうれしい。:
You don't need to apologize...
Though, it does make me
kind of happy.
translations.いいのいいの。そのかわり、元気になったらいっぱい遊んでね？:
Don't worry about it. 
Instead, once I'm better, 
you have to hang out with 
me a whole bunch, okay？
translations.そんなにかわいい顔しないで。お姉さんの熱が上がっちゃうでしょ？:
Don't give me that cute face. 
You're gonna make this 
older girl's fever go up, 
you know？
translations.そうそう、りんご切ったんだった。食べられる？:
Oh, right, I sliced some 
apples. Think you can eat？
translations.それって、食べさせてくれる？:
Does that mean 
you're gonna feed me？
translations.オッケー、いいよ。楽な姿勢にしてて。:
Sure, no problem. 
Just get comfortable.
translations.今日はお見舞い、ありがとう。おかげですぐに治っちゃいそう。:
Thanks for coming by 
to see me today. 
Thanks to you, I think I'll 
get better in no time.
translations.うん。じゃあ●はそろそろ帰るよ。元気になるの、待ってるから。:
Yeah. Well, ● should 
get going soon. 
I'll be waiting for you 
to get all better.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……もういいのか？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... 
Are you feeling better 
already？
translations.もうすっかり。ご心配おかけしました。:
Completely! 
Sorry for making you worry.
translations.よかった……でもお見舞い行けずじまいだったな。:
That's a relief... 
Though I never did get 
around to visiting you.
translations.いいの。あなたにうつさないで済んだから。ね。:
It's okay. At least 
I didn't pass it to you, 
right？
translations.（●の心配まで……お見舞い行けばよかったかな）:
(Worrying about ●, 
too... Maybe I should've 
gone to visit.)
translations.あなたがお見舞いに来てくれないから、自分でなんとかしました。:
Since you didn't come 
visit me, I had to manage 
all on my own.
translations.あ……ごめん、行けなくて。:
Ah... Sorry I couldn't 
make it over.
translations.冗談。弱ってるところなんて見せたくないもの。:
Just kidding! 
Besides, I didn't want you 
seeing me all weak anyway.
translations.（でもやっぱ、行ったら喜んでくれたよな……）:
(Still, I bet she would've 
been happy if I'd visited...)
translations.もう、風邪は大丈夫なの？:
Is your cold really 
all better now？
translations.よかった……お見舞いに行こうと思ってたけど、その前に治っちゃったな。:
That's good... I was planning 
to visit, but you beat me 
to it and got better first.
translations.あ、それ残念。あなたに看病してほしかったな。:
Aw, that's too bad. 
I really wanted you to nurse 
me back to health, too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、もう体調はいいの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you 
feeling all right now？
translations.あなたに元気もらって復活したよ。:
You gave me the energy 
I needed to bounce back.
translations.キスって、不思議な力があるんだね。:
Kisses really do have 
some kind of mysterious 
power, don't they？
translations.よかった……元気になったみたいだな。:
That's good... Looks like 
you're full of energy again.
translations.お見舞い効果だね。あなたはあのあと、大丈夫だった？:
That's the power of your 
visit. Were you okay after 
that, though？
translations.ああ、問題なし。また風邪ひいたときは言ってよ。:
Yeah, no problem at all. 
Let me know if you ever 
catch a cold again.
translations.風邪になるたびキスするの？ それも……いいかもね。:
A kiss every time I get 
sick？ That... might not 
be so bad, actually.
translations.よかったよ、元気になったみたいで。:
I'm glad. Looks like you're 
back on your feet.
translations.これはやっぱり、あなたのおかげだね。:
I definitely have you 
to thank for that.
translations.もう、そんなストレートに言わないの。:
Geez, don't put it so 
bluntly!
translations.ねえ、私と話してて辛くない？ 大丈夫？:
Hey, is talking to me 
too tiring？ Are you okay？
translations.大丈夫。むしろ元気をもらってるって。:
I'm fine. If anything, 
you're giving me energy.
translations.あなたの風邪……私にうつして治せないか、試してみていい？:
Your cold... 
Can I try taking it from 
you to see if it cures you？
translations.体の具合、悪くなってない？ ちゃんと寝てなきゃダメよ。:
Feeling any worse？
You've got to stay in bed
and rest, you know.
translations.子どもじゃないんだから、おとなしく寝てるって。:
I'm not a kid, you know.
I'll stay in bed and behave.
translations.風邪、きつそうだね。私が持って帰れないか、試してみようか？:
Your cold looks pretty rough.
Want me to try taking it home
with me？
translations.早く治してね……私、ずっと心配してるんだから。:
Get well soon, okay...？
I've been worrying about you
the whole time.
translations.ありがと。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲まで体調崩さないようにね。:
Thanks. Don't go catching it
yourself, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ねえ……風邪って、キスでうつせば治るんじゃなかったっけ？ 試してみる？:
Hey... doesn't kissing
pass a cold and cure it？
Want to give it a try？
translations.うん……試してみるね。: Yeah... I'll give it a try.
translations.冗談のつもりだったけど……じゃあ、試すね？:
I was only teasing, but...
all right, here goes？
translations.本当かどうか、やってみないとね？:
We won't know if it's true
unless we try, right？
translations.いい返事。じゃあ……。:
That's what I like to hear.
Now then...
translations.……これで、元気出たかな。:
...Did that give you some
energy back？
translations.ああ。なんか力がわいてきた気がする。:
Yeah. I feel like I'm getting
my strength back.
translations.よかった。じゃあ私に風邪がうつったってことだね。:
Good. That must mean
your cold passed to me, then.
translations.（まあ、本当にうつりはしないよな）:
(Well, it's not like she
actually caught it.)
translations.うん……元気もらった。: Yeah... I feel a lot better.
translations.よかった。じゃあ、もし私がこれで風邪ひいたら、今みたいに看病してね？:
Good. If I catch a cold now,
you have to take care of me
just like this, okay？
translations.（本当にうつるわけじゃないもんな）:
(Not that it actually
works that way, though.)
translations.……風邪、うつったかな？:
...Did I catch your cold,
do you think？
translations.うつったらダメだって。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が倒れちゃう。:
You can't catch it!
You'll get sick in bed, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.何言ってるの？ うつらないとあなたが治らないじゃない。:
What are you saying？
If I don't catch it,
you won't get better.
translations.（本当にうつったりはしないよな）:
(It's not like that actually
happens, though.)
translations.風邪、早く治してね。お願い。:
Get over your cold soon, okay？
Pretty please？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も……風邪うつらないようにな。:
You too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Make sure you don't catch it.
translations.わかってる。二人とも元気じゃないとデートできないもんね。:
I know. We can't go on dates
unless we're both healthy,
after all.
translations.うん……ありがとう。体が軽くなった気がする。:
Yeah... thanks.
My body feels a lot lighter.
translations.私も。風邪はどこかに行っちゃったのかな？:
Me too. Did the cold
just run off somewhere？
translations.もしかして、風邪うつった!?: Wait, did you catch my cold!?
translations.そうじゃなくて……急に照れてきちゃって。:
No, that's not it...
I just got all shy
all of a sudden.
translations.それは良くないよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が風邪ひいちゃうだろ？:
That wouldn't be good.
Then you'd catch my
cold, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.私はそれでもいいのに……うん、わかった。:
I wouldn't mind if I
did, though...
Okay, I got it.
translations.無理だって、そんなの。うつっても治ったりはしないだろ。:
Come on, that's impossible.
Passing it to you
won't cure me.
translations.ふーん……そういうものかな。:
Hmm...
Is that how it works？
translations.迷信か……やっぱりそうかな。:
A superstition, huh...
Yeah, I guess so.
translations.お腹は大丈夫？ おかゆ作ったんだけど……。:
How's your stomach？
I made some rice porridge
for you, but...
translations.食べられるよ。いただきまーす！:
I can eat!
Thanks for the food!
translations.お見舞いありがと、元気出てきた！:
Thanks for visiting,
I'm already feeling better!
translations.よかった。じゃあ私はそろそろ失礼しようかな。完全に治るまでちゃんと休んでね。:
I'm glad.
I should probably get
going now.
Get plenty of rest until
you're all better, okay？
translations.無理してない？ 本当にもう治った？:
You're not pushing yourself？
Are you really all better？
translations.見ての通り、ピンピンしてるよ。:
As you can see,
I'm fit as a fiddle.
translations.よかった……ずっと心配で。:
What a relief...
I was worried the
whole time.
translations.そんな大げさなことじゃないって。心配してくれてありがとう。:
It really wasn't that
big of a deal.
Thanks for worrying about me.
translations.復帰おめでとう。もう大丈夫？:
Welcome back!
Are you feeling alright now？
translations.ああ。もともとそんなにひどい風邪じゃなかったし。:
Yeah. It wasn't that bad
of a cold to begin with.
translations.そっか、そんなに元気なら、甘えさせなくても大丈夫かな。:
I see. If you're that full
of energy, I guess I don't
need to pamper you then.
translations.治ってよかったね……心配したよ。:
I'm glad you're better...
I was worried, you know.
translations.会えなかった分も、ちゃーんと甘えさせてあげるからね。:
To make up for lost time,
I'll be sure to spoil
you rotten, okay？
translations.風邪、バッチリ治ったよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のおかげだな。:
My cold's totally gone.
It's all thanks to you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.お見舞いに行った甲斐があったかな。:
Hehe, guess visiting you
was worth it then.
translations.ところで……そっちは大丈夫？ 風邪ひいたりとか……。:
By the way... are you okay？
You didn't catch it
or anything...？
translations.私？ 大丈夫、うつらなかったみたい。:
Me？ I'm fine,
looks like I didn't catch it.
translations.うん、よかったね。私のお見舞い効果かな？:
Yeah, that's great.
Was it the power of my visit,
I wonder？
translations.そうそう、あのときはありがとう。……あのあと、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
Yeah, thanks for that.
...How about you after that,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.あ、えーっと……こっちも大丈夫だったよ。:
Ah, umm...
I was fine too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のおかげで風邪、ちゃんと治ったよ。:
Thanks to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
my cold is all better.
translations.よかった。あのときのキスが効いたんだね。:
I'm glad.
That kiss back then really
did the trick, huh？
translations.そうだね……ってことは、そっちにうつったり……。:
Yeah... Wait, does that mean
you might've caught it...？
translations.大丈夫。私も風邪はもらわないで済んだから。:
Don't worry.
I managed not to catch
it from you either.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、いつもとちょっと違うかも？）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seems a little
different from usual？)
translations.こんなこと言ったら、驚かれるかもしれないけど……。:
You might be surprised
if I tell you this, but...
translations.なにって……もちろん、あなたのことが。ダメ？:
What do you mean 'what'？...
You, of course. Is that bad？
translations.ダメじゃないけど……驚かないよ、そんなの当たり前じゃん。:
It's not that, but...
I'm not surprised.
That's just a given.
translations.当たり前だけど……当たり前じゃないの。だって……。:
It is, but...
it isn't.
Because...
translations.こんなに好きなの……いつもと違う。:
I love you so much...
it's not like usual.
translations.ごめん、おかしなこと言ってるよね……私、ちょっとおかしいの……。:
Sorry, I sound crazy,
don't I...？
I think I'm going
a little crazy...
translations.おかしくなっちゃうくらい、好きなの……。:
I love you so much,
it's driving me crazy...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、なんか様子が……怒ってる？）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seems off...
Is she mad at me？)
translations.……決まってるでしょ。好き、大好き。だーい好き！:
...You already know.
I love you, I love you,
I looove you!
translations.そんなの関係ない。好き！:
I don't care!
I love you!
translations.何かいうことないの？:
Don't you have
anything to say？
translations.（ん？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ご機嫌？）:
(Hm？ Is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
in a good mood？)
translations.顔、あつくて……爆発しちゃいそう……。:
My face is so hot...
I feel like I'm gonna explode...
translations.なんていうか、今の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って……。:
I mean, right now, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you're kind of...
translations.やだ……聞きたくない。聞いたら、ほんとに爆発しちゃう……。:
