Though it was of me, so...
I'm happy, but embarrassed, too.
Hehe.
translations.いいじゃない、それも。自由に撮らせてあげれば▼:
Why not？ Sounds fine to me.
Just let him shoot whatever
he wants▼
translations.カレがそんなに撮りたいなら、ちょっとくらい……。:
If he wants to that badly...
maybe just a little...
translations.そういうの良くないと思うから、ダメって叱るかな。:
I don't think that's right,
so I'd probably scold him
and say no.
translations.うーん……イヤだと思うことは素直にそう言うよ、私は。:
Hmm... If I don't like it,
I just tell him honestly.
translations.おかしな写真ばっかりで困ってるの。ここはひとつ、叱っておくべき？:
He only takes weird photos,
it's so annoying. Should I give
him a good scolding？
translations.さっきから気になってたんだけど、かわいいネックレスしてるね。:
I've been noticing for a bit,
but that's a really cute
necklace you're wearing.
translations.素敵な指輪ね。それってもしかして……。:
What a lovely ring.
Could that be...？
translations.素敵なリングね。それってもしかして……。:
What a lovely ring.
Could that be...？
translations.その髪型、似合ってるね。:
That hairstyle looks
great on you.
translations.その服、かわいい！ あなたにぴったり。:
That outfit is so cute!
It looks perfect on you.
translations.あ、気づいた？ カレからもらったんだよ。:
Ah, you noticed？
My boyfriend gave it to me.
translations.カレがほめてくれたから、この色にしてるの。イメージ変わって面白いよ。:
I picked this color because
he complimented it. It's fun
changing up my look.
translations.自分が楽しくて、カレも喜んでくれるような、そんなファッションを目指したいよね。:
I like to aim for fashion that's
fun for me, but also makes
him happy, you know？
translations.もっとかわいくなって、カレをメロメロにさせちゃおうね♪:
Let's get even cuter and make
our boyfriends head over
heels for us♪
translations.正直……まだわからないな、そういうの……。:
To be honest... I still don't
really know about that sort
of thing...
translations.そうね、今みたいな日が、これからも続いていけばいいなって……そしたら少しずつ、変:
Well... I hope days like this
can just keep on going...
Then little by little,
we might start to change...
translations.将来、か……。カレとしたいことが色々ありすぎてうまく言えないなあ。ふふっ♪:
The future, huh...
There's so much I want to do
with him, I can't put it
into words. Hehe♪
translations.それはもちろん、色々考えるよ。カレの苗字を……私の名前にくっつけたりとか▼ 気が:
Of course I think about it.
Like putting his last name with
my first name... ▼Am I
getting ahead of myself？
translations.もちろん、これからもカレとずっと一緒だよ。もし私が離れようとしても、カレが放して:
Of course I'll stay with him
forever. Even if I tried to leave,
he wouldn't let me go▼
translations.このままカレと一緒に生きていくって決めてるよ▼ おじいちゃんとおばあちゃんになっ:
I've decided I'm spending my
life with him▼ Even when we're
old and gray, forever and
ever... you know？
translations.私たちが出会ったのは、神様がくれた運命だったと思うの。ずっとこのまま、永遠に今み:
I think us meeting was fate
from God. I want to spend every
day like this forever...▼
translations.もうこんな時間？ 夢中でしゃべっちゃったね。:
Is it already this late？
We got totally carried away
talking, didn't we.
translations.今日はありがとう。おかげで少し、元気になれたかな。:
Thanks for today.
I feel a little cheered up,
thanks to you.
translations.ふふ、こんなにしゃべったの、ひさしぶりかも。:
Hehe, it's been a while since
I chatted this much.
translations.名残惜しいけど、今回はここまでね。:
I hate to say goodbye,
but that's all for today.
translations.あなたのカレにも、よろしくね。:
Say hi to your boyfriend
for me, okay？
translations.もう夜だね。気をつけて帰って？:
It's night already.
Get home safe, okay？
translations.そろそろ寝る時間だよね？ じゃあ、おやすみ。:
It's about bedtime, right？
Well, good night.
translations.今日はお話しできてうれしかった。じゃあね。:
It was so nice talking today.
See you around.
translations.早く帰らないとね。遅くまで出歩いてると、カレが心配しちゃうし。:
I should get home soon.
If I'm out too late,
he'll start worrying about me.
translations.それで、カレシがカノジョにどんな用かな？:
So, what does this boyfriend
need from his girlfriend？
translations.はーい。ちょうどあなたの声が聞きたかったの▼:
Heeey. I was just wanting
to hear your voice▼
translations.はい、姉ヶ崎です。どちらさまですか？:
Yes, Anegasaki speaking.
Who is this, please？
translations.あわてちゃって、かわいい▼ もちろんわかってるよ。:
Look at you flustered,
so cute▼
Of course I know it's you.
translations.う……。えーっと、用件話してもいいかな？:
Ugh... Um, can I tell you
what I called about？
translations.ちょっと待って！ 切らないでね。:
Hold on a sec!
Don't hang up, okay？
translations.お待たせ。長電話の体勢に入りました。どうぞ、続けて？:
Thanks for waiting!
I'm all settled in for a long
chat. Go ahead, continue？
translations.はは、大丈夫だよ。すぐ済むし。:
Haha, you don't need to.
It won't take long.
translations.もしもし、●だけど。今、電話いい？:
Hello, it's ●.
Can you talk right now？
translations.ちょっと……はい。今よくなったよ。:
Hold on... Okay.
I can talk now.
translations.ちょっと話したいことがあってさ。:
There's something I wanted
to talk to you about.
translations.いいよ。私もあなたとお話ししたかったし。:
Sure. I wanted to talk
with you too.
translations.どうしよっかな……なんちゃって。いいよ。:
Hmm, what should I do...
Just kidding! Sure.
translations.いいよ。あなたとなら何時間でも。:
Sure. If it's with you,
I could talk for hours.
translations.はは、そんなに何時間もかけないよ。えっと……。:
Haha, I won't keep you for
hours. Um...
translations.もしもし、●だけど。電話続けてもいい？:
Hello, it's ●.
Can you keep talking？
translations.どうしよっかな……いいよ？:
Hmm, what should I do...
Sure, why not？
translations.●だけど……。なんか元気ない？ かけ直そうか？:
It's ●...
You sound a little down.
Should I call back later？
translations.いいよ、終わらせちゃおう？ どうぞ。:
It's fine, let's just get it
over with. Go ahead.
translations.えっと……お話？: Um... Did you want to talk？
translations.そうだけど、都合悪い？: Yeah, is it a bad time？
translations.そういうわけじゃないけど……まあいいか。続けて？:
Not really, but...
Oh well. Go ahead？
translations.大きな声出さないの、ちょっとからかっただけ……私に用なんでしょ？ どうぞ。:
Don't shout, I was just
teasing you a bit...
You needed me, right？ Go ahead.
translations.今日の放課後、二人で▲デート場所▲に行きたいと思ってさ。どう？:
I was thinking the two of us
could go to ▲デート場所▲
after school today. What do you say？
translations.▲デート場所▲なんていいんじゃない？:
How about ▲デート場所▲？
Sounds pretty good, right？
translations.▲月▲▲日▲がいいな。そっちは？:
I'd love to go to
▲月▲▲日▲. How about you？
translations.せっかくだけど、ちょっと乗り気になれなくて……。:
Thanks for asking, but I'm
just not in the mood...
translations.うーん……ごめん、やめとく。:
Hmm... Sorry,
I'll pass this time.
translations.ごめんなさい、また誘ってね。:
I'm sorry.
Ask me again, okay？
translations.バイトのシフトと被ってる……。また別の日にしてくれるとうれしいな。:
It clashes with my shift...
I'd love to if we could
pick another day.
translations.わかった。また連絡するから。:
Got it.
I'll reach out again later.
translations.学校抜け出して今すぐデートに行きたいね。:
I wish we could ditch school
and go on our date right now.
translations.ま、そういうわけには行かないから……また放課後に。:
Well, we can't do that...
See you after school, then.
translations.放課後が待ち遠しいね。あなたもそうでしょ？:
I can't wait for after
school. You feel the same,
don't you？
translations.そりゃね。授業も上の空になりそう。:
Totally. My mind's gonna be
wandering all through class.
translations.じゃあ、また後で。校門でね。:
See you later, then.
Meet me at the school gate.
translations.前みたいなことはナシね？ すっぽかされるのって、つらいから……。:
No pulling what you did last
time, okay？ Getting stood up
really hurts...
translations.もうしない。この前はごめん。:
I won't do it again.
I'm really sorry about before.
translations.んー……この前デートをいきなりキャンセルしたの、覚えてるよね？:
Hmm... You remember how you
suddenly canceled last time,
don't you？
translations.今回は大丈夫！ 前の分まで埋め合わせするから！:
It'll be fine this time!
I'll make up for last time too,
I promise!
translations.この前すっぽかされたぶん、今度のデートはサービスしてもらおうかな？:
Since you stood me up last
time, you'd better spoil me
on our date, okay♪
translations.わかった。がんばって▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の信頼を取り戻すよ。:
Got it. I'll do my best to
earn back ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s trust.
translations.言っておくけど、この前みたいなことはもうしないでね。:
Just so you know, don't do
what you did last time again,
okay？
translations.あのときはごめん、放っておいて。気をつけるから。:
I'm sorry for leaving you
hanging back then.
I'll be more careful.
translations.今度のデートでは、ほったらかしなんてナシだからね？:
On our next date, you're not
leaving me hanging, okay？
translations.わかってる。あれは反省してるよ……。:
I know. I really regret
doing that...
translations.じゃあ、この前放っておかれたことはチャラにしてあげようかな。:
Then maybe I'll let you off
the hook for leaving me alone
last time.
translations.うん……。もう絶対あんなことしないから。:
Yeah... I swear I'll never
do anything like that again.
translations.ようやく会えるね。最近すれ違いばっかりだったから……。:
We finally get to see each
other. We've kept missing
each other lately...
translations.ごめん。今日はゆっくりデートしよう。:
I'm sorry. Let's take our
time on our date today.
translations.さあ、今まで会えなかったぶんをどうやって挽回してくれるのかな？:
Now then... how are you going
to make up for all the time
we've missed？
translations.あのね……最近ずっと会ってくれなくて、さびしかったんだよ？:
You know... you haven't seen
me lately, and I was starting
to feel lonely.
translations.ごめん。今日は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が満足するまでずっと一緒にいるから。:
I'm sorry. Today I'll stay
with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ until you're
completely satisfied.
translations.実は▲生成選択肢１▲を手に入れたんだけど、二人で▲デート場所▲に行かない？:
Actually, I got ▲生成選択肢１▲...
Want to go to ▲デート場所▲ together？
translations.▲月▲▲日▲の夜って、空いてる？:
Are you free on the night
of ▲月▲ ▲日▲？
translations.それ、素敵！ 喜んで行かせてもらいます、ふふ♪:
That sounds lovely!
I'd love to go, hehe♪
translations.張り切ったんだ。カノジョとして、そのがんばりには応えてあげないとね？:
You really went all out.
As your girlfriend, I've got to
reward that effort, don't I？
translations.すごく楽しそう！ うん、連れてって！:
That sounds like so much fun!
Yes, take me with you!
translations.いいよ。予定、空けておくから。:
Sure. I'll keep my schedule
open for you.
translations.わかった。お願い、聞いてあげる。:
All right. I'll grant that
request of yours.
translations.オッケーだよ。ありがとう、誘ってくれて。:
Sounds good!
Thanks for asking me.
translations.うーん……せっかくだけど、今回はやめておく。怒らないでね？:
Hmm... It sounds nice, but
I'll pass this time.
Don't be mad, okay？
translations.今はお出かけって気分じゃないの。ごめん。:
I'm not really in the mood
to go out right now. Sorry.
translations.できればあなたの気持ちに応えてあげたかったけど……。:
I really wanted to say yes
if I could, but...
translations.無理しなくてもいいよ。まあ、また連絡するからさ。:
You don't have to push yourself.
I'll call you again later, okay?
translations.別の日なら、予定空けられるんだけど……。:
If it were another day,
I could make time, though...
translations.ありがとう。平日を乗り切る楽しみができたよ。:
Thanks. Now I have something
to get me through the week!
translations.ああ。●も次の休みが楽しみだよ。:
Yeah. ●'s really looking
forward to our next day off, too.
translations.休みの予定が決まってよかった。:
I'm glad we got our plans
sorted for our day off.
translations.いいタイミングで誘えたみたいだな。:
Sounds like I asked you
at just the right time.
translations.そうだな。●、はりきるから！:
Yeah. ●'ll make sure
to give it everything!
translations.学校帰りのデートって、なんだかウキウキするね。:
Dating on the way home from school
always feels so exciting.
translations.へえ、制服でデートするからかな？:
Huh, maybe because we're
hanging out in our uniforms？
translations.ステキな電話をありがとう。じゃあね。:
Thanks for the lovely call.
See you later.
translations.じゃあ、またね。もし約束破ったら……わかってるよね？:
See you later, then.
If you break your promise...
you know what'll happen, right？
translations.わかってる、絶対破らないから。じゃあ、また。:
I know, I definitely won't break it.
See you later.
translations.デート、楽しみにしてるから。じゃあね▼:
I'm really looking forward
to our date. See you, ▼
translations.もしもし、少し時間ほしいな。今いい？:
Hello？ Got a minute for me？
Are you free right now？
translations.ちゃんと電話出たね、よろしい♪: Good boy, picking up right away♪
translations.機嫌よさそうだね、なに？:
You sound in high spirits.
What's up？
translations.もしもし、今、電話いい？ いいよね。:
Hello？ Free to talk right now？
Of course you are.
translations.まあ、大丈夫だけどさ。どうしたの？:
Well, yeah, I'm good.
What's going on？
translations.今日あたり、デートに行くのもいいなって考えたんだけど。:
I was just thinking it'd be nice
to go on a date today.
translations.今日の帰り、二人でデートしようよ。ね、そうしよう？:
Let's go on a date after school
today, just the two of us.
Come on, what do you say？
translations.次の休みまで待てないから、今日の帰りにデートしたいの。どう？:
I can't wait until our next day off,
so let's go on a date after
school today. How's that sound？
translations.いい一日になりそうだね♪ それじゃ、校門前で。:
Today's gonna be a great day♪
See you at the school gate, then.
translations.了解。ホームルームが終わったらダッシュするから。:
Got it. I'll sprint over
the second homeroom's over.
translations.じゃあ、まずは真面目に授業受けなくちゃ。居残りになってデート中止なんてダメだから:
Then you'd better pay attention
in class first. Getting detention
and cancelling our date
is strictly forbidden, okay？
translations.ご心配なく。今日はきっちり優等生でいるから。:
Don't worry. I'll be an absolute
model student today.
translations.じゃあ、またあとで。それまでは時計の針とにらめっこ大会になりそう。:
See you later, then.
Until then, it's gonna be a staring
contest with the clock.
translations.あー、●もそうなりそう……。じゃあ、また。:
Ah, looks like ●'ll be doing
the same... See you soon.
translations.悪いけど、今回はパスしていい？:
Sorry, mind if I take a pass
this time？
translations.そう……無理言ってもしょうがないもんね。じゃあ、気が向いたら連絡してね？:
I see... No point in forcing it,
right？ Let me know whenever
you feel like it, okay？
translations.ごめん、やっぱり今回はやめとかない？:
Sorry, maybe let's hold off
for this time？
translations.……そう。またタイミングを見て誘うね。:
...I see. I'll ask you again
another time, then.
translations.んー……その日はちょっと。:
Mmm... That day's a little
tough for me.
translations.また会いたいの？ 実は、私も。:
You want to see me again？
To tell the truth, so do I.
translations.さっきので満足できなかった？ じゃあ次は気が済むまで……ね？:
Was that not enough earlier？
Then next time, we'll keep going
until you're satisfied... okay？
translations.もう一回？ 困った甘えん坊さん▼:
Again？ You really are such
a spoiled boy ▼
translations.また？ 私も嫌じゃないけど……。:
Again？ It's not like I
mind, but...
translations.もう、ちょっとくらい我慢できないの？:
Geez, can't you wait
just a little bit？
translations.こらこら、さっきも会ったじゃない。しょうがないなあ。:
Now, now, we just saw
each other. What am I
gonna do with you？
translations.じゃあ今から▲デート場所▲で集合ってことで。:
All right, let's meet up
at ▲デート場所▲ right now, then.
translations.良かった……。避けられてるんじゃないかと思ってたから。じゃあ、また後でね。:
What a relief... I was
worried you were avoiding
me. See you in a bit!
translations.今から▲デート場所▲で待ち合わせでいいかな？:
Can we meet up at ▲デート場所▲
right now？
translations.了解。今まで放っておかれたぶんの埋め合わせ、期待してるからね？ それじゃ。:
Roger that! You'd better
make up for leaving me
alone for so long, okay？
See you soon.
translations.今から▲デート場所▲ってことでいい？:
So we're meeting at ▲デート場所▲
right now, okay？
translations.はい。もう、あんまり私のこと放っておいたらダメよ？ じゃあ、後で。:
Yep. Don't you go leaving
me all alone like that
again, okay？ See you soon.
translations.私の気持ちはわかってるでしょ？ こんなの、もう嫌……。:
You know how I feel,
don't you？ I can't
take this anymore...
translations.そこをなんとか。お願いだから……。:
Please, work with me here.
I'm begging you...
translations.ちょっと、本気で怒るよ？:
Hey, I'm really gonna
get mad, okay？
translations.ごめん。でも●、どうしても会いたくて……わかってよ。:
I'm sorry. But ●,
I just really want to see
you... Please understand.
translations.私、行きたくないの。何回も言わせないで。:
I don't want to go.
Don't make me keep
repeating myself.
translations.あきらめきれないんだよ。ただもう、会いたくて……。:
I can't just give up.
I just want to see you
so badly...
translations.行かないかもしれないから……期待しないでね。:
I might not show up...
so don't get your hopes up.
translations.●、来てくれるまで待ってるから……。:
●, I'll keep waiting
until you get there...
translations.行くとは言ってないからね？ わかった？:
I didn't say I was going,
okay？ Understand？
translations.わかった。でも●、待ってるから。:
I know. But ●,
I'll still be waiting.
translations.行くかどうかはこれから決めるから。:
I'll decide later whether
I'm going or not.
translations.それでいいよ。●は先に待ってるから。:
That's fine. ●'ll
be waiting ahead of time.
translations.さっきからあなたの顔が消えないの。多分、あなたに会うまでずっと……。ね、助けて。:
Your face won't leave
my head. Probably won't
until I see you, either...
Hey, rescue me？
translations.ちょっと時間もらえる？:
Could you give me
a little time？
translations.正解、私です。ご褒美に……今から会おう？ ね、あなたに甘えさせて。:
Bingo, it's me! As your
reward... let's meet up right
now？ Come on, spoil me
a little.
translations.少し遅くできない？: Can we make it a bit later？
translations.よかった、つながって。ねえ、今すぐ会えない？ 私からのお願い▼:
I'm so glad I reached you.
Hey, can we meet right now？
It's a request from me,
▼
translations.お願いなら仕方ない:
If you're asking,
I can't say no.
translations.じゃあ、▲デート場所▲で待ち合わせでいい？:
Then can we meet up
at ▲デート場所▲？
translations.ありがとう……。待ってるね。:
Thank you... I'll be
waiting for you.
translations.待たせないよ。●もすぐに行くから。:
I won't keep you waiting.
●'ll be right there, too.
translations.いいよ。場所は▲デート場所▲でいい？:
Sure thing.
Is ▲デート場所▲ okay？
translations.やった♪ いっぱい甘えちゃうから覚悟しておいて▼:
Yay♪ You'd better be ready,
'cause I'm gonna be
extra spoiled today!▼
translations.じゃあ、▲デート場所▲で。: See you at ▲デート場所▲, then.
translations.了解！ わがままなカノジョで困っちゃう？:
Got it! Am I giving you
a hard time, being such a
demanding girlfriend？
translations.全然。じゃあ、またあとで。:
Not at all.
See you in a bit.
translations.わかった。それまでがんばる……。:
Alright. I'll hang in there
until then...
translations.お願いね。遅刻なんてイヤよ？:
Promise me, okay？
No being late, alright？
translations.わかってるって。じゃあ、またあとで。:
I know, I know.
See you in a bit.
translations.もう。おあずけだなんて。:
Jeez. Putting me on hold
like this...
translations.そんなつもりじゃないって。そしたら▲時刻▲、▲デート場所▲で。:
I didn't mean it like that.
Let's do ▲時刻▲ at ▲デート場所▲, then.
translations.はーい。じゃあ、なるべく早めにね？:
Okaaay. Try to get there
as soon as you can, alright？
translations.そうだよね、急だもんね……。:
I know... It really was
on short notice...
translations.がっかりしないで。じゃあ、▲時刻▲に▲デート場所▲で。:
Don't look so down.
How about ▲時刻▲ at ▲デート場所▲, then？
translations.絶対だよ？ 私、待ってるから。:
You promise？
I'll be waiting, okay？
translations.うん、ちょっとだけ待ってて。:
Yeah, just hang on
a little bit.
translations.悪いけど、無理なんだ。我慢してもらえる？:
Sorry, but I really can't.
Can you hold tight for now？
translations.なんとかならない？ 我慢なんて、できそうにないよ……。:
Can't you figure something out？
I really don't think
I can wait...
translations.えーっ！ かわいいカノジョがこんなに頼んでるのに？:
Whaaat! Even with your cute
girlfriend begging you
this much？
translations.後でなら、なんとか: If it's later, I could manage
translations.いきなり無茶言わないでよ……。:
Don't ask the impossible
out of nowhere...
translations.無茶なのはわかってる。だからお願いしてるの。ね？ ね？:
I know it's crazy.
That's why I'm begging you.
Please？ Pretty please？
translations.そう言われても……なんともならないって。:
Even if you say that...
there's really nothing
I can do.
translations.そう……。私、悪いカノジョだね。あなたを困らせて。:
I see... I'm a bad girlfriend,
aren't I？ Giving you a
hard time.
translations.●こそ、お願い聞いてあげられなくてごめん。それじゃ……。:
No, ● should be the one
apologizing for not doing what
you asked. Talk to you later...
translations.無理なものは無理だから、ごめん。:
I really just can't,
so I'm sorry.
translations.はぁ……こんなに頼んでもダメかぁ。残念。:
Haaah... Even after begging
this much, it's still a no,
huh. What a bummer.
translations.●も残念だけど……また連絡するからさ。じゃあ。:
● feel bummed too, but...
I'll call you again later.
See you.
translations.どうしてもダメで……わかってよ。:
I really just can't...
Please understand.
translations.今、電話いい？ いいよね？:
Can you talk right now？
You can, right？
translations.上機嫌だね、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
Someone's in a good mood,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.寧々です。今、お話できる？:
It's Nene. Can you talk
right now？
translations.あ、私。よかった、電話つながって。:
Ah, it's me. I'm glad
I reached you.
translations.私。今、ちょっと時間ある？:
It's me. Do you have
a minute right now？
translations.今度のデート、誘ってくれてありがとう。:
Thanks for asking me out
on our next date.
translations.ああ、うん。……それを言うために電話くれたの？:
Oh, yeah. ...Did you call
just to tell me that？
translations.そうだよ。素敵なデートを準備してくれたお礼。:
Yup. To thank you for planning
such a wonderful date.
translations.こりゃあ当日はがんばらないと。:
Man, I'd better bring my
A-game that day.
translations.ねえ、今度のデート……準備、大変だったんじゃない？:
Hey, about our next date...
Was it hard to plan？
translations.まあ、それなりに……。それがどうかした？:
Well, a bit, yeah...
Why do you ask？
translations.カノジョを大切にしてくれるカレシに、感謝の気持ちを込めたプレゼントをあげようと思:
I wanted to give a gift straight
from the heart to a boyfriend
who treats his girl so well.
translations.チュ▼ ……ふふ、電話越しのキス。デートのときは、あなたからしてね▼:
*Mwah*▼ ...Fufu, a kiss over
the phone. When we're on our
date, you have to kiss me▼
translations.はは……がんばってムードを盛り上げないとな。:
Haha... Guess I'll have to
work hard on setting the mood.
translations.デートに誘ってくれてありがとう……。それが言いたくて。:
Thanks for asking me out...
I just wanted to say that.
translations.そんな、わざわざ。デートだったら今までもしてるじゃない。:
You didn't need to call just
for that. It's not like we
haven't been on dates before.
translations.ううん、今度のデートは特別なんでしょ？ お姉さんにはわかってるんだから。:
No, this next date is special,
isn't it？ Big sis can tell,
you know.
translations.二人の特別な思い出、作ろうね▼:
Let's make some special
memories together▼
translations.デートの日、早くできないかな？:
Can't our date get here
any faster？
translations.早く行きたいなーって。: I just really want to go already.
translations.そっか。まあ、待つのも楽しみのひとつだと思ってさ。:
I see. Well, the anticipation
is part of the fun, too.
translations.なるほど……この時間も楽しんじゃえばいいんだ。:
I see... So I should just enjoy
the waiting, too.
translations.今度のデートのこと考えたら、待ち遠しくてたまらないの。ね、どうにかして。:
Thinking about our next date
has me so excited I can't stand
it. Hey, do something about it.
translations.どうにか!? えっと……我慢しなさい、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！:
Do something!？ Um...
Just be patient, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.えらく素直だな……。じゃあ、当日まで我慢ね。:
Well, aren't you obedient... 
Then just hold out 
until the day of, okay？
translations.了解です。そのかわり、当日は我慢しないから▼:
Understood. But in exchange, 
I'm not holding back at all 
on that day, ▼.
translations.楽しみにしてるからね、次のデート。:
I'm really looking forward 
to our next date, you know？
translations.いつもより気合入ってるよ、●も。:
●'s even more fired up 
than usual, too.
translations.じゃあ私も気合入れなきゃ。チェスト！:
Then I've gotta get 
fired up too. Chesuto!
translations.チェスト!? なんのかけ声？:
Chesuto!？ 
What kind of shout is that？
translations.そうね。手をつなぐときとか、気合を入れて、こうグッと。:
Well... Like holding hands, 
getting all pumped up 
and squeezing tight!
translations.手をつなぐのにかけ声はいらないよ……。:
You don't need a battle cry 
just to hold hands...
translations.この前誘ってくれたデート……今から行けないかな？:
That date you asked me on... 
Can't we just go right now？
translations.ウソウソ、無理だってわかってる。でもね、早く行きたいって気持ちが溜まってきて……:
Kidding, I know we can't! 
Still, wanting to go so soon 
just keeps building up... 
It almost hurts, really.
translations.そっか……。なんだか、かわいそうだな。:
I see... Now I kind of 
feel bad for you.
translations.もう大丈夫。あなたの声を聞いて少し満足したから。:
I'm fine now. Hearing your 
voice satisfied me a bit.
translations.これだけ期待されてるんだったら、●もがんばらないとな。:
With expectations this high, 
●'s gotta give it 
his all too.
translations.こんなに早く時間が過ぎてほしいって思うの、久しぶり。:
It's been so long since I 
wished for time to fly by 
this fast.
translations.ほら、デート誘ってくれたでしょ？ あれ、早く行きたいね。:
You know that date you asked 
me on？ I can't wait for it 
to get here.
translations.ああ、そうだな。待ち遠しいな。:
Yeah, you're right. 
I can't wait either.
translations.いっぱい楽しんで、いっぱい思い出作ろうね？:
Let's have tons of fun 
and make lots of memories, 
okay？
translations.そうだな。めいっぱい楽しいデートにするよ。:
Yeah. I'll make sure it's 
the most fun date ever.
translations.もう少しだね……デートの日。:
Not much longer now... 
until the day of our date.
translations.ああ、もう少しの辛抱だな。:
Yeah, just a little more 
patience.
translations.あ……あなたも辛抱してるんだ。実は私も。:
Ah... So you're waiting 
patiently too. Honestly, 
so am I.
translations.早く行きたいな。次のデートはちょっと特別だからさ。:
I want to go already. 
Our next date is a bit 
special, after all.
translations.特別、か……。期待しちゃうなぁ。:
Special, huh... 
Now you've got my hopes up.
translations.いいよ、期待してて。きっと楽しいデートになるから。:
Go ahead, get your hopes up. 
It's gonna be a blast.
translations.デートの日の天気予報、見た？:
Did you check the forecast 
for the day of our date？
translations.ねー。雨になったらどうしよう。:
Right？ What should we do 
if it rains？
translations.中止はイヤ。あぁ、でもせっかくの日に雨になるのもイヤ……。:
I don't want to cancel! 
Aww, but I'd hate for it 
to rain on our date too...
translations.心配しすぎだって。大丈夫、なんとかなるよ。:
You're worrying too much. 
Don't worry, it'll work out.
translations.さっき天気予報見たら、デートの日は雨だったよ。:
I just checked the forecast, 
and it said rain for 
the day of our date.
translations.任せて。私がてるてる坊主作るから。:
Leave it to me! 
I'll make a teru teru bozu.
translations.てるてる坊主？ 効果あるの？:
A teru teru bozu!？ 
Does that even work？
translations.お姉さんのてるてる坊主はご利益満点だよ？ 乞う、ご期待。:
Big sis's teru teru bozu 
work like a charm, you know？ 
Just you wait!
translations.はは、自信満々だな。:
Haha, full of confidence, 
aren't you.
translations.いよいよ明日だね、デート。:
Tomorrow is finally the day, 
huh？ Our date.
translations.待ちに待った、って感じだな。: Feels like we've been waiting forever.
translations.今夜は目が冴えて眠れないかも……。小学校のときの遠足の前日みたい。:
I might be too wide awake
to sleep tonight...
Like the night before an
elementary school field trip.
translations.あなたも、今日は夜更かししないで早めに寝て。お願いだから遅刻しないでね？:
Don't you stay up late tonight either,
get to bed early.
Please don't be late, okay？
translations.正解。明日は遅刻しないでね。もししたら……先に行っちゃうから！:
Correct! Don't be late tomorrow.
If you are...
I'm going without you!
translations.ええっ!? 置いて行かれるってこと!?: Wait, what!? You'd leave me behind!?
translations.冗談。あなたがいないと意味ないじゃない。:
Just kidding.
It wouldn't mean anything
without you anyway.
translations.わかった……いつも以上に気を付けるよ。: Got it... I'll be extra careful, then.
translations.いよいよ明日だね、デート。ずーっと楽しみにしてたんだよ？:
Our date is finally tomorrow.
I've been looking forward to it
forever, you know？
translations.●も楽しみにしてたよ。: ●'s been looking forward to it too!
translations.ううん、絶対私のほうが楽しみにしてた！:
Uh-uh, I was definitely
way more excited than you!
translations.ふふ、そうだね。でもいいじゃない、二人とも楽しみにしてたってことで。:
Hehe, true.
Isn't it great that both of us
were looking forward to it, though？
translations.うん。明日はいいデートになりそうだな。:
Yeah. Feels like tomorrow's
going to be a great date.
translations.明日のデート、楽しみにしてるね。:
I'm really looking forward
to our date tomorrow.
translations.明日の約束、覚えてるよね？: You remember our plans tomorrow, right？
translations.もちろん。楽しみにしてたデートだからね。:
Of course. It's the date
I've been waiting for.
translations.明日がデートだと思うと、今からうきうきしてくるね。:
Just thinking about our date tomorrow
has me all excited already.
translations.それ、わかる。●もだから。: I get that. Same goes for ●.
translations.今日、デートだよ。準備できてる？: Our date's today. Are you all ready？
translations.ばっちりだから、任せといて。: All set. Leave it to me.
translations.今日だよ、約束。忘れてないよね？:
Our plans are today.
You didn't forget, did you？
translations.心配しなくても、忘れるわけないって。:
Don't worry, there's no way
I'd forget.
translations.今日だね、デート。ふふ、そわそわするね。:
Our date's today.
Hehe, I've got butterflies.
translations.ああ。早く▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に会いたいな。: Yeah. I can't wait to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.デートまでまだまだあるね……あと何日だっけ？:
There's still so long until our date...
How many days left was it again？
translations.はは、数えちゃうと余計気になるんじゃない？:
Haha, counting them down
just makes it worse, doesn't it？
translations.デート、は……まだ先だね。さびしいでしょ？:
Our date is... still pretty far off.
You miss me, don't you？
translations.ああ、だから電話してくれてうれしいよ。: Yeah. That's why I'm so glad you called.
translations.あーあ。あなたとのデート、もっと早くなればいいのに。:
Aww. I wish our date
could get here sooner.
translations.まだ先だもんな。まあ、仕方ないって。:
It's still a ways off.
Nothing we can do, though.
translations.もしかして、今日が何の日か忘れてない？:
Don't tell me you forgot
what day it is today？
translations.じゃあ単純に遅刻してるだけ？ もう、ずっと待ってるのに……。:
Then are you just running late？
Jeez, I've been waiting here forever...
translations.ごめん！ すぐ行くから！: I'm sorry! I'll be right there!
translations.あのね……私に何か言うことない？:
Hey... don't you have
something to say to me？
translations.はぁ。もういいから、早く来て？ 私、待ってるんだから。:
*sigh* Never mind, just hurry up
and get here, okay？ I'm waiting.
translations.ありがとう。急いで向かうから。:
Thank you. I'm on my way
as fast as I can!
translations.ほったらかしにするなんて、ひどいよ！:
Leaving me hanging like that
is so mean!
translations.今からでも来れるよね？ 私、まだ待ってるから。:
You can still make it now,
right？ I'm still waiting.
translations.ねえ……さっきはどうして来なかったの？ 何か事情があった？:
Hey... why didn't you show up
earlier？ Did something happen？
translations.そういうわけじゃないんだ……ごめん！:
It wasn't anything like that...
I'm sorry!
translations.そう……。だったら今からでも会えるってことかな？:
I see... Does that mean
we can still see each other now？
translations.埋め合わせはまた今度に: I'll make it up next time
translations.約束の時間に来なかったね。私がどれだけ悲しかったかわかる？:
You didn't show up on time.
Do you know how sad
that made me feel？
translations.ん、素直でよろしい。一応、今からでも会えなくはないけど……どうする？:
Mm, good boy for owning up.
I mean, we could still meet up
now... What do you want to do？
translations.今からデートしよう: Let's go on our date now
translations.埋め合わせは今度に: I'll make it up next time
translations.どうして待ち合わせの場所に来なかったの？ 言い訳があるなら聞いておくけど？:
Why didn't you meet me where
we planned？ If you have an excuse,
I'm listening？
translations.言い訳はしない……ごめんなさい。:
I won't make excuses...
I'm really sorry.
translations.ふーん……じゃあ、どうやって挽回するつもり？:
Hmm... So how do you plan
on making it up to me？
translations.また今度埋め合わせする: I'll make it up next time
translations.そうだな、今からでも会おっか？:
Yeah, want to still meet up
now, then？
translations.いいよ。だけど遅れた分はちゃんと埋め合わせしてね？:
Sure. But you'd better make up
for being late, okay？
translations.埋め合わせは今度にするよ。ちゃんと仕切り直すから。:
I'll make it up next time.
I want to do this right.
translations.ふぅん？ じゃあ……次こそちゃんとしてよね？:
Hmm？ Well... you better
make it count next time, okay？
translations.わかった。今回はほんと、ごめん……。:
Got it. I'm really sorry
about today...
translations.今からデートしよう。あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に時間があればだけど……。:
Let's go on our date now.
Ah, only if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ has
the time, though...
translations.ありがとう。全力で挽回する！:
Thank you! I'll do everything
I can to make it up to you!
translations.埋め合わせはまた今度にさせてもらうよ……。:
Let me make it up to you
next time instead...
translations.そっか、残念。今度は、早く来てくれるとうれしいな。:
I see, that's too bad.
Next time, I'd love it if you
got there early.
translations.うん。できるかぎり待たせないようにするから。:
Yeah. I'll do my best
not to keep you waiting.
translations.じゃあ今度ちゃんとデートしよう。そのときはちゃんとするから！:
Then let's have a real date
next time. I'll do it right!
translations.意気込んじゃって。じゃあこっちも期待しちゃうから。:
Look at you, all fired up.
Now I'm really gonna hold you
to that.
translations.いいよ。●、がんばる！:
You got it, ●!
I'll do my best!
translations.また今度、ちゃんと埋め合わせするよ。:
I'll definitely make it up to you
next time.
translations.よろしい。でも……少しくらいの埋め合わせじゃ納得しないから。:
Very good. But... a tiny token
gesture isn't gonna cut it.
translations.今日も約束破ったね……。もう我慢の限界。:
You broke your promise today,
too... That's the last straw.
translations.決めた。“ごめんなさい”って謝るまで、もう口きいてあげません。:
That's it. I'm not talking to
you until you say 'I'm sorry.'
translations.……ちゃんと言ってくれたね。じゃあ今回だけは許してあげる。:
...You actually said it.
Alright, I'll let you off
just this once.
translations.聞こえなかったよ？ “ごめんなさい”は？:
I didn't hear you？
Where's that 'I'm sorry'？
translations.もう、約束破るなんてどういうつもり？ 何かあったんじゃないかって、私心配してたの:
Jeez, breaking a promise...
What were you thinking？
I was worried sick that
something happened to you...
translations.ごめん、色々あって……。:
I'm sorry, a lot of stuff
came up...
translations.もういいよ。今度からはちゃんと連絡ちょうだい？ それじゃ。:
It's fine. Just make sure
you let me know next time,
okay？ Talk to you later.
translations.最近……あまり会ってくれないね？:
You haven't really seen me
much lately, have you？
translations.そうだよ。ねえ、私……さびしいんだよ？:
Yeah. Hey...
I've been lonely, you know？
translations.ごめん、さびしい思いさせて。また●からも連絡するから……。:
Sorry for making you feel
lonely. ● will get
in touch again soon...
translations.ほんとね？ 私、待ってるから。それじゃ……。:
You mean it？
I'll be waiting, then.
Talk to you later...
translations.（最近油断してたかも。ちゃんとしなくちゃな）:
(Maybe I've been slacking
off lately. I need to step
it up.)
translations.よし！ 今から会おう！:
Alright! Let's meet up
right now!
translations.ほんと？ うれしい……。急いで支度しなくちゃ。:
Really？ I'm so happy...
I've gotta hurry and get
ready!
translations.じゃあ●、先に行って待ってるから。:
Alright ●, I'll go on
ahead and wait for you.
translations.それは誤解だって。たまたま連絡できない日が続いただけだから。:
You've got the wrong idea.
I just had a few days in a
row where I couldn't reach
out, that's all.
translations.そうなの？ そっか……あなたの都合考えてなくてごめんね？ じゃあ……。:
Is that so？ I see...
Sorry for not considering
your schedule, okay？
Talk to you later...
translations.（うーん……さびしがっているか）:
(Hmm... Guess she really
was feeling lonely.)
translations.体、大丈夫？ ちゃんと家で休んでる？:
Are you feeling okay？
Are you resting up at home
like you should？
translations.ああ、おとなしくしてるよ。心配してくれてありがとう……。:
Yeah, I'm taking it easy.
Thanks for checking on me...
translations.声に元気ないような気がするなぁ。時間作れたらお見舞いに行くから、がんばって。:
You sound so drained...
If I can make some time,
I'll come visit, so hang in
there, okay？
translations.それはうれしいな……来れそうだったらよろしく。:
I'd love that... If you can
make it, please do.
translations.ねえ、体調はどう？ ほんとはそばで看病してあげたいけど……。:
Hey, how are you feeling？
I really wish I could be
there to take care of you,
though...
translations.それもいいけど……悪いよ、自分でなんとか治すから。:
That sounds nice, but...
I'd feel bad. I'll manage
to get better on my own.
translations.こういうときこそ頼ってほしいんだけどな。時間作れそうならお見舞い行くからね？:
Times like this are when
I want you to lean on me.
If I can make time, I'll
come visit, okay？
translations.デート、楽しかったよ。ありがとう。:
I had a great time on our
date. Thank you.
translations.そっか。喜んでくれて良かった。:
Really？ I'm glad you had
a good time.
translations.またこんなデートしたいな。期待してもいい？:
I'd love to go on another
date like that. Can I get
my hopes up？
translations.楽しかったよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
I had fun. What about you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.もちろん、楽しかったよ♪ ありがとう。:
Of course I had fun♪
Thank you.
translations.楽しいデートだったね。あなたはどうだった？:
That was such a fun date.
How was it for you？
translations.●も楽しかったよ。次もこれくらい楽しいデートにできたらいいな。:
● had fun, too.
I hope our next date is
just as much fun.
translations.ううん、次はもっと楽しいデートにしなくちゃ。ね？:
Uh-uh, we have to make our
next one even more fun.
Right？
translations.今回のデートでね、あなたに惚れ直しちゃった。:
You know, today's date
made me fall for you
all over again.
translations.それだけ素敵なデートだったってこと。あなたがカレシで良かった▼:
That's how great it was.
I'm so glad you're my
boyfriend▼
translations.そんなにベタ誉めされると照れるな……ありがとう。:
When you praise me like
that, I get shy...
Thanks.
translations.最高の時間をありがとう。まだ胸が熱いよ……。:
Thanks for an amazing
time. My heart's still
all warm...
translations.●も。いいデートだったな……。:
● too.
That was a really great
date...
translations.この余韻、ずーっと味わってたいな……。でも眠れなくなっちゃいそう。:
I want to savor this
afterglow forever...
Though I might not sleep!
translations.はは、あんまり夜更かししないようにね。:
Haha, don't stay up
too late, okay？
translations.今回のデートは最高だったよ。こんなに幸せでいいのかなって感じ♪:
Today was the best!
I almost wonder if it's
okay to be this happy♪
translations.そんなに喜んでくれたんだ……。:
You're really that happy
about it...
translations.またこんなデートしよ。約束ね？:
Let's have another date
like this. Promise？
translations.デート、感動しちゃった。ありがとう。:
Our date was so touching.
Thank you.
translations.お礼なんていいよ。●も楽しかったし。:
You don't have to thank
me. ● had fun too.
translations.あなたとの時間はいつでも特別だけど、その中でもとびきり特別……。:
Time with you is always
special, but this was
extra special...
translations.これからも二人の特別な日をたくさん作っていこうね。:
Let's keep making lots
of special days for
the two of us, okay？
translations.今回のデートは感激の連続で……胸がいっぱいになる感じがしたの。:
Today was so touching...
My heart felt completely
full the whole time.
translations.はは、それじゃしばらくはデートしなくてもいい感じ？:
Haha, so does that mean
you're good on dates
for a while？
translations.その逆。毎日でもデートしたくなっちゃうくらい。:
Just the opposite!
I want to go on dates
every single day.
translations.毎日って……それは難しいけどさ。:
Every single day...？
That might be tough.
translations.ふふ、わかってる。それだけ楽しかったってこと。:
Hehe, I know.
That's just how much
fun I had.
translations.ありがとう。そう言ってくれると、準備した甲斐あったよ。:
Thanks. Hearing that
makes all the planning
worth it.
translations.ねえ、ありがとう。１秒も忘れたくない、最高のデートだったよ。:
Hey, thank you.
I don't want to forget
a single second of today.
translations.●も今日は楽しかった……。デートできて本当に良かった。:
● had fun today too...
I'm really glad we went
on this date.
translations.起きた出来事、全部メモしておけばよかったかな……。:
Maybe I should've taken
notes on everything that
happened...
translations.ふふ、ブログでも作って私たちのラブラブぶりを公開しちゃおっか▼:
Hehe, maybe I should start
a blog to show off how
lovey-dovey we are▼
translations.それは恥ずかしいから勘弁して……。:
Give me a break, that'd
be so embarrassing...
translations.たまにはあなたの家でのんびりデートっていうのも、いいね。:
A chill date at your place
every now and then
is really nice.
translations.これからは毎回家デートにする？:
Should all our dates
be at home from now on？
translations.それもいいけど、お出かけするのも楽しいから……。:
That sounds nice, but
going out is fun too...
translations.あなたの部屋って落ち着くね。いっそのこと、一緒に住んじゃおうか？:
Your room is so calming.
Maybe we should just
move in together？
translations.ふふ、冗談。でも、将来冗談じゃなくなるかは、あなた次第かな？:
Hehe, just kidding.
Though whether that stays
a joke is up to you？
translations.デート、楽しかったよ。あなたの部屋、また行きたいな、いい？:
Today was so fun.
Can I come over to your
room again sometime？
translations.もちろん。それじゃしっかり掃除しとかないと。:
Of course. Guess I'd better
clean up really well then.
translations.そうだね。カノジョに見られちゃいけないもの、隠しておかないと。:
That's right. Better hide
anything your girlfriend
shouldn't see.
translations.私の家に来てくれてありがとう。楽しかった？:
Thanks for coming over.
Did you have fun？
translations.ああ、楽しかった。また行ってもいい？:
Yeah, I had a blast.
Can I come over again？
translations.いいよ。あなたといれば、外でも家でも、素敵な時間になるんだもん。:
Of course. When I'm with you,
staying in or going out,
it's always wonderful.
translations.（……かわいいこと言ってくれちゃって）:
(...Look at you, saying
such sweet things.)
translations.家デートって、いつもより距離が近づくような感じがして、好きだな。:
I really like dates at home.
It feels like we get even
closer than usual.
translations.そうだな。後はのんびりくつろげるし……。:
Yeah. Plus, we can just
kick back and relax...
translations.でも、のんびりしすぎて帰りがつい遅くなっちゃうよね。:
Though we relax so much
that it ends up getting
late before you know it.
translations.そういうところも楽しいけどね。:
Though that's all part
of the fun, too.
translations.家に来てくれてうれしかったけど、帰った後さびしくなっちゃうね……。:
I was so glad you came over,
but it feels so lonely
after you head home...
translations.もっといてほしかった？:
Did you want me
to stay longer？
translations.うん……。あなたが帰ると、部屋が急に静かになったみたいで。:
Yeah... Once you leave,
the room suddenly feels
so quiet.
translations.ごめん。また行くからさ。:
Sorry. I'll come over
again soon.
translations.あの、シャワー貸してくれてありがとう。:
Um, thanks for letting me
use your shower.
translations.ああ。……でも、なんかドキドキした。:
Sure. ...Though, honestly,
my heart was racing a bit.
translations.もう……。でも、実は私も。:
Oh, stop... But actually,
mine was too.
translations.そりゃそうだよな。:
Haha, I guess
that's only natural.
translations.デートで行ったお店、おいしかったね。:
That place we went to
on our date was so good.
translations.食事がおいしいと会話も弾むし、いい店だったな。:
Good food really gets the
conversation flowing.
It was a great spot.
translations.次も行ってみようか？:
Want to go there again
next time？
translations.いいね。考えとくよ。:
Sounds good.
I'll keep it in mind.
translations.ねえ、デートで行ったお店、いいチョイスだったね。:
Hey, that restaurant
on our date was such
a great choice.
translations.そうだな。せっかくのお出かけだし、おいしいもの食べられて良かったよ。:
Yeah. Since we were out,
I'm glad we got to have
something delicious.
translations.今度のデートでも、あれくらいおいしいお店に行けたらうれしいな。:
I'd love it if we could go
somewhere just as good
on our next date.
translations.オッケー、探しとくよ。:
All right, I'll find us
a good spot.
translations.ねえ、デートで行ったお店、あらかじめリサーチしてたの？:
Hey, did you research that
restaurant beforehand？
translations.私の好みにぴったりだったから。ありがとう。:
It was right up my alley.
Thank you.
translations.どういたしまして。喜んでくれてよかった。:
You're welcome.
I'm glad you liked it.
translations.ねえ……今、何してる？:
Hey... what are you up to
right now？
translations.別に何もしてないよ。そっちは？:
Not much of anything.
How about you？
translations.何もしてない。そしたら、あなたに電話したくなって……よかった、つながって。:
Nothing. And then I really
wanted to call you...
I'm glad I reached you.
translations.ううん。あなたと電話してるな、って。ごめんね、特に用はなかったの。:
No. Just thinking, 'I'm on
the phone with you.' Sorry,
I didn't have a real reason.
translations.いいよ、別に用なんかなくても。●も話せてうれしいし。:
It's fine, you don't need
a reason. ●'s glad
to talk to you too.
translations.ぼーっとしてたら、あなたがどうしてるか気になってきて。:
I was zoning out, and then
I started wondering
what you were up to.
translations.別に何もしてないよ。だから電話くれてうれしかった。:
Not much of anything.
So I'm really glad
you called.
translations.なんとなく電話できるって、いいね。あなただっていつでも電話くれていいんだからね？:
It's nice to just call like this.
You know you can call me
anytime too, right？
translations.はーい▼ ふふ、あなたの声が聞きたかったの。:
Yes？ ▼ Hehe, I just
wanted to hear your voice.
translations.はは、そっか。●の声でよければ何回でも聞かせるよ。:
Haha, I see. If ●'s voice
is good enough, I'll talk
to you as much as you want.
translations.ねえねえ、今私のこと考えてたでしょ？:
Hey, hey, you were thinking
about me just now,
weren't you？
translations.あなたが私の声聞きたがってると思って、かけてあげたの。うれしい？:
I figured you wanted to 
hear my voice, so I called. 
Happy？
translations.そっか。ありがとう、うれしいよ。:
Oh, I see. 
Thanks, I'm really glad.
translations.誰かの声が無性に聞きたくなるときって、ない？:
Don't you ever just really 
want to hear someone's 
voice？
translations.あるよ。なんとなくさびしいときとかね。:
Yeah. Like when I'm 
feeling kind of lonely.
translations.そうそう。だから電話に出てくれてありがとう。:
Exactly. So thanks for 
answering my call.
translations.あのね……なんだか眠れないの……。:
Hey... I just can't seem 
to fall asleep...
translations.大丈夫？ ●にできることある？:
Are you okay？ 
Is there anything 
● can do？
translations.……あなたの声聞いたら落ち着いてきた。これでたぶん眠れると思う……。:
...Hearing your voice 
calmed me down. 
I think I can probably 
sleep now...
translations.そう？ また眠れなくなったらいつでも電話して。:
Really？ If you can't 
sleep again, call me 
anytime.
translations.昨日怖い夢見ちゃって……そのせいかな、うまく眠れないの。いい方法ないかな？:
I had a scary dream last 
night... Maybe that's why 
I can't seem to sleep. 
Any good ideas？
translations.安心して眠れる方法か。えーっと……好きだよ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
A way to sleep peacefully, 
huh. Um... 
I love you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そう来たか……。ありがとう、いい夢が見られそう。:
Didn't see that coming... 
Thanks, I think I'll have 
sweet dreams now.
translations.これで合ってた？ よかった……。:
Did that do the trick？ 
Phew, what a relief...
translations.私ね、あなたと電話した夜はぐっすり眠れるんだよ。だから寝る前に少しお話ししておこ:
You know, I always sleep 
so soundly on nights we 
talk. So I wanted to chat 
a bit before bed.
translations.へえー、●の声にそんな効果が……。どうしてだろう？:
Huh, ●'s voice has 
that kind of effect...？ 
I wonder why.
translations.うーん、安心するからかな？ あなたの声、大好きだよ。:
Hmm, maybe because it's 
so comforting？ 
I really love your voice.
translations.（……ドキドキしてこっちが眠れなくなりそうだ）:
(...Now my heart's racing. 
I'm the one who won't 
be able to sleep.)
translations.ねえ、そろそろ寝る時間でしょ？:
Hey, isn't it about time 
for bed？
translations.じゃあ、一日の最後にしゃべったのは私ってことになるのかな。おやすみなさい。:
Then I guess that means 
I'm the last person you 
talked to today. 
Good night.
translations.たしかにね。明日の一番も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だといいな。おやすみ。:
You're right. I hope the 
first one tomorrow is 
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, too. Good night.
translations.もういい時間だね。そろそろ寝るの？:
It's getting pretty late. 
Are you heading to bed 
soon？
translations.ダメだよ、夜更かしは。ちゃんと寝なさい。:
No staying up late! 
Go get some proper sleep.
translations.もう寝る時間だよね。おやすみなさい。:
It's about time for bed, 
isn't it？ Good night.
translations.ねえ。誰かに“おやすみなさい”って言えるのって、うれしい？:
Hey. Doesn't it feel nice 
being able to say 
'good night' to someone？
translations.ああ、一人暮らしだと言う機会ないし。助かるよ。:
Yeah, living alone, I 
never get the chance to. 
I really appreciate it.
translations.ねえ、明日デキシーズのシフト入れてなかった？:
Hey, didn't you have a 
shift at Dixie's tomorrow？
translations.ちょっとそれが気になったの。起きたら確認しておくね？ おやすみ。:
I was just wondering. 
I'll check when I wake 
up, okay？ Good night.
translations.あなたって、けっこう夜遅くまで起きてる？ 体に良くないよ？:
Are you usually up pretty 
late？ It's not good for 
your health, you know？
translations.少しくらいは大丈夫だって。:
A little bit won't hurt, 
really.
translations.ちゃんと睡眠取れば勉強の効率だって違うんだから。はい、おやすみなさい。:
If you get proper sleep, 
you'll study way better. 
Now then, good night.
translations.あのね、寝る前のラブコールです。:
Just so you know... 
this is your bedtime love 
call.
translations.今から寝るんだ？ じゃあ……おやすみなさい。:
Heading to bed now？ 
Then... good night.
translations.●もそろそろ寝ようかな……。:
Guess ● should
head to bed soon, too...
translations.あ、まだ半分寝てるね？ 起こしに行こうか？:
Ah, you're still
half-asleep, aren't you？
Want me to come wake you up？
translations.あぁ……ありがとう。おかげで目が覚めたよ。:
Ah... thanks.
That woke me right up.
translations.カノジョからのモーニングコール、感謝してね？:
A wake-up call from your
girlfriend... You'd better
appreciate it, okay？
translations.おはよう。ちゃんと起きてるかな？:
Good morning.
Are you properly awake？
translations.起きてるよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もちゃんと起きてるね。:
I'm awake.
Looks like you're wide
awake too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.一応ね。あなたにモーニングコールしたくて、早起きしちゃった。:
Pretty much. I wanted to
give you a wake-up call,
so I got up early.
translations.おはよう。今日も一日、がんばろうね。:
Good morning.
Let's do our best today,
okay？
translations.ああ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲から電話もらったから元気出てきた！:
Yeah. Getting a call
from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really
perked me up!
translations.よしよし。じゃあまた、学校でね。:
There, there.
See you at school, then.
translations.ハーイ。朝の準備はバッチリかな？:
Hi there!
Are you all ready to go？
translations.もう、そういうのは昨日のうちにやっておいたほうがいいんだよ？ 朝は忙しいんだから:
Jeez, you should really
get ready the night before.
Mornings are busy, you know？
translations.ああ……ありがとう。この電話で目が覚めたよ。:
Yeah... thanks.
Your call woke me right up.
translations.カノジョのモーニングコールで起きられて幸せ？:
Happy waking up to a
morning call from your
girlfriend？
translations.そうだな。優しいカノジョで助かったよ。:
Yeah. I'm lucky to have
such a sweet girlfriend.
translations.最近バイトに出てないね。何か理由があるの？:
You haven't been working
shifts lately.
Is there a reason？
translations.そうじゃないけど……なかなか出るヒマがなくてさ。:
Not really, but...
I haven't had much time
to go in lately.
translations.そう……。私もあなたのこと頼りにしてるから、出られそうになったら、お願いね。:
I see... I really rely on
you, so when you're free,
please come in, okay？
translations.じゃあ、そろそろ切るね。:
Well, I should probably
hang up now.
translations.バイバイ。●からもまた電話するから。:
Bye-bye. ● will call
you again, too.
translations.そろそろ切らないとね。それじゃ、おやすみ。:
I'd better hang up now.
Well then, good night.
translations.ごめん、もっとお話ししたいのに……眠くなってきちゃった。:
Sorry, I wanted to talk
more, but... I'm getting
so sleepy.
translations.じゃあ……おやすみ。またな。:
All right... good night.
Talk to you later.
translations.そろそろおやすみの時間だね。今日の最後に声聞けて、うれしかったよ。:
It's about time for bed.
I was glad to hear your voice
at the end of the day.
translations.●もだよ。じゃあ……また明日。:
● was happy, too.
Well... see you tomorrow.
translations.私……あまり機嫌よくないよ。:
I'm... not in a very
good mood right now.
translations.うん、そのことなんだけど。:
Yeah, that's what I'm
calling about.
translations.どっちにも非があるよな: We were both in the wrong.
translations.●が悪かったよ……ごめん。:
● was in the wrong...
I'm sorry.
translations.……謝ってくれるんだ。じゃあ、許してあげる。:
...You're actually apologizing.
Well then, I forgive you.
translations.ありがとう。なかなか言い出せなくて……本当ごめん。:
Thanks. I had trouble
bringing it up...
I'm really sorry.
translations.いいよ。私もあまり引きずりたくないし。:
It's okay. I didn't want to
drag this out either.
translations.でも、反省してくれてるなら……次のデートはいっぱいサービスしてほしいな。:
Still, if you're really sorry...
you'd better treat me extra well
on our next date.
translations.了解。精一杯やらせてもらいます。:
Understood.
I'll give it my all.
translations.どっちにも非があると思うんだけど……どうかな。:
I think we were both at fault...
What do you think？
translations.そう言われればそうかもしれないけど……。:
I guess when you put it like that,
you might be right, but...
translations.でもわだかまりが残るのはイヤだし……。ちゃんと謝るよ、ごめん。:
Still, I hate leaving bad feelings
between us...
I'm really sorry.
translations.ずるいよそんなの……。こっちこそごめんね。私ばっかり文句言って……。:
Hey, that's not fair...
I'm sorry too. All I did was
complain the whole time...
translations.気にしてないよ。ほんとお互い様だしさ。:
Don't worry about it.
Really, it was on both of us.
translations.うん……。わかった、もう気にしない。:
Yeah... Okay,
I won't dwell on it anymore.
translations.そうじゃなくてさ……●が言いたいのは……。:
That's not it...
What ● meant was...
translations.……いいよ、わかった。あなたがちゃんと考えてくれたなら、それでいいの。:
...It's fine, I understand.
As long as you actually thought
about it, that's enough for me.
translations.たしかにあなただけのせいじゃないもん。私もつい……意地悪言っちゃった。:
It definitely wasn't all your fault
anyway. I ended up being...
a little mean, too.
translations.ごめん、●から仲直りの連絡するべきだったよな。次からはちゃんとするから。:
Sorry, ● should've reached
out to make up.
I'll do better next time.
translations.あ、留守録入ってる。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲からか。:
Oh, a voicemail.
Is it from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.もしもし、私です。今日はあなたの誕生日だね、おめでとう。:
Hello, it's me. Today's your
birthday, right？ Happy birthday!
translations.留守電だけど、私が一番最初だよね？ ふふ、それじゃ。:
Even if it's voicemail, I'm first,
right？ Hehe, talk soon!
translations.（こんな遅くに電話くれるなんて……お礼言っとこう）:
(Calling this late just to say
that... I should thank her.)
translations.もしもし、姉ヶ崎寧々です。今日は大切な記念日……。:
Hello, it's Nene Anegasaki.
Today is our special anniversary...
translations.ふつつかなカノジョですが、これからもどうぞよろしくお願いします。じゃあね。:
I know I have my flaws,
but please keep taking good care
of me. Bye for now!
translations.（こっちこそよろしくお願いしますって感じだな。あとでお礼言っとこう）:
(I should be the one saying that.
I'll make sure to thank her later.)
translations.もしもし。出られないんだ、一番乗りしたかったのになぁ……。:
Hello？ You can't pick up, huh...
And here I wanted to be first...
translations.えっと、ハッピーニューイヤー、って言いたかったの。今年もよろしく。:
Um, I just wanted to say
Happy New Year! Let's have
another great year together.
translations.（それで連絡くれたのか。うれしいけど、悪いことしたな）:
(So that's why she called.
I'm happy she did, but I feel
bad for missing it.)
translations.もしもし。もし都合よければ、会えるかなと思ったんだけど……ダメみたいだね。また電:
Hello？ I was hoping we could
meet up if you were free...
Guess not. I'll call again later.
translations.（気づかなかった……こっちから電話しようかな）:
(I didn't notice... Maybe I
should give her a call.)
translations.私だよ。会いたいと思って電話したのに、残念。おたがい惜しいことしたね？ じゃあ、:
It's me. I called because
I wanted to see you,
too bad. We both missed
out, huh？ Talk soon.
translations.（ほんと惜しいことしたな……。あとで電話するか）:
(We really did miss out...
I'll call her later.)
translations.留守電か……はぁ。会いたかったんだけど、うまくいかないね。じゃあ。:
Voicemail, huh... *sigh*
I wanted to see you, but
guess it wasn't meant to be.
Bye for now.
translations.（残念……。こっちから電話しようかな）:
(Too bad... Maybe I should
give her a call.)
translations.寧々です。よかったらだけど、今度、どこか遊びに行けないかな？ 考えておいてね。:
It's Nene. If you're free,
wanna go hang out
somewhere soon？
Think about it, okay？
translations.（デートか……こっちから誘ってみようかな？）:
(A date, huh... Maybe I
should ask her out myself？)
translations.もしもし、そろそろデートしたくなってきたんだけど、あなたは？ 返事、楽しみにして:
Hello？ I've been wanting to
go on a date lately,
how about you？ I'll be
waiting for your reply.
translations.（●のバカ！ ちゃんとあとで連絡しとかないと）:
(●, you idiot!
I've gotta make sure to
get back to her later.)
translations.私。ねえ、どこかに連れてってほしいな。あなたからの連絡、待ってるね♪:
It's me. Hey, take me out
somewhere fun, okay？
I'll be waiting to hear
from you♪
translations.（こっちから電話したほうがいいかな……）:
(Maybe I should give her
a call...)
translations.もしもし。なんとなく、あなたの声が聞きたかったんだけど……ごめん。じゃあね。:
Hello？ I just kind of
wanted to hear your voice,
but... sorry. Bye.
translations.（なんだ？ あとで電話したほうがいいかな）:
(Wonder what that was about？
Maybe I should call her later.)
translations.どうしたの、誰かと会うの？:
What's up, are you
meeting someone？
translations.ええ、そうなの？ ふふ、困っちゃう♪:
Wait, really？ Hehe, you're
putting me on the spot♪
translations.えぇと、じゃあ……なんて呼べばいいかな？:
Um, so... what should
I call you？
translations.▲紹介友達名▲。うん……よろしく。:
▲紹介友達名▲. Yeah... nice
to meet you.
translations.▲紹介友達名▲。よろしくね。: ▲紹介友達名▲. Nice to meet you.
translations.う～ん、じゃあ、もうここに書いちゃって？:
Hmm, alright, why don't you
just write it here for me？
translations.▲紹介友達名▲。そっかそっか。よろしくね？:
▲紹介友達名▲. Got it, got it.
Nice to meet you, okay？
translations.ダ～メ。やめなさい、もう。:
No way. Cut it out already,
geez.
translations.えぇと……そんなに、じっと見ないでも……ねぇ？:
Um... you don't have to
stare so intently... you know？
translations.あの……そんなに見ないでください……。:
Um... please don't stare
at me like that...
translations.ちょっと、近いかなぁ～って。:
Just thinking you're
a little close, maybe~
translations.ちょっと、近すぎません？:
Aren't you a bit
too close？
translations.ち、近いんですけど……。:
Y-You're kind of close,
you know...
translations.あの……えと、もう、いいかな。:
Um... er, is that
enough now, maybe？
translations.えと……まぁ、いっか、うん。:
Er... well, I guess
it's fine, yeah.
translations.もしかして、彼のお兄さん？:
Are you his older brother,
by any chance？
translations.あの、もしかして、彼のお父さんですか？:
Um, are you his father,
by any chance？
translations.あの、もしかして、彼のお姉さんですか？:
Um, could you be
his older sister？
translations.あの、もしかして、彼のお母さんですか？:
Um, could you be
his mother？
translations.じゃあ、カレとはどういう？:
Then, how are you
related to him？
translations.あの……カレとはどういう？:
Um... how are you
related to him？
translations.じゃあ、もしかして、弟くんかな？:
Then could you be
his little brother？
translations.え、まさかお母さん、とか？:
Wait, don't tell me...
his mom？
translations.じゃあ、もしかして、妹さん？:
Then could you be
his little sister？
translations.わたし、あの……彼とお付き合いしてます。姉ヶ崎、寧々といいます。よろしくお願いし:
Um, I'm... dating him.
My name is Nene Anegasaki.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
translations.似てるかも……あ、いえ。:
You kind of look alike...
Ah, never mind.
translations.あの、お世話になってます。よろしく、お願いします。:
Um, thank you for always
looking after him.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
translations.お兄さんですか……ふふっ。:
His older brother, I see...
Hehe.
translations.あの、よろしくお願いします。お姉さん。:
Um, it's a pleasure to
meet you, big sister.
translations.よろしくね。 お姉ちゃんって呼んで？:
Nice to meet you.
Call me Big Sis, okay？
translations.よろしくね。 お父さんに似てるねぇ……。:
Nice to meet you.
You really look like
your dad...
translations.どうもです。 よろしくね？:
Hello there.
Nice to meet you, okay？
translations.なるほど。 よろしくお願いします。:
I see.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
translations.うん……すぐわかっちゃった、ふふっ！:
Yeah... I could tell
right away, hehe！
translations.やっぱり、家族ですよね。うん……。:
You really are family,
aren't you？ Yeah...
translations.ちょっと質問なんですけど、家族の間でスキンシップが多いんですか？いえ、なんとなく:
I have a quick question...
Does your family show
a lot of physical affection？
No reason, just wondering.
translations.これからもよろしくお願いします。:
Please take good care of me
from now on as well.
translations.髪、そんなにおかしいかな……。:
Is my hair really
that weird...？
translations.なんかいっぱいいて。賑やかね？:
There are so many people.
It's so lively, isn't it？
translations.じゃあ、同じ質問させてください。どうですか？:
Then let me ask you
the same question.
How about it？
translations.彼とは、もう長い？:
Have you known him
for a long time？
translations.彼から、わたしのこと、聞いてた？: Did he tell you about me？
translations.彼、わたしのこと、何か？:
Did he say anything
about me？
translations.ちょっと、照れちゃうよね？:
It's a little embarrassing,
isn't it？
translations.なんか、不思議な感じですね？:
It feels kind of strange,
doesn't it？
translations.こんなの、初めてだよね？:
It's your first time doing
something like this, right？
translations.こういうの、初めてですか？:
Is this sort of thing
a first for you？
translations.そっか。なんかそんな感じする。:
I see.
I kind of had a feeling.
translations.じゃあ、わたしと会えない時って……なるほどね？ ふふっ。:
So when he can't see me...
Aha, I get it？ Hehe.
translations.もう、恥ずかしい……。:
Oh jeez,
this is so embarrassing...
translations.そうですか……あの、こんな感じです。:
I see... Um, well,
this is pretty much how we are.
translations.じゃあ、久しぶりかな？ よかった。:
So it's been a while, then？
I'm glad.
translations.そうなの？ もう……。: Is that so？ Oh, come on...
translations.すみません、あの、お気づかいなく。:
I'm sorry, um,
please don't mind me.
translations.そうなんだ……よし、がんばろ、わたしも。:
I see... All right,
I'll do my best too.
translations.そっかそっか。 よかった。:
I see, I see.
What a relief.
translations.そうなんですか、じゃあ、よかった。:
Oh, is that so？
Well then, I'm glad.
translations.まだ、そんなに長くは……。:
We haven't been together
all that long yet...
translations.まだ、そんなに長くないんです。:
We haven't been together
that long yet, actually.
translations.もう１年以上。なんだよね……。:
It's been over a year now,
actually...
translations.えと、もう1年以上になります。:
Um, we've been together
for over a year now.
translations.どれくらいだっけ……もう、長～く。:
How long has it been...？
Just... a looong time.
translations.わたし達、もう、ずいぶん長いです。:
We've already been together
for quite a long time.
translations.いつも側にいて大切にしてくれるところ……言っちゃった！恥ずかし！:
How he's always there for me
and cherishes me...
Aah, I said it!
So embarrassing!
translations.いつも側にいてくれて……大切にしてもらってます。:
He's always by my side...
and he treats me so dearly.
translations.えぇと、優しいところ。温かいっていうか。ふふっ、恥ずかしい。:
Um, how kind he is.
Warm, I guess.
Hehe, this is embarrassing.
translations.優しい人だからだと、思います。温かい人です。:
I think it's because
he's such a kind person.
He's so warm.
translations.それはほら、カッコいいでしょ、彼？ ……なんてね！ ふふっ！:
I mean, look at him,
he's handsome, right？
...Just kidding! Hehe!
translations.カッコいいですもん、彼。学校でもモテモテです。ふふっ。:
He really is good-looking.
He's super popular
at school, too. Hehe.
translations.やっぱり、アタマがいいところ。わたしがボーッとしてるから。:
Definitely how smart he is.
Since I tend to space out.
translations.それは、ほらアタマがいいし、話も面白いし――あの、やだ……。:
Well, you know, he's smart,
and fun to talk to—
um, gosh, listen to me...
translations.ダメ？ そういうの言わなきゃ？ う～ん……やっぱりダメ。:
No good？ Do I really have
to say something like that？
Mmm... nope, still can't.
translations.最近なら……そうだ料理。美味しいって褒められたこと。がんばったから、余計嬉しくて:
Recently... Oh, my cooking!
He told me it was delicious.
I worked hard on it,
so that made me extra happy.
translations.料理が上手って褒められたこと。やっぱり、女子ですから。ふふっ。:
Getting praised
for my cooking.
I am a girl, after all. Hehe.
translations.最近なら……やっぱり、プレゼント。うん……すごく嬉しかった。ふふっ。:
Recently... Definitely
the present he gave me.
Yeah... that made me
so happy. Hehe.
translations.あの、彼からプレゼントを……すごく嬉しかったです。:
Well, he gave me a present...
It made me so happy.
translations.大切な日を、また一緒に迎えられたことかな……なんて、ちょっと大人っぽいでしょ？:
Celebrating another special day
together, I guess... Hehe, doesn't
that sound kind of mature？
translations.やっぱり、彼と一緒に大切な日を迎えられたこと――あ、やだ、恥ずかしい……。:
Getting to spend a special day
with him, I'd say—
Oh gosh, that's embarrassing...
translations.最近……あ、そう！誕生日をお祝いしてもらったこと。ふふっ！:
Lately... Oh, I know!
Having him celebrate my birthday!
Hehe!
translations.この間、誕生日だったんですけど、あの、彼がお祝いしてくれて……。:
It was my birthday recently,
and, well, he celebrated it
with me...
translations.最近嬉しかったのはやっぱり――えぇと……無し無し。忘れて？:
What made me happy recently was—
uh... nope, forget it!
Just forget I said anything, okay？
translations.最近嬉しかったのは彼が――あの……忘れてください。ホホホ……。:
What made me happy recently
was when he—um... please just
forget that. Ahaha...
translations.メールのことかな。やっぱり少ないと、気になるよね、そういうの……。:
Texting, maybe. When there aren't
many messages, you can't help
but worry, right？
translations.ときどき、彼がメールをくれないことがあって。めんどくさがりじゃないですか、彼。:
Sometimes he doesn't text me.
He can be a little lazy with that,
can't he？
translations.悩みか……う～ん、彼とスキンシップがちょっと足りないっていうか、ほら、よそよそし:
Worries... Hmm, maybe not enough
cuddling? It makes him feel
distant, you know？
translations.彼がよそよそしいって言うか、スキンシップが――えぇと、やっぱりやめときます……。:
He seems a bit distant, or rather,
physical affection... um, actually,
never mind...
translations.彼と食事の好みが、合わないなぁと思うことがあって。けっこう重要だよ？:
Sometimes I feel our tastes in food
don't really match. That's pretty
important, you know？
translations.彼と、たまに食事の好みが合わないことが……あ、でもわたしそういうとこどうにでもな:
Sometimes our tastes in food don't
quite match... Oh, but I can adapt
to anything, so it's fine.
translations.彼がね、カメラに凝ってるんだけど……すぐ、エッチな角度で撮りたがるんだもん。:
He's gotten into photography lately...
but he always tries to take photos
from naughty angles!
translations.最近彼、カメラに凝ってるじゃないですか……それは、いいんですけど、えぇと……なん:
He's been into photography lately...
Which is fine, but, um...
never mind, it's nothing.
translations.悩みか……やっぱり、あれかな……彼、ちょっとキスが……一生懸命なのはわかるけど、:
Worries... I guess that one thing...
He's a little... with kissing...
I know he tries his best, but...
translations.えぇと……やめときます。彼、けっこう傷つきやすいですもんね？ ふふっ。:
Um... I'd better not say.
He gets his feelings hurt easily,
doesn't he？ Hehe.
translations.ほら、突然触ってきたりとか……しつこい時。嫌な時だって、あるでしょ？そういうの。:
Like touching me out of nowhere...
or being too persistent. There're
times you're not in the mood, right？
translations.悩み……あの、もしかして、お家ではスキンシップが盛んなんですか？:
Worries... Um, by any chance,
is everyone really affectionate
at your house？
translations.悩み、悩みか……悩んでないからな……最近。:
Worries, huh...
I don't really have any... lately.
translations.悩みは……えぇと……すいません、あんまり悩んでないみたいです。:
Worries... um... I'm sorry,
I guess I don't really have any.
translations.趣味は……映画鑑賞とか、あとは家の中のことをチマチマやること。:
My hobbies... Watching movies,
and puttering around doing little
chores around the house.
translations.趣味は映画鑑賞です。あとは、細かい片付けとか、意外と好きです。:
My hobby is watching movies.
I also surprisingly enjoy doing little
tidying-up tasks.
translations.趣味とは違うかもしれないけど、最近、アルバイトが楽しくて……彼もいっしょだし、な:
It might not really be a hobby,
but I've been enjoying work lately...
Plus he's there with me. Just kidding!
translations.最近、彼と一緒にバイトに熱中してたりします。:
Lately, I've been really focused on
our part-time job together.
translations.趣味はお料理です。……ふふっ、最近ハマってて。聞かれたら言ってみようって。:
My hobby is cooking! ...Hehe,
I've been into it lately, so I wanted
to say that if someone asked.
translations.最近はですね、あの、お料理をよく作ってます。彼が食べてくれますから。:
Lately, well, I've been cooking a lot.
Since he's always there to eat it.
translations.最近は、カメラかな……あ、撮るのじゃなくて撮られる方。ちょっと、モデル気分。:
Lately, photography, maybe...
Oh, not taking photos, being the subject!
It makes me feel like a model.
translations.最近は、彼の写真のモデルになるのが、趣味みたいになってます。二人の趣味です。:
Lately, modeling for his photos
has kind of become a hobby.
A hobby for both of us, really.
translations.好きなのは……う～ん、のど飴はよく食べるかな、うん。:
What I like... Hmm, I eat cough drops
a lot, I guess. Yeah.
translations.そうですね……なんでも。親が好き嫌いなく育ててくれたので、助かってます。:
Let's see... pretty much anything.
My parents raised me not to be picky,
so that really helps.
translations.ここのところ和食かな。よく、食べてるからかも。:
Lately it's Japanese food, I think.
Probably because I eat it so often.
translations.最近は、和食です。彼とよく食べに行くので。:
Lately, it's Japanese food.
He and I go out to eat it often.
translations.最近よく行くレストランが出来て、そこのかな。美味しいの、そこ。:
There's a restaurant I've been going to
a lot lately, so maybe their food.
It's really delicious there.
translations.最近彼とよく行ってるレストランがあるんですけど、そこのメニューです。あ、今度、行:
There's a restaurant he and I have
been going to a lot—their food.
Oh, we should go together sometime!
translations.中華かな……うん。奥が深いのよ、中華は。それが分かってきたかも。:
Chinese food, maybe... Yeah.
Chinese cuisine is really deep, you know？
I think I'm starting to appreciate it.
translations.最近は中華ですね。よく食べに行きます、彼と。:
Lately it's Chinese food.
He and I go out for it a lot.
translations.最近、気が付いたら彼の好きなものが好きになっちゃった……言っちゃった、恥ずかし…:
Lately, before I knew it,
I started liking whatever he likes...
I said it out loud! How embarrassing...
translations.彼の趣味が移っちゃったみたいで、一緒です、彼と。:
His tastes seem to have rubbed off on me,
so mine are the same as his now.
translations.彼の一つ上で、高三の１７です。:
I'm a year older than him—
a high school senior, 17.
translations.高三。１８になっちゃいました。:
High school senior.
I ended up turning 18!
translations.彼の一つ上で、高三の１８です。:
I'm a year older than him—
a high school senior, 18.
translations.なぁに？この髪、そんな気になる？:
What's up？ Does my hair
really catch your eye that much？
translations.あの、そんなに気になります？ この髪？:
Um, does my hair really
catch your eye that much？
translations.……この髪、やっぱりおかしいかな？:
...Does my hair really look weird,
after all？
translations.やっぱり、おかしいですか、この髪？:
Does my hair really look strange,
after all？
translations.なんとなく、いつもこんな風だけど……。:
I pretty much always have it
like this, though...
translations.髪は、いつもこんな感じですけど……。:
I usually wear my hair
like this, though...
translations.これは……彼のリクエストっていうか……ふふっ。:
This is... kind of his request,
I guess... Heheh.
translations.こういうのが、彼の好みだそうなので……ふふっ。:
He said he prefers this style,
so... Heheh.
translations.この間切っちゃったんだけど……おかしいかな？:
I just got it cut recently...
Does it look weird？
translations.彼と相談して、切ってみたんですけど……似合わないですか？:
I talked it over with him
and got it cut, but...
does it not suit me？
translations.この間染めたばかりなんだけど……おかしくない？:
I just dyed it recently...
It doesn't look weird, does it？
translations.彼と相談して染めてみたんですけど……おかしいですか？:
I talked it over with him
and tried dyeing it, but...
does it look weird？
translations.ときどきわかんなくなるんだけど、彼、もしかして趣味悪いのかな……。:
Sometimes I really can't tell...
Does he have bad taste... maybe？
translations.あの、彼の趣味って、家族の間では悪いってことになってます？:
Um, does he have a reputation
for bad taste in the family？
translations.そっかそっか……なるほど。: I see, I see... That makes sense.
translations.そっか、よかった。わたしが信じなきゃね？:
I see, what a relief.
I've gotta trust him, right？
translations.もう、このカッコがそんなに気になる？:
Geez, are you that curious
about what I'm wearing？
translations.あの、やっぱり気になります、この服？:
Um, are you that curious
about my outfit？
translations.また……そんなにおかしい？この服？:
Again...？
Does this outfit really
look that weird？
translations.えっと……そんなにおかしいですか、この服？:
Um... does this outfit really
look that strange？
translations.これは、彼が今日着て来てほしいって……おかしい？:
He asked me to wear this today...
Does it look weird？
translations.これ、実は彼のリクエストなんですけど……おかしいですか？:
Actually, he requested this today...
Does it look strange？
translations.これ、実は彼からのプレゼントなんだけど……。:
Actually, this was a present
from him, though...
translations.これ、実は彼からのプレゼントなんです……。:
Actually, this was a present
from him...
translations.ふふっ、じゃあ、よかった！: Heheh, well, that's a relief then!
translations.そっか。うん、残念……。: I see. Yeah, that's too bad...
translations.ねぇ、やっぱり彼と一緒だと、女の子が着る服の好みの話になる？:
Hey, when you're with him,
does he talk about what clothes
he likes on girls？
translations.やっぱり、彼と一緒だと女の子が着る服の好みの話になるんですか？:
When you're with him,
does he talk about what clothes
he likes on girls？
translations.やっぱり……男子って、そんな話ばっかり。:
I knew it... Boys are always
talking about stuff like that.
translations.ふふっ、可愛いもんだ。うん。:
Heheh, that's cute of him.
Mm-hmm.
translations.嘘。ぜったい嘘だと思う。ふふっ。:
No way. That's gotta be a lie.
Heheh.
translations.こういう感じのって、着る？: Do you wear stuff like this？
translations.こういう感じの、着ることあります？:
Do you ever wear
stuff like this？
translations.やっぱり！ 趣味、合いそうだもんね、わたし達！:
I knew it! We've got the
exact same taste, you and me!
translations.あ、じゃあ、ぜったい趣味合いますよ、わたし達！:
Ah, then we definitely share
the same taste!
translations.もうちょっと大人っぽい感じとか……。:
Maybe something a little
more mature, or...？
translations.もうちょっと、大人しめの感じとか……。:
Maybe something a little
more understated, or...？
translations.あ、似合いそう……うんうん。:
Oh, that'd look great on you...
Mm-hmm.
translations.血液型、Ａ型でしょ？: Your blood type is A, right？
translations.血液型、Ａ型ですよね？:
You're blood type A,
aren't you？
translations.血液型、Ｂ型でしょ？: Your blood type is B, right？
translations.血液型、Ｂ型ですよね？:
You're blood type B,
aren't you？
translations.血液型、ＡＢ型でしょ？: Your blood type is AB, right？
translations.血液型、ＡＢ型ですよね？:
You're blood type AB,
aren't you？
translations.血液型、Ｏ型でしょ？: Your blood type is O, right？
translations.血液型、Ｏ型ですよね？:
You're blood type O,
aren't you？
translations.でしょ！！ ゼッタイそうだと思った！:
Called it!
I knew it, I just knew it!
translations.ですよね？ ゼッタイそうだと思った。:
Right？ I was totally sure
that was it.
translations.あれっ？ 絶対そうだと思ったんだけどなぁ……本当は？:
Huh？ But I was so sure...
So what are you really？
translations.あれっ？ そうですか……じゃあ正解は？:
Huh？ Really...？
So what's the real answer？
translations.そうなんですか？う～ん、意外です。:
Is that so？
Hmm, I wouldn't have guessed.
translations.でしょ？ じゃ、いいのよね？:
Told you!
So I got it right, yeah？
translations.彼と同じ血液型だよね、知ってる？:
You have the same blood type
as him, you know？
translations.彼と同じですよね、うん、なるほどね。:
Same blood type as him, right？
Yeah, that makes sense.
translations.それじゃあ、今度はわたし。何型だ？:
Alright, my turn now.
What type am I？
translations.じゃあ、今度はわたし。何型でしょう？:
Okay, my turn next.
What type do you think I am？
translations.当たりましたー！ 大らかで頼れるO型ばんざーい！:
Bingo! Three cheers for
easygoing, dependable Type O!
translations.当たりでーす！ O型同士、同じにおいがしますよね？ ね？:
You got it! We're both Type O,
so we give off the same vibe,
right？ Don't we？
translations.ざんねーん！ 正解は、O型です。そう、彼と一緒。大雑把なカップルです。:
Too bad!
The right answer is Type O.
Yup, same as him.
We're a pretty carefree couple.
translations.残念、正解は、O型でーす。そう、彼と一緒で、どっちかって言うと大雑把です。:
Too bad,
the answer is Type O!
Yup, same as him—
we're both pretty carefree,
if anything.
translations.ん？ ……ちなみに、どのあたりが？:
Hmm？ ...Out of curiosity,
what made you think that？
translations.あ、そういうところあるかも。なるほど、それでか。:
Ah, I might be like that.
I see, so that's why.
translations.どうしてぇ？そんなことないんだけどな……。:
Whyyy？ I'm not really
like that, though...
translations.まあ、そういうところもありますな。:
Well, I suppose I can be
like that at times.
translations.因みに正解は……ジャン！ O型でした。 わかりやすいって言われるんだけど……。:
By the way, the answer is...
Ta-da! Type O!
People say I'm an open book,
though...
translations.ねぇ、それじゃ、血液型相性診断。信じる？:
Hey, so do you believe in
blood type compatibility？
translations.それじゃ、血液型の相性って信じちゃいます？:
Well then, do you believe
in blood type compatibility？
translations.だよね！ じゃあ、自分と相性いいのって何型？:
Right？ So, which type
goes best with yours？
translations.ですよね！ じゃあ、自分と相性がいいのは何型だと思いますか？:
Right？ So which type do you
think is your best match？
translations.そうですか……当たるんだけどなぁ。:
Is that so...？ It's usually
pretty accurate, though.
translations.やっぱり、キッチリしてるところとか？:
Is it because they're
so organized and neat？
translations.それは……クリエイティブな感じがするからとか？:
Is that... because they feel
so creative, maybe？
translations.へぇ……ちょっとミステリアスな感じがいいとか？:
Ohh... Is it because you like
that mysterious vibe？
translations.もちろん、相性バッチリ▼ 大らか同士だし。:
Of course, that's a perfect
match ▼ Since you're
both so laid-back.
translations.違う？ じゃあ……あ、好きな人の血液型だったりして？:
No？ Then... oh, could it be
your crush's blood type？
translations.そっか……う～ん、気になるな。:
I see... Hmm, now I'm
really curious.
translations.うん。あなたとは、そういう感じが合うのかも。:
Yeah. That vibe might
really suit you.
translations.なんか、わかる気がします。うん。:
I feel like I get that.
Mm-hmm.
translations.相性バッチリのパターンだよね？それ。:
That's a match made
in heaven, isn't it？
translations.相性バッチリですよね、そういうパターン。:
That kind of pairing really
is a great match, isn't it？
translations.相性なんて、気の持ちようだし、あなたはそうなのかもね？:
Compatibility is all in your
head anyway, so maybe that's
just how it works for you？
translations.まあ、相性なんて、気の持ちようですもんね？:
Well, compatibility is all
about mindset anyway, right？
translations.それじゃ、血液型的には彼とも相性バッチリなんだ。:
So by blood type, you and
he are a perfect match too.
translations.じゃあ、彼とは血液型診断では、いまいちなんだ。:
So by blood type, you two
aren't the best match, then.
translations.実際の相性は、どういう感じ？:
How's your compatibility
in real life, though？
translations.そうだよね。うん、気にしない気にしない。:
Right？ Yeah, don't pay it
any mind, don't worry.
translations.ちょっと確認なんだけど……自分の上に兄弟、いる？:
Just checking, but... do you
have an older sibling？
translations.だと思った。下の子っていうオーラ出てるもん。じゃあ、もしかしてお兄さん、いる？:
I thought so. You've got
that younger-sibling aura.
Do you have an older brother？
translations.でしょ？ じゃあ、弟、いる？:
Right？ Then, do you
have a younger brother？
translations.大当たりー！ 当てるの得意だもん♪:
Bingo！ I'm pretty good
at guessing♪
translations.お姉さんか……言われてみれば、甘えんぼっぽい？:
An older sister, huh...
Now that you mention it,
do you like being pampered？
translations.おしい！ いると思ったんだけどなぁ。:
So close！ And here I really
thought you had one.
translations.因みに、わたしは、一人っ子です。兄弟欲しかったな。:
By the way, I'm an only
child. I always wanted
brothers and sisters.
translations.そうだ、せっかくだから聞いちゃお……。:
Oh, since I have the chance,
let me ask...
translations.せっかくだから聞いちゃいますけど……。:
Since I have the chance,
may I ask something...？
translations.彼って、昔からこんな感じ？:
Has he always been
like this？
translations.彼って、子供の頃からこうなんですか？:
Has he always been like
this, even as a kid？
translations.だったんですね？: So that's how he was, then？
translations.そっか……へぇ、意外かも。:
I see... Huh, that's
kind of surprising.
translations.そうだったんだ……わかった気がします、いろいろ。:
I see... I feel like that
explains a whole lot.
translations.彼、家でもいつも、活動的な感じ？:
Is he always super active
at home, too？
translations.彼ってお家でもやっぱり、やんちゃなんですか？:
Is he just as mischievous
around the house, too？
translations.彼って、家でもいつも、落ち着いてる感じ？:
Is he always this calm
around the house, too？
translations.彼ってお家でもやっぱり、のんびり屋さんですか？:
Is he pretty laid-back
at home, too？
translations.ふふっ、じゃあ、同じだ。安心しちゃった。:
Hehe, so he's the same.
That's a relief.
translations.ふふっ、じゃ、同じなんですね。わたしと一緒のときと。:
Hehe, then he's the same
as when he's with me.
translations.ふぅん……わたしの前では、カッコつけてるのかな？:
Hmm... I wonder if he's
just trying to act cool
around me？
translations.そうなんだ……ちょっと想像つかないです。:
Is that so...？ I can't
really picture that.
translations.わたしといる時は、どっちかっていうと、のんびーりしてる、かな？:
When he's with me,
he's more on the
laid-back side, I guess？
translations.わたしの前ではどっちかっていうと、積極的な感じ、かな？:
When he's with me,
he's more on the bolder
side, I guess？
translations.それに、いつも優しくて……。:
Plus, he's always
so sweet to me...
translations.でも、時々ちょっとクールだったり……。:
Though sometimes he can
be a little cool...
translations.彼のそういうところ、好きになったのかな……ふふっ。:
Maybe that's the part of him
I fell for... Hehe.
translations.彼のそういうところが、わたしは、好きなんだなって、思ってます。:
I think that's the part of
him that I really love.
translations.彼から、優しい人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
a really sweet person, but...
translations.彼からはクールな人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
the cool type, but...
translations.彼からは大人しい人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
on the quiet side, but...
translations.彼からは賑やかな人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
really lively, but...
translations.彼からはマジメな人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
pretty serious, but...
translations.彼からは面白い人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
really funny, but...
translations.でも、会ってみたら違って……。:
Now that I meet you,
you're not quite like that...
translations.聞いてたとおりでした。:
You're just like he said
you were.
translations.やさしいよね？ すごく。:
You really are sweet,
aren't you？
translations.やさしいんですね。ふふっ。:
You really are so sweet.
Hehe.
translations.実は、クールだよね？:
You're actually pretty
cool, aren't you？
translations.クールなんですね？ 本当は。:
You're actually quite cool,
aren't you？ Deep down.
translations.落ち着いた方ですよね、本当は。:
You're actually very
composed, aren't you？
translations.賑やかな人だなって。:
You're definitely a lively
person, aren't you.
translations.楽しい方なんだなって。:
You're such a fun person
to be around.
translations.真面目な人だよね、うん。:
You're pretty serious,
aren't you？ Yep.
translations.今日は、本当に会えて楽しかった。:
It was so much fun
meeting you today.
translations.今日は、会えて嬉しかったです。:
I'm so glad I got to
meet you today.
translations.あの、もしかして、彼の弟くん？:
Um, are you his
little brother, by chance？
translations.あの、もしかして、彼の妹さん？:
Um, are you his
little sister, by chance？
translations.あれ、じゃあ、お兄さん？:
Wait, are you his
older brother, then？
translations.あれ、じゃあ、お姉さん？:
Wait, are you his
older sister, then？
translations.その……少し顔が怖くて……。:
Um... your expression was
a little scary...
translations.やさしいんだね……そう思った。:
You're really sweet...
That's what I thought.
translations.クールな人なんだね、言われない？:
You're pretty cool,
aren't you？ Don't
people tell you that？
translations.落ち着いてるね。物静か、っていうか。:
You're so calm.
Quiet, in a way.
translations.正直すぎるっていうか……ほら、視線が。:
A little too honest,
maybe... Look where
your eyes are.
translations.……なんだかエッチな視線を感じたんだけど？:
...Felt like you were
giving me a naughty look,
though？
translations.なんだかじろじろ見てくるような、気のせいかな。:
Felt like you were staring
at me... Or is that just
my imagination？
translations.女の子のことじろじろ見るのは失礼だよ？:
It's rude to stare at a girl
like that, you know？
translations.じーっと見つめてくるんだね。なにか気になるんだ。:
You really stare right at me,
don't you. Is something
on your mind？
translations.スキンシップが好きなのかな。:
Guess you like being
touchy-feely, huh.
translations.少し行き過ぎてるかな。その、スキンシップが。:
Maybe a little too much,
though. You know,
all the touching.
translations.女の子はもっと大切に扱った方がいいと思うな。触りすぎ。:
You should treat girls
with more care.
Too much touching.
translations.会話のタイミングがマイペースなんだね。:
You really take conversations
at your own pace.
translations.すごくマイペースだね。会話のタイミング、自由過ぎるよ。:
You're so on your own time.
The way you time
conversations is too wild.
translations.緊張しやすいのかな？ もう少し話したかったね。:
Do you get nervous easily？
I wanted to talk a bit more.
translations.緊張しちゃうタイプだね。あまり話せなかったな。:
You're the type to get
nervous, huh. We didn't
really get to talk much.
translations.やさしい方なんですね……。:
You're a very kind person,
aren't you...
translations.きっと、クールな方なんですね。:
You must be a pretty cool
person, aren't you.
translations.穏やかな方なんですね。そう感じました。:
You're such a gentle person.
That's how it felt.
translations.なんだか、賑やかな方なんですね。:
You seem like a really
lively person.
translations.真面目な方なんですね。:
You're a very serious
person, aren't you.
translations.視線が……気のせいかもしれないですけど。:
Your eyes were... Well,
maybe it was just
my imagination.
translations.視線が少し気になって……ごめんなさい。:
Your stare made me a little
nervous... Sorry about that.
translations.あの、見られてる気がして……。:
Um, I felt like you were
staring at me...
translations.見てましたよね。緊張しちゃいました。:
You were staring, right？
It made me kind of nervous.
translations.見つめられて……緊張しました。はい。:
Being stared at like that...
It made me nervous. Yes.
translations.あの、スキンシップが……。なんでもないです。:
Um, all the touching was...
Never mind, it's nothing.
translations.あの、スキンシップがお好き、っていうことなんですか。:
Um... does that mean you
really like physical touch？
translations.はっきり言って、あの、触りすぎだと思います。:
To be frank, um... I think
you touched me way too much.
translations.会話のタイミングがマイペースなんですね。:
Your conversation timing is
really at your own pace.
translations.すごくマイペースですよね。あ、会話のタイミングのことなんですけど。:
You really go at your own
pace, don't you？ Ah, I mean
with conversation timing.
translations.緊張してました？ もう少しお話したかったです。:
Were you nervous？
I was hoping we could
talk a little more.
translations.緊張してたように見えました。あまりお話できなかったですね。:
You seemed pretty nervous.
We didn't really get to
talk much, did we？
translations.あなたって、似てるよね。:
You know, you look a lot like
someone.
translations.あの、似てますよね。:
Um, you really look like
someone.
translations.今男性に人気の……。:
That person who's popular
with guys right now...
translations.今女性に人気の……。:
That person who's popular
with girls right now...
translations.テレビでよく見る……。:
That person who's on TV
all the time...
translations.この間、街で見かけた……。:
That person I saw in town
the other day...
translations.みんなの憧れの……。:
That person everyone looks
up to...
translations.ふふ、そっくりなんだもん。:
Hehe, you really are the
spitting image.
translations.はい、そっくりだと思います。。:
Yes, I really think you're
the spitting image.
translations.あれ？ そっくりだと思うんだけどな。:
Huh？ But I really thought
you were the spitting image.
translations.そうですか？ 似てると思ったんですけど……。:
Is that so？
I thought you two
seemed alike, though...
translations.そう？ 似てると思ったんだけどな……。:
Really？
I thought you two
seemed so alike, though...
translations.あ、ごめんなさい。似てるかなって思ったんですけど。:
Ah, sorry about that.
I just thought you two
seemed kind of alike.
translations.これからもよろしくね。:
Take good care of me
from now on too, okay？
translations.うーん……そうでもない、かな。:
Hmm... maybe not
so much, I guess.
translations.アミューズメントスポットって楽しそう！ 連れて来てくれてありがとう。:
An amusement center
sounds like so much fun!
Thanks for bringing me.
translations.どういたしまして。●もわくわくしてきた！:
You're welcome.
I'm getting excited too,
●!
translations.また二人で遊べるね。私も来たかったんだ。:
We get to hang out
together again.
I really wanted to come!
translations.●も。さて、どれから始めるかな……。:
Me too, ●.
Now then, what should
we start with...？
translations.今日はゲーム？ メダル？ 私はどっちでもオッケーだよ。:
Are we doing video games
or medal games today？
I'm good with either!
translations.ふふ、また？ 飽きないもんね。:
Hehe, this again？
You never get tired of
it, do you.
translations.だな。めいっぱい楽しもう！:
Yeah. Let's make the
most of it!
translations.もう、またなんだ。いいよ、とことん付き合っちゃうから。:
Jeez, this again？
Alright, I'll stick with you
to the very end.
translations.ノット３０って面白かった♪ またやりたいな。:
Not 30 was really fun♪
I'd love to play again.
translations.ああ、いつでも付き合うよ。:
Sure, I'll play with you
anytime.
translations.ノット３０、クラスでやってた子がいたな。負けなしなんだって。:
Someone in my class used
to play Not 30.
They said they never lost.
translations.へえ、ってことは、何かコツがあるのか。:
Huh, so there must be
some trick to it.
translations.だるまさんが転んだって、早口だとちょっと言いにくいよね。:
Daruma-san ga koronda
is kind of a tongue-twister
if you say it fast, huh？
translations.そのもどかしさが面白いのかもな。:
Maybe that frustration
is what makes it fun.
translations.だーるまさん♪ だーるまさん♪ ……これはにらめっこだっけ。:
Daaaruma-san♪
Daaaruma-san♪
...Wait, was that for
the staring contest？
translations.この手の遊びにけっこう出てくるのかもな、だるまさん。:
Daruma-san shows up a lot
in these kinds of games,
doesn't he.
translations.スイカ割りって楽しいよね。食べにくいかたちになっちゃうのが、ちょっと残念だけど。:
Watermelon splitting is
so fun. It's just a shame
it ends up hard to eat.
translations.剣豪みたいに、真っ二つってわけにはいかないもんな。:
Yeah, not like we can
slice it cleanly in two
like a master swordsman.
translations.スイカ割り。間違えて砂浜に寝そべってる人を叩いちゃいそうで……ちょっと怖いところ:
Watermelon splitting...
I'm always scared I'll hit
someone on the sand by
mistake. It's a bit scary.
translations.叩かれたらびっくりするな……。:
I'd definitely freak out
if someone whacked me...
translations.マシュマロキャッチ、二人の相性がわかって面白いね。息合わせないとうまくいかないも:
Marshmallow toss really
tests your compatibility.
You have to be in sync
or it won't work.
translations.マシュマロ美味しいけど……食べ過ぎないようにしなきゃ。:
Marshmallows are yummy,
but... I've gotta make sure
not to eat too many.
translations.（やっぱりそこは気にするんだ……）:
(So she does worry
about that after all...)
translations.集中しすぎて寄り目になってたかも。ダーツって楽しいね♪:
I focused so hard I might
have gone cross-eyed.
Darts is so much fun♪
translations.まっすぐ飛ばすだけでもけっこう難しいもんだな。:
Just throwing it straight
is surprisingly tough.
translations.ダーツセット、部屋にあっても面白そう……。:
A dartboard in my room
sounds pretty fun...
translations.んー、ハマっちゃうかもな。:
Hmm, you might end up
getting hooked.
translations.スピード勝負は得意じゃないけど……それでも嫌いじゃないな♪:
I'm not great at Speed,
but... I still really like it♪
translations.楽しんでたもんな、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
You definitely looked like
you were having fun, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.実はスピードでむきになって、つき指したことあるの。あなたも気をつけてね？:
Truth is, I once got so
into Speed I jammed my
finger. You be careful,
too, okay？
translations.意外とスポーツみたいだもんな、このゲーム……。:
This game's surprisingly
like a sport, huh...
translations.シャボン玉、楽しい。子供になったみたい♪:
Bubbles are so fun.
I feel like a kid again♪
translations.（無邪気な▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も可愛いよな……）:
(Seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ act so
innocent is cute, too...)
translations.シャボン玉といえば、シャボンのお風呂って難しいんだよ？ なかなかキレイにあわ立た:
Speaking of soap bubbles,
bubble baths are actually
pretty tricky, you know？
They don't lather up easily.
translations.へえ、シャボンの風呂か……。:
Huh, a bubble bath,
is it...
translations.ふふ、楽しかった♪ ケンカしたときは、これで決着をつけるのもいいかもね。:
Fufu, that was fun♪
If we ever fight, maybe
we should settle things
with this.
translations.痛いのが飛んできそうだな……。:
Sounds like I'd take
a painful hit or two...
translations.このゲーム男女でやるのはフェアじゃないかもね、男の子は女の子のこと叩きにくいでし:
This game might not be fair 
to play guy versus girl.
It's hard for a boy 
to hit a girl, after all？
translations.これって、仲良しの人とやると、もっと楽しくなるゲームだね♪:
This game is so much more fun 
when you play with someone 
you're really close to♪
translations.はは、意外な駆け引きされたりしてな。:
Haha, like pulling unexpected 
mind games on each other.
translations.このゲーム、裏をかけば力がなくても勝てるよね……ふふふ。:
With this game, you can win 
without much strength if you 
outsmart them... Hehehe.
translations.面白いね、これ！ 私、やっつけるの得意かも？:
This is fun! I might actually be 
pretty good at beating them？
translations.ねえ、ほんとに宇宙人が侵略してきたら、私のこと守ってくれる？:
Hey, if aliens really did invade, 
would you protect me？
translations.もちろん、指一本触れさせないって！:
Of course! I won't let them 
lay a single finger on you!
translations.パネルの選び方に悩むね。計算しきれないかも……。:
It's hard deciding which panel 
to pick. I can't quite calculate 
it all...
translations.直感で選んじゃうのもアリじゃない？: Why not just follow your gut？
translations.目の前のメダルにつられてると、次選べなくなっちゃうね。:
If you get lured by the medals 
right in front of you, 
you're stuck on the next pick.
translations.少しは先読みもしとかないとな……。:
Yeah, gotta plan ahead 
at least a little bit...
translations.かわいいキャラがトコトコ歩いててかわい～ね。:
Watching the cute characters 
toddle along is so adorable～
translations.ほんと、動き見てるだけでも楽しいな。:
Totally. Just watching them move 
is fun on its own.
translations.ジャックポットならず、か。惜しかったね。:
No jackpot, huh？ 
That was so close.
translations.いい感じだったね♪ ジャックポットも取れたし。:
That went great♪ 
We even got the jackpot!
translations.ああ、思わず声出そうになったよ。: Yeah, I almost shouted out loud.
translations.グランドクロスっていろんな世界が出てくるから、見てるだけで満足しちゃう。:
Grand Cross shows so many 
different worlds, I'm satisfied 
just watching it.
