translations.お休みの朝って、目が覚めてもお布団から出るのがもったいない気がして、なかなか出ら: On mornings off, even after waking up, it feels like such a waste to get out of bed, so you just can't bring yourself to move, can you？
translations.今朝、タイマーをかけ忘れたと思って飛び起きちゃった。ふふ、お休みなのにね。: This morning, I jumped out of bed thinking I forgot to set my alarm. Fufu, even though it's my day off.
translations.朝ね、テレビの血液型占いでＯ型が一番だったの。今日はいいことが３つあるんですって: This morning, Type O was number one on the TV blood type horoscope. It said three good things would happen today.
translations.朝からしっかり食べちゃった。でもそうすると、一日中元気でいられるの。あなたもちゃ: I ate a really big breakfast this morning. But doing that keeps me energized all day. Are you eating properly, too？
translations.午前中の体育って、身体が目覚めてないからきついのよね。午後は午後で疲れちゃうんだ: Morning gym class is rough since your body isn't awake yet, you know？ Though the afternoon has its own kind of fatigue...
translations.授業中にお腹が鳴っちゃったこと、ない？ 今日ね、咳するフリして誤魔化しちゃった。: Has your stomach ever growled during class？ Today, I pretended to cough to cover it up. That's our little secret, okay？
translations.今朝は早く目が覚めちゃったんだけど、朝焼けが見られたの。空が金色で、ホントきれい: I woke up early this morning, but I got to see the sunrise. The sky was golden, it was so pretty...
translations.朝の納豆ご飯、好きなんだけど……あなたとのこと考えると、ちょっと……ね。: I love having natto on rice in the morning, but... thinking about being around you, it's a little... you know.
translations.お昼の紅茶は濃い目のダージリンが多いかな。紅茶にはちょっとうるさいんだから。: For lunchtime tea, I usually go with a strong Darjeeling. I'm pretty particular about my black tea, you know.
translations.今日は徹底的にお掃除するんだ。スチームモップ、欲しいな……。: I'm going to clean from top to bottom today. I really want a steam mop...
translations.古い雑誌を捨てようと思ったのに、つい読み始めちゃって……。結局そのままなの。: I meant to throw away some old magazines, but I ended up flipping through them... In the end, they're still right where they were.
translations.お母さんとショッピングモールに\n行ってきたの。洋服買って\nもらっちゃった♪:
I went to the mall with
my mom earlier. She even
bought me some clothes♪
translations.友達にあなたを紹介しろって言われるんだけど……。こういうのってタイミングが難しい: My friends keep asking me to introduce you to them, but... the timing for that kind of thing is tricky, isn't it？
translations.よく気がつくって先生に褒められちゃった。先生って見てないようで、ちゃーんと見てる: The teacher praised me today for being so attentive. It feels like they're never watching, but they really notice everything.
translations.授業中にメールしてた友達が、携帯を取り上げられちゃったの。すぐに返してもらってた: A friend of mine who was texting during class got her phone taken away. She got it back right away, but you be careful too, okay？
translations.友達が教科書の写真にラクガキしてて、それがすっごく面白くて……。授業中に思い出し: A friend was doodling in their textbook, and it was so funny... I started laughing in class just thinking back on it.
translations.最近携帯の充電の減りが早いのよね……。ねえ、次に携帯を替える時は、おそろいにしな: Lately my phone battery has been draining so fast... Hey, next time we get new phones, want to get matching ones？
translations.校舎の１階の空き教室、お昼休みは自由に使っていいんですって。知ってた？: I heard the empty classroom on the first floor is free for anyone to use during lunch. Did you know that？
translations.夕焼けを見るとホッとしない？ 時々、紅茶をいれて好きな音楽をかけて、夕焼けをボー: Doesn't looking at the sunset just soothe you？ Sometimes, I love brewing some tea, putting on some music, and just zoning out to the sunset.
translations.この時間に眠くなることがあるんだけど、寝ちゃうと夜に眠れなくなるのよね。だからガ: I sometimes get sleepy around this time, but if I nap now, I won't be able to sleep tonight. So I have to resist, resist...
translations.ファッション誌、２冊買っちゃった▼ これからじっくり研究するんだ。: I went and bought two fashion magazines▼ Now I'm gonna study them from cover to cover.
translations.海外のお土産に、のど飴もらっちゃった。海外には珍しいのど飴がいっぱいあるんだよ？: Someone gave me cough drops as a souvenir from abroad. You know, they have so many unique throat drops overseas？
translations.お得情報。放課後購買に行くと、パンの売れ残りを半額で売ってることがあるんだって。: Here's a hot tip. If you head to the school store after class, they sometimes sell leftover pastries for half price. Did you know that？
translations.バイトのシフトを入れてないのに、間違えて行っちゃうことがあって。クセになってるの: Sometimes I accidentally show up to work even when I'm not scheduled. It must be out of habit...
translations.バイトがない日は、５時頃スーパーに買い物に行くの。もちろんタイムセール狙い。いい: On days I don't work, I go grocery shopping around 5. Going after the discount hour, of course. Don't you think I'd make a good wife？
translations.学校から帰ったら、予習復習しなくちゃって思うんだけど……ね。宿題はちゃんとやって: When I get home from school, I always think I should review and prep, but... well. I do do my homework, though, you know？
translations.今ね、野菜スープに凝ってるんだ。その時残ってるお野菜をいろいろ入れるから、いつも: Right now, I'm really into making vegetable soup. I just throw in whatever leftover veggies I have, so it tastes different every time.
translations.レンタル屋さんに寄ったら、ホラーのタイトルがすごく増えてたんだよ。しょっちゅう私: When I stopped by the rental shop, they had way more horror titles in stock. I wonder if it's because I rent them so often？
translations.休日の夜はいつもより少し夕飯を早めにして、その分バスタイムを長くするの。雑誌を読: On weekend nights, I eat dinner a little earlier than usual so I can take a longer bath. Like having a nice soak while reading a magazine.
translations.お休みの日は、お手入れに時間をかけるんだ。コットンパックしたり、爪を整えたり……: On my days off, I like to take my time with self-care. Putting on a face pack, shaping my nails...
translations.友達と電話してたら、しゃべってる途中で向こうが寝ちゃったの。ふふ、疲れてたみたい: I was talking on the phone with a friend, and she fell asleep right in the middle of our conversation. Fufu, she must have been tired.
translations.お料理番組で生キャラメルの作り方を覚えちゃった。ねぇ、のど飴も手作りできるのかな: I learned how to make fresh caramel from a cooking show. Hey, do you think you can make cough drops from scratch, too？
translations.宿題はなるべく夕飯の前に終わらせた方がいいのかな。ご飯の後って眠くなっちゃうでし: Maybe it's better to finish homework before dinner. You always get sleepy after eating, don't you？
translations.ご飯を食べようと思ったら、炊飯器のスイッチを入れ忘れてたことに気付いて……。: I sat down ready to eat, only to realize I'd forgotten to turn on the rice cooker...
translations.ドラマはなるべく録画じゃなくて、その時間に見るようにしてるの。次の日に友達が内容:
I try to watch TV dramas live
instead of recording them.
Otherwise, my friends spoil
everything the next day!
translations.テレビショッピングって、見てると絶対欲しくなっちゃうの。困るなあ。:
Whenever I watch shopping
channels, I always want what's
on. It's a real problem...
translations.ハンドクリームは、香りがあるのとないのと２種類持ってるんだ。今使ってるのはラベン:
I keep two kinds of hand
cream: scented and unscented.
Right now, I'm using one with
a lavender scent.
translations.宿題が多い日に限って、テレビで面白そうな映画やってたりするのよね。結局いつも誘惑:
It's always when I have tons
of homework that a good movie
comes on TV. In the end, I
always give in to temptation...
translations.眠れない時たまに深夜映画を観るんだけど、たいていいつの間にか寝ちゃってるの。それ:
When I can't sleep, I put on
a late-night movie, but I
almost always drift off.
...And somehow I manage to
turn the TV off, too.
translations.休日にＤＶＤを何本も借りて、一日中見てることがあるの。朝から夜までずーっと。私の:
Sometimes on days off, I'll
rent a bunch of DVDs and
watch them all day long. From
morning till night. It's my
own little luxury♪
translations.夜更かしはお肌に悪いってわかってるのに、たまにしちゃうのよね。気をつけなくちゃ。:
I know staying up late is bad
for my skin, but I still do it
sometimes. I've really got to
be careful.
translations.コンポの調子が悪くて直そうと思ったんだけど、どうすればいいかわからなくて……。下:
My stereo's acting up, so I
wanted to fix it, but I had no
clue what to do... If I mess
with it, I'll just break it,
right？
translations.夜中にふっと目がさめること、ある？ 友達はよくあるって言うけど、私はあんまりない:
Do you ever suddenly wake up
in the night？ My friends say
they do, but rarely me. Guess
I'm just a heavy sleeper.
translations.寝てる間にメールがくると、無意識に返事してることがあるの。朝に携帯を見て、びっく:
If I get a text while asleep,
sometimes I reply without even
realizing it. Then I check my
phone in the morning and get
quite a surprise.
translations.いい夢見ちゃった。あなたと私が一緒に……ううん、やっぱりなんでもない。:
I had such a nice dream.
You and I were together, and...
Mm, never mind, it's nothing.
translations.深夜に赤ちゃんの泣き声が聞こえると思ったら、ネコだったみたい。ドキッとしちゃった:
I thought I heard a baby crying
in the dead of night, but it
was just a cat. It really
spooked me.
translations.時々、明日は晴れますようにっ、ててるてる坊主を作るんだけど、朝になると頭が下を向:
Sometimes I make a teru teru
bozu to pray for sunny skies,
but by morning its head is
drooping down. Maybe its
head's just too big...？
translations.夜はなるべく早く寝るようにしてるんだけど、つい本を読みふけっちゃった。恋愛小説は:
I try to go to bed early, but
I got totally lost in a book.
With romance novels, you just
have to know how it ends, you
know？
translations.学校の勉強ってどう思う？ やっぱり嫌いだったりするのかな。:
How do you feel about school-
work？ Do you hate it like
everyone else？
translations.運動にもいろいろあるけど、体動かすのって好きなほう？:
There are all kinds of sports,
but do you like moving around
and being active？
translations.芸術……そうね、作品を見るだけじゃなくて、作るほうにも興味あるのかな。:
When it comes to art... Are
you interested in making it, or
do you just like looking at it？
translations.あなたってファッションにはこだわるほう？:
Are you the type who's
particular about fashion？
translations.あなたって実はお掃除好きだったりするのかな？:
Do you secretly like cleaning,
by any chance？
translations.お料理だけど、食べるだけじゃなくて、作るほうにも興味ある？:
When it comes to cooking, are
you interested in making food,
or just eating it？
translations.ねぇ、洗濯はいつも自分でしてるの？:
Hey, do you always do your
own laundry？
translations.聞いてみたかったんだけど、あなたってどちらかというとアウトドア派？:
I've been wondering, are you
more of an outdoors person？
translations.最近はインドア派が増えたって言うけど、あなたもそう？:
They say more people are home-
bodies these days. Are you an
indoor person too？
translations.市内にもいくつか公園があるでしょ？ ああいう場所で一日中のんびりするのもいいよね:
There are several parks around
town, right？ Spending the whole
day relaxing somewhere like
that sounds so nice.
translations.古い建物っていいよね。あなたはどう思う？:
Old buildings have such charm,
don't they？ What do you think？
translations.映画は好き？ 古いのでも、新しいのでもいいの。:
Do you like movies？ Old or
new, either is fine.
translations.好きなスポーツってあるのかな。見るんじゃなくて、するほう。:
Do you have a favorite sport？
To play, I mean, not just watch.
translations.ねぇ、食べるのは好き？ 実はすっごくグルメだったりして。:
Hey, do you love to eat？
Maybe you're secretly a huge
foodie.
translations.ショッピングは好きなほう？ 洋服とか靴とか、自分のためのよ？:
Do you like shopping？ For
yourself, I mean, like clothes
or shoes？
translations.写真を撮るなら、風景なんかより女の子がいい、なんて思ってない？:
You don't think girls are way
better to photograph than
landscapes, do you？
translations.教会って神聖な気持ちになるよね。心が落ち着くっていうか……。:
Churches give you this sacred
feeling, don't they？ Like
they just put your heart at
ease...
translations.ライブ鑑賞はよくするほうなのかな。:
Do you go see live music
very often？
translations.大声で歌うのって気持ちいいよね。あなたは好き？:
Singing at the top of your
lungs feels so good. Do you
like doing that？
translations.最近、電車でゲームしてる人を良く見るね。あなたもゲームが好きなのかな。:
I've been seeing a lot of people
playing games on the train. Are
you into gaming too？
translations.あなたは音楽を聴くのって、好き？: Do you like listening to music？
translations.この前、アニメでちょっと感動しちゃった。あなたもそういうこと、あるのかな。:
The other day, an anime made me
tear up a little. Does that ever
happen to you？
translations.遊園地に行くと子供みたいにはしゃいじゃう。あなたもそうなのかな。:
I turn into such a kid at
amusement parks. Are you like
that too？
translations.私はね、水泳はあんまりなんだけど……。あなたは得意なのかな？:
I'm not much of a swimmer
myself... Are you good at it？
translations.星ってロマンティックよね。星空だけじゃなくて、星座のお話なんかも……。:
The stars are so romantic.
Not just the night sky, but the
stories behind constellations,
too...
translations.植物は好き？ もしかして、育ててたりするのかな。:
Do you like plants？ Are you
growing any, by chance？
translations.イベントはよく見るほう？ 舞台とかコンサートとか……。:
Do you go to live events often？
Like plays or concerts...？
translations.あなたはお買い物するのって、好きなのかな？:
Do you enjoy going shopping,
I wonder？
translations.海って行くたびに違う表情を見せてくれるから、面白いね。あなたは好き？:
The sea shows a different face
every time you go, so it's neat.
Do you like the ocean？
translations.ねぇ、男の子はみんな、女の子の水着姿が好きなんでしょ？:
Hey, all boys love seeing girls
in swimsuits, don't they？
translations.水族館っていいよね。ロマンティックムードいっぱいなんだもん。:
Aquariums are nice, aren't they？
They're just so full of romance.
translations.あなたは山って好き？ 登ってもいいし、見るだけでもいいし。:
Do you like mountains？
Climbing them is great, but just
looking at them is nice too.
translations.動物ってカワイイよね。ちっちゃなネズミも、おっきなゾウもみんな。:
Animals are so cute, aren't they？
From tiny mice to huge elephants,
all of them.
translations.小さな頃は、よく自然の中で遊んだな。あなたもそうだった？:
When I was little, I used to play
outside in nature a lot.
Were you like that too？
translations.ねぇ、あなたはお風呂好きさんなのかな？:
Hey, are you a bath lover,
I wonder？
translations.見たい映画があるんだ。今度一緒に行かない？:
There's a movie I want to see.
Want to go together sometime？
translations.自転車の二人乗りってちょっと憧れるのよね。あなたもそう？:
Riding two on a bike is kind of
a dream of mine. You too？
translations.私はコーヒーよりは紅茶が好きかな。あなたはコーヒー派だったかな？:
I prefer tea over coffee, myself.
Are you a coffee person？
translations.そのうち宇宙旅行ができるかもしれないんだって。ねぇ、行ってみたいと思わない？:
They say space travel might be
possible before long.
Don't you want to go？
translations.あなたは夜は早いほう？ 夜中にメールしても大丈夫かな。:
Do you turn in early at night？
Is it okay to text you late？
translations.肩がこるのって運動不足なのかな……。あなたは大丈夫？:
My shoulders are stiff...
Maybe I need more exercise.
Are you doing okay？
translations.目の下のほくろ、小さな頃からあるみたいなの。これ、このままでいいと思う？:
This mole under my eye,
I've had it since I was little.
Do you think I should keep it？
translations.ねぇ、私に着てもらいたい服ってある？:
Hey, is there anything you'd like
to see me wear？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。この呼び方、好きなんだ？:
▲主人公＊▲.
You like me calling you that, huh？
translations.時々ね、あなたのことを考えてたらドキドキして眠れなくなっちゃうことがるの。あなた:
Sometimes, thinking about you
makes my heart race so much
that I just can't fall asleep.
Does that ever happen to you？
translations.ねぇ、一人でいると急に寂しくなったりしない？ 夜中とか……。:
Hey, do you ever get lonely all of
a sudden when you're alone？
Like late at night...？
translations.女の子にはね、いろんな秘密があるの。ふふ、知りたい？:
Girls have all kinds of secrets,
you know. Hehe, want to know？
translations.ねぇ、私たちってイチャイチャしすぎかな？:
Hey... do you think we're being
a little too lovey-dovey？
translations.あのね、深い意味はないんだけど……。あなたは自分の指輪のサイズ、知ってる？:
Um, there's no hidden meaning or
anything, but...
Do you know your ring size？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。将来のこと考えたことある？ あなたと私の……。:
▲主人公＊▲.
Have you ever thought about
the future？ About you and me...
translations.んー、なんとなく聞いてみただけ。どうなのかなって。:
Mm, I just felt like asking.
Just wondered, is all.
translations.深い意味はないのよ？ でも、あなたのことならどんな小さなことでも知りたいの。:
There's no hidden meaning, okay？
I just want to know everything about
you, even the little things.
translations.またひとつあなたを知っちゃった。覚えておくね？:
Now I know one more thing about you.
I'll remember it, okay？
translations.ちょっとね、聞いてみたかったの。答えてくれてありがとう。:
I just wanted to ask, is all.
Thanks for answering.
translations.別に何もないんだけどね？ なんだか急に気になっちゃって。:
It's nothing special, really.
It just suddenly crossed my mind.
translations.ふふ、あなたのことを知れば知るほど、知りたいことが増えちゃうみたい。:
Hehe, the more I learn about you,
the more I want to know.
translations.うん、聞いて良かった。またあなたに近付けた気がする。:
Yeah, I'm glad I asked.
I feel like I got a little closer to you.
translations.そういえば、前にも聞いたかもしれないね。ふふ。:
Come to think of it, I might have
asked that before. Hehe.
translations.何度も同じこと聞いてごめんなさい。でも、もしかしたら考えが変わってるかもしれない:
Sorry for asking the same 
thing over and over. 
Maybe you've changed 
your mind, though？
translations.前にも同じことを聞いたかな？: Did I ask you this before？
translations.ねぇ、男の子って……ううん、その、あなたは大きさとか気にするほう？:
Hey, do guys... No, I mean, 
are you the type to care 
about size？
translations.そうだよね、男の子だもんね。んー、それはそれで……。:
Thought so, you're a guy, 
after all. 
Hmm, well that's...
translations.それっていいことなのかな、どうなんだろ……。:
I wonder if that's a good 
thing or not...
translations.普通ってことは、気にしなくていいのかな……。:
So average means... 
I don't have to worry about 
it, maybe？
translations.そうなんだ。ちょっと予想外だったかも……。:
Oh, really. That was a little 
unexpected...
translations.あのね、ハッキリ答えてもらいたいんだけど、私ってダイエットしたほうがいいと思う？:
Um, be honest with me... 
Do you think I should go 
on a diet？
translations.うぅ、やっぱりそうなんだ……。ありがとう、ちょっと考えてみるね？:
Ugh, I knew it... 
Thanks, I'll think about it, 
okay？
translations.ホント？ ホントにそう思う？ それならいいの。ふふ。:
Really？ You really think so？ 
Then I'm glad. Hehe.
translations.最近、すごくお腹がすくからつい食べちゃうの。私、このままで大丈夫だと思う？:
Lately I get so hungry, 
I just keep eating. 
Do you think I'm okay 
like this？
translations.ホント？ でも、ちょっとだけ増えて……。ねぇ、気になったらハッキリ言っていいんだ:
Really？ But I gained just a 
little... Hey, if it bothers 
you, you can tell me, okay？
translations.そっか、それならいいの。あなたっていっぱい食べる女の子が好きなのかな？:
I see, then that's fine. 
Do you like girls who eat 
a lot, maybe？
translations.やっぱり……。わかった、少し気をつけてみるね？ ありがとう、ハッキリ言ってくれて:
I knew it... Okay, I'll try to 
be careful, alright？ 
Thanks for being honest.
translations.そっか。体重は変わってないから、いいと思ってたんだけど……。あなたが気になるなら:
I see. My weight hasn't 
changed, so I thought it was 
fine, but... If it bothers 
you, maybe I'll reconsider.
translations.ねぇ、どんな料理が好き？:
Hey, what kind of food 
do you like？
translations.ジャンルわけできないような料理って、どうかな。:
How about food that doesn't 
fit into one category？
translations.ホント？ じゃあ、ほっぺた落ちそうなくらい美味しいの作ってあげちゃう▼:
Really？ Then I'll make you 
something so delicious, 
your cheeks'll melt right off▼
translations.そっか、それは練習しないと難しいな……。いつか美味しいの作ってあげるから、待って:
I see, that'll take some 
practice... I'll make you 
something delicious someday, 
so just wait for me, okay？
translations.そうなんだ……。それならすぐに美味しいのを食べさせてあげられたのになぁ。:
Is that so... And here I 
could've made you something 
delicious right away.
translations.少しホッとしちゃった。実はそれ、苦手なの。:
I'm a little relieved. 
To be honest, I'm not very 
good at that.
translations.あなたの好きなものくらいは、得意料理ですって胸を張れるようにならなくちゃね。:
At the very least, I should 
be able to proudly call your 
favorite food my specialty.
translations.何でもリクエストしてね？ まだ全部には応えられないけど、そのうちきっと……。:
Request anything you want, 
okay？ I might not be able to 
make it all yet, but someday...
translations.そのうち、苦手なものでも美味しいって言わせてみせるんだから。:
One of these days, I'll get 
you to say even the foods you 
dislike are delicious!
translations.この前、新しいレシピを手に入れたの。今度あなたで試しちゃおうかな？:
I got a new recipe recently. 
Maybe I'll test it out 
on you next time？
translations.新しいレシピを見つけちゃった。作ってあげるの、楽しみだな。:
I found a new recipe. 
I can't wait to make it 
for you.
translations.今は洋食に凝ってるの。ハンバーグソースなんかもちゃんと作るんだよ？:
Right now I'm really into 
Western cooking. I even make 
the hamburger steak sauce 
from scratch, you know？
translations.最近、中華に目覚めたの。本場の調味料を使ったりして、本格的なんだから。:
Lately I've gotten into 
Chinese food. I use authentic 
seasonings and everything, 
so it's the real deal.
translations.やっぱり定番は和食よね。お味噌汁も出汁からとるんだよ？:
Japanese food is the classic, 
after all. I even make the 
dashi for miso soup from 
scratch, you know？
translations.ジャンルにこだわらずに、研究するのも楽しいのよね。:
It's fun experimenting 
without sticking to any 
one genre, too.
translations.今はお菓子作りがマイブームなの。ラッピングにも凝ってるんだ。:
Making sweets is my big thing 
right now. I'm even getting 
fancy with the wrapping.
translations.今度のデート、どうしようか。実はもう決めてたりする？:
What should we do on our next 
date？ Have you actually 
already decided？
translations.ホント？ 嬉しいな。誘われる準備は万端だよ？:
Really？ That makes me happy. 
I'm totally ready for your 
invite, you know？
translations.じゃあ一緒に決めようか。私の行きたいところは、あなたの行きたいところだよ。:
Then let's decide together. 
Where I want to go is 
wherever you want to go.
translations.まだ行ったことのないところ、あったかな。:
I wonder if there are places 
we haven't been to yet.
translations.落ち着いた場所でいちゃいちゃするのもいいね、ふふ▼:
Snuggling somewhere quiet 
sounds nice too, hehe.▼
translations.流行スポットに行くのもいいね。混んでるかもしれないけど。:
Going somewhere trendy 
sounds fun too. Even if it 
might be crowded, though.
translations.この前行ったところも良かったなぁ。:
The place we went the other 
day was really nice, too.
translations.やっぱり、二人っきりになれるところがいいかな？:
I guess somewhere we can 
be all alone together 
would be best？
translations.とわのウォッチャーの最新号、どんな特集だっけ。:
What was the feature in the 
latest Towano Watcher again？
translations.そうだ、今度はインドアデートなんてどう？ どこか屋内で楽しめるところ。:
Oh, how about an indoor date 
this time？ Somewhere fun 
where we can stay inside.
translations.次はアウトドアデートにする？ どこか外で楽しめるところ。:
Want an outdoor date next time？ 
Somewhere fun outside.
translations.今、いい映画かイベントやってるかな……。何か見に行くのはどう？:
I wonder if there are any 
good movies or events going 
on... How about seeing one？
translations.ありきたりだけど、ショッピングはどうかな。何か欲しいもの、ない？:
It might be kind of cliché, 
but how about shopping？ 
Is there anything you want？
translations.たまには思いきり体を動かしたいかな。あなたは？:
I'd kind of like to work up 
a sweat for once. 
How about you？
translations.今度のデートはのーんびりしたいかな。何をするでもなく、ね？:
For our next date, I'd love 
to just take it easy. 
Not doing much of anything, 
you know？
translations.そうね、今度のデートはいろいろ遊べるところがいいな。:
Let's see... for our next date, 
somewhere with lots of things 
to do sounds nice.
translations.じゃあ、そうしよっか。もちろん、気が変わったら違うところでもいいからね？:
Let's do that, then. 
Of course, if you change 
your mind, somewhere else 
is totally fine, okay？
translations.うん、あなたがそう言うなら。ホントはね、あなたとならどこでもいいの。:
Yeah, if you say so. 
Honestly, as long as I'm 
with you, anywhere is fine.
translations.あ、行きたいところがあるんだ。どこでも連れて行って？:
Oh, you have somewhere in mind？ 
Take me wherever you want, 
okay？
translations.うん、あなたの行きたいところでいいよ？ もっとワガママ言ってくれていいんだから。:
Yeah, wherever you want to go 
is fine by me. You can be 
more selfish with me, you know？
translations.どこでもいいよ？ あなたと一緒なら、どこでも。:
Anywhere is fine with me. 
As long as I'm with you, 
anywhere at all.
translations.そんなに深く考えなくていいのよ。デートは次の１回で終わりじゃないんだから。:
You don't have to overthink it. 
It's not like our next date 
is going to be our last.
translations.ねぇ、学校帰りにそのまま行くのもいいと思わない？:
Hey, don't you think going 
straight there after school 
would be fun？
translations.美味しいお店もチェックしておかなくちゃ。:
I'll have to check out some 
tasty places to eat, too.
translations.いろんなところに行こうね。行ったことのない場所がなくなっちゃうくらい。:
Let's go to all kinds of places. 
Until there's nowhere left 
we haven't been to.
translations.いつでも連絡ちょうだいね？ 待ってるから。:
Reach out anytime, okay？ 
I'll be waiting.
translations.どこに行こうか考える時間も楽しいね。:
Thinking about where to go 
is half the fun, isn't it？
translations.前みたいに、帰りが遅くなりすぎないようにしなくちゃね？ 高校生だもん、ね。:
We can't stay out too late 
like last time, okay？ 
We are high schoolers, 
after all.
translations.ねぇ、女の子からキスするのってどうかな。いいと思う？:
Hey, what do you think about 
the girl kissing first？ 
Do you like that？
translations.ホント？ じゃあ、どんどん……。覚悟してね？:
Really？ In that case, I might 
do it all the time... 
Brace yourself, okay？
translations.もっと積極的なほうがいいんだ。恥ずかしいけど、頑張っちゃおうかな……。:
So you like it when I take 
the initiative. It's a bit 
embarrassing, but maybe 
I'll give it my all...
translations.自分からしたいんだ。私はいつでも準備オーケーだからね？:
So you want to be the one 
to do it. Well, I'm ready 
whenever you are, okay？
translations.よかった。私からは勇気がいるっていうか、ちょっと恥ずかしいなって思ってたから……:
What a relief. It takes guts 
for me to do it, and I was 
a little shy about it...
translations.ねぇ、男の子ってキスされるより、するほうが好きなのかな？:
Hey, do boys prefer doing the 
kissing rather than being kissed？
translations.そうなんだ。私ね、強引なのも嫌いじゃないよ。:
Is that so？ You know, 
I don't mind you being a 
little forceful with me, either.
translations.私も、するよりされるほうがいいな。……遠慮しちゃダメだからね？:
I prefer being kissed to doing 
the kissing, too. 
...So don't hold back, okay？
translations.あ、されたいんだ。ふふ、私これからキス魔になっちゃおうかな。:
Oh, so you want me to kiss you. 
Hehe, maybe I'll turn into 
a kissing monster from now on.
translations.じゃあ、私から……。いざとなると、なんだか照れちゃいそう。:
Then I'll kiss you... 
Though when the moment comes, 
I feel like I'll get shy.
translations.あのね、変なこと聞くかもしれないけど……。私のどこに一番触れたいって思う？:
Um, this might be a strange 
question, but... where on me 
do you want to touch the most？
translations.あなたが頭を撫でてくれると、子供みたいな気分になって安心するんだ。年上なのにおか:
When you pat my head, I feel 
like a little kid and it relaxes 
me. Is that weird, since I'm 
older than you？
translations.すべすべして気持ちいいでしょ。頑張ってお手入れしてるんだから。:
It's nice and smooth, right？ 
I take really good care of it, 
you know.
translations.寄りかかるのも好きだけど、優しく触れられるのも気持ちいいから好き。:
I love leaning against you, 
but having you touch me gently 
feels so good too.
translations.手をつなぐと、指先や手のひらからあなたの感情が伝わってくる気がするの。:
When we hold hands, I feel 
like I can sense your feelings 
through your fingertips and palms.
translations.ぎゅってされると、あなたをすごく近くに感じるんだ。:
When you hold me tight, 
I feel so close to you.
translations.キスって、いつまで経っても慣れないね。するたびに、心臓が壊れそうなくらいドキドキ:
Kissing is something 
I just never get used to. 
Every time we do, 
my heart pounds so hard 
it feels like it might burst.
translations.ねぇ、食べさせ合いっこするのってどう思う？:
Hey, what do you think 
about feeding each other？
translations.いかにも恋人同士ですって感じよね。今度あーんってやってあげる▼:
It feels just like 
being a real couple. 
Next time, I'll feed you! 
'Say ahh!'▼
translations.じゃあ、今度お弁当食べさせてあげよっか。学校ではさすがに恥ずかしいかな。:
Then next time, maybe 
I'll feed you some lunch. 
Though doing that at school 
might be a little embarrassing.
translations.あなたにあーんってされたら、すっごく幸せかも。ふふ、想像しただけで幸せ▼:
If you fed me like that, 
I'd be so happy. 
Hehe, just imagining it 
makes me smile▼
translations.私はいいと思うんだけどな。ねぇ、騙されたと思って一度やってみない？:
I think it'd be sweet. 
Come on, humor me and 
try it just once？
translations.あ、バカップルっぽいって思ってるでしょ。やってみたら、案外好きかもしれないよ？:
Ah, you think we'd look 
like silly lovebirds, right？ 
Give it a shot, you might 
actually like it, you know？
translations.もしかして、人目を気にしちゃうのかな。二人だけの時にこっそりやってみない？:
Are you worried about 
people watching, maybe？ 
How about we try it in secret 
when it's just the two of us？
translations.ねぇ、最近ちゃんと眠れてる？:
Hey, have you been 
sleeping okay lately？
translations.最近、運動はしてるのかな。:
Have you been getting 
any exercise lately？
translations.朝、昼、夜、と３食きちんと食べてる？:
Are you eating three 
proper meals a day？ 
Breakfast, lunch, and dinner？
translations.３度のお食事以外は、控えなくちゃダメよ？ 間食しすぎてない？:
You shouldn't snack too much 
between meals, okay？ 
You're not overdoing it 
on junk food, are you？
translations.夜暖かくても、朝に冷えることが多いでしょ。ちゃんとあったかくして寝てる？:
Even if it's warm at night, 
mornings get chilly, right？ 
Are you bundling up 
when you go to sleep？
translations.寝冷えに気をつけてね？ クーラーのつけっぱなしは絶対ダメなんだから。わかった？:
Don't catch a chill while 
sleeping, okay？ Leaving the AC 
on all night is a big no-no. 
Understood？
translations.こら、誤魔化さない。心配だから、ちゃんと答えて？:
Hey, don't dodge the question. 
I'm worried about you, 
so give me a straight answer？
translations.もう、知らんぷりしちゃって。ちゃんとしてるならいいけど……。:
Sheesh, playing dumb now？ 
Well, as long as you're taking 
care of yourself, but...
translations.あなたがそんな風だと心配だな。ホント、健康には気をつけてね？:
It really worries me 
when you're like that. 
Seriously, please take good 
care of your health, okay？
translations.えらいえらい。私が思うよりずーっとしっかりしてるんだ。:
Good boy, good boy. 
You're way more responsible 
than I give you credit for.
translations.さすが。ちゃんとしてるね？:
That's my guy. 
You really have things 
together, don't you？
translations.少しは気をつけてるみたいね。でも、もっと気にしないとダメだぞ？:
Looks like you're trying 
a little. But you've gotta pay 
more attention than that, okay？
translations.もう、心配だなぁ。一度生活を見直しなさい？ わかった？:
Geez, you really worry me. 
Take a good look at your habits 
for once, okay？ Promise me？
translations.ねぇ、身体壊しちゃうよ。私にできることがあれば協力するから、もう少しちゃんとしよ:
Hey, you're gonna ruin 
your health. If there's 
anything I can do, I'll help, 
so let's get you back on track？
translations.ダメダメ。そんなの絶対ダメ。お願い、ひとつでもいいから改善していこう、ね？:
No, no, absolutely not. 
Please, let's fix things, 
even just one step 
at a time, okay？
translations.睡眠は量より質が大切なの。寝る前にホッと一息つく時間を作ると、よく眠れるよ？:
Sleep is more about 
quality than quantity. 
If you unwind before bed, 
you'll sleep so much better, 
you know？
translations.頭を使ったら、身体も適度に使うこと。バランスが大切なんだから。いい？:
If you've been using your brain, 
you need to move your body too. 
Balance is key. Got it？
translations.朝食を抜いたりしてない？ 牛乳１杯でもいいから、何かお腹にいれる習慣をつけること:
You're not skipping breakfast, 
are you？ Even a glass of milk 
is fine—make a habit of 
putting something in your belly.
translations.おやつを食べすぎちゃう気持ちはわかるけど、ほどほどにね？ 私も一緒に頑張るから。:
I get wanting to snack, 
believe me, but moderation, okay？ 
I'll work on it with you.
translations.風邪は寝てる間に一番引きやすいんだから。パソコンの前でそのまま……なんて、絶対ダ:
It's easiest to catch a cold 
while you sleep. Passing out 
at your computer... don't you dare 
do that, okay？
translations.クーラーはなるべく消したほうがいいけど、せめて温度を上げること。夏風邪は性質が悪:
It's best to turn off the AC, 
but at least turn the temp up. 
Summer colds are nasty, 
you know？
translations.今日行ったところ、すっごく良かった。:
The place we went today 
was really wonderful.
translations.ねぇ、この前行ったところ、すごく楽しかったね。:
Hey, that place we went 
the other day was 
so much fun, wasn't it？
translations.ゲームセンター。いろんなゲームで遊べたのが楽しかったね。:
The arcade. It was so fun 
getting to play all those 
different games together.
translations.プリントされた写真がもらえるんだね。いい記念になるから、うれしい。:
You get printed photos, huh？ 
It makes for a great keepsake, 
I really love it.
translations.メダルがたくさんもらえると、興奮しちゃうね。:
When you win a ton of medals, 
it really gets you hyped, 
doesn't it？
translations.演出がすごかったね。あのジャックポット。:
The effects were incredible, 
weren't they？ That jackpot!
translations.スクラッチカードももらえちゃったね。また行きたいな。:
We even got scratch cards! 
I really want to go again.
translations.……うん、私も。大好き。:
...Yeah, me too. 
I love you so much.
translations.なぁに、突然。私も好きだよ？:
What's this all of a sudden？ 
I love you too, you know？
translations.ホントかなぁ？ 素直に聞けないな……。:
Really, now？
I can't just take your
word for it...
translations.私もよ。あなたのこと、心から愛してる。:
Me too. I love you
with all my heart.
translations.やだ、もう……。私もね、愛してる。:
Oh, stop it...
I love you too, you know.
translations.もう、こんなところで……。ふふ、でも嬉しい。:
Jeez, in a place like this？
Hehe, but I'm glad.
translations.もう、嬉しくないって言ったらウソになるけど……。:
I'd be lying if I said
it didn't make me happy,
though...
translations.……ウソつきの口が言うことは、聞きません。:
...I'm not listening to
anything that comes out
of those lying lips.
translations.好きよ。あなたに会えて本当に良かった。:
I love you. I'm so,
so glad that I met you.
translations.大好き。どうしたの？ 甘えたくなっちゃった？:
I love you. What's up？
Feel like being spoiled？
translations.わかってるくせに。なぁに、言ってほしいの？:
You already know.
What, do you want me
to say it？
translations.どうだったかなぁ。好き、かも。:
Hmm, I wonder.
Maybe I do love you.
translations.嫌いになれたら楽なのかなぁ……。:
I wonder if it'd be easier
if I could just hate you...
translations.もちろんいいよ？ ……優しくね？:
Of course you can？
...Be gentle, okay？
translations.うん。いちいち断らなくてもいいのに。:
Sure. You don't have to
ask permission every single
time, you know.
translations.……今は嫌。わかるでしょ？:
...Not right now.
You know why, don't you？
translations.もう、そんなことばっかり言って▼:
Jeez, you're always
saying things like that▼
translations.改まって言われると、照れちゃうね。:
Hearing you say it so
formally is kind of
embarrassing.
translations.ホント、私をメロメロにさせるのがうまいんだから。:
You really know how to
make me melt, you know.
translations.……あなたが私のカレで良かった。何回そう思ったかな。:
...I'm so glad you're my
boyfriend. I wonder how
many times I've thought that.
translations.もう、恥ずかしいじゃない。……もっと言って？:
Jeez, that's embarrassing.
...Say it some more？
translations.そういうこと、サラッと言っちゃうんだ。かっこいい～。:
You just say things like
that so casually. How cool~
translations.もう一度言って？ あなたの声、ずっと聞いてたい……。:
Say it again？
I want to listen to your
voice forever...
translations.私もね、あなたに言いたいことがいっぱいあるの。もっといっぱいお話しよう？:
There's so much I want
to tell you too. Let's talk
a whole lot more, okay？
translations.……待って。ドキドキしすぎて、心臓が破裂しちゃいそう。:
...Wait. My heart's racing
so fast, I feel like
it's going to burst.
translations.ねぇ、私も聞いていい？:
Hey, can I ask
something too？
translations.次は私の番ね？ 何聞いちゃおうかな～。:
My turn next, right？
Now, what should I ask~？
translations.もう、あなたばっかり。私も聞いちゃおう。:
Jeez, you're asking all
the questions. My turn!
translations.私も聞きたいことがあるんだ。いいかな？:
There's something I want to
ask too. Is that okay？
translations.私にもあなたのこと、教えてほしいな？:
Won't you tell me more
about yourself, too？
translations.▲新主人公▲。こんな風に呼ばれるのって、どう？:
▲新主人公▲. How does it feel
being called that？
translations.そうなの？ ふぅん、こういうのもいいんだ。そっかそっか。:
Is that so？ Hmm, you like
this sort of thing too.
Got it, got it.
translations.▲新主人公▲。んー、ちょっと恥ずかしいかな。やっぱりまたの機会にね？:
▲新主人公▲. Hmm, maybe that's
a bit too embarrassing.
Let's save it for another
time, okay？
translations.面白いと思ったんだけどなぁ。ふふ。冗談だったら。:
And here I thought it'd
be fun. Hehe. Just teasing.
translations.ねぇ、こっちこっち。内緒話しよ？:
Hey, over here, over here.
Wanna share a secret？
translations.あまり大きな声では言えないことなの。人に聞こえると嫌だから、そばに来てほしいな。:
It's not something I can
say out loud. I don't want
anyone to overhear, so
come a little closer, okay？
translations.どう、聞こえる？ あなただけに聞いてもらいたいの。:
Can you hear me？
I only want you to
hear this.
translations.私は全部あなたのものです。:
I'm completely yours.
All of me.
translations.あなたに一生ついていきます。:
I'll stick by your side
for the rest of my life.
translations.ふふ、びっくりした？ あなたって時々いじめたくなっちゃうんだもの。ごめんね？:
Hehe, did I startle you？
I just can't resist teasing
you sometimes. Sorry, okay？
translations.……それだけ。はい、恥ずかしいからオシマイ！:
...That's all. Okay, we're
done, I'm way too embarrassed!
translations.もうすぐ年末……。一緒にカウントダウンなんて、ステキ……。:
It's almost the end of the
year... Counting down together
sounds so wonderful...
translations.年末年始、楽しかったね。一番好きな人と一緒に年越しなんて……贅沢♪:
New Year's was so fun. Ringing
it in with the person I love
most... What a treat♪
translations.もうすぐバレンタイン……。もうすぐ……バレンタインね？:
It's almost Valentine's Day...
Almost Valentine's, right？
translations.バレンタイン、喜んでくれたかな？ 私ばっかり楽しんでたわけじゃないよね。:
Did you like Valentine's Day？
I wasn't the only one having
fun, was I？
translations.もうすぐホワイトデー……。楽しみにしてるけど、無理はしないでね。:
It's almost White Day...
I can't wait, but don't push
yourself, okay？
translations.ホワイトデー……あなたの気持ち、うれしかったよ。:
White Day... Knowing how you
felt made me so happy.
translations.もうすぐエイプリルフール……。あんまりイジめちゃ、可哀想かな。:
April Fools' is coming up...
Maybe I'd feel bad if I
teased you too much, though.
translations.エイプリルフールのこと、覚えてる？:
Do you remember what happened
on April Fools' Day？
translations.もうすぐ遠足……。いくつになってもワクワクしちゃうね。:
The field trip is coming up...
No matter how old you get,
it's always exciting, huh？
translations.遠足、楽しかったね。学年合同で、本当によかった。:
The field trip was so fun.
I'm so glad our grades got
to go together.
translations.もうすぐ合唱コンクール……。緊張するね。:
The choir contest is almost
here... It's nerve-wracking,
isn't it？
translations.合唱コンクール、感動しちゃった。がんばってよかったね。:
The choir contest was so
moving. I'm really glad we
tried our best.
translations.もうすぐ七夕……。願い事はどうしようかな、:
Tanabata is coming up...
I wonder what I should wish
for...
translations.七夕、楽しかったね。願い事、かなうかな。:
Tanabata was so much fun.
I wonder if our wishes will
come true.
translations.もうすぐ十羽野祭り……。今年はどんな感じなのかな。:
The Towano Festival is almost
here... Wonder what it'll be
like this year.
translations.十羽野祭り、楽しかったね。盛り上がってよかった。:
The Towano Festival was great.
I'm glad it was so lively.
translations.もうすぐ体育祭……。うん、がんばらなきゃ。:
Sports Day is coming up...
Yeah, I've gotta give it
my all.
translations.体育祭、楽しかったね。始まる前は憂鬱でも、始まっちゃえば、ね。:
Sports Day was so fun. You
dread it beforehand, but once
it starts, you know？
translations.もうすぐハロウィン……。あなたにとっては、イタズラもご褒美……なのかな？:
Halloween is almost here...
For you, is getting tricked
just another treat...？
translations.ハロウィン、楽しかったね。なんだって楽しんだ者勝ち！:
Halloween was so fun.
Whatever you do, the one who
has the most fun wins!
translations.もうすぐ文化祭……。今年の文化祭は、目一杯楽しもうね。:
The culture fest is almost
here... Let's enjoy this one
to the absolute fullest, okay？
translations.文化祭、楽しかったね。ふたりのステキな思い出、また増えちゃった。:
The culture fest was so fun.
We made another wonderful
memory together.
translations.もうすぐクリスマス……。絶対、一緒に過ごそうね。:
Christmas is almost here...
We definitely have to spend it
together, okay？
translations.クリスマス……ありがとう。思ってた通り、最高の思い出になっちゃった。:
Christmas was... wonderful,
thank you. It really turned
into the best memory ever.
translations.ねぇ、誕生日にほしいもの、聞いていいかな。:
Hey, can I ask what you want
for your birthday？
translations.うん、わかった。でも、違うのになっちゃったらごめんね？:
Got it, okay. But sorry if it
turns out a bit different,
okay？
translations.なるほど……。候補のひとつに入れとくね？:
I see... I'll keep that in
mind as an option, okay？
translations.うーん、私に用意できるかな……。期待しないで待っててね？:
Hmm, I wonder if I can get
that... Don't get your hopes
up too high, okay？
translations.私ね、今度の誕生日にほしいものがあるの。当ててみて？:
You know, there's something
I want for my birthday.
Care to guess？
translations.正解はあなたと特別な場所でするキスです。ね、叶えられそうでしょ？:
The answer is... a kiss from
you in a special place. See,
totally doable, right？
translations.じゃーん、正解はあなたです。一日私の言うことを何でも聞くこと。……なんてどう？:
Ta-da! The answer is you.
Doing whatever I say for an
entire day. ...How's that sound？
translations.正解はね、あなたがそばにいてくれればいいの。他に何もいらないよ。:
The answer is... just having
you by my side. I really don't
need anything else.
translations.今度の記念日だけどね、どんな風に過ごしたい？:
Speaking of our anniversary,
how would you like to spend it？
translations.私はいつも通りでいいよ？ つまり、あなたがいればいいってこと。:
I'm fine with our usual？
Basically, having you with me
is all I really need.
translations.うん、それもいいね。そうしちゃおっか？:
Yeah, that sounds nice too.
Shall we do that, then？
translations.もう考えててくれたんだ。あなたに全部任せちゃおうかな。:
You already thought about it？
Maybe I'll just leave
everything up to you, then.
translations.ねえねえ。今年の抱負は何かな？:
Hey, hey.
What's your resolution
for this year？
translations.わぁ、しっかりしてるんだ。あなたならきっと大丈夫。:
Wow, that's really solid.
I know you'll do great.
translations.じゃあ、私のも言うね？ 私の抱負は、今年もずっとあなたにメロメロでいることです。:
Then I'll tell you mine, okay？
My resolution is to stay
head over heels for you this year.
translations.そういうのをスラスラ答えられるって、ポイント高いよ。さすがだね▼:
Answering that so smoothly
earns you major points.
As expected of you, ▼.
translations.今月ももうすぐ終わるんだね。ねぇ、最近では何が一番楽しかった？:
This month is almost over, huh.
Hey, what was the most
fun for you lately？
translations.私は春のお菓子……。美味しかったけど、食べ過ぎちゃったかな。:
For me, spring sweets...
They were delicious, but maybe
I ate a little too much.
translations.私は、やっぱり桜かな。ちゃんとしたお花見じゃなくても、ふと目に入る桜も好きだな。:
For me, cherry blossoms.
Even without a proper picnic,
just seeing them is so nice.
translations.私は……お散歩かな。春のお散歩、気持ちいいもんね。:
For me... walks, I guess.
Spring walks just feel
so nice, you know？
translations.私は……やっぱり海。泳げなくたって、楽しみようはあるんだから。:
For me... definitely the beach.
Even if I can't swim, there are
plenty of ways to have fun.
translations.私は、アイスに、かき氷に……。ダメだね、こんなに食べてばっかりじゃ。:
For me, ice cream, shaved ice...
No good, huh, thinking about
nothing but eating.
translations.私は花火……かな。花火を見ないと、夏が終わらない感じ。:
For me, fireworks... I guess.
Summer just doesn't feel
over without fireworks.
translations.私は、芸術の秋。映画だって……立派な芸術よね？:
For me, an autumn of the arts.
Movies... count as art too,
right？
translations.私は、食欲の秋。ではなくて、料理の秋です。これでもがんばったんだから。:
For me, an autumn of appetite.
Or rather, an autumn of cooking!
I really did my best, you know.
translations.私はセールが楽しかったな。結果だけじゃなくて、買い物することが楽しくなったりね。:
For me, the sales were fun.
Not just what I bought, but
shopping itself was a blast.
translations.地面が凍ったり、少し雪が積もったり、そういうのを見るのが楽しかったな。:
Watching the ground freeze over
or a little snow piling up...
That was really fun to see.
translations.私はお鍋！ 作るのも食べるのも、楽しいもんね。:
For me, hot pot!
Making it and eating it
are both so much fun.
translations.私はコタツに入ってのんびりしたことでーす。:
For me, it's curling up
under the kotatsu and relaxing~
translations.▲主人公＊▲、今時間ある？ 大丈夫なら、一緒に遊ばない？:
▲主人公＊▲, do you have some time？
If you're free, wanna
play together？
translations.ねぇ、ちょっと休憩しない？ 気分転換に一緒に遊ぼうよ。:
Hey, wanna take a quick break？
Let's play something together
for a change of pace.
translations.暇だな～。ねぇねぇ、一緒に遊ぼうよ。いいでしょ？:
I'm so bored~.
Hey, hey, let's play together.
Come on, won't you？
translations.アツくなっちゃったね。ねぇ、もう一度する？:
That got pretty intense, huh.
Hey, wanna go again？
translations.あ、ご褒美がほしいんでしょ。どうしようかな～♪:
Ah, you want a reward, don't you？
Hmm, what should I do~♪
translations.じゃあ、決まりね？ 楽しみだな。:
Then it's settled, right？
I can't wait.
translations.あれ？ いいんだ。じゃあ、また今度ね？:
Huh？ Never mind, then？
We'll do it another time, okay？
translations.ねぇ、ジャストカウントって遊びしよう？ 私が時計を見てるから、３０秒経ったと思っ:
Hey, wanna play Just Count？
I'll watch the clock, so when you
think 30 seconds have passed,
just shout 'Now!' okay？
translations.いい、始めるよ？ よーい、スタート！:
Ready？ Here we go...
Ready, start!
translations.もう、早いよ～。: Geez, that was way too fast~
translations.まだまだ。３０秒たってません。:
Not yet!
30 seconds haven't passed yet.
translations.んー、惜しい！ あとちょっとだったよ？:
Mmm, so close!
Just a little bit more, you know？
translations.残念、ちょっと遅かったかな。また挑戦してみてね？:
Too bad, a little too late.
Try again next time, okay？
translations.すごい、ぴったり！ よくわかったね。:
Amazing, right on the dot!
Good sense of time.
translations.このところメールが少ないな～。ネネ、寂しいな～。:
You haven't texted me much lately~.
Nene's feeling lonely~.
translations.いつもたくさんメールくれるよね。あなたがずっとそばにいるみたいで、嬉しいな。:
You always text me so much.
It feels like you're right by my side,
and that makes me so happy.
translations.最近忙しい？ あまりデートに連れて行ってもらってない気がするな～。:
Are you busy lately？
Feels like you haven't taken me out
on dates much~.
translations.ねぇ、私たち以上にデートしてるカップルなんて、なかなかいないんじゃないかな？:
Hey, do you think there's
any couple out there that goes
on more dates than us？
translations.最近あまり呼んでくれないね。もっとじゃんじゃん呼び出していいんだからね？:
You haven't called on me much lately.
You know you can ask for me
anytime, right？
translations.あなたがしょっちゅう連絡くれるから、寂しいなんて思う暇がないの。私、すごく幸せだ:
You reach out to me so often
I don't even have time to feel lonely.
I'm really happy, you know？
translations.最近スキンシップ不足のような気がするけど、もしかして私に遠慮してる？ そんなの、:
Feels like we haven't touched
much lately. Are you holding back？
You don't need to be shy with me,
you know？
translations.あなたって最近甘えんぼさん？ 私にしょっちゅう触れてくるでしょ。もちろん、嬉しい:
Have you been feeling clingy lately？
You've been touching me so much.
Not that I'm complaining, of course？
translations.あなたみたいな人のこと、ストイックっていうのかなぁ。もうちょっとスキンシップがあ:
I wonder if someone like you
is what they call 'stoic.'
I wouldn't mind a little more touch,
though...
translations.もう、あなたって場所を選ばないんだから。……嬉しいから余計に困っちゃう。:
Geez, you really don't care
where we are, do you？
...It's all the more trouble
because I actually like it.
translations.その、キスのことだけど……もっと強引でもいいんだからね？ もちろん優しいのも好き:
Um, about kissing...
You can be a bit more forceful,
you know？
Gentle is nice too, but...
translations.最近のあなた、すごく積極的だね。キスなんて特に……ふふ▼:
You've been so bold lately.
Especially with kisses... Fufu.▼
translations.ねぇ、最近あまりキスしてくれないのって、私のせいなのかな。ちょっと寂しいな……。:
Hey, is it my fault you haven't
kissed me much lately？
I feel a little lonely...
translations.私の彼は、いつからキス魔になっちゃったのかな？ 最近いっぱいしてくれるね。:
When did my boyfriend turn into
such a kiss monster？
You've been giving me so many lately.
translations.昨日も大好きだったけど、今日のほうがもっと好きだよ？ 明日はもっともっと好きにな:
I loved you yesterday, but I love you
even more today, you know？
Tomorrow might be even more.
translations.私とあなたの距離、どんどん縮まってる。いつかくっついちゃうのかな？:
The distance between us
keeps shrinking.
Think we'll end up
fused together someday？
translations.そういえば、この間紹介してくれたお友達とは最近会ってるの？:
By the way, have you seen that friend
you introduced me to lately？
translations.ねえ、この前紹介してくれたお友達、どうしてるかな。:
Hey, I wonder how that friend
you introduced me to is doing.
translations.前にダブルデートしたでしょ？ ああいうのも新鮮でいいね。:
We went on a double date before, right？
That was a fun change of pace.
translations.この前みんなでおしゃべりしたの、楽しかったなぁ。またやりたいね。:
It was so fun chatting
with everyone the other day.
We should do it again.
translations.この前、ガールズトークしちゃったの。ふふ、いろいろ話しちゃった。:
I had some girl talk the other day.
Fufu, we talked about all sorts of things.
translations.そうだ、この前友達と彼氏について話したんだよ。どんなこと話したかはナイショ。:
Oh, right! I was talking with
my friend about boyfriends
the other day. What we said
is a secret, though.
translations.ふふ、別に変なことは言ってないよ？ ……たぶんだけど。:
Fufu, I didn't say anything weird,
okay？ ...Probably, anyway.
translations.ここだけの話だけど、やっぱりあなたが一番かなって思っちゃった。:
Just between you and me,
it just reminded me that you're
definitely the best.
translations.そういえば、メール見てくれた？ ちゃんと届いてるかな……。:
By the way, did you see my message？
I hope it went through...
translations.ねぇ、電話したのわかったかな。そんなにたいした用事じゃなかったんだけどね？:
Hey, did you notice I called？
It wasn't anything important, though.
translations.そうそう、ＷＥＢが更新されてたよ。新しい情報はこまめにチェックしないとね。:
Oh right, the website was updated.
Gotta keep checking for new info,
you know？
translations.ねぇ、あなたの顔、よーく見せて？:
Hey, let me get a good look
at your face？
translations.もうちょっとこっち。真正面から私を見て？:
A little more this way.
Look right at me, straight on？
translations.んー、よく見えないなぁ。正面だよ？:
Hmm, I can't see you well.
Face me directly, okay？
translations.うん、そこ。そのままでいてね？:
Yeah, right there.
Stay just like that, okay？
translations.あ、動いたでしょ。さっきの位置に戻ってね。:
Ah, you moved!
Go back to where you were.
translations.そうそう。そこがベストポジション。:
There you go.
That's the sweet spot.
translations.あなたの顔、ハッキリ見えるよ。ふふ。:
I can see your face clearly now.
Fufu.
translations.あれ？ いつもと感じが違うような……。:
Huh？ You look a little different
than usual...
translations.こうして二人きりで、ずっと見つめあってたいな……。:
Just the two of us like this...
I wish we could gaze at each other
forever.
translations.あなたの顔、こんなにマジマジと見たことあったかな？:
I wonder if I've ever stared
at your face this closely before？
translations.そんなに見られると恥ずかしくなってきちゃった……。:
Having you stare back at me
is making me blush...
translations.▲主人公＊▲。私ね、あなたの顔、だーい好き。:
▲主人公＊▲
You know... I just love your face
so, so much.
translations.あれ？ うーん、やっぱりいつもと感じが違うような……。:
Huh？ Hmm, you definitely seem
different than usual...
translations.なあに？ 今笑ったでしょ。面白いこと思い出しちゃった？:
What is it？ You just laughed,
didn't you？ Did you remember
something funny？
translations.あ、人の顔見て笑っちゃって。そんな子は、くすぐりの刑にしちゃうぞ？:
Hey, laughing at my face？
That calls for tickle torture,
you know？
translations.ふふ、あなたが笑うから、私もつられちゃったじゃない。ふふ……。:
Hehe, you laughed, so now
you've got me laughing too.
Hehe...
translations.あなたの笑う顔を見てると、心がじんわりあったかくなるの。:
Watching you smile just warms
my heart right up.
translations.ねぇ、目を閉じて？ そのままじっとして……いい？ チュ。:
Hey, close your eyes？
Now stay still... Okay？
*Mwah*.
translations.ふふ、しちゃった。ねぇ、目はちゃんと閉じてた？:
Hehe, I did it.
Hey, did you keep your eyes
closed the whole time？
translations.ねぇ、頭なでてもいい？ いい子いい子……。:
Hey, can I pat your head？
Good boy, good boy...
translations.子供みたいな顔して。ホントかわいいんだから。:
Look at that baby face.
You're seriously so cute.
translations.どこ行くの？ 早く帰ってきてね。待ってるから。:
Where are you going？
Come back soon, okay？
I'll be waiting.
translations.あ、行っちゃうんだ。じゃあ、続きは今度ね。:
Oh, you're leaving.
Well, we'll pick this up
next time, then.
translations.負けちゃった……もう一回勝負してくれたら、写真撮ってもいいよ？ あなたが勝ったら:
I lost... If you play me one
more time, I'll let you take a photo？
If you win, one picture.
If I win, no reward. How's that？
translations.うん。今度こそ勝ってみせるんだから。じゃあいくよ？:
Okay. I'm definitely winning
this time. Here goes, okay？
translations.そっか、仕方ないね。約束だからご褒美あげなくちゃ。:
Oh well, fair is fair.
A promise is a promise,
so here's your reward.
translations.やった、私の勝ちだよ。残念だけど、ご褒美はおあずけです。:
Yay, I win！
Too bad, but your reward
is on hold.
translations.やだ、また負けちゃった。じゃあ約束だから、１枚写真を撮らせてあげる。１枚だけだよ:
Aw, I lost again.
Well, a promise is a promise,
so I'll let you take a photo.
Just one, okay？
translations.かわいく撮ってね？ 変なの撮ったら、怒っちゃうから。:
Make sure I look cute, okay？
If you take a weird one,
I'll get mad.
translations.はい、終了です。お疲れさまでした。:
All right, time's up.
Good job.
translations.わぁ、私の勝ち！ ねぇ、やっぱり私もご褒美がほしいな。いいでしょ？:
Yay, I win！
Hey, I want a reward too,
you know. Can I have one？
translations.“ネネ愛してる”って言って？ ちゃんと感情こめてね。はい。:
Tell me, "I love you, Nene"？
Put some real feeling into it,
okay？ Go ahead.
translations.“ネネ愛してる”だよ？ ハッキリ言ってほしいなぁ。:
It's "I love you, Nene,"
remember？ I want you to say it
nice and clear.
translations.もう、照れちゃって。しょうがないから今日は許してあげる。:
Aw, you're all bashful.
I guess I'll let you off
the hook today.
translations.……ありがとう。何度聞いてもドキドキしちゃう。私も、大好きだよ？:
...Thank you. Every time I hear
that, my heart flutters.
I love you too, you know？
translations.今、少しいい？ 聞いてもらいたいことがあるの。:
Do you have a second？
There's something I'd like
you to hear.
translations.んー、やっぱり今はいいかな。また今度聞いてもらうね？:
Hmm, never mind for now.
I'll tell you another time,
okay？
translations.私今、すごくドキドキしてる。あなたのことを考えるとこうなっちゃうの。この気持ち、:
My heart's pounding right now.
It happens whenever I think
about you. I want to treasure
this feeling forever.
translations.私ね、毎日が楽しいの。あなたに会ったら何を話そうとか、こうしようとか考えるだけで:
You know, every day is so fun.
Just thinking about what to talk
about or do when I see you
gets me so excited.
translations.今ね、自分を磨くのに一生懸命なの。心も身体も、あなたには一番きれいな私を見てもら:
I'm working hard on myself
right now. In heart and body,
I want you to see me at my best.
So I'll keep trying my hardest.
translations.あのね、あなたにはすごく感謝してるの。こんなに人を好きになれることも、こんなに人:
You know, I'm so grateful to you.
I never knew I could love someone
like this, or feel so gentle toward
another person, until you.
translations.私ね、あなたの新しい一面を発見するたびに、本当に幸せな気分になるんだ。さりげない:
Whenever I discover a new side
of you, it makes me truly happy.
A little gesture, a phrase you say...
I can find happiness in even
the smallest things.
translations.私ね、あなたと一緒にいられるだけで幸せなの。何をしてても、どこにいても、あなたさ:
Just being with you makes me
so happy. Whatever we're doing,
wherever we are, you're all I need.
It has to be you.
translations.私、あなたに会えて本当によかった。誰かを好きになることがこんなに素敵で幸せだって:
I'm so glad I met you.
You taught me how wonderful
and happy loving someone can be.
translations.私ね、あなたのためなら何でもできるよ。あなたに会うまで、自分がそんなことを思うな:
I'd do anything for you.
Before I met you, I never imagined
I'd feel that way about someone.
That's how precious you are to me.
translations.あのね、一生とか永遠の愛って信じる？ 私ね、今は信じられるよ。一生そばにいたいと:
Hey, do you believe in eternal
love, or love for a lifetime？
I believe in it now. Because I met
the person I want to stay beside
forever... you.
translations.ねぇ、私ね、愛してるなんてキザな言葉だと思ってた。でもあなたに会って、言葉が心か:
You know, I used to think saying
"I love you" was cheesy. But after
meeting you, I learned how it feels
when words come straight from
the heart. ...I love you.
translations.これが今の私の気持ちだよ。うまく伝わったかな。:
That's how I feel right now.
Did that make sense？
translations.前にも話したことあったかな？ でも、これが今の私の気持ちだから。:
Have I said that before？
Either way, that's really
how I feel right now.
translations.なあに？ いいよ、あなたの気が済むまでつきあってあげる。:
What is it？ Sure, I'll keep you
company for as long as you want.
translations.もっと話して。気になること、全部。:
Tell me more.
Everything that's
on your mind.
translations.……大丈夫？ 無理して話すことないよ。:
...Are you okay？
You don't have to push
yourself to talk.
translations.ねぇ、笑ってみて？ 無理にでも笑うと、心が軽くなるの。ホントだよ？:
Hey, try smiling for me？
Even if it's forced,
it makes you feel lighter.
It's true, you know？
translations.よし、おまじないしてあげちゃう。悪いの悪いの、飛んでいけ～。:
All right, I'll cast
a little spell for you.
Shoo, shoo, bad things,
fly away~.
translations.何かあればいつでも聞くから、ね？ 明日からまた頑張れそう？:
I'm always here to listen
if you need me, okay？
Think you can face
tomorrow now？
translations.いざという時は私の顔を思い出して。どう？ 少し気分が良くなったでしょ。ふふ。:
If things get rough,
just picture my face.
How's that？ Feel a little
better now？ Hehe.
translations.私の前では頑張らなくていいから。ね、肩の力抜いて？ リラックスしよう。:
You don't have to act tough
in front of me.
Come on, loosen up, okay？
Let's just relax.
translations.ここまでやってこれたんだもん。明日からもやれるよ。:
You've made it this far,
after all.
You can handle tomorrow,
too.
translations.ねぇ、気分転換しよっか。何したい？:
Hey, let's do something
for a change of pace.
What do you want to do？
translations.はい、ここからは気分を変えていきましょ。いいでしょ？:
All right, let's switch
gears from here on out.
Sound good？
translations.ちょっとは元気出たかな？ 今夜はいい夢見られるよ、きっと。:
Feeling a little better？
I'm sure you'll have
sweet dreams tonight.
translations.もっと私のこと頼っていいんだからね。話を聞くしかできないけど……ね？:
You can lean on me
more, you know.
Even if all I can do is
listen... okay？
translations.あっ、待ってね、今ロック中なの。あなたが本当に私のカレだって確認できたら、解除す:
Ah, hold on, it's locked
right now. Once I make sure
you're really my boyfriend,
I'll unlock it, okay？
Come on, let me see
your face properly.
translations.えっと……よく見えないな。ちゃんと顔を見せて？:
Um... I can't see very
well. Show me your face
properly, okay？
translations.んー……じゃあ、そうね……名前を言ってもらっていいかな？:
Hmm... In that case...
Could you tell me your
name, please？
translations.たしかに私のカレシ♪ お待たせ。:
Definitely my boyfriend♪
Sorry to keep you waiting.
translations.ん？ ちゃんと聞こえなかったよ？:
Hm？ I couldn't really
hear you, you know？
translations.名前が違う気がする……聞き間違いだったらごめんね？ えっと……本人だったら秘密の:
I don't think that's
your name... Sorry if I
misheard, though！ Um...
if it's really you, you know
the secret command, right？
translations.それじゃあ、入力してみて？: All right, enter it for me？
translations.あれっ？ 違うと思うんだけど……。:
Huh？ I don't think
that's right...
translations.大切なコマンドなのに、忘れちゃったの？ どうしよう……じゃあ、最後のチャンス。:
Did you forget such an
important command？
What am I gonna do...
Okay, last chance.
translations.“ネネあいしてるよ”って言ってくれたら、信じる。これが最後だからね？:
If you say 'I love you,
Nene', I'll believe you.
This is the last chance,
okay？
translations.ふふ……私にそんなこと言えるのは、あなただけだもんね♪:
Hehe... You're the only one
who could say that to me♪
translations.どうしたの？ “ネネあいしてるよ”って言うだけだよ？:
What's the matter？
All you have to say is
'I love you, Nene', okay？
translations.もういい……ここまで頑張ったんだから。仕方ないから、信じてあげる。:
All right, that's enough...
You tried so hard, after all.
Guess I have no choice
but to believe you.
translations.はい、ロック解除。私って甘いのかなぁ……次はダメだよ？:
There, unlocked.
Am I too soft on you,
I wonder...
No next time, okay？
translations.今日は……デートでした▼ いつも思うけど、どうしてカレったらあんなにカワイイんだ:
Today was... a date▼
I always wonder, how is he
so ridiculously cute？
It tickles my motherly
instincts so much,
it's almost a problem♪
translations.今日は久しぶりのデートだったもんな……私、ぎこちなかった？ でもでも、彼と一緒に:
Today was our first date
in a while... Was I awkward？
Still, getting to go out
with him was just wonderful...
I want to go on lots more
dates with him♪
translations.最近、私たちデートばっかり？ うん、デートばっかり▼ それでもまたスグ会いたくな:
Have we been doing nothing
but dating lately？
Yep, non-stop dates▼
Even so, I still want to see
him again right away.
...I wonder if he's thinking
about me right now, too？
translations.今日は、放課後デートして帰っちゃった▼ やっぱりこういうときって、いつもより色々:
Today, we went on an
after-school date▼
At times like this, I guess
I'm more self-conscious.
Classmates, teachers...
...Still, thinking
'Let's just show them all！'
—is that too bold of me？
translations.今日のデートはスペシャルバージョン▼ 思い出すだけで顔がフニャ……ってなっちゃう:
Today's date was a special
edition▼ Just thinking of
it makes my face melt♪
So grateful to him...
for making such a wonderful,
unforgettable memory♪
translations.今日は～……最っ高に楽しいデートでした▼ カレって私の喜ぶこと、やっぱりお見通し:
Today was~... the absolute
most fun date ever▼
Does he really see right
through what makes me happy？
It's vexing yet delightful...
He's so sweet and cute,
I lo~ve him so much▼
translations.今日もやっぱり素敵なデート。私の方がお姉さんなのに、なんだかたくさん甘えちゃった:
Today was another wonderful
date. Even though I'm the
older one, I feel like I
acted pretty spoiled, huh？
I just wanted to be with him
as long as possible♪
translations.今日はカレと楽しくデート。場所の雰囲気もカレのエスコートも合格だったかな？ 今度:
Had a fun date with him
today. The atmosphere and
how he escorted me both
passed with flying colors？
I'll have to pamper him
like a good boy next time♪
translations.デートのたびにサプライズなんて起こるはずないのわかってるけど……今日はもうちょっ:
I know surprises can't
happen every date, but...
I wished today's date had
been a bit more special~...
Am I being greedy？
No, no, snap out of it！
translations.今日の気持ちはカレとすれちがい……楽しいはずのデートがガッカリ……。私の努力が足: He and I just weren't on the same page today... Our date was supposed to be fun, but it was such a letdown... Maybe I'm not trying hard enough？ I shouldn't put it all on him. Hang in there, me!
translations.今日のデートは正直、楽しくなかった……。なんだかカレが……私のこと全然考えてくれ: To be honest, today's date wasn't fun at all... It felt like he wasn't thinking about me at all, and that just made me sad.
translations.今日の髪型、彼がとっても気に入ってくれたみたいで嬉しい♪ ハッピー♪ しばらくこ: He seemed to really love my hairstyle today, which makes me so happy♪ Yay♪ Maybe I'll stick with this style for a while？ I want to be his type as much as I can, after all▼
translations.彼に服を褒められるのって、好き。服だけじゃなくてなんでも、好みだよ、好きだよって: I love it when he compliments my outfits. Not just clothes, either—whenever he tells me he likes something or that it's his type, I'm walking on air♪ All right... I'll have to study today's look a little more♪
translations.デート帰りにカレを家に招待しちゃった……。家で一緒にいるのって……普段とぜんぜん: I ended up inviting him over after our date... Being together at home is... totally different from usual... Totally different, and... my heart wouldn't stop racing. I hope he comes over again.
translations.デートのあと、彼の部屋に行くことに。色々考えちゃったけど……カレはカワイイ紳士で: After our date, we ended up going to his room. All sorts of thoughts crossed my mind, but... he was such a cute gentleman▼ We got to spend a lot of time together, so I'm really glad I went♪
translations.今日食事したお店、お気に入りになっちゃった。雰囲気も味も大満足♪ 彼も気に入って: The place we ate at today became an instant favorite. The food and atmosphere were both amazing♪ I wonder if he liked it too？ I hope we can go back together sometime.
translations.食事の最中、カレと食べさせあいっこすることに。カレも照れちゃったみたいで……その: During our meal, we ended up feeding each other bites. He seemed so shy about it... and seeing that look on his face started making me blush, too▼
translations.アーンって、カレと食べさせ合いっこするのもだいぶ上手くなってきたかも。それがない: I think we've gotten pretty good at feeding each other and saying "say aah." What am I going to do if meals feel like something's missing without that now▼
translations.なんだかカレに甘えたくなっちゃって、今日は自分から近づいていっちゃった。たまには: I just felt like cuddling up to him, so today I went ahead and made the first move. Nothing wrong with that once in a while, right？ Besides, the surprised look on his face was just too cute▼
translations.女の子はもっとデリケートに扱うもの……って、注意しないとダメなのかな。今日のスキ: Do I need to remind him that girls are supposed to be treated more delicately...？ He was a little too selfish and handsy today, which made things kind of uncomfortable.
translations.カレにキスしてもらいたくて、自分から積極的にムード作りしちゃった……。わざとらし: I really wanted him to kiss me, so I went ahead and set the mood myself... I hope it didn't seem too forced... I wonder if he thought I was being weird...？ Or maybe, just maybe, he was actually happy about it...？
translations.キスしたいなら、もっと自然で優しいムードを作ってほしいな……。今日のカレは……ち: If he wants to kiss, I wish he'd create a gentler, more natural mood... Today, it felt like he just didn't care about the atmosphere at all.
translations.今日、カレの顔を見てたら……キス、したくなって……自分からしちゃった▼ 今日の私: Looking at his face today... I just wanted to kiss him so badly... that I went and kissed him myself▼ Was I being a little too bold today？ I hope it made him feel as happy as it made me.
translations.今日のキスは強引すぎ……。そりゃあキスしたくないって言われるよりは、してくれる方: His kiss was way too forceful today... I mean, I'd rather he kiss me than say he doesn't want to, but... I still wish he'd considered my feelings a little.
translations.今日はたくさんキスしちゃった……だって、彼のキスがすごくうれしくて♪ かわいくて: We kissed so much today... His kisses just make me so happy♪ He's adorable, and he's such a good kisser... What am I going to do with him▼
translations.まだ感覚が残ってる感じがする……。ずっとずーっとキスしたまま離れなくなりそうな…: I can still feel it lingering... It felt like we were never going to pull apart, like we could've stayed like that forever... an endless kiss. At this rate, I'll probably be kissing him in my dreams, too.
translations.今日はカレにたーくさん甘えて……アピールしちゃった。だって……カレのことが大好き: I was so affectionate and clingy with him today... really showed it off. I just couldn't help it—I needed him to know how much I love him.
translations.写真を撮りたいって言うカレに応えてあげたんだけど……私もどんどんその気になっちゃ: I went along with him when he said he wanted to take pictures... but I ended up getting totally into it myself, and it was so much fun♪ I think I made a pretty good model today, didn't I？
translations.カレに写真を撮ってもらうことになったんだけど、カメラを向けられるとどうしても緊張: He took some pictures of me, but whenever the camera's pointed my way, I just get so nervous... I really want to look like I'm having fun, though.
translations.今日は話の流れで、写真を撮らせてあげることに。だけど、ちょっと恥ずかしかったな。: In the flow of our conversation, I ended up letting him take some photos. It was a little embarrassing, though. I can't really tell if I was just being overly self-conscious... or if it was the way he was taking them.
translations.雨っていいな。だって、好きな人と相合傘ができるんだもん▼ 傘を持ってくれるカレっ: Rain is wonderful. After all, you get to share an umbrella with the one you love▼ Holding the umbrella like that made him look a little more manly than usual, I think.
translations.今は料理の勉強中だから、二人で食事に行ったときは必ず彼の反応をチェック！ 美味し: Since I'm practicing my cooking right now, I always check his reaction whenever we eat out together! The look on his face when he tastes something delicious is just so cute▼
translations.カレの好きな料理をマスターしたくて、最近ヒマさえあればプレゼントしてもらった本と: I really want to master his favorite dishes, so lately I've been glued to that cookbook he gave me whenever I have free time. I think I'm finally getting the hang of how he likes his flavors.
translations.カレに晩ご飯を作ってあげたら美味しいって、たくさん食べてくれた♪ あんな顔された: I made him dinner today, and he said it was delicious and ate a ton♪ When he makes a face like that, it makes me want to cook for him every single day▼
translations.頑張って手作りの晩ご飯をごちそうしたんだけど……カレの反応はまあまあ、だったかな: I worked hard on a homemade dinner for him, but... his reaction was just so-so, I guess. I want to get good enough to make meals that'll leave him absolutely thrilled.
translations.せっかくカレに喜んでもらおうと思って晩ご飯を作ったのに、好みじゃなかったみたい。: I made dinner hoping to make him happy, but it seems it wasn't really to his taste. I guess my cooking skills just aren't quite there yet. I'll have to practice more at home.
translations.朝ご飯を作りに行ったら、カレの奥様になったみたいな気分が味わえて特別な感じ。新婚: Going over to make breakfast for him felt so special, almost like I was his wife. It felt like playing newlyweds... and it was so much fun♪
translations.カレに手作りのお弁当を作って行くことが、私の趣味みたいになってるかも。ちゃんと栄: Making homemade bentos for him has practically become a hobby of mine. I've got to balance the nutrition properly and make sure they look cute, too.
translations.カレにプレゼントもらっちゃった♪ 急だったから驚いたけど……普段から私のことを考: I got a present from him♪ It was so sudden that it caught me by surprise... but knowing he's thinking about me in his everyday life just warms my heart. I'm so lucky to have such a wonderful boyfriend.
translations.試験に向けて一緒に勉強会することに。カレの真剣な表情って素敵。こんなに頑張ってる: We decided to study together for our exams. His serious expression is so handsome. He's working so hard, so I really want to be there to support him.
translations.せっかく二人で一緒に勉強会したのに、カレは全然身が入ってなかったみたい。がんばっ: Even though we had a study session together, his heart didn't seem in it at all. He's so much cooler when he's trying his best, and that's the side of him I love...
translations.最近、カレに呼び出されることが多い気がする。私に会いたくてしょうがないんだぁって: I feel like he's been asking me to meet up a lot lately. Knowing he just can't wait to see me is so endearing▼
translations.最近のカレ、会おうって連絡してくれるのはいいんだけど……会うと決まっていつもくっ: It's sweet that he reaches out to meet up lately, but... without fail, he always gets super clingy once we're together... That's nice too, but I kind of wish we could spend a little more time just talking.
translations.最近、カレからメールが来てないけど、どうしたんだろう……めんどくさいのかな？ お: He hasn't texted me lately, so I wonder what's going on... Is it a hassle for him？ Even just a quick 'good morning' or 'good night' would be fine... Without even that, I get a little lonely.
translations.私、カレにメール送りすぎてるかな？ どんなことでもすぐに伝えたいだけなんだけど…: Am I texting him too much？ I just want to tell him about everything right away, but... if it's too frequent, he might feel like I'm being clingy. I should be careful.
translations.今日はカレとちゃんと話せてよかった。最近少し不満がたまっちゃってたけど、きちんと: I'm so glad he and I had a proper talk today. I'd let a little frustration bottle up lately, but being honest about your feelings really is important. Yep, everything's fine now. We're right back to normal♪
translations.ささいなことが積もり積もって、ケンカになっちゃったけど……。今はそのおかげで気持: Little things piled up and turned into an argument, but... because of that, we finally understand each other and made up completely. I guess that's what they mean when they say the ground hardens after rain.
translations.風邪をひいちゃって休んでたらカレがお見舞いに来て、いっぱい優しくしてくれた♪ こ: I caught a cold and stayed home, and he came over to visit and was so sweet to me♪ If this is what happens, catching a cold every now and then wouldn't be so bad▼
translations.カレの風邪が心配だからお見舞いに行ってきた。ちゃんと寝てるか、食事や洗濯はできて: I was worried about his cold, so I went to check on him. I'd been wondering if he was sleeping properly and managing food and laundry, but he seemed okay... I think. Forcing my help on him would just be a bother, after all.
translations.この日記帳は、カレからのプレゼント。もちろん書くこともほとんど、カレのことになっ:
This diary was a present from him.
Naturally, most of what I write
will end up being about him, too.
I wonder if he was secretly hoping
I'd write about him, too？
translations.記念日です。とても大切な……ひょっとしたら、一年で一番かもしれない特別な日。この:
It's our anniversary.
A very special day... maybe even
the most special day of the year.
He gave me so, so much happiness
this past year, so this year,
I want to give back as much as I can.
translations.カレの誕生日▼ プレゼント喜んじゃって、子供みたいで可愛かったな▼ 来年も再来年:
It's his birthday ▼.
He got so happy over his present,
it was adorable, like a little kid ▼.
Next year, the year after that...
I want to keep celebrating it forever,
until he's an old grandpa♪
Though that means I'll be an old
grandma too, which is another story...
translations.誕生日でーす♪ なんて書いてみても、やっぱりユーウツ。誕生日なんて、カレのお祝い:
It's my birthday♪
...Even writing that cheerily,
it's still kind of depressing.
Birthdays wouldn't have anything
good going for them without his sweet
words and his present.
His birthday wishes... I could replay
them in my head forever.
translations.クリスマスでした。私たちみたいなラブラブカップルが、もーっとラブラブになれちゃう:
It was Christmas. A day made for
lovey-dovey couples like us to get
even more lovey-dovey.
I got to soak in such a romantic vibe
with him... Totally enchanted ▼.
I should've told him how much
I love him even more.
translations.バレンタインデー！ 今日は何組カップルができたんだろう……。バレンタインチョコを:
Valentine's Day！
I wonder how many couples were
born today...
Handing over chocolates and confessing
on the spot... That's such a dream.
Maybe I'll try giving them to him
like that next year♪
translations.ホワイトデー！ カレはこのお返し、どんなこと考えながら選んでくれたのかなあ……い:
White Day！
I wonder what was going through
his head when he picked out this gift...
Did he agonize over it？
Ugh, just imagining it is too cute ▼.
translations.カレと一緒に年越し……やっぱり恋人同士はコレよね▼ 夜帰る時間を気にしなくていい:
Ringing in the New Year with him...
This is definitely what lovers do ▼.
It's so wonderful not having to worry
about what time I have to head home.
I wonder how many years until that's
just our everyday normal？
translations.文化祭でした。文化祭デート、いいなあって思ってたんだ。学校でデートできるって、な:
It was the school festival.
I've always wanted a school festival date.
Going on a date at school feels like
such a special treat.
After all, the school festival is really
the only time all year that school feels
out of the ordinary.
translations.体育祭。私にとっては、かっこいいカレシを眺める日▼ スポーツをするときって、普段:
Sports Day. For me, that meant a day
to gaze at my cool boyfriend ▼.
Guys just look so much more gallant
when they're playing sports, don't they？
I burned every second into my memory♪
translations.デキシーズに新しいバイトの子が入ってきた。素直でいい子みたいだけど……すこ～し頼:
A new boy started working at Dixie's.
He seems like an honest, good kid...
though he feels a tiiiny bit unreliable.
I'll have to show him the ropes.
translations.一人前のお祝いに、お食事。先輩としてかっこよくキメるつもりだったのに……失敗した:
A meal to celebrate him learning
the ropes. I was planning to play the
cool senpai, but... totally botched it.
translations.それに、ちょっと無理矢理誘ったみたいになっちゃったかな……迷惑に思われてないとい:
Besides, I might have come on a bit
too forceful inviting him...
I hope he didn't find it annoying.
Come to think of it, eating out one-on-one
with a coworker... I don't think
I've really done that before.
translations.新メニューのアイディア出しのために、二人で甘味屋さん。イヤな顔せず付き合ってくれ:
The two of us went to a sweets shop
to brainstorm ideas for the new menu.
He didn't complain once, and he even
gave me solid advice...
He's surprisingly reliable...
translations.それと私、あんな風に思われてたんだ……我ながらヘンな質問しちゃった。それにしても:
Also, so that's what he thinks of me...
Even I know that was a weird question.
Still, it really felt like a date.
That wasn't my intention at all
when I invited him, though...
translations.新メニューのアイディア出しのために、二人でラーメン屋さん。女子一人じゃ入りにくか:
The two of us went to a ramen shop
to brainstorm ideas for the new menu.
It's hard for a girl to go into those alone,
so it was a big help.
He gave me advice, too...
Yeah, he might actually be reliable.
translations.それにしても……あんな質問しちゃって、ヘンに思われなかったかな。おまけに、“デー:
Still... I wonder if he thought I was
weird for asking that kind of question.
On top of that, "Could this be a date？"...
I didn't mean to blurt that out at all.
translations.新メニューのアイディア出しのために、二人で高級レストラン。さすがに女子高生一人じ:
The two of us went to a fancy restaurant
to brainstorm ideas for the new menu.
A high school girl can't really go
into a place like that alone.
He gave me valuable feedback, too,
so I'm glad I asked him along.
translations.だけど、なんだか余計な、思わせぶりなことまで言っちゃった……どうしてだろ。ちょっ:
But I ended up saying unnecessary,
suggestive things... Why did I do that？
Maybe I was getting a little carried away.
It wasn't like it was a date to him, anyway.
translations.新メニューのアイディア出しのために、二人で湖畔のレストラン。ちょっと遠いし、一人:
The two of us went to a lakeside
restaurant to brainstorm ideas for the
new menu. It's a bit far, and I didn't
feel like going alone, so it worked out.
He might actually be pretty dependable.
translations.仕事して、楽しくお食事して……それだけで終わらせておけばよかったのに。余計なこと:
Doing our job, having a nice meal...
I should have just left it at that.
I ended up saying something unnecessary.
Did he think it was weird？...
translations.今日のはデート……だよね。ちゃんと、デート、って言ったし。なのに、つまらないこと:
Today was a date... right？
I mean, I specifically said "date."
Yet I kept obsessing over silly things
and couldn't enjoy myself at all at first.
What am I doing？
I was looking forward to it so much, too.
translations.私、つまんなそうにしてるように見えたかも。思い切ってカレに聞いたおかげで少しはス:
I probably looked bored to him.
Taking the plunge and asking him cleared
the air a little, but...
I wonder if that gave away how I feel...
Then again, he seems pretty dense.
translations.でもやっぱり、誘ってよかった。一緒にデートしてよかった。おかげで少し、前に進める:
Still, I'm glad I invited him.
I'm glad we went on a date together.
Thanks to that, I can take a step forward.
I already... about him...
translations.はっきり言っちゃった。抱えてた不満、吐き出したおかげでスッキリしたけど……大人気:
I went and said it straight out.
Letting out all my bottled-up frustration
felt good, but... maybe it was childish.
Even though I'm older and his senpai.
translations.カレのすることぜんぶ、気になっちゃう。気持ちが落ち着かなくなって、不安で……特に:
Everything he does catches my attention.
It makes me restless and anxious...
especially whenever other girls are around.
I had no idea I was this jealous of a person...
translations.でも、もう迷わない。それが自分だってわかっちゃったから。すぐに不安になって、嫉妬:
But I won't waver anymore.
Because I realized that's just who I am.
Getting anxious so easily, getting jealous...
I realized I don't have to hate myself
for being weak like that.
I love him.
translations.少しストレート過ぎたかな。でもカレ、鈍いもんね。あれくらいハッキリ言わないと、私:
Maybe I was a bit too direct.
But he's so dense.
If I don't spell it out that clearly,
my feelings won't get through at all.
Though... he probably still doesn't get it.
translations.そんなところもカワイイんだけど、さすがに少しじれったいかな……。なんてね、だから:
That's part of what makes him cute,
but it really is a little frustrating...
Just kidding—if he actually noticed how
I felt right now, I'd probably panic.
When I try so hard to act like the cool,
composed older girl around him.
translations.カレが、好き。もう決めたから、カレに言いたい。告白したい。:
I love him.
I've made up my mind, so I want to tell him.
I want to confess.
translations.なにを気にしてたのかな、私。悩むことなんて、なにもなかったのに。はっきり言ってよ:
What was I even worrying about？
There was nothing to fret over at all.
I'm glad I told him straight.
I feel like that brought me closer
to him again.
translations.私がお姉さんなんだもん。カレのすることはなんでも受け入れて、なんでも許してあげて:
I'm the older girl, after all.
I'll accept everything he does, forgive
him for anything, and that way, maybe
I can make him fall in love with me, too...
translations.カレのこと、好き。それさえわかっちゃったら、もう他のことなんて、なにも考えなくて:
I love him.
Now that I know that much, I don't need
to overthink anything else.
All that's left is to brace myself...
and tell him.
translations.また残って仕事しちゃった。さすがにちょっと疲れたかも。でもその分お給料はもらえる:
I stayed late and worked overtime again.
I guess I am a little tired.
Still, I get paid for it, and it's
rewarding work, so I have to keep at it.
translations.それより、あの子、一人前に心配しちゃって。まだまだ自分の仕事で覚えなきゃいけない:
More importantly, that boy was worrying
about me like he's a full-fledged pro.
Even though he's still got plenty of work
to learn for himself.
Still, it made me happy...
Nobody else at Dixie's worries about me
like that...
translations.今度観に行く映画……内容はもうわかってるけど、楽しみだな。きっとあの子と観たら、:
The movie we're going to see next time...
I already know what happens,
but I'm still excited.
Watching it with him, we can get scared
together, talk about it afterward...
There's so much to look forward to.
translations.次のお出かけはもう、デートって言ってもいいよね。理由なんてなしに、純粋に二人で遊:
I guess I can call our next outing
a date, right？
There's no work excuse, we're just hanging
out, purely the two of us.
I wonder what kind of date it'll be...
Will this finally make my feelings clear？
translations.告白、しちゃった。カレに好きだって……。もう、どうしよう。頭の中ぐちゃぐちゃで、:
I confessed.
I told him I love him...
Oh gosh, what am I going to do？
My head is a total mess, should I really
even be writing in a diary right now？
translations.今日は朝からずっといろんなこと考えすぎて……カレの前でどんな顔してたのかな。そん:
I was overthinking so many things all day...
I wonder what kind of face I was making
in front of him.
I didn't have the luxury to think about
that then, but... looking back now,
it's so embarrassing.
translations.告白して、ＯＫもらったあとの今でも……さっきからずっと顔がにやけちゃったり、急に:
Even now, after confessing and hearing
him say yes... my face has been grinning
nonstop, and then suddenly I get anxious
and sad...
I might be like this for a while.
translations.明日朝になったら、どんな気持ちになるのかな。カレシがいる生活が始まるなんて、まだ:
I wonder how I'll feel
tomorrow morning？
I still can't quite imagine
life with a boyfriend.
Still, I know it's bound
to be so much fun.
So fun and so happy,
every day will be bliss...
I can just feel it.
translations.今日、眠れるかな。目を閉じたら、きっとまた思い出しちゃう。カレの顔、声、それから:
I wonder if I'll be able
to sleep tonight？
If I close my eyes,
I know I'll just remember
it all over again.
His face, his voice,
and the way he felt.
Our... kiss...
translations.最近、テニス部に仲のいい同級生がいるの？:
Have you been getting close
to a classmate in the
tennis club lately？
translations.▲高嶺＊＊▲のことかな。:
I wonder if she
means ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
translations.最近、図書委員に仲のいい後輩がいるの？:
Have you been getting close
to an underclassman on the
library committee lately？
translations.▲小早川＊▲のことかな。:
I wonder if she
means ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ほんとなんだ。やるー。: So it's true. Look at you~
translations.やるーって……なにが？:
'Look at me'？ What's that
supposed to mean？
translations.え、モテてるってことじゃないの？ ……違うの？:
Well, doesn't that mean you're
popular？ ...Am I wrong？
translations.テニス部の同級生とは、なにか進展した？:
Made any progress with
that classmate from the
tennis club？
translations.図書委員の後輩とは、なにか進展した？:
Made any progress with
your underclassman on the
library committee？
translations.ほらほら、どうなの？:
Come on, spill！
How is it going？
translations.進展って別に……そういうのじゃないけど。:
'Progress'？ It's not really
like that, though.
translations.えー、そうなの？ うーん、はっきりしないなあ。:
Aw, really？ Hmm, you're
being awfully vague.
translations.学校の校舎裏に来てください\nネネ:
Please come behind the
school building.
Nene
translations.どうしたの、急に。しかも学校でって。:
What's up, all of a sudden？
And why at school？
translations.うん、実はどこでもよかったんだけど……。なんとなく、気分を変えたくて。:
Yeah, anywhere would've been
fine, really... I just wanted
a change of pace, I guess.
translations.あなたと会ったとき、最初は少し頼りないかな、って思ってたの。:
When we first met, I kinda
thought you were a little
unreliable.
translations.ふふ。でも、成長してくれたよね。仕事も、それ以外でも。:
Fufu. But you've really
grown. At work, and in
other ways too.
translations.うん。私のこと気遣ってくれたり。たまに、私よりも年上みたいな、そんな感じもして…:
Yeah. Like looking out for
me. Sometimes you even felt
older than me, you know...？
translations.あ、違うの。お礼が言いたくて。:
Ah, no, that's not it.
I wanted to thank you.
translations.言ったでしょ。そんなに私は人から頼られるような人間じゃないって。:
I told you, didn't I？
I'm really not someone
people should rely on so much.
translations.無理しなくていいって言ってくれて、うれしかった。:
When you told me I didn't
have to push myself,
it made me really happy.
translations.あなたみたいな後輩ができて、本当によかった。:
I'm so glad I got a junior
like you.
translations.これからも、可愛くて……たまに頼りになる後輩でいてほしいな。:
I hope you'll always be my
cute, sometimes-dependable
junior.
translations.もちろん。●でよければだけど。:
Of course. If you're happy
with ●, that is.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に告白されたときのこと、思い出すな……）:
(Takes me back to when
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ confessed to me...)
translations.こら、あなたには可愛いカノジョがいるでしょ。めっ！:
Hey now, you already have
a cute girlfriend, don't you？
Bad boy！
translations.あれ……なんだ、夢か……。:
Huh...？ What, it was
just a dream...？
translations.（こんな夢見るなんて……カノジョに申し訳ないな）:
(Having a dream like that...
I feel so bad for
my girlfriend.)
translations.ねえ、私……少し雰囲気変わったと思わない、かな。:
Hey... don't you think
my vibe is a little
different, maybe？
translations.外見じゃなくて、内面のことなんだけど……。:
Not on the outside,
on the inside, I mean...
translations.内面……そういえば、なんか大人しいな。:
The inside... Come to think
of it, you do seem quieter.
translations.そうなの。落ち着いた感じを意識しようかなって。:
Right. I thought I'd
try to be a little more
calm and composed.
translations.たしかに……でもなんで急に。:
True... But why all
of a sudden？
translations.どうしてかな。あなたがその方が喜ぶ気がしたの。:
I wonder. I just had a feeling
you'd like me better
that way.
translations.（落ち着いた▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……やっぱりいいかもな）:
(A calm ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
That might actually be nice.)
translations.ほら。私、印象変わった感じするでしょ。:
See？ Don't you think
I give off a different
impression？
translations.えっ……うーん……そうかな？:
Huh... Hmm...
Do you think so？
translations.わからないの？ もう！ 見た目のことじゃないよ？:
You can't tell？ Jeez！
I'm not talking about
my looks, you know？
translations.えっと……なんか、押しが強い感じするね。:
Well... you do seem
a bit more assertive, I guess.
translations.ふふ、そうなの。これからは少し強気でいこうかなって。:
Fufu, that's right. I figured
I'd try being a little
bolder from now on.
translations.強気か……たしかにそんな感じかも。でもなんで？:
Bolder, huh... Yeah, maybe so.
But why？
translations.え？ うーん、あなたがそっちの方が好きなのかなって思って。:
Eh？ Well, I just thought
you might like that
better.
translations.（強気な▲姉ヶ崎＊▲か……いいかも）:
(A bolder ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh...
Might not be bad.)
translations.あのね、私、印象違って見えないかな。:
Hey, don't you think
I seem a little different？
translations.わからないんだ。しょうがないなあ、もう。よしよし。:
You really can't tell？
Jeez, what am I going to do
with you. There, there.
translations.こんなお姉さん、イヤ？:
Don't like this kind
of big sister？
translations.イヤじゃないけど。なんで急に？:
Not that I don't, but...
Why all of a sudden？
translations.こんな明るいお姉さんが、あなたは好きな気がしたから。:
Because I felt like you'd
like a cheerful big sister
like this.
translations.（明るい▲姉ヶ崎＊▲か……いいかもな）:
(A cheerful ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh...
Might be nice.)
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。ウイニングバーガーってよく行く？:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Do you go
to Winning Burger often？
translations.そうね、よく行くよ。学校帰りとか。:
Yeah, pretty often.
Like on the way home
from school.
translations.だよな、それが普通だよな。:
Right？ That's pretty
normal, I guess.
translations.普通かどうかわからないけど……どうして？:
I don't know about normal,
but... why do you ask？
translations.うちの学校で入ったことがない奴って、いるのかなって。:
I just wondered if there's
anyone at our school who's
never been there.
translations.んー、それはさすがに珍しいかもね。:
Hmm, that really would
be pretty rare, I guess.
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。とわのウォッチャーって知ってるよな。:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You know
Towano Watcher, right？
translations.うん、もちろん。たまにチェックするよ。:
Yeah, of course.
I check it sometimes.
translations.そっか。あまり遊びなれてない人間が、雑誌だけを頼りに他人を遊びに連れて行くのって:
I see. What do you think
about someone who doesn't go
out much...
taking someone else out
based solely on a magazine？
translations.そうね……本で読むだけじゃわからないことってあるし。:
Well... there are definitely
things you can't learn just
from reading a magazine.
translations.他に誰か引っ張ってくれる人がいればいいと思うけど。:
I think it'd be fine if there
was someone else along to
take the lead, though.
translations.（そうだよな……▲高嶺＊＊▲、大丈夫かな）:
(Yeah, true... I wonder if
▲高嶺＊＊▲ will be okay.)
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。デートの付き添いのための練習に行く、ってどう思う？:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What do you
think about going to practice
chaperoning a date？
translations.やっぱりそういう反応だよな。:
I figured that's how
you'd react.
translations.つまり……デートなのよね？:
So basically...
it's a date, right？
translations.あ、デートに誘われたんだ。ひゅーひゅー！:
Ooh, someone asked you out!
Woo-woo~!
translations.（▲高嶺＊＊▲のアレはデートなのかな……断らないほうがよかったかな）:
(Was that thing with ▲高嶺＊＊▲
a date？ Maybe I shouldn't
have turned her down...)
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は夜の繁華街って行ったりする？:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Do you ever hang out
downtown at night, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そんなことないよ。もう、人をなんだと思ってるの。:
Of course not! Geez,
what kind of person do you
think I am？
translations.うちの後輩を見かけて、ちょっと気になって。:
I saw an underclassman there,
so I was kind of worried.
translations.そっか、危ないんじゃないのかな。:
I see. That sounds pretty
dangerous, doesn't it？
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。学校に放課後私服で来るって、どういうことかな。:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Why would someone show up
at school in casual clothes？
translations.え、あまり見たことないけど……。どうしたの？:
Huh, you don't see that
very often... What's up？
translations.うーん、そうね……。家でなにかあったのかな。:
Hmm, yeah... Maybe something
happened at home？
translations.話聞いてあげたらどうかな。:
Maybe you should try
talking to them？
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は深夜のコンビニって行く？:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Do you ever go to convenience
stores late at night, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.後輩をよく見かけるから、気になるんだよな。:
I keep seeing an underclassman
there, so I'm kind of worried.
translations.それは、危ないよ。なにか事情があるのかもしれないけど……。:
That really is dangerous.
They might have their reasons,
though...
translations.なにかあったんなら、話してみて？:
If something's on your mind,
you can talk to me, okay？
translations.そういうわけじゃないんだけど……あのさ。:
It's not really that, but...
listen.
translations.いいよ……うん。私は、あなたのカノジョだよ。:
It's okay... Yeah.
I'm your girlfriend.
translations.なんか、いろいろ思い出しててさ。:
I was just thinking back on
all kinds of stuff.
translations.●たちのこと。出会って、付き合うまでもいろいろあったなー、とか。:
About ● and me.
Like how a lot happened between
when we met and started dating.
translations.わかるな……そういうの。:
I get that...
