rely on me, right？
translations.なんとなく思っただけ。今は大丈夫？:
Just had a feeling.
Are you doing okay for now？
translations.そっか、ありがと。今は大丈夫。:
I see, thanks.
I'm fine for now.
translations.カワイイ後輩だもんね。守ってあげなきゃ。:
You're my cute junior,
after all. I've gotta
look out for you.
translations.（そんな風に思ってくれてたのか）:
(So that's how she thinks
of me.)
translations.ねえ、無理してたりしない？:
Hey, you aren't pushing
yourself too hard, are you？
translations.カノジョいい子だけど、付き合ってればいろいろストレスとかもあるんじゃないかなって:
She's a sweet girl, but
dating can come with all
kinds of stress, you know？
translations.なるほど。まあ、●に限っては大丈夫かな！:
I see. Well, as far as
● goes,
I think I'm totally fine!
translations.もう、調子のっちゃって。:
Geez, look at you getting
all full of yourself.
translations.（別に無理はしてないよな）:
(It's not like I'm
pushing myself, anyway.)
translations.ねえねえ、最近カノジョとはいかがですか？:
Hey, hey, how are things
going with your girlfriend
lately？
translations.いかがって……なにが？:
How are they...？
What do you mean？
translations.それはもう色々と……。:
Oh, you know...
all kinds of things...
translations.ここに２人で\n泊まるんだよな。:
So the two of us are
staying here together, huh.
translations.私たち、\nホテルの人にほんとの\n夫婦って思われてるかな。:
I wonder if the hotel staff
think we're a real
married couple？
translations.どうかな。\nラブラブっぷりじゃ、本物に\n負けてないと思うけど。:
Who knows？ But with how
lovey-dovey we are, I bet
we rival the real deal.
translations.じゃあ、\n今日も見せつけちゃお？:
Then why don't we
show off today, too？
translations.私がチェックインするから、\nあなたはゆっくりしてて。:
I'll handle check-in,
so just relax, okay？
translations.荷物部屋まで持っていくよ。:
I'll carry our bags
up to the room.
translations.ふふ、\n私あなたの奥様に見えるかな？:
Hehe, do I look like
your wife？
translations.台帳の名前、\nあなたの苗字にしちゃった▼:
I signed the register
with your last name▼
translations.どっち？\n二人が泊まる部屋でしょ？:
What do you mean, whose？
It's the room for both of us,
of course？
translations.だって……せっかく一緒の\n旅行なのに別々なんて、\nそんなの。ヤだよ。:
I mean... we came all this
way on a trip together.
Being apart？ No way.
translations.ふふ、どうして部屋に\n入るたびに緊張するの？:
Hehe, why do you get
so nervous every time
we go into a room？
translations.そんなだと、\n私が緊張する\n暇がないんだよね。:
When you're like that,
I don't even have time
to get nervous myself.
translations.私だって\nドキドキしてるのに。\nそれに気付かないぐらいに、\n硬くなってるん:
My heart is pounding too,
you know. But you're so
stiff, you haven't even
noticed.
translations.責めてるんじゃないよ。\nそういうとこも、\nカワイくて好き。:
I'm not blaming you.
That's part of what makes
you so cute, and I love it.
translations.おっ、そろそろバイキングが\nはじまっている時間だな。:
Oh, the buffet should be
starting around now.
translations.おなか減っちゃった。\nうーん、たくさん\n食べちゃいそう……。:
I'm so hungry.
Mmm, I might end up
eating a ton……
translations.新鮮な海の幸が\nもりだくさん、だって。:
Apparently they have a ton
of fresh seafood.
translations.ふふ。食べたいものあったら\n取ってきてあげるから\n言ってね。:
Hehe. If there's anything
you want, let me know and
I'll go get it for you.
translations.うん、そこでね。\nおじ様からいい話を\n聞いたの。:
Yeah, just over there.
An older gentleman told me
a really nice story.
translations.熱海港から船で初島っていう\n島に行けるのね。:
You can take a boat from
Atami Port to an island
called Hatsushima.
translations.そこには誰も\n辿り着いたことがない\nビーチがあるんだって。:
Apparently, there's a
beach there that nobody has
ever reached.
translations.でね、そこで愛を\n誓い合った二人は永遠に\n幸せになれるんだって。:
And if two people pledge
their love there, they'll be
happy forever.
translations.（どこかで\n聞いたような話だな……）:
(I feel like I've heard
that somewhere before……)
translations.おっけー。\nじゃあ明日は\n伝説のビーチ探しだ。:
Okay.
Then tomorrow we'll search
for the legendary beach.
translations.ダンディでステキな\nおじ様だったよ？:
He was a very dapper,
charming gentleman, you know？
translations.ねえ、またあそこに\n行くのは、どうかな？:
Hey, how about we go
back there again？
translations.あそこって……\n例のビーチ？:
Back there... you mean
that beach？
translations.そう、あのときの\n思い出の場所……。:
Yeah. That place full of
memories for us……
translations.そうだな、\nまた探してみるか……。:
Yeah, guess we can go
look for it again……
translations.貸切風呂よりも、\n露天風呂にいかない？:
Instead of the private bath,
why don't we go to the
open-air bath？
translations.貸切風呂よりも、\n露天風呂にいってみない？:
Instead of the private bath,
want to try the open-air
bath？
translations.（これが、布団だったら、\nくっつけちゃったりして……）:
(If these were futons, we
could push them together
and……)
translations.お布団でも、\n良かったのにね……。:
Futons would have been
nice, too……
translations.思うよ？\nお布団なら、二つ並べて、\nほら……ねぇ？:
I do？
With futons, we could
push them together,
and... you know？
translations.そ、そうだよね！\nでも、そう言う事なら、\n少し狭いけどベッドでも――:
R-Right!
Though if that's what
you mean, even in a bed,
it'd be tight, but—
translations.無理よ。\n落っこちちゃうもん。\nベッドでゴロゴロ転がったら。:
No way.
We'd fall right off
if we went rolling around
on the bed.
translations.ゴロゴロ……\nああ、そっち？:
Rolling around...
Oh, that's what you meant？
translations.……ん？\nん～～？\nどっちだと思ったの？:
...Hm？
Hmm~~？
What did you think
I meant？
translations.え？\nう～ん、どうしようかな……。\n言っちゃおうかな。\n……聞きたい？:
Huh？
Hmm, what should I do...
Should I just tell you？
...Wanna hear it？
translations.そこまで言われると気になるよ。:
Now that you say that,
I'm really curious.
translations.あのね、湘南の江の島って\nあるでしょ？\n行ってみたいと思わない？:
So, you know Enoshima
over in Shonan, right？
Don't you want to go？
translations.そう。\n日帰り出来るし、美味しいものも\n色々あるみたいだし、\nそれにほら、:
Yeah.
We could do a day trip,
and there's lots of good
food to try!
Plus, don't you think a date
in Shonan sounds romantic？
translations.どうして！\n江の島には弁天様がいるんだよ？:
Wait, why？！
Enoshima has Benten-sama,
you know？
translations.もうっ！\n弁天様は、カップルで\nお参りしちゃいけないの。\n嫉妬して、\n別:
Geez!
Couples aren't supposed
to visit Benten-sama!
She gets jealous and makes
them break up!
translations.お母さんにその事、\n相談したらね、\nあ、そんな迷信信じるなんて、\n自信無い:
When I talked to my mom
about it, she said:
'Oh, believing a superstition
like that just means you
lack confidence.'
What do you think？
translations.自信って、●と▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が、\nその……。:
Confidence, as in...
● and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
well...
translations.うん。\nだから、ちゃんと\n愛し合ってるっていうか……。:
Yeah.
Like, whether we really
love each other, or...
translations.悔しいでしょ？\nそんなこと言われるの。\n自信、あるもんね？:
Isn't it frustrating,
hearing her say that？
We've got confidence, right？
translations.よし……。\nやっぱり行こう。\n江の島。\n行って証明しよう。:
All right...
Let's go after all.
To Enoshima.
Let's go and prove it!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……\nなんか今日はいつもより\nちょっと……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
You're looking a little...
extra special today.
translations.うん。\n気合い入っちゃった。\nだって、弁天様と会うんだもん。:
Yup.
I really went all out!
After all, I'm meeting
Benten-sama.
translations.そっか。\n……あれ？\nでも、可愛い方が、\n嫉妬されるんじゃないかな……。:
I see.
...Wait.
Won't being cuter just make
her even more jealous...？
translations.そうかもしれないけど、\nちゃんとしておきたいじゃない？\n勝負なんだから。\n:
Maybe, but I want to look
my best, you know？
It's a showdown!
Ah...
Don't tell me you're not
confident？
translations.ねぇねぇ、さっき、\nいつもより可愛いって言った？:
Hey, hey... Did you just say
I was cuter than usual？
translations.（……複雑な乙女ゴコロ？）:
(...A girl's heart is a
complicated thing？)
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！\nもう来てたの？:
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
Are you here already？
translations.ちょっと、ね、\n早く来ちゃった。:
Just a bit, yeah.
I got here early.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……\n今日はいつもより\nちょっと……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Today you're looking
a little extra...
translations.よろしい。\n弁天様に会うんだもん。\nなんていうかな……。\n手は抜けないの。:
Very good.
I'm meeting Benten-sama,
after all.
How should I put it...
I can't slack off.
Especially woman to woman.
translations.それは、まあ、\n初めて行くんだもん、江の島。\nそれに、ほら……。:
Well, yeah!
It's my first time going
to Enoshima, after all.
Besides, you know...
translations.江ノ電って、乗ってみたかったの。\n普通の電車より、\nデートですって感じがしな:
I've always wanted to ride
the Enoden.
Doesn't it feel way more
like an actual date than
a regular train？
translations.でしょ？\nせっかく来たんだから、\nちゃんと楽しまなきゃ。\nふふっ♪:
Right？
We came all this way,
so we've got to enjoy every
minute of it.
Hehe♪
translations.あ……。\nねぇ、見た？\n今停まってた電車！:
Ah...
Hey, did you see that？
The train that was just
stopped there!
translations.昔の電車みたいで、\nすごく可愛いかった……。\n色んな電車があるよね、\n江ノ:
It looked vintage,
it was so cute...
The Enoden has so many
different trains, huh？
translations.そっかそっか……。\nじゃあ、\n何度も江の島に来れば、\nいつか全部に乗れるか:
Right, right...
Then if we come to Enoshima
a whole bunch, maybe we can
ride every one eventually.
translations.全部か……。\n何回来ればいいのかな？:
Every one, huh...？
Wonder how many trips
that would take.
translations.何回も来ればいいでしょ？\nふふっ！:
We'll just come as many
times as it takes, right？
Hehe!
translations.はぁ、着いた～\nここが江の島かぁ……。:
Phew, we're here~
So this is Enoshima...
translations.う～ん！\n観光地っぽくて、ワクワクする！:
Mmm!
It feels just like a resort,
I'm so excited!
translations.電車のあっち側の窓から、\n海が見えたから、\nあっち。:
I saw the ocean from the
window on that side of the
train, so over that way.
translations.そっか、太平洋だもんね！\nそっかそっか……。:
Right, the Pacific Ocean!
Right, right...
translations.さすが、男の子。\nこういう時、頼りになるね？\nね、早く行こう！:
Spoken like a true guy.
You're so reliable at times
like this!
Come on, let's hurry!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nちゃんと楽しんでるみたいだな）:
(Looks like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
really having a good time.)
translations.海が南だから、\n江の島はあっち！\nね？:
The sea is south,
so Enoshima is that way!
Right？
translations.そりゃあ、もう。\n江の島ですもの？\nね、早く行こう？:
Well of course!
It's Enoshima, after all!
Come on, let's hurry!
translations.あ、あれ？\nあれだよね！:
Ah, is that...？
That's it, right？
translations.こんなに近くに見えるんだ……。:
It looks so close from
here...
translations.うん。\nよく見える……。:
Yeah.
We can see it so clearly...
translations.すごい……。\nなんだか本当に、\n弁天様に会っちゃいそうな\n気がしてきた……:
Incredible...
I really feel like we might
run into Benten-sama at this
rate...
translations.かもね。\nちょっとワクワクするな！:
Maybe so.
I'm getting kind of excited!
translations.ムッ……。\nそんな観光気分で、大丈夫？\nデートはデートだけど、\n勝負でもあ:
Hmph...
Are you sure you should be
in tourist mode？
Sure, it's a date, but it's
a showdown too, you know？
translations.今日もよく晴れたな……。\n島がよく見える。:
Another clear day today...
We can see the island really
well.
translations.すごく近くにみえて、\n声が届きそう。\nおーい、江の島ー！:
It looks so close,
like my voice could reach!
Heeey, Enoshimaaa!
translations.ちょ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nはしゃぎすぎだよ！:
Whoa, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
don't get too carried away!
translations.いいんです。\nほら、あなたも\nはしゃいではしゃいで！:
I don't care!
Come on, you get hyped up
too, let loose!
translations.ねぇねぇ、\nそろそろお腹すいたんじゃない？:
Hey, hey,
aren't you getting hungry
by now？
translations.実はさっきから、\n腹ペコで……。:
To be honest, I've been
starving for a while...
translations.お弁当、持って来たよ？:
I brought a boxed lunch,
you know？
translations.江の島名物でもいいかなって\n思ったんだけど、\nやっぱり、カノジョとしては、\:
I thought local Enoshima
specialties might be nice,
but as your girlfriend,
I just couldn't compromise.
Wanna eat？
translations.よろしい。\nふふっ！\nじゃあ、どこかお弁当\n食べるとこ探して？:
Good answer.
Hehe!
Now, why don't you find us
a spot to eat lunch？
translations.さてと。\nまずは、どこ行くかな……。:
Alright.
Where should we go first...？
translations.そっか。\nうん、それがいいかも。:
I see.
Yeah, that sounds good.
translations.ふふっ、お粗末さま。\nやっぱり、江の島名物の前に\n食べてもらった方が、\n評:
Hehe, you're welcome.
After all, you'd rate it
higher if you ate mine before
the Enoshima snacks, right？
translations.そういう意味だったのか。\nさてと、\n昼も食べたことだし、次は……。:
So that was your plan...
Well, now that we've eaten,
where to next...？
translations.せっかくだから、このまま\nサムエル・コッキング苑、\n行かない？:
Since we're already here,
wanna head over to the
Samuel Cocking Garden？
translations.さてと、\nそろそろあそこかな……。:
Alright...
Guess it's about time
for that place...
translations.▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲、\n行くでしょ？:
We're going to ▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲,
right？
translations.うん、そこは押さえときたいよね？:
Yeah, definitely don't want
to miss that one, right？
translations.次はやっぱり、あそこかな……。:
Next up has gotta be
that place, huh...
translations.ねぇ、江の島って、\n普通に住んでる人もいるよね？:
Hey, people actually live
on Enoshima, right？
translations.うん、\n普通の家もけっこうあるね。:
Yeah, there are quite
a few regular houses here.
translations.もし、弁天様がカップルを\n別れさせちゃうとしたらよ？\n恋人同士とか夫婦はどう:
If Benten-sama really broke
couples up, though...
what would the lovers and
married couples here do？
translations.そうか……。\nじゃあ、やっぱり\nただの迷信なんだ。:
Oh, right...
Then I guess it really is
just a superstition.
translations.だよね、やっぱり。\nそっか、そっか……あ。:
Right？ Thought so.
I see, I see... Ah.
translations.でも、もしかしたら、\nみんな独身か恋人無しって\n可能性も、ある？:
Wait, could it be that
everyone here is single or
doesn't have a partner？
translations.うん。\n謎は深まるばかりだもん。\n弁天様と縁結び……。:
Yeah.
The mystery just deepens.
Benten-sama and matchmaking...
translations.弁天様が嫉妬してっていうのは、\nやっぱり、迷信なんじゃない？:
Isn't that whole 'Benten-sama
getting jealous' thing just
a superstition, after all？
translations.そんな気もしてきた。\nでも……。\nねぇ、気がついた？:
I was starting to think so.
But...
Hey, did you notice？
translations.あのお宮にはね、\n天女と龍の伝説っていうのが、\nあるんだって。:
Apparently, that shrine has
a legend about a celestial
maiden and a dragon.
translations.天女と龍か……。\nそれがどうしたの？:
A maiden and a dragon...
What about them？
translations.うん。\n天女と弁天様って、同じ？:
Yeah.
Are the celestial maiden
and Benten-sama the same？
translations.じゃあ、江島神社の\n３人の女神っていうのは？:
Then what about the three
goddesses of Enoshima Shrine？
translations.なんにしろ、\n女神様がたくさんいるのよ、\n江の島には。\nうん、まだ油断でき:
Either way, there are a lot
of goddesses on Enoshima.
Yep, we can't let our guard
down just yet.
translations.（大変なことに\nなって来たな……）:
(This is getting pretty
out of hand...)
translations.ハァ……。\n結構階段があるね……。:
*Phew*...
There sure are a lot
of stairs...
translations.下から頂上まで、\n結構あるからね。:
Yeah, it's quite a ways
from the bottom to the top.
translations.エスカーって、あったね。\nあれで登ったら、\nすぐなのかな？:
There was that 'Escar,'
right？ I wonder if taking that
would get us up in no time？
translations.エスカレーターでしょ？\n乗ってみる？:
It's an escalator, right？
Want to ride it？
translations.だって、\nなんだか負けた気がしない？\n女神様達に。:
I mean, wouldn't it feel
like we lost somehow？
To the goddesses, I mean.
translations.そういうもんなの。\nほら、がんばって！:
That's just how it is.
Come on, hang in there!
translations.（もう弁天様は\n関係無くなってるような……）:
(Pretty sure Benten-sama has
nothing to do with this now...)
translations.もしかして、\n弁天様と伝説の天女様は、\n同じなんじゃないかな。:
Could Benzaiten
and the heavenly maiden
from the legend...
be the same person？
translations.いい？\n伝説では、龍は天女様に恋をして\n二人は結婚するでしょ？\nでも、弁天:
Listen.
In the legend, the dragon
falls for the maiden
and they get married, right？
If Benzaiten interfered,
they would've broken up
way before that, right？
translations.ね？\nと、言うことは、弁天様と\n天女様は同一人物なのよ、\nあんなに優しそう:
See？
Which means Benzaiten
and the maiden are
the exact same person!
She looked so gentle, too,
so I'm sure of it.
translations.そう！\n実は濡れ衣なのでした！\nすごい、寧々ちゃん、\n江の島伝説解明！:
Yep!
She was falsely accused!
Way to go, Nene-chan!
Enoshima legend solved!
translations.でも、弁天様を疑って\n悪いことしちゃったね？\n帰りに、謝ろうね？\nふふっ！:
Still, it was bad of us
to doubt her, huh？
Let's apologize to her
on the way back, okay？
Hehe!
translations.う～ん……\n今日も海がきれい。\n潮風が気持ちいい！:
Mmm...
The ocean is so pretty today.
The sea breeze feels great!
translations.この道って、\nときどき、海が見えるじゃない？\nあぁ、いま島にいるんだって、\:
Along this path,
you can catch glimpses
of the ocean, right？
Doesn't it really feel
like being on an island？
translations.そうだね。\n遠くまで良く見えるし。:
Yeah.
You can see really far out.
translations.お天気もいいしね？\n湘南でデートって感じが……\nあ、そうだ。\nねぇねぇ。:
And the weather's nice, too？
It feels like a Shonan date...
Oh, right!
Hey, hey.
translations.また、湘南の男の子っぽいこと\n言って？:
Say something like a cool
Shonan guy again？
translations.うん。\nいい感じ！\nお土産物屋さんいっぱい。\n美味しそうな匂いもするし。:
Yeah.
It feels so lively!
Lots of souvenir shops.
And it smells delicious, too.
translations.色々売ってるな。: They sell all kinds of stuff.
translations.サザエの壺焼き、ハマグリ……\nシラスも有名でしょ？\nあ、丸焼きたこせんべいだ:
Grilled turban shell, clams...
Shirasu is famous here, too.
Oh, whole-grilled octopus
rice crackers!
translations.なんか、食べてみる？: Wanna grab a bite of something？
translations.そう！\nここで買い食いなんてしたら、\n鳥居の向こうの弁天様に\n見られちゃう:
Right!
If we eat snacks out here,
Benzaiten past the torii
gate might see us,
you know？
translations.その油断が、危ないの。\nだから、お昼までは見るだけ。\nわかった？:
Letting your guard down
is dangerous!
So just looking until lunch.
Got it？
translations.うん、弁天様のお宮。\nとうとう来ちゃった……。:
Yeah, Benzaiten's shrine.
We're finally here...
translations.自信、あるもんね？\n私たち……。:
We've got confidence,
right？ You and me...
translations.ハァ……。\nなんだか拍子抜け\nしちゃった……。\n弁天様、思ってたより、\n:
*sigh*...
That was kind of
an anticlimax...
Benzaiten looked way
gentler than I expected,
don't you think？
translations.もっと怖いと思ってた？:
Did you expect her
to be scarier？
translations.だって……。\nそれにね、この江島神社は、\n縁結びの御利益があるんだって。:
Well...
And besides, they say this
shrine actually blesses couples
with good matchmaking.
translations.うん。\nピンク色の絵馬がいっぱいある。\nカップルのだよな。:
Yeah.
Tons of pink ema plaques.
They're from couples, right？
translations.稚児ヶ淵か……。\nすごい景色だな……。:
Chigogafuchi, huh...
What an incredible view...
translations.ホント、すごい景色……。\n映画でドラゴンが暴れる\n場所みたい。:
It really is...
It looks like somewhere
a dragon would rampage
in a movie.
translations.神秘的な感じがする。\n龍神様が\n住んでるんだもんね……。\nあれ？:
It feels so mystical.
A dragon god lives here,
after all...
Wait, huh？
translations.龍神様と、あの伝説の\n五つの頭の龍って、同じ？:
Are the Dragon God
and that five-headed
dragon from the legend
the same？
translations.どうだろう……。\n龍神様の頭は一つみたい\nだったけど。:
I wonder...
Though it looked like
the Dragon God only had
one head.
translations.同じだとすると、\nやっぱり天女様も\nここで一緒に暮したのかな？:
If they're the same,
do you think the maiden
lived here with him too？
translations.そっか……。\nじゃあ、ここは二人の愛の巣\nだったかもしれないんだ。:
I see...
Then this place might have
been their love nest.
translations.そうしよう？\nだって、そう考えると、\nちょっとロマンチックな\n場所じゃない:
Let's go with that, okay？
I mean, doesn't thinking
of it like that make it
a romantic spot？
Right？
translations.う～ん、いい匂い！\nね、なに食べる？:
Mmm, smells so good!
Hey, what should we eat？
translations.今日はいいの？\n弁天様が見てるんじゃ……。:
Is it okay today？
Won't Benten-sama
be watching...？
translations.いいの。\nだって、もうお友達だから。\nふふっ！:
It's fine.
We're friends now, after all.
Hehe！
translations.ねぇ、サザエの苦いところ、\n食べられるっけ？:
Hey, can you eat
the bitter part
of a turban shell？
translations.私ね、白いところは\n好きなんだけど……。\n食べてくれる、苦いところ？:
See, I love the white part,
but...
Will you eat the bitter part
for me？
translations.見てほら、\nしらすのアイスだって！\n冒険するなぁ……どうする？:
Look, look!
Whitebait ice cream!
Talk about adventurous...
What should we do？
translations.そうだ、あさひ本店の\n丸焼きたこせんべいも\n食べなくちゃ！\nほら、行こう！:
Oh, we also have to try
the whole-grilled octopus
cracker from Asahi Honten!
Come on, let's go！
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nお腹壊さないといいけど……）:
(I just hope ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ doesn't
upset her stomach...)
translations.ねぇ、弁天様に、\nご挨拶して行くでしょ？:
Hey, we're going to pay
our respects to Benten-sama,
right？
translations.前はあんなに疑っちゃって、\n悪いことしちゃったね。\nもう、許してくれたよね？:
We doubted her so much
before, that was awful of us.
She's forgiven us by now,
right？
translations.大丈夫だよ。\n優しい弁天様だもんな。:
It'll be fine.
She's a kind goddess,
after all.
translations.ひとりで行ってくる。\nあなたは、そこに居て。:
I'll go by myself.
You stay right there.
translations.（ヤキモチ妬くのは、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の方だな……）:
(Turns out ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is
the jealous one...)
translations.稚児ヶ淵か……。\nいつ来てもすごい景色だな……。:
Chigogafuchi, huh...
No matter when you come,
it's an incredible view...
translations.行こう、龍神様にご挨拶。:
Let's go greet
the Dragon God.
translations.ねぇねぇ、\n私ね、ここに来るとどうしても\n気になることがあるの……。:
Hey, hey...
Whenever I come here,
there's something that always
bugs me...
translations.フナムシの説明、あるでしょ？\nそこにね、\n“非常にまずい”って\n書いてある:
There's an info sign about
sea roaches, right？
Well, on it, it says
"extremely bad-tasting"...
translations.誰か、食べたのかな？\nフナムシ……。:
Did someone actually eat one？
A sea roach...？
translations.家族がいっぱい。\nやっぱり、江の島に来たら、\n寄るところなんだね。\nサムエ:
So many families.
The Samuel Cocking Garden
really is a must-visit
when you come to Enoshima.
translations.江の島のてっぺんだもんな。:
It is the very top of
Enoshima, after all.
translations.ねぇ、灯台、登るでしょ？\n行こう？:
Hey, we're going up the
lighthouse, right？ Let's go！
translations.すごーい……。\n遠くまでよく見える！:
Incredible...
You can see so far！
translations.本当。\n潮風もすごい！\nでも楽しい！\nふふっ！:
It really is.
The sea breeze is strong, too!
But it's so much fun!
Hehe！
translations.今、ちょっとカッコ良かったよ？\n湘南の男の子って感じだった。:
You looked kinda cool
just now, you know？
Like a real Shonan boy.
translations.そっか、龍だもんね……。\nでも、頭は一つよね？:
Right, it's a dragon...
Wait, doesn't it only
have one head？
translations.伝説の龍は、頭が五つだもんね。\nやっぱり別の龍なのかな……。:
The legendary dragon has
five heads, after all.
Maybe it's a
different one...？
translations.どういうことなのか、\nどこかに書いてあるかも\nしれないよ？:
Maybe there's a sign
somewhere that explains it？
translations.もう、\nそれじゃ面白くないじゃない。\nロマンが無いなぁ。:
Aw,
where's the fun in that？
You've got no sense
of romance.
translations.うん……。\n眺めはいいんだけどね。:
Yeah...
The view is great, though.
translations.それに、ここまで来ないと\n江の島に来たって\n言えない感じがする……。:
Besides, it feels like
you haven't really been to
Enoshima unless you come
all the way up here...
translations.なんか、わかる気がする……。:
Yeah, I think I know
what you mean...
translations.ふふっ、\nじゃあ、しょうがないね？:
Hehe,
then it couldn't be
helped, right？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nねぇねぇ、この辺、\n写真撮るのにいいんじゃない？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Hey, wouldn't this be
a great spot for a photo？
translations.そうだな、よし、撮ろうか？:
Yeah. Alright,
shall we take one？
translations.ねぇ、ここで写真撮ったら、\nいいんじゃない？:
Hey, wouldn't it be nice
to take a photo here？
translations.撮ろう、江の島の思い出。:
Let's get a photo
for our Enoshima memories.
translations.ねぇ、ここで写真、撮って？\n今日の夕焼け、撮っておきたい。:
Hey, could you take a photo？
I really want a shot
of today's sunset.
translations.わからないけど、\n太陽の位置とレンズの屈折で、\n光のイタズラだろうな……。:
Not sure, but between
the sun's angle and lens
refraction, it's probably
just a trick of the light...
translations.そっか、イタズラか……。: A trick of the light, huh...
translations.ねぇ、でもこうしない？:
Hey, how about we look at
it this way instead？
translations.これは、弁天様でもある天女様が\n私たちと仲直りのしるしに、\nプレゼントしてく:
This is a celestial robe
gifted by the maiden—
Lady Benten herself—
to make peace with us.
Right？
translations.それが、私たちの江の島の伝説。\nありがとう、弁天様。:
That'll be our very own
Enoshima legend.
Thank you, Lady Benten.
translations.どうしたの？\nあ、もしかして……。:
What's wrong？
Oh, could it be...？
translations.わぁ……。\nすご～い！！\nまたプレゼントしてくれたんだ！\nきれい……。:
Whoa...
Amazing!!
She gave us another gift!
It's so pretty...
translations.うん、\n本当の天女様みたいだ……。:
Yeah,
you look just like a real
heavenly maiden...
translations.え、きれいって言ったのは、\nそうじゃなくて、\nほら、羽衣が……。:
Wait, when I said pretty,
I didn't mean—
I was talking about
the robe...
translations.でも、うれしい……。\nありがとう。:
Still, that makes me happy...
Thank you.
translations.さてと……\nそろそろ日が傾くな。:
Well then...
The sun's starting to
go down soon.
translations.うん……。\nハァ～\nやっと謎が解明したのに、残念。:
Yeah...
*sigh*
Just when we finally
solved the mystery, too.
What a shame.
translations.どこか今から寄れるところ、\nあるかな？:
Is there anywhere else
we can swing by right now？
translations.う～ん……あ、ほら！\nじゃあ、あそこは？:
Hmm... Oh, look!
How about over there？
translations.ねぇ、ロマンチックじゃない？\nきっと、天女様と龍の\nゆかりの地なのよ。:
Doesn't that sound romantic？
I bet it's connected to
the maiden and the dragon.
translations.決めた。\nじゃあ、最後はあそこ！:
It's decided!
That'll be our last stop.
translations.そう、“龍恋の鐘”。\n江の島の日の終わりは、\nロマンチックにね？:
Yep, the “Bell of Dragon Love.”
Let's end our day in Enoshima
on a romantic note, okay？
translations.本当……きれい。\nねぇ、あの鐘、龍恋の鐘かな？:
It really is... so pretty.
Hey, do you think that's
the Bell of Dragon Love？
translations.そっか……。\nあ、見て、鍵がたくさん。\nきっとカップルが残して\nいったんだ:
I see...
Oh look, so many padlocks.
Couples must have left
them here, right...？
translations.思い出さない？\nほら、熱海の……。:
Doesn't this remind you？
You know, back in Atami...
translations.ということは……。\nやっぱり、縁結びなんだ。\n江の島。\nそっか……。:
Which means...
Enoshima really brings
couples together, after all.
I see...
translations.私ね、本当は、\nお母さんに言われた時、\nショックだったの。:
To tell you the truth...
when my mom said that,
it really shook me.
translations.ほら、\n“自信ないんだ”って言われて。\n冗談で言ったんだって、\nそれはわか:
You know...
She said, “You're not
confident, are you？”
I knew she was just joking,
I really did, but...
translations.そんな迷信が気になるなんて、\n心のどこかで、やっぱり\n自信が無い証拠なんじゃ:
Getting worried over a silly
superstition like that...
Maybe it was proof that,
deep down, I really wasn't
confident in us...
translations.だからね、\nあなたが一緒に来てくれるって\n言ってくれた時、\nすごく嬉しかっ:
That's why,
when you said you'd come
along with me,
it made me so happy.
translations.この人と一緒なら、\n何があっても平気。\nちゃんと確かめようって、\n勇気が持:
“As long as I'm with him,
we'll be fine no matter what.”
It gave me the courage
to see for myself.
translations.今日一日一緒にいて、\nちゃんと、確かめられたよね？\n二人なら、平気って。:
Spending today together...
we proved it, didn't we？
That as long as we're together,
we'll be just fine.
translations.やっぱり、天女様と龍に\nあやかって、二人で鐘を鳴らすと\n永遠に……っていうこ:
I wonder if ringing it
together grants you eternity,
just like the maiden
and the dragon？
translations.よし、\n鳴らしてみよう。:
Alright,
let's give it a ring.
translations.不思議な音がする……。\nこれで、永遠に結ばれるのかな？:
What a mysterious sound...
Does this mean we'll be
together forever now？
translations.説明があるけど、読んでみる？:
There's a sign here.
Want to read it？
translations.……ううん。\n今日は、ただ不思議な音の鐘。\nもう、言い伝えは無し。\nそれよ:
...No.
Today, it's just a bell
with a mysterious sound.
No more legends.
Instead...
do something I can
believe in even more？
translations.二人なら、ずっと大丈夫……。:
As long as we're together,
we'll always be okay...
translations.ねぇ、龍恋の鐘ってあれ？\n鍵がたくさん掛ってるけど……。:
Hey, is that the Bell
of Dragon Love？
There are so many
padlocks hanging on it...
translations.ねぇ、\n何か思い出すでしょ、ほら？:
Hey,
doesn't this remind you
of something？ You know...
translations.よろしい。\nふふっ、\nそう、あいじょう岬。:
Very good.
Hehe,
yep, Cape Aijo.
translations.ということは、\nやっぱり、縁結びなんだ。\nここも。:
Which means...
this place really does
bring lovers together, too.
translations.お母さんに、\n“自信無いんだ”って\n言われた時ね、\n本当は少し、不安になっ:
When my mom told me,
“You must not be confident,”
truth is...
it made me a little anxious.
translations.だって、二人の気持ちを\n信じていれば、\nそんなこと言われたって、\n気になら:
I mean, if I really
trusted how we felt,
something like that
shouldn't have bothered
me at all, right？
translations.もちろん、私は平気よ？\nでも、もしかして……。:
Of course, I'm okay now.
But what if...？
translations.あなたが弁天様のことを聞いて、\n一緒に江の島に来て\nくれなかったら……。\n:
What if you heard about
Benten and didn't want to
come here with me...？
So... I tested you.
...I'm sorry, okay？
translations.でも、\nちゃんと一緒に来てくれた。\n二人の気持ちに自信があるから。\nそうで:
But you came anyway.
Because you're confident
in how we feel.
Aren't you？
translations.そうだ、ねぇ、\nあの鐘、鳴らして行こう？:
Oh, hey...
Wanna go ring that bell？
translations.あの鐘って、\nやっぱり縁結びの――:
That bell... isn't that
for tying the knot—
translations.そうかもね。\nでも、今日は合格の鐘。\nあなたが、ちゃんと私を\n信じてくれて:
Maybe so.
But today it's a passing bell.
Proof that you really
believed in me.
translations.ん？\nちょっと、\n合格の鐘っぽくなかったかな？:
Hm？
Maybe that didn't sound
much like passing？
translations.ふふっ、でも、\n１００点満点です。\nねぇ、御褒美はどうしたい？:
Hehe, but still,
you get a perfect score.
Hey... what do you want
for your reward？
translations.うん。\nこっちも１００点、かな？\n……大好き。:
Mmh.
That gets a hundred, too.
...I love you.
translations.ふふっ、\n思った通り、\nロマンチックな場所だね？:
Hehe,
it's just as romantic as
I thought it'd be, huh？
translations.ねぇ、あれが龍恋の鐘かな？\nほら、見て。\nカップルが残していった鍵が\nたく:
Hey, is that the
Bell of Ryuren？
Look, there are so many
padlocks couples left behind.
translations.ねぇ、ああいうの見ると、\n思い出しちゃわない？\nあいじょう岬。:
Hey, seeing those...
doesn't it take you back？
To Cape Aijo.
translations.やっぱり、縁結びなんだ。\n江の島。\nなぁんだ、ふふっ……。:
Enoshima really is for lovers,
after all.
All that worry for nothing,
hehe...
translations.私ね、本当は、\nお母さんに“自信無いんだ？”\nって言われて、\nギクッとしち:
To be honest,
when Mom asked if I was
feeling insecure,
it really stung.
translations.もちろん、\nお母さん、冗談で言ったのよ？\nそれはわかってるんだけど……。:
Of course,
she was only joking.
I know that, but still...
translations.そういう不思議な事って、\nあるかもしれないじゃない？\nだから、ちょっとむきに:
What if legends like that
actually have some truth？
So I got a little defensive...
I was acting weird today,
wasn't I？
translations.だよね、ハァ……。\nもう、バカみたい。:
Thought so. *sigh*...
I feel so silly.
translations.ありがとう。\nでも、もう大丈夫。\n今日一日一緒にいて、\nこんなに楽しくて…:
Thanks.
But I'm okay now.
Spending today with you was
so much fun...
translations.お互いを信じ合えてるって、\nちゃんと確かめられたから。:
It showed me for sure
that we really do believe
in each other.
translations.それに、ほら、\n伝説の謎も解けたしね？\nふふっ！\nそうだ、あの鐘……。:
Plus, we even solved
the legend's mystery, right？
Hehe!
Oh, speaking of which,
that bell...
translations.説明があるから、読んでみる？:
There's an explanation here,
wanna read it？
translations.伝説は、私たちが作るの。\nだから、今日のあの鐘は……。:
We make our own legend.
So today, that bell is...
translations.そうだ、弁天様にね、\n“私たちは、\nずっと一緒です”って\n約束する鐘。:
I know! It's our promise
to Benten-sama that
we'll be together forever.
translations.うん。\n江の島の日の終わりは、\nここが一番……。\nロマンチックにね？:
Yeah.
There's no better way to end
a day in Enoshima than this...
Romantic, right？
translations.ふふっ！\nハァ……\n今日も楽しかった！\n弁天様もご機嫌だったし。:
Hehe!
*sigh*...
Today was so much fun!
Benten-sama was in a great
mood, too.
translations.だって、ほら……\n私たち、今日もこんなに\n仲良しじゃない？:
I mean, look...
Aren't we getting along
so well again today？
translations.そうよ？\nふふっ！\nさてと、じゃあ、\nそろそろ、鐘を鳴らしますか。:
See？
Hehe!
Well then, shall we
ring the bell soon？
translations.弁天様に、\n“今日も私たちは\nラブラブでした▼”って言う、\n報告の鐘。:
A bell to report to
Benten-sama, 'We were so
lovey-dovey today, ▼!'
translations.ちょっと、照れるけど……。\nよし、鳴らそう！:
It's a little embarrassing,
but... All right, let's
ring it!
translations.ふふっ！\nこれ、ラブラブな音？:
Hehe!
Does that sound like a
lovey-dovey ring？
translations.いいの、これで。\nはい、じゃあラブラブな証拠。\n……ね？:
It's fine like this.
Here's proof of our love.
...See？
translations.ラブラブ、伝わったかな？:
Did she get how in
love we are, I wonder？
translations.楽しかった……。\nねぇ、\n思い切って来てみて、\nよかったね？:
That was so fun...
Hey, aren't you glad
we took the plunge and
came？
translations.来る時はあんなに\n心配してたのが、嘘みたい。:
I can hardly believe how
worried I was on the
way here.
translations.最初はどうなるかと\n思ったけどね。:
I wasn't sure how it'd
turn out at first, though.
translations.本当。\nでも良かった。\n伝説の謎も解決したしね？\nふふっ……あ。:
Totally.
But I'm so glad.
We even solved the mystery
of the legend, right？
Hehe... Oh.
translations.お待たせ。\nほら見て、このストラップ。:
Thanks for waiting.
Look at this strap!
translations.これって、弁天様が持ってた？:
Isn't this what
Benten-sama was holding？
translations.そう、琵琶。\nいいでしょ～、あげないよ！\nふふっ！:
Yep, a biwa!
Cute, right~？
Not giving it to you,
though! Hehe!
translations.ほら、電車が来た。\n行こう？:
Look, the train's here.
Shall we go？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、いい思い出に\nなったみたいだな……）:
(Looks like this became
a great memory for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.う～ん……\n今日もよく遊んだね？:
Mmm...
We sure had a lot of
fun today, didn't we？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n江の島に来ると\nテンション上がるもんね？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you always get
so excited whenever we come
to Enoshima, don't you？
translations.まあね？\n最後はやっぱり、\nちょっと寂しいけど……。:
I guess？
Though it's always a little
sad when it's time to go...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、すっかり\n弁天様のファンだな……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s totally become
a fan of Benten-sama...)
translations.ねぇ～？\nちょっと、今日はハードだね。\nまた、\n熱海でも当たらないかなぁ。:
Tell me about it~
Today's been pretty rough.
I wish we'd win
another trip to Atami.
translations.熱海じゃないけどさ、\n実は、また当たったんだ！:
It's not Atami,
but guess what？
I actually won again!
translations.当たったって……\nまさか、旅行？:
You won...?
Don't tell me...
A trip？
translations.そのまさか。\n旅行の懸賞。:
You guessed it.
A sweepstakes trip.
translations.えぇ!?\nどこ？\n温泉あるとこ？:
Wait, really!?
Where to？
Somewhere with hot springs？
translations.おとなの修学旅行、\n日光・鬼怒川温泉の旅、\n一泊二日!!:
A 'Grown-Up School Trip'
to Nikko & Kinugawa Onsen!
Two days and one night!!
translations.そうそう。\n学生じゃない人向けの、\n修学旅行のスポット巡りだよ。:
Yeah. You visit all the classic
school trip spots,
aimed at adults.
translations.ううん、そうじゃなくて\nほら、私たち……。:
No, it's not that,
it's just... you know, us...
translations.寧々さ～ん、わたしムリ！\nクーポンのやり方わかんない～！:
Nene-saaan, I can't do this!
I don't get how
the coupons work~!
translations.ちょっと見て来るね？\nあ、\nこの話は、また後で。:
I'll go check on her, okay？
Oh, and let's finish
this talk later.
translations.どこわかんない？\n先にコードのスキャンした？:
What part is tricky？
Did you scan the code first？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、遅いな……\n●も手伝いに行くかな？）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s taking a while...
Maybe ● should go
help out too？)
translations.ごめんごめん。\n抜けられなくなっちゃって！\nうん、行こう！:
Sorry, sorry!
I got totally tied up!
So, let's go!
translations.いいの？\nなんか、気にかかってるみたい\nだったけど。:
Are you sure？
You seemed kinda hung up
on something before.
translations.それは……ほら、私たち、\nゼッタイ一緒に行けない\nじゃない？ 本当の修学旅行:
Well... you know,
we could never go together,
right？ On a real school trip.
translations.まあ、学年が違うしね。:
Well, yeah, since we're
in different grades.
translations.その事、思い出しちゃって。\n修学旅行ってね？\nカップルが\n誕生しちゃったり:
That just reminded me.
You know how school trips are？
Couples get together...
translations.私たち、そういうの、\n出来ないんだなって、\nもう、諦めてたから。:
I'd already given up on
us ever getting to do
something like that.
translations.でも、さっきの話。\nそれなら、修学旅行しちゃえば\nいいんだよね、二人で？:
But hearing what you said...
we can just have our own
school trip, right？ Together.
translations.ふふっ！\nやった、修学旅行だ！\nねぇ、ねぇ、いつ行くの？:
Hehe!
Yay, a school trip!
Hey, hey, when are we going？
translations.えーと、デートの日にちは\nまた決めるとして……。:
Uh, we can figure out
the exact date later, but...
translations.じゃあ。\n▲月▲▲日▲から、\n一泊二日の修学旅行だ！:
Then it's settled.
Starting ▲月▲▲日▲,
our two-day school trip!
translations.オッケー。\nよーし、修学旅行だ～！\nいろいろ考えなきゃ……。:
Okay!
Alright, school trip time~!
I've got so much to plan...
translations.（やったっ!!\n●と▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n二人きりの修学旅行だっ！）:
(Alright!!
A school trip for just the
two of us, ● and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!)
translations.さてと！\n休憩、休憩！:
All right!
Break time, break time!
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。\n休憩終わったとこ？:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Just finishing your break？
translations.うん。\n入れ違い。\nざーんねん。:
Yep.
Just missed each other.
Too baaad.
translations.（そうだ！\nまた当たった\n日光・鬼怒川旅行の懸賞、\n誘ってみるかな……）:
(Oh, right!
I won that Nikko-Kinugawa
prize trip again.
Maybe I'll invite her...)
translations.実は、また当たったんだ、\n日光・鬼怒川温泉\nおとなの修学旅行！:
Actually, I won again!
The Nikko-Kinugawa Onsen
'Grown-Up School Trip'!
translations.うん。\nでも、う～ん……いいのかな？:
Yeah.
Though, hmm...
Is it really okay？
translations.だって、こんなに私たちばっかり\n当たるってことは、きっと、\nよっぽど応募者が:
I mean, if we keep winning,
hardly anyone else must be
entering, right？
translations.大丈夫？\nつぶれたりしない？\nその会社。:
Are they okay？
That company isn't
going under, are they？
translations.どうだろうな……。\nじゃあ、やめとく？:
Hard to say...
Should we pass on it, then？
translations.…………うん。\nやっぱり行く。\nまたやりたいもん、修学旅行。:
............Yeah.
I still want to go.
I really want to do our
school trip again.
translations.よし！\nそれじゃあ、\nいつにするかな……。:
Alright!
Then the question is,
when should we go...？
translations.（デートはまた今度、\n別の日にしよう……。）:
(We can always do our date
some other day...)
translations.▲月▲▲日▲から、\n一泊二日の修学旅行だ！:
An overnight school trip,
starting ▲月▲▲日▲!
translations.修学旅行だ！\nありがた～く、楽しんじゃおう。\nあ、そうそう。:
A school trip!
Let's take full advantage
and have fun!
Oh, that reminds me.
translations.ねぇねぇ、\n修学旅行、行くんだよね？:
Hey, hey,
we're going on that school
trip, right？
translations.じゃあ、買い物に行かない？\nこれから。\n修学旅行の物。:
Then want to go shopping？
Right now.
For stuff for the trip.
translations.そう言われると、パッと\n思いつかないけど、とりあえず。\nね、行こう？:
When you put it like that,
nothing comes to mind,
but anyway! Let's go？
translations.さて、と……\nなに買う？:
All right then...
What should we get？
translations.う～ん……あ！\nトランプとか！\nほら、やりたくなるかもよ？:
Hmm... Oh!
Playing cards!
We might feel like playing,
you know？
translations.トランプか。\nひとつくらい、\n家にあったかも……。:
Playing cards, huh.
I might have a deck
at home...
translations.私、持ってた。\nう～ん……。:
I have one at home.
Hmm...
translations.（待てよ……\n鬼怒川温泉に行くわけだから、\nまた、家族風呂とか、\nあるかも:
(Wait a sec...
Since it's Kinugawa Onsen,
they might have a private
bath again...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n水着買わなくて平気？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
don't you need to get
a swimsuit？
translations.ほら、また熱海みたいに、\n家族風呂があるかも\nしれないしさ？:
Well, like back in Atami,
there might be a private
bath again, you know？
translations.あ、そっか。\n……ん？ でも、それはちょっと\n設定と違うかな……。:
Ah, true.
...Hm？ But that doesn't
really fit our setting...？
translations.あ、いいのいいの！\nじゃあ、\n一応……買っとこうかな？:
Ah, never mind!
Then... maybe I'll buy one
just in case？
translations.さて！\n買い物は、まあこんなもんかな。:
Alright!
I guess that's about it
for our shopping.
translations.そうだね。\n無理に買わなくてもね。\nもったいないもん。:
Yeah.
No need to force it.
That'd just be wasteful.
translations.私、まだちょっと、\nいろいろ買い物していくから、\n先、帰って？:
I still have a few things
to buy, so why don't you
head home without me？
translations.いいの。\nもう……お子様だなぁ。:
No, it's okay.
Honestly...
You're such a kid.
translations.……もうっ。\nじゃあね？\n修学旅行の朝、\n寝坊しないでね？:
...Sheesh.
See you later, okay？
Don't you dare oversleep
the morning of the trip！
translations.（女子には色々あるんだな、\nきっと……）:
(Girls must have all kinds
of things to take care of...)
translations.うん。\n向こうも晴れてるといいな。:
Yeah.
Hope it's clear over there, too.
translations.まあね。\nでも、五月雨の修学旅行って\nいうのも、ちょっと素敵かもよ？:
True.
Though early summer rain
on a school trip could be
lovely too, don't you think？
translations.おはよう。\nハァ、まだ朝から暑いね？\n少し、\n涼しくなった気もするけど。:
Morning.
Whew, it's hot already,
isn't it？ Though maybe
it's cooled off a little.
translations.うん、向こうはどうかな？:
Yeah, I wonder how it is
over there？
translations.涼しいといいなぁ。\n秋を先取りしたいじゃない？\nほら、修学旅行って感じで。:
Hope it's cool.
Wouldn't it be nice to get
an early taste of autumn？
For that school trip feel.
translations.まだ、あんまり\n修学旅行っぽくないね？:
It doesn't really feel like
a school trip yet, does it？
translations.いつもの電車だからね。\n浅草で、特急に乗り換えたら、\n気分でるかもな。:
Well, it's our usual train.
Once we change trains at
Asakusa, that might
get us in the mood.
translations.そっかそっか、\n特急に乗ったら、か……\nなるほどね？:
Right, right.
Once we're on the express,
huh... Makes sense！
translations.おぉ……\n特急スペーシアか！\n旅に出るって感じだな！:
Whoa...
The Spacia express！
Now it really feels like
we're traveling！
translations.うん、ホント。\n修学旅行になって来た……よし！:
Yeah, totally.
It's starting to feel like
a school trip... Alright！
translations.ほら、男子！\n早く乗ってくださーい！\nふふっ▼:
Come on, boys！
Hurry up and get on board！
Hehe▼
translations.そう言えばさ、\nまた、やるんでしょ？\n同級生ごっこ？:
Come to think of it,
are we doing that again？
Playing classmates？
translations.もちろん。\nでも、それは、スペーシアの\nところに着いてから。:
Of course.
But not until we reach
the Spacia.
translations.だって、非日常の始まりっていう\n感じがするでしょ、\n特急に乗るのって？:
Because riding the express
really feels like stepping
out of the ordinary,
doesn't it？
translations.だから。\n特急に乗ってからが、\n修学旅行です。 ふふっ！:
So the school trip
only starts once we're
on the express. Hehe！
translations.特急スペーシアか……\nなるほど、非日常だな！:
The Spacia express...
Yeah, definitely out of
the ordinary！
translations.うん。\nじゃあ、乗ろうか？:
Yeah.
Shall we get on, then？
translations.ん～？\n……そうだっけ、『男子』？:
Hmm～？
...Is that how a 'boy'
is supposed to talk？
translations.あ、そっか。\nじゃあ……\nほら、行くぞ姉ヶ崎！:
Oh, right.
In that case...
Come on, Anegasaki,
let's go！
translations.シート広いな！\nそれに速いな……\n何キロくらい出てんだろ？:
These seats are huge！
And it's so fast...
Wonder how fast we're going？
translations.ふふっ、\n修学旅行っぽくなって来た？\nはい、そこで、提案です。:
Hehe, starting to feel like
a school trip now？
Well then, I have a proposal.
translations.いま、私達、修学旅行でしょ？\nだから、同い年って事にしない？\n二人は、同級生:
Right now, we're on a
school trip, right？
So how about we pretend
we're the same age？
We're classmates, see.
translations.そうなの。\nそれに、\nまだ付き合う前なんだよ？:
That's right.
And what's more,
we aren't dating yet, okay？
translations.そう。 でもね？\nお互い意識し合ってて、内心では\n修学旅行をきっかけに\nお:
Right. But listen？
We're both into each other,
and deep down we're hoping
this school trip might be
our chance to start dating.
translations.あぁ、なるほど……\nいや、\nでもなんでそんなこと――。:
Ah, I see...
Wait, but why would we―
translations.だって、そういうの、\nちょっと憧れない？\n恋愛小説みたいなの。ダメ？:
Come on, haven't you ever
dreamed about that sort of thing？
Like in a romance novel.
No good？
translations.ダメってワケじゃ……\nでも、う～ん……。:
It's not that it's bad...
Just, hmm...
translations.（提案っていうより、\nもう決まってたんだな……）:
(Less of a suggestion,
more like she already decided...)
translations.やっぱ、シート広いな！\nこの間の修学旅行でも思ったけど\nスペーシアって――。:
Man, these seats are huge!
I thought so on our last
school trip too, the Spacia is―
translations.うん。\nほら、この前、日光に行った時。:
Yeah.
You know, when we went
to Nikko that time.
translations.修学旅行って\n何度も行かないでしょ？:
You don't go on school trips
over and over, you know？
translations.あ、ほら！\nもう埼玉県だって！\nすご～い、早いねぇ～！\nふふっ！:
Oh, look!
We're already in Saitama!
Woooow, so fast!
Heheh!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n今回も徹底してるな……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s really
committing to the bit
this time, too...)
translations.ねぇねぇ、この辺て、\nもう栃木県かな？:
Hey, hey, around here,
are we in Tochigi already？
translations.まだ少し先じゃないかな？:
Still a little further,
I think？
translations.あ、そうだ。ビュッフェコーナー\n有ったよね？\nなんか買って来ようっと。:
Oh, right. There was a buffet
counter, wasn't there？
I'm gonna go grab something.
translations.そこは、\n“オレのも買って来て！”とか\nほら、偉そうなカンジ。:
That's where you go,
“Get mine too!”
You know, act all bossy.
translations.そっか。\nじゃあ……\nついでにオレのコーヒーも頼む！:
Right.
Then...
Grab me a coffee while
you're at it!
translations.もうっ！\n自分で行けばいいのに。\nまったく、男子って！:
Jeez!
You could just go yourself.
Honestly, boys!
translations.まもなく、\n鬼怒川温泉に到着します。\nどちら様も、\nお忘れ物の無いよう……:
We will soon be arriving at
Kinugawa-Onsen.
Please ensure you take all
belongings with you...
translations.そろそろ降りる\n支度しなきゃな！:
Better get ready
to get off!
translations.へぇ、きれいな駅だね？\nもっと、ひなびた感じかと\n思ってた。:
Huh, what a pretty station？
I thought it'd feel a lot
more rustic.
translations.たしかに。 えぇと、行程表では\nまず、『ライン下り』だっけ？\nじゃあ、行こう:
Totally. Um, the itinerary says
the river cruise is first, right？
Shall we go, then？
translations.あれ……\nなんかおかしかった？:
Huh...
Did I say something weird？
translations.同級生の男子って、\nもっと乱暴に言うでしょ？\n“おい、姉ヶ崎”みたいに。:
A guy in the same class
would sound rougher, right？
Like, “Hey, Anegasaki.”
translations.それ……●が言うの？:
You really want
● to say that？
translations.そうよ？\nね、言ってみて？:
Of course!
Come on, try it？
translations.じゃあ……\nほら、行こうぜ、姉ヶ崎。:
All right then...
Come on, let's go, Anegasaki.
translations.あ、いや……\nだって、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が\n言えっていうから――。:
Ah, wait...
I mean, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was the one
who told me to say it―
translations.そっかぁ、鬼怒川温泉って\nこういう感じなんだぁ……\nなるほど～……。:
So this is what Kinugawa Onsen
is like...
I see, I see~...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nちょっとワザとらしいよ……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, that felt
a little too forced...
translations.やっぱり？\nじゃあ、初めてはここまで。\nでも、付き合う前だからね？:
You think so？
Guess that's enough of that.
Remember though, we're not
dating yet, okay？
translations.ねぇ、ライン下りだよね？:
Hey, the river cruise is next,
right？
translations.えぇと……\nほら、行くぞ、姉ヶ崎！:
Uh...
Come on, let's go, Anegasaki!
translations.ありがと。\nこの下が乗り場？:
Thanks.
Is the dock down below？
translations.そうみたいだな。\nえっと、\nほら、行こうぜ、姉ヶ崎？:
Looks like it.
Uh...
Come on, let's go, Anegasaki？
translations.あ、板について来た。\nふふっ。:
Ah, you're getting the hang of it.
Hehe.
translations.へぇ……\n先の方、\nけっこう流れが急だな。:
Whoa...
The current's pretty fast
further downstream.
translations.うん。\n水がきれいだね……\n空気も湿ってて、気持ちいい！:
Yeah.
The water is so clear...
And the mist in the air feels
so nice!
translations.あ、ほら！\n乗船はじまったみたいだ。\n行こう。:
Oh, look!
Looks like boarding started.
Let's go.
translations.ほら、手、貸して？\n河原は歩きにくいから。:
Here, take my hand.
It's hard to walk on these rocks.
translations.でも……\nウワサ、されちゃうよ？\nとか言っちゃって、ふふっ！:
But...
People might start gossiping,
you know？
Just kidding, hehe!
translations.あ、付き合う前だった……\nいいからさ、ほら、手。:
Oh, right, before we started
dating...
Come on, just give me your hand.
translations.ありがとう……\n優しいんだね？:
Thank you...
You're pretty sweet, you know？
translations.（なんか、\n妙な気分になってきた……）:
(Man, this is starting to feel
kind of weird...)
translations.ありがと。\nまだちょっと時間あるけど、\n河原、歩いてみよう？:
Thanks.
We still have a little time.
Want to take a walk by the river？
translations.大丈夫？\n足元悪いから、手、繋ぐ？:
You okay？
The footing's bad, want me
to hold your hand？
translations.平気です！\nそんなに簡単に、\n手は繋がないよ～！:
I'm fine!
I don't hold hands that easily,
mister~!
translations.お待たせしました！\n乗船開始します！:
Thanks for waiting, folks!
We're ready for boarding!
translations.ほら、意地張ってないで、\n手、貸せよ。:
Come on, quit being stubborn
and take my hand.
translations.（よし、なんか慣れて来た！）:
(Alright, I'm getting the hang
of this!)
translations.おぉ……\nけっこう、\n急なとこもあるな……。:
Whoa...
There are some pretty rough rapids
further down...
translations.うん……\nちょっと、緊張してきちゃった。:
Yeah...
I'm getting a little nervous.
translations.はい、シート上げてください！:
Alright, please pull up
your splash sheets!
translations.ほら、水かぶるよ！\nこっち来て！:
Watch out, you'll get soaked!
Get over here!
translations.けっこう、水、跳ねるな……\nかからなかった？:
Water really splashes...
Did you get wet？
translations.大丈夫。\n抱きよせてくれたから。:
I'm fine.
Because you pulled me close.
translations.でも、ビックリしちゃった。\n強引なんだもん……\nとか言っちゃった、ふふっ！:
You startled me, though.
Being so forceful and all...
Just kidding, hehe!
translations.（ちょっと\n楽しくなってきた……）:
(This is starting
to get kinda fun...)
translations.おぉ!!\n今のは凄かったな……\n水、かからなかった？:
Whoa!!
That was intense...
Did you get wet？
translations.いや、べつに下心は……。:
Wait, I didn't mean anything
funny by it...
translations.はい、あちらをご覧ください。\n何かの顔に見えませんか？:
Now, look over that way.
Doesn't it look like a face？
translations.あ、ゴリラ岩かな？\nう～ん……。:
Oh, is that Gorilla Rock？
Hmm...
translations.やった、見えた！\nわーい！:
Yay, I can see it!
Woohoo!
translations.（こうしてると、\n本当に同級生みたいだな……）:
(Doing this, it really feels
like we're classmates...)
translations.ハァ、楽しかった！\n意外とたくましいんだね？:
Phew, that was fun!
You're surprisingly manly,
aren't you？
translations.そういう姉ヶ崎は、\n意外と恐がりなんだな！:
Well, you're surprisingly
a scaredy-cat, Anegasaki!
translations.ふふっ、いい感じ！\nあ、ソフトクリーム売ってるよ？:
Hehe, not bad!
Oh, look, they're selling
soft-serve ice cream!
translations.じゃあ、\n別べつの頼んで、交換だ！:
Then let's each get
a different flavor and swap!
translations.あ、そっか……\n付き合う前は、\nそういうことしないか？:
Oh, right...
People don't do that kind
of thing before they date？
translations.うん……\nそうなんだけど。\nでも、\nどうしちゃったんだろ……。:
Yeah...
That's true, but...
Still, what's gotten
into me...？
translations.よし、次はバスを乗り継いで\n東武ワールドスクウェアだ！:
Alright, next we transfer
buses to Tobu World Square!
translations.よかった、\n今日はゴリラ岩がわかって♪:
I'm glad I could spot
Gorilla Rock today♪
translations.他のは相変わらず、\nわかんなかった？:
Still couldn't figure out
the other ones？
translations.うん、実は。\n才能ないのかな？:
Yeah, honestly.
Guess I've got no knack
for it？
translations.才能ってほどの事でも\nないだろ？\nあ、また、アイス喰ってく？:
It doesn't take real talent,
does it？
Wanna grab ice cream again？
translations.うん。\nまた、\nドキドキしちゃうかな……\nふふっ！:
Yeah.
I wonder if my heart'll
flutter again... Hehe!
translations.よし、\n東武ワールドスクウェアだな！:
Alright,
Tobu World Square it is!
translations.東武ワールドスクウェアか……\n楽しいとこだといいね、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？:
Tobu World Square, huh...
Hope it's a fun place,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うん、ちょっと……\nほら、さっき、\nアイス、食べたでしょ？:
Yeah, a little...
You know how we had
ice cream earlier？
translations.あなたに、交換だって\n言われた時ね、私……\nすごく、ドキドキしちゃった。:
When you told me to swap,
my heart...
started racing so fast.
translations.おかしいよね？\nだって、私たちほら、\nいつも、もっと色々……ね？:
It's silly, right？
I mean, usually we do
so much more... right？
translations.どうしたのかな？\nやっぱり、\n同級生ごっこのせい？:
I wonder why？
Is it because
we're playing classmates？
translations.東武ワールドスクウェア\n入り口です。\nお降りのお客さまは、\nお忘れ物の無い:
Next stop, Tobu World Square.
Please make sure not to leave
anything behind as you exit...
translations.着いた。\n夢・感動との出逢い。\n東武ワールドスクウェアか……。:
We're here.
'Where dreams and wonder meet.'
Tobu World Square, huh...
translations.うん。\nねぇ、またやって？\n行こうぜって。:
Yeah.
Hey, say that thing again？
'Let's go!'
translations.夢・感動との出逢い。\n東武ワールドスクウェアか……。:
'Where dreams and wonder meet.'
Tobu World Square, huh...
translations.ね、またいっぱい、\n写真撮ろうね？:
Hey, let's take
lots of pictures again, okay？
translations.あっ……\nほら、キュンってなった。:
Ah...
See？ It gave me butterflies.
translations.おお!?\nスゲー……\n１／２５の世界か。:
Whoa!?
Incredible...
A 1/25th scale world, huh.
translations.すごーい！\nほら、国会議事堂！\n東京駅も！:
Amazing!
Look, the National Diet Building!
And Tokyo Station, too!
translations.これ、全部1／２５なんだよね？\n空港の飛行機も？:
Everything's 1/25th scale, right？
Even the planes at the airport？
translations.１人くらいなら、がんばって\n乗せて飛んでくれそう、ふふっ！\nね、海外の方、行:
It feels like it could almost fly
with one person, hehe!
Come on, let's see the world zone!
translations.大きい……\n本物は、これの２５倍でしょ？\nえぇと、１・２・３・４……。:
It's huge...
The real one is 25 times this, right？
Let's see... One, two, three, four...
translations.無理！ わかんない！\nふふっ！\n本物見てみたいなぁ……。:
No way! I can't picture it!
Hehe!
I'd love to see the real thing...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nピラミッドが好きなんだな？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you really like pyramids, huh？
translations.大好き。ピラミッドもそうだけど\n世界の七不思議とか古代遺跡も。\nそこに居るっ:
Love them. Not just pyramids,
the Seven Wonders and ancient ruins too.
Just imagining standing there...
translations.ほら、ぶるって、ならない？\n武者震いみたいなの。:
See, don't you get chills？
Like a thrill running through you.
translations.わかる気がする。: I think I get what you mean.
translations.うん、撮って撮って！\n本当にピラミッドの前に\n居るみたいによ？ いい？:
Yeah, do it, do it!
Make it look like I'm really standing
in front of the pyramid, okay？
translations.ほらほら、パルテノン神殿！\n後ろにピラミッドの先っぽが\n見えてるの！ お得な:
Look, look, the Parthenon!
You can see the tip of the pyramid
behind it! What a bonus!
translations.ここならではの景色だね？:
Definitely a view you can
only get here, huh？
translations.本当。\nあ、あっち！ コロッセオ！:
Totally.
Oh, over there! The Colosseum!
translations.すごーい、アリの巣みたーい！\nあの、小さな部屋に奴隷とか\nライオンが入れられ:
Amazing, it looks like an anthill!
I wonder if they kept slaves and lions
in those little rooms？
translations.それで、見世物として、\n戦わされたんだよね……そうだ！\nわたしね、小さい頃よ:
And they made them fight
for a spectacle, right... Oh!
You know, when I was little...
translations.いざ、ライオンと戦わされる事に\nなったら、こうしようと思って、\n考えた作戦が:
I came up with a strategy in case
I was ever forced to fight a lion.
translations.まず初めに、エイッ！ って\n眼つぶしして、それからお腹の\nところを思いっきり:
First, I'd go 'Hyaa!' and jab its eyes,
then kick it in the stomach
with all my might.
translations.ほら！\nなんか、勝てそうな気がしない？:
See？
Doesn't it kinda feel
like I could win？
translations.そうかなぁ……\nエイッ！ ってやるでしょ？\nそれから素早く……う～ん……。:
You think so？
First, you go 'Hyaa!', right？
Then quickly... Hmm...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nなんかカワイイ……\nよし、撮っておこう）:
（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
kinda adorable...
Alright, gotta get a picture.）
translations.この辺は、ヨーロッパの建物か！\n細かく出来てるなぁ……。:
This area's European buildings!
The detail on these is amazing...
translations.ねぇ！\nサグラダ・ファミリアでしょ？\n凱旋門、ノートルダム寺院に……\nあ、:
Look!
Sagrada Família, right？
The Arc de Triomphe,
Notre-Dame... Ah, over there!
translations.そうそう、タージ・マハル！\n彫刻が細か～い！\nきれい……いいなぁ……。:
Yeah, the Taj Mahal!
The carvings are so intricate!
It's gorgeous... How lovely...
translations.１／２５でこれって事は……\nけっこうな大きさだろうな。:
If it's this big at 1/25th scale...
The real thing must be huge.
translations.それにね？\n本物は全部大理石なんだよ？:
And you know what？
The real one is made entirely
out of marble!
translations.月の夜に、サリーを着て\nお散歩したら、素敵だろうなぁ、\n行ってみたいなぁ……:
Taking a walk there on a moonlit
night wearing a sari...
It'd be so wonderful.
I'd love to go...
translations.（うん、\nここも撮っておこう……）:
(Yeah,
better get a photo here too...)
translations.ハァ～\n楽しかったなぁ……。:
Haaah...
That was so much fun...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nはしゃいでたね？:
You were having a blast,
weren't you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.あっ、自分だって！\nでも……うん。:
Hey, you were too!
Though... yeah.
translations.ちょっと、はしゃいじゃった。\n自分でも、わかった。なんか\n子供っぽくなってる:
I got a little carried away.
Even I could tell. Like I was
acting like a total kid.
translations.１／２５の世界旅行だもんな？:
Well, it's a 1/25th scale world
tour, after all, right？
translations.うん、それに……\nちょっと、同級生ごっこ、\n休憩しない？:
Yeah, and... why don't we take
a quick break from playing
classmates？
translations.いつもより\n男の子っぽいんだもん。:
Because you're acting way
more boyish than usual.
translations.うん……ふふっ。\nはい、休憩おしまい。\nもうすぐバスでしょ？:
Yeah... Hehe.
Alright, break time's over!
Our bus is almost here, right？
translations.そうだった！\n次は、\nEDO WONDERLAND 日光江戸村だ！:
That's right!
Next up is
EDO WONDERLAND Nikko Edomura!
translations.ほら、あれ、やってやって！: Come on, do the thing! Do it!
translations.じゃあ……\nほら、行くぞ、姉ヶ崎！:
Well then...
Come on, let's go, Anegasaki!
translations.いやぁ……\nやっぱ楽しいな！\n夢・感動に出会えた気がする！:
Man... That was so fun!
I feel like I really discovered
dreams and wonder!
translations.また世界一周しちゃったね？\nハァ～……いつか、\n本当に行ってみたいなぁ……。:
We went around the world again,
didn't we？
Haaah... I really want to go for
real someday...
translations.うん、二人で……あ、そうだ。\n付き合う前だったっけ――。:
Yeah, the two of us... Oh, right.
We aren't supposed to be
dating yet—
translations.ねぇねぇ、\nちょっと、同級生ごっこ、\nブレイクするよ？:
Hey, hey.
Can we take a little break from
playing classmates？
translations.贅沢な旅じゃなくても、\nどこか、一か所でいいから、\n世界の名所巡りみたいなの:
It doesn't have to be a fancy trip.
Just one place would be fine, but...
a tour of world landmarks—
translations.いつか、二人でしようね？:
Let's do that together someday,
okay？
translations.ふふっ、もうすぐバスでしょ？\nほら、休憩おしまい。\nあれ、やって？:
Fufu, the bus will be here soon,
right？
Alright, break time's over.
Do that thing for me, okay？
translations.次は、\nEDO WONDERLAND 日光江戸村だ！\n行くぞ、姉ヶ崎！:
Next up is
EDO WONDERLAND Nikko Edomura!
Let's go, Anegasaki!
translations.EDO WONDERLAND\n日光江戸村入り口です。\nお降りのお客さまは、\:
This is the entrance to
EDO WONDERLAND
Nikko Edomura.
Passengers alighting,
please make sure not to
leave anything behind...
translations.おぉ……\n来たな、EDO WONDERLAND\n日光江戸村。:
Ooh...
Here we are: EDO WONDERLAND
Nikko Edomura.
translations.EDO WONDERLAND……\nっていうことは、出るよね？\n忍者？:
EDO WONDERLAND...
So does that mean they'll show up？
Ninjas？
translations.ン～ッ！\nこれはいいかも――あれ？\nねぇ、あの門番みたいな人……。:
Mmm!
This might be great—huh？
Hey, that guard-looking guy...
translations.お客様、\n通行手形はお持ちでござるか？:
Honored guests,
dost thou possess a travel pass？
translations.あ、わかった！\nチケットの事だよ！:
Oh, I get it!
He means tickets!
translations.そこは、“ござる”だよ！\nね、そうですよね？:
You're supposed to say
'de gozaru' there!
Right？ Isn't that right？
translations.左様でござる。\nそれじゃあ、気をつけて\nいってらっしゃいでござる！:
That it is, de gozaru!
Well then, safe travels
on your way, de gozaru!
translations.ふふっ、楽しいっ！\nほら、じゃあアレやって？\nあ、江戸バージョンだよ？:
Hehe, this is so fun!
Come on, do that thing!
The Edo version, okay？
translations.江戸バージョン!?\nえぇと、じゃあ……\n姉ヶ崎どの、行くでござる！:
The Edo version!?
Uh, well then...
Lady Anegasaki,
let us depart, de gozaru!
translations.アハッ、変なのっ！\nおっかしい～！:
Aha, that's so weird!
You're hilarious~!
translations.（だって、\nやれって言うから……）:
(Well, you're the one
who told me to...)
translations.おぉ……\nまた来たか、\nEDO WONDERLAND 日光江戸村。:
Whoa...
We're back at
EDO WONDERLAND
Nikko Edomura.
translations.来ましたねぇ……\n血沸き肉躍る、\nEDO WONDERLAND▼:
Here we are...
The blood-pumping,
thrilling
EDO WONDERLAND▼
translations.えっと、門番の人は……\nあ、居た。\n……じゃあ、行こうか？:
Uh, where's the gatekeeper...
Oh, there he is.
...Shall we go？
translations.えっ？\nやってくれないの？\n江戸バージョン。:
Huh？
Aren't you gonna do it？
The Edo version.
translations.だって、笑うじゃん……。:
Come on, you'll just
laugh at me...
translations.今度は笑わないから！\nねっ、お願い？:
I won't laugh this time!
Come on, please？
translations.姉ヶ崎どの、行くでござるぞ！:
Lady Anegasaki,
let us depart, de gozaru!
translations.う～ん、本格的だよな……。:
Mm, they really went all
out with this...
translations.うん。お店とか、町の人も\n本物みたい。\nということは……。:
Yeah. Even the shops
and townsfolk look
so real.
Which means...
translations.町人のフリをして、忍者が\nまぎれてるかもしれない。\nほら、あの人とか怪しいか:
There might be ninjas
blending in, disguised
as townspeople.
Look, that person over there
looks suspicious.
translations.『地獄寺』か……\n当然、入ってく？:
The 'Temple of Hell', huh...
Naturally, we're going in？
translations.なるほど……\n当時の人が信じてた『地獄』を\n再現してるんだ……。:
I see...
They've recreated 'Hell'
just as people back then
believed it to be...
translations.ほら、細かいとこまで\nちゃんと作り込んでる……。:
Look, even the smallest
details are crafted
so carefully...
translations.（なんか、\n身もフタも無い感想だな……）:
(Man, that was kind of
a clinical take...)
translations.やっ、なにっ!?\nやだやだ～!!:
Eek, what's that!?
No, no, nooo!!
translations.（おっ▼\n腕に柔らかい感触が……）:
(Whoa▼
I feel something soft
against my arm...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。\nけっこう、恐がってた？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Were you actually
pretty scared？
translations.だから、ビックリするのと\n恐いのは違うの、もうっ！:
I told you, being startled
is totally different from
being scared! Jeez!
translations.その割に、最後まで\n腕にしがみついてたけど？:
Even though you clung
to my arm the whole time？
translations.だからそれは……\nそういう設定なんです！\n同級生の寧々ちゃんは！:
Well, that's just...
that's part of the role!
For classmate Nene-chan!
translations.そう言えば、\nもう昼過ぎてるな……\nそろそろ、昼メシにする？:
Come to think of it,
it's already past noon...
Time for some lunch？
translations.いいよ？\nあそこにしよ、\nほら『釜めし松前屋』。:
Sure!
Let's go there, look—
'Kamameshi Matsumaeya'.
translations.どうしよっかなぁ。\n『将軍釜めし』もいいけど、\n『けんちん汁セット』も……。:
Hmm, what should I get？
The 'Shogun Kamameshi'
looks good, but so does the
'Kenchin-jiru Set'...
translations.●はいいけど……\nまた、同級生ごっこ休憩？:
I don't mind, ●...
but taking another break
from playing classmates？
translations.そうじゃなくて……\nだんだんお互いの気持ちを\nわかり始めた二人が――。:
No, it's not that...
It's when two people
who are starting to realize
their feelings for each other—
translations.ここで初めて、\n自然に半分こしちゃうの……ね？\n決めた、『けんちん汁セット』:
—naturally share their food
for the first time right here...
See？
Decided: Kenchin-jiru Set!
translations.（そう言われると、\nなんか意識しちゃうな……）:
(Hearing her say that
makes me way too self-conscious...)
translations.あの行列は……\n『忍者からす屋敷』、か。:
That line is for...
the 'Ninja Crow Mansion', huh？
translations.あっ！\nそれそれ！\nね、並ぼう！:
Ah!
That's it!
Come on, let's line up!
translations.すごいアクションだね……。\n本物の忍者みたい……。:
The stunts were incredible...
Just like real ninjas...
translations.うん。\nからくりも凄い……。:
Yeah.
The stage tricks were wild...
translations.ねっ、ねっ！\nカッコいいよねぇ～！:
Right, right?!
He was so cool~!
translations.ハァ～……\nカッコよかったな、あの忍者……\nやっぱり、憧れちゃう。:
*Sigh*...
That ninja was so cool...
I can't help admiring that.
translations.ん……あれ？ あれれ？\nもしかして、ヤキモチ妬いて\nくれたのか……な？:
Mm... wait, what's this?
Could it be that you're
getting jealous... maybe？
translations.ふふっ、違うよ？\n小さい頃、忍者になろうと\n思ってた事があるのっ！:
Hehe, it's not that！
When I was little,
I wanted to be a ninja！
translations.からくりとか忍術が大好きで、\n真似したりして。\nそういう意味よ？:
I loved all the tricks and ninjutsu,
and used to copy them.
That's all I meant, okay？
translations.……もうっ……\nねぇ、手、繋いでいい？:
...Geez...
Hey, can I hold your hand？
translations.ここはね、ヤキモチ妬かれた\n寧々ちゃんが、キュンってなって\n手を握っちゃうと:
This is where Nene-chan,
touched that you got jealous,
holds your hand. See？
translations.この辺りは\n一段と本格的だな……。:
This area feels
even more authentic...
translations.時代劇のセットとしても\n使われるんだって。:
I heard they even use it
as a set for period dramas.
translations.ふふっ。\nよかった、ご機嫌がなおって。:
Fufu.
I'm glad you cheered up.
translations.ほら、ヤキモチ、\n妬いてくれたでしょ？:
Come on, you were
jealous just now, right？
translations.違うの、嬉しかったの。\nでも、まだわかってないなぁ、\nって。いい？:
No, I was happy.
I just thought, 'He still
doesn't get it.' Listen, okay？
translations.あのね？ 女の子って、大好きな\n人と一緒にいる時は、他の男の子\nなんて、目に:
You see, when a girl is with
the person she loves, she doesn't
even notice other guys, okay？
translations.あれ？\nじゃあ、今のは、同級生の\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？:
Huh？
Wait, so was that
the classmate ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ん？\nあれ、そっか。\nどっちだろ？ う～ん……。:
Mm？
Oh, I guess so.
Which was it？ Hmm...
translations.わかんなくなっちゃった。\n変なの……。:
Now I can't even tell.
How silly...
translations.おいらん道中が始まります。\nどちら様も、おいらんの優雅な\n『おねり』をご覧く:
The Oiran Procession is starting!
Ladies and gentlemen, please enjoy
the courtesan's elegant parade!
translations.着物もきれいだけど、\nおいらんの人も素敵……\nいいなぁ……。:
Her kimono is gorgeous,
and the oiran herself is lovely...
Must be nice...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もやってみたい？:
Do you want to try it too,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うん、やってみたい。\nでも……あんなに\n綺麗にはなれないかなぁ……。:
Yeah, I'd love to.
Though... I don't think
I could look that beautiful...
translations.う～ん……\nでも、あの人、\nすごく綺麗だよ？:
Hmm...
Still, she's just
so beautiful, you know？
translations.美人だもんね？\nあの“おいらん”さん。:
She really is gorgeous, huh？
That oiran lady.
translations.いや、そうじゃなくて……\nあ、ヤキモチ？:
No, that's not it...
Wait, are you jealous？
translations.忍者と同じだって、\nほら、あの姿に憧れるっていう。:
It's just like with ninjas!
You know, admiring the way
they look.
translations.じゃあ、小さい頃\n“おいらん”になりたかった？:
So, did you want to be an
oiran when you were little？
translations.（よし、お土産もの屋も\n一通り見たな！ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n買い物すんだかな？）:
(Alright, checked out all the
souvenir shops!
I wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is done
shopping？)
translations.お待たせ。\n見て見て、これなーんだ？:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Look, look, guess what this is？
translations.ストラップ？\nあ、名前入りだ……。:
A strap？
Oh, it has our names on it...
translations.そう。一つあげる。\nあ、『寧々』って書いてあるのが\nあなたのね？:
Yep! Here's one for you.
The one that says 'Nene'
is yours, okay？
translations.『▲名前▲』は、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の？:
And the one with '▲名前▲'
is for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そう。ねぇ、良く見て？\n二人とも、『２－Ｂ』って\n書いてあるでしょ？:
Uh-huh. Hey, look closely.
They both say '2-B' on them,
don't they？
translations.▲主人公＊▲……\n修学旅行の思い出に、\nもらってくれる？:
▲主人公＊▲...
Will you keep it as a memory
of our school trip？
translations.こうして二人は、\nまた一歩、前進したのでした。\nふふっ。:
And so, the two took another
step forward together.
Hehe.
translations.楽しかった！\nさすが、EDO WONDERLAND！:
That was so much fun!
EDO WONDERLAND really lived
up to the hype!
translations.ああ、また来たいな？:
Yeah, let's come back again
sometime, okay？
translations.うん。\nそれじゃ、今日はもう……\n旅館に行くだけだね？:
Yeah.
Then all that's left today
is heading to the inn, right？
translations.うん、\nそろそろバスが来るな。:
Yeah,
the bus should be here soon.
translations.だって、それはやっぱり……\n少しは、緊張するよ？\n女子としては。:
Well, I mean...
I'm bound to be at least
a little nervous, aren't I？
As a girl, you know.
translations.そっか……\nでも、ほら、修学旅行だから。:
I see...
But hey, it's a school trip,
remember？
translations.あ、そっか……\nじゃあ、いいんだ。\n普通に楽しみで。:
Oh, right...
Then that's fine.
I can just look forward to it
normally.
translations.もうっ、違うのっ！\nそういうのじゃないから！:
Jeez, no!
It's not like that at all!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nちょっと疲れた？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
are you a little tired？
translations.うん。\nきっと、幸せのため息。\nふふ。:
Yeah.
It must be a sigh
of happiness.
Hehe.
translations.ここから、べつのバス？:
Do we take a different bus
from here？
translations.そう。\nホテル行きのバスは……。\nお、あれか！:
Yeah.
The bus to the hotel is...
Oh, that's it!
translations.お待たせしました。\n鬼怒川プラザホテルに\nお泊りのお客様！:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Guests staying at the
Kinugawa Plaza Hotel!
translations.着いた！\nここが今日の宿、\n鬼怒川プラザホテルか！:
We're here!
So this is where we're staying,
the Kinugawa Plaza Hotel!
translations.わぁ、大きい……\nん？\nなんだろう、あの……玉？:
Wow, it's huge...
Hmm？
What is that... giant ball？
translations.お待たせ。\nチェックインしたよ？\n夕食は、7時だってさ。:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
We're all checked in.
Dinner's at 7, apparently.
translations.うん……\nねぇ、ここで、いいんだよね？\nなんだか、豪華だけど……。:
Yeah...
Hey, this is really where
we're staying, right？
It's so fancy, though...
translations.お待たせいたしました。\nご案内いたします。 奥様、\nお荷物お持ちしましょうか:
Thank you for waiting.
Allow me to show you up.
Ma'am, may I take your bags？
translations.わたし？\nえと、あの、\nはぁ、すいません。:
Me？
Um, er...
Ah, thank you.
translations.びっくりした～……\n修学旅行の\nつもりだったから……。:
That startled me...
I was treating this like
a regular school trip...
translations.ちょっと……照れるね？:
It's a little...
embarrassing, isn't it？
translations.そうそう、玉！\nまたお世話になります♪\nふふっ！:
Right, the orb!
Thanks for having us again♪
Hehe!
translations.お待たせ。\nチェックインしたよ？\n夕食は、7時だって。:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
All checked in.
Dinner is at seven, they said.
translations.お待たせいたしました。\nご案内いたします。 奥様、\nお荷物お持ちしましょうか:
Thank you for waiting.
Allow me to show you up.
Ma'am, may I take your bags？
translations.あ、いえ、\n主人が運びますので、\nお構いなく。:
Oh, no,
my husband will carry them,
so please don't worry.
translations.言っちゃった……。\nゴメン、運んでくれる？\nふふ。:
I actually said it...
Sorry, will you carry them？
Hehe.
translations.それでは、\nごゆっくりおくつろぎください。:
Please make yourself at home
and have a relaxing stay.
translations.わぁ、すごい！\n広～い、それにお洒落……。:
Wow, amazing!
It's huge, and so stylish...
translations.うん……\n豪華だな、こりゃ……。:
Yeah...
This place is seriously fancy.
translations.和洋折衷？\nあ！\nほら、窓の外、\nお風呂、だよね？:
Japanese-Western blend？
Ah! Look out the window,
that's a bath, right？
translations.そっか……\nカップルの人とか、\n一緒に入れちゃうのか……。:
I see...
So couples can
go in together, huh...
translations.残念だったね？\n修学旅行で。 ふふ。:
Too bad for you, huh？
Since it's a school trip. Hehe.
translations.ねぇ、\nお茶いれよっか？:
Hey,
should I make some tea？
translations.う～ん、すごい部屋だなぁ……\nなんだかね、モデルルームに\nいるみたいじゃない:
Mm, what an amazing room...
Doesn't it kind of feel like
we're in a showroom？
translations.そうなのよ。\n素敵なんだけど、なんか、\n修学旅行っぽくないの……。:
Right？
It's lovely, but it doesn't
feel like a school trip...
translations.まあ、それはそれでさ？:
Well, that's not bad either,
is it？
translations.わかった。\nじゃあ、こういう事なの。:
I've got it.
Here's the story, then.
translations.ひょんな事から、二人だけ\n豪華な部屋に泊まる事に\nなっちゃったの。よし。:
Through a bizarre twist of fate,
just the two of us ended up
in this luxury room. There!
translations.そうだ、\n食事の前に、大浴場に、\n行ってみる？:
Oh yeah.
Want to check out the big bath
before dinner？
translations.あ、いいかも！\nちょっと、汗も流したいしね？:
Oh, that sounds nice!
I kinda wanted to wash
off some sweat anyway？
translations.それじゃ、\nここで待ち合わせね？:
Well then,
let's meet back here, okay？
translations.ちょっと、\n長いかもしれないけど、\nゴメンね？:
I might take a while,
so sorry in advance, okay？
translations.ふふ、\nじゃあ、あとでね？\nいってきま～す♪:
Hehe, see you later then？
Off I go~♪
translations.『宝の湯』か！\n縁起がいいな！:
'Bath of Treasures', huh!
Sounds pretty lucky!
translations.広いな～っ！\n鬼怒川を一望！\n気持ちいい～っ！:
Man, it's huge!
A full view of Kinugawa!
Feels amazing~!
translations.（はぁ～っ、\n一日の疲れが取れる……\n眠くなりそうだな……）:
(Phew... It's washing away
all the day's fatigue...
I'm getting sleepy...)
translations.危ない危ない……\n本当に上がろう……。:
That was close...
I really better get out...
translations.ゴメン、待ったよね？:
Sorry!
Have you been waiting long？
translations.あ、男子が変な目で見てる！\n先生に言いつけちゃお。\nふふ♪:
Ah, this boy's giving me
weird looks!
I'm telling the teacher.
Hehe♪
translations.はぁ～……\nいいお湯でした。:
Pheeew...
That was such a nice bath.
translations.うん。\nやっぱ、温泉っていいな……。:
Yeah.
Hot springs really are
the best...
translations.失礼します。\nお食事のご用意に参りました。:
Pardon the intrusion.
I've brought your meal.
translations.わぁい、\n上げ膳据え膳だ！:
Yay,
waited on hand and foot!
translations.ウマいなぁ！\n量もすごいし！:
This is great!
And there's so much of it!
translations.ねぇ？\nお刺身に、鉄板焼きに\nお鍋か……。:
Right？
Sashimi, teppanyaki,
and hot pot...
translations.ん～、全部食べたいけど、\nちょっと無理かな……。\nね、手伝ってくれる？:
Mmm, I want to eat it all,
but I don't think I can...
Hey, will you help me out？
translations.あ、修学旅行中だっけ……。:
Oh wait,
we're on a school trip...
translations.私も～……\n食べ過ぎちゃった……。:
Me too...
I ate way too much...
translations.腹ごなしに、ちょっと散歩する？\nホテルの中？:
Wanna take a walk to walk
it off？ Just around the hotel？
translations.あ、探検でしょ？\nいいよ、しよっか？:
Oh, like exploring？
Sure, let's do it!
translations.いろいろあるな……\n名産に、宇都宮餃子、\nご当地限定菓子もたくさん……。:
They've got a lot...
Local specialties, Utsunomiya
gyoza, regional snacks...
translations.うん、宇都宮餃子。\nお母さんに頼まれてるの。\n栃木だから、きっとあるって。:
Yeah, Utsunomiya gyoza.
My mom asked for some.
Said since we're in Tochigi,
they're sure to have them.
translations.あ、そうだ！\nさっき、見付けたんだけど、\nゲームコーナー、行ってみよ？:
Oh, right!
I spotted it earlier, but...
wanna check out the arcade？
translations.卓球？\nう～ん、浴衣だからなぁ……。:
Ping-pong？
Mmm, but in a yukata...
I don't know...
translations.浴衣だから、いいんだよっ！:
Being in yukatas is what
makes it great!
translations.そういうもの？\nじゃあ、やる？:
Is that how it works？
Well then, shall we？
translations.もうっ！\nテニス部なんだから、\nちょっと手加減してっ！:
Geez!
You're on the tennis team,
you should go easy on me!
translations.ウソ。右に行ったり\n左に行ったり、わざと、\nやるんだもん。裾が乱れて――:
Liar! You kept hitting left
and right on purpose!
My robe was opening up—
translations.あ……そういうこと？\nもうっ！\n男子ってサイテー！:
Wait... is that why？
Geez!
Boys are the worst!
translations.ハァ……\n誰かさんのせいで\n汗かいちゃった。:
Phew...
I got all sweaty thanks to
a certain someone.
translations.ゴメン……\nそう言えば、貸切風呂の\nチケット貰ったっけ。:
Sorry...
Come to think of it,
didn't we get tickets for
the private bath？
translations.そうしよっか！\nあ、待って、\n水着いるでしょ？:
Let's!
Wait a second,
we need swimsuits, right？
translations.（しっかりしてるよな、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really has her act
together...)
translations.あ、ほら、\nあそこじゃない？:
Oh, look!
Isn't that it over there？
translations.風情があるよね？\n入ろう！:
It's got so much charm!
Let's go in!
translations.ねぇ、木のお風呂って、\n贅沢だよね？\nお殿様みたいで。:
Hey, a wooden bath is so
luxurious, isn't it？
Like being a lord.
translations.ふふ！\nじゃあ、お背中流しましょうか？\nお殿様？:
Fufu!
Shall I wash your back,
milord？
translations.うん。\nじゃあ、先に上がって、\n外で待ってて？:
Yeah.
Can you get out first
and wait outside for me？
translations.だって、水着着たまま\n帰れないでしょ？\n着替えなきゃ……。:
I mean, we can't head back
in our swimsuits, right？
I have to change...
translations.ハァ～～！\n殿サマ気分だ！:
Aaaah!
I feel like a lord!
translations.ふふ、\n修学旅行なのにね？:
Fufu,
even though this is supposed
to be a school trip？
translations.そうだった……。\n本当の修学旅行じゃ、\nさすがに、これは無理だね？:
Oh yeah, right...
On a real school trip,
this'd never happen, huh？
translations.待って。\nそれじゃ、えぇとね。\nう～ん……。:
Wait.
In that case, let's see...
Mmm...
translations.じゃあ、ここでは休憩。\nはい。\n背中流してあげる。:
So we'll take a break here.
Come here,
I'll wash your back.
translations.はぁ……。\nいいお湯だったね～？:
Phew...
That was a nice bath,
wasn't it？
translations.いや、ほら、\n浴衣姿が、似合うなって。:
Well, you know...
That yukata really
suits you.
translations.でしょ？\n素直でよろしい。\nふふ♪:
Right？
Good boy for being honest.
Hehe♪
translations.ねぇ、今、なに考えたか、\nわかっちゃった……。:
Hey, I totally know
what you were just
thinking about...
translations.はい、ここからまた、\n修学旅行だよ？\nふふ▼:
Alright, back to our
school trip now, okay？
Hehe▼
translations.ねぇ、ちょっと、\n遠回りして、部屋に戻らない？:
Hey, want to take the long
way back to the room？
translations.なんでも。\n行こう？:
No reason.
Come on, let's go？
translations.さっきから、なんの事？:
What have you been talking
about this whole time？
translations.ねぇねぇ、\nここって、キャンドルがあって、\nロマンチックじゃない？:
Hey, look...
With the candles and all,
isn't this place romantic？
translations.なにか、言いたくならない？:
Doesn't it make you want
to say something？
translations.ハァ……\nわかんないか、男子には……。:
*sigh*...
Boys just don't get it,
do they...
translations.まくら投げやらなきゃ！:
We have to have
a pillow fight!
translations.まくら投げ？\n……二人で？:
A pillow fight？
...Just the two of us？
translations.ね、やろうやろう！:
Come on, let's do it,
let's do it!
translations.う～ん……\nなんか、違う？:
Hmm...
Doesn't this feel a bit off？
translations.どっちかって言うと、\nキャッチボールだな、これは。:
Feels more like
playing catch than anything.
translations.やられた……\nじゃあ、こっちも！:
You got me...
Take this, then!
translations.ここって、ほら、\nベッドでしょ？\n修学旅行は、お布団だよね？:
I mean, look,
we've got beds here, right？
A school trip needs futons!
translations.ああ、\nそういうイメージだよね？:
Ah, yeah,
that's how you picture it,
huh？
translations.お布団なら、\nゴロゴロ出来るし、\nあ、それにほら！:
With futons, you can
roll around, and oh, look!
translations.お布団かぶって、\n怖い話とか、ね？\nあるでしょ？:
Huddling under the blankets
to tell scary stories...
That's part of it, right？
translations.それなら、ベッドでも出来るよ！: We could do that in bed too!
translations.え……\nでも、それじゃ、\nどっちかのベッドに、ほら……。:
Huh...？
B-But then we'd have to be
in the same bed, you know...
translations.なんか、ダメ……\nなんか、違う気がするもん……。:
That's just, no...
It feels completely
different...
translations.（やっぱ、そうなるか……）:
（Yeah, figured that's
how she'd take it...）
translations.私も……\nそろそろ、寝よっか？:
Me too...
Should we head to bed soon？
translations.ねぇねぇ、\nアレ、やらない？:
Hey, hey...
Wanna do that thing？
translations.修学旅行で、\n電気消したら、やるでしょ？:
You know, what everyone does
on school trips
after lights out？
translations.ほら、好きな人、\n当てっこするの。:
You know, guessing
who each other's crush is!
translations.ああ……\nあるかも。\nでも、二人でやっても……。:
Ah... Yeah, maybe.
Though with just
the two of us...？
translations.いいの♪\nじゃあ、そっちから。\nまずは……。:
It's fine♪
Okay, you go first.
Starting with...
translations.同じクラスの人？: Is it someone in your class？
translations.ふふ、\nわかっちゃった▼\nきっと、相思相愛だよ？:
Hehe, I knew it▼
I bet your feelings
are mutual, you know？
translations.そうしよっか？\nあ、じゃあ、アレまたやろう？:
Shall we？
Oh, wait, wanna play
that game again？
translations.やるんだ、やっぱり……。:
So we're doing this
again, huh...？
translations.はい、いいよ？\n質問して。:
Yup! Go ahead.
Ask me a question.
translations.じゃあ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が\n好きな人は、同じクラス？:
Then, is the person ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
likes in your class？
translations.あれ？\nえぇと、どっちだっけ……。:
Huh？
Umm, wait, which is it...？
translations.だって、今は同級生だもん。:
Well, right now
we're classmates, after all.
translations.ふふ、じゃあ、\nべつのヒントね？\nその人は……。:
Hehe. Okay, how about
another hint？
That person is...
translations.いま、いちばん、\n私の近くにいる人……。:
And the person closest
to me right now...
translations.ふぁ……眠っ。\nちょっと、\n早起きし過ぎたかな…………。:
*Yawn*... Still sleepy.
Did I wake up
a little too early...？
translations.（おっと、\n起こさないようにしなきゃ……）:
(Whoops, I'd better not
wake her up...)
translations.（早く起きて得した……\n昨日、ちゃんと寝たからな！）:
(Waking up early paid off...
Good thing I went to sleep
on time last night!)
translations.（もう少し、\nこうしておこう……）:
(I'll just stay like this
a little longer...)
translations.修学旅行だよ～？\n早く起きない人は、\nイタズラされちゃうよ～？:
It's a school trip, you know~？
Anyone who doesn't wake up
gets pranked~
translations.カワイイ▼\nイタズラ決定で～す。:
You're so cute▼
Prank time it is~
translations.おはよう……\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、今、なんかした？:
Morning...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, did you just
do something？
translations.起きてどっかに行ったのか？\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ー？:
Did she wake up
and go somewhere？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲~？
translations.えっ？\n起きちゃったの？\nこっち来ちゃダメ！:
Huh？
You're awake？
Don't come over here!
translations.……ゴメン、\n着替え中だと思わなくて。:
...Sorry,
I had no idea you were
getting changed.
translations.んっ！\nもうっ、男子ってサイテー！:
Hmph!
Geez, boys are the worst!
translations.はぁ、\nあぶないあぶない。:
Whew,
that was a close one.
translations.誰かさんに覗かれないように、\n寝てるうちにね？:
While you were asleep,
so a certain someone
couldn't peek, right？
translations.信用ないなぁ……。:
You really don't trust me,
do you...
translations.ウソだよ♪\n朝ご飯、出来たって、\n行こう！:
Just kidding♪
Breakfast is ready,
let's go!
translations.すごぉい！\n窓いっぱい、鬼怒川！:
Amazing!
The Kinugawa River fills
the whole window!
translations.和食も洋食も\n色々あるよ！:
There's so much Japanese
and Western food!
translations.和食は\n『おばんざい』だって！\nあ、でもこの匂い……。:
They even have 'obanzai'
for the Japanese food!
Oh, but that smell...
translations.焼き立てのパンだ！\nえ～、もう、どうしよう！:
Fresh-baked bread!
Aww, what should I do!?
translations.でも、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲\n朝からそんなに食べて平気？:
Still, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
can you really eat that much
this early？
translations.だって、\nいろいろ食べたいんだもん。\n食べきれなかったら、ほら。:
Because I want to try
a bit of everything!
If I can't finish it, well...
translations.手伝って♪\nア～ンって、ね？\nふふ▼:
You'll help me♪
Say 'ahh', okay？
Ehehe▼
translations.ありがとうございました。\nまたのお越しを\nお待ちしております。:
Thank you very much.
We look forward to
having you again.
translations.よし、と……\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、お待たせ！:
All right...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, sorry to keep you
waiting!
translations.いいホテルだったね！\n『鬼怒川プラザホテル』。:
That was a great hotel!
The Kinugawa Plaza Hotel.
translations.うん。\nあんな部屋、\nめったに泊まれないもんね？:
Yeah.
It's not every day you get
to stay in a room like that,
right？
translations.そうだ、記念に写真、\n撮って行こう？:
Oh, why don't we take
a souvenir photo before
we go？
translations.あ！\nじゃあ、玉と一緒に！:
Ah!
Let's take it with
the stone ball, then!
translations.ダメ、もっと男子っぽく！: No no, sound more like a guy!
translations.うん、ぐっすり！\nあれ？\n眠れなかった？:
Yep, like a log!
Huh？
Couldn't sleep？
translations.あ、あれだ。\n東武日光行き。:
Oh, that's it.
Bound for Tobu-Nikko.
translations.電車、２つしか\n繋がってないんだ。\nなんか、カワイイ▼:
There are only two cars!
That's kind of cute▼
translations.こういう時こそ、\nなにか男子っぽい知識を披露して\nポイントアップしなきゃ。:
Times like this are when
you show off manly trivia
to score points!
translations.ほら、男子は女子より、\n鉄道とか、詳しいでしょ？:
You know, guys usually know
more about trains than girls
do, right？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n鉄道に興味あったの？:
Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
are you into trains？
translations.違うの。男子が、\n『知ってて当然』みたいに話して\nくれるのが好きなの。女子は:
Nope. Girls just like it
when guys explain things
like it's second nature.
translations.というワケで、ちょっと\nがっかりな２日目の始まり\nなのでした。まる。:
And so, day two starts off
a little bit disappointing.
Period.
translations.（少し、スポットのガイド\n読んどくか……）:
(Maybe I should read up on
some spots in the guide...)
translations.ハァ、ぐっすり寝ちゃった……\nやっぱり自然に囲まれてると、\n夜はよく眠れるね:
Haaah, I slept so well...
Being surrounded by nature
really helps you sleep, huh？
translations.また来たいな、鬼怒川……。:
I want to come back to
Kinugawa again someday...
translations.ほら、東武日光行き。\nあれに乗り換えだ。:
Look, that one's for Tobu-
Nikko. That's our transfer.
translations.あ、２つしか繋がってないんだ？\nカワイイね？ ね？:
Oh, it only has two cars？
Isn't that cute？ Huh？
translations.えぇと……下今市で鬼怒川方面と\n切り離して、ここから日光までは\n２両編成にな:
Well... they uncouple the
Kinugawa cars at Shimo-
Imaichi, so it's a two-car
train from here to Nikko.
translations.へぇ、そうなんだ！\nよく知ってるね～▼:
Ooh, really？
You sure know your stuff,
▼
translations.というワケで、２日目は朝から\n一歩前進の二人でした。まる。\nふふっ。:
And so, day two begins with
our couple taking a step
forward. Period.
Hehe.
translations.ねぇ、あの山。\n面白い形。\n有名な山なのかな……。:
Hey, look at that mountain.
What an interesting shape.
I wonder if it's famous...
translations.へぇ……\nでも、デコボコしてて、\nあんまり富士山ぽくないよ？:
Huh...
It's so bumpy, it doesn't
really look like Mount Fuji？
translations.じゃあ、\n男体山じゃないのかな……。:
Then maybe it's not
Mount Nantai after all...
translations.着いたーっ！\n来たな、日光！:
We made it!
Nikko, here we come!
translations.ここからが、いよいよ\n修学旅行って気がしない？\n……ね？:
Doesn't it feel like our
class trip is finally
starting now？ ...Right？
translations.あ、見えてきたよ、\n男体山。:
Oh, look, you can see it!
Mount Nantai.
translations.日光富士ともいうんだよ？\nね？:
They call it Nikko-Fuji too,
you know？ Neat, huh？
translations.着いたーっ！\nさてと、荷物を預けて\nバスに乗ろう。:
We're here!
All right, let's drop off
our bags and take the bus.
translations.うんうん。\nでも、ほら、\nその前に……ね？:
Mm-hmm.
Wait, but first...
You know what, right？
translations.ここから、\nバスでいろは坂か……。:
From here, we take the bus
up Irohazaka, huh...
translations.“いろはにほへと ちりぬるを”\n……なんだっけ？:
'Iroha nihoheto,
chirinuru wo...'
...Wait, what came next？
translations.あ、ダメ、言わないで！\n思い出すから……\nう～ん……あ、そうだ！:
Ah, wait, don't tell me!
I'm gonna remember it...
Hrmm... Oh, right!
translations.“あさきゆめみし、\nえひもせず”！\nやった！:
'Asaki yumemishi,
ehi mo sezu'!
Nailed it!
translations.なんか、短いよ？:
Isn't that, like...
way too short？
translations.あれ？\nい、ろ、は、に、ほ、へ、と……\n……。:
Huh？
I, ro, ha, ni, ho, he, to...
...
translations.２４文字しかないね……\nちょっと抜けちゃった？:
There's only 24 letters...
Did I skip a little bit？
translations.（だいぶ抜けた気がする……）:
(Pretty sure you skipped
a whole lot...)
translations.おぉ……\nさすが『いろは坂』。\nやっぱり曲がるなぁ……。:
Whoa...
They don't call it Irohazaka
for nothing. So many turns...
translations.ねぇ？\nあ、ほらほら、また！:
Right？
Ah, look look, another one!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、\nこういうの苦手かと思ってた。:
I thought you weren't good
with this kind of thing, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そう？\nジェットコースターは嫌だけど、\nこれは楽しいよ？ あ……。:
Really？ I hate roller coasters,
but this is fun!
...Wait.
translations.もしかして、\n恐がった方がポイント高い？\nお付き合いの前としては？:
Wait, would I score more points
if I acted scared？
For two people before dating？
translations.きゃー▼\nとか、言っちゃったりして。\nどうかな？ ふふっ！:
Like screaming, 'Eek, ▼!'
or something？
How's that sound？ Fufu!
translations.エレベーターで降りるんだ！\nへぇ……。:
We take an elevator down!
Huh, wow...
translations.あっ！\nねぇ、これ滝の音？:
Ah!
Hey, is that the waterfall？
translations.有名な景色が目の前にあるのに\n本当じゃないみたい……\n不思議……。:
Such a famous view right
in front of me, yet it doesn't
even feel real... How strange.
translations.日光にいるんだね、\n私たち……。:
We really are in Nikko,
aren't we...
translations.あれ？\nなんか、\n涙出そうになっちゃった。:
Huh？
For some reason, I feel like
crying all of a sudden.
translations.すごいね……\nねぇ、あれ全部水なんだよ？:
It's incredible...
Hey, every bit of that is water,
you know？
translations.あれ？\n私なんか変な事言ってる……\nふふっ、おかしいね？:
Huh？ Did I say something
weird...？ Hehe, I sound
silly, don't I？
translations.うん、そうなの……\nよかった。:
Yeah, it really is...
I'm glad.
translations.あなたが、そういう気持ち、\n一緒に感じてくれる人で。:
That you're someone who can
feel that way with me.
translations.きっとね、私にとって、\nすごく、大事な事なんだと思う。:
I think that's something
really important to me.
translations.おぉ、中禅寺湖か……。:
Whoa, so this is
Lake Chuzenji...
translations.あ、ほら見て！\nあっちの山！:
Ah, look!
That mountain over there!
translations.ほらほら、富士山みたいでしょ？:
See, see？ Doesn't it look
just like Mt. Fuji？
translations.ああ、そういえば！:
Oh yeah, now that you
mention it!
translations.よそのガイドさんの説明が\n聞こえちゃったんだけど、\nあれ、男体山だって。:
I overheard another guide
explaining it, and apparently
that's Mount Nantai.
translations.じゃあ、さっき電車から\n見えたのは――。:
So then, the one we saw
from the train earlier was—
translations.それも男体山。\nここから見た時に富士山に\nなるの。だから、さっきも正解。:
That's Mount Nantai, too.
It looks like Mt. Fuji from
here, so you were right!
translations.やっぱり自信無かったんだ！:
I knew you weren't
sure after all!
translations.でも、可愛いところも\nあって、いいなと\n思ったのでした。まる。ふふっ！:
Still, I thought having
such a cute side was nice.
Full stop. Heheh!
translations.う～ん、\n今日も風が強いなぁ……。:
Mmh... The wind's
really strong today, too...
translations.湖から吹いてくるな……。:
It's blowing in
from the lake...
translations.ねぇ、こんな風にしてると、\nちょっと、叫びたくならない？:
Hey, when it blows like this,
doesn't it make you
want to shout？
translations.それは、ほら。\nやっぱり、アレでしょ？\n付き合う前の二人なら。:
Well, you know.
It's gotta be *that*, right？
For two people before
they start dating.
translations.『好きだ―！ 姉ヶ崎ーっ！』\nとか。:
"I love you,
Anegasakiii!"
Something like that.
translations.だって、そういうのされた事、\nないもん。:
Well, nobody's ever done
something like that for me.
translations.やっぱり、そういのは、\nもっと真面目じゃないと。\nいつか、またね？:
Something like that really
needs to be more serious.
Maybe someday, okay？
translations.（いつか真面目に\nやらされるのか……）:
(So she's gonna make me
do it seriously someday...？)
translations.おぉっ!?\n下りも曲がるな、いろは坂！:
Whoa!?
Irohazaka's got just as
many curves on the way down!
translations.えぇっ!?\nふくろ、袋は……。:
Whaat!?
A b-bag, where's a bag...
translations.うぅ……\nどうして下りはダメなんだろ……\nもうやだ……。:
Ugh...
Why does going downhill
mess me up so bad...？
I hate this...
translations.はぁ……\nこうしてると、楽……\nごめんね？:
Haa...
Leaning like this helps...
Sorry, okay？
translations.いいけど……\nあ、これはもしかして、\nまた一歩前進の二人？:
I don't mind, but...
Wait, is this another
step forward for us？
translations.日光物産商会。\nここで昼メシの予定だけど……\nやめとく？:
Nikko Bussan Shokai.
We planned to eat lunch
here, but... want to skip it？
translations.わぁ……\nちょっと\nアンティークショップみたいね？:
Wow...
It kind of looks like
an antique shop, huh？
translations.明治創業だって。\n国の登録有形文化財らしい。:
Said it was founded in Meiji.
Apparently it's a registered
cultural property.
translations.そっかぁ……\nこれは来ないとだよね。:
I see...
Then we definitely
had to come, huh.
translations.ゆば弁当『匠』と\n『ハンバーグセット』、\nお待たせいたしました。:
Thank you for waiting.
Here is the "Takumi" Yuba Bento
and the Hamburg Steak Set.
translations.やぁ～、美味しそう♪\nゆば大好き！\nいただきま～す♪:
Ooh, looks delicious♪
I love yuba!
Time to dig in～♪
translations.（さっきまであんなに\n気持ち悪そうだったのに……）:
(And she was looking so sick
just a minute ago...)
translations.ん？\nなぁに？\nちょっとあげよっか？:
Hm？
What is it？
Want a little taste？
translations.タダじゃダメだよ？\nそっちも一口ちょうだい♪\nふふっ！:
Not for free, mister♪
You have to give me
a bite of yours, too♪
Heheh!
