translations.そうだけど、\nでも、なんだか違うの！\nだって、『結婚』って……。:
I know, but...
it feels different!
I mean, 'marriage' is...
translations.ビックリするよ、もうっ……。:
It just took me by surprise,
geez...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と、ずっと一緒だ！\nって……。:
That I'd be together
with you forever, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.あれ？\n●、なんかおかしなこと――:
Huh？
●, did I say
something weird—
translations.ううん……おかしくないよ？\nすごく、うれしい。\n私も、ずっと同じ気持ちだもん:
No... Not at all？
I'm really, really happy.
Because I've felt the exact
same way all along.
translations.あなたに出逢って、\n好きになった時から、\nずっと……。:
Ever since I met you
and fell in love with you...
the whole time...
translations.じゃあ、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、なんて？:
Then what did you vow,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ん、私？\n私は、ほら……。:
Hm, me？
Well, I, you know...
translations.えっと～……\nなんだっけ？\n忘れちゃった、かな？:
Umm...
What was it again？
Maybe I forgot？
translations.だいたい、同じなのっ！\n同じだけど……。:
It's pretty much the same!
The same, but...
translations.もう、ちょっとだけ、\nすごい事……\nヒミツだよ▼:
Just a tiny bit more
special...
It's a secret▼
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と、いつか本当の\n新婚旅行するぞ！\nって……。:
That someday, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
we'd go on a real
honeymoon together!
translations.もし、あなたが、\nぜんぜん違うこと誓ってたら、\nどうしようって、思ってたから:
I was wondering what I'd do
if you'd vowed something
totally different.
translations.いつか、あなたと、\n新婚旅行に行こう、って。\nごっこじゃ、なくて……。:
That someday, you and I
would go on a honeymoon.
Not pretend, but for real...
translations.じゃあ、同じだったんだ！\nやった！:
Then it really was the same!
Yes!
translations.新婚旅行ってことはさ、\nその前にも、色いろあるよね！:
A honeymoon means
there's plenty that has to
happen before that, too!
translations.じゃあ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n●と、け――:
Then, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
will you and ● get mar—
translations.ダメ、今はそこまで……。\nもう少し大人になった時、\nちゃんと申し込んで？:
No, stop right there...
When we're a little older,
ask me properly, okay？
translations.答えは、\nきっと、『はい』だから。\n……ね▼:
Because my answer
will definitely be 'yes.'
...Right, ▼？
translations.もうっ……\nくっついてたら、\n汗かいちゃった、ふふ。:
Geez...
Snuggling up like that
got me all sweaty, hehe.
translations.ハァ～……\n暑くなっちゃった。\nおかしい、ふふ。:
*phew*...
I got so hot.
It's so silly, hehe.
translations.じゃあ、そろそろ行こっか？\n旦那サマ▼:
So, ready to get going,
hubby▼？
translations.ほら、今日も富士山、\nよく見える！:
Look, we can see Mt. Fuji
really clearly today too!
translations.ハァ～、広いなぁ……\nまだ暑いけど、\n風が気持ちいい……。:
Phew, it's so wide open...
It's still warm out,
but the breeze feels nice...
translations.お、いい表情！\nじゃあ、写真撮ろうか？:
Ooh, great expression!
Want me to snap a picture？
translations.うぅ……\nこの時間は、やっぱり寒い～。:
Brr...
It really does get cold
at this time of day~
translations.ほら、空気が澄んでるから、\n夕焼けの富士山、\nすごくきれいだよ？:
Look, the air is so clear,
Mt. Fuji in the sunset
looks gorgeous, doesn't it？
translations.じゃあ、今日もバックにして\n写真撮ろうか？:
Shall we take a picture
with it in the background
today too？
translations.ねぇねぇ、\n今回も、この間みたいに撮れた？:
Hey, hey,
did it turn out like the one
we took the other day？
translations.きれい……\nまた、ハネムーンごっこの\n宝物が出来ちゃったね？:
So pretty...
Looks like we made another
treasure for our pretend
honeymoon, didn't we？
translations.そっか、うん。\nじゃあ……やっぱり今回も、\n聞いちゃおっかな？:
I see, yeah.
Well then... I think I'm gonna
ask you again this time.
translations.そうです。\n昨日、鐘を鳴らす時、\n誓った事。:
That's right.
What you vowed yesterday
when we rang the bell.
translations.いつかきっと、\n二人で本当の新婚旅行をします。\n……ね？:
'Someday, we'll definitely go
on a real honeymoon together.'
...Right？
translations.（うわぁ……さすがに、\nこれは言い辛いなぁ……）:
(Whoa... That's really tough
to say out loud...)
translations.コラ。\nちゃんと、お姉さんの目を見て、\n言ってみなさい！:
Hey now.
Look your big sister in the eyes
and tell me!
translations.わかった……\nエッチな事なんだ……。:
I knew it...
It was something naughty...
translations.ハァ～、\nロマンチックじゃないんだから。\nしょうがないなぁ……。:
*Sigh*...
You're not romantic at all.
I suppose I have no choice...
translations.これでガマンしなさい▼:
You'll just have to make do
with this▼
translations.もちろん、一緒だよ。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と、いつか本当の\n新婚旅行するぞ！ って。:
Of course it's the same.
I vowed that someday I'd go
on a real honeymoon with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.…………うん。\n私だって、わかってたよ？:
......Yeah.
I already knew that,
you know？
translations.でも、やっぱり……\n言葉にすると恥ずかしいね？:
Still...
It's pretty embarrassing to put
into words, isn't it？
translations.うん、ちょっと……。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、顔が赤いよ？:
Yeah, a little...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, your face is red,
you know？
translations.あなたもです！\nもう～、見ないで……。:
Yours is too!
Jeez, don't look at me...
translations.あなたも、来て？\nキスしてれば、\n見えなくなるから……。:
Come here...
If we're kissing,
you won't be able to see...
translations.あれ？\nまだ顔、赤いよ？:
Huh?
Your face is still red,
you know？
translations.しょうがないか？\nハネムーンだもんね？\n旦那サマ▼:
Can't be helped, right？
It's our honeymoon, after all,
hubby▼
translations.きっとそれは、幸せのため息。:
It must've been
a sigh of pure happiness.
translations.幸せすぎて、困っちゃった。\nハァ～……ふふ▼:
I'm just so happy,
it's almost too much.
*Sigh*... Hehe▼
translations.次は、箱根湯本駅、\n箱根湯本駅でございます。\nThe next stop …:
Next stop, Hakone-Yumoto.
Hakone-Yumoto Station.
The next stop...
translations.お土産は、こんなもんか？\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は……まだか。:
Is this enough souvenirs？
Still waiting on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.（遅いな……\nそろそろ時間が――）:
(She's taking a while...
We're almost out of time—)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nまた、ずいぶん買ったね……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you sure bought a lot...
translations.だって、お母さんに頼まれて……\n湯葉でしょ？ 干物、かまぼこ、\nロールケーキ:
Mom asked for all this...
Tofu skin, dried fish,
fish cake, roll cake,
and, um...
translations.もう、買い出しだな……\n自分には、何か買った？:
That's basically grocery shopping...
Did you get anything
for yourself？
translations.いいね。\nデキシーズのみんなには、\nどうする？:
Nice.
What about everyone
at Dixie's？
translations.●も。\nまあ、いいか？\nそんなに気を使わなくても。:
Me too, ●.
Well, who cares？
No need to worry so much.
translations.そういうわけには行かないの！\n二人で休んだんだから、\nもうっ、ちゃんとして。:
We can't do that!
We both took time off,
so come on, be responsible!
translations.う～ん、\nおまんじゅうでいいかな、\nちょっと待ってて？:
Hmm, steamed buns are fine.
Wait here a second, okay？
translations.（結婚したら、\nこんな感じなんだろうか……）:
(Is this what it's like
when you're married...？)
translations.間に合った。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、こっち！:
Made it in time.
Over here, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.あ、来た時と違う電車。\nこれ、ロマンスカー？:
Oh, it's different
from the train on the way here.
Is this the Romancecar？
translations.ほら、乗って乗って！: Come on, get on, get on!
translations.よかった。\nやっぱりロマンスカーで♪:
I'm so glad.
Romancecar really is the best♪
translations.だって、ほら、\nまた無いでしょ？\n椅子の真ん中の、肘掛。:
I mean, look,
it's missing again, right？
The armrest in the middle.
translations.やっぱり、ついつい\n距離が縮まっちゃうみたい。\nね▼:
Looks like we just can't help
getting closer together.
Right▼？
translations.あ～ん、\n大きな駅は、もうっ！:
Aww, big stations are
the worst!
translations.うん、着いちゃったね。\nもう、真っ暗……\n行こっか？:
Yeah, we're back.
It's completely dark out...
Shall we go？
translations.ねぇ、今回は、\n記録更新じゃないよね、\n一緒にいる時間。:
Hey, we didn't break our record
this time, did we？
For time spent together.
translations.そっかそっか……。\nでも、いいんだもん。\n気が付いたから。:
I see, I see...
But that's okay.
Because I realized something.
translations.それは……\n本当は、行く先はどこでも、\nハネムーンになるってこと。:
That...
no matter where we go,
it's always our honeymoon.
translations.本当のハネムーンなら、\n二人でカギをあけて、\n一緒のお家に入るのにね？:
If this were a real honeymoon,
we'd unlock the door and go
into our home together, huh？
translations.やっぱり“ごっこ”は、\n“ごっこ”か……。:
Playing pretend is still
just pretend, after all...
translations.うん……\nこれで、次までガマンできる。\nふふ。:
Mm...
Now I can hold out
until next time. Hehe.
translations.“次までガマン”か……\nハァ～……旅行のあとは、\nいつも寂しくなるな……。:
'Hold out till next time,'
huh... *Sigh*
I always get so lonely
after a trip...
translations.うん。\n旅行のあとは、\nいつも忘れ物しちゃうね▼:
Yeah.
I always seem to forget
something after a trip▼
translations.ごめんね？\n二回も送らせちゃって。:
Sorry, okay？
Making you walk me home
twice like this.
translations.ほら、もう行って？\n寂しくなって、\nまた忘れ物しちゃうから。:
Go on, head off, okay？
If I get lonely, I'll just
'forget' something again.
translations.うちの主人が……\nとか言っちゃって、ふふ！:
'My dear husband...'
Look at me go, hehe!
translations.ハネムーンだもんね？:
We are on our honeymoon,
after all, right？
translations.あ、ここ、\nハネムーンっぽい。:
Oh, this spot feels
just like a honeymoon.
translations.結構、カップル多いね？:
There are quite a few
couples here, aren't there？
translations.やっぱり新婚さんも、\nいるのかな？:
I wonder if there are
newlyweds here too？
translations.やっぱり、蒸し暑い……。\n雨、降らないよね？:
It really is muggy...
It won't rain, will it？
translations.あ、ほら、モミジ！\nいいなぁ、紅葉の箱根。:
Oh look, autumn leaves!
Hakone's fall foliage
is so lovely.
translations.空が高い……。\nうぅ……箱根は\n風が、もう冷たいね？:
The sky looks so high...
Brr... The wind in Hakone
is already chilly, isn't it？
translations.和室なんだ……\nそっかそっか。:
It's a Japanese-style room...
I see, I see.
translations.窓から見える山、\nなんだろう……駒ケ岳？:
I wonder what mountain
that is outside...
Mount Komagatake？
translations.お布団って、\n自分で敷くのかな……\nあ、まだ敷かないよ？:
Do we lay out our own
futons, I wonder...
Ah, not yet, though!
translations.お茶、淹れましょうか？\n旦那サマ▼\nふふ。:
Shall I brew some tea,
hubby▼？
Hehe.
translations.ねぇ、こういう駅って、\nみんな、速足だよね？:
Hey, at stations like this,
everyone walks so fast,
don't they？
translations.歩き方のルールが\nあるのかな……？:
Is there some kind of rule
for how to walk here...？
translations.一番前、窓が大きいね……。:
The window in front
is huge...
translations.温泉街って感じがするねぇ……。:
It really feels like
a hot spring town...
translations.海、見えないかな……。:
I wonder if we'll be able
to see the ocean...
translations.わぁ、\n落ち葉がすごい……。:
Whoa, look at all
these fallen leaves...
translations.お庭も凄いなぁ……。:
The garden is pretty
amazing, too...
translations.きれいだな……\nどうやって作るんだろ？:
It's so pretty...
I wonder how they
make this？
translations.ねぇ、\nヨーロッパのお城って、\nこんな感じかな？:
Hey...
I wonder if European
castles are like this？
translations.あ、闘牛の絵。\nスペイン風なのかな……。:
Oh, a bullfight painting.
I wonder if this is
Spanish-style...
translations.テラス、気持ちよさそう。\n出てもいいのかな？:
The terrace looks
so nice.
Can we go out there？
translations.すご～い、\nモクモクしてる……。:
Whoa...
Look at all that steam
billowing up...
translations.う～ん……\nこの匂いがね……。:
Mmm...
This smell is really
something...
translations.あの鳥居、箱根神社かな？:
I wonder if that torii
is Hakone Shrine？
translations.ん～……\nパワー、感じる？:
Mmm...
Can you feel the power？
translations.神社の境内って、\n自然と声が小さくならない？:
When you're at a shrine,
don't you just naturally
lower your voice？
translations.ここが、全部、\n離宮だったのかな？:
Was all of this really
an imperial villa？
translations.これぜ～んぶ、\nお庭だったってこと？\nわ～……。:
You mean all of this
was just the garden？
Whoa...
translations.あんまりハネムーンぽく\nないね？ ふふ。:
It doesn't feel much
like a honeymoon,
does it？ Hehe.
translations.ねぇねぇ……\nくっついちゃおっか？\nふふ！:
Hey, hey...
Wanna cuddle up close？
Hehe!
translations.あれ……お前、\nなんでこんな所に!?:
Huh...？ Wait, what are
you doing here!?
translations.なんでって、修学旅行だろ？\n寝ぼけてんのか？:
What d'you mean？ We're on
our school trip!
Still half-asleep？
translations.のん気に寝てる場合じゃねーぞ！\n姉ヶ崎が、なんか用あるってさ。\n河原で待って:
No time to be snoozing!
Anegasaki says she needs you.
She's waiting by the river.
translations.姉ヶ崎が……\nつーか、お前、“姉ヶ崎”って、\n偉そうに――:
Anegasaki...？
Wait, who gave you the right
to call her just 'Anegasaki'--？
translations.はぁ？\n姉ヶ崎は姉ヶ崎だろ……\nまだ寝ぼけてんのか？:
Huh？
She's Anegasaki, isn't she...？
Are you still half-asleep？
translations.クッソー、なんで姉ヶ崎が、\nこんなヤツに……\nとにかく、伝言つたえたからな？:
Dammit, why's Anegasaki
into a guy like you...？
Anyway, I passed on the
message, alright？
translations.（どうなってんだ……？\nとにかく、行ってみるか……）:
(What is going on...？
Guess I'll go check it out...)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nこんな所に呼び出して、\nなんだろう……）:
(I wonder why ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
called me out here...)
translations.嬉しい……\n来てくれたんだ……。:
I'm so glad...
You really came...
translations.どうしたの、こんな所で？:
What's wrong？
Calling me out here...
translations.わたし、\nどうしても、この旅行中に、\n言いたい事があって……。:
There's something...
I just had to tell you
on this trip...
translations.ハァ……\nどうしよう、やっぱり\n怖くなっちゃった……。:
Phew...
What do I do...？
I'm getting scared after all...
translations.なんか、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲らしく\nないな。\n大丈夫だから、話してよ？:
That doesn't sound like you
at all, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
It's okay, you can tell me.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n私のこと……どう思ってる？:
▲主人公＊▲.
How do you... feel about me？
translations.待って！\nいいの、わかってる……\n友達、だよね？:
Wait!
It's fine, I know...
We're just friends, right？
translations.でも、私は……私はね？\nあなたの事、\nずっと好きだった……。:
But I... The truth is,
I've liked you for so long...
translations.1年で、同じクラスに\nなった時から、ずっと……。:
Ever since we were put
in the same class freshman year...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……\nん？\nちょっと待って……同じクラス？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Wait.
Hold on... same class？
translations.こんな事言ったら、もう、\n今までみたいに友達で\nいられなくなっちゃうよね？:
If I tell you this, we won't
be able to stay friends like
before, will we？
translations.でも、苦しくて……\nこのままじゃ、私もう……。\nだから、決めたの。:
But it hurts so much...
I can't take it anymore...
So I decided.
translations.修学旅行中に、\nあなたに告白するって。:
I decided I'd confess
to you on this trip.
translations.付き合ってください、私と。\n好きなの……。\nあなたの彼女になりたいの……。:
Please go out with me.
I love you...
I want to be your girlfriend...
translations.本当に好きなら抱きしめて！\nガバーッと！:
If you really love me,
hug me! Squeeze me tight!
translations.ガ、ガバーッと？\nよし……\nじゃあ……行くよ？:
S-Squeeze you tight？
Alright...
Here goes...
translations.夢か……\nずいぶん生々しかったけど……。:
A dream...？
Felt pretty vivid, though...
translations.大丈夫……？\nうなされてたよ……。:
Are you okay...？
You were having a nightmare...
translations.はぁ～～！\nいい湯だった！:
Aaah!
That was a great soak!
translations.（いくらなんでも、遅いな……\n先に部屋に帰ったのかな？）:
(She's taking pretty long...
Did she already go back to
the room？)
translations.ただいま。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、帰ってる？:
I'm back.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you in here？
translations.（ん？\n部屋の露天風呂に、\n誰か入ってる？）:
(Hm？
Is someone in our room's
open-air bath？)
translations.はぁ～～\nいいお湯……極楽極楽♪:
Haaah...
Such nice water...
Pure bliss♪
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲らしき声が……\nでも、不審者かもしれない！）:
(That sounded like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Wait, what if it's
an intruder？)
translations.（しょうがない……\nここは、確認しないとな。\n少し、開けてみるか……）:
(Can't be helped...
Gotta go make sure.
I'll just slide it open a bit...)
translations.（のように見えるけど……\nいや、まだまだよく見えない！）:
(It looks like her, but...
No, I can't really tell yet!)
translations.（そうか、もうちょい、\nこう、横から見れば……）:
(Right, if I just look
a little more from the side...)
translations.（ダメだ!!\n湯気かっ！ \n湯気が邪魔なんだっ！）:
(No good!!
Curse this steam!
It's totally in the way!)
translations.（こんな時は……\nそうだ、吹けばいいんだ！）:
(At times like this...
Right, I just have to blow on it!)
translations.やっ、なにっ？\n誰っ!? 覗き!?:
Wait, what？
Who's there!? A peeper!?
translations.いやーッ！\n先生ー、男子がっ！\n男子が覗いてますーっ！:
Nooo!
Teacherrr, a boy!
A boy is peeping on meee!
translations.ちょっと待って！\nこれにはワケがっ!!:
Wait a second!
There's a reason for this!!
translations.……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？\nなに、どうかした？:
...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
What is it, something wrong？
translations.もうっ、\nホントに寝ちゃうかなぁ。\nふふ。:
Jeez, I can't believe
you really fell asleep.
Fufu.
translations.ゴメン……。\nって言うか、どうしちゃったの、\nその格好？:
Sorry...
Wait, what's with that outfit？
translations.着替えちゃったの。\nカワイイでしょ？:
I changed into it.
Cute, right？
translations.なんでって、\n新婚旅行でしょ？\nこういうの、好きかなって。:
Why？ Because it's our
honeymoon, right？
I thought you might like this.
translations.好き……。\nいや、ちょっと待って。\nそれは、つまりその～……。:
I do...
Wait, hold on.
Does that mean, like, uh...
translations.ふふ。\nねぇ、こっち、来ない？:
Fufu.
Hey, won't you come over here？
translations.えぇっ!?\nいやでも、さっき二人で――:
Wait, what!?
B-But earlier we already—
translations.いいの、それは。\nね、おいでおいで？\n旦那サマ▼:
Never mind that.
Come on, come here.
Hubby▼
translations.じゃ、じゃあ……\nせっかくだから、ちょっと――:
W-Well, then...
Since you're offering, maybe just—
translations.だよな……夢だよな！\nそれにしても、\nすごい夢だった……。:
Right... It was a dream!
Still, though,
that was one crazy dream...
translations.どうしたの……!?\n大きな声出して……。:
What happened...!?
Shouting out loud like that...
translations.まだ、まゆ玉の中？\nあんまり長く入ってると\n身体に良くないよ～？:
Still in the cocoon bath？
Staying in too long isn't
good for you, you know～？
translations.それもそうだ。\nそろそろ出よう……。:
Good point.
Time to get out, I guess...
translations.お～い。\nいい湯だね♪:
Heeey.
The water feels great, huh♪
translations.そうだけど……いや！\nここ男湯だよ!?\n入って来ちゃったの？:
Yeah, but... Wait!
This is the men's bath!?
Did you just come right in？
translations.来ちゃったの▼\nだって、せっかく新婚さん\nなんだもん。一緒に……ね？:
Sure did▼
I mean, we're on our honeymoon,
after all. Let's bathe together... okay？
translations.なぁに？\n照れてるの？\nおかしいよ、夫婦なのに。:
What is it？
Are you blushing？
That's silly, when
we're married and all.
translations.いや、でも……\nちょっと、確認なんだけど、\nそのタオルの下って……。:
I mean, sure, but...
Just checking, but
what's under that towel...？
translations.それは、ご想像にお任せします。\nふふ▼:
I'll leave that to
your imagination.
Hehe▼
translations.（よく見えないけど、\nさすがに、水着だよな？\nでも、もし違うとマズイし……）:
(I can't see clearly,
but surely she's got a
swimsuit on, right？
Though if she doesn't,
that'd be bad...)
translations.（そうだ、\nもうちょい、横から見れば……）:
(Right, if I just
look from the side
a bit more...)
translations.（あぁっ!!\n湯気っ！ 湯気が邪魔だっ！）:
(Aargh!! The steam!
The steam's in the way!)
translations.（しょうがない……\n吹いてみるしかない……）:
(Nothing else for it...
I'll just have to try
blowing it away...)
translations.くっそー!!\nなんて湯気だっ！\n完璧にガードしてやがるっ！:
Dammit!!
What is with this steam!?
It's got her completely
shielded!
translations.なに？\n湯気がどうしたの？:
What is it？
What about the steam？
translations.……え？\nいや、こっちのこと！:
...Huh？
N-No, nothing!
Just talking to myself!
translations.ふふ、変なの。\nほら、風邪ひいちゃうよ？\n早く入りなさい、ア・ナ・タ▼:
Hehe, you're weird.
Look, you'll catch a cold.
Hurry on in,
d-a-r-l-i-n-g▼
translations.は、はい。\nそれじゃ、失礼します……\nよいしょっと――あれ？:
Y-Yes.
Excuse me, then...
All right――huh？
translations.……待てよ？\nたしか、\n前にも似たような事が……。:
...Wait a second？
Didn't something like
this happen before...？
translations.ねえ、あなたって実は、\nスゴイ人なんじゃない？:
Hey, are you secretly,
like, super amazing？
translations.あんなのスラスラ\n解いちゃうなんて……\n天才、なのかも。:
Solving that so easily...
Maybe you really are
a genius.
translations.このままいくと、\n博士や科学者になって、\nいくつも大発明をして……。:
At this rate, you'll be
a scientist or professor,
making huge inventions...
translations.大きな賞をもらって、\n世界の有名人に選ばれて、\n取材に引っ張りだこで……。:
winning big awards,
becoming world-famous,
getting swarmed with
interviews...
translations.そんなことになったら、\n二人の時間がほとんど\nなくなっちゃう。:
If that happens,
we won't have any
time together.
translations.勉強もいいけど……\n私も、ね？:
Studying is great, but...
pay attention to me, too,
okay？
translations.（化学の実験発表、\n完璧だったな！\n先生も驚いてたし……）:
(That chemistry lab
presentation went great!
Even the teacher looked
surprised...)
translations.うん……\nあなたってやっぱり\nスゴイんだ。:
Yeah...
You really are amazing,
after all.
translations.何回惚れ直したらいいのか\nわからないくらい。:
I don't even know
how many times I can fall
for you all over again.
translations.（よし、これからも\nがんばるぞ!!）:
(All right!
I'm gonna keep giving it
my all!!)
translations.ねえ、\n私にも勉強法、教えて？:
Hey,
teach me how you study,
too？
translations.いいけど、特別なことは\nしてないと思うよ？:
Sure, but I don't think
I'm doing anything
special, you know？
translations.あなたのやり方を\n真似したら、私も\n理数系が得意になるかも。:
If I copy you, maybe I'll
get good at math and
science too.
translations.あっ、今、\nまさか～って顔した！:
Ah! You just made
a 'no way' face!
translations.しました。\nお詫びに、出来るように\nなるまで面倒見なさい？:
You did too.
To make up for it, you
have to tutor me until
I get it, okay？
translations.それ以上頭良くなっちゃ\nダメ。:
Don't go getting
any smarter than that.
translations.先輩の立場、\nなくなっちゃう。:
I'll lose my place
as your upperclassman.
translations.ふふっ、困ってる。\nかわいい▼:
Hehe, look at you flustered.
So cute▼
translations.ごめん。\nあんまりよくできるから、\n少し妬いちゃった。:
Sorry. You're just so good
at it, I got a little
jealous.
translations.（物理の抜き打ちテストで\n満点……\n●もけっこうやるな！）:
(A perfect score on a pop
physics quiz...
●'s pretty good!)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n無理してない？:
▲主人公＊▲.
You aren't pushing
yourself too hard, are you？
translations.してないよ。\nどうして？:
I'm not.
Why do you ask？
translations.出来すぎる彼を持つと、\n彼女は心配になっちゃうの。:
When your boyfriend is
an overachiever, a girl
can't help but worry.
translations.大丈夫。\n無理してないよ。:
I'm fine.
I'm not pushing myself.
translations.うん。\n私、そういうの\nぜんぜんだもん。:
Yeah.
I'm totally useless with
that sort of thing.
translations.じゃあ、\n●も目指そうかな。:
Then maybe ● should
aim for that, too.
translations.あなたのことを\n言ってるんだよ？:
I'm talking about you,
you know？
translations.というより……\nあなたがそうだから、\nいいのかも。:
Or maybe...
I just like it because
it's you.
translations.すごい！\n漢詩の暗記テスト、\nパーフェクトだったんだ！:
Incredible!
You got a perfect score
on your Chinese poetry test!
translations.はは。ラッキーが\n重なったっていうか……。:
Haha. It was just a streak
of good luck, mostly...
translations.ううん。\nあなたの実力だって、\nちゃんとわかってるよ？:
Nuh-uh.
I know full well
it's all your own skill,
you know？
translations.うまくいったときくらい、\n威張っていいんだから。\nね？ ほら。:
You're allowed to brag
a little when you do well.
Come on, show off a bit!
translations.じゃあ……\nどうだ！:
Well then...
How do ya like that!
translations.うん。\nよくがんばりました▼:
Hehe.
You did such a good job▼
translations.あなたの現国のレポート、\nカンペキだって職員室で\n噂になってるみたいだよ？:
Word in the teachers' room
is that your modern lit
report was totally flawless,
you know？
translations.私の出る幕、\nぜんぜんないみたい。\nさびしいなぁ。:
Looks like there's no room
for me to help at all.
I feel kind of left out.
translations.いやいや、まだまだ\n頼りにしてますって。:
No, no way,
I'm still totally
relying on you!
translations.ふふ、そっか。\n私ももっと、\nがんばらなくちゃ。:
Hehe, okay then.
I'd better work even harder
for you, too.
translations.オススメの参考書、\n教えてあげようか。:
Want me to recommend
some good study guides？
translations.お、助かる。: Oh, that'd be a big help.
translations.ふふ、こんなときは\nひとつ年上でよかったなって\n思っちゃう。:
Hehe, times like this,
I'm really glad
I'm a year older than you.
translations.だってあなた、すっごく\nよく出来るんだもの。:
Because you're just
so good at everything.
translations.１年リードしてないと、\nとてもじゃないけど\n追いつけないくらい。:
If I didn't have a one-year
head start, there's no way
I could keep up with you.
translations.でも、１年先輩な分、\n教えてあげられることが\nあってよかった。:
Still, being a year ahead,
I'm glad there are things
I can teach you.
translations.（やる気が湧いてきた……\nこれからもがんばるぞ！）:
(I'm feeling so motivated...
I'll keep giving it my all!)
translations.謙遜しちゃって。\nさっきの授業、先生に\n褒められたって聞いたよ？:
Look at you being modest.
I heard the teacher praised
you in class earlier, you know？
translations.あなたの情報は\nすぐにキャッチする\n特殊能力を持ってるの。:
I have a special superpower
that picks up info about you
right away.
translations.そう、あなた専用。\nふふっ。:
That's right, just for you.
Hehe.
translations.あなたって実は、\n古代からタイムワープして\nきたんじゃない？:
Are you sure you didn't
time-travel here from
ancient times？
translations.そんなに古文をスラスラ\n読めちゃう現代人、\n滅多にいないよ？:
There aren't many people
today who can read classical
Japanese that smoothly, you know？
translations.あります。\nもう、バイリンガルって\n言ってもいいくらい。:
Oh, absolutely.
You're practically bilingual
at this point!
translations.すごいなんてもんじゃない。\nすっっっごくすごいよ！\nふふ▼:
Amazing doesn't even
begin to cover it.
It's suuuuuper amazing!
Hehe▼
translations.（努力してきて\n本当によかった……！）:
(I'm so glad I put in
all that hard work...!)
translations.（漢字テストは100点、\n質問にも全部答えられたし……\nよし、バッチリだ！）:
(A hundred on the kanji test,
and I answered every question...
Alright, nailed it!)
translations.気を緩めちゃダメよ？\n今の状態をキープすること。:
Don't let your guard down,
okay？ You've gotta keep
this up.
translations.あなたが描いた絵、\n見たよ。:
I saw that picture
you painted.
translations.なかなかうまく描けたと\n思うんだけど、どうかな。:
I thought it turned out
pretty well. What did you
think？
translations.ステキだった……\nこう、胸がぎゅっと\nしめつけられる感じ。:
It was wonderful...
Like it gave my heart
a little squeeze.
translations.あったかくて、優しくて、\nいつまでも見てたいって思う。:
It's so warm and gentle,
I feel like I could look
at it forever.
translations.（やった。\nがんばったかいが\nあったな）:
(Sweet!
All that hard work
really paid off.)
translations.作品には、そのときの気持ちが\n表れるって言うけど……。:
They say your artwork
shows how you were feeling
at the time, though...
translations.あなたの作品を見てると、\nしあわせな気分に\nなってくるの。:
Whenever I look at your art,
it just makes me feel
so happy.
translations.それは……\n●がしあわせだって\nことかな。:
Does that mean...
● was feeling happy？
translations.……もう。\nなんだか強制したみたい。:
...Geez.
Now it feels like I forced
you to say that.
translations.でも、それなら、これは\n二人の共同作品ってこと……\nかな？:
Still, if that's true,
does that make this our
joint creation... maybe？
translations.わぁ、その絵、\n力作じゃない？:
Whoa, that painting is
quite the masterpiece,
isn't it？
translations.短時間で描いたわりには、\nうまくいったかな。:
For something I did so fast,
I think it turned out
pretty well.
translations.うん、すごくステキ。\n部屋に飾っておきたいくらい。:
Yeah, it's really lovely.
I almost want to hang it
in my room.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に\n褒められると、素晴らしい\n作品に見えてきた。:
Hearing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ praise it
makes it really look like
a masterpiece.
translations.ふふ。\n誰が見ても、\nいい絵だと思うよ？:
Hehe.
Anyone who sees it would
think it's great, okay？
translations.ねえ、\n本格的に習ってみたら？:
Hey,
why not take proper lessons？
translations.うん。\n授業で描くだけじゃ、\nもったいないよ。:
Yeah.
It's a waste to only
draw in class.
translations.私も詳しいわけじゃないけど、\n才能あるって思うもの。:
I'm no expert, but I really
think you've got talent.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に\n言われると、その気に\nなってくるな……。:
Hearing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ say that
makes me feel like
I really could...
translations.本気だよ？\nいざというときは\n全力で応援するから、ね？:
I'm serious, you know？
If you do, I'll be cheering
with all I've got, okay？
translations.わぁ……その絵、\nすっごく気合入ってるね？:
Whoa... You really put
a lot into that painting,
didn't you？
translations.うん。\nだって、今にも\n飛び出してきそうだもん。:
Yeah.
Because it looks ready
to jump right out at you.
translations.だからね、物陰から猛獣が\n飛び出してきそうなの。\nすっごくリアル！:
I know, but it feels like
a beast could jump out from
the shadows! It's so real！
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の\n想像力もすごいな……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s imagination
is pretty wild too...)
translations.個性的な作品だね？\nあなたらしいって\n言うのかな。:
It's quite a unique piece,
isn't it？ Very 'you',
I guess you could say.
translations.そうだなぁ……\n優しくて、かわいくて、\nちょっと微笑ましくて……。:
Let's see...
Gentle, cute, and kind of
endearing...
translations.それから、けっこう\nたくましい所もあるし……。:
Plus, you can be
surprisingly manly, too...
translations.（作品の話、だよな？）:
(She IS talking about
the painting, right？)
translations.音楽ってセンスよね……。:
Music really comes down
to natural talent, huh...
translations.努力ももちろんあるけど、\nやっぱりセンスが\n大事だと思うの。:
Effort matters, of course,
but having natural talent
is what really counts.
translations.あなたって、\nセンスの塊よね。:
And you're just overflowing
with natural talent.
translations.あるってば。\n私が保証する。:
Oh, you are.
I guarantee it.
translations.うん。\n私、ファンに\nなっちゃったもの。:
Yup.
I've totally become
a fan of yours.
translations.貴重なファン第一号\nなんだから、\n大切にしなくちゃ、ね？:
I'm your precious first fan,
so you'd better treat me
really well, okay？
translations.それじゃ、\nがんばったご褒美に――:
Well then, as a reward
for working so hard--
translations.ふふ。今、\nどんな期待をしたのかな？:
Hehe. Now what were you
expecting just now？
translations.じゃあ、いいよ。\nそれで。:
Well, fine then.
We'll leave it at that.
translations.えっ？\nえっと……\n……そんなにスゴイご褒美？:
Huh？
Um... were you expecting
THAT big of a reward？
translations.音楽の授業なんて、\nなくなっちゃえばいいのに。:
I kind of wish music class
would just disappear.
translations.だって……\nあなたが歌ってるとこ、\nかっこいいんだもの。:
Because... you look so cool
whenever you sing.
translations.みんなに見せるの、\nもったいないじゃない？\nひとりじめしたいなって。:
It feels like a waste
showing you off to everyone.
I want you all to myself.
translations.気持ち良さそうに\n歌うんだね。:
You look like you're
having so much fun singing.
translations.ふふ、\n思い出しただけで、こう……\nふふふっ。:
Hehe.
Just thinking about it,
I just... hehehe.
translations.あ、複雑そうな顔してる。\nそんな顔も、かわいい▼:
Aw, you look so conflicted.
Even that face is cute, ▼.
translations.歌も演奏も完璧！\n非の打ちどころがないって\nこういうことを言うんだね。:
Your singing and playing
were both perfect!
I guess that's what they mean
by totally flawless.
translations.そんなことない。\nさっきのあなた、すごく\nいい顔してて、魅力的で……。:
Not at all!
You had such a wonderful look
on your face, so charming...
translations.ますます好きに\nなっちゃうじゃない。\nもう、どうしよう～。:
You're just making me
fall for you even harder.
Geez, what am I gonna do？
translations.（照れるな……\nでも、がんばって\nよかった！）:
(Man, I'm blushing...
But I'm really glad
I gave it my all!)
translations.ふふ、わかってるくせに。:
Hehe, like you don't
already know.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の口から\n聞きたいなぁ。:
I want to hear it
straight from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.うん。堂々として、\n自信たっぷりで……\n私もそんな風に歌えたらなぁ。:
Yeah. So poised and
full of confidence...
I wish I could sing
like that, too.
translations.でも、あんまり\nがんばられちゃうと\n心配だな。:
Still, if you push
yourself too hard,
I start to worry.
translations.大丈夫だって。\n心配性だなあ。:
I'll be fine.
You're such a worrywart.
translations.それはそうよ。\nだって、あなたのことだもん。:
Well, of course I am.
It's you, after all.
translations.心配しすぎだっていうのは\nわかってるんだけど……\n気をつけてね？:
I know I worry
too much, but...
please be careful, okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を\n心配させるような\n無茶なことはしないよ。:
I won't do anything
reckless to make you
worry, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.うん。\nあんまり元気で、\n飛んで行っちゃいそう。:
Yeah. You're so energetic,
looks like you're
about to take off.
translations.はは、確かに動き足りない\nかもしれないな。:
Haha, yeah, I might
still have some steam
to blow off.
translations.じゃあ、\n余った分は私にちょうだい？:
Then why don't you
give the extra to me？
translations.あっ、来た来た。\n元気になれそう！:
Ah, here it comes!
I feel energized already!
translations.見てた、見てた。\nマラソン、速かったね？:
I sure was!
You were so fast
in that marathon,
weren't you？
translations.自己ベストを\n更新したんじゃないかな。:
I think I might've
set a new personal best.
translations.……やだ、私、\nさっきからすごいしか\n言ってないね？:
...Oh geez, all I've
been saying is 'amazing'
this whole time, huh？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にだったら\n何度でも言われたいけどな。:
If it's from you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I'd happily hear it
a hundred times.
translations.スゴイ！ ラスト１秒で\n３ポイントシュートなんて、\nプロの選手みたい！:
Amazing! A three-pointer
with one second left？
You looked like a pro!
translations.あれはたまたま、\nパスのタイミングが\n良かったっていうか。:
That was just luck,
mostly. The pass was
timed really well.
translations.それでも、簡単に\n出来ることじゃないもの。\nでしょ？:
Even so, it's not
easy to pull off.
Right？
translations.もう……\nどこまでカッコよく\nなっちゃうつもり？:
Jeez... Just how cool
do you plan on getting？
translations.私、ずっと\n応援してたんだよ？:
I was cheering for you
the whole time, you know？
translations.なぁんだ、\n私の声、届かなかったんだ。\n残念……。:
Aww, you didn't hear me？
What a shame...
translations.ふふ、いいの。\nそれだけ集中してたって\nことでしょ？:
Hehe, it's fine.
Just means you were
that focused, right？
translations.やる時は全力でやる。\nあなたのそういうところが\n好きなんだもん。:
Giving it everything
when it counts.
That's what I love
about you, after all.
translations.見てたよ？\n大活躍だったね。:
I was watching!
You were incredible out there.
translations.ああ、今日は絶好調！: Yeah, I'm on a roll today!
translations.はぁ……\nやっぱり同じ学年だったら\nよかったな。:
*Sigh*...
I really wish we were
in the same grade.
translations.そうすればあなたの活躍を\nもっとたくさん\n見ていられるでしょ？:
That way, I'd get to see
you shine a whole lot more,
wouldn't I？
translations.活躍してないとこも\n見せちゃうかも？:
You might catch me looking
not so cool, though？
translations.ふふ、あなたなら\n何でもいいみたい▼:
Hehe, when it's you,
I think I'd love seeing
any side of you▼
translations.こーら。\nなんでも一人で\nやっちゃわないの。:
Hey, now.
Don't go doing everything
by yourself.
translations.仕事、お姉さんに\n少しはとっといて？\n暇になっちゃうじゃない。:
Leave some work for your
big sister, will you？
I'll have nothing to do.
translations.ふふっ。\nなんて、あなたがいてくれて\n本当に助かってる。:
Hehe.
Just kidding, having you here
is really a lifesaver.
translations.これからも頼りに\nしてるから、ね？:
I'll keep counting on you
from now on too, okay？
translations.（よし、期待に応えて\nこれからもがんばるぞ！）:
(All right, I'll keep
giving it my all to live up
to her expectations!)
translations.見てたよ？ サービス満点\nだって、お客様に\n褒められてたでしょ。:
I saw that, you know.
The customer said your service
was great, didn't they？
translations.あれはたまたま、\nみんなの代表で言われたって\nいうか……。:
That was just luck...
More like they said it
for all of us, really...
translations.ふふ、謙遜しちゃって。\nよくがんばりました。:
Hehe, so modest.
You did a wonderful job.
translations.でも、たまには頼ってね？\n一人でがんばり\nすぎないように。:
Just lean on me sometimes,
okay？ Don't push yourself
too hard all alone.
translations.ふふ、そういうとこは\n後輩だなぁ。:
Hehe, you really are
my underclassman like that.
translations.私は、あなたのおかげで\n楽させてもらっちゃってる\nから。:
I got to take it easy today,
all thanks to you.
translations.うん。だって、私がやろうと\nする前に、あなたが\nやっちゃうんだもの。:
Yeah. You beat me to it
before I can even start
on anything.
translations.もう、あなたがここに\nいなかった頃のことなんて、\n思い出せないなぁ。:
I can't even remember
what it was like around here
before you joined.
translations.それだけあなたを\n頼ってるってこと▼:
That's how much
I rely on you▼
translations.（そうか……\nこれからも期待に応えて\nいかなくちゃな！）:
(Man...
I'd better keep working hard
to live up to her expectations!)
translations.あなたと一緒だと、\n仕事が楽しいな。:
Working with you is
so much fun.
translations.はは、今日はとくに\n順調だからな！:
Haha, especially today,
since everything's going
so smoothly!
translations.仕事ができるのもあるけど、\nそれだけじゃないよ？:
Getting a lot done is nice,
but that's not all of it,
you know？
translations.あなたとだから楽しいの。\n他の誰も、代わりには\nなれないんだから。:
It's fun because it's you.
Nobody else could ever
take your place.
translations.あ、照れてる。\nかわいいなぁ▼:
Aw, you're blushing.
You're so cute▼
translations.はは、●も今\nそう思ってたとこ。:
Haha, ●, I was just
thinking the same about you.
translations.ふふ、いい顔。\n私も嬉しくなっちゃう。:
Hehe, look at that face.
It makes me happy too.
translations.でも……ちょっと\nもったいないかな？:
Though... maybe it's
a little bit of a waste？
translations.あなたのそういう顔、\nできれば一人占め\nしたいなぁ、なんて……。:
I kind of wish I could
keep that look on your face
all to myself, though...
translations.おつかれさま。\n今日はあなたに何度も\n助けられちゃった。:
Good work today.
You really saved me
so many times.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も\nおつかれ。:
Good work to you
too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.私は、ぜんぜん。\nずっとあなたに\n頼りっぱなしだったし。:
Not at all.
I was leaning on you
the entire time.
translations.これからも\n頼りにしてるから、ね？:
I'll keep counting on you
from now on, okay？
translations.ふふ、ホント\n頼もしくなっちゃって▼:
Hehe, look at you,
getting so dependable...▼
translations.あ、ごめんなさい。\n近くに来たら、\n急に意識しちゃって……。:
Ah, sorry.
Now that you're up close,
I got all flustered...
translations.泳いでる姿を見て\nかっこいいって\n思ってたけど……。:
I was already thinking
how cool you looked
swimming out there, but...
translations.そうして立ってるだけでも\nかっこいい……▼:
even just standing there,
you look so handsome...▼
translations.（それを言うなら\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のほうが……）:
(If we're talking looks,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is way more...)
translations.リレー、\nダントツの一番だったね！:
You won that relay
by a mile!
translations.みんながうまく繋いで\nくれたからな。:
Everyone on the team
did a great job
passing it off to me.
translations.あなたが一番で\nゴールしたとき、\n叫びそうになっちゃった。:
When you crossed the line
in first place,
I almost screamed.
translations.今ゴールしたの、\n私の彼だよって。\nかっこいいでしょって。:
'The guy who just finished
is my boyfriend!
Isn't he so cool？'
translations.ん～、やっぱり叫びたい！\nあとで友達に\n自慢しちゃおっと。:
Mmm, I still want to!
I'm gonna brag to my
friends about you later.
translations.（ここまで\n喜んでもらえるなんて……\nがんばった甲斐があったな）:
(Seeing her this happy...
Giving it my all was
totally worth it.)
translations.なんだか、眠れないね？:
Can't seem to sleep,
can we？
translations.明日の朝、\n目が覚めても一緒なんだね？:
Tomorrow morning,
when we wake up,
we'll still be together？
translations.ふぁ～～……\nそろそろ、寝よっか？:
Yaaawn...
Ready to head to bed？
translations.ううん？\n手、繋いでくれるかな？:
Nothing...
Will you hold my hand？
translations.男の子は、\nすぐにこれなんだから！:
You boys are always
so quick to do this!
translations.羞恥心を持たなきゃダメ。:
You've gotta have
a little shame, you know？
translations.もう！ み～んな見てるでしょ？:
Jeez! Everyone's looking
right at us, you know？
translations.こら！ 狼モードはダメよ？:
Hey! No going wolf mode
on me, okay？
translations.もう！ すぐえっちな\n顔するんだから……。:
Jeez! You get that pervy
look on your face so fast...
translations.私はいいんだけど・・・・・ね？:
Not that I mind,
but... you know？
translations.2人きりの時にね？:
Save it for when it's
just the two of us, okay？
translations.これくらいで……ね？:
Let's leave it at that...
okay？
translations.また今度にしよっ。:
Let's save the rest
for next time.
translations.もう！\nイタズラっ子なんだから。:
Jeez! You really are
such a little rascal.
translations.今度はちゃんと\n受け止めるから……\nゴメンね。:
I'll be properly ready
for you next time...
I'm sorry.
translations.飽きちゃったのかな……？: Did you get bored of me...？
translations.いつでも、待ってるからね？:
I'm always waiting
for you, okay？
translations.もっと、\n触れていたかったな……。:
I wanted to keep
touching you, though...
translations.ドキドキさせたくせに、\nズルい……。:
You got my heart pounding,
and now you stop？ No fair...
translations.もっと、\n仲良くしたくなっちゃった？:
Did you want to get
even closer to me？
translations.なんで私の考えてる事、\nわかるの？:
How did you know
what I was thinking？
translations.もう、断れないって\nわかってるくせに……。:
Jeez, you know I can't
say no to you...
translations.もう……調子に乗りすぎだぞ？:
Hey now... you're getting
way too carried away.
translations.ねえ？\nそんなのどこで覚えたの？:
Hey... where did you
learn to do that？
translations.もう少し大事にして欲しい。:
I wish you'd treat me
a little more gently.
translations.大好きだけど……ゴメンね。:
I love you, but...
I'm sorry.
translations.ちょっと言い過ぎたかも……。\nゴメン。:
Maybe I was a bit
too harsh... Sorry.
translations.じゃあ、そろそろ帰るか……。:
Well, guess we should
head home soon...
translations.（キスに\n夢中になり過ぎてたな……）:
(We got way too caught up
in that kiss...)
translations.こんな所で何やってんだよ……\nって……\nあーーーーーーーっ！！:
What're you doing out
here anyway...?
Wait...
Aaaaaaaahhh!!
translations.な、成戸！！\nおまえこそ何やってんだよ！？:
N-Naruto!？
What are YOU doing here!？
translations.おまえ……キッスとか……\nそれも、\nこんなキレイなお姉さんと……。:
You're... kissing...？
And with such a gorgeous
older girl, too...
translations.ちっとも……、\nちっとも\nうらやましくなんかあるぞーー！:
I'm not jealous at all...
Not even a little...
I'M TOTALLY JEALOUS!!
translations.な、なんだよ。\nヘンなヤツだな……。:
Wh-what's his deal？
What a weird guy...
translations.（アイツには\n刺激が強すぎたかな……）:
(Maybe that was a bit
too much for him...)
translations.やい！ こら！ おまえ！\n俺たちＪ２ＤＣの誓いは\nどうなったんだよ！:
Hey! Listen here, you!
What happened to our
J2DC oath!？
translations.なんだよ、そのＪ２ＣＤって？:
What the heck is this
"J2CD" thing？
translations.純情純潔男子倶楽部！\n略してＪ２ＤＣだ！\n裏切り者めーーー！:
Pure-Hearted Pure Boys
Club! J2DC for short!
You traitorrrr!!
translations.ねえ、そのＪ２なんちゃらに\n入ってたの？:
Hey, were you in that
J2-whatever club？
translations.いや、なんだろ……？\nＪＪＢＣって？:
No clue...？
What even is JJBC？
translations.まぁ～、ずいぶんと\n仲がいいこと！ いいわね、\n若いって～初々しいわぁ～。:
My, look how close
you two are! How nice,
being young and sweet~
translations.おばちゃんなんかサ、\n接吻なんか、ずいぶんと\nご無沙汰なもんだから……。:
It's been so long since
an old lady like me has had
a proper kiss, you know...
translations.それじゃあ……失礼します！:
Well then...
we'll be on our way!
translations.それでね、思い出すわぁ～\nこれでも、おばちゃん高校時代は\n学校中でも一番の美:
That reminds me~ Back in
high school, people called me
the prettiest girl in school,
believe it or not!
translations.もう学校中の男子が競って\nおばちゃんを落とそうしてサ……\n他の女生徒なんか、:
Boys all over school were
fighting to win me over!
The other girls were so
jealous, they treated me
like a total femme fatale!
translations.（長いな……帰りたい……）:
(This is taking forever...
I just wanna go home...)
translations.その日は予定があるけど、\nいいの？:
I've got plans that day,
are you sure？
translations.問題です。\n初夢に見ると\n縁起が良いものは？:
Pop quiz!
What brings good luck
if you see it in your
first dream of the year？
translations.えっと……\n一富士、二鷹……\nあとは……なんだっけ。:
Let's see...
First Fuji, second hawk...
What was the last one again？
translations.三なすび。\n私は見たことがないんだけど。\nあなたはどう？:
Number three: eggplant.
I've never seen one myself,
though. How about you？
translations.今年見たような気がする: I feel like I saw one this year
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と\nデートする夢なら:
If it's a dream about
going on a date with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
translations.なら、今年はいい一年になるね。\nあなたにとっていい年なら、\n私にとっても、か:
Then it'll be a great year.
If it's a good year for you,
it will be for me too, right？
translations.それはね、正夢です。\n詳しい内容、聞かせてね？:
Well, that's a dream
bound to come true!
Tell me all about it, okay？
translations.ううん。そうじゃないけど、\nもっと厚着してくれば\n良かったかな。:
No, not that, but maybe
I should've bundled up
a little more.
translations.どこかで暖かいものでも\n飲もうか？:
Want to get something
warm to drink somewhere？
translations.……もっと近づいたらいいよ:
...You could always
get closer to me.
translations.ありがとう、でも大丈夫。\n……そのあったかい\n気持ちで十分。:
Thanks, but I'm okay.
...Just that warm thought
is more than enough.
translations.じゃあ……\n手だけ……つないでいい？\nそうすれば、寒い日も\n楽しくなっちゃ:
Then... can we at least...
hold hands？
That way, even a cold day
can be fun.
translations.梅の花を見ると、昔、\nおばあちゃん家で梅干しを\n漬けるの、手伝ったのを\n思:
Seeing plum blossoms reminds
me of pickling umeboshi
at Grandma's house
back in the day.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n梅干しなんて作れるの？:
You know how to make
umeboshi, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.作り方は聞いたことあるけど、\n１人で漬けられるかは\n自信ないな。:
I've heard how it's done,
but I'm not confident
I could do it on my own.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の作った\n梅干し、食べてみたいな:
I'd love to try some
umeboshi you made, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は\nいい奥さんになれるね:
You'd make a great wife,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ええ、難しいなあ……じゃあ\n今度、お母さんに教えてもらい\nながら、作ってみよ:
Oh, that's asking a lot...
Maybe I'll try making some
next time, with Mom
showing me how.
translations.梅干しの漬け方を知ってる\n女の子なんて、\nモテないと思うんだけど。\n……あ:
I don't think girls who know
how to pickle umeboshi
are very popular with guys.
...Or do you feel
differently？
translations.学校の近くの桜、ついこの前、\nつぼみがほころんだと\n思ったら満開だって。:
The cherry blossoms near
school, it felt like the buds
just opened, and now they're
already in full bloom.
translations.それなら花見の計画、早めに\n立てないとな。咲いてから\n散るのって、けっこう早:
Then we'd better plan our
flower viewing soon. Once they
bloom, they scatter pretty fast.
translations.せっかくだから、\n大勢で騒ぐよりも\n２人きりにしない？:
Since we're going, instead
of a big noisy crowd, how
about just the two of us？
translations.大勢の方が楽しいと思うけどな:
I think a big group
would be more fun, though.
translations.もちろんそのつもり！:
Of course! That was
my plan all along!
translations.あ、そう？\nうん、あなたがそういうなら。:
Oh, really？
Well, if you say so.
translations.２人でながめる桜\n……いいね。\nきっと素敵……。:
Looking at the cherry
blossoms together...
That sounds wonderful...
translations.寝不足？\n夜更かしばかりしてたら\nダメよ？:
Didn't get enough sleep？
You shouldn't be staying up
late all the time, you know？
translations.ちゃんと寝てるんだけど、\nつい眠く……春だし。:
I sleep fine, but I just
get so drowsy... It's
springtime, after all.
translations.そうね、\nこうあったかいと……。\n眠いかも。:
True. When it's warm like
this... I get sleepy too.
translations.やっぱり春の陽気のせいだね:
It's definitely the warm
spring weather's fault.
translations.……かな。\nちょっと言い訳っぽいけど、\nしかたないよね。:
...Maybe. Sounds a bit
like an excuse, but we can't
really help it, right？
translations.それもいいかも。\nひざまくらしたりして？:
That might be nice.
Maybe with a lap pillow？
translations.ご近所でガーデニングを\n始めた家があって、そこの\nお庭がとってもきれいなの。:
Someone in the neighborhood
started gardening, and their
yard is so pretty.
translations.へえ。\nオシャレな趣味って感じだね。:
Huh.
Sounds like a stylish hobby.
translations.そこの花壇はすごく立派\nなんだけど、きれいに保つのは\n相当難しいんだって。\:
Their flowerbed is gorgeous,
but they said keeping it nice
is really tough.
...I kind of want to try it.
translations.●も一緒に花を育てたいな:
I'd love to grow flowers
with you too, ●.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に\nガーデニングって似合いそう:
Gardening would really
suit you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あ、結構好きなんだ？\n一緒にやるのも楽しそう。:
Oh, you're pretty into it？
Doing it together
sounds like fun.
translations.そう？ そうだなあ、\n将来やるとしたら、だんな様にも\n手伝ってもらいたいな？:
Really？ Well, if I do it
someday, I'd want my hubby
to help out too, you know？
translations.気づいたらもう今年は\n半分終わりなんだね。:
Before I even realized it,
half the year's already over.
translations.そっか。\n言われるまで\n気づかなかった。:
Oh, yeah.
I didn't even realize
until you mentioned it.
translations.それって、時間が過ぎてくのも\n忘れるほど、この半年が\n充実していたってこと？:
Does that mean the last
six months were so full, you
didn't even notice the time？
translations.まだまだ充実してないと思う:
I don't think it's been
all that fulfilling yet.
translations.どういたしまして♪\nでももちろん、\n私も同じだよ？:
You're very welcome♪
Though of course,
I feel the exact same way.
translations.……そっか。\nじゃああと半年……\n一緒に充実させようね。:
...I see.
Well, the next six months...
let's make them great together.
translations.もしかして\n夏休みの疲れでも残ってる？:
Could it be you're still
tired from summer break？
translations.うん、毎日まだ暑いし、\n夏休みが終わった実感が\nまだないんだよね。:
Yeah, it's still hot every day,
so it doesn't really feel like
break is over yet.
translations.それはそうだけど、\n早く気分を切り替えないと。\nさっ、元気出して。:
I get that, but you need to
switch gears soon.
Come on, cheer up!
translations.……よし！\n気合い入れ直すか:
...Alright!
Time to get back in gear.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の元気を\n分けて欲しいな:
I want ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ to share
some of that energy.
translations.その意気、その意気。\n２学期もがんばろ♪:
That's the spirit!
Let's do our best
this term too♪
translations.……もう仕方ないな。\n私の元気、あなたに届け……\nえいっ！ ふふっ、これでど:
...Oh, you.
Sending you my energy...
Hiyah! Hehe, how's that？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n衣替えはもう済んだ？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Swapped over your
wardrobe yet？
translations.●は制服を出したくらいかな。\n女の子は服がたくさんあって、\n大変そうだけど。:
● pretty much just took
out the uniform. Girls have
so many clothes, it must
be tough.
translations.大変だけど、\nファッションショーみたいで\n楽しいよ？:
It's work, but it feels like
a fashion show, so it's fun？
translations.女の子はオシャレができて、\nうらやましいな:
I'm jealous that girls get
to be so fashionable.
translations.そのショーのチケット欲しい！: I want a ticket to that show!
translations.男の子だって……\nあ、今度私がコーディネイト\nしてあげよっか？:
Boys can too, you know...
Oh, want me to pick out an
outfit for you next time？
translations.ふふっ……そうね～？\n機会があればカレシにだけは\nこっそり見せてあげようかな:
Hehe... Well~？
Maybe I'll let only my
boyfriend sneak a peek,
if the chance comes up.
translations.こんなに毎日暑いんなら、\nまだ衣替えなんか\nするんじゃなかったよ。:
If it was gonna be this hot
every day, I shouldn't have
swapped clothes yet.
translations.私のクラスでも\n学校についたらすぐに、\n上着を脱ぐ人が多いかも。:
In my class too, a lot of
people take their jackets off
as soon as they get to school.
translations.だよね。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は\n暑くないの？ 汗もかいて\nないみたいだけど。:
Right？ Aren't you hot,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ You don't even
look like you're sweating.
translations.暑いことは暑いけど、どちらか\nというと、秋物が着られて\nうれしいのが、勝って:
It is hot, but I think being
excited to wear fall clothes
wins out for me.
translations.汗をかかないなんて\n女優みたいだね:
Not breaking a sweat...
Just like an actress.
translations.ファッションのためなら、\nがまんできるんだ:
You can put up with anything
for fashion, huh.
translations.そんなことはないけど、\nでも、汗で崩れた姿なんて、\nカレシに見せられないでし:
Not quite, but I couldn't
let my boyfriend see me
looking all sweaty and
messy, right？
translations.女の子は大変なんだから。:
Being a girl is hard work,
you know.
translations.ふふっ、どんなときも\nかわいくいたいと思う\n女の子は多いと思うな。:
Hehe, I think lots of girls
want to look cute no matter
what, though.
translations.神無月には、日本中から\n神様が出雲に集まるって\n言われてるよね。:
They say during Kannazuki,
gods from all across Japan
gather in Izumo, right？
translations.そうそう。\n●も古文の授業で習ったよ。:
Yeah, that's right.
● learned that in
classical Japanese class too.
translations.集まった神様は誰と誰が\n結ばれるのか、人間の運命に\nついて、会議をするんだっ:
Apparently they hold a meeting
about human fate, like who
ends up with who.
translations.へえ。そんな説があるんだ。:
Huh. I didn't know
that was a thing.
translations.もしかして\nあなたと私も、そこで\n決められてたのかもね。:
Maybe you and I were decided
there, too.
translations.ありがとうございます▼\nそしてこれからも見守っていて\nくださいね。ふふふっ。:
Thank you so much▼
And please keep watching
over us, okay？ Hehehe.
translations.そう……かな？\nでも、日本中にこんなに\nたくさんの人がいるのに、\nこうして:
You think…… so？
Even with so many people
all across Japan,
we still found each other.
translations.それって\n特別なことだと思わない？:
Don't you think
that's really special？
translations.登校する途中にね、\n空き地で霜柱を見つけたの。\n寒いわけだよね。:
On my way to school,
I saw frost columns in an
empty lot.
No wonder it's so cold.
translations.へえ、\nもう霜柱なんて出来るんだ。:
Huh, we're getting
frost columns already？
translations.ちょっと懐かしくなっちゃった。\n小さい頃って、\n霜柱を踏んで遊ばなかった？:
It made me feel nostalgic.
Didn't you ever stomp on
frost columns when you were
a kid？
translations.経験ないから、やってみたいな:
I never have,
so I'd like to try.
translations.やった、懐かしいな:
I did!
That takes me back.
translations.そうなんだ。\nサクッサクッていう感覚、\n楽しいんだよ？:
Really？ That crunch-crunch
feeling is so much fun,
you know？
translations.誰が先に見つけて踏むか、\n競争したりして\n……私ヤンチャだったから。:
We'd race to see who could
find and stomp them first...
...I was kind of a tomboy.
translations.ペットを飼うとしたら、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は\nなにを飼ってみたい？\nやっぱりネコ:
If you could have a pet,
what would you want, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
A cat, after all？
Or maybe a dog？
translations.うーん……\n飼えるかどうかは置いておいて、\n飼ってみたいのは……タヌキ？:
Hmm……
Putting aside if I can or not,
what I'd want is...
a tanuki, maybe？
translations.やっぱり変？\nでもあのまんまるな目とか、\nぽんぽこなお腹とか、\n愛らしいと:
Is that weird after all？
But with those round eyes
and that roly-poly tummy,
don't you think they're
just adorable？
translations.実は凶暴らしいよ？:
I hear they're actually
pretty vicious, though？
translations.え？ 外見はあんななのに……\nそれで、あんまり飼ってるって\n人もいないのかな:
Huh？ But they look so sweet……
Maybe that's why you hardly ever
see people keeping them as pets.
translations.実際には飼えないと\n思うんだけど、ヌイグルミとか\nストラップ見つけると、\n:
I know I can't keep one,
but when I see plushies
or phone charms,
I just end up buying them.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nこの前ね、知り合いの人の\nお手伝いで、子犬の里親捜し\nイベ:
▲主人公＊▲.
The other day, I helped out an
acquaintance at a puppy
adoption event.
translations.ああ、近くの公園でやってた\nヤツ？ けっこう人が\n集まってたみたいだね。:
Oh, the one at the park nearby？
Looked like quite a crowd
showed up.
translations.でも、かわいいだけじゃ、\n飼ってくれる人は\nなかなかいないよね。:
Still, just being cute isn't
always enough to find people
who'll adopt them, you know.
translations.最後までちゃんと\n育てて欲しいよね:
You'd want owners who'll
care for them to the very end.
translations.うん。\nでも、里親さんたちは、\nそういうところちゃんと考えて\n引き取ってく:
Yeah.
But the new families really
thought that through before
adopting, so I'm sure
they'll be just fine.
translations.あ、そういう意味でこの話、\nしたんじゃないよ？:
Ah, I didn't bring this up
to imply anything, you know？
translations.……でも、あなたが\nあの子たちのこと、\n真剣に考えてくれて、\nうれしいな。:
……Still, it makes me happy
that you're thinking so
seriously about those pups.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nよく友達と動物で例えると○○に\n似てる、みたいな話、しない？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Do you ever talk with friends
about what animal someone's
like, and stuff like that？
translations.するする。あれってさ、\n見た目というかそいつのイメージ\nみたいなところがある:
Totally. It's not just looks,
it's about their whole vibe,
you know？
translations.なんて言われたの？: What did they say you were？
translations.タヌキ。\n……きらいじゃないけど、\nどういうイメージで\n見られてるんだろう:
A tanuki.
……I don't hate it,
but what kind of impression
do they have of me？
translations.え～？ そっか……。\nなんとなく優しそうで、\n悪い意味じゃないん\nだろうけ:
Ehh？ I see……
I guess it sounds gentle, and
not meant in a bad way,
but still……
translations.ダイエット……\nしようかな……。:
Maybe I should……
go on a diet……
translations.そうだよね、みんな悪い意味で\n言ってるわけじゃないよね。\n安心した▼:
Right, nobody meant it in a
bad way, did they？
That's a relief▼
translations.きゃっ!?\nい、いま……そこのすみに……\nカ、カエル。:
Eek!?
J-Just now…… in the corner……
a f-frog!
translations.カエル……？ あれ、あそこの\n家の庭石だよ。コケがついて、\n遠目だとカエルに:
A frog……？ That's just a
garden stone over there.
It's got moss, so from afar
it does look like one, though.
translations.……ほんと？ もうっ、\n笑わないで。……本物の\nカエルに見えたんだから。:
……Really？ Jeez,
don't laugh! ……It looked
like a real frog to me.
translations.特に雨上がりの日は……\n絶対いるんだもん。:
Especially after it rains……
They're always out!
translations.ごめん、ごめん。でもさ、\nあわてる▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の\n姿を見るの、結構楽しくて。:
Sorry, sorry. But you know,
seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in a panic
is actually pretty fun.
translations.ちょっと意外に思えたんだ:
I just found it
a bit surprising.
translations.なんだかかわいく思えたな:
I just thought it was
really cute, honestly.
translations.だって、あの緑色のぬめっとした\n感じがね。あ～、やだ。\n思い浮かべただけで…:
I mean, that slimy green
texture... Ugh, no.
Just thinking about it
gives me the creeps...
translations.カエルだけは苦手なの！\n小さい頃の\nトラウマっていうか……\nあ、あのね、\:
Frogs are the one thing
I just can't handle!
It's kind of like childhood
trauma, or...
U-Um... would you mind
if I held onto your arm？
translations.最近ね、編みぐるみに\nはまってるの。毛糸で編んだ\nヌイグルミみたいなものかな:
Lately, I've been really
into amigurumi. They're like
little plushies knit
from yarn.
translations.へえ。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は\nどんなの編んでるの？:
Huh.
What kind do you make,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ほとんどが動物なんだけど、\nウサギとか、ネコとか、\nタヌキかな……。:
Mostly animals. Bunnies,
cats, maybe a tanuki...
translations.今度見せてもらいたいな:
I'd love to see them
sometime.
translations.やっぱりタヌキ好きなんだ……:
So you really do
like tanukis after all...
translations.慣れれば簡単だよ？\n男の人でも編みぐるみを\nしている人もいるし……。:
It's easy once you get
the hang of it, you know？
Plenty of guys do
amigurumi, too...
translations.あっ、今度教えてあげようか？:
Oh, want me to teach you
sometime？
translations.好きっていうか……\n親近感があるっていうのかな。:
It's not that I like them
so much as... I feel a kind
of kinship, maybe？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nこの前図書館に\n新刊の予約入れてた？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
did you put a hold on a
new book at the library？
translations.うん……\nあ、図書委員だもんね。:
Yeah...
Oh right, you're on the
library committee.
translations.一応ね。予約してた新刊が\n入ったから。読みたいなら早めに\n借りたほうがいいと:
Yep. The new release you
reserved came in, so if you
want to read it, you should
probably check it out soon.
translations.うん、ありがとう。そうだ。あと\n図書委員さんに今度、オススメの\n本を紹介して:
Yeah, thanks. Oh, hey.
Think our library rep could
recommend me a book
sometime？
translations.当番の日なら\nオススメしてあげるよ:
I can give you some
recommendations on a day
I'm on duty.
translations.放課後なら、いつでも\nオススメしてあげるよ:
I can give you
recommendations anytime
after school.
translations.ありがとう。あなたの当番の日、\n教えておいてね。:
Thanks. Be sure to let me
know what days you're on duty.
translations.ふふっ、\nあなたの好みもわかって、\n一石二鳥かも。:
Hehe, that way I'll get to
learn your tastes too, so it's
two birds with one stone.
translations.ありがとう。なら、誰もいない\n図書館に２人きりってことも\nあり得るんだ。:
Thanks. In that case,
we might even get to be
all alone together in an
empty library.
translations.ふふっ、\nなんだか図書館デートみたいね。:
Hehe, that sounds kind of
like a library date, doesn't it？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nね。ラブレターって\n書いたことある？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Hey, have you ever written
a love letter？
translations.えっ、急になんで？:
Huh？ Where's this coming
from all of a sudden？
translations.あのね、学校で今\nラブレターを書くのが\n流行ってるんだって。:
Well, apparently writing
love letters is a big thing
at school right now.
translations.うん、手書き。手書きの\nラブレターって、メールと\nちがって温かみがあるよね。:
Yep, handwritten. A hand-
written love letter has a
warmth that texts just
don't have, you know？
translations.ラブレターだなんて、\n古風な流行だね:
Love letters, huh？
That's an old-fashioned trend.
translations.●もラブレター\n書いてみようかな……:
Maybe ● should
try writing a love letter too...
translations.私も初めて聞いたときは\n驚いたけど……なんかいいよね。:
I was surprised when I first
heard about it too... but it's
kind of nice, isn't it？
translations.必死に考えたラブレターを、\nドキドキしながら相手に渡すって\n……ふふっ、素敵:
Pouring your heart into it,
handing it over with your
heart pounding... Hehe,
don't you think that's lovely？
translations.ほんとに？ それって私に、\nだよね。ふふ、想いのつまった\nラブレター……待っ:
Really？ That's to me,
right？ Hehe, I'll be waiting
for that letter full of all
your feelings, okay？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nこの前ね、学校の調理実習で、\nカレーを作ったの。:
▲主人公＊▲.
So the other day, we made
curry in home ec class.
translations.それで、\n学校中にカレーのにおいが……。\nおかげで、うちのクラスの男子は\n:
So that's why the whole
school smelled like curry...
The guys in our class had
their stomachs rumbling
the entire time.
translations.ふふっ、\nそれは悪いことしちゃったかも。\n調理実習じゃなければ、あなたに\n:
Hehe, maybe we should
apologize for that.
If it weren't for class,
I would've loved to treat
you to some.
translations.今度実習のあるときは呼んでよ:
Invite me next time
you have cooking class!
translations.今度▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の家で\n作って欲しいな:
I'd love for you to make it
at ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s place next time.
translations.ふふっ、お世辞が上手なんだ。\nじゃ、今度実習をやるときは、\nこっそり招待して:
Fufu, you sure know
how to flatter me.
Next time we have class,
maybe I'll sneak you
an invitation.
translations.私の家で？\nふふっ、じゃあ、新妻寧々は\n愛しのだんな様の帰りを、\n愛情カレ:
At my place？
Fufu, then maybe 'newlywed Nene'
should cook up some curry
filled with love,
and wait for her darling
husband to come home？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nあなたのクラスも持ち物検査、\nたまにある？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Does your class ever have
bag checks？
translations.うん。抜き打ちの検査で、\nマンガを持ってきてたヤツが、\n没収されたりはよくあ:
Yeah. We get surprise checks,
and guys who bring manga
often get it confiscated.
translations.私のクラスでも\nときどきやるんだけど、\nクラスのみんなの評判が悪いの。:
They do them in my class
sometimes too, but nobody
really likes them.
translations.私は、あんまり厳しいのも\n良くないとは思うんだけど……。:
I don't think being
too strict is good either,
though...
translations.●は自主性に任せて欲しいな:
I wish they'd trust us
to be responsible, ●.
translations.たしかに抜き打ち検査も\n仕方ないのかな:
I guess surprise checks
can't really be helped.
translations.うん、私もその方が\nいいとは思うの。:
Yeah, I think that would
be much better, too.
translations.ただ、実際は校則違反をしてる人\nも多いし……。一度クラスで話し\n合ってみた方:
Still, plenty of people
break the rules anyway...
Maybe we should talk it out
as a class once.
translations.……あなたは校則違反のもの、\n持ち込んでないよね？:
...You're not bringing
anything against the rules,
are you？
translations.ほら……男の子ってちょっと\nエッチな本とか。……あなたは\n持ってきてないよね:
Like... dirty magazines,
or whatever boys like.
...You haven't brought
any, right？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nなにか悩みごと？\nさっきから暗い顔してるけど。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
is something on your mind？
You've looked kind of down
for a while now.
translations.友達がね、カレシとケンカして\n落ち込んでるみたいなの。\nそれで相談されて……:
A friend of mine had a fight
with her boyfriend,
and she's really down.
She asked me for advice...
translations.女友達とばかり遊んで、\nほったらかしにしてたせいで、\nカレシが怒っちゃったみ:
She hung out with girlfriends
and totally neglected him,
so he got really mad.
I know it's her fault too,
but...
translations.バランスが難しいよね:
It's hard to strike
a balance, isn't it？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は\n●とばかり一緒でいいの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you okay
spending all your time
with just ●？
translations.そうなの。\nだからもう一度\nよく話し合ってみたらって、\nアドバイスしたんだ:
Exactly. So I suggested
she talk things through
with him again, but...
translations.仲直りできたらいいな。: I really hope they make up.
translations.考えたことなかった。:
I've never really
thought about that.
translations.私の友達は遊んでても、かえって\nカレシとデートしなくていいの？\nって、気を使:
When I'm with my friends,
they worry about me instead:
'Shouldn't you be on a date
with your boyfriend？'
translations.だから心配しなくても大丈夫▼:
So there's no need
to worry, ▼.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n友達があなたの写真を見たいって\n言うの。……いいかな？:
▲主人公＊▲.
My friends said they want to
see a picture of you...
Would that be okay？
translations.え？\nどうして●の写真……？:
Huh？ Why do they want
a picture of ●...？
translations.お昼休みに\nカレシ自慢みたいになってね、\n私はあまりそういうの\n好きじゃな:
At lunch, everyone started
bragging about boyfriends.
I'm not really into that...
but I couldn't say no,
so I promised I'd take one.
translations.写真くらい何枚でも！:
You can take as many
photos as you want!
translations.もしかして写真が欲しいのは\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？:
Could the one who really
wants a photo be ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.もう、こっちは結構\n恥ずかしいのに。あなたが\nいいなら、私もかまわないけど。:
Geez, I'm actually pretty
embarrassed here. But if you're
okay with it, so am I.
translations.それは……たしかにそういう\n考えもちょっとあったけど……。:
Well... okay, maybe that
thought crossed my mind
a little, but...
translations.やっぱり携帯の待ち受けに\nするのは、やめた方がいいかな？:
Maybe I shouldn't set it
as my phone wallpaper？
translations.みんなから相談されることが\n多いんだけど……。\nどうして、いつも私なのかな？:
People come to me for advice
a lot...
Why is it always me, though？
translations.やっぱり\n頼りがいがあるのは事実だし。:
Well, the truth is,
you're really dependable.
translations.うん……一度ついちゃった\nイメージは簡単にはとれないか。:
Yeah... Once an image sticks,
it's not easy to shake.
translations.わざとドジをしてみるとか！:
How about acting clumsy
on purpose?!
translations.気にせずに\n自然体でいいと思うけど:
I think you're fine just
being yourself, though.
translations.うーん、難しいなあ……。\nデキシーズで\nお皿をひっくり返したり……。\nだめ:
Hmm, that's tough...
Like flipping a plate over
at Dixie's...?
No, I can't do that.
translations.……今の私でいいってこと？:
...You mean I'm fine
just the way I am？
translations.うれしいけど。でも、\nできれば“みんなの寧々さん”\nじゃなくて、\nあなたの:
That makes me happy. But...
if I could, instead of being
'everyone's Nene-san',
I'd rather be your Nene,
you know？ Fufu!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nもしかして今日、機嫌が良い？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
are you in a good mood today,
by any chance？
translations.ふふっ……わかる？\n実はね、昨日スーパーで\n期間限定“七味柚子のど飴”を、\:
Hehe... Can you tell？
Actually, yesterday at the market,
I finally found them—
those limited-edition
shichimi yuzu cough drops.
translations.七味と柚子……？ ずいぶん\n独創的な組み合わせの飴だけど\n……おいしいの？:
Shichimi and yuzu...？
That's a pretty wild combo
for candy... Is it good？
translations.一見普通の柚子のど飴\nなんだけど、ときどきピリッと\nした刺激があって、意外と:
They look like normal yuzu drops,
but every so often you get a kick
that's surprisingly soothing.
Wanna try one？
translations.一度、食べてみたいな。\n覚悟を決めて:
I'd like to try one.
Gotta brace myself first.
translations.そんなに警戒することも\nないと思うけどな。\nハマっちゃうかもよ？:
I don't think you need to be
that cautious, though.
You might even get hooked？
translations.遠慮しなくてもいいのに。\nじゃあ代わりに\nメロンののど飴あげる。:
You didn't need to hold back.
Here, I'll give you
a melon cough drop instead.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n料理が趣味の男の人って、\nどう思う？:
▲主人公＊▲.
What do you think of guys
who cook as a hobby？
translations.ふふっ、\n２人で一緒に料理するのって、\n楽しいだろうなって思ったん\nだけど:
Hehe. I was just thinking
it'd be fun to cook together,
just the two of us.
Don't you think so？
translations.できれば料理の得意な\n女の子に作って欲しいな:
I'd rather a girl who can cook
make it for me, honestly.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒なら、\n楽しそうだな:
It sounds like a lot of fun
if it's with you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.もう、最近は男子も\n料理ができないと困るよ？\nそうだ、今度、\n包丁の持ち方:
Geez, guys need to know
how to cook these days, too.
I know! Next time, I'll teach you
how to hold a kitchen knife.
Ready for special training？
translations.料理ってね、難しそうに\n思っていてもいざ始めると\nどんどん楽しくなっていくの:
Cooking might seem hard,
but once you actually start,
it gets more and more fun.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n昨日ね、テレビショッピングで\nつい洗剤を買っちゃったの。:
▲主人公＊▲.
Yesterday, I ended up buying
detergent off TV shopping.
translations.テレビショッピングって\n……あの、\n“やあボブ、今日はどんな\n商品を紹介し:
TV shopping... As in,
'Hey Bob, what kind of product
are you showing us today？'
That kind of thing？
translations.それそれ。届いたら、\n家中ピカピカにするのが、\nいまから楽しみだな。:
That's it! Once it arrives,
I can't wait to make
the whole house sparkle.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って\n掃除好きなんだね:
You really like cleaning,
don't you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.●の部屋もきれいにして\n欲しいくらいだよ:
I'd love it if you cleaned
●'s room, too.
translations.だって、汚れが落ちて\nピカピカになっていくのって、\n見てて気持ちいいでしょう:
I mean, watching all the dirt
come off until it sparkles
just feels so good, right？
translations.私ね、汚れを見つけると、\nついきれいにしたくなるの。:
Whenever I spot a mess,
I just can't help wanting
to clean it up right away.
translations.自分の部屋は\n自分できれいにしなさい。\n……と言いたいところだけど、\nあな:
Clean your own room yourself!
...is what I'd like to say,
but if it's your room,
maybe I just might head over？
translations.あ、\nカノジョに見せられないものは\n隠しておくこと……ふふっ。:
Oh, and make sure to hide
anything you don't want
your girlfriend to see... Hehe.
translations.友達がね、恋愛関係を長続き\nさせるには、カレシの趣味に\n合わせるのも大事だっ:
A friend of mine told me that
to make a relationship last,
it's important to get into
your boyfriend's hobbies.
translations.たしかに共通の\n趣味があると、話もはずむ\nかもしれないけど……。:
Having hobbies in common
makes talking easier, I guess,
but still...
translations.カノジョとしては、カレシの\n趣味のこと、もうちょっと\n理解したいなって、最近:
Lately, I've been thinking
that as your girlfriend,
I'd like to understand
your hobbies a little better.
translations.気持ちで充分、\n無理しちゃ意味ないし:
The thought's plenty.
No point if you're forcing it.
translations.むしろ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の\n方をもっと理解したいな:
If anything, I'd rather
understand ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ better.
translations.もう、優しいんだ。\nあとたしかに、\n無理に合わせるのって、\n恋人として、ち:
Aw, you're so sweet.
And it's true, forcing yourself
to match is kind of weird
for a couple anyway.
translations.あ、そうくるんだ？\n私、結構容赦ないかも。\nふふ♪:
Oh, is that how it is？
I might not go easy on you.
Hehe♪
translations.後輩がね、今度バレー部の\nレギュラーになれたって、\n報告しに来てくれたの。:
One of my underclassmen
came to tell me she made
the starting volleyball lineup.
translations.へえ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って\nやっぱり後輩にも\n慕われてるんだ。:
Huh, so the underclassmen
really look up to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.その子はたまたま\n知り合う機会があって。\nお祝いしてあげたいんだけど、\n大:
We just happened to cross paths.
I want to get her something
to celebrate, without going
overboard. What do you think
I should get her？
translations.タオルとか部活で使う\n実用品かな:
Maybe something practical
for club, like a towel？
translations.あ、そうね。\nただのタオルだとさびしいから、\n彼女のイニシャルを\n刺繍して:
Oh, good idea.
A plain towel feels a bit dull,
so I'll embroider
her initials on it.
translations.そっか、まずはおめでとうって\n伝えて。そのときにプレゼントに\nついても聞いて:
Right. I'll congratulate her first,
and ask about gifts
while we're talking.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n地域限定商品ってよくあるけど、\nああいうのって、\nどうやれ:
▲主人公＊▲.
You see regional goods a lot,
but how do you actually
buy something like that？
translations.どうだろ、\n何か欲しいものあるの？:
Hmm, I wonder.
Is there something specific
you want？
translations.私、のど飴が好きでしょ。\nそれに地域限定の味が\nあるんだって。:
You know how much
I love cough drops, right？
Well, apparently they have
regional flavors!
translations.それならネットで\n買えるんじゃないかな:
Couldn't you just buy those
online, then？
translations.お菓子の問屋街に行ってみる？:
Want to try visiting
a candy wholesale district？
translations.あ、そうか。最近は\nなんでもネットで買えるんだ。\nふふっ、良かった。:
Oh, right! You can buy pretty
much anything online these days.
Hehe, that's a relief.
translations.そんな街あるんだ……\nなんだか楽しそう。\nそこでのデートもいいかもね♪:
There's a place like that...？
That sounds like fun.
A date there could be nice, too♪
translations.▲主人公＊▲。コンビニで\n変わったのど飴を見つけたの。\nファーストキスの味だ:
▲主人公＊▲. I found a weird
cough drop at the convenience
store. It says it tastes like
a first kiss.
translations.え……どんな味なの？:
Huh...
What does that taste like？
translations.ほのかに甘酸っぱくて、\nそれでいてスッと通り過ぎて、\nさわやかさが残る……\:
A little sweet and sour,
it melts right away,
and leaves a fresh aftertaste...
Something like that, I think.
translations.ふふっ、初めてのキス……\nどんな味だったかな。:
Hehe, our first kiss...
I wonder what that tasted like.
translations.たしかに\n甘酸っぱい味だったかも:
Come to think of it,
maybe it was sweet and sour.
translations.え？\nいまここで？ それは……\nあ、ダメ。\nだって、今したって\n初めての:
Huh？ Right here, right now？
That's... oh, no way!
I mean, even if we did,
it wouldn't be our first kiss!
So, nope! Denied!
translations.ふふっ、顔真っ赤だよ？\nなら、そののど飴をなめれば、\nいつでも思い出せるね？:
Hehe, your face is bright red!
Then if you have one of
those drops, you can relive it
anytime, right？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n駅前のカフェで\n食べ放題のケーキビュッフェを\nやってるの、:
▲主人公＊▲. Did you know the cafe
in front of the station is
doing an all-you-can-eat
cake buffet？
translations.そうなんだ。ああいうの、\n女の子同士だと気軽に行けて\nうらやましいよなあ。:
Oh yeah？ I'm kind of jealous
how easily girls can go
to places like that together.
translations.女の子の特権ですから。\n食べ放題といっても、\nそんなに食べられないと\n思っ:
It's a girl's privilege,
after all. Though even with
all-you-can-eat, I didn't think
I could eat that much...
translations.実は……小さいのだけど、\n１０個も食べちゃった。\nダイエットがんばらないと。:
Actually... they were small,
but I ate ten of them.
I really need to work
on my diet now.
translations.ケーキビュッフェ、\n●も行ってみたいな:
A cake buffet, huh...
I'd kind of like to go too,
●.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nぜんぜん太ってなんかないのに:
You're not fat at all,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.カップルで\n来てた人も結構いたよ。:
There were actually quite
a few couples there, you know.
translations.あ、ダイエットは……うんっ！\nあなたとのデート中は\n休みでもいいかな。:
Ah, well, my diet... Yep!
I guess I can take a break
from it when I'm on a date
with you.
translations.油断すると\n見えないところにお肉が……\nあ、こらっ。今の忘れること！:
If I let my guard down,
the fat goes straight to places
you can't see... Hey!
Forget you heard that!
translations.最近家にいるときは、\nどんなことしてるの？:
What do you usually do
at home these days？
translations.うーん、\n間取り図を見たりしてるかな。\nほら、折り込みチラシにも\nよく入っ:
Hmm, I guess I've been
looking at floor plans.
You know, like the ones in
newspaper flyers？
translations.分譲住宅とかマンションの？:
Like for new houses
and condos？
translations.そう。間取り図を見て、将来\nこういう家に住めたらいいな、\nとか、ここはダンナ:
Yeah. Looking at floor plans
and imagining living in a house
like that someday... like, 'This'll
be my husband's room, and this
is the kids' room.' It's so fun.
translations.その想像の中に\n●もいたら、うれしいな:
I'd be really happy if I was
in that daydream too, ●.
translations.１枚の間取りからでも、\nたくさんのストーリーを\n想像できるの。\nふふっ、な:
Just from one single layout,
you can imagine so many stories.
Hehe, it's kind of like
playing house when I was little.
translations.あなた、おかえりなさい。\n夕食にします？\nそれとも先にお風呂？\nふふっ、将:
'Welcome home, dear.
Would you like dinner？
Or maybe a bath first？'
Hehe, wouldn't it be wonderful
if we really talked like that
someday...？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n最近、新しい料理の\nレパートリーを増やしたいと\n思ってるん:
▲主人公＊▲.
Lately I've been wanting to
expand my cooking repertoire,
but...
translations.もしかしてまた店長に\n何かアイデアがないか、\n訊かれたの？:
Did the manager ask you
for new ideas again？
translations.ううん……\nそうじゃなくて、もっと料理が\nうまくなりたいなって。\n実は研究:
No... It's not that,
I just want to get better
at cooking. I'm actually
working on something right now.
translations.いい報告を待ってます:
I'll be waiting to hear
the good news, then.
translations.もうっ、そんなに急かさないの。\nカレシにはおいしいものを\n食べて欲しいから、:
Geez, don't rush me!
I want my boyfriend to eat
something truly delicious,
so just a little longer. Okay？
translations.はい、少々お待ちください▼\nふふっ♪:
Yes, sir! Please wait
just a moment, ▼!
Hehe♪
translations.いつも思うんだけど、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って\n学校でもバイトでも完璧だよね。:
I'm always thinking this,
but you're basically perfect
at school and at work, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.え……そんなことないのに。\nこの前だってお客様の前で\nコーヒー、こぼしちゃっ:
Huh... That's not true at all.
Just the other day, I spilled
coffee right in front
of a customer...
translations.デキシーズで？\nそれ、怒られなかった？:
At Dixie's？
Did they get mad at you？
translations.運良くお客様には\nかからなかったから。\nそれにそのお客様、\nとても紳士な方:
Luckily, none got on him.
And the customer was
such a gentleman about it.
He just smiled and told me
it was totally fine.
translations.ちょっと▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に\n親近感:
Makes me feel a little
closer to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ヤキモチ焼いちゃうかもな:
I might get jealous,
you know.
translations.もう、\nそんなことでほっとしないの。\n私だって失敗するし、\nそんなときは誰:
Geez, don't feel relieved
over something like that!
I make mistakes too, and
I get down enough to want
someone to comfort me.
translations.もう……\nいつも言ってるけど、\n私が大好きなのは、\nあなただけなんだから。:
Geez...
Like I always tell you,
the only one I love is you.
Don't go getting weird
ideas! Bad!
translations.どうしたの。●、何かした？:
What is it？ Did I do
something, ●？
translations.うん、だーいすき▼\nふふっ♪:
Yeah, I love you so much,
▼.
Hehe♪
translations.なあに？\nふふ、呼んでみただけー▼:
What is it？
Hehe, just wanted to say
your name, ▼~
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n自分の名前の由来が何か、\n気にしたことってある？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Have you ever wondered
where your name came from？
translations.そういえば気にしたことないな:
Come to think of it,
I've never really thought
about it.
translations.気になって、\n親に聞いたことがある:
I was curious, so I asked
my parents once.
translations.なんだ残念。\n知りたかったのになー。:
Aw, that's too bad.
I really wanted to know~
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、まだ来てないみたいだな。: Looks like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ isn't here yet.
translations.キスじらし台詞のメッセージ番号エラー: Kiss tease line message number error
translations.今日は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の家に\n呼ばれてるんだよな。:
I've been invited over to
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s house today.
translations.そういや●、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲になんて\n呼ばれてたっけ？:
By the way, what was
● called by
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ again？
translations.（よし、やさしくスキンシップしよう）:
(All right, let's be gentle
and affectionate.)
translations.（よし、ちょっといたずらしてみよう）:
(All right, let's tease her
a little.)
translations.いきなり、そういうのは……。:
Doing that right out of
the blue is...
translations.なんでも許すわけじゃないよ？:
I won't just let you get
away with anything, okay？
translations.わかるけど、我慢して。:
I get how you feel,
but hold back.
translations.あ、目がやらしいーぞ。:
Hey, you've got a naughty
look in your eyes.
translations.……ん、ここはどこだ？ 目の前が真っ白だ。:
Huh, where am I？ It's all
white.
translations.……少しずつ晴れてきたな。:
...It's starting to become a
little clearer.
translations.なんでこんなところに……。そうか、これは夢か。:
hy am I here...？ So, this is
just a dream.
translations.……夢なら、触っても怒られないかな？:
Since it's a dream, maybe she
won't get angry if I touch
her.
translations.よし、試しにタッチしてみよう。:
All right. I'll try touching
her.
translations.……びっくりした。夢の中でも反応はするんだな。:
...I was surprised. Even in
the middle of a dream, she
gave a reaction.
translations.……もう少し触れるかな？:
...I wonder if I could touch
her a little more.
translations.……嫌がってる。ダメなときもあるんだな。:
...But there are times when
it's not good to touch her.
translations.すごく喜んでるみたいだ。:
It looks like she's really
enjoying it.
translations.触る場所によって反応が違うな。:
Her responses are different
depending on where I touch
her.
translations.相手の気分によって、触っていいところとダメなところがあるのか。:
Depending on her mood, some
places will be good to touch,
and some bad.
translations.あと、触れる回数も相手の気分で変わるみたいだな。:
Looks like the number of times
I can touch her depends on her
mood, too.
translations.触っていい場所ってどこだろう、試してみるか。:
Where can I touch her？ I
guess I'll give it a go.
translations.髪……恋人ならではだな。:
Her hair... It's okay I guess,
because I'm her boyfriend.
translations.おでこ……なんか可愛いな。:
Her forehead... She looks so
cute.
translations.耳……くすぐったくないのかな。:
Her ear... I wonder if she's
ticklish.
translations.体……ここは慎重にいかないとな。:
Her body... I have to be
careful with this.
translations.腕……くんだりできたらいいよな。:
Her arm... It would be good if
we could walk arm in arm.
translations.手……つないだりもしたいよな。:
Her hand.... I want to hold
her hand.
translations.髪、おでこ、耳、体、腕、手……こんなもんかな。:
Her hair, forehead, ear, body,
arm, and hand. That's about
all.
translations.あれ、世界がまた白く……。もう終わり？:
Ah, the world is turning white
again... Is it over already？
translations.そっか、夢か。それにしても生々しい夢だったな。:
I see. A dream, huh？ What a
vivid and lively dream.
translations.でも夢で満足してちゃダメだよな。:
But I won't be satisfied with
just a dream.
translations.よし、デートのときはしっかりやるぞ！:
All right. I'll do it right on
a date！
translations.どこだ、ここは。誰もいない……。:
What is this place？ There's
no one here...
translations.そういえば前にもこんな夢を見たことがあったような……。:
That's right. I feel like I've
had this dream before...
translations.それになんか良い雰囲気だな。:
The atmosphere now is nice,
too.
translations.前はタッチしかできなかったけど、今度はなでてみよう。:
Before, I could only touch
her. But I should try
something different now.
translations.触り方で反応が少し違うな。:
Her reactions to being touched
change slightly.
translations.よし、今度はほっぺだけ触ってみよう。:
All right, this time I will
try her cheek.
translations.っと、ここは触って欲しくないのか。:
Hmm... You didn't want me to
touch there？
translations.これはやめておいた方がいいな。:
I think it would be best not
to do that.
translations.もう少し長く触ってみるか。:
I'll try touching her a little
longer.
translations.長く触ってあげると、喜んでくれるのか。:
If I touch her longer, will
she like it？
translations.触る場所によって、表情がときどき変わるんだな。:
Depending on where I touch
her, her expression will
change from time to time.
translations.どこが触れるんだろう、とりあえず試してみるか。:
I wonder where I should touch.
I guess I'll try different
spots for now.
translations.頭……なでられるみたいだな。:
Her head.... I can gently pat
her.
translations.おでこ……さわれるみたいだな。:
Her forehead.... I can touch
here, too.
translations.ほっぺ……ここもさわれるな。:
Her cheek... I can touch here
as well.
translations.肩まわり……ここも大丈夫みたいだ。:
Her shoulder. Looks like it's
all right to touch her here as
well.
translations.頭、おでこ、ほっぺ、肩まわり……大体わかってきたぞ。:
Her head, forehead, cheek, and
shoulder... I think I've got
it.
translations.やっぱり、キスしてもいいってことなのか？:
Am I allowed to kiss her after
all？
translations.夢とはいえ、いいのかな……。:
Because this is a dream, I
guess it's okay.
translations.でも予行演習と思えば、いいよな。:
Think of it as practice, this
should be good.
translations.さてどうしよう。キスなんだから、基本は唇だよな。:
Well, what now？ Lips are the
first thing you think of when
kissing, right？
translations.でも、おでことかほっぺとか口の周りとかに軽くキスするのもありかな？:
I think I can kiss her
forehead, cheek, or near her
mouth.
translations.よし、とりあえず試してみよう。:
All right. For now, I'll try
to test it out.
translations.ほっぺには軽く触れるのがいいみたいだ。:
Lightly touching her cheek
seems to be okay.
translations.おでこにキス……こういうのもいいかもな。:
Kissing her forehead... This
looks okay.
translations.口の周り……軽く触れるぐらいがいいのかな。:
Near her mouth... Seems it's
okay to lightly touch around
here.
translations.こうやって唇に軽く触れるのもありか。:
Now, maybe I can try touching
her lips lightly.
translations.唇以外は、あまり長くはキスできないみたいだ。:
Just for the lips, I guess I
can try a long kiss.
translations.つい、色々やってしまった……。:
Whoa... I just wound up doing
various things...
translations.じゃあ、気を取り直して、もう一度。:
Well, let me pull myself
together.
translations.唇に触り続ければいいんだよな……。:
It's okay to continue touching
her lips.
translations.夢なのに、ヘンな気分になってきた……。:
Even though it's a dream, this
turned out to be quite a
strange feeling...
translations.違う違う、唇にキスしないと。:
Wrong ！ I have to kiss her
lips.
translations.こんな夢見るなんて、欲求不満なのかな。:
It's really frustrating to
think that this is only a
dream.
translations.恥ずかしくて、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲には言えないな。:
I'm so embarrassed. I
definitely can't tell
▲Anegasaki＊▲
about this.
translations.あ、また目の前が白くなってく……これで終わりか。:
Ah, everything is going white
again... Is it over？
translations.少し名残惜しいけど、しょせんは夢だしな……。:
I wish I could stay, but I
guess it's just a dream, after
all...
translations.こんな夢見るなんて、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に合わせる顔がない……。:
After a dream like this, it
will be tough seeing
▲Anegasaki＊▲.
translations.いや、夢じゃなくて実際にできるようになればいいか。:
I hope that I can do this in
real life, not just in my
dreams...
translations.よし、次のデートではがんばるぞ！:
All right！ I'll try my best
on my next date.
translations.むちゃくちゃ眠いぞ……だめだ……。:
I'm really sleepy... I'm...
going to...
translations.カレシの好きなとこは？: What do you like about him？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nもう、来てるかな？）:
(I wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is here already？)
translations.お姉さんからは以上です。: That's all from your big sis.
translations.髪、切ってきたんだけど、何か言うことない？:
I just had a haircut... Don't
you have anything to say？
translations.ねえ。髪、ショートにしてみたんだけど、どうかな？:
Hey, my hair is shorter now.
What do you think？
translations.髪、セミロングにしてみたんだけど。何か言うことは？:
I tried this semi-long
hairstyle... Don't you have
anything to say？
translations.ねえねえ。この髪型、どう思う？:
Hey, hey. What do you think
about this hairstyle？
translations.リンコの髪、けっこう長くなったでしょ。:
Rinko's hair is much longer
now, right？
translations.髪、伸ばしてみたんだけど、感想ある？:
My hair is longer now. What's
your opinion？
translations.ほら。髪、伸ばしてみたよ。女の子っぽい？:
Hey, my hair is longer now. Do
I look feminine？
translations.そう。やっぱ、こういうの好きなんだ。そっか。:
Okay, you like this then. I
see.
translations.そっか。へへ。ま、気に入らないなんて言ったら、小キックだったけどね！:
Really？ Hehe. Well, if you
said that you didn't like it,
I would kick you！
translations.へへへ。よかった。これで、リンコの魅力、さらにアップってとこだね！:
Hehehe. That's good. Now,
Rinko's charm level is going
up, right？
translations.えぇっ？ 難しいなぁ、もう……。:
Eh！？ This is very difficult.
Hah...
translations.ウソ？ 好きだと思ったんだけどな……。:
No way. I thought you would
like it...
translations.わかった。じゃあ、もうやめとくね。:
I see. I won't do this style
anymore.
translations.これ、新しい髪型。評価受付中。:
Here's the new hairstyle. Now,
evaluation time.
translations.これ、どう？ 新しい髪型。:
Here, how is it？ My new
hairstyle.
translations.あのさ、髪型変えたんだけど、どう？ ヘン？:
Say... I changed my hairstyle.
How is it？ Weird？
translations.わかった、覚えとく。しばらくこれにしよっと。:
I got it. I'll keep it like
this for a while.
translations.へへ。そっか、こういうの好きか。:
Hmm？ Really？ So you like it
like this.
translations.ちょっと雰囲気変えてみたんだけど……。:
Just wanted to change the mood
a bit...
translations.こういうイメージってどう？ ほれ、感想言ってみ。:
Do you like my new image？
Hey, tell me what you think.
translations.ねえねえ。リンコ、イメチェンしてみたんだけど。:
Hey, hey. Rinko tried this
image change.
translations.ねぇねぇ、どこかおかしくない？:
Hey, hey. Do I look different
today？
translations.リンコのイメージなんだけどさ。変えてみようかなって思って。:
Rinko's image has changed
somehow, right？
translations.おとなしい感じにしてみたんだけど……似合うかな？:
I tried to look more mature.
Does this look suit me？
translations.おとなしい感じの服、好きそうだったから……どうかな？:
I'm wearing this mature
looking outfit. What do you
think？
translations.清楚系美少女のリンコって、どうかな？:
What do you think about this
neat, lady-like look for
Rinko？
translations.可愛い服って似合わないかもだけど……。:
I tried this cute outfit. Does
it suit me？
translations.可愛い感じにまとめてみたんだけど、どう？:
I tried to look cute. What do
you think？
translations.こういう感じの服、好きだったよね？:
Do you like this style of
clothing？
translations.ねぇ、ほら、カジュアルな感じにしてみたよ。どうかな？:
Hey, look. I tried this casual
outfit. How do I look？
translations.たまには、こんな服もいいかなって……。:
Occasionally, it's good to
wear something like this,
huh...？
translations.こんな感じの服にしてみたんだけど……。ねぇ、なんか言ってってば。:
I tried this style of
clothing... Hey, do you have
anything to say？
translations.どうかな。頑張ってセクシーなの着てきたんだけど。:
What do you think？ I tried
this sexy outfit this time.
translations.そっか。じゃ……これからはこのイメージでいこうかな。:
I see. Then I'll keep this
look for a while.
translations.うんうん。だったらこれからは、こういう感じの服そろえておくから。:
Okay, okay. I'll keep wearing
this style of clothing from
now on.
translations.へへ……よかった。それじゃこれからは、こういう服にするね。:
Hehe. I'm glad. Then I'll keep
wearing this style from now
on.
translations.そっか……。じゃあ、もう着るのやめよ。:
I see... Then I'll stop
wearing this...
translations.気に入ってくれると思って着てきたのに。……ちょっとショックかも。:
I chose this because I thought
you would like it....This is a
shock.
translations.なに？ ちゃんと感想言ってくれないと、わかんないじゃん。:
What？ If you don't say what
you think clearly, how can I
know？
translations.……せっかく頑張ってきたのに。張り合いないなぁ。:
...I really tried my best for
this. This isn't worth my
effort at all.
translations.……ああ、そう。どっちでもいいんだ。:
...Ah, I see. You don't care
then.
translations.無視、ですか……。いいけどね！:
Are you ignoring me...？ Fine,
then！
translations.今日の服、どう思う？:
What do you think about my
outfit today？
translations.（うん？ いつもと同じ雰囲気の服だよな？）:
(Hmm？ It's the same as what
she usually wears, isn't it？)
translations.今日の服だけどさ、なんか感想ある？:
What do you think about my
outfit today？
translations.（えーと。いつもと似たような雰囲気の服だよな？）:
(Hmm？ This is similar to what
she usually wears...)
translations.ねえ。やっぱり、こういう清楚な感じの服ってさ、今でも好きなの？:
Hey, do you like this
neat-and-tidy clothing style？
translations.今日の服ってさ。本当にリンコに似合ってるかな？:
Do you think this outfit suits
Rinko？
translations.今日の服、こんな感じだけどさ。……どう？:
I tried this outfit today.
...What do you think？
translations.（今日のはいつもと同じ可愛い系の服だよな？）:
(This is the cute style that
she usually wears.)
translations.今日のファッションにさ、何か感想はある？:
What do you think about my
fashion today？
translations.この服、どうかな？:
What do you think about this
outfit？
translations.へへ。そうだよね。そう言ってくれると思った。:
Hehe, right？ I already
thought you'd say that.
translations.そっか。気に入らないんだ。そうかもなーとは思ってたけどね。:
I see. You didn't like it. I
thought you would, though.
translations.えぇー？ こういうの好きだと思ったから着てきたのに。:
Eh？ I chose this because I
thought you would like it.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、もっと頑張ってみるね。:
I see. Then I'll try harder
next time.
translations.それだけ？ まあ、いいんだけど。:
That's it？ Well, that's fine,
though.
translations.そんな答えじゃつまんないって。素直に似合うっていえばいいじゃん。:
What's with that answer？
Can't you just honestly say
that you like it？
translations.そういう意味じゃなくて！ ああ、いいよ、もう！:
That's not what I asked you！
Ah, this is enough！
translations.ユーウツ。文系科目はいいけどさ、数学とかリンコ苦手だしさ……。:
Well, I'm okay with social
sciences but I'm very bad at
math...
translations.最近、勉強がはかどんないんだよね……。アンタはどうかなって思ったんだけど……。:
Lately, I didn't do well with
my study... How about you...？
translations.あのさ……勉強会ってわけじゃないけど、わかんないところあってさ……放課後とか空い:
Hey... There are some
materials that I don't quite
understand in class. I wonder
if you're free after school...
translations.じゃあさ、あとで家に来てくれる？ 待ってるからさ。:
Then come to my house. I'll be
waiting.
translations.じゃさ、学校終わったらリンコの家に来ること。:
Then come to Rinko's house
after school.
translations.それじゃさ、学校終わったらリンコの家で。……よろしくね。:
Then come to my house after
school. I'll have to trouble
you.
translations.えー、それってリンコより大切な用事なの？:
Eh？ You have something even
more important than Rinko！？
translations.あれ、余裕あるじゃん。テスト近いのにさ。:
Eh？ You still have time to
have fun？ Exams are getting
close.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。そういえばもうすぐテストだったか……。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
