It's almost exam time again,
huh...？
translations.あ、リンコが勉強しようとしてるのに、こんなとこで遊んでる。:
Ah, Rinko was thinking about
studying with you but you're
having fun here.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。そういえばもうすぐテストだったな……。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
Right, it's almost exam time
again...
translations.あれ、偶然じゃん。……あのさ、この後、時間ある？ わかんないとこあってさ……。:
Eh？ What a coincidence. Well,
do you have time after this？
There's something I don't
understand...
translations.▲小早川＊▲。そういえばもうすぐテストか……。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
Right, it's almost exam time
again...
translations.じゃさ、後で家に来て。:
Then come to my house after
this.
translations.別に頼んでないって。……まあ、いいけどさ。:
I didn't ask for your help...
but it's okay.
translations.頼りになるじゃん。じゃあさ、家で待ってるから。:
You're reliable. Then I'll be
waiting at home.
translations.あ、そうくるんだ。薄情者。:
Ah, is that so？ What a
cold-hearted guy.
translations.そっか……。じゃあ、また今度。今度は絶対だよ？:
Really...？ Then maybe next
time... Next time, okay？
translations.じゃ、リンコの部屋で。リンコにも教えてよね、上級生なんだからさ。:
Then come to Rinko's house.
You'll teach Rinko, too,
right？ You're an
upperclassman, after all.
translations.下級生に教わるつもり？ ま、いいけど。リンコの部屋でね。:
And you need help from an
underclassman？ Well, that's
fine. Come to Rinko's house
then.
translations.うん、もちろん。リンコの部屋に、おいでよ。:
Of course, that's okay. Come
to Rinko's house, okay？
translations.中入るのは初めてか……じゃ、入って。:
It's your first time to get in
my room, right？ Welcome.
translations.じゃ、入って。言っとくけどさ、不審者は容赦なく捕まるから。:
Okay, welcome. Let me tell
you. If you do anything weird,
I'll get the security guard to
arrest you.
translations.あのさ……中に入るのは……初めてだよね？:
Say... This is your first time
to get in my room, right？
translations.守衛さんには、いちおうカレシって言っとくから。:
I already told the security
guard that you're my
boyfriend.
translations.（不審者扱いか……）:
(Or they might think that I'm
a suspicious person？)
translations.あのさ、リンコの家、もう慣れた？:
Hey, you've come to Rinko's
house quite often, huh？
translations.部屋見てもいいけど、外に出たら記憶から抹消すること。:
You can look as much as you
want, but you have to forget
everything when you leave.
translations.金目の物、そんなにないから。:
I don't have anything valuable
here.
translations.なんか、自分の部屋なのに緊張してきた……。:
It's my own room, but somehow,
I'm getting nervous...
translations.ほら。突っ立ってないで、準備するよ。:
Hey, let's get ready for
studying.
translations.へへ。まだちょっとだけ落ち着かないかも。:
Hehe. I need to calm myself
down a bit.
translations.ほらほら、早く座って。: Hey, come on. Have a seat.
translations.これから問題を３つ出すよ。正解だったら、ご褒美もあるかもね。:
There will be 3 questions. If
you answer them all correctly,
you'll get a reward.
translations.ほんとに全問正解……？ ご褒美か……約束だし。:
You really got them all
correct... I promised you a
reward, right...？
translations.全問正解だね。じゃあ、リンコからご褒美あげる……。:
All correct, huh？ Then Rinko
will give you a reward...
translations.ご褒美はなしだね。惜しかったけどさ。:
I can't give you the reward.
This is regrettable.
translations.はい、残念。一問間違えたから、ご褒美はなし。:
Okay, too bad. You didn't get
all the correct answers. No
reward.
translations.惜しかったけど、これだとご褒美はあげられないよ？:
This is regrettable, but I
can't give you any reward.
translations.どうする？ もう一回やってあげてもいいけど？:
It can't be helped. Let's try
once more.
translations.しょうがないなー。じゃ、もう一回。:
What do you wanna do？ I don't
mind doing this again, though.
translations.ダメすぎ。ご褒美には程遠いね。:
You're way too bad to get any
reward.
translations.残念……。ちょっと間違い多かったね。:
Too bad... You missed too many
of them.
translations.今度こそ正解してみせてよね。:
You'd better get it right
this time.
translations.もう……しょうがないな。ちょっと待ってて。:
Geez... I have no choice. Just
wait a moment.
translations.あのさ……もっとそばに……よらないの？:
Hey... Do you want to get
closer to me...？
translations.なんかさ……足りないよね？:
Something is quite lacking
here, huh...？
translations.せっかくくれたんだしさ……だったら見る権利くらいはあるだろうし……。:
I went through the trouble for
this... So it's your privilege
to look at me...
translations.はい、ご褒美。ここでお披露目になっちゃった。:
Okay, the reward. Think of it
as my debut.
translations.ご褒美。オトコってさ、こういうの好き、なんだよね？:
Your reward. I think most guys
like something like this,
right？
translations.ご褒美。こんなリンコ……どう思う？:
Your reward. What do you think
when you look at Rinko？
translations.はい。ご褒美タイムおしまい。:
Okay, time's up for your
reward.
translations.ご褒美はここまで！ ああもう、恥ずかしかった！:
This is it for the reward！
Argh！ It's embarrassing.
translations.はい。ご褒美おしまい。続きはまた今度だよ。:
Okay. That's enough. We'll
continue next time.
translations.もう一回、問題解いてくれたら、別のも見せてあげるけど？ どうする？:
If you answer another set of
questions correctly, I'll show
you a different costume. How's
that？
translations.ＯＫ。じゃあ、もう一回チャレンジ。:
Okay. Then another round of
challenge.
translations.そう。じゃあ、また今度。:
I see. Then we'll do this
later.
translations.頑張ったみたいだしさ、特別……。:
Since you really tried your
best, here's a special...
translations.特別だよ。これで……やる気、出たよね？:
This is special... Do you feel
motivated？
translations.しょうがないからさ、はい。これで少しはやる気出るでしょ？:
It can't be helped... Here.
Will this motivate you a
little bit？
translations.もう。これでやる気でないなら知らないから。:
Geez. If this can't motivate
you, I don't know what will.
translations.恥ずかしいんだから……これで、やるき出してよね。:
It's embarrassing... I hope
this helps motivate you.
translations.どうなの？ これさ。: What do you think about this？
translations.なんか……落ち着かないんだけど……。:
Somehow... I can't feel at
ease...
translations.これだと……罰ゲームみたいじゃん。:
I feel like I'm punished to
wear this.
translations.いつまで見てんの……ばか……。:
How long are you going to
look...？ Idiot...
translations.もう、何もないってば……。:
Hey, I said there's nothing
here...
translations.こんな格好だけど……いい……？:
Is this kind of outfit
okay...？
translations.服とか……気にならないよね……？:
You don't care much about my
outfit, huh...？
translations.このまま？ そんなの、おかしいって……。:
Like this, do I look
strange...？
translations.それじゃ、今日はこのへんで切り上げよっか。:
Then this should be it for
today.
translations.今日はありがと。けっこう勉強になったと思う。:
Thank you. I think I've
learned many things today.
translations.自信ついた。これならテストいい点取れるかも。:
Now I'm more confident. I'll
probably get good grades on
the exams.
translations.今日はほんとにありがとね。この調子なら、テストもがんばれそうかも。:
Thank you for today. Like
this, I'm sure I can do my
best on the exams.
translations.いまいち不安かな……。:
I still feel uneasy about the
exams...
translations.うーん。勉強会の意味なかったかも……。:
Well... I didn't feel much
like we were reviewing
lessons...
translations.あんまりうまくいかなかったね。どうしよ……。:
It didn't go well. What should
I do...？
translations.勉強……全然はかどらなかったんだけど……？:
We didn't make much progress
on our lesson reviews...
translations.全然うまくいかなかったじゃん……。むしろ時間の無駄……。:
It didn't go well... I feel
like it was such a waste of
time...
translations.さっぱりだった。テスト、すごく不安……。:
This is not good. Now, I feel
very uneasy about the exams...
translations.もう、こんな時間だし、今日はもう終わり。:
It's already this late. We
should stop here.
translations.もうこんな時間か……すぐ帰っちゃう？:
It's this time already？ Do
you have to hurry home？
translations.もう少し一緒にいたいな: I still want to be here
translations.そっか。じゃあ……下まで送るから。: Okay. I'll see you off then...
translations.来てくれてサンキュ。勉強、もうちょっとがんばってみる。:
Thanks for coming. I'll try my
best with my study.
translations.なんか来てもらって悪かったかも。勉強のほうも、あんまりだったし……。:
Somehow, it wasn't a good idea
for you to come here. Our
study didn't go well either...
translations.勉強会っていうより……ちょっとヘンな感じ……。:
The way we review our lessons
was a bit weird...
translations.憩いの場が求められてるのかもな。家族で弁当持って来たりするにはいいところかも。:
I think people are looking for
a place to relax. There are
families that bring lunch
boxes here too.
translations.いいんじゃない、そういうのもさ。うん、悪くないね。:
Isn't that good？ I think it's
not a bad idea.
translations.（家族とは上手くいってるみたいだな……）:
(I guess she's getting along
well with her family now...)
translations.ここ歩くと、時間の経過を感じる。:
Walking around here makes me
feel like we're traveling
through time.
translations.木なんかは日々成長してるしな。:
These trees grow day by day,
huh？
translations.こういう自然のある場所に来ると、季節の変化なんかもわかるしさ。:
Being close to nature like
this, we can notice all the
season changes.
translations.ずっと一緒にこういうの見られたらいいよな。:
It would be nice if we could
stay here watching this
forever.
translations.……なに言ってんの。バカじゃん。:
...What are you saying？ Are
you an idiot？
translations.遠くに行くのもいいけど、こういうところでまったりするのもいいよな。:
It's good to go for a vacation
somewhere, but just relaxing
here is nice, too.
translations.ほんとはイチャイチャしたいとか、思ってんじゃない？:
Actually, you were thinking
about flirting with me and
stuff, right？
translations.神社って、来ると身が引き締まらないか？ いつも誰かに見られてるって感じがして。:
When you come to the shrine,
do you feel like someone or
something is watching us all
the time？
translations.たしかに。そういえば中学のとき、鳥居なんかにいたずらしたらさ。:
Yeah, right. Speaking of
which, one time I was trying
to play a prank with the
shrine's archway.
translations.バチでも当たった？:
Did you get cursed after
that？
translations.うん。神社の人に見つかって境内の掃除させられた。ほんとどこから見てたんだろ、あれ:
Yeah, the shrine keeper found
out and forced me to sweep the
shrine's ground. I still
wonder how he could see me.
translations.（見られてるって、そういう意味じゃ……）:
(I didn't mean it that way
though...)
translations.神社かぁ。なんかさ、年中、虫がいそう……。:
A shrine, huh？ There are a
lot of insects here all year
round...
translations.童心にかえって虫捕りでもするか？:
Do you feel like catching some
insects now？
translations.ガキかっつーの。一人でやれば？:
Do you think I'm a child！？
If you want to, do it by
yourself.
translations.それじゃデートの意味が……。:
If I do so, this won't be like
a date...
translations.だったらもっとデートっぽい提案したら？ そしたら、リンコもノってあげるからさ。:
If you know that, try
suggesting something more
suitable for a date. I might
join you then.
translations.おみくじ引いていこっか？:
Do you want to draw a
fortune？
translations.落ち込むなって！ とりあえず、一緒に結びにいこうよ！:
Don't feel down！ Let's tie
our fortune together to drive
away bad luck！
translations.なんで？ コレ、大吉なんだけど？:
Why？ Look, I got the
"excellent luck" one.
translations.じゃあ、もっと喜べばいいのに。:
Well then, you should've acted
a bit happier.
translations.だって、あとは下がるだけじゃん？ ハァ……つまんない。:
But I can't get any better
fortune after I got this one.
Hah... This is boring.
translations.（●の方が落ち込みたいよ……）:
(I should be the one who feels
disappointed...)
translations.タイトル変わってるからわかんなかったけど、原作読んだことある。:
They changed the title so I
didn't recognize it at first,
but I've read the original
novel.
translations.設定もストーリーも大胆にアレンジしてるから、すぐわからなかった。へぇ、やるなぁ。:
The scenes and story are
pretty unique so I noticed it.
They did pretty well for this.
translations.（この映画、正解だったみたいだな）:
(Seems like I chose the right
movie this time.)
translations.ま、そこそこかな。: Well, it was so-so, I think.
translations.思ったよりは楽しめた。最初から期待してなければ、外すショックもないしね。:
It was better than I thought.
But I didn't expect much to
begin with, so I didn't feel
disappointed.
translations.映画なんてさ、そのぐらいに構えてるのがちょうどいいって。:
For a movie, that much is
enough for me to care about.
translations.なんか、“いかにも”って感じ。制作費数十億？ 全米ナンバー１？ “泣けましたー”:
Why would people give
"Thumbs-up" or "No.1 at U.S.
Box Office" or "I'm so
impressed" opinions for such a
movie？
translations.ま、たまにはこういうくだらない娯楽で時間を浪費するのもいいんじゃない？:
Well, it's fine that we waste
our time with something
worthless like this
occasionally, right？
translations.無駄のある生活こそが、人生に潤いを与えるってね。:
Sometimes you can gain
something from living a futile
life, right？
translations.（ポジティブなんだかネガティブなんだか……）:
(Does that have positive or
negative meaning...？)
translations.リンコ、ボウリングって苦手なんだよね。:
I'm so bad at bowling, aren't
I？
translations.ボールが重いから？:
I think the ball is too heavy
for you.
translations.……悪い？ だって腕つりそうになるんだもん。:
...Really？ That's why my arm
is getting sore...
translations.……子供用ボール使えば？:
...Why don't you use the
children's ball then？
translations.ヤダ、カッコわるい。ポリシーに反するよ。:
No, that's so uncool. It's
against my policy.
translations.ストライクを２回連続で出すのはダブルだよね。:
When we get 2 strikes in a
row, it's called "double,"
right？
translations.だな、３回連続だとターキー。:
Yeah, and for 3 strikes in a
row, it's called "turkey."
translations.それそれ、なんでターキーなわけ？ ターキーって七面鳥だよね？:
Why is that？ Turkey as a type
of bird？
translations.なんかいろいろ説はあるらしいけど……実際のところは知らないな。:
There are many theories about
this, but I don't know which
one is true.
translations.もう、気になるなぁ。ターキー達成したら、教えること！:
Well, never mind. If I can
make a turkey, you tell me
then.
translations.ふぅ。ボウリングもさ、やってみるとそこそこ面白いよね。:
Phew, it's quite fun to play
bowling once I get used to it.
translations.スカーンって爽快に倒せるようになるとさ、もっと面白くなるんだろうけどね。重いボー:
It would be more enjoyable if
I could sweep all the pins
though. Maybe I should use a
heavier ball.
translations.重いのは持てないだろ？: You can't carry a heavy ball.
translations.じゃあ両手で……いやいや、カッコ悪い。:
Then I'll use both hands...
No, that would be so uncool.
translations.（爽快感より、カッコ良さなんだな）:
(You care more about being
cool than having fun, huh？)
translations.うん、やっぱ生で観るのはいいからさ。でも本当に観たいバンドはほとんど解散しちゃっ:
Yeah, their live performances
were nice. Anyway, most of the
bands that I like are already
disbanded.
translations.伝説のライブとかさ、観たかったよ。リンコがもっと早く生まれてればなぁ。:
VThere were those legendary
concerts that I wanted to
watch. I wish I were born
sooner.
translations.辛口リンコから４０点台もらえれば、胸を張っていいって。リンコの点数は世の評論家プ:
Anyone who gets 40 points from
me can be proud. Add 20 points
to my score and it can be
world critics' standard.
translations.じゃあ▲小早川＊▲に選ばれた●は、胸を張ってもいいのかな。:
Then as a guy that
▲Kobayaka＊▲
chose, I can be proud, right？
translations.……今の発言、７点。:
...For that statement, I give
you 7 points.
translations.大分ね、ここまで外してくれると、いっそ清々しい。:
I wish we could leave this
place as soon as possible.
translations.悪いのはアンタだけじゃないって、こういう文化を容認してる現代社会が悪いんだよ。ア:
It's not just you. It's the
whole society that approves
something like this. You're
not the only one to be blamed.
translations.（やっぱ●も悪いんだな……）:
(But I'm one of those to be
blamed, right...？)
translations.へっへっへー。リンコをカラオケに連れてきたらどうなるか、当然理解してるよね？:
Teeheehee. You know what will
happen when you take Rinko to
the karaoke box, right？
translations.当然、入れる曲は洋楽縛りに決まってんじゃん。ちゃらちゃらしたＪ－ＰＯＰなんか歌わ:
Of course, we'll sing only
Western songs. I won't sing
any cheesy J-POP songs, you
know？
translations.さーて、何、歌おっかなー。今日のリンコはすごいよー。驚くよー。:
Well, what should I sing
first？ I'm really good at
this. You'll be surprised.
translations.（テンション高いな……楽しんでるからいいけど）:
(She's so pumped up... I think
it's fine as long as she
enjoys it.)
translations.こう、カラオケ来るとさ。前の人の履歴をチェックしちゃうよね。:
When we come to a karaoke box
like this, we can see what the
people before us sang, right？
translations.ああ、見ちゃうね、つい。: Yeah, we can see the records.
translations.ん、なんだこれ、履歴がデュエットのラブソングばっか。:
Huh？ What are these？ They
are all duets and love songs.
translations.カップルで楽しくカラオケですか、ちゃんと歌うたえっつーの。:
Why did a couple come to a
karaoke box？ And can't they
just sing regular songs？
translations.（●達の立場は……？）:
(And what about us？ What are
we...？)
translations.さーて。今日は何、歌おっかなー。:
Well, what am I gonna sing
today？
translations.たまには洋楽以外も歌わないか？:
Can we sing something besides
Western songs occasionally？
translations.せっかく●と来てるんだから、流行りのラブソングとか。:
Since we're already here, how
about some popular love
songs？
translations.やだ、最悪、ダサい、却下。……はい、この曲でケッテー。:
No, that's the worst. No way！
I object. ...Here, let's sing
this song.
translations.（ん、これは英語のラブソング……だよな？）:
(Huh？ This is an English love
song... I think.)
translations.観覧車なんて、ぐるぐる回るだけで何が楽しいんだろ、って思ってたけどさ。:
The Ferris wheel just keeps
going round and round. I was
wondering what was so fun
about it.
translations.乗ってみると、結構面白いもんだね。:
Once I tried it, it was pretty
fun.
translations.気に入ってくれて嬉しいよ。: I'm happy that you like it.
translations.なんでアンタが嬉しがるのさ。リンコは観覧車を褒めたの、アンタいつから観覧車になっ:
Why are you being happy？ I'm
praising the Ferris wheel.
Since when did you become the
Ferris wheel, huh？
translations.観覧車って不思議だよね。昼と夜とじゃなんか違う感じがする。:
The Ferris wheel is wonderful.
The feelings are different
during the daytime and the
nighttime.
translations.ほら。昼間は家族連れとかがわーって楽しむ感じだけど、夕方とか夜になると……。:
See. During the daytime,
people bring their families
and have some fun. Then at
nighttime...
translations.そんなつもりがなくても、一緒に乗った相手を意識したりして。:
Even for the couples that
don't intend for such a mood,
they will feel it too.
translations.そんなこと……ま、乗ってみたらわかるかもね。:
For that... Well, we'll know
if we try, right？
translations.なんかくだらなくない？ こういうのって。:
It's kind of dumb, isn't it？
This stuff.
translations.あぁも脅かしてやろうって気満々だと、却って怖がらないぞって思うじゃん。:
It really felt like they were
trying to scare you, but
rather, don't you think it
wasn't even scary？
translations.その割に、中では●にぴったりくっついてたぞ？:
You're saying that now, but
weren't you holding onto me
tightly when we were in
there？
translations.あれは演技、サービスだよ。へへ、だまされた？:
That was an act. My special
service. Hehe, did I fool
you？
translations.もう！ なんでこんなに暗いかな！ 歩きにくいし！:
Geez！ Why is it so dark！？
It's hard to walk！
translations.どうせアンタも“きゃー！ 暗ーい！ こわーい！”とか言って抱きついてくるのを期待:
You might expect me to scream,
"Kyaa！ It's dark！ I'm
scared！" and cling to you,
but it's never gonna happen.
translations.入り口にさ、“ボクより小さい子は乗れないよ”って書いた絵あるよね。:
There's that sign, "If you are
shorter than me, you can't
ride this" at the entrance.
translations.あの絵って、昔からなんかムカツクんだよね。:
I've felt so irritated with
that picture since a long time
ago.
translations.身長制限にひっかかったことがあるのか？:
It's there to show the height
restriction, isn't it？
translations.それは！ あるけど……とにかく上から目線が気にくわないんだってば！:
That's right！ But... I felt
like it was looking down on me
every time！
translations.だからさ、身長追い越した後はいつも見下ろしてやることにしてんだよね。:
That's why ever since I've
grown taller than it, I always
walked there and looked down
on it.
translations.ジェットコースターってさ……一番上に昇りきるとこまでが本番だね。:
For a roller coaster, the most
exciting moment is when it's
getting close to the summit,
right？
translations.たしかに、走りだしちゃえば一瞬だからな。:
Right. After that, everything
goes by in an instant.
translations.この昇っているときの緊張感があるからこそ、それが解放されたときのカタルシスが大き:
The excitement when we go up
to the peak and then unleash
all our feelings is like a
catharsis, huh？
translations.そんなに理屈っぽく考えなくても……。:
You don't have to think of
such a theory...
translations.この遊園地の目玉なんだよ。:
This is the amusement park's
special program.
translations.ほんとにおとぎの国みたいだね……。: This is like a real fairyland.
translations.うわぁ……。電気代かかりそー……。:
Wow... Their electricity bill
must cost a lot...
translations.……微妙な反応だな。あんまり興味ないか？:
...What a strange reaction.
You don't like this then？
translations.違うって。ちゃんとキレイだなって思ってるって！:
It's not like that. I think
it's very beautiful！
translations.じゃあ、なんで電気代？:
Then why are you concerned
about the electricity bill？
translations.それは、ちょっと気になっただけで……いいから照れ隠しってことにしとけっつーの。:
That's because I was just
wondering... Can you not make
me feel any more awkward！？
translations.このまま、時間止まっちゃえばいいのに……。:
It would be nice if we could
stop time right here...
translations.ご機嫌だな、▲小早川＊▲。:
You are in such a good mood,
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
translations.プールってさ、海と違って流されても壁があるじゃん。浮き輪に乗って、ぼーって浮いて:
Unlike the sea, the swimming
pool has walls. I can put this
swim ring on and float around
without worrying.
translations.ああ、そういう楽しみ方もあるかな。:
Yeah, you can enjoy your time
like that.
translations.あ、別に浮き輪がないと泳げないわけじゃないから。:
Ah, but that doesn't mean I
can't swim without this swim
ring.
translations.そんなこと言ってないよ。でも危ないから、ひっくり返るなよ？:
I didn't say that. But you
must be careful. Don't let it
topple over and fall, okay？
translations.だから泳げるって言ってんじゃん！:
I said that I can swim, didn't
you hear！？
translations.うん。泳ぐならやっぱプールだね。施設も充実してるし。:
Yeah, it sure is nice to swim
in the pool. This is very well
designed.
translations.海は海で楽しいけどな。:
But the sea also has its good
points.
translations.水飲んだ時のショックは海のほうがおっきいじゃん。:
If you choke, sea water would
feel more terrible.
translations.……ちょっとはしゃぎすぎたかも。疲れた、眠い。:
...I was in such high spirits
that I'm now exhausted. I'm
sleepy.
translations.こら、こんなとこで立って寝るな。器用だな。:
Hey, don't fall asleep while
you're standing like that.
translations.ほら、着替えて来いって。待っててやるから。:
Come on. Go change your
clothes. I'll wait here.
translations.（眠いと素直になるのか？）:
(She becomes obedient when
she's sleepy, huh？)
translations.星座の説明ってさ、なんか聞き入っちゃう。:
I tried to listen to the
narration attentively.
translations.でもすぐ忘れちゃうんだよな。:
But you forgot about it in no
time, right？
translations.そうそう。カタチ見ただけじゃ覚えられないしさ、なんか名前もややこしいし。:
Right, right. I can't remember
the stars' configurations or
their names.
translations.何度聞いても、新鮮な話に感じるから、得した気になれるな。:
This way, whenever you come
here, everything you hear will
always sound like new
information to you.
translations.ねぇ。最近、星って見てる？:
Hey, have you been looking at
the stars lately？
translations.だよね。忙しい現代人は星を見上げる心の余裕さえ失ってさ。:
Right. People these days get
too busy to glance up at the
sky.
translations.あまつさえ偽物の星でそんな心の隙間を埋めようとする。いやぁ、世知辛いね。:
Yet they invented something
like this so that they could
see fake stars. Ah, life is
tough.
translations.ひょっとして行きたくないのか？:
Does it mean you don't like to
come to this place？
translations.……そういうわけじゃ。悪かったね、リンコ素直じゃなくってさ。:
...That's not the case. Sorry,
Rinko didn't really mean to
say that.
translations.星ってさ、何万年とか何億年とか前の光がようやく届いて見えてるんだよね。:
For the stars, it takes them
some million or billion years
until their lights reach us
and we can see them, right？
translations.リンコたちのいる星の光も、別の星の誰かが何万年もかけて見てるのかな？:
The light from our star will
reach other stars in some
billion years and someone out
there might see it.
translations.リンコ達のことも見られたりするのかな。リンコ達はどう見えてるのかな？ ね？:
Will someone be able to see
us, too？ I wonder how they
will see us. Hmm？
translations.別に恥ずかしいことなんて、してないじゃん？:
But we aren't doing anything
embarrassing now.
translations.こういうとこ来るとさ、花ってこんなに種類があったんだって改めて思うよ。:
Whenever I come here, I'm
always amazed with how many
types of flowers there are.
translations.花だけじゃなくて、珍しい木や草もあるみたいだぞ。:
Not just flowers, there are
also rare plants and grasses
here as well.
translations.あっ、この花、ヘンな形してる。:
Ah, that flower has such a
weird shape.
translations.ヘンな形って……。花もそんなこと言われたくないって思ってるぞ、きっと。:
Weird shape...？ I don't think
the flower would be happy to
hear you say that, really.
translations.あ、ヘンな顔の男子高校生がいる。:
Ah, this high school guy right
here is making such a weird
face.
translations.……その男子高校生も、そんなこと言われたくないって思ってるぞ……きっと。:
...I don't think the high
school guy is happy to hear
you say that... Really.
translations.植物って、普通の呼び方以外にも学名とかあって覚えきれなくない？:
Plants also have their
scientific names besides their
common names, right？ Do you
remember them？
translations.別に覚えなくてもいいだろ？:
There's no need to remember,
is there？
translations.でもさ、わざとやってんじゃないかってくらい複雑な名前してる、挑戦的じゃん？:
But they are such complicated
names. Don't you feel
challenged to remember them？
translations.そりゃ、リンコたちにだよ。よっし、いっこくらい覚えてこっと。:
Then let me make it a
challenge for us. Let's see
how many we can remember.
translations.（帰る頃には忘れてるんだろうな）:
(By the time I reach home,
I'll surely forget all of
them.)
translations.ああ。亜熱帯植物のコーナーだからな。:
Yeah, it's the subtropical
plants' corner after all.
translations.残念だけどリンコにはここの花たちを愛でる余裕がないよ。:
It's very unfortunate that
Rinko doesn't have any passion
for the flowers here.
translations.さよなら。もう会えないと思うけど……。:
Goodbye. I think I'll never
see them ever again.
translations.置いてくよ？ アンタもリンコにさよならされたい？:
I'm leaving. Do you want me to
say goodbye to you, too？
translations.わかったわかった。: I got it, I got it.
translations.リンコは楽しかったけど……アンタは退屈じゃなかった？:
I really had fun... But did
you get bored？
translations.なんか自分が楽しいと、楽しいのは自分だけなんじゃないかって思ったりする。:
I had so much fun that I was
worrying whether it was just
me.
translations.そんなことないって。●も充分楽しいぞ。:
I said that it's not the case.
I also had some fun.
translations.ふぅん。こういうとこって来たことないな……。ひとりだったら一生来なかったかも。:
Hmm, I've never been to this
kind of show. If I were alone,
I would never have a chance to
watch it.
translations.良かったかどうかは、また別問題だけど……。:
Whether it's good or not,
that's another question...
translations.▲小早川＊▲に少しでも良いことがあるなら、●も付き合ってる甲斐があるよ。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
if I could make you enjoy it
just a little bit, that would
make bringing you here worth
it.
translations.あーあ、リンコがオトコに影響されるなんてなー。:
Ah~！ No, Rinko doesn't easily
get influenced by a guy！
translations.人が多いだけじゃん？ 他に行くところないのかっつーの。:
It was just too crowded. Can't
you think of some place else
to go？
translations.なんか疲れてるから、小キックは封印中だよ。命拾いしたね。:
I'm just too exhausted to give
you a kick. Your life is safe
for today.
translations.海が近いからなぁ。: We're very close to the ocean.
translations.あの橋も揺れたりしないのかな……。:
I wonder if that bridge was
shaking...
translations.ああ、それでここ、デートスポットに使ってるんだ。吊り橋効果ってやつ？:
Ah, that thing is the famous
date spot, right？ Is it
what's called a suspension
bridge？
translations.吊り橋か、一気に橋の風格が下がったな。:
Suspension bridge？ It's more
like a normal bridge that is
curving down.
translations.なんでカップルってこんなとこ来たがるんだろ？ 夜景がきれい？ ロマンチック？ あ:
Why do couples like to come
here？ Because the night view
is beautiful and romantic？
Ah, come on. Answer me.
translations.今や完全にデートスポットだからな。普通に遊びに行くのと同じ感覚なんだろ。:
It's called a perfect date
spot, but it doesn't feel any
different from when I came
here alone.
translations.だね。だいたい、そんなこと言ったら、リンコたちも同じようなもんだし。:
Yeah, when you say so, I can
feel that our thoughts are
pretty much alike.
translations.で、どうする？:
Now then, what are we gonna
do？
translations.せっかく来たんだし、ちょっと歩いてみよ。喜んでるふりくらいはしてあげるよ。:
Since we're already here,
let's take a stroll. For you,
I can at least pretend to have
fun.
translations.この橋、渡るべからず。:
We shouldn't walk across this
bridge.
translations.つまり……橋の中央を渡ればいいのか？:
That means... you're fine if
we walk up to the middle of
the bridge？
translations.轢かれるよ。車、走ってるし。:
We would be run over. There
are car lanes, right？
translations.海の定番といえば？:
What's your general impression
of the ocean？
translations.はずれ。そんな非生産的なことはしません。:
No. I'm not going to do
anything unproductive like
that.
translations.やっぱこれだよね。やきそば食べよ。:
It has to be something like...
eating fried noodles.
translations.（生産的というか即物的というか……）:
(I doubt that's what you can
call "productive"...)
translations.あ、砂の城なんて作ってる。なんで海にまで来てさ、砂で遊んだりするんだろ。水に触れ:
Ah, people are building sand
castles？ Why do they come to
the ocean to play with sand
and not get in the ocean？
translations.まぁ、ビーチ込みで海水浴だろ？:
Well, they might be playing on
the beach before sea bathing.
translations.ふぅん、まあ下手に体動かすよりはラクでよさそうだけどさ。……あそこからまだ大きく:
Hmm, maybe they just don't
like to move their bodies that
much. ...That's such a big
sand castle. Pretty nice.
translations.……ね、リンコ達でも作れるかな？:
...Hey, shall we build one
like that, too？
translations.（興味あるのか）:
(Actually, you wanted to do
it, huh？)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。水着、似合ってるな。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
You look good with that
swimsuit.
translations.でも、ほんとに似合ってる。:
But it really suits you
nicely.
translations.たまには素直に褒められてみろって。:
I just want to praise you
frankly.
translations.……わかった、褒められとく。ありがと。:
...I get it. Thanks for
praising me.
translations.来てから言うのもなんだけどさ、何するの？ 水、冷たいよ？:
When you said we should just
come here, what did you think
we could do？ The water is
very cold.
translations.別に恋人同士が海に来るのに、目的なんていらないだろ。:
We are lovers, right？ We
don't need any special reason
to come to the ocean.
translations.ちょっとくさかったか……。:
This is getting a little
awkward...
translations.……わかったわかった、散歩でもする？ 実はこんな海も嫌いじゃないよ、暑くないしさ:
...I got it, I got it. Let's
take a stroll. I don't really
hate it here. At least the
weather isn't so hot.
translations.シーズンオフの海は物悲しいね、演歌の世界だね。:
The off-season ocean feels
pretty sad. It's like
listening to oldies songs.
translations.リンコには、波をバックに熱唱する演歌歌手が見えるよ。:
It's like Rinko is singing an
oldie song with the waves as
her background music.
translations.なんだそれ。例えば、どんな歌？:
What is this？ For example,
what kind of song？
translations.って、歌うかっつーの！:
What！？ You think I'm gonna
sing here！？
translations.リンコは、時季外れの静かな海のほうが好きかな。:
I think I like the quiet
off-season ocean like this.
translations.何をするわけでもないけどね。:
We can't really do anything
here though.
translations.波の音聞いてると、和むよな。:
We can feel at peace just
listening to the wave's sound.
translations.……まったく、カレシが和んじゃったみたいだし？ 少しぐらい退屈でも、もうちょっと:
...Really. I mean I want my
boyfriend to feel inner peace
although it's a little boring
to be here.
translations.マンボウってさ、なに考えてるんだろね。:
I wonder what these sunfish
are thinking.
translations.ぼけーっとしてるように見えるけどな。:
They look like they're just
fooling around all day.
translations.実はすっごい哲学的なこと考えてたりして。宇宙とは何かー、命とは何かー。:
But they might actually think
about something very
philosophical, like what the
universe is, or what life
is...
translations.ほら、アンタも少しは見習ってみ？:
Hey, can you at least follow
their examples？
translations.スキューバダイビングなんかで、マンボウと一緒に泳ぐのが人気らしいよ。:
When people go scuba diving,
they like to swim along with
the sunfish, you know？
translations.でっかいのに、おとなしくて。たしかに最適かもな。:
Sunfish are huge and obedient
so they're the best choice.
translations.リンコも、マンボウだったら一緒に泳いであげてもいいかな。:
For me, I think swimming
alongside the sunfish isn't a
bad idea.
translations.皮膚にはたくさんの寄生虫が貼りついてるって、ここに書いてあるぞ。:
But it's written here that
there are so many parasites on
sunfish's skin.
translations.……やっぱ見てるだけがいい……。:
...Then it's good enough to
just watch them...
translations.飛べない鳥か……。:
A bird that can't fly,
huh...？
translations.なんとなく。コンプレックスとかあるのかなって。:
I wonder if it has some kind
of inferiority complex.
translations.生き物なんだし、集団で生きてればコンプレックスもあるだろ。:
All kinds of living creatures
that live as a group have some
kind of complex, I think.
translations.また無難にまとめるし……アンタはあまりなさそうだね、お気楽だし。:
They have to gather to feel
safe... Totally not like you
who take everything so
lightly.
translations.ペンギンの赤ちゃんって可愛いよね。ちっちゃくてさ、灰色でさ、もふもふしてて。:
The penguin's baby is just so
cute. It's all gray and
fluffy.
translations.そうそう。これで大きくなっても可愛いんだから大自然の奇蹟だね。:
Right, and penguins are still
cute when they grow up. This
is such a miracle of nature.
translations.たまにはね。あっ、お土産買ってこっと。ペンギンのなにか。:
I'm like this occasionally.
Let's buy some souvenirs. I
want something about penguins.
translations.海中を疑似体験って感じ？:
This feels as if we are under
the sea, huh？
translations.あっ！ なんか今、通った！:
Ah！ Something was just
passing by！
translations.なんだろ。速くてよくわからなかった。:
What was that？ It was so fast
that I couldn't see clearly.
translations.そんなのもう一回確かめたらいいじゃん。今度はちゃんと見ててよ。:
Shall we confirm what it was？
If it comes by again, I will
surely know.
translations.（……これはしばらく足止めくらうな）:
(...That means we'll be stuck
here for a while, huh？)
translations.ねぇ。水族館でも小さな魚って大きな魚に食べられたりしてるのかな？:
Hey, in the aquarium, small
fish are eaten by bigger fish,
right？
translations.どうだろうな。目の前で魚が食べられたら小さい子はショックかも。:
I wonder if those tiny fish
are shocked when they see
their friends being eaten
right before their eyes.
translations.弱肉強食か、あまり好きな言葉じゃないかも。小さい子には優しくしてあげればいいんだ:
"The survival of the fittest,"
huh？ I don't like it. The
smaller ones should be treated
with kindness.
translations.イルカってほんと賢いよね。地球で二番目くらいに賢いかも。:
Dolphins are really smart. I
think they're the second
smartest animal in the world.
translations.二番目って……。一番が人間だとして、あとは？:
Second...？ Then humans are
the smartest, right？
translations.一番はネコ。可愛くて賢くてさ、パーフェクトだよ。:
The smartest ones are cats.
Being cute and smart, they're
so perfect.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲のネコ好きはよっぽどだな）:
(▲Kobayaka＊▲'s
love for cats is just too
extreme...)
translations.イルカってなんであんなに跳ねるんだろ、驚異のメカニズムだね。:
How come the dolphins can jump
like that？ There must be some
mechanisms.
translations.たしかに。こう間近で見てても不思議だな。:
Yeah, when we watch them this
close, the jumps are really
wonderful.
translations.きっと筋肉ムキムキだね、可愛い顔してるけど。:
They must be quite brawny,
even with those cute faces.
translations.うん。でもきっとショーのあとは筋肉痛だよ、プロだねぇ。:
Yeah, but they'll have to
endure muscular pain after the
show. They're professionals.
translations.（……なるのか、筋肉痛？）:
(...I wonder if they'll have
muscular pain...)
translations.カップルが多い。すっかりデートスポットじゃん。:
So many couples here. It must
really be a famous date spot.
translations.あ、ネコだ。ここらへん、ネコ多いよな。:
Ah, cats. There are many cats
over there.
translations.……前言撤回。気に入ってるかも、へへ。:
...I withdraw my words. I like
this place. Hehe.
translations.あれってドラマの撮影か？ こんなところで撮影してるのか。:
Are they filming a TV series
over there？
translations.景色いいから、撮影でよく使われてるって聞いたことあるよ。:
This place has nice scenery. I
heard that it's often used as
a location for films and
series.
translations.行っちゃった。しかし……あんな着ぐるみが出てくるドラマってあったか？:
They're gone. But... Is there
a series that has that cartoon
character？
translations.……っていうかさ、カメラなかったんだけど、ほんとにドラマの撮影？:
...And I didn't see any
camera. Are you sure they're
filming a series？
translations.……もしかして、タダのヘンな人だったのか……。:
...Don't tell me they're just
some weird people...
translations.あ、スケボーやってる人たちがいるな。:
Ah, there are people
skateboarding over there.
translations.ねぇ。ああいうのって、やったことある？: Hey, have you ever tried it？
translations.学校に遅刻しそうなときに役立ちそうなんだけど、どうかな？:
It might be handy when I'm
late for school. What do you
think？
translations.危ないって。怪我でもしたら……。:
It's quite dangerous. You
might get hurt...
translations.お父さんかっつーの！:
Don't talk like you're my
dad！
translations.カップルってさ、やたら高いとこ行きたがると思わない？ 偏見？:
Couples usually enjoy being at
some high places, don't you
think？ Pretty typical.
translations.そう……かな？ たしかに景色がどうこうとか、デートスポットには高い場所が多いかも:
Is... that so？ But I guess
many date spots with nice
scenery are all up in high
places, huh？
translations.高いとこに昇って？ 気分まで浮ついちゃって？ もっと地に足のついた付き合いはでき:
They just try to build those
places at high spots？ Can't
people date somewhere closer
to the ground？
translations.まぁ、たまには浮ついちゃうぐらいが楽しいんじゃないか？:
Well, occasionally, the
excitement when we're up this
high feels nice, right？
translations.そう、た・ま・に。そのさじ加減が、大人の付き合いってやつでしょ。:
Yes, once in a while. The
people that keep going to such
places are some boring adults.
translations.わざわざ上まで来たんだからさ、ぐるっとまわってみれば。:
Since we're already here, how
about we try walking around？
translations.そうだな。一番良い景色を見ていこうぜ。:
Okay, let's go to the spot
with the best view.
translations.はぁ。アンタってさ、たまにほんと子供みたいにはしゃぐよね。:
Hah, sometimes you really act
like a kid.
translations.だってせっかく来たんだし。:
Because I've been waiting for
us to be here.
translations.ま、いいんだけどさ。あ、走ると転ぶから気をつけなよ。:
Well, fine then. Ah, don't
run, or you'll fall down. Be
careful.
translations.実際昇ってみると、外から眺めるより高く感じるんだよね。:
When we're actually here, it's
much higher up than I had
pictured it.
translations.ずっと下見てるけど怖くないのか？:
Aren't you scared when you
look down like that？
translations.なんで？ ここって手抜き工事の噂でもあんの？:
Why？ Were there rumors about
accidents or poor construction
here？
translations.ないなら問題なし。ほら、アンタもおいでよ。見るだけならタダなんだからさ。:
Then that's no problem. Come
on. You should try looking
down there too. They won't
charge us for it.
translations.なるほど。このあたり、いかにも女の子が好きそうなデザインだよね。:
I see. This is the kind of
design that girls like, huh？
translations.じゃあ、聞くけどさ。この中にリンコが気に入りそうなものがあると思う？:
Then let me ask. Among these
items, which one would Rinko
like？
translations.そ、リンコの好みは複雑なの。雑誌とタレントに踊らされるティーンエイジャーとは違う:
Right. Rinko's preference is
complicated, unlike those
teenagers who copy magazine
models or idols.
translations.だって……こんな店にあるの、リンコに似合うはずないじゃん。:
But why do we have to be
here？ There isn't anything
that will suit Rinko anyway.
translations.そんなことないって。とにかく見るだけ見てみよう。見るだけならタダなんだし。:
Even if you say so, we can
just look around. They won't
charge us for looking.
translations.……うん。見るくらいなら、いいけど……。:
...Okay, it's fine if we just
look around...
translations.（もうちょっと自信持ってもいいのにな）:
(You should have more
confidence in yourself.)
translations.クラスの子とかはさ、こういうのいろいろ試してるらしいんだけど。:
A lot of my classmates like to
try these items.
translations.へぇ。さすがにこのあたりは男には理解しにくい世界だな。:
Huh？ This is really the world
that guys can't understand.
translations.でもさ、女の子のきれいになりたいって気持ちぐらい理解できない？ 一応、カノジョ持:
But at least you should
understand the feelings of
girls who want to become
pretty. You have a girlfriend,
after all.
translations.まあ……それはな。やっぱり▲小早川＊▲もそうなのか？:
Well... In that case,
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
you want to become pretty,
too？
translations.……あーあ。やっぱわかってないよね、アンタ。:
...Hah, you really don't
understand a thing.
translations.女って面倒だよね。外出するにもいちいち化粧したりしないといけないし。:
It's so troublesome to be
women. Many women can't go
outside without putting on
make-ups.
translations.▲小早川＊▲は化粧しないよな。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
but you don't wear any
make-ups, right？
translations.でもそのうちするようになるんだよな、どんな風になるんだろう。:
But you'll start using them
someday, right？ I wonder how
you'll look.
translations.勝手に想像すんな！:
Don't imagine things on your
own！
translations.いかにも女の子向けのアクセサリーショップだな。:
There are only accessories for
girls, huh？
translations.一応、男向けもあるみたいだけど？:
There seem to be some for
guys, too.
translations.似合うかどうかは別問題だけどさ、リンコは別に止めないよ？:
Well, whether they will look
good on you or not is
questionable though.
translations.ん？ 気に入ったのがあったのか？:
Hmm？ Is there any of them
that you like？
translations.別に。まだそこまで興味はないかな。:
Not really. I'm not that
interested in these items.
translations.でもミュージシャンって結構ジャラジャラ付けてるよな、真似したりしないの？:
But many music artists wear
these kinds of items too,
right？ Haven't you tried to
copy them？
translations.真似とか言うな。あとね、音楽はファッションじゃないの、精神性なの、精神性。:
Don't say such a thing as
copy. And music is not
fashion. Music is the soul.
The soul！
translations.んー。こーんな静かな湖畔に来るとさ、自然と眠くなっちゃうね。:
Hmm. It sure is quiet. It's
like I'm automatically feeling
sleepy when I'm at the lake
shore.
translations.ちょっ、カノジョとのデート中に眠いとか言うなっつーの。:
Wait. Don't say you're getting
sleepy while you're on a date
with your girlfriend！
translations.だってさ、また来ればいいじゃないか、何度でも。:
But, we can always come back
here as many time as we want,
right？
translations.なんだ？ 突然……。:
Why do you ask me that all of
a sudden...？
translations.どれくらい？ この湖よりおっきい？:
How much do you love me？ As
much as the size of this
lake？
translations.そうだな……。この湖の１０杯分ぐらい。:
Let me see... About 10 times
the size of this lake.
translations.……あっさり答えるし。もっと照れたっていいじゃん、へへ。:
...You easily answered my
question. I was expecting that
you'd get more embarrassed.
Hehe.
translations.自転車貸してくれるんだよ。で、サイクリングロードを走れる。▲小早川＊▲、自転車は:
You can rent bicycles to ride
around here.
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
can you ride a bicycle？
translations.ごめんごめん。で、どうする？:
Sorry, sorry. Well, do you
want to ride it？
translations.知らない、一人で走ってれば？:
I don't know. Do they have a
tandem？
translations.もし、ここからリンコが落っこちたらさ、助けるために飛び込んでくれる？:
If Rinko fell from here, would
you jump down to save Rinko's
life？
translations.そりゃ、飛び込むだろ！ ちなみに●が落ちたら、▲小早川＊▲は？:
Of course I'd jump！ By the
way, if I fell, would you jump
down to save me,
▲Kobayaka＊▲？
translations.うーーん、人を呼ぶくらいはするかも。:
Hmm, I'd call others to help
you, I think.
translations.じゃあ、人がいなかったら？:
What if there weren't people
around？
translations.カレシの根性に期待！:
I'd believe in my boyfriend
that he'd survive！
translations.ほんとだ。結構数いるな。: Really. That's a lot of them.
translations.ここ、釣りも出来るみたい。:
Seems like fishing is allowed
here.
translations.釣りか、さすがにデートに選ぶには渋すぎるかな。:
Fishing, huh？ I think it's
such a boring thing to do
during a date.
translations.釣りも悪くないけど、今することでもないかな。老後の趣味にとっておくよ。:
I don't hate fishing, but
that's not something we should
do. It's a hobby for old
people.
translations.どうかな？ 今はなんともないけど。:
I wonder. I don't feel sick
now though.
translations.そっか。やっぱ湖の遊覧船じゃ、ぬるいよね。:
I see. Maybe because this
pleasure cruise moves slowly
in the lake.
translations.荒々しいのがいいのか？: Do you want it to go faster？
translations.うん。そしたらさ、気分が悪くなったアンタを介抱できるじゃん？:
Yeah, in that case, I could be
nursing you while you got
seasick, right？
translations.（介抱はされたいけど……そのために気分悪くなるのはな……）:
(I want her to look after me,
but I don't want to get
sick...)
translations.暑い。疲れた。足痛い。:
Too hot. I'm tired. My feet
hurt.
translations.頂上まで着いたらそんなこと忘れちゃうって。ほら、もう少し頑張ろう。:
You'll forget about all these
once you reach the peak. Come
on. Just keep it up a little
longer.
translations.……なんでそんな無駄にテンション高いかな……むかついてきた、びしっ。:
...Why are you so uselessly
energetic...？ This is
irritating！
translations.山で人とすれ違うときさ、必ず挨拶するんだね。:
We have to greet other people
when they walk past us on the
mountain, huh？
translations.うん、マナーってやつだな。▲小早川＊▲もちゃんと挨拶しろよ？:
Yeah, that's good manners.
▲Kobayaka＊▲
should greet them, too.
translations.●と最初に会った頃、してたっけ？:
Did you greet me when we first
met？ I can't remember...
translations.う、うるさい。たしかにそんな時期もあったかもしれないけどさ、今のリンコは違うじゃ:
S-Shut up！ There was a moment
like that for me, but the
current Rinko is different！
translations.あれ……？ 道、さっきから下ってない？:
Eh...？ Have we been going
downhill？
translations.そんなことないだろ。人だっているし。:
That can't be. There are also
people walking around here.
translations.でもほら、道標も……。下りのコースに入っちゃったみたい……。:
But, look at that signpost...
It says this path is going
downhill...
translations.うわ、マジかよ。テンションも下り坂だな……。:
Whoa, are you serious？ Now,
my excitement has gone
downhill as well...
translations.つまんない、２０点。いいから、復帰するよ。ほら。:
This is boring. You get only
20 points. Anyway, let's go
back. Come on.
translations.やっぱお年寄りが多いね。:
This place is full of old
people.
translations.そうだなぁ、紅葉狩りする高校生カップルてのも珍しいかもな。:
Yeah, it's rare for high
school couples to come to view
maple leaves on a date.
translations.真顔でカップルとか言うな……はずい。:
Don't use the word "couples."
It's embarrassing...
translations.思うのもダメなのかよ！:
Don't I even have the right to
think！？
translations.紅葉を見ると、秋って感じがするな。まさに風物詩。:
These maple leaves remind me
that it's fall.
translations.まぁ、そういうのもあるけどさ、足下も。ほら。:
Well, you can say that, but
there are these things on the
ground as well. Look.
translations.秋といえばさ、やっぱ栗ごはんって感じ？:
When we talk about fall, we
can't forget about chestnut
rice, right？
translations.そうだよな、栗の数でケンカしたり！:
Right. Are we gonna fight over
who gets more chestnuts in the
rice？
translations.ふっふっふー。リンコをスキーに誘ったこと、後悔することになるよ。:
Teeheehee. Are you regretting
it now that you invited Rinko
to ski？
translations.リンコ、こう見えてスキーは得意なんだよね。隣で滑るのが恥ずかしくなるくらいの腕前:
Because I'm actually very good
at skiing, you know？ So good
that I might cause the people
who ski near me to feel
embarrassed.
translations.お手柔らかにな。: Don't be too hard on me.
translations.それじゃ、上級者コース行っちゃう？ ほらほら置いてくよ。:
Now then, let's go to the
advanced course. Come on.
Follow me.
translations.ゲレンデだと３割増しで女の人が美人に見えるっていうけど、本当だな。:
People say that the 3 levels
of ski slopes are like the
beauty levels of women. I
think that's true.
translations.ふぅん。でもさ、そういう台詞はこっち向いて言うべきじゃん？:
Hmm. But that kind of saying
doesn't have anything to do
with me, right？
translations.▲小早川＊▲も美人だよ。３割増しで。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
you're a beautiful girl. So,
you're like the premium slope.
translations.……ねぇ。ちょっとスキー以外のこともやってみよっか。:
...Hey, for now, shall we do
something besides skiing？
translations.はは。▲小早川＊▲、鼻が赤くなってるぞ。:
Haha.
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
your nose and your face are
all red.
translations.えっ？ ちょっ、バカ、見んな！:
Eh？ Wait. You idiot. Don't
look！
translations.リンコには縁のない世界だね。すごいとは思うけどさ。:
These things aren't related to
Rinko at all.
translations.素直にへぇとかほぉとか言ってればいいんじゃないか？:
Can you just act a bit like
"Heh" or "Oh" or something
like that？
translations.はぁ……二人とも縁がないみたいだね。:
Hah... I don't think we can
relate to each other now.
translations.なにこれ？ なんかでっかい目がいっこだけ描いてあるけど？:
What is this？ There's only a
very big eye on the whole
painting.
translations.タイトルは……“視線”か。まんまだな。:
Its title is... "A glance."
So, I guess that's it.
translations.さっきから見られてるとは思ってたけどさ。そっか、こいつだったか。:
That's what I thought when I
first saw it. Yeah, so that's
its name.
translations.よし、見つめ返してやろう。:
All right, let's stare back at
it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲はこの絵がお気に入りか。普通の風景画だけど、訴えかけるものでもあった:
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
do you like this painting？
You usually complain about all
kinds of paintings here
though.
translations.絵、キライ！ どうせ描けないもん。:
I hate paintings！ I've never
been able to paint them.
translations.（美術館に展示してある絵に対抗しても……）:
(And you're saying that out
loud in an art gallery...)
translations.映像で見るのとはまた違うよな。:
It's different from when we
see it in pictures, right？
translations.ここまで大きいとモンスターだよ。ゲームに敵として出てきてもおかしくなさそう。:
If it's this big, it can be
called a monster. I won't be
surprised if it is featured as
an enemy in a game.
translations.……じゃあ、そのゲームの主人公は野菜だね。はい、決まり。:
...Well, in a game that has a
vegetable as a protagonist
then. Yeah, it's decided.
translations.キリンの首はなぜ長い？ はい。:
Why does a giraffe have a long
neck？
translations.それは……お前の可愛い顔を食べるためさ！:
Because... Then it will be
able to eat you, you cute
little girl！
translations.……どんだけ背高いの、その赤ずきん。:
...What was that？ Am I the
little red riding hood？
translations.ライオンってさ、ネコ科なんだよね。いくらネコでもこれはちょっとなぁ。:
Lions are in the cat family
too, right？ No matter how
much they look like cats, they
are still a little bit...
translations.まあ、猫とは大きさが違うからな。やっぱり怖い……。:
Well, their sizes are much
different. Lions are really
scary...
translations.メスはたてがみがないからさ、ちょっと猫っぽいんだけど。:
Without those sharp fangs and
nails, they just look like
cats.
translations.▲小早川＊▲も、たてがみはないよな？:
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
you don't have a mane, right？
translations.はあ？ なにそれ？ 頭から噛まれたい？:
Huh？ What's that？ Want me to
bite your head off！？
translations.ライオンとトラが戦ったら、どっちが強いのかな？ やっぱライオン？ 百獣の王だし。:
If a lion fights with a tiger,
which one will be stronger？ I
think it's the lion because
it's the king of beasts.
translations.ライオンとトラでも子供を作れるらしいぞ？:
A lion and a tiger can
reproduce and make a baby, you
know？
translations.先に惚れた方が負けってことだよ。:
The one that falls in love
first will lose.
translations.んー、この獣臭さ。独特だよねぇ。:
Hmm, these animals really have
such unique smells.
translations.べつにフツー。でもたまには動物と触れあうのもいいんじゃない？:
I like them in general. It's
good to get close to animals
every once in a while.
translations.うわ。この子もふもふ～。: Wow, this one is so fluffy~
translations.獣とケダモノって何が違うのかな？:
How do you tell animals and
beasts apart？
translations.なに、男ってこういうことしたいんだ。:
What, so guys actually want
to do stuff like this？
translations.ふーん。どんなのがいいの？ 参考までに。:
Hmm. What kind do you like？
Just for reference.
translations.はいはい、そうですね。しょうがないな……。:
Yeah, yeah, figures.
Guess I have no choice...

Hehehe▼ Then Rinko will keep
wearing these.
translations.あのさ、そろそろリンコが髪、変えるとしたら、どういうのがいいと思う？:
Well, Rinko is thinking about
changing hairstyle. What do
you think would be good？
translations.でもさ、前はずーっとショートだったから、なんか、ね。:
But my hair has always been
short, right？
translations.●には、やっぱり、初めて会ったときの印象が、▲小早川＊▲のイメージかな。:
That is
▲Kobayaka＊▲'s
image that left a strong
impression on me when we first
met.
translations.その……ちょっと気が強そうだけど、似合ってて可愛いなーとか、さ？:
Well... You seemed like
someone with strong will. Plus
you looked very cute.
translations.へぇ……そんな風に見えてたんだ。そっか……へへ。じゃあ、まあ、いっかな。:
Hmm...？ So that's how you saw
me. I see... Hehe. Okay. I
think it's good then.
translations.出ました……オトコってさ、やっぱりロングが好きなんだ。なんで？:
I see this coming... Guys just
like long hair, huh？ I wonder
why.
translations.そりゃあ、女の子らしいしさ、風になびいたりするとなんだか、こう……。:
It makes you look feminine.
And when it's swaying in the
wind, it just... Well...
translations.さわりたくなっちゃう？:
Just makes you want to touch
it？
translations.ううん。一応、希望としては聞きました。:
Never mind. I just wanted to
ask for your opinion.
translations.そうだな……セミロングだな。:
That would be... semi-long, I
think.
translations.ロングもいいけど、ショートも▲小早川＊▲らしい。アレンジで二度うれしい！:
Long is good, but short suits
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
With semi-long, you can make
both long and short
hairstyles！
translations.ヘアカタログかっつーの。:
Don't talk like you're looking
at a hair catalog！
translations.いっとくけど、セミロングって一番めんどくさいんだよ？:
Let me tell you. Semi-long is
the most troublesome
hairstyle, okay？
translations.イヤとは言ってないじゃん。しょうがないもん……カノジョなんだから。:
I didn't say I wouldn't do it.
As your girlfriend, I have no
choice.
translations.（長からず短からず、セミだよな！）:
(Not long, nor short.
Semi-long is best！)
translations.やっぱり、今の長さがいいな。●その髪型の▲小早川＊▲好きだもん。:
Actually, the current length
is nice. I like
▲Kobayaka＊▲
with this hairstyle.
translations.そっか……好きなんだ。じゃあ、いいけどね。そっか……へへ▼:
I see... You like it. That's
fine then. I see... Hehe▼
translations.あのさ、ちょっと髪、変えようかなーなんて。なんか希望ってある？ 一応、聞いといて:
Well, I'm thinking about
changing my hairstyle. Do you
have any preferences？ I just
wanted to ask though.
translations.やっぱり、初めて会ったときの、▲小早川＊▲のイメージだからかな。いや、可愛かった:
When we met for the first
time, that's what fit
▲Kobayaka＊▲'s
image. No, I mean you looked
cute with it...
translations.どうせ今は可愛くないしね？ ショートは無し、と。:
You mean without short hair, I
wouldn't look cute, huh？
translations.ヤダ。そんなヘンな顔したって、してあげない。:
No. If you make that weird
face, I won't change it for
you.
translations.なんでチカラ入ってんの……そっか、やっぱりロングが好きなんだ。:
Why do you have to be
assertive like that...？ You
really like long hair, huh？
translations.まあね、女の子らしいしさ、▲小早川＊▲って意外と似合うよ。ロング。:
Well, it's very feminine. I
bet
▲Kobayaka＊▲
will look unexpectedly good
with it.
translations.え？ まあ、小さいことはいいから、ここはロングで、ひとつ！:
Eh？ Well, you used to have
long hair when you were a kid.
Just try it again！
translations.“意外”とか言わせとくのもアタマ来るし……言うこと聞くのも……うーん……。:
But I believe you said
"unexpectedly" earlier...
Hmm...
translations.ロングもいいけど、ショートも▲小早川＊▲らしい。●は二度うれしい！:
Long is good, but short suits
▲Kobayaka＊▲
as well. Semi-long would be a
mixture of both.
translations.その分こっちは二倍手間かかるの！ 洗髪大変なのにまとめんの大変だし。:
Do you know that it would be
very troublesome for me！？
Washing and caring for my hair
would be difficult.
translations.そっか、諦めるかな……。:
Really？ Just forget about
this then...
translations.もう……じゃあ、もっと可愛くお願いしてみ？:
Geez... How about you try to
beg me in a cute way？
translations.もう！ そうやってさ、すぐ恥ずかしいこと言うんだもん。バカじゃん……。:
Geez！ Why did you say
something like that all of a
sudden？ It's embarrassing.
You idiot...
translations.あのね？ リンコそろそろ、髪、変えようかなって。どういうのが好き？:
Well？ Rinko is thinking about
changing hairstyle. What would
you prefer？
translations.でも……ホントはさ？ もっと女の子っぽい方がさ、好きなんじゃない？:
But... Don't you like
something more feminine？
translations.うーん……やっぱり印象が強いのかな。あの日、●が好きになった▲小早川＊▲はショー:
Well... On the day we first
met, that short hair of
▲Kobayaka＊▲
left quite strong impression
on me.
translations.うん……わかった。じゃあ、リンコショートにしようっと。へへ▼:
Hmm... I got it. Then I'll go
with short hair. Hehe▼
translations.（……ちょっとキザだった？ でも、ショートだよな！）:
(...Did I sound a little
smug？ Anyway, I like short
hair！)
translations.そっか……やっぱり、長い髪って憧れちゃう？:
I see... You really yearn for
girls with long hair, huh？
translations.そりゃあ、女の子らしいし、風になびいたりするとなんだか、こう、キラキラしてさ……:
It'll make you look feminine.
And when it's swaying in the
wind, it'll be glittering...
translations.そっか……そうだよね？ リンコもね、今度は伸ばそうかなって、思ってたんだ。:
Really...？ I see. I've been
thinking about growing long
hair too.
translations.へへ▼じゃあ、リンコ、髪の毛のーばそっと。:
Hehe▼ Then Rinko will try to
grow long hair.
translations.（ロングの▲小早川＊▲！ 楽しみ！）:
(Long is the best,
▲Kobayaka＊▲！
I'm looking forward to it！)
translations.そうなんだ？ 男の子ってさ、ロングかショートが好きなんじゃないの？:
Really？ But usually, guys
would prefer either long or
short hair, right？
translations.それは言えてる。でもな、ロングもいいけどショートも▲小早川＊▲らしい。なので、苦:
That might be true. For
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
long is nice but short suits
you. It's difficult for me to
choose...
translations.そうだよ。カレシとしては、重大な判断だからな。:
Yeah. It's such a crucial
decision for a boyfriend to
make.
translations.いいよ。じゃあ、リンコセミロングにしーようっと。カノジョとしては、ね。:
It's okay. As your girlfriend,
Rinko will go with semi-long,
okay？
translations.（よしきた！ 長からず短からず、セミだよな！）:
(Yeah！ Not long, nor short.
Semi-long is best！)
translations.そっか……好きなんだ。じゃあ、いいよ。リンコはさ、そう言って欲しいだけだから……:
Really...？ You like it. It's
fine then. That's what Rinko
wanted to hear... Hehe▼
translations.好きな食べ物ってさ、なんだっけ？ 聞いたことあったかもだけど。:
What's your favorite food？ I
might have already asked you
though.
translations.好きな食べ物か……最近は、そうだな……。:
My favorite food...？ Lately,
I like...
translations.ポテチでしょ！ ▲小早川＊▲もだろ？:
Potato chips！
▲Kobayaka＊▲
likes them too, right？
translations.●も最近、ハマッてる。やっぱ、カレルビーだよな？:
I'm getting obsessed with
them. And it has to be the
ones from Kalbee.
translations.いまハマんなっつーの。:
Why do you have to get
obsessed with them now！？
translations.和食でしょ、日本人ならさっぱりと！:
I love Japanese food. I'm
Japanese, after all！
translations.和食、か……じゃあさ、おにぎりは和食？:
Japanese food...？ Well, does
rice ball count as Japanese
food？
translations.おにぎり？ まあ……洋食ではないな。:
Rice ball？ Well... It's
surely not Western food.
translations.そうそう。サンドイッチよりは、和食だよね？:
I see. So you like Japanese
food more than sandwiches,
huh？
translations.洋食っぽいのが好きかな。やっぱ、若者にはケチャップとソースだろ！:
I love Western food. Ketchup
and sauce are famous for young
people, right！？
translations.そっか、洋食ね。えぇと、サンドイッチってさ、洋食だよね？:
I see. Western food, huh？
Hmm, do sandwiches count as
Western food？
translations.サンドイッチ？ まあ、中華ではないかな。:
Sandwiches？ Well, they're not
Chinese food for sure.
translations.和食でもないしね。じゃあ洋食だよ。ね？ よし、へへへ！:
And not Japanese food either.
Then they're Western food,
right？ Okay. Hehehe！
translations.中華料理が好きだな！ 油っぽくて、“ハァー食った！”っていう満足感がね！:
I love Chinese food！ Like
stir-fried dishes that make
you go "haaaa" when you eat
them.
translations.べつに？ でもさ、油は体に悪いよ？ メタボになるよ？:
Nothing. But oily food isn't
good for your health, right？
You'd get fat.
translations.この歳で？ ないない！ ラーメン屋なら手ごろだし！:
Get fat？ At this age？ No
way！ I eat at the noodle
shops all the time. It's
convenient！
translations.こっちは手ごろじゃないっつーの。:
But this is not convenient for
me at all！
translations.どこか、遊びに行きたいって思ってるところ、ある？:
When you want to go out to
have some fun, where do you
like to go？
translations.遊びに行きたいところか……。: Go out to have some fun？
translations.ふぅん。そういうところがいいんだ？:
Hmm？ So that's what you like,
huh？
translations.ああ。のんびりデートするのも悪くないだろ？:
Yeah. And I don't mind
spending our dates leisurely
like that.
translations.体を動かせるところだな。そんな激しいスポーツとかじゃなくても。:
Like, places where I can move
my body. But not to the point
of extreme sports or anything.
translations.ふぅん。それはひとりで？ それともリンコと？:
Hmm. You like to go alone, or
go with Rinko？
translations.そんなの▲小早川＊▲と一緒に行くに決まってるじゃないか。:
Of course, I want to go with
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
translations.たまには運動もいいもんだぞ。:
It's good to exercise
occasionally, okay？
translations.ふぅん。そういうところに行きたいんだ？:
Hmm？ So you want to go to
such places？
translations.たまにはいいと思うぞ。▲小早川＊▲が退屈しないようなところ選ぶつもりだし。:
It's good to go there
occasionally. I'm trying to
look for places where
▲Kobayaka＊▲
wouldn't get bored of.
translations.そんなの調べるくらい、なんてことないって。:
It's not a big deal to do that
for you.
translations.どうせなら賑やかに遊びたいだろ？:
It's fun to play around,
right？
translations.そうか。▲小早川＊▲も行きたいところあるなら教えてくれよ？:
I see. If there are any places
▲Kobayaka＊▲
wanted to go, just tell me,
okay？
translations.あのさ。デートに行くならどんなとこがいい？:
Well. When we go out on dates,
where would you like to go？
translations.ほんとに？ なんか年寄り臭くない？:
You're really acting like old
people.
translations.別にそんなことないって。そういうデートもいいもんだぞ。:
No, I just think that it'd be
nice to go on dates at such
places.
translations.力説しなくてもいいっての。とりあえず希望は聞いとくけどね。:
Don't pressure me. Anyway, I
just wanted to ask your
opinion.
translations.悪くないと思うけどな。:
I think those places aren't
bad.
translations.体を動かせるところだな。そんなに激しいスポーツとかじゃなくても。:
Anywhere I can move my body.
But not something like extreme
sports.
translations.……それってさ、リンコがそういうの苦手だってわかってて言ってる？:
...Well, Rinko isn't very good
at exercising. You know it,
right？
translations.たまにはいいじゃないか。健康的で。:
But it's good every once in a
while. It's healthy.
translations.そういうなって。人気があるんだから、遊びに行ったら楽しいはずだろ？:
Oh, yeah？ If the places are
famous, it'd be fun to go
there.
translations.流行に踊らされるってどうかと思うよ？:
So you're easily manipulated
by the media, huh？
translations.だからこそ、自分の目で確かめに行くんだってば。:
I just want to see with my own
eyes why those places become
popular.
translations.遊べるところ？ つまり……遊園地とか？:
Where you can play？ Like the
theme park？
translations.特にこだわらないけど、そんな感じのところ。:
Not limited to that, but it's
something like that.
translations.定番だっていいじゃないか。はずれは少なそうだし。:
Standard is good, isn't it？
There's less chance things
would go wrong.
translations.ねぇ。どっか遊びに行くとしてさ、どういうとこが好み？:
Hey. When you want to go out
to play, where would you want
to go？
translations.●の好みか……。: Where do I want to go...？
translations.リンコと一緒だとやっぱり疲れる？:
Are you getting tired when
you're with Rinko？
translations.そういうわけじゃないよ。ただ、そういう雰囲気のところもいいだろ？:
That's not the case. I just
like the atmosphere at those
places.
translations.そうだね。うん、わかった。: I see. Okay, I got it.
translations.外にこだわらないけどな。ただ健康的に遊ぶのも悪くないだろ？:
It's not like I'm obsessed
with exercising. It's just
good to be healthy.
translations.そうだね。そういうのも悪くないかもね。:
I see. It's not bad if we go
to such places.
translations.ああ、それもかな。▲小早川＊▲は退屈かもしれないけど。:
Ah, maybe so.
▲Kobayaka＊▲
might not enjoy these places,
though.
translations.別にそんなことないって。リンコ、アンタの好みも知っておきたいし。:
Not really. Rinko just wanted
to know your preferences.
translations.そうか。じゃあ、いろいろチェックしておかないとな。:
Really？ I'll be checking out
various places for you then.
translations.限定はしないけど、そんな感じのところだな。:
Not limited to that, but it's
something like that.
translations.そっか。うん、楽しいところっていいよね。:
I see. Hmm, some places fun
would be nice, huh？
translations.ああ。遊びに行くなら楽しまないと。:
Yeah. We can enjoy ourselves
there.
translations.ひとりの時ってどこに行ったりしてる？:
Where do you like to go when
you go out alone？
translations.……ふぅん。そういうとこが好きなんだ？:
...Hmm. So you like places
like that？
translations.好きというか、気楽だしな。本も読めそうだし。:
It's more like I can enjoy
myself there, like reading a
book or something.
translations.あ……そっか。そういう過ごし方なんだ。:
Ah... I see. So you like to
spend your time like that.
translations.いつもそうじゃないけど、そういうこともあるかな。:
It's not always, but sometimes
that's what I like to do.
translations.……ふぅん。そういうとこに行ってるんだ？:
...Hmm. So you like to go to
such places.
translations.いざって時のために鍛えておきたいしな。:
At least I've got to forge my
body, okay？
translations.たとえば雑誌やＷＥＢで紹介されてるところとか。:
Like the ones that are
recommended in magazines or on
internet.
translations.ふぅん。そういうとこ、行くんだ？:
Hmm. So you like to go to such
places, huh？
translations.若者らしく、いいだろ。:
Those places are suitable for
teenagers like us.
translations.ひとりで遊んでも楽しいところ探すよ。:
I have to find places where I
can have fun by myself.
translations.ふぅん。遊び人なんだ？:
Hmm？ So you like to play
alone, huh？
translations.なんか聞こえが悪いけど、まぁいいか。:
It doesn't sound nice when you
say that. Anyway, whatever.
translations.ひとりで遊びに行く時ってどういうところに行く？:
Where do you like to go when
you want to go out alone？
translations.静かで落ち着けるところがいいな。:
Calm and quiet places would be
nice.
translations.ひとりでもそういうとこに行くんだ？:
So you like to go to such
places by yourself？
translations.▲小早川＊▲だって昔はそうだったんじゃないか？ 読書の時とか。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲
also liked to do that in the
past, right？ Like, going
somewhere to read books and
stuff.
translations.だからそういうところだな。:
So, those are the kinds of
places I like.
translations.へぇ。健康志向なんだ？:
Hmm？ So you're worried about
your health, huh？
translations.そうじゃないけど、一応、鍛えておきたいし。:
Not really. Well, I just like
to forge my body.
translations.ふぅん。男ってそういうもんなの？:
Hmm, so guys like to do things
like that, huh？
translations.そりゃまあ、カノジョを支えられるくらいにはなっておきたいからな。:
Well, yeah. At least I should
make my girlfriend proud of
me.
translations.まぁ世間に置いてかれないように。:
Well, I should keep up with
what's going on in the
society.
translations.世間に、ね。結構マメだね。:
The society, huh？ You're
working hard.
translations.ひとりで？ 遊びに？: And you go to play alone？
translations.ひとりで行くのは時間つぶしだよ。本番は▲小早川＊▲と一緒に行く時なんだから。:
I'll just kill some time there
waiting for the real date with
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
translations.やっぱ、一番楽しいのは、▲小早川＊▲と二人のときだけどな。:
My most enjoyable moments are
when I'm together with
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
translations.あのさ、どっかにひとりで出かけるとしたら、どういうとこに行く？:
Say, when you want to go out
alone, where do you go？
translations.ああ。どことは思いつかないけど、のんびりしたいし。:
Yeah, it's good to relax there
without thinking about
anything.
translations.そっか。うん、そういうところ、いいよね。:
I see. It'd feel nice to go to
such places, huh？
translations.だろ？ せわしないのはちょっと、って感じだからな。:
Yeah？ It feels like I can put
away all the worries.
translations.だよな。いざって時のために鍛えておかないと。:
Yeah. I'm forging my body so
you can rely on me in case of
emergency.
translations.ああ。雑誌やＷＥＢで紹介されてるところ。:
Yeah, like places that are
recommended in magazines or on
internet.
translations.へぇ。そういうの調べてるんだ？:
Hmm？ So you're investigating
such places？
translations.若者らしく、ね。:
Those places are good for
teenager like us, okay？
translations.うん。賑やかなところなんかだな。:
Yeah, some bustling places
would be nice.
translations.でもさ、それってさ……ひとりでも楽しい？:
But, for such places... Is it
fun to go alone？
translations.楽しめなくもないかな、でも▲小早川＊▲と二人の方がもっといいけどな。:
It's kind of fun,
but it would be best if
▲Kobayaka＊▲
can join me.
translations.あのさ、よく“好きなタイプ”とか、言うじゃん？ ちょっと聞いとこうかなって思って:
You know how they talk about
someone's "type" of girl and
all？ I was wondering what
yours would be.
translations.●の好きなタイプ？ そうだな、最近は……。:
My type of girl？ Let's see...
She has to be...
translations.知的で強気な子だろ、うん。:
An intellectual and strong
girl, yeah.
translations.知的は、分かるけど、強気っていうのは？:
I understand intellectual, but
what do you mean by strong？
translations.言いたいことを言うとか、ちょっとキツイことでもね。:
Well, I think it's a bit hard
to explain.
translations.罵られちゃったり？:
Like the type that likes to
scold you？
translations.おぉ、いいんじゃない？ それくらい激しいほうが。:
Well, why not？ She'd better
go all-out at it, too.
translations.そうそう！ ガツーンとね。:
Yeah, exactly! Like, really
let me have it.
translations.優しくて、積極的な子だな。:
A kind and positive girl, I'd
say.
translations.あれ？ なんか、●ヘンな事言った？:
Huh？ Did I say anything
weird？
translations.でも、なんか拗ねちゃったような……。:
Well, you don't look happy
about it...
translations.リンコが？ なんで？ いつもの冷たくて消極的なリンコじゃん。:
Me？ Why would I？ I'm just my
usual cold, negative self.
translations.だって、好きだから●、▲小早川＊▲と付き合ってるんだし。:
Because I like you,
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
that's why I like to be with
you.
translations.あれ？ ●なんか、ヘンなこと言ったかな……。:
Eh？ Did I say something
weird？
translations.ムードとか考えろっつーの。そういうの、言うときは……。:
At least consider the mood
before saying something like
that...
translations.（なんか、こっちも照れてきた……）:
(What？ She made me feel
embarrassed somehow...)
translations.アンタの好きなタイプってさ、どんなだっけ？ ネタとして聞いてあげようと思って。:
What kind of girl is your
type？ It's just a topic that
came to my mind, so I just
asked.
translations.ネタって……うーん、最近はそうだな……。:
Just a topic, huh？ Well,
lately, the type of girl I
like is...
translations.なるほど……つまり、補完関係を求めてますな。:
I see... It's like you seek
for what you lack, huh？
translations.つまり、無いものねだりですな。:
I mean because you don't have
those qualities.
translations.そうか！ ●が、暑苦しくて鬱陶しいから！:
I see！ I'm just the
tyrannical and gloomy kind！
translations.へぇ……じゃあ、まあ、リンコを好きになっちゃうのも、無理ないってことか。:
Eh？ Then currently, aren't
you forcing yourself to like
Rinko？
translations.どうせリンコはイジワルだよっ！:
Why do you like to tease Rinko
like this！？
translations.（怒っちゃった。▲小早川＊▲って難しい……）:
(Now she's angry.
▲Kobayaka＊▲
is difficult to please...)
translations.な、なに言ってんの!? バカじゃん？:
W-What did you just say！？
Are you an idiot！？
translations.だって、●は▲小早川＊▲が好きで、付き合ってるんだし。▲小早川＊▲だってそうだろ:
Because I like you,
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
That's why I like to be with
you. It's the same for you,
right
▲Kobayaka＊▲？
translations.言っとくけど、アンタなんかゼンッゼン、タイプとかじゃないからっ！:
Let me tell you. You are not
my type at all！
translations.それは……タイプとかじゃなくて、ほら……アレ。:
Because... It's not all about
type. It's that...
translations.アンタには到底理解できない、複雑な精神運動によって、その、どうにかなってるんだか:
It's something you can never
ever understand. It has
something to do with
complicated soul and mind, and
stuff！
translations.最新の“好きなタイプ”、聞いとこうかなって。カノジョとしてはさ？:
Have I asked you lately about
the "type" you like？ I'm your
girlfriend, after all.
translations.ちょっとクールでさ、物静かなタイプ、かな？: A cool and calm type, I think.
translations.だって、だってリンコはさ、てっきり、その……。:
But... But Rinko thought
that... Surely...
translations.ううん。そうなんだ……カノジョって難しい……。:
Never mind. I got it. Being
someone's girlfriend is so
difficult...
translations.やっぱり知的で、ちょっと強気な子って、いいよな。:
An intellectual and strong
girl will be nice.
translations.知的で強気……イジワルな生徒会長みたいな感じ？:
Intellectual and strong？
Something like a mean student
council president type？
translations.イジワル……あぁ、なるほど……ツンツンしてる感じかもな。:
Mean...？ Ah, I'd say the type
that's a bit reserved and
aloof.
translations.まあ、ツンツンばっかりでもな。やっぱり、たまには……。:
Nah, not aloof all the time.
Just occasionally is okay...
translations.やっぱり●は、今の▲小早川＊▲かな？:
For me, I like
▲Kobayaka＊▲
right now.
translations.もう……ちゃんとホントのこと、教えて欲しいんだけどな、リンコは。:
Hey... I seriously asked you,
didn't I？
translations.そっか……じゃあ、いい▼でも、リンコにはさ、いつも本当のこと、言ってね？:
Okay... Fine, then▼ But if
you change your mind, you have
to tell Rinko honestly, okay？
translations.（本当に、今の▲小早川＊▲が一番だよ）:
(I really like
▲Kobayaka＊▲
the way she is right now.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲、最近、家ではどうしてる？:
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
how's everything at your house
lately？
translations.？ べつに、フツーだけど？ 本読んだり、音楽聴いたり。:
？ Everything's normal. I read
books and listen to music.
translations.あ、そうだ……弟がさ、“ご本よんで？”って、絵本持って部屋に来る。:
Ah, right... One time, my
little brother came in my room
and asked me to read him a
picture book.
translations.へぇ！ ▲小早川＊▲に懐いちゃってんだ？:
Eh！？ So
▲Kobayaka＊▲
could take care of a kid,
too！？
translations.まあね、へへ……それでね？ いっしょに音楽聴いてるとね？:
Sort of. Hehe... And then we
listened to music together.
translations.ヘンテコな踊りおどって、ヘンテコな歌まで唄うの。それが可愛いくて……ん？:
He also showed me his funny
dance and funny song. He was
just too cute-- ...Hey.
translations.なんて顔してんの……ニタニタして。:
Why do you have such a broad
grin on your face？
translations.べつに？ 仲がいいんだな、と思って。:
No particular reason. I'm just
thinking that you two get
along well.
translations.フツーじゃん……姉弟だもん。:
It's normal... We are brother
and sister.
translations.（うん、いい感じだな）:
(Um, everything seems to go
well for her.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲、最近さ、家ではどうしてる？:
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
how's everything at your house
lately？
translations.上手くいってるかって聞きたいんでしょ？:
Are you wondering if
everything goes smoothly for
me？
translations.弟がさ、懐いちゃって。今日も出かけるとき、大変だったんだから。“行っちゃヤダ！”:
`I've been taking care of my
little brother. Today, when I
left, he even shouted, "No,
don't go！"
translations.いや、▲小早川＊▲も、弟が可愛くてしょうがないって顔してるから。:
No, I was just picturing how
cute
▲Kobayaka＊▲'s
brother is.
translations.当たり前じゃん……弟だもん。:
Of course, he's cute... He's
my brother.
translations.言っとくけど、アンタと違って美男子なんだから！:
Let me tell you. He is such a
handsome boy, unlike you！
translations.弟がね、懐いちゃって。今日も出かけるとき、大変だったんだよ？ “行っちゃヤダ！”:
I've been taking care of my
little brother. Today, when I
left, he even shouted, "No,
don't go！"
translations.へぇー！ じゃあ、もしかして、●のライバル？:
Eh！？ Don't tell me that this
boy is my future rival！
translations.そうだよ？ すっごく、ハンサムだから、幼稚園でモテモテらしいよ？:
He is！ He is handsome and he
is very popular in his
kindergarten.
translations.ま、まあ、男はさ、ハートだから！:
W-Well, for a man, the heart
is more important than the
looks！
translations.仲良くしなきゃダメだよ？ そのうちさ、会うこともあるかもでしょ？:
But you have to be nice to
him. Maybe there's a chance
that you guys will meet, you
know？
translations.▲小早川＊▲ってさ、家にいるときは、何やってんの？:
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
what do you do when you stay
home？
translations.えぇと……もうちょっと、ヒントは？:
Um... What do you do then？
Can you give me a hint？
translations.ずっと、自分の部屋にいる。:
I just stay in my room all the
time.
translations.へぇ、退屈しないの？:
Huh？ Don't you get bored if
you do that？
translations.ぜんぜん。やることいっぱいあるもん。本読んだり、音楽聴いたり。:
Not at all. There are lots of
things to do. Reading books,
listening to music, etc.
translations.そっか。それじゃ、家の人は寂しいかも……。:
I see. Don't your family
members feel lonely then？
translations.そんなわけないじゃん。あっちはあっちで忙しいんだし。:
I don't think so. They are
busy with their stuff, too.
translations.あ、仕事で遅いとか……。:
Ah, like they work until
late...？
translations.うるさいな……なんなのこれ？ 生活指導？:
Shut up already... What is
this？ An educational
guidance？
translations.（話したくないことが、あるんだろうな、これは……）:
(I think this is the topic she
doesn't want to talk about...)
translations.朝って弱いほうだっけ？ 最近、起きるの辛いなぁーとか、思う？:
Is it difficult for you to
wake up in the morning？ Like,
do you feel like you don't
want to get up？
translations.朝？ そうだな……●はどっちかっていうと……。:
In the morning？ Well... For
me...
translations.出来る男は朝型なんだよ！: A man must get up early！
translations.まあ、強いほうかな？:
Well, I can get up very
easily.
translations.ううん、きいただけ。:
Never mind. I just randomly
asked.
translations.ハァ、なんでこう鈍いのかな……。:
*sigh* Why is he so slow like
this...？
translations.まあ、弱いほうかもな？: Well, I can barely get up.
translations.だろうと思った。ねぇ……もしもだけど。:
That's what I thought. Hey...
What if...
translations.リンコが朝起こしてあげたら、うれしい？:
What if Rinko wakes you up in
the morning？ Will you be
happy？
translations.そりゃ、もちろん！ ……いいの？:
Of course, I will！ ...Are you
sure？
translations.うーん、考えとく。へへ！:
Well, I'll think about it.
Hehe！
translations.出来る男はな、朝型なんだよ！ 憶えとけ？:
A strong man must get up
early！ Don't you agree？
translations.弱いことにしとけっつーの。:
Can't you just be weak for
once！？
translations.ううん、なんでも！ バカなんだから……。:
Never mind. It's nothing！
You're just an idiot...
translations.自慢じゃないけど、バリバリ夜型です！:
It's not something to be proud
of, but I usually stay up
until morning！
translations.威張んなっつーの。:
Then don't say it like you're
proud of it！
translations.じゃあさ、リンコが朝起こしてくれないかなーとか、思ったりする？:
Hey, have you ever wished that
Rinko would wake you up in the
morning？
translations.え!? ……それは、つまり遠まわしにうちに泊まりたいっていう……。:
Eh！？ ...Is this an indirect
hint that you want to stay
with me overnight...？
translations.なんで成長してるんだ!? そのエプロン姿は一体？:
When did you grow up so
much！？ And that apron is...
translations.だって……アナタの奥さんですもの。成長くらいするし、エプロンだってつけるわよ。:
Because... I'm your wife. I
have grown up and that's why
I'm wearing an apron.
translations.奥さん!? もしかして、●たち夫婦なの!?:
My wife！？ You mean we are
married！？
translations.変な人ね……。さぁ、寝ぼけてないで！ 早く出かけないと会社に遅れちゃうわよ。:
You're such a weird guy...
Hey, are you still half
asleep？ If you don't hurry,
you will be late for work.
translations.ヤバ！ 遅刻だ！ じゃあ、行ってくるよ！:
Oh no！ I'm late！ Then I'm
leaving！
translations.今日のお夕飯、何にします？:
What do you want to eat for
your dinner？
translations.急いでるんだし！ そんなのあとでもいいだろ？:
I'm in a hurry！ We don't have
to talk about that now.
translations.ダメよ！ 旦那様のために、美味しいお夕飯を用意するのが妻の役目ですもの。:
No！ It's the duty of a wife
to cook delicious food for her
husband.
translations.今夜は何が食べたい？ 和食？ 洋食？ 中華？ それとも……。:
What do you want for dinner
tonight？ Japanese food？
Western？ Or Chinese？ Or...
translations.なんでもいいよ！ それくらい自分で決めてくれよ！:
Whatever is fine！ Just decide
by your own！
translations.そ、そうよね。アタシって……夕飯の献立も一人で決められないダメな女……あなたの妻:
R-Right. I'm such a useless
woman who can't even think of
a dinner menu by herself. I'm
not qualified to be your
wife！
translations.じゃ、嫌いにならない？ 今でも愛してる？:
Then do you hate me？ Do you
still love me like this？
translations.嫌いにならないし、愛してるよ！:
I don't hate you and I still
love you！
translations.もういいね。行ってくるから。:
You're okay now, right？ I'll
get going.
translations.もう！ 結婚指輪を忘れてるじゃない！ ほんと、そそっかしいんだから……。:
Geez！ You forget to wear your
wedding ring！ You're so
careless...
translations.指輪!? ああ、でも今日はもう急いでるから！:
Ring！？ Oh, but I'm in such a
hurry today！
translations.きっと他に女ができたに違いないわ！ ……もうアタシなんて、木曜の燃えるゴミの日に:
You must have other women,
right！？ ...Now, I am like a
piece of garbage waiting to be
dumped！
translations.捨てない、捨てない！ わかった。ちゃんと指輪していくから！:
I'm not going to dump you！ I
am not！ Okay, I'll wear the
ring！
translations.じゃあ、もう遅刻しそうだから今度こそ行ってくるよ。:
I'm already late, so I have to
leave now.
translations.いってきますのチューを忘れてるでしょ？:
Did you forget a goodbye
kiss？
translations.毎朝してるじゃない。はぁい。チュー……。:
You do it every morning. Come
on, chu~
translations.ま、待てって！ ほら、もう会社の時間がさ……！:
W-Wait a sec！ Hey, it's time
I have to be at work...！
translations.やっぱり……!! やっぱりアタシの事、もう愛してない……。:
As I thought...！ You don't
love me anymore...
translations.愛してます！ 愛してますから仕事に行かせて下さいっ!!:
I love you！ I love you, so
please let me go to work！！
translations.ホント!? 今すぐ１００万回“愛してる”って言ってくれる？:
Really！？ Then can you say
"Ai-shi-te-ru" (I love you) to
me a million times？
translations.（“愛してる”って１００万回言わないと、会社に行かせてもらえないぞ……）:
(If I don't say "Ai-shi-te-ru"
million times, she won't let
me go to work...)
translations.愛してる……愛してる……愛してる……。:
I love you... I love you... I
love you...
translations.ふぅ……やっと、９６万５７３０回目か……。:
Phew... This is already the
965,730th time...
translations.ん……？？ ……なんだ夢か。新婚生活も悪くない……か？:
Huh...？ ...It was a dream？
Getting married isn't too
bad... Maybe？
translations.（“愛してる！”を、１００万回か……）:
("I love you！" a million
times, huh...)
translations.マイクに向かって“愛してる！”と声を出そう:
Say "I love you！" into the
microphone
translations.うん……ん？ ところで、ここはドコだ!?:
Hmm... Huh？ By the way, where
are we！？
translations.どこって、無人島じゃん？:
Where？ We are on a deserted
island.
translations.む、無人島!? なんで、こんなところに？:
D-Deserted island！？ How did
we end up here？
translations.結局、この島に流れ着いたのは、あんたとリンコのふたりだけ……。:
In the end, the only people
who washed ashore on this
island are you and Rinko...
translations.無人島でふたりっきり!?:
Just the two of us on this
deserted island！？
translations.未知の宇宙光線とか、研究所から漏れた細菌とかでさ、ホントに映画みたいな下らない展:
There was that weird light and
then there were some sort of
germs leaked from a research
lab. Something like what we
usually see in cheesy
movies...
translations.世界中で、よくわからない異変が起こってるってことか？:
So you mean there are unusual
phenomena all around the
world？
translations.そう……。結局、この世界にはアンタとリンコのふたりしか生き残らなかった……。:
Right... And in the end, you
and I are the only human
beings left in this world...
translations.●たち、ふたりだけ!? これから、どうしたらいいんだ……。:
Just the two of us！？ What do
we do from now on...？
translations.この世界はリンコが望んだ世界なんだよ……。:
This is the world that Rinko
wished for...
translations.なんで、こんな世界を……？:
Why did you wish for this kind
of world...？
translations.リンコはさ、誰からも受け入れてもらえなくて……誰からも理解してもらえなくて……い:
For me, no one wants me... No
one can understand me... So I
just want to be alone by
myself.
translations.神様にさ……、そんなにリンコをひとりぽっちにしたいなら、せめて孤独を感じさせない:
I prayed to God for solitude.
I wanted to be isolated from
others.
translations.そしたらこんな世界になっちゃった。みんなが消えちゃえば、孤独を感じることもなくな:
And it ended up like this. Now
that everyone else has
vanished, I can have the
solitude I've wished for...
translations.そんなお願いをしたリンコに、神様が罰を与えたんだよ。:
God must have punished me for
making that kind of wish.
translations.リンコのカレシになっちゃったばっかりに、一緒に罰を受ける羽目になっちゃって、ゴメ:
You've just become my
boyfriend and I dragged you
into this mess. I'm sorry...
translations.神様は、罰を与えたんじゃないよ……。だって、▲小早川＊▲を孤独にしなかったろ？:
God didn't punish you,
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
At least, you are not alone in
this world.
translations.この世界を●たちに託したんだよ……きっと。:
We are entrusted to create a
new world...
translations.これからは、ふたりぽっちなんだからさ、一緒に力を合わせて生きていかなくちゃ！:
From now on, we both must do
our best to live on in this
world！
translations.そっか……。でも、もうリンコは、寂しくないよ？ アンタがいるから……。:
I see... Now I'm not lonely
anymore, because I have you...
translations.頑張って生きていこう。●たちの命を、後世に繋いでいくんだ！:
Let's do our best to live on.
We are in charge of making a
new world！
translations.夢か。▲小早川＊▲とふたりっきりの世界、か……。:
A dream？ The world with just
▲Kobayaka＊▲
and me, huh...？
translations.ごめんよ。何、言ってるかわからないや……。:
Sorry, I don't understand what
you're saying...
translations.遊んで欲しいの？: You want me to play with you？
translations.じゃあ、毎度おなじみのスキンシップでもするか！:
Then I'll try patting you,
okay？
translations.おっと……ここは嫌いらしいな……。:
Oh... She seems to hate
this...
translations.ここは弱点らしい……。:
I think that's her weak
spot...
translations.ははは、気持ちよさそうだな。: Hahaha, in a good mood, huh？
translations.ネコリンコ、可愛かったな……。:
Rinko the kitten was so
cute...
translations.（あの肉球……触ってみようかな？）:
(Those paw pads... Maybe I'll
try touching them？)
translations.（耳は本物なのか？ 気になる……）:
(Are those ears real？ Now I'm
curious...)
translations.（猫だから尻尾を触ると警戒されるかな？）:
(Since she's a cat, will she
get wary if I touch her tail？)
translations.（猫といえばアゴでゴロゴロ……だよな。）:
(Cats purr when you scratch
their chin... right？)
translations.（このヒゲ、触ったら怒るかな？）:
(Will she get mad if I touch
these whiskers？)
translations.はぴかむりんくる～♪はぴかむりんこの魔法であなたの人生、開運よ！:
Lucky Magical~♪ Lucky Magical
Girl Rinko is here to make
your life better！
translations.▲小早川＊▲!? どうしたんだ？ その格好!?:
▲Kobayaka＊▲！？
What's wrong？ Why are you
dressed like that！？
translations.知らないの？ “開運少女はぴかむりんこ”大好評放映中！:
Don't you know？ This "Lucky
Magical Girl Rinko" is a very
popular show on TV！
translations.はぴかむりんこ……？ 魔法少女みたいなヤツ？:
Lucky Magical Girl Rinko？
It's some sort of a magical
girl show？
translations.なるほどね……それアレだろ？ 魔法のステッキ！:
I see... And that must be the
magical wand！
translations.ん？ ああ……これ、棍棒。: Huh？ Ah, this one is a stick.
translations.悪いヤツをさ、これでボコ殴りするっ！:
I use this to strike the bad
guys.
translations.ボッコボコのギッタギタだぞー！:
Bang！ Bang！ Boom！ Boom！
Just like that！
translations.……なんだよ、それ？ それで変身とかしちゃうんじゃないの？ ハートとか星型の光線:
...And what's with this look？
Did you do the transformation,
like the ones with the hearts
or star beams and stuff...？
translations.変身？ そんなことできるわけないじゃん。フツウに着替えますけど？:
Transformation？ How could I
possibly do that？ I just
simply changed my clothes.
translations.着替えるの？ コスプレかよ!?:
Changed your clothes？ So this
is just a cosplay？
translations.コスプレ？ そんなの興味あるように見える？:
Cosplay？ Do I look like
someone who would do that kind
of thing？
translations.へぇ、何に使うの？: Hmm？ What do you use it for？
translations.うーん……それが、りんこにもよくわからないんだよね。なんか偉い人、すぽんさぁ？:
Well... I don't really know
much. Someone named
"S-pon-sor" told me to carry
it.
translations.（女児向け玩具用アイテムってやつか……）:
(So it's a toy for grade
school girls, huh？)
translations.この鈴付きネックレスは？:
What's that necklace with a
bell on it？
translations.これが光ったら、誰かが呼んでるっつーことじゃない？:
When this thing shines, I'll
know that someone is calling
for me.
translations.光ってるけど、いいの？:
But it's shining now. Don't
you have to go？
translations.今日は、やめとく……なんかだるいし。:
I'll just skip it... I feel
kind of sluggish today.
translations.あ……、衣装にはさわんないでよ？ レンタルなんだから。:
Ah... Don't touch my costume.
It's a rental item.
translations.自前じゃないのか……。:
You don't even have one for
your own, huh...？
translations.ところで、魔法少女だったら、アレ……いるんじゃないの？ お供のちっこい動物みたい:
By the way, since you're a
magical girl, don't you have
that thing... I mean, that
tiny animal as your sidekick？
translations.そんなのいない、低予算だからケチってんじゃない？:
I don't. We had a budget cut,
so we have to be stingy.
translations.そうなの？ さっきから画面の左のほうにチラっと見えてるのは？:
Really？ Then what is that
thing on the left screen？
translations.なんだ、いるじゃん！ へぇ……、ダルマなんだ。斬新な設定だよな。:
What？ You got it！ Hmm...？ A
Daruma doll？ This is so
original.
translations.うむ、はぴかむりんこの父だが？:
Um, I'm Magical Girl Rinko's
dad.
translations.スミマセン！ お父さん！ いつも凛子さんにはお世話になっております!!:
I'm sorry, Dad！ Rinko-san has
always been taking good care
of me.
translations.むむっ！ むむむむっ!? キミかっ！ りんこを夜遅くまで連れ回している輩はー!!:
Hmm！ Hmmmmmmmmmm！！ So, it's
you！ You are the one who
hangs out with Rinko until
late every night, huh！？
translations.ウン、この人が、りんこのカレシだよ。:
Yes, this guy is Rinko's
boyfriend.
translations.連れ回してるなんてっ！ とんでもない……。:
I never intended to hang out
with her that late...
translations.けしからんっ！ 娘を惑わす輩は断じて許さーん！:
No excuse！ I can't forgive a
guy who confuses my daughter！
translations.りんこっ！ 例のアレでおしおきしなさい！:
Rinko！ Punish him with that
thing！
translations.お父さん……怒ってるからさ、ちょっとビーム受けといて？:
My dad is angry now, so just
bear with this beam for a bit,
okay？
translations.ふぅぅ……まぁ、とーぜん夢だよな……？:
Urgh... Well, of course, it
was just a dream...
translations.しかし、こりゃ１クールで打ち切り確定だな。:
But a show like that would
definitely be cancelled in no
time.
translations.（首元の鈴、光ってるぞ……）:
(The bell around her neck is
shining...)
translations.（ハート型のあれは一体何に使うんだ？）:
(What on earth is that
heart-shaped thing for？)
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ ずいぶん、ちっさくなっちゃったね？:
▲Kobayaka＊▲？
Why do you become this small？
translations.えっと、かわいい、お洋服着てるんだね？:
Well... You are so cute with
that outfit...
translations.リボンはママにつけてもらったの？:
Did your Mama tie the ribbons
for you？
translations.（こりゃ、だめだ……。なんとか興味を持ってくれる話をしないと……）:
(This is no good... I should
find a topic to talk with her
about...)
translations.じゃあ、お友達だね！ リンコちゃんも仲良くしてね？:
Then we are friends！ Will
Rinko-chan be my friend, too？
translations.（しまった！ なにがいけなかったんだ？）:
(Oh no！ I probably said
something bad.)
translations.エミリーちゃんが、おままごとしましょ？ だって……。:
Emily-chan asked if you wanted
to play house...
translations.ええと、それじゃパパがお仕事から帰ってくるとこからはじめよっか？:
Then let's start from when
Papa comes home from work,
okay？
translations.ううん、パパはおしごと、いそがしいからかえってこないよ？:
No. Papa is always busy with
work. Papa doesn't come home.
translations.そっかーでもパパは、今日は仕事が早く終わったからお家に帰る事にするよ。:
I see. But today Papa finished
work early, so Papa is coming
home.
translations.まぁ！ アナタがはやくかえってくるなんてあしたはアメでもふるんじゃないかしら？:
Oh！ You came home early
today. It will surely rain
tomorrow then.
translations.っと、気を取り直してもう一度。ガチャ……ただいま～。:
Um, let's do it again from the
beginning. ...I'm home~.
translations.おかえりなさい、アナタ。シ～メ～にします？ それとも、ロ～フ～？:
Welcome home, my dear. Do you
want ninder first or take a
wowsher first？
translations.シーメーってなにかな？ パパわかんないや……？:
What is ninder？ Papa doesn't
quite understand...
translations.しらない。りんこのパパがかえったら、いつもシ～メ～まだ？ ってゆってるから。:
Don't know. Rinko's Papa
always says "Is ninder
ready？" when he arrives home.
translations.そっか……なんだかわかんないけどじゃあ、シーメーにしようかな。:
I see... I still don't get it
but I think I'll have ninder
first.
translations.ごめんなさい、はやくかえってくるとおもってなかったから、よういしてないわ。:
Sorry. I didn't know that you
would be home early. I didn't
prepare it for you.
translations.ははは……パパのシーメー、今日はないのかー。:
ahaha... So there's no ninder
for Papa, huh？
translations.あ、そういえばこのあいだかしたツェーじゅうゲーまんかえしてよ。:
Ah, please don't forget to
make a maypent.
translations.ザギンでシースーたべて、ギロッポンからシータクでかえってきたからかしてって、ゆっ:
Last time, you said you had to
go on a nusibess trip with
your pomcany, didn't you？
translations.？？？？ リンコちゃんのお家は不思議な言葉を使うんだね。:
？？？？？ Rinko-chan's family
sure talks in a very
mysterious way, huh？
translations.ううん、パパだけだよ？ きっとニホンジンじゃ、ないんだね。:
No, only Papa does. He
definitely isn't Japanese.
translations.そんなこと言ったらパパかわいそうだよ？:
Saying that makes Papa seem
very pitiful.
translations.いいの！ パパはママをいじめるんだもん！ だからキライ！:
It's fine！ Papa treats Mama
badly！ That's why Rinko hates
him！
translations.この、おようふくもママがつくってくれたんだよ？ エミリーちゃんとおそろいなんだ。:
And this outfit... Mama made
it, you know？ It looks the
same as Emily-chan's. Hehe...
translations.へえー、すっごく似合ってるよ。やさしいママなんだね？:
Yeah, it looks exactly the
same. Your Mama is very kind,
right？
translations.うん！ ママはね、おようふくつくるのと～ってもじょうずなの！:
Yes！ Mama is very good at
making clothes！
translations.りんこがね、およめさんにいくときもウエディングドレスをつくってくれるんだって！:
When Rinko gets married, Mama
will make a wedding dress for
Rinko too！
translations.そうか……。リンコちゃんの花嫁姿を楽しみにしてるんだね。:
I see... I can't wait to see
Rinko-chan as a bride.
translations.ずっと寂しい思いをして生きてきたのかもしれないな……。:
I wonder if she had grown up
with such lonely memories...
translations.（あの人形、大事そうにしてるな……）:
(She's holding onto that doll
like it's really precious...)
translations.あの白い帽子の女の子……、まるで、身体が透き通ってるみたいだ。:
That girl with the white
hat... Somehow, she looks
transparent...
translations.会ったのは初めてだけど？:
This is the first time we've
met, isn't it？
translations.ううん、今は記憶が少し混乱しているだけ。ほら、息を吸ってみて……？:
No, your memory hasn't gotten
in order yet. Come on. Take a
deep breath...
translations.でも、ここがどこかもわかってないんだ……。:
But I don't even know where
this place is...
translations.ここは頭の中の記憶。時計の針がサカサマに回る特別な場所……。:
This is a place in your
memories where time moves
backward... It's a special
place...
translations.フフフ、あ……ほら！ 見えない？:
Hehe... Ah... Hey！ Can you
see it？
