translations.あの夏、真っ青な空の下で、水しぶきをあげ川で遊んだこと……。ヒマワリを背負って歩:
That summer, under the blue
sky, we played by the river.
We walked in the sunflower
fields. We listened to cicadas
cry.
translations.何かを忘れている……そんな気がする。:
I feel like I have forgotten
something...
translations.うん。……もう大丈夫だよ。ワタシは、もういかなきゃ……。:
Well, that's okay. I have to
go now.
translations.そっか……。キミのこと、ずっと憶えてるから。:
I see... I will remember you
forever.
translations.べつに憶えていなくてもいいの。たださ、想い出してくれたら……。:
You don't have to remember me.
Just put me somewhere in your
memories...
translations.でもさ……、どうしても、わからない時はラベンダーたちに聞いてみ？:
Then... Whenever you can't
remember me, just ask these
lavenders.
translations.ラベンダーの花言葉をねっ！ フンっ！:
There's a flower language for
lavender！ Hmph！
translations.ラベンダーの花言葉“あなたを待っています”:
Lavender's flower language is,
"I am waiting for you."
translations.大丈夫だと思うけど、これからも▲小早川＊▲に寂しい思いはさせないようにしよう。:
I think she's okay now, but
I'll make sure ▲小早川＊▲
never feels lonely again.
translations.クッソー！ 地球侵略を企む\nデス・ゲノムめっ……くっ\nもはや、ここまでかーー:
Gaaah！ Death Genome！ They
have planned to invade the
Earth... Argh... They've come
this far...！
translations.地球防衛軍のみなさんっ！ \nここはボクに\nまかせて下さい！:
Everyone in the Earth Defense
Force, from here on, just
leave it to me！
translations.き、君はリンタロウ少年！ \nハッ！ \n……それはまさかっ!?:
Y-You are Rintaro！ Hah！
...Could that be...
translations.ヴォルヴァヴィン……\nまさか、プロトタイプが\n完成していたとは！:
Volvavin...！？ No way！ The
prototype production is
complete！？
translations.決まった!! ヴォルキック！ \nざまぁみろ！ \nデス・ゲノムめっ！:
Yes！！ The Volve Kick！ How's
that, Death Genome！？
translations.なんだとっ……！ \nヴォルキックが\nきかないなんて！:
What was that...！？ The Volve
Kick couldn't do anything to
him！
translations.どういうことだ！ \nヴォルヴァヴィンの動きが\n停止したぞ！:
What is that！？ Now, Volvavin
can't move！
translations.やはり、まだ実戦には\n早過ぎたのか……。:
Of course, the real battle has
just started...
translations.リンタロウくんっ！ 危険だ！\nヴォルヴァヴィンから\n離れろぉぉ！:
Rintaro-kun！ It's too
dangerous. You must leave
Volvavin now！！
translations.離れるもんか……\n離れるもんか……\n離れるもんかーーーーっ！:
Do I have to leave...？ Do I
have to leave...？ Do I have
to leave~~~~！？
translations.（さぁ……共に力を合わせて\nデス・ゲノムを\n倒すのです！）:
(Now... We shall join forces
to bring down Death Genome！)
translations.（今こそ、私の力を\n授けましょう……さぁ！ \nヴォルフュージョンと\n叫びな:
(Now is the time I shall grant
you my power... Now, shout
"Volve Fusion"！)
translations.感じる……！ \nリンタロウくんと\nヴォルヴァヴィンの\nシンクロ率が上昇して:
I can feel it...！ Rintaro-kun
and Volvavin are now
synchronized！
translations.そうか！ ヴォルヴァヴィンは\nリンタロウくんの\nお母さんのＤＮＡで\n造られ:
Right！ The Super Robot
Warrior Volvavin was built
with the DNA of Rintaro-kun's
mother.
translations.子を守ろうとする母の心が\nふたりを超絶合体\nさせたのかっ！:
Now, it's using the spirit of
a mother who wants to protect
her daughter！
translations.ヴォルフュ～～ジョンッ!! \nやっぱ、ヴォルヴァヴィン\n最高だよな……。:
Volve Fusion~~~~！！ Yes！
Volvavin is the best...
translations.はぁ……目、ちゃんと覚めてる？:
Hah... Are you fully awake
now？
translations.じゃ、話の続き……今リンコたちが生きて、感じている世界は、ひょっとして夢なんじゃ:
Then let's continue... The
world we are in now, the
feelings we feel, could they
possibly be just a dream...？
translations.……でもさ、●は今こうして▲小早川＊▲を見て、感じてる。:
...But now I can really see
you, and feel you,
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
translations.それに、手を伸ばせば触れることだってできる。その感覚はリアルだよ。:
If I reach out my hand, I can
touch you. This feeling tells
me that it's real.
translations.でもその感覚だって、結局は脳が感じていること。その脳が夢を見ていたら……？:
But the feeling you mentioned
is just a perception of your
brain. What if your brain is
also dreaming...？
translations.ないんだよ、保証なんて。今自分が起きているのか、夢を見ているのか、本当のことは、:
There's no proof at all. Who
knows if you are now awake or
you are still dreaming... No
one knows...
translations.夢はさ、無意識が生み出す、“見たい”と思ったイメージなんだよ。:
A dream is what your
subconsciousness creates. It
shows you what you want to
see...
translations.こうしてアンタと幸せに生きてるリンコ、これはリンコの無意識が生み出したイメージな:
For Rinko to be with you like
this, it's probably Rinko's
subconsciousness that created
this world.
translations.そんな理想が生み出した世界だから、アンタはこんなに近くにいてくれて、リンコはこん:
In this ideal world where you
are this close to Rinko, Rinko
would be overly happy.
translations.だって、夢の中なら何でも許されちゃうもん。:
Since it's a dream, you are
allowed to do anything you
want.
translations.リンコがわがままを言っても、アンタは笑って許してくれる……そんな素敵な世界をリン:
Rinko could be very selfish
and you would just laugh it
off... It's this wonderful
world that Rinko wishes for...
translations.それは、●がそうしたいからだよ。:
I also wish for such a
wonderful world.
translations.あぁ、▲小早川＊▲のわがままを聞いてやるのが、●の幸せだ。:
Yeah, seeing
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
being able to do what she
wants is also my happiness.
translations.だからさ、アンタが幸せだと感じているその世界、それが、アンタの無意識が生み出した:
If that's what makes you
happy, then your
subconsciousness can create
such a dream for you...
translations.（だめだ、よくわからなくなってきた……ねむい……）:
(No good... I don't know why
I'm getting so sleepy...)
translations.なに？ また寝るわけ？:
What？ Are you going to sleep
again？
translations.いい夢、見られるといいね……。:
It would be nice if you saw a
nice dream...
translations.リンコも、今日夢を見たよ……アンタと一緒にいた夢……。:
Rinko also had a dream
today... A dream where Rinko
was with you...
translations.アンタの後ろにある太陽が……すごく眩しかった……。:
The sun behind you was shining
so brightly...
translations.その太陽から、ながーい管が垂れて下がってきてさ……。:
There was a long tunnel coming
from the sun...
translations.それが持ち上がったかと思ったら、風が吹き出してきて……。:
And then there was a strong
wind gushing out...
translations.……また、▲小早川＊▲の話の途中で眠っちゃったのか。:
...I fell asleep while talking
to ▲Kobayaka＊▲
again, eh？
translations.ってことは、これは夢……明晰夢ってやつか……？:
And is this still a dream？ So
it's a dream within a
dream...？
translations.自分の部屋の風景も、枕の感触も……すごく、リアルだな……。:
But the feel of my pillow in
my room here... It must be
real...
translations.って、違う！ さっきのが夢で、今が現実……だよな？:
Oh no！ The one before was a
dream！ This is reality
then... I think...
translations.ついに、最後の一葉になってしまったね。:
Finally, that's the last leaf
left on the tree.
translations.あの枯れ木……。どんどん葉が落ちていって……まるで●の命みたいだ。:
That withering tree... Its
leaves are rapidly
disappearing... Just like my
life.
translations.そんなこと言ってると、本当に治らなくなっちゃうよ。:
If you say something like
that, you won't be able to
recover.
translations.▲小早川＊▲……。本当なんだ。●、かなり悪いみたいなんだよ。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲...
I'm just saying the truth. I
can feel myself getting weaker
day-by-day.
translations.ウソ、聞こえない。そんなの信じない。:
Liar, I won't listen to you. I
won't believe in such
nonsense.
translations.あの木も●が入院したころは、青々と葉が茂っていた。今は……もう最後の力を振りしぼ:
Like myself, the tree was full
of green leaves when I entered
this hospital. Now, we are
only waiting for our end...
translations.きっと治るよ。新しい薬もらったんでしょ？:
We'll get you healed. We'll
buy some new medicine, okay？
translations.薬を変えてもムダだよ。これはタダの痛み止め、治療法はないんだ。:
Even if we change the
medicine, it will only stop
the pain. It won't cure my
illness.
translations.絶対元気になるって！ 弱気になったら病気に負けちゃう。:
You will get better, I said！
You'll only be defeated by
your illness with such a weak
heart.
translations.優しいんだね、▲小早川＊▲。でも、●は知っているんだ。もう、そう長くはないってこ:
You are so kind,
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
But, I already understand. I
won't last any longer.
translations.だけど……●が逝ってしまっても、一体何人が涙を流してくれるんだろうか……。:
Now... I wonder who will shed
a tear for me when I leave.
translations.リンコは泣くよ。リンコは……あなたのことをずっとずっと好きでいるんだから。:
Rinko will cry. Because
Rinko... Rinko will always
love you forever.
translations.●の命があとわずかだと知って、そんなことを言ってくれるんだね。:
You must be saying that for me
because my life is ending
soon.
translations.当たり前じゃない！ あなたは世界でいちばん大事な人……。:
Of course not！ You are the
most precious person for me in
this whole world...
translations.だから……リンコをひとりにしないで！:
That's why... Don't leave
Rinko alone！
translations.うれしいよ。だけど、もう時間がないんだ。:
I'm so happy. But I don't have
much time left.
translations.お願いだから、そんなこと言わないで！ なんでもする！ どんなお医者さんでも連れて:
I beg you. Don't say such
things！ I will do anything
for you！ I will ask any
doctor to come and cure you！
So...
translations.▲小早川＊▲はまだ若い。たくさん恋して、楽しんで生きなきゃだめだ。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
you are still young. You will
be loved, and you should live
your life happily.
translations.いや……リンコはあなたじゃなきゃダメなの……！:
I don't want to... Rinko can
never love anyone else but
you...！
translations.最期の時に▲小早川＊▲と一緒でよかったよ。こうやって温かい手に触れることができて:
I am so glad that I have
▲Kobayaka＊▲
here by my side in my final
moment... I can go peacefully
while holding your warm
hands...
translations.死んでしまうなんて、絶対許さないから。だから……そんなこと言っちゃダメ。:
I will never forgive you if
you die. That's why... Stop
saying such cruel things.
translations.ふふ……▲小早川＊▲は相変わらずワガママだな。:
Haha... As usual,
▲Kobayaka＊▲
is such a selfish girl.
translations.うん。ワガママだから……リンコは必ず治るって信じてるから……諦めたくない……。:
Yes. I'm selfish... Just
believe in me. I'll surely
find a way to cure you. I
won't give up...
translations.アンタがいなくなるなんて……。: If you are not with me...
translations.●は▲小早川＊▲に会えてよかった。その思い出があるから、もう何も怖くないんだ。:
I'm so glad that I met
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
It's due to my beautiful
memories with you that I don't
fear anything anymore.
translations.▲小早川＊▲……●が死んでもくじけちゃダメだ。約束して。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲...
You should carry on even when
I'm gone, okay？ Please
promise me.
translations.約束してくれるよね？ いつまでも、素直でまっすぐな▲小早川＊▲でいてくれることを:
Promise me, okay？ You should
always be like the
▲Kobayaka＊▲
I admire, always cheerful, and
always honest.
translations.……よかった……これで安心して……逝けるよ……。:
...I'm so glad.
...This way...
I can leave peacefully...
translations.ああ、最後の一葉が風に揺られて……さようなら、▲小早川＊▲……。:
Ah, the last leaf has finally
been blown away by the wind...
Goodbye,
▲Kobayaka＊▲...
translations.（泣いてる……涙を拭いてあげなきゃ）:
(She's crying... I have to
wipe away her tears.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲がキラー・バンビーズのメンバーとして……！）:
(▲Kobayaka＊▲
is now an official member of
the Killer Bambies...)
translations.こんばんは、キラー・バンビーズです。:
Good evening, we are the
Killer Bambies.
translations.まずは……今夜集まってくれた、アンタ達に感謝。:
First of all, we'd like to
thank you all for gathering
here tonight.
translations.それと……デスジャビのゴッド……。:
And then... to the God of the
Deth Jabbi...
translations.ろくでなしのアタシに生きる意味を与えてくれたアイツに、最低の感謝を込めて……。:
For giving me meaning for my
once good-for-nothing life, my
lowest gratitude...
translations.今夜は、倒れるまで、全部出し切るから……。:
Tonight, we will go all out
until you collapse...
translations.あとは……もう、わかんないや……。:
And then... Hmm, I don't know
anymore...
translations.アンタ達は……アタシのお喋りを聞きに来たわけじゃないよね？:
All of you aren't here to hear
my preaching, right？
translations.地獄の果てまで、よろしく……。:
I will expect you to accompany
me, to the deepest pits of
hell.
translations.（最前列で見てるのに……）:
(Even though I'm watching her
from the front row...)
translations.（なんでだろう、ステージが遠く……）:
(I don't know why the stage
seems to be so far away...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲が、遠くに感じる……）:
(▲Kobayaka＊▲...
She just seems to be far
away...)
translations.（●たちは、繋がってる……）:
(We are always connected to
each other...)
translations.（距離も、立場も、関係ない……）:
(How different the position
is, however far the distance
is, they all don't matter...)
translations.（●たちは……ひとつなんだよな？）:
(It's because we are one,
isn't it？)
translations.夢の中の▲小早川＊▲、輝いてたな……。:
Even in my dreams,
▲Kobayaka＊▲
surely shines brightly...
translations.今の▲小早川＊▲みたいな……。:
Someone like you are right
now, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.▲小早川＊▲って、クールで頭もいいしさ。そういうの、好きだぞ。:
You're cool and smart,
▲小早川＊▲. I like that
sort of thing.
translations.自覚ないってのが、タチ悪い……。:
The worst part is that you
don't even realize it...
translations.それは、今の▲小早川＊▲みたいな……。:
Well, someone like you are
right now, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.乱暴なくらいがこっちも気楽だしさ。:
It's easier for me to relax
when you're a little rough
like that.
translations.●たち、お互いタイプだったりしてな。:
Maybe you and I are each
other's type, ●.
translations.はぁ!? 何それ。:
Huh！？ What's that supposed
to mean？
translations.リンコのは……タイプとかじゃなくて、ほら……アレ。:
With me...it's not about
types or anything. You know,
it's...that thing.
translations.最新の“好きなタイプ”、聞いとこうかなって。:
I thought I'd ask what your
latest "type" of girl is.
translations.ううん。そうなんだ……難しい……。:
Never mind. Oh, I see...
This is hard...
translations.今の▲小早川＊▲みたいなの、かな？:
Someone like you are right
now, ▲小早川＊▲, maybe？
translations.ホントのこと言ってるんだけどな、●は。最近、素直になったなって。:
I'm being serious, though.
You've gotten a lot more
honest lately, ●.
translations.そっか……うん。じゃあ、いい。:
Oh, I see... Yeah.
Then that's fine.
translations.（今の▲小早川＊▲、いいよな）:
(I really like the way
▲小早川＊▲ is right now.)
translations.さてと、今日もはりきって図書委員に……。:
Okay, I'll work hard as a
library committee today.
translations.▲小早川＊▲がいない……サボりか？:
▲Kobayaka＊▲
is not here... Is she
skipping？
translations.なにそれ、いちゃ悪いの。:
What is this？ Am I doing
anything bad？
translations.悪いだろ、委員サボってんだから。:
You are. You are skipping the
library work.
translations.いーじゃん、少しくらいさ。サボってんじゃなくて、英気を養ってんの。:
Just a little bit would be
fine, right？ I'm not
skipping. I'm just collecting
some wisdom.
translations.なんのためだよ……●は戻るから、ちゃんと来いよ。:
For what...？ I'm leaving.
You'd better go back too.
translations.アンタはさ、リンコの味方なんでしょ？:
You are Rinko's ally, aren't
you？
translations.ううん、ただ隣に誰かいて欲しいって思っただけ。それだけじゃダメ？:
No. Just feel like I need
someone by my side now. Is
that bad？
translations.またなんかあったら、言えよな。:
If something happened, just
tell me, okay？
translations.さてと、今日もはりきって図書委員になるか！:
Yeah. Today I'll do my best as
a library committee！
translations.はぁ……アンタさ、無駄に元気だね。:
Hah... You're just so
uselessly lively.
translations.なんかだるくて、頭痛い。:
I feel sluggish and I have
headache.
translations.そんな驚かなくても。:
You don't have to be that
loud.
translations.だって体調悪いんだろ。仕事は●が代わりにやっとくから、帰ったらどうだ？:
But you are sick. Let me
handle your work today. You'd
better go home.
translations.大げさにしないでってば、心配しすぎ。:
Don't exaggerate the
situation. You worry too much.
translations.ったく、本気にしちゃってさ。おちおち仮病も使えやしない。:
Geez！ Now I'm really getting
headache. I shouldn't feign
sick...
translations.なんでもない。ほんとアンタは心配性のお兄ちゃんだね！:
Nothing. You're like a big
brother who keeps worrying
about things！
translations.（今日は委員の当番じゃないしな、ゆっくりするか）:
(I'm not on library committee
duty today. I'll just relax.)
translations.相変わらず暇そうじゃん、気の緩んだ顔しちゃってさ。:
As usual, you have too much
free time. You look bored.
translations.そんなことないって。これでも色々忙しいんだよ。:
That's not the case. I also
have many things to take care
of.
translations.まぁ、実はリンコも暇だしさ。:
Well, actually, Rinko was also
bored.
translations.あれ、そういや▲小早川＊▲さ。今日、図書委員の当番じゃなかったっけ？:
Eh？ But today is your turn to
work as a library committee,
isn't it,
▲Kobayaka＊▲？
translations.そういえば……。まぁ、サボればいっか。:
Speaking of it... Well, I'll
skip it then.
translations.でも▲小早川＊▲、最近よくサボってるよな。:
But
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
you often skipped your work
lately.
translations.そろそろペナルティで、一ヶ月本の貸出禁止だぞ。:
A penalty for skipping work is
prohibition from borrowing any
books for one month, you
know？
translations.いてっ！ ●は悪くないだろ!?:
Ouch！ It's not my fault at
all！
translations.悪い！ アンタはリンコの味方なんだから、面倒見る義務があるの！:
It's your fault！ You are
Rinko's ally, so it's your
duty to take care of all the
trouble！
translations.リンコがこう言ってるんだから、いいじゃん！:
Since Rinko says so, it's
reasonable！
translations.わかったわかった、とりあえず今は急げ。次からは気を付けるから。:
I got it, I got it. But you
should hurry to work. I'll be
sure to warn you early next
time.
translations.来た。ちょっとリンコのことかくまって。:
He's here. Let Rinko hide
behind you.
translations.（あそこにいるの１年の担任……。そうか、先生から逃げてたのか）:
(That teacher is in charge of
first year students. So, she
ran away from the teacher？)
translations.ちょっと、あんまくっつかないでよ！:
Hey, don't get too close to
me！
translations.いいじゃん、そんなの。嬉しかったくせに。:
Isn't it good？ You looked so
happy like that...
translations.なんだ。何慌ててるんだ？:
What？ Seems like you're in
hot haste.
translations.だってさ。その、ヘンじゃない？\nリンコがこんなとこにいたらさ。:
Well, isn't it weird that you
see me here？
translations.花屋？ たしかにイメージじゃないな。:
At a flower shop？ It doesn't
fit your image, I guess.
translations.リンコだって、ときどき部屋に花ぐらい飾るよ。:
At least I use flowers to
decorate my room sometimes.
translations.ねぇ。やっぱり、リンコが花ってヘン？ 笑っちゃう？:
Hey. Is it really weird for me
to buy flowers？ You wanna
laugh？
translations.少し引っかかる言い方だけど……ならいいや、へへ。:
The way you said it isn't that
nice, but... It's fine. Hehe.
translations.でも▲小早川＊▲の部屋か、どんなのか少し気になるな。:
But I kind of wonder how
▲Kobayaka＊▲'s
room looks like.
translations.気になるなら、来てみればいいじゃん……。:
If you are curious, why don't
you come to visit？
translations.（今日も学校は静かで平和だな……）:
(It's so quiet and peaceful at
school today.)
translations.校舎裏の方だな、行ってみるか……。:
It was from the back of that
building. I'd better check...
translations.（見てはいけないものを見てしまったかも）:
(I feel like I've seen
something that I'm not
supposed to see.)
translations.バッチリ。ほんとネコ好きなんだな。:
Absolutely. You really like
cats, huh？
translations.いいじゃん。可愛いんだからしょうがないじゃん。:
Why not？ They are cute, so I
can't help it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲もな！ ネコかと思ったぞ。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲,
you're cute too！ Very cute
when you're with the cats.
translations.はぁ、グラウンド３０周って……。:
I have to run 30 laps around
the track...
translations.そりゃ、こんだけ走らされればな……。:
I don't know if I can finish
this...
translations.今日もあと一息だから、がんばろうね。:
Just a little bit more. Keep
it up.
translations.なんかやる気出てきたぞ。:
Now I feel like I'm in high
spirits.
translations.興味なし、か。:
I think you're not interested
in sports.
translations.まぁね。……さっきの人、かっこいいね。:
Sort of... That person just
now was so good-looking.
translations.▲高嶺＊＊▲か、女の子からもそう見えるんだな。:
▲Takane＊＊▲？
Even a girl also says this,
huh？
translations.“も”ってことは、アンタもそう思ってんの？:
"Also"？ So you think she's
good-looking too？
translations.（この棚は終わり、次は……）:
(I'm done with this shelf.
What's next...？)
translations.なんのなんの。●、図書委員だし。お安い御用だよ。:
It's nothing. As a library
committee, this is just an
easy job.
translations.さて、と。●はそろそろ帰るかな……。:
Well... It's time to go
home...
translations.もう帰るから。返却本戻しといて。:
I'm going home. You take care
of these returned books.
translations.お安い御用なんでしょ。:
It's just an easy job, isn't
it？
translations.ごめんね呼び止めて。もう行くから。:
Sorry for taking your time. I
have to go.
translations.見てたのか。そんなんじゃねぇって。:
Did you see it？ I'm not
popular or anything.
translations.ふぅん。でもお似合いじゃん？:
Hmm？ But you two look good
together.
translations.んなわけないじゃん、バカじゃないの？ ぜんぜん釣り合ってないっつーの！:
Not really！ Are you an
idiot！？ You don't look good
with her at all！
translations.へへ、見学。邪魔にならないようにするからさ、見てっていい？:
Hehe. I'm here to observe.
I'll try not to bother you, so
can I stay and watch？
translations.いいけど、これからダブルスのパートナーと打ち合わせなんだよな。:
Fine. I'm waiting for my mixed
doubles partner here.
translations.ふぅん。やっぱリンコ、お邪魔みたいだから。帰るね。:
Hmm？ Then I might be a bother
for you. I'm leaving.
translations.どうしたの、今の子。すごい勢いで行っちゃった。:
What's the matter？ Seems like
that girl just ran away.
translations.よし、ゴミ捨て終了！:
Okay, I'm done with the
trash！
translations.通りかかっただけ。そっか、ここで働いてんだっけ。:
I just walk past. So, you're
working here？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。お願い、ちょっと来て。:
▲主人公＊▲.
Can you help me here？
translations.あのね。さっき私がレジ打ちしたお客様が、あなたのこと褒めてたの。:
Hey, just a moment ago while I
was working as a cashier, a
customer praised you.
translations.うん。接客が丁寧で、ニコニコしてて気持ちがいいって。:
Yeah. She said that you were
polite and your smile always
made her feel good.
translations.お席までご案内します。: I'll take you to your seat.
translations.店員の接客態度が気に入らない。:
I'm not impressed with this
waiter's service.
translations.顔がニヤニヤしてて気持ち悪い。:
Your grinning face makes me
feel sick.
translations.これ、忘れものみたいですよ。窓際の机の下に筆箱が落ちてたんです。:
Here. Seems like someone
forgot this pencil box. It was
on the floor under that table.
translations.それはどうも、ご親切に。:
Thank you very much. You are
so kind.
translations.ふふ。ちゃあんと委員の仕事もしてるんだね、バイトも大変なのに。:
Hehe. You really work hard as
a committee, huh？ You work
hard for your part-time job as
well.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、いいところに。今忘れ物預かったんだけど……。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
Nice timing. Can you take care
of this forgotten item？
translations.（むちゃくちゃ機嫌悪そう……）:
(She looks so pissed for no
reason...)
translations.これってどうするんだっけ？:
What should I do with this
then？
translations.リンコはアンタのお姉さんじゃないんだから、なんでもかんでも聞くなっつーの。:
I'm not your older sister.
Don't keep asking me for every
little thing.
translations.なに怒ってんだよ。そういうの、よくないぞ。:
What are you angry at？ This
is not good, you know？
translations.それはどうもご親切に。:
"Thank you very much. You are
so kind."
translations.どうせリンコはいじわるだよ！:
Whatever！ I'm always a mean
girl！
translations.（なんであんなに怒ってるんだ？）:
(Why was she so mad like
that？)
translations.そろそろ行こっかな。あんまり仲良くしてると恋人に間違われちゃうかも。:
I'd better go. If we get too
close, someone might mistake
us as lovers.
translations.ときどき、ドキっとすること言うよな。:
She really likes to say some
surprising stuff.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ あれ、いつからそこに。:
▲Kobayaka＊▲？
Eh？ How long have you been
here？
translations.恋人に間違われちゃう、あたりから。:
Long enough to mistake you two
as lovers.
translations.リンコと一緒にいても、兄妹にしか見られないかもね。:
If you're with Rinko, we're
probably mistaken as brother
and sister.
translations.アンタのおかげでさ、学校もそこそこ悪くなかったかも。:
Thanks to you, school isn't a
terrible place for me anymore.
translations.そりゃよかった、●がいなくてもしっかりやれよ。:
That's great then. You must
behave even when I'm not here,
okay？
translations.また年上ぶっちゃってさ。ダメなアニキみたいだったよ、アンタ。:
Don't act like you're so grown
up. You're just like a
good-for-nothing older brother
for me.
translations.（ほんと妹みたいな感じだったな……）:
(She is just like a little
sister to me...)
translations.おう、ありがと。●が卒業してさびしいか？:
Oh, thanks. Do you feel lonely
that I graduated？
translations.はは、今日は素直だな。:
Haha. Today, you're being
frank, huh？
translations.アンタのおかげで、リンコは変われた。ありがとう。:
I could change because of you.
Thanks.
translations.それで、ほんとはアンタには、もっとずっと傍にいてほしかった。:
And I really want you to stay
beside me, forever.
translations.でも、ダメだった。リンコは、結局妹のまま。女としては見てくれなかった。:
But, that's not possible. You
just think of me as your
little sister and never see me
as a woman.
translations.まったくさ、鈍いよね！:
In the end, you are just too
dumb！
translations.怒ってますが、なにか？: Yes, I'm mad. What of it？
translations.まだ怒ってるっつーの。: I told you, I'm still mad.
translations.まだ怒ってるんだから。反省してよね。: I'm still mad at you. You'd better think about what you did.
translations.今日、リンコの誕生日なんだよね。お祝いは？: Today's my birthday, you know. Aren't you gonna say it？
translations.今日はリンコの誕生日！ もちろん覚えてるよね？: Today's my birthday! You remembered, right？
translations.リンコの誕生日忘れてたでしょ。はぁ……。: You forgot my birthday, didn't you？ Sigh...
translations.どーせ、リンコの誕生日なんて覚えてなかったんでしょ。: I bet you didn't even remember my birthday anyway.
translations.来てくれなかったね、リンコの誕生日。さみしかったよ。: You didn't come see me on my birthday. I was lonely.
translations.ハッピバースデー。今日は特別だよ？……コホン……大好き▼: Happy birthday. Since today's special... Ahem... I love you▼
translations.ハッピバースデー！また年取ったね？……ウ・ソ！ ス・キ▼: Happy birthday! Getting old, huh？ ...Just kidding! Love you▼
translations.ニャーニャニャーニャー！ ……コホン……ネコ語でハッピバースデーだよ……。: Meow, meow, meow-meow! ...Ahem. That's 'happy birthday' in cat...
translations.遅いっつーの。待ってたのにさ。……ハッピバースデー。バカ。: You're late. I was waiting for you. ...Happy birthday, dummy.
translations.どこ行ってたんだ！ 言えなかったじゃん、ハッピバースデー。……バ～カ。: Where were you! I didn't get to wish you a happy birthday. ...Dummy.
translations.ハッピーバースデー！ 遅くなっちゃったけど、リンコは忘れないよ。: Happy birthday! I know it's late, but I'd never forget.
translations.覚えてる？ 今日は、リンコ達が初めて会った日。リンコはさ、あの日のこと、一生忘れ: Remember？ Today's the day we first met. I don't think I'll ever forget that day for the rest of my life.
translations.今日はさ、二人が初めて会った日だね？ ……忘れてないよね？: Today's the day the two of us first met, right？ ...You haven't forgotten, have you？
translations.今日は、何の日だ？ へへ……リンコ達が、初めて会った日だよ？忘れないでね？: Guess what today is？ Hehe... It's the day we first met. Don't forget it, okay？
translations.今日は、二人が付き合い始めた日だよ？ リンコのこと、好きになってくれてありがとう: Today's the day we started going out, you know？ Thanks for falling for me.
translations.今日はぁ……リンコが告白してあげた日！ ……うん。 夕日がさ、きれいだったね？: Today is... the day I did you the favor of asking you out! ...Yeah. The sunset was pretty that day, huh？
translations.今日はさ、何の日だ？……へへ、そう、リンコが告白しちゃった日だよ。: So, what's today？ ...Hehe, yep, it's the day I confessed to you.
translations.今日は……リンコたちが初めてキスした記念日。覚えてた？: Today's... the anniversary of our first kiss. Did you remember？
translations.今日は初めてキスした記念日だよ。覚えてる、よね？: Today's the anniversary of our first kiss. You remember, right？
translations.今日は、ふたりが初めてキスした記念日。……ちょっと照れるね。: Today's the anniversary of our first kiss. ...Kind of embarrassing, huh.
translations.月曜日かぁ。今日からまた長い一週間が始まるよ……。: Monday, huh. Another long week starts today...
translations.今日は火曜か。あ、いつも読んでる雑誌、買わなきゃ。: It's Tuesday, huh. Oh, I need to buy the magazine I always read.
translations.週の真ん中、水曜日。ちょっとダレちゃうよね。: Wednesday, right in the middle of the week. Kind of makes you lose steam, huh.
translations.木曜日は、観たいドラマがあるんだ。: There's a show I want to watch on Thursdays.
translations.金曜か、今週も乗り切った、っと。: Friday, huh. Made it through another week.
translations.やっと土曜日かぁ。一週間、お疲れ様。: Finally Saturday, huh. Good work this week.
translations.土曜日って、ついつい夜ふかししちゃうんだよねー。: On Saturdays, I always end up staying up late.
translations.楽しい日曜日だよ。今日はどうする？: Good old Sunday. What should we do today？
translations.せっかくの日曜日だけど、一日中ゴロゴロしてるのも好きかな。: I know it's Sunday and all, but I kinda like just lounging around all day, too.
translations.環境が変わると出会いも増えるっていうけど……。別に。何でもない。: They say a change of scenery brings new people into your life, but... Whatever. It's nothing.
translations.最近、眠いよね。ふぁ……。: Been so sleepy lately, huh. Yawn...
translations.うー。リンコ、暑いの苦手なんだよね。: Ugh. I really don't do well with the heat.
translations.行楽のシーズンかぁ。ねえ、海と山どっちが好き？: Outing season, huh. Hey, which do you like better, the beach or the mountains？
translations.リンコの秋は、やっぱり「読書の秋」かな。: For me, fall is definitely all about reading.
translations.最近、食べ物がおいしいよね。リンコ、秋は嫌いじゃないな。: Food's been so good lately, huh. I don't dislike fall.
translations.冬は好きだよ。スノボとかできるからね。: I like winter. You get to go snowboarding and stuff.
translations.冬は、こたつで昼寝するのが好きかも。: I think I like napping under the kotatsu in the winter.
translations.あけましておめでとう。今年も一緒だと、うれしいかな。: Happy New Year. It'd be nice if we could be together this year, too.
translations.初夢って見た？ リンコは……秘密。: Did you have your first dream of the year？ Mine is... a secret.
translations.初夢はどんなかって？ あんたが……やっぱ言わない！: What was my first dream of the year about？ You were... Never mind, I'm not telling!
translations.ふたりでいる初夢見たんだよ。きっと今年もずっと一緒だね。: My first dream of the year was of the two of us. I bet we'll be together all year.
translations.あ～あ、冬休みも終わり。なんか、かったるいなー。: Aw, winter break's over. Everything feels like such a drag.
translations.七草粥食べた？ リンコは食べたよ。: Did you eat seven-herb rice porridge？ I did.
translations.成人の日かぁ。成人するまで一緒にいられたらいいね。: Coming of Age Day, huh. It'd be nice if we're still together when we come of age.
translations.今日は鏡開きなんだって。知ってた？: Apparently today is Kagami Biraki. Did you know that？
translations.今日は鬼は～外、福は～内、だよ。: Today's the day for 'Demons out, good luck in.'
translations.立春だね。春っていうけどまだ寒い……。: It's the first day of spring. Only on the calendar, though. It's still cold...
translations.建国記念日。昔は紀元節って言ったんだって。本に書いてあった。: National Foundation Day. Apparently it used to be called Kigensetsu. I read it in a book.
translations.リンコだって、ちゃんと覚えてるよ。バレンタイン……。: Even I remembered what today is. Valentine's Day...
translations.今日は自分でチョコ買っちゃダメだよ！ 理由は……言わないけど。: Don't go buying your own chocolate today! As for why... I'm not telling.
translations.もしかして期待してたりする？ だって今日は……えへへ。: Don't tell me you're getting your hopes up？ Because today is... ehehe.
translations.あ、今年は閏年か！ ４年に１回の特別な日だね。: Oh, this year's a leap year! A special day that only comes once every four years.
translations.そろそろ梅の花が咲く季節だね。: It's almost the season for plum blossoms to bloom.
translations.ホワイトデーかあ。あ、高いお礼は期待してないから。: White Day, huh. Oh, I'm not expecting anything expensive back, just so you know.
translations.……べつに期待してないもん、ホワイトデーなんて。: ...It's not like I'm expecting anything for White Day.
translations.ホワイトデーか。実はちょっぴり期待してたりして……。: White Day, huh. To tell the truth, maybe I have my hopes up just a little...
translations.今日は春分。昼と夜の長さが同じになる日だね。: Today's the vernal equinox. The day when day and night are the same length.
translations.もうすぐ春休みだね。どっか遊びにいかない？: Spring break is almost here. Want to go hang out somewhere？
translations.やった。春休みだね。ずっとゲームしてられるよ。: Yes, spring break. Now I can play games all day.
translations.今日はとうとうエンディング……なんて、エイプリルフールでした！: Today, we finally reach the ending... Just kidding, April Fools'!
translations.リンコは今日から旅に出ます。ウソだよ▼ ビックリした？: I'm leaving on a journey starting today. Just kidding▼ Did I surprise you？
translations.今日で春休み終わりかあ。学校行くの面倒……。: Spring break ends today, huh. Going to school is such a pain...
translations.桜、咲いてるね。お花見とかするの？: The cherry blossoms are blooming. Are you going flower viewing or anything？
translations.今日は昭和の日。昔は昭和天皇の誕生日だったんだよ。: Today is Showa Day. It used to be Emperor Showa's birthday.
translations.もうすぐ連休だね。どこか行く？: The holidays are coming up soon. Are you going anywhere？
translations.今日は憲法記念日。日本国憲法が施行された日だよ。: Today is Constitution Memorial Day. It's the day Japan's constitution went into effect.
translations.今日はみどりの日。自然と親しむ日なんだって。: Today is Greenery Day. Apparently it's a day for appreciating nature.
translations.今日はこどもの日。弟に鯉のぼり、作ってあげよっかな。: Today is Children's Day. Maybe I'll make a carp streamer for my little brother.
translations.今日は立夏だね。暦の上ではもう夏なんだよ。: Today's the first day of summer. According to the calendar, anyway.
translations.母の日かぁ。リンコはどうしよっかな。: Mother's Day, huh. I wonder what I should do.
translations.体育祭、苦手。走るの嫌い。: I'm no good with sports festivals. I hate running.
translations.今日は夏至だね。昼間が一番長い日なんだって。: Today's the summer solstice. It's the longest day of the year.
translations.今日から夏服に衣替えだね。: We switch to summer uniforms starting today.
translations.お父さんに父の日のプレゼント、買おうと思うんだ。: I'm thinking of buying my dad a Father's Day present.
translations.もうすぐ海開きなんだって。もうすっかり夏だね。: I hear the beaches are opening soon. It really is summer now, huh.
translations.織姫と彦星が会える日だね……。晴れるといいな。: Today's the day Orihime and Hikoboshi get to meet... I hope it's clear out.
translations.もうすぐ夏休みだけど、どっか連れてってくれる？: Summer break's almost here. Are you gonna take me somewhere？
translations.今日は海の日じゃん。ま、祝日ってことに意味があるわけで。: Today's Marine Day. Well, the important part is that we get the day off.
translations.やっと夏休み！ これで宿題さえなければね……。: Summer break at last! Now if only there wasn't any homework...
translations.暦の上では今日から秋。実際は、夏真っ盛りだけどね。: The calendar says autumn starts today. Though really, we're right in the middle of summer.
translations.あちこちで花火大会とかやってるね。浴衣着て見に行こっか。: There are fireworks festivals going on all over. Wanna put on yukata and go see one？
translations.今日はお盆か。盆踊り？ 踊らないっつーの。: It's Obon today, huh. The Bon dance？ As if I'm gonna dance.
translations.あーあ、夏休みも終わり。学校行きたくないなー。: Aw man, summer break's over. I really don't wanna go to school.
translations.今は秋のお彼岸だね。お墓参り行ってきた？: It's the autumn Ohigan now. Did you go visit your family's grave？
translations.今日は敬老の日でしょ。お年寄りは大切にね。: Today's Respect for the Aged Day, right？ Be good to your elders.
translations.今日は秋分。昼と夜の長さが同じになる日だね。: Today's the autumn equinox. Day and night are the exact same length.
translations.衣替えだね。露出度が減って残念とか思ってるでしょ？: Time to switch uniforms. You're disappointed we'll be showing less skin, aren't you？
translations.月見だんごって食べたことある？ リンコはないんだ。: Have you ever tried tsukimi dango？ I never have.
translations.今日はハロウィンだね。トリック・オア・トリート！ びしっ！: It's Halloween today. Trick or treat! Bam!
translations.今日は文化の日、文化的なことしてる？……って、文化的ってなんだろ。: It's Culture Day. Doing anything cultural？ ...Wait, what counts as cultural, anyway？
translations.今日は立冬かぁ。さすがに寒くなってきたもんね。: First day of winter on the calendar, huh. It really has gotten cold lately.
translations.七五三だね。リンコも子供のころ、振袖着たよ。: It's Shichi-Go-San today. I wore a kimono for it when I was little, too.
translations.今日は勤労感謝の日だよ。うーん、働くってよくわかんないや。: Today's Labor Thanksgiving Day. Hmm, I don't really know what working feels like yet.
translations.今日は文化祭だよ。ちょっとだけ楽しみかな。: Today's the school festival. I guess I'm looking forward to it a little.
translations.もうすぐ冬休みだ～。待ち遠しいな。: Winter break is almost here. I can't wait.
translations.冬至だからカボチャ食べたんだ。あと柚子湯にも入るよ。: It's the winter solstice, so I had some squash. Gonna take a yuzu bath later, too.
translations.今日は天皇誕生日。昔でいうところの天長節だね。: Today's the Emperor's Birthday. Back in the old days, they called it Tenchosetsu.
translations.今日から冬休み。スノボしに行きたいな……。: Winter break starts today. I'd love to go snowboarding...
translations.今日はイヴだね。予定はもちろんリンコでしょ？: It's Christmas Eve. You're spending it with me, obviously, right？
translations.今日はイヴか……。違っ……別に何も期待してないって！: It's Christmas Eve, huh... W-wait, it's not like I'm expecting anything!
translations.今日はイヴだね。ずっと一緒に過ごしたいな。: It's Christmas Eve. I wanna spend the whole day with you.
translations.もう大晦日かぁ。今年はいい年だった？: New Year's Eve already, huh. Was it a good year for you？
translations.テストかぁ。文系科目は得意なんだけどな。: Exams, huh. I'm pretty good at the humanities subjects, at least.
translations.やっとリンコのこと思い出したんだ。 忘れたかと思ったよ。: So you finally remembered me. I thought you'd forgotten all about me.
translations.あっ……。お・ひ・さ・し・ぶ・り！ びしっ！: Oh... Long. Time. No. See! Bam!
translations.よかった、覚えててくれたんだ。もうリンコをひとりにしないでね。: Thank goodness, you still remember me. Don't leave me all alone again, okay？
translations.今まで何してたの？ ……もう。: What have you been doing all this time？ ...Geez.
translations.会いたかったのに。いつまでほっとくんだ……ばか。: I missed you, you know. How long were you gonna leave me hanging... idiot.
translations.……もう会えないかと思ってたよ。よかった……。: ...I thought I'd never see you again. Thank goodness...
translations.またなの？ リンコのこと、そんなに気になる？: Back again？ Can't get me off your mind or something？
translations.ゲームは一日一時間！ ……なーんてね。会えてうれしいよ。: Only one hour of games a day! ...Just kidding. I'm happy to see you.
translations.また会えたね。へへっ、リンコのこと、好きだから？: Back so soon, huh. Hehe, is it 'cause you like me that much？
translations.また来た……なんなの？: Back again...？ What do you want？
translations.アタシもさ、暇じゃないんだよ？: Look, I've got things to do too, you know？
translations.あ、来た来た。 で？ 今日はどうすんの？: Oh, there you are. So？ What are we doing today？
translations.へへ、今日も遊んどく？: Heh, wanna hang out again today？
translations.もうちょっとしたらさ、いいことあるかもよ？: Stick around a little longer and something good might happen, you know？
translations.そろそろ、言っちゃおうかな……。: Maybe it's about time I just said it...
translations.一人でいるの、飽きちゃった。早く遊びに行こ。: I got bored being on my own. Come on, let's go hang out.
translations.また会えたね。元気？: Nice to see you again. How's it going？
translations.会えると、ちょっとほっとするかな。: I guess it's kind of a relief whenever I get to see you.
translations.こんな時間に会いに来たの？ ま、熱心なのはいいことだね。: You came to see me at this hour？ Well, I can appreciate the dedication.
translations.どうしたの？ またリンコの声が聞きたくなった？: What's up？ Did you miss hearing my voice again？
translations.今、ちょうど会いたいって思ってたんだ。: I was just thinking about how I wanted to see you.
translations.話したいことがいろいろあるんだ。: There's a bunch of stuff I want to talk to you about.
translations.あ、やっぱり来た。うんうん、リンコの予想通り。: Aha, I knew you'd come. Yep, just like I predicted.
translations.あ、来た。……別に浮かれてなんかないってば！: Oh, you're here. ...I'm not getting all excited or anything!
translations.今日は、リンコが満足するまで付き合ってよね。: You'd better keep me company today until I'm satisfied.
translations.顔がニヤけてるよ。まあ、リンコもうれしいけどね、それなりに。: You're grinning. Well, I'm pretty happy to see you too, I guess.
translations.もっと会いに来る回数、増やしてよね！: You need to come see me way more often!
translations.早くおいで。 リンコが前よりかわいくなってるとこ見せたげるからさ。: Hurry up and get over here. I'll show you how much cuter I've gotten.
translations.不公平だよ。リンコばっかり、会いたがってるみたいじゃん。: It's not fair. It feels like I'm the only one who's dying to see you.
translations.ワクワクするね。今日はどんなことする？: I'm excited. What are we gonna do today？
translations.会えてドキドキしてる？ しなきゃダメ。だって……リンコもしてるもん。: Is your heart racing now that you're with me？ It better be. Because... mine is too.
translations.会いにきてくれるの待ってた。……したいこといっぱいあるんだ。: I've been waiting for you to come see me. ...There's so much I want to do.
translations.こっちからも会いに行けたらいいんだけどな……。: I wish I could be the one coming to see you sometimes...
translations.へへ……うれしい。また、会いに来てくれたね。: Heh... I'm happy. You came to see me again.
translations.えへへ……なんかうれしくて笑っちゃう。: Hehe... I'm so happy I can't help smiling.
translations.リンコ、寂しいの嫌いだから。ずっと一緒にいてね。: I hate feeling lonely. So stay with me forever, okay？
translations.あのさ、アンタが来るの、実はけっこー楽しみにしてたんだけど？:
Hey, I was actually really
looking forward to you
coming over, you know？
translations.今日、来るのか不安だった。なんか最近冷たかったしさ。:
I was worried you wouldn't
come today. You've been
kind of cold lately.
translations.ほんとだよ。もっと来ればいいじゃん。:
Seriously. You should come
over more often.
translations.相変わらずだな、この部屋も。:
This room hasn't changed
a bit, huh.
translations.そう？ 勝手知ったる、ってやつか。:
Think so？ Guess you know
your way around by now.
translations.結構、長いよね……。:
It's been a pretty long
time, huh...
translations.ようやく、それっぽくなってきたかな。:
Guess we're finally starting
to look the part, huh.
translations.まだこれからかな、リンコたちって。:
Guess things are still just
getting started for us.
translations.リンコたちが付き合い始めてからの、長さの話。:
I'm talking about how long
we've been going out.
translations.うーん、デートとか……。どんなとこ行ったっけ。:
Hmm, like our dates...
Where all have we been？
translations.ここらへんで行けそうなところは全部行ったな、たぶん。:
I think we've been just
about everywhere we can
go around here.
translations.行けそうなところは大体行ったんじゃないか？:
Haven't we been to most of
the places around here？
translations.あんまり行ってないな。開拓するか。:
We haven't been to that
many places. Should we go
explore some new ones？
translations.色々思い出作ったよね。たくさんあるけど、リンコ全部覚えてる。:
We've made lots of memories,
huh. There are so many,
but I remember them all.
translations.色んなことしたけど、まだいけるんじゃない？ 同じとこでも、行く時期によって違うし:
We've done a lot, but there's
still more we can do, right？
Even the same places feel
different at other times.
translations.もっと色々行こうよ。思い出、増やしたいじゃん。:
Let's go to more places.
I want to make more
memories with you.
translations.思い出足り無さ過ぎ。もっと色々したいんだっつーの！:
We barely have any memories
yet. I want us to do way
more stuff together!
translations.まあデート以外にも、してるしね。ほら、恋人だし。:
Well, we do stuff besides
dates, too. Come on, we're
a couple.
translations.わかれっつーの。……キスのこと。:
Take a hint already.
...I mean kissing.
translations.リンコがこんなになったのも、アンタがたくさんするからだし。:
The only reason I'm like
this is because you kiss
me so much.
translations.あんなにたくさんしといてさ……。:
After you kissed me that
many times...
translations.でもさ、まだ足りないんじゃない。恋人としては。:
Still, I don't think we do
it enough. Not for a couple.
translations.でもあんまりしてくれないと、不安になる……。:
Though if you don't kiss me
much, I get anxious...
translations.あとはさ、あの長いやつ。しかも何度も……、はあ……。:
And then there are those
long ones. Over and over,
too... *sigh*...
translations.あとはさ、あの長いやつ。思い出したら……、ああもう！:
And then there was that
long one. Just thinking
about it... Ugh, geez!
translations.リンコからも何度もしちゃったり……。:
And I've ended up kissing
you a bunch of times, too...
translations.リンコからも何度もしちゃったことも、あったっけ……。:
There was even that time I
kept kissing you over and
over, huh...
translations.そういえば……。▲小早川＊▲は何か一緒にしたいことって、ある？:
Come to think of it...
Is there anything you want
to do together, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.……旅行行きたい。例えば……その、泊まりとかで。:
...I want to go on a trip.
Like... you know, an
overnight one.
translations.……旅行行きたい。: ...I want to go on a trip.
translations.旅行行きたい。また二人でさ。:
I want to go on a trip.
Just the two of us again.
translations.そっか、楽しかったもんな。: Right, we had a lot of fun.
translations.うん。だから、また行きたい。:
Yeah. That's why I want to
go again.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。アンタが選んだんだから、ちゃんと見てよね、水着。:
▲主人公＊▲. You're the one
who picked this swimsuit,
so you'd better look.
translations.ああ、もちろん！ いいぞ、▲小早川＊▲。似合ってる!!:
Yeah, of course! Looking
good, ▲小早川＊▲. It really
suits you!!
translations.アンタ、ほんとにこういうのが好きなの？ なんか変態っぽくない？:
You really like stuff like
this？ Isn't it kind of
pervy？
translations.違う！ これで▲小早川＊▲の魅力が倍増するんだ!!:
Not at all! This makes
you twice as appealing,
▲小早川＊▲!!
translations.はいはい、おだてられてあげる。悪い気はしないし。:
Yeah, yeah, I'll let you
flatter me. It doesn't
feel bad, anyway.
translations.お風呂入ってくるけど。……のぞかないでよ。:
I'm going to take a bath.
...Don't peek, okay？
translations.お風呂入ってくるけど。: I'm going to take a bath.
translations.風呂上がりなんだから、しょうがないじゃん。:
I just got out of the bath.
What do you expect？
translations.きゃっ！ バカ、入ってくんな！:
Eek! Idiot, don't come in
here!
translations.……一緒に入りたい、とか？ 別にいいけど。:
...Did you want to join me
or something？ I don't mind.
translations.絶対、変なこと考えてた。:
You were definitely
thinking about something
weird.
translations.あのさ、知ってる？ 最近ハマってるゲーム。:
Hey, you know that game
I've been into lately？
translations.違う。ぱずるだまって、パズルゲーム。:
No. It's a puzzle game
called Puzzle Dama.
translations.そっか、じゃあ今度やってみるか。:
I see. Maybe I'll give it a
try sometime.
translations.あのさ、これからも……リンコ、カノジョでいていいのかな？:
Hey, um... Can I keep
being your girlfriend from
now on？
translations.そりゃそうだけどさ。まあいっか、リンコがそうさせてやるから。:
Well, yeah, I guess.
Whatever, I'll just make
sure it stays that way.
translations.気の利いたこと言えっつーの！ しょうがないなあ、もう。:
Can't you say something
nice for once! Jeez,
you're hopeless.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ありがと、リンコのそばにいてくれて……。:
▲主人公＊▲. Thanks for
staying by my side...
translations.あのさ、好きな人ができた。: Listen, there's someone I like now.
translations.……あ！ なんだ、ミュージシャンのことか。: ...Oh! Come on, you mean a musician.
translations.え……じゃあ、小説の登場人物とか。ゲームのキャラクターとか。: Wait... Then a character from a novel？ Or a game character or something？
translations.（▲小早川＊▲……さっきの、どういうことなんだ？）: (▲小早川＊▲... What was that about earlier？)
translations.さっきの、どういう意味なんだ？: What did you mean back there？
translations.心当たり、ないわけ？ はあ……リンコ、アンタのことが心配だよ。: You really have no idea？ Sigh... I'm worried about you.
translations.なんだよ、それ。心配なのはこっちだ。: What's that supposed to mean？ I'm the one who's worried here.
translations.……ごめん。そんな真剣になるなんて。: ...Sorry. I didn't think you'd take it so seriously.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲……ダメだ、気になって何もできない）: (▲小早川＊▲... No good, it's bothering me too much to do anything.)
translations.まずは落ち着いて。目、閉じて。: Calm down first. Close your eyes.
translations.ほんと、ごめん。まさか……さ。: I'm really sorry. I just never thought...
translations.「好きな人ができた」「おいおい、エイプリ・フールだろ！」……ってなるかと。: I figured I'd say, 'There's someone I like,' and you'd go, 'Come on, it's April Fools'!' ...or something.
translations.かなりね。でもそういうとこも、嫌いじゃないよ。ごめん、これで許して。: Pretty much. But I don't dislike that about you. Sorry, hope this makes up for it.
translations.ああそっか、ゴールデンウィークか。それが？: Oh right, Golden Week. What about it？
translations.ゴールデンウィークっていうか、３日から５日までの３日間だけど。: Well, not all of Golden Week, just the three days from the 3rd to the 5th.
translations.その間に毎日、長く続くキスをすると、二人の仲が急に進むんだってさ。: They say if you share a long kiss every day during those three days, you'll suddenly get a lot closer.
translations.わかるでしょ、あれだって。: You know the one I mean.
translations.ばか、本気にすんなっつーの。:
Idiot, don't take it
so seriously.
translations.（じゃあなんでそんな話したんだ？）:
(Then why'd she even
bring it up？)
translations.ゴールデンウィークのキス。覚えてないの？:
The Golden Week kiss.
Don't you remember？
translations.こんなので、何かが変わるとは思えないけど。:
Not that I think something
like this changes anything.
translations.（でもなんか▲小早川＊▲ともっと親密になれた気がする……）:
(Still, I feel like I got
closer to ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.別に気にしてないから、いいんだけどさ。:
I don't really care that
you didn't, so it's fine.
translations.ゴールデンウィークのキス。やっぱ忘れてたんだ。:
The Golden Week kiss.
I knew you forgot.
translations.だから、気にしてないっつーの。: I told you, I don't care.
translations.（今日はプール開きだ。別の学年と合同だから、▲小早川＊▲とも……）:
(The pool opens today.
It's a joint class with
▲小早川＊▲'s grade, so...)
translations.意味わかんないっつーの。はっきり言えば？:
What does that even mean？
Just say it straight.
translations.この中で、▲小早川＊▲が一番かわいいぞ。:
Out of everyone here,
you're the cutest,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……他人と比べられても、うれしくないし。:
...Getting compared to
others doesn't make me
happy, you know.
translations.見てない！ ……えっと、じろじろは見てない。たぶん。:
I wasn't! ...Well, I
wasn't staring. Probably.
translations.それ以上、近づくと蹴るよ。:
Come any closer and
I'll kick you.
translations.あと他の女子のこと凝視したら、先生にセクハラで訴えるから。:
And if you stare at other
girls, I'll report you for
sexual harassment.
translations.蹴られる方が、マシか？:
Is getting kicked the
better option here？
translations.へへ。学校のプールでってのも、新鮮だね。:
Hehe. Being at the school
pool like this feels kind
of fresh, huh？
translations.あんまり見ないでよ。周りにみんないるんだから。:
Don't stare so much.
Everyone's around.
translations.暇ならさ、付き合ってよ。:
If you're free, come
keep me company.
translations.ああ、何すんの？ タイムでも計るか？:
Sure, doing what？ Want me
to time your laps？
translations.やだよ、めんどくさい。読書。図書委員らしいでしょ。:
No way, too much work.
Reading. Very library
committee of me, right？
translations.だってみんなプールで遊んでるだけだしさ。なら何したっていいじゃん。:
Everyone's just messing
around in the pool anyway.
So I can do whatever, right？
translations.（それは違うだろ……）:
(Pretty sure that's not
how it works...)
translations.アンタさ、どれくらい水に潜ってられる？:
Hey, how long can you hold
your breath underwater？
translations.さあ……どうだろう。１分ぐらいか？:
Hmm... I don't know.
Maybe a minute or so？
translations.じゃあさ、３分潜ってみて。成功したら、図書室に置いてるポテチあげる。:
Then try for three minutes.
If you make it, you can have
my chips in the library.
translations.はあ、なんで３倍!? あと報酬少ない！:
What, three times as long！？
And that reward is tiny!
translations.文句言わない！ ほらほら。:
No complaining!
Come on, get in there.
translations.リンコってさ。やっぱ子供っぽいよね？:
I really do look kind of
childish, don't I？
translations.え？ なんでそんなこと聞くんだよ。: Huh？ Why do you ask that？
translations.だってみんな同じ水着着てると……見た目が、さ。:
Well, with everyone in the
same swimsuit... you know,
how I look and all.
translations.そうか？ ▲小早川＊▲以外見てないから、わかんなかった。:
Really？ I wasn't looking at
anyone besides you, ▲小早川＊▲,
so I couldn't tell.
translations.へへ、かっこつけんなっつーの。:
Heh, quit trying to
sound so cool.
translations.プール、めんどくさいって思ってたけど、結構いいね。ほとんど自由時間だし。:
I thought pool class would be
a pain, but I kinda like it.
It's almost all free time.
translations.充分休んだし、たまには泳ごうかな。:
I've rested plenty, so maybe
I'll actually swim for once.
translations.しないっつーの。ほら、行くよ。: As if. Come on, let's go.
translations.悪い。そんなに驚くとは。:
Sorry. Didn't think I'd
startle you that badly.
translations.呼吸止まるかと思った。……だからさ、人工呼吸してよ。:
I almost stopped breathing.
...So come on, give me
mouth-to-mouth.
translations.ばーか！ 嘘に決まってるっつーの。ばーかばーか！:
Idiot! Obviously I'm kidding.
Stupid, stupid!
translations.（よっぽど驚いたんだな……）:
(Guess I really caught her
off guard...)
translations.……した。仕返しにくすぐってやる。:
...You did. Now I'm gonna
tickle you to get even.
translations.わっ、おい！ 大声で変なこと言うなって！:
Whoa, hey! Don't yell stuff
like that out loud!
translations.ああ、そういえばそうだな。:
Oh yeah, now that you
mention it.
translations.やっぱさ、小さい子がいる家は笹飾って願い事するのかな。:
I guess families with little
kids decorate bamboo grass
and make wishes, huh.
translations.そうだな……。まあ、やるところが多いんじゃないか？:
Probably... I bet a lot of
families do that, right？
translations.そっか。小早川家にも弟がいるもんな。:
Oh, right. You've got a
little brother at home, too.
translations.なあ、さっきの七夕の話。何悩んでるんだ？:
Hey, about Tanabata earlier.
What are you torn about？
translations.だってさ……、リンコが短冊に願い事って、似合わなくない？:
I mean... Me, writing wishes
on paper strips？ Doesn't
really suit me, does it？
translations.そう、かな？ ▲小早川＊▲って、意外とそういうの好きだったりするじゃん。:
You think？ You actually kind
of like that stuff, don't
you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.色々ひっかかる言い方だけど……リンコにはリンコの線引きがあるの。:
I take issue with how you
put that... Look, I have my
own lines to draw.
translations.ふーん。で、弟のために付き合うか悩んでるのか。:
Huh. So you're debating
whether to play along for
your brother's sake.
translations.そう。情とアティチュードのせめぎ合いなの。:
Right. It's a clash between
sentiment and attitude.
translations.よくわかんないな。どういうこと？:
I don't really get it.
What do you mean？
translations.それは……こだわりってのは、説明しずらいもんなの！:
Well... Personal principles
are hard to explain!
translations.ねえ、七夕さ。やっぱやることにしたよ。:
Hey, about Tanabata. I
decided to do it after all.
translations.そっか。喜ぶといいな。: I see. Hope he likes it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って。弟相手だとやっぱ大人なんだな。:
You really act like the
grown-up around your little
brother, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.いつでもフツーに大人じゃん？ ちゃんとカレシもいるしさ。:
I'm always plenty grown-up,
aren't I？ I even have a
boyfriend and everything.
translations.じゃあ、●のおかげでもあるのか。:
Guess that's partly thanks
to ●, then.
translations.調子のって。でもまあ、そうかもね。感謝してるから、お礼。:
Don't let it go to your
head. Still, maybe so. I
appreciate it, so...thanks.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。いきなり行っちゃうことないだろ。せっかく会えたのに。:
▲小早川＊▲. You don't have to
just run off like that. We
finally got to hang out.
translations.別にいつでも会えるじゃん。:
It's not like we can't see
each other whenever.
translations.やれやれ、カレシが寂しがりやだからさ……。:
Good grief, having a needy
boyfriend is such work...
translations.じゃあいいじゃん。暇つぶしの相手ぐらいして。:
Then what's the problem？
At least help me kill some
time.
translations.なんとなく、来た。たまにはいいでしょ？:
Just felt like coming by.
That's fine once in a while,
right？
translations.……って思ってた。違う？:
...is what you were just
thinking. Am I wrong？
translations.同じこと考えてたから。:
'Cause I was thinking the
exact same thing.
translations.あんま暗い顔しないでよ、こっちまで暗くなるから。:
Don't look so gloomy.
You're bringing me down too.
translations.あー、悪い。でも来たくないだろ、やっぱ。:
Ah, my bad. Still, you don't
wanna be here either, right？
translations.当然。言ってもしょうがないんだから、言わないで。:
Obviously. Complaining won't
change anything, so drop it.
translations.ねえ、ゲーセン行こっか？: Hey, wanna go to the arcade？
translations.いきなりそれかよ。:
Well, that came out of
nowhere.
translations.アンタ結構練習してたもんね。:
You did put in a lot of
practice, after all.
translations.ご苦労様って感じだけど、せっかくだから結果も出しといたら？ 一応見ておくから。:
Sounds like a pain, but why
not go for a win while you're
at it？ I'll be watching.
translations.あのさ、ほんとは出たくないんだけど、二人三脚押し付けられちゃって。:
So, I really don't want to,
but I got roped into doing
the three-legged race.
translations.はは、そっか。まあ諦めてがんばれ。:
Haha, I see. Well, just
accept your fate and do
your best.
translations.じゃなくて、相手も探さなきゃいけなくて。:
No, that's not it. I have to
find a partner, too.
translations.ああ、そういうことか。よし、じゃあ一緒に出るか。:
Oh, that's what you mean.
Alright, wanna team up then？
translations.当たり前だろ。じゃあ、軽く練習しとくか。:
Of course. Come on, let's
get a quick practice in.
translations.ん、何？ ほら、行くぞ。:
Hm？ What was that？
Come on, let's go.
translations.なんでもない！ ……ったく、はりきっちゃってさ。:
Nothing! ...Geez, look at
you getting all fired up.
translations.はあ、ビリって……。リンコたち、ひょっとして相性悪い？:
Sigh, dead last... Do we
just have bad chemistry？
translations.息は合ってたと思うぞ。それよりは、体力の問題だな。:
I think we were in sync.
It was more of a stamina
issue.
translations.リンコの、ね。アンタはがんばってたのに。:
Mine, you mean. Even though
you were trying so hard.
translations.いいよ。これはこれで思い出になったからさ。:
Don't worry about it. It
still made for a good memory.
translations.▲小早川＊▲とだったら、それも悪くないな。:
If it's with you, ▲小早川＊▲,
even that's not so bad.
translations.何それ？ マゾ？:
What's that supposed to
mean？ Are you a masochist？
translations.なんでそうなるんだよ！:
How do you get that from
what I said？!
translations.冗談。ありがと、助けてくれてうれしかったよ……。:
Just kidding. Thanks. I was
really glad you helped me...
translations.ハロウィンってさ、なんかやるの？:
Hey, are you doing anything
for Halloween？
translations.ああ、そういえば今日か。何かする予定はないな。:
Oh right, that's today.
I don't really have any
plans.
translations.だよね。仮装とか、結構めんどくさいしさ。:
Right？ Dressing up and all
that is kind of a hassle.
translations.そうかもしれないけど……できたらできたで楽しいかもな。:
Maybe so... Though if we
actually did it, it might
be fun.
translations.なんで？ ▲小早川＊▲は何か予定あるのか？:
Why？ Do you have plans or
something, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ないけど……どうしよっかな。:
Not really... Wonder what
I should do.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ どうしたんだよ、急に。:
▲小早川＊▲？ What are you
doing here all of a sudden？
translations.何、来ちゃダメ？:
What, am I not allowed to
come over？
translations.そういうわけじゃないけど。とりあえずあがれって。:
That's not what I meant.
Anyway, come on in.
translations.で、どうしたんだ。今日って何かあったっけ？:
So, what's up？ Was there
something going on today？
translations.まあ。ちょっと準備してくる。こっち来ないで。:
Sort of. I'm gonna go get
ready. Don't come over here.
translations.えっと、なんだっけ。お菓子くれなきゃ、小キック！:
Um, how did it go again？
Give me candy, or you get
a light kick!
translations.お菓子のかわりのものでもいいけど……。:
Something instead of candy
would be fine too, though...
translations.へへ、びっくりしたでしょ？:
Hehe, I surprised you,
didn't I？
translations.そりゃあ……。ハロウィンの話で考え込んでたのは、これだったのか。:
Well, yeah... So this is
what you were thinking about
when Halloween came up.
translations.まあね。リンコは結構楽しかったよ。アンタは？:
Yeah. I actually had a lot
of fun. How about you？
translations.●は楽しかったっていうか……。:
● wouldn't say it was fun,
exactly...
translations.恥ずかしいというか、ドキドキしたというか……。:
More like embarrassing...
or it had my heart racing...
translations.それしかないのかっつーの……。:
Is that seriously all you've
got to say...？
translations.押しかけといて、送らせちゃった。ごめんね。:
I barged in on you and even
made you walk me home.
Sorry about that.
translations.いいよ、そんなの。じゃあ、またな。:
Don't worry about it.
See you later.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲のクラス、のぞいてみるか……）:
(Maybe I'll go check out
▲小早川＊▲'s class...)
translations.……よっ。そっちのクラス、何やってるんだ？:
...Hey. What's your class
doing for the festival？
translations.とわの市の歴史資料展示。:
An exhibit on Towano City's
historical records.
translations.いーじゃん、楽だし。アンタ運営委員だっけ。忙しい？:
Who cares？ It's easy. You're
on the steering committee,
right？ Keeping busy？
translations.当日はそんなに仕事ないんだ、●は。:
On the actual day, ●
don't have that much work.
translations.ところでその格好、何？:
By the way, what's with
that outfit？
translations.準備全部サボってたら、先生に客引きやらされた。つまんない展示の客引きとかほんと最:
I skipped all the prep, so I
got stuck luring people into
a dull exhibit. The worst...
translations.（可哀想に……でも自業自得か）:
(Poor thing... Though she did
bring it on herself.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。服、着替えたんだな。:
▲小早川＊▲. You changed your
clothes, huh.
translations.当たり前だっつーの。もう忘れて。:
Well, obviously. Just forget
you ever saw that.
translations.でもさ、文化祭自体は成功じゃん？ アンタたちのおかげで。:
Still, the festival itself
was a big hit, right？ Thanks
to you guys.
translations.●のおかげかどうかはわかんないけど、ひとまずよかったよ。:
Not sure how much ● had
to do with it, but I'm glad
it went well.
translations.ふーん。あのさ、ちょっと付き合って。:
Right. Hey, come with me
for a minute.
translations.ちょっと一緒に行ってほしいところ、あるから。:
There's somewhere I want you
to go with me real quick.
translations.誰もいないな。この屋上、いい場所なのにあんまり人気ないよな。:
Nobody's here. This roof's a
really nice spot, but nobody
ever seems to come up here.
translations.うん。だから……あのときもここに呼び出した。:
Yeah. That's why... I asked
you to meet me here back
then, too.
translations.好きな場所だし、誰にも邪魔されないし、だからここで……好きって言った。:
I like it up here, and no one
bothers you. That's why I...
told you I liked you here.
translations.ここに来る度に思い出しちゃうから。気軽に来れなくなって、いい迷惑だよ。:
Now I think of it every time
I come up here. I can't just
relax anymore. What a pain.
translations.はは。それ、●が悪いのか？:
Haha. Wait, did ● do
something wrong？
translations.それは、どうでもいいや。それより……今もまた思い出してる。:
Whatever, that doesn't
matter. Besides... I'm
thinking about it right now.
translations.あのときと同じこと、していい？: Can I do the same thing as back then？
translations.うん。今日から夏期講習か。はあ……。: Yeah. Summer classes start today, huh. *Sigh*...
translations.なに他人事みたいなこと言ってんの。: You say that like it's not your problem too.
translations.ねえ、どうしたら夏期講習なくなるかな。アンタが今から学校の窓ガラス全部割るとか？: Hey, what would it take to get summer classes canceled？ Maybe you could go smash all the school windows right now？
translations.夏期講習どころか、●の学生生活が終わるって。: Forget summer classes, ● wouldn't have a school life anymore.
translations.おはよ。夏期講習、早く終わるといいね！: Morning. Sure hope summer classes end soon!
translations.うん。夏期講習、もうやだ。: Yeah. I'm already sick of summer classes.
translations.もう、っていうか。最初からいやがってたような。: Already？ Pretty sure you hated them from the start.
translations.あつい。なんで暑いときにわざわざ夏期講習やんの？: It's hot. Why do they go out of their way to hold summer classes when it's this hot？
translations.おはよ。夏期講習飽きた。サボろ？: Morning. I'm bored of summer classes. Wanna skip？
translations.気持ちはわかるけど、がまんしろって。: I know how you feel, but just tough it out.
translations.うん。知ってた？ 今日から冬期講習らしいよ。: Yeah. Did you know？ Apparently winter classes start today.
translations.？ ああ。だから、ここにいるんだろ？: ？ Yeah. Isn't that why we're here？
translations.なんだ、やっぱ現実か……。: Aw, so this really is reality...
translations.リンコさ、冬期講習受けたがってるように見える？: Do I look like I want to take winter classes to you？
translations.だったら今日までになんとかしてくれればよかったのに。理不尽だよ……。: Then you should've done something about them before today. It's so unreasonable...
translations.おはよ。今日から冬期講習です。マル？ バツ？: Morning. True or false: winter classes start today.
translations.うん。ねえ、寒い中、朝起きた時点でもう講習クリアしてない？:
Yeah. Hey, doesn't getting
up in the freezing cold
count as passing already？
translations.うん。いい、言ってみただけ。:
Yeah. Never mind,
I was just saying.
translations.リンコ、風邪ひいたかも。: I think I caught a cold.
translations.え？ 来て大丈夫なのか？:
Huh？ Are you okay
to be here？
translations.……ごめん、嘘。お母さんも騙されてくれればよかったのに。:
...Sorry, I lied. I wish
Mom had fallen for it too.
translations.できもしないこと言わないでよ。:
Don't say that when
you know I can't.
translations.うん。今日から春期講習か。何回ぐらい居眠りするんだろ……。:
Yeah. Spring classes start
today. Wonder how many
times I'll doze off...
translations.とりあえず、居眠りするのは前提なんだな。:
So dozing off is
already a given, huh.
translations.よーし、春期講習。今日からがんばる！:
All right, spring classes.
I'm gonna try hard today!
translations.おはよ。今日から春期講習だね。明日ぐらいには終わってるかな？:
Morning. Spring classes
start today. Think they'll
be over by tomorrow？
translations.さすがに、そこまで短くはないな。:
I don't think they're
quite that short.
translations.そうだよね。何度も確認したもん。:
I know. I checked
plenty of times.
translations.うん。今日こそ眠らないようにするよ。:
Yeah. I'm definitely staying
awake in class today.
translations.前回もそう思ってたんだけどね。:
I told myself that
last time too, though.
translations.おはよ。講習もそろそろ終わりだね。:
Morning. Classes are
almost over, huh.
translations.まあ……そうかな？ 名残惜しいか。:
Yeah, I guess so.
Gonna miss them？
translations.そういえば、▲小早川＊▲。コンテストのこと聞いた？:
By the way, ▲小早川＊▲,
hear about the contest？
translations.別にリンコには関係ないし。:
It's got nothing to do
with me, anyway.
translations.意外と▲小早川＊▲が選ばれるかもしれないぞ？:
They might actually pick
you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.水着コンテスト。▲小早川＊▲が優勝だって。:
The swimsuit contest.
Heard you took first, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.嬉しく……はないか。:
Guess you're not...
too thrilled, huh.
translations.見世物みたいでやだ。:
I hate feeling like
I'm on display.
translations.やじゃないの？ カノジョがさ。:
Doesn't it bother you？
With your girlfriend, I mean.
translations.複雑だけど……いいじゃん、カノジョの自慢が増えるってことで。:
I have mixed feelings...
but hey, I get to brag
about my girlfriend more.
translations.お疲れ。ちゃんとやってんじゃん。: Good work. Looks like you're actually doing your job.
translations.へへ。遊びに来たよ。: Hehe. Just came by to see you.
translations.誰に聞いてる？ 調子いいもんね。: Who do you think you're asking？ I'm doing great.
translations.まあ、いい感じ。心配しないでよ。: Pretty good, I guess. Don't worry about me.
translations.なんか調子出ない。すぐ治ると思うけど。: I'm feeling a bit off. Should be fine soon, though.
translations.ついで。それだけ。: I was in the area. That's all.
translations.リンコのカレシはどうしてるかなって。: Just wondering how my boyfriend was doing.
translations.様子見に来た。あとは……会いたかったから。: Came to check on you. And... because I wanted to see you.
translations.なんとなく。……じゃなくて、なんとなく会いたくなっただけ。: Just because. ...Wait, no. I just kind of wanted to see you, that's all.
translations.会いたくなったの。それで、じゅーぶんでしょ？: I wanted to see you. Isn't that reason enough？
translations.いつも仕事押し付けてるしさ。はい、差し入れ。: Since I'm always dumping work on you. Here, brought you something.
translations.差し入れ。そんなに、いいもんじゃないけど。: Brought you a little something. It's nothing special, though.
translations.いつもがんばってるみたいだしさ。ほら、使って。: Looks like you're always working hard, so... Here, use this.
translations.じゃあ、こっちも仕事あるから。: Well, I've got work of my own to do.
translations.はい、仕事戻る。リンコも暇じゃないし。: All right, back to work. I'm not exactly free either.
translations.じゃあ、戻るから。仕事がんばろ。: Well, I'm heading back. Let's both do our best.
translations.じゃあ、邪魔しないように帰る。: Well, I'll head out so I don't get in your way.
translations.邪魔したくないし、帰る。それじゃ。: I don't want to get in your way, so I'll head home. See ya.
translations.じゃあもう行くね。がんばって。: Well, I'm gonna get going. Keep at it.
translations.なんで？ 今日、何かあったっけ？: Why？ Was there something special about today？
translations.なんか悪くない？ リンコばっかり。: Isn't this kinda unfair？ I'm always the one getting stuff.
translations.こういうとこマメだよね。いいと思うけど？: You're always on top of things like this. I think it's nice, though.
translations.開けていいんだよね、これ。: I can open this now, right？
translations.やるじゃん！ もう、抜け目ないなあ。: Nice one! Man, you really don't miss a beat.
translations.へー、悪くないじゃん、もらっとく。: Huh, not bad at all. I'll take it.
translations.うわ。一応もらっとく。サンキュー。: Whoa. Well, I'll take it anyway. Thanks.
translations.まあ、これ。お返しだから。: Well, here. Just paying you back.
translations.こっちも用意してるって。気に入るかわかんないけど。: I got something for you, too. Don't know if you'll like it, though.
translations.こういう記念、大事にするのもいいかも。: Cherishing special days like this might not be so bad.
translations.……わかんない？ 最近さ、ちょっと冷たいよね。:
...Can't you tell？
You've been a bit cold
lately.
translations.ノリとかいいから。もっとちゃんとしてよ。:
Forget playing along.
Take this seriously.
translations.（うーん、今日はほんとに機嫌が悪い。たしかに最近冷たくしてたかも……）:
(Man, she's in a really bad
mood today. I guess I have
been a bit cold lately...)
translations.しょうがないじゃん。カノジョなんだから……。:
I can't help it.
I'm your girlfriend...
translations.……今回だけ。今回だけだから、調子のったりしないで。:
...Just this once.
Only this once, so don't
push your luck.
translations.わかってるって。反省した！:
I know, I know.
I've learned my lesson!
translations.どうしたじゃないっつーの。最近さ、カレシとしてどうなの？:
Don't 'what's up' me.
What kind of boyfriend have
you been lately？
translations.えっと……機嫌悪い？: Uh... Are you in a bad mood？
translations.悪いのはリンコの機嫌じゃなくて、アンタの態度でしょ。:
What's bad isn't my mood,
it's your attitude.
translations.あーもう、ダメ。やっぱりダメ！:
Ugh, no.
I just can't let this go!
translations.なんで。いいだろ、これぐらい。:
Why？
Come on, it's no big deal.
translations.よくない、バカ！: It is a big deal, idiot!
translations.やだ、許さない。: No way. I won't forgive you.
translations.許さないけど……許したくないけど、もう……許す。:
I won't... I don't want to
forgive you, but ugh...
I forgive you.
translations.許す！ 許せばいいんでしょ……。:
I forgive you!
That's what you want,
right...？
translations.気のせいかな。最近さ、冷たくされてる気がする。:
Maybe I'm imagining things.
I feel like you've been cold
to me lately.
translations.え……。あー、気のせいじゃない？:
Huh...？ Uh, aren't you
just imagining things？
translations.お願い。もう一度、ちゃんと答えて。:
Please. Give me a real
answer this time.
translations.だって、不安なくならないんだもん……。:
Because this uneasy feeling
won't go away...
translations.……しょうがないよね。長く付き合ってれば、そういうこともあるよね。:
...It can't be helped, huh.
When you date for a long
time, these things happen.
translations.ああ。こういうこともあるって。だから今回は、な？:
Yeah. Stuff like this
happens. So let it go
this time, okay？
translations.うん……しょうがないから。:
Fine... I guess it can't
be helped.
translations.（あ、▲小早川＊▲……。まだ怒ってるかな？）:
(Oh, ▲小早川＊▲...
I wonder if she's still mad？)
translations.リンコまだ、そんな気分じゃない。:
I'm still not in the mood
for that.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。あのさ、デートに行こうよ。:
▲小早川＊▲. Hey, let's
go on a date.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。あのさ、デートに……。:
▲小早川＊▲. Hey, let's
go on a date...
translations.ううん。行きたくない。: No. I don't want to go.
translations.（電話だ……。あ、▲小早川＊▲。もう、怒ってないのかな？）:
(My phone... Oh, ▲小早川＊▲.
Is she not mad anymore？)
translations.あのさ、デートの約束のことなんだけど。:
Hey, about that date we
had planned.
translations.デートの約束。あれ、なし。:
That date we planned.
It's off.
translations.じゃ、用件終わり。:
Anyway, that's all I
called to say.
translations.ねえ、今度のデートの約束。覚えてるよね。:
Hey, you remember the date
we have coming up, right？
translations.そっか。でもあれ、キャンセルしたい。それじゃ。:
I see. Well, I want to
cancel it. Bye.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。あのさ、今から会えない？:
▲小早川＊▲. Hey, can we
meet up right now？
translations.今から会えない。この先も会えない。……かもね。:
I can't meet you now. Or
ever again. ...Maybe.
translations.一生懸命さ。バッカみたい。:
Trying so hard. You look
like an idiot.
translations.こんなときでも、手は抜かないんだ。:
Even at a time like this,
you don't slack off, huh.
translations.そのやる気をもう少しさ……。:
Wish you'd use some of
that motivation on...
translations.一応、よかったじゃん。: Well, good for you, I guess.
translations.（あ、▲小早川＊▲だ……。まだ怒ってるかな？）:
(Oh, it's ▲小早川＊▲...
Wonder if she's still mad？)
translations.話すこと、ないから。: I have nothing to say to you.
translations.うん、知ってる。がんばっちゃってさ。:
Yeah, I know.
You've been trying so hard.
translations.だってキツかったから。▲小早川＊▲とちゃんと話せないの。:
Because it was rough
not being able to talk
to you properly, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.もう、いいから。こんなのやめ。もう、やだ。:
It's fine already.
Let's stop doing this.
I hate it.
translations.ああ。じゃあ仲直りだな。:
Yeah. Guess we're
making up, then.
translations.がんばりすぎだっつーの。それでいいんだけど。:
You've been trying way too
hard. Not that I mind.
translations.ああ、どうしたら▲小早川＊▲に許してもらえるかって……。:
Yeah, I just wanted you
to forgive me, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.極端すぎ。普段からもっとちゃんとしてればいいだけじゃん。:
You go way overboard.
Just do things right
the first time.
translations.そうだな、反省した。:
You're right.
I learned my lesson.
translations.いいよ。こっちも充分仕返ししたし。……結構無理して。:
It's fine. I got you back
plenty. ...Even if I had
to push myself to do it.
translations.あーもう、ばか。これで許したなんて、思わないで。:
Ugh, you idiot.
Don't think this means
I've forgiven you.
translations.見てた。リンコのために。:
I saw. You did all that
for me.
translations.ああ、早く▲小早川＊▲と仲直りしたくて。:
Yeah, I wanted to make up
with you as soon as I could,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.うん、ありがとう。リンコももう、限界だった。:
Yeah, thanks.
I was at my limit, too.
translations.当たり前じゃん。寂しくないわけないじゃん。:
Obviously. How could I
not be lonely？
translations.ごめん。もうあんな思い、させないから。:
I'm sorry. I won't put you
through that again.
translations.はあっ？ なんで……。えっと、入って。:
Huh？ Why are you...
Um, come in.
translations.お見舞いに来たぞ。いい子にしてたか？:
I came to check on you.
Been a good girl？
translations.なに、いい子って。いきなり来てさ……。:
"A good girl"？ You just
show up out of nowhere...
translations.もうだいぶ、いい。暇だったから、ちょうどよかった。:
I'm much better now. I was
bored, so it's good timing.
translations.悪い、長くなったな。そろそろ帰るわ。:
Sorry for staying so long.
I should get going.
translations.そういう意味じゃない。でも一応、ありがと。:
That's not what I meant.
But thanks, anyway.
translations.お、なんか元気そうだな。:
Oh, you look like you're
doing pretty well.
translations.まあね。お見舞いとか大げさだし。:
Yeah, well. Coming to visit
is making a big deal of it.
translations.迷惑じゃない。……わざわざありがと。:
You're not bothering me.
...Thanks for coming by.
translations.（なんか素直だな……。病気のせい？）:
(She's unusually honest...
Is it because she's sick？)
translations.いいでしょ、たまには。ほんとに、ちょっとうれしかったんだから。:
It's fine once in a while.
I really was a bit happy.
translations.結構時間経ったな。そろそろ帰るけど、また来てもいいか？:
It's getting late. I'll head
out, but can I come again？
translations.いちいち聞かなくていい。:
You don't have to ask
every time.
translations.そっか、じゃあな。早く治せよ。:
Got it. See you later.
Get well soon.
translations.えっ？ は、入っちゃダメ！ …………いいよ。:
Huh？ D-don't come in!
...Okay, come in.
translations.どうだ、大丈夫か？:
How are you doing？
Are you okay？
translations.うん、もうだいぶよくなった。退屈してた。:
Yeah, I'm much better now.
I was getting bored.
translations.うん。……へへ、来てくれたね？:
Yeah. ...Hehe, you came
to see me, huh？
translations.当たり前だろ、心配したんだから。:
Of course I did.
I was worried about you.
translations.そろそろ帰るか。長居すると悪いしな。:
I should get going soon.
It's bad if I stay too long.
translations.帰っちゃやだ。: I don't want you to go.
translations.そういうわけにもいかないだろ。まずはちゃんと治せって。:
I can't really do that.
Get yourself better first.
translations.うん……また来てくれる？:
Okay...
Will you come by again？
translations.ああ。だから今日はがまんな。じゃあ。:
Yeah. So just hang in there
for today, okay？ See ya.
translations.といっても部屋から出るわけにはいかないし。:
Yeah, well, it's not like
you can leave your room.
translations.そこをなんとか。お母さん説得してきてよ。:
Come on, do something.
Go talk my mom into it.
translations.わがまま言うなって。元気そうだけど、一応病人だろ。:
Don't be difficult. You seem
fine, sure, but you're still sick.
translations.ねえ、何度もお見舞い来てるけど、暇なの？:
Hey, you've come to visit me
a lot. Got nothing better to do？
translations.暇じゃなくても来るよ。:
I'd come even if I didn't
have free time.
translations.顔赤いぞ？ 大丈夫か？:
Your face is red. Are you
okay？
translations.あーもう、うるさい！ わかれっつーの。:
Ugh, shut up! Take a hint,
will you？
translations.ねえ、そんなにリンコのこと心配？ 早くよくなってほしい？:
Hey, are you really that worried
about me？ Do you want me to
get better soon？
translations.へへ、聞きたくなっただけ。: Hehe, I just felt like asking.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。もう治ったのか？:
▲小早川＊▲. Are you all better
now？
translations.大げさ過ぎ。ただの風邪じゃん？:
You're making a big deal out
of nothing. It was just a cold.
translations.こじらせたら大変だろ。素直に喜ばせてくれって。:
It'd be bad if it got worse.
Just let me be happy for you.
translations.しょーがないな。心配性のじじいはさ。:
Guess I can't stop you.
Such a worrywart of an old man.
translations.見りゃわかるじゃん？:
Can't you tell just by
looking？
translations.はは、そうだな。完全復活だな。:
Haha, true. You're completely
back to normal.
translations.あとさ、一応、お見舞いありがと。:
Also, well... thanks for
coming to visit me.
translations.ん？ ああ、そんなの気にすんな。治ってよかった。:
Hm？ Oh, don't sweat it.
I'm just glad you're better.
translations.気にさせろっつーの。うれしかったんだから。:
Don't just brush it off.
It made me really happy.
translations.うん。きっとお見舞いのおかげだよ？:
Yeah. I bet it's because you
came to visit me.
translations.はは、そっか？ ▲小早川＊▲もちゃんとおとなしくしてたもんな。:
Haha, really？ Well, you did
stay put and rest, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.だってさ、早く遊びたいじゃん。:
Well yeah, I wanted to hang
out again as soon as possible.
translations.そうだな、なんでもできるぞ！:
Right! We can do whatever
we want now!
translations.でもさ。まずはアンタと、ね？:
Yeah, well... First, just
something with you, okay？
translations.そう、お見舞い。一応、カノジョだし？:
Yep, I came to check on you.
I am your girlfriend, after all.
translations.ありがとな、わざわざ家まで。:
Thanks for coming all the
way to my place.
translations.病人が気つかうなっつーの。:
You're the sick one here.
Stop worrying about me.
translations.はは、そうだな。でも来てくれてよかった、暇だったんだ。:
Haha, fair point. Still, I'm
glad you came. I was bored.
translations.あ、もうこんな時間。帰ったほうがいいよね。:
Oh, look at the time.
I should probably get going.
translations.もっといてもいいぞ？:
You can stay longer,
you know？
translations.そうしたいけど……。それで悪くなってもイヤじゃん。:
I'd like to, but...
I don't want you getting
worse because of me.
translations.早く治してよ。病気のせいで暇なの、アンタだけじゃないし。:
Get better soon, okay？
You're not the only one bored
because you're sick.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲のためにも、早く治さなくっちゃな）:
(I need to get better soon,
for ▲小早川＊▲'s sake too.)
translations.びっくりした。来てくれると思わなかったから。:
You surprised me.
I didn't expect you to come.
translations.なにそれ、そんな意外？:
What's that supposed to mean？
Is it really so surprising？
translations.そうじゃないけど、急だったからさ。:
Not like that, it was just
out of the blue.
translations.そっちの方がありがたみあるかなって。元気そうでよかった。:
I figured you'd appreciate it
more that way.
Glad you look okay.
translations.そろそろ帰る。安静にした方がいいし。:
I'll head out soon.
You should be resting.
translations.そんな気つかわなくても。:
You don't need to worry
about me that much.
translations.つかうっつーの。病人相手なんだし。:
Of course I do.
You're the one who's sick.
translations.そうなの。あんまカノジョに心配かけるの、よくないと思うけど？:
It is. Besides, I don't think
you should make your
girlfriend worry so much.
translations.へへ、来たよ？: Hehe, I came to see you.
translations.ちょうど暇だったんだ。うれしいよ。:
I was just sitting around
bored. I'm glad you came.
translations.まあ、ぼちぼち。だいぶ楽にはなったよ。:
Hangin' in there.
I feel a lot better now.
translations.ごめん、長居しちゃった。もう帰るね。:
Sorry, I stayed too long.
I'll head home now.
translations.ああ、ありがと。ほんと助かった。:
Yeah, thanks.
I really appreciate it.
translations.他にも助けてほしいことある？ 家事とかさ。:
Anything else you need help
with？ Like housework.
translations.え、それは大丈夫。間に合ってる。:
Uh, I'm good on that.
I can manage.
translations.……不安そうな顔すんなっつーの。ほんとにやばくなったら、声かけてね。じゃあ。:
...Quit looking so worried.
If things get really bad,
just call me. See ya.
translations.ねえ、リンコ邪魔じゃない？: Hey, am I in the way？
translations.まさか。来てくれてうれしいよ。:
No way.
I'm happy you came.
translations.んー、これもカレシの特権だな。:
Man, the perks of being
your boyfriend.
translations.幸せ者だね。病気になってもお見舞い来てくれる優しいカノジョがいてさ。:
You're a lucky guy, having a
sweet girlfriend who visits
you when you're sick.
translations.ああ、●は幸せ者だ。もう思い残すことはない……。:
Yeah, ● is one lucky
guy. I have no regrets left...
translations.あれ、悲しい気分になんない？:
Huh？ Doesn't that make you
feel sad？
translations.なんない。もしそんな状況になっても、リンコ置いて何してんだって、蹴ってやるから。:
Nope. If it came to that, I'd
kick you and ask what you think
you're doing leaving me behind.
translations.ねえ、なんかしたいことある？:
Hey, is there anything
you want to do？
translations.なあ、じゃない。そういうのは治ってから。: Don't give me that. Save that stuff for when you're better.
translations.悔しかったらさ、早く治してよ。: If you don't like it, hurry up and get better.
translations.お見舞いサンキュ。おかげで復活。: Thanks for coming to see me. I'm back on my feet thanks to you.
translations.あれ、反応うすいな。: Huh, that's a pretty lukewarm reaction.
translations.病気の間、暇してた分機嫌悪いの。早く治すこと。: I'm in a bad mood from being bored while you were sick. Better fix it fast.
translations.おかげで完全復活だ。今ならキックもよけられるぞ？: I'm completely recovered thanks to you. Bet I could even dodge your kicks now.
translations.病気してた間の分も、リンコのことかまうこと！: You have to make up for all the time you were sick and pay attention to me!
translations.もうすっかりよくなったぞ。▲小早川＊▲の見舞いのおかげだ。: I'm all better now. All thanks to your visit, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.へへ、やった。じゃあお返しに、デート連れてってよ。: Hehe, nice. Then take me on a date to pay me back.
translations.ああ、そうだな。どうしよっかな……。: Yeah, good idea. Let's see, what should we do...
translations.ね、ね、いつにする？: Hey, hey, when should we go？
translations.このゲームはＤＳ本体の時計に連動してるからさ、時間が合ってるか確認してからはじめ: This game is linked to your DS's clock, so make sure the time is right before you start.
translations.もし時間がずれてたら一度電源をＯＦＦにして、ＤＳ本体の時計を合わせてきて。: If the time is off, turn the power OFF and go set your DS's clock first.
translations.ゲームの時間をアンタの生活に合わせて決定して。でも、ど～してもって人だけだから。: Set the in-game time to match your schedule. Only if you really have to, though.
translations.ほんとにこれでいい？ あとから文句言わないこと。: Are you sure this is okay？ Don't go complaining about it later.
translations.そっか、よかった。じゃあ、またな。:
Oh, good. Well, see you
later.
translations.しょうがないな。いーよ。:
Guess it can't be helped.
Sure.
translations.サンキュ、助かる。じゃあ、またな。:
Thanks, you're a lifesaver.
See you later.
translations.いいよ。よかった、中止にならなくて。:
Sure. I'm glad we didn't
have to cancel.
translations.だな。じゃあ、そういうことだから。またな。:
Yeah, me too. Well, that's
settled, then. See ya.
translations.えっと……ごめん。やっぱなんでもないや。:
Um... Sorry. Never mind,
it's nothing.
translations.ふーん、別にいいけど。じゃあ。:
Oh. Doesn't really matter
to me. Bye.
translations.なにそれ？ 用がないなら、切るよ。じゃあ。:
What's with that？ If you
don't need anything, I'm
hanging up. Bye.
translations.まあ、いいけど。なんとかする。:
Well, I guess that's fine.
I'll make it work.
translations.ダメ。都合悪い。:
I can't. That doesn't work
for me.
translations.最近さ、図書館の本、返し忘れる人、多くない？: Don't you think a lot of people have been forgetting to return library books lately？
translations.気づいてないわけ？ 委員の仕事、まじめにやってんの？: You haven't noticed？ Are you even taking your library duty seriously？
translations.やってるって。ちゃんと顔を出してるだろ？: I am. I show up when I'm supposed to, don't I？
translations.顔出すだけじゃだめだっつーの。: Just showing up isn't enough, you know.
translations.それはいいとして、そんなに返し忘れる人、多いのか？: Anyway, are that many people really forgetting to return them？
translations.うん。図書館によく顔を出す人にはさ、リンコもそれとなく注意はするんだけど……。: Yeah. For the regulars who come in a lot, I try to drop a hint and remind them, but...
translations.そうか。このままだと、本が減っていくもんな。: I see. At this rate, we're just going to keep losing books.
translations.そう！ せっかく借りに行ったのにお目当ての本がないときのガッカリ感っていったら。: Right! There's nothing more disappointing than going to borrow a book you want and finding out it's not there.
translations.よし、●もなにか対策を考えてみるよ。: All right, ● will try to think of something we can do too.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。昨日さ、本を返さない人の教室、行ってきた。: ▲主人公＊▲. Yesterday I went to the classroom of someone with an overdue book.
translations.仕事熱心なんだな。: You're really dedicated to the job.
translations.だって、肝心なときにアンタいないし。: Well, you're never around when it actually counts.
translations.……ごめん。で、どうしたんだ？ 返してもらえたんだろ？: ...Sorry. So how did it go？ You got it back, right？
translations.うん。返してはもらえた。でも、相手がすっごいヤな奴だった。: Yeah, I got it back. But the person who had it was a total jerk.
translations.まさか、なにかされたのか？: Wait, did they do something to you？
translations.ふーん。一応心配してくれてるんだ？: Hmm. So you actually do worry about me？
translations.ありがと。でも、大丈夫。嫌味を言われただけ。: Thanks. I'm fine, though. They just made a snide remark.
translations.今日返すつもりだったのに、とかさ……ウソつくなっつーの。: Giving me that 'I was gonna return it today' excuse... Like, quit lying already.
translations.やっぱり借りる人の意識を変える方法を考えた方が、いいんじゃないか？: Maybe we should figure out a way to get people to be more mindful when they borrow books？
translations.あのさ、借りた本を返し忘れてる人の話だけど。: Hey, about those people who keep forgetting to return their books.
translations.また一人で返してもらいに行ったのか？: Did you go track them down by yourself again？
translations.うん。でもキリがないね。: Yeah. But there's just no end to it.
translations.きっと借りたこと自体、忘れてる人が多いんだろうな。: A lot of them probably forgot they even borrowed a book in the first place.
translations.図書館の本はみんなの物だってのに自覚がないんだよ。: They don't seem to realize that library books belong to everyone.
translations.まあ、そういう●も昔、借りたままずっと忘れてたことが……。: Well, to be fair, ● once borrowed a book and completely forgot about it too...
translations.それ、図書委員失格。: You're disqualified from the library committee.
translations.じゃあ、ポスターか何かで呼びかけたらどうだ？ 全校に呼びかければ、借りてたことを: Then how about putting up posters or something as a reminder？ If the whole school sees them, some people should remember they still have books out, right？
translations.……そっか。それいいかも。先輩たちにも一度相談してみる。: ...Oh. That might actually work. I'll try bringing it up with the upperclassmen.
translations.あのさ、この前、アンタがポスター作ったらどうかって話、したじゃん。: Hey, remember how you suggested making posters the other day？
translations.先輩たちと相談して、とりあえず簡単なもの廊下に張り出してみた。: I talked it over with the upperclassmen, and we put up some simple ones in the hallway for now.
translations.ああ、●も見た。図書館の入口のところに貼ってあるヤツだろ？: Yeah, ● saw it too. The one right by the library entrance, right？
translations.それが、あれだけでも結構効果あるみたい。: Actually, it seems like even just that is making a big difference.
translations.放課後になって、返却カウンターに列できてたもん。: There was a whole line at the return counter after school.
translations.そうか。それは良かったな。これで問題解決、か。: I see. That's great. Guess that solves the problem, then.
translations.そんなに簡単じゃないって。効果があるのは、今だけかもしれないし。: It's not that simple. It might only work for now, anyway.
translations.そっか。仕事熱心だな。▲小早川＊▲は。: I see. You're really dedicated to your job, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.バカじゃん。リンコは当たり前のことやってるだけ。でも……。: Don't be dumb. I'm just doing what I'm supposed to. Still...
translations.もっとがんばってほめてもらいたい、かも……へへ。: Maybe I'll work even harder so you'll praise me some more... Hehe.
translations.この前クラスの子が手作りのクッキー持ってきた。: A girl in my class brought in homemade cookies the other day.
translations.お菓子作りって女の子らしい趣味だな。: Baking sweets is a pretty girly hobby.
translations.でもさ、男子がみんな、デレデレしちゃってて、見てらんなかった。: Yeah, but all the boys were fawning over her. It was painful to watch.
translations.担任の先生まで、喜んで食べてるんだから、もう世も末だね。: Even our homeroom teacher was happily eating them. The world really is coming to an end.
translations.担任って男の先生だろ？ 男はそういうもんなんだから許してやれって。: Your homeroom teacher's a guy, right？ That's just how guys are, so cut them some slack.
translations.ただのクッキーだよ？ あんなの誰でも作れるじゃん。: They're just cookies, you know？ Anyone can make those.
translations.味よりも、手作りってところが重要なんだよ。: It's less about the taste and more about the fact that they're homemade.
translations.ふうん。アンタもそういうタイプの子が好きなんだ？: Hmm. So you're into that type of girl too？
translations.特にできないなりにも一生懸命作ってくれたりするとな。: Especially when she's not great at it, but still tries her hardest to make them.
translations.……なんでこっち見るの？ クッキーくらい作れるっつーの。: ...Why are you looking at me like that？ I can bake cookies, you know.
translations.あのさ、この前クッキー焼いてきた子の話。: About that girl who brought in cookies the other day...
translations.ああ、きっと男子に人気なんだろ。: Yeah. I bet she's really popular with the boys now.
translations.ううん。むしろ女子に人気。: Nope. She's actually popular with the girls.
translations.女子がみんな、お菓子作りをおしえて欲しいって。たしかにおいしかったし。: All the girls want her to teach them how to bake. And I mean, they really were good.
translations.ふうん。それは意外な展開だな。: Huh. That's an unexpected turn of events.
translations.でしょ？ 今度、放課後にその子のうちでお菓子作りするらしいよ。: Right？ Apparently they're going to her house after school soon to bake together.
translations.らしい？ ▲小早川＊▲は行かないんだ。: Apparently？ So you're not going, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……うん。リンコってそういうキャラじゃないじゃん？: ...Yeah. That's just not really my thing, you know？
translations.もったいないな。●は▲小早川＊▲の作ったクッキー、食べてみたかったなあ。: That's a shame. ● really wanted to try your cookies, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.あのさ、今度、お菓子作りの勉強会に参加することになった。: Hey, so I ended up joining that baking group.
translations.あれ？ この前は参加しないって言ってなかったか？: Huh？ Didn't you say last time that you weren't going？
translations.クラスでリンコ一人だけ参加しないのも変じゃん。: It'd be weird if I was the only one in class who didn't go.
translations.（前の▲小早川＊▲なら、絶対参加しなかったと思うけど……）: (The old ▲小早川＊▲ never would've gone, though...)
translations.▲小早川＊▲の作ったクッキー楽しみだな、って思って。: I was just thinking how much I'm looking forward to your cookies, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.誰もアンタに食べさせるとは言ってないじゃん。: I never said I was giving any to you.
translations.……しょうがないな。失敗したのなら、持ってきてあげる。: ...Oh, fine. If I mess any up, I'll bring them to you.
translations.ちゃんと成功したのにしてくれよ。: Come on, bring me the ones that actually turn out good.
translations.これ。お菓子作りの勉強会、行ってきたから。: Here. I went to that baking group.
translations.その表情からすると、うまくできたんだな。お、ちゃんとラッピングまでして、うまそう: Going by the look on your face, they turned out well. Oh, you even wrapped them up. They look delicious.
translations.……開けてないじゃん。てきとーなこと、言うなっつーの。: ...You haven't even opened it yet. Don't just say stuff like that.
translations.そうだな。じゃ、早速味を……。: Fair point. Alright, let's see how they taste...
translations.どうして、そんな意外そうな顔するかな。: Why do you have to look so surprised？
translations.だってこれ、普通に店で売っててもおかしくないぞ。: Because these are good enough to be sold in a store.
translations.へへっ。じゃあ次はどんなクッキー作ろっかな。: Hehe. Wonder what kind of cookies I should bake next, then.
translations.……え、またクッキー？ クッキー以外は？: ...Wait, cookies again？ What about something else？
translations.なし。だってクッキーしか作り方知らないし。: Nothing else. Cookies are all I know how to make.
translations.学校の裏に空き地あるでしょ？: You know that empty lot behind the school？
translations.ああ。あの草ぼうぼうの茂みだらけの場所か。: Yeah. That overgrown place full of bushes, right？
