translations.そう。あそこにさ、子ネコが捨てられてた。: Yeah. Someone abandoned a kitten there.
translations.捨てネコか、最近多いけど酷い話だよな。: An abandoned cat, huh. You hear about it a lot lately, but it's awful.
translations.でしょ？ あんなかわいい子を捨てられる神経がぜんぜん理解できない。: Right？ I don't get how anyone could have the nerve to abandon something so cute.
translations.飼い主にも事情があるんだろうけど捨てることはないよな。: The owner probably had their reasons, but they didn't have to abandon it.
translations.だからリンコ、こっそり校内で飼おうかなって。: So I was thinking of secretly keeping it at school.
translations.大丈夫か？ 先生に見つかるぞ。: Is that a good idea？ A teacher's gonna find out.
translations.やっぱり。それでどうなった？: I knew it. So what happened？
translations.子ネコ抱えて、学校中逃げ回った……。: I tucked the kitten under my arm and ran all over school...
translations.ついに降参した先生は、飼い主捜しに協力することになりました、とさ。: In the end, the teacher gave in and agreed to help find it a home. The end.
translations.捨てネコさ、飼ってくれる人が見つかったって。: They found someone to take in that stray kitten.
translations.あまり嬉しそうじゃないな？: You don't seem too happy about it？
translations.リンコのもとから離れるのが……。まだちっちゃいんだよ。: Just, having it leave me... It's still so little.
translations.なら、新しい飼い主の家で触られせてもらったら？: Why not ask if you can visit and pet it at the new owner's house？
translations.そんなことしたら、情が移って離れられなくなるじゃん。: If I do that, I'll get too attached and won't be able to let go.
translations.そうか……。なら、その子ネコが幸せになるように遠くから祈るしかないな。: I see... Then all we can do is pray from afar that the kitten has a happy life.
translations.……うん。それがあの子にとってもいいことだよね。: ...Yeah. That's what's best for the little one, too.
translations.先生から聞いたけど、あの子ネコ。今、病気なんだって。: I heard from the teacher about that kitten. They said it's sick right now.
translations.捨てた飼い主、ワクチンもちゃんと打ってなかったとか。: Apparently the owner who abandoned it didn't even get it properly vaccinated.
translations.そりゃ酷いな……。具合はどんなだって？: That's awful... How bad is it？
translations.もしあの子が……リンコどうしよう。: If something happens to it... What am I gonna do？
translations.しっかりしろって。▲小早川＊▲はその子のこと信じてやれよ。: Hang in there. You've gotta believe in the little guy, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.大丈夫だって。今はちゃんと先生に診てもらってるんだから。: It'll be okay. A vet is taking proper care of it now.
translations.うん……そうだね。遠くからでも、励ましてやろっと。: Yeah... you're right. I'll root for it, even if it's from afar.
translations.この世にはネコの神様がいるんだよ。ぜったいに!!: There really is a cat god in this world. Definitely!!
translations.？ そうか、あの子ネコ、助かったんだな。: ？ Oh, I get it. That kitten pulled through, huh.
translations.そう。リンコの祈り、ネコの神様に通じたのかな。: Yeah. Maybe my prayers reached the cat god.
translations.飼い主さんから元気になったあの子の写真もらっちゃった。もう……か～わいいのっ。: The owner gave me a photo of it all better now. Seriously... it's SO cute.
translations.ネコ飼いたいなあ。……今は無理だけど。: I really want a cat... Though I can't right now.
translations.なら、将来はたくさんのネコに囲まれて暮らせるといいな。: Well, hopefully in the future you can live surrounded by lots of cats.
translations.へへ、頼りにしてるよ？: Hehe, I'm counting on you, okay？
translations.あのさ、質問。最近どんな本読んでる？: Hey, question. What kind of books have you been reading lately？
translations.本か……あんまり読んでないな。: Books, huh... I haven't been reading much lately.
translations.図書委員失格。: You fail as a library committee member.
translations.そう言う▲小早川＊▲は？ なにか読んでるのか。: What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？ Reading anything？
translations.最近はドイツ文学。『若きヘインテルの悩み』あたりかな。: German literature lately. Like 'Young Heinter's Sorrows.'
translations.ドイツ文学か……。どんな話だっけ？: German literature, huh... What's that one about again？
translations.初恋をした青年が叶わぬ恋愛に絶望する話。: It's about a young man who falls into despair over his unrequited first love.
translations.読み終わったら貸してあげる。: I'll lend it to you when I'm done.
translations.……●はあんまり絶望したくはないんだけど。: ...●'d rather not fall into despair, though.
translations.重苦しい顔して、どうしたんだ？: You look pretty grim. What's wrong？
translations.想像以上に重い話だった。: This story's heavier than I expected.
translations.ああ。『若きヘインテルの悩み』だっけ？: Oh, right. 'Young Heinter's Sorrows,' was it？
translations.主人公の青年はさ、婚約者のいる美人に恋をするの。: The main character is a young man who falls in love with a beautiful woman who's already engaged.
translations.でも、恋は叶うことなく、結果すべてに絶望して自殺するんだよね。: His feelings are never returned, so he ends up despairing over everything and kills himself.
translations.ね。アンタは絶対に叶わない恋ってどう思う？: Hey. What do you think about love that has zero chance of working out？
translations.したくはないし、想像もできないな。: I wouldn't want to go through it, and I can't even imagine it.
translations.そっか。順風満帆な人生なんだ。: I see. Smooth sailing all the way for you, huh.
translations.順風満帆でもないけど、恋はかなってるからな。: I wouldn't say smooth sailing, but my love did work out.
translations.なあ。まだあれ読んでるのか？ 若きヘインテルの……。: Hey. Still reading that book？ Young Heinter's...
translations.悩み。あと少しだけど。読めば読むほど絶望的。: Sorrows. Just a little left, though. The more I read, the more hopeless it gets.
translations.そういや、出版当初は同じように絶望して自殺する若者が出た、なんて話もあるよな。: Come to think of it, I heard when it first came out, some young people fell into despair and killed themselves the same way.
translations.そんなに思い詰める前に格ゲーでもやって発散すれば良かったのに。: They should've just blown off some steam with a fighting game before letting it get to them that badly.
translations.当時格ゲーはなかったんだろうな……。: Pretty sure they didn't have fighting games back then...
translations.もし……リンコがなにもかも嫌になるくらい絶望したとしたら、アンタはどうする……？: What if... I fell so deep into despair that I got sick of everything？ What would you do...？
translations.絶望するはずないだろ。: There's no way you'd fall into despair.
translations.最後まで●は味方だって言ったろ？ 絶望なんてしないよ。: ● promised to be on your side to the very end, remember？ You won't fall into despair.
translations.かっこつけんなっつーの。……へへ。: Quit trying to act cool... Hehe.
translations.うん。徹夜して一気に読んじゃったから。: Yeah. I stayed up all night and finished the rest in one go.
translations.ああ、若きなんとかの。面白かった？: Oh, that Young-something book. Was it good？
translations.リンコの感想だけ聞いて、読んだつもりになる気？: Are you planning to just hear my thoughts and pretend you read it？
translations.興味あるなら自分で読みなって。: If you're curious, read it yourself.
translations.……読むの大変そうだよな。延々と悲劇を読まされるのも辛そうだし。: ...Sounds like a tough read, though. Having to sit through endless tragedy sounds rough, too.
translations.この作品は、その悲劇を通していかに生きるかって哲学を問うてるんだよ。: The story uses that tragedy to ask the philosophical question of how to live.
translations.ふーん。●には一生、わからないままでいたい哲学だな。: Hmm. ● hope to go my whole life without ever understanding a philosophy like that.
translations.普通はそうだよね。好きこのんで悲劇の人生なんてさ……。: Well, normally, yeah. Nobody chooses to live a tragic life...
translations.そうそう。やっぱり恋は叶った方が楽しいし、充実してるもんな。: Right, right. Love is way more fun and fulfilling when it actually works out.
translations.……なに一人でニヤニヤしてんの。バカじゃん。: ...What are you grinning to yourself about？ Idiot.
translations.ね。今度できるファーストフードの噂、知ってる？: Hey. Have you heard the rumors about the new fast-food place opening up？
translations.知らないな。新しい店ができるんだ？: No, I haven't. They're opening a new place？
translations.そう。今バイト募集してるらしいよ。: Yeah. Apparently they're hiring part-timers right now.
translations.それだけで噂になるんだな。: That alone is enough to get people talking, huh.
translations.その制服がかわいいんだってさ。: They say the uniform is really cute.
translations.ふーん。じゃ、リンコがその制服を着たいって言ったら？: Hmm. Well, what if I said I wanted to wear that uniform？
translations.冗談だから。想像すんなっつーの。: It was a joke. Stop picturing it already.
translations.この前話したファーストフードの店だけど。: About that fast-food place I mentioned the other day.
translations.ああ、制服がかわいいって噂してた？: Oh, the one rumored to have the cute uniforms？
translations.見に行ったのか？ わざわざ。: Did you go all the way out there to see it？
translations.まさか。男子がチラシ、もらってきた。: As if. One of the boys brought back a flyer.
translations.リンコの趣味とはちょっと違うかも。: It's not quite my taste, I think.
translations.どう違うんだ？ ウェイトレスの制服にそんなに違いはないだろ。: How so？ Waitress uniforms can't be all that different, right？
translations.んと……かわいいだけじゃなく、もうちょっと毒が欲しいかな。: Well... I want it to have a little more edge to it, not just be cute.
translations.そして店内にはパンク流しまくり。: And have punk music blasting inside the restaurant.
translations.落ち着かなさそうな店だな……。: Doesn't sound like a very relaxing place to eat...
translations.そっかな。リンコにとっては理想の店なんだけど……。: You think？ Sounds like the ideal place to me...
translations.まだ新婚の先生だっけ。美人の先生で、結婚を知ったときにはたくさんの男子が泣き……: The newlywed teacher, right？ She's really pretty, and when news of her marriage got out, a lot of guys cried...
translations.男子……バカじゃん。: Boys... What a bunch of idiots.
translations.今月から産休に入るって。: I heard she's going on maternity leave starting this month.
translations.へえ。赤ちゃんができたんだ。: Oh, wow. So she's having a baby.
translations.そう。赤ちゃんがどっち似になるか、今、女子は騒いでる。: Yeah. All the girls are making a fuss right now over which parent the baby's going to look like.
translations.気が早いな。旦那さんは岩みたいにがっちりした人だったっけ。: Getting a little ahead of themselves, aren't they？ Her husband's built like a rock, right？
translations.うん。写真見せてもらったことがあるけど、あれはまさに美女と野獣だね。: Yeah. She showed me a photo once, and they really are Beauty and the Beast.
translations.リンコとアンタは周りからどう見えてるんだろ。: I wonder how the two of us look to other people.
translations.俺が野獣だって？: Are you calling me a beast？
translations.さあ？ 少なくとも白馬の王子様ではないね。: Who knows？ You're definitely not a prince on a white horse, at least.
translations.リンコは王子様より愛嬌のある野獣の方が好きだけどね。: Well, I prefer a charming beast over a prince anyway.
translations.あのさ。赤ちゃんって育てるの大変なのかな。: Hey. Is raising a baby really that hard？
translations.育児が大変で、川村先生の職場復帰はないんじゃないかって。今、みんなが言ってる。: Everyone's saying Ms. Kawamura might not come back to work because childcare is so tough.
translations.人気もあるし、教えるのがうまい先生だから、それが本当なら残念だな。: She's popular and a good teacher, so it'd be a shame if that's true.
translations.でしょ。でも、育児が大変そうなのもなんとなくわかるんだよね。: Right？ Though I can kind of see how raising a kid would be rough.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って育児経験でもあるのか？: Do you have experience raising kids or something, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.な、なんだよ。親戚の子どもを預かったことでもあるんじゃないのか？: W-what's with that look？ I just figured maybe you'd babysat a relative's kid or something.
translations.あ、そっか。……うちさ、まだ小さい弟いるじゃん。: Oh, right. ...You know I have a little brother at home, right？
translations.そういえばそうだな。: Now that you mention it, yeah.
translations.普段はかわいくて、手がかからないんだけど、一度泣き出すともう大変。まるで怪獣だね: He's usually cute and easy to handle, but once he starts crying, it's a nightmare. Like a little monster.
translations.産まれたばかりの乳児だともっと大変だろうな。: A newborn baby must be even harder to deal with.
translations.うん。できれば先生は辞めないで欲しいけど、無理は言えないよね。: Yeah. I hope she doesn't quit, if possible, but you can't really blame her if she does.
translations.……最悪。リンコ生まれて最大のピンチだよ。: ...This is the worst. Biggest crisis of my life.
translations.次の英語の授業でスピーチすることになった。: I got stuck giving a speech in the next English class.
translations.それって抜擢されたってことじゃないのか？: Doesn't that mean you were specially chosen for it？
translations.リンコが洋楽好きだってこと、知られててさ……。: People know I'm into Western music, so...
translations.聞くのとしゃべるのはぜんぜん違うっつーの。: Listening to it and speaking it are two totally different things, you know.
translations.準備はともかく、スピーチは本番があるからな。: I can help you prep, sure, but you're on your own for the actual speech.
translations.そういえば英語のスピーチ、どうなった？: By the way, how did that English speech go？
translations.なら、報告してくれよ。気にしてたんだから。: Then tell me how it went. I was wondering about it.
translations.うん。悪くなかった……と思う。一応ほめられた。: Yeah. Not bad... I think. The teacher praised me, at least.
translations.すごいじゃん。なに話したんだ？: Hey, that's great. What did you talk about？
translations.キラーバンビーズの詞を引用しながら、その世界観について……。: I quoted some Killer Bambis lyrics and talked about the world of their music...
translations.要するにキラーバンビーズ大好きって話。好きなものだと、スラスラ言葉が出てくるんだ: Basically, how much I love Killer Bambis. The words just flow when it's something you like.
translations.なんだか想像できるな。▲小早川＊▲がネコへの愛を語るときもすごいもんな。: I can picture that. You really get going when you talk about how much you love cats, too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.じゃあさ、今からリンコのことがどれだけ好きか語ってみて。: Okay then, let's hear you talk about how much you love me right now.
translations.そっか……リンコのことそんなに好きじゃないんだ。: I see... So you don't really like me that much.
translations.だから、なんでこんなところで……。: Come on, why here of all places...
translations.（スピーチは上手くいっても演技はダメだな……）: (Her speech might've gone well, but her acting is terrible...)
translations.図書委員の女子でさ、朗読会やることになった。: The girls on the library committee decided to hold a reading session.
translations.朗読会？ みんなで集まって本読むのか？: A reading session？ Like everyone getting together to read books？
translations.ちょっと違う。ボランティアとして保育園児に本を読んであげるんだって。:
Not quite. We're volunteering
to read books to preschoolers.
translations.●たちは聞いてないけど？:
● and the guys haven't
heard about that, though？
translations.うん。まずは女子だけ。:
Yeah. It's just the girls
for now.
translations.ふうん。▲小早川＊▲はそういうの、参加しないと思ってたのに。:
Huh. I didn't think you'd take
part in that kind of thing, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.それ偏見。ちっちゃい子たちがどんな本を喜ぶか考えるの、楽しいんだから。:
That's an unfair assumption.
It's fun thinking about what
books little kids will enjoy.
translations.そういえば家でも弟に読んであげたりするんだっけ。:
Come to think of it, you read to
your little brother at home, right？
translations.キラキラした目をして、聞いてくれてるの見てると、リンコも嬉しくなるんだ。:
Seeing him listen with his eyes
all lit up makes me happy too.
translations.それで本が好きになってくれれば、いいことだしな。:
Plus, if it gets kids to love
books, that's a great thing.
translations.そうだね。これは責任重大かも。:
Yeah. This might actually be
a pretty big responsibility.
translations.この前の朗読会、結構好評だったよ。:
That reading session the other
day went over pretty well.
translations.へえ、良かったな。どんな本読んであげたんだ？:
Oh yeah？ That's great.
What kind of book did you read them？
translations.最初は短い絵本がいいかなって思って、『きつねのおかいもの』って本にした。:
I figured a short picture book
would be good to start with, so I
picked "The Fox Goes Shopping."
translations.聞いたことないけど、どんな話？:
Never heard of it.
What's it about？
translations.子ぎつねが、初めてのおかいものに出かけて、いろんな冒険する話。特に男の子に大人気:
A little fox goes shopping for
the first time and has all kinds of
adventures. The boys especially loved it.
translations.先生やお母さんからも、また次もお願いします、なんて言われちゃった。へへっ。:
Even the teachers and moms
asked me to come back and do it
again next time. Hehe.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って保母さんとか向いてるのかもな。:
Maybe you're cut out to be
a preschool teacher, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そうかな？ そういえば、最近の子ってませてるっていうか、そこは驚いた。:
You think so？ Though it really
surprised me how precocious
kids are these days.
translations.お姉ちゃんは彼氏いるの？ て訊かれた。しかも相手は４歳同士のカップル。:
They asked, "Do you have a
boyfriend？" And that was coming
from a four-year-old couple.
translations.４歳にか……。それでなんて？:
Four years old, huh...
So what did you tell them？
translations.次に来るときに、お姉ちゃんの彼氏の写真見せてあげるって答えた。へへ、よろしく。:
I told them I'd show them a
photo of my boyfriend next time
I visit. Hehe, hope you're ready.
translations.（なんか緊張するな……）:
(Somehow that makes me
kind of nervous...)
translations.リンコさ、アンタに\nべったりしすぎかな。:
Have I been getting
too clingy with you？
translations.今更だけど、\nリンコらしくないかなって。:
It's a little late to ask,
but it just doesn't feel
very much like me.
translations.▲小早川＊▲らしいって。\n▲小早川＊▲が\nしたいようにするってことだろ？:
Being like ▲小早川＊▲ just
means ▲小早川＊▲ doing whatever
she wants, right？
translations.▲小早川＊▲が●と\n一緒にいたいって思ってくれる\nならそれでいいじゃん。:
If ▲小早川＊▲ wants to be
with ●, then that's
all that matters, right？
translations.しょうがないか、\nアンタといると楽しいんだもん。:
Guess I can't help it.
Being with you is fun.
translations.ほんとはもっと\nずっと一緒にいたい。:
Honestly, I want to stay
with you so much longer.
translations.毎日遅くなったら\nお別れって……。\nもっと一緒にいられたら。:
Having to part ways every
day once it gets late...
I wish we could stay longer.
translations.あのさ、▲小早川＊▲。\n実は懸賞で当たったんだ。\n熱海に一泊二日。:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲.
I actually won a prize.
An overnight trip to Atami.
translations.●たち二人で……\n行かないか？:
●... Just the two of us.
Want to go？
translations.旅行、わかった。\n……一緒に行く。:
About the trip... Okay.
...I'll go with you.
translations.そ、そっか。\nえっと、いつにする？:
O-oh, got it.
Um, when should we go？
translations.（●と▲小早川＊▲、\n初めての旅行か……）:
(● and ▲小早川＊▲...
Our first trip together, huh.)
translations.……ほんとに？ \nこっそり買ってるんじゃ。:
...Really？
You didn't secretly buy
them yourself, did you？
translations.違うって！ \nまあ、だからさ。\n一緒に行かないかなって。:
I didn't!
Anyway, that's why I was
hoping you'd go with me.
translations.うん。……うれしい。\nねえ、いつ？:
Yeah. ...I'm happy.
So, when are we going？
translations.（▲小早川＊▲と\n旅行に行けるぞ！）:
(I get to go on a trip
with ▲小早川＊▲!)
translations.旅行の買い物に行くから付き合って。もちろん今から。:
I'm going shopping for the
trip, so come with me.
Right now, obviously.
translations.じゃあ、ショッピングモールで。: Meet me at the mall, then.
translations.考えてないのかよ。:
You haven't even thought
about it？
translations.人生の先輩なんだからさ、いいとこみせてよ。:
You're older and wiser,
so show me what you've got.
translations.いざとなったら、頼りにしてるから。:
If anything comes up,
I'm counting on you.
translations.たぶんじゃ困る。リンコたち、一蓮托生なんだから。:
"Probably" doesn't cut it.
We're in this together,
you know.
translations.んな、おおげさな。:
Come on, don't be so
dramatic.
translations.付き合ってくれて、助かった。:
Thanks for coming with me.
It really helped.
translations.ちゃんと前もって準備しろよ？:
Make sure you pack ahead
of time, okay？
translations.春にしては珍しくさ。たまたま早く目が覚めたから。:
Rare for me in spring, huh？
I just happened to wake up
early.
translations.おはよ。待たせちゃったな。:
Morning. Sorry to keep
you waiting.
translations.暑い！ 向こうはもっと涼しい？:
It's hot! Is it any cooler
where we're going？
translations.おはよ。そんなことはないと思うぞ。:
Morning. I don't think
it will be.
translations.絶好の行楽日和ってやつ？:
Guess you'd call this
perfect weather for a trip？
translations.さむい……。向こうも寒かったら、すぐ帰るよ。:
So cold... If it's freezing
there too, I'm going
straight home.
translations.おいおい、少しは我慢しろって。:
Hey, come on. Tough it out
a little.
translations.まあ、なんとなく。……どう？:
Well, just felt like it.
...What do you think？
translations.いい、気のきいた答えなんて期待してないし。:
Whatever. I didn't expect
a clever answer anyway.
translations.……言われるこっちの身にもなれっつーの。:
...Try putting yourself in
my shoes before saying that.
translations.（いいよな。今日の▲小早川＊▲の服）:
(Yeah, ▲小早川＊▲'s outfit
today is really nice.)
translations.はあ、脱ぎたい。:
Ugh, now I want to take
it off.
translations.どう？ リンコは……気に入ってるんだけど。:
What do you think？
Personally... I like it.
translations.個人の好みにとやかく言いたくないけど……空気読めっつーの。:
I won't judge your taste,
but... read the room,
would you？
translations.うん、今日のために。似合ってる？:
Yeah, did it just for today.
Does it suit me？
translations.せっかく、がんばったのに……。:
And I worked so hard
on it...
translations.今日の服、変じゃない？:
Does my outfit look
weird today？
translations.へへ、もっと言ってもいいよ？:
Hehe, you can say more,
you know？
translations.変じゃないなら、いいや。:
Well, as long as
it's not weird.
translations.あのさ、旅行のことばっかで、忘れたりしてないよね。:
Hey, you didn't forget just
because of the trip, right？
translations.乗り換えは向こう。ほんとに何も調べてないんだな。:
Our transfer's that way.
You really didn't look
anything up, huh.
translations.せっかく二人いるんだから、分担しないと非効率的じゃん？:
There's two of us, so it's
inefficient not to split
up the work, right？
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の分担はなんなんだ？）:
(And what's ▲小早川＊▲'s
share of the work？)
translations.弟がさ、電車好きなんだよね。:
My little brother's really
into trains, you know.
translations.あー、わかる。そういう年頃だよな。写真とか模型とかさ。:
Ah, I get that. He's at
that age, huh. Photos,
models, stuff like that.
translations.そうだな。▲小早川＊▲はわかんない？:
Guess so. You don't
get it, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.向こうだって。忘れたのか？:
It's that way, I told you.
Did you forget？
translations.忘れたっていうか、そもそも覚えてない。:
Can't forget what I never
bothered to remember.
translations.新幹線と違ってさ、風情があるよね。:
Unlike the bullet train,
this has real charm to it.
translations.なんで二極論なわけ？ 適材適所でしょ。:
Why so black and white？
Everything has its place.
translations.預けなかったっけ。引率の人に。:
Didn't I leave it with
the chaperone？
translations.創作するな。あと引率の人じゃない。:
Stop making stuff up. And
I'm not your chaperone.
translations.どうしよう……。やばい？:
What do I do...
Is this bad？
translations.最悪、お金余分に払わないといけないかもな。:
Worst case, we might have
to pay extra.
translations.こっちを見て言うな。:
Don't look at me when
you say that.
translations.切符、そこに落ちてますよ。カノジョさんの席の下。:
Your ticket fell right
there. Under your
girlfriend's seat.
translations.あ、ほんと。ありがとうございます。助かりました。:
Oh, you're right. Thank
you so much. You're a
lifesaver.
translations.（……知らない人には礼儀正しいんだな、いいことだけど……）:
(...She's polite to
strangers, huh. Which is
a good thing, but...)
translations.熱海ってさ、昔は新婚旅行の定番だったって。:
Apparently Atami used to be
the go-to honeymoon spot.
translations.……別に、なんとなく知ってることを披露しただけ。:
...Nothing. Just sharing
a random piece of trivia.
translations.だからさ、旅行の間、新婚のふりをするってこと。:
You know, pretending we're
newlyweds for the trip.
translations.まあイヤならいいけど。:
Well, we don't have to
if you don't want to.
translations.（何がしたかったんだ？）:
(What was she trying
to get at？)
translations.ほら、準備して。降りるぞ。:
Come on, get ready.
This is our stop.
translations.別に。熱海だなーって。:
Nothing. Just thinking,
so this is Atami.
translations.いつからそんな常連。:
Since when are you
a regular here？
translations.いいじゃん、●たち思い出の場所だろ。:
Come on, ●, this place
is full of memories for us.
translations.さて、まずはどうするかな。:
Now then, what should we
do first？
translations.電車乗ると、疲れる。:
Riding the train wears
me out.
translations.じゃあちょっと早いけど。休憩がてら昼食にするか。:
It's a bit early, but let's
take a break and grab lunch.
translations.いい景色じゃんか。でもあんま乗り出すなよ。:
Great view, isn't it？ Just
don't lean out too far.
translations.じゃあ代わりに乗り出して？ ほら、手すりの上歩いたりしないの？:
Then why don't you lean out
for me？ Come on, aren't you
gonna walk on the railing？
translations.しないっつーの！: No way am I doing that！
translations.電車の中でポテチ食べてたしな。:
Well, you were eating
potato chips on the train.
translations.長距離移動でポテチ食べないのは、リンコの主義に反するから。:
Not eating potato chips on
a long trip goes against
my principles.
translations.なんだかなあ。男尊女卑？ やれやれだね。:
I don't know about this.
Male chauvinism？ Good grief.
translations.まあ、そんな印象も受けるけど。どんな話だっけ。:
Well, it kind of looks
that way. How does the
story go again？
translations.途中で作者が亡くなったから未完なんだよね。:
The author died before
finishing it, so it's
incomplete.
translations.へえ、そうなんだ。さすが図書委員。:
Oh, really？ Leave it to
a library committee member.
translations.アンタもだっつーの。それよりさ、ちょっと頼みごと。:
You're on the committee too.
Anyway, do me a quick favor.
translations.オチが見える、蹴るだろ！:
I know where this is going.
You're gonna kick me!
translations.いーじゃん。その程度の代償で熱海観光が満喫できるんだから。:
What's the big deal？ It's a
small price to pay to get
the full Atami experience.
translations.それどんな観光だよ……。:
What kind of sightseeing
is that...?
translations.なんだかなあ。リンコのキックが消化不良気味だよ。:
Man... Now my kicking foot
feels all unsatisfied.
translations.発散させとく？ ゲーセンないかな？:
Maybe I should blow off
some steam. Is there an
arcade around here？
translations.ここまで来てゲーセン行かなくてもいいだろ。そういや見かけないけど。:
We didn't come all this way
to go to an arcade. Not that
I've seen any around here.
translations.知らない土地に来ると、地元民と対戦したくなるんだけどなあ。:
Whenever I visit somewhere
new, I get the urge to take
on the locals, though.
translations.待った待った。諦めるの早い！:
Hold on, wait! You're
giving up way too fast!
translations.だって、上見えないし。意味わかんない。:
I can't even see the top.
This is ridiculous.
translations.まあゆっくりでいいからさ。:
Come on, we can just take
our time.
translations.リンコのことおんぶしたくない？:
Don't you want to give me
a piggyback ride？
translations.それでも健康な男子高校生？:
And you call yourself a
healthy high school boy？
translations.もうやめとこ。他のとこ行く体力なくなるって。:
Let's just turn back. We
won't have the energy left
to go anywhere else.
translations.上の方、紅葉してる。はあ、エスカレーター作ればいいのに。:
The leaves are turning red
up top. Sigh... They really
ought to build an escalator.
translations.情緒のかけらもないな……。:
So much for taking in the
atmosphere...
translations.上の方は空気が澄んでるね。運動した後だと特にそう感じるのかな？:
The air is so clear up here.
Maybe it feels that way
especially after exercising？
translations.運動してない▲小早川＊▲にはわかんないだろうな。:
Not that you'd know, ▲小早川＊▲,
since you didn't exercise.
translations.お疲れ。カノジョを背負って階段登れれば、アンタも一人前だよ。:
Good job. Carry your
girlfriend up these stairs
and you're a real man.
translations.キレイに紅葉してるね。苦労して登った甲斐があったよ。:
The autumn leaves are so
pretty. It was worth all the
trouble climbing up here.
translations.ああ、ほんとだ。苦労したのは●だけど。:
Yeah, they really are.
Though ● did all
the hard work.
translations.まあお約束ってことで、お参りしとく？:
Well, just to follow
tradition, should we pray
while we're here？
translations.そうだな、せっかく来たんだし。:
Yeah, might as well since
we came all this way.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲との仲がもっと進展しますように）:
(I hope ▲小早川＊▲ and I
grow even closer.)
translations.（なんだろう。前より▲小早川＊▲と親密になった気がする！）:
(What's this？ I feel like
I've gotten closer to
▲小早川＊▲ than before!)
translations.なんか効果ある気がする。パワースポットってやつ？:
I feel like it's actually
doing something. Is this one
of those "power spots"？
translations.じゃあ、着替えてくる。待ってて。:
Okay, I'm gonna go change.
Wait here for me.
translations.ああ、そうだな。じゃあ。:
Yeah, right. See you in
a bit.
translations.（うーん。見渡してみても、やっぱり▲小早川＊▲が一番可愛いよな）:
(Hmm. Even looking around,
▲小早川＊▲ really is the cutest
girl here.)
translations.うん、これこれ。:
Yeah, now that's what I'm
talking about.
translations.やっぱ夏の旅行ってこれなわけ？\n即物的だね。:
So this is all a summer trip
is to you？ Talk about a
one-track mind.
translations.水着さ、一応リクエストにこたえたんだけど？:
I wore the swimsuit
you asked for, you know？
translations.そうそう、素直に感謝しとくもんだよ。:
That's right. You oughta
just be grateful.
translations.（そういや▲小早川＊▲。日焼け対策ってしてるのかな）:
(Come to think of it, is
▲小早川＊▲ using any sun
protection？)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。日焼け止め塗った方がいいんじゃない？:
▲小早川＊▲, shouldn't you
put on some sunscreen？
translations.しょうがないな。塗ってやるよ。:
Guess there's no helping it.
I'll put it on for you.
translations.サンオイル？ へえ、そういう趣味。:
Tanning oil？ Huh, so that's
what you're into.
translations.きっと小麦色の肌の▲小早川＊▲もかわいいぞ！ ●が塗ろうか？:
I bet a tanned ▲小早川＊▲
would be cute too!
Should ● put it on you？
translations.わかったから。でもこっちくんな。:
Yeah, yeah, I get it.
Just don't come near me.
translations.なんかいかにも作った海岸って感じ。:
This really feels like
a man-made beach.
translations.そんな斜にかまえなくても。:
You don't have to be
so cynical about it.
translations.別に悪く言ってるわけじゃないし。人工のものが天然のものに劣るなんて決まり、ないじ:
I don't mean it in a bad way.
There's no rule saying man-made
is worse than natural, right？
translations.そうそう。大事なのは、そのとき隣にいる人間でしょ？:
That's right. What matters
is who's by your side at
the time, right？
translations.なんかさ、桜多くない？:
Hey, aren't there a lot of
cherry trees around here？
translations.熱海桜、ってやつだな。:
They're what you call
Atami cherry blossoms.
translations.じゃあ、とわのの桜は十羽野桜？:
So would the ones in Towano
be Towano cherry blossoms？
translations.聞いたことないけど、地域振興に使えるかもね。:
Never heard of 'em, but they
could use that to promote
the town.
translations.まんじゅうとか、そういうの？:
Like souvenir buns and
that sort of thing？
translations.そしたら税収アップで学校の施設も充実するかもよ？:
Then with the extra tax
money, maybe our school gets
better facilities too？
translations.（私立だけどな……黙っておこう）:
(It's a private school,
though... I'll stay quiet.)
translations.メールか？ さっきからちょくちょくいじってるよな。:
Texting？ You've been on it
on and off for a while now.
translations.なに、一緒にいるときに携帯触られると嫌がるタイプ？:
What, does it bother you
when I look at my phone
while we're together？
translations.ちょっとした、旅の記録ってやつ。:
Just keeping a little
record of our trip.
translations.（ま、しょうがないか）: (Well, I guess it can't be helped.)
translations.長過ぎだろ、▲小早川＊▲！: You're taking way too long, ▲小早川＊▲!
translations.あとちょっとー。まだ時間あるでしょ？: Just a little longer. We still have time, right？
translations.そうだけど……でもさ、早くホテル着けばそれだけ二人の時間が……。: Yeah, but... the sooner we get to the hotel, the more time we'll have to ourselves...
translations.ああ、これで上まで。: Yeah, all the way to the top.
translations.違うっつーの。ほら、行くんでしょ。: As if. Come on, we're going, right？
translations.おお、動いてる。結構速いな。: Whoa, it's moving. Pretty fast, too.
translations.ねえ、ツッコんでいい？: Hey, can I point something out？
translations.これ乗らなくても、上まで行けるんだよね。バスとかで。: We didn't have to ride this to get to the top, you know. We could've taken a bus.
translations.そうだけど……楽しいじゃん！: Well, yeah, but... this is more fun!
translations.まあね……。同乗者次第かな、へへ。: I guess... Depends on who you're riding with, hehe.
translations.ここに錠前をかけると、二人はずっと幸せになれるってさ。: They say if a couple puts a lock here, they'll be happy forever.
translations.愛の錠前であいじょう岬？: A love lock... Is that why they call it Aijou Cape？
translations.そういうこと。やろうぜ！: You got it. Let's do it!
translations.リンコのポリシーに反するけど……しょうがないなあ。: It goes against my principles, but... oh well, I guess.
translations.（とりあえず文句は言っておくんだな）: (She always has to complain first, huh.)
translations.もう奉納されたんじゃないか？: Didn't they collect it for the shrine already？
translations.神様も大変だね、毎度毎度色恋沙汰でさ。ご苦労さまって感じ。: The gods sure have it rough, dealing with everyone's love lives all the time. Gotta hand it to them.
translations.（●たちもだけどな）: (Not that ● and I are any different.)
translations.ねえ、あそこは？ 行かないの？: Hey, what about over there？ Aren't we going in？
translations.えっと……特に予定にはないな。: Uh... It's not really on the schedule.
translations.パンフレットぐらいもらっとく？: Should we at least grab a pamphlet？
translations.前も言ったことあるかもしれないけどさ。: I might've said this before, but...
translations.なんでカップルって高いところ好きなんだっけ。: Why is it that couples like high places so much？
translations.さあ、なんでだろ。でもたしかに●たちも高いとこ好きだよな。: Who knows. Though you and I sure like high places too, ●.
translations.ほんとね。特に夜景とかさ……。: True. Especially night views and stuff...
translations.そろそろホテル行くか。: Should we head to the hotel soon？
translations.着いたら、まず休むか。: Let's get some rest first thing when we arrive.
translations.うん、寝る。かも。: Yeah, I'm going to sleep. Maybe.
translations.な、なんでも。……っていうか、アンタは平気なの？: N-Nothing. ...Anyway, are you really okay with this？
translations.二人で泊まるとか。初めてなのに。: Staying the night together like this. Even though it's our first time.
translations.もう、慣れた？ こういうの。: Have you gotten used to this kind of thing yet？
translations.予約してる▲苗字▲ですけど……。: I have a reservation under ▲苗字▲...
translations.可愛らしい奥様ですね。: What an adorable wife you have.
translations.思うんだけどさ。ホテルの職員が荷物運ぶ必要あるの？: You know, I was thinking. Do hotel staff really need to carry our bags？
translations.労働力の無駄じゃない？ 自分で持てるっつーの。: Isn't it a waste of labor？ I can carry my own stuff.
translations.あとさ、可愛らしいって何？ 小動物かっつーの！: And what's with calling me 'adorable'？ What am I, some kind of small animal？
translations.（あえて奥様には反応しないんだな）: (So she's purposely ignoring the 'wife' part, huh.)
translations.部屋って、どうなってんの？: What's going on with the rooms？
translations.別でとったはずなんだけど……。: I'm sure I booked separate rooms, though...
translations.手違いだって。他の部屋も空いてないみたいだし、困ったな。: They said there was a mix-up. Looks like they don't have any other rooms open either. What a pain.
translations.違うって！ もう一回話してくる。: No way! I'll go talk to them again.
translations.同じ部屋でいいって。: I'm saying it's fine to share a room.
translations.だって一緒に旅行に来て。部屋が別々とか変じゃん。一緒にいたいのに。: I mean, we came on this trip together. Getting separate rooms would be weird. I want to be together anyway.
translations.なんか、同室が当り前っていうのもな。: Somehow, it feels weird just taking sharing a room for granted.
translations.なんだ、たまには別がいいとか？: What, would you rather have separate rooms for a change？
translations.それはもっとやだ。……だからガマンしてんの。: I'd hate that even more. ...That's why I'm putting up with it.
translations.はは、\nまずはチェックするよな。\nわかるわかる。:
Haha,
you always check that first.
I get it, I get it.
translations.お菓子といえば？ \nほら。:
And what goes with snacks？
Come on.
translations.お茶か。\nはいはい、いれてやるよ。:
Tea, right.
All right, I'll make us some.
translations.サンキュ。\n次はリンコが\nやったげるからさ。:
Thanks.
I'll make it for you
next time.
translations.なあ、▲小早川＊▲。ホテルの中、探検しよう。: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Let's go explore the hotel.
translations.いいよ。レトロゲー探し？: Sure. Looking for retro arcade games？
translations.そこかよ。それもいいけどさ。: Right to the games, huh？ I mean, I'm down for that too.
translations.あとは少し寂れたラウンジとかあれば最高なんだけど、あるかな？: And if there's a slightly run-down lounge or something, that'd be perfect. Think they have one？
translations.カラオケは？ サウナは？ なんか無性にわくわくする。: What about karaoke？ Or a sauna？ For some reason, I'm getting really excited.
translations.（ツボがわかんないな……）: (I never know what's gonna get her excited...)
translations.のど乾いた。ジュース買ってくる。: I'm thirsty. Gonna go get some juice.
translations.いってらっしゃい。寄り道すんなよ。迷子になるなよ。: See you. Don't get sidetracked. And don't get lost.
translations.ふん。マッサージ、４０分４５００円か……。高校生には無理だな。: Hmm. 4,500 yen for a 40-minute massage, huh... Way out of a high schooler's budget.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、財布忘れてるじゃん。やれやれ、子供だな。: ▲小早川＊▲ left her wallet behind. Man, talk about being a kid.
translations.（あ、鍵どうしよう……）: (Oh, what should I do about the key...？)
translations.ばか！ なんで鍵かかってんだっつーの。早く来て！: Idiot! Why the heck is the door locked？ Hurry up and get back here!
translations.ごめん、すぐ見つかると思って。財布忘れてっただろ？: Sorry, I thought I'd find you right away. You forgot your wallet, right？
translations.小銭だけ持って出たの。早く鍵開けて。: I just took some change with me. Hurry up and unlock the door.
translations.（外じゃないだろ……とりあえず戻るか）: (No way she went outside... Guess I'll head back for now.)
translations.何ふらふらしてんの？: What are you wandering around for？
translations.財布忘れてっただろ？ だから追いかけたんだけど。: You forgot your wallet, right？ So I went after you.
translations.は？ 小銭だけ持って出たに決まってんじゃん。: Huh？ Obviously I just took some change with me.
translations.どこまで行ってたわけ？: Just how far did you go looking for me？
translations.食事までまだ時間あるし。先に風呂入っちゃおう。: We still have time before dinner. Let's take a bath first.
translations.？ このホテル、いろんな風呂があって時間によって男女が入れ替わるんだってさ。: ？ Looks like this hotel has all kinds of baths, and the men's and women's sides switch depending on the time.
translations.今の時間だと男がローマ風呂で、女が花のお風呂、か。: Right now, the men's is the Roman bath, and the women's is the flower bath, huh.
translations.ローマ風呂の方がいいけど……いいや、待つのも面倒だし。: I'd rather try the Roman bath... Whatever, waiting around is a pain anyway.
translations.二人でお風呂行ってさ、あがったあとに待ってるの。: Where we both go to the baths, and wait for each other after getting out.
translations.あー、やっちゃうか？: Oh, yeah, should we do that？
translations.いーねー。今日のリンコはフォークソングだよ。: Nice. Today, I'm straight out of a folk song.
translations.じゃあ、あがったらここで待ってるよ。: Alright, I'll wait for you here when I get out.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲はきっとまだだよな……）: (I bet ▲小早川＊▲ is still in there...)
translations.肩までちゃんとつかったか？:
Did you soak all the way
up to your shoulders？
translations.そのまま１０秒数えたか？:
And count to ten while
you were in there？
translations.２秒で充分！ 熱いのやだ。:
Two seconds is plenty!
I hate hot baths.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の風呂は短い、と……）:
(Note to self: ▲小早川＊▲
takes short baths...)
translations.そういや、浴衣。結構似合うな？:
By the way, that yukata
looks pretty good on you.
translations.ふーん、それって褒め言葉？:
Hmm. Is that supposed
to be a compliment？
translations.そりゃ、似合うんだから。:
Of course. It really
suits you.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って、刺身大丈夫だっけ？:
Wait, are you okay with
sashimi, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.なんか苦手そう。なんとなくだけど。:
You just seem like you
wouldn't like it, for
some reason.
translations.食べるよ。だってネコだし。:
I eat it. I'm a cat,
after all.
translations.じゃあ、ちょっと休むか……。:
Let's rest for a bit,
then...
translations.そういやさ、ネットで見たんだけど。:
Oh yeah, I saw something
online earlier.
translations.熱海港から船で行ける初島ってとこがあるんだけどさ。:
There's this island called
Hatsushima you can take a
boat to from Atami Port.
translations.そこには誰も辿り着いたことがない、伝説のビーチがあるんだってさ。:
Apparently there's a
legendary beach there that
no one's ever reached.
translations.そこで愛を誓い合うと、永遠に幸せに……って、なんか言ってて恥ずかしくなるんだけど:
If you pledge your love there,
you'll be happy forever...
Ugh, I feel silly just saying it.
translations.へえ、はじめて聞いた。: Huh, first I've heard of it.
translations.ちょっと行ってみたいかもな。:
I kinda want to go
check it out.
translations.誰も行ったことないんだろ？ わくわくするじゃん。:
No one's ever been there,
right？ Sounds exciting.
translations.じゃあ明日、探してみる？:
Wanna try looking for it
tomorrow, then？
translations.ああ、そうしよう。明日は初島だ。:
Yeah, let's do it.
Hatsushima it is tomorrow.
translations.ほら、あそこ。伝説の。:
You know, that place.
The legendary one.
translations.うん、定番ってわけじゃないけどさ。:
Yeah. Not that it's a
typical tourist spot, though.
translations.あ、ここ卓球台があるんだ。:
Oh, they have a ping-pong
table here.
translations.そういうなって。ほら、やろう。:
Aw, don't be like that.
Come on, let's play.
translations.はいはい、てきとーにね。:
Yeah, yeah. Just don't
try too hard, okay？
translations.何本気出してんの、ばかみたい。:
Why'd you go all out？
What an idiot.
translations.（そういう▲小早川＊▲も結構……）:
(▲小早川＊▲ was going
pretty hard too, though...)
translations.お風呂入ったあとなのに、汗かいちゃったし。:
I just took a bath, and
now I'm all sweaty again.
translations.リンコに本気出させることも出来ないって……やっぱジジイ？:
You couldn't even make me
get serious... Are you
really an old man？
translations.（あ、露天風呂あるのか。▲小早川＊▲も誘って行ってみようかな）:
(Oh, there's an open-air
bath. Maybe I'll ask
▲小早川＊▲ to go with me.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲、露天風呂入ろう！:
▲小早川＊▲, let's hit the
open-air bath!
translations.露天風呂？ いいや、めんどくさいし。:
An open-air bath？ Nah,
too much trouble.
translations.露天風呂……。へえ、いいかも。:
An open-air bath... Huh,
that might be nice.
translations.うん、いつの間に……ぜんぜん気付かなかった。:
Yeah, when did that start？
I didn't notice at all.
translations.ちょっ？ 大声出すなっつーの。:
Hey？ I told you not to
shout.
translations.え、うん……まあ露天風呂だし？:
Uh, yeah... Well, it is
an open-air bath.
translations.▲小早川＊▲ー！ そっちどんな感じ？:
▲小早川＊▲! How is it over
on your side？
translations.もうやめてって。人入ってきたらイヤじゃん。:
Stop it already. What if
someone else comes in？
translations.それに！ アンタの声聞きながらだと、落ち着かないの！:
Besides! I can't relax
when I can hear your voice!
translations.貸切のお風呂あるんだって……入ってみない？:
I heard there's a private
bath... Want to try it？
translations.ほんと？ じゃあ、先行ってる。:
Really？ Okay, I'll head
over first.
translations.（これが家族風呂か……▲小早川＊▲は？）:
(So this is the family
bath... Where's ▲小早川＊▲？)
translations.どうした？ 入らないのか？:
What's wrong？ Aren't you
getting in？
translations.何見てんの？ スケベ。:
What are you staring at,
perv？
translations.思いっきり見てた、スケベジジイ。:
You totally were, you
dirty old man.
translations.……なんてね。水着でお風呂ってのも結構いいじゃん？:
...Just kidding. A bath in
swimsuits is pretty nice
too, right？
translations.バカ！ 変態！ 何考えてんだっつーの！:
Idiot! Pervert! What the
heck were you thinking？
translations.外まで聞こえちゃうって！ ●が出るから！:
People outside will hear!
● will get out!
translations.（そういや▲小早川＊▲、夜景がどうこう言ってたな）:
(Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲
said something about the
night view.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。夜の散歩、行かないか？:
▲小早川＊▲. Want to go for
a night walk？
translations.今日さ、街を見渡したとき、夜景がなんとかって言ってただろ？:
Earlier today, when we
looked out over town, didn't
you mention the night view？
translations.そうだけど……やっぱいいや、めんどくさいから。:
I did, but... never mind.
It's too much trouble.
translations.言った。へへ、そういうことちゃんと覚えてるし。:
I did. Hehe, you actually
remembered that.
translations.夜の散歩……へへ。わくわくする。:
A walk at night... Hehe.
Kind of exciting.
translations.▲小早川＊▲は珍しくないだろ？:
That's nothing new for you
though, is it, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ちょっと遠いけど、歩いていくか。:
It's a bit far, but let's
walk there.
translations.なんか、想像以上で。……くやしい。:
It's just... better than I
imagined. ...It's annoying.
translations.夜景に感激、とか……キャラじゃない。:
Getting all moved by a night
view... isn't really my
style.
translations.まあとにかく、満足したってこと？:
Well, anyway, does that
mean you're satisfied？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。花火、やってるって。:
▲主人公＊▲. Sounds like
they're doing fireworks.
translations.どうする？: What do you want to do？
translations.当り前じゃん。別の花火なんだから……。:
Obviously. It's a different
fireworks show...
translations.人で、前見えない。:
There are so many people,
I can't see.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ここのビーチさ、ライトアップされるって。:
▲主人公＊▲. I heard they
light up the beach here.
translations.へえ、ビーチが？ どんな感じだろ。:
Oh, the beach？ I wonder
what that's like.
translations.いっとく？: Want to go check it out？
translations.ふーん……無関心は早く老けるってさ。:
Hmm... Being indifferent
makes you age faster, you
know.
translations.ほんとにライトアップされてる。こうなるのか。:
It really is lit up. So
this is how it looks.
translations.普通の女の子は？ ってこと？ そーいう考え捨てなって。:
You mean a 'normal girl'
would？ Drop that way of
thinking already.
translations.世の中には色んな女の子がいるけど、アンタのカノジョは一人だけなんだから。:
There are all kinds of girls
out there, but you only have
one girlfriend.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、そろそろ部屋戻ろう。:
▲小早川＊▲, let's head back
to the room soon.
translations.あのさ……そろそろ、電気消す？:
Hey... Should we turn off
the lights soon？
translations.でもさ、まだ……寝ないよね？:
Still... you're not going
to sleep yet, right？
translations.びっくりするじゃん。リンコたち、寝坊した？:
You startled me. Did we
oversleep？
translations.へへ、いつまで寝てるんだっつーの。:
Hehe, how long were you
planning on sleeping？
translations.ああ、おはよ……。もう少しまともな起こし方、ないの？:
Oh, morning... Isn't there
a more normal way you could
wake me up？
translations.まだ時間いいでしょ？ くっついてていい？:
We still have time, right？
Can I snuggle up to you？
translations.（まあ可愛いし、いっか……）:
(Well, she's cute, so I
guess it's fine...)
translations.あのさ、着替えるんだけど？: Hey, I need to get changed？
translations.リンコ、露出癖なんてないんだけど。:
I'm not an exhibitionist,
you know.
translations.ああ、終わってるな。じゃあ飯行こう。:
Oh, you are done. Let's go
get some food, then.
translations.（終わってたんだから、いいじゃん）:
(She was already done, so
what's the big deal？)
translations.まあね。嫌いなもの食べなくていいし。:
I guess so. You don't have
to eat anything you hate.
translations.好きなものが食べられるってことだろ？:
Don't you mean you get to
eat whatever you like？
translations.同じじゃ……あれ、同じか？: It's not the... Wait, is it？
translations.細かいこと気にすると、老けるよ。:
Worrying about the little
things will make you age
faster.
translations.よそ見しながら食べるからだ。:
That's what happens when
you don't pay attention
while you eat.
translations.ねえ、代わりとってきて？: Hey, go get me another one？
translations.いいホテルだったよな。:
That was a pretty nice
hotel, huh？
translations.伝説のビーチ。また行けるかな。:
The legendary beach.
I wonder if we can get
there again.
translations.酔わないといいけど。: I hope I don't get seasick.
translations.じゃあ、のんびりしますか。:
Well, guess I'll just
take it easy.
translations.デッキには出ないのか？:
You're not going out on
the deck？
translations.じゃあ、●も気が向いたら。:
Guess ●'ll go when I
feel like it, too.
translations.無理しないで、はしゃいできたら？:
You don't have to hold back
for me. Go have fun out
there.
translations.別に無理してはしゃぎたいわけじゃないって。:
It's not like I'm dying to
go run around out there.
translations.おー、やっぱ気持ちいいな。:
Man, it really does feel
nice out here.
translations.なんだ、結局来たのか。:
Oh, so you came out after
all.
translations.鳥さ。動いてる船によくついてくるね。:
Look at the birds.
Funny how they can keep up
with a moving boat.
translations.またポテチか。昼食べられなくなるぞ。:
More potato chips？ You're
gonna ruin your appetite
for lunch.
translations.大丈夫、おいしいから。あと、あげないから。:
It's fine, they're good.
And no, you can't have any.
translations.はいはい。あんまこぼすなよ。:
Yeah, yeah. Just don't
make a mess.
translations.はは、ポテチによってきたんだな。:
Haha, guess the chips
drew them in.
translations.これリンコの。って、それより結構怖いんだけど！:
These are mine! Wait,
never mind that, they're
actually pretty scary!
translations.大丈夫だろ、なんか優しそうだし。:
You'll be fine. They look
friendly enough.
translations.どこが!? みんなハンターの目してるって！:
Friendly where!? They've
all got the eyes of a
hunter!
translations.いいから、助けてよー！: Just shut up and help me!
translations.ありがと、お礼にポテチあげる。:
Thanks. Here, you can have
the chips as a thank-you.
translations.いきなり自然に対して悪口か？:
Are you really insulting
nature right off the bat？
translations.悪口じゃないっつーの。小さいのが悪いとでも？ リンコに文句ある？:
That's not an insult. What's
wrong with being small？ Got
a problem with me or what？
translations.いいがかりだ……。それより、飯食おう。:
Now you're just twisting my
words... Anyway, let's get
something to eat.
translations.ここがいいのか？ なんで？:
You want to eat here？
How come？
translations.……まあ、そうだな。でも美味そうじゃん、入ろ。:
...Well, fair enough.
Looks pretty good though.
Let's head in.
translations.ここまで来てラーメンか。●のエビちゃん食う？:
Ramen, after coming all
this way？ Want the shrimp
● got？
translations.岩のりラーメンだからいいんだっつーの。でもエビはちょうだい。:
It's rock seaweed ramen,
so it's fine. Give me the
shrimp, though.
translations.まあ、ぼちぼち探せばいいじゃん。:
Well, we can take our time
looking for it.
translations.お参りとか、いいのか？:
Aren't we going to pray
or anything？
translations.へー、灯台登れるんだ。:
Huh, you can climb up the
lighthouse.
translations.一般公開されてる灯台は少ないって、お父さんが言ってた。:
My dad said there aren't
many lighthouses open to
the public.
translations.へえ、お父さん詳しいのか？:
Oh yeah？ Does your dad
know a lot about them？
translations.なんかね、灯台マニアなんだって。で、のぼっとく？:
Yeah, apparently he's a
lighthouse buff. So, want
to climb up？
translations.まあ、いっか。お父さんに自慢できるし。:
Sure, why not. I can brag
about it to my dad.
translations.ま、しばらくこうしてるか。:
Well, let's stay like this
for a little while.
translations.だよな、旅疲れもあるし。:
Right？ We're worn out from
the trip, too.
translations.伝説のビーチ、見つかんない……。:
We can't find the
legendary beach...
translations.見つからないから、伝説なんだろうな……。:
Maybe it's a legend because
no one can find it...
translations.ビーチは見つからなくても、●は楽しかった。▲小早川＊▲は？:
Even without finding the
beach, ● had fun.
Did you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.聞こえるって。ほら、こっち。:
I really do. Come on,
this way.
translations.ビーチって、この辺だったよね。:
The beach was supposed to
be around here, right？
translations.波の音……●にも聞こえる。:
The sound of waves...
● can hear it too.
translations.ビーチって、この辺じゃなかったっけ。:
Wasn't the beach supposed
to be around here？
translations.はあ、いいよ。そんなに行きたかったわけじゃないし……。:
Forget it. It's not like I
wanted to go that badly...
translations.伝説のビーチって……ここかな？:
The legendary beach...
Is this it？
translations.だろうな。ほんとに地図に載ってない。:
Must be. It really isn't
on the map.
translations.愛を誓い合うと、ってやつ。:
That thing about swearing
our love to each other.
translations.小早川凛子は永遠にあなたを愛することを誓います。:
I, Rinko Kobayakawa, swear
to love you forever.
translations.▲苗字▲▲名前▲は、小早川凛子を永遠に愛することを誓います。:
I, ▲苗字▲ ▲名前▲,
swear to love Rinko
Kobayakawa forever.
translations.もしかして、昨日からずっと一緒？:
Wait, have we been together
nonstop since yesterday？
translations.そりゃ、二人の旅行だしな。:
Well yeah, we're on a trip
together.
translations.その間、ずっとドキドキとまんない。:
My heart hasn't stopped
pounding this whole time.
translations.あのときからずっと。:
It's been like this
ever since then.
translations.あのときから、ドキドキしっぱなしで……。:
My heart's been racing
nonstop ever since...
translations.どんどん好きになってる。:
And I just keep falling
for you more and more.
translations.好きが、とまんない。:
I just can't stop
loving you.
translations.でも、知りたい。これから先のことも。:
But I want to see what's
ahead for us, too.
translations.そっちの好きも、もっとちょうだい……。:
So give me more of your
love, too...
translations.ここだよね、伝説のビーチ。:
This is it, right？
The legendary beach.
translations.だろうな。地図にも載ってない。:
Must be. It's not even
on the map.
translations.すごいじゃん……。ほんとだったんだ。:
Wow, amazing...
So it really is real.
translations.小早川凛子はあなたを愛することを誓います、永遠に。:
I, Rinko Kobayakawa, swear
to love you... forever.
translations.なんかさ、昨日からずっと一緒じゃん。:
We've been together nonstop
since yesterday, huh.
translations.そうだな、はじめてかもな。:
Yeah, that might be a first
for us.
translations.これだけ一緒にいると、飽きてもよさそうなもんだけど……。:
You'd think it'd be okay to
get tired of each other
after all this time...
translations.……ていうか、そんなのありえない。:
...Actually, there's no way
I'd ever get tired of you.
translations.もっと一緒にいたいと思ってる。:
All I can think is how I
want to be with you more.
translations.離れたくないって、思ってる。:
That I never want us to
be apart.
translations.ああ、同じだ。: Yeah, I feel the same way.
translations.なのに帰らないといけないの？:
And yet we still have to
go home？
translations.しょうがないことなのは、わかるけど……。:
I know it can't be helped,
though...
translations.今はこれでガマンする。でも大人になったら……。:
I'll put up with it for now.
But when we're older...
translations.うん……。大好き……キス、したい。:
Yeah... I love you...
I want to kiss you.
translations.ここが、伝説のビーチ……。:
So this is the legendary
beach...
translations.だな。地図にも載ってない。:
Yeah. It's not even on
the map.
translations.ほんとだったんだ……。すごく……キレイ。:
It really does exist...
It's so... pretty.
translations.ねえ、したいな。: Hey, I want to do it.
translations.言ったでしょ。ここで愛を誓い合うの。:
I told you, right？
Swearing our love here.
translations.小早川凛子は永遠にあなたを愛します。:
I, Rinko Kobayakawa, will
love you forever.
translations.こんなに一緒にいられるの、はじめて……。:
It's the first time we've
been together this long...
translations.ひとつ、大人になれたね。:
We grew up a little,
didn't we？
translations.あとどれだけ大人になればいいかな。:
I wonder how much older
we have to get.
translations.帰らずにすむかな、って。:
Before we don't have to
go back home.
translations.困らせちゃった？: Did I put you on the spot？
translations.いいよ。充分、楽しいもん。:
Never mind. I'm having
plenty of fun already.
translations.大好きな人と一緒にいられるだけで、幸せだもん。:
Just being with the one
I love makes me happy.
translations.大好き。あのときからずっと。:
I love you. I have ever
since back then.
translations.もう一回、あのときみたいに……。:
One more time, just like
back then...
translations.大好き……。キス、しよ？:
I love you...
Let's kiss, okay？
translations.うん……リンコたちの思い出の場所……。:
Yeah... Our special place
full of memories...
translations.今、何考えてる？:
What's on your mind
right now？
translations.リンコは、最初にここに来たときのこと。:
I'm thinking about the first
time we came here.
translations.うん……●も、そうかな。:
Yeah... I guess you are too,
●.
translations.このあと何したいかも、わかる？:
Do you also know what I
want to do next？
translations.さすがに疲れたな。もうちょっとがんばれ。:
Must be worn out. Hang in
there just a little longer.
translations.電車の時間までは、少しあるな。:
We still have a bit of time
before our train.
translations.土産、見て行くか？:
Want to look at souvenirs
before we go？
translations.誰に買うんだ？: Who are you buying them for？
translations.家族にだけでいいや。: Just for my family is fine.
translations.旅行のお土産買わないだけで壊れる友情なんて持ち合わせてないもん。:
I don't have friendships
that fall apart just over
not buying souvenirs.
translations.かっこいいような、言い訳のような……。:
Can't tell if that's cool
or just an excuse...
translations.いいの。それにお土産買うのって難しいじゃん。:
It's fine. Besides, buying
souvenirs is hard.
translations.だから苦手なんだってば。お土産のセンス、自信ない。:
I told you, I'm bad at this.
I'm not confident in my
taste in souvenirs.
translations.（妙なこと気にするな）:
(What a weird thing to
be self-conscious about.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲さ。結構焼けた？:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Did you
get pretty tanned？
translations.そう？ 痛くなるのやだな。:
Really？ I hope it doesn't
start hurting.
translations.さすがに疲れたな。寝ちゃいそうだ。:
I'm pretty wiped out.
I might fall asleep.
translations.爆睡し過ぎ。帰れなくなるとこだったじゃん。:
You slept way too hard.
We almost couldn't get home.
translations.悪かったよ。でも爆睡っぷりでいったら▲小早川＊▲も……。:
My bad. Though if we're
talking about sleeping hard,
▲小早川＊▲, you too...
translations.そこは見て見ぬフリ。:
You're supposed to pretend
you didn't see that.
translations.リンコたち、どれくらいの間、一緒にいたかな。:
I wonder how long the two
of us were together.
translations.まあ、大体一日半だよな。:
Well, about a day and a
half, right？
translations.一日半でこれか……。:
Just a day and a half,
and it's like this...
translations.もっと長くいたらさ、どうなるのかな？:
What do you think would
happen if we stayed together
longer？
translations.想像はつくけどね。:
Though I have a pretty
good idea.
translations.へへ、秘密。でも、悪い感じじゃないよ？:
Hehe, it's a secret.
Nothing bad, though.
translations.ごめん、送ってもらっちゃった。:
Sorry for making you walk
me home.
translations.いいよ……はあ、終わっちゃったな。:
Don't worry about it...
Sigh, it's all over now.
translations.あのさ……また、行きたい。: Um... I want to go again.
translations.ああ、そうだな。また行くか。:
Yeah, me too. Let's go
again sometime.
translations.はあ、お別れか……。バイバイ。:
Sigh, time to say goodbye...
Bye-bye.
translations.まさかこのまま帰らないよね。大事なこと忘れてる。:
Don't tell me you're just
going home. You're forgetting
something important.
translations.もしもし、今どこ？:
Hello？ Where are you
right now？
translations.もうすぐ、例のコンビニだけど。:
I'm almost at that
convenience store.
translations.あのさ、荷物見せてもらってもいい？:
Hey, mind if I look
through your bag？
translations.リンコの荷物混ざっちゃったかも。:
Some of my stuff might've
gotten mixed in.
translations.そんな大事なもの？ なに？:
Is it really that important？
What is it？
translations.そういうことは聞くなっつーの。:
Don't ask about stuff
like that.
translations.（行っちゃった。せっかくの別れの雰囲気が……）:
(She's gone. So much for our
bittersweet goodbye...)
translations.ふーん。まあこんなもんか。:
Hmm. Guess this is about
what I expected.
translations.楽しくないわけないじゃん。:
There's no way I'm not
having fun.
translations.だって、一緒にいたいし。:
I mean, I want to be
with you.
translations.まあ、来てよかったけど。:
Well, I'm glad we came,
though.
translations.景色見るのって、そんなに楽しい？:
Is looking at the scenery
really that fun？
translations.なんか眠い……。あ、退屈ってわけじゃないけど。:
I'm kinda sleepy... Oh,
not that I'm bored or
anything.
translations.春だなあ……とか思ってる？ 年寄りくさい。:
Are you thinking, 'Ah, it's
spring...' or something？
You sound like an old man.
translations.暑くもなく、寒くもなく。それが一番。:
Not too hot, not too cold.
That's the best.
translations.結構、紅葉してる。:
The leaves have turned
quite a bit.
translations.寒い！ なんとかして。: It's freezing! Do something about it.
translations.１泊で全部回るって、やっぱ無理？: Is it really impossible to see everything on an overnight trip？
translations.疲れた。……ちょっとだけだから。: I'm tired. ...Just for a little bit.
translations.はい、この場所のウンチク語って。冗談だって。: Okay, hit me with some trivia about this place. Just kidding.
translations.こんなにずっと一緒にいるのって……。: Being together for this long is...
translations.このあとは、なんだっけ？: What were we doing after this again？
translations.……何見てんの？ いいけど。: ...What are you staring at？ Not that I care.
translations.そういえば畳って、久々かも。: Come to think of it, it's been a while since I've been on tatami.
translations.いい部屋だよね。“ぽく”ってさ。: It's a nice room, isn't it？ Really feels like a proper inn.
translations.バレンタインのチョコ持ってきたから。ほら、いちおうカノジョだし。: I brought you Valentine's chocolate. Here. I am your girlfriend, after all.
translations.ありがとう！ 嬉しいよ。: Thanks! That makes me really happy.
translations.……そんなにはしゃぐようなことでもないじゃん。こういうイベントなんだしさ。: ...It's nothing to get that worked up over. It's just what you do on days like this.
translations.そうかな、▲小早川＊▲にもらえたってこと、素直に嬉しいよ。: Maybe, but I'm honestly just happy to get some from you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.それなら、わざわざ並んで買った甲斐があったけど……。: Well, in that case, I guess waiting in line to buy it was worth it...
translations.そんなことまでしてくれたんだ。: You went to all that trouble for me.
translations.ま、他の買い物のついでに。……たまたま目に入ったし……。: Well, I was already out shopping for other stuff. ...It just happened to catch my eye...
translations.そっか、ありがとう。これは●もホワイトデーには気合い入れないとな。: Got it, thanks. Looks like ● will have to go all out for White Day, too.
translations.……あ、そういうのもあったね。そっか、うん。それじゃ、よろしく。: ...Oh right, that's a thing too. Got it, yeah. I'll be counting on you, then.
translations.あ……平静を装ってもダメだよ。リンコは全部お見通しなんだから。: Oh... Trying to play it cool won't work. Rinko sees right through you.
translations.もしかしてバレンタインか？: Wait, is this about Valentine's Day？
translations.カノジョがいるのにもらえなかったら、アンタが可哀想じゃん？ ってわけで……。: It'd be pretty sad if you had a girlfriend and still didn't get anything, right？ So...
translations.くれないの？: You're not giving it to me？
translations.なんかこのまま渡すのもシャクだからさ、“お願いします！ チョコをくださいリンコ様: It kind of bugs me to just hand it over, so say, 'Please! Give me some chocolate, Lady Rinko!'
translations.（照れ隠し、なのか？）: (Is she just trying to hide her embarrassment？)
translations.今日、バレンタインじゃん。もしかしたらチョコ待ってるかなーって。: It's Valentine's Day today, right？ I figured maybe you were waiting for some chocolate.
translations.そんなの当たり前じゃん、カノジョなんだからさ。はい。: Of course I am. I'm your girlfriend, after all. Here.
translations.手作り？ そっか、頑張ってくれたんだな……。: Homemade？ I see, you really worked hard on it for me...
translations.苦労したんだからさ、ちゃんと味わってよね。へへ。: It was a lot of work, so you'd better savor every bite, okay？ Hehe.
translations.うん。あとさ……ホワイトデー、期待してるからね？: Good. And hey... I'm counting on you for White Day, okay？
translations.なに？ なんかあったっけ。: What？ Is something going on today？
translations.誕生日……だよね、今日。おめでとう。: It's your birthday today... right？ Happy birthday.
translations.……しょうがないじゃん。いちおう、カノジョなんだしさ。: ...Well, what else was I gonna do？ I am your girlfriend, after all.
translations.あと、これ、プレゼント。気に入るかどうかは保証しないけど。: Also, here's a present. No guarantees you'll like it, though.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が選んでくれたんだろ？ きっと気に入るよ。: You picked it out for me, right, ▲小早川＊▲？ I'm sure I'll love it.
translations.……だといいんだけどさ……嬉しかったり、する？: ...I hope so, anyway... Does it make you happy？
translations.もちろん、本当にありがとう、▲小早川＊▲……。: Of course. Thank you so much, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.今日ってさ、アンタの誕生日だよね？ その、おめでとう。: Today's your birthday, right？ Um, happy birthday.
translations.もっと派手に喜んでもいいよ。リンコがわざわざプレゼントまで用意してあげたんだから: You could look a little more excited, you know. I even went out of my way to get you a present.
translations.柄にもなく、迷っちゃったっつーの。感謝しないと許さないから。: It's totally out of character for me, spending so long trying to pick something out. You'd better be grateful.
translations.本当にありがとう、▲小早川＊▲。●のために、いろいろ考えてくれたんだな……。: Thank you so much, ▲小早川＊▲. You really put a lot of thought into this for ●...
translations.あー、もう！ なんでこんなに照れるんだろう……。: Ugh, seriously! Why am I getting so embarrassed...？
translations.お誕生日おめでとう。一番に言いたかったんだけど、もう誰かに言われちゃった？: Happy birthday. I wanted to be the first to say it, but did someone else beat me to it？
translations.そっか、ありがとう！ 大丈夫、▲小早川＊▲が一番乗りだよ。: Oh, right, thank you! Don't worry, ▲小早川＊▲, you're the very first.
translations.そっか。よかった……。あ、リンコね、プレゼント持ってきたんだけど。: Really？ Good... Oh, I brought you a present, too.
translations.リンコも、アンタの喜ぶ顔が見られて嬉しいよ。: I'm happy I got to see your face light up, too.
translations.プレゼントってさ、相手のそういう顔を見るために贈るのかもね。: Maybe that's the whole point of giving presents—just to see that look on the other person's face.
translations.今日、誕生日だよな。おめでとう。: Today's your birthday, right？ Happy birthday.
translations.それと、プレゼントもあるんだ。: And I got you a present, too.
translations.とにかく、お礼は言っとく。ありがと。: Anyway, I should at least say thanks. So, thanks.
translations.いいよ、そんなに気にしなくても。: Don't worry about it, it's no big deal.
translations.最近、思うんだけどさ。リンコ、ずっとアンタに甘えてばっかりだよね？: I've been thinking lately... I do nothing but lean on you all the time, don't I？
translations.プレゼントだけじゃなくて、いろんなもの、もらってる……。: Not just presents, either. You've given me so much...
translations.だけどリンコ、こんなんだから大したこと返せないし……正直さ、リンコのことまだ好き: Meanwhile, the way I am, I can never really give much back... Honestly, do you still like me？
translations.当たり前だろ。▲小早川＊▲の気持ち、ちゃんと伝わってるって。:
Of course I do. I know
how you feel, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そっか……だったら、嬉しい、かな。:
I see... Then I guess
that makes me happy.
translations.どうした？ 今日は素直？:
What's this？ Being
extra honest today？
translations.それは今日だけ、誕生日だから特別ってことにして。:
That's just for today.
Call it a birthday special.
translations.ははっ、そうか。じゃあ●も、その言葉を素直に受け取っておくよ。:
Haha, okay. Then ●'ll
just take your word for it.
translations.ああ、もう。やっぱ言うんじゃなかった。:
Ugh, jeez. I knew I
shouldn't have said that.
translations.今日、誕生日だろ？ おめでとう。:
Today's your birthday,
right？ Happy birthday.
translations.……それは嬉しいけどさ、そんなに慌てなくても、逃げないってば。:
...That makes me happy,
but no need to rush. I'm
not going anywhere.
translations.つい嬉しくってさ。プレゼントもあるんだ……。:
I just got excited. I have
a present for you, too...
translations.これ、欲しかったヤツだ。やるじゃん。:
This is the one I wanted.
Not bad.
translations.うん……リンコの好み、そこそこわかってるね。:
Yeah... You've got a fair
idea of what I like.
translations.……ありがと、気持ちだけでも嬉しいからさ。:
...Thanks. I appreciate
the thought, at least.
translations.なんかさ、家族以外の人に祝ってもらうのって、ヘンな感じ……。:
It feels kind of weird,
having someone besides my
family celebrate it...
translations.そう？ じゃあ、慣らしてこうか。毎年のことなんだから。:
Yeah？ Then let's get you
used to it. It's going to
happen every year now.
translations.う……。そうだよね。毎年、なんだもんね。:
Ugh... Right. Every year
from now on, huh.
translations.だけどそれはアンタだって同じだから！ アンタの誕生日にはお祝いし返してやるから。:
But the same goes for
you! On your birthday, I'll
celebrate you right back.
translations.はは、じゃあ●も慣れておくか。:
Haha, guess ●'d better
get used to it too.
translations.なにそれ、余裕ぶっちゃってさ。その余裕も、今のうちだよ。:
What's with you acting so
cool？ Enjoy it while you
still can.
translations.そっか、ほどほどに頼むよ。: I see. Go easy on me, okay？
translations.誕生日おめでとう！ プレゼント受け取ってくれるか？:
Happy birthday! Will you
take this present？
translations.あっ……これ、嬉しい……。大切にするね。:
Oh... I love this...
I'll treasure it.
translations.わっ……こんなのあるんだ……。:
Whoa... I didn't know
they made things like this.
translations.これ……。あ、うん。気持ちは嬉しいけど……。:
This is... Oh, yeah. I
appreciate the thought,
at least...
translations.気にするなって。年に一度の誕生日なんだから。:
Don't mention it. Your
birthday only comes once
a year.
translations.うん。でも、プレゼント選ぶ時だって、リンコのことずっと考えてくれてたんだよね？:
Yeah. Still, you thought
about me the whole time
you picked this, right？
translations.うん。だから●もずっと楽しかったよ。●の方からお礼言いたいぐらい。:
Yeah. That's why ● had
fun the whole time. ●
should be thanking you.
translations.へへ、なにそれ？:
Hehe, what's that supposed
to mean？
translations.リンコはさ、一日中ずーっとアンタのことばっかり考えてることだって、あるよ？:
Some days, I spend the
entire day thinking only
about you, you know？
translations.カレシだもん。当たり前だよ。:
You're my boyfriend.
Of course I do.
translations.ああ、記念日だよな。●たちが付き合い始めた。:
Yeah, our anniversary.
The day ● started going
out with you.
translations.一応、プレゼント用意したんだけど。:
I got a present ready
for you, actually.
translations.ん、リンコも。じゃあ、交換しよっか。:
Yeah, me too. Want to
trade, then？
translations.これ、リンコがずっと狙ってたやつだ……。:
I've had my eye on this
for ages...
translations.うん、大切にする。:
Yeah, I'll take good care
of it.
translations.まぁ記念だし……もらっとくけどさ……。:
Well, it's our anniversary...
I guess I'll take it...
translations.今度は来年に向けての準備かな。どうせなら毎年お祝いしたいしさ。:
Now to start getting ready for
next year. Might as well
celebrate it every year.
translations.せっかくの記念日だもんな。:
It is our anniversary,
after all.
translations.初心忘れるべからず、だね。:
Never forget where we started,
right？
translations.（えっと……そういうことでいいのか？）:
(Uh... I guess that's one way
to put it？)
translations.もちろん。●たちが付き合い始めた記念日だろ？:
Of course. It's the anniversary
of when you and ● started
going out, right？
translations.ちゃんとプレゼントだって用意したぞ。:
I even got a present ready
for you.
translations.えっ、ほんとに？ じゃあ……リンコと交換。:
Wait, really？ Then... trade
with me.
translations.すごい……、こういうのって記念になるよね。:
Wow... A gift like this really
makes it memorable.
translations.へぇ……大切にしよっと。:
Huh... I'll take good care
of it.
translations.これからもさ、こうやって毎年お祝いできるといいかな。:
It'd be nice if we could keep
celebrating like this every
year.
translations.きっとさ、こういう小さな、嬉しかったり楽しかったりがさ、恋人同士ってことなんだろ:
I bet all these little happy,
fun moments are what being a
couple is all about.
translations.ああ、もう今から来年のこととか考えちゃうよ。:
Yeah, I'm already thinking
about next year.
translations.気が早いっつーの。:
You're getting way ahead of
yourself.
translations.ああ、●たちが付き合い始めた記念日だな。:
Yeah, it's the anniversary of
when you and ● started
going out.
translations.当たり前だろ。ちゃんとプレゼントだって用意したぞ。:
Of course I did. I even got a
present ready for you.
translations.へへ、実は……リンコも。交換だね。:
Hehe, actually... me too.
Let's trade.
translations.わぁ、こういうのくれるとは思わなかった……。:
Whoa, I didn't expect you to
get me something like this...
translations.一応アンタのくれたものだしさ、好きになれるかもしれないし。:
Well, it's from you, so maybe
it'll grow on me.
translations.来年もさ、同じことができるといいね。:
It'd be nice if we could do
the same thing next year.
translations.そうだな。来年も再来年も……。:
Yeah. Next year, and the year
after that...
translations.リンコがお婆ちゃんになっても？: Even when I'm an old lady？
translations.うん、その時は、どんなものプレゼントするんだろうな……。:
Yeah. I wonder what kind of
present I'll get you then...
translations.けっこー、イヤじゃないけど？:
I actually don't mind it,
you know？
translations.子供みたい。いーけど。:
You're like a kid.
Not that I mind.
translations.どんな反応すればいいか、わかんないよ。:
I don't know how I'm
supposed to react to that.
translations.アンタがいいなら、いいけど。:
If it makes you happy,
I guess it's fine.
translations.リンコのでさ、楽しいわけ？:
Is mine really
that much fun？
translations.さりげなくやってくれちゃってさ。:
Acting all casual
about it, huh.
translations.そんなにリンコのこと好き？ バレバレだっつーの。:
You like me that much？
It's totally obvious.
translations.……ダメだ。ダメなとこが見つかんないや、へへ。:
...No good. Can't find a
single thing wrong, hehe.
translations.まあ、たまにはね。次もだと、イヤだけど。:
Well, once in a while.
Not next time, though.
translations.最後の一歩がさ、肝心なわけ。:
It's that final step
that really matters.
translations.へへ、さっすが！: Hehe, knew you could do it!
translations.そうそう、ポイントは地道に稼ぐもんだよ？:
Right, you have to earn
points little by little.
translations.期待がおっきかったのかも。:
Maybe my hopes
were just too high.
translations.詰めが甘い。完璧にやられても……困るけど。:
Sloppy finish. Though if
you did it perfectly...
that'd be trouble too.
translations.ほら……甘えてあげるから、さ。: Come on... I'll let you spoil me.
translations.そっちだって、期待してたんでしょ？: You were hoping for this too, weren't you？
translations.いーけど、ちゃんとしてね？: Fine, just do it right, okay？
translations.アンタって……。うん、いいよ。: You really are... Yeah, go ahead.
translations.早く、しろっつーの……。: Just hurry up and do it...
translations.お願いしていい？: Can I leave it to you？
translations.もっと？ リンコ、どーしよう……。: More？ What am I gonna do...
translations.何これ、リンコたち……どうなるの？: What is this？ What's going to happen to us？
translations.なんもわかんない……考えらんない。: I don't know anymore... I can't even think.
translations.もう、何度か意識飛んじゃってる……。: My mind's gone blank a few times already...
translations.リンコのこと好きって……伝わったよ。: I can really tell... how much you love me.
translations.こんなこと……誰にも言えない。: I could never... tell anyone about this.
translations.アンタとのキス……好きだから、さ。: I just... really like kissing you.
translations.ああもう……大好き。: Ugh, geez... I love you so much.
translations.好き、なんだってば……。: I'm telling you, I love you...
translations.してほしいんだって。: I'm telling you I want you to.
translations.もう、しろっつーの。: Come on, just do it already.
translations.言わせんな……キスしたい。: Don't make me say it... I want a kiss.
translations.もう、お願い。キス、してほしいよ……。: Come on, please. I want you to kiss me...
translations.なんでキスしないの？ してほしいのに……。: Why won't you kiss me？ I want you to...
translations.バレンタインにキスって……なんかそのまんま。いいけど。: A kiss on Valentine's... kind of cliché. Not that I mind.
translations.ホワイトデー、これのお返しも受け付けるから。: I'll take something in return for this on White Day, too.
translations.幸せ者だね、チョコ以外にももらえてさ？: Aren't you lucky, getting more than just chocolate？
translations.記念日の思い出、増えたね。……そんだけ。: That's one more anniversary memory. ...That's all.
translations.記念のキスなんだから……覚えててよ。: It's a kiss for our anniversary... so don't forget it.
translations.へへ、記念日にキスしちゃった。: Hehe, we kissed on our anniversary.
translations.こっちのプレゼントも、もらっといてあげる。: I'll go ahead and take this present, too.
translations.またもらっちゃった……プレゼント。: I got another present from you...
translations.まあ誕生日だしさ。……いつもしてるかもだけど。: Well, it is your birthday. ...Even if we do this all the time.
translations.これも……プレゼントみたいなもんだから。: This is... kind of like a present, too.
translations.このプレゼントもちゃんと受け取った？ へへ、ならいいよ。: Did you get this present, too？ Hehe, good.
translations.はあ、今年のクリスマス、忘れられなくなった。: Hah... Now I'll never forget this Christmas.
translations.今日のリンコ、ちょっと素直かも？ クリスマスだし。: Maybe I'm being a little more honest today？ It is Christmas, after all.
translations.クリスマスのキス……特別だね。: A Christmas kiss... It feels special.
translations.記念日だからキスしたってわけじゃ、ないし。: It's not like I only kissed you because it's our anniversary.
translations.記念日のたびにキス、とか考えてるんじゃないの？: Are you planning on kissing me every anniversary or something？
translations.寂しい思いさせた分……もっとして。: Kiss me more... to make up for how lonely I was.
translations.ガマン、してたんだっつーの……。: I was holding back this whole time, you know...
translations.好き、もうケンカなんてやだ……。: I love you. I don't want to fight anymore...
translations.もう離れるの、いや。: I don't want to be apart anymore.
translations.あのさ……ちっちゃい子ってどう思う……？: Hey... What do you think of small girls...？
translations.そうだな、時々生意気だと思うこともあるけど、基本的には好きかな。かわいいだろ。: Well, they can be a little cheeky sometimes, but for the most part I like them. They're cute, right？
translations.親戚の子たちなんかと遊ぶとさ、アイツら子どものくせにたまに大人びたこと言うんだよ: Whenever I play with my younger relatives, they're just kids, but sometimes they say the most grown-up things.
translations.え？ ……違う？: Huh？ ...Is that not what you meant？
translations.なんの話？ ●、また勘違いしてる？: What are you talking about？ Did ● get the wrong idea again？
translations.一人で納得するなよ。気持ち悪いだろ。: Don't just settle it in your own head. That's weird.
translations.付き合ってて、やっぱり身長の差って……気にする？: When you're dating someone, does a height difference... bother you？
translations.なんだよ、突然。: Where did that come from all of a sudden？
translations.これは知り合いの話なんだけど。: This is about someone I know, though.
translations.デートで並んで歩くときなんか、背が小さいとかなり気にするらしい。: Apparently, when you're walking side by side on a date, being short makes you really self-conscious.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。そんなこと、気にしてるんだ？: ▲小早川＊▲. Does that sort of thing bother you？
translations.だから、リンコじゃなくて、知り合いの話。: Like I said, it's not about me. It's about someone I know.
translations.どうして気になるのか、●にはわからないんだけど。: ● can't really see why that's something to worry about, though.
translations.ほら、歩く歩幅とかさ。: You know, like the difference in your stride when you walk.
translations.●はいつも▲小早川＊▲に合わせてるつもりだけど、早すぎたか……？: ● always try to keep pace with ▲小早川＊▲, though. Was I walking too fast...？
translations.合わせて……そうなんだ、気づかなかった。: You match my pace...？ Oh, I didn't realize.
translations.だから、そんなこと気にしなくていいと思うけどな。: So I really don't think you need to worry about that.
translations.そっか……知り合いに伝えとく。: I see... I'll pass that on to this person I know.
translations.身長の話だけどさ、まだ気にしてる？: About that height thing... Is it still bothering you？
translations.だから、知り合いの話だって。: I told you, it's about someone I know.
translations.でもさ、好きになってしまえば、そんな細かいこと、普通はどうでも良くなるだろ。: Still, once you fall for someone, little things like that usually don't matter at all, right？
translations.だって、身長の高い低いで付き合うかどうかなんて、ほとんどの奴は決めないぞ。: I mean, almost nobody decides whether to date someone based on how tall or short they are.
translations.そっか。ちょっと安心。: I see. That's a little reassuring.
translations.やっぱり気にしてたんだ。: So it really was bothering you.
translations.……まあ……ちょっと。……ほら……キスするときとか……さ。: ...Well... a little. ...You know... like when we kiss and stuff...
translations.……あ、そういうことか。でも、キスのとき、一生懸命背伸びをしてくれる姿って、それ: ...Oh, that's what you mean. Still, I really like how you stretch up on your tiptoes whenever we kiss.
translations.なんでそうなるんだよ……。: How does that make me a pervert...？
translations.ずっと気にしてるみたいだけど、身長が小さいなら小さいで……。: You seem really hung up on it, but if you're short, being short—
translations.何度も小さいとか言うな。: Stop calling me short over and over.
translations.……小柄なら小柄でいいこともあるんじゃないか？: ...Well, being petite has its good points too, doesn't it？
translations.ほら、“お姫さま抱っこ”がしやすいとか……あ、こら怒るなって。: You know, like how easy it is to carry you like a princess... Hey, come on, don't get mad.
translations.なら、どうしてそんな顔してるんだよ。: Then why are you making that face？
translations.お姫さま抱っこってさ……どんな感じなのかな。……あ、やっぱ今のなし。: Being carried like a princess... I wonder what that feels like. ...Uh, never mind, forget I said that.
translations.興味はあるんだ？: So you are curious about it？
translations.それはリンコだって、女の子なわけだし……でも、やって欲しいなんて思わないけど。: Well, I am a girl, after all... Not that I'm asking you to do it or anything.
translations.どうして？ やって欲しければ●がいつでもやってやるけど？: Why not？ If you want, ● can do it for you anytime.
translations.誰も見てないところでなら、いいんじゃないか？: Wouldn't it be fine if no one's watching？
translations.うん、それなら……って、なんでリンコまで……。もう、バカじゃん。: Yeah, then maybe... Wait, why am I getting swept up in this too...？ Ugh, you're an idiot.
translations.（素直にやって欲しいって、言えばいいのに）: (She could just be honest and say she wants me to do it.)
translations.あのさ。結婚したらやっぱ新婚旅行は行きたい？: Hey. If you got married, would you want to go on a honeymoon？
translations.……な、なにをいきなり。: ...W-Where did that come from all of a sudden？
translations.勘違いすんなっつーの。うちのお父さんと……お母さんの話。: Don't get the wrong idea. I'm talking about my dad and... my mom.
translations.再婚してから、旅行くらい行ってないのか？: Haven't they gone on a trip or anything since they got remarried？
translations.新婚旅行どころか一泊旅行もなし。: Forget a honeymoon, they haven't even gone away for a single night.
translations.仕事が忙しいとか？: Are they busy with work or something？
translations.それもあるけど、子どもを置いていけないってのがあるんじゃないの？: There's that, too, but I think it's more that they feel they can't leave the kids behind.
translations.ああ。弟ってまだ小さいんだよな？: Right. Your little brother is still pretty young, isn't he？
translations.うん。リンコだけなら、置いていってもらっても構わないんだけど。: Yeah. If it were just me, I wouldn't mind them leaving me home alone, though.
translations.女の子の一人暮らしは、短期間でも、さすがにまずいだろ。: Leaving a girl home all by herself, even for a short trip, probably isn't a good idea.
translations.一人は……慣れてるよ。それに……今はアンタもいるしね。: I'm used to... being alone. Besides... I have you now, too.
translations.変な想像すんなっつーの。誰も家に呼ぶなんて言ってないから。: Get your mind out of the gutter. I never said anything about inviting you over.
translations.弟を預けられれば、新婚旅行に行けるのか……。: So if someone could look after your brother, they'd be able to go on a honeymoon...
translations.そう簡単でもない。お父さんはともかく……お母さんは心配症なとこあるし。: It's not that simple. My dad is one thing, but... my mom tends to be a worrier.
translations.なに？ 変なこと言った!?: What？ Did I say something weird!？
translations.普通にお母さんって言えるようになったんだなって。: I was just thinking how naturally you call her "Mom" now.
translations.そ。リンコだっていつまでも子どもじゃないんだから。: Yeah. I can't stay a kid forever, you know.
translations.良かったな、ちゃんと“家族”になれて。: I'm really glad for you, that you've become a real family.
translations.あのさ、そういう保護者みたいなことばっか言ってると、早く老けるよ？: You know, if you keep talking like my guardian all the time, you're gonna get old fast？
translations.それでさ、近くの温泉なら家族で行けるんじゃないかって、パンフレットをさっき集めて: Anyway, I figured we could go as a family if it's a hot spring nearby, so I picked up some brochures earlier.
translations.へえ。今はいろんなプランがあるんだな。: Huh. They really have all kinds of plans these days.
translations.そ。近くなら一泊二日からあるから、予定も立てやすいしね。: Yeah. If it's nearby, they have overnight packages, so it's easier to schedule, too.
translations.変なのばっかり見つけんな。このスケベ大魔神。: Stop picking out all the weird ones, you giant pervert.
translations.たまたまこれだけだろ、見つけたのは!!: I just happened to spot this one by chance!!
translations.そんなことより、親にはこのこと、ちゃんと話したのか？: More importantly, have you actually talked to your parents about this yet？
translations.まだ。なかなか切り出すタイミングがなくて……。: Not yet. I haven't really found the right time to bring it up...
translations.でも、なるべく早く話だけしといた方がいいぞ。一人で決めるわけにもいかないんだから: Still, you should at least bring it up with them as soon as you can. You can't exactly decide everything on your own.
translations.うん、わかってる。今日帰ったら話すよ。: Yeah, I know. I'll bring it up when I get home today.
translations.……ついさっき、家から電話があった。: ...I just got a call from home.
translations.うん……泣かれちゃったよ。: Yeah... She started crying on me.
translations.リンコ、旅行雑誌とか調べてたから、なんとなく、何か隠し事してるの感じてたみたい。: Since I'd been looking through travel magazines and stuff, she could kind of tell I was hiding something.
translations.最初はまた家出でもするのか不安でしょうがなかったって……。だから、本当のこと話し: At first she was worried sick that I might run away from home again... So I told her the truth.
translations.それで電話口で泣かれちゃったのか……。: And that made her cry over the phone...
translations.うん。でも泣いたのは、嬉しいからだって……。: Yeah. Though she said she was crying because she was happy...
translations.泣かなくたっていいのに。娘だもん、親が幸せになって欲しいって、そりゃ考えるよ……: She didn't have to cry over it. I'm their daughter—of course I want my parents to be happy...
translations.そっか。なら、早く帰ってあげた方がいいんじゃないのか？: I see. Shouldn't you head home to them soon, then？
translations.……うん。今日家族みんなで旅行の計画練ろうって……お母さんが言ってた。: ...Yeah. Mom said... we should all plan the trip together as a family today.
translations.うん。あとでちゃんと結果報告するから。: Yeah. I'll let you know how it goes later.
translations.●のことは気にしなくていいから。旅行、行けるといいな。: You don't have to worry about ●. I hope you get to go on that trip.
translations.最近思うんけどさ、１０年後の自分はなにしてるのかな。: I've been wondering lately... What am I gonna be doing ten years from now？
translations.前はさ、将来のことなんか……って思ってたけど、最近はなんとなく。: Before, I couldn't care less about the future... but lately it's been on my mind.
translations.うぬぼれんなっつーの。……少しくらいは影響あるかもしれないけど。: Don't flatter yourself. ...Though you might've had a little influence on it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲の１０年後か。ＯＬとかやってるのかな。……なわけないか。: ▲小早川＊▲ ten years from now, huh. Think you'll be an office worker or something？ ...Nah, I can't see it.
translations.なんか……枠に囚われないっていうか……そういうこと。: Just that... you don't really fit into a mold, I guess... Something like that.
translations.ぜんぜんわかんない。けど、アンタは間違いなく１０年後、オッサンだね。: That makes zero sense. Though in ten years, you're definitely gonna be a total old man.
translations.……そんなことないだろ。: ...Come on, I won't be that bad.
translations.精神的な部分でってこと。他人の世話ばっかり焼いてると、すぐ老けるよ？: I mean mentally. Keep fussing over other people all the time and you'll age fast, you know？
translations.……誰が焼かせてるんだ。: ...And whose fault is it that I have to fuss？
translations.１０年後の話だけどさ、結局▲小早川＊▲は自分でどう考えてたんだ？: Going back to that ten-years-from-now thing, what did you actually have in mind, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.将来なりたいものを考えてみるとか。: Try thinking about what you want to be in the future.
translations.なわけないっつーの。本気にしかけた？: As if. Did you almost buy that？
translations.格ゲーばっかやってるとこ見てるから、つい。: I always see you playing fighting games, so I couldn't help it.
translations.はぁ……これだから現実と虚構の区別もつかない人は……。: Sigh... Dealing with people who can't tell reality from fiction, I swear...
translations.そこまで言わなくてもいいだろ。結局何になりたいんだ？: You don't have to put it like that. So what do you actually want to be？
translations.リンコの１０年後の話より、アンタはどうなってると思うの？: Forget about me in ten years—what do you think you'll be doing？
translations.●か……。無難にサラリーマンとか？: ●, huh... Playing it safe as an office worker, maybe？
translations.別にいいけど。もっと夢とかないの？ そういうとこが、オッサンくさいんだって。: Nothing wrong with that, I guess. Don't you have any bigger dreams？ That's the exact kind of thing that makes you sound like an old man.
translations.夢なあ……。あったかい家庭を持ててたら、それだけで幸せかな。: A dream, huh... If I have a warm, happy family, I think that alone would be enough for me.
translations.おかしい？ 前は結婚とかありえないって思ってたけど……。: Is it weird？ Before, I thought there was no way I'd ever get married, but...
translations.お父さんの再婚がきっかけ？:
Is that because your dad
got remarried？
translations.それもあるかな。でもさ……それだけじゃなくて……やっぱいい。:
Maybe that's part of it.
But it's not just that...
Actually, never mind.
translations.言いかけてやめるなよ。:
Come on, don't stop
halfway through.
translations.１０年後の話。フェアじゃないよな。いい加減、はぐらかすなよ。:
About ten years from now...
That's not fair. Stop dodging
the question already.
translations.別に冗談でもないよ。そのうち結婚ぐらい、するんじゃないの。:
I'm not really joking.
I'll probably get married
someday, won't I？
translations.もしかして未来の旦那様に嫉妬してる？:
Wait, are you jealous of
my future husband？
translations.へへ、がんばれって！:
Hehe, you'd better work
hard, then!
translations.▲小早川＊▲ってさ、最近はなにかに興味持ってるの？:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲, is there
anything you've been into
lately？
translations.動画サイトでさ、毎日のようにネコの動画視てるかな。:
I've been watching cat videos
online almost every day.
translations.うん。毎日視てても飽きない。:
Yeah. I watch them every day
and never get tired of them.
translations.みんな個性があって生意気な子もいれば、臆病な子もいて、反応もぜ～んぶ違うんだよ？:
They each have their own
personality. Some are sassy,
some are timid, and their
reactions are all different.
translations.そういうの視てると、ぎゅ～～～ってしたくなるよ。:
Watching them just makes me
want to squeeze them tight.
translations.ほんと、▲小早川＊▲はネコが好きだよな。:
You really do love cats,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ただね、困ったことがあるんだよ。……おかげで毎日寝不足。:
There's just one problem,
though. ...I'm losing sleep
over it every night.
translations.そこはほどほどにしといた方がいいぞ。:
You might want to tone it
down a bit.
translations.うん。わかってるんだけど、気づくと延々視ちゃってるんだよね。かわいいって罪だよね:
Yeah, I know. But before I
realize it, I've been watching
for hours. Being that cute
ought to be a crime...
translations.ところでさ、ネットでは動画サイトを視てるだけ？:
By the way, do you only use
the internet to watch videos？
translations.……うん。他はあんまり見て回らない。もともとお父さんのパソコンだし。:
...Yeah. I don't really look
at much else. It's my dad's
computer to begin with.
translations.あ、ネットでゲームとかはやらないんだ。:
Oh, so you don't play games
online or anything.
translations.格ゲーはやっぱりゲームセンターで直接相手を叩きのめしてた方が楽しい。:
With fighting games, it's more
fun crushing your opponent in
person at the arcade.
translations.叩きのめすって……ほら、一応女の子なんだからさ。:
Crush them...? Come on,
you're still a girl, you know.
translations.格ゲーやってるときのリンコは女の子じゃなくて一人の格闘家だから。:
When I'm playing a fighting
game, I'm not a girl.
I'm a fighter.
translations.対戦やるときは、女の子キャラばっかりなのにな。:
Even though you only ever pick
girl characters in versus.
translations.ゴツいキャラ使って勝っても、美しくないじゃん。ポリシーだよ。:
Winning with some bulky guy
isn't pretty at all. It's a
matter of principle.
translations.あ、ネットっていえば、キラーバンビーズの未発表音源の配信が始まったんだ。:
Oh, speaking of the internet,
they just put an unreleased
Killer Bambis track online.
translations.ああ、▲小早川＊▲の音楽プレイヤーにいつも入ってるやつ？:
Oh, the one that's always
on your music player, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そう。今回の曲は、ライブ音源なんだけど、変に加工してなくて、ざらっとした感じで、:
Yeah. It's a live recording
this time, and it's not overly
edited. That raw, gritty feel
makes it sound so real.
translations.そういえば▲小早川＊▲は、ライブに行ったりはしないのか？:
Come to think of it, do you
ever go to concerts,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.キラーバンビーズは来日しないから。さすがに海外までは行けない。:
Killer Bambis never come to
Japan. And I can't exactly go
overseas to see them.
translations.そっか。あ、それに▲小早川＊▲は混んだライブハウスだと……。:
I see. Oh, plus in a crowded
venue, ▲小早川＊▲, you'd...
translations.混んだライブハウスだと、何……？ 踏みつぶされるとでも言いたいんだ？:
In a packed venue, I'd what？
Are you trying to say I'd get
trampled？
translations.まだ言ってないだろ。:
I didn't even say anything
yet.
translations.大丈夫。ライブハウスに行くときは●が守ってやるから。:
It's okay. When we go to a
show, ● will protect you.
translations.……うん。あのさ、そのときは手つかんでても大丈夫……かな。:
...Okay. Um, when we do,
would it be okay if I held
onto your hand...？
translations.それとさ……どうすれば背伸びるんだろ。:
Also... I wonder how I can
grow taller.
translations.牛乳を飲むといいって、よく言われるよな。:
People always say drinking
milk helps, right？
translations.……それ、ずっとやってる。ぜんぜん伸びないけど。:
...I've been doing that the
whole time. I haven't grown
at all, though.
translations.そんなに背、伸ばしたいのか。:
Do you really want to get
taller that badly？
translations.そういう言い方だと、なんかリンコが必死みたいじゃん。:
When you put it like that,
it makes me sound desperate.
translations.でも、伸びたら嬉しいんだろ？:
Still, you'd be happy if you
grew taller, right？
translations.それは……ほら、カレシと歩くときも……釣り合うじゃん？:
Well... You know, when I'm
walking with my boyfriend...
we'd match better, right？
translations.え？ ●は今のままの▲小早川＊▲で、ぜんぜんいいと思ってるのに。:
Huh？ ● thought you were
totally fine just the way
you are, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.無理して●に合わせようとなんかしなくたって、▲小早川＊▲はそのままでいいんだから:
You don't need to push
yourself to match ●.
You're fine just as you are,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……ありがと。ちょっと気が楽になった。:
...Thanks. That makes me
feel a little better.
