translations.ねえ、ＺＩＮＺＩＮきてる？: Hey, are you feeling the ZINZIN？
translations.上上下下左右左右。: Up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right.
translations.ナンでも噛んでもよく食べる。: Naan or non-naan, I'll chew through anything.
translations.七転八倒、まあ頑張れ。: Writhing in agony... well, hang in there.
translations.サバンナに千尋の谷ってある？: Are there even bottomless ravines in the savanna？
translations.真空管占い、いくよ？ ばきゅ～む！: Ready for vacuum tube fortune-telling？ Vaaacuum!
translations.コンビニだけじゃ生きていけないよね？: You can't live on convenience stores alone, right？
translations.虫が多いから、もう帰るよ。: There are too many bugs, so I'm going home.
translations.円周率何桁まで言える？: How many digits of pi can you recite？
translations.カルビ一人前追加ねー。: One more order of short ribs, please.
translations.へえ、歌もお芝居もやりたいんだ？: Oh, so you want to sing and act too？
translations.見るんじゃない、感じるんじゃない、触るんじゃない。: Don't look, don't feel, don't touch.
translations.カロリー計算にスパコン使って５ｋｇ減。: Used a supercomputer to count calories and lost 5 kg.
translations.危機一髪、危なかった。: By a hair's breadth... That was close.
translations.なぜならリンコはロックだからね。: Because Rinko is rock, that's why.
translations.ネコが丸くなっちゃ、おしまいよ。: Once a cat goes soft and curls up, it's all over.
translations.焼き鳥職人になりたいんだけど。: I kind of want to become a yakitori master.
translations.もうちょっとビブラートに包んでよ……。: Try wrapping that in a little more vibrato...
translations.なんかセンチメートルだね。: Kind of makes you feel all centimeter, doesn't it.
translations.なで肩でカバンがずり落ちちゃう。: My shoulders slope so much my bag keeps slipping off.
translations.得意満面、調子にのんな！: All full of yourself—don't get cocky!
translations.布団だって、たまには飛ばずに落ち着きたいよ。: Even a futon wants to settle down and not go flying sometimes.
translations.う～、肉まんに優しく包まれちゃう～。: Mmm... gently wrapped up in a pork bun...
translations.リンコ様とお呼び！ ビシッ！ ビシッ！: Call me Lady Rinko! Crack! Crack!
translations.パンのミミを、牛乳につけて食べる。: Dipping bread crusts in milk and eating them.
translations.ひどい、冷ましたんだ。: That's mean, you let it get cold.
translations.リンコの秘密、ひとつだけ教えてあげよっか？: Want me to tell you just one of my secrets？
translations.三日三晩三食ポテチ、小早川凛子、小早川凛子です。: Potato chips morning, noon, and night for three days straight—Rinko Kobayakawa, I'm Rinko Kobayakawa.
translations.リンコ風邪の子じゃないもん、健康体だもん。: I'm not a sickly kid, I'm the picture of health.
translations.ノーベル賞取ったのは、光電効果でだよ。: He won the Nobel Prize for the photoelectric effect, you know.
translations.そうそう、魚偏にブルー。: Right, right, the fish radical plus 'blue.'
translations.僕は耳と目を閉じる。: I'll close my ears and eyes.
translations.スペースオペラはまだ早いよ……。: It's still too soon for a space opera...
translations.ワガママばかり言ってると、リンコの怒りが有頂天だよ。: Keep being selfish and my anger will hit cloud nine.
translations.道具はそろった……あとは人か。: The tools are all here... Now we just need the people.
translations.コンビニ行ってくる。: I'm heading to the convenience store.
translations.問答無用、胸に手をあてて。: No questions asked—put your hand on your heart.
translations.肩こったー、揉んで！: My shoulders are so stiff. Rub them!
translations.音飛びなんて、過去の話！: Skipping tracks are a thing of the past!
translations.取調中に親子丼って、故郷でお袋さん泣いてるぞ？: Eating oyakodon during an interrogation？ Your mom back home must be in tears.
translations.ダブルバッファリングの半分は、シングルバッファでできてるよ。: Half of double buffering is made of single buffers.
translations.毎朝お味噌汁一緒に飲みたいね。: I'd love to have miso soup together every morning.
translations.そのカード、何に使うの？: What are you going to use that card for？
translations.無茶苦茶、ホントわかってる？: That's absurd—do you really get it？
translations.無理することなんて、ないよ。: You don't have to push yourself.
translations.ヘイガール、デートしようぜ？: Hey girl, wanna go on a date？
translations.一蓮托生、頼りにしてる。: We're in this together. I'm counting on you.
translations.凛子とかけて、なんと説く？: Riddle me this: what is Rinko like？
translations.うん、席譲ろう。: Yeah, let's give up our seat.
translations.うん、適度に運動しよう。: Yeah, let's get some regular exercise.
translations.うん、早寝早起きしよう。: Yeah, let's go to bed early and wake up early.
translations.うん、一本早い電車乗ろう。: Yeah, let's catch the earlier train.
translations.うん、親孝行しよう。: Yeah, let's be good to our parents.
translations.うん、元気にいこう。: Yeah, let's keep our spirits up.
translations.うん、栄養バランス考えよう。: Yeah, let's eat a balanced diet.
translations.もうすぐ正月か。二人で初詣、とかね。: It's almost New Year's. Maybe the two of us will visit a shrine, or something.
translations.まあ年の初めぐらいはね、素直になってもいいけど。: Well, at least for the start of the year, I guess I can be honest with him.
translations.どうせめんどくさがるんじゃないかな。行けるかどうか。: He'll probably just say it's a pain anyway. Not sure if we'll even go.
translations.やっぱバレンタインぐらい、用意してやんないと。へへ。: I guess I should get something ready for him for Valentine's, at least. Hehe.
translations.せっかく用意しても、ちゃんと伝わるかな。: Even if I go to the trouble of getting something ready, I wonder if it'll get across to him.
translations.もうすぐホワイトデーか。少しは気になるかな。: White Day is coming up. I guess I'm a little curious.
translations.どうせしっかり用意してるんだろうな。へへ、しょーがないの。: He's probably got something all ready for me anyway. Hehe, he just can't help himself.
translations.ちゃんと覚えてるかな。まさか……忘れてたり。: I wonder if he actually remembers. No way... did he forget？
translations.もうすぐエイプリルフールか。なんか面白いことあるかな。: It's almost April Fools' Day. Wonder if anything interesting will happen.
translations.まあ、アイツとだったら、面白いことあるかも。: Well, if I'm with him, something fun might happen.
translations.そんな、何か起きるような日かな……。: Is it really the kind of day where anything happens...？
translations.もうすぐゴールデンウィークか。いいこと、あるかな。: Golden Week is coming up. Wonder if anything good will happen.
translations.なんか楽しいこと起きそうな気がする。たぶん。: I feel like something fun is going to happen. Probably.
translations.どうかなあ……。あんまり期待してないけど。: I don't know... I'm not getting my hopes up too much, though.
translations.もうすぐ学校のプール開きか。リンコのこと見て、どう思うんだろ。: The school pool opens soon. I wonder what he'll think when he sees me.
translations.あんまりじろじろ見たら、蹴ってやろーっと。: If he stares too much, I'm kicking him.
translations.もうすぐ七夕か。アイツは何か願い事、あるのかな。: It's almost Tanabata. I wonder if he has a wish in mind.
translations.あんまり興味はないけど、何か起きても面白いかも。: I'm not really into it, but it might be fun if something happens.
translations.もうすぐ水着コンテストだってさ。やれやれだね。: They say the swimsuit contest is coming up soon. Give me a break.
translations.別に興味はないけど……アイツは気にするのかな？: I don't really care about it, but... I wonder if he does？
translations.どうせやらしいこと考えるに決まってる。サイテー。: He's definitely gonna have dirty thoughts anyway. The worst.
translations.もうすぐ体育祭か。アイツがんばっちゃうのかな。: Sports Day is coming up. Wonder if he's going to go all out.
translations.アイツ、やるときはちゃんとやるんだよね。: He really comes through when it counts, though.
translations.ちゃんとやるかな、アイツ。リンコも人のこと言えないけど。: Wonder if he'll actually try. Not that I have any room to talk.
translations.もうすぐハロウィンか。面白いこと、できるかな。: It's almost Halloween. Wonder if we can do something fun.
translations.アイツのこと、驚かせるのもいいかも。: It might be fun to give him a scare.
translations.「なんかあるの？」とか言いそう。はあ。: He'll probably just say, "Is something going on？" Sigh.
translations.もうすぐ文化祭か。一緒に楽しめるかな。: The school festival is coming up. Wonder if we'll be able to enjoy it together.
translations.文化祭、アイツと一緒に……。悪くないかも。: The school festival, together with him... That might not be so bad.
translations.ほってかれそうで、やだな。どうなんだろ。: I'd hate it if he just left me on my own. Wonder how it'll go.
translations.もうすぐクリスマスか。ご苦労さまって感じだけど。: It's almost Christmas. Feels like a whole lot of fuss for nothing, though.
translations.まあ、世間に踊らされるのも、たまにはね。: Well, getting swept up in the hype isn't so bad once in a while.
translations.ほっとかれたら、それはそれで……やだ。: If he just leaves me alone on that day, though... I'd hate that.
translations.リンコたち「前からの付き合い」なわけ。わかる？: We've been together since before, you know. Get it？
translations.リンコたちはさ「今回からの付き合い」。そういうこと。: We just started going out this time around. That's how it is.
translations.リンコ、アイツと……お、お泊まりしちゃった！ あはは。: I... s-stayed overnight with him! Ahaha.
translations.アイツと、その……お泊まりしたいなーって、ちょっとだけ。: I kind of want to, um... stay overnight with him. Just a little.
translations.アイツと出かけたとき日に焼けちゃってさ。水着の跡がくっきり。: I got a tan when I went out with him. Left super obvious swimsuit lines.
translations.アイツと出かけて、泳いだんだけど。日焼けの跡つかなくてよかった。: I went swimming with him, and thankfully I didn't get any tan lines.
translations.クールなとこあるんだよね、アイツ。嫌いじゃないけど。: He's got a pretty cool side to him. Not that I mind, though.
translations.アイツ積極的だから、たまに困る。悪くない意味で、だけど。: He's so forward it catches me off guard sometimes. Not in a bad way, though.
translations.アイツがもっと積極的になっても……。ま、いっか。今のままでも。: I wouldn't mind if he were a bit more forward... Well, whatever. He's fine the way he is.
translations.アイツがさ「大きな画面でよく見えるようになった」って。なんのこと？: He said he can see me way better on a bigger screen now. What's he talking about？
translations.アイツ「もっと大きな画面がいいな」って。意味わかんないっつーの。: He said he wishes he had a bigger screen. Like, what does that even mean？
translations.アイツ、バイバイした後もまたすぐ飛んでくるの。離れたくないんだね。: Even after we say goodbye, he comes running right back. Guess he hates being apart from me.
translations.アイツさ。一度会ってから、次に来るまでが……長いんだよ。: You know, after we hang out, it takes him forever to come see me again.
translations.で、そっちのことも教えてくれるんでしょ？: So, you're gonna tell me about your guy too, right？
translations.ねえ。カレシのこと、なんて呼んでるわけ？: Hey, what do you call your boyfriend, anyway？
translations.そうだ。カレシの呼び方、教えてよ。: Oh, right. Tell me what you call your boyfriend.
translations.ふーん。結構おかたい感じ？ いいんだけど。: Hmm. Kinda formal, isn't it？ Not that there's anything wrong with that.
translations.やっぱ名前か……。そうなるよね。: His first name, huh... Yeah, makes sense.
translations.へ～？ ラブラブじゃん？: Oh, really？ Aren't you two lovey-dovey？
translations.次は当然、そっちが教える番。: Naturally, it's your turn to tell me next.
translations.じゃあさ、アンタは何て呼んでるの？: Then what about you？ What do you call him？
translations.うん、いい質問。どうなの？: Yeah, good question. Well, how about it？
translations.電池、切れかかってる。そろそろ充電した方がいいんじゃない？: The battery's almost dead. Shouldn't you charge it soon？
translations.は？ 急になに言ってんの？ ……誰か、見てるっつーの。: Huh？ What are you saying all of a sudden？ ...Someone's watching, you know.
translations.どうして今、そういうこと言うかな。……バカじゃん。: Why do you have to say stuff like that right now？ ...You're an idiot.
translations.今は……パス。なんかさ、こういうの……大切にしたいから。ね。: For now... I'll pass. I mean... I want to treasure this sort of thing. Okay？
translations.あのさ……今日、帰ってくるの何時ころ？ ……待ってないっつーの。: Hey... What time are you coming home today？ ...Not that I'm waiting or anything.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。いってらっしゃい。うん、がんばって。: ▲主人公＊▲. Have a good day. Yeah, do your best.
translations.行ってきますのキスは？ ……なーんて本気にするなっつーの。期待してバカじゃん。: What about my goodbye kiss？ ...Just kidding, don't take it seriously. Getting your hopes up like an idiot.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。早かったんだ。うん……おかえり。: ▲主人公＊▲. You're back early. Yeah... welcome home.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。おかえり。早くご飯食べれば？: ▲主人公＊▲. Welcome home. Why don't you go ahead and eat？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。おかえり。疲れた？ ふーん、気合いが足りないっつーの。: ▲主人公＊▲. Welcome home. Tired？ Hmph, you're just not trying hard enough.
translations.あのさ……今度リンコが作ってあげたら、嬉しい？: Hey... If I cooked for you sometime, would that make you happy？
translations.はあ、ほんとおいしそうに食べるね。いいけど。: Man, you really look like you're enjoying your food. Not that I mind.
translations.おいしかった？ はいはい、良かったね。: Was it good？ Yeah, yeah, good for you.
translations.ちゃんと歯を磨いて、お風呂入って、それから寝ること。: Make sure you brush your teeth, take a bath, and then go to bed.
translations.食べ終わったら、ちゃんと洗い物しとくこと。いい？: Make sure you do the dishes when you're done eating. Got it？
translations.もう寝ちゃうんだ……いいけど。: Going to sleep already, huh... Not that I mind.
translations.ねっ。おやすみのキス……しよっか。: Hey. How about... a goodnight kiss？
translations.最近さ、アンタが興味持ってることってなに？: So, what kind of stuff have you been into lately？
translations.ちょっと面白そう。リンコも興味わいてきた。: Sounds kind of interesting. Now I'm curious too.
translations.ないの？ なら、次までになにか探しておくこと。約束だから。: Nothing？ Then find something before next time. It's a promise.
translations.へえ。じゃ、今度リンコにも教えて。: Oh yeah？ Tell me about it sometime, then.
translations.最近はどんな音楽聴くようになった？: What kind of music have you been listening to lately？
translations.へえ、センスいいじゃん。リンコの好みとぴったり。: Oh, you've got good taste. That's right up my alley.
translations.ないの？ それじゃ今度リンコがお勧めしてあげよっか？: Nothing？ Want me to recommend something to you sometime, then？
translations.ね。今度リンコにもそれ、聞かせてくれる？: Hey. Will you let me listen to it sometime？
translations.アンタってさ、普段どんなテレビ見てるの？: What kind of TV shows do you usually watch？
translations.偶然！ リンコもその番組大好きなんだ。: What a coincidence! I love that show too.
translations.それ、面白い？ ふーん……リンコも見てみようかな。: Is it good？ Hmm... Maybe I'll check it out too.
translations.いっこ質問。リンコのさ……チャームポイントってどこだと思う？: Quick question. What do you think... my best feature is？
translations.それ。リンコに魅力ないみたいじゃん。: That makes it sound like I have nothing going for me.
translations.……そっか。参考にしとく。: ...I see. I'll keep that in mind.
translations.いっこ質問。今の髪型どう思う？ 好き？: Quick question. What do you think of my hair right now？ Do you like it？
translations.そっか。実はリンコも気に入ってるんだ。へへ。: I see. Actually, I really like it too. Hehe.
translations.いっこ質問。リンコの服の趣味どう思う？ 好き？: Quick question. What do you think of my taste in clothes？ Do you like it？
translations.……リンコとはセンスが合わないんだね。: ...I guess our tastes just don't match.
translations.ふぅん。なら今度はアンタが服、選んでくれる？: Hmm. Then will you pick out my clothes next time？
translations.あのさ。今何してる？: Hey. What are you doing right now？
translations.ふぅん。リンコもしてみようかな。: Hmm. Maybe I'll try doing that too.
translations.そっか。それってそんなに面白い？: I see. Is it really that fun？
translations.あのさ、今度リンコも一緒にしていい？: Hey, can I join you next time？
translations.眠れない。もしかして……アンタのせいかな。: I can't sleep. Maybe... it's your fault.
translations.バカじゃん。自意識過剰なんじゃない？: Don't be stupid. Aren't you a little full of yourself？
translations.眠ろうとすると、アンタの顔が浮かんできて……バカ。: Whenever I try to sleep, your face pops into my head... Idiot.
translations.あのさ……その……お泊まり、楽しかったよね。: Hey... um... staying over was fun, right？
translations.リンコも……うん……これ以上、言わせんなっつーの。: Me too... Yeah... Don't make me say any more than that.
translations.そっか。……じゃ、もう行かない。……ウソ。: I see. ...Then I won't go anymore. ...Just kidding.
translations.うん……また行ってもいい。: Yeah... We can go again sometime.
translations.いっこ質問。あのさ、こうやってリンコがくっついてるの迷惑？: Quick question. Hey, does it bother you when I cling to you like this？
translations.そっか。……迷惑じゃないならいいんだ。へへ。: I see. ...As long as it doesn't bother you, then good. Hehe.
translations.そっか……じゃ、少し離れて歩くことにする。: I see... Then I'll walk a little further away.
translations.イヤじゃなければ……リンコは……バカ、これ以上言わせんなっつーの。: If you don't mind... I... Idiot, don't make me say any more.
translations.ねぇ。今、リンコのこと考えてなかった？: Hey. Weren't you just thinking about me？
translations.そっか。へへっ。リンコも同じこと考えてた。: I see. Hehe. I was thinking the same thing.
translations.ウソツキ。さっきからヤらしい目で、リンコのこと見てたくせに。: Liar. You've been staring at me with pervy eyes this whole time.
translations.ふぅん。アンタはリンコの味方じゃなかった？: Hmm. Weren't you supposed to be on my side？
translations.あのさ、アンタはどんなとき幸せだって思う？: Hey, when do you feel the happiest？
translations.うん……リンコも今、こうしてるのが幸せだよ。: Yeah... Being like this right now makes me happy, too.
translations.そっか。……そういうのも幸せっていうんだ。: I see. ...So that's another kind of happiness.
translations.……リンコは今が幸せ。アンタが、こうしてすぐ側にいてくれるのが。: ...I'm happy right now. Just having you right here next to me like this.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。アンタはリンコといるとき……ううん、なんでもない。: ▲主人公＊▲. When you're with me, do you... Never mind, it's nothing.
translations.……そば、いてもいいよね。: ...It's okay if I stay by your side, right？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。アンタが側にいてくれれば、リンコはさびしくないよ。: ▲主人公＊▲. As long as you're here with me, I don't feel lonely.
translations.……休みになったらずっと一緒にいられる、よね？: ...Once we're on break, we can be together the whole time, right？
translations.あのさ……リンコがキスしたいって言ったらどうする？ ……バカ、冗談だっつーの。: Hey... what would you do if I said I wanted a kiss？ ...Idiot, I'm just kidding.
translations.口、なんかついてる。取って欲しい？ あ、甘えるなっつーの。: You have something on your mouth. Want me to get it？ D-Don't expect me to baby you.
translations.ね。手貸して……。手……意外とおっきいんだ……。: Hey. Give me your hand... Your hands... are bigger than I thought...
translations.もし世界中が敵になっても、それでもリンコの味方でいてくれる、よね？: Even if the whole world turned against me, you'd still be on my side, right？
translations.アンタの横……リンコの指定席だから。: The spot next to you... is reserved for me.
translations.ん、んんーっ。あったかくなると眠くなる。: Mmph, mmm... Getting warm makes me sleepy.
translations.ね。桜が咲いたらお花見行こっか。: Hey. When the cherry blossoms bloom, let's go see them.
translations.こんないい天気だと、学校なんてサボりたくなるよ。: When it's this nice out, it makes me want to skip school.
translations.……暑くてとろけちゃいそうだよ。アイス、食べたくない？: ...It's so hot I feel like I'm gonna melt. Want some ice cream？
translations.ね。この暑さっていつまで続くのかな……？: Hey. How much longer do you think this heat's gonna last...？
translations.秋といえば……？ そんなの読書の秋に決まってんじゃん。: What's fall all about...？ Reading, obviously.
translations.枯れ葉が散るのってさ。……寂しいよね。そう思わない？: Watching the dead leaves fall... feels kind of lonely. Don't you think？
translations.秋といえば焚き火。……なんかいいよね、ああいうの。: Fall makes me think of bonfires. ...There's something nice about that sort of thing.
translations.ううっ……風が冷たくなってきたね。: Brrr... The wind's gotten pretty cold.
translations.くしゅん。あっためて欲しいニャン▼……なんてにゃ。: Achoo. Warm me up, meow▼ ...Just kidding, meow.
translations.今年は雪、降るかな？: I wonder if it'll snow this year？
translations.あのさ、こんな時間から何してるワケ？ もしかして徹夜？: Hey, what are you doing up at this hour？ Did you pull an all-nighter？
translations.早起きなんだ。あんまり早いとおじーちゃんって呼ばれるよ？ へへっ。: You're up early. Get up too early and people'll start calling you grandpa, you know？ Heheh.
translations.こんな早く起きてどうするの？ リンコはまだ眠いよ。: What are you getting up this early for？ I'm still sleepy.
translations.朝ご飯？ あぁ……リンコはあんまり食べたくない。: Breakfast？ Ah... I don't really feel like eating.
translations.ね。朝食はご飯派？ それともパン派？ リンコはパン派かな。: Hey. Are you a rice person at breakfast？ Or a bread person？ I think I'm a bread person.
translations.リンコはさ、朝弱いんだ。: I'm really not a morning person.
translations.はぁ……朝から元気でうらやましいよ。: Sigh... I'm jealous you have so much energy this early.
translations.どうしてこんなに眠いのかな……。: I wonder why I'm so sleepy...
translations.今日はまだ始まったばかり、か。: The day's only just getting started, huh.
translations.ね。オヤツの時間だよ。少し休憩しよっか。: Hey, it's snack time. Let's take a little break.
translations.しっかりやってる？ リンコはまだ眠いけど。: Working hard？ I'm still sleepy, though.
translations.もうすぐお昼だね。おなかすいた？: It's almost lunchtime. Are you hungry？
translations.リンコはやっと目が覚めてきたよ。: I'm finally starting to wake up.
translations.あのさ、今日のお昼ごはんはもう決めた？: Hey, have you decided what you're having for lunch today？
translations.あと半日、がんばっていこう……なんてね。: Half a day left, let's do our best... or whatever.
translations.ね。今日のお昼ご飯はなに食べた？: Hey. What'd you have for lunch today？
translations.お腹がいっぱいになったら、お昼寝したくなるよね。: Once you're full, it really makes you want to take a nap, huh.
translations.……リンコ、ちょっとお昼寝していいかな。: ...I think I might take a little nap, if that's okay.
translations.眠いからって、アンタはサボっちゃダメ。: Just because you're sleepy doesn't mean you get to slack off.
translations.そろそろオヤツの時間だよ？: It's almost snack time, you know？
translations.オヤツ、か……リンコ、ポテチが食べたいな。: A snack, huh... I'm in the mood for potato chips.
translations.ね。このあとの予定、考えてる？: Hey. Have you thought about your plans for later？
translations.今日もあと一息。ガンバレ。: Almost done for the day. Hang in there.
translations.あ、もう夕方か。まだ帰らないの？: Oh, it's evening already. Not heading home yet？
translations.リンコは……帰りにゲーセン寄ってこうかな。: I think... I might stop by the arcade on my way home.
translations.晩御飯どうする？ 鯖缶ばっか食べない方がいいよ。: What are you doing for dinner？ You shouldn't just eat canned mackerel all the time.
translations.あーあ、リンコも一緒にご飯食べたかったな。: Aw, I wish I could've had dinner with you too.
translations.ね。今日のテレビ、なにかおもしろいのある？: Hey. Anything good on TV tonight？
translations.夜ってさ……なんだか人恋しくなる……。: At night... I start feeling kind of lonely...
translations.晩御飯食べた？ 一応心配しとく。: Did you eat dinner？ Just thought I'd check.
translations.あ、宿題……。代わりにやってくれ、ないよね？: Oh, homework... You wouldn't do it for me, would you？
translations.ちゃんとお風呂入った？ あったまんないと風邪ひくよ。: Did you take a proper bath？ You'll catch a cold if you don't warm up.
translations.あ……流れ星。うっそ。: Oh... a shooting star. Just kidding.
translations.そろそろ眠くなってきた？ リンコも……んんっ……眠い。: Getting sleepy yet？ I'm... mm... sleepy too.
translations.この時間になるとベッドが恋しくなるよねぇ。: At this hour, your bed really starts calling to you, huh.
translations.ね。寝る前にちゃんとハミガキした？: Hey. Did you brush your teeth before bed？
translations.寝る前にちゃんと戸締まり確認すること。いい？: Make sure everything's locked up before you go to sleep. Okay？
translations.リンコ……そろそろ寝る。おやすみ。: I'm... going to bed soon. Goodnight.
translations.また明日、たくさん話そうね。: Let's talk a lot again tomorrow, okay？
translations.……この時間だと、星、見えるかな。: ...I wonder if you can see the stars at this hour.
translations.まだ起きてるんだ。……明日大丈夫なの？: You're still up. ...Are you going to be okay tomorrow？
translations.眠れないの？ ホットミルク飲むと眠れるらしいよ？: Can't sleep？ I hear warm milk helps you fall asleep.
translations.まだ寝ないの？ 明日休みだから……夜更かし、する？: Not sleeping yet？ Tomorrow's a day off, so... want to stay up late？
translations.みんなが寝てる時間に起きてるって、なんだかワクワクしない？: Being awake while everyone else is asleep is kind of exciting, isn't it？
translations.あのさ……ううん、なんでもない。アンタの夢、見れるかな。: Hey... No, never mind. I wonder if I'll dream about you.
translations.起きるの早いね。ん？ もしかして徹夜？: You're up early. Hm？ Wait, did you pull an all-nighter？
translations.おはよ。……って、早すぎ？: Morning. ...Wait, is it too early for that？
translations.一日に何回もリンコに会いに来てくれるって……暇なの？ なんてね。嬉しいよ。: Coming to see me this many times in one day... Are you bored or something？ Just kidding. I'm glad.
translations.毎日リンコに会いに来てくれるんだ。……そっか。へへ。: You come to see me every day. ...I see. Hehe.
translations.そんなにリンコのこと見てたいんだ。……ありがと。一応ね。: You really like looking at me that much, huh. ...Thanks. I guess.
translations.また会った。……この時間、よく会うね。: We meet again. ...We run into each other a lot around this time.
translations.リンコとの思い出、大切にしてくれるんだ。ありがと。: You really treasure your memories with me, huh. Thanks.
translations.あのさ、他の子と会ったりしてないよね？ ヤキモチ？ そんなんじゃないっつーの。: Hey, you're not seeing some other girl, are you？ Jealous？ It's not like that.
translations.あれ？ なんか広くなった？: Huh？ Did it get bigger in here？
translations.なんかさ、アンタの夢よく見る。へへ、あと少しで……ってね。: You know, I've been dreaming about you a lot. Hehe, just a little more... or something.
translations.ねえ。アンタ毎週がんばってるじゃん？ あと少しでさ、揃っちゃうかも。: Hey. You've been keeping at it every week, right？ Just a little more and you might have the whole set.
translations.あのさ、前にも言ったよね。セーブしないで電源切らないでって。なのに今日もやったで: Look, I told you before, didn't I？ Not to turn the power off without saving. And you did it again today, didn't you？
translations.ね。今日からいろんなことができるようになったって？ ……ちょっと楽しみ。: Hey. I heard we can do all kinds of new things starting today？ ...I'm kind of looking forward to it.
translations.ね。新しくできるようになったこと、もう試してみた？: Hey. Have you tried out the new things we can do yet？
translations.リンコ、いろいろやりたいことがあって迷っちゃうよ。: There's so much I want to do, I don't know where to start.
translations.もうリンコとなんか会いたくなくなった？: Do you not want to see me anymore？
translations.キス……もうしてくれないんだ。いいけど。: So you won't... kiss me anymore. Whatever, it's fine.
translations.アンタだけはリンコの味方だって言ったの。ウソだったんだ。: You said you'd always be on my side, even if no one else was. So that was a lie.
translations.リンコはアンタのことばっかり考えてるのに……バカ。: All I ever do is think about you... Idiot.
translations.やっぱりリンコ一人じゃダメなんだよ……。: I really can't do this on my own after all...
translations.ずっと味方だって言ったくせに……バカ。: You said you'd always be on my side... Idiot.
translations.どうしてリンコにそんなこと言うの？: Why would you say something like that to me？
translations.世界中が敵になってもリンコの味方。信じていいの？: You're on my side even if the whole world is against me. Can I really believe that？
translations.……うん、わかった。じゃ……仲直りのキス……しよ。ちゅっ。: ...Okay, got it. Then... let's kiss and make up. Mwah.
translations.これ……リンコに似合う、かな？: Does this... look good on me, I wonder？
translations.へへっ。……わりといいかも。: Hehe. ...This might actually be pretty good.
translations.星座占い、か。くだらないけど、たまには見てみよっかな。: Horoscopes, huh. They're silly, but maybe I'll check mine for once.
translations.いい事言ってたから、信じてみよっかな。: It said something good, so maybe I'll believe it.
translations.ふぅん……占いなんてこんなもんだよね。: Hmm... Well, that's how horoscopes usually go.
translations.最悪。見なきゃ良かった。: The worst. Wish I hadn't looked.
translations.アイツの運勢は……最高？ ちょっとしゃくだけど、あとで教えてあげようかな。: His fortune is... the very best？ It's a little annoying, but maybe I'll tell him later.
translations.アイツの運勢、結構いいじゃん。あとで教えてあげよ。: His fortune's pretty good. I'll tell him later.
translations.アイツの運勢、可もなく不可もなく、か。なんかつまんない。: His fortune's nothing special either way, huh. Kind of boring.
translations.アイツの運勢、今日最悪じゃん。ま、しょせん占いだしね。: His fortune's the worst today. Well, it's just a horoscope anyway.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。帰っちゃったかな。: ▲主人公＊▲. I wonder if he went home.
translations.▲主人公＊▲、待っててくれるかな。: I wonder if ▲主人公＊▲ is waiting for me.
translations.リンコも生き返るよ……ふぅ。: That brings me right back to life... Phew.
translations.肌。ちゃんとつるつるになってるかな。: My skin... Wonder if it's nice and smooth now.
translations.……ちょっとはおっきくなった、かな？: ...Wonder if they've gotten a little bigger？
translations.ウソ！ 絶対この体重計壊れてる！: No way! This scale is definitely broken!
translations.アイツはどのくらいが好きなのかな。……べつに気にしてるわけじゃないけど。: Wonder what size he likes. ...Not that I care or anything.
translations.これじゃ普通すぎる、かな。: Maybe this is a little too plain.
translations.これは、なんだか張り切ってるみたいで変、かな。: This feels like I'm trying too hard... A bit weird, maybe.
translations.リンコなに気にしてんだろ……。どうでもいいじゃん。: What am I even worrying about...？ Who cares.
translations.アイツはどんなのが好きなの、かな。: I wonder what kind he likes.
translations.アイツもやっぱり大きい方が好き……なのかな。ふぅ。: Wonder if he prefers them bigger, too... Sigh.
translations.どうやったらスタイル良くなるのかな……。: I wonder how I can get a better figure...
translations.リンコ……なにアイツのことばっか気にしてるんだろ。: Why am I so hung up on what he thinks...？
translations.うん！ やっぱりお風呂上がりにはこれだよね。: Yeah! Nothing beats this right after a bath.
translations.あれ？ これで合ってたっけ？ ま、いっか。: Huh？ Was this right？ Oh, whatever.
translations.たぶんこれでいいと思うんだけど。: I think this should be fine, though.
translations.我ながら上出来！ きっと喜んでくれるよね。: Not bad, if I do say so myself! Bet he'll love it.
translations.愛情もたっぷり。これでマズイわけないじゃん。: Made with plenty of love, too. No way it tastes bad.
translations.そこでガードして起き上がりで、小キック……。: Block there, then a light kick on wake-up...
translations.たしかアイツと対戦してたと思ったんだけど……。: I could've sworn I was playing a match against him...
translations.ね。ぎゅっとされるの……好き？: Hey. Do you like... being hugged tight？
translations.油断大敵。小キック！: Never let your guard down. Light kick!
translations.やるじゃん。それでこそリンコのライバル。: Not bad. Wouldn't expect any less from my rival.
translations.あーっ、もうズルイよ、今のは。: Ugh, come on, that was playing dirty.
translations.ネコリンコは寂しがりやなんだニャ♪: Kitty Rinko gets lonely easily, meow♪
translations.このままぬくぬくがいいんだニャ。: I just wanna stay nice and warm like this, meow.
translations.なんてことになると思ったら甘い！: If you thought that's how this would go, think again!
translations.だいたいアンタってさ、かわいい子見るとすーぐ鼻の下伸ばして。: Seriously, the second you see a cute girl, you go all goofy over her.
translations.……リンコは自分でかわいいとか……そんなこと……。: ...Not that I'm calling myself cute, or anything...
translations.一年って過ぎるの早いよね。: A year really flies by, doesn't it？
translations.もしかして……アンタと一緒だったから、かな？: Maybe... it's because I was with you？
translations.残り３０秒……あ、カウントダウン始まるよ。: Thirty seconds left... Oh, the countdown's starting.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。今年もよろしく……。: ▲主人公＊▲. Here's to another good year together...
translations.リンコ……今年は二人でもっと楽しい時間……作りたいな。: This year... I want the two of us to have even more fun times together.
translations.ん？ リンコになにか選んで欲しいわけ？: Hm？ You want me to pick something out for you？
translations.じゃ、リンコの右側と左側に選んで欲しいものを分けて置いて。: Okay, then put the things you want me to choose between on my left and right.
translations.うーん……リンコにはどっちも良く見えるんだけど、選ばなきゃダメなんだよね？: Hmm... They both look good to me, though. I still have to pick one, right？
translations.どっちがいいかな……そうだ。: Which one's better... Oh, I know.
translations.もう……リンコにこんな難しい選択させるなっつーの。: Geez... Don't make me make such a tough choice.
translations.ていうかさ、リンコに頼らないで、アンタが自分で選べばいいじゃん。: Besides, instead of relying on me, you should just pick for yourself.
translations.まあ、また迷ったら相談してくれてもいいけどさ。: Well, if you can't decide again, I guess you can ask me.
translations.ん？ 何か嫌なことでもあったとか？ リンコで良ければ話聞くけど？: Hm？ Did something bad happen？ If you don't mind talking to me, I'll listen.
translations.あのさ……無理したってリンコにはわかるんだから。: Look... I can tell when you're forcing yourself, you know.
translations.リンコだって落ち込む日はあるよ。: Even I have days where I feel down.
translations.アンタはいつだって側にいてくれたじゃん。リンコも同じだよ。: You've always been there for me, right？ It's the same for me.
translations.元気になるまで、リンコが側にいてあげる。: I'll stay by your side until you feel better.
translations.あんまり落ち込んでると、リンコまで哀しくなるじゃん。: If you stay this down, it's gonna make me sad too.
translations.どう？ リンコが側にいてもダメ、かな？: Well？ Does having me here not help...？
translations.リンコはね、アンタの笑顔が見たいの。: You know, I just want to see you smile.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。いつもみたいに笑ってよ！: ▲主人公＊▲. Smile like you always do!
translations.へへっ……ちょっとは元気出たかな？: Heh... Feeling a little better now？
translations.ほら思いっきり深呼吸して。: Come on, take a nice, deep breath.
translations.せーのーっ、あれ？ これ、深呼吸じゃない？: Ready, go! ...Huh？ Wait, isn't that how you take a deep breath？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。リンコはいつだって味方だよ？: ▲主人公＊▲. You know I'm always on your side, right？
translations.へへっ。……やっといつもの笑顔が戻ったみたいだね。: Heh. ...Looks like your usual smile is finally back.
translations.あのさ……リンコは話聞くぐらいしかできないけど、辛いときは頼ってくれていいから。: Look... All I can really do is listen, but you can lean on me when things get tough.
translations.あのさ……横、寝てもいい、かな？: Um... Can I lie down next to you？
translations.添い寝……してあげよっか。嫌ならいいけど。: Want me to... lie down with you？ If you don't want me to, that's fine.
translations.もう寝ちゃった……？ あのさ……眠るまで側にいてあげる。: Are you asleep already...？ Um... I'll stay right here until you fall asleep.
translations.あのさ、いつもわがままばっか言ってごめん。だから、今日はゆっくり休んでよ。ね。: Listen... Sorry for always being so selfish. Just get some good rest today, okay？
translations.まだ、寝ないの？: Aren't you going to sleep yet？
translations.無邪気な寝顔しちゃって。: Look at you, sleeping so innocently.
translations.ふぁ……リンコも眠くなってきちゃった。おやすみ……。: *Yawn*... I'm getting sleepy too. Good night...
translations.ね。おやすみのキス……しよっか。: Hey. How about... a goodnight kiss？
translations.あのさ……早く寝なよ。: Come on... Just go to sleep already.
translations.あのさ……さっきうなされて変なこと言ってなかった？: Um... Weren't you tossing and turning and saying weird stuff just now？
translations.起きろー！ ……ごめん、なんかうなってたから、つい。: Wake up! ...Sorry, you were groaning in your sleep, so I just reacted.
translations.ん？ んん……ん？ ごめん……リンコも一緒に寝ちゃってたみたい。おはよう。: Mm？ Mmm... Huh？ Sorry... Looks like I fell asleep too. Morning.
translations.一緒にストレッチ？ ん……めんどくさいな。まあ、いいけど。: Stretch together？ Mm... What a pain. Well, fine.
translations.リンコさ、最近運動不足なんだ。だから一緒にやろ。: I haven't been getting enough exercise lately. So let's do it together.
translations.なんだ、アンタはやらないんだ。: Oh, so you're not doing it.
translations.足を肩幅に開いて、左手を腰に、右手を耳の横につけて伸ばして……よっと。: Feet shoulder-width apart, left hand on your hip, right arm up by your ear, and stretch... There.
translations.いっち、に、さん、し、ごー、ろく、しち、はち。: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight.
translations.リンコがいっち、に、さん、し って言ったら、その後にごー、ろく、しち、はち、って: After I say 'one, two, three, four,' you follow up with 'five, six, seven, eight.' Got it？
translations.はい、いっち、に、さん、しー。: Ready, and: one, two, three, four.
translations.ほら、もっと元気よく声出して。: Come on, put some more energy into your voice.
translations.次は足を前後に開いて、手は腰に当てる。右足のひざを曲げてまえに、左足のひざを伸ば: Next, step one foot back and put your hands on your hips. Bend your right knee forward and keep your left leg straight back to stretch your Achilles tendon.
translations.最後だよ。両足をそろえて手を前でそろえて、つま先を触るように体を曲げる。そしたら: Last one. Feet together, hands in front of you, and bend down to touch your toes. Then come back up, hands on your hips, and lean back.
translations.はい、これでストレッチ終了。ちゃんとできた？: Okay, that's it for stretching. Did you do it properly？
translations.腕立て伏せがやりたい？ べつにいいけど。: You want to do push-ups？ Sure, I guess.
translations.リンコさ、最近運動不足だから、一緒にやろ。: I haven't been getting enough exercise lately, so let's do it together.
translations.あのさ、腕立て伏せ、付き合わない？: Hey, want to do some push-ups with me？
translations.へへっ。じゃ、一緒にがんばろ。: Heh. Okay, let's both do our best.
translations.……そうなんだ。一緒にやりたかったのに。: ...Oh. And here I wanted to do it together.
translations.１セットで腕立て１０回。何セットする？: One set is ten push-ups. How many sets are you doing？
translations.ま、アンタにはそれくらいがちょうどいいかもね。: Well, that's probably just about right for you.
translations.男の子ならこれくらいはできないとね。: A guy should be able to do at least this much.
translations.本当に大丈夫？ かっこつけようとしてない？: Are you sure you'll be okay？ You're not just trying to show off, are you？
translations.５０回にチャレンジ？ 無理しない方がいいと思うけど。: Going for fifty？ I don't think you should push yourself too hard.
translations.本気？ ……ま、無理だと思ったら途中で止めれば？: Seriously？ ...Well, if it gets to be too much, just stop halfway through.
translations.じゃあ、始めよっか。リンコが数えるからアンタもちゃんと声出してね。: Okay, let's get started. I'll count, so make sure you count out loud too.
translations.うん、よくできました。それでこそリンコのカレシだよ。: Yeah, well done. That's my boyfriend for you.
translations.そんなにたくさん？ ……リンコ驚いちゃった。アンタのこと見直した。: That many？ ...You surprised me. I'm seeing you in a new light.
translations.お疲れ。たまに運動するといい汗かくでしょ。: Good workout. It feels good to work up a sweat every now and then, right？
translations.汗……拭いてあげるから。ほら、こっちに来る。: I'll wipe your sweat off. Come on, get over here.
translations.体動かすのって健康的だと思わない？: Don't you think getting some exercise feels pretty healthy？
translations.リンコも少しだけやってみようかな。教えてくれる？: Maybe I'll try doing a few, too. Will you coach me？
translations.じゃ、お願い。……優しくね。: Okay, go ahead. ...Go easy on me.
translations.あのさ、ちゃんと数えて。: Hey, make sure you count properly.
translations.はぁはぁ……もう……ダメ……かも……。: Huff, huff... I don't think... I can go on...
translations.はぁ……疲れた。でも、たまに運動すると気持ちいいね。: Phew... I'm beat. Still, it feels nice to work out once in a while.
translations.ダメ……リンコ、げんかいだよ……。: No good... I've hit my limit...
translations.お疲れ。また一緒に運動しよ。: Good workout. Let's exercise together again sometime.
translations.ふぅ……汗かいちゃった。シャワー浴びてくる。: Whew... I worked up a sweat. I'm gonna go take a shower.
translations.ん？ あのね、もし覗いたりしたら、蹴るよ？: Hm？ Listen, if you try to peek, I'll kick you, okay？
translations.１セットで腹筋１０回。何セットする？: One set is ten sit-ups. How many sets are you doing？
translations.一緒にゲームしたい？ へへ。リンコに挑戦なんて百年早い。: Wanna play a game together？ Hehe. You're a hundred years too early to challenge me.
translations.あのさ、一緒にゲーム、しよ？: Hey, wanna play a game together？
translations.そっか。じゃ、また今度やろ。: I see. Well, let's play some other time.
translations.やった！ またこてんぱんにやっつけてあげるから。: Nice! I'm gonna totally crush you again.
translations.いいよ。今回も勝たせてもらうからね。: Sure. I'll be taking the win this time, too.
translations.あのさ、普通カノジョ相手に本気、出さないよね？: Hey, normally guys don't go all out against their girlfriend, right？
translations.へへっ。お手並み拝見。: Hehe. Let's see what you've got.
translations.あれ？ もうやめちゃうの？ 残念。またやろうね。: Huh？ Quitting already？ Too bad. Let's play again sometime.
translations.へへっ。楽しかったー。もう一回しよ？: Hehe. That was fun. Wanna go another round？
translations.うん。じゃあ、また最初から。: Okay. Let's start from the beginning again.
translations.へへっ。楽しかった？ リンコは楽しかったよ。また遊ぼ。: Hehe. Did you have fun？ I sure did. Let's play again sometime.
translations.そっか……大変だったんだね……。: I see... Sounds like you had a rough time...
translations.こういう時はさ、もっと、くっついて話そ？ ね？: When things are like this, come sit closer while we talk. Okay？
translations.いつかさ……リンコの味方だって、言ってくれたでしょ？: Remember how you once told me you were on my side？
translations.アンタはさ、そんな大した意味で言ったんじゃないかもしれないけど、リンコはね、: Maybe you didn't mean anything huge by it, but for me...
translations.あの時、すごく嬉しかった……ずっと、世界で一人ぼっちなんだって、思ってたから。: It made me so happy back then... Because I'd always felt like I was all alone in the world.
translations.味方だって言ってもらって、本当に救われたんだよ？ 味方だって言ってもらったらね、: Hearing you say you were on my side really saved me, you know？ Once you told me that...
translations.今まであった嫌なことも悲しいことも、全部、許せるような気がした。: I felt like I could forgive all the awful, sad things that had happened up until then.
translations.もう何が起こっても、きっと、一緒に笑い飛ばせるって、: Like no matter what happened anymore, we'd be able to laugh it off together.
translations.だから、今度はさ、リンコが言う番。: So this time, it's my turn to say it.
translations.リンコはいつも、あんたの味方だよ？ 世界ＶＳアンタになったって、リンコは、最後ま: I'm always on your side, okay？ Even if it's you against the world, I'll stick by you to the very end, no matter what.
translations.聞いてる？ もし、誰かがアンタのこといらないッて言ったって、リンコはアンタがいな: Are you listening？ Even if someone says they don't want you around, I don't want a world without you in it.
translations.アンタのことダメって言う奴が居たら、リンコがそいつのこと蹴っ飛ばしてやる。わかっ: If anyone ever says you're no good, I'll kick their butt for you. Got it？
translations.胸張って行こうよ？ ぜんぜん平気だよ、ざまー見ろ！ って、笑い飛ばしてやろ？: Let's hold our heads high, okay？ Let's just laugh in their faces and say, "Doesn't bother me one bit, so take that!"
translations.２人ならきっと、平気。２人は、最強のタッグなんだから。: As long as we're together, we'll be fine. We're the ultimate tag team, after all.
translations.これからは、つらいことがあったらさ、ときどき、リンコに甘えてよ。: From now on, whenever things get rough, lean on me once in a while.
translations.いつもリンコが甘えるばっかりじゃ、やだもん。リンコは、あんたのカノジョなんだから: I don't want to be the only one leaning on you all the time. I am your girlfriend, after all. Okay？
translations.そんなことよりリンコと……別にいいけど。: Forget that, hang out with me... Well, whatever.
translations.アンタってさ、基本真面目だよね？: You're pretty serious about things, huh？
translations.リンコがいると、学校も楽しいでしょ？: School's way more fun with me around, right？
translations.ふーん。ちゃんとしてるんだ。: Hmm. Look at you taking it seriously.
translations.たまには勉強もいいんじゃない？: Studying once in a while isn't so bad, right？
translations.じゃあ、リンコの分もよろしく。: Great, do my share too while you're at it.
translations.問題見せるなっつーの。一人でがんばれ！: Quit showing me the problems. Do it yourself!
translations.それ得意？ 教えてくれると、嬉しいんだけど？: Are you good at this？ It'd be nice if you taught me, you know？
translations.そんなに頭使うとさ、疲れない？: Doesn't using your brain that much wear you out？
translations.まあ、一応図書委員だし。ってこと？: Well, you are on the library committee, I guess. Is that it？
translations.そこ違うって。しょうがないな、もう。: No, that part's wrong. Jeez, you're hopeless.
translations.下級生に教わるなんて、恥ずかしいことはないよーに！: Try not to embarrass yourself getting tutored by an underclassman!
translations.そっか、そういうやり方もあるか。: Oh, right. Guess that's another way to do it.
translations.どれどれ。あー、なるほどね？: Let's see here. Ah, I get what you're going for？
translations.がんばるだけじゃ上手く描けないじゃん？ だからほどほどに。: Trying hard alone won't make you a good artist, right？ So don't overdo it.
translations.うん、そこそこがんばれば？: Yeah, just give it a decent shot, I guess？
translations.リンコは諦めてるから、アンタががんばって。: I've already given up, so you do your best.
translations.参考にするからさ、しっかりやってよ。: I'm gonna use yours as a reference, so do a good job.
translations.あ、すごい……。じゃなくて、よく見るとフツー？: Whoa, that's amazing... Wait no, looking closely, it's pretty average？
translations.学校の授業の音楽じゃさ、気がのらないよね。: It's hard to get into the music they make us do in class, huh.
translations.つまんない演奏だったら、帰るから。: If your playing's boring, I'm leaving.
translations.なーに恥ずかしがってんの？: What're you getting all shy for？
translations.へへ、リンコはちょーっとうるさいよ？: Hehe, I'm kind of a tough critic, you know？
translations.こういうの、結構がんばっちゃう方？: Are you the type who actually tries hard at this stuff？
translations.まあ、気楽にやろうよ。: Well, let's just take it easy.
translations.歌うんだ。へー、ききたーい。: Oh, you're singing. Huh, I wanna hear.
translations.退屈させたら、小キック！: Bore me and you get a light kick!
translations.あ、聴いてこっと。いいでしょ？: Oh, I'm gonna come listen. You don't mind, right？
translations.お疲れ。じゃあ、さらに倍！: Good work. Now do double that!
translations.サボればいーのに。付き合うけど？: You should just slack off. I'll keep you company, you know？
translations.うーん、まだいけるんじゃない？: Hmm, you've still got more in you, don't you？
translations.かっこいいとこ、見たいな？: Let's see you look cool, okay？
translations.まあ、てきとーでいいじゃん？: Well, we can just wing it, right？
translations.働くね。じゃあリンコの分も任せた。: Working hard, huh. I'll leave my share to you too.
translations.サボらないこと！ リンコが言うなって？: No slacking off! Look who's talking, right？
translations.あ、やってくれるんだ。優しいじゃん。: Oh, you'll do it for me. That's sweet of you.
translations.うん、そっちはよろしく。: Yeah, I'll leave that to you.
translations.手が空いたらさ、こっちもかまってよ……。: When you're free, pay some attention to me too...
translations.がんばれがんばれー。: Keep it up, keep it up.
translations.それ違う。まだまだだね。: That's wrong. You've still got a ways to go.
translations.こう見えてもさ、アンタのこと頼りにしてるんだから。: Believe it or not, I really am counting on you.
translations.こっちもちゃんとやってるってば。: Hey, I'm doing my share too, you know.
translations.なんか、風邪ひいたみたいで。: I think I caught a cold.
translations.え、風邪？ 悪いのか？: Wait, a cold？ Is it bad？
translations.でも委員会とかは無理かも。一応報告。:
Doubt I'll make it to
committee, though.
Just letting you know.
translations.そんなのいいから、早く治せって。:
Don't worry about that.
Just get well soon.
translations.あ、そっか。もう誕生日か。:
Oh, right. It's already
my birthday, huh.
translations.ああ、ほんとありがと。うれしかった。:
Yeah, thanks a lot.
That made me really happy.
translations.電話だけで済ませようと思ってるわけじゃないから。:
It's not like a phone call
is all you're getting.
translations.あんま気つかうなって。:
You don't have to go
out of your way.
translations.だな、もうそんな時期か。:
Right. It's that time
of year already, huh.
translations.うん。だから、一応電話。: Yeah. So I figured I'd call.
translations.そっか。この一年色々あったな……。:
I see. A lot's happened
this past year...
translations.遅いから、そろそろ切る。:
It's late, so I'm gonna
hang up soon.
translations.へへ、やりたかったんだよね、これ。:
Hehe, I really wanted
to do this.
translations.うん、今年もよろしく。:
Yeah. Here's to
another good year.
translations.（●と▲小早川＊▲の新しい一年が始まるな……）:
(A new year is starting
for ● and ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.よかった、すぐ言えて。:
I'm glad I got to say it
right away.
translations.でも弟の方が早かった。カレシ失格。:
My little brother beat you
to it, though. You fail
as a boyfriend.
translations.冗談だっつーの。弟がこんな時間に起きてるわけないじゃん。:
I'm kidding, jeez. There's
no way he'd be up this late.
translations.遅くにごめんな。そろそろ切るよ。:
Sorry for calling so late.
I'll let you go.
translations.うん。あのさ、ほんとにちょっと、うれしかったよ。:
Okay. And hey... I actually
was a little happy.
translations.ならよかった。じゃあ、またな。:
Glad to hear it.
See you later, then.
translations.（０時過ぎたな。今日は●と▲小早川＊▲の記念日だ）:
(It's past midnight. Today's
● and ▲小早川＊▲'s
anniversary.)
translations.んなわけないじゃん。二人の記念日でしょ。:
Of course I didn't.
It's our anniversary, right？
translations.まあ、遅いしね。電話ありがと。:
Well, it is late.
Thanks for calling.
translations.なんか言いたいことありそう。:
You look like you've got
something to say.
translations.ちゃんと見えてるから。: I can see you just fine.
translations.それしかないのかっつーの。:
Is that seriously
your only move？
translations.ぜんっぜん、眠くないし……。:
I'm seriously not sleepy
at all...
translations.ドキドキ？ するに決まってるじゃん。:
Heart racing？
Of course it is.
translations.あれっ……あ、寝てたか。: Huh... Oh, guess I dozed off.
translations.へへ、リンコの足技がキックだけだと思った？: Hehe, did you think kicking was all I could do with my legs？
translations.降参っていうか……。なんか変な気分になるだろ、それ。: It's not about giving up... Doing that makes me feel kinda funny, you know.
translations.なんで握るの、手。: Why are you holding my hand？
translations.いや、とかじゃなくて……。なんでって聞いてるんじゃん。: It's not that I mind... I'm just asking why.
translations.あのさ、変なこと考えない？: Hey, promise you won't get any weird ideas？
translations.いいから。変なこと考えない？: Never mind that. Promise you won't get any weird ideas？
translations.……寂しそうな顔しないでよ。……行くから。: ...Don't give me that lonely look. ...I'm coming over.
translations.浴衣、引っ張ってるんだけど。: Hey, you're pulling on my yukata.
translations.何脱がそうとしてんの。: Why are you trying to undress me？
translations.意外とおっきいね、背中。: Your back is bigger than I thought.
translations.あのさ、いっこお願い。: Hey, I have one favor to ask.
translations.いいけど……寝づらいのか？ じゃあ、●がそっち行くよ。: Sure, but... is yours uncomfortable？ Then ● can take that one.
translations.何そのボケ。笑えないんだけど？: What kind of joke is that？ Not funny.
translations.アンタが寝てる、この布団でってこと。: I meant in this futon, with you in it.
translations.朝までこのままで、いい？: Can we stay like this until morning？
translations.……なんで、下ばっかり見てるの？:
...Why do you keep
looking down there？
translations.じろじろ見ないで。恥ずかしいじゃん……。:
Don't stare like that.
It's embarrassing...
translations.そんなに見ないでよ。スタイルよくないもん……。:
Stop staring so much. I don't
have that great a figure...
translations.何で見てんの？ 恥ずかしいよ。:
Why are you staring？
It's embarrassing.
translations.リンコの脚線美にメロメロ？:
Head over heels for
my shapely legs？
translations.そんな風に、じろじろ見るな！:
Quit staring at me
like that!
translations.どうせリンコはスタイルよくないよ。:
It's not like I have
a good figure anyway.
translations.そんなにリンコの足が気になる？:
Are you really that
interested in my legs？
translations.……もっと、他のところも見てよ。:
...Look at the rest of me,
too.
translations.もう……子供じゃないんだしさ……。:
Jeez... I'm not a kid
anymore, you know...
translations.……ちょっとだけ、そのまま……ね？:
...Stay like that just
a little longer... okay？
translations.髪触るの好きだよね。:
You really like touching
my hair, don't you？
translations.へへ……リンコたち、ラブラブだね。:
Hehe... We're pretty
lovey-dovey, aren't we？
translations.男の子の手ってさ……あったかいよね。:
Boys' hands are...
really warm, aren't they？
translations.……ずっとこうしてたいけどさ……ほら……。:
...I want to stay like this
forever, but... you know...
translations.離れられなくなっちゃうよ……。:
I won't be able to
let go of you...
translations.もっと強く。ぎゅって、して。:
Hold on tighter.
Squeeze a little harder.
translations.ちょっと……恥ずかしいのは、なしだよ？:
Hey... No doing anything
embarrassing, okay？
translations.ヤダ。手、離せないよ。:
No way. I can't let go
of your hand.
translations.この手、リンコは大好きだよ。:
I really love this hand
of yours.
translations.うれしい……かな。:
I think... that makes
me happy.
translations.割と好きだよ。そういうの。:
I actually kind of like
that sort of thing.
translations.ちゃんとわかってるじゃん。:
You know me pretty well,
don't you？
translations.まぁ……わるくないかな。:
Well... I guess it's
not bad.
translations.楽しそう？ そうかも。:
Look like I'm having fun？
Maybe I am.
translations.楽しいよ。ウソじゃないって。:
I'm having fun.
I'm not lying.
translations.なんだか笑っちゃいそう。:
I feel like
I'm gonna laugh.
translations.へへ……。なんかいいね。:
Hehe...
This is kind of nice.
translations.バカ！ ま、まあいいけど。:
Idiot! W-Well, I guess
it's fine.
translations.もう！ なにがしたいわけ？:
Geez! What are you
trying to do？
translations.平気な顔できないよ……。:
I can't keep
a straight face...
translations.どう反応すればいいか、わかんないよ。もう……。:
I don't even know how to
react to that. Geez...
translations.落ち着く、かな。: It calms me down, I think.
translations.まあ、これで、ひと安心。:
Well, I can
breathe easy now.
translations.うん……好きかな。: Yeah... I think I like it.
translations.好きすぎておかしくなりそうだよ。:
I love you so much
I think I'm going crazy.
translations.なんでだろ、すごく切なくなってきた……。:
I don't know why, my chest
is starting to ache...
translations.リンコのこと……大切に思ってくれてんだね。:
You really care about me,
don't you...
translations.リンコ、もっとキス上手になるから……。:
I'll get even better
at kissing...
translations.ながーい、キスだね……。:
That was a really long
kiss...
translations.チュー……好きだね？:
You really like kisses,
don't you？
translations.撫でても何もないよ？:
Patting my head won't get
you anything, you know？
translations.結構好きかも。:
I think I actually
like this.
translations.頭なでて、おしまい？:
Just a pat on the head
and that's it？
translations.もうちょっと続けていいよ。:
You can keep going
a little longer.
translations.そんなにリンコの髪に触りたいの？:
Do you want to touch
my hair that badly？
translations.髪の毛触るの好きなの？:
Do you like touching
my hair？
translations.しょうがないなぁ、もう……。:
Guess it can't be helped.
Geez...
translations.へへ……髪の毛くしゃくしゃだね。:
Hehe... My hair's all
messed up now.
translations.アンタだから許すんだからね。:
I'm only letting you get
away with this because
it's you.
translations.へへへ……ちょっと気持ちいいかも。:
Hehehe... That actually
feels pretty good.
translations.もっとやってもいいよ。:
You can do it some more
if you want.
translations.熱なんかないよ。:
I don't have a fever or
anything.
translations.なんでおでこ触ってるの？:
Why are you touching my
forehead？
translations.どうしたの？ おでこなんか触って。:
What is it？ Why are you
touching my forehead？
translations.楽しい？ それならいいけど？:
Having fun？ Well, if
you're happy, I guess.
translations.んっ！ やめてよ～。ぞわぞわってするから。:
Mm！ Stop that~. It gives
me the shivers.
translations.もうっ！ ……へんな声出ちゃったじゃん！:
Geez！ ...You made me make
a weird noise！
translations.ひゃっ!? もぉ……そういうの弱いんだから……。:
Hyah！？ Geez... You know
that's my weak spot...
translations.やっぱ好きなの？:
So you really do like
this, huh？
translations.ドキドキしてるの、ばれちゃいそうだね。:
You're gonna notice how
fast my heart's beating.
translations.あっ！ ドキドキするね……こういうの……。:
Ah！ Stuff like this...
really gets my heart
racing.
translations.もっとしっかり組んでもいいよ。:
You can hold my arm a
little tighter if you want.
translations.こうしてると、離れたくなくなるね……。:
Being like this makes me
not want to let go...
translations.くっつきたいなら、もっとくっつけばいいじゃん。ほら！:
If you want to get close,
just come closer already.
Come on！
translations.べ、別に赤くなんてなってないよ。そっちこそ赤いじゃん！:
I-I'm not blushing at all.
You're the one who's red！
translations.へへへ。もっとくっつこ。……別に恥ずかしくないよ。:
Hehehe. Let's get closer.
...I'm not embarrassed or
anything.
translations.こうしてると、すごく感じるね。……お互いの体温。:
When we're like this, I
can really feel it...
Each other's warmth.
translations.手？ ちょっとくらいなら貸してもいいよ。:
My hand？ I guess you can
have it for a bit.
translations.握りたいの？ いいよそのかわり優しくね。:
You want to hold my hand？
Okay, just be gentle.
translations.手、握りたいんでしょ。別にいいよ。:
You want to hold hands,
right？ Go ahead, I don't
mind.
translations.手握ると、お互いが溶け合う感じがする。:
When we hold hands, it
feels like we're melting
into each other.
translations.手ぐらい握ってもいいよ。リンコも嫌じゃないし。:
Holding hands is fine.
I don't mind it either.
translations.……もうちょっと、しっかり握ってもいいよ。:
...You can hold on a
little tighter if you want.
translations.指と指を絡めるみたいにして……うん、これ好き。:
Lacing our fingers
together like this...
Yeah, I like this.
translations.手を握ると、なんか自然に見つめ合っちゃうよね。:
When we hold hands, we
just kind of end up looking
into each other's eyes.
translations.はぁ……、わかってないなぁー。:
Hah... You really don't
get it.
translations.なにそれ……？ 鈍感！:
What's with that...？
You're so dense！
translations.リンコにさ……、興味ない？:
Are you... not interested
in me？
translations.ふぅん……。べつに、いいけどさ……。:
Hmph... Whatever, I don't
really care...
translations.今日からこのクラスを担当する……。:
I'm in charge of this class
starting today...
translations.違う、生徒じゃないってば、先生だってば……！:
No, I said I'm not a student,
I'm the teacher...!
translations.うるさーい！ 授業中は静かにしろー！:
Shut uuuup!
Be quiet during claaass!
translations.もうこんな時間……。リンコ、先生なのに遅刻しちゃうかも……。:
It's so late already... I might
be late, and I'm the teacher...
translations.こらぁ……授業中に雑談するなぁ……リンコが教頭に叱られる……。:
Hey... No chatting in class...
The vice principal's gonna yell at me...
translations.リンコ先生は怒ると怖いんだぞぉ……愛の鞭～！:
Miss Rinko's scary when she's mad...
Tough looove...!
translations.もう起きないと……。ご主人様にご奉仕……ご奉仕……。ダメ……眠いよ……。:
Gotta get up... Serve Master...
Serve him... Can't... So sleepy...
translations.むー。メイド服って、面倒臭い……。:
Mmph. Maid outfits are
such a pain...
translations.こら、ご主人様……メイドさんの言うことにはちゃんと従えー……。:
Hey, Master... Do what your maid
tells you to dooo...
translations.ご飯……早く食べないと消えちゃう……待って……。:
My food... If I don't eat fast,
it'll disappear... Wait...
translations.あー、おいしかった。……あ、それ何？ それも食べる……。:
Ahh, so good... Oh, what's that？
I'm eating that too...
translations.うーん、苦しい……食べ過ぎた……。:
Ugh, I'm stuffed...
Ate too much...
translations.授業ダルいー、もう帰りたいー。:
Class is such a draaag,
I wanna go hooome.
translations.うそ……なんでこんな点数……うー、追試はイヤ～……。:
No way... How'd I get this score...
Ugh, no makeup exaaams...
translations.先生っ……リンコ起きてるよ……起きてるってば……。:
Teach... I'm awake...
I said I'm awake...
translations.早く、アレ乗ろうよ……あ、あっちもいいな……。:
Come on, let's ride that...
Oh, that one looks good too...
translations.あのさ、書き初めとかする？: Hey, do you do New Year's calligraphy？
translations.うーん……学校の宿題ぐらいでしかやんないな。: Hmm... Only when it's for school homework, really.
translations.だよね……はぁ、リンコは憂うつだよ。: Figures... Ugh, I'm really dreading it.
translations.弟が幼稚園でやるっていうからさ、なんか付き合わされそう。: My little brother says they're doing it at preschool, so it looks like I'll get roped into doing it with him.
translations.なるほどね。▲小早川＊▲って字、苦手だっけ？: Gotcha. Are you bad at calligraphy, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そういうわけじゃないけど、何書けばいいのかわかんないし。なんかない？: It's not that, I just don't know what to write. Got any ideas？
translations.そうだな……やっぱ四字熟語かな。天下無双、百戦錬磨、一騎当千……。: Let's see... Maybe a four-character idiom. "Peerless Under Heaven," "Battle-Hardened," "Match for a Thousand"...
translations.なんでそんな物騒なのばっか？: Why do they all sound so violent？
translations.そりゃ、▲小早川＊▲“らしさ”を考えてさ？: Well, I was going for something that fits ▲小早川＊▲'s "style," you know？
translations.どんな、“らしさ”だっつーの！: And what kind of "style" is that supposed to be？！
translations.あのさ、おせち料理って好き？: Hey, do you like New Year's osechi dishes？
translations.おせちっていっても色々あるしなあ。もちろん好きなものもあるぞ？: Well, osechi has all kinds of different things in it. Of course there are some I like.
translations.ふーん。でもさ、最初はいいけど、そのうち飽きてこない？: Huh. Still, it's fine at first, but don't you get tired of it after a while？
translations.ああ、三が日が終わる頃には、他のものが食べたくなったりな。カレーとか。: Yeah, by the time the first three days of the year are over, you start craving other stuff. Like curry.
translations.だよね。宅配ピザ屋にとっても、お正月は稼ぎ時らしいよ？: Right？ Apparently New Year's is peak season for pizza delivery places, too.
translations.へー、どこで調べたんだ、そんなの。: Huh, where'd you look something like that up？
translations.それ、調査っていうか、小早川家の話だろ？: That's not so much a survey as just what happens at the Kobayakawa house, isn't it？
translations.違うっつーの、原ちゃんの家もそうだって言ってたし。あとは……。: It is not! Hara said her family's the same way. And then...
translations.なんか、どこかの親戚の人もそんなこと言ってた気がする。そんな感じなんだってば。: I feel like one of my relatives said something like that, too. It's something like that, okay!
translations.今度さ、豆まきやろっか。: Hey, wanna do some bean-throwing soon？
translations.なんだよ、急に。: Where'd that come from all of a sudden？
translations.２月っていえば節分でしょ？ 弟が豆まきやりたいって言うから。: February means Setsubun, right？ My little brother says he wants to throw beans.
translations.お姉ちゃんとしては、かわいい弟の希望をかなえてあげたいわけだ。: And as his big sister, you want to make your cute little brother's wish come true.
translations.そういうこと。で、どう？: Pretty much. So, what do you say？
translations.念のために聞いておくけど、オニの役は……。: Just to be sure, who's playing the demon...？
translations.アンタに決まってるじゃん。他に誰かいる？: You, obviously. Who else is there？
translations.そういうのはお父さんがやるもんじゃないのか？: Isn't the dad usually supposed to do that sort of thing？
translations.だって、お父さんじゃイマイチ頼りにならないし……アンタの方がまだマシかなって。: Yeah, well, my dad's not really cut out for it... so I figured you'd at least be passable.
translations.……家族の団らんを邪魔しちゃ悪いからな。●は辞退しとくよ。: ...I wouldn't want to intrude on your family time, so ● will pass on that.
translations.えー、アンタが頼りだったのに。きっと最高のやられ……じゃない、鬼役になれるって！: Come on, I was counting on you. I know you'd make the best punching bag... I mean, demon!
translations.（“まだマシ”なんじゃなかったのか？）: (Wait, wasn't I just "passable" a second ago？)
translations.２月って、一年で一番寒く感じるよな……。: February always feels like the coldest time of the year...
translations.お年寄りにはこたえる季節ですか？: Is this season rough on the elderly？
translations.まあな……一歳しか違わないけどな！: Yeah, well... we're only a year apart, you know!
translations.あ～あ、あったかくなるまで、できれば毎日コタツで丸くなってたいよ……。:
Man, I wish I could just
curl up under the kotatsu every
day until it warms up...
translations.相変わらずインドア派だな。冬眠でもするつもりか？:
Still an indoor person, huh.
Planning to hibernate or
something？
translations.だってさ、コタツの快適さには逆らえないよ。:
Come on, there's no resisting
how cozy a kotatsu is.
translations.それは●も賛成だけど。あとはミカンでもあれば最高かな。:
● can't argue with that.
Throw in some mandarins and
it'd be perfect.
translations.リンコはどちらかといえば、ホットココアだね。:
I'm more of a hot cocoa
person, myself.
translations.外から帰ってきたあとに、両手でマグカップを抱えてるときの温かさ……あれが幸せって:
Coming in from the cold and
warming your hands on a mug...
I guess that's what happiness is.
translations.はは、手軽な幸せだな。:
Haha, that's a pretty simple
kind of happiness.
translations.わかってないな。そういう些細な事象にこそ、真理が隠れてるもんだよ。:
You just don't get it. The
truth is hidden in trivial
little things like that.
translations.（わかるような、わからんような……）:
(I kind of get what she means,
and kind of don't...)
translations.最近はあったかくなってきたし、いい季節かもな。:
It's been getting warmer
lately. Pretty nice time of
year, huh.
translations.３月は、別れの季節でもあるけどね。:
March is also the season for
goodbyes, though.
translations.……なんか思い出でもあるのか？:
...Does that bring back some
kind of memory for you？
translations.小学校の頃さ、大学を出たばかりの若い女の先生がいたんだよ。:
Back in elementary school, we
had a young woman teacher
who was fresh out of college.
translations.リンコのこと、何かと気にかけてくれてたんだけど、急に転任が決まって……。:
She was always looking out for
me, but then all of a sudden,
she got transferred...
translations.そっか。▲小早川＊▲、そのとき寂しかったんだな。:
I see. That must've been
lonely for you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.あ～もう、なに思い出してるんだろ。:
Ugh, why am I even thinking
about that right now？
translations.誰だって、そういう思い出あるだろ。たまに思い出したっていいじゃん。:
Everyone has memories like
that. Nothing wrong with
looking back once in a while.
translations.でもさ、リンコっぽくないじゃん。:
Still, it doesn't really seem
like me, does it.
translations.……そっか、アンタの前で意地はってもしょうがないか。そうだね、こういうのも、ある:
...Right, no point trying to act
tough in front of you. Yeah,
maybe this is like me in a way.
translations.近所の庭にさ、桃の花が咲いてたんだよね。:
There were peach blossoms
blooming in a yard near my
place.
translations.そういや、そんな季節だな。:
Come to think of it,
it is that time of year.
translations.うん。でさ、しばらく眺めてたら、その家のおばあちゃんに話しかけられてさ。:
Yeah. I was looking at them for
a while, and the old lady who
lives there started talking to me.
translations.へえ。なんかいいな、そういうの。:
Oh yeah？ There's something
nice about that.
translations.でしょ。結構仲良くなったよ。お茶とお菓子ごちそうになったし。:
Right？ We hit it off pretty
well. She even treated me to
some tea and snacks.
translations.まさかそれが目当てで……。:
Don't tell me you were after
that the whole time...
translations.そんなわけないっつーの。情緒がないなあ。:
As if. You really have no
appreciation for the mood.
translations.そのおばあちゃんは、ちゃんとＴＰＯにマッチしたお菓子を用意してくれたのにさ。:
And she even went out of her
way to serve a snack that fit
the occasion, too.
translations.へえ、和菓子とか？:
Oh yeah？ Like traditional
sweets or something？
translations.ううん、桃味のポテチ。あまじょっぱくて結構イケたよ？:
Nope, peach-flavored potato
chips. Sweet and salty—they
were actually pretty good.
translations.うちの近所のお姉さんがさ、就職したんだよね。:
An older girl from my
neighborhood just started a
new job.
translations.でさ、久しぶりに会ったら、イメージがガラっと変わってた。:
When I saw her for the first
time in a while, her whole look
had completely changed.
translations.久しぶりって、どれくらい会ってなかったんだ？:
How long had it been since
you last saw her？
translations.それ、つい最近だろ……。: That's barely any time at all...
translations.わかってないな。女が変わるのに、一ヶ月は充分な時間だって。:
You don't get it. A month is
plenty of time for a woman
to change.
translations.ビシッとスーツを着て、メイクもばっちり。最初、誰かわかんなかったもん。:
She was wearing a sharp suit
with full makeup. I didn't even
recognize her at first.
translations.リンコも将来あんな風にスーツを着こなすＯＬさんになるのかね……うーん、ちょっと違:
I wonder if I'll be an office
worker pulling off a suit like
that someday... Hmm, maybe not.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲がＯＬか、想像できないな……）:
(▲小早川＊▲ in an office job,
huh... I can't really picture it.)
translations.春になるとうかれるって言うじゃん、なんで？:
They say people get all
giddy in the spring. Why？
translations.あったかくなるからじゃないか？:
Maybe because it gets
warmer out？
translations.なんであったかくなるとうかれるの？:
And why does warm weather
make people giddy？
translations.えっと……▲小早川＊▲はウキウキしてこないのか？:
Um... Don't you get all
excited too, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.質問から逃げたね……。まあいいけど。:
Dodging the question, huh...
Well, whatever.
translations.リンコは地に足がついてるからね。いちいちそんなことで浮つかないよ。:
I've got my feet on the
ground. I don't get all
giddy over stuff like that.
translations.読んだのは顔色だっつーの。でさ、なんで春になるとうかれるの？:
I just read your face.
Anyway, why do people get
giddy in the spring？
translations.いっこ質問。母の日に贈るものといえば？:
Quick question. What do
you give for Mother's Day？
translations.いいじゃんか、普通で。母の日にはカーネーションで決まりだろ。:
What's wrong with ordinary？
Carnations are the rule for
Mother's Day.
translations.決まってない。ただの固定観念じゃん。宇宙開闢以来の真理じゃないよ。:
There is no rule. It's just
a stereotype, not some law
from time immemorial.
translations.図書委員の語彙とは思えないね。嘆かわしいよ。:
Some vocabulary for a guy
on the library committee.
Honestly, it's tragic.
translations.まあ図書委員云々は置いとくにしてもさ、「若者の活字離れ～」なんて言われる時代にそ:
Even aside from that, it's
lame being a poster boy for
'kids not reading anymore.'
translations.すいません……で、なんだっけ、母の日のプレゼントだっけ。:
Sorry... Anyway, where were
we？ Mother's Day gifts？
translations.あっ、忘れてた。まあいいや、それは自分で考えるから。それより今は活字離れについて:
Oh, I forgot. Whatever,
I'll think of something.
Right now we're discussing
kids not reading anymore.
translations.なんか周りで花粉症に苦しんでる人が多いんだよね。:
Seems like a lot of people
around me are suffering
from hay fever lately.
translations.え、まだ？ スギは終わったよな。:
Wait, still？ Cedar pollen
season is over, right？
translations.花粉症の子にきいたら、スギ花粉の時期が終わっても、まだ当分は続くらしいよ。:
Someone with hay fever told
me it still goes on for a
while even after the cedar
pollen season ends.
translations.それ、辛いな……。▲小早川＊▲は大丈夫なのか？:
That sounds rough... Are
you okay, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.幸い、リンコは大丈夫。健康に産んでくれた親に感謝だね。:
Luckily, I'm fine. Guess I
have my parents to thank
for my good health.
translations.でも花粉症って突然くるらしいからな。油断はできないぞ？:
Still, I hear hay fever can
hit you out of nowhere.
Don't let your guard down.
translations.脅してもムダだって。今までそんな兆しなかったし、親戚だってみんな……っくしゅ。:
Trying to scare me won't
work. I've never had any
symptoms, and my... *achoo*.
translations.風邪だね！ あー風邪だ風邪。まいったなーもう、くしゅっ。:
It's a cold! Definitely a
cold. Man, what a pain...
*achoo*.
translations.そろそろ父の日だな。▲小早川＊▲は何かするの？:
Father's Day is coming up.
Are you doing anything for
it, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.どうかな。弟はお父さんの絵を描くみたいだけど。:
Not sure. Looks like my
little brother's drawing a
picture of Dad, though.
translations.へえ、喜んでくれるといいな。:
Oh, nice. I hope your dad
likes it.
translations.まあ、そっちは大丈夫だろうけど、リンコの方はね……まだ決めてない。:
Well, I'm sure he'll like
that, but as for me... I
haven't decided yet.
translations.じゃあ……●に相談か？:
So... are you asking ●
for advice？
translations.しないっつーの。お母さんと一緒に決めるから。:
As if. I'm going to decide
with my mom.
translations.なにガッカリしてんの。そんなに頼りにしてほしいわけ？:
Why look so disappointed？
Do you want me to rely on
you that badly？
translations.そりゃあ彼氏として、男として……。:
Well yeah, as your boyfriend,
and as a man...
translations.アンタもお父さんも同じジジイだしね、意見参考になるかも。聞いてあげてもいいよ。:
You and my dad are both old
men anyway, so your take might
be useful. I'll hear you out.
translations.（これは頼られてるのか……？）:
(Does this count as her
relying on me...？)
translations.ジューン・ブライドって言うじゃん。:
You know that whole
'June bride' thing, right？
translations.あのさ、６月に結婚すると幸せになれる、ってひどい話じゃん。他の月に結婚した人はど:
Saying you'll be happy if
you marry in June is awful.
What about other months？
translations.まあ実際のところ、６月の結婚って多くないらしいけどね。:
Though apparently, not that
many people actually get
married in June anyway.
translations.雨が多いじゃん。せっかくの結婚式に、天気が悪いと嫌でしょ。:
All the rain. Nobody wants
bad weather on their big
wedding day, right？
translations.ああ、なるほど。それにしても……詳しいな、▲小早川＊▲。:
Ah, makes sense. Still...
you sure know a lot about
this stuff, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そういうの結構気になるタイプなんだな。:
Guess you're actually pretty
into that kind of thing.
translations.……うるさいな。こんなのただの知識、雑学だっつーの。:
...Shut up. It's just basic
knowledge. Trivia, okay？
translations.すっかり暑くなってきたし、薄着の人が多いな。:
It's gotten really hot out.
A lot of people are dressed
pretty lightly.
translations.なんだよ……●は夏物もうちょっと用意しようかなって思っただけで。:
Come on... ● just thought
about getting a few more
summer clothes, that's all.
translations.ふうん……薄着になるのはいいけどさ、アンタもそれなりに身体を鍛えといた方がいいか:
Hmm... Wearing less is fine,
but maybe you should work on
getting in shape first.
translations.ほら、カノジョとしてはさ、カレシにはカッコよくいて欲しいっていうか……。:
I mean, as your girlfriend,
I kind of want my boyfriend
to look good, you know...
translations.▲小早川＊▲ってまさか……マッチョが好み？:
Wait, ▲小早川＊▲... Don't tell
me you're into buff guys？
translations.違うっつーの。マッチョじゃなくて、普通でいいんだけど。:
Of course not. Not buff,
just normal is fine.
translations.わかったよ、▲小早川＊▲が恥ずかしくない程度には鍛えておくから。:
Okay, I'll work out enough
so I don't embarrass you,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.まあ、期待しとく。応援はしないけど。:
Well, I'll count on it. I'm
not cheering you on, though.
translations.嫌いじゃないけど……そうか、もうそんな時期か。:
Sure, I like them... Right, it's
that time of year already.
translations.そう。だからさ、聞いてこいって。:
Yeah. So I was told
to go ask you.
translations.お母さんが……カレシの意見も聞いておけって。:
My mom... She told me to get
my boyfriend's opinion too.
translations.……なんか照れるな、そういう話聞くと。:
...Hearing stuff like that
kind of makes me blush.
translations.それはこっちの台詞。親からそういうこと言われると気まずくって。:
That's my line. It's really
awkward when your parents
say stuff like that to you.
translations.で、さ……リンコの浴衣、見たい？:
So, um... Do you want to see
me in a yukata？
translations.大きな声出さなくても聞こえるっつーの。わかったから。:
No need to shout, I can hear
you fine. I get it already.
translations.この時期は、冷房の効いた部屋にずっとこもってたいね。:
This time of year, I just
want to stay inside with
the AC on all day.
translations.気持ちはわかるけど、体壊すだろうな。:
I get how you feel, but
that's bad for your health.
translations.炎天下に出歩いて、熱中症になる方が不健康だって。:
Going out in the blazing sun
and getting heatstroke is
way worse for your health.
translations.極端だな……そうだ、部屋でも水着着てれば、きっと涼しいぞ。:
Talk about extreme... Hey, if
you wear a swimsuit indoors,
I bet that'd keep you cool.
translations.ここに、普段からカノジョに水着を着させようとする変態がいる。:
We have a pervert here trying
to make his girlfriend wear
a swimsuit around the house.
translations.そんなこと言ってないだろ。ただのたとえで……。:
That's not what I said.
It was just an example...
translations.夏休みの宿題って、先に片づける派？ 後回し派？:
For summer homework, do you
do it right away, or put it
off till later？
translations.まあね。でも問題なのはさ、いつだって先に片づけるのが正義で、後回しは悪って固定観:
Yeah. Though the problem is
how everyone acts like doing
it early is righteous, and
putting it off is evil.
translations.たしかにそれが一般的な考えだけど……問題なのか？:
That's how most people see
it, sure... Is that a
problem？
translations.大問題だね。効率を無視してる。:
A huge problem. It completely
ignores efficiency.
translations.背水の陣ってやつだよ。人間、追い込まれた方が力が出せるんだからさ、後回しにした方:
Having your back against the
wall. People do better under
pressure, so putting it off
should take less time overall.
translations.そう……かもしれないけど。:
That... might be true,
I guess.
translations.そうだって。なのにさ、頭ごなしに非効率な方法を推奨されるんだよ？ やりにくいっつ:
It is. Yet everyone blindly
pushes the inefficient way
on us. What a pain.
translations.（要は、とにかく後回しにしたいんだな……）:
(Basically, she just wants
an excuse to put it off...)
translations.秋休みってないのかな……。:
I wonder why we don't have
an autumn break...
translations.だからだよ。まだ夏休みの余韻が残ってるっていうかさ。:
That's why. I'm still in
that summer break afterglow,
you know.
translations.要するに夏休みボケなわけだ。:
So basically, your brain's
still on vacation.
translations.そんなところ。大人は秋休みの導入を真剣に考えるべきだね。:
Pretty much. Adults really
ought to seriously consider
adding an autumn break.
translations.実現したら何するんだ？:
What would you even do if
we had one？
translations.読書したり、音楽聴いたり、ネコとたわむれたり……。:
Read books, listen to music,
play with cats...
translations.そうだけど……あ、そうだ、アンタともたくさんデートしてあげる。これならいいでしょ:
True, I guess... Oh, right,
I'd go on lots of dates with
you, too. How's that？
translations.●はいいけど……●には実現するための権限はないしな。:
Fine by ●, sure...
though nobody gave ● the
power to make it happen.
translations.……そりゃそうだ。あーあ、機嫌とって損した。:
...Fair point. Ugh, I
buttered you up for nothing.
translations.コンビニでさ、もう中華まんを見かけたんだよね。:
I already saw steamed buns
at the convenience store.
translations.そんな時期か、もう秋だもんな。:
That time of year already,
huh. It is autumn now.
translations.ふーん、食欲の秋ですか。:
Hmm. So autumn's the season
for eating to you, huh.
translations.そうかも。毎年新しい味が登場するし、楽しみだろ。:
Maybe so. They have new
flavors every year, so it's
something to look forward to.
translations.図書委員としてどうかと思うけど。:
Not sure how I feel about a
library committee member
saying that.
translations.かたいこと言うなって！ ▲小早川＊▲は、どんな中華まん食べてみたい？ はいっ。:
Don't be so stiff! What kind
of steamed bun do you wanna
try, ▲小早川＊▲？ Go!
translations.えっ？ えっと……ポテチ、まん？:
Huh？ Um...
a potato chip bun？
translations.バカにするなっつーの。ポテチのフレーバー変えれば色んな味が楽しめてお得じゃん。そ:
Quit mocking me. Switching up
the chip flavors gives you tons
of varieties. Plus... um...
translations.あーもう、アドリブ弱いんだってば……。:
Ugh, come on, you know I'm
bad when put on the spot...
translations.▲小早川＊▲、浮かない顔だけど、なんかあった？:
Why the long face, ▲小早川＊▲？
Did something happen？
translations.家で栗ご飯が出たんだよね。:
We had chestnut rice at
home.
translations.秋っぽいな。嫌いなのか？:
Sounds like autumn. Do you
not like it？
translations.大アリ。お父さんがさ、知り合いからたくさん栗をもらってきて。:
A huge one. My dad got a ton
of chestnuts from a friend.
translations.そう、そういうこと。もう毎日栗づくし。いくらおいしくても毎日は辛いよね。:
Yeah, you guessed it. Nonstop
chestnuts every day. No matter
how good, every day is rough.
translations.お母さんがメニューを工夫してくれるのがせめてもの救いだったんだけど……。:
My mom getting creative with
the menu was the one saving
grace, though...
translations.レパートリーが尽きたときが怖いね。献立がループするか、あるいは色モノに走るかの二:
I'm scared for when she runs
out of ideas. Either the menu
loops, or we get weird dishes.
translations.（うーん、どっちがいいんだろうな……）:
(Hmm, I wonder which would be
better...)
translations.商店街がさ、どこもハロウィンの飾り付けしてるんだよね。:
Everywhere in the shopping
district has Halloween
decorations up right now.
translations.相変わらず日本は海外文化の受容に寛容だね。一応宗教行事なのに。:
Japan is as open to foreign
culture as ever. Even though
it's a religious holiday.
translations.そうだっけ、まあ楽しければいいんじゃないの。:
Is it？ Well, as long as it's
fun, isn't that what matters？
translations.アンタってさ、何も考えてないようで、たまに核心をつくこと言うよね。:
You seem like you're not
thinking at all, yet sometimes
you really hit the mark.
translations.割とね。そういう自然体なとこがいいと思うよ。:
More or less. I like that
natural side of yours.
translations.たまに、ほんとなんにも考えてないんだろうなって思うこともあるけどさ。そこはご愛嬌:
Though sometimes I think you
really aren't thinking at all.
Guess that's your charm.
translations.落ち葉ってさ、邪魔だよね。:
Fallen leaves are a real
nuisance, aren't they？
translations.▲小早川＊▲風に言えば、「情緒がない」ってことなのかなー、と。:
If I put it like ▲小早川＊▲
would, I'd say you have 'no
sense of poetry.'
translations.言うじゃん。揚げ足取り？:
Look at you getting smart.
Trying to trip me up？
translations.そういうつもりじゃないけどさ。: I wasn't trying to do that.
translations.まあいいや。とにかく落ち葉は邪魔だよ、これは間違いないね。:
Whatever. Either way, fallen
leaves are a nuisance. There's
no denying that.
translations.そうかもしれないけど、これもひとつの風物詩だろ。結構キレイだったりするじゃん。:
Maybe, but they're a sign of
the season, right？ Plus they
can look pretty nice.
translations.人に害を与えるものに風物詩も何もないっての。これ以上肩をもつと怒るよ？:
Nothing that harms people is a
'sign of the season.' Take their
side again and I'll get mad.
translations.（なんか面倒くさそうな話かな……）:
(Sounds like this is gonna be
some complicated story...)
translations.今日家を出るとき、落ち葉で滑って転んだ。この痛みが消えるまで、落ち葉は敵。:
I slipped on leaves and fell
leaving home today. Until the
pain fades, they're the enemy.
translations.（……むちゃくちゃ単純な話だったな）:
(...Okay, that was a
ridiculously simple story.)
translations.そろそろ期末テストか。:
Finals are just around the
corner, huh.
translations.そろそろ準備をしておかないとまずいだろ？:
It'll be bad if we don't start
studying soon, won't it？
translations.ううん、ギリギリまで考えないことにしてる。:
Nope, I'm not thinking about
them until the last minute.
translations.やっぱり一夜漬けタイプか。:
I knew you were the type to
cram the night before.
translations.やっぱりとか決めつけるなっつーの。リンコは燃費がいいんだから。:
Quit assuming things already.
I'm just fuel-efficient.
translations.そう。最小の努力で、できるかぎりの成果を求めるのがリンコのスタイル。:
Yeah. Aiming for the best
results with minimal effort is
just my style.
translations.一見かっこいいことのように聞こえるけど……。:
That sounds pretty cool on the
surface, but...
translations.かっこいいじゃん。努力する人自体を否定はしないけどさ、これはこれで結構達成感ある:
It IS cool. I'm not knocking
people who work hard, but this
way feels pretty rewarding too.
translations.ね。今年は雪、たくさん降るかな。:
Hey. Think we'll get a lot of
snow this year？
translations.降るにしても、たくさんかどうかはわからないな。:
Even if it does snow, I don't
know if we'll get a lot.
translations.でも▲小早川＊▲、寒いの苦手じゃないのか？ 雪はいいのか？:
Wait, don't you hate the cold,
▲小早川＊▲？ You're okay with snow？
translations.んー、学校に行けなくなるぐらい積もってくれればなーって。: Well, I was just hoping it'd pile up enough that we couldn't go to school.
translations.それは大ごとだな。デートもできないだろ？: That'd be a huge deal. We wouldn't be able to go on dates either, you know？
translations.まあ、そうか……。じゃあ学校だけ雪に埋もれてくれないかな。: Yeah, I guess... Can't the snow just bury the school and nowhere else？
translations.（……想像するとちょっと楽しそうだな）: (...Picturing that actually sounds kind of fun.)
translations.年越しそば、年越しうどん、年越しラーメン。: New Year's Eve soba, New Year's Eve udon, New Year's Eve ramen.
translations.なんだ、大晦日なに食べるかって話？: What's this, talking about what to eat on New Year's Eve？
translations.うん。そば、うどん、ラーメンは食べたことあるんだけどさ。他になんかないかなって。: Yeah. I've done soba, udon, and ramen before, so I was wondering if there's anything else.
translations.麺類ならなんでもいいのか？ じゃあ、パスタは？: Anything goes as long as it's noodles？ What about pasta, then？
translations.アリだけど、汁物じゃないとなんとなく……あ、スープパスタならいっか。: That could work, though it doesn't feel right without broth... Oh, soup pasta would work.
translations.うん、年越しスープパスタ。いいじゃん。: Yeah, New Year's Eve soup pasta. Sounds good to me.
translations.伝統を重んじる人からは怒られそうだけど……まあ、なんでもいいか。: Traditionalists would probably get mad at you, but... well, whatever works, I guess.
translations.あ、ううん。なんでもありならいっそ……。: Oh, wait, no. If anything goes, maybe I should just go all out...
translations.年越し流しそうめん。どう、流行らないかな？: New Year's Eve flowing somen. What do you think, could it catch on？
translations.……ちょっと時代を先取りし過ぎだと思うぞ。: ...I think that's a little too ahead of its time.
translations.あーっ、つまんない！ なんでお正月って、同じような特番ばっかなんだろ。: Ugh, I'm bored! Why is New Year's TV nothing but the same old specials？
translations.毎年のことだからなー。正月特番なんてみんな、ぼーっとしながら見るもんだし。: It's the same every year. People just zone out watching New Year's specials anyway.
translations.まあ新年早々、重いドキュメンタリー放送されても困るけどね。: True, though I wouldn't want them airing some heavy documentary right at the start of the year either.
translations.じゃあ、▲小早川＊▲はどんなのが見たいんだ？: So what kind of show do you want to watch, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.隠し芸大会みたいなのは結構好きだったけどね。ほら、テーブルクロス引きとか、あった: I actually liked those celebrity talent shows. You know, where they'd do the tablecloth pull and stuff.
translations.……そうだ、今度アンタんちでやってみない？ リンコでも意外とできそうな気がするん: ...Hey, wanna try it at your place sometime？ I feel like I could actually pull it off.
translations.そういえば成人式か……。晴れ着姿って華やかでいいよな。: Come to think of it, it's Coming of Age Day... People look so glamorous in their formal kimono.
translations.見てるだけで華やいだ気分にはなるね。: Just looking at them puts you in a festive mood.
translations.見てるだけ、か。自分で着てみたいと思わない？: Just looking, huh？ Don't you want to try wearing one yourself？
translations.思わないこともないけど……苦しそうじゃん。: I mean, a little, maybe... but it looks super uncomfortable.
translations.帯でぎゅうぎゅう締め付けられたまま、何時間もあの姿でいられる自信は、リンコにはな: I really don't think I could last for hours like that with the sash tied so tightly around me.
translations.成人した▲小早川＊▲の晴れ着姿、想像してさ。……ハハハ。: Just picturing you in a kimono for your Coming of Age Day, ▲小早川＊▲. ...Hahaha.
translations.二十歳……ね。“大人”になった自分のことなんて、想像できないよ。まだ遠い先のこと: Turning twenty, huh... I can't even picture myself as an "adult." That's still so far off.
translations.（“大人”の▲小早川＊▲。どんな風に変わってるのか、ちょっと楽しみだな……）: (An "adult" ▲小早川＊▲. I'm kind of looking forward to seeing how she'll change...)
translations.ハァ……そろそろ立春って言っても、ぜんぜん暖かくならないね。: *Sigh*... They say it's almost the first day of spring, but it's not getting any warmer at all.
translations.冬真っ盛りなのに“立春”って。春の気配なんてぜんぜんないのに。: Calling it the "start of spring" in the dead of winter... There isn't even a hint of spring yet.
translations.●にそんなこと言われても、昔からそう言われてるとしか。: Don't look at ●. That's just what it's always been called.
translations.……そういえば、立春ってことは春一番か……。: ...Come to think of it, the start of spring means those strong first spring winds are coming...
translations.なんだ、春一番でスカートが、とかそういう意味じゃないのか。: Oh, so you aren't thinking about the wind blowing skirts up.
translations.本当にぃ？ ま、やさしいカノジョは信じてあげるけどね。: Really？ Well, since I'm such a nice girlfriend, I'll take your word for it.
translations.いつになったら暖かくなるんだろ。寒いの、苦手なんだけど。: I wonder when it'll finally warm up. I don't do well with the cold.
translations.そろそろ暖かくなってもいい頃なんだけど……寒い日が続くよな。: It really ought to be warming up by now... Still so cold every day, though.
translations.毎日こんな気温じゃね。このまま冬が続くのかって思うよ。: With temperatures like this every day, yeah. Makes you wonder if winter's ever going to end.
translations.さすがにそんなことはないだろ。きっとすぐそこまで春は来てる……はず。: I doubt that'll happen. Spring's gotta be right around the corner... probably.
translations.おーい、春はどこだー。……なんて言ってもやってこないか。: Hey, spring, where are you... Not like calling out for it is gonna make it show up.
translations.呼んで来てくれるなら、●も呼びたいけどなあ。: If calling for it worked, ● would be calling out too.
translations.ほら、あそこ。梅のつぼみ、見っけ。春はまだ遠いと思ってたけど、ちゃーんと近づいて: Look, over there. I found some plum buds. I thought spring was still a long way off, but it really is getting closer.
translations.最近さ、夜が短くなったよね。春分の日も近いんだって、カレンダー見て気づいた。: The nights have gotten shorter lately, huh. I looked at the calendar and realized the spring equinox is coming up soon.
translations.夜型の▲小早川＊▲としては残念じゃないの？: Isn't that a bummer for a night owl like you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そうでもないけど。そんなに夜のイメージだっけ？: Not really. Do you really associate me with the night that much？
translations.出会った頃のイメージがあるからなー。: Well, that's the impression I got when we first met.
translations.まあ、リンコもアンタはサバ缶のイメージだけど。: Well, I still associate you with canned mackerel, too.
translations.どんなイメージだよ……。: What kind of association is that...
translations.冗談だっつーの。けどさ、恋人同士には昼も夜も関係ないんじゃない？: I'm kidding, obviously. Besides, day or night doesn't really matter when you're a couple, right？
translations.リンコが会いたいって思えば、アンタは昼夜関係なく会いに来てくれるでしょ？: If I want to see you, you'll come see me whether it's day or night, won't you？
translations.えっ!? ●、２４時間待機……？: Huh!? ● have to be on standby 24/7...？
translations.それくらいの気持ちでいてくれるよねって話。真夜中に呼び出したりはしないから。: I just mean I'd like you to feel that way. I'm not gonna call you out in the middle of the night.
translations.もしかして、花粉症？: Wait, do you have hay fever？
translations.どうだろ、まあそんなシーズンだけど。: Not sure. It is that time of year, though.
translations.あのさ、今年の花粉は例年の１０倍！ とかよく言うじゃん。: You know how they always say stuff like, "This year's pollen is ten times worse than usual!"？
translations.たしかによく聞くかも。: Yeah, you do hear that a lot.
translations.思うんだけどさ、それ、毎年言ってない？: I've been thinking... don't they say that every single year？
translations.そんなこと……そうかもな。: No way... Well, maybe they do.
translations.嘘ついてるってわけじゃないんだろうけど、きっと数字のマジックでだまされてるんだよ: I'm sure they aren't outright lying, but they're definitely tricking us with statistics.
translations.花粉が多いってなると、誰が得するんだ？: Who even benefits if there's more pollen？
translations.ほら、薬とかマスクがたくさん売れるじゃん。陰謀だね。: Think about it, they sell way more medicine and masks. It's a conspiracy.
translations.そう。だから気にしたら負け。: Yep. So if you let it get to you, you lose.
translations.新番組の時期だな。: It's that time of year for new TV shows.
translations.そっか。あんまり興味ないから、気にしたことなかった。: Oh, right. I'm not really interested, so I never paid much attention.
translations.▲小早川＊▲は観たいのないの？ ドラマとかバラエティとかさ。: Nothing you want to watch, ▲小早川＊▲？ Like dramas or variety shows？
translations.連ドラは一度見逃すと、話がわからなくなるからパス。よっぽど興味持てば別だけど。: If you miss one episode of a drama series, you lose track of the plot, so I pass. Unless it's something I'm really into.
translations.バラエティはもっと興味ないね。読書か、音楽聴いてた方がよっぽど有意義。: And I care even less about variety shows. Reading a book or listening to music is a much better use of my time.
translations.新番組にまったく興味なし？: So zero interest in the new lineup？
translations.あるにはあるけど……たぶんアンタは興味ないかも。: Well, there is one thing... though you probably wouldn't care for it.
translations.そう、パンクとハードコアがメイン。今時めずらしいよね、もうメロコアって時代でもな: Yeah, mostly punk and hardcore. Pretty rare these days, especially since the melodic hardcore era's long over.
translations.これからどんなのやるんだろ。やっぱりエモとかスクリーモあたりもおさえてくるのかな: I wonder what they'll play going forward. Probably stuff like emo and screamo too, I guess.
translations.そうだな……ピクニックとかいいかもな。: Yeah... A picnic might be nice.
translations.おにぎりかサンドイッチに、卵焼き、からあげ……デザートにフルーツ？: Rice balls or sandwiches, rolled omelet, fried chicken... and fruit for dessert？
translations.ふーん、じゃあ、がんばって。: Hmm. Well, good luck with that.
translations.弁当男子ってやつ？: Going to be one of those guys who makes his own bento？
translations.授業で俳句の話聞いたんだけどさ、季語ってあるじゃん。詳しい？: We talked about haiku in class, and you know how they have seasonal words？ Do you know much about them？
translations.知ってるけど……詳しくはないな。: I know what they are, just... not a whole lot.
translations.今の時期は“立夏”でさ。それって、夏の季語なんだって。: Right now it's the start of summer on the old calendar, so apparently that counts as a summer seasonal word.
translations.夏か。まだ５月じゃ、夏なんて遠い先の話だけどなあ。: Summer, huh. It's only May, so summer still feels a long way off.
translations.旧暦ってことだけど、実感ないよね。: It's based on the lunar calendar, so it doesn't really feel like it, does it.
translations.今から夏です、って言われてもな……。: Yeah, even if they tell us summer starts now...
translations.どこの南国だって話だよね。海で泳いだりしたら、風邪ひくよ。: Right？ Like, what tropical island is this？ If you went swimming in the ocean now, you'd catch a cold.
translations.まあな。で、夏の季語を使って、▲小早川＊▲は何か俳句詠んだの？: True. So, did you write a haiku with a summer word, ▲小早川＊▲？
