translations.え……それはさ、ほらアンタにこの話をしたかったから……へへ、そのあとの授業よく聞: Uh... Well, see, I was busy thinking about telling you this, so... hehe, I wasn't really paying attention to the rest of class.
translations.ね。折り紙で折る兜ってあるじゃん。折り方知ってる？: Hey. You know those origami samurai helmets？ Do you know how to fold one？
translations.なんとなく覚えてはいるんだけど、折れるかどうかっていうと……。: I vaguely remember how, but whether I could actually fold one is another story...
translations.リンコも。けど弟に聞かれて、折れないとは言えないよね。お姉ちゃんのプライドにかけ: Same here. But my little brother asked me, and I couldn't just say I didn't know how. My pride as his big sister was on the line.
translations.必死になっちゃったわけだ。: So you really had to scramble, huh.
translations.リンコ自身、折れそうで折れないモヤモヤ感が嫌だったんだよね。: Plus, it really bugged me feeling like I almost remembered how to fold it, but not quite.
translations.で、折れたんだ？: So, did you manage to fold it？
translations.折り紙の本を見ながら折ったんだけど、うまくいかないんだよね。: I tried following an origami book, but it just wouldn't turn out right.
translations.本を見ながらでも無理？ 兜ってそんなに難しかったっけ。: Even with a book？ Were those helmets really that hard to make？
translations.本の通り折ってるはずなんだけど、なぜか変形ロボができあがってさ。弟は喜んでくれて: I thought I was following the steps, but somehow I ended up with a transforming robot. My brother's happy with it, though, so all's well that ends well.
translations.だいぶ日が長くなってきたな。: The days have gotten a lot longer.
translations.昼間が一番長い時期だよね。日本だとさらっと流されちゃうけど。: It's the time of year when the days are longest. People in Japan don't really make a big deal out of it, though.
translations.天気予報でちょっと触れたりするくらいかな。: Yeah, it pretty much just gets a quick mention on the weather forecast.
translations.北欧だと夏至って特別な日としてお祝いするんだってさ。: Apparently in Northern Europe, they celebrate the summer solstice as a special holiday.
translations.へえ、博識じゃん。: Huh, you really know your stuff.
translations.お父さんの受け売り。北極近いとこだと、夏至の頃から白夜が見られるんだってさ。: Just repeating what my dad told me. He said near the Arctic, you get what they call 'white nights' around the summer solstice.
translations.白夜か……太陽が沈まないっていう？: White nights, huh... That's when the sun never sets, right？
translations.そ。昼が長いどころかずっと昼間の明るさなんだって。だから白い夜で白夜。: Yeah. Far from the days just being long, it stays bright as day the whole time. That's why they call it a white night.
translations.へえ、一度くらい見てみたいな。一緒にさ。:
Huh, I'd love to see that
someday. With you.
translations.アンタと海外旅行か……へへ。:
A trip overseas with you...
Hehe.
translations.もしかして、機嫌悪い……？: Are you in a bad mood...？
translations.日本の梅雨の不快さについて、朝から考察してたところ。:
I've just been contemplating
how miserable Japan's rainy
season is all morning.
translations.結論は湿度が高いせいで、うまく髪がまとまらない。ほら、ここんとこ。:
That the high humidity makes
my hair impossible to manage.
Look, right here.
translations.……そうか？ まあ、そんな理由でよかったよ。:
...Really？ Well, I'm glad
that's all it is.
translations.よくないっつーの。……ね、変じゃない？:
It's not okay at all.
...Doesn't it look weird？
translations.えっと……いつも通り可愛いぞ。:
Uh... You look as cute
as always.
translations.へへ。悪いね、言わせちゃって。:
Hehe. Sorry for making you
say it.
translations.はは、機嫌はなおったみたいだな。:
Haha, looks like you're in
a better mood now.
translations.海の日ってさ、なんとなく忘れられがちじゃない？:
Doesn't it feel like people
always forget Marine Day？
translations.たしかに他の祝日に比べて、影が薄いかもな……。:
It does kind of fade into the
background next to other
holidays...
translations.海の日なんて意識したことなかったよ。ただの休みだと思ってた。:
I never really paid attention
to Marine Day. I just thought
it was another day off.
translations.そんなんじゃ、海の日に悪いだろ。:
That's kind of harsh on
Marine Day, don't you think？
translations.そういわれると……なあ？:
Well, when you put it like
that...
translations.でしょ？ 何か意味があるんだろうけどさ。:
Right？ I'm sure there's some
meaning behind it, though.
translations.意味……なんだっけかな。:
The meaning... What was it
again？
translations.砂浜で“海のバカヤロー！”って叫んで青春する日？ まさか、そういうんじゃないよね:
A day to yell 'Stupid ocean!'
on the beach like in a teen
drama？ ...It's not that, right？
translations.（それはさすがに祝日にならないって……）:
(Pretty sure that wouldn't be
a national holiday...)
translations.うちさ、けっこうたくさんお中元が贈られてくるんだよね。昨日も３か所から来たかな。:
We get a whole lot of summer
gifts sent to our house. Three
more came just yesterday.
translations.そう。あれで結構業界で顔が広いみたい。:
Yeah. Apparently he's pretty
well-connected in the industry.
translations.へえ、やり手だったりするんだ。: Huh, so he's a big deal, then.
translations.期待の若手クリエイター、だってさ。若手っていう歳かっつーの。こんなおっきい娘だっ:
A 'promising young creator,'
they say. As if he's young when
he has a daughter this big.
translations.（おっきくはないけどな）:
(Not that you're all that big,
though.)
translations.アンタ、そのすぐ顔に出るくせ治したほうがいいよ。:
You should really fix that
habit of letting everything
show on your face.
translations.ごめん。“おっきくはないけどな”って思ったんだ。:
Sorry. I was just thinking,
'Not that you're all that big.'
translations.口に出せばいいわけじゃないっつーの！:
Saying it out loud doesn't make
it any better!
translations.大丈夫。今はカレシの視線しかないもんね。:
It's fine. My boyfriend's the
only one looking right now,
anyway.
translations.まあ、ならいいけど。: Well, I guess it's fine, then.
translations.こんなに暑い日が続くと、ぐったりもするよ。:
When hot days drag on like
this, it really wipes you out.
translations.●も夜は寝苦しくてダメだな。つい冷房つけたくなる。:
Can't even sleep at night either, ●.
Makes me want to turn on the AC.
translations.でしょ？ でもカレンダーみたら、もう秋なんだよ。立秋だよ？:
Right？ If you look at the calendar, though,
it's already autumn. The first day of fall.
translations.なのにこの蒸し暑さ。いったいいつまで続くんだろ。:
And yet it's still this muggy.
How much longer is it going to last？
translations.うーん、来月になれば、秋の気配もしてくるんじゃないかな。:
Hmm, I bet it'll start feeling like
autumn once next month rolls around.
translations.はあ。早く涼しくなってくれないと、リンコの気力ゲージが尽きるよ。:
Sigh... If it doesn't cool down soon,
my energy gauge is going to run out.
translations.ニュースでさ、お盆の帰省ラッシュのことやってた。あれじゃ、着く頃にはぐったりだよ:
The news had a story on the Obon travel
rush. You'd be exhausted just getting there.
translations.毎年恒例だけどな。: It's the same thing every year, though.
translations.いつも思うんだよね。なにもみんな、この時期に帰らなくてもいいのに。:
I always think about that. People don't
all have to go home at the same time.
translations.そうは言っても、お盆とぜんぜん違う時期に帰省しても、意味がなくないか？:
Yeah, but wouldn't it defeat the purpose
if you didn't go home during Obon？
translations.それはご先祖様もさ、混雑を避けて帰ってくればいいんだよ。:
Well, our ancestors' spirits should just
avoid the rush and come back later too.
translations.ご先祖様の交通規制か、シュールだな……。:
Traffic control for ancestors...
That's pretty surreal.
translations.かわいい子孫たちのためだよ。それくらいは考慮してほしいね。:
It's for their beloved descendants.
They could at least be that considerate.
translations.ところで▲小早川＊▲は田舎に行ったりしないの？:
By the way, do you ever go visit
family in the countryside, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコがいないと、アンタが寂しがるじゃん？:
If I'm not around, you'll get lonely,
won't you？
translations.暦の上だともう秋なんだね。まだ暑いくらいの日があるのに不思議。:
The calendar says it's already autumn.
Weird, when some days are still so hot.
translations.秋分の日を過ぎると一気に秋になっちゃうけどな。:
Once the autumn equinox passes, though,
it'll feel like fall all at once.
translations.ホント、時が過ぎるのって早いよね。: Time really does fly, doesn't it？
translations.たまにはそんな日もあるよ。……でもさ、リンコ、結構秋も好きだよ？:
I have days like that sometimes.
...Still, I actually like autumn quite a bit.
translations.▲小早川＊▲にとっては読書の秋でもあるしな。:
Plus, for you, ▲小早川＊▲, autumn is
the season for reading.
translations.それだけじゃなくて……寒くなればこうやって……。:
It's not just that... When it gets cold,
we can do this...
translations.猫や犬の里親探しのボランティア、ちょっと手伝ってるんだよね。:
I've been helping out a bit as a volunteer
finding homes for cats and dogs.
translations.動物愛護週間だしね。: It is Animal Welfare Week, after all.
translations.なるほど。猫好きの▲小早川＊▲にぴったりだしな。:
I see. That's a great fit for a cat lover
like you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.無責任な飼い主のせいで、あの子たち辛い目に遭ってるんだよ。捨てるくらいなら飼うな:
Those poor animals suffer because of
irresponsible owners. Don't get a pet
if you're just going to abandon it.
translations.ホントならリンコが全部引き取ってあげたいくらい。けど、現実には無理でしょ。:
Honestly, I wish I could take them all in
myself. Realistically, though, I can't.
translations.だからさ、せめて里親捜しくらいは手伝おうと思って。:
So I figured I could at least help
find new homes for them.
translations.本当は最初に飼った人が最後まで、大切に育ててくれればそれが一番なんだけどね。でも:
Ideally, the first owner would take good care
of them until the very end. Still...
translations.そっか。一匹でも多く、いい飼い主と出会えるといいな。:
Yeah. I hope as many of them as possible
can find good owners.
translations.クラスの女子がさ、秋物のセールがあるって騒いでたんだよ。:
The girls in my class were making a big fuss
about some fall clothes sale.
translations.うちのクラスも。セールくらいではしゃがなくてもいいのにね。:
In my class, too. I don't see why people
get so worked up over a sale.
translations.ファッションに興味がないわけじゃないけど。セールはね……。:
It's not that I don't care about fashion,
but sales are just...
translations.人が多いと▲小早川＊▲、つぶされちゃうか……。:
Yeah, in a big crowd, you'd probably
get squished, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.だいたいさ、安いってだけで一時の衝動に流されたくないの。冷静になってから後悔する:
Besides, I don't want to get carried away
just because things are cheap. I'm sure
I'd regret it once I calmed down.
translations.まるで経験したことがあるみたいだな。: Sounds like you're speaking from experience.
translations.……過去には……いろいろとさ。とにかく！ それ以来もう衝動には流されないことに決: ...Well, things happened... in the past. Anyway! Ever since then, I decided not to get carried away on impulse anymore.
translations.いっこ豆知識。体育の日ってさ、もともと東京オリンピックの開会式の日だったんだよ。: Here's a little trivia for you. Health and Sports Day used to be the date of the Tokyo Olympics opening ceremony.
translations.そういえば、そんな話を聞いたことがあるような……。: Now that you mention it, I think I've heard that before...
translations.リンコのおかげで、１つ知識が増えたね。: See？ You learned something new thanks to me.
translations.あんまり使い道はなさそうだけどな。: Can't see it ever coming in handy, though.
translations.いいじゃん。でさ、どうせなら今からオリンピック目指してみない？: Oh, come on. Hey, since we're on the subject, why don't you start training for the Olympics？
translations.次が無理なら、その次とか。そしたらリンコが応援しに行くからさ。: If the next one's impossible, then the one after that. I'll come cheer you on.
translations.無茶苦茶だな……どうした？: That's crazy... Where's this coming from？
translations.平凡な高校生が体操でオリンピックを目指すマンガ読んだら、面白くってさ。汗臭いスポ: I read this manga about an ordinary high schooler aiming for the Olympics in gymnastics, and it was really good. I'm not big on sweaty, intense sports stories, but it wasn't like that.
translations.（でも自分でやろうって気にはならないんだな……）: (Guess it didn't inspire her to try it herself, though...)
translations.たしかに最近寒くなったな。: Yeah, it's gotten pretty chilly lately.
translations.あんまり寒いから、日々コタツを出したい誘惑と格闘中。: It's so cold I'm fighting the urge to break out the kotatsu every day.
translations.リンコはコタツで丸くなる～♪\nってことか。:
♪ Rinko curls up under the kotatsu～♪
Something like that？
translations.ホント、そんな感じ。春までずっとコタツで丸くなってたいよ。: Honestly, yeah. I just want to stay curled up under the kotatsu until spring.
translations.さすがにそれはな……とりあえず厚手の冬物を出すとか……。: I don't know about that... Maybe just pull out some heavy winter clothes for now...？
translations.それよりも、カイロがいいな。リンコ専用のカイロ。いいでしょ？: I'd rather have a hand warmer. My own personal warmer. You don't mind, right？
translations.はいはい、●の体でよければいくらでも使ってくれ。: Sure, sure. If ● can warm you up, use me all you want.
translations.今度インフルエンザの予防接種あるでしょ？ 泣いたりしないようにね。: We have flu shots coming up soon, right？ Try not to cry.
translations.子供じゃないんだから泣くわけないだろ。: I'm not a little kid. No way I'm gonna cry.
translations.そう？ 小学生の頃は、男子の方がギャーギャー泣いてた覚えがあるんだけど。: Really？ Back in elementary school, I remember the boys being the ones bawling their eyes out.
translations.高校生だっつーの。むしろ▲小早川＊▲の方が泣くんじゃないの？: I'm in high school now, come on. If anything, aren't you the one who's gonna cry, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そんなわけないじゃん。だいたい、男の人の方が痛みに弱いって言うよ。: As if. Besides, they say guys have a lower tolerance for pain anyway.
translations.痛いのは痛いけど、人前では泣かないよ。: Sure, it hurts, but I'm not gonna cry in front of people.
translations.それに●は▲小早川＊▲のキックで、痛みには慣れてるからな。: Besides, ● got used to pain thanks to all your kicks, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.じゃ、予防接種の前にもう１回いっとく？: Then want me to give you one more before the shot？
translations.冬至にはカボチャを食べると、風邪を引かないっていうじゃん。: You know how they say eating pumpkin on the winter solstice keeps you from catching a cold？
translations.▲小早川＊▲、野菜嫌いじゃなかったっけ？: Wait, ▲小早川＊▲, didn't you hate vegetables？
translations.カボチャもあんまり好きじゃない。だから基本的には食べないんだけどさ。: I'm not a fan of pumpkin, either. So as a rule, I don't eat it.
translations.だってお母さんが作ってくれて、それを食べないのも悪いじゃん。: Mom made some for me, and I'd feel bad not eating it.
translations.なるほど。お母さんの作るのだけは例外か。: I see. So your mom's cooking is the one exception.
translations.まあね。最初は一口だけと思ったんだけどさ……。: Pretty much. At first I only meant to take one bite, though...
translations.（母親の味か……ちょっといいな）: (Mom's home cooking, huh... That's kinda nice.)
translations.そろそろ年末じゃん。アンタんち、大掃除してる？: It's almost the end of the year. Is your family doing any year-end cleaning？
translations.……ぼちぼちかな。▲小早川＊▲は？: ...Little by little, I guess. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコも、自分の部屋の掃除が進まなくて困ってる。: I'm having a hard time making any progress cleaning my room, too.
translations.▲小早川＊▲の部屋って、そんなに散らかってたっけ？: Was your room really that messy, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.散らかってはないよ。けど、本棚の本を少し処分しろって言われてて。: It's not messy. I was just told to get rid of some of the books on my shelves.
translations.本を処分するのって抵抗あるんだよね。どれもこれも思い出があるし。: I really hate getting rid of books, though. Every single one has memories attached to it.
translations.だから処分するの選ぼうと思っても、懐かしくてつい読み始めちゃうんだよね。: So even when I try to pick which ones to get rid of, I get nostalgic and end up reading them.
translations.ああ、わかるわかる。●もよくやるよ。: Oh, I know the feeling. ● do that all the time, too.
translations.でしょ？ この前なんかさ、朝から整理をはじめたのに、気づいたら夕方だよ。: Right？ Just the other day, I started sorting them in the morning, and before I knew it, it was evening.
translations.（この分だと年内に終わるか、怪しいな……）: (At this rate, I doubt she'll finish before the year's over...)
translations.あのさ、“付き合う”って\nどういうことだと思う？:
Hey, what do you think
"going out" really means？
translations.ちょっとね、\n友だちと話しててさ。\nリンコのカレシの考えも、\n聞いてみたい:
Nothing much, just
talking with some friends.
I wanted to hear what my
boyfriend thinks, too.
translations.そうだな……、ずっと一緒に\n居たいって、お互いに思ってる\nことってのはどうだ:
Let's see... How about
both people wanting to
be together forever？
translations.悪くないんじゃない、\n意外性はないけど。:
Not bad, I guess, though
it's hardly surprising.
translations.意外性はいらないだろ。\n▲小早川＊▲はどう思う？:
It doesn't need to be
surprising. What do you
think, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.さあね、\nただ、この答えにズレがあると、\n二人は上手くいかないらしい。:
Who knows. Apparently, if
a couple's out of sync on
this, they won't work out.
translations.へえ、なるほど。\nで、●たちはズレてんの？:
Huh, makes sense.
So, are we out of sync,
●？
translations.リンコたち、\nけっこう上手くいってると\n思ってたんだけど？:
I thought we were doing
pretty well together,
though？
translations.そう。\nてことは、そういうこと。\nよかったね。:
Right.
So there's your answer.
Good for us.
translations.……めざといな。ちょっと、友だちに聞かれたこと、思い出してた。: ...Nothing gets past you. I was just remembering something a friend asked me.
translations.付き合うってどういうことなのかって。: About what it really means to go out with someone.
translations.難しいな……で、▲小早川＊▲はなんて？: That's a tough one... So what did you say, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコは、答えられなかった。: I couldn't come up with an answer.
translations.だって、みんな“面倒くさい”とか、“束縛されること”とか言っててさ……。: Because everyone else was saying stuff like "it's a hassle" or "it's just being tied down"...
translations.その子たちのことキライじゃないけど。でも、そんな風に思うのって、悲しいなって。: I don't dislike those girls or anything. Still, I thought it was kind of sad to look at it that way.
translations.心配そうな顔すんなっつーの。リンコはそんな風に思ってないからさ。一緒にいるの……: Quit looking so worried. I don't feel that way at all. Being with you... is fun, you know？
translations.あのね、質問してもいい？: Hey, can I ask you a question？
translations.なんだ、あらたまって。: What is it？ You sound serious.
translations.付き合うって、どういうことなのかな？: What does it really mean to go out with someone？
translations.？ ●、なにか不安にさせるようなことしたか？: ？ Did I do something to make you uneasy, ●？
translations.そうじゃないよ。\nただね、友だちに色々相談されて、上手く答えられなかったから。:
It's not that.
A friend came to me for advice, and I couldn't give her a good answer.
translations.そんなの簡単、恋人同士になること。それでいいんじゃないか？: That's easy. It means being a couple. Isn't it as simple as that？
translations.テキトーだなあ。リンコ、色々難しい事考えてたのに。: Well, that's a casual answer. And here I was overthinking all kinds of complicated stuff.
translations.まあ、そのノーテンキなのがいいとこか。悩んでたのがバカらしくなっちゃった。リンコ: Well, I guess being so carefree is one of your good points. Makes me feel silly for worrying over it. We're a couple! Simple as that, right？
translations.さっきから、ぼーっとしてるけど、どうした？: You've been spacing out for a while now. What's up？
translations.悩みごとなら、相談に乗るぞ？: If you're worried about something, I'm here to listen, you know？
translations.考え事って言うと、すぐ悩んでると思うのは短絡的だね。: Jumping straight from "thinking" to "worried" is pretty simplistic of you.
translations.悩みじゃないなら、なに？: Okay, if you're not worried, then what is it？
translations.悩みごとじゃないとは言ってないじゃん。: I didn't say I wasn't worried.
translations.もう、乙女心は複雑なの。: Honestly, a girl's heart is complicated.
translations.（乙女心……女の子って何考えてるんだ……）: (A girl's heart... What even goes on in a girl's head...？)
translations.アンタはさ、リンコの考えてること、分かったりする？: Hey, can you ever tell what I'm thinking？
translations.そりゃあ、前よりは……。: Well, better than I used to...
translations.ふーん、じゃあ、今、リンコが考えたことなに？: Oh yeah？ Then what was I thinking just now？
translations.えっ、今？ うーん……。\nみ、耳の後ろがかゆい？:
Huh, right now？ Hmm...
I-it's itchy behind your ear？
translations.う…………あ、今考えてることはわかるぞ。:
Ugh... Oh, I know what
you're thinking right now.
translations.（●もまだまだだな……）: (● still have a ways to go...)
translations.女の子ってさ、なに考えてるんだろうな？:
What goes on inside a girl's
head, anyway？
translations.こないだクラスの女子が数人で大笑いしてて、何がおかしいのか、聞いてみたらさ、理由:
Some girls in class were laughing
their heads off, and when I asked
why, even they didn't know.
translations.うん、わかるわかる。: Yeah, I get it, I get it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲もそうなのか？ うーん……。:
Are you like that too, ▲小早川＊▲？
Hmm...
translations.違うって。わかるっていうのは現象を理解できるってこと、共感って意味じゃないよ？:
That's not it. Saying I "get it"
means I understand the phenomenon,
not that I relate to them, okay？
translations.つまりさ、その子たちって実は何も考えてないんだよ。女子の涙には面倒くさい理由があ:
Basically, they aren't thinking at all.
Girls cry for complicated reasons, but
laugh for no reason. That's my theory.
translations.へー。で、▲小早川＊▲はそうじゃないんだ。:
Huh. So you're not like that,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そう、リンコの喜怒哀楽は複雑なんだから。がんばってひも解いてよ♪:
Yep. My emotions are complex, so
do your best to unravel them♪
translations.（うーん、答えを見せてほしい……）:
(Hmm, I wish she'd just show me
the answer key...)
translations.あのさ……、▲小早川＊▲はどんなときにドキドキする？:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲... What kind of
thing makes your heart race？
translations.なんでそんなこと聞くの？ 怪しいんだけど。:
Why are you asking that？
Seems kind of suspicious.
translations.別に怪しくないって。カノジョをドキドキさせるのも、カレシの役目だろ？:
It's not suspicious. Making his
girlfriend's heart race is part
of a boyfriend's job, right？
translations.それ、何の受け売り？: Where did you get that line？
translations.友だちが言ってた。雑誌の受け売り。:
A friend said it. Got it
secondhand from a magazine.
translations.そんなことだと思った。\nそれを馬鹿正直に本人に聞いちゃうのが、アンタだよね。:
I figured as much.
It's so like you to just flat-out
ask the girl herself.
translations.まあいいや。\nリンコがドキドキするのは、ひとりで、夜出歩いてるときかな。:
Well, whatever.
My heart races when I'm out
walking alone at night, I guess.
translations.そういう意味じゃないだろ。それに一人じゃ危ないって！:
That's not what I meant!
Besides, it's dangerous alone!
translations.それそれ。また、おせっかいジジイが声かけてくるかもって思うとさ。付き合う前のこと:
Exactly. Thinking some nosy old man
might talk to me again reminds me of
before we dated. Makes my heart race.
translations.▲小早川＊▲のドキドキするときってどんなとき？:
When does your heart race,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そんなこと、簡単に教えないっつーの。\nやられることわかりきってるじゃん。:
Like I'd tell you that easily.
I know you'll just use it on me.
translations.でしょ？ 敵に塩を送るようなまね、できないね。それに、順番としてはまずそっちから:
See？ I'm not about to help out
the enemy. Besides, shouldn't
you be the one to go first？
translations.一番は、▲小早川＊▲とキスするときだな！:
Number one is when I kiss you,
▲小早川＊▲!
translations.えっと、もっと具体的に言うべき？: Uh, should I be more specific？
translations.（こういうこと言うと、▲小早川＊▲はドキドキするんだな……）:
(So saying stuff like that makes
▲小早川＊▲'s heart race, huh...)
translations.あのさ、聞いてもいい？: Hey, can I ask you something？
translations.初めてリンコに会ったとき、ドキドキした？:
Did your heart race when you
first met me？
translations.……したかな。\n純粋にドキドキっていうより、ワクワク感だったかもしれないけど。:
...I think so.
Though maybe it was excitement
more than my heart racing.
translations.ああ。まさかあのときは、▲小早川＊▲とこうなるとは思わなかったけどな。:
Yeah. Back then, I never
imagined you and I would
end up like this, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.へへ、リンコの方が早く予感してたと思うな。\n会う度にドキドキが、増えていったし:
Heh, I think I saw it coming
before you did.
Every time we met, you made
my heart race a little more.
translations.ドキドキか……、それって今も増え続けてるとか？:
Made your heart race, huh...
Does it still do that more
and more even now？
translations.あーあ、今調子乗りすぎたから、１０Ｐ減った。:
Oh, too bad. You got carried
away just now, so that's
minus 10 points.
translations.ね、ピンチとチャンス、どっちが苦手？:
Hey, which do you handle worse:
being in a pinch, or having
a big chance？
translations.んー、そりゃピンチはいやだけど、……チャンスも失敗できないって思うと。:
Hmm, obviously I hate being in
a pinch... but a big chance
means you can't afford to fail.
translations.でしょ？ 結局どっちもドキドキして、あんまり嬉しくないんだよね。普通が一番ってこ:
Right？ Either way your heart's
pounding, so neither is much
fun. Normal really is best.
translations.確かに普通に▲小早川＊▲と一緒にいられるんなら、それでいいな。:
True. As long as I can just be
with you like usual, ▲小早川＊▲,
that's enough for me.
translations.何そのこじつけ。: That's a bit of a stretch.
translations.まあ、そうかもしれないけど。ずっと一緒にいるとさ、ピンチとかチャンスとか色々ある:
Well, maybe. Still, if we stay
together a long time, I'm sure
we'll hit all kinds of pinches
and chances.
translations.二人の将来……とかさ……そんな感じ！:
Like, our future together...
and stuff like that!
translations.最近流行ってる恋愛ドラマ知ってる？:
Do you know that romance drama
that's really popular lately？
translations.ああ、うちのクラスの女子も騒いでる。:
Yeah, the girls in my class
won't stop talking about it.
translations.主役の俳優の声が人気なんだって。聞いてるだけでドキドキするらしいよ。:
They say the lead actor's voice
is huge right now. Just hearing
it makes your heart race.
translations.わかんない。ちょっとやってみてくんない？:
I don't know. Wanna try doing
it for me？
translations.そう、“俺がこの国に来たのは、君に出会うためだったんだ”\nはい！:
Yeah. "The reason I came to
this country was to meet you."
Okay, go ahead!
translations.はいって言われても。:
Wait, you seriously want me
to say that？
translations.“●がとわの市に来たのは、▲小早川＊▲に出会うためだったんだ”:
"The reason ● came to Towano
was to meet you, ▲小早川＊▲."
translations.どう？ ドキドキした？:
Well？ Did that make your
heart race？
translations.あのね、いつもリンコのこと、考えててくれてありがとう。:
Hey... thank you for always
thinking about me.
translations.えっ？ どうした急に改まって。:
Huh？ Why so formal all of
a sudden？
translations.そりゃ、驚くだろ。なんかの最終回みたいだったぞ。:
Of course I'm surprised. That
sounded like the final episode
of something.
translations.リンコが未来に帰っちゃうとか？:
Like I'm about to go back
to the future or something？
translations.そんなに驚いたんなら、成功だね。\nカレシを時にはドキドキさせてみよう！ って雑:
If it surprised you that much,
then it worked.
I saw a magazine ad that said,
"Make your boyfriend's heart
race once in a while!"
translations.……それ、ドキドキの種類が違うと思うぞ。:
...I think that's the wrong
kind of heart-racing.
translations.●の顔に何かついてるか？:
Do ● have something
on my face？
translations.……やっぱ変わってないと思うけどな。:
...Yeah, I really don't think
you've changed.
translations.友達がさ。\nカッコよくなったとか言ってたから……。:
My friend was saying...
that you've gotten cooler
lately.
translations.●、そんなこと言われてるのか？:
Wait, people are saying
● got cooler？
translations.ニヤニヤすんなっつーの。そんなに嬉しいわけ？:
Wipe that grin off your face.
Does it really make you that
happy？
translations.そりゃ、嬉しいだろ。: Well yeah, of course it does.
translations.まあいいけどさ。あんまり調子に乗らないこと。\n……でさ、原因に心当たりってある:
Well, whatever. Just don't
let it go to your head.
...So, any idea what caused
it？
translations.●が変わったとすれば、▲小早川＊▲が原因だろうな。他にはなんもないし。:
If ● changed, it's probably
because of you, ▲小早川＊▲.
There's nothing else.
translations.……いいんじゃない？\nへへ、リンコはそういうの、悪くないと思う。:
...I like the sound of that.
Hehe, I don't think that's
bad at all.
translations.この前さ、すっごく楽しそうに女子と話してたよね？:
The other day, you were
having an awfully fun chat
with some girl, weren't
you？
translations.そうか？ ……クラスの女子かな？:
Was I？ ...Maybe a girl from
my class？
translations.ごめん、ごめん、わかった。\nそんな恐い顔するなよ。:
Sorry, sorry, I get it.
Don't give me such a scary
look.
translations.なんか最近、アンタの周りに女子が多いような気がする。:
I feel like there've been a
lot of girls around you
lately.
translations.うーん……、確かに、▲小早川＊▲と付き合ってから、女子と自然に話せるようになった:
Hmm... True, ever since I
started dating you, ▲小早川＊▲,
maybe I've gotten better at
talking to girls.
translations.ええっ！ 何それ、さらっと言ったけど。:
What？ Hold on, you just
said that so casually.
translations.かわいいカノジョがいる男の余裕ってやつかな！:
Guess that's the confidence
of a guy with a cute
girlfriend!
translations.余裕って……こっちの身にもなれっつーの！:
Confidence... Put yourself
in my shoes, will you!
translations.この前、コンビニで立ち読みしてた？:
Were you browsing magazines
at the convenience store
the other day？
translations.……ああ、してたかも。なんだよ、声かけてくれればいいのに。:
...Yeah, I think I was.
What gives？ You should've
said hi.
translations.なんか、ちょっと大きく見えたから。:
You just looked a little
bigger than usual.
translations.違うっつーの。たくましいって言うかさ、鯖缶持ってキョロキョロしてたときと比べると:
That's not what I mean.
More dependable, I guess...
Way different from when you
were looking around holding
a can of mackerel...
translations.●のせいかよ。:
How am ● to blame for
that？
translations.もう、夜のコンビニとか一人で行かせられないね。:
I can't let you go to the
convenience store alone at
night anymore.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲からそれをいわれるとは……）:
(Never thought I'd hear
that from ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.この前、教室覗いてた？:
Were you peeking into my
classroom the other day？
translations.ちょっと▲小早川＊▲の様子を見にさ。:
I just came to check on
you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.やっぱり。声かければいいのに。:
I knew it. You should've
called out to me.
translations.友達と楽しそうに昼食べてたから。遠慮したんだよ。:
You were having fun eating
lunch with your friends, so
I held back.
translations.なんで？ リンコに遠慮なんてしないでよ。:
Why？ Don't hold back
around me.
translations.▲小早川＊▲にっていうか、周りの友だちにな。輪の中心は▲小早川＊▲っぽかったし、:
Not around you, ▲小早川＊▲,
around your friends. You
seemed like the center of
the group, ▲小早川＊▲, so it'd
be rude if ● pulled you
away.
translations.リンコが中心……？ そんなこと無いと思うけど。:
Me, the center of the
group...？ I don't think so.
translations.……確かに恋愛トークになると、リンコに質問が集中するときはある。:
...Though when the topic
turns to romance, everyone
does tend to bombard me
with questions.
translations.（それで●も、ジロジロ見られたのか……）:
(So that's why ● got
stared at so much...)
translations.あのさ……恋愛相談されたんだけど。:
Hey... someone asked me for
relationship advice.
translations.そうだけど、なんか不満？:
Yeah. Got a problem with
that？
translations.そうじゃなくて、変わったなってさ。:
No, I was just thinking,
what a change.
translations.で、どんな相談されたんだ？:
So, what kind of advice did
they ask for？
translations.年上カレシとうまく付き合うコツ。:
Tips on how to make things
work with an older boyfriend.
translations.えっ……、\nそれで、なんて？:
Whoa...
And what'd you tell them？
translations.そんなネタバレしないよ。:
I'm not spoiling that
for you.
translations.こないだ、\nアンタのクラスに行ったら、\n“おさなづま”とか\n言われた……。:
When I went by your class
the other day,
someone called me
your 'child bride'...
translations.……ごめん、\nいやな思いさせたな。:
...Sorry you had to
put up with that.
translations.別に平気。\nたかがいっこ上なだけなのに。\n男子はやっぱり子供だね。:
I don't really care.
You're only a year older.
Boys really are childish.
translations.そうだな。\nクラスのヤツら、いつの間にか\n▲小早川＊▲と●のこと\n全員知っ:
Yeah.
Before I knew it, everyone
in my class found out about
▲小早川＊▲ and ●.
translations.公認カップルってやつ？ \n……悪くないと思うけど。:
So we're an official couple？
...I don't mind that.
translations.でも、あんまり\nからかわれるようなら、\n●が……。:
Still, if they tease you
too much, ● will...
translations.いいよ。逆に\nアンタのカノジョってことで、\n気を遣ってもらってるみたい。\n:
It's fine. Actually, since
I'm your girlfriend, they
seem to look out for me.
They even go out of their
way to tell me stuff like,
'He just left with a girl.'
translations.悪いことできないね？:
Guess you can't do
anything bad now, huh？
translations.さっきのカップル見た？ \nほら、女の子がバッチリメイクだった。:
Did you see that couple
earlier？ The girl had
full makeup on.
translations.うん、リンコもついジロジロ見ちゃったけどさ。\nやっぱり、同じ年くらいのカップル:
Yeah, I couldn't help
staring a little too.
I guess couples around our
age always catch my eye.
translations.そうじゃない？ 自分たちと比べてとかさ。:
Isn't it？ Like comparing
them to ourselves.
translations.比べるまでもなく、▲小早川＊▲がいいよ、●は。:
No need to compare.
▲小早川＊▲ is the one for ●.
translations.おお、素直だな。どうした？:
Whoa, that's honest of you.
What's the occasion？
translations.やっぱ、今のウソ。ナシ。:
Actually, that was a lie.
Forget I said anything.
translations.さっきのおじいちゃんとおばあちゃん……仲良しだったね。:
That old couple earlier...
They seemed really close.
translations.……ああ、あの年で手をつないだりって、なんかいいよな？:
...Yeah, holding hands at
that age is pretty nice,
isn't it？
translations.うん。\n負けたって感じ。:
Yeah.
Feels like they've got
us beat.
translations.今はな、●たちも時間を重ねればさ。\nな、ばあさんや。:
For now, maybe. Just give
● and you some more time.
Right, Grandma？
translations.今、一瞬アンタがおじいちゃんに見えたよ。:
For a second there, I actually
pictured you as an old man.
translations.どうだった？ ●のじいちゃん姿は？:
How was it？ How did ●
look as an old man？
translations.けっこう素敵なロマンスグレーだった。ひいき目かもだけど。:
A pretty handsome silver fox.
Though maybe I'm biased.
translations.そっか。▲小早川＊▲のおばあちゃんも、かわいいだろうな。:
I see. I bet ▲小早川＊▲ will
make a cute grandma, too.
translations.ずっと一緒にいられるといいね。:
I hope we can stay
together forever.
translations.さっきのカップル……すごかったね。目のやり場に困っちゃった。:
That couple just now...
Whoa. I didn't know where
to look.
translations.……うん。\nあれに比べたら、リンコたちっておとなしいもんだね。:
...Yeah.
Compared to them, we're
pretty tame, huh.
translations.比較対象が悪いな、あれはバカップルっていうんだよ。:
That's a bad comparison.
They're what you call
idiots in love.
translations.ただ、▲小早川＊▲がいいなら、●は……。:
Still, if you're okay with it, ▲小早川＊▲,
●...
translations.イヤ……ってわけじゃないけどさ……。: Well, it's not like I'd hate it...
translations.なんとなく、知り合ったばかりの頃の▲小早川＊▲のメール思い出したんだけどさ――:
I was just thinking back to your texts
from when we first met, ▲小早川＊▲—
translations.なんで？\n●たちの大事な思い出だぞ。\n▲小早川＊▲はそういう覚えてないのか？:
Why？
● mean, they're precious memories for us.
Don't you remember them, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.だろ？\n結構長く付き合ったんだなって思うよ。:
See？
Makes me realize we've been
dating for quite a while now.
translations.最初の頃は、例えば……。:
Like back in the beginning,
for example...
translations.いいから。\nなんでそう子供っぽいことするかな……。\n長く付き合っても全然変わ:
That's enough.
Why do you have to be so childish...？
Even after all this time, you're still
an old man who acts like a kid.
translations.長くなればなるほど、近くなるものなーんだ？:
What gets closer
the longer it goes on？
translations.そう。友だちがね、カレシに出されたんだって。:
Yeah. A friend told me
her boyfriend asked her that.
translations.うーん……降参。答え何？: Hmm... I give up. What's the answer？
translations.答えは男女の仲だって。\nリンコたちはどう？\n付き合って長くなってきたけどさ。:
The bond between a guy and a girl.
What about us？
We've been dating a while now.
translations.そうだな、近いどころか、距離なくなっちゃってもいいぞ。:
Well, forget just being close—
I'm fine with zero distance between us.
translations.……ふーん。じゃあ、近づけば近づくほど、深く感じるのは？:
...I see. Then what feels deeper
the closer you get？
translations.男女の溝だって。\n最適な距離を保つことが必要ってこと。:
The rift between a guy and a girl.
Meaning you need to keep the right distance.
translations.●たちのメール、だいぶたまったよな。\nそれだけ長く付き合ってるってことか。:
● noticed our texts have really piled up.
Guess that shows how long we've been together.
translations.……そうだね。\n読み返すと、そのときのことが思い浮かばない？:
...Yeah.
When you read them back, doesn't it
bring back memories of those times？
translations.いつデートに行ったとか、何を食べたとか……。:
Like when we went on dates,
or what we ate...
translations.うん。それに……、行き違いがあったりも。:
Yeah. Plus... the times we had
misunderstandings, too.
translations.長く付き合ってるなんて、感じたことなかったけど……、今ちょっとそんな感じしたかも:
I'd never really felt like we've been
together a long time, but...
I think I kinda felt it just now.
translations.ああ、そうだな。\n▲小早川＊▲風に言えば……、悪くないって感じか。:
Yeah, same here.
To say it like you would, ▲小早川＊▲...
I guess it's "not bad."
translations.へへ、それって最高って意味だよ。\n知ってた？:
Hehe, that actually means "the best."
Did you know that？
translations.深刻な顔してるけど、なにかあった？: You look pretty serious. Did something happen？
translations.この前、ネコカフェに行ったんだけどさ。一匹だけ懐いてくれない女の子がいた。: I went to a cat cafe the other day. There was this one girl who just wouldn't warm up to me.
translations.ネコカフェ？ へえ。まあ、ネコは気まぐれだしな。: A cat cafe？ Huh. Well, cats can be pretty fickle.
translations.でもその子はさ、見た瞬間ビビっときたんだよ。この子とは仲良くなれる、って！: Yeah, but the second I saw her, something just clicked. I knew we could be friends!
translations.ふーん、じゃあエサで釣ってみたら？: Hmm. Why not try winning her over with food？
translations.そ。サバ缶とか。: Yeah. Like canned mackerel or something.
translations.はは、そうだよな。人間用のサバ缶なんてあげられないよな。: Haha, right. You can't feed a cat canned mackerel meant for people.
translations.ネコは！ エサで釣るとかそんな浅はかな考えじゃ仲良くなってくれないの。わかってな: You can't win a cat over with something as shallow as bribing it with food! You don't get it at all.
translations.あれ？ 手、ひっかき傷か？: Huh？ Is that a scratch on your hand？
translations.ああ、これね、ネコカフェでやられた。: Oh, this？ Got it at the cat cafe.
translations.あの子を振り向かせるまで通わないとね。: I have to keep going until I get her to notice me.
translations.それでその愛しのカノジョに引っかかれたってわけか。大変だな。: And your beloved lady friend ended up scratching you, huh？ Rough.
translations.軽くだから、たいしたことないよ。ちゃんと消毒もしたしね。: It's just a light scratch, no big deal. I made sure to disinfect it, too.
translations.引っかかれたわりには、なんかうれしそうだな。: You look awfully happy for someone who just got scratched.
translations.だって向こうから近づいてきてくれたんだもん。へへ、進展だね。: Because she actually came up to me on her own. Hehe, that's progress.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲をここまでメロメロにするとは……）: (To think she'd have ▲小早川＊▲ this smitten...)
translations.ね。聞いてよ。ついにあの子がリンコのすぐ横で眠ってくれたんだよ!!: Hey, listen. That girl finally fell asleep right next to me!!
translations.そう、リンコの横でお腹を見せてゴロゴロって……。: Yeah, right beside me, showing her belly and purring...
translations.ああ、ネコカフェか。じゃあそろそろ、触らせてくれるかもな？: Oh, the cat cafe. Guess she might let you pet her soon, huh？
translations.ダメ！ 女の子は繊細なんだから、いきなり触ったりしたら、嫌われちゃうじゃん。: No way! Girls are delicate. If you just start touching them out of nowhere, they'll hate you.
translations.そっか……。女の子は繊細だから、触ったりしたらだめ、か。: I see... Girls are delicate, so no touching them out of nowhere, huh.
translations.どうした、なんか寂しそうだけど？: What's wrong？ You look kind of lonely.
translations.ネコカフェに行ったらさ、あの子、もういなかった。: I went to the cat cafe, and she wasn't there anymore.
translations.なんで？ 病気とか？: Why？ Did she get sick or something？
translations.ううん。最近お見合いしたらしくてさ、赤ちゃんできたんだって。: No. Apparently they paired her up with a mate recently, and she's having kittens.
translations.なんだ、それならおめでたいことじゃないか。: Oh, well that's great news then, isn't it？
translations.まあね。でも、しばらくはお産で会えないんだよ。……寂しいじゃん。: I guess. But I won't be able to see her for a while until she gives birth. ...I'm gonna miss her.
translations.かわいい仔猫を連れて、帰ってくるって。: She'll be back before you know it, with cute little kittens in tow.
translations.……うん、そうだね。それにあの子も大切なパートナーを見つけたんだし、幸せだもんね: ...Yeah, you're right. Plus, she found someone special of her own, so she must be happy.
translations.ああ、▲小早川＊▲が●と出会えたみたいにな！: Yeah, just like when ▲小早川＊▲ met ●!
translations.一言多いっつーの。たしかに、今のリンコみたいに幸せなら、安心だけど。: You always say one thing too many. Still, if she's as happy as I am right now, I guess I can rest easy.
translations.ヴォルヴァヴィンの話、したじゃん。: Remember how I told you about Volvavin？
translations.弟がハマってるやつな。: The one your little brother's into, right.
translations.まだヴォルヴァヴィンごっこに付き合わされてるのか？: Wait, is he still making you play Volvavin with him？
translations.ちがう。弟がオモチャ屋さんでヴォルヴァヴィンのプラモデル見つけてさ。: No. He found a Volvavin model kit at the toy store.
translations.それで、一緒に作ることになった。: Yeah, and I ended up agreeing to build it with him.
translations.▲小早川＊▲ってプラモ作れるの？: Can you even build model kits, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.……お姉ちゃんだから、大切な弟のためにがんばるよ。: ...I'm his big sister. I'll do my best for my little brother.
translations.そっか。役に立つかわかんないけど、相談にはのるよ。: Gotcha. Not sure how much help I'll be, but you can always ask me for advice.
translations.プラモデルって意外と難しいね。: Model kits are harder than I thought.
translations.説明書のとおりに作れば、そんなに難しくないと思うけどな。: I don't think it's that hard if you just follow the instructions.
translations.それが難しいんだっつーの。パーツ多すぎだし。: That's the hard part, okay？ Plus there are way too many pieces.
translations.ああ……ヴォルヴァヴィンは変形合体完全再現！ とか宣伝してたような。: Right... Didn't the ads say Volvavin fully transforms and combines, or something？
translations.いきなり難しすぎたかな……。: Maybe I picked one that was too hard to start with...
translations.はぁ……誰か代わりに作ってくれないかな。: *Sigh*... Wish someone would build it for me.
translations.●でよければ手伝うけど。: ● can help out if you want.
translations.……うーん、ダメダメ。こういうときこそデキるお姉ちゃんの姿を見せないと。: ...Hmm, no way. This is when I have to show him what a capable big sister I am.
translations.（自分で作ってあげたいんだな……）: (Guess she really wants to build it for him herself...)
translations.ああ、やっぱり手伝ってほしいとか。: Oh, did you decide you want my help after all？
translations.誰もそんなこと言ってないじゃん。: I didn't say anything like that.
translations.この前、オモチャ屋さんで、ガストンＸのプラモを見つけたんだけど。: The other day, I saw a Gaston X model kit at the toy store.
translations.ガストン……？ ああ、ヴォルヴァヴィンのライバルロボだっけ。: Gaston...？ Oh, isn't that Volvavin's rival robot？
translations.やっぱ飾るときはさ、２体そろってた方が絵的にはかっこいいと思わない？: Don't you think it'd look way cooler having the two of them displayed together？
translations.……まずはヴォルヴァヴィンを完成させてから、考えた方がいいと思うぞ。: ...I think you should finish Volvavin first before worrying about that.
translations.うん……でも、もう買っちゃったんだよね。: Yeah... except I already bought it.
translations.そういえばヴォルヴァヴィンのプラモ、どうなった？: By the way, how did that Volvavin model turn out？
translations.上手くいかなかったとか……。: Don't tell me it didn't go well...
translations.あんまりリンコをなめない方がいいよ？: You really shouldn't underestimate me, you know？
translations.完成したに決まってるじゃん。へへ。: Of course I finished it. Hehe.
translations.よかったな、おめでとう。弟も喜んだろ。: Nice, congrats. Bet your brother was thrilled.
translations.まあね。アンタにもヴォルヴァヴィンの勇姿を見せてあげたいくらいだよ。: Yeah, pretty much. I almost wish I could show you Volvavin in all its glory.
translations.当然。今はうちの本棚の上で、２体が戦ってるよ。: Obviously. The two of them are battling it out on top of our bookshelf right now.
translations.へえ。▲小早川＊▲って、もっと不器用だと思ってた。: Huh. Honestly, ▲小早川＊▲, I thought you were way more clumsy.
translations.お見舞いの品って、なにがいいのかな。:
What's a good gift to get
for a hospital visit？
translations.お見舞い？ 誰か、病気とか？:
A hospital visit？ Is someone
sick or something？
translations.ううん。ほら、英語の花巻先生。産休とってたじゃん。:
No. Remember Ms. Hanamaki,
the English teacher？ She's
on maternity leave.
translations.それでさ、健康な赤ちゃんが産まれますようにって、クラスで何か送ろうって話になって:
So the class is talking
about sending her something
to wish for a healthy baby.
translations.出産のお祝いか。●、赤ちゃん産んだ経験はないしな……。:
A baby gift, huh. Though it's
not like you've ever had a
baby yourself, ●...
translations.……当たり前だっつーの。……相談して損した。:
...Obviously not.
...I shouldn't have bothered
asking you.
translations.それは冗談だけど。そういうのはさ、男に聞くよりクラスの女子で決めた方がいいんじゃ:
Just kidding. Still, wouldn't
the girls in your class know
better than a guy would？
translations.そうかもね、じゃあそうしよっかな。:
Maybe so. Guess I'll go
do that, then.
translations.花巻先生の話だけどさ。:
About that thing with
Ms. Hanamaki.
translations.クラスで花を贈ることに決めた。無難すぎるような気もするけどね。:
The class decided to send
her flowers. Feels a little
too safe, though.
translations.生徒が贈るんだから、きっとなんだって喜んでくれるよ:
It's coming from her
students, so I'm sure she'll
be happy with anything.
translations.▲小早川＊▲も一緒に話し合ったんだろ？ 昔のままだったら、めんどくさがったりした:
You joined in the talk too,
right, ▲小早川＊▲？
You used to hate that stuff.
translations.今でもそういうの、別に好きなわけじゃないけど。:
It's not like I enjoy that
kind of thing now, either.
translations.それでも成長だろ、いいことじゃん。:
Still, that's progress.
It's a good thing.
translations.花巻先生に花を贈る話、なかなか進まないんだよね。:
That plan to send flowers to
Ms. Hanamaki isn't really
going anywhere.
translations.そうなのか？ あとはどんな花を贈るか決めるぐらいじゃないの？:
Really？ All that's left is
picking what kind of flowers
to send, isn't it？
translations.そうだけどさ、それでモメてんの。:
Yeah, well, that's what
everyone's arguing over.
translations.▲小早川＊▲はどんな花がいいんだ？:
What kind of flowers do you
like for it, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.んー……この前、駅前の花屋さんでチューリップの鉢植え見かけて、気にいったんだけど:
Hmm... I liked the potted
tulips I saw at the florist
by the station recently.
translations.鉢植えってお見舞いにはよくないんじゃなかったっけ。:
Wait, aren't potted plants
bad luck for hospital visits？
translations.あ……“寝付く”ってやつか。めでたいことでもダメなのかな。:
Oh... Because they 'take
root' in bed, right？ Even
for a happy occasion？
translations.まあいいや、餅は餅屋。花屋さんに相談するよ。:
Oh well. Best to leave it to
the pros. I'll just ask the
florist.
translations.あのね。花巻先生のお見舞いにクラスの何人かで行ってきたんだけど。:
Hey. A few of us from class
went to visit Ms. Hanamaki
in the hospital.
translations.うん。産まれたばかりの赤ちゃんも見せてもらった。:
Yeah. She let us see the
newborn baby, too.
translations.すっごくちっちゃい手でリンコの指をぎゅ～って。ああ、もうっ、かわいすぎ！:
It squeezed my finger with
its tiny little hand. Ahh,
seriously, it was too cute!
translations.へえ、やっぱそういうの見ると赤ちゃんほしくなったりすんの？:
Huh. Does seeing that kind
of thing make you want a
baby of your own？
translations.▲小早川＊▲って、普段どんな雑誌読んでるんだ？: What kind of magazines do you usually read, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.いつも厚い本読んでるイメージが強いからさ。: I just always picture you reading thick books.
translations.雑誌だって読むって。でも最近の子の流行にはあんまり興味ないしな……。: I read magazines too, you know. I'm just not really into whatever's trendy with kids these days...
translations.最近の子って……▲小早川＊▲だって最近の子だろ。: "Kids these days"？ You're one of them, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.年齢のことじゃないっつーの、わかんないかな。: I'm not talking about age. Don't you get it？
translations.内面の話。だいたいさ、最近の子にアンタみたいなジジイが手に負えるわけないじゃん？: I mean on the inside. Besides, what girl these days could handle an old man like you？
translations.（●も、最近の子のはずなんだけどな……）: (Pretty sure ● still counts as a girl these days, though...)
translations.この前、雑誌の話したじゃん。アンタはどんな雑誌読むの？: Remember how we talked about magazines the other day？ What kind do you read？
translations.……コミック誌が一番多いかな。週刊ダッシュとかさ、そういうの。: ...Mostly manga magazines, I guess. Like Weekly Dash and stuff like that.
translations.ふーん……水着の女の子の雑誌ね……。: Hmm... So, magazines with girls in swimsuits...
translations.真の目的はどっちだか。: Who knows what you're really buying them for.
translations.だから、マンガだって。: I told you, for the manga.
translations.まあ、どっちでもいいけどさ。やれやれ。: Well, doesn't matter to me either way. Good grief.
translations.ん、なんか機嫌悪い？: Hm？ Are you in a bad mood or something？
translations.買おうと思ってたファッション誌が、売り切れてた。: The fashion magazine I was gonna buy was sold out.
translations.なんで驚くわけ。リンコがファッション誌読むのが意外ってこと？: Why are you so surprised？ Is it really that weird for me to read a fashion magazine？
translations.この間、読まないって言ってただろ。: Didn't you say the other day that you don't read them？
translations.読まないとは言ってないって。そこらへん、リンコは柔軟だからさ。: I never said I don't read them. I'm pretty flexible about that stuff.
translations.……そうか？ で、その雑誌のなにが目当てだったんだ？: ...Are you？ So, what were you after in that magazine？
translations.なんか妙にうれしそう。なにかあった？: You look weirdly happy. Did something happen？
translations.前、▲小早川＊▲が買おうとしたファッション誌の特集さ。: About that feature in the fashion magazine you tried to buy the other day, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.「カレのための愛されファッション」ってやつじゃない？: Wasn't it "Lovable Outfits Just for Your Boyfriend"？
translations.そうなのか？ クラスの女子が読んでたから、てっきりそれだと思ったのに。: Really？ A girl in my class was reading it, so I was sure that was the one.
translations.そんなわけないし。勝手に盛り上がるなっつーの。: As if. Don't get all excited over nothing.
translations.悪い。▲小早川＊▲がそんなこと考えてたら、うれしいなって思ったんだけど。: Sorry. I just thought it'd make me really happy if you were thinking about stuff like that, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.男子ってホント、幼稚すぎ。: Boys are seriously way too immature.
translations.「何があった？」ってきかないんだ。: So you're not gonna ask what happened？
translations.不機嫌そうだから、きかない方がいいのかなと思ってさ……。: You looked pretty grumpy, so I figured it was better not to ask...
translations.ここは聞くべきところなの。: This is where you're supposed to ask.
translations.まあいいや。クラスの男子がさ、図書室に幽霊が出るとか、盛り上がってんの。: Whatever. The boys in my class are getting all worked up over some rumor about a ghost in the library.
translations.リンコも知らないし、興味もなし。なのに、いちいち言いにくるんだよ。: I don't know anything about it either, and I couldn't care less. Yet they keep coming up to tell me about it.
translations.図書委員だから、だって。図書委員の仕事に、幽霊退治なんてないっつーの。: Because I'm on the library committee, apparently. Last I checked, ghost hunting wasn't part of the job.
translations.例の幽霊のこと、\n図書委員の先輩に\n話したんだけどさ。:
I told an upperclassman
on the library committee
about that ghost rumor.
translations.放っておけばいいのに。\nどうせつまらない噂だろ。:
You should just ignore it.
It's just a silly rumor.
translations.でもクラスでその話ばっかり\nされるからさ。:
Yeah, but it's all anyone
in my class talks about.
translations.続いてるどころか、広まってる。\nリンコは興味ないのに。:
It's only spreading more.
Not that I care about it.
translations.興味ないのか。\n苦手なわけじゃなくて？:
So you just don't care？
You're not scared of ghosts？
translations.は？ 誰もそんなこと\n言ってないじゃん。:
Huh？ Nobody said anything
about being scared.
translations.あれ……そこ。\n▲小早川＊▲の後ろ\n……なんかいる。:
Huh... Right there.
Behind you, ▲小早川＊▲...
There's something there.
translations.!? \nへ、変なこと\n言うなっつーの！:
!?
D-Don't say creepy stuff
like that, seriously!
translations.（そこまで驚かなくても……）: (She didn't have to jump like that...)
translations.はぁ……もういい加減にして欲しい。例の幽霊話。: Sigh... I wish people would give that ghost story a rest already.
translations.まだ消えてないんだ。そろそろ収まってもよさそうなもんだけど。: It still hasn't died down？ You'd think people would've moved on by now.
translations.表向きはね。でも男子は肝試しを計画してるみたい。: On the surface, sure. But it sounds like the boys are planning a test of courage.
translations.肝試しってことは夜に、だよな。: A test of courage... So they're going in at night, huh.
translations.ホント、男子は子供っぽいんだからさ。幽霊なんているわけないじゃん。: Boys are seriously so childish. As if ghosts are even real.
translations.いなくてもいいんだろ。こういうのは計画するのが、楽しいんだって。: It doesn't matter if it's real or not. Half the fun with stuff like this is planning it.
translations.アンタまでそんなこと言うんだ。: Now you're talking like them, too.
translations.だって、夜の学校ってワクワクしないか？: Come on, isn't being at school at night kind of exciting？
translations.リンコには理解不能だね。: I don't get the appeal at all.
translations.だいたい、もし本当に出たらどうするんだっつーの。: Besides, what would they even do if a ghost actually showed up？
translations.なんか校内が騒ぎになってたよな？: There was a big commotion around school earlier, wasn't there？
translations.ほら、男子が肝試しするって言ってたじゃん。夜中に学校に忍び込んで、警報機鳴らしち: Remember how the boys were talking about doing a test of courage？ Apparently they snuck into school in the middle of the night and set off the alarm.
translations.親も呼び出されて、相当怒られたってさ。自業自得。: Their parents got called in too, and they got chewed out big time. Serves them right.
translations.それで結局、幽霊はいたのか？: So, was there actually a ghost？
translations.正体は、書庫の立て付けの悪いドアだってさ。リンコの言ったとおり、幽霊なんているわ: Turned out it was just a loose door in the archive room. Like I said, there's no way ghosts are—
translations.……やっぱり恐がりなんじゃないか？: ...Are you sure you're not just easily scared？
translations.怖いんじゃなくて、驚いただけだっつーの。バカじゃん。: I wasn't scared, you just startled me! Idiot.
translations.（そんなムキにならなくても……）: (She doesn't have to get so defensive...)
translations.ねえ、インテリアとかって好き？: Hey, are you into room decor and stuff like that？
translations.好きかって言われるとなあ。でも凝る人はかなり凝るよな。: I don't know if I'd say I'm into it, personally. Though people who care about that stuff really go all out.
translations.ウチはお母さんが結構好き。でさ、ちょっと遠いけど新しいインテリアショップができた:
My mom's pretty into it.
And apparently a new home
decor shop opened a bit
far from here.
translations.ああ、この前テレビでも特集してたっけ。:
Oh yeah, I think they did
a feature on it on TV the
other day.
translations.そこを一度見に行きたいんだって。:
She says she wants to go
check it out sometime.
translations.その顔だと、行きたくないのか？:
Going by that look on your
face, you don't wanna go？
translations.そういうわけじゃないけど。リンコは部屋のインテリア変えるつもりないから、退屈かな:
It's not that. I just don't
plan on changing my room,
so I figure I'll be bored.
translations.行ってみると、意外と楽しいかもしれないぞ。:
You never know, it might
be more fun than you think
once you get there.
translations.話してたインテリアショップ、結局行くことになりそう。:
Looks like I'm going to
that home decor shop I
told you about after all.
translations.そっか、せっかくなら楽しんで来なよ。:
I see. Well, since you're
going, try to have fun.
translations.うん、でもお母さんがさ、ついでにリンコの部屋も模様替えすれば、だって。:
Yeah, except my mom said I
might as well redecorate
my room while we're at it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲はしたくないんだよな。:
And you don't really want
to, right, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.今のでリンコは気に入ってるんだけど、もっとカワイイ系にした方がいいって……。:
I like how it is now, but
she says I should go for
a cuter style...
translations.んなことないって。いいんじゃないか、カワイイ系。:
Not at all. I think a cute
style could be nice.
translations.……他人事だと思って。でも楽しそうなお母さん見てると、嫌だって言いにくいしなあ。:
...Easy for you to say.
Still, seeing how excited
my mom is makes it hard
to say no.
translations.この前話してたインテリアショップ、行ったのか？:
Did you go to that home
decor shop you mentioned
the other day？
translations.まだ。お父さんの休みにあわせて、家族で行くことになった。:
Not yet. We decided to go
as a family on my dad's
day off.
translations.帰ってきたら、▲小早川＊▲の部屋はカワイイ系になるのかあ。:
So when you get back, your
room's gonna get a cute
makeover, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……なに？ 楽しみなワケ？:
...What？ Are you looking
forward to it or something？
translations.ニヤニヤしない。アンタが期待するほど、カワイくはならないと思うよ。:
Quit grinning. I doubt it's
gonna get as cute as you're
hoping for.
translations.そうなのか？ せっかくだから、徹底的にやればいいのに。:
Really？ If you're gonna do
it, you might as well go
all the way.
translations.リンコにも譲れない線があるから。そこはちゃんと主張するんだってば。:
I have lines I won't cross,
too. I'm definitely putting
my foot down on that.
translations.（どんな部屋になるのか、楽しみだな）:
(I can't wait to see how
her room turns out.)
translations.インテリアショップ、行ってきた。:
I went to that home decor
shop.
translations.ああ、例の。どうだった？:
Oh, the one you mentioned.
How was it？
translations.想像してたより楽しかった。パソコンでいろんな組み合わせをシミュレーションできて。:
More fun than I expected.
You could simulate all kinds
of layouts on a computer.
translations.パズルみたいでさ、いろんな組み合わせが楽しめるんだよ。:
It's like a puzzle. It's fun
trying out all sorts of
different combinations.
translations.面白そうだな。……それで、模様替えは？:
Sounds neat. ...So how are
things with redecorating？
translations.お、カワイイ系か！:
Oh, going with the cute
style then!
translations.そっちじゃないっつーの。バッチリ阻止したよ。お母さんもちゃんと納得させたしね。:
Not like that. I shut that
plan right down. Even got
my mom to agree to it.
translations.そんなにガッカリしなくてもいいじゃん。アンタがどーしてもっていうなら考えるよ、将:
You don't have to look so
disappointed. If you insist,
I'll think about it... in
the future.
translations.（将来ね……将来？）:
(In the future, huh...
Wait, the future？)
translations.趣味人が家にいると、ちょっと困るね。ほどほどにしてほしいよ。:
Having a hardcore hobbyist
in the house is a bit of a
pain. I wish he'd tone it
down.
translations.お父さん。もともと多趣味なんだけど、今はカメラだってさ。:
My dad. He's always had a
lot of hobbies, and now
apparently it's cameras.
translations.本格的にやると大変そうだよな……。:
Getting serious about that
sounds like a lot of work...
translations.お小遣いの範囲でやってるみたいだけど。たださ……。:
He seems to be keeping it
within his allowance, at
least. It's just...
translations.娘としては、モデルをさせられるのが大変。: As his daughter, getting roped into modeling for him is rough.
translations.モデルくらい、やってあげればいいのに。: Come on, it wouldn't hurt to model for him a little.
translations.でもさ「そのポーズいいよ！」とか「今の表情カワイイね！」とか、いちいち言うんだよ: Yeah, except he's always saying stuff like, "Great pose!" or "That look is so cute!" Even in public.
translations.（それはたしかに恥ずかしいかもな……）: (Okay, yeah, that would be pretty embarrassing...)
translations.お父さんのカメラ、まだ続いてんの？: Is your dad still keeping up with the photography thing？
translations.モデルは、まだ▲小早川＊▲か。: And you're still his model, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.一応家族全員だけどさ。なんかリンコが一番被害にあってる気がする。: Technically it's the whole family, but I feel like I'm getting the worst of it.
translations.被害なんて言うなよ。娘の成長の記録を残したいんだろ。: Don't put it like that. He probably just wants a record of his daughter growing up.
translations.人間は１０分で成長したりしないから。: People don't grow in ten-minute intervals, you know.
translations.ははっ、そりゃそうだ。まあ▲小早川＊▲ならモデルとして不足なしだしな。: Haha, fair point. Well, he couldn't ask for a better model than you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……どさくさに紛れて恥ずかしい事言うなっつーの。: ...Hey, don't just casually slip embarrassing lines like that into the conversation.
translations.（ダメか……自然に言えたと思ったんだけどな）: (No good, huh... And here I thought I slipped that in pretty smoothly.)
translations.家族の集合写真なんて、いまさら恥ずかしいと思わない？: Don't you think taking a family portrait at this point is kind of embarrassing？
translations.ん？ ああ、お父さんのカメラの話か。: Hm？ Oh, is this about your dad's camera again？
translations.リンコへの集中攻撃がおさまったら、今度は家族の集合写真だって。: Now that he's finally eased up on me, he says he wants a group family photo next.
translations.いいと思うけどな。嫌なのか？: Sounds nice to me. You don't want to？
translations.気軽に言ってくれるね。ただ撮るだけならいいんだけど……。: Easy for you to say. I wouldn't mind if we were just taking a normal picture, but...
translations.なんかたくらんでそうで。普通の家族写真じゃ面白くないとか言ってるし。: I can tell he's up to something. He keeps saying a normal family photo would be boring.
translations.よくわかんないけど、お父さんだけがノリノリでさ……。: Who knows, but Dad's the only one super excited about it...
translations.家族写真はどうなった？ ほら、お父さんが撮るって言ってた。: Whatever happened with that family photo？ You know, the one your dad wanted to take.
translations.なんだっけ、面白い写真だっけ。: What was it again, an "interesting" photo？
translations.……うん。スタジオまで借りてやろうなんて、言い出した。: ...Yeah. He even started talking about renting out a studio for it.
translations.スタジオか、本格的だな。▲小早川＊▲も楽しめばいいのに。: A studio, huh？ That's serious business. Why not just have fun with it, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.家族写真くらい普通に撮りたいじゃん。後に残るものだしさ。: Come on, I just want a normal family photo. Those things stick around forever.
translations.……そっか。変な写真だと、何年も経ってから見るとキツイかもな。: ...Good point. If it's a weird photo, it might be rough looking back on it years from now.
translations.でしょ？ だからお母さんと２人で必死に止めたよ。着ぐるみ家族写真とか、あり得ない: Right？ So Mom and I had to team up to stop him. A family photo in mascot costumes？ No way.
translations.（着ぐるみ……見てみたかったな、ちょっと残念）: (Mascot costumes... I kinda wanted to see that. Too bad.)
translations.弟がよくウチに友達を連れてくるんだけどさ、子供ってかわいいよね。: My little brother brings his friends over a lot, and honestly, kids are pretty cute.
translations.まあな、無邪気で元気で。: Yeah, they're so innocent and full of energy.
translations.もちろんその中でも弟が一番かわいいんだけど。: Though obviously, my brother is the cutest one of all.
translations.はは、姉バカだな。: Haha, someone's a doting big sister.
translations.なんて言われてもいいの。かわいいものは、かわいいんだから。: Call me whatever you want. Cute is cute.
translations.そういえば、姉弟ケンカってするのか？: Come to think of it, do the two of you ever fight？
translations.するわけないじゃん。まだまだ、子供だよ、相手はさ。: Of course not. Come on, he's still just a little kid.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲も子供っぽいところ、あると思うけどな……）: (I think ▲小早川＊▲ has her own childish side too, though...)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。手のとこ、アザになってないか？: ▲小早川＊▲, is that a bruise on your hand？
translations.ああ……弟たちと戦隊物ごっこして、ちょっと打ったかも。: Oh... I was playing superheroes with my brother and his friends. I must've bumped it.
translations.そんなのにまで付き合ってるんだ。:
You even play along
with stuff like that, huh.
translations.うん。男の子って、パワーが有り余ってるって感じだね。:
Yeah. It's like boys have
way too much energy.
translations.……それって、相手するのも大変そうだな。:
...Sounds like it's tough
just keeping up with them.
translations.“ごっこ”って言っても、本気で相手をしないとね。じゃないと無理。:
Even if it's just pretend,
you have to play for real.
Otherwise it's impossible.
translations.子供を育ててるお母さんたちって、大変だよね。毎日ヘトヘトになりそう。:
Moms raising kids really
have it rough. They must be
exhausted every day.
translations.アンタも相手してみる……？:
Wanna try playing with
them sometime...？
translations.最近さ、子育てに悩み中。:
Lately, I've been having
trouble raising a kid.
translations.なんだ……変な言い方するなって。:
Oh, man... Don't put it
in such a weird way.
translations.でさ。反抗期なのかな？ リンコの言うことを聞かないことがたまにあって、大変。:
Anyway, is it a rebellious
phase？ Sometimes he won't
listen to me. It's rough.
translations.将来▲小早川＊▲の子供ができたら、もっと大変だと思うぞ。:
It'll probably be even
tougher when you have your
own kids someday, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.やっぱり？ そうだよね、弟でこんなに大変なのに、自分の子供か……想像もできないね:
You think so？ Right, if my
brother's this hard, my own
kid... I can't even imagine.
translations.勝手に想像するなっつーの。:
Hey, don't go imagining it
on your own.
translations.いいじゃん、気になるだろ。:
Come on, why not？
Of course I'm curious.
translations.子供って気分屋だね。反抗期だと思ったら、甘えてきたりしてさ。:
Kids are so moody. Just when
I think they're rebelling,
they get all clingy.
translations.ああ、弟たちか？ でもそれ、▲小早川＊▲みたいだな。:
Oh, your brothers？
That sounds a lot like you
though, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.それはリンコが、子供っぽいって言いたいワケ？:
Are you trying to say
I'm childish？
translations.そこまでは言わないけど……急に怒ったり甘えたりするだろ。:
I wouldn't go that far...
but you get mad or clingy
out of nowhere, don't you？
translations.甘えてはいない。:
I don't get clingy.
I keep my cool.
translations.そうなの。アンタの感じ方の問題じゃない？:
I do. Isn't it just
how you're taking it？
translations.しつこいなあ……あ、何。もしかして甘えて欲しいとか？:
You really don't let up...
Oh, wait. Do you want me
to get clingy with you？
translations.そういうつもりで言ったわけじゃないけど……甘えられるのもいいもんだよな。:
That's not what I meant...
but I do like it when you
get clingy with me.
translations.ふーん、やっぱそうなんだ。じゃあ適度に、節度をもって、ＴＰＯをわきまえて甘えてあ:
Hmm, I knew it. Fine, I'll
be clingy—in moderation, and
at the right time and place.
translations.欲しい本があるんだけど、なかなか見つからないんだよね。:
There's a book I want, but
I'm having a hard time
finding it.
translations.本屋に問い合わせてみた？:
Did you try asking at
a bookstore？
translations.もう絶版だって。: They said it's out of print.
translations.そうなると入手困難だな。がんばって古本探すか……あとはオークションか。:
That makes it tough to get.
You could hunt for a used
copy... or try an auction.
translations.うーん、リンコのお小遣いでなんとかなるかな。:
Hmm, I wonder if I can
afford it on my allowance.
translations.ちなみになんの本？: By the way, what book is it？
translations.……それはいい。笑われるから。:
...Never mind that.
You'll laugh at me.
translations.やっぱり古い本って、出版社にも在庫はないみたいだね。:
Looks like the publisher
doesn't keep old books
in stock after all.
translations.ああ、探してる本？ なら、古書店街を探してみたら？:
Oh, the book you're after？
Why not try the used
bookstore district？
translations.たまにとんでもない掘り出し物が見つかるらしいぞ。:
I hear you can find some
amazing hidden gems there
sometimes.
translations.……そっか。ちょっと調べてみる。ありがと。: ...I see. I'll look into it. Thanks.
translations.カノジョが困ってたら、助けるのが男の役目！ なんてな？: When his girlfriend's in trouble, it's a guy's job to help out! ...Right？
translations.頼りになるカレシで良かったよ、ホント。: I'm really glad I have such a reliable boyfriend.
translations.このあいだ、古書店街に行ってきたよ。: I went to the used bookstore district the other day.
translations.探してた本、見つかった？: Did you find the book you were looking for？
translations.ううん……ただ、すっごく熱心に探してくれたおじいちゃんのお店があって、感動したよ: No... But there was an old man at one shop who looked so hard for it. I was really touched.
translations.うん。知り合いのお店にまできいてくれて、本当に親切だった。: Yeah. He even asked around at other shops he knew. He was really kind.
translations.でも、そこまでしてもらって見つからないとなると、難しいかもな。: Still, if he went that far and couldn't find it, it might be tough to track down.
translations.もし見つかったら、電話くれるって言ってくれたけど……。なんかちょっと気がすんじゃ: He said he'd call me if it turns up, though... Honestly, I think I feel satisfied already.
translations.なんで？ 欲しいんだろ？: Why？ You still want it, right？
translations.みんなに、ここまでしてもらったからさ。もちろん、頼りになるカレシにも感謝してるよ: Just having everyone go that far for me was enough. And of course, I'm grateful to my reliable boyfriend, too.
translations.（結局なんの本だったんだろ……）: (I wonder what book it actually was...)
translations.探してた本。お店から電話かかってきてさ、あのおじいちゃんが見つけてくれたんだよ！: The one I was looking for. The shop called me—that old man actually found it for me!
translations.うん。リンコのおこづかいで買えそうだし、ほんとよかった。: Yeah. Looks like I can afford it with my allowance, too, so that's a relief.
translations.そっか、高価な物じゃなくてよかったな。で、結局なんの本なんだ？: Good thing it wasn't super expensive. So, what book is it anyway？
translations.まあ無理にはきかないけど。: Well, you don't have to tell me if you don't want to.
translations.ううん、いい。……えっとね、リンコが初めて買ってもらった本。: No, it's fine. ...Um, it's the very first book that was ever bought for me.
translations.……ふと思い出して、読み直したくなって。家中探したんだけど、なくってさ。: ...I remembered it out of the blue and wanted to read it again. I searched all over the house, but it wasn't there.
translations.思い出の本か。\nいい本って、大人になってからも、違った面白さがあるんだよな。:
A childhood favorite, huh.
Good books are fun in a whole different way when you're older.
translations.そっか……じゃあいつかアンタにも読ませてあげるよ。……なんか恥ずかしいから、その: I see... Well, I'll let you read it sometime, then. ...It's kind of embarrassing, so maybe later.
translations.最近、駅前でナンパされる子が多いみたい。それが結構しつこいみたいでさ。: Lately, it seems a lot of girls are getting hit on in front of the station. And the guy's pretty persistent, apparently.
translations.うん、リンコは大丈夫。心配してくれるんだ。: Yeah, I'm fine. Sweet of you to worry about me.
translations.そりゃ。ナンパ男を蹴ったりしないかって……。: Of course. I'm worried you might kick the guy...
translations.……ちょっと、どっちの心配してんの。: ...Hey, who are you worried about here？
translations.両方だって、両方！: Both of you! Both of you!
translations.……まあ、いいけど。ところでさ、アンタはナンパしたことあんの？: ...Well, whatever. Anyway, have you ever tried picking up girls？
translations.え？ ●は……したことないぞ。: Huh？ Well, ●... has never done that.
translations.（やましいことはない……はず）: (I have nothing to feel guilty about... I think.)
translations.駅前を通ったらさ、ほんとにナンパしてる男がいたよ。: When I walked past the station earlier, there really was a guy hitting on girls.
translations.ああ、噂の。: Oh, the one everyone's talking about.
translations.うん、どうも一人らしいよ。いつもそいつがナンパしてるんだって。: Yeah, apparently it's just the one guy. People say it's always him hitting on girls.
translations.絡まれたりしなかったか？: He didn't bother you, did he？
translations.まあ、遠くから見てただけだし。それにもし絡まれても、アンタが助けに来てくれるでし: Well, I was just watching from a distance. Besides, even if he did, you'd come rescue me, right？
translations.助けに行くのが遅れることもあるかもしれないだろ。: I might not always make it there in time, you know.
translations.（無責任に言い切ってしまった……）: (I just made a pretty reckless promise...)
translations.駅前のナンパ男、騒ぎになってるね。: That guy hitting on girls in front of the station is turning into a big deal.
translations.先生も、女子に注意しろって言ってたな。▲小早川＊▲も気をつけろよ？: Even the teachers were telling the girls to watch out. You be careful too, okay, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.もしリンコに声かけたりしたら……。: If he tries talking to me...
translations.うわっ！ だから、そういうことすんなって。危ないだろ？: Whoa! Come on, I told you not to do that. It's dangerous, okay？
translations.わかってるよ。ホント、心配性だね。: I know, I know. You really worry too much.
translations.でもさ、そんなにしつこくして、女に好かれると思ってるのかな。: Still, does he really think girls are gonna like him if he's that pushy？
translations.押してダメなら引いてみろって言葉、知らないんじゃないか？: Guess he's never heard the saying, "If pushing doesn't work, try backing off."
translations.ふーん、ずいぶん、慣れた感じの意見だけど？: Hmm, you sound awfully experienced with that stuff, don't you？
translations.（なんか、いやな汗かいたな……）: (Man, that made me break into a cold sweat...)
translations.この前……駅前でナンパされた。: The other day... somebody tried to pick me up in front of the station.
translations.え、例のナンパ男か。大丈夫だったか？: Wait, was it that guy everyone's talking about？ Are you okay？
translations.うん。“このハンケチ、落としましたか？”だって。: Yeah. He said, "Pardon me, did you drop this kerchief？"
translations.それは例のナンパ男じゃないよな……。: Then that wasn't the pickup artist, was it...
translations.うん、でも話してみたら……孫が風邪で倒れたから、代わりに落とし主を探してるって言: Yeah, but when I talked to him... he said his grandson was in bed with a cold, so he was looking for the owner in his place.
translations.おじいちゃんの孫が例のナンパ男。: The old man's grandson is that guy who's been hitting on girls.
translations.ああ！ 落とし主探してたのか、なんで交番に届けないんだろ。: Oh! So he was just looking for the owner. Why didn't he just turn it in to the police box？
translations.ハンカチ落とした後姿に一目ぼれしたんだって。うちの高校の生徒だってことしかわから: Apparently he fell in love at first sight seeing her from behind when she dropped her handkerchief. All he knows is that she goes to our high school.
translations.（それでお祖父さんが……いい話……なのか？）: (So his grandpa took over for him... Wait, is that actually a sweet story...？)
translations.アンタの図書貸し出しリスト見たんだけどさ、もうちょっと本読んだほうがいいんじゃな: I saw your library checkout history. Don't you think you should read a little more？
translations.リンコの足下にもおよばないよ。: You don't even come close to how much I read.
translations.そりゃ▲小早川＊▲と比べたらな。: Well, yeah, if you compare me to you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.一生のうちに読める本なんて、たかが知れてるんだからさ。時間は有意義に使わないと。: There are only so many books you can read in a lifetime, you know. You have to use your time meaningfully.
translations.とりあえずリンコが本選んであげよっか？: Want me to pick out some books for you for starters？
translations.▲小早川＊▲推薦か。何々？: Recommendations from ▲小早川＊▲, huh？ Let's see, what do we have here？
translations.……お、昔から少し成長してる！:
...Oh, I've moved up a little
since last time!
translations.▲小早川＊▲が、推薦してくれた本さ……。:
So, about the books you
recommended, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.まだ読んでない……どれもこれもブ厚い本ばかりだったぞ、辞書かと思っただろ。:
I haven't read them yet...
Every last one of them is huge.
I thought they were dictionaries.
translations.有意義に時間を使える本を選んだんだけど。:
I just picked books that'd
be a good use of your time.
translations.もっと手軽に読めるのがいいんだけどな。あれじゃ持ち運べないって。:
I'd prefer something easier to
pick up and read. I can't even
carry those around.
translations.ワガママだなあ、じゃあもうちょっとライトでカジュアルで初心者向けのにしてあげるよ:
So picky. Fine, I'll give you
something a bit lighter and more
casual, for beginners.
translations.まあ徐々にならしていけばいいか。:
Well, I guess I can ease you
into it bit by bit.
translations.なんにも。期待しててってこと。:
Nothing. Just saying you can
look forward to it.
translations.リンコの課題図書ライトバージョンはどう？:
How's the light version of
my required reading？
translations.一応読んでみたけど……。: Well, I did read it, but...
translations.悪くないでしょ、アメリカ文学も。:
American literature isn't bad
either, right？
translations.かも、ってのが気になるけど……ほんとにわかってんのかな。:
That "maybe" bothers me,
though... Do you actually get it？
translations.詳しくどうとは言えないけどさ、ただ「いいな」って。:
I can't really put my finger on
why, I just thought it was good.
translations.まあ、それでもいっか。:
Well, I guess that's good
enough.
translations.あとはやっぱり▲小早川＊▲のこと考えながら読むと面白いんだよな。:
Plus, it's really interesting to
read while thinking about you,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.はあ？ なにそれ。:
Huh？ What's that supposed to
mean？
translations.▲小早川＊▲はこの本のどこが好きなんだろうとか、ここ読んで笑ったのかなとか、悲し:
Like wondering what part of the
book you liked, ▲小早川＊▲, or
if this part made you laugh, or
if it made you sad...
translations.なにそれっ……そんなの……あーもう、教えるんじゃなかった。:
What is that...？ Come on...
Ugh, I never should've recommended
it to you.
translations.（自分の頭の中見られてるような気になったりするのかな……）:
(Maybe it makes her feel like
I'm peeking inside her head...)
translations.▲小早川＊▲の課題図書だけどさ。:
About that required reading
of yours, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……そんな顔するなっつーの。なに？:
...Quit making that face.
What is it？
translations.あれからちゃんと理解しようと思ったんだけど、やっぱ難しくてわからなかったよ。:
I tried to really understand it
after that, but it was still too
hard for me to get.
translations.謝らなくてもいいって。強制したかったわけじゃないし。:
You don't have to apologize.
It's not like I wanted to force
it on you.
translations.前にも言ったかもしれないけどさ。お互いの趣味が合う必要なんてないんだって。:
I might've said this before,
but we don't have to share all
the same hobbies.
translations.アンタがリンコのこと理解してくれようとしただけで、リンコはうれしいよ。:
Just knowing you tried to
understand me makes me happy.
translations.駅前のゲーセンでファイト・ウィズ・フィアーの新作のロケテやるんだってさ。:
They're doing a location test
for the new Fight with Fear at
the arcade by the station.
translations.ファイト・ウィズ・フィアー、格ゲー。久々の新作だよ？:
Fight with Fear. It's a fighting
game. The first new one in ages,
you know？
translations.正式なリリース前に一部店舗にだけ、試験的に置かれること。素人じゃあるまいし！:
It's when select arcades get a
trial version before the official
release. What are you, an amateur？
translations.あ～っ、早くプレイしたいっ！ ここまで格ゲー熱があがるのは久しぶりだよ。:
Ugh, I can't wait to play it!
It's been ages since I got this
hyped for a fighting game.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲がここまで興奮するなんて、たしかに滅多にないかも……）:
(It really is rare to see
▲小早川＊▲ get this excited...)
translations.ＦＷＦのロケテ、行ってきたよ。結構並んだけど。:
I went to the FWF location
test. Had to wait in a pretty
long line, though.
translations.ほら、新作の格ゲー。: You know, the new fighting game.
translations.それそれ。で、どうだった？: Right, that one. So, how was it？
translations.対戦台では全敗……。: I lost every single versus match...
translations.初めてのゲームなんだろ。そう簡単に勝てないんじゃないか？: It's a brand-new game, right？ You can't expect to win that easily.
translations.相手も条件はいっしょじゃん。: The other players were in the same boat, though.
translations.そっか……。対戦相手がお忍びでやってきた開発者だったとか。: True... Maybe you were up against one of the devs playing incognito.
translations.あ、それはあるかも。 ちょっとこなれた感じだったし……今度は絶対負けないから！: Oh, that could be it. They did seem a little too used to it... Well, next time I'm definitely not losing!
translations.（▲小早川＊▲に目をつけられたら、その人も逃げられないな……）: (Now that ▲小早川＊▲ has her sights set on them, there's no escaping her...)
translations.……ぜんぜん勘が取り戻せない。: ...I can't get my feel for it back at all.
translations.ＦＷＦシリーズは得意なはずだったのに……。: The FWF series is supposed to be my specialty...
translations.ああ。なんだ格ゲーの話か。: Oh. You're just talking about that fighting game.
translations.なんだじゃないっつーの。対人戦で負けるって、自分を否定された気分になるんだよね。: It's not 'just' a game. Losing against another player makes me feel like I'm being rejected as a person.
translations.Ｋ．Ｏ．されたキャラと自分が重なるんだよ……もう一度自分を見つめ直さないと。: I see myself in my K.O.'d character... I need to take a long, hard look at myself.
translations.気楽に楽しめばいいよ、ゲームなんだからさ。: Just relax and have fun with it. It's only a game.
translations.無敵のフレームが……調整中なのかなあ、もう……。: The invincibility frames... Are they still tweaking them or what...？
translations.新作の格ゲー、その後どうなんだ？: How's that new fighting game going since then？
translations.それにもう限界だったし。: Besides, I was already at my limit.
translations.なるほどね。でも正式に稼働したら、やるんだろ？: Gotcha. You're gonna play it once it's officially out, though, right？
translations.そりゃあね。ある程度の勘はつかんだから、それまでは家庭用の前作をやりこんでおくよ: Well, yeah. I got a decent feel for it, so until then I'll just practice on the last one at home.
translations.しょうがないな、ちょっとレクチャーしてあげるよ。どこから話そうかな……。: Guess I don't have a choice. I'll give you a little lecture on it. Now, where to start...
translations.あのさ、アンタはメールと電話と直接会って話すのと、どれがいい？: Hey, which do you prefer—texting, calling, or talking in person？
translations.……会って話すのが一番だとは思うけどな。: ...I think talking in person is best.
translations.そうだよね。でも、直接会って言いにくいこととかもあるじゃん。: Yeah, true. Still, some things are hard to say face-to-face.
translations.そうだな、上手く使い分けってのが正解かな。: Yeah. I guess using each for the right situation is the way to go.
translations.急ぎの時は電話、急いでないときはメール、とか。: Calling when it's urgent, texting when it's not. Stuff like that.
translations.なんか……ビジネスマンみたいな理由。: That sounds... like a businessman's answer.
translations.手紙？ それはやっぱり儀礼的な……。: Letters？ I guess those are more for formal occasions...
translations.やっぱりビジネスマンみたい……ほんとに高校生？: You really do sound like a businessman... Are you sure you're in high school？
translations.こないだ話した電話、メール、手紙の使いわけだけどさ。深刻度ってのはどう？: About what we talked about the other day—when to call, text, or write a letter. What about going by how serious it is？
translations.深刻度……どういうこと？: How serious it is... What do you mean？
translations.面と向かって言えない順、かな。電話では言わないけど、メールとか手紙ならってことあ: Like, ordered by how hard it is to say to someone's face. There are things you wouldn't say on the phone, but could in a text or letter, right？
translations.ボケなくていいっつーの。付き合ってる２人の話。: Quit playing dumb. I'm talking about a couple.
translations.じゃあやっぱり……「好き」とか「愛してる」とか、そういうの？: Then I guess... stuff like "I like you" or "I love you"？
translations.結構言ってる気がする……かも。: I feel like we say that pretty often already... maybe.
translations.アンタには当てはまらないってことがよく分かったよ。そういうとこ、悪くないけどさ。: Well, now I know that rule doesn't apply to you at all. Not that I mind that about you.
translations.友達にきいてみた。電話とメールと手紙について。: I asked a friend of mine about the whole phone, text, and letter thing.
translations.基本はメールで電話はあんまりしないって。: She said she mostly texts and doesn't really call much.
translations.いきなりアンタから手紙が届いたら、何事かって身構えちゃうかも。: If I got a letter from you out of the blue, I'd probably brace myself and wonder what happened.
translations.深刻な内容を想像するよな。: You'd assume it's something really serious.
translations.想像しただけで、ちょっとドキドキする。あんまりよくない意味で。: Just imagining it makes my heart race a little. And not in a good way.
translations.そうだ、いい手紙の使い方あったよ。: Oh, right. I thought of a good way to use letters.
translations.深刻なことを伝える以外の？: Something other than delivering serious news？
translations.うん。未来のアンタへ今のリンコからメッセージ。: Yeah. A message from the me of today to the you of the future.
translations.手紙だったら、読まずにいつまででも置いておけるじゃん。: With a letter, you can hold onto it as long as you want without reading it, right？
translations.ちゃんと我慢して開封しなければ、だけどさ。: Provided you actually have the self-control not to open it, anyway.
translations.それ、結構難しそうだな。: That sounds pretty tough to do.
translations.うん……リンコ、守れる気がしないかも。: Yeah... I don't think I could hold back, honestly.
translations.はは、●たちには難しいかもな。: Haha, that might be a little too hard for you and ●.
translations.いいアイディアだと思ったんだけどな……。: And here I thought it was a good idea...
translations.はぁ……親って、どうしてあんなにうるさいんだろ。: Sigh... Why do parents have to nag so much？
translations.部屋をちゃんと片付けろって、出がけに言われた。: They told me to clean up my room right as I was heading out.
translations.それは……しょうがないんじゃ。: Well... can you really blame them for that？
translations.でも、あとで片付けようと思ってたんだよ。なのに……。: Yeah, but I was already planning to clean it later. And then they had to go and say it...
translations.……●も、おんなじ言い訳をしたことあるなあ。: ...● used to make that exact same excuse.
translations.リンコのは言い訳じゃないから。本当にやろうとしてたんだっつーの。: It's not an excuse. I really was going to do it, okay？
translations.あ～あ、タイミング悪いな～。おかげで片付けする気なくなっちゃった。: Ugh, what awful timing. Now I've totally lost the motivation to clean.
translations.それ、片づけないですむ理由にしようとしてないか？: Aren't you just using that as an excuse not to clean it？
translations.部屋の片付け、したのか？ この前、言ってたろ？: Did you end up cleaning your room？ You mentioned it the other day.
translations.……覚えてたか、記憶力いいね。記憶力って言えばさ……。: ...Oh, you remembered. Good memory. Speaking of memory...
translations.はは、誤魔化すなって。片づけは？: Haha, don't change the subject. What about your room？
translations.実は……まだ。ほんのちょっと、本が出しっぱなしなだけなんだけど。: Actually... not yet. It's just a tiny bit, though. Just some books left out.
translations.ほんのちょっと。きっと男だったら許されるレベルだよ、不公平。: Just a tiny bit. If I were a guy, I'd get a pass for this much. It's not fair.
translations.それはあるかもな……。でも親には言われるんだろ？: You might have a point there... Still, your parents are gonna get on your case, right？
translations.……はあ、やっぱりやらないとダメかあ。: ...Sigh. Guess I really do have to clean it.
translations.部屋ってさ、片付けたと思ったら、またすぐ散らかるんだよね。: Just when you think you've cleaned your room, it gets messy again right away.
translations.片付けてる途中で、懐かしい本とかＣＤが出てきてさ、それを鑑賞してると……ね。: While I'm in the middle of cleaning, I find old books and CDs, and once I start going through them... well, you know.
translations.しょうがないじゃん。一度気になると、なかなか止まらないもんだよ。: I can't help it. Once something catches your eye, it's hard to stop.
translations.でも、そんなことしてたら、永遠に片付けが終わらないような。: Yeah, but at that rate, you're never gonna finish cleaning.
translations.……大丈夫だよ……たぶん。今度は誘惑を断ち切るよう、がんばるからさ。: ...It'll be fine... probably. Next time I'll try harder to resist temptation.
translations.どうやってって……がんばる。: What do you mean, how...？ By trying hard.
translations.（がんばるだけじゃなあ……）: (Just trying hard isn't gonna cut it...)
translations.とうとう部屋の片付けが終わったよ。これで文句ないよね。: I finally finished cleaning my room. No complaints now, right？
translations.そんな自慢げに。もとはといえば、散らかさなければいいんだろ。: You don't have to sound so smug. You wouldn't have to do it at all if you didn't make a mess in the first place.
translations.でさ、そういうアンタの部屋はどうなわけ？: Anyway, what about your own room？
translations.リンコに散々偉そうなこといったんだからさ、行動の規範を見せてほしいよね。: After lecturing me like you're so high and mighty, I'd love to see you set a good example.
translations.へへ、部屋がキレイだと気分がいいねー。: Hehe, having a clean room sure feels nice.
translations.この前さ、図書委員の代表で講演を聞きに行ってきたんだけど。: The other day, I had to go listen to a lecture as the library committee rep.
translations.ああ、図書室運営についてだっけ？: Oh, the one about library management？
translations.うん、先生のつきそいでね。もう眠くって。: Yeah, I went along with one of the teachers. I was so sleepy.
translations.なんとか踏ん張った。だけどさ、なんでえらい人の話って、催眠効果があるんだろ。: I managed to stay awake. Still, why do speeches by important people always have such a hypnotic effect？
translations.担任の先生、学年主任、教頭先生、校長先生の順に、眠くなるもん、不思議だよ。: Homeroom teacher, head of the grade, vice principal, principal... You get sleepier right in that order. It's weird.
translations.それで睡魔と戦いながら、どんな話を聴いてきたんだ？: So while you were fighting off sleep, what was the lecture actually about？
translations.……睡魔と戦って、勝ったことしか覚えてない。: ...All I remember is fighting off sleep and winning.
translations.それよりさ、講演の後に市営図書館の書庫を見学させてもらえたんだよ、閉架式のやつ。: Anyway, after the lecture, they let us tour the city library's archives, the closed stacks. I could spend all day in there and never get bored...
translations.（▲小早川＊▲は座学は苦手、と）: (Note to self: ▲小早川＊▲ isn't big on lectures.)
translations.驚いたのはこっちだよ。恋、とかって。: I'm the one you startled. Talking about being in love like that.
translations.ああ、今のは、前見せてもらった市営図書館の書庫の話。: Oh, that was about the city library's stacks they showed me the other day.
translations.……紛らわしい言い方すんなよ。: ...Don't put it like that. It's misleading.
translations.へえ、もしかして今のって嫉妬？: Huh. Were you jealous just now？
translations.でもさ、本に嫉妬はどうかと思うなあ。: Still, getting jealous of books is a little much, don't you think.
translations.いつもジジイ扱いすると怒るくせに。へへ、うろたえちゃってさ。: And yet you always get mad when I treat you like an old man. Hehe, you got all flustered.
translations.新しい本棚が欲しいな。本が増えて、置き場所に困ってるんだよね。: I want a new bookshelf. I've got so many books now, I'm running out of places to put them.
translations.確かに、本は場所を取るんだよな。: Books really do take up a lot of space, huh.
translations.リンコの部屋の本棚と、この前見た市営図書館の書庫と比べると、さ……。: When I compare the bookshelves in my room to the stacks at the city library I saw the other day...
translations.比べてどうするんだよ……。: What good does comparing them do...
translations.どうしようもないけどさ、あんな書庫があったらいいな。: None, I know, but I really wish I had stacks like that.
translations.そんなのが家にあったら、▲小早川＊▲がそこに閉じこもっちゃうだろ。: If you had something like that at home, ▲小早川＊▲, you'd just lock yourself in there.
translations.大丈夫だって、たまにはアンタの顔見に出てきてあげるからさ。: Relax, I'd come out every now and then just to see your face.
translations.欲しい本があるんだけど、自粛中。: There's a book I want, but I'm holding back right now.
translations.▲小早川＊▲の部屋、本棚がいっぱいなんだっけ。: The bookshelves in your room are full, right, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そう。もう、限界な感じ。: Yeah. Pretty much at their limit.
translations.少しは処分できないのか？: Can't you get rid of a few？
translations.本を捨てるなんてあり得ない。思い入れもあるし、絶対無理。: Throwing away books is out of the question. I'm attached to them, so there's just no way.
translations.じゃあ、売ったり、友だちにあげたりさ。寄贈ってのもあるだろ？: Then what about selling them, or giving them to friends？ You could donate them, too.
translations.……ま、いいけど。この前、弟にネコの絵を描いてあげたらさ……。: ...Well, whatever. The other day, I drew a picture of a cat for my little brother...
translations.あげたら？: You drew it for him, and？
translations.悔しいやら情けないやら申し訳ないやら……。: I felt frustrated, pathetic, and guilty all at once...
translations.（泣くくらい怖いネコ……）: (A cat scary enough to make him cry...)
translations.……はぁ。どうしたら絵ってうまくなるんだろう。: ...*Sigh*. How do you get better at drawing, anyway.
translations.そっか、まだ弟は喜んでくれないか？: I take it your brother still isn't thrilled with your art？
translations.うーん、喜んではくれたんだけど、不本意な感じ。: Well, he liked it, just not the way I wanted him to.
translations.不本意？ 今度はなにを描いたんだ？: Not how you wanted？ What'd you draw this time？
translations.ニワトリ。トサカが特徴的だし、他に間違えようがないしね。なのに……。: A rooster. With a comb like that, you can't really mistake it for anything else. And yet...
translations.お相撲さんって言われた……。: He called it a sumo wrestler...
translations.弟は喜んでくれたけど、ニワトリとして喜んでほしいじゃん。……はあ。: He liked it, sure, but I wanted him to like it as a rooster. ...Sigh.
translations.なあ、美術の先生に相談してみるってのはどうだ？: Hey, why don't you try asking the art teacher for advice？
translations.先生か……そっか……最初からそうすれば良かったのかも。ちょっと聞いてみる。: The teacher, huh... Right... Maybe I should've just done that from the start. I'll go ask.
translations.（相撲取りとニワトリ……トリは合ってるな）: (A sumo wrestler and a rooster... Well, 'wrestler' and 'rooster' sound kind of close, at least.)
translations.この前、美術の先生に、絵が上手くなる方法聞いてみた。: I asked the art teacher the other day how to get better at drawing.
translations.良い絵をたくさん見て、感性を磨けばうまくなるかも、だって。……リンコは今すぐ上手: They said if I look at lots of good art and refine my eye, I might improve. ...But I want to get better right now.
translations.今すぐは無理だろ……。: You can't just get good overnight...
translations.だってさ、このままじゃ姉の面子が丸つぶれだよ。: Yeah, well, at this rate I'm gonna lose all my dignity as his big sister.
translations.考えすぎだって、結果的には喜んでくれたんだろ？ ニワトリの絵。: You're overthinking it. He ended up liking it anyway, right？ The rooster drawing.
translations.心の中で笑ってた、リンコには聞こえた。はあ……。: You were laughing on the inside. I heard it. Sigh...
translations.（そんなにショックだったのか……）: (It really got to her that bad, huh...)
translations.弟がリンコの似顔絵描いてくれたんだけどさ。それがね、特徴を捉えててすっごく上手い: My little brother drew a portrait of me. And he really captured my features, it's super good.
translations.あれはきっと絵の才能があるね。天才だね。: He's definitely got a knack for art. Total genius.
translations.べた褒めだな……。: Laying the praise on thick, huh...
translations.へへ、姉バカですから。: Hehe, I'm a proud big sister, after all.
translations.そういう▲小早川＊▲の絵の方は、どうしたんだ？: What about your own drawing, ▲小早川＊▲？ How's that going？
translations.弟にあんな才能があるなら、わざわざリンコが絵を描いてあげることないよ。: If my brother's got that kind of talent, there's no need for me to bother drawing for him.
