translations.終わり。リンコは弟の才能が、開花するのを見守ることにするよ。: Over. I'm just gonna watch over my brother as his talent blossoms.
translations.（めでたしめでたし、か？）: (All's well that ends well, I guess？)
translations.ね、アンタの初恋っていつ頃だった？: Hey, when was your first love？
translations.うん、弟がね、カノジョを紹介してくれたんだ。: Well, my little brother introduced me to his girlfriend.
translations.お母さんが言ってたけど、おませさんが多いんだってさ。相手は近所の公園でよく会う子: Mom says there are a lot of precocious kids like that. Apparently she's a girl he sees a lot at the park nearby.
translations.初恋ってよりも、友達じゃないのか。: Doesn't that just make them friends, rather than a first love？
translations.でもね、ふたりは将来を誓い合ってるらしいよ。: Yeah, well, apparently the two of them have already promised each other their futures.
translations.そう、近頃の子供は侮れないよ。アンタも負けないようにね。: Yep. You can't underestimate kids these days. Better make sure you don't lose to them.
translations.家に帰ったら、弟のカノジョがいてさ、どう接したらいいのか困ったよ。: When I got home, my brother's girlfriend was there, and I had no idea how to act around her.
translations.まだ子供なんだから、そんなに意識しなくてもいいだろ。: They're still just kids, so you don't have to overthink it that much.
translations.将来を誓い合った二人だよ。……目の前でキスとかしてたらどうする？: These two have promised their futures to each other. ...What would I do if they started kissing right in front of me？
translations.でもさ、アンタは好きな子に、イタズラでチューとかしなかった？: Still, didn't you ever kiss a girl you liked as a prank？
translations.それは……▲小早川＊▲はしてたのか？: Well... Did you do that, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.質問したのはリンコだっつーの。: Hey, I'm the one asking the question here.
translations.まさか、ヤキモチ？ そんな小さいときのことで……器が知れるよ。: Don't tell me you're jealous？ Over something from when I was that little... That's pretty petty.
translations.してないっつーの、当たり前じゃん。ヘンな顔！: I didn't, obviously. You're making such a weird face!
translations.（そういや▲小早川＊▲の初恋ってどうだったんだ……）: (Come to think of it, I wonder what ▲小早川＊▲'s first love was like...)
translations.ん？ ……なににらんでんの。: Hm？ ...What are you glaring at me for？
translations.……ああ、▲小早川＊▲の弟の初恋、どうなったのかなって。: ...Oh, I was just wondering what happened with your little brother's first love, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.リンコはそっと見守ることにしたよ。だから、もうこれでこの話は終わり。: I decided to just watch over them quietly. So that's the end of that topic.
translations.なんでアンタが残念そうな顔するわけ？: Why do you look so disappointed？
translations.ほら、この前きいた……▲小早川＊▲の初恋さ。: You know, what we talked about the other day... Your first love, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.なんだそんなの気にしてたんだ。リンコの初恋相手はミュージシャンだよ。: Oh, is that what was on your mind？ My first love was a musician.
translations.ずるくないって。まあミュージシャン以外だと……アンタ……。: It's not unfair. Well, if we're not counting musicians... then you...
translations.もう、しつこいなあ。それよりそっちはどうなの、そっちは。: Jeez, you're persistent. Anyway, what about you, huh？
translations.もう、嘘でもいいからリンコって言えばいいのに。: Jeez, even if it was a lie, you could've just said Rinko.
translations.ごめんって、●は……。: I said I'm sorry. It's just, ●...
translations.もう時間切れ。この話は本当に終わり！: Too late, time's up. This conversation is officially over!
translations.（……まあ本気で怒ってるわけじゃなさそうだから、いいか）: (...Well, she doesn't seem seriously mad, so I guess it's fine.)
translations.前に電車に乗ってたとき思ったんだよね、このままどこまでも行けたらいいなって。: When I was on the train the other day, I thought how nice it'd be if I could just keep going forever.
translations.●もテスト前は思うかも……。: ● might feel that way before tests too...
translations.それはただの現実逃避。リンコが言いたいのは、遠くに行ってみたいってこと。: That's just escaping reality. What I'm talking about is wanting to go somewhere far away.
translations.あんまり変わらないと思うけどな。: I don't think there's much of a difference, though.
translations.ぜんぜん違うっつーの。もっとこう……わかんないかなあ。: It's completely different. It's more like... Ugh, don't you get it？
translations.そう、そんな感じ。どこまでも続く線路の先にもしかしたら……。: Yeah, something like that. Like maybe, at the end of those endless tracks...
translations.車窓から外を見つめながら、そんな風に想いを馳せる。: Just gazing out the train window, letting my thoughts wander like that.
translations.▲小早川＊▲……？ なんか変だぞ？: ▲小早川＊▲...？ You're acting kind of weird.
translations.ね、アンタは今、幸せ？ どこか遠くに行きたいとか思ってない？: Hey, are you happy right now？ Do you ever feel like going somewhere far away？
translations.幸せだと思うけど……。ああ、前したなそんな話。遠くに行きたい、とかなんとか。: I think I'm happy... Oh, we talked about that before, didn't we？ Wanting to go somewhere far away and all that.
translations.それそれ。でもさ、その幸せは、リンコとの関係に依存してるよね。: Yeah, that. But that happiness depends on your relationship with me, doesn't it？
translations.最近思う。この幸せは続くのか……永遠なのか……って。: I've been wondering lately... Will this happiness last？ Is it really forever？
translations.あ、勘違いしないで。別にアンタが嫌いになったとかじゃないから。: Oh, don't get the wrong idea. It's not like I've stopped liking you or anything.
translations.まあさ、リンコもたまに色々考えるわけ。気にしないでよ。: Well, I just get to thinking about stuff sometimes too. Don't worry about it.
translations.ね、もしリンコがいなくなって、今の幸せが崩れたらどうする？: Hey, what would you do if I disappeared and all the happiness we have now fell apart？
translations.……やっぱり変だ。この前からどうしたんだよ、幸せがどうとか。: ...Yeah, you're definitely acting weird. What's been up with you lately, talking about happiness and all that？
translations.なんとなくって……何か隠してないよな？: No reason...？ You're not hiding something from me, are you？
translations.ごめん。そんなに深刻に考えなくていいって。: Sorry. You really don't need to take it that seriously.
translations.前に言ったよね。幸せは永遠なのかなって……。: Remember what I said before？ About wondering if happiness lasts forever...
translations.リンコとアンタの関係は永遠だよね: What we have is forever, right？
translations.そりゃ、そうありたいよ。: Of course, I want it to be.
translations.（うーん、なんかまだはっきりしないな）: (Hmm, I still feel like I'm missing something here.)
translations.『愛と別れの日々』、通称“アイワカ”っていう連載小説読んでたんだよね。: I've been reading a serialized novel called "Days of Love and Parting"—"Aiwaka" for short.
translations.幸福な毎日を送っていた主人公が家族や仲間に裏切られて、一転して幸福な日常が崩れて: The main character is living a happy life, then gets betrayed by family and friends, and everything falls apart. They thought it'd last forever, and then they lose it all...
translations.アイワカ読んでたら、つい影響されちゃってさ。: Reading Aiwaka kind of got into my head.
translations.なんか流行りモノにのっかってるみたいで言いだせなかったんだけど、完結したらスッキ: I didn't want to say anything 'cause it felt like I was just jumping on a trend, but now that it's over, it's out of my system.
translations.あのなあ……時々おかしなこと言うから、何かあったのかと思ったよ。: Come on... You kept saying weird stuff, so I thought something was actually wrong.
translations.へへ、平凡な毎日が一番ってことだね。: Hehe, goes to show an ordinary life is best after all.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲と一緒にいると平凡って感じじゃないけどな）: (Though being with ▲小早川＊▲ hardly feels ordinary.)
translations.最近、アニマルチャンネルよく観るんだよね。: I've been watching the Animal Channel a lot lately.
translations.２４時間ずっと動物番組やってる？: The one that plays animal shows 24 hours a day？
translations.そう。最初はさ、何が面白いのかわからなかったけど、ネコ特番をやってて。: Yeah. At first I didn't get what was so great about it, but then they had a cat special.
translations.それって、最初から最後までネコだらけ？: Wait, so it's just cats from start to finish？
translations.一回の放送ではたったの２時間だよ。: Each broadcast is only two hours long.
translations.もう、たまらないよ。直接遊ぶのもいいけど、画面の中のネコはまた違ったよさがあるん: Honestly, I can't get enough of it. Playing with them in person is nice too, but watching cats on a screen has its own charm.
translations.またアニマルチャンネルでネコ特集やらないかな。禁断症状だよ。: I hope the Animal Channel does another cat special soon. I'm going through withdrawal here.
translations.うーん、▲小早川＊▲の家はネコ飼えないのか？: Hmm, can't you get a cat at your place, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.だって、ネコをかわいがりすぎて、アンタのこと忘れちゃうかもよ？: Because I might dote on the cat so much I forget all about you, you know？
translations.……●とネコどっちを取るんだ、みたいなことになりそうだな。: ...Sounds like I'd wind up asking, "Is it the cat or ●？"
translations.でしょ？ まあ、答えは決まってるけどね。: Right？ Well, the answer's pretty obvious, though.
translations.冗談だってば。ほら、お約束ってやつ。: Come on, I'm kidding. You know I had to say that.
translations.リンコにとって、死活問題。: It's a matter of life and death for me.
translations.ネコ特集のＤＶＤが出るんだよ。未放送特典付き。: The cat special is coming out on DVD. With unaired bonus footage.
translations.なのに、リンコの財政状況はかなりピンチ。どうしよう。: And yet my finances are in pretty dire straits. What do I do？
translations.そんなことで悩まなくても……。: You don't have to agonize over something like that...
translations.そんなことって……限定販売だよ？ 二度と手に入らないんだよ？: "Something like that"？ It's a limited edition. I'll never get another chance to buy it, you know？
translations.うーん……まあ、大事な問題か？: Hmm... Well, I guess it is a big deal to you？
translations.そうだよ！ 発売日まで、しばらくポテチはがまんかな。: It is! Guess I'll have to lay off the potato chips until it comes out.
translations.結局、予約しちゃったよ。ネコ特集のＤＶＤ。: I ended up pre-ordering it. The cat special DVD.
translations.家の手伝いと引き替えに、お父さんがプレゼントしてくれるって。へへ。: My dad said he'd get it for me if I help out around the house. Hehe.
translations.よかったな……でも、▲小早川＊▲って家事、苦手だろ？: That's great... Wait, aren't you bad at housework, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.愛するネコたちのためなら、どんなことでもがんばれるよ。: For my beloved cats, I can power through anything.
translations.まあ、あの番組の魅力は、見てない人には理解できないだろうけど。: Well, I guess someone who hasn't seen the show wouldn't get the appeal.
translations.▲小早川＊▲の話を聞いてると、すごい感動巨編に思えてくるよ。: Listening to you talk about it, ▲小早川＊▲, makes it sound like some deeply moving epic.
translations.全部でＤＶＤ５枚組なんだけど、ずっとネコがゴロゴロしてるの。たしかにある意味、感: It's a five-disc set, and it's just cats lounging around the whole time. In a way, it really is a moving epic.
translations.（ゴロゴロしてるだけのＤＶＤが５枚か……）: (Five whole discs of cats just lounging around, huh...)
translations.普段使わない道ってたまに通ってみたくなるよね。: Don't you ever feel like taking a street you don't normally use？
translations.ああ、なんとなくわかる。意外な発見があったりするしな。: Yeah, I get that. Sometimes you stumble across something unexpected.
translations.それでさ、やってみたら、レトロな喫茶店を見つけたんだよね。: So I tried doing that, and I found this retro coffee shop.
translations.そう。カフェじゃなくて喫茶店。昭和の香り漂ってる感じの。: Yeah. Not some trendy cafe, an old-school coffee shop. The kind with a real vintage vibe.
translations.ううん。ああいう古いお店って、なんとなく常連以外お断りみたいな雰囲気あるじゃん。: No. Old places like that kind of give off a "regulars only" vibe, you know？
translations.なんかガンコ店主って感じの店構えでさ。ドア開けたら怒鳴られそうだよ。: Just looking at the storefront makes you think the owner's some grumpy old guy. Like he'd yell at me the second I opened the door.
translations.（どんな店構えだよ、それ）: (What kind of storefront says all that？)\n
translations.この前話したガンコ親父のやってるレトロな喫茶店。: Remember that retro coffee shop run by the grumpy old guy I mentioned the other day？
translations.ガンコ親父がいるかどうかは確かめてないんだろ？: You didn't actually check if there's a grumpy old guy in there, right？
translations.だから、確かめに行ってきた。: Which is why I went back to check.
translations.窓からちょっとのぞいたら、大人しそうなおじいさんが一人でやってるみたいだった。: I peeked through the window, and it looked like a quiet old man was running it by himself.
translations.それなら入りやすそうじゃないか？: Doesn't that make it pretty easy to go in, then？
translations.甘いね。見た目は穏やかでも、きっと店内で物音でも立てようものなら、喝ぁーっ！: How naive. He might look mild-mannered, but I bet if you make even a peep in there, he's all, "QUIET!"
translations.つまりそれくらい緊張感漂うお店だってことだよ。: I'm just saying, that's how tense the vibe is in there.
translations.（勝手に想像だけふくらませてないか？）: (Isn't she just letting her imagination run wild？)
translations.ガンコ親父の喫茶店だけど、ついに入ってみたよ。: About that stubborn old man's coffee shop... I finally went inside.
translations.すっかりガンコ親父の店に決定なんだな。で、どうだった？: So you've totally settled on calling it the stubborn old man's place, huh. How was it？
translations.うん、お茶もケーキもおいしかった。: Yeah, both the tea and the cake were really good.
translations.店主のおじいさん？ 話してみると気さくで、優しい人だったよ。: The old man who runs it？ Once we talked, he turned out to be really friendly and nice.
translations.なら、ガンコ親父の店っていう言い方はどうなんだ？: Then maybe you shouldn't call it the stubborn old man's place？
translations.それもそっか。呼び方考えないと。: Fair point. I'll have to think of something else to call it.
translations.普通に喫茶店でいいだろ……。: Just calling it the coffee shop is fine...
translations.それよりさ、店内で流れてる曲もいい味出してるんだよね。ジャズ自体はよくわかんない: Anyway, the music playing in there has a great vibe, too. I don't know much about jazz itself, but it really fits the mood.
translations.あれからさ、レトロな喫茶店のおじいさんと仲良くなっちゃった。: Since last time, I've actually gotten pretty friendly with the old man at that retro coffee shop.
translations.へえ、▲小早川＊▲が、そこまで気に入るってのも珍しいな。: Huh, it's rare for you to warm up to someone that much, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そんなに仲良くなれたってことは、共通の話題でもあったとか？: For you two to get along that well, did you have something in common to talk about？
translations.おじいさんは昔、レコード店を経営してたって言ってた。: He told me he used to run a record store back in the day.
translations.へえ、それで今は引退して喫茶店のマスターか。: Huh, and now he's retired and runs a coffee shop.
translations.ジャズ専門ってわけでもなくてさ、結構激しいのもいけるクチ。だから話が弾んで。: He's not strictly into jazz, either. He actually likes the heavy stuff too, so we really hit it off.
translations.へえ、でもそんないい店なら●も行ってみたいな。: Huh, if it's such a nice place, ● would like to go too.
translations.子供はお断りって感じだから。それにリンコの秘密の店ってのがいいんだもん。: Because it has a "no kids allowed" vibe. Besides, I like keeping it as my own secret spot.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って、ドラマそんなに見ないよな？: You don't really watch TV dramas much, do you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.●はボチボチだけど……クラスの女子が恋愛ドラマの話しててさ。: ● watch them every now and then, but... some girls in my class were talking about a romance drama.
translations.恋愛ドラマなんか見てると、こっちが恥ずかしくなるよ。: Just watching romance dramas makes me feel embarrassed.
translations.それに、家族で見てるとさ。ほら、気まずくなるシーンとかあるじゃん。: Plus, when you're watching with your family, there are scenes that get really awkward, you know？
translations.ああ。お父さんが咳払いして、チャンネル変えたりな。: Yeah. Like your dad clearing his throat and changing the channel.
translations.うちには好奇心旺盛な男の子もいるから大変だよ。: We have a super curious little boy at our house, too, so it's a real pain.
translations.まだちっちゃいから、何もわかんないだろ。: He's still little, so he wouldn't understand any of it, right？
translations.甘い甘い。いまどきの園児をナメない方がいいよ。: You're way too naive. You shouldn't underestimate preschoolers these days.
translations.うちの近くでさ、ドラマの撮影に遭遇したよ。: I ran into a TV drama shoot near my house the other day.
translations.学園ドラマらしいよ？ 今売れてるアイドルもたくさん出るんだって。: A high school drama, apparently. They said a bunch of popular idols are in it, too.
translations.学園ドラマだったら、家族でも見られるな。: If it's a school drama, you could watch that with your family.
translations.浅はかだね、まだ大人の恋愛だったらいいけど、学園ドラマでキスシーンでもあってみな: That's wishful thinking. An adult romance is one thing, but imagine if a school drama has a kissing scene.
translations.“お姉ちゃんもキスするの”なんて、弟が言ってくるのが容易に想像できるよ。: I can already picture my little brother asking, "Do you kiss too, Sis？"
translations.▲小早川＊▲の家の近くで撮影してたドラマ、どんな内容なんだろ。: I wonder what that drama they were filming near your house is about, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.学園恋愛もの。後輩の女の子を好きになった少年が主人公だって。: A school romance. Apparently it's about a boy who falls for a younger girl at school.
translations.さあ？ で、その恋はちゃんと成就するのか？: Who knows？ So, does it actually work out for them？
translations.気になるなら見ればいいじゃん。: If you're curious, why don't you just watch it？
translations.気になるっていうか……ほら、立場上、な？: It's not just curiosity... You know, given our situation？
translations.へへ。まあでも、似てるようで似てないけどね。: Hehe. Well, it seems similar, but it's actually not.
translations.逆ってこと。: I mean it's the other way around.
translations.リンコたちのは、年上の先輩を好きになった少女の話、でしょ。もともとはさ。: Ours is the story of a girl who fell for an older boy at school, right？ Originally, anyway.
translations.ドラマ観た？ 例の学園恋愛もの。: Did you watch the drama？ That school romance one.
translations.結局家族そろって観たよ。: I ended up watching it with my whole family.
translations.まあ問題ない内容だったよな。あとあれ、近くの公園、出てたよな。: Well, there wasn't anything too bad in it. Oh, and that park nearby was in it, wasn't it？
translations.うん。弟なんて大騒ぎしてたよ。: Yeah. My little brother was making a huge fuss over it.
translations.じゃあ、このドラマは小早川家で楽しめそうだな。: Looks like the Kobayakawa family will be able to enjoy this show, then.
translations.ダメだよ。……あの公園でキスシーン撮影してたんだから。: No way. ...They filmed a kissing scene at that park.
translations.団らんが凍り付くよ。: The whole living room will freeze over.
translations.そっか……じゃあ気になるなら、●が内容教えるよ。: Got it... Well, if you're curious, ● can tell you what happens.
translations.いいね。なんなら、あの公園で再現してくれてもいいけど？: Sounds good. Or if you want, you could always reenact it for me at that park？
translations.不動産屋さんに家の間取りが貼ってあるじゃん。: You know how real estate offices have floor plans posted up？
translations.ああ、窓にズラッと貼ってあるやつな。: Yeah, the ones lined up all over the window.
translations.あれって見るの楽しいと思わない？: Don't you think those are fun to look at？
translations.ほら、そこに住むとしたら……って想像すると楽しいでしょ？: Come on, isn't it fun to imagine what it'd be like to live there？
translations.自分が住むとしたらか……。: What it'd be like to live there, huh...
translations.そう。もしそこに住んでたらって仮定して、朝起きて夜寝るまでを想像してみるわけ。: Yeah. You pretend you live there, and imagine your whole day from waking up to going to bed.
translations.起きて学校いって、帰ってきて寝て……。: Wake up, go to school, come home, go to sleep...
translations.久しぶりに絶句したね。そんなんじゃ、人生損するよ。: That's the first time in a while I've been left speechless. You're missing out on life like that.
translations.この前家族で、住宅展示場に行ってきたよ。: I went to a model home exhibition with my family the other day.
translations.間取り図だけじゃなくて、ついに本物を見に行ったのか。: So you finally went to see the real thing instead of just looking at floor plans.
translations.ま、そんなとこ。うちの親もわりと好きみたいだしね。: Pretty much. Seems like my parents are kind of into it too.
translations.親子連れも多いでしょ。だから、一日いても飽きないようにいろんな工夫がされてるんだ: A lot of families with kids go, right？ So they have all kinds of things set up so you won't get bored even if you stay all day.
translations.リンコたちが行ったところは、屋台なんかも出てたよ。: The place we went to even had food stalls.
translations.家を買うってことは人生の一大イベントだからね。ある意味お祭り気分だよ。: Buying a house is one of life's biggest events, after all. In a way, people are in a festive mood.
translations.んー、将来は自分で住む家を考えることになるんだよね。なんか楽しみになってきた。: Hmm, someday I'll be thinking about a house of my own to live in. I'm kind of looking forward to it now.
translations.（まあ、楽しそうだしいいか）: (Well, she seems to be having fun, so I guess it's fine.)
translations.引っ越ししたくなることってない？: Don't you ever feel like moving？
translations.なんで……あ、もしかして住宅展示場に行ったせいか？: Why... Oh, is this because you went to that model home exhibition？
translations.そんなとこ。住んでるところも含めて、環境をぱーっと変えてみたくなったよ。: Something like that. It made me want to completely change up my surroundings, including where I live.
translations.そうは言っても、実際には難しいだろうな。: Still, it'd probably be tough to actually do.
translations.だから今は妄想の中だけでがまんしてる。: Which is why I'm settling for just daydreaming about it for now.
translations.それに、たとえば遠くに引っ越したら、簡単には会えなくなるだろ？: Besides, if you moved far away, we wouldn't be able to see each other so easily, right？
translations.それは困る……あ、でも遠距離恋愛も意外とドラマチックでよかったりして。: That'd be a problem... Oh, though a long-distance relationship might actually be kind of dramatic and nice.
translations.……あのあと、ちょっと泣いちゃったよ。: ...I actually cried a little after that.
translations.あわてないでいいよ。遠距離恋愛がどうとか話したじゃん。: Calm down. Remember how we were talking about long-distance relationships？
translations.ああ、引っ越しの話か。: Oh, when we talked about moving.
translations.もしアンタと遠距離恋愛することになったらって、ベッドの中で考えてたら、涙出てきた: I was lying in bed thinking about what it'd be like if we ended up long-distance, and I started tearing up.
translations.間取り見て想像するのはしばらくいいかな。あと１０年くらいは。: I think I'm good on looking at floor plans and daydreaming for a while. For another ten years or so.
translations.実際に必要になるまではさ、とっておくのもいいかなって。: I figured it might be nice to save it for when it's actually needed.
translations.そっか、じゃあそのときはまた楽しめるな？: I see. Well, you'll have fun with it again when the time comes, huh？
translations.他人事みたいに言うなっつーの。: Don't talk like it doesn't involve you.
translations.あのさ、遊園地ってどう思う？: Hey, what do you think about amusement parks？
translations.それだけじゃわかんないって、どうした？: You didn't give me much to go on. Why do you ask？
translations.それはね、“小早川理論”だよ。聞きたい？: Well, it's part of the "Kobayakawa Theory." Want to hear it？
translations.小早川理論？ 面白そうじゃん、教えてよ。: The Kobayakawa Theory？ Sounds interesting, tell me.
translations.人生と遊園地の関係。幼い頃は親と、若くして恋人と、長じては子供と、老いては孫と。: The relationship between life and amusement parks. You go with your parents as a kid, your partner when you're young, your kids when you're grown, and your grandkids when you're old. See？ Amusement parks are with you your whole life.
translations.（わかるような、わからんよーな）: (I kind of get it, and kind of don't...)
translations.“遊園地は人生とともにある”ってやつか。: The one about how amusement parks are with you your whole life？
translations.そう。理論の応用編があるんだけど聞きたい？: Right. There's an advanced part to the theory, too. Want to hear it？
translations.賢明な判断。これを知ってれば、大儲け間違いなしだよ。: Wise choice. With this knowledge, you're guaranteed to make a fortune.
translations.大儲け？ 人生論じゃないのか？: A fortune？ Wait, wasn't this a philosophy on life？
translations.経済論かな。つまり、子供と女性を引きつければ、成人男子もついてくるってこと。そこ: Call it economics. Basically, if you attract women and children, adult men will follow. As long as you nail that, booming business is guaranteed.
translations.なんだか、急に生臭くなってきたな。: Man, this suddenly got all about money.
translations.経済ってそういうもんでしょ。要は、儲けたいなら、女子供を捕まえろってことだね。: That's just how economics works. Bottom line, if you want to make a profit, win over the women and kids.
translations.焼き肉を一緒に食べてる男女は深い関係って話、知ってる？: Have you heard that if a guy and a girl eat yakiniku together, it means they're really close？
translations.さあ……それも“小早川理論”か？: Can't say I have... Is that another "Kobayakawa Theory"？
translations.ううん。友だちから聞いた。結構、一般的な話らしいよ。: Nope. Heard it from a friend. Apparently it's a pretty common saying.
translations.リンコたちも毎日焼き肉食べれば、もっと深い関係になれるかもよ。: Maybe if we ate barbecue every day, we'd get even closer.
translations.毎日は飽きるだろ。: We'd get tired of having it every day.
translations.じゃあいいよ、ステーキでも鉄板焼きでも。でもハンバーグとかはダメっぽいよね。: Fine, steak or teppanyaki works too. Hamburger steak probably doesn't count, though.
translations.（焼いた肉ならなんでもいいのか……）: (So any kind of grilled meat will do...)
translations.“新小早川理論”聞きたい？: Want to hear the 'New Kobayakawa Theory'？
translations.はは、お願いします。小早川教授。: Haha, by all means, Professor Kobayakawa.
translations.一緒にホルモン食べてる男女は、すごく深い仲ってのはどう？: How about this: a guy and girl who eat tripe together are super close？
translations.それって……前に聞いた、焼き肉食べてるカップルの話？: Isn't that... from what you said before about couples eating barbecue？
translations.そう、焼き肉より、ホルモンの方が深い感じするじゃん。: Yeah, tripe feels way deeper than regular barbecue, doesn't it？
translations.わかるような……わからんような……。: I kind of get it... and kind of don't...
translations.そんなすごまれても……そうだ。その理論、検証はしたのか？: Even if you say it so intensely... Oh, right. Have you tested that theory？
translations.それがさ、思いつきは良かったんだけど、リンコあんまり得意じゃないんだよね、ホルモ: Well, it was a good idea, but I don't actually do too well with tripe.
translations.やっぱりさ、女の子ってかわいいグッズ持っとくべきなのかな。: I wonder if girls really should carry cute stuff around.
translations.べき、ではないと思うけど、なんで？: I don't think you 'should' have to, why？
translations.周りで、携帯とかデコるのが流行っててさ。まあ前からだけど、最近特に。: Decorating phones and stuff is really popular around me. Well, it has been for a while, but especially lately.
translations.へえ、そういや▲小早川＊▲はしないな。: Huh. Come to think of it, you don't do that, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.みんながリンコの持ち物は地味だって言うから。カレシとしてはどう思う？: Because everyone says my stuff is plain. What do you think, as my boyfriend？
translations.まあ派手ではないと思うけど。いいだろ別に。▲小早川＊▲がいいって思うモノを持って: Well, it's not flashy, sure. But what's wrong with that？ Just carry whatever you like, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.まあね、基本スタンスはそうなんだけどさ……。: True. That's my basic stance on it too, but...
translations.（迷ってるわけか）: (So she's on the fence about it.)
translations.この前、友だちとショッピングモール行ったんだけどさ。: I went to the mall with a friend the other day.
translations.へえ、何見てきたの？: Oh yeah？ What did you go look at？
translations.うん、実はさ……リンコの携帯が地味だから、デコってあげるって言われて。: Well, actually... she said my phone was plain and offered to decorate it for me.
translations.あれ、しないんじゃなかったっけ。: Wait, I thought you didn't do that.
translations.基本スタンスは、ね。そこはフレキシブルにさ、ほら、とりあえず見学ってことで。: As my basic stance, yeah. Gotta be flexible, you know. I just went to take a look for now.
translations.まんざらでもないんだったら、やってみればいいじゃん。: If you're curious about it, why not just give it a try？
translations.だから、見学だけだって。: Like I said, I was just looking.
translations.はいはい。で、見学はどうだった？: Right, right. So how was looking？
translations.はは、そっか。よかったじゃん。: Haha, I see. Good for you.
translations.そういや携帯は結局デコらないんだな。: Come to think of it, you ended up not decorating your phone.
translations.そうなんだ。ってことは、元に戻したってことか？: Oh, really. Does that mean you changed it back？
translations.うん、たまに眺める分にはいいけど、普段使うものがゴテゴテしてるのはしっくりこなく: Yeah. It's nice to look at now and then, but having something I use every day all gaudy just didn't feel right.
translations.やっぱりリンコにはシンプルなのがあってるって思ったよ。: I realized simple really does suit me better.
translations.はは、やっぱそうか。それがわかっただけでも収穫だな。: Haha, figured as much. Just finding that out makes it worth it, though.
translations.ゴテゴテしてる携帯って、洋服着せられたネコみたいで、ちょっと窮屈っていうか。: A phone covered in all that stuff is like a cat forced into clothes. It just seems a bit suffocating.
translations.なるほど……▲小早川＊▲らしい発想だな。: I see... That's such a ▲小早川＊▲ way of looking at it.
translations.洋服着たネコも可愛くて好きなんだけどさ、あんまりやり過ぎるのはよくないってこと。: I mean, cats in clothes are cute and I like them, too. I'm just saying it's not good to overdo it.
translations.携帯デコるって話さ、友だちは大丈夫だったのか？ すすめてくれてたんだろ。: About decorating your phone—was your friend okay with that？ She's the one who talked you into it, right？
translations.うん、別に向こうもよかれと思ってすすめてくれただけだし。: Yeah. She was just suggesting it to be nice, anyway.
translations.自分には合わなかったけどさ、ちょっと勉強にもなったよ。: It wasn't for me, but I did learn a little something from it.
translations.リンコは携帯選ぶとき、シンプルなのにしたんだけど。みんなはデコること前提で選ぶん: When I picked out my phone, I went with a simple one. Apparently everyone else picks theirs planning to decorate it—basically, just as a base.
translations.最初から気に入ったものを選ぶか、後で自分好みに変えるか、ちょっと示唆に富んでるな: Whether you pick something you like from the start, or change it to your liking later... I thought that was pretty telling.
translations.リンコは元々のアンタが気に入ったから、アンタを選んだ。そういうこと。: I liked you the way you already were, so I chose you. That's what I mean.
translations.小さい頃に好きだった本って、覚えてる？: Do you remember the books you liked when you were little？
translations.うーん、場面とか絵は覚えてるんだけど、話は曖昧なのが多いかな。: Hmm, I remember certain scenes and pictures, but the stories themselves are mostly a blur.
translations.そうなんだよね。この間、本屋さんでそういう本をたまたま見かけたから読んでみたんだ: Right？ I happened to spot one of those books at the bookstore the other day, so I gave it a read.
translations.やっぱり記憶と違ってたんだけど、いい意味で裏切られたって感じですごく面白かった。: It was different from how I remembered it, sure enough, but it surprised me in a good way. It was really interesting.
translations.女の子が友だちの家に遊びに行く途中、迷っちゃうって話なんだけど。: It's about a girl who gets lost on her way to a friend's house.
translations.リンコの記憶では女の子はネコの後を追いかけて行くと、なんとか家に着くって話だった: The way I remembered it, the girl follows a cat and somehow manages to make it to the house, except...
translations.うん、全然。家に電話かけて、迎えに来てもらってた。: No, not at all. She just called home and had someone come pick her up.
translations.小さい頃に読んだ本の話だけどさ。: About that book I read when I was little...
translations.ああ、記憶が全然違ってたってやつか。: Oh, the one you remembered completely wrong？
translations.うん、あれね、タイトル間違えてたみたい。: Yeah. Turns out I had the title mixed up.
translations.なんだ。そりゃ、話は違うよな。: Oh, come on. No wonder the story was different.
translations.うん、リンコの記憶っていい加減だってわかったよ。: Yeah. It made me realize just how unreliable my memory is.
translations.そうかも。他にもそういうことあったりするのかも。: Maybe. There might be other things I'm misremembering, too.
translations.ああ、結構たくさんあるかもな……。: Yeah, I bet there are plenty...
translations.ジジイだもんね？: Because you're an old man, right？
translations.いっこ上だけどな。: I'm only a year older than you.
translations.こういう定番なやり取りは、きっと大人になっても忘れないと思うけどね。: Though I'm sure I won't forget our usual back-and-forths like this, even when we're grown up.
translations.（なんかいいな……それ）: (I kind of like the sound of that...)
translations.人間は忘れる動物だってさ。ほら、前に話した、昔読んだ本の話みたいに。: They say humans are creatures that forget. You know, like that book from my childhood I told you about.
translations.ああ、記憶違いの。: Oh, the one you remembered wrong.
translations.そう。あんまり忘れっぽいのも困るけど、ネチっこく覚えてるのもやだよね。: Right. Being too forgetful is a problem, but holding onto every little thing is pretty unpleasant too.
translations.一度覚えたら忘れないってのも、テストとかは便利だけどな。: Never forgetting anything once you've learned it would come in handy for tests, though.
translations.子供だね。すぐテストとか言っちゃうんだからさ。:
You're such a kid, jumping
straight to tests like that.
translations.▲小早川＊▲はどうして、忘れた方がいいんだ？:
Why do you think it's
better to forget, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコが忘れたいことはそんなにないけど、アンタに忘れて欲しいことはあるかも。:
There isn't much I want to
forget, but there might be
things I want you to forget.
translations.え、●？ 何を？:
Huh, things ● should
forget？ Like what？
translations.そりゃ、色々……。アンタには恥ずかしいところ、いっぱい見られてるからさ。:
Well, all kinds of things...
You've seen me in plenty of
embarrassing moments.
translations.なんだろう、結構心当たりあるかも。うーん……。:
Hmm, I think I can actually
picture a few. Let's see...
translations.ちょっと、変な想像すんなっつーの！:
Hey, don't go imagining
anything weird!
translations.ふたりで一緒に経験したことは、もしどっちかが忘れちゃっても大丈夫だね。:
With the things we've
experienced together, it's okay
even if one of us forgets.
translations.記憶の話か？ そうだな……●が▲小早川＊▲に思い出させてやるよ。:
Still on the memory thing？
Yeah... ● can just remind
you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.それはこっちのセリフ。年寄りは物忘れが激しいって言うしさ。:
That's my line. They say old
folks are super forgetful,
after all.
translations.いっこ違いだけどな。●がほんとに物忘れする頃は▲小早川＊▲だって、おばあちゃんだ:
We're only a year apart. By the
time ● actually get forgetful,
you'll be a grandma too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.それじゃダメじゃん。ふたりとも忘れちゃう。:
Well, that's no good. Then
we'll both end up forgetting.
translations.どうして？ リンコはヤだ。: Why not？ I don't want that.
translations.ごめん、変な話しちゃった。:
Sorry, that was a weird thing
to bring up.
translations.とりあえずさ、物忘れが激しくなっちゃう頃まで一緒にいられたら、うれしいと思うんだ:
Anyway, I'd be happy if we
could stay together until we're
both old and forgetful.
translations.家の近くからネコの鳴き声が一晩中聞こえてくるんだよね。:
I've been hearing a cat meowing
near my house all night long.
translations.だと思う。その鳴き声がすごく大きくって。:
I think so. And its cries are
really loud.
translations.静かな夜なんか特に響くんだよね。悲しそうで、寂しそうなんだ。:
It really echoes on quiet
nights. It sounds so sad and
lonely.
translations.まさか誰かにいじめられてるとか？:
You don't think someone's
mistreating it, do you？
translations.わかんない。探しても見つからなくて。:
I don't know. I looked for it,
but I couldn't find it.
translations.うん。もしケガでもしてたら、手当くらいしてあげたいのに。:
Yeah. If it's hurt or anything,
I'd at least like to patch it up.
translations.家の近くで鳴いている野良ネコだけど……。:
About that stray cat meowing
near my house...
translations.昼間探してもダメだから、鳴いている夜中に探してみようと思って。:
Looking during the day didn't
work, so I'm thinking of looking
at night when it's meowing.
translations.夜は危ないだろ。:
Going out at night is
dangerous, though.
translations.大丈夫。家の周りを探すだけだから。:
It'll be fine. I'm just going
to look around the house.
translations.もしかして心配してくれてる？:
Are you worried about me,
by any chance？
translations.へへ。そうだね、カレシを心配させちゃ悪いか。でも気になるな……。:
Hehe. Yeah, I shouldn't make my
boyfriend worry. Still, it's on
my mind...
translations.やっぱり鳴いてるネコが心配で、夜中に探しに出た。:
I was still worried about that
meowing cat, so I went out
looking for it last night.
translations.でも、大丈夫。お父さんに付き合ってもらったし。:
It's okay, though. I had my dad
come with me.
translations.なんだ、それなら。それでネコは見つかった？:
Oh, well, that's alright then.
So did you find the cat？
translations.うん。連れて帰るまではできなかったけど、見た感じケガもしてなかったよ。:
Yeah. We couldn't bring it
home, but it didn't look hurt
or anything.
translations.そうか、良かったな。でもどうして一晩中鳴いてるんだろうな。: I see, that's good. I wonder why it's meowing all night, though.
translations.お父さんにきいたら、たぶん発情期だろって。: I asked my dad, and he said it's probably in heat.
translations.ああ、そういうもんか。: Oh, so that's what it is.
translations.リンコには寂しそうに聞こえたんだけどな……。: It sounded lonely to me, though...
translations.ハナちゃんにカレシができたみたい。: Looks like Hana got a boyfriend.
translations.ハナちゃん？ ▲小早川＊▲の友達？: Hana？ A friend of yours, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.夜に鳴いてたネコ。名前がないと呼びにくいしね。: The cat that was meowing at night. It's hard to talk about her without a name.
translations.はは、カレシができたってことは、やっぱり発情期だったのかもな。: Haha. If she got a boyfriend, I guess she really was in heat.
translations.笑うことないじゃん、自然の摂理だよ。: You don't have to laugh. It's just nature taking its course.
translations.ほら、寂しそうな声って▲小早川＊▲が言ってたからさ。: Well, you were the one saying she sounded lonely, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.うるさいな。ネコの幸せを素直に喜べないなんて、リンコのカレシ失格だね。: Shut up. If you can't just be happy for a cat, you fail as my boyfriend.
translations.ごめんごめん。幸せになれるといいな、ハナちゃん。: Sorry, sorry. I hope Hana finds happiness.
translations.ハナちゃんのカレシはデリカシーのあるネコだといいけどね。アンタと違って。: I just hope Hana's boyfriend has some tact. Unlike you.
translations.あのさ、日帰り旅行とお出かけって、何が違うと思う？: Hey, what do you think the difference is between a day trip and just going out？
translations.その日に帰ってくるなら、普通に出かけるのと一緒じゃん。: If you come back the same day, isn't it the same as just going out？
translations.どのくらいから、日帰り旅行になるのかな。: How far do you have to go for it to count as a day trip？
translations.わかんないけど。なんで、そんなことが気になるんだ？: I don't know. Why are you wondering about that？
translations.その定義がはっきりすれば、リンコたちのデートが毎回、日帰り旅行にレベルアップする: If we nail down the definition, every one of our dates might level up into a day trip, you know？
translations.（レベルアップ……まあそんな感じかもな）: (Level up... Well, I guess that's one way to put it.)
translations.日帰り旅行と普通のデートの差、わかったよ。: I figured out the difference between a day trip and a normal date.
translations.たしかに距離の問題ではあるんだけどね、ちょっと違う。: It is a matter of distance, sure, just a different kind.
translations.ふたりの距離の問題、っていうのはどう？: How about the distance between the two of us？
translations.へえ、上手いこと言うな。: Huh, that's a nice way of putting it.
translations.でしょ？ 少し遠出してふたりが旅行だと思えば、それは旅行になるよ。: Right？ If we go a little further out and both think of it as a trip, then it's a trip.
translations.そうだな。じゃあ、これからいつでも日帰り旅行ができるな。: True. Then we can go on a day trip anytime we want from now on.
translations.日帰り旅行のこと、友だちに話したらノリノリだったよ。: I told my friend about the day trip idea, and she was really into it.
translations.ふたり次第で、どこに行っても日帰り旅行だって？: That anywhere can be a day trip if the two of you say it is？
translations.リンコの発想に驚いてたよ。: She was amazed I came up with that.
translations.そう、それで、今度この友達と日帰り旅行に行くことになったよ。: Yeah, so now I'm going on a day trip with her soon.
translations.はは、なるほどね。それ、●は呼ばれないのか？: Haha, I see. No invite for ●？
translations.そういうのじゃないの。女だけの旅行なんだから。: It's not that kind of trip. It's girls only.
translations.友だちとの日帰り旅行、どうだった？ 映画観に行くってやつ。: How was the day trip with your friend？ The movie one.
translations.楽しかったよ。映画観て、お茶して、カラオケ行っただけだけど。: It was fun. All we did was see a movie, get some tea, and go to karaoke, though.
translations.でもさ、やっぱり自然とカレシの話になるんだよね。: Still, the conversation naturally turned to boyfriends.
translations.ああ……そうか。慣れないな、そういうの。: Oh... right. I'm still not used to that kind of thing.
translations.安心しなって、変なことは言ってないからさ。: Relax, I didn't say anything weird.
translations.はは、そっか。自慢のカレシだもんな！: Haha, gotcha. Well, I am a boyfriend worth bragging about!
translations.今の発言は、友だちに言いふらしてやろ。: I'm telling all my friends what you just said.
translations.テレビの企画で街頭インタビューやってたんだけどさ。: They were doing street interviews for a TV show.
translations.“恋人と二十四時間一緒にいたいか”だってさ。: They asked, 'Would you want to be with your partner 24 hours a day？'
translations.二十四時間か……。▲小早川＊▲ならどう答える？: Twenty-four hours a day, huh... How would you answer, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.正直、微妙……かも。: Honestly, I'm... not so sure I would.
translations.だって二十四時間だよ。いくら好きな相手でもさ。: I mean, we're talking 24 hours a day. No matter how much you like them.
translations.でも、もし結婚したら二十四時間一緒ってのもあるんじゃないか？: Still, if you got married, couldn't you end up being together 24 hours a day？
translations.うん一般論として……あ、違う。●たちが結婚とかそういう意味で言ったんじゃなくて！: Yeah, just speaking generally... Oh, wait! I didn't mean you and me getting married or anything, ●!
translations.“恋人と二十四時間一緒にいたいか”ってインタビュー、みんな結構見てたらしいよ。: Seems like a lot of people saw that 'Would you want to be with your partner 24 hours a day？' interview.
translations.なんか不満そうだな。: You don't sound too happy about it.
translations.二十四時間一緒にいたいって女子が意外と多かった。: A surprising number of girls said they'd want to be together 24 hours a day.
translations.リンコの感覚が変なのかな……？: Am I the weird one for feeling this way...？
translations.変とまではいかないと思うけど。: I wouldn't go so far as to call it weird.
translations.だってさ、リンコだってカレシのことは大好きだよ？ でもさ、一人の時間を大切にした: I mean, I love my boyfriend too, okay？ But sometimes you want to value your alone time, right？
translations.声、大きいって。人に見られてる……。: You're being really loud. People are staring...
translations.（痴話喧嘩みたいに思われたのかな……それも悪い気分じゃないけど）: (I wonder if they think we're having a lovers' quarrel... Doesn't feel half bad, though.)
translations.ちょっと考えてた。前に話した、リンコは一人の時間も大切にしたいってこと。: I was just thinking a little. About what I said before, how I want to value my alone time too.
translations.それは本当なんだけど、でも、一人でいるとアンタの声、聞きたくなるし。: That part is true, but... when I'm alone, I start wanting to hear your voice.
translations.会いたい、って思うし……。: And I start wanting to see you...
translations.なんか考えれば考えるほど、リンコも結局、みんなと同じ考えなのかもって。: The more I think about it, I feel like maybe I'm no different from everyone else after all.
translations.“恋人と二十四時間一緒にいたいか”。: 'Would you want to be with your partner 24 hours a day？'
translations.ああ……また考えてたんだ。: Oh... You've been thinking about that again.
translations.面白いテーマだし。一般論としてね。: It's an interesting topic. Speaking generally, of course.
translations.（思いっきり自分の考えぶちまけてた気するけど……）: (Pretty sure she was spilling her own feelings about it before, though...)
translations.なんでも。で、考えた結果は？: Nothing. So, what conclusion did you come to？
translations.やっぱりリンコは、一緒にいたくない。: In the end, I still don't want to be together.
translations.ふーん。続きは？: Hmm. And the rest of it？
translations.続きってなに。: What do you mean, the rest？
translations.前話した時の様子からいって、それで終わりってことはないんじゃないかって……●の希: Going by last time we talked, I figured there had to be more to it... though maybe that's partly wishful thinking from ●.
translations.……一回しか言わない。何時間一緒とか、ずっと離れないとか……。: ...I'm only saying this once. How many hours we spend together, or never being apart...
translations.そんなこと気にならないぐらい、隣にいるのが当たり前、みたいな、そんな風になりたい: I want being by your side to feel so natural that we don't even worry about stuff like that. Probably something like that. ...That's all.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って読書は小説が多いのか？: Do you mostly read novels, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.うん、そうだね。ノンフィクションも結構好きだけど。: Yeah, mostly. Though I like nonfiction quite a bit, too.
translations.周りはやっぱり漫画が多いんじゃないのか？: Don't most people around you read manga instead？
translations.そりゃね、リンコも漫画好きだし。ただみんなが読んでるようなやつは……。: Well, sure. I like manga too. It's just, the stuff everyone else is reading...
translations.こう、いきなり冴えない女の子が完全無欠のイケメンに何故か好かれちゃって、とか。: Like when some plain girl suddenly has a flawless, handsome guy fall for her out of nowhere.
translations.そういうご都合主義がちょっとね。面白ければいいってのもわかるし、娯楽としては間違: All that wish fulfillment is a bit much for me. I get that it only needs to be fun, and there's nothing wrong with it as entertainment, though.
translations.……悪かったな、完全無欠のイケメンじゃなくて。: ...Sorry I'm not some flawless, handsome guy.
translations.悪くないよ。完全無欠の人間なんて好きじゃないもん。よかったね。: Nothing to be sorry for. I don't even like flawless people anyway. Lucky you.
translations.（……まあ喜んでおくか）: (...Guess I'll take that as a compliment.)
translations.『こころ合わせ』って少女マンガ知ってる？: Have you heard of a shojo manga called 'Heart to Heart'？
translations.名前ぐらいは聞いたことあったかな……。: I think I've at least heard the name...
translations.図書室に入れてくれって要望が結構来てるんだよね。なに考えてんだか。: We've been getting quite a few requests to add it to the library. What are people thinking？
translations.前にもそんな話あったかもしれないけど、マンガは無理じゃないの？: Didn't something like this come up before？ Isn't manga off-limits？
translations.内容次第では……って言ってる人もいるけどさ、前例を作らないのが重要なのに。: Some people say it depends on the content, but the whole point is not setting a precedent.
translations.一応、先輩から１巻だけ借りてはきたけど。設定は双子のイケメン兄弟に恋愛偏差値の低: I did borrow the first volume from an upperclassman, though. The premise is a girl who's clueless about romance pining after handsome twin brothers...
translations.やれやれって感じ。でも読み方はわかってるから。: Kind of makes me roll my eyes. But I know the right way to read stuff like this.
translations.読み方？: The right way to read it？
translations.そう。こういうのは頭を空っぽにして、純粋な気持ちで読むの。そうすると結構楽しめる: Yeah. With stories like this, you just turn your brain off and read it with an open heart. Apparently you can actually enjoy it that way.
translations.（歩み寄ってるようで、実はかなり斜に構えてる気が……）: (She sounds like she's giving it a fair shot, but I feel like she's still being pretty cynical about it...)
translations.『こころ合わせ』のことだけどさ、図書室に入れても良い気がしてきた。: About 'Heart to Heart'... I'm starting to think it might be okay to put it in the library.
translations.えっ、そんなに良かったのか？: Whoa, was it really that good？
translations.……うん。読まずにバカにしてた自分が恥ずかしいよ。: ...Yeah. I'm ashamed of myself for looking down on it before I even read it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲にそこまで言わせるか。: For ▲小早川＊▲ to go that far, it must really be something.
translations.もうね、まず主人公のハルカの純愛がきゅーんって来る。: First off, the main character Haruka's pure-hearted love really tugs at your heartstrings.
translations.それだけだとただの少女漫画なんだけどさ、恋愛相手の心情変化とか、サブキャラの絡め: If that were all, it'd just be another shojo manga, but the way the love interest's feelings shift, and how the side characters are woven in... It's really well done.
translations.前に言ってた、頭を空っぽにして読む、って感じじゃないんだな。: So it's not the kind of 'turn your brain off and read' thing you were talking about before.
translations.そう、それ。さらっと表面だけ読んでも面白いし、突き詰めても奥が深い。だから万人受: Right, exactly. It's fun even if you just skim the surface, and it's deep if you really dig into it. That's probably why it appeals to everyone.
translations.へえ、そこまでだったら図書室に入れてもいいんじゃないの？: Huh. If it's that good, why not go ahead and put it in the library？
translations.うーん、まだ迷ってるんだよね……。: Hmm, I'm still on the fence about it...
translations.『こころ合わせ』、入れることにしたんだな。: So you decided to add 'Heart to Heart' to the library after all.
translations.試験的にね。ただし、今回はあくまでも例外。: On a trial basis, yeah. Though this time is strictly an exception.
translations.なんでもかんでも要望を入れてたら、きりがないもんな。: Yeah, if you accepted every single request, there'd be no end to it.
translations.そうそう。ひとまずは一件落着。: Exactly. So that settles that for now.
translations.あーあ、『こころ合わせ』みたいな恋愛がしたい……。: Man... I wish I could have a romance like in 'Kokoro Awase'...
translations.いいじゃん、別に。マンガの恋愛に憧れるくらい。: What's the big deal？ I'm allowed to wish for a manga romance.
translations.そうだけどさ……こう、今の恋愛に不満があるのかって思うじゃんか。: Well, yeah, but... it makes me wonder if you're unhappy with our relationship right now.
translations.ないけど、ヒトってのは強欲なものでさ、どこまでも欲しがっちゃうんだよね。: I'm not, it's just that people are greedy creatures. We always end up wanting more.
translations.もちろんフィクション限定。ノンフィクション部門ではアンタがランキング不動の一位だ: Only in fiction, of course. In the nonfiction rankings, you're the undisputed number one.
translations.あっ、いますっごい\nイケメンが歩いてた。:
Oh, a really hot guy
just walked by.
translations.うわ、つまんない。\n“お前は俺だけ見てろ”\nとか言わないんだ？:
Wow, boring.
Aren't you gonna say,
'Keep your eyes on me'？
translations.よーし、言って欲しいなら……。:
All right, if you want me
to say it...
translations.無理無理。\n似合わないからやめた方がいいって。:
No way.
It wouldn't suit you at all,
so don't bother.
translations.ね。今突然、悪いヤツが\nリンコに襲いかかってきたら\nどうする？:
Hey. What would you do if
some bad guy suddenly
attacked me right now？
translations.そりゃもちろん\n身体をはって守る！:
Put my body on the line
to protect you, obviously!
translations.ゲームオーバー。\nもっとレベルあげないと。:
Game over.
You need to level up more.
translations.あっ！\n今、ネコがそこの角曲がってった。:
Oh!
A cat just turned
that corner.
translations.ほんと好きだな。\nそんな珍しくないだろ？:
You really love cats, huh？
They're not that rare.
translations.……大人くらいの大きさでも？:
...Even when it's the size
of a grown adult？
translations.それ……ほんとにネコか？:
Wait... Was that really
a cat？
translations.白い線から足踏み外したらアウト。\n昔そんな遊びしなかった？:
Step off the white line and
you're out. Didn't you play
that when you were little？
translations.あ、ねえ、あそこの古い建物。\n洋館っていうの？:
Oh, hey, see that old
building？ Is that what you
call a Western mansion？
translations.なんか嫉妬深い少女の霊がいるとかで、\nカップルが前を通り過ぎると\n呪われるん:
They say a jealous girl's
ghost haunts it and curses
couples who walk past.
translations.いいよ、ウソだし。\nアンタって意外と怖がり？:
It's fine, I made it up.
Are you actually a
scaredy-cat？
translations.この道まっすぐ行くと、\nどこにつながってんだろうね。:
I wonder where this road
leads if we keep going
straight.
translations.えっと、駅前だっけ？:
Uh, right in front of
the station, isn't it？
translations.文学？\nえっと……「●たちの未来に\nつながってるんだ！」:
Poetic？
Uh... 'It leads straight to
our future, ●!'
translations.あ……ねえ、\n化粧してる男ってどうなの。:
Oh... Hey, what do you
think of guys who wear
makeup？
translations.ん、ああ、あの人……\nバンドマンか？:
Hm？ Oh, that guy...
Is he in a band？
translations.短絡的。\nまあそれっぽいけど。:
Way to jump to conclusions.
Well, he does look like it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲は否定的なのか？\n好きなミュージシャンに\n化粧してる人いなかった:
Are you against it, ▲小早川＊▲？
Don't some of the musicians
you like wear makeup？
translations.いるけど……\nそれとこれとは全然違うっつーの。:
Yeah, but...
that and this are two
totally different things.
translations.▲小早川＊▲くらいなら、\n乗れそうだな。:
Someone your size could
probably ride it, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.また外でイチャイチャ\nしてるカップルがいる……。:
There's another couple
being all lovey-dovey in
public...
translations.うわ、ほんとだ……。\nでも“また”って？:
Whoa, you're right...
Wait, what do you mean,
'another'？
translations.最近よく遭遇する気がする。\nはあ、風紀の乱れだね。:
I feel like I keep running into
them lately. Ugh, morals really
are going downhill.
translations.じゃ、▲小早川＊▲は\n外でイチャイチャしない派か。\n……そうだっけ？:
Guess ▲小早川＊▲'s against
being lovey-dovey in public.
...Wait, are you？
translations.ショーウィンドウの\nマネキンが動いたように見えて……。:
It looked like that mannequin in
the display window just moved...
translations.ああもう、いいから。\n早く行くよ。:
Ugh, never mind!
Come on, let's just go.
translations.今、ギターの音聞こえなかった？\nどこかで練習してるのかな。:
Didn't you hear a guitar just now？
Wonder if someone's practicing.
translations.リンコも久しぶりに\n触ってみよっかな……。:
Maybe I'll try picking mine up
again after all this time...
translations.ああ、持ってるんだっけ。: Oh right, you own one, huh.
translations.うん、持ってるだけだけど。\nはあ、触るとまた凹むかな……。:
Yeah, I just own it, though.
*Sigh* Playing it'll probably
just bum me out again...
translations.白馬の王子様ねえ……。: A prince on a white horse, huh...
translations.ん？ ああ、広告か。\n「あなただけの\n白馬の王子様、紹介します」\nすごいキ:
Hm？ Oh, that ad.
"Meet your very own
prince on a white horse."
Quite the slogan, huh.
translations.なんで白馬なんだろ？:
Why does it have to be
a white horse, anyway？
translations.さあ、かっこいい\nからじゃないのか。:
Who knows？ Probably just
because it looks cool.
translations.だったら虎とかの方がかっこよくない？\nホワイトタイガーに乗った王子様。:
Wouldn't a tiger be cooler, then？
A prince riding a white tiger.
translations.かっこいいけど、怖いな……。:
It'd be cool, sure,
but also terrifying...
translations.そろそろ坂道だな。: Coming up on the hill soon.
translations.坂道歩いてるとさ、\n岩が転がってくる想像しない？:
When you're walking up a hill,
don't you ever picture a giant
boulder rolling down at you？
translations.相変わらず物騒だな。:
Your mind goes to dangerous
places, as usual.
translations.そう？ 楽しそうじゃん。\nエンタテインメントだよ。:
Really？ Sounds fun to me.
It's pure entertainment.
translations.よくＣＭでさ、\n仲の良い夫婦が手をつないで\n歩くシーンあるじゃん。:
You know how commercials always
have scenes of happy couples
walking around holding hands？
translations.言ってないっつーの。\nアンタがそうしたいなら、\n別にいいけど。:
I didn't ask to!
I mean, if you want to,
I don't mind.
translations.どうした？\nそんな怖そうな犬じゃないだろ？:
What's wrong？
That dog doesn't look
all that scary, does it？
translations.あれはリンコと\n相性が悪い顔だよ。\nあーいうのに近づくと\nロクなことになら:
It's got the face of a dog
I don't get along with.
Nothing good ever happens
when I go near ones like that.
translations.この先にさ、\n通行人に必ず吠える犬がいるよね。:
There's that dog up ahead that
always barks at anyone passing by.
translations.ああ、繋がれてるけど、\n今にも飛びかかって\nきそうなんだよな。:
Yeah. It's chained up,
but it always looks ready
to pounce at any second.
translations.あの鎖がいつ切れるか心配で。\nそうなったら、助けてよ？:
I'm always worried that chain's
gonna snap. If it does,
you'll save me, right？
translations.ありがと。\nリンコが逃げ切れるように、\n十分引きつけといて。:
Thanks.
Just keep it busy long enough
for me to get away.
translations.昔、小さい頃さ、\nポテチって葉っぱだと\n思ってたんだよね。:
Back when I was little,
I used to think potato chips
were actually leaves.
translations.形が葉っぱみたいじゃん。\nだからああいう状態で\n木になってるって……。:
They're shaped like leaves, right？
So I thought they just grew
on trees like that...
translations.はは、色んな味の木があるわけだ。:
Haha, so there'd be trees
for all the different flavors.
translations.そ、コンソメとかのりしおとか。\n子供ってよくそんなこと思いつくよね。:
Right, like consomme or seaweed
salt. Kids sure come up with
the weirdest ideas.
translations.移動は無駄な時間だけど、\n散歩には意味があるって\n言ってた人がいてさ。:
Someone once said that traveling
is just wasted time, but going
for a walk has meaning.
translations.移動は目的地に行くためのものだけど。\n散歩は歩くことそのものに\n意味があるわ:
Getting somewhere is just about
the destination. With a walk,
walking itself is the point.
translations.なるほど、そうだな。\n散歩はそれ自体が楽しかったり、\n休憩だったりするもんな:
I see, you have a point.
A walk can be fun in itself,
or a nice way to take a break.
translations.そ、だから今は散歩。\nほら、なんか楽しい話してよ。:
Yep, so this is a walk.
Come on, talk about something fun.
translations.あ、路上で占いやってる。\nやってく？:
Oh, a street fortune-teller.
Want to give it a try？
translations.いいよ別に、興味ないし。\nそれよりさ。:
I'm good, I'm not interested.
Besides...
translations.雑誌とかテレビならともかく、\nああいう客の顔を見ながらする占いって、\nやっぱ:
Magazines and TV are one thing,
but face-to-face like that,
wouldn't it be better for business
to only tell them good things？
translations.あるいは逆に不安をあおって\n商売に結び付けるとかね。:
Or go the other way and stir up
their anxieties to make a sale.
translations.大丈夫？\n前見て歩かないから。:
Are you okay？
That's what you get for not
watching where you're going.
translations.枝が飛び出てたのか。\n気付かなかった。:
A branch was sticking out, huh.
I didn't notice.
translations.リンコに見とれてるからじゃないの。\nちゃーんと前向いて\n歩かないとね。:
Probably too busy staring at me.
You need to look straight ahead
when you walk.
translations.この先を曲がるとさ、\nノラ猫たちの集会場があるって\n知ってた？:
Did you know there's a hangout
for stray cats just around
the corner up ahead？
translations.へえ、そんなのがあるんだ。\n行かなくていいのか？:
Oh, really？
Are you sure you don't want to go？
translations.いいよ。\n邪魔しちゃ悪いから、\nときどき遠くからながめるだけ。:
I'm fine.
I'd feel bad intruding, so I just
watch from a distance sometimes.
translations.そう。\nプライベートに踏み込んだら\n悪いでしょ。:
Yeah.
It wouldn't be right to invade
their privacy, would it？
translations.デートマニュアルみたいなの\n参考にしたりする？:
Do you ever use things like
dating guides for reference？
translations.あー……たまにチラッと\n見たりはするかもな。:
Uh... I might take a quick peek
at them every now and then.
translations.チラ見くらいならいいけどさ、\n大事なのはオリジナリティだよね？:
A quick peek is fine,
but originality is what really
matters, right？
translations.一瞬、\n財布落としたのかと思った。:
For a second there,
I thought I dropped my wallet.
translations.うん。ねえ、\nリンコが物落とさないように、\nずっと注意しててよ。:
Yeah. Hey,
keep an eye on me the whole time
so I don't drop anything.
translations.いいけど……\nまずは自分で気をつけてな。:
I don't mind, but...
try being careful yourself first.
translations.世の中には自分に似てる人が\n３人はいるって言うよね。:
They say everyone has three
look-alikes out there in the world.
translations.よく聞く話だけど\n実際に会ったことはないな。:
You hear that a lot,
but I've never actually met mine.
translations.でもほら、あそこに\nリンコそっくりの女の子が……。:
Still, look over there.
That girl looks just like me...
translations.冗談だっつーの。\nなんでそんなに食いつくかな。:
I was kidding, geez.
Why'd you jump on that so fast？
translations.（そりゃ見てみたいだろ～）: (Of course I'd want to see that!)
translations.ねえ、楽器弾く\n女子ってどう思う？:
Hey, what do you think of girls
who play musical instruments？
translations.楽器っていっても色々あるけど……\nいいよな、清楚だったり、\nかっこよかったり:
Depends on the instrument,
but it's nice. It can look
graceful, or really cool.
translations.……いい。\nあんな絶望感は\n一度味わえば十分。:
...I'll pass.
Tasting that kind of despair
once in my life was plenty.
translations.最近、ジャンケンが弱く\nなったような気がする。:
Lately, I feel like I've
gotten worse at
rock-paper-scissors.
translations.ジャンケンの強さって\nなんなんだろうな……。:
What even makes someone good
at rock-paper-scissors...
translations.……やっぱやめた。\nここでまた負けたら、\nさらに自信喪失するから。:
...Actually, never mind.
If I lose again here, I'll
lose even more confidence.
translations.そろそろイヤフォン替えたいんだよね。\nたまに調子悪くって。:
I wanna get new earphones
soon. Mine act up sometimes.
translations.どんなの買うか決めてる？:
Have you decided what kind
to get？
translations.ううん、まだ。\nお父さんがそういうの\n詳しいんだけどさ……。:
No, not yet.
My dad knows a lot about
that stuff, though...
translations.やだ。\n詳し過ぎて、話長いんだもん。:
No way.
He knows too much, so he'll
go on about it forever.
translations.ねえ。手相見せて？: Hey, let me read your palm？
translations.▲小早川＊▲、\nそんな特技あったのか。:
▲小早川＊▲, I didn't know
you had a talent for that.
translations.自己流。\n図書室で手相の本読んだら、\n意外に面白くてさ。:
I'm self-taught.
I read a library book on it,
and it was pretty neat.
translations.うん、これはリンコから\n離れられない相が出てるね。\n……へへ。:
Yep, this line says you'll
never be able to leave me.
...Hehe.
translations.太陽って東から昇るよね？\nもし西から昇ったら\nどうなると思う？:
The sun rises in the east,
right？ What if it rose in
the west instead？
translations.どうなるって……。\n太陽が東に沈むように\nなるんじゃないか？:
What would happen...?
Wouldn't it just set in
the east instead？
translations.そりゃそうだけど……。\nもっとなんかないの？\n大変なことになるよ!?:
Well, obviously...
Isn't there anything else？
It'd be a huge deal!？
translations.そうだな……\nひょっとしたら\n左利きの人が増えるかも！:
Let's see...
Maybe there'd be more
left-handed people!
translations.（わかるような、\nわからんような……）:
(I kind of get it, and
I kind of don't...)
translations.こうして歩いてると、\nときどき会話に困るよね。:
When we're walking like this,
it's hard to know what to
talk about sometimes.
translations.●と話す話題が\nないとか……？:
Like we've got nothing to
talk about, ●...？
translations.そうじゃなくて。\n思いつきで変なこと言うのもやだし、\nかといって黙ってて\n:
Not like that. I don't want
to say something weird at
random, but I'd feel bad if
I stayed quiet and bored you.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、\nそんな可愛いこと考えてたのか。:
▲小早川＊▲, you were thinking
about something that cute？
translations.なっ、うるさいっつーの。\nやっぱり話題間違えた。:
Wha-- Shut up already.
I knew I picked a bad topic.
translations.なにがだよ。●、なんかしたか？:
What is？ ●, did I
do something？
translations.こうやって並んで歩いてるとさ、\n見下ろされるわけじゃん、\nなんかヤだ。:
Walking side by side like
this, you're looking down at
me, right？ I don't like that.
translations.しょうがないだろ。\n身長差があるんだから。:
Can't really help that.
There's a height difference.
translations.納得できない。\n今日は膝曲げて歩いてみてよ。:
I can't accept that. Try
walking on bent knees today.
translations.だって、そしたらアンタに\n見下ろされて歩かなくても\nいいじゃん。逆にはるか\:
Then I wouldn't have to walk
with you looking down at me.
I'd look down on you from
way up in the sky instead.
translations.しょうがないだろ、身長差は。\n……でもそうなると\nスカートはけないな？:
Can't help the height gap.
...Though then you wouldn't
be able to wear a skirt, huh？
translations.やっぱり食事って、\nどこで何を食べるかより、\n誰と食べるかじゃない？:
When it comes to meals, it's
more about who you eat with
than where or what, right？
translations.家族とか、恋人とか？:
Like with family, or a
special someone？
translations.そう。\n大切な人と一緒なら、\nファミレスだって充分だよ。:
Yeah.
If I'm with someone special,
even a family restaurant is
more than enough.
translations.お、ファミレス\n馬鹿にすんなよ？:
Hey, don't look down on
family restaurants.
translations.はいはい。\nとにかくさ、アンタと一緒の\n食事って結構嫌いじゃないよ。:
Yeah, yeah.
Anyway, eating out with you
really isn't so bad.
translations.あれ、サッカーボール？: Huh？ Is that a soccer ball？
translations.すいませーん。\n取ってもらえますかー!?:
Excuse me!
Could you get that for me!？
translations.ケータイの待ち受けって、何にしてる？:
What do you use for your
phone wallpaper？
translations.ふーん、\nリンコの写真だったりして？:
Hmm, don't tell me
it's a picture of me？
translations.さーね。\n▲小早川＊▲こそ、\n●の写真じゃねーの!?:
Who knows.
What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Isn't yours a photo of ●!？
translations.残念、\n日替わりでネコの写真だよ。:
Too bad.
It's a different cat photo
every day.
translations.外には危険がいっぱいだよ。:
There's danger all over
the place out here.
translations.物が落ちてきたり飛んできたり、\n暴漢に襲われたり、\n車や自転車も。:
Falling or flying objects,
getting attacked by thugs,
cars and bikes...
translations.このカレシはどれくらい\nの危険から守って\nくれんのかなーって。:
Just wondering how much
danger this boyfriend of mine
can protect me from.
translations.あ、恋人つなぎ。:
Oh, they're holding hands
like lovers.
translations.姉妹かな。\n仲いいね。:
Maybe they're sisters.
They seem close.
translations.リンコもさ、\n弟と手つないで歩くの\n好きなんだよね。:
I actually like walking
hand in hand with my little
brother, too.
translations.悪い。\nちょっと速かったな。:
Sorry.
I was walking a little fast.
translations.いいよ、ゆっくり行こう。:
It's fine,
let's take it slow.
translations.ね。今朝の\n天気予報どうだっけ？:
Hey, what did the weather
forecast say this morning？
translations.どうだったかな……\nこの空模様だと\nまだ大丈夫だと思うけど。:
Good question...
Looking at the sky, I think
we're still okay for now.
translations.もし降ったら一緒に雨宿り\nするのも悪くないかもよ。:
If it rains, waiting it out
together wouldn't be so bad.
translations.うん……いいかも。\nむしろ降ってくれても\nいいかな。へへ。:
Yeah... that sounds nice.
Actually, I wouldn't mind
if it rained. Hehe.
translations.べつに悪いことしてる\nわけじゃないし、\n見つかってもいいんじゃないか？:
It's not like we're doing
anything wrong, so who cares
if we're seen？
translations.あ、そっか。\nなんか条件反射で。:
Oh, right.
Guess it was just a reflex.
translations.わっ！\n……スピード出し過ぎだっつーの。\n蹴ってやる！:
Whoa!
...Way too fast, seriously.
I oughta kick 'em!
translations.そんな睨むなって。\n怖い人だったらどうするんだよ。:
Don't glare like that.
What if it's someone scary？
translations.別にそんなの……\nあれ、なんかこんなやり取りあったっけ。:
Like I care...
Huh, didn't we have this
exact conversation before？
translations.ああ、付き合う前か。\nゲーセンでな。:
Yeah, before we started
dating. At the arcade.
translations.すぐ曲がっちゃった。\nチョンマゲで刀差してたよ。:
He just turned the corner.
Had a topknot and a sword.
translations.撮影か？\nにしても周りに\nそんな人いないし……。:
Shooting a movie？
Though I don't see anyone
else like that around...
translations.久しぶりにちゃんと\nＪ－ＰＯＰ聴いてみた。:
I gave J-pop a real listen
for the first time in ages.
translations.まさか。\nリンコの側からの\n歩み寄りってやつ。:
As if.
Just me trying to meet
halfway for once.
translations.お父さんがすすめて\nくれただけあって、悪くなかったけど、\nボーカルがね……\:
My dad recommended it,
so it wasn't half bad,
but the vocals...
were kind of wimpy...
translations.親が海外出張のお土産に\nぬいぐるみ買ってきたんだよね。:
My folks got me a plushie
from a business trip abroad.
translations.▲小早川＊▲にぬいぐるみ？\nああ、ネコ？:
A plushie for you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Oh, is it a cat？
translations.ううん。現地の民話を元にした\n魔除けのぬいぐるみだってさ。\nなんの動物かもわ:
Nope. A plushie that wards
off evil in local folklore.
No idea what animal it is,
and I wake up feeling awful.
translations.リンコとデートしてて、\n楽しい？:
Do you have fun
going out with me？
translations.当たり前だろ、\nなんで今更。:
Of course I do.
Why ask that now？
translations.へへ、たまに聞きたくなんの。\n定時確認ってやつ。:
Hehe, I just like to ask
sometimes. A routine check.
translations.すごい、魔法少女がいる。\nほら、あの女の子。:
Whoa, a magical girl.
Look at that little girl.
translations.おー、なりきりセットってやつか。\nステッキまで持って。:
Oh, a little dress-up set.
She's even got the wand.
translations.んー、可愛いなあ。\n弟も可愛いけど、妹もいいかも。:
Mm, she's so cute.
My little brother's cute, but
a sister might be nice too.
translations.ほんと可愛いな、\nひらっひらのふりっふりでさ。:
Yeah, super cute.
All frilly and fluttery.
translations.……忘れてた、\nロリコンだっけ。:
...Right, I forgot.
You're into little girls.
translations.“とわの市の怪人”の話、\n知ってる？:
Have you heard about
the 'Phantom of Towano'？
translations.そんなとこ。\n仮面とマント姿で\n近所を徘徊してるって。:
Pretty much.
They say someone in a mask
and cape roams the streets.
translations.さあ？\n運よく会えると、\nアメちゃんくれるんだって。:
Who knows？
If you're lucky enough to meet
them, you get a piece of candy.
translations.ね。男ってさ、\nなんで膝枕好きなの？:
Hey. Why do guys like
lap pillows so much？
translations.男がみんなそうって\nことはないだろうけど、\nまあ、憧れるよな。:
Maybe not every guy,
but yeah, it's definitely
something we dream about.
translations.ふーん、クラスの男子が\n盛り上がってたんだよね。\n……そっか。:
Hmm. The guys in my class
were all hyped up about it.
...I see.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲が膝枕？\nまさかな……）:
(A lap pillow from ▲小早川＊▲？
No way...)
translations.水たまり見つけると、\n無性に跳んでみたくならない？:
When you see a puddle, don't
you just wanna jump in it？
translations.子供扱いすんなっつーの。\nジジイ！:
Quit treating me like a kid！
Old man！
translations.友達がさ、最近デートが\nマンネリだって、\nカレシのこと愚痴ってた。:
My friend was venting about
her boyfriend, saying their
dates are in a rut lately.
translations.マンネリ……か。\n▲小早川＊▲もそう思う？:
In a rut, huh...
Do you think we are, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.別に。\nそれって必ずしも\n悪い事じゃないし。:
Not really.
That's not necessarily
a bad thing, anyway.
translations.慣れてきた、ってことじゃないの。\nそれはそれで、\n次のステージって感じするし:
It just means you're used to
each other. In a way, that
feels like the next stage.
translations.あそこの竹ヤブ。\nいつも真っ暗でさ、\n小さい頃は恐くて、いつも\n走って通り:
That bamboo grove over there.
It's always so dark. I was
scared of it as a kid, so I'd
always run right past it.
translations.高校生だっつーの。: Come on, I'm in high school.
translations.夜だったら、\nわかんないけど……。:
Though if it were night,
I'm not so sure...
translations.目線の高さが\n変わったことに気付くと、\n成長を感じるよね。:
When you notice your eye
level's changed, you really
feel like you've grown, huh.
translations.こういう塀もさ、\n小さい頃はすごく\n高く感じたな……。:
Walls like this one, too...
They felt so tall back
when I was little...
translations.聞こえてるんですけど心の声。:
I can hear your inner voice,
you know.
translations.……今すれ違った人が\n聴いてた曲、\nキラーバンビーズだ。:
...The song that person we
just passed was listening to
is by the Killer Bambies.
translations.音漏れだけでよくわかるな。:
Impressive you can tell just
from the sound leaking out.
translations.●も▲小早川＊▲の\n声だったら音漏れだけでも\nわかる自信があるけどな。:
Still, ● could definitely
tell ▲小早川＊▲'s voice just
from the sound leaking, too.
translations.そこ通った女の人。\n舞踏会って感じのドレスだった。:
The woman who just passed.
Her dress looked like it
belonged at a ball.
translations.うん、なんかベルサイユ！\nって感じだった。:
Yeah, it was like, total
Versailles!
translations.（何のイベントがあるんだろ……）:
(Wonder what kind of event
is going on...)
translations.デートってさ、歩くよね。:
You end up walking a lot
on dates, huh.
translations.わかる。なんで\nこんなに歩いてんだろ、\nって思うことあるよな。:
I know. Sometimes you wonder
why you're walking around
so much.
translations.別にイヤなわけじゃ\nないんだけどね。:
Not that I mind it
or anything, though.
translations.これもデートの一部だもんな。:
It's all part of the date,
after all.
translations.そうそう。じゃあリンコたちも\nサクサク歩きますか。:
Yep. Well then, shall we
keep moving along too？
translations.黒塗りの高級車って\n威圧感あるね。:
Those black luxury cars
are pretty intimidating.
translations.ああ、止まってるな。\n社長！ って感じの車が。:
Yeah, there's one parked.
Screams 'company president!'
translations.いつかああいう車\n蹴ってみたいな。:
I kind of want to kick
a car like that someday.
translations.なんかこうスカっとしそうじゃん。\n反体制、って感じで。:
Seems like it'd feel great,
you know？ It's very
anti-establishment.
translations.（危ない……まあさすがに\n実際はやんないと思うけど）:
(Whoa... Well, I doubt she'd
actually do it for real.)
translations.迷い猫のポスター、\n貼ってあったね。:
There was a lost cat poster
put up back there.
translations.ああ……\nあ、また貼ってある。\n飼い主は必死で\n探してるんだろうな。:
Yeah... Oh, there's another
one. The owner must be
frantically looking for it.
translations.どうかこの子が無事に\n飼い主さんのところに\n戻れますように！:
I hope this little kitty
makes it back to its owner
safe and sound!
translations.あのベビーカーの\n赤ちゃん、可愛い。:
That baby in the stroller
is really cute.
translations.お、ほんとだ。\n笑ってる。:
Oh, you're right.
Look at that smile.
translations.いいな～、赤ちゃん。\nお父さんとお母さん、\n子供作んないのかな。:
Babies are so nice...
I wonder if my dad and mom
will ever have another kid.
translations.それはいいよ、\n困らせちゃうかもしれないし。:
Nah, I'll pass.
It might just put them
on the spot.
translations.ぼんやりしてるから。:
That's what you get for
spacing out.
translations.……あーあ、靴が\nちょっと濡れちゃったよ。:
...Aw man, my shoes got
a little wet.
translations.カノジョに夢中になるのも\nいいけどさ、ちゃんと\n前見て歩きなって。:
Being crazy about your
girlfriend is nice and all,
but look where you're going.
translations.あ、新刊出てたんだ。: Oh, the new book is out.
translations.ああ、本屋のポップか。\nベストセラー作家じゃん、\nああいうのも読むんだ？:
Oh, the bookstore display？
That's a bestselling author.
You read that stuff too？
translations.まあ一応。\nおさえとく感じで。:
Well, more or less.
Just to keep up with what's
out there.
translations.さすが図書委員だな！:
Spoken like a true
library committee member!
translations.アンタもだっつーの。:
You're on the committee too,
you know.
translations.あの人だかりなにかな？:
I wonder what that crowd's
all about？
translations.……カメラもあるな。\nドラマの撮影か何かだろ。:
...There are cameras, too.
Probably filming a TV drama
or something.
translations.この辺りでも\nそんなのやってるんだ。:
I didn't know they filmed
stuff like that around here.
translations.別にいい。\nみっともないし。:
No, I'm good.
Gawking like that is tacky.
translations.今の子、友達だよな？:
That girl just now is a
friend of yours, right？
translations.そのわりには素っ気なかったな。:
You were pretty short with
her for a friend.
translations.仲はいい方だけど。\nアンタといるとこ\n見られると……さ。:
We're actually pretty close.
It's just, being seen with
you is a little... you know.
translations.さっき楽器屋に\n飾ってあったギター、\nずっと見てたな？:
You were really staring at
that guitar on display at
the music shop earlier, huh？
translations.うん、Ｇｏｄ．Ｍｔモデル。\n本人が使ってたギターを完全再現したやつ。:
Yeah, it's a God.Mt model.
An exact replica of the one
he actually used.
translations.へえ、そういうのもあるんだ。\nやっぱ欲しいもの？:
Huh, I didn't know they made
those. Do you want it？
translations.高くて買えないし。\nそもそもリンコが\n持っててもしょうがないよ。:
It's way too expensive.
Besides, there's no point in
me owning one anyway.
translations.まあ弾かないとな。: True, you'd have to play it.
translations.でもあの店の前通るときは、\n必ずガン見してこっと。:
Still, every time I pass by
that shop, I'm definitely
gonna stop and stare at it.
translations.（どこかで聞いた話だな……）:
(Feels like I've heard this
story somewhere before...)
translations.最近多いな。\n近くにマンションも建ったし、\nそれでか。変化が速いな……。:
There've been a lot lately.
Must be because of that new
apartment building. Things
sure change fast...
translations.まあ便利になってくれるなら、\nそれでいいけどね。:
Well, as long as it makes
things more convenient,
it's fine by me.
translations.自分が住んでた街が\n変わっちゃうのって、\n寂しかったりしない？:
Doesn't it make you a little
sad seeing your hometown
change like this？
translations.だからってそれで思い出が\n消えるわけじゃないじゃん。\nだからいーよ。:
It's not like that makes my
memories disappear or
anything. So I don't mind.
translations.引っ越し屋だ。\nそこのマンションかな。:
Movers. Wonder if they're
for that apartment building.
translations.そう。親の話だと\nあそこのマンション、\n若い夫婦が多いみたい。:
Yeah. From what my parents
said, a lot of young couples
live in that building.
translations.若い夫婦か。\nじゃあそのうち赤ちゃんも増えてきて、\nうるさくなるのかもな。:
Young couples, huh.
Guess there'll be lots of
babies soon. Might get
pretty noisy.
translations.うわ、\n夜泣きとか大変そう……。:
Ugh, dealing with crying
at night sounds rough...
translations.リンコ調べだけどさ。\n頭をなでられるのが\n好きな女子って多いみたい。:
From my own research,
it seems a lot of girls like
having their heads patted.
translations.ふーん、男子からすると\n結構勇気のいる行動だけどな。:
Hmm. Takes a lot of nerve
for a guy to actually do
that, though.
translations.まあ誰にでも\nされたいことじゃないだろうね。:
Well, it's not like they want
just anyone doing it.
translations.だな。ところで\nその女子の中に\n▲小早川＊▲は入ってる？:
True. By the way, does that
include you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.さーね。\nリンコはいわゆる一般女子の\n範疇には収まりたくないので。:
Who knows.
I'd rather not fit into the
ordinary-girl category.
translations.（じゃあ▲小早川＊▲は\n特殊女子か……）:
(So ▲小早川＊▲ is in the
special-girl category...？)
translations.目の前を虫が\n横切ったから、ちょっと。:
A bug just flew right
in front of my eyes,
that's all.
translations.ああ、苦手だっけ？:
Oh, right. You're not
good with bugs？
translations.苦手っていうより嫌い。\nそうじゃなくても、\nいきなり目の前横切られたら、\n:
More like I hate them.
And even if I didn't, having
one fly right in front of me
would startle anyone.
translations.女って不利だと思わない？:
Don't you think girls are
at a disadvantage？
translations.いきなりだな、どうした？:
Where'd that come from？
What's up？
translations.デートの準備に手間とか\n時間がかかるじゃん。\n服とか髪とか、あと色々……。:
Getting ready for a date
takes so much time and effort.
Clothes, hair, all of that...
translations.ふーん、たしかに大変だな！:
Huh, yeah, that does sound
like a lot of work!
translations.誰のせいだっつーの！:
And whose fault do you
think that is!?
translations.オープンカーが止まってる。:
There's a convertible
parked over there.
translations.ほんとだ。\nあれ、\n中まる見えじゃないのか。:
You're right.
Wait, can't people see
right inside it？
translations.防犯とかどうなってるんだろ。:
I wonder how security
works on a car like that.
translations.天気にも左右されるしな。:
Plus you're at the mercy
of the weather.
translations.かっこいいけど、\n苦労が多そうな車だね。:
It looks cool, but it seems
like a lot of trouble.
translations.可愛いのに苦労が多い\nカノジョみたいなもん？:
Kind of like a girlfriend
who's cute, but a lot of
trouble？
translations.うまいこと言った\nつもりかっつーの！:
Oh, you think you're
so clever, don't you!?
translations.カノジョへの気づかいはさ、\n相手に気付かれないぐらい\nさりげないのがいいよね:
Being considerate to your
girlfriend is best when it's
so subtle she doesn't notice.
translations.結構自然と\n車道側に寄ったりするよね、\nアンタってさ。:
You always naturally move
to the street side when
we walk, don't you？
translations.そう？ はは、なんか照れるな。:
I do？ Haha, now I feel
kind of bashful.
translations.調子にのるなっつーの。\nリンコが気付いちゃったから失格。\n気付かれないように:
Don't let it get to your head.
You failed since I noticed.
Do it without me noticing.
translations.ちょっとつまづいただけだって。\n心配し過ぎ。:
I just stumbled a little.
You worry too much.
translations.ちゃんと前を見て\n歩かないから……うわっ。:
That's 'cause you're not
watching where you're...
Whoa!
translations.お互い、気をつけないとね。:
Looks like we both need
to be careful.
translations.子供のときって、\n歩きながら歌ったりした？:
Did you ever sing while
walking when you were
a kid？
translations.あー、あったかもな。\n▲小早川＊▲は？:
Yeah, I think I did.
What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.覚えてないけど、\nちっちゃい頃は\n割とよく歌ってたらしいよ。:
I don't remember, but they
say I used to sing a lot
when I was little.
translations.へー。まさか、\nその頃からパンク？:
Huh. Don't tell me it was
punk rock back then too？
translations.まさか。\nママが教えてくれた童謡とか、\nそのとき観てたアニメの歌だって。:
Of course not. It was nursery
rhymes my mom taught me, or
theme songs from anime.
translations.大丈夫か？\nったくスピード出し過ぎだろ！:
Are you okay？
Jeez, they were going
way too fast!
translations.いいよ別に。……もう、\nアンタが先に怒っちゃったら、\nリンコが怒れないじゃん:
It's fine. ...Geez, if you
get mad first, then I don't
get a chance to.
translations.あ……携帯の\n充電してなかったかも。:
Oh... I might've forgotten
to charge my phone.
translations.切れそう？\nショップ探して充電するか？:
Is it about to die？
Should we find a place
to charge it？
translations.……別にいいや。\n切れたら切れたで。:
...Nah, it's fine.
If it dies, it dies.
translations.うん、アンタと一緒にいるんだから、\nアンタから連絡くることはないでしょ。\nだ:
Yeah. I'm already with you,
so it's not like you're
gonna call me. It's fine.
translations.あそこの本屋、\n閉まっちゃうんだ。:
That bookstore over there
is closing down.
translations.個人じゃ大型店には\nかなわないよな。:
Small shops really can't
compete with the big chains.
translations.大きい本屋は便利だけどさ、\n小さい店の雰囲気も\n嫌いじゃないんだけどね……。:
Big bookstores are handy,
sure, but I kind of like the
feel of small shops too...
translations.あ……なんか良い匂い。\n焼きたてのパン……かな。:
Oh... Something smells good.
Freshly baked bread, maybe.
translations.ああ、移動販売の車だ。\n結構人気みたいだな。:
Oh, it's a bakery van.
Looks pretty popular.
translations.この漂ってくる甘い香り。\n人気になるのもわかるよ。:
With this sweet smell
drifting over, I can see
why it's so popular.
translations.……うーん……\n並んでるし、いいや。\nまた今度。:
...Hmm...
There's a line, so I'll pass.
Maybe next time.
translations.ああ、子供が\n靴飛ばしてただけか。:
Oh, it's just some kids
kicking their shoes off.
translations.混ざってきたら？\nたまにはジジイも童心に\nかえりたいんじゃない？:
Why don't you join in？
Even an old man wants to feel
like a kid sometimes, right？
translations.一歳違いだけどな！:
I'm only a year older
than you!
translations.なんだろ、\n人だかりが出来てる。:
Wonder what's going on.
There's a crowd over there.
translations.スーパーの大安売り？:
A big sale at the
supermarket？
translations.なんだ。それにしても\n主婦のパワーはすごいね。:
Oh, is that it. Still,
housewives sure are intense.
translations.▲小早川＊▲だって、\n主婦になるかもしれないぞ？:
You might end up a housewife
someday too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……無理。\n少なくともあそこには\n入っていけない。:
...No way.
At the very least, I could
never jump into that crowd.
translations.歩きながら\n本読んでる人がいる、\n器用だね。:
Someone's reading a book
while walking.
That takes skill.
translations.本は落ち着いて読みたいけど、\n現代の忙しさを考えると、\nたしかに何かしながら:
I'd rather sit and read,
but with how busy life is now,
multitasking like that is
kind of unavoidable.
translations.▲小早川＊▲も、\nよく音楽聴きながら本読むよな。:
You read while listening to
music a lot too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.あれは基本。でさ、\nその曲聴くと本の内容を連想したり、\n逆に本のタイトル見か:
That's just the basics.
Later, the song reminds me of
the book, or the title gets
the song stuck in my head.
It's pretty fun.
translations.親と一緒にいるところを\n友達に見られたくない\n時期ってあった？:
Did you ever have a phase
where you didn't want friends
seeing you with your parents？
translations.あー、小学校高学年とか、\nあったかもな。:
Hmm, maybe around the end
of grade school.
translations.あーいうのも“はしか”\nみたいなもんなのかな。\nいつの間にか治ってるんだけど:
Wonder if that's like getting
the measles or something.
It goes away before you
even realize it, though.
translations.独立心の目覚め、\nみたいなもんなのかな？:
Maybe it's like the first
sign of independence？
translations.そうかもね。\n“自分は一人でも平気だ！”\nみたいな、そんなわけないのにさ。:
Could be. Like, 'I can make it
all on my own!' Even though
that's obviously not true.
translations.あの軽自動車、かわいい。\nイギリスのだっけ？:
That little car is cute.
Isn't it British？
translations.そこまで車に興味ないけど、\n乗るならああいうのかな。:
I don't care much about cars,
but if I had to drive one,
maybe something like that.
translations.へえ。なんとなく、\nかっこいいのが\n好きだと思ってた。:
Huh. For some reason,
I figured you'd go for
something cooler.
translations.あれくらい愛嬌\nある方がいいって。\nそれに英国産ってのがいいよね。:
It's better when they have
a little charm like that.
Plus, I like that it's British.
translations.道路工事してるんだ、\n通れるかな。:
They're doing roadwork.
Think we can get through？
translations.いけるみたいだけど、\n泥になってるな。\n遠回りするか？:
Looks like we can,
but it's pretty muddy.
Want to take a detour？
translations.いいよ、気をつけて歩くから。\nなんならおんぶしてみる？:
It's fine, I'll watch my step.
Or do you want to give me
a piggyback ride？
translations.えっ!?\nうーん、まあ▲小早川＊▲が\n恥ずかしくないなら……。:
Huh!?
Well, I guess if it wouldn't
embarrass you, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.恥ずかしいに決まってるじゃん。\n冗談だってば。:
Of course it'd be embarrassing.
I was only kidding.
translations.この先の道でさ、\n人面猫が見つかったらしいよ？:
Apparently someone spotted a cat
with a human face up the road.
translations.人面……\n▲小早川＊▲には悪いけど、\nさすがにちょっと気持ち悪いな。:
A human face...
Sorry, ▲小早川＊▲, but that
sounds pretty creepy.
translations.いや、さすがにリンコも\n可愛いとは思えないから……。:
No, even I wouldn't find
something like that cute...
translations.想像しちゃったじゃん、\nこわ……。:
Great, now I pictured it.
Creepy...
translations.ほんとだって！\n……あれ、なんだ、風船か。:
I'm serious!
...Wait, oh. It's just a balloon.
translations.ほらね。\nそれにＵＦＯって\n悪い思い出があって嫌い。:
See？
Besides, I have bad memories
of UFOs. I hate them.
translations.昔お父さんとケンカしたとき、\n秘蔵のレコードを窓から「ＵＦＯ！」\nって投げた:
Once, during a fight with my dad,
I yelled "UFO!" and threw his prized
record out the window. He was furious.
translations.リンコたちって、\n普通に歩き過ぎなのかな。:
Do you think we walk
too normally together？
translations.もっと恋人っぽい歩き方って\nいうのがあるんじゃないの？:
Isn't there a way to walk
that's more like a couple？
translations.（自分が言い出したんじゃないか～）: (You're the one who brought it up...)
translations.あ……タマに\n水あげてくるの忘れた。:
Oh... I forgot to water
Tama before I left.
translations.サボテンなら\n平気なんじゃないの？:
It's a cactus, though.
Shouldn't it be fine？
translations.うん、でも一応\nお母さんに電話しとく。:
Yeah, probably, but I'll call
my mom just in case.
translations.そういえばコンビニのおでんってさ、\nいつの間にか年中\n売るようになってない？:
Come to think of it, haven't
convenience stores been selling
oden all year round lately？
translations.そういえば、\n季節感がなくなってるな。:
Now that you mention it,
nothing's really seasonal anymore.
translations.そのうち、冬に\nかき氷なんてのも出てくるかも。:
Before long, they might start
selling shaved ice in the winter.
translations.小学生が集まって\nゲームしてる。:
Some grade-schoolers are
huddled together playing games.
translations.▲小早川＊▲は\n携帯ゲームはやんないのか？:
Do you ever play handheld
games, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.やるけど、外ではあんまり。\nリンコの携帯ゲームは不携帯ゲームだよ。:
I do, just not outside much.
My portables aren't very portable.
translations.足下のオシャレって\n難しいよね。:
Picking out cute shoes
is tricky, isn't it？
translations.だってさ、機能性も\n重視しなきゃじゃん。\nデートって、結構歩くし。:
Well, you have to think
about practicality, too.
We walk a lot on dates.
translations.そういう苦労もあるってこと。:
Just saying, a lot of
thought goes into it.
translations.街頭で配ってるチラシってさ、\n受け取ったら負けって感じがする。:
Flyers people hand out on the
street are a trap. Take one,
and you've already lost.
translations.だってさ、全然興味がなかったらどうすんの？:
I mean, what do you do if
you have zero interest in it？
translations.そうなったらただのゴミじゃん。\nゴミ箱が近くになかったら\n邪魔になるしさ。\:
Then it's just trash.
And if there's no trash can nearby,
you're stuck carrying it around.
That's why I never take them.
translations.情報誌が運営してるサイトでさ、\n恋人同士が手をつないだまま\n目を閉じて横断歩:
A magazine website posted
a superstition that if a
couple crosses the street
holding hands with their
eyes shut, they'll be happy.
translations.うん、だからすぐに\nクレームがきて削除されたんだけどさ。\nそれでかえってカル:
Yeah, they got complaints
right away and took it down.
Instead, that just gave it
a weird cult following.
translations.けが人が出る前に\n廃れることを祈るよ。:
I just hope it dies out
before someone gets hurt.
translations.怪談猫女ってのが\nいるらしいよ。\nよくある都市伝説ってやつ。:
They say there's a ghost
story about a Cat Woman.
Just a typical urban legend.
translations.へえ、\n顔だけ猫の、女の人なのか？:
Huh.
A woman with a cat's face？
translations.ううん、逆。\n体が二足歩行の猫で、\n顔が絶世の美女なんだってさ。:
No, the opposite.
A cat walking on two legs,
with the face of a gorgeous
woman, apparently.
translations.要は、人間が着ぐるみ着て\n被り物だけ脱いだような格好なんだって。:
Basically, it looks like a
person in a cat suit who
just took the headpiece off.
translations.（それ、着ぐるみ着た\nただの美女なんじゃ……）:
(Isn't that just a pretty
girl in a cat suit...？)
translations.あ、行っちゃった。\n残念だったな。:
Aw, it ran off.
Too bad.
translations.いいよ、すぐに懐く子より、\n高潔な感じがして、\nかっこいいよね。:
It's fine. Having some pride
is way cooler than warming
up to people right away.
translations.そういうもの。\nそれが正しい猫のあり方だよ。:
That's how it works.
That's how a proper cat is
supposed to be.
translations.ああいうの見ると、\nちょっと出所を突き止めたくなるね。:
Seeing something like that
kind of makes you want to
track down where it's from.
translations.お、いっとくか？: Oh, wanna go check it out？
translations.……いい。\n昔それやろうとしたけど、\nああいうのって意外に遠くて、\nいつま:
...I'm good.
I tried doing that once, but
things like that are further
than they look. You never
seem to get any closer.
translations.今のリンコたちって\n恋人同士に見えるかな。:
Do you think we look like
a couple right now？
translations.でも友達にさ、\n兄妹みたいって言われた。:
Yeah, well, my friend told
me we look like siblings.
translations.そうか？\nこの歳の兄妹って、\n一緒に出歩いたりしないだろ。:
Really？
Siblings our age wouldn't
hang out like this, though.
translations.そういう問題じゃないっつーの。\nわかってないなあ。:
That's not the point here.
You just don't get it.
translations.デートの日に天気がいいと、\n得した気分になるね。:
Getting nice weather on a
date kind of makes you feel
like you lucked out.
translations.はあ、一気に所帯じみたね。\nリンコは自分で洗濯しないから、\nよくわかんないし:
Ugh, way to make it sound so
domestic all of a sudden.
I don't do my own laundry,
so I wouldn't know.
translations.はは、たまには\nお母さんのこと手伝えって！:
Haha, you should help your
mom out once in a while!
translations.なんか人生の先輩面\nされっぱなしなのも\n悔しいし、考えとく。:
I hate letting you act like
the mature one all the time,
so I'll think about it.
translations.とわの市ってさ、\n道路のゴミ少ない気がしない？\n前住んでたとこと比べてどう？:
Doesn't it seem like there's
hardly any litter in Towano？
How's it compare to where
you used to live？
translations.ああ、言われてみれば、\nそうかも。:
Yeah, now that you mention
it, maybe so.
translations.まあいいことだよね。\n気分もいいし、細かいとこに\n手が行き届いてるのは\n社:
Well, it's a good thing.
It feels nice, and attention
to the little details proves
that society's systems are
working the way they should.
translations.（道路のゴミで\nそこまで考えるか！）:
(Who thinks that deeply
about street litter？！)
translations.うっ……\nなんでチョウチョと蛾で\n受ける印象がこんなに違うんだろ。:
Ugh...
Why do butterflies and moths
leave such completely
different impressions？
translations.そうだな、蛾にとっちゃ\nいい迷惑だな。:
Yeah, kind of unfair to
the moths, really.
translations.「責任者出てこい！」\nってところだね。:
They must be like, "Let me
speak to the manager!"
translations.なんかはしゃいでない？:
Aren't you acting kind
of hyper right now？
translations.▲小早川＊▲が言うなら、\nそうなんだろ。\nよーし、行こうぜっ♪:
Well, if ▲小早川＊▲ says so,
I guess I must be.
All right, let's go♪
translations.さっき、道路に\nチョークの落書きあったね。:
There were chalk doodles
on the road back there.
translations.ああ、久しぶりに見たかも。:
Yeah, it's been a while
since I've seen that.
translations.なんかイタズラ心に\nムラムラくる感じがする！:
It's getting my mischievous
side all worked up!
translations.やるなよ、高校生だぞ、●ら。:
Don't do it. We're in
high school, ●.
translations.わかってるって。\nアンタの顔に落書きさせてよ。\nそれならいいでしょ？:
I know, I know.
Let me doodle on your face.
That's fine, right？
translations.はあ、みんなでおてて合わせていただきますって、幼稚園児かっつーの。毎日毎日……。: Ugh, putting our little hands together before we eat？ What are we, kindergartners？ Every single day...
translations.は？ 生まれたときから小早川ですけど、それが何か？: Huh？ I've been Kobayakawa since the day I was born. What about it？
translations.何ぼけっとしてんの、バッカみたい。: What are you spacing out for？ You look so dumb.
translations.（ここは……小学校の教室？ そっか、ボク、小学生だっけ）: (Is this... an elementary school classroom？ Oh right, I'm in elementary school.)
translations.先週のヴォルヴァヴィン観た？: Did you watch Volvavin last week？
translations.はあ？ ヴォルヴァヴィンって……あのロボットアニメ？: Huh？ Volvavin... You mean that robot anime？
translations.それそれ、やっぱ女子は観ない？: Yeah, that one. I guess girls don't watch it, huh？
translations.女子とか男子とかそういう問題じゃないっつーの。: It's not about being a boy or a girl.
translations.小四にもなってロボットアニメって、ガキすぎ。: Watching robot anime in the fourth grade is way too childish.
translations.それになに？ 女子とか男子って発想がそもそもありえない。じぇんだーってわかる？: Besides, what's with that？ Grouping people into boys and girls is ridiculous to begin with. Do you know what 'gender' is？ 'Gen-der.'
