translations.え？ それは……その……どうせ説明してもわかんないからいい。説明するだけムダ。: Huh？ Well... um... You wouldn't get it even if I explained it, so never mind. It's a waste of time.
translations.（なんか昭和の給食みたいだな……）: (It looks like a school lunch from the Showa era...)
translations.なんでアンタ、さっきからそんなキョドウフシンなの。今更学校の給食なんて珍しくない: Why have you been acting so weird this whole time？ It's not like school lunch is anything new.
translations.そうだよね、毎日食べてるし……。: Right, we eat it every day...
translations.じゃあなんで残してるの？: Then why are you leaving them？
translations.残してない。……食べてないだけ。: I'm not leaving them. ...I'm just not eating them.
translations.？ やっぱ嫌いなんじゃないの？: ？ Doesn't that mean you hate them after all？
translations.違うっつーの。ま・ず・い・か・ら。: No, it doesn't. They. Taste. Bad.
translations.ぜんぜん違う。リンコのは好き嫌いじゃなくて、グルメなの。まずいものは食べないぽり: It's totally different. I'm not being picky, I'm a gourmet. It's my 'policy' not to eat bad food.
translations.なんでも食べる、とか、ただ味覚オンチなだけじゃん。: People who eat anything and everything just have no sense of taste.
translations.そう！ ……そうだ、そんなに気になるならさ、これあげる。: Exactly! ...Oh, I know. If it bothers you that much, you can have them.
translations.いいっていいって、遠慮しないの。ほら、こっそり……。: It's fine, it's fine, don't be shy. Here, before anyone looks...
translations.こら、小早川さん！ また給食残してるの!?: Hey, Kobayakawa! Are you leaving food on your tray again!?
translations.しかも他人に食べさせようとして！: And trying to get someone else to eat it for you, too!
translations.ほら、先生も付き合ってあげるから。ゆっくりでいいから、自分でちゃんと食べようね？: Come on, I'll stay here with you. Take your time, just eat it all yourself, okay？
translations.（へえ、こうしてると年相応でカワイイじゃん……）: (Huh, she's actually pretty cute when she acts her age like this...)
translations.何急に上から目線になってるんだっつーの！: What's with you acting all high and mighty out of nowhere!
translations.（夢か……▲小早川＊▲、小学生からあんな感じだったのかな）: (A dream... I wonder if ▲小早川＊▲ was already like that back in grade school.)
translations.ニューとわのタウンに突如現れた謎の秘密結社デ・キシーズ。不幸のパルスで街のみんな: The mysterious secret society De-Kishis has suddenly appeared in New Towano Town! With their Pulse of Misfortune, has everyone in town gone unlucky!?
translations.対するりんこは……以下略♪ はぴかむりんこセカンドシーズン、今日も開運、はぴかむ: Standing against them is Rinko... yadda yadda♪ It's Happy-Come Rinko Season 2! Bringing good luck again today, Happy-Come Rinkle~♪
translations.なんだ？ はぴかむりんこ？ それって前に観た……。: What the？ Happy-Come Rinko？ Isn't that what I saw before...
translations.お、すげー！ ほんとにはぴかむりんこだ！: Whoa, awesome! It really is Happy-Come Rinko!
translations.もちろんよ！ みんなの開運、助けちゃう♪: Of course it is! I'm here to bring good luck to everyone♪
translations.……あれ、なんかキャラ変わってない？: ...Wait, didn't your personality change a bit？
translations.うんうん…………説明するね？ りんこは第一期のラストではっぴーブレスの洗礼を受け: Uh-huh... Let me explain, okay？ At the end of Season 1, Rinko was baptized by the Happy Breath and had a change of heart! I've graduated from being that gloomy, monotone magical girl I used to be!
translations.って、誰が根暗の大根役者だっつーの！: Wait—who are you calling a gloomy hack actor!
translations.チッ！ そこのＡＤが……あ、ううん、なんでもない。そうよね、お父さん？: Tch! That AD over there just... Ah, no, it's nothing. Right, Dad？
translations.そうだー！ りんこー！ お父さんは感動してるぞー！: That's right, Rinko! Your dad is so moved!
translations.どうも、お父さん。先日は大変お世話に……ひどい目にあわせてくれましたね。: Hello, Dad. Thank you so much for the other day... when you put me through absolute hell.
translations.そうだったか？ 気にするなテレビの前の少年！: Did I？ Don't sweat it, boy in front of the TV!
translations.まあいいっすけど……それより、よかったな。低予算っぽかったのに、二期が放映されて: Well, whatever... Anyway, good for you. It looked super low-budget, yet you still got a second season.
translations.まあね？ これもリンコの才能だよ、へへ。ギャラもちょっとあがったしね……。: Well, yeah？ That's all thanks to my talent, hehe. My pay went up a little, too...
translations.あーっと！ 紹介するね、りんこのハッピーフレンド、まなかちゃんだよ♪: A-anyway! Let me introduce Rinko's Happy Friend, Manaka-chan♪
translations.オッス！ らきらきまなぴょん、参上で～す♪: Heya! Lucky-Lucky Manapyon is on the scene~♪
translations.▲高嶺＊＊▲、仕事は選んだ方が……。: ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you really ought to be pickier about the jobs you take...
translations.ねえ、私、そろそろ出てもいーい？: Hey, is it okay if I come out soon？
translations.あ、ネネ先輩。よろしくどうぞっす！: Oh, Nene-senpai. Looking forward to working with you!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は一体、どんな役なの？: What kind of role are you even playing, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私は謎の秘密結社デ・キシーズの長官、あまぞねーねよ！ あなたのハッピー、ばっきゅ: I'm Amazo-Nene, commander of the mysterious secret society De-Kissez! Time to vacuuuum up your Happy!
translations.……引いたら怒るわよ？: ...If you cringe at me, I'll get mad, okay？
translations.う、うわー！ デ・キシーズのあまぞねーねだ！ ハッピーを吸われないように、にっげ: W-Whoa! It's Amazo-Nene of De-Kissez! Run away before she sucks up our Happy～!
translations.だって、いきなりだし！: Come on, that was totally out of nowhere!
translations.まあ、贅沢は言ってられないわね。じゃあ、気を取り直して！: Well, beggars can't be choosers. Now, let's get back on track!
translations.ちょっと、本番中に携帯鳴らすって、おたくの事務所どういう教育してんの？: Excuse me, letting your phone ring in the middle of a take？ What kind of training does your agency give you？
translations.軽蔑します……。: I've lost all respect for you...
translations.もしもし……。はい……あの、今本番中で……え!?: Hello...? Yes... Um, we're right in the middle of filming... Huh!?
translations.二期を切り上げて、第三期『はぴかむスリー』!? ちょ、ちょっと、スリーってどうい: You're wrapping up Season 2 early for Season 3, "Hapi-Kamu Three"!? W-Wait a second, what do you mean, "Three"？ Huh, you're coming over here？
translations.あー、メンゴメンゴ。スポンサーがもっとオモチャ売りたいっていうからさ、主人公３倍: Ah, my bad, my bad. The sponsors wanna move more toys, see, so triple the main characters means triple the merch—everybody's rolling in dough, lol.
translations.３人って……センターはリンコだよね？ っていうか、ギャラは!?: Three main characters...? Rinko's still the center, right？ And more importantly, what about my pay!?
translations.センターは選挙で決めようと思うんだよね、はぴかむ総選挙。もし人気の出てくるサブキ: We're thinking of deciding the center by popular vote—the Hapi-Kamu General Election. And if any side characters take off, a total upset is 100% on the table.
translations.はあ!? 冗談じゃないっつーの！ 不動のセンターはリンコでしょ！ あとギャラ！: What!? You've gotta be kidding me! Rinko is the undisputed center! And what about my pay!?
translations.おっと～？ ケツがあるんだった、じゃ、このあとギロッポンでＭＴＧだから、じゃ！: Whoops～？ Got a hard out right after this—got a mtg down in Roppongi, so catch ya later!
translations.りんこ、これがギョーカイだ！ 負けるんじゃない！: Rinko, that's showbiz for you! Don't let it beat you!
translations.うう……せっかくの冠番組なのに……。: Ugh... It was supposed to be my very own show...
translations.選挙活動しなきゃ……まずはパパに頼んで地元の基盤を……。: I need to start campaigning... First, I'll ask Papa to help secure my local base...
translations.テレビの前のボク～？ お姉さんに一票入れてくれたら～、ふふふ▼: Hey there, little boy in front of the TV～？ If you give big sis your vote～... Hehehe▼
translations.ん、下克上……ダルマもありなのか？: Hmm, a total upset... Does that mean a Daruma has a shot too？
translations.バカ！ バカ！ とんでけー！ はぴかむりんくる～♪: Stupid! Stupid! Go fly away! Hapi-Kamu Rinkuru～♪
translations.第三期、ほんとにあるのかな……。: I wonder if there'll really be a season three...
translations.御用検めである。手向かいすれば容赦なく斬り捨てる！: Official inspection! Resist, and we will cut you down without mercy!
translations.新撰組一番隊隊長、小早川凛子。いざ参るっ！: Rinko Kobayakawa, Captain of the Shinsengumi First Unit. Prepare yourself!
translations.あれ……▲小早川＊▲？ なんだそのかっこ！ それに刀……のオモチャ？: Huh... ▲小早川＊▲？ What's with the outfit! And is that a... toy sword？
translations.何をぼさっとしている。その腰の二本はただの飾りか!?: What are you spacing out for？ Are those two swords at your hip just for show!?
translations.たった二人で打ち込むとは笑止っ！ 返り討ちにしてくれるわ！: Storming in with just the two of you？ Laughable! We'll cut you down where you stand!
translations.これほどまで、不逞浪士が池田屋に潜んでいたとは。しかし、局長たちが来るまで持ちこ: To think this many lawless ronin were hiding in the Ikedaya. Still, we must hold out until the Commander arrives!
translations.小早川先生！ このままでは返り討ち。いったん退くべきだ。: Master Kobayakawa! At this rate, they'll wipe us out. We should fall back for now.
translations.……ならば、お前だけでも逃げろ。わたしが囲みを切り開く。: ...Then save yourself. I'll carve a path through them.
translations.バカなことを！ 先生と●は相棒だ、どこに行くときも一緒だ。: Don't talk nonsense! You and ● are partners—wherever we go, we go together.
translations.だが……このままでは二人とも……。: But... at this rate, both of us will...
translations.死ぬときだって一緒。そう誓ったはずだ！ 先生を置いていけるかっ！: Even in death, we're together. We swore an oath! How could I leave you behind, Master!?
translations.こんなところでお前を死なせるわけにいかない！ 共にこの囲み、切り開くぞ！: I won't let you die in a place like this! Together, we'll break through their lines!
translations.なっ、まだいたのか！ 先生！: What, there's still one left!? Master!
translations.先生っ！ 傷は浅い、気をしっかりっ！: Master! The wound is shallow—stay with me!
translations.……ごめん、約束守れそうにないや。だから……アンタだけでも逃げ……て……。: ...Sorry, looks like I can't keep my promise. So... at least you have to get... away...
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ 死ぬなっ！ ●を置いて、お前だけ死ぬなんて許さないから……。: ▲小早川＊▲! Don't die! I'll never forgive you if you die and leave ● behind...
translations.へへ、アンタの顔が遠くに……。: Heh heh, your face is getting so far away...
translations.この血……なんかサラサラしてないか？ それにこのニオイ……。: This blood... isn't it kind of thin？ And what's this smell...
translations.……何言ってんの。ただの血糊に決まってるじゃん。: ...What are you talking about？ Obviously it's just fake blood.
translations.血糊っていうか……これ、トマトジュースじゃないか？: Fake blood？ Wait... isn't this tomato juice？
translations.血糊になりそうなの探したんだけどなくてさ。そしたらテーブルの上にトマトジュースが: I looked around for something I could use as fake blood, but couldn't find anything. And then there happened to be tomato juice on the table.
translations.あったわけって……うわ、トマトジュースの臭いがすごいな……。: Happened to be... Whoa, the smell of tomato juice is really strong...
translations.どうした？ 顔色がすっごく悪いけど。: What's wrong？ You look really pale.
translations.リンコ……トマト大っ嫌いだってこと忘れてた……バカじゃん。: I totally forgot how much I hate tomatoes... How stupid is that.
translations.あっ……意識が遠くなる……じゃ、あとはアンタに任せたから。そういうことで。: Ugh... I'm blacking out... Well, I'll leave the rest to you. Good luck.
translations.ちょっと待て！ 気を失うなら、この囲みを突破してから……ハ、ハハハハ。: Hold on! If you're gonna pass out, wait till we break through this ambush... Ha, hahaha.
translations.えっと……この状況……逃がしてはくれませんよね？: Uh... Looking at the situation... I don't suppose you'll let us go？
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ 目を醒ましてくれよー!! ひとりでコイツら全員なんか倒せるわけな: ▲小早川＊▲! Wake up already!! There's no way I can take all these guys on by myself!
translations.はっ……夢か。▲小早川＊▲……ああいう格好似合うような。: Gasp... Just a dream. Still, ▲小早川＊▲... kind of suited an outfit like that.
translations.（この刀で敵を斬るように画面をスライドだ！）: (Slide across the screen to slash the enemies with this sword!)
translations.画面をスライドして敵を斬れ: Slide across the screen to slash the enemies.
translations.わたしです、親指姫です。覚えていませんか、ツバメさん。: It's me, Thumbelina. Don't you remember me, Mr. Swallow？
translations.ああ、ごめんごめん。……それにしても▲小早川＊▲。またなんか、サイズがちっちゃく: Oh, sorry, sorry. ...Still, ▲小早川＊▲, you've gotten all tiny again.
translations.（しまった、ちっちゃいとか言ったら怒られるか？）: (Oops, is she gonna get mad at me for calling her tiny？)
translations.▲小早川＊▲……泣いて？ どうした？: ▲小早川＊▲... Are you crying？ What's wrong？
translations.実はわたし、モグラさんと結婚させられてしまうんです。: The truth is, I'm being forced to marry Mr. Mole.
translations.モグラさんは地下の世界のお方、お嫁にいったら当然わたしもお日様のない地下へ……う: Mr. Mole lives in the underground world. If I marry him, I'll have to live underground without the sun too... *sob*...
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、いつもと違って清楚で儚げな感じで……こういうのも可愛いかも）: (▲小早川＊▲'s acting all pure and delicate, unlike usual... This side of her might be kinda cute too.)
translations.よーし、わかった！ ●に任せとけ！: All right, got it! ● can handle this!
translations.ありがとうございます、ツバメさん！: Thank you so much, Mr. Swallow!
translations.うわってなんだよ。金ならあんだよ、愛もな。: What's with the 'whoa'？ I've got plenty of money, and love too.
translations.へへへ。愛してるぜ～親指姫～、愛してるぜ～。: Hehehe. I love you, Thumbelina~, I really love you~.
translations.お前との結婚はネズミのおばさん公認だぜ？ あとはお前の返事だけだ～。: Ms. Mouse already gave our marriage her blessing, y'know？ All that's left is your answer~.
translations.親指姫が嫌がってるの、わかるだろ。無理矢理迫るなよ。: You can see Thumbelina doesn't want this, right？ Stop forcing yourself on her.
translations.親指姫は住んだことのない地下に不安がってるだけだ、そんなのすぐ慣れる。: Thumbelina's just nervous about living underground 'cause she's never done it before. She'll get used to it in no time.
translations.ダメだ、親指姫。弱気になっちゃいけない！: No, Thumbelina. You can't lose heart!
translations.邪魔すんなよ。じゃあお前に親指姫を幸せにできるのか。金持ってんのか？ 金～？: Stay out of this. What, you think you can make Thumbelina happy？ You got money？ Money～？
translations.それは……●、まだ高校生だし……。: Well... ● am still in high school...
translations.そんなんじゃ親指姫は渡せないだろ～、渡せね～よ～。: Then I sure can't hand Thumbelina over to you, now can I～？ No way～.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。●のこと、信じてくれるか？: ▲小早川＊▲. Can you believe in who ● am？
translations.こんなカレシだけど、それでも信じてくれるか？: I may not be much of a boyfriend, but do you still believe in me？
translations.金も地位もなくたって、●が▲小早川＊▲のことを一番愛してるんだ！ その●が、一番: Even without money or status, ● love ▲小早川＊▲ more than anyone! And ● can make ▲小早川＊▲ happier than anyone else!
translations.そんなの、若造のキレイごとだ！: That's just naive talk from some kid!
translations.若造のキレイごとで結構、●たち若いんだからな！: Naive talk from a kid is fine by me! She and ● are young, after all!
translations.ツバメさん、わたしを連れ去って。: Mr. Swallow, take me away from here.
translations.ああ、わかった。一緒に花の国へ行こう！: Yeah, got it. Let's go to the Land of Flowers together!
translations.大丈夫？ 落ちないように捕まってろよ。: You okay？ Hold on tight so you don't fall.
translations.リンコ、実はレースゲーとかフライトシミュレータも結構得意なんだよね。: Actually, I'm pretty good at racing games and flight simulators, you know.
translations.えー、ハンドル握ると性格変わるタイプ!?: Wait, are you the type whose personality changes behind the wheel？!
translations.▲小早川＊▲が車の免許取るときは要注意だな。: I'd better watch out when ▲小早川＊▲ gets her driver's license.
translations.（最初は実感わかなかったけど……やっぱり子供っていいな……）: (It didn't feel real at first... but having a kid really is great...)
translations.（愛する妻に、可愛い子供……最高だ！）: (A wife I love, and a cute kid... Life couldn't be better!)
translations.なれたもんだよな、あやすのも。: You've really gotten the hang of soothing the baby.
translations.そうだよ、最初はもっと危なっかしかった。: Yeah, you were a lot shakier at it in the beginning.
translations.ああ、でも子供が産まれて急に、頼もしくなったっていうか……大人の女性になったって: Yeah, but once the baby was born, you suddenly became so dependable... Like a real grown woman, I guess.
translations.そんな今更、もうとっくに大人でしょ。: Come on, I've been an adult for a long time now.
translations.……なんだよ、急に。: ...Where'd that come from all of a sudden？
translations.急じゃないよ……こんなにたくさんの宝物をくれて。: It's not all of a sudden... You've given me so many treasures.
translations.高校生のとき、あなたがカレシになってくれたとき……。: Back in high school, when you became my boyfriend...
translations.わたし、あれ以上の幸せがあるなんて思わなかった。: I never thought I could be any happier than that.
translations.うん……。それからね、結婚したときも、驚いたの。: Yeah... And then, when we got married, I was surprised too.
translations.それまでもずっと一緒だったんだから、きっと結婚したって、何も変わらないだろうって: We'd been together all that time already, so I figured getting married wouldn't really change anything.
translations.……あなたとの会話も、毎日の生活も、みんな、それまでと同じ。: ...Our conversations, our daily life, all of it was the same as before.
translations.あなたを好きっていう、その気持ちだけが、わたしの中でどんどん大きくなっていったの: My love for you was the one thing that kept growing bigger and bigger inside me.
translations.あのときは、幸せが大きくなったのを感じたけど……今はまた、違う。: Back then, I felt my happiness grow bigger... but now, it's different again.
translations.ふたりだけでいたときの、“あなたを好き”っていうだけの気持ちじゃなくて。もっと、: It's not just the feeling of loving you like when it was only the two of us. It's something more...
translations.大切なこの子を見てると、自分が優しくなれるの。それも……幸せ。: When I look at our precious child, it makes me a gentler person. And that makes me happy, too.
translations.カレシと、ダンナ様と、赤ちゃんと……みんな、あなたがくれた。: A boyfriend, a husband, a baby... You gave them all to me.
translations.わたしの幸せは、みんな、あなたのおかげ。だから、ありがとう。: All of my happiness is thanks to you. So, thank you.
translations.そんなの●にとっても、同じだよ……ありがとう。: ● feel the same way, too... Thank you.
translations.おはようございます。\n君の教育係になった、\n主任の▲苗字▲▲名前▲だ。\nよ:
Good morning.
I'm Chief ▲苗字▲ ▲名前▲,
and I'll be training you.
Nice to meet you.
translations.新人の小早川凛子です。\n精一杯がんばりますので、\nご指導よろしくお願いします:
I'm the new hire, Rinko
Kobayakawa. I'll do my best,
and I look forward to
learning from you.
translations.……小早川くんは礼儀正しくて、\n気持ちがいいね。\n期待してるよ！:
...You're so polite,
Kobayakawa. It's refreshing.
I have high hopes for you！
translations.いえ、そんな……\nありがとうございます。:
Oh, not at all...
Thank you very much.
translations.うんうん。\nでは早速、ひとつ仕事を……。:
Right, right.
Then let's get you started
on your first task...
translations.（小早川くんは\nちゃんとやってるかな……）:
(I wonder if Kobayakawa
is doing okay...)
translations.ありがとうございます。\n大丈夫です。:
Thank you for asking.
Everything's fine.
translations.これは……通勤中に聴いていて。\n停止し忘れていたみたいです。:
I was... listening to this
on my way in. I must have
forgotten to stop it.
translations.それならいいが……\n業務中はしまっておくように。:
Well, alright then...
Keep it put away during work.
translations.いいんだいいんだ。\nじゃあ引き続き頼むよ。:
Don't worry about it.
Keep up the good work.
translations.小早川くん。さっき頼んだ、\n表の作成。どんな感じ？ \nまさかもう終わった？:
Kobayakawa, how's that chart
I asked for coming along？
Don't tell me you're done？
translations.えっと……\nいえ、まだもう少し。\nでも順調です。:
Um...
No, just a little longer.
It's going smoothly, though.
translations.へえ、優秀だな。\nどれどれ……。:
Wow, impressive.
Let's take a look...
translations.あ、あの！ これは、その……\n調べ物をしていて！ \nわからないことを検索して:
U-um! I was just...
doing some research!
I was looking something up
and ended up on this forum...
translations.ん……そうか。それなら……\nん？ 格ゲー攻略？:
Hm... I see. Well then...
Huh？ Fighting game guides？
translations.……ん？ なんだ、\n香ばしい匂いがするな。:
...Hm？ Wait, something
smells really good in here.
translations.あ……気のせいじゃ\nないでしょうか？:
Oh... Aren't you just
imagining things？
translations.いや、たしかに……\nこの辺か？:
No, I definitely smell it...
Right around here？
translations.へへじゃないよ、君。\n入社からいきなりこんな\n態度で、この先やっていけると\:
Don't "hehe" me.
You think you'll last here
acting like this on your
first day？ Good grief...
translations.うっさいなー、\nさっきから聞いてれば。\n何様ですか、主任様？:
Ugh, quit nagging already.
Who do you think you are,
Mr. Supervisor？
translations.あれするな、これはだめって、\nそんなんじゃ\nやる気出ないんですけど。:
"Don't do this, don't do that."
You're totally killing
my motivation here.
translations.それ以上やると、\nパワハラで訴えますよ。:
Keep it up and I'll report
you for harassment.
translations.部長！ 助けてください！ \n主任が、主任が……\nわたしのことを……。:
Director! Please help me!
My supervisor, he...
he was...
translations.ばかもーん！ \n君は新人研修から\nやり直したまえ！ \n代わりに小早川くん、:
You fool!
Start over from new-hire
training!
Kobayakawa, you're the
supervisor from now on!
translations.あれ……よかった、\n夢か。ひどい目にあった……。:
Huh...？ Thank goodness,
it was a dream.
That was awful...
translations.でもスーツ姿で敬語の\n▲小早川＊▲は、\n悪くなかったな……。:
Still, ▲小早川＊▲ in a suit
speaking so politely
wasn't bad at all...
translations.（この音、机の上から\n聞こえてる？）:
(Is that sound coming
from the desk？)
translations.ゴー、ゴー、ＴＯＷＡＮＯ！ レッツゴー、ＴＯＷＡＮＯ！: Go, go, TOWANO! Let's go, TOWANO!
translations.（今度こそ、リンダをプロムに誘うんだ……）: (This time for sure, I'm asking Linda to prom...)
translations.おっと、いけない。ボクの自己紹介がまだだったね。: Whoops, my bad. Haven't introduced myself yet, have I？
translations.ボクの名は……▲名前▲！ ＴＯＷＡＮＯ ＣＩＴＹの名門、フォーエバーハイスクール: The name's... ▲名前▲! I'm the quarterback for the football team at TOWANO CITY's prestigious Forever High.
translations.正確に言えば……うん、クォーターバック志望の補欠だね。そうとも言う。: Well, to be exact... yeah, I'm a benchwarmer who wants to be quarterback. You could put it that way too.
translations.そんなボクにとってチアのリンダは高嶺の花……でも、次こそリンダをプロムに誘うんだ: For a guy like me, Linda the cheerleader is way out of my league... But this time, I'm gonna ask her to prom for sure!
translations.（よーし、まずはリンダに声をかけるぞ……）: (All right, first I'll go talk to Linda...)
translations.あ……、ホワッツアップ？ どうしたの？: Oh... What's up？ Something on your mind？
translations.その……ボクと一緒に……。: Um... would you go with me...
translations.あ、ううん！ なんでもない！ 忘れて！: Ah, nope! Nothing! Forget I said anything!
translations.ねえ、チアの練習付き合ってくれない？ 上手くできたら、なんでもお願い聞いてあげる: Hey, mind helping me with cheer practice？ If you do well, I'll grant you any favor you want.
translations.いいでしょ、ほら！ リピート！: Come on, you don't mind, right？ Repeat after me!
translations.サンクス、助かっちゃった。: Thanks, that really helped me out.
translations.お願い、何かあるんじゃないの？: Didn't you have a favor to ask me？
translations.つれない顔すんなよ、ハニー。: Don't give me the cold shoulder, honey.
translations.プロムの相手、まだ決まってないんだろ？ ヘイヘイ、オレと行こうぜ～。: You still don't have a prom date, right？ Hey, come on, go with me!
translations.リ、リンダは……オレとプロムに行くんだ！ お前はすっこんでろ！: L-Linda's... going to prom with me! Back off!
translations.へへへ……何言ってんだ、お前？: Hehehe... What're you talking about, man？
translations.ちょっと、選手にかなうわけないじゃん！: Hold on, you don't stand a chance against one of the players!
translations.リンダ……オレとプロムに行ってくれ！: Linda... Go to prom with me!
translations.……うん……いいよ。へへ、かっこよかった……。: ...Yeah... okay. Hehe, that was pretty cool...
translations.フォーエバーハイスクールのキッカーをなめるなー！: Don't mess with Forever High's kicker!
translations.えっと……リンダだっけ、リンコだっけ……。: Wait... Was it Linda, or Rinko...？
translations.何をボケっとしているか！: What are you spacing out for!
translations.対戦相手の名前も調べていないとは……余裕のつもりか！:
You don't even know your
opponent's name... Pretty
cocky, aren't you!
translations.それ、小キックじゃないだろ！ なんかすごかったぞ。:
That was no light kick!
That move was crazy!
translations.今のはレバー前入れ小キックアル。:
That was forward on the
stick plus light kick.
translations.（でも、待てよ……反撃って……●がカノジョに手を出せるわけないだろ！）:
(Wait a sec... Fight back？
There's no way ● could lay
a hand on my girlfriend!)
translations.ならこちらから……はあ！:
Then I'll come to you...
Hah!
translations.（こうなったら……時間切れまで逃げ切って、引き分けにしてやる！）:
(In that case... I'll just
run out the clock and force
a draw!)
translations.くっ、逃げるのは上手いアルね。:
Grr, you're pretty good at
running away.
translations.はあ、はあ……なんとかいけそうだ……。:
Huff, huff... Looks like I
might just pull this off...
translations.……そうカナ？ 攻め続けたおかげで、ゲージは満タンアル。:
...You think so？ Thanks to
staying on the offensive,
my gauge is full.
translations.ゲージが溜まればこっちのもの、必殺技を喰らうヨロシ！:
With a full gauge, it's all
mine! Eat my special move!
translations.行くアルヨ、小キック連打で～！:
Here I go! Rapid-fire
light kicks~!
translations.（なんかあったかくて、やわらかくて、気持ち良かったな……）:
(It was so warm and soft...
Felt really nice...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲……無防備に寝てるな。まったく、上にカレシが乗ってるっていうのに…:
(▲小早川＊▲... Sleeping with her
guard totally down. And with her
boyfriend right on top of her...)
translations.（それに▲小早川＊▲、なんかおっきくなってないか？）:
(And hasn't ▲小早川＊▲ gotten
way bigger somehow？)
translations.起きちゃったの？ リンコはまだ寝るよ、おやすみ……。:
Are you up already？
I'm still sleeping. Night...
translations.（……理由はよくわかんないけど…………）:
(...I don't really get how
this happened, but...)
translations.（これってもしかして……チャンスか!?）:
(Could this actually be...
my big chance!?)
translations.（よーし、普段怒鳴られたり蹴られたりしてる仕返ししてやるぞ……）:
(Alright, time for some payback
for always yelling at me and
kicking me...)
translations.（やばい、起きそうだ……。また寝かさないと……）:
(Uh-oh, she's waking up...
I need to put her back to sleep...)
translations.（寝かせるには……ハンモックを揺らしてみよう……）:
(To get her back to sleep...
Let's try rocking the hammock...)
translations.あー、よく寝た……。: Ahh, that was a good nap...
translations.（ダメだ、完全に起きちゃったな。ここまでか）:
(No good, she's wide awake now.
Guess the fun's over.)
translations.へへ、アンタもよく眠れた？: Hehe, did you sleep well too？
translations.そっかそっか、お前はかわいーなー▼:
I see, I see.
You're just the cutest thing▼
translations.（うわ、体が胸に押し付けられて……）:
(Whoa, she's pressing me
right against her chest...)
translations.どうしたの？ うれしーの？:
What's the matter？
Does that make you happy？
translations.好き好き好き～かわいい～～▼: I love you, I love you~ So cute~~▼
translations.（うわ、痛い！ 痛い！ 可愛がりすぎだろ！）: (Whoa, ow! Ow! That's a little too much love!)
translations.ふう……慣れたとはいえ、やっぱり暑いな。: Phew... Even once you're used to it, it's still hot.
translations.（●と▲小早川＊▲が無人島での生活を始めて、どれくらい経っただろう……）: (How long has it been since ● and ▲小早川＊▲ started living on this deserted island...？)
translations.（いまだ救助の希望を捨てきれない●と違って、▲小早川＊▲はもうすっかり……）: (● still can't give up hope of being rescued, whereas ▲小早川＊▲ has already gone full...)
translations.リンコだー！ オマエー！ 帰ったなー！: It's Rinko! Hey, you! You back!
translations.ああ、魚と果物、とって来た！: Yeah, I got fish and fruit!
translations.コイツか？ リンコが拾った！ きっと役に立つ！: This guy？ Rinko found him! He'll come in handy!
translations.ガツガツ……ウマイぞ！ オマエたちもクウ！: Chomp, chomp... Tasty! You guys eat too!
translations.（しかしコイツ、むかつく顔してるよな……）: (Still, this guy's got a really annoying face...)
translations.やらしい顔しやがって……▲小早川＊▲から離れろ！: Wipe that sleazy look off your face... Get away from ▲小早川＊▲!
translations.やっぱり、リンコにはオマエだ！ オマエがリンコのだ！: I knew it, Rinko needs you! You're Rinko's!
translations.▲小早川＊▲……そうだよな、信じてたよ。: ▲小早川＊▲... Yeah, I always believed in you.
translations.うん、リンコ、どこにいても、ずっとこの島で二人きりでも……。: Yeah. No matter where Rinko is, even stuck on this island with just us two...
translations.▲主人公＊▲。アンタと一緒、アンタだけが、リンコのパートナー！: ▲主人公＊▲. I'm with you. You're Rinko's one and only partner!
translations.だから……リンコ、オマエをクウ！: That's why... Rinko's gonna eat you!
translations.そうだな…………くう？ 食う!?: Yeah, totally... Wait, eat？ Eat me!？
translations.毛むくじゃらのアイツより、オマエの方がウマそうだ！: You look way tastier than that hairy thing!
translations.……食料選びだったの!?: ...You were just picking what to eat!？
translations.はあっはあっはあっ……。夢、か……。: Haa, haa, haa... A dream, huh...
translations.まさかカノジョに食べられそうになるなんて……。: I never thought my own girlfriend would try to eat me...
translations.そんな愛情表現は遠慮したいな……。: I think I'll pass on that kind of affection...
translations.（サルに負けないように激しく振ってやる！）: (I'm not losing to some monkey! I'll shake it with all I've got!)
translations.もしもし、▲小早川＊▲？ 急かもしれないけど、今から会えない？:
Hello, ▲小早川＊▲？
I know this is sudden, but
can we meet up right now？
translations.べつに、いいよ。カレシなんだし。:
I don't mind. You are my
boyfriend, after all.
translations.よかった。それなら▲デート場所▲に来れる？:

● thought so too. So you
liked them too, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ゴーイングマイウェイって感じ。周りを気にしてない感じがいいよ。:
They just do their own
thing. I like how they don't
care what anyone thinks.
translations.見た感じ地味だったけど、音は一番印象に残ったな。: They looked pretty plain, but their sound left the biggest impression on me.
translations.骨太でズンって胸の奥に響いてきて……あれこそ本物のロックだね！: It had real grit and hit you right in the chest... Now that's real rock!
translations.ねえ。アンタはジャズの良さってわかってる？: Hey. Do you actually get what makes jazz good？
translations.そうやって聞かれると……ただ、いいなあとは思うけど。: When you put it like that... I just think it sounds nice, I guess.
translations.リンコもそんな感じ。説明できるようになりたいな。: Same here. I wish I could actually put it into words, though.
translations.聴いて気持ちよければそれでいいんじゃないの？: If it feels good to listen to, isn't that enough？
translations.そうかもしれないけど……リンコはもっとちゃんと知りたいの。: Maybe, but... I want to understand it properly.
translations.……ヒップホップか。リンコには最近の若い子の好みがわかんないよ。: ...Hip-hop, huh. I really don't get what kids these days are into.
translations.最近の若い子って……▲小早川＊▲だってそうだろ？: "Kids these days"？ ...Aren't you one of them, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.それは開きがありすぎだな……じゃあ、今日のはハズレか。: That's a pretty big gap... So today was a bust for you, then.
translations.……実はそこそこ聴けたかも。自分でも意外だけど、なんでだろ。: ...Actually, it wasn't bad to listen to. Even I'm surprised. Wonder why.
translations.アンタってこういうのも好きなんだ。: So you're into this kind of stuff too, huh.
translations.ふーん、リンコも結構気に入ったけどね。: Hmm. Well, I actually liked it quite a bit too.
translations.▲小早川＊▲も可愛い声してるんだしさ、いいんじゃない？: You've got a cute voice too, ▲小早川＊▲, so why not？
translations.褒めてくれるのは別にいいけど……そんな単純な世界でもないんじゃないの、きっと。: I don't mind the compliment, but... I'm pretty sure it's not that simple a world.
translations.あのさ……暗い所で人の話を聴いてると、眠くならない？: Say... doesn't listening to someone talk in the dark make you sleepy？
translations.ああ、少しわかるかも。: Yeah, I kind of get what you mean.
translations.さっきも危なかったんだけどさ。: It was a close call for me earlier, actually.
translations.話が面白かったから、それで繋ぎとめられてた感じだよ。眠りと現実の間で行ったり来た: The story was interesting, so that kinda kept me anchored. I was drifting back and forth between sleep and reality.
translations.なんか気持ちよさそうだな。: That actually sounds kind of nice.
translations.小さい頃、こういうの観たりした？: Did you ever watch stuff like this when you were little？
translations.ううん、あんまり。きっと最後まで集中してられないと思う。: No, not really. I doubt I could've sat through it till the end.
translations.まあな……今はどうだった？: Fair point... How was it now？
translations.うん、結構面白かった。たまにシュール過ぎてわけわかんなかったけど。: Yeah, it was pretty fun. Though parts of it were so surreal I had no idea what was going on.
translations.なんだ▲小早川＊▲もか。そういうの理解できると思ったんだけど。: Oh, you too, ▲小早川＊▲？ Here I thought you'd get that kind of thing.
translations.どういう意味だっつーの。リンコがシュールだとでも？: What's that supposed to mean？ Are you calling me surreal？
translations.へへ。実はさ、今日のカラオケ楽しみにしてたんだよね。: Hehe. To tell the truth, I was really looking forward to karaoke today.
translations.お、いつになく張り切ってるな。: Oh, you're way more hyped than usual.
translations.当たり前じゃん。前からリクエストしてた曲が入ったって聞いてさ。: Of course I am. I heard they finally added the song I've been requesting.
translations.なるほど。今日が歌い初めなわけだ。: I see. So today's its big debut, huh.
translations.そういうこと。じゃ、早速入れますか。: Yep, pretty much. Alright, let's put it in right away.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、ドリンク何にする？: ▲小早川＊▲, what do you want to drink？
translations.それより早く曲入れなきゃ。時間もったいないじゃん。: Forget that, we need to queue up some songs first. We're wasting time.
translations.ドリンクを選ぶ時間くらい……。: Picking a drink barely takes any time...
translations.はい、まずはアンタから。曲入れておいてあげたから。がんばって！: Here, you're up first. I already put a song in for you. Good luck!
translations.さてと、次は……うん、これかな。: Now then, next up is... yeah, let's go with this one.
translations.デュエット曲。今日はリンコの特別サービス。:
It's a duet. Consider it a
special treat from me today.
translations.はは……なんか照れるな。:
Haha... Makes me feel
a little shy.
translations.アンタが照れたら、こっちまで恥ずかしくなるじゃん。恥ずかしがるの禁止。:
If you get all shy, you'll
make me embarrassed too.
No being shy allowed.
translations.あっ……向こうのゴンドラ見るの禁止。:
Oh... No looking at that
gondola over there.
translations.そういうこと、言葉にするなっつーの。:
You don't have to say it
out loud, geez.
translations.周りから見られるの気にならないのかな……なあ？:
I wonder if they don't mind
people seeing them... Right？
translations.なんでリンコに聞くんだっつーの、気になるに決まってるじゃん……。:
Why are you asking me, geez？
Obviously I'd mind...
translations.あっ、ごめん。足ふんじゃったよな。:
Oh, sorry. I stepped on
your foot, didn't I？
translations.別にいいよ。観覧車の中って狭いし……へへ。:
It's fine. Ferris wheels
are pretty cramped... Hehe.
translations.ううん。観覧車の中……こうして足が触れあう距離って、なんとなくいいよね。:
Nope. Being in here... close
enough for our feet to touch
like this is kinda nice.
translations.ここのお化け屋敷、マイナーチェンジして恐さ倍増らしいんだけど……。:
They say they revamped this
haunted house to make it
twice as scary, though...
translations.人が作ったものには、限界があるよ。:
There's a limit to what
man-made things can do.
translations.だからって、もう少し驚いてあげればいいのに。:
Even so, you could at least
act a little more surprised.
translations.リンコの前に立ちふさがる相手はお化けだろうと何だろうと……ビシッ。:
Whether it's a ghost or
whatever, if it gets in my
way... Bam.
translations.今回のは相当恐かったな。▲小早川＊▲も……。:
That one was pretty scary.
Even ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.アレは反則。恐がらせるんじゃなくて、驚かしてるだけじゃん。:
That was a foul. They're
not scaring people, they're
just startling them.
translations.まあな。突然飛び出して来られたら、誰だって驚くか……。:
True. Anyone'd jump if
something leaped out at
them like that...
translations.邪道だね。一から演出を考え直すべきだと、リンコは思う。:
It's cheap. I think they
should rethink the whole
production from scratch.
translations.（怖かったのが相当悔しいんだろうな……）:
(She must really hate that
it scared her...)
translations.そんな辛そうな顔しないでよ。もう一回乗るんだから。:
Don't look so miserable.
We're going on it again.
translations.弱音を吐かない！ さっ、もう１回並ぶよ。:
No whining! Come on,
let's get back in line.
translations.こういうのさ、“きゃあ、恐～い！”とか言って女の子がカレシに抱きついたりするもん:
Aren't girls supposed to go
"Eek, scary!" and cling to
their boyfriends on these？
translations.ふうん……そういうのがやりたいんだ。:
Hmm... So that's what
you want to do.
translations.じゃ、サービスで抱きついてあげよっか？:
Then want me to give you
a hug as a bonus？
translations.あ、ごめん。今日サービスデーじゃなかった、また今度ね。:
Oh, sorry. Today's not
bonus day. Maybe next time.
translations.……あーもう、人が多くて、パレード見えない。:
...Ugh, it's so crowded
I can't see the parade.
translations.肩車でもする？:
Want to ride on
my shoulders？
translations.なら、向こうの段差に行くか。:
Then let's go over to
those steps.
translations.……うん、きれい……、へへ、これなら見る価値あったね。: ...Yeah, it's pretty... Hehe, it was worth coming to see after all.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ ひょっとして眠い？: ▲小早川＊▲？ Are you sleepy by any chance？
translations.珍しいな、もう帰るか？: That's rare for you. Want to head home？
translations.いい。せっかくパレード見に来たのに、もったいないじゃん。: I'm fine. We came all this way to see the parade, so it'd be a waste.
translations.そうだな、でも眠くなったら●の肩貸してあげるから。: True, but if you get sleepy, ● can lend you a shoulder.
translations.何度も呼んでたんだけど、すっかり見とれてたな。: I called your name a few times, but you were totally entranced.
translations.……まあ、リンコも女の子ですから。: ...Well, I am a girl, after all.
translations.まあ、こんなときぐらいはね……。今のリンコのことは後で忘れるように。: Well, at a time like this, at least... Just make sure you forget you saw me like this later.
translations.あっ、キレイなお姉さんがアンタに向かって、手を振ってるよ！: Oh, that pretty girl over there is waving at you!
translations.……なんでこんな単純なのに引っかかるかな。: ...How do you fall for something so obvious？
translations.引っかかったっていうか……条件反射だって。: I didn't fall for it... That was just a reflex.
translations.やだやだ、言い訳は見苦しいっつーの。: Ugh, making excuses is just pathetic.
translations.ふぅ……ちょっと休憩。: Phew... Time for a little break.
translations.遊び足りないよ。ウォータースライダーだってまだ５回しか乗ってない！: I haven't had nearly enough fun yet. We've only gone down the water slide five times!
translations.５回も、だと思うけど……。: I think five times is plenty, though...
translations.もう……しょうがないな、ジジイは。: Geez... What am I gonna do with you, old man.
translations.ちょっと休憩したら、あと最低５回は乗るからね？: After a quick break, we're riding it at least five more times, okay？
translations.さっきからリンコのことチラチラ見てるような気がするんだけど……何？: I feel like you've been sneaking glances at me for a while now... What is it？
translations.別に普通だろ、見ちゃダメってことはないだろうし。: It's nothing weird. Not like there's a rule against looking at you.
translations.目がヤラしい。: You've got a dirty look in your eyes.
translations.そっか。生まれつき、エロいのか……。: I see. So you were born a pervert...
translations.映像だってわかってても、星に包まれてるような不思議な気分になるよね。: Even when you know it's just a projection, it feels strangely like being surrounded by stars.
translations.なんかこう些細なことは忘れて、素直になれそうな気分だよ。: It makes me feel like I can forget all the little things and just be honest with myself.
translations.……じゃあ、なに。なんかよこしまな思いを感じるから、やっぱ素直は無し。: ...Well then, what？ I'm sensing ulterior motives from you, so forget what I said about being honest.
translations.一面の星空……やっぱキレイだね。: A sky full of stars... It really is beautiful.
translations.実際には街の灯りが強くて、こんなにたくさんの星、滅多に見られないもんな。: With all the city lights in real life, you rarely get to see this many stars.
translations.いつかどこか遠いとこで、２人きりでこうして星……見たいな。: Someday, I'd like to go somewhere far away and look at the stars like this... just the two of us.
translations.２人きりが大事なのか。: So 'just the two of us' is the important part, huh.
translations.そこ反応するなっつーの。でも、そこが大事。わかるでしょ。: Don't latch onto that part. Still, yeah, it is important. You know what I mean.
translations.あのさ、周りのカップル……みんな、くっついてる。: Hey, all the couples around us... They're all snuggled up together.
translations.この雰囲気だからな。: Well, it's that kind of atmosphere.
translations.じゃあ、●らはもう行くか。:
Should we just head out
then, ●？
translations.そうじゃなくて……もう、察しろっつーの。:
That's not it... Come on,
take a hint already.
translations.これだけ植物があると、世話するのも大変そう。:
Taking care of this many
plants must be hard work.
translations.全部最適な条件がちがうだろうしな。:
Especially since they all
need different conditions.
translations.そう言えばリンコの家のタマが元気ないんだよね。:
Speaking of which, Tama
hasn't been looking very
lively at home lately.
translations.そう。ここの職員の人なら相談に乗ってくれそうじゃない？:
Yeah. Think the staff here
would give me some advice？
translations.植物ってさ、よく使う和名とぜんぜんちがう学名がついてることがあるんだね。:
Some plants have scientific
names that sound nothing
like their Japanese names.
translations.これはツバキだけど……えーっとカメリアジャポニカ……だって。:
This is a tsubaki, but...
um, it says here it's
"Camellia japonica."
translations.へえ、じゃあ今度からそう呼んでみるか。カメリアジャポニカ！:
Huh. Maybe I'll call them
that from now on, then.
Camellia japonica!
translations.やだよ、めんどくさい。一人でがんばって。:
No way, too much trouble.
You can do that on your own.
translations.うう、ジメジメしてる……。:
Ugh, it's so muggy
in here...
translations.そりゃ植物にあわせてるしな。:
Well, it is set for the
plants, after all.
translations.もっと人間に過ごしやすいとこないのかな。:
Isn't there anywhere a bit
more comfortable for humans？
translations.どうだろう……植物園だしな。:
I don't know... It is a
botanical garden.
translations.そこはもっとさ、鑑賞する側のことも考えてもらわないと。鑑賞される側の植物だけじゃ:
They need to think of the
viewers, too. This place
can't run on just the plants.
translations.たまにはさ、こういうイベントに来るのもいいね。結構楽しかったよ。:
It's nice coming to an event
like this once in a while.
I had a pretty good time.
translations.そっか、よかった。来た甲斐あったな。:
I'm glad to hear that.
Made the trip worth it.
translations.疲れたけど、嫌な感じの疲れじゃないしね。:
I'm tired, sure, but it's
a good kind of tired.
translations.なんか言い方が軽いけど……まあそう、ハマっちゃう感じ。また来てもいいかも。:
Not sure I like how you put
it, but...yeah, I guess so.
Wouldn't mind coming again.
translations.今日のイベントさ、どうだった？: So, how was the event today？
translations.うーん……良くも悪くも普通。:
Hmm... Average, for better
or worse.
translations.主催者が改善点をきちんと理解してれば、次はよくなるかもね。:
If the organizers realize
what needs improving, maybe
next time will be better.
translations.イベントの内容はおいとくとしても……列整理とか、入場時の対応とか、イベント中の放:
Setting the event aside...
Little things like line
control, admission, and
announcements matter, too.
translations.（意外に細かいとこ気にしてるな……）:
(She's surprisingly picky
about the little things...)
translations.▲小早川＊▲……もしかして機嫌が悪い？:
▲小早川＊▲... Are you in a
bad mood？
translations.あんなに混んでるのに係員が誘導しないなんて、信じられない。:
I can't believe the staff
didn't direct the crowd when
it was that packed.
translations.ああ……確かに運営は酷かったな。:
Yeah... The management
really was terrible.
translations.イベント以前の問題だね。これじゃ楽しめないよ。:
That's a problem before the
event even starts. There's
no enjoying it like this.
translations.ちなみにイベントの内容の方は……。:
And what about the event
itself...？
translations.▲小早川＊▲、横で見てて退屈そうだったけど、大丈夫だった？:
▲小早川＊▲, you looked pretty
bored next to me. Were you
all right？
translations.クラシックってさ、どうしてあんなに睡魔を呼び寄せるんだろうね。:
Why is it that classical
music always makes people
so sleepy？
translations.眠くなるのは、なんとなく……リズムなのかな？:
Maybe what makes you sleepy
is...the rhythm, or
something？
translations.でも、リンコは隣の人みたいに寝息は立ててないけど？: Still, I wasn't snoozing away like the person next to me, was I？
translations.▲小早川＊▲が座ってたのは、端の席だよな。: You had the seat on the end, right, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そう。だから隣の人は一人しかいないね。: Yep. Which means there was only one person sitting next to me.
translations.最初はアイドルのライブなんて……って言ってたのに、グッズを買うくらい気に入ったん: At first you were all 'An idol concert, really？', and now you liked it enough to buy merch.
translations.いいじゃん、感動したんだから。: So what？ It really moved me.
translations.悪いとは言ってないよ。: I'm not saying there's anything wrong with it.
translations.ならいいけど。アイドルはプロレスと一緒だね、まがいものも多いけど、本物は凄まじい: Good. Idols are just like pro wrestling. There are a lot of phonies out there, but the real deal is incredible.
translations.（おお、なんか熱いこと言ってるな……）: (Whoa, she's getting pretty passionate about this...)
translations.ミュージカルってさ、コンサートなのか劇なのか、よくわかんない。: With musicals, I can never really tell if they're supposed to be a concert or a play.
translations.落ち込むなっつーの。つまんなかったわけじゃないんだから。むしろ楽しかったよ？: Oh, don't look so down. It's not like I was bored. I actually had fun, okay？
translations.そう？ ならいいんだけど。: Really？ Well, as long as you enjoyed it.
translations.あまり形式にこだわり過ぎると、本質を見失うからね。大事なのは楽しめるかどうかだよ: Get too hung up on labels and you miss the whole point. What matters is whether you enjoy it.
translations.やっぱ生の戦いはテンションあがるね。: Nothing gets the blood pumping like seeing a match live.
translations.ゲームとはちがう興奮っていうかさ、息づかい？ そういうのまで感じられてこう……ビ: It's a different thrill from video games. You can hear them breathing and everything, and then... Wham!
translations.あ、ごめん。興奮して。中キックだったかも。: Oh, sorry. Got carried away. That might've been a medium kick.
translations.（大キックもあるのかな……）: (Does she have a heavy kick, too...？)
translations.……でさ、最後の回。アレがサヨナラ勝ちって言うんだ？: ...So, that last inning. That's what they call a walk-off win？
translations.野球のルール、だいたいはわかるだろ？: You know the basic rules of baseball, right？
translations.まあ、なんとなく。それより応援の方が面白かったけどね。: More or less. Watching the cheering section was way more fun, though.
translations.はは、まあその楽しみかたもアリだな。: Haha, well, that's one way to enjoy the game.
translations.特にほら、あのバク転するマスコットとかさ！ キモカワイイよね♪: Especially that mascot doing backflips! He's so creepy-cute♪
translations.リンコ……人混み苦手……。: I don't... do well with crowds...
translations.みんな必死だからな、●たちじゃ太刀打ちできないよ。: Everyone's dead serious here, ●. Casuals like us don't stand a chance.
translations.そうだね、物見遊山で来るものじゃないよ。楽しかったからいいけど。: Yeah, it's definitely not somewhere you just drop by for sightseeing. I had fun, though, so it's fine.
translations.通い続けてたら、もっと楽しくなるのかな？: I wonder if it gets even more fun once you're a regular？
translations.そうかもしれないけど……そこまではいいや。多趣味なリンコは忙しいからさ。: Maybe, but... I think I'll pass. I've got too many hobbies keeping me busy as it is.
translations.このベイブリッジがさ、穴場デートスポットだって雑誌に載ったらしいよ。: I heard a magazine listed the Bay Bridge as a 'hidden gem' of a date spot.
translations.穴場……か？ 結構メジャーだと思うんだけど。: A hidden gem...？ I'm pretty sure it's super famous.
translations.ねえ、きっとその記事の担当者は恥かいちゃったんじゃないかな。かわいそうに。: Right？ Whoever wrote that article must've been so embarrassed. Poor thing.
translations.そんな心配までするのか。: You're actually worried about the writer？
translations.“あの人、ベイブリッジのことも知らなかったらしいよ”なんて言われてると思うと、せ: It just breaks my heart picturing people saying, 'Apparently they'd never even heard of the Bay Bridge.'
translations.ここの眺めってキレイだよね、なんか絵ハガキみたい。: The view from here is really pretty, isn't it？ It looks like a postcard.
translations.えっと……“どんな風景よりキミの方がきれいだよ”。: Um... 'No view could ever be as beautiful as you.'
translations.はいはい、そーいうの似合わないから。先週のドラマだっけ？: Yeah, yeah, that doesn't suit you at all. Was that from last week's drama？
translations.はは、バレたか。こういう台詞、ちょっと言ってみたくて。: Haha, busted. I just kind of wanted to try saying a line like that.
translations.リンコはさ、そんな借り物の台詞じゃなくて、アンタの本音が聞けたらそれだけでうれし: I'd be happy just hearing how you really feel, instead of some borrowed line.
translations.こうしてるとさ、なんだかロマンチックな気分になるよな。: Being like this kind of puts you in a romantic mood, doesn't it？
translations.そう？ リンコは巨大怪獣がベイブリッジを破壊するシーンを想像した。: Does it？ I was picturing a giant monster destroying the Bay Bridge.
translations.あのな……●たち恋人なんだし、もうちょっとさ……。: Come on... You and ● are a couple, so couldn't you be a little more...
translations.じゃ、恋人っぽいことしてみる？ 肩に寄りかかったり、腕組んだり。そしたらどうせ照: Then want to try doing couple stuff？ Like leaning on your shoulder, or linking arms. You'd just get embarrassed anyway.
translations.そりゃお互い様だろ。: That goes for both of us.
translations.やっぱさ、カノジョの水着姿見たら、惚れ直したりするわけ？: So when you see your girlfriend in a swimsuit, does it make you fall for her all over again？
translations.ジロジロ見んな。惚れ直すっつーか、ただのエロジジイじゃん。: Quit staring. That's not falling in love again, you're just being a dirty old man.
translations.そーいうんじゃないって。いつでも見られるわけじゃないし……普段と違うカノジョの姿: It's not like that. It's not something I get to see all the time... I have to burn this rare sight of my girlfriend into my memory.
translations.なるほど……うーん、なんかキレイな言葉にしてるだけで、あんまりエロさが減った気が: I see... Hmm, I feel like you're just dressing it up in nice words, and it doesn't make it any less pervy.
translations.いつも思うんだけどさ。どうやったらナイスバディになれるのかな。: I always wonder... How do people get a figure like that？
translations.ああ……まあ、▲小早川＊▲はならなくてもいいだろ。今のままで。: Ah... Well, you don't need to, ▲小早川＊▲. You're fine just the way you are.
translations.そう言ってくれると助かるよ。あんなの真似できる気しないし。: It helps to hear you say that. I don't feel like I could ever pull that off anyway.
translations.ロリコンのカレシで助かるよ。: It's a big help having a lolicon for a boyfriend.
translations.もうっ、カレシならちゃんとリンコのこと、見ててよ！: Geez, if you're my boyfriend, keep your eyes on me!
translations.アンタがフラフラしてるから、ナンパ男に声かけられた。: You wandered off, so some guy tried to hit on me.
translations.え!? ごめん、大丈夫だったか？ そいつはどこに……。: What!? Sorry, are you okay？ Where did the guy go...
translations.今頃病院かもね。キックしてやったし。: Probably the hospital by now. I kicked him.
translations.だから危ないって……。: I keep telling you that's dangerous...
translations.ぜんぜん。ちょっと冷たくて、気持ちいいくらいだよ。: Not at all. It's just cool enough to feel nice.
translations.やれやれ……たまに子供っぽいよな。: Good grief... You can be kind of childish sometimes.
translations.何か言った、ジジイ。: Did you say something, old man？
translations.ほら、裸足で波打ち際に立ってると、波が引くとき気持ちいいからさ、やってみれば？: Come on, when you stand barefoot at the water's edge, it feels really nice when the waves pull back. Why don't you try it？
translations.どうした、何か見つけたのか？: What's up？ Did you find something？
translations.ううん。こう、静かなところに２人きりだとさ、世界にリンコたちしかいないのかも……: Nope. It's just, when we're all alone somewhere quiet like this, don't you ever feel like maybe we're the only ones left in the world？
translations.そうだな、わかるかも。本当に世界で２人きりになったらどうする？: Yeah, I think I get that. What would you do if we really were the only two left in the world？
translations.それでもいいんじゃない？ ひとりはヤだけど、ふたりなら、さ。: Wouldn't that be fine？ I'd hate to be alone, but if it's the two of us...
translations.……寒っ。こんな時期に海なんて、リンコたちバカじゃん。: ...Brr, it's freezing. We're idiots for coming to the beach this time of year.
translations.空気は澄んでて、気持ちいいと思ったんだけどな。: I thought it'd feel nice with the air so clear, though.
translations.リンコは澄んだ空気より、あったかい空気がいい。: I'd take warm air over clear air any day.
translations.コイツさ、いったい何を考えてるんだろ。:
I wonder what's going through
this guy's head.
translations.う～ん、漫然と、ぼうっとしてるだけとか。:
Hmm, maybe he's just stunned,
zoning out like a fish.
translations.漫然と、ぼうっと……略して？:
Stunned, like a fish...
And for short？
translations.取り上げる座布団がないから……罰としてキックでいい？:
I can't dock you points for that
pun... so is a kick okay instead？
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ どうした、水槽にらんで。:
▲小早川＊▲？ Why are you
glaring at the tank？
translations.リンコは売られたケンカを買ってるだけ。先ににらんできたのはコイツ。:
He picked a fight, so I'm taking
him on. He glared at me first.
translations.マンボウとにらめっこか。勝敗つくのか？:
A staring contest with a sunfish？
Can anyone even win that？
translations.表情読めないんだよね……そのくせ、こっちのこと見透かしたような雰囲気を感じるし。:
I can't read his face... yet it
feels like he sees right through
me. He's a tricky opponent.
translations.あのさ、ペンギンって飼えないのかな？:
Hey, do you think you can
keep a penguin as a pet？
translations.この環境を自宅で再現するのは、大変そうだな。飼いたいのか？:
Recreating an environment like
this at home would be rough.
Do you want one？
translations.まさか、言ってみただけ。: As if. I was just asking.
translations.そりゃそうだな……ペンギンって散歩とかするのかな。:
Yeah, figured... I wonder if you
have to walk a penguin, though.
translations.首輪とリードつけて？ なんかシュール。:
With a collar and a leash？
That'd look pretty surreal.
translations.ペンギンってさ、愛嬌のある生き物だよね。:
Penguins really are charming
little creatures, aren't they？
translations.ひょこひょこって歩くとことかな。:
Yeah, like how they waddle
around.
translations.生まれながらこれって、勝ち組だよね。:
Being born that cute basically
makes them winners at life.
translations.はは、もしかしてネコに匹敵するぐらい好きだったり？:
Haha, do you like them almost
as much as cats now？
translations.それはないって。ネコはちょっとそういうのじゃないし、殿堂入りだよ。:
Not a chance. Cats are in a
different league. They're in
the Hall of Fame.
translations.おっ……すげぇ！ イワシの群れって迫力あるよな。:
Whoa... awesome! A school of
sardines is seriously impressive.
translations.大声あげてはしゃいでいいのは、小学生まで。いい歳して恥ずかしいっつーの。:
Only grade-schoolers get a pass
for yelling like that. Act your
age, you're embarrassing me.
translations.あっ！ ほら、見て見て。マンタが泳いでる！:
Oh! Hey, look, look!
There's a manta ray swimming by!
translations.うるさい、いいじゃん、マンタなんだから。:
Shut up, it's fine!
It's a manta ray, after all.
translations.（なにがいいのか、さっぱりわからん！）:
(I have no idea what difference
that makes!)
translations.水中トンネルって、誰が発明したんだろうね。:
I wonder who invented the
underwater tunnel.
translations.水槽をトンネルにしたんだから、斬新だよな。:
Turning a fish tank into a
tunnel is pretty clever, yeah.
translations.トンネルを水槽にしたんでしょ。:
Pretty sure they turned a
tunnel into a fish tank.
translations.どっちでもいいって。だから、トンネルを水槽にしたってことで。:
Doesn't really matter which.
So let's just say they turned
a tunnel into a fish tank.
translations.水族館に来たらさ、イルカショーは外せないよね。:
You can't go to an aquarium
and skip the dolphin show.
translations.イルカと一緒に泳げるとこってあるじゃん、ここではやらないのかな。:
Some places let you swim with
the dolphins, right？ I wonder
if they don't do that here.
translations.聞いたことないな……。: Never heard of them doing it here...
translations.どうすればいいんだろ、ここの株主になればいいかな。:
Wonder what it'd take. Maybe I
should become a shareholder here？
translations.（夢見がちなのか現実的なのか、どっちなんだ……）:
(I can't tell if she's being a
dreamer or a realist here...)
translations.▲小早川＊▲、あんまり前行くと、水被るぞ。:
▲小早川＊▲, if you go too far
up front, you'll get splashed.
translations.少しくらい水を被るのがイルカショーの楽しみ方だよ。: Getting splashed a little is part of the fun of a dolphin show.
translations.いつの間に逃げたんだ、▲小早川＊▲。: When did you get out of the way, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.へへ、格ゲーで磨かれたリンコの危機回避能力だよ。: Hehe, you can thank fighting games for honing my dodging reflexes.
translations.この公園ってさ、カップルに人気だよね。: This park is pretty popular with couples, isn't it？
translations.そうだなあ……何故か深夜は更に増えるらしいぞ。: Yeah... Apparently there's even more of them late at night for some reason.
translations.高校生には縁がない話だけどな。: Not that it has anything to do with high schoolers, though.
translations.ふーん、なんかいつもと違って爽やかだね、アンタ。: Hmm, look at you being all wholesome for once.
translations.この公園から眺める海って、リンコ、わりと好きかも。: I think I actually kind of like the view of the ocean from this park.
translations.そうだな。たまに港を出て行く客船も見えたりして。: Yeah. Sometimes you can even see cruise ships leaving the port.
translations.これでもうちょっと浮ついた雰囲気が薄まればね。: Now if only this place would tone it down a little.
translations.音じゃなくて、雰囲気。こうデートスポット、って感じじゃん。: Not the noise, the vibe. It just screams "date spot," you know？
translations.（●たちもデートしてるしなあ……）: (Well, we're on a date right now too, ●...)
translations.今日は少し風あるね。: It's a little breezy today, huh？
translations.そうだな……。これも海沿いの公園って感じだけどな。: Yeah... Makes it feel like a real seaside park, though.
translations.そうだね、磯くさいってわけじゃないし。けっこう快適だよ。: True, and it doesn't smell like low tide or anything. It's actually pretty nice.
translations.海、風とくればあとは……。: We've got the sea and the breeze, so all that's left is...
translations.雷とか？ ほら、アクセントにさ。: Lightning, maybe？ You know, to spice things up.
translations.（一気に快適じゃなくなりそうだけど……）: (Pretty sure that'd ruin the nice weather real quick...)
translations.こうやって下見てると、吸い込まれそうにならない？: When you look down like this, doesn't it feel like you're gonna get sucked in？
translations.あ、もしかして高いトコ恐いとか？: Oh, wait. Are you afraid of heights or something？
translations.そんなこと……想像力が豊かなだけだって。だからこう、吸い込まれる様子がリアルに…: No way... I just have an active imagination, that's all. Like, I can vividly picture getting sucked in...
translations.たしかに想像力豊かだよね、でもどっちかっていうと……妄想力？: You definitely have an active imagination, yeah. Or is it more like... delusions？
translations.ここってさ、カップルも多いのにお土産物が弱いよね。: For a place that gets this many couples, the souvenirs here are pretty weak, huh？
translations.スカイタワーせんべいにスカイタワー最中……だもんな。: Yeah... It's all Sky Tower rice crackers and Sky Tower bean wafers.
translations.スカイタワー変形ロボとか作ればいいのに、弟だったら喜ぶよ。: They should make a transforming Sky Tower robot or something. My little brother would love that.
translations.そりゃ子供は喜ぶだろうけど……。: Well sure, kids would love it, but...
translations.いっそ本当にタワーを変形可能にしてアトラクション化！ どう？: Better yet, make the actual tower transform and turn it into a ride! How about that？
translations.はは、それなら面白そうだな。: Haha, now that actually sounds fun.
translations.こういう建物の中にいるとさ、緊急時どうやって脱出するんだろうって考えない？: When you're inside a building like this, don't you ever wonder how you'd escape in an emergency？
translations.わからなくもないけど……慎重っていうかネガティブすぎないか。: I kinda get it, but... isn't that less cautious and more just pessimistic？
translations.そうかな、結構楽しい空想だと思うんだけど。: You think？ I think it's a pretty fun thing to daydream about.
translations.空想？ 脱出装置の話だろ？: Daydream？ We're talking about escape devices, right？
translations.スライダーで滑って脱出とか、一人用の小型ロケットで射出される、とかそういうの。: Like sliding down a chute to escape, or getting launched out in a one-person mini rocket. Stuff like that.
translations.（これも弟と見てるロボットアニメの影響か？）: (Is this another thing she picked up from watching robot anime with her little brother？)
translations.試着してくるから、ちょっと待ってて。感想もよろしく。: I'm gonna go try this on, so wait here a sec. Let me know what you think.
translations.……今の、いかにもカップル定番の会話って感じで、ちょっと許せない気が……。: ...That just sounded like such a cliché couple exchange, I'm not sure I can let it slide...
translations.いいじゃん、定番でも、楽しけりゃさ。: Come on, what's wrong with cliché as long as we're having fun？
translations.世の中は便利になったはずなのに、ちょっと体のサイズが平均からずれてるだけで衣服に: The world's supposed to be so convenient now, so why is it still such a pain to find clothes just because your measurements are a little off average？
translations.そういうもん？ たしかに女の子の方が大変そうだけど。: Is it really like that？ Though I guess girls do have it tougher.
translations.ほんとだよ、女子の体の方が……なんていうの、バラエティに富んでるからさ。: Seriously. Girls' bodies have a lot more... how do I put it, variety to them.
translations.それは……ほら、出たり引っ込んだり、そういうの！: You know... curves in some places, not in others, stuff like that!
translations.（これ以上つっこむのはやめよう……）: (Better not press her any further on this...)
translations.ここにいるとさ、時間経つの忘れるね。: It's easy to lose track of time in a place like this.
translations.そんなに好きだっけ、こういうの。: I didn't know you were that into this kind of stuff.
translations.無駄にジャラジャラしてるのが好きじゃないだけ、さりげないのがいいよね。: I just don't like stuff that's all flashy and gaudy. Subtle is nice, though.
translations.そうそう、そういう……値段はさりげなくないみたいだけど。: Yeah, just like that... Though the price tag doesn't look very subtle.
translations.よく婚約指輪は給料の三ヶ月分って言うよね。誰が決めたんだろ。: People always say an engagement ring should cost three months' salary. Wonder who came up with that.
translations.なんか、メーカーのキャッチコピーだったとかなんとか。: I heard it was an ad slogan from some jewelry company or something.
translations.ふーん。じゃあ確たる根拠があるわけじゃないんだ。: Huh. So it's not like there's any real basis for it.
translations.だなあ。でも三ヶ月分！ って奮発した感じがするよな。: Guess not. Still, 'three months' salary!' really makes it sound like you went all out.
translations.別に何ヶ月分でもいいけどさ、あんまり値段を強調されるとちょっと引いちゃうよ。: I don't really care how many months' worth it is, honestly. Making a huge deal out of the price is kind of a turn-off.
translations.▲小早川＊▲もメイクに興味あるのか？: Are you interested in makeup too, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そりゃ女子ですから。今のところ、ほとんど興味だけだけど。: Well, I am a girl. For now it's mostly just curiosity, though.
translations.まあ必要ないよな。: Well, it's not like you need it.
translations.何利いた風なこと言ってんの。あ、カノジョは自分の思い通りにしたいタイプだっけ。: Look at you, talking like you know it all. Oh, or are you the type who wants his girlfriend just the way he likes her？
translations.そんなんじゃないって。せっかく元がキレイなんだから……っていう。: That's not what I meant. I just meant you're already pretty without it...
translations.ふーん……へへ、最後までちゃんと言えっつーの。: Hmm... Hehe, don't trail off at the end, say it properly.
translations.こんなにたくさん種類があって、選ぶだけでも大変そうだな。: With this many kinds to choose from, just picking one out looks like a lot of work.
translations.他人事みたいに言ってるけど、男用のも結構あるよ。: You say that like it has nothing to do with you, but there's plenty of men's stuff here too.
translations.へえ……まあ他人事かな？: Huh... Well, still doesn't really apply to me, does it？
translations.へへ、他人事じゃなくしてみる？: Hehe, want me to make it apply to you？
translations.なに言ってんの、その歳でチャレンジ精神なくしてたらすぐ老けるよ。: Come on, if you lose your sense of adventure at your age, you're gonna get old fast.
translations.この湖で恋人と一緒にボードに乗ると、一生添い遂げられるらしいよ？: They say if you ride a boat on this lake with your sweetheart, you'll stay together forever.
translations.それだけで？ なんか簡単すぎないか？: Just from that？ Doesn't that sound a little too easy？
translations.さすがに気付くか。そう、条件がある。: Figured you'd catch on. Yeah, there's a catch.
translations.湖の外周を３０分以内に一周するんだって、まだ誰も達成してないみたいだけど。: You have to do a full lap around the lake in under thirty minutes. Apparently nobody's ever pulled it off, though.
translations.（３０分全力でこぎ続けるのか……やってみたい！ とか言わないよな……）: (Rowing at full speed for thirty minutes straight... Please tell me she's not gonna say she wants to try it...)
translations.湖の売店で売ってるソフトクリームが美味しいんだってさ。: I heard the soft-serve they sell at the lake stand is really good.
translations.そうなの？ 牧場が隣接してるわけでもないしなあ。: Really？ It's not like there's a farm right next door or anything.
translations.甘い。海の家で食べるラーメンやカレーを美味しく感じるのと同じだよ。: You're so naive. It's the same reason ramen and curry taste better at a beach hut.
translations.それはなんとなくわかるな。: Okay, I kinda get what you mean.
translations.シチュエーションも大切ってこと。ほら、行こ。: It's all about the atmosphere. Come on, let's go.
translations.ここって小学生の遠足の定番なんだよね。リンコも来たことある。: This place is a classic spot for grade school field trips. I've been here before, too.
translations.へえ、楽しい思い出でもある？: Oh yeah？ Got any fun memories of it？
translations.むしろ哀しい思い出。お気に入りの帽子を湖に落としちゃってさ。: More like a sad one. I dropped my favorite hat into the lake.
translations.金の帽子か、普通の帽子かって？: Did someone ask if you dropped a golden hat or a regular hat？
translations.だったらよかったんだけどね、当時のピュアなリンコはきっと普通の帽子を選んだはずだ: I wish. Though the pure, innocent me back then definitely would've picked the regular hat.
translations.遊覧船に乗るとさ、一番先に立ってみたいと思わない？: When you're on a sightseeing boat, don't you kinda want to stand right at the very front？
translations.ああ、ジェットコースターの先頭！ みたいな。: Oh, yeah, like riding in the front car of a roller coaster!
translations.違うっつーの。そうじゃなくて……ほら……もっと恋人っぽい。: No, that's not what I mean. Not like that... You know... More like a couple.
translations.そうそれ！ ……だけど、やっぱ、今のなし。: Yeah, that! ...Actually, never mind. Forget I said anything.
translations.遊覧船って、なんでこんなにゆっくりなんだろ。: How come sightseeing boats go so slow？
translations.遊覧だからな、ゆっくり景色を眺めるためじゃないか。: Well, it's for sightseeing. You're supposed to take your time and enjoy the view.
translations.もっとさ、風を切って走ったりしたら人気出ると思わない？ 多少小さくなってもいいか: Don't you think it'd be more popular if it tore across the water？ Even if the boat had to be a little smaller.
translations.それはどっちかっていうと遊園地のアトラクションだな。: That sounds more like an amusement park ride.
translations.そっか。じゃあいっそここをテーマパーク化……はダメだね、せっかくの雰囲気が台無し: True. Maybe they should just turn this whole place into a theme park... Nah, that'd ruin the nice atmosphere.
translations.船旅って憧れるよね、世界一周とかさ。: Going on a cruise sounds so nice. Like sailing around the world.
translations.へえ、▲小早川＊▲ってそういうのめんどくさがりそうなのに。: Huh. I figured you'd find something like that too much trouble, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……たしかに船で世界一周は長いよね、飽きそう。: ...Now that you mention it, sailing around the world does take a long time. I'd probably get bored.
translations.だろ？ 結局船の中で読書とゲームばっかりだったりして。: Right？ You'd probably just end up reading and playing games in your cabin the whole time.
translations.それ否定できないよ。世界半周とか四分の一、いっそ日本一周でもいいかな。: I can't even deny that. Maybe halfway around the world, or a quarter... Or honestly, just around Japan would be fine.
translations.これ、ハイキングじゃなかったっけ。: Wait, wasn't this supposed to be a hike？
translations.本格的登山にしか思えないんですけど……。: Because this feels like full-on mountain climbing to me...
translations.コースの選択ミスだな……。: Guess we picked the wrong trail...
translations.あーもう、誰なのこんなコース考えたの。: Ugh, seriously, who came up with this trail？
translations.（▲小早川＊▲が、きついコースがいいって言ったんだけどな……）: (▲小早川＊▲ was the one who said she wanted a tough trail, though...)
translations.よし、ここでちょっと休憩にするか。: All right, let's take a quick break here.
translations.へへ。リンコはちゃんとオヤツ用意してきたよ、ポテチ。: Hehe. I made sure to pack snacks for us—potato chips.
translations.ここでもポテチか。体動かすからエネルギーになりそうなものにすればいいのに。: Potato chips even out here, huh？ Since we're getting a workout, you'd think we'd want something that gives us more energy.
translations.リンコのエネルギー源はポテチだから、問題ないよ。: Potato chips are my main source of energy, so it's fine.
translations.はは、まあ気持ちの問題か。: Haha, I guess it's a mindset thing.
translations.なにそれ、文句ある？ せっかくアンタの分も持ってきたのに。: What's that supposed to mean？ Got a problem with it？ And here I went and brought some for you, too.
translations.ごめんごめん、ありがたくもらうよ。: Sorry, sorry. I'll gladly take some.
translations.さっき年配の人にまで追い抜かれたよ……。: We just got passed by an older hiker back there...
translations.しょうがないだろ、慣れないコースで。: Can't help it, we're not used to this trail.
translations.まったくジジイはこれだから。リンコが手引いてあげようか？: Man, old guys, I swear. Want me to hold your hand and lead you？
translations.……もう一ガンバリ、行くぞ！: ...Time for one more push. Let's go!
translations.気合いだけは充分なんだけどね。ほら、がんばれがんばれ。: You've got plenty of spirit, at least. Come on, keep at it.
translations.きれいだけど、あんまり見とれてると、危ないよね。: It's pretty, sure, but staring too hard is dangerous, isn't it？
translations.足もとに気をつけないとな。落ち葉って滑るし。: Yeah, gotta watch our step. Fallen leaves are slippery.
translations.そうじゃなくて。見とれているうちに深い山の中へと誘い込まれ……キャーッ！: Not like that. You get so entranced you're lured deep into the mountains... Eek!
translations.……なんでそんなホラー的な展開になるんだよ。: ...Why did you turn it into a horror story？
translations.んー、同じ景色ばっかでちょっと飽きてきたから。: Hmm, well, the scenery's all the same, so I was getting a little bored.
translations.もうすぐ頂上だから、ガマンしろって。ほら。: We're almost at the summit, so just hang in there. Come on.
translations.▲小早川＊▲はあんまり写真撮らないんだな。: You don't take many pictures, huh, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.まあね……なんとなく。撮らなくてもいいかもって。: Yeah, well... Just felt like maybe I didn't need to.
translations.もともとそこまで撮る方じゃないけどさ、この風景は目に焼き付けといた方がいいかなっ: I'm not big on taking pictures to begin with, and I figured I'd rather burn this view into my memory.
translations.こういうのもライブ感っていうのかな。そんな感じ。: I guess you'd call it experiencing it live. Something like that.
translations.せっかくスキーに来たのに、機嫌悪そうだな？: We came all the way out here to ski, so why the bad mood？
translations.……さっき小学生に、スキースクール参加の仲間と間違われた。: ...Some grade schooler just mistook me for one of the kids in their ski class.
translations.たしかに体はちょっと小さいけど……スキーはプロ級だっつーの。: Sure, I'm a little short, but... I'm practically a pro on skis.
translations.頭来たから、目の前でリンコの超絶技巧を見せつけてやったよ。: It ticked me off, so I showed off my killer skills right in front of them.
translations.ちょっと休もう。それにしても▲小早川＊▲、やっぱ上手いな。: Let's take a quick break. Still, you really are good at this, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.へへ、もっと言ってもいーけど？: Hehe, you can keep the compliments coming, you know？
translations.はは、調子に乗ると転ぶぞ。: Haha, don't get cocky or you'll wipe out.
translations.誰に言ってるんだっつーの。置いてくよっ。: Who do you think you're talking to？ I'm leaving you behind!
translations.スキー場で飲むコーヒーって、美味しいよね。: Coffee at a ski resort tastes so good, doesn't it？
translations.わかるわかる。身体があったまってく感じが気持ちいいよな。: Totally. That feeling of warming up from the inside out is great.
translations.あの感覚のためにスキーをするっていうのも間違ってないと思うね。: Honestly, I think skiing just for that feeling is totally valid.
translations.はは、“この一杯のために生きてる！”みたいなやつだな。: Haha, the whole "I live for this one cup!" thing, huh.
translations.オッサンくさい例え！: That sounds like such an old man thing to say!
translations.その抽象画、気になるのか？: Did that abstract painting catch your eye？
translations.リンコの描いた絵と、これと、そんなに違うとは思えないんだけどな……。: I really don't think there's much difference between this and the stuff I draw...
translations.そう思いたくなる気持ちもわかるけど……。: I get why you'd want to think that, but...
translations.見れば見るほど似てると思えてくるよ。ぐにゃっとしたラインが特に。: The more I look at it, the more alike they seem. Especially those squiggly lines.
translations.（もしかして▲小早川＊▲には絵の才能が……まさかな）: (Could ▲小早川＊▲ actually have a talent for art...？ Nah, no way.)
translations.入口にあった彫像、気づいた？: Did you notice that statue by the entrance？
translations.教頭先生にそっくり。……ぷっ。: It looks just like the vice principal. ...Pfft.
translations.……ははっ。言われるとたしかに。: ...Haha. Now that you mention it, it really does.
translations.いっそ教頭像として、学校に寄贈してほしいレベルだよ。みんな絶賛間違いなし。: They might as well donate it to our school as a statue of him. Everyone would love it.
translations.芸術はいいよね。こうして眺めてるだけでも心が洗われる気がするよ。: Art is nice, isn't it？ Just looking at it like this is good for the soul.
translations.おお、なんかすごいな、▲小早川＊▲。わかるのか。: Whoa, impressive, ▲小早川＊▲. You actually get this stuff？
translations.なんとなくわかったつもりでいると、そのうちわかるように……ならないかな？: I figured if I pretend I understand it, maybe I'll actually start to get it eventually...？
translations.キリンってさ、どうしてあんなに首が長くなったんだろうね。: I wonder why giraffes ended up with such long necks.
translations.高いところのエサを食べるために進化したんじゃなかったか？: Didn't they evolve that way to reach food high up in the trees？
translations.なら、足が伸びても良かったんじゃない？ 首だと疲れそうじゃん。: Then couldn't their legs have just gotten longer instead？ Having a long neck seems exhausting.
translations.それだと逆に低いところのエサが食べにくいんじゃないか、首だったら、首だけ下げられ: Wouldn't that make it harder to eat food down low？ With a long neck, all they have to do is lower their head.
translations.なら！ ……うーん……思いつかない、アンタの勝ちでいいよ。: Well then! ...Hmm... I got nothing. Fine, you win.
translations.キリンって動物園でも一、二を争う人気動物かもね。: Giraffes might just be the number one or two most popular animals at the zoo.
translations.リンコも、昔好きでさ、遠足のときなんかによくキリンの絵を描いたよ。: I used to like them a lot too. I'd always draw giraffes when we came on field trips.
translations.へえ、どんなできだったんだ？: Oh yeah？ How'd they turn out？
translations.“リンコちゃん、消防車を描くときは黄色じゃなくて赤のクレヨンを使いましょうね”っ: 'Rinko-chan, when you draw a fire truck, let's use a red crayon instead of yellow, okay？'
translations.動物園に来て消防車の絵なんか描かないっつーの！: Like I'd draw a fire truck on a trip to the zoo!
translations.（だめだ……どんな絵か想像できない……）: (Man... I can't even picture what that drawing looked like...)
translations.ライオンがエサを食べる瞬間って、目の前で見ると迫力あるね。: Seeing a lion eat up close in person is pretty intense.
translations.だなあ、見てるとこっちまでどう猛な気分に……。: Yeah, watching it makes me feel kinda ferocious myself...
translations.ライオンのエサ見てお腹鳴らすって……ねえ？: Your stomach is growling at lion food... Seriously？
translations.つい……ほら、●、肉食系だから！ ……なんつって。: I couldn't help it... Hey, ●'s a real carnivore, you know! ...Just kidding.
translations.あー、赤ちゃんライオンかわいいー♪: Aw, look how cute the baby lion is♪
translations.檻の中の百獣の王……シュールだね。: The king of beasts in a cage... Kind of surreal.
translations.やっぱり野生のライオンと戦ったら負けちゃうのかな。: I wonder if it'd lose in a fight against a wild lion.
translations.そんな気もするけど……ライオン同士って戦うんだっけ。: Probably... Wait, do lions even fight each other？
translations.さあ。でもやっぱ、男である以上は戦うんじゃないの、愛する女のために。ねえ？: Who knows. Still, any real male would fight for the woman he loves, right？
translations.鳥にエサをあげられるんだってさ、どうする？: Looks like you can feed the birds here. Wanna do it？
translations.（鳥に悪気はないと思うんだけどな……）: (I don't think the birds meant any harm...)
translations.まあ、ネコはここじゃなくてもふれあえるしな。: Well, you don't really need to come to a zoo to see cats.
translations.ネコ科の子はどこかな？: I wonder where the felines are？
translations.ふうん、カメラか。\nこういうの興味あるんだ？:
Hmm, cameras, huh？
You into this kind of stuff？
translations.もしかして、\n大砲みたいなレンズ持ってたりする？:
Don't tell me you own
a lens the size of a cannon？
translations.なーんだ、それでリンコを激写してるかと思ったのに。:
Aw, and here I thought you
were using it to snap pics
of me.
translations.▲小早川＊▲を撮るのは好きだけどな。:
I do love taking pictures
of ▲小早川＊▲, though.
translations.なんでいきなり、好きとか言うかな……。安売り禁止。:
Why do you just say 'love'
out of nowhere...？ Don't
throw it around so cheaply.
translations.あ、このデジカメ、ちっちゃくてイイかも。:
Oh, this digital camera is
so tiny. It's kinda nice.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、写真に興味あんの？:
Are you interested in
photography, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そうでもないけど。歩いてて美人さんを見つけると撮りたくなるでしょ？:
Not really. But when you spot
a beauty on the street, you
wanna snap a photo, right？
translations.美人さん？\n……もしかして、猫か？:
A beauty？
...Wait, do you mean a cat？
translations.それ以外に被写体はあり得ないね。:
Any other subject is
out of the question.
translations.ねえ。\nカメラってさ、たくさん種類があるんだね。:
Hey.
There really are a ton of
different cameras, huh.
translations.新機種が次々に出るからな。:
Yeah, new models come out
one after another.
translations.ふーん……それってさ、下手でも上手に撮れるようになってるってこと？:
Hmm... Does that mean they're
made so even bad photographers
can take good pictures？
translations.そういう目的のもあるだろうな。:
I'm sure some of them are
designed with that in mind.
translations.なんか寂しくない？ 趣味の世界ってそんなんじゃないと思うね、リンコは。:
Isn't that kinda sad？ I don't
think that's what a hobby
should be about.
translations.そうかもな。だけど誰でも簡単にできるってのも、いいことだと思うぞ。:
Maybe. Still, I think making
it easy for anyone to get
into is a good thing, too.
translations.またジジイはそうやって、大人ぶる……。:
There you go again, old man,
acting all grown-up...
translations.重い……、なにこのペン？: So heavy... What is this pen？
translations.勉強しながら鍛えられる、文武両道ペン？ だってさ。:
It says it's the 'Brains and
Brawn Pen' that lets you work
out while you study.
translations.ははっ、確かに。\n▲小早川＊▲だったら、どういう名前にする？:
Haha, true.
What would you name it,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.お、こっちに海外のポテチがあるぞ。:
Oh, they've got imported
potato chips over here.
translations.どれどれ……。\n……ホットペッパーにテリヤキソース……、えっ!!:
Let's see...
...Hot pepper, teriyaki
sauce... Huh？!
translations.これだけじゃ、ネタが何かわかんないじゃん。:
That doesn't even tell you
what kind of fish is on it.
translations.このネコ貯金箱、デザインをした人の人格を疑うよ。:
This cat piggy bank makes me
question the character of
whoever designed it.
translations.だって、取り出し口が無いんだよ。\nてことは、この子を壊す前提ってことでしょ？:
Because there's no stopper
to get the coins out.
Meaning you're supposed to
smash this poor thing, right？
translations.どういうつもりだろ、ほんと、こんなかわいい子を……。:
What were they thinking,
seriously？ Doing that to
such a cute little guy...
translations.（●はそんな▲小早川＊▲の方がかわいいと思う）:
(● thinks ▲小早川＊▲ is
way cuter right now.)
translations.さあ、全てを委ねる覚悟、できた？:
Alright, are you ready to
leave everything in my hands？
translations.リンコが頭からつま先まで、ビシッとコーディネートするってこと。:
It means I'm gonna style you
from head to toe.
translations.大船に乗ったつもりでいてよ。\n今日はファッションシーンにパラダイムシフトが起こ:
Just sit back and relax.
Today, we're causing a paradigm
shift in the fashion scene.
translations.（●、どんなカッコさせられるんだ……？）:
(What kind of outfit is
● gonna get put in...？)
translations.あ、このワンピース、試してみよっかな。\nちょっと待ってて。:
Oh, maybe I'll try this
dress on.
Wait here a sec.
translations.これ着るにはさ、リンコのレベルが足りなかったみたい。:
Looks like my level isn't
high enough to wear this.
translations.……メリハリとも言う。\nこれ以上言わせたら、蹴るよ。:
...You could also call it
curves. Make me say any more
and I'll kick you.
translations.そうだ。今日は、▲小早川＊▲の弟の服を選ぶってのはどうだ？:
Hey, how about we pick out
some clothes for your little
brother today, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ああ、きっと喜ぶぞ？: Yeah, I bet he'd like that.
translations.うん、……へへ、ありがと。\nふたりで子供服選びか……なんかいいじゃん。:
Yeah... Hehe, thanks.
Picking out kids' clothes
together... That's kinda nice.
translations.夫婦に間違われたりしてな！:
People might even mistake us
for a married couple!
translations.バカじゃん。たまにはいいこと言うと思ったのにさ。:
What are you, stupid？
And here I thought you had a
good idea for once.
translations.あー、もうメダル無くなっちゃったよ。:
Ugh, I'm out of tokens
already.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、真剣だったな。\n瞬きしてなかったぞ。:
You were really into that,
▲小早川＊▲.
You didn't even blink.
translations.ちょ、ちょっと、なに見てんだっつーの。まったく……、\nん？ あれ、メダルだ。一:
H-Hey, quit staring at me,
would you？ Honestly...
Hm？ Oh, I missed a token.
translations.おっ！ ラストチャンスだな。\n勝負だ、▲小早川＊▲!!:
Oh! One last chance.
This is it, ▲小早川＊▲!!
translations.プレッシャーかけんなっつーの。\n……アンタがやってよ、最後の一回。\nほら、託:
Quit pressuring me.
...Here, you do the last one.
I'm counting on you!
translations.（ミスったら責められるんだよな……）:
(She's totally going to blame
me if I mess this up...)
translations.競馬ゲームか……。\n……あ、これいい！ この馬にしなよ。:
A horse racing game, huh...
...Oh, this one's good!
Go with this horse.
translations.いいじゃん、好きでしょ、鯖缶。:
Come on, you like canned
mackerel, don't you？
translations.いいから。ほら、早くしないと、出走しちゃうよ。\nいっけー！ 鯖缶!!:
Whatever. Hurry up or the
race'll start without us.
Go! Canned Mackerel!!
translations.メダルの雪崩が起きそう……。:
Looks like a token avalanche
is about to happen...
translations.プッシャー機っていうみたいだな。自分が入れたコインで、中にあるコインを押し出すん:
It's called a coin pusher.
You use the coins you put in
to push out the ones inside.
translations.なるほど……単純だけどいいね、これ。:
I see... It's simple,
but I like it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が静かに燃えてる……。:
▲小早川＊▲ is quietly
getting fired up...
translations.へへ。\n金貨の山を前にした、海賊の気持ちだね。さあ、やるよ。:
Hehe.
I feel like a pirate in front
of a pile of gold. Here I go.
translations.（燃えてるっていうか、なんかギラギラしてるな……）:
(She's less "fired up" and
more "glinting with greed"...)
translations.ああ、ダメだ……。ショットが安定しない。:
Ugh, no good... My shots
are all over the place.
translations.アンタの場合はさ、メンタルの問題じゃない。\n……そうだ、テレビの番組みたいに、:
With you, it's a mental thing,
isn't it？ ...Maybe a prize
would help, like on TV？
translations.▲小早川＊▲が、賞品くれるの？:
You'll give me a prize,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.うん。\n……あ、待って、やっぱ逆にする。:
Yeah.
...Oh, wait. Actually,
let's do the opposite.
translations.そう、外したら罰を与えることにした。:
Yeah. I decided I'll punish
you if you miss.
translations.隣の人、変わった色のダーツ使ってるね？:
That person next to us is
using some unusual-colored
darts, huh？
translations.ああ、マイダーツだな。オーダーメイドかも。:
Yeah, those are their own
personal darts. Might even be
custom-made.
translations.へえ、そんなのあるんだ……。:
Huh, I didn't know that
was a thing...
translations.●たちも作ってみる？:
Should we get some made
for ourselves too, ●？
translations.面白そう。\nリンコは音の出るのがいいな。どこに当たっても、ブルに入ったみたいな:
Sounds fun. I want ones that
make noise, so it'll feel like
a bullseye wherever they hit.
translations.ほんとだ。店主催のダーツ大会か。:
Oh, yeah. Looks like an
in-house darts tournament.
translations.賞品は……ダーツボード？ なんか微妙。:
The prize is... a dartboard？
Kind of underwhelming.
translations.ほら、野球大会の賞品がバットとかさ、作文コンクールで鉛筆もらったり、大食い大会で:
It's like winning a bat at a
baseball tourney, pencils in
an essay contest, or a meal
voucher at an eating contest.
Like, thanks, I've got plenty.
translations.なるほど。確かに、そうかも。:
I see. Yeah, you might have
a point.
translations.そんな無理な姿勢で打たなくても、補助具を使えば？:
You don't have to strain
yourself like that. Why not
use the cue rest？
translations.いや。\n……初めてそれ見たときから、絶対使わないって思ってた。:
No way.
...Ever since I first saw that
thing, I swore I'd never use it.
translations.どうして？ 別に背の低い人のためのものってわけじゃ――:
Why？ It's not like it's only
for short people—
translations.誰もそんなこと言ってないっつーの。\nその佇まいがイヤなの。:
Nobody said anything about
that! I just hate the way
it looks.
translations.連敗だ……。\n絶好調だな▲小早川＊▲。:
Another loss...
You're on a roll, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.へへ、今のリンコにはボールが止まって見えるよ。:
Hehe. Right now, the ball
looks like it's standing
completely still to me.
translations.（……そりゃ、打つ時は止まってるな）:
(...Well, yeah. It is standing
still when you hit it.)
translations.うん……、でも、これ見よがしな感じが、鼻につくね。\n対決、申し込む？:
Yeah... Though the way he's
showing off is kind of grating.
Wanna challenge him？
translations.返り討ちにあうのが目に見えてるだろ。:
It's obvious he'd wipe the
floor with us.
translations.うーん……じゃあ、こっちの土俵に引き込むとか？:
Hmm... Then what if we bring
him onto our turf？
translations.それは、格ゲーで負かすってことか？:
You mean beat him at a
fighting game？
translations.（▲小早川＊▲……趣旨が変わってるぞ）:
(▲小早川＊▲... That kind of
defeats the whole point.)
translations.ここでバイトできたら、いいよね。:
Working part-time here would
be pretty nice.
translations.▲小早川＊▲にはうってつけかもな。:
It might be the perfect fit
for you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.好きな音楽きいて、ジャケットやポスター眺めてさ。:
Just listening to music I like,
looking at album covers and
posters...
translations.……それじゃ、全然働いてないだろ。:
...That's not really working
at all, is it？
translations.そういえば……。好きなものが近くにあるのに、自由に聞いたり眺めたりできないってこ:
Now that you mention it...
Being surrounded by things I
love, but not free to listen or
look？ That might actually be
hell...
translations.このアイドルグループが一押しなのか。:
Guess they're really pushing
this idol group.
translations.ハデに宣伝してるね。\nリンコは商業主義なんかに流されないけどさ。:
They're really going all-out
promoting them.
Not that I fall for that kind
of commercialism.
translations.……厳しいな。\n聴いてみればいい曲もあるかもよ。:
...That's harsh.
They might have some good
songs if you give them a listen.
translations.確かに、いいと思ったよ。\nだけど、売り方がさ……。:
I mean, I did think it was
good.
It's just the way they're
being marketed...
translations.ちゃんと聴いてるんだな。:
So you actually did listen to
them.
translations.聴きもしないで、語るなんて最低だね。\n実際にゴテゴテしてなくて、素朴で良い曲だ:
Judging music without even
listening to it is the worst.
It's actually a simple, good
song without all the clutter,
which makes it even more of a
shame.
translations.さっきから流れてるＰＶ、結構古そうだけど、ああいうのが好きなのか？:
That music video playing over
there looks pretty old. Are
you into that kind of stuff？
translations.これは、オマージュってやつでしょ。\n最近流行ってるらしいよ。こういう演出が。:
It's what you call an homage.
Apparently this kind of style
is trending lately.
translations.時代が▲小早川＊▲に追いついてきた感じだな。:
Sounds like the times are
finally catching up to you,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.まあ、悪い気はしないけどさ、別にいい気もしないね。:
Well, it doesn't feel bad,
but I'm not thrilled about it
either.
translations.“これであなたも一流シェフ”だって！\nリンコもなれるかな？:
It says, 'With this, you too
can be a top chef!'
Think I could become one？
translations.電子レンジ買ったからって、料理上手になれるわけじゃないだろ。:
Just buying a microwave
isn't gonna make you a
good cook, you know.
translations.そんな言い方しなくたっていいじゃん。\nせっかく光明が差したって思ったのに。:
You don't have to put it
like that. And here I thought
I finally saw a ray of hope.
translations.▲小早川＊▲の手料理なら、なんでも食べるって。:
Hey, if it's your cooking,
▲小早川＊▲, I'll eat anything.
translations.“なんでも食べる”じゃなくて“なんでも美味しい”って言ってもらいたいの。わかって:
I don't want 'I'll eat anything.'
I want to hear 'Everything's
delicious.' You just don't get it.
translations.パソコンの健康診断だって。\nそういえばうちのパソコン、調子悪いってお父さんが言:
PC health checkups, huh.
Now that I think about it, Dad
said ours has been acting up.
translations.今度、見てもらえばいいよ。:
You should bring it in for
them to look at sometime.
translations.そうだね。それまで、無事だといいけど。:
Yeah. I just hope it stays
in one piece until then.
translations.お父さん、電化製品を叩いてなおすタイプなんだよね。:
Dad's the type who tries to
fix appliances by hitting them.
translations.……健康診断じゃなくて、救急治療が必要そうだな。:
...Sounds like it needs
emergency care, not a checkup.
translations.高級オーディオコーナーだって。アンタもこういうの好きなわけ？:
The high-end audio section,
huh. Are you into this
kind of stuff too？
translations.ウチのジジイ、こういうの大好き。ジジイ同士、趣味が同じかと思って。:
My old man loves this stuff.
I figured two old men might
share the same tastes.
translations.いっこ上だって。でも子供ができても趣味人でいるっていいよな、あこがれるかも。:
I'm only a year older! Still,
keeping your hobbies after
having kids is pretty cool.
translations.趣味もいいけどさ、アンタは自分のレコードコレクションの雪崩おこして５歳の娘を下敷:
Hobbies are fine, just don't be
the kind of dad who buries his
5-year-old in a record avalanche.
translations.ヴォルヴァヴィンのフィギュアもあるじゃん。弟、好きそう。:
Oh, they have Volvavin
figures too. My little brother
would love this.
translations.やっぱりお姉ちゃんだな。: Spoken like a true big sister.
translations.まあね。\nうわっ、あっちに大きいのがある。:
Well, yeah.
Whoa, there's a huge one
over there.
translations.これ買ってあげたら、びっくりするだろうけど……\n値段もメガサイズだね。:
He'd be thrilled if I got him
this, I bet, but...
the price is mega-size too.
translations.アニメの主題歌って、なんかいいね。\n聴いてると元気になる感じする。:
Anime theme songs are actually
pretty nice. Listening to them
kind of gives me energy.
translations.へえ、意外だな。\n▲小早川＊▲がアニソンに興味をもつなんて。:
Huh, that's a surprise.
Didn't think you'd be into
anime songs, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.いいものはいい、リンコの評価基準にブレはないよ。\n……でも、あの歌手の衣装は…:
Good music is good music. My
standards don't waver. ...Still,
what's with that singer's outfit？
translations.あれは魔法少女の衣装みたいだな。:
Looks like a magical girl
costume or something.
translations.ふーん、ちょっと、リンコには理解できないね。:
Hmm. That's a little beyond
my understanding.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、似合うと思うけど……言ったらキックだろうな）:
(I think it'd suit ▲小早川＊▲...
but she'd kick me if I said so.)
translations.すごい、全部ゲームとかアニメのキャラなんだよね。:
Wow, they're all characters
from games and anime, right？
translations.うん、凝ってるよな……あ、あれ\n▲小早川＊▲のやってる格ゲーのキャラじゃないか:
Yeah, super detailed... Oh, isn't
that from the fighting game
you play, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.どれ？ あ……ねえ、なんで野生児のはずなのにメガネかけてんの。:
Which one？ Oh... Hey, why's
he wearing glasses when he's
supposed to be a wild child？
translations.チラチラ見すぎだっつーの！:
Stop sneaking glances
at them already!
translations.イテッ。\n誤解だって、どっち向いてもメイドだらけなんだから……。:
Ow! You've got it wrong, there
are maids everywhere I look...
translations.ずいぶん嬉しそうだけど、そんなにメイドさんが好きなんだ？:
You look pretty happy about it,
though. Like maids that much？
translations.好きなら、リンコに頼めばいいのに……。:
If you like it that much, you
could just ask me to...
translations.へえ－、お絵かきオムライスか、面白そうじゃん。\nやらせてよ。:
Oh, omelet rice you draw on.
Sounds fun. Let me try.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、絵を描くのはメイドさんみたいだぞ。:
▲小早川＊▲, I think the maid is
the one who draws on it.
translations.何でって、それが店のシステムだから。:
Because that's just how
this place works.
translations.へえ……で、アンタはどっちがいいの？:
Oh... Well, who would you
rather have do it？
translations.えっと……▲小早川＊▲に書いてもらおうかな？:
Uh... Maybe I'll have
▲小早川＊▲ draw on mine？
translations.女の子のお客さんもいるんだね。:
There are girls here
as customers, too.
translations.うん、結構楽しんでるみたいだな。\n▲小早川＊▲も、お嬢様って言われてどう？:
Yeah, they seem into it.
How does it feel being
called "Young Lady," ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.どうって言われてもね。\nリンコはお嬢様じゃないし。:
I don't know what to tell you.
I'm not a "Young Lady."
translations.そんなこと言ったら●だって、ご主人様じゃないけど。:
Well, you could say the same
about ● being
the "Master."
translations.……？\nアンタがご主人様でリンコがお嬢様ってことはさ――:
......？
Wait, if you're the Master of
the house and I'm the Young
Lady--
translations.ふたりは親子ってことになるね。\n……お父さん。:
Then that makes us father
and daughter.
...Dad.
translations.鐘の音ってさ、たまに聴くと心が落ち着くよね。:
The sound of bells is really
soothing to hear every now
and then, isn't it？
translations.そうじゃないけど。あの音色って結構好きかも。:
No, I'm not. I think I just
really like the way they
sound.
translations.まあ、キレイな音だよな。: Yeah, it is a nice sound.
translations.静かに読書してるときに鳴ると、一気に嫌いになるけど。:
Though if they go off while
I'm quietly reading, I instantly
hate them.
translations.参考までにきくけど、アンタって教会と神社どっちが好き？:
Just for reference, which do
you prefer, churches or
