shrines？
translations.なんでって……それは……質問したのはこっちだっつーの。ばか。:
Why？ Um, well... Hey, I'm the
one asking the questions here.
Dummy.
translations.あのさ、神様って本当にいると思う？:
Hey, do you think God
really exists？
translations.うーん……よくわかんないけどいたらいいよな。:
Hmm... I don't really know,
but it'd be nice if He did.
translations.ちょっと思ったんだけどさ。アンタとリンコが出会えたのが何かの縁なんだとしたら、神:
I was just thinking. If fate
is what brought you and me
together, maybe it wouldn't
hurt to thank God for it.
translations.そうだな。感謝するのも悪くないな。:
Yeah. Thanking Him isn't
a bad idea.
translations.うーん……この絵ってさ、どうなってるの？ 触れそうだけど、触れない……変なの。:
Hmm... What's going on with
this painting？ It looks like
you could touch it, but you
can't... How weird.
translations.トリックアートだな。平面の絵を、立体に見えるように描いてるんだよ。:
It's trick art. It's a flat
painting drawn to look 3D.
translations.錯覚だってわかってても……あーっ、なんかもやもやする！:
Even knowing it's an optical
illusion... Argh, it's bugging
me so much!
translations.そんな必死になって見なくても……。:
You don't have to stare at it
that hard...
translations.だって脳がだまされてるんだよ、負けってことじゃん。:
Because my brain's getting
tricked! That means I'm
losing to it.
translations.さっき入口のとこでさ、ポストカード売ってたよ。部屋に飾ったらいいと思わない？:
They were selling postcards
by the entrance earlier. Don't
you think they'd look nice
in a room？
translations.でしょ。特にさ、世界の子供が描いたネコの絵。:
Right？ Especially the pictures
of cats drawn by kids from
around the world.
translations.それぞれ味があって良かったよな。:
Yeah, each one had its own
charm.
translations.題材が同じネコでもさ、地域や国によって色づかいからなにからぜんぜん違う。面白いよ:
Even when they're all drawing
cats, everything from the
colors on down changes by
country. It's fascinating.
translations.こういう作品を眺めてるとさ、創作意欲が刺激されるね。: Looking at pieces like these really sparks the urge to make something.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、ゲイジュツに目覚める、か。: So ▲小早川＊▲'s awakening to the world of "art," huh.
translations.……リンコも絵、はじめてみようかな。: ...Maybe I'll try taking up painting, too.
translations.なんでそんなに驚くかな。真剣にやったらポテンシャルが発揮されるかもしれないじゃん: Why do you look so shocked？ If I actually tried, I might have some hidden potential, you know.
translations.んーっ、少し街から離れただけなのに……気持ちいい。: Mmm... We're only a little ways out of town, and it already feels so nice.
translations.やっぱり空気が違うな。: The air really is different out here.
translations.そこまでケモノ臭くないのがいいよね。空間が広いからかな。: I'm glad it doesn't smell too much like animals. Probably because it's so wide open.
translations.たしかに、動物園に比べると、そうかも。: True, especially compared to a zoo.
translations.それだけでも来た甲斐あったな。キレイな空気の吸い溜めしとこっと。: That alone makes the trip worth it. I'm gonna stock up on all this fresh air while I can.
translations.牧場に来るとさ、なんとなく芝生の上に寝転がりたくなるよね: Coming to a ranch kind of makes you want to just flop down on the grass, doesn't it？
translations.わかるわかる。ごろごろしたくなるな。: I know what you mean. Makes you want to just roll around.
translations.牧場には危険がたくさんってこと。: There are plenty of hazards on the ground at a ranch.
translations.ここで寝るのは危ないな……。: Yeah, lying down here would be risky...
translations.さっきさ、売店でソフトクリーム売ってたよ。ここで取れた牛乳から作ってるんだって。: I saw them selling soft-serve at the stand earlier. Apparently it's made with milk right from here.
translations.しぼりたての牛乳でソフトクリームか。うまそうだな。: Soft-serve made with fresh milk, huh. Sounds delicious.
translations.しぼったばかりの牛乳ってちょっと苦手だけど、ソフトクリームならいくつでも食べられ: I'm not big on milk straight from the cow, but if it's soft-serve, I could eat as many as I want.
translations.いくつでも……腹壊すぞ。: As many as you want...？ You'll get a stomachache.
translations.そうだけど……そこをなんとかするのが、カレシじゃん。: Maybe, but... doing something about that is what boyfriends are for, isn't it？
translations.▲小早川＊▲。ここの花畑を精一杯の笑顔で走り抜けてみないか？: ▲小早川＊▲, how about running through this flower field with the biggest smile you can muster？
translations.なんとなく少女漫画の主人公っぽくていいかな……なんて。: I just thought it'd be nice, like the heroine in a shojo manga... or something.
translations.却下。笑顔くらいいくらでも見せてあげるけどさ、花畑である必然性がない。: Rejected. I'll smile for you all you want, but there's zero reason it has to be in a flower field.
translations.必然性って言われても……。単にかわいいかなって思ったからさ。: It's not about needing a reason... I just thought it'd look cute.
translations.やっぱり却下。リンコのキャラじゃないもん。: Still rejected. That's just not my style.
translations.なんか、絵本みたい。: It feels like something out of a picture book.
translations.そう。ちょっと現実感ないっていうか、幻想的ってほどじゃないけどさ。: Yeah. It doesn't quite feel real—not that I'd go so far as to call it magical or anything.
translations.そうだな……じゃあ、●たちは絵本の中の住人か。: True... So ● and I are characters in a storybook, huh.
translations.そうだね、お姫様と……その家来だね。: Right. A princess... and her servant.
translations.なあ。売店行ってみようよ。: Hey, let's go check out the shop.
translations.売店？ なにかあるの？: The shop？ Do they have something good？
translations.ここで取れた、自家製のハチミツだってさ。: They've got homemade honey harvested right here.
translations.へえ、いいかも。ホットケーキにかけたり……。: Oh, that sounds nice. Drizzled over pancakes...
translations.牛の乳搾り体験ができるらしいけど、参加してみる？: Looks like they let you try milking a cow here. Want to give it a shot？
translations.やってみたいけど。初心者でも簡単にしぼれるものなの？: I kind of want to, yeah. Is it actually easy enough for a beginner to do？
translations.大丈夫だと思うけどな。結構人気あるみたいだし。: I think it'll be fine. It seems pretty popular.
translations.もしリンコが牛の立場だったら、勘弁してよって思うな、きっと。: If I were in the cow's place, I'd definitely be thinking, "Give me a break already."
translations.目がいやらしい！: Quit giving me that pervy look!
translations.親子のための木工体験か。やってみたいな。: A parent-and-child woodworking class, huh. I'd kind of like to try that.
translations.親子じゃなくても大丈夫なのかな？: I wonder if it's okay even if we're not parent and child？
translations.べつにいいんじゃない？ リンコ、わりと子供好きだしさ、一緒にやってみたい。: I don't see why not. I actually like kids pretty well, so I'd love to join in with them.
translations.いざとなったら、▲小早川＊▲が子供役に……。: If it comes down to it, you could always play the kid, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.乗馬体験、か。馬って人の顔色を見るんだよね。: Horseback riding, huh. Horses can really read people, you know.
translations.まさに馬に馬鹿にされたりするわけか。: So even a horse can get on its high horse and look down on you, huh.
translations.……もしかして面白いこと言ったつもり？: ...Did you actually think that was funny？
translations.……自分でもやっちゃったと思った。: ...Even I knew it was bad the second I said it.
translations.古いお寺って、なんだか落ち着くね。こうしてぼんやりと眺めてるとさ、時間の経つのを: There's something really calming about old temples. Just spacing out and looking at it like this makes you lose track of time.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って意外と渋い趣味なんだな。: You've got surprisingly old-school tastes, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.日常のいろんな悩み事とか、忘れられるじゃん？: It lets you forget about all your everyday worries and stuff, doesn't it？
translations.そりゃ……リンコだって悩みの一つや二つあるからさ。……今すぐには思いつかないけど: Well, yeah... Even I have a worry or two, you know. ...Though I can't think of any off the top of my head.
translations.奥十羽野寺って見た感じ古いけど、建ってどれくらいなのかな。１０００年くらい……？: Oku-Towano Temple looks pretty old, but I wonder how long it's been standing. About a thousand years...？
translations.さすがにそんなに古くはないだろ。えっと……江戸時代だってさ。だいたい４００年くら: I doubt it's quite that old. Let's see... Says here it's from the Edo period. So around 400 years or so.
translations.そんなものって……十分古いだろ。: What do you mean, "that's all"...？ That's plenty old.
translations.うーん。歴史的な建物ってさ、江戸時代くらいだと結構新しく思えない？ 中国四千年、: Hmm. When it comes to historical buildings, doesn't the Edo period feel pretty recent？ Especially when you think about China's 4,000 years of history and all. That's only a tenth of it.
translations.うーん、一理ある、かなあ……。: Hmm, I guess you might have a point...
translations.もしかしてやりたいとか、言い出さないよね……？: Don't tell me you're gonna say you want to try it...？
translations.そんなに嫌か？: Do you hate the idea that much？
translations.リンコは絶対、足がしびれて立てなくなるよ。それに雑念があると、棒で殴られるでしょ: My legs would definitely fall asleep and I wouldn't be able to stand up. Plus, if your mind wanders, they smack you with a stick, right？ My head's full of worldly thoughts.
translations.うーん……いいね、滝！: Mmm... Man, this waterfall is great!
translations.▲小早川＊▲。あんまり近づくと濡れるぞ。: ▲小早川＊▲. You're gonna get wet if you get too close.
translations.水しぶきも気持ちいいくらいだよ。アンタも、もっとこっちに来ればいいのに。: The spray actually feels pretty nice. You should come closer too.
translations.足もとが悪いんだから、気をつけないと……おわっ!?: The footing's slippery here, so you have to be careful... Whoa!？
translations.言ってる本人が滑りそうになってどうすんの？ 手、貸してあげよっか？: You're the one telling me to be careful, and you almost slip？ Want me to give you a hand？
translations.昔はここの滝に打たれて、修行した人とかいたのかな？: I wonder if people used to stand under this waterfall to train back in the old days？
translations.滝って言ったら、修行っていうイメージじゃん。: Well, when you think of waterfalls, you think of people training under them, right？
translations.そうか？ それってもっと激しい滝じゃないか。それでさ、こう、上から流木とかふって: You think so？ Wouldn't that be a much fiercer waterfall？ The kind where, like, logs come tumbling down from the top.
translations.そしてキック一閃、木が真っ二つ！: And then with one flash of a kick, the log splits right in two!
translations.●は真っ二つにしなくていい！: You don't need to go splitting any logs in two, ●!
translations.……こうしてると、吸い込まれそうになるね。: ...Looking at it like this, I feel like I could get pulled right in.
translations.ほら、あんまり前に行くと危ないから。: Hey, don't get too close to the edge. It's dangerous.
translations.心配性だね。早く老けるってば。: You're such a worrywart. You're gonna get old fast.
translations.●が心配性なんじゃなくて、▲小早川＊▲が無謀すぎるんだって。: It's not that ● worry too much—you're just way too reckless, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.リンコのそばには、アンタがいつもついててくれるじゃん。だから安心して、こんなこと: Well, I've always got you right here next to me. That's why I feel safe enough to do stuff like this.
translations.（うれしいやら、プレッシャーやら）: (I'm happy to hear that, but talk about pressure...)
translations.ここの温泉の効能、腰痛、神経痛、肩こり……だってさ。効果あった？: It says the hot springs here are good for lower back pain, nerve pain, stiff shoulders... Did it work for you？
translations.高校生だっつーの。それよりその効能、レポーター風にもう一回。: I'm in high school, you know. Anyway, read those benefits again like a TV reporter.
translations.この温泉の効能はー、腰痛や神経痛、肩こりなどによく効くそうなんです。さっそく入っ: The waters at this hot spring are said to work wonders for lower back pain, nerve pain, and stiff shoulders! I'm going to go ahead and take a dip right now!
translations.奥十羽野温泉の源泉って、この近くだよね。何度くらいなんだろ。: The source for Oku-Towano Hot Springs is somewhere around here, right？ I wonder how hot it is.
translations.源泉だと９０度くらいかな？: Probably around 90 degrees right at the source？
translations.とても入れないね、それじゃ。: No way you could get in that, then.
translations.さすがになー。でも、源泉でゆでたタマゴを近くで売ってるらしいぞ。: Yeah, definitely not. Heard they sell eggs boiled in the source water nearby, though.
translations.そうなんだ。へえ、行ってみよ。: Oh, really？ Cool, let's go check it out.
translations.さっきすれ違った２人。やっぱりカップルかな……？: Those two we just passed... Think they're a couple...？
translations.そんな雰囲気だったな。ここの温泉、結構カップルに人気らしいから。: Looked like it. Apparently the hot springs here are pretty popular with couples.
translations.じゃ、リンコたちと一緒か……へへ。: Then they're just like us... Hehe.
translations.向こうもリンコたちとまったく同じ会話してるのかもって。: I was just thinking maybe they're having the exact same conversation about us.
translations.スケートって、あんまりうまくならない方がいいのかも。: Maybe it's better not to get too good at skating.
translations.ぎこちない滑り方の方がカレシ受けはいいって、うちのクラスの子が言ってたよ。: A girl in my class said guys like it better when their girlfriend is a little clumsy on the ice.
translations.……まあそういうこともあるかな。カノジョの方がうまかったりすると、男の立場がなく: ...Well, I guess there's some truth to that. It kinda hurts a guy's pride if his girlfriend's a better skater than him...
translations.やっぱそうなんだ……。ねえ、リンコすべれなーい。: So it IS true... Hey, help, I can't skaaate.
translations.はいはい。手でも引こうか？: Yeah, yeah. Want me to hold your hand and pull you along？
translations.たまにさ、スポーツセンターのリンクで滑ってる、すごくうまい人いるよね。: Sometimes you see people at the sports center rink who are crazy good at skating, right？
translations.●も見たことあるけど、選手か何かかな。: Yeah, ● saw someone like that too. Wonder if they're a pro or something.
translations.たぶんね。あれくらい滑れるようになるまで、どれくらいかかるんだろ。: Probably. I wonder how long it takes to get that good.
translations.▲小早川＊▲も運動神経は悪くないんだから、練習すればいけるかも？: You're pretty athletic too, ▲小早川＊▲. Maybe you could get there if you practiced？
translations.練習って言葉があんまり好きじゃない。それにさ、リンコだけ本気で滑ってたらデートに: I'm not a big fan of the word "practice." Besides, if I'm skating all seriously by myself, you can hardly call it a date. Would you really want that？
translations.▲小早川＊▲、なんでウィンタースポーツだけ得意なんだ？: ▲小早川＊▲, how come you're only good at winter sports？
translations.なんでって言われても……なんでだろ。ネコが好きだから？: Beats me... Why is that, I wonder. Because I like cats？
translations.ね。さっき係の人に聞いたんだけど。スカッシュって相当激しい有酸素運動なんだって。: Hey, I heard from the staff earlier that squash is actually a super intense cardio workout.
translations.最初は楽なスポーツだと思ってたけど、実際にやると、すごいよね。: At first I thought it'd be an easy sport, but once you actually play, it's pretty brutal.
translations.ああ、止まる暇ないんだよな。特訓って感じ。: Yeah, you don't get a second to catch your breath. Feels like special training.
translations.だよね。本気でやったら絶対筋肉痛だから、いかにムキにならずにやるかが重要だよ。: Right？ If we go all out, we're definitely gonna be sore tomorrow, so the key is not getting too carried away.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲には難しい話かもな……）:
(Easier said than done for
▲小早川＊▲, though...)
translations.壁に打ち返すだけなら、これ、１人でやればよくない。:
If you're just hitting it
off a wall, couldn't you do
this by yourself？
translations.じゃあ、あとはよろしく……。:
Anyway, I'll leave the rest
to you...
translations.うわ、あの人、無茶苦茶上手い……。:
Whoa, that person is crazy
good...
translations.アンタ、テニス部でしょ。ちょっと勝負してきてよ。:
You're on the tennis team,
right？ Go take them on.
translations.え？ でもテニスとスカッシュは……。:
Huh？ But tennis and squash
are...
translations.ほらほら！ フレー！ フレー！\nと・わ・の！:
Come on, go! Rah, rah!
To-wa-no!
translations.ね。やっぱりカレシは力強い方がいいよね。リンコを守ってくれそうな。:
Hey. It really is better having
a strong boyfriend, huh？
Someone who can protect me.
translations.……変なこと考えてないか？:
...You aren't getting any
weird ideas, are you？
translations.ここのマシンでウェイトトレーニングをすると、あのポスターの人みたいな身体になるの:
I was just wondering if lifting
weights here would make you
look like the guy on that poster.
translations.●をボディービルダーにする気か？:
Are you trying to turn ●
into a bodybuilder？
translations.……ダメ？ うーん、残念。面白そうなのに。:
...No good？ Hmm, too bad.
Thought it'd be fun, though.
translations.こう、トレーニングマシンを見てるとさ。:
You know, just looking at all
these workout machines...
translations.なんか、鍛えてるっていう気分になれるよね。:
Kind of makes you feel like
you're working out, huh.
translations.見てるだけで……気分だけ？:
Just from looking...？ You only
want the feeling？
translations.だって本格的に鍛えて、マッチョリンコになっても嫌じゃん。:
Well, you wouldn't want me
working out for real and turning
into Macho Rinko, right.
translations.スポーツジムってあんまり若い人がいない印象。:
I feel like you don't really see
many young people at gyms.
translations.毎日主婦がエアロビとか、やってるんじゃないの？:
Isn't it mostly housewives
doing aerobics every day or
something？
translations.パンフレット見ると、そうでもないけどな。フットサルとかバスケのチームもあるらしい:
Going by the brochure, not
really. Looks like they have
futsal and basketball teams too.
translations.へー。球技はいいや。: Huh. I'll pass on ball games.
translations.おはよう。朝からごめんな。ゆっくりしたかったんじゃないか？:
Morning. Sorry to drag you
out so early. Did you want
to sleep in？
translations.まあね。でもアンタに会うって理由があれば、少しぐらいはさ。:
Kind of. But if it's to see
you, I don't mind losing a
little sleep.
translations.おはよう。朝からごめんな。急に呼び出して。:
Morning. Sorry for calling
you out so early all of a
sudden.
translations.ま、しょうがないよ。起きてすぐリンコに会いたくなるってのはさ。:
Well, can't blame you for
wanting to see me the second
you wake up.
translations.おはよう。朝から呼び出してごめんな。:
Morning. Sorry for calling
you out this early.
translations.ううん、朝から会うっていいじゃん？ １日中いい気分でいられそうだし。:
No, meeting up early is
nice, isn't it？ I'll be in a
good mood all day.
translations.悪いな。急に呼び出してさ。:
Sorry for calling you out
all of a sudden.
translations.なんで？ カレシがカノジョに急に会いたくなるって、自然なことじゃん。:
Why？ It's only natural for a
boyfriend to suddenly want
to see his girlfriend.
translations.ごめんな、急に会おうとか言って。:
Sorry for asking to meet up
out of nowhere.
translations.謝るぐらいなら呼び出すなっつーの。そんなの気にしないってば、イヤなら来ないよ。:
Don't call me out if you're
just gonna apologize. If I
minded, I wouldn't come.
translations.ごめん。急だったろ？:
Sorry. That was pretty
sudden, huh？
translations.ううん。会いたいって言われたら、リンコも嬉しいし。:
Not at all. It makes me
happy when you say you want
to see me.
translations.ごめんな。遅くに呼び出したりして。:
Sorry for calling you out
so late.
translations.別に平気。リンコ、夜好きだし。:
It's fine. I like the night
anyway.
translations.悪いな。こんな時間に。:
Sorry to call you out at
this hour.
translations.まあね……１日の終わりはやっぱ、カノジョで締めくくりたいってとこ？:
Well... I guess you wanted
to wrap up the day with your
girlfriend, huh？
translations.ごめん、遅くに呼び出して。:
Sorry for calling you out
so late.
translations.ううん。夜に会うのって、恋人同士ってかんじするし。なんか嬉しいかも。:
It's fine. Meeting at night
makes us feel like real
lovers. I kinda like it.
translations.おはよ。急に会いたくなったんだけど……顔見たら今度は眠くなってきた。:
Morning. I suddenly wanted
to see you... but seeing your
face is making me sleepy.
translations.（安心するってことでいいのか？）:
(Does that mean I put her at
ease？)
translations.おはよ。顔寝ぼけてない？ ガツンと起こしてあげよっか？:
Morning. Still half-asleep？
Want me to smack you awake？
translations.大丈夫！ 今の言葉で目が覚めた。:
I'm good! That woke me right
up.
translations.おはよ。朝から急に会いたくなっちゃった。へへ。:
Morning. I just suddenly
wanted to see you this
morning. Hehe.
translations.はは、しょうがないな。:
Haha, what am I gonna do
with you？
translations.けっこう早かったじゃん。リンコに会いたくて急いで来たんだ？:
That was pretty fast. Did
you rush over because you
wanted to see me so bad？
translations.来た来た。へへ、やっぱ会いたい時はガマンしちゃダメだね。:
There you are. Hehe, I knew
I shouldn't hold back when I
want to see you.
translations.ガマンされたら、●もイヤだしな。:
I wouldn't want you holding
back either, ●.
translations.遅くにごめん。リンコ、夜の方が楽だしさ。: Sorry it's so late. Nighttime's just easier for me.
translations.全然。合わせるって。: Not at all. I'll work around your schedule.
translations.呼び出す時間ってさ、気にしなくても大丈夫？: Is it okay if I don't worry too much about when I call you out？
translations.へへ、ありがと。出てきて大丈夫だった？: Hehe, thanks. Was it okay for you to come out？
translations.あのさ、ちょっと歩こっか。: Hey, let's take a little walk.
translations.ほら、ちょっと散歩しよ。: Come on, let's go for a little walk.
translations.まだ時間あるならさ、少し散歩しよ？: If you still have time, wanna go for a little walk？
translations.結構、話せたね。: We got to talk quite a bit.
translations.もっと遠回りしてもよかったけど。: I wouldn't have minded taking an even longer way around, though.
translations.そろそろ帰らなきゃ……。もっと時間があればいいのに。バイバイ。: I have to head back soon... I wish we had more time. Bye-bye.
translations.あ～あ、好きなだけ一緒にいられたらいいのに……。じゃあ、またね。: Man, I wish we could stay together as long as we wanted... Well, see you.
translations.やだ……帰りたくない。とか言って……へへ。じゃあね？: No... I don't wanna go home. Just kidding... Hehe. See ya？
translations.じゃあ、そろそろ行こうかな。楽しかったよ。: Well, I guess I should get going. I had fun.
translations.●も。じゃあまたな。: ● had fun, too. See you later.
translations.リンコはそろそろ行くけど。まだ帰りたくないなんて、わがまま言わないでよね。: I'm gonna head back soon. Don't go being selfish and saying you don't want to go home yet.
translations.わかってるって。またな。: I know, I know. See you later.
translations.ありがとね。また散歩しよ。: Thanks. Let's go for a walk again.
translations.あ……と、リンコだけど。今、話せる？: Uh... um, it's Rinko. Can you talk right now？
translations.ちょっとお願い。: I have a little favor to ask.
translations.へへ、正解。今、話してもいい？: Hehe, you got it. Can you talk right now？
translations.デートでもどうかな、と思って。: I was thinking maybe we could go on a date.
translations.リンコがデートに誘ったら、嬉しいかな、と思ってさ。: I thought you might be happy if I asked you out on a date.
translations.ちょっとさ……デートしたいなぁ、と思って。: It's just... I was thinking I kinda want to go on a date.
translations.明日、デートする？: Wanna go on a date tomorrow？
translations.リンコの希望は……今からなんだけど。どこか遊びに行かない？: I'm hoping for... right now, actually. Wanna go hang out somewhere？
translations.今から遊びに行かない？: Wanna go hang out right now？
translations.ね、今から遊びに行こうよ。: Hey, let's go hang out right now.
translations.アンタの行きたいところでいいけど？: I'm fine with wherever you want to go.
translations.場所のリクエストはある？ 希望聞くよ？: Got any requests for where to go？ I'm listening.
translations.うーん……そこは気分じゃない。: Hmm... I'm not in the mood to go there.
translations.それ……どうなの。: Uh... I don't know about that.
translations.できれば、違うとこがいいな。: I'd rather go somewhere else, if we can.
translations.うん、楽しくなりそう。: Yeah, sounds like it'll be fun.
translations.けっこう……待ち遠しいかも。: Honestly... I kind of can't wait.
translations.そっか。ならよかった。: I see. That's good to hear.
translations.あ、ちょっと楽しみになってきた。: Oh, I'm starting to look forward to it a little.
translations.やった。なんか、嬉しいな。: Nice. Somehow, that makes me happy.
translations.ああ。楽しいデートにしような。: Yeah. Let's make it a fun date.
translations.残念だけど、また次にしよ。: That's too bad, but let's do it another time.
translations.うん。しかたないか……。: Yeah. Guess it can't be helped...
translations.へへ。かかってくる気してた。: Hehe. I had a feeling you'd call.
translations.▲月▲▲日▲、空いてる？ ▲デート場所▲に行こう。: Are you free ▲月▲▲日▲？ Let's go to ▲デート場所▲.
translations.明日なんだけどさ、▲デート場所▲に行かない？: About tomorrow, want to go to ▲デート場所▲？
translations.今から、いっしょに▲デート場所▲なんてどう？: How about we go to ▲デート場所▲ right now？
translations.いいじゃんいいじゃん。もちろんオッケー。: Sounds good, sounds good. Of course I'm in.
translations.了解。忘れるまでは覚えておくから。: Got it. I'll remember it until I forget.
translations.もちろん、いいよ。明日か……へへ。: Of course, sounds good. Tomorrow, huh... Hehe.
translations.うん、オッケー。ちょうどそんな気分だったし。: Yeah, okay. I was just in the mood for that anyway.
translations.今から？ ……わかった。じゃ、待ってて。: Right now？ ...All right. Wait for me, then.
translations.ムリ。いつでも暇ってわけじゃないし。: Can't. It's not like I'm free all the time.
translations.明日……急すぎ。悪いけど……ムリ。: Tomorrow...？ That's too sudden. Sorry, but... I can't.
translations.今から？ それはムリ……。: Right now？ I can't do that...
translations.今からって言った？ ムリに決まってんじゃん。: Did you say right now？ Obviously I can't.
translations.うーん、そこって気分じゃないんだよね……。違うとこにしよ。: Hmm, I'm not really in the mood for that place... Let's go somewhere else.
translations.その日じゃなきゃダメ？ 他の日のほうが、都合いいんだけど。: Does it have to be that day？ Another day would work better for me.
translations.噛み合わないときもあるってことで。しょうがないか。: Guess our schedules just don't line up sometimes. Oh well.
translations.待ち合わせ、何時にする？: What time should we meet up？
translations.じゃあ決まり。▲時刻▲に▲デート場所▲で待ち合わせな。: Then it's settled. Let's meet at ▲時刻▲ at ▲デート場所▲.
translations.遅くない？ ちょっと時間もったいないって。: Isn't that kind of late？ Feels like a waste of time.
translations.ちょっとさ、早すぎない？ リンコだって、色々準備あるんだけど？: Hey, isn't that a little too early？ I have things to get ready too, you know？
translations.へへ……時間、早送りしたいかも。: Hehe... I kind of wish I could fast-forward time.
translations.はは、約束は逃げないから。: Haha, our plans aren't going anywhere.
translations.うん。それじゃあ、当日に。: Yeah. See you on the day, then.
translations.んー、早く寝て早く明日になるなら、早寝するんだけどさ。: Hmm, if going to bed early made tomorrow come faster, I'd totally do it.
translations.じっくり明日を待つしかないな。:
Guess we'll just have to
wait patiently for tomorrow.
translations.それじゃ、急いで行くから。そっちも、最高速で来てよ？:
All right, I'll hurry over.
You get there as fast as
you can too, okay？
translations.わかってる。早く会いたいもんな。:
I know. I want to see you
as soon as I can, too.
translations.なるべく、早く行くからさ。:
I'll get there as fast
as I can.
translations.うん。気をつけてな。: Yeah. Be careful on the way.
translations.こういうこともあるよね。また誘って。:
Things like this happen.
Ask me out again sometime.
translations.うん。懲りずに誘うよ。:
Yeah. I'll definitely
ask you out again.
translations.なんだ……そうなの？ わかった。じゃあ、今回は我慢する。:
Oh... really？ Got it.
Guess I'll just have to
put up with it this time.
translations.せっかくなのに、ごめん。また今度、誘うから。:
Sorry, after you made time.
I'll ask you out again soon.
translations.……そういうの、一番気になるって。まあ、いいけど。:
...Doing that just makes me
more curious, you know.
Well, whatever.
translations.やっぱりいいや。ごめん。気にしないで。:
Actually, never mind. Sorry.
Don't worry about it.
translations.なに？ はっきりしないなぁ。べつにいいけど。:
What is it？ Wish you'd spit
it out. Not that I care.
translations.ふうん。こっちも別にいいですけど。:
Hmph.
Not like I care anyway.
translations.決まりだね。じゃあ、楽しみにしてるからさ。よろしく。:
It's settled, then. Well,
I'll be looking forward to it.
See you there.
translations.うん、●も。それじゃあ、また。:
Yeah, same here, ●.
See you later.
translations.決まりだね。デート、楽しみにしてる。……おやすみ。:
It's settled, then. I'm looking
forward to our date.
...Good night.
translations.……次の機会ってことで。じゃあね。:
...Let's try again next time.
See you.
translations.しかたないか。じゃあ、また。:
Guess it can't be helped.
See you later.
translations.……次の機会ってことで。じゃあ、またね。おやすみ。:
...Let's try again next time.
Well, see you. Good night.
translations.しかたないか。うん、おやすみ。:
Guess it can't be helped.
Yeah, good night.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が切ってから切るよ。:
I'll hang up after you do,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ふうん……そう言うんなら、リンコから切るけどさ……。:
Hmm... If you say so,
I'll hang up first, then...
translations.……どうしたの？ なんで切らないの？:
...What's wrong？
Why aren't you hanging up？
translations.▲小早川＊▲が切らないからだよ。:
Because you haven't hung up
yet, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.リンコから切るの？ うーん……なんか、ヤダ。:
You want me to hang up first？
Hmm... I don't really want to.
translations.しょうがないな、じゃあな。:
Guess I have no choice.
See you.
translations.……やだな。切りたくなくなっちゃう。:
...This is bad. Now I don't
want to hang up anymore.
translations.話しても話しても、足りないね？ でも……切らないわけにはいかないし。:
No matter how much we talk,
it's never enough, is it？
Still... we have to hang up.
translations.うん。この続きは、会ったときに話そう。じゃあな。:
Yeah. Let's save the rest
for when we meet up. See you.
translations.あ、もう来てる。もしかして待たせた？: Oh, you're already here. Did I keep you waiting？
translations.大丈夫。こっちも今来たとこだよ。: It's fine. I just got here myself.
translations.お待ちどうさま。リンコより早いなんて感心だね。: Sorry for the wait. Getting here before me is pretty impressive.
translations.待たせるわけにはいかないからな。: Can't keep you waiting, after all.
translations.お待たせ。ゴメン。リンコのほうが遅れちゃった。: Sorry for the wait. My bad—I ended up being the late one.
translations.全然、大丈夫。ちょうどいい時間だよ。: Don't worry about it. You're right on time.
translations.悪いね。暑いのに、早く来てくれてたんだ？: My bad. You came early even in this heat？
translations.待たせちゃ悪いだろ？ ▲小早川＊▲、暑いの弱かったよな。: I couldn't make you wait, right？ You don't do well in the heat, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.先に来てるなんて感心じゃん。こんな暑い日にリンコを待たせたらキックだったよ。: Look at you, getting here early. If you made me wait in this heat, I would've kicked you.
translations.早く来といてよかった。: Glad I got here early, then.
translations.今日も暑いね。汗かいてる。ゴメン……もしかして待たせちゃった？: It's hot again today. You're sweating. Sorry... Did I keep you waiting？
translations.そんなことないよ。時間ぴったり。: Not at all. You're right on time.
translations.お待たせ。寒かったんじゃない？: Sorry for the wait. Weren't you cold？
translations.今着いたとこだから、平気だよ。: I'm fine, I just got here.
translations.お待たせ。寒いね？: Sorry for the wait. Pretty cold, huh？
translations.寒い～。背中丸まってるよ？ 結構待ってたとか？: It's freezing... You're all hunched over. Have you been waiting long？
translations.そっか？ そんな待ってないんだけどな。: Am I？ I haven't been waiting that long, though.
translations.あ、来た。約束の時間守ったね。: Oh, you're here. Right on time, huh.
translations.当たり前だよ。大人のマナーってやつだな。: Of course. Call it grown-up manners.
translations.来た来た。時間もぴったりだし、リンコから探す手間が省けてよかった。: There you are. Right on time, and it saved me the trouble of looking for you.
translations.▲小早川＊▲を見つけるのは簡単だしな。: Well, it's easy to spot you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ぴったり。リンコもね、今さっき来たとこなんだ。: Right on the dot. I just got here myself, actually.
translations.そっか。あんまり待たせずにすんで、よかったよ。: I see. Glad I didn't keep you waiting long.
translations.あ、来た。ちょうど約束の時間か。早いとこ移動しとく？: Oh, there you are. Right on time, huh. Wanna head somewhere else quick？
translations.そうだな。ここじゃ暑くてのぼせそうだ。: Yeah. It's so hot out here I'm gonna get dizzy.
translations.こっちこっち。遅刻しなかったじゃん。: Over here. Hey, you didn't show up late.
translations.この暑い日に遅刻なんてしたら、カレシ失格って言われそうだしな。: If I showed up late in this heat, you'd probably call me a failure of a boyfriend.
translations.うん、ジャスト。早く行こ。暑いのやだもん。: Yep, right on time. Let's get going. I hate the heat.
translations.オッケー。▲小早川＊▲が溶ける前に移動だ。: Okay. Let's move before you melt, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.時間は守るタイプ……っと。うー、さむっ。: So you're the punctual type, huh. Brr, it's freezing.
translations.ほんとだな。早いとこ移動するか。: No kidding. Let's head somewhere else quick.
translations.なんでこんなに寒いわけ？ 長居は無用、ほら行くよ。: Why is it this cold？ No point sticking around here. Come on, let's go.
translations.よかったー、待たされなくて。リンコに寒さは凶器だよ。: Thank goodness you didn't make me wait. The cold is a lethal weapon to me.
translations.はは、遅れなくてよかったよ。: Haha, glad I wasn't late, then.
translations.あ、来た。あのさ……今後、時間厳守って約束、リンコとできる？: Oh, you're here. Listen... Can you promise me you'll be on time from now on？
translations.ゴメン。肝に銘じます……。: Sorry. I'll take it to heart...
translations.遅刻するんだ。デートに気がのらないってこと？: Late, huh. Does that mean you're not in the mood for our date？
translations.あー、来た来た。もう……リンコってさ、待たされる女なわけ？: Oh, look who's here. Seriously... Am I the kind of girl you just leave waiting？
translations.遅い……暑い……。喉かわいた。: You're late... It's hot... I'm thirsty.
translations.ほんと、ごめんっ。すぐに冷たい物買ってくるよ。: I'm really sorry! I'll go get you something cold right now.
translations.この暑い中リンコを待たせるとは、いい度胸してるじゃん。: Making me wait out in this heat... You've got some nerve.
translations.ごめん……。謝るから、キックは勘弁してくれ。: Sorry... Look, I'm apologizing, so spare me the kick.
translations.暑い、遅い！ リンコに直射日光は凶器だって。: It's hot, and you're late! Direct sunlight is a lethal weapon to me, you know.
translations.遅かったね？ ま、いいけど。ところで、なんなの？ この寒さ。: Took you long enough, huh？ Well, whatever. By the way, what is with this cold？
translations.あのさ、寒いんだけど。リンコのお仕置き希望なわけ？: Hey, I'm freezing here. Are you asking to be punished or what？
translations.寒いよ……。もう少し遅かったら、リンコもう動けなくなってた。: It's so cold... A little later and I would've been frozen solid.
translations.ほんと……ごめんな、待たせて。: I'm really... sorry for making you wait.
translations.誰が遅れていいって言った？ 小キックの嵐、くらっとく？: Who said you could be late？ Want a flurry of low kicks？
translations.勘弁！ ほんと、悪かったと思ってる。: Have mercy! I really do feel bad about it.
translations.遅すぎるよ！ 来ないのかと思って、不安になっちゃったじゃん。もうっ！: You're way too late! I started worrying you weren't gonna show up at all. Jeez!
translations.心配させて、ほんとゴメン！: I'm really sorry I made you worry!
translations.……暑くて、思考停止。どうすんの？: ...My brain stopped working from the heat. What are you gonna do about it？
translations.反省してる……。埋め合わせ、考えるよ。: I know I messed up... I'll figure out a way to make it up to you.
translations.暑い、暑い、暑い！ あと３秒遅れてたら帰ってた。: It's hot, hot, hot! Three seconds later and I would've gone home.
translations.ごめん！ この暑さの中、待たせるなんて……。: Sorry! I shouldn't have made you wait in this heat...
translations.遅すぎだってば！ 心配すぎて、暑いってことすら忘れてたよ。: You're way too late! I was so worried I even forgot how hot it was.
translations.ごめんな。待っててくれて、ありがとう。: I'm sorry. Thanks for waiting for me.
translations.ごめんっ。ちゃんと埋め合わせ考えるから……許してくれ。: Sorry! I'll definitely make it up to you... so please forgive me.
translations.寒いっ！ ……寒すぎて、蹴る気にもならない。: It's freezing! ...I'm too cold to even bother kicking you.
translations.遅すぎる！ 待ち合わせ場所間違えたのかと思って、不安だったっつーの。バカ……。: You're way too late! I was worried I got the meeting spot wrong, you know. Idiot...
translations.ごめんな。こんなに寒いのに待っててくれて、ありがとう。: I'm sorry. Thanks for waiting for me out in the cold like this.
translations.それが……デートの約束してた日なんだけど、都合が悪くなっちゃってさ。:
Well... Something came up on
the day we planned our date.
translations.キャンセル？ ふーん、しょうがないね。了解。:
So you're canceling？ Hm,
can't be helped. Got it.
translations.あ、▲小早川＊▲？ ▲苗字▲だけど。実は、デートの約束してた日、都合悪くなっちゃ:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲？ It's ▲苗字▲.
Actually, something came up
on the day of our date...
translations.へえ……そうなんだ？ リンコのほうが先に約束してたのに、都合悪いんだ？ へえ。:
Oh... really？ You made plans
with me first, and something
came up？ Huh.
translations.ごめん！ ●も楽しみにしてたんだけど。こればっかりは……ほんと、ごめん。:
Sorry! ● was looking
forward to it, too. I really
can't help this one... Sorry.
translations.いいよ、許してあげる。世の中、なんでも予定通りってわけにはいかないもんね。:
It's fine, I'll let it slide.
Nothing in life ever goes
all according to plan, anyway.
translations.あ、▲苗字▲だけど。あのさ……デートの約束してた日、都合悪くなっちゃって。:
Hey, it's ▲苗字▲. Listen...
Something came up on the day
we planned our date.
translations.うそ……。リンコ楽しみにしてたの、知ってるでしょ？:
No way... You know how much
I was looking forward to it,
right？
translations.うん。●も楽しみにしてたんだけど……ごめんな。:
Yeah. ● was looking
forward to it, too... Sorry.
translations.わかった……今回はリンコが我慢する。次のデートのことでも考えとくから。:
Okay... I'll just deal with
it this time. I'll think
about our next date instead.
translations.言いにくいんだけど……急用ができて、今日のデート行けなくなったんだ。ごめん。:
I hate to say this, but...
Something urgent came up, so
I can't make our date today.
Sorry.
translations.そっか……。急用じゃ、しかたないね。ちょうど読みたい本も溜まってたし、いいよ。ま:
I see... If it's urgent, it
can't be helped. I've got a
backlog of books to read
anyway, so it's fine. Bye.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ ▲苗字▲だけど。あのさ……デートなんだけど、行けそうにないんだ。:
▲小早川＊▲？ It's ▲苗字▲.
Listen... About our date, I
don't think I can make it.
translations.うそっ!? 今日だよ、それドタキャンだよ？ わかってる？:
Are you serious？ It's today!
That's bailing last minute,
you know that？
translations.うん、わかってる……。どうしても都合がつかなくてさ。ごめんっ！:
Yeah, I know... I just really
couldn't make it work.
I'm sorry!
translations.ふ～ん、あっそ。いいけど？ ひとりでどこ行こっかなぁ。あ、アンタに言ってもしょう:
Hmph, I see. Whatever. Wonder
where I'll go by myself. Not
that there's any point telling
you. Bye.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ ▲苗字▲だけど。実は……今日さ、行けないんだ。デート……。:
▲小早川＊▲？ It's ▲苗字▲.
Actually... I can't make it
today. To our date...
translations.本気で言ってるの？ リンコ、すっごく楽しみにしてたのに。わかってたでしょ？:
Are you serious？ I was really
looking forward to it. You
knew that, didn't you？
translations.うん……●も楽しみだったけどさ。ほんと、ごめんな。こんな急で……。:
Yeah... ● was looking
forward to it, too. I'm really
sorry it's so sudden...
translations.もうっ……。リンコをひとりにするなんて！ バカ……。:
Ugh... Leaving me all by
myself like this! Idiot...
translations.ごめん、▲苗字▲だけど。実は……今日、行けなくなったんだ。:
Sorry, it's ▲苗字▲. Actually...
I can't make it today.
translations.……そんなの、待ち合わせ時間過ぎてから言うこと？:
...Is that really something
you wait until after our
meeting time to tell me？
translations.ごめん……。反省してる。:
I'm sorry... I know I messed
up.
translations.言うは易しってね。なにごとも行動が伴わないと。あーあ、時間損した……。それじゃ！:
Easier said than done. Words
don't mean much without
action. Ugh, what a waste of
time... Bye!
translations.ごめん、▲苗字▲だけど。あの、今さらだけど……。今日、行けなくなったんだ。:
Sorry, it's ▲苗字▲. Um, I know
it's late to be saying this,
but... I can't make it today.
translations.は？ ほんと今さらじゃん。待ち合わせの時間、覚えてるよね？:
Huh？ It really IS late to be
saying that. You do remember
when we were supposed to
meet, right？
translations.ごめん！ いろいろ調整はしてみたけど、どうしても都合がつかなくて。:
I'm sorry! I tried moving
things around, but I just
couldn't make it work.
translations.ごめん、●だけど。あのさ、今日のデート……ダメになったんだ。:
Sorry, it's ●. Listen,
about our date today... I
can't make it anymore.
translations.うそっ！ もう時間過ぎてるのに……。リンコ、ずっと待ってるんだよ？:
No way! We're already past
the meeting time... I've been
waiting this whole time, you
know？
translations.ごめん！ ほんと、悪いと思ってる。急な用事が入っちゃって、どうしても都合が……。:
I'm sorry! I really feel bad
about it. Something urgent
came up, and I just can't...
translations.……待ってても意味ないなら、もう帰るから。じゃ……切るね。:
...If there's no point in
waiting, I'm going home.
Bye... I'm hanging up.
translations.今日さ……楽しいのに、ちょっと苦しかった。たぶん、アンタのこともっと好きになった: Today was fun, but... my chest kinda hurt, too. I think I might've fallen for you even more.
translations.あのさ、これ以上リンコのことメロメロにさせて、どうしたいわけ？: Hey, just what are you trying to do, making me fall even harder for you？
translations.リンコが今、どのくらい幸せかわかる？ もうこの世界じゃおさまんないくらいかも。: Do you have any idea how happy I am right now？ It feels like this whole world isn't big enough to hold it.
translations.今日は、いい１日だったから。なんかリンコ、素直になれたみたい。: Today was a really good day. I feel like I could actually be honest with myself.
translations.今日さ、これこそラブラブカップル！ って感じだったかも。: Today kinda felt like we were a real lovey-dovey couple.
translations.リンコ大満足。ほんと楽しかった！: I'm super satisfied. That was really fun!
translations.平凡な日。ま、世の中普通が一番。: Just an ordinary day. Well, normal is best in this world.
translations.まあ、楽しかったんじゃない？ それなりに。: Well, that was pretty fun, wasn't it？ Good enough, anyway.
translations.今日のデート、よかったね。次はもっと楽しくしたいな。: Today's date was nice. I hope we make the next one even more fun.
translations.今日のデート、物足りなかった……。: Today's date felt like it was missing something...
translations.ねえ……リンコ、今日なにか間違えたかな。だったら言ってね。: Hey... did I do something wrong today？ Tell me if I did, okay？
translations.無理してデートしなくていいから。こっちだって、不愉快だしさ。: You don't have to force yourself to go out with me. It's no fun for me that way, either.
translations.ちょっと……今日のってさ、デートって言えるわけ？: Hold on... can you really even call today a date？
translations.あのさ……今日って、会わないほうがよかった？: Hey... would it have been better if we hadn't met up today？
translations.ほら。髪、切ったんだけど。どう？: Look. I got my hair cut. What do you think？
translations.ショートにしたのか。: So you cut it short, huh.
translations.見て。髪、切ったんだけどさ。意見ある？: Look. I cut my hair. Any thoughts？
translations.ほら。髪、短くしてみた。似合うかな？: Look. I tried cutting my hair short. Does it suit me？
translations.あのさ……この長さって、どうかな？: Say... What do you think of this length？
translations.ねえ、髪の長さ変えてみたんだけどさ。どう思う？: Hey, I tried changing my hair length. What do you think？
translations.ああ、セミロングになったんだ……。: Oh, so it's medium length now...
translations.ねえ。この髪の長さって、ヘンじゃないよね？: Hey. This hair length doesn't look weird, right？
translations.だいぶ髪伸びたんだけど、どう？: My hair's gotten pretty long. What do you think？
translations.あのさ、けっこう髪伸びたでしょ。似合ってる？: Say, my hair's grown out quite a bit, huh. Does it suit me？
translations.ねえ？ 髪、伸ばしたけど。ヘンじゃないよね？: Hey. I grew my hair out, but... it doesn't look weird, does it？
translations.ずいぶん長くなったよな……。: It's gotten really long, hasn't it...
translations.そっか。好みか。そうだと思ったけど。: I see. So you like it. I figured as much, though.
translations.そっか、そっか。気に入ったんだ？ アンタならそう言うと思ったけどね。: I see, I see. So you like it？ I knew you'd say that, though.
translations.へへ。そう言うと思ってたんだ。ありがと。: Hehe. I knew you'd say that. Thanks.
translations.えっ？ こういうの、好みかと思ったのに……。: Huh？ And here I thought you liked this sort of thing...
translations.ええっ、好みじゃなかったの？ なんだ……。: What, so you don't like it？ Oh...
translations.気に入ってくれると思ったのに、はあ……。: And here I thought you'd like it... Sigh...
translations.ちょっと、髪型アレンジしてみたんだけど。: I tried styling my hair a bit differently.
translations.前の髪型のほうが……: I liked how it was before...
translations.ほら見て？ この髪型、ニューバージョンなんだけど。: Take a look. It's a new version of my hairstyle.
translations.ねえねえ、髪型アレンジしてみたんだけど。似合うかな？: Hey, I tried doing something different with my hair. Does it suit me？
translations.それなら良かった。これ、定番にしてもいいかも。: Good to hear. Maybe I'll make this one of my regulars.
translations.そっか。やっぱり好きなんだ？ 思った通り。: Oh, yeah？ So you do like it？ Just like I thought.
translations.そんなぁ。かわいいと思ったんだけどな……。: Aw, come on. I thought it looked cute...
translations.髪の色変えてみたんだけど？: I changed my hair color. What do you think？
translations.ほら。髪の色変えたんだけど？: Look. I changed my hair color.
translations.ああ、雰囲気が変わって……。: Yeah, it's a whole new vibe...
translations.ねえ。この髪の色、リンコに似合うかな？: Hey. Do you think this hair color suits me？
translations.似合う、好きだ: It suits you. I like it.
translations.ちょっと気分転換になるかな……と思って。こんな色にしたんだけど。: I thought a change of pace might be nice... so I went with this color.
translations.雰囲気ガラっと変わったでしょ。どう？: Total change in vibe, right？ What do you think？
translations.雰囲気っていうか、ナシだな: Forget the vibe, it's a no.
translations.この色新鮮かな？ って思ったんだけど。ダメ？: I thought this color might feel fresh. Is it bad？
translations.少し服のイメージ、変えようかと思ってさ……。: I was thinking of changing up my style a little...
translations.今日のリンコ、服の雰囲気変わったでしょ？: My outfit has a different vibe today, don't you think？
translations.ほら、こんなリンコはどう？ 服の雰囲気変わったと思うんだけど。: Here, how do you like this look on me？ I think it's a different vibe from usual.
translations.一応、清楚にしたつもりなんだけど……どう？: I tried going for a neat and proper look... How is it？
translations.この感じ、どう？ おとなしめでしょ。:
How's this look？
Pretty modest, right？
translations.いわゆる清楚系のつもりなんだけど、どうかな？:
I was going for a neat,
proper look. What do you think？
translations.こういう女の子らしい格好って、恥ずかしいんだけど……さ。:
Dressing all girly like this
is kind of embarrassing, though...
translations.自分で言うのもなんだけど、かわいい系の服でしょ？:
I know I'm saying it myself,
but these clothes are cute, right？
translations.今日のリンコは、かわいい系だよ。気に入ってくれた？:
I went for a cute look today.
Do you like it？
translations.こういうカジュアル系ってさ、意外と難しいもんだね。感想は？:
Casual styles like this are
surprisingly tricky.
What do you think？
translations.ねぇ。カジュアルな感じのリンコって、どう？:
Hey. What do you think of me
in a casual look？
translations.期待してたのと違う……: Not what I was hoping for...
translations.大人っぽいのに挑戦してみたんだけど……。ヘン？:
I tried going for a more
mature look... Is it weird？
translations.少しは大人っぽく……って思ったんだけど。どう？:
I wanted to look a little more
grown-up... How is it？
translations.これでリンコにも少しは色気、出たかな……？ ダメ？: Think this gives me a little sex appeal...? Or no good？
translations.そう？ だったら、これからはこんな感じの服にしよっかな。: Really？ Then maybe I'll stick with clothes like this from now on.
translations.気に入ったんなら、これからもこの路線にしてあげる。: If you like it, I'll keep dressing along these lines for you.
translations.ならよかった。これからはこの感じでいこっかな♪: Good to hear. Maybe I'll keep going with this look from now on♪
translations.なにそれ……。気に入らないならもう、いいや。: What's with that...? If you don't like it, then forget it.
translations.そんな言いかたしなくてもいいじゃん……。バーカ！: You don't have to put it like that... Idiot!
translations.ええっ……。好きだと思ったのにな。こういうの。: What...? And here I thought you'd like this kind of thing.
translations.ハァ……。もうちょっとシャキっと反応してよね。: Sigh... Give me a clearer reaction than that.
translations.なんだ……。もっと喜んでくれると思ったのにな。: Oh... And here I thought you'd be happier about it.
translations.リンコに興味もってくれないんだ……。: So you're not interested in me...
translations.さて、今日の服に感想は？ おとなしめだとは思うんだけど。: So, any thoughts on today's outfit？ I think it's pretty modest, though.
translations.さ、今日も感想聞いておこうかな？ 一応ね。: Well, let's hear your thoughts again today？ Just for the record.
translations.ちょっとイメチェンしたら？: Why not try a new look？
translations.今日も清楚系にしたよ。どうかな？: I went with a neat, modest look again today. How is it？
translations.こっち系の可愛い服って、似合ってるのか心配なんだよね……。: With cute clothes like this, I always worry if they actually suit me...
translations.今日の服、女の子って感じしない？: Doesn't today's outfit feel really girly？
translations.ねえ、今日はこんな感じでどうかな？: Hey, how about this look for today？
translations.イメージ変えてみたら？: Why not try a new look？
translations.服、このままこんな感じでいいかな。こういうの楽だし。: Is it okay if I keep dressing like this？ Stuff like this is comfortable.
translations.今の服ってアンタの好み？ こういうラフな感じの。: Are the clothes I'm wearing now your type？ This laid-back style, I mean.
translations.今のリンコの服、ヘンじゃないよね？ カジュアルな感じだと思うけど。: My outfit right now isn't weird, is it？ I think it's a pretty casual look.
translations.そっか。それなら、別にいいんだけど。: I see. Well, in that case, I guess it's fine.
translations.やっぱり？ そう言うと思った。: Right？ I knew you'd say that.
translations.よかったぁ。褒められるの、好き。へへ。: Thank goodness. I like getting compliments. Hehe.
translations.あっそ。違うのが好きなんだ。早く言ってよ。: Oh, really. So you like something else. You should've said so sooner.
translations.なに、偉そうに。まあ、わかったけど。: What's with the high-and-mighty attitude？ Well, fine, I get it.
translations.そっか……。次は褒めてもらえるようにしよっと。: I see... Next time I'll wear something you'll compliment me on.
translations.ハッキリしてよ。いいのか悪いのかが問題じゃん。: Give me a straight answer. The whole point is whether it's good or bad.
translations.もうっ。もっと言うことあるでしょ？: Geez. Don't you have more to say than that？
translations.リンコ、もう帰らないと……。: I have to head home now...
translations.名残惜しいのはわかるけどさ……。またね。: I know it's hard to say goodbye, but... See you.
translations.あーあ……。もう、帰んなきゃいけないのかぁ……。: Aw man... Guess I have to head home already...
translations.少しずつ、一緒にいられる時間が増えればいいな。: I hope we get to spend more time together little by little.
translations.うん。あのさ……今日も楽しかった。ありがとね。: Yeah. Hey... Today was fun too. Thanks.
translations.●も楽しかったよ。じゃあ、またな。: ● had fun too. See you later.
translations.もう少し一緒にいたいって思うのに……。: I want to stay with you a little longer, though...
translations.そっか、それ聞けたからいいや。じゃあ、またね？ バイバイ。: I see. Well, hearing that is enough for me. See you, okay？ Bye-bye.
translations.今日のデートはここまで。それじゃ、またね。: That's it for today's date. Well, see you.
translations.さて……もう時間だしさ、帰るね。: Well... it's about time, so I'll head home.
translations.今日は……ここまでだね。それじゃあ、バイバイ。: Guess that's it for today. Well then, bye-bye.
translations.あのさ、やっぱり……ね。: Hey, on second thought... you know.
translations.どうした？ バイバイしただろ？: What's up？ Didn't we just say bye-bye？
translations.やっぱり……もうちょっと……。: On second thought... just a little more...
translations.ありがと。リンコのカレシは優しいね。へへ。: Thanks. My boyfriend sure is sweet. Hehe.
translations.まあね。許してあげるか。: I guess so. I'll let you off the hook.
translations.ふ～ん。リンコも興味わいてきたかも。:
Hmm. Now I'm kinda
curious about it too.
translations.今、リンコのこと考えてた？:
Were you just thinking
about me？
translations.数字も記号も見たくない。:
I don't wanna see another
number or symbol.
translations.数字に強い人って尊敬する。:
I really respect people
who are good with numbers.
translations.うわ、めんどくさそう。: Ugh, that looks like a pain.
translations.リンコも頑張ろっかな。:
Maybe I should put in
some effort too.
translations.解釈は人それぞれってことだね。:
Guess everyone has their
own interpretation.
translations.わかった気になるだけじゃダメだって。:
Just thinking you get it
isn't good enough.
translations.手伝ってあげよっか？ うーそ。:
Want me to help you out？
...Just kidding.
translations.読解力は全ての基本じゃん。:
Reading comprehension is
the basis of everything.
translations.そのセンス、わりと好きかも。:
I think I kinda like
your style.
translations.美術得意？ リンコのもやっといてくれていいけど。:
Good at art？ You're welcome
to do mine too, you know.
translations.リンコがモデルになってあげよっか？: Want me to model for you？
translations.それ、ちゃんと仕上がるの？:
Is that actually gonna
turn out okay？
translations.授業で歌うのって恥ずかしいよね、カラオケなら平気なのに。:
Singing in class is so
embarrassing. Karaoke's fine,
though.
translations.楽器ができると、それだけでかっこいいかも。:
Just being able to play an
instrument makes you cool.
translations.もっとガツンといきなって。: Come on, give it some punch.
translations.リンコがさ、音楽の授業じゃ教えてくれないことも教えるよ。:
I'll teach you music stuff
they don't teach in class.
translations.限界からのあと１回が筋力アップになるらしいよ。:
They say one more rep past
your limit builds muscle.
translations.筋肉痛とか……絶対ヤダ。:
Sore muscles...？
Definitely not for me.
translations.あ……今見てなかったから、もう１回！:
Oh... I wasn't looking just
now, so do it again!
translations.乳酸溜まってるって感じ。:
Looks like the lactic acid
is really building up.
translations.リンコは、あっちで本読んでるから。:
I'll just be over there
reading a book.
translations.ちゃんと、やりがい感じてる？:
Are you actually finding
this rewarding？
translations.ページをめくる音、嫌いじゃないんだよね。:
I don't mind the sound of
pages turning, actually.
translations.仕事はいくらでもあるから。:
There's plenty more work
where that came from.
translations.こういう仕事は、適当にがんばる。:
For work like this, just do
enough to get by.
translations.それ重いから、よろしく。:
That one's heavy, so
it's all yours.
translations.早く終わらせてさ、リンコと遊ぼ？:
Finish up quick and hang out
with me, okay？
translations.ドキドキさせすぎだっつーの。: You're making my heart pound way too much.
translations.ふーん、もっとイチャイチャしたいって顔。……リンコもだけど。: Hmph, you look like you want more. ...Me too, though.
translations.ふたりの世界、入りすぎかな？: Are we getting too lost in our own little world？
translations.ちょっと、かなりやられちゃったかも……。: Wait, that really got to me...
translations.イチャイチャしすぎじゃない？ やめろって意味じゃなくて。: Aren't we getting a little too lovey-dovey？ Not that I want you to stop.
translations.なんか……愛されてるって感じ。: I kind of... really feel loved.
translations.はいはい、リンコも好きだから、さ。: Yeah, yeah, I love you too, okay.
translations.ダメ……。体がふやけてくる。: No good... I feel like I'm melting.
translations.はいはい。アンタがリンコを好きってのはわかったから。: Yeah, yeah. I get it already, you love me.
translations.うわ、だらしない顔になってる。気持ちはわかるけど。: Wow, look at that goofy grin on your face. I get how you feel, though.
translations.ねえ……嬉しい？ へへ、だよね？: Hey... are you happy？ Hehe, thought so.
translations.ま、これくらいはしょうがないか。: Well, I guess this much is fine.
translations.くっつきすぎだって。焦んないこと。: You're sticking too close. Take it easy.
translations.こういうの、もっと甘えたくなるし。: Stuff like this just makes me want to be spoiled more.
translations.そのへんで、もういいでしょ。: That's about enough for now, isn't it？
translations.もう、くっつきすぎ。……恥ずかしくないわけ？: Geez, you're way too close. ...Aren't you embarrassed？
translations.デレデレし過ぎはさ、よくないって。: Getting too lovey-dovey isn't good, you know.
translations.だからさ……。やっぱいい。: Look, I told you... Never mind.
translations.ちょっと。ベタベタしすぎ。: Hey. You're being way too touchy.
translations.それって自己満足？: Are you just doing that for yourself？
translations.なんか……蹴りたくなってきた。: I'm kind of... getting the urge to kick you.
translations.リンコ怒らせて楽しいわけ？: Is it fun making me mad or something？
translations.ほんとに……わかんないんだ？: Do you really... not get it？
translations.イライラさせたいわけ？: Are you trying to get on my nerves？
translations.なにやってるんだか……。: What do you think you're doing...
translations.あわてんなっつーの。: Don't be in such a rush.
translations.はは、機嫌いいな。: Haha, you're in a good mood.
translations.ねえ、目的地着いたよ？:
Hey, we made it to our
destination, you know？
translations.場所……ここだね。:
Looks like...
this is the place.
translations.楽しかったなあ。\n帰りたくないって思うな……。:
That was a lot of fun.
Makes me not want to leave...
translations.うん……思う。: Yeah... I feel the same way.
translations.しかたないな。帰ろうか。:
Guess we have no choice.
Shall we head home？
translations.やだなぁ。もうこんな時間だって……。:
Aw, no way.
It's already this late...
translations.そっか……。残念だけど、帰らないとな。:
I see... It's a shame,
but we'd better head home.
translations.名残惜しいけど、ぼちぼち帰ろうか？:
Hate to call it a day,
but shall we head home soon？
translations.うん。あんまり遅くなると困るしね。:
Yeah. It'd be bad if we
stayed out too late.
translations.あーあ、そろそろ帰らないと。:
Aw man, we should probably
head home soon.
translations.ほんとだ。いい時間だな。:
You're right.
It's getting pretty late.
translations.あのさ、そろそろ帰ったほうがよくない？:
Hey, don't you think we
should head home soon？
translations.あ、ほんとだ。じゃあ帰るか。:
Oh, you're right.
Let's head back, then.
translations.さて、これからどうするの？ カレシとしては。:
So, what do we do from here？
As my boyfriend, I mean.
translations.さて、肝心なのはここからだよ？ カレシレベルが試されるとき。:
Here comes the important
part. Time to test your
boyfriend level.
translations.リンコが行きたいのは……。あっ、カレシならわかるよね？:
Where I want to go is...
Oh, you're my boyfriend, so
you can tell, right？
translations.さて、これからどうする？: So, what should we do now？
translations.これからどうするか考えてる？:
Have you thought about what
we're doing next？
translations.まずはどこから行くの？ 任せるよ。:
Where are we going first？
I'll leave it to you.
translations.ほら、ここからのプランは？:
Come on, what's the plan
from here？
translations.どこから回るの？ リンコは……べつにどこでもいいや。:
Where are we starting？
Personally... I'm fine with
wherever.
translations.次はどうするの？ ほれほれ。:
What are we doing next？
Come on, out with it.
translations.次はどうするの？ さあ期待。:
What are we doing next？
I'm expecting good things.
translations.次はね……。ううん、やっぱ決めて。:
Next up is... Nah, never
mind. You decide.
translations.さて、次はどこ行くつもり？:
So, where are you planning
to go next？
translations.次はどうするか考えてる？ リンコにふらないでね。:
Thought about what to do
next？ Don't put it on me.
translations.ねえねえ、次はどうするの？ 期待していいよね？:
Hey, what's next？ I can
get my hopes up, right？
translations.映画選ぶのって、難しいよね？ リンコは……アンタが観たいのがいいな。:
Picking a movie is tough,
isn't it？ I'd like to watch
whatever you want to see.
translations.けっこう、良さそうなのやってるじゃん。どれにする？:
They're playing some pretty
good stuff. Which one should
we watch？
translations.どれにしようかな？ あ、カレシのお奨めを聞いとこっと。:
Which one should we pick？
I'll ask my boyfriend for
a recommendation.
translations.この中から選ぶんだ？ 好きなの選んでいいよ。:
We're picking from these？
You can choose whichever
you like.
translations.どれが観たい？ 好きなの言ってみ。:
Which one do you wanna see？
Pick whichever you like.
translations.どれが観たい？ たぶんあっちを選ぶだろうな～。:
Which one do you wanna see？
I bet you'll pick that one.
translations.●？ ●が観たいのは……。:
●？ What ●
would want to see is...
translations.どのタイトルもパッとしないなぁ。:
None of these titles look
all that great.
translations.お願いがあるんだけど……もう一本、いっとく？:
I have a favor to ask...
Want to catch one more？
translations.あのさ、他のも面白そうじゃない？:
Hey, don't the other ones
look pretty good too？
translations.よし。だったら他も観ていくか。:
All right. Let's check out
another one, then.
translations.ねぇねぇ。わがまま言ってもいい？:
Hey. Can I be a little
selfish right now？
translations.他の映画も観たくなったかも……。:
I think I'm in the mood to
see another movie...
translations.他のも観たくなってきた。:
Now I feel like seeing
something else, too.
translations.もう１本くらい観たいなーとか、思わない？:
Don't you kind of feel like
watching one more？
translations.言われてみれば観たいかな。:
Now that you mention it,
yeah, I kind of do.
translations.いいんじゃない？ リンコも同じとこ選んだと思う。:
Sounds good to me. I think
I would've picked there too.
translations.うん。楽しそうじゃん。大賛成。:
Yeah, sounds like fun.
I'm all for it.
translations.あーあ……リンコの予想外。:
Aw man... That wasn't what
I was expecting.
translations.あのさ……リンコお腹空いたんだけど。お昼食べて行かない？:
Hey... I'm getting hungry.
Want to go grab some lunch？
translations.●もお腹空いてたんだ。行こう。:
● was getting hungry too.
Let's go.
translations.お昼食べに行こうよ。リンコもう、さっきからお腹空いちゃって。:
Let's go get lunch. I've
been starving for a while.
translations.●もお腹空いてたんだよ。じゃあ行くか。:
● was getting hungry too.
Let's head out, then.
translations.リンコ、お腹空いちゃった。どこか入りたいな。:
I'm hungry. I want to stop
somewhere for food.
translations.どこかでさ、お昼食べない？:
Want to grab some lunch
somewhere？
translations.お腹空かない？ お昼食べに行こうよ。:
Aren't you hungry？ Let's go
get some lunch.
translations.お腹空いて動けないよ。ねえ、ご飯タイムにしよ？:
I'm too hungry to move.
Can we stop for food now？
translations.あのさ……ちょっとお茶でも飲んで、のんびりしない？:
Hey... Want to go get some
tea and relax for a bit？
translations.リンコ、ちょっと休みたい。どこかでゆっくりしない？:
I want to rest a little.
Can we go relax somewhere？
translations.ここらへんでさ、ティータイムにしない？ リンコ、少し疲れたかも。:
Want to stop for tea around
here？ I'm a little tired.
translations.カフェとかないかな？ ちょっと休憩したい。:
Is there a cafe around here？
I'd like to take a break.
translations.疲れた？ ひと息つくか。:
Getting tired？ Let's take
a breather.
translations.ねえ、お茶しよ。リンコ、ちょっと疲れた。:
Hey, let's go get some tea.
I'm a little tired.
translations.そっか。じゃ、休もう。: Got it. Let's take a break, then.
translations.リンコ、お茶したいな。ダメ？: I kind of want to stop for tea. Can we？
translations.えっと……ご飯、行くでしょ？ 今日ご飯いらないって言ってきたし。: Um... we're getting dinner, right？ I already told my family not to make me anything.
translations.もちろん。ウマイもん食べに行こう。: Of course. Let's go get something good.
translations.晩ご飯食べて行くでしょ。そのつもりだったんだけど。: We're getting dinner before heading back, right？ I figured you'd planned on it.
translations.ねえ、ご飯食べに行こ？ リンコ、今日はご飯いらないって言ってきちゃった。: Hey, let's go get something to eat. I already told everyone at home I wouldn't need dinner tonight.
translations.よし。じゃあ、どこで食べようか。: All right. Where do you want to eat, then？
translations.もうこんな時間だし、ご飯行かない？: It's getting pretty late. Want to go grab some dinner？
translations.ほんとだ。どうりで腹が減ると思った。: Oh, you're right. No wonder I'm so hungry.
translations.リンコ、お腹空いちゃったな。アンタはどう？: I'm getting hungry. What about you？
translations.ああ、言われてみれば。: Yeah, now that you mention it.
translations.そろそろお腹空いてきちゃった。どこかでご飯食べて行こうよ。: I'm starting to get hungry. Let's stop somewhere to eat.
translations.●も腹減ったな。じゃあ行くか。: Yeah, ● could eat too. Let's go.
translations.この店だね？ 早く入ろ。: This is the place, right？ Come on, let's go in.
translations.着いた着いた。早く入ろ。: Here we are. Come on, let's go inside.
translations.着いたー。座れるかな？ 早く入ろ。: We're here. Think we can get a table？ Let's hurry inside.
translations.まだ……けっこう時間あるんじゃない？: Don't we still have... plenty of time left？
translations.リンコ……まだ、帰りたくないな。: I... don't really want to go home yet.
translations.この時間なら、リンコ、もう少し遊べるかも。: Since it's still early, I think I can stay out a little longer.
translations.なら、他の場所も行けるな。: Then we've got time to check out somewhere else.
translations.他のとこにも行けるかな……って。: I was thinking... maybe we could go somewhere else too.
translations.それならどこ行こうか？: Where do you want to go, then？
translations.ねえ。他のとこでも、遊ぼ？: Hey. Let's go hang out somewhere else too, okay？
translations.そうだな。だったら、もう少し遊ぶか。: True. Want to hang out a little longer, then？
translations.うん。いいかも。じゃあ、どこに行く？: Yeah, I'd like that. Where should we go？
translations.だよな？ じゃあ、もう少し、遊んでいく？: Right？ Want to hang out a bit longer, then？
translations.賛成、どこか行きたい場所ある？: I'm all for that. Anywhere in particular you want to go？
translations.よーし。もう少し遊ぶか？: All right. Want to stay out a little longer？
translations.でもあんまり遅くなってもな……。: Yeah, but we shouldn't stay out too late...
translations.そうだけど、遅くなったら家の人が心配するだろ？: Maybe, but your family'll worry if you're out too late, right？
translations.そこで遊ぶには、時間足りないでしょ。: We don't have enough time to hang out there.
translations.うーん……やっぱ、そうだよな。: Hmm... Yeah, I guess you're right.
translations.そこじゃ、時間足んないじゃん……。: We won't have enough time for that...
translations.行きたいけど……そこじゃあ、時間足りないと思う。: I'd like to go, but... I don't think we have enough time.
translations.あのさ……。やっぱ、やめとく。: Listen... On second thought, never mind.
translations.なんで、そこ……？ うーん、やっぱキャンセルで……。: Why there...？ Hmm, actually, let's just forget it...
translations.なんでそうなるかな。伝わらなかったんだね。: Why would you pick that？ Guess you didn't get the hint.
translations.ひとつ聞くけど……セーブせずに電源切ったよね？ なんで？: Let me ask you something... You turned the power off without saving, didn't you？ Why？
translations.ちょっと。セーブせずに電源切んなかった？ ハァ……。: Hey. Didn't you turn the power off without saving？ Ugh...
translations.ねぇ……セーブせずに電源切ったでしょ？ もう……。: Hey... You turned the power off without saving, didn't you？ Honestly...
translations.あのさ……セーブせずに電源切ったよね？ 怒らせたい？: Listen... You turned the power off without saving, right？ Are you trying to make me mad？
translations.またセーブせずに電源切った！ なんで？ ほんと、がっかり……。: You turned the power off without saving again! Why？ I'm really disappointed in you...
translations.まただよね……セーブせずに電源切るの。そういうの、リンコは絶対やだ……。: You did it again, didn't you... Turning the power off without saving. I really hate that...
translations.またしてもセーブせずに電源切ったね。嫌われたいわけ……？ もう許せない。: You turned the power off without saving yet again. Do you want me to hate you...？ I can't let this slide anymore.
translations.ああもう……セーブせずに電源切るなって、何回言った？ もう許さないから覚悟して。: Ugh, seriously... How many times have I told you not to turn the power off without saving？ I'm not forgiving you this time, so be ready for it.
translations.リンコがセーブせずに電源切られるの嫌いって知ってるよね？ もうダメ。: You know how much I hate it when you turn the power off without saving, right？ That's it.
translations.「もうしません、許してください」って言えば？ そしたら許すからさ。: Why don't you say, "I won't do it again, please forgive me"？ Do that and I'll let you off the hook.
translations.「もうしません、許してください」ってハッキリ言うこと。じゃなきゃ、リンコの怒りは: Say "I won't do it again, please forgive me," loud and clear. Otherwise, I'm staying mad at you.
translations.「もうしません、許してください」ってリンコの目を見て言って？ そしたら、許したげ: Look me in the eye and say, "I won't do it again, please forgive me," okay？ Then I'll forgive you.
translations.まだ言わないわけ？: Still not going to say it？
translations.「もうしません、許してください」って言えない？ 簡単でしょ。: Can't you just say, "I won't do it again, please forgive me"？ It's not that hard.
translations.「もうしません、許してください」だよ？ 簡単じゃん。ほら、言って。: All you have to say is, "I won't do it again, please forgive me." Easy, right？ Come on, say it.
translations.聞こえなかった？ 「もうしません、許してください」って言って欲しい。: Did you not hear me？ I want you to say, "I won't do it again, please forgive me."
translations.聞こえなかった……。やり直し。: I couldn't hear you... Do it over.
translations.えっ？ 今のはナシでしょ。もう１回。: Huh？ That didn't count. One more time.
translations.それじゃあ伝わんないよ。もう１回、お願い。: I can't tell if you mean it like that. One more time, please.
translations.なにそれ……なんか、ズルい。そりゃ……許すけど。: What was that...？ That's not fair. I mean... I'll forgive you, though.
translations.なに今の。もう……わかった。許すよ。: What was that just now？ Jeez... Fine, I get it. I forgive you.
translations.うそっ……。そんなことされたら、許すしかないじゃん……バカ。: No way... When you do something like that, I have no choice but to forgive you... Dummy.
translations.ほんとに言ってくれたんだ？ うん、許すから……。: You actually said it？ Okay, I forgive you...
translations.ちゃんと言えるじゃん。その気持ちを大切にすること。: See, you can say it when you try. Don't forget how you feel right now.
translations.うん、もちろん許してあげる。へへ。: Yeah, of course I'll forgive you. Hehe.
translations.だけど、もう絶対しないで？ 約束。: But seriously, don't ever do it again, okay？ Promise me.
translations.許すからって調子に乗らないこと。これでも傷ついたんだからさ。: Just because I'm forgiving you doesn't mean you can get carried away. That actually hurt my feelings, you know.
translations.お願いだから、もうしないでね？\nリンコとの約束だよ。:
Please don't do it again, okay？
It's a promise.
translations.それって、許さなくてもいいってこと？: Does that mean you don't care if I forgive you or not？
translations.「セーブせずに電源切るな」。学習しないの？: "Don't turn the power off without saving." Do you never learn？
translations.いい加減にしろっつーの！ 「セーブせずに電源切るな」。はあ。: Give me a break already! "Don't turn the power off without saving." Ugh.
translations.セーブせずに電源切るって……何かあるならハッキリ言ってよ。……悲しいけど。: Turning the power off without saving... If something's wrong, just tell me straight. ...Even if it makes me sad.
translations.どうしよっかな……うん、「リンコが一番大好き」って言って。: What should I do with you... Okay, say, "I love you the most, Rinko."
translations.許して欲しいなら「リンコが一番大好き」って誠意を込めて言ってみ！: If you want me to forgive you, say "I love you the most, Rinko," and really mean it!
translations.許して欲しいなら「リンコが一番大好き」って言うこと。言ってくれるよね？: If you want me to forgive you, you have to say, "I love you the most, Rinko." You'll say it for me, right？
translations.ほら……言わないつもり？: Come on... Are you not going to say it？
translations.ずっと黙るつもりじゃ\nないよね……？:
You're not gonna stay
quiet forever, are you...？
translations.え？ なにか言った？ 聞こえないよ……。:
Huh？ Did you say something？
I can't hear you...
translations.そうやって誤魔化すなんて……。:
Trying to worm your way
out of it like that...
translations.そんな手がリンコに通用するとでも思ってるわけ？:
You really think a trick
like that works on me？
translations.そんなに、言いたくないんだ……。:
You really don't want to
say it that badly, huh...
translations.うん……大丈夫、ちゃんと聞こえた。:
Yeah... It's okay,
I heard you.
translations.うそじゃないよね？ リンコ、信じるよ？:
You're not lying, right？
I'm gonna believe you, okay？
translations.次……「好きだよ」って３回。言えるよね？:
Next... Say "I love you"
three times. You can do
that, right？
translations.……でもまだダメ。次は「好きだよ」って３回言うこと！:
...But you're not off the
hook yet. Next, say "I love
you" three times!
translations.信じていいなら「好きだよ」って３回言って？:
If you really mean it, say
"I love you" three times,
okay？
translations.言ってくれたって……いいじゃん。:
Come on... You could at
least say it for me.
translations.聞きたいな……。: I want to hear you say it...
translations.もうっ、なんでそうなるかな。:
Ugh, why won't you just
say it right？
translations.そうじゃないよ……わかってるでしょ？:
That's not it...
You know what to say, right？
translations.うん……それが聞きたかったんだ。:
Yeah... That's what I
wanted to hear.
translations.よかった、言ってくれて。リンコも同じ気持ちだし。:
I'm glad you said it.
I feel the same way, too.
translations.今度こそ、約束。ふたりの思い出を消すなんてナシ。わかった？:
Promise me this time.
No more erasing our memories
together. Got it？
translations.反省した？ リンコだってほんとはこんなことしたくないから、もうやめてよ。:
Did you learn your lesson？
I don't actually like doing
this either, so stop it.
translations.仲直りしよ？ ほんとにもうしないでね。ふたりの時間、全部大切にしたいから。:
Let's make up, okay？ Just
don't do it again. I want to
treasure all our time together.
translations.その態度……それでいいんだ？:
Are you sure you want to
take that attitude with me？
translations.それって、ほんとに反省してんの？ 罰として、リンコに愛の言葉をいーっぱい言ってよ:
Are you actually sorry at
all？ As punishment, you have
to tell me how much you love
me. A whole lot.
translations.やっぱ愛の言葉といえば“あいしてる”だよね。:
When it comes to words of
love, it's gotta be
"I love you," right？
translations.そうだな……じゃあ、“小キック”て言ってみて。意味は深く考えないでいいよ。:
Let's see... Okay, try
saying "Light Kick." Don't
think too hard about what
it means.
translations.ほら、お腹から声出す。:
Come on, shout from your
stomach.
translations.オッケー！ 愛の言葉……ちゃんと受け取ったよ。:
Okay! Your words of love...
came through loud and clear.
translations.やるじゃん。新記録達成だよ！:
Not bad. You set a new
record!
translations.なんか反省してる感じしないんだよね。こういうときはさ、ビシッと反省文でしょ。:
You don't really seem all
that sorry. At times like
this, a proper written
apology is in order.
translations.なに、その字？: What kind of handwriting is that？
translations.うん、ちゃんと反省してるって認めてあげるよ。: Alright, I'll admit you're actually sorry.
translations.へぇ！ 新記録出ちゃった。: Oh! You set a new record.
translations.ほんとに反省してんのかな？ 反省してるんだったらさ、リンコの目を見て。目を逸らし: Are you really sorry？ If you are, look me in the eye. Look away or move and you're out.
translations.そっ。今はリンコだけ見ればいいの。: That's it. Just keep your eyes on me right now.
translations.へへ……いつもこのくらいリンコのこと真剣に見てよね。: Hehe... You should always look at me this seriously.
translations.新記録達成！ まだまだ、見つめててもいいけど？: A new record! You can keep staring at me if you want, though？
translations.ちょっと……これでギブって。ほんと、反省してよね。: Hey... Giving up already？ You really need to think about what you did.
translations.しょうがないなぁ……今回はこのへんで勘弁してあげる。: What am I going to do with you... I'll let you off the hook this time.
translations.帰るに決まってんじゃん……。:
Of course I'm walking home
with you...
translations.カノジョがカレシ待ってちゃおかしい？:
Is it weird for a girlfriend
to wait for her boyfriend？
translations.リンコ、まだ用事あるから。……またね。:
I still have stuff to do.
...See you later.
translations.（今日は一人で帰りたい気分だな……）:
(I feel like heading home
alone today...)
translations.さあ、帰ろう。: All right, time to go home.
translations.なにしてんだ？ 一緒に帰ろう。:
What are you up to？
Let's walk home together.
translations.なにって、待ってたんだっつーの。ほら、行くよ。:
Waiting for you, obviously.
Come on, let's go.
translations.今日は用事があるからムリ。じゃあね。:
I can't today, I've got
stuff to do. See ya.
translations.（うーん。今日は一人で帰ろうかな……）:
(Hmm. Maybe I'll head home
alone today...)
translations.オッス。一緒に帰るか？:
Hey. Want to walk home
together？
translations.うん、そのつもりで待ってた。へへ、早く帰ろ。:
Yeah, that's why I was
waiting. Hehe, let's go.
translations.ごめんね。リンコ、まだ用事があって今日はダメ。バイバイ。:
Sorry. I still have stuff to
do today, so I can't. Bye.
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ 一緒に帰ろうか？:
▲小早川＊▲!
Want to walk home together？
translations.別にいいけど？ カノジョだし。:
Sure, why not？ I am your
girlfriend, after all.
translations.今日はムリだから、先に帰って。……じゃあ。:
I can't today, so go on
ahead. ...See ya.
translations.リンコと？ しょうがないなぁ。: With me？ Oh, all right then.
translations.ああ……今日はダメ。それじゃ、バイバイ。:
Oh... I can't today.
Anyway, bye.
translations.（なんとなく、今日は一人で帰りたい……）:
(For some reason, I feel like
going home alone today...)
translations.よっ、一緒に帰らないか？:
Hey, want to walk home
together？
translations.お疲れさま。うん、帰ろ。:
Good work today. Yeah, let's
go home.
translations.今日はムリだから……。じゃあね、バイバイ。:
I can't today...
See you later, bye.
translations.（うーん、今日は一人で帰りたい気分だ……）:
(Hmm, I feel like going home
alone today...)
translations.さあ、帰ろう……。: All right, time to head home...
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ 一緒に帰らないか？: ▲小早川＊▲! Want to walk home together？
translations.えっと、一緒に帰らないかって……。: Uh, I asked if you wanted to walk home together...
translations.（今日は一人で帰るか……）: (I guess I'll go home alone today...)
translations.帰りたくないからに決まってんじゃん。それじゃ……。: Because I don't want to, obviously. Bye...
translations.もう帰るんだったら、一緒にどう？: If you're heading home now, want to walk together？
translations.帰らないって……用事か？: You're not...？ Got plans or something？
translations.用はないけど……帰らないったら、帰らないの！: I don't have plans... I'm just not walking home with you!
translations.（今日は一人で帰ろっかな……）: (Maybe I'll just go home alone today...)
translations.『あ……』って、なに？ 帰ろうよ。: What's with the "Oh..."？ Come on, let's go home.
translations.ちょうどよかった。一緒に帰ろうか？: Good timing. Shall we walk home together？
translations.ちょうどいいって、リンコが合わせてあげたんじゃん。さ、帰ろ？: "Good timing"？ I waited for you on purpose. Come on, let's go.
translations.ごめん、今日はちょっと一緒に帰れないんだ……。: Sorry, I can't walk home with you today...
translations.あっそ……。別に待ってたわけじゃないし、いいけど。: Oh, really... Whatever. It's not like I was waiting for you anyway.
translations.次は一緒に帰ろうな。: Let's walk home together next time, okay？
translations.なにボヤっとしてんの。ほら、一緒に帰るよ。: What are you spacing out for？ Come on, we're walking home together.
translations.うん、そうだな。一緒に帰ろう。: Yeah, let's do that. Let's walk home together.
translations.ごめん、今日はちょっと帰れないんだ……。: Sorry, I can't walk home with you today...
translations.そうだよな。待っててくれたのに、ごめん。: Yeah, you're right. Sorry, especially since you waited for me.
translations.待ってたよ。一緒に帰ろ？: I was waiting for you. Want to walk home together？
translations.ああ、一緒に帰ろう。待っててくれてありがとな。: Yeah, let's go together. Thanks for waiting for me.
translations.へへ。だってリンコ、アンタのカノジョだもん。待つのもけっこう楽しいよ。: Hehe. Well, I'm your girlfriend, after all. Waiting for you is actually pretty fun.
translations.だったら先に教えてくれればいいのに。もう。: You could've told me that ahead of time. Honestly.
translations.だよな。悪かった。: Yeah, you're right. Sorry about that.
translations.毎日、学校がこっちに来てくれればラクなのに。: It'd be so much easier if school just came to us every day.
translations.さ、今日も長い１日がはじまるよ。: Well, here starts another long day.
translations.だな。気合入れないと。: Yeah. Gotta brace ourselves for it.
translations.カノジョが待ってくれてる朝って、嬉しい？: Does it make you happy having your girlfriend wait for you in the morning？
translations.よかった。今日もいいことあるといいね。: Good. Hope something nice happens today, too.
translations.待った？ 雨になっちゃったね。:
Wait long？
It started raining, huh.
translations.今来たとこだよ。ま、天気は仕方ないって。:
I just got here.
Well, can't help the weather.
translations.お待たせ。よかった先に来てて。今日、寒すぎ。:
Sorry for the wait. Glad you got
here first. It's freezing today.
translations.時間ぴったりじゃん。これで雨じゃなかったらサイコーなのに。:
Right on time, huh. It'd be
great if it weren't raining.
translations.たまには雰囲気あっていいって。:
It sets a nice mood every once
in a while.
translations.うん、時間ぴったり。雪だし、遅れるかと思った。:
Yeah, right on time. With the
snow, I thought you'd be late.
translations.そんなギリギリには出ないって。: I wouldn't cut it that close.
translations.遅れた！ 雨の中、ごめんな。:
I'm late! Sorry for making you
wait in the rain.
translations.はあ、雪の中待ち続ける健気なリンコ……。:
Sigh... Poor, devoted Rinko,
waiting out in the snow...
translations.雨の中、どんだけ待たせる気だっつーの。:
Seriously, how long were you
gonna make me wait in the rain？
translations.遅すぎ！ 雪の中こんなに待たせるなんて信じらんない。:
Way too late! I can't believe you
made me wait so long in the snow.
translations.ほんと、悪い……。待っててくれてありがとう。:
I'm really sorry...
Thanks for waiting for me.
translations.はあ……なんでまだ家にいるの……。:
Sigh... Why are you still
at home...？
translations.いるじゃん……。忘れてたわけ？:
So you are home...
Did you forget or something？
translations.来る途中で合流できるかな……って思ってたけど。着いちゃったし。:
I thought I might run into you on
the way... Guess I made it here.
translations.すいません。この地図の場所へ行きたいんですが……。:
Excuse me. I'm trying to get to
this place on the map...
translations.あ、道ですか？ えっと……ココならこの道を真っ直ぐ行ってひとつ目の信号を……。:
Oh, directions？ Let's see...
Go straight down this road, and
at the first light...
translations.なんてね。見てたよ。いいとこあるじゃん。:
Just kidding. I saw that.
You've got a good side to you.
translations.うわっ、当たった！: Whoa, I won a free one!
translations.▲小早川＊▲。ほらこれ、当たった！ もう一本！:
▲小早川＊▲. Look, I won!
Got an extra drink!
translations.へー、ラッキーじゃん。じゃ、ごちそうさま。:
Huh, lucky you.
Thanks for the drink, then.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。リンコ今着いたとこだけど、そっちも？:
▲主人公＊▲. I just got here.
You too？
translations.ああ、たった今。今日はいつにも増して息が合いそうだな！:
Yeah, just now. Looks like we're
extra in sync today!
translations.じゃあジャンケンしてみる？ あいこにならなかったら、罰ゲームでキック！:
Wanna play rock-paper-scissors？
If we don't tie, you get a kick!
translations.ねえ、ネコ見なかった？: Hey, did you see a cat？
translations.来る途中で見かけて、追いかけてきたんだけど、見失っちゃった。あーあ。:
I saw one on the way and followed
it, but I lost it. Oh well.
translations.はは、まあそのうちまた出てくるかもな。:
Haha, well, maybe it'll show up
again soon.
translations.（ちょっと遅れた……\nあれ、▲小早川＊▲、なんかヘンだな）:
(I'm a little late...
Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲'s acting weird.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。なんか顔ひきつってないか？ ……つま先立ちしてる？: ▲小早川＊▲. You look kind of strained. ...Are you standing on your tiptoes？
translations.ああこれ、筋トレ。なんとなく。: Oh, this？ Just a little workout. No real reason.
translations.まあ飽きるまでは。: Until I get bored of it, anyway.
translations.（なんかすぐ飽きそうだな……）: (Something tells me that won't take long...)
translations.（キョロキョロしてる……こうやって見ると、なんか守りたくなる感じがするよな、▲小: (She's looking around for me... Seeing ▲小早川＊▲ like this really makes me want to protect her.)
translations.なにわけわかんないこと言ってんの？ 遅刻。: What are you babbling about？ You're late.
translations.（ヤバイ……かなり遅刻だ。\nあ、▲小早川＊▲？）:
(Crap... I'm super late.
Oh, is that ▲小早川＊▲？)
translations.（男と話してる……？ あ……行っちゃった）: (Is she talking to some guy...？ Oh... He left.)
translations.悪い、今話してたのって誰？ 友達？: Sorry. Who was that you were just talking to？ A friend？
translations.違う、ナンパ。しかも中学生！ 『どこ中？』だってさ。バカにすんなっつーの。: No, some guy hitting on me. A middle schooler, too! Asked me what middle school I go to. Seriously, give me a break.
translations.（中学生と思われたのか……）: (So he thought she was in middle school...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、帰っちゃったかな……）: (I wonder if ▲小早川＊▲ already went home...)
translations.あれ、▲小早川＊▲。今来たの？: Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲, did you just get here？
translations.実は……はは、お互い遅刻か。: Actually, yeah... Haha, guess we're both late.
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ なんで!?: ▲小早川＊▲! What are you doing here!？
translations.忘れてたら蹴ってやろうかと思って。: I figured I'd kick you if you'd forgotten.
translations.その様子だと、覚えてはいたみたいだね。はあ……。: By the looks of it, you didn't forget. *Sigh*...
translations.いいから、早く支度。: Never mind that, just hurry and get ready.
translations.あ、もう大丈夫。出られるから。: Oh, I'm all set. We can head out now.
translations.あっそ。もう、心配したっつーの。: Oh, okay. Jeez, you had me worried.
translations.（今日曇ってるけど、このくらいがちょうどいいな……）: (It's cloudy today, but weather like this is just right...)
translations.ねえ、なんかどんよりした天気だよねぇ……。: Man, the weather's so gloomy today...
translations.だよねぇ。パッと晴れてくれないかな。: I know, right？ I wish it would just clear up already.
translations.お待たせ。なんかはっきりしない天気だね。リンコはこれぐらいが好きだけど。: Sorry for the wait. The weather's kind of dreary today, huh？ Though I actually like it this way.
translations.だよな！ ●たち気が合うな。: I know, right! We really think alike, ●.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。待った？: ▲主人公＊▲. Did I keep you waiting？
translations.いや。それよりなんか微妙な雲行きだな。降水確率も微妙だったし。: Nah. Anyway, those clouds look kind of iffy. The forecast was on the fence about rain, too.
translations.近所のネコが顔洗ってなかったし、大丈夫じゃないかな。あの子の予報当たるから。: The neighborhood cat wasn't washing its face, so I think we're fine. Its forecasts are always right.
translations.あ、▲小早川＊▲！ 雨、すごいな。: Oh, ▲小早川＊▲! It's really coming down.
translations.どこかで雨宿りした方が……。: Maybe we should duck out of the rain somewhere...
translations.ほんと一瞬だったな……。: That was over in a flash...
translations.よ、▲小早川＊▲。雨になっちゃったな。: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Started raining on us, huh.
translations.別にいいけど、傘持つのがめんどくさい。: I don't really mind, except holding an umbrella is a pain.
translations.それって……遠まわしに、相合傘の催促？: Is that... a roundabout way of asking to share mine？
translations.言ってないっつーの。: That is so not what I said.
translations.イッテ～、雪で滑った……。: Owww, I slipped on the snow...
translations.清々しい転びっぷりだったよ、コントみたい！: That was a spectacular wipeout, right out of a slapstick routine!
translations.▲小早川＊▲、待った？: Did I keep you waiting, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.今来たとこ。それよりさ、あそこに小さい雪ダルマがあるの気づいた？: I just got here. Anyway, did you notice that tiny snowman over there？
translations.あ、ほんとだ。小さいのに顔も腕もついてる。器用に作ってんなぁ。: Oh, you're right. It's tiny, but it's even got a face and arms. Someone did a neat job making it.
translations.ちょっと写真撮ってくるから……待て！: I'm gonna go take a quick picture, so... stay!
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ どうした？ なにかあったのか？: ▲小早川＊▲! What's wrong？ Did something happen？
translations.風が強くて、スカートが……。: The wind's so strong, my skirt...
translations.遅かったか……。: I got here too late, huh...
translations.▲小早川＊▲。今来たの？: ▲小早川＊▲. Did you just get here？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。うん、ちょうど今着いたとこ。: ▲主人公＊▲. Yeah, I just got here.
translations.うん……平気。風に押されちゃっただけだし。: Yeah... I'm fine. The wind just pushed me a little.
translations.なんか文句ありそうな顔……。よくわかんないけど。: You look like you've got a complaint... Not sure what, though.
translations.これ……この前の。へへ、つけてきちゃった。: This is... from the other day. Hehe, I wore it today.
translations.これね、気に入っちゃったから、またつけてみた。: I really ended up liking this, so I wore it again.
translations.気分的にさ、こっちのプレゼントつけてみた。: I felt like wearing this present today.
translations.そう？ へへ。じゃあ当分、ヘビーローテーション決定。: Really？ Hehe. Guess it's going into heavy rotation for a while.
translations.うん、リンコも結構いいと思ってる。: Yeah, I think it looks pretty good too.
translations.ちょっと。感動とかしないわけ？: Hey. Aren't you even a little impressed？
translations.なに？ はっきりしないなぁ。: What is it？ Don't be so wishy-washy.
translations.髪型変えてみたら？: Why not try a new hairstyle？
translations.髪の色変えてみたら？: Why not try a new hair color？
translations.髪の長さ変えてみたら？: Why not change your hair length？
translations.それもいいかも。考えとく。: That might be nice. I'll think about it.
translations.そう……。リンコはけっこう気に入ってるのに。: I see... And here I actually liked it.
translations.……言いたいことはハッキリ言う。: ...If you have something to say, just say it.
translations.なんなの？ 黙ってたらわかんないし。: What is it？ I can't tell if you don't say anything.
translations.ええ!? こないだ変えたばっかじゃん。: What!？ I just changed it the other day.
translations.そっか……そうなったか: I see... So that's how it turned out.
translations.はいはい。ムリして感想とか言わなくていいから。: Yeah, yeah. You don't have to force yourself to say anything.
translations.ねえ。髪、最近伸びたでしょ。どう？: Hey. My hair's gotten longer lately, right？ What do you think？
translations.切らないの？: Aren't you going to cut it？
translations.そっか、よかった。リンコもこのまま伸ばそうと思ってたんだよね。: Oh, good. I was thinking of letting it grow out like this, too.
translations.短いのがいいんだ？ ま、いいけど。: You prefer it short？ Well, alright.
translations.まさか、気づいてなかったわけ？ ……まさかね。: Wait, did you not even notice？ ...No way, right？
translations.この髪型、どう思う？: What do you think of this hairstyle？
translations.この髪の色さ、どう？: What do you think of this hair color？
translations.えっと……この髪の色さ、どう思う？ ほら、忌憚なく。: Um... What do you think of this hair color？ Come on, don't hold back.
translations.すごい！ 似合うもんだな: Wow! It actually really suits you.
translations.そう？\nこういうの好きなんだ？\n覚えとこっと。:
Really？
So you like this look？
I'll keep that in mind.
translations.ええっ……。そっか……好みじゃないか。:
Oh... I see...
So you're not a fan.
translations.お腹すいたー。お昼さ、どうすんの？:
I'm hungry.
What're we doing for lunch？
translations.お腹空いたー。もうダメかも。:
I'm starving.
I might not make it.
translations.そういえば、ちょっとお腹空いてきたかも。:
Come to think of it,
I'm getting a little hungry.
translations.なんか、のど渇いてきちゃった。:
I'm starting to get
a little thirsty.
translations.いいねぇ。行こ行こ。:
Sounds good.
Come on, let's go.
translations.うーん……気分じゃない。:
Hmm...
I'm not in the mood.
translations.見てほら、雲の切れ間。天気よくなってきたみたい。:
Look, a break in the clouds.
Seems like it's clearing up.
translations.なんか空、あやしくなってきた。曇りですめばいいけど。:
The sky's looking dicey.
Hope it just stays cloudy.
translations.雪だ……。ほら、ほらほら。降ってきた。:
It's snow... Look, look.
It's coming down.
translations.外、雨降ってきたみたい。けっこう強くなるんじゃない？:
It started raining outside.
Think it'll get pretty heavy？
translations.ちょ、降ってきた。強くなるんじゃない？:
Hey, it's coming down.
Think it'll get heavy？
translations.ほんとだ。予定変更した方がいいかもな……。:
You're right. Maybe we
should change our plans...
translations.うん、オッケー。そうと決まれば早く行こ。:
Yeah, okay. Now that that's
settled, let's hurry.
translations.うん……リンコも同じ気持ちかな。:
Yeah... I think I feel the
same way.
translations.甘えんなっつーの。: Don't get all needy on me.
translations.周り気にしろっつーの。:
Pay attention to your
surroundings, will you？
translations.ダメだって。ほら……人。:
I told you, no.
Look... people.
translations.リンコ、そんな気分じゃないっつーの。:
I told you, I'm not in
the mood for that.
translations.え？ あ……傘、傾いてるって。: Huh？ Hey... You're tilting the umbrella.
translations.こらっ。こんだけくっついてるんだから……十分じゃん。: Hey. We're already pressed right up against each other... Isn't this close enough？
translations.雨、かかっちゃうからさ。: We're going to get rained on.
translations.はい、前見て歩く。: Come on, watch where you're walking.
translations.まあいいけど、下手なのはやめてよ。: Fine by me, just don't take a bad one.
translations.リンコがモデルなんだから、ピンボケとかやめてよ。: I'm your model here, so don't make it blurry or anything.
translations.へへ、上手く撮ってよ？: Hehe, take a good one, okay？
translations.やだ。イヤだから、やだ。: No. I don't want to, so no.
translations.軽く、なにか食べない？: Want to grab a quick bite？
translations.お腹空いたな……。いい時間だし、昼どう？: I'm getting hungry... It's about that time, so how about lunch？
translations.そろそろ晩ご飯の時間だな。どっか食べに行く？: It's almost dinnertime. Want to go eat somewhere？
translations.うん、いいね。リンコもお腹空いてきた。: Yeah, sounds good. I'm getting hungry too.
translations.うん。行きたいなら付き合うよ。: Sure. If you want to go, I'll come with you.
translations.めんどくさい。リンコ、お腹空いてないし。: Too much trouble. I'm not even hungry.
translations.もう着いたか。こんな近かったっけ？: We're here already？ Was it always this close？
translations.傘、持ってるじゃん。つまんない。: Oh, you have an umbrella. Boring.
translations.……ふたりして傘持ってきて。準備のいいカップルだね。: ...Look at us, both bringing umbrellas. What a well-prepared couple.
translations.リンコ、わざと傘忘れて来ればよかった。: I should've forgotten my umbrella on purpose.
translations.傘ないんだ？ しょうがないな……ほら。: You don't have an umbrella？ Guess I have no choice... Here.
translations.おっ、サンキュ。じゃあ●、傘持つよ。: Oh, thanks. Then ● will hold the umbrella.
translations.傘、忘れたんだ？ ほら、入れてあげる。: Forgot your umbrella？ Here, you can share mine.
translations.はい、傘。リンコと相合傘できるなんて、幸せでしょ？: Here, get under. Sharing an umbrella with me... Aren't you lucky？
translations.ああ、サンキュ。忘れてラッキーだった。: Yeah, thanks. Lucky I forgot mine.
translations.はい。傘、ないんだろ？: Here. You don't have an umbrella, right？
translations.ほら、●の傘に入れば？: Here, why don't you share ●'s umbrella？
translations.……しょうがないなぁ。くっつきすぎるのは禁止、: ...Guess I have no choice. No getting too close, though.
translations.ほら、こっちの傘入れよ。持ってないんだろ？: Come on, get under my umbrella. You don't have one, right？
translations.うん。へへ……忘れてきてよかった。:
Okay. Heh... Glad I forgot
mine.
translations.傘持ってないのか？ ●もなんだよな……。:
No umbrella？ ● don't
have one either...
translations.そっか……。べつに、いいんだけどさ。:
Oh, okay... Not that I mind,
or anything.
translations.今……リンコにくっつきたいって思ってる？:
Are you... thinking you want
to get closer to me right now？
translations.……こっちの方がさ、恋人同士ってカンジ……するかも。:
...This feels a little more...
