like we're a couple, maybe.
translations.ぎゅっ！ とか……言ってみたりね。へへ。:
Squeeze! ...Just felt like
saying it out loud. Heh.
translations.……ん？ 今日、ここだっけ？:
...Huh？ Was it supposed to
be here today？
translations.えっと……ごめん、間違えた。:
Uh... Sorry, I got the place
wrong.
translations.何やってんだか。まあ、ここでもいっか。:
What are you doing？ Well,
I guess here is fine too.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲がいいなら、それでいいか……）:
(If ▲小早川＊▲'s fine with it,
I guess it's okay...)
translations.……ねえ。あのさ、こっちでいいんだっけ？:
...Hey. Um, is this where
we were supposed to go？
translations.はあ、しょうがないな。時間なくなるし、ここでいいよ。:
Sigh, honestly. We'll run out
of time, so here is fine.
translations.さーて、どのゲーム攻めよっか？:
Now then, which game should
we tackle first？
translations.ねえ、どれにすんの？: Hey, which one are we playing？
translations.好きなの選べば？:
Why don't you pick whatever
you want？
translations.ね、ね？ もうちょっと遊ぼうよ。:
Hey, come on. Let's play a
little longer.
translations.まあ、おもしろかったかな。他のもやっとく？:
Well, that was pretty fun.
Want to try something else？
translations.得意気な顔してるとこ悪いけど。リンコ、そろそろ違うとこ行きたい。:
Sorry to wipe that smug look
off your face, but I want to
go somewhere else now.
translations.えっと……今日お弁当作ってきたんだけどさ、どうする？: Um... I made us lunch today. What do you want to do？
translations.もちろん、食べるよ。ラッキー！: Eat it, of course. Lucky me!
translations.一応、お弁当作ってきたんだよね。いらないならいいけど。: I went ahead and made a boxed lunch. It's fine if you don't want it, though.
translations.あのさ、お弁当作ってきた。食べるでしょ？: Hey, I made lunch. You're gonna eat it, right？
translations.じゃあ、●の家に来る？: Then wanna come over to ●'s place？
translations.そこはちょっと……気分じゃない。: Not there... I'm not really in the mood for that.
translations.糸くずついてる。ほら、しゃがむ！: There's a piece of lint in it. Come on, bend down!
translations.今朝、近所の小学生に「おはよう」て言ったのにさ……無視された。: I said good morning to a grade-schooler in my neighborhood this morning... and got totally ignored.
translations.むやみに返事してはいけませんって、学校で言われてるとか？: Maybe their school tells them not to talk to strangers？
translations.そんなの相手見て臨機応変に対応すればいいじゃん。善良な女子高生相手にさ。最近の子: They should be able to judge case by case, though. I'm just a harmless high school girl. Kids these days...
translations.最近の子って……自分はいつの子だよ。: "Kids these days"？ ...How old do you think you are？
translations.昨日の夜にやってた特番観た？: Did you watch that special on TV last night？
translations.ああ、クイズの２時間番組？ 観ようと思ってたけど、結局忘れてた。: Oh, the two-hour quiz show？ I meant to watch it, but I ended up forgetting.
translations.全然つまんないの。最後まで観ても人気の理由わかんなかった。: It was super boring. Even after watching it all the way to the end, I still didn't get why it's so popular.
translations.（最後までは観たんだな……）: (So she did watch it all the way to the end...)
translations.なにそれ？ オッサンくさい。: What was that？ You sound like an old man.
translations.……いっこ違いだけどな。: ...I'm only a year older than you, you know.
translations.へへ、悪口じゃないといいけどね。: Hehe, hope they're not talking bad about you, though.
translations.リンコのクラスメイト。……そっか。あのふたり、つき合ってたんだ。: They're my classmates. ...I see. So those two are dating.
translations.へえ、言いふらしたりすんなよ？: Huh. Don't go spreading it around, okay？
translations.……あそこにいる双子、ソックリ。ねえ、もしリンコが双子だったらどうする？: ...Those twins over there look identical. Hey, what would you do if I had a twin？
translations.どういう意味？ 『ふたりとつき合いたーい』とか思うんじゃないの？: What's that supposed to mean？ Wouldn't you be thinking, "I wanna date both of them!" or something？
translations.あ、キレイなネコ。これは野良じゃないね。: Oh, what a pretty cat. Definitely not a stray.
translations.わかるのか？ 何もつけてないけど。: Can you tell？ It's not wearing a collar or anything.
translations.毛並みとかツヤ見てればわかるよ。まだまだだね。: You can tell just by looking at how glossy and well-groomed its coat is. You still have a lot to learn.
translations.うーん、わかんない。: Hmm, I can't tell the difference.
translations.あ、少しアザになってる。: Oh, I've got a little bruise.
translations.弟とのヴォルヴァヴィンごっこで、ちょっとね。子供の遊びは過酷だよ。: Just playing Volvavin with my little brother. Kids play rough.
translations.う……ちょっとお腹痛い。: Ugh... My stomach hurts a little.
translations.え……大丈夫か？ どこかで休むか？: Huh...？ Are you okay？ Want to rest somewhere？
translations.んー、たぶん大丈夫。よくあるやつだから、待てば大丈夫。: Hmm, I think I'm fine. I get this a lot, so it'll pass.
translations.ならいいけど、辛かったら言えよ？: Okay, good. Tell me if it gets worse, alright？
translations.ん、ほんとだ。挨拶でもしとくか？: Oh, you're right. Should we go say hi？
translations.いいよ、ヤブヘビになるから。ほら、ジロジロ見るとバレるって。: No, we'd just be asking for trouble. Come on, don't stare or we'll get caught.
translations.（そんなに後ろ暗いことがあるのか……？）: (Does she have a guilty conscience about something...？)
translations.軽めの食事しないか？: Want to grab a light bite？
translations.昼、まだだよな。どっかで食べない？: We haven't had lunch yet, right？ Want to eat somewhere？
translations.そろそろ晩ご飯の時間じゃないか？ どうする？: Isn't it almost dinnertime？ What do you want to do？
translations.あのさ……これ、リンコ特製弁当だけど。食べる？: Hey... I made a special lunch. Want some？
translations.まだ昼前だし、もうちょっと時間いい？: It's not even noon yet. Do you have a little more time？
translations.まだ早いだろ？ もう少し遊ぶか。: It's still early, right？ Let's hang out a little longer.
translations.まだ時間大丈夫？ もう少し一緒にいたいんだけど。: Are you still good on time？ I'd like to stay with you a little longer.
translations.もちろん。リンコだって、まだ一緒にいたいし。: Of course. I want to stay with you longer, too.
translations.よかった。じゃあ次は、どこ行くかな。: Great. Where should we go next, then？
translations.うん。リンコも、もう少しって思ってたんだよね。: Yeah. I was hoping we could stay out a little longer, too.
translations.もう少し遊んでたいけどさ……この後予定があって。: I'd like to hang out longer, too, but... I have plans after this.
translations.そっか。じゃあそろそろ……。: I see. Guess we should wrap things up, then...
translations.リンコだって、もう少しって思うけど……時間がさ。: I want to stay longer too, but... it's getting late.
translations.リンコ、ヒマじゃないし。もう帰る。: It's not like I have all day. I'm going home.
translations.仕方ないか……。: Nothing I can do about that...
translations.じゃあ、●の家、寄って行く？: Then want to stop by ●'s place？
translations.あのさ、もたれて……いい？: Hey, mind if I... lean on you？
translations.あのさ、もたれちゃっていい？: Hey, can I lean on you？
translations.……ちょっと疲れただけだから。: ...I'm just a little tired, that's all.
translations.ずっと……こうしてたいかも。: I kind of want to... stay like this forever.
translations.乗り過ごす？ とかね……降りよ。: Want to miss our stop？ Just kidding... Let's get off.
translations.ほら、降りなきゃ。: Come on, we have to get off.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。もうすぐ着くから、起きないと。: ▲小早川＊▲. We're almost there, so you need to wake up.
translations.……ん？ もうちょっと寝てたかったのに……。: ...Mm？ I wanted to sleep a little longer, though...
translations.疲れてないか？ もたれていいよ。: Aren't you tired？ You can lean on me.
translations.うん。ちょっと疲れたし……お願いしよっかな。: Yeah. I'm a little tired... so maybe I'll take you up on that.
translations.やだ……。なんか気分じゃないし。: No thanks... I'm just not really in the mood.
translations.アンタが寂しそうな顔するから、しょうがなくね。: Only because you looked so lonely. I guess I have no choice.
translations.電車が止まらなかったら、ずっと……こうしてられるのに。: If the train never stopped, we could stay like this... forever.
translations.いつでも寄りかかっていいからさ。: You can lean on me anytime.
translations.よかったら、家寄らない？ もう少し一緒にいたいしさ。: Want to stop by my place？ I'd like to be with you a little longer.
translations.家……か。うん、いいかも。: Your place...？ Yeah, that sounds nice.
translations.今から？ う～ん……やめとく。: Right now？ Hmm... I think I'll pass.
translations.あのさ、もう少し一緒にいたいんだけど……アンタの家、大丈夫？: Hey, I want to stay together a little longer... Is your place okay？
translations.少しでも長く一緒にいたいしな。: I want to spend as much time with you as I can, too.
translations.ごめんな。また今度来てくれよ。: Sorry about that. Come over next time, okay？
translations.実はさ、プレゼントあるんだけど。: Actually, I have a present for you.
translations.プレゼント？ へえ、何？: A present？ Oh, what is it？
translations.へへ、寂しそうな顔すんなっつーの。: Hehe, quit making such a lonely face.
translations.次会ったときでいいじゃん？ じゃあね。: Save it for next time we meet, okay？ See ya.
translations.えっ、快？ じゃ、じゃあね。バイバイ！: Huh, Kai？ S-See ya, then. Bye-bye！
translations.あっ……家のカギない。: Oh... I don't have my house key.
translations.え、カバンの中ないのか？ じゃあ、ポケットは？: Huh, it's not in your bag？ What about your pockets？
translations.ポケット？ えっと……あ、あった！ 焦った……。: My pockets？ Let's see... Oh, found it！ That scared me...
translations.はは、●も焦った。じゃあな。: Haha, ● panicked there too. See ya.
translations.あのさ、よかったら家あがってく？ 弟、うるさいかもしれないけど。: Hey, want to come inside for a bit？ My brother might be noisy, though.
translations.ついでだし、あがってく？ 家族いないから、静かだと思うし。: Since you're here, want to come in？ Nobody's home, so it should be quiet.
translations.いいの？ じゃあ、そうしよう: Are you sure？ Let's do that, then.
translations.そっか……じゃあ、また今度。: Oh, okay... Maybe next time, then.
translations.せっかく誘ってくれたのに、ごめんな。: Sorry, after you offered and everything.
translations.このまま住んじゃえばいいのに……へへ、冗談だっつーの。: You should just move in already... Hehe, I'm only joking.
translations.ありがと、楽しかった。またね。: Thanks, I had fun. See you.
translations.なんか、引き止めて迷惑だったかな？ ……じゃあね。: Did I keep you too long？ Sorry if it was a bother... See you.
translations.あのさ……今日は、楽しかった。ごめんね。: Listen... I had fun today. And I'm sorry.
translations.なら、よかった。●のほうこそ、前は気づかい足りなかったよ、ごめんな。: I'm glad. ● wasn't considerate enough last time either. Sorry about that.
translations.ううん、仲直りできてうれしい。これからも、よろしく。: It's fine, I'm just happy we made up. Let's keep getting along.
translations.えっとさ、この間は……ごめん。このデートで、仲直り……できた？: Um, about the other day... I'm sorry. Are we good again... after today's date？
translations.うん、できた。これからは●も、もっといろいろ気をつけるよ。: Yeah, we're good. ● will try to be more careful from now on, too.
translations.へへ……ありがと。じゃあ、次のデートも楽しみにしてるから。: Hehe... Thanks. I'll be looking forward to our next date, then.
translations.ああ、また楽しいデートしような。それじゃ。: Yeah, let's have another fun date soon. See you.
translations.あの……なんか、ごめんね。リンコのこと……もう許してくれる？: Um... I'm really sorry. Can you... forgive me now？
translations.気にしなくていいよ。●だって悪いんだし。: Don't worry about it. ● was at fault too.
translations.よかった！ じゃあ、またデートしようね？ 今日はありがと。バイバイ。: Thank goodness! Let's go on another date soon, okay？ Thanks for today. Bye-bye.
translations.オッケー。リンコもちょうどそんな気分だったんだ。: Okay. I was just in the mood for that too.
translations.そっか、よかった。じゃあ、どこ行こうか？: Oh, good. Where should we go, then？
translations.行きたいけど……今日はリンコ、早く帰んないと。: I want to, but... I have to get home early today.
translations.ダメか……。じゃ、寄り道なしで帰るか。: Too bad... Guess we'll just head straight home, then.
translations.そこで決まり。早く行こ。: That's the place, then. Come on, let's go.
translations.そこか……。アンタが行きたいならしょうがないか。: There, huh... Well, if you want to go, I guess I can't complain.
translations.リンコ、寄り道する時間ないんだよね。一緒に帰るだけじゃダメ？: I don't really have time for a detour. Can't we just walk home together？
translations.そっか。じゃ、まっすぐ帰るか。: Got it. Let's just head straight home, then.
translations.ふ～ん……。そこ、好きなんだ。別にいいけどさ。: Hmm... So you like that place. Well, I don't mind.
translations.なんでそうなるかな、行くワケないじゃん……。じゃ。: How did you even come up with that？ No way I'm going... Bye.
translations.あのさ……帰り、どっか寄ってく？: Hey... Want to stop somewhere on the way home？
translations.なーんだ。じゃあ、一緒に帰るだけならどう？: Oh, bummer. How about just walking home together, then？
translations.（いけね……待ち合わせの時間過ぎてる……）: (Crap... It's past the time we were supposed to meet...)
translations.遅い……。迎えにきたの、感謝してよ。: You're late... You should be grateful I came to get you.
translations.やばい！ 待ち合わせ時間過ぎてる……。: Shoot! It's past our meeting time...
translations.まだこんなとこにいた。カノジョに迎えにこさせるなんて、カレシ失格。: So you were still here. Making your girlfriend come pick you up... You fail as a boyfriend.
translations.あっ！ 待ち合わせの時間過ぎてる……。: Ah! It's past the time we were supposed to meet...
translations.あっ……じゃないっつーの。迎えにきたよ。: Don't "Ah!" me. I came to get you.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。まさか……約束、忘れてるとか？: ▲主人公＊▲. Don't tell me... you forgot our plans？
translations.あ、▲小早川＊▲。今行こうと思ってたんだ。: Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. I was just about to head over.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。アンタの焦った顔見に来たよ。: ▲主人公＊▲. I came to see the panicked look on your face.
translations.え？ まだ時間じゃないだろ。: Huh？ It's not even time yet.
translations.教室まで来ちゃった。どう、カノジョが迎えに来るのって？: I came all the way to your classroom. So, how does it feel having your girlfriend come get you？
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ ごめん、待った？:
▲小早川＊▲! Sorry, did I
keep you waiting？
translations.“ごめん、待った？”って。ラブラブだな。: "Sorry, were you waiting long？" Look at you two lovebirds.
translations.あ、お前！ 余計なこと言いふらすなよ？:
Hey! Don't go blabbing
about this, okay？
translations.はあ、元気だね。アンタのお友達。:
Man, your friend sure
has a lot of energy.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。お待たせ。:
▲小早川＊▲. Sorry to
keep you waiting.
translations.よっ、お二人さん。仲良く下校か？ 熱いね！:
Yo, you two. Walking home
together？ Hot stuff!
translations.冷やかすなよ、あっち行けって。:
Quit teasing us and
get lost already.
translations.ずいぶんレトロな表現使う友達だね……まあ、面白いけど。:
Your friend uses some pretty
retro expressions... Well,
he's funny, though.
translations.ううん。リンコは全然平気。: Nope. I don't mind at all.
translations.おい、小早川。オレたちにも、そのくらい優しくしてくれよ。:
Hey, Kobayakawa. How about
being that nice to us, too？
translations.なに言ってんの？ バカじゃん。:
What are you talking about？
You're an idiot.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、けっこうクラスの男子とも普通に話せてるんだな）:
(Huh, ▲小早川＊▲ can talk
pretty normally with the
guys in her class, too.)
translations.お前たち。こんなとこでなにしてるんだ？:
You two. What are you
doing out here？
translations.図書委員のことで相談してるだけですけど、問題ありますか？:
We're just discussing library
committee business. Is there
a problem？
translations.ああ、そうか。委員の仕事はしっかり頑張るように。:
Oh, I see. Well, keep up the
good work with the committee.
translations.おまえたち、高校生らしい付き合いをしてるだろうな？:
You two are keeping things
appropriate for high school
students, right？
translations.高校生らしくない付き合いが、なんなのか分かりません。教えていただけませんか？:
I don't know what's
inappropriate for high school
students. Could you tell me？
translations.あ、いや……まぁ、それならいいんだ。:
Uh, no... Well, that's
fine, then.
translations.小早川じゃないか。そっちは２年の……。:
Well, if it isn't Kobayakawa.
And you're that second-year...
translations.あ……えっと、図書委員の先輩です。:
Oh... Um, he's my senior on
the library committee.
translations.ええ。図書室の運営について、先輩に相談してたんです。失礼します。:
Yes. I was just asking him
for advice on running the
library. Excuse us.
translations.取りに行ってこいよ。●はここで待ってるから。:
Go on and get it, ●.
I'll wait right here.
translations.いいよ。教科書がなければ、宿題できなかった理由にもなるし。:
Nah, it's fine. Without my
textbook, I'll have an excuse
for not doing the homework.
translations.（ならないだろ……）:
(Pretty sure that won't
fly as an excuse...)
translations.あっ！ 教室に忘れもの……。:
Oh! I left something in
the classroom...
translations.取りに帰るか？: Want to go back and get it？
translations.んー、いいや。大したものじゃないし。:
Hmm, nah. It's nothing
important anyway.
translations.今日配られたプリント忘れてきちゃった……。教室、ついてきてくれる？:
I forgot the handout we got
today... Will you come back
to the classroom with me？
translations.ああ。１年の教室ってめったに行けないから、ちょっと楽しみだな。:
Sure. I rarely get to see the
first-year classrooms, so I'm
kind of looking forward to it.
translations.あっ、待って。……あったあった。国語のノートに挟んであったよ。:
Oh, wait... Never mind, here
it is. It was tucked inside
my Japanese notebook.
translations.そう……なんか残念……。:
Oh... Well, that's kind of
disappointing...
translations.ねえ、あそこにいるのって２年の担任？:
Hey, isn't that a second-year
homeroom teacher over there？
translations.ああ、そうだな……一緒にいるのは１年生か？:
Yeah, it is... Is that a
first-year with him？
translations.隣のクラスの女子……アヤシイ……。:
A girl from the class next
door... How suspicious...
translations.はは、そうとも限んないだろ。:
Haha, it's probably nothing
like that.
translations.あ……あのカップル、ふたりともリンコのクラスの学級委員なんだよね。:
Oh... That couple over there,
they're both the class reps
for my homeroom.
translations.いっつもリンコに“校則は守れ”ってうるさいのにさ、自分たちは楽しくやってんじゃん:
They're always nagging me about
the school rules, yet look at
them having fun.
translations.まあ、付き合うくらい、いいだろ。:
Well, there's nothing wrong
with dating, right？
translations.なに？ ……気になる女子でもいるとか？:
What？ ...See a girl you're
interested in or something？
translations.違うって、●のクラスの子で――:
No, ● just know her from
my class—
translations.あっ、誰か来た……うちのクラスの男子じゃん！ へえ、あっちは年上のカノジョと年下:
Oh, someone's coming... Hey,
he's from my class! Huh, an
older girlfriend and younger
boyfriend.
translations.なんだよ……あ、あの女子、下駄箱に……。:
What gives...? Oh, that girl by
the shoe lockers...
translations.そう、ラブレターかなんかじゃない？ 邪魔するのは無粋でしょ。:
Yeah, a love letter or something,
maybe？ It'd be rude to get in
the way.
translations.なんだよ……あ、あれって……告白してるのか？:
What is it...? Wait, are they...
confessing their feelings？
translations.たぶんね、のぞくのは趣味悪いから。さっさと行くよ。:
Looks like it, and eavesdropping
is in bad taste. Come on, let's
get going.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、なにソワソワしてんの？:
▲小早川＊▲, what's got you
so fidgety？
translations.ん……今日、クラスの友達が先輩に告白するって言ってたから。:
Mm... A friend from my class
said she's confessing to an
upperclassman today.
translations.それで▲小早川＊▲まで緊張してんのか。自分のときのことを思い出したりしてな？:
And that's making you nervous
too, ▲小早川＊▲？ Brings back
memories of your own, huh？
translations.それはいいっつーの。ほら行くよ。:
Leave me out of this. Come on,
let's go.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲……あれ、誰かと話してる）:
(▲小早川＊▲... Huh？ She's talking
to someone.)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。いたんだ？ 早く行こ。:
▲主人公＊▲. You were here？
Let's get going.
translations.そっちの話は終わったのか？:
Are you done talking over
there？
translations.ああ、なんか名前と連絡先聞かれただけ。無視したけど。:
Oh, he just asked for my name
and number. I ignored him,
though.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。今、誰かと喋ってた？:
▲小早川＊▲. Were you just talking
with someone？
translations.３年生だって。“クラスと名前教えて？”って。:
Some third-year. He asked me
for my name and homeroom.
translations.まさか。蹴るっておどしたらいなくなった。:
As if. I threatened to kick him
and he took off.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。遅いじゃん。リンコ、大変だったんだから。:
▲主人公＊▲. You're late. I just
had quite the ordeal, you know.
translations.知らない男子にナンパされた。:
Some random guy tried to hit
on me.
translations.なんにもないって。そんなに心配なら、リンコのこと一人にするなっつーの。:
Nothing happened. If you're
that worried, don't leave me
by myself.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、お待たせ。:
Sorry to keep you waiting,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.あ……。はぁ、もっとゆっくりでもよかったのに。:
Oh... *sigh* You could've taken
a little longer.
translations.ネコが迷い込んできたから一緒に遊んでたの。アンタの声聞いて逃げちゃったけどね。:
A stray cat wandered in and I
was playing with it. It ran off
when it heard your voice, though.
translations.あっ……ちょっと、急に大きな声で呼ばないでよ。逃げちゃったじゃん。:
Ah... Hey, don't call out so
loudly all of a sudden. Look,
it ran away.
translations.キレイな三毛ネコ。おっかけよっかな……。:
A pretty calico cat. Maybe I'll
go after it...
translations.悪かったよ。でも●との約束あるだろ。:
Sorry. Didn't you and ●
have plans, though？
translations.そう、よく学校に侵入してくる子。リンコに会いに来てるみたいでさ、カワイイの。: Yeah, it sneaks into school a lot. It's like it comes just to see me. So cute.
translations.へえ、●も見たかったな。: Huh, ● would've liked to see it too.
translations.ペンケースが落ちてたんだけど……。: I found a pencil case on the ground...
translations.名前書いてないのか？: Is there a name on it？
translations.高校生にもなって持ち物に名前書かないって。: Who puts their name on their stuff in high school？
translations.そっか……それじゃ、職員室に寄って届けるか。: Good point... Let's drop it off at the faculty office, then.
translations.クリアファイル拾っちゃった。しかもリンコの好きなバンドのステッカー貼ってある。: I found a plastic folder. And it has a sticker of a band I like on it.
translations.へえ、自分で貼ったっぽいな。: Huh, looks like they put it on themselves.
translations.愛を感じるね。落とし主、誰かなあ。: You can really feel the love. I wonder whose it is.
translations.もしわかったら、趣味があうかもな。: If we find out, you two might have the same taste.
translations.化粧ポーチ拾っちゃった。これ職員室に届けたら、持ち主が先生に怒られそう。: I found a makeup pouch. If we turn this in to the faculty office, the owner's probably gonna get in trouble.
translations.そっか……。じゃあ、元の場所に戻しておくか？: True... Should we just put it back where you found it？
translations.そう。拾ってくれたんだ？ ありがとう。: Yes. Did you pick it up for me？ Thank you.
translations.なんだ先生のだったのか……。ま、無事に持ち主が見つかってよかったね。: Oh, so it was a teacher's... Well, good thing we found the owner.
translations.え？ ああ、ごめん音楽聴いてた。: Huh？ Oh, sorry, I was listening to music.
translations.ちょっと、なにしてんの。リンコなら、こっちですけど。: Hey, what are you doing？ I'm over here, you know.
translations.あっ、▲小早川＊▲！ あ、ははは、人違いだったみたい。: Oh, ▲小早川＊▲! Ah, hahaha, looks like I got the wrong person.
translations.カノジョを見間違えるとか、失礼なんですけど。: Mistaking someone else for your girlfriend is pretty rude, you know.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。なんで後ろにリンコいるの、わかったの？: ▲主人公＊▲. How did you know I was behind you？
translations.へえ、すごいじゃん。愛のチカラ？: Huh, impressive. The power of love？
translations.見つかるとヤバイな……。: It'll be bad if we get caught...
translations.ウワサでは、反省文を原稿用紙２０枚分書かされるらしいよ。どうせ読まないくせにさ。: Rumor has it they make you write a twenty-page apology essay. Even though they don't bother reading it anyway.
translations.面倒なことにならないように、道を変えるか。: Let's go another way and save ourselves the trouble.
translations.よう。学校帰りにデートか？ うらやましいな、オイ！: Yo. Going on a date after school？ Man, I'm jealous!
translations.へえ。カノジョと学校帰りにデートって、自慢になるんだ？: Huh. So going on an after-school date with your girlfriend is something to brag about？
translations.デートすることじゃなくて、カノジョが自慢なんだけどな。: It's not the date I'm bragging about, it's my girlfriend.
translations.……たまにはいいこと言うじゃん。:
...You actually say
something nice for once.
translations.最近お父さんがさ、早く帰って来いってうるさいんだよね。:
My dad's been nagging me
to come home early lately.
translations.娘のことが心配なんだな。:
He's just worried about
his daughter.
translations.それもあるだろうけど……弟の面倒をリンコに見させたいみたい。お母さんと二人の時間:
Maybe, but... I think he
wants me to watch my brother
so he gets time with Mom.
translations.“トイレットペーパー買ってきて”だって。デート中のオトメにトイレットペーパーって:
'Go buy some toilet paper,'
she says. Asking a maiden on
a date for toilet paper...
translations.お母さんだ、ちょっとごめん。:
It's my mom.
Sorry, hang on.
translations.もしもし？ ああ、快？ ……うん、わかったわかった。……チョコ？ はーい、じゃあ:
Hello？ Oh, Kai？ ...Yeah,
okay, got it. ...Chocolate？
Alright, be a good boy then.
translations.弟。お母さんの携帯使ってかけてきた。おみやげちょーだいって。:
It was my little brother.
He called from Mom's phone
asking me to bring a treat.
translations.探さなくていいっつーの。ほら、行くよ。:
Don't go looking for her.
Come on, let's go.
translations.ん、メールだ。ちょっとごめん。:
Hm, a text.
Sorry, hang on.
translations.通販サイトだ。『お探しの商品が入荷しました』だってさ。どうしよっかな。:
An online shop. 'The item
you wanted is back in stock.'
Hmm, what should I do...
translations.ネット通販か。有効活用してそうだな、▲小早川＊▲は。:
Online shopping, huh？ I bet
you get a lot of use out of
that, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.もしもし？ ……違います。……はい、そうですね。……はい、失礼します。:
Hello？ ...No, wrong number.
...Yes, that's right.
...Okay, goodbye.
translations.●が電話したときより丁寧に対応するんだな……。:
You're way more polite than
when ● calls...
translations.そりゃそうでしょ。アンタの場合は対応レベル最低でも問題ないもん。:
Well, obviously. With you,
the bare minimum is fine.
translations.（まあ、それだけ身近な存在ってことか）:
(Guess that just means
she's comfortable with me.)
translations.う……筋肉痛かも。:
Ugh... I think my muscles
are sore.
translations.筋肉痛？ 運動なんてしたか？:
Sore muscles？ Did you
work out or something？
translations.家の掃除で……リンコも歳かもね。アンタほどじゃないけど。:
Just cleaning the house...
Maybe I'm getting old.
Not as old as you, though.
translations.あとでさ、コンビニ寄っていい？:
Hey, can we stop by a
convenience store later？
translations.弟におみやげ。なんかね、お菓子についてるオマケを集めてるんだって。:
A treat for my brother.
Apparently he's collecting
the prizes in some candy.
translations.へえ、ああいうの楽しいよな。:
Oh, nice. Collecting those
is always fun.
translations.そうだ。途中で百円均一の店見つけたら教えて。:
Oh, right. Let me know if
you spot a 100-yen shop on
the way.
translations.この前、３００円で買ったものが百円均一にも売ってるって聞いて、ショックだったんだ:
I heard something I paid
300 yen for is sold at the
100-yen shop. I refuse to
believe it till I see it.
translations.まあ、その気持ちわかんないでもないけど。:
Well, I can't say I don't
get how you feel.
translations.……リンコ今日、掃除当番じゃなかったっけ？:
...Wait, wasn't I on
cleaning duty today？
translations.んー、違う来週だったはず。うん、だよね？:
Hmm, no, it should be next
week. Yeah, right？
translations.だから、●に聞かれても困るって。:
Like I said, asking ●
isn't gonna help.
translations.ほんと。センパイもどうも。邪魔しちゃ悪いから行くね～。: Yeah, really. Hi to you too, Senpai. I don't want to get in your way, so I'll get going.
translations.（なんだろう……カノジョの友達って少し緊張する）: (Why is it... running into my girlfriend's friends always makes me a little nervous.)
translations.ほら、見て。あの子が着てる服、かわいくない？: Hey, look. Isn't that girl's outfit cute？
translations.へえ。かわいいと言えばかわいいけど……。: Huh. I mean, I guess it's cute, sure...
translations.リンコが着たら似合うかな？: Do you think it'd look good on me？
translations.（でもあれ、中学生だよな……黙っておくか）: (Pretty sure she's in middle school, though... Maybe I'll keep that to myself.)
translations.なんだかカップラーメンが食べたくなってきた。: I'm kind of getting a craving for cup ramen.
translations.ダメ！ うーん、家に帰るまでガマンしよっと。それまで思い出すと辛いから、これから: Nope! Hmm, I'll just hold off until I get home. Thinking about it till then is torture, so cup ramen talk is officially banned from now on.
translations.自分でふっといてなあ……。: You're the one who brought it up...
translations.学校の近くに、新しいカフェができたんだって。: I heard a new cafe opened up near the school.
translations.へえ、行ってみる？: Oh yeah？ Wanna check it out？
translations.やだよ、だってウチの生徒たくさんいそうじゃん。よっぽど主張の激しいカップルじゃな: No way, it's probably full of kids from our school. You'd have to be a really in-your-face couple to pull that off.
translations.今日はこれでおしまいか……。明日まで、長い夜になりそう。: Guess that's it for today... Feels like it's going to be a long night until tomorrow.
translations.寂しくなったら連絡くれよ。: Call me if you get lonely.
translations.今日も１日お疲れさま。また、明日ね。: Good work today. See you tomorrow.
translations.明日は休みだね。だからって長く一緒にいられないのが残念だけど。: No school tomorrow. Too bad that doesn't mean we get to spend more time together, though.
translations.さぁて、明日は休み。夜更かししよっと。: All right, tomorrow's a day off. Think I'll stay up late.
translations.明日は休みだし、ゆっくりしよっかな。じゃあね。: Since tomorrow's a day off, I think I'll just take it easy. See ya.
translations.うん……今はまだリンコの活動時間外。:
Yeah... It's still outside
my operating hours.
translations.ちょっとね。新しいゲーム買ったんだけど、ボス倒すのに手こずってさ。気づいたら、外:
A little. I bought a new
game and had a hard time
beating the boss. Next thing
I knew, it was light out.
translations.でも、ボスが倒せないまま不機嫌なリンコを見るよりは、いいと思わない？ おかげで今:
Still, isn't this better than
seeing me grumpy over a
boss？ Thanks to that, I'm
all smiles today.
translations.ねえ。授業って全部、午後からにしたらいいと思わない？:
Hey. Don't you think all
classes should start in
the afternoon？
translations.いきなりだな。午前中は？:
That's out of nowhere.
What about the morning？
translations.休み、午前中くらいゆっくりしたいじゃん。絶対みんな賛成すると思うよ。:
Free time. You want to take
it easy in the morning,
right？ I'm sure everyone
would be on board.
translations.でもそうすると、夜まで授業になるんじゃないか？:
Wouldn't that mean having
classes until night, though？
translations.……やっぱヤメ。夜くらいゆっくりしたいじゃん。:
...Never mind, then.
I want to take it easy
at night, too.
translations.（いつもゆっくりしたいんだな）:
(Sounds like she always
wants to take it easy.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。どうしたんだよ、暗いな。:
▲小早川＊▲. What's wrong？
You look gloomy.
translations.能天気なアンタにはわかんないよ。:
Someone as carefree as you
wouldn't understand.
translations.うん、遅刻が多いって先生に怒られた。はあ……。:
Yeah. The teacher chewed me
out for being late so much.
Sigh...
translations.はあ……午前中から体育なんだよね……勘弁して欲しい。体がまだ起きてないっつーの。:
Sigh... We have P.E. in the
morning... Give me a break.
My body isn't even awake yet.
translations.そうだな、午後ならまだいいのにな。:
Yeah, it'd be better if
it were in the afternoon.
translations.午後は午後で、お昼ご飯食べたあとだと、眠くなるじゃん。:
In the afternoon, you just
get sleepy after eating
lunch, though.
translations.う～ん……リンコの気が向いたとき、かな？:
Hmm... Whenever I feel
like it, maybe？
translations.（ずっと、向かなそうだな）:
(I doubt she'll ever
feel like it.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲!? ごめん、ぶつかったか？:
▲小早川＊▲!？ Sorry, did I
bump into you？
translations.体育でスクワットやってたら……なんかムキになっちゃって。じゃあ……。:
We did squats in P.E., and...
I kind of got carried away.
See you...
translations.（ムキになってスクワットする▲小早川＊▲……）:
(▲小早川＊▲ getting carried
away doing squats...)
translations.あ、ねえねえ。さっき購買で青汁見かけたんだけどさ、どういうこと？:
Oh, hey. I saw green juice
at the school store earlier.
What's the deal with that？
translations.どういうことって……リクエストがあったんじゃないか？:
What do you mean？ Maybe
someone requested it？
translations.……あれ、高校生が飲むような味じゃないよ。:
...That stuff doesn't taste
like anything a high schooler
should be drinking.
translations.あるけど、リンコは虫じゃないっつーの。苦いだけだよ。:
Yeah, and I'm not a bug,
you know. It's just bitter.
translations.（そこまで言われたら、飲む気しないな……）:
(Putting it like that makes
me never want to try it...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲……図書室の方行くのか？）:
(▲小早川＊▲... Is she heading
to the library？)
translations.よっ、図書室行くのか？ こんな時間に？:
Hey, heading to the library？
At this hour？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。うん、忘れ物とりに。:
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah, I left
something behind.
translations.そっか、じゃあついてくか？:
I see. Want me to
come with you？
translations.トレーニング。\n悪いヤツがいたら……\nビシッてさ。:
Training.
If some bad guy shows up...
Wham.
translations.もう、危ないことはやめろよ。:
Come on, don't do anything
dangerous.
translations.……冗談だっつーの。\nなんで本気にするかな。:
...I'm kidding, obviously.
Why take it so seriously？
translations.▲小早川＊▲なら、\nやりかねないと思ってさ。:
Knowing you, ▲小早川＊▲,
I figured you just might.
translations.……ほらっ、\nすぐそういうことするから。:
...See？ Because you always
do stuff like that.
translations.アンタにしかしないって。\n愛情表現ってやつ。:
I only do it to you.
Call it showing affection.
translations.あっ、もう……探してたのに。:
Oh, come on...
I was looking for you.
translations.もういい。教材運び頼まれてたから手伝ってもらおうかと思ったけど、諦めた。:
Forget it. I got asked to
move class materials and
wanted help, but I gave up.
translations.諦めたって……いいのかそれ。:
You gave up...?
Are you sure that's okay？
translations.１年の小早川凛子さん、至急職員室に来て下さい。:
First-year Rinko Kobayakawa,
please come to the staff
room immediately.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、１人で、何してたんだ？:
▲小早川＊▲, what were
you doing by yourself？
translations.屋上から見下ろしてると、人がアリみたいで面白いよ。:
Looking down from the roof,
people look like ants.
It's pretty amusing.
translations.（普段見下ろされてるからな……）:
(Guess she's usually the one
being looked down on...)
translations.なんか言いたそうだけど……。なに？:
You look like you want to
say something... What？
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ ●はブラブラしてたらなんとなく。そっちはなんで？:
▲小早川＊▲？ ● was just
wandering around and ended
up here. What about you？
translations.……バスケの練習、しとこうと思って。体育の時間に恥かくのヤだし……ああもう、見ら:
...I wanted to practice
basketball so I don't look
bad in P.E. ...Ugh, I didn't
think anyone would see me.
translations.（意外に努力家なところもあるのか？）:
(Guess she's more of a hard
worker than I thought？)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。いいとこで会った。あのさ、不意打ちって卑怯だと思わない？:
▲主人公＊▲. Good timing.
Hey, don't you think sneak
attacks are playing dirty？
translations.不意打ち？ 格ゲーの話か？:
Sneak attacks？ Are we
talking fighting games？
translations.違うってば。数学の授業でさ、抜き打ちの小テストがあって……。:
No, come on. We had a
pop quiz in math class...
translations.ああ、それで散々な結果だったわけか。: Ah, so you bombed it, huh？
translations.決めつけるなっつーの、合ってるけど。リンコだって、事前にわかってれば予習するのに:
Don't just assume that—even
if you're right. Even I'd
study if I knew in advance.
translations.間違ってないけど、アンタが思ってるようなことじゃないよ。:
You're not wrong, but it's
not what you're thinking.
translations.今日は褒められにきたの。図書館だよりにリンコが書いた書評がさ、評判良いんだって、:
I came to get praised today.
My library newsletter book
review was a hit, so they
asked me to do a column.
translations.まあ、面倒だから連載はしないけどね。悪い気分じゃないよ。:
Well, it's a hassle, so I'm
not gonna do it. Doesn't
feel bad, though.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲が連載するなら、毎回読んでもいいかも）:
(If ▲小早川＊▲ wrote a column,
I might read it every time.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲……思い出し笑いは不気味だぞ……。:
▲小早川＊▲... Laughing to
yourself is kinda creepy...
translations.あっ、勝手に聞くなっつーの。これから化学の実験なんだよね。:
Ack, don't just listen in
on me. We have a chemistry
lab next, that's all.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って理系は苦手じゃなかったか？:
Aren't you bad at science,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.実験は別。楽だし、結構面白いじゃん。:
Labs are different. They're
easy, and actually pretty fun.
translations.（それが成績には反映されないんだな）:
(Too bad that doesn't show
up in her grades.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。なんか機嫌悪そうだな？:
▲小早川＊▲. In a bad mood
or something？
translations.今日さ、寝坊して朝ご飯食べてないんだよね。……お昼まだかな。:
I overslept today and missed
breakfast. ...Is it lunch
yet？
translations.早弁したら……？:
Why not eat your lunch
early...？
translations.そんな体育会系男子みたいなこと、できないね。:
I'm not doing something a
guy on a sports team would
do.
translations.その例えはよくわかんないけど、腹減ってるんだろ？:
I don't really get that
comparison, but you're
hungry, right？
translations.いいの、美学に反するから。:
It's fine. It goes against
my principles.
translations.よお、▲小早川＊▲。相変わらず眠そうだな。:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Looking
sleepy as usual.
translations.何が相変わらずだっつーの。今はしょうがないよ、催眠術うけてきたから。:
What do you mean, 'as usual'？
I can't help it right now.
I just got hypnotized.
translations.数学の授業。先生の喋り方が強烈でさ、リンコのクラスでは“催眠術師”って呼んでる。:
Math class. The teacher's
voice is lethal. Everyone in
my class calls him 'The
Hypnotist.'
translations.特に午後の授業は、危険だよ。不可抗力だね、これは。:
Afternoon classes are
especially dangerous. There's
just no fighting it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ どうした。病気？ ケガ？:
▲小早川＊▲？ What's wrong？
Are you sick？ Hurt？
translations.そんなあわてなくていいよ。ただのお昼寝。:
You don't need to freak out.
I was just taking a nap.
translations.そ。あんたに会えて、目覚めもばっちりだよ、じゃ！:
Yep. And seeing you woke me
right up. Later!
translations.（じゃ！ じゃないだろ。……驚いた）:
(Don't just 'Later!' me.
...She gave me a scare.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。もしかしてここって、お気に入りスポット？:
▲小早川＊▲. Is this your
favorite spot or something？
translations.うん、教室にいると息苦しいし。:
Yeah, it's suffocating being
in the classroom.
translations.ないよ。安心しなって。ジュース飲む？:
Nope. Don't worry about it.
Want some juice？
translations.いらないならいいけど。:
If you don't want any,
that's fine.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。なんだ、ぼーっとして。:
▲小早川＊▲. What's up？
You're spacing out.
translations.だってさ。午後になると、早く放課後になんないかなって気になるじゃん。:
Well, once the afternoon
hits, you start wishing
school was over already.
translations.でもそんな浮ついてると、授業中に怒られるぞ。:
Keep spacing out like that
and you'll get in trouble in
class.
translations.わかってるって。まったく、説教好きなんだから。:
I know, I know. Jeez, you
really love lecturing me.
translations.授業はちゃんと受けるって。それより、今日は授業終わったらどうしよっかな。:
I'll pay attention in class.
Anyway, what should I do
after school today...
translations.▲小早川＊▲。何してんだ、こんなとこで。:
▲小早川＊▲. What are you
doing in a place like this？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。通りかかっただけだけど、ほら、理科室の人体模型ってちょっとよくない:
▲主人公＊▲. I was just
passing by, but look. Isn't
the anatomy model kinda cool？
translations.まったくわからない！: I don't get that at all!
translations.えー、わかってないなー。: Aw, you just don't get it.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。うん、今リンコのクラス、教室使えないからさ。:
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah, I can't
use my classroom right now.
translations.なんか男子がまたくだらない遊びを発明したみたいでさ。物が飛び交ってて読書どころじ:
The boys came up with some
dumb new game again. Stuff's
flying everywhere, so I
can't read in there.
translations.若者は元気だなあ。:
Young people sure have a
lot of energy.
translations.そうだね、おじいさん。でもほんと、小学生かっつーの。:
Whatever you say, Grandpa.
Seriously though, what are
they, in grade school？
translations.ねえねえ。購買部にさ、新しい飲み物が増えたんだよ。:
Hey, listen. The school store
just got some new drinks in.
translations.増えたって言っても、どうせまたお茶とかだろ？:
New drinks？ It's probably
just another kind of tea or
something, right？
translations.なんかキワモノもあるらしいよ、気になるでしょ？:
I heard they've got some
weird ones, too. Makes you
curious, right？
translations.リンコは気になるの。だからさ、人柱になってよ。ね？:
Well, I am. So be my guinea
pig, okay？
translations.あのさ、部活って楽しい？ アンタがやってるの見てたら、なんか興味がわいてきた。:
Hey, are clubs fun？ Watching
you do yours kinda got me
curious.
translations.へえ。じゃあ、どこかに体験入部してみたらどうだ？:
Oh yeah？ Why not try one out
for a day, then？
translations.そうだな……ゲーム部とかない？\n部費でゲーセン通うの。:
Let's see... Is there a gaming
club or something？ Where we
use club funds for the arcade.
translations.じゃあ、作るしかないか。めんどくさいな……。:
Guess I'd have to start one
myself, then. What a pain...
translations.絶対実現しないから安心しろって。:
Don't worry, it'd never get
approved anyway.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ なんだ、暗いな。:
▲小早川＊▲？ What's with the
long face？
translations.アンタって変なあだ名ないの？:
Do you have any weird
nicknames？
translations.（変なあだ名でもつけられたのか？）:
(Did someone give her a weird
nickname or something？)
translations.なんでだよ。姿を見かけたから……。:
Of course not. I just happened
to spot you, so...
translations.それで女子更衣室まで一緒に行こうって？:
And you thought you'd come
all the way to the girls'
locker room with me？
translations.▲小早川＊▲。なんだ、入部希望か？:
▲小早川＊▲. What's up, looking
to join the club？
translations.ここ通りかかったら、テニス部の顧問にコートの掃除しとけって言われた。どういうこと:
I was just walking by when the
tennis club advisor told me to
clean the courts. What gives？
translations.ああ……鈴木先生の勘違いじゃないか？:
Ah... Mr. Suzuki must've
mistaken you for a member.
translations.はあ、なにそれ。じゃあ部員のアンタが代わりにやっといてよ。:
Ugh, seriously？ Then you're a
member—you do it instead.
translations.じゃあ、そういうことで。: Alright, I'll leave you to it.
translations.アンタって、クラスで何か係ってやってる？: Do you have any class duties？
translations.クラスの係はないな。図書委員やってるわけだし。:
No class duties for me. I'm
already on the library
committee, after all.
translations.だよねー、そう言ってるんだけどさ。:
Right？ That's what I keep
telling them, too.
translations.担任にやってくれって言われた。なんで多忙なリンコに頼むんだっつーの。:
My homeroom teacher told me to
take one on. Why ask someone
as busy as me？
translations.（暇そうにしてたんじゃないかな……）: (Probably because you looked like you had free time...)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ネコがこっち来たみたいだから追っかけてきたんだけどさ、見失っちゃっ: ▲主人公＊▲. I saw a cat go this way and followed it, but I lost sight of it.
translations.へえ、じゃあ呼んでみたら？ にゃーん、ってさ。: Oh yeah？ Why don't you try calling it？ Like, 'Meow.'
translations.うん、そうだね。にゃ……言わないっつーの。: Right, good idea. Meo... As if I'd say that.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。なんか騒がしいけど、何があったか知ってる？: ▲小早川＊▲. It's pretty noisy out there. Do you know what happened？
translations.さっき犬が入り込んで、購買のカツサンドを奪ったらしいよ。: Apparently a dog wandered in earlier and stole a cutlet sandwich from the school store.
translations.え、犬が校舎の中まで？ 大丈夫かそれ……。: Wait, a dog got all the way inside？ Is that okay...？
translations.大丈夫だよ。その犬見たけどさ、ミニチュアダックスだったもん。学校に来たお客さんの: It's fine. I saw it, and it was just a miniature dachshund. Apparently it belongs to a visitor.
translations.へへ、可愛かったよ。犬も結構いいもんだね。: Hehe, it was cute. Dogs are pretty nice, too.
translations.ごめん……雑巾もってくる。: Sorry... I'll go get a cloth.
translations.ああ……大丈夫、小説読んでてちょっと。『夜に惑いて』ってシリーズ。: Oh... I'm fine. It's just from a novel I'm reading. A series called 'Lost in the Night.'
translations.教室で読んで、泣いちゃったら恥ずかしいじゃん。: It'd be embarrassing if I read it in the classroom and started crying.
translations.……冷たいな、なんか怒ってる？: ...That's cold. Are you mad about something？
translations.リンコに残された時間はあとわずかなの、用がないなら、また後で。: I don't have much time left. If it's nothing important, talk to me later.
translations.え、なんかあったのか？ ●にできることがあれば――: Wait, did something happen？ If there's anything ● can do--
translations.もう、うるさいな。宿題忘れて、急いでやんなきゃいけないの。: Geez, stop making a fuss. I forgot my homework and have to get it done fast.
translations.なんだ……がんばれ。: Oh, is that all... Good luck.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ 何ブツブツ、言ってるんだ。: ▲小早川＊▲？ What are you muttering about？
translations.わっ……なんだ。あのさ、今日のリンコの顔さ、変じゃない？: Wah... Oh, it's you. Hey, doesn't my face look weird today？
translations.いつもと一緒だろ。カワイイじゃん。: It looks the same as usual. Cute as always.
translations.は!? ちょっとこんなとこで！ ……やっぱ男にきいてもわかんないか。: What！？ Don't say that here！ ...I guess a guy wouldn't notice anyway.
translations.（なんか本人にしかわからない違いがあるのか？）: (Is there some difference only she can tell？)
translations.え、ああ……あのさ、水飲み場の蛇口からオレンジジュースが出る学校があるんだって。: Huh？ Oh... I heard there's a school where orange juice comes out of the faucets.
translations.でも、手洗いはどうするのかなって……。ベトベトだよね。: But I was wondering how they wash their hands... They'd get all sticky.
translations.……それは水が出る蛇口で洗うんだろ？: ...Wouldn't they just use a faucet that has water？
translations.そっか、水も出るのか……だよね。あー、スッキリした。: Oh right, they'd have water too... Of course. Ah, glad we cleared that up.
translations.（まさかそれで悩んでたのか……）: (Don't tell me that's what was bothering her...)
translations.昼でも、夜でも、起きたときの挨拶はおはようなの。なんか、問題ある？: Day or night, if I just woke up, it's 'good morning.' Got a problem with that？
translations.（朝でも、昼でも寝起きは機嫌が悪いんだな……）: (Guess she wakes up grumpy whether it's morning or afternoon...)
translations.あ、聞きたい？ あのね、御堂ふみ子先生の新刊が出るんだよ。: Oh, you want to hear？ A new book by Fumiko Mido is coming out.
translations.御堂ふみ子先生だよ、少女漫画界の巨星！ 先生の作品を知らないなんて、人生８割方損: Fumiko Mido! A giant of the shojo manga world! If you don't know her work, you're missing out on 80% of life.
translations.（２割しか楽しめてないのか●は……）: (Does that mean ● only enjoys the other 20% of life...)
translations.……落ち込んだ。もう、立ち直れないかも知れないよ、リンコは。: ...I'm crushed. I don't think I'll ever recover from this.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ 何があったんだよ。また先生に怒られたか？: ▲小早川＊▲？ What happened？ Did you get in trouble with a teacher again？
translations.ネコのシッポの形のシャーペンが、行方不明……ああ、もう最悪。: My cat-tail mechanical pencil is missing... Ugh, this is the worst.
translations.そんな特徴があるペンだったら大丈夫だって、見つかるよ。: If it stands out that much, I'm sure it'll turn up.
translations.そうかな……だといいけど。: You think so...？ I hope you're right.
translations.お、▲小早川＊▲。中庭って気持ちいいよな。: Oh, hey, ▲小早川＊▲. The courtyard really feels nice, doesn't it？
translations.うん、ここでボンヤリするのっていいよね。: Yeah. It's nice just spacing out here.
translations.この時間がずっと続けばいいのにって思うよな。: Makes you wish this could last forever.
translations.はあ、これだ。教室戻んなきゃ。: Sigh, there goes the bell. Gotta get back to class.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ もう授業始まるぞ。: ▲小早川＊▲？ Class is about to start.
translations.リンコのクラスは自習。アンタのクラスが体育やってるのが見えたからさ、ちょっと抜け: My class has study hall. I saw your class out here for P.E., so I snuck out for a bit.
translations.……バレたら怒られるぞ。: ...You're gonna get in trouble if you're caught.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ちょっといい？ 音楽の授業ってつまんないよね。: ▲主人公＊▲, got a second？ Music class is so boring, isn't it？
translations.▲小早川＊▲。まあ授業になると、一気にやらされてる感じになるからな。: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Well, once it's for a class, it suddenly feels like a chore.
translations.そう、特に合唱。好きでもない歌を唄いたくないよね。: Exactly, especially chorus. I don't want to sing songs I don't even like.
translations.で、何が言いたいんだ？: So, what are you getting at？
translations.▲小早川＊▲。こんなとこにいたのか？: ▲小早川＊▲. So this is where you were？
translations.……うん。ここにいると、いろいろ思い出す。: ...Yeah. Being here makes me remember all kinds of things.
translations.あ……違う！ あのことじゃなくって！ 別に違いはしないんだけど……。: Ah... No! Not THAT! Well, I mean, not NOT that, either...
translations.ちょっとも沢山もないっつーの。周りから見たらイチャイチャしてるみたいじゃん。: No 'just a peek,' no nothing. People around us are gonna think we're flirting.
translations.あれ、アンタも本借りに来た？: Oh, did you come to check out a book too？
translations.んー、なんとなく来ただけだけど。せっかくだから、▲小早川＊▲にオススメしてもらう: Hmm, I just kinda wandered in. Since I'm here, maybe you can recommend something, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そうなの？ じゃあオススメできるものはありませんね。: Oh really？ Then I don't have anything to recommend to you.
translations.誤解を招く言い方はやめてくれ……。: Stop saying stuff that gives people the wrong idea...
translations.ねえ、なんで人間には肉球がないのかな。あれば、暇つぶしでプニプニできるし、かわい: Hey, how come humans don't have paw pads？ We could squish 'em to kill time, plus they'd be cute, right？
translations.うーん……たしかにアンタに肉球がついてても可愛くないね、むしろ怖いね。じゃあいい: Hmm... Yeah, paw pads on you wouldn't be cute at all. Actually, that's kinda creepy. Never mind then.
translations.だろ？ ▲小早川＊▲だったらアリかもな？: Right？ Though on you, ▲小早川＊▲, they might actually work？
translations.へえ…………そういうフェチ？: Huh... So you're into that kinda thing？
translations.わっ!? なんでカウンターの下にいるんだよ。: Whoa!? What are you doing under the counter？
translations.アンタが来るの見えたから、驚かせてやろうと思って。どうだった？: I saw you coming and figured I'd scare you. How was it？
translations.どうだったかって言われれば……子供っぽいかな。: How was it？ Well... kinda childish, I guess.
translations.ずっと貸し出し対応してて、疲れた。だから教室までおんぶ。: I've been checking out books nonstop and I'm beat. So carry me back to class.
translations.……しょうがないな。▲小早川＊▲がそういうなら。: ...Guess I have no choice, if you say so, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……さすがに冗談だけど……へへ、そっか、頼めばやってくれるんだ。: ...Okay, I was obviously kidding, but... hehe. Good to know you'd actually do it if I asked.
translations.ねえ、今度、理科のコーナー強化するってきいた？: Hey, did you hear we're expanding the science section soon？
translations.ああ……そんなこと言ってたっけ。: Yeah... I think they mentioned something about that.
translations.リストアップ頼まれたんだけど……よくわかんなくてさ。: They asked me to put a list together, but... I don't really know much about it.
translations.わかった、●も手伝うよ。: Got it. I'll help you out, ●.
translations.やったっ！ やっぱ頼るべきものはカレシだね。: Yes! Nothing like having a boyfriend you can count on.
translations.（こんなに喜ばれたら、手伝わないわけにいかないよな）: (When she's this happy about it, there's no way I couldn't help.)
translations.あのさ、図書室に住みたいと思ったことない？: Say, have you ever wanted to live in the library？
translations.住みたいかって言われると……どうかな。: Live here？ Hmm... I don't know about that.
translations.リンコは永住希望。だって読み放題だよ？: I'd move in permanently. It's all-you-can-read, you know？
translations.そのかわり、毎日、図書当番だけどな。: Yeah, except you'd be on library duty every single day.
translations.……永住はやめるか、ホームステイくらいで。: ...Maybe I'll pass on moving in forever. A short stay works.
translations.（何日かは泊まり込みたいんだな）: (So she still wants to stay over for a few days.)
translations.あれ？ ▲小早川＊▲が当番だと思ったのに……またサボりか。: Huh？ I thought ▲小早川＊▲ was on duty today... Skipping again？
translations.何してるって、アンタさ……図書室では本を読んでるに決まってるでしょ。: What do you think？ Come on... It's the library. I'm reading a book, obviously.
translations.（カウンターの下で丸まって読書か……小動物みたいだな……）: (Curled up under the counter reading a book... She's like a little animal...)
translations.あのさ、なんで委員長って規則にうるさいの？: Hey, why is the committee head so uptight about the rules？
translations.そりゃ責任があるしな。: Well, it comes with the responsibility.
translations.はあ。だいたいさ、みつあみメガネで、規則規則って……なんなの。: Ugh. Seriously, with the braids and glasses, always going on about 'the rules, the rules'... What's with that？
translations.みつあみメガネ？ ウチの委員長はみつあみでもメガネでもないよな。: Braids and glasses？ Our committee head doesn't wear braids or glasses.
translations.そう？ リンコにはそうやって見えるんだけどね、なんとなく。: Really？ That's how they look to me, anyway. Somehow.
translations.（どんなイメージなんだ）: (What kind of mental image is that？)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。図書当番じゃなかったっけ？: ▲小早川＊▲. Weren't you on library duty？
translations.だって、利用者、誰もいなかったし。: Well, nobody was using the library.
translations.誰もいないからって、サボっていいわけないだろ。: Just because nobody's there doesn't mean you can skip out.
translations.大丈夫だよ。誰か来たら戻るから。: It's fine. I'll go back if someone shows up.
translations.……誰か来たことが、どうしてわかるんだよ。: ...And how are you supposed to know if someone shows up？
translations.はぁ……今週中に図書室だよりに載せるオススメ選ばなきゃ。: Sigh... I have to pick my book recommendations for the library newsletter by the end of the week.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、得意だろ？: Isn't that right up your alley, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ネタが尽きたよ。リンコの好きな本が万人向けじゃないことくらい分かってるから。: I'm out of ideas. Even I know the books I like aren't for everyone.
translations.たまにはそういうのがあっても面白いだろ。▲小早川＊▲はマイナー担当ってことでさ。: It's fun to have picks like that once in a while. You can be in charge of the niche stuff, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ふーん……まあそれでいっか。: Hmm... Well, I guess that works.
translations.大変だよ。図書委員の中で派閥争いが始まりそう。: It's bad. A war between factions is about to break out on the library committee.
translations.そんな話初めて聞いたぞ。みんな仲良いと思ってたけど。: That's the first I've heard of it. I thought everyone got along.
translations.エンタメ派と純文学派で、血で血を洗う抗争だよ。リンコはどちらかというと、純文寄り: It's a bloody feud between the popular fiction and literary fiction factions. If I had to pick, I lean more toward literary fiction, though...
translations.なんだ、派閥ってそういうのか……。: Oh, that's what you meant by factions...
translations.当たり前じゃん。どういうのだと思ってたワケ？: Obviously. What did you think I meant？
translations.（次期委員長の座を巡って……とかじゃないんだな）: (So it's not a power struggle over who becomes the next committee head...)
translations.ついに謎が解明されたよ。図書室の謎。: The mystery has finally been solved. The mystery of the library.
translations.貸し出しカウンターの上にある花。いつも誰が生けてるのか、わからなかったでしょ？: The flowers on the checkout counter. We never knew who was arranging them all this time, right？
translations.委員長の仕業だったみたい。それも、代々の図書委員長が引き次いでいる伝統なんだって: Turns out it was the committee head's doing. Apparently it's a tradition passed down from one library committee head to the next. Like a secret art passed down to a single successor.
translations.（一子相伝……生け方も教えてくれるのか？）: (Passed down to a single successor... Does that mean they teach you how to arrange flowers, too？)
translations.ねえ、なんかパソコンの調子悪いみたい。: Hey, it looks like the computer's acting up.
translations.ああ、ここんとこそうだったもんな。新しくしてもらいたいよな。: Yeah, it's been like that lately. I wish they'd get us a new one.
translations.大変らしいよ、そういうの。うーん、とりあえず職員室から拝借できないかな。: Apparently that's a whole ordeal. Hmm, I wonder if we can just borrow one from the staff room for now.
translations.拝借って……ああ、頼んで貸してもらうってことか。: 'Borrow'...? Oh, you mean ask them to lend us one.
translations.え？ あ、ああ、そう。正式に、依頼してね。ほら、非常事態だし。: Huh？ O-Oh, right. By putting in an official request, of course. Since it's an emergency and all.
translations.（勝手に拝借……って思ってなかったか？）: (Wait... was she planning on just taking one without asking？)
translations.あっ、いいトコに来た。次の図書室だよりの特集記事頼まれたんだけど、何かネタない？: Oh, good timing. They asked me to write a feature for the next library newsletter. Got any ideas？
translations.なんかって言われてもな……、この前はライトノベル特集で、その前は……。: Ideas, huh... Well, last time was a feature on light novels, and before that was...
translations.あれネコに偏重しすぎて、注意されてたよな。: Didn't you get in trouble for making that one way too focused on cats？
translations.リンコに任せた時点で、そうなるに決まってるよ。でも読者の評判は良かったんだよ？: That was bound to happen the second they put me in charge of it. The readers loved it, though.
translations.このまえ古い本を業者に引き取ってもらったとき、ちょっと切なくなったよ。: When we had the vendor come take away those old books the other day, I felt a little sad.
translations.そうだな……委員で本の修繕とかもしたからな。: Yeah... Especially since we helped mend them on the committee and all.
translations.……新しい持ち主が見つかるといいけどね。: ...I hope they find new owners, though.
translations.なんで返却期限守らない人間がいるんだろ。: Why is it that some people just can't return books on time？
translations.……つい忘れちゃうんだろうな。みんな、悪気はないと思うけど。: ...They probably just forget. I don't think anyone means any harm by it, though.
translations.悪気はないで済んだら、警察はいらないよ。: If "not meaning any harm" let you off the hook, we wouldn't need the police.
translations.新刊なのに一週間も延滞してるんだよ、リンコがどれだけ楽しみにしてるか。あーもう…: It's a new release and it's already a whole week overdue! Do they have any idea how much I've been looking forward to reading it？ Ugh...
translations.（頼む、早く返してあげてくれ……）: (Whoever has it, please bring it back soon...)
translations.さっき先生に、書庫にある本の虫干し頼まれちゃったんだよね。: The teacher just asked me to air out the books in the archives.
translations.もしかして、あのゴツい百科事典みたいな本も？: Wait, does that include those massive encyclopedia-looking ones？
translations.そう、男としての力の見せ所、カノジョも惚れ直すかもよ。: Yep. It's your chance to show off your manly strength. Your girlfriend might fall for you all over again.
translations.キャー、カッコイイー。もっとスキになっちゃいそー。: Ooh, so cool. I think I'm falling for you even more.
translations.はあ……しょうがないな。: Sigh... Guess I don't have a choice.
translations.え？ 何か約束してた？: Huh？ Did we have plans or something？
translations.放課後に新刊の整理手伝って欲しいって言ったのに……。: I told you I wanted help sorting the new arrivals after school...
translations.え……聞いてないけど？: Wait... You never told me that, though？
translations.え？ ……あ、昼休みに伝えようとして忘れたんだった。へへ、ごめんね。: Huh？ ...Oh, right, I meant to tell you at lunch and forgot. Hehe, sorry.
translations.一目瞭然だっつーの。どうしてくれんの、これ。: Yeah, no kidding. Anyone can see that. What are you gonna do about this？
translations.どうしろって……なんだよ、不機嫌だな。: What do you want me to do about it...? Man, someone's grumpy.
translations.雨のせい。リンコは水気に弱いんだよ。: It's the rain's fault. I don't do well with moisture.
translations.おはよう……。朝の第一声がそれか。: Morning... That's the first thing you say today？
translations.だって雨だよ、濡れるじゃん。: Well, it's raining! I'm gonna get wet.
translations.傘があるだろ。: You have an umbrella, don't you？
translations.傘さしてても濡れるときは濡れるの！: Even with an umbrella, you still get wet when it rains!
translations.今日、一日中雨なのかな？: Wonder if it's gonna rain all day today？
translations.はぁ。苦手なんだよね、雨って。一人だったら学校行かないね。:
Ugh. I really don't do well
with rain. If I were alone,
I'd just skip school.
translations.雨くらいで休もうとするなよ……。:
Don't skip school over a
little rain...
translations.いい天気じゃん。このままだといいんだけど。:
Nice weather, huh.
Hope it stays like this.
translations.どうだろうな、大丈夫じゃないか？:
I'm sure it'll hold up just
fine, don't you think？
translations.このまま崩れないといいな。: Hope it holds up like this.
translations.雲多くない？ イヤーな予感……。:
Awful lot of clouds, huh？
I've got a bad feeling...
translations.途中で降られるのは勘弁だな。:
I could really do without
getting caught in the rain.
translations.曇りかぁ。まあいいけどさ。:
Cloudy, huh.
Well, I don't mind.
translations.かえって過ごしやすいかもしれないしな。:
Might actually be more
comfortable this way.
translations.降ってるけど、どうするつもり？:
It's raining.
What're you gonna do？
translations.●に言われてもな……行くぞ。:
Don't ask ●...
Come on, let's go.
translations.雨か……まあしょうがないね。:
Rain, huh...
Well, can't be helped.
translations.しょうがないな、ほら行こう。:
Nothing we can do about it.
Come on, let's go.
translations.あのさ……リンコ、楽しみにしてるから。:
Hey... I'm really looking
forward to it, okay.
translations.……デートのことだって！ わざと言わせてない？:
...Our date, obviously!
Are you making me say it
on purpose？
translations.そんなんじゃないって。そうだな、●も楽しみにしてる。:
It's not like that.
Yeah, ● can't wait either.
translations.言ってないっつーの。まあ期待度は普通。:
I didn't say that!
My expectations are just
average.
translations.（遅いな、▲小早川＊▲……。まあ待ってみるか）:
(▲小早川＊▲'s running late...
Guess I'll wait a bit.)
translations.先行ってると思ってた……。アンタも遅刻しちゃうじゃん。:
I thought you would've gone
on ahead... You're gonna be
late too, you know.
translations.置いてくわけないだろ。ほら、少し急げば間に合うって。:
I'm not gonna leave you
behind. Come on, we'll make
it if we hurry a bit.
translations.格好つけちゃってさ。……一応、ありがとって言っとく。:
Trying to act all cool.
...Well, thanks, I guess.
translations.リンコが待ってるってわかってて、なんで遅刻するわけ？:
You knew I was waiting for
you, so how could you be
late？
translations.ごめん……目覚まし時計が鳴らなくて……。:
Sorry... My alarm didn't
go off...
translations.（……まあ悪いのは●だしな）:
(...Well, it really is on
●, after all.)
translations.あれ？ 今日って英和辞典いるんだっけ？:
Huh？ Do we need our English
dictionaries today？
translations.●に聞くなよ……。忘れたんなら貸すけど。:
Don't ask ●...
If you forgot yours, I can
lend you mine.
translations.（素直に貸してくれって言えばいいのに……）:
(Why can't she just ask me
to lend it to her...？)
translations.あ！ 今、猫通った！: Oh! A cat just went by!
translations.こらこら、追いかけるな！ 遅刻するだろ！:
Hey, don't chase after it!
We're gonna be late!
translations.どうした？ 忘れ物か？:
What's wrong？
Did you forget something？
translations.新しく買った曲、プレイヤーに入れるの忘れた。戻って入れてこようかな……。:
I forgot to put my new song
on my player. Maybe I should
go back and put it on...
translations.遅刻するぞ。１日くらいガマンしろって。:
You'll be late.
Just tough it out for a day.
translations.お弁当あるんだけどさ……食べる？:
So, I brought lunch today...
Want some？
translations.もちろん、食べる！ えーっと、場所は……。:
Of course I do!
Now, where should we eat...
translations.今日はお弁当用意してる。アンタの分もあるけど？:
I made lunch today.
I got some for you too,
if you want？
translations.ほんとか？ じゃあどこで食おうか？:
Really？
Where should we eat, then？
translations.アンタの分のお弁当、作ってきたんだよ。: I made lunch for you today.
translations.おお、サンキュ。どこで食べるかな？:
Oh, thanks!
Where should we eat？
translations.▲飲食店＊＊＊＊＊▲で食べるか？: Wanna go to ▲飲食店＊＊＊＊＊▲ to eat？
translations.そうか。じゃあ学食行ってみるか？:
I see. Wanna check out
the cafeteria, then？
translations.そういや二人で行ったことなかったっけ。じゃあ、そうしよ。:
Come to think of it, we've
never gone together, huh？
Alright, let's do that.
translations.今日はお弁当ないんだけど、どうする？:
I don't have a lunch today.
What should we do？
translations.んー……じゃあ、学食はどうだ？ 一緒に行ったことなかったよな。:
Hmm... How about the
cafeteria？ We haven't been
there together yet, right？
translations.いいかも。そうしよっか。:
That sounds nice.
Let's do that.
translations.今日のお昼、お弁当ないんだよね……。:
I didn't bring a lunch
with me today...
translations.じゃあ学食行かないか？ まだ一緒に行ってないだろ。:
Wanna go to the cafeteria？
We haven't gone together yet.
translations.今日は学食って気分なんだけど。:
I'm in the mood for
the cafeteria today.
translations.今日は学食行くよ。:
We're going to the
cafeteria today.
translations.学食か。それもいいかもな。:
The cafeteria, huh？
That sounds pretty good.
translations.あのさ、今日は学食行きたい。いい？:
Hey, I wanna eat at the
cafeteria today. Okay？
translations.●は結構うまかったと思うけどな。:
I thought ● was
pretty good, though.
translations.ふーん。じゃあもうリンコのお弁当、いらないか。:
Hmph. Guess you don't need
my lunches anymore, then.
translations.あ、そう。しょうがないな。:
Oh, really.
Guess I have no choice.
translations.ごちそうさま。うまかった！:
Thanks for the food.
That was really good!
translations.▲小早川＊▲の弁当よりはうまくなかった！:
Not as good as your
lunches, ▲小早川＊▲!
translations.はいはい、調子いーね。また作ってあげるから。:
Yeah, yeah, nice save.
I'll make you lunch again.
translations.ふぅ、食べ過ぎたかも。:
Phew, I might've eaten
a bit too much.
translations.腹八分にしとけよ。眠くなるぞ。:
You shouldn't overdo it.
You're gonna get sleepy.
translations.眠くなってきた……ここで寝ていい？:
I'm getting sleepy now...
Can I take a nap here？
translations.言ったそばから。寝たらダメだって！:
Right after I warned you.
You can't sleep here!
translations.▲主人公＊▲。傘持ってる？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Do you have an umbrella？
translations.ああ、バッチリだ。▲小早川＊▲は持ってないのか？:
Yeah, I'm all set.
Don't you have one, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.……持ってないこともないけど。:
...It's not like I don't
have one, but...
translations.やっぱ持ってない。入れてってよ。:
Actually, I don't have one.
Let me share yours.
translations.それならよかった。一人だけずぶ濡れで帰らせるのも気分よくないしね。:
Good. I'd feel bad letting
you walk home soaked alone.
translations.一緒に入れてくれないのかよ……。:
Wait, you wouldn't have
shared yours with me...？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。傘なしで帰る気？ ありえなくない。:
▲主人公＊▲. Going home without
an umbrella？ Unbelievable.
translations.▲小早川＊▲か。走ればなんとかなるって。:
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲.
I'll be fine if I just run.
translations.格好つけないで、リンコの傘に入んなよ。:
Stop trying to act tough
and get under my umbrella.
translations.しょうがないじゃん。アンタに風邪引かれたらリンコがつまんない思いするんだから。:
I don't have a choice.
If you catch a cold, I'm the
one who'll be bored.
translations.ねえ、お腹すいてる？ すいてるよね。:
Hey, are you hungry？
You're hungry, right？
translations.ん？ ▲小早川＊▲。なんだ、いきなり。:
Hm？ ▲小早川＊▲.
What's this all of a sudden？
translations.調理実習あったからさ、お菓子作ったんだけど。食べるでしょ？:
We had cooking class today,
so I made some sweets.
You'll eat some, right？
translations.（おいしいな……よくできてるぞ、これは）:
(It's delicious...
This is really well made.)
translations.感想は？ 聞かなくてもわかるけど。:
Well, what do you think？
Not that I need to ask.
translations.（自信満々だな。たしかにこれはウマイ！）:
(She's full of confidence.
And it really is delicious!)
translations.（うん、いける。おいしいな）:
(Yeah, not bad at all.
It's delicious.)
translations.失敗はしてないはず。:
I don't think I made
any mistakes.
translations.もっとおいしく作れたら良かったんだけどさ……。:
I wish it had turned out
a little better, though...
translations.先に言っとくけど、無理しなくていいから。:
Just so you know, you don't
have to force yourself.
translations.悪気は、ないから。:
I didn't mean any harm,
okay？
translations.（う……悪気があってこの味だと問題だろ……）:
（Ugh... If she DID mean harm
with this taste, we'd have
a real problem...）
translations.ごめん。実はあんまり自信ないんだけど……。:
Sorry. Honestly, I'm not
too confident about this
one...
translations.ヨダレついてる。ボサッとしてないで、さっさと起きる。:
You're drooling. Quit spacing
out and get up already.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。起こしに来てくれたのか。でもまだ眠気が……。:
▲小早川＊▲. You came to
wake me up？ I'm still so
sleepy, though...
translations.これ以上待たせるつもり？ リンコ、けっこうがんばって早起きして来てるんだけど。:
Are you gonna make me wait
even longer？ I worked pretty
hard to get up early and
come over, you know.
translations.そうだな……ありがと。起きるよ……。:
You're right... Thanks.
I'm getting up...
translations.あ、▲小早川＊▲？ 来てくれたのか……おはよ……。:
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲？ You came
over...？ Morning...
translations.なんだ、寝ぼけてたのか……。いいから、早く起きないと蹴るよ！:
What, you were just half-
asleep...？ Whatever, get up
now or I'm kicking you!
translations.なんで朝から不機嫌なんだ？:
Why are you so grumpy first
thing in the morning？
translations.あ、起きちゃった。布団に潜り込んでやろうと思ったのに。:
Oh, you're awake. And here I
was thinking of crawling
under the covers with you.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ ●を起こしに来た……んだよな？:
▲小早川＊▲？ You came here
to wake ● up... right？
translations.だって、自分だけ気持ち良さそうに寝ちゃってさ。ずるいじゃん。:
Well, you looked so comfy
sleeping all by yourself.
It's not fair.
translations.二人とも遅刻するって……危なかった。:
We'd both wind up late...
That was a close one.
translations.ギリギリセーフ。良かったね。:
Just in the nick of time.
Lucky you.
translations.（０までいったら何するつもりだったんだろ……）:
（I wonder what she was gonna
do if she hit zero...）
translations.わぁ！ ……▲小早川＊▲か。耳元で大声出すなよ。:
Whoa! ...Oh, it's you,
▲小早川＊▲. Don't yell right
in my ear like that.
translations.だって、全然起きないし。リンコ暇じゃん。:
Well, you wouldn't wake up
at all. I was getting bored.
translations.悪い。朝から起こしに来てくれてるのにな。:
Sorry. Especially when you
came all this way to wake
me up.
translations.ま、いいや。目、覚めてるよね？:
Well, whatever. You're wide
awake now, right？
translations.ああ、大丈夫。さっさと支度しないとな。:
Yeah, I'm good. Better get
ready quick.
translations.今、さ……なんか音しなかったか？: Hey, just now... Did I hear something？
translations.さあ、気のせいじゃない？ 寝ぼけてないで、早く支度しなって。: Who knows？ Maybe you imagined it. Stop being half-asleep and go get ready.
translations.ん、なんでおいしそうな匂いが……？: Mm, why does something smell so good...？
translations.いいタイミングで起きたじゃん。: Look who woke up at just the right time.
translations.▲小早川＊▲？ 起こしに来てくれたのか？: ▲小早川＊▲？ Did you come wake me up？
translations.朝ごはんも作ってあげたから。ご飯、炊きたてだし早く食べよ。: I made you breakfast, too. The rice is freshly cooked, so let's eat.
translations.おおっ！ ありがとな。●に合わせて和食にしてくれたのか？: Whoa, thanks! Did you make a Japanese breakfast because you knew ●'d like it？
translations.まーね……ほら、ニヤけてないでさっさと起きる。: Pretty much... Come on, stop grinning like that and get up already.
translations.起きろっつーの！ 朝ごはん、できてるよ？: Wake up already! Breakfast is ready, you know？
translations.おはよう……。いいなぁ、こういうの。夫婦って感じ？: Morning... Man, I love this. Feels like we're married, huh？
translations.バーカ。早くしないと、ご飯冷めるよ。: Idiot. If you don't hurry up, the food's gonna get cold.
translations.どう？ 絶妙の水加減でしょ？: Well？ I got the water ratio for the rice just right, didn't I？
translations.ああ。米ってこんなにおいしく炊けるんだな……。: Yeah. I had no idea rice could taste this good...
translations.とりあえず、形にはなったかな……。: Well, at least it came together alright, I guess...
translations.朝から米が食べられるだけで十分うれしいよ。: I'm plenty happy just getting to eat rice in the morning.
translations.ちょーっと失敗したかな……残してもいいから。: I might've messed it up a little... You don't have to finish it.
translations.せっかく作ってくれたんだし、がんばるよ……。: You went to the trouble of making it for me, so I'll do my best...
translations.食べ物の匂いで起きるとか、アンタってほんと現金。: So the smell of food is what finally wakes you up. You're so predictable.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。朝食作ってくれたのか？: ▲小早川＊▲. Did you make breakfast for me？
translations.まーね。洋食でいいんだっけ。: Pretty much. Western-style is what you like, right？
translations.●の好みに合わせてくれたのか。優しいなあ、▲小早川＊▲……。: You made it the way ●'d like it, huh. That's really sweet of you, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.へへ、気が利くカノジョで良かったね？: Hehe, aren't you glad you have such a thoughtful girlfriend？
translations.ほらほら、リンコお手製のブレックファーストだよ。: Come on, look. It's a homemade breakfast, made by yours truly.
translations.ん……おはよう、▲小早川＊▲。来てくれてありがとう。: Mm... Morning, ▲小早川＊▲. Thanks for coming over.
translations.へへ、幸せなカレシだね。朝ごはん、一緒に食べよ。: Hehe, you're one lucky boyfriend. Come on, let's eat breakfast together.
translations.（ほんと、朝から幸せだ！）: (Man, I'm so lucky waking up to this!)
translations.我ながらいい出来だったね、今回は。: That actually turned out pretty well this time, if I do say so myself.
translations.味はどう？ そんなに悪くないと思うけど。: How does it taste？ I don't think it's half bad.
translations.うん、ちゃんとできてると思うぞ。: Yeah, I think it turned out really well.
translations.最後でミスったかも……。どうよ？: I might've messed up at the very end... How is it？
translations.ところでさ、今日って晩ご飯なに食べるか決めた？ なんだったら、リンコが作ってもい: By the way, have you decided what you're having for dinner tonight？ I wouldn't mind making something for you, if you want.
translations.ねえ、今から帰んの？: Hey, are you heading home now？
translations.あ、▲小早川＊▲。ああ、一緒に帰るか？: Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. Yeah, wanna walk home together？
translations.うん。で……さ。今日の晩ご飯なに食べるか決めた？ リンコに作って欲しいんじゃない: Yeah. So... have you decided what you're having for dinner tonight？ You want me to make you something, don't you？
translations.よぉ、▲小早川＊▲。帰るか。: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Ready to head home？
translations.ねえ、今日の晩ご飯だけど……リンコが作りに行って一緒に食べるの、どうかな？: Hey, about dinner tonight... How about I come over to cook and we eat together？
translations.ごめんな。じゃあ、行くか。: Sorry about that. Well, shall we get going？
translations.へへ、そうこなくっちゃ。だったらこのままスーパー寄ってこうよ。: Hehe, that's what I like to hear. Let's stop by the supermarket on the way, then.
translations.そうだな。材料買いに行くか。: Good idea. Let's go pick up the ingredients.
translations.このスーパーね、結構めずらしい食材も置いてるんだよ。: This supermarket actually carries some pretty unusual ingredients.
translations.今日の特売ってなにかな？ やっぱ安いにこしたことはないもんね。: Wonder what's on sale today？ The cheaper the better, after all.
translations.へえ、ちゃんとしてるんだな。: Huh, you're really on top of this.
translations.こうやって二人で並んで買い物ってさ……なんか、ね？: Shopping side by side like this... kinda feels like something, doesn't it？
translations.ところでさ、なにが食べたい？: By the way, what are you in the mood for？
translations.▲メニュー▲が食べたい気分だな。: I'm in the mood for ▲メニュー▲.
translations.オッケー。それなら、なんとかなりそう。: Okay. I think I can manage that.
translations.う～ん……じゃあ、チャレンジしてみる。: Hmm... All right, I'll give it a shot.
translations.まあ、大丈夫じゃない？: I'm sure it'll turn out fine.
translations.そうと決まれば、さっさと材料揃えちゃお。: Now that that's settled, let's hurry and grab what we need.
translations.これで全部だよね？ なんか買い忘れてないかな。: That's everything, right？ Hope we didn't forget anything.
translations.忘れてたら●が買いに走るよ。さぁ、帰ろう。: If we did, ● can run out and get it. Come on, let's head back.
translations.荷物多くなったから、結構大変だったね。: We ended up with a lot of bags, so that was pretty tough.
translations.お疲れって、本番はこれからだっつーの。: "Good work"？ The real work starts now, you know.
translations.荷物重かったでしょ？ お疲れさま。: Those bags were heavy, huh？ Thanks for carrying them.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が学校帰りに作りに来てくれるのって……そういや初めてか。: Having ▲小早川＊▲ come over to cook after school... Come to think of it, this is a first, huh？
translations.だよね、感謝していいよ？ へへ。: Right？ Feel free to thank me. Hehe.
translations.ま、遠慮なく上がってよ。: Well, come on in. Make yourself at home.
translations.じゃ、遠慮なくお邪魔しまーす。: Don't mind if I do. Coming in.
translations.はは、自分の家みたいだな。: Haha, you act like you live here.
translations.よしっ、じゃあ始めますか。: All right, time to get started.
translations.さて。気合い入れて作るから、リンコの邪魔はしないように。: All right. I'm going all out with this, so stay out of my way.
translations.それじゃあ作り始めるから、ちょっと待っててね。: I'm gonna get started now, so just wait a bit.
translations.やっぱ一緒にご飯を食べるっていいよな。今日はありがとう。: Eating together really is great. Thanks for today.
translations.まあ、こっちも楽しかったし。: Well, I had a good time too.
translations.じゃあ送ってくから……行こうか。: I'll walk you home, then... Ready to go？
translations.いいって、ひとりで平気だから。……じゃあね。: Don't worry about it, I'm fine on my own. ...See ya.
translations.今日はありがとう。ご飯も美味しかったし、楽しかったよ。: Thanks for today. The food was delicious, and I had a great time.
translations.ま、このくらいならまた作ってあげてもいいけどね。: Well, if it's just something like this, I wouldn't mind making it for you again.
translations.それじゃあ今日はもう送ってくよ。: All right, I'll walk you home now.
translations.いいよ。ひとりで帰れるし……またね。バイバイ。: It's fine. I can get home on my own... See you later. Bye.
translations.ご飯ありがとな。うれしかったよ。: Thanks for the meal. It really made me happy.
translations.リンコも楽しかった。また作ってあげるね。: I had fun too. I'll cook for you again sometime.
translations.頼むよ。……じゃあ、行こうか。: I'll hold you to that. ...All right, shall we go？
translations.いいよ、リンコひとりで帰れるし。それじゃあ、またね。: That's okay, I can get home by myself. See you later.
translations.やっぱり送ってくよ。: Come on, I'll walk you home after all.
translations.あのさ、言ったことあったっけ。リンコが日記つけてるって話。: Hey, did I ever mention that I keep a diary？
translations.言うと思った。いいじゃん別に。: I knew you'd say that. There's nothing wrong with it.
translations.悪くはないよ。どんなこと書いてんの？: I didn't say there was. What kind of stuff do you write in it？
translations.（うーん、実際はどうなんだろ。▲小早川＊▲の日記って……）: (Hmm, I wonder what's actually in there. ▲小早川＊▲'s diary...)
translations.ベニヤの表裏が大事なんだっつーの。:
I'm telling you, the front and
back of the plywood matter.
translations.鳴かぬなら 小キックだ！ ホトトギス:
If the cuckoo will not sing...
hit it with a light kick!
translations.家の前の警備、ヨロシク。:
Keep guard in front of
the house for me, thanks.
translations.コンニャクイモのポテチって……どんな食感だろ。:
Konjac potato chips... I wonder
what the texture is like.
translations.あのネコ、チャウチャウちゃうんちゃう？:
Wait, isn't that cat
actually a Chow Chow？
translations.いけー、必殺！ ヴォルヴァヴィン・チョークスリーパー！:
Go, finishing move!
Wolvavin Choke Sleeper!
translations.野球のシーズン中は、本気出す気にならないっつーの。:
I just can't get serious
during baseball season.
translations.避難訓練の心得『おかし』。押さない、噛まない、小キックしない。:
Fire drill rules: Don't push,
don't bite, no light kicks.
translations.西暦１６００年、関ヶ原の戦いの裏で、ジャガイモ日本伝来！:
1600 AD: While Sekigahara raged,
potatoes arrived in Japan!
translations.野菜もちゃんと食べないとね。……ポテチとかポテトチップスとか。:
Gotta eat your veggies.
Like chips, or potato chips.
translations.ネコって意外と仲間とつるんでるよね。:
Cats actually hang out with
their friends a lot, huh.
translations.ギロッポンでスーシーいっとく？:
Wanna grab some shi-su
down in G-Roppon？
translations.魏志倭人伝っていう本はないよ。:
There's no actual book
called 'Gishi Wajinden.'
translations.アルデンテじゃないとやだ。:
I refuse to eat it
unless it's al dente.
translations.醤油は牡蠣醤油でお願い。:
Make it oyster soy sauce
for me, please.
translations.今日はピーマン食べられる気がする、気がするだけだから食べない。:
Feel like I could eat peppers
today. Still won't, though.
translations.何で猫耳とか好きなわけ？:
Why are you into cat ears
and stuff like that？
translations.見てみたいものシリーズ。ナスカの浮世絵。:
Things I Want to See:
The Nazca Ukiyo-e Prints.
translations.メガネロボ・ロウガンダーＺ お楽しみにね！:
Glasses Robo: Rougander Z!
Look forward to it!
translations.ここだけの話……いい加減にしロドリゲス！:
Just between us...
Cut it out, Rodriguez!
translations.気分は月火水日日日日。:
My week goes Mon, Tue, Wed,
Sun, Sun, Sun, Sun.
translations.まがまがしい闇鍋、美味しゅうございました。:
That sinister mystery hot pot
was most delicious.
translations.お兄ちゃん、男前やからもう一個おまけしとこ。:
You're a handsome fella, so
I'll throw in an extra one!
translations.政府の陰謀に巻き込まれて……遅刻しました。:
I got caught up in a government
conspiracy... so I'm late.
translations.へい、おやっさん、タコ食いねえ！:
Hey, boss!
Eat up some octopus!
translations.ネギが鴨しょってらぁ！:
Look, a green onion carrying
a duck on its back!
translations.巻いて巻いて、巨大アンモナイッ！:
Roll it, coil it,
Giant Ammonite!
translations.すなわちデストルドー。\nあるいはタナトス。:
In other words, Destrudo.
Or perhaps Thanatos.
translations.校庭にいるの放課後少年じゃない？:
Isn't that After-School Boy
out in the schoolyard？
translations.さとう、しお、す、せ……せ……。:
Sa for sugar, Shi for salt,
Su for vinegar, Se... Se...
translations.ブラック派？ ミルク派？:
Do you take it black,
or with milk？
translations.昔、どこかで会ったことない？:
Haven't we met somewhere
before, a long time ago？
translations.爆弾処理は得意だからさ。:
Bomb disposal is my
specialty, you know.
translations.おとなしく手を上げろ！ バンザイ！:
Put your hands up nice
and easy! Banzai!
translations.本は読み終えたら本棚に！:
Put books back on the shelf
when you finish them!
translations.リップルとレーザー、どっちがいいかな。:
Ripple or Laser...
Which one should I go with？
translations.次は３枚におろすんだっけ？:
Next I fillet it into
three pieces, right？
translations.大根おろしすぎたー！:
I grated way too much
daikon!
translations.明日から本気出す出す、エクソダス。:
I'll get serious tomorrow.
No fuss, Exodus.
translations.あれ、鍵かけたっけ？ まあいっか。:
Huh, did I lock the door？
Oh well.
translations.お客さーん終点ですよー起きてくださーい。:
Excuse me, last stop.
Time to wake up.
translations.うわー先割れスプーンだ懐かしー。:
Whoa, a spork.
That takes me back.
translations.魚眼レンズ、のぞき込んでみ？:
Try looking right into
the fisheye lens.
translations.英語さえしゃべれれば、なんとかなるって！:
As long as you speak
English, you'll get by fine!
translations.１ドットの差が、生死を分けるときもある！:
Sometimes a single pixel is
a matter of life and death!
translations.容量が足りなくて、残り５分録画されてなかった……。:
I ran out of space, so the
last five minutes cut off...
translations.温泉卵、白身抜きで。:
One hot spring egg,
hold the whites.
translations.また十字ボタンの下、押したね？:
You pressed down on the
D-pad again, didn't you？
translations.ゴルフボールのくぼみの数っていくつ？:
How many dimples does
a golf ball have？
translations.サーフィンでやってくるサンタクロース！:
Here comes Santa Claus
on a surfboard!
translations.テストの残り３分でカップラーメンを作る。:
Making cup noodles with
three minutes left on a test.
translations.信じるものはすくわれる……足元を。:
Those who believe get lifted
up... by their ankles.
translations.牛丼つゆだく肉抜きで。:
One beef bowl, extra broth,
hold the beef.
translations.小キック！ 中小キック！ 大小キック！:
Light kick! Medium-light
kick! Heavy-light kick!
translations.草履、冷えてます。:
Your sandals are nice
and chilled.
translations.大丈夫。ポテチは野菜だから。:
It's fine. Potato chips
count as a vegetable.
translations.しいたけは英語でもしいたけ。:
Shiitake is still shiitake,
even in English.
translations.続きはＷＥＢで！: Find out more on the web!
translations.心頭滅却しても熱いものは熱い。: Even if you clear your mind, hot things are still hot.
translations.指の関節を蚊に刺される呪いをかけた。: I put a curse on you so a mosquito bites your knuckle.
translations.ちょっとカメラ止めて。困るなー、事務所通してんの？: Hey, cut the camera. Come on, did you clear this with my agency？
translations.どうする？ 執行猶予つける？: What do you say？ Should we give 'em a suspended sentence？
translations.あ、袋いりません。: Oh, I don't need a bag.
translations.やっぱり青鹿毛かな！: Gotta go with a dark bay horse！
translations.牛乳飲んどけばなんとかなるよ。: Just drink some milk and you'll be fine.
translations.デカメロンって名前は反則だよね。: A name like "Decameron" is just unfair, isn't it？
translations.あの兄弟が持ってるギター、アジフライに似てない？: Doesn't the guitar those brothers have look like a piece of fried fish？
translations.スクイズでサヨナラホームラン。: A walk-off home run on a squeeze bunt.
translations.井戸あるところはサンダル。: Where there is a well, there are sandals.
translations.論より証拠、ロンよりツモ！: Proof beats talk, and Tsumo beats Ron！
translations.木星より水星の方が好きかな。なんとなく。: I think I like Mercury better than Jupiter. Just because.
translations.ラーメン、醤油派？ 味噌派？ 塩派？: For ramen, are you team soy sauce, miso, or salt？
translations.秋刀魚の鯖缶が食べたい！: I want to eat canned mackerel made of saury！
translations.おじさーん、日替わり定食、小ライス大盛りね！: Excuse me, mister！ One daily special, with an extra-large small rice！
translations.すいませーん、半チャーハン二つで。: Excuse me, I'll have two half-orders of fried rice.
translations.あなたが落としたのは、この金のリンコですか？ それとも、普通のリンコですか？: Was the Rinko you dropped this golden Rinko？ Or this regular Rinko？
translations.おじいさんが光る竹を切ると、中から小さくて可愛いリンコが出てきました。: When the old man cut open the glowing bamboo, a tiny, cute Rinko came out.
translations.ピッチャー振りかぶって……逃げたー！: The pitcher winds up... and runs away！
translations.右手と左手どっちがすき？: Which do you like better, the right hand or the left hand？
translations.はいはい、また粉塵爆破ですか……。: Yeah, yeah, another dust explosion, huh...
translations.ちょっとちょっと、フェロモン漏れてるって。: Hey now, your pheromones are leaking.
translations.ここからが本来の小早川凛子です。: From here on out is the real Rinko Kobayakawa.
translations.焼そばパン買って来いよ。: Go buy me some yakisoba bread.
translations.肩たたき券、あげる。: Here, a shoulder massage coupon for you.
translations.今日の晩御飯はどの缶詰にする？: Which canned food do you want for dinner tonight？
translations.すごい！ 勉強なのにゲームみたい！: Amazing！ It's studying, but it feels just like a game！
translations.校長先生って普段何してんのかな？: I wonder what the principal actually does all day？
translations.リンコと呼ばれた少年がいてね。: There once was a boy they called Rinko.
translations.今日のライブは国技館。: Today's gig is at the Kokugikan.
translations.まだ焼けてないっつーの！: Hey, it's not done cooking yet!
translations.ハロー……いい話なんだろうな？: Hello... This better be good news, right？
translations.ＡとＤとＥ覚えれば１００曲弾けるって言われたから……。: Someone told me if I learned A, D, and E, I could play a hundred songs...
translations.ＰとＪ、どっちが好き？ それともハム？: Which do you like better, P or J？ Or humbuckers？
translations.転調めんどいからトランスポーズで。: Changing keys is a pain, so just use the transpose button.
translations.跳び箱跳ばずに、だるま落とし。: Playing daruma-otoshi with the vaulting box instead of jumping it.
translations.さっきから靴ばっか見てるね。: You've been staring at your shoes this whole time.
translations.もっとこうオーセンティックな感じでさ！: Give it a more, like, authentic vibe!
translations.歯磨きは短時間で。これがロック。: Keep brushing your teeth brief. That's rock.
translations.深夜に爪切り。これがロック。: Clipping your nails late at night. That's rock.
translations.天然水でカップ焼きそば。これがロック。: Making instant yakisoba with mineral water. That's rock.
translations.列は無意味に詰めない。これがロック。: Not inching forward in line for no reason. That's rock.
translations.コーヒーは食前。これがロック。: Drinking your coffee before the meal. That's rock.
translations.どんな本でもカバーはかけない。これがロック。: Never putting a cover on any book. That's rock.
translations.照明はこまめに消すけど、デジタル機器はつけっぱなし。これがロック。: Turning off the lights diligently, but leaving all your electronics on. That's rock.
translations.カレンダーは半月経ってからめくる。これがロック。: Waiting until halfway through the month to flip the calendar. That's rock.
translations.買い物かごは使わない。これがロック。: Never using a shopping basket. That's rock.
translations.そばかすをなでる。これがロック。: Giving your freckles a little stroke. That's rock.
translations.このへんでお弁当にしとく？ 気持ち良さそうだしさ。:
Wanna have our lunch here？
It feels nice out.
translations.お弁当食べるの、ここでいいよね。:
This is a good spot for
lunch, right？
translations.和食って、けっこう手間かかるんだよね。:
Japanese food takes quite
a bit of work, you know.
translations.がんばってくれたんだ？ ありがとう。いただきます！:
You worked hard on it？
Thanks. Let's dig in!
translations.カノジョの作ったお袋の味、って感じかな。食べてみて。:
Call it home-style cooking,
made by your girlfriend.
Go on, try it.
translations.おおっ！ やっぱり和風だよな。いただきます！:
Whoa! Can't beat Japanese
food. Let's dig in!
translations.どう？ 洋食屋さんの味、再現できてるといいけど。:
How's it look？ Hope I got
that restaurant taste right.
translations.●の好物ばかりだよ。いただきます！:
It's full of your favorites,
●. Let's dig in!
translations.けっこうカワイく出来てるでしょ？ 味は……ま、食べて判断して。:
Came out pretty cute, right？
As for the taste... Well,
try it and see for yourself.
translations.洋風弁当か、うまそうだな。いただきまーす！:
A Western-style bento, huh？
Looks great. Let's eat!
translations.見た目はあれだけど、味はそれなりに中華なはず。……たぶん。:
It might not look like much,
but it should taste like
Chinese food. ...Probably.
translations.いいねー、ボリュームたっぷりだな！ いただきます。:
Nice, looks super filling!
Let's dig in.
translations.はい、リンコの満漢全席弁当だよ。:
Here, it's Rinko's Imperial
Chinese Feast bento.
translations.おっ、豪勢な中華だな！ いただきます。:
Oh, a fancy Chinese spread!
Let's dig in.
translations.はい、見た目もなかなかでしょ。へへ、自画自賛。:
Here. Looks pretty good too,
doesn't it？ Hehe, if I do
say so myself.
translations.うん、▲小早川＊▲、腕あげたな。:
Yeah, ▲小早川＊▲, you've
really gotten better.
translations.はい、リンコ特製弁当。アンタは幸せ者だね、ホント。:
Here, Rinko's special bento.
You really are a lucky guy.
translations.ああ、そうだな。うまそ！ いただきます。:
Yeah, I sure am. Looks great!
Let's dig in.
translations.あのさ、アーンとか……してほしいわけ？:
So, what... do you want me
to feed you or something？
translations.ふーん、じゃあ、今日は特別。ほら、アーンして。:
Hmph. Well, just for today.
Come on, say ”ahhh.”
translations.遠慮すんなっつーの、口開けてみ。アーン！:
Quit holding back already.
Open your mouth. Ahhh!
translations.……なに本気にしてんだっつーの。バーカ。:
...Why're you taking me
so seriously？ Idiot.
translations.あのさ……リンコも食べたいんだけど。わかるでしょ。:
Hey... I want a bite, too.
You get what I mean, right？
translations.へへ……こういうの、恋人ってカンジするよね。:
Hehe... Doing this really
makes us feel like a couple.
translations.いいから。ほら、早く！ アーン……。:
Just do it. Come on, hurry!
Ahhh...
translations.赤くなっちゃってさ。じゃあいいよ。:
Look at you blushing.
Never mind, then.
translations.ウマかった！ 五つ星級だな。ごちそうさまー。:
That was great! Five-star
quality. Thanks for the meal!
translations.ほんと？ 素直に喜んであげる……へへ。:
Really？ Guess I'll just take
the compliment... Hehe.
translations.はぁ、美味かったよ。店に出せるぐらいかもな。ごちそうさまでした。:
Phew, that was good. You could
serve this at a restaurant.
Thanks for the meal.
translations.ほんと？ そんなに喜んでもらえると作り甲斐があるってもんだよ。:
Really？ If you like it that
much, it makes all the effort
worth it.
translations.ごちそうさま。ありがとうな。:
That hit the spot.
Thanks for making it.
translations.ふぅ……初体験の味だった。:
Phew... I've never tasted
anything like that before.
translations.なんかビミョーな感想だけど……。:
Not sure if that's a
compliment or not...
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の料理の腕……まだ荒削りなところはあるかな）:
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... It's
still a little rough around
the edges.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の料理の腕……そつなくこなしてる感じだな）:
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... She
handles it pretty smoothly.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の料理の腕……上手くなったよな）: (▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... She's gotten pretty good at it.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の料理の腕……カレシとして自慢できるレベルだな）: (▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... As her boyfriend, it's definitely something I can brag about.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の料理の腕……もう素人とは思えないな）: (▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... Hard to believe she's still an amateur.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の料理の腕……人に教えられるレベルだろうな）: (▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... She's good enough to teach other people at this point.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の料理の腕……一流シェフ並だな）: (▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... She's on par with a top-class chef.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の料理の腕……三ツ星レストランの料理かってくらいだな）: (▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... It's like eating at a three-star restaurant.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の料理の腕……世界一ってレベルだな）: (▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... She might just be the best in the world.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の料理の腕……人類史上最高だな！）: (▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... It's the greatest in human history!)
translations.あのさ、次はどんなのがいい？ 気が向けば作ってあげるかもよ。: Say, what kind of food do you want next time？ I might make it for you if I'm in the mood.
translations.▲料理ジャンル▲が食べたいな。: I'd love to have ▲料理ジャンル▲.
translations.なんだ、リンコのオハコじゃん。任せてよ。: Oh, that's my specialty. Leave it to me.
translations.なるほどね。ま、覚えとく。: I see. Well, I'll keep it in mind.
translations.そうきたか。あんまり自信ないんだよね。: Going with that, huh. I'm not too confident about that one.
translations.うーん……考えとくけど、期待はまったくしないで。: Hmm... I'll think about it, but don't get your hopes up at all.
translations.ふーん、アタリだといいけど。: Hmm, hope this place turns out to be good.
translations.初めてだもんな。とりあえず、入ってみよう。: It's our first time here, after all. Let's head inside for now.
translations.この店、けっこう好きなんだよね。: I actually like this place quite a bit.
translations.気に入ってたんだ？ よかった。: Oh, you like it here？ Glad to hear it.
translations.ん？ 入ろうよ。: Hm？ Come on, let's go in.
translations.今日は何にしよっかな。: Wonder what I should get today.
translations.もうここのメニュー、大体把握してるもんな。: We pretty much know the whole menu here by now, huh.
translations.この店そんなに好き？ ……ま、アンタがいいなら、いいけどさ。: Do you really like this place that much？ ...Well, if you're happy with it, I don't mind.
translations.まぁまぁ、そう言わず。: Now, now, don't be like that.
translations.ほら、なににする？: So, what are you gonna get？
translations.んーお腹ペコペコだから、全部、美味しそうに見えるよ。きっと気のせいだけど。: Hmm, I'm starving, so everything looks good to me. Probably just my imagination, though.
translations.う～ん、ピンとこないな……。: Hmm, nothing's really jumping out at me...
