translations.●は▲生成選択肢１▲に\nするけど、▲小早川＊▲は？:
● will go with ▲生成選択肢１▲.
What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.なに、リンコが決めていいんだ？ じゃあ……コレは？: What, you're letting me pick for you？ Then... how about this？
translations.▲生成選択肢１▲か。うん、それにする。: ▲生成選択肢１▲, huh. Yeah, I'll go with that.
translations.▲生成選択肢２▲？ \nうまそうだな。\nじゃ、店員さん呼ぶか。:
▲生成選択肢２▲？
That sounds good.
Let's call the server over.
translations.違う髪型にしてみない？: Want to try a different style？
translations.出会った頃の髪型にして: Wear it like when we first met.
translations.なにそれ？ 気になるじゃん……。: What's that about？ Now you've got me curious...
translations.出会ったころの髪型にしてみない？: Why don't you wear your hair like when we first met？
translations.へえ、それってどんな心理からくるんだろ。まあ、考えとくけど。: Huh, I wonder what the psychology behind that is. Well, I'll think about it.
translations.なに、懐かしくなっちゃった？ でもさ、急にはムリだよ。ちょっと待って。: What, feeling nostalgic？ I can't do that right away, though. Give me some time.
translations.髪型変えてみるのも、いいんじゃないかと思ってさ。: I just thought it might be nice to try changing up your hairstyle.
translations.ふーん、すごいね、リンコも髪型変えようって思ってたとこ。じゃあさ、どんな感じがい: Huh, what a coincidence. I was just thinking of changing my hair too. So, tell me what kind of style you'd like.
translations.そっか……違うの見たかったけど。: I see... I would've liked to see something different, though.
translations.●さ、今の髪型好きだから。当分、そのままがいいなって。: ● really like your current hairstyle. I hope you keep it like that for a while.
translations.ふーん、素直じゃん。へへ、リンコもこの髪、気に入ってるからさ。: Huh, well aren't you honest. Hehe, I really like my hair this way too.
translations.うーん……リンコが飽きるまでね。: Hmm... Only until I get tired of it.
translations.髪の長さってさ……。: About the length of your hair...
translations.長さ？ なんか気になるの？: The length？ Is something about it bothering you？
translations.もっと伸ばしたら？: Why not grow it out more？
translations.だったら今のままでいいってことじゃん。: Then that means it's fine just the way it is.
translations.そっちの方が好きってことね、わかった、考えてみるよ。: So you like it better that way. Got it, I'll think about it.
translations.ああ、絶対似合うって。: Yeah, it'd definitely look great on you.
translations.頭の片隅に置いとくよ。……置いとくだけね。: I'll keep it in the back of my mind. ...And just leave it there.
translations.あのさ、今日つけてるアクセサリー……。: Hey, about the accessory you're wearing today...
translations.そのヘアアクセ、いいカンジだなと思ってさ。:
I just thought that hair
accessory looks really nice.
translations.そのイヤリング、似合ってるなって思ってさ。:
I just thought those
earrings really suit you.
translations.その腕のやつ、似合ってるよな。:
That thing on your wrist
really suits you.
translations.指輪、いいよな。似合ってる。:
That ring's nice.
It really suits you.
translations.メガネ、似合うなあって思ってさ。:
I just thought those glasses
look really good on you.
translations.ふーん……ヘヘ、しばらくつけとくか。:
Huh... Hehe, maybe I'll
stick with this for a while.
translations.そのヘアアクセ……あんまり似合ってないなと思って。:
That hair accessory...
I don't think it suits you.
translations.そのイヤリング、似合ってないよな……。:
Those earrings don't really
suit you...
translations.腕のそれさ……似合ってないよ。:
That thing on your wrist...
It doesn't suit you.
translations.その指輪、似合ってないよな。:
That ring doesn't really
suit you.
translations.▲小早川＊▲にはそういうメガネ、似合わないな。:
Glasses like those don't
really suit you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.あっそ。じゃあ、もうしない……。:
Oh, really. Fine, I won't
wear this anymore...
translations.ごめんな。でもそうした方がいいって。:
Sorry. Still, I think that's
for the best.
translations.▲小早川＊▲は、どうやって服を選ぶんだ？:
How do you usually pick out
your clothes, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.形で選んでみるの、どうだ？:
How about picking clothes
by their shape？
translations.シルエットってこと？ ふーん、で、何系？:
You mean the silhouette？
Hmm. Like what, then？
translations.スカートはどうだ？ 女の子らしく。:
How about a skirt？
Something girly.
translations.パンツスタイルがいいよな。スラッとして見えるっていうだろ。:
Pants would be nice.
They look sleek, right？
translations.こう……さ、やっぱ露出が多めだと……さっぱりするじゃん。:
Well... showing more skin
feels nice and breezy, right？
translations.そういうのがいいんだ。優しいカノジョはきっとリクエストに応えてくれるんじゃない。:
So that's what you like.
A sweet girlfriend might just
take you up on that request.
translations.ふ～ん……。要するに、今のリンコが気に入らないってことか。:
Hmm... So basically, you're
not happy with how I look now.
translations.色で選んでみるのって面白いんじゃないか。:
Wouldn't it be fun to try
picking clothes by color？
translations.●は暖色系で、明るい色が好きだな。: I like bright, warm colors on you, ●.
translations.明るい寒色系が好きかな。爽やかだし。: I think I like bright, cool colors. They have a fresh look.
translations.落ち着いた暖色系が好きだな。一緒にいて、ホッとするイメージで。: I like subdued warm colors. They give off a relaxing vibe when we're together.
translations.落ち着いた寒色系なんていいんじゃないか？ ▲小早川＊▲に似合いそうで。: How about subdued cool colors？ I think they'd look good on you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そこまで言うならしょうがないか。カレシの要望にこたえるのも、務めだしね。: Well, if you insist. Humoring my boyfriend is part of the job, after all.
translations.リンコ、そういう色好きじゃないんだけど。: I don't really like those kinds of colors, though.
translations.ジャンルで選んでみるなんてどうだ？: How about picking a different style？
translations.女の子のカジュアルファッションって、けっこう好きなんだよな。: I'm actually a big fan of casual clothes on a girl.
translations.男はさカノジョには、清楚系を求めてしまうもんなんだよ。: Guys can't help wanting their girlfriends to dress neat and proper.
translations.ん？ じゃあ、これでいいってことじゃん。: Huh？ Then what I'm wearing now is fine.
translations.まあ、そうか。今の感じでいいんだよな。: Well, yeah, I guess so. Your current style is fine.
translations.ふーん、そういうもんか。じゃあ、挑戦してみよっかな。: Hmm, is that how it is？ Maybe I'll give it a try, then.
translations.やった。楽しみにしてるよ。: Awesome. I'll look forward to it.
translations.そんなこと言われたって、リンコはこういうのが好きなの。: Even if you say that, this is what I like wearing.
translations.なぁ、●の呼び方変えてみないか？: Hey, how about calling me something other than ●？
translations.呼び方による。どんなの？: Depends on the name. Like what？
translations.いいよ、今のままで。慣れてるし。: I'm fine with what I call you now. I'm used to it.
translations.▲新主人公▲、なんてよくないか？: Don't you think ▲新主人公▲ sounds good？
translations.……これで満足？ アンタがいいならいいんだけど。: ...Happy now？ I mean, if you like it, fine.
translations.▲新主人公▲、がいいんだけどな……。: I'd really like ▲新主人公▲, though...
translations.案外、悪くないね。結構気に入ったかも。: That's actually not bad. I think I kind of like it.
translations.▲新主人公▲、っていいと思わないか？: Don't you think ▲新主人公▲ sounds nice？
translations.ほんとだ。この呼び方、リンコもいいと思う。: You're right. I like the sound of that, too.
translations.あのさ、▲小早川＊▲の呼びかた変えてみようって思うんだけど。: Hey, I was thinking of calling you something other than ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.やだ。リンコは今のでいい。: No. I'm fine with how it is now.
translations.▲生成選択肢５▲、なんていいと思うんだけど。: I think ▲生成選択肢５▲ sounds pretty good.
translations.……本気で言ってる？ だとしたらアンタのセンスを疑うよ。: ...Are you serious？ If so, I'm questioning your taste.
translations.ふーん……まぁ……いいんじゃない。: Hmm... Well... I guess that's fine.
translations.へえ。いいよ、しょうがないからさ。: Huh. Okay, if you really want to.
translations.▲生成選択肢５▲、ってどうだ？: What do you think of ▲生成選択肢５▲？
translations.ちょっと、リンコのこと、からかってる？: Hey, are you messing with me？
translations.リンコの髪型ってさ、どんなのがいいと思う？ 一緒に考えてよ。: What kind of hairstyle do you think would suit me？ Help me pick one.
translations.今のままでいいって: I like it the way it is.
translations.あ、そう。……面倒くさがってるだけじゃないよね。: Oh, really. ...You're not just saying that because it's a pain, right？
translations.ほんとに今のままがいいんだって。: I really do like it the way it is.
translations.どういう雰囲気がいいかな？: What kind of look should I go for？
translations.この辺りから選んでみるのはどうだ？: How about picking something from around here？
translations.ふんふん、こういうのがウケるわけね。で、どれ？: Uh-huh, so this is the kind of thing you're into. Well, which one？
translations.この辺りなんていいんじゃないか？: Don't the ones around here look pretty good？
translations.なるほどね。それで、この中で一番いいのはどれ？: I see. So which one of these do you like best？
translations.この辺の、よさそうだと思うな。: I think the ones around here look nice.
translations.ほんと、いいね。……でも一番はどれ？: Yeah, those are nice. ...Which one's your favorite, though？
translations.リンコに似合うかな。: I wonder if it'd suit me.
translations.けっこうイイかも。: This might actually be pretty good.
translations.髪の長さ、考えてる？: Did you think about my hair length？
translations.今のリンコじゃ、長さ足りなくない？: Isn't my hair too short for that right now？
translations.うん、いいじゃん。これに決まり！: Yeah, that's nice. Let's go with this one!
translations.絶対似合って。: It'll definitely look great on you.
translations.それ？ う～ん……まぁ、いいけどさ。: That one？ Hmm... Well, I guess it's fine.
translations.色はどうしよっか？: What should I do about the color？
translations.ちゃんと髪型に合うの選んでよ？: Make sure you pick one that actually fits the style, okay？
translations.色は考えてる？:
Have you thought
about the color？
translations.リンコに似合うのだよ？ わかってる？:
Something that suits me,
okay？ You know that, right？
translations.ついでにカラーも考えてよ。:
Pick out a color too
while you're at it.
translations.ウケ狙いはナシだからね？:
Don't pick something just
for a laugh, okay？
translations.うん、いいかも。ムリなくいける感じかな。:
Yeah, that might be good.
Feels like I can pull it off.
translations.これって……ほんとに大丈夫？:
Is this one...
really gonna be okay？
translations.●は……大丈夫だと思う。:
I think... it'll look fine
on you, ●.
translations.なるほどね。アンタの好み、大体わかったかも。:
I see. I think I've got
a pretty good idea of
what you like now.
translations.楽しみだな。: I can't wait to see it.
translations.これ、アタリ！ おいしいよ、食べてみ。:
This is a winner!
It's really good, try some.
translations.そっち、おいしそうだよね。ちょっと食べていい？:
Yours looks really good.
Can I have a bite？
translations.うん。予想以上、正直びっくりした。ここに住んでもいいかもね。:
Yeah, way better than I
expected. Honestly surprised.
I could practically live here.
translations.うん、けっこうよかった。また来ようよ。:
Yeah, it was pretty good.
Let's come back sometime.
translations.これはあんまり……っていうか、苦手かも。:
I didn't really care for it...
Honestly, it's not for me.
translations.（よかった。喜んでもらえたみたいだ）:
(Great. Looks like
she really enjoyed it.)
translations.（苦手か……なにがダメだったんだろう？）:
(Not for her, huh...
Wonder what she didn't like？)
translations.味も量も、ちょうどいいカンジだね。:
Both the taste and the
portion size were just right.
translations.味は良かったんだけど、ちょっとボリュームがさ。:
It tasted good,
but the portion was a bit...
translations.……お腹いっぱい。味はちょっとアレだったけど、結局食べちゃった。:
...I'm stuffed. The taste
was a little questionable,
but I ate it all anyway.
translations.お腹は満たされたかな。味は褒められないけどさ。:
Well, it filled me up.
Can't say much for
the taste, though.
translations.味もダメだし、量もケチってるし……。:
It didn't taste good, and
they skimped on the portion...
translations.ゆっくりできて、いい感じだよね。また来よっか。:
It's nice and relaxing here.
We should come back sometime.
translations.ちょっとこの店じゃ、落ち着けなかったね。残念。:
I couldn't really relax
in a place like this. Too bad.
translations.食器もインテリアも、好みだし。気に入ったかも。:
The tableware and decor are
just my style. I think I like
this place.
translations.店の雰囲気が、ないよね。:
This place has zero
atmosphere, huh.
translations.ここ、今評判らしいね。: I hear this place is pretty popular right now.
translations.あれっ、いけるじゃん。: Oh, this is actually pretty good.
translations.んーまあ、人を選ぶ味？: Hmm, well... it's an acquired taste？
translations.あー……失敗したかな。: Ah... Maybe this was a mistake.
translations.評判いいだけはあったね。おいしかった。: I see why it's so popular. That was really good.
translations.なんか……期待はずれだったかも。: That was kind of... a letdown.
translations.なんかさ、けっこう、久々じゃん。: Feels like it's been a pretty long time, huh.
translations.なんか、久しぶりってカンジじゃん。別に文句はありませんけど。: Feels like it's been a while. Not that I'm complaining or anything.
translations.どう、久しぶりのリンコの家は？: So, how does it feel being back at my place after so long？
translations.いらっしゃい。まあ勝手はわかるよね。: Welcome. Well, you know your way around by now, right.
translations.ほら、早く入って。テキトーに座ってよ。: Come on, get in here. Just sit wherever.
translations.はい、どうぞ。くつろいじゃって。: Come on in. Make yourself at home.
translations.アンタって……なんかミョーに、この部屋に馴染んでない？: Don't you look... weirdly at home in this room？
translations.絶対そうだって。いるよね、誰の家に行ってもさ、５秒で家族並に馴染んじゃうヒト。: You totally do. Some people are just like that—they go to someone's house and act like part of the family in five seconds flat.
translations.●、そこまで、くつろいでるかな……。: Do I really look that relaxed, ●...
translations.こうやって、家でのんびりするのもいいよね？: It's nice just taking it easy at home like this, isn't it？
translations.ああ。ちょっと、ドキドキするけどな……。: Yeah. Makes my heart race a little, though...
translations.まさか、リンコと二人っきりだから……とか？: Don't tell me... it's because the two of us are all alone？
translations.それもあるけど……ほら、なんか気まずいじゃん。カノジョの家って。: Well, there's that, too, but... you know, being at your girlfriend's house is just kind of awkward.
translations.ふーん、そんなもんか。: Huh. Guess that's how it is.
translations.オススメは弟愛飲のジュース。ダブルらむね味、特濃メロン味、いちごジャム味……。: I recommend the juices my little brother loves. Double Ramune, Extra-Rich Melon, Strawberry Jam...
translations.まあね、でもクセになるよ。: Well, yeah, but they're kind of addictive.
translations.じゃあ▲小早川＊▲のオススメで。: Then I'll go with whatever you recommend, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そうだ。ポテチ食べる？: Oh, right. Want some potato chips？
translations.ああ。▲小早川＊▲、いつもここで食べてるのか？: Sure. Do you always eat them in here, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.うん、座ったり、寝そべったり……。あっ！ ごめん。ポテチ、切らしてたんだ……。: Yeah, sitting around, sprawling out... Oh! Sorry. I'm all out of chips...
translations.いいよ、別に。: It's fine, don't worry about it.
translations.アンタがよくても、リンコはよくない。コンビニ行けばよかった……今日の夜食どうしよ: It might be fine for you, but it's not fine for me. I should've gone to the convenience store... What am I gonna do for my late-night snack tonight...
translations.夜食の心配か……。: Worried about your late-night snack, huh...
translations.ジロジロ見んなっつーの、家宅捜査？: Quit staring at everything, will you？ What is this, a police search？
translations.▲小早川＊▲っぽいなって思ってただけだよ。: I was just thinking how much this room feels like you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.なにそれ“っぽい”とか決めつけて欲しくないんですけど。: What's that supposed to mean？ I wish you wouldn't just label things as 'like me.'
translations.ふーん、これがアンタの中のリンコのイメージってわけか……。: Hmm, so this is the image you have of me in your head, huh...
translations.ねえ、リンコが一人暮らしだったらな……とか思う？: Hey, do you ever wish I lived on my own？
translations.だって、もっと気軽に遊びに来れるじゃん。: Because then you could come hang out whenever you wanted.
translations.うーん、でも心配事も増えるからなあ。世の中、物騒だからさ。: Hmm, yeah, but I'd also worry about you a lot more. It's a dangerous world out there.
translations.アンタが、２４時間体制で見張ってくれればいいじゃん。: Then you could just keep watch over me 24/7.
translations.（それってもう、一人暮らしっていうか……）: (At that point, could you even call that living alone...？)
translations.他人の部屋ってさ、なんかにおいが気になったりするよね。: When you go into someone else's room, you kind of notice how it smells, right？
translations.においか……たしかにあるよな、そこならでは、みたいなのが。: The smell, huh... Yeah, every place definitely has its own scent.
translations.なんか、気になってさ……。: It just made me a little self-conscious...
translations.どれどれ、▲小早川＊▲の部屋は……。: Let's see how ▲小早川＊▲'s room smells, then...
translations.ちょっと、やめてよ。鼻呼吸禁止。: Hey, knock it off. No breathing through your nose.
translations.（そっちが言いだしたことじゃんか……）: (You're the one who brought it up...)
translations.アンタは家に帰ったら、まずなにする？: What's the first thing you do when you get home？
translations.うがい、手洗いかな？: Wash my hands and gargle, I guess？
translations.服は？ すぐ部屋着に着替えるタイプ？: What about your clothes？ Do you change into loungewear right away？
translations.まあ、制服だったら。▲小早川＊▲は？: Well, if I'm in my uniform, yeah. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコは、割とすぐ着替えるかな。……一人のときはさ。: I change pretty much right away. ...When I'm by myself, anyway.
translations.（そっか、今は出かけたままの服だもんな）: (Right, she's still wearing what she had on when we went out.)
translations.なに？ さっきからキョロキョロしてさ。: What？ You've been looking all around for a while now.
translations.今にも指先でなぞって「リンコさん、こんなにホコリが」とか言い出しそうだよ。: You look like you're about to run a finger over a shelf and say, 'Look at all this dust, Rinko.'
translations.はは、そんなことないって。キレイにしてるなって見てただけだよ。: Haha, I wouldn't do that. I was just thinking how neat and clean you keep it.
translations.これでも結構見えないところは……。: Well, the places you can't see are actually pretty...
translations.ねえ、カノジョの部屋に来るのってさ、どんな気分？: Hey, what does it feel like coming over to your girlfriend's room？
translations.うれしいとか、恥ずかしいとか、色々あるじゃん。: You know, like happy, or embarrassed, or whatever.
translations.そりゃうれしいよ。やっぱ特別って感じ、するし。: I'm happy, of course. It really feels special.
translations.当然。こんなの、カレシだけの特別に決まってるじゃん。: Obviously. Of course this is a special privilege just for my boyfriend.
translations.リンコの部屋に来て、やってみたいことってある？: Is there anything you've wanted to try doing in my room？
translations.うーん、そうやって改めて聞かれると。: Hmm, when you put me on the spot like that...
translations.セクハラは禁止。: And you can't try anything pervy.
translations.ねえ、なんかないの？ セクハラ以外に。: Well, isn't there anything？ Besides the pervy stuff.
translations.（とりあえずセクハラは忘れてくれ……）: (Can we please drop the 'pervy stuff' part already...)
translations.お、ファッション誌。▲小早川＊▲は、どんなの読むんだ？: Oh, a fashion magazine. What kind do you read, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ちょっと。勝手にイジんなっつーの。: Hey. Don't just go touching my stuff.
translations.カレに見せたいファッション特集……ちゃんとこういうのチェックしてんだな。: 'Outfits to Impress Your Boyfriend'... So you actually check out stuff like this, huh.
translations.見るなっつーの。それ、付録がほしかっただけだから。: I said don't look. I only bought that one for the freebie.
translations.なんかしゃべってよ……。気まずいじゃん、会話途切れると。: Say something... It gets awkward when the conversation dies.
translations.そうだよ。部屋でふたりっきりなんだよ？ 静かになったら、ドキドキするじゃん。: Yeah. We're all alone in my room, you know？ When it gets quiet, my heart starts pounding.
translations.ＣＤ大量にあったりはしないんだな。: You don't have a ton of CDs in here, huh.
translations.リンコはあんまり持ってないよ。すごいのはお父さん。: I don't own that many myself. My dad's the one with the crazy collection.
translations.うん、ＣＤもたくさんあるけど、コレクションしてるのはレコードの方。: Yeah. He has a lot of CDs too, but what he really collects are vinyl records.
translations.へえ、ちょっと憧れるな。: Huh, I kind of admire that.
translations.別にいいけど……ほどほどにね。: Nothing wrong with that, just... keep it in moderation.
translations.▲小早川＊▲の蔵書ってこれで全部？: Are these all the books you own, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.他の部屋にも置いてあるけど、大体は。結構少ないでしょ。: I keep some in other rooms too, but that's most of them. Pretty small collection, right？
translations.まあ学生の身分じゃな。そのための図書室か。: Well, on a student budget, sure. Guess that's what the library is for.
translations.そのための図書委員でもあるね。: And that's why I'm on the library committee, too.
translations.図書室の本が全部、▲小早川＊▲の蔵書って感じか。: So it's like the whole library is your personal collection, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.へへ、それいいね。: Hehe, I like the sound of that.
translations.もう少し大人っぽい部屋にしてもいいのかな。: I wonder if I should make my room look a little more grown-up.
translations.ここ数年、大きくは変えてないからさ。成長に合わせて気分転換とか。: I haven't changed much in here for a few years. Figured I could switch things up to match how I've grown.
translations.そういう意味で言ったんじゃないって。: Hey, I didn't mean it like that.
translations.そういえばネコグッズとか、あんまりないんだな。: Come to think of it, you don't really have much cat stuff in here.
translations.ぬいぐるたくさん並べるのは趣味じゃないしね。: Lining up a bunch of stuffed animals isn't really my thing.
translations.実は押入れに隠してあったりして？: Don't tell me you're hiding them all in the closet？
translations.は、なにそれ？: Huh？ What's that supposed to mean？
translations.●が帰ったら取り出して、可愛がってるとか。: Like once ●'s gone home, you take them out and cuddle them.
translations.妄想たくましすぎ。はあ、アンタのことが心配だよ。: You have way too much imagination. Honestly, I worry about you.
translations.やっぱり少し落ち着かないかも、アンタがこの部屋にいるのって。: It really is a little hard to relax with you in my room.
translations.ワクワクもあるけどね。: Though it's kind of exciting, too.
translations.なのにさ、アンタが帰っちゃうと、一気にいつも通りのリンコの部屋に戻っちゃうんだよ: And yet, as soon as you go home, it goes right back to being my usual room all at once.
translations.▲小早川＊▲の部屋に弟が入ってきたりする？: Does your little brother ever come into your room, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.する。リンコがくつろいでたら、しょっちゅう襲撃してくるよ。: He does. Whenever I'm just relaxing in here, he raids the place all the time.
translations.襲撃……落ち着かないな。: Raids, huh... Hard to relax like that.
translations.一応、勝手に入っちゃダメとは言ってあるけど、忍び込んでる形跡あるもん。まあしょう: I've told him not to come in without asking, but I can tell he still sneaks in. Guess there's no helping it, though.
translations.声、出てますけど。: You're saying that out loud, you know.
translations.そこ……アンタが座ってるとこ。ほんとはリンコの定位置なんだよね。: Right there... where you're sitting. That's actually my usual spot, you know.
translations.そっか、なんか悪いな。: Oh, I see. Now I feel kinda bad.
translations.いいよ、アンタの定位置にしてあげても。: It's fine. I can make it your usual spot instead.
translations.そう。なんかよくない、そういうの。: Yeah. Doesn't that sound kinda nice？
translations.なあ、▲小早川＊▲のアルバム見たいな。: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲, I'd like to see your photo album.
translations.アルバムか……べつにいいけど。: My album, huh... Sure, I don't mind.
translations.うわ……これ、懐かしくない？: Whoa... Doesn't this bring back memories？
translations.あー、こんなのあったあった。: Oh right, I remember this one.
translations.そうそう、このときね……。: Right, right, this was back when...
translations.なんか懐かしい。不思議だね。: Brings back memories. Kinda strange, huh.
translations.思い出すな……。リンコの人生も色々あったってことか。: Takes me back... Guess a lot's happened in my life too, huh.
translations.これ、この間撮ったやつじゃん。: Hey, we just took this one the other day.
translations.あ、これ、前に撮ったやつ。: Oh, we took this one a while back.
translations.このときアンタ、変な顔してたよね。: You were making a weird face in this one.
translations.あれ？ これ、つい最近のか。: Huh？ This one's from just the other day.
translations.古い写真も恥ずかしいけど、最近のも……なんかね、: Old photos are embarrassing too, but recent ones are... well, you know.
translations.この写真、悪くないんじゃない。: This photo didn't turn out half bad.
translations.こんなのあったっけ……盗撮？: When did we take this...? Did you sneak this shot？
translations.あっ……これ見ちゃダメ。: Ah... Don't look at this one.
translations.ねえ、この写真、なんか変じゃない？: Hey, doesn't something look weird in this photo？
translations.ここ見て……人の顔がっ！ なんてね、びっくりした？: Look right here... There's a face! Just kidding. Did I get you？
translations.うーん、ちょっと写真の整理しないとね。: Hmm, I really need to sort through these photos sometime.
translations.この写真……気のせいか。: This photo... Never mind, must be my imagination.
translations.へへ……ごめん、思い出し笑い。: Heh... Sorry, just remembered something funny.
translations.ちょっと、そんなに真剣に見なくていいって。: Hey, you don't have to stare at it that hard.
translations.初詣のときか。すごい人だったの、思い出すよ。: From New Year's, huh. I remember how crowded it was.
translations.ああ……バレンタインか。こんなの撮るなっつーの。: Ugh... Valentine's Day, huh. Why'd you have to take a picture of this.
translations.ホワイトデーの写真か。このときねえ……へへ、まあいいや。: A photo from White Day, huh. Back then... Heh, well, never mind.
translations.クリスマス、か……。また、次も写真撮ってよ。: Christmas, huh... Take a picture next time, too.
translations.誕生日の写真じゃん。へへ、アンタがお祝いしてくれたから、最高の一日だったよ。: Hey, my birthday photo. Heh, having you celebrate with me made it the best day ever.
translations.これは……アンタの誕生日のか。次は何が欲しい？: This one's... from your birthday, huh. What do you want next time？
translations.特別な日の写真が残ってるのって、いいよね。: It's nice having photos from special days like this.
translations.リンコさ……このときのこと、ずっと忘れないと思う……。: You know... I don't think I'll ever forget this day...
translations.ほら、この日、アンタもちゃんと覚えてる？: Look. Do you remember this day, too？
translations.この写真見ると、思い出すな……色々。: Looking at this photo brings back a lot of memories...
translations.もっと写真、増えるといいいね。: It'd be nice to add even more photos.
translations.たまには、こんなのもイイかな。思い出鑑賞会って感じ？: Doing this once in a while isn't bad. A little trip down memory lane, I guess？
translations.面白かった。また見よ。: That was fun. Let's look at them again sometime.
translations.なかなか、よく撮れてるじゃん。被写体がいいってこと？: These came out pretty well. Guess you had a good subject？
translations.いいね、アルバム鑑賞会。またやろ。: Looking through the album is nice. Let's do it again.
translations.はい、おしまい。また見たいときは言ってよ。: Okay, show's over. Tell me whenever you want to look again.
translations.もう……いつまで見てんの？ アンタも好きだね……。: Geez... How long are you gonna stare at them？ You really don't get tired of it...
translations.楽しい思い出ばっかだね、うん。: Nothing but good memories in here, yeah.
translations.もう片付けるよ。見たくなったら、また来ればいいんだからさ。: I'm putting it away now. If you want to see it again, just come over.
translations.写真もいいけどさ……、ほら、実物がここにいるよ。: Photos are fine and all, but... hey, the real thing is right here.
translations.なあ……たまには、一緒に勉強なんてどうだ？: Hey... How about we study together for a change？
translations.勉強……そうきたか。アンタがしたいなら、いいけどさ。: Studying... Didn't see that coming. If you want to, sure.
translations.なんで？ ここは図書室じゃないんだけど。: Why？ This isn't the library, you know.
translations.ちょっとさ、写真撮っていい？: Hey, mind if I take a picture？
translations.今？ 好きだね。いいけど。:
Right now？ You sure like taking
pictures. Fine by me.
translations.……やだ、今は撮影禁止。:
...No way. No photos allowed
right now.
translations.ねえ、アルバム見たくない？:
Hey, want to look at
my photo album？
translations.あっそ。もう頼まれても見せてやんない……。:
Oh, fine. I'm not showing you
even if you beg me later...
translations.あのさ、たまには勉強でもする？ 高校生らしく。:
Hey, want to do some studying
for once？ Like actual high
schoolers.
translations.はあ……そんなんじゃ、テストで泣き見るよ？:
*Sigh*... Keep that up and
you'll be sorry come test time.
translations.あのさ、今もカメラって持ってんの？:
Hey, do you have your camera
on you right now？
translations.ちょっと待ってて。ポテチでもとってくるから。:
Wait here a sec. I'll go grab
some potato chips or something.
translations.（……一人でいるのって妙に緊張するな）:
(...Being left alone in here
makes me weirdly nervous.)
translations.ねえ、リンコちゃん。お友達に挨拶してもいい？:
Hey, Rinko. Can I say hello
to your friend？
translations.ちょっとお母さん、なにしてんの？:
Hey, Mom, what do you think
you're doing？
translations.えっと……ジュースでもどう？:
Um... Would you two like
some juice？
translations.いいって、そんなのリンコがやるから。:
Forget it, I can get that
myself.
translations.（部屋の様子が気になるのかな）:
(Guess she's curious about what
we're doing in here.)
translations.快、今はお客さんが来てるから、あとでね。:
I have a guest over right now,
Kai. Later, okay？
translations.ちょっ、いいから、お部屋戻って。:
H-Hey, never mind that, just
go back to your room.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲も、弟にはかなわないみたいだな……）:
(Looks like even ▲小早川＊▲ is
no match for her little brother...)
translations.えっと……そう。だから、ね。:
Um... Yeah. So wait till later,
okay？
translations.（お兄ちゃんか……いずれは……）:
("Big Bro," huh... Maybe
someday I really will be...)
translations.お姉ちゃん、見て見てー。新しいロボ！:
Sis, look, look! It's my
new robot!
translations.わ、ほんとだ。カッコイイじゃん。: Oh, you're right. That's really cool.
translations.快、お姉ちゃんは今、カレシさんが来てて忙しいんだから。邪魔しちゃダメよ？: Kai, your sister is busy with her boyfriend right now. Don't bother her, okay？
translations.（まる聞こえって、居心地悪いな……）: (Hearing every word of that makes me feel kind of awkward...)
translations.あっ、快！ それお姉ちゃんのポテチでしょ。: Hey, Kai! Those are my potato chips.
translations.ほら、ここに『リ』って書いてあるでしょ。これはお姉ちゃんのだよ。: Look, I wrote my name right here. That means they're mine.
translations.いいよ、それは食べていいから。でも次はやっちゃダメだよ。: It's okay, you can have those. Just don't do it again, okay？
translations.（優しいな……でもポテチに名前書くのか）: (That's sweet of her... Wait, she writes her name on her chips？)
translations.なんだ……友達か？: Oh... You have a friend over？
translations.そうじゃないけど……えっと、いつまでいるんだ？: Not really, just... uh, how long is he staying？
translations.なに、今来客中。: What？ I have company right now.
translations.ああ、悪い。……まあ、それは知ってたんだけどな。: Oh, sorry. ...Well, I actually knew that already.
translations.はは、なんでもない。悪いな邪魔して。: Haha, it's nothing. Sorry to bother you.
translations.快、どうしたの。こんなとこで？: Kai, what's wrong？ What are you doing out here？
translations.うん……お父さんがお姉ちゃんたち何してるか聞いてこいって。: Um... Dad told me to go listen and see what you guys were doing.
translations.それ言っちゃダメだろ～……。: You weren't supposed to tell her that...
translations.いいよ、快は悪くないから。: It's fine. It's not your fault, Kai.
translations.アイツ、リンコがいない間に何もしないよね。: He's not up to anything while I'm out of the room, right？
translations.お待たせ。なにしてたの？: Sorry for the wait. What were you up to？
translations.ちょっと、なにやってんの。: Hey, what do you think you're doing？
translations.あのさ、今度のデート、なに着てこうかなって。カレシの意見、聞いていい？:
Hey, I was wondering what to wear
for our next date. Mind giving me
your opinion as my boyfriend？
translations.あっそ……。じゃあ、どんな格好でも文句言わないように。:
Oh, really... Fine, then don't
complain no matter what I wear.
translations.へへ。じゃあさ、ちょっと待ってて。: Hehe. Hold on a sec, then.
translations.ほんと？ でもついでだし、他のも見てよ。:
Really？ Well, while I'm at it,
take a look at some others too.
translations.こっちはどう？ 似合うかな。:
How about this one？
Do you think it suits me？
translations.清楚な感じが見たいな: I'd like a neat, proper look
translations.やった。へへ……なんか照れるね。:
Nice. Hehe... Makes me feel
kind of shy.
translations.あっそ……じゃあ、どういうのがいいわけ？:
Oh, okay... Then what kind
of outfit do you want？
translations.そうなんだ……。まぁ、期待しないで待ってて。:
Oh, really... Well, don't get
your hopes up while you wait.
translations.なにそれ……本気？ ……そんなのあったかな。:
What the heck... Are you serious？
...Do I even own anything like that？
translations.こんな感じだけどさ、結局のところは？:
So that's what I've got.
What's the final verdict？
translations.ひとつ前のにしよう: Let's go with the previous one
translations.もう任せるよ: I'll leave it up to you
translations.けっきょく、こういうのが好きなわけか。じゃあ、決まりってことで。:
So this is the kind of look you
like after all. That settles it, then.
translations.ふ～ん。こういうのが好きってことか。……考えとく。:
Hmm. So you're into this kind
of thing, huh. ...I'll think about it.
translations.それが一番困るっつーの。……じゃあ、文句禁止。:
That's the least helpful answer,
you know. ...No complaining, then.
translations.あー、楽しかったぁ。アンタは？:
Man, that was fun.
How about you？
translations.もちろん、●も。でも、そろそろ帰ったほうがいいな。:
Of course, ● had fun too.
Better head home soon, though.
translations.ほんとだ。さすがに帰らないとな。:
You're right. I really ought
to get going.
translations.んー……あのさ、もう少し、いてほしいかも。:
Mmm... Actually, I kind of
want you to stay a little longer.
translations.それじゃ、もう少しだけ: All right, just a little longer.
translations.やった。そう言うと思ってたんだよね。: Yes. I knew you'd say that.
translations.そっか……。ま、しょうがないね。また来てよ。:
Oh... Well, can't be helped.
Come over again.
translations.遠慮なく上がってよ。:
Come on in. Make yourself
at home.
translations.こういう風に遊びに来るのって、初めてじゃないか？:
Isn't this the first time
you've come over like this？
translations.なんもないけど、テキトーにくつろいでよ。:
There's not much here, but
make yourself comfortable.
translations.はーい。言われなくてもそうするけど。: Okay. I was going to anyway.
translations.あー、帰ってきたぁってカンジ。:
Ahh, feels just like coming
home.
translations.ははっ、もうすっかり、慣れた感じだな。:
Haha, looks like you're
totally used to this place.
translations.アンタの部屋ってさ、なんか落ち着くね。:
I feel kind of relaxed in
your room.
translations.あ、わかった。あんまりキレイじゃないからだ！:
Oh, I know. It's because it's
not all that clean!
translations.（……喜べない）:
(...Not sure I should be
happy about that.)
translations.ね、この部屋のこだわりってどこ？:
Hey, what are you particular
about with this room？
translations.こだわり？ インテリアとかのことか？:
Particular about？ You mean
like the decor？
translations.そう。どういうコンセプトかなって思ってさ。:
Yeah. I was wondering what
kind of concept you went for.
translations.コンセプトとか考えてないけど……。:
I didn't really have a concept
in mind...
translations.じゃあ、リンコに任せてみる気ない？ ロックな部屋にしてあげるよ。:
Then why not leave it to me？
I'll make your room rock.
translations.もしリンコがさ、帰りたくないって言ったらどうする？:
What would you do if I said I
didn't want to go home？
translations.はは、最初から答えさせる気ないだろ。:
Haha, you weren't gonna let
me answer from the start.
translations.まあね、からかっただけだし。:
Pretty much. I was just
teasing you anyway.
translations.ねえ、男の部屋ってこんなカンジなの？:
Hey, are all guys' rooms like
this？
translations.どうかな？ そんな特殊な部屋じゃないと思うけど。:
Who knows？ I don't think my
room's anything unusual, though.
translations.お父さんの部屋は、こんなにさっぱりしてないしね。:
My dad's room isn't nearly
this neat and simple.
translations.まあいっか、お父さんの部屋と、アンタの部屋、それしか知らなくても。:
Well, I guess it's fine if my
dad's room and yours are the
only ones I know.
translations.もしかして、大掃除した？:
Did you do some major cleaning
or something？
translations.別に大掃除ってほどじゃないけど。:
Not a major cleaning or
anything, really.
translations.ふーん、人には隠し事のひとつやふたつあっていいって思うけどね。:
Hmm. I think everyone's
entitled to a secret or two,
though.
translations.そういえば、今日ってさ……。:
Come to think of it,
today's...
translations.動物番組のスペシャルやってるんだよね、ネコ特集の。:
There's an animal show
special on today. All about
cats.
translations.テレビつけるか？: Want me to turn on the TV？
translations.今はいいや、弟がイタズラしてなきゃちゃんと録れてるはずだから。:
I'm fine for now. It should
be recording at home, unless
my brother messed with it.
translations.いいけど、なんか使うのか？:
Sure, but do you need it for
something？
translations.パソコンの中身ってさ、そのヒトの趣味とか嗜好とか、人間性が詰まるもんでしょ。:
What's on a person's PC says
a lot about their tastes,
hobbies, and who they are.
translations.待った。……今度にしよう。:
Hold it. ...Let's do that
another time.
translations.なんで、なんかまずいことでもある？:
Why？ Got something on there
you don't want me to see？
translations.ないけど……ほらもっと別のことしよう。な。:
No, it's just... Come on,
let's do something else.
Okay？
translations.へえ、そういうの見てデートのリサーチしてるとか。:
Huh. Do you use things like
that to research date spots？
translations.まあ、な。これはラーメン特集だけど。:
Well, yeah. Though this
issue's all about ramen.
translations.出た、なんで男子ってそんなにラーメン好きなわけ？:
There it is. Why are guys so
obsessed with ramen, anyway？
translations.この部屋に入った女子って、リンコで何人目？:
How many girls have been in
this room before me？
translations.▲小早川＊▲だけじゃないかな。:
Pretty sure you're the only
one, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ほんと。嘘ついたってしょうがないだろ。:
Really. What would be the
point of lying about that？
translations.ね、ここさ、リンコの物置いていい？:
Hey, can I leave some of my
stuff here？
translations.色々……読み終わった本とか、使わない教材とか……。:
Different things... Books
I've finished, study guides
I don't use anymore...
translations.おい……それ物置じゃないか。:
Hey... You're treating my
room like a storage shed.
translations.へへ。でもほら、部屋にカノジョの物が増えるのってうれしいっていうじゃん。:
Hehe. Don't guys like it
when their girlfriend's stuff
starts piling up, though？
translations.なんか想像してみたら、ウケた。:
I just pictured it in my
head, and it was funny.
translations.アンタが黙ってるから、黙ってんの。アンタは？:
I'm only quiet because you
are. What about you？
translations.これも気が合うってことか？:
Does this mean we're on the
same wavelength？
translations.違う気がするけど……黙ってても安心できるのは、いいね。:
I don't think that's it...
But it is nice, feeling at
ease even in silence.
translations.ね、こうやってふたりでいるのと、一人で部屋にいるの、どっちが好き？:
Hey, which do you like more？
Being together like this, or
having your room to yourself？
translations.そりゃ、一緒の方が楽しいけど。:
Well, being together is
definitely more fun.
translations.邪魔に思ったりしない？ 一人の時間が欲しい、とか。:
Do you ever feel like I'm in
the way？ Like you want some
time to yourself.
translations.一人の時間が無いわけじゃないしな、やっぱふたりがいいって。:
I still get plenty of time
to myself. Being together is
way better.
translations.ふーん……じゃ、遠慮しない。:
Hmm... Okay, then I won't
hold back.
translations.同じクラスの子がさ、カレシの家に遊びに行ったんだけど。:
A girl in my class went over
to her boyfriend's house
the other day.
translations.へえ、今と同じ状況だな。:
Oh yeah？ Same situation as
us right now.
translations.行ったらさ、自分の写真がいっぱい飾ってあって、ちょっと引いたって。:
When she got there, he had
tons of solo photos on display,
and it creeped her out a bit.
translations.自分って、カノジョの写真？:
Solo photos？ You mean pictures
of her？
translations.違う、自分自身の。つまりそのカレシの。:
No, of himself.
The boyfriend, I mean.
translations.この部屋をリンコ色に染めたいって気に、ちょっとなるね。:
It kind of makes me want to
make this room Rinko-colored.
translations.それって、何色だ？:
And what color is that,
exactly？
translations.……それ、ギャグ？:
...Is that supposed to be
a joke？
translations.（あ、▲小早川＊▲の趣味に染めるってことか……）:
(Oh, she means decorating it
to match ▲小早川＊▲'s tastes...)
translations.カノジョが家に来たら、してもらいたいことってある？:
Is there anything you'd want
your girlfriend to do when
she comes over？
translations.掃除洗濯、色々苦手ですけどね。:
I'm terrible at cleaning,
laundry, and all that stuff,
though.
translations.はは、ありがとう。そう言ってくれるのがうれしいよ。:
Haha, thanks. Just hearing
you say that makes me happy.
translations.まーた自分だけいい子になる……へへ。:
There you go playing the
good guy again... Hehe.
translations.やっぱさ、窓が大きいと気持ちいいね？:
Having a big window really
does feel nice, doesn't it？
translations.そうだな。日当たりもよくなるし、風も通るし。:
Yeah. It gets plenty of sun,
and there's a nice breeze.
translations.いいなぁ。リンコの部屋には大きな窓ないし。:
I'm jealous. My room doesn't
have a big window like this.
translations.もしあったら、そこからフラフラ出ていっちゃいそうだしな。:
If it did, you'd probably
just wander right out of it.
translations.そういうこと言うんだ。じゃあ、部屋から一歩も出ない。:
Oh, really？ Fine, then I
won't take a single step
out of the room.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。料理できるんだっけ。:
▲主人公＊▲. You know how to
cook, right？
translations.できるってほどじゃ……。:
Not well enough to call it
cooking...
translations.やめといた方がいいか……カレシの手料理食べたなんて、かなり自慢できるネタなんだけ:
Maybe better not... Though I
could really brag if my
boyfriend cooked for me.
translations.いいよ、自慢なんてしなくて。:
You don't need to brag about
something like that.
translations.家にいるときって、音楽聴く方？:
Do you listen to much music
when you're at home？
translations.リンコは部屋にいるときはかけっぱなし。ヘッドフォンだけどさ。:
I have music playing nonstop
whenever I'm in my room.
With headphones on, though.
translations.だよな、お隣さんもいるし、なかなか音量上げれないんだよな。:
Yeah. With neighbors around,
you can't really turn the
volume up too loud.
translations.そう、爆音で気が済むまでパンクが聴ける家に住みたいね？:
Yeah. Wouldn't we love to
live in a house where we can
blast punk all we want？
translations.（住みたいね？ ……って）:
('Wouldn't we love to live
in a house,' she says...)
translations.アンタの部屋って、物が少ないよね？:
You don't have much stuff in
your room, do you？
translations.もうちょっと生活感あってもいいと思うんだけどなあ。:
I think it could look a bit
more lived-in, though.
translations.そう言われてもな。:
Not sure what I can do about
that.
translations.ふう……安上がりな男だね。:
Phew... You're a pretty
low-maintenance guy, huh.
translations.（それっていいのか？ 悪いのか？）:
(Is that a good thing？
Or a bad thing？)
translations.新しく手に入れたゲーム、やるか？:
Want to play a new game
I just got？
translations.ゲームでもするか？:
Want to play a game or
something？
translations.いいねぇ。なにやる？:
Sounds good. What are we
playing？
translations.オッケー。すぐ攻略してやるから。:
Okay. I'll have it beat
in no time.
translations.またリンコに勝負を挑むつもり？ 根性はあるね。:
Challenging me again？
You've got guts.
translations.新作のＤＶＤ買ったんだけど、観る？:
I bought a new DVD.
Want to watch it？
translations.ＤＶＤでも観ようか？:
Want to watch a DVD or
something？
translations.いいよ。で、何観る？:
Sure. So, what are we
watching？
translations.……別に観たくないんだけど。:
...I don't really feel like
watching anything.
translations.へえ、いいね、面白そうじゃん。:
Oh, nice. That looks pretty
interesting.
translations.うーん、そっち系？ ……まあ、いいよ。:
Hmm, that kind of movie？
...Well, okay.
translations.想像以上だったよ。また今度観てもいいくらい。:
That was better than I
expected. I wouldn't mind
watching it again sometime.
translations.まあ、たまにはこういうのもいいかな。:
Well, something like this is
nice every once in a while.
translations.はぁ……。時間を返せって感じじゃない？ これ。:
Sigh... Doesn't that make you
want your time back？
translations.そうだ。新しいＣＤあるんだけど、聴く？:
Oh, right. I got a new CD.
Want to listen to it？
translations.なんか音楽でも聴く？:
Want to listen to
some music？
translations.うん、いいね。どんなのがある？:
Yeah, sounds good.
What do you have？
translations.へえ、これいいカンジじゃん！ センスあるね。:
Oh, this is pretty good!
You've got good taste.
translations.ねぇ、なんかゲームしない？: Hey, want to play a game？
translations.あのさ、なんかＤＶＤ観せてよ？:
Hey, let's watch a DVD or
something.
translations.はあ、もうこんな時間か……、楽しくて時間経つの忘れちゃうよ。:
It's this late already...？
I had so much fun I lost
track of time.
translations.もう帰ろっかな……。:
Maybe I should head home
soon...
translations.もうちょっと大丈夫だろ？: Can't you stay a bit longer？
translations.そうだね。もう少しくらい平気かな。:
True. A little longer
should be fine.
translations.やっぱ……今日はやめとく。:
Actually... I'll just head
home for today.
translations.そうだね。ちょっと寂しいけどさ。:
Yeah, true. Though it's a
little sad to leave.
translations.リンコは……もうちょっと一緒にいたいけど。: I'd... like to stay together a little longer, though.
translations.そっか、ならもちろんいいよ。: Oh, okay. Then sure, of course.
translations.それじゃ、家まで送るから。: All right, I'll walk you home.
translations.あのさ……ちょっと、お腹空かない？: Hey... Aren't you getting a little hungry？
translations.そうだな、そういえば。: Yeah, now that you mention it.
translations.ふーん……新しい料理覚えたんだけど。食べてみる？: Hmm... I learned how to make something new, actually. Want to try it？
translations.リンコが……作ってあげても、いいんだけど。: I mean... I wouldn't mind cooking something for you.
translations.なんか食べに行く？: Want to go get something to eat？
translations.それより、作ってほしいな: I'd rather you cooked for me
translations.よーしっ。挑戦してみる。: All right. I'll give it a shot.
translations.挑戦……応援してるからな。: "Give it a shot"... Well, I'm rooting for you.
translations.なんか食材、あったかな。: Wonder if I have anything to cook with.
translations.材料足りなかったら買いに走るからさ。頼むよ。: If we're missing anything, I'll run out and buy it. Please？
translations.……しょうがないなぁ。ほんと世話の焼けるカレシだね。: ...Oh, fine. You really are a high-maintenance boyfriend.
translations.やだよ。料理する気分じゃないし。: No way. I'm not in the mood to cook.
translations.……そっか。残念だけど、食べに行くか。: ...Oh. That's too bad, but let's go grab a bite then.
translations.せっかく、覚えたのに……バーカ。: And after I went and learned how to make it, too... Idiot.
translations.うん、いいじゃん。そうしよ。: Yeah, sounds good. Let's do that.
translations.これで気合が入ったし、そろそろ始めるよ。: Okay, I'm all hyped up now. I'll get started.
translations.たまには、こういうのもいいんじゃないかなってさ……。: I just figured doing this every once in a while might be nice...
translations.一応きいとこうかな？ リクエスト。: Might as well ask, I guess. Any requests？
translations.そーくると思った。それ、リンコの得意料理だよ。: Thought you'd say that. That's my specialty.
translations.まあ記憶を頼りに……。期待しないで待っててよ。: Well, I'll be going off memory... Don't get your hopes up.
translations.そんなの作ったことないけど……。ヘンなの出来ても笑わないでよ。: I've never made anything like that before... Don't laugh if it turns out weird.
translations.う～ん、甘くした方がいいかな。: Hmm, maybe I should make it sweeter.
translations.うん。いいニオイじゃん。はい、お待たせ。: Yeah, smells pretty good. Here you go, sorry for the wait.
translations.へへ。この食器、リンコとお揃いだね。うれしいでしょ？: Hehe. We've got matching dishes now. Aren't you glad？
translations.次はさ、なに作って欲しい？ 一応、考えといてあげるから。: What do you want me to make next time？ I'll keep it in mind for you.
translations.最悪……蛇口壊れてるし。: Ugh, the worst... The faucet's broken.
translations.うわ、ごめん。服大丈夫か？: Whoa, sorry! Are your clothes okay？
translations.悪い。じゃあシャワー使ってよ。:
My bad. Go ahead and use
the shower.
translations.なんか寒気がする……なんだろ。:
I've got the chills...
Wonder why.
translations.大丈夫か？ 風呂場使っていいから、あったまってきたら。:
You okay？ You can use the
bath to warm up.
translations.ひどい雨、びしょ濡れじゃん……。:
That rain's awful. I'm
completely soaked...
translations.風邪ひきそうだな。シャワー使ってきなよ。:
You're gonna catch a cold.
Go take a shower.
translations.そうしたほうがいいかも。じゃあ借りる。:
Yeah, I probably should.
I'll go use it, then.
translations.（できるだけ意識しないようにしよう……）:
(Try not to think about it
too much...)
translations.なんか、服……ある？:
Do you have something...
I could wear？
translations.とりあえず、それで我慢してくれな。:
Just make do with that
for now.
translations.これ？ ちょっと、恥ずかしいんだけど……。:
This？ It's kind of
embarrassing, though...
translations.そっか……。もうちょっとマシなの探してみるよ。:
Right... I'll look for
something a little better.
translations.ふぅ……サッパリした。ちゃんと大人しく待ってたんだ？:
Phew... much better.
So you actually behaved
and waited？
translations.えっと……なんか、変な感じだね。:
Um... This feels kind of
weird, doesn't it？
translations.はは、だな。●も落ち着かなかった。:
Haha, yeah. ● was
pretty restless, too.
translations.ありがと。なんか……これさ、泊まるみたいじゃん。:
Thanks. Somehow... this
feels like a sleepover.
translations.やっぱ気のせい。忘れて。:
Never mind, it's nothing.
Forget I said that.
translations.生き返ったあ。ほら……アンタも。風邪引くよ？:
I feel alive again. Here...
you should go too, or
you'll catch a cold.
translations.ね、なに考えてんの。: Hey, what are you thinking about？
translations.デートスポットのリサーチは万全。て感じ？: So you've got all the date spots researched, huh？
translations.まさか疲れたなんて言わないよね？: You're not gonna say you're tired already, right？
translations.さっきからリンコのこと見てない？: Have you been staring at me this whole time？
translations.ちょっと眠い……けど、いつものことか。: I'm a little sleepy... Guess that's nothing new, though.
translations.なにぼけっとしてんの？: What are you spacing out for？
translations.カレシのエスコートに期待だね。: I'm counting on my boyfriend to lead the way.
translations.あんまりはしゃぐと疲れるよ。: You'll wear yourself out if you get too excited.
translations.そろそろなんかアクション起こしてもいいんじゃない。: Don't you think it's about time you made a move？
translations.ほら、ぼさっとしない。リンコに見とれるわけでもないでしょ。: Hey, stop spacing out. It's not like you're entranced by me or anything.
translations.ね。もう少し話しようよ。: Hey. Let's talk a little more.
translations.もう少しこうしててもいいかも。: Maybe we could stay like this a little longer.
translations.いつまでリンコのこと見てんの？: How long are you gonna keep staring at me？
translations.まだまだデートはこれからだよ。: Our date's only just getting started.
translations.えっ!? 今見てた？: Huh!？ Were you just looking at me？
translations.なんかウキウキしてきたかも。: I think I'm actually getting kind of excited.
translations.顔ニヤけてるけど、楽しい？: You've got this big grin on your face. Having fun？
translations.今日はいつもより……なんかいいかも。: Today feels... kinda nicer than usual.
translations.アンタのこと見ててもいい？: Is it okay if I just look at you？
translations.へへ。些細な幸せ、かもね。: Hehe. Guess it's the little things that make you happy.
translations.あんまり見るなっつーの、緊張するから。: Quit staring so much, you're making me nervous.
translations.ね。楽しい？ へへ、リンコも。: Hey, having fun？ Hehe, me too.
translations.もっと近づいても、いいかもね。: Maybe it'd be okay to get a little closer.
translations.２人きりだよね……物理的にっていうか、精神的に。: We're all alone right now... Not physically, I mean mentally.
translations.あのさ……リンコのこと好き？ やっぱ、答えなくていい。: Hey, um... Do you like me？ Actually, don't answer that.
translations.今のリンコたち、周りからどう見えるかな。: I wonder how the two of us look to everyone else right now.
translations.あんまり他のカップルのこと、気にすんなっつーの。: Stop paying so much attention to other couples, seriously.
translations.恋人たちの季節っていつ？ 年中そんな言葉聞く気がする。: When is the season for lovers, anyway？ I feel like people say that all year round.
translations.恋人にはさ、ハッキリ言って欲しいときがあるんだよね。: Sometimes you just want your boyfriend to say things straight out, you know.
translations.ね。リンコたち、ベストカップルって感じじゃない？: Hey, don't we seem like the perfect couple？
translations.ね、蹴っていい？ これも一種のナントカ表現、ってやつで。: Hey, can I kick you？ Call it my way of expressing... whatchamacallit.
translations.カレシの手ってあったかいんだよね、なんでだろ。: A boyfriend's hand is so warm. I wonder why.
translations.恋人ならさ、もっとくっついててもいいのかもね。: Since we're a couple, maybe we could stick even closer together.
translations.あっ、向こうのカップル……まあ、気にしないけど。: Oh, that couple over there... Well, not that I care.
translations.あのさ。なんでもかんでもカノジョに言わせちゃダメだよ。: Listen. You can't just make your girlfriend be the one to say everything.
translations.リンコたちって、もしかして少しバカップル？ まさかね。: Are we turning into a sappy couple or something？ Yeah, right.
translations.ふたりでいるとさ、特別なことって必要ないよね。: We don't really need to do anything special when we're together, huh.
translations.……へへ、今ヘンな顔してたの見ちゃった！: ...Hehe, I saw that weird face you just made!
translations.リンコは……アンタのこと……なんでもなーい。: When it comes to you, I... Never mind.
translations.なんか見られてる。まあ気にしないけどね、恋人同士なんだし。: People are staring. Not that I care. We're a couple, after all.
translations.寄り道するのもたまにはいいよね。: It's nice to take a detour every once in a while.
translations.普段通らない道を行くのって、ワクワクしない？: Isn't it kind of exciting going down a street we don't usually take？
translations.ゆっくりでいいんじゃない。: We can just take it slow.
translations.平日はどこもすいてるね。: Everywhere's so empty on weekdays, huh.
translations.たまにはこういう気楽なデートもいいかもね。: A laid-back date like this is nice every once in a while.
translations.今日あんまり人いない？ ……変なこと考えないように。: There's barely anyone around today, huh？ ...Don't get any weird ideas.
translations.ずーっとゆっくりしたいけど、そうもいかないか。: I'd love to just hang out forever, but I guess we can't.
translations.こういうのさ、学生の特権だね。: Getting to do stuff like this is one of the perks of being a student.
translations.もうちょっと話す時間あればいいのにさ。: I wish we had a little more time to talk.
translations.もっとたくさん時間ほしいよね、色々とさ。: I wish we had way more time. For all kinds of things.
translations.腹が立つくらい、いい天気だね。冗談だけど。: The weather's so nice it's almost annoying. Just kidding.
translations.日差し強いね……もっと落ち着けばいいのに。: The sun's really strong today... I wish it'd tone it down a little.
translations.晴れてよかった～。: I'm so glad it's sunny out.
translations.いい天気。リンコの日頃の行いのおかげか。: Nice weather. Must be my good karma paying off.
translations.なんか曇ってるね。晴れないかな。: It's kind of cloudy out. I hope it clears up.
translations.ちょっと曇ってるくらいが、過ごしやすいかもね。: It's actually kind of nice when it's a little cloudy like this.
translations.んー、雨降ってないだけマシか。: Hmm, well, at least it's not raining.
translations.雨か……アンタは雨好き？: Rain, huh... Do you like the rain？
translations.雨の日に聴きたくなる曲って、ない？: Don't you have certain songs you feel like listening to on rainy days？
translations.雨でも楽しいね。気の持ちようによってはだけど。: Even the rain can be fun. If you're in the right mood for it, anyway.
translations.もっと涼しいところないかな。: I wonder if there's somewhere cooler around here.
translations.ん～。風、気持ちいいね。: Mmm... The breeze feels really nice.
translations.このくらいの気温だと過ごしやすいね。: This kind of weather is so nice and comfortable.
translations.デートに最適な季節かもね。: This might be the best time of year for a date.
translations.ポータブルこたつが欲しい。: I wish I had a portable kotatsu right now.
translations.なんか人多い……やれやれ。: It's pretty crowded... What a pain.
translations.人多いからさ、迷子になんないでよ？: It's really crowded, so try not to get lost, okay？
translations.ふーん……まあ、周りに誰もいないよりはいいよね。: Hmm... Well, I guess it's better than the place being completely dead.
translations.ここ、いつもはもっと混んでるのかな。: I wonder if it's usually more crowded here.
translations.そこそこ人いるね。: There's a fair number of people here.
translations.ここ、もしかして穴場スポット？: Could this place be a hidden gem？
translations.なんか貸し切りって感じかも。: Kind of feels like we have the place to ourselves.
translations.リンコの目の前では隙見せない方がいいよ。: You shouldn't let your guard down in front of me.
translations.チャンス……かもよ？: This might be your chance, you know？
translations.あのさ……もっと近くでも文句は言わないけど。: Hey... I wouldn't complain if you got a little closer.
translations.なんでそうじらすかな……。: Why do you have to be such a tease...
translations.……あ、今誰も見てない、かも。: ...Oh, I don't think anyone's looking right now.
translations.ねぇ、キスしよっか。なんて言ったらどうする？: Hey, wanna kiss？ ...What would you do if I said that？
translations.さあ、今日はこれから。: Alright, the day's just getting started.
translations.時間があるとさ、かえって何するか迷うよね。: Having plenty of time actually makes it harder to decide what to do, huh.
translations.時間はムダにしないこと。: Make sure you don't waste any time.
translations.デート中に時計ばっか気にするのって、マイナスかもね。: Constantly checking the time on a date might cost you points, you know.
translations.時間が過ぎるの、早くない？: Doesn't it feel like time's flying by？
translations.もうこんな時間か……なんかなあ。: It's this late already... That's kind of a bummer.
translations.陳腐だけどさ、楽しい時間ってすぐに過ぎるんだよね。: I know it's cliché, but time really does fly when you're having fun.
translations.けっこういい時間になってきたね。はあ……。: It's getting pretty late, huh. Sigh...
translations.ねぇ、どうする？: Hey, what do you want to do？
translations.デートプランは万全、だよね？: You've got our date plan all worked out, right？
translations.計画性は大事だよ。わかってると思うけど。: Planning ahead is important. Though I'm sure you know that.
translations.今日のデートプラン、予想中……。: Trying to guess your plan for today's date...
translations.今日はカンペキな計画って感じ？: So, do you have the perfect plan lined up for today？
translations.ちょっとのんびりしすぎたかな。そうでもない？: Maybe we took it a little too easy. Or do you think we're fine？
translations.デートプランはあくまでプラン。臨機応変にね。: A date plan is just a guideline. You've gotta stay flexible.
translations.どう？ 今日のデートはプラン通り？: Well？ Is today's date going according to plan？
translations.次はさ、どうすんの？ ノープランじゃないよね。: So, what are we doing next？ Don't tell me you don't have a plan.
translations.あのさ、この後どうするか決めた？ 忘れてることない？: Hey, have you decided what we're doing after this？ Sure you're not forgetting anything？
translations.今日さ、それなりに楽しみにしてたから。: I was actually looking forward to today, in my own way.
translations.やっぱり、カレシは車道側を歩くとか、意識してるわけ？: Do you actually think about that whole 'boyfriend walks on the street side' thing？
translations.どこに行くかも大事だけどさ、誰とどう過ごすかが肝心だよね。: Where we go matters, sure, but who you're with and how you spend the time is what really counts.
translations.リンコ、歩幅が広くないからさ。不本意だけど。: I don't have a very long stride, you know. Much as I hate to admit it.
translations.あっ、ネコ？ ……違ったかな。: Oh, is that a cat？ ...Guess not.
translations.歩く速度が一緒……へへ。: We're walking at the exact same pace... Hehe.
translations.スキップとかしたくならない？ ……冗談だっつーの。: Doesn't this make you wanna skip？ ...I'm kidding, obviously.
translations.なんか歌いたくなるね、歌わないけど。: Kinda makes me feel like singing. Not that I'm going to.
translations.今日のデート、思い出し中。: Just thinking back on today's date.
translations.次のデートはどうしよっかな……。: Wonder what we should do for our next date...
translations.次のデートの計画、立てといた方がいいかな。: Maybe we should go ahead and plan our next date.
translations.がんばってくれたカレシはお疲れモード？: Did my hardworking boyfriend wear himself out？
translations.あともうちょっと時間があればね、もっと堪能できたかも。: If we had a little more time, we could've enjoyed ourselves even more.
translations.せっかくのデートだからさ、最後までいい気分でいたいよね。: We're on a date, so let's keep the good mood going till the very end.
translations.もうデートも終わりかな……。: Guess our date's just about over...
translations.なんかワガママ言いたくなってくる、困らせたくはないけど。: I'm starting to feel like being a little selfish. Don't wanna give you a hard time, though.
translations.途中で会ったカップルがさ、リンコたちのことうらやましそうに見てたよ。: That couple we passed earlier looked pretty jealous of us.
translations.今夜は良い夢見られるかも……デートの続き、とかね。: Might have some good dreams tonight... Like a continuation of our date.
translations.ここ来たの、何度めだろ。: Wonder how many times we've been here now.
translations.ここ、結構気に入ったかも。: I think I actually kinda like this place.
translations.ここ、前にドラマのロケ地になったらしいよ？: Did you know they filmed a TV drama here once？
translations.たしかここに由来したおまじないがあったような、すぐ忘れちゃったけど。: I think there was some good-luck charm connected to this place, though I forgot it right away.
translations.友達がここ、オススメしてた。: A friend of mine recommended this place.
translations.迷子にならないように。: Make sure you don't get lost.
translations.キョロキョロすんな。: Quit looking all over the place.
translations.なんかヘンなものないかな。: Wonder if there's anything weird around here.
translations.エスコートするのはカレシの務め、だよね。: Escorting me is your job as my boyfriend, right？
translations.デートといえば……なんだろ。: When you think of a date... what comes to mind？
translations.この場所もいつか思い出になるのかな。: Wonder if this place will become a fond memory someday, too.
translations.どんな場所だろうと、知りつくすには時間が足りないよね。: No matter the place, there's never enough time to see all of it.
translations.まあ、どこだろうと、ふたりっきりってのはあんまりないよね。: Well, no matter where we go, we rarely get the place all to ourselves.
translations.今日はデート日和ってヤツ？: Guess you'd call today perfect date weather？
translations.向こうに座れるところあるみたいだよ。: Looks like there's a place to sit over there.
translations.緑の多いところって落ち着くかも。: Places with lots of greenery are pretty relaxing.
translations.空気がいいと、気分もよくなる、でしょ。: Fresh air puts you in a better mood, doesn't it？
translations.外にいると、つい野良ネコを探しちゃうよね～。: Whenever I'm outside, I always end up looking for stray cats.
translations.ここ、雑誌で紹介されてたの見たかも。: I think I saw this place featured in a magazine.
translations.ここ、前もこんな感じだったかな。: Was this place like this last time, too？
translations.ここさ、よく来るの？: So, do you come here a lot？
translations.空調効き過ぎじゃないかな。: Isn't the air conditioning a little too strong？
translations.ふーん、これ流行ってるんだ。: Huh, so this is what's popular right now.
translations.さて、どこから回りますか。: Now then, where should we start？
translations.意外と広いんだよね、ここ。: This place is bigger than it looks.
translations.なんかうるさい。: It's kind of loud in here.
translations.周りに流されてはしゃがないでよ。: Don't get carried away just because everyone else is.
translations.たまにはこういうのも悪くないかな。: I guess something like this isn't bad once in a while.
translations.ここで大声出したら反響しそうだよね。……冗談だけど。: If you yelled in here, it'd probably echo. ...Just kidding.
translations.ここならのんびりできそうだね。: Looks like we can take it easy here.
translations.追加は……やめとくか。: Ordering more... yeah, maybe I'll pass.
translations.あんまり他のテーブル見るなっつーの。: Hey, stop looking at the other tables.
translations.なるほど、こういう店か。: I see, so it's this kind of place.
translations.アンタって意外としっかり者タイプなんだ。: You're more put-together than I thought.
translations.ちゃんと掃除してる？: Do you actually clean in here？
translations.男の部屋ってもっとすごいの想像するよね。: You'd expect a guy's room to be a lot messier.
translations.本棚チェーック！ うっそ。: Time to check the bookshelf! Just kidding.
translations.あ、エッチな本！ ……驚いた？: Aha, a dirty book! ...Made you jump, didn't I？
translations.なんかないの。意外な一品。: Don't you have anything surprising tucked away？
translations.そんなにそわそわすんなっつーの。: Quit fidgeting so much, will you？
translations.この部屋、何回来ることになるのかな……。: I wonder how many times I'll end up coming to this room...
translations.やっぱり男の部屋だよね……。: It really is a guy's room, huh...
translations.あのさ……また来てもいいよね。: Hey... it's okay if I come over again, right？
translations.なんか飲みたかったら言って。: Let me know if you want something to drink.
translations.もっとくつろげばいいのに。: You can relax a little more, you know.
translations.どう？ 意外と片付いてるでしょ。: Well？ It's cleaner than you expected, right？
translations.割と悪くない趣味の部屋だと思うんだけど……。: I think my room's in pretty good taste, though...
translations.音楽……は、まあいっか。: Should I put on music... nah, never mind.
translations.あっちの方は踏み込まないこと。: Stay away from that side of the room.
translations.そんなに緊張されると、リンコまで……ほら、リラックス！: If you're that nervous, you'll make me nervous too... Come on, relax!
translations.部屋、ジロジロ見るのはセクハラ。: Staring around a girl's room like that is harassment, you know.
translations.２人きり……か。: Just the two of us, huh...
translations.このシチュエーション、レベル高いっつーの。:
This whole situation is
a little much, you know.
translations.なんかしてないと、落ち着かないかも。:
I can't really settle down
unless I'm doing something.
translations.ダメ……なんでそんなこと言うかな。:
No way... Why do you
even say stuff like that.
translations.ふうん、そう思うんだ。:
Hmm, so that's what
you think.
translations.……悪くはないと思うんだけど。:
...I don't think it's
all that bad, though.
translations.さすがリンコのカレシだね。ありがと♪:
That's my boyfriend
for you. Thanks.
translations.そんなことばっかり……誰かに聴かれるじゃん。:
Keep talking like that and
someone's gonna hear us.
translations.なんでそう……もうっ……バカじゃん。:
Why are you like this...
Ugh... You're an idiot.
translations.心配しなくてもアンタしか見えてないから。:
You don't have to worry.
I only have eyes for you.
translations.心配しなくてもいいよ、大丈夫だからさ。:
You don't need to worry.
I'm fine, really.
translations.アンタもそう思う？ そっか。: You think so, too？ I see.
translations.ふーん、そういうこと言うわけ？:
Oh, so you're going to
say things like that？
translations.今のは聞かなかったことにしとく。:
I'll pretend I didn't
hear that just now.
translations.偶然。リンコも同じこと考えてた。:
What a coincidence. I was
thinking the same thing.
translations.言葉より行動。じゃない？:
Actions speak louder than
words, don't you think？
translations.参考意見として聞いとく。:
I'll keep that in mind
for reference.
translations.カレシの意見は大事にしなきゃね。:
I have to respect my
boyfriend's opinion.
translations.それはちょっとね。: I'm not so sure about that.
translations.本気にするけど？:
I'll take you seriously,
you know？
translations.アンタのこと……わかってはいるけどさ、再確認。: I already know about you... but let's double-check.
translations.アンタの苗字、か。へへ、リンコにとっては、ちょっと特別。: Your last name, huh. Hehe, it's kind of special to me.
translations.はい、名前。改めて確認って、なんか照れるね。: Next, your first name. Going over it again like this is kind of embarrassing.
translations.ほら、誕生日。リンコの誕生日はもちろん覚えてるだろうけど。: Here, your birthday. Though I'm sure you remember mine, of course.
translations.アンタの血液型。リンコはＢ型だから、相性は……ま、そういうのはいいか。: Your blood type. I'm type B, so our compatibility is... Well, never mind that.
translations.で、読み方は？: So, how do you pronounce it？
translations.アンタが生まれたところ。そのうち連れてってよね。: Where you were born. You'd better take me there sometime.
translations.ハンドルネームはどうする？ ま、あだ名みたいなもんだし、難しく考えなくてもいいん: What about your handle？ Well, it's basically just a nickname, so don't overthink it.
translations.リンコになんて呼ばれたいのか、聞いとく。: Let me ask what you want me to call you.
translations.リンコのことはなんて呼びたい？ それも一応聞いとく。: What do you want to call me？ I'll ask that too, just in case.
translations.へへ。しょうがないな、呼び方はそれでいいよ。: Hehe. All right then, you can call me that.
translations.念のため、間違いないか確認しといてよ。大丈夫だとは思うけどさ。: Double-check that everything's right, just in case. I'm sure it's fine, though.
translations.うん、オッケーだね。アンタのこと、これからもっと教えてよね。: Yeah, looks good. You'll have to tell me even more about yourself from now on.
translations.んー、どれどれ。このゲームは、ニンテンドー３ＤＳ本体の時計に連動して進み……ます: Hmm, let's see. This game progresses in sync with the Nintendo 3DS system clock... Please make sure the time isn't off before starting the game. Or so it says.
translations.で、もし時間がずれてたら一度電源をＯＦＦにして、ニンテンドー３ＤＳ本体の時計を正: And if the time is off, it says to turn the power OFF once and set the Nintendo 3DS system clock to the right time.
translations.ゲームを始めるとゲーム内の時間は変更できないから、慎重にね。: Once you start the game, you can't change the in-game time, so be careful.
translations.それじゃ、このゲームの時間をアンタの生活に合わせて設定して。生活時間が合わない場: All right, set the game's time to match your schedule. If your schedule doesn't line up, you can shift the time to make it work, but only if you really have to.
translations.本当にこれでＯＫ？: Are you sure this is OK？
translations.よし、設定終わり！ お疲れ！: All right, all done with the settings! Good work!
translations.へへ、お待たせ。: Hehe, sorry to keep you waiting.
translations.ねえ、こうやって並んで歩くの……もしかして結構久々？: Hey, walking side by side like this... Has it actually been a while？
translations.別にいいよ。ただ、これからはちゃんと構ってよね。: It's fine. Just make sure you pay plenty of attention to me from now on.
translations.熱海とかさ、行ったよね。: We went to Atami together, didn't we？
translations.ああ、行ったな……思い出したのか？: Yeah, we did... Were you just thinking about it？
translations.うん……よく思い出すよ。楽しかったし……あれはリンコの思い出ランキングの中でも、: Yeah... I think back on it a lot. It was fun... and it's pretty high up on my list of favorite memories.
translations.なにより……アンタと一番長く一緒にいられた記念だもん。: More than anything... it was the longest we ever got to spend together.
translations.なーんかリンコのこと見てない？: Have you been staring at me or something？
translations.見てるじゃん。なに、リンコに惚れ直しちゃったとか？: You totally are. What, did you fall for me all over again？
translations.自分で言うのもなんだけどさ、たしかにリンコ、最近きれいになった気がしてるんだよね: Not to brag or anything, but I really do feel like I've gotten prettier lately.
translations.へへ。別に答えなくてもいいけどさ、期待に満ちた目、してるよ。: Hehe. You don't have to answer, though I do have a pretty hopeful look in my eyes right now.
translations.してるって。ほら、顔よく見せてみ？: I sure do. Come on, let me get a good look at your face.
translations.もっと正面から、リンコのこと見てよ。: Look right at me, straight on.
translations.そんな離れないでよ。こっち来て。: Don't stay so far away. Come closer.
translations.顔近過ぎ。そんなにこっち来なくても見えてるってば。: Your face is way too close. I can see you fine without you coming that close.
translations.うん、オッケーオッケー。そのままにっこりスマイル～。: Yeah, okay, okay. Now give me a big smile.
translations.恥ずかしがってんの？ まあ、いいけどね。: Are you embarrassed or something？ Well, whatever.
translations.なんか静かだなーって……。: Just thinking how quiet it is...
translations.楽しいことはこれからいくらでもあるんだからさ。: We've got plenty of fun stuff ahead of us, after all.
translations.ね。のど乾かない？ 特別にリンコが買ってくるけど？: Hey. Aren't you thirsty？ As a special treat, I can go get us something.
translations.じゃあ、頼もうかな: Sure, I'll take you up on it
translations.珍しいな。じゃあ、頼もうかな。: That doesn't happen often. Sure, I'll take you up on that.
translations.お待たせ！ リンコのセンスで選んだけど、文句ないよね。: Sorry for the wait! I picked them out myself, so no complaining, okay？
translations.へえ、優しいじゃん。１０秒でゴー！: Oh, how sweet of you. You have ten seconds, go!
translations.お待たせ。いろいろあったけど、これで良かったか？: Sorry for the wait. They had a bunch of stuff, is this okay？
translations.オッケー。走って買ってきてもらったのに文句言うほどリンコは鬼じゃないよ。: It's fine. I'm not heartless enough to complain after making you run to get it.
translations.疲れない？ ベンチあるから、座ろうよ。: Aren't you tired？ There's a bench over there, let's sit down.
translations.少しだけ休んでいこうか: Let's just rest a little bit
translations.しばらく休んでくか。: Let's rest here for a while.
translations.そうだね。ゆっくりするのもいいかも。: Yeah. Taking it easy for a bit sounds nice.
translations.少しだけ休んでいこうか。: Let's just rest for a little bit.
translations.うん。じゃあさ、次はどうすんの？: Okay. So, what are we doing next？
translations.はは、そんなに急かすなって。: Haha, don't rush me like that.
translations.今日ちょっと暑いね。上着必要なかったかも、脱ごうかな？: It's a bit hot today. Maybe I didn't need a jacket. Should I take it off？
translations.脱いだ方がいいよ。でも、置き忘れないようにな。: You should take it off. Just don't forget it anywhere, okay？
translations.そっか……そうかも。やめとこうかな。: Oh... You might be right. Maybe I'll keep it on.
translations.今日ちょっと寒くない？ もっと厚着してくればよかった。: Isn't it kind of cold today？ I should've dressed warmer.
translations.もっとそばに寄れば？ 少しはマシになるだろ。: Why not come a little closer？ That should warm you up a bit.
translations.……なんか顔がやらしいから、手だけにしておく。ほら。: ...Your face looks kinda sleazy, so we're just holding hands. Here.
translations.んー、いいや。でもさ、風よけぐらいにはなってよ。: Hmm, nah, I'm good. You can at least block the wind for me, though.
translations.あっ、あそこ、出店だ。買ってきていい？: Oh, look, a food stall. Can I go get something？
translations.●が買ってくるよ。▲小早川＊▲は、ここで待ってな。: ●'ll go get us some. Wait here, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.んー、じゃあ一緒に行く。: Hmm... Then I'll come with you.
translations.並ぶだけの価値はあったな。: That was worth waiting in line for.
translations.並んでる間の期待感っていうのかな、それもおいしく感じる要素かもよ。: Maybe it's the anticipation while waiting in line that makes it taste even better.
translations.ネコ！ あーん、カワイイ▼ ね。アンタも飼ってみたいと思わない？: A cat! Aww, so cute▼ Hey, don't you want to have one too？
translations.ネコより▲小早川＊▲と一緒にいたいな。: I'd rather be with you than a cat, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そんなこと聞いてないっつーの。あーんカワイイ～▼: That's not what I asked, geez. Aww, it's so cute~▼
translations.だよね？ 一家に一ネコだよ♪: Right？ Every home needs a cat♪
translations.サンオイル塗ってやろうか？: Want me to put tanning oil on you？
translations.日焼け止め塗ってやろうか？: Want me to put sunscreen on you？
translations.へえ、日焼けがいいんだ。まあいいけど、自分で塗るから。: Oh, so you like a tan. Fine by me, but I'll put it on myself.
translations.そうだね。持ってるなら貸して、自分で塗るから。: Yeah, good idea. Lend it to me if you have some. I'll put it on myself.
translations.きれいな景色じゃん……何考えてんの？: Great view, huh... What's on your mind？
translations.景色より▲小早川＊▲に見とれてた: I was admiring ▲小早川＊▲, not the view
translations.つい景色に見とれてた: I just got lost in the view
translations.ごめん。景色より▲小早川＊▲に見とれてた。: Sorry. Forget the view, I was admiring you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ふーん、陳腐な台詞。……まあ効果があるから、陳腐になったのかもしれないけどね。へ: Hmph, what a cliché line. ...Well, maybe it became a cliché because it works. Hehe.
translations.つい景色に見とれちゃってさ。: I just got lost in the view.
translations.それわかる。この景色、そのまま持って帰りたくなるね。: I get that. Makes you want to pack this whole view up and take it home.
translations.ずいぶん人多いね。もしかして人気スポット？: There sure are a lot of people. Is this a popular spot or something？
translations.騒々しいな。イヤか？: It's pretty noisy. Does it bother you？
translations.別にイヤってほどじゃないよ。もう少し落ち着いてる方が好きだけどさ。: I wouldn't say I hate it. Though I do prefer somewhere a bit quieter.
translations.にぎやかなくらいがいいだろ？: It's nice when it's lively like this, right？
translations.まあね。でも時と場合によるかな。: I guess. Depends on the time and place, though.
translations.あんまり人いないね。もしかしてここ穴場？: Hardly anyone's around. Did we find a hidden gem？
translations.いいんじゃない、落ち着いて話せるんだからさ。: That's fine, isn't it？ It means we can talk in peace.
translations.まあね。騒がしいよりはいいよ。: Yeah, I guess. Better than it being noisy.
translations.せっかくのデートなのに、雨か。: We finally have a date, and it's raining.
translations.雨のデートも悪くないだろ？: A rainy date isn't so bad, right？
translations.デートの日はやっぱり晴れて欲しかったな。:
I really wish it'd been
sunny for our date.
translations.まあ、そうかもね。雨だと色々と面倒だし。:
Yeah, I guess so. Rain makes
everything a hassle.
translations.んー、どうだろ。気の持ちようかもね。:
Hmm, I don't know. Guess it
depends on your mindset.
translations.あのさ。今日帰り、アンタんち行っていい？:
Hey. Can I come over to your
place on the way home today？
translations.その前にまずはデート、楽しまないと！:
First things first though,
let's enjoy our date!
translations.ふーん、じゃあいいよ。まあ見られたくないものもあるか。:
Oh. Fine, then. Guess you've
got stuff you don't want me
to see.
translations.あ、占いやってる。相性占いだってさ。:
Oh, a fortune teller. Looks
like they do compatibility
readings.
translations.信じてないから興味ない: I don't buy into that stuff
translations.信じてないから興味ないや。:
I don't buy into that stuff,
so I'm not interested.
translations.だよね。賢明な判断してくれて助かるよ。:
Right？ Glad you've got some
common sense.
translations.ちょっと気になるな。占ってもらうか！:
I'm kind of curious. Let's
get a reading!
translations.へえ、相性最高だってさ。だからどうってことはないけど、気分は悪くないね。:
Huh, best compatibility, she
says. Not that it means much,
but it doesn't feel bad.
translations.ふーん、まあ、普通？ そりゃ相性悪かったら一緒にいないし。:
Hmm. Pretty average, then？
Well, we wouldn't be together
if we didn't get along.
translations.（悪くないけど、もっといい結果だったらよかったな）:
(Not bad, though I wish we'd
gotten a better result.)
translations.どういうこと？ いいのか悪いのか……。:
What's that supposed to mean？
Is it good or bad...？
translations.きれいな花。誰かが手入れしてるのかな。:
Pretty flowers. Wonder if
someone's tending to them.
translations.花っていいよな。名前わからなくても、見ててるだけで落ち着くし。:
Flowers really are nice.
Even if I don't know their
names, they're soothing.
translations.そうかもね。へへ、アンタも同じこと考えてたか。:
Yeah, maybe. Heh, so you were
thinking the same thing.
translations.……そう？ それってたぶんいい意味だよね。ならいいや。:
...Really？ You probably mean
that in a good way, right？
Then I'll take it.
translations.あ、うちのクラスの……。向こうもカレシと一緒だ。:
Oh, she's in my class...
And she's with her boyfriend,
too.
translations.●たちはどう\n思われてるんだろうな:
Wonder what they think of
us, ●
translations.●たちは、向こうからどう思われてるんだろうな。:
I wonder what they think of
us, ●.
translations.その自信はどこからくるんだっつーの。:
Where do you even get that
confidence from？
translations.もしかして、リンコが来るからあわてて掃除した？:
Did you hurry and clean up
just because I was coming
over？
translations.ふーん。まあ、そういうことにしとくか。:
Hmm. Well, I'll take your
word for it.
translations.不自然に片付き過ぎなんだっつーの。散らかってるよりはいいけど。: It's unnaturally neat, you know. Better than a mess, though.
translations.リラックスリラックス！ 自分の部屋だと思ってさ。: Relax, relax! Make yourself at home.
translations.そんな風に思えるわけないっつーの。: Like there's any way I could do that.
translations.お茶でもいれようか？ そうすれば、落ち着くだろ。: Should I make some tea？ That ought to help you settle down.
translations.へへ、気がきくね。おかまいなく。: Hehe, aren't you considerate. Don't go to any trouble, though.
translations.この本、リンコも前に読んでた。: I read this book a while back, too.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が好きそうだからな、なんとなく気になって。: It looked like something you'd like, ▲小早川＊▲, so I got curious.
translations.へえ、いじらしいとこあるじゃん。この作家の本、他にも貸してあげるよ。: Huh, that's actually kind of sweet. I'll lend you some more by this author.
translations.偶然なんだ。やっぱ一緒にいると趣味も似てくるのかな。: A coincidence, huh. Guess our tastes start rubbing off on each other.
translations.緊張してるんだよ。女の子の部屋ってなんとなくさ……。: I'm just nervous. Being in a girl's room kind of does that...
translations.そういうの、こっちに伝染するんだってば。迷惑。: That kind of thing rubs off on me, you know. What a pain.
translations.きれいな部屋だと思って、つい。やっぱり女の子の部屋だな。: I just couldn't help noticing how nice it is. Definitely a girl's room.
translations.お茶いれるよ。\n紅茶？ コーヒー？:
I'll make us something.
Tea？ Coffee？
translations.了解。\nお待ちあそばせ。:
Got it.
One moment, my good sir.
translations.はい、あなた。\n…………ごめん、\n今のやっぱなし。:
Coming right up, dear.
...Sorry,
forget I just said that.
translations.ライブＤＶＤでも観る？: Wanna watch a concert DVD or something？
translations.それより▲小早川＊▲ともっと話したいな。: I'd rather talk more with you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.お、いいね！ オススメある？: Oh, sounds great! Got any recommendations？
translations.へへ、あたりまえじゃん。待ってなって。: Hehe, obviously. Just hang on a sec.
translations.ふーん……まあ、それでもいっか。: Hmm... Well, I guess that's fine too.
translations.ねえ、ちょっと服見てもいい？: Hey, mind if we look at clothes for a bit？
translations.あのさ、服探したいから付き合ってよ。: Hey, I want to look for some clothes. Come with me.
translations.違うのが見たいんだけど: I'd rather look at something else.
translations.リンコ、洋服選びたいんだけど。一緒に探してくれる？: I want to pick out some clothes. Will you help me look？
translations.そっか……。じゃあ、どこ見る？: Oh, okay... Where do you want to look, then？
translations.ね、どんな感じの服がいいと思う？: Hey, what kind of clothes do you think would look good？
translations.ふ～ん、わかった。それじゃあ選んでくるね。: Hmm, got it. I'll go pick some out, then.
translations.結構いいと思わない？: Don't you think this is pretty good？
translations.リンコはこれ好きなんだけど。アンタは？: I really like this one. What about you？
translations.これって、リンコに似合ってんのかな？: Do you think this actually suits me？
translations.これ……上手く着れてるかな？: Am I... pulling this off okay？
translations.違うのも見たいな: I'd like to see something else, too.
translations.（いい加減決めないと機嫌悪くなるかもな……）: (If I don't pick one soon, she might get in a bad mood...)
translations.１つ前のにしよう: Let's go with the one before this.
translations.決まりだね。アンタに選んでもらってよかったよ。: Then it's settled. I'm glad I had you pick for me.
translations.へへ……いつもと違う感じってさ、自分でも新鮮。選んでくれてありがと。: Hehe... Wearing something different from usual feels kinda fresh, even to me. Thanks for picking it out.
translations.今日ってリンコの誕生日なんだよね。……知ってると思うけど。: It's my birthday today. ...Though I figure you already know.
translations.ハッピーバースデーリンコ！ ほら、言ってみ？: Happy birthday, Rinko! Come on, let's hear you say it.
translations.リンコの誕生日……やっぱり覚えててくれたんだ？ へへ。: So you really did remember my birthday, huh？ Hehe.
translations.今日って、あれじゃん。えっと……誕生日おめでとう。: Today's the day, isn't it. Um... Happy birthday.
translations.ハッピーバースデー！ お祝いしてほしい？ しょうがないなぁ。: Happy birthday! Want me to celebrate with you？ Guess I don't have a choice.
translations.お誕生日おめでとう。リンコとふたりでお祝いがいいよね。: Happy birthday. You'd rather celebrate just the two of us, right？
translations.あのさ、今日ってふたりが初めて会った日なんだよね。知ってた？: Hey, today's the day we first met, you know. Did you know that？
translations.今日ってさ、リンコとアンタが初めて会った記念日じゃん。へへ。: Today's the anniversary of the day we first met, you know. Hehe.
translations.今日はね、リンコたちが初めて会った大切な日だよ。覚えといてね。: Today's an important day—it's when we first met. Make sure you remember it.
translations.リンコたちが付き合い始めた日、覚えてる？ 今日がその記念日なんだよね。: Remember the day we started going out？ Today's our anniversary.
translations.ほら、今日ってリンコたちが付き合い始めた記念日じゃん。お祝いとかしちゃう？: Hey, today's the anniversary of when we started dating. Wanna celebrate or something？
translations.今日はふたりが付き合い始めた記念日だね。リンコはちゃんと覚えてるよ♪: Today's the anniversary of when we started going out. I remembered, of course♪
translations.月曜日がやってきた……１週間の始まりか。: Monday's here... Start of a new week, huh.
translations.まだ火曜日だって。今日はなにしよっかな。: It's only Tuesday. Wonder what I should do today.
translations.水曜日か。気合い入んないよね……。: Wednesday, huh. Hard to get motivated...
translations.やっと木曜日って感じ。週末の予定でも考えとく？: Feels like it's finally Thursday. Wanna start thinking about weekend plans？
translations.きたきた、金曜日。我ながら１週間よく頑張った！: Yes, it's Friday. Have to admit, I worked pretty hard this week!
translations.土曜日は楽しいことだけ考えてたいよね？ もちろん、明日もだけど。: On Saturdays, you just wanna think about fun stuff, right？ And tomorrow too, of course.
translations.ほら日曜日なんだから、しっかり遊んでストレス解消！: Come on, it's Sunday. Let's have some real fun and blow off some steam!
translations.春はあけぼの。……そんなに早起きしてられないけどさ。: They say spring is best at dawn. ...Not that I can wake up that early.
translations.暑い……。夏の眠りと書いて、夏眠したい。: It's so hot... Forget winter, I wanna hibernate through the summer.
translations.秋か……。たまには物思いにふけるのもいいよね？: Autumn, huh... It's nice to get lost in thought every now and then, right？
translations.寒すぎ。……リンコはこたつで丸くなる。: Way too cold. ...I'm curling up under the kotatsu.
translations.なに？ 用があるなら簡潔に。用がなければ回れ右。: What？ If you want something, keep it brief. If not, turn right back around.
translations.なんとなく……来ると思ったんだよね。: Somehow... I had a feeling you'd show up.
translations.やっと来た。待たせすぎだっつーの。: You're finally here. Kept me waiting way too long.
translations.あ、来た来た。待ちくたびれるところだったよ。: Oh, there you are. I was just about to get tired of waiting.
translations.待ってたよ。アンタに会えないと……退屈じゃん。: I was waiting for you. It's boring when I don't get to see you.
translations.もっと早く来てよ。……寂しいじゃん。: Come see me sooner next time. ...I get lonely, you know.
translations.こっちこっち。リンコの顔見て、嬉しい？: Over here. Happy to see my face？
translations.今日も来たんだ？ 嬉しいに決まってるじゃん。: Back again today？ Of course I'm happy to see you.
translations.遅い！ ずっと待ってたんだから……へへ。: You're late! I've been waiting forever... Hehe.
translations.アンタの顔見たらニヤけてきた。: Seeing your face is making me grin.
translations.もっといっぱい会いに来てもいいんじゃない？: You could come see me a lot more often, you know？
translations.悔しいけど……アンタに会いたいって思っちゃうんだよね。: Hate to admit it... but I always end up wanting to see you.
translations.そろそろ来るころだと思ってたんだよね。: I figured it was about time you showed up.
translations.リンコに会いたいんだ。もっと頻繁でもいいけど。: So you wanted to see me, huh. You can come by even more often, you know.
translations.ほら、たっぷり付き合ってよ？: Come on, you're gonna hang out with me for a good long while, right？
translations.来た……別に、待ちぶせてたわけじゃないけど。: You're here... Not that I was lying in wait for you or anything.
translations.へへ……どのくらいリンコに会いたかったのか、言ってみ？: Hehe... Go on, tell me how badly you wanted to see me.
translations.あけましておめでと。リンコたちの幸せを願って、初詣行っとく？: Happy New Year. Wanna visit the shrine and pray for our happiness？
translations.一富士二鷹三カレシだったんだけど……縁起いいかな？ へへ。: Mt. Fuji, a hawk, and my boyfriend... Think that's a lucky first dream of the year？ Hehe.
translations.あんたの初夢教えてよ。まさかリンコが出てないってことはないよね？: Tell me about your first dream of the year. You're not gonna say I wasn't in it, right？
translations.初夢見た？ リンコの初夢には思った通りアンタが出てきたよ。: Did you have your first dream of the year？ Just like I figured, you showed up in mine.
translations.今日は２月１４日か……。しょうがないから準備しようかな？: It's February 14th today... Guess I might as well get something ready, huh？
translations.リンコ以外からチョコもらった場合は、全部没収だから。: If you get chocolates from anyone besides me, I'm confiscating all of them.
translations.リンコのキャラじゃないかもだけど……今日は楽しみにしててね♪: It might not really be my thing, but... look forward to today, okay♪
translations.えっと、今日はホワイトデーか。……ん？ ただの独り言。: Let's see, today's White Day... Hm？ Just talking to myself.
translations.今日はホワイトデーかぁ。なかなかいい響きだよね？: It's White Day today, huh. Has a pretty nice ring to it, don't you think？
translations.今日はホワイトデーだから、リンコの言うことなんでも聞いてくれる？: Since it's White Day, you'll do whatever I say today, right？
translations.ウソつきは泥棒の始まり……って、ほんとかなぁ？: They say lying is the first step to stealing... Think that's actually true？
translations.アンタって、ウソつくのヘタそうだよね。: You seem like you'd be terrible at lying.
translations.逆エイプリルフールってどう？ １日絶対に嘘ついちゃダメなの。: How about a reverse April Fools' Day？ You have to go the whole day without telling a single lie.
translations.遠足といえば？ ポテチに決まってるじゃん。常識だよ。: Number one field trip essential？ Potato chips, obviously. That's just common sense.
translations.合唱コンクールか。ほら、がんばれ！: The choir competition, huh. Come on, do your best!
translations.今日は七夕だしね。せっかくだから、短冊に願いごと書いとく？: It's Tanabata today, after all. Might as well write a wish on a paper strip, huh？
translations.十羽野祭りだよ。屋台いっぱい出てるかな？: It's the Towano Festival. Wonder if there'll be lots of food stalls out？
translations.体育祭……誰がそんなの考えたんだろ？ めんどくさい。: Sports Festival... Who even came up with that idea？ What a pain.
translations.ハロウィンのお菓子ってリンコももらえる？ とりあえず、トリック・オア・トリート！: Do I get some Halloween candy too？ Anyway, trick or treat!
translations.文化祭か。まあ、それなりには楽しめるんじゃない？ へへ。: The school festival, huh. Well, I guess it should be fun enough, right？ Hehe.
translations.あのさ……やっぱクリスマスイヴって、リンコと過ごしたい？: Hey... Do you want to spend Christmas Eve with me after all？
translations.クリスマスイヴ？ 別に……一緒にいてあげてもいいけど。: Christmas Eve？ I mean... I don't mind hanging out with you.
translations.やっぱり来た……イヴだもんね♪: I knew you'd come... It is Christmas Eve, after all♪
translations.大晦日といえば、夜更かししても怒られない日だよね♪: New Year's Eve is the one night nobody gets mad at you for staying up late, right♪
translations.今日って試験結果の発表日だよね。ま、今さら気にしたってしょうがないか。: Exam results come out today, right. Well, no point stressing over it now.
translations.ねえ、もうすぐリンコの誕生日なんだよね。もちろん知ってるとは思うけど。: Hey, my birthday's coming up soon. Though I'm sure you already knew that.
translations.そういえば、そろそろだっけ？ ほら、アンタの……。: Come to think of it, isn't it coming up soon？ You know, your...
translations.リンコたちが付き合いだしたのって、いつだっけ？ あ……もうすぐかぁ。へへ。: When did we start going out again？ Oh... that's coming up soon, huh. Hehe.
translations.この時期、あっちもこっちもチョコだらけだね？ もしかして、期待してる？: There's chocolate everywhere you look this time of year, huh？ Wait, are you getting your hopes up？
translations.もうすぐホワイトデーじゃん。ところで、なんでホワイトなんだろ？: White Day's almost here. By the way, why do they call it White Day anyway？
translations.もうすぐエイプリルフール。安心して、リンコはウソなんかつかないからさ。へへ。: April Fools' Day is coming up. Don't worry, I wouldn't lie to you. Hehe.
translations.今度、遠足あるじゃん？ めんどくさいけど、おやつはポテチで決まりだね。: We've got that field trip coming up, right？ It's a pain, but at least potato chips for snacks is a given.
translations.合唱コンクールか……さて、どうなりますか。: The choir competition, huh... Well, let's see how this goes.
translations.もうすぐ七夕、いよいよ夏だね。夏休みも近いよ。: Tanabata's almost here, so summer's finally starting. Summer break's right around the corner, too.
translations.十羽野祭り、もうすぐだね。まあ、アンタとなら行ってもいいかな。: The Towano Festival is coming up soon. Well, if it's with you, I guess I wouldn't mind going.
translations.あーあ、憂鬱な日が近づいてきた。 なんで体育祭なんてあるんだろ。: Ugh, that dreaded day is getting closer. Why do we even have a Sports Festival anyway？
translations.今日、ハロウィンのかぼちゃ見つけちゃった。もうそんな時期なんだね。: I saw some Halloween pumpkins today. Guess it's that time of year already.
translations.もうすぐ文化祭だけどさ、ちゃんとやる気出してくれる？: The school festival's coming up soon, so you're actually gonna put some effort into it, right？
translations.クリスマスまであとちょっと。別に、うかれてるわけじゃないけどさ。: Christmas is right around the corner. Not that I'm getting all excited about it or anything.
translations.今年もあとちょっと。いろいろあったけど、まあ満足な１年だったかな？: The year's almost over. A lot happened, but all in all, I guess it was a pretty good year, huh？
translations.もうすぐテストか……まあ、いっか。: Exams are coming up, huh... Well, whatever.
translations.明日は期待してていいよ？ 中身は明日のお楽しみ。: You can look forward to tomorrow, okay？ Wait and see what it is.
translations.明日はえっと……。別に、なんでもないけど。: Tomorrow is, um... Never mind, it's nothing.
translations.明日って、なんの日だっけ？ ……聞いてみただけ。: What day is tomorrow again？ ...Just asking.
