translations.今日のデートの約束、覚えてる？ 忘れたら小キック！: You remember our date today, right？ Forget and you get a little kick!
translations.ちょっと！ デートの時間だってば。急げ急げ！: Hey! It's time for our date. Hurry, hurry!
translations.明日のデート、絶対遅れないでよ？: Don't you dare be late for our date tomorrow, okay？
translations.なんか食べたいものある？ ……ちょっと聞いてみただけ。: Anything you feel like eating？ ...I was just asking.
translations.この街が発展するみたいにさ、リンコたちの関係も発展してくのかな？: Think things between us will keep growing, just like this town is？
translations.ねえ、新しいお店ができたらしいよ。行ってみる？: Hey, I heard a new place opened up. Wanna go check it out？
translations.最近人気のスポット知ってる？ マメに情報もチェックしといてよ。: Do you know what spots are popular lately？ Make sure you keep up with that stuff.
translations.ねえ、なんで最近メールくれないわけ？: Hey, why haven't you been texting me lately？
translations.あのさ、最近メールあんまりないよね……気にしてないけど。: Listen, you haven't really been texting me much lately... Not that I care.
translations.最近メールくれなくなったね……。リンコ、寂しいんだけど……。: You stopped texting me lately... It makes me lonely, you know...
translations.最近リンコたち会ってないよね？ アンタはこのままでいいわけ？: We haven't really seen each other lately, have we？ Are you okay with things being like this？
translations.ねえ、なんで最近会わないわけ？ このままリンコを放っとくつもり？: Hey, why haven't we been seeing each other lately？ Are you just gonna leave me alone like this？
translations.最近全然会ってくれないんだね……。リンコの気持ち、わからない？: You never come see me anymore... Don't you get how I feel？
translations.最近さ……あんまりキス……してなくない？: Say... We haven't really been kissing much lately... have we？
translations.あのさ……最近キスの回数が少ないじゃん。なんで？: Listen... You haven't been kissing me as much lately. Why？
translations.最近ね、えっと……あんまりキスしないでしょ？ イヤになっちゃった？: Lately, um... we haven't been kissing much, right？ Are you tired of it？
translations.体調悪そうじゃん……。こう見えても、リンコ……心配してるんだから。: You don't look so good... I might not show it, but... I am worried about you, you know.
translations.勉強の調子、まあまあ良さそうじゃん。いい感じ、いい感じ。: Looks like your studies are going pretty well. Nice, nice.
translations.まさか、リンコに隠れて勉強してんの？ 絶好調じゃん。: Wait, have you been studying behind my back？ You're on a roll.
translations.なんか、体の調子いい？ ま、そのまま頑張ってよ。: Are you feeling in good shape or something？ Well, keep it up.
translations.体のコンディション、絶好調みたいじゃん！: Looks like you're in peak physical condition!
translations.最近、冴えてるみたいじゃん。いいね。: Looks like you've been pretty sharp lately. Nice.
translations.なになに、センスがみなぎってる感じがする！: Whoa, it feels like you're overflowing with style!
translations.最近なんかカッコいいかも……。ちょっと、ドキドキしちゃった。: You've been looking kind of cool lately... Made my heart skip a beat.
translations.なんだか最近すごく……アレだね、かっこいいよ。: Lately you've been really... you know, cool.
translations.まあ、ちょっと遅めのバレンタインプレゼントだと思ってさ。: Well, just think of it as a slightly late Valentine's present.
translations.ホワイトデーにお返しもらえないのも、もったいないし。: Besides, it'd be a waste to miss out on getting something back on White Day.
translations.あっ……そういえば、▲小早川＊▲に渡そうと思ってたプレゼントがあったんだ。: Oh, right... I have a present I've been meaning to give you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.あのさ、この間調味料見つけたから、▲小早川＊▲にと思って……。: I found this seasoning the other day, and thought you might like it, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.調味料？ ふーん、開けてもいい？: Seasoning？ Hmm, can I open it？
translations.わ……いい匂い！ これ使えば、美味しい料理できるんじゃないかな、ありがと。: Whoa... It smells great! I bet I can make something really good with this. Thanks.
translations.あ、いい匂いじゃん。使い勝手良さそうだね、ありがと。: Oh, that smells nice. Looks like it'll be pretty useful. Thanks.
translations.なにこれ……微妙な匂い。リンコに使いこなせるかわかんないけど……ありがと。: What is this...？ It smells kind of weird. Not sure I'll know how to use it, but... thanks.
translations.扱いにくかったらごめんな……。: Sorry if it's hard to use...
translations.じゃあ今度これ使って料理してみるからさ。それまで楽しみにしといてよ。: Well, I'll try cooking something with it next time. Look forward to it.
translations.実はさ、▲小早川＊▲読むかなと思って、本買ったんだ。: Actually, I bought a book thinking you might like to read it, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.あっ、この本欲しかったんだよね、なんでわかったの？ へへ……ありがと。: Oh, I've been wanting this book. How'd you know？ Hehe... Thanks.
translations.なんとなく、▲小早川＊▲が好きそうだなと思ったんだ。: Just had a feeling it was something you'd like, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.へえ、この本あれば料理のレパートリーも増えそう。ありがと。: Huh. With this book, I bet I can add more dishes to my repertoire. Thanks.
translations.ああ。役立ててくれたら嬉しいよ。: Yeah. Hope you get some good use out of it.
translations.あ……このジャンル苦手なんだよね。これ見て克服できればいいな。: Oh... I'm not really good with this kind of dish. Hopefully this'll help me get the hang of it.
translations.そっか、ならよかったかな？: I see. Well, guess it worked out then？
translations.そのうち、これ見て新しい料理にチャレンジしてみるからさ。期待しててよ。: I'll use this to try making some new dishes sometime soon. Look forward to it.
translations.なんでってわけじゃないけど。前に出かけたとき、▲小早川＊▲に似合いそうなの見つけ: No special reason. I just saw something that'd look good on you when I was out the other day, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.いいの？ ありがと、開けてみるね。: Are you sure？ Thanks, I'll open it up.
translations.へえ、いいじゃん！ リンコの好みわかってるね、へへ。: Oh, nice! You really know my taste, huh？ Hehe.
translations.あ、こういうの結構好きかも。ありがと。: Oh, I think I actually like stuff like this. Thanks.
translations.今日って特別な日とかじゃないよね……へへ。: Today's not even a special occasion or anything... Hehe.
translations.実はプレゼントがあるんだ。▲小早川＊▲の部屋にどうかなって。: Actually, I have a present for you. I thought it might look nice in your room, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.プレゼント？ ……なんか企んでる？: A present？ ...Are you up to something？
translations.そんなんじゃないって。ただ、よさそうなの見つけたからさ。: Nothing like that. I just found something that looked nice.
translations.へえ……ありがと。開けてもいい？: Huh... Thanks. Can I open it？
translations.そうだ、これ。見つけたら買ってみたんだけど……。: Oh right, here. I saw this and decided to buy it for you...
translations.なに、くれるの？: What is it？ Is it for me？
translations.日記帳。つけてるって言ってただろ？: A diary. You said you keep one, right？
translations.●もよくわからないんだけど、なんか特別な日記帳らしいぞ。: ● don't really know the details myself, but apparently it's some kind of special diary.
translations.へー、特別ねえ……たしかになんかパワー持ってそうだけど……。: Huh, special, is it... It does look like it's got some kind of power to it...
translations.というわけで、悩んでるんだけどさ、図書委員推薦図書。どうするかなぁ……: So yeah, I'm stuck on what to pick for the library committee's recommended book. Not sure what to do...
translations.あれ？ ▲小早川＊▲知ってたの？: Huh？ You knew about that, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.だってそれ、リンコが断ったからそっち行ったんだもん。: Well yeah, it only went to you because I turned it down.
translations.そうだったのか……なんだよ、こんなのいつもみたいにさ、やっちゃえばいいじゃん？: So that's what happened... Come on, why didn't you just do it yourself like usual？
translations.こういうイベントの時くらい、他の人がやれば、いいと思いまーす。: For an event like this, I think someone else should do it for a change.
translations.いや、だから。アンタとか。: Yeah, you know. Someone like you.
translations.それが、う～ん……青春で高校生らしくて、誰でも読めるのって……どう考えてもつまら: Well, uh... Something about youth and high school that anyone can get into... Honestly, it all just sounds kinda boring.
translations.そこよ。誰でも読める本なんて、そういう無意味なオーダーだから断ったの。: Exactly. 'A book anyone can read' is a completely meaningless request. That's why I said no.
translations.お待たせしました。こちらでよろしいですか？: Sorry to keep you waiting. Is this the one？
translations.辻村深月の“ぼくのメジャースプーン”。ずっと読み逃してたからさ、ついでに。: 'My Measuring Spoon' by Mizuki Tsujimura. I've been meaning to read it for ages, so I figured I'd grab it while I'm here.
translations.小学４年生の男の子の話。ミステリーになるのかな……: It's about a fourth-grade boy. I guess you'd call it a mystery...
translations.テーマもいいしね、リンコが目指してるところと、ちょっと似てるような予感もしてんの: The theme is good, too. I have a hunch it's kind of close to what I'm aiming for myself.
translations.へぇ……●も読んでみるかな――: Huh... Maybe ● should read it too—
translations.あ、そっか！ じゃあ、これにしよう、推薦図書！: Oh, right! Let's just make this the recommended book!
translations.いいじゃん、一緒に読めるし。ね、決まり！ ほら、アンタも買った買った。: Why not？ That way we can read it together. Come on, it's settled! Go on, buy a copy too.
translations.一緒に、か……おう、いいかもなっ！: Read it together, huh... Yeah, I like the sound of that!
translations.▲小早川＊▲は……あ、いた。: Where's ▲小早川＊▲... Oh, there she is.
translations.これからさ、読みに行かない？ ぼくのメジャースプーン。: Wanna go read 'My Measuring Spoon' now？
translations.これから？ いいよ？ 丁度読もうと思ってたとこ。: Right now？ Sure. I was just about to read some anyway.
translations.オッケー。付き合ってあげよっかな！: Okay. Guess I can keep you company!
translations.ほら！じゃない。やっと思い出したか……: Don't 'you know!' me. You finally remembered, huh...
translations.まあ、ちょっと久々だけど。: Well, it has been a little while.
translations.先読めなくて、迷惑してるっつーの。ハァ、つまんない約束しちゃった……: It's been a real pain not being able to read ahead, you know. Ugh, why did I ever make that promise...
translations.そうだ、ぼくのメジャースプーン、読まなきゃ！: Oh right, I need to read 'My Measuring Spoon'!
translations.▲小早川＊▲いるかな？ 電話してみるか……: Wonder if ▲小早川＊▲ is free？ Maybe I'll give her a call...
translations.これからさ、一緒に読まない？ 例の、ぼくのメジャースプーン。: Wanna read together now？ You know, 'My Measuring Spoon.'
translations.今から？ まあ、いいけど。じゃ、ウチ来る？: Right now？ Well, sure. Wanna come over to my place, then？
translations.おぉ、行く行く！ それじゃ、あとでな！: Yeah, I'm on my way! See you in a bit!
translations.ポテチ買って来てね。待ってるよ▼: Grab some potato chips on the way. I'll be waiting▼
translations.そうだ、ぼくのメジャースプーンのつづきでも読むかな！: Oh right, maybe I'll read some more of 'My Measuring Spoon'!
translations.時間あったらさ、ぼくのメジャースプーンのつづき、一緒に読もうぜ？:
If you've got time, wanna
read more of My Measuring
Spoon together？
translations.オッケーオッケー。やっとつづきが読める！ じゃ、急いで家来て。:
Okay, okay. I finally get to
read the rest! Hurry and
come over to my place.
translations.あ、ポテチ買ってきて！ 急いで！:
Oh, and buy some chips
on the way! Hurry!
translations.いけねっ！ ぼくのメジャースプーンのつづき、そろそろ読まなきゃな……:
Oh, shoot! I really need
to get back to reading
My Measuring Spoon soon...
translations.アンタがね！ もう……じゃあ、大至急家来て。ポテチ持参で。:
YOU'RE the one who forgot!
Geez... Come over right
away, then. Bring chips.
translations.アタシたちさ、こうやって同時に同じ本読むのって、実は初めてじゃん？:
Reading the same book at
the same time like this is
actually a first for us, huh？
translations.そう言えばそうか……:
Now that you mention it,
yeah...
translations.どうせならさ、これ読むときはいつも一緒にいない？ なんちて……ヘヘ。:
Since we're at it, why don't
we always read it together？
Just kidding... Hehe.
translations.でしょ！ リンコ、アイディアマンでしょ？ ほめてほめて。:
Right？ I'm full of great
ideas, aren't I？ Come on,
praise me, praise me.
translations.じゃあ決まり！ 今からだよ？ はい、スタート！:
Then it's settled! Starting
right now, okay？ Ready, go!
translations.▲小早川＊▲はどこまで読んだ？:
How far have you read,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.プロローグが終わって、ふみちゃんの紹介が終わったとこ。:
Just past the prologue,
right after Fumi-chan gets
introduced.
translations.居たよね、ふみちゃんみたいな、超然とした感じの子。:
There was always a kid like
Fumi-chan around, right？
Kind of aloof and above it all.
translations.ふみちゃんの発表会で、はじめて“力”を使っちゃったとこ。:
The part at Fumi-chan's
recital where he uses his
"power" for the first time.
translations.“力”って……なんだかビミョーな話になって来ちゃったな……:
A "power"...？ This story's
taking kind of a weird
turn...
translations.市川雄太って奴が、学校のうさぎ、バラバラにしちゃった……:
Some guy named Yuta
Ichikawa butchered all the
school rabbits...
translations.う～ん……リンコこういうの、苦手。もっと普通の話でいいのに。:
Ugh... I'm really not good
with this kind of stuff. I wish
it were a more normal story.
translations.妙にリアルな書き込みの話があって……あと、ショック状態のふみちゃんに力を使おうと:
There were those eerily
realistic online posts... And
now he's about to use his
power on Fumi-chan in shock.
translations.こういうのさ、フィクションでもダメ。気分が悪くなる。ハァ……:
I can't handle this stuff,
even in fiction. It makes me
feel sick. *sigh*...
translations.市川雄太が執行猶予になってそれで、親戚の先生に会いに行くとこ。:
Yuta Ichikawa got a
suspended sentence, so now
he's going to see a professor
who's a relative of his.
translations.「皆さんに謝りたい」ってさ、ゼッタイ嘘だよね。裁判官の心証よくするための。なんか:
That "I want to apologize to
everyone" thing is such a lie.
Just trying to look good for
the judge. It's so realistic
it makes me mad...
translations.日曜に犯人に会うことになって秋山先生のとこで、“条件ゲーム提示能力”の説明受けて:
He's set to meet the culprit
Sunday, and Prof. Akiyama's
explaining the "conditional
game ability." Yeah, it's
getting interesting now.
translations.こうして説明を聞くとさ、もしかして、実際にある力？ って思えてくるよね……巧いな:
Hearing it explained like
this almost makes you think
the power could be real,
huh...？ That's really clever
writing.
translations.秋山先生の授業、２日目。加害者は守られて、被害者が救われないってところ。ちょっと:
Day two of Prof. Akiyama's
lessons. Where the culprit
is protected and the victim
isn't saved. Feels kind of
like a college lecture.
translations.これって理屈はわかってもさ、納得できないんだよね……すごくわかる、こういうの。:
Even if you get the logic
behind it, you just can't
accept it... I totally get
that feeling.
translations.まだ授業２日目で、動物の命の重さの話してるとこ……:
Still on day two of the
lessons, talking about the
weight of an animal's life...
translations.そうそう、これもさ……頭では理解できても、心が納得してくれない問題なんだよね……:
Yeah, this too... It's one of
those things your head can
understand, but your heart
just won't accept...
translations.犯人が後でウサギを食べたら、いいのか？って例えで、正しい正しくないじゃなく、復讐:
Using the example of "Would
it be fine if the culprit ate
the rabbits after？" to make
him admit it's about revenge,
not right or wrong.
translations.スゴイよ、秋山先生。大学の講義受けてるみたい。こんな先生いたらいいな……:
Prof. Akiyama is amazing.
It feels like taking a college
lecture. I wish I had a
teacher like him...
translations.三日目の授業。反省させないと、復讐にならないってところ。:
Day three of the lessons.
The part about how it's not
revenge unless you make
them feel remorse.
translations.なんかさ……秋山先生って、自分の話になるとすごく冷徹になるじゃん？ ああいう男は:
You know... Prof. Akiyama
gets super cold and detached
when talking about himself,
right？ Guys like that score
high with me. Try it sometime？
translations.三日目の続きで、復讐の考え方と、被害者と加害者の話のとこ。:
Continuing day three, talking
about the nature of revenge,
and victims versus culprits.
translations.リンコがこの子の立場なら、やっぱり最後の人と同じ意見かな……:
If I were in this kid's
shoes, I'd probably agree
with that last person...
translations.サンタの思い出のとこ。それで、その後、“条件と罰”を決めたって――:
The Santa memory part.
Right where they decide the
'conditions and punishment'--
translations.なんだろ、なんて言う気なんだろ……気になる～！:
I wonder what he's going
to say... I'm dying to know!
translations.４日目が終わったとこ。ふみちゃんが学校に来て、クラスの子とケンカになっちゃって:
The end of Day 4. Fumi-chan
goes to school and gets in a
fight with a classmate...
translations.小学生の頃ってさ、ああいう残酷なこと、やっちゃうんだよね……リンコも覚えあるもん:
Grade schoolers really do
cruel things like that...
I remember doing it too.
translations.５日目で、二人がお互いの考える、”条件と罰”を発表したとこ。:
Day 5, where they both share
their own ideas for the
'conditions and punishment.'
translations.秋山先生ってさ、やっぱり恐い人なのかも……:
You know, Akiyama-sensei
might actually be a scary
person after all...
translations.土曜日、ふみちゃんも連れて、みんなで動物園に行ったとこ。:
Saturday, at the part where
they bring Fumi-chan along
and all go to the zoo.
translations.人間以外の全ての生き物の姿が見えなくなるって、どんな感じだろう……想像してみ？:
What's it like, not being
able to see any living thing
but humans...？ Imagine that.
translations.先生が過去の事件の話をして、帰りに電車の中でふみちゃんに謝ったところ……:
Where Sensei talks about a
past case and apologizes to
Fumi-chan on the train...
translations.過去の事件てさ、なんか具体的だったけど、他の本になってんのかな？ 調べとこ……:
That past case was awfully
specific. Is it from another
book？ I should look it up...
translations.日曜日、ついに市川雄太と対決したところ……:
Sunday, where they finally
confront Yuta Ichikawa...
translations.ビックリした……ホント、裏切られた。先生まで騙されてたなんて……:
That shocked me... I feel
so betrayed. I can't believe
even Sensei was fooled...
translations.病院で、秋山先生に告白してるところ……:
The part at the hospital,
confessing to Akiyama-sensei...
translations.あぁ、ダメだ……思い出すと泣けちゃって……:
Ugh, I can't... Just thinking
about it makes me tear up...
translations.誰かさんが読み終わるの待ってるとこ。とっくに読み終わったっつーの……:
The part where I wait for a
certain someone to finish.
I finished ages ago...
translations.はい、さっさと読も読も！:
All right, come on,
get reading!
translations.読了！ いやぁ、いい話だった！:
Finished! Man, that was a
really good story!
translations.あ～あ、先を越されたか……: Aw man, you beat me to it...
translations.越すよそりゃ、読むの遅い！ ほら、さっさと読まないと、リンコが声出して回想しちゃ:
Of course I did, you read so
slow! Hurry up, or I'll start
recapping it out loud!
translations.いまどこ？ まさか、更に進んだとか？:
Where are you at now？
Don't tell me you got even
further ahead？
translations.まだまだ。初めのほうだな……:
Still a ways to go.
I'm near the beginning...
translations.中盤。折り返し地点かな……:
Around the middle. About
the halfway point, I guess...
translations.もう終盤。いよいよ佳境だな……:
Near the end now. Finally
getting to the climax...
translations.遅い。まいてまいて。: Too slow. Pick up the pace.
translations.（うぅ、ちょっと急ぐか……）:
(Ugh, maybe I should
speed up a bit...)
translations.遅いなぁ……さき行っちゃうよ？:
You're so slow... I'm gonna
leave you behind, you know？
translations.遅っ！ ちゃんと集中してんの？:
So slow! Are you actually
focusing？
translations.早けりゃエライとは言わないけどさ、遅いよ……:
I'm not saying reading fast
makes you great or anything,
but you're slow...
translations.あ、リンコの方が早い。ほら、がんばって。:
Oh, I'm further ahead.
Come on, keep at it.
translations.お、アタシと同じくらい。やるね……:
Oh, about the same spot as
me. Not bad...
translations.じゃ、同じくらいのとこだね。なんか、いいね。:
So we're at about the same
spot. That's kind of nice.
translations.じゃ、同じくらいだね。このまま一緒にだからね？ オッケー？:
So we're at about the same
spot. Let's stay together
like this, okay？ Got it？
translations.リンコと同じじゃん。へへ……よしよし。:
Hey, same as me.
Hehe... Good, good.
translations.あ、一緒だ▼へへ、このまま、一緒にね？:
Oh, we're at the same spot▼
Hehe, let's stay together
like this, okay？
translations.リンコもおんなじくらいだよ。さすが、気が合いますねぇ。なんちて、へへっ！:
I'm right around there too.
Guess we're really in sync,
huh？ Just kidding, hehe!
translations.ウソぉ？ 速すぎじゃない、それ……:
No way？ Isn't that
a little too fast...？
translations.速っ……あのさ、ちゃんと読んでるよね？:
So fast... Hey, you are
reading it properly, right？
translations.えぇ！？ まさか、流し読みしてる？:
What！？ Don't tell me
you're skimming it？
translations.言っとくけど、速きゃエライってワケじゃないから。:
Just so you know, reading
fast doesn't make you great.
translations.えぇ？ もう、速いよ……:
What？ Come on,
you're going too fast...
translations.すごい……でもさ、ゆっくり読まないともったいない本だよ、これ？:
Wow... Still, it's a waste
not to take your time
with a book like this, okay？
translations.集中してる……ちぇッ、いいもんねー。アタシも読も読も。:
Totally focused, huh...
Tch, fine by me.
I'll get back to reading too.
translations.はぁ？ もうおしまいってこと？:
Huh？ You mean you're
done for today already？
translations.えぇ、もうちょっと！ いいとこなのに……:
Aww, just a little longer!
I'm at a good part...
translations.おっ、そうする？ リンコも丁度いいとこ。:
Oh, calling it a day？
I'm at a good stopping
point too.
translations.はい、今日はそろそろおしまい！:
All right, time to wrap it
up for today!
translations.う～ん！ 読んだ読んだ……今日はこの辺にしといてやろうか？:
Mmm! Got plenty of reading
in... Should we call it
a day right about here？
translations.ねぇ、あのさ、今日はどのあたりまで行った？:
Hey, so how far did you
get today？
translations.あ、じゃ先行っちゃった。まあ、リンコは読むの速いからね。:
Oh, then I got ahead of you.
Well, I am a fast reader.
translations.遅いなぁ……集中力、足りてんの？:
You're so slow... Are you
having trouble focusing？
translations.じゃあちょっとリンコがリードだね？ リンコの勝ーち▼:
Then I'm a little ahead
of you, huh？ I win▼
translations.じゃ、同じくらいのとこだ。そうそうこういうの。なんかさ、カップルっぽいじゃん？:
Then we're at about the same
spot. Yeah, just like this.
Feels kind of couple-y, huh？
translations.じゃ、リンコと似たようなもんだ。よしよし、そのペースでね？:
Then you're right around
where I am. Good, good,
keep up that pace, okay？
translations.リンコもそのへん。リンコたちってさ、こういうとこがカップルだよね？ へへッ。:
I'm around there too.
This kind of thing makes us
a real couple, huh？ Hehe.
translations.えっ、もう？ リンコが言うものなんだけどさ、ちょっと、速すぎない？ ちゃんと読め:
Wait, already？ I know I'm
not one to talk, but isn't
that too fast？ Are you
actually taking it in？
translations.速っ！ いや、あのさ……競争してもしょうがないからね？ 一応、言っとくけど。:
So fast! Look, uh...
There's no point making it
a race, okay？ Just saying.
translations.えぇっ！？ リンコより速いの？ えっとさ、ちゃんと読んでる？ 斜め読みはもったい:
What！？ Faster than me？
Um, are you reading it
properly？ It's a waste
to just skim through it.
translations.読了、っと。うん……うん、いいお話だった。:
And, finished. Yeah...
Yeah, that was a good story.
translations.読了っと。ぼくのメジャースプーンか……うん、面白かった。:
And, finished. My Measuring
Spoon, huh... Yeah, it was
really interesting.
translations.おしまい、っと……ハァ……いいお話しでした。:
And, done... *sigh*...
That was such a good story.
translations.えっとね、リンコは――と。ネタばれしちゃうからやめとく。:
Um, well, I'm at—actually,
never mind. I don't want
to spoil anything for you.
translations.う～ん……全く予想外の展開。うわさ通りだね……:
Hmm... I didn't see this
coming at all. It really
lives up to the rumors...
translations.“条件ゲーム提示能力”か……ありえないのに、もしかしたらあるかも？って思わせる絶:
The power to set conditional
games, huh... It's impossible,
yet so cleverly written you
think it might exist. Cool.
translations.“正しいこと”……なんかさ、ホントに大学で哲学の先生の講義聞いてるみたいな感じ、:
"What is right"... It really
feels like listening to a
philosophy professor's
lecture at a university.
translations.この子とふみちゃんってさ、きっとお互い特別なんだよね。子供だってそういうのある。:
This kid and Fumi must be
really special to each other.
Even kids have bonds like
that. I can believe in it.
translations.もうすぐ“日曜日”……どうなるんだろ、ゼンゼン予測できない。ドキドキする……:
It's almost "Sunday"...
I have no idea what'll happen.
My heart is pounding...
translations.まだ始まったばっかりだから、決めつけるのもあれだけどさ……:
We just started reading it,
so I shouldn't jump to
conclusions, but still...
translations.なんだ？ ガラにも無く奥歯にモノの挟まったような言い方だな。:
What is it？ It's not like
you to beat around the bush
like that.
translations.まあね？ すごく期待してたし……なんか想像してたのと、ずいぶん違うんだよね。:
Well, yeah. I had high hopes
for it... and it's nothing
like what I imagined.
translations.もっと青春の光と影みたいな？:
More about the light and
shadow of youth？
translations.違う、その逆。ううん、ミステリーが嫌いなわけじゃないんだけどさ、もっと青春小説っ: No, the opposite. I mean, it's not that I dislike mysteries, I just thought it'd be more of a coming-of-age story...
translations.ファンタジー？ いくらなんでもそんな勘違い――え……してたの？: Fantasy？ There's no way I'd get that mixed up-- Wait... did you？
translations.なんか言い方がむかつくけど、まあ、そうかな、うん。普通の舞台でそういうの、ホント: The way you put that kind of annoys me, but yeah, pretty much. You really don't see stories like that in a normal setting lately.
translations.う～ん……やっぱ、ダメかも。: Hmm... Maybe this just isn't working for me.
translations.前にも言ったけどさ、リンコ向きじゃないかも、ぼくのメジャースプーン。: Like I said before, My Measuring Spoon just might not be for me.
translations.ウサギが殺されるところ？:
The part where the
rabbits get killed？
translations.だってさ、あんなショッキングな要素って必要ある？ フィクションでも、ちゃんと必然: I mean, was something that shocking really necessary？ Even in fiction, I can't buy into it unless there's a real reason for it.
translations.まあ、そこもあるかな。超能力と記憶喪失って、ダメな作家の必需品じゃん？ ……リン: Well, that's part of it too. Psychic powers and amnesia are basically crutches for bad writers, aren't they？ ...Am I being too cynical？
translations.なに？ なんだか、機嫌いいな？: What is it？ You look like you're in a good mood.
translations.ぼくのメジャースプーン、やっぱいいよ、面白くなって来た。: My Measuring Spoon is actually really good. It's starting to get interesting.
translations.助手のお姉さん、\n気になるよな！:
That cute assistant
really grabs your attention!
translations.そこもいい。なんかホントにありそうじゃん？ 天然の催眠術みたいな感じで。巧いよ、: That part's good too. Doesn't it feel like it could actually exist？ Like some kind of natural hypnosis. Making it that convincing takes real skill.
translations.助手のお姉さん、気になるよな！: That cute assistant really grabs your attention!
translations.ハァ？ わが彼氏ながら情けない……: Huh？ I know you're my boyfriend, but that's just pathetic...
translations.そう！ だんだん、わかって来た。ウサギたちの話も、ちゃんと活きてきそうだし。: Yes! It's starting to click for me now. Looks like the whole thing with the rabbits is actually going to pay off, too.
translations.いいね、面白いねやっぱ。さすが、リンコが目を付けてただけはあるよ。: Yeah, this really is good. Leave it to me to spot a winner.
translations.そっ！ 普遍的な命題にぶち当たってこそ文学でしょ。特にあの――: Yep! It's not real literature unless it tackles universal questions head-on. Especially that part about--
translations.刑罰と被害者の\n気持ちのところ？:
Punishment and how
the victims feel？
translations.ハエは殺せるのにってところ？:
How we can kill flies
without thinking twice？
translations.吉宗の生類憐みの令の正当性？:
Yoshimune's Edicts on
Compassion for Living Things？
translations.刑罰と被害者の気持ちのところ？: Punishment and how the victims feel？
translations.うん、あそこも良かった。読んでる時、完全に“ぼく”とシンクロしたもん。: Yeah, that part was good too. I was completely in sync with the narrator while I was reading it.
translations.そう！ 命の重さに差なんてつけたくないけど、でも、っていうあれ。考えると眠れなく: Yes! That whole dilemma where you don't want to rank the value of different lives, and yet... Thinking about it keeps me up at night...
translations.カッコいいとこ悪いけどさ……綱吉でしょ、そこは。もうちょっと本読も？: Hate to ruin your smart-guy moment, but... that was Tsunayoshi. Maybe read a few more books？
translations.いまさ、秋山先生のセリフ思い出して、ゾクッとしちゃった。: I just remembered one of Professor Akiyama's lines and got chills.
translations.“力”を使うことに\nなんの抵抗も感じない――:
"I'd feel no hesitation
using the power--"
translations.だけど、あのパン屋さんは\n優しいよ――:
"But that baker is
a kind person--"
translations.彼に対して“力”を使うことになんの抵抗も感じない――ってとこ？:
'I'd feel no hesitation at all
using the power on him'—that part？
translations.そう！ ゾクッとした。ねぇねぇ、もう一回やってみ？:
Yeah! It gave me chills.
Hey, say it one more time？
translations.あぁ、あったよね、あれも痺れた、うん。:
Oh, right, there was that line too.
That one gave me chills too, yeah.
translations.それは、ふみちゃんのセリフでしょうが。……ま、泣けちゃったけどね、へへ……:
Come on, that's Fumi-chan's line.
...Well, it did make me cry, hehe...
translations.とうとう決めちゃったってよ？ “条件と罰”……:
Looks like they finally decided
on it, huh？ The 'condition and
punishment'...
translations.あぁ、気になるよな……: Yeah, I'm dying to know what it is...
translations.当てっこ、いっとく？ ほら、お先にどうぞ？:
Want to try guessing？
Go on, you first.
translations.反省しろ、そうでなければ\n死ぬ、とか？:
Repent, or else
you'll die, maybe？
translations.反省しろ、そうでなければ、\nウサギに呪われる、とか？:
Repent, or else you'll
be cursed by rabbits？
translations.反省しろ、そうでなければ、\n一文無しになる、とか？:
Repent, or else you'll
go flat broke, maybe？
translations.反省しろ、そうでなければ死ぬ、とか？: Repent, or else you'll die, maybe？
translations.それは無いな。だって、残酷すぎるって、いつも言ってたじゃん。リンコの予想は教えら:
No way it's that. He kept saying
that'd be too cruel, remember？
And I'm not telling you my guess.
translations.反省しろ、そうでなければ、ウサギに呪われる、とか？:
Repent, or else you'll be cursed
by rabbits, maybe？
translations.なるほど……悪夢をみせて反省させるってやつだね？ あ、リンコの予想はパスで。:
I see... Give him nightmares until
he repents, huh？ Oh, I'll pass on
sharing my guess.
translations.反省しろ、そうでなければ、一文無しになる、とか？:
Repent, or else you'll go flat
broke, maybe？
translations.う～ん……先生は経済封鎖だって言ってたけど。あ、リンコの予想はパスで。:
Hmm... The professor did say his
would be an economic blockade.
Oh, I'll pass on sharing my guess.
translations.うん。先生の方はなんとなく想像ついたけどさ、ぼくの方は……う～ん。:
Yeah. I kind of saw the professor's
coming, but the boy's... hmm.
translations.なんか、罰が甘過ぎるよな？:
Feels like the punishment
is way too light, huh？
translations.心から反省って、曖昧だよな？:
'Sincerely repent' is
pretty vague, isn't it？
translations.人間以外の生き物ってことは、\n植物も入るもんな！:
Living things besides humans
includes plants too!
translations.そうそう。市川雄太が条件を守らないの、目に見えてるもんね？ いいのかな、それで。:
Right, exactly. It's obvious Yuta
Ichikawa won't keep the condition,
right？ Is that really okay...
translations.反省しろって言われて反省しても、意味ないって言ってたしね？ う～ん……:
Plus he said repenting just because
you're told to is meaningless, right？
Hmm...
translations.人間以外の生き物ってことは、植物も入るもんな！:
Living things besides humans
includes plants too!
translations.……ん？ いや、そこはべつにいいかな？ う～ん……:
...Huh？ No, I don't think that part
really matters. Hmm...
translations.また泣かされちゃった、帰りの電車のシーン……:
That scene on the train ride home
made me cry again...
translations.小学生のくせにさ、あんなに全部抱えて独りで決意するんだもん……:
He's just a grade schooler, yet he
takes all that on himself and makes
up his mind all alone...
translations.人間よりウサギの方が\n好きなんて悲しすぎるよな……:
Liking rabbits more than
people is just too sad...
translations.ぼくが明日、あいつに\n罰を与えてくる、ってとこ？:
'Tomorrow, I'm going to
punish him'—that part？
translations.あれは……そんなことないよ、きっと。きっと届いてると思いたいよ……:
About that... I'm sure that's not true.
I want to believe his feelings
reached her...
translations.人間よりウサギの方が好きなんて悲しすぎるよな……:
Liking rabbits more than people
is just too sad...
translations.あぁ、そこも……ウサギ当番より楽しいこと、あんまり無いって言ってたもんね……ヤバ:
Yeah, that part too... He said there
wasn't much he enjoyed more than
rabbit duty... Oh no, I'm tearing up...
translations.ぼくが明日、あいつに罰を与えてくる、ってとこ？:
'Tomorrow, I'm going to punish him'
—that part？
translations.そうそう！ あそこ泣いちゃった……子供のくせに、独りで決意して、お姫様を守ろうと:
Yeah, that's it! That made me cry...
He's just a kid, yet he resolves to
protect his princess all on his own.
translations.ハァ……読み始めからはゼンゼン予想できなかった……: *Sigh*... When I first started reading, I never saw any of this coming...
translations.文句言ってたもんな？ 最初の頃。: You were complaining about it at first, weren't you？
translations.ところで、ラスト間際だしさ、色いろあったけどやっぱり――: Anyway, we're almost at the end now. A lot's happened, but the part that really stands out is—
translations.先生が言った罰、\n気になるよな？:
Curious about the punishment
the doctor mentioned, right？
translations.“ぼく”って\nアタマ良過ぎるよな！:
The narrator is just
way too smart!
translations.病院で先生に告白するところ？:
When he confesses to the
doctor at the hospital？
translations.先生が言った罰、気になるよな？: Curious about the punishment the doctor mentioned, right？
translations.なるなる！ 最後にはわかるのかな？ わかんなかったら眠れなくなっちゃうよね！: Totally! Think we'll find out at the end？ If we don't, I won't be able to sleep tonight!
translations.“ぼく”ってアタマ良過ぎるよな！: The narrator is just way too smart!
translations.そうそう！ しかも無謀でさ、カッコいいの！ 女子なら惚れちゃうよ、あれ。小学生な: I know, right! Plus he's so reckless and cool! Any girl would fall for him. Even if he is still in grade school.
translations.そうそう！ それにまた先生がさ、人はそれでも愛と呼ぶんだって、キザなのに泣けて泣: Yes, that part! And then when the doctor tells him that people still call that love... It's a little corny, but I couldn't stop crying...
translations.お疲れ。あっ、目、赤いぞ？ わかる。実はリンコもちょっと、ね？: Nice work. Oh, your eyes are red, you know？ I don't blame you. Honestly, I teared up a little myself.
translations.うん……リンコももう終わるから、ちょっと待ってて……: Yeah... I'm almost done too, so give me just a second...
translations.「ぼくのメジャースプーン」か……▲小早川＊▲、読み終えてどう？: "My Measuring Spoon," huh... What did you think of it, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.うん……最初はさ、本当に読むの止めようかと思った。: Yeah... At first, I honestly thought about putting it down.
translations.最近の本てさ、無闇にショッキングな事とか、グロテスクにするのが多くてさ。: A lot of books lately just throw in shocking or grotesque stuff for the sake of it.
translations.またかって、思っちゃったの。でもさ、完全にリンコの早とちりだった。一本も二本もと: I figured this was just more of the same. But I totally jumped to conclusions. It really got me good.
translations.一見、普通の青春小説ぽいのに、ビジネス書みたいな対話形式だったり、しかもちゃんと: At first glance it seems like a normal coming-of-age novel, but it's written as a dialogue almost like a business book, and it works as real suspense, too—
translations.それでも、テーマはきっちり普遍的な命題を扱っててさ、登場人物も、みんな魅力的だし: Even so, it tackles universal themes head-on, and all the characters are so compelling... Honestly, it was just a really great read.
translations.なるほど、そういうもんかね……: I see. So that's how you look at it, huh...
translations.こんなの読むとさ、作家になろうなんて気、起こらなくなる。今の自分じゃ絶対書けない: Reading something like this makes me want to give up on ever becoming a writer. There's no way I could write anything like this right now.
translations.……と、作家志望の図書委員、小早川凛子をも唸らせる名著である……: "...A masterpiece that leaves even aspiring writer and library committee member Rinko Kobayakawa in awe..."
translations.本の書評に書いてやる。元気出せよ。: I'll put that in the book review. Cheer up.
translations.えっ、ちょっと……本気！？ やめろっつーの！: Wait, hold on... Are you serious！？ Cut it out!
translations.よし、忘れないうちに書こう！: All right, better write it down before I forget!
translations.うん……簡単に言うと、久々に残りを読むのが惜しくなった本。: Yeah... Put simply, it's the first book in a long time where I didn't want to reach the end.
translations.なるほど、上手くまとめたな。: I see. That's a nice way of summing it up.
translations.ホントだってば。面白い本と出会うとね、いつもそう感じるもん。: I really mean it. Whenever I come across a great book, that's always how I feel.
translations.普遍的なテーマなのに、ちゃんとエンタテインメントになってたり、ミステリーとしてき: It deals with universal themes, yet it's still genuinely entertaining, and as a mystery it ties up all its foreshadowing so neatly.
translations.そういうのも凄いけど、面白いと思う本って、その時の自分に必要なことが書かれてるん: All of that is impressive too, of course, but a book you truly love always has the exact words you need to hear at that moment in your life.
translations.なるほど……今のってさ、書評になりそうだな？: I see... Hey, what you just said would make a pretty good book review, wouldn't it？
translations.でしょ？ 因みに、この本でリンコに一番響いたのはね――: Right？ By the way, the part of this book that resonated with me the most was—
translations.本当に誰かに傷つけられた時、傷を癒す唯一の方法は、自分のために一生懸命になってく: When someone truly hurts you, the only way to heal that wound is to remember that there's someone out there who'll give their all for your sake.
translations.あった。結局、その道を取ったんだよな、主人公は。: Yeah. In the end, that's the path the main character chose.
translations.うん。あぁ、それでリンコは誰かさんに恋しちゃったんだって、思い出しちゃった。: Yeah. Oh, and it reminded me that that's the exact reason I fell in love with a certain someone.
translations.（ここは書評に書けないな……）: (Can't really put that part in the book review...)
translations.うん、まずは……ちゃんと面白いのに、ちゃんと普遍的なテーマを扱ってて、すごいと思: Well, first off... I think it's amazing how it tackles universal themes while still being genuinely entertaining.
translations.でも、リンコが一番すごいと思ったのは……実はラブストーリーにもなってるってとこ。: But what impressed me the most is... how it's actually a love story, too.
translations.だって、話すことも出来ないお姫様に毎日会いに行くんだよ？: I mean, he goes to see a princess who can't even speak every single day, right？
translations.自分のせいで彼女が傷ついたって、守れなかったって。: Thinking it's his fault she got hurt, and that he couldn't protect her.
translations.最後にはとうとう命がけで彼女が愛されてることを証明しようとするんだもん。: And in the end, he even risks his life trying to prove that she's loved.
translations.これってさ、究極の告白だよ。: That's the ultimate confession of love.
translations.なるほどね……面白い解釈だな、それ、書評になりそうだな！: I see... That's an interesting take. I could probably use that for the book review!
translations.もう……あ、もう一つ気付いこと、あるよ？: Jeez... Oh, there's one more thing I realized, you know？
translations.読書って独りでするものだと思ってたけどさ、好きな人と一緒だと、倍楽しいってこと。: I always thought reading was something you do alone, but with someone you like, it's twice as fun. Hehe...
translations.辻村深月、ぼくのメジャースプーン、へぇ……こういうのがいいのか？: "My Measuring Spoon" by Mizuki Tsujimura, huh... So this is a good one？
translations.はい。誰でもぶつかったことのある、命題が説教臭くないストーリーになってて、ゼッタ: Yes. It takes a question everyone's faced and turns it into a story without being preachy. People will definitely enjoy it. Right？
translations.……なんだ？ やっぱり小早川が一枚噛んでるのか？: ...What's this？ Did Kobayakawa have a hand in this after all？
translations.いえ？ わたしは読みたい本を読んだだけですから。彼と。: No？ I just read a book I wanted to read, that's all. With him.
translations.彼と、ね……そりゃご馳走サマ。まあ、お疲れさん！ 心して書評を読ませてもらうぞ。: "With him," huh... Well, aren't you two sweet. Anyway, good work! I'll be sure to give this review a proper read.
translations.ハァ～～！ やり遂げたって感じだな！ ▲小早川＊▲のお陰だよ。: Phew~! Really feels like we accomplished something! And it's all thanks to you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.だ、か、ら、リンコは、一緒に読んだだけじゃん。: Like I keep saying, all I did was read it with you.
translations.でもさ、やっぱりいい選択だったよ。共感するヤツ多いんじゃないか？ ぼくのメジャー: Still, it really was a great choice. I bet a lot of people will relate to "My Measuring Spoon."
translations.うん、普段はふざけててもさ、心のどっかでは、みんな真面目に考えてるもんね。: Yeah. Even if people joke around most of the time, deep down, everyone thinks seriously about that stuff.
translations.そうだな。書評でうまくそれが伝わるといいんだけどな。: True. I just hope my review gets that across.
translations.大丈夫。なかなかいい書評だと思う。: It'll be fine. I think it's a pretty good review.
translations.これを書いた人は、すごく共感できたって伝わってくるもん。いい文章だよ。: You can really tell how much the person who wrote it connected with the book. It's well written.
translations.▲小早川＊▲にそう言われると、自信出てくるな。: Hearing that from you gives me some confidence, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.じゃあさ……図書委員カップル推薦って書いちゃおっか？ へへ……: Then... maybe we should put "Recommended by the Library Committee Couple" on it？ Hehe...
translations.ちょっ、冗談だって！ そんな恥ずかしいこと書いたらゼッタイコロス！ わかった？: W-Wait, I was kidding! If you write something that embarrassing, I'll seriously kill you! Got it？
translations.え？ えぇと、まあ……だよな、▲小早川＊▲？: Huh？ Uh, well... It is, right, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.なんだ、小早川にやらせたのか？ まあ、小早川なら間違い無いけど……: What, did you make Kobayakawa do it for you？ Well, if it's Kobayakawa, I'm sure it's solid, but...
translations.仕方ない奴だな……小早川、お疲れさん。: What am I going to do with you... Good work, Kobayakawa.
translations.ハァ……結局、最初から最後まで▲小早川＊▲に頼っちゃったな。: Sigh... In the end, I relied on you from start to finish, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そうそう。どうかと思うよ？ 彼女に課題やらせるのって。: You sure did. Making your girlfriend do your assignment for you is pretty questionable, you know？
translations.それに、バカ正直に白状してさ？ 自分が書いたことにして黙ってりゃいいのに。: Plus, why'd you go and confess like an honest idiot？ You should've just stayed quiet and said you wrote it.
translations.それは、さすがにな。彼氏として、無いだろ。: I couldn't do that. What kind of boyfriend would I be？
translations.また、変な意地張っちゃって。よし、じゃあ……: There you go being stubborn over weird things again. All right, then...
translations.アンタはぼくのメジャースプーンを最後まで読みなさい、そうでなければ――: You must read My Measuring Spoon to the very end, or else—
translations.この先、ぼくのメジャースプーンを読めなくなる。: From here on out, you will never be able to read My Measuring Spoon again.
translations.あの本を最後まで読めばわかります。: You'll understand once you read the book to the end.
translations.本ってね、読まされるものじゃなくて、その人が必要なときに読むことになるものなんだ: Books aren't something you're forced to read. They're something you end up reading when you need them.
translations.リンコはそう思ってんの。だから、これでよし。: That's what I think, anyway. So this works out.
translations.（●もまた気が向いたときに、読んでみるかな……）: (Maybe ● will try reading it again when the mood strikes...)
translations.へえ、そういうことか……。: Huh, so that's what's going on...
translations.出た、“心の闇”。ハァ……。: There it is, 'darkness in the heart.' *Sigh*...
translations.えぇ、ちょっと…… やだよ、こういうの……。: Ugh, wait... I hate this kind of stuff...
translations.うわぁ……なにコイツら……。: Ugh... What is wrong with these people...？
translations.ハァ……正直キツくなって来た……。: *Sigh*... Honestly, this is getting hard to read...
translations.いい感じ、面白くなってきたかも！: Nice, this is actually getting pretty good!
translations.ちょっと先生、そんなこと言われちゃあ……。: Come on, Sensei, when you put it like that...
translations.また、引っ張るね～。: Really dragging out the suspense, huh...
translations.先生ってさ、案外恐い人だよね……。: Sensei's actually kind of scary, huh...
translations.自分のために一生懸命になった人間がいること……。: Knowing there's someone who gave their all for your sake...
translations.ん？ん？ ……罰になってる？: Hm？ Wait... Is that really a punishment？
translations.お母さん、いい人じゃん……うん。: Hey, the mom's a good person... Yeah.
translations.ん？ ……見えなくなる？ と……あ、そうか！ アタマいいな。: Hm？ ...Can't see it anymore？ Which means... Oh, I get it! Pretty smart.
translations.来た、市川だ……緊張……。: Oh, here comes Ichikawa... Now I'm nervous...
translations.えぇーっ！？ ちょ、全然違うじゃん！ ――あ、ゴメン……。でも、えぇ～……。: Whaaat!？ Wait, that's completely different! ...Oh, sorry. But still, come on...
translations.ちょっとちょっと、えぇ～……罰は？: Hold on, wait... What about the punishment？
translations.グスッ……いいなこの言葉……。: Sniff... That's such a nice line...
translations.グスッ……もう、先生ずるい……。: Sniff... Come on, Sensei, that's not fair...
translations.▲小早川＊▲ってロックとかパンクとか好きじゃん。: You're into rock and punk and stuff, right, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ロックとかパンクとかってくくりに突っ込みたいけど……で、なに？: I've got an issue with you lumping rock and punk together like that, but... what about it？
translations.自分でやったりはしないんだな、バンドとか。: You don't play in a band or anything yourself, huh.
translations.そっか、楽器とか興味ないのか？: I see. Just not interested in playing instruments？
translations.前に言ったかもしれないけど……昔ギター買ったけど、すぐやめちゃったの。: I might've mentioned this before, but... I bought a guitar a while back and gave up pretty much right away.
translations.なんかきっかけがあれば、またやってみたいんだけど……。: If I had a good reason to start again, I'd like to give it another try, though...
translations.へえ、そういうもんか。: Huh, is that how it is.
translations.はあ、今日も平和だね……。: Sigh... Nice and peaceful again today...
translations.平和なのはいいけど、サボんなって。今日利用者多いぞ。: Peaceful is great and all, but don't slack off. Lots of people using the library today.
translations.はいはい、ボチボチね。: Yeah, yeah. I'll get to it.
translations.あなたが仕事しない分ねえ、私に迷惑かかるのよ……。: Every bit of work you don't do just makes more trouble for me...
translations.先輩もですよ……さっきから小早川さんと喋ってるだけじゃないですか……。: That goes for you too... All you've been doing is chatting with Kobayakawa...
translations.ああもう、わかったって。行きますよ。: Ugh, fine, I get it. I'm going.
translations.あのさ、言いたいことあるなら言えばいいじゃん。: Look, if you have something to say, why don't you just say it？
translations.……い、言いたいこと!? ……なによそんなの……な、ないわよ……忌々しい……。: ...S-Something to say!? ...What's that supposed to mean... I-I don't... How detestable...
translations.あの……えっと……待ってる人がいるから……みんな仕事を……ごめんなさい……。: Um... well... there's someone waiting, so... everyone should get back to work... I'm sorry...
translations.すいませーん！ 受付お願いしたいんですけどー！: Excuse me! Can I get some help at the desk？
translations.これだから……アンタたちのせいで……忌々しい……。: See...? It's all your fault... Detestable...
translations.（なんか混んできたな……図書室が盛況とか、この学校真面目なのか不真面目なのか……: (Getting pretty crowded in here... A packed library？ I can't tell if this school is studious or what...)
translations.あ～、センパイもどうも。えっと、最近リンコとどうですか？: Oh, hey there! So, how've things been with Rinko lately？
translations.いやー、どうって……そりゃな？: Well, you know... Pretty good, right？
translations.ちょっと、余計なこと言わないでよ？: Hey, don't go saying anything unnecessary, okay？
translations.余計なことって……恋人同士の色々、とか？: Unnecessary？ Like... all the couple stuff we do？
translations.へえ、仲よさそう。: Huh, looks like you two are getting along great.
translations.あ、えっと……どうしよう……えっと……。: Ah, um... What do I do... Um...
translations.あ、原ちんいたいた。図書室だって聞いたからさー、探しちゃった♪: Oh, there you are, Hara! Heard you were in the library, so we came looking for you♪
translations.ねえ、ねえ、あの子さ……ザ・図書委員って感じじゃない？: Hey, look at that girl... Doesn't she just scream 'library committee'？
translations.ほら、メガネ分厚くって～スカート長くて～みつあみで～って感じじゃん？: Like, look—thick glasses, long skirt, braided hair, the whole deal, right？
translations.ご、ごめんなさい……あ、あの、あんまり騒ぐと……。: I-I'm sorry... U-Um, if you make too much noise...
translations.うわ、背高っ。なんか迫力あるんですけど……。: Whoa, she's huge. Kinda intimidating, honestly...
translations.ご、ごめんなさい……えっと、あの……ごめんなさい……。: I-I'm sorry... Um, er... I'm really sorry...
translations.あのさ……ね、もう行こうよ？: Hey... come on, let's just go already, okay？
translations.ちょっと、図書室で騒がないでくれる。: Hey. Could you not make a racket in the library？
translations.あれ、原ちんって小早川……さんと仲いいんだっけ。: Wait, Hara, are you friends with... Kobayakawa？
translations.えっと、そうじゃなくて。……リンコはいいんだけど……最近のリンコの友達、ちょっと:
Um, that's not what I meant.
...Rinko's fine, it's just...
her friends lately are kind
of gloomy, I guess...
translations.おーい、何やってんだー。図書室では静粛に！:
Hey, what's going on over
here! Quiet in the library!
translations.お前らも、一緒になって騒いじゃいかんだろ。:
You guys shouldn't join in
and make a racket either.
translations.ああもう、腹立つ……。: Ugh, that makes me so mad...
translations.それって……この前の図書室のアレか？:
You mean... that thing in
the library the other day？
translations.▲小早川＊▲の友達の……原ちゃんだっけ。:
That friend of yours, ▲小早川＊▲...
Hara-chan, was it？
translations.あんなに薄情だとは思わなかった。ギャルたちと一緒になってさ！:
I didn't think she was so
cold. Laughing along with
those girls like that!
translations.……友達からあんな風にバカにされたら……悔しいじゃん。:
...Getting mocked like that
by a friend... really stings.
translations.原ちゃんがあんな風に思ってるなんて……知らなかった。:
I had no idea Hara-chan felt
that way...
translations.あの子もギャル友達の手前、色々あるんだよ。きっと……な？:
She was probably just trying
to save face in front of her
friends. You know？
translations.（ケンカとかにならなきゃいいけど……）:
(I hope this doesn't turn
into a fight or anything...)
translations.（さて、今日も図書委員だ！）:
(All right, time for library
duty again today!)
translations.（みんな、なんか暗いな……前のこと気にしてるのか……）:
(Everyone seems so down...
Are they still bothered by
what happened before...？)
translations.担任、ひどいよね。教室に残ってダベるとか、普通じゃない？:
Our homeroom teacher is the
worst. Staying after to chat
in class is normal, right？
translations.そうそう、なんでウチらが追い出されるかわかんないですけどー。:
Totally! I don't get why we
had to get kicked out.
translations.アハハハ！ キャラじゃないし！: Ahahaha! That is so not you!
translations.あ、あの。ご、ごめんなさい……もう少しその……。:
U-Um. I-I'm sorry... Could
you keep it down a little...
translations.あの。図書室はみんなが使う場所なんで、静かにしてもらえない？:
Excuse me. Everyone uses the
library, so could you please
keep it down？
translations.みんなが使うなら、ウチらだっていていいじゃん。:
If everyone uses it, then we
can be here too, right？
translations.権利があるし！: Yeah, we have a right to!
translations.だから静かにしろって言ってるんだっつーの。アンタたちのうるさいおしゃべりは読書の:
That's why I'm telling you to
be quiet! Your loud chatting
is bothering people trying to
read! Don't you get that？
translations.えっと……ほら、ここにずっといるのもなんだし、カラオケでも行っとく？:
Um... Hey, no point staying
here forever anyway. Wanna go
do karaoke or something？
translations.はあ、今日は面倒なことにはなんなかったな。:
Phew, at least things didn't
get out of hand today.
translations.ねえ、二人とも、悔しくないわけ？ ナメられっぱなしで。:
Hey, doesn't that frustrate
you two？ Letting them walk
all over us like that.
translations.私は特に……気にしなければいいだけだから……。: Not really... I just try not to let it bother me...
translations.ああもう、アンタたちはやり返してやろう！ って気にならないわけ？ こう、ロックの: Ugh, seriously! Don't you guys want to get back at them？ Where's your rock 'n' roll soul!？
translations.図書委員は暗くて弱い！ なんて、勝手な思い込みなんだからさ、それを覆すようなもの: People just assume the library committee is gloomy and weak! We should show them something that proves them totally wrong!
translations.それがロックの魂なのか？ 音楽やるってこと？: Is that what a rock 'n' roll soul is？ Wait, you mean playing music？
translations.そうじゃなくて……ロックってのは意識の話！: That's not what I mean... Rock is a state of mind!
translations.……あ、んー……でも音楽ってのは悪くないかもね……音楽……ロック……バンドとか？: ...Wait, hmm... Actually, music might not be a bad idea... Music... rock... Maybe a band？
translations.そう……バンド！ いいかも！: Yeah... a band! That could work!
translations.▲小早川＊▲、待って。どうした、長倉。: Hold on, ▲小早川＊▲. What is it, Nagakura？
translations.ご、ごめんなさい……ロックじゃないけど……私、中学の時、吹奏楽部でドラムやってた: I-I'm sorry... It's not rock, but... I played drums in the brass band back in middle school...
translations.マジ？ 見かけによらないっていうか……。あ、ニューミュージックとか？: Seriously？ I wouldn't have guessed by looking at you... Oh, like folk-pop or something？
translations.関係ないじゃん、そんなの。感じ悪い。: What does that have to do with anything？ Way to be rude.
translations.まあまあ！ にしてもみんな楽器経験あるんだな、すげーじゃん！: Now, now! Still, you all have experience playing instruments. That's awesome!
translations.できるんでしょうね、えらそうなこと言ってるんだから。: I'm sure she can, seeing how big she's talking.
translations.なんとかなるって！ よーし……じゃあ決まり！: We'll make it work! Alright... then it's settled!
translations.なあ……バンドやろうぜ！ って本気なのか？: Hey... Were you serious about starting a band？
translations.当たり前じゃん。原ちゃんたちのこと、びっくりさせてやるんだから！: Obviously. We're gonna totally shock Hara-chan and her friends!
translations.びっくりさせるため……って、それって楽しいのか？: Just to shock them...？ Is that even gonna be fun？
translations.楽しいだけでパンクができるかっつーの。: You think you can play punk just by having fun？
translations.パンクなんだ……パンクって、楽しくないのか？: Oh, so it's punk... Wait, is punk not fun？
translations.そうじゃないけど……音楽にはね、精神性が必要なの。精神性。: That's not it, but... Music takes spirit, you know？ Spirit.
translations.よくわかんないけど……。: I don't really get it, but...
translations.あーもう、腹立つ！ って気持ちを、音楽にぶつけるの。: You take that 'Ugh, I'm so ticked off!' feeling and slam it right into the music.
translations.（そういや。前に▲小早川＊▲が言ってたバンドの話、どうするんだろ……）: (Come to think of it, I wonder what's happening with that band ▲小早川＊▲ mentioned before...)
translations.はい！ じゃあ、バンドのミーティングするからメンバー集まって！: All right! We're having a band meeting, so gather round, everyone!
translations.アンタも当事者なんだから、同席すんの。: You're part of this too, so sit down and join us.
translations.あの……バンドって言ってもどんな？: Um... What kind of band are we talking about？
translations.だってリンコ……アタシが言い出したんだし……。: Because Rinko... I mean, I'm the one who brought it up...
translations.あっと！ そうじゃなくて、ほら、色々考えたんすけど……やっぱりパンクかなって。: Ack! I mean, no, look—I thought about it a lot, and... I figured it really has to be punk.
translations.私、ささだまさしげしか弾いたことないんだけど。: I've only ever played Sasada Masashige, though.
translations.ああ、そっか。ギターって、そういうアレか……。: Oh, right. So by guitar, you meant that kind of...
translations.なによ……ささだまさしげは、く、暗くないわよ！: What's that supposed to mean...？ Sasada Masashige is n-not gloomy!
translations.あ、あの……パンクって、ロックやメタルとは違うの？: U-Um... Is punk different from rock or metal？
translations.違うかって？\n全然違うでしょ、いい？\nそもそもパンクってのは――:
Different？
It's totally different! Listen,
the whole point of punk is—
translations.ストップ！ その説明はいいから。: Stop! You can skip the lecture.
translations.ご、ごめんなさい……私が余計なこと……。: I-I'm sorry... I shouldn't have asked...
translations.ねえ、そのパンクとやらをやるとして……色々決めないといけないんじゃないの？: Hey, assuming we're doing this "punk" thing... don't we have a lot to figure out first？
translations.（……二人とも、意外とやる気？）: (...Are the two of them actually into this？)
translations.ボーカルはどうするの？ 小早川さんがやる？: What are we doing about vocals？ Are you going to sing, Kobayakawa？
translations.うーん……それも悪くないけど……弾きながらはちょっと……。: Hmm... That wouldn't be bad, but... singing while playing is a bit much...
translations.それに、パンクなんだから、やっぱり男ボーカルでしょ。: Besides, this is punk we're talking about, so we really need a guy on vocals.
translations.へえ、ガールズバンドでボーカルだけ男ってことか！: Oh, so an all-girl band with just a guy on vocals!
translations.そうそう。それにせっかくだし、メンバーは図書委員でそろえたいよね。: Yeah, exactly. Plus, while we're at it, we might as well keep the lineup all library committee members.
translations.なんか文学的じゃん。知的で破壊的なパンク、クールじゃん。: It feels kinda literary, you know？ Intellectual, destructive punk—pretty cool, right？
translations.……破壊的ってなんなのよ……。: ...What do you even mean by destructive...？
translations.ご、ごめんなさい……。よくわからないけど……。: I-I'm sorry... I don't really get it, though...
translations.わかんないならいいや。誰かいないかな、図書委員で暇そうな男。: Never mind if you don't get it. Now, is there any guy on the library committee who looks like he's got free time？
translations.図書委員で、暇そうな男ね……。: A guy on the library committee with free time on his hands, huh...
translations.恋人同士でバンドって……忌々しい……。: A couple in a band together... How sickening...
translations.いいんじゃないのかな……知らない人を探すより、気楽だし。話したこともない男の人な: I think it's a good idea... It's a lot less stressful than looking for a stranger. A guy I've never even talked to would be...
translations.（……このメンバーでバンド……大丈夫か？）:
(A band with this lineup...
Is this really gonna work？)
translations.なに。所信表明？:
What？ Ready to give a
speech on your resolve？
translations.違うよ。ほんとに●でいいのか？:
No. Are you really sure
about ●？
translations.ちょっと。決まったことに対して文句言わないでよ。:
Hey. Don't complain after
it's already been decided.
translations.アンタもこれからパンクスなんだから、ビシっとしてよ。:
You're a punk now too, so
get it together.
translations.パンクスねえ……にしてもさ？:
A punk, huh... Even so,
though？
translations.なんで、あの二人にあんな絡むんだ？ ちょっと珍しいよな、▲小早川＊▲にしては。:
Why're you getting so
involved with those two？
It's kinda unusual for you,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ああ、だって二人とも言いたいこと言わないし。こっちが黙ってると、なに考えてるかわ:
Well, neither of them ever
speaks their mind. If I stay
quiet, I'll never know what
they're thinking.
translations.ああいうの見てると、自分を思い出すっていうか……さ。:
Watching them kinda reminds
me of myself, I guess...
translations.さて、バンド会議をはじめるよ。:
All right, let's start the
band meeting.
translations.いきなりだな！ ……たしかに暇だけど。:
Well that's sudden! ...Not
that I'm busy, though.
translations.なんなのよ……なんでアンタが仕切ってるのよ……。:
What's your deal...？ Why
are you calling the shots...？
translations.なに、文句ある？ 言い出したのアタシだし。:
What, got a problem with
that？ It was my idea.
translations.別にアンタが仕切ってもいいけど？:
I mean, you can take charge
if you want？
translations.ご、ごめんなさい……あの、二人とも怒らないで……。:
I-I'm sorry... Um, please
don't get mad, you two...
translations.まずはパート決めかな。誰がどの楽器を担当するか。:
First, let's assign parts.
Who plays which instrument.
translations.言ったじゃない……私、ギターをやってたのよ……。:
I told you already...
I used to play guitar...
translations.いいじゃん、アコギしか弾けないんでしょ。だったら同じだって。:
So what？ You only play
acoustic anyway. It's pretty
much the same thing.
translations.おい、▲小早川＊▲。それじゃ佐々木さんが……。:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. That's a little
unfair to Sasaki...
translations.ほら、やってくれるってさ。: See？ She says she'll do it.
translations.で、バンドの目標は「ロンドンミリオンクラブでライブ！」:
And our band's goal is:
"Play live at the London
Million Club!"
translations.なんなのよ……真面目に考えなさいよ……。:
What the heck... Take this
seriously...
translations.わかってるっつーの。まあ、無難に近所のハコでやっとく？:
I know, I know. Well, wanna
play it safe and do a show
at a local joint？
translations.ライブハウス。行ったことくらいありません？: A music club. Haven't you at least been to one？
translations.佐々木さんは……ないよね。: And Sasaki... I take it you haven't either.
translations.はい。ない、と。: Right. Put you down for a no.
translations.まあまあ！ つってもライブハウスって……なんだかハードル高くないか？ お金払って: Now, now! Still, playing at a club... isn't that setting the bar kind of high？ People actually pay to come watch, right？
translations.イヤ！ そんなの絶対無理……絶対無理……。: No way! I could never do that... Never in a million years...
translations.無理に決まってるじゃない！: Of course it's out of the question!
translations.そ、そう？ やってみたかったんだけど……たしかに厳しいかな。: Y-You think so？ I wanted to give it a shot, though... Yeah, maybe that's a bit much.
translations.あ……そういえば、軽音楽部の友達が言ってたけど……。: Oh... Come to think of it, my friend in the Light Music Club mentioned something...
translations.ウチの軽音楽部、定期的に講堂で演奏会をしてて……たまにだけど、部に属してない個人: Our Light Music Club puts on regular concerts in the auditorium... and she said every now and then, they let independent bands from outside the club perform too...
translations.へえ、そういえばそんなのやってたような。: Huh. Now that you mention it, I think I have seen them doing that.
translations.それくらいなら……。: If it's just something like that...
translations.うーん、校内の軽音イベントかあ……。: Hmm, a school music club event, huh...
translations.なんでそんな不満そうなんだよ。: Why do you sound so disappointed？
translations.だって～、しょっぱいなあ……。: Come on, it's just so small-time...
translations.バンドやったことない●らにはちょうどいいだろ。: You and the others have never been in a band before, ●, so isn't that just about right？
translations.ギャルどもに見せつけるには校内の方が都合がいいかも……うん、いいじゃん！: Playing at school might actually work better for showing up those flashy girls... Yeah, I like it!
translations.目標決定！ アタシたちは軽音部のライブイベントに出るよ！: Then that's our goal! We're gonna play at the Light Music Club's live show!
translations.なんなのよ、なんでそんなに自信満々なのよ……。: What is with you？ Why are you suddenly so confident...？
translations.（軽音のイベントかあ……面白そうだな！）: (A Light Music Club event, huh... Sounds like fun!)
translations.（あれ……あそこにいるの、▲小早川＊▲と……）: (Huh...？ Over there, isn't that ▲小早川＊▲ and...)
translations.ねえ、リンコさ。最近……なんか付き合い悪くない？: Hey, Rinko. You haven't really been hanging out with me lately, have you？
translations.ん……ちょっと、新しいこと始めたから。: Mm... I just started something new, that's all.
translations.へえ、かっこいいじゃん。軽音でも入ったの？: Whoa, that's cool. Did you join the Light Music Club or something？
translations.ううん、図書委員のみんなと。: No, I'm doing it with the others on the library committee.
translations.……ねえ、リンコ。この前のこと……。ほら、図書室で。: ...Hey, Rinko. About the other day... You know, in the library.
translations.……思うんだけどさ……ああいうギャルっぽい子達、原ちゃんには合わないと思うんだよ: ...You know, I really don't think flashy girls like them are your type of crowd, Hara.
translations.うーん。話してみるといい子だし、リンコも友達になってみれば？: Hmm. They're actually really nice once you talk to them. Why don't you try making friends with them too, Rinko？
translations.忘れ物？ 取りにかえるか？: Forgot something？ Want to go back for it？
translations.違うっつーの、バンドの話。バンド名！: No, not that. I mean the band. Our band name!
translations.バンド名？ ああ、そういえば……そういうの、決めるんだ。: A band name？ Oh, right... We have to come up with one of those.
translations.当然でしょ。優れたバンドは名前もクールなもんだよ。: Obviously. Every great band has a cool name.
translations.へえ。じゃあ、またみんなで会議して決めるか？: I see. Should we all get together and decide on one？
translations.うーん、そういうのってさ、大人数で話し合ってもなかなか決まらないと思うんだよね。: Hmm, when too many people try to talk something like that over, it takes forever to settle on anything.
translations.そりゃそうかもしれないけど、ちょっとくらいはみんなの――: Maybe so, but shouldn't we at least ask everyone—
translations.イメージはあるんだよね。でもこう、も一つカチッとハマらないっつーかぁ……ヘヘヘ。: I already have a rough idea. It just hasn't quite clicked into place yet... Hehehe.
translations.（自分で決めたいんだな……）: (She just wants to pick it herself...)
translations.ねえ、色々考えてきたんだけど。: Hey, I came up with a few ideas.
translations.バンド名。ほら、書いてきた。この中だったらどれがいい？: Our band name. Look, I wrote them down. Which of these do you like best？
translations.この中なら……▲バンド＊▲かな！: Out of these... I'd go with ▲バンド＊▲!
translations.イン・ザ・ライ……か。うん、やっぱりね。だよね！: In the Rye, huh... Yeah, I knew it. Right？
translations.ザ・ダダ？ そう来たか……まあ、いいか。: The Dada？ Going with that one, huh... Well, works for me.
translations.十羽野ライブラリアンズ？ それ捨て案だったんだけど……ま、いっか。: Towano Librarians？ That one was just filler, though... Well, whatever.
translations.リンコ＆ザ・ステューピッド!?\n……こういうのもアリなんだ？\nまあ……いっか:
Rinko & The Stupid!？
...You're okay with that？
Well... fine by me.
translations.（●たちだけで決めていいのかな……）: (Is it really okay for just her and ● to decide this on our own...？)
translations.さて、待たせたね。アタシから重要な発表があります。: All right, sorry to keep you waiting. I have an important announcement to make.
translations.なんなのよ、いきなり。: What's this all of a sudden？
translations.バンド名が決定しました。: Our band name has been decided.
translations.ちょっと待ちなさいよ、なんでそんなこと勝手に決めるわけ。: Hold on a second! Why are you just deciding that on your own？
translations.なんでアンタが決めんのよ……長倉先輩、なんか言ってやってよ……。: Why do you get to decide...？ Nagakura-senpai, say something to her...
translations.私？ えっと、その、私は特に……ご、ごめんなさい……。: Me？ Um, well, I don't really mind... I-I'm sorry...
translations.ほら、長倉先輩もこう言ってるし……アンタだって賛成してくれたじゃん。: See, Nagakura-senpai's fine with it... And you agreed too, didn't you？
translations.●？ 賛成っていうか……。: ●？ I wouldn't really call that agreeing...
translations.……これだからカレシ持ちは……恋人同士でバンド？ おめでたいのよ……なんなのよ…: ...Girls with boyfriends, I swear... A band with your lover？ Good for you... What even is this... Ugh, how infuriating...
translations.う……ああもう、いいでしょ。: Ugh... Oh, whatever, just hear me out.
translations.バンド名はイン・ザ・ライ！: Our band name is In the Rye!
translations.バンド名はザ・ダダ！: Our band name is The Dada!
translations.バンド名は十羽野ライブラリアンズ！: Our band name is The Towano Librarians!
translations.バンド名はリンコ＆ザ・ステューピッド！: Our band name is Rinko & The Stupid!
translations.ふんっ、じゃあ次は私ね？ 実は私も考えて――: Hmph. Then it's my turn next, right？ Actually, I thought of one too—
translations.その名前……いいかも……。: That name... I kind of like it...
translations.……なんなのよ……忌々しい……。: ...What is with you guys... How infuriating...
translations.楽器とかってどうすればいいんだ？ ●はいいけど……みんなはさ。: What should we do about instruments and stuff？ ● is fine, but... what about everyone else？
translations.ご、ごめんなさい……私、ドラムセットは持ってない……学校のを使わせてもらえないか: I-I'm sorry... I don't own a drum set... I wonder if the school would let us use theirs...
translations.私もベースなんて持ってないわよ。: I don't have a bass either, you know.
translations.はあ!? そんな簡単に言わないでよ！: Huh!? Don't just say that like it's nothing!
translations.大丈夫だって、安いのもあるじゃん。機材にこだわらないのがパンクだよ。: It'll be fine, they make cheap ones too. Not fussing over gear is what punk's all about.
translations.だから知らないわよパンクなんて……。: I keep telling you, I don't know anything about punk...
translations.ベース……たしか兄貴がボロボロの持ってたはず……ぶつぶつ……。: A bass... I think my brother had a beat-up old one somewhere... mutter, mutter...
translations.ああ、それなんだけど、ちょっと付き合ってよ。: Oh, about that—come with me for a bit.
translations.そっか、そういえばギター持ってるって言ってたもんな。: Right, now that I think about it, you did say you had a guitar.
translations.そう。まあ長い間ほうっておいたから、メンテした方がいいかなって。: Yeah. Well, I left it sitting around for a long time, so I figured it could use a tune-up.
translations.よし。じゃあまずは●に見せてもらおうか！: All right. Then let ● take a look at it first!
translations.張り切んなっつーの、ギターのことわかるの？: Don't get all worked up. Do you even know anything about guitars？
translations.えーと……特に電気系統は問題なさそうですね、若干ガリがありますけど、すぐ直ります: Let's see... The electronics look fine. The pots are a little scratchy, but that's an easy fix.
translations.フレットはほとんど減ってないですし、ネックが少し順反ってますけど……ロッド回して: The frets have barely any wear. The neck has a slight forward bow, though... I'll adjust the truss rod for you.
translations.順……あ、ああ、やっぱり？ だと思ったんだ！: Forward... Oh, yeah, really？ Just what I thought!
translations.はい、ではお預かりして。出来上がりは――: All right, I'll hold on to it for you then. It'll be ready on—
translations.んー、なんかバンドマンって感じだな！ 何言ってるのかよくわかんなかったけど！: Man, makes me feel like I'm really in a band! Even if I barely understood a word he said!
translations.まだなんにもしてないっつーの…………へへ、でも楽しみ。: We haven't even done anything yet... Hehe, I'm looking forward to it, though.
translations.（ほんとに楽しそうだな……●もがんばるぞ！）: (She really looks like she's having fun... ● is gonna give it everything too!)
translations.（さて、今日もバンドマンだ！）: (All right, back to band duty today!)
translations.なあ、そういえばさ。: Hey, come to think of it.
translations.バンド活動って具体的にどうすりゃいいんだ？ ほら、練習場所とかさ。: How does being in a band actually work？ Like, where do we practice and stuff？
translations.へへ、そこはぬかりないよ。: Hehe, I've already got that covered.
translations.あ、先生。どうでした？: Oh, Sensei. How did it go？
translations.ああ、ＯＫもらってきたぞ。軽音部も毎日使ってるわけじゃないから、空いてる日は自由: Yeah, I got the okay. The light music club doesn't use it every day, so you're free to use it on their off days.
translations.ただ、委員の仕事の方もしっかりな。: Just make sure you keep up with your committee work, too.
translations.やれやれ。まあこれがやる気に繋がってくれれば……。: Good grief. Well, if this gets her motivated...
translations.軽音部が練習に使ってる音楽室、ウチのバンドで使わせてもらえるように先生に頼んでも: I had Sensei ask if our band could borrow the music room the light music club uses for practice.
translations.いつの間に……。: When did you set that up...？
translations.へへ、こういうのはスピードが大切だからね。: Hehe, you've gotta move fast with stuff like this.
translations.楽器持って突っ立ってるだけじゃ、何もできないでしょうが……。: We won't get anywhere just standing around holding our instruments...
translations.えっと……曲はどうすればいいのか……。: Um... What are we doing for a song...？
translations.曲？ ああ、曲ね……えぇと、まずは思い思いに音出ししてみよっか？ はい！: A song？ Oh, right, a song... Um, first off, how about we all just warm up and play whatever？ Okay, go!
translations.忘れてたくせに、ククッ……。: Like you didn't just forget... Hehe...
translations.お、終わったら曲についてミーティング！ ……するつもりだったから。: W-we're having a song meeting right after! ...That was the plan all along.
translations.そんなことだと思ったのよ……カップルバンドなんて……ハァ～ア……。: I knew it'd be like this... A couple's band, seriously... *Sigh*...
translations.だ、大丈夫……なのかな……。: I-is this going to be okay...？
translations.ハア、そんなことも忘れてたなんて……。: *Sigh* I can't believe you forgot something that basic...
translations.違うっつーの！ まずは全員で音を出して、手ごたえを感じたかったの！: I didn't forget! I just wanted us all to make some noise first and get a feel for it!
translations.ジャレないでよ……忌々しい……。: Quit flirting... You make me sick...
translations.そうかな。ちょっと……うらやましくない？: Really？ I'm kind of... jealous, aren't you？
translations.コホン！ やっぱりさ、やるならオリジナルがいいよね。: Ahem! Anyway, if we're gonna do this, we should do an original song.
translations.また無茶なことを……。: Now you're asking for something crazy again...
translations.カバーじゃないの？ そんなの、誰が作るのよ……。: Not a cover？ Who's supposed to write it, then...？
translations.長倉先輩、吹奏楽部だったんでしょ？ 曲とか作れないんすか？: Nagakura-senpai, you were in the brass band, right？ Can't you write songs or something？
translations.わ、私!? ごめんなさい……そういうのは全然……ごめんなさい……。: M-me!? I'm sorry... I don't know the first thing about that... I'm sorry...
translations.いいっすよ。じゃあアンタは……。: It's fine, really. Then what about you...？
translations.無理か。じゃあ佐々木さんは？: Yeah, no way. What about you, Sasaki-san？
translations.私だって、やったことないわよ……作曲なんて。:
I've never written music
before either...
translations.えー、って何よ……ギター弾くだけじゃなくてちょっと作ってみたいって……興味はあっ:
What's that reaction for...？
I mean, I was curious about
writing a little instead of
just playing guitar, sure...
translations.マジ!? いけるいける！:
Seriously！？ You can totally
pull it off！
translations.大丈夫大丈夫、佐々木さん成績いいし、勉強熱心じゃん。作曲も勉強すれば、簡単にでき:
You'll be fine！ You get good
grades, Sasaki, and study hard.
If you study songwriting too,
it'll be easy, won't it？
translations.参考文献として、パンクの名盤一通り貸すからさ！ ね、お願い！:
I'll lend you all the classic
punk albums for reference！
Come on, please！
translations.お願いって……アンタがやりたいんでしょ？ やればいいじゃない……。:
'Please'...？ You're the one
who wants to do it, right？
Why don't you write it...？
translations.……と思って、ちょっと試してみたんだけど……全然上手くいかなくて……。:
...That's what I thought,
so I gave it a little try...
and it went terribly...
translations.でさ、後でアタシに作曲の仕方教えてくれないかなーって……。:
So I was hoping maybe you
could teach me how to write
songs later...
translations.……ああ、そういうこと…………ククッ、いいわよ……。:
...Oh, so that's your angle...
...Heh heh, fine...
translations.でも、アンタには教えない……私の作った曲でやってもらうわよ……。:
But I'm not teaching you...
We're going to play the song
that I write...
translations.まあ、さすがに虫がよすぎだろ。:
Well, you were asking for
a bit much there.
translations.ああもう、わかった！ でも詞は絶対アタシが書くから！:
Ugh, fine, I get it！
But I'm definitely writing
the lyrics！
translations.あれから、ちょっと避けちゃってさ。ゴメン。:
I kind of avoided you
after what happened. Sorry.
translations.あのあとすぐ思い返してさ、なんかゴメン……原ちゃん、悪くないのにね。:
I thought about it right after,
and I felt bad... It wasn't
even your fault, Hara.
translations.……とにかく、そんな理由で原ちゃんとも仲悪くなるの、イヤだし。:
...Anyway, I'd hate for things
to get weird between us over
something like that.
translations.あの子達だって、付き合ってみるといい子なんだけどな……。:
Those girls are actually
pretty nice once you get
to know them, though...
translations.それは、やっぱり……さ。ちょっとダメかも。:
Yeah, about that...
I don't think I can.
translations.そっかあ、でもわかった。とにかく、仲直り。:
I see... Okay, I get it.
Anyway, we're good now.
translations.（まだちょっとギクシャクしてる気もするけど……）:
(Seems like things are still
a bit awkward between them...)
translations.なあ、詞ってどうなの？ 順調か？:
Hey, how are the lyrics going？
Coming along okay？
translations.へえ……なあ、ちょっと見せてよ。: Oh yeah...？ Hey, let me see.
translations.なんでだよ、いーじゃん。ほらほら！:
Why not？ It's fine, isn't it？
Come on, let's see！
translations.やーだ！ まだ未完成だし……それに一対一で見せるのって恥ずかしいじゃん。みんなに:
No way！ It's not done yet...
Besides, showing you one-on-one
is embarrassing. I'd rather
show everyone all at once.
translations.（さあ、今日もバンドマンだ！）:
(All right, time to be
in a band again today！)
translations.まあ、一応作ってはみたけど……。:
Well, I did try putting
something together...
translations.あんまりハードルあげないでくださいよ……。:
Please don't set the bar
so high...
translations.どうせこんな曲よ……なによ……文句ある？ ……なんなのよ……忌々しい……。:
Well, that's all it is...
What？ Got a complaint？
...What is it... Curses...
translations.いやー、アタシの見る目に狂いはなかったね。やるじゃん！:
Well, looks like my eye for
talent was spot on. Nice job!
translations.なんなのよ、偉そうに……ホ、ホントに、いいと思う？:
What's with the high-and-mighty
attitude... D-Do you really
think it's good？
translations.佐々木さん、すごいよ……私、なんだか感動しちゃった……。:
You're amazing, Sasaki...
I'm honestly kind of moved...
translations.ま、まさかそんな、大げさな……ククッ……。:
N-No way, you're exaggerating...
Heh heh...
translations.あ、読みたい。: Oh, I'd love to read them.
translations.うん……やっぱり小早川さん、こういうの得意なのね。:
Yeah... You really have a
knack for this, Kobayakawa.
translations.実はこういうの、前からちょっとあっためてたっていうか……。だから、かも。:
To be honest, I'd been sitting
on some ideas like this for a
while... Maybe that's why.
translations.えっと、佐々木さんから見たら……どうかな。:
Um, what do you think of them,
Sasaki？
translations.いいと思う……べ、別にさっき褒められたからそのお返しとか、そういう気持ち悪い友情:
I think they're good... I-It's
not like I'm just returning the
compliment, or doing some gross
friendship thing!
translations.……うわ、アタシ……素でツンデレやっちゃった……。:
...Ugh, I just went full
tsundere without trying...
translations.でも小早川さん、本当に才能あるよ……。:
Still, you really are talented,
Kobayakawa...
translations.私、本当に泣きそう……うっ……。:
I think I'm really going to
cry... *sniff*...
translations.ああ、曲も詞もいいのができて……これで本格的に活動できそうだな！:
Yeah, we've got a great song
and great lyrics... Now the band
can really get going!
translations.うん……なんか、アタシまで感動してきちゃった……。ありがと、みんな。:
Yeah... Somehow even I'm
starting to get choked up...
Thanks, everyone.
translations.……別にアンタのためにやってるわけじゃないわよ……。:
...It's not like I'm doing
this for you...
translations.よーし、これからがんばって練習するぞー！:
All right, let's practice
hard from here on out!
translations.少し遅れたな。二人とももういるかな。:
We're a little late. I wonder
if the other two are here yet.
translations.あれ……軽音部だ！:
Oh... It's the light music
club!
translations.えー、イイ男いる？: Ooh, any cute guys in there？
translations.えっと……あれ、女だけ……っていうか、あの子ら……。: Let's see... Wait, it's just girls... Hold on, aren't they...
translations.なにこれ……バンド？ マジ!?: What is this... a band？ Seriously!？
translations.ロックとかってやっちゃうわけ？: Are you gonna play rock and stuff？
translations.それはないっしょ！ 図書委員だよ？: No way! They're on the library committee, right？
translations.なんなのよ……なにしにきたのよ……邪魔なのよ……。: What's their deal... Why did they come here... They're in the way...
translations.あ、あの、ごめんなさい……練習中だから……。: U-Um, I'm sorry... We're in the middle of practice...
translations.あ、ごめんなさーい。邪魔しちゃってー。: Oh, sooorry for getting in your way.
translations.二人とも、シャキっとする！ 別に文句言われたわけじゃないんだからさ。: Come on, you two, stand tall! It's not like they were complaining about us.
translations.……なんで偉そうなのよ……忌々しい……。: ...Why is she acting so bossy... How irritating...
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、なんだかリーダーっぽくなってるよな）: (▲小早川＊▲ is starting to act like a real leader.)
translations.さあ、音楽室行くよ。: Come on, let's head to the music room.
translations.ちょっと、なんで音楽室使ってんの？ 今日はアタシ達の番なはずだけど。: Hey, why are you using the music room？ It's supposed to be our turn today.
translations.知らねーよ、そんなの。つーか誰。: How should I know？ Who even are you？
translations.あれじゃねーの。顧問が言ってた。ほれ、図書委員がどーとか。: Ain't they the ones the advisor mentioned？ Somethin' about the library committee.
translations.ああ、言ってた言ってた。なんだ、間借りしてる分際で偉そうにすんなよ。今日はオレら: Oh yeah, he did say that. Man, don't get all cocky when you're just borrowing the place. We're using it today.
translations.それとも見学でもしてくか？: Or what, you wanna stick around and watch？
translations.誰が。どうせ高校の軽音レベルでしょ。: As if. You're just at a high school club level anyway.
translations.テメエ……俺らの音聴いたことあんのかよ！: Why you... Have you even heard us play？!
translations.まあまあ、ごめんな！ そうだなー……せっかくだから観て行こっかなー、な？: Whoa, whoa, sorry about that! Well... since we're here, maybe we will watch for a bit. Right？
translations.ま、そういうわけで！ 邪魔しないからさ、ちょっと見学させてよ！: So yeah! We won't get in the way, so let us watch for a bit!
translations.ちょっと、何ヘラヘラしてんの。: Hey, quit grinning at them like that.
translations.まあまあ、たしかに態度はちょっと気に入らないけどさ、他のバンドの演奏観るのって、: Come on, I don't like their attitude either, but watching another band play could be good reference for us.
translations.たしかにそうかも……私たち、初心者だし……アマチュアバンドを生で観ることってない: That might be true... We're beginners, after all... and we never get to see an amateur band play live.
translations.そりゃあ本職にはかないませんよ……忌々しい……。: Well, of course we're no match for the regulars... How detestable...
translations.（●たち、こいつらに混ざってライブなんてできるのか……？）: (Can ● and the others really put on a show alongside these guys...？)
translations.さて、仕事も終わったし。練習しよっか。: All right, work's done. Shall we practice？
translations.場所がないと、どうしようもないじゃない……どうするのよ。: There's nothing we can do without a place to play... What are we supposed to do？
translations.今日も音楽室は軽音部が使ってるみたい。: It looks like the Light Music Club is using the music room again today.
translations.んー……じゃあさ、外のスタジオ使ってみる？: Hmm... Then how about we try using a studio off-campus？
translations.おー……ここがリハーサルスタジオか！: Whoa... So this is a rehearsal studio!
translations.なんだか……場違いじゃない？\n……周りの人間から、バカに\nされてる気がする…:
Don't we seem... a little
out of place？ ...I feel like
everyone here is looking down
on us... How detestable...
translations.ビビっちゃダメっすよ、先輩！: Don't go chickening out on me, Senpai!
translations.軽音の奴らの演奏聴いたでしょ？\nもっとやんなきゃ！:
You heard those Light Music
Club guys play, right？
We've gotta practice more!
translations.そ、そっか……はい……が、がんばる……。: Y-You're right... Okay... I-I'll do my best...
translations.すごい……音の響き方が違う。: Amazing... The sound resonates so differently in here.
translations.ふふ……楽しいかも……。: Hehe... This might actually be fun...
translations.ますますバンドっぽくなってきたな！: We're really starting to feel like a band!
translations.思いっきり音が出せて気持ちいいな！: It feels great being able to play as loud as we want!
translations.なんだか上達したような気になる……。: Somehow it makes me feel like I've gotten better...
translations.ほんと。これならもっと早く来ればよかったよ。: For real. We should've come here sooner.
translations.……でもお金かかるから……そんなに何回もは難しいよね……。: ...It costs money, though... so coming here a lot might be tough...
translations.だな、音楽室使える日はやっぱり音楽室使おう。: Yeah, let's stick to the music room whenever it's free.
translations.これもあの忌々しい軽音部のせいで……。: And it's all because of that detestable light music club...
translations.打倒！ 軽音部！: Down with the light music club!
translations.（……なんか目的変わってないか？）: (...Wait, hasn't our goal kind of changed？)
translations.リンコ。まだバンドやってるの？: Rinko. Are you still doing that band thing？
translations.まだ、って……。特にやめる予定はないよ。少なくともライブやるまではね。: What do you mean, 'still'...? I'm not planning on quitting. At least not until the show.
translations.そう。軽音主催のイベントのやつ、知ってる？: Yeah. You know that event the light music club puts on？
translations.あー、やってるってことくらいは。観たことはないけど。: Ah, I know it's a thing. Never been to one, though.
translations.そっか。アタシも観たことはないんだけどね。……観に来てくれる？: Right. I haven't either, actually. ...Will you come watch？
translations.もちろん、行く行く。応援用のウチワ作ってく～。: Of course, I'll totally be there. I'll even make a fan sign to wave for you.
translations.アイドルの追っかけかっつーの！: What am I, a pop idol？
translations.なあ。ギターの調子、どうだ？: Hey. How's the guitar coming along？
translations.ああ……うん、まあやってるけど。: Oh... Yeah, well, I'm working on it.
translations.うるさいなあ……いいよね、ボーカル様はお気楽でさ。: Give it a rest... Must be nice being the carefree lead singer.
translations.ええ？ そうかな……まあ、歌うの結構楽しいかも！: Huh？ You think so...? Well, singing is actually pretty fun!
translations.あっそ、そりゃよかった。もしかして……調子のってる？: Oh, good for you. Wait... is it going to your head？
translations.そんなんじゃないって！: No way, it's not like that!
translations.これで俺様も女子にモテモテかも……なんて思ってない？: You're not thinking, 'Now I'm gonna be a total chick magnet,' are you？
translations.そんなんじゃ……やっぱボーカルってモテるのかな？: I told you, I'm not... Wait, are lead singers really popular with girls？
translations.へへ。まあ、ギターの方はぼちぼちがんばるよ……。: Hehe. Well, I'll keep plugging away at the guitar...
translations.それなりにまとまってきた気はするけど……。: I feel like we're starting to come together, more or less...
translations.ギターがね……全然ダメじゃない。: It's the guitar... It's not good enough at all.
translations.あ、あの……でも……このまま練習続ければ……。: U-um... But... if she keeps practicing like this...
translations.佐々木さん……あの、小早川さん、すごく練習してると思う。:
Sasaki... Um, I really think
Kobayakawa's been practicing
a lot.
translations.左手の指、ボロボロだし……練習の度に、少しでも上達はしてるし……。:
The fingers on her left hand
are a mess... and she improves
a bit more every practice...
translations.それに……バンドへの思い入れだって……。:
And besides... she cares so
much about this band...
translations.向き不向きってのも……あるだろうし……。:
Still... some people just
aren't cut out for certain
things...
translations.この曲、ベースはそんなに難しくないし……だから私は、なんとかなってるわけだし……:
The bass part in this song
isn't that hard... That's the
only reason I'm getting by...
translations.……このまま逃げられても困るんで、連れ戻してきたらどうですか……。:
...It's a problem if she walks
out on us, so why don't you
go bring her back...
translations.ふん。こうやってカレシに慰めてもらうのね……忌々しい……。:
Hmph. Getting her boyfriend
to go comfort her like this...
How irritating...
translations.ふふ、いいじゃない。:
Hehe, there's nothing wrong
with that.
translations.（聞こえてるんだけどなあ……）:
(I can still hear you,
you know...)
translations.うん、ごめん……すぐ戻るよ。:
Yeah, sorry... I'll be right
back.
translations.リンコも、ちゃんと考えてるからさ。たぶん、大丈夫。:
I've been thinking things
through, too. It'll probably
be fine.
translations.（なんかイヤな予感が……）:
(I have a bad feeling
about this...)
translations.アタシにギターは向いてなかったんだよ。手が小さくてコード押さえられないし。:
I just wasn't cut out for
guitar. My hands are too small
to hold down the chords.
translations.ベースだったら、単音でいいから問題ないでしょ？:
With bass, it's just single
notes, so it shouldn't be a
problem, right？
translations.せっかく練習してきたのよ……それを今更……。:
After all the practice I've
put in... You can't ask that
now...
translations.ごめん！ 最初、アタシがギターやらせてって言ったのに、悪いけど……。お願い。:
Sorry! I know I'm the one who
asked to play guitar first,
and I feel bad... Please.
translations.……せっかく練習してきたんだから、私もこのバンドは成功させたい……。:
...I've practiced hard, too,
so I want this band to
succeed...
translations.パートを変えて、それでバンドがよくなるなら……。:
If switching parts will make
the band better...
translations.ふん。お互いが今まで練習してきたことを教え合えば、少しは楽でしょ……。:
Hmph. If we teach each other
what we've practiced so far,
it'll be a bit easier...
translations.ねえ、ベース、ちょっと貸してもらってもいい？:
Hey, mind if I borrow your
bass for a second？
translations.うんうん、しっくりくるよ。パンクはベースだよね、やっぱり。:
Yeah, this feels right.
Punk's all about the bass,
after all.
translations.シノムンとか、かっこいいじゃん。あのジャケみたいに、ベースを叩きつけてみたり！:
Shinomun is super cool, too.
Maybe I'll smash the bass just
like on that album cover!
translations.あと、もういっこお願いなんだけど……。: Also, I have one more favor to ask...
translations.このベース、使わせてもらってもいいかな？: Would you mind if I used this bass？
translations.今の……すごくよかったかも……。: That just now... might've been really good...
translations.そこ、水差さない。よーし、じゃあミーティング！: Hey, don't ruin the mood. All right, meeting time!
translations.アタシとしたことが、大切なことを忘れてた。: I can't believe I forgot something so important.
translations.なによそれ……衣装なんて着るわけ？: What's that about...？ You want us to wear outfits？
translations.何が当たり前よ……誰にとっての当たり前よ……私は衣装なんて……。: What do you mean, obviously...？ Obvious to who...？ I'm not wearing some outfit...
translations.衣装って……どんなの着るんだ？\n学校のイベントだし、\nそんな派手にはできない:
Outfits...？ Like what？
It's a school event, so
nothing too flashy, right？
translations.つまんないもなにも、衣装なんていらないわよ……。: Fun or not, we don't need outfits...
translations.そう、衣装！ 問題はどうやって作るかだけど――: Yep, outfits! The question is how we're gonna make them—
translations.▲小早川＊▲、待った。なに、長倉？: Hold on, ▲小早川＊▲. What is it, Nagakura？
translations.ご、ごめんなさい……衣装……あの、私に作らせてくれない……かな。: S-sorry... The outfits... um, would you let me make them...？
translations.ご、ごめんなさい……あの、ダメならいいの……ただ……私、そういうの考えるの好きだ: S-sorry... Um, it's fine if you don't want me to... I just... really like coming up with things like that, and...
translations.小早川さんは詞を書いて……佐々木さんは曲を作って……私だけ……何もできてないから: Kobayakawa-san is writing the lyrics... and Sasaki-san wrote the music... I'm the only one who hasn't done anything.
translations.そんなの気にすることじゃないっすよ……何もしてないのは、そこのアレですから。: You don't need to worry about that... The one doing nothing here is that guy over there.
translations.でも、やってくれるなら助かりますよ。ねえ？: Still, if you're willing to do it, that'd be a huge help. Right？
translations.私は……別に構わないけど……。: I mean... I don't really mind...
translations.うん……ありがとう。もちろん、みんなの意見も参考にするから。: Yeah... thank you. Of course, I'll take everyone's input too.
translations.へへ、もちろん！ デザインには口出したいし……あ、手伝いもしますよ？: Heh, of course! I definitely want a say in the design... Oh, and I'll help make them too, okay？
translations.さて、ミーティングするよ。集合。: Okay, we're having a meeting. Gather round.
translations.前にした衣装の話って、あれからどうなったんだ？: What ever happened with those stage outfits we talked about？
translations.ああ、あれはいいの。女子で上手いことやっておくから。: Oh, don't worry about that. Us girls have it covered.
translations.この件はね、男子禁制なの。: No boys allowed on this one.
translations.大丈夫だって。アンタの分もちゃんと用意しとくから。ね、先輩。: Relax. We're making one for you too. Right, Senpai？
translations.というわけで、アタシたちの衣装は本番のお楽しみ！: So yeah, you'll have to wait till the show to see our outfits!
translations.（気になるけど……たしかに本番の楽しみが増えるか）: (I'm curious... though I guess it gives me more to look forward to.)
translations.（さて今日もバンドマンだ！）: (All right, back to the band life today!)
translations.あのさ。今日、練習の前にちょっと遊んでかない？: Hey. Wanna hang out a bit before practice today？
translations.（さて、出かける準備するか……）: (All right, better get ready to head out...)
translations.やばいな、間に合うかな……。: Uh-oh, are we gonna make it in time...？
translations.ダメかも……遅刻ペース。: Maybe not... At this rate we'll be late.
translations.ついてないな。電車は止まるし、道は工事中だし……とんだ計算違いだ……。: Talk about bad luck. Delayed trains, roadwork... Total miscalculation...
translations.……なんで二人そろって遅れてるのよ……。: ...Why are you both showing up late together...？
translations.どうせデートでもしてきたんでしょ。これだからカレシ持ちは……忌々しい……。: You were probably out on a date anyway. Ugh, girls with boyfriends... Disgusting...
translations.だから、ゴメンて。さ、練習！: I already said I'm sorry. Come on, let's practice!
translations.だいたい、みんなアンタのわがままに付き合ってんのよ？ なのに、な、なんなのよその: Besides, we're all just humoring your selfishness here, you know？ And you give us that attitude...？
translations.ちょっと……ワガママって、なに？ アタシは、みんながもっと……。: Hold on... What do you mean, selfish？ I just wanted everyone to...
translations.もっと、楽しくいられるようにって、言われっぱなしじゃなくて、もっと言いたいこと言: To have more fun, and stop letting people walk all over you, and actually speak your minds. That's why—
translations.でもね、わたしたち、そんなに可哀想かな……。: Still... do we really seem that pitiful...？
translations.気にしてるのか、前の練習でのこと。: Are you still thinking about what happened at our last practice？
translations.きっとね、長倉先輩にも佐々木さんにも、ずっと見透かされてたんだよ。リンコだってあ: I bet Nagakura and Sasaki saw right through me the whole time. Thinking I'm no different from those girls.
translations.ごめん、なんでもない。めんどくさい話、やめようよ。: Sorry, it's nothing. Let's drop the heavy talk.
translations.えっと……あの……ちょっと合ってなかったかな……。: Um... well... I think our timing was a little off...
translations.じゃあ、今のところ、もう一回……。: All right, let's take it from that part one more time...
translations.（ダメだ、合わない……）: (No good, we're completely out of sync...)
translations.……なによ……なんなのよ……。: ...What is this... What's wrong with us...
translations.えっと……よし、じゃあもう一度やるか！: Uh... All right, let's give it another shot!
translations.やっぱり無理だったのよ……。: I knew this was never going to work...
translations.（こんな状態でライブなんて……できるのか？）: (Can we really pull off a live show like this...？)
translations.（佐々木さんと長倉さんは、もう帰っちゃったか……）: (Guess Sasaki and Nagakura already went home...)
translations.ん……あの二人……佐々木さんと長倉先輩、見てるとさ……。: Mm... When I look at the two of them... at Sasaki and Nagakura...
