translations.なんとなく、昔の……アンタに会う前のリンコ見てるみたいでさ。: Somehow, it feels like I'm looking at the old me... from before I met you.
translations.昔の……そうかな？: The old you... You think so？
translations.別に似てるってわけじゃないよ……ただ、自分の世界だけに閉じこもって。周りと関わら: Not that we're alike or anything... Just the way they shut themselves up in their own world and try not to get involved with anyone around them...
translations.リンコにはアンタがいたから……リンコは、変われたけど。: I had you, so... I was able to change, though.
translations.やっぱりああいうの見てると、ちょっと……ね。: Still, seeing them like that gets to me a little, you know.
translations.アンタからもらった優しさ……他の誰かにわけられたり……。: The kindness you gave me... I wondered if I could share it with someone else...
translations.今のリンコだったら……そういうこと、誰かにしてあげられないかなって……。: I thought maybe the me I am now... could do something like that for someone...
translations.そう思って、バンドの話……思いついたんだよね。その場でだったけどさ。: That's why I came up with the whole band idea. Even if it was on the spur of the moment.
translations.でもそれって……リンコのエゴだったんだね……。: But in the end... that was just me being selfish, wasn't it...
translations.……ちゃんと二人に謝る。: ...I'm going to apologize properly to the two of them.
translations.それに……偉そうなこと言っといて、リンコが原因でライブが失敗したら、かっこ悪いも: Besides... after talking so big, it'd be pretty pathetic if the show flopped because of me.
translations.ああ、ライブは成功させないとな！: Yeah, we've gotta make this show a success!
translations.そういうこと！ アンタも、しっかりね！: Exactly! You'd better stay sharp too!
translations.（相変わらず空気が重いな……）: (The mood in here is as heavy as ever...)
translations.練習に遅刻したことも……パートチェンジとか曲作りとか……いろいろワガママ言ったこ: Being late to practice... Being selfish about switching parts, writing the song, and everything.
translations.あとは……突然、バンドやろうぜ！ なんて巻き込んだりしたことも。: And... for dragging you into this out of nowhere, saying we should start a band.
translations.アタシ、それがいいことなんだと思ってた。: I thought I was doing a good thing.
translations.あのギャルたちにバカにされて、悔しくないのかって。だったら、アタシがなんとかして: Those girls were making fun of you, and I figured it had to bother you. That I'd do something about it for you.
translations.なんとかしてあげよう、って\n……そう、思ってた。:
That I'd do it for you...
That's what I was thinking.
translations.……大きなお世話なのよ……偉そうに……。: ...Nobody asked you to butt in... Acting all high and mighty...
translations.大きなお世話だけど、それがすごくうれしかったから、アタシも先輩も……。: You were butting in, sure, but it still made us really happy. Me and Nagakura both...
translations.小早川さんがついていてくれれば、きっと、頑張れるって……いつも、もっと胸を張って: We felt like as long as you were with us, Kobayakawa, we could do our best... That we could finally hold our heads a little higher...
translations.だから……絶対にライブを成功させたい。一緒にがんばってきたこと、無駄にしたくない: That's why... I really want this show to be a success. I don't want everything we've worked so hard on together to go to waste.
translations.どうせなんて言って、もう逃げない……。本気で精一杯、やってみたい……。: No more making excuses and running away... I want to give it everything I've got, for real...
translations.うん、がんばろ……悔いが残らないように、本気で！: Yeah, let's do this... Let's give it our all so we don't have any regrets!
translations.（ついにライブ前日……）: (It's finally the day before the show...)
translations.（もうすぐリハーサルだけど、まだみんな来ないのか……）: (Rehearsal's starting soon, but nobody else is here yet...)
translations.ああ、おはよ。いよいよ明日だな！: Hey, morning. Tomorrow's finally the big day!
translations.よう、▲小早川＊▲。いよいよだな！: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. The big day's almost here!
translations.（ここでライブするのか、広いよな……何人くらい来るんだろう……）: (So this is where we're playing. It's huge... I wonder how many people will show up...)
translations.なにボケーっとしてんの。: What are you spacing out for？
translations.はは、いやー広いな！: Haha, man, this place is huge!
translations.いつもの講堂じゃん。ビビってんの？: It's just the usual auditorium. Are you scared？
translations.……はあ……そっちは、大丈夫？: *Sigh*... How about you two？ Are you okay？
translations.ご、ごめんなさい……ダ、ダ……ダメ……かも……。: I-I'm sorry... I-I... I don't think I can do this...
translations.なによ……なんなのよ……だから最初から無理だって言ってたのよ……。: What is this... What even is this... See, I told you from the start this was impossible...
translations.なんでリハも観なきゃいけないの？ 本番明日じゃん。: Why do we gotta watch the rehearsal too？ The real show's tomorrow.
translations.いいじゃん、ほら、始まっちゃうって！: Come on, it's fine! Look, they're about to start!
translations.違うし！ ディ・プリュムスはただのＶ系じゃないし！ ほら、原ちんも！: As if! Besides, Des Plumes isn't just some visual kei band! Come on, Hara!
translations.そうそう、シン様のリハ、見逃しちゃうし。: Yeah, we don't wanna miss Shin's rehearsal.
translations.はーい、本番もよろしくお願いします。では次のバンド、お願いします。: Okay, looking forward to tomorrow too. Next band up, please.
translations.ドラムさん、三点もらってもいいですか？: Drummer, can you give me the main three？
translations.あー、ハットとスネアとバスドラで……適当に音ください。: Uh, hi-hat, snare, and kick... Just give me a beat.
translations.はは、プログレかよ。: Haha, what is that, prog rock？
translations.（くそ、バカにしやがって！）: (Damn it, they're making fun of us!)
translations.それじゃ曲でくださーい。: All right, let's hear a song then.
translations.（うう、みんなボロボロだったな……●含めて）: (Ugh, everyone was a total wreck... ● included.)
translations.ご、ごめんなさい……私のせいで……帰りたい……。: I-I'm so sorry... It's all my fault... I wanna go home...
translations.これだから……これだから……忌々しい……。: This is why... Just as I feared... How wretched...
translations.（このままで大丈夫かな……）: (Are we really gonna be okay like this...？)
translations.ライブ、もうそろそろだよね。: Your show's coming up pretty soon, right？
translations.練習、がんばってるみたいじゃん。: Looks like you've been practicing hard.
translations.へへ、期待しといてよ。: Heh, you can look forward to it.
translations.えっと……自信はそんなにないけど……まあ期待はしててよ！: Um... I don't know about confident, but... well, look forward to it anyway!
translations.えー、なにそれ。: Huh？ What's that supposed to mean？
translations.音楽ってのは技術じゃないの。アタシたちの本気見せてあげるから。: Music isn't just about skill. We'll show you what our band can really do.
translations.ふーん、よくわからないけど……楽しみにしてる。: Hmm, I don't really get it, but... I'm looking forward to it.
translations.（いよいよこの日……\nライブ当日だ！）:
(The day is finally here...
It's the day of the show!)
translations.（二人とも、\nやっぱり緊張してる……）:
(Just as I thought,
they're both nervous...)
translations.リハは、リハじゃん。\n逆に考えれば失敗したのがリハで\nラッキーだったんだって:
Rehearsal's just rehearsal.
Think about it—we're lucky
we messed up in rehearsal!
translations.大丈夫だって、練習して\nきたんだから。このままじゃ、\nまたあのギャルたちに\:
We'll be fine, we practiced.
If we stay like this,
those girls are just gonna
laugh at us again.
translations.練習が上手くいったときの\n楽しいイメージを思い出して、\n思いっきりやればいい:
Just remember how fun it was
when practice went well, and
give it all you've got.
Then it'll be a big success!
Besides, we're punk,
so making mistakes
doesn't even matter!
translations.なんなのよパンクって……\nまあ、それくらいなら、\nできるけど……。:
What's "punk" even mean...
Well, if that's all it is,
I can do that much...
translations.目つぶってていいなら、\n私も……。:
If I can close my eyes,
then I can do it too...
translations.周りからどう見えたってさ、\nどうだカッコいいだろ！ \nって言ったモン勝ちだよ:
No matter what people think,
if we're like, "See how cool
we are!" then we win!
translations.よし……じゃあ音楽室行くか？: All right... Ready to head to the music room？
translations.うん、いい感じ！ \nみんな愛してるぜ！:
Yeah, looking good!
I love you guys!
translations.（●は着るだけだから楽だけど……女子はメイクとかあって大変そうだな……）: (● just have to put my outfit on, so it's easy, but the girls have makeup and stuff to deal with...)
translations.すげー、かわいいよ！ 似合ってる！: Whoa, you look super cute! It really suits you!
translations.だからそこ……人前でイチャつかないでよ……。: Hey, you two... Don't flirt in front of people...
translations.なによ……なんなのよ……いいわよ、笑いなさいよ……。: What... What is it... Go ahead, laugh it up...
translations.いや……すげーな……別人みたいだ。: No... it's amazing... You look like a totally different person.
translations.ふん、そうでしょうよ。似合ってないし……なんなのよ……忌々しい……。: Hmph, I'm sure. It doesn't suit me at all... Seriously, what is this... So irritating...
translations.そんなことないって、かっこいい！: That's not true at all, you look cool!
translations.ふん……なによ、なんなのよ……これだから……。: Hmph... What, what's with you... Honestly...
translations.……ってことは長倉さんも……。: ...Wait, does that mean Nagakura is too...？
translations.……なんでそんな隅っこにいんの？: ...Why are you hiding in the corner like that？
translations.だって……恥ずかしくて……こんな格好……。: Because... it's embarrassing... dressed like this...
translations.それ、自分でデザインしたんじゃん……。: You're the one who designed it, though...
translations.そうだけど……途中で夢中になっちゃって……後で自分が着るってこと、すっかり忘れて: I know, but... I got so carried away making it... I completely forgot I'd have to wear it later...
translations.ははは！ いいじゃん、似合ってるって！:
Hahaha! Come on, it looks
great on you!
translations.なんでも！ ほら、講堂行くよ！\n準備はいい？:
Nothing! Come on, let's head to
the auditorium! Everyone ready？
translations.えっと……イントロが……Ａメロで……キメが……。:
Um... the intro, then the verse...
and the break goes...
translations.ちょっと体育会系っぽくてアレだけどさ、その……。:
It's kind of a sports-team thing,
which isn't really our style, but...
translations.その……手を合わせてオー！\n……みたいな。:
You know... putting our hands in
and going, 'Yeah!' ...Like that.
translations.はは、いいじゃん。やろうよ！: Haha, I like it. Let's do it!
translations.じゃあいくよ。せーの――: Okay, here we go. One, two—
translations.それでは次のバンドは一般参加のイン・ザ・ライです。:
And our next band is a general
entry, In the Rye.
translations.それでは次のバンドは一般参加のザ・ダダです。:
And our next band is a general
entry, The Dada.
translations.それでは次のバンドは一般参加の十羽野ライブラリアンズです。:
And our next band is a general
entry, the Towano Librarians.
translations.それでは次のバンドは一般参加のリンコ＆ザ・ステューピッドです。:
And our next band is a general
entry, Rinko & The Stupid.
translations.ちょっと何これ、かっこいいんですけどー！:
Wait, what is this？ They're so
cool!
translations.すごいすごい！ 音ちょーアツい！:
Awesome! Their sound is super
hot!
translations.ほらほらー！ 来いよー！: Come on, come on! Bring it!
translations.（▲小早川＊▲も楽しそうだ……）: (▲小早川＊▲ looks like she's having fun, too...)
translations.（バンド……やってよかった！）: (I'm so glad we did this band!)
translations.（結局歌も演奏もボロボロだったけど……でもスゲェ気持ちよかったよな！ 盛り上がっ: (Our singing and playing were a total mess in the end... but man, that felt amazing! And the crowd loved it!)
translations.ちょっと、すごいよ！ あんなにかっこいいなんて思わなかったし！: Hey, that was amazing! I had no idea you guys were that cool!
translations.すげぇ！ カッコ良かった！ まじヤバかった！: That was awesome! So cool! Like, seriously crazy good!
translations.衣装も、カワイイ！ なにあれ、作ったの？: Your outfits are super cute, too! Wait, did you make those？
translations.いいなー。ウチらもバンドやるかーって、な？: I'm jealous. Maybe we should start a band too, huh？
translations.ウチらじゃ無理じゃない？: No way could we pull that off, right？
translations.（あの子達……ちゃんと観てくれてたんだ……）: (Those girls... they really came and watched us...)
translations.はいあの、ごめんなさい……え、どうして？: Yes, um, I'm sorry... Wait, why are you apologizing？
translations.なんかウチら、やな感じだったかもねって、ずっと思ってたんだけど言いづらくてさ……: We've been thinking for a while that we were kinda jerks to you, we just didn't know how to say it... Anyway, wanna go to karaoke sometime？
translations.もちろんリンコも一緒に……こうお詫びというか……親睦というか、ね。: You too, of course, Rinko... Call it an apology, or... a bonding thing, you know.
translations.別に……かまわないけど。: I mean... I don't really mind.
translations.ライブは大成功……だよな！: The show was a huge success... right!
translations.え……そりゃあ、むちゃくちゃ気持ちよかった！: Huh？ Well yeah, it felt amazing!
translations.だったらさ、成功でいいんじゃないか？: Then I think we can call that a success, right？
translations.ははは！ さっきまで動き回ってたもんな。: Hahaha! Well, you were moving all around up there.
translations.時間でいったらそんなでもないのに……。: Even though it wasn't that long time-wise...
translations.だな。でも体は疲れてるのに……気分は落ち着かないっていうかさ。: Yeah. Though even with my body this tired... my head's still wired, you know？
translations.これもランナーズハイみたいなもんかな！: Maybe it's like a runner's high!
translations.なに、テンション高いよ。: What's with you？ You're really hyper.
translations.リンコはちょっと……落ち着きたい。……ねえ？: I just want to... calm down a bit. ...Hey？
translations.リンコ……なんか成長できたかも。: I feel like... I might've grown a little.
translations.最高の思い出、できたよね……。: We made an amazing memory, didn't we...
translations.まさに青春って感じの。: The kind that really feels like 'youth.'
translations.▲小早川＊▲らしくないって？: Doesn't sound like ▲小早川＊▲, you say？
translations.アンタと一緒にできて……ほんとうによかった……。: I'm really glad... I got to do this with you...
translations.なあなあ、軽音部のイベントで、すげえカッコよかったバンドがいたんだってよ！: Hey, did you hear？ Apparently there was this super cool band at the Light Music Club event!
translations.マジで？ ウチの軽音、そんなにすごいのいたか？: Seriously？ Did our Light Music Club even have anyone that good？
translations.それが軽音部のバンドじゃないんだよ。なんか図書委員の女子が組んだバンドで……。: That's the thing, they weren't even from the club. It was a band some girls on the library committee put together...
translations.（すごい、●たちのバンド、そんなに話題になってたのか……）: (Wow, I didn't know ●'s band was causing that much of a buzz...)
translations.あーもう担任！ だから教室から追い出すなっての！: Ugh, our stupid homeroom teacher! Stop kicking us out of the classroom already!
translations.アハハハ！ アンタが騒ぎすぎだからっしょ！: Ahahaha! That's only 'cause you were making way too much noise!
translations.えっと、お邪魔してまーす。なんつって。: Um, pardon the intrusion! Just kidding.
translations.いいから静かにしなさいよ……。: Just keep it down in here, will you...
translations.いいじゃん、ほら、最近なんか常連だし。ねえ、長倉先輩。: Aw, come on, I'm practically a regular here lately anyway. Right, Nagakura？
translations.えっと……その、常連でも……静かに……。: Um... well, even if you're a regular... please be quiet...
translations.まともに対応しないでください。常連とか……本も借りずに喋ってるだけで……。: Please don't humor her. Calling herself a regular when all she does is chat without even borrowing a book...
translations.……じゃあさ、カラオケでも行っとく？: ...Well then, wanna go hit karaoke instead？
translations.そうしよそうしよ！: Let's do it, let's do it!
translations.……ねえ、委員の仕事、もう終わりでしょ。一緒しない？: ...Hey, you're just about done with your committee shift, right？ Wanna come with us？
translations.よかったら、佐々木さんと長倉先輩も。ね？: You two can come too if you want, Sasaki, Nagakura. What do you say？
translations.ククッ……ヴァーティカルサウンドのメドレー入れてやる……。: Heh heh... I'll queue up a Vertical Sound medley...
translations.いいねいいね！ バンドマンとカラオケ！: Love it, love it! Karaoke with real band members!
translations.じゃあ、そんな感じで。ね、リンコ？:
Sounds like a plan, then.
Right, Rinko？
translations.アンタってさ、朝はパン派？ ごはん派？: So for breakfast, are you a bread person or a rice person？
translations.いいから答える。そしたらいいことあるかもよ。: Just answer. Something good might come of it.
translations.ごはんだな。日本人なら朝は和食でしょ！: Rice for me. If you're Japanese, breakfast has to be Japanese food!
translations.あんまり面白くない答えだけど。: That's a pretty boring answer, though.
translations.面白いとかあるのか？: Was it supposed to be interesting？
translations.ううん、別に。ま、いいや。和食ね、了解。: No, not really. Whatever. Japanese food, got it.
translations.朝食といえば、オシャレにパンだな。: When it comes to breakfast, I like keeping it stylish with bread.
translations.どこがオシャレ？ フツーじゃん。: How is that stylish？ That's just normal.
translations.とにかくパンなわけね。わかった。: Anyway, so it's bread for you. Got it.
translations.ん？ 前はパンって言ってたけど？: Hmm？ Didn't you say bread last time？
translations.朝からしっかり食べといたほうがいいかなと思ってさ。: I figured it's better to eat something filling in the morning.
translations.はいはい、そーですかっと。なるほどね、次はごはんにしとくか。: Yeah, yeah, I see. Got it. I'll go with rice next time, then.
translations.あれ？ ごはん派じゃなかった？: Huh？ Weren't you a rice person？
translations.ふーん……パンね。まあいいんだけどさ。次はパンか。: Hmm... Bread, huh. Well, I don't mind. Bread next time, then.
translations.和食、洋食、中華。はい、この中から好きなの選んで。: Japanese, Western, or Chinese food. Come on, pick your favorite out of those.
translations.じゃあ、和食。なんか落ち着くよな。: Japanese food, then. There's something comforting about it.
translations.わかるかも。和食ならリンコも得意だしね、へへ。: I get that. Plus, I'm pretty good at making Japanese food, hehe.
translations.和食が好きだな、その中だと。: Out of those, I'd say I like Japanese food.
translations.そんなこと言われても……。: What do you want me to say...？
translations.しょうがないな。練習かあ……。: Guess I have no choice. Time to practice, huh...
translations.洋食がいいな。やっぱ若者はね！: I'd go with Western food. We're young, after all!
translations.たしかにね。リンコも洋食好きだよ、作るのもね。: True. I like Western food too, and I like making it.
translations.だったら、洋食で。: Then I'll go with Western food.
translations.なんで困ってるんだ？: Why does that sound like a problem？
translations.なんでもない。あーあ……がんばりますか。: It's nothing. Man... Guess I'll do my best.
translations.やっぱ中華でしょ！ 四千年だし！: Gotta be Chinese food! You can't beat four thousand years of history!
translations.いいね♪ わかった、だったら楽しみにしといてよ。: Nice♪ Got it. You can look forward to it, then.
translations.うそ。中華作るの苦手なんだけど。: No way. I'm not really good at cooking Chinese food, though.
translations.ん？ 食べる話じゃなくて作る話だったのか？:
Hm？ Wait, are we talking
about cooking it, not just
eating it？
translations.あー、ううん。食べる話で合ってるけどさ……。:
Uh, no. We're talking about
eating it, it's just...
translations.●の好みはそういうんじゃないんだよな……。:
● don't really go for
any of those...
translations.そーなんだ？ まあ色々考えて作るの、嫌いじゃないけどね。:
Oh, really？ Well, I don't
mind coming up with different
things to cook.
translations.話聞いてた？ 三つの中から選んでって言ったじゃん。:
Were you even listening？
I told you to pick from
those three.
translations.参るなぁ……そういうの困るんだけど。:
Give me a break... You're
making this difficult.
translations.好きなものか。最近だったら……。:
My favorite food, huh？
Lately, it'd have to be...
translations.へー……。まあ、期待しないで待ってて。:
Huh... Well, don't get your
hopes up, okay？
translations.作ってくれるってこと？ 期待するなってのは無理かもな。:
Wait, you'll make it for me？
Kind of hard not to get my
hopes up now.
translations.やっぱそうなんだ。相当好きだよね。:
Thought so. You really love
that stuff, huh？
translations.まあな。こだわりだ！:
Yeah, well. I know what
I like!
translations.前と違ってない？ アンタ、ひょっとしてニセモノ？:
Isn't that different from
before？ Don't tell me you're
an impostor？
translations.本物に決まってるだろ……。ちょっと好みが変わったんだよ。:
Of course I'm the real me...
My tastes just changed a bit.
translations.あのさ、女の子の靴下の長さに好みとかある？ そーゆー細かいとこ気にしてそうだし。:
Hey, do you have a preference
for how long a girl's socks
are？ You seem like you'd care
about little details like that.
translations.靴下は短いのが好きだな。こう、活発な感じがしてさ。:
I like short socks. They give
off a lively vibe, you know？
translations.ふーん、そういうもん？ 短い靴下か……。:
Hmm, is that how it works？
Short socks, huh...
translations.普通の長さでいいんじゃないか？\n少なくとも悪目立ちは\nしないだろ。:
Isn't regular length fine？
At least they won't stick out
in a bad way.
translations.ま、それが無難だよね。:
Well, that's the safe bet,
yeah.
translations.長い靴下がいいんじゃないか？ 上品な感じが出るだろ。:
Long socks are nice, aren't
they？ They look kind of
classy.
translations.靴下で？ そういうもんなのか……。:
From socks？ So that's how
it works, huh...
translations.そんなの、似合ってればなんでもいいんじゃないか？:
Does it matter, as long as
they suit her？
translations.そうかもしれないんだけど、“なんでも”が一番難しいんだよね。:
Maybe so, but "anything" is
the hardest answer to work
with.
translations.あのさ。もしかして、まだ気にしてたりする？:
Hey. By any chance, is it
still bothering you？
translations.この前のケンカのこと。ちょーっと言い過ぎたかもって思ってさ。:
That fight we had the other
day. I felt like maybe I went
a little too far.
translations.ねえ、やっぱまだ気にしてんの？:
Hey, are you still hung up
on it after all？
translations.この前のケンカ、泣いてたかと思ってさ。:
That fight the other day.
I thought maybe you were
crying over it.
translations.この前のケンカのこと、謝っとく。ごめん。:
I wanted to apologize for our
fight the other day. Sorry.
translations.なんだよ、もう終わったことだろ？:
Come on, that's already in
the past, isn't it？
translations.そうだけど。ひょっとしたら、まだ気にしてるかなって。:
Yeah, I know. I just wondered
if it still bothered you.
translations.うれしかったよ、ちゃんとケンカできて。:
I was glad we could have
a real fight.
translations.素直に感情ぶつけてくれて、さ。これも恋人ならではだろ。:
You didn't hold back how you
felt. That's what being a
couple is all about, right？
translations.まあたしかに……あんなのはアンタにだけ、かもね。へへ。:
Well, true... You're probably
the only one I'd act like
that with. Hehe.
translations.うれしかったよ。いいケンカができたな。:
I was glad. I think we had
a good fight.
translations.いいケンカって、どういう意味？:
What do you mean by
"a good fight"？
translations.仲直りできたケンカは、いいケンカだろ。たまにはぶつかることだってあるんだから、い:
Any fight where you make up
is a good fight. We're bound
to clash sometimes, right？
translations.ふーん、強がっちゃってさ。ほんとは泣いてたくせに！ へへ。:
Hmph, acting all tough.
I bet you were actually
crying! Hehe.
translations.うれしかったよ。●の中では、いい思い出になってる。:
I was glad. For ●,
it's a good memory now.
translations.ああ。ケンカしたことも、▲小早川＊▲と二人で過ごした時間には変わらないからな。:
Yeah. Even when we're fighting,
it's still time I get to spend
with you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.なんか余裕で、ちょっと悔しい。でもいいや、じゃあこれからは楽しい思い出たくさん作:
You're so unfazed, it's kind
of annoying. Oh well—let's
make lots of fun memories
from now on♪
translations.はは、全然気にしてないって！:
Haha, it doesn't bother me
at all!
translations.それはそれで、どうかと思うけど。:
I'm not sure how I feel
about that, either.
translations.タフなんだよ。だから、●には遠慮なくなんでも言えよ。:
I'm tough. So don't hold back
with ●—you can say
whatever you want.
translations.へへ、かっこつけちゃってさ！ 一応、ありがとって言っとく。:
Hehe, listen to you trying
to sound cool! Still, thanks,
I guess.
translations.もう全然気にしてないって。:
I'm really not bothered by
it anymore.
translations.ほんとに？ 余裕だね、やるじゃん。:
Really？ Look at you taking
it in stride. Not bad.
translations.だったらまた……ってのは冗談だけど！:
Then maybe next time...
Just kidding!
translations.……あー、すっかり忘れてた！ 全然気にしてないよ。:
...Oh, I completely forgot
about that! I don't mind
at all.
translations.いいから。●がいいって言ってるんだからさ。もうそんな気にするなよ。:
Leave it be. ● says it's
fine, so don't worry about
it anymore.
translations.……そんな優しい顔しちゃってさ。へへ。:
...Giving me such a kind
look. Hehe.
translations.さすがにやっぱり、ショックだったな。:
Honestly, I have to admit
it was a shock.
translations.でも▲小早川＊▲の新しい一面も見られたし、な。悪いことばっかりじゃなかったかも。:
Still, I got to see a new side
of you, ▲小早川＊▲. So maybe it
wasn't all bad.
translations.あっそ……物好きだね。:
Oh, really... You're a weird
one.
translations.その話はいいよ……やっぱりショックだったし。:
Let's drop that subject...
It really was a shock.
translations.そっか、やっぱり泣いてたか。悪かったね。:
I see, so it really did make
you cry. My bad.
translations.いいよ。ただ、これからは楽しい事だけな？:
It's okay. Just stick to fun
stuff from now on, alright？
translations.はいはい、ポジティブだね。了解。:
Yeah, yeah, Mr. Positive.
Got it.
translations.やっぱり……。ほんとごめん。: I knew it... I'm really sorry.
translations.でももういいよ。引っ張ってもしょうがないだろ。: It's fine now, though. No point dwelling on it, right？
translations.……ありがと。リンコも気を取り直して、いつもの自分に戻るよ。: ...Thanks. I'll pull myself together and go back to being the usual me.
translations.この際聞くけどさ……リンコ、やっぱり料理上手い方がうれしい？: Since we're at it, let me ask... Would you be happier if I were a good cook after all？
translations.ほんとは無理して食べてたりとか……。ほら。: Like, maybe you're actually forcing yourself to eat my food... You know.
translations.下手でもいいよ: I don't mind if you're bad.
translations.そりゃ、上手い方がいいに決まってるけどさ。: Well sure, obviously it's better if you're good at it.
translations.……やっぱ、美味しくないって思ってた？: ...So you really did think my food didn't taste good？
translations.そういうわけじゃないけどさ、程度の問題だよ。より美味しい方がいいだろ。: That's not what I mean, it's just a matter of degree. The tastier the better, right？
translations.そっか……わかった。じゃあ、もっと上手く作れるようにがんばろっと。へへ。: I see... Got it. Then I'll work hard so I can cook even better. Hehe.
translations.なんで？ 美味しい方がいいでしょ？: Why？ Wouldn't it be better if it tastes good？
translations.▲小早川＊▲の手料理だったら、なんでも美味しく食べられる自信があるからな。: Because if it's your home cooking, ▲小早川＊▲, I'm confident I'll enjoy anything you make.
translations.なんか詭弁っぽいけど……まあいいや、ありがと。: That sounds like twisted logic... Oh well, thanks.
translations.下手でもいいよ、●は。: I don't mind if you're bad at it, ●.
translations.ほんとに？ そのうちスゴイの作っちゃうかもよ？ 悪い意味で。: Really？ I might end up making something crazy one of these days, you know？ In a bad way.
translations.それは愛が試される時、だな！: That'll be the true test of my love, then!
translations.フォローになってるんだか……でもありがと。: I'm not sure that's really reassuring... Still, thanks.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。ま、散歩ってとこかな。: ▲小早川＊▲. Just taking a walk, I guess.
translations.ふ～ん。つまり、特に目的もなくさまよってたってとこか。: Hmm. So basically, you're just wandering around aimlessly.
translations.ああ。●はもうちょっとブラブラしてから帰るよ。: Yeah. ● might wander around a little longer before heading home.
translations.びっくりした。なんでこんなとこにいんの？: You startled me. What are you doing out here？
translations.下見してたんだよ。デートにいい場所ないかなぁと思って。: Just scouting around. Seeing if there are any good date spots.
translations.それって……リンコとのデートだよね？: You mean... for a date with me, right？
translations.当たり前だろ？ いいとこ見つけとくからな。: Obviously. I'll find us a good spot.
translations.へへ、じゃあ詳しくは聞かない方がいいね。じゃあ。: Heh, guess I shouldn't ask for details then. See ya.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。びっくりしたよ……。なんでここに？: ▲小早川＊▲. You scared me... What brings you here？
translations.弟にせがまれてね、遊びにきたの。: My little brother begged me to bring him here to play.
translations.友達見つけて向こうで遊んでる。友達のお母さんが一緒に弟も見ててくれるっていうから: He found a friend and went to play over there. His friend's mom offered to keep an eye on him too, so I'm taking a little walk.
translations.じゃ、そろそろ戻るね。: Anyway, I should head back soon.
translations.見慣れた後姿があると思ったら……。: Thought I recognized you from behind...
translations.わっ、▲小早川＊▲。ひとりか？: Whoa, ▲小早川＊▲. Are you by yourself？
translations.今日はお父さんに付き合わされてんの。『どうしても観なくちゃいけないんだ』とか言っ: My dad dragged me along today. Kept going on about how he "just had to see it." Like, go by yourself then.
translations.親子水入らずでいいじゃないか。……で、お父さんは？: Nothing wrong with some father-daughter time. ...So where is your dad？
translations.あっちで映画観てるよ？ リンコはつまんないから出てきちゃった。ま、そろそろ戻って: Over there watching the movie. I got bored, so I walked out. Guess I'll head back soon, though.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、奇遇だな。映画観に来たのか？: ▲小早川＊▲, fancy meeting you here. Here to see a movie？
translations.ううん。欲しいパンフレットがあったから、ちょっと寄っただけ。: Nope. Just stopped by to pick up a program I wanted.
translations.へえ。で、買ったの？: Oh yeah？ Did you get it？
translations.うん。お母さんの好きな俳優が出てるからプレゼント。: Yeah. An actor my mom likes is in it, so it's a present for her.
translations.あれ？ ▲小早川＊▲。映画観に来てたのか？: Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲. Did you come to see a movie？
translations.弟が電話してきてさ、“早く帰ってきて遊んで～”って駄々こねられちゃったから。: My little brother called and threw a fit telling me to come home and play with him.
translations.はは、そっか。いいお姉ちゃんしてるんだな。: Haha, I see. Being a good big sister, huh.
translations.へえ、筋力アップでもするつもり？: Oh, trying to bulk up or something？
translations.わっ、▲小早川＊▲！ もしかして▲小早川＊▲もトレーニング？: Whoa, ▲小早川＊▲! Wait, are you working out too, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.まさか。通りかかっただけ。……もしかしたら、アンタがいるかな？: As if. Just passing through. ...Thought maybe you'd be here？
translations.そっか。嬉しいな。: I see. That makes me happy.
translations.ただの予感。……ニヤニヤするなっつーの。: It was just a hunch. ...Quit grinning like that.
translations.あれ、▲小早川＊▲。なにしてるんだ？: Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲. What are you up to？
translations.あ、ちょうどいいところに来た。ここのスイミングスクールって評判いいか知ってる？: Oh, good timing. Do you know if the swimming school here has a good reputation？
translations.評判？ 知らないけど……なんで？: A good reputation？ No idea... Why？
translations.弟が習いたいんだってさ。で、リンコが偵察することになったんだけど、アンタにその役: My little brother says he wants to take lessons. I got stuck scouting the place out, so I'll pass the job on to you.
translations.●には荷が重いな、辞退するよ。: That's too big a job for me. ● think I'll pass.
translations.遠慮なんてしなくていいから。じゃ、よろしく。: No need to be so modest. Anyway, I'm counting on you.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。運動しにきたの？: ▲主人公＊▲. Did you come here to work out？
translations.よぉ、▲小早川＊▲。……うん、ときどき無性に運動したくなるときってあるだろ？: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. ...Yeah, don't you ever get a sudden urge to work out？
translations.ないね。無性に本を読み漁りたくなるときならあるけど。……あ、読みたくなってきた。: Not at all. I do get the urge to devour a pile of books sometimes, though. ...Oh, now I feel like reading. I'm heading home.
translations.（この辺に用事があったんじゃないんだな）: (Guess she didn't actually have any business around here.)
translations.へへっ、やっぱりアンタだったか。: Heh, I knew it was you.
translations.おっ、▲小早川＊▲も来てたのか。買い物？: Oh, you're here too, ▲小早川＊▲？ Doing some shopping？
translations.ちょっと……ね。アンタこそワザワザこんなとこまで来て、なに買うつもり？ まさか鯖: Just a little, yeah. What about you？ You came all the way out here—what are you buying？ Don't tell me it's canned mackerel.
translations.そんなわけないだろ。単なるウィンドウショッピングだよ。: Of course not. I'm just window-shopping.
translations.だったら誘ってくれればいいのに。……ま、まだ用があるからムリなんだけど。: Then you should've invited me along. ...Well, I still have errands to run, so I couldn't have come anyway.
translations.……なんだ、残念ながら、今リンコが求めてる男はアンタじゃないんだよね……。: ...Oh. Unfortunately, you're not the guy I want right now...
translations.弟がはぐれちゃって、探してるの。: My little brother wandered off, so I'm looking for him.
translations.もしもし……うん、あっ、見つかったんだ？ うん、わかった。じゃ。: Hello...？ Yeah. Oh, you found him？ Okay, got it. Bye.
translations.弟、見つかったってさ……。それじゃ、行くね。: Sounds like they found my brother... Anyway, I'm gonna go.
translations.そっか、よかったな。バイバイ。: I see, that's a relief. Bye.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ひとりでなにしてんの？: ▲主人公＊▲. What are you doing here by yourself？
translations.▲小早川＊▲。ちょっといろいろ見てまわろうかと思ってさ。そっちこそ、ひとりじゃな: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Just thought I'd look around a bit. Aren't you by yourself too？
translations.リンコはお父さんのお遣い。急に“注文してた靴をもらってきてくれ”って。どうしても: I'm running an errand for my dad. Out of nowhere he told me to go pick up the shoes he ordered. Apparently he absolutely needs them today.
translations.そうなんだ、なんか大変だな。: Oh, I see. Sounds like a hassle.
translations.まったく、世話の焼ける父親なんだから……。: Honestly, he's such a high-maintenance dad...
translations.うわっ……なんでいるの。: Whoa... What are you doing here？
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ ●だってびっくりしたよ。なにしてるんだ？: ▲小早川＊▲! ● was surprised too, you know. What are you up to？
translations.べつに。通りかかっただけ。今日のイベントに興味あったの？: Nothing really. Just passing through. Were you interested in today's event？
translations.うーん……あるというか、ないというか。: Hmm... Kind of yes, kind of no.
translations.ヒマだから適当に来たってとこ？ でも残念、リンコは忙しいからかまってあげられない: So you were just bored and wandered over？ Well, too bad—I'm busy, so I can't keep you company. See ya.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。なんか観にきたの？: ▲主人公＊▲. Did you come to see a show or something？
translations.よぉ！ ちょっとね。▲小早川＊▲は？: Hey! Yeah, something like that. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.うん、ヴォルヴァヴィンのショーをやってるってウワサがあったから来たんだけど……誤: Yeah, I heard a rumor there was a Volvavin show going on here, so I came to check... Looks like it was a false alarm, though.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が観るのか？ 弟じゃなくて？: Wait, you wanted to watch it, ▲小早川＊▲？ Not your little brother？
translations.リンコが代わりに観てリアルに再現してあげる約束したんだよね。じゃ、弟が待ってるか: I promised I'd watch it for him and reenact the whole thing in vivid detail. Anyway, my brother's waiting, so I'm heading home.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲のリアルな再現って……見てみたかった）: (▲小早川＊▲ reenacting it in vivid detail... I kinda wanted to see that.)
translations.うん。来日中のミュージシャンを見かけた気がするんだけど、見失って。:
Yeah. I thought I spotted
a musician who's visiting
Japan, but I lost them.
translations.はは、おっかけか。▲小早川＊▲も意外と……。:
Haha, chasing after stars？
Who knew ▲小早川＊▲ was
actually...
translations.まあね、たまにはここらの連中を揉んでやらないと。:
Well, yeah. I have to school
the locals around here every
now and then.
translations.大丈夫だって。じゃ、挑戦者きたから。じゃあね。:
It's fine. Anyway, a new
challenger's here. See ya.
translations.よぉ、▲小早川＊▲。偶然だな。一緒に遊んでかないか？:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. What a
coincidence. Wanna hang
out for a bit？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ダメなんだよね……。さっき友達から連絡あってさ、今から会う約束しち:
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry, I can't...
A friend just called, and
I promised we'd meet up now.
translations.「リンコはカレシばっかで友達をないがしろにする～」なんて言われたくないしね。アン:
I don't want them saying I
ignore my friends for my
boyfriend. You wouldn't
want that either, right？
translations.（うん、友達を大事にするカノジョのほうがいいよな）:
(Yeah, it's better to have a
girlfriend who values her
friends.)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ひとりでゲーセン？:
▲主人公＊▲. At the arcade
by yourself？
translations.バレたか。えっと……こっそり練習でもしようかなと思って。:
You caught me. Uh... I was
thinking of getting some
secret practice in.
translations.そんなのリンコに言えばコーチしてあげるのに。:
If you just asked me, I'd
coach you myself.
translations.それじゃ意味ないんだよ。自力で練習して▲小早川＊▲を驚かせたいんだから。:
That defeats the purpose.
I want to practice on my own
and surprise you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ふ～ん。じゃ、期待して待ってる。リンコはいつでも挑戦受け付けてるからさ。:
Hmm. Well, I'll look forward
to it. I'm always open to a
challenge anytime.
translations.アンタって、電化製品とか興味あったっけ？:
Were you always interested
in home electronics？
translations.興味ってわけじゃないけど。家にあったら便利だろうなぁって思いながら見てることが多:
Not really. I mostly just
look around thinking how
handy it'd be to have this
stuff at home.
translations.家電コーナーか。リンコはちょっと他のフロアに用事があるから、悪いけど、行くね。:
Home appliances, huh. I have
some business on another
floor, so sorry, I'm gonna
head out.
translations.（ゲームか、ＡＶ機器コーナーだろうな……）:
(Probably the games or the
audio-visual section...)
translations.あ、アンタも来てたんだ？ ヒマつぶし？:
Oh, you're here too？
Just killing time？
translations.ヒマつぶしって決めつけんなよ。はずれてないけど……。▲小早川＊▲は？:
Don't assume I'm killing
time. You're not wrong,
though... What about you,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコはちゃんと用事があってきたの。ヒマで来たんじゃないから。:
I actually have things to do
here. I didn't just come
because I was bored.
translations.家族サービスってやつ。これも娘の務めだからね。:
Clocking in some family
time. It's part of the job
as a daughter.
translations.お兄さん、今ならポイント２０％還元ですよ。:
Hey mister, you get 20% back
in reward points right now.
translations.へへ……リンコもアンタ見つけたときは驚いたよ。:
Hehe... I was surprised when
I spotted you, too.
translations.ううん、家族で食事行くまでの時間つぶし。もうすぐこの近くで待ち合わせ。:
No, just killing time before
a family dinner. I'm meeting
up with them nearby soon.
translations.そっか、楽しんでこいよ。: I see. Have a good time.
translations.あっそ。リンコは今輸入盤のチェックに忙しいから、かまってあげられない。:
Oh, okay. I'm busy checking
the imports right now, so I
don't have time to chat.
translations.バッタリ会ったんだから、もっと驚いてよね。: We just ran into each other by chance. You could at least act a little surprised.
translations.はは、今更どこで会ったって驚かないって。: Haha, at this point, running into you anywhere wouldn't surprise me.
translations.……ところでここ、洋楽コーナーだけど？: ...By the way, you do realize this is the Western music section？
translations.いい心がけじゃん。わからないことがあったら聞いてよ。色々教えてあげるからさ。: That's the spirit. If there's anything you don't get, just ask me. I'll teach you all about it.
translations.おっ、▲小早川＊▲じゃん。どうしたんだ、こんなとこで。: Oh, hey, ▲小早川＊▲. What are you doing in a place like this？
translations.こんなとこでって……ここ、ＣＤショップだし……リンコがいても普通じゃん。: What do you mean, "a place like this"...？ It's a CD shop. It's totally normal for me to be here.
translations.でも、ここＪ－ＰＯＰコーナーだぞ？: Yeah, but this is the J-Pop section, you know？
translations.えっと……弟の……そうそう、弟が好きな曲があってさ、探しに来たの。じゃあね。: Um... my little brother's... Yeah, right, there's a song my brother likes, so I came to look for it. See ya.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。▲小早川＊▲もここに来たのか？: ▲小早川＊▲. Did you come here too, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.違うよ、ちょっと通りかかっただけ。それよりさ、アンタってやっぱ……ロリコン？: No, I was just passing by. More importantly, are you actually... a lolicon？
translations.堂々と美少女ポスターの前に立ってるから、てっきりそうかと思った。: You were standing right out in the open in front of a cute girl poster, so I figured you must be.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。いいところに。……ねえ、アンタってここの常連？ 店員と知り合い？: ▲主人公＊▲. Good timing. ...Hey, are you a regular here？ Do you know the staff？
translations.弟が欲しがってたオモチャがあったんだけど、キープとか頼めないかなって。: They have a toy my little brother's been wanting, and I was wondering if I could ask them to put it on hold.
translations.へえ、レアなのか？ じゃあ頼んでみるか。: Oh yeah？ Is it rare？ Let's go ask them, then.
translations.ホント？ やった、助かるよ。: Really？ Great, that's a big help.
translations.あれ、▲小早川＊▲。アニメショップに来たりするんだ？: Huh, ▲小早川＊▲？ I didn't know you came to anime shops？
translations.こっち方面に用があるときは覗くんだよね。たまにカワイイ猫グッズがあったりすんの。: Whenever I have errands around here, I take a peek inside. Sometimes they have cute cat stuff.
translations.そうなんだ。今日はいいのあった？: I see. Did you find anything good today？
translations.今日はあんまり見当たらなかった。じっくり探してる時間もないしね。: I didn't really see much today. And I don't have time to look around carefully anyway.
translations.じゃあ、●もチェックしといてやるよ。: In that case, ● can keep an eye out for you too.
translations.へへ、よろしく。: Hehe, thanks. I'll count on you.
translations.わっ……▲小早川＊▲！ ここでなにしてるんだよ？: Whoa... ▲小早川＊▲! What are you doing here？
translations.リンコはただの通りすがり。用があるからのんびりしてらんないけど……。: I'm just passing by. I've got things to do, so I can't stick around long, though...
translations.そっか、じゃあもう行ったら？: I see. Well, shouldn't you get going, then？
translations.アンタのあわてかた、なんか怪しい。: You're acting awfully flustered. It's kind of suspicious.
translations.別にあわててないって……。ほら、用事あるんだろ。行かなくていいのか？: I'm not flustered at all... Come on, you have errands to run, right？ Shouldn't you be going？
translations.言われなくても行くし。……やっぱ怪しいんだよねぇ。ま、いいけど。: I was going to leave without you telling me. ...Still, you're definitely acting suspicious. Well, whatever.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。もしかして、この店に入るの？: ▲主人公＊▲. Don't tell me you're going into this shop？
translations.えっ!? ああ……入ってみるのもいいかもな、はは。: Huh？! Oh... yeah, I thought maybe I'd check it out, haha.
translations.入りたかったら堂々と入ればいいじゃん。: If you want to go in, just go right on in.
translations.別に、どうしても入りたいってわけじゃ……。▲小早川＊▲はどこか行く予定だったんじ: It's not like I'm dying to go in or anything... Didn't you have somewhere to be, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.あっ、そうだった。まったく……アンタが妙なとこにいるから。: Oh, right, I did. Jeez... it's your fault for hanging around such a weird place.
translations.「早く帰ってきてくださいね、ご主人さま▼」……こんなカンジ？: "Please come back soon, Master▼" ...Something like that？
translations.バイトでもしよっかなぁと思って。この店、たまに猫耳イベントやってんの。その日はス: I was thinking I might get a part-time job here. They do cat-ear events sometimes, and the whole staff wears them that day.
translations.ええっ、バイト!? ここで？ ▲小早川＊▲が？: What, a job！？ Here？ You, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.……ウソに決まってんじゃん。リンコが接客嫌いなの知ってるでしょ？ じゃあ、用があ: ...Obviously I'm kidding. You know I hate dealing with customers, right？ Anyway, I've got stuff to do, so I'm leaving.
translations.わっ、▲小早川＊▲か。……信心深いっていうか、静かなところに来たかっただけだよ。: Whoa, ▲小早川＊▲. ...It's not that I'm devout, I just wanted to come somewhere quiet.
translations.へえ。ま、リンコもわりと好きだから、気持ちわかるけど。: Huh. Well, I actually kind of like it here too, so I get it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲もリフレッシュしにきたのか？: Did you come here for a breather too, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコは読書に没頭しにきた。家にいると弟が気になって……。だから、アンタもジャマ: I came here to get lost in my book. At home, my little brother's too much of a distraction... So don't you bother me either.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲だ。ウロウロして、どうしたんだろ？）: (It's ▲小早川＊▲. Why is she pacing around like that？)
translations.（おっと、見失う！）: (Whoops, I'm gonna lose sight of her！)
translations.子猫の声がしたから探してたんだけど……隠れちゃったかな？: I heard a kitten mewing, so I was looking for it... Maybe it hid somewhere？
translations.そうだ！ ミルクとかあればつられて出てくるかも……。じゃ、取りに帰るから。バイバ: I know！ If I had some milk or something, it might come out... Okay, I'm going home to get some. Bye.
translations.（ある意味、忙しそうだな……）: (She sure looks busy, in a way...)
translations.のんびり散歩？: Out for a nice, slow walk？
translations.ああ、そんなとこかな。▲小早川＊▲は？: Yeah, something like that. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコも散歩してた。でもさっきお父さんから連絡きたから、もう行かなきゃ。: I was taking a walk too. But my dad just got hold of me, so I have to go.
translations.そっか。今度はふたりでのんびりしに来ような。: Gotcha. Let's come take it easy here together next time.
translations.おお！ たまにはいいかなぁと思ってね。: Yeah！ I figured it'd be nice once in a while.
translations.へえ。カノジョは誘ってくれないんだ？: Huh. Not gonna invite your girlfriend？
translations.付き合ってくれるのか？ だったら、今から一緒にやろうよ。: You'll join me？ Then let's play a game together right now.
translations.残念。リンコはこれから大切な用事があるんだよねぇ。: Too bad. I've got something important to do after this.
translations.ああ、うん。友達と約束あるから。: Oh, yeah. I have plans with a friend.
translations.ところでさ、ボウリングってなにが楽しいの？ 遠くに向かってボール転がすだけじゃん: By the way, what's so fun about bowling？ All you do is roll a ball at stuff far away.
translations.転がすだけじゃないだろ。ピンに当てて、倒して……。: You don't just roll it. You hit the pins, knock them down...
translations.……ピンに当たるとは限んないでしょ。だからさ……。: ...Assuming it even hits the pins. That's my point...
translations.▲小早川＊▲。寂しそうって……これでも楽しんでるつもりだぞ。: ▲小早川＊▲. "Lonely"？ ...I'm actually having a good time here, you know.
translations.リンコ用事あるんだけど……まあ少しだけなら見ててあげる。がんばれがんばれ。: I have stuff to do, though... Well, I can watch for a little bit. Go, go, do your best.
translations.えーっと、そうだな……それもいいかもしれないな。:
Uh, well... I guess that's
not a bad idea.
translations.ふ～ん。ま、結構ヒトカラ人口多いらしいしね。悪くはないと思うけど。:
Hmm. Well, lots of people go
solo these days, apparently.
Nothing wrong with that.
translations.（バカにされなくてよかった……）:
(Glad she didn't make fun
of me...)
translations.ああ、アンタか。カラオケ行くの？:
Oh, it's you. Going to
karaoke？
translations.うん……。▲小早川＊▲は？ ヒマだったら一緒に行かないか？:
Yeah... What about you,
▲小早川＊▲？ Wanna come with
me if you're free？
translations.残念ながら、ヒマじゃないんだよね。今度、時間があるときに誘ってよ。:
Too bad, I'm actually busy.
Ask me some other time when
I'm free.
translations.そうかな？ 住んでるところそんなに離れてないんだし。遊びに行く場所なんてだいたい:
Is it？ We don't live that far
apart. Everyone hangs out at
the same places anyway.
translations.まあ、そうなんだけどさ。なんか嬉しいだろ、こういうの。:
Well, yeah, sure. Still,
it's nice running into you
like this, right？
translations.うん……わかんなくもないけどね。:
Yeah... I guess I get what
you mean.
translations.こういうとこってさ、カノジョと来るもんじゃないの？:
Aren't you supposed to come
to places like this with
your girlfriend？
translations.へへ。そのカノジョが参上！:
Hehe. And here's that
girlfriend now!
translations.家族で。でも弟が寝ちゃってさ、もう帰んないと。:
My family. My little brother
fell asleep though, so we've
gotta head home.
translations.そっか。家族団らんって感じだな。:
I see. A nice little family
outing, huh.
translations.なんだ、気づいてたのか。誰と話してたの？:
Oh, you noticed me. Who were
you talking to？
translations.アンケートに協力してくれって、断ったけど。:
Wanted me to fill out a
survey. I said no, though.
translations.まあね、リンコは大人だから、しつこくされてもすぐに蹴ったりはしないよ。:
Yeah. I'm mature, so I don't
just kick people right away
even if they get pushy.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。こういう場所、ひとりで来るほど好きだっけ？:
▲小早川＊▲. Do you even like
places like this enough to
come by yourself？
translations.友達に誘われてさ。デートの下見だって。:
A friend invited me. Says
she's scouting for a date.
translations.へえ。●も下見しときたいな。:
Huh. ● should scout it
out too.
translations.今日はダメだよ。女同士で、女目線のデートプランを考えるんだから。:
No can do today. It's just us
girls planning a date from a
girl's perspective.
translations.女目線のスポット……。:
A date spot from a girl's
perspective...
translations.なんかヘンなこと考えてない？ ……まあいいや、じゃあね。:
You're not thinking anything
weird, are you？ ...Whatever,
see ya.
translations.よっ！ ちょっと、ここでお茶でもしようかと思ってさ。:
Hey! Just thought I'd grab
some tea here or something.
translations.そっか。ここの新デザート、すっごく美味しいって評判なんだよね。:
Oh, yeah？ I hear their new
dessert is supposed to be
really good.
translations.へえ。一緒に食べてく？:
Oh yeah？ Wanna get some with
me？
translations.行きたいのは山々だけど、今日はちょっとね。食べたら感想教えてよ。:
I'd love to, but I can't
today. Let me know how it is
if you get it.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ちょっとね。ところで、アンタって一人でお茶するの好きなタイプ？:
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah, just out
and about. Anyway, do you
like going to cafes alone？
translations.好きってことはないけど……まあ、ぼちぼち。:
I wouldn't say I love it,
but... every now and then.
translations.ふーん、寂しいからって泣かないでね。今度カノジョが暇なときに付き合ってあげるから:
Hmm, don't go crying 'cause
you're lonely. Your girlfriend
will join you when she's free.
translations.今だけね。これから友達と約束あるから。アンタは？: Just for now. I'm meeting up with a friend soon. What about you？
translations.●は、ヒマだしお茶でも飲もうかと思って。: ● had some free time, so I thought I'd grab some tea.
translations.そんなの家で飲めばいいじゃん。: You could just drink that at home.
translations.自分でいれるのとは味が違うんだよ。: It tastes different from when I make it myself.
translations.へえ、別にいいんだけどさ。じゃ、ごゆっくり。: Huh. Well, whatever makes you happy. Enjoy yourself.
translations.どうした？ お茶してくのか？: What's up？ Stopping for some tea？
translations.ううん、通りかかっただけ。もう帰らないと。: No, I was just passing by. I need to head home.
translations.そうなのか。悪かったな、ひきとめて。: Oh, okay. Sorry for holding you up.
translations.いいよ、別に。それじゃあ、また。: It's fine, don't worry about it. See you later.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。お茶しに来たのか？: ▲小早川＊▲. Did you come to get some tea？
translations.違うよ、この近くでちょっと用事。アンタはひとりでお茶すんの？: No, I just had an errand nearby. Are you getting tea by yourself？
translations.へえ。なんかそういうの、大人っぽいじゃん……。: Huh. That's kind of grown-up of you...
translations.惚れ直した？: Falling for me all over again？
translations.やっぱりアンタか……へへ。外食？: Thought that was you... Hehe. Eating out？
translations.ああ、外食ばっかじゃ体には良くないんだろうけどな。: Yeah. Eating out all the time probably isn't great for me, though.
translations.アンタの場合、家で鯖缶ばっか食べてるよりは外食したほうが体に良さそうだけどね。: In your case, eating out is probably healthier than living off canned mackerel at home.
translations.……鯖缶ばっか食べてるわけじゃないけどな。: ...It's not like canned mackerel is all I eat.
translations.せめて栄養バランス考えて注文するように。じゃ、またね。: At least try to order something well-balanced. See you later.
translations.うん。ここの味、わりと好きだしな。: Yeah. I really like the food here.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が作ってくれるのが一番だけど。: Though nothing beats what you make for me, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.バーカ。おだててるつもり？ もう行くからっ。: Idiot. Are you trying to flatter me？ I'm leaving.
translations.わっ……びっくりしたぁ。▲小早川＊▲こそ、どこ行くんだ？: Whoa... You startled me. Where are you headed, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコは家族で食事。今日は珍しくお父さんが時間あるっていうから。: Out to eat with my family. My dad actually has time today for once.
translations.へえ。でも今は一緒じゃないのか？: Oh yeah？ You're not with them right now, though？
translations.現地集合だもん。じゃ、行ってくる。: We're meeting at the restaurant. Anyway, I'm off.
translations.いいなぁ。アンタは気ままにひとりで食事か……。: Must be nice. Just eating all by yourself without a care...
translations.えっ？ ああ、▲小早川＊▲か。一人より、家族で食べるほうが美味しいだろ？: Huh？ Oh, hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Food tastes better with family than alone, doesn't it？
translations.そんなことないよ。野菜食べろって言われるし、弟には好きなオカズとられちゃうし……: Not really. They nag me to eat my vegetables, and my little brother steals my favorite side dishes...
translations.子どもみたいな理由だな。お母さんの作ってくれる料理は美味しいんだろ？: You sound like a little kid. Your mom's cooking is good, isn't it？
translations.うん、まあね。じゃあそういうわけで、美味しいご飯食べに帰るよ。: Yeah, I guess. Anyway, I'm heading home for some of that good cooking.
translations.（なんだかんだ言って、満足してるんだな）: (For all her complaining, she's pretty happy with it.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲、ちょうどよかった。今から食事行こうと思うんだけど、一緒にどう？: ▲小早川＊▲, good timing. I was just about to go get something to eat. Wanna join me？
translations.残念……。リンコ、さっき食べたばっかだし。: Too bad... I just ate a little while ago.
translations.じゃあ、●は食事するから▲小早川＊▲はお茶とデザートだけでも……。: Then how about ● get a meal, and you just have tea and dessert, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.ごめん、今から友達の家に行く約束しちゃったんだよね。: Sorry, I promised I'd head over to a friend's house right now.
translations.そっか……。じゃあ、あきらめるか。: Oh, okay... Guess I'll give up on that, then.
translations.もしかして、リンコがこのへんにいるの知ってた？: Wait, did you know I was around here？
translations.まさか。偶然だよ。: No way. It's just a coincidence.
translations.あれっ……なんでいるの？: Huh...? What are you doing here？
translations.なんでって言われても……。そっちこそ、なんで？: What do you mean, what am I doing here...? What about you？
translations.もうっ。こっちが先に質問したんだから、アンタが先に答えるのがルールじゃん。: Geez. I asked first, so the rule is you have to answer first.
translations.●は……散歩だ！: ● just... came out for a walk!
translations.つまり、ヒマなわけね。リンコは……しまった！ 遅刻しちゃうじゃん。じゃあね！: So in other words, you've got nothing to do. As for me... Crap! I'm gonna be late. See ya!
translations.（で、●の質問に答えてないぞ……）: （And she didn't even answer the question ● asked...）
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ ……待ち合わせしてたっけ？: ▲小早川＊▲! ...Wait, did we have plans to meet up？
translations.へへっ、ウソウソ。アンタが見えたからさ、驚かしてやろうと思っただけ。: Hehe, just kidding. I spotted you and thought I'd catch you off guard.
translations.なんだぁ……約束忘れてたらどうしようって、かなりヒヤヒヤしたぞ。: Oh, come on... You had me seriously sweating that I'd forgotten our plans.
translations.ホントの約束を忘れたときは、容赦なくキックだからね。: If you ever forget real plans, you're getting a kick with no mercy.
translations.約束もしてないのにバッタリ会うってさ、赤い糸で結ばれてるって感じしない？: Running into each other without even planning it... Doesn't it feel like we're tied by the red string of fate？
translations.ちょ……冗談だっつーの。そんな真顔で言われたら、こっちが恥ずかしくなるじゃん……: W-Wait... I was only joking. When you say it with a straight face like that, it makes me embarrassed...
translations.せっかくだから、このままデートする？: Since we're both here, want to just go on a date？
translations.ダメ！ リンコは予定があるの。じゃあね。: No can do! I've got plans. See ya.
translations.偶然だね？ なんか、ヘンな感じ……。: What a coincidence, huh？ Feels kind of weird...
translations.ほんと。嬉しいような、恥ずかしいような。: Tell me about it. Part of me is happy, part of me is embarrassed.
translations.へへ、話し込んじゃった。もう行かなきゃ。: Hehe, we got carried away talking. I really need to get going.
translations.おお、▲小早川＊▲。もしかして、ヒマ？: Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. Are you free right now, by any chance？
translations.そんな風に見える？ 残念ながら、今すぐ帰んなきゃダメなんだよね。: Do I look like it？ Hate to break it to you, but I have to head straight home right now.
translations.そう期待通りにはいかないか。: Guess things don't go my way that easily.
translations.こっちの話。じゃあ、またな。: Nothing, just talking to myself. See you later.
translations.へへ……なんかアンタに会うような気がしてたんだよね。: Hehe... For some reason, I had a feeling I'd run into you.
translations.へえ。●もちょっと、そんな気がしてたかも。: Huh. ● kind of had a feeling like that, too.
translations.ほんとに？ アンタってそんなに調子よかったっけ。: Really？ Since when were you such a smooth talker？
translations.あ、もう行かなきゃ……。バイバイ。: Oh, I have to get going... Bye-bye.
translations.うん。ちょっとね、お遣い。お母さんは弟の面倒見てるからさ。: Yeah. Just running a quick errand. Mom's busy looking after my little brother.
translations.いいよ、大したことじゃないし。なんか悪いし。じゃあね。: It's fine, it's nothing big. I'd feel bad anyway. See ya.
translations.今、あの女の人見てたでしょ……。: You were just looking at that woman, weren't you...
translations.リンコがこんなに近くにいたのに気づかないとか……。: You didn't even notice me, and I was standing right here...
translations.たまたまボーっとしてたんだよ。: I was just spacing out, that's all.
translations.あっそ。ま、いいけど……じゃ、リンコ急ぐから。: Uh-huh. Well, whatever... Anyway, I'm in a hurry.
translations.（びっくりしたけど……とりあえず、納得してくれたんだよな？）: (That gave me a scare, but... she bought it for now, right？)
translations.アンタって、すきだらけだね。: You really leave yourself wide open.
translations.やっぱり▲小早川＊▲かぁ。: I knew it was you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……っと、もう行かなきゃ。友達と約束してるんだ。: ...Oh, I have to get going. I'm meeting up with a friend.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。アンタって嫌いな食べ物あったっけ。: ▲主人公＊▲. Do you have any foods you hate？
translations.●は……あ、▲小早川＊▲はグリンピース嫌いなんだっけ？ 給食で残してたよな。: ●... Oh, don't you hate green peas, ▲小早川＊▲？ You used to leave them behind at school lunch.
translations.は!? なんでそれ…………質問してるのはこっち！: Huh！？ How do you know that...... I'm the one asking the questions here!
translations.食べられなくて先生に怒られて、泣きそうになったりな。: You couldn't eat them, so the teacher scolded you and you almost cried.
translations.適当に見てきたようなこと言うなっつーの！: Stop making stuff up like you saw it happen!
translations.弟が見てるアニメがさ、打ち切りになったんだよね。: That anime my little brother watches got canceled.
translations.へえ、世知辛いな。: Man, it's a harsh world out there.
translations.ほんと、夢を与えるはずのアニメなのにさ、切ないったら。: Seriously. Anime is supposed to give kids dreams, so it's pretty depressing.
translations.はぴかむりんこは打ち切られないといいな！: I hope Happy Come Rinko doesn't get canceled!
translations.…………はあ、アンタの妄想アニメの話ですか。: ......Sigh. Are you talking about some anime you made up in your head？
translations.時代劇って、結構面白いよね。弟と一緒に見ると、チャンバラごっこに付き合うのが大変: Period dramas are actually pretty good. Though when I watch them with my brother, getting roped into playing sword fights with him is a pain.
translations.あー、やっぱ▲小早川＊▲はやられ役なのか？: Ah, so are you stuck playing the one who gets cut down, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そうそう。やられた～……がくり。……なんて感じで……。: Yeah, pretty much. Like, "You got me..." Flop. ...Something like that...
translations.!? 死ぬな、小早川先生！ しっかりしろー！: ！？ Don't die, Master Kobayakawa! Hang in there!
translations.いや……そこまで真剣にやられると、ちょっと……。: Uh... When you get that into it, it's a little much...
translations.はっ……あれは夢か……。: Huh... Wait, was that a dream...？
translations.昨日さ、珍しく弟に女の子向けっぽい本を読んであげたんだよね。: Yesterday, for a change, I read my little brother a book that's more for girls.
translations.シンデレラ、白雪姫、人魚姫……。: Cinderella, Snow White, The Little Mermaid...
translations.▲小早川＊▲の場合、親指姫じゃないのか？ ほら、サイズ的にも。: In your case, ▲小早川＊▲, wouldn't it be Thumbelina？ You know, size-wise.
translations.赤ちゃんってさ、可愛いよね。: Babies are pretty cute, aren't they？
translations.へえ、赤ちゃん欲しいのか？ ▲小早川＊▲の子供はきっと……。: Oh, do you want a baby？ I bet ▲小早川＊▲'s kid would be...
translations.ネコの赤ちゃんの話だっつーの！: I was talking about baby cats!
translations.リンコもさ、数年後にはもう働いてたりするんだよね。: In just a few years, I'll probably be out working a job too.
translations.どうした、急に。: What brought that on all of a sudden？
translations.ふと思ったわけ。社会人のリンコってどんな感じかなーって。結構真面目にやれたりして: It just crossed my mind. I was wondering what I'd be like as a working adult. Maybe I'd actually take it pretty seriously？
translations.いて！ だからそれやめないと無理だって！: Ow! See, you'll never make it if you don't stop doing that!
translations.はは、何言ってるんだよ。お前のことだろ、ヘイ、リンダ。: Haha, what are you talking about？ It's you! Hey, Linda.
translations.なあ、▲小早川＊▲のキックってさ……。: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲, about those kicks of yours...
translations.違う！ なんで小キックなんだ？ 中とか大とかあんの？: No! Why is it a light kick？ Do you have medium and heavy kicks too？
translations.（なんか聞いちゃいけない気がする……ヘンな夢も見たし）: (I have a feeling I shouldn't ask... especially after that weird dream I had.)
translations.は、なんで邪魔すんの。: Huh？ Why are you getting in my way？
translations.▲小早川＊▲は可愛がってるつもりでもな、可愛がられる方は迷惑かもしれないだろ。相: You might think you're just showing some love, ▲小早川＊▲, but the one on the receiving end might hate it. You have to think about their feelings too.
translations.なにそれ、感じ悪いんですけど。ネコだって幸せに決まってるじゃーん。: What's your problem？ That's pretty rude. Obviously the cat's happy about it.
translations.なに、なんでそんな驚くの。: What？ Why do you look so shocked？
translations.せっかくだから、ここで写真でも撮ろうか。: While we're here, want to take a picture？
translations.▲小早川＊▲。ここで写真撮らない？: ▲小早川＊▲. Want to take a picture here？
translations.いいよ。今度はどんなポーズがいいかな。: Sure. What kind of pose should I do this time？
translations.祭りっぽいポーズってある？ 普通でいいの？: Is there such a thing as a festival pose？ Or is normal fine？
translations.ふーん、やっぱこういう格好がレアショットってやつなわけ？: Hmm, so an outfit like this counts as a rare shot, huh？
translations.“お菓子くれないと、イタズラしちゃうぞ？” こんな感じでどう？: 'Give me candy or I'll play a trick on you!' How's that？
translations.せっかくだから文化的な写真、撮ってね？: Make sure you take a nice, cultural-looking photo, okay？
translations.旅の思い出、たくさん写真に残そうね。: Let's take lots of pictures to remember our trip.
translations.へへ。やっぱクリスマスは特別な日だしさ。かわいく撮ってね。: Hehe. Christmas is a special day, after all. Make sure I look cute, okay？
translations.今年最初の写真はリンコでね▼: Make sure I'm your first photo of the year, okay？▼
translations.毎年こうして撮ってもらえたら、いい記念になるね。: If you take my picture like this every year, it'll make a nice keepsake.
translations.これも記念写真、ってことになるのかな。失敗しないでよ？: I guess this counts as a commemorative photo too. Don't mess it up, okay？
translations.ね。ちゃんと周りの景色も入ってる？: Hey, are you getting the scenery around me in the shot too？
translations.屋台いっぱい出てるね。: There are so many food stalls out.
translations.どこか寄りたいとこある？: Anywhere you want to stop by？
translations.そうだな……じゃあ、あれ！: Let's see... How about that one!
translations.へえ、美味そうだな。▲メニュー▲。: Oh, that looks good, ▲メニュー▲.
translations.うん、美味しいよ、食べる？: Yeah, it's really good. Want some？
translations.うん、美味い！ ごちそうさま。: Yeah, that's good! Thanks for the bite.
translations.せっかく来たんだからさ、何か食べたい物ある？: Since we're here, is there anything you feel like eating？
translations.やっぱり屋台なら、これ食べないと。: When it comes to food stalls, you've gotta go with this.
translations.おいし。カレシに食べさせてもらうとなおさらね。へへ。: That's good. Tastes even better when my boyfriend feeds me. Hehe.
translations.お弁当作ってきたんだけどさ……食べる？: I made us lunch today... Want to eat？
translations.はしゃぎ過ぎだっつーの。カノジョだし、お弁当くらいはね。: You're making way too big a deal out of it. I'm your girlfriend, so making lunch is no big thing.
translations.あのさ……お腹すいたよね。お弁当作ってきたんだけど。: Hey... you must be hungry, right？ I brought a lunch I made.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が作ったの？ もちろん食べるよ！: You made it, ▲小早川＊▲？ Of course I'll eat it!
translations.そんなにあわてなくても、お弁当は逃げないっつーの。: Slow down, the food isn't gonna run away.
translations.がんばって、お弁当作ってきたんだ。食べてくれるよね？: I worked really hard making lunch today. You'll eat it, right？
translations.もちろん！ ▲小早川＊▲の手作りか、楽しみだな。: Of course! A homemade lunch from ▲小早川＊▲... I can't wait.
translations.そんなに喜んでくれると……へへ、うれしい。さあ、めしあがれ。: Seeing you that excited about it... hehe, makes me happy. Here, dig in.
translations.誕生日だったじゃん。ホントは当日に渡したかったんだけど。: It was your birthday, right？ I really wanted to give this to you on the actual day, though.
translations.ほら、記念日だったじゃん。だからそのプレゼント。: Look, it was our anniversary, remember？ So here's a present for it.
translations.クリスマスプレゼント。当日に渡せなかったからさ。:
Your Christmas present.
I couldn't give it to you
on the day of, so...
translations.ちょっと過ぎちゃったけどさ、バレンタインのプレゼント。:
It's a little late, but
here's your Valentine's
present.
translations.やっぱそっか。へへ、ありがと。:
I thought you might.
Hehe, thanks.
translations.ありがとう。うれしいよ。:
Thank you.
That makes me happy.
translations.喜んでくれたんなら、よかったよ。大切にしてね。:
As long as you like it,
I'm glad. Take good care
of it, okay？
translations.じゃ、そういうことで。来年はちゃんと当日に会うようにしようね。:
Anyway, there you go.
Let's make sure we meet up
on the actual day next year.
translations.そうだな、ごめん。プレゼントありがとうな。:
Yeah, sorry about that.
And thanks for the present.
translations.ホワイトデー過ぎちゃったけど、お返しにこれ。:
White Day's already passed,
but here's something
in return.
translations.ううん、気にしてない。ちゃんと用意してくれてたんだ、ありがと。:
No, I don't mind.
You still got something
for me. Thanks.
translations.これ誕生日プレゼント……って遅いよな。:
Here's your birthday
present... A bit late,
though, huh.
translations.もうとっくに過ぎてるんですけど？:
It's already way past
my birthday, you know？
translations.ごめん！ 忘れてたわけじゃないんだ。:
Sorry! It's not like
I forgot about it.
translations.べつに怒ってなんかないよ。でも、来年は一緒に過ごすこと。約束だよ？:
I'm not mad or anything.
But next year, we're gonna
spend it together. Promise？
translations.（そういえば▲小早川＊▲の誕生日過ぎちゃったけど、今からでもなにかできないかな…:
(Come to think of it,
▲小早川＊▲'s birthday's passed,
but isn't there something
I can still do now...？)
translations.付き合う前のことだし、別に渡さなくてもいいかなって思ったんけど……まあ、一応。:
We weren't dating yet then,
so I thought about skipping
it... but well, here.
translations.そんなに気使わなくてもいいけど……でもやっぱすげえうれしいよ。:
You didn't have to go out
of your way... but honestly,
that makes me super happy.
translations.うん……そっか。へへ。じゃあね。:
Yeah... I see. Hehe.
See you later.
translations.そういえばさ、来週だよ。気づいてる？:
By the way, it's next week.
Did you notice？
translations.２人がつきあい始めた記念日。忘れてないよね？:
The anniversary of when we
started dating. You haven't
forgotten, right？
translations.ならいいけど。せっかくだからさ、何か思い出に残ることしようよ。:
Good. Since it's a special
occasion, let's do something
memorable.
translations.だってさ、普通にデートするだけだと、いつもと変わりないし。:
I mean, just going on a
normal date wouldn't be any
different from usual.
translations.記念におそろいの何か買うとか！:
How about buying matching
stuff to celebrate!
translations.なにそれ、恥ずかしいっつーの。却下。:
What's with that？ That's way
too embarrassing. Rejected.
translations.もう少し考えてみよっか。２人でこういう相談するのも楽しいじゃん。:
Let's think a little more.
Planning things like this
together is fun, anyway.
translations.記念日さ、やっぱりいいかも。おそろいのグッズ。:
About our anniversary...
maybe matching stuff isn't
a bad idea after all.
translations.お、そっか。じゃあ何にするかな……。:
Oh, yeah？ Then I wonder
what we should get...
translations.ならさ、明日一緒にショッピングモールに行って、２人で決めたいな。……どう？:
Then let's go to the mall
together tomorrow and pick
something out. ...Sound good？
translations.相談しながらプレゼントを選ぶ、か。……うん、いいな、それ。:
Picking out presents
together, huh. ...Yeah,
I like the sound of that.
translations.でしょ？ きっと楽しいと思うんだよね。:
Right？ I bet it'll be
a lot of fun.
translations.でもなんで考えが変わったんだ？ 却下されたじゃん。:
Wait, why the change of
heart？ You shot it down
before.
translations.それはまあリンコにも思うところがあるっていうか。実際に日が近づくと、そういう気分:
Well, I had second thoughts.
When the day gets closer,
you get in that mood, right？
translations.それは……恋人っぽい気分ってやつ。:
You know... the whole
being-a-couple mood.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。どこから回るか考えてきた？:
▲小早川＊▲. Have you thought
about where to look first？
translations.まだだけど。……ちょっと張り切りすぎじゃない？:
Not yet. ...Aren't you a bit
too eager about this？
translations.そんなにあわてなくても。ゆっくり時間をかけて選びたいじゃん、プレゼントって。:
There's no need to rush.
We want to take our time
picking out presents, right？
translations.……それもそうか。ゆっくりいくか。:
...Good point. Let's
take our time, then.
translations.遅刻じゃなくても、カノジョを待たせたりしないこと。:
Even if you're not late,
don't keep your girlfriend
waiting.
translations.よろしい。じゃ、さっそく見て回ろ？:
Good. Now then, let's go
look around, okay？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。あのさ、なににするかだいたい決めてきた？:
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, do you
have a rough idea of what
you want to get？
translations.まだだけど。▲小早川＊▲は？:
Not yet. What about you,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そうだなあ……あっ、こんなこと考えてる時間ももったいないよ。:
Let's see... Actually, it's
a waste of time just
standing here thinking.
translations.じゃ、さっそく店をいくつか回ってみるか。:
Let's go check out a few
shops right now.
translations.キーホルダー……とかは？:
What about... a keychain
or something？
translations.イニシャル刻んだり？ 観光地じゃないんだしさ、却下。:
With our initials on it？
This isn't a tourist spot.
Rejected.
translations.２人の名前を彫った皿。:
A plate with both our
names carved into it.
translations.結婚式の引き出物かっつーの。:
What is that, a wedding
favor？
translations.冗談だって。それより、▲小早川＊▲の意見は？:
I'm just kidding. Anyway,
what do you think, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.カレシのセンスを見てみようと思ってさ。観察。:
I wanted to see what kind
of taste my boyfriend has.
Just observing.
translations.２人の記念の品なんだから、２人で選ぶって言っただろ？:
It's a keepsake for both
of us. Didn't we say we'd
pick it out together？
translations.しょうがない。じゃあさ、向こうの店から見てく？:
Oh, alright. Want to start
with that shop over there？
translations.やっぱり女の子の意見って大事だな。●だけなら絶対に選べなかったよ。:
A girl's opinion really
does matter. ● alone
never could've picked this.
translations.リンコが時間をかけて選んであげたんだからさ、大切にすること。いい？:
I took the time to pick it
out for you, so take good
care of it. Got it？
translations.せっかく買うんなら、手元に残るのがいいよなー。:
If we're buying something,
it'd be nice to get
something we can keep.
translations.だね。でも、いかにもカップルー、なのは却下。:
Yeah. Anything that screams
"we're a couple" is
rejected, though.
translations.ダメなの？ 定番ってことだろ？:
No good？ Doesn't that just
mean it's a classic？
translations.定番だから嫌なの。バカップルアピールしてるみたいじゃん。:
That's why I hate it. It's
like we're showing off what
a sappy couple we are.
translations.おそろいのものを買うのもダメ？:
So buying matching things
is out, too？
translations.さりげなくおそろい、みたいな感じなら許容範囲。センスの見せ所だね。:
If they're subtly matching,
that's acceptable. Time to
show off your good taste.
translations.カノジョのために頭を悩ますのはカレシの役目。さあがんばって。:
It's a boyfriend's job to
rack his brain for his
girlfriend. Do your best.
translations.時間はかかったけど、いいものが選べて良かったな。▲小早川＊▲も気に入った？:
It took a while, but I'm
glad we got something nice.
You like it too, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.悪くないんじゃない？ カレシの努力も認めてあげないとね。:
It's not bad, I guess. I
have to give my boyfriend
credit for trying.
translations.プレゼントっていえば花が定番かな。:
When it comes to presents,
flowers are a classic.
translations.カレシからのプレゼントなら、なんでもうれしいけど。:
If it's a present from my
boyfriend, I'm happy with
anything, though.
translations.うーん、せっかくなんだから２人で選ぼうよ。何か欲しいものない？:
Hmm, since we're both here,
let's pick something out
together. Anything you want？
translations.ない……こともないけど。:
Well... I wouldn't say
there's nothing.
translations.今日は▲小早川＊▲のワガママなんでも聞くよ。:
I'll indulge whatever you
ask for today, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.モノだけじゃなくてさ……今日はゆっくり見て回りたいな。……手つないでさ。:
Not just things... I want to
take our time looking around
today. ...Holding hands.
translations.そう。プレゼント選んで終わりじゃ寂しいじゃん。ね？:
Yeah. It'd be sad if we just
picked a present and called
it a day. Right？
translations.▲小早川＊▲、なかなかプレゼント決まらないんだもんな。: You were having a hard time deciding on a present, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.いいじゃん、ちゃんと買えたんだから。結果オーライってやつ。: So what？ I got one in the end. All's well that ends well.
translations.（選んでるときの▲小早川＊▲。楽しそうだったな……）: (▲小早川＊▲ looked like she was having so much fun picking it out...)
translations.来年もまたこうして一緒に記念日を迎えられたらいいな。: I hope we can celebrate our anniversary together like this again next year.
translations.来年も？ ……気持ちが変わらなければね。: Next year too？ ...As long as your feelings don't change.
translations.リンコの気持ちは、絶対変わらないだろうけど。: Though I doubt mine ever will.
translations.言ってない。空耳。気のせい。……あっ、送るのここまででいいから。: Nothing. You're hearing things. Just your imagination. ...Oh, this is far enough.
translations.あのさ……お礼。今日……楽しかったから。: Um... this is to say thanks. Since... I had fun today.
translations.もうお別れ、か。: Time to say goodbye already, huh.
translations.そんな一生のお別れみたいな顔しないの。いつでも会えるじゃん。明日も……その先もず: Don't look like we're saying goodbye forever. We can see each other whenever. Tomorrow... and forever after that, too.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。もしかしてプレゼント気に入ってない？: ▲小早川＊▲. Did you not like the present after all？
translations.そうじゃなくて。やっぱり……ちゃんと言葉でもさ、言って欲しいわけじゃん。: It's not that. It's just... I want to hear you actually say it out loud, too.
translations.プレゼントを渡せば、それでいいと思ってたりしないよね？: You don't think just handing me a present is enough, do you？
translations.じゃあさ、特別な日には何か言うことがあるんじゃないの？: Then isn't there something you should be saying on a special day like today？
translations.そうか。……●さ、▲小早川＊▲がカノジョで本当に良かったと思ってる。: I see. ...● feel so lucky to have you as my girlfriend, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.リンコもだよ。だからさ、ほら……しないの？ 誰か来ちゃう前にさ。: Me too. So, come on... aren't you going to？ Before someone comes along.
translations.今日はありがと。思い出に残る一日だった。: Thanks for today. It was a day I'll never forget.
translations.●もだよ。また来年もこうしてお祝いできたらいいな。: ● feel the same way. I hope we can celebrate like this again next year.
translations.お店の人。リンコたちのこと、“カップルですか？”なんて言ってたね。: That clerk at the shop asked if we were a couple, didn't they.
translations.べつに恥ずかしがることないじゃん。間違ってないし。: There's nothing to be embarrassed about. It's not like they were wrong.
translations.あれ？ ▲小早川＊▲の方が恥ずかしがると思ってたのにな。: Huh？ I thought you'd be the embarrassed one, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そんなことないよ…………もう着いちゃったか。: Not at all... ...Oh, we're here already.
translations.あのさ、リンコたち恋人なんだよね？ ならさ……お別れのキス。: Hey, we're a couple, right？ Then... how about a goodbye kiss.
translations.早くしてくれないと、誰か来ちゃうじゃん。: If you don't hurry, someone's going to come along.
translations.今日はな。●は▲小早川＊▲のこと、これからもずっと好きなんだから、いつでもできる: Just for today. ● love you and always will, ▲小早川＊▲, so we can kiss anytime.
translations.もうっ……バカじゃん。そんなことわざわざ言わなくても……。: Geez... what are you, stupid？ You don't have to say stuff like that out loud...
translations.アンタの誕生日ってもうすぐだよね？: Your birthday's coming up soon, isn't it？
translations.そういえばそうか。: Now that you mention it, yeah.
translations.……もしかして自分の誕生日も覚えてないの？: ...Wait, do you not even remember your own birthday？
translations.覚えてるけど、あんまり意識してないからさ。: I remember it, I just don't really think about it much.
translations.誕生日って特別な日なのに。そんな風だと、普段と同じように過ぎていっちゃうよ？: Birthdays are supposed to be special. At that rate, it'll just pass you by like any other day, you know？
translations.と言ってもなあ。▲小早川＊▲は祝ってくれないの？: Yeah, well... Aren't you going to celebrate it for me, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.お祝いして欲しいんだ？: Oh, so you want me to celebrate it？
translations.それはまあ……カノジョに祝ってもらえたらうれしいかな。: Well, yeah... It'd make me happy to have my girlfriend celebrate it.
translations.しょうがないな。何か考えとく。: Fine, I guess I have no choice. I'll think of something.
translations.なんてね。スケジュール帳にはちゃーんと“カレシの誕生日”って、ずっと前からしるし: Just kidding. I've had "Boyfriend's Birthday" marked down in my planner for ages now.
translations.明日の夜、予定空けといてね。: Make sure you keep tomorrow night open, okay？
translations.誕生日でしょ？ もしかして……何か予定入れちゃった？: It's your birthday, isn't it？ Don't tell me... you already made plans？
translations.まだだけど。▲小早川＊▲がお祝いしてくれるの？: Not yet. Are you going to celebrate it with me, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.考えとくって言ったじゃん。だからさ、アンタんちで待ってて。: I told you I'd think of something, didn't I？ So just wait for me at your place.
translations.●んち？ てっきりどこかに行こうっていう誘いかと思ったよ。: My place？ ● thought for sure you were inviting me out somewhere.
translations.そんなのいつでもできるじゃん。誕生日は一年に一日しかないんだよ？: We can do that anytime. Your birthday only comes once a year, you know？
translations.それはそうだけど……何してくれるの？: Well, yeah, that's true, but... what are you going to do for me？
translations.それは当日のお楽しみ。リンコが忘れられない誕生日にしてあげるからね。: You'll just have to wait and see. I'm going to make it a birthday you'll never forget.
translations.（忘れられない誕生日か。楽しみだな）: (A birthday I'll never forget, huh？ I can't wait.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲……その買い物袋なに？: ▲小早川＊▲... What's with the grocery bag？
translations.もしかして……▲小早川＊▲が料理作ってくれるの？: Wait... Are you going to cook for me, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.なにその驚き方。そっか。食べたくないんだ。なら、作るのやめるけど？: What's with the shocked look？ Oh, I see. You don't want to eat my cooking. I don't have to make anything, you know？
translations.急だったから驚いただけ。もちろん食べたいよ！: I was just surprised since it was so sudden. Of course I want to eat it!
translations.じゃ、キッチン借りるから。: All right, I'm borrowing your kitchen, then.
translations.（いったいどんな料理を作ってくれるんだろうな）: (I wonder what kind of food she's going to make for me.)
translations.はい、リンコお手製の料理。……あっもう、そんなにあわてんなっつーの。: Here, homemade by yours truly. ...Hey, come on, don't be in such a rush.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が作ってくれたんだから、すぐ食べたくてさ。: You made it for me, ▲小早川＊▲, so I couldn't wait to dig in.
translations.あわてなくても逃げてかないから、ちゃんと味わって食べて。: Slow down, it's not going to run away. Make sure you actually taste it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。待ってたよ。……あれ？ 買い物袋？: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. I've been waiting for you. ...Huh？ A grocery bag？
translations.誕生日に出来合いの料理じゃ、さびしいでしょ。: Store-bought food on your birthday would be kind of sad, wouldn't it？
translations.……ってことは、▲小早川＊▲が料理作ってくれるの？: ...Does that mean you're going to cook for me, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そういうこと。キッチン借りるけど……いい？: That's right. I'm going to use your kitchen... Is that okay？
translations.ああ。好きなように使っていいよ。: Yeah. Go ahead and use whatever you need.
translations.……なに？ そんなジロジロ見てられたらやりにくいんだけど。: ...What？ It's hard to work with you staring at me like that.
translations.そうだな、うん！ じゃ、できあがるのを楽しみに待ってる。: Right, sorry! I'll just wait and look forward to when it's done, then.
translations.はい。リンコ特製の手料理。: Here you go. My own special homemade cooking.
translations.おっ、今日はなんか手が込んでない？: Whoa, didn't you go all out today？
translations.それは……まあ誕生日だしね。味は保証できないけど……どう？: Well... it is your birthday, after all. I can't guarantee how it tastes, though... How is it？
translations.へへ。お待たせ。買い物してたら遅くなっちゃった。: Hehe. Sorry for the wait. I got held up doing some shopping.
translations.忘れられない誕生日にしてあげるって言ったよね。だから、今晩はリンコが料理を作って: I told you I'd make it a birthday you'll never forget, right？ So tonight, I'm going to cook for you▼
translations.ホントに？ そりゃうれしいな。: Really？ That makes me really happy.
translations.腕によりをかけて作るからね。楽しみにしてて。: I'm going to put my all into making it, okay？ Look forward to it.
translations.（今日の▲小早川＊▲、気合い入ってる分、楽しみだな）: (▲小早川＊▲'s really fired up today, so I'm extra excited for this.)
translations.おっ、すごいな。これ全部▲小早川＊▲が作ったの？: Whoa, amazing. You made all of this, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.うん。レシピ通りだけど……口に合うといいな。ね、早く食べてみて？: Yeah. I just followed the recipe, though... I hope you like it. Come on, try some？
translations.すごくおいしかったよ。▲小早川＊▲、料理の腕あがったんじゃない？: That was really good. You've gotten better at cooking, haven't you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そっか。口に合ったんなら良かったけど。: I see. Well, I'm glad you liked it.
translations.それとさ……その後ろにあるの、もしかして●へのプレゼント？: And hey... Is that behind you a present for ●, by any chance？
translations.そうだけど。なんで渡すより先に見つけるかな。……はい、これ。: Yeah, it is. Why'd you have to spot it before I could give it to you？ ...Here.
translations.だってなかなか渡してくれないからさ。: Because you were taking so long to give it to me.
translations.リンコだって、タイミングとか考えてたんだから。どうせ渡すんだからいいけど。: I was trying to figure out the right timing, you know. Well, I was going to give it to you anyway, so whatever.
translations.誕生日にカノジョの手料理とプレゼントなんて●、幸せ者だよな。: Home-cooked food and a present from my girlfriend on my birthday... ● sure is a lucky guy.
translations.大げさ。そんなに喜ぶとかえってウソっぽいっつーの。: You're exaggerating. Getting that excited over it just makes it sound fake.
translations.ウソじゃなくて、本当にうれしいんだって。ありがとう、▲小早川＊▲。: I'm not faking it, I'm seriously happy. Thanks, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.味は保証しないなんて言って、おいしかったよ。: You said you couldn't guarantee the taste, but it was delicious.
translations.誕生日なんだからいいに決まってるじゃん。: It's your birthday, so of course I'm sure.
translations.手料理作ってもらった上に、プレゼントか。すごくうれしいよ。: A present on top of a home-cooked meal, huh. I'm really happy.
translations.そんなに喜んでくれるんだ。: You're really that happy about it, huh.
translations.そりゃカノジョにここまでしてもらえば、誰だって喜ぶよ。: Well, any guy would be happy if his girlfriend did all this for him.
translations.そっか。……なら、がんばったかいがあったかも。: I see. ...Then maybe it was worth working so hard on it.
translations.ああ、最高の誕生日になった。ありがとな。: Yeah, this has been the best birthday ever. Thanks.
translations.それはさ、カノジョだから……当然じゃん。: Well, I'm your girlfriend, so... of course.
translations.口に合うもなにも、料理おいしかったよ。: I more than liked it. The food was delicious.
translations.良かった。……実はうまくできなかったらどうしようって不安だったんだ。: Thank goodness. ...Honestly, I was worried about what I'd do if it didn't turn out well.
translations.手料理作ってもらったのに、プレゼントまで？: You already cooked for me, and you got me a present too？
translations.だって誕生日なのにプレゼントがないと変じゃない？: Well, wouldn't it be weird not to have a present on your birthday？
translations.●、手料理だけでもすごいうれしかったんだけどな。: Just the home-cooked meal alone made ● super happy, though.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が選んでくれたんだろ？ なら、気に入らないわけないよ。: You picked it out for me, right, ▲小早川＊▲？ Then there's no way I wouldn't like it.
translations.ホントに？ それじゃさ、ずっと大切にしてよ？: Really？ Then make sure you treasure it forever, okay？
translations.さてと、そろそろ帰りますか。: All right, I should probably head home soon.
translations.こんな時間まで引き留めちゃって悪い。送ってくよ。: Sorry for keeping you this late. I'll walk you home.
translations.うん……けど、やっぱいい。ひとりで帰れる。: Yeah... Actually, never mind. I can walk home by myself.
translations.それだけって……。: What do you mean, is that it...？
translations.あのさ……しないの？ カノジョが帰るのに？: Hey... Aren't you gonna do anything？ Your girlfriend's about to leave, you know？
translations.今日はありがとな。いい誕生日になったよ。: Thanks for today. It was a great birthday.
translations.……喜んでくれて良かった。じゃ。: ...I'm glad you liked it. See ya.
translations.あ……そろそろ帰らなきゃ。: Oh... I really should get going.
translations.名残惜しいのはわかるけどさ、帰らないわけにいかないじゃん？: I know you don't want me to leave, but I have to go home eventually, right？
translations.寂しがりやのカレシを持つと苦労するね、ホント。: Having a boyfriend who gets lonely so easily is rough, honestly.
translations.寂しがりやって……まあ寂しいけど。: Who're you calling lonely...？ Well, okay, I am a little lonely.
translations.そんな寂しがりやさんは、いつもみたいにしないの？ ほら……ギュッてさ……。: Then aren't you gonna do what you always do, Mr. Lonely？ Come on... hold me tight...
translations.どう？ これで寂しくないんじゃない？: How's that？ Not so lonely anymore, right？
translations.うん。今のが一番の誕生日プレゼントかも。: Yeah. That might've been the best birthday present of all.
translations.なんでそういうこと……まあ喜んでくれたんならいいけど。じゃ。: Why do you gotta say stuff like that... Well, as long as you're happy. See ya.
translations.ほら、そろそろ帰らないと親が心配するぞ。: Come on, you should head home soon or your parents'll worry.
translations.あんまり年上ぶるなっつーの。: Quit acting like you're so much older than me.
translations.あのさ、帰る前に質問……誕生日どうだった？: Hey, quick question before I go... How was your birthday？
translations.▲小早川＊▲に祝ってもらえて、うれしかったよ。: I was really happy I got to celebrate it with you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.喜んでくれて良かった。じゃあさ……今度はリンコのお願い、いい？: I'm glad you liked it. So... can I ask a favor of my own now？
translations.ごほうび。……ね。キス……しよ？: A reward. ...Come on. Can we... kiss？
translations.あのさ……忘れてたりしないよね？ そろそろなんだけど。: Hey... You haven't forgotten, have you？ It's coming up pretty soon.
translations.……本当に覚えてないの？ カノジョの誕生日忘れるなんて信じられないんですけど。: ...Do you seriously not remember？ I can't believe you'd forget your own girlfriend's birthday.
translations.冗談だよ。▲小早川＊▲の誕生日忘れるわけないだろ。: Just kidding. There's no way I'd forget your birthday, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……ごめん、催促したみたいで。でも、特別なことは必要ないからね。: ...Sorry, I didn't mean to sound like I was fishing for something. You don't need to do anything special, though.
translations.パーティとかは？: What about a party or something？
translations.小さい頃は毎年パーティ開いてもらったけど……。: My family threw me a party every year when I was little, sure, but...
translations.そういう大げさなのはいいよ。リンコは特別なことをするより、アンタと一緒に過ごせれ: I don't need anything big like that. I don't care about doing anything special, as long as I get to spend the day with you.
translations.（本当にそんなことでいいのかな……？）: (Is she really okay with just that...？)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。例えばさ、誕生日に行ってみたいところってないの？: ▲小早川＊▲. Just as an example, is there anywhere you'd like to go for your birthday？
translations.急にそんなこと言われても……特にない。: That's kinda sudden... Nowhere in particular.
translations.それっていつもと同じだよ。: That's just what we always do.
translations.いいの。そうだ、ゲーセンで格ゲーもやろ？ それで仕上げはライブ。: That's fine. Oh, let's play fighting games at the arcade, too. And then wrap it up with a live show.
translations.リンコの好きなものフルコースでどう？ 普段は全部回ること、なかなかできないからさ: How about a full course of my favorite things？ We don't usually get to hit them all in one day.
translations.充分だよ。好きなことばっかりの一日なんて、あんまり体験できないしね。: More than enough. It's not often I get a whole day of nothing but things I love.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲が行きたいんなら、それでいいのかな）: (Well, if that's where ▲小早川＊▲ wants to go, I guess it's fine.)
translations.へへ、ありがと。じゃ、早速カラオケから行っとく？: Hehe, thanks. Wanna head straight to karaoke first？
translations.それなんだけど。今日のデート、本当にいつもと同じでいいの？: About that... Are you sure you want today's date to just be the usual？
translations.いいって言ってるじゃん。それに同じじゃないよ？: I already told you it's fine. Besides, it's not the same.
translations.それはまあ……カラオケから始まってライブハウスまで、耐久レースみたいなスケジュー: Well, yeah... Starting with karaoke and going all the way to a live show, the schedule's like an endurance race.
translations.そういうこと。時間がもったいないからさ、早く行こ。: Exactly. We don't have time to waste, so let's get going.
translations.もっと普段行けないような場所、言ってくれても良かったのに。: You could've picked somewhere we don't normally get to go, you know.
translations.いいの。入ったばかりの新しい格ゲー、いち早くプレイしてみたかったんだから。: It's fine. They just got a new fighting game in, and I wanted to try it out as soon as possible.
translations.それ、べつに誕生日じゃなくてもいいんじゃないか？: Couldn't you do that on a day that isn't your birthday？
translations.うーん、まあ▲小早川＊▲が喜ぶなら、それでいいか。: Hmm, well, if it makes you happy, ▲小早川＊▲, I guess it's fine.
translations.そういうこと。今日はたっぷりもんであげるからね。: That's right. I'm gonna put you through the wringer today.
translations.誕生日だからって、そこはお手柔らかにお願いしたいな。: Even if it is your birthday, I'd appreciate it if you went easy on me.
translations.へへ。どうしよっかな？: Hehe. I wonder if I should？
translations.んー、歌ったね！: Man, we really sang a lot!
translations.飛ばすな……この後大丈夫か？: You're really going all out... Are you gonna be okay for the rest of the day？
translations.大丈夫。じゃあゲーセン行くよ！: I'm fine. Come on, off to the arcade!
translations.急がないとライブ始まっちゃうよ。: If we don't hurry, the show's gonna start.
translations.あー、よかった。今まで観た中じゃベストパフォーマンスだね。: Ahh, that was great. Easily the best performance I've seen from them yet.
translations.カラオケであれだけ歌ったあとに、ライブでシャウトだろ。もう声ガラガラ。: First we sang all those songs at karaoke, and then all that shouting at the show. My voice is completely shot.
translations.▲小早川＊▲はぜんぜん疲れてないみたいだな。ライブ中ずっと跳んでただろ？: You don't look tired at all, ▲小早川＊▲. You were jumping around the entire show, weren't you？
translations.心地良い疲れだね。リンコはこのあと、またカラオケでも大丈夫なくらいなんだけど。: It's a good kind of tired. Honestly, I could go for another round of karaoke right now.
translations.（それは勘弁してくれ……バタバタの一日だったな……）: (Please spare me... What a hectic day...)
translations.……誕生日を祝ってもらうって、なんかいいね。: ...Having someone celebrate your birthday is actually pretty nice.
translations.でも、▲小早川＊▲の家でも祝ってもらえるんじゃないの？: Doesn't your family celebrate it at home too, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.それはそれ。けど、カレシと過ごす誕生日って特別じゃん。: Well, yeah. But spending your birthday with your boyfriend is special, isn't it？
translations.そんなものだよ。だからさ……ありがと。今日はすごく楽しかった。: Of course it is. So... thanks. I had a really great time today.
translations.しかめっ面でそんなこと言う▲小早川＊▲がさ……ははっ。: It's just, seeing you say that with a scowl on your face, ▲小早川＊▲... Haha.
translations.あっ、また笑った！ いいかげん怒るよ？: Hey, you laughed again! You trying to make me mad？
translations.悪い、もう笑わないからっ！: Sorry, sorry, I won't laugh anymore!
translations.無理しなくていいんだけど？: You don't have to force yourself, you know？
translations.無理してるわけじゃないけど……疲れもしたな。: I'm not forcing myself, though... I did get pretty tired.
translations.でも楽しかったのはほんと？: Still, did you really have fun？
translations.だったら、それならいいんだ。リンコだけ楽しんでたのかなって、思ったからさ。: Okay, as long as that's true. I was worried I was the only one having fun.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が楽しそうな顔を見てるのが、●は楽しかったよ。今もさ。: Seeing ▲小早川＊▲ look so happy is what made it fun for ●. Even right now.
translations.……そんなに見つめられたら恥ずかしいじゃん。: ...It's embarrassing when you stare at me like that.
translations.はは。そんなに照れなくてもいいのに。: Haha. You don't have to get that shy.
translations.無理言って引っ張り回したんじゃないかと思ってさ。: I felt like I was being selfish and dragging you around everywhere.
translations.そんなことないよ。誕生日なんだから、▲小早川＊▲が喜んでくれればそれでいいんだよ: Not at all. It's your birthday, so as long as ▲小早川＊▲ is happy, that's all that matters.
translations.でも、さすがに疲れたんじゃない？: Still, you must be worn out, right？
translations.まあ……少しはな。でもそれ以上に楽しかったよ、ほんとに。: Well... a little. But I had way more fun than that, really.
translations.またカラオケ行っとく？: Want to go to karaoke again？
translations.そうだ、誕生日プレゼント、渡さないと。: Oh right, I need to give you your birthday present.
translations.他に誰がいる？: Who else would it be for？
translations.気遣わなくてもいいのに。今日つきあってもらっただけでうれしかったんだからさ。: You didn't have to go out of your way. Just having you spend the day with me made me happy enough.
translations.リンコに？ なんだろ。: For me？ I wonder what it is.
translations.へへ。ありがと。……中、見てもいいよね？: Hehe. Thanks. ...Mind if I open it？
translations.いいじゃん！ このセンス、リンコ好き。: Oh, nice! I really like your taste.
translations.リンコの好みよくわかってるじゃん、へー！ ありがと。: You really know what I like, huh! Thanks.
translations.リンコさ、こういうの欲しかったんだ。よくわかったね。ありがと。: I've actually been wanting something like this. You really know me. Thanks.
translations.こういうのもいいんじゃない？ ありがと。: Something like this is nice, too. Thanks.
translations.リンコってこういうイメージなんだ？ へー、新発見かも。: So this is the kind of image you have of me？ Huh, that's a new discovery.
