translations.一生懸命考えてくれたんだね。ありがと。: You put a lot of thought into this for me, huh. Thanks.
translations.えっ!? ……あのさ、これ……しょうがないか。: Huh!? ...Um, this is... Well, I guess it can't be helped.
translations.もう少しリンコの好み、わかってくれてると思ったんだけど……。: I thought you knew my tastes a little better than this...
translations.一生懸命選んでくれたのはわかるけどさ……うん、気持ちだけ受けとっておく。: I can tell you tried hard picking this out, but... yeah, it's the thought that counts.
translations.ね。家の中まで着いてくるつもり？ ここでいいよ。: Hey. Are you planning on following me all the way inside？ This is far enough.
translations.あのさ、あとちょっとだけなら時間あるけど。それと、さ……。: Um, I still have a little bit of time left. And, well...
translations.今日はこれで終わり。あのさ、また来年……リンコの誕生日お祝いしてくれる？: That's all for today. Um, next year... will you celebrate my birthday again？
translations.そんなの聞くまでもないだろ？: Do you even have to ask？
translations.そっか。……じゃ、今度こそまたね。: I see. ...Well, see you later, for real this time.
translations.あのさ……お別れの時はさ、するものじゃないの？: Um... Aren't we supposed to do that when we say goodbye？
translations.もっとリードしてくれてもいいのに。: You could take the lead a little more, you know.
translations.おやすみ。それとさ……今日はすごく楽しかった。ありがと。: Good night. Oh, and... I had a really great time today. Thanks.
translations.今日の▲小早川＊▲はやけに素直だな。: You're being awfully honest today, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そう……かな？ ね。来年の誕生日もこんな楽しい一日だといいね。: You... think so？ Hey, I hope my birthday next year is just as fun as today.
translations.今から考えとくよ。じゃあな、おやすみ。: I'll start planning it now. See ya, good night.
translations.じゃあ、ここで。お別れ、だね……。: Well, right here is fine. Time to say goodbye, huh...
translations.そんな一生の別れみたいな言い方しなくても。: You don't have to make it sound like we're parting forever.
translations.だって今日一日が楽しかった分、お別れのときは寂しいよ。: Well, today was so much fun that it makes saying goodbye lonely.
translations.来年も、その先の誕生日もずっとこんな楽しい日だといいな……。: I hope my birthday next year, and all the ones after that, are always this much fun...
translations.うん、そうだね。あのさ……ちょっとだけ……いい？: Yeah, you're right. Um... Just for a second... okay？
translations.へへ。安心した。これで今日はいい夢がみられるかもね。: Hehe. I feel better now. Maybe I'll have sweet dreams tonight.
translations.笹が街に飾ってあったね。七夕か……。: There were bamboo branches set up around town. Guess it's almost Tanabata...
translations.そういえばもう来週か。: Come to think of it, that's already next week, huh.
translations.ね。アンタはどんなお願いごとをするの？: Hey. What kind of wish are you going to make？
translations.あーずるい。……そうだ。願い事を書いた短冊を当日持ち寄ろうよ。それならいいよね？: Ugh, no fair. ...I know. Let's both bring our wish strips on the day of. That works, right？
translations.それなら……うん、ちょっと恥ずかしいけどな。: In that case... sure, though it's a little embarrassing.
translations.ダメ。ちゃんと見せ合うんだから。いい？ 絶対だからね。: Too bad. We're showing them to each other properly. Okay？ You better not back out.
translations.短冊、ちゃんと持ってきた？: Did you remember to bring your wish strip？
translations.どれ、▲小早川＊▲の願いは……。: Let's see what ▲小早川＊▲ wished for...
translations.あっもうっ、見るなっつーの。ほら、アンタの短冊は？: Hey, come on, don't look yet! What about your wish strip？
translations.よく、こんなこと……。他の人に見られたらどうすんの？: How can you write something like this...？ What if someone else sees it？
translations.見られないから、別にいいだろ？: No one's gonna see it, so what does it matter？
translations.……これがアンタの願い……なの？: ...Is this really... what you wished for？
translations.うん。……あれ、なんかまずかった？: Yeah. ...Wait, did I say something wrong？
translations.七夕だよ。織姫と彦星だよ。もうちょっと状況考えろっつーの。: It's Tanabata. Orihime and Hikoboshi. Think about the occasion a little, seriously.
translations.（なんか機嫌悪くさせちゃった……？）: (Did I put her in a bad mood...？)
translations.実はさ……短冊、用意するの忘れちゃったんだよな。: Actually... I forgot to get a wish strip ready.
translations.えっ!? 本当に？ ……信じらんない。あんなに約束したのに。: What!? Seriously？ ...Unbelievable. After you promised me like that.
translations.ごめんじゃすまないっつーの。ほら、今すぐここで書く。: 'Sorry' doesn't cut it. Come on, you're writing one right here, right now.
translations.見て見て。あのあたりが天の川だよね。: Look, look. That's the Milky Way over there, right？
translations.そうすると、あれが彦星で……あっちが織姫か。: Then that one's Hikoboshi... and that one over there is Orihime.
translations.晴れて良かったよね。愛し合う２人がちゃんと会えてさ。: I'm glad it's clear out. Now the two lovers actually get to meet.
translations.いつでも会いたいときに会える●たちは、幸せだな。: You and ● are lucky we can see each other whenever we want.
translations.あのさ、そばに行っていい？: Hey, can I come a little closer？
translations.大好きな人のもっとそばに行きたくなったの。離ればなれにならないように。: I just wanted to be closer to the person I love. So we don't get separated.
translations.それともう一つお願い、いい？: And can I ask for one more thing？
translations.七夕だからいいよ。どんなお願い？: It's Tanabata, so sure. What's your wish？
translations.へへ。彦星と織姫に見られたかな？: Hehe. Think Hikoboshi and Orihime saw us？
translations.もう十羽野神社でお祭りの準備やってるけど、もうそんな時期なんだな。: They're already setting up for the festival at Towano Shrine. Guess it's that time of year already.
translations.うーん、リンコは友達と行くよ。: Hmm, I'm going with my friends.
translations.どうして？ 一緒に行かないの？: Why？ You don't want to go together？
translations.だってさ、十羽野祭りには言い伝えがあるんだよ。: Because there's a legend about the Towano Festival.
translations.言い伝え？ たしか神社の恋愛の神様がどうとか……。: A legend？ Something about the god of love at the shrine, right...？
translations.そう。だけど、すでにカップルの２人が祭り中に神社にお参りすると、神様が嫉妬して別: Yeah. They say if a couple visits the shrine together during the festival, the god gets jealous and makes them break up.
translations.ただの言い伝えかもしれないよ。けど、万が一ってこともあるじゃん。: It might just be a legend. But you never know, right？
translations.今日から十羽野祭りだね。朝からもうにぎわってるってさ。: The Towano Festival starts today. I hear it's been crowded since this morning.
translations.そういえば▲小早川＊▲、友達と行くの？: By the way, ▲小早川＊▲, are you going with your friends？
translations.なんかさ、みんなつかまんなくて……。: Well, I couldn't get a hold of anyone...
translations.やっぱり●と行こうよ。: Let's just go together, you and ●.
translations.……それで、もし言い伝えが本当だったら？: ...And what if the legend is true？
translations.▲小早川＊▲はその言い伝えどおりに別れたカップル、知ってる？: ▲小早川＊▲, do you know any couples who actually broke up like the legend says？
translations.だろ？ ●たちの愛がそんな言い伝えごときに負けると思う？: Right？ Do you really think the love you and ● share would lose to some old legend？
translations.愛って……言ってて恥ずかしくない？ ……仕方ない。アンタがそこまでして行きたいな: Our 'love'...？ Aren't you embarrassed saying that？ ...Fine. If you want to go that badly, I'll come with you.
translations.なに？ そんなにジロジロ見て……変？: What？ Why are you staring like that... Does it look weird？
translations.ううん。▲小早川＊▲、浴衣すごく似合ってるよ。: No, not at all. The yukata looks great on you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ね。今度はあっちに行ってみようよ。金魚すくいやってるよ。: Hey, let's go over there next. They have goldfish scooping.
translations.あっ、こら。あんまり走ると危ないぞ。: Hey, slow down. It's dangerous to run like that.
translations.ねえねえ。アンタって金魚すくい得意？: Hey. Are you any good at scooping goldfish？
translations.さあ、どうだろうな。▲小早川＊▲よりは得意かもな。: Hmm, who knows. I might be better at it than you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.言うじゃん。手加減してあげないから。: Oh, big talk. I'm not going easy on you.
translations.そろそろ十羽野祭りも終わりだね。: The Towano Festival is almost over, huh.
translations.でさ……最終日は花火だって。: And, well... they're having fireworks on the last day.
translations.うん、一緒に見たい。: Yeah, I want to watch them with you.
translations.でもさ……祭りの間ずっとリンコの手、離さないでいてくれる？: But... promise you won't let go of my hand the whole time we're at the festival？
translations.もちろん。迷子になったりしたら困るもんな。: Of course. Wouldn't want you getting lost on me.
translations.そういう意味じゃないっつーの。……まあ離さないんならそれでいいけど。: That's not what I meant. ...Well, as long as you don't let go, I guess it's fine.
translations.（もしかして▲小早川＊▲。十羽野神社の言い伝えのこと、まだ心配してる……？）: (Could ▲小早川＊▲ still be worried about that legend at Towano Shrine...？)
translations.今日の浴衣すごくかわいいなと思ってさ。: I was just thinking how cute your yukata looks today.
translations.おだてても、何も出ませんけど？: Flattery won't get you anywhere, you know？
translations.そんなことより早く行こ？: Never mind that, let's get going, okay？
translations.ね。十羽野祭りの言い伝え……ホントだったらどうする？: Hey. What if the legend about the Towano Festival... really is true？
translations.またそんなこと言う。: There you go bringing that up again.
translations.（どうか神様が●たちに嫉妬しませんように）: (● just hope the gods don't get jealous of us.)
translations.なんだ、ノラ猫か。もうっ、おどかしたらめっ。: Oh, it's just a stray cat. Jeez, bad kitty, scaring me like that.
translations.この子、神社の軒下に住み着いてるのかな。: I wonder if this little guy lives under the eaves of the shrine.
translations.もしかしたら神のお使いだったりして？: Maybe it's a messenger of the gods？
translations.もしそうなら、ずいぶんかわいいお使いだね。あっ、こらくすぐったい▼: If so, that's one awfully cute messenger. Ah, hey, that tickles▼
translations.はは、神様のお使いに気に入られたんじゃないか？: Haha, looks like the gods' messenger has taken a liking to you, huh？
translations.そっか。なら、嫉妬深い神様もリンコたちの仲は認めてくれたってことかな？: Think so？ Maybe that means even a jealous god approves of the two of us？
translations.今年のお祭りもこれでおしまいなんだな……。: Guess this wraps up the festival for this year...
translations.しばらくこうしててもいい？: Can we stay like this for a little while？
translations.あのさ……何があってもリンコのそばから離れていったりしないよね？: Hey... no matter what happens, you won't ever leave my side, right？
translations.今日の▲小早川＊▲は妙に甘えるんだな。: You're being awfully clingy today, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そういうわけじゃないけど。ね、こんなとき……してくれないの？: It's not like that. Hey, at a moment like this... aren't you going to...？
translations.へへ。不思議だね。こうされると、すごく落ち着く。: Hehe. It's funny. When you do this, it really calms me down.
translations.あっ、次おっきなのがあがるよ。: Oh, a big one's going up next.
translations.今度、花火大会があるんだって。ね。行こうよ。: I heard there's a fireworks festival coming up. Hey, let's go.
translations.ああ、聞いたかも。行くか。: Yeah, I think I heard about that. Let's go.
translations.今年はかなり規模を拡大するらしいからさ、見なきゃ損だよ、これは。: Apparently they're making it way bigger this year, so we'd really be missing out if we didn't go.
translations.そっか、楽しみだな。:
Nice, I'm looking forward
to it.
translations.でも、当日は相当混むんだろうな。:
It's probably gonna be
pretty crowded that day,
though.
translations.だから、行くとしたら一番見やすい場所は、事前に調べとかないとダメみたい。:
Right, so if we're going, we
should scope out the best
spot to watch from ahead of
time.
translations.いい鑑賞スポットは、かなり競争率激しいみたいだよ？:
I hear it's pretty tough
to get a good spot, though.
translations.ベストな場所は限られてるだろうしな……。よし、●が探しとくよ。:
There can't be many prime
spots... All right, ●
will find one for us.
translations.うん、楽しみにしてる。:
Okay, I'm looking forward
to it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、遅いな。まさかいきなり迷子……？:
▲小早川＊▲'s late. Don't tell
me she got lost already...？
translations.おまたせ。……どうかした、きょとんとした顔して。:
Sorry to keep you. ...What's
wrong？ You're staring.
translations.うん……言わなかったっけ？ 着るのに時間かかっちゃったけど。……どう？:
Yeah... Did I forget to
mention it？ It took me a
while to put on. ...How do
I look？
translations.へへ。ありがと。やっぱり着てきて良かった。:
Hehe. Thanks. I'm glad I
wore it.
translations.花火があがるまで、まだ時間があるし、屋台でも見に行く？:
We still have some time
before the fireworks start.
Want to check out the
stalls？
translations.屋台も堪能したし、そろそろ行こうか。:
Well, we've had our fill of
the stalls. Ready to head
over？
translations.早くしないと、場所がなくなっちゃうかもしれないしね。:
Yeah, if we don't hurry, we
might not get a spot.
translations.はぐれないように、●の手をしっかり握って。:
Hold on tight to my hand so
● don't lose you.
translations.ああ、やっぱり生で見るとちがうな。:
Yeah, nothing beats seeing
them in person.
translations.もう少しゆっくりしたいけど、早くしないと駅が混みそうだな。:
I'd like to stick around a
little longer, but the
station's gonna get packed
if we don't hurry.
translations.そっか、残念。こう混んでちゃ、余韻にひたる暇もないね。:
Right, too bad. With a
crowd like this, you can't
even bask in the afterglow.
translations.こんな穴場があったんだ？:
There was a hidden spot
like this？
translations.▲小早川＊▲と２人きりでゆっくり見たいと思ってさ、探したんだよ。:
I wanted to watch them alone
with you, ▲小早川＊▲, so I
looked around for one.
translations.へへ。さすがだね。ありがと。:
Hehe. Leave it to you.
Thanks.
translations.おっ。そろそろ打ち上げが始まるころかな。:
Oh, looks like they're
about to start.
translations.すごい……きれい……。ね。今の見た!?:
Wow... So pretty... Hey,
did you see that one!？
translations.この位置からだと、すごい迫力だな。:
They're really impressive
from this angle.
translations.うん。まるで花火がこっちに迫ってくるみたいだね。:
Yeah. It feels like they're
coming right at us.
translations.さっきからなんで花火じゃなくて、リンコばっかり見てるの？:
How come you keep looking
at me instead of the
fireworks？
translations.▲小早川＊▲の目に花火が映ってる。:
The fireworks are reflecting
in your eyes, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.あのさ、見つめるだけ……？:
Um... Are you just going to
stare...？
translations.花火……終わったみたい……行こっか。:
Looks like... the fireworks
are over... Should we go？
translations.花火、たくさんあがったと思ったけど……終わってみるとあっという間。:
They set off so many
fireworks... but now that
it's over, it went by in a
flash.
translations.でもさ、すっごく楽しかったよね。:
Still, that was a lot of
fun, wasn't it？
translations.ね。また来年も一緒に行こうね。決定。:
Hey, let's come together
again next year. It's
settled.
translations.いいの。今から約束しとくんだから。来年も行くの。:
I don't care. We're making
the promise right now.
We're coming next year too.
translations.わかったよ。約束する。また来年も一緒に花火を見に行こう。:
All right, I promise. Let's
come see the fireworks
together again next year.
translations.さっきから世界の終わりみたいな顔して、どうした？:
You look like it's the end
of the world. What's wrong？
translations.体育祭が再来週に迫ってるでしょ。こういうの、やめにして欲しいよ。:
Sports Day is in two weeks,
right？ I wish they'd just
cancel stuff like this.
translations.学校行事なんだしさ、参加しないわけにいかないだろ。:
It's a school event, so we
don't really have a choice.
translations.拒否権を認めて欲しい。:
I wish we had the right to
veto it.
translations.またそういうこと言う。●は騎馬戦に出るんだけど、▲小早川＊▲は？:
There you go again. ● have
the cavalry battle, though.
What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.障害物競走。残ったのがそれしかなかった。:
The obstacle race. It was
the only thing left.
translations.じゃ、あきらめてがんばるしかないな。:
Guess you'll just have to
accept it and do your best.
translations.どうしてわざわざ障害物を越えていかなきゃならないわけ？ 普通に走ればいいじゃん。:
Why do we have to go out of
our way to climb over stuff？
Why not just run normally？
translations.そんな根本的なことを言われてもな……。:
Look, don't question the
whole point of the race...
translations.▲小早川＊▲。練習やってるな。:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Getting some
practice in, huh？
translations.だってさ、普通に走るだけでも疲れるのに障害って……こんな競技考えた人、バカじゃん:
Running normally is tiring
enough without obstacles...
Whoever thought of this event
is an idiot.
translations.えっ？ なんで準備運動なんかしてるの？:
Huh？ Why are you doing
warm-up exercises？
translations.▲小早川＊▲の練習につきあおうと思ってさ。:
I figured I'd join you for
practice, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.だってアンタは騎馬戦なんでしょ？ 関係ないのに。:
Wait, aren't you in the
cavalry battle？ This has
nothing to do with yours.
translations.ついで。騎馬戦に出るヤツが障害物競走の練習しちゃいけないこともないだろ？:
Just felt like it. No rule
saying cavalry battle guys
can't practice obstacles,
right？
translations.それはそうだけど……もうっ、待ってよ。リンコもやるからっ！:
Well, sure, but... Jeez,
wait up! I'm doing it too!
translations.入場行進の練習のときさ、手と足が一緒だったろ？:
In marching practice, you
moved the same arm and leg
together, didn't you？
translations.適当な嘘つくなっつーの。イヤなだけで、緊張してるわけじゃないんだし。:
Quit making stuff up. I just
hate this, okay？ It's not
like I'm nervous.
translations.予行練習なんていらないっつーの。人生ぶっつけ本番が基本でしょ。:
Rehearsals are pointless,
anyway. Life is all about
winging it on the spot.
translations.そうもいかないだろ。進行とかあるんだからさ。:
It doesn't work like that.
They've got a schedule to
keep and everything.
translations.はあ……せめてビリだけは避けたいよね。ビリになったら全校から注目されるよ、きっと:
*Sigh*... At least I want to
avoid last place. The whole
school would stare at me for
sure.
translations.大丈夫だよ。●とあれだけ練習したんだ。自信持って！:
You'll be fine. Look how much
you and ● practiced! Have
some confidence!
translations.……うん。ああ、お腹痛くなりたい。:
...Yeah. Ugh, I wish I'd get
a stomachache right now.
translations.（さてと、▲小早川＊▲の出る障害物競走は……午前中か）:
(Now then, ▲小早川＊▲'s obstacle
race is... in the morning.)
translations.（よし、応援に行かないと！）:
(Okay, I have to go cheer
her on!)
translations.▲小早川＊▲。応援しに来たぞ。:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. I came to cheer
you on.
translations.出る以上は勝たないとね。じゃないと、アンタとの練習も無駄になるし。:
If I'm competing, I have to
win. Otherwise, practicing
with you would go to waste.
translations.じゃ、そろそろ行ってくるね。一位になって戻ってくるから、期待してていいよ。:
Well, I should get going.
I'm coming back in first, so
you can count on it.
translations.おっ、▲小早川＊▲、いいとこにつけてる！ いけ、そのまま！:
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲'s in a great spot!
Go, keep it up!
translations.へへ。張り切りすぎて、コケちゃった。: Heh. Got a little too into it and tripped.
translations.ケガは!? どこか痛くないか？: Are you hurt!？ Are you okay？
translations.もうっ、大げさ。どうしてリンコより必死になってるわけ？: Geez, don't make such a big deal out of it. Why are you freaking out more than me？
translations.だから大げさ。こんなのすぐに治るよ。それよりさ……応援してくれたのにゴメン。: Like I said, it's no big deal. A scrape like this'll heal right up. Anyway... sorry, after you came to cheer for me.
translations.そんなの気にしなくていいから。ほらっ、おぶされ。保健室まで連れてってやるからさ。: Don't worry about that. Come on, hop on my back. I'll carry you to the nurse's office.
translations.次は午前最後の種目、２年生男子による騎馬戦です。: Up next is the final event of the morning: the second-year boys' cavalry battle.
translations.（よし、▲小早川＊▲ががんばったんだ。●もがんばるか！）: (Alright, ▲小早川＊▲ gave it her all. ● better give it everything too!)
translations.いよいよだね。騎馬戦。: It's finally time for the cavalry battle, huh.
translations.応援はいいけど、ケガだけはしないようにね。: I don't mind cheering, just make sure you don't get hurt.
translations.やったっ。大活躍だったじゃん。: Nice. You were amazing out there.
translations.▲小早川＊▲の応援があったからだよ。: Only because you were cheering for me, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.うんうん、わかってればいい！ でもすごかった！: Mhm, as long as you know it! Still, you were great!
translations.よし……疲れただろうし、そろそろお弁当にしよっか？: Alright... You must be tired, so how about we eat our lunch soon？
translations.接戦だったんだから、そんなに落ち込まなくてもいいよ。: It was a close match, so you don't have to look so down.
translations.せっかく▲小早川＊▲が応援してくれたのにな。: And after you cheered for me too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.いいよ、別のことでがんばればいいじゃん。: It's fine. You can just make up for it in something else.
translations.じゃ、その前にお弁当にしよ？: Anyway, let's have our lunch first, okay？
translations.（フォークダンスか、▲小早川＊▲と踊れるかな……）: (The folk dance, huh... I wonder if I'll get to dance with ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲と踊る番まで回るかな……）: (I wonder if the line will rotate far enough for me to dance with ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲まで回ればいいけど……）: (I hope I make it around to ▲小早川＊▲ in time...)
translations.……なんか照れるね、こういうの。: ...Stuff like this is kind of embarrassing.
translations.こういうのって、恥ずかしがるとかえって変に見えるんだってさ。: They say acting shy during this kind of thing actually makes you stand out more.
translations.ほら、●と同じように足を出して……うん、そう。: Here, step out just like ● do... Yeah, just like that.
translations.こう……かな。……へへ、ちょっと楽しくなってきた。: Like... this？ ...Heh, this is actually getting kind of fun.
translations.ふう……いい体育祭だったな。▲小早川＊▲も楽しんでたみたいだし。: Phew... That was a great Sports Day. Looked like you had fun too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.まあ……思ってたほどイヤじゃなかったよ。これもアンタのおかげかな。……お疲れ様。: Well... I didn't hate it as much as I thought I would. Guess I have you to thank for that. ...Good work today.
translations.今さ、校内ハロウィンパーティの参加者募集してるらしいよ？: Hey, I heard they're looking for people to sign up for the school Halloween party？
translations.へえ。学校でハロウィンパーティなんかやるんだ。: Huh. I didn't know the school threw a Halloween party.
translations.みたいだね。アンタが参加したがるかなと思って、教えてあげたんだけどどう？: Seems like it. I figured you might want to go, so I thought I'd let you know. What do you think？
translations.●？ どうせなら▲小早川＊▲も参加しようよ。: ●？ If we're doing this, you should join too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.うーん、ハロウィンパーティってなにするんだろ。お菓子もらえるんだっけ？: Hmm, what do you even do at a Halloween party？ Do they hand out candy？
translations.やっぱり仮装したりするんじゃないのかな？: Don't people usually dress up in costumes？
translations.仮装か……なんか面白そう。参加してみてもいいかも。: Costumes, huh... That actually sounds kind of fun. Maybe I'll give it a try.
translations.うん。でも、仮装ってなんでもいいのかな……？: Yeah. Though I wonder if just any costume is okay...？
translations.（何するつもりなんだろ……）: (I wonder what she has in mind...)
translations.どんな仮装にしたらいいと思う……？: What kind of costume do you think I should wear...？
translations.どんなのって言われてもな……。: I'm not really sure how to answer that...
translations.アンタの個人的な意見でいいから。: Just tell me what you'd personally like.
translations.そっか。その線で考えてみるよ。: Got it. I'll think of something along those lines.
translations.今教えてくれないの？: You're not gonna tell me now？
translations.こういうのはさ、当日わかった方が楽しいと思わない？ だからヒミツ。: Don't you think this sort of thing is more fun if you find out on the day？ So it's a secret.
translations.（当日はどんな仮装をしてくるんだろ。楽しみだな）: (I wonder what she'll dress up as on the day. I'm looking forward to it.)
translations.はーい……え？ その格好は……。: Coming... Huh？ What's with that outfit...
translations.だからってその仮装のまま登校するつもり……？: Wait, you're planning on going to school in that costume...？
translations.だってどうせ着替えるんだし、今日ならシャレで済むでしょ。: Well, I have to change into it anyway, and since it's today, people will just take it as a joke.
translations.そういうこと。ところで……へへ、リンコの仮装……どう思う？: Yep. Anyway... hehe, what do you think... of my costume？
translations.実は結構いい線いってると思ってたんだよね。さっ、早くしないとパーティが始まるよ。: Honestly, I thought I did a pretty good job with it myself. Come on, the party's gonna start if we don't hurry. Let's go.
translations.これだけ参加者がいると、よくわかんない仮装の人も多いね。: With this many people here, there are a lot of costumes I don't even recognize.
translations.あれは、映画のキャラクターかな。魔法学園物の……。: I think that one's a movie character. From that magic school series...
translations.あ、ほんとだ。へえ、ああいうのもアリなんだ。: Oh, you're right. Huh, I guess stuff like that counts too.
translations.ヒロインの子がかわいいんだよな。: The heroine in that is really cute.
translations.おっ、あれは……アニメの主人公だな。仮装っていうか、コスプレか？: Oh, that's... an anime protagonist. Isn't that more like cosplay than a Halloween costume？
translations.なんか、リンコより楽しそうだね。……別にいいけど。: You seem to be enjoying this more than I am. ...Not that I mind.
translations.さて、パーティも盛り上がってきましたが、ここで夜の校内を使った肝試しの時間です！: Now that the party's in full swing, it's time for a test of courage through the school at night!
translations.肝試し……？ そんなのあったっけ。: A test of courage...？ Was that always part of the plan？
translations.いいじゃん、面白そうだし。参加しよ。: Who cares, it sounds fun. Let's do it.
translations.これさ、全部仮装だってわかってれば、ぜんぜん恐くないよね。: You know, once you realize everyone's just in costume, this isn't scary at all.
translations.あのさ、かぶり物ならもっと恐ろしげなのにした方がいいよ。: Listen, if you're gonna wear a mask, you should pick something a lot scarier.
translations.あ、うん。これしかなかったんだよ……。: Uh, yeah. This was all they had left...
translations.脅かし役と普通に会話すんなよ……。:
Don't just have a normal
chat with the monsters...
translations.だー、臭い！ 近寄んなっつーの！:
Ugh, you stink!
Stay away from me!
translations.そろそろ文化祭だけど、▲小早川＊▲のクラスって何かやんの？:
The festival's coming up.
What's your class doing,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.それよりも、図書委員も先生が妙にやる気らしいよ。:
Forget that. The library
committee advisor is weirdly
fired up about it too.
translations.図書委員も？ 何やんだろ……。:
The library committee too？
Wonder what we're doing...
translations.なんか、世界の名作童話を紙芝居形式で展示するんだってさ。:
Apparently we're displaying
classic fairy tales like a
picture-story show.
translations.紙芝居ってことは……絵、描くんだよな。:
A picture-story show means...
someone has to draw the
illustrations, right？
translations.（●や▲小早川＊▲が挿絵を描いて大丈夫なんだろうか……）:
(Is it really okay if ●
and ▲小早川＊▲ draw the
illustrations...？)
translations.逃げないようにって、先輩にクギを刺されたらさ、仕方ないよ。はあ……。:
The seniors warned us not to
bail, so we don't have much
choice. Sigh...
translations.ね。紙芝居の絵だけど、どれくらい完成してる？:
Hey. How far along are the
story illustrations？
translations.まだ３分の２ってとこか……。:
Only about two-thirds done,
I guess...
translations.絶対終わらないよ。……リンコが枚数をもっと増やそうなんて言ったせいだね。:
We're never gonna finish.
...It's my fault for saying
we should add more pages.
translations.▲小早川＊▲は帰っていいよ。●は泊まりで作業続けるからさ。:
You can go home, ▲小早川＊▲.
● will stay overnight
and keep working.
translations.そんな！ 先生に見つかったらアンタだけ怒られるじゃん。:
No way! If a teacher finds
out, you'll get in trouble
all by yourself.
translations.ふぅ……危なかった。さっきのって宿直の警備員さんだよな。▲小早川＊▲？:
Phew... That was close. That
was the night guard just now,
right？ ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.あのさ……そんなにしがみつかれたままだと……●身動き取れないんだけど。:
Um... If you keep clinging
to me like that... ●
can't move.
translations.やばい！ 作業の途中で寝ちゃったよ！ ……あれ、紙芝居完成してる？:
Crap! I fell asleep in the
middle of working! ...Huh？
The story's all finished？
translations.もしかして……これ、▲小早川＊▲が？:
Wait... Did you finish this,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.……うん。あとは仕上げだけだったから……さ……。おやす……み……なさい……。:
...Yeah. It only needed the
finishing touches, so...
Good... night...
translations.ひとりで無理して。はは、▲小早川＊▲の寝顔か。かわいいな。:
Pushing yourself all on your
own. Haha, ▲小早川＊▲'s sleeping
face... Pretty cute.
translations.触ったら……小キックっ！ ……むにゃむにゃ。:
Touch me and... low kick!
...Mmm, zzz...
translations.まだ何も食べてないもんな……じゃあ屋台回るか。:
We haven't eaten anything
yet... Wanna hit the food
stalls？
translations.食べた後はそれか。眠いんなら保健室のベッド借りて寝てたら？:
Now that you've eaten, it's
sleepiness, huh？ Why not go
nap in the nurse's office？
translations.せっかくの文化祭じゃん。アンタと一緒に回りたい……。:
It's the school festival,
though. I want to look
around with you...
translations.けどさ、いまにもまぶたがくっつきそうだぞ？:
Yeah, but you can barely
keep your eyes open.
translations.うん……限界かも。あのさ、眠気を吹っ飛ばすような出し物、見に行かない？:
Yeah... I'm at my limit.
Hey, can we go see something
that'll wake me right up？
translations.眠気を吹っ飛ばす出し物？:
Something that'll wake
you right up？
translations.意外によかった、高校生バンドもバカにしたもんじゃないね。:
That was surprisingly good.
High school bands are
nothing to scoff at.
translations.●達も高校生だっつーの。眠気は覚めたか？:
We're in high school too,
●. Did that wake
you up？
translations.んー、少しはね。まあ文化祭終わるまでならなんとかなるかな……。:
Mm, a little. I think I can
last until the festival's
over...
translations.さてと、まだ時間があるしもう少し回るか。:
All right, we've still got
time. Let's look around a
little more.
translations.ここは……写真部か。:
Looks like this is... the
Photography Club.
translations.“世界記念写真コーナー”？ 観光スポットの紹介か何か？:
"World Photo Corner"？ Is it
an exhibit on tourist spots
or something？
translations.わからないから、入ってみるか。:
I'm not sure. Let's go in
and see.
translations.十羽野にいながらにして、世界各地の風景をバックに記念写真が撮れる……てことか。:
So you can take souvenir
photos with world scenery
without leaving Towano, huh.
translations.つーか、なんでリンコは衣装まで着替えさせられなきゃいけないわけ!?:
Seriously, why did I even
have to change into a
costume!?
translations.ハハハ、でもいい記念写真が撮れただろ？:
Hahaha, still, we got a
great souvenir photo out
of it, right？
translations.でもあんな人がいるとこでポーズ取らされて……。:
Still, making me strike a
pose in front of people
like that...
translations.そろそろ図書委員に戻らないとな。●たちの当番の時間だ。:
We should get back to the
library exhibit. It's time
for our shift, ●.
translations.図書委員会の出し物の責任者は、今すぐ提出書類を持って職員室まで来てください。:
Will the Library Committee
rep please bring your forms
to the staff room at once.
translations.あっ、いけね。展示内容の申請書類を出せって言われてたんだった。:
Oh, shoot. I was supposed
to turn in the form for
our exhibit.
translations.まだ出してなかったの？:
You still haven't turned
it in？
translations.あとで出そうと思って、つい忘れてたんだよ。ごめん。●、今から行ってくる！:
I meant to do it later and
totally forgot. Sorry,
●, I'll go right now!
translations.えっ!? ここ……図書委員会の展示、だよね？:
Huh!? This is... the Library
Committee's exhibit, right？
translations.●たちがいない間にこんなにお客さんが？:
All these people showed up
while we were gone, ●？
translations.こら、２人とも遅い。今からあなたたちの当番だから、あとはお願いね。:
Hey, you two are late. It's
your shift now, so I'll
leave the rest to you.
translations.まさかこんなに入るとは思わなかったよ。てっきり休憩所扱いされると思ってたのに。:
I never thought it'd get
this crowded. I figured it'd
just be used as a rest area.
translations.ね。お姉ちゃん、あの怪獣は強いの？:
Hey, miss, is that monster
strong？
translations.うっ……あれは王子様なんだけどね～？:
Ugh... That's supposed to
be the prince, though？
translations.イテッ……。まあ仕方ないよ。徹夜で描き上げたんだ。少しくらい変わったのがあっても:
Ow... Well, it happens. We
pulled an all-nighter, so a
few drawings came out weird.
translations.あれ、徹夜する前に描いたんだけど？:
I drew that one before the
all-nighter, though？
translations.そう……なんだ。でもさっ、子どもたちに人気はあるみたいだぞ。:
Oh... you did. Still, it
seems like a big hit with
the kids.
translations.その人気の理由が……正直複雑な心境。:
Given why it's so popular...
I have mixed feelings, to
be honest.
translations.さて、あともう少しで文化祭も終わりだな。▲小早川＊▲？ ……寝ちゃってるのか。:
Well, the festival's almost
over. ▲小早川＊▲？ ...Did you
fall asleep？
translations.んーっ、文化祭楽しかった。なんかさ、やりきったって感じ？:
Mmm, the festival was fun.
It feels like we really
gave it our all, you know？
translations.徹夜までして仕上げたもんな。:
We did stay up all night to
finish it, after all.
translations.先生に見つからないようにドキドキしながらね……。それもアンタとの……。:
With our hearts pounding so
we wouldn't get caught...
And with you, that's...
translations.なんでもないっ！ ね。後夜祭の花火が始まったよ。行こっ！:
It's nothing!
Look, the after-party
fireworks just started.
Let's go!
translations.ほら、早くっ！ グラウンド行かないと。:
Come on, hurry! We have to
get out to the field.
translations.なあ、教室で見ればいいんじゃないか？ ほら、ちょうど目の前だ。:
Why don't we just watch from
the classroom？ Look, they're
right in front of us.
translations.ほんとだ、ここからでも十分。:
You're right. We can see
plenty from here.
translations.でもやっぱり花火大会みたいにはいかないな。:
Still, it's not quite like a
real fireworks festival.
translations.けど、こういうこじんまりとしたのもいいんじゃない？:
Maybe, but something small
like this is nice too,
don't you think？
translations.最初は文化祭なんて面倒くさいって思ってたのに、終わるとなるとちょっと寂しいね。:
At first I thought the school
festival was just a pain, but
now that it's ending, it's a
little sad.
translations.なんだかんだ、ずっと２人でいたもんな……。:
After all, the two of us
were together the whole
time...
translations.そういえばさ、今も２人きり……なんだよね。:
Come to think of it, we're
all alone right now too...
translations.へへ。また来年も一緒に文化祭の出し物、やれたらいいね。:
Hehe. It'd be nice if we
could work on the festival
together again next year.
translations.もう街はすっかりクリスマスムードだもんなあ。:
Yeah, the whole town's in
the Christmas spirit already.
translations.へへ。去年のクリスマスのこと、思い出しちゃった。:
Hehe. I just remembered
last Christmas.
translations.●も。楽しかったよな、２人きりで過ごしたクリスマス。:
● was just thinking about it
too. Spending Christmas alone
together was a lot of fun.
translations.プレゼントに服、くれたよね。ありがと。:
You gave me clothes for my
present, right？ Thanks.
translations.プレゼントにコスメ、くれたよね。ありがと。:
You gave me makeup for my
present, right？ Thanks.
translations.プレゼントにアクセ、くれたよね。ありがと。:
You gave me an accessory for
my present, right？ Thanks.
translations.大切にしてくれてると、うれしいけどな。:
It makes me happy knowing
you treasure it.
translations.そりゃね。だって、大切な人からもらったプレゼントだし。:
Of course I do. It's a
present from someone special
to me, after all.
translations.……そっか。今年は去年よりもっと楽しいクリスマスにしたいな。:
...I see. I want to make
this Christmas even more fun
than last year's.
translations.なるよ、きっと。だって去年よりリンコはアンタのこと……へへ。:
I'm sure it will be. Because
compared to last year, my
feelings for you... Hehe.
translations.クリスマスか？ もう街はすっかりクリスマス一色だもんなあ。:
Christmas, you mean？ The
whole town's decked out for
it already.
translations.大切な人と過ごすクリスマス……へへ、なんかいいね。:
Spending Christmas with
someone special... Hehe,
it sounds really nice.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。なんか機嫌いいみたいだけど？:
▲小早川＊▲. You seem to be in a
pretty good mood.
translations.だってお祭りじゃん。近づいてくると、それだけでワクワクしてくるでしょ？:
Well, it's like a festival.
Doesn't it get you excited
just knowing it's coming up？
translations.あー、それはわかる。: Yeah, I know what you mean.
translations.だからさ、自然に笑顔になっちゃうんだよ。:
That's why I just can't help
smiling.
translations.今年のクリスマス。アンタと過ごすクリスマス。楽しみだな。:
Christmas this year...
Spending it with you. I can't
wait.
translations.早く来ないかな……。: I wish it'd get here sooner...
translations.あのさ、２人きりのクリスマスもいいけど、大勢でやるクリスマスパーティもいいと思わ:
Hey, spending Christmas just
the two of us is nice, but a
big Christmas party sounds
good too, don't you think？
translations.そういえば十羽野高校主催のパーティが……。ほら、ポスター貼ってなかったっけ。:
Now that you mention it,
Towano High is hosting a
party... Remember seeing the
posters up？
translations.リンコもそれ誘われてるんだよね。で、たまにはさ、そういうにぎやかなのもいいかなっ:
I got invited to that too.
And I figured a lively party
like that might be nice for a
change.
translations.リンコはカレシと過ごすと思って、友だちは最初は誘うの遠慮してたみたいだけど。:
My friends thought I'd be
spending it with my boyfriend,
so they hesitated to invite
me at first.
translations.そんな遠慮しなくてもいいのにな。:
They didn't have to hold
back like that.
translations.じゃあさ、こうしよう。夕方から２人きりでデートして、そのあとパーティに行く。:
Then let's do this. We'll go
on a date just the two of us
in the evening, and head to
the party after.
translations.お待たせっ。……もしかしてかなり待たせちゃった？:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
...Have you been waiting long？
translations.へへ。クリスマスだから、いつもよりオシャレに時間かかっちゃった。ごめん。:
Hehe. Since it's Christmas,
I took longer than usual
getting dressed up. Sorry.
translations.いいよ、似合ってるからさ。じゃ、早速行こうか。:
It's fine, it suits you.
Well, ready to head out？
translations.……やっぱり……少しだけ。だから……もっとそばに……いい？:
...Actually... just a little.
So... can I get closer？
translations.ほら、街がライトアップされて、スカイタワーの上から見るとすごくきれいだよ。:
Look, the city's all lit up.
It looks so pretty from the
top of the Sky Tower.
translations.……？ なんで夜景じゃなくてリンコのこと見てるの？:
...？ Why are you looking at me
instead of the night view？
translations.じゃ、もっとじっと見つめようかな……ハハ。:
Then maybe I'll stare a little
longer... Haha.
translations.そろそろ学校のパーティに行かないと。:
We should head over to the
school party soon.
translations.２人きりの時間はまたあとでな。:
We'll have more time to
ourselves later.
translations.もうかなり集まってるなあ。:
There's already a huge
crowd here.
translations.クリスマスらしく、みんなオシャレしてるね。:
Everyone's all dressed up
for Christmas.
translations.リンコ!? 来てたんだ……いいの？:
Rinko!? You came...
Is that okay？
translations.うん。さっきまで２人だったから……。:
Yeah. It was just the two
of us until now...
translations.へえ。じゃ、デートしてきたところなんだ。うらやましいなー。:
Oh, so you just came from
a date. I'm so jealous.
translations.全校生徒が集まったんじゃないかってくらい多いね。:
There are so many people,
it's like the whole school
showed up.
translations.それは言い過ぎだけど……おっ、クリスマスツリーもあるんだ。:
That's a bit much, but...
Oh, they have a Christmas
tree too.
translations.ホントだ。写真撮っておこっと。:
You're right. I'll take
a picture.
translations.あとでビンゴ大会をするので、カードを１枚どうぞ。:
We're playing bingo later,
so please take a card.
translations.ビンゴか……じゃあ、この辺を。:
Bingo, huh... Okay, I'll take
one from around here.
translations.はい、それじゃ、カードはちゃんと持っていてくださいね。:
Here you go. Make sure you
hang on to your cards.
translations.これだけ人数がいるとな……どうだろ。:
With this many people here...
Who knows.
translations.へえ、賞品は▲アイテム名▲か。▲小早川＊▲、強運だな。:
Oh, the prize is ▲アイテム名▲, huh.
You're really lucky, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.へへ。まだ賞品は残ってるみたいだし、アンタにもチャンスはあるんじゃない？:
Hehe. Looks like there are
still prizes left, so you've
got a chance too, right？
translations.それではこれでビンゴ大会は終了でーす！:
And that wraps up our
bingo game!
translations.へへ。２人とも賞品が当たるなんてすごいじゃん。予想外のクリスマスプレゼントだね。:
Hehe. It's pretty great that
we both won prizes. An
unexpected Christmas present.
translations.クリスマスパーティ、楽しかったね。大勢で集まるのも悪くないかも。:
The Christmas party was fun.
Getting together with a big
group isn't so bad.
translations.そうだな。……じゃ、今度はクリスマスツリー見に行くか！:
Yeah. ...All right, want to go
see a Christmas tree next？
translations.学校のツリーでも良かったんだけど……。:
The tree at school was
fine by me, though...
translations.いいから。あれよりもっと立派なのがあるみたいだからさ。:
Come on. I heard there's an
even nicer one out there.
translations.これが見せたくて、急いで連れてきたんだよ。夜景に浮かぶツリー、きれいだろ？:
I wanted you to see this,
so I rushed us over. Pretty,
isn't it？ Lit up against
the night sky like that.
translations.反則だよ、こんなステキなの。……泣きそうになるじゃん。:
That's not fair, showing me
something this nice. ...You're
gonna make me cry.
translations.あのさ、プレゼントあるんだけど、アンタは？:
Hey, so... I have a present
for you. What about you？
translations.もちろん●も用意してあるよ。:
Of course ● got one
for you, too.
translations.じゃあ今交換、する？: Want to trade them now, then？
translations.もちろんプレゼント、用意してきてるよね？:
You brought a present too,
of course, right？
translations.ね。リンコのクリスマスプレゼント……見たい？:
Hey. Want to see my
Christmas present...？
translations.じゃあ、ここでプレゼント交換しよっか？:
Then want to exchange
presents right here？
translations.リンコの好みにぴったり……ずっと大切にするね。:
It's just my style...
I'll treasure it forever.
translations.結構好き、かな。ありがと。:
I think I like this
pretty well. Thanks.
translations.いいね、こういうのも。ありがと。:
Something like this is
nice, too. Thanks.
translations.えっ!? ……リンコはこういうイメージなんだ。いいけど。:
Huh!? ...So this is the kind
of image you have of me.
I mean, it's fine.
translations.もう少しさ……こう……ううん……やっぱいい。:
Couldn't you have... like...
No... never mind.
translations.一生懸命選んでくれたのはうれしいんだけどさ……でも……ううん、なんでもない。:
I'm glad you tried so hard
to pick something out,
but... No, never mind.
translations.（この空気。何かプレゼント用意しとくべきだったか……）:
(Oof, this mood. Maybe I
should've gotten a present...)
translations.……用意してないわけ？ ……まあ、デートだけで満足しとくべきか。:
...Wait, you didn't get one？
...Well, I guess I should
settle for just the date.
translations.（やっぱりプレゼント、ちゃんと用意すべきだったかな……？）:
(Maybe I really should've
gotten a present ready...？)
translations.あのさ……プレゼント、楽しみにしてたんだけど？:
Look... I was really looking
forward to a present,
you know？
translations.そっか。……ううん、いいの。リンコのワガママだから。:
Oh. ...No, it's fine.
I'm just being selfish.
translations.（やっぱりプレゼントは用意しておくべきだったかな……？）:
(I guess I really should've
had a present ready...？)
translations.●は好きだな。▲小早川＊▲は？: ● like it. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.前はさ、クリスマスに浮かれるカップルなんてばかじゃんって、思ってたんだよね。: I used to think couples getting all excited over Christmas were stupid.
translations.なのに……今のリンコたちはまったく同じことやってるんだよ。: And yet... here we are doing the exact same thing.
translations.いいんじゃないの？ だって▲小早川＊▲、今すごく楽しいだろ？: That's fine, isn't it？ I mean, you're having a lot of fun right now, aren't you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.……うん。すごく楽しい。: ...Yeah. I'm having a lot of fun.
translations.……ならさ、他のカップルみたいに……する？: ...Then, want to do... what other couples do？
translations.もっとクリスマスが好きになったら、どうしよう。: What am I gonna do if I start liking Christmas even more？
translations.じゃ、もっとする？: Then want to do that some more？
translations.調子にのるなっつーの。けど……今日だけは……いいかも。: Don't push your luck. Still... just for today... maybe it's okay.
translations.今日は……ありがと。うまく言えないけど……。: Thanks... for today. I can't really put it into words, though...
translations.いいよ、▲小早川＊▲が喜んでくれたら、それでさ。: It's fine. As long as it made you happy, ▲小早川＊▲, that's enough for me.
translations.リンコは肝心なときに何も言えなくなるんだよね。どうしてなんだろ。: I can never seem to say anything when it really matters. I wonder why.
translations.アンタにはいっぱい、いっぱい言いたいことがあるのに……。: Even though there's so, so much I want to say to you...
translations.だから今はこうすることしか……。: So right now, this is the only thing I can do...
translations.ね。……伝わってる？: Hey. ...Is it getting through to you？
translations.うん。……すごくあったかい。もうしばらくこのままでいていい……？: No. ...I'm really warm. Can we stay like this a little longer...？
translations.ああ。好きなだけいていいよ。: Yeah. Stay as long as you like.
translations.うーん、難しいんじゃないかな。: Hmm, I don't think that's very likely.
translations.残念……子どもの頃さ、雪がたくさん積もるようにお願いしなかった？: Too bad... When you were a kid, didn't you ever wish for a ton of snow to pile up？
translations.したした。大きな雪だるまが作れるようにって。: Oh, definitely. So I could build a huge snowman.
translations.同じだね。もし小さい頃に２人が出会ってたら、リンコはもっと……。: Same here. If the two of us had met when we were little, maybe I would've been...
translations.最初から素直でいられたかな。: More honest from the very beginning.
translations.いつ会ったかは……関係ないんじゃないか？: When we met... doesn't really matter, does it？
translations.それって？ これからでも遅くない……ってこと？: What do you mean？ That it's not too late... even now？
translations.そっか……じゃ、リンコは今この瞬間から、すこしだけ素直になろうと思います。へへ。: I see... Then starting from this very moment, I think I'll try being just a little more honest. Hehe.
translations.一年が過ぎるのって早いよな。もう年末だよ。: The year really flies by, doesn't it？ It's already the end of the year.
translations.そういえばカウントダウンイベントがあるんだよね。一緒に行きたいね。: Come to think of it, there's a countdown event, right？ I'd like to go together.
translations.ああ。一年に一度だもんな。: Yeah. It only comes around once a year, after all.
translations.そうそう。がんばって予定空けてね？: Exactly. Do your best to keep your schedule open, okay？
translations.そういう▲小早川＊▲はどうなんだ？ 空いてるの？: What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？ Are you free？
translations.リンコも一応お父さんに許可もらわないといけないけど……。: I still have to get my dad's permission first, though...
translations.なら、お互いに確認してからだな。: Then let's both check and make sure first.
translations.そうだね。うまく都合がつけばいいけど。: Yeah. Hopefully we can both make it work.
translations.ね。大晦日の予定だけどさ。: Hey. About our plans for New Year's Eve.
translations.はは、驚かすなって。:
Haha, don't scare me like
that.
translations.お父さんはブツブツ言ってたけどさ、一応信頼してるみたい。:
Dad grumbled a bit, but it
seems like he trusts us.
translations.はは……そっか……なんか緊張するな。:
Haha... I see... That
makes me kind of nervous.
translations.とにかくこれでカウントダウンイベント、一緒に行けるね。:
Anyway, now we can go to
the countdown event
together.
translations.あれ？ まだカウントダウンイベントには早いと思うけど。:
Huh？ Isn't it still a bit
early for the countdown
event？
translations.うん。その前に一緒に夕ご飯食べようと思ってさ。:
Yeah. I thought we could
have dinner together
first.
translations.そっか、どうする？ 外行くか？:
Got it. What should we do？
Eat out？
translations.いいの。リンコがこれから作ってあげるから。キッチン借りるからね。:
No need. I'm going to cook
for you right now. I'll
borrow your kitchen.
translations.そ。やっぱり年越しにはこれがなくちゃ。さあ、食べよ。:
Yep. Can't have New Year's
Eve without it. Come on,
let's eat.
translations.ごちそうさま。おいしかったよ。:
Thanks for the meal.
That was really good.
translations.じゃ、片付けちゃうから、先に出かける用意しといて。:
I'll clean this up, so go
ahead and get ready to
leave.
translations.いいよ、●も手伝うから。その方が早く終わるだろ？:
It's fine, ● will help
too. We'll finish faster
that way, right？
translations.そうだね……へへ。じゃ、お願いしようかな。:
True... Hehe. Okay, I'll
take you up on that.
translations.さすがに人多いね……。:
There really are a lot of
people out...
translations.大丈夫か？ はぐれないように、手つなぐか？:
Are you okay？ Want to hold
hands so we don't get
separated？
translations.子供じゃないっつーの。でも……うん。:
I'm not a kid, you know.
Still... yeah.
translations.リンコがピンチのときは、いつもこうして手引いてくれる気がする。:
Whenever I'm in a pinch, I
feel like you always take
my hand and lead me.
translations.リンコが落ち込んだときも、楽しいときも……いつもこの手がリンコを引っ張ってくれた:
Whether I was feeling down
or having fun... this hand
always pulled me along.
translations.それですごく安心できて……。へへ。今年はありがと。:
It always made me feel so
safe... Hehe. Thanks for
everything this year.
translations.●だって▲小早川＊▲がいたからがんばれたこと、たくさんあるぞ。だからお互い様。:
● only made it through
a lot of things thanks to
▲小早川＊▲, too. So we're even.
translations.そっか。……あっ、そろそろ会場だよ。:
Yeah？ ...Oh, we're almost
at the venue.
translations.途中の道もすごかったけど、会場はもっと人多いね。:
The streets on the way
were packed, but it's even
more crowded here.
translations.つぶされそうだな……。:
Feels like we're gonna get
crushed...
translations.カウントダウンが始まるころには、もっと人が増えそうだね。:
It looks like it'll get
even more crowded by the
time the countdown starts.
translations.カウントダウンまであとどれくらいかな。:
Wonder how much longer
until the countdown.
translations.そっか、なんかテンションあがってくるな。:
Got it. I'm starting to
get hyped up.
translations.へへ、ほんと。今からドキドキしてきた。:
Hehe, yeah. My heart's
already pounding.
translations.へへ。去年最後のキスと今年最初のキス、一緒にしちゃった。:
Hehe. We did our last kiss
of last year and first kiss
of this year all in one.
translations.ああ……しかもこんなとこで……。:
Yeah... and in a place
like this, too...
translations.それは言うなっつーの……もう、とにかくさ。:
Don't point that out...
Jeez, anyway.
translations.あけましておめでとう。今年もよろしく。:
Happy New Year.
Here's to another year.
translations.今年も一年もっと楽しい思い出作ろうね。:
Let's make even more fun
memories together this year.
translations.そうだな。今年もよろしく。:
Yeah. Here's to another
great year.
translations.そろそろかな、初日の出。:
It should be time for the
first sunrise soon.
translations.こんなにきれいな初日の出が見られるなんて、思わなかったな。:
I never thought we'd get to
see such a pretty sunrise.
translations.途中からはため息しか出なかったね。:
After a while, all I could
do was sigh.
translations.なんか、今年はいい一年になりそうだな。:
Feels like this is gonna be
a really good year.
translations.なりそう、じゃなくて絶対にするの。:
Not 'gonna be.' We're
definitely making it one.
translations.そうだな。きっといい一年にするよ。２人でな。:
Right. We'll make it a
great year. Together.
translations.どう……かな？ 変じゃない？:
So... what do you think？
Does it look weird？
translations.似合ってる似合ってる。似合ってるよ！:
It looks great, it looks
great. Really, it suits you!
translations.そんな何回も言わなくていいから。恥ずかしいじゃん。:
You don't have to say it
that many times. It's
embarrassing.
translations.でも、今日の▲小早川＊▲、すごくきれいだと思う。:
Still, I think you look
really beautiful today,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.へへ。早く初詣行こ。:
Hehe. Come on, let's head
to the shrine.
translations.それはもちろん今年も▲小早川＊▲と、いい一年が過ごせますようにってさ。:
To have another great year
with you, ▲小早川＊▲,
of course.
translations.ふーん……なんだ一緒か。:
Hmm... Oh, so we wished for
the same thing.
translations.やっぱり？ そんな気がしてたんだよな。:
Really？ I had a feeling
you might.
translations.ね。せっかく神社に来たんだから、おみくじ引かない？:
Hey. Since we're already at
the shrine, want to draw
fortunes？
translations.おっ、大吉だ。新年から縁起がいいな。:
Oh, great luck! That's a
good way to start the year.
translations.リンコもだ。恋愛運は……現在の縁を大切に、だって。へへ。:
Same here. For love, it
says... 'Cherish the bond
you have now.' Hehe.
translations.吉か。まあまあかな。:
Good luck, huh？ Not bad,
I guess.
translations.リンコも。吉ってことはまだ上があるってことだよ。どんどんよくなるってことじゃない:
Same here. That just means
there's still room to go up.
Things'll only get better, right？
translations.そんなに落ち込むなっつーの、リンコもだから。気をつけて生活すればいいだけのことじ:
Don't look so down. I got
it too. All we have to do is
be careful, right？
translations.さて、おみくじを境内の枝に結んで、と。:
All right, let's tie our
fortunes to the branch...
translations.（おみくじの結果以上に良い一年になるといいな）:
(I hope this year turns out
even better than the
fortune says.)
translations.お守り売ってるな。買っていこうか？:
They're selling charms over
there. Wanna buy some？
translations.そうだね。どれにする？:
Sure. Which one should we
get？
translations.健康は大事、だよね。基本。:
Health is important, right？
It's the most basic thing.
translations.恋愛成就？ もう成就してるじゃん……まだ足りないって？:
Success in love？ We're
already together, though...
Is that not enough for you？
translations.神頼みもいいけど、実力もつけなきゃね。:
Praying for it is fine,
but you still have to put
in the work.
translations.どうか御利益がありますように。:
Let's hope the charm brings
us good luck.
translations.自分で努力すればさ、御利益はあとからついてくるもんだよ、きっと。:
Put in the effort yourself,
and the luck will follow.
Probably.
translations.……考えてみれば、カウントダウンからぜんぜん寝てないんだね。:
...Come to think of it, we
haven't slept at all since
the countdown.
translations.おいおい。\nぜんぜんは言いすぎだろ……。\nでも、眠いか？:
Hey now.
'Not at all' is a stretch...
Are you sleepy, though？
translations.ちょっとだけ。楽しすぎて眠気なんか感じなかったけどね。:
Just a little. I was having
too much fun to even feel
sleepy, though.
translations.でも……帰ったら、そのままベッド直行……かも……。:
Still... once I get home, I
might go straight to bed...
translations.ちゃんと晴れ着は脱ぐんだぞ。:
Make sure you take off your
kimono first.
translations.うん……わかってる。じゃ、またね。:
Yeah... I know. See you
later, then.
translations.ああ。……その前に。改めてだけど、今年もよろしく。▲小早川＊▲。:
Yeah. ...Before you go,
though. Here's to another
good year together, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.うん。今年もリンコのこと、ちゃーんと見守っててね。よろしく▼:
Yeah. Make sure you look
after me this year, too.
I'm counting on you▼
translations.なあ、写真コンテストってのがあるらしいんだけど、知ってる？:
Hey, apparently there's a
photo contest going on. Have
you heard about it？
translations.なんか案内のメールが来てさ。で、相談なんだけど……モデルやってくれないか？ ▲小:
I got an email about it.
Would you be my model,
▲小早川＊▲？ I was thinking of
entering a photo of you.
translations.えー……めんどくさい。:
Ugh... That sounds like a
pain.
translations.そんなこと言わずにさ。▲小早川＊▲の写真だったら、いい結果が出せそうな気がするん:
Oh, come on, ▲小早川＊▲. I feel
like I could do really well
if it's a photo of you.
translations.ヘンなおだて方すんなっつーの。はあ、しょうがないから付き合ってあげるけどさ。:
Don't flatter me in such a
weird way. Ugh, fine, I guess
I'll play along.
translations.なあ、また写真コンテストやるみたいなんだよ。今度もモデルしてくれない？:
Hey, looks like there's
another photo contest. Will
you model for me again？
translations.また写真コンテストがあるんだけど、協力してくれるよな？:
There's another photo
contest. You'll help me out
again, right？
translations.もちろん、そのつもりだけど？:
Of course. I was already
planning on it, wasn't I？
translations.また写真コンテストがあるらしいんだけどさ、協力してくれるか？:
Looks like there's another
photo contest. Would you mind
helping me out？
translations.うーん……どうしてもって言うなら……いいけど。:
Hmm... Well, if you insist...
I guess so.
translations.わかってると思うけど、いい感じに撮ってよ。:
I'm sure you know this, but
make sure it's a good shot.
translations.よし。あとでやっぱりヤダとか言わないでくれよ？:
Alright. Don't go backing out
on me later, okay？
translations.この前応募したコンテストの結果が出てさ。:
The results for that contest
I entered the other day just
came out.
translations.ん？ ああ、写真コンテストだっけ。で？:
Hm？ Oh, the photo contest,
right. Well？
translations.なんと、入選したんだ。:
Believe it or not, my photo
made the cut.
translations.ふーん。ここに飾ってあるんだ。:
Hmm. So they have them on
display in here.
translations.あっ、あるじゃん。アンタの写真。: Oh, there it is. Your photo.
translations.これって、最優秀賞じゃん……へえ～。:
Wait, this won the grand
prize... Huh.
translations.わ、最優秀賞だって！ やるじゃん。:
Whoa, it says grand prize!
Not bad at all.
translations.ねえ、最優秀賞って書いてあるよ？ すごいすごい！ おめでと。:
Hey, it says you won the
grand prize! That's amazing!
Congrats.
translations.優秀賞か。これって結構すごいよね。:
The Excellence Award, huh.
That's pretty impressive.
translations.へえ、優秀賞だってさ。実力あるんだ。:
Oh, the Excellence Award.
You've actually got talent.
translations.わぁ、優秀賞だよ。やったじゃん、おめでと。:
Wow, the Excellence Award.
Way to go! Congrats.
translations.入選だったら自慢できるよね。:
An honorable mention is
something you can brag about.
translations.入選か……モデルがいいんだから、もっと上でも……冗談だっつーの。:
Honorable mention, huh...
With such a good model, you
could've placed higher...
Just kidding, obviously.
translations.よかったね。入選なんて、すごいじゃん。:
Good for you. Getting an
honorable mention is great.
translations.▲小早川＊▲に感謝だな。ありがとう。:
I have you to thank for
this, ▲小早川＊▲. Thank you.
translations.まあ、カノジョだし。協力するのは当たり前だからさ。:
Well, I am your girlfriend.
Helping out is only natural.
translations.はは。じゃあ、また次回もあったらよろしくな。:
Haha. Well, if there's a
next time, I'm counting on
you again.
translations.●の写真が認められたのも、▲小早川＊▲のおかげだよ。サンキュ。:
My photo of ● getting
recognized is all thanks to
you, ▲小早川＊▲. Thanks.
translations.リンコがアンタの実力を引き出してあげたようなもんだもんね。へへ。:
Pretty much means I brought
out your true talent, right？
Hehe.
translations.そうそう。次もあったら、また協力してくれよな。:
Totally. If there's a next
time, help me out again,
okay？
translations.ありがとう。▲小早川＊▲もモデル、お疲れ様。:
Thanks. And good work
modeling for me, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.へへ、こんなにいい写真撮ってくれるならジャンジャン協力するよ。:
Hehe, if you take photos
this good, I'll help out
anytime.
translations.じゃあ、今度応募するときもモデル頼むな。:
Then I'll count on you to
model for me next time I
enter, too.
translations.前に応募した写真コンテスト……落選した。:
That photo contest I entered
a while back... I didn't
make the cut.
translations.ふーん。ま、そんな簡単に入選するもんでもないでしょ？:
Hmm. Well, it's not like
winning a prize is that
easy, right？
translations.そうだろうけど……▲小早川＊▲にも協力してもらったのに。:
Maybe so, but... Even with
you helping me out, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.別に、撮ってるとき楽しかったんだから、それでいいじゃん。また次もあるんじゃない？:
Whatever, it was fun taking
them, so who cares？ There's
always next time, right？
translations.そうだな。次はもっといい写真撮れるように頑張るよ。:
Yeah, you're right. I'll try
harder so I can take an even
better photo next time.
translations.あ……そうだ、前に応募した写真コンテストの結果だけどさ……。:
Oh... right, about the
results for that photo
contest I entered...
translations.ダメだったんだ。顔に書いてある。:
No luck, huh. It's written
all over your face.
translations.ごめんな、せっかく協力してもらったのに。:
Sorry, especially after you
went to the trouble of
helping me.
translations.別に……面白かったから、やっただけだし。次も応募するんなら、また考えてあげてもい:
It's fine... I only did it
because it was fun anyway.
If you enter again, I might
consider helping out.
translations.そっか。▲小早川＊▲がそう言ってくれたらやる気出るよ。ありがとう。:
I see. Hearing you say that
really motivates me,
▲小早川＊▲. Thanks.
translations.ごめん……この前の写真コンテスト、入選できなかったんだ。:
Sorry... I didn't make the
cut in that photo contest
from a while back.
translations.……そうなんだ？ でもリンコに謝らなくてもいいよ。だって、楽しかったし。:
...Oh, really？ You don't
have to apologize to me,
though. I had fun.
translations.そう言ってもらえると救われるよ。ありがと。:
It makes me feel a lot
better hearing you say that.
Thanks.
translations.あのさ、また挑戦してみようね？:
Hey, let's try again
sometime, okay？
translations.ああ。それまで、もっといい写真が撮れるように腕を磨いとくよ。:
Yeah. I'll brush up on my
skills so I can take even
better photos by then.
translations.あのさ、いっこ質問なんだけど。:
Hey, I've got a quick
question for you.
translations.アレの好み、聞いておこうと思って。:
I figured I should ask what
your preference is for...
you know.
translations.甘くて、茶色で……もうすぐアレな感じの。:
It's sweet, brown... and
that day for it is coming up
soon.
translations.もうすぐ……ああ、バレンタインか。:
Coming up soon... Oh,
Valentine's Day.
translations.さあ？ で、どうなの。:
Who knows？ Anyway, what do
you like？
translations.こう、ゴテっとしたのがいいとか、シンプルなのがいいとか……それか、変わったのとか:
Like, do you want something
super fancy, or simple...
or maybe something unique？
translations.リンコの勘も捨てたもんじゃないなって。:
Just thinking my intuition
isn't half bad.
translations.あ……まさかもう考えてたり？:
Oh... Don't tell me you've
already planned something？
translations.へへ、そうやって想像するのは勝手だけど？:
Hehe, you're free to imagine
whatever you want.
translations.どうした？ なんかまずかった？:
What's wrong？ Did I say
something bad？
translations.あ……もしかしてもう用意してたり……。:
Oh... Wait, did you already
get something ready...？
translations.違うっつーの。ただ……ちょっと意外だったから。:
That's not it. It just...
surprised me a little.
translations.よっ、何してんだ？: Hey, what are you up to？
translations.あ、この店……もしかしてバレンタインの準備とか？:
Oh, this shop... Are you
getting ready for
Valentine's or something？
translations.いいから、ほっとけっつーの。:
Never mind that, just leave
me alone already.
translations.邪魔しないで。ほら、あっち行く！:
Don't get in my way.
Come on, shoo!
translations.（気付かないフリした方がよかったかな……）:
(Maybe I should've pretended
I didn't see her...)
translations.（まあいっか、面白いもの見られたし）:
(Oh well, at least I got to
see something interesting.)
translations.ええ、アンタのカノジョの小早川凛子ですけど。:
Yes, it's Rinko Kobayakawa,
your girlfriend.
translations.なんでそう思うわけ。なんか怒られるようなことしたんだ。:
Why would you think that？
Did you do something to make
me mad？
translations.あのさ、探してたんだよ。▲小早川＊▲のこと。:
Hey, I've been looking for
you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.別にリンコに用なんてないんじゃない。リンコじゃなくたって、用は済むみたいだし。:
You don't really need me for
anything, right？ Looks like
you're fine without me.
translations.おい、ほんと何怒ってんだよ。せっかくのバレンタインなのに……。:
Hey, seriously, why are you
mad？ It's Valentine's Day
and everything...
translations.そうだよ、せっかくのバレンタインだよ。なのになんで、リンコ以外に……。:
Yeah, it IS Valentine's Day.
So why were you with someone
other than me...
translations.▲小早川＊▲か。なんだよモテてるって。:
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. What do
you mean, "popular"？
translations.さっきの人からチョコもらってたじゃん。:
That girl just now gave you
chocolates, didn't she？
translations.やらしーんだ。カノジョ持ちのくせに……。:
How sleazy. And you already
have a girlfriend...
translations.え？ だからこれは……。: Huh？ I told you, this is...
translations.カノジョに知られたら、大変かも……。:
If your girlfriend finds
out, you'll be in trouble...
translations.冗談だっつーの。なに、誰かに渡してくれって頼まれたとか？:
I'm just kidding. What, did
someone ask you to deliver
it for them？
translations.それそれ。ヘンな誤解すんなっつーの。:
Yeah, that's it. Don't get
the wrong idea.
translations.へへ、そんなことだろうと思った。アンタがそんなにモテるわけないしねー。:
Hehe, I figured as much.
No way you'd actually be
that popular.
translations.あのなあ……。そういう▲小早川＊▲は●にチョコくれないのか？:
Come on... What about you,
▲小早川＊▲？ Aren't you giving
● any chocolate？
translations.はあ、なんで？ ……やっぱり欲しいわけ？ カノジョ以外からのチョコ。:
Huh, why？ ...Wait, so you DO
want chocolate from someone
besides your girlfriend？
translations.……なんか、誤解させちゃったかな……えっと、ごめん。:
...Did I give her the wrong
idea？ ...Um, sorry.
translations.いいよ、▲小早川＊▲が悪いわけじゃないし。:
It's fine. It's not your
fault, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.図書委員の用事。このあとすぐ図書室来いって、先生が。:
Library committee stuff. The
teacher said to head to the
library right after this.
translations.ああ。なんだろ、●、何かしたっけ。:
Oh. I wonder what for.
Did ● do something？
translations.さあ、大した用じゃないみたいだったけど。:
Who knows. Didn't seem like
anything major, though.
translations.そんなどうでもいいことにアタシ使うなっつーの。:
I swear, don't use me for
trivial stuff like that.
translations.まあ、いいけど。アンタが悪いわけじゃないし。:
Well, whatever. It's not
your fault anyway.
translations.カノジョ？ もう行っちゃったけど、話の途中だった？ 悪いことしたかな……。:
Your girlfriend？ She left.
Were you in the middle of
talking？ I feel kinda bad...
translations.ああ、そんな気にすることじゃないと思うけど……。:
Yeah, I don't think it's
anything to worry about...
translations.（黙っていなくならなくてもいいのに。どうしたんだろ……）:
(She didn't have to leave
without saying anything.
I wonder what's wrong...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の誤解をとかないと……）:
(I need to clear up ▲小早川＊▲'s
misunderstanding...)
translations.だって、リンコ、せっかく……。:
Because I went through all
that trouble...
translations.せっかくアンタのためにさ……なのに。:
I did it just for you...
and yet...
translations.（これじゃダメだ……ちゃんとキッパリ説明しないと）:
(This won't do... I have to
explain it to her clearly.)
translations.そんな世界の終わりみたいな顔すんなっつーの。:
Quit looking like it's the
end of the world, seriously.
translations.してる。カノジョに誤解されたの、そんなにショックなわけ？:
You do. Are you really that
shook up over your girlfriend
getting the wrong idea？
translations.はあ……別にやましいことなんてないんだから、ウジウジしてないで、話せばいいじゃん:
Geez... You've got nothing to
hide, so quit moping around
and just talk to her.
translations.……そうだな。はあ……そりゃそうだ。:
...Yeah, that's true.
Man... You're totally right.
translations.一応アタシにも責任はあるわけだし……アタシも一緒に説明しよっか？:
I mean, I'm partly to blame
too... Want me to come with
you and explain？
translations.そう？ まあ、かえってややこしくなるか。じゃあ、がんばれ。:
Yeah？ Well, that might just
make it more complicated.
Good luck, then.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ あれから顔合わせてないけど……。:
With ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ I haven't run
into her since then...
translations.そっか……ねえ、アンタ、もうカノジョからチョコもらった？:
I see... Hey, did your
girlfriend give you your
chocolate yet？
translations.さっきさ、チョコ渡そうとしてたんじゃないのかな、カノジョ。:
Maybe your girlfriend was
about to give you chocolate
back there.
translations.そこにアタシが割り込んで……うわー、やっちゃったかも。:
And I barged right in...
Ugh, I might've really
messed things up.
translations.そうかもしれないけど……▲小早川＊▲が気にすることじゃないよ。:
Maybe, but... you don't need
to worry about it, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.大丈夫だって、ちゃんと説明するから。心配してくれてありがとな。: It'll be fine, I'll explain everything to her. Thanks for worrying about me.
translations.うん、ちゃんと誤解とけるといいね。: Yeah. I hope you can clear up the misunderstanding.
translations.（さて、そうとなったら▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と話しないと……）: (All right, now I need to go talk to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.今度こそ、聞いてくれよ。: Come on, hear me out this time.
translations.やだ、聞いてもらう。: Nope, you're gonna listen to me.
translations.誤解されたまま、バレンタイン終わって欲しくないんだよ。: I don't want Valentine's Day to end with you misunderstanding me.
translations.あれは……テニス部で使う器具を受け取っただけで……。: That was... I was just picking up some gear for the tennis club...
translations.あれは……バイトで使う資料を受け取っただけで……。: That was... I was just picking up some materials for work...
translations.ほんとだって、▲小早川＊▲がいるのに、他の女子からチョコなんてもらうわけないだろ: It's true. I have you, ▲小早川＊▲. Why would I take chocolate from another girl？
translations.それじゃ、リンコ、バカじゃん……。: Then I just look like an idiot...
translations.そんなことないよ、誤解させたのは●だし……それにさ。: That's not true. ● was the one who gave you the wrong idea... And besides.
translations.そうやってヤキモチやいてくれたのが、ちょっとうれしいっていうか……。: I'm actually kind of happy you got jealous like that...
translations.はあ？ なにそれ！: Huh？ What's that supposed to mean?
translations.ヤキモチとか、そういうことじゃないんですけど。: It's not like I was jealous or anything.
translations.なにその余裕。なんかむかつくんですけど……。: Why are you acting so smug？ It's seriously annoying...
translations.余裕ってわけじゃないけど……。: I'm not trying to act smug, though...
translations.忘れるところだった、はいこれ。: I almost forgot. Here, take this.
translations.サンキュ。忘れんなよ。: Thanks. Don't go forgetting it, now.
translations.アンタが怒らせるからだよ。: It's your fault for making me mad.
translations.そんなに怒んないでさ、話聞いてくれよ。: Don't be so mad. Just hear me out.
translations.怒ってない、あきれてんの！: I'm not mad, I'm fed up with you!
translations.バレンタインにカノジョのことほっといて、他の女子にデレデレとか信じらんない。: Leaving your girlfriend hanging on Valentine's Day to go fawn over some other girl？ Unbelievable.
translations.ほんとだよ。あれは、テニス部で使う器具を受け取っただけで……。: I mean it. I was just getting some equipment for the tennis club...
translations.ほんとだよ。あれは、バイトで使う資料を受け取っただけで……。: I mean it. I was just getting some materials for work...
translations.そうだとしてもさ、カノジョに誤解させたのはアンタのせいじゃん。: Even so, it's still your fault for giving your girlfriend the wrong idea.
translations.ちゃんとしてくれないと、許さない。: I won't forgive you unless you do things right.
translations.えっと、チョコもらえばいいのか？: Uh, so I just take the chocolates？
translations.最初から真っ先にリンコのとこに来てればよかったのに。: You should've just come straight to me from the start.
translations.悪い。次はそうする。: My bad. Next time I will.
translations.次も……もらってくれるんだ。: So you'll... take them next time, too.
translations.ごめん、なんか誤解させたみたいで……。: Sorry, looks like I gave you the wrong idea...
translations.そう、誤解。だからちゃんと説明したくて。: Yeah, a misunderstanding. I wanted to clear things up.
translations.朝、●が他の女子と話してるの見てたんだよな。: You saw me talking to another girl this morning, right, ●？
translations.それ、信じていいの？ チョコ、もらったりしてない？: Can I really believe that？ You didn't get chocolates from her？
translations.……だって、▲小早川＊▲がいるのに、いらないだろ。: ...I mean, I've got you, ▲小早川＊▲. I don't need anyone else's.
translations.リンコは、最初から信じてたけどね。: I believed you from the start, though.
translations.そんなの……ちょっとだけだもん。: Okay, maybe I doubted you... just a little.
translations.カノジョだから……たまにそういうの、気になっちゃったりするんだもん。: I'm your girlfriend... Of course I worry about that stuff sometimes.
translations.そう、しょうがないの。……許して？: Right, I can't help it. ...Forgive me？
translations.こっちが本番だもんね……はい。: Anyway, here's the main event... Here.
translations.ちゃんと愛情こめて作ったんだから、しっかり味わってね。: I put a lot of love into making them, so savor every bite, okay？
translations.……なんかもったいないな。: ...Almost feels like a waste to eat them.
translations.そう言ってくれるのはうれしいけど……すぐ食べてね？: I'm glad you feel that way, but... eat them soon, okay？
translations.もうすぐリンコにとって、うれしい日がやってくるね。: A big day for me is coming up soon, you know.
translations.ホワイトデー。忘れないでほしいんですけど。: White Day. I'd appreciate it if you didn't forget.
translations.ああ。忘れてないけどさ、そんなに楽しみにしてたんだ。: Right. I haven't forgotten, I just didn't realize you were looking forward to it that much.
translations.そりゃあね。それだけカレシに期待してるってこと。: Well, yeah. That just means I have high expectations for my boyfriend.
translations.バレンタインみたいなこと、ないといいけど……。: Hopefully nothing happens like on Valentine's Day, though...
translations.どういうことだよ。: What do you mean by that？
translations.リンコはさ、フツーのホワイトデーでいいと思うけど。: I'm fine with just an average White Day, though.
translations.そう。カレシがフツーにプレゼント選んでくれて、フツーに会いに来てくれればね？: Yeah. Just my boyfriend picking out a present and coming to see me like normal, you know？
translations.（フツーと言いつつ、なんかハードルあがってそうな気も……）: (She says "average," but I feel like the bar just got raised somehow...)
translations.自信あるってほどじゃないけど……。: I wouldn't really call it confidence, but...
translations.期待しちゃうな～、どんなのかな～。: Now I'm really excited. I wonder what it is.
translations.楽しみでなかなか眠れなかったんだよね、実は。: Actually, I was looking forward to it so much I could barely sleep.
translations.（このプレゼントで大丈夫かな……）: (Is this present really gonna be okay...？)
translations.えっと……あ、ちょっと用事が。: Uh... Oh, I just remembered I have something to do.
translations.じゃあな、▲小早川＊▲。またあとで！: See you, ▲小早川＊▲. Catch you later!
translations.（うーん、なんか不安になってきた……）: (Man, now I'm starting to get nervous...)
translations.（さっきは思わず不安になって逃げちゃったけど……）: (I got nervous and ran off earlier, but...)
translations.（プレゼント、渡さないわけにはいかないよな）: (It's not like I can just not give her the present.)
translations.（ちゃんと選んだんだ……大丈夫だよな！）: (I put real thought into picking it out... It'll be fine!)
translations.ちょっと、さっきなんで逃げたの。: Hey, why did you run off earlier？
translations.まあ……ほら、用事がさ。: Well... you know, I had something to take care of.
translations.いいけど。ほら、なんかあるでしょ。: Whatever. Come on, you have something for me, don't you？
translations.ああ、ホワイトデーな。ちゃんと用意してきたから。: Yeah, for White Day. I made sure to get you something.
translations.もう。さっき渡してくれればよかったのに。: Geez. You should've just given it to me earlier.
translations.ここまでもったいぶったんだから、すっごいプレゼントじゃないと許さないから！: After dragging it out like this, I won't forgive you unless it's an amazing present!
translations.ごめん、そういう意味じゃなくて……。: Sorry, I didn't mean it like that...
translations.悪い、まだ用事終わってなかったんだよ！ またな！: Sorry, I actually didn't finish that errand yet! See ya!
translations.（ダメだ……ちゃんと渡さないと……）:
(No... I have to give it to
her properly...)
translations.こっちも、あおっちゃったしさ。なんかごめん。:
I kind of pressured you, too.
Sorry about that.
translations.いいよ。これ、ホワイトデーのプレゼント……。:
It's fine. Here, your White
Day present...
translations.一応、がんばって選んだつもりなんだけど……。:
I really did try my best to
pick something good, though...
translations.もう、そんな不安そうな顔すんなっつーの。:
Geez, stop looking so worried
already.
translations.アンタが一生懸命選んでくれたんでしょ。:
You tried really hard to pick
it out for me, right？
translations.そんなの、ガッカリするわけないじゃん。:
There's no way I'd be
disappointed by that.
translations.そりゃ……物によって、うれしさの大きさは違うのかもしれないけど……。:
Sure... how happy I am might
depend a little on what it is...
translations.一番うれしいのはさ、アンタがリンコのこと考えながら選んでくれたって、そのことだも:
What makes me happiest is
knowing you were thinking of
me when you picked it out.
translations.それなのに、プレゼント渡さずに逃げるとか、本末転倒じゃん。:
Running away without giving it
to me totally defeats the
whole point.
translations.まったく。変なとこで気つかうんだからさ。:
Honestly. You worry about the
weirdest things.
translations.プレゼント、うれしかった。ほんとだよ……。:
I'm really happy with the
present. I mean it...
translations.カノジョから逃げるとか、ありえないんですけど。:
Running away from your own
girlfriend？ Unbelievable.
translations.だよな……ほんと、ごめん。なんか、▲小早川＊▲が楽しみにしてるの見たら、不安にな:
I know... I'm really sorry.
Seeing how excited you were,
▲小早川＊▲, I got nervous.
translations.そんなことだろうと思った。:
I figured it was something
like that.
translations.リンコのこと大切に思ってくれて。: If you really care about me...
translations.リンコのこと考えながら選んでくれたなら、受け取ってあげるけど。:
and you picked it out with me
in mind, then I'll take it.
translations.当たり前だ。だから、これ、受け取ってくれ。:
Of course I did. So please,
take it.
translations.しょうがないな、受け取ってあげますか。:
Fine, fine. Guess I'll take it
off your hands.
translations.別に、いいプレゼントじゃないと受け取らないとか、そういう意味で言ったんじゃないか:
I didn't mean I wouldn't take
it unless it was some amazing
present.
translations.ただ……本当に楽しみにしてて、それ、伝えたかっただけだから。:
I was just... really looking
forward to it, and I wanted
you to know that.
translations.じゃあ、もっとわかりやすく教えてあげる。:
Then let me make it even
easier to understand.
translations.もう、置いてかないでよ。:
Geez, don't just leave me
behind like that.
translations.リンコ、不安になるじゃん。: It makes me anxious, you know.
translations.……でも、不安にさせたのはリンコの方もか。:
...Though I guess I'm the one
who made you anxious first.
translations.リンコが、あんなこと言ったからだよね。期待してるーって。:
It's because I said all that
stuff about getting my hopes
up, right？
translations.リンコが楽しみにしてるのは……プレゼントもそうだけどさ。: What I'm looking forward to... well, it's the present too, sure.
translations.どんな顔して渡してくれるのかな、とか……。: But it's also wondering what kind of face you'll make when you give it to me...
translations.なんて言って渡してくれるのかな、とか……。: Or what you're going to say when you hand it over...
translations.そういうのも含めてなんだからさ。: All of that is part of it too, you know.
translations.ああ。バレンタインのときはありがとな。だからこれ……お返し。▲小早川＊▲のこと考: Yeah. Thanks for Valentine's Day. Here... this is for you. I picked it out thinking of you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……ねえ、もうひとつ、楽しみにしてたことあるんだけど、いい？: ...Hey, there's one more thing I was looking forward to. Is that okay？
translations.（今日、エイプリルフールだもんな……▲小早川＊▲、何か言おうとしてるのか？）: (It's April Fools' Day today... Is ▲小早川＊▲ about to try something on me？)
translations.（……よし、先手必勝！）: (...All right, I'll beat her to the punch!)
translations.（しまった、何も考えてなかった！）: (Shoot, I didn't think of anything to say!)
translations.えっと……そうだ、▲小早川＊▲の好きなバンド、あったよな。: Uh... Right, there's that band you really like, isn't there, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そんなの、たくさんあるけど。: There are plenty of bands I like.
translations.そのひとつの……ほら、キラーなんとか。: One of them... you know, Killer-something.
translations.それの超レア盤が近所に入荷したんだってさ。: I heard a super rare record of theirs just came into a shop nearby.
translations.なんだっけ、ほら……ブーなんとか。海賊版だっけ。: What do they call it, you know... a boo-something. Like a pirated copy？
translations.リンコ、アーティストの権利を侵害するブートレグって否定派なんだよね。: I'm against bootlegs that infringe on the artist's rights, you know.
translations.でも、ほら、なんだっけ、アーティスト自身も公認してるブートレグってのもあるんだろ: Yeah, but wait, what do you call it—aren't there bootlegs that the artists themselves officially approve？
translations.オフィシャルブートレグね。まあそういうのもあるけど。: Official bootlegs. Well, those do exist.
translations.えっと……たしかそれだったと思うぞ。オフィシャルブートレグ！: Uh... I'm pretty sure that's what it was. An official bootleg!
translations.すごくしどろもどろなんですけど……。: You're stumbling all over your words, you know...
translations.嘘の内容もそうだけど、役者にダメ出ししたいね。０点。: The lie itself is bad enough, but the acting really needs work too. Zero out of ten.
translations.なあ、▲小早川＊▲。さっき話したブートレグなんだけど。: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. About that bootleg I mentioned earlier...
translations.……まだそんなこと言ってんの？ 無理に嘘つかなくてもいいじゃん。: ...Are you still going on about that？ You don't have to force yourself to lie, you know.
translations.嘘じゃなかったんだよ、ほんとにあったんだって。: It wasn't a lie! They really do have one, I swear.
translations.わざわざこんなとこまで連れて来て……つまんない嘘ついたことは別に怒ってないからい: Dragging me all the way out here... Look, I'm not mad that you told a lame lie, so you can drop it already.
translations.そうじゃないって。ほら、これ！: That's not it! Look right here!
translations.ほんとだ……これ、観客が４２人しかいなかった、初期の伝説のライブじゃん……。: It really is... This is from that legendary early show with only 42 people in the audience...
translations.……だな。普通のＣＤの１０倍以上だよ。: ...Yeah. It's over ten times the price of a normal CD.
translations.欲しいけど……さすがに買うのは無理だね。: I want it, but... there's no way I can afford that.
translations.でもいいもの見たよ、しばらく売れないといいな……。: Still, it was nice just getting to see it. I hope nobody buys it for a while...
translations.教えてくれて、ありがと。絶対に嘘だと思ってた。疑ってごめんね。: Thanks for telling me about it. I was sure you were lying. Sorry for doubting you.
translations.（ほんとは嘘のつもりだったんだけどな……）: (I actually did mean it as a lie, though...)
translations.（さすがに見つからないか……）: (Guess I'm not gonna find one after all...)
translations.（当たり前だよな、思いつきのデマカセだったんだから……）: (Well, obviously. I just made the whole thing up on the spot...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲……何やってんだ？）: (▲小早川＊▲... What is she doing here？)
translations.何してんの、こんなとこで。: What are you doing in a place like this？
translations.なにって、アンタこそ……。: What do you mean, what am I doing？ What about you...？
translations.●は……あ、まさか▲小早川＊▲もブートレグ探しに来たとか。: ●... Wait, don't tell me you came looking for that bootleg too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.はあ？ 何言ってんの、あんなデマカセなんて信じるわけないじゃん！: Huh？ What are you talking about？ There's no way I'd fall for a bogus story like that!
translations.すいませーん。お探しのキラーバンビーズのブート、やっぱり入ってないですね。: Excuse me, miss. I checked, and we don't have that Killer Bambies bootleg you were looking for after all.
translations.あ、すいません。あの、ありがとうございました。: Oh, sorry. Um, thank you anyway.
translations.いえ、ご利用ありがとうございます。またよろしくお願いします。: Not at all, thank you for stopping by. Please come again.
translations.信じてないっつーの。: I told you, I didn't believe it.
translations.信じてないけど、でも万が一ってこともあるじゃん。その可能性を無視なんてできないっ: I didn't believe you, but there was always that one-in-a-million chance, right？ I couldn't just ignore the possibility.
translations.だったら●に聞けばよかったのに……。まあ聞かれても困るんだけど。: Then you should've just asked ●... Though I wouldn't have known what to say if you did.
translations.アンタに聞きにいって、それで“ひっかかったー！”なんて言われたらサイアクじゃん。: If I went and asked you, and you went, 'Haha, gotcha!' that would've been the absolute worst.
translations.どっちにしろサイアクだったけど。あーもう、忘れろ！: Though it ended up being the worst either way. Ugh, just forget this happened!
translations.（上手くだませたってわけじゃないけど……一応エイプリルフール成功……なのかな）: (I didn't exactly trick her smoothly, but... I guess that still counts as a successful April Fools' prank？)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲に嘘ついちゃったけど、いくらなんでもバレバレだったな……）: (I tried lying to ▲小早川＊▲, but that was way too obvious...)
translations.（……特になにもないな。もちろんキラーバンビーズのブートレグもない）: (...Nothing special here. And of course, no Killer Bambies bootleg either.)
translations.（ん……こんなところでＣＤ売ってる……）: (Hm... They're selling CDs in a place like this...)
translations.（キラーバンビーズだ……しかもブートレグ）: (It's Killer Bambies... And it's a bootleg, too.)
translations.（まさか本当に見つかるなんて……▲小早川＊▲に教えてやろう）: (I can't believe I actually found one... Let's go tell ▲小早川＊▲.)
translations.遠足の話って、聞いた？ 高原に行くってやつ。: Did you hear about the field trip？ The one up to the highlands.
translations.ああ、聞いた。学校合同って、珍しいよな。: Yeah, I heard. A joint trip for the whole school is pretty unusual, huh？
translations.そうかもね……感想それだけ？: I guess so... Is that all you have to say about it？
translations.学校合同だと……●たちも一緒に行動できるかな？: Since it's the whole school... think we'll get to hang out together, ●？
translations.へへ、どうだろ。そこが気になるよね。: Hehe, who knows. That's the part that really matters, right？
translations.だよな……あんまり自由時間とかなさそうだけど。: Yeah... Though I doubt we'll get much free time.
translations.わざわざ学校行事で出かけるんだからさ、それなりに楽しくなってくれないとね。: If they're dragging us out for a school event, it better at least be somewhat fun.
translations.ちょっと。\nあんまり大きい声で\nそういうこと言わないでよ。:
Hey.
Don't say stuff like that
so loud.
translations.だって、周りに\n色々いるじゃん……。:
'Cause there are people
all around us...
translations.へへ、お前らいつでも\n仲いいんだな。\nやっぱあれか？ \nタイミング見計らっ:
Heh, you two are always
so close, huh.
Wait, let me guess—
looking for a chance to
sneak off together？
translations.なあ、お前のカノジョ怖くね？: Dude, isn't your girlfriend kinda scary？
translations.んー、ああ見えても\n結構可愛いところも\nあるんだけどな。:
Hmm, she may act like that,
but she actually has
a pretty cute side too.
translations.聞こえてますけど、センパイ方！: I can hear you two, Senpai!
translations.（そろそろ弁当かな……▲小早川＊▲は……あっ、いた）: (About time for lunch... Where's ▲小早川＊▲... Oh, there she is.)
translations.あ、こら。向こう行って食べるよ。: Oh, hey, wait. Let's go eat over there.
translations.あ、リンコ。カレシに手作りのお弁当!? 見せて見せて～♪: Oh, Rinko! Did you make a homemade lunch for your boyfriend!? Let me see, let me see~♪
translations.いいの。あの子噂好きだから、すぐにお弁当のメニューまで全校に広まっちゃうよ。: It's fine. She's a total gossip—before you know it, the whole school would know every single thing I packed.
translations.ここならいっか。さ、食べよ。: Here should be fine. Come on, let's eat.
translations.なんでも。弁当ありがとな。いただきまーす。: Nothing. Thanks for making lunch. Let's dig in.
translations.お粗末さま。どうだった？: Hope it was okay. How was it？
translations.美味かった！ やっぱり普段より気合入ってる気がしたけど……早起きとかしたのか？: It was great! It definitely felt like you put even more effort into it than usual... Did you get up early to make it？
translations.（うれしそうだな……やっぱりがんばってくれたのか）: (She looks happy... Guess she really did work hard on it for me.)
translations.はあ、やっと二人になれたな……弁当のときぐらいだったし。: Phew, we finally got some time alone... The only other chance we had was during lunch.
translations.なんかさ不思議な感じしない？ デートで来たことある場所に学校行事で来るのって。: Doesn't it feel kind of weird？ Coming to a place we've been on a date for a school trip.
translations.そういう場所にアンタといるとデートしてるみたいな気分になって、なのに周りには同級: Being in a place like this with you makes it feel like we're on a date, even though our classmates and teachers are all around us...
translations.ここってさ、二人で来るのもよさそうじゃない？: Hey, wouldn't this place be nice to come to just the two of us？
translations.二人？ ああ、デートでってことか。そういやここは来たことないな。: Just the two of us？ Oh, you mean on a date. Come to think of it, we've never been here together.
translations.そう。結構遊べそうなところあるじゃん。団体行動だと、あんまり遊べないしさ。: Yeah. There's plenty to do around here, right？ And we can't really have much fun when we're stuck in a big group.
translations.ねえ、せっかく二人きりなんだしさ……キス、しよ。: Hey, since we're finally alone... let's kiss.
translations.さて、じゃあ行きますか。:
Well then, ready to
head back？
translations.うん……なんか城にまつわるヘンな噂を聞いたことがあるんだよね……。:
Yeah... I heard a weird rumor
about the castle once...
translations.噂？ 怪談とか……そういうの？:
A rumor？ Like a ghost story
or something？
translations.（城の怪談ねえ……）:
(A ghost story about
the castle, huh...)
translations.（学年合同だし、▲小早川＊▲のクラスもいるかな……）:
(Since classes are combined,
I wonder if ▲小早川＊▲'s class
is here too...)
translations.プールサイドでキョロキョロするの、やめてよ。:
Stop looking all around
by the pool like that.
translations.水着だなーって。:
Just thinking how you're
in a swimsuit.
translations.そりゃ、制服が濡れたら困るしね。:
Well, yeah. I don't want
to get my uniform wet.
translations.そうじゃなくて……いいぞ、似合ってる！:
That's not what I meant...
It looks great on you!
translations.似合ってるって……スクール水着じゃん。:
Looks great...？ It's just
a school swimsuit.
translations.そうだけど……じゃあさ、一緒に水着買いに行かないか？ ほら、海とかプールでデート:
True, but... Hey, want to go
buy a swimsuit together？
For beach or pool dates.
translations.はあ、なんでそうなるの。しかも一緒に？:
Ugh, how did we get to that？
And together, no less？
translations.んー、じゃあ、勝負で勝ったらってのはどう？:
Hmm... Okay, how about if
you beat me in a contest？
translations.じゃあ、水の中に長く潜ってられたほうが勝ちね。:
Whoever can stay underwater
the longest wins.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、結構自信ありそうだったな。ここはひとつ……）:
(▲小早川＊▲ looked pretty
confident. Looks like I'll
have to...)
translations.はあ……よし、●の勝ちだな。:
Hah... All right, that's
a win for ●.
translations.卑怯じゃん、笑わせるなんて。:
That's playing dirty,
making me laugh like that.
translations.そうか？ とにかく、これで決まりだな。水着買いに行くか。:
You think？ Anyway, a deal's
a deal. Let's go buy
a swimsuit.
translations.なんでそんなにはりきってるわけ。:
Why are you so eager
about this？
translations.別に。楽しいじゃん。:
No reason. It's fun,
isn't it？
translations.まあいいけどね。じゃあ選んでくるよ。:
Whatever. I'll go pick
some out, then.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲に似合う水着は……）:
(The swimsuit that'd suit
▲小早川＊▲ best is...)
translations.……目に付いたの着てみたけど、どう？:
...I just tried on the first
one I saw. How is it？
translations.あ、そう。じゃあ別の探してくる。:
Oh, okay. I'll go look
for another one, then.
translations.ほら、こういうのは？:
Here, what about something
like this？
translations.こういうのなら、いいんじゃない？:
Something like this should
be good, right？
translations.ねえ、いい加減決めて欲しいんだけど。:
Hey, could you just make up
your mind already？
translations.今までので、どれがよかった？:
Out of all of them so far,
which one did you like best？
translations.了解。じゃあ買ってくる。: Got it. I'll go buy it, then.
translations.さて、水着も買ったし。: All right, now that I've got a swimsuit...
translations.あとはデートだな！: All that's left is the date!
translations.そうだね。まあさっき見ちゃったから、水着に新鮮さはないかもしれないけど。: Right. Though you already saw it just now, so the swimsuit might not feel all that new.
translations.そんなことないって。きっと海辺やプールサイドで見たらまた印象変わるぞ。: That's not true. I bet it'll look totally different at the beach or by the pool.
translations.そういうもの？ まあいいけど。: Is that how it works？ Well, fine by me.
translations.最近、メールの回数少なくない？: Haven't your texts been coming less often lately？
translations.そうだから言ってんの。: I'm saying it because they have.
translations.なんで最近メールあんまりくれないの？: How come you barely text me lately？
translations.リンコがウソついてるとでも言いたいわけ？: What, are you trying to say I'm lying？
translations.（ちょっと機嫌悪いな……）: (She's in a bit of a bad mood...)
translations.あのさ……ちょっと聞いてもいい？: Hey... Can I ask you something？
translations.最近、あんまりメールくれないじゃん。どうして？: You haven't been texting me much lately. Why？
translations.そうかな……？ そんなつもりはなかったんだけど。: Really...？ I wasn't trying not to or anything.
translations.リンコのこと、あんまり考えてないってことなのかなって。: I just wondered if it meant you aren't thinking about me much.
translations.ちょっと……キスの回数、少なくなってる気がするんだけど。: Hey... I feel like we haven't been kissing as much lately.
translations.キスして欲しいのか？: Do you want me to kiss you？
translations.バカ！ そういう意味じゃなくて。: Idiot! That's not what I meant.
translations.（愛情表現、足りなかったかもな……）: (Maybe I haven't been showing her enough affection...)
translations.最近あんまりキスしないじゃん。どういうこと？: You barely kiss me lately. What's that about？
translations.どういうことって……深い意味は……。: What's it about...? It doesn't really mean anything...
translations.あっそ……適当なんだ。: Oh, I see... So it's just whatever to you.
translations.どうした、暗い顔して？: What's wrong？ Why the gloomy face？
translations.うん……。最近、キスしてくれないから……なんでかなって思ってさ。: Well... You haven't been kissing me lately... so I was just wondering why.
translations.気にすることないだろ、別に、ケンカとかそういうんじゃないし。: There's nothing to worry about. It's not like we're fighting or anything.
translations.でも……キスはしてくれてないじゃん。: Yeah, but... you still haven't been kissing me.
translations.ある。最近、デートすっぽかすのなんで？: Yeah, it did. Why do you keep standing me up on dates lately？
translations.楽しみにしてたぶん、悲しいんだからね。わかってんの？: I was looking forward to them, so it really hurts, you know. Do you get that？
translations.（んー、少し怒らせちゃったのかな）: (Hmm, I guess I made her a little mad.)
translations.なんでデートすっぽかすの？ 最近多いよね。: Why do you keep standing me up？ Things like that have been happening a lot lately.
translations.とぼけたってダメ！ 結構……キズつくんだから。: Playing dumb won't work! It actually... really hurts, you know.
translations.うん……。最近デートすっぽかされることが多いから、気になって。: Well... You've been standing me up on dates a lot lately, so it's been bothering me.
translations.もう、リンコとデートしたくないわけじゃないよね？: It's not like you don't want to go out with me anymore, right？
translations.（不安にさせちゃダメだよな……）: (I really shouldn't be making her feel insecure...)
translations.前のデート、なんでリンコのことほうっておいたの？ そういうの、イヤなんだけど。: Why did you just leave me alone on our last date？ I really hate that.
translations.ごまかしてもダメ。もう……やめてよね？: Dodging the question won't work. Just... don't do it again, okay？
translations.（さすがに少し怒ったか……）: (Guess she really is a little mad...)
translations.この前のデートのとき、リンコ、ほうっておかれたじゃん。そういうの嫌いなんだけど。: You left me all alone on our last date, remember？ I hate it when you do that.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、なになに？: ▲小早川＊▲! What's up, what is it？
translations.リンコは怒ってんの。この前のデートのとき、ほうっておかれたから。: I'm mad at you. Because you left me on my own during our last date.
translations.（あれか……少し気にしてるみたいだ）: (Oh, that... Looks like it's bothering her a bit.)
translations.別に、気にしてるわけじゃないんだけど……ひとつ聞いていい？: It's not like it's bothering me or anything, but... can I ask you something？
translations.最近会う回数減ってるでしょ。……なんで？: We haven't been seeing each other as much lately. ...Why？
translations.あえて減らしてるわけじゃないんだけど……。: It's not like I'm doing it on purpose...
translations.しかたなくってこと？ なら……いいんだけど。: So it just couldn't be helped？ Well... if that's all, it's fine.
translations.あのさ……リンコたち、最近あんまり会ってないよね。: Hey... We haven't really been seeing each other much lately, have we？
translations.そうだっつーの。アンタは寂しくないの？: Yes, it is. Don't you get lonely？
translations.（もっと会う機会を増やさなくちゃダメか……）: (I need to make more time to see her...)
translations.あのさ……なんで最近会う回数が少なくなったの？: Hey... Why haven't we been seeing each other as much lately？
translations.気にしてよ、もうっ。結構、寂しいんだから。: Well, notice, geez. I've been pretty lonely, you know.
