translations.（あんまり寂しがらせないようにしないとな）: (I should try not to let her get too lonely.)
translations.なんだよ、テンション低いな……。: What is it？ You seem kinda down...
translations.それよりさっきの人ダレ？ ずいぶん仲良さそうだったけど。別に言いたくないならいい: Anyway, who was that earlier？ You two looked pretty close. Not that you have to tell me if you don't want to...
translations.（そういうことか……）: (Oh, so that's what this is about...)
translations.さっきアンタが仲良さそうに話してた女の人ってさ、どういう関係なの？: That girl you were having such a nice chat with earlier... What is she to you？
translations.どういう関係って、ただの友達だけど。: What is she to me？ She's just a friend.
translations.ふ～ん。じゃあ……リンコはただのカノジョだよね。: Hmm. Well then... I guess that makes me 'just' your girlfriend.
translations.ねえ……イヤなら言わなくてもいいんだけどさ。: Hey... You don't have to say anything if you don't want to, but...
translations.アンタが仲良く喋ってた女の人のことだけど……。: About that girl you were getting along so well with...
translations.ああ、さっきの？ 普通に喋ってただけだし、ただの友達だよ。: Oh, earlier？ We were just talking normally. She's just a friend.
translations.そう？ ならいいんだけど……ちょっと心配しちゃった。: Really？ Well, okay then... I just got a little worried.
translations.ん～……一日寝てれば大丈夫かな。: Mmm... I think I'll be fine if I sleep for a day.
translations.本当か？ あんま無理すんなよ。: You sure？ Don't push yourself too hard.
translations.心配してんの？ アンタがうつしたくせに……へへ。: Worried about me？ Even though you're the one who gave it to me... Hehe.
translations.いいわけないじゃん……なんてね。このくらい一日寝てればスグ治るよ。: Not good, obviously... Just kidding. A day of sleep and I'll be fine in no time.
translations.だといいけど……。その風邪、●がうつしちゃったのかな？: I hope so... Did ● give you that cold？
translations.自意識過剰。まあ……たぶんアンタの風邪だけどさ。: Don't flatter yourself. Well... it probably is your cold, though.
translations.良くはないけど、このくらいなら一日休めば平気かな。: Not great, but I think I'll be fine if I rest for a day.
translations.無理しないでゆっくり休めよ。その風邪、●がうつしたのかも知れないし……。: Take it easy and get plenty of rest. ● might've given you that cold, after all...
translations.そうかな……？ アンタの風邪だったらまだうれしいかも。: You think...？ If it's your cold, I might actually be kind of glad.
translations.また●にうつすか？ そしたら早く治るかも。: Want to give it to ● again？ Maybe you'll get better faster.
translations.そんなのダメ。アンタが風邪ひいたら、看病すんのめんどくさいしさ。: No way. If you catch a cold, nursing you back to health would be a pain.
translations.●にうつし返すか？ 遠慮しなくていいぞ。: Want to pass it back to ●？ Don't hold back on my account.
translations.バカ。そんなことしたら、リンコがアンタの看病しなくちゃいけなくなるじゃん。: Idiot. If I did that, I'd end up having to take care of you.
translations.もう一度●にうつす？ 責任もって引き取るぞ。: Want to give it back to ●？ I'll take full responsibility and take it off your hands.
translations.へへ……うれしいけど、それじゃあいつまでたってもデートできないじゃん。: Hehe... That's sweet, but then we'd never be able to go on a date.
translations.ごめんな。もっと●が気をつけてればよかったな。: I'm sorry. ● should've been more careful.
translations.気にしすぎだって。リンコもさっさと元気になるからさ。: You're worrying too much. I'll be back on my feet in no time.
translations.ほんと悪いことしたな……。: I really feel bad about this...
translations.もういいってば。アンタは元気でいて、リンコを看病してくれればそれでいいの。: Drop it already. All you need to do is stay healthy and take care of me.
translations.気をつければよかったな。反省するよ。: I should've been more careful. That's on me.
translations.そんなに気にしないでよ。リンコだって、もっとしっかり予防してればよかったんだから: Don't beat yourself up over it. I should've been more careful about not catching it, too.
translations.ほら、りんご切ってみたんだけど食べる？: Here, I sliced up some apple. Want some？
translations.ありがとう、気がきくじゃん。ついでだからさ、食べさせてよ。: Thanks, how thoughtful of you. While you're at it, why don't you feed me？
translations.お見舞いありがとね。結構……うれしかったよ。なんか、早く治りそうな気がしてきた。: Thanks for coming to check on me. I was actually... really happy. I feel like I'm gonna get better a lot faster now.
translations.よかった。じゃあ、帰るけど……なんか困ったことがあったら連絡くれよな。: Glad to hear it. Well, I'll head home now... Call me if you need anything, okay？
translations.まあね、もともとたいしたことなかったし。: Yeah, well, it wasn't a big deal to begin with.
translations.お見舞い行けなくてごめんな。: Sorry I couldn't come visit you.
translations.いいよそんなの。来たらたぶん……寝てらんなかったと思うし。: Don't worry about it. If you'd come over... I probably wouldn't have gotten any sleep anyway.
translations.もう体調戻ったのか？: Are you back to normal already？
translations.ちょっとした風邪だし、寝てればすぐ治ったよ。: It was just a little cold. I slept it right off.
translations.よかった。けど……お見舞い行きそびれてごめんな。: That's good. Still... sorry I missed the chance to come check on you.
translations.別に。お見舞いなんか来て風邪うつったら困るじゃん。: Whatever. It would've been a pain if you came to visit and caught it from me.
translations.風邪治ったんだ？: Did you get over your cold？
translations.うん、もう大丈夫！ 心配かけてごめんね。: Yeah, I'm fine now! Sorry for making you worry.
translations.●のほうこそ、こんなときにお見舞いも行かないで……ごめんな。: ● should be the one apologizing, since I didn't even come visit you... Sorry.
translations.いいの。アンタが来たらドキドキして、ゆっくりできなかったと思うしね。: It's fine. If you'd come over, my heart would've been racing too much to get any rest anyway.
translations.（……なんか心苦しいな）: (...I still feel pretty bad about it.)
translations.風邪、思ったより早く良くなったんじゃないか？: Didn't you get over your cold faster than expected？
translations.うん。誰かさんが風邪を少しもらってくれたからかもね。: Yeah. Maybe because a certain someone took a little of it off my hands.
translations.なに顔赤くしてんの？ ……へへ。: Why is your face turning red？ ...Hehe.
translations.風邪、もういいのか？: Are you over your cold already？
translations.うん。思ったより早く治ったかも。: Yeah. I think it cleared up faster than I expected.
translations.●のキスが効いたんだな。: Guess the kiss ● gave you worked.
translations.バカ！ ……よくそんなこと恥ずかしげもなく言えるよね。: Idiot! ...I can't believe you can just say stuff like that with a straight face.
translations.すっかり体調良さそうだな。: You look like you're feeling all better.
translations.そうなんだよね。予定より早く元気になったみたい。アンタのキスのおかげかな？: Yeah, looks like I bounced back faster than planned. Maybe it's thanks to your kiss？
translations.あれ、顔赤いよ。熱？ なんてね……へへ。: Oh, your face is red. Got a fever？ Just kidding... Hehe.
translations.少しだるいけど、たいしたことないよ。: A little sluggish, but it's nothing serious.
translations.風邪ってさ、誰かにうつすと早く治るって言うよね？: You know how they say a cold goes away faster if you pass it on to someone？
translations.調子どう？ 悪い？: How are you holding up？ Feeling bad？
translations.そんなでもないよ。ゆっくりしてればすぐ治ると思う。: Not that bad. I think I'll be fine soon if I just take it easy.
translations.リンコがその風邪もらってあげようか？: Want me to take that cold off your hands？
translations.ダメだよ: I can't let you do that.
translations.そんな心配するほどでもないよ。寝てたら大丈夫だろ。: It's nothing to worry that much about. I'll be fine after some sleep.
translations.風邪ってさ、人にうつすと早く治るって言うよね？ あれって、ほんとかな？: They say you get over a cold faster if you give it to someone else, right？ I wonder if that's true.
translations.試すって、リンコで？ ……別にいいけど。: Try it... on me？ ...I mean, I don't mind.
translations.いいけど。それってやっぱ……だよね？: I don't mind, sure. That means what I think it means... right？
translations.それってつまり……そういうことだよね？ もちろん、かまわないけど……。: Wait, so you mean... doing that, right？ Of course I don't mind, though...
translations.またそんなこと言って……。別にいいんだけどさ。: There you go saying stuff like that again... Not that I mind.
translations.しょうがないな。ちゃんと早く治してよ？: Oh, alright. You better get well soon, okay？
translations.もちろん、いいよ。その代わり、早く良くなってね？: Of course I will. Just make sure you get better soon, okay？
translations.うん、効いてきた気がする。:
Yeah, I think it's starting
to work.
translations.まったく……調子いいんだから。これでリンコが寝込んだら、きっちり看病してもらわな:
Honestly... you're too much.
If this puts me in bed,
you'd better take good care
of me.
translations.ん～、なんか治ってきたような……。:
Hmm, I think I'm starting
to feel better already...
translations.そんな早く効果でるわけないじゃん。リンコが風邪ひいたときは責任とってよね。:
There's no way it kicks in
that fast. If I catch a cold,
you're taking responsibility.
translations.リンコに風邪がうつったら、アンタが面倒みてよね？:
If I catch your cold,
you'll take care of me,
right？
translations.（ほんとにうつるとか……まさかな）:
(Wait, could she actually
catch it...? No way.)
translations.うん、今回も効果ありそう。:
Yeah, I think it's going to
work this time too.
translations.まったく……リンコが風邪ひいたらどうするつもりなんだか。:
Honestly... What are you
gonna do if I catch a cold？
translations.そのときは面倒みるって。:
I'll take care of you if
that happens.
translations.はい、ちゃんともらってあげたから。:
There. I took it off your
hands for you.
translations.ありがとう。効果ありそうだよ。:
Thanks. I think it'll do
the trick.
translations.わかってると思うけど、リンコのときもお願いね。:
I'm sure you know, but I'll
expect the same when it's
my turn.
translations.●のほうはバッチリ。あとは▲小早川＊▲にうつらなければいいんだけどな。:
● should be fine now.
I just hope you don't catch
it, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.リンコならうつってもかまわないよ。だって……優しくしてくれるでしょ？:
I wouldn't mind catching it.
You'd be extra nice to me,
wouldn't you？
translations.ダメだって。お見舞い来てもらって風邪ひかすわけにはいかないよ。:
No way. You came all this
way to check on me—I can't
get you sick.
translations.ウソに決まってるだろ。もしかして、信じてるのか？:
That's obviously a myth.
Don't tell me you actually
believe it？
translations.あのさ、おかゆ作ってみたんだけど……食べる？:
Hey, I tried making some
rice porridge... Want some？
translations.今日はありがとうな。▲小早川＊▲のおかげで元気出てきたよ。:
Thanks for today, ▲小早川＊▲.
I'm feeling a lot better
now because of you.
translations.よかった。じゃあこれで帰るけど、なにかあったら連絡してね。バイバイ。:
Good. Well, I'll head home
now, but call me if you need
anything. Bye.
translations.ああ、ちょっとした風邪だったみたい。すっかり元気だよ。:
Yeah, seems it was just a
mild cold. I'm totally fine
now.
translations.よかった……大したことなくて。:
Thank goodness... I'm glad
it wasn't anything serious.
translations.そんな気を遣わなくていいよ、ありがとな。:
You don't have to worry so
much about me. Thanks.
translations.ああ、もう大丈夫。心配してくれてたのか？:
Yeah, I'm fine now. Were
you worried about me？
translations.まあ、これでも一応ね。:
Well, believe it or not,
yeah.
translations.よかった。アンタが調子悪いと、こっちも元気なくなっちゃうよ。:
Good. When you're under the
weather, it brings me down
too.
translations.▲小早川＊▲のおかげで、すっかり体調戻ったよ。:
Thanks to you, ▲小早川＊▲,
I'm completely back to
normal.
translations.へえ。あの話、案外迷信じゃなかったのかもね。: Huh. Maybe that whole thing wasn't just superstition after all.
translations.そうかも……。それより▲小早川＊▲は風邪ひかなかったか？: Maybe... More importantly, did you catch my cold, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.一応、心配してくれるんだ？ 大丈夫だって。: Oh, so you actually do worry about me？ I'm fine, seriously.
translations.お見舞いありがとう。すっかり良くなったよ。: Thanks for coming to see me. I'm all better now.
translations.よかったじゃん。それって、リンコのおかげだったりして？: Good for you. Think maybe you have me to thank for that？
translations.絶対そうだよ。また、頼むな。: Definitely. I'll be counting on you next time, too.
translations.こないだはお見舞いありがとうな。この通り、元気になったよ。: Thanks for visiting me the other day. As you can see, I'm all better.
translations.よかった。もしかして……キスが効いたのかな？: I'm glad. Maybe... that kiss worked？
translations.そうかもな。でも、▲小早川＊▲まで風邪ひかなかったか？: Could be. Wait, you didn't catch my cold, did you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.うん、リンコは大丈夫だったよ。うつったらアンタに看病してもらえたのにな……へへ。: No, I was fine. Though if I had caught it, you could've nursed me back to health... Hehe.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、なんか様子が……）: (▲小早川＊▲ is acting kind of strange...)
translations.えっと、なんて言ったらいいのかな……。: Um, how do I put this...
translations.あー……その、改めて言うことでもないんだけどさ。: Uh... Well, it's not really something I need to make a big deal of saying, but...
translations.……な、わけじゃん。一応。リンコはアンタのこと。: I mean... that's how I feel about you, right？ Technically.
translations.えっと、じゃなくて……。: Wait, no, that's not what I...
translations.（ん？ ▲小早川＊▲、ちょっといつもと印象が……）: (Hm？ Something seems a little different about ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.だって……なんか、怒ってるのか？: Well... Are you mad at me or something？
translations.じゃあ、なんなんだよ、さっきから……。: Then what's been going on with you...？
translations.なんか、今更だけど、緊張しちゃって……。: It's a little late for this, I know, I just got nervous...
translations.好き、って伝えたくて……。: I wanted to tell you that I love you...
translations.甘えたくなっちゃった。: I kind of want you to spoil me.
translations.甘えても、いい？: Is it okay if I get a little clingy？
translations.だから、甘えたくなっちゃう。: That's why I want you to spoil me.
translations.結局、なんの話だったんだ？: What were you trying to tell me, anyway？
translations.忘れた……いいじゃん、用は済んだから。: I forgot... Whatever, I got what I came for.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、こんな大胆になることもあるんだな……）: (I guess even ▲小早川＊▲ gets this bold sometimes...)
translations.好き、って、伝わった？: That I love you... Did that get across？
translations.（こんな積極的な▲小早川＊▲、珍しいな……）: (It's rare to see ▲小早川＊▲ be this forward...)
translations.へへ、甘えちゃった。: Hehe, I got a little clingy.
translations.これからも、たくさん、可愛がってね？: Keep giving me lots of affection from now on, okay？
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、いつもよりさらに積極的だな……）: (▲小早川＊▲ is even more forward than usual...)
translations.いきなりだな。どこかで買ってくか。:
Well, that's sudden.
Want to stop and get some？
translations.ドーナツ欲は突然なの。そこらへんのドーナツじゃなくて、ワゴン販売のやつがいい。:
Doughnut cravings hit out of
nowhere. And I don't want
just any. I want the ones
they sell out of a van.
translations.ワゴン……移動販売ってこと？:
A van... You mean like a
food truck？
translations.そう、最近ウワサになってるんだよね。話聞いてたら食べたくなっちゃって。:
Yeah, everyone's been
talking about it lately.
Hearing about it made me
want some.
translations.ふーん、どこで買えるんだ？:
Huh. Where can you
buy them？
translations.それがわかれば苦労しないっつーの。神出鬼没なんだってさ。:
If I knew that, it wouldn't
be an issue. Apparently it
just pops up wherever.
translations.こないだ話してたワゴンのドーナツ屋さんだろ？:
That's the doughnut truck
you were talking about the
other day, right？
translations.んー、夢にまで見たこの匂い。買いに行こ！:
Mmm, that's the smell I've
been dreaming about. Let's
go get some!
translations.クレープってたまーに食べたくならない？:
Don't you ever get a random
craving for crepes？
translations.クレープか……たしかにしょっちゅうだとくどいかもしれないけど、たまに食べるとワク:
Crepes, huh... Having them
all the time might be a bit
much, but they're a fun
treat every now and then.
translations.だよね。甘いデザート系からツナとか入ったおかず系まで対応できるのもいいね。:
Right？ Plus, I like how they
go from sweet desserts to
savory ones with tuna and
stuff.
translations.そういえば、最近この街に移動販売のクレープ屋さんが来てるって聞いたな。:
Come to think of it, I heard
a crepe truck has been
coming around town lately.
translations.あ、リンコも聞いたことある。でも……いつも場所を変えて売ってるから、どこにいるか:
Oh, I've heard about that
too. But they're always
changing spots, so you never
know where they'll be.
translations.じゃあ、今度探してみるか。見つかったら一緒に食べような。:
Then let's look for it some
time. When we find it, we'll
get some together.
translations.ほんとに？ やった、約束だからね。:
Really？ Yay. It's a promise,
okay？
translations.来た来た。ほら、あの店見てよ。:
There you are. Look at that
truck over there.
translations.へえ、これが噂のクレープ屋さんか。:
Oh, so this is the famous
crepe truck.
translations.偶然見つけてさ。前に一緒に食べようって言ったろ？:
I happened to spot it. We
said we'd get some together,
remember？
translations.へへ、ちゃんと覚えてたんだ。……いい匂いがする。:
Hehe, you actually
remembered. ...It smells so
good.
translations.早速買って食べるか。:
Let's go grab some right
now.
translations.うん！ どの味にしよっかなー……。:
Yeah! Now what kind should
I get...
translations.暑い……なんでこんなに暑いんだろ？ ねえ、蹴っていい？:
It's hot... Why is it so
hot？ Hey, can I kick you？
translations.スカッとするかもしれないじゃん。ジトジトしてる日本の気候が悪い！:
It might make me feel
better. Blame Japan's gross,
muggy weather!
translations.じゃあ、アイスでも食べたほうが落ち着くんじゃないか？:
Wouldn't eating some ice
cream or something cool you
down better？
translations.それもそうだね……。あっ、そういえばクラスの子が新しいジェラート屋さん見つけたっ:
True enough... Oh, come to
think of it, a girl in my
class said she found a new
gelato place.
translations.へえ、今から買いに行く？:
Oh yeah？ Want to go get some
now？
translations.移動ワゴンのお店だから、探すだけで疲れちゃうよ……。:
It's a food truck, so just
looking for it would wear us
out...
translations.そっか。じゃあ、見つけたら連絡するよ。:
I see. Well, I'll let you
know if I spot it.
translations.よろしく。それはそれとして、今のこの暑さもどうにかしないとね……。:
Thanks. Anyway, we still
need to do something about
this heat right now...
translations.▲小早川＊▲。あれ、この前話してたジェラート屋さん！:
▲小早川＊▲. Look, it's that
gelato truck you mentioned
the other day!
translations.ほんとに、探してくれたんだ？:
You really went and
looked for it？
translations.リンコの話、覚えててくれてありがと……へへ。:
Thanks for remembering
what I said... Hehe.
translations.早く一緒に食べよっ。なに味にしよっかなぁ？:
Come on, let's get some.
What flavor should I get？
translations.おいしい甘栗が食べたい。:
I want some really good
roasted chestnuts.
translations.秋だもんな！ でもどうした、急に。:
Well, it is fall!
Why so sudden, though？
translations.昨日食べた甘栗があんまり美味しくなくてさ……まあ全部食べたけど。:
The ones I had yesterday
weren't very good...
I still ate 'em all, though.
translations.そりゃ残念だな……そういや、移動販売の美味しい甘栗のウワサを聞いたんだけど。:
That's too bad... Oh, I did
hear a rumor about a truck
that sells really good ones.
translations.それがさ、場所も時間も決まってないんだよ。だからレアみたい。:
Thing is, it doesn't have a
set time or place. Makes it
pretty hard to catch.
translations.ちょっと、そんな話聞いたら余計に食べたくなるじゃん。:
Hey, hearing that just makes
me want them even more.
translations.んー。じゃあ、探してみるか……。:
Hmm. Guess I'll keep an
eye out for it, then...
translations.（よし、▲小早川＊▲に買っていってやろっと）:
(Alright, I'll buy some
and take them to ▲小早川＊▲.)
translations.これ、届けにきたんだ。: Just came to drop these off.
translations.これって……甘栗!? わざわざ買ってきてくれたの？:
Wait...roasted chestnuts!?
You went out of your way
to buy them for me？
translations.ありがとう。食べられるのもうれしいけど……。:
Thanks. I'm happy I get
to eat them and all, but...
translations.話を覚えてて、本当に探してくれたのがうれしいよ。:
What really makes me happy
is that you remembered and
actually looked for them.
translations.ああ、うん。なんかね、最近ウワサの焼き芋屋さんがここらへんに出没するらしいよ。:
Oh, yeah. I heard a rumored
sweet potato vendor has been
sighted around here lately.
translations.美味しいんだけど、いつどこに現れるかわからないんだってさ。伝説の焼き芋だね。:
They're good, but you never
know where they'll show up.
They're like a legend.
translations.ね、見つけたらさ、リンコにも教えてよ。:
Hey, if you find them,
let me know too, okay？
translations.そうだな、ちょっと探してみるか。:
Sure, I'll look around
for them a bit.
translations.ほら、前に話してた焼き芋屋さん。:
Look, it's that sweet potato
vendor we talked about.
translations.ほんとだぁ。いいねぇ、冬の風物詩って感じ？:
It really is. Nice—nothing
says winter like this, huh？
translations.早く食べよ、焼きたての焼き芋！\n甘くてホクホクだといいなぁ……\nへへ。:
Let's eat 'em while they're
hot! Hope they're nice and
sweet and fluffy... Hehe.
translations.●も楽しみになってきた。:
Now ● can't wait to try
them, either.
translations.美味しかったら家にも買って帰ろうっと。:
If they're good, I'll buy
some to take home, too.
translations.生徒の何人かが同時にＵＦＯを見たって話。:
The story about how a bunch
of students all saw a UFO at
the same time.
translations.ああ、そういえば聞いたかも。:
Oh, now that you mention it,
I think I heard about that.
translations.なんでリンコの前には現れないんだろ……。:
Why doesn't one ever show up
in front of me...？
translations.へえ、見たいの？: Huh, you want to see one？
translations.別にそういうわけじゃないけど……なんか証拠つかみたいじゃん。:
Not really, it's just...
you'd want to get some proof,
wouldn't you？
translations.証拠か……じゃあ、見かけたら写真でも撮ってみるかな。:
Proof, huh... Well, if I spot
one, maybe I'll try taking
a picture.
translations.なに？ あわてちゃってさ。:
What is it？
You're in such a hurry.
translations.とにかく、これ見てよ。: Anyway, take a look at this.
translations.写真？ ……あっ、まさかＵＦＯ？ バッチリ写ってるじゃん。: A photo？ ...Wait, is that a UFO？ You got a really clear shot of it.
translations.はは、やっぱり見たかったんだな。: Haha, so you really did want to see one.
translations.それはまあ……いいじゃん、別に。へへ。: Well, yeah... Whatever, it's no big deal. Hehe.
translations.ねえ、あのさ……トワッシーって知ってる？: Hey, um... Do you know about Towassie？
translations.トワッシー……聞いたことあるような、ないような。: Towassie... I feel like I've heard of it, maybe.
translations.十羽野湖に生息してる伝説の巨大生物だよ。: It's a legendary giant creature that lives in Lake Towano.
translations.だからさ、トワッシー探して写真撮ってきてよ。: So go look for Towassie and get a picture of it for me.
translations.だって面白そうだけど、大変じゃん。リンコ、ずーっと何かを待つのって苦手だし。: I mean, it sounds fun, but it's a lot of work. And I'm no good at waiting around forever for something.
translations.んー、まあ、ほどほどに探してみるよ。: Hmm, well, I'll keep an eye out when I can.
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ お待ちかねのものを手に入れたぞ。: ▲小早川＊▲! I got what you've been waiting for.
translations.お待ちかねのもの？ ……なに？: What I've been waiting for？ ...What is it？
translations.おい、トワッシー捜索隊を忘れたのか？: Hey, did you already forget the Towassie search party？
translations.あっ、それか。えっ……手に入れたってことは……。: Oh, right, that. Wait... If you got it, does that mean...
translations.そう、写真！ 撮れたんだよ。: Yep, a photo! I managed to get a shot.
translations.ほんとだ……これ、本物？ アンタが撮ったの？ どんな感じだった？: You really did... Is this real？ Did you take this？ What was it like？
translations.まあまあ、質問にはじっくり答えるから。: Whoa, slow down. I'll answer all your questions.
translations.もう、もったいぶらないで早くしゃべんなよ。聞きたいこといっぱいあるんだから。: Come on, quit dragging it out and spill it already. I've got tons of questions.
translations.そろそろ中間テストかぁ……。: Midterms are coming up soon, huh...
translations.そろそろ期末テストかぁ……。: Finals are coming up soon, huh...
translations.ハァ……めんどくさいな。試験勉強してる？: Ugh... What a pain. Have you been studying？
translations.まあ……それなりだけど。: Well... A decent amount, I guess.
translations.ふ～ん、準備してるんだ……。じゃあ、どこらへんを狙ってるわけ？: Hmm, so you're getting ready... What kind of rank are you aiming for, then？
translations.ハァ……中間テストの時期かぁ……。: Sigh... It's almost time for midterms, huh...
translations.ハァ……期末テストの時期かぁ……。: Sigh... It's almost time for finals, huh...
translations.テストなんてめんどくさいもの、誰が考えたんだろ？ 全然やる気出ない……。: Who even came up with a pain in the neck like exams？ I have zero motivation...
translations.目標でも決めれば少しはやる気が出るんじゃないか？: Maybe setting a goal would help get you motivated？
translations.みたいだなって……他人ごとみたいに言っちゃって。大丈夫？: 'Seems that way'？ You act like it's someone else's problem. Are you gonna be okay？
translations.自信あるんだ？ じゃあ目標は？: Pretty confident, huh？ What's your goal, then？
translations.うそっ……ムリしないほうがいいよ？:
No way... Better not push
yourself too hard, okay？
translations.……そんなにムリかなあ。:
...Is it really that much
of a stretch？
translations.まあ、たまにはな。: Well, every once in a while.
translations.アンタって、冗談得意だっけ？:
Since when were you good
at telling jokes？
translations.すごーい！ 目標高かったんだね？:
Wow! Aiming pretty high,
aren't you？
translations.へえ……いいんじゃない？ あんまり背伸びしても仕方ないし。:
Huh... Sounds good to me.
No point pushing it too far.
translations.まあ、適度な目標なんじゃないの。:
Well, that seems like a
reasonable enough goal.
translations.ムリせず足元を固めるよ。:
Just playing it safe and
steady.
translations.うん、きっと大丈夫だよ。:
Yeah, I'm sure you'll
do fine.
translations.だよな、まあこんなもんだろ。:
Right？ Seems about right
for me.
translations.とにかく、目標も決まったことだし……頑張ろっか。:
Anyway, now that you've got
a goal... let's do our best.
translations.もう、目標変更はナシだからね。:
No changing your goal now,
okay？
translations.わかってる。頑張るよ！: I know. I'll do my best!
translations.目標達成できるといいね？ お互い頑張ろ。:
Hope you reach your goal.
Let's both do our best.
translations.お疲れ。手応えは？:
Nice work. How do you think
you did？
translations.お疲れさま。大丈夫だった？: Good work. Did it go okay？
translations.ふーん。ま、明日も気を抜かないように。:
Huh. Well, don't let your
guard down tomorrow either.
translations.へえ。まあ、とにかく明日も気合いだね。:
Oh yeah？ Well, keep that
energy up tomorrow too.
translations.そっか、また明日も頑張ろうね。:
I see. Let's do our best
again tomorrow.
translations.１週間長かったぁ……。ま、無事に終わってなにより。:
What a long week... Well,
glad it's all over safely.
translations.この１週間、お互い頑張ったよね。お疲れさま！:
We both worked hard this
week. Good job!
translations.（さて、テストの結果は……）:
(Now then, how did I do on
the exams...)
translations.こんなことってあるんだな……。:
So things like this really
do happen, huh...
translations.やったぁー！ まさかの１位だ！: Yes! I actually got first place!
translations.まあ、リンコは信じてたけどね……へへ。: Well, I believed in you all along, though... Hehe.
translations.よしっ、１０位以内だ！: All right, I made the top ten!
translations.まあね、ちょっと本気出せばこんなもんだよ。: Well, this is what happens when I actually try a little.
translations.じゃあ次はもっと本気だして、１位狙いだね。: Then next time you can try even harder and aim for first place.
translations.おおっ！ １０位以内に入ったぞ。: Oh! I made it into the top ten.
translations.へ～え、やればできるじゃん。おめでとう。: Huh, so you can do it when you try. Congrats.
translations.調子に乗んなっつーの。次は１位獲ってもらうからね。: Don't let it go to your head. You're getting first place next time.
translations.じゃあ今度は１位だね？ 頑張って……へへ。: Then it's first place next time, right？ Good luck... Hehe.
translations.なんとか無事に１００位以内だ。: Somehow I managed to make the top hundred.
translations.このくらいはクリアしてもらわないとねぇ。リンコのカレシとしてはさ。: I need you to clear at least that much, you know. As my boyfriend.
translations.よかったぁ……１００位以内に入れた。: Thank goodness... I made it into the top hundred.
translations.ふーん、目標達成じゃん。おめでと。: Hmm, so you reached your goal. Congrats.
translations.ま、有言実行は男の鉄則だよね。次はもっと高い目標立てたら？: Well, a man's gotta keep his word, right？ Why not set the bar higher next time？
translations.ふぅ……１００位以内に入ってた。: Phew... I made the top hundred.
translations.目標達成できてよかったね。: I'm glad you reached your goal.
translations.へへ……なんか、リンコまでホッとしちゃった。: Hehe... Now I feel relieved too.
translations.まあ、努力したんだし……いいじゃん。: Well, you put in the effort... so it's fine.
translations.そうそう。１位目指して努力したことに意味があるんだよ。: Yeah. Working hard for first place is what really matters.
translations.なに落ち込んでんの？ また次回頑張ればいいじゃん。: What are you moping for？ Just try again next time.
translations.そうだよ。イヤでもテストはまたやってくるんだから。: That's right. There's always gonna be another test whether you like it or not.
translations.やっぱり、１位なわけないか……。: Figured there was no way I'd get first...
translations.うん……無茶な目標だったかな。: Yeah... Maybe I aimed too high.
translations.そんなことないよ……また今度、頑張ろ。次は大丈夫だって！: No you didn't... Let's just try again next time. You'll do fine!
translations.残念……１０位以内ならずか。: Too bad... Didn't make the top ten.
translations.そっか……でも、頑張ってたのは知ってるからさ。: I see... Well, I know how hard you worked for it.
translations.元気だしなよ。この世の終わりってわけじゃあるまいし。: Cheer up. It's not like it's the end of the world.
translations.その代わり、次は絶対リベンジだから！: Just make sure you get them back next time!
translations.あーあ……１０位以内に入れなかったか……。: Man... I didn't make the top ten...
translations.残念だったね。でも、頑張ってる姿はカッコよかった……かもね。へへ。: Too bad. Still, seeing you try so hard was pretty cool... maybe. Heh.
translations.だから元気出して、また頑張ろうよ。: So cheer up, and let's give it another shot next time.
translations.げっ……１００位以内に入ってない。: Ugh... I didn't even make the top hundred.
translations.あーあ、目標達成ならず。: Oh well, so much for reaching your goal.
translations.まあまあ自信あったのにな……。: And here I felt pretty confident about it...
translations.その自信が油断につながるんだってば。: That confidence is what makes you careless, you know.
translations.あー……１００位にも入れなかった。: Aw man... I couldn't even crack the top hundred.
translations.残念でした。まあ、惜しかったんじゃないの？: Too bad for you. Well, you were probably close, right？
translations.思い切って１０位以内とか目指せば、１００位以内なんて楽勝かもよ。: If you go all out and aim for the top ten, making the top hundred might be a breeze.
translations.うわ……マジか。１００位にも入ってない……。: Whoa... Seriously？ I'm not even in the top hundred...
translations.うーん……応援してたのに。: Hmm... And after I was rooting for you, too.
translations.これは……努力不足だったな。認めるよ。: Yeah... I just didn't put in enough effort. I'll admit it.
translations.まあ、あんまり落ち込まないでよ。: Well, don't let it get you down too much.
translations.とにかく、これでほんとに試験は全部終わり！: Anyway, exams are officially all over now!
translations.さぁ、これからはパッと気分をかえて遊ぼうよ。: Come on, let's put all that behind us and go have some fun.
translations.ああ。デートもしないとな。: Yeah. We've gotta go on some dates, too.
translations.そうこうしてるうちに、もうすぐお楽しみの夏休みだよ♪: And before we know it, summer break will finally be here.
translations.ああ。気分をかえて、いっぱい思い出つくろうな。: Yeah. Let's switch gears and make a ton of memories.
translations.テストが終わったらもう年末。冬休みももうすぐだよ。: Now that exams are over, it's already the end of the year. Winter break is right around the corner.
translations.ほんとだな。満喫するか。: You're right. Let's make the most of it.
translations.うん、その名も『十羽野城の亡霊』。: Yeah. They call it 'The Ghost of Towano Castle.'
translations.亡霊……怪談？: A ghost... Like a ghost story？
translations.というよりは、都市伝説……なのかな。: More like an urban legend, I guess.
translations.最近、十羽野城で夜な夜な妙なうめき声が聞こえるんだってさ。ありがちといえばありが: Lately, people say you can hear strange groaning sounds at Towano Castle every night. Pretty cliche, I know, but still.
translations.へえ……城なら雰囲気あるかもな。: Huh... Well, a castle definitely has the right atmosphere for it.
translations.でさ……行っとく？: So... wanna go check it out？
translations.そう。まだ早いかもしれないけど……雰囲気くらいは味わえるんじゃない。: Yeah. It might still be a little early, but... we should at least get a feel for the atmosphere.
translations.決まり。ほら、行くよ！: Then it's settled. Come on, let's go!
translations.さて……どこら辺なのかな……。: Now then... I wonder where around here it is...
translations.城っていっても広いからな。一周するのも大変だし……。: It's a pretty big castle, after all. Just walking all the way around it is a lot of work...
translations.……なんかいざとなると、めんどくさくなってきたかも。:
...Now that we're actually
here, it's starting to feel
like a pain.
translations.聞こえない？ うめき声。:
Don't you hear it？
A moaning sound.
translations.よし、じゃあ行きますか。カレシが怖がりだからさ。:
Alright, let's get going.
Since my boyfriend's such
a scaredy-cat.
translations.あのさ、アレ、なんだったのかな……。:
Hey, I wonder what that
thing was...
translations.ほら、『十羽野城の亡霊』。:
You know, the 'Ghost of
Towano Castle.'
translations.ねえ、また行ってみようよ。:
Hey, let's go check it
out again.
translations.出るってわかってれば怖くないって、ほら。:
It's not scary if we know
it's coming. Come on.
translations.前、声が聞こえたのってこの辺だよね。:
This is where we heard the
voice last time, right？
translations.ううん、聞こえないな。: No, I don't hear a thing.
translations.まあ、空耳だったかもしれないし。なんかの動物だったのかもな。:
Well, we might've imagined
it. Or maybe it was some
kind of animal.
translations.うーん、そんなところか。長居しても時間のムダだし、行こっか。:
Yeah, probably. Staying here
is a waste of time anyway,
so let's head back.
translations.噂……特には聞いてないけど。:
A rumor...？ I haven't heard
anything in particular.
translations.じゃあ教える。それは『屋敷のドラキュラ伝説』。:
Then I'll tell you. It's the
'Legend of the Mansion
Dracula.'
translations.違うっつーの、現実の噂。最近、話題になってる。:
No way, it's a real rumor.
People have been talking
about it lately.
translations.この町にある洋館でさ、夜な夜な悪魔の儀式が行われているとか、行われていないとか…:
At the Western mansion in
town, they say dark rituals
are held every night...
or maybe they aren't...
translations.噂だからね。……じゃあ、はっきりさせとく？:
Well, it is a rumor.
...Want to go find out
for sure？
translations.うーん、雰囲気あるね……。:
Hmm, it's definitely got
the right atmosphere...
translations.儀式は夜な夜ななんだろ、今はまだ早いんじゃないか？:
The rituals are at night,
right？ Isn't it still a bit
too early？
translations.そこをなんとかするのが、ハンターの仕事でしょ。:
Making it work anyway is
a hunter's job, right？
translations.いいから、働く！: Never mind that, get to work!
translations.ううん、音……なんか聞こえる……。:
No, a sound...
I can hear something...
translations.では、はっきりしたということで。:
Well, now that we've
cleared that up.
translations.賛成。ほら、早く行くよ。:
Agreed. Come on,
let's get moving.
translations.そういえば、噂、本当だったのかな……。:
By the way, I wonder if that
rumor was actually true...
translations.あの噂、『屋敷のドラキュラ伝説』。:
That one—'The Legend of
Dracula's Mansion.'
translations.やっぱり気になるからさ、また行っていい？:
It's still bugging me.
Can we go back again？
translations.大丈夫だって、リンコがついてるからさ。:
Relax, you've got me
with you.
translations.なんでかな、悪魔の休日？:
I wonder why. Is it
the devil's day off？
translations.かもな。それか、なにかを聞き間違いしたのかもしれないし。:
Maybe. Or maybe we just
misheard something.
translations.そりゃあ、実際に悪魔の儀式なわけないけどさ、もうちょっと期待してたのに。:
Obviously it wasn't a real
ritual, but I was still
hoping for a little more.
translations.実際はこんなもんだろ。:
That's usually how these
things go in real life.
translations.んー、まあ、少しは暇つぶしになったかな。行こ。:
Well, it killed a little
time, at least. Let's go.
translations.あ、昨日のニュース観た？ 例のやつ。:
Oh, did you see the news
yesterday？ About that thing.
translations.それ、未確認動物。山の方で足跡が目撃されたって。:
Yeah, an unidentified animal.
They say someone spotted
tracks up in the mountains.
translations.そうみたい。実際のビッグフットはまだ発見されてないんだって。:
Looks like it. They haven't
found Bigfoot itself yet.
translations.発見されてたら、もっと大騒ぎになってるよな。:
If they had, there'd be
a much bigger fuss about it.
translations.ここだけの話、見つけたら賞金も出るらしいよ。:
Between you and me, I hear
there's a reward if you
manage to find it.
translations.どう、賞金稼ぎ、してみれば？:
What do you say？ Wanna try
being a bounty hunter？
translations.●が？ ▲小早川＊▲も手伝ってくれるのか？:
●？ Are you gonna
help me too, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.……まさか。めんどくさいし、本当にいるわけないじゃん。:
...As if. That's way too much
trouble, and there's no way
it's actually real.
translations.だからさ、暇つぶしにアンタが探してよ。:
So why don't you go look
for it to kill some time？
translations.あのニュースにはがっかりだったね……。:
That news turned out to be
a real letdown...
translations.ん、何の話？:
Hm？ What are you
talking about？
translations.ああ、前に話した『山奥のビッグフット』。:
Oh, the 'Bigfoot in the
Mountains' thing from before.
translations.結局誰かのイタズラだったってさ。:
Turns out it was just
somebody's prank.
translations.イタズラにしてもさ、もっと洗練されててほしいよね。:
Even for a prank, I wish
it had a little more style.
translations.誰に迷惑かけるでもないんだから、エンタテインメントに徹してさ。:
It wasn't hurting anyone, so
they should've gone all out
to make it entertaining.
translations.本気にした人も結構いたみたいだけどな。:
Seems like plenty of people
actually bought it, though.
translations.やれやれだね。でもまあ、その人達も楽しかったんじゃない？:
Good grief. Still, I bet
those people had fun with
it anyway, right？
translations.はあ、何か他に面白いことないかなー……。:
Sigh... Isn't there anything
else interesting going on...？
translations.リンコが仕入れてきた話、聞きたい？:
Want to hear a story I
picked up？
translations.『渓谷の幽霊』……知ってる？:
'The Ghost of the Gorge'...
Ever heard of it？
translations.怪談か……知らないな。:
A ghost story, huh...
No, I haven't.
translations.今、結構話題らしいよ。:
Apparently a lot of people
are talking about it lately.
translations.奥十羽野の渓谷に、この世に未練を残した女性の幽霊が……って。:
They say the ghost of a
woman with lingering regrets
haunts the Okutowano gorge...
translations.へえ、話題ってことは、目撃されたりするんだ。:
Huh. If people are talking
about it, someone must've
seen her.
translations.そうみたい。ありがちな話だけど、こう身近にあると、ちょっとワクワクしてくるじゃん:
Seems like it. It's a cliché
story, sure, but when it's
this close to home, it's kind
of exciting.
translations.そういうもの。遠くのメジャーな幽霊より、近くのマイナー幽霊だよ。:
That's how it is. A minor
local ghost beats a famous
one far away.
translations.『渓谷の幽霊』の話、してたよな。:
You were talking about the
'Ghost of the Gorge' before,
right？
translations.あー……あったね、そんなの。:
Oh... Right, that was a
thing.
translations.まあ、新情報もなかったしね。なにかあったの？:
Well, nothing new came up.
Why, did something happen？
translations.ああ、実はこんなメールが来たんだけど……。:
Yeah, I actually got this
email...
translations.イタズラにしては……結構手が込んでるね。:
For a prank... it's pretty
elaborate.
translations.最初届いたときは、結構本気でビックリしたよ。:
When I first got it, it
really freaked me out.
translations.……ねえ、なんでアンタんとこに来たわけ？:
...Hey, why did it get sent
to you, anyway？
translations.んー、他にも届いた人いるかな。ローカルな幽霊なんだから、無差別メールってわけでも:
Hmm, wonder if anyone else
got it. It's a local ghost, so
it can't just be random spam...
translations.（まあ、面白がってはくれたみたいだな……）:
(Well, at least she seems
amused by it...)
translations.あのさ、前に遊園地に行ったじゃん。:
Hey, remember when we went
to the amusement park？
translations.そのときに落とし物しちゃってさ。:
I dropped something while
we were there.
translations.お気に入りのネコのキーホルダー。そのときは気付かなくってさ。:
My favorite cat keychain.
I didn't notice at the time.
translations.そっか……遊園地には届けたのか？:
I see... Did you check with
the park？
translations.早めにした方がいいんじゃないのか？ お気に入りなんだろ。:
Shouldn't you do that soon？
It's your favorite, right？
translations.そうなんだけど、噂がね……。:
Yeah, I know, but there's
this rumor...
translations.夜中に、園内の落とし物を拾って回ってるらしいよ。:
Apparently it wanders the
park at night picking up
lost items.
translations.いいお化けなんだな。: So it's a nice ghost, then.
translations.それだけじゃないんだって。そのお化けに拾われた物は、直接取り返さないと呪われるっ:
That's not all, though. They
say if it picks up your stuff,
you get cursed unless you take
it back in person.
translations.呪いが怖いわけじゃないけど……なんか悔しいじゃん、負けたみたいで。:
It's not that I'm scared of
the curse... It'd just bug me,
like I'm admitting defeat.
translations.でも、どうやって探すんだ。入れないだろ。:
Wait, how are we supposed to
look？ We can't get inside.
translations.それは……こう、上手く侵入して……。:
Well... we just, you know,
sneak our way in...
translations.冗談だっつーの。正直に言えば、入れてくれないかな。:
I'm kidding, obviously.
If we just explain things,
maybe they'll let us in.
translations.話のわかる人でよかったね。これで探せるよ。:
Good thing they understood.
Now we can look for it.
translations.そうだな。あまり遅くならないうちに探すか。:
Yeah. Let's look for it
before it gets too late.
translations.ダメ、見つかんない。: No luck. I can't find it.
translations.暗いしな……そろそろ諦めるか？:
It's dark out, too... Should
we give up for tonight？
translations.君たちどうしたの、こんな時間に。もうとっくに閉園だよ。:
What are you two doing here
at this hour？ The park closed
a long time ago.
translations.ああ、ネコのキーホルダーね。あったあった。:
Oh, a cat keychain, right？
Yeah, I found that.
translations.うん。えっと、ありがとうございました。:
Yeah. Um, thank you
very much.
translations.いやいや。それにしても……着替えるの面倒だから、このまま閉園後に見回りしてたんだ:
Don't mention it. I was just
doing rounds like this 'cause
changing's a pain... Had no
idea it started a rumor.
translations.迷惑かけるのもなんだし、これからは着替えてからにするよ。じゃあ、早く帰りなよ。:
I don't wanna cause trouble,
so I'll change first from now
on. Well, get on home now.
translations.へへ、最初ビビってたくせに。:
Heh, says the guy who was
scared at first.
translations.はは。まあ遅くなるとなんだし、帰るか。:
Haha. Well, before it gets
too late, let's head home.
translations.来たはいいけど……入れるのかな。:
We made it here, sure...
but can we even get in？
translations.どうだろ。勝手に入るわけにもいかないし……警備の人、いないかな。探してみるか。:
Who knows. We can't just walk
in... Maybe there's a guard
around. Let's take a look.
translations.人はいないみたいだな。今日は諦めるか。:
Looks like nobody's around.
Should we give up for today？
translations.お化けに拾われてるとは限らないからな。案内所で、落とし物届けられてないか聞いてこ:
No guarantee the ghost picked
it up. Let's ask at the info
desk if anyone turned it in.
translations.ネコのキーホルダー……届けられてませんね。申し訳ありません。:
A cat keychain... No, nothing
like that has been turned in.
I'm very sorry.
translations.なんか慣れないっていうか……。: I'm still not really used to this...
translations.イヤなわけじゃないから。: It's not like I hate it.
translations.そっか、こういう感じなんだ……。: I see, so that's how it feels...
translations.なんでそんな嬉しそうなわけ？ こっちまでつられるじゃん。: Why do you look so happy？ You're making me smile too.
translations.もう……ほんと好きだね。バーカ♪: Geez... you really love this, huh？ Dummy♪
translations.なんか、どんどんエロおやじ化してない？: Aren't you turning into more and more of a dirty old man？
translations.あのさ……ううん、なんでもない。そのままでいい。: Hey... Never mind, it's nothing. Just stay like that.
translations.はいはい、満足した？ まだって顔してるけど。: Yeah, yeah, are you satisfied？ Your face says not yet, though.
translations.うれしがっちゃってさ。ヘンな顔♪ へへ。: Look how happy you are. What a goofy face♪ Hehe.
translations.これじゃ、リンコたちバカップルじゃん。: At this rate, we're just a pair of lovey-dovey idiots.
translations.リンコも反撃しちゃおっかなぁ？ えいっ！ とかね。: Maybe I'll fight back too？ Like, take that!
translations.こんなことで喜ぶなんてバカじゃないの？ ま、リンコもだけどさ。: Getting happy over something like this is so dumb. Well, I'm no better.
translations.もっとイチャイチャしたいんだ？ どうしよっかなぁ？: You wanna get even more lovey-dovey？ Hmm, what should I do？
translations.リンコがこんな気分になるの、アンタだけだからね。わかってる？: You're the only one who makes me feel like this. You know that, right？
translations.ほんと、リンコのこと好きだよね。わかったわかった。: You really like me, huh？ Alright, alright.
translations.そんな目で見るなっつーの。なんか……照れるし。: Quit looking at me like that. It's... kinda embarrassing.
translations.これでリンコが喜ぶと思った？ まあ、はずれてはないよ。: Did you think this would make me happy？ Well, you're not wrong.
translations.恥ずかしいじゃん……いいけど。: That's embarrassing... Not that I mind.
translations.なんて言えばいいか、まだわかんない。: I still don't know what I'm supposed to say.
translations.どうしたいの？ 言ってみ。: What do you wanna do？ Go on, tell me.
translations.また？ しょうがないなぁ。: Again？ Guess I have no choice.
translations.また、そんなくっついて……。: Clinging to me like that again...
translations.リンコたち、こんなのばっかだね。: This is all we ever do, huh？
translations.もっとベタベタしたいでしょ？: You wanna be all over me even more, right？
translations.ほっぺたスリスリしちゃおっかな。: Maybe I'll rub my cheek against yours.
translations.まあね……好きかも。: Well... I think I like it.
translations.そっちのほうが顔赤いってば。: Your face is way redder than mine.
translations.アンタだから、いいんだもん。: It's only okay because it's you.
translations.そんなのヤダって……ちょっとだけ、だけど。: I said no... Okay, just a little.
translations.ひゃ！ その手、つねるよ。: Eek! I'm gonna pinch that hand.
translations.へへ、ダメだって言ってるじゃん。: Hehe, I told you no, didn't I？
translations.こういうの、うれしいもんだね。: Stuff like this actually feels nice.
translations.可愛がってくれてるってこと？: Are you trying to spoil me？
translations.髪って、けっこう特別なんだよ？: My hair's pretty special, you know？
translations.もっと……いいかも。: A little more... might be nice.
translations.一瞬、目つむっちゃった。: I closed my eyes for a second.
translations.ちょっとだけ……慣れたかも。: I think I'm getting a little used to it.
translations.それで、次はどうすんの？: So, what are you gonna do next？
translations.もう、特別だっつーの……。: Geez, I'm making an exception here...
translations.耳、好きなわけ？ ……もう。: Do you have a thing for ears？ ...Geez.
translations.そんな……急だっつーの。: Hey... that was way too sudden.
translations.待って……ダメだって。: Wait... I told you not to.
translations.んっ！ ……ちょっと、びっくりしただけ。: Nngh! ...I was just a little surprised, that's all.
translations.喜ぶなっつーの。: Don't look so happy about it.
translations.リンコのこと好きだから？: Is it because you like me？
translations.腕組んだら、恋人って感じするよね。: Linking arms really makes us feel like a couple, huh.
translations.いいね、腕組むって。: It's nice, linking arms like this.
translations.スリスリしたくなっちゃうじゃん。: You're gonna make me wanna nuzzle up to you.
translations.もっとギュッてしていいよ？: You can hold me even tighter, you know？
translations.もう離れたくないもんっ。: I don't wanna let go anymore.
translations.リンコの手、冷たくないかな？: I hope my hands aren't cold.
translations.緊張して、汗ばんじゃうかも。: I'm nervous, so my hands might get sweaty.
translations.恋人つなぎがいい？:
Do you want to lace
our fingers together？
translations.手つなぐの……好きかも。:
Holding hands...
I think I like it.
translations.はい、貸してあげる。: Here, I'll lend it to you.
translations.もう離れないんじゃない？ へへ。:
Don't think we'll ever
let go now, huh？ Hehe.
translations.リンコの手、どうしたいわけ？:
What are you trying to do
with my hand？
translations.かるーくつなぐのもいいよね。:
Holding hands lightly
is nice too, isn't it？
translations.すごく、ドキドキしてきた。:
My heart is pounding
so hard now.
translations.恥ずかしくて……顔見れない。:
It's embarrassing...
I can't look at you.
translations.もっとなでていいよ？:
You can stroke it more,
you know？
translations.アンタのほっぺも触っていい？: Can I touch your cheek too？
translations.ほっぺとほっぺ、くっつけてみる？:
Want to press our cheeks
together？
translations.きゃっ……心臓止まるかと思った。:
Eek... I thought my heart
was gonna stop.
translations.くすぐったいけど……気持ちいいかも。:
It tickles, but...
I think it feels nice.
translations.もしかして、色っぽかった？:
Did it look sexy or
something？
translations.つい、手が伸びたとか？ へへ。:
Couldn't keep your hands
to yourself？ Hehe.
translations.うなじってそんなにいい？:
Is the nape of my neck
really that great？
translations.わりと気持ちいいよ？:
That feels pretty nice,
you know？
translations.なんて言ったらいいんだろ……。: I'm not sure how to put it...
translations.もっと触りたくなる？: Does that make you want to touch me more？
translations.クセになったらどうすんの？: What're you gonna do if it becomes a habit？
translations.ホコリでも付いてた？: Was there dust on me or something？
translations.え？ なにかあった？: Huh？ Was there something on me？
translations.きゃっ！ 一気に背筋伸びた……。: Eek! That made my back straighten right up...
translations.本ばっか読んでると、いつのまにか猫背になるんだよね。: When all I do is read, I end up slouching before I know it.
translations.はい、アンタも姿勢よく！: All right, you fix your posture too!
translations.なに？ アヤシイ触りかた……。: What？ You're touching me in a weird way...
translations.背中？ 触りたいんだ？: My back？ You want to touch it？
translations.えっ？ あ、呼ばれたかと思った。: Huh？ Oh, I thought you were calling me.
translations.見えないから……緊張する。: I can't see what you're doing, so... it makes me nervous.
translations.なんか楽しんでる？: Are you having fun with this or something？
translations.ヘンな感じ……イヤじゃなくてさ。: It feels weird... Not in a bad way, though.
translations.なにげなくがいいかも。: I think I like it when you're casual about it.
translations.リンコ、困った顔してる？: Do I have a troubled look on my face？
translations.もうっ、手の動きがなんかヘン。: Geez, the way you're moving your hand is weird.
translations.それも、愛情表現？: Is that another way of showing affection？
translations.ちょっと、なに調子に乗ってんの？: Hey, why are you getting so carried away？
translations.その手、つねっちゃおうかな？: Maybe I should pinch that hand of yours？
translations.あっ！ ん～、我慢してあげる。: Ah! Mmm, I'll put up with it for you.
translations.キックしてほしいなら言って？: If you want me to kick you, just say the word, okay？
translations.やっぱエロおやじ？: So you really are a dirty old man？
translations.誰が触っていいって言った？: Who said you could touch me there？
translations.反射的に、キックが出そう……。: I'm about to kick you on reflex...
translations.あんまり触りすぎるのは……。: Touching me too much is a little...
translations.まあ、無理に止めないけど。: Well, I won't force you to stop.
translations.これってさ、関係が進展してるってこと？:
So, does this mean our
relationship is progressing？
translations.どのくらい我慢してて欲しい？:
How long do you want me
to put up with this？
translations.リンコにかまって欲しいんだ？:
You want Rinko to pay
attention to you？
translations.えっと、なんの話だっけ？:
Um, what was I talking
about again？
translations.で、続きなんだけどさ。: So, back to what I was saying.
translations.もう、わかんなくなったじゃん。:
Geez, now I lost my
train of thought.
translations.話の続きしていい？: Can I finish what I was saying？
translations.なんだじゃないっつーの。もうちょっと驚いてくれないと、張り合いないじゃん。: Don't give me 'just you.' Where's the fun in it if you don't act a little more surprised？
translations.もしかしてずっと隠れてた？: Wait, were you hiding there the whole time？
translations.なかなか見つけてくれないからさ、待ちきれなくて出てきちゃった。へへ。: You were taking forever to spot me, so I got tired of waiting and came out. Hehe.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。……なんかさ、今日のアンタ、いつもとちょっと違う。: ▲主人公＊▲. ...You know, something seems a little different about you today.
translations.そうか？ 一緒だろ？: Really？ Pretty sure I'm the same as always.
translations.ふうん……じゃあ、リンコのせいなのかな。: Hmm... Maybe it's just me, then.
translations.なんだか、いつもと違うことが起きそうな予感してる。だから周りも特別に見えるのかも: I just have this feeling something out of the ordinary's gonna happen. Maybe that's making everything around me look special.
translations.よっ。遅刻したわりにテンション高いな。: Hey. You're in pretty high spirits for someone who's late.
translations.気合入れて準備してたら遅れちゃったの。それぐらい大目に見てよ。: I went all out getting ready and lost track of time. Cut me some slack, okay？
translations.ねえ、さっきから女の人ばっかり見てたでしょ。: Hey. You've been checking out other girls this whole time, haven't you？
translations.▲小早川＊▲……ちがうって。▲小早川＊▲のこと探してたんだよ。: ▲小早川＊▲... Come on, no I wasn't. I was looking for you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ホント？ じゃ、リンコのことだけ、ずっと見つめてられる？: Really？ Then can you keep your eyes just on me the whole time？
translations.ちょっと、何本気にしてんだっつーの……こっちにらむの禁止！: Hey, don't take it so literally... No glaring at me!
translations.▲小早川＊▲。待った？: ▲小早川＊▲. Did I keep you waiting？
translations.リンコも今来たとこ。カレシのこと待つのもたまにはいいもんだね。: I just got here too. Waiting around for my boyfriend isn't so bad once in a while.
translations.まあ、色々考えるのがね。今日はどんな話しようかな……とかさ。: Yeah, it gives me time to think about stuff. Like what we're gonna talk about today...
translations.じゃあ、次もゆっくりでいいか。: Guess I can take my time next time, too.
translations.たまにだっつーの。あとわざと遅れるとかナシだから。: I said once in a while! And showing up late on purpose is totally off-limits.
translations.今日、テンション高くない？: You're pretty hyped up today, aren't you？
translations.カレシがデートの準備がんばってくれたみたいだからね。そのせいかも。: Well, it looks like my boyfriend worked really hard planning our date. Maybe that's why.
translations.プレッシャーかけるなあ。: Way to put the pressure on.
translations.期待してんの！ 頼むよ。: I've got high hopes! Don't let me down.
translations.あ、いた。……もう、探したって。: Oh, there you are. ...Jeez, I've been looking all over for you.
translations.ごめん。人が多くてさ、●も▲小早川＊▲のこと見つけられなかった。: Sorry. It's so crowded, ● couldn't find you either, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……すぐに見つけろっつーの。: ...You're supposed to find me right away.
translations.なんでもない。ほら、行こ。: It's nothing. Come on, let's go.
translations.もう、遅いっ！: Jeez, what took you so long!
translations.そうだけど。さっきまでいたカップルがさ、横でずっとイチャイチャして……。: Yeah, I know, but... there was a couple right next to me being all lovey-dovey until a second ago...
translations.それで自分もしたくなったとか……。: Don't tell me that made you want to do it too...
translations.は？ 違うっつーの！ 見せつけられて困ってたの。バカじゃん。: Huh？ As if! It was just awkward having them flaunt it in front of me. You're such an idiot.
translations.ごめんじゃないっつーの。アンタが遅いから、声かけられちゃったじゃん。: Don't give me 'sorry.' Some guy came up and talked to me because you were late.
translations.え!? ナンパか？: What!? Was he hitting on you？
translations.まあ、たぶん。しつこくなかったから大丈夫だけど、そんなに慌てるぐらいなら最初から: Probably, yeah. He wasn't pushy, so it's fine, but if you're gonna get that worked up, don't be late in the first place.
translations.アンタって……意外に目立つかも、遠くにいてもすぐわかる。: You... actually stand out more than I thought. I can spot you right away, even from a distance.
translations.へえ、それっていい意味ってことだよな？: Oh yeah？ You mean that in a good way, right？
translations.えっ？ えっと……じゃあ、悪い意味ってことで。: Huh？ Um... In that case, let's say in a bad way.
translations.とりあえずお茶でもいっとく？: Want to go grab something to drink first？
translations.じゃあ、お茶にするか。: Let's go get something to drink, then.
translations.ねえ。少しお茶してこうよ。いいでしょ。: Hey. Let's stop for a drink for a bit. Okay？
translations.そういえばさ、前のバレンタインのこと、覚えてる？: By the way, do you remember last Valentine's Day？
translations.前の……って、●たちの？: Last Valentine's... You mean the one ● spent with you？
translations.そう。ほら、あげたじゃん、チョコ。: Yeah. Remember, I gave you chocolate.
translations.あ、ごめん。思い出し笑い。ホワイトデーの。: Oh, sorry. Just laughing at a memory. From White Day.
translations.そう。くれたじゃん、お返し。: Yeah. Remember, you got me something in return.
translations.クリスマスのこと、思い出しちゃう……。: I keep thinking back to Christmas...
translations.アンタと一緒に過ごしたクリスマスのこと。: The Christmas I spent with you.
translations.ん？ ああ、当たり前じゃん。そうじゃなくて思い出してただけ。: Hm？ Oh, obviously not. That's not what I meant, I was just thinking back to it.
translations.だって、たまに思い出しちゃうんだもん。お祝いしてもらったこと。: Well, I can't help thinking back on it sometimes. How you celebrated it with me.
translations.突然だけどさ、アンタの誕生日、欲しいものがあれば聞いとくけど。: Kind of random, I know, but if there's anything you want for your birthday, I'm listening.
translations.とか言って、もう考えてあったりして？: You say that, but don't you already have something in mind？
translations.ただ。前より喜んで欲しいから、リサーチ。前のときのこと、覚えてる？: It's just, I want you to like it even more than last time, so I'm doing some research. Do you remember last time？
translations.前の記念日のこと、覚えてる？: Do you remember our last anniversary？
translations.記念日って……●たちが付き合い始めた？: Anniversary... You mean of when you and ● started going out？
translations.そう、一緒にお祝いしたじゃん。: Yeah, we celebrated it together, remember？
translations.●の余裕がむかつくって言ってたよな: You said it ticked you off how calm ● was.
translations.カノジョに誤解させるのが悪いって言ってたよな: You said it was my fault for giving my girlfriend the wrong idea.
translations.▲小早川＊▲は最初から信じてたって言ってたよな: You said ▲小早川＊▲ could be trusted from the start
translations.●が選んだんならガッカリするわけないって言ってくれたよな: You said if ● picked it, you wouldn't be disappointed
translations.しょうがないから受け取ってあげるって言ってたよな: You said you'd accept it since you had no choice
translations.どうやって渡してくれるかが楽しみだって言ってたよな: You said you were looking forward to how I'd give it to you
translations.もっとクリスマスが好きになったら……って言ってたよな: You said, "If I start liking Christmas even more..."
translations.肝心なときに何も言えなくなるって言ってたよな: You said you never know what to say when it counts
translations.すこしだけ素直になるって言ってたよな: You said you'd try being a little more honest
translations.来年も祝ってくれるかって言ってたよな: You asked if I'd celebrate with you next year too
translations.次の誕生日も楽しいといいって言ってたよな: You said you hoped your next birthday would be fun too
translations.楽しい分、お別れが寂しいって言ってたよな: You said the more fun it is, the harder it is to say goodbye
translations.カノジョが帰るのにしないのか……って言ってたよな: You asked if I wasn't going to do it before you went home...
translations.寂しがりやのカレシを持つと苦労するって言ってたよな: You said it's tough having a boyfriend who gets lonely easily
translations.祝ってくれたかわりに、お願いしてきたよな: You asked me for a favor in return for celebrating
translations.明日もその先もずっと会えるって言ってたよな: You said we'd see each other tomorrow and forever after
translations.プレゼントだけじゃなくて言葉も必要って言ってたよな: You said you needed words too, not just a present
translations.恋人同士なんだから恥ずかしがることないって言ってたよな: You said we're a couple so there's nothing to be shy about
translations.当然か。リンコのカレシはいつもリンコのこと、考えてくれてるもんね？: Of course you do. My boyfriend's always thinking about me, right？
translations.そこまで言われると、ちょっと照れるけどな。: When you put it like that, it's kind of embarrassing.

translations.今日のこと、忘れられないと思う。それくらい、特別なデートだったと思うよ。ありがと: I don't think I'll ever forget today. That's how special a date it was. Thanks.
translations.いつもより、たくさんがんばったよね。そういうのわかるからさ、ほんと、ありがと。: You tried a lot harder than usual today, didn't you？ I notice things like that, so really, thanks.
translations.今日って特別な日だよね？\nなら、もうちょっと特別なこと、一緒にしたかった。\n:
Today's a special day, right？
I wanted to do something a bit more special together.
Didn't you feel the same way？
translations.ありがと。今日はスペシャルなデートになったよ。こういう思い出、大切にしたいよね。: Thanks. Today turned into a really special date. I want to treasure memories like this.
translations.永遠のお別れでもないのに、離れたくなくなってる。リンコ……どうかしちゃったのかな: It's not like this is goodbye forever, so why don't I want to leave？ I wonder what's gotten into me...
translations.●だってずっと一緒にいられるなら、そうしたいけど……。: ●I mean, if we could stay together forever, I'd love to, but...
translations.あのね、だから、もう少しだけ……。: Hey, so... just for a little longer...
translations.あ……うん……\nもうちょっとこっち来て。:
Um... yeah...
Come a little closer.
translations.へへ、びっくりした？ \nお別れの……ってやつ。\nじゃあね。:
Hehe, did I surprise you？
A little goodbye... you know.
See ya.
translations.……これでおしまいか。うん、楽しかった。じゃ、またね。: ...Guess that's it for today. Yeah, I had fun. See you later.
translations.ありがと。……帰らないわけにいかないもんね。じゃ、また。: Thanks. ...Can't just not go home, I guess. See you later.
translations.もうちょっと…………ううん、ワガママか。バイバイ。: Just a little longer... ...No, I'm being selfish. Bye-bye.
translations.最後にもうちょっと…………しょうがないか。じゃあね。: Just a little more before we go... ...Guess it can't be helped. See ya.
translations.じゃあ、またね。最後にワガママ言ってごめん。: Well, see you later. Sorry for being selfish at the end.
translations.そろそろ暗くなってきたね。ライトアップ始まる頃かな？: It's starting to get dark. I wonder if they'll turn the lights on soon？
translations.そうだな。……ところで、寒くない？: Yeah. ...By the way, aren't you cold？
translations.ちょっとだけね。でも大丈夫……くしゅんっ……へへ。: Just a little. But I'm fine... *achoo*... Hehe.
translations.ほら。春っていってもまだ夜は寒いからさ、あんまり無理すんなよ。: See？ Even though it's spring, the nights are still cold, so don't tough it out too much.
translations.……うん。じゃ、お願いしちゃおっかな。: ...Okay. Then maybe I'll ask you for a favor.
translations.逃げるなっつーの。こうする方がいいでしょ。: Hey, don't back away. It's better this way, right？
translations.いいじゃん、べつに。他のカップルもみんな同じことしてるんだし。: What's the big deal？ All the other couples are doing the same thing anyway.
translations.そうだな……よし。早く行かないと、桜が見やすい場所取られちゃうぞ。: True... All right. If we don't hurry, someone's gonna take the good spots to see the cherry blossoms.
translations.よかったね。見やすい場所がすいてて。: Good thing a spot with a nice view was open.
translations.すいてたんじゃなくて、必死で確保したんだけどな。: It wasn't just open—I had to scramble to save it for us, you know.
translations.……こうして見ると、昼間とはぜんぜん印象が違うよね。: ...Looking at them like this, they give off a totally different vibe than during the day.
translations.そんな陳腐な一言で片付けたくないな…………でも、いい言葉が出てこないや。: I don't want to sum it up with a cliché like that... ...Still, I can't think of a better way to put it.
translations.キレイに咲いていられるのって、短い期間なんだよね。咲いたと思ったらすぐ散っちゃう: They only stay in bloom for such a short time. Just when you think they've opened, they're already falling.
translations.そうだな……。でも、また来年きっとキレイな花が咲くよ。: True... Still, I'm sure they'll bloom just as nicely again next year.
translations.来年、か……。また……来れるかな……アンタと一緒に……。: Next year, huh... I wonder if we'll be able to come back... together...
translations.桜が散る話なんかしたからかな……なんか不安になっちゃったかも。: Maybe it's because I brought up the petals falling... I think I just made myself anxious.
translations.そんな心配いらないって。: You don't need to worry about that.
translations.うん、わかってる。わかってるよ。: Yeah, I know. I know that.
translations.でもちょっと……ぎゅってして。: Still... hold me tight for a second.
translations.来年も……桜見ような。: Let's come see the cherry blossoms next year, too.
translations.来年だけじゃなくて、その先もずっと、かな。: Not just next year. Every year after that, too.
translations.うん、来年も再来年も、その先もずっと……約束。: Yeah. Next year, the year after, and forever after that... It's a promise.
translations.すっかり神社のまわりの木も色づいてるね。……あっ、ぎんなん落ちてる。: The trees around the shrine have really changed color. ...Oh, there are ginkgo nuts on the ground.
translations.小さい頃、ぎんなん拾ったりした？: Did you ever pick up ginkgo nuts when you were little？
translations.拾った拾った。けど、臭いがね。: All the time. That smell, though.
translations.そうそう。手まで臭くなったりして。: Right, right. Even your hands end up smelling like them.
translations.まあ、あれも秋を感じるひとときだよね。: Well, that's just another little reminder that it's autumn.
translations.ち、が、う！ ぎんなんを拾うって行為が。: N-o! I mean the act of picking them up.
translations.小さい頃、夢中になってぎんなん拾っててさ。気づくとね、あの木と木の間を太陽が沈ん: When I was little, I'd get completely absorbed in picking them up. And before I knew it, the sun would be sinking right between those trees.
translations.夕焼けか……きれいだろうな。: The sunset, huh... Bet that was pretty.
translations.あのときも、リンコはこうやって木の間から、街が真っ赤に染まってくのを見てた……真: Back then, I'd stand here just like this, watching through the trees as the town turned bright red... until it got pitch dark.
translations.子供の頃の思い出ってさ、いつまで経っても忘れないよな。脳裏に焼き付いてるっていう: You never really forget childhood memories like that, do you. It's like they're burned into your mind.
translations.だよね。街がどんなに変わっても、この夕焼けだけはあの頃とぜんぜん変わらない。リン: Yeah. No matter how much the town changes, this sunset hasn't changed a bit since back then. It's the exact same sunset from my memories.
translations.わぁ……ライトアップされた紅葉もいいね。こんなに鮮やかなんだ……。: Wow... The autumn leaves look nice lit up, too. I didn't realize they'd be this vivid...
translations.リンコが小さい頃は日が落ちると、真っ暗だったんだよね。ここの境内。: When I was little, the shrine grounds here used to get pitch dark once the sun went down.
translations.べつに……ううん、アンタにウソついても仕方ないか。: Not really... No, there's no point lying to you, is there.
translations.すごく恐かった。なんか、世界でリンコ一人だけが取り残された気がしてさ……。: I was terrified. It felt like I was the only person left behind in the whole world...
translations.迎えに来てくれたお父さんの手が大きくて、あったかくて……安心したの覚えてる。: When my dad came to get me, his hand was so big and warm... I remember how safe it made me feel.
translations.風も出てきたし、あったかいものでも飲むか。向こうで甘酒配ってる。: The wind's picking up, so let's get something warm to drink. They're handing out amazake over there.
translations.●じゃ、お父さんの代わりにはならないかもしれないけどさ。: I guess ● isn't much of a substitute for your dad, though.
translations.小さい頃お父さんが引いてくれた手。今はアンタが引いてくれるわけか……へへ。: My dad used to take my hand when I was little. And now you're the one doing it, huh... Hehe.
translations.こうしてると、アンタの温度……伝わってくる。……あったかいよ。: Being like this, I can feel your warmth... It's nice and warm.
translations.今日ってさ、なんかカップル多くない？: Aren't there a lot of couples here today？
translations.そうだな。恋人同士にオススメの映画って、雑誌にも載ってたし。……嫌だった？: Yeah. It was in a magazine as a recommended movie for couples, too. ...Does that bother you？
translations.▲小早川＊▲はそういう映画、好きじゃないのかなって。: I just thought you might not like that kind of movie, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.リンコはストーリー上の必然性がない、狙ったようなラブシーンが嫌いなだけ。: I only hate forced love scenes that don't serve any purpose in the story.
translations.別に、内容が面白ければ、ジャンルは問わないよ。: As long as it's good, I don't really care about the genre.
translations.そっか、今日のやつ、面白いといいな。: Gotcha. Well, I hope today's is a good one.
translations.まあね。過度な期待はせずに、楽しむつもり。: Yeah. I'll just enjoy it without expecting too much.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、大丈夫か？ ハンカチあるけど……。: ▲小早川＊▲, are you okay？ I have a handkerchief if you need it...
translations.……ありがと。良かったね、この映画。: ...Thanks. That was a really good movie.
translations.ああ。でも▲小早川＊▲がそんなに感動するなんて、思わなかったよ。: Yeah. I didn't expect it to move you that much, though, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.前半さ、なんだよくある話か、って思ったの。: During the first half, I figured it was just another typical story.
translations.なのにクライマックス直前のシーン。ヒロインを危険に巻き込まないために、主人公が別: But then that scene right before the climax. The hero breaks up with the heroine so he won't drag her into danger, right？
translations.あそこは見せ場の一つだよな。: Yeah, that was one of the best scenes.
translations.それがようやく想いが通じた、最愛の人なのに……。それなのに……お別れだよ。それっ: Even though she's the person he loves most, and their feelings finally reached each other... Even so... they part ways. That's just too sad.
translations.リンコはやっと見つけた居場所がなくなるなんて、想像したくない。そんなことなら、一: I don't even want to imagine losing the place where I finally belong. I'd much rather jump into danger together than go through that.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲……そんなに感情移入してたんだ）: (▲小早川＊▲... She really got that emotionally invested in it.)
translations.大丈夫だよ、●は▲小早川＊▲を置いてどこかに行ったりしないから。: Don't worry. ● would never go off somewhere and leave you behind, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.本当に。●が▲小早川＊▲に寂しい想いなんかさせると思うか？: Really. Do you think ● would ever make you feel lonely like that, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.絶対だよ？ 絶対に一人で危ないまねとかしちゃダメだからね？: You promise, right？ You better never do anything dangerous all on your own, okay？
translations.そんなに念を押さなくても大丈夫だよ。: You don't have to stress over it that much. I won't.
translations.……よかった。へへ、嬉しいはずなのに、なんか泣きそう。: ...Good. Hehe, I should be happy, but I feel like I'm gonna cry.
translations.はぁ……緊張してきた。もうちょっとでトーナメント開始だよね？: Sigh... Now I'm getting nervous. The tournament's starting any minute now, right？
translations.カップルトーナメントな。ほら、肩の力を抜いて。: The couples tournament, yeah. Come on, loosen up a bit.
translations.……そういうアンタも、シューズ履き替え忘れてるんですけど？: ...You say that, but didn't you forget to change your shoes？
translations.まったくもう……お互い様だね。: Honestly... Guess we're in the same boat.
translations.勢いで来てみたけどさ、やっぱりいざとなると緊張してくるな。: We came here on a whim, but now that we're actually doing it, it really makes you nervous.
translations.そんなに緊張されたら困るよ。リンコのミスは、カレシが全部カバーしてくれるのを期待: It'll be a problem if you're that nervous. I'm counting on my boyfriend to cover for all of my mistakes.
translations.これよりトーナメント第一回戦を開始いたします。: We will now begin the first round of the tournament.
translations.さて……第一投いってきますか。よいしょっ。: Alright... Time for my first throw. Hup.
translations.そんな重い球、▲小早川＊▲には無理だって。もっと軽いの選んだ方が……。: A ball that heavy is way too much for you, ▲小早川＊▲. You should pick a lighter one...
translations.だいじょう……おっとと……せーのっ！: I'm fi... whoa there... Here goes!
translations.……ごめん。最後に●がスペア取れてれば、決勝にいけたのにな。: ...Sorry. If ● had picked up that last spare, we could've made the finals.
translations.そんなことないって。けっこう、かっこ良かったかも。: Don't say that. You were actually pretty cool.
translations.一応ね。リンコのミスを何度もスペアでカバーしてくれたじゃん。: Well, yeah. You covered for my mistakes with spares so many times.
translations.出演者の中でもスペア率は一番だよ。: You had the highest spare rate out of everyone here.
translations.結構苦労したんだぞ。▲小早川＊▲、取りにくいところばっかり残すから。: It wasn't easy, you know. ▲小早川＊▲, you kept leaving the hardest pins to pick up.
translations.カレシに活躍の機会を与えてあげたんだっつーの。: I was just giving my boyfriend a chance to shine, you know.
translations.まあね。でも、リンコは優勝よりも、ベストパートナー賞もらえたことの方が嬉しかった: Well, yeah. Still, I'm happier about getting the Best Partner Award than winning the whole thing.
translations.ベストパートナー賞の賞品ってなんだっけ。: What was the prize for the Best Partner Award again？
translations.２人の記念写真。: A commemorative photo of the two of us.
translations.いいじゃん。賞品よりもさ、あれだけたくさんいる中で、ベストパートナーだって言われ: Come on, it's nice. Forget the prize—I'm just happy they called us the best partners out of all those couples.
translations.アンタも喜んでくれないと、リンコがバカみたいじゃん。: If you aren't happy about it too, it makes me look silly.
translations.ごめんごめん、●だってうれしくないわけじゃないって。: Sorry, sorry. ● really am happy about it too.
translations.へへ、これからもずっとリンコのベストパートナーでいてよね。: Hehe. Keep being my best partner from now on, okay？
translations.▲小早川＊▲、さっきからずっとウィンドウショッピングばっかりしてるけど、何か欲し: ▲小早川＊▲, we've just been window-shopping this whole time. Isn't there anything you want？
translations.もしかして優しいカレシが何か買ってくれるの？: Why, is my sweet boyfriend offering to buy me something？
translations.冗談。リンコはむやみにおねだりするつもりはないから。欲しいものは自分で買うよ。: Just kidding. I'm not gonna go begging you to buy me stuff for no reason. If I want something, I'll buy it myself.
translations.それはそれで寂しいかもな。たまにはプレゼントとかしたいし。: That's kind of lonely in its own way, though. I'd like to get you a present every now and then.
translations.それも素直に嬉しいけどさ。でも、プレゼントって、何か特別な想いがこもってるものじ: I mean, I'm happy to hear that. Still, a present is supposed to have special feelings behind it, right？
translations.だから、むやみやたらにおねだりするのは、なんか違うと思うんだよね、リンコは。: So asking you to buy me things just because feels kind of wrong to me.
translations.難しくないっつーの。想いのこもってない、ただ物質だけのプレゼントは欲しくないって: It's not that complicated. I just don't want a present that's only a material thing without any real feelings behind it.
translations.それにさ、同じ高校生だもん。アンタの財布の中身がどうとか、想像はつくよ。: Besides, we're both high schoolers. I have a pretty good idea what the inside of your wallet looks like.
translations.……それもそうか。じゃ、今日は夜までこうしてウィンドウショッピングを楽しむか。: ...Fair point. Alright then, let's just enjoy window-shopping like this until tonight.
translations.夜までか……。えっと、何があるんだっけ。: Until tonight, huh... Wait, what's happening tonight again？
translations.忘れたのか？ じゃあ、ナイショ。: Did you forget？ Then it's a secret.
translations.ええ、カノジョに隠し事するんだ？: Wait, you're keeping secrets from your girlfriend？
translations.サプライズがあった方がいいだろ。あともう少しなんだから、おとなしく待ってろって。: It's better with a little surprise, right？ Just sit tight and wait a bit longer.
translations.ねえ。まだ？ もうすっかり暗くなったんだけど。: Hey, is it time yet？ It's already completely dark out.
translations.すごい……これってイルミネーション!? イルミネーションって、冬のものだと思って: Wow... Is this a light display！？ I always thought those were just for winter.
translations.夜になると、このスターイルミネーションが灯るんだってさ。: Apparently they turn on this "Star Illumination" every night after dark.
translations.スターイルミネーションか……本当に星の中に立ってるみたい。: Star Illumination, huh... It really feels like we're standing right in the middle of the stars.
translations.な。サプライズがあった方が楽しめただろ？: See？ It's more fun as a surprise, isn't it？
translations.せっかくだから少し見て回るか。手、つなぐ？: Let's walk around and take a look while we're here. Wanna hold hands？
translations.それより今日はさ、こうしたい気分。: Actually, today I'm more in the mood to do this.
translations.もしかして緊張してる？ こうして耳を寄せると……へへ、アンタのドキドキが聞こえて: Are you nervous？ When I press my ear close like this... hehe, I can almost hear your heart pounding.
translations.だって▲小早川＊▲が急にそんな……。: Well, ▲小早川＊▲, when you suddenly do something like that...
translations.言ったよね、想いのこもっていないプレゼントは欲しくないって。: I told you earlier, right？ That I didn't want a present without real feelings behind it.
translations.モノじゃなくてもさ、カノジョを喜ばせたいっていうアンタの想い。それがリンコにとっ: Even if it's not an object, just knowing you want to make your girlfriend happy is the best gift I could ask for. So... I'm really happy.
translations.へへ。こんなに近づいちゃった。: Hehe. I've gotten pretty close to you.
translations.それじゃ歩けないよ。それに……周りに人が。: I can't walk like this. Besides... there are people around.
translations.聞こえない。今のリンコは幸せすぎて、アンタ以外の何も目に入らないよ……。: I can't hear you. I'm so happy right now, I don't have eyes for anyone but you...
translations.“世界のカップル展”って言うけどさ、どんな内容なの？: It's called 'Couples of the World,' but what's the exhibit actually about？
translations.パンフレットによれば、世界中のカップルの愛の一瞬を捉えた写真展だって。: According to the pamphlet, it's a photo exhibit capturing moments of love between couples around the world.
translations.ふうん。やっぱりさ、見に来てるのもカップルばっかりだね。: Huh. Figures everyone here to see it is a couple, too.
translations.そうだな……●たちもだろ？: Yeah... You and ● are a couple too, right？
translations.そうだけどさ……。あ、いろんなカップルのキスシーンだって。: Well, yeah, but... Oh, it says these are kissing scenes of different couples.
translations.ちっちゃい子からお年寄りまで……なんかみんな幸せそうだな。: From little kids to old folks... Everyone looks so happy.
translations.やらしいとか恥ずかしいとか、そんなことぜんぜんなくて、素直にいいなって思えるね。: There's nothing sleazy or embarrassing about it at all. It's just really nice. Maybe we could do that too...
translations.あっ、ううん、なんでもない。たださ……。こういう幸せそうな写真見てると、リンコも: Oh, no, it's nothing. It's just... looking at happy photos like these makes me kind of...
translations.言わせんなっつーの。: Don't make me spell it out.
translations.イテッ……●からは何にも言ってないんだけどな。: Ow... ● wasn't the one who brought it up, though.
translations.最初は写真展って、もっとつまんないと思ってた。けど、すっごく楽しかった。: At first I thought a photo exhibit would be way more boring. But I had a lot of fun.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が喜んでくれて良かったよ。: I'm glad you liked it, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.技術とか、そーいうのわかんないけど、被写体の気持ちが伝わってくるっていうかさ。こ: I don't know much about technique or anything like that, but you could really feel what the subjects were feeling. It made me feel all warm and fuzzy inside, too.
translations.それは●もなんとなく感じたな。▲小早川＊▲のお気に入りはどの写真だった？: ● kind of felt that too. Which photo was your favorite, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.公園のベンチでさ。おじいちゃんのほっぺにおばあちゃんが、チュッてしてた写真あった: Remember that photo on the park bench？ Where the old lady was giving the old man a peck on the cheek？
translations.ああ、あれか。そんなに大きくなかったけど、良い雰囲気の写真だったな。: Oh, that one. It wasn't very big, but it had a really nice vibe to it.
translations.そのパネルの前でさ、年配のカップルがいたの覚えてる？ ２人でさ、しっかり手をつな: Remember the older couple standing in front of that panel？ The two of them were holding hands tightly, just gazing at the photo.
translations.その表情がすっごく幸せそうでさ、リンコまであったかい気持ちになったよ。あのカップ: They looked so happy, it made me feel warm inside too. It felt like that couple was part of the art itself.
translations.“世界のカップル展”って単なる写真じゃなくて、あの場そのものが展示なのかもな。あ: Maybe 'Couples of the World' isn't just the photos, but the whole space itself. Just being there makes everyone feel happy.
translations.きっとあのカップルは、いつもああして手をつないで歩いてるんだね。ちょっと憧れるか: I bet that couple always walks around holding hands like that. I kind of admire it. Growing old like that is really nice.
translations.理想の歳の取り方、か。いくつになっても自然と手をつなげるっていいよな。: An ideal way to grow old, huh. Being able to hold hands naturally no matter how old you get really is nice.
translations.……なんだかリンコも手、つなぎたくなっちゃったな。: ...Now I kind of want to hold hands, too.
translations.……うん。やっぱりアンタと手、つないでると安心する。: ...Yeah. Holding your hand really puts me at ease.
translations.ずっとこうして手をつないで……あのカップルみたいになれたらいいな。: I hope we can keep holding hands like this forever... and end up like that couple.
translations.ずっと、か……そうだね。でさ、歳を取ったときに、若いカップルにうらやましいって思: Forever, huh... Yeah. And when we get old, it'd be nice if young couples looked at the two of us with envy.
translations.そこまでいくのは、まだだいぶ先のことだろうけど。: Though we've still got a long way to go before we get that far.
translations.そんな未来のことはわかんないか。でも、今リンコはすごく幸せだし、ずっとこの幸せが: I guess there's no telling that far into the future. But I'm really happy right now, and I hope this happiness lasts forever.
translations.ライブまで、まだちょっと早かったね。: We're still a little early for the show, huh.
translations.向こうにスタンディングカフェがあるから、あそこで待ってるか。: There's a standing cafe over there. Want to wait there？
translations.そうだね。リンコは何飲もっかな……。: Yeah, sure. Wonder what I should get to drink...
translations.これ以上笑うと本気で怒るよ？: If you laugh any more, I'm seriously gonna get mad, okay？
translations.ごめん、ごめん。たしかにあの店員は失礼だよな。: Sorry, sorry. That guy at the door really was rude, though.
translations.何が“今夜のライブは、中学生は入場不可です“だっつーの。: "No middle schoolers allowed at tonight's show"—give me a break.
translations.もう許してやれって。▲小早川＊▲の剣幕に泣きそうな顔で謝ってただろ。: Let it go already. The way you tore into him, ▲小早川＊▲, he looked ready to cry when he apologized.
translations.しょうがない。今日はせっかくのデートなんだし、許してあげよう。: Fine, whatever. We're finally on a date today, so I'll let him off the hook.
translations.そうそう。音楽を聴く前にそんなカリカリしてたら、楽しめないだろ？: That's the spirit. You won't be able to enjoy the music if you're all worked up before it even starts, right？
translations.そういえば今日のライブってどんなのだっけ？: By the way, what kind of show is it tonight, again？
translations.『ラブソングナイト』だってさ。いくつかのバンドやボーカリストが競演するみたい。: It's called "Love Song Night." Sounds like a bunch of bands and vocalists are performing together.
translations.リンコが相手じゃなければ、デートとしてはアリなのかもしれないけどね。: If you were with anyone else, it might've been a good choice for a date.
translations.あれ？ もしかして気に入らなかった？: Huh？ Wait, are you not into the idea？
translations.ラブソングって陳腐な歌詞が多いじゃん。愛してるとか、いつまでも一緒にとか。: Love songs usually have such cheesy lyrics, you know？ All that "I love you" and "together forever" stuff.
translations.そんなありきたりのラブソングなら、リンコは感動なんかしないよ？ デートはデートだ: Run-of-the-mill love songs like that aren't gonna move me, okay？ A date's a date, sure, but I'm picky about my music.
translations.（大丈夫かな……▲小早川＊▲、不機嫌になったりしないだろうな）: (I hope this goes okay... ▲小早川＊▲ isn't gonna get in a bad mood, is she？)
translations.さっきのガールズバンド……よかったね。: That all-girl band just now... They were good.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が気に入るなんて、よっぽどだな。: For you to like them, ▲小早川＊▲, they must've really been something.
translations.音はリンコの好みとは違うんだけどさ、歌詞にじーんと来ちゃった。: Their sound isn't really my thing, but the lyrics really got to me.
translations.……女の子にしか書けない詞だよね、なんか共感しちゃった。恥ずかしいけど。: ...Those are lyrics only a girl could write. I kinda related to them. Embarrassing as it is to admit.
translations.なんで？ いいと思ったんなら、それでいいんじゃないか？: Why？ If you thought it was good, isn't that all that matters？
translations.そうなんだけど、詞に感動するなんて……ほら、リンコのキャラじゃないっつーか。: Yeah, I know, but getting moved by lyrics... Come on, it's just out of character for me.
translations.それに、テクニックも正直シロウトだったのに。なんでこんなに耳に残るんだろ。: Plus, honestly, their technique was pretty amateur. So why is it stuck in my head like this？
translations.良い音楽はテクニックだけじゃないってことか？ よくわかんないけど。: Maybe it means good music isn't just about technique？ Not that I really know.
translations.まあ、それはあるよ。パンクだってテクニックの音楽じゃないしさ。まっすぐな想いを伝: Well, that's true. Punk isn't about technical skill either. You don't need technique to get honest feelings across.
translations.……ちょっとね。ラブソングナイト……いいね。このあとの曲も楽しみだよ。: ...Nothing, really. Love Song Night... isn't bad. I'm looking forward to the rest of the songs now.
translations.うーん……今日は誘ってくれてありがと。意外な収穫。: Mmm... Thanks for inviting me out today. That was an unexpected find.
translations.ＣＤ買うぐらい気に入ったんだな。: You liked them enough to buy their CD, huh.
translations.まあね、たまにはこういうのもいいかも。これで……さっきの曲の歌詞みたいにさ。: Yeah, well, stuff like this isn't bad once in a while. Maybe now... just like in the lyrics to that song earlier...
translations.リンコも、もっとまっすぐな想い、アンタにぶつけられるようになるかもね。: I'll be able to hit you with my own honest feelings, too.
translations.カラオケに行く前にさ、コンビニに寄ってこうよ。: Before we head to karaoke, let's stop by the convenience store.
translations.ああ、持ち込みできたんだっけ。: Oh right, they let you bring your own food and drinks in, huh.
translations.今日は思いっきり歌うからね。覚悟しといて。: I'm gonna sing my heart out today. Just so you're prepared.
translations.はは……どれくらいつきあわされるんだろ。: Haha... I wonder how long you're gonna keep me there.
translations.それくらいの心構えでいてねってこと。ね。アンタは何も買わないでいいの？: I just mean you should be ready for that. Hey, are you sure you don't need to buy anything？
translations.……それより、▲小早川＊▲。そのカゴいっぱいのポテチ、どうすんの？: ...Never mind that, ▲小早川＊▲. What are you doing with a whole basket full of potato chips？
translations.どうするって、買って食べるに決まってるじゃん。: What do you think？ I'm buying them to eat, obviously.
translations.そりゃそうだろうけど、同じのをいくつも買わなくてもさ。: Well, yeah, obviously, but you don't need to buy a bunch of the exact same kind.
translations.わかってないな。これがうず塩味、こっちがコンソメ、それでこれが……。: You really don't get it. This one's lightly salted, this one's consomme, and this one is...
translations.わかった、わかった。全部味が違うって言いたいんだろ。: Okay, okay, I get it. You're trying to say they're all different flavors, right？
translations.じゃ、食料も買い込んだことだし、行こっか。:
All right, now that we're
stocked up on food,
let's get going.
translations.えっと……洋楽縛りだと●、もう歌える曲ないんだけど。:
Um... If it's Western music
only, ● don't have any
songs left to sing.
translations.えーっ、もう終わりなの？ リンコのカレシなら、もっと持ち歌増やしとかないと。:
What, you're done already？
If you're my boyfriend, you
need more go-to songs.
translations.無茶言うなよ。Ｊポップなら……。:
Cut me some slack. If I
could do J-pop...
translations.ほら、まだまだいくよ！:
Come on, we're just getting
started!
translations.ふう……。あれ、▲小早川＊▲、まだ次の曲入れてないのか？:
Phew... Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲,
you haven't put in the
next song yet？
translations.はは、何が朝までだよ。:
Haha, so much for going
until morning.
translations.なんだ、寝言か……。:
Oh, she's just talking in
her sleep...
translations.よし、来たよ。格ゲー大会！:
All right, we're here.
The fighting game tournament!
translations.まあ、▲小早川＊▲くらい上手けりゃ、優勝できるんじゃないか？:
Well, as good as you are,
▲小早川＊▲, couldn't you
win the whole thing？
translations.わかってないな……アンタの前でやってるのなんてただの遊び。ガチ勢同士の対戦なんて:
You don't get it... What I do
around you is just casual
play. You've never seen real
tryhards go at it.
translations.前の大会ではここのチャンピオンにイヤっていうほど、わからされたからね。:
At the last tournament, the
champ here bodied me so hard
it wasn't even funny.
translations.でも今回は違うよ。この日のためにちゃんと仕上げてきたんだからさ。:
But this time's different.
I've been labbing nonstop
just for today.
translations.今のリンコになら……ワンチャンあるよ！:
The way I'm playing now...
I could totally clutch this!
translations.（何を言ってるのかよくわからない……専門用語？）:
(I barely understood any of
that... Is that gamer lingo？)
translations.（すごい、▲小早川＊▲、なんだかんだ決勝までいっちゃったじゃん……）:
(Whoa, ▲小早川＊▲ actually
made it all the way to
the finals...)
translations.それでは決勝戦！ モモセ ＶＳ リンコ！:
Now for the finals!
Momose VS Rinko!
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、いつもと違ってギャーギャー騒がないんだな。すげー集中力）:
(▲小早川＊▲ isn't making a
ruckus like usual. She's
super focused.)
translations.あーっと！ ここでモモセ、コマ投げからの～？:
Ohhh! Momose lands a
command grab, and into a—？
translations.（うわ、相手にキレたりすんなよ……）:
(Whoa, please don't blow up
at your opponent...)
translations.準優勝おめでと、やっぱすごいんだな。:
Congrats on second place.
You really are amazing.
translations.ワンチャンあると思ったのに……。:
I really thought I could
clutch it...
translations.●は▲小早川＊▲がキレなくてほっとしたよ。いつかみたいにさ。:
● was just relieved
you didn't lose your cool,
▲小早川＊▲. Like that one time.
translations.古い話すんなっつーの。それに、あれは向こうがキレたの。:
Don't bring up ancient
history. Besides, the other
guy started that.
translations.別に……今もムカムカしてるけどさ、大会中にリアルファイトとか、ダサすぎじゃん。も:
Not really... I'm still ticked
off, but starting a real fight
at a tourney is way too lame.
I almost smashed the cabinet,
though... Not that I would.
translations.？ まあ、とにかくお疲れ。楽しかったか？: ？ Well, anyway, good match. Did you have fun？
translations.負けたのに、楽しいわけないじゃん。: I lost, so of course it wasn't fun.
translations.ごめん、今日デートなのに……勝手にリンコだけ熱中しちゃって、不機嫌になって……。: Sorry, we're supposed to be on a date today... I got carried away all by myself, and now I'm in a bad mood...
translations.なんだ。いいって。見てて楽しかったし、▲小早川＊▲の新しい一面も見られたしさ。: Is that what this is about？ Don't worry about it. It was fun watching, and I got to see a new side of you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.じゃあ、気を取り直して、なんか別のゲームやるか？: All right, want to shake it off and play something else？
translations.ううん、同じのがいい。: No, I want to play the same one.
translations.うん、さっき負けた悔しさ、アンタをボコって晴らすことにする。: Yeah. I'm gonna work off my frustration from losing earlier by thrashing you.
translations.いいから。ほら、行くよ！: Don't argue. Come on, let's go!
translations.（……まあ、楽しそうだしいいか）: (...Well, she looks like she's having fun, so I guess it's fine.)
translations.そうだね。できれば前に行きたいんだけど……。: Yeah. I'd like to get up front if we can, though...
translations.うーん、この人の多さだと辛いだろ。: Hmm, with a crowd this big, that might be tough.
translations.だいたいさ、主催者もおかしいよね。こんなとこでインストアライブなんて、入りきるわ: Seriously, what were the organizers thinking？ Holding an in-store gig at a place like this... There's no way everyone's gonna fit.
translations.このバンド、●はあんまり知らないんだけど……すごいの？: ● don't really know much about this band, though... Are they a big deal？
translations.はあ、インディーズ最後の大物も、素人から見ればそんなもんか。: Sigh... So even the last big indie band means nothing to an amateur, huh.
translations.素人って……まあ、すごいバンドってことだな。: An amateur...？ Well, I take it they're amazing, then.
translations.そう。それがついにメジャーデビューするわけ。そりゃテンションもあがるよ。: Yeah. And they're finally making their major label debut. Of course I'm hyped.
translations.日本のバンドで▲小早川＊▲がそれだけ入れ込むってだけで、なんかすごさがわかるよ。: Just seeing you get this into a Japanese band tells me how good they must be, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ライブさ、やっぱ最高だったでしょ。: That show was amazing, wasn't it？
translations.ああ、すごかった。▲小早川＊▲のお墨付きは伊達じゃないな！: Yeah, it was incredible. If ▲小早川＊▲ vouches for them, they're the real deal!
translations.ライブ終わったってのに、まだ騒ぎがおさまんないな…………うわっ。: The show's over, but the crowd still hasn't calmed down...... Whoa!
translations.なんとかね。●は大丈夫だけど、▲小早川＊▲こそ……。: Yeah, somehow. ● can manage, but what about you, ▲小早川＊▲...？
translations.リンコは大丈夫、人の間をすり抜けて……きゃっ!?: I'm fine, I'll just slip through the crowd... Ah!?
translations.だいじょーぶ……だけど……あっもうっ、変なとこ触んなっつーの。: I'm okaaay... mostly... Ugh, come on, watch where you're touching!
translations.▲小早川＊▲!! おいっ！ 本当に大丈夫かっ!?: ▲小早川＊▲!! Hey! Are you really okay!?
translations.▲小早川＊▲、返事しろっ！ どこにいるんだっ!?: ▲小早川＊▲, answer me! Where are you!?
translations.リンコを探してたときのアンタの顔。必死だったよ。鏡があったら見せてあげたかったく: You should've seen your face while you were looking for me. You looked so desperate. I wish I had a mirror to show you.
translations.カノジョが突然消えたんだから、必死になるのは当たり前だろ。なのに……。: My girlfriend suddenly disappeared in a crowd, so of course I was desperate. And here you are...
translations.……ごめん。調子に乗りすぎたかも。: ...Sorry. Maybe I got a little carried away.
translations.……そんな怒ってるわけじゃないんだけどさ。: ...It's not like I'm that mad or anything.
translations.……本当は嬉しかったんだよ。リンコのこと、本気で心配してくれてるんだって思って。: ...Honestly, I was happy. Knowing you were genuinely worried about me.
translations.リンコはいつだって感謝してるよ。なのに、なんか、上手く言えないことがあって。特に: I'm always grateful to you. It's just, sometimes I have trouble putting it into words. Especially... when it's you.
translations.もういいよ。▲小早川＊▲が言葉にしなくても、●はわかってるつもりだから。: It's fine. Even if you don't put it into words, ▲小早川＊▲, ● already know.
translations.……うん……リンコは幸せなんだよね、きっと。いつも見守ってくれてる、アンタみたい: ...Yeah... I guess I'm really lucky. Having a boyfriend like you who's always looking out for me.
translations.さすが歩行者天国だな……。: The pedestrian zone really draws a crowd...
