translations.ほんと、すごい人。: Yeah, there are so many people.
translations.リンコは平気だけど。歩行者天国の日にしか楽しめないものもあるじゃん。ほら、あれ。: I don't mind it. Besides, there are things you can only enjoy on pedestrian-only days. Look over there.
translations.歩行者天国の日はああやって、パフォーマンスしてる人が多いんだってさ。: I heard a lot of people come out to perform like that when the street's closed to traffic.
translations.……今、ミニスカートのメイドさんを見てたでしょ。: ...You were just staring at that maid in the miniskirt, weren't you.
translations.違うって！ ●は純粋にダンスに……。: No way! ● was just watching the dancing...
translations.まあ、そういうことにしておきますか……あれ、なに？ ダンボール？ 変なのが飛び回: Well, let's just go with that... Wait, what's that？ A cardboard box？ Something weird is jumping around.
translations.たしかに変だな。あれもコスプレ……か？: That really is weird. Is that supposed to be cosplay too...？
translations.どう見ても、頭からダンボールかぶっただけにしか見えないけど……。よくあんなの着て: It just looks like someone with a cardboard box over their head to me... I don't know how they can dance wearing that.
translations.ある意味、注目を集めるよな。: Well, it definitely gets people's attention.
translations.あっ、跳んだ！ 今の見た!? ダンボール着たままバク転したよ……。: Oh, they jumped! Did you see that!？ They just did a backflip in a cardboard box...
translations.（ほんとに楽しんでる……“来ない方が～”なんて言うんじゃなかったな）: (She's really enjoying herself... I shouldn't have said that about not coming today.)
translations.陽が落ちたとたん、静かになったね。: It got quiet as soon as the sun went down.
translations.これくらいの方が、店を見て回るにはいいかも。人もだいぶ少なくなったしさ。: This might actually be better for looking around the shops. The crowd's thinned out a lot, too.
translations.ね。あの人たちなにしてるのかな？ さっきコスプレでダンスしてた人だよね。: Hey, what are those people doing？ Those are the cosplay dancers from earlier, right？
translations.なんだろ……ゴミ拾いか？ さっきのパフォーマンスで出たゴミ以外も拾ってるみたいだ: Let's see... Picking up trash？ Looks like they're picking up more than just the litter from their performance, too.
translations.へえ……ちゃんと後始末までするんだ。: Huh... So they actually clean up after themselves.
translations.手伝ってみる？: Want to give them a hand？
translations.……実はさ、リンコも同じこと言おうと思ってた。しよっか？: ...Actually, I was just about to say the same thing. Shall we？
translations.うーん、なんか良いことしたあとって、気分いいよね。: Mmm, doing a good deed really leaves you feeling good, doesn't it.
translations.あのコスプレの人たちとも話せたしな。: Plus we got to talk with those cosplayers.
translations.面白い人たちだったね。リンコまでコスプレに誘われちゃったけど。: They were a fun bunch. Even if they did try to talk me into cosplaying.
translations.やってみればいいのに。: You should give it a try.
translations.無理無理。リンコは人前であんなに踊れないよ。: No way. I could never dance like that in front of people.
translations.残念だな、見たかったのに……。: Too bad, I would've liked to see that...
translations.なんでそんな本気で残念がるかな……人前では絶対にやらないからっ！: Why do you sound so genuinely disappointed... I'm never doing that in public!
translations.人前じゃなきゃやってくれるのか？: So you'll do it if it's not in public？
translations.それは……まあ、アンタしか見てないときなら……ううん、やっぱダメっ！: Well... I mean, if you're the only one watching... No, forget it, no way!
translations.（まんざらでもなさそうなんだけどな……）: (She doesn't seem totally against the idea, though...)
translations.ねえねえ。どれに乗る？: Hey, hey. Which one should we ride？
translations.おい！ いきなりそんなハードなのいく？: Hey! We're starting with something that intense right off the bat？
translations.せっかく遊園地に来たんだもん、いきなりメインにいっとくべきじゃない？: We're at an amusement park, so shouldn't we go straight for the main attraction？
translations.▲小早川＊▲ってさ、弁当のおかずで好きなものは最初に食べるタイプ？: Say, ▲小早川＊▲, are you the type who eats your favorite thing in your lunchbox first？
translations.だね。人生は短いんだよ。回り道なんかしてらんないってこと。: Yep. Life is short. There's no time for taking detours.
translations.（まさか遊園地のアトラクションで、人生を語られるとは思わなかったな……）: (I never thought I'd get a lecture on life over amusement park rides...)
translations.ね。楽しかったでしょ？ もう１回いっとく？: See？ That was fun, right？ Wanna go one more time？
translations.……ちょっと休ませて欲しい。さすがに３周はキツイぞ。: ...Let me take a break. Three times in a row is rough.
translations.えーっ、時間がもったいない。: Come on, that's a waste of time.
translations.やっぱ女の子の方が絶叫系って強いのかもな。他にも絶叫しながら、笑顔って子が結構い: Maybe girls just handle thrill rides better. I saw plenty of other girls screaming their heads off with huge smiles on their faces.
translations.そうかな？ リンコ、絶叫系そんなに得意じゃないよ？: You think？ I'm not all that good with thrill rides, though.
translations.（３周も乗っといて……）: (Says the girl who just rode it three times...)
translations.わっ、夜の遊園地って雰囲気あるね……。: Whoa, the amusement park at night really has a nice atmosphere...
translations.ちょっと怖い気もするな。: Feels a little creepy to me.
translations.そう？ なんか、おとぎの国って感じじゃん。: Really？ It feels kind of like a fairy-tale land.
translations.ナイトパレードならわかるけど……うーん。: I'd get it if there were a night parade, maybe, but... hm.
translations.わかんないかな。想像力の欠如だね、なげかわしい。: You don't get it？ What a lack of imagination. Pitiful.
translations.おとぎの国なんだからさ。アンタは王子様。じゃあ、リンコは？: Since this is a fairy-tale land, you're the prince. So what does that make me？
translations.そういうこと。お姫様って、女の子なら一度は憧れるよね。: Exactly. Every girl dreams of being a princess at least once.
translations.リンコだって女の子だからね。小さい頃は人形のドレスを着せ替えたりして、お姫様ごっ: I'm a girl too, you know. When I was little, I used to dress up dolls and play princess.
translations.へえ……。人形じゃなくて、本物のドレスも似合うかもよ？: Huh... Forget the dolls, a real dress might look great on you too.
translations.無理無理。今は……こんなだもん。リンコのキャラじゃないよ。: No way. Look at how I am now. That's totally not my style.
translations.……ちょっと気分いいかも。リンコの王子様。踊っていただけますか？: ...This actually feels kind of nice. My prince, would you care to dance with me？
translations.ほら、ぼーっとしてない。せっかくプールに来たんだから、泳がないと。: Hey, quit spacing out. We came all the way to the pool, so we ought to swim.
translations.さっきからリンコのこと、ちらちら見てる。油断すると、これだ。: You've been sneaking glances at me this whole time. The second I let my guard down, this happens.
translations.ちらちらじゃなきゃいいとか……？: So it's okay as long as I'm not sneaking them...？
translations.はいはい。それにしても、さすがカップルデー。どの女の子もかわいい水着を着てきてる: Yeah, yeah. Still, you can really tell it's Couples' Day. Every girl here is wearing a cute swimsuit.
translations.ふうん……そっか。他の子の水着もチェックしてるんだ？: Hmm... I see. So you're checking out other girls' swimsuits too？
translations.それは……ほら、どうしても目に入るっていうかさ……。: Well... come on, they just kind of catch my eye...
translations.他の子の水着見るくらいなら、リンコの見てよ……。: If you're going to look at other girls' swimsuits, look at mine instead...
translations.絶対見せたくないなら、プールになんか来ないよ。水着も……カレシに気に入って欲しい: If I didn't want you to see me at all, I wouldn't have come to the pool. And my swimsuit... I want my boyfriend to like it.
translations.あ……うん、かわいい。かわいいよ。: Oh... yeah, it's cute. Really cute.
translations.なんか、まだカップルがウロウロしてる。: Looks like there are still couples hanging around.
translations.ウロウロって……●たちもだろ？: "Hanging around"... Aren't you and ● doing that too？
translations.そうだけど……リンコたちはあんな風に外でベタベタしてないじゃん。: Well, yeah, but... it's not like we're all over each other in public like they are.
translations.あのさ……ちょっと、ここにいていいかな？: Hey... Can we stay here a little longer？
translations.今日は室内プールだったけどさ、夏になったら海に行こ？ 海の方が、まだ……その。: We came to an indoor pool today, but when summer gets here, let's go to the beach. At the beach, it's a little more... um.
translations.その……プールだと……２人きりになれないじゃん。: Well... at a pool... we can't really be alone together.
translations.そうだな、今日なんか特に混んでたもんな。: True, it was especially crowded today.
translations.海に行くときはさ、アンタが気に入ってくれる水着。新しいのを選んでみたりするのも、: When we go to the beach, maybe I'll pick out a new swimsuit that you'll like.
translations.へへ……。はあ、なんか疲れちゃった。: Hehe... Phew, I'm kind of tired now.
translations.……遊び疲れたか。じゃあ、そろそろ帰るか。: ...All worn out from having fun, huh？ Well, let's head home soon.
translations.ね。３６０度スクリーンってことは、この天井が全部スクリーンになるわけ？: Hey. Does a 360-degree screen mean this whole ceiling turns into a screen？
translations.星空ってロマンチックだって言うけど、ほら周り。: People say a starry sky is romantic, and... well, look around us.
translations.はあ……ね。すごく良かったよね。解説もわかりやすかったし、ちょっと興味出て来たか: Wow... Hey, that was really good, wasn't it？ The commentary was easy to follow, too. I think I might actually be getting into this.
translations.あのさ、始まる前に何か言いかけなかった？: Hey, weren't you about to say something right before it started？
translations.あー、あれは……もういいや。: Oh, that... Never mind, forget it.
translations.気になるじゃん。何？: Now I'm curious. What was it？
translations.ほら、早く出ないと怒られるよ。: Come on, they're gonna yell at us if we don't head out soon.
translations.うっ、寒……。\n夜になると特に冷えるな。:
Brr, it's cold...
It really gets chilly at night.
translations.外もすごい星空……。\n冬は空気が澄んでるから、\n星もよく見えるね。:
The stars outside are amazing,
too... The winter air is so clear,
you can see them really well.
translations.そうだな。\nプラネタリウムの\n星空以上かも……。:
Yeah.
It might be even better than
the planetarium...
translations.そりゃ本物の星空の迫力には\nかなわないよ。\n今にも降ってきそうじゃない？:
Well, nothing beats the real
thing. Doesn't it feel like they
could rain down any second？
translations.……まだ覚えてたんだ、\nジジイのくせに。:
...You still remembered that,
for an old man.
translations.隠されると余計気になるだろ。: When you hide it, it just makes me more curious.
translations.……ほら、プラネタリウムの\n中さ、カップルばっか\nだったじゃん。だから……\:
...Look, inside the planetarium,
it was nothing but couples,
right？ So I thought... maybe we
could act like a couple, too.
translations.それなら、中にいる間に\n言えばよかったのに。:
Then you should've just said so
while we were inside.
translations.簡単に言うなっつーの。\nもういいよ。\n今さら言っても仕方ないし。:
Like it's that easy to say.
Whatever, forget it.
No point bringing it up now.
translations.カノジョにギュッてされて、\nうれしくないの？:
Aren't you happy getting
hugged by your girlfriend？
translations.だよね。\nリンコもうれしいもん。:
Thought so.
I'm happy too, you know.
translations.……にしても、\nちょっと人目が気になるな。:
...Still, I'm a bit worried
about people watching us.
translations.大丈夫だよ。リンコたちのこと\n見てるのは……。:
Don't worry. The only ones
watching us right now...
translations.空の星だけ……ってやつ。\nこれ、キザな男の方が言うべき\n台詞なんじゃないの？:
...are the stars above, right？
Isn't a corny line like that
meant to come from the guy？
translations.蛍鑑賞会か……。リンコは見たことないんだよね。: Firefly viewing, huh... I've never actually seen them before.
translations.そうなんだ。この辺にももういないんだな。: I see. I guess there aren't any around here anymore.
translations.たぶん山の方にまでいかないと無理だよ。とわの市の中心部はもう、自然の川はほとんど: You probably have to go all the way into the mountains. There are barely any natural rivers left in central Towano.
translations.そっか、じゃあ今日は楽しみだな。: Gotcha. Well, I'm looking forward to today, then.
translations.うん。目の前で光る蛍楽しみ。: Yeah. I can't wait to see fireflies glowing right in front of us.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って虫は大丈夫なんだっけ？: Are you okay with bugs, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.前に言わなかったっけ、平気。それより、虫っていうのやめてよ。: Didn't I tell you before？ I'm fine with them. Besides, stop calling them bugs.
translations.？ 虫は虫だろ？: ？ A bug's a bug, isn't it？
translations.それはそうだけど……同じだけど違うの！: Well, yeah, technically... They're the same, but different!
translations.だってさ、光るんだよ？ それってすごいじゃん！: I mean, they glow, you know？ That's amazing!
translations.（よくわかんないけど……まあいいか）: (I still don't really get it... but whatever.)
translations.蛍ってさ、求愛のためにこうやって輝くんだよね。……へへ。: Fireflies glow like this to court a mate, right？ ...Hehe.
translations.意味深な笑い方するなあ。: What's that laugh supposed to mean？
translations.人間も同じだったら、アンタが光るってことだよね。ちょっと面白いよね。: If humans worked the same way, you'd be the one glowing right now. It's kind of funny to picture.
translations.蛍ならいいけど、●が光ってもキレイには見えないだろうな。: It's fine for fireflies, ●, but even if you glowed, I doubt it'd look very pretty.
translations.あ、ほらっ、２匹飛び立った。きっとあれ、今オスの方が告白してるんだよ。: Oh, look, two of them just took off. I bet the male is confessing his feelings right now.
translations.結ばれるといいな。: I hope they end up together.
translations.蛍の寿命って短いんだよね。やっと結ばれたのに……かわいそう。: Fireflies have such short lifespans, don't they？ They finally found each other, and yet... It's sad.
translations.短い寿命だからこそ、最後の一瞬までこうして輝き続けるんだろうな。: Maybe because their lives are so short, they keep shining like this right up to the very last moment.
translations.リンコは蛍じゃなくて良かったよ。もし蛍だったら、やっと結ばれたアンタとすぐにお別: I'm glad I'm not a firefly. If I were, I'd have to say goodbye to you right after we finally got together.
translations.▲小早川＊▲……お別れのことなんか考えなくていいよ。: ▲小早川＊▲... You don't need to think about saying goodbye.
translations.……はあっ。なんだろ、蛍の光見てると、センチメンタルになるのかな。: ...Sigh. What is it about watching fireflies that makes me all sentimental？
translations.アンタたちも幸せになってね。そのまま絶対にはぐれたりしたらダメだから。: You two be happy, okay？ Make sure you never get separated.
translations.ね。さっきの女の人さ、元オリンピックのメダリストだって。: Hey. Apparently that woman earlier is a former Olympic medalist.
translations.それでジャンプもあんなにきれいに決まってたんだ。: No wonder she landed her jumps so cleanly.
translations.ジャンプもきれいだけど、表現力っていうの？ ちょっとした動きにも違いが出るね。: Her jumps were great, too, but what do they call it, expressiveness？ You can see the difference even in the smallest movements.
translations.選手時代はさ、表現力が課題だ、みたいに言われてたんだって。なのにプロのショーに出: Apparently back when she competed, people said expressiveness was her weak point. But once she started doing pro shows, she was like a whole different skater.
translations.へえ。▲小早川＊▲ってアイススケートに詳しいんだな。意外な発見。: Huh. You know a lot about ice skating, ▲小早川＊▲. Didn't expect that.
translations.へへ。任せて。……と言いたいところだけど、実はお父さん情報。前にスケートの番組の: Hehe, leave it to me. ...Is what I'd like to say, but I actually got it from my dad. From back when he worked on a skating show.
translations.なんだ。でも、そういう情報が入ってると、見方も変わってくるよな。: Oh, I see. Still, knowing stuff like that changes how you watch it, huh.
translations.そうだね。リンコなんかスケートのこと、ぜんぜん知らなかったのにもうファンになりつ: Yeah. I didn't know a thing about skating before, and I'm already starting to become a fan.
translations.リンコも小さい頃から、スケートやってたらあんな風になれてたかな？: Do you think I could've been like that if I'd skated since I was little？
translations.そしたら今頃、あのリンクの上にいるのは▲小早川＊▲だった可能性もあるのか。“氷上: Then that could've been you out on the rink right now, ▲小早川＊▲. Rinko Kobayakawa, the 'Fairy on Ice'... huh.
translations.そういう言い方されると、ちょっと……。けど、あんなに自由に滑れたら楽しいだろうな: When you put it like that, it's a little... Still, I bet it'd be fun to skate as freely as that.
translations.んー、さすがにあんな風にはいかないね。: Hmm, yeah, no way I can skate like that.
translations.充分だろ、上手いじゃん。: You're doing plenty fine. You're good at this.
translations.へへ。まあウィンタースポーツはね。でもさっき見たイメージだと……。: Hehe. Well, I am good at winter sports. Though going off what we just watched...
translations.なんか、真剣な顔してるから。: You just have this really serious look on your face.
translations.これは怒ってんじゃなくて、心配してんの。: I'm not mad, I'm worried about you.
translations.またジジイ得意の心配顔か。: Back at it with your classic worried old man face, huh.
translations.あ……ごめん。リンコ、また……。: Ah... sorry. There I go again...
translations.どういたしまして。いいよ、怪我はなかったんだし。: You're welcome. It's fine, as long as you didn't get hurt.
translations.うん、もっかい滑るの付き合ってくれる？: Yeah. Will you skate with me one more time？
translations.あのさ、いっこ聞きたかったんだけど、いい？: Hey, there's something I wanted to ask you. Is that okay？
translations.ガールズコレクションもいいけどさ、まさかリンコにそーいうファッションさせたいわけ: The Girls Collection is fine and all, but you're not hoping to get me to dress like that, are you？
translations.ああ、それでさっきから微妙な表情してたんだ。: Oh, so that's why you've had that weird look on your face.
translations.微妙っていうか……うーん。: I wouldn't call it weird, just... hmm.
translations.そろそろ始まるな。ほら、行くぞ。: It's about to start. Come on, let's go.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、楽しくなかった？: Did you not have fun, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ううん、ショー自体は面白かった。想像よりもずっと。: No, the show itself was fun. Way more than I expected.
translations.そりゃよかった。なんでうなってんの？: That's good to hear. Then why are you groaning？
translations.さっきの話。リンコがああいう服が似合うキャラだったらいいんだろうけど……ちょっと: About what I said earlier. It'd be one thing if I were the type who could pull off clothes like that, but... that's not really me, is it？
translations.そんなことないだろ。▲小早川＊▲って結構なんでも似合うし……ああいうの着ても充分: That's not true. You look good in pretty much anything, ▲小早川＊▲... and I think you'd look plenty cute in clothes like that... too.
translations.……言いながら照れるなっつーの。こっちまで……恥ずかしいじゃん。: ...Don't get all bashful while you're saying it. You're making me embarrassed too.
translations.うん……でも押し付ける気はないからさ。●もたまに希望言ったりするけど、▲小早川＊: Yeah... Well, I'm not trying to force it on you, ●. You tell me your preferences sometimes too, sure, but you're not a dress-up doll. Just wear whatever you like, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……うん。優しいカレシで良かった。へへ。: ...Yeah. I'm glad I've got such a sweet boyfriend. Hehe.
translations.優しいかな？ 当たり前のことだと思うけどな。: Sweet？ I think that's just common sense, though.
translations.優しいよ。ちゃんとリンコのこと尊重してくれる。そんな優しいカレシそうはいないね。: You are sweet. You actually respect me. Boyfriends as sweet as you are hard to come by.
translations.ひとつわかったことがあるんだよね。: There's one thing I figured out, though.
translations.わかったこと？ ショーを観て、か？: Something you figured out？ From watching the show？
translations.そう、これはファッションの極意といっても過言じゃないかもしれない。: Yeah. It might not even be an exaggeration to call it the ultimate secret of fashion.
translations.へえ、気になるな。聞かせてよ。: Oh, now I'm curious. Let's hear it.
translations.今日のショーさ、可愛い服に、可愛いアクセサリーに、可愛いメイク、可愛い髪……そし: Today's show had cute clothes, cute accessories, cute makeup, cute hair... and cute models.
translations.……やっぱ可愛いと思ったんだ。: ...So you did think they were cute.
translations.なんでもない。まあ、それが全部あわさって、あのショーの成功につながったわけじゃん: Nothing. Anyway, all of that coming together is what made the show such a success, right？
translations.でもポイントはそこじゃないね。: But that's not the real point.
translations.モデルの表情、目線、歩き方、その他諸々の立ち居振る舞い。: The models' expressions, their gaze, how they walk, and the rest of how they carry themselves.
translations.これだね。着飾るのもいいけど、やっぱそっちを磨かないとね。: That's what matters. Dressing up is fine, but that's what you really need to polish.
translations.へえ……じゃあ▲小早川＊▲は具体的になにするんだ？: Huh... So what are you going to do specifically, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.えっと、それは……別に、●は今の▲小早川＊▲のままでも……。: Uh, well... Not really. ● is fine staying the ▲小早川＊▲ you are now...
translations.あんな着飾ったモデルたちじゃなくて、ちゃんとありのままのリンコを見てよ。: Don't look at those dressed-up models. Look properly at me, just the way I am.
translations.……●は、目移りした気なんてないけど？: ...● wasn't checking them out or anything, though？
translations.へへ、言うじゃん……そういうことにしといてあげる。: Hehe, smooth talker... I'll let you off with that.
translations.ＥＣＯってさ、やっぱ人気なの？: So is ECO really that popular？
translations.まあね。少なくともリンコの周りでは。: I guess so. At least with the people around me.
translations.周りだけ？ ▲小早川＊▲はそんなでもないんだ。: Just around you？ So you're not that into them, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そりゃね。もっともらしいこと書いてるけどさ、年齢どころか性別も不詳の人間、信頼で: Well, yeah. What they write sounds plausible enough, but you can't trust someone when you don't even know their gender, let alone their age.
translations.たしかに謎は多いよな……。: True, there are a lot of mysteries about them...
translations.だいたいさ、女の気持ちも男の気持ちも両方理解できるって、不可能じゃない？: Besides, understanding how both women and men feel is pretty much impossible, isn't it？
translations.女の気持ちわかってるな～ってよく思うしさ。なおかつ、男目線のコメントもすごく説得: I often find myself thinking they really get how women feel. And on top of that, their comments from a guy's perspective are super convincing too, like they're speaking from actual experience.
translations.そうだよ。そんな完璧な恋愛カリスマなんて、信用できないね！: Yeah. There's no way you can trust a romance guru who's that perfect!
translations.（意外に熱心な読者だったり……？）: (Is she actually a pretty avid reader...？)
translations.お待たせいたしました、恋のカリスマＥＣＯの登場です！ みなさま盛大な拍手でお迎え: Thank you for waiting, everyone! Here comes the guru of love, ECO! Please give a big round of applause!
translations.ボナセーラ。ＥＣＯです、よろしく～♪ お待たせ、悩める子羊ちゃん達。お悩み、解決: Buonasera! I'm ECO, nice to meet you~♪ Sorry to keep you waiting, my troubled little lambs. I'm going to solve all your problems!
translations.ほんとに信用できないかも……。: Maybe they really can't be trusted...
translations.バイバイ、子羊ちゃん達！ また今度、アリベデルチ。: Bye-bye, my little lambs! Until next time, arrivederci!
translations.きっついね、キャラが。: That persona is a bit much.
translations.でも言ってることは、やっぱりためになった気がするけど……。: Still, I feel like what they actually said was pretty helpful...
translations.さっきの恋愛講座さ。: About that love seminar just now.
translations.たしかに面白かったんだけど、だから、ちょっと不安になるとこもあって。: It was definitely interesting, yeah, but because of that, it also made me a little uneasy.
translations.ああいう不特定多数に向けた話に共感しちゃうのってさ、なんか、自分が型にはまってる: Relating to advice meant for just anyone like that... makes me feel like I fit right into a mold.
translations.こう、ステレオタイプな恋愛しちゃってるのかなって。: Like maybe we're just having some stereotypical romance.
translations.それって、別に悪いことでもないんじゃないか。: That's not necessarily a bad thing, is it？
translations.そうかもしれないけど、なんとなくイヤなの！ もっと斬新な恋愛しようよ。: Maybe not, but I still don't like the idea! Let's have a more original romance.
translations.斬新な恋愛って……。うーん……例えば？: A more original romance... Hmm... Like what？
translations.それはわかんないけど！ えっと……例えば……。: I don't know! Um... for example...
translations.そうだな、新しいってわけじゃなくて、むしろ逆だけど。それが今はかえって新しいって: Let's see, it's not actually new—more like the opposite. Which kind of makes it fresh again nowadays.
translations.つまりさ、温故知新ってやつ。古き日本の、黙って相手に従うって感じの。: You know, learning from the past. Like in old-fashioned Japan, quietly obeying your partner.
translations.一歩後ろを歩いて、相手を立てて、三つ指揃えてお帰りなさいませ、みたいな。: Walking a step behind, deferring to your partner, bowing on your knees to say "welcome home"... that sort of thing.
translations.へえ、意外だな、▲小早川＊▲がそんなこと言うなんて……。でもちょっと悪くないかも: Huh, I'm surprised to hear you say something like that, ▲小早川＊▲... Though it doesn't sound half bad.
translations.でしょ？ まあリンコたちの場合は男女逆バージョンってことになるけど、そんな変わら: Right？ Well, in our case the roles would be reversed, but that's basically the same thing, right？
translations.じゃあ決まり！ 今日からリンコ関白！: Then it's settled! Starting today, Rinko rules the roost!
translations.（それって……今とあんまり変わらないかも？）: (Wait... is that really any different from how things are now？)
translations.あれ？ ▲小早川＊▲、どこ行ったんだ？ まさか迷子……。: Huh？ Where did ▲小早川＊▲ go？ Don't tell me she got lost...
translations.いたか。迷子になったのかと思った。: There you are. I thought you got lost.
translations.誰が迷子？ 子供扱いするなっつーの。: Who's lost？ Stop treating me like a kid.
translations.向こうの方は結構背の高い花もあってさ、かくれんぼにもってこいだなって見てきたの。: There are some pretty tall flowers over that way. I was just thinking they'd be perfect for hide-and-seek.
translations.細かいこと気にするなっつーの。……くしゅん。: Don't sweat the small stuff, I said. ...Achoo.
translations.風邪か？ それか花粉とか……でもこの花は花粉症とは関係ないよな？: Did you catch a cold？ Or maybe pollen... Though these flowers don't cause hay fever, do they？
translations.だと思うけど……。ちょっと寒くなったからかも、春っていっても夕方になるとちょっと: I don't think so... Maybe it just got a little chilly. Even in spring, it still cools down in the evening.
translations.じゃあ、どこか中に入るか。: Want to head inside somewhere, then？
translations.いいよ、ちょっと動けばあったかくなるって。ほら、鬼ごっことか。: It's fine. Moving around a bit will warm us right up. Come on, like a game of tag.
translations.はは、かくれんぼの次は鬼ごっこか。: Haha, first hide-and-seek and now tag？
translations.いいじゃん、たまには。体動かさないと、ますます老けるよ。: Nothing wrong with it once in a while. If you don't move around, you'll only get older faster.
translations.テニス部だっつーの！: I'm in the tennis club, you know!
translations.夜になったらますます肌寒くなってきたね。: It's gotten even chillier now that it's night.
translations.そうだな。風邪引くなよ？: Yeah. Don't catch a cold, okay？
translations.じゃあ……こうしちゃお。へへ。: Then... I'll just do this. Hehe.
translations.そんなにくっつかれたら、歩きづらいんだけどな……。: It's kind of hard to walk with you clinging to me like that...
translations.さすがに暗くなると、人がいなくなるね。: There really isn't anyone around once it gets dark.
translations.もう……春なんだよね。今はまだ肌寒いけど、だんだんあったかくなってく。: It's already spring, isn't it... It's still chilly right now, but it'll get warmer and warmer.
translations.あったかくなるのが嫌みたいな言い方だけど？: You make it sound like you don't want it to get warmer.
translations.こうやって、あったかい……なんて甘えることができなくなるじゃん。寒い間の特権なの: Then I won't have an excuse to cling to you and say how warm you are like this. That's a cold-weather privilege.
translations.今日の▲小早川＊▲は、いつもより甘えん坊なんだな。: You're more affectionate than usual today, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.今日見たお花畑が、リンコの頭の中まで浸食してきたんだよ……。: The flower fields we saw today must have started invading my head, too...
translations.……あんまり上手い言い方じゃなかったかな。: ...Maybe that wasn't the best way to put it.
translations.はは、こんなときに上手いこと言わなくてもいいだろ。: Haha, you don't have to say anything clever at a time like this.
translations.冬のベイブリッジってもっと人が少ないと思ってたよ。意外だった。: I thought there'd be fewer people on the Bay Bridge in winter. Kind of surprising.
translations.つまりここはイチャイチャする場所なんだな。: So basically, this is a spot for getting lovey-dovey.
translations.イチャイチャ……そういう直接的な言い方したら、ムードも何もないじゃん。: Lovey-dovey... If you put it that bluntly, it totally kills the mood.
translations.……ごめん。その……▲小早川＊▲もやっぱりイチャイチャしたいのかなーって。: ...Sorry. Um... I just wondered if you wanted to get lovey-dovey too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.したい。……なんて言うと思った？: I do. ...Is that what you thought I'd say？
translations.流れっていうか、そういうのが大事なわけ。それなのに……。: There's a flow to these things, you know. That stuff matters. And yet...
translations.あ……▲小早川＊▲。ごめん、怒ったんなら……。: Ah... ▲小早川＊▲. Sorry, if you're mad...
translations.べつに怒ってないけど？ ちょっと呆れただけ。: I'm not really mad, okay？ Just a little exasperated.
translations.怒ってないってば。ほら、イチャイチャするんでしょ、少しだけね。: I told you I'm not mad. Come on, we're getting lovey-dovey, right？ Just a little.
translations.へへ。一度乗ってみたかったんだ。このクルーズ船。: Hehe. I've always wanted to ride this cruise ship at least once.
translations.湾内をぐるっと回って帰ってくるわけか。でもさ……うっ、さすがに冬の海はこたえるな: So it circles around the bay and comes back, huh. Still... brr, the winter sea breeze really gets to you.
translations.こういうときはさ、余計な言葉はいらないと思うんだけど。: At times like this, I don't think we need any extra words.
translations.……うん。他のカップルも自分たちの世界に入り込んでるみたいだな。: ...Yeah. Looks like the other couples are all in their own little worlds, too.
translations.余計な言葉はいらないって言ったでしょ？: Didn't I say we don't need any extra words？
translations.……そうだったな。じゃ、このまま。: ...Right, you did. Let's stay like this, then.
translations.船、港に戻らなくてもいいのに……。: I wish the boat didn't have to go back to port...
translations.てめっ…………ああもう、わかったよ。くそっ、声かけるんじゃなかった。: You little... Argh, fine, I get it! Damn, never should've talked to her.
translations.それはこっちの台詞。着替えるのにいつまで時間かかってるわけ。: That's my line. How long does it take you to get changed？
translations.それは、悪い……。で、大丈夫だったか？: Sorry about that... Anyway, are you okay？
translations.●も遅くなったのは悪いけど、もっと気をつけた方がいいぞ。: Sorry ● took so long, too, but you should be more careful.
translations.大丈夫だよ。蹴ってやったから。素足だとこっちも痛いんだけど。: I'm fine. I gave him a kick. Hurts my foot too when I'm barefoot, though.
translations.心配させてごめん。でもさ、アンタがこっちに来てるの見えたから。それなら、絡まれた: Sorry for making you worry. Still, I saw you heading over here. Figured even if some guy bothered me, you'd help me out.
translations.そりゃな。まあ、そういうことなら…………ダメだろ。: Well, yeah. I guess in that case...... Wait, no it's not.
translations.ね。早く花火しよっ！: Come on, let's do the fireworks already!
translations.そんなにあわてなくても、夜はまだ長いんだからさ。: No need to rush. The night's still young.
translations.いいからっ！ まずは……打ち上げ花火いっとく？: Just come on! First up... wanna set off a skyrocket？
translations.いつの間に……●、手持ちの花火しか買わなかったはずなんだけど。: When did you get that...？ I thought ● only bought handheld fireworks.
translations.せっかく海まで来たんだよ？ 少しくらい派手なのやらなきゃ損じゃん。: We came all the way out to the beach, you know？ It'd be a waste not to do something a little flashy.
translations.それもそうか。街中じゃ打ち上げ花火なんかできないもんな。: Good point. Can't really set off skyrockets in the middle of town.
translations.当然。だってちょっと怖いじゃん。ほらほら。: Obviously. They're kinda scary, you know. Go on, go on.
translations.線香花火が最後、か。ちょっとしんみりしちゃうよね。: Ending with sparklers, huh. Kinda makes things feel a bit wistful.
translations.なんとなくわかるな。他の花火みたいに派手さがない分な。: Yeah, I get what you mean. Since they're not flashy like the other fireworks.
translations.なんとなくいじらしいよね。落ちないようにがんばってる感じがしてさ。: There's something endearing about them. Like they're trying their hardest not to drop.
translations.あともうちょっと……あともうちょっとがんばれ。: Just a little longer... Hang in there just a little longer.
translations.なに？ こっち見てた？: What？ Were you looking at me？
translations.ああ……なんか、▲小早川＊▲の横顔がさ。線香花火に照らされて……きれいだったから: Yeah... Seeing your profile lit up by the sparkler, ▲小早川＊▲... You just looked really pretty.
translations.へへ……そっか。じゃ。そろそろ帰ろっか。: Hehe... Yeah, okay. Well, should we head back soon？
translations.ん？ なに、見てたの？: Hm？ What, were you watching me？
translations.さっきからずっと大水槽の前から動こうとしないからさ。そんなに好きなんだ。: You haven't budged from in front of the main tank for a while now. You really like it that much, huh.
translations.……うん。珍しい魚がいるわけじゃないけどね。: ...Yeah. Not that there are any rare fish in here, though.
translations.でも、小魚の群れがまるで１匹の魚みたいに、そろって方向転換するとことかさ。じっと: Still, the way a school of little fish turns all at once like one big fish... Isn't it neat when you just watch them？
translations.でしょ？ それにこの水槽のライトアップ。: Right？ Plus the lighting in this tank.
translations.見た目はキレイなのにさ、水槽の魚を刺激しないように工夫してるらしいよ。海に光が差: It looks pretty, and apparently it's designed not to stress the fish in the tank. It says they made the lighting to look like sunlight filtering into the ocean.
translations.へえ。▲小早川＊▲って意外と物知りなんだな。: Huh. You actually know a lot, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.……将来家に欲しいな、\nこういう水槽。:
...I'd love a tank like this
at home someday.
translations.楽しそうだけど……\n掃除が大変そうだな。:
Sounds nice, though...
it'd be a pain to clean.
translations.だよね、まあそれは\nアンタに任せるよ。:
True. Well, I'll leave
that part to you.
translations.呼んだじゃないよ。\nさっきから何度も呼んでた。:
Not just once. I've been
calling you for a while.
translations.ハハハ……ずっと水槽に\n見入ってたもんな。:
Hahaha... You were totally
absorbed in the tank.
translations.そんなに長く？ \nあれ、もう閉館時間？:
For that long？
Wait, is it closing time？
translations.そう。さっきからずっと\nアナウンスもしてるよ。:
Yeah. They've been making
announcements for a while.
translations.……ごめん、気づかなかった。\nせっかくのデートなのに……\nつまんなかったよね:
...Sorry, I didn't realize.
And on our date, too...
Was that boring for you？
translations.▲小早川＊▲が\n楽しかったんなら、\nそれでいいよ。それに……。:
If you had a good time,
▲小早川＊▲, that's all
that matters. Besides...
translations.水槽をぼうっと見てる\n▲小早川＊▲を●が見てる。\nその構図がなんか楽しかった:
You zoning out at the tank,
▲小早川＊▲, while ● just
watched... That was fun.
translations.リンコさ、クラシックってほとんど聴かないんだけど。: You know, I almost never listen to classical music.
translations.もしかして……嫌だったか？: Wait... Did you not want to come？
translations.せっかく誘ってくれたんだもん、嬉しいよ。でも……。: You went to the trouble of inviting me, so I'm glad to be here. It's just...
translations.前にクラシック聴いたときに、寝ちゃったんだよね。リンコでも、さすがにそれは失礼だ: The last time I listened to classical music, I fell asleep. Even I know that's pretty rude, so...
translations.そんな堅苦しいコンサートじゃないから大丈夫だよ。眠かったら、そのまま寝ちゃっても: It's not that formal of a concert, so don't worry. If you get sleepy, you can just go ahead and sleep.
translations.野外コンサートだからさ、演奏の迷惑にならなければ自由な聴き方でいいって。もともと: Since it's an outdoor concert, they say you can listen however you like as long as it doesn't disrupt the performance. Apparently that laid-back vibe is their whole selling point.
translations.へえ。リンコはクラシックのコンサートって姿勢をビシッとして、おとなしく聴いてなく: Huh. I always thought you had to sit up straight and listen quietly at a classical concert.
translations.そういうコンサートもあるけどね。あっ、そろそろ始まるぞ。: Well, some concerts are like that. Oh, it's about to start.
translations.▲小早川＊▲……？ やっぱり寝ちゃったか。: ▲小早川＊▲...？ Guess you fell asleep after all.
translations.ぜんっぜん起きてるっつーの。: I'm totally awake, I'll have you know.
translations.まあね、でも退屈でっていうより、気持ちよくってさ。んーいい演奏だった。: Well, yeah, but not because I was bored. It just felt really nice. Mmm, that was a good performance.
translations.（ほんとに聴いてたのかな……）: (I wonder if she was actually listening...)
translations.コンサートが終わって、だいぶ静かになったな。: It's gotten pretty quiet now that the concert's over.
translations.そうだね。風……少し強くなってきたかな？: Yeah. Is the wind... picking up a little？
translations.さっきリンコが寝てたとき、ヘンなことしようとした？: Earlier, when I was asleep, did you try anything funny？
translations.今なら誰もいないから、さっきの続き……してもいいのに。: Nobody's around right now, so... we could pick up where we left off, you know.
translations.なーんてね、ドキッとした？ へへ。: Just kidding. Did I get your heart racing？ Hehe.
translations.冗談でもないけどね。ただ……リンコはさ、やっぱりいざとなると素直になれないし。: I wasn't completely joking, though. It's just... when it comes down to it, I still have trouble being honest with my feelings.
translations.だから時々いじわるしちゃう。それでも……こんなカノジョ嫌いになったりしない？: So sometimes I end up teasing you like that. Even so... you won't start hating a girlfriend like me, will you？
translations.……なるわけないだろ。素直じゃないとこも含めて、▲小早川＊▲のこと、好きなんだか: ...Of course I won't. I love everything about you, ▲小早川＊▲, even when you aren't totally honest.
translations.……なんか安心した。あのさ……たまには素直なリンコでもいいよね？: ...That's a relief. Hey... is it okay if I'm honest once in a while？
translations.さっきから難しい顔してるけど、どうかした？: You've had a serious look on your face for a while now. What's up？
translations.これって有名な画家の絵なんだよね？: This is by a famous painter, right？
translations.ああ。この美術館の目玉らしいよ。: Yeah. Apparently it's this museum's main attraction.
translations.どう見ても子供の落書きじゃない？: Doesn't it just look like a kid's scribble no matter how you look at it？
translations.美術館の人に聞かれたらどうするんだ？: What if someone who works here hears you？
translations.しょうがないじゃん。素直な感想なんだもん。そういうアンタは、この絵の良さがわかる: I can't help it. It's my honest impression. What about you？ Do you see what's so great about this painting...？
translations.うーん……抽象画は●もよくわかんないな。: Hmm... abstract art doesn't make much sense to ●, either.
translations.でしょ？ リンコの描く絵と違いがわかんないよ。: Right？ I can't tell the difference between this and my own drawings.
translations.そう言われると……いや、きっと見る人が見れば良さはわかるんだよ。うん、きっとそう: When you put it like that... No, I'm sure someone with an eye for it can tell why it's good. Yeah, that must be it.
translations.なんか自分で納得させようとしてない？: Aren't you just trying to convince yourself？
translations.ハハハ……バレたか。芸術って難しいよな。: Hahaha... You caught me. Art is tough, huh.
translations.だよねー。だからさ、難しいこと抜きにして、自分の感性を信じればいいんじゃない？: I know, right？ So why not skip the complicated stuff and just trust your own sensibilities？
translations.そ。リンコの絵だって実は見る人が見れば、すごいことになるかもよ？: Yeah. Who knows, if the right person saw my drawings, they might turn out to be a big deal too.
translations.外はもうだいぶ暗くなってきたけど。: It's gotten pretty dark outside already, though.
translations.このあとはナイトミュージアムだな。: Next up is the night museum.
translations.うん……どんな感じかな。: Yeah... I wonder what it'll be like.
translations.昼間と同じ場所なのに、雰囲気がぜんぜん違うね。: It's the same place as during the day, but the atmosphere is completely different.
translations.べつに恐くなんか……そういうこと言うなっつーの。意識しちゃうじゃん。: I'm not scared... Stop saying stuff like that. You're gonna make me think about it.
translations.べつに恐いわけじゃないから。暗いとさ、転びそうになるからつかまってるだけ。: It's not like I'm scared or anything. It's just dark, so I'm holding on to you so I don't trip.
translations.……静かだね。まるでこの世界にアンタとリンコ。２人だけしかいないみたい。: ...It's so quiet. It feels like you and I are the only two people in the world.
translations.もしこの美術館を出たら、世界中に２人だけだったらどうする？: What would you do if we walked out of this museum and we really were the only two people in the world？
translations.べつに……それでもいいけど。: Nothing really... I wouldn't mind that.
translations.ひとりぼっちじゃないんでしょ。なら、いいんじゃない。: I wouldn't be all alone, right？ So that'd be fine by me.
translations.……リンコはアンタさえいてくれれば、どんな世界でも生きていける気がするよ。: ...As long as you're with me, I feel like I could live in any kind of world.
translations.ふれあい広場にさ、この春生まれたばかりの動物の赤ちゃんがいるらしいよ。: Hey, I heard they have baby animals at the petting zoo that were just born this spring.
translations.じゃ、行ってみるか。: Let's go take a look, then.
translations.ネコの赤ちゃんがいたら最高なんだけど……いないよね。: It'd be amazing if they had kittens, but... I guess they wouldn't.
translations.さすがに動物園にネコはな。: Yeah, you don't really see cats at a zoo.
translations.なんかちょっとタヌキっぽいところがかわいいよね。ヌイグルミみたいで……トローンと: The way it looks a little like a raccoon dog is cute, isn't it？ Like a stuffed animal... with those sleepy eyes.
translations.▲小早川＊▲ってやっぱり動物が好きなんだな。: You really do love animals, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そうでもないと思うけど。動物はなんでも好きっていうのとはちょっと違うかも。: I don't know about that. It's not like I just love every animal.
translations.じゃ、好きになる基準は？: Then what's your standard for liking them？
translations.そ。抱き心地がいいのが好き。肉球とかさ、もふもふってするのが気持ちいいの。: Yeah. I like ones that feel nice to hug. Soft paw pads, fluffy fur... things that feel good to touch.
translations.……アルパカ？ 赤ちゃんにしてはもうだいぶ大きいよ。: ...An alpaca？ It's already pretty big for a baby.
translations.うう……抱きかかえるのはちょっと無理そう。それに顔が……。: Ugh... I don't think I could pick that up. And its face is...
translations.はは、▲小早川＊▲が抱きかかえようとしたら、きっと押しつぶされるな。: Haha, if you tried to pick it up, ▲小早川＊▲, it'd probably crush you.
translations.……えっ!? あそこって……とわの市、だよね？: ...Huh！？ That's... Towano City over there, isn't it？
translations.この前たまたま雑誌で見たんだけどさ。どうせ山の上動物園に来るなら、ここは外せない: I happened to see it in a magazine the other day. Figured if we were coming to the Hilltop Zoo anyway, we couldn't miss this spot. ...Was I trying a little too hard to look cool？
translations.あそこが普段リンコたちが暮らしてる街なんだ……。見慣れた街なのに、こうして見ると: That's the town we live in every day... I'm so used to seeing it, but looking at it from here... it's a strange feeling.
translations.街っていうより、光の海だよな。: It looks less like a town and more like a sea of light.
translations.ん？ ▲小早川＊▲、ちょっとウルって来てる？: Hm？ Are you tearing up a little, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.もうっ、せっかくいいムードだったのに台無し！: Geez, we had such a nice mood going and you ruined it!
translations.ごめんってば。調子に乗った●が悪かったよ。: I said I'm sorry. ● got carried away. My bad.
translations.きれいな夜景を見せてくれたことに免じて、許してあげる。その代わり一発……いいよね: Since you showed me such a pretty night view, I'll forgive you. In exchange for one hit... okay？
translations.へへ。今日はこれで許してあげる▼: Hehe. I'll let you off with that for today▼
translations.急に芋掘りに行こうなんて言われたときは、驚いたよ。: You really surprised me when you suddenly asked to go digging for sweet potatoes.
translations.幼稚園のときに遠足で芋掘りに行ったりしなかった？: Didn't you go sweet potato digging on a field trip back in kindergarten？
translations.行ったよ。だからさ……。またリンコを子供扱いしてるのかなって。: I did. Which is why... I thought maybe you were treating me like a kid again.
translations.そういうわけじゃないよ。童心に返ったみたいで楽しくない？: That's not what I meant. Isn't it fun feeling like a kid again？
translations.顔。土がついてるよ？: Your face. You've got dirt on it, you know？
translations.汚れた手で拭いたら意味ないじゃん？ ほらっ、こっちに顔向けて。: Wiping it with dirty hands defeats the whole point, doesn't it？ Come on, turn your face toward me.
translations.焼き芋ってさ、こうやって焼けるのを待ってる瞬間。楽しくない？: You know, just waiting like this for the sweet potatoes to roast... Isn't this part kind of fun？
translations.ああ、なんとなくわかる。早く焼けないかなって、ワクワクするよな。: Yeah, I know what you mean. You get all excited wondering if they're ready yet.
translations.あっ、そろそろ焼けたかな？: Oh, do you think they're about done？
translations.とりあえず大丈夫だと思うけど、一応家帰ってからも冷やしてよ？: I think it'll be fine for now, but make sure you cool it down after you get home too, okay？
translations.……ありがと。なんか照れるな、こんな風に▲小早川＊▲に手当してもらうと。: ...Thanks. It makes me kind of shy, having you take care of me like this, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.照れる必要、ないじゃん。: There's nothing to be embarrassed about.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲ってこういうの、意外とてきぱきしてるんだな）: (▲小早川＊▲'s surprisingly good at handling stuff like this.)
translations.うう……焼き芋ちょっと食べ過ぎたかも。: Ugh... I think I ate a little too much sweet potato.
translations.まったく。いっつもリンコのこと、子供扱いするくせに今日のアンタときたらさ。火傷は: Geez. You're always treating me like a kid, and yet look at you today. Even burning yourself.
translations.つい童心に返っちゃってさ。: I just got carried away feeling like a kid again.
translations.へへ。……ま、たまにはいいかもね。リンコも楽しかったし。: Heh. ...Well, maybe that's fine every now and then. I had fun too.
translations.よかった。芋掘りなんてつまんないって、言われるかと思ったんだよ。: I'm glad. I thought you were gonna tell me digging up sweet potatoes was boring.
translations.そうじゃなくて……カレシの世話をするのってさ……なんていうか、楽しい。リンコ、い: Not just that... Taking care of my boyfriend is, well... kind of fun. I feel like you're always the one supporting me. So...
translations.●だって▲小早川＊▲に支えられてるって。: ● lean on you for support too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ホントだよ。▲小早川＊▲のため……って言ったら大げさだけどさ、がんばれるのは大切: It's true. Saying it's for you, ▲小早川＊▲... might sound dramatic, but I can do my best because I have a girlfriend who means so much to me.
translations.大切なカノジョのためならがんばれる、か……へへ。もう一回。: You can do your best for a girlfriend who means so much to you, huh... Heh. Say it one more time.
translations.仕方ないな……▲小早川＊▲がいるから、●はがんばれるよ。: What am I gonna do with you... Because you're here, ▲小早川＊▲, ● can do my best.
translations.うん……リンコもアンタの支えになりたい。そしてアンタも……。: Yeah... I want to support you too. And for you to...
translations.ああ、▲小早川＊▲の支えになりたいよ。: Yeah, I want to be there to support you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.一面のススキ野原か。こういうとこに来ると、ススキの中を突っ切りたくならない？: A whole field of pampas grass, huh. Doesn't coming to a place like this make you want to run right through it？
translations.ああ、わかる。子供の時考えたよな。: Yeah, I get that. We used to think about doing that as kids, huh.
translations.でも、いいんじゃない？ たまには子供の頃に戻ってみてもさっ！: Still, why not？ There's nothing wrong with going back to being a kid every once in a while!
translations.さーて、リンコはどこでしょう。カレシなら探してみ。: Now then, where could I be？ If you're my boyfriend, try and find me.
translations.まったく……よーし、絶対見つけてやるからなっ！: Geez... All right, you bet I'm gonna find you!
translations.とは言ったものの、難しいな……。: Though now that I said that, this is actually pretty tough...
translations.今日さ……お月様、見えるかな。: I wonder... if we'll be able to see the moon tonight.
translations.そうだな、今日あたりは見頃だって聞いてたんだけど。……雲が晴れないと難しいかな。: Yeah, I heard tonight was supposed to be a great night for it. ...Might be tough unless the clouds clear up, though.
translations.せっかく来たんだもん、きれいなお月様見たいよね。お願いしよっか？: We came all this way, so I really want to see a pretty moon. Should we make a wish？
translations.ずいぶんおおざっぱだな。神様って言っても、いろいろいるだろ？: That's pretty vague. There are all kinds of gods out there, aren't there？
translations.お月様を見せてくれるなら、どんな神様でもオッケー。だから神様お願い！: Any god is fine as long as they let us see the moon. So please, gods, help us out!
translations.よし、じゃあ●も。神様どうか雲を払ってください。: All right, then ● will too. Oh gods, please clear away the clouds.
translations.あっ……ほら、雲の隙間からお月様が。: Oh... Look, the moon's peeking out through the clouds.
translations.一瞬だけだったな。: That was only for a second, huh.
translations.前にさ、自分が月の住人なんじゃないかって。思ったことがあるんだよね。: A while back, I used to wonder if maybe I was actually from the moon.
translations.月の……かぐや姫みたいな？: From the moon... Like Princess Kaguya？
translations.ちょっと違う……自分の居場所は本当はここにはなくてって……そんな風に考えてた。: Not quite... More like I felt I didn't really belong here... That's how I used to think.
translations.ね。もしリンコが本当に月の住人で、いつか帰る日が来たらどうする？: Hey. What would you do if I really were from the moon, and the day came for me to go back？
translations.……かっこつけちゃってさ。大丈夫……リンコはどこにも行かないよ。ずっとここにいる: ...Look at you, trying to sound cool. Don't worry... I'm not going anywhere. I'll always be right here.
translations.ね。そろそろ花嫁さんが出てくる頃かな。こういうのって何度見てもわくわくするね。: Hey, the bride should be coming out soon. Weddings are always exciting, no matter how many times you see one.
translations.前に結婚式に出たことあるんだ？: You've been to a wedding before？
translations.親戚のお姉さんの式とかね。普段と見違えたみたいに、式の最中は輝いてたの、覚えてる: My older cousin's wedding and stuff. I remember how radiant she looked during the ceremony, like a whole different person.
translations.やっぱりドレスを着ると、印象が違って見えるのかな。: I guess wearing a dress really makes a person look different.
translations.それだけじゃなくて……幸せの絶頂のとき、女性は一番輝くって、よく言うじゃん。: It's not just that... You know how they say a woman shines brightest at the peak of her happiness.
translations.そっか。▲小早川＊▲もそういうときが来るんだよな。: Right. That day'll come for you too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.は!? リンコはまだそんなこと、考えられないかな。相手だってまだ……。: Huh!? I can't even think about that yet. Besides, as for who I'd marry...
translations.それは……アンタなら……だけど、でもまだ高校生だし。現実味ないっていうか……。: Well... if it's you, sure... But we're still in high school. It just doesn't feel real yet...
translations.お、そろそろ新郎新婦が出てくる頃だな。: Oh, looks like the bride and groom are about to come out.
translations.ちょっと話！ …………もう。: Hey, we were in the middle of talking! ...Geez.
translations.ブーケ、▲小早川＊▲のとこにまっすぐ飛んできたよな。: That bouquet flew straight to you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.うん、でも……良かったのかな。リンコが受け取っちゃって。: Yeah, but... was it really okay for me to catch it？
translations.受け取った人が次に結婚できるって言うじゃん。そんなのをリンコがさ。: They say whoever catches it will be the next to get married, right？ I'm not sure I should have it.
translations.気にしなくていいんじゃないか？ みんな、拍手してくれてたし。: I don't think you need to worry about it. Everyone was clapping for you, after all.
translations.そういえばブーケを受け取ったあと、あの新婦さん、▲小早川＊▲に何か言ってなかった: By the way, didn't the bride say something to you after you caught the bouquet, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.んと……幸せになってねって。: Um... She told me to be happy.
translations.なら、その気持ちを素直に受け取っておけばいいと思うけどな。: Then I think you should just gladly accept her blessing.
translations.リンコは今でも十分に幸せ。これ以上の幸せなんて、今はまだ考えられないよ。: I'm already plenty happy right now. I can't even imagine being any happier than this.
translations.なら、●が今以上に▲小早川＊▲のこと、幸せにするぞ。それがカレシの務め。だろ？: Then ● will just have to make you even happier, ▲小早川＊▲. That's a boyfriend's job, right？
translations.もうっ……バカじゃん。それじゃまるで……プロポーズ、みたい。: Geez... Are you an idiot？ That almost sounds like... a proposal.
translations.……幸せにしてもらわなくていいよ。: ...You don't need to make me happy.
translations.リンコはもうたくさんの幸せをアンタからもらったもん。だからさ……。: You've already given me so much happiness. So...
translations.幸せにしてもらうんじゃなくて、一緒に幸せになろ？: Instead of you making me happy, let's be happy together, okay？
translations.奥十羽野まで来ると、家も少なくなるね。: There really aren't many houses once you get all the way out to Okutowano.
translations.●たちの住んでるとこに比べると、こじんまりとしてるよな。: It's pretty small and cozy compared to where you and ● live.
translations.この雰囲気、旅に来たって感じがして、嫌いじゃないけどね。: I don't dislike the atmosphere here, though. It makes it feel like we're really on a trip.
translations.とりあえず部屋に荷物置いたら、辺り回ってみない？ 時間もったいないし。: Once we drop our bags off in the room, want to look around the area？ It'd be a waste of time not to.
translations.そうだな。さっき宿の周りに土産物屋もあったしな。: Yeah, good idea. I saw some souvenir shops around the inn earlier, too.
translations.これなんか弟に買っていってあげたら、喜ぶかな。: I wonder if my little brother would like something like this if I bought it for him.
translations.民芸品。それでね、ほら、こうすると……変形。へへ。良くない？: A folk craft. And look, if you do this... it transforms. Hehe. Isn't it cool？
translations.変形って……ロボットものみたいだな。: Transforms？ Sounds like a giant robot toy.
translations.そんなに違わないでしょ。弟はこういうの喜びそうなんだよね。: It's not that different, right？ My brother really goes for this kind of stuff.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲の方が喜んでそうだな……）:
(Looks like ▲小早川＊▲'s
enjoying it the most...)
translations.そういえばさっき宿の人に聞いたんだけど、温泉はいつでも入っていいんだって。:
By the way, the staff told
me earlier that we can use
the hot spring anytime.
translations.そんなに急いで温泉に入りたいんだ。ふーん。:
So you're in that much of a
hurry to get in the hot
spring. Hmm.
translations.変な意味じゃなくてさ！ せっかく来たんだし……。:
I didn't mean it like that!
It's just, since we're
already here...
translations.ま、いいけど。せっかくの温泉旅館だしね。温泉行こっ！:
Well, fine by me. We are at
a hot spring inn, after all.
Let's go!
translations.男女別々か……そりゃそうだ。:
Separate baths for men and
women... Well, obviously.
translations.声に出てるんですけど……。:
You said that out loud,
you know...
translations.あのなー……いいから、入るぞ。:
Come on... Whatever, let's
just go in.
translations.……寒いな。早く入ろっと。:
...Man, it's cold. Better
get in quick.
translations.ねー、そっちはどんな感じ？:
Hey, how is it over on
your side？
translations.そっか、同じ温泉だもんね。ああっ……気持ちいい。:
Right, I guess it's the same
hot spring. Ahhh... This
feels so good.
translations.（男湯と女湯が分かれてるって言っても、一枚の板で区切ってあるだけか）:
(The baths may be separate,
but there's just a single
wooden wall between us.)
translations.……ちょっとのぼせちゃった。リンコ早めに出るね。:
...I'm feeling a bit dizzy
from the heat. I'm going to
get out early, okay？
translations.あっ、すごいね、ここのお湯！ 美肌効果があるって言ってたけど、もうすべすべな気が:
Oh, the water here is great!
They said it's good for your
skin, and mine's so smooth!
translations.（この薄い板一枚隔てて▲小早川＊▲がいるんだな……）:
(▲小早川＊▲ is right on the
other side of this thin
wooden wall...)
translations.あっつー……完全にのぼせた……。:
Man, I'm burning up...
I'm completely dizzy...
translations.なんでそんなになるまで、入ってるかな。冷たい水もらってこようか？:
Why did you stay in until
you got like that？ Should I
go get you some cold water？
translations.大丈夫。だいぶ落ち着いてきたから。:
I'm okay. I'm feeling a lot
better already.
translations.まだ顔が真っ赤だけど？:
Your face is still bright
red, though？
translations.（……そんなに近づかれたら、余計ドキドキするだろ）:
(...If you get that close,
my heart's only going to
pound even harder.)
translations.なんか、こういうのちょっと憧れかも。旦那さんのことを介抱する奥さんみたいでさ……:
I kind of like doing this.
It's like a wife taking care
of her husband... Hehe.
translations.あんまりわたしに心配かけないでね、あ、な、た▼:
Try not to make me worry so
much, okay, d-a-r-l-i-n-g▼
translations.ほら、ここまでくればわかるでしょ？:
Come on, it's obvious
at this point, right？
translations.しょうがないじゃん……今、したいんだから。:
I can't help it...
I just want to right now.
translations.リンコだって、こんなときもあるよ。:
Even I have moments
like this, you know.
translations.ねえ、もっと近づいてさ……ね？:
Hey, come a little
closer... okay？
translations.いいじゃん、恋人同士だし。:
Come on, it's fine.
We're a couple.
translations.わかってないだけ？ それともわざと？:
Are you just clueless？
Or is this on purpose？
translations.今は……ダメだった？: Was now... not a good time？
translations.ドキドキの距離だね。:
Close enough to make
my heart race.
translations.これって……そういうことだよね？:
This means... what I think
it means, right？
translations.焦るなっつーの。: Don't be in such a rush.
translations.そんなに引っぱんなくても大丈夫だって。:
You don't have to pull
that hard, you know.
translations.へへ、強引もたまにはいいね。: Hehe, it's nice when you're forceful once in a while.
translations.リンコは逃げないからさ。: I'm not going to run away, you know.
translations.ほんとはね、早く仲直りしたかったんだ。: To be honest, I really wanted to make up with you sooner.
translations.リンコはいつだってアンタのこと大好きだよ。: I always love you, no matter what.
translations.あれ見て！ ……あ、気のせいだったみたい。: Look at that! ...Oh, never mind, I must've imagined it.
translations.優しくしてくれなきゃ、怒るよ？: I'll get mad if you aren't gentle with me, okay？
translations.甘えてもいい？: Can I let you spoil me？
translations.リンコね……ううん、なんでもない。: You know, I... No, never mind.
translations.意識なくなっちゃうかも……。: I think I might pass out...
translations.夢の中、いるみたい。: It feels like I'm in a dream.
translations.こんな感覚……あるんだね。: I didn't know... you could feel like this.
translations.恥ずかしいより……嬉しい。: More than embarrassed... I'm just happy.
translations.２人の世界だよね？: We're in our own little world, aren't we？
translations.誰にも邪魔されたくない……。: I don't want anyone getting in our way...
translations.アンタをずーっと独り占めするんだから！: I'm keeping you all to myself forever!
translations.時間が止まればいいのに……。: I wish time would just stop...
translations.もっといっぱい好きって言って。: Tell me you love me more.
translations.イヤなんて……言わないから。: I'm not going to say no...
translations.そこの感覚……おかしくなってきたじゃん。: That spot feels all funny now.
translations.しないんだ？ あっそ……。: Not gonna do it？ Oh, fine...
translations.今、キスするモード？: Are we in kissing mode now？
translations.そんな強引じゃなくても……。: No need to be so forceful...
translations.アンタって……しょうがないなぁ。: Honestly... what am I gonna do with you.
translations.いいよ、全然ヘーキ。: Sure, I don't mind at all.
translations.リンコのこと、ちゃんと考えてる？: Are you even thinking about how I feel？
translations.なに？ もっと聞かせて。: What is it？ Let me hear more.
translations.耳に意識、集中しちゃう。: All my focus goes straight to my ears.
translations.あんまり、待たせないでよ？: Don't keep me waiting too long, okay？
translations.キス……してくれるよね？: You're going to... kiss me, right？
translations.このまま……待ってればいい？: Should I just... wait like this？
translations.上手くできるかな？: I wonder if I'll do it right？
translations.どんどん好きになる……。: I'm falling for you more and more...
translations.ラブラブ……ってやつかも。: Maybe this is what they call... lovey-dovey.
translations.アンタだから、いいんだね、きっと。: I bet it's only this good because it's you.
translations.２人の秘密だから。: It's just between the two of us.
translations.んっ……ちょっとびっくりした。: Mm... That surprised me a little.
translations.もうっ……意地悪のつもり？: Geez... Are you trying to tease me？
translations.へへ……リンコがどうしたいか、わかる？: Hehe... Know what I want to do？
translations.ねえ……また近づけたかな？: Hey... Think we got a little closer？
translations.リンコのこと、もっと好きになってくれた？: Do you love me even more now？
translations.また……好きな気持ちが増えちゃった。: I think... I love you even more now.
translations.へへ……意地悪しちゃった。: Hehe... That was a little mean of me.
translations.もっといろいろあるでしょ？: There are other places, aren't there？
translations.違うキスがしたいな。: I want a different kind of kiss.
translations.気分変えよ？: How about a change of pace？
translations.あっ……油断しちゃった: Ah... I let my guard down.
translations.まだ……足りないんだってば。: Come on... that's still not enough.
translations.これで終わりだと思ったら大間違い♪: Big mistake if you think we're done♪
translations.やめちゃダメ……もっとキスして？: Don't stop... Kiss me some more？
translations.このままずーっとキスしてたい……。: I want to keep kissing like this forever...
translations.リンコね、アンタの唇……好き。: You know, I really like... your lips.
translations.どこまで続けんの？: How long are you gonna keep going？
translations.こんなにキスして平気なの？ リンコは……。: Are you okay after kissing this much？ Because I'm...
translations.いろんな感覚が……おかしくなってきちゃった。: My senses... are starting to go crazy.
translations.いっちばん、大好き……。: I love you most of all...
translations.これ以上の幸せあるのかな？: Could I get any happier than this？
translations.大好きって言葉じゃ、足りないね……。: Just saying I love you isn't enough...
translations.リンコたち、愛し合ってるんだね。: We really do love each other, huh.
translations.大好きすぎるんだもん。: I just love you way too much.
translations.アンタしか見えないよ……。: I only have eyes for you...
translations.これ以上って……考えられないね。: I can't imagine anything better than this...
translations.ふぅ……こんなに幸せでいいのかな？: Phew... Am I allowed to be this happy？
translations.もうアンタなしじゃ、生きていけないじゃん。: I can't live without you anymore, you know.
translations.こんなにリンコを好きにさせて……責任とってよ？: Making me fall for you this hard... You'd better take responsibility, okay？
translations.リンコ、もう次のキスのこと考えてる……。: I'm already thinking about our next kiss...
translations.好きだってば。: I really do love you, okay.
translations.ずっとラブラブでいようね。: Let's stay crazy about each other forever.
translations.顔見ればわかるでしょ？ リンコは幸せ。: Can't you tell by looking at me？ I'm happy.
translations.好きだね……キス。: You really like kissing, don't you...
translations.もしかして、キスで頭いっぱい？: Wait, is kissing all you can think about？
translations.元気出てきた♪: I feel a lot better now♪
translations.今度はもっと……。ううん、なんでもない。: Next time, let's do more... No, never mind.
translations.リンコはキス魔じゃないもんっ。: I'm not some kissing fiend, you know.
translations.今度はさ、もっと熱ーいキスしよっか？ へへ。: How about an even hotter kiss next time？ Hehe.
translations.やっぱり、アンタのことが好き……。: I knew it, I really do love you...
translations.こんなキスされたら……怒れないじゃん。: How can I stay mad when you kiss me like that...
translations.リンコ……なに悩んでたんだろう。へへ。: I forgot what I was even worried about. Hehe.
translations.もう、いいけど……。: Geez... I mean, it's fine, but...
translations.べつに……嫌じゃないけど。: It's not like... I hated it, though.
translations.はあ、こんなんで満足しちゃってさ……。: Sigh... Getting satisfied with something like this...
translations.いきなりじゃん……。いいけど……。: That was so sudden... It's fine, though...
translations.いつもこうだと、困るかもだけど。: It might be a problem if you're always like this, though.
translations.ああもう、顔あつい……。: Jeez, my face is so hot...
translations.こっちが断らないからってさ。: Just because I don't say no...
translations.反省しろっつーの。: Think about what you did, seriously.
translations.この前のテスト、イマイチだったんでしょ？ 一緒に勉強したらはかどるかもって思うん: You didn't do so great on the last test, right？ Maybe we'll get more done if we study together... What do you think？
translations.この前のテスト、あんまり良くなかったって言ってたじゃん。今からリンコと一緒に勉強: You said you didn't do too well on the last test, right？ Wanna have a study session with me right now？
translations.前回のテスト、残念だったね……。復習するんなら、今から一緒にどう？: Too bad about that last test... If you're gonna review, how about we do it together right now？
translations.それじゃあ、家で待ってるから用意ができたら来てね。: Alright, I'll be waiting at my place, so come over when you're ready.
translations.オッケー。じゃあ後でリンコの家に集合ね。: Okay. Meet me at my place later, then.
translations.決定。それじゃ、準備ができたらリンコの家に来てね。: It's settled, then. Come over to my place once you're ready.
translations.ふ～ん。ま、リンコはかまわないけどね。: Hmph. Well, I don't really mind.
translations.そう？ だったら別にいいんだけど……。: Really？ Well, if you say so...
translations.部屋の中、あんまりジロジロ見ないでよ？: Don't go staring all around my room, okay？
translations.アンタの部屋よりはキレイだと思うけど。: Though I'm pretty sure it's cleaner than yours.
translations.あんまり部屋中見まわさないでね？: Try not to look around my room too much, okay？
translations.そう言われると、気になるんだけどな……。: When you put it like that, it just makes me curious...
translations.なんの教科にする？: What subject do you want to do？
translations.さてと、どの教科にすんの？: Alright, what subject are we doing？
translations.どの教科を勉強したい？: Which subject do you want to study？
translations.なにそれ……バーカ。: What's that supposed to mean... Idiot.
translations.もう、しつこいなあ。とりあえず、総合でいいでしょ。: Jeez, you're persistent. Let's just do General for now, okay？
translations.まったく……。どうしてもそれがいいわけ？: Seriously... Do you really want that so badly？
translations.はいはい。じゃあ、それでいいから……。: Yeah, yeah. Fine, we'll do that...
translations.しょうがないなぁ……わがままなんだから。: Oh, fine... You always have to have your way.
translations.いいよ。じゃあ、それにしよ。: Sure. Let's go with that, then.
translations.すごいじゃん。これなら心配なさそうだし、お茶でも飲んでちょっと休憩する？: Hey, nice job. Looks like you'll be fine at this rate. Wanna take a little break and have some tea？
translations.じゃ、準備するから待ってて。: Alright, wait here while I go get it ready.
translations.やるじゃん！ これならちょっとくらい休憩しても大丈夫そうだし、お茶にする？: Look at you go! At this rate, a little break shouldn't hurt. Wanna have some tea？
translations.すごーい！ これなら問題なさそうだし、ここらへんでティータイムにしない？: Amazing! You look like you've got this down, so how about a little tea break？
translations.うん。じゃあ準備してくるね。: Okay. I'll go get it ready.
translations.完璧じゃん。じゃあ……なにかご褒美いるかな。: That was perfect. Maybe I should give you a little reward, then...
translations.えっ!? 全問正解じゃん。じゃあ、ご褒美でもあげよっかなぁ。: Huh!？ You got every single one right. Maybe I'll give you a reward, then.
translations.すごい、すごい。全問正解だから、ご褒美あげちゃおっかな？: Wow, that's great. Since you got them all right, maybe I'll give you a reward？
translations.もしかして、疲れてる？ 一度お茶でものんで、気分転換しよっか？: Are you tired or something？ Want to have some tea and clear your head？
translations.やれやれ……調子出ないね。お茶でも飲んでリフレッシュしたほうがいいかも。: Man... you're really off your game. Maybe we should have some tea so you can refresh.
translations.しかたない。準備してくるから、待ってて。: Can't be helped. I'll go get it ready, so wait here.
translations.う～ん……。こういうときはさ、お茶でも飲んで気持ちを切りかえようよ。: Hmm... At times like this, let's just have some tea and reset.
translations.決まり！ じゃあ、急いで準備してくるから。: It's settled! I'll go get it ready right away, then.
translations.ご褒美……どう？ アンタにプレゼントしてもらった服だけど……似合ってる？: So... how's this for a reward？ It's the outfit you gave me... Does it look good on me？

Do you have a habit of only

at me while you're eating.

your mouth.

Look, there's some right by
your mouth.

Oh! Did you get that on your
mouth on purpose？
translations.リンコが取ってあげてもよかったんだけど。:
I wouldn't have minded

translations.へえ、食べさせてくれるんだ？: Oh, you're going to feed me？

To think I'd be getting fed

I feel like people are

Don't stare at my face

Waiting for it might be the

translations.ハァ……こういうのが幸せのひとときだね。: Hah... Moments like this are what happiness is all about.
translations.また、してあげてもいいよ。: I wouldn't mind doing it for you again.
translations.カップルのイベントって感じで……いいかも♪: Feels like a real couple thing... I kind of like it♪

translations.こういうの慣れてないからさ……。: I'm not really used to this...
translations.まったく、しょうがないなぁ。: Jeez, I guess I have no choice.
translations.もういいんじゃない？ 続きはまた今度。: Isn't that enough？ Let's do the rest next time.
translations.いっぱい撮れてよかったよ。: I'm glad I got to take so many.

translations.もっと撮ってもよかったけど。: I wouldn't have minded taking more, though.

translations.このくらいにしとくか。: Guess I'll leave it at that.

translations.リンコ……もう限界かも。: Rinko... might be at her limit.

translations.結構ドキドキしたかも。: That actually got my heart racing a bit.

translations.ちょっと撮りすぎじゃない？: Aren't you taking a bit too many？

translations.ついつい、楽しくって。: Sorry, I was just having too much fun.
translations.あのさ、写真ばっかり撮るのもどうなの。: Look, doing nothing but taking pictures is a bit much.

translations.ちゃんとキレイに撮ってよね？: Make sure I look good, okay？
translations.かわいく撮ってよ？ へへ。: Make me look cute, okay？ Hehe.

translations.写真の出来、気になるかも。: I'm kind of curious how they'll turn out.
translations.ちゃんと写真残しといてよ、これでも楽しみにしてるんだからさ。: Make sure you save the photos, okay？ Believe it or not, I'm looking forward to seeing them.
translations.いつも写真できるの楽しみなんだよね。: I always look forward to seeing how the photos turn out.
translations.どんなふうに仕上がるんだろ？: I wonder how they'll turn out？
translations.二人の思い出、いっぱい残そうね。: Let's capture lots of memories of us together.

translations.これからもどんどん写真増やそうね。: Let's keep taking lots more pictures from now on.
translations.この写真も、あっという間に懐かしくなるのかな？: I wonder if this photo's gonna feel nostalgic before we know it？
translations.ダメ！ 調子乗んなっ。: No way! Don't push your luck.
translations.そんなの撮らせないっつーの。: As if I'd let you take a shot like that.
translations.できるだけキレイに撮ってよ？: Make it look as nice as you can, okay？
translations.かわいく撮れた写真じゃないと、見ないから。: If I don't look cute in it, I'm not looking at it.
translations.できた写真見るとき、ワクワクするんだよねぇ。: It's always exciting looking at the finished photos.
translations.こう見えて、楽しみにしてるんだから。: Believe it or not, I'm actually looking forward to this.
translations.できた写真をふたりで見るのが楽しいんだよね。: It's fun looking through the finished photos together.
translations.どんな写真になるのかな……。: I wonder how the photos will turn out...
translations.ちょっとずつ思い出が増えてくね。: We're making more memories little by little, huh.
translations.これも全部思い出だからさ、大事にしなくちゃ。: All of these are memories too, so we've gotta treasure them.
translations.どこまで思い出増えるかな？: I wonder how many memories we'll end up making？
translations.もっといっぱい思い出残したいなぁ。: I want to make lots more memories like this.

translations.いつもとギャップがある表情っていいかも。: An expression you don't usually see might be nice.

translations.早く上達しないと……。: I need to get better at this soon...

translations.使いこなすの難しいな。: It's tough to get the hang of this.
translations.モデルはいいんだけど……。: The model is great, at least...

It's way more fun
playing together, huh.

Which do you like more,
me or games？

Don't you want to kick
something when you lose？

You know a lot about
games, don't you？

Time really flies when

Hmm, guess I still have
a long way to go, huh？

translations.ハイスコア更新!? ナイスプレイ！: A new high score!? Nice play!
translations.ちょっとくらい構えっつーの！: Pay a little attention to me, will you!

All right, the rest is up

Lose, and you get a
light kick!

Hm？ Want me to switch out
soon？

Whoops... Gotta let you have
some of the glory too.
Wanna switch？
translations.はじめまして、よろしく。:
How do you do？
Nice to meet you.
translations.なになに、嬉しそうな顔しちゃって。:
What's with that happy look
on your face？
translations.初対面って、緊張する。よろしく。:
Meeting new people makes me
nervous. Nice to meet you.
translations.えっと、小早川凛子です。よろしく。:
Um, I'm Rinko Kobayakawa.

translations.別に。……って言ってもバレバレ？:
Not really. ...Or is it
that obvious？
translations.今日のリンコはかなり上機嫌だよ。:
I'm in a pretty good

Hehe, I just feel kind of
happy right now.
translations.可もなく不可もなくってとこ。: Not good, not bad, I'd say.
translations.さあ？ こんなもんでしょ。:
Who knows？ I'm always
like this.
translations.ちょっと……。ううん、やっぱなんでもない。:
Just a little... No, never
mind. It's nothing.

Hey, there's something

Hey, it's not really advice,
but... I'd like to hear
what you think.
translations.遠慮はいいからさ、聞いてよ。:
No need to hold back,
just ask me.

translations.リンコはちょっと違う考えかも。: I might see it a little differently.
translations.そっか。うん、なんか納得。: I see. Yeah, that makes sense.
translations.う～ん……そうなのかなぁ？: Hmm... Is that really how it is？
translations.さあ、よくわかんない。: Who knows. I'm not really sure.
translations.そんなの答えられるはずないじゃん。: There's no way I can answer that.
translations.照れちゃってさ。: Look at you getting all shy.
translations.言いたくないなら別にいいけどね。: You don't have to tell me if you don't want to.
translations.そんな態度とられると、ますます聞きたくなるんだけど。: When you act like that, it just makes me want to hear it even more.

translations.ええっ、これもダメ？: What, I can't talk about this either？

translations.アイツといると、なんか胸がキューッてなるの。わかる？ キューッて感じ。: When I'm with him, my chest gets all tight. You know？ Like my heart's being squeezed.
translations.リンコね、もう壊れちゃったかも知れない。だって、アイツのことしか考えられないんだ: I think I might be broken beyond repair. I literally can't think about anything but him.
translations.リンコとアイツは一心同体みたいな感じ。誰にも邪魔できない……ってね▼: It feels like me and him are two halves of a whole. Nobody can get between us... or something like that▼
translations.ずーっと一緒にいようねって……わざわざ言わなくても、アイツの目を見れば伝わってく: We don't even have to say 'let's stay together forever' out loud... I can tell just by looking into his eyes▼
translations.好き過ぎて、これ以上どうやって表現すればいいのかわかんないんだよね。アイツも同じ: I love him so much, I don't even know how to express it anymore. Apparently he feels the same way, though. Hehe▼
translations.実はケンカ中……。仲直りはしたいんだけど、そう上手くはね。: We're actually in a fight right now... I want to make up, but it's not that easy.
translations.ちょっとケンカしちゃって。仲直りはするつもりだけど、上手くいかなくてさ。: We got into a little fight. I'm planning on making up with him, but it's not going so well.
translations.ケンカ中……。ああもう、なんでこうなっちゃったんだろ？: We're fighting right now... Ugh, how did things end up like this？
translations.まぁ気分転換したらさ、素直になれるかもよ？: Well, maybe a change of pace will help you be more honest with him？
translations.仲直りしたい気持ちってさ、たぶん相手にも伝わってるんじゃないかな。: If you want to make up, I'm sure he can probably tell too.
translations.えっとさ、カレシとのスキンシップってどんな感じ？: Um, so... what's it like getting affectionate with your boyfriend？
translations.ねえ、スキンシップってどう？ なんて言うか……上手くいってる？: Hey, how are things with physical affection？ Like... is that going well？
translations.あのさ、カレシのキスって……上手い？: So, is your boyfriend... a good kisser？
translations.うちはイイ感じ……かも。幸せな気持ちになるから。: Things are pretty good with us... I think. It makes me feel happy.
translations.リンコのカレシね、上手いのかも。自慢じゃないけどさ。: My boyfriend might actually be pretty good at it. Not to brag or anything.
translations.う～ん、どうかな。わかんないってことは、上手くはないのかも。: Hmm, I don't know. If I can't tell, maybe he's not all that good at it.
translations.別にって感じ……。イヤとまでは言わないけどさ。: It's nothing special, really... Not that I dislike it or anything.
translations.あのさ……スキンシップして欲しいときって、こっちからアピールしたほうがいいのかな: Say... when you want some physical affection, do you think it's better to drop a hint？
translations.キス……あんまりしないんだけど、ヘンかな。: We don't really kiss all that much... Is that weird？
translations.最近のデートどう？ 楽しめてる？: How have your dates been lately？ Having fun？
translations.学校帰りに寄り道したりしてさ、結構楽しんでるよ。: We've been stopping by places after school and stuff. I'm having a pretty good time.
translations.まあ、普通のデートを楽しんでるかな。: Well, we're just enjoying normal dates, I guess.
translations.この前さ、すっごく特別な思い出ができたんだぁ。思い出すとまた……へへ。: The other day, we made a really special memory. Just thinking back on it makes me... Hehe.
translations.へへ、アイツん家に行っちゃった。ドキドキしっぱなし。: Hehe, I went over to his place. My heart wouldn't stop pounding.
translations.この前はうちに来てもらったんだよね。なんか、いつもの部屋がちょっと違う風に感じる: I had him come over to my place the other day. Somehow my room feels a little different now.
translations.んー、ドキドキなことがあってさ。へへ……内容はヒミツだけど。: Hmm, something really exciting happened. Hehe... The details are a secret, though.
translations.学校の後だとさ、カレシともっといっぱい一緒にいたいのに！ ……ってストレス溜まん: When it's just after school, don't you get frustrated thinking, 'I wanna spend way more time with him!'？
translations.カレシの部屋に寄って帰ろうかなぁとか、思わない？: Don't you ever feel like stopping by your boyfriend's room on the way home？
translations.なんか特別なイベントがあるときくらいさ、出かけたいって思わない？: Don't you feel like going out at least when there's some kind of special event？
translations.いつものデートもいいけど、そればっかりじゃあね。たまには特別なデートもしたいじゃ: Regular dates are nice and all, but not all the time. You want a special date every now and then, right？
translations.放課後のデートも楽しいと思わない？: Don't you think after-school dates are fun too？
translations.外で会うのもいいけどさ、カレシの家でデートってのもアリじゃない？: Going out is nice, sure, but isn't a date at your boyfriend's place a good option too？
translations.普段のデートがあるからこそ、特別なデートが際立つんだよね。そう思わない？: It's because you have your everyday dates that the special ones really stand out. Don't you think？
translations.いいじゃん！ 特別な思い出できてさ。: That's great! You got to make a special memory.
translations.カレシの家ももちろんいいんだけどさ、休日は２人で出かけたくならない？: Going to your boyfriend's place is nice, of course, but on days off, don't you feel like going out together？
translations.今度はさ、カレシを自分の部屋に招待するってのもいいんじゃない？: Next time, wouldn't it be nice to invite your boyfriend over to your room？
translations.自分の部屋でデートもいいけど、やっぱカレシの部屋にも行きたいよね？: A date in your own room is nice, sure, but you still want to go to your boyfriend's room too, right？
translations.カレシが自分の部屋にいるって思うとさ、なんかドキドキするよね。: Just thinking that your boyfriend's in your room kinda makes your heart race, doesn't it？
translations.デートの後さ、ずっと一緒にいたいって言われたら……とか考えたりしない？ どうする: Do you ever wonder what it'd be like if, after a date, he said he wanted to stay with you forever...？ What would you do？
translations.ん～、そうは思わないかも。: Hmm, I don't really think so.
translations.そう？ リンコはそうでもないなぁ。: Really？ I don't really feel that way.
translations.わかる……。リンコもそう思っちゃうかも。: I get that... I think I'd feel the same way.
translations.ちょっと、そんなこと……。そりゃリンコだって……。: Hey, come on... Well, even I'd...
translations.うーん、まだそこまでは考えないかも……。: Hmm, I don't think I'm thinking that far ahead yet...
translations.ええ!? そんなこと……リンコにはわかんないよ。: What!？ Something like that... I wouldn't know.
translations.あのさ、カレシに手料理なんて作ったりしてる？: Hey, do you ever cook for your boyfriend？
translations.あのさ、手料理の話が聞きたいんだけど。もちろんカレシに作るって意味のね。: Hey, I want to hear about your home cooking. Cooking for your boyfriend, I mean, obviously.
translations.んー、たいしたことはしないけど……朝ご飯作ってあげることは多いかな。: Hmm, I don't make anything fancy, but... I do make him breakfast pretty often, I guess.
translations.そうだなぁ、結構晩ご飯は作りに行ってるかも。: Let's see... I actually go over to make him dinner pretty often.
translations.一緒に家で勉強するとき、手作りのお菓子用意したりね。: Or I'll make homemade snacks for when we study together at home.
translations.やっぱりさ、特別なデートのあとって、料理も張り切って作っちゃうかな。: After a special date, I guess I do end up going all out with the cooking.
translations.リンコはわりと和食を作ることが多いね。: I end up making Japanese food pretty often.
translations.作るのは、洋食が多くなってるかも。: I think I've been making a lot of Western-style food lately.
translations.そうだな……中華を作ることが多い気がする。: Let's see... I feel like I make Chinese food a lot.
translations.ジャンルとかあんまり意識せず作ってるかな。: I don't really think about the type of cuisine when I cook.
translations.郷土料理に興味があって、よく作るかも。各地の味を知るって楽しいじゃん。: I'm into regional dishes, so I make those a lot. It's fun learning what food tastes like in different places.
translations.結構自信のある料理があるんだけどさ、レシピ教えるから作ってみてよ。: There's a dish I'm pretty confident in. I'll give you the recipe, so you should try making it.
translations.料理といえば、前作ったのがカレシに好評でさ。教えるからそっちも作ってみてよ。: Speaking of cooking, something I made a while back was a big hit with my boyfriend. I'll teach you how to make it, so give it a try.
translations.へえ、ありがと。上手くできるかわかんないけど、やってみる。: Oh, thanks. I don't know if it'll turn out well, but I'll give it a shot.
translations.リンコにできるかな？ チャレンジはしてみるよ。: I wonder if I can pull it off？ I'll give it a try, though.
translations.ほんと？ 嬉しい、助かるよ。: Really？ I'm glad. That's a big help.
translations.あのさ……苦手な料理とかって、どうやって克服すればいいと思う？: Hey... How do you think I can get better at making dishes I'm not good at？
translations.ねえ……カレシの好みって、ちゃんと合わせられる？ なんか難しくって……。: Hey... Are you good at matching your boyfriend's tastes？ I'm finding it kind of hard...
translations.ちょっと聞きたいことがあるんだけど……。料理のレパートリーって多いほう？ リンコ: There's something I wanted to ask... Do you know how to make a lot of dishes？ I don't have very many under my belt...
translations.それだったらさ、調味料変えてみたらどう？ それだけで割といい感じになったりするよ: In that case, why not try changing up the seasoning？ Sometimes just doing that makes it turn out pretty good.
translations.まずは数をこなすしかないんじゃないかな……そうすれば自然とさ。: I think you just have to keep making it over and over at first... Then it'll come naturally.
translations.苦手なものこそ、何回も何回もたくさん作って練習すればいいんだよ。カレシもわかって: If you're bad at making something, that's all the more reason to practice making it over and over. I'm sure your boyfriend will understand.
translations.調味料ひとつでも好みがあるからね。カレシ好みの調味料を見つけるのがいいかも。: People have preferences even down to a single seasoning. It might help to figure out which ones your boyfriend likes.
translations.カレシに意見聞いちゃえば？ 遠慮なんて必要ないって。: Why not just ask your boyfriend what he thinks？ There's no need to hold back.
translations.あ、それじゃあリンコの得意なやつ教えてあげるよ。: Oh, then I'll teach you something I'm good at making.
translations.じゃあさ、オススメの料理ひとつ教えるよ。今度試してみて。: Then I'll teach you a dish I recommend. Try making it sometime.
translations.デート中の食事ってどんな感じ？: What's it like when you two eat out on dates？
translations.デートの食事に使えそうな、いい店見つけた？: Have you found any good places to eat on a date？
translations.それがさ……あんまり食事には行かないんだよね。: The thing is... we don't really go out to eat much.
translations.食事はよく行くかな。アイツと食事すると、いつもより美味しく感じるしね。: We go out to eat a lot, I guess. Food tastes better than usual when I'm eating with him.
translations.食事に行くのは行くんだけどさ、あんまり好みが合わないかもって思うんだよね。: We do go out to eat, sure, but I get the feeling our tastes don't really match.
translations.リンコたちって食べ物の好み合うからさ、店選びもアイツに任せておけば大体オッケーな: We have the same taste in food, so if I leave picking the place up to him, it usually works out fine.
translations.食事中は主に会話かな。まあ、楽しいよ。: We mostly just talk while we eat. Well, it's fun.
translations.食事中も楽しいよ。食べさせあいっことかしたりね、へへ。: Eating together is fun, too. We feed each other and stuff. Hehe.
translations.大体いつも同じ店になっちゃうんだよね。二人ともお気に入りだからいいんだけどさ。: We almost always end up going to the same place. We both like it there, though, so I don't mind.
translations.わりといろんなお店に行くかな。そっちの方が楽しいしね。: We go to a bunch of different places, I think. It's more fun that way.
translations.いつの間にかさ、この辺りの店は制覇しちゃってたみたい。: Before we knew it, I think we ended up trying every place around here.
translations.アイツの好きな食べ物とリンコの好みが結構ズレてるんだよね……。: The food he likes and what I like are pretty different...
translations.デートのときさ、写真は撮るほう？: Do you take a lot of pictures when you're on a date？
translations.デートの最中って、やっぱ写真撮ったりする？: Do you guys take pictures while you're out on a date？
translations.カレシに写真撮られるときってさ、普通にしてる？ その……サービスショットとかアリ: When your boyfriend takes your picture, do you just act normal？ Or, um... do you ever do anything a little extra for him？
translations.ときどき写真撮ってる最中にさ、どこまで要求に答えたらいいのか悩むときない？: When he's taking pictures of you, don't you ever wonder how far you should go along with his requests？
translations.アイツは、あんまり写真に興味ないっぽい……。: He doesn't seem all that interested in taking pictures...
translations.アイツって、ほんと写真撮るの好きなんだよね。思い出が増えるのは嬉しいんだけどさ。: He really likes taking pictures. I'm happy we get to make more memories, though.
translations.写真撮るのはいいんだけどさ、腕前はまだまだかな。: I don't mind him taking pictures, but he's still got a lot to learn.
translations.それがさ、アイツって写真撮るのがすごく上手いんだよね。どこで練習したんだろ？: The thing is, he's actually really good at taking pictures. I wonder where he practiced？
translations.写真好きはいいとして……アングルがちょっとね。キワドイっていうか……男ってそうい: It's fine that he likes photography, but... his angles are a little much. Kind of suggestive, I guess... Are all guys like that...？
translations.なんか、すっかりカメラにハマっちゃったらしくてさ。よくわかんないパーツいっぱい持: Seems like he's gotten totally hooked on cameras lately. He had all these parts I don't even recognize.
translations.びっくりなんだけどさ、アイツの写真がコンテストで賞獲ったんだって。まあ被写体は…: Get this, a photo he took actually won a prize in a contest. Well, the subject was... his girlfriend, though.
translations.一応ね、要求には応えるつもりではいるよ。アイツのこと信用してるしね。: I mean, I try to go along with what he asks for. I trust him, after all.
translations.まあ……。アイツが喜ぶなら、ある程度は我慢できるかな。: Well... If it makes him happy, I can put up with it to an extent.
translations.あんまり調子に乗ってきたらさ、キックしてやるよ。: If he gets too carried away, I'll just kick him.
translations.ヘンな写真撮ってあとあと残るのはイヤだもんね。断るときはキッパリ断るのが自分のた: I'd hate for him to take some weird photo and have it stick around forever. Putting your foot down and saying no is for your own good.
translations.アイツさ、エッチな写真撮ろうとしてくるんだよね……。やっぱ怒ったほうがいいかな？: He keeps trying to take naughty pictures of me... Should I be getting mad at him？
translations.いい指輪してるじゃん。: That's a nice ring you've got on.
translations.あのさ。いいね、その髪型。: Hey. I like your hair like that.
translations.へへ。実はさ、アイツからのプレゼントなんだ。: Hehe. It's actually a present from him.
translations.ありがと。まあアイツの好みに合わせて、さ。色変えてみたんだ。: Thanks. Well, I tried changing the color to match his taste.
translations.カレシを喜ばせたいって思うといろいろ頑張っちゃうよね。やっぱさ、かわいいって言っ: When you want to make your boyfriend happy, you end up trying all kinds of things, right？ After all, you want him to say you're cute.
translations.女の子同士でファッションの話ってさ、刺激になっていいよね。: Talking fashion with another girl is great. It's really inspiring.
translations.ん……考えるとしたら、これから徐々にって感じなんじゃないかな？: Hmm... If I do think about it, I guess it'll just be bit by bit from now on？
translations.そりゃあね。このままずっと一緒にいれたらいいなぁとか、漠然とだけど思うよ。もう…: Well, sure. I do vaguely think it'd be nice if we could stay together like this forever. Okay... that's all I'm saying.
translations.将来のことまで頭まわんないよ。ただずっとアイツと一緒にいたいって……そればっかり: I can't even wrap my head around the future yet. All I can think about... is wanting to stay with him forever.
translations.将来のことはわかんないけど……今リンコはアイツが大好きで、たぶんその気持ちはこれ: I don't know what the future holds, but... I can say for sure that I really love him right now, and that feeling probably isn't going to change.
translations.将来を想像してさ、ついニヤけちゃう。アイツも同じ気持ちだといいんだけど……。リン: When I picture our future, I can't help grinning. I hope he feels the same way, though... I'm ready to trust him and follow wherever he leads.
translations.アイツとの将来なんて考えるとさ、なんかもう、冷静でいられないんだよね。頭の中ぐち: Whenever I think about a future with him, I just can't stay calm anymore. My head's a total mess, but the one thing that's always clear is how much I love him...
translations.アイツのいない将来なんて、リンコの中には存在しないよ。だからもう、ずーっと決めて: A future without him doesn't even exist to me. So I've already had my mind made up for a long time—we're staying together.
translations.なんかさ、今日はテンション上がっちゃったね。: Feels like we got pretty carried away today, huh？
translations.なんか、いろいろ考えちゃったよ。: Man, that really got me thinking about a lot of things.
translations.やっぱガールズトークって止まんなくなるよね。: Once you start having girl talk, you really can't stop, huh？
translations.今回はここまでにしよっか。また話そ。: Let's wrap it up here for today. Let's talk again soon.
translations.こっちばっか盛り上がると、お互いのカレシがヤキモチ妬いちゃうからさ。続きはまた今: If we have all the fun by ourselves, our boyfriends are gonna get jealous. Let's save the rest for next time.
translations.時間も時間だし、そろそろ終わろっか。また盛り上がろうよ。: It's getting late, so maybe we should wrap things up. Let's do this again sometime.
translations.もうこんな時間か。今日はこのへんで、おやすみ。: Is it this late already？ Let's call it a night. Goodnight.
translations.当ったり前じゃん。なに？: Of course I do. What is it？
translations.へへ。リンコと話したかった？: Hehe. Did you want to talk to me？
translations.もしもし、●。今、大丈夫？: Hello, it's ●. Is now a good time？
translations.電話うれしい。どうしたの？: I'm glad you called. What's up？
translations.もしもし、●。今、話せる？: Hello, it's ●. Can you talk right now？
translations.●だけど。今いい？: It's ●. Is now a good time？
translations.今日、▲デート場所▲寄って帰らないか？: Want to stop by ▲デート場所▲ on the way home today？
translations.わかった、楽しみだね。: Okay. I'm looking forward to it.
translations.ん～、ちょっとムリかも……。: Hmm, I don't think I can...
translations.都合よくないんだよね……。: That's not really a good time for me...
translations.今日はダメだから……また別の日、誘ってよ。: I can't today... So ask me again another day.
translations.授業サボってさ、今から行っちゃう？ へへ。: Want to skip class and just go right now？ Hehe.
translations.ダメだって。それに楽しみはとっといた方がいいだろ。: We can't do that. Besides, it's better to save the fun for later.
translations.学校帰りの寄り道って、リンコ好きなんだよね。: I really like stopping places on the way home from school.
translations.この前は約束すっぽかされたしね。どうやってお詫びしてもらおっかな？: You stood me up last time, you know. How should I have you make it up to me？
translations.ごめんって。今度は大丈夫！ ちゃんと楽しませるよ。: I'm really sorry. It'll be fine this time! I'll make sure you have fun.
translations.前にすっぽかしたぶん、しっかり穴埋めしてもらうからね。: You'd better make up for standing me up last time.
translations.もう、すっぽかしたりしないでよ？ リンコ、楽しみにしてるんだから。: Don't stand me up again, okay？ I'm really looking forward to it.
translations.ごめん。今度はお詫びも兼ねて、絶対楽しいデートにするから。: I'm sorry. I'll make sure our next date is great to make it up to you.
translations.この前、リンコを放ったらかしにしたこと……しょうがないから、許してあげるよ。: About you leaving me hanging the other day... I guess I'll forgive you.
translations.ごめんな。わざとじゃなかったんだけど……。: Sorry about that. I didn't do it on purpose, though...
translations.前にリンコをほったらかしにしたこと、しょうがないからこれでチャラにしてあげるか。: Oh well. With this, I'll call us even for you ignoring me before.
translations.これで、この間リンコを放ったらかしにしたことも許してあげるよ。しょーがないな。: With this, I'll forgive you for neglecting me the other day, too. Oh well.
translations.よろしく。反省してるからさ。: Thanks. I really did learn my lesson.
translations.最近全然会ってくれなかったからさ……結構、心配だったんだよね。: You haven't come to see me at all lately... I was actually pretty worried.
