translations.最近全然会ってなかったもんね。これ以上会わないでいたらアンタのこと忘れちゃうとこ: We haven't seen each other at all lately. Any longer and I would've forgotten all about you, you know!
translations.ごめん、ごめん。忘れないでくれよ？: Sorry, sorry. Don't forget about me, okay？
translations.よかったぁ。全然会ってくれないから、リンコ……何かしたのかなって。: What a relief. Since you wouldn't see me at all, I wondered if I'd... done something wrong.
translations.あのさ、▲生成選択肢１▲があるんだけど。▲月▲▲日▲、▲デート場所▲行かない？: Hey, there's ▲生成選択肢１▲ coming up. Want to go ▲月▲ ▲日▲, ▲デート場所▲？
translations.やった。それ、行きたかったんだよね。: Nice. I've been wanting to go to that.
translations.いいね。それさ、リンコ興味あるよ。: Sounds good. I'm actually interested in that.
translations.もしかして、リンコが行きたいって知ってた？ へへ。: Did you know I wanted to go to that？ Hehe.
translations.へえ、そういうのあるんだ。まあ、いいけど。: Huh, didn't know they had something like that. Sure, why not.
translations.わかった、いいよ。どんなのか興味あるし。: Okay, sure. I'm curious to see what it's like.
translations.うん、大丈夫。どんな感じなのかな。: Yeah, that works. I wonder what it'll be like.
translations.んー、行けそうにない。残念だけど。: Hmm, doesn't look like I can make it. Too bad, though.
translations.気がのらないから……やめとく。: I'm not really in the mood... so I'll pass.
translations.ごめん……。またなんかあったら誘って。: Sorry... Invite me again if something else comes up.
translations.その日はムリだからさ、別の日じゃダメ？: I can't make it that day. Can we do another day？
translations.どうしよう。なんか、今から楽しくなってきた。: Man, I don't know why, but I'm already starting to get excited.
translations.はは、気が早いな。: Haha, getting a little ahead of yourself, aren't you？
translations.まぁ、決定ってことでいいんじゃない？: Well, I guess that settles it, then？
translations.たぶんその日の授業どうでもよくなっちゃうと思う。アンタのせいってことで。: I probably won't care about class at all that day. I'm blaming you for that.
translations.●？ まあ、楽しみにしてくれるのはうれしいけどな。: ●？ Well, I'm glad you're looking forward to it, anyway.
translations.学校のあとってことか。そういうのもいいかもね。: Right after school, huh. That could be nice, too.
translations.それじゃ、楽しみにしてるから。ちょっと調べとこっかな。: Anyway, I'm looking forward to it. Maybe I'll read up on it a little.
translations.かなり待ち遠しいかも。期待に応えるように。: I think I really can't wait. Make sure you live up to my expectations.
translations.リンコの楽しみ、増やしてくれてありがと。: Thanks for giving me something else to look forward to.
translations.もしもし？ リンコだけど。今、話してもいい？: Hello？ It's Rinko. Is now a good time to talk？
translations.あのさ、今日の帰り……一緒にどっか行かない？: Hey, on the way home today... want to go somewhere together？
translations.今日さ、帰りにどっか寄っていこうよ。: Hey, let's stop somewhere on the way home today.
translations.えっとさ、今日一緒にどこか寄って帰らない？: Um, want to stop somewhere together on the way home today？
translations.それじゃ、あとで。校門のとこで待ってるから。: See you later, then. I'll be waiting by the school gate.
translations.わかった。じゃ、あとでな。: Got it. See you later, then.
translations.それじゃ、放課後に校門のとこで待ち合わせで。: All right, let's meet by the school gate after school.
translations.わかった。じゃ、放課後な。: Got it. See you after school.
translations.やった！ それじゃあ放課後、校門で待ってるからさ。へへ。: Great! I'll be waiting at the school gate after school, then. Hehe.
translations.……ごめん。やっぱ、今回はなしにしよ。: ...Sorry. Let's call it off this time after all.
translations.う～ん、わかった。じゃ、また今度ね。: Hmm... okay. Maybe next time, then.
translations.ごめん！ やっぱり今回はキャンセルで。: Sorry! Let's cancel this time after all.
translations.オッケー。その日で決まりだね。: Okay. It's set for that day, then.
translations.その日はちょっと、ムリなんだよね……。: That day doesn't really work for me...
translations.さっきも会ったのに？ ま……リンコもやぶさかじゃないけど。: Even though we just saw each other？ Well... I wouldn't mind.
translations.そんなにリンコに会いたいんだ？ へへ……いいよ。: You want to see me that badly？ Hehe... sure.
translations.また会いたいんだ？ 別にいいけど。: You want to meet up again？ I don't mind.
translations.さっき会ったばっかじゃん？ しょうがないなぁ。: Didn't we just see each other？ Oh, all right.
translations.さっき会ったばっかりなのに。でも、いいよ。: We just saw each other a little while ago. Still, okay.
translations.だったら、今から▲デート場所▲で。: All right, meet me at ▲デート場所▲ now.
translations.最近会ってなかったから、ちょっと不安だったんだよね。誘ってくれてありがと。じゃ、: We haven't seen each other lately, so I was getting a little worried. Thanks for asking me out. See you soon.
translations.それじゃあ、▲デート場所▲で。: See you at ▲デート場所▲, then.
translations.会おうって言ってくるの久しぶりじゃない？ しょうがないから急いで行ってあげる……: Hasn't it been a while since you asked to meet up？ I guess I'll hurry over for you... Hehe.
translations.じゃあ、▲デート場所▲でな。: All right, see you at ▲デート場所▲.
translations.わかった。なんか……こういうの久しぶりでうれしい。早く会いたいから急いで行くね。: Got it. It's been a while since we did this... I'm happy. I can't wait to see you, so I'll hurry over.
translations.ごめん……。でも、どうしても会いたくてさ。: Sorry... I just really wanted to see you.
translations.あのさ。会いたくないって言ってんの。: Listen. I'm telling you I don't want to see you.
translations.……でも、どうしても会いたくてさ。: ...Still, I really want to see you.
translations.あのさ……リンコ、イヤなんだってば。: Look... I told you I don't want to.
translations.ごめん。そうなんだけど、どうしても会いたいんだよ。: Sorry. I know, I just really want to see you.
translations.行くとは言ってないからね。じゃ。: I didn't say I'd come, okay？ Bye.
translations.……待ってても、ムダかもしれないよ。: ...Waiting might be a waste of time, you know.
translations.それでも、待ってるよ。それじゃ。: I'll still wait for you. See you.
translations.もしもし……リンコ。今から会いたい……。: Hello... It's Rinko. I want to see you right now...
translations.あ、リンコ。今すぐ会いたいんだけど……いいって言って。:
Hey, it's Rinko. I want to
see you right now...
Just say yes.
translations.あの、リンコだけど。えっとね……今すぐ会いたいなぁって思って。……ダメ？:
Um, it's Rinko. So, um...
I was hoping to see you
right now. ...Can we？
translations.待ってるから。すぐ来てよ？ 絶対だよ？:
I'll be waiting. Come right
away, okay？ Promise？
translations.だったら、▲デート場所▲で会おう。:
Then let's meet at
▲デート場所▲.
translations.それでオッケー。急いで来てよね？ 遅れたらほんと怒るから。:
Works for me. Hurry over,
okay？ I'll seriously be mad
if you're late.
translations.じゃあ、▲デート場所▲で会おうか。:
Okay, let's meet at
▲デート場所▲ then.
translations.やったぁ。わがまま言って、ごめんね？ ……へへ。:
Yay. Sorry for being so
selfish, okay？ ...Hehe.
translations.●も会いたいから、いいよ。:
It's fine, ● want to
see you too.
translations.じゃあ、▲時▲に▲デート場所▲でな。:
Okay, let's meet at ▲時▲
at ▲デート場所▲.
translations.わかった、待ってる……。ほんとは今すぐに会いたいんだけどさ。:
Got it, I'll be waiting...
Though I really wanted to
see you right now.
translations.ごめん。●も、待たせないように行くから。じゃ、あとで。:
Sorry. ● won't keep you
waiting. See you later.
translations.よし。じゃあ、▲時▲に▲デート場所▲で。:
Alright. Let's meet at
▲時▲ at ▲デート場所▲, then.
translations.ちゃんと来てよね。少しでも遅れたら蹴るから。:
You better show up. If you're
even a little late, I'll kick
you.
translations.はは。大丈夫だって、それじゃ。:
Haha. Don't worry, I'll be
there. See you.
translations.よし、決まりだな。じゃあ、▲時▲に▲デート場所▲で。:
Alright, it's settled.
Let's meet at ▲時▲ at
▲デート場所▲.
translations.うん、うれしい。リンコのわがまま聞いてくれて、ありがとね。:
Okay, I'm glad. Thanks for
letting me be a little
selfish.
translations.わがままだなんて思わないよ。じゃ、あとでな。:
I don't think you're being
selfish at all. See you later.
translations.ごめん……ちょっとムリなんだ。:
Sorry... I just can't right
now.
translations.ムリなんだよなぁ……ごめん。:
I really can't make it...
Sorry.
translations.どうしても会いたいんだってば！:
Come on, I really want to
see you!
translations.ちょっとムリなんだよな……ごめん。:
I just can't make it...
Sorry.
translations.やだ！ リンコ会いたい。それでも……絶対ムリなの？:
No! I want to see you.
Is there really... no way at
all？
translations.やっぱり、ダメだな……。ごめんな。:
I really can't make it after
all... I'm sorry.
translations.そっか……しょうがないよね、急だし。別にいいよ……気にしないで。:
I see... Guess it can't be
helped, since it's so sudden.
It's fine... Don't worry.
translations.ほんと、ごめんな……。せっかく誘ってくれたのに。:
I'm really sorry... Especially
since you asked me out.
translations.う～ん、どうしてもムリなんだよな……。:
Ugh, there's just no way I
can make it...
translations.あっそ。リンコがこんなにお願いしてもダメなんだ？ ……別にいいけど。バカ！:
Oh, really. Even after I
begged you this much？
...Whatever. Idiot!
translations.ほんと、ごめん。また今度にしような。:
I'm really sorry. Let's make
it another time.
translations.ごめん……どう頑張ってもムリなんだ。: Sorry... There's just no way I can make it work.
translations.そっか……わかった。わがままばっかり言ってごめんね？ リンコ……今回は我慢するよ: I see... Okay. Sorry for being so selfish. I'll... hold back this time.
translations.ほんと、ごめんな？ 誘ってくれてありがとう。また、今度会おう。: I'm really sorry. Thanks for asking me out, though. Let's meet up another time.
translations.あのさ……一応お礼言っとこうかと思って。: Listen... I figured I should probably thank you.
translations.ほら、デート誘ってくれたから。: You know, for asking me out on a date.
translations.そんなの付き合ってるんだし、当たり前のことだろ？: We're dating, aren't we？ That's only natural.
translations.でも、普通のデートとはちょっと違うじゃん。だから……さ。: Still, it's a little different from a regular date. So... yeah.
translations.そっか。喜んでもらえたんなら●もうれしいよ。: I see. Well, if you're happy, then ● am too.
translations.えっとさ、お礼でも言っとこうかなと思って。一応。: Um, I just thought I'd say thank you. Just because.
translations.デート、誘ってくれたじゃん。: You asked me out on a date, didn't you？
translations.だけど、いつもと違って特別って感じがしたからさ。……うれしかったんだよね。: Even so, it felt special compared to usual. ...It made me happy.
translations.そう言ってもらえたら●もうれしいよ。: Hearing you say that, ● am happy too.
translations.デート、誘ってくれたでしょ？ だからさ、ありがとう。: You asked me out on a date, right？ So, thank you.
translations.カレシがカノジョ誘うなんて普通のことだよ。: It's totally normal for a guy to ask his girlfriend out.
translations.でも、今度のデートは普通じゃなくて特別って……リンコは思ったから。うれしいんだよ: Still, this next date feels special to me, not just like any other date... So I'm happy.
translations.ありがとう。●もうれしいから、お礼言っとく。: Thanks. ● feel the same way, so thank you too.
translations.ね、デートまであと何時間かな？: Hey, how many hours left until our date？
translations.まあ、どうでもいいか、そんなこと。: Well, I guess it doesn't really matter.
translations.だって……何時間かわかっても、ドキドキ治まるわけじゃないし。: Because... even if I know how many hours are left, it won't stop my heart from racing.
translations.こんなこと話してたら期待があがっちゃうね。: Talking like this is really getting my hopes up.
translations.（こりゃ、なにがなんでも楽しませなくちゃいけないな）: (Looks like I've gotta make sure she has a good time no matter what.)
translations.今度のデートさ、楽しみだよね。: I'm really looking forward to our next date.
translations.ちょっと特別だしな。: Well, it is a little special.
translations.うん。でも、リンコにとってはアンタと一緒ならどこでも特別なんだけどね。: Yeah. Though for me, anywhere is special as long as I'm with you.
translations.……珍しく素直だな、照れるだろ。: ...You're being unusually honest. You're gonna make me blush.
translations.ねえ？ リンコがデート待ち遠しいのって、ちゃんと伝わってる？: Hey, can you tell how much I can't wait for our date？
translations.それだけはっきり言われたら伝わるって。: When you say it that clearly, yeah, I can tell.
translations.ほんとに？ じゃあ、楽しみにしてるのは伝わってる？: Really？ Then can you tell how much I'm looking forward to it？
translations.待ち遠しいと楽しみって、違うのか？: Is there a difference between not being able to wait and looking forward to it？
translations.こう、ニュアンスがさ。なんとなく。: It's, like, a difference in nuance. Kind of.
translations.デートまでにコンディション整えとかないと。: I've gotta make sure I'm in top shape by our date.
translations.はは、大げさだなぁ。: Haha, aren't you exaggerating a little？
translations.大げさじゃないって。アンタも万全にしといてよ。: I'm not exaggerating. Make sure you're in top shape too.
translations.なにすればいいんだ？: What am I supposed to do？
translations.風邪ひかないように、帰ったらうがいと手洗いをするとか、栄養のあるもの食べるとか、: Stuff like washing your hands and gargling when you get home so you don't catch a cold, eating nutritious food, going to bed early...
translations.（要は、体調管理か……）: (So basically, just taking care of my health...)
translations.それなら●も同感だな。: In that case, ● would have to agree.
translations.この待ちきれなさが、また当日のデートを盛り上げるんだよね。: Not being able to wait like this is what makes the actual date even more exciting, though.
translations.デート当日ってさ、曇りらしいよ。: I heard it's supposed to be cloudy on the day of our date.
translations.まあ、それはそれで。過ごしやすくていいかもよ。: Well, that's fine in its own way. Might make it nice and comfortable out.
translations.ふーん、そんなもんか。ならいいけど。: Hmm, I guess so. Well, if you're fine with it.
translations.天気予報見たらさ、デートの日は雨になってた。: I checked the weather forecast, and it says it's gonna rain on the day of our date.
translations.雨だと、気持ちまでドンヨリしそうでヤなんだよね。: I hate when it rains, 'cause it makes my mood feel all gloomy too.
translations.当日は●たちのパワーに負けて、雨雲もどっか行くんじゃないか？ はは！: Maybe the rain clouds won't stand a chance against the energy you and ● have, and they'll just blow away! Haha!
translations.……本気で言ってんの？ さむっ。: ...Are you being serious？ That's so corny.
translations.明日の用意、もうした？: Did you get ready for tomorrow yet？
translations.まだ、これから。▲小早川＊▲はもうできたのか？: Not yet, I'm about to. Are you all ready, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ううん、まだ。なに準備したらいいんだろ？: No, not yet. What should I even get ready？
translations.明日着る服とか、持ち物とか……かな。: Your clothes for tomorrow, what you're bringing... stuff like that, I guess.
translations.持ってきてもいいけど……まるで遠足だな。ははっ。: You can bring some if you want, but... it makes it sound like a field trip. Haha.
translations.明日、なん時に起きるつもり？: What time are you getting up tomorrow？
translations.さぁ、まだ決めてないけど。: Not sure, I haven't decided yet.
translations.じゃ、リンコが決めてあげる。朝、５時半に起きること！: Then I'll decide for you. Wake up at 5:30 in the morning!
translations.……早すぎるだろ。それにデートは夕方からだぞ？: ...That's way too early. Besides, our date's in the evening, isn't it？
translations.ダメ！ こういうのは気合が大切なんだから。: Too bad! You've gotta put some spirit into this kind of thing.
translations.（気合ねえ、まあ楽しみにしてるってことか）: (Spirit, huh？ Guess that means she's looking forward to it.)
translations.あのさ、ほんとに明日でいいんだよね？ デート。: Hey, it really is tomorrow, right？ Our date.
translations.ずっと、早く早くって思ってたから……いよいよ明日となると信じられなくて。: I've been waiting for it to get here for so long... Now that it's finally tomorrow, I can hardly believe it.
translations.じゃあ明日になったら、なんて思うんだ？: Then what are you gonna think once tomorrow gets here？
translations.ほんとに今日でいいのかな？ ……って思うかも。: I might think, 'Is it really today？'
translations.はは。大丈夫、明日で間違いないから。ちゃんと来いよ。: Haha. Don't worry, it's definitely tomorrow. Make sure you show up.
translations.明日、わかってる？: You know what tomorrow is, right？
translations.もちろん、わかってるよ。デートだろ。: Of course I do. Our date, right？
translations.明日、遅刻したら怒るよ？ すっぽかしなんて、言語道断だからね。: I'll be mad if you're late tomorrow, okay？ And standing me up is completely out of the question.
translations.大丈夫だって。行く前から脅すなよ。: I'll be fine. Don't threaten me before we even go.
translations.楽しみにしてるからね、明日のデート。へへ。: I'm really looking forward to our date tomorrow. Hehe.
translations.今日の約束覚えてるよね？: You remember our plans for today, right？
translations.今日は思いっきり楽しむからね。: I'm gonna have as much fun as I can today.
translations.今日は朝からワクワクしっぱなし。アンタも？: I've been excited all morning. What about you？
translations.次のデートの約束、もっと早い日にすればよかったかも。: Maybe we should've scheduled our next date a little sooner.
translations.早くデートの日になんないかなぁ待ちきれなくてストレスたまるじゃん。: I wish the day of our date would hurry up and get here. Having to wait is stressing me out.
translations.（そのストレス、●には向けないでほしいな）: (● just hope she doesn't take that stress out on me.)
translations.次のデートのこと考えてたらさ、アンタの声聞きたくなっちゃった。: I was thinking about our next date, and I just wanted to hear your voice.
translations.そっか、それならいくらでも。: Oh yeah？ Then we can talk as long as you want.
translations.もしもし……今、何時ですかー？: Hello... What time is it right now？
translations.ごめん！ もうすぐ行くから、待ってて。: Sorry! I'm almost there, so wait for me.
translations.あと５分だけ待ってあげる。: I'll give you five more minutes.
translations.もしもし、リンコだけど。なにが言いたいかわかる？: Hello, it's Rinko. Do you know what I'm calling to say？
translations.ほんと？ 心配しちゃったよ……。待ってるから早く来てね。: Really？ You had me worried... I'll be waiting, so hurry up and get here.
translations.うん、本当にごめん。すぐ行く！: Yeah, I'm really sorry. I'll be right there!
translations.ごめん……言い訳もできないな。: I'm sorry... I don't even have an excuse.
translations.で、どうするの？: So, what are you going to do？
translations.今度埋め合わせするよ: I'll make it up to you next time.
translations.ちょっと、どういうつもり？ リンコをこんなに待たせてタダですむと思ってる？: Hey, what's the big idea？ You think you can make me wait this long and get away with it？
translations.さて、これからどうしたい？: Well then, what do you want to do now？
translations.この埋め合わせはまた今度: I'll make it up to you another time.
translations.あのね……リンコ、ずっと待ってたんだよ？: Listen... I was waiting for you the whole time, you know？
translations.今からどうする？ 待ってようか？ 今度にする？: What are we doing now？ Should I wait, or do this another time？
translations.今度埋め合わせさせて: Let me make it up to you next time.
translations.今からでも構わないかな？: Would it be okay if I came over now？
translations.わかった……。じゃ、リンコももう一度待ち合わせ場所に行くから。: Okay... Then I'll head back to our meeting spot, too.
translations.ありがとう。今度こそ間違いなく行くよ。: Thanks. I'll definitely be there this time.
translations.今からでも、デートしてくれるか？: Will you still go on our date if I come now？
translations.しょうがないなぁ……。じゃあ、さっさと待ち合わせ場所に来ること！ わかった？: Guess I have no choice... Then get to the meeting spot right now! Got it？
translations.今から行くよ。それでもいい？: I'll head over now. Is that okay？
translations.わかった。それじゃ、また待ち合わせ場所で待ってる。: Okay. Then I'll wait for you at the meeting spot again.
translations.ほんとごめんな。すぐ行くから。: I'm really sorry. I'll be right there.
translations.今度、必ず埋め合わせするよ……。: I'll definitely make it up to you next time...
translations.今度こそ……約束だからね。: You'd better... It's a promise, okay？
translations.この埋め合わせは今度必ずするよ。今日はごめん！: I promise I'll make this up to you next time. Sorry about today!
translations.あっそ……わかった。その言葉、忘れないでよね？: Oh, really... Fine. Don't forget you said that, okay？
translations.……今度埋め合わせさせてもらっていいか？: ...Will you let me make it up to you next time？
translations.わかった。残念だけど、また今度ね……。期待してるからさ。: Okay. It's a shame, but next time, then... I'll be counting on it.
translations.今日さ、なんで来なかったの？ 約束忘れてた？: Hey, why didn't you show up today？ Did you forget our promise？
translations.言い訳より“ごめんなさい”が先じゃん。ほら、言ってみ。: Shouldn't "I'm sorry" come before the excuses？ Come on, say it.
translations.はぁ……。しょうがないから今回は見逃してあげる。: Sigh... Fine, I'll let it slide this time.
translations.ありがと。今度は気をつけるよ。: Thanks. I'll be more careful next time.
translations.よく聞こえない。“ごめんなさい”って言った？: I couldn't quite hear you. Did you say "I'm sorry"？
translations.デートすっぽかすとか、信じらんないんだけど。: Standing me up on a date... I really can't believe you.
translations.ごめん……わざとじゃないんだ。: I'm sorry... I didn't do it on purpose.
translations.あっそ。とにかく、心配になるじゃん……。: I see. Still, it makes me worry, you know...
translations.あのさ……リンコ、なんか悪いことした？: Hey... Did I do something wrong？
translations.だって、最近なんか態度がさ。……不安になるじゃん。: Because of how you've been acting lately. ...It makes me uneasy, you know.
translations.そっか……もっと連絡するように気をつけるよ。: I see... I'll make sure to keep in touch more.
translations.そうしてくれたら、不安なくなるかも……。: If you do that, I might not feel so uneasy...
translations.そっか……それじゃ、今から会おうか？: I see... Well then, want to meet up right now？
translations.ああ。▲デート場所▲で待ってるよ。: Yeah. I'll be waiting at ▲デート場所▲.
translations.そんなの気にしすぎだよ。気のせい、気のせい。: You're just overthinking it. It's all in your head.
translations.そうかな？ ……だったらいいんだけど。: You think so？ ...I hope you're right.
translations.●も少しは気をつけるからさ。: ● will try to be a little more careful too.
translations.調子どう？ だいぶ悪いの？: How are you feeling？ Is it really bad？
translations.大丈夫。ちょっと休んでればなんとかなるよ。: I'm okay. I just need to rest for a bit and I'll be fine.
translations.ちゃんと寝てなきゃダメだからね。リンコもさ、お見舞い行くようにするから。: You better make sure you stay in bed. I'll try to come visit you, too.
translations.ああ、心配してくれてありがとう。: Yeah, thanks for worrying about me.
translations.あのさ……大丈夫？ ちょっと心配になったから電話してみた。: Hey... Are you okay？ I got a little worried, so I called to check on you.
translations.ムリしないでさ、ゆっくり休んでよね。: Don't push yourself. Just take it easy and get plenty of rest, okay？
translations.ありがとう。少し元気出たよ。: Thanks. I'm feeling a little better already.
translations.デートさ、楽しかったよね。: Our date was fun, wasn't it？
translations.またデートしようね。いいでしょ？: Let's go out again sometime. Okay？
translations.当たり前だろ。イヤだって言われても誘うかもな。: Of course. I might ask you out even if you say no.
translations.デートどうだった？ 感想言ってみ。: How was the date？ Tell me what you thought.
translations.まずは▲小早川＊▲の感想聞かせてよ。: Tell me what you thought first, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.リンコは……悪くなかった。かなり、悪くなかったかも。: For me... it wasn't bad. Actually, not bad at all.
translations.良かったってことか。●もだよ。: So that means you liked it. ● did too.
translations.楽しかったね、デート。また行きたいな。: That date was fun. I'd like to go again.
translations.はは。気が早いな。: Haha. Getting a little ahead of yourself, aren't you？
translations.リンコね、今すっごく幸せな気分。: You know, I feel really happy right now.
translations.●も同じだよ。▲小早川＊▲のおかげだな。: ● felt the same way. It's all thanks to you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.それはお互い様。とにかくデートが最高だったおかげだね。: Right back at you. Anyway, it's because the date was so great.
translations.ああ。ほんと、いい時間が過ごせたな。: Yeah. We really had a great time.
translations.帰ってから、ずっとドキドキしてるんだけど。: My heart's been racing ever since I got home.
translations.●も。デート、最高だったもんな。: ● feel the same way. That date really was the best.
translations.ほんと、最高に幸せな気分になれたよ。ありがと。: Really, it made me feel so happy. Thanks.
translations.次回はもっといいデートにしような。: Let's make the next date even better.
translations.リンコが今、どんな気持ちか当ててみて。: Try and guess how I'm feeling right now.
translations.ハズレ！ 正解は、すっごく幸せな気持ちでした。最高のデート、ありがとね。: Wrong! The right answer is: super happy. Thanks for the best date.
translations.デートさ、色々準備してくれて、ありがと。: Hey, thanks for getting everything ready for our date.
translations.どういたしまして。楽しんでもらえたみたいで良かったよ。: You're welcome. I'm just glad you enjoyed it.
translations.こんなのが毎日だったら、すごいかも。: If every day were like this, that'd be amazing.
translations.はは。こういうのは、たまにだからいいんだよ。: Haha. This kind of thing is special because it's only once in a while.
translations.わかってるって。それくらい楽しかったってこと！: I know that. I just meant that's how much fun I had!
translations.▲小早川＊▲……。●のほうこそ、ありがとう。: ▲小早川＊▲... ● should be the one thanking you.
translations.あのさ、お礼言おうと思って。: Hey, I just wanted to say thanks.
translations.そっ。デートが特別楽しかったから。: Yeah. Because our date was extra fun.
translations.だったら●も▲小早川＊▲にお礼を言わないとな。: Then ● have to thank you too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ダメ！ リンコが先に言うんだからっ。特別な時間をありがとね……へへ。: No way! I'm saying it first. Thanks for such a special time... Hehe.
translations.（なんか……照れるな）: (Man... That makes me blush a little.)
translations.今回のデートってさ、準備とかいろいろ大変だったんじゃない？: Wasn't it a lot of work getting everything ready for this date？
translations.うーん、まぁそれほどでもないかな。: Hmm, well, it wasn't that big a deal.
translations.かっこつけちゃって……。: Listen to you trying to act cool...
translations.カノジョのためなら、このくらい大したことないってことだよ。: I just mean it's no big deal if I'm doing it for my girlfriend.
translations.へへ……なんかうれしい。おかげで特別な思い出ができたんだもんね。ありがと。: Hehe... That makes me kinda happy. Thanks to you, we made some really special memories. Thanks.
translations.ああ。また、特別な思い出作りに行こうな。: Yeah. Let's go make more special memories sometime.
translations.あのさ、アンタの家でデートって、結構好きかも。: You know, I think I actually really like having dates at your place.
translations.じゃ、いつ行ってもいいように毎日掃除しといてよね。: Then make sure you clean every day so I can come over whenever.
translations.アンタの部屋ってさ、なんか落ち着くよね。: There's something really relaxing about your room, you know.
translations.そう？ じゃ、ずっといていいよ。なんてな！: Really？ Then you can stay forever. Just kidding!
translations.バーカ。そんなことできるわけないじゃん……。: Dummy. You know I can't do that...
translations.楽しかったよ、アンタの家。あのさ、また行ってもいい？: I had fun at your place. Hey, can I come over again sometime？
translations.もちろん。いくらでも来い！: Of course. Come over as much as you want!
translations.……そういう言い方されるとちょっと。: ...When you say it like that, it's a little much.
translations.うちに来た感想でも聞いとこうかな？: So, care to tell me what you thought of my place？
translations.すっかりくつろいじゃったよ。ありがとう。: I made myself right at home. Thanks.
translations.よかった。じゃ、また来てよ。: Good. Then come over again sometime.
translations.今リンコの部屋さ、なんとなくアンタの雰囲気が残ってる気がする。: I feel like there's still a trace of you lingering in my room.
translations.気配っていうか、なんていうか……とにかく、いい感じなの！: More like your presence, or your vibe... Anyway, it feels nice!
translations.いい感じか……へえ。: It feels nice, huh... Good to know.
translations.リンコの家、楽しかった？: Did you have fun at my place？
translations.ああ、楽しかったよ。また行ってもいい？: Yeah, I had a great time. Can I come over again？
translations.もちろん。いつでも！ ……ってわけじゃないけど、基本的には歓迎するからさ。: Of course. Anytime! ...Well, maybe not anytime, but for the most part, you're welcome to.
translations.あのさ、お風呂貸してくれてありがと。: Hey, thanks for letting me use your bath.
translations.ああ。構わないよ。: Sure. I didn't mind at all.
translations.なんか、ちょっとだけドキドキしたかも。: It kind of got my heart racing a little.
translations.デートのときのご飯さ、おいしかった。: The food we had on our date was really good.
translations.そうだな、覚えとく。: Yeah, I'll keep that in mind.
translations.リンコさ、デートで食べた店の味好きなんだけど。: I really liked the food at that place we went to on our date.
translations.へえ、気に入ったか。: Oh yeah？ Glad you liked it.
translations.デートの食事って、結構大事かもね。: Where you eat on a date might actually be pretty important.
translations.そうだな、これからも気を付けるよ。: True. I'll make sure to choose carefully from now on, too.
translations.アンタのこと見直したかも。: I might have to give you a little more credit.
translations.デートで食事した店、ちゃんとリンコの好みにあったチョイスだったからさ。: Because the place you picked for us to eat on our date suited my tastes perfectly.
translations.そっか。当たりだったんだな。: I see. Guess I picked a winner, then.
translations.ねえ、今なにしてんの？: Hey, what are you doing right now？
translations.とりあえず、ボーッとしてたかな。: Just spacing out for now, I guess.
translations.ボーッて、とりあえずするもんなの？: Is spacing out really something you do 'for now'？
translations.言われてみれば、ヘンかもな。: Now that you mention it, that does sound weird.
translations.別に用ってわけじゃないんだけどさ、なにしてんのかなぁと思って。: I didn't really call for any reason in particular. I just wondered what you were up to.
translations.▲小早川＊▲はなにしてんの？: What are you up to, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.言うと思ったよ……。: I knew you were going to say that...
translations.あのさ、今なにしてた？: Hey, what were you up to just now？
translations.えっと……何してたっけ？: Uh... What was I doing again？
translations.うわ、ボケ？ お大事に。: Wow, going senile already？ Get well soon.
translations.あのさ、急にアンタの声が聞きたくなっちゃった。: Hey... I suddenly felt like hearing your voice.
translations.そっか、●も▲小早川＊▲の声が聞きたいと思ってた。: Really？ ● was hoping to hear your voice too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.なんか面白い話ないの？: Got any interesting stories for me？
translations.唐突だな。……急に言われても思いつかないって。: Well, that's sudden. ...I can't just come up with something on the spot.
translations.まあいいや。ほんとはちょっと声が聞きたかっただけだからさ。: Eh, whatever. Really, I just wanted to hear your voice for a bit.
translations.なんだ。でも、今度はなにかネタを用意しとこうかな。: Oh, is that it？ Still, maybe I'll have a story ready for next time.
translations.どうした？ ●、なんかヘンなこと言った？: What's wrong？ Did ● say something weird？
translations.ううん。声が聞けて、うれしくなっただけ。: Nope. I'm just happy I got to hear your voice.
translations.遅くにごめん。まだ起きてた？: Sorry for calling so late. Were you still up？
translations.眠れなくて電話したんだけどさ。アンタの声聞いてたら眠れそうな気がしてきた。: I called because I couldn't sleep. But now that I'm hearing your voice, I feel like I might be able to.
translations.●の声は子守唄の代わりか。はは。: So ● work as a lullaby now, huh？ Haha.
translations.なんか、眠れなくて電話しちゃった。……話しても大丈夫？: I couldn't sleep for some reason, so I ended up calling. ...Is it okay to talk？
translations.いいよ、いくらでも。: Sure, as long as you want.
translations.ありがと。アンタの声って落ち着くんだよね。なんでだろ？: Thanks. Your voice really calms me down. Wonder why？
translations.波長が合う……ってやつか？: Maybe we're just on the same wavelength？
translations.もう少し起きてるかな。▲小早川＊▲は？: I'll probably stay up a little longer. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコもまだ……。寝ようとして目をつむったらアンタが出てきたから電話した。: I'm still up, too... I closed my eyes to go to sleep and you popped into my head, so I called.
translations.寝る前にさ、おやすみでも言おうかと思って。: Just thought I'd say good night before going to bed.
translations.それでわざわざ電話くれたんだ、サンキュ。: You called just for that？ Thanks.
translations.寝る前にはさ、やっぱおやすみの挨拶じゃん？: You gotta say good night before going to bed, right？
translations.おやすみ。ちゃんとリンコの夢を見ること。: Good night. Make sure you dream about me.
translations.はは、プレッシャーだな。おやすみ。: Haha, no pressure or anything. Good night.
translations.あのさ、おやすみって言いたくなっちゃった。: Hey, I just felt like saying good night.
translations.ああ！ リンコが先に言おうと思ったのに。えっと、おやすみ。いい夢見てね……へへ。: Hey! I wanted to say it first. Um, good night. Sweet dreams... hehe.
translations.明日、リンコ委員の当番だったかも。めんどくさい。: I think I have committee duty tomorrow. What a pain.
translations.まあ、そう言うなって。: Come on, don't be like that.
translations.仕事考えたらダルくて眠くなってきた。……おやすみ。: Just thinking about the work is making me tired and sleepy. ...Good night.
translations.ああ、おやすみ。明日頑張れよ。: Yeah, good night. Hang in there tomorrow.
translations.ああ、疲れたぁ。今日はぐっすり眠れそう。: Man, I'm beat. I bet I'll sleep like a log tonight.
translations.そんな疲れるようなことあったのか？: Did something happen to tire you out that much？
translations.いろいろあるの。リンコは多忙だからね。それじゃ、おやすみ。: Just a bunch of stuff. I'm a busy girl, you know. Anyway, good night.
translations.ああ、おやすみ。●も早く寝よう。: Yeah, good night. ● should get to bed soon, too.
translations.リンコはそんな疲れてないよ、若いもん。でも早く寝よっと。おやすみ。: I'm not all that tired. I'm still young, after all. Still, I'm gonna turn in early. Good night.
translations.いっこ上だけどな。ま、いいや。おやすみ。: I'm only a year older than you, though. Oh well. Good night.
translations.大丈夫、声聞いたらバッチリ目が覚めたよ。: I'm fine. Hearing your voice woke me right up.
translations.眠そうな声しちゃってさ。しゃっきとしろっつーの。: Listen to how sleepy you sound. Come on, snap out of it.
translations.う～ん……よし！ 気合で起きるぞ。: Mmm... All right! Time to power through and get up.
translations.おっはよ。もう朝だよ？: Morning. You know it's morning already, right？
translations.うん……もうこんな時間か。: Yeah... Is it this late already？
translations.リンコのモーニングコールどう？ うれしい？: How do you like my wake-up call？ Happy to hear from me？
translations.ああ。いい１日になりそうな気がする。: Yeah. I feel like today's gonna be a good day.
translations.もう朝なんだから、起きてよ？: It's morning already, so get up, okay？
translations.どこが。全然声が寝てるけど？ 電話切ったらそのまま二度寝とかしないでよ。: Yeah, right. You still sound fast asleep. Don't just go back to bed after we hang up.
translations.わかった。ちゃんと起きるって。: Got it. I'll get up for real.
translations.まだ……半分寝てた。: Not quite... I was still half-asleep.
translations.はい、起きて起きて。早起きは３文の得。はい、３文って今ではいくら？: Come on, up you get. They say waking up early earns you three mon. Quick, how much is three mon today？
translations.んー……朝から問題出すのはやめてくれ。: Ugh... Don't quiz me first thing in the morning.
translations.リンコが朝をお知らせするよ。: This is Rinko with your morning announcement.
translations.もう、しっかり起きてよ。リンコのモーニングコール受けておいて寝坊はナシだからね。: Come on, wake up for real. You're not allowed to oversleep after getting a wake-up call from me.
translations.そうだな。起こしてくれてありがと。: You're right. Thanks for waking me up.
translations.最近さ、委員の仕事サボってない？ ちゃんと出てよ。: Haven't you been slacking off on committee duty lately？ Make sure you show up.
translations.そうだっけ……●の当番いつだ？: Have I...？ When am ● on duty next？
translations.ハァ……やっぱりね。いいから来てよ、リンコもいるんだしさ。: *Sigh*... I knew it. Just make sure you come, okay？ I'm there too, after all.
translations.そうだな、わかった。気を付けるよ。: Yeah, got it. I'll be more careful.
translations.じゃ、切るね？ バイバイ。: I'm hanging up now, okay？ Bye.
translations.こんな時間だし、そろそろ切るね。: Look at the time. I should probably hang up now.
translations.もう少し話してたいんだけど……時間も遅いし。それじゃ、またね。バイバイ。: I'd like to talk a little longer, but... it's getting late. Anyway, see you later. Bye.
translations.もっと話してたいけど、もう切らなきゃね。この続きは、また会って話そ？ バイバイ。: I want to keep talking, but I really should hang up. Let's pick this up next time we meet, okay？ Bye.
translations.なに？ リンコ、今怒ってんだけど。: What？ I'm mad at you right now, you know.
translations.●が悪いんだから、当然だろ？ ごめんな。: Of course—● was the one in the wrong. I'm sorry.
translations.……一人で怒ってるリンコがバカみたいじゃん。:
...That makes me feel
stupid for being mad
all by myself.
translations.……しょうがないなぁ。その代わり今度会ったら……まあいいや。とにかく許すからさ。:
...Fine, I guess. Next time
I see you, though... Well,
whatever. I forgive you.
translations.（機嫌直してくれたみたいだな……）:
(Looks like she's in a
better mood now...)
translations.●はお互い様だと思うんだ。:
● think we're both
in the wrong here.
translations.だったら、さっさと仲直りしようぜ。:
Then let's just make up
already.
translations.なにそれ……大人ぶっちゃってさ。:
What's with that...?
Quit acting so grown-up.
translations.そりゃ、●のほうが大人だからな。:
Well, ● happen to be
more grown-up than you.
translations.うるさい、ジジイ。……いいや、わかった、仲直りね。:
Shut up, old man. ...Fine,
whatever. We're good now.
translations.考えたんだけど、●は悪くないだろ？:
Thinking it over, ●
wasn't in the wrong
here, right？
translations.じゃあ、リンコが悪いって言うの？:
So you're saying it's
my fault, then？
translations.そうは言わないけど……●ばっか責められるのも。:
Not saying that, but...
● shouldn't take all
the blame, either.
translations.……まあ、リンコも少しわがままだったかもしれない。:
...Well, I guess I might've
been a little selfish too.
translations.このままケンカしててもしょうがないしさ、仲直りしよう。な？:
There's no point staying
mad at each other, so
let's make up. Okay？
translations.……▲小早川＊▲から着信だ。メッセージ残ってるみたいだな。:
...A missed call from
▲小早川＊▲. Looks like she
left a message.
translations.もしもし、リンコ。えっと今日さ、アンタの誕生日でしょ？:
Hello, it's Rinko. Um,
today's your birthday,
right？
translations.一応おめでと。ほんとは直接言いたかったけど。:
Anyway, happy birthday.
I really wanted to tell
you directly, though.
translations.（覚えててくれたのに、取れなくて悪いことしたな……）:
(She remembered, and I
missed her call. Now I
feel bad...)
translations.リンコだよ。今日はさ、二人にとっての大切な記念日じゃん？:
It's Rinko. Today's an
important anniversary
for us, isn't it？
translations.だから電話したんだけど……まあ、しょうがないか。:
That's why I called,
but... well, I guess it
can't be helped.
translations.（そっか、それでかけてくれたのか……）:
(Right, so that's why
she called me...)
translations.出ないみたいだから、とりあえず残しとく。それじゃ。:
Looks like you're not
picking up, so I'm leaving
a message. Bye.
translations.（わざわざかけてくれたのか。できれば直接聞きたかったな）:
(She called just for that.
I wish I could've heard
it from her directly.)
translations.もしもし、リンコ。……会えないかなと思ったんだけど。……また連絡する。:
Hello, it's Rinko. ...I was
hoping I could see you.
...I'll call again later.
translations.（しまった……せっかくの誘いだったのに）:
(Shoot... I missed my
chance to hang out
with her.)
translations.リンコだけど。せっかく会いたいと思って連絡したのに、なんで留守電なわけ？:
It's Rinko. I called 'cause
I wanted to see you, so why
did I get your voicemail？
translations.（……あとでこっちから誘ったほうがいいかな？）:
(...Maybe I should call
her back and ask her
to hang out？)
translations.えっと、ちょっと、会いたかったんだよね……。でも、忙しいならまた今度でいいや。じ:
Um, I kind of wanted to
see you... If you're busy,
another time's fine. Bye.
translations.（あとで●のほうから連絡入れるかな）:
(Maybe ● should give
her a call later.)
translations.……リンコ。デートの相談がしたかったんだけど……ま、いいや。:
...It's Rinko. I wanted to
talk about our next date,
but... well, never mind.
translations.（あとで連絡したほうがいいか）:
(I should probably call
her back later.)
translations.デート誘おうと思ったのに、出ないし……。:
I was gonna ask you out
on a date, and you didn't
even pick up...
translations.リンコ。今度デートでもどうかなと思って電話したんだけど……。また今度にするね。:
It's Rinko. I called to ask
if you wanted to go on a
date... Maybe next time.
translations.（せっかくの電話だったのに、悪いことしたな）:
(She went out of her way
to call. I feel bad for
missing it.)
translations.もしもし、リンコ。えっと……なにってわけじゃないんだけど、なんとなく。それじゃ。:
Hello, it's Rinko. Um...
No real reason, I just
felt like calling. Bye.
translations.（どうしたんだろ？ あとでこっちからも連絡しとくか）: (I wonder what's up？ I'll get back to her later.)
translations.ふぅん……。まあ、いいけどさ。: Hmm... Well, I guess that's fine.
translations.えぇと……なんて呼べばいいかな……。: Um... What should I call you...？
translations.▲紹介友達名▲。よろしく。: ▲紹介友達名▲. Nice to meet you.
translations.違う？ ……じゃあ、もう一度。: Did I get it wrong？ ...Okay, let's try again.
translations.▲紹介友達名▲。うん、どうも。よろしく。: ▲紹介友達名▲. Yeah, hi. Nice to meet you.
translations.じゃあさ、もうここに、書いて？: Then just write it down here for me, okay？
translations.▲紹介友達名▲。オッケー。よろしく。: ▲紹介友達名▲. Okay. Nice to meet you.
translations.なんか、落ちてます？: Um, is something on the floor？
translations.ちょっと、なに、こんな時……。: Hey, what are you doing at a time like this...？
translations.ん？ なんかついてる？: Hm？ Is something on my face？
translations.あのさ、そんな、見ないでよ……。: Hey, don't stare at me like that...
translations.えっと……そんな、見られると……。: Um... When you stare at me like that...
translations.ちょ、ちょっと近すぎ？: A-Aren't you a little too close？
translations.あれ？ そんな難しかったかな……。:
Huh？ Was it really
that hard...？
translations.ひょっとして、彼のお兄さん、だったり？:
Could you be his older
brother, maybe？
translations.もしかして、彼のお父さん、ですか？:
Could you be his father,
by any chance？
translations.もしかして、彼のお姉さん、ですか？:
Could you be his older
sister, by any chance？
translations.もしかして、彼のお母さん、ですか？:
Could you be his mother,
by any chance？
translations.あれ？ 絶対そうだと思ったのに……。:
Huh？ And here I was
so sure of it...
translations.えっと、カレとはどういうアレですか？:
Um, how are you two...
you know, related？
translations.あの……カレとはどういう感じの、アレ？:
Um... so how do you two
know each other, exactly？
translations.じゃあ、もしかしてお父さん、とか？:
Wait, could you be
his dad, then？
translations.じゃあ、もしかして、弟だったりする？:
Wait, does that make you
his little brother, then？
translations.え、じゃあ、カレの妹ってこと？:
Huh, so does that make
you his little sister？
translations.えと、あの……彼とお付き合いしてます。小早川凛子です。……どうも。:
Um, well... I'm dating him.
I'm Rinko Kobayakawa.
...Nice to meet you.
translations.似てますね……将来こうなるんだ。:
You two look alike...
So this is how he'll
turn out in the future.
translations.えっと、あの、ふつつか者ですが……よろしくお願いします:
Um, well, I know I'm not
much, but... it's very
nice to meet you.
translations.なるほどなるほど……似てますよね？ ククッ。:
I see, I see... You two
do look alike, huh？ Heh.
translations.よろしくお願いします。一度、会ってみたくて、ヘヘ。:
Nice to meet you. I've
been wanting to meet
you at least once. Hehe.
translations.よろしくね。 アタシも弟がいるよ？:
Nice to meet you. I have
a little brother too,
you know.
translations.よろしくね。 お父さんによく似てるね？:
Nice to meet you. You look
a lot like your dad, huh？
translations.どうもどうも。 よろしくね。:
Hey there. Nice to
meet you.
translations.やっぱり！ なんか似てるし！:
I knew it! You two kind
of look alike, after all!
translations.さすがＤＮＡ。すぐわかっちゃった。:
Can't beat DNA. I could
tell right away.
translations.聞きたかったんですけど、家族のスキンシップ、盛んなお家なんですか？:
I've been meaning to ask,
is your family big on
physical affection？
translations.いいじゃん、気に入ってんだもん……。:
Come on, what's wrong with
that？ I like it...
translations.なんか人がいっぱい。賑やかだね。:
There are so many people
around. Pretty lively, huh.
translations.じゃあ、同じ質問。どうですか？:
Then I'll ask the same
thing. How about you？
translations.彼からさ、アタシのこと、聞いてたりする？:
Has he told you anything
about me？
translations.アタシのこと、カレから聞いてたりします？:
Has he mentioned me to you
at all？
translations.ちょっと、緊張しちゃいますね。:
I'm getting a little
nervous here.
translations.こういうのって、初めて？:
Is this your first time
doing something like this？
translations.そっか。なんか、似てるとこあるもんね。:
Gotcha. You two are kind of
alike, after all.
translations.彼、忙しぶってるけど、そういうことか。:
He always acts so busy,
so that's why, huh.
translations.すいません、こんなです。:
Sorry, this is just
what I'm like.
translations.じゃ、よかったね。今日会えて。:
Good thing you got to see
him today, then.
translations.ん？ ……隠してんのかな。:
Huh？ ...Wonder if he's
keeping me a secret.
translations.そ、そうですか。すいません、いきなり。:
O-Oh, I see. Sorry to spring
this on you out of nowhere.
translations.そっか。 がんばれ、リンコ。:
Oh, okay. Hang in there,
Rinko.
translations.そ、そうですか。アタシは、ちょっと……。:
O-Oh, really？ I'm a little
nervous myself...
translations.そうなんだ？ ちょっと安心。:
Oh, really？ That's a little
reassuring.
translations.アタシ達は、まだ、そんなには。:
We haven't been together
all that long yet.
translations.まだ、最近ですけど、はい。:
It's still pretty recent
for us, yes.
translations.もう１年以上かな。早いなぁ。:
Over a year now, I guess.
Time sure flies.
translations.もう１年以上……です。はい。:
It's been over a year
now... Yes.
translations.えっと、どれくらいだろ……けっこう長いかな。:
Um, how long has it been...
Pretty long now, I think.
translations.もう、ずいぶん長いです。はい。:
We've been together quite
a long time now, yes.
translations.えっと……とにかく、いつも一緒に居てくれるから……そういうの、やっぱポイント高い:
Um... Well, he's always with
me... That definitely scores
a lot of points, yeah.
translations.あの……とにかく、いつも一緒に居てくれて……ほら、マメじゃないですか、彼。: Um... Well, he's always there for me... And you know how attentive he is.
translations.う～ん……ほら、あったかいっていうか、まあ優しいっていうか、ヘヘ。: Hmm... Well, he's warm, or I guess kind, you could say. Hehe.
translations.あの、なんていうか、ほら……優しいところ、です。: Um, how should I put it... It's how kind he is.
translations.まあ、ほら、わりとカッコいいじゃん？まあ、そこくらいかな？ へへ。: Well, I mean, he's pretty good-looking, right？ Guess that's about it？ Hehe.
translations.見た目とか。それだけじゃないですけど。ほら、カッコいいじゃないですか、彼。: His looks, for one. Not just that, of course, but... you know how handsome he is.
translations.うん、まあ……アタマいいじゃん？ そういうとこは、やっぱさ、好きかな。: Yeah, well... he's smart, right？ I guess I really like that about him.
translations.それは、その……やっぱりアタマがいいところです。話してて楽しいし。: Well, um... I'd say it's how smart he is. He's fun to talk to, as well.
translations.えぇ？ いや、そういうのは、いいじゃん。パス、パス！: Huh？ Come on, you don't need to know that. Pass, pass!
translations.えぇ？ えっと、そういうのはまた、いずれ……はい。: Oh？ Um, let's save that for another time... Yes.
translations.最近か……あ、料理が上手くなったって、褒められたこと。あれは、ちょっと嬉しかった: Lately, huh... Oh, getting told my cooking's gotten better. That made me kinda happy. I am a girl, after all.
translations.料理がうまいって褒められて。最近は、それが一番うれしかったです。: He complimented my cooking. Lately, that's what made me the happiest.
translations.最近だったら……やっぱり、プレゼントもらったこと。あ、なにかは秘密。へへ。: Lately... I'd have to say getting a present from him. Oh, what it is is a secret. Hehe.
translations.プレゼントをもらって……それが、一番かな、はい。: He gave me a present... I think that would be number one, yes.
translations.嬉しかったこと……う～ん、大切な日に、一緒に居られたことかな……え？ 誰とかは、: Something that made me happy... Hmm, getting to spend an important day together, maybe... Huh？ With who？ Um... I'll pass on that.
translations.やっぱり、大切な日に一緒にいられたこと――あれ、言っていいんだっけ……。: I'd say getting to spend an important day together... Wait, was I allowed to say that...？
translations.最近だったら、やっぱりあれかな、大切な人が誕生日をお祝いしてくれたこと。すごく嬉: Lately, I guess it'd be having someone special celebrate my birthday. That made me really happy.
translations.この間、誕生日に彼、お祝いしてくれて……嬉しかったです。: He celebrated my birthday for me the other day... That made me really happy.
translations.最近嬉しかったこと？ それはやっぱり――いいや、やっぱやめとく。: Something that made me happy lately？ That'd have to be... Never mind, I'll keep it to myself.
translations.最近嬉しかったのはやっぱり――えと、やっぱパスです。ＴＰＯをわきまえて。: What made me happy lately would be... Um, actually, I'll pass. There's a time and a place.
translations.メールかな、やっぱ。あんまり来ないんだもん。くだらないことだとは思うけどさ……な: Texts, I guess. He barely sends me any. I know it's a silly thing to fuss over, but... you know.
translations.彼からのメールがですね、少ないんですよ。ちょっとしかってください。: He doesn't send me very many texts, you see. Please scold him a little for me.
translations.悩みって言えば、う～ん……少ないことかな。……ほら、スキンシップっていうの？そう: If we're talking complaints, hmm... Not getting enough, maybe. ...You know, physical affection？ Touching and stuff like that？
translations.悩みと言えばやっぱりキ――いえ、なんでも……パスです。: If I had to name a complaint, it'd be ki... No, never mind... I'll pass.
translations.食事の好みがさ、合わなくて……そういうのって、ボディブローのように効いてくるよね: Our tastes in food don't really match... Stuff like that really starts to wear on you after a while, you know？
translations.食事の好みがですね、ちょっとあわないんです、彼と。まあ、好き嫌い多いのはアタシで: Our tastes in food don't quite match, you see. Well, I'm the picky eater between the two of us, though...
translations.彼がカメラ買ったんだけどさ、ほら、すぐ撮りたがるわけよ。エッチなアングルで。ハァ: He bought a camera, right？ And of course he immediately wants to take pictures of me. From sleazy angles. *Sigh*... Boys, honestly...
translations.最近彼、カメラ買ったんですけど……ほら、えぇと……やっぱ、いいです。忘れてくださ: He bought a camera recently, and... well, um... Actually, never mind. Please forget I said anything.
translations.悩みって言うとあれなんだけど……彼、下手なんだよね、ほら、キスとか？: I don't know if I'd call it a problem, exactly, but... he's kind of bad at, you know, kissing and stuff？
translations.悩みって言うとあれなんですけど……やめときます。あとで、彼に怒られるんで。: I don't know if I'd call it a complaint, but... I'd better not say. He'll get mad at me later.
translations.悩みは……う～ん、やたら触ってくることとか……嬉しいんだよ？ 嬉しいんだけど……: My complaint is... hmm, how he's always touching me... Look, it makes me happy, okay？ It does, but... sometimes I'm just not in the mood, you know？
translations.つかぬことを聞きますけど、おうちではスキンシップって多いんですか？: This is an odd question to ask, but is your family big on physical affection at home？
translations.悩みって言ったら、そりゃ――やっぱ、いい。パス。危ない危ない。: If we're talking complaints, obviously... Actually, never mind. Pass. That was a close one.
translations.悩みっていうと、やっぱり、やめときます……パスで。: As for complaints, well... I think I'll keep that to myself. Pass.
translations.趣味は……やっぱ本読むことかな。彼と一緒で図書委員だし。あとは、音楽。: My hobbies... Reading, I guess. I'm on the library committee just like him. Other than that, music.
translations.趣味は、読書ですね。アタシも彼と一緒で図書委員です。あとは、音楽です。: My hobby is reading. I'm on the library committee too, just like him. Aside from that, music.
translations.最近、バンドやってて。今はそれにハマり中。あ、彼も一緒。: I've been playing in a band lately. Really into that right now. Oh, he's in it too.
translations.最近、彼と一緒にバンドやってます。: Lately, I've been playing in a band together with him.
translations.趣味？ 最近は料理にハマってるかな。女子っぽいでしょ？食べてくれる人がいると、ね: Hobbies？ I guess I've been really into cooking lately. Pretty girly, huh？ Having someone to cook for makes all the difference. Hehe.
translations.最近はですね、料理にはまってます。彼が食べてくれるんで、張り合いがあって。: Lately, I've been really into cooking. He eats what I make, so it makes it really rewarding.
translations.最近は、あ、写真とか。今のとこ撮られる専門だけど。ちょっと興味あって。: Lately, oh, photography and stuff. Though right now I'm strictly the one getting my picture taken. I'm kinda interested in it, though.
translations.最近、彼の写真に付き合ってます。今のところ撮られてるだけですけど。: Lately, I've been helping him with his photography. Though so far, he's just taking pictures of me.
translations.好きなのは……う～ん、ポテチとか。: What I like... Hmm, potato chips and stuff.
translations.ポテ……えと、ポテト？ を少々……。: Potato ch... Um, potatoes？ Just a little...
translations.最近は、和食かな。なんか、食べること多くて。: Lately, Japanese food, maybe. I've just been eating it a lot.
translations.最近、よく彼と和食を食べます。それで、好きになってきました。: Lately, he and I eat a lot of Japanese food. It's really grown on me.
translations.洋食屋さんメニューっていうの？ああいうの。最近、よく食べてるかな。: Western-style diner food, I guess you'd call it？ Stuff like that. I've been eating it a lot lately.
translations.洋食屋さんメニューみたいなのかな、最近、彼とよくいくお店が好きで。: Western-style diner food, I suppose. I really like this place he and I have been going to lately.
translations.中華。なんかね、最近よく行くから。コレステロールが、ちょっと心配。: Chinese food. We've just been going a lot lately. I'm a little worried about my cholesterol.
translations.最近は中華ですね。なんだか、デートの度に二人で行ってる気が。: Lately, it's Chinese food. I feel like the two of us go every time we have a date.
translations.最近、案外なんでも好きって気がついちゃって。何がってより、誰とが重要っていうか。: Lately I've realized I actually like just about anything. Like it's less about what I'm eating, and more about who I'm with. Hehe.
translations.案外、なんでも好きです。好きな人と一緒だとなんでも美味しいっていうか――あ、いえ: I actually like just about anything. Everything tastes good when I'm with the person I like, or... Ah, never mind...
translations.高校一年、１５です。: First year of high school. I'm 15.
translations.高校一年、１６です。: First year of high school. I'm 16.
translations.この頭？ そんな気になる？: My hair？ Does it bother you that much？
translations.えっと、やっぱ気になります？わたしの髪型？: Um, does my hairstyle really bother you？
translations.やっぱ、変かな……このアタマ。: Does my hair look weird after all...？
translations.そんなに気になります？ この髪。: Does my hair really bother you that much？
translations.なんか、こういうのがいいかなって。: I just figured something like this would be nice.
translations.髪は、大体いつもこんなですけど……。: My hair is usually more or less like this, though...
translations.これは、ほら、彼がやって欲しがるからさ、それで。: Well, you know, he wanted me to wear it like this, so.
translations.一応これ、彼のリクエストで……。: Actually, this was by his request...
translations.彼と相談して、切っちゃったんだけど……変？: I talked it over with him and got it cut... Does it look weird？
translations.彼と相談して、切っちゃったんですけど……おかしいですか？: I talked it over with him and got it cut... Does it look strange？
translations.一応、彼にも聞いて色変えてみたんだけど……あれ、変？: I asked him first before changing the color, though... Wait, is it weird？
translations.彼と相談して、髪染めたんですけど……おかしいですか？: I talked it over with him and dyed my hair... Does it look strange？
translations.ま、まあ、そんな大したもんじゃないけど……。: W-Well, it's nothing that special, though...
translations.いいじゃん別に。好きでやってんだもん。: What does it matter？ I'm doing it because I like it.
translations.ときどき考えちゃうんだけど、彼ってさ、もしかして趣味、悪いと思う？: I wonder about this sometimes, but... do you think he might have bad taste？
translations.ちょっと質問なんですけど、彼、趣味悪いですか？: Just a quick question, but... does he have bad taste？
translations.そっか……うすうすそんな気もしてたんだけど……。: I see... I kind of had a sneaking suspicion myself, though...
translations.だよね、そんなことないよね？よし、信じよう……。: Right？ Of course he doesn't. Okay, I'll trust him...
translations.ん？ やっぱ気になる？ この服。: Hm？ Does this outfit bother you after all？
translations.あれ？ やっぱり気になります、この服？: Oh？ Does this outfit bother you after all？
translations.あ、また……そんなに気になる？ この服？: Oh, again... Does this outfit bother you that much？
translations.えっと……そんなに気になります？ この服？: Um... Does this outfit really bother you that much？
translations.これは、彼が今日着てって言うから……変？:
My boyfriend asked me to
wear it today... Is it weird？
translations.これ、彼のリクエストなんですけど……。:
My boyfriend asked me
to wear this, actually...
translations.これは、彼の趣味っていうか、もらったのなんだけど……。:
I guess it's his taste...
He gave this to me, actually.
translations.これは、彼からもらって、そのプレゼントで……。:
My boyfriend gave this to me
as a present...
translations.彼と女の子の服の趣味とか、話す？:
Do you two ever talk about
what kind of clothes you
like on girls？
translations.彼と女の子の服の趣味のこと、話したりしますか？:
Do you and my boyfriend
ever talk about what kind of
clothes you like on girls？
translations.やっぱ、男ってこういうの好きなのかな……。:
Guess guys really are into
stuff like this, huh...
translations.そっか、なるほどね。じゃあ、まあ、付き合うか。:
I see, got it. Well,
I guess I'll go along with it.
translations.そうなんだ……う～ん、男って複雑……。:
Oh, really...？ Hmm,
guys are complicated...
translations.そっか。アタシたちけっこう、趣味合うかもね？:
I see. Maybe you and I
have pretty similar taste？
translations.へぇ！ じゃ、結構趣味合うかもですね？:
Oh, really! Maybe we have
pretty similar taste, then？
translations.やっぱり、もうちょっと大人っぽい感じの？:
Do you go for something
a little more mature？
translations.もっと、カワイイ感じのが多い？:
Do you usually go for
something a little cuter？
translations.なるほどなるほど、うん、わかる気がする。:
I see, I see. Yeah,
that makes sense to me.
translations.う～ん？ どんなんだろ……。:
Hmm？ I wonder what kind,
then...
translations.アンタってさ、Ａ型だよね？:
Hey, you're blood type A,
right？
translations.アンタってさ、Ｂ型だよね？:
Hey, you're blood type B,
right？
translations.アンタってさ、ＡＢ型だよね？:
Hey, you're blood type AB,
right？
translations.アンタってさ、Ｏ型だよね？:
Hey, you're blood type O,
right？
translations.だよね、まんまだもん！: I knew it! It's so obvious!
translations.うそっ？ 絶対そうだと思ったんだけどな……正解は？:
No way! I was so sure I had
it right... What's the answer？
translations.えっ？ あれ、おかしいな……ちなみに正解は？:
Huh？ That's strange...
What's the right answer, then？
translations.そっか……ちょっと、いやかなり意外……。:
Oh... That's a little—no,
actually pretty surprising...
translations.そうですか……ちょっと意外かもです。:
Really...？ That's a little
surprising, actually.
translations.じゃ、当たってんじゃん！: Hey, then I got it right!
translations.ですよね、うん。当てるの得意なんです。:
I thought so. I'm pretty
good at guessing these.
translations.てことはさ、彼と同じじゃん。知ってた？:
Wait, that means you're the
same as him. Did you know？
translations.彼と同じなんだ、なるほどね。:
Oh, the same as my boyfriend.
I see, that makes sense.
translations.じゃあ、次、アタシは何型だ？:
Okay, my turn.
What blood type am I？
translations.じゃあ、今度は、アタシ、何型でしょう？:
All right, my turn now.
What blood type do you
think I am？
translations.当たりー！ クリエイティブで情熱的なＢ型人間イェーイ！:
Bingo! A creative, passionate
type B, yeah!
translations.当たりー！ やっぱ気が合うと思った！Ｂ型連盟ですね！:
Bingo! I knew we clicked!
We're the Type B Alliance!
translations.ブー！ 正解は、彼と一緒、はた迷惑なB型カップルです。よろしく:
Bzzzt! The answer's type B,
same as him. We're a pesky
type-B couple. Nice to meet ya.
translations.残念、正解は、B型でした。 そう彼と一緒。ちょっとはた迷惑なB型どうしです。:
Too bad, the right answer is
type B. Just like my boyfriend.
We're a pesky type-B pair.
translations.ん？……ちなみに、どのあたりが？:
Hm？ ...Out of curiosity,
what makes you say that？
translations.へぇ……そう見えるんだ。でも、当たってるような気もする。:
Huh... So that's how I come
across. You might not be
wrong, though.
translations.えぇ？ そうかなぁ～納得いかない……。:
What？ Really...？
I don't buy that at all...
translations.まあ、当たってなくもない、かも？:
Well, I guess you're not
totally off the mark, maybe？
translations.因みに正解は、B型でした。 けっこう、わかりやすいと思うんだけど……。:
By the way, the answer was
Type B. I thought it was
pretty obvious, though...
translations.じゃあさ、血液型の相性って信じるほう？:
So, do you believe in
blood type compatibility？
translations.それじゃ、血液型の相性ってあると思います？:
Well then, do you think blood
type compatibility is real？
translations.じゃあさ、自分と相性がいいって思うの何型？:
So, what type do you think
you get along with best？
translations.じゃあ、自分と相性がいい血液型って何型ですか？:
Then which blood type are
you most compatible with？
translations.そうかなぁ、だってインド人はＢ型ばっかなんだよ？:
You think so？ Most people in
India are Type B, you know？
translations.やっぱり、キッチリしてるところが？:
Is it because they're so
neat and organized？
translations.だよね、やっぱ！ でも、B型メンドくさいよね……。:
Right？ I knew it! Though
Type Bs can be a pain...
translations.へぇ……裏表みたいなのが、グッときちゃう、とか？:
Oh... Do you have a thing
for that two-sided nature？
translations.やっぱり、おおらかな感じが？:
Is it because they're so
easygoing and laid-back？
translations.じゃあなんだろ。あ、好きな人が……とか？:
Then I wonder why. Oh, is
someone you like that type？
translations.なんだろ……気になる。:
I wonder why, then...
Now I'm curious.
translations.なんかさ、アンタとは合うのかもね、そういうの。:
Yeah, I feel like that type
might actually suit you.
translations.ちょっと、わかる気がします。:
I feel like I can kind of
understand that.
translations.相性いいんだよね、そういうパターン。:
That combination usually
gets along pretty well.
translations.相性いいんですよね、そういうパターン。:
That combination is supposed
to be a great match, right.
translations.逆にいいのかもね、アンタの場合はそういうのも。:
In your case, that might
actually work out better.
translations.意外にいいのかもですね、そういうのも。:
That might actually be a
surprisingly good match.
translations.じゃあ、血液型的には彼と相性バッチリなんだ。:
So going by blood type, you
and he are a great match.
translations.あ、そっか。血液型診断では彼と相性いまいちだけど。:
Oh, I see. By blood type,
you two aren't a great
match, though.
translations.実際の相性は？ どんなもん？:
What about in real life？
How do you two get along？
translations.だと思った。うん、納得納得。:
I thought so. Yeah, that
makes total sense.
translations.ちょっと確認なんだけど……自分の上の兄弟って、いる？:
Just to check... Do you have
any older siblings？
translations.だよね！すごい下の子っぽいもん。 じゃあ、もしかしてお兄さん、いる？:
I knew it! You totally seem
like a younger sibling. Do
you have an older brother？
translations.だよね！アタシも長女だからさ、なんとなく、わかる。 じゃあ、弟、いる？:
I knew it! I'm the oldest
too, so I can kind of tell.
Got a younger brother, then？
translations.やったー！ 当てるの得意なんだ♪:
Yes! I'm pretty good at
guessing this stuff. ♪
translations.お姉さんだったか……なるほど、言われてみればそうだね。:
An older sister, huh... Now
that you mention it, I can
definitely see that.
translations.やったー！ また当てちゃった。すごいでしょ？:
Yes! I got it right again.
Pretty impressive, huh？
translations.残念。弟がいたらアタシといっしょだなと思って。:
Too bad. If you had a little
brother, we'd be the same.
translations.因みに、アタシには、最近可愛い弟が出来ました。:
By the way, I recently got a
cute little brother myself.
translations.せっかくだから聞いちゃおっかな……。:
Since I've got the chance,
maybe I'll ask something...
translations.彼って、昔からこんな？:
Has he always been
like this？
translations.へぇ……なるほど。意外かも。:
Huh... I see. That's kind of
surprising.
translations.なるほど……わかる気がします。:
I see... I feel like I can
understand that.
translations.彼ってさ、家でもいつも、ドタバタしてんの？:
Is he always running around
making a fuss at home, too？
translations.彼ってお家でもやっぱり、やんちゃ坊主ですか？:
Is he a bit of a rascal
at home, too？
translations.彼ってさ、家でもいつも、ボーっとしてる？:
Does he always space out
at home, too？
translations.彼ってお家でもやっぱり、ふわっ、とした感じなんですか？:
Is he a little spacey
at home, too？
translations.まんまか……だろうと思った。:
So he's the exact same...
I figured as much.
translations.やっぱり……自然体ってことですよね？:
I knew it... So he's just
being himself, then？
translations.そうなの！？ じゃあアタシの前ではもしかして……。:
Really！？ Then when he's
around me, could he be...？
translations.ヘェ！ ちょっと想像つかないかも。:
Oh, really！ That's kind of
hard for me to picture.
translations.アタシの前ではどっちかっていうと、やっぱりボーッとしてるかな？:
Around me, I guess he's
more on the spacey side？
translations.アタシの前ではどっちかっていうと、やっぱりヤンチャな感じかな？:
Around me, I guess he's
more on the rowdy side？
translations.でも、なんだかんだ言って優しいから。:
Still, when it comes down
to it, he's really sweet.
translations.でも、時々ちょっと意地悪で。:
Though he can be a little
mean sometimes.
translations.彼のそういうところが、気に入ってんの……へへ。:
That's what I like
about him... Hehe.
translations.彼のそういうところが、やっぱりアタシは、好き、です。:
That's the part of him
I really... like.
translations.でも、会ってみたら、そうじゃなくて……。:
When we actually met, you
weren't like that at all...
translations.やさしいよね？ ホントは。:
You're actually really
sweet, aren't you？
translations.やさしいんですね。本当は。:
You're actually really
kind, aren't you.
translations.クールだよね？ けっこう。:
You're actually pretty
cool, aren't you？
translations.クールなんですね？ けっこう。:
You're quite the cool type,
aren't you？
translations.ウルサイよね？ あ、いい意味で。:
You're pretty loud, huh？
Oh, in a good way.
translations.面白い人ですよね、実は。:
You're actually a really
funny person, aren't you.
translations.今日は、会えてよかった。:
I'm glad I got to meet you
today.
translations.今日、会えて嬉しかったです。:
I'm really happy I got to
meet you today.
translations.もしかして、彼の弟、とか？:
Wait, are you his little
brother or something？
translations.もしかして、彼の妹、とか？:
Wait, are you his little
sister or something？
translations.え、じゃあ、お兄さんってこと？:
Wait, does that make you
his older brother？
translations.え、じゃあ、お姉さんってこと？:
Wait, does that make you
his older sister？
translations.えっと、顔怖い……。:
Um, you're making a scary
face...
translations.えっと、あの……どこ見てます？:
Um, excuse me...
Where are you looking？
translations.物静かって感じ。: You seem like the quiet type.
translations.なんか、本能に忠実っていうか……。: You're kind of... true to your instincts, I guess...
translations.なんかやらしい。バレてないと思った？: You have a dirty mind. Did you think I wouldn't notice？
translations.なんていうか……好奇心旺盛っていうか。: How do I put it... You're pretty curious, I guess.
translations.なんかじろじろ見てくるね。ヘンなこと考えてない？: You sure stare a lot. You aren't thinking anything weird, are you？
translations.こう、じっと見つめてくるよね。ちょっと緊張するかも。: You really stare right at me. It makes me a little nervous.
translations.スキンシップが好きなわけ？: Do you just like being touchy-feely or something？
translations.スキンシップ過剰、ちょっと配慮がないかも。: Way too touchy-feely. It's a little inconsiderate.
translations.マイペースだね。自分のタイミングで会話してるっていうか。: You really go at your own pace. Like you only talk on your own timing.
translations.マイペース過ぎ。会話にはタイミングってのがあるじゃん。: You're way too in your own world. Timing matters in a conversation, you know.
translations.緊張するタイプ？ もうちょっと話したかったけど。: Are you the nervous type？ I wanted to talk a little more, though.
translations.緊張するタイプなんだ。あんまり話せなかったね。: So you're the nervous type. We didn't get to talk much.
translations.少しだけ、その……。やっぱりいいです。: You're a little bit, um... Never mind.
translations.少しだけ、その、遠慮がない感じが……いいんですけどね。: You seem a little, um, forward... Well, it's fine, though.
translations.いろいろ見てくるから……緊張しました。: You kept looking all over, so... it made me nervous.
translations.いろいろ見てきますよね。かなり緊張しました。: You really look all over, don't you？ It made me pretty nervous.
translations.じっと見つめられるから……緊張しました。: You kept staring right at me, so... it made me nervous.
translations.スキンシップが好きなんですね。: You like physical contact, don't you？
translations.スキンシップがかなり激しいですよね。: You're pretty forward with the touching, aren't you？
translations.ちょっと触りすぎ……じゃないですかね。: Don't you think... you're touching me a little too much？
translations.マイペースな人なんですね。会話のタイミングとか。: You like to go at your own pace, don't you？ With your timing in conversation and all.
translations.マイペースな人ですよね。会話のタイミングとか、かなり。: You really do things at your own pace, don't you？ Especially your timing when we talk.
translations.緊張してましたか？ もうちょっとお話したかったです。: Were you nervous？ I would've liked to talk a little more.
translations.緊張してましたよね。あまり話せませんでしたね。:
You were nervous, right？
We didn't get to talk much.
translations.アンタさ、似てるね。:
Hey, you look a lot like
someone.
translations.あの、似てますね。:
Um, you look a lot like
someone.
translations.今男の人に人気の……。:
That person who's popular
with men right now...
translations.今女の人に人気の……。:
That person who's popular
with women right now...
translations.テレビによく出てる……。:
That person who's always
on TV...
translations.ほら、海外の……。:
You know, that person
from overseas...
translations.ちょっとダメな感じの……。:
That person who's kind of
a mess...
translations.ほんと、そっくりだし。:
Seriously, you look just
like them.
translations.ええ、そっくりですよ。:
Yes, you really look just
like them.
translations.えー、絶対似てるって！:
Come on, you totally look
like them!
translations.そんなことないですよ、似てますって。:
That's not true. You really
do look like them.
translations.えー、似てると思うんだけどな。:
Huh... I really think you
look like them, though.
translations.そうですか。似てると思うんですけど……。:
Really？ I think you look
like them, though...
translations.これからもよろしく。:
Hope we get along from
now on.
translations.ここって初めてだっけ？ なんかワクワクしてきた。: Is this our first time here？ I'm actually getting kind of excited.
translations.ああ。楽しめそうだな。: Yeah. Looks like it'll be fun.
translations.あんまり熱中しすぎるなよ。: Just don't get too carried away.
translations.また来ちゃった。へへ……今日もいっぱい遊びたいな。: Here we are again. Hehe... I wanna play a whole bunch today, too.
translations.ああ。思いっきり楽しもうな。: Yeah. Let's have as much fun as we can.
translations.やっぱアンタも遊び足りなかったんだ？: So you didn't get your fill last time either, huh？
translations.もう、とことん遊んじゃおうよ。: Come on, let's play till we drop.
translations.ノット３０、面白かったぁ。またやろうね。: Not 30 was so much fun. Let's play it again sometime.
translations.ノット３０って、確か必勝法みたいなのがあったよね？: Isn't there some kind of guaranteed way to win at Not 30？
translations.ああ、なんか先に言えばいい数字があったっけな。: Yeah, I think there are certain numbers you want to call out first.
translations.だるまさんがころんだって、この歳になっても面白いもんだね。: Red Light, Green Light is still pretty fun even at our age, huh.
translations.だるまさんがころんだってさ、どんどん前に行くタイプと後ろで待ってるタイプと、性格: You can really see someone's personality in Red Light, Green Light—whether they charge ahead or hang back.
translations.あー、わかるわかる。: Oh, yeah, I totally get that.
translations.ああ、面白かった。誘導だったらリンコのほうが上手いかもね。: Man, that was fun. I might actually be better at giving directions than you.
translations.スイカってさ、一応野菜……なんだよね。リンコはおいしければどっちでもいいんだけど: Watermelons are technically vegetables, right...？ Not that I care either way, as long as they taste good.
translations.はは、言われてみればそうだな。: Haha, now that you mention it, that's true.
translations.マシュマロキャッチ、思ったより難しかったかも。その分熱中できたけどさ。: Catching marshmallows was harder than I thought. That just made me get more into it, though.
translations.マシュマロって、いろんな食べ方があるんだって。あとコラーゲンが入ってて美容にもい: Apparently there are all kinds of ways to eat marshmallows. Plus they have collagen, so they're supposed to be good for your skin.
translations.ダーツって、集中力いるよね。上手くなればなるほどハマるかも！: Darts really takes concentration, huh. I feel like the better you get, the more addictive it is!
translations.うん。●ももっと練習しようかな？: Yeah. Maybe ● should practice more, too？
translations.ダーツっていろんなルールがあるじゃん。やっぱ詳しいほうが楽しいんだろうね。: There are all kinds of rules for darts, right？ It's probably more fun when you actually know them all.
translations.まずは点数計算からだな。大変そうだけど……。: First we'd have to learn how to keep score. Sounds like a lot of work, though...
translations.スピードって、ついついムキになるよね。二人とも、顔が必死だもん。: It's so easy to get super competitive playing Speed. We both had such desperate looks on our faces.
translations.ははは、それだけ面白いんだよな。: Hahaha, that just shows how fun it is.
translations.スピードにもローカルルールってあるじゃん。 ややこしいから統一すればいいのにね。: Speed has house rules too, doesn't it？ It's confusing, so I wish they'd just standardize them.
translations.ああ、ほかのゲームでもそういうことあるよな。: Yeah, that happens with a lot of other games, too.
translations.シャボン玉って、なんでこんなに和むんだろう？: Why is blowing bubbles so relaxing？
translations.子供も大人も、こういうところは一緒だな。: Kids and adults are the same when it comes to stuff like this.
translations.シャボン液作るときに、砂糖入れたりヒアルロン酸入れたりすると割れにくくなるんだっ: They say if you put sugar or hyaluronic acid in bubble solution, the bubbles don't pop as easily.
translations.これってテレビで見てると簡単そうなのに、自分でやってみると難しいね。: This looks so easy on TV, but it's actually pretty hard when you try it yourself.
translations.ハラハラしっぱなしでテンション上がるよな。: It keeps you on the edge of your seat the whole time. Really gets the blood pumping.
translations.このゲーム考えたのって、なんか有名な人らしいよ？ 知ってた？: Apparently some famous person came up with this game. Did you know that？
translations.このゲームってシンプルなのに、なんでこんなにテンション上がっちゃうんだろ。: This game is so simple, so why do I get this worked up over it？
translations.これってさ、カップルでやってるとただイチャイチャしてるだけに見えない？: When a couple plays this, doesn't it look like they're just flirting？
translations.スペースエージェントかぁ、面白かった。しっかり覚えとこっと。: Space Agent, huh... That was fun. I'll have to remember that one.
translations.こういうゲームって、ゲーセンの基本って感じじゃない？: Doesn't a game like this feel like an arcade staple？
translations.家じゃなかなかできないもんな。そうかも。: Yeah, maybe. It's not something you can easily play at home.
translations.パネルを選ぶだけかと思って油断してた。結構頭使うよね。: I let my guard down thinking you just pick panels. It actually takes a lot of thought.
translations.勘と計算と、どっちも必要かもな。: You probably need both intuition and calculation.
translations.上手くパネルをつなげられるとさ、ガッツポーズしたくなるかも。: When you link the panels together just right, it kind of makes you want to pump your fist.
translations.ついチカラ入っちゃうような。: Yeah, you can't help getting really into it.
translations.２択になったとき……迷うよね。: When it comes down to two choices... it's hard to decide.
translations.だな、頭の使いどころだ。: Yeah, that's where you really have to use your head.
translations.ああもう……せっかくジャックポットのチャンスだったのに。: Aw, come on... And we finally had a shot at the jackpot, too.
translations.悔しいな、また頑張ろ。: That's frustrating. Let's try again next time.
translations.ジャックポット獲得の瞬間って快感だよね？ ハマりそう。: The moment you hit the jackpot feels amazing, doesn't it？ I could get hooked on this.
translations.ハラハラして、回転が止まるまでの時間が長く感じたよ。: I was on the edge of my seat. It felt like it took forever to stop spinning.
translations.グランドクロス面白かったよね。なんかもっとコツとかありそうじゃない？: Grand Cross was fun, wasn't it？ Don't you feel like there's some kind of trick to it？
translations.▲小早川＊▲、そういうの見つけるの得意そうだな。: You seem like you'd be good at figuring that stuff out, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ジャックポットチャンスのとき、あんなにドキドキすると思わなかった。: I didn't think my heart would race like that during the Jackpot Chance.
translations.ほんと。ハズレたのは悔しいけどな。: Seriously. Still stings that we missed it, though.
translations.グランドクロスのジャックポットすごかったね！ お祝いムードって感じで興奮した。: The Grand Cross jackpot was amazing! It felt like a real celebration, I got so excited.
translations.ほんと、何回でも味わいたいよ。: Yeah, I could experience that over and over again.
translations.面白かった。フォーチュントリニティってちょっとした旅行気分にならない？: That was fun. Doesn't Fortune Trinity kind of make you feel like you're on a little trip？
translations.色んな世界遺産が見られるもんな。: Yeah, since you get to see all kinds of World Heritage sites.
translations.ジャックポット、絶対いけると思ったのに！: I really thought we had that jackpot for sure!
translations.手に汗握る！ ってやつだったな。: That really had our palms sweating, huh.
translations.フォーチュントリニティのジャックポット、いいじゃん。音に合わせて出てくるメダルの: The Fortune Trinity jackpot is pretty great. I like how the medals dispense in time with the music.
translations.また見たくなるな。: Makes you want to see it again.
translations.アニマロッタのアニマたちって可愛いよね？ リンコはやっぱりネコっぽいのが一番好き: The Anima in Anima Lotta are cute, aren't they？ I think I like the cat-like one best.
translations.ネコっぽいの……どれだっけ？: The cat-like one... Which one was that again？
translations.アニマロッタのジャックポットチャンス、取れると思ったのに。ボールの数もすごかった: I really thought we'd get the Jackpot Chance in Anima Lotta. There were so many balls, too.
translations.光りの演出がきれいだったよな。: The light show was really pretty, though.
translations.アニマロッタのジャックポット、取れてよかった。演出もキレイだったし満足。: I'm glad we got the jackpot in Anima Lotta. The presentation was really pretty, too. I'm satisfied.
translations.よし、また見ような。: Alright, let's get it again sometime.
translations.ジャックポットチャンスって肩にチカラ入っちゃうね。: You really tense up during a Jackpot Chance, huh.
translations.ハズレても演出見てるだけで楽しめるな。: Even when you miss, it's fun just watching the show.
translations.あのジャックポットチャンス、取っておきたかったな……残念。: I really wanted to win that Jackpot Chance... What a shame.
translations.次はきっと大丈夫だって。: I'm sure we'll get it next time.
translations.ジャックポットが決まった瞬間見た？ 嬉しくてさ、夢に出てきそう。: Did you see the exact moment we won the jackpot？ I was so happy, I feel like I'm gonna dream about it.
translations.●も！ しっかり記憶に焼き付いてるよ。: ● will too! It's burned right into my memory.
translations.ジャックポット取るとさ、大声でみんなに自慢したくなるね。: Hitting the jackpot makes you wanna brag to everyone out loud, huh.
translations.ああ。あれはちょっと感動ものだよな。: Yeah. That was honestly kind of moving.
translations.メダルゲームって、ゲーセンならではって感じでリンコは好きかな。: Medal games really have that true arcade feel. I think I like 'em.
translations.●も結構楽しめたよ。: ● had a pretty good time, too.
translations.メダルゲームって結構楽しいかも。格ゲーもいいけどさ、こっちもハマりそう。: Medal games are actually pretty fun. Fighting games are great and all, but I could get hooked on these, too.
translations.ますますゲーセン漬けになりそうだな。: Looks like we're gonna end up spending even more time at the arcade.
translations.大収穫だったね。メダルいっぱい出たし、演出はキラキラで見ごたえあったし。: That was a huge haul. We got tons of medals, and the flashy effects were great to watch.
translations.いつもこんな感じだといいのにな。: Sure wish it went like that every time.
translations.あんまりメダルは出せなかったけど、ゲームは面白かったよね。: We didn't win that many medals, but the game itself was fun, huh.
translations.ああ。あれでメダルがいっぱい出れば文句なしだな。: Yeah. If we'd won a ton of medals too, I'd have zero complaints.
translations.ほんと楽しかったぁ。リンコは満喫したけど、アンタは？: That was seriously fun. I had a blast, anyway. What about you？
translations.なんかもう、夢中になりすぎちゃった。リンコ、ひとりではしゃいでた？: Man, I got way too into that. Was I the only one getting all excited？
translations.そんなことないよ。●も夢中になってたから。: Not at all. ● got totally into it, too.
translations.時間が過ぎるのって、あっという間だよね。もう終わりなんて、やだなぁ。: Time really flies, doesn't it. I hate that it's already over.
translations.ほんと。●ももっと遊んでたいよ。: For real. ● could keep playing a lot longer, too.
translations.もう最高だったよ。ここに住みたいくらい楽しかったなぁ。へへっ。: That was the best. I had so much fun I could practically live here. Heheh.
translations.ああ楽しかった。きっと、アンタと一緒だからこんなに楽しいんだね。: Man, that was fun. I bet it's only this much fun 'cause I'm with you.
translations.はは、嬉しいこと言ってくれるな。: Haha, you sure know how to make a guy happy.
translations.リンコ、やみつきになりそう。また絶対来ようね。: I think I'm getting addicted. We definitely have to come back.
translations.ねえ、次はいつ来る？ なるべく早くね。: Hey, when are we coming back？ Make it as soon as possible, okay.
translations.でも……ちょっと悔しかったなぁ。次は絶対リベンジ！: Still... that was kinda frustrating. Next time, we're getting payback for sure!
translations.だけどこの結果じゃあリンコとしては納得いかないな。: Still, personally, I can't just accept a result like that.
translations.熱くなるのもほどほどに頼むな。: Just try not to get too carried away, okay.
translations.でもな～、あそこでもっと頑張ってれば……。帰ったら研究しよっと。: Still, if I'd just pushed a little harder back there... I'm gonna read up on it when I get home.
translations.さて、スクラッチだ。: All right, time for the scratch card.
translations.シルバーか、ここはキッチリ当てておきたいな。: Silver, huh. I'd really like to hit a winner here.
translations.おっ！ ハズレなしのゴールドスクラッチだ。: Oh! It's a Gold Scratch—every card's a winner.
translations.おおっ、プラチナだ！ 高額狙うぞ。: Whoa, Platinum! Let's go for the big prize.
translations.これは……伝説のプレミア!? なんか神々しいな。: This is... the legendary Premier!? It looks almost divine.
translations.左な気がする……。: I have a feeling it's the left one...
translations.ん～、真ん中があやしい。: Hmm, I've got a hunch about the middle one.
translations.んーっ、わかんない。アンタに任せる！: Ugh, I don't know. I'm leaving it to you!
translations.おおっ！ ▲小早川＊▲の言うこと聞いてよかったよ。: Whoa! I'm glad I listened to ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.よし！ ▲小早川＊▲の思いが伝わったのかもな。: Yes! Guess ▲小早川＊▲'s feelings got through.
translations.あのさ……今日の晩ごはん、\nリンコが作るから家に\n食べにこない？\nムリにと:
Listen... I'm making dinner
tonight. Want to come over
and eat？ You don't have to
force yourself, though.
translations.そんなの、行くに決まってるって。: Come on, of course I'll come.
translations.そう？ へへ……じゃあ学校終わったら先に帰って待ってるから、適当に来てよ。: Really？ Hehe... Then I'll head home after school and wait for you. Come over whenever.
translations.へへ……そう言うと思った。じゃあ準備しとくから、またあとで。: Hehe... I knew you'd say that. I'll get things ready, so see you later.
translations.今日はちょっとムリだな……ごめん。: Today's a bit tough for me... Sorry.
translations.あっそ……なら別にいいんだけどね。: Oh, really... Well, that's fine then.
translations.もしかしてさぁ、リンコの家でご飯食べるのって初めてじゃない？: Wait, isn't this your first time eating at my place？
translations.そうなんだよ。ちょっと緊張するなぁ。: Yeah, it is. I'm kind of nervous.
translations.初めてじゃないんだし、ほらほら。楽にしてくれていいからね。: It's not your first time here, so come on. Just make yourself at home.
translations.今日は、最近覚えた料理を食べてほしくてさ。まあ、出来てからのお楽しみってことで。: Today, I wanted you to try a dish I recently learned. Well, you'll see what it is when it's ready.
translations.一応、メニューは考えてあるんだけど……食べたいのがあるなら言ってくれていいよ？: I do have a menu in mind... but if there's something you want to eat, just say the word, okay？
translations.オッケー。じゃあ、最近覚えた料理作ってみるよ。: Okay. Then I'll try making a dish I learned recently.
translations.オッケー。せっかくだから、アンタの好きそうなの作ってあげる。: Okay. Since you're here, I'll make something I think you'll like.
translations.それじゃあ▲メニュー▲をリクエストしようかな。: Then I think I'll request ▲メニュー▲.
translations.お待たせ。我ながら上手くできたって感じだから、期待しちゃってよ。: Sorry to keep you waiting. It turned out pretty great if I do say so myself, so you're in for a treat.
translations.お待たせ。まあ、食べてみてよ。: Sorry to keep you waiting. Well, give it a try.
translations.ごめん、お待たせ。ちょっと……失敗しちゃったかも。でも食べられるから安心して。: Sorry for the wait. I might've... messed it up a little. Don't worry, though, it's still edible.
translations.ちょっとさ、新しい感じに挑戦してみたんだ。どうかな？: I tried going for something a little new this time. What do you think？
translations.今回は自分なりのアレンジを加えてるんだから。: I put my own spin on it this time.
translations.今日はリンコ流のアレンジを試してみたんだ、へへっ。: I tried doing it Rinko-style today, hehe.
translations.レシピ通りもいいけどさ、個性を出せるようになってこそ一人前だと思うんだよね。どう: Following a recipe is fine, sure, but I think you're only a real cook once you can add your own touch. How is it？
translations.今日の料理はちょっと工夫してるんだ。アンタにその違い、わかるかなぁ。: I did something a little different with today's dish. Wonder if you'll be able to tell.
translations.これさ、味付けにちょっとこだわってみたんだよね。アンタの口に合うかな？: I put some extra thought into the seasoning on this one. Is it to your taste？
translations.和食は自信あるんだよね。まあ、食べればわかるから。: I'm pretty confident when it comes to Japanese food. Well, you'll know once you take a bite.
translations.最近は和食が一番得意かも。アンタの好みと合うかはわかんないけどね。: Japanese food might be my best dish lately. Not sure if it matches your tastes, though.
translations.最近、和食の味付けがいい感じなんだよね。: Lately, I've really been nailing the seasoning on Japanese dishes.
translations.洋食って幅広いけど、リンコはわりと得意なほうかな。: Western food covers a lot of ground, but I think I'm pretty good at it.
translations.最近、洋食作るのは自信あるんだよね。: Lately, I've been feeling pretty confident making Western dishes.
translations.洋食の味付けは任せてよ。アンタの口にも絶対合うって。: Leave the Western seasoning to me. I know you're gonna love it.
translations.中華料理が上手く作れるって結構自慢なんだよね。: Being able to cook good Chinese food is actually something I'm pretty proud of.
translations.リンコ、中華は得意かも。まあ食べてみ？ 自画自賛なんて言わせないから、へへ。: I think Chinese might be my specialty. Go on, try it. You'll see I'm not just bragging, hehe.
translations.最近、中華料理作ると味も油の加減もピタッと決まるんだよねぇ。センスあるのかな？: Lately whenever I make Chinese food, I get the flavor and oil just right. Maybe I have a knack for it？
translations.最近、この手の料理が得意になってきたんだ。いい味出してると思うんだけど？: I've gotten pretty good at this kind of dish lately. I think the flavor came out great, don't you？
translations.こういう料理が得意なカノジョってどう？ へへっ。: What do you think of having a girlfriend who's good at making dishes like this？ Hehe.
translations.最近こんな感じの料理が得意になってさ。アンタも美味しいって言うと思うけど。: I've gotten pretty good at making stuff like this lately. I bet you'll think it's good, too.
translations.リンコにかかれば、どんな料理でもバッチリだから。: With me cooking, any dish is gonna turn out great.
translations.最近、なにを作っても上手くいくんだよね。今日のもきっと美味しいから。: Lately, everything I make has been turning out great. I'm sure today's dish is good, too.
translations.リンコって料理のセンスあるのかなぁ？ 得意な料理は全部ですって言いたい気分……へ: Maybe I've got a knack for cooking？ Makes me feel like saying my specialty is everything... Hehe.
translations.なんか……和食ってムズい。一生懸命作ってるんだけど……なにが足りないんだろ？: Man... Japanese food is tough. I'm trying as hard as I can, too... What's it missing？
translations.ハァ……和食って繊細な料理なんだよね。リンコなりには頑張ったから……食べてみて。: Sigh... Japanese cooking is so delicate. I did the best I could, though... so give it a try.
translations.最近和食が上手く仕上がらないんだよね……。かなり頑張って作ったんだけどなぁ。: My Japanese dishes haven't been turning out right lately... And I worked really hard on this, too.
translations.あのさ……最近、洋食が上手く作れなくて。でも、これ一生懸命作ったんだからね？: Listen... I've been having trouble making Western dishes lately. Still, I worked really hard on this, okay？
translations.洋食って簡単そうに見えて奥が深いね。今日のはたぶん……頑張ったなりの味にはなって: Western cooking looks simple, but there's a lot to it. Today's dish should at least... taste like I put the effort in, I think.
translations.最近、洋食に悩まされるんだよね。今日の料理もさ、一生懸命作ったってのはわかってよ: Western dishes have been giving me a hard time lately. Just know I really gave today's dish my all, okay？
translations.中華って段取り覚えるのが大変でさ……。あっ、だけどどの工程でも愛情はもれなく入っ: Chinese cooking has so many steps to keep track of... Oh, but I made sure to put plenty of love into every single one.
translations.中華の味付けって独特なのあるよね？ だから、この味付けが独特だったとしても……そ: Some Chinese dishes have pretty unique seasoning, right？ So even if this tastes a little unique... we could just say it's not my fault... No？
translations.中華って……うーん、やっぱり難しかった。: Chinese food is... yeah, it really was tough to make.
translations.この料理がなかなか上手く作れなくて……。でも、かなり頑張ったから！: I've been having a hard time getting this dish right... Still, I tried really hard on it!
translations.これ……手を抜いたわけじゃないから。むしろ、いつも以上に気合い入れて作ったんだけ: Just so you know... I didn't cut any corners on this. If anything, I put way more effort into it than usual...
translations.頑張って作ったんだけど……この料理はあんまり自信ないなぁ。: I did my best making it, but... I don't feel too confident about this dish.
translations.最近さ……なに作っても味が決まらないのが悩みなんだけど。どうすればアンタ好みにな: Lately... I've been struggling to get the flavors right no matter what I make. What can I do to make it the way you like？
translations.料理って自信ないなぁ……。誰でも美味しく作れる調味料とか発明されたらいいのに。: I'm really not confident in my cooking... I wish someone would invent a seasoning that makes anything taste good.
translations.なんで料理ってこんなに難しいんだろ……。でも、一生懸命作ったから食べてくれるよね: Why does cooking have to be this hard...？ Still, I worked really hard on it, so you'll eat it, right？
translations.この食器わかる？ アンタにもらった、おそろいのやつだよ。へへっ。: Recognize these dishes？ They're the matching ones you got me. Hehe.
translations.この食器、気に入ってるんだ。別に……おそろいだからってワケじゃないけど。: I really like using these dishes. Not that... it's just because we have matching sets or anything.
translations.あーお腹いっぱい。ごちそうさま！: Man, I'm stuffed. Thanks for the meal!
translations.（なんだろ……妙にいいことが起きそうな予感がする）: (What is this...？ I have a strange feeling something good is about to happen.)
translations.で、どうだった？ わりと自分では自信あるんだけど。: So, how was it？ Personally, I feel pretty good about how it turned out.
translations.じゃあ、感想言ってみ？ 今日のは自信あるんだ、へへ。: Alright, let's hear what you thought. I feel pretty confident about today's dish, hehe.
translations.（よく出来てたんじゃないかな？）: (I'd say it turned out pretty well, didn't it？)
translations.ねえ、感想言ってくれるでしょ？ だって、今日は自信あるもんね。: Hey, you're gonna tell me what you thought, right？ I know I nailed it today.
translations.（まあ……なにも失敗してなかったもんな）: (Well... she didn't mess anything up, at least.)
translations.どうだった？ 美味しかった？: How was it？ Was it good？
translations.ねえ、感想聞いてもいい？: Hey, mind telling me what you thought？
translations.……どうだった？ やっぱ、美味しくないよね。: ...How was it？ Didn't taste very good, did it？
translations.（さすがに、失敗したって顔してるな……）: (She's got 'I messed up' written all over her face...)
translations.……感想言う？ イヤなら別にいいんだけど。: ...Are you gonna tell me what you thought？ You don't have to if you don't want to.
translations.（ここは、正直に言ったほうがいいのかな？）: (Maybe I should just be honest here？)
translations.これじゃ、感想……言いにくいよね？: Makes it kind of hard to say what you thought, huh？
translations.ほんと？ やったぁ！ リンコ、かなり頑張ったもんね。へへっ♪: Really？ Yes! I worked pretty hard on it, you know. Hehe♪
translations.そう？ 良かったぁ。まあまあの自信はあったんだけどね。: Yeah？ Thank goodness. I felt pretty good about how it turned out, though.
translations.えっ、そうなんだ？ ……絶対失敗したと思ってた。拍子抜けかも。: Wait, really？ ...I was sure I messed it up. That's almost anticlimactic.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、一応合格ってことで。: I see. Guess that's a passing grade for now, then.
translations.ふ～ん、ならいいんだけどさ。: Hmm. Well, as long as it was okay.
translations.まあ、普通に美味しかったよ。: Well, it tasted fine to me.
translations.ほんと？ あれでも大丈夫なんだ……へえ。: Really？ Even like that, it's okay with you... Huh.
translations.ちょっと、●の好みじゃなかったかな。: ● don't think it was quite to my taste.
translations.えっ……そうなんだ。上手く出来たと思ったのに……考え直さないとダメか。: Oh... I see. And here I thought it turned out well... Guess I'll have to rethink it.
translations.違う感じの味付けのほうが好きかな……。: I think I'd prefer it seasoned a little differently...
translations.そうなんだ？ じゃあ、今度は違うの勉強しとくから。: Oh, really？ Okay, I'll look into a different way to make it next time.
translations.なんだろ……●の好みでは……ないかな。: How do I put it... ● don't think it's really... to my taste.
translations.……そっか。なんとなくわかってはいたけど。次はもうちょっと上手く作れるように頑張: ...I see. I kind of figured as much, though. I'll try to do a better job next time.
translations.あのさ……アンタは、お弁当じゃない日もあったほうがいい？: Hey... Would you rather have some days where we don't do boxed lunches？
