translations.▲小早川＊▲が大変ならいいんだけど、●はお弁当が好きだな。: You don't have to if it's too much trouble, ▲小早川＊▲, but ● really like your boxed lunches.
translations.ほんとに？ それじゃあ、また作ってくる。: Really？ Okay, then I'll make it again for you.
translations.▲小早川＊▲も大変だろうし、学食でもいいかなとは思うよ。: It must be a lot of work for you too, ▲小早川＊▲, so I think the cafeteria is fine.
translations.そっか。ま、リンコはいいんだけど……学食行くのも楽しいかもね。: I see. Well, I don't mind making it, but... going to the cafeteria could be fun too.
translations.アンタってさ、朝ごはんはいつもどうしてるの？: Hey, what do you usually do for breakfast？
translations.そのときどきで……適当かな。: It depends on the day... I just throw something together.
translations.じゃあさ、今度リンコが作りに行ってあげようか？ イヤならムリにとは言わないけど。: Then want me to come over and make it for you sometime？ I won't force you if you don't want me to, though.
translations.この間の朝ごはんどうだった？ なんだったら……また作りに行こうかと思うんだけど。: How was breakfast the other day？ If you want... I was thinking I could come make it again.
translations.自分で用意しようかな: I think I'll make my own
translations.朝ごはん用意してもらえたら助かるな。: It'd really help me out if you made breakfast.
translations.朝ごはんは……自分で作りたいから。: For breakfast... I kind of want to make it myself.
translations.なんだ……そっか。じゃ、別にいいけどさ。: Oh... I see. Well, that's fine then.
translations.最近さ、お菓子作りにハマってるんだよねぇ。アンタも食べてみたい？: I've really gotten into baking sweets lately. Do you want to try some too？
translations.そりゃあ食べたいよ。: Of course I want to try them.
translations.へへ……オッケー。じゃあ仕方ないから今度作ってあげるよ。: Hehe... Okay. Guess I'll have to make you some next time, then.
translations.あのさ……また晩ご飯作りに行ってもいい？: Hey... Can I come over and make dinner again？
translations.▲小早川＊▲が構わないんなら、よろしく頼むよ。: If you don't mind, ▲小早川＊▲, I'd really appreciate it.
translations.わかった。じゃあ今度作りに行くからさ、それまで楽しみに待っててよ。: Got it. I'll come over and cook for you soon, so look forward to it.
translations.なるべく自分で作りたいから……。: I want to try making my own food as much as I can...
translations.あっそ……。まあ、いいんだけどね。: Oh... Well, that's fine, I guess.
translations.ねむい……この季節、眠くなるなって方が無理だよ。:
So sleepy... It's impossible
not to get drowsy this time
of year.
translations.春だね……それにしても……春だねえ。:
It's spring...
Boy, is it ever spring.
translations.この季節ってさ、なんか見た目もあったかいよね。:
Everything even looks warm
this time of year, huh？
translations.ん、何か春っぽいものってあった？:
Hm？ Did you see anything
spring-like around？
translations.春の花って……何がわかる？:
Spring flowers...
Do you know the names of any？
translations.春といえば、桜でしょ。そんなに長くは咲いてないけど。:
Spring means cherry blossoms,
right？ Even if they don't
stay in bloom very long.
translations.春といえば……なんだろ、チョウチョとかかな。:
Spring makes me think of...
what, butterflies, maybe？
translations.春はもちろん、新じゃがポテチ！ でしょ。:
Spring obviously means
new-crop potato chips! Right？
translations.春は睡眠。いつでもじゃないっつーの。:
Spring is for sleeping.
And no, I don't say that
every season.
translations.あつい、リンコが暑いの嫌いって、知らない？:
It's hot. Don't you know
I hate the heat？
translations.ねえ、のどかわかない？ リンコはかわいたんですけど。:
Hey, aren't you thirsty？
Because I sure am.
translations.これだけ暑いとさ、こう、ゆらゆら～って見えるねよね。空気が。:
When it's this hot, you can
see the air shimmering, huh？
translations.もうなんか、風景もあついね……。ほら、見た感じが。:
Even the scenery feels hot...
You know, just looking at it.
translations.どこかに涼しそうな場所ないかな……。:
Isn't there anywhere cool
around here...？
translations.夏といったら、夕立ち、打ち水……少しでも涼しくなるように、ってね。:
Summer means evening showers,
sprinkling water outside...
Anything to cool off a bit.
translations.夏といったら、夏バテには気をつけましょう。:
Since it's summer, watch out
for the heat getting to you.
translations.夏……夏フェスか……フェスってそんなに興味ないんだよね。:
Summer... Summer festivals,
huh... I'm not really that
into music festivals.
translations.いいねえ、涼しくなって。何着るか考えるのがめんどくさいけど。:
Nice that it's cooled down.
Figuring out what to wear
is a pain, though.
translations.やっぱり出かけるのは涼しくなってからがいいよね。あつい中、外に出るのはナンセンス:
Going out is way better once
it cools down. Going outside
in the heat makes no sense.
translations.春の次に秋がくればいいのにね。:
I wish autumn came right
after spring.
translations.空が高い……って、具体的にどういうこと？:
People say the sky looks high
in autumn... What does that
actually mean？
translations.秋っぽいものって、なんか見える？:
Do you see anything
autumn-like around？
translations.赤とか黄色とか、秋の風景は派手だよね。:
With all the reds and yellows,
autumn scenery is pretty
flashy, huh？
translations.秋はね、落ち葉で転ばないようにしないと。:
In autumn, you've gotta watch
out so you don't slip on
fallen leaves.
translations.秋か……秋だったら、栗が好きかな。:
Autumn, huh... If we're
talking autumn, I like
chestnuts.
translations.秋か……小さい頃、トンボつかまえようとしたよね。:
Autumn, huh... Didn't you try
catching dragonflies when
you were little？
translations.芸術の秋、すなわち音楽の秋、すなわちロックの秋。:
Autumn is for art, which
means it's for music, which
means it's for rock.
translations.さむい……あつさが苦手な分、さむさに強くしてくれればいいのに。:
So cold... Since I hate the
heat so much, I wish I at
least handled the cold better.
translations.うー、さむ……。なんとかして。:
Brrr, it's cold...
Do something about it.
translations.乾燥してて、風が痛い気がするよ……。:
The air's so dry, the wind
almost hurts...
translations.いかにもな冬景色って、そうそうお目にかかれないよね。:
You don't really see a classic
winter landscape all that
often, huh？
translations.こう、今の季節に風景ながめてると……さびしくなったりするわけ？:
When you look at the scenery
this time of year... does it
make you feel lonely or what？
translations.空気が張り詰めてるこの感じは嫌いじゃないんだけど……もっとあったかければね……。:
I don't mind how crisp the
air feels, if only it were
warmer...
translations.冬といえばさ、やっぱりカイロが手放せないよね。:
In the winter, I really can't
do without hand warmers.
translations.冬といったらスキーでしょ、もっと手軽にできればいいのに。:
Winter means skiing, right？
I wish it wasn't such a hassle
to go, though.
translations.冬って、あったかくした部屋でアイス食べたくなるよね。:
Winter makes you wanna eat
ice cream in a nice, warm
room, huh？
translations.ネコリンコはさ、冬はコタツで丸くなるの。:
In winter, Kitty Rinko curls
up under the kotatsu.
translations.ねむい……さすがに寝るかも。: So sleepy... I might actually fall asleep.
translations.早起きは三文の得……さあ、どんな得があるかな。: The early bird catches the worm... Well, let's see what I get out of it.
translations.なんかまだ薄暗い感じ……。: It still feels kind of dim out...
translations.こんな時間に滅多に外出ないからさ、見る物すべてが新鮮って感じ。: I almost never go out this early, so everything looks kind of fresh.
translations.さすがにこの時間だと、ウロウロしてる人も少ないよね。: Makes sense there aren't many people out and about at this hour.
translations.明け方のエンジン音ってさ、なんであんなに響くんだろうね。: Why do car engines always echo so loud at dawn？
translations.起きるのは辛いけどさ、一旦目が覚めちゃうと、朝の空気も気持ちいいかも。: Getting up is rough, but once I'm actually awake, the morning air feels kind of nice.
translations.朝早く起きなきゃいけない仕事はリンコには無理だね。新聞配達とかさ。: I could never do a job where you have to get up early. Like a paper route.
translations.なんだろ。この時間って、空気が淀んでない感じするね。: I don't know what it is, but the air doesn't feel stale at all right now.
translations.せっかく朝から出かけるんだから、その分楽しんで元とらないとね。: Since we bothered coming out this early, we'd better have enough fun to make it worth it.
translations.やっぱりどうしたって、リンコは夜型だね。: No matter how you look at it, I'm definitely a night person.
translations.朝の風景は希望に満ちてるね……なんとなく。: The morning scenery feels so full of hope... sort of.
translations.んー、この時間に活動してる人たちは、眠くないのかな。: Mm, don't the people up and moving at this hour get sleepy？
translations.この太陽の傾きから考えると今は…………何時だろ。: Judging by the angle of the sun, right now it's... wait, what time is it？
translations.ねえ、午後からの天気って変わるのかな。: Hey, do you think the weather's going to change this afternoon？
translations.朝の方が色々はかどるっていうけどさ、なんで？ 眠いだけじゃん。: People say you get more done in the morning, but how？ You're just sleepy.
translations.午前中に済ませなきゃいけないこと……なにかあったっけ。: Something I needed to get done before noon... Was there anything？
translations.あのさ、おなかすいた？ リンコはまあ、ぼちぼち。: Hey, are you hungry？ I'm... getting there, I guess.
translations.昼は眠いね、これはあらがいようのない真理だよ。: Afternoons make you sleepy. That's just an undeniable truth.
translations.昼寝したいね。きっと気持ちいいよ。: I want to take a nap. Bet it'd feel great.
translations.影が短いね。踏めるなら踏んでみ？: Our shadows are so short. Think you can step on mine？ Try it.
translations.ちょっとにぎやかになってきたかな。: It's starting to get a little lively out.
translations.昼は昼寝。他になにかある？: Afternoons are for naps. What else is there？
translations.なんでこの国にはシエスタがないかな……。: Why doesn't this country have siestas...？
translations.昼の最強メニューって何？ 自分にとってそういうの、ない？: What's the ultimate lunch to you？ Don't you have a go-to favorite？
translations.おやつのポテチは……まだいいかな。: I think I'll hold off on my snack chips... for now.
translations.さて……夜は何食べよっかな。: Let's see... What should I have for dinner？
translations.まだまだ……夜になったら、リンコの時間だよ。: The day's just getting started... Once night falls, that's my time.
translations.夕方ってさ、なんでいつ見ても懐かしい感じがするんだろうね。: Why does the evening always feel so nostalgic whenever you look at it？
translations.夕陽か……ううん、見てただけ。: The sunset... No, nothing, I was just watching it.
translations.オレンジ色……よくこんなキレイな色になるもんだよね。: It's so orange... Amazing how the sky turns such a pretty color, isn't it？
translations.へへ……リンコの顔も、夕焼け色？: Hehe... Is my face sunset-colored too？
translations.逢魔時ってやつかな。漢字で書ける？: Guess this is what they call the twilight hour. Know how to write the kanji for it？
translations.カラスが鳴くから……って、小さい頃歌った？: Did you ever sing that song about going home when the crows caw when you were little？
translations.ねえ、あの鳥って何かわかる？ あっ、行っちゃった……。: Hey, do you know what kind of bird that is？ Oh, it flew away...
translations.ようやく夜だね。夜行性の人間が活動始めるよ、リンコみたいな。: It's finally night. Time for nocturnal people to get moving, like me.
translations.夜のデート……それだけで特別感あるよね。: A nighttime date... Just that alone makes it feel special, doesn't it？
translations.素朴な疑問だけど、なんで夜になると帰らなきゃいけないわけ？ 親が言うから、とかお: Honest question, why do we have to go home once it's night？ 'Because our parents say so' is a pretty lame reason, right？
translations.ん、なにか面白いものあった？ リンコは結構夜目がきくんだよ。: Hm, spot something interesting？ I actually have pretty good night vision, you know.
translations.あっ……何か光った気がしたんだけど、気のせいかな。ネコの眼っぽい光。: Oh... I thought I saw something glint just now, or maybe I imagined it. Like a cat's eyes.
translations.んー……普通に考えれば、そろそろ帰る時間なのかな。: Hmm... Normally speaking, I guess it's about time to head home.
translations.男女二人で夜景ながめて……まあ、たまにはベタなのもいいか。: A boy and a girl looking out at the night view... Well, a little cliche isn't bad once in a while.
translations.今日の晩御飯なにかなー。: I wonder what's for dinner tonight.
translations.へへ、まだ一緒にいられるって、結構すごいよね。: Hehe, being able to stay together this late is pretty great, isn't it？
translations.もしかして、眠い？ まだまだ！ ……ほんとに眠かったら、無理しないでよ？: Are you sleepy？ The night's still young! ...Though if you're really tired, don't push yourself, okay？
translations.へへ、リンコはぜんぜん眠くないよ。: Hehe, I'm not sleepy at all.
translations.へえー、星、結構見えるね。: Oh, you can actually see a lot of stars.
translations.さすがに真っ暗か……なんか取り残されてる感覚。: Pretty pitch black out now... Makes me feel like we've been left behind.
translations.あのさ、怖かったら、リンコにくっついてもいいんだけど？: Hey, if you're scared, you can stick close to me, you know？
translations.さすがにちょっと寒いかな……。: Okay, it's definitely getting a little cold...
translations.静かだねえ……。なんか大声出したくなる。: It's so quiet... Kind of makes me want to yell out loud.
translations.あれ、何か動いた？ おどかしてるわけじゃないっつーの。: Huh, did something just move？ Come on, I'm not trying to scare you.
translations.夜食のポテチ、いっとく？: Up for some late-night potato chips？
translations.こんな時間に一緒にいるのってさ……なんでもない。: Being together at an hour like this... Never mind.
translations.まだ眠くないんだ……やるじゃん。: Still not sleepy, huh... Not bad.
translations.んー……そろそろ眠くなってきたかも。: Mm... I might be getting sleepy now.
translations.この時間だと、何も見えないかな……。: I guess you can't really see anything at this hour...
translations.あっ、幽霊！ ……まあ、お約束ってことで。: Oh, a ghost! ...Well, had to get the classic joke out of the way.
translations.んー、あとどれくらいで明るくなるのかな。: Hmm, I wonder how much longer until it gets light out.
translations.ねえ、寒くない？ リンコはちょっと。: Hey, aren't you cold？ I'm a little chilly.
translations.この時間って、なんか神経が研ぎ澄まされるね……ビシ！ なんつって。: Being up this late kind of sharpens your senses, doesn't it... Zap! Just kidding.
translations.今、リンコたち以外は誰も起きてないよね……。: Nobody else is awake right now except the two of us, huh...
translations.夜ポテチ……は、まあいっか。: Late-night chips... Actually, maybe I'll pass.
translations.いいお天気ですね。無難な挨拶シリーズ。: Nice weather we're having. From my 'safe small talk' series.
translations.うんうん。太陽もリンコたちを祝福してるね。: Yep, yep. Even the sun's giving us its blessing.
translations.キレイに晴れたね……てるてる坊主とか作ってたりして？: It cleared up nicely... What, did you make a weather charm or something？
translations.空が青いね、青春だね！: The sky's so blue. Nothing says youth like this!
translations.曇っちゃったか。デートには影響ないでしょ。: Clouded over, huh. Shouldn't get in the way of our date, though.
translations.これくら曇ってる方が、むしろいいのかな。: Honestly, it might actually be nicer when it's this overcast.
translations.どよーんって感じ。まあ、気分まで落ち込んでもしかたないね。: Sky's looking pretty gloomy. Well, no point letting it drag our mood down too.
translations.雲出てるね、雨にならないといいけど。: Lots of clouds out. Hope it doesn't turn into rain.
translations.曇ってると、今が何時か……とかあいまいにならない？: When it's overcast like this, doesn't it get hard to tell what time of day it is？
translations.雨のデートって、どうなの？ 楽しみようはあるよね。: How do you feel about dates in the rain？ There are still ways to enjoy them, right？
translations.んー……雨男？: Hmm... Are you a rain magnet？
translations.雨の日の床ってすべりやすくってさ……転ばないようにしなきゃ。: Floors get so slippery on rainy days... Gotta be careful not to fall.
translations.この調子だと……やみそうにないかな。: At this rate... I don't think it's going to let up.
translations.降ってる降ってる。今日は最後まで雨なのかな。: It's really coming down. Wonder if it's gonna rain the whole day.
translations.雪が降るとは思わなかったなー。: I didn't think it was going to snow.
translations.少しくらいの雪ならさ、傘ささなくても大丈夫だよね。: If it's just a little snow, we don't really need an umbrella, right？
translations.ほらほら、面白い転び方してみ。: Come on, try falling in a funny way.
translations.雪景色か……うん、悪くないね。: A snowy landscape, huh... Yeah, not bad.
translations.この調子だと……どうかな、明日も雪残ってるかな。: At this rate... I wonder if the snow will still be here tomorrow.
translations.ちょっと、リンコ飛ばされそうなんですけど……。: Hey, I'm about to get blown away here...
translations.ほら、ぼさっと立ってないで。風よけ風よけ。: Come on, don't just stand there spacing out. Be my windbreak.
translations.上空も風強いんだね……ほら、雲が速い。: The wind must be strong up high, too... Look how fast the clouds are moving.
translations.風強い。ねえ……何か飛んでこないよね。: It's so windy. Hey... Nothing's gonna come flying at us, right？
translations.ちょっとちょっと、雷鳴ってるじゃん。: Hey, wait a second, that's thunder.
translations.雷。近くに落ちたり……しないよね。: Thunder. It's not going to strike nearby... is it？
translations.きゃー、雷こわーい！ って抱きつくと、ポイントアップ？: If I go, "Eek, thunder is so scary!" and cling to you, do I get bonus points？
translations.あ、稲光！ サンダー！ って感じ。: Oh, a flash of lightning! Gives off real "Thunder!" vibes.
translations.雷落ちる瞬間って結構好きかも。フラッシュみたいになるの。: I think I actually kinda like the moment lightning strikes. How it lights up like a flash.
translations.ここ、結構楽しいじゃん。期待以上かも。: This place is actually pretty fun. Better than I expected.
translations.いいね、ここ。やっぱりデートは楽しくなくっちゃね。: I like this place. A date's gotta be fun, after all.
translations.ここさ、何目的だったの？ なんか楽しいことある？: So, what did we come here for？ Is there something fun to do？
translations.楽しいスポット選びはデートの基本、って感じ？: Picking a fun spot is Dating 101, huh？
translations.ん、なになに？ なんか楽しそうな物あった？: Hm, what is it？ Did you find something fun？
translations.へへ、ちゃんと楽しんでるからさ、安心しなって。: Hehe, don't worry, I'm having a good time.
translations.あれ、もしかしてリンコだけ楽しんじゃってる？ ほら、アンタも。: Wait, am I the only one having fun here？ Come on, you too.
translations.リンコを気にせず、楽しんじゃってもいいけど。: You don't have to worry about me. Just go ahead and have fun.
translations.ほらほら、ちゃんと楽しまなきゃ。: Come on, you've gotta enjoy yourself too.
translations.ん～、このペースで遊んでたらバテちゃうかも。: Hmm, if we keep going at this pace, I might wear myself out.
translations.ほらほら、見てみなって。: Hey, come on, take a look.
translations.今日も一緒に来られてよかったよ。: I'm glad we could come here together today, too.
translations.リンコと一緒だと、どこでも楽しい。: Anywhere is fun when you're with me.
translations.へへ、そんな風に思ってる？: Hehe, is that what you're thinking？
translations.へへ、だってさ、今日楽しいもん♪: Hehe, well, today's been really fun♪
translations.ここ落ち着く……ゆっくりしてこ。: It's nice and calming here... Let's take it easy.
translations.いいとこじゃん……安心する。: Nice spot... It really puts me at ease.
translations.静かでいいね……ナントカ波、出てそう。: It's nice and quiet... Like it's giving off those whatchamacallit waves.
translations.落ち着く場所だね……はあ。: This place is really calming... Ahh.
translations.ここにいると、のーんびりし過ぎちゃうかも。: Being here, I might end up getting way too relaxed.
translations.ねむ…………ああ、ううん。退屈じゃなくてさ、なんか和んじゃって。: So sleepy... Oh, no, I'm not bored or anything. It's just so soothing.
translations.どう、くつろいでますか？ おじいちゃん。: So, are you feeling nice and relaxed, Grandpa？
translations.んー……ストレスも一気に解消できそうな感じ。: Mmm... Feels like all my stress could just melt away at once.
translations.疲れた現代人の心を癒してくれる……って感じ。: It's like... the kind of thing that heals the weary modern soul.
translations.へへ、安心しきった顔しちゃってさ。: Hehe, look at you, completely at ease.
translations.なんでだろ、妙に落ち着く。: I don't know why, but this is weirdly calming.
translations.なにがこんなに安心させるんだろ、雰囲気？: What makes it feel so comforting, I wonder？ The atmosphere？
translations.これさ、なんかパワーあるね。落ち着くもん。: This thing's got some kind of power to it. It really calms me down.
translations.リンコがこんなに落ち着けるのってさ……。: You know, the only place I can relax this much...
translations.やっぱりアンタの隣だけかも、へへ。: ...might just be right next to you. Hehe.
translations.こういう落ち着いたデートも、たまにはいいかもね。: A quiet, laid-back date like this is nice every once in a while.
translations.あんまり落ち着きすぎると、老けちゃいそうだけど。: Though if we get too settled down, we might start feeling old.
translations.ふたりなら、どこでも行けそう。: Feels like the two of us could go anywhere.
translations.だってさ、アンタがいれば、どこでも安心だもん。: 'Cause as long as you're there, I feel safe anywhere.
translations.はあ……いいとこだね……。: Ahh... This is a really nice place...
translations.ヘンな感覚……ここ、幸せ感じちゃうかも。: What a weird feeling... Just being here makes me feel happy.
translations.へへ、リンコは今ハッピーだよ。: Hehe, I'm feeling pretty happy right now.
translations.わかるよ。アンタの気持ちも、伝わってきてるからさ。: I can tell how you feel, too. It's coming right through to me.
translations.はあ、不思議と満たされる感じする。: Ahh, it's strange, I feel so fulfilled right now.
translations.気のせいかな……なんだか、いい気分になる。: Maybe it's just me... but this puts me in a really good mood.
translations.言いたくなっただけ、いいでしょ、別に。: I just felt like saying it. That's allowed, isn't it？
translations.ん、なんとなく、幸せだなって。: Mm, I just thought... I'm really happy right now.
translations.ここで眠りたいくらいだよ、落ち着く。: It's so peaceful here, I could almost fall asleep.
translations.ここさ、リラックスできるね……。: You can really relax here, huh...
translations.ん～……ここならゆっくりできるね。: Mmm... We can really take our time here.
translations.ね、リラックスできる場所だよね。: It's a really relaxing spot, isn't it？
translations.ん……あ、今リンコ、ゆるい顔してた？: Mm... Oh, was I making a totally spaced-out face just now？
translations.ちゃんとリラックスできてる？: Are you managing to relax okay？
translations.今くらいはさ、面倒なこと忘れよ。: Let's just forget about all the annoying stuff for now.
translations.癒された顔しちゃって。そんなに疲れてたわけ？: You look totally soothed. Were you really that worn out？
translations.これ、なんで落ち着くのかな。: I wonder why this feels so calming.
translations.リラックスできる感じする。……どこらへんが？: It feels kind of relaxing. ...Wait, what part of it？
translations.ねえ、アンタもリラックスできそう？: Hey, think you can relax here too？
translations.ほら、アンタもん～……ってしてみ。: Come on, you try going "Mmm..." too.
translations.たとえ悩みがあってもさ、こうしてると忘れちゃいそう。: Even if something was bothering me, doing this would make me forget all about it.
translations.……別にないよ、悩みなんて。たとえばの話。: ...Not that anything's bothering me. I'm just saying.
translations.リンコもアンタの癒しになれたらな～なんて思ったりするからさ。: 'Cause sometimes I wish I could help you unwind like this, too.
translations.懐かしい感じ……そんな気しない？: It feels nostalgic... Don't you think？
translations.ここってさ、なんでか懐かしい気持ちになる。: For some reason, this place makes me feel nostalgic.
translations.ただの安心……っていうのもちょっと違う、なんだろう。: It's not just that it feels comforting... What is it, I wonder？
translations.親しみを感じるって……こういう感覚かな。: Maybe this is what it means for something to feel familiar.
translations.これ、リンコっぽい、って感じしない？: Doesn't this feel kind of like me？
translations.なにこれ……他人って気がしないよ。: What is this...？ It doesn't feel like a stranger at all.
translations.ここ、どうして懐かしい感じがするんだと思う？: Why do you think this place feels so nostalgic？
translations.アンタもここって、懐かしい感じする？: Does this place feel nostalgic to you, too？
translations.へへ、ここには何かがある気がするよ！: Hehe, I've got a feeling there's something special here!
translations.ふーん、面白いことありそう。: Hmm, looks like something interesting might happen.
translations.リンコの予言、何かが起きる！: My prediction: something's about to happen!
translations.実はさっきからさ、不思議とワクワクしてるんだよね。: Honestly, I've been feeling weirdly excited for a while now.
translations.え、これ……何かあるのかな。: Huh, look at this... Wonder if there's something to it.
translations.よくはわかんないけど……何かがありそうな気はするんだよね。: I don't really know what, though... I just have a feeling there's something to it.
translations.デートのたびに新発見ってあるもんだよね。: You really do discover something new on every date, huh.
translations.今日は何があるかな……。: I wonder what we'll find today...
translations.デートってさ、何事も楽しもうって姿勢が大切だよね。: On a date, what matters most is trying to have fun with everything, right？
translations.別に無理してるわけじゃないけど、意識の問題だって。: Not that I'm forcing myself or anything. It's just a matter of attitude.
translations.ほら見て！ へえ……すごいじゃん。: Hey, look! Huh... That's pretty cool.
translations.さあ……盛り上がってきたよ！: All right... Now things are getting exciting!
translations.へへ、見てわかる？ リンコ結構ワクワクしてる。: Hehe, can you tell just by looking？ I'm actually pretty excited.
translations.プッ……ちょっとこれ、すごい！: Pfft... Hey, look at this, it's amazing!
translations.とりあえず、叫んどいた。: I just figured I should yell something.
translations.リンコ、テンション高すぎ？: Am I getting a little too carried away？
translations.アンタも楽しんでるなら、いいんだけどさ。: As long as you're having fun too, I guess it's fine.
translations.ここってさ、何か面白い逸話とありそうじゃない？: Doesn't it feel like there's some interesting story behind this place？
translations.ほら、絶対何かあるって、ここ。: Come on, there's definitely something to this place.
translations.わかる？ リンコがワクワクしてるの。: Can you tell how excited I am？
translations.たまには子供みたいにはしゃいじゃうのもいいよね。: It's nice to goof around like a kid every now and then.
translations.アンタは、笑ったりしないもん。: I know you won't laugh at me for it.
translations.気になるものは全部、知りたい。: If something catches my eye, I want to know all about it.
translations.いいでしょ、付き合ってよ。: It's fine, right？ Come on, humor me.
translations.ここさ、何かあるかな。: I wonder if there's anything around here.
translations.何かしたいことある？: Is there something you want to do？
translations.ふーん、こういうことか。: Huh, so that's what it's about.
translations.これって、要するになんなの？: So what is this supposed to be, anyway？
translations.そう見えるかもだけど、リンコは楽しんでるよ。: I might look it, but I'm having a good time.
translations.別に無理にしゃべんなくてもいいよね、一緒にいるだけでも充分だし。: We don't have to force ourselves to talk, right？ Just being together is enough.
translations.え？ なんか、ヘンなとこだね。: Huh？ This place is kind of weird.
translations.なんか違和感あるんだよねー。: Something about it just feels off.
translations.これさ、なんなの？ わけわかんない。: What even is this？ It makes no sense.
translations.こうしてリンコたちがデートしてる。: Here we are, out on a date like this.
translations.それって実は、すごい確率のうえに成り立ってるわけだよね。: When you think about it, the odds of this happening are pretty crazy.
translations.ちょっとヘンな感じじゃない？: Doesn't it feel a little weird？
translations.ここさ……少し落ち着かないっていうか……。: This place... I don't know, it makes me a little restless...
translations.なんだか、ここにいると、ソワソワしない？: Doesn't being here make you feel kind of antsy？
translations.うわ、ドキドキしてきた……。: Whoa, my heart's starting to race...
translations.今更緊張するのって、おかしいかな。: Is it weird to get nervous at this point？
translations.それとも、たまには必要なことなのかな、こういう感覚も。: Or maybe it's good to feel like this every once in a while.
translations.なんかさ、落ち着かなくて……さ。: I just can't seem to settle down...
translations.へへ、ここ。面白いね。: Hehe. This place is pretty interesting.
translations.ヘンな場所……いい意味でね。: It's a weird spot... in a good way.
translations.……へへ。あ、今の聞かなかったことにして。: ...Hehe. Oh, pretend you didn't hear that.
translations.いいじゃん、これ。笑える！: Hey, this is great. It's hilarious!
translations.ほらほら、アンタももっと楽しそうにしてもいいんだけど？: Come on, you could at least look like you're having fun too, you know？
translations.アンタといると、リンコ、笑いすぎな気がする。: I feel like I laugh way too much when I'm with you.
translations.ここにいるとさ、なんか元気出てこない？: Doesn't being here kind of perk you up？
translations.う～ん……気持ちいい場所じゃん。: Mmm... This is a really nice spot.
translations.こうしてデートしてるとさ……やっぱり気分がいいんだよね。: Being out on a date like this... really does put me in a good mood.
translations.デート健康法、なんてね。: Call it date therapy, or something.
translations.リンコの元気わけてあげよっか？: Want me to share some of my energy with you？
translations.このあたりじゃ……リンコたちが一番！ かな。: Around here... I think we're number one.
translations.いいとこだね……ありがと。: This is a nice place... Thanks.
translations.リンコは幸せ者だね。感謝してるよ。: I'm a lucky girl. I appreciate it.
translations.それはアンタが……いいや、なんでもない。: And that's because you... Nah, never mind.
translations.ちょっとくらいバカップルっぽくってもいいかな。: Maybe it's okay if we act like a sappy couple a little bit.
translations.どう見られるかより、自分たちが楽しいことの方が優先だし。: Having fun ourselves matters way more than what people think of us, anyway.
translations.こんなところ……いいのかな。: Are we really okay... being somewhere like this？
translations.うん……実はちょっと不安。: Yeah... Honestly, I'm a little uneasy.
translations.あのさ……やっぱいい。……ごめん、やっぱり気になる。: Hey... Never mind. ...Sorry, it really is bothering me.
translations.ほんとに大丈夫なわけ？ これ。: Are you sure this is really okay？
translations.とかって台詞あるじゃん。あれ……少しわかるときもあるかも。: You know how people say that line？ Sometimes... I think I kind of get it.
translations.あのさ……隣、行っていい？: Hey... Can I come over next to you？
translations.いや驚くって。: Come on, of course I'm surprised.
translations.はあ……焦った。: Phew... That caught me off guard.
translations.最初は焦ったけど……。: It caught me off guard at first, but...
translations.一緒にこんなとこ来ることになるなんてさ……。: To think we'd end up coming somewhere like this together...
translations.この場所、なんか……ちょっと怖い、っていうかさ……。: This place is kind of... a little creepy, I guess...
translations.イヤな予感する……。: I've got a bad feeling about this...
translations.怖い……かも。: I might be... a little scared.
translations.これ、大丈夫かな……。: Are we gonna be okay here...？
translations.だって、なんかありそうじゃん。: I mean, it feels like something's about to happen.
translations.リンコが怖い、って言ったら……。: If I told you I was scared...
translations.もちろん、助けてくれるよね。: Of course you'd protect me, right？
translations.アンタがいればさ、大丈夫。: As long as you're here, I'm fine.
translations.あのさ、この先って何があると思う？: Hey, what do you think is up ahead？
translations.さーて、どうなってるかなー。: Now then, let's see what's up ahead.
translations.待ち遠しいよ、実はね。: I actually can't wait, to tell the truth.
translations.ただ移動するだけじゃもったいないよね。: It'd be a waste to just rush from place to place, right？
translations.まあ、焦って行かなくてもいいんじゃない。: Well, we don't need to be in a hurry, right？
translations.……あ、黙ってるのはヒマだからじゃなくて……ほら、無理に話す必要もないじゃん。: ...Oh, I'm not quiet because I'm bored... Come on, we don't need to force a conversation, right？
translations.へへ、今だってちゃんとデートの一部だからね。: Hehe, even this counts as part of our date, you know.
translations.こうしてる姿ってさ……まさか兄妹には見られないよね。: Us together like this... Nobody's gonna mistake us for brother and sister, right？
translations.ん、ちゃーんと楽しいって。: Yeah, I really am having fun.
translations.歩いてるだけでもさ、いい感じだよね。: Even just walking around together feels nice, doesn't it？
translations.へへ、食べさせてあげよっか。: Hehe, want me to give you a bite？
translations.食事は楽しくしないとね。: Meals are meant to be enjoyed, after all.
translations.そのうち一緒に食事するのが当たり前になるのかな……。: I wonder if eating together will just feel totally normal someday...
translations.楽しく食事ができるかっていうのも、重要な相性のひとつじゃない？: Being able to enjoy a meal together is a big part of compatibility, don't you think？
translations.うーん……ねえ、アンタは何か買うの？: Hmm... Hey, are you buying anything？
translations.そっちは、どう？ いいのあった？: How about you？ Find anything good？
translations.せっかくだし記念品とか……うーん、今はいいか。: Maybe a souvenir since we're here... Hmm, maybe not right now.
translations.ねえ、リンコにはどれがいい？: Hey, which one's good for me？
translations.無駄なもの買ったりしてない？ 浪費癖はマイナスポイントだから。: You're not buying anything pointless, are you？ Wasting money is a minus in my book.
translations.ねえ、あれ。あれって、なんだっけ？: Hey, look at that. What was that again？
translations.珍しいものありそうじゃん。: Looks like they've got some unusual stuff.
translations.名物料理、なにかあるよね。: There's gotta be some local specialty dish here, right？
translations.全部周れるかな。: I wonder if we can get around to everything.
translations.ほらほら、調べてきた知識、披露してよ。: Come on, show off all that research you did.
translations.よく知らない場所ってテンションあがるよね。: Being somewhere unfamiliar is pretty exciting, huh.
translations.ここに住むのって、どんな感じかな。: I wonder what it's like to live here.
translations.旅の恥はかき捨てってね。ちょっとくらい、イチャイチャしてみる？: Nobody knows us out here, right？ Wanna get a little lovey-dovey？
translations.もう少しぐるっとしてもいいでしょ。: We can look around a little longer, right？
translations.このへん、まだ何かあるかな。: I wonder if there's anything else around here.
translations.まだいいでしょ。何か探そうよ。: We don't have to leave yet, right？ Let's go find something.
translations.ねえ、面白いもの見つけた？: Hey, did you find anything interesting？
translations.周りの風景も、結構面白いかも。: The scenery around here is actually pretty interesting.
translations.ふたりでのんびり歩きますか。: Shall we take a nice, slow walk together？
translations.一緒に遊べるものって、何かあるかな。: I wonder if there's something we can do together.
translations.ん、ヒマしてない？: Hm？ You're not bored, are you？
translations.こうしてる時間、好きだよ……。: I really like spending time like this...
translations.いいね、ゆっくりできて。: It's nice being able to take it easy like this.
translations.歩いてるだけでも、退屈はしないでしょ。: Even if we're just walking, it's not boring, right？
translations.そのうち、何か見つかるんじゃない。: We'll probably stumble across something sooner or later.
translations.そうだな……もうちょっと歩こっか。: Let's see... Wanna walk a little more？
translations.ねえねえ、面白いものないの？: Hey, isn't there anything interesting around？
translations.景色をぼーっと眺めてみたり……。: Just spacing out and watching the scenery...
translations.何か話そっか。なんでもいいよ。: Wanna talk about something？ Anything's fine.
translations.リンコと歩く速さ合わせるの、めんどくさくない？: Isn't it a pain matching your pace to mine？
translations.頭からっぽにしてさ、散歩ってことで。: Let's just clear our heads and go for a walk.
translations.散歩を楽しくする要素って……なんだろ。: I wonder what it is... that makes a walk fun.
translations.面白そうじゃん。期待通りだといいけど。: Looks pretty fun. Hope it lives up to expectations.
translations.すぐ遊べるといいんだけどね。待つのイヤだし。: Hope we can get right to it. I hate waiting.
translations.これって面白いのかな。評判知ってる？: I wonder if this is any good. Have you heard anything about it？
translations.ふーん、なるほどなるほど。こういう感じですか。: Hmm, I see, I see. So that's what it's like.
translations.二人で遊べてよかったよ。一人じゃね……。: I'm glad we could do this together. Doing it alone would be...
translations.リンコたち、周りからどう見えてるかな。: I wonder how the two of us look to everyone else.
translations.こういうのはやっぱり、二人じゃないとね。: You really need two people for stuff like this.
translations.満喫～。また遊ぶのもいいね。: I had my fill. We should do this again sometime.
translations.なんだかめまぐるしいね。: Things feel kind of hectic here.
translations.もうちょっと自然があってもいいと思わない？ どうかな。: Don't you think this place could use a bit more nature？ What do you think？
translations.ほら、よさそうな店探してよ。: Come on, see if you can find a good shop.
translations.……ねえ、あれ。あそこ、いい感じじゃない？: ...Hey, look at that. Doesn't that place look nice？
translations.みなさん、お忙しそうですね。リンコは自分のペースでいいや。: Everyone looks so busy. I'll just stick to my own pace.
translations.どれどれ……っと、挙動不審かな。: Let's see here... Wait, do I look suspicious？
translations.今は人少ないんだ。……まあ、これはこれでいっか。: There aren't many people around right now. ...Well, this is fine too.
translations.意外に静か？ 人少ないね。: Surprisingly quiet, huh？ Not many people around.
translations.なんかゴミゴミしてる。: It feels kind of cramped around here.
translations.にぎやかなのはいいけどさ、人多くない？: Lively is fine and all, but isn't it a little too crowded？
translations.ん……水平線だ。: Mm... You can see the horizon.
translations.風気持ちいいね。やっぱ海辺だし。: The breeze feels nice. Well, we are right by the sea.
translations.……ん？ うん、やっぱり潮の香りがする。: ...Hm？ Yeah, I can definitely smell the salt air.
translations.海に向かって叫ぶのって……やっほーは違うよね……。: When you shout out at the ocean... saying "Yoo-hoo" isn't quite right, is it...
translations.ねえ、面白そうな船、ない？: Hey, do you see any interesting boats out there？
translations.なんか……ほぼ貸し切り状態？: Feels like... we practically have the place to ourselves？
translations.意外に穴場なのかな、空いてるね。: Maybe this is a hidden gem. It's pretty empty.
translations.さすが、海の近くは人が多いね。: Figures there'd be a lot of people near the ocean.
translations.人多い、みんな海好きだね……。: So many people. Everyone really loves the beach, huh...
translations.空気がキレイ……な気がする。水辺だから？: The air feels really clean... I think. Maybe because we're by the water？
translations.ほら、景色が水面に映ってる……。: Look, the scenery's reflecting off the water...
translations.ねえねえ、魚いない？: Hey, hey, do you see any fish？
translations.ん……やっぱり空気湿ってるかな。: Mm... The air feels a bit damp here, doesn't it？
translations.あれ？ 今、水面に何かはねた？: Huh？ Did something just splash in the water？
translations.へへ、穴場じゃん。ここ。: Hehe, this spot's a real hidden gem.
translations.あれ、人少ない……なんでだろ。: Huh, there's hardly anyone here... I wonder why.
translations.なんか混んでる。人はね、水辺に集まりやすい習性があるって。: It's pretty crowded. They say humans have a natural instinct to gather near water.
translations.人多いなあ……まあいいけど。: Sure are a lot of people... Well, I guess it's fine.
translations.んー……自然を満喫って感じ。: Mmm... Feels like we're really soaking in nature.
translations.はい、深呼吸ー。空気が美味しいでしょ。: Okay, deep breath. The air tastes so fresh, doesn't it？
translations.自然に囲まれた生活……ってのはリンコのイメージじゃないけど、たまにはいいね。: Living surrounded by nature isn't really my style, but it's nice once in a while.
translations.これで虫がいなければね……。: Now if only there weren't any bugs...
translations.これだけ自然残ってるんだね……。: There's still this much nature left around here, huh...
translations.こうして自然に囲まれてると……何か悟りが開けそうだね。: Being surrounded by nature like this... makes me feel like I could reach enlightenment or something.
translations.自然がたくさんで、人も少なくて、いいねえ。: Lots of nature, hardly any people... This is nice.
translations.空いてていいね。人に邪魔されず、静かでさ……。:
It's nice and empty. Quiet,
and nobody's in our way...
translations.人多いね。みんな自然に飢えてるってことかな。:
There's a lot of people.
Guess everyone's starved
for nature.
translations.これでもっと空いてればな……。:
If only it were a little
less crowded...
translations.これじゃ、景色もあんまり見えないか……。:
Guess we can't really see
the view like this...
translations.ちょっと暗いけど……大丈夫？:
It's kind of dark...
Are you okay？
translations.もっと明かりがあってもいいと思わない？:
Don't you think they could
use a few more lights？
translations.そうだね、なんか暗いし、ちょっと……。:
Yeah, it's kind of dark,
so I'm a little...
translations.ああ、照明落としてる？: Oh, did they dim the lights？
translations.なんか薄暗いなあ……。: It's kind of dim in here...
translations.暗いね……ちゃんとリンコの顔見えてる？:
It's dark... Can you even
see my face properly？
translations.手、つなご。ほら、暗いしさ。:
Let's hold hands.
Come on, it's dark.
translations.アンタは紫外線とか、気にするタイプ？:
Are you the type to worry
about UV rays and stuff？
translations.日差し強いけど……あんまり肌とか気にしたことないや。:
The sun's strong... Not that
I've ever worried much
about my skin.
translations.なんか明るい雰囲気だね。:
It has a nice, bright
atmosphere.
translations.ん？ ああ、照明強いのかな。:
Hm？ Oh, maybe the lights
are just really bright.
translations.ここまで明るくする必要あるのかな。:
Do they really need to make
it this bright？
translations.へえ……照明キレイじゃん。:
Huh... The lighting's
actually pretty nice.
translations.意外と広くないね。:
It's smaller than I
thought it'd be.
translations.これなら簡単に周れるかな。:
Guess it'll be easy to
look around, then.
translations.こじんまりとしてるね、いいけど。:
It's pretty cozy.
Not that I mind.
translations.んー、どこまで行っていいのかな、ここ。:
Hmm, how far are we allowed
to go in here？
translations.窮屈な印象かも、そうじゃない？:
Feels a little cramped,
don't you think？
translations.ここなら、すぐ見て周れるね。:
We can probably look around
this place pretty quick.
translations.ちょっと窮屈だね、まあいっか。:
It's a little cramped.
Oh well.
translations.圧迫感があるっていうか……天井低いとか？:
It feels a bit closed in...
Maybe the ceiling's low？
translations.だだっ広いって感じ。: It feels huge and wide open.
translations.ねえ、どこらへんまで行けるかな。:
Hey, how far out do you
think we can go？
translations.開放感ある場所っていいね。:
I like wide-open places
like this.
translations.ぐる……っと見渡せるね。:
You can see all the way
around...
translations.これは一周するのも大変そう。:
Just making one lap around
looks like a lot of work.
translations.ここ、気分がいいね。天井高いのかな。: It feels nice in here. Maybe it's the high ceiling.
translations.屋内なのに、開放感あるね。: It feels so open in here, even though we're indoors.
translations.見て周ろっか、大変そうだけど。: Shall we look around？ Looks like a lot to cover, though.
translations.どこに連れてってくれるのかな、楽しみだな～。: I wonder where you're taking me. I can't wait.
translations.それで、今日はどこに行きますか？: So, where are we headed today？
translations.それじゃあ、デートスタート！: All right, let the date begin!
translations.当然、今日のデートも楽しませてくれるんでしょ。: You're going to show me a good time today too, right？
translations.どこ行くんだっけ。内緒？: Where are we going again？ Is it a secret？
translations.実はさ、結構楽しみにしてたんだよね。: To tell the truth, I was actually really looking forward to this.
translations.へへ。どうせ、楽しみで早起きしちゃったんじゃないの？: Hehe. Let me guess, you were so excited you woke up early？
translations.ぼさっとしてると、置いてくよ。: If you just stand there spacing out, I'll leave you behind.
translations.ここ評判いいんだよね……リサーチ済みってわけ？: This place gets great reviews... Did you do your research？
translations.へへ、ここ来たかったんだよね。わかってるじゃん。: Hehe, I've been wanting to come here. You know me well.
translations.いいねいいね、ちょうど来たかったし。: Nice, nice. I was just wanting to come here.
translations.ここ面白いってね。評判聞いたことある。: They say this place is fun. I've heard good things about it.
translations.最近評判いいらしいね、ここ。: I hear this place has been getting good reviews lately.
translations.よし、じゃあここで遊びますか。: All right, let's hang out here then.
translations.ここか……楽しいといいんだけど。: Here, huh... Well, I hope it's fun.
translations.へえ、こういう選択ってわけね。: Huh, so this is what you picked.
translations.評判聞かないけど……どうなんだろうね、ここ。: I haven't heard much about this place... Wonder how it is.
translations.またここ？ 好きなんだ。: Here again？ You really like this place, huh.
translations.ふーん、前にも来たっけ。: Hmm, haven't we been here before？
translations.移動しよっか。どこがいいかな……。: Let's head somewhere else. Where should we go...
translations.よし、次のとこ行こっか。: All right, let's head to the next spot.
translations.さーて、次はどこに連れてってくれるのかな。: Now then, where are you taking me next？
translations.うーん、ここは……任せた。: Hmm, I'll leave this one to you.
translations.次は……ねえ、どうすんの？: Next up... Hey, what are we doing？
translations.さて、今度はどうする？: So, what should we do now？
translations.じゃあ、ここは…………どっち？: Okay, so from here... Which way？
translations.そうだな……あっちにしよ。: Let's see... Let's go that way.
translations.次はリンコが決めよっかな。こっちでいいでしょ。: Maybe I'll pick next. This way's fine, right？
translations.さて、と……うーん、あっち！: Let's see now... Hmm, that way!
translations.ん、さっきもそっち行ったっけ。別にいいよ。: Hm, didn't we go that way earlier？ Whatever, I don't mind.
translations.はいはい。……あれ、さっきと同じか。: Sure, sure. ...Wait, same way as before？
translations.へへ、カレシががんばってくれたおかげかな。こんなに楽しかったのって。: Hehe, I guess I had so much fun because my boyfriend tried so hard.
translations.面白かったー♪ これなら次も期待しちゃうね。: That was fun♪ You're getting my hopes up for next time.
translations.今日も楽しかったよ。ほめてあげよっか。: Today was fun too. Maybe I'll give you a little praise.
translations.おかげで楽しかったんだけどさ……ねえ、無理はしてない？: I had a good time thanks to you, though... Hey, you didn't overdo it, did you？
translations.ねえねえ、次のデートの計画ってもうあるの？ だって今日楽しかったからさ、次も気に: Hey, do you already have plans for our next date？ Today was so fun, I can't help wondering what's next.
translations.んー……はあ……へへ、満足のため息。: Mmm... haah... Hehe, that was a contented sigh.
translations.疲れてない？ リンコはまあ……そこそこかな。: Are you tired？ I'm, well... a little bit, I guess.
translations.うん、楽しかった。またよろしく。: Yeah, I had fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translations.今日のデートは…………うん、よかったんじゃない。: Today's date was... yeah, pretty good, I'd say.
translations.もう終わりか……あっという間だね。: Over already...？ That went by fast.
translations.まあいいんだけどさ……ちょっとだけ物足りなかったかも、ボリューム的に。: Well, it's fine, I guess... It just felt a little bit short, is all.
translations.あれ、終わり？ そっか、楽しかったよ。: Oh, we're done？ Okay. I had fun.
translations.うん、ちょうどいい時間って感じ。満足。: Yeah, that felt like just the right length. I'm satisfied.
translations.結構遊んだね。これ以上だと、ちょっと疲れるよ。: We did quite a lot. Any longer and I'd start getting tired.
translations.ボリューム的にはさ、このくらいがちょうどいいよね。デートって。: Length-wise, this is just about right for a date, don't you think？
translations.遊びまくったって感じ。そっちは疲れてない？: Feels like we really went all out. Aren't you tired？
translations.こんな時間……たっぷり遊んだね。: Look at the time... We really made a day of it.
translations.デート尽くしだったかも。盛りだくさんだったね。: That was a non-stop date. We really packed a lot in.
translations.あのさ、別の場所でもいいかもね。次のデートはさ。: Say, maybe we could go somewhere different for our next date.
translations.あれ、今日行ったのって、前と同じとこだっけ。まあいいけど。: Wait, didn't we go to the same places last time？ Well, whatever.
translations.●、あのさ、いいデートスポット見つけたんだけど……今から行こうよ。: ●, hey, I found a great spot for a date... Let's head over right now.
translations.今から？ まあいいけど……。じゃあ支度するから、ちょっと待ってて。: Right now？ Well, okay... Give me a bit to get ready.
translations.ああ、あのさ。実は面白そうなデートコース見つけたんだよ。今から行かない？: Hey, listen. I actually found a really fun-looking date plan. Wanna go right now？
translations.へえ……いいよ。準備終わったら、すぐ行く。: Huh... Sure. I'll head right over once I'm ready.
translations.サンキュ。それじゃ、後でな。: Thanks. See you in a bit.
translations.あのさ、急なんだけど、今から出かけない？ 面白いデート思いついたんだ。: Hey, I know this is sudden, but wanna go out right now？ I came up with a fun date idea.
translations.今からか……いいよ、ほんとに面白いといいけど。: Right now, huh... Sure. It better actually be fun, though.
translations.任せとけって。それじゃ、後でな。: Leave it to me. See you soon.
translations.実はさ、お弁当持って来たんだよね。: Actually, I brought a boxed lunch with me.
translations.急だったのに用意してきたリンコ、すごいと思わない？: Pretty impressive that I threw it together on such short notice, don't you think？
translations.急な誘いでまいったけどさ……実はお弁当あるんだよね。: You caught me off guard asking me out so suddenly, but... I actually brought lunch.
translations.じゃーん、お弁当持って来たんだ。時間ないのに、がんばった！: Ta-da, I brought lunch. I worked really hard on such short notice!
translations.おー！ 大変だったよな、ありがと！: Awesome! That must've been tough, thanks!
translations.ジャンケン負けたら……言うこと聞く……わかった？: If you lose rock-paper-scissors... you do what I say... got it？
translations.やった……これで５０連勝～。: Yes... that's 50 wins in a row...
translations.悔しかったら、捕まえてみろっつーの……鬼さん、こちら……。: If it bugs you so much, try and catch me... Over here...
translations.もう……遅い……待ち合わせ時間すぎてる……。: Geez... you're late... It's past our meeting time...
translations.そんなに謝らなくても……いいよ……。: It's okay... you don't have to apologize so much...
translations.キス……してくれたら、許してあげよっかな……。: If you kiss me... maybe I'll forgive you...
translations.さあ、試合開始のゴングが鳴りました……。: And the bell rings to start the match...
translations.ね……あ・な・た……起きて……遅刻しちゃう……。: Hey... dar-ling... wake up... you'll be late...
translations.今日は早く……帰ってきてね……だって、寂しいんだもん……。: Come home... early today, okay... 'Cause I get lonely...
translations.おかえりなさい……ご飯にする？ お風呂にする？ それとも……ポテチ▼: Welcome home... Do you want dinner？ A bath？ Or... potato chips▼
translations.リンコは……ネコリンコに生まれ変わったニャ……。: Rinko has been... reborn as Kitty Rinko, meow...
translations.リンコは……コタツで丸くなる……ニャ。: Rinko is gonna... curl up under the kotatsu... meow.
translations.一番安心するのは……カレシのヒザの上……ニャ……ゴロゴロ。: Where I feel safest... is on my boyfriend's lap... meow... purr...
translations.明日のデート、どんなプランなんだろ……。: I wonder what he has planned for our date tomorrow...
translations.明日、晴れるかな、どうかな。: I wonder if it'll be sunny tomorrow, or what.
translations.早く明日になんないかな～。: Can't tomorrow hurry up and get here already...
translations.……はあ、さっきから何回時計確認してるんだっつーの。どんだけ待ちきれないの。: ...Sigh. How many times have I checked the clock now？ How impatient can I be.
translations.明日、最初はなんて声かけよっかな。: I wonder what I should say to him first tomorrow.
translations.明日、早めに行って驚かせちゃおっかな。へへ。: Maybe I'll show up early tomorrow and surprise him. Hehe.
translations.明日はたくさん甘えてみたり……へへ。: Maybe I'll try acting extra affectionate tomorrow... Hehe.
translations.デートの前日にこんなドキドキするのって、普通なのかな。アイツもそうなのかな。: Is it normal for your heart to race like this the day before a date？ I wonder if he feels the same way.
translations.明日のデート……へへ、ニヤける。: Our date tomorrow... Hehe, I can't stop grinning.
translations.早く会いたいな……。こんな風に思ってること、絶対教えてやんないけど。: I can't wait to see him... Not that I'd ever tell him I feel this way.
translations.昨日のデート……へへ、楽しかったな。: Yesterday's date... Hehe, that was fun.
translations.まだデートの余韻残ってるかも……。: I think I'm still caught up in the afterglow of our date...
translations.次はどこ連れてってくれるのかな～。: I wonder where he'll take me next...
translations.次のデートいつかな？ 早く決めてくれるといいんだけど。: I wonder when our next date is？ I hope he sets it up soon.
translations.昨日デートしたばっかりで、また会いたくなるとか……重症？: We just had a date yesterday, and I already want to see him again... Do I have it bad or what？
translations.へへ……“カレシの家”か。なんか特別な響き。: Hehe... "My boyfriend's house," huh. That has a special ring to it.
translations.あんなにドキドキしたのって、やっぱりアイツとのデートだからだよね。: I guess my heart only raced that much because it was a date with him.
translations.楽しい時間はすぐに過ぎる……か。デート中に時間止まっちゃえばよかったのに。: Time flies when you're having fun... huh. I wish time had just stopped during our date.
translations.メールしようかな……けど、テスト勉強の邪魔かな。: Maybe I'll text him... Though I don't want to interrupt his studying.
translations.はあ、勉強しなきゃ……しなくてもいっか。: Sigh, I have to study... Or maybe I'll just skip it.
translations.メールくらいならいいかな…………ああもう、集中！: Just one text couldn't hurt, right... Ugh, come on, focus!
translations.二人で勉強すると、はかどるのになあ……。: I get so much more done when the two of us study together...
translations.また一緒に勉強しよって、誘ってみよっかな。楽できるし。: Maybe I'll ask him to study with me again. Makes my life easier, anyway.
translations.あっ、ここの問題……教えてもらうの忘れてた。……でも、また一緒に勉強する理由にな: Oh, this problem... I forgot to get his help on it. ...Still, I guess it's an excuse to study together again.
translations.はあ。ドキドキして眠れないなんて、子供みたいじゃん……。: Sigh. Too excited to sleep—I'm acting like a little kid...
translations.待ち合わせの時間は……うん、オッケー。: The time we're meeting is... yep, all good.
translations.早く明日に…………ああもう、楽しみにし過ぎだっつーの。: I wish tomorrow would hurry up and... Ugh, seriously, I'm way too excited for this.
translations.もっとしたいかも……。: I think I want to do it some more...
translations.キス……か。へへ。なんかいいかも。: Kissing, huh... Hehe. I think I kind of like it.
translations.……まだドキドキしてる。リンコどうにかなっちゃうのかな。: ...My heart's still racing. Am I losing my mind or something？
translations.キスって、こんなにドキドキ……するんだよね。: So kissing really makes your heart... pound like this, huh.
translations.すごかった……まだ感覚が残ってる気がする。: That was intense... I swear I can still feel it.
translations.キス……またしちゃった。……うまくなったりするのかな……。: We kissed... again. ...I wonder if I'm getting any better at it...
translations.少し会えないだけで寂しい……それだけ好きってこと？: Lonely just from being apart for a little while... Does that mean I like him that much？
translations.毎日カレシのことばっか考えるのって、ひょっとして重症？: Thinking about my boyfriend nonstop every day... Do I have it bad or what？
translations.あーあ、今夜も夢にまで出てくるのかな、アイツ。: Man... Is he gonna show up in my dreams again tonight, too？
translations.大好き……なんて面と向かっては、言えないよね。: "I love you"... There's no way I could say that to his face.
translations.このままだと、好きな気持ち、止まらなくなりそう……。: At this rate, I don't think I'll be able to hold back how much I like him...
translations.なんだろ、なんか、すごく好き。: I don't know why, I just... really like him.
translations.アイツがここにいてほしい……ってね。: I wish he were here with me... Yeah, right.
translations.急に連絡したら……迷惑かな。: If I messaged him out of the blue... would that bother him？
translations.声……聞きたいな。: I want to hear... his voice.
translations.恋愛って、なんか楽しいかも。: Being in love... might actually be kind of fun.
translations.もっと一緒にいたいけどね……まあ、それはそれで色々あるだろうし、今くらいがいいの: I'd like to spend more time together, though... Well, that'd probably bring its own problems. Maybe things are best the way they are now.
translations.アイツも今、同じ気持ちなのかな……。: I wonder if he's feeling the same way right now...
translations.最近ちょっとすれ違いが多い気がする。: I feel like we've been out of sync a lot lately.
translations.もっとカノジョとして扱って欲しいんだけど……。: I wish he'd treat me more like his girlfriend, though...
translations.もしかして、ケンタイキってヤツ？: Could this be what they call a rut？
translations.最近少し素っ気ない気がする。気のせいかな……？: He seems a little distant lately. Is it just my imagination...？
translations.もっと楽しい気持ちでいたいんだけどな……。: I'd really rather feel happier about things than this...
translations.はあ、なんだかな……。: Sigh... I don't even know anymore...
translations.なんでリンコの気持ち、わかんないかな……。: Why doesn't he get how I feel...？
translations.ああもう、サイアク！: Ugh, seriously, this is the worst!
translations.アイツ、リンコのことこのままにしとくつもりじゃないよね。: He's not planning on just leaving me like this, is he？
translations.起きる時間……？ まあ、いっか。: Time to get up...？ Eh, whatever.
translations.たかが遅刻……うん、たかが遅刻。: It's just being late... Yeah, just a little late.
translations.なんでこんなに……眠い……だまされてる。: Why am I so... sleepy... I'm being tricked.
translations.ちょっとイイ感じかも。: Hey, this might actually be pretty good.
translations.予習復習は、欠かさずに。やれる範囲で、欠かさずに。: Never skip prep and review. ...Well, as much as I can manage, anyway.
translations.……あー、わかんないっつーの。: ...Ugh, I don't get this at all.
translations.これは、カレシもほれ直すかもね。: This might make my boyfriend fall for me all over again.
translations.新しい香り、気づくかな。: I wonder if he'll notice my new scent.
translations.たまにはこっちから、一緒に帰ろって誘ってみるかな。: Maybe I'll ask him to walk home with me for a change.
translations.今日、一緒に帰ればよかったかな……。: Maybe we should've walked home together today...
translations.一人で帰るのって、やっぱ物足りない。: Walking home alone really feels like something's missing.
translations.昼……まあ、今日は一人でいいか。: Lunch... Well, I guess eating alone is fine today.
translations.昼ご飯、一緒に食べよって、誘ってみようかな。: Maybe I'll ask him to eat lunch with me.
translations.アイツ……もう食べちゃったかな。一緒に食べればよかったかも。: I wonder if he already ate... Maybe we should've eaten together.
translations.はあ、サボんなっつーの……寂しいじゃん。: *Sigh* Don't go skipping out on me... I get lonely, you know.
translations.今日……来てないんだ。どうしたんだろ。: He's not here today... I wonder what happened.
translations.今日、来ないのかな。まあいいけど……別に。: I wonder if he's not coming today. Well, whatever... Not like I care.
translations.まだ起きてんの？ リンコはまだオッケーだからさ、話す？: Still awake？ I'm still good to stay up, so wanna talk？
translations.そろそろ寝ないと、明日辛いんじゃない？ リンコもさすがに眠い……。: Won't tomorrow be rough if you don't sleep soon？ Even I'm getting sleepy...
translations.おはよ。……まさか徹夜したわけじゃないよね？ 睡眠は大事だよ。: Morning. ...Don't tell me you pulled an all-nighter？ Sleep is important, you know.
translations.おはよ。朝食ちゃんと食べた？ 食べるのたまに面倒なことあるけどさ……リンコが作れ: Morning. Did you eat a proper breakfast？ I know it's a hassle sometimes, but... if I made it for you, you'd feel like eating, right？
translations.へへ。寝ぼけた顔も見てて面白いね。 リンコはもう完全に起きてるっつーの。: Hehe. Your half-asleep face is fun to watch, too. Me, I'm already wide awake.
translations.おはよ。早起きすると気分いいね。それにさ、こうやってゆっくり話す時間もできるし。: Morning. Waking up early feels great. Plus, it gives us time to take it easy and talk like this.
translations.んー、昼か……。大丈夫、午後から本気出すから。大丈夫大丈夫。: Mmm, noon already... It's fine, I'll get serious this afternoon. Totally fine.
translations.食べたら眠くなってきた。一緒に昼寝しよっか？ ふたり並んで……とかさ。: Eating made me sleepy. Wanna take a nap together？ Side by side... or something.
translations.ちゃんとご飯食べた？ 大丈夫だと思うけどさ、あんまり心配させないでよ。: Did you eat a proper meal？ I'm sure you're fine, just don't make me worry too much.
translations.んーっ、とりあえず一息ついたかな。リンコがんばった。: Mmm, guess I can finally catch my breath. I worked hard.
translations.あっ、今油断してなかった？ ちゃんと見てるんだからさ、シャキっとする。: Ah, were you spacing out just now？ I've got my eyes on you, so snap out of it.
translations.ね。今なに考えてた？ リンコは……ほら、この顔見て、当ててみ？: Hey. What were you thinking about just now？ As for me... Come on, look at my face and take a guess.
translations.あっ、宿題やらなくちゃ……。えっと……やらないとダメかな。: Ah, I have to do my homework... Um... do I really have to？
translations.そろそろお風呂入って寝よっかな。……アンタも夜更かししないようにね。: I think I'll take a bath and go to bed soon. ...Don't stay up too late either, okay？
translations.夢の中で会えるかな……なんてね。へへ。: Wonder if I'll see you in my dreams... Just kidding. Hehe.
translations.……まだ起きてるの？ ……もう眠い……。続きは明日でもいいんじゃない。: ...Are you still up？ ...I'm so sleepy... Can't we save the rest for tomorrow？
translations.寝ようと思ってたんだけど……しょうがないな、ちょっとだけだよ？: I was just about to go to sleep, but... oh well. Just for a little bit, okay？
translations.もう寝ちゃうんだ……？ リンコまだ少しいけるかな……どうする？: Going to sleep already...？ I can stay up a little longer... What do you wanna do？
translations.何しに来たの？ ……ウソ。ホントはすごく寂しくて、なんで会いに来てくれないんだろ: What'd you come here for？ ...Just kidding. Honestly, I was really lonely, wondering every single day why you wouldn't come see me.
translations.ここのところ毎日会いに来てくれるね。ありがと。やっぱりカレシの顔見るのって、いい: You've been coming to see me every day lately. Thanks. Seeing my boyfriend's face really is the best.
translations.ファッションに手抜いたら……カノジョとしてダメだよね。: If I start slacking on fashion... that'd make me a bad girlfriend, right？
translations.これはさすがに違うかな……どうかな。: This probably doesn't work... Or maybe it does.
translations.この組み合わせは……うん、ありかも。: This combination... yeah, it might work.
translations.かわいいっていってもらえるかな。: I wonder if he'll tell me I look cute.
translations.この色、気に入ってくれるかな？: I wonder if he'll like this color？
translations.ちょっとの変化でも気づいてくれるかな。: I wonder if he'll notice even a small change.
translations.オシャレはもっと冒険してみた方がいいのかな……？: Maybe I should be a little more adventurous with how I dress...？
translations.どんなのが好みかなあ、ああもう、難しい。: I wonder what kind of look he likes... Ugh, this is hard.
translations.これは結構イイ線いってるんじゃない。: I think I'm onto something with this one.
translations.うーん、さっきの方がかわいかったかな。: Hmm, maybe the last one was cuter.
translations.えっと……なんて送ろっかな。: Let's see... What should I write？
translations.へへ……向こうもメール待ってたりして。: Hehe... Maybe he's waiting for an email from me, too.
translations.へへ、着信の瞬間って、いいね。: Hehe, that moment a message comes in is so nice.
translations.送信っ。すぐに読むかな。: Sent! Wonder if he'll read it right away.
translations.そうだ、準備しなきゃ……。: Oh, right, I have to get ready...
translations.あ、そうだ。今のうちに……。: Oh, right. While I have a minute...
translations.ちょっとおなかすいたかも……。: Think I'm getting a little hungry...
translations.……そういえば最近、ウエスト少しきつくなってたかも。: ...Come to think of it, things have felt a little tight around my waist lately.
translations.少しやせたかな？: Did I lose a little weight？
translations.そういえばデート中、よく食べてるし。: Come to think of it, I have been eating a lot on our dates.
translations.ふーん。あんまり外食とかしないしね。: Hmm. Well, I don't really eat out much.
translations.へへ、我ながらいい感じにできたかも。: Hehe, I think this turned out pretty well, if I do say so myself.
translations.いい出来。食べさせてあげたら、驚くだろうな、きっと。: Turned out great. I bet he'll be surprised when I have him try it.
translations.やっぱ食べさせる相手がいると、上達もするよね。: Having someone to cook for really helps you improve, huh.
translations.うん、この味この味。: Yep, that's the taste right there.
translations.うーん……なんかヘンかも。: Hmm... Something seems a little off.
translations.あれ？ こうじゃなかったっけ。: Huh？ Wasn't it supposed to go like this？
translations.レシピ通りに作れば大丈夫……のはず。: As long as I follow the recipe, it should be fine... I think.
translations.微妙かも……ここからなんとかなるかなあ。: This looks a little iffy... Wonder if I can still save it.
translations.お弁当、喜んでくれるかな。: I wonder if he'll like the lunch I made.
translations.せっかく作るんだから、驚かせないとね。: If I'm going to make it for him, I want to surprise him.
translations.お弁当は彩りも大事だよね……。: Making a lunch look colorful matters too, right...
translations.全部食べてくれるかな。: I wonder if he'll eat it all.
translations.新しいレシピ、早速練習してみよっかな。: Maybe I'll try practicing that new recipe right away.
translations.前は微妙な評価だったから……今度はリベンジ！: He wasn't too impressed last time... Time to redeem myself!
translations.へへ。やっぱりほめられると、やる気出ちゃうね。: Hehe. Getting praised really does motivate you, huh.
translations.これいいな……うーん、どうしよう。: This one's nice... Hmm, what should I do.
translations.へえ……悪くないじゃん。: Huh... That's not bad at all.
translations.……これ、ちょっとかわいすぎるかな。: ...Is this one a little too cute for me？
translations.こんな風に着こなせたらいいんだけどね……。: It'd be nice if I could pull off an outfit like this...
translations.あっ、このコーディネイト参考になるかも。: Oh, I could probably take some pointers from this outfit.
translations.これおいしそう。アイツは好きかな。: This looks good. I wonder if he'd like it.
translations.お、このレシピ探してたんだよね。: Oh, I've been looking for this recipe.
translations.今度は何作ろっかな？: What should I make next time？
translations.作れそうなの載ってるかな……。: I wonder if there's anything in here I can actually make...
translations.ながめてるだけで料理が上手くなれば苦労しないんだけどね。: Life would be easy if just staring at recipes made me a better cook.
translations.んー、もうちょっとでやめとこ。: Mm, I'll stop after just a little more.
translations.う……食べ過ぎたかも。: Ugh... I might've eaten too much.
translations.なんか癖になるかも。: I could get hooked on these.
translations.んー……眠たくなるくらい気持ちいい朝……。: Mmm... Such a nice morning it's making me sleepy...
translations.ん？ なんか見られてる気が……。: Hm？ I feel like someone's watching me...
translations.のぞかれてる感じが……まさかね。: Feels like someone's peeking at me... No way, right.
translations.小キック！ ……変な気配がしたんだけど。: Light kick! ...Wait, I could've sworn I sensed something weird.
translations.あのさ、少し話さない？: Hey, want to talk for a bit？
translations.今話してもいいよね。: You're free to talk right now, right？
translations.あのさ。ちょっと話したいんだけど。: Hey. I kind of want to talk for a minute.
translations.ねえ、話す時間くらいあるでしょ。: Come on, you at least have time to talk, don't you？
translations.ね、いま何してんの？: Hey, what're you doing right now？
translations.今日さ、いいことあった？: So, did anything good happen today？
translations.へへ、何気ない会話ってのが大切だよね。: Hehe. Casual little chats like this are important, right？
translations.あのさ、今度付き合って欲しいところあるんだよね。: Hey, there's somewhere I want you to come with me sometime.
translations.何か悩みとかない？ 聞くぐらいならできるしさ。: Is anything bothering you？ I can at least listen.
translations.はーい、面白い話して。: All right, tell me something interesting.
translations.ね、最近なんかおもしろい番組ない？: Hey, have there been any good shows on lately？
translations.たまにはさ、そっちがリンコに本のオススメしてよ。: You should recommend a book to me for a change.
translations.んっ……なんか見てた？: Hm... Were you looking at something？
translations.２年の授業ってやっぱ１年より難しいのかな。はあ。: I guess second-year classes really are harder than first-year ones, huh. Ugh.
translations.ポテチってさ、同じ味でも食べる季節でちょっと違う気がするんだよね。気のせいかな。: I feel like potato chips taste a little different depending on the season, even if it's the same flavor. Maybe it's just me.
translations.アンタは部活とかバイトとか大変だね。リンコは図書委員だけで精一杯だよ。: You've got your hands full with clubs and work and all that. Just being on the library committee is plenty for me.
translations.今って映画、何やってるんだっけ。: What movies are playing right now, again？
translations.最近、ハマってるバンドあるんだよね。今度聴いてみる？: There's this band I've been really into lately. Wanna give them a listen sometime？
translations.雑誌の占いってさ、たまーに妙に頭に残るよね。: Horoscopes in magazines really stick in your head sometimes, don't they？
translations.アンタって携帯とか詳しい？ 変えたいわけじゃないけど、リンコあんまり詳しくないか: Do you know a lot about cell phones？ Not that I'm looking to get a new one, I just don't know much about them.
translations.時間大丈夫かな。: I wonder if we're okay on time.
translations.あれ、聞こえなかった？ まあしょうがないか。: Huh, did you not hear me？ Oh well.
translations.今忙しいとか？ じゃあ後で。: Are you busy right now？ Catch you later, then.
translations.おーい……。後でもいいか。: Hey... Guess it can wait till later.
translations.じゃあさ、話したくなったら声かけてよ。: Well, let me know when you feel like talking.
translations.もういいんだ。じゃあ、また。: Done already？ See you later, then.
translations.もっと話しててもいいけど……まあいつでも話せるしね。: I wouldn't mind talking longer... Then again, we can talk anytime.
translations.いつまでも……ってわけにはいかないしね。: Guess we can't just stand here talking forever.
translations.最近絶好調って感じじゃない？: Things have been going great for you lately, haven't they？
translations.アタリ！ もちろん、見てればわかるんだってば。: Bingo! Of course I can tell just by looking at you.
translations.あれ、そう？ そんな風に見えるんだけどね。: Huh, really？ Sure looks like it to me, though.
translations.あのさ、最近調子いい？: Hey, have things been going well lately？
translations.やっぱりね。そうだと思った。: I knew it. I thought so.
translations.ふーん、気づいてないだけかもよ。: Hmm, maybe you just haven't noticed.
translations.あのさ、最近調子どう？: Hey, how have you been doing lately？
translations.そうなんだ。まあ、そんなときもあるよ。: Oh, really. Well, we all have days like that.
translations.あのさ、最近落ち込んでない？ なんかそんな気するんだけど。: Hey, have you been feeling down lately？ I kind of get that feeling.
translations.そっか……。じゃあ、リンコが元気わけてあげないとね。: I see... Guess it's up to me to cheer you up, then.
translations.ならいいけど……無理はしないでよ。: Well, okay then... Just don't push yourself too hard.
translations.あのさ、今日あまり無茶しない方がいいよ。そんな気がする。: Hey, you probably shouldn't overdo it today. I just have a feeling.
translations.遅刻！ って思ってあわてて起きたんだけど……今日休みじゃんね。: I jumped out of bed thinking I was late... and then realized we're off today.
translations.休日の朝食はしっかり味わんないとね。優雅なひとときだよ。: You really have to savor breakfast on a day off. It's a nice, relaxing moment.
translations.休みの日はやっぱり、家事手伝わないとね。お母さんも働いてるしさ。: I really should help out with chores on my days off. My mom works, too, after all.
translations.休みの日に早起きしちゃったときのガッカリ感っていったらないよね。: There's nothing more disappointing than waking up early by accident on a day off.
translations.二度寝、三度寝、四度寝……どこまで記録って伸ばせるかな。: Going back to sleep once, twice, three times... Wonder how far I can push my record.
translations.朝のテレビってなんか見ちゃうよね。もうすぐ出なきゃ……ってときに限って気になるこ: It's so easy to get sucked into morning TV. And it's always right when you have to leave that something interesting comes on.
translations.今日、アンタの夢見ちゃった……かも。あんまり覚えてないんだけどさ。: I think I had a dream about you today... maybe. I don't really remember much of it, though.
translations.宿題やるの忘れちゃったんだけどさ、なんとか誤魔化せるかな。: So I forgot to do my homework. Think I can talk my way out of it somehow？
translations.朝、家のカギが見つからなくて大変だったんだよね。結局制服のポケットに入ってたんだ: I had a whole ordeal this morning trying to find my house key. Turned out it was in my uniform pocket the whole time.
translations.朝食の目玉焼き、黄身が双子だったんだよね。ちょっと得した気分。: My fried egg at breakfast had a double yolk. Feels like a little bonus.
translations.休日は昼までダラダラするに限るね。毎日こうだったらいいのに。: Nothing beats lounging around until noon on a day off. I wish every day could be like this.
translations.お母さんの買い物に付き合ってたら、アンタが好きそうな服見つけたんだよね。どうしよ: I tagged along with my mom to go shopping and found some clothes you might like. Wonder if I should get them.
translations.ご近所さんに犬の散歩頼まれちゃった。悪くないけど……やっぱり猫がいいな。: A neighbor asked me to walk their dog. It's not bad, I guess... but I still prefer cats.
translations.今日、お母さんがお菓子作ってくれたんだよね。作り方、教えてもらおうかな……。: My mom made some sweets today. Maybe I'll ask her to teach me how...
translations.購買部、いつにも増して騒がしかったね。なんか新商品あったっけ。: The school store was even rowdier than usual. Did something new come out or something？
translations.なんか学校に、野良犬が入ってきちゃったらしいよ。……授業はつぶれなかったけど。: Apparently a stray dog wandered into the school. ...Didn't get us out of class, though.
translations.昼休みに友達と、ガールズトーク……みたいなことを少ししたかも。: I think I had a little bit of... girl talk with my friends at lunch.
translations.学校の花壇さ、悪くないよね。変化があるとやっぱり気になっちゃうっていうかさ。: The school flowerbeds aren't half bad, you know. Whenever something changes, it kind of catches my eye.
translations.授業中に友達と手紙を回してたら、先生に怒られた。これも青春の一ページだね。: I got scolded by the teacher for passing notes with a friend during class. Just another page in the book of youth, I guess.
translations.クラスにいつもケンカしてる男子と女子がいるんだけどさ、ひょっとして両想いだったり: There's this guy and girl in my class who are always arguing. What if they actually like each other...？ Wonder if that's it.
translations.運動不足解消のために近所をジョギング……とかした方がいいのかな。ハードル高いけど: Maybe I should jog around the neighborhood or something to get more exercise. That's a pretty high bar for me, though.
translations.近くで工事してるみたい。こっちも負けずに音楽のボリュームあげたら怒られたんだよね: Sounds like there's construction going on nearby. I turned my music way up to compete with it and got yelled at. So unfair.
translations.つまんないことで弟のこと叱っちゃった。大人気ないね、ちゃんと謝らないと。: I snapped at my little brother over something stupid. That wasn't very mature of me. I need to apologize properly.
translations.外で偶然、同じ中学の子たちと会ったんだよね。まあ、少し話したぐらいだけど。: I randomly bumped into some kids from my old middle school while I was out. We only talked for a bit, though.
translations.さっきさ、弟の友達に囲まれて大変だったよ。無邪気な笑顔で「お姉ちゃん」って呼ばれ: My brother's friends swarmed me earlier and it was a lot to handle. Can't really brush them off when they're beaming up at me like that, though.
translations.近所で交通事故あったみたい。アンタも気をつけてね、約束。: Looks like there was a traffic accident in the neighborhood. You be careful out there too, okay？ Promise me.
translations.学校の近くにクレープ屋さんとかたこ焼き屋さんの屋台出すとか……反則だよね。逆らえ: Setting up crepe and takoyaki stands right near the school... That's playing dirty. There's no resisting that.
translations.先生の小言に付き合わされた。別にリンコが悪いわけじゃないのにさ、はあ。: Got stuck listening to the teacher lecture me. Even though I didn't do anything wrong. *sigh*
translations.失恋した友達の話を聞いたんだけど、上手いこと言えなかったよ。難しいね。: A friend got her heart broken and vented to me, but I didn't really know what to say. That stuff's hard.
translations.今日、国語の授業の朗読ほめられた。感情がこもってたって言われたけど……半分寝てた: I got praised for my reading in Japanese class today. The teacher said it was full of emotion... even though I was half-asleep.
translations.今日は夕食の準備でも手伝ってみよっかな。……アンタも食べてくれると張り合いあるん: Maybe I'll help make dinner tonight. ...I'd be a lot more motivated if you were eating it too, though.
translations.休みだし、いつもよりゆっくりお風呂に入ってみた。半身浴しながら読書、オススメかも: Since it's a day off, I took a longer bath than usual. Soaking while reading a book is actually pretty nice. I recommend it.
translations.録画してたドラマ一気に観たから目が疲れた……。面白かったからよかったけどさ。: I binged a drama I had recorded and now my eyes are tired... It was good, though, so it was worth it.
translations.夕食にカレー作ったんだけど、予想よりおいしくなかったんだよね。どこで失敗したんだ: I made curry for dinner, but it didn't turn out as good as I expected. Wonder where I messed up.
translations.さっき停電あったんだよね、そっちは大丈夫だった？: We had a blackout here earlier. Was everything okay on your end？
translations.今日から始まったドラマ、結構面白かったかも。来週からでも観てみたら？: That new show that started today was actually pretty good. Maybe try tuning in next week？
translations.ちょっと長風呂しちゃったから、のぼせたかも。あー、なんかぼーっとして気持ちいい。: I stayed in the bath a bit too long and got a little dizzy. Ahh, my head's all fuzzy, though. Feels kind of nice.
translations.今日はリンコが弟に本読んであげたんだ。弟も読書家になったりするのかな。: I read a book to my little brother today. Wonder if he'll turn into a bookworm too.
translations.テレビで怖い話特集やっててさ…………いいや、なんでもない。: There was a scary story special on TV, and... ...Never mind, it's nothing.
translations.今夜は熟睡できる気がする。なんとなく。: I feel like I'm gonna sleep really well tonight. Just a hunch.
translations.友達とつい長電話しちゃって、こんな時間。……さすがに寝たほうがいいかな。: I got carried away talking on the phone with a friend, and now it's this late. ...I should probably go to bed.
translations.今日も休みを満喫したよ。休日平日のバランス、入れ替わんないかな。: Made the most of my day off again today. Can't they flip the ratio of weekdays to weekends？
translations.女友達とパジャマパーティとか、楽しいのかな。男子は男子で面白そうだけど。: I wonder if having a slumber party with girlfriends is fun. Though I guess guys have their own version of that too.
translations.今日の布団はふかふかだよ。へへ、ぐっすり眠れそう。: My futon is super fluffy today. Hehe, I think I'll sleep like a log.
translations.もうこんな時間か……時間泥棒がいる気がする。: It's this late already... I feel like there's a time thief around.
translations.今夜は、なんか空気がキレイな気がする。何が違うんだろ。: The air feels really clear tonight for some reason. I wonder what's different.
translations.……恐い夢見てさ、起きちゃった。何かに負けた気がする。: ...I had a bad dream and woke up. Makes me feel like I lost to something.
translations.眠れないときは深夜番組に限るね。適当にチャンネル変えながら観るの、結構好きかも。: Nothing beats late-night TV when you can't sleep. I actually kind of like just flipping through the channels.
translations.宿題から逃避のために本読んだりゲームしたりしてたらこんな時間……。: I was reading and playing games to avoid my homework, and now it's this late...
translations.こんな時間にネコのカップルがないてる。深夜のデートかな。: A pair of cats are meowing outside at this hour. Maybe they're on a late-night date.
translations.あのさ。運動するのって好きなほうだっけ？: Hey, are you the type who likes exercising？
translations.あのさ。絵を描いたりするの、得意なほう？: Hey, are you any good at drawing？
translations.あのさ。ファッションとかどのくらい興味ある？: Hey, how interested are you in fashion and stuff？
translations.あのさ。掃除ってけっこうしっかりするほう？: Hey, are you pretty thorough when it comes to cleaning？
translations.あのさ。もしかして料理、得意だったりする？: Hey, are you actually good at cooking, by any chance？
translations.あのさ。洗濯、ちゃんとやってる？: Hey, do you keep up with your laundry？
translations.あのさ。外に遊びに出かけるのって好き？: Hey, do you like going out for fun？
translations.あのさ。インドアでまったりするの、好きなほう？: Hey, are you the type who likes relaxing indoors？
translations.あのさ。公園で散歩するのって好き？: Hey, do you like taking walks in the park？
translations.あのさ。古い建物を見て回るの、結構楽しいと思わない？: Hey, don't you think looking around old buildings is pretty fun？
translations.あのさ。体動かすのって好き？: Hey, do you like being active？
translations.あのさ。ショッピング行くのって好きだっけ？: Hey, do you like going shopping？
translations.あのさ。写真撮るのってやっぱり女の子がいいの？: Hey, when you take pictures, do you prefer taking them of girls？
translations.あのさ。教会の雰囲気って、好きだったりしない？: Hey, don't you kind of like the atmosphere in churches？
translations.あのさ。ライブに行ったりする？: Hey, do you ever go to live shows？
translations.あのさ。気分がいいと、歌ったりしない？: Hey, do you ever sing when you're in a good mood？
translations.あのさ。よくゲームやったりするほう？: Hey, are you the type who plays a lot of games？
translations.あのさ。普段音楽聴いたりするの？: Hey, do you usually listen to music？
translations.あのさ。アニメってよく観たりする？: Hey, do you watch much anime？
translations.あのさ。遊園地デートって好き？: Hey, do you like amusement park dates？
translations.あのさ。泳ぐのって得意なほう？: Hey, are you a pretty good swimmer？
translations.あのさ。星見たりするのって、好きなほう？: Hey, are you the type who likes stargazing？
translations.あのさ。植物に囲まれてると、リラックスするよね？: Hey, being surrounded by plants is relaxing, isn't it？
translations.あのさ。イベントがあると、よく見に行ったりするほう？: Hey, when there's an event going on, do you usually go check it out？
translations.あのさ。実は買い物好き？: Hey, do you actually like shopping？
translations.あのさ。海に行ったりするの好き？: Hey, do you like going to the beach？
translations.あのさ。やっぱり女の子の水着姿とか興味あるわけ？: Hey, so are you into seeing girls in swimsuits and stuff？
translations.あのさ。山登りってしてみたいと思う？: Hey, would you ever want to try mountain climbing？
translations.あのさ。動物とかやっぱり好きなの？: Hey, do you like animals and stuff？
translations.あのさ。自然に囲まれるのって、好き？: Hey, do you like being surrounded by nature？
translations.あのさ。お風呂ってつい長く入っちゃわない？: Hey, don't you end up staying in the bath for a long time？
translations.ねぇ、夜寝る前って何してるの？: Hey, what do you usually do before going to bed？
translations.眠れないとき、どうしてる？: What do you do when you can't sleep？
translations.ネコとイヌ、飼うならどっち？: If you had a pet, would you want a cat or a dog？
translations.最近、寝る前にちゃんと予習復習してる？: Have you been keeping up with your studies before bed lately？
translations.寝る前にオススメの本って何かある？: Do you have any good book recommendations for before bed？
translations.デートってどういうのが好き？: What kind of dates do you like？
translations.二人で旅行行くとしたら、どんなとこ行きたい？: If we went on a trip together, where would you want to go？
translations.歳を取っても手をつないで歩くカップルって、いいと思わない？: Don't you think it's nice when couples still hold hands even when they're old？
translations.ドラマみたいな恋愛ってどう思う？: What do you think about romance that's like a TV drama？
translations.デートの前の日ってドキドキして眠れないよね？: You get too excited to sleep the night before a date, don't you？
translations.当然、記念日は全部覚えてるよね？: You remember all of our anniversaries, obviously, right？
translations.ギュッとするのとされるの、どっちが好き？: Do you like hugging or being hugged more？
translations.カノジョの好きなところを、今すぐ５つあげなさい。へへ。: Name five things you like about your girlfriend right now. Hehe.
translations.あのさ……キス……うまくなったと思う？: Hey... Do you think... I've gotten better at kissing？
translations.あのさ、女の子のことって……ちゃんとわかってる？ わかんないことってある？: Hey, do you really... understand girls？ Is there anything you don't get？
translations.予想通り。やっぱりね。: Just as I expected. I knew it.
translations.それはどうかな。: I'm not so sure about that.
translations.んー、なんとなく聞いてみただけ。: Mm, I just felt like asking.
translations.別に深い意味は無いんだけどさ。: There's no deep meaning behind it or anything.
translations.へへ、メモっとこ。: Hehe, I'll make a note of that.
translations.そういう答えもあるんだ。: So that's one way to answer, huh.
translations.カレシのことはさ、どんな小さなことも知っておきたいわけ。: I just want to know everything about my boyfriend, no matter how small.
translations.そういえば、前にも聞いたっけ？: Come to think of it, did I ask you this before？
translations.何度も聞いてごめん。やっぱり気になるんだよね。: Sorry for asking so many times. I just can't help being curious.
translations.前にも同じこと聞いたっけ？ でも、カノジョとしては最新情報を知りたいからさ。: Did I ask the same thing before？ Well, as your girlfriend, I want to stay up to date.
translations.あのさ。やっぱりおっきい方がいいものなのかな。: Hey. Is bigger really better after all？
translations.でもおっきいって、どれくらいなんだろ。: But I wonder what counts as big.
translations.……そんなこと言われてもさ。: ...I don't know what to say to that.
translations.リンコ、最近太ったかな。気になる？: I wonder if I've gained weight lately. Is it noticeable？
translations.うわ、やっぱり気になるんだ……少しダイエットとかしたほうがいいのかな。: Ugh, so you did notice... Maybe I should go on a bit of a diet.
translations.なんだ、そっか。気にしすぎかな。: Oh, really? Maybe I'm just overthinking it.
translations.最近食べすぎてる気がするんだけど……別に見た目は大丈夫だよね？: I feel like I've been eating too much lately... I still look fine though, right？
translations.……そっか。まあ見てわかんないなら、セーフだよね。: ...Right. Well, if you can't tell just by looking, I'm safe.
translations.うん……そんなに気にしてるわけじゃないんだけどさ。: Yeah... Not that I'm super worried about it or anything.
translations.やっぱり……実はね。はあ……わかるぐらい増えてるか。: I knew it... Honestly, yeah. *Sigh*... So I've gained enough that it shows, huh.
translations.そうなの？ そんなに増えてないはずなんだけどな。: Really？ I shouldn't have put on that much, though.
translations.あのさ、好きな料理のこと教えてくれる？: Hey, will you tell me what kind of food you like？
translations.和食って好きなほう？: Are you a fan of Japanese food？
translations.こう……ジャンルわけできないような料理って好きかな。: Do you like dishes that, you know... don't really fit into a genre？
translations.へへ、そっか。じゃあ期待していいかもよ。: Hehe, I see. Then you might have something to look forward to.
translations.うわ……そっか。練習か……。: Oof... I see. Guess I need to practice...
translations.えー……今から好きになってくれてもいいんだけど。: Come on... You could always start liking it now, you know.
translations.ふーん。やっぱりカレシの好みは把握しとかないとね。: Hmm. Well, a girlfriend should know what her boyfriend likes.
translations.なるほどね。気にしないで、ただのリサーチだから。: Got it. Don't mind me, just doing a little research.
translations.そっか、研究しとこうかな。: I see. Maybe I'll study up on it.
translations.この間新しいレシピ手に入れたからさ。試してみようかなーって。: I got a new recipe the other day, so I was thinking of trying it out.
translations.またいいレシピ見つけたんだよね。よかったら実験……冗談だっつーの。: I found another good recipe. If you don't mind being my guinea pig... I'm kidding, obviously.
translations.最近洋食に凝ってるんだよね。ちゃんと研究してるんだから。: I've been really into making Western food lately. I'm doing my homework on it and everything.
translations.最近中華に凝ってるんだよね。自分が食べたものとか、参考にしつつ。: I've been really into making Chinese food lately. Using stuff I've eaten myself as a reference.
translations.最近和食に凝ってるんだよね。お母さんにも教えてもらったりしてさ。: I've been really into making Japanese food lately. My mom's been teaching me some things, too.
translations.ジャンルに縛られずに料理作れたりするとかっこいいよね。: It's pretty cool when you can cook without being tied to any one style, you know.
translations.お菓子作りが楽しくて最近凝ってるんだけど……意外？: I've been having fun making sweets lately... Surprising？
translations.あのさ、今度のデートって、どうすんの？ 決めてる？: Hey, what are we doing for our next date？ Have you decided？
translations.へへ、さすが。じゃあ、楽しみに待つとしますか。: Hehe, nice. Guess I'll just look forward to it, then.
translations.じゃあ、いっしょに考えるのもいいかもね。どこがいいかな……。: Then maybe we should figure it out together. Where should we go...
translations.落ち着いた場所とかどうだろ。: How about somewhere quiet and relaxing.
translations.にぎやかなところもいいかもね。: Somewhere lively could be nice, too.
translations.まだ行ったことの無いところに行ってみたいかも。: Maybe I'd like to go somewhere we haven't been yet.
translations.ほとんどのデートスポット回った気がするし。: I feel like we've been to most of the date spots already.
translations.前に行って一番楽しかったのはどこ？ そこにもう一度行くの、アリじゃない。: Where did you have the most fun going before？ Going back there wouldn't be a bad idea.
translations.おいしい店が近くにある場所とかいいかも。: Somewhere near a good place to eat might be nice.
translations.今度のデートはさ、屋内で楽しめるところがいいかも。: For our next date, maybe somewhere indoors would be good.
translations.今度のデートはさ、外で楽しめるところにしとく？: For our next date, want to go somewhere outdoors？
translations.じゃあさ、こういうのは。今度のデートは何か公演とか展示を見に行くとか。: Then how about this: for our next date, we go see a show or an exhibit or something.
translations.あのさ、今度のデートは買い物とかどう？: Hey, how about going shopping on our next date？
translations.あのさ、今度のデートは体を動かしてみよっか？: Hey, want to do something active on our next date？
translations.あのさ、今度のデートはのんびりできるようなところにしよっか？: Hey, want to go somewhere we can just take it easy on our next date？
translations.あのさ、今度のデートは思い切り遊べるところがいいかな。: Hey, for our next date, maybe somewhere we can really have fun.
translations.へへ。そうそう、カノジョの言うことは聞いとくもんだよ。: Hehe. That's right, you should always listen to your girlfriend.
translations.じゃあ決定かな。期待しとく。: Guess it's settled, then. I'll look forward to it.
translations.そう？ まあ考えといてよ。: Oh, really？ Well, think it over.
translations.ふーん。じゃあ何か考えがあるってことかな。: Hmm. Guess that means you already have something in mind.
translations.当日、期待しとく。: I'll look forward to the day of.
translations.やっぱりデートは、事前に色々考えるのも楽しいね。: Planning things out ahead of time really is half the fun of a date.
translations.学校帰りに行くのもたまにはいいんじゃない。: Going somewhere after school isn't a bad idea every once in a while.
translations.近くのおいしい店も忘れずチェックしとくこと。: Don't forget to check out good places to eat nearby, too.
translations.楽しいデートになるように、ちゃーんと考えてよね。: Make sure you plan it out properly so it's a fun date, okay.
translations.着ていく服、さっそく選ばないと。: I better start picking out what I'm going to wear.
translations.デートのあとは……どうしようかな。: Wonder what we should do... after the date.
translations.また、帰りが遅くならないように気をつけないとね。: We'll have to be careful not to stay out too late again.
translations.あのさ、カノジョからのキス……って、好き？: Hey, do you like it when... your girlfriend kisses you first？
translations.そっか……結構悪くないんだよね。: I see... It's really not so bad, you know.
translations.そっか……ちょっと緊張するけど。: I see... It makes me a little nervous, though.
translations.そうなんだ。やっぱり自分からの方が、いいんだ。: Oh, I see. So you'd rather be the one to initiate it.
translations.そうなんだ。まあ、そっちの方が助かるかも。: Oh, I see. Well, that might be easier on me, honestly.
translations.男ってさ、やっぱり、その、強引にキスしたりするの好きなわけ？: So, do guys really like... um, kissing a girl kind of forcefully？
translations.やっぱりそうなの？ うーん、実はそんなに、イヤでもないっていうか。: So you really do？ Hmm, well, it's not like I mind it that much, actually.
translations.それって……こっちからのを待ってるとか？ 努力はするけど。: Does that mean... you're waiting for me to make the first move？ I'll try my best, I guess.
translations.そうなんだ……でもたまには……。: Oh, I see... Still, every once in a while...
translations.あのさ。リンコの、その……どこにスキンシップするのが楽しい？: Hey. Where do you like, um... touching me the most？
translations.そっか。こっちも、ほっとした気分になる。: I see. It makes me feel relaxed, too.
translations.へへ。ちょっと照れるね。: Hehe. It's a little embarrassing, though.
translations.そうなんだ。組んだりとか……ね。: Oh, I see. Like linking arms and stuff... right.
translations.そうだね、お互いのこと、ちゃんと感じられるし。: Yeah, we can really feel each other close that way.
translations.それって……キスってこと？ ストレート過ぎだっつーの。: Wait, you mean... kissing？ That's way too direct.
translations.あのさ、食べさせあうのって好き？: Hey, do you like feeding each other？
translations.うん、周りの目があるとちょっと……だけど。嫌いじゃないよ。: Yeah, it's a little awkward with people watching... but I don't dislike it.
translations.実はこういうの、憧れだったり……とかね。: To tell the truth, I kind of always wanted to try this... or something.
translations.まあ、食事って恋人同士にとって、重要なファクターらしいからね。: Well, sharing a meal is apparently an important factor for a couple.
translations.そうなの？ リンコは嫌いじゃないんだけど。: Really？ I don't mind it, personally.
translations.ふーん。食べさせてもらうのたまになら、悪くないんだけど。: Hmm. Having you feed me once in a while isn't so bad, though.
translations.それ……照れてるってこと？: Wait... does that mean you're embarrassed？
translations.あのさ。最近睡眠ちゃんととってる？: Hey. Have you been getting enough sleep lately？
translations.あのさ。ちゃんと運動してる？: Hey. Have you been getting enough exercise？
translations.あのさ。食事は３食ちゃんと食べてる？: Hey. Have you been eating three proper meals a day？
translations.あのさ。おやつたくさん食べすぎてない？: Hey. You haven't been eating too many snacks, have you？
translations.あのさ。ちゃんと暖かくして寝てる？: Hey. Are you staying warm enough when you sleep？
translations.あのさ。寝るときはちゃんとクーラー消してる？: Hey. Do you make sure to turn off the AC before going to sleep？
translations.ちゃんと答えてよ。ほら。: Give me a straight answer. Come on.
