translations.カノジョとして、気にしときたいんだけど。: As your girlfriend, I want to keep track of this stuff.
translations.言いたくないならいいけど、心配してるってこと、わかってよ。: If you don't want to say, fine, just know that I'm worried about you.
translations.へえ、完璧じゃん。ちゃんとしてんだ。: Huh, that's perfect. You're really on top of things.
translations.ちゃんとしてるね。やるじゃん。: You're taking good care of yourself. Not bad.
translations.ある程度は……って感じか。ちょっと心配、気をつけてよ。: So, more or less... huh. That worries me a little. Be careful, okay？
translations.ほんとに？ 改善しないと、体壊すよ？: Seriously？ If you don't fix that, you're gonna make yourself sick, you know？
translations.……ダメじゃん！ もっとちゃんとする！ カノジョに心配かけないでよ……。: ...That's no good! Take better care of yourself! Don't make your girlfriend worry...
translations.ちゃんと寝ないと、疲れとれないじゃん。リンコが言うのもなんだけどさ。: If you don't sleep properly, you won't shake off the fatigue. Not that I'm one to talk.
translations.運動も適度にしたほうがいいんじゃない。リンコも……まあ、がんばるよ。: You should probably get a decent amount of exercise, too. I'll... well, I'll try my best too.
translations.ご飯はきちんと食べようよ。なんなら、作るしさ。: Make sure you eat proper meals. If you want, I'll even cook for you.
translations.間食ばっかだと、よくないよ。リンコも気をつけるからさ、ポテチとか。: Eating nothing but snacks isn't good for you. I'll watch the potato chips and stuff, too.
translations.風邪ひくっつーの。ちゃんと暖かくして寝ること。: You're gonna catch a cold. Make sure you stay warm when you sleep.
translations.ダメじゃん。クーラーつけっぱなしだと、よくないよ。: That's no good. Leaving the AC on all night isn't good for you.
translations.今日出かけたところさ、楽しかったね。: That place we went to today was fun, wasn't it？
translations.あのさ、この間出かけたところ、楽しかったよね。: Hey, that place we went to the other day was fun, wasn't it？
translations.いろんなミニゲームが遊べたもんね、またやろうよ。: We got to play all kinds of mini-games. Let's do it again.
translations.写真がプリントされてさ、そういう記念が残るのっていいよね。: Having the photos printed out like that is nice. It's great to have a keepsake.
translations.メダルゲームってテンションあがるね！ またやりたいかも。: Medal games really get you pumped up! I think I want to play again.
translations.ジャックポットすごかった！ あれはまた見たいよ。: That jackpot was amazing! I definitely want to see that again.
translations.スクラッチカードもらえたしね。また行こうよ。: Plus we got a scratch card. Let's go again.
translations.はあ!? いきなりそんな…………リンコも、とか言わせたいわけ。: Huh!? Out of nowhere...... What, are you trying to get me to say 'me too'？
translations.そんな言葉じゃごまかされないんですけど。: You're not fooling me with sweet talk, you know.
translations.うん……リンコも……その、愛し、てる。: Yeah... I... um, love you, too.
translations.え……リンコも言わなきゃダメ？ ううん、やっぱダメ。でも思ってるから。: Huh... Do I have to say it too？ No, I really can't. But I feel the same way.
translations.こんなとこでさらっと言うなっつーの。……うれしいけどさ。: Don't just casually drop that here. ...It makes me happy, though.
translations.言葉だけなら、なんとでも言えるけどね……。: Anyone can just say the words, you know...
translations.うん、その……一応大好き。一応じゃなくても、うん。: Yeah, um... I guess I love you. Well, even without the 'I guess,' yeah.
translations.……好きだけど……もうちょっとリンコのこと考えてよ。: ...I do like you, but... try to think about me a little more.
translations.……このタイミングで聞く？: ...You're really asking me that right now？
translations.別にいいけど……ちゃんとリンコのこと考えてよ。: I don't really mind, but... think about how I feel a little more.
translations.……うん。まあ、少しだけなら。: ...Yeah. Well, if it's just for a bit.
translations.しょうがないな……はいはい。: What am I gonna do with you... Fine, fine.
translations.今……？ もうちょっと空気読んでほしいんですけど。: Right now...？ I really wish you'd learn to read the room.
translations.はあ、すぐそういうこと言うし。: Honestly, you always jump right to saying stuff like that.
translations.自分で言ってて照れないわけ？: Don't you get embarrassed saying that stuff yourself？
translations.リンコたち、こんなことばっか考えてるみたいじゃん。: It makes it look like this is all we ever think about.
translations.こんな話、恋人ならではだよね。: Talking like this is really a couple thing, huh.
translations.こういうの、いいよね。: This kind of thing is nice, isn't it.
translations.なんかダメ、勝手に顔が笑っちゃいそうになる。: Ugh, it's no use. I can't stop myself from smiling.
translations.え、顔赤くなってる？ しょうがないじゃん。: Huh, my face is red？ Well, I can't help it.
translations.恥ずかしいけど、うれしい……。: It's embarrassing, but... it makes me happy.
translations.あのさ、リンコも聞いていい？: Hey, can I ask you something too？
translations.そっちばっかりずるい。: It's not fair if it's only ever you.
translations.リンコからも。いいよね？: My turn now. That's okay, right？
translations.今度はリンコが聞く番。: Now it's my turn to ask.
translations.あのさ、こっちから聞くけど。: Hey, let me ask you something now.
translations.▲新主人公▲。……なんて呼ばれるの、どう？: ▲新主人公▲. ...What do you think of me calling you that？
translations.そっか……へへ、じゃあ今度からそう呼んでみる？: I see... Hehe, maybe I'll try calling you that from now on？
translations.▲新主人公▲。んー、やっぱりなし。なんか恥ずかしいから。: ▲新主人公▲. Hmm, actually, never mind. It's kind of embarrassing.
translations.なんだ、やっぱそう。ちょっと面白かったけど。: Oh, figures. It was kind of fun, though.
translations.あのさ……秘密の話なんだけど……ちょっと耳かして。: Hey... it's a secret, so... lend me your ear a sec.
translations.耳、近づけてよ？ ……他の人に聞かれたくないから。: Bring your ear closer, okay？ ...I don't want anyone else to hear.
translations.聞こえてる？ 聞こえてたら、“聞こえてる”って大きな声で言って？: Can you hear me？ If you can, say "I can hear you" nice and loud, okay？
translations.ずっと一緒にいたいな……。: I want to stay with you forever...
translations.リンコは、アンタだけ……。: You're the only one for me...
translations.もうすぐ年末か……合法的夜更かしのチャンスだね。: Almost the end of the year, huh... A chance to stay up late legally.
translations.年末年始、楽しかったね。ちょっと大人になった感じがする。: New Year's was fun, huh. I feel a little more grown-up now.
translations.もうすぐバレンタインか……さて、どうしよっかな。: Valentine's Day is almost here... Now, what should I do.
translations.バレンタイン、どうだった？ リンコは結構満足だったんだけど。: How was Valentine's Day？ I was pretty happy with how it went.
translations.もうすぐホワイトデーか……もうすぐホワイトデーか。: White Day's almost here... White Day's almost here.
translations.もうすぐエイプリルフールか……リンコの脳細胞が最強の嘘を生み出すよ。: April Fools' is almost here... My brain cells are gonna come up with the ultimate lie.
translations.エイプリルフール、結構楽しかったかも。: April Fools' was actually pretty fun.
translations.もうすぐ遠足か……定番の質問シリーズ！ バナナは！ ……やっぱやめた。: The field trip's coming up... Time for the classic question! Do bananas count as— ...Actually, never mind.
translations.遠足、楽しかったね。疲れるけど……それでもやっぱり楽しかった。: The field trip was fun, huh. Tiring, sure... but still really fun.
translations.もうすぐ合唱コンクールか……。独唱コンクールはないのかな。: The choir competition is coming up... I wonder why there's no solo competition.
translations.合唱コンクール、楽しかったね。へへ、感動しちゃった。: The choir competition was fun. Hehe, I actually got a little moved.
translations.もうすぐ七夕か……おお、彦星。どうしてあなたは彦星なの!?: Tanabata's almost here... O Hikoboshi, wherefore art thou Hikoboshi!？
translations.七夕、結構楽しかったかも。行事はきちんとやるもんだね。: Tanabata was actually pretty fun. Guess it pays to do traditional events properly.
translations.もうすぐ十羽野祭りか……。リンコのお祭り好きな一面、見られるかもよ。: The Towano Festival is coming up... You might get to see my festival-loving side.
translations.十羽野祭り、盛り上がったね！ やっぱ祭りはああじゃないと。: The Towano Festival was a blast! That's how a festival should be.
translations.もうすぐ体育祭か……もうすぐ体育祭かあ……。: Sports Day is almost here... Sports Day is almost here, huh...
translations.体育祭、楽しかった！ 競技はめんどくさいけど、イベントとして楽しめればオッケーだ: Sports Day was fun! Competing is a pain, but as long as you enjoy the event itself, it's all good.
translations.もうすぐハロウィンか……トリックアンドトリート！ ってのはなし？: Halloween's almost here... How about 'Trick AND Treat!'？ No good？
translations.ハロウィン意外と盛り上がったね。悪くないかも。: Halloween was surprisingly lively. Not bad at all.
translations.もうすぐ文化祭か……今年の文化祭は期待できる！ 気がする！: The school festival is coming up... We can expect great things this year! I think!
translations.文化祭さ、やっぱりいい思い出になった。へへ。: The school festival really turned into a great memory. Hehe.
translations.クリスマス、ありがと。最高の思い出になったよ。: Thanks for Christmas. It made for the best memory.
translations.あのさ、もうすぐ誕生日でしょ。ほしいものって何かある？: Hey, your birthday's coming up, right？ Is there anything you want？
translations.リンコにも用意できるかな？: Think that's something I could get for you？
translations.がんばってみる。無理だったらごめんね。: I'll see what I can do. Sorry if I can't pull it off.
translations.もうすぐリンコの誕生日だなー。ほしいもの、わかる？: My birthday's coming up soon. Do you know what I want？
translations.正解は……まずはやっぱりアンタからのお祝いの言葉。へへ。: The right answer is... first off, hearing you say happy birthday, of course. Hehe.
translations.正解は……いつもよりちょっとだけ特別な……キス、とかね。: The right answer is... a kiss that's a little more special than usual... Maybe.
translations.正解は……もちろん、アンタと過ごす特別な時間。: The right answer is... special time spent with you, of course.
translations.あのさ、記念日はどうやって過ごす？: Hey, how should we spend our anniversary？
translations.一日一緒にいられるだけで、うれしいんだけどさ。: Just getting to be together all day makes me happy, though.
translations.やっぱり、そうだな……二人の記念の物、ほしいよね。: You know, I think... I'd really like something to commemorate the two of us.
translations.そっか……じゃあ、考えとく。: I see... Okay, I'll think about it.
translations.あのさ、今年の抱負ってなに？: Hey, what's your New Year's resolution？
translations.へえ、いいんじゃない。リンコも応援するからさ。: Huh, sounds good to me. I'll be rooting for you, too.
translations.リンコの抱負は……今年もたくさん二人で一緒にいること。へへ。: My resolution is... for the two of us to spend lots of time together this year, too. Hehe.
translations.リンコの抱負は……去年よりもっとアンタを好きになること、とかね。: My resolution is... to fall for you even more than last year, maybe.
translations.今月ももう終わりか……。あのさ、最近一番楽しかったことって何？: This month is already over, huh... Hey, what's the most fun thing you've done lately？
translations.リンコは……春の限定ポテチかな。毎年楽しみなんだよね。: For me... probably the limited-edition spring potato chips. I look forward to them every year.
translations.リンコは……やっぱりお花見、かな。桜好きだし。: For me... probably seeing the cherry blossoms. I do like them.
translations.リンコは……なにげない散歩かな。春の散歩ってそれだけでウキウキしてくるし。: For me... just taking casual walks, maybe. Walking around in the spring puts me in a good mood all on its own.
translations.リンコは……夏だし、海に行ったことかな。定番すぎ？: For me... since it's summer, going to the beach, I guess. Too cliche？
translations.リンコは……かき氷。あれを食べないと、夏って感じがしないって。: For me... shaved ice. It really doesn't feel like summer until I've had some.
translations.リンコは……花火かな。大きな花火大会もいいけど、コンビニに売ってる花火も捨てがた: For me... fireworks, maybe. Big fireworks shows are nice, too, but the ones from the convenience store are hard to beat.
translations.リンコは……読書かな。読書の秋、当然だよね。: For me... reading, I guess. Autumn is the season for reading, so obviously.
translations.リンコは……料理、かな。食欲の秋ってわけじゃないけどさ、ちょっと気合入ったかも。: For me... cooking, maybe. Not just because of my autumn appetite or anything, I just got a little into it.
translations.リンコは……バーゲン、かな。買わなくても見てるだけで楽しいし。: For me... the sales, I guess. Even if I don't buy anything, it's fun just looking around.
translations.リンコは……やっぱりスキー。年中やりたいぐらいだよ。: For me... definitely skiing. I could practically do it all year round.
translations.リンコは……鍋かな。家族と鍋を囲むのって楽しいよね。: For me... hot pot, maybe. Sitting around a hot pot with your family is nice, isn't it？
translations.リンコは……雪がつもったことかな。コタツで丸くなるだけだけどね。: For me... when the snow piled up, maybe. Though all I do is curl up under the kotatsu.
translations.あのさ、今時間ある？ 暇だったら遊んでよ。: Hey, do you have time right now？ If you're free, let's play something.
translations.今なにしてる？ 少しくらい息抜きするよ。: What are you up to right now？ Let's take a little break.
translations.ねえ。暇してるんなら遊ぼ。: Hey. If you're not doing anything, let's play.
translations.どう、おもしろかった？ もう一回いっとく？: Well, was that fun？ Wanna go one more round？
translations.あのさ。なにして遊ぼっか？: So, what do you want to play？
translations.イーアルカンフーでリンコに挑戦してみる？: Want to take me on in Yie Ar Kung-Fu？
translations.じゃあ、それで。よーし……。: Okay, let's do that. All right...
translations.しないんだ。じゃあまた今度で。: Oh, you don't want to. Next time, then.
translations.じゃあさ、ジャストカウントって遊びしよ。リンコが時計で３０秒計るから、アンタは頭: Okay, let's play a game called Just Count. I'll time 30 seconds on my watch, so count 30 seconds in your head and say "Now!" when time's up.
translations.じゃあはじめるよ。よーい、スタート。: Okay, here we go. Ready, start.
translations.残念。まだ３０秒たってないよ。: Too bad. It hasn't been 30 seconds yet.
translations.おしい！ 残念、あと少しだったのに。: So close! Too bad, just a little longer.
translations.残念、遅かったね。“ハイ！”って言わないとだめだよ。: Too bad, too late. You have to say "Now!"
translations.あのさ、最近メールあんまりくれない気がするんだけど。: Hey, I feel like you haven't been texting me much lately.
translations.アンタって意外とマメだよね。いつもメールくれてさ……ありがと。: You're surprisingly attentive, huh. Always texting me... Thanks.
translations.最近あんまりデートしてないんじゃない？ 忙しいならワガママ言わないけどさ……たま: We haven't really gone on many dates lately, have we？ If you're busy, I won't be selfish, but... I want to go out once in a while.
translations.いつもいろんなトコに連れてってくれてありがと。いつも次のデート、楽しみにしてる。: Thanks for always taking me to all kinds of places. I'm always looking forward to our next date.
translations.最近あんまり呼び出してくれないよね。短い時間でも話せた方がいいじゃん。: You haven't asked me to meet up much lately, huh. Even if it's just for a little bit, it's better if we can talk.
translations.会いたいなって思ってると、いつも呼び出してくれるよね。以心伝心って感じする。: Whenever I'm thinking I want to see you, you always ask me to meet up. Feels like we're on the same wavelength.
translations.最近さ、カノジョとして見てくれてるのか不安になる。もっと……スキンシップとかさ。: Lately, I get worried whether you still see me as your girlfriend. I want more... physical affection and stuff.
translations.へへ……いつもアンタの温もり感じてるよ。スキンシップ、必要だよね。: Hehe... I can always feel your warmth. Being affectionate like that is important, right？
translations.リンコの話、ちゃんと聞いてくれてるよね。まあ、恋人同士なんだし、会話中のスキンシ: You really listen when I talk, huh. Well, we are a couple, so touching me a little while we're talking... wouldn't be out of the question.
translations.最近、よく会話中にスキンシップしてくるよね。へへ、落ち着けっつーの。: You've been pretty handsy while we're talking lately, huh. Hehe, calm down already.
translations.リンコのこと、大切にしてくれてるよね。強引にキスしたり……しないし。でもたまにな: You really treat me well, don't you. You never force a kiss on me or anything... Though once in a while... I wouldn't mind.
translations.最近積極的だよね、キス。別に絶対イヤってわけじゃないけど。: You've been pretty bold with your kisses lately. Not that I'm totally against it or anything.
translations.キス……少ない気がする。: I feel like... we haven't been kissing much lately.
translations.キスをするたびに幸せになる……つまり、今は幸せってことだね。: Every time we kiss, I feel happy... Which means I'm plenty happy right now.
translations.二人の距離がさ、どんどん近づいてると思うんだよね。……いいね、こういうの。: I feel like the two of us keep getting closer and closer. ...I like this.
translations.ね。今の二人ってベストカップルって感じしない？: Hey. Don't you think we make the perfect couple right now？
translations.あのさ、この間紹介してくれた人って、最近会ってる？: Say, have you seen that friend you introduced me to lately？
translations.この前紹介してくれた人いたじゃん？ あの人元気？: Remember that friend you introduced me to before？ How are they doing？
translations.ダブルデートっていうの？ ああいうのも、楽しいよね。: A double date, right？ Doing things like that is pretty fun, too.
translations.ダブルデートってさ、なんか参考になるかも。: You know, going on a double date actually gives you a lot of pointers.
translations.この前さ、カレシがいる友達と話したんだけど、面白かったよ。: I was talking with a friend who has a boyfriend the other day. It was pretty interesting.
translations.あのさ、この前お互いのカレシについて友達と話したんだ。……ガールズトークってやつ: So, a friend and I talked about our boyfriends the other day. ...What you'd call girl talk. Hehe.
translations.心配？ 大丈夫。変なこと言うわけないじゃん。: Worried？ Relax. It's not like I'd say anything weird about you.
translations.んー、のろけたりは……したかもね。: Hmm, I might've... bragged about you a little, though.
translations.メール送ったんだけど、ちゃんとチェックした？ 忘れたりしてない？: I sent you a message earlier. Did you check it？ You didn't forget, did you？
translations.留守電にメッセージ入れといたんだけど、聞いた？ 急ぎじゃないけどさ、一応。: I left you a voicemail earlier. Did you listen to it？ It's nothing urgent, just making sure.
translations.WEBマガジン、更新されたみたい。新しい情報チェックしといたら？: Looks like the web magazine updated. Why don't you check out what's new？
translations.ほら、恥ずかしがらずにこっち向く。顔、こっち向けて。: Come on, don't be shy. Look at me. Turn your face this way.
translations.もう少し正面。ほら、しゃきっとする。: Face me a little more. Come on, sit up straight.
translations.んー、よく見えない……。: Hmm, I can't see you very well...
translations.うん、そこそこ。そのままにしてて。: Yeah, right there. Stay just like that.
translations.あっ、動いた？ じっとしてて。: Ah, did you move？ Hold still.
translations.その位置。今度は動かないでよ？: Right there. Don't move this time, okay？
translations.へへ。アンタの顔……よく見えるよ。: Hehe. I can see your face... really well now.
translations.ん？ もしかしてイメチェンした？: Hm？ Did you change up your look？
translations.こうやってさ、ずっとカレシのこと見てられたら幸せかも。: If I could just keep looking at my boyfriend like this forever, I think I'd be happy.
translations.目そらさないでよ……このまま。: Don't look away... Stay just like this.
translations.……なんかさ、こんなにじっと見つめられてると照れるね。: ...You know, having you stare at me this closely is kind of embarrassing.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。……好き。へへ。言ってみたくなった。: ▲主人公＊▲. ...I love you. Hehe. Just felt like saying it.
translations.やっぱりいつもと雰囲気違うね。……なんでだろ。: There really is something different about you today. ...I wonder what it is.
translations.ニヤニヤしない。……そんなにリンコの顔見るの、楽しい？: Quit grinning like that. ...Is looking at my face really that fun？
translations.付き合ってるとさ、自然と笑顔になるよね。: Being together like this just makes you smile naturally, doesn't it.
translations.アンタの笑顔……結構好きだよ。: I actually really like your smile, you know.
translations.あのさ……少し目閉じてくれない？ 絶対開けちゃダメ！ ……チュッ。: Hey... could you close your eyes for a sec？ No peeking! ...Mwah.
translations.頭なでてあげよっか？ 逆パターンってことでさ。: Want me to pat your head？ Turning the tables for a change.
translations.こういうのも新鮮でいいかも。……なでられるのも好きだけど。: Doing it this way is a nice change of pace. ...Though I still like it when you pat mine.
translations.あっ、どうした？ どこ行くの？: Ah, what's wrong？ Where are you going？
translations.ご褒美？ 覚えてたんだ……じゃ、もう一回勝負！ それで勝ったら写真も撮っていいよ: Your reward？ So you remembered... Fine, one more match! Beat me again and I'll let you take a photo, too. But if I win, you get nothing. Deal？
translations.じゃ、今度は本気出すから。次はそう簡単に勝たせないよ。: All right, I'm not holding back this time. I won't let you win so easily.
translations.しょうがないか……。約束だもんね、じゃあご褒美。: Guess I have no choice... A promise is a promise. Here's your reward.
translations.やった。リンコの勝ち！ ご褒美はなしだね。: Yes, I win! No reward for you.
translations.またリンコの負け？ はあ……あ、写真は１枚ね。: I lost again？ Ugh... Oh, and only one photo, okay？
translations.１枚だけだから。あと変な写真撮ったりしたら小キック。: Only one. And take anything weird, and you're getting a little kick.
translations.はい、おしまい。これで満足でしょ？: All right, we're done. That's enough for you, right？
translations.リンコの勝ち！ さあ、どんなご褒美をくれるのかな？: I win! Now, what kind of reward are you going to give me？
translations.じゃあ“リンコ愛してる”って大きな声で言ってみ？: Okay, let's hear you say "I love you, Rinko" out loud.
translations.ふうん、言えないんだ。……照れてる？: Hmm, can't say it, huh. ...Are you embarrassed？
translations.へへ。許してあげよっかな。照れたアンタの顔も見られたしね。: Hehe. Guess I'll let you off the hook. I got to see you blush, anyway.
translations.……改めて言われると、なんか。へへ、満足。: ...When you actually say it out loud, I don't know... Hehe, I'm satisfied.
translations.あのさ、ちょっといい？ 聞いて欲しいことがあるんだけど……。: Hey, do you have a second？ There's something I want you to hear...
translations.……やっぱいい。気が変わったから、また今度ね。: ...Never mind. I changed my mind. Maybe next time.
translations.一緒に出かけたり、他愛のない話をしてるだけでもさ、なんだかすごく大切な時間に思え: Just going out together and talking about nothing in particular... It all feels so precious to me.
translations.出会えて良かった。……なんて今さら？ でも、それが今の正直な気持ち。: I'm glad I met you. ...Kind of late to be saying that, huh？ Still, that's honestly how I feel right now.
translations.誰かを好きになるってさ、いいことだよね。: Falling in love with someone is a really nice thing, isn't it？
translations.なんかさ、“カノジョ”っていい響きだと思わない？ ……カレシとカノジョ。へへ。: Hey, don't you think "girlfriend" has a nice ring to it？ ...Boyfriend and girlfriend. Hehe.
translations.付き合い始めた頃は恥ずかしかったけど……今はもっとくっついていたいって……そんな: I used to be embarrassed when we first started dating... Now I just want to be even closer to you... That's what I've been thinking.
translations.あのさ……こんなこと言うの\n恥ずかしいんだけど……\nギュッてしてくれる？ \:
Hey... It's embarrassing
to say this, but...
will you hold me tight？
That alone makes me happy.
translations.あのさ、言葉にしないと伝わらないことってあるよね。特に大切なことはちゃんと言葉に: You know, some things don't get across unless you put them into words. Especially the important things. So... I love you.
translations.好き。……突然すぎる？ でも、言いたくなったんだから、いいでしょ。: I love you. ...Too sudden？ Well, I just felt like saying it, so it's fine, right？
translations.一回だけじゃ、リンコの想い伝えきれないから……何回でも言いたい。好き……大好きっ: Saying it once isn't enough to get my feelings across... so I want to say it over and over. I love you... I really love you.
translations.二人の思い出、思い返してたら……なんか泣けてきたんだよね。それくらい、大切で、好: I was looking back on our memories together... and I started tearing up a little. That's how much you mean to me. I love you.
translations.いまのリンコの気持ち。伝わった？: That's how I feel right now. Did it get through to you？
translations.前にもこの話、したっけ？ いいじゃん、これが今の素直な気持ちなんだからさ。: Did I already tell you this before？ Well, who cares. It's how I honestly feel right now.
translations.なに、また聞いてほしいことあるんだ。いいよ、いくらでも。: What, got something else you want me to listen to？ Sure, as much as you want.
translations.嫌なことでも、誰かに話せば楽になるかもよ？: Even when something's bothering you, talking about it might make you feel better, you know？
translations.無理してるんじゃない？ 大丈夫？: You're not pushing yourself too hard, are you？ Are you okay？
translations.リンコはいつでも味方。当たり前じゃん。: I'm always on your side. Obviously.
translations.がんばってる姿は好きだけど、無理だけはしないこと。: I like seeing you work hard, just don't overdo it.
translations.ほーらっ、暗い顔は似合わないよ？: Come on, a gloomy face doesn't suit you, you know？
translations.元気、わけてあげるから。ね。: I'll share some of my energy with you. Okay？
translations.たまには一休みするのもいいんじゃない？ いつもがんばってるし。: Why not take a breather every now and then？ You're always working so hard.
translations.嫌なことは今日で忘れて。明日からまたがんばろ。: Leave the bad stuff behind today. Let's start fresh tomorrow.
translations.ほら、気分転換にリンコと遊ぼ。: Come on, hang out with me for a change of pace.
translations.いつまでもくよくよしてないで、何か別のことしよ？: Stop moping around already and let's do something else, okay？
translations.辛いことがあったら、何でも言ってくれていいんだよ？: If you're going through a rough time, you know you can tell me anything, right？
translations.もう元気出た？ それなら良かった。: Feeling better already？ Good, I'm glad.
translations.あっ……と、今ロック中。アンタがリンコのカレシだってこと確認できたら解除してあげ: Oh... right, it's locked right now. Once I make sure you're really my boyfriend, I'll unlock it for you. Anyway, let me see your face.
translations.リンコをしっかり正面から見てよ。: Look right at me, straight on.
translations.ん……えっと、アイツの友達とか？: Hmm... Um, are you a friend of his or something？
translations.ちゃんと見えないんだけど……。もう一回いい？: I can't really see you clearly... Can we try that one more time？
translations.ん～……あのさ、顔じゃわかりにくかったから、名前言ってみてよ。: Hmm... Hey, I couldn't really tell from your face, so try saying your name.
translations.苗字と名前、きっちりフルネームでね。: First and last name—give me your full name properly.
translations.最初からアンタだってわかってたんだけどさ、へへっ。: I knew it was you right from the start, though. Hehe.
translations.なに？ ちゃんと聞こえなかった。: What？ I didn't quite catch that.
translations.それ……名前違うんだけど。じゃあさ、本人なら秘密のコマンド知ってるでしょ？: That's... not the right name. Well then, if it's really you, you know the secret code, right？
translations.コマンド忘れたとか？ しょうがないなぁ……じゃあ、最後のチャンスあげるから。: Did you forget the code or something？ Honestly... Fine, I'll give you one last chance.
translations.はっきりした声で“リンコあいしてるよ”って言ってみ。: Say "I love you, Rinko" loud and clear.
translations.やっとクリア。リンコを愛してるのはカレシに違いないもんね。: Finally passed. Anyone who loves me has gotta be my boyfriend, after all.
translations.なに言ってんの？ “リンコあいしてるよ”って言うんだってば。: What are you saying？ I told you to say, "I love you, Rinko."
translations.……なんか、根負けしちゃった。リンコに会うためにここまで頑張るってことは、アンタ: ...Okay, you wore me down. If you're trying this hard just to see me, it's definitely you, right...？
translations.しょうがないから今回は解除してあげる。次からはもっとシャキっと決めてよね。: Fine, I'll unlock it for you this time. Get it right without all the fuss next time, okay？
translations.今日はアイツとデート。待ち合わせして、いっぱい話して……たったそれだけ。なのにな: Had a date with him today. We met up, talked a bunch... and that was it. So why was it this much fun？ Having a boyfriend really is nice.
translations.今日は久しぶりのデートだった。もっとたくさんデートしたっていいのに……アイツ忙し: Went on a date today for the first time in a while. It wouldn't hurt to go out more often... Is he busy or something？ Well, it's not like I've got nothing to do either, though...
translations.ここのところ、デートばっかりしてる。アイツがしたいっていうなら、リンコは毎日デー: We've been doing nothing but going on dates lately. Not that I'd mind going out with him every single day, if that's what he wants.
translations.今日は学校帰りにデートしたおかげで、授業の疲れもふっとんじゃった。こういうご褒美: Thanks to our after-school date today, all my tiredness from class just vanished. With a reward like this, maybe I can actually try hard at school every day.
translations.今日のデートはいつもと雰囲気が違って……なんだかドキドキ。アイツも前もって色々計: Today's date had a different vibe than usual... It kinda made my heart race. Looks like he planned a bunch of things out ahead of time, too. I really couldn't ask for more as a girlfriend. ...Lucky me!
translations.ヤバいかも……今日のアイツ、最高！ なにも言わなくてもリンコの気持ちわかってるみ: Oh man... he was amazing today! It felt like he knew exactly how I felt without me saying a word, and he kept saying all the right things to make my heart flutter. I think I'm falling for him even harder.
translations.今日はいい気分で眠れそう。アイツが優しくて、むちゃくちゃ楽しいデートだったし。た: Feels like I'll sleep great tonight. He was so sweet to me, and the date was crazy fun. I bet he feels the same way, too. We were definitely on the exact same wavelength today.
translations.今日は普通にデート。普通に楽しかったし、アイツは普通に優しかったし。まあ、なんで: Just a normal date today. It was normal fun, and he was his normal sweet self. Well, they say normal is best anyway. Definitely a passing grade.
translations.特別なことがあるってわけじゃないのに、やっぱりデートって楽しい。それってきっと、: Even when nothing special happens, dates really are fun. That's gotta be because he likes me so much, right？ Well, I feel the same way about him, though.
translations.なんだろ……今日はイマイチだった、かも。ピントがズレてるっていうか……リンコのこ: I don't know... Today was kinda meh, maybe. Like we were out of sync, or... like he wasn't even looking at me... Oh well, guess I'll just have to bring my A-game next time!
translations.なんか落ち着かない……これ、絶対に今日のデートのせいじゃん。あんなデートだったら: I feel so restless... This is totally because of today's date. If it was gonna be like that, I'd rather we hadn't gone at all... He'd better make it up to me next time.
translations.今日、髪型褒められた。これはしっかり覚えておかなくちゃ。アイツはこういうのが好き: He complimented my hair today. I'd better make a mental note of this. So that's the style he likes, huh... Good to know.
translations.アイツの好みを考えて着ていった服が、バッチリ正解だったときって嬉しい。もっと好み: I love it when I pick out an outfit with his tastes in mind and totally nail it. I wanna figure out more of what he likes and make him call me cute.
translations.デートの帰り、アイツを家に誘ってみた。家族とか気になってイヤがるかな……なんて心: On the way back from our date, I invited him over to my place. I was worried he might not want to because of my family and all... but he came over surprisingly easily. Hanging out in my own room might actually be pretty nice.
translations.デートの帰り、家に誘われた。まだリンコと一緒にいたかったんだね。愛いヤツ。アイツ: He invited me over to his place after our date. Guess he still wanted to be with me. What a sweetheart. His place is actually pretty relaxing, though.
translations.今日、一緒に行った店は大当たりだった。あんなに美味しい料理が作れたら、アイツもリ: The place we went to eat today was a total jackpot. If I could cook food that good, I bet he'd fall head over heels for me all over again...
translations.今日の食事中、なんとなく食べさせあいっこみたいな感じになって……。照れくさいから: While we were eating today, we kinda ended up feeding each other... It was embarrassing so I hesitated a little, but we're a couple, so... there's nothing wrong with that, right？
translations.またアイツと食べさせあいっこ、しちゃった。しかもなんか、こういうの慣れてきてるか: We ended up feeding each other again today. And the worst part is, I think I'm actually getting used to it. Man, what is happening to me...
translations.今日はリンコの方から、イチャイチャしちゃったかも。だって、そうしたかったから。ど: I think I was the one getting all lovey-dovey with him today. I mean, I couldn't help it—I wanted to. Wonder what he thought... Think it made him happy？
translations.なんか、今日はアイツがベタベタしすぎで、ちょっと困った。まあ、嬉しいは嬉しいんだ: He was way too handsy today, and I didn't really know what to do with him. I mean, I'm happy he likes me and all, but... getting touched that much is kinda exhausting.
translations.今日はいいムードにもっていきたくて、リンコから積極的になってみた。なんだか、自然: I wanted to set the mood today, so I tried being the assertive one for a change. It kind of just happened naturally. I mean, I really do like him.
translations.キスの前にいい雰囲気になってきたと思ったのに、アイツが強引すぎて、ちょっとガッカ: Just when I thought the mood was right for a kiss, he got way too pushy. What a letdown. I wish he'd be a little more gentle with me.
translations.今日は思わずリンコからキスしにいっちゃった……。思い出すだけで、ジタバタしたくな: Today I ended up kissing him first without even thinking... Just remembering it makes me want to bury my face in my hands. Is it weird for a girlfriend to be the one to initiate a kiss？
translations.なんであんなにムチャなキスしてくるんだか。女子はもっと大切に扱うもんだよね。今度: I don't get why he has to kiss me so roughly like that. You're supposed to treat a girl with more care. Next time he tries pulling that, maybe I'll just kick him.
translations.今日はいっぱいキスしちゃった……。付き合ってるんだし、おかしくはないと思うけど…: We kissed so much today... We're going out, so I guess there's nothing weird about it, but... maybe we got a little too lost in our own world...
translations.思い出したら、また顔がアツくなってきた……。あんなにキスが止まらなくなるなんて、: Just thinking about it is making my face burn all over again... I don't even know what came over me, not being able to stop kissing like that. I was so swept up in the moment, I didn't even stop to worry if someone might see us.
translations.今日のリンコ、ちょっとヘンだったかな……。自分でもよくわからなかった。あんなに大: Was I acting a little strange today...？ Even I don't really know what came over me. What does it mean when I get that bold...？ Maybe that was just me being honest with my feelings...
translations.今日はいっぱい写真を撮られた。アイツが何考えてたのかはわかんないけど……まあ、楽: He took a ton of pictures of me today. No idea what was going through his head, but... well, it was fun, so whatever. I'll have him take some more sometime.
translations.写真撮られるのって、なんであんなに緊張するんだろ？ 絶対ヘンな顔に写ってると思う: Why do I get so nervous having my picture taken？ I bet my face looks super weird in them... If he's going to save them, I really wish he'd only keep the ones where I actually look good...
translations.アイツに写真撮られることになったのはいいんだけど、なんか恥ずかしかったな。リンコ: Letting him take my picture was fine and all, but it felt kind of embarrassing. Am I just overthinking it？ Why can't we just take normal pictures in a normal way？
translations.今日の天気はイマイチだったけど、リンコの心は晴天なり。相合傘しちゃったもんね。ふ: The weather was gloomy today, but inside I felt like it was nothing but blue skies. We got to share an umbrella, after all. Just the two of us under one umbrella... Yeah, maybe rain isn't so bad once in a while.
translations.ふたりでご飯食べに行くときって、アイツの好みを探るチャンスなんだよね。リンコが美: Going out to eat together is always a good chance to figure out his tastes. Though honestly, the best thing is when he likes the same food I do.
translations.最近、もっと料理上手くなりたいなって思う。アイツにもらった本見ながら練習でもしよ: Lately, I've been wanting to get better at cooking. Maybe I'll practice with that cookbook he gave me. If I can make a really good meal, I'm sure he'll be happy too.
translations.アイツを家に呼んで晩ご飯作ってあげたら、すごく喜んでくれた。おかげでリンコも大満: I invited him over and made him dinner, and he loved it. Which left me feeling pretty proud of myself, too. Guess all that practice paid off. Maybe I'll cook for him again sometime.
translations.今日はリンコが晩ご飯を作って一緒に食べた。反応はそこそこ良かったかな？ 上手くい: Today I made dinner and we ate together. His reaction was pretty decent, I think？ It turned out okay, but next time I'm definitely going to make him say it's delicious.
translations.アイツに手料理食べさせたら、イマイチな感じだった……悔しいなあ。どこで失敗したん: I cooked for him today, and it didn't really go over too well... Ugh, how frustrating. Where did I mess up？ I have to practice more so I can really blow him away next time!
translations.今朝は、朝ごはんを作りにアイツの家に行った。朝ごはんの用意して一緒に家を出るって: I went over to his place this morning to make him breakfast. Fixing breakfast and leaving the house together felt like we were a married couple. ...Not that I'd ever say that out loud.
translations.お弁当を作るのって楽しい。アイツのためだったら不思議と苦じゃないんだよね。他の人: Making lunch is actually really fun. Strangely enough, when it's for him, I don't mind the effort at all. Doing it for anyone else would be a total pain, though... I just like seeing his face light up.
translations.今日、なぜか急にプレゼントもらった。一瞬、リンコが記念日忘れたのかと思って焦っち: Out of nowhere, he gave me a present today. For a second I panicked, thinking I'd forgotten an anniversary or something. A surprise gift, huh... Gotta hand it to him, that was pretty smooth.
translations.今日は一緒に勉強会をした。意外とアイツが頑張ってたからビックリ。よし、リンコも負: We studied together today. He actually worked way harder than I expected, which caught me off guard. Alright, I can't let him outdo me—I've gotta try hard too.
translations.せっかく一緒に勉強会したのに、アイツってばサボってばっか。こっちまでやる気なくし: We went to the trouble of studying together, and all he did was slack off. It completely killed my motivation, too... If I bomb my next test, I'm holding him responsible.
translations.なんだか最近、アイツにいっぱい呼び出されてる気がする。そんなに焦んなくてもリンコ: I feel like he's been asking me to meet up a lot lately. He doesn't have to be so needy—it's not like I'm going anywhere. Well, I guess it doesn't feel bad knowing he wants to see me.
translations.アイツが呼ぶから会いに行ったら、話すよりイチャイチャがメインって感じだった。アイ: He asked to meet up, so I went, and it felt like he was way more interested in getting handsy than actually talking. Is that all he cares about？ I mean, I guess it still means he likes me, but...
translations.なんでメール来ないんだろ。寂しいっつーの、バカ……。会ったり、電話で話したりも大: Why hasn't he texted me？ It's lonely, you idiot... Hanging out and talking on the phone are great and all, but texting is an important part of staying in touch, too.
translations.ちょっと最近メールしすぎてるかな。会って話すネタも残しとかないとね。あんまりメー: Maybe I've been texting him a little too much lately. I should probably save some things to talk about in person. Besides, I don't want to overwhelm him and become a nuisance.
translations.最近ちょっとイライラしてたけど、今日のアイツの言葉で、リンコの心はスッキリ元通り: I'd been feeling a little on edge lately, but what he said today completely cleared the air for me. I'm glad we managed to avoid a fight.
translations.アイツとケンカになっちゃったときはどうしようって思ったけど……ちゃんと話をしたら: When we got into a fight, I didn't know what to do... but once we actually talked things through, we were able to make up. I guess our wires just got crossed a little. I need to work on myself, too.
translations.風邪ひいてダルい……。でもアイツがお見舞い来てくれたから、ちょっと元気出てきたか: Caught a cold and I feel awful... But he came over to check on me, and I think it actually perked me up a little. He really is sweet.
translations.アイツが風邪ひいたっていうから、お見舞いに行った。思ったより元気そうで安心したけ: I heard he caught a cold, so I went to check on him. He looked better than I expected, which was a relief, but... I still can't help worrying a little. I hope he gets well soon...
translations.アイツに日記帳をもらった。毎日は無理かもしれないけど、できるだけ書くことにする。: He gave me a diary. I might not be able to keep up with it every single day, but I'll write in it as often as I can. I have a feeling most of it's going to be about him, though...
translations.今日は忘れることの出来ない、特別な記念日。こんな思い、自分一人じゃ感じられなかっ: Today is a special, unforgettable anniversary. I never could have known feelings like this all on my own. I'm really grateful to him for giving me the happiness of building another year together like this.
translations.今日はアイツの誕生日。プレゼント探しはちょっと苦労したけど、喜んでもらえたみたい: Today is his birthday. Picking out a present was a bit of a struggle, but he seemed to like it, so I'm glad. And just like that, he's another year older, and I'll never be able to catch up to him... Well, obviously.
translations.今日は誕生日。アイツも気の利いたプレゼントを用意してくれたけど、一番うれしいのは: Today is my birthday. He got me a really thoughtful present, too, but the gift isn't what makes me happiest. It's that he's always there by my side... That's what really makes me happy.
translations.今日はクリスマス、恋人たちの聖なる日ってやつ。本では何度も読んだし、街中でもよく: Today is Christmas—what they call a special night for lovers. I've read about it in books plenty of times and seen it all over town. All those things that used to feel like they belonged to someone else's world are slowly becoming part of mine.
translations.今日はバレンタイン。告白するならともかく、恋人同士のバレンタインって何のためにあ: Today is Valentine's Day. I get it if you're confessing to someone, but I always wondered what the point was for couples who are already together... Still, maybe it's there so we can remind each other how we feel.
translations.ホワイトデー。アイツからしっかりもらっちゃった。ホワイトデーは３倍返しって誰が決: It's White Day, and he made sure to get me something back. Who even came up with that rule about paying back three times as much on White Day？ Just getting something from him already makes it feel five times as special to me.
translations.今年はアイツと年越し。一年をまたぐ瞬間に一緒にいられるって……なんかすごい。今年: I rang in the New Year with him this time. Being together at the exact moment one year turns into the next... is kind of amazing. Here's to another good year with you.
translations.今日は文化祭。最初は期待してなかったけど、アイツと過ごしてみたら……意外に楽しか: Today was the school festival. I wasn't expecting much at first, but spending it with him... turned out to be surprisingly fun. Looks like I've got one more precious memory to hold on to.
translations.今日は憂鬱な体育祭。そんな風に思ってても、アイツがいれば楽しく過ごせる体育祭。ち: Today was the dreaded sports festival. Even though I was dreading it, having him there actually made it fun. I guess it wasn't half bad.
translations.今日、知らないやつに声をかけられた。いきなり編入してきて委員とかありえないし。邪: Some guy I don't know talked to me today. Transferring in out of nowhere and joining the committee is just ridiculous. He's only going to get in my way. He seems like a total pain, so I'm going to avoid him as much as I can.
translations.今日、ゲーセンでボコッた相手に絡まれた。ほんとサイアク。アイツが来てくれなかった: I got hassled today by some jerk I trashed at the arcade. Seriously the worst. Good thing that guy showed up when he did, or who knows what would've happened... Honestly, I was a little scared.
translations.勢いでアイツのことカレシとか言っちゃったけど、カレシとか意味わかんないし……。そ: I blurted out that he was my boyfriend in the heat of the moment, which doesn't even make sense... Like someone like him would ever be my boyfriend. As if... I barely even know the guy...
translations.今日はウチにあの人たちが来たから、出かけた。嫌いじゃないし、もちろん悪い人でもな: Those people came over to the house today, so I went out. I don't hate them, and of course they aren't bad people, I just can't do it. I'm only in the way there anyway, so I figured I'd get some fresh air and clear my head.
translations.それだけならいつも通りだけど……今日はかまってくれる奴がいた。アイツのおかげで、: Normally that'd be the end of it, except... someone actually kept me company today. Thanks to him, I think my mood lifted a little. Maybe it's just me, but having someone by my side might actually be kind of nice.
translations.ほんとは暑い日に外なんて出たくないけど、そうも言ってられない。あの人たちがウチに: I really hate going out on hot days, but I didn't have much choice. Those people were coming over, so I had to make myself scarce and stay out of the way. Besides... a certain nosy somebody came up and talked to me.
translations.あんなのでも一緒にいれば気晴らしになるかな……って。そこまで期待なんてしてなかっ: I figured even someone like him might take my mind off things... I didn't have high hopes or anything, but he might've proved me a little wrong.
translations.今日はなぜか動物園に行った。そこまで行きたかったわけじゃないけど、家にいづらかっ: For some reason, I ended up going to the zoo today. Not that I was dying to go or anything, it was just awkward being at home. And we only went to the zoo because he suggested it, not because I picked it.
translations.アイツってヘン。リンコのことなんかほっとけばいいのに、やたらからんでくるし。家に: He's such a weirdo. He should just leave me alone, but he keeps bothering me. I did feel a little lighter when I got home, though. Is that what they call animal therapy？ Or maybe it was because of him... Yeah, right.
translations.冬の海は好き。鈍色の海と空が混ざってて、どこから空で、どこからが海かわかんない感: I like the ocean in winter. The leaden gray sea and sky bleed together until you can't tell where one ends and the other begins. It kind of feels like the way I do inside whenever those people come over. Obviously he wouldn't know any of that, but he's the one who took me there.
translations.誘ったのただの気まぐれかな、リンコの事なんかほうっておけばいいのに。でもアイツの: Maybe he just invited me on a whim. He really should just leave me alone. Still, thanks to him, I feel like my own sky cleared up a little... or something like that. Maybe it's just my imagination.
translations.遊園地は嫌い。家族ばっかり目に付いて、今の自分のこと、色々考えちゃう。新しい家族: I hate amusement parks. All I ever notice are the families, and it makes me start overthinking everything about my life right now. My new family, my dad, me... It's not like those people did anything wrong, and my dad... isn't to blame either. I'm the only one who isn't handling it well. And because of that, I lash out at people who have nothing to do with it... and push everyone away...
translations.なのに、リンコのこと構ってくれる物好きが、今日、連れ出してくれた。最初はあんまり: Even so, the one weirdo who actually bothers with me took me out today. At first, I wasn't having much fun. I thought it might take my mind off things, but seeing all the families still got on my nerves. It's supposed to be a fun place, yet it felt like I was surrounded by enemies. And in the middle of all that, he was the one person who told me he'd be on my side.
translations.うれしかった。一人じゃないってわかっただけで、気持ちがすごく軽くなった。一緒にい: It made me really happy. Just knowing I wasn't alone took such a huge weight off my chest. I never knew how reassuring it could be just to have someone there with me. A special day spent with the person who taught me something so important. Today was my first date.
translations.お兄ちゃんがいたらきっとこんな感じなのかな？ 最初はそう思ってた。頼りになるし、: Is this what it's like having an older brother？ That's what I thought at first. He's reliable, and he pays attention to me whenever I look lonely. But somehow, I don't think that's quite it.
translations.お兄ちゃんじゃ……ないよね。だって、家族だったら、そばにいてドキドキなんてしない: He's not... like a brother, is he. If he were family, my heart wouldn't race just from being near him... And I wouldn't want to be with him all the time, or hold his hand, or have him look at me.
translations.気がついたらいつもアイツのことばっか考えてる……。この気持ち、どうしたらいいんだ: Before I know it, he's all I ever think about... What am I supposed to do with these feelings？ I guess that's one thing my 'big brother' can't teach me.
translations.リンコは妹なんかじゃない。そりゃ１歳年下だし、背だって少し低いかも知れないけど。: I'm not his little sister. Sure, I'm a year younger, and maybe I'm a little short. And okay, maybe I'm always causing him trouble, asking him for advice and having him help me out with everything.
translations.だからってそんな理由で妹だなんて、絶対違う。だって、そんなんじゃいつまでたっても: But treating me like a little sister just because of that is completely wrong. If that's all I am to him, things between us will never change.
translations.いつもそばに居てドキドキする。ちょっと体が触れたふれただけで、頭が爆発しそう。ア: My heart races whenever I'm next to him. Just brushing against him makes my head feel like it's gonna explode. A little sister is NOT what I want to be. I wonder if that stupid 'big brother' even gets that!
translations.リンコにお兄ちゃんがいたらどうだったんだろう。やっぱりすごく甘えちゃってたのかな: I wonder what it would've been like if I'd had an older brother. Would I have let myself be totally spoiled by him？ Always sticking close, wanting his attention, giving him a hard time... I wonder how it would've been.
translations.でもリンコはお兄ちゃんがほしいわけじゃない。いつもリンコを助けてくれて、ちょっと: Still, it's not an older brother I want. What I want is him—the guy who always helps me out, who's kind to me even when I give him a hard time, and... who promised he'd stay by my side.
translations.リンコがなりたいのは、そんなあなたのたった一人の特別な人。どうやったら伝わるのか: What I want to be is your one and only special person. Couldn't you tell me how to make you understand that？ I'm really at a loss here.
translations.今日もまた、図書室が騒がしかった。おしゃべりなら余所でやれっつーの。おまけに注意: The library was noisy again today. If you want to chat, go do it somewhere else, seriously. And then they have the nerve to snap back at me when I tell them to be quiet... It's exhausting. They act like a bunch of grade-schoolers. Unbelievable.
translations.そしたらまたアイツ……最近、なにかとからんでくるあの新入りがまた首を突っ込んでき: And then he showed up again... That new guy on the committee who's been bugging me lately stuck his nose into it again. I'm the one in the right here, and if that makes me a few enemies... then so what？ I wish he'd just leave me alone...
translations.今日はまたゲーセンに行ったけど……やっぱりボロボロだった、全然勝てない。対戦台に: I went back to the arcade today, but... I played terribly again. Couldn't win at all. Every time I sit down at a versus cabinet, I keep thinking that gorilla of a guy might barge in again... Thanks to that, I can't concentrate at all.
translations.でも今日声をかけてきたのは、アイツだった。ほんと、生活指導みたいっていうか、補導: Except the person who came up to me today was him. Seriously, what is he, a hall monitor or a truant officer or something？ He's only a year older than me. Still, the last time he came with me to the arcade, I played really well... What even is he to me, anyway...？
translations.今日のことはなんて書こうかな。なにかを書こうと思っても、上手く言葉が見つからない: How should I even write about today？ I want to put something down, but I can't find the right words. It'd be easy enough if I just wrote down what happened, and if a diary is only meant to be a record of events, maybe that'd be fine. But that's not it.
translations.今のリンコが書きたいのは出来事とかそういうのじゃなくて、リンコの気持ち。でも表現: What I want to write about right now isn't what happened—it's how I feel. Only I don't know how to express it. Because I've never felt anything like this before. Stringing together words I've read in books wouldn't do it justice. How do the people who write those books put feelings like this into words, anyway？ Um, anyway, I'm getting sidetracked.
translations.ちょっとしたきっかけで生まれた小さな気持ちが、大きくなって、どんどん大きくなって: A tiny feeling born from the smallest moment grew bigger, and bigger, and bigger. Until I couldn't hold it inside anymore, and I didn't know what else to do. It felt like it was going to crush me, so I decided to let it all out.
translations.どうなるかわからない。もしかしたら押しつぶされたままのほうが楽だったって、後悔す: I didn't know what would happen. For all I knew, I'd end up regretting it, wishing I'd just let those feelings crush me instead. Even so, I made up my mind. I wanted him to hear how I felt. I wanted the person I needed to tell most of all to hear me out. My true feelings. I love you.
translations.文字にしたらたったの２文字。本気で言うと、こんなに重いなんて。それからアイツ……: Written down, it's just three little words. Who knew they'd carry so much weight when you really mean them. And what that guy... what my boyfriend gave me in return... was a kiss.
translations.なんか最近さ、テニス部に仲良くしてる人、いるらしいじゃん。: So I hear you've been getting close with someone on the tennis team lately.
translations.なんか最近さ、バイト先で仲良くしてる人、いるらしいじゃん。: So I hear you've been getting close with someone at your part-time job lately.
translations.へー、ほんとにいるんだ。意外にやるじゃん。: Huh, so there really is someone. You're doing surprisingly well for yourself.
translations.まあまあ。いいねえ、青春だねえ。ヒューヒュー！: Now, now. Good for you, though. Ah, young love. Woo-hoo!
translations.（……なんか照れるな）: (...Man, now I feel kind of sheepish.)
translations.テニス部の例の人、最近どうなわけ？: So how have things been going with that girl on the tennis team？
translations.バイト先の例の人、最近どうなわけ？: So how have things been going with that girl from work？
translations.進展って。別にそういうのじゃ……。: Progress？ It's not really like that...
translations.またまたそんなこと言って。好きなんじゃないの？: Oh, come on, don't give me that. You like her, don't you？
translations.（さて、今日の図書委員もこれにて終了……あれ？ ▲小早川＊▲どこだ？）:
(Well, that's it for library
duty today... Huh？ Where'd
▲小早川＊▲ go？)
translations.屋上で待ってるから来て。\nリンコ:
Waiting on the roof. Come up.
Rinko
translations.どうしたんだよ。こんなとこ呼び出して……ハァ。: What's wrong？ Calling me out to a place like this... *pant*
translations.そんなに慌てちゃってさ、またリンコが泣いてると思った？: Look at you, in such a rush. Did you think I was up here crying again？
translations.ただ……お礼言いたくてさ。改めて。: I just... wanted to say thank you. Properly.
translations.リンコが困ってると、助けてくれたじゃん。: Whenever I was in trouble, you helped me out.
translations.ゲーセンで絡まれたときも、家族のことも……リンコが一人でいると、助けてくれたじゃ: When those guys hassled me at the arcade, and with my family... Whenever I was all alone, you helped me.
translations.アンタさ、ほんとにお兄ちゃんみたい。: You're really like a big brother to me.
translations.そうだな、▲小早川＊▲も妹みたいだ。: Yeah, and you're like a little sister to me, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.これからも……リンコの……アタシのお兄ちゃんでいてくれる？: From now on... will you keep being Rinko's... I mean, my big brother？
translations.ああ、まだまだ目が離せないからな。: Yeah. Can't take my eyes off you just yet, after all.
translations.へへ、調子にのんなっつーの。: Hehe. Don't let it go to your head.
translations.本当にありがとう。これからもさ、そばにいてよ。: Thank you, really. Stick by me from now on, okay？
translations.（屋上……まさか、また……）:
(The roof... Don't tell me,
not again...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲に告白されたときのこと、思い出すな……）:
(Reminds me of when
▲小早川＊▲ confessed to me...)
translations.なにやってんの？ 屋上にいるよ。\nリンコ:
What are you doing？
I'm on the roof.
Rinko
translations.（なにって、そっちこそ……屋上……まさかまた……）:
(What am I doing？ What about
you... The roof... Don't tell
me, not again...)
translations.（夕焼け？ 屋上にいるのか……まさか……）:
(The sunset？ Is she on the
roof...？ Don't tell me...)
translations.やれやれ、カノジョがいるってのに。ほら、おしまい。:
Good grief, and you already
have a girlfriend. All right,
that's enough.
translations.あのさ、リンコ……ちょっと変わった気がしない？:
Hey, don't you feel like...
I've changed a little？
translations.ああ、見た目じゃなくてさ。ほら、内面的な。:
Oh, not how I look.
You know, on the inside.
translations.内面……そういや、なんか大人しいな。:
On the inside... Now that you
mention it, you do seem a bit
quieter.
translations.そう。ちょっと落ち着いた感じになろうかなって。:
Yeah. I thought I'd try
being a little calmer.
translations.んー、なんとなく。アンタがそういう方がいいかなって。:
Hmm, no real reason. Just
thought you might like me
better that way.
translations.（落ち着いた▲小早川＊▲か……いいかもな）:
(A calmer ▲小早川＊▲, huh...
That could be nice.)
translations.リンコ、ちょっと変わったよね。:
I've changed a little,
haven't I？
translations.ジロジロ見んなっつーの、蹴るよ。:
Quit staring at me,
or I'll kick you.
translations.……たしかに。なんか、怖いな。:
...You really have. You're
kind of scary.
translations.怖いっていうか……さ。こう、強気な感じでいこうかなって思ったわけ。:
Not scary, just... you know.
I figured I'd try being a bit
more feisty.
translations.まあ、蹴られるのはイヤだけど……。:
Well, I'd rather not get
kicked, though...
translations.それは冗談。でもさ、こういう感じ、アンタ嫌いじゃないかなって思って。:
That part was a joke. But I
figured you might not mind
me being like this.
translations.（強気な▲小早川＊▲か……いいかもな）:
(A feisty ▲小早川＊▲, huh...
That could be nice.)
translations.ねえ、リンコ、なんか雰囲気変わったと思わない？:
Hey, don't you think my vibe
has changed a little？
translations.もう、わかってよ。リンコ、悲しいんですけど。:
Come on, notice already.
You're making me sad here.
translations.そう、それそれ。素直で明るいリンコちゃん。悪くないんじゃない？:
Yeah, exactly. Honest,
cheerful Rinko. Not bad,
right？
translations.でも、なんで急に？: But why all of a sudden？
translations.なんとなくだけど、こうしてた方が、アンタももっと嬉しいかなって思ってさ。:
No big reason. Just figured
you might be happier if I
acted like this.
translations.（素直な▲小早川＊▲か……いいかもな）:
(An honest ▲小早川＊▲, huh...
That might be nice.)
translations.なあ、▲小早川＊▲。ウイニングバーガーってよく行く？:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Do you go
to Winning Burger much？
translations.かなりね。ヘビーユーザーだよ。:
Quite a bit. I'm a big-time
regular.
translations.そっか、高校生だもんな。:
Right, you're a high
schooler, after all.
translations.なにそれ。まあ、たしかに高校生は多いけど。:
What's that supposed to mean？
Though yeah, there are a lot
of high schoolers.
translations.うちの学校で入ったことがない奴って、いるかな。:
I wonder if there's anyone at
our school who's never been.
translations.えー、どうだろ。いないんじゃないの？:
Hmm, who knows. Probably not,
right？
translations.あのさ、▲小早川＊▲。とわのウォッチャーって知ってるよな。:
Say, ▲小早川＊▲. You know
Towano Watcher, right？
translations.あんまり遊びなれてない人間が、雑誌だけを頼りに他人を遊びに連れて行くのってどうか:
What do you think of someone
who doesn't get out much
using only a magazine to show
people around？
translations.経験に勝るものなし、でしょ。他に誰かがついてればいいかもだけど。:
Nothing beats experience,
right？ Though it might be fine
if someone else tags along.
translations.なあ、▲小早川＊▲。デートの付き添いのための練習に行く、ってどう思う？:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. What do you
think about going on a
practice run to chaperone a
date？
translations.よくわかんないけど……それってデートなんじゃないの？:
I don't really get it, but...
isn't that just a date？
translations.なに、デートに誘われたとか？ まさかね。:
What, did someone ask you
out on a date？ As if.
translations.なあ、▲小早川＊▲。バイト先の先輩にご飯に誘われたら、どうする？:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. What would
you do if a senior coworker
asked you out to eat？
translations.その先輩の、先輩度合いにもよるだろうけど……深く考える必要ないんじゃない？:
Depends on how senior they
are, I guess... but no need
to overthink it, right？
translations.その先輩が嫌いなわけでもないなら、なおさらでしょ。:
Especially if it's not like
you dislike them.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……嫌いなわけないけど）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... There's no way
I dislike her, though.)
translations.バイト先で新メニューのアイディアを出してくれって言われたんだよ。:
They asked me at work to come
up with ideas for a new menu
item.
translations.えー、なんかめんどくさそう。それってバイトの仕事？:
Ugh, sounds like a pain. Is
that even a part-timer's job？
translations.なにか役得があるなら、別だけどさ。:
Unless there's some kind of
perk to it, I guess.
translations.（役得……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒に出かけられるな……）:
(A perk... I'd get to go out
with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I guess...)
translations.一緒に出かける約束したら、果たさないとダメだよな。:
If you promise to go out
with someone, you have to
keep it, right？
translations.そりゃあ、そうでしょ。約束したんだから。:
Well, yeah, obviously. You
made a promise.
translations.約束破るのは人として無責任なんじゃない。:
Breaking a promise is just
irresponsible as a person.
translations.（まあ、そうだよな……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲との約束、どうしよう）:
(Yeah, she's right... What am
I gonna do about my promise
to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？)
translations.なに、ぼーっとして……あ、いつもそっか。:
What are you spacing out
for... Oh, right, you're
always like that.
translations.ちょっと……ほんとなに？ ヘン。:
Hey... seriously, what is it？
You're acting weird.
translations.▲小早川＊▲は、●のカノジョなんだなって。:
Thinking how, ▲小早川＊▲,
● really have you as
my girlfriend.
translations.……そうだな。なに言ってんだ、●。: ...Yeah, you're right. What am ● even saying？
translations.別に、いいけど……。: I mean, I don't mind, but...
translations.そうじゃないけど、ただいろいろ思い出しててさ。: Not really. I was just thinking back on things.
translations.●たちが出会って、いろいろあって――: How ● first met you, everything we went through—
translations.思い出して、なんか発見あった？: Did you come to some big realization looking back？
translations.やっぱり●には、▲小早川＊▲しかいないなって……。: Just that ● really couldn't be with anyone but ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.そういうの、わかるよ。: I get what you mean, though.
translations.アンタと付き合う前のこと思い出したり、ってさ。: Thinking back to before we started going out, and all that.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲が●のカノジョでよかったな……）: (I'm so glad ▲小早川＊▲ is the one ● get to call my girlfriend...)
translations.職員室まで持って行って。一週間以内に。:
Take it to the staff room.
Within a week.
translations.まあいいよ。ついでだし。:
Sure, I don't mind.
I'm heading that way anyway.
translations.よろしく。アタシ、職員室に近づきたくないから。:
Thanks. I don't want to go
anywhere near the staff room.
translations.自分でやれって。▲小早川＊▲の用事なんだろ？:
Do it yourself, ▲小早川＊▲.
It's your errand, isn't it？
translations.（▲小早川＊▲のノート渡さないと……先生どこかな）:
(I need to hand in ▲小早川＊▲'s
notebook... Where's the teacher？)
translations.持って行ってくれたんだ。: So you took it in for me.
translations.ああ、前に頼まれたやつな。ちゃんと先生に渡したぞ。:
Yeah, the one you asked me
about. Handed it right to
the teacher.
translations.（礼はなし、か……まだ素っ気ないな）:
(Not even a thank-you, huh...
She's still pretty cold.)
translations.なんで持って行ってないわけ。:
How come you didn't
take it in？
translations.あー……なんか、タイミング合わなくて……。:
Uh... I just couldn't find
the right time...
translations.ねえ、アタシの代わりに図書委員の仕事やって。:
Hey, do my library duty
for me.
translations.別にいいけど……なんで？:
I don't really mind,
but... why？
translations.やだよ、そんなの。: No way, I'm not doing that.
translations.（そういえば、▲小早川＊▲に仕事代わってくれって言われてたな……）:
(Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲
asked me to cover her duty...)
translations.仕事、ほんとに代わってくれたんだ。:
You actually covered my duty
for me.
translations.（そこはありがとうだと思うんだけどな……）:
(Pretty sure that's where you're
supposed to say thanks...)
translations.仕事サボったでしょ。代わってって言ったのに。:
You skipped out on library duty,
didn't you？ Even though I asked
you to cover for me.
translations.さっきアタシが先生に怒られたんだけど。:
I just got chewed out by
the teacher because of that.
translations.（まあ、約束破ったのは悪いか……）: (Well, I guess it's my fault for breaking my promise...)
translations.これ。３日後までに未返却リスト作っといて。: Here. Have the overdue list done in three days.
translations.ムリだって: No way I can do that
translations.まあ、これも委員の仕事覚える勉強だと思ってな。: Well, I figure it's good practice for learning the committee work.
translations.急に言われてもムリだって。: There's no way I can do that on such short notice.
translations.ヒマなくせに……。: Like you've got anything better to do...
translations.（ヒマってわけでもないんだけどな……）: (It's not like I'm totally free, though...)
translations.（そういえば、▲小早川＊▲から未返却リスト作れって頼まれてたな……）: (Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ asked me to make that overdue list...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲から頼まれてるリスト作んないと……）: (I still need to make that list ▲小早川＊▲ asked for...)
translations.未返却リスト、ちゃんと出来たんだ。: Oh, you actually finished the overdue list.
translations.まあな、結構必死だったけど。: Yeah, though I really had to scramble.
translations.未返却リスト、出来てないし。: You didn't even finish the overdue list.
translations.ああ……ちょっと時間が足りなかったな……。: Yeah... I kind of ran out of time...
translations.なあ、それ。▲小早川＊▲ってどんな音楽聴いてるんだ？: Hey, what's that？ What kind of music do you listen to, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.……言ってもわかんないからいい。: ...Never mind. You wouldn't know it even if I told you.
translations.聴いたらわかるかもしれないぞ？: Maybe I'd know it if I heard it？
translations.……はあ、気が向いたらね。また声かけたら？: ...Sigh. Maybe if I feel like it. Try asking me again sometime.
translations.わかった、また今度聴かせてくれよ。約束だぞ。: Got it, let me listen next time. It's a promise.
translations.別に約束はしないけど……好きにすれば。: I'm not making any promises, but... do whatever you want.
translations.まあ、今気が向かないならいいよ。: Well, if you don't feel like it right now, never mind.
translations.（そういえば▲小早川＊▲が\n聴いてる音楽、聴かせて\nくれるんだっけ……）:
(Right, wasn't ▲小早川＊▲
going to let me listen
to her music...？)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲が\n聴いてる音楽、聴かせて\nくれなかったな……）:
(▲小早川＊▲ didn't
let me listen to
her music...)
translations.のんびり探そう: Take my time looking for her
translations.はあ、そんなに聴きたいわけ？: Sigh... Do you really want to hear it that badly？
translations.なんとなく気になるしな。: I'm just kind of curious, that's all.
translations.別にいいけど……ほら。: I guess I don't mind, but... Here.
translations.（……少し嬉しそうな気もするけど……気のせいかな）: (...She seems kind of happy about that, though... Maybe I'm imagining things.)
translations.結局来ないし。: And you never even showed up.
translations.別に。アタシも無理に聴かせたいわけじゃないし、いいんだけど。: Nothing. It's not like I wanted to force you to listen anyway, so whatever.
translations.そういや、図書強化週間が始まるんだっけ？: By the way, isn't Library Week starting soon？
translations.そう。だから委員の仕事、サボんないで。: Yeah. So don't slack off on your committee duties.
translations.言われなくてもわかってるって。: I know, you don't have to tell me.
translations.はは、任せとけって。: Haha, just leave it to me.
translations.なにその自信、意味わかんない。: Where's all that confidence coming from？ Makes no sense.
translations.●はその期間、当番じゃなかったような……。: ● wasn't scheduled for duty that week, though...
translations.……アタシが忙しくしてる中、自分だけサボるわけか。: ...So while I'm busy working, you're just gonna slack off by yourself.
translations.（そう言われてもなあ……）: (What am I supposed to say to that...)
translations.（図書強化週間か……委員の仕事行かないと）: (It's Library Week... I should get to my committee duties.)
translations.（まだ図書強化週間か……委員の仕事行くかな）: (Still Library Week, huh... Guess I'll go do my committee duties.)
translations.やっと強化週間終わりか。▲小早川＊▲もお疲れ。: Library Week's finally over, huh. Good work to you too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.疲れるほどの仕事してないけどね、アタシは。: I didn't really do enough work to get tired, though.
translations.そうか？ たしかに、想像してたよりはスムーズに終わったかも。: Really？ Well, it did go smoother than I expected.
translations.……戦力外だと思ってた人間が、意外に役に立ったからね。: ...Because someone I'd written off as dead weight turned out to be surprisingly useful.
translations.仕事しない新入りとか、サイテー。: A newbie who doesn't even do his job is the worst.
translations.謝っても遅いっつーの。: A bit late to be apologizing now.
translations.眠い……アンタさ、１週間でいいから毎朝アタシにメール送って起こしてよ。: I'm so sleepy... Hey, just for a week, text me every morning to wake me up.
translations.いいよ、面白そうだし。けど、メールくらいで起きるのか？: Sure, sounds fun. Will a text really be enough to wake you up, though？
translations.なんで●が……。家族に起こしてもらったほうが早くないか？: Why do ● have to...？ Wouldn't it be faster to have your family wake you up？
translations.（？ なんか不機嫌？）: (？ Is she in a bad mood？ )
translations.（そういえば、▲小早川＊▲にメールで起こしてくれって言われてたな）: (Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ asked me to wake her up with a text.)
translations.（そうだ、▲小早川＊▲にメール……）: (Oh right, I need to text ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.アンタのお節介のおかげで寝坊せずにすんだかも。: Thanks to your meddling, I might've managed not to oversleep.
translations.とりあえず、お礼言っとく。: For now, I'll just say thanks.
translations.アンタって……お節介のわりに役に立たないよね。結局メール送らないし。: For a busybody... you're pretty useless, you know. You never even texted me.
translations.あー、朝の……。ごめんな。: Ah, right, this morning... Sorry about that.
translations.いい、最初からあてにしてなかったし。: Whatever. I wasn't counting on you to begin with.
translations.そうだ。これからしばらく図書委員の業務改善ミーティングするって。: Oh, right. Apparently the library committee's holding meetings to improve operations for a while.
translations.業務改善？ なんか大げさだな。: Improve operations？ Sounds kind of overblown.
translations.同感だけど、絶対出席だってさ。: Agreed, but they said attendance is mandatory.
translations.わかった、しょうがないな: Got it. Guess I have no choice.
translations.ムリだなぁ: I don't think I can make it
translations.そっか。まあ、しょうがないな。: I see. Well, guess we don't have a choice.
translations.これも委員の義務ってこと。サボんないで。: It's part of our duties on the committee. Don't skip out.
translations.ちょっと都合があって……ムリだな。: I've got some things going on... I don't think I can make it.
translations.そうやって忙しいふりするわけか。ズルじゃん。: So you're just gonna pretend you're busy. What a cop-out.
translations.（そういえば、図書委員の業務改善ミーティングだっけ……）: (Come to think of it, wasn't there a library committee meeting on improving operations...？)
translations.（図書委員の業務改善ミーティングがあったな……）: (Right, I've got that library committee meeting on improving operations...)
translations.ミーティング、皆勤じゃん。: Look at you, perfect attendance at the meetings.
translations.まあな。それよりこれ、\n結局なんだったんだ？:
Yeah, well. Anyway, what
was that even about？
translations.さあ。\n先生の気まぐれじゃない？\nやれやれだよ。:
Who knows.
Probably just a whim of the
teacher's. What a pain.
translations.図書委員のミーティング、なんで来ないの。: Why didn't you come to the library committee meetings？
translations.あー……まあ、色々な？: Uh... Well, a lot came up, you know？
translations.欠席者がいるおかげで先生の機嫌悪くなるし、とばっちりだっつーの。: Having people absent put the teacher in a bad mood, and the rest of us had to deal with it.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って、下校のとき真っ直ぐ家に帰ってるのか？: Hey, ▲小早川＊▲, do you go straight home after school？
translations.ふーん。信用出来ないならついてくる？: Hmm. If you don't trust me, want to tag along？
translations.暇だし、そうしよっかな: I'm free, so maybe I will
translations.いいよ、そこまでのことじゃないし: Nah, it's not that big a deal
translations.そうしよっかな、暇だし。: Maybe I will, since I'm free.
translations.本気にすんなっつーの。: I wasn't being serious, you know.
translations.なんだ。ダメなら最初から言うなよ。: Oh, come on. If you don't want me to, don't offer in the first place.
translations.ダメとは言ってないじゃん……。別にいいけど。: I didn't say you couldn't... I don't really mind.
translations.じゃあ、しばらくそうするか。: All right, guess I'll do that for a while.
translations.（本気でイヤってわけではなさそうだな……）: (Doesn't seem like she's actually against it...)
translations.やっぱいいや。そこまで気になるわけじゃないし。: Never mind, it's fine. I'm not that curious anyway.
translations.なんだ……中途半端。: What the heck... Talk about half-hearted.
translations.（そういえば▲小早川＊▲に付き合って一緒に帰るって言ったっけ……どこにいるかな）: (Come to think of it, I said I'd walk home with ▲小早川＊▲... Wonder where she is.)
translations.（今日も▲小早川＊▲に付き合って一緒に帰るか……どこにいるかな）: (Guess I'll walk home with ▲小早川＊▲ again today... Wonder where she is.)
translations.そんなわけないだろ。まあ一安心だな。: Of course not. Just relieved is all.
translations.別に心配しなくていいっつーの。もういいでしょ、じゃあね。: I told you, you don't need to worry about me. We're good now, right？ Later.
translations.帰り、アタシについてくるんじゃなかったっけ。: Weren't you supposed to tag along with me after school？
translations.そういや……まあ、色々都合がさ。: Oh, right... Well, something came up.
translations.（言ったとおりにした方がよかったかな）: (Maybe I should've done like I said I would...)
translations.返却されてない本、結構あるな。: There are quite a few overdue books.
translations.……回収してまわった方がいいのかな。: ...Think we should go around and collect them？
translations.そこまでしなくても: We don't need to go that far
translations.全部まわるの、結構大変そうだな。: Tracking them all down looks like a lot of work, though.
translations.何日かにわけないとダメかもね。: Might have to split it up over a few days.
translations.なにも、そこまでしなくても……。: I don't think we need to go that far...
translations.（そういえば、未返却本の回収するんだったな……▲小早川＊▲どこだろ）: (Oh right, we're supposed to collect those overdue books... Wonder where ▲小早川＊▲ is.)
translations.（今日も未返却本の回収するか……▲小早川＊▲どこだろ）: (Time to collect overdue books again today... Wonder where ▲小早川＊▲ is.)
translations.思った以上に回収できたかも。: We actually got back more than I expected.
translations.持ってきてるけど返しにいくのが面倒で……って人が多かったな。: A lot of people had the books on them, they just couldn't be bothered to drop them off.
translations.借りたものは返す、そんなの常識じゃん。まあ、とにかくお疲れ。: If you borrow something, you return it. It's basic common sense. Anyway, good work today.
translations.アンタさ、アタシ一人に回収させる気だったわけ？: Were you seriously planning on making me collect them all by myself？
translations.あ、未返却の……。そうじゃないけど……。: Oh, the overdue books... No, that's not it...
translations.じゃあ、口だけで責任感ないってことか。: So you're all talk and zero responsibility, then.
translations.最近もゲーセン行ってるのか？ 遅くまで遊んでると心配かけるぞ。: Still going to the arcade lately？ People are gonna worry if you stay out late.
translations.うるさい……生活指導は間に合ってるから。: Shut up... I get enough lectures from the teachers.
translations.心配だったらさ、アンタが監視しにくれば。: If you're so worried, why don't you come keep an eye on me yourself？
translations.よし、言ったな。本当に行くからな。: All right, I'll hold you to that. I'm really gonna show up, you know.
translations.あー、さすがにうっとうしいか。: Uh, I guess that'd be pretty annoying, huh.
translations.なら、顔出すくらいな。邪魔はしないよ。: Then I'll just drop in and say hi. I won't get in your way.
translations.物好きだね。: You sure are a weird one.
translations.まさか、そんなことしないって。それじゃ、本当に生活指導の先生みたいだろ。: No way, I wouldn't go that far. Then I really would be acting like a teacher.
translations.（？ なんかちょっと不満そうだな……）: (？ She seems a little disappointed for some reason...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、今日もゲーセン行ってんのかな……様子見に行くか）: (I wonder if ▲小早川＊▲'s at the arcade again today... Maybe I'll go check on her.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲は今日もゲーセンかな……様子見に行くか）: (Wonder if ▲小早川＊▲'s at the arcade today too... Guess I'll go check on her.)
translations.よく来るね。もういいでしょ。: You sure keep coming back. You can stop now, you know.
translations.まあな。そんなに危ないこともなさそうだし。: Yeah, I guess. Doesn't look like it's all that dangerous around here anyway.
translations.心配しすぎなんだっつーの。お節介。: I told you, you worry way too much. Such a busybody.
translations.そう言うなって。いいから、気をつけろよ。: Come on, don't be like that. Just be careful, okay？
translations.結局来ないし、ゲーセン。: You never even showed up at the arcade.
translations.それならそれでいいんだけどね、来られてもうっとうしいし。: Not that I care. It would've just been annoying if you did show up.
translations.ねえ、図書委員って言っても基本ヒマだしさ。どっちがたくさん仕事しながら本読めるか: Hey, being on library duty is mostly just sitting around anyway. Wanna have a contest to see who can read more books while working？
translations.勝負か。よーし、負けないぞ！: A contest, huh？ All right, I'm not gonna lose!
translations.へへ、そんな簡単にリンコに勝てると思ってんの？: Hehe, you think you can beat me that easily？
translations.そんなこと言って……遊んでる場合じゃないだろ？: Come on... We're supposed to be working, not goofing off.
translations.はいはい、真面目くんだね。: Yeah, yeah, look at Mr. Serious over here.
translations.それが普通だろ……たぶん。: Pretty sure that's just called being normal... probably.
translations.（そういえば▲小早川＊▲と、どれだけ本読めるか競争するんだったな……なに読もう）: (Oh yeah, ▲小早川＊▲ and I were gonna see who could read the most books... What should I read？)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲と、どれだけ本読めるか競争中だ……なに読もう）: (I'm in the middle of that reading contest with ▲小早川＊▲... What should I read？)
translations.まあな……といっても▲小早川＊▲よりは少ないけど。: Yeah, well... still not as much as you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そこはほら、プロとアマチュアの差だよ。: Well, y'know, that's the difference between a pro and an amateur.
translations.アマチュアにしてはよくやったってこと。まあ暇つぶしにはなったよ。: It means you did pretty good for an amateur. Anyway, it was a good way to kill time.
translations.アンタ、どのくらい読めた？: How much did you manage to read？
translations.全然ダメじゃん。リンコの１０分の１以下だね。: That's pathetic. Less than a tenth of what I read.
translations.（仕事サボってのことだしなあ……）: (Well, only by slacking off on work...)
translations.校舎の裏で子ネコ見つけたんだよ、３匹。親ネコは見当たらなかったけど……住みついて: I found three kittens behind the school building. Didn't see the mother anywhere, though... Wonder if they moved in？
translations.えっ？ じゃあさ、リンコが里親探すから、それまで二人で世話してあげようよ。: Wait, really？ Then I'll look for someone to adopt them, so let's take care of them together until then.
translations.そうだな。放っとくわけにもいかないし。: Yeah, good idea. We can't just leave them there.
translations.決まり！ 明日から毎朝迎えに行くから、ミルクとかエサとか持ってこ。: It's settled! I'll come get you every morning starting tomorrow, so let's bring milk and food for them.
translations.わかった。エサってなにがいいかな？: Got it. What kind of food should we bring？
translations.アンタはサバ缶持ってるでしょ。: You've got canned mackerel on you, don't you？
translations.あれはネコには……。: I don't think that's good for cats...
translations.冗談だっつーの。じゃあ、そういうことで。: It was a joke, obviously. Anyway, that's the plan.
translations.（なんかテンション高い？）: (Is it just me, or is she really excited？)
translations.ん～……そんなことしたら、情が移っちゃいそうだしな……。: Hmm... If we do that, we're just gonna get attached to them...
translations.それはそうだけど……もう、じゃあいい。: Well, yeah, maybe, but... Fine, forget it.
translations.（そういえば▲小早川＊▲と、ネコの世話するんだったな……）: (Right, I'm supposed to take care of the kittens with ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.（今日も▲小早川＊▲と、ネコの世話か……）: (Taking care of the kittens with ▲小早川＊▲ again today, huh...)
translations.子ネコの里親、見つかったよ。: I found a home for the kittens.
translations.これでも苦労したんだから。: It was a lot of work, you know.
translations.おつかれ。でも▲小早川＊▲、寂しいんじゃないのか？: Thanks for doing all that. Aren't you gonna miss them, though, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.まあ……ちょっとね。でも子ネコの幸せが一番だからね。: Well... a little. But what's best for the kittens comes first.
translations.校舎裏の子ネコ、いなくなってた……。: The kittens behind the school... They're gone...
translations.えっ……誰かにもらわれたのかな？: What...? Think someone took them in？
translations.（ちゃんと見といた方がよかったかな……）: (Maybe I should've kept a better eye on them...)
translations.図書室の本の内容について聞かれたとき、とっさに説明するのって難しいよな。: When people ask what a library book is about, it's pretty hard to explain on the spot, isn't it？
translations.じゃあさ、よく聞かれる本には『解説カード』みたいなの付ける？: Then how about we put little summary cards on the books people ask about a lot？
translations.でしょ？ まあ、頑張ってよ。: Right？ Well, good luck with that.
translations.頑張ってって……一緒にやるんだろ？: What do you mean, "good luck"...? We're doing it together, aren't we？
translations.だって、言いだしっぺだろ。: Because it was your idea in the first place.
translations.よし。じゃあ一緒にやるか！: All right, let's do this together!
translations.それはそれで、めんどくさいな……。: That sounds like a pain in its own right...
translations.だったら、自分でなんとかすれば？: Then why don't you figure something out yourself？
translations.（せっかく提案してくれたのに……悪かったかな）: (She was just trying to help... Maybe I shouldn't have said that.)
translations.（そういえば、▲小早川＊▲が図書室の本の解説カード作ろうって言ってたな……）: (Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ mentioned making summary cards for the library books...)
translations.（今日も解説カード作るか……）: (Guess I'll work on those summary cards again today...)
translations.出来たじゃん、解説カード。結構いいかも。: Look at that, the summary cards are done. They actually turned out pretty good.
translations.ああ、▲小早川＊▲のおかげだな。: Yeah, all thanks to you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.アンタも頑張ったほうじゃない？ へへ。: You worked pretty hard yourself, didn't you？ Hehe.
translations.これなら借りるほうも便利になるよな。: This should make things easier for the people borrowing them, too.
translations.なんで今までなかったんだろ。歴代の図書委員は気が利かないね。: I wonder why we didn't have these before. The past library committees weren't very thoughtful.
translations.アンタさ、最初から解説カード作り、リンコに押し付けるつもりだったわけ？: Wait, were you planning on dumping all the summary card work on me from the very beginning？
translations.じゃあ、ちゃんと手伝えっつーの。: Then actually help me out already.
translations.あのさ、よく本屋さんに宣伝のポップってあるよね。: Hey, you know those little promo signs they always have in bookstores？
translations.ああ、結構凝ったやつもあるな。: Yeah, some of them are pretty elaborate.
translations.ああいうの、図書委員でもできないかな。: I wonder if we could do something like that for the library committee.
translations.面白いかもな、作ってみるか。: Could be fun. Let's try making some.
translations.じゃあ決まり。妥協は許さないから、覚悟しといて。: Then it's settled. I'm not accepting any compromises, so be ready.
translations.うーん、ちょっとやりすぎって気もするな。: Hmm, I feel like that might be going a bit overboard.
translations.（そういえば、▲小早川＊▲が本の宣伝ポップ作ろうって言ってたな……）: (Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ mentioned making promo signs for the books...)
translations.（よし、今日も本のポップ作るか……）: (All right, guess I'll work on those promo signs again today...)
translations.お疲れ。イイ感じに仕上がったじゃん。: Good work. They turned out looking pretty nice.
translations.▲小早川＊▲もお疲れ。これならみんなに喜んでもらえそうだな。: Good work to you too, ▲小早川＊▲. I think everyone's going to like these.
translations.そこらへんのショップにも負けないね。: They're just as good as anything you'd see in a real store.
translations.●のセンスだな、はは。: That's all thanks to your good taste, ●. Haha.
translations.ハァ？ なに言ってんの。: Huh？ What are you talking about？
translations.（調子に乗りすぎたか……でもやってよかったな）: (Maybe I got a little carried away... Still, I'm glad we did this.)
translations.なんか、中途半端でかっこ悪い……。: They look kind of half-baked and lame...
translations.（確かに……●の責任だな……）: (She's right... ● have to take responsibility for this...)
translations.最近家族とはどうだ？: How have things been with your family lately？
translations.それよりさ、アンタしばらく暇？\n夜、ちょっとだけつき合って欲しいんだけど……。:
Never mind that, are you free for a while？
Could you hang out with me a bit at night...？
translations.お父さんがさ、これからしばらく夜は早めに帰れるんだって。めずらしく。:
My dad said he'll be able
to come home early at night
for a while. For once.
translations.じゃあ、家族団らんしたほうが……。:
Then shouldn't you spend
time with your family...？
translations.それもそうだけどさ。二人の時間も必要かなって。:
Well, yeah, maybe.
I just figured the two of
them need some time alone.
translations.弟はともかく、リンコがいたら気にするだろうし。:
My little brother's one thing,
but if I'm around, they'll
probably feel awkward.
translations.そういうこと。ま、テキトーに公園とかで時間潰せればオッケーだから。:
That's how it is. Anyway, as
long as we can kill some time
at the park or wherever, it's fine.

translations.（あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……声かけてみるか）:
（Oh, there's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...

I was just about to go

▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ about something...

translations.はいはい、お邪魔しました。じゃあね。: Fine, sorry to bother you. Bye.

translations.別に、待ってたわけじゃないし……もう行く。じゃあ。: It's not like I was waiting for you... I'm leaving. Bye.
translations.ごめん、気づかなくて。じゃあ、●急ぐから。: Sorry, I didn't see you. Anyway, ● gotta hurry.

translations.いつもじゃないの。じゃあ。:
Isn't that normal for you？
Bye.

Hey, it's not like ●

translations.もう……いい。リンコ、行かないと……。:
Never mind... I have to

translations.ふ～ん、暇人か。じゃあ。:
Hmm, got time to kill, huh？
Bye.
translations.ちょっとな、特になにってわけじゃないけど。:
Not much, nothing in

...Oh, my bad. Did I hold

...Oh, sorry. Did I get in

It's fine. Not like I'm busy

Would you rather I did have

translations.そりゃそっか……。: Well, I guess that makes sense...
translations.これはしょうがないんじゃない？: There's no helping this one, is there？
translations.慰めてあげても……いいけど。: I could cheer you up... if you want.
