translations.えっと、思ってないんだったら、いいんだけど。: Um, if you don't think so, that's fine.
translations.自分ではちょっと意識してたりとかね……へへ。: I've just been trying a little harder myself, is all... Hehe.
translations.（古本屋か……なんか面白いものあるかな……）: (A used bookstore, huh... Wonder if they have anything good...)
translations.やっぱり▲小早川＊▲だ。よう。: I knew it was ▲小早川＊▲. Hey.
translations.なんでこんなとこにいんの。: What are you doing in a place like this？
translations.なんでって、ただブラブラと……そうだ、ほら●、図書委員だし！ 本を愛でに来たんだ: Just browsing around... Oh, come on, ●, I'm on the library committee! I came to appreciate some books.
translations.リンコも一緒。ちょっと探してる本があってさ。ここいい本あるんだよね。: Same here. There's a book I'm looking for. They have a good selection here.
translations.興味あるなら、解説するけど。: If you're interested, I can explain it to you.
translations.で、そんな時代にあっても、ビート・ジェネレーションの作家とは一線を画してて……。: And even in an era like that, they set themselves apart from the Beat Generation writers...
translations.なに、質問？: What, do you have a question？
translations.えっと、もうかなり時間経ってるし、また今度にしないか？ 店の人も苦笑してるぞ。: Um, we've been here a pretty long time, so how about we save it for later？ Even the clerk's smiling awkwardly at us.
translations.ええ、まだ一番いいところを話してないんだけど。: What？ I haven't even gotten to the best part yet.
translations.それはまた委員活動のときにでも聞くよ。ほら、図書委員らしく。: I'll hear the rest during committee duty next time. You know, like proper library committee members.
translations.人にこんなに語ったの、久しぶりかも。アンタってなんか……そういうところあるよね。: It's been a while since I talked that much to someone. You kind of have... a knack for that. You're easy to talk to.
translations.そうだよ……楽しかった。じゃあね。: Yeah... That was fun. See you.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、自分が好きなものはあんなに語るんだな……）: (▲小早川＊▲ sure talks a lot when it's about something she likes...)
translations.（楽器屋か……色々あるけど……）: (A music store, huh... They've got all kinds of stuff...)
translations.よっ、偶然だな。楽器屋に用なんてあるのか？: Hey, what a coincidence. Did you need something at a music store？
translations.別に用ってわけじゃ……。: It's not like I needed anything...
translations.あ、▲小早川＊▲いつも音楽聴いてるもんな。やっぱ自分でやったりもするのか？: Oh right, ▲小早川＊▲, you're always listening to music. Do you play an instrument yourself？
translations.……まあ、昔ギターをちょっとね。: ...Well, I used to play a little guitar.
translations.えっと……弾けるっていうか……まあね？: Um... I don't know if I'd say I can play, exactly... I guess？
translations.すごいな、ちょっと弾いてみせてよ。: That's awesome. Play something for me.
translations.はい、チューニング終わりましたんで、どうぞ。: All right, it's all tuned up for you. Here you go.
translations.いや、こう、ギターの重さとかさ、ネックの握りとかを確認してんの。: No, I'm, like, checking the weight of the guitar and how the neck feels in my hand.
translations.へえ、本格的だな……。: Whoa, you really know your stuff...
translations.はい、ありがとうございました。: All right, thank you very much.
translations.へえ、あれだけでわかるもんなんだな。: Huh, you can tell just from that.
translations.（なんか焦ってたような……●、悪いことしたのかな……）: （She seemed kind of flustered... Did ● do something wrong...？）
translations.（さてと……そろそろ帰るかな……）: （Well then... Maybe I should head home soon...）
translations.なんかボーっとしてた。: I was just kind of spacing out.
translations.はは、なんだそれ。▲小早川＊▲でもそんなことあるんだな。: Haha, what's that about？ Even you have moments like that, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.いいじゃん、別に。たまにはのんびりするのもさ。: What's wrong with that？ It's nice to just take it easy sometimes.
translations.そうかもな。なんか気持ちよさそうだし、●も付き合うよ。: Maybe so. It looks pretty nice, so ● think I'll join you.
translations.付き合うって、何もしないんだよ。: Join me？ I'm not doing anything, you know.
translations.●にもボーっとさせろって。: Come on, ● want to space out too.
translations.なんでだろ。アンタの隣って落ち着く。: I wonder why. I feel so relaxed next to you.
translations.そうか？ ●も▲小早川＊▲といると、そうかも。: Really？ ● think I feel the same way when I'm with you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ほんとアンタって、お兄ちゃんみたいだね。: You really are like a big brother.
translations.いっこ上だしな。: Well, I am a year older.
translations.歳もそうだろうけど……それだけじゃないよ。: There's the age thing, sure... but that's not all it is.
translations.きっとアンタだから、お兄ちゃんなんだよ。: It's because you're you that you feel like a big brother.
translations.いいよ、わかんなくても。: It's fine if you don't get it.
translations.リンコはもう行くね。バイバイ。: Rinko has to go now. Bye-bye.
translations.（さて、今日もはりきって図書委員に……）: （All right, time for another day of library duty...）
translations.あの態度、ほんとありえないんだけど。: Seriously, can you believe her attitude？
translations.ねえ？ ああもうムカツク！: I know, right？ Ugh, it ticks me off so much!
translations.（まさか、また▲小早川＊▲……）: （Don't tell me that's about ▲小早川＊▲ again...）
translations.なあ、誰かとモメたのか？: Hey, did you get into an argument with someone？
translations.違ってたら悪いけど……もしかしたらって思って。: Sorry if I'm wrong, but... I had a feeling.
translations.アタシ今機嫌悪いの。話しかけないで。: I'm in a bad mood right now. Don't talk to me.
translations.機嫌悪いって……やっぱり何かあったんだろ？: In a bad mood... So something really did happen, huh？
translations.……あのバカ女たちが、図書室で携帯いじってて。音も消さずにピーピーピーピー。: ...Those stupid girls were messing with their phones in the library. Beeping away without even putting them on silent.
translations.した。悪い？: I did. Got a problem with that？
translations.なんて言ったんだ？: What did you say to them？
translations.マナーも守れないバカは学校の施設使うなって。あとついでに、メイクが下手で全然似合: I told them idiots who don't even have basic manners shouldn't use school facilities. And while I was at it, that their makeup sucks and doesn't suit them at all.
translations.それは言い過ぎだろ……。: That's going a little too far...
translations.なにそれ。アンタもあのバカ女の肩持つの。: What's your deal？ Taking those stupid girls' side too？
translations.違うよ。そうじゃないけど、そんな言い方したら敵ばっか作っちゃうぞ。: No, that's not it. Put it like that, though, and you're just gonna make enemies left and right.
translations.（ちょっと遅いけど……何かやってくかな）: (It's a little late, but... maybe I'll play something before heading back.)
translations.またこんな時間に一人で出歩いて……。: Out wandering around by yourself this late again...
translations.なにそれ。アンタ生徒会だっけ？: What's your deal？ Since when are you on the student council？
translations.図書委員だよ！ それに……ここだと前絡まれてたアイツと会うかもしれないし。: I'm on the library committee! Besides... if you stay here, you might run into that creep who hassled you before.
translations.別に……一応、周りには気配ってるし。: Not really... I'm keeping an eye on my surroundings anyway.
translations.って言ってもなあ。わざわざ危ない橋渡らなくても。: Still, though. Why take the risk if you don't have to？
translations.……しょうがないじゃん。: ...It's not like I have a choice.
translations.しょうがないって……まだ、家にいたくないのか。: No choice？ ...Do you still not want to be at home？
translations.しばらく付き合うから、ここは出よう。な？: I'll hang out with you for a while, so let's get out of here. Okay？
translations.え？ なんで……まあ、帰るならいいんだけど。: Huh？ Why... Well, if you're heading home, I guess that's fine.
translations.委員長がうるさいからね。遊ぶにしても気がノらない。: Because Mr. Class Rep won't stop nagging me. Kills the mood for hanging out.
translations.図書委員な！ いいや。じゃあ送ってくよ。: It's library committee! Whatever. Come on, I'll walk you home.
translations.いい、まっすぐ帰るから。: I'm fine. I'm going straight home.
translations.はあ……勝手についてくれば。: *Sigh*... Follow me if you want, see if I care.
translations.なんかアンタってさ、アタシにつきまとってるみたいだよね。: You know, it's starting to feel like you're stalking me or something.
translations.はあ？ なんだよそれ。: Huh？ What's that supposed to mean？
translations.（と一緒に、なんかヤバそうな人が……）: (And there's some sketchy-looking guy with her...)
translations.（危なそうだし、とりあえず様子を見るか……）:
(That guy looks dangerous. I'll
just wait and see for now...)
translations.（ほっ、なんとかなったみたいだな……）:
(Phew, looks like things worked
themselves out...)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲……前にもこんなことあったな）:
(▲小早川＊▲... Didn't this exact
thing happen before？)
translations.（と一緒に、またヤバそうな人が……）:
(And she's with another sketchy-
looking guy...)
translations.（前も大丈夫だったし、ほっとけば大丈夫だろ……）:
(She was fine last time, so
it'll probably work out again...)
translations.（ほっ、またなんとかなったみたいだな……）:
(Phew, looks like she managed
to get out of it again...)
translations.（ほっとけないだろ！）:
(There's no way I can just
leave her!)
translations.なにテメェ？ こいつのカレシ？:
Who the hell're you？ Her
boyfriend？
translations.そう。今、デート中。:
Yeah. We're in the middle of
a date.
translations.そうじゃん！ この人すっごく強いんだから！:
Of course we are! And he's
super strong, you know!
translations.アンタのことっ！ ボカーンとやっつけちゃえ！:
You! Go on, clobber him—
kaboom!
translations.へぇ……兄さん、ボカーンといっとく？:
Oh yeah...? Feel like going
"kaboom," buddy？
translations.いや、ボカーンって……。:
Hold on, what does "kaboom"
even mean...
translations.やんのか、コラッ!!: You want a piece of me, punk!!
translations.（▲小早川＊▲は休みか……なんか、あったんじゃないよな？）:
(▲小早川＊▲'s absent, huh... I hope
nothing happened to her.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ どうしたんだよ今頃……しかも私服だし……。:
▲小早川＊▲! What're you doing here
at this hour... and in casual
clothes...？
translations.（家に帰ってない、とか……コンビニでは制服のままだったし……）:
(Could it be she hasn't gone
home...? She was still in her
uniform at the convenience store...)
translations.（やっぱり、屋上で泣いてたことと、関係あるのか……）:
(Does this have something to do
with her crying on the roof...?)
translations.（それでも、わざわざ図書室に来るってことは、もしかして、●を頼って……）:
(Still, if she came all the way
to the library, maybe she's
counting on ●...)
translations.よし、デートに誘おう: All right, I'll ask her out.
translations.ああ、気をつけて帰れよ。:
Yeah, take care on your way
home.
translations.▲小早川＊▲！ また私服で……なんかあったのか？。:
▲小早川＊▲! You're in casual clothes
again... Did something happen？
translations.（やっぱり、なにかあったんじゃ……）:
(Something definitely happened
to her, didn't it...)
translations.よし、デートに誘ってみよう: All right, I'll ask her out
translations.なあ、今度の日曜あいてるか？: Hey, are you free this Sunday？
translations.いや、その……デートとかさ、どうかと思って？: Well, uh... How about we go on a date or something？
translations.デ……デートって……誰と、誰が。: A... a date...? Between who and who？
translations.……何いってんの、バカじゃん……。: ...What are you talking about？ Are you stupid...?
translations.付き合っても……いいけど。: I guess I wouldn't mind... going with you.
translations.デートとかと違うからっ！ ほら……ただ出かけるだけだから。: It's not a date or anything! Look... we're just going out somewhere.
translations.いいよ、それで。じゃあ、ただ出かけような？: That's fine by me. Let's just go out somewhere, then, okay？
translations.こんな時間か……今日はもう寝るか！: It's already this late... Guess I'll go to bed!
translations.プレミアムゴールドっていうサバ缶が出てる。\nリンコ:
They came out with a canned
mackerel called Premium Gold.
Rinko
translations.へぇ、プレミアムゴールドね……でも、なんでこんな時間に……。: Huh, Premium Gold, eh... Wait, why at this hour...?
translations.もしかしてコンビニに▲小早川＊▲が……: Could ▲小早川＊▲ be at the convenience store...
translations.まあ、大した理由はないだろ: I'm sure there's no big reason
translations.まあ、大した理由はないだろ。返信だけしとこっと。: I'm sure there's no big reason. I'll just send a reply.
translations.今日もこんな時間か……もう寝るか！: Look how late it is again... Time for bed!
translations.サバ缶プレミアムゴールド、いらないの？\nリンコ:
Don't you want the Premium
Gold canned mackerel？
Rinko
translations.また……なんで、わざわざこんな時間に……。: Again...? Why go out of her way to text me this late...?
translations.コンビニに▲小早川＊▲がいる気がする……: I have a feeling ▲小早川＊▲'s at the convenience store...
translations.大した理由はないだろうし、寝よう: Probably nothing important, I'll go to sleep
translations.大したことじゃないよな。返信だけして寝よう。: It's probably no big deal. I'll just reply and go to sleep.
translations.プレミアムゴールドだってさ……知ってた？: It's called Premium Gold... Did you know about this？
translations.べつにじゃないだろ!? こんな時間に……。: It can't be nothing!? Look how late it is...
translations.あの……他のお客様に迷惑ですんで……。: Excuse me... You're disturbing the other customers...
translations.怒ってないよ。●に用があったんだろ？: I'm not mad. You needed something from ●, right？
translations.うん……日曜日さ、どっか行こ？: Yeah... Hey, let's go somewhere on Sunday, okay？
translations.まさか……そのためにわざわざこんなことしたのか？:
Wait... You went through all
this trouble just for that？
translations.だって、電話して寝てたらさ、悪いじゃん……。:
Well, if I called and you
were asleep, I'd feel bad...
translations.起こせよ！ メールに気づかなかったらどうすんだ!?:
Wake me up, then! What if I
hadn't noticed your text？
translations.怒ってないけど、無茶すんなよ……。:
I'm not mad, just don't do
anything reckless...
translations.（やっぱり、また家に居づらいのかな……）:
(Things must be awkward
at home again...)
translations.あのさ……リンコたち、付き合うことになったわけじゃん。だからさ……。:
So, um... since we're going
out now and all...
translations.その……デート、行かない？: Um... wanna go on a date？
translations.ダメなわけないって。行こう！: Of course I do. Let's go!
translations.うん……じゃあ、詳しいことは後で。:
Okay... We can figure out
the details later, then.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲とデート……そうだよな、恋人同士だもんな）:
(A date with ▲小早川＊▲... Right,
we are a couple now.)
translations.（うーん、初デートの待ち合わせか。なんか緊張するな……）:
(Meeting up for our first
date... I'm kinda nervous.)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲……まだかな……）:
(I wonder if ▲小早川＊▲ is
here yet...)
translations.なんだ、来てたんなら声かけてくれよ。:
What, if you were already
here, you should've said so.
translations.へへ。なんかソワソワしてるアンタ見るのが楽しかったからさ。ごめん。:
Hehe. It was just fun
watching you fidget around
like that. Sorry.
translations.見てたのか……まあいいや、ほら行こう。:
You were watching me...？
Well, whatever. Let's go.
translations.最初のデートがライブか……なんかハードだな。:
A concert for our first
date, huh... Pretty intense.
translations.いいじゃん、リンコっぽいでしょ。ほら、入るよ。:
What's wrong with that？
It's very me. Come on,
let's go in.
translations.ああ、すごい。▲小早川＊▲、こういうの好きなんだな。:
Yeah, it was amazing. So
you're into this kind of
stuff, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.まあそうだけど、本当に好きなのは……あ、ほらアンコールやるよ！:
Well, yeah, though what I'm
really into is... Oh, look,
it's the encore!
translations.はあ、疲れた……でも楽しかったな。:
Phew, I'm worn out...
But that was really fun.
translations.うん！ 帰りどこかに寄れたらなって思ったけど……結構時間経っちゃったね。もう帰ら:
Yeah! I wanted to stop
somewhere on the way back,
but it's gotten pretty late.
We should head home.
translations.そうだな……それは次の課題ってことにしとくか。:
Yeah... Let's save that
for next time, then.
translations.うん……ねえ、カノジョなんだからさ……デート終わってそのまま解散ってことはないで:
Yeah... Hey, I'm your
girlfriend now, so... we're
not just gonna split up
right here, right？
translations.ああ、送ってく。ほら。:
Yeah, I'll walk you home.
Come on.
translations.今日は……ありがと。初デートにしては、まあまあかな。:
Thanks... for today. For a
first date, it was decent,
I guess.
translations.だって……デートとか、まだよくわかんないし。:
Well... I still don't know
much about dating, anyway.
translations.それは●もだな。まあ、これからがんばるよ。:
Same goes for ●. Well,
I'll do my best from now on.
translations.うん。あと、やっぱりさ……恋人同士のデートって……。:
Yeah. Also, you know...
when couples go on a date...
translations.最後はキス……するんじゃないかな。:
Don't they usually...
kiss at the end？
translations.ありがと。じゃあ、またね。バイバイ！:
Thanks. See you later, then.
Bye-bye!
translations.お、いた。先生！:
Oh, there he is.
Excuse me, sir！
translations.ん？ ああ、２年の……どうした？:
Hm？ Oh, a second-year...
What is it？
translations.（あ、▲小早川＊▲のノート……もう時間ないか）:
(Oh, ▲小早川＊▲'s notebook...
Guess I'm out of time.)
translations.（そうだ、▲小早川＊▲のノート届けないと……）:
(Right, I need to turn in
▲小早川＊▲'s notebook...)
translations.アタシの代わりなんだから、委員サボんないでよ。:
You're filling in for me, so
don't slack off on committee
duty.
translations.（今から図書室行っても遅いか……帰ろ）:
(Probably too late to hit the
library now... I'll head home.)
translations.（遅くなったけど、今からでも図書室行こう）:
(It's gotten late, but I'll
head to the library anyway.)
translations.（あ、未返却リスト……今日はもう帰るか）:
(Oh, the overdue list...
Guess I'll head home today.)
translations.（あ、未返却リスト……図書室行こう）:
(Oh, the overdue list...
Better head to the library.)
translations.▲小早川＊▲が聴いてる音楽、聴かせてくれよ。:
Let me hear what music you're
listening to, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ふーん。でもやっぱり気が向かない。: Hmm. Still don't feel like it.
translations.そんなに聴きたい？ ふーん……:
You want to hear it that
badly？ Hmm...
translations.アンタも懲りないね……。:
You really don't give up,
do you...
translations.（結構時間くったな……▲小早川＊▲探すのはあきらめるか）:
(That took a while... Guess I'll
give up on finding ▲小早川＊▲.)
translations.（結構時間くったな……▲小早川＊▲、いるかな？）:
(That took a while... Wonder
if ▲小早川＊▲ is still around？)
translations.今日から気合い入れて。:
Time to buckle down
starting today.
translations.来たか……。今日もたっぷり仕事あるから。:
So you came... There's plenty
of work today, too.
translations.まだ新入りみたいなもんなんだから、しっかり働いてよ。:
You're still basically the new
guy, so make sure you pull
your weight.
translations.（今から図書室行っても遅いよな……帰ろう）:
(It's too late to go to the
library now... I'll head home.)
translations.（今からでも図書室行くか……）:
(Maybe I'll still swing by
the library...)
translations.めんどくさいけど……アタシも義務を果たしにきたってわけ。:
It's a pain, but... I came to
do my duty, too.
translations.これ、いつまでやるのかな。:
Wonder how long this is
going to go on.
translations.アンタも飽きないね……。:
You really don't get tired
of this, do you...
translations.そういうわけじゃないんだけどさ。:
That's not really what
it's about, though.
translations.（あ、図書委員のミーティング……もう遅いし、帰るか）:
(Oh, the library committee
meeting... It's too late now,
so I'll just head home.)
translations.（あ、図書委員のミーティング……間に合うかな？）:
(Oh, the library committee
meeting... Think I can still
make it？)
translations.ほんとについてくるんだ、別にいいけど……。:
You're really tagging along,
huh. I don't mind, though...
translations.また、ついてくるんだ。ご苦労さま。:
Tagging along again, huh.
Thanks for the effort.
translations.たしかにまっすぐ帰ったな。:
Well, you really did come
straight home.
translations.そりゃついてこられたら、しょうがないじゃん。:
Well, what choice do I have
when you follow me the whole
way？
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、いないな……帰るか）:
(▲小早川＊▲ isn't around...
Guess I'll head home.)
translations.（遅くなったけど……▲小早川＊▲、まだどこかにいるかな？）:
(It's gotten late, but... I
wonder if ▲小早川＊▲ is still
around somewhere？)
translations.さて、回収いきますか。:
All right, shall we go collect
those books？

translations.しょうがないじゃん。お兄ちゃんが頼りないカレシだからさ！: What else could I do？ 'Big bro' here is such a hopeless boyfriend!
translations.そう言うなって。じゃあ、よろしくな。: Come on, don't say that. Anyway, I'm counting on you.
translations.ちょっと見て来る！: I'm gonna go take a look!
translations.（元気だな……）: (She sure has a lot of energy...)
translations.いた。何してんの。: There you are. What are you doing？
translations.ああ、ちょっとな。▲彼女＊＊▲に見つかって……。: Oh, nothing much. ▲彼女＊＊▲ just spotted me...
translations.もしかして、誤解とかされちゃった？: Wait, did she get the wrong idea？
translations.で、何があったって？: So, what was it you found earlier？
translations.今日は助かったよ、サンキュ。: You really helped me out today. Thanks.
translations.どういたしまして。アタシのアドバイス参考にして、ビシっと決めてよね。: You're welcome. Take my advice and make sure you nail it, okay？
translations.なにしてんの、こんなところで。: What are you doing out here？
translations.ああ……まあ、ブラブラと。: Oh... Just hanging around, I guess.
translations.ふーん、一人じゃないみたいだけど？: Hmm. Doesn't look like you're alone, though？
translations.テニス部の買出しかなにか？: Out buying supplies for the tennis club or something？
translations.今日バイトだっけ、その用事とか？: Did you have work today？ Is it an errand for that？
translations.ふーん。ならいいけど。じゃあ、リンコ行くから。: Hmm. Well, okay then. Anyway, I'm gonna get going.
translations.ねえ、最近カノジョのこと大切にしてる？: Hey, have you been treating your girlfriend right lately？
translations.まあ、それなりに……なんで▲小早川＊▲にそんな心配されないといけないんだよ。: Well, well enough... Why do I need you worrying about that, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.アンタがだらしないからじゃん。どうせカノジョにおんぶにだっこなんでしょ。: Because you're so hopeless. I bet you've just been letting your girlfriend do everything for you.
translations.やっぱりさ、アンタが悪いよね。: Honestly, you really are the problem here.
translations.カノジョの話。アンタにはもったいないよ。: I'm talking about your girlfriend. She's way too good for you.
translations.いやー、よくこんなのと付き合ってると思うよ。感心するな。: Man, I don't know how she puts up with dating someone like you. I'm impressed.
translations.はあ、カノジョが可哀想。: Sigh... I feel sorry for your girlfriend.
translations.こんなカレシでさ。あの人ならもっといい人いるんじゃないかなー。: Being stuck with a boyfriend like you. Someone like her could do way better, don't you think？
translations.そんなにヘコまないでよ。ほら、がんばれ！: Don't get so bummed out. Come on, step it up！
translations.（けなしてるのか励ましてるのかどっちなんだ……）: (Is she insulting me or cheering me on here...？)
translations.カノジョさ、大丈夫なわけ？: Hey, is your girlfriend actually okay？
translations.大丈夫って……▲彼女＊＊▲は完璧だぞ！: What do you mean, okay...? ▲彼女＊＊▲ is perfect！
translations.うわ……それだよそれ。カレシのことこんなに調子にのらせちゃってさ。しつけがなって: Ugh... That's what I mean. Letting her boyfriend get this full of himself. She hasn't trained you right at all.
translations.たしかに完璧っぽいけど、カレシの扱いはまだまだかな。: She does seem pretty perfect, sure, but she still has a lot to learn about handling her boyfriend.
translations.（えらそうなこと言っちゃって）: (Listen to her acting all high and mighty.)
translations.へへ。ねえねえ、甘えてもいい？: Hehe. Hey, hey, can I let you spoil me a little？
translations.なんだよいきなり。別にいいけど……いやダメだダメだ。●には▲彼女＊＊▲ってカノジ: Where'd that come from？ Sure, I don't mind... Wait, no, no way. ● already has ▲彼女＊＊▲ as a girlfriend.
translations.ちぇっ、ケチ。お兄ちゃんのくせに。: Tch, stingy. Some big brother you are.
translations.バーカ、簡単に騙されるなっつーの！: Idiot, don't fall for it so easily！
translations.カノジョはいいよねー。: Your girlfriend sure has it nice.
translations.だってさ、アンタに言えばなんでもワガママ聞いてくれるんでしょ。: Because she can ask you for anything and you'll go along with whatever selfish thing she wants, right？
translations.▲彼女＊＊▲はそんなにワガママじゃないぞ。▲小早川＊▲と違って。: ▲彼女＊＊▲ isn't that selfish. Unlike you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そうなの？ でも結構お願い聞いちゃうんじゃないの？: Really？ Still, you do pretty much whatever she asks, don't you？
translations.カノジョって、いい人だと思うけどさ。: I think your girlfriend's a great person, but...
translations.アタシだって、結構いい女だと思わない？: Don't you think I'm a pretty great girl myself？
translations.ちょっと、なにそれ！ 失礼過ぎなんですけど。: Hey, what's with that reaction！ That is seriously rude.
translations.（まあいい奴だとは思うけどね）: (Well, she's a good friend, I'll give her that.)
translations.アタシって、ダメなのかな。: I wonder if there's something wrong with me.
translations.なんだよ、らしくないな。: What's with you？ That's not like you.
translations.だってアンタみたいなのでも立派なカノジョがいるのに、アタシときたら……。: I mean, even someone like you has a wonderful girlfriend, and yet here I am...
translations.まあ、別にカレシなんていらないけどね。: Well, it's not like I need a boyfriend anyway.
translations.アンタもさ、がんばれ！: Hey, you hang in there too!
translations.どうせいつも、自分じゃカノジョに釣り合わないかも～とか思ってるんでしょ。: Knowing you, you're probably always thinking you might not be good enough for your girlfriend.
translations.大丈夫大丈夫。アンタだって磨けばそこそこ光るかもしれないからさ！: Don't worry about it. Even you might shine a little with some polish!
translations.（……ほめられてるのか？）: (...Is that supposed to be a compliment？)
translations.あのさ、アタシが困ってたら、助けてくれる？: Hey, if I'm ever in trouble, would you help me out？
translations.へへ。心強いね。カノジョ以外も助けてくれるんだ？: Heh. Good to know. So you'll help out girls besides your girlfriend too？
translations.そりゃな。友達だろ。: Course I would. We're friends, aren't we？
translations.へー、言うじゃん。口だけにならないといいけどね。: Oh, listen to you. Just hope you're not all talk.
translations.カノジョいるのって楽しそうだけど、大変そうでもあるからさ。なんか無理とかしてるの: Having a girlfriend looks fun, sure, but it also seems like a lot of work. Just wondered if you were pushing yourself too hard.
translations.それなら大丈夫！ カノジョのために無理するのは辛くないしな！: Oh, I'm fine on that front! Pushing myself for my girlfriend isn't hard at all!
translations.はいはい、ごちそうさま。聞いて損した。: Yeah, yeah, spare me the sap. Sorry I even asked.
translations.最近どうですか。相変わらずラブラブですか。: So how goes it lately？ Still all lovey-dovey as usual？
translations.なんかむかついた。: You just ticked me off for some reason.
translations.な、なんでも。\n……っていうか、\nアンタは平気なの？:
N-Nothing.
...I mean,
are you fine with this？
translations.二人で泊まるとか。\n初めてなのに。:
Staying overnight together.
It's our first time.
translations.もう、慣れた？\nこういうの。:
Have you gotten used to
this sort of thing yet？
translations.いらっしゃいませ。\nようこそ、ホテル大野屋へ。:
Welcome! Thank you for
visiting Hotel Ohnoya.
translations.予約してる\n▲苗字▲ですけど……。:
I have a reservation
under ▲苗字▲...
translations.荷物持とうか？: Want me to carry your bag？
translations.今日はたくさん\n歩かせちゃったからな。:
I made you walk a lot
today, after all.
translations.じゃあお言葉に甘えて。:
Then I'll take you up
on that.
translations.●達周りからどう見えるかな。:
I wonder how we look to
people around us, ●.
translations.ん～、普通にカップルに\n見えるんじゃない？:
Hmm, don't we just look
like a normal couple？
translations.▲小早川＊▲は可愛らしい\n奥様に見えたりして。:
Maybe you look like an
adorable wife, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.だいたい、可愛らしいって何？\n小動物かっつーの！:
And what's 'adorable'
supposed to mean？ What am
I, a small animal？
translations.（あえて奥様には\n反応しないんだな）:
(So she's choosing not to
react to the 'wife' part.)
translations.別でとったはず\nなんだけど……。:
I'm sure I booked
separate rooms, though...
translations.手違いだって。\n他の部屋も空いてない\nみたいだし、困ったな。:
They said it was a mix-up.
And it looks like they're
all booked up... Now what？
translations.違うって！\nもう一回話してくる。:
I didn't! I'll go talk
to them one more time.
translations.だって一緒に旅行に来て。\n部屋が別々とか変じゃん。\n一緒にいたいのに。:
We're on a trip together.
Separate rooms is weird.
I want to be with you.
translations.なんか、同室が\n当り前っていうのもな。:
Still, taking it for granted
that we'll share a room...
translations.なんだ、\nたまには別がいいとか？:
What, would you rather get
separate rooms for a change？
translations.それはもっとやだ。\n……だからガマンしてんの。:
I'd hate that even more.
...That's why I'm putting
up with it.
translations.のど乾いた。\nジュース買ってくる。:
I'm thirsty. I'm going
to go buy some juice.
translations.いってらっしゃい。\n寄り道すんなよ。\n迷子になるなよ。:
See you in a bit.
Don't get sidetracked,
and don't get lost.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、\n財布忘れてるじゃん。\nやれやれ、子供だな。:
▲小早川＊▲, you left
your wallet behind.
Man, what a kid.
translations.ばか！ なんで鍵\nかかってんだっつーの。\n早く来て！:
Idiot! Why the heck is
the door locked？
Get back here, quick!
translations.ごめん、\nすぐ見つかると思って。\n財布忘れてっただろ？:
Sorry, I thought I'd find
you right away. You forgot
your wallet, didn't you？
translations.小銭だけ持って出たの。\n早く鍵開けて。:
I just took some change
with me. Hurry up and
unlock the door.
translations.（外じゃないだろ……\nとりあえず戻るか）:
(She wouldn't go outside...
I'll head back for now.)
translations.財布忘れてっただろ？\nだから追いかけたんだけど。:
You forgot your wallet,
so I went after you.
translations.は？\n小銭だけ持って出たに\n決まってんじゃん。:
Huh？ Obviously I just
took some change with me.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って、\n刺身大丈夫だっけ？:
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲, are you
okay with sashimi？
translations.なんか苦手そう。\nなんとなくだけど。:
Seems like you wouldn't be
a fan. Just a hunch, though.
translations.食べるよ。\nだってネコだし。:
I eat it.
After all, I'm a cat.
translations.ほら、ぼさっとしていないで\n早く行こう。:
Come on, stop spacing out
and let's go.
translations.じゃあ、\nちょっと休むか……。:
Well then, let's rest
for a bit...
translations.そういやさ、\nネットで見たんだけど。:
By the way, I saw
something online.
translations.熱海港から船で行ける\n初島ってとこが\nあるんだけどさ。:
There's this island called
Hatsushima you can get to
by boat from Atami Port.
translations.そこには誰も辿り着いた\nことがない、伝説のビーチが\nあるんだってさ。:
Apparently there's a
legendary beach there that
no one's ever reached.
translations.そこで愛を誓い合うと、\n永遠に幸せに……って、\nなんか言ってて\n恥ずかしく:
If you swear your love
there, you'll be happy
forever... Man, it's kind of
embarrassing just saying it.
translations.ちょっと\n行ってみたいかもな。:
I kind of want to
go check it out.
translations.誰も行ったことないんだろ？\nわくわくするじゃん。:
Nobody's ever been there,
right？ Sounds exciting.
translations.ああ、そうしよう。\n明日は初島だ。:
Yeah, let's do that.
Hatsushima tomorrow, then.
translations.ほら、あそこ。\n伝説の。:
You know, that place.
The legendary one.
translations.うん、定番って\nわけじゃないけどさ。:
Yeah, not that it's a
regular thing or anything.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、\nそろそろ部屋へ戻ろう。:
▲小早川＊▲,
let's head back to the room.
translations.どした？\nニヤニヤして……。:
What's with you？
Grinning like that...
translations.ベッドがそんなに珍しい？:
Are beds really that
unusual to you？
translations.いや、そうじゃなくて、\n布団でも良かったな、と。:
No, it's not that. I just
thought futons would've
been nice, too.
translations.あ、それはリンコも思った。\nやっぱりさ、ほら……\nせっかく泊まるワケだし？:
Oh, I thought so too.
I mean, come on... since
we're staying the night？
translations.だよな！\nじゃあ、片方のベッドに――:
Right？ Then let's just
use one of the beds—
translations.そう、いつもベッドだから、\n布団の方が、非日常感が――:
Yeah, I always use a bed,
so futons have more of
that getaway feel—
translations.ちょっと待った……\n片方のベッドに？:
Hold on a second...
Use one of the beds？
translations.調子に乗んな！\nエロジジイ……。:
Don't get carried away!
You dirty old man...
translations.▲主人公＊▲、\nそう言えばさ、\nこないだのあれ、観た？:
▲主人公＊▲,
by the way, did you watch
that thing the other day？
translations.あれって言ったらあれでしょ。\n“ふらり途中下車の町”。:
You know what I mean.
'Wandering Stopover Towns.'
translations.テレビの旅番組か。\nいや、観てないけど？:
Oh, that TV travel show.
No, I didn't watch it.
translations.そこは観とこうよ！:
Come on, you should've
watched it!
translations.じゃあさ、\n江の島って知ってる？:
Well then,
do you know Enoshima？
translations.いいとこだってね～？\n近からず遠からず、\n日帰りで行けちゃうみたい\nだしさ:
I hear it's a great place.
Not too close, not too far,
and just right for a day
trip, you know？
translations.それにほら、江の島は湘南だよ？\n湘南って言ったら青春だよ？\n青春の登竜門みた:
Plus, Enoshima is in Shonan!
And Shonan means youth, right？
It's practically a rite of
passage for teenagers!
translations.登竜門？\nよくわかんないけど……。\nつまり、行ってみたいってこと？:
A rite of passage？
Not sure I follow, but...
Are you saying you wanna go？
translations.え、リンコが？\nう～ん、どうだろうなぁ～\nアンタが行きたいかと思って。:
Huh, me？
Hmm, I don't know about that~
I just figured YOU wanted to go.
translations.行ってみたいんじゃないの？\n……ね？:
You want to go, don't you？
...Right？
translations.よし、じゃあ行ってみるか？:
All right, wanna go check
it out then？
translations.やったっ！\nじゃ、決まりね！\n武士に二言はないからね！\nアンタは今日から武:
Yes!
Then it's settled!
A samurai never goes back
on his word, so starting
today, you're a samurai! Hehe!
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、\nよっぽど行きたいんだな……）:
(▲小早川＊▲ must really
want to go...)
translations.▲小早川＊▲……\nなんか今日はいつもより、\nお洒落だな？:
▲小早川＊▲...
You're dressed up more than
usual today, aren't you？
translations.だってさ、そりゃあさ……\nねぇ？:
Well, I mean, of course...
You know？
translations.まあ、いいからいいから！\nほら、行こう！\n青春が待ってるぜ！:
Anyway, never mind that!
Come on, let's go!
Our youth is waiting for us!
translations.ノリノリだな、▲小早川＊▲。\nよし、行くか！:
You're really into this,
▲小早川＊▲. All right, let's go!
translations.へへ……\n今日は江の島だからね？:
Hehe...
Well, we're going to
Enoshima today, right？
translations.▲小早川＊▲……\nやっぱりいつもより、\nちょっとお洒落？:
▲小早川＊▲...
Did you dress up a little
more than usual today？
translations.あのさ、\nこの電車、江ノ電だよね？\nってことは、もう湘南？:
Listen,
this train is the Enoden, right？
Does that mean we're in Shonan？
translations.さっきから窓の外、\n家ばっかでさ、\nこう……湘南っぽくないじゃん？:
All I've seen out the window
are houses, so...
it doesn't feel very Shonan,
does it？
translations.さっき鵠沼あたりで\nちらっと海が見えたろ？:
We caught a glimpse of the
ocean back around Kugenuma,
didn't we？
translations.ダメだ、前向きに行こう。\n江ノ電に乗ってからが湘南。\nそういうことで。:
No, gotta stay positive.
Shonan starts once you're on
the Enoden. Let's go with that.
translations.なんだそれ……。\nでもまあ、そうだな？:
What kind of rule is that...？
Well, sure, why not？
translations.そうそう、湘南なんてさ、\n気の持ちようだよ。\n前向きに行こうジャン♪\nあ、:
That's right, Shonan is all
a state of mind.
Let's stay positive, jan♪
Oh, since we're in Shonan now,
I'll be saying 'jan' a lot, okay？
translations.やっぱさ、江ノ電に乗ると、\nなんかテンション上がるね？:
Riding the Enoden really
gets you excited, huh？
translations.旅って感じがするよな、\nやっぱり。:
It really makes you feel
like you're on a trip.
translations.ちょっとさ、\n一番前行って来ていい？:
Hey, mind if I go up
to the very front？
translations.あのさ……。\n念のため、質問なんだけどさ。\nここ、江の島だよね？:
Hey, um...
Just to be sure, quick question.
This IS Enoshima, right？
translations.だろ？\n江ノ島駅って書いてある。:
Pretty sure？
The sign says Enoshima Station.
translations.海は？\nっていうか江の島は？:
Where's the ocean？
Or for that matter, Enoshima？
translations.さっき江ノ電から\nちらっと見えたような。:
I think I caught a glimpse
of it from the train earlier.
translations.江の島は江の島でもさ、\n別の江の島でしたって\nオチじゃないよね？:
Don't tell me it IS Enoshima,
just a totally different one
with the same name？
translations.まさか……\nとりあえず、\nちょっと南に向かってみるか？\nほら、前向きに行こ:
No way...
Anyway, how about we
head south a bit first？
Come on, stay positive!
translations.はぁ～！\nやっぱいいね。\n江ノ電江ノ島駅は。\n風情があるね！:
Ahh~!
I really love this place.
Enoden Enoshima Station
has such a nice vibe!
translations.海も江の島も見えないけどな。:
Even though you can't see
the ocean or Enoshima.
translations.こうして、\n目を閉じて耳を澄ましてみれば\nほら、もう潮騒が……。:
If you just close your eyes
and listen closely like this,
see, you can hear the waves...
translations.聞こえるような気が、\nしないでもない、かもしれない。:
...Or maybe I kind of feel
like I can almost hear them.
translations.わかったわかった。\nほら、行こう！:
Okay, okay, I get it.
Come on, let's go!
translations.ほら、こっち！\n早く早く！:
Come on, this way!
Hurry, hurry!
translations.来たねぇ、江の島……。\nぽっかり浮かんだ島！\n灯台、輝く海！\nやっぱさ、こ:
Here we are, Enoshima...
An island floating out there!
A lighthouse, a shining sea!
Now this is more like it!
translations.ああ、\nこれぞ江の島って感じだな！:
Yeah,
now this feels like Enoshima!
translations.誰？\n別の江の島じゃ……。\nとか言っちゃってさ、失礼だよ？\n江の島さんに対:
Who was it that said,
"Maybe it's another Enoshima"？
That's pretty rude
to Mr. Enoshima, you know.
translations.まあな。\n言ったのは▲小早川＊▲\nだけどな。:
Yeah, well,
you're the one who said it,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そっか、へへ。\nごめんなさい、江の島さん。\n行こう！:
Oh right, hehe.
Sorry about that, Mr. Enoshima.
Let's go!
translations.今日もいい天気だな、\n島がよく見える。:
Nice weather again today.
You can really see the island.
translations.ただいま、江の島。\nまた来ちゃったよ。:
I'm back, Enoshima.
Came to visit again.
translations.ずいぶん気に入ったんだな、\n江の島。:
You've really taken a liking
to Enoshima, huh.
translations.まあね。\nもう、リンコの\n縄張りみたいなもんだからね。\nハァ～、緑の島！:
Well, yeah.
It's practically Rinko's
turf at this point.
Ahh~, green island! Blue sea!
Long bridge!
translations.……ちょっと長いよね、\n弁天橋……。:
...It really is kinda long,
though, Benten Bridge...
translations.歩いて渡るには、\nちょっとな……。:
A bit much
to cross on foot, yeah...
translations.さてと、いい時間だし\nそろそろかな……。:
Well, it's a good time for it,
so maybe we should...
translations.またまた。\nホントは期待してたくせに。:
Oh, come on.
Like you weren't hoping for it.
translations.そうです。\nリンコズランチＢＯＸ\nｉｎ 江の島です。:
That's right.
It's Rinko's Lunch Box
in Enoshima.
translations.やったー！\nじゃあ、江の島名物がたくさん？:
Awesome!
So it's packed with
Enoshima specialties？
translations.入って無いのでネーミングで\nカバーです。\nほら、\nどっか見晴らしいい場所探:
There aren't any in it, so
the name's doing all the work.
Come on, find us a spot
with a nice view!
translations.うん。\n先に行っといた方が\nいいかもね。\nオッケー。:
Yeah.
Might be better to head there
first.
Okay.
translations.どういたしまして。\n……江の島名物は、\n島に色々あるからさ？\n手作り弁当は:
You're welcome.
...There're plenty of Enoshima
specialties on the island,
so think of a homemade lunch
as a Rinko specialty.
translations.そうだな？\nさてと、\n昼も食べたことだし、次は……。:
True enough.
Alright, now that we've
had lunch, next up...
translations.ここまで来たんだからさ、\nサムエル・コッキング苑、\n行こうよ。\nほら、灯台:
Since we came all this way,
let's go to the
Samuel Cocking Garden.
Come on, we gotta hit
the lighthouse too, right？
translations.▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲、\n行くだろ？:
We're going to
▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲, right？
translations.行っとく。\nへへ、\nリンコもそう思ってたよ。:
Let's.
Hehe, I was thinking
the same thing.
translations.う～ん……\nやっぱさ、潮風が違うね。\n湘南は！:
Mmm...
The sea breeze really is
different here in Shonan!
translations.まあな。\n来てよかったな？:
Guess so.
Glad we came, huh？
translations.うん。\nあっ……ほら、猫！\nおーい、ねこニャ～ン♪:
Yeah.
Oh... Look, a cat!
Hey there, kitty~♪
translations.反応無しか……。\nなんか偉そうな奴だな。:
No reaction, huh...
Pretty full of himself.
translations.コラ、\n気、悪くするじゃん！\nあ……。:
Hey,
you'll hurt his feelings!
Oh...
translations.うん。\n逃げるわけでもなく、\nなんか余裕って感じ。\n……どこ行くんだろ。:
Yeah.
Didn't even run away.
Just strolled right off.
...Wonder where he's going.
translations.ちょっと、ついて行ってみる？: Wanna follow him for a bit？
translations.それ面白そう！\n……だけど、いいや。\n今日は、やめとく。:
That sounds fun!
...Actually, never mind.
Let's pass on that today.
translations.ん？\n疲れたなら少し休もうか？:
Hm？
Want to take a little break
if you're tired？
translations.ぜんぜん？\nちょっと、潮風深呼吸中……。:
Not at all？
Just taking deep breaths
of the sea breeze...
translations.エスカーか……\nうまいこと考えるね。:
The Escar, huh...
Pretty clever idea.
translations.平気――あっ！\nほらまたあの子！\nさっきの茶トラの猫、\nこっち見てる。\n:
I'm fine-- Oh!
Look, it's him again!
That ginger tabby's
looking right at us.
Hey there.
translations.また行っちゃった……\n逃げるでもなくモタモタと。\nリンコたちさ、\nもしかし:
He walked off again...
Not running, just dawdling.
Do you think...
he's looking down on us？
translations.リンコがさ、\n江の島の一番偉い人に\nなったら、どうすると思う？:
What do you think I'd do
if I were put in charge
of all of Enoshima？
translations.全ての坂にエスカーを\n整備します。:
I would install Escars
on every single hill.
translations.あ、ほら！\nまたいた！\nさっきのでっかい茶トラ！:
Oh, look!
There he is again!
That big ginger tabby!
translations.もう行っちゃった……\nまたこっち見てた。:
He's already gone...
He was looking at us again.
translations.もしかしてあの子、\nリンコ達について来いって\n言いたいのかな？:
Wait, do you think
he's trying to tell us
to follow him？
translations.う～ん……\nやっぱさ、風が違うね。\n湘南は！:
Mmm...
The breeze really is
different here in Shonan!
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n知ってる？\nなんかさ、今日は\n爽やか湘南ボーイって感じだよ:
Hey, ▲主人公＊▲.
You know what？
You've got a real breezy
Shonan boy vibe today.
translations.う～ん！\nいいじゃん、いいじゃん！\nお土産物屋がいっぱい！:
Mmm!
Nice, very nice!
So many souvenir shops!
translations.観光客も多いな。\nザ・観光地って感じだ。:
Lots of tourists, too.
Real textbook tourist spot.
translations.まあね。\n普段のリンコなら\nちょっと苦手かも。\nでも、今日は気合い入ってる:
True.
Normally this might be
a bit much for me.
But I'm all geared up today.
translations.それは～……。\nほら、今日のリンコは\n湘南ガールだから？\nあ、なんかいい匂:
Well, that's...
Because I'm a Shonan girl
today, obviously？
Oh, something smells good!
translations.サザエの壺焼きか？\n食べてみる？:
Grilled turban shells？
Wanna try some？
translations.サザエはね……\n先っちょのスプラッターな\nとこがちょっとね……\nあ、あれは:
Turban shells, though...
That gory-looking bit at the
end is a little much...
Oh, what's that？
Look at those retro bottles.
translations.へぇ！\nリンコそっちにしーようっと！:
Ooh!
I think I'll go with that!
translations.この辺津宮にはさ、\n日本三大弁天の一つの、\n裸弁天が祀られてるんだって。:
They say Hetsunomiya here
enshrines the Naked Benten,
one of Japan's three great
Benten statues.
translations.縁結びの神様だけどさ、\n昔は、カップルで来ると弁天様が\nヤキモチやいて、別れ:
She's a matchmaking goddess,
but people used to say she'd
get jealous of couples who
visit and break them up.
translations.へぇ、詳しいんだな？:
Huh, you really know
a lot about this, huh？
translations.ん？\nなんか罰あたりなこと考えてる？:
Hm？
Are you thinking something
sacrilegious right now？
translations.ハァ……\n階段降りすぎで、\n膝が笑ってる……。:
Ugh...
We went down so many stairs,
my knees are shaking...
translations.岩屋は……。\nもう少し先だな。:
The Iwaya caves are...
just a bit further ahead.
translations.期待させるねぇ……。:
Really builds up the
anticipation, huh...
translations.わっ、涼し～！: Whoa, it's so cool in here!
translations.いろいろ演出もあって、\nちゃんと整備されてるんだな。:
They've got all sorts of
effects set up. It's really
well maintained.
translations.そうそう。\nここもやっぱり、\n天女と五頭龍の……。:
Yeah, right.
This place is also tied to
the five-headed dragon and
the celestial maiden...
translations.……え？\nリンコそんなこと言った？\nさあ、もうちょっと奥、\n行くよ？:
...Huh？
Did I say that？
Come on, let's head a little
further inside, okay？
translations.賑やかだね、相変わらず。: It's as lively as ever here.
translations.だな。\nそれに、いつ来ても、\n美味そうな匂いがするな。:
Yeah.
And it always smells so good
no matter when we come.
translations.サザエの壺焼きね。\n確かに、いい匂いだけどね。:
The grilled turban shells, huh.
They do smell good, I'll admit.
translations.今回は、\n思い切って\nチャレンジしてみるか？:
Want to take the plunge
and try one this time？
translations.人はさ、サザエの味がわかった\n時から大人になっちゃうんだよ。:
People become adults the
moment they acquire a taste
for turban shells, you know.
translations.リンコはさ、\nもう少し子供のままでいたいよ。:
And I'd like to stay a kid
just a little bit longer.
translations.……食べないんだな、つまり？:
...So in other words,
you're not eating one？
translations.丸焼きたこせんべい並ぼっと。:
I'm gonna get in line for the
whole-octopus crackers.
translations.ちょっとさ、\n離れて歩いてくんない？:
Hey, could you walk
a little bit away from me？
translations.そうじゃないけど……。\nほら、あんまり仲がいいと、\n弁天様が、さ？:
It's not that...
You know, if we look too
close, Benten might...
translations.ヤキモチやくって？\n迷信だろ。\nそれに、本当は\n縁結びの神様だって。:
Get jealous, right？
That's just superstition.
Besides, she's actually a
matchmaking goddess.
translations.でもさ、万が一ってことも\nあるかもよ？:
Still, you never know
for sure, right？
translations.▲小早川＊▲……\nよし、じゃあちょっとな？:
▲小早川＊▲...
All right, just a little, okay？
translations.うん。\nちょっとの間だけ、ね？:
Yeah.
Just for a little while, okay？
translations.エスカーは……。\n出来てないか。そっか。:
An Escar escalator...
Still haven't built one, huh.
translations.こうして見てるとさ、\nやっぱりここの龍神様が、\nラスボスっぽいね。:
Looking at it like this,
the Dragon God in here really
feels like the final boss.
translations.大きいのは龍宮の方だろ？:
The one at Ryugu Shrine
is bigger, though, right？
translations.う～ん……。\nでも、光る石の演出とか、\n洞窟の奥ってこと考えると、\nやっぱ:
Hmm...
With the glowing stone effect
and being deep in a cave, this
one's totally the final boss.
translations.リンコ達も、\nたまには案内書きとか、\n読んでみよっか。\n小学生じゃないんだ:
Maybe we should actually
read the info signs for once.
We're not grade-schoolers
anymore...
translations.う～ん……。\nこのあたりが全部、\nサムエルさんの庭園だったんだ。:
Hmm...
So this whole area used to be
Mr. Samuel's garden.
translations.あ、ほら、あっち！\n灯台見えてる！:
Oh, look over there!
You can see the lighthouse!
translations.下から見るよりさ、\nやっぱ高いね、登ってみると。:
It feels way higher up here
than it looked from down
below.
translations.島のてっぺんに建ってるからな。:
Well, it's built right at
the top of the island.
translations.うん……\n湘南が一望だね。\nあ、えぼし岩みっけ。:
Yeah...
You can see all of Shonan.
Oh, I found Eboshi Rock.
translations.歌詞によく使われるよな。\n向こうが鎌倉か。:
It pops up in song lyrics a
lot. And that's Kamakura
over there, huh.
translations.ハァ！\n風、強い！\nでも気持ちいい！\nすごく正しい青春な感じ！:
Whoa!
The wind's strong!
Feels great, though!
Like textbook youth!
translations.反対側、行ってみよう？\nほら、リンコを捕まえて～！:
Let's check out the other
side! Come on, catch me
if you can!
translations.走るなって、\n青春すぎるだろ！:
Hey, don't run!
That's taking the youth
thing way too far!
translations.龍だね……。\n江の島ってさ、\nちょっとＲＰＧ的なとこあるね。\n天女とか、龍:
Sure is...
Enoshima kind of feels like
an RPG, doesn't it？ With
celestial maidens and dragons.
translations.色々な所に描かれるよな。:
You see them depicted all
over the place here.
translations.そうそう。\n実はそれが全部フラグで、\nこれがラスボスの洞窟だとしたら、どうよ:
Right, right.
What if all of that is
foreshadowing, and this is
the final boss's cave？
translations.どうよって言われても……。\nまあ、クエストだろうな。:
What do you want me to say
to that...? Well, I guess
it'd be a quest.
translations.では、選ばれし勇者よ、\nドラゴンを倒すのです！:
Then go forth, Chosen Hero,
and slay the dragon!
translations.そう。\nリンコ姫はここで待ってるから。\nやっておしまい！:
That's right.
Princess Rinko will wait right
here. Go finish it off!
translations.稚児ヶ淵か……。\nこうして見ると、\n海底が隆起したってわかるな。:
So this is Chigogafuchi...
Looking at it like this, you
can really tell it's raised
seafloor.
translations.うん……\nあっちの岩屋はさ、\n龍窟とも言うんだって。\nホント、\n龍が棲ん:
Yeah...
They say the Iwaya caves
are also called the Dragon
Caves. It really feels like
a dragon could live there.
translations.ところでさ、\nこの辺、エスカーなかった？:
By the way,
isn't there an Escar
around here？
translations.エスカーって、\nあの神社をつないでる\nエスカレーターだろ？\nないんじゃない:
The Escar？ You mean those
escalators connecting the
shrines？ I don't think
there's one back here.
translations.そんなに乗りたかったのか、\nエスカー？:
Did you want to ride the
Escar that badly？
translations.ていうか、今、猛烈にね。\nさっき降りた階段のこと\n思い出したから……。:
Well, I really do right now.
I just remembered all those
stairs we walked down
earlier...
translations.確かに。\n今度はあれ、登るわけか……。:
Good point.
We have to climb all the way
back up those now...
translations.ねぇねぇ、カメラマンさん。\nこの辺さ、いい雰囲気？:
Hey, Mr. Photographer.
Doesn't this spot have a
nice vibe？
translations.あ、ここいいかも。\n江の島っぽい。:
Oh, this spot looks nice.
Very Enoshima.
translations.じゃあ、写真撮っとくか。:
All right, let's take a
picture.
translations.ねぇ、せっかくだからさ、\nここでも写真、撮って？:
Hey, since we're here,
will you take a picture
of me here too？
translations.なになに、\nリンコも見る。:
What is it？
Let me see too.
translations.わからないけど、\n太陽の位置とレンズの屈折で、\n光のイタズラとか、かな……。:
I don't know, maybe a trick
of the light from the angle
of the sun and the lens...
translations.でも、なんだか\nほら……。:
Still, look at it...
It kind of looks like...
translations.うん。\nまるで、天女の羽衣だ……。:
Yeah.
It looks just like a celestial
maiden's feathered robe...
translations.きっとさ、あの茶トラの子が\nリンコ達にプレゼントして\nくれたんだね……\n大:
I bet that ginger tabby gave
it to us as a present...
Let's treasure it, okay？
translations.なに、失敗した？: What, did it not come out right？
translations.えっ！\nもしかして、また？:
Wait!
Don't tell me it happened again？
translations.やった、羽衣の写真！:
Yes! Another photo of the
feathered robe!
translations.すごい……\nこういう偶然って\nよくある事なのかな……。:
Amazing...
I wonder if coincidences like
this happen a lot...
translations.じゃなきゃ、\n▲小早川＊▲が、\n本当に天女か……。:
Either that, or ▲小早川＊▲
really is a celestial maiden...
translations.だとしたらさ……\nリンコの龍になってくれる？:
If I am...
will you be my dragon？
translations.へへ、\nずっと、一緒だね？:
Hehe,
we'll be together forever, right？
translations.う～ん……\nどっかで通り過ぎちゃったの\nかな……。:
Hmm...
I wonder if we passed it
somewhere along the way...
translations.ホントはさ、リンコまだ\n行きたいとこがあったんだけど、\nもう遅いし、また――:
Well, there was still somewhere
I wanted to go, but it's getting
late, so maybe next—
translations.あっ、あの茶トラだ……\nちょっと待って、\n挨拶してくる。:
Oh, it's that ginger tabby...
Wait a second, I'm going to
go say hi.
translations.また見失っちゃった……\n確かこっちの道に……。:
I lost sight of it again...
I'm pretty sure it went down
this path...
translations.この先は……\n“龍恋の鐘”だって。:
It says the 'Bell of Dragon's
Love' is just ahead.
translations.“龍恋の鐘”……\nそこかも！:
'Bell of Dragon's Love'...
That might be it!
translations.さて……\n今日も江の島を満喫したし、\nそろそろ日が傾くし……。:
Well then...
We got to enjoy Enoshima again
today, and the sun's starting
to set...
translations.ほら、\n最後はやっぱり、ね？:
Come on,
there's one last place we have
to go, right？
translations.夕焼けがすごいな……\nここ？\n▲小早川＊▲が来たかったのは。:
What a sunset...
Is this where you
wanted to come, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.そう。\nあそこの鐘にね、\n天女と五頭龍の伝説のことが\n書いてあるんだって。:
Yeah.
Apparently the legend of the
celestial maiden and the five-headed
dragon is written on that bell.
translations.“天女と五頭龍”？:
'The Celestial Maiden and the
Five-Headed Dragon'？
translations.昔、悪いことばかりしてた\n五つの頭の龍が、この島の\n天女様に恋をして、\nそ:
Long ago, a wicked five-headed
dragon fell in love with this
island's celestial maiden,
had a change of heart, and
protected the people.
translations.それで、天女と龍が\n結ばれた伝説にちなんで、\nこの鐘を鳴らす恋人たちは……。:
And based on the legend of
the maiden and the dragon
coming together, lovers who
ring this bell...
translations.ずっと、\n一緒にいられるんだって。:
They say they'll stay
together forever.
translations.▲小早川＊▲……。\nそれでここに来たかったの？:
▲小早川＊▲...
Is that why you wanted
to come here？
translations.ちょっと似てるでしょ？: It's a little similar, isn't it？
translations.思い出さない？\nリンコがさ、ほら、\n屋上で……。:
Doesn't it remind you？
You know, when I was
on the roof...
translations.テレビで観て、\nリンコも思い出しちゃって。:
I saw this place on TV, and it
brought all those memories back.
translations.リンコは、今でもこうして\n二人でいるだけで、\n時々涙が出そうになるよ。:
Even now, just being with you
like this makes me want to
cry sometimes.
translations.そのことをここで\nもう一度、言いたくて……。:
I wanted to tell you that
one more time, right here...
translations.初めから、そう言えばいいのに。:
You could've just said so
from the start.
translations.だってさ、\nそういう青春ぽいの、\n真面目に言うと、\n笑われそうだもん。:
Well, if I say cheesy,
youthful stuff like that
with a straight face, I feel
like you'll laugh at me.
translations.うん……。\nあのさ、\n今、誰も見てないかも……。:
Yeah...
Hey,
I don't think anyone's
looking right now...
translations.大好き……。\nへへ……。\n鐘、鳴らそっか？:
I love you...
Hehe...
Should we ring the bell？
translations.！！\nなんか、\nちょっと想像してたのと違った。:
!!
That wasn't quite
what I imagined.
translations.でもさ、\nご利益ありそうだよ？:
Still, it sounds like
it'll bring us luck.
translations.まあね。\nなんでか、わかった？:
Yeah.
Did you figure out why？
translations.あの鐘の周りに、\nいっぱい鍵がかかってます。\n……ほら、どっかで見たでしょ？:
There are lots of padlocks
all around that bell.
...Looks familiar, right？
translations.よろしい。\nへへ、\nちょっと似てるでしょ？:
Very good.
Hehe,
looks a bit like it, right？
translations.あの日も、屋上から\nそれはきれいな夕焼けが\n見えました……。:
We saw such a beautiful
sunset from the roof
that day, too...
translations.そうか、\n告白してくれた日の――:
Right, the day
you confessed to me—
translations.やっぱいい！\nちょっと、恥ずかしい……。:
Never mind!
It's a little embarrassing...
translations.テレビでやってて、\nそれで、思い出しちゃってさ。\nもう一度……。:
I saw this place on TV,
and it brought it all back.
I wanted to say it again...
translations.リンコ、照れ屋だからさ、\nこの場所の力を借りれば、\nちゃんと、言えると思って:
I get shy easily, so I figured
with this place's help,
I could say it properly.
translations.そう。\nあの鐘にはさ、\n天女と五頭龍の伝説のことが\n書いてあるんだよ。:
Yeah.
The legend of the celestial
maiden and the five-headed
dragon is written on it.
translations.まあね。\nちょっとリンコのキャラじゃ\nないからさ、言いづらくて。:
Yeah.
It's not really like me,
so it was hard to bring up.
translations.そっか。\nよし、鳴らそう！:
I see.
All right, let's ring it!
translations.！！\nなんか、ちょっと和風？:
!!
Kind of a traditional
Japanese sound, huh？
translations.ありがたい感じだな……。: Has a sacred ring to it...
translations.ま、いっか？\nこういうのも、\nリンコ達だけの思い出だもんね？:
Well, that's fine.
This is a memory just
for the two of us, right？
translations.ねぇ……\n今、リンコ達だけだよ？:
Hey...
We're all alone right now,
you know？
translations.もう……\nほら、もっとこっち。\n来ればいいジャン？:
Geez...
Come on, over here.
Just come a little closer.
translations.へへ……。\n潮風の味がした。:
Hehe...
Tasted like the sea breeze.
translations.うん……。\nあの鐘のね、\n力を借りようかなって。:
Yeah...
I thought I'd borrow
that bell's power.
translations.昔むかし、悪いことばかりしてた\n五つの頭の龍が、この島の\n天女様に恋をしまし:
Once upon a time, a wicked
five-headed dragon fell in love
with this island's celestial
maiden. To win her love, he
reformed and protected people.
translations.それでね、天女様と龍は\n永遠に結ばれたんだって、\nだから、この鐘を鳴らす\n:
And they say the maiden and
the dragon were joined forever.
So lovers who ring
this bell...
translations.それにね？\nほら、思い出さない？:
Plus...
Come on, doesn't it remind
you of something？
translations.あの鐘みたいに、\n鍵がいっぱいかかった……。:
All those locks hanging
up around it, just like
that bell...
translations.リンコがさ、\nほら、校舎の屋上で……。:
When I...
you know, up on the school
rooftop...
translations.うん……\nテレビで観て、\nリンコも思い出しちゃって。\nね、鐘、鳴らしてみよ:
Yeah...
I saw it on TV and it
brought it all back.
Hey, wanna ring the bell？
translations.！！\nあれ？\nなんか、想像してたのと違った。:
!!
Huh？
That didn't sound how I
imagined it would.
translations.うん。\nでも、勇気が出たかも。:
Yeah.
Still, I think it gave me
a little courage.
translations.ねぇ、\nリンコはさ、勇気が無いから、\n時々、こんな風に\nめんどくさいけど…:
Look...
I'm not very brave, so I
know I can be a pain like
this sometimes...
translations.でも、ずっとずっと、\n大好き。\n一緒にいたい……。:
But I really, truly
love you.
I want to stay with you...
translations.リンコの気持ち、\nちゃんと伝わった？:
Did my feelings...
really get through to you？
translations.じゃあ、\n次にしたいこと、わかる？:
Then...
do you know what I want
to do next？
translations.やっぱり、\nちょっと恥ずかしいね……。:
It really is
a little embarrassing...
translations.やっぱり、\nここは夕焼けがいいな……。:
The sunset really is
great up here...
translations.うん。\n一日の冒険の終わりって\n感じ。:
Yeah.
Feels like the end of a
day-long adventure.
translations.ザ ヘブンリーメイデン ＆\nザ ５ヘッディッド ドラゴン。\n鐘のところに英語:
"The Heavenly Maiden &
the 5-Headed Dragon."
It's written in English
right by the bell.
translations.“天女と五頭龍”か。\nやっぱ、ＲＰＧっぽいよな？:
"The Heavenly Maiden and
Five-Headed Dragon," huh.
Really sounds like an RPG.
translations.ねぇねぇ\nエンディングは？:
Hey, hey,
what about the ending？
translations.エンディング？\nどうしよう。:
The ending？
What should we do？
translations.じゃあね……\nまず、ドラゴンとお姫様が、\n鐘を鳴らします。:
Okay, so...
First, the dragon and the
princess ring the bell.
translations.●、ドラゴン？:
Wait, ● get to be
the dragon？
translations.お姫様がよかった？:
Did you want to be the
princess instead？
translations.！！\nやっぱさ、\n和風だね、この音。:
!!
That sound really is
very traditional, huh.
translations.天女と龍の方が合ってるな？:
Fits a heavenly maiden and
dragon better, doesn't it？
translations.はい、じゃあ続き。\nそれから龍は……。:
Okay, back to the story.
And then, the dragon...
translations.おーい、\n▲小早川＊▲！\nもう電車来るぞ？:
Hey,
▲小早川＊▲!
The train's almost here!
translations.そっ。\n……どう？\nわりと男前でしょ？\nこのドラゴン。:
Yep.
...What do you think？
He's pretty handsome for
a dragon, right？
translations.そうか？\nもっとカッコいいの、\nありそうだけどな？:
You think so？
I feel like there've gotta
be cooler ones out there.
translations.う～ん、\nあったような気もするけど……\nいいじゃん。\nリンコはこれが好きな:
Hmm,
maybe there were, but...
who cares？
I like this one! Hehe!
translations.そっか。\nじゃあ、●もそれ、\n買うかな？:
I see.
Maybe ● should buy
that one too, then？
translations.あのさ……。\nアンタがドラゴン買って\nどうすんの？\n買うんなら、\n世界一:
Listen... What're you gonna
do with a dragon？ If you
buy one, it should be the
world's cutest celestial
maiden, right？
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、いい思い出に\nなったみたいだな……）:
(Looks like this made a nice
memory for ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.この駅ってさ、夕方になると\n旅先っていうより、\n自分の町の駅みたいな\n感じ:
When evening comes, this
station feels less like a
trip and more like the one
back in my own town...
translations.うん。\nなんかわかる気がする……。:
Yeah.
I think I know what you mean...
translations.まるでさ、\n早く帰っておいでって\n言われてるみたい。:
It's almost like
it's telling us to hurry
on home.
translations.やっぱりさ、\n江の島に来ると、\n▲小早川＊▲は乙女になるな。:
You know, coming to Enoshima
really brings out the maiden
in you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ん？\nいつも乙女だっつーの！:
Huh？
I'm always a maiden,
I'll have you know!
translations.電車来た！\n急げーっ！:
The train's here!
Come on, hurry!
translations.（そうだ！\n日光・鬼怒川旅行の懸賞、\n誘ってみるかな……）:
(Oh, right!
Maybe I'll invite her on that
Nikko-Kinugawa prize trip...)
translations.実はさ、また当たったんだ、\n旅行の懸賞。:
Actually, I won another
prize trip.
translations.前に言ったかもしんないけどさ、\n買ってるよね？\nもう、明らかに。:
I might've said this before,
but you're buying these,
aren't you？ Obviously.
translations.違うって！\nそれに今回は、熱海じゃなくて、\n『おとなの修学旅行、\n日光・鬼:
I'm telling you, I'm not!
And it's not Atami this time!
It's a 2-day, 1-night
'Adult School Trip to
Nikko and Kinugawa Onsen'!!
translations.へぇ～\n日光・鬼怒川か……\nん？\n『おとなの修学旅行』？:
Huh...
Nikko and Kinugawa, huh...
Wait.
'Adult School Trip'？
translations.まあ、●達の場合、修学旅行は\nそのまま学生だけどな。\n旅行は旅行だしさ？:
Well, in your case, ●,
we're still actual students.
But a trip's a trip, right？
translations.へぇ、\nなんか、▲小早川＊▲っぽく\n無いところに、引っかかるな？:
Huh.
That's an unusual part for
you to care about, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.だってさ……\n行けないじゃん？\nホントの修学旅行には、\n一緒に……。:
Well, I mean...
We can't go on a real
school trip together,
can we...？
translations.そっか。\nまあ、学年違うからな？:
Right.
Since we're in different
grades and all.
translations.アンタが留年でもしてくれれば、\n話は別だけど。:
If you got held back a year,
that'd be a different story,
though.
translations.ぶっそうな事言うな……\nでも、たしかに\nそういう意味でもアリだよな？:
Don't jinx me like that...
Still, in that sense, this
is a pretty nice idea, huh？
translations.うん……\nアリだね、これは……うんうん。\nヘッヘッヘッ……。:
Yeah...
This could really work...
Mhm, yeah.
Heheheh...
translations.べつに？\nそんでそんで？ いつ？\nこっちは休みなら、\nいつでもいいけど？:
Nothing？
So, so？ When is it？
As long as it's a day off,
I'm good whenever.
translations.じゃあ。\n▲月▲▲日▲から、\n一泊二日のおとなの修学旅行だ！:
All right, then.
Starting ▲月▲▲日▲,
it's our 2-day, 1-night
Adult School Trip!
translations.ていうか、あのさ。\n『おとな』関係ないからね？\n言っとくけど。\n学生だから:
Just so we're clear, the
'adult' part has nothing to
do with us, okay？
We're still students.
translations.まあ…………ちょびっとなら、\nオトナでもいいけど？\nほら、二人きりだし？\n:
Well... I guess a little bit
of 'adult' is okay, though？
Since we'll be alone, and...
I am your girlfriend.
translations.（よしっ!!\n●と▲小早川＊▲、\n二人きりの修学旅行だっ！）:
(All right!!
A school trip with ●,▲小早川＊▲
just the two of us!)
translations.実はまた当たったんだ。\n『日光・鬼怒川、\nおとなの修学旅行』。:
Actually, I won that raffle
again. The 'Nikko-Kinugawa
Adult School Trip.'
translations.いやいやいや……\n無い無い無い。:
No, no, no...
There's just no way.
translations.当たったんだって！\nじゃ、行くのやめるか？:
I'm telling you, I won it!
Well, wanna skip it then？
translations.そうは言ってないけどさ。\n……騙されてないよね？\n行った先でナゾのセミナーと:
I didn't say that. ...You're
not being scammed, right？
Like some shady seminar.
You're an easy target...
translations.考えすぎだろ……\nそれより日程、どうする？:
You're overthinking it...
Anyway, when should we go？
translations.よしっ！\n▲月▲▲日▲からの\n一泊二日で、\n『おとなの修学旅行』だ！:
All right!
A 2-day, 1-night
'Adult School Trip'
starting ▲月▲▲日▲!
translations.『おとな』強調しないように。\nちょびっとだから。:
Don't emphasize the 'adult'
part. I said just a little bit.
translations.そうだった。\n……ちょびっとって、\nどれくらいだっけ？:
Oh, right.
...Wait, how much is
'a little bit' again？
translations.それは、ほら……\n知ってるじゃん……バカ。:
Come on...
You already know... Idiot.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲と、\n二人きりの\n修学旅行に行けるぞ！）:
(I get to go on a school trip
with ▲小早川＊▲,
just the two of us!)
translations.なんか買い物、必要？\nほら、修学旅行じゃん？:
Do we need to shop for
anything？ It's a school
trip, after all.
translations.（とりあえず、行っとくか）:
(Might as well go along
with it.)
translations.そこは、考えてよ。\n年上なんだからさ。:
You figure that part out.
You're the older one.
translations.そんなことかとは\n思ったけどな……\nじゃあ、とりあえず……。:
I had a feeling you'd say
that...
Okay, for starters...
translations.▲小早川＊▲、\n水着買っとかなくていいのか？:
▲小早川＊▲,
don't you need to buy
a swimsuit？
translations.水着？\nこの時期に？:
A swimsuit？
At this time of year？
translations.ほら、また熱海みたいに、\n家族風呂があるかも\nしれないしだろ？:
Well, they might have a
private bath again, like
in Atami, right？
translations.あるかも知んないけどさ、\nなんで、入ること\n前提になってんの……。:
Maybe they do, but why are
you assuming we're going in
together...
translations.そうは言ってないけどさ……\nなんか、水着で一緒にって、\n恥ずかしいっていうか:
I didn't say that...
It's just embarrassing going
in together in swimsuits...
translations.さてと！\n買い物、これで終了か？\n▲小早川＊▲、なに買った？:
All right!
Are we all done shopping？
What'd you buy, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.オヤツかよ……\nまあ、修学旅行っぽくは\nあるけどさ。:
Snacks...？
Well, I guess that feels
like a school trip.
translations.まあ、リンコくらい\n旅慣れてくると、\n特に準備しなくても\n大丈夫ってことだ:
Well, when you're a seasoned
traveler like me, you don't
really need to prep anything.
translations.じゃ、なんで\n買い物に来たんだよ……。:
Then why did we even
come shopping...
translations.いいじゃん、\nアンタが準備万端ならさ？\nリンコは全面的に信頼してるよ。:
What does it matter, as long
as you're all prepared？
I have complete faith in you.
translations.じゃあな？\n当日にドタバタしないように、\n前の夜に荷造りしとけよ？:
See you, then.
Make sure you pack the night
before so you're not rushing
that morning, okay？
translations.はいはい。\n善処します！\nそんじゃね、バイバイ！:
Yeah, yeah.
I'll see what I can do!
Later, bye-bye!
translations.（はぁ～～……ねむ……\nえぇと、▲小早川＊▲は……）:
(Yaawn... So sleepy...
Let's see, where's ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.（おいおい……\nそろそろ洒落になんないぞ……）:
(Hey, come on...
This is getting past the
point of being funny...)
translations.アセったのはこっちだよ……\n寝坊か？:
I'm the one who was
panicking...
Did you oversleep？
translations.言われた通り、昨日の夜\n準備してたら遅くなっちゃって。\nえらい？:
I stayed up late packing last
night, just like you told me.
Aren't you proud of me？
translations.まあな。\n寝坊しちゃしょうがないけどな。:
Yeah, sure.
Doesn't do much good if you
oversleep, though.
translations.まあ、この清々しい\n五月晴れに免じてさ、\n大目に見てよ、ね！:
Come on, cut me some slack
for the sake of this lovely
May weather, okay？
translations.はぁ～……ヤバかった……。:
Phew... That was way too
close...
translations.だから寝る前に支度しろって\n言ったろ？:
Didn't I tell you to pack
before going to bed？
translations.まあまあ、\n女子には色々あるんだよ。\nほら、\n女心と秋の空っていうじゃん？:
Now, now, girls have a lot
going on. You know what they
say about a woman's heart
and the autumn sky, right？
translations.まあな……\nいや、全く関係ないな。:
Right...
Wait, no, that has nothing
to do with this.
translations.へへっ！\nほら、行こう？\nＬｅｔ’ｓ修学旅行！:
Heheh!
Come on, let's go!
Off on our school trip!
translations.ねぇねぇ、\nどっかで乗り換えんでしょ？:
Hey, we have to transfer
somewhere, right？
translations.ああ、浅草から\n東武鉄道の特急。:
Yeah, we take the Tobu
limited express from Asakusa.
translations.で、その特急に乗ったら、\n今度は？:
And once we're on the
express, where to next？
translations.鬼怒川温泉まで行くんだろ？:
We take it all the way to
Kinugawa Onsen, right？
translations.いや、今日は鬼怒川に泊まって、\n明日――▲小早川＊▲……\nもしかして、全く\:
No, we stay in Kinugawa tonight,
and tomorrow—▲小早川＊▲...
Wait, have you not looked at
the itinerary at all？
translations.ヘヘッ、\n頼りにしてるよ▼:
Heh heh.
I'm counting on you, ▼.
translations.おぉ……\n特急スペーシアか……。:
Whoa...
So that's the Spacia express...
translations.へぇ……\n修学旅行って感じがする。\n空飛びそうだね？:
Ooh...
Now this feels like a school
trip. Looks like it could fly,
doesn't it？
translations.飛ばないだろうけどな。\n速そうだよな？:
I doubt it flies,
but it sure looks fast, huh？
translations.ほら、乗るよ！\nリンコ窓側ねっ！:
Come on, let's get on!
I get the window seat!
translations.そうだ。\n▲小早川＊▲、\nツアーの行程表、見たか？:
Oh, right.
▲小早川＊▲, did you look at
the tour itinerary？
translations.はい！\nぜんぜん見てませーん。:
Yes, sir!
Haven't looked at it at all!
translations.少しは見ろよ……。: At least take a look at it...
translations.そういうのはさ、やっぱ、\n男の見せどころじゃん？\nリンコは、三歩下がって\n:
Come on, that kind of stuff is
where a guy gets to shine, right？
I'm gonna play the dutiful
girl walking three steps behind.
Counting on you, ▼.
translations.（そう言う意味じゃないと\n思うぞ……）:
(I don't think that's what
that phrase means...)
translations.いよいよ、\n修学旅行の始まりだな！:
Our school trip is finally
getting started!
translations.う～っ……\nなんか、特急に乗る前って、\nこう、ブルっとする。:
Ooh...
Right before getting on an
express train, I always get
this sudden shiver.
translations.武者震いか？\nわかるわかる！:
Trembling with excitement？
I totally get it!
translations.ちょっと、先に座ってて……\nあ、リンコ窓側取ったから！:
Hold on, go sit down first...
Oh, and I called the window
seat!
translations.（トイレか……\n三歩下がって、な……）:
(Ah, the restroom...
So much for three steps
behind...)
translations.う～ん……\n広い車内、大きな椅子！\nやっぱ特急はいいよな！:
Man...
Spacious cars, big seats!
You really can't beat an
express train!
translations.やっぱ、すごいね、スペーシア。\nビュッフェでコーヒーと\nポテチ買ってきちゃっ:
The Spacia really is amazing.
I ended up buying coffee and
potato chips at the snack car.
translations.ビュッフェはいいけど、\n今からそんなの食って大丈夫か？:
The snack car's great and all,
but should you really be eating
that stuff right now？
translations.平気。\nっていうかさ、\n言っとくけど、修学旅行だよ？\nわかってる？:
I'll be fine.
More importantly, just so we're
clear, this is a school trip.
You get that, right？
translations.つまり、リンコとアンタは、\n同学年でしょ？\nそこんとこ、忘れてない？:
Which means you and I are in
the same grade, right？
You haven't forgotten that,
have you？
translations.同学年の男子のくせに、あんまり\nエラそうにしないように。\nわかった？:
So quit acting so bossy when
we're in the same grade.
Got it？
translations.（女子は\nエラそうでいいのか……）:
(And it's fine for the girl
to act bossy, huh...)
translations.おぉ……\nこの辺りまで来ると、\nずいぶん景色が違うな……。:
Whoa...
The scenery really changes
once you get out this far...
translations.同学年てさ、どうすればいい？\n具体的には。:
So how should we act like we're
in the same grade？
Specifically, I mean.
translations.まだ続いてたのか……\nさぁ……しゃべり方とか？:
We're still on that...？
I dunno... Maybe how we talk？
translations.だよね？\nそう思ってアタマの中で\nシミュレーションして\nたんだけど……。:
Right？
That's what I thought, so I
was running simulations in
my head, but...
translations.どうも、いまいち、\n普段と\n変わんないっていうか……。:
It doesn't really seem any
different from how I usually
talk...
translations.▲小早川＊▲の場合、\nまあ、そうだろうな……。:
In your case, ▲小早川＊▲,
yeah, probably not...
translations.いっそ、キャラ変えてみる？\n例えばほら、昭和の青春ドラマの\nカップルみたいに:
Should we just try changing
our personas completely？
Like a couple from an old-school
teen drama—a dashing guy and
a sweet, cute girl.
translations.（同学年、\n関係無くなってるな……）:
(What happened to being in
the same grade...？)
translations.あのさ、\nいっこ、提案なんだけどさ……。:
Hey,
I have a little suggestion...
translations.素直で可愛いリンコちゃん、\nまたやってあげよっかな、って。\nほら……喜んでた:
I was thinking maybe I could
do 'sweet, cute little Rinko'
for you again.
Come on... You liked it before,
didn't you？
translations.オッケ……じゃなくて……。: You got it... Wait, I mean...
translations.（今回も楽しくなりそうだっ！）:
(Looks like this time's gonna
be a lot of fun too!)
translations.まもなく\n鬼怒川温泉に到着します。\nどちら様も\nお忘れ物の無いよう……。:
We will soon be arriving at
Kinugawa Onsen.
Please make sure you don't
leave anything behind...
translations.来たか、鬼怒川温泉……\nけっこう、近代的なんだな？:
So this is Kinugawa Onsen...
It's pretty modern, huh？
translations.うん……でも、\n二人でいれば、それだけで\nロマンチック……そうでしょ？:
Yes... But just being together
makes it romantic...
Don't you think？
translations.おいおい…………\nどした？:
Whoa, hey...
What's gotten into you？
translations.ちょっとストップ……\n言ったじゃん！\nやって、アンタも魅力的な男子！:
Hold on, time out...
I told you I was doing this!
Now you be the charming guy!
translations.本気だったのかよ……\nじゃあ……よし。:
Wait, you were serious...？
Alright then... Here goes.
translations.そうだな、素敵な思い出、\nたくさん作ろうぜ！\n▲小早川＊▲！:
You said it! Let's make lots
of wonderful memories,
▲小早川＊▲!
translations.ストップストップ。\nえぇと……うん、\nそっかそっか、そうなるんだ。\nじゃあ:
Stop, stop.
Uh... yeah, okay, I see
how that turns out.
Tell you what, hmm...
Never mind, just act normal.
translations.ねぇ、なぁに、あの像？\n鬼かなぁ……カワイイ▼\n見に行こう？:
Hey, what's that statue？
An ogre, maybe...? So cute▼
Shall we go look？
translations.また、二人で来ちゃったね？\n鬼怒川温泉……。:
We came back here together
again, didn't we？
Kinugawa Onsen...
translations.ああ、また鬼怒川で一泊だな？:
Yeah, another overnight stay
in Kinugawa, huh？
translations.うん。\n今日はずっと一緒……\nやっぱり少し、緊張しちゃう。:
Yes.
We're together all day today...
It still makes me a little
nervous.
translations.大丈夫！\n変なことはしないって。:
Don't worry!
I won't try anything funny.
translations.うん……\nでも、ちょっとくらいなら……\nウソ、なんでもないっ！:
Okay...
Though a little wouldn't hurt...
Just kidding, never mind!
translations.（やっぱいいな、これ……\n修学旅行っぽくは無いけどな。）:
(Man, I really do like this...
Doesn't feel much like
a school trip, though.)
translations.お、おう……\nとりあえず、乗船場のある\n川岸に降りてみるか。:
Y-Yeah...
Anyway, let's head down to
the dock by the riverbank.
translations.水が澄んでる……\nきれい……。:
The water's so clear...
It's pretty...
translations.うん、確かに……\nていうか、\n本当に、それでいくのか？:
Yeah, it really is...
Wait, are you seriously
sticking with that act？
translations.おっ！\nあの、救命胴衣ってさ？\nサイズでいったら、\n▲小早川＊▲は\n『４:
Oh, look!
Those life jackets over there—
going by size, would yours be
'Ages 4 to Grade School',
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.やだ～、もうっ！\nイジワルなんだからっ！:
Oh, stop it!
You're such a meanie!
translations.あ、乗船が始まったみたい！\n行こう？:
Oh, looks like boarding's
started! Shall we go？
translations.サンキュ！\n早く川のとこ、行ってみよ？:
Thanks!
Come on, let's head down
to the river!
translations.はぁ～！\n空気がヒンヤリしてて、\n気持ちいい……。:
Aaah!
The air's nice and cool.
Feels so good...
translations.ああ……\nこの辺りは流れも\n緩やかだしな？:
Yeah...
The current's pretty gentle
around here, too.
translations.この時二人はまだ、猛獣が\nひしめくジャングルクルーズに\nなろうとは、予想だに:
Little did the two of them know
this would become a jungle
cruise swarming with wild
beasts... Heheh!
translations.あっ、早く！\nリンコ、前の方乗りたい！\n行こっ！:
Oh, hurry!
I wanna sit up near the front!
Let's go!
translations.おぉ……\n思ったより、スリルあるぞ……。:
Whoa...
This is more thrilling
than I expected...
translations.はい、水が来ますよ！\nシート上げてください！:
Alright, water's coming!
Please pull up your
splash sheets!
translations.え、ウソッ!?\nちょ、待って!!:
What, no way！？
W-Wait a second!!
translations.はい、\nこれがお化け岩！\nお化けに見えますねぇ～。:
And right here is Ghost Rock!
Sure looks like a ghost,
doesn't it？
translations.アハハッ！\nさすがに無理あるって！\n大体さ、ゴリラ岩とか象岩とか\nさっきま:
Ahaha!
Okay, that's a huge stretch!
Besides, we had Gorilla Rock
and Elephant Rock—it was a
jungle theme up till now!
translations.おお……\nけっこう水かかったぞ！:
Whoa...
We got splashed pretty good!
translations.イェー！\nリンコはセーフだもんねっ！\nヘヘンッ！:
Yay!
Rinko stayed nice and dry!
Heheh!
translations.はい、あちらをご覧ください！\nあの飛び出した岩、見えますか？:
Now, please look over there!
See that rock sticking out？
translations.先に言っちゃダメだろ！: Don't say it before he does!
translations.うん、決めた。\nやっぱ、ヤメ。\n無理、昭和のモテ女子。\nまずセリフが無理。:
Yeah, I've decided.
I'm dropping it.
The Showa popular-girl act
is a no-go. Especially the
lines.
translations.早かったな……\nまあ、いつもの通りでいけよ。:
That was fast...
Well, just be yourself.
translations.だよね？\nでもさ……ちょっと、\n楽しかった、素直キャラって。:
Right？
Still... playing the sweet,
honest type was kind of fun.
translations.だから……\n素直で可愛いリンコちゃんは、\n続行……アリ？:
So...
would it be okay if sweet,
cute little Rinko stuck
around a bit longer？
translations.ヘヘッ！\nじゃあ……\n手、繋いじゃおっと♪:
Heheh!
Then...
I'm gonna hold your hand♪
translations.次はバスを乗り継いで\n東武ワールドスクウェアだな！:
Next we take the bus over
to Tobu World Square!
translations.いやぁ～、楽しいっ！\nエンタテイメントしてるよね？:
Man, that was so much fun!
Now that's entertainment,
right？
translations.船頭さんのナレーションが\n効いてるな？:
The boatman's commentary
really sells it, huh？
translations.そういうこと！\nそうだ……\nねぇねぇ、手つないでいい？:
Exactly!
Oh, right...
Hey, can we hold hands？
translations.ヘッヘー♪\nバスの中も、ずっとだからね？:
Heheh♪
Even on the bus, the whole
time, okay？
translations.あ、バス来た！\nほら、行こ？\n東武ワールドスクウェア！:
Oh, the bus is here!
Come on, let's go!
Off to Tobu World Square!
translations.ここさ、リンコ結構、\n楽しみにしてたんだよね。:
You know, Rinko's actually
been looking forward to
this place a lot.
translations.小さい頃さ、\nお人形とか、ドールハウスとか、\nいっぱい持っててさ、\nよく遊:
When I was little,
I had tons of dolls and
dollhouses, and I used to
play with my mom all the time.
translations.（亡くなったお母さんの事だな、\nきっと……）:
(She must mean her mother
who passed away...)
translations.フリフリの服ばっか\n着せてもらってさ、\n髪も長ーくてさ……、\n今からは想像:
She always dressed me up
in frilly clothes, and my
hair was super long...
Hard to imagine now, huh？
translations.いいじゃん。\n今日は、素直でカワイイ\n▲小早川＊▲だろ？:
Nothing wrong with that.
Besides, you're sweet, cute
▲小早川＊▲ today, right？
translations.着いた。\n東武ワールドスクウェアか……。:
We're here.
Tobu World Square, huh...
translations.『夢・感動との出逢い』。\n煽るね～……いいの？\nリンコ、期待しちゃうぞ？:
'An Encounter with Dreams
and Wonder.' Talk about hype...
Careful, or Rinko's gonna
get her hopes up.
translations.着いた！\n夢・感動との出逢い。\n東武ワールドスクウェア……。:
We're here!
Where dreams and wonder meet:
Tobu World Square...
translations.えぇ～\n先に言っとくけど、リンコ、\n童心に返っちゃいますけど。:
Ahem...
Fair warning: I'm about to
turn into a total kid in here.
translations.それはそれは、\nはしゃいじゃいますけども。:
I mean, I'm really gonna
get carried away here.
translations.や～ん、\nちょっとちょっと！\n人もちゃんと作ってあるよ～\n燃える～▼:
Oh, wow, hey, look!
They even made tiny people!
I'm so into this!▼
translations.あっ、あそこ！\nほら、こっちこっち！:
Oh, over there!
Come on, this way, this way!
translations.見て見てっ！\nほらっ、みんなちっちゃいのに、\n歩いたり買い物したりしてるっ！:
Look, look!
Even though everyone's tiny,
they're walking around and
doing their shopping!
translations.おぉ、\n細かいよな～……。:
Whoa,
look at all the detail...
translations.やーい、チビスケー！\n巨大怪獣になった気分！:
Hey there, pipsqueaks!
I feel like a giant monster!
translations.ほら、撮って撮って！\nギャオーー!!:
Come on, take a picture!
Rawwwr!!
translations.おぉ、\nここはヨーロッパだな？:
Oh,
this must be Europe, huh？
translations.イェーイ！\n一瞬でヨーロッパ一周！:
Yay!
A trip around Europe
in a flash!
translations.▲小早川＊▲、\nあんまり走ってコケるなよ？:
▲小早川＊▲,
don't run around so much
you trip, okay？
translations.ヘッヘー！\nあっ、ロンドンの\nバッキンガム宮殿、見っけ！\n凱旋門もある！:
Heheh!
Oh, I found London's
Buckingham Palace!
And the Arc de Triomphe!
translations.１／２５でも結構、でっかいね？\nこれさ、リンコくぐれちゃうよ？:
Even at 1/25 scale, it's
pretty big, huh？ I bet I could
crawl right under this!
translations.ダメだぞ？\nやめろよ？:
Hey, you can't do that.
Don't even try it, okay？
translations.それは、アレですな？\n『くぐれ』って“フリ”ですな？\nよぉし……。:
Ah, I get it!
That's my cue to actually
do it, right？ All right...
translations.ノリノリだな、\n▲小早川＊▲……。:
You're really having a blast,
▲小早川＊▲...
translations.なんかお目当ての物があんのか？:
Is there something in
particular you're looking for？
translations.うん……あっ！\nあれかもっ！:
Yeah... Oh!
That might be it!
translations.ハァ……\nやっぱり、いいなぁ、\nずっと見ていたい……。:
Ahh...
It really is wonderful.
I could look at it forever...
translations.ノイシュバンシュタイン城か。\nずいぶんお気に入りだな？:
Neuschwanstein Castle, huh.
You're really fond of it,
aren't you？
translations.うん……\nだってさ、\n世界一きれいなお城だよ？:
Yeah...
I mean, it's the prettiest
castle in the world, isn't it？
translations.きっと、この屋根の下が、\n大広間でさ、毎晩舞踏会が\nあってさ……。:
I bet right under this roof
there's a grand hall, where
they hold a ball every night...
translations.小さい頃、よくお母さんと\nやったんだ……\n舞踏会ごっこ。:
When I was little, I used to
play pretend balls with my
mom all the time...
translations.お姫様のドレス着て……\nもちろん、おもちゃのだけど。\nお人形にもドレス着せて:
I'd wear a princess dress...
A toy one, of course. And we'd
put dresses on my dolls, too...
translations.そっか……\n楽しい思い出だな？:
I see...
That's a nice memory, huh？
translations.やっぱりちょっと、寂しい……。:
It makes me feel a little
lonely, though...
translations.いやぁ……いいな、\n東武ワールドスクウェア！\n世界一周した気分！:
Man... Tobu World Square
was great! Feels like we just
went around the world!
translations.うん。\nなんかさ、リンコちょっと、\nはしゃぎ過ぎ？:
Yeah.
Say, did I get a little too
carried away in there？
translations.う～ん……やっぱ、変かな？\nフツーにしてるべき？:
Hmm... Is it weird？
Should I just act normal？
translations.いいよ、こういうのも。\n修学旅行だしな？:
No, it's nice for a change.
It's a school trip, right？
translations.素直で可愛いリンコちゃんは、\nこんな事しちゃうんだよ！:
Sweet, cute little Rinko
does stuff like this too!
translations.ほら、行こ？\nもうすぐ、バス来るんでしょ？:
Come on, let's go.
The bus comes soon, right？
translations.そうだった！\n次は、\nEDO WONDERLAND 日光江戸村！:
Oh, right!
Next up is
Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura!
translations.いやぁ……\n今回もはしゃいだな！:
Man...
We really got into it again!
translations.ヘヘッ、まあね？\nミニチュアってさ、\nなんか、テンション上がる。:
Hehe, I guess？
Miniatures just get me
all excited for some reason.
translations.こういうの、好きなんだな？\n▲小早川＊▲。:
You really like this stuff, huh,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.うん。\nそれも、ある。\nでも……。:
Yeah.
That's part of it.
Though...
translations.二人っきりの修学旅行は、\n素直で可愛いリンコちゃん\nなんだもん。ヘヘッ……。:
On a school trip for two,
I get to be sweet, cute
little Rinko. Hehe...
translations.EDO WONDERLAND 日光江戸村\n入り口です。\nお降りのお客さまは、:
Now arriving at Edo Wonderland
Nikko Edomura.
Please make sure you have
all your belongings...
translations.おぉ……\n来たぞ。\nEDO WONDERLAND 日光江戸村。:
Whoa...
We're here.
Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura.
translations.EDO WONDERLAND。\nなんか、お寺の入り口みたいに\n見えるけど――:
Edo Wonderland.
It looks kind of like the gate
to a temple, though-- Oh!
translations.なんか、イカツイお役人\nみたいな人、こっち見てる……。:
Some stern-looking official
is staring right at us...
translations.はい？\nあの……えっ？\n通行手形？:
Huh？
Um... What？
A travel pass？
translations.あ、そっか！\nえっと、大人２枚でござる！:
Oh, I get it!
Um, two adults, good sir!
translations.……はい、たしかに！\nそれじゃあ、気をつけて\nいってらっしゃいでござる！:
...Right, all in order!
Have a safe trip in there,
good travelers!
translations.なるほど、\n徹底してんだな……。:
I see.
They really commit to it...
translations.あ、そういう冷めた態度は、\nよくないでござるよ？\nん？:
Ah, such a cynical attitude
doth not become thee!
Right？
translations.おう、\nそうだな。\nあ……そうでござるな！:
Right,
my bad.
Uh... Verily, 'tis so!
translations.ヘヘッ！\nいざ、参ろうでござるーっ！:
Hehe!
Come, let us venture forth!
translations.また、来たでござる。\nね、通行手形！\n貸して貸して！:
We have returned, good sir.
Hey, the travel passes!
Let me have 'em!
translations.おーい、お役人さーん!!\n頼もーーっ！:
Hail, good officer!!
Grant us entryyy!
translations.（よし、\n●もテンション上げてくか！）:
(Alright, time for ●
to get into the spirit too!)
translations.リンコさ、筋金入りの\n帰宅部だから、わりと\n時代劇詳しいんだけどさ。:
Since I'm a die-hard member
of the Go-Home Club, I know
my period dramas pretty well.
translations.これは、すごいよ……\nん？ あれ、『矢場』だって！\n頼もー頼もーっ！:
And this is amazing...
Hm？ Look, an archery range!
Grant us entry! Hallooo!
translations.いや、\nけっこう難しいぞ、これ？:
Hey,
this is pretty tough, okay？
translations.お兄さん、ちょっと\n力入り過ぎたかなぁ？\nお姉さん、どうですか？:
Looks like you tensed up
a little too much!
Care to try, miss？
translations.任されたッ！\nリンコ之介が仇討ちでござる！:
Leave it to me!
Rinkonosuke will avenge you!
translations.イェーイ！\nぬいぐるみゲットでござる～▼:
Yaaay!
Verily, I scored a plushie~▼
translations.そう言えば、\nもう昼過ぎてるしな？:
Come to think of it,
it's already past noon, huh？
translations.腹が減っては戦は出来ぬで\nござるのだ！\n頼もーーっ！:
A warrior cannot fight
on an empty stomach!
Make waaay!
translations.よし、うなぎ釜めしだ！\n▲小早川＊▲、\nまだ決まんないのか？:
Okay, eel kamameshi for me!
Still haven't decided,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ちょっと待つでござるよ。\n……よし、じゃあ、\nかれーらいす！:
Patience, my good man.
...Okay, I'll have the
'Ye Olde Curry Rice'!
translations.悩んだわりに、カレーか。:
All that time thinking,
and you just get curry？
translations.“かれーらいす”でござる。\nリンコ之介は、こういうとこ\n保守的なんでござる。:
'Ye Olde Curry Rice,' verily.
Rinkonosuke likes to play it
safe with these things.
translations.満足満足！\n美味い『かれーらいす』で\nあった！:
Most satisfying!
That was a mighty fine
'Ye Olde Curry Rice'!
translations.“忍者”？\nフフフッ……\nこれは拙者、腕が鳴るでござる。:
'Ninja'？
Heheheh...
This warrior is itching
for a challenge.
translations.おい……\n本気じゃないよな？\n待て待て、リンコ之介どのーっ！:
Hey...
You're not serious, right？
Wait up, Lord Rinkonosuke!
translations.べ、べつに？\n変なところから忍者が\n飛び出してきたから、\nちょっと……。:
N-Nothing!
A ninja just jumped out
from a weird spot,
that's all...
translations.スゲー、\n本格的アクションだったな？:
Man, that was some
serious action in there, huh？
translations.まあ、今日はこの辺に\nしといてやるでござる……。:
Well, this warrior shall
spare them for today...
translations.（けっこう、ビビッてたな、\n▲小早川＊▲……）:
(▲小早川＊▲ was pretty
spooked in there...)
translations.あ、ほらあれ。\nあの黒い壁のとこ。:
Oh, look over there.
By that black wall.
translations.『忍者からくり格言迷路』か。\n……大丈夫か？:
'Ninja Trick Proverb Maze,' huh？
...Sure you'll be okay？
translations.ん？\n拙者も見くびられたものよ……\n競争だ、お先っ！:
Hmm？
Do not underestimate me...
It's a race! See ya!
translations.あれ？\n“人を呪わば穴二つ”\nさっき見たよな……。:
Huh？
'Curse a man, dig two graves'...
Didn't I just pass this one？
translations.難しい……\nおーい、▲小早川＊▲～！\nそっち、どうだ？:
This is tough...
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲~!
How's it going over there？
translations.ヘヘッ！\nもう、ゴールのそばだよーん！:
Heheh!
I'm right by the goal already~!
translations.着いたっ！\nあれ、▲小早川＊▲まだか……\nおーい、どうした？:
Made it!
Huh, ▲小早川＊▲'s not here yet...
Heeey, what happened？
translations.▲小早川＊▲！\n隠し扉、気がついたか？\nそこ通らないと着かないぞ？:
▲小早川＊▲!
Did you spot the hidden door？
You have to go through it!
translations.お～い！\n途中で脱出口があるだろ？\nそこから出ちゃえよ！:
Hey!
There's an exit halfway
through, right？
Just come out through there!
translations.ヤダッ！\nそっち行く！:
No way!
I'm coming over there!
translations.あっちから来たから、\n次は……こっちだよな？\nお～い、リンコ之介ー……。:
I came from that way,
so next is... this way, right？
Heeey, Rinkonosuke...
translations.そうか。\nよし、ゴールに行くぞ？:
Okay.
Come on, let's head
to the goal.
translations.到着ーっ！\nほら、先、入れよ！:
We're here!
Go on, you go in first!
translations.ちょっと、\n素直なリンコちゃん、\n忘れてたなって思って。:
I was just thinking
I kinda forgot to be
'honest Rinko' back there.
translations.アンタのそういうとこがさ、\nやっぱり大好き▼:
That's the part of you
I really love▼
translations.ハァ～……あんな風に\nして歩いてみたいな……\n似合わないのわかってるけどさ？:
Sigh... I'd love to try
walking around like that...
Even though I know
it wouldn't suit me.
translations.そんなことないかもしれないぞ？:
I wouldn't be so sure
about that.
translations.ウソだね。\nホントはさ、七五三みたいに\nなるって、思ってるくせに。:
Yeah, right.
You totally think I'd look like
a little kid playing dress-up.
translations.（七五三か……なるほど……）:
(A kid playing dress-up, huh...
I can kinda see it...)
translations.あのさ、さっき、\nリンコまた、忘れてた。:
Hey... just now,
I forgot again.
translations.もし、リンコがおいらんで、\n七五三みたいでも、アンタだけは\nご贔屓になってく:
If I were an oiran, even if I
looked like a kid in dress-up,
would you still be my patron？
translations.（よし、お土産もの屋も\n一通り見たし……\nあれ、▲小早川＊▲は？）:
(All right, we've looked around
all the souvenir shops...
Huh, where's ▲小早川＊▲？)
translations.お待たせ。\n刀とかいろいろ買っちゃったよ。\nそれに……ジャーン、ほら！:
Sorry for the wait.
I bought a sword and a bunch
of stuff. Plus... ta-da, look!
translations.ストラップ？\nあ、名前が……。:
Phone straps？
Oh, there are names on them...
translations.リンコって書いてある方が、\nアンタのだからね？\nお揃いだよ？:
The one that says Rinko
is yours, got it？
They're a matching set.
translations.へぇ、\nなんかちょっと、\n▲小早川＊▲っぽくないぞ？:
Huh.
That's kinda unlike you,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.いいんだよ、\n今日のリンコは、\nそういうリンコなんだもん。:
It's fine.
That's just the kind of Rinko
I'm being today.
translations.そっか……\n素直なリンコちゃん記念だな？:
Right...
To commemorate
'honest Rinko' day, huh？
translations.そう。記念だよ……ついでに、\nリンコだと思って大事にしてね▼\nとか、言っちゃ:
Yep, to commemorate it...
Might as well say, 'Pretend it's
me and take good care of it▼'
translations.お、おう。\nちょっと照れるけど、\n大事にする。:
O-oh, sure.
It's a little embarrassing,
but I'll treasure it.
translations.ハァ……\n面白かった。\nEDO WONDERLAND 日光江戸村。\nまだま:
Phew...
That was fun.
Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura.
Feels like I still haven't
had enough.
translations.ああ、また来ような？:
Yeah, let's come back
again sometime.
translations.ハァ～～\n遊んだでござるよ……。:
Phew...
This humble samurai sure
had fun today...
translations.ハハッ、\n▲小早川＊▲、\nはしゃいでたな？:
Haha,
you really cut loose today,
huh, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ヘヘッ、まあね？\nいいんだもん、今日は！:
Hehe, I guess so!
It's fine, though—
today's special!
translations.素直なリンコちゃんだからな？:
Because you're being
'honest Rinko' today, right？
translations.うん、修学旅行だしね？:
Yep, and it's a school trip,
after all.
translations.そうそう、この後は、\nいよいよ旅館だからな！:
That's right! And next up,
it's finally time for the inn!
translations.“いよいよ”とか言わない！\nなんか、照れるじゃん……\nバカ！:
Don't say 'finally' like that!
It makes me feel all shy...
Idiot!
translations.（なんか、\n変な意味にとられたか……）:
(Did she take that
the wrong way or something...？)
translations.寝たのか……\nずいぶん、\nはしゃいだからな……。:
Asleep already...？
You did get pretty
carried away back there...
translations.まだ、寝てないんだけど……\n子供とパパさんかっつーの。:
I'm not asleep yet...
What are we, a dad
and his little kid？
translations.バス、乗り継ぐんだっけ？:
Don't we have to
transfer buses here？
translations.ああ。\nホテル行きのバスは……。\nお、あれか！:
Yeah.
The bus for the hotel is...
Oh, that must be it!
translations.へぇ！ ゴージャスじゃん……。\nつーか、あれなに？\n……玉？:
Whoa! Pretty fancy...
Wait, what's that thing？
...A ball？
translations.お待たせ。\nチェックインして来たぞ？\n夕食は、7時だってさ。:
Sorry for the wait.
I got us checked in.
They said dinner's at 7.
translations.そんなことよりさ……いいの？\nなんかゴージャス過ぎない？\nあ、実は別料金とか:
Never mind that... Is this okay？
Isn't this place way too fancy？
Watch them charge us extra!
translations.そんなことはない……\nと、思うけど……。:
They wouldn't do that...
I think...
translations.お待たせいたしました。\nお部屋にご案内いたします。\nお連れ様、お荷物は？:
Thank you for waiting.
I'll show you to your room.
Miss, may I take your bag？
translations.あ、えぇと、大丈夫です！\nはい……。:
Oh, um, I'm fine!
Thank you...
translations.ふぅん……\n奥様には見えないワケね？\nま、いいけどね？:
Hmph...
Guess I don't look like
a wife, huh？ Whatever.
translations.また世話になるよ！\nへへっ！:
Thanks for having us again!
Hehe!
translations.お待たせ。\nチェックインすんだよ。\n夕食は、7時だって。:
Sorry for the wait.
We're all checked in.
They said dinner's at 7.
translations.７時ね？\nオッケー！\nあ、係の人来た！ エヘン！:
At 7, right？
Okay!
Oh, here comes the staff! Ahem!
translations.素敵なホテルね～\nアナタ？:
Such a lovely hotel,
isn't it, darling？
translations.お待たせいたしました。\nお部屋にご案内いたします。\n奥様、お荷物お持ちします:
Thank you for waiting.
I'll show you to your room.
Ma'am, may I take your bag？
translations.えっと……大丈夫です。\n主人が運びますから。:
Um... I'm fine, thank you.
My husband will carry it.
translations.広ぉ～い……。\nつーか、デカ！\nテレビ、デカッ！:
It's huuuge...
Wait, look at that!
The TV is massive!
translations.本当だ。\nインテリアもお洒落だよな……\nマッサージチェアもあるぞ？:
You're right.
The decor is really classy, too...
Hey, there's even a massage chair!
translations.リンコ、だんだん\n怖くなってきたんだけど……。\nいいんだよね？ タダだよね？:
Okay, I'm starting to get
a little scared here...
This is okay, right？ It's free？
translations.大丈夫、だろ……。: It should be fine... I think.
translations.よし！ いいじゃん、\nゴージャスルーム、\n楽しんじゃえ！:
Alright! Whatever,
let's just enjoy our
fancy room!
translations.おいで、\n凛子がお茶をいれてしんぜよう。:
Come on over.
Allow Lady Rinko to pour
you some tea.
translations.それにしてもさ、\nすごい部屋だよねぇ……\n鬼怒川もよく見えるし。:
Still, this really is
an amazing room...
Great view of Kinugawa, too.
translations.バルコニーに\n専用の露天風呂も付いてるしな？:
Plus, we've got our own
open-air bath on the balcony.
translations.そうそう！\nさすがに、入れないけどさ。:
I know, right!
Not that I can actually
use it, though.
translations.だって、部屋の中から\nまる見えじゃん！:
Because you can see right
into it from the room!
