translations.でも、ほら、\n障子があって、一応、\n見えないようにも――:
Yeah, but look, there's a
paper screen you can close
so you can't see—
translations.なぁ、\n食事の前に、大浴場、\n行っとく？:
Hey, wanna hit the big
public bath before dinner？
translations.じゃあ、\nここで待ち合わせな？:
Alright, let's meet
back here after, okay？
translations.オッケー！\nあんまり長湯しないようにね？:
Okay!
Don't stay in too long, alright？
translations.女子はいいんだよ！\nそんじゃ、あとでね？:
Girls are allowed to take their time!
See you in a bit!
translations.いいじゃん、よく似合ってる。:
What's wrong with that？
It looks great on you.
translations.うぅ……\nマッサージチェアっていいね！\nリンコの家にも一つ欲しいよ。:
Mmm...
Massage chairs are great!
I want one at my house too.
translations.そんなにか？\n●もやろうかな？:
Is it that good？
Maybe ● should try it too？
translations.やった方がいいって。\nタダだし。:
You totally should.
It's free, after all.
translations.懐石だよ？\n『おしながき』見てみ？:
It's a kaiseki meal, see？
Check out the menu.
translations.おお、\nまだ沢山出るみたいだな？:
Whoa, looks like there's
still a lot more coming.
translations.リンコ、全部は無理だよ。\nう～ん……\nそれじゃねぇ……よし！:
There's no way I can eat
all this. Hmm...
In that case... Alright!
translations.お刺身と……ねり物？\nあと、お鍋あげるから、\nデザートは全部頂戴♪:
You can have the sashimi,
fish cake, and the hot pot,
so give me all the dessert♪
translations.まあまあ。\nその代わり、リンコが\nア～ンしてあげるから。:
Now, now.
In return, I'll feed it
right to you, okay？
translations.（悔しいけど、うれしい……）:
(I hate to admit it,
but I'm pretty happy...)
translations.リンコも……\nもう食べらんない……。:
Me too...
I can't eat another bite...
translations.腹ごなしに、探検するか？\nホテルの中？:
Wanna explore the hotel
to help digest our food？
translations.う～ん……ゴロゴロしてたい\n気もするけど……\nよし、行っとくか。:
Hmm... Part of me just wants
to lounge around, but...
alright, let's go.
translations.餃子のポテチがあったよ？\nご当地？:
They have gyoza potato chips.
Is that a local thing？
translations.宇都宮餃子ってことかな？\n買うの？:
For Utsunomiya gyoza, maybe？
Are you gonna buy them？
translations.買うけど、食べないよ？\nほら……\nエチケットっていうかさ？:
I'll buy them, but I won't
eat them now. You know...
Out of courtesy, I guess？
translations.あ、さっき見かけたんだけど、\nゲーセンみたいなのあったよ？\n行こ！:
Oh, I saw something like an
arcade earlier.
Let's go check it out!
translations.へぇ、\nビリヤードもあるのか！\n勝負するか？:
Oh, nice,
they even have pool!
Wanna play a game？
translations.う～ん、\nビリヤードは\n不利っていうか――。:
Hmm,
I'm kind of at a disadvantage
when it comes to pool—
translations.ああ、そっか。\n小さい人は、\n手玉に届かない事、多いもんな？:
Oh, right.
Short people often can't
reach the cue ball, huh？
translations.ヘッヘッヘッ、勝～ち～！\n二度と小さい人とか\n言わないように。:
Heheheh, I win~!
Don't you ever call me
short again.
translations.チョロイもんだね？\n浴衣だと、裾が気になるから、\n不利だと思ったんだけどさ。:
Piece of cake. I thought
worrying about my yukata hem
would be a disadvantage.
translations.途中から、\n気にするの忘れてたもんな！:
Well, halfway through,
you totally forgot to
worry about it!
translations.なっ！\nどこ見てんだっつーの！\nスケベ！:
Wha—!
Where were you looking!?
You pervert!
translations.（エッチくらいに\nしてくれよ……）:
(Couldn't she at least tone it
down to just "naughty"...？ )
translations.汗かいちゃった……\nリンコ、もう一回、\n温泉行こっかな？:
I worked up a sweat...
Maybe I'll go take
another dip in the bath.
translations.そう言えば、貸切風呂の\nチケット貰ったな。\n『鬼燈亭』だっけ。:
Come to think of it, we got
tickets for the private bath.
"Hozukitei," wasn't it？
translations.まあ、せっかくだし……\nいっかな。:
Well, since we've got
the ticket... why not.
translations.あ、ほらほら！\nあれ？:
Oh, look, look!
Is that it？
translations.へぇ……いいね？\nちょっと、妖怪が住んでそうな\n感じ？:
Huh... Nice.
Kinda looks like a place
spirits would live, huh？
translations.まあな？\n普通は、風情って言うけどな？\n入ろう！:
I guess？
Usually people call that
'classic charm.' Let's go in!
translations.うん、いい気持ち……\n虫の声が聞こえる……。:
Yeah, it feels great...
You can hear the insects...
translations.今は、素直な▲小早川＊▲？:
So right now, you're
the sweet ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.じゃあ、素直で優しい\nリンコちゃんは、\n背中を洗ってあげちゃおっかな？:
Then maybe sweet, kind little
Rinko will wash your back
for you？
translations.だから！\n先、上がってて！\n着替えらんないっつーの……。:
Come on!
You get out first!
I can't change with you here...
translations.ハァ～～！\n修学旅行、最高！:
Ahhhh!
School trips are the best!
translations.今はぜんぜん、\n修学旅行っぽくないけどね？:
Doesn't really feel like
a school trip right now, though.
translations.まあ、大人の修学旅行だし。:
Well, it is an adult
school trip.
translations.なんか、\n恥ずかしくなって来た……。\nこっち見んな！:
Now I'm starting to feel
kinda embarrassed...
Don't look at me!
translations.（う～ん！\nやっぱ浴衣って、\n風情があっていいよな……）:
（Man!
A yukata really does have
that classic charm...）
translations.いや、浴衣姿って風情があるな、\nと思ってさ？:
Nothing, I was just thinking
a yukata has real classic charm.
translations.ふぅん。\n風情があって……色っぽいとか？:
Hmm.
Classic charm...
You mean sexy？
translations.よかった、さっきのポテチ\n食べなくて。:
I'm glad I didn't eat
those potato chips earlier.
translations.もう一回くらい、\nするかなって思ったんだ▼:
I had a feeling we'd do that
at least one more time▼
translations.ちょっとだけ、\n自由行動にしない？\n部屋に戻るまで。:
Wanna do our own thing
for a little bit？
Just till we're back in the room.
translations.（する事もないし、\n部屋に戻るか……）:
（Nothing else to do,
so I might as well head back...）
translations.そっか……。\nお、ゴメン、ちょっとトイレ！:
I see...
Oh, sorry, gotta use the bathroom!
translations.ハァ……\nお気楽でいいね、男子はさ。:
Sigh...
Must be nice being a guy,
so carefree like that.
translations.ゴージャスなのは\nいいんだけどさ、なんかこう、\n足りないよね？ 修学旅行感？:
Fancy is nice and all, but
isn't something missing？
That school trip vibe？
translations.出た？\n修学旅行感？:
Feeling it yet？
That school trip vibe？
translations.わかった……\n宣戦布告とみなす！:
All right... I'm taking that
as a declaration of war!
translations.そうだ、\n寝る時、どうする？:
Oh yeah, what are we gonna
do when we go to sleep？
translations.だって、ほら、\nベッド、二つあるじゃん？\n大きなのが。:
Well, look, there are
two beds, right？
Really big ones.
translations.確かに、大きいベッドだな？: They sure are big beds, huh？
translations.ちょ……違っ！\nそういう意味じゃないから！:
W-Wait, no!
That's not what I meant!
translations.だから、リンコが言ってんのは、\nどっちのベッド使う？ って、\nそういう意味じ:
I was just asking which bed
we're each gonna take!
That's all I meant!
translations.なんでもない！\nリンコ、壁側取ったから！:
It's nothing!
I'm taking the wall side!
translations.リンコも……\n寝よっか？:
Me too...
Should we go to sleep？
translations.あのさ、リンコ、\n忘れてたんだけどさ……。:
So, um,
there's something I forgot...
translations.修学旅行と言えば、\nまくら投げの他に、\nあるじゃん、もう一個？:
Speaking of school trips,
besides a pillow fight,
there's one more thing, right？
translations.男子はやんないかな、\nほら、好きな人……\n言いっこしたり。:
Maybe guys don't do this,
but you know... telling each
other who you like.
translations.リンコの好きな人、\n言っちゃおっかな……。:
Maybe I should tell you
who I like...
translations.ハァ～～ア！\nそろそろ、寝るかな！:
Yaaawn!
About time to get some sleep!
translations.ふぁ……\nリンコも寝よ……。:
Yawn...
I'll go to sleep too...
translations.あのさ、\nリンコ考えたんだけどさ……。:
Hey, so...
I was just thinking...
translations.もし、リンコ達が、\n本当の修学旅行、\n一緒にしてたら……。:
If we were on a real
school trip together...
translations.やっぱり、クラスメートに、\nいろいろ聞かれてさ、次の日、\nヒューヒュー言われ:
Our classmates would ask us
all kinds of stuff, and tease
us the next day...
translations.なんか、いいな、\nそういうの、\nちょっと憧れる……。:
That sounds kinda nice.
I kind of wish we could
have that...
translations.やっぱり、\n今のリンコ達が、\n最高に幸せな気がするから……。:
'Cause I feel like
the way we are right now
is the happiest we could be...
translations.▲小早川＊▲は……\n当然のように、\nまだ寝てるな……。:
And ▲小早川＊▲ is...
still fast asleep,
of course...
translations.（早く起きて得した。\n昨日、ちゃんと寝たからな！）:
(Waking up early paid off.
Good thing I went to sleep
on time last night!)
translations.修学旅行名物、\nねぼすけの顔に落書き、\nいっちゃおっかなぁ～。:
Maybe I'll go for a school
trip classic and doodle on
the sleepyhead's face...
translations.罪の無い顔しちゃって……\nなかなかカワイイよ？:
Looking all innocent...
You're actually pretty cute,
you know？
translations.おはよう……\n▲小早川＊▲、今、なんかした？:
Morning...
▲小早川＊▲, did you just
do something？
translations.どっか行ったのか？\n▲小早川＊▲ー？\nいるー？:
Did she go somewhere？
▲小早川＊▲？
Are you here？
translations.ウソ？\nちょ、ちょっと待って！\nまだ寝てろっつーの！:
No way!
W-Wait a second!
Go back to sleep already!
translations.おぉ……いい眺め！\nそれに、いい匂い！:
Ooh... Great view!
And it smells so good!
translations.和食も洋食も\n色々あるみたいだぞ？:
Looks like they have all kinds
of Japanese and Western food.
translations.ホント？\nじゃあ、いろいろ取って来よう！:
Really？
Then let's go grab a bunch!
translations.よしよし、\n色いろ取って来たね？:
Nice, nice.
You got a good variety, huh？
translations.そう言う▲小早川＊▲は、\nそれだけか？:
Wait, is that all you got,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコ？\nリンコの分なら、\nアンタのトレイの上にあるけど？:
Me？
My share is right there
on your tray, though？
translations.よし、と……\n▲小早川＊▲、お待たせ！:
Alrighty...
Sorry for the wait, ▲小早川＊▲!
translations.いいホテルだったよな！\n『鬼怒川プラザホテル』。:
The Kinugawa Plaza Hotel
was really nice, huh!
translations.まあね。\nゴージャスな\n修学旅行の夜だった。:
I guess so.
It was a pretty fancy
night for a school trip.
translations.よし！\nじゃあ、今日はいよいよ日光だ！:
All right!
Today's finally the day
we head to Nikko!
translations.ほら、急げ！\n間に合わないぞ！:
Come on, hurry!
We're gonna miss it!
translations.昨日お土産買い過ぎたんだろ？:
You bought too many
souvenirs yesterday, huh？
translations.だって、刀のおもちゃとかさ、\n買わないとゼッタイ\n後悔するじゃん、あとで。:
Well, if you don't buy a
toy sword and stuff, you
know you'll regret it later.
translations.むしろ、逆だと思うけどな、\n普通……。:
Pretty sure it's usually
the other way around...
translations.うん。\n素直でしょ？:
Yep.
At least I'm honest, right？
translations.はぁ……\n間に合って良かったな？:
Phew...
Good thing we made it, huh？
translations.あ、電車みじかっ！\nへぇ、これに乗んの？:
Oh, what a short train!
Huh, we're taking this？
translations.前どっち？\nリンコ前に乗～ろうっと！:
Which way's the front？
I'm gonna ride up front!
translations.さて、下今市で乗り換えて、\n東武日光駅だ。\n行くぞ？:
Okay, we transfer here at
Shimo-Imaichi for
Tobu-Nikko Station. Ready？
translations.ん？\nちょっとさ、\n鬼怒川とお別れしてた。:
Hm？
Just saying goodbye
to Kinugawa.
translations.そう。\nすっごく楽しかった、\nまたね？ って。:
Yeah.
Like, "I had so much fun,
see you again."
translations.あ、電車もう来てる！\n前の方、乗るよっ！:
Oh, the train's already here!
Let's get in the front!
translations.なんだ？\n思い出し笑いか？:
What is it？
Thinking of something funny？
translations.そうじゃなくて……\n想像してた。:
No, I was just...
imagining something.
translations.こうやって知らないところに、\n来るとさ？\nもしここに住んでたら、\nどんなだ:
When you visit somewhere
new like this, don't you
ever imagine what it'd be
like to live here？
translations.ここに住んでたらか……\nどうなる？:
If we lived here, huh...
What would it be like？
translations.きっとさ、二人で毎日この電車に\n乗ってさ、学校行くんだよ。\nいつも座る席とか:
We'd probably take this
train to school together
every day. And we'd have
our usual seats and all.
translations.なるほどな……\nいいかもな、そういうのも……。:
I see...
That actually sounds
kind of nice...
translations.着いたーっ！\n来たぞ、日光！:
We made it!
Here we are in Nikko!
translations.来ちゃったねぇ、日光……\nいろは坂、でしょ？\nバス？ 行こう行こう！:
We really came to Nikko...
Next is Irohazaka, right？
By bus？ Let's go, let's go!
translations.いや、ちょっとその前に、\n荷物をどっかに預けよう。\n重いし……。:
Hold on, let's find a place
to stash our bags first.
They're heavy...
translations.だらしないぞ？\nリンコがいっこ\n持ってあげよっか？:
What a wimp.
Want me to carry
one of them for you？
translations.ヘヘッ、ゴメン▼\nロッカー探して来るよ。:
Hehe, sorry▼
I'll go look for a locker.
translations.中禅寺湖からみるとさ、\n富士山みたいなのにね……。:
It looks just like Mt. Fuji
when you see it from Lake
Chuzenji, though...
translations.角度が違うからな。:
We're looking at it from
a different angle.
translations.ということはさ、\n上から見ると……。:
Which means if you look
at it from above...
translations.ダメだ。\nゼンゼンわかりませーん。:
Nope.
I have no clue at all.
translations.着いたーっ！\nさてと、荷物を預けて\nバス停に行くぞ？:
We're here!
Alright, let's drop off our
bags and hit the bus stop.
translations.ハァ……\nそこなんだよね……\nこの修学旅行の難点は。:
Sigh...
That's the one downside
to this school trip.
translations.酔う。\nゼッタイ酔う。:
I'm gonna get sick.
Definitely gonna get sick.
translations.酔い止め持ってこなかったのか？:
Did you not bring any
motion sickness medicine？
translations.浮かれてたからね……\n出発前のリンコに\n説教してやりたいよ。:
I was too excited...
I'd like to give pre-trip me
a good lecture right now.
translations.そうだ！\nいっそ歩いて登ってみる？:
Wait!
Why don't we just hike up
the mountain instead？
translations.いやいやいや！\n無理だろ……。:
No, no, no!
There's no way...
translations.おぉ……\nさすが『いろは坂』。\nやっぱり曲がる曲がる……。:
Whoa...
Irohazaka really lives up to
its name. So many curves...
translations.“まだ”って、おい……\nほら、カーブにある、\n標識の“いろは”、読んでこう！:
"For now"？ Hey...
Look at the "Iroha" signs on
the curves! Let's read 'em!
translations.えぇと……\nあった、“を”だ！\n次はなんだ？:
Let's see...
There's one, it's "Wo"!
What comes next？
translations.その次、その次は……\nえぇと…………うぅ!!:
After that, after that is...
um......... Urgh!!
translations.わかった！\nもういい、もうやめよう！:
Okay, got it!
Never mind, let's stop!
translations.（上までもってくれ……）:
(Please just hold on till
we reach the top...)
translations.はぁ……やっと着いた……\nいろは坂ってさ、いろは以外に、\nカーブいっぱいある:
Phew... Finally here...
Irohazaka has way more turns
than just the Iroha poem...
translations.確かにな。\nまあ、よく耐えてくれた。\nほら、華厳の滝の入り口。:
It really does. Still, you
held up great. Look, that's
the entrance to Kegon Falls.
translations.エレベーターって\n書いてある。\nエスカーじゃないんだ。:
The sign says "elevator."
Guess it's not an Escar.
translations.地獄から極楽に来た気分！:
Feels like going straight
from hell to paradise!
translations.もう、いろは坂の事は忘れろ。:
Come on, just forget about
Irohazaka already.
translations.落差９７ｍだっけ？\n――あ、あれ、ほら！:
It's a 97-meter drop, right？
--Oh, look at that!
translations.本当だ。\nすごい景色だな……。:
You're right.
What an amazing view...
translations.来て良かったね、\n日光……。:
I'm glad we came
to Nikko...
translations.いろは坂があったとしても……。:
Even if we had to deal
with Irohazaka...
translations.ハァ……\n生きてるって素晴らしい！\n特にいろは坂の後では！:
Aah...
It's great to be alive!
Especially after Irohazaka!
translations.ねぇ、華厳の滝に打たれて\n修行出来んのかな？:
Hey, do you think you could
train under Kegon Falls？
translations.打たれて!?\nいや、イチコロだろうな……。:
Under it!?
No, that'd kill you instantly...
translations.そうか……\nその後、下の涅槃の滝を\n流れていくわけだ。:
I see...
And then you float right down
Nirvana Falls at the bottom.
translations.どんなシステムだよ……。: What kind of system is that...
translations.餃子コロッケと、\nゆばコロッケか……\nう～ん……。:
Gyoza croquettes and
yuba croquettes...
Hmm...
translations.いっこずつ買って、\n半分こしよ？:
Why don't we buy one of each
and split them？
translations.大丈夫か？\nまだバスに乗るんだぞ？:
Are you sure you'll be okay？
We still have another bus ride.
translations.素直なリンコちゃんは\n食欲にも素直なのです。\nヘヘッ！:
Good little Rinko is honest
with her appetite, too.
Heheh!
translations.うん……\nねぇねぇ、\nあの富士山みたいな山は？:
Yeah...
Hey, hey, what's that mountain
that looks like Mt. Fuji？
translations.男体山だって。\n日光富士とも言うらしい。:
It says Mt. Nantai.
Apparently they also call it
Nikko Fuji.
translations.なるほどねぇ……\n戦場ヶ原はどっち？:
I see, I see...
Which way is Senjogahara？
translations.ふむふむ……\nじゃあさ、あっちの奥の山は？:
Uh-huh...
Then what's that mountain
way in the back？
translations.だから、ほら……\n日光……連山？:
Well, you know...
The Nikko... mountain range？
translations.なるほど？\n上手くまとめましたなぁ……？:
Oh really？
Wrapped that all up nicely,
didn't you...？
translations.まあ、いいや！\n素直なリンコが褒めてあげる。\nスゴ～イ、モノ知りなんだぁ▼:
Well, whatever!
Good little Rinko will praise you.
Woooow, you know so much▼
translations.（おちょくられてるような\n気がしてきた……\n次に来る時は調べとこう……）:
(I feel like she's messing
with me... I'll do my homework
before next time...)
translations.この湖があの男体山の噴火で\n出来たなんて、\n信じられないね？:
Hard to believe this lake was
formed by Mt. Nantai erupting,
isn't it？
translations.二万年前に出来た\n堰き止め湖だよな？:
It's a dammed lake that formed
20,000 years ago, right？
translations.じゃあ、あの奥の山は？:
Then what's that mountain
in the back？
translations.じゃ、手前の左の――。:
Okay, then the one in front
on the left—
translations.もう少しだ、\nがんばれ、▲小早川＊▲！:
Just a little further.
Hang in there, ▲小早川＊▲!
translations.よくがんばった……\n早速で悪いけど、\nここで昼メシの予定だぞ？:
You did great...
Hate to spring this on you right
away, but this is our lunch spot.
translations.『日光物産商会』？\nへぇ……なんかカッコイイ。\n明治時代みたい。:
'Nikko Bussan Shokai'？
Huh... That's kinda cool.
Feels like the Meiji era.
translations.へぇ……いいなぁ……\nやっぱさ、明治創業なんだって。\nリンコの見る目に狂いは:
Ooh, nice... It really was
founded in the Meiji era.
I've got a good eye, huh？
translations.あ、窓ガラスが、ほら！\n細かく波打ってる！\n明治、いい時代だったねぇ……。:
Oh, look at the window glass!
It's got little ripples in it!
Meiji sure was a great era...
translations.ゆば弁当『匠』と\n『カレーセット』、\nお待たせいたしました。:
The Takumi Yuba Bento
and the Curry Set.
Thank you for waiting.
translations.言いたくはないけどさ……\nせっかく日光に来て、\nまたカレーか？:
I hate to say it, but...
we come all the way to Nikko
and you get curry again？
translations.いいの。リンコはね、無駄に\n冒険しない主義なの。\n人生がアドベンチャーだから:
It's fine. I don't believe in
taking pointless risks.
Life's enough of an adventure.
translations.なんだそりゃ……\nおっ、このゆばウマい！\n揚げてあんのかな……。:
What does that even mean...？
Oh, this yuba's really good!
Wonder if it's deep-fried...
translations.ホント？\nどれどれ、リンコにちょっと\n食べさせてみ♪:
Really？
Ooh, let me try
a little bite♪
translations.うん、がんばったな！\nまだ昼だけどな？:
Yeah, you did great!
It's only noon, though？
translations.さてと……\nごはんごはん！\nお腹減った～♪:
Now then...
Time to eat!
I'm starving~♪
translations.いいねぇ、ここ……\n明治か……いい時代だったよ。:
I really like this place...
Meiji, huh... Good times.
translations.お待たせいたしました。\nご注文はお決まりですか？:
Thank you for waiting.
Are you ready to order？
translations.ダメ。\n『かにクリームコロッケセット』\nお願いします。:
Nope.
One Crab Cream Croquette
Set, please.
translations.やっぱり、日光に来たらさ、\nゆばだよね？:
When you come to Nikko,
it's gotta be yuba, right？
translations.本当、そう思う――\nお、ウマいぞ、このコロッケ！:
I couldn't agree more--
Oh, this croquette's really good!
translations.だろうと思ったんだよ！\nはい、この酢味噌のやつと\nトレード▼:
I knew it would be!
Here, trade me for this
vinegared miso one▼
translations.お、あった！\nあれだろ、神橋！:
Oh, there it is!
That must be Shinkyo Bridge!
translations.へぇ……\n下の方が石なんだね……。:
Huh...
The bottom part is made of stone...
translations.説明によると、江戸時代から、\n今の石の橋脚になって。\n基本、そのままだってさ:
The sign says it's had those
stone piers since the Edo period.
Pretty much unchanged since then.
translations.フムフム……\n元々……読み方わかんないけど、\nエラいお坊さんが川を渡る時、:
Hmm, let's see... Originally,
when some great monk--can't
read his name--crossed the river,
translations.二匹の大蛇が出てきて、\n橋になったんだって。:
two giant snakes appeared
and turned into a bridge.
translations.ハハッ、ずいぶん、\nデカイヘビがいたもんだな？\nまさかな？:
Haha, must've been some
pretty huge snakes, huh？
As if.
translations.わかってないなぁ……\n伝承ってのはさ、心の真実が\n受け継がれたものなんだよ。:
You just don't get it...
Folklore is how the truth in
people's hearts gets passed down.
translations.だから、二匹の大蛇は居たの。\n当時の人の心の真実としてね。:
So those two giant snakes existed.
As the truth in the hearts
of the people back then.
translations.だからぁ……こう……\nきっと、普通サイズの大蛇が？\n何匹も\nグニャグニャ重:
I mean... like...
maybe a bunch of normal-sized
big snakes？ All tangled up
on top of each other...
translations.その上を\nお坊さんが歩いたとかさ？\nうん、きっとそう。:
and the monk walked
right across them or something？
Yeah, that must be it.
translations.ハァ……\nあのさ、まだ？\n東照宮……。:
*Sigh*...
Hey, are we there yet？
To Toshogu...
translations.そろそろ、のはずだけどな……\nお？\nあれ、参道入り口だ！:
Should be coming up soon...
Oh？
There's the entrance to the path!
translations.おぉ……\n鳥居がまだあんなに先に……。:
Whoa...
The torii gate is still
way up ahead...
translations.あのさ、素直で可愛い\nリンコちゃんが、おんぶして▼\nってお願いしたら？:
Say, what if sweet, cute little
Rinko asked you, 'Give me a
piggyback ride▼'？
translations.（ついに、悪用し始めたな……）:
(And now she's starting
to abuse it...)
translations.はぁ……\n近くで見ると、\n想像以上にデカイぞ……。:
Whoa...
Seeing it up close, it's way
bigger than I imagined...
translations.高さ９ｍ、\n柱の太さが１．１ｍだってさ？:
Says it's 9 meters tall,
and the pillars are
1.1 meters thick.
translations.石を積んだだけの構造なのに、\n大地震でも、少しズレた\nだけで――。:
The stones are just stacked,
so even in a big earthquake,
it barely shifted—
translations.あのさ、それより\n気になる事が有るんだけど。:
Hey, there's something I care
about way more than that.
translations.猫とか猿のとこってさ、\nあと、どんくらい？:
How much further is it
to the cat and the monkeys？
translations.地図によると……\nもう少し先だな。:
According to the map...
just a bit further ahead.
translations.リンコさぁ、\nもう、あきらめて、\nどっかで休みたいな▼:
Honestly, I'd really like to
just give up and go rest
somewhere▼
translations.もう少しだって……\nほら、行くぞ？:
I told you, it's just a little
further... Come on, let's go.
translations.素直に可愛く言ったのに～！\nおんぶ～！:
And after I asked so sweetly!
Give me a piggyback ride!
translations.ハァ……\nやっと鳥居まで着いた！:
Phew...
We finally made it to the
torii gate!
translations.やっぱり、デカイよな……\n『東照大権現』って書いてある\n板だけでも畳一畳だっ:
Man, it really is huge...
Just that 'Tosho Daigongen'
plaque is as big as a tatami.
translations.意味無いだろ……\nほら、目あけて！\n行くぞ！:
That's not gonna help...
Come on, open your eyes!
Let's go!
translations.着いたー！\nイェー！\nリンコがんばったよ！:
We made it!
Yay!
I did such a good job!
translations.よしよし。\nしかし、きらびやかだよな……\nさすが徳川家康の――。:
There, there.
Still, it's so flashy...
Leave it to Tokugawa Ieyasu—
translations.猫んとこ行こ？\nどこだっけ？:
Let's go see the cat.
Where was it again？
translations.『眠り猫』だろ？\nえぇと……あ！:
The 'Sleeping Cat,' right？
Let's see... Oh!
translations.いや、猿。\n『見ざる聞かざる言わざる』の\n神厩舎だ。:
No, the monkeys. It's the
stable with 'see no evil, hear
no evil, speak no evil.'
translations.おぉ……\n子ザルがワリとカワイイ。\nリンコは『聞かザル』推し。:
Ooh... The baby monkeys are
actually pretty cute.
My pick is 'hear no evil.'
translations.全部で８枚の猿の彫刻があって、\n生まれてから子供を産むまでが\n描かれてるって:
The guide says there are 8
carvings, showing a monkey's
life from birth to parenthood.
translations.人の生涯ってワケだね？\nで、わかんないのがさ、\n６枚目のやつ。:
So it's like a human life, huh？
What I don't get, though,
is the sixth one.
translations.恋愛のやつ？\n確かに、仲が良さそうには、\n見えないよな？:
The one about romance？
Yeah, they definitely don't
look like they get along, huh？
translations.むしろ、『逃げられた……』って\n感じじゃん？\nもっと、ラブラブでいいのにね？:
It looks more like one walked
out on the other, right？
They should be more lovey-dovey.
translations.猿のラブラブ……\nどんなだ？:
Monkeys being lovey-dovey...
What would that even look like？
translations.う～ん……\nラブラブでウキウキッ♪\nみたいなの。:
Hmm...
Like, lovey-dovey and going
'ooh-ooh' over each other♪
translations.ビミョーにダジャレか。\nまあ、カワイイけどな？:
Sort of a pun, huh？
Well, it's cute, though.
translations.あら、可愛いお猿さん達だこと！\nいいわねぇ～、若い人は……。:
Oh my, what cute little monkeys!
Ah, to be young...
translations.さてと……\nあそこに見えるのが、\n三神庫の『想像の象』だな？:
Anyway... That over there must
be the 'Imaginary Elephants' on
the Sacred Storehouses, right？
translations.あら、ほっぺが真っ赤！\n可愛いお猿さんねぇ～。:
Oh my, your cheeks are bright
red! What cute little monkeys.
translations.おぉ、陽明門か……\nまた、派手だな……。:
Whoa, so this is Yomeimon Gate...
Talk about flashy...
translations.『想像の象』のところも、\n相当スゴかったけどさ、\nやっぱ、ここが一番だね？:
The 'Imaginary Elephants' were
pretty amazing too,
but this really tops it all, huh？
translations.花模様もすごいけど、\n龍とか麒麟とか、霊獣の彫刻が\nギッシリだってさ……。:
The floral designs are great,
and it's packed with carvings
of dragons, kirin, and beasts...
translations.なんかもう、\n和風のＲＰＧだね……。:
It's basically a
Japanese-style RPG
at this point...
translations.あのさ、門の天井にドラゴンの\n絵、あるじゃん？:
Hey, see that dragon painted
on the gate's ceiling？
translations.ドラゴン？\nあぁ、龍の絵な？\n狩野探幽、だってさ。:
A dragon？
Oh, that painting up there？
By Kano Tan'yu, apparently.
translations.あそこの下通ると、なんか\nフラグ立つんだろうね。:
I bet walking under that
triggers some kind of flag.
translations.で、マップが切り替わって\n倒すまで出られなくなる、と。\n装備大丈夫かな……。:
Then the map changes and you
can't leave till you beat it.
Hope my gear's good enough...
translations.なんの心配だよ……。:
What are you even
worrying about...？
translations.見っけ！\nほら、あそこで寝てた！\nニャア～！:
Found it!
Look, it's sleeping over there!
Meow!
translations.おっ？\n思ったより小さいな……。:
Oh？
It's smaller than I thought...
translations.１／１ってことじゃん？\nや～ん！\nいいないいなっ▼:
So it's life-sized, right？
Aww!
I love it, I love it!▼
translations.ホント、▲小早川＊▲は\n猫好きだよな？:
You really do love cats,
huh, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.猫ってさ、寝てる時、こう、\n下のまぶたがあがるじゃん？\n三日月みたいに。:
You know how when cats sleep,
their lower eyelids curve up？
Like little crescent moons.
translations.そこがポイントだよねぇ～\nわかってるよねぇ……\n彫ったの、誰だっけ？:
That's the best part.
They totally nailed it...
Who carved this again？
translations.そうそう、ジンゴローさん。\nリンコは、\n友達になれそうな気がするよ。:
Right, right, Jingoro-san.
I feel like he and I
could've been good friends.
translations.そこまで言われると、\n本望だろうな甚五郎さんも。:
I'm sure Jingoro-san would be
thrilled to hear you say that.
translations.あの巨大な龍にしては、\nカワイイ声だったな？:
For such a huge dragon,
it had a pretty cute voice, huh？
translations.まあね。\nでも、リンコ感動した……。:
I guess so.
Still, it really moved me...
translations.うん……\nちゃんと、前ふりがあって、\n奥に大ボスが……。:
Yeah...
It had proper buildup, and then
the big boss in the back...
translations.そういうさ、\nゲーム的ないい意味のケレン味？\n江戸自体からあったんだね……。:
That kind of game-like flair—
in a good way, I mean？
Even the Edo period had it...
translations.やっぱ、日本のゲームはさ、\n世界に誇るべきだよ、\nうん……。:
Japanese games really are
something to be proud of,
yeah...
translations.（色んな感心の\n仕方があるな……）:
(There really are all kinds of
ways to be impressed...)
translations.この塀はさ、\nいったいどこまで続いてる？\nあの世まで？:
Just how far does this wall
keep going？
All the way to the afterlife？
translations.罰当たりなこと言うな……\nほら、ずっと先に門が\n見えるだろ？:
Don't say stuff like that...
Look, you can see the gate
way up ahead, right？
translations.やっぱアレだったか……。: So it really was that far...
translations.へぇ……\n東照宮とも違ってさ、\n静かで、厳かな感じがする……。:
Huh...
It's different from Toshogu.
Feels quiet and solemn...
translations.二荒山神社は山全体が、\n境内なんだってさ。\n神聖な所なんだな、\nやっぱり…:
They say the whole mountain is
Futarasan Shrine's grounds.
It really is a sacred place...
translations.最近は、そういう意味でも\n注目されてるらしいな。:
Seems like it's been getting
attention for that lately, too.
translations.あ、あっち……\n霊泉だって！:
Oh, over there...
It's a sacred spring!
translations.『智慧の水、酒の水、若水』……\nう～ん、ここは“智慧”？:
'Wisdom, Sake, and Youth'...
Hmm, should I go with 'Wisdom'？
translations.若水はいいのか？:
You don't want the
Water of Youth？
translations.リンコがこれ以上若返ったらさ、\nアンタ、捕まるよ？\nデートしてるとこ。:
If I get any younger, you're
gonna get arrested when they
catch us on a date.
translations.笑い過ぎなんだけど……。:
You're laughing a little
too hard at that...
translations.どうしよっかな……\nリンコ、行きたいとこが\nあったんだけど……。:
Hmm, what to do...
There's somewhere else
I wanted to go, though...
translations.ハァ……\nさすがに疲れて来たな……。:
Phew...
I'm starting to get
pretty tired...
translations.まあね？\nでもさ、ここが最後だと思うと\nちょっと、\n歩くの惜しくなる……。:
I guess？
But knowing this is our
last stop makes me reluctant
for the walk to end...
translations.ああ、そうだな……。:
Yeah, I know what
you mean...
translations.さて、と……\n霊泉、飲んで行くんだろ？:
All right, then...
You wanted to drink from
the sacred spring, right？
translations.そうそう。\n今度はさ、『酒の水』いっとく？:
Right, yeah.
Should we try the
'Water of Sake' this time？
translations.いっぱい、やるか？: Shall we have a drink, then？
translations.期待してたのか……\n▲小早川＊▲も二荒山神社に\n来ると、信心深くなるんだな？:
You were hoping it was...?
Even ▲小早川＊▲ becomes
a believer here at
Futarasan Shrine, huh？
translations.まあ、そういうのも\nあるかも知れないけど……\nほら？:
Well, maybe there's
a bit of that, too,
but... you know？
translations.素直で可愛いリンコだもん。\nちょっと、忘れかけたけど。:
I'm being sweet and honest
Rinko right now. Though
I almost forgot for a bit.
translations.ねぇ……\n行こ？ あそこ。:
Hey...
Let's go over there, okay？
translations.そう……\nお祈りすると、\n夫婦円満の御利益だよ。:
Yeah...
If you pray here, it brings
a happy marriage.
translations.リンコ達はさ、\nまだ、夫婦じゃないけどさ……。:
Not that the two of us
are married yet,
or anything...
translations.私たち、まだ夫婦じゃないけど、\nいつか、そうなれたら、\nちゃんと、お礼に来ま:
We aren't married yet,
but if we ever are someday,
we'll be sure to come back
and thank you.
translations.さてと……\n日光土産も一通り見たかな！:
All right...
That's just about all the
Nikko souvenirs, I think!
translations.あれ？\n▲小早川＊▲、また\n買い込んでるのかな……。:
Huh？
Wonder if ▲小早川＊▲ is
stocking up again...
translations.やっぱり……\nずいぶん、買ったみたいだな？:
I knew it...
Looks like you bought
quite a lot, huh？
translations.まあね？\nまずは、弟に眠り猫の\nキーホルダーでしょ？:
I guess？
First, a Sleeping Cat
keychain for my brother.
translations.お父さんには、\n眠り猫のボールペン。\nお母さんには、箸置きセット。:
A Sleeping Cat pen for
my dad. And a set of
chopstick rests for my mom.
translations.あ、眠り猫のね？\nそれと、原ちゃんと\n長倉先輩たちには――。:
Oh, Sleeping Cat ones, too.
And then for Hara-chan
and Nagakura-senpai...
translations.当たり！\nあ、やっぱり買った？\n買っちゃうよね～▼:
Bingo!
Oh, did you buy some too？
You just have to, right？▼
translations.うん、そう、ね……\nじゃあ、自分にも当然――。:
Yeah, right, sure...
Then for yourself,
naturally...
translations.眠り猫のストラップ！\n当然でしょ！:
A Sleeping Cat phone strap!
Obviously!
translations.（想像を超える\n猫づくしだな……）:
(That's way more cat stuff
than I ever imagined...)
translations.ハァ～……\nいよいよ\n修学旅行も終わりか……。:
Sigh...
So the school trip is
finally coming to an end...
translations.あ、男のくせに！\nセンチメンタル？:
Hey, aren't you a guy？
Getting all sentimental？
translations.発車までまだあるよね？\nちょっと、その辺歩こう？:
We still have time before
the train leaves, right？
Let's walk around a bit.
translations.そうだな。\n最後の写真も撮るか？:
Yeah, good idea.
Want to take one last
photo, too？
translations.う～ん……\n夕日がきれい……。:
Mmm...
The sunset is so pretty...
translations.そうだな。\n山の方だからかな……。:
It really is.
Maybe because we're
out in the mountains...
translations.思い出しちゃった……\nあの日の夕焼けのこと。\nほら、屋上の……。:
It just reminded me...
of the sunset that day.
You know, on the roof...
translations.素直ってのもさ、\nたまにはいいもんだね？\n気がついてた？:
Being honest like this
is nice once in a while, huh？
Did you notice？
translations.アンタもさ、いつもより\nなんか、ほら……\n世話焼きお兄ちゃんぽかったよ？:
You were acting a lot more
like a doting big brother
than usual, you know？
translations.……気付いてないんだ……\nそういうとこがさ、\nリンコはやっぱり……。:
...You didn't even realize...
It's that side of you
that I really...
translations.はい、素直で可愛い\nリンコちゃん終了～！\nほら、行くよ、お兄ちゃん！:
Okay, that's the end of
sweet and honest Rinko-chan!
Come on, let's go, big brother!
translations.はぁ……\nやっぱいいな！\n修学旅行は！:
Man...
School trips really
are great!
translations.今回の素直で\n可愛いリンコちゃんは、\nいかがでしたか？:
So, how did you like
sweet and honest Rinko-chan
this time around？
translations.う～ん……言葉が足りないので\nここで終了～！:
Hmm... Not enough words,
so we're calling it here!
translations.あれ？\n家に着くまでが修学旅行だろ？:
Huh？ Doesn't the school trip
last until we get home？
translations.でも、終了で～す！\nはい、写真撮って！:
Too bad, it's over!
Here, take my picture!
translations.えぇと、\n特急きぬ……だっけ……。\nそうだよな、▲小早川＊▲？:
Let's see, the Limited Express
Kinu... right？
Isn't it, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.あのさ、\nリンコがそんな事\n憶えてるわけないじゃん。:
Look, there's no way
I'd remember something
like that.
translations.はいはい。\n聞いた●が間違ってたよ。:
Yeah, yeah.
● was wrong to even ask.
translations.……なんかさ、\n急にいつもっぽくなったね？\nリンコ達。:
...Feels like we're suddenly
back to our usual selves,
doesn't it？
translations.まあ、●達らしくていいよ。:
Well, ● like it.
It's more like us.
translations.だよね？\n修学旅行は、\nみんなの心の中にあるのさ！:
Right？
The school trip lives on
in all of our hearts!
translations.バイバイ、日光！\nまた会おうぜ！:
Bye-bye, Nikko!
Until we meet again!
translations.ハァ……\nもう春日部か……\n浅草まですぐだな？:
Phew...
Kasukabe already...
Almost back to Asakusa, huh？
translations.まあね？\n今回の旅でさ、\nいろいろ考えちゃった……。:
Yeah, kind of.
This trip just got me
thinking about a lot of things...
translations.リンコのお母さんの話、\nしたじゃん？\nほら、最初の方の。:
Remember how I told you
about my mom？
My first mom, I mean.
translations.いつも、リンコに可愛い洋服\n着せてさ、リンコの髪を\n梳くのが大好きで……。:
She always dressed me up
in cute clothes, and loved
brushing my hair...
translations.もし、お母さんが生きてたら、\n本当に、素直で可愛いままに\nなってたのかな、な:
It made me wonder if I'd have
stayed sweet and honest for real
if she were still alive...
translations.あ、べつに哀しいとか、\nそういうんじゃさ、ないから。\n考えてもしょうがないし:
Oh, it's not like I'm sad
about it or anything.
No point dwelling on it anyway.
translations.でも……\n今のリンコ、お母さんは\n好きかな、って。ちょっとね？:
Still...
I did wonder a little if she'd
like the way I am now.
translations.大丈夫。\n今の▲小早川＊▲だって、\n素直で可愛いだろ？:
It's okay.
You're still sweet and honest
now, aren't you, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.…………ウソだね。\n素直で可愛いリンコちゃん、\nもう、終わってるじゃん。:
......That's a lie.
Sweet and honest Rinko-chan
is already over.
translations.あのさ、\n家に着くまでが、\n修学旅行って言うじゃん？:
Hey, you know how they say
the school trip isn't over
until you get home？
translations.ん？\nああ、言うな、うん。:
Hm？
Yeah, they do say that.
translations.じゃあ……\nまだ続けてもいいよね？:
Then...
I can keep it going a little
longer, right？
translations.いつも可愛くなくて、\nゴメン。:
Sorry I'm not usually
very cute.
translations.えぇと……\nこれで、\nホントに終了だから……。:
Um...
Okay, now it's
really over...
translations.ハァ……\nもう埼玉か……\n浅草まですぐだな？:
Phew...
Saitama already...
Almost back to Asakusa, huh？
translations.修学旅行終わったのが、\nそんなにセンチメンタルか？:
Feeling that sentimental
now that the school trip's over？
translations.そうじゃなくてさ……\nちょっと、やり過ぎたかなって、\n素直で可愛いリンコちゃ:
It's not that...
I just wondered if I overdid
sweet and honest Rinko-chan.
translations.まあ、\nあれはあれで……。:
Well,
that was nice in its own way...
translations.最初はさ、ただ冗談のつもり\nだったんだけど、ほら、\n東武ワールドスクウェアで:
At first I only meant it
as a joke, you know, back at
Tobu World Square...
translations.最初のお母さんの事、\n思い出したら、\nちょっと、ね……。:
But once I started thinking
about my first mom,
well, you know...
translations.あの頃は、リンコも\nこんな風に素直だったなって、\nなんか、懐かしいなって……:
I used to be this honest
back then, too...
It felt kind of nostalgic.
translations.今のひねくれたリンコ見たらさ、\nきっと、\nお母さん、ショックだよね？:
If Mom saw how cynical
I am now, she'd probably
be shocked, wouldn't she？
translations.ああ、もうヤメ！\nこういうの、ヤダ。:
Ugh, enough of that!
I hate getting like this.
translations.今の▲小早川＊▲だって、\nきっと、お母さんは好きだろ？:
Your mom would love the
▲小早川＊▲ you are now too,
wouldn't she？
translations.なんで？\nお母さんの事、知らないくせに。:
Why do you say that？
You don't even know my mom.
translations.●には、同じに見えるから、\n修学旅行の▲小早川＊▲も、\nいつもの▲小早川＊▲:
Because to ●, you look
the same—the ▲小早川＊▲ on this
trip, and the usual ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.本当は素直で可愛いところとか。:
Like how you're actually
honest and cute.
translations.家に帰るまでが修学旅行だから、\n素直なリンコも、\nもうちょっと、ね……。:
The trip's not over till we're
home, so I'll stay honest
just a little longer...
translations.ほら、もう……\nどうすんだ、この空気……。:
Aw, man...
What do we do with this
awkward mood now...？
translations.ハァ……\n春日部ってことは……\n浅草まですぐだな？:
*Sigh*...
If we're at Kasukabe...
Asakusa's right up ahead, huh？
translations.ん？\nなんか、心ここにあらずだな？:
Hm？
Seems like your mind's
somewhere else？
translations.うん……\nなんだかさ、\nわかんなくなっちゃった……。:
Yeah...
I just can't really tell
anymore...
translations.素直で可愛いリンコちゃんと、\nいつものリンコ。\nどっちが、本当？:
The honest, cute Rinko,
and the usual me.
Which one is the real me？
translations.最初はね、ふざけてたんだよ？\nでも、だんだん楽しくなって、\nそしたらさ……。:
At first, I was just messing
around, you know？ But then
it started getting fun, and...
translations.ああ、前はこんな感じだったな、\nお母さんがいた頃は、いつも\n笑ってたなって…:
I realized I used to be like
this. Back when my mom was
around, I was always smiling...
translations.きっとね？\nリンコは自分で思ってたより、\n強くないんだよ。:
I guess...
I'm not as strong as I
thought I was.
translations.だから、\nひねくれちゃうのかな……\n困ったもんだね？ ヘヘッ……。:
Maybe that's why I act so
cynical... What a pain,
huh？ Heheh...
translations.あれ？\nいま、素直になってる……\nどっちかもう、わかんないや。:
Huh？
I'm being honest right now...
I really can't tell anymore.
translations.どっちでもいいよ。\n▲小早川＊▲は\n▲小早川＊▲だろ？:
Either way is fine.
▲小早川＊▲ is still
▲小早川＊▲, right？
translations.そうだ。\nだから、あんまり無理すんな。:
That's right.
So don't force yourself.
translations.無理するなって、言ったじゃん？\nしたかったんだもん……。:
You told me not to force
myself, didn't you？
And I wanted to do that...
translations.家に着くまでが修学旅行だよ？\nだから、まだいいんだよ？\n素直なままでも……。:
The trip's not over till we
get home, right？ So it's okay
if I stay honest for now...
translations.ゴメン……\nちょっとさ、\n素直すぎたかも……。:
Sorry...
Maybe I was a little
too honest...
translations.ハァ……\n楽しかった修学旅行も、\nもうすぐ終わりか……。:
*Sigh*...
Guess our fun school trip is
almost over, huh...
translations.またまたセンチメンタルだ。\n家に着くまでが修学旅行じゃ\nなかったっけ？:
Getting sentimental again.
Didn't they say the trip's
not over till we get home？
translations.まあな。\nでも、素直で可愛いリンコも\nお終いだしな？:
Well, yeah.
But honest, cute Rinko is
coming to an end too, right？
translations.ちょっとだけ、続ける？:
Want me to keep it up
just a little longer？
translations.ホント、旅行中は、\nいつもよりお兄ちゃんぽくてさ、\nすごくカッコ良かったよ▼:
You were way more like a big
brother than usual on this
trip. You were super cool▼
translations.あれ？\nまだ来ないね？\n車内販売……。:
Huh？
It hasn't come by yet,
has it？ The snack cart...
translations.……大丈夫みたいだな？\nそれじゃ、もう一度――。:
...Looks like the coast is
clear, huh？
Alright then, one more time—
translations.ああ、もうわかんない！\nどっち？:
Ugh, I have no idea!
Which way is it？
translations.地下鉄は……あっちだろ？: The subway is... that way, right？
translations.（はしゃいでたから、\n疲れたんだな……）:
(She was having so much fun,
she must be worn out...)
translations.よく寝てたからさ？: You were sleeping so soundly, though.
translations.もう……どんなエロスか！: Jeez... What kind of pervert does that！
translations.ほら、ちゃんと目覚ませ。\nもうすぐ着くぞ？:
Come on, wake up already.
We're almost there.
translations.やっと、着いた……\nもう、夜だな？:
Finally back...
It's already night, huh？
translations.さっきまで、\n夕焼けの日光だったのにね……。:
And we were just in Nikko
watching the sunset...
translations.また、行けばいいよ。\nそうだろ？:
We can always go again.
Right？
translations.そうだね……うん。\n行こう？\n日常が待ってる！:
True... yeah.
Come on, let's go.
Everyday life awaits！
translations.もしかしてさ、\n熱海の時より、長くない？\n一緒に居る時間。:
Come to think of it,
weren't we together even longer
than on our trip to Atami？
translations.こうして一泊が二泊になり、\n二泊が三泊になり、悪い子に\nなってくんだからね？:
That's how one night becomes two,
and two becomes three, until I
turn into a bad girl, you know？
translations.家に着いたか……\nこれで、本当に修学旅行終了だ。:
Well, we're at your place...
Guess our school trip's really over.
translations.だね……\nお疲れ様。:
Yeah...
Thanks for a great trip.
translations.また、やろうな？\n修学旅行。:
Let's do it again sometime, okay？
Another school trip.
translations.わかんない。\nでも、いろいろ嬉しかった……。:
I don't know.
I was just really happy about
a lot of things...
translations.もしかして、\n素直なリンコ、継続中？:
Wait, are you still in
honest Rinko mode？
translations.忘れ物届けに、\n追いかけるって、\n出てきちゃった。:
I told them you forgot something
so I'd have an excuse to
come run after you.
translations.じゃあ、ホントにホントに、\nおしまいね？:
Okay, now it's really, truly
over, right？
translations.ああ、キリがないしな？:
Yeah, otherwise we'll never
say goodbye.
translations.はい、素直で可愛いリンコも、\nホントにホントに終了！:
And with that, sweet, honest Rinko
is really, truly done too！
translations.同級生っていう、設定。\n忘れないように。:
Remember the premise:
we're supposed to be classmates.
translations.うん……修学旅行っぽい。:
Yeah... It really feels
like a school trip.
translations.なるほど。\nここがねぇ……。:
I see.
So this is the place...
translations.うん……\nこれは、見ないと損かもね……。:
Yeah... It'd be a shame
to miss out on this...
translations.はぁ～……\n見に来る価値はあるね……。:
Whoa... Definitely worth
coming to see...
translations.ここ好き！\n修学旅行もバカに出来ないね？:
I like it here! School trips
aren't half bad, huh？
translations.これってさ……あれ？\n世界遺産？:
Wait, is this...
a World Heritage Site？
translations.外国の人、多いね？\nやっぱ。:
Lots of foreign tourists
here, huh？
translations.緑の色がさ、きれいだよね？\nやっぱ、今は。:
The greenery's so pretty
this time of year, huh？
translations.もうちょい、\n薄着で来ればよかったかも……。:
Maybe I should've worn
something a bit lighter...
translations.やっぱさ、夏より\n空が高くなった気がする……。:
The sky really does feel
higher than in summer...
translations.あっち、行ってみよっか？: Want to head over that way？
translations.なるほどね……\nこういうとこか。:
I see...
So it's this kind of place.
translations.離れると、迷子になるかも……。:
If we get separated,
I might get lost...
translations.なんかさ……大人気分？\nビミョーに緊張。\nヘヘッ……。:
Feels kind of grown-up, huh？
Makes me a bit nervous.
Hehe...
translations.修学旅行にしちゃ、\nリッチな感じ？:
Pretty fancy for a
school trip, isn't it？
translations.ねぇねぇ、\n窓の外、見てみた？:
Hey, did you look
out the window yet？
translations.冷蔵庫の中、見た？\n……飲んじゃう？:
Did you check the fridge？
...Want to drink something？
translations.鬼怒川の鬼怒太ね。\nよしよし、覚えてやろう。:
Kinuta of Kinugawa, huh.
Okay, I'll remember you.
translations.いいとこだったな、\n鬼怒川……。:
Kinugawa sure was
a nice place...
translations.もうちょっと、\n居たかったな……。:
Wish we could've stayed
a little longer...
translations.田んぼ増えて来た……。:
Seeing a lot more
rice fields now...
translations.石がゴロゴロ。\n歩きにくい……。:
Lots of rocks everywhere.
It's hard to walk...
translations.けっこう、流れ速い？:
The current's pretty fast,
isn't it？
translations.えぇと……\nあっち行ったっけ？:
Let's see...
Did we go that way yet？
translations.怪獣の気持ちが\nわかる気がするよ……。:
I think I know how a
giant monster feels now...
translations.いっそ、\nちょんまげ被っちゃうか……。:
Maybe I should just put on
a topknot wig too...
translations.うぅ、\n時代劇っぽくて燃える……。:
Ooh, it's just like a period
drama. Gets me fired up...
translations.ちょっとさ、\nリンコ達には立派すぎ？:
Isn't this place a bit
too fancy for us？
translations.けっこう人泊まってるね？:
Quite a lot of people
are staying here, huh？
translations.ハァ……\n来た甲斐があったよ。:
Haaah...
It was worth the trip.
translations.あの山の先もさ、\nまだ中禅寺湖だよね……。:
Even past that mountain,
it's still Lake Chuzenji...
translations.カツミチ――\nいやいや……ショウドウ？\nなんて読むの？:
Katsumichi—
no, wait... Shodo？
How do you read that？
translations.おぉ、世界遺産だねぇ……。:
Ohh, a World Heritage
site, huh...
translations.もっとさ、\nひなびた感じかと思ってた……。:
I thought it'd feel
a lot more rustic...
translations.よそのツアーに混ざってさ、\nガイドさんの説明、聞いちゃう？:
Wanna sneak into a tour
group and listen to
the guide？
translations.遠い～……修行？:
So far... Is this
some kind of training？
translations.やっぱさ、\n神聖な場所って感じする……。:
It really does feel like
a sacred place...
translations.木が高い……\n天狗いるかも……。:
The trees are so tall...
Maybe there are tengu...
translations.いいじゃん？\nべつに……。:
Why not？
It's no big deal...
translations.まあ、なんて言うか……。: Well, how do I put it...
translations.▲小早川＊▲、\n遅いな……\n今日は書架整理の日なのに。:
▲小早川＊▲'s running late...
And we're supposed to sort
the bookshelves today.
translations.ゴメン、着替えてたら、\nちょっと遅くなっちゃった。:
Sorry, I was getting changed,
so I'm a little late.
translations.どうしたって、熱海でしょ？\n忘れた？:
What do you mean？
We're going to Atami, right？
Did you forget？
translations.いや、そうじゃなくて……。: No, that's not what I mean...
translations.こうして、暗い図書館で\n本を整理するだけじゃなくてさ、\nたまには息抜きしない:
We can't just sort books in
a dark library all the time.
We need a break now and then...
translations.じゃあ、行っとく？\n今度は熱海だけじゃなくて、\n他のところにも。:
Then wanna go for it？
Not just Atami this time,
but somewhere else, too.
translations.どうだね？\nやっとるかね？:
How goes it？
Working hard in here？
translations.遅れてきてなんだ、\nその態度は……。:
What's with that attitude？
You're the one who's late...
translations.リンコだってさ、\nこうやって暗い図書室で\n書架整理してるとさ……。:
Even for me, you know,
sorting shelves in a dark
library like this...
translations.考えちゃうんだよね、\nこれって青春？\nいいのか、青春って。:
It makes me wonder—is this
really what youth is about？
Is this really okay？
translations.書を捨てて旅に出よう！\nなんてね？:
Let's ditch the books
and hit the road!
...Or something like that？
translations.旅行か……。\nそう言えば、二人で\nした事ないんだよな？:
A trip, huh...
Come to think of it, we've
never taken one, have we？
translations.じゃあ、行っとく？\nパ～ッと、泊まりがけでさ！:
Then wanna go for it？
Go all out on an
overnight trip!
translations.そうだな、\n考えてみるか……。:
Yeah, maybe I'll
think about it...
translations.ねぇ、いつ？\nいつ行く？:
Hey, when？
When are we going？
translations.そんな急には……\nほら、先立つものも、な？:
Hold on, not so fast...
We need the money for it
first, you know？
translations.じゃあさ、\n懸賞とか、\nそういうのに応募したら？:
Then why don't you
enter a sweepstakes
or something？
translations.懸賞？\nそうそう、当たらないだろう！:
A sweepstakes？
You don't just win those
that easily!
translations.そうとも、限らないんだなぁ、\nこれが……。:
I wouldn't be so sure
about that...
translations.なんでも？\nもし、旅行が当たったらさ、\nリンコと、行きたい？:
Never mind that.
If you did win a trip,
would you wanna go with me？
translations.じゃあ、約束。\nねぇねぇ……\n今、誰も見てないみたいよ？:
Then it's a promise.
Hey... Nobody's watching
right now, you know？
translations.（そうだ！\n箱根旅行の懸賞\n誘ってみるかな……）:
(Oh yeah!
Maybe I'll ask her on that
Hakone trip I won...)
translations.実は、また当たったんだ！\n旅行！:
Actually, I won again!
Another trip!
translations.だんだん心配になって\nきたんだけどさ、\nアンタってさ、アレ？:
I'm starting to get a little
worried here, you know.
Are you, like...？
translations.もしかして、最近巷を騒がせてる\nハッカーとか、そういう……。:
...one of those hackers
everyone's talking about
lately, or something？
translations.ならいいんだけどさ。\nで？ 今度は、熱海？\n日光・鬼怒川？:
Well, as long as you're not.
So？ Is it Atami this time？
Nikko and Kinugawa？
translations.今度は、箱根だ！\n国内ハネムーン再発見、\n一泊二日――:
It's Hakone this time!
'Rediscover Honeymoons:
2 Days, 1 Night'--
translations.国内ハネムーン再発見、\n一泊二日の旅っていう、\n旅行なんだけどさ？:
It's a trip called
'Rediscover Honeymoons:
2 Days, 1 Night.'
translations.ハネムーンって……\nあのさ、意味、知ってるよね？:
A honeymoon...
Look, you do know what
that means, right？
translations.新婚旅行だろ？\n昭和30年代には、箱根とか\n熱海が多かったんだって。:
A trip for newlyweds, right？
They say Hakone and Atami
were big back in the '50s.
translations.そういう所をもう一度観光しよう\nっていう、カップル向けの\nパックらしい。:
Apparently it's a couples'
package for revisiting
places like that.
translations.あんまり気が進まないか？\n箱根？:
Not too keen on going？
To Hakone, I mean？
translations.箱根はいいんだけどさ、\nほら……だって……。:
Hakone itself is fine,
it's just... you know...
translations.リンコだってさ、\n一応、考えるよ……。\nお年頃なワケだし？:
I mean, even I think about
it a little, you know...
I am that age, right？
translations.でも、まあ、\nそういう名前なだけで、\n今までの旅行と、変わらないぞ？:
Well, sure, but that's just
the name. It's no different
from our other trips.
translations.行ってみよっかな……\nさっきの話。\nほら、旅行の。:
Maybe I will go after all...
On that thing you mentioned.
Y'know, the trip.
translations.全部言わなくていいから！:
You don't have to say
the whole thing!
translations.……ただの旅行だもんね？\nそういう、テーマのさ？:
...It's just a normal trip,
right？ With that theme？
translations.それで？\nいつにすんの？:
So？
When are we doing this？
translations.（えーと、デートは\nまた別の日にしよう……。）:
(Hmm, let's save our date
for another day...)
translations.じゃあ。\n▲月▲▲日▲から、\n一泊二日のハネムーン！:
All right, then.
Starting ▲月▲▲日▲,
a 2-day, 1-night honeymoon!
translations.という名前の、旅行な？:
...is the name of the trip,
right？
translations.そういうこと。\nでも、まあ、\nちょっとくらいならさ……。:
Right, exactly.
Still, well...
if it's just a little bit...
translations.付き合わないでもないよ？\n新婚さんごっこみたいなの……\nリンコも、鬼じゃない:
I can play along a little,
you know？ Like newlyweds...
I'm not heartless or anything.
translations.（やったっ!!\n●と▲小早川＊▲、\nハネムーンごっこだっ！）:
(Alright!!
A pretend honeymoon for
● and ▲小早川＊▲!)
translations.（そうだ！ また当たった\n箱根旅行の懸賞、\n誘ってみるかな……）:
(Oh yeah! I won that Hakone
trip again. Maybe I'll ask
her to come along...)
translations.あれでしょ？\nそういうファイアーウォールの\nシステムの穴っていうの？:
It's that thing, right？
A loophole in the firewall
system, or whatever？
translations.まだそんなこと言ってんのか……\n安心しろ。\n正々堂々、当たったから。:
You're still on about that？
Don't worry.
I won it fair and square.
translations.そういう事にしとくよ。\nリンコも共犯者になる覚悟は\nあるからね。:
Let's just go with that.
I'm ready to be your
accomplice, after all.
translations.どうする？\n行くだろ？:
So, what do you say？
You're coming, right？
translations.そりゃ、まあ、行くけど……\nどうしよっかな……\nこの間みたいな、ほら。:
Well, yeah, I'll go, but...
I don't know about doing...
you know, like last time.
translations.うん……\n実は、あれさ、あとでモーレツに\n恥ずかしくなるっていうか……。:
Yeah...
Truth is, it gets insanely
embarrassing afterward...
translations.まあ、無理すんなよ。\nじゃあ、いつにする？:
Well, don't push yourself.
So, when should we go？
translations.（デートは、また別の日だな。\nハネムーンだし……。）:
(Let's save our date for
another day. Since this is
a honeymoon and all...)
translations.じゃあ。\n▲月▲▲日▲から、\n一泊二日の箱根旅行だ！:
Alright then.
Starting ▲月▲▲日▲,
2 days, 1 night in Hakone!
translations.え、いいのか、\n新婚さんごっこで？:
Wait, you're okay with
playing newlyweds？
translations.リンコだって鬼じゃないんだし？\nカレシの期待にも\n応えてあげたいし？:
I'm not heartless, you know？
And I want to live up to my
boyfriend's expectations？
translations.やるかやらないかって\n言えば、まあ……やる？:
Between doing it or not,
well... I guess I'll do it？
translations.（やりたいんだな、\n▲小早川＊▲……）:
(So you really do want to,
huh, ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.あのさ、\n行くじゃん？ 箱根。:
Listen, you know how
we're going to Hakone？
translations.ああ、\n国内ハネムーン再発見、\n箱根一泊二日の旅？:
Yeah, the 'Rediscover
Honeymoons: 2 Days, 1 Night
in Hakone' trip？
translations.今から、買い物行くよ？:
We're going shopping
right now, okay？
translations.（とりあえず、行ってみるか）:
(Guess I'll go meet her
for now.)
translations.どうした？\n買い物なんて必要か？\n旅慣れた▲小早川＊▲だろ？:
What's up？ Do you really
need to shop？ Aren't you
used to traveling, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.それはそれ。\n今度のは、ほら……\nアレじゃん。:
That's different.
This time, you know...
it's that thing.
translations.そっちじゃなくて、\nほら……例の。:
Not that part.
You know... the other thing.
translations.でも、ごっこなわけだし……\nなんか特に必要か？:
Still, it's just pretend...
Do we need anything special？
translations.そこは考えてよ。\n年上なんだから。:
Come up with something.
You're the older one here.
translations.やっぱり、ダメだ。\nなんにも思いつかないな……。:
Nope, it's no use.
I can't think of a thing...
translations.リンコも。\nポテチくらいしか、\n思いつかなかったよ。:
Me neither.
Potato chips were about
all I could come up with.
translations.それは修学旅行でも\n買ってるけどな？:
Don't people buy those for
school trips too, though？
translations.まあね。\nう～ん……ないの？\nなんかこう、お揃いみたいなの。:
True.
Hmm... Isn't there anything？
Like, something matching.
translations.聞かなかった事にする。\nじゃあ、あれは？ 通信でさ、\n共に闘うようなゲーム。:
I'll pretend I didn't hear
that. How about a game where
we team up over wireless？
translations.ハァ……\nもういいや、解散ね？:
Sigh...
Whatever, let's just
call it a day, okay？
translations.まあ、無理に買い物する\n必要もないな？:
Well, it's not like we
have to buy anything.
translations.だね？ あ、そうだ！\nリンコはさ、ちょっと\n買い物あるから、ここで。:
True. Oh, right!
I actually have a little
shopping to do, so I'll
split off here.
translations.付き合うぞ？\nなに買うんだ？:
I can come with you.
What're you buying？
translations.それは……\nほら、その……気持ちの上では、\n新婦なわけだし新しい方が……。:
Well, it's...
You know, um... In spirit,
I'm a bride, so I figured
something new...
translations.いいの！\n知らなくて！\nそんじゃね？:
Never mind!
You don't need to know!
See ya!
translations.えぇと……まあ、ね？\n朝から蒸し暑かったしさ？\nそれに、ほら……。:
Um... well, yeah.
It's been muggy all morning.
And besides, you know...
translations.新婚早々、\n寝坊できないもんな？:
Can't be oversleeping when
we're newlyweds, huh？
translations.時間通りだぞ？\nそんなに早く来たのか？:
I'm right on time, though.
How early did you get here？
translations.新婚早々、\n寝坊できないとか？:
Because newlyweds can't
afford to oversleep？
translations.一応、さ……\nそういう設定だしさ、\n気持ちの問題っていうか……。:
Well, I mean...
That's the whole premise,
and it's about being in
the right mindset...
translations.そっか……\nよし！\n行こう、ハネムーン！:
I see...
All right!
Off on our honeymoon!
translations.やっ、ちょっと！\nはっきり言うなっつーの！:
H-Hey, wait!
Don't just blurt it out!
translations.う～ん……\nリンコの想像力にも\n限界ってもんがあるんだよ？:
Hmm...
Even my imagination
has its limits, you know.
translations.どう見ても\nアレっぽくないじゃん、\nこの電車。:
No matter how you look at
it, this train doesn't feel
like 'that' at all.
translations.あっ！\nこれ？\nこれに乗る？:
Oh!
Is this it？
Are we taking this one？
translations.えっ？\nうん……まあ、ね？\nヘヘッ。:
Huh？
Yeah... I guess so.
Heheh.
translations.日常すぎる……。\nHoneyでもMoonでもない……。:
It's way too everyday...
Not 'honey' or 'moon'
at all...
translations.まあ、\n『ロマンスカー』まではな？:
Well, until we get on
the Romancecar, anyway.
translations.そうだった……。\n頼むよ、『ロマンスカー』？:
Oh, right...
I'm counting on you,
Romancecar.
translations.おぉ、やっぱりいいな、\n『ロマンスカー』！:
Whoa, the Romancecar
really is nice!
translations.うん。\n第一、名前がイカスよね？\nへへっ！:
Yeah.
First off, it's got a
cool name, right？
Heheh!
translations.いいね！\nなんて言うかさ、こう、\n開放的？:
It's nice!
How do I put it... like,
open and free？
translations.まあな？\n旅は人を開放的にするしな？:
Guess so.
Travel does make people
feel more open and free.
translations.だんだんそういう気分に\nなって来た。\nほら……ハネムーン、だっけ？:
I'm starting to get into
that kind of mood.
You know... a honeymoon, right？
translations.だよね？\nやっぱりさ、\n非日常だよ、うん。:
I know, right？
It really feels out of
the ordinary. Yeah.
translations.ハネムーンっぽいか？: Does it feel like a honeymoon？
translations.そ、そうだけど……\nまだ、そのキーワードはＮＧ。:
W-Well, yeah, but...
that word is still off-limits.
translations.まだって……。\nいつならいいんだ？:
Still...？
Then when is it okay？
translations.これで、よし……\nもう、言っていいよ？\nほら、ハネムーン……だっけ？:
There we go...
Okay, you can say it now.
You know, honeymoon... right？
translations.ずいぶん町の中、\n走ってるけどさ……\nあってるよね？ この特急で。:
We've been going through
town for a while now...
This is the right train, right？
translations.熱海の時と違って、\n陸の方を走ってるからな。:
Unlike when we went to Atami,
we're traveling inland.
translations.あのさ、熱海って言えばさ、\nやったじゃん？\nほら……ごっこ。:
Hey, speaking of Atami,
we did that thing, didn't we？
You know... playing pretend.
translations.そ、そうなんだけどさ……。\nなんか違うんだよね、\n今回は。:
Y-Yeah, that, but...
Something feels different
this time.
translations.それは、やっぱり、\n心構えって言うか……\n今回は旅行の目的なワケだし？:
Well, I guess it's our
mindset, or rather...
it's the goal of our trip this time？
translations.そうだ、熱海って言えばさ、\nイヤがったじゃん、\nほら、“ごっこ”……。:
Oh yeah, speaking of Atami,
you didn't want to do it.
You know, playing pretend...
translations.今度は、キッチリやって\nもらうよ？\nアンタが言いだしたんだからね？:
This time, I'm making you
do it properly, okay？
You're the one who brought it up.
translations.（キッチリ、\n“ハネムーンごっこ”……\nがんばろう……。）:
(Playing honeymoon
'properly'...
I'd better do my best...)
translations.そっか。\n熱海と記憶が混ざっちゃうんだ。\nなるほどね……。:
I see.
I mixed up my memories with Atami.
That makes sense...
translations.リンコ達ってさ、\n今までも、\nけっこう旅行したじゃん？:
You and I have gone on
quite a few trips
by now, haven't we？
translations.リンコは、いつも、最後にした\n旅行が一番好き。だから、\n今度もそうなるといい:
My favorite trip is always
the latest one we took.
So I hope this one is, too.
translations.聞いた？\n箱根湯本だって！:
Did you hear that？
It said Hakone-Yumoto!
translations.へぇ……\nリンコさ、実は箱根って\n初めてなんだけどさ……。:
Huh...
This is actually my
first time in Hakone, you know...
translations.なんか、あれだね？\nザ・観光地って感じだね！\nへぇ……。:
It's really got that
classic tourist spot vibe!
Huh...
translations.箱根だからな！\n行くぞ！:
Well, it is Hakone!
Let's go!
translations.リンコ達はさ、\n今、アレなわけじゃん？\nほら、えっと……。:
Right now, you and I
are doing that thing, right？
You know, um...
translations.いつもよりさ、\nくっついた方が、いい？:
Should we stick closer
together than usual？
translations.こっからはさ、\n気合い入れて行くよ？\nハネムーン。:
From here on out,
let's give it all we've got, okay？
Our honeymoon.
translations.あ！\n見えた、赤い橋！:
Oh!
I see it, the red bridge!
translations.『あじさいばし』、ね？\nうん。\n……で、アジサイは？:
'Hydrangea Bridge,' right？
Yeah.
...So where are the hydrangeas？
translations.アジサイは……あ！\nほら、川岸に咲いてるぞ？:
The hydrangeas are... oh!
Look, they're blooming
along the riverbank.
translations.ん？ どこ？\n……あ、見っけ！\nよかったよかった。:
Hm？ Where？
...Oh, I see them!
Thank goodness.
translations.リンコもさ、\nハネムーンの時くらい、\n毒舌は控えたいからさ。:
Even I'd like to hold back
the snark on our honeymoon,
at least.
translations.アジサイの名所っていうより、\n箱根は町をあげてアジサイで\n観光客を迎えること:
Rather than a famous spot,
all of Hakone started welcoming
visitors with hydrangeas—
translations.その記念みたいな感じらしいぞ？:
And I heard the bridge is
kind of a tribute to that.
translations.箱根の６月はアジサイって、\nわけだね？ オッケー。\n心意気は受け取ったよ。:
So June in Hakone means
hydrangeas, huh？ Okay.
I appreciate the spirit.
translations.アジサイは、無しと……。\nまあ、秋だしね？:
No hydrangeas in sight...
Well, it is autumn.
translations.でもさ、\n紅葉がきれいじゃん。\n川の緑といいコントラストで。:
Still, the autumn leaves
are pretty. Nice contrast
with the green river.
translations.本当だな……\nなんか、今日は前向きだな？\n▲小早川＊▲。:
You're right...
You're awfully positive today,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.まあね？\nリンコだってさ、ハネムーンの時\nくらい、シニカルは封印するよ。:
Well, yeah.
Even I can put a lid on the
cynicism during our honeymoon.
translations.それは、ほら……\n旦那サマしだいじゃん？\nヘヘ▼:
That depends on...
my dear husband, doesn't it？
Hehe▼
translations.ちょっと早いけど、この辺りで\n昼ごはん食べて行くか？\n箱根なんだから、そうだ:
It's a bit early, but wanna
grab lunch here？ Since we're
in Hakone, let's see...
translations.……箱根に来たんだぞ？:
...We came all the way
to Hakone, you know？
translations.そういうとこはブレないな……。\nでも、この辺にラーメンなんて、\nやってるとこ:
You never waver on that...
Wait, is there even a ramen
place open around here？
translations.あ、ほら！\nあるじゃん、あそこ！:
Oh, look!
There's one right over there!
translations.あるんだ……。\nへぇ、湯本手打ちラーメン、\n『ハイカラ中華 日清亭』か。:
There really is...
Huh, Yumoto hand-pulled ramen,
'Haikara Chuka Nisshintei.'
translations.ここにする！\nほら、入るよ！:
Let's eat here!
Come on, let's go in!
translations.へぇ……\nちょっと、レトロな\nカフェみたいな感じだな？:
Huh...
Feels kind of like
a retro cafe, doesn't it？
translations.そこは、ほら、箱根だからね。\nただのラーメン屋さんじゃ\nないんだよ。:
Well, it is Hakone, after all.
It's not just your average
ramen shop.
translations.なるほどな……。\n▲小早川＊▲、もう\nなに頼むか決まったか？:
Fair point...
Have you decided what
you're ordering, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコはねぇ……\nよし、これだ！:
Let's see...
Okay, I'm getting this!
translations.お待たせしました！\n『サンマ―メン』と、\n『五目ワンタンメン』になります！:
Here you go!
One sanma-men and
one gomoku wonton-men!
translations.お、▲小早川＊▲のも\n美味そうだな？:
Oh, yours looks
really good too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.でしょ？\nあ……\nじゃあ、やっとく？:
Right？
Oh...
Then, should we do it？
translations.ここは、やっぱさ？: We kind of have to, right？
translations.ごちそうさま！\nハァ～……満足▼:
That hit the spot!
Ahh... I'm so full▼
translations.ちょっと早いけど、\n昼ごはん食べて行くか？:
It's a bit early,
but wanna grab some lunch？
translations.賛成！\n箱根と言えばやっぱり……。:
I'm in!
When you think of Hakone...
translations.ここ、ここ！\n『ハイカラ日清亭』。\nほら、入るよ？:
It's gotta be this place!
'Haikara Nisshintei.'
Come on, let's go inside.
translations.だって、二人じゃん？:
Well, there are two of us,
right？
translations.お待たせしました。\n『サンマ―メン』と、\n『チャーシューメン』です。:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Here's your sanma-men
and chashu-men.
translations.そういうことか……。:
So that's what you were
after...
translations.いいじゃん？\n新婚さんなんだし。\nリンコのもあげるからさ？:
What's wrong with that？
We're newlyweds, after all.
I'll share some of mine too.
translations.ごちそうさま。\nやっぱ箱根はラーメン♪:
That hit the spot.
Nothing beats ramen in Hakone♪
translations.あのさ、\nまた電車乗んの？\nここ、箱根だよね？:
Hey,
we're getting on another train？
We're already in Hakone, right？
translations.箱根登山鉄道で強羅まで。\n『箱根ガラスの森美術館』に\n行くからな。:
We're taking the mountain
railway to Gora. We're headed to
the Hakone Glass Forest Museum.
translations.ぜんぜん、\n行程表読んでないな……？:
You didn't read the
itinerary at all, did you...？
translations.三歩下がってついて行くよ。\n日本の妻ですから。:
I'll follow three steps behind.
I'm a traditional Japanese wife,
after all.
translations.これで山登んの？\n見た目、フツーじゃん……。\nもっと、ゴツいの想像した。:
We're climbing a mountain
in this？ It looks totally normal...
I pictured something more rugged.
translations.有名な登山電車だぞ？\nほら、乗ろう！:
It's a famous mountain train,
you know？ Come on, let's get on!
translations.次はさ、\n『箱根ガラスの森美術館』\nだよね？:
Next up is the
Hakone Glass Forest Museum,
right？
translations.あ、いたいた！\n登山鉄道！:
Oh, there it is!
The mountain train!
translations.一回乗ってみるとさ、\nたくましく見えるもんだね？:
Once you've ridden it once,
it actually looks pretty sturdy,
doesn't it？
translations.今日も最後まで頼むよ？\nリンコ、足で山登るのは\nゼッタイやだからね？:
I'm counting on you to go all
the way today too. I refuse to
climb a mountain on foot, okay？
translations.アジサイ！\nほら、たくさん咲いてる！:
Hydrangeas!
Look, there's so many in bloom!
translations.すごい……\nアジサイの中を走ってる……。:
Amazing...
We're riding right through
the hydrangeas...
translations.▲小早川＊▲、\n『あじさい橋』で\nいろいろ言ってたよな？:
You had a lot to say back at
Hydrangea Bridge, didn't you,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコが全面的に悪かったよ……\nいいね、\nアジサイの箱根……。:
I was completely in the wrong...
Hakone with hydrangeas
really is nice...
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、喜んでる。\nいい時期に来たな！）:
(▲小早川＊▲'s really happy.
We came at a great time of year!)
translations.みて、紅葉。\nいいなぁ……。:
Look at the fall leaves.
They're so nice...
translations.ああ……\n秋らしくていいよな？:
Yeah...
Really feels like autumn, huh？
translations.やっぱさ、\n秋だよ、箱根はさ……。:
Autumn really is
the best season for Hakone...
translations.いいじゃん？\nハネムーンだもん。\nヘヘッ。:
What's wrong with that？
It's our honeymoon, after all.
Heheh.
translations.こういう、日本ならではの\n良さを楽しむハネムーンもさ、\nありだよ、うん……。:
A honeymoon where you just enjoy
the beauty of Japan like this...
is pretty great too, yeah...
translations.（▲小早川＊▲、喜んでる。\nいい時期に来たよな……）:
(▲小早川＊▲'s really happy.
We came at a great time of year...)
translations.あれ？\nなんか、涼しい？:
Huh？
Is it a little cooler up here？
translations.結構、登ったからな？:
We did climb pretty high,
after all.
translations.うん、登ってた！\nやるよね、登山鉄道？\nがんばったよ。:
Yeah, we really did!
Not bad for a mountain train, huh？
It worked hard.
translations.まあな。\nここからは、バスで\n『箱根ガラスの森美術館』だ。:
Sure did.
From here, we take a bus to
the Hakone Glass Forest Museum.
translations.えっ……？ なんで、\nもう少しがんばらないかな、\n登山鉄道……。:
What...？ Why couldn't the
mountain train just try
a little harder...？
translations.そっか、バスとか苦手だもんな？:
Oh right, you don't do well
with buses, do you？
translations.こういう時はさ、\n男らしさをアピールすれば？\nハネムーンなんだしさ。:
At times like this, why not
show off how manly you are？
It is our honeymoon.
translations.寒っ！\nどんだけ登ったんだ、\n登山鉄道……。:
It's freezing!
Just how high up did that
mountain train climb...？
translations.まあまあ。\n箱根って感じするじゃないか。:
Come on.
It feels like Hakone, right？
translations.早めに乗るか？\n『箱根ガラスの森美術館』まで、\nバスだから。:
Want to board early？
We're taking a bus to the
Hakone Glass Forest Museum.
translations.そうだった……\nうぅ……でも、\n心の準備が……。:
Oh, right...
Ugh... But I haven't
prepared myself yet...
translations.とりあえず、\nギュッてするように……。\nそういうのも夫の務めだよ？:
For now, hold me tight...
That's part of a husband's
duty, you know？
translations.▲小早川＊▲……\nもう、そんなに？:
▲小早川＊▲...
Is it that bad already？
translations.がんばれ、もう少しだから！:
Hang in there!
We're almost there!
translations.次の揺れがヤマかも……。:
The next jolt might put me
over the edge...
translations.うん……\n今ので、がんばれた。\nへへ。:
Yeah...
That got me through it.
Hehe.
translations.がんばったな、▲小早川＊▲。\n着いたぞ、\n『箱根ガラスの森美術館』。:
You hung in there, ▲小早川＊▲.
We're here--the Hakone
Glass Forest Museum.
translations.言っとくけどさ、今のバスで\n相当ハードル上がったよ？\n楽しませてもらうから…:
Just so you know, that bus
really raised the bar.
This better be good...
translations.ほら、みて見ろよ？\nガラスの木！:
Hey, look at that!
A glass tree!
translations.あ、ホントだ。\nキラキラしてる……。\nなんでだろ？:
Oh, you're right.
It's all sparkly...
I wonder why？
translations.これ、チケット？\nへぇ……いいね！\n期待しちゃうよ？:
This is the ticket？
Huh... Pretty nice!
Now I'm getting excited.
translations.ハァ～～……。\nここがあるから頑張れた\n気がするよ。:
Phew...
I think looking forward to
this is what got me through.
translations.ほら見ろ、\nクリスタルガラスの木、\n今日もキラキラだぞ？:
Look over there.
The crystal glass tree is
sparkling today, too.
translations.あ、本当だ。\n太陽の光だけなんだよね？\n不思議……。:
Oh, you're right.
And that's just the sunlight,
right？ It's like magic...
translations.あれ？\nこれ、この間と違うよ？\nリンコ、また取っとこう。:
Huh？ It's different from
last time. I'm gonna save
this one, too.
translations.わぁ……\nすごいよ、これ！\nリンコの想像を超えてたよ……。:
Wow...
This is amazing!
Way beyond my imagination...
translations.ガラスもすごいけど、館内もな？\n全部、ヴェネチアの\nイメージらしいぞ？:
The glass is great, and this
place, too. Apparently it's
all modeled after Venice.
translations.うん……\nヨーロッパの感じがする！\nあっち、行ってみよう？:
Yeah...
It really feels like Europe!
Let's go look over there？
translations.あ、これ見て！\nガラスのアジサイ！\nキレイだよ？:
Oh, look at this!
Glass hydrangeas!
Aren't they pretty？
translations.えぇと、『オルテンシア』、か。\nクリスタルガラスが……\n２千粒!?:
Let's see, 'Ortensia,' huh.
It's got... 2,000
crystal glass beads!?
translations.本物のアジサイと\n一緒に並んでるところが、\nまた憎いね……。:
Putting them right alongside
real hydrangeas is such
a clever touch, too...
translations.見て、これ何？\nススキ？\n全部ガラスで出来てる！:
Look, what's this？
Pampas grass？
It's made entirely of glass!
translations.ガラスのススキか……。\nええと、１００粒のクリスタル\nガラスの穂が、１００株:
Glass pampas grass, huh...
Let's see, 100 stalks with
100 crystal beads on each!?
translations.１万粒……\nあ、風で揺れるんだ！\nいい仕事してますな……。:
10,000 beads...
Oh, they sway in the breeze!
That's some fine craftsmanship...
translations.これ、すごいよ？\n光の回廊だって！:
This is amazing!
It's called the Corridor of Light!
translations.１６万!? どうりで……。\n太陽がキラキラ反射して、\n眩しいくらいだもんね…:
160,000!? No wonder...
The sunlight sparkling off it
is almost blinding...
translations.これさ、\n写真に撮らないと損じゃない？:
Hey, wouldn't it be a waste
not to take a picture of this？
translations.オッケー！\n▲小早川＊▲、入れよ！:
Okay!
Get in the frame, ▲小早川＊▲!
translations.あのさ、\nここって、ちょっとさ、\nバージンロードみたいだね？:
You know,
doesn't this kind of look
like a wedding aisle？
translations.ああ、そんな感じもするな？: Yeah, it kind of does, huh？
translations.へへ▼\n腕、組んで通っちゃお？:
Hehe▼
Want to link arms and walk down it？
translations.う～ん！\nいいね、やっぱり！\nバスの後は特に！:
Mmm!
It really is nice here!
Especially after that bus ride!
translations.もう忘れろ。\n正面の山って、大涌谷か？\n煙が見えるぞ？:
Forget about the bus already.
Is that mountain ahead Owakudani？
You can see the smoke.
translations.太陽の加減で、\n眩しくて目がちかちかする……。:
With how the sun's hitting it,
the glare is making me see spots...
translations.おお……\nそうだ、写真、撮るか？:
Whoa...
Oh right, wanna take a picture？
translations.さて、\nじゃあ、通りますか？:
Well then,
shall we walk on through？
translations.ハネムーンなんだから、\nいいでしょ？ ア・ナ・タ▼ \nわっ、照れる……。:
It's our honeymoon, so why not？
Right, d-a-r-l-i-n-g▼
Whoa, that's embarrassing...
translations.へぇ……\n美術館っていうよりさ、\n大豪邸って感じがするね？:
Huh...
More than an art museum, it feels
like a huge mansion, doesn't it？
translations.わっ、細かっ！\nモザイク？\n絵じゃないんだよね？:
Whoa, it's so intricate!
A mosaic？
That's not painted, right？
translations.ほぅ……古代ローマですか？\nよく見ると、色んな花が……。\nきっと、お高いんで:
Ohh... Ancient Rome, you say？
Look closely, there're all kinds of
flowers... Must be quite pricey, hm？
translations.『点彩花文蓋付ゴブレット』。\nこれ、すごいね……。:
'Lidded Goblet with Dotted
Floral Pattern.'
This is amazing...
translations.ヨーロッパ貴族の\n持ち物だったらしいぞ？:
Says here it belonged to
European nobility.
translations.リンコが怪盗だったら、\nこれをいただくことにするよ。:
If I were a phantom thief,
this is what I'd steal.
translations.あっ、ほら、ガラスのもの、\nいっぱい売ってるよ？\n見てこう？:
Oh, look, they sell all kinds
of glass stuff here!
Wanna take a look？
translations.いいけど、\nぶつかって落とすなよ？:
Sure, just don't bump into
anything and knock it over, okay？
translations.へぇ……\nミルフィオリもあるよ？:
Huh...
They have millefiori here too!
translations.フュージング？\nへぇ、体験できるんだって。:
Glass fusing？
Huh, it says you can try it out.
translations.へぇ、ガラスを組み合わせて、\n溶かし合わせるのか……。\nやってみるか？:
Huh, so you arrange glass pieces
and fuse them together...
Wanna give it a try？
translations.う～ん、\n出来た、けど……\n後は、焼きあがり次第か。:
Hmm,
that's done, I guess...
Now it all depends on how it fires.
translations.レストランで、休憩するか？:
Wanna take a break
at the restaurant？
translations.お、気がきくね？\nいい旦那サマになれるよ？\nヘヘッ。:
Oh, how thoughtful of you!
You'll make a great husband!
Hehe.
translations.『カフェテラッツァ』か……。\nイタリアのカフェの感じだよな？:
'Caffe Terrazza,' huh...
Feels just like an Italian
cafe, doesn't it？
translations.歌、歌ってる人さ、\nこっち来るかな……\n歌わされちゃうかもよ？:
Do you think the singer
will come over here...？
They might make us sing.
translations.わっ、見てこれ？\nフルーツいっぱい！:
Whoa, look at this!
It's full of fruit!
translations.う～ん、甘い匂い……\nちょっとさ、アレだね？\nハネムーンな感じ。 ヘヘ▼:
Mmm, smells so sweet...
Kind of feels like we're on
a honeymoon, huh？ Hehe▼
translations.どうもです。\nさて……どうなった？:
Thanks.
Now then... how'd it turn out？
translations.う～ん……抽象？\nリンコの顔のつもりだったけど、\nアンタの顔ってことにする。:
Hmm... abstract art？
It was supposed to be my
face, so I'll say it's yours.
translations.まだ時間あるけど、\nもう少し、見て回るか？:
We've still got time.
Want to look around a
little more？
translations.いいね。\nあっち行ってみよう？\nほら、庭園の奥の方。:
Sounds good.
Let's head over that way.
Look, deeper in the garden.
translations.わっ、\nこれなに、ガラスの噴水？\nフォンターナだって！:
Whoa, what's this,
a glass fountain？
It says 'Fontana'!
translations.さすがに、\nもう数じゃ驚かないけどね……\nキラッキラだねぇ……。:
The numbers alone don't
surprise me anymore, but...
it's so sparkly...
translations.ん？\nほら、あっち、鐘があるよ？:
Hm？
Look, there's a bell
over there.
translations.あ、じゃあ、あれ？\n『あいじょう岬』みたいな感じ？:
Oh, so is it like...
'Cape Aijo' or something？
translations.でもさ、このカラーリングだよ？\n両端から二人で引っ張って\n鳴らすみたいだし。:
Yeah, but look at the colors.
And it looks like two people
pull both ends to ring it.
translations.本当だ。\n……誓っとくか？:
You're right.
...Should we make a vow？
translations.やっぱ、言わない。\n秘密にしとく……。:
Actually, I'm not telling.
I'll keep it a secret...
translations.（じゃあ、●は\n▲小早川＊▲と……）:
(Then ● will make a vow
with ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.きっとさ、\n同じことだよね……。\nだって、リンコ達、\nハネムーンだもんね？:
I bet we vowed the
same thing...
Since we're on our
honeymoon, right？
translations.ガラスの噴水！\nそうそう、この先にさ\nあるよね？:
The glass fountain!
Oh right, it's just up ahead
past this, isn't it？
translations.『誓いの鐘』だろ？\n今日はどうする？:
'The Bell of Vows,' right？
What do you want to do
today？
translations.う～ん……うん。\n鳴らそう。\nハネムーンとしてのケジメだよ。:
Hmm... yeah.
Let's ring it. We have to do
our honeymoon properly.
translations.誓う事、決まった？:
Have you decided on
your vow？
translations.（よし、じゃあ、\n●は▲小早川＊▲と……）:
(Alright, ● will make
a vow with ▲小早川＊▲...)
translations.へへ▼\n同じ誓い、だよね？:
Hehe▼
We made the same vow,
right？
translations.はぁ～……\n『箱根ガラスの森美術館』か。:
Phew...
So that was the Hakone
Venetian Glass Museum.
translations.そっか。\nいいとこだもんな？:
Yeah.
It's a really nice place,
isn't it？
translations.うん、また来たい。\nあ、バス来た？:
Yeah, I want to come again.
Oh, is that our bus？
translations.そうみたいだ。\n行くぞ？:
Looks like it.
Ready to go？
translations.そうじゃなくてさ、\nさっきの、秘密の誓い。\n知りたいんだけど。:
No, not that.
The secret vow from earlier.
I want to know what it was.
translations.ああ……あれ、な？\nじゃあ、▲小早川＊▲も\n言うか。:
Oh... that, huh？
Then ▲小早川＊▲ will tell you
if you tell me yours.
translations.え？\nえぇと。リンコのは……\nほら、だいたいわかるじゃん？:
Huh？ Um, mine is...
Come on, you can pretty much
guess, can't you？
translations.（▲小早川＊▲は、\n何を誓ったんだろう……？）:
(What kind of vow did
▲小早川＊▲ make...？)
translations.次は、終点。桃源台、\n桃源台でございます。\n箱根ロープウェイ、海……。:
Next is the final stop,
Togendai, Togendai.
For the Hakone Ropeway,
the pirate...
translations.ねぇねぇ、\nこれさ、芦ノ湖だよね！:
Hey, look,
this is Lake Ashi, right!
translations.ちょっとさ、\nそばまでいってみる？:
Want to go a little closer
and take a look？
translations.え？ べつに？\nちょっと、忘れてたから……\nハネムーンだよね……。:
Huh？ Nothing.
I just kind of forgot...
It's our honeymoon, right...
translations.（改めて言われると、\n●もなんだか緊張する……）:
(Hearing it put like that
makes ● kind of
nervous too...)
translations.ほら、見えて来たぞ。\n『箱根レイクホテル』！:
Look, it's coming into view.
The 'Hakone Lake Hotel'!
translations.へぇ……\nなんかさ、\nリゾートって感じだね。:
Huh...
It really feels like
a resort, doesn't it.
translations.そっか……リンコ、温泉旅館\nみたいなの想像してたからさ、\nちょっと、緊張って:
I see... I was picturing
something more like a hot
spring inn, so I'm a little
nervous, I guess...
translations.旦那サマに\nくっついてよっと……。:
I'll just stick close
to my dear husband...
translations.旦那サマと一緒だから、\n怖くないもん▼\nとか言っちゃって、へへ▼:
I'm not scared as long as
I'm with my dear husband▼
...Or something like that,
hehe▼
translations.見て、あれ……\nシャンデリアがある……。:
Look at that...
They have a chandelier...
translations.本当だ。\nここもヨーロッパ風みたいだな？:
You're right.
Looks like this place has
a European style too, huh？
translations.うん……\nリンコがアルカードだったらさ、\nあのシャンデリアに乗るね。:
Yeah...
If I were Alucard, I'd totally
ride on that chandelier.
translations.ドラキュラかよ。\n……乗るなよ？\nちょっと、\nチェックインしてくる。:
What are you, Dracula？
...Don't climb on it, okay？
I'll go check us in
real quick.
translations.あのさ、\nハネムーンじゃん？\n名前、一緒にしとく？:
Um, since this is
our honeymoon and all...
Should we put down
the same last name？
translations.お待たせ。\nちゃんと書いたぞ、\n“▲苗字▲ 凛子”って。:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
I wrote it down properly:
'▲苗字▲ Rinko'.
translations.お待たせいたしました。\nそれでは、館内施設の\nご説明をさせていただきます。:
Thank you for waiting.
Allow me to explain
the hotel's facilities.
translations.奥様も、どうぞこちらへ。:
Your wife is welcome to
step right this way, too.
translations.へへ……奥サマだってさ。\n見えるんだ？ へへ▼:
Hehe... They called me
your wife.
Guess I look the part？ Hehe▼
translations.（こっちも\nちょっと照れるな……）:
(That makes me a little
bashful too...)
translations.そうそう、これこれ、\n乗れそうなシャンデリア！:
Oh right, this is it!
The chandelier that looks
like you could ride on it!
translations.乗るなよ？\nじゃあ、\nチェックインして来る。:
Don't climb on it, okay？
Alright, I'm gonna go
check us in.
translations.わかってるよね？\nほら、名前のこと……。:
You remember, right？
You know, about the name...
translations.お待たせ。\nちゃんと書いたぞ？\n“▲苗字▲ 凛子”。:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
I wrote it down properly, see？
'▲苗字▲ Rinko'.
translations.うぅ……\nやっぱ、ちょっと\nこそばゆい感じする。:
Ugh...
It really does feel a little
embarrassing, though.
translations.あ、はい。\nじゃあ、主人と一緒に。:
Oh, yes.
I'll join my husband, then.
translations.主人だって。\nへへ……もう、なに？\nなにサマだっつーの！:
I called you 'my husband.'
Hehe... Seriously, what？
Who do you think you are!
translations.ハァ～～……\nなんかちょっと、\nホッとした……。:
Phew...
That's actually kind of
a relief...
translations.やっぱさ、\nあんまりハネムーンっぽくても、\n息が詰まるじゃん？:
I mean, if it's too much
like a honeymoon, it's kind
of stifling, right？
translations.そりゃそうじゃん？\nだってさ、大きなベッドに\n花びらとか飾られたら、もう――:
Of course it is.
If there was a big bed with
flower petals all over it—
translations.あっ！\n窓の外！\n山が近くに見える～！:
Oh!
Look outside!
The mountains look so close!
translations.まあまあ、ここはひとつ、\n新妻のリンコが\nいれてしんぜよう。:
Now, now. Allow your new
wife Rinko to make it
for you.
translations.なんかさ、いいよね、\nこういうの。\n昭和の夫婦みたいなの。:
This is kind of nice,
you know？ Like an old-school
married couple.
translations.縁側とかもあってさ、\n旦那さんは新聞とか読みながら、\n“お～い、お茶！”とか:
With a porch and all, where
the husband reads the paper
and goes, "Hey, tea!"
translations.……あれ？\nなんだろう、なんかムカつく。:
...Huh？
I don't know why, but that
actually ticks me off.
translations.まだ、食事まで時間あるし、\n風呂、行っとくか？:
We still have time before
dinner. Wanna take a bath？
translations.あ、いいじゃん！\nお風呂上がりにご飯てさ、\n贅沢な感じするよね？:
Oh, good idea!
Having dinner after a bath
feels so luxurious, right？
translations.男湯が『天』で、\n女湯が『空』か……そうだ、\n露天風呂もあるんだっけ？:
Men's is "Heaven," women's
is "Sky"... Oh, isn't there
an outdoor bath, too？
translations.困ったな……別々か……\nほら、新婚さんってことだと、\nやっぱり、さ？:
Too bad they're separate...
Since we're supposed to be
newlyweds and all, you know？
translations.だよな、うん……。\nじゃあ、ロビーで待ち合わせな？:
Yeah, fair enough...
Let's meet up in the lobby？
translations.▲小早川＊▲!?\nなんだ、どうした～？:
▲小早川＊▲!？
What is it？ What's up？
translations.ヘヘ、\nこっち誰もいないからさ、\nちょっと言ってみた。:
Hehe, nobody else is over
here, so I just wanted to
try saying it.
translations.こっちには\n居るかもしれないだろ……。:
There might be people
on my side, you know...
translations.まあまあ！\nねぇ、そっちにもある？\n大きなマユみたいなの。:
Never mind that!
Hey, is there a big cocoon
thing on your side, too？
translations.あ、サウナだったよ？\nリンコ、ちょっと入ってみる。:
Oh, it's a sauna.
Rinko's gonna go try it out.
translations.へぇ！\n●も入ってみるかな？:
Oh yeah？
Maybe ● will try
it out, too.
translations.あのさ、いっこ質問。\nサウナに入る時って、\nタオルとか巻いた方がいいの？:
Hey, quick question.
Should I wrap a towel around
myself in the sauna？
translations.タオル？\nいや、いいんじゃないか？:
A towel？
No, I think you're fine
without one.
translations.そっか。\nじゃあ、いいか、裸で。:
Got it.
I'll just go in naked, then.
translations.一緒に入れないじゃん？\nだから、そのふりだけ。:
We can't bathe together,
so let's just pretend.
translations.じゃあ、リンコが背中、\n流してあげる▼:
Then Rinko will wash
your back for you▼
translations.サンキュー！\nじゃあ、終わったら●が――:
Thanks!
Then when you're done,
● will—
translations.いや、\nいいなぁと思って。:
Nothing, I just
thought you looked great.
translations.ヘヘッ▼\nじゃあ、よし。\n行きましょ、アナタ▼:
Hehe▼
All right, then.
Let's go, dear▼
translations.あ、ほら、\nリラクゼーションルーム\nだってさ？:
Oh, look.
It says there's a
relaxation room.
translations.へぇ……\nあ、じゃあアレ、あるかも！:
Huh...
Oh, then maybe they have
one of those!
translations.はぁ～～極楽極楽……\nあ、そこそこ、\n効く～～。:
Ahhh~ Pure bliss...
Oh, right there,
that hits the spot~.
translations.ハマってたな、\nマッサージチェア？:
You really got into that
massage chair, huh？
translations.サイコー……リンコが\n新居をかまえるとしたらさ、\nなには無くとも、まず買うね:
It was the best... When I
get a place of my own, that's
the first thing I'm buying.
translations.そんなにか……。\nなぁ、\nお土産コーナー覗いてくだろ？:
That much, huh...
Hey, wanna check out the
gift shop on the way？
translations.寄木細工に温泉の素……\n箱根名物か。\n色々あるんだな……。:
Parquetry and bath salts...
Hakone specialties, huh.
They've got all sorts of stuff...
translations.リンコ？\nご当地ポテチとか、\nそういうの。:
Me？
Local potato chips,
stuff like that.
translations.そんなに腹減ってるなら、\n食事に行くか？:
If you're that hungry,
should we go get dinner？
translations.違っ……\n一応、探してただけじゃん？:
That's not...
I was just looking
around, okay？
translations.やっぱ、\n行っとこうかな……。:
Actually, maybe we
should go eat...
translations.ねぇねぇ、\nなんか、あれだね？\nちょっと、大人な感じ？:
Hey, look at this place.
Isn't it kind of...
a little grown-up？
translations.そ、そうだな……。\nよし、行ってみよう。:
Y-Yeah, it is...
All right, let's go in.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、ウエイターが来る\n度に緊張してるな……。:
▲小早川＊▲, you tense up
every time the waiter
comes over...
translations.だってさ、なんか、\nバレてる気がしてさ……\nリンコ達が高校生だって。:
Well, I just feel like
they can tell... that we're
high schoolers.
translations.ウソ？\nやっぱ、そうなの……？:
No way.
You really think so...？
translations.そう言えば、なんだか\n周りの人達もリンコ達を\n怪しんでるような……。:
Now that you mention it,
it feels like the people around
us are suspicious, too...
translations.気のせいだろ？\nほら、食べよう？:
It's just your imagination.
Come on, let's eat.
translations.うぅ……ここはやっぱ、\n大人な感じで……。:
Ugh... I better act
more grown-up here...
translations.まあ、これすごく美味しいわ！\nアナタも食べてみて？\nア～ン▼:
Oh my, this is delicious!
Why don't you try some, dear？
Say ahh~▼
translations.ハァ～\nやっぱり日本人は畳だね？\n落ち着くよ～。:
Ahhh~ Nothing beats tatami
mats, huh？
It's so relaxing~.
translations.緊張してたもんな？:
You were pretty tense
back there, huh？
translations.へへ、\nちょっと、ね？\nお茶のもっかな？:
Hehe,
just a little.
Maybe I'll have some tea.
translations.え？\n●は新聞読んでればいいんだろ？:
Huh？
Isn't ● just supposed
to read the newspaper？
translations.あのさ、新婚旅行くらい、\n奥さんにサービスするもんだよ？\nお～い、お茶！:
Look, you should at least
spoil your wife on your
honeymoon, right？ Hey, tea!
translations.あ……そう言えばさ、湖、\n行くって言ってたじゃん？\nもう遅いかな？:
Oh... Come to think of it,
didn't we say we'd go to the
lake？ Is it too late now？
translations.すぐそこだし、\nせっかくだから行くか？:
It's right nearby.
Wanna go while we're here？
translations.うん。\n湖の方、真っ暗……。:
Yeah. It's pitch black
over by the lake...
translations.こうしてけばさ、平気だもん。\nね、アナタ▼:
I'll be fine as long as
we stay like this.
Right, honey▼
translations.結構、暗いな？\n平気か？:
It's pretty dark out here.
Are you doing okay？
translations.うん、来てみると\nなんか、平気。\n向こう岸の灯りがいい感じ……。:
Yeah, now that we're here,
I'm actually fine. The lights
across the lake look nice...
translations.へへ……やっぱいいね？\nこうしてさ、二人で夜歩くの。\n時間、気にしないでさ？:
Hehe... It really is nice,
walking together at night
without worrying about time.
translations.いつもなら、\n家に帰らなきゃだからな？:
Yeah, since normally we'd
have to head home by now.
translations.家か……ねぇ？\n将来はさ、どんな家がいい？\n子供は何人とかさ？:
Home, huh... Hey, what kind
of house do you want someday？
And how many kids？
translations.そうだな……\n▲小早川＊▲は、\nどうしたい？:
Let's see...
What would you like,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.子供は……ひとりでいいかな？\nその代わり、\nすっごく、可愛がっちゃうの。:
For kids... maybe just one？
That way, I can shower them
with all my love.
translations.いつも、ベタベタくっついてる。\n子供が、もう、やめて～って\n言うくらい。:
I'd be clinging to them
all the time. Enough to make
them beg me to stop.
translations.子供も、大変だな？:
That kid's gonna have it
rough, huh？
translations.まあね？\nでもさ、大きくなった時、\nその頃の事、思い出して――:
Maybe so.
But when they grow up and
look back on those days...
translations.家族っていいなって、\n思って欲しいんだ……。\n自分にはいつも味方がいるって。:
I want them to feel glad
to have a family... and know
we're always on their side.
translations.因みに、イメージの上では、\n男の子。\nお父さん、そっくりの。:
By the way, I'm picturing
a boy.
One who's just like his dad.
translations.山の上だしな……。:
Well, we are up in
the mountains...
translations.でも、こうすれば\n平気だもんね！\nアナタ▼:
Still, I'm fine as long as
I do this!
Right, honey▼
translations.ほら、海賊船が泊まってるよ！:
Look, the pirate ship is
docked over there!
translations.ああ、本当だ、\n明日もあれに乗るんだな……。:
Oh, yeah, it is.
Guess we're riding that
again tomorrow...
translations.船でさ、小さい子たちが\nお父さんに、叱られてたじゃん？\nこら、走り回るな、っ:
Remember those kids on the
boat whose dad scolded them
for running around？
translations.あぁ、いたな？\nお父さん、大変そうだよな……。:
Yeah, I remember.
Being a dad looked pretty
rough...
translations.なんかさ、想像しちゃった。\nアンタもさ、あんな風に\nなるんだろうな、って。:
It got me imagining things.
Like how you'll probably
turn out just like that.
translations.ゼッタイなるね。\nリンコにもさ、ときどき\nそんな感じだもん。:
Definitely.
You already act like that
with me sometimes.
translations.そんなことないだろ？: I don't do that, do I？
translations.なるね。\n怒っててもさ、どっか優しいの。\nだから、安心して怒られちゃう。:
You do. Even when you're
mad, you're still gentle, so
it's easy to let you scold me.
translations.なめられてるって事？:
So you don't take me
seriously, then？
translations.かもね？ でも、\nそういうお父さんのいる家が、\nリンコの理想なんだ……。:
Maybe a little.
Still, a home with a dad like
that is my ideal family...
translations.こういうのは、\nお父さんっぽくなくて\nいいかも……。:
Doing this, though...
it's nice that you don't
feel like a dad...
translations.遊歩道があるな？:
Looks like there's a trail
over here.
translations.はぁ!?\n入るわけないじゃん！\n怖いっつーの！:
Huh!?
No way are we going in there!
It's creepy!
translations.当たり前じゃんっ！\nもう帰ろうよ～っ！:
Well, obviously!
Come on, let's go back!
translations.よしよし。\nじゃあ、\nもうちょっと先まで……。:
There, there.
Just a little bit further,
then...
translations.いやぁ～っ！\nもうやだぁ～～ッ!!:
Nooo!
I've had enough of this!!
translations.そうだ。\n遊歩道があったな？:
Oh, right. There was
a walking path, wasn't there？
translations.じゃあ、そこで独りで\n待ってるか？:
Wanna wait right there
all by yourself, then？
translations.じゃあ、入るしかないな……。:
Then I guess you'll have
to come in with me...
translations.もう～\n意味わかんないっつーの……。:
Ugh...
You make no sense at all...
translations.まあまあ……ん？\nヤバイぞ、これは。\n何かよくないモノが……。:
Now, now... Hm？
Uh-oh, this is bad.
There's something evil here...
translations.ちょ……なにっ？\nなに言ってんのっ!?:
W-Wait... What？
What are you talking about!?
translations.そうそう、これこれ！\n大丈夫、木の枝だって！:
Oh yeah, that's the stuff!
Relax, it's just a tree branch!
translations.バカっ!!\nエロじじいっ！:
You idiot!!
You pervy old man!
translations.痛っ!!\nそうだ、これもだった……。:
Ow!!
Right, forgot about this part...
translations.だって、もう、\n他にすることないじゃん？:
Well, there's nothing else
left to do, right？
translations.えっ？\n他にっていうと……。:
Huh？
What do you mean, nothing else...
translations.リンコの家、ベッドだからさ？\nお布団でゴロゴロしたい！:
I have a bed at home, see？
I wanna roll around on a futon!
translations.あぁ……ああ、そっちか！:
Oh... Ohh, that's what
you meant!
translations.ちょっと……\n他にどっちがあるんだっつーの。:
Excuse me...？
What else could I possibly mean？
translations.あのさ……近いよね？\nお布団……。:
Um... Aren't the futons
kind of close together...？
translations.そう……でもないだろ？\nほら、新婚なわけだし！:
Not... really, right？
Come on, we're newlyweds!
translations.う～ん……\nじゃあ、まあ、\nそういう事で……。:
Hmm...
Well, okay,
if you say so...
translations.さてと……\nもう一度、お風呂入るよね？\nやっぱり。:
Now then...
We're taking another bath,
right？ Obviously.
translations.汗かいたでしょ？\n外、蒸し暑かったし。\nベタベタして気持ち悪いじゃん？:
We worked up a sweat, right？
It was so muggy outside.
Feeling all sticky is gross.
translations.外行ったから、冷えちゃった。\n温泉だしさ、\n温まってから寝たいじゃん？:
I got chilly outside.
And since it's a hot spring,
wanna warm up before bed？
translations.だから、\n他にどっちがあるんだっつーの！:
Seriously, what else
could I possibly mean!?
translations.（フゥ……\nいろいろ誤解するな、\n新婚旅行ごっこは……）:
(Phew...
Playing honeymoon sure leads
to a lot of mix-ups...)
translations.そんじゃ、\nロビーの前でね？:
All right then,
meet you by the lobby？
translations.オッケー。\nあんまり長湯すんなよ？:
Okay.
Don't stay in too long, alright？
translations.またか……\n▲小早川＊▲、どうした～？:
Not again...
▲小早川＊▲, what is it～？
translations.リンコまた、サウナ入る～。: I'm going in the sauna again～.
translations.遅くなるってことか……\nじゃあ、●も入るかな？:
Guess she'll be a while...
Maybe ●'ll go in, too？
translations.あ、遅いよ！\nなにやってたの？:
Oh, you're late!
What took you so long？
translations.あれ？\nなんかさ、顔、赤いよ？\nのぼせた？:
Huh？
Your face is all red.
Did you stay in too long？
translations.（風呂で居眠りは\nゼッタイやめよう……）:
(I am never dozing off
