in the bath again...)
translations.もう、眠い……。\nもう、電気消そう？:
I'm getting sleepy...
Can we turn the lights off？
translations.なんか、ゴメン……\n色いろ、気つかわせちゃってさ？:
Hey, sorry...
I made you be all careful
around me, didn't I？
translations.だってさ、\n今回はほら、ハネムーンじゃん？\nだから……。:
I mean, we're calling this
a honeymoon, right？
So...
translations.旅行に誘われた時から、\n実は、リンコ、ちょっと\n疑っちゃってた。:
Honestly, ever since you
invited me on this trip,
I was a little suspicious.
translations.リンコ達はさ、\nもう少し、このままで\nいいんだよね？:
It's okay if we stay
like this a little longer,
right？
translations.あのさ……\nお休みのチューくらいならさ、\nリンコだってしてあげられるよ？:
You know...
If it's a goodnight kiss,
I can do at least that much.
translations.へへ……\nお布団に入ってさ、\nもう少し、なんか話そう？:
Hehe...
Let's get under the covers
and talk a little longer.
translations.そろそろ寝るか？\n電気、消すぞ？:
Ready to go to sleep？
I'm turning off the lights.
translations.うん、そうする……\nあ、その前に――:
Yeah, okay...
Oh, but before that—
translations.へへ……\nお休みの、アレ、\nいっちゃおっかな？:
Hehe...
How about we do that
goodnight thing first？
translations.▲小早川＊▲は、\nまだ寝てるな……\n当然のように。:
▲小早川＊▲'s still
fast asleep...
No surprise there.
translations.ヘッヘッヘッ……\n気持ち良さそうに寝ちゃって。\n可愛くなくもないよ？:
Hehehe...
Sleeping so peacefully.
Kind of cute, I guess.
translations.じゃあ、\nそろそろいっとこうかな？\nせ～の……。:
Alright,
time to do this.
One, two...
translations.新婚名物くすぐり起こしで\n御座います。\n起きて、アナタ▼:
It's the famous newlywed
tickle wake-up call.
Wake up, honey▼
translations.ちょ……ダメ！\nそのまま、こっち向かない！:
W-Wait, stop!
Stay right there!
Don't look this way!
translations.▲小早川＊▲。\nもういいよな！:
▲小早川＊▲,
you must be done by now!
translations.着替え終わったのか……。:
Oh, you already finished
getting dressed...
translations.ほら、残念そうな顔してないで\n朝ご飯、始まってるってさ、\n行こう？:
Don't look so disappointed.
Breakfast is already open,
so let's go.
translations.よし……\nオッケー、もういいよ？:
All right...
Okay, you can look now.
translations.お待たせ。\n朝ご飯、もう出来てるってさ、\n早く行こう？:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
They say breakfast is ready,
so let's get going.
translations.そっか、\nじゃあ、●も着替えなきゃ！:
Oh, right.
● needs to get
changed, too!
translations.まだ脱ぐなっつーの！\nほら、\nリンコ、後ろ向いてるから！:
Don't just start stripping!
Here, I'll turn around!
translations.ん～……これこれ！\n焼き立てクロワッサンの匂い！:
Mmm... That's the stuff!
The smell of freshly baked
croissants!
translations.お、いっぱい取ったね？\nよしよし♪\nわかってるね？:
Oh, you got a lot, huh？
Good, good♪
You know the drill.
translations.いいじゃん、どうせそっちから\nもらうんだし。\nへへっ！:
Who cares？ I'm just gonna
take some of yours anyway.
Heheh!
translations.はぁ～～、いい眺め！\nテラスで食事ってさ、なんか、\nハネムーンって感じする。:
Ahhh, what a nice view!
Eating out on a terrace really
feels like a honeymoon.
translations.でしょ？ じゃあ、ここはひとつ\nリンコが\nラブラブしてしんぜよう。:
Right？ Well then, allow me
to give you the full
lovey-dovey treatment.
translations.はい、アナタ？\nア～ン▼:
Here you go, darling.
Say ahh▼
translations.よし。\nじゃあ、行くか？:
All right.
Shall we get going, then？
translations.また来れるといいね……\nあ、そうだ。\n写真撮ってく？:
I hope we can come back...
Oh, I know.
Want to take a photo first？
translations.お待たせ！\nチケット買って来たぞ。:
Sorry for the wait!
I got the tickets.
translations.うん。\n熱海のより、ずいぶん大きいね？:
Yeah.
It's way bigger than the one
in Atami, isn't it？
translations.駅もたくさんあるし、\n規模が違うからな？:
It has lots of stations, too.
It's on a whole other scale.
translations.なるほどね……\nなんかさ、リンコ、\nアドレナリン出て来た……。:
Makes sense...
Man, I can feel my
adrenaline pumping...
translations.……暴れんなよ？:
...Don't go jumping around
in there, okay？
translations.暴れないっつーの。\n小学生じゃあるまいし。:
I'm not gonna jump around.
What am I, a grade-schooler？
translations.高っ！\n見てあれ、地面っ！\n煙出てるしっ!?:
We're so high up!
Look at the ground!
There's smoke coming out!?
translations.これはもう、あれだね？\n戦闘員が出て来て、\n派手に爆破だよね？ ね？:
This is totally that, right？
Where the henchmen show up
with big explosions! Right？
translations.ああ、戦隊モノの\n格闘シーンな？:
Yeah, like a fight scene
in a superhero show, right？
translations.ひゃ～……\nあっ！\nちょっと、ほらっ、富士山っ！:
Whaaa...
Oh!
Hey, look! It's Mt. Fuji!
translations.デカッ、富士山デカッ！: It's huge! Mt. Fuji is huge!
translations.捕まえた……。\n危ないから、暴れんなよ？:
Gotcha...
It's dangerous, so don't
jump around, okay？
translations.ねっ？\nこれは出て来るよね？\n戦闘員！:
See？
This is totally where the
henchmen show up, right？
translations.わかったから、暴れんなよ？:
I get it, just don't start
jumping around, okay？
translations.……やっぱ、\n暴れよっかなぁ～♪:
...Actually, maybe I will
move around a bit~♪
translations.じゃあ、捕まえてて▼\nへへ。:
Then hold on tight to me▼
Hehe.
translations.あっちこっちから煙……\nはぁ～……\n火山だもんね……。:
There's smoke everywhere...
Whoa...
It really is a volcano...
translations.硫黄か？\nたしかにな……。:
Sulfur, huh？
Yeah, it really is...
translations.ん？ あれなに？\n木の間から見えてるヤツ。\n小さいロープウェイみたいなの。:
Hm？ What's that？
There, between the trees.
Like a tiny ropeway.
translations.ああ、ホントだ。\nなんか運んでるのかな？:
Oh, you're right.
Wonder if it's carrying
something？
translations.いいなぁ、\nリンコもあれに乗せて\nくんないかな？:
Must be nice.
Think they'd let me ride
in that thing too？
translations.ほら、\nもう少しだから、がんばれ！:
Come on, we're almost there.
Hang in there!
translations.ねぇ、あっちこっち\n黄色くなってるじゃん？\nあれ、温泉の素になる？:
Hey, see how it's yellow all
over？ Do they make instant
hot spring mix out of that？
translations.あれは、硫黄だろ？\n温泉の素にも入ってるかもな？:
That's sulfur, right？
It might go into the mix,
yeah.
translations.じゃあ、\n温泉の素の素ってワケだ。:
So it's the mix that makes
the hot spring mix.
translations.やっぱここに来ると、\n箱根って感じがするね！\n行くよーっ？:
Coming here really makes it
feel like Hakone!
Come on, let's go!
translations.はい、行こう？\n旦那サマ▼:
Okay, shall we go,
dear husband▼
translations.やっぱ、すごいな？\nこのニオイは……。:
Man, this smell really is
something else...
translations.でもさ、ほらほら！\nこのニオイってさ――:
Yeah, but hey, look!
This smell is kind of—
translations.ハハッ！\n小学生らしいな？\nあ、悪い、なんだっけ？:
Haha! Leave it to grade-
schoolers. Oh, sorry, what
were you saying？
translations.う～ん……。\nやっぱ、無理。:
Hmm...
Yeah, I can't do it.
translations.リンコもさ、今回こそなんとか\nハネムーン気分になろうと\n努力はしたんだよ。:
Look, I really did try to
get into the honeymoon mood
this time, okay？
translations.そう。\nそして今、無理という\n結論に達しました。:
Yes. And I have now reached
the conclusion that it's
impossible.
translations.黒たまご食べよっと♪:
Guess I'll just eat some
black eggs♪
translations.▲小早川＊▲、\n『黒たまご』買ってきたぞ♪:
▲小早川＊▲,
I bought us some black eggs♪
translations.ご苦労ご苦労。\nおっ、黒いねぇ～♪:
Good work, good work.
Ooh, they really are black~♪
translations.しかし、あの小っちゃい\nロープウェイが、\nこいつ用だったとはね？:
Still, to think that tiny
ropeway was just for
hauling these...
translations.なにサマだって話だよね？\nほら、リンコの玉子、殻むいて？:
Talk about getting the royal
treatment, right？ Here, peel
mine for me, will you？
translations.そういうこと。\n誰も、いないしさ？\nへへ……。:
That's right.
Nobody else is here, right？
Hehe...
translations.これでちょっぴり、\nハネムーン気分▼:
Now it feels a little
like a honeymoon▼
translations.ちょっと早いけど、\n海賊船に乗る前に、\nここで昼飯にするか？:
It's a bit early, but want
to grab lunch here before
getting on the pirate ship？
translations.賛成～！\n芦ノ湖見ながら食べよ？:
Sounds good to me!
Let's look out at Lake Ashi
while we eat, okay？
translations.わぁ、\n窓いっぱい芦ノ湖じゃん！:
Whoa,
Lake Ashi fills up the
whole window!
translations.本当だ。\nじゃあ、リンコは……\nよし、カレーだ。:
You're right.
Okay, I'll have...
Alright, curry it is.
translations.まあね。\nん？\nあ、なんか豚肉も美味しそう。:
Well, yeah.
Hm？
Oh, the pork looks good too.
translations.へぇ……\n特別な豚みたいだな？:
Huh...
Looks like it's some kind
of special pork？
translations.よし。\nグッと来たから、こっち。\nカツカレーにしよっと。:
Alright.
That sold me on this one.
I'll get the katsu curry.
translations.へぇ、●もそれに\nすればよかったかな……。:
Oh, maybe ● should've
gotten that too...
translations.またまた。\n素直じゃないんだから▼\nはい、ア～ン♪:
Oh, come on.
Just be honest▼
Here, say ahh♪
translations.さてと、\n今日は何にしようかな～……\n何がいい？:
Now then,
what should I get today...
What do you think？
translations.何がいいって？\nまた、カレーじゃないのか？:
What do I think？
Aren't you getting curry
again？
translations.そうじゃなくて……\nじゃあ、ジンジャーソテーだ。\nいいよね？:
That's not what I meant...
Okay, the ginger saute.
Sound good to you？
translations.はい。\nじゃあ、あとはあげる。:
Here.
You can have the rest.
translations.リンコはアンタがたくさん\n食べるとこ見んのが好きなの。\nはい、ア～ン♪:
I just like watching you
eat a lot.
Here, say ahh♪
translations.おぉ……\n思ったより凝ってるね\nディテール！:
Whoa...
The details are way more
intricate than I expected!
translations.お、やっぱこういうのは、\nあれかな？\n男の子の血が騒ぐかな？:
Oh, is this one of those
things that gets a guy's
blood pumping？
translations.じゃあ、ほらほら！\nはしゃいじゃいな？:
Then come on!
Go ahead and get excited!
translations.いや、あの、\nそう言われると、ちょっと……。:
Well, uh,
when you put me on the spot
like that...
translations.いいの。ここはさ、少年っぽさを\nアピールするとこだよ？\nハネムーンとしては。:
It's fine. For a honeymoon,
this is where you show off
your boyish side, right？
translations.（素直にはしゃげないな……）:
(It's hard to just get
excited on command...)
translations.う～ん……\nやっぱ燃えるね！\n海賊船！:
Mmm...
A pirate ship really does
get you fired up!
translations.ロマンだよな！:
Gotta love the spirit of
adventure!
translations.まあね？\nでもさ、デッキに出たら……\nわかってるね？:
Well, yeah.
Once we're out on the deck,
though...you know the drill,
right？
translations.へへ、\nじゃあ、よろしい。\n行こ？:
Hehe,
very good.
Shall we go？
translations.▲小早川＊▲、危ないから\n走るなよ？:
▲小早川＊▲, it's dangerous,
so don't run, okay？
translations.そんなことよりさ、\n見た？\n色んなとこに海賊がいるの？:
Never mind that,
did you see all the pirates
around the ship？
translations.ロマンだよね！\nいいよね、海賊！:
Gotta love the adventure!
Pirates are so cool!
translations.じゃあさ、\nリンコが船長ね？\n来い、野郎ども！:
Alright then,
I get to be the captain, okay？
Follow me, boys!
translations.そう。\n今はハネムーンに戻った……。:
Yep.
We're back on our
honeymoon now...
translations.熱海のさ、\n初島に行くときも、乗ったよね？:
Remember when we took a boat
to Hatsushima in Atami？
translations.それからかも、\nリンコが船を\n好きになったの……。:
I think that's when
I started liking boats...
translations.そうだ、\n写真、撮って？:
Oh, right.
Take a picture of me？
translations.リンコさ、\n本当のハネムーンでも\n船に乗りたいな……。:
You know, I'd like to
take a boat on our
real honeymoon, too...
translations.（船旅か。\nいいかもな……）:
(A cruise, huh.
That might be nice...)
translations.そうそう！\n船から見えたよね？:
Right, right!
We saw it from the boat,
didn't we？
translations.水の中に立ってるね、\n本当に……。:
It really is standing
right in the water...
translations.ああ、湖から龍神を\n迎えるんだって。:
Yeah, they say it's there to
welcome the dragon god
from the lake.
translations.龍神か。\nなるほど……。\nじゃあ、あれだね？:
A dragon god, huh.
I see...
Then you know what that means？
translations.あの石畳の先まで行って\nＡボタンで出現て感じだね？\nＲＰＧ的には。:
In an RPG, you'd walk to
the end of the stone path and
press A to summon it, right？
translations.はぁ……\nいい眺めだね……\n紅葉の箱根か、きれいだな……。:
Ahhh...
What a nice view...
Hakone in autumn is so pretty.
translations.お、▲小早川＊▲にしては\n珍しい感想だな？:
Oh, it's unusual to hear
you say something like that,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.うん……自分でも不思議。\n前のリンコだったらさ、\n紅葉なんて気にもしなかった:
Yeah... It surprises me, too.
The old me wouldn't have cared
at all about autumn leaves.
translations.秋の空が高いってことも。\n下ばっかり見てたからさ？\n誰かさんの影響かな……へ:
Or how high the fall sky is.
I always looked down. Must be
someone's influence... Hehe.
translations.着いた……あのさ、\nえらい神社とかお寺って、長い\n階段作んなきゃダメなのかね:
We're here... Hey, is there
some rule that big shrines and
temples need long stairs？
translations.まあまあ。\nここは、金運とか縁結びの\n御利益もあるらしいぞ？:
Now, now.
They say this place blesses
you with money and love, too.
translations.九頭龍神社は……\nあっちだ！:
Kuzuryu Shrine is...
over that way!
translations.九頭龍って、\nアタマが９つの龍だよね？:
Kuzuryu means a dragon
with nine heads, right？
translations.１、２、３……\nちゃんと頭が九つあるぞ？:
One, two, three...
Yep, all nine heads are there.
translations.Nine-Headed Dragonって\nワケだ。\nほら、江の島は、五頭龍じ:
A Nine-Headed Dragon, then.
Remember how Enoshima had
a five-headed dragon？
translations.おぉ、そうだったな？: Oh yeah, it did, didn't it？
translations.じゃあやっぱり、天女サマに\nやっつけられて、たのかな？:
So was this one tamed by a
celestial maiden, too？
translations.いや、萬巻上人だって。\n男だろう？:
No, it says Priest Mangan.
That's a guy, right？
translations.じゃあ、ロマンスは無しか。\nちょっと、同情するよ。:
So no romance, then.
I kinda feel bad for it.
translations.コラコラ……\nバチ当たりな事言うな。:
Hey, hey...
Don't say something that'll
get you cursed.
translations.龍神水か……\nこれを飲むとご利益があるの？:
Dragon god water, huh...
Do you get blessed if you
drink this？
translations.リンコは実利主義者だからね？\n階段の長さや頭の数には\n騙されないよ？:
I'm a pragmatist, you know？
Long stairs and extra heads
don't fool me.
translations.リンコ達の縁は、\nもう、ギュッと固結びに\nなってると思うけど……。:
I think the bond between us
is already tied in a nice,
tight knot, though...
translations.もう一回、\n結んどいてください……。\nお金の方は、ガマンしますから。:
Please tie it one more
time anyway...
I'll pass on the money part.
translations.九頭龍神社も行くだろ？:
We're going to Kuzuryu
Shrine too, right？
translations.もちろん。\nキッチリ登らせて\nもらいましたよ、階段？:
Of course.
I climbed every last one
of those stairs, didn't I？
translations.よし、と。\nちゃんと飲んだ？\n龍神水？:
There we go.
Did you drink the
Dragon God water？
translations.えぇ～……\nリンコ達がまた、こうしてここに\n居るってことは……。:
Um...
The fact that the two of us
are back here again means...
translations.ちゃんと、\n聞いてくれたんですよね？\nこの間のお願い。:
You really did grant
our wish from last time,
didn't you？
translations.ありがとうございます。\nまた、宜しくお願いします……。\nいつも、二人で居られ:
Thank you very much.
Please watch over us again...
so we can always be together.
translations.さてと。\nねぇ、この後は？:
All right, then.
Hey, where to after this？
translations.『恩賜箱根公園』かな。\n少し、歩くけどいいか？:
Onshi-Hakone Park, I think.
It's a bit of a walk,
is that okay？
translations.じゃあ、\n腕組んで行くか？:
Want to link arms
on the way, then？
translations.うん。\nじゃあ、がんばれる。\nへへ▼:
Yeah.
Then I can keep going.
Hehe▼
translations.ねぇ、この後さ、\n行くよね？\n『恩賜箱根公園』？:
Hey, we're going to
Onshi-Hakone Park
after this, right？
translations.ハァ～……\n奥さまはさ、ちょっと\nお疲れかなぁ……。:
*Sigh*...
Your wife is feeling
a little tired, you know...
translations.よしよし。\nじゃあ、腕、組んでくか？\n奥さま。:
There, there.
Want to link arms, then,
my dear wife？
translations.風が気持ちいい……\n少し涼しくなった？:
The breeze feels nice...
Has it gotten a bit cooler？
translations.なんでも？\nただ……湖がきれいだなって。:
Nothing, really.
Just... thinking how pretty
the lake is.
translations.▲小早川＊▲らしくない\n発言だな。:
That doesn't sound
like you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ホントだね……。\nハネムーンだからかな……。:
It really doesn't...
Maybe because it's our
honeymoon...
translations.きれいだな……\n紅葉の湖……。:
It's so pretty...
The autumn leaves
by the lake...
translations.なんでかな、紅葉って、\n見てるとこう、ギュッと\n胸が締め付けられる気がする。:
I wonder why... Looking at
autumn leaves makes my
chest tighten up like this.
translations.前はそんな事なかったのに……\nきっと、切ないとか、そういう\n気持ちに敏感にな:
It never used to...
I must've gotten more sensitive
to bittersweet feelings.
translations.寒っ！\nもうちょっと、くっついちゃえ！\nへへ▼:
Brr, it's cold!
I'm gonna snuggle closer!
Hehe▼
translations.へぇ……\n島みたいになってる。\n広いんだ……。:
Oh...
It's shaped like an island.
And it's so big...
translations.そうだな……。\nよし、とりあえず行こう。:
Yeah...
All right, let's head in.
translations.うん……あれ？\n今、この『中央門』だよね？\nて、ことは……。:
Okay... Wait？
We're at the Central Gate
right now, right？ Which means...
translations.やっぱり階段だった～\nあぁ～……。:
I knew it, more stairs...
Ugh...
translations.着いたね。\nまずは……そうそう、\n『湖畔展望館』！:
We're here.
First up... oh, right,
the Lakeside View Hall!
translations.忘れてた……\n階段があったんだ～……。:
I forgot...
There were stairs here...
translations.『湖畔展望館』だって。\nどうしたんだろ、\n豪勢な建物だね……。:
It says Lakeside View Hall.
I wonder what the deal is.
Such a grand building...
translations.ああ。\n離宮の本館をイメージ\nして建てられたらしい。:
Yeah. I hear it was
modeled after the main hall
of the old imperial villa.
translations.あ、ほら！\nこっち来てみ！\nテラスになってる。:
Oh, look!
Come over here!
There's a terrace.
translations.うん……\nなんだかさ、\n映画のシーンみたい。:
Yeah...
It kind of feels like
a scene from a movie.
translations.ハネムーンのラストシーンにも\n丁度いいのかな……。:
Maybe it'd be just right
for the final scene
of a honeymoon...
translations.ああ、\nそろそろこの旅行も\n終わりか……。:
Yeah,
I guess this trip is
almost over...
translations.休憩したらさ、\n展望台、行ってみたい。:
Once we've rested a bit,
I'd like to check out
the observation deck.
translations.着いた、展望館！\nねぇねぇ、またテラスに\n行きたい！:
We're at the View Hall!
Hey, I want to go out
on the terrace again!
translations.リンコはさ、\nここから見る芦ノ湖が、\nいちばん好き……。:
I think the view of
Lake Ashi from right here
is my favorite...
translations.それに、少し、\nセンチメンタルだしね？:
Plus, it feels a little
sentimental, doesn't it？
translations.そうだな。\nもうすぐ、旅行も終わりか……。:
Yeah.
Our trip is almost over...
translations.休憩したらさ、\n展望台、行こ？\nほら、また写真撮らなきゃ。:
Let's go to the observation
deck after we rest, okay？
We need to take a photo.
translations.はぁ～……\nやっぱり広いねぇ……。:
Phew...
This place really is big...
translations.まだ、ずいぶん明るいね……\nあ、富士山。\n少し霞んでるけど、大きい。:
It's still pretty bright...
Oh, Mt. Fuji. It's a bit
hazy, but it's huge.
translations.うぅ～……\n外はやっぱり寒いねっ！:
Brrr...
It really is cold outside!
translations.でも、いいな……\nほら、富士山がくっきり。\nやっぱり、近く見えるね……。:
Still, this is nice...
Look how clear Mt. Fuji is.
It looks so close...
translations.ねぇねぇ……\n鐘を鳴らす時、誓ったじゃん？\nあれ、そろそろ教えてよ。:
Hey... Remember the vow you
made when we rang the bell？
Tell me what it was already.
translations.じゃあ、▲小早川＊▲も\n教えるんだぞ？:
Then you have to tell me
yours too, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.リンコもか……だよね？\nうん、いいよ？\nでも、そっちが先。:
Me too, huh... Fair enough.
Okay, fine.
But you go first.
translations.いつか、▲小早川＊▲と、\n結婚するぞ、って……。:
That someday, I'm going
to marry you, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.け、結婚って……\nなに言ってんの？\nだってさ、高校生だよ？:
M-Marry...？
What are you saying？
We're still in high school!
translations.だから、いつかって事だけど……\nダメか？:
That's why I said someday...
Is that a problem？
translations.違う！\nダメなわけ、ないじゃん……\nバカ。:
No!
Of course it's not...
Idiot.
translations.驚いたの！\nだって、『結婚』なんてさ、\n急に言うんだもん……。:
You just surprised me!
Bringing up marriage out of
the blue like that...
translations.じゃあ、\n▲小早川＊▲は、なんて？:
So,
what did you say, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.リンコは……\n本当のハネムーンするって。\nいつか、アンタとさ？:
Mine was...
to go on a real honeymoon
with you someday.
translations.そうか！\nじゃあ、一緒だな！\n結婚しないと出来ないわけだし！:
Oh! Then ours are the same!
We can't do that without
getting married first!
translations.理屈ではそうだけど、違う！\n『結婚』って、\n言葉に出して言われるのは！:
Technically, yeah, but it's
different! Hearing the word
"marry" said out loud...
translations.もっと、\n心の準備したかったよ、\nアセるじゃん……もうっ！:
I wanted more time to
prepare myself! You caught
me off guard... Geeze!
translations.ダメだよ。\nリンコは深～く傷ついたからね？:
Too late for sorry.
You've deeply wounded me,
you know？
translations.ちゃんと、治して……。:
Now you have to
make it better...
translations.▲小早川＊▲と、ずっと一緒だ！\nって……。:
That I'll stay with you
forever, ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.ん？\nべつに？\nおかしくないよ？:
Hm？
Not really.
It's not weird at all.
translations.リンコだってさ、思ってるもん。\nいつだって、\n自分でも呆れるくらい……。:
I feel the same way, you know.
All the time,
so much it amazes even me...
translations.それは、ほら、\nつまり、その……。:
Well, you know,
I mean, um...
translations.もう少し、具体的っていうか……\nえっと……。:
Mine was a bit more specific,
or rather... Um...
translations.違っ、\nアンタが考えてるような\nアレじゃないからっ！:
No,
it's not what you're
thinking of at all!
translations.もっと、\nロマンチックな事だから……。\nわかれっつーの……。:
It's something way more
romantic than that...
Take a hint, seriously...
translations.▲小早川＊▲と、いつか本当の\n新婚旅行するぞ！\nって……。:
That someday, I'm going on a
real honeymoon with ▲小早川＊▲!
Something like that...
translations.ハァ……\n緊張して損した！:
Sigh...
I got all nervous for nothing!
translations.だってさ、もしハズレたらさ、\nショック受けるよ。 リンコ、\n本気で誓ったんだ:
Well, if we didn't match,
it would've been a shock.
I meant my vow seriously, okay？
translations.そっか……\nじゃあ、\n▲小早川＊▲は、なんて？:
I see...
So, what did you
say, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.……いっしょだよ？\nそんなの、\n決まってるじゃん……バカ。:
...The same thing.
Isn't that
obvious... Dummy.
translations.本当の新婚旅行か……\nまず、『新婚』にならなきゃ、\n行けないよな？:
A real honeymoon, huh...
We'd have to be 'newlyweds'
before we could go, right？
translations.まあ、そりゃ……ね？\n婚、ってくらいだから。:
Well, yeah... obviously.
You can't skip the 'wed' part.
translations.じゃあ、▲小早川＊▲、\n●と、け――:
Then, ▲小早川＊▲,
how about you and ●
get m—
translations.ちょ、ちょっと待った！\nなに言ってんの!?\nバカ！:
H-Hold on a second!
What are you saying!？
Dummy!
translations.ちゃんと大人になって、\n心の準備が出来てから、\nちゃんと、言ってよ……。:
Wait until we're both grown up
and I'm ready for it,
then say it properly...
translations.リンコもさ、今日から、\n心の準備、始めとくから……。:
I'll start getting myself
ready for it too,
starting today...
translations.へへ……\nやっぱり、まだ暑いね？\nくっつくとさ？:
Hehe...
It really is still warm out, huh？
Especially when we're this close.
translations.なんかさ、\n寒くなくなっちゃった。\nへへ……。:
Somehow,
I'm not cold anymore.
Hehe...
translations.よし、日が沈みきる前に\n写真撮ろう？:
All right, let's take a picture
before the sun goes all the way down.
translations.撮れた？\nリンコに見せてみ？:
Did you get it？
Let me see.
translations.これさ……\nほら、江の島のやつと、\n似てる……。:
Look at this...
It's just like the one
from Enoshima...
translations.不思議な感じ……\n大事に取っとこうね？\n宝物だもん……。:
It feels kind of magical...
Let's keep it safe, okay？
It's a treasure...
translations.旅行の最後に\nいい思い出が出来たな……。:
We made a great memory
to wrap up our trip...
translations.おっ、今日も富士山、\nよく見える！:
Oh, we've got a great view
of Mt. Fuji today, too!
translations.ハァ～……\nやっと涼しくなってきた。\n気持ちいい……。:
Phew...
It's finally cooling down.
Feels nice...
translations.お、いい感じ。\n▲小早川＊▲、写真撮るぞ？:
Oh, looking good.
▲小早川＊▲, let's take a picture.
translations.うぅ、寒っ……\n外はやっぱ寒いよ。:
Brr, it's cold...
It really is chilly outside.
translations.でも、富士山がくっきり。\nシルエットになってる……\nもう少しで日が沈むね……:
Still, Mt. Fuji looks so clear.
It's a silhouette now...
The sun's almost down...
translations.よし、暗くなる前に\n写真撮るぞ？:
All right, let's take a picture
before it gets dark.
translations.どんな感じ？\nこの間みたいに撮れた？\nリンコに見せてみ？:
How did it turn out？
Did it come out like last time？
Let me see.
translations.すごい……\nまた増えちゃった。\n宝物……。:
Wow...
That's one more
treasure for me...
translations.ああ、\n今度のもいいな？:
Yeah,
this one turned out
great too, huh？
translations.うん。\nじゃあさ……\n今度もそろそろ、いっとく？:
Yeah.
So... should we go ahead
and do it this time, too？
translations.もちろん。\n恒例の誓いの告白です。\n……はい、どうぞ？:
Of course.
It's our customary vow.
...Okay, go ahead？
translations.リンコのは同じだよ？:
Mine's the same as before,
you know？
translations.きっと二人で、\n本当の新婚旅行します、って。\nへへ……。:
That the two of us will go
on a real honeymoon someday.
Hehe...
translations.（う～ん……さすがに、\nこれは言い辛いなぁ……）:
(Ugh... That's a little
hard to say out loud...)
translations.ちょっと……\nなんで目そらすかな？\nもしかして……。:
Hey...
Why are you looking away？
Don't tell me...
translations.ハハ～ン？\nリンコの目を見て\n言えない系の事なんだ……。:
Aha？
So it's something you can't
look me in the eye and say...
translations.でも、\n可哀そうだから、\nチューくらいしてあげよっかな▼:
Still, I feel kind of bad,
so maybe I'll at least
give you a kiss▼
translations.もちろん、一緒だよ。\n▲小早川＊▲と、いつか本当の\n新婚旅行するぞ！ って。:
Mine's the same, of course.
Someday, I'm going on a real
honeymoon with ▲小早川＊▲!
translations.なんかさ……\n今、胸の奥が、\nギュッてなったよ……。:
You know...
I just felt my chest
tighten up a little...
translations.こういう時はさ、\nキスすると、治るんだよ？\n知ってるよね？:
When that happens,
a kiss makes it all better.
You know that, right？
translations.これが、\n今のリンコ達の、\n精いっぱいのハネムーンだよね？:
This is the closest thing
to a honeymoon we can
have right now, isn't it？
translations.大丈夫。\nでも、足が棒……。:
I'm fine.
My legs feel like lead, though...
translations.今日は、よく歩いたからな？:
We did a lot of
walking today, huh？
translations.うん……\nなんかさ、悪くないね？\nこういうのも。:
Yeah...
Somehow, even this
isn't so bad, huh？
translations.今の疲れた感じとかさ、\n明日には、もう、全部思い出に\nなっちゃうんだもんね…:
Even feeling tired like this...
By tomorrow, it'll all just
be a memory...
translations.そう考えるとさ、\n大切にしなきゃって思うよ。:
When I think about it that way,
I want to cherish every bit of it.
translations.お土産は、こんなもんか？\n▲小早川＊▲は……まだか。:
That should do it for souvenirs.
Is ▲小早川＊▲... still not done？
translations.遅いぞ、▲小早川＊▲？:
What took you so long,
▲小早川＊▲？
translations.ゴメン。弟のお土産選ぶのに\n時間掛かっちゃって。\nやっぱさ、電車だよね？:
Sorry. It took me a while to pick
a souvenir for my little brother.
Can't go wrong with a train, right？
translations.ああ、いいかもな？\n自分には、なに買った？:
Yeah, that sounds good.
What'd you buy for yourself？
translations.箱根だしね？\nへへ、お気に入り▼\nにゃぁ～♪:
Since we're in Hakone, right？
Hehe, I love it▼
Meow♪
translations.よかったな？\nそろそろ行くけど、\nもういいな？:
Good for you.
We should get going soon.
Are you all set？
translations.ちょっと待って。\nえぇと……あ、あとアレだ！\nチョンマゲと、刀。:
Wait a sec.
Um... oh, and those too!
A topknot and a sword.
translations.鬼怒川でも\nそんなの買ってたろ……。\n無駄遣いすんなって。:
You bought stuff like that
in Kinugawa too...
Don't waste your money.
translations.それはそれ！\nああいうのは、買わないと\n帰ってから後悔すんの！:
That was different!
If I don't buy stuff like that,
I'll regret it when I get home!
translations.間に合った。\n▲小早川＊▲、急げ！:
We're still in time.
Hurry, ▲小早川＊▲!
translations.おぉっ!?\nなんか速そう！\nこれもロマンスカー？:
Whoa!?
It looks so fast!
Is this a Romancecar too？
translations.ＶＳＥっていう車両。: It's a model called the VSE.
translations.カッコいいね……。\nその辺で、おもちゃ売ってる？:
It looks cool...
Do they sell toy ones
around here？
translations.ハァ～\nよかった、間に合って。:
Phew...
Thank goodness we made it.
translations.あとはもう、\n寝てればいいね？:
Now we can just sleep
the rest of the way, right？
translations.まだ、乗り換えがあるから、\n寝過ごさないようにしないと。:
We still have to transfer,
so we can't oversleep.
translations.リンコはいいんだもんね。\nそういうのはさ、\n旦那サマの役目でしょ？:
I'm fine to sleep, though.
Stuff like that is the
husband's job, right？
translations.もうっ、\nもうちょっとゆっくり！\n迷子になるじゃん！:
Jeez, slow down a little!
I'm gonna get lost!
translations.成田離婚ってしってる？:
Ever heard of a
honeymoon divorce？
translations.わかったから、急げ！:
Alright, I get it,
just hurry!
translations.なんかさ、旦那サマっていうより\nパパさんっぽいよ？\nお疲れサマ▼:
You seem more like a dad
than a husband, you know？
Thanks for everything▼
translations.ねぇ、さすがに今回は、\n記録更新じゃないよね？\n一緒にいる時間。:
Hey, I guess we didn't
break our record this time？
For time spent together.
translations.だよね……。\nまあ、いいや、それは。\nナンバー１よりオンリー１だね？:
I figured... Well, whatever.
It's better to be one of a
kind than number one, right？
translations.二人で旅行に行くとさ、\nいつも、新しいリンコを\n発見するってこと。:
I mean, whenever we go on
a trip together, I always
discover a new side of myself.
translations.今回はどんな発見だ？:
What did you discover
this time？
translations.リンコってさ、意外とカワイイ\n奥サマになりそうだなって。\nでしょ？ 旦那サマ:
That I'd actually make
a pretty cute wife.
Right, hubby▼
translations.なんかさ、\nやっぱり、\n理不尽な感じがするよ。:
You know,
it really just
doesn't feel fair.
translations.本当の新婚さんなら、\n今夜も一緒に居られるんだもん。:
If we were really newlyweds,
we'd get to stay together
tonight, too.
translations.へへ、\nまた切なくなっちゃった……。:
Hehe,
now I'm feeling sad again...
translations.うん……\nちょっと治った。\n今日はこれでガマンだね？:
Yeah...
That made it a little better.
Guess this'll have to do
for today, huh？
translations.“これでガマン”か……\nハァ～……旅行のあとは、\nいつも寂しくなるな……。:
"This'll have to do," huh...
*sigh* I always get so lonely
after a trip...
translations.お別れのキス、してないじゃん？\nさっきのはさ、\n別のだったから。:
We didn't have a goodbye kiss,
did we？ The one earlier
was for something else.
translations.また送らせちゃった。\nへへ。:
I made you walk me back again.
Hehe.
translations.じゃあね？\nこれで本当に。\nもう、\n他のキス思いつかないしさ？:
See you later, okay？
For real this time.
I can't think of any other
kinds of kisses, anyway.
translations.旦那、主人……うちの人？\nいやいやいや……。:
Hubby, husband... my man？
No, no, no...
translations.お？\nここって、ハネムーンぽい？:
Oh？
Has a honeymoon vibe, huh？
translations.カップルいるね……\n新婚さんだったりして。:
There's a couple...
Maybe they're newlyweds.
translations.あ、あれは……\n新婚さんってより、旧婚さん？:
Oh, those two look more like
oldlyweds than newlyweds？
translations.あ、紅葉してる。\n秋なんだね……。:
Oh, the leaves are turning.
Guess it's really fall...
translations.説明、聞いた？\n布団は、アンタが敷くんだって。:
Did you hear that？
You gotta lay out the futons.
translations.お、浴衣じゃん♪\nそっか、温泉だもんね？:
Oh, yukata♪
Right, it is a hot spring, huh？
translations.リンコ、\nお茶が飲みたいなぁ……。\nねぇねぇ？:
I could really go for
some tea right now...
Hey, how about it？
translations.ヒト多すぎ……\nなんで、ぶつかんないんだろ？:
Way too many people...
How is no one colliding？
translations.こういうとこってさ、\n早足で歩くルール？:
Is walking fast a rule
in places like this？
translations.『ロマンス』ってとこが、\nグッと来るよね？:
Having "Romance" in the name
is a nice touch, huh？
translations.一番前にさ、\n運転する人居ないんだけど……。:
Hey, there's nobody driving
up at the very front...
translations.電車が坂に停まってる……。:
The train is stopped
right on a slope...
translations.ああ……\n印籠もかっとけば\n良かったかな……。:
Man...
Maybe I should've bought
an inro, too...
translations.あ、また駅とばした！\n速っ……。:
Oh, we skipped another station!
So fast...
translations.アジサイがいっぱい……。\nわかった、リンコの負けだよ。:
So many hydrangeas...
Okay, fine, I admit defeat.
translations.紅葉の箱根か……\n風情だねぇ……。:
Autumn leaves in Hakone...
Very atmospheric...
translations.ガラスの木……。\nＬＥＤじゃないよね？:
A glass tree...
Those aren't LEDs, right？
translations.おとぎの国だね……\nリンコだって、\n嫌いじゃないよ？:
It's like a fairy tale...
Hey, even I don't hate
stuff like this, okay？
translations.細かっ！\nなにこれ、どうなってんの……？:
So detailed!
How does this even work...？
translations.そっか、\nヴェネチアなんだ？:
Oh, I get it,
it's Venice, huh？
translations.あのシャンデリアさ、\n階段からジャンプでギリ届く？:
Think you could jump from
the stairs and grab that
chandelier？
translations.ちょっとさ、\n日本じゃないみたいだね……。:
It kinda feels like
we're not in Japan...
translations.テラスで食事すんのかな？\n……セレブ？:
Do people eat on the terrace？
...Are we celebrities？
translations.あっちこっち煙が……\n爆発しないよね？:
There's smoke everywhere...
It won't explode, right？
translations.ねぇねぇ！\nこのにおいってさ……\nやめとこ。ハネムーンだしね？:
Hey, hey!
Doesn't this smell like...
Never mind. It's a honeymoon.
translations.あ、あの鳥居って\nもしかして……。:
Oh, could that torii gate
over there be...
translations.船旅ってさ、憧れるよ……。:
There's something romantic
about traveling by boat...
translations.バリアフリーの神社って\n無いのかな……。:
Don't they have any
step-free shrines...？
translations.なるほど、\n由緒正しいんだ……フム。:
I see, it has
a long history... Hmm.
translations.ハァ……\nもたれかかっていい？:
Haah...
Can I lean on you？
translations.ヒッヒッヒッヒッ……\n起きろ～～\n起きるのだ～～。:
Heeheeheehee......
Wake uuuup...
You must wake uuuup...
translations.百物語でしょ。\nアンタこそ、なに寝てんの。:
Telling ghost stories, duh.
What are you doing sleeping？
translations.待て待て……\nロウソクの数、制服……\nどこからツッコミ入れれば……。:
Hold on, wait...
The candles, the uniform...
Where do I even start...？
translations.ディテールはいい。\n修学旅行の定番じゃん？\nまだ、やってないじゃん。:
Forget the details.
It's a school trip classic, right？
And we haven't done it yet.
translations.まあ、そう言われてみれば……。: Well, now that you mention it...
translations.それは、大正時代に建てられたと\nいう、洋館でした。館の主は、\n代々、非業の死:
It was a Western mansion,
built in the Taisho era.
For generations, its owners
all met with grisly deaths--
translations.今は住む者も訪れる者も無く、\nただ、町外れに\n打ち捨てられたまま……。:
Now no one lives there or
even visits. It just sits
abandoned on the edge of town...
translations.館には、地下室へ続く、\n階段がありました。その階段を\n一段、一段と下って行く:
In the mansion, there were
stairs to the basement.
And as you walk down them,
one step at a time...
translations.階段に、猫が、おんねん……。:
On the stairs,
a cat's... there...
translations.よし。\nじゃあ……そうだ。\nあるところに……。:
All right.
Then... let's see.
Once upon a time...
translations.そして、その子は\nゆっくり振り返ると……。:
And when the kid
slowly turned around...
translations.バカッ！\nバカぁーーッ!!\nなにそれ、ズルいッ！:
Idiot!
You idiooot!!
What was that？ That's cheating!
translations.じゃあ、最後のロウソク消すぞ？:
All right, I'm blowing out
the last candle, okay？
translations.（息を吹きかけて\nロウソクの火を消そう）:
(Blow on the candle
to put out the flame.)
translations.ねぇ……\n今、なんか、聴こえなかった？:
Hey...
Did you just hear something？
translations.さあ……\nもしかすると、来たのかもな？\n何かが、あの世から……。:
Who knows...
Maybe something came over？
From the other side...
translations.ヤダ～、\nもうヤダよぉ～!!:
Nooo!
I can't take this anymore!!
translations.▲小早川＊▲、ゴメンゴメン！\n冗談だって。:
▲小早川＊▲, sorry, sorry!
I was just kidding.
translations.このまま、ギュッてしろ。:
Hold me tight,
just like this.
translations.リンコ、\n本当に怖かったんだから……。\nこのまま、朝まで……。:
Rinko was really,
really scared...
Stay like this till morning...
translations.夢か……\nまた、ずいぶん手の込んだ……。:
A dream, huh...
That was pretty elaborate...
translations.（ハハ、\n罪の無い顔で寝てる……）:
(Haha, look at her
sleeping so innocently...)
translations.へーき？\nなんかうなされてたけど。:
You okay？
You were groaning in your sleep.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲は……\nまだみたいだな？）:
(Looks like ▲小早川＊▲...
still isn't out yet？)
translations.ただいま。\n▲小早川＊▲、いるか～？:
I'm back.
▲小早川＊▲, you in here？
translations.なんだ、こっちの風呂には、\n入らないのかと思った。:
Oh, there you are. I thought
you weren't gonna use this bath.
translations.よく聞こえな～い！\nそこ、開ければ？:
I can't hear you!
Why don't you open the door？
translations.（いいのかな……\nでも、\n開けろっていうんだから……）:
(Is it really okay...？
Well, she did tell me
to open it...)
translations.いいよ、\nここにいるリンコは、\n素直なリンコちゃんだもん。:
It's fine.
The Rinko in here is a sweet,
honest little Rinko, after all.
translations.そういうもんなの。\nほら、よく見てみ？\nいつもと違うでしょ？:
That's how it works.
Come on, take a close look.
Different from usual, right？
translations.（よく見ろって……\nどっちみち、\nよく見えないな……）:
(Take a close look, she says...
Either way, I can't really
see much...)
translations.（う～ん、なんだろう？\nそうか、湯気だっ！ \n湯気が邪魔なんだっ！）:
(Hmm, why is that？
Oh, right, the steam!
The steam's in the way!)
translations.ウソ……\nちょっと、なに覗いてんだ！:
No way...
Hey, what are you peeking for!?
translations.……え？\nいや、だって、見ろって――:
...Huh？
No, wait, you told me to look—
translations.先生ー！\nエロ男子が、\nお風呂覗いてまーす！:
Teacher!
Some pervy boy is
peeking in the bath!
translations.ちょっと待って！\n濡れ衣だっ!!:
Hold on a second!
I'm being framed!!
translations.▲小早川＊▲!?\nちょ、おい！\nなにしてんだよ……。:
▲小早川＊▲!?
W-Wait, hey!
What are you doing...？
translations.そっちこそ、なにしてんだ。\n花嫁をほっといて寝ちゃうとか、\n信じらんないよ…:
What are YOU doing？
Falling asleep and leaving your
bride all alone... Unbelievable...
translations.ゴメン……。\nって言うか、え？\nその格好、どうした？:
Sorry...
Wait a second, huh？
What's with that outfit？
translations.着替えた。\nだって、リンコに\n魅力が無いから寝るんだもん。:
I changed.
Since you only fell asleep because
I'm not attractive enough.
translations.いや、それは、\nだって、さっき寝る前に――:
No, that's not it!
Before I went to sleep earlier—
translations.言いわけすんな。\n……それで、どうなの？:
No excuses.
...So, what do you think？
translations.少しは……セクシー？: Is it at least... a little sexy？
translations.えぇと、\nそりゃ、もちろん！:
Uh, well,
of course it is!
translations.信じらんないよ……。\n態度で示してくんなきゃ……。:
I don't buy it...
Not unless you prove it
to me...
translations.（罪の無い顔して……\nどんな夢見てんだろうな）:
(Sleeping so innocently...
Wonder what she's dreaming about.)
translations.（どんな夢みてんだよ……）:
(Just what kind of dream
is she having...？)
translations.なにジッとみてんの。\nまったく……。:
What are you staring at？
Honestly...
translations.ハァ～、汗かいたぁ！\nそろそろ、出るかな！:
Man, I worked up a sweat!
Guess I'll get out soon!
translations.あんまり入ってると、\nのぼせるし――:
If I stay in too long,
I'll get lightheaded—
translations.はぁ～……。\nリンコもう、\nのぼせちゃうっつーの。:
Phew...
I'm already getting
lightheaded in here.
translations.▲小早川＊▲！\nおい、ここ男湯だぞ!?:
▲小早川＊▲!
Hey, this is the men's bath!
translations.知ってるよ？\n待ってたんだもん。:
Yeah, I know.
I was waiting for you.
translations.だって、新婚さんなんだからさ、\n一緒に入るじゃん？\nフツー……。:
Well, we're newlyweds.
Bathing together is normal,
isn't it？
translations.一緒にって……\nなあ、念のため聞くけど、\nタオルの下、水着きてる？:
Together...? Hey, just
checking, are you wearing a
swimsuit under that towel？
translations.そんなの、\n見ればわかるじゃん……。:
You can tell just by
looking, can't you...？
translations.（そりゃ、そうだけど……\nちょっと、よく見えないぞ？）:
(Well, yeah, but...
Wait, I can't really see？)
translations.（あぁっ、湯気がっ！\n湯気をどけなきゃ！）:
(Argh, the steam!
I have to clear the steam!)
translations.（やりたくはない。\nでも、やらなきゃならない\n時もある……吹くか……）:
(I don't want to do this.
But sometimes a guy has no
choice... Guess I'll blow...)
translations.あぁっ、なんだよっ!!\n生きてるのか、この湯気はっ！:
Argh, what the heck!!
Is this steam alive!？
translations.あのさ、\n声、出ちゃってるよ？:
Hey, you know you're
saying that out loud？
translations.え？\nああ、うん……\nいや、こっちのこと！:
Huh？
Oh, yeah...
Never mind, it's nothing!
translations.そんなとこ居ないでさ、\nもっと近くで確かめれば\nいいじゃん……。:
Don't just stand way over
there. Come closer and
see for yourself...
translations.いいに決まってんじゃん、\n新婚さんだもん……。:
Of course I'm sure.
We are newlyweds...
translations.えーと、加法定理……で、\n……よし、解けたぞ！:
Let's see, addition formula...
...All right, I solved it!
translations.▲小早川＊▲？\nいつから？:
▲小早川＊▲？
How long have you been there？
translations.イイモノ見られたから\nべつに気にしてないよ。:
I got to see something nice,
so I don't really mind.
translations.がんばってるカレシの横顔。:
My boyfriend from the side,
working hard.
translations.カッコ良かったよ。\nアンタの、一生懸命な横顔。:
You looked really cool,
all focused like that.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n最近、女子に\nモテモテじゃない？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Aren't you pretty popular
with the girls lately？
translations.きゃー、こんな難問が\n解けるなんてステキー！\nカッコイイー！\n……とか言わ:
Like, 'Whoa, you can solve
such hard problems! Amazing!
You're so cool!'
...They don't tell you that？
translations.そっか。\nカッコイイと思ってるの\nリンコだけか。:
I see.
So I'm the only one who
thinks it's cool, huh.
translations.今、カッコイイとか……。: You just said it was cool...
translations.そんなこと\n言ってないっつーの！\n……バカじゃん。:
I did NOT say anything
like that!
...Stupid.
translations.他の生徒に教えてたじゃん。\nずっと見てたよ。\nほんと、先生っぽかった。:
You were tutoring those other
students. I was watching the
whole time. Like a real teacher.
translations.ははは……数学の授業で\nわからないところがあるって\n言うからさ。:
Hahaha... They just said there
was something from math class
they didn't understand.
translations.それで教えられるって\nすごいよ。:
Being able to teach it
like that is amazing.
translations.ね。せんせ。\nリンコにも今度、やさしく\n数学教えてくれる？▼:
Hey, Teach.
Will you be nice and tutor me
in math sometime too？▼
translations.（先生か……\n悪い気はしないな）:
(Being called Teach, huh...
Doesn't feel half bad.)
translations.（●だけか、実験成功は……\n気持ちいいなー）:
(So only ● pulled off
the experiment, huh...
Man, that feels good.)
translations.あ、▲小早川＊▲。\nいや、実験の片付けをな。:
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲.
Just cleaning up after the lab.
translations.ふうん……\nで、なんで一人でやってんの？:
Hmm...
And why are you doing it alone？
translations.うん。何かいい気分なもんで。\nつい……引き受けちゃってさ。:
Well, I was just in a really
good mood, so I kinda...
volunteered to do it.
translations.ほんと、アンタって……。\n……ま、いいや。\n手伝ってあげるよ。:
Seriously, you're such a...
...Well, whatever.
I'll give you a hand.
translations.えっ、いいって。: Huh？ No, you don't have to.
translations.いいの。\n実験うまくいったのアンタだけ\nなんでしょ。:
It's fine.
You were the only one whose
experiment worked, right？
translations.知ってるよ。\nがんばったじゃん。:
Of course I know.
You worked hard.
translations.（よーし、\nもっとがんばるぞ！）:
(All right,
I'm gonna try even harder!)
translations.（物理の抜き打ちテストで\n満点！\nがんばったからなー）:
(A perfect score on the
physics pop quiz!
All that hard work paid off.)
translations.あのさ、\n無理してない……よね？:
Hey,
you're not pushing yourself
too hard... right？
translations.がんばり過ぎるカレシを見てると\nカノジョとしては心配なわけさ。:
Watching my boyfriend work
too hard makes me worry
as his girlfriend, you know.
translations.アンタが倒れたりしたら\nリンコまで\nどうにかなっちゃうんだからね。:
If you collapsed on me,
I wouldn't know what to do
with myself, you know.
translations.おいおい。大丈夫だよ。\n無理してないから。:
Hey, take it easy. I'm fine.
I'm not pushing myself.
translations.……そっか。\nなら良かった。\nじゃあさ……言っとくけど。:
...Okay.
That's good, then.
Well... I'll just say this.
translations.良かったじゃん。\n何かリンコもうれしい。\n……おめでと▼:
Good for you.
Makes me kinda happy, too.
...Congrats▼
translations.あのさ、リンコにも今度\n数学、教えてよ。:
Hey, teach me math
sometime too, okay？
translations.いいけど、\n簡単な攻略法なんてないぞ。:
Sure, but there aren't any
easy shortcuts, you know.
translations.そうなの……？\nなーんだ。リンコも理数系\n得意になるかと思ったのに。:
Really...？
Aw, man. I thought I'd get
good at math and science too.
translations.……今、\nリンコにはぜったい無理って\n思ったでしょ。:
...You just thought there's
no way I could do it,
didn't you.
translations.表情に出てるから。\n罰として、優しく、ていねいに\n勉強を教えること。:
It's all over your face.
As punishment, you have to
tutor me gently and carefully.
translations.拒否できないからね？\n罰なんだから。\nマンツーマンだからね！:
And you can't say no, got it？
It's a punishment.
One-on-one, okay!
translations.（こんな罰なら歓迎だな！）:
(That's a punishment
I can get behind!)
translations.やったっ！\n先生にほめられたぞ。\n古文の文法は\nがんばったもんな。:
Yes!
The teacher praised me.
All that work on classical
grammar paid off.
translations.ちょっと成績良かったくらいで\nはしゃいじゃって。\nガキかっつーの。:
Getting so excited just 'cause
you did a little well.
What are you, a kid？
translations.それくらいの問題\nリンコだって\n余裕なんですけど？:
Questions like that are
a breeze for me too,
you know？
translations.……つ、つい、嬉しくてさ。:
...I-I couldn't help it,
I was just happy.
translations.そんな凹まなくていいじゃん。\n言いすぎた。\nごめん。:
Don't look so bummed out.
I went too far.
Sorry.
translations.さっきはほら……\nこっち見てる人がいたからさ。\n改めて……がんばったよね。\:
Earlier, you know...
people were looking our way.
For real... you worked hard.
Congratulations.
translations.……って、\nいつまでも\nニヤニヤすんな。:
...Hey,
wipe that grin
off your face already.
translations.（▲小早川＊▲らしい\n言い方だけど\nまたやる気が出てきたぞ）:
(That's such a ▲小早川＊▲
way of putting it,
but now I'm motivated again!)
translations.さっきの朗読\nカッコ良かったよ。:
Your reading in class
earlier was really cool.
translations.はは、いきなり指されてさ、\nあわてたよ。:
Haha, I got called on out of
nowhere, so I panicked a bit.
translations.練習なしで？\nぶっつけ本番……？:
With no practice？
You just winged it...？
translations.ね。\n今度、朗読のコツ\nリンコにも教えてよ。:
Hey.
Teach me the trick to
reading aloud sometime.
translations.コツか……\n感情を込めて、かなあ。\nここでやってみる？:
The trick, huh...
Putting emotion into it, maybe.
Wanna try right here？
translations.ここで？\n感情を込めて、か。\n……やってみてもいいけど。:
Right here？
With emotion, huh.
...I guess I can try.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nすごく……大好き……だよ。\n……どう？:
▲主人公＊▲.
I really... love you... a lot.
...How was that？
translations.う、うん……いいと、思う。\n（今のは……\nごほうび、かな？）:
Y-Yeah... I think... it's good.
(Was that...
a reward for me？)
translations.（小論文の評価、\nかなり良かったな）:
(I got a pretty great grade
on my essay.)
translations.その顔を見ると論文\nうまくいったみたいだね。:
By the look on your face,
your essay went well, huh.
translations.もっと喜んだら!?\nそーだ。\nカノジョが褒めてあげる。:
You could act happier!
Oh, I know.
Your girlfriend'll praise you.
translations.すごいじゃん。完ぺきじゃん。\n良かった良かった。\nリンコも、とーってもうれし:
Amazing. Totally perfect.
Good for you, good for you.
I'm suuuper happy too!
translations.あのさ……。\nわかんないかな！\nどんだけ鈍いんだっつーの。:
Look...
Don't you get it？
How dense can you be？
translations.リンコなりに、がんばって\n褒めてるんじゃん……。:
I'm doing my best to praise you
in my own way here...
translations.ついに課題だった本\n読破したぞ！:
I finally finished reading
that book for class!
translations.あ……それ、\nリンコが断念した本。\nそっか。……やるじゃん。:
Oh... That's the book
I gave up on.
I see. ...Not bad.
translations.●も最初先生に\n課題出されたとき、\n無理だと思ったよ。:
● thought it was impossible
at first too, when the
teacher assigned it.
translations.リンコももう一度\nチャレンジしてみようかな……。:
Maybe I'll give it
another try myself...
translations.そうだよ。\n読破したら感想言い合おう。\nな！:
You should!
Let's talk about it once
you finish it, okay？
translations.こうやってお互いに\n刺激し合うのってイイね。\nちょっと憧れだったからさ……\:
Pushing each other like
this is nice.
I always kind of wanted
that... Hehe.
translations.アンタと一緒だと\nリンコはどんなことも\nがんばれる気がする。\nありがと。:
When I'm with you, I feel
like I can take on
just about anything.
Thanks.
translations.（苦労したけど、\nがんばって読破した甲斐が\nあったな！）:
(It was tough going,
but finishing that book
was totally worth it!)
translations.文系なら\n誰にも負けない気が\nしてきたぞ！:
I feel like I can beat
anyone in the humanities
right about now!
translations.文系なら誰にも負けない、か。\nリンコにもだよね。\nふぅん。:
Beat anyone in the
humanities, huh.
Even me, right？ ...Hmm.
translations.自信を持つのは\n悪いことじゃないよね。:
There's nothing wrong with
having some confidence.
translations.（絶対怒ってる……。\nちょっと調子に\n乗りすぎたかな）:
(She's definitely mad...
Maybe I got a little
too carried away.)
translations.へへっ……びっくりした？\nカレシががんばったんだよ。\n怒るわけないじゃん。:
Hehe... Scared you, huh？
My boyfriend worked hard.
Why would I be mad？
translations.アンタの、そういう\nがんばり屋のトコが……\nリンコはすごく好きだもん。\n次:
How hard you work like
that... is something I
really love about you.
Keep it up▼
translations.（もっとがんばれそうな\n気がしてきた！）:
(Now I feel like I can
push myself even harder!)
translations.またまたー。\nさっきの授業のことだよ。:
Oh, please.
I mean in class just now.
translations.先生に褒められたんでしょ？\n古文の現代語解釈\n完璧だーって。:
The teacher praised you,
right？ Said your classical
lit translation was spot-on.
translations.早っ！\nなぜそれを？:
That was fast!
How do you know that？
translations.へへッ。\nカレシに関する情報網は\nカンペキだからね。:
Hehe.
My intel network on my
boyfriend is airtight.
translations.●に関する情報網か……。:
● have a whole intel
network on me, huh...
translations.一番に褒めてあげたいじゃん。\nほら、カノジョとしてはさ。:
I want to be the first
to praise you.
As your girlfriend, y'know.
translations.（次もまたがんばるか！）:
(I'll give it my all
next time, too!)
translations.自分で言うのも何だけど\nこの絵は自信作かも。:
Not to brag, but I think
this painting turned out
pretty well.
translations.え……？\nため息なんかついて\n●の絵、変……？:
Huh...？
Why the sigh？ Is what
● painted weird...？
translations.感動してんの。\nこの色使いを見ると、\nフォーヴィスムの\n影響受けてるんじゃ:
I'm impressed, actually.
Looking at these colors,
were you influenced
by Fauvism？
translations.アンタは将来きっと\n美術史に名前を刻まれる\n逸材になるね。:
Someday your name is
definitely going down
in art history.
translations.あっ、そうだ。\nサインもらっとこ。:
Oh, right.
I should get your autograph.
translations.へへっ……だよね。\nけど、リンコがこの絵、\n好きなのは本心だよ。:
Hehe... True.
Still, I really do mean it
when I say I like this.
translations.（その評価が一番嬉しいな！）:
(That's the best praise
I could ask for!)
translations.この絵、自分では\nけっこう自信作っていえるかな。:
I think I can safely call
this painting some of
my best work.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n絵、得意だったっけ……？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Were you always good at
painting...？
translations.うーん……得意っていうか\n描くのは好きかな。:
Hmm... I don't know about
good, I just like drawing.
translations.あ、もしかして照れてる？\nへえ、じゃあもっと\nじっくり見ちゃおっと。:
Oh, are you embarrassed？
Heh, then I'm gonna take
a real close look.
translations.そ、そんなに近づかなくても\n……で、どうかな？:
Y-You don't have to get
that close... So, how is it？
translations.専門家じゃないからさ、\nうまいかどうかはわからないよ？:
I'm no expert, so I can't
tell if it's good or not.
translations.けど、リンコは筆のタッチも\n色使いも……全部好き。\nリンコはこの絵が大好き。:
But the brushstrokes, the
colors... I like all of it.
I love this painting.
Do you need anything more？
translations.ここまで来れば\n完成まであとちょっとだ。:
Now that I've gotten this
far, it's almost finished.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nリンコには\n見せてくれないの……？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Aren't you going to
show me...？
translations.まだ仕上げ前だけど……\n見る？:
I still haven't put the
finishing touches on it...
Wanna see？
translations.見たい、見たい。\nへえ……センスいいじゃん。\nこういう絵も描くんだ？:
Yeah, let me see.
Whoa... You've got good taste.
You paint stuff like this too？
translations.これは完成が楽しみだね。\nもちろん最初に\nリンコに見せてくれるよね？:
I can't wait till it's done.
You'll show it to me first,
of course, right？
translations.（楽しみにしてくれてるし\nあともうちょっと\n仕上げまでがんばるぞ！）:
(She's looking forward to it,
so I'll give it one last push
to finish it up!)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nクラスの人たちに\n囲まれてたみたいじゃん？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Looked like your classmates
were crowding around you？
translations.美術の時間に\nイラスト描いたらさ\n欲しいっていうヤツらが\n多くて。:
I drew an illustration in art
class, and a bunch of people
said they wanted it.
translations.……すっごいカッコイイ。\n格ゲーのキャラにいそうだよね。\nいたら絶対に使うね:
...That's super cool.
Looks like a fighting game
character. If it were, I'd
definitely use them!
translations.▲小早川＊▲のイメージで\n描いてたから\nそう言われると嬉しいよ。:
I drew it with you in mind,
▲小早川＊▲, so I'm really glad
to hear you say that.
translations.リンコのイメージ……？\nへへっ、ありがと。\nこのイラストもらっていい？\n大:
With me in mind...？
Heheh, thanks.
Can I have this drawing？
I'll treasure it!
translations.あっ……じゃあ\nもっとちゃんと描き直すよ！:
Oh... Then let me redraw it
properly for you!
translations.これでいいの。\nリンコのために描いてくれた\n世界で一つだけのイラスト。\nそ:
This one's fine.
A one-of-a-kind drawing
you made just for me.
That's more than enough.
translations.やっぱり先生にほめられると\n張り合いが出るよな。:
Getting praised by the
teacher really motivates
you, huh.
translations.ふーん……\nリンコにほめられるより？:
Hmm...
More than getting praised
by me？
translations.あ……いやっ……\n聞いてたんだ？:
Ah... Uh, no...
You heard that？
translations.美術の先生も\n見る目があるじゃん。\nま、リンコはとっくに\nアンタの才能に\:
Guess the art teacher has
a good eye after all.
Well, I noticed your talent
a long time ago, though.
translations.当たり前だっつーの。\nいちいち言わなきゃダメ？:
Obviously.
Do I have to spell it out
every single time？
translations.アンタのイイところ\nリンコはぜーんぶ知ってるよ。\n……だってカノジョだもん。:
I know every single good
thing about you.
...I am your girlfriend,
after all.
translations.（やっぱり\n▲小早川＊▲に言われた方が\nやる気になるな！）:
(Hearing it from ▲小早川＊▲
definitely motivates me
way more!)
translations.合唱で、\nクラスもまとまってきたな！:
Choir practice has really
brought our class together!
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nしっかりリーダーシップ\n取ってたじゃん。:
▲主人公＊▲.
Looked like you were really
taking the lead in there.
translations.リーダーシップなんて\n大げさだろ。:
Taking the lead is
a bit of an exaggeration.
translations.リンコのクラスはさ\nリーダーシップ、取れる人が\nいないんだよね……。:
In my class, there isn't
really anyone who can step
up and lead...
translations.リンコがリーダー？\n絶対無理！\nそういうタイプじゃないから。:
Me, a leader？
No way!
I'm not the type at all.
translations.見てみたいけどな。\n▲小早川＊▲のリーダー。\nできると思うぞ。:
I'd like to see it, though.
You as a leader, ▲小早川＊▲.
I think you could do it.
translations.ま……アンタもがんばってる\nもんね。\nうん、がんばってみるよ。:
Well... you're working hard too,
after all.
Okay, I'll give it a try.
translations.（よーし、●もがんばるぞ！）: (Alright, ● need to do my best too!)
translations.音楽の授業ってさ、\nやっぱ男女一緒？:
Music class has guys and
girls together, right？
translations.うん、そうだけど\nなんでだ？:
Yeah, it does.
Why do you ask？
translations.アンタが演奏してるトコ\n他の女子が見てるんだなって\n思ったらさ……。:
I just got to thinking how
other girls are watching
you play...
translations.アンタもさ、\nかっこよく演奏しなくて\nいいんだからね。:
You don't need to look
so cool when you play,
you know.
translations.リンコの前だけでさ、\nいいんだよ。\nカッコいいのはさ……。:
You only need to be cool
when you're in front
of me...
translations.今日の授業の合唱、\nイイ感じだったな。:
The chorus in class today
went pretty well.
translations.やっぱり、アンタの\nクラスだったんだ。:
I knew that was
your class.
translations.つい、ね。聞いちゃったよ。\nまあ……良かった。\nうまかったけど……。:
I couldn't help overhearing.
Well... it was good.
You guys sounded nice, but...
translations.アンタの声ばっか\n聞こえちゃってさ。:
Your voice was the only one
I could hear.
translations.リンコにはカレシの声ばっか\n聞こえちゃうみたい……。\nへへっ。:
Guess my ears just tune in
to my boyfriend's voice...
Hehe.
translations.最近、演奏するのが\n楽しくなってきたな。:
Playing music has gotten
pretty fun lately.
translations.がんばってるじゃん。\nいい感じだよ！:
You've been working at it.
You're doing great!
translations.なに？\nリンコの言うことが\n信用ならんと？:
What？
Are you saying you don't
trust my word？
translations.本当だっつーの。\nアンタの演奏、\nセンスいいんだからね。:
I mean it, seriously.
You have a real knack
for playing.
translations.（センスいい……か。\nよーし、がんばるぞ！）:
(A real knack for it, huh...
Alright, I'll keep it up!)
translations.あ、▲小早川＊▲。\n演奏聞いたか？:
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲.
Did you hear me play？
translations.うん。\n良かったんじゃない？:
Yeah.
It was pretty good, I guess？
translations.カッコ良くて、\nちょっと惚れなおしちゃった\n……ヘヘ▼:
You were so cool, I fell
for you all over again.
...Hehe▼
translations.（次もがんばるか！）: (I'll do my best next time too!)
translations.すごいね。\n練習の成果？:
Nice.
All that practice paying off？
translations.自己記録を更新しただけで\n喜びすぎかな？:
Am I getting too excited
just beating my own record？
translations.そんなことないよ。\n立派な記録じゃん。:
Not at all.
It's an impressive record.
translations.そうかな……？\n▲小早川＊▲にそう言われると\n自信が出てくるよ。:
You think...？
Hearing that from you gives
me confidence, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nフレー、フレー、\nがんばれ、がんばれ♪:
▲主人公＊▲.
Hip, hip, hooray,
go for it, go for it♪
translations.……へへっ。\nリンコはさ、\nいつもアンタのこと\n応援してるよ▼:
...Hehe.
Just so you know,
I'm always cheering
for you▼
translations.（やった！\n次もがんばろう）:
(All right!
I'll keep it up next time!)
translations.１位なんて、\n大活躍だったじゃん。:
First place？
You were amazing out there.
translations.まあな！\n今日は調子良かったんだ。:
Yeah!
I was in great form today.
translations.はぁ……なんでリンコは\nあと一年早く\n生まれなかったんだろ。:
Sigh... Why couldn't I have
been born a year earlier？
translations.そしたらさ、同じクラスになって\n堂々と応援できるのにさ。:
Then we could've been in the
same class, and I could cheer
for you out in the open.
translations.応援してくれていいのに。: You can cheer for me anyway.
translations.そんなの……恥ずかしいじゃん。\nみんな見てるし。\nだからさ……。:
That's... embarrassing.
Everyone's watching.
So instead...
translations.リンコにだけ、\nもっとカッコイイとこ\n見せるように……。:
Make sure you look even
cooler, just for me...
translations.（次もがんばるぞー！）: (I'll do my best next time too!)
translations.ゴール！\nやっぱり決勝点を決めると\n気分いいな。:
Goal!
Scoring the winning point
really feels great.
translations.張り切っちゃって。: Look at you, all fired up.
translations.▲小早川＊▲の前では\nイイところ見せたいんだ。:
I want to look good
in front of you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.リンコの前だから……？: Because it's in front of me...？
translations.そんな大声で……\n他の人に聞こえるじゃん。:
Not so loud...
Other people are gonna hear.
translations.あのさ……かっこいいと\n思う、よ。:
Listen... I think you
looked cool, okay.
translations.かっこいいって言ったの！\nもう……何度も\n言わせんなっつーの。\n……次も期:
I said you looked cool!
Geez... Don't make me
repeat myself.
...I'm counting on you
next time, too.
translations.最後のスリーポイントシュート！\nあの距離で、まさか入るとは\n思わなかったよね:
That three-pointer at the end!
I never thought you'd make it
from that far out.
translations.ははは、半分くらい\n運任せだったけど。:
Hahaha, it was about
half luck, though.
translations.運も実力のうち。\nでしょ？:
Luck is part of skill.
Right？
translations.幸運の女神が\n見ててくれたしな！:
Plus, I had the goddess of luck
watching over me!
translations.リンコの……こと？\nもうっ……恥ずかしいじゃん！\n大きな声で言うなっつーの。:
You mean... me？
Geez... That's embarrassing!
Don't say it so loud.
translations.しょうがない。\n……いられるように努力するよ。:
Guess I have no choice.
...I'll do my best to stay one.
translations.アンタの女神でいられるように\nするって言ってんの！\n……何度も言わせんな。:
I said I'll do my best to stay
your goddess!
...Don't make me repeat myself.
translations.（よーし、\n●もがんばるぞ！）:
(All right,
● have to do my best, too!)
translations.はぁ……はぁ、はぁ……\nよしっ……完走だ！:
Huff... huff, huff...
All right... I finished!
translations.お疲れ。\n男子は長距離走？\n大変だね。:
Good work.
Long-distance running for the
boys？ That's rough.
translations.最後の最後で……\n全力ダッシュ……したら\n……はぁ……はぁ……。:
I went into a full sprint...
right at the very end...
Huff... huff...
translations.体育の授業で\nそんなに本気になって。\n……バカじゃん。:
Getting that serious
over gym class.
...You're such an idiot.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が目に入ったらさ\nつい……ははは。:
Once I spotted you, ▲小早川＊▲,
I couldn't help it... Hahaha.
translations.ていうか、\n自然と力が入っちゃうんだよな。\n▲小早川＊▲の前だと。:
I mean, I just naturally
try harder when I'm
in front of you, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.じゃ……そんながんばった\nカレシにはごほうびを\nあげなきゃいけないよね。:
Then... since my boyfriend
worked so hard, I guess I have
to give him a reward.
translations.アンタががんばってる姿\n……すごくカッコ良かったよ▼:
Seeing you give it your all...
You looked really cool.▼
translations.今日は貸し出しも\n少なそうだし、残りは\n本棚を整理するくらいか。:
Doesn't look like many books
are getting checked out today.
Just gotta tidy the shelves.
translations.▲小早川＊▲。\n走ってこなくてもいいだろ。:
▲小早川＊▲.
You didn't have to run.
translations.だって……今日の当番は……\nリンコでしょ。\n……ごめん。:
But... today was supposed
to be my shift, right？
...Sorry.
translations.気にしなくていいよ、\n今日は仕事も少なかったしさ。:
Don't worry about it.
There wasn't much to do
today anyway.
translations.ほら、そんな凹むなって。\n●が勝手に\n当番代わっただけなんだからさ。:
Come on, don't beat yourself
up. ● just covered your
shift on my own.
translations.じゃ、次のアンタの当番のとき、\nリンコも手伝うから。\nそれでいい……？:
Then I'll help out the next
time you're on duty.
Is that okay...？
translations.そうだな。\nじゃ、頼むよ。:
Sounds good.
I'll count on you, then.
translations.うん！\nあ……それから……\nいつもリンコのこと\n助けてくれて、ありがと▼:
Okay!
Oh... and...
thanks for always helping me
out▼
translations.さてと……備品購入リストに\n先生のハンコをもらって\n今日の業務はおしまい！:
All right... Just need the
teacher's stamp on the supply
list and I'm done for today!
translations.備品……あ、そういえば\nプリンタ用紙とか\nもうなくなるって\n言ってたっけ。:
Supplies... Oh, didn't they
say we were almost out of
printer paper and stuff？
translations.おっ、サンキュ。\nリストに追加しとく。:
Oh, thanks.
I'll add it to the list.
translations.最近頼ってばっかりだったから。\nいっこ役に立てたから……\nへへっ、なんかうれ:
I've just been relying on you
so much lately. Being useful
for once... hehe, kind of made
me happy. ...Weird, huh.
translations.そんなのお互いさま。: Hey, we help each other out.
translations.そっか。\nお互いさまか。\nリンコもアンタの助けに\nなってるんだ……安心した:
Right.
We help each other out.
So I'm actually being a help
to you too... That's a relief.
translations.お互いさま。\n……いいね、そういうの。:
Helping each other out.
...I like the sound of that.
translations.ふぅ……図書館が\n整とんされてると気持ちいいな！:
Phew... It feels great seeing
the library all neat and tidy!
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n今日ってアンタの\n当番じゃないよね……？:
▲主人公＊▲.
It's not your shift
today, is it...？
translations.出したままの本があると\n放っておけなくてさ。:
I saw books left out and just
couldn't leave them there.
translations.本を出したままに\nしておけないなんて、\nもうすっかり図書委員だね。:
Not being able to leave books
sitting out... You're a true
library committee member now.
translations.えっ、もしかして\n今ごろ認められた……？:
Wait, are you only just now
giving me your approval...？
translations.……なんて冗談。\nリンコはアンタのこと、\nいつだって\n一番頼りにしてるんだ:
...Just kidding.
You're always the one I count
on the most.
You know that, right？
translations.よしっ、これで\n図書館新聞の原稿もあがり！:
All right, that wraps up the
draft for the library paper!
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n今回は特にがんばったね。:
▲主人公＊▲.
You worked extra hard on it
this time.
translations.▲小早川＊▲の協力が\nあったからだよ。:
Only because I had your help,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.リンコは紙面構成のアイデアを\n出しただけ。\n内容を考えたのは全部\nアンタじ:
I only came up with the ideas
for the layout.
You're the one who came up
with all the content.
translations.いや、▲小早川＊▲だって\n書評欄を……。:
Come on, ▲小早川＊▲, you did
the book review column...
translations.お互いにほめあって、変なの。:
Look at us complimenting each
other. Kind of weird.
translations.これだけの力作だもん、\nみんな読んでくれると\nいいけど。:
We put so much into this,
so I hope everyone reads it.
translations.じゃ、この勢いで、\n次の号の企画も\n考えちゃいますか、編集長。:
Well, while we're on a roll,
want to start planning the
next issue, Editor-in-Chief？
translations.（編集長か……\nよし、がんばるぞ！）:
(Editor-in-Chief, huh...
All right, I'll do my best!)
translations.ふぅ……がんばっただけあって\n予定より早く\n本棚の整理、終わったな！:
Phew... All that hard work
paid off. Finished sorting the
shelves ahead of schedule!
translations.お疲れ。\n一人で全部……\nやっちゃったんだ。:
Good work.
You did all of it...
by yourself.
translations.▲小早川＊▲に訊かなくても\n一通りの作業はもう\n覚えたしな。:
I've got the routine down now,
so I don't have to ask you
for help anymore, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.そっか。\nじゃ、もうリンコはいらないか。\n一人で大丈夫だよね。:
I see.
Guess you don't need me
anymore, then.
You're fine on your own.
translations.ほんとに一人で……いいの？\nリンコがいないと寂しいなら\n寂しいって言えばいい:
Are you really okay... alone？
If you're lonely without me,
you could just say so.
translations.うん…………そうだな。\nやっぱり二人でやろうか。:
Yeah... good point.
Let's keep doing it together.
translations.しょうがない……\nアンタがそう言うなら\nリンコはべつにいいけど。:
What am I gonna do with you...
If you insist, I guess
I don't mind.
translations.あのさ……やっぱ言っとく。\nリンコも一人より二人がいい。\n……へへっ。:
Um... Actually, I'll just say
it. I'd rather do it together
than alone, too. ...Hehe.
translations.（何だか今日は調子がいいぞ）:
(Feels like I'm in great
shape today.)
translations.!!!?\nなんだ、▲小早川＊▲か。\n……びっくりした。:
!!!？
Oh, it's you, ▲小早川＊▲.
...You startled me.
translations.へへっ。\nぼーっとしてるからさ。:
Heheh.
That's what you get for
spacing out.
translations.怒んない、怒んない。\nいーじゃん。:
Come on, don't be mad.
It's no big deal.
translations.べつに。ただ……\nアンタの泳いでるとこ見えて\nきたんだけどさ……。:
Nothing really. I just...
saw you swimming, so I
came over, and...
translations.なんか、\nかっこいーなーとか\nおっきいなーとか……。:
I was thinking, like,
how cool you look, and
how big you are...
translations.へへ……。\nリンコのカレシって……\n自慢できるカレシだよね！:
Hehe...
My boyfriend's really
someone to be proud of!
translations.近くで見ると……\n意外とたくましいっていうか、さ\n肩とか、胸板とかさ……。:
Up close, you're actually
pretty well-built, huh...
Your shoulders and chest...
translations.やだ、なに言ってんだろ。\n今の忘れて！\n絶対っ！:
Ugh, what am I saying？
Forget what I just said!
I mean it!
translations.ほらっ、泳ご！\n早くっ！:
Come on, let's swim!
Hurry up!
translations.ハァ……\n明日は、もう帰るのか……。:
Sigh... We're going home
tomorrow already...
translations.明日はさ、今日より\nもっと、楽しくしようね？:
Let's make tomorrow even
more fun than today, okay？
translations.じゃあ、がまんする……。: Then I'll put up with it...
translations.朝起きてもさ、一緒だね？:
When morning comes, we'll
still be together, right？
translations.リンコは今、本当のハネムーンと\n同じくらい幸せだよ？\nおやすみ、アナタ▼:
Right now, I'm just as happy as
if this were a real honeymoon.
Goodnight, darling▼
translations.いいけど……寝づらいのか？\nじゃあ、●がそっち行くよ。:
Sure... Hard to sleep there？
Then ● can take yours.
translations.何そのボケ。\n笑えないんだけど？:
What is that, a joke？
It's not funny, you know.
translations.アンタが寝てる、\nこの布団でってこと。:
I meant in this futon,
the one you're sleeping in.
translations.まぁ、ちょっと、落ち着こうか？: Let's calm down a bit, okay？
translations.あのさ……見られたいの？:
Um... Do you want people
watching us？
translations.触り過ぎだっつーの。:
You're touching me
way too much.
translations.いつまで触ってんだ！ ビシっ！:
How long are you gonna
keep touching me! Smack!
translations.変なとこばっかり\nなんだもん……。:
You keep touching me
in weird places...
translations.ダメだって！\nわかれっつーの……。:
I said no!
Take a hint already...
translations.ダメだって。\n今はってことだけどさ……。:
I told you, no.
Well, just for right now...
translations.ストップ！\nまた、次っつーことで……。:
Stop!
Save it for next time...
translations.ダメだけど……\nまた、次なら……。:
Not right now...
Maybe next time...
translations.リンコも、\n嫌なわけじゃないからさ……。:
It's not like I
dislike it or anything...
translations.もう、そこでやめるかな……。:
Geez, you're really
stopping right there...？
translations.嫌なんじゃないけど……\nダメだよ。:
It's not that I don't
want to... We just can't.
translations.そろそろ、行っとく？: So, ready to go for it？
translations.来たな？ エロスめ。:
Making your move, huh？
You perv.
translations.うん、\nリンコも同じこと思ってた……。:
Yeah...
I was thinking the exact
same thing.
translations.うん、男らしくてよろしい。:
Yeah, nice and manly.
I approve.
translations.いいよ？ \nカノジョだもん……。:
Sure, go ahead.
I'm your girlfriend,
after all...
translations.ヤ・メ・ロ！\nアニマルかっつーの！:
S-T-O-P!
What are you, an animal!？
translations.リンコもさ、言い過ぎたかも……\nゴメン。:
Maybe I went a bit too
far, too... Sorry.
translations.次は蹴るので、\nそのつもりで……。:
Next time I'm kicking you,
just so you know...
translations.（キスに夢中に\nなり過ぎてたな……）:
(I got way too caught up
in kissing her...)
translations.おまえ……それは……！\nキスか？\nキスなのか……！？:
You... Was that just...!
A kiss？
Were you kissing...!？
translations.チキショーー！\nちっとも、うらやましくなんか\nあるんだからなーー！:
Dammiiiit!
I'm not even a little bit...
totally jealous of youuu!!
translations.やい！ こら！ おまえ！\n俺たちＪ２ＤＣの\n誓いはどうなったんだよ！:
Hey! Hold it right there!
What happened to our
J2DC oath!？
translations.何？\nそのＪ２なんちゃらって？\nダサ……。:
What's with that
"J2-whatever" thing？
How lame...
translations.いやいや、\nＪＪＧＢなんか知らないし！:
N-no, hold on! I don't know
anything about any JJGB!
translations.それでね、思い出すわぁ～\nこれでも、おばちゃん\n大学時代はミスコン荒らしなん:
Oh, that takes me back~!
Believe it or not, back in
college I used to sweep
all the beauty pageants!
translations.そりゃ、もう世の男性が競って\nおばちゃんの唇？ \n狙ってたりするわけヨ！:
Why, men everywhere were
competing just to get a
shot at these lips of mine,
you know!
translations.ちょっと街なんか歩いてたら、\n横スクロールの\nアクションみたいな？ \n避け:
Walking down the street was
like some side-scrolling
action game, you know？
It was all I could do
just to dodge 'em all!
translations.（しまった……！\n無限ループに\n陥ってしまったか……？）:
(Oh no...!
Have we gotten stuck
in an endless loop...？)
translations.その日は予定あるけど、\nいーの？:
I have plans that day.
Is that okay？
translations.苦情は一切受け付けないから。:
I'm not taking any
complaints, though.
translations.▲小早川＊▲は、まだ来てないみたいだな。:
Looks like ▲小早川＊▲
isn't here yet.
translations.今日は▲小早川＊▲の家に\n呼ばれてるんだよな。:
I got invited over to
▲小早川＊▲'s house today.
translations.そういや●、\n▲小早川＊▲になんて\n呼ばれてたっけ？:
Come to think of it,
what was ● called
by ▲小早川＊▲ again？
translations.やっぱり、キスしてもいいってことなのかな。:
I'm allowed to kiss her after
all？
translations.恥ずかしくて、▲小早川＊▲には言えないな。:
I'm so embarrassed. I
definitely can't tell
▲Kobayaka＊▲
about this.
translations.こんな夢見るなんて、▲小早川＊▲に合わせる顔がない……。:
After a dream like this, it
will be tough seeing
▲Kobayaka＊▲.
translations.そういえばさ、\n初夢って見たことある？:
By the way, have you ever
had a New Year's dream？
translations.▲小早川＊▲と\nデートした夢を……:
I dreamed I went on a date
with ▲小早川＊▲...
translations.なーんだ、そっか。\nリンコ見てないから、\n話だけでも聞こうと思ったのに。:
Aw, really？ I didn't have one,
so I was hoping I could at
least hear about yours.
translations.じゃあさ、来年は見てよ？:
Well then, make sure you
have one next year, okay？
translations.そういうこと、\n平気で言うし……。\nあのさ、それってやっぱ……\n好きだから:
You just come right out and
say stuff like that...
Hey, do you think you had it...
because you like me？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nこのさむさ……\nあり得ないと思わない？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Don't you think this cold...
is just ridiculous？
translations.あり得ないって言われても、\n冬だしな。:
You say that, but it is
winter, you know.
translations.冬がさむいって誰が決めたの？\nそんなの横暴じゃん。\nさむくていいことなんか、:
Who decided winter had to be
cold？ That's tyranny.
There's nothing good about
it being cold at all.
translations.雪が降るとロマンチックだろ？: Isn't it romantic when it snows？
translations.さむければ温めあえるだろ？: We can warm each other up, right？
translations.何、ロマンチスト推し？\n……そういうのもいいかも。\n……でも、さむいのはダメ:
What, playing the romantic？
...I guess that's not bad.
...Still, I hate the cold.
translations.何、手つなぎたい……とか？\nリンコも嫌いじゃないけどね。\nほら、手。:
What, you wanna hold hands
or something？ Not that I
mind. Here, give me your hand.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n通学路のそばにさ、\n梅が咲いてるの知ってる？\n一本横道に入:
▲主人公＊▲.
Did you know there are plum
blossoms blooming near our
way to school？ Just one
side street over.
translations.梅か……\nぜんぜん気づかなかったな。:
Plum blossoms, huh...
I didn't notice at all.
translations.そこでいっこクイズ。\n梅の花言葉って知ってる？:
So, pop quiz. Do you know
what plum blossoms mean in
the language of flowers？
translations.あれ、やるじゃん。\n……リンコは昨日たまたま\n知ったばっかなのに。:
Oh, not bad.
...And here I only just found
out by chance yesterday.
translations.ところでさ、梅が咲いても\nまだまだ寒いね。\nあーもう、寒い寒い！:
Anyway, even with the plums
blooming, it's still freezing.
Brr, so cold, so cold!
translations.学校の裏の桜並木。この前、\n校舎の窓から見たんだけど、\n今が一番見頃だってさ:
Those cherry trees behind the
school. I saw them from a
window the other day, and they
say they're at their peak now.
translations.そっか。 あそこって\n生徒以外近づかないから\n花見の穴場なんだよな。:
Right. Nobody but students
goes back there, so it's a
great secret spot for viewing.
translations.それでさ、\nうちのクラスの友達が、\nアンタのこと見たいから、\n一緒にお花見:
So anyway, a friend from my
class wants to see what you're
like, and asked if we'd all go
blossom viewing together.
translations.やだ、２人きりがいい！: No way, I want it just us two!
translations.顔を出すくらいならいいけど: I could stop by and say hi, at least.
translations.やだ、って\n……なにダダこねてんの？\nジジイのくせに、へへ！:
"No way"？ ...What are you
throwing a tantrum for？
Acting like a kid, old man. Hehe!
translations.あ、恥ずかしがってる。\nまあ、ほんとに来られても、\nリンコも照れるんだけどさ:
Oh, look who's being shy.
Well, if you actually came,
I'd be pretty embarrassed too.
translations.アクビ多いな……\nもしかして、つまんない？:
You're yawning a lot...
Am I boring you？
translations.ううん、眠いだけ。 ほら、\n最近あったかくなったから、\n朝起きるのも辛いし。:
No, I'm just sleepy. You know,
since it's gotten warmer lately,
it's hard waking up in the
morning, too.
translations.たしかになー。\n●もよく授業中に眠くなるよ。:
True enough.
● get sleepy in class a lot,
too.
translations.やっぱり？\nどうしてこんなに\n眠いんだろうね。:
Right？
I wonder why we get so
sleepy like this.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が\n夢に出てくるから……:
Because ▲小早川＊▲ keeps
showing up in my dreams...
translations.それ、理由じゃないし……\nそれより“なのだ”って\n……ドヤ顔で言うなっつーの:
That's not even a reason...
And what's with the "indeed"？
...Quit looking so smug!
translations.それがアンタの理由？\nリンコには当てはまらないね。\n……だって、\nたまにし:
That's your excuse？
Doesn't apply to me, though.
...'Cause you only show up in
mine once in a while.
translations.あ、こんなところに花壇\nあったんだ。このちっちゃな花、\nかわいい……。:
Oh, I didn't know there was a
flower bed here. These tiny
little flowers are so cute...
translations.でもは余計だっつーの。\n……じゃあさ、リンコに\n合う花ってどんなの？:
You could leave out the "even"!
...Okay then, what kind of
flower do you think suits me？
translations.へえ、ちょっと意外かも。\n華やかか……それって、\nいい意味でいいんだよね？:
Huh, that's kind of surprising.
Flashy, huh... You mean that
in a good way, right？
translations.ちょっと自信なさげなのが\nひっかかるけど……実は\nけっこう悪い気しないかも。:
It bugs me how unsure you
sound... Still, it actually
doesn't feel half bad.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nカレンダーを見てたらさ、\n重大な事実に気づいたんだけど。:
▲主人公＊▲.
I was looking at the calendar
and realized something huge.
translations.なんだっけ……●、\nデートの予定すっぽかしたり\nしてないよな？:
Wait, what... ●,
I didn't blow off a date
or anything, did I？
translations.そんなことしてたら\n即キックだって。\nそうじゃなくて、\n今年がもう半分終わ:
If you did that, I'd kick you
on the spot. No, it's just...
the year is already half over.
...Don't you think that went
by way too fast？
translations.それだけ充実していたって\nことだな！:
Just means it's been
a really full year！
translations.まだ半分残ってるだろ？: We still have half left, right？
translations.そっか、それで……\nあ、じゃあさ、\n早く過ぎたのはアンタのせい？\nうん、や:
Oh, so that's why...
Wait, so it's your fault
it flew by so fast？
Want me to kick you anyway？
translations.はあ、いいね、そのプラス志向。\nだめだだめだ、\nリンコも見習わないと！:
Huh. Gotta love that positive
thinking. Man, I really need
to take a page from your book！
translations.夏休みって\n長いと思ってたけど、\nあっという間。:
I always think summer break
is gonna be long, but it
flies by in no time.
translations.まあね……\nそれよりさ、宿題は？:
Well, yeah...
More importantly, what about
your homework？
translations.もちろん提出した！: Already turned it in, of course！
translations.なーんだ。まだだったら\nバカにできたのになー。\nせっかくリンコが真面目に\n:
Aw, man. If you hadn't, I could've
made fun of you. And here I
actually buckled down and
finished mine for once.
translations.残念、リンコは完璧。\nそういうアンタこそ、まさか？:
Too bad for you, mine's all
done. Don't tell me YOU
haven't finished yours？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n衣替えの準備した？ 早いよね、\nもう冬服に替わるって。:
▲主人公＊▲. Are you ready
for the uniform switch？
Crazy how it's already time
for winter uniforms.
translations.そっか……\nもうすっかり秋なんだな。:
Yeah...
Guess it's really fall now.
translations.どうしたの遠く見て。\n何考えてる？:
Why're you staring off into
space？ What's on your mind？
translations.秋は女の子が\n薄着じゃなくなるからな！:
Girls start covering up
more in the fall！
translations.サイアク！ せめて“女の子”\nじゃなくて、“カノジョ”\nだったらまだ可愛げあ:
You're the worst！ It'd at least
be a little cute if you said
"my girlfriend" instead of
"girls"！
translations.うん、まあね……でもさ、\n秋は秋できっと新しい思い出、\nたくさんできると思う:
Yeah, I get that... Still,
I'm sure we'll make plenty
of new memories this fall, too.
...As long as I'm with you.
translations.衣替えが済んだってことは、\nもう秋だよね、ＯＫ？\n合ってる？:
Now that we've switched
uniforms, it's officially fall,
okay？ Am I right？
translations.カレンダーももう秋だからな。: The calendar says it's fall, too.
translations.じゃあなんでこんなに暑いの？\n異常気象だね、これは。\n地球温暖化は深刻だよ。:
Then why is it so hot out？
This weather is seriously weird.
Global warming is no joke.
translations.大げさだな、\nなんとかなるなる！:
You're exaggerating.
It'll work itself out！
translations.エコに目覚めたとか？: Going green all of a sudden？
translations.そーいう意識が環境を\nダメにするんだってば。\n……個人的にはそういうとこ、\:
That kind of attitude is what
ruins the environment, you know.
...Though personally, I don't
hate that side of you.
translations.ううん、リンコはクーラー\nがんがんかけるからさ、\n代わりにアンタが我慢して、:
Nope. I'm gonna blast the A/C
at full power, so you can
sweat it out and save energy
for the both of us.
translations.１０月ってさ、\n旧暦だと神無月だよね。:
In the old lunar calendar,
October is called Kannazuki,
right？
translations.なんだ知ってたか。\n古文って得意？:
Oh, so you knew that.
Are you good at classical
Japanese？
translations.雑学が豊富なだけだよ: I just know a lot of trivia.
translations.あーそれそれ、いまそかり。\n意味わかってないまま\n覚えてるんだけど、いいのか:
Ah, yeah, that! Imasokari.
I memorized it without even
knowing what it means, though.
Is that okay？
translations.なんか勉強できなくても、\nそういうの知ってると\n頭良さそうに見えるよね。\n:
Even if you're bad at school,
knowing stuff like that makes
you look smart, huh.
Maybe I should try that...
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n今朝、寒いと思ったら、\n家の前の水たまりが凍ってたよ。:
▲主人公＊▲. I thought it felt
cold this morning, and the
puddle out front was frozen.
translations.急に寒くなったからな。\nもうすっかり冬だ。:
It got cold all of a sudden.
Winter's really here.
translations.寒いの苦手だけど、\nあの薄い氷を踏んだときの\nパリッて音、面白くない？:
I'm not big on the cold,
but isn't that crunch when you
step on thin ice kinda fun？
translations.その気持ちわかる！: I know just what you mean！
translations.いーの。こういうのは\n子供っぽいんじゃなくて、\n純真っていうの！:
Who cares. That's not
childish, it's called
being innocent！
translations.だよね～？\nくだらない、\nささやかな楽しみだよ。:
Right～？
It's just one of those
silly little pleasures.
translations.テレビでよく動物番組やってる\nけどさ、ああいうのって\n安易な気がするよね。:
You know all those animal
shows on TV？ I feel like
they're kind of lazy.
translations.動物の赤ちゃんとか\n出しておけば、みんな、\nキャーキャー言ってくれると\n思:
Like how they think if
they just show some baby
animals, everyone'll fawn
all over them.
translations.じゃ、▲小早川＊▲は\n見ないんだ？:
So you don't watch
them, ▲小早川＊▲？
translations.やれやれ、大人は大変ですな。\nお父さんも視聴率で\n苦労してるしね……。:
Man, adults sure have it
rough. My dad's always
stressing over ratings too.
translations.そんなこと言ってないじゃん。\n悔しいけど、\n動物の赤ちゃんは反則。:
I never said that.
I hate to admit it, but
baby animals aren't fair.
translations.リンコでもきゅーんと\nきちゃうよ。:
They make even my heart
melt a little.
translations.アンタの好きな\n動物ってなんだっけ。\n訊いたことなかったよね？:
What's your favorite
animal again？ I don't think
I've ever asked you.
translations.そういえばそうだっけ？:
Now that you mention it,
maybe not？
translations.一応きかせてよ。\nカレシの調査ってやつで。:
Tell me, just for the
record. Call it boyfriend
research.
translations.ふーん。ま、人それぞれの\n好みだしね。別にリンコも\n犬が嫌いなわけじゃないし:
Hmm. Well, to each their
own. It's not like I hate
dogs or anything, either.
translations.ほんと？ 無理して\n合わせてなきゃいいけど。:
Really？ I hope you're not
just saying that for me.
translations.じゃあさ、\n今度ネコ見かけたらアンタにも\nモフモフさせてあげる。:
Okay then, next time we
spot a cat, I'll let you
pet its fluffy fur too.
translations.親が遊びに行く計画を立ててるん\nだけどさ。行き先が動物園\nなんだよね……どう:
My parents are planning
an outing, and it's to
the zoo... What do you
think？
translations.うーん、いいんじゃないか？\n家族で行っても楽しいだろうし。:
Hmm, sounds nice to me.
Going with your family
should be fun, right？
translations.ん、勉強になるってこと？\nまあ弟もリンコみたいに\n勉強嫌いになったら困るしね:
Wait, so it's educational？
Well, it'd be bad if my
brother ended up hating
school like me.
translations.そっか……たしかに\n家族団らん、って感じするね。\nま、付き合ってあげますか。:
I see... That does sound
like a nice family time.
Guess I'll tag along.
translations.最近、英語の授業で\nよく指されるんだけど、\nあれって絶対リンコのこと、\n目:
I keep getting called on
in English class lately.
The teacher definitely
has it out for me！
translations.英語の先生と\nなんかあったとか？:
Did something happen with
the English teacher？
translations.一度、英語の発音がいいって\nほめられて。おかげで毎回、\n教科書を読まされるん:
I got praised once for my
pronunciation, so now they
make me read the textbook
every class. Just 'cause I
listen to Western music
doesn't mean I know English.
translations.それって良いことだと\n思うけど？:
Isn't that a good thing,
though？
translations.でしょ？\n英語の曲が好きなだけで、\n英語の授業が\n好きなわけじゃないっつー:
Right？
I just like English songs.
It doesn't mean I like
English class.
translations.ほめられるのは悪い気\nしないけど……期待に\n応えつづけるのも大変なの。:
Being praised doesn't feel
bad, sure... but keeping up
with expectations is hard.
translations.この前、職員室に若くて、\nきれいな女の人が来てたん\nだけど。ね、誰だと思う？:
There was a young, pretty
woman in the staff room
the other day. Guess who
she was？
translations.学年主任の元教え子だって。\nそのうち教育実習でうちの学校に\n来るみたいだよ。:
A former student of our
head teacher's. Apparently
she's coming here soon as
a student teacher.
translations.先生かあ……\nちょっと憧れるかも。:
Being a teacher, huh...
That actually sounds kind
of nice.
translations.意外に先生に向いてるかもな: You might make a good teacher.
translations.……なに？\nリンコだって意外と、\nいい先生になるかもよ？\n宿題もテストもな:
...What？
I might actually make a
good teacher, you know？
No homework, no tests.
The students would love me.
translations.冗談のつもりだったのに、\n……それに先生になったら、\n授業サボれないしね。:
I was only kidding...
Besides, if I was a teacher,
I couldn't skip class.
translations.どうして制服なんてあるのかな。\nスカート丈は何センチとか、\nいちいちうるさい:
Why do we even have uniforms？
They're always nagging us
about how long our skirts are.
translations.うるさいのって\n生活指導の先生だろ？\n校則があるのは事実だけど、\nちょっと:
That's the guidance teacher
on your case, right？
I get that rules are rules,
but they're way too picky.
translations.男子にはあんまり\n言わないんだよ、あの先生。:
That teacher hardly ever
says anything to the boys.
translations.あーあ、いっそ私服通学になれば\nいいのに。そう思わない？:
Ugh, I wish we could just
wear casual clothes to school.
Don't you think？
translations.まあ、楽だし。\nアンタも色んなカノジョが\n見られるしね！:
Well, they're comfier.
Plus, you'd get to see me
in all kinds of outfits!
translations.……ああ、そういうフェチ\nですか。わたしのことは\n変な目で見ないでくださいね:
...Oh, so you have a fetish
for them？ Please don't give me
any weird looks, okay？
translations.最近さ、\n自分でお弁当作ってくる\n生徒が増えたみたい。:
Lately, it seems like more
students are making and
bringing their own lunches.
translations.中庭のリンコの特等席。\n最近、カップルに\n占領されてるんだよね。:
My favorite spot in the
courtyard has been taken over
by couples lately.
translations.落ち着いて本が読める、\n貴重な場所なのに。学校で\nイチャイチャすんなっつーの:
It's a rare spot where I can
read in peace. They shouldn't
be all lovey-dovey at school.
translations.●たちも\nイチャイチャしてみる？:
Should we get all lovey-dovey
too, ●？
translations.うーん……あーっ、やっぱダメ。\n横でイチャイチャされたら、\nこっちが困るっつ:
Hmm... Ugh, no way.
It bugs me when people are
lovey-dovey right next to me.
translations.い・や！\n周りに流されてるみたいで、\nいや。\n自分たちの意思でなら、\nや:
N-O!
I hate feeling like we're just
following the crowd.
If it's because we want to,
though, I wouldn't mind.
translations.試験前にノートの貸し借りって\nよくやるよね？:
People trade notes a lot
right before exams, don't they？
translations.やるやる。\nまじめな奴のノートを\nコピーしてもらったりする。:
Oh, totally.
I'll get copies of notes
from the serious students.
translations.それでさ、友達に\nすごくわかりやすく、きれいに\nノートをとる子がいるんだけど:
Well, I have a friend who takes
super neat, easy-to-read notes.
I wonder if that's just
a natural talent.
translations.どうなんだろう。\n参考書よりも\nわかりやすい奴っているよな。:
Who knows.
Some people's notes are easier
to understand than textbooks.
translations.あんなの、ぜったい\nリンコにはまねできないよ。:
There's no way I could ever
take notes like that.
translations.自分でわかれば十分だろ: It's fine if you can read them.
translations.あ、そっか。\n見せてもらうノートがきれいなら\nそれでいっか。:
Oh, good point.
As long as the notes I borrow
are neat, that's all I need.
translations.別に今でも汚くはないし。\nそうだ、先輩のノートも\n見せてくださいよ。\n参考:
It's not like mine are messy now.
Oh, why don't you kindly let me
see your notes, too？
Just for reference. Come on.
translations.友達がダイエット始めたみたい。\nそれでさ、リンコは\nダイエットの必要がなくて:
My friend started a diet.
She told me she's jealous
that I don't need to
go on one myself.
translations.たしかに、▲小早川＊▲って\nジャンクフード大好きなのに、\nぜんぜん太らないよ:
True, you love junk food,
▲小早川＊▲, but you never
put on any weight at all.
translations.うーん、\nリンコは普通にしてるだけ。\nみんなどうして必死なんだろ。:
Hmm, I don't do anything special.
I wonder why everyone's
so obsessed with it.
translations.それ、あんまり\n言わないほうがいいぞ:
You probably shouldn't
say that out loud.
translations.少しでも綺麗に\nなりたいんだろうな:
Guess they just want to
look as pretty as they can.
translations.……その忠告、遅かった。\n言ったらすごいバッシング\n受けたよ。難しいなあ。:
...Too late for that warning.
I said it and got majorly
chewed out. It's tough.
translations.やせることがきれいになること\nじゃないと思うけどね。そもそも\n外見だけ気をつ:
I don't think skinny equals
pretty, though. What's the point
of only working on the outside？
Right？
translations.友達がさ、\nカレシの浮気に悩んでるって。\n別れたくはないんだけど、\nどうし:
A friend of mine is upset
because her boyfriend cheated.
She doesn't want to break up,
so she doesn't know
what to do.
translations.男は浮気をするイキモノだって、\nその子のカレシは言ってる\nみたい。\nアンタ:
Her boyfriend apparently says
men are just wired to cheat.
You're not like that...
are you？
translations.絶対、浮気はしません！: I will never cheat on you!
translations.!?\n……いっぺん蹴られとく？\n笑えない冗談禁止！:
!?
...Want me to kick you？
No unfunny jokes allowed!
translations.ん、よろしい。\nへへっ……リンコのそばに、\nこれからもずっと、\nずうーっと:
Good answer.
Hehe... You're gonna stay
by my side forever and
ever, right？
translations.昨日、友達と\nポテチはどの味がベストかって\nちょっとした論争になった。:
Yesterday, my friend and I
got into a little debate over
the best potato chip flavor.
translations.コンソメ味が一番なんて、\nありえないし。\nうずしお味がベスト。\n素材の味を:
There's no way consomme is
the best. Sea salt wins,
hands down.
The simplicity that brings
out the natural flavor is
what really matters.
translations.それを言ったら終わりじゃん。\n世の中には白黒つけなきゃ\nいけないこともあるの:
Saying that kills the whole
debate. Some things in this
world have to be settled!
translations.うーん、そっかなあ。\n時代がリンコに\n追いついてないってこと？:
Hmm, you think so？
Guess the times just haven't
caught up with me yet？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n友達ってたくさんいた方が\nいいのかな。:
▲主人公＊▲.
Do you think it's better to
have a lot of friends？
translations.そうじゃないけど、よく言う\nじゃん。友達をたくさん\n作りましょうって。:
Not really, it's just what
people always say, right？
"Make lots of friends."
translations.よく話す子は何人かいるけど……\nたくさんってのは\nよくわかんない。:
There are a few people I
talk to a lot, but... I don't
really get having "a lot."
translations.そうだよね。\nリンコもそう思って。\nうんアンタがそう言うならＯＫ。:
Right？
That's what I thought, too.
If you say so, then I'm good.
translations.そうなんだ。ちょっとだけ\n安心したかも。不安になっても、\n一人じゃなければ平:
Oh, really. That's kind of a
relief. Even if we get worried,
we're fine as long as we're
not alone.
translations.この前、\n友達とカラオケ行ったらさ。\n……あーっ、もう。:
So I went to karaoke with my
friends the other day.
...Ugh, seriously.
translations.洋楽縛りだって言ったら、\n拒否られた。:
I said we should do Western
music only, and they shot me
down.
translations.……知らない曲は\nいやなんだろうな。:
...They probably didn't want
to sing songs they don't know.
translations.新しい名曲との出会いの\nチャンスでもあるのに。\nみんな保守的。:
Even though it's a chance to
discover great new music.
Everyone's so conservative.
translations.そう。文化はね、\n能動的に楽しむもんなの。\n漫然と耳に入ってくるもの\nばっ:
Right. Culture is meant to
be enjoyed actively.
If you only listen to whatever
drifts into your ears, your
sensibilities will rot.
translations.うん……\n練習中の曲あるから……\nそれが上手くなったらね？:
Yeah...
There's a song I'm practicing...
So once I get good at it, okay？
translations.機嫌がよさそうだな。\nなにかあった？:
You look like you're in a
good mood. Something happen？
translations.駅前のゲーセンでさ、\n強敵に会ったんだよね。:
I ran into a tough opponent
at the arcade by the station.
translations.しかもリンコと同い年で……\nやっぱライバルがいると、さらに\n強くなれそうな気:
And they're my age, too...
Having a rival really makes me
feel like I can get even
stronger.
translations.ごめん……\nライバルになれなくて:
Sorry...
I can't be a rival for you
translations.ライバルって、もしかして男？: Wait, is this rival a guy？
translations.別にアンタが完璧じゃないことは\n知ってますから。完璧なカレシで\nさえいればい:
Look, I already know you're
not perfect. All you need to
be is the perfect boyfriend.
translations.女の子だけど？\nあ……あらあら、そういうこと？\n男のライバルも現れないかな～:
She's a girl, though？
Oh... My, my, is that what
this is about？ Maybe a guy
rival will show up too～？
translations.最近また、ネットオークションに\nはまってる。\nやっぱテンションあがるね。:
I've gotten back into online
auctions lately.
They really get me pumped.
translations.オークションかあ、\nおもしろそうだな。:
Online auctions, huh？
Sounds kind of fun.
translations.駆け引きが大事でさ、\n格ゲーの対戦にも\n通じるとこあるかも。:
It's all about the mind games.
Kind of reminds me of playing
a fighting game, actually.
translations.一番の戦利品は？: What's your best prize so far？
translations.キラーバンビーズのブートレグ\n……つまり海賊盤が欲しいん\nだけど……やっぱい:
A Killer Bambis bootleg...
like, a pirated recording.
...Actually, never mind.
It's not fair to the artist.
translations.ギターの神様、Ｇｏｄ Ｍｔ．の\nピックってのがあるよ？\n削れてるとこが生々し:
I got a pick used by the
guitar god himself, God Mt.!
The worn-down edge on it is
just so raw and real～！
translations.最近、市の図書館に\n通ってるんだけど、\n予想以上に良かったよ。:
