I've been going to the city
library lately, and it's way
better than I expected.
translations.たしかに蔵書は\n学校のより多そうだな。:
Makes sense. They've probably
got more books than our
school does.
translations.単純に数だけじゃなくて、\n質もかな。:
It isn't just the sheer
number. The selection is
better, too.
translations.最近、\n童話を原書で読もうと思って。\n学校の図書館だとなかなかね。:
Lately, I've wanted to read
fairy tales in the original
language. They're hard to find
at the school library.
translations.好きでやってることだもん。\nだから勉強だなんて\n思わなかった。:
I'm just doing it because I
like it. I never really
thought of it as studying.
translations.結構、童話も好きですけど？:
I actually like fairy tales
quite a bit, you know？
translations.ただ……誤解されるのがイヤで\n黙ってるから、\n他の人には言わないこと。:
I just keep quiet so people
don't get the wrong idea.
Don't go telling anyone else.
translations.友達のカレシがさ、\n最近格闘技にハマってるん\nだって。:
My friend's boyfriend has
been really into martial arts
lately, apparently.
translations.なら、\n▲小早川＊▲とは\n話が合ったりして。:
Then maybe you and he would
have a lot to talk about,
▲小早川＊▲.
translations.格闘技好きってわけじゃ\nないんだけどね。:
It's not like I'm a fan of
martial arts or anything.
translations.なのに友達も勘違いしててさ、\n今度格闘技イベントで\nダブルデートしないかって:
Even so, my friend got the
wrong idea too, and asked us
on a double date to a
martial arts event.
translations.▲小早川＊▲が\n暴れないか心配で……:
I'm worried you'll go wild,
▲小早川＊▲...
translations.そう？ でも……格闘技が\nどうこうっていうより\nダブルデートってさ……\nな:
You think？ Forget the martial
arts part... just the idea of
a double date makes me kind
of nervous.
translations.なんなら今暴れても\nいいんだけど？\nほら、キック行くよ？:
I could always go wild right
now, you know？
Here comes a kick.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nなんでデートの定番って\n映画なの？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Why are movies always the
go-to date？
translations.共通の話題を見つけやすいから\nじゃないの？ 付き合い始めた\nばかりの頃は特に:
Isn't it because it gives you
something to talk about？
Especially when you first
start dating.
translations.ふうん、無難な回答。\nじゃあさ、恋愛初期における\n最適な映画とは？:
Hmm, safe answer.
Okay then, what's the best
movie for early on in a
relationship？
translations.コメディ映画で大笑い！: A comedy for some big laughs!
translations.一理あるね。やっぱまずは楽しい\n雰囲気にしないと。はずれの\n映画に当たったら:
Good point. You want to keep
the mood fun at first. Though
if the movie's a dud, it's
the worst.
translations.またしても無難な回答。\nでもなんか下心が見えて\nやだなあ。:
Another safe answer.
Kind of feels like you've got
an ulterior motive, though.
Not a fan.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nあのさ、アンタもやっぱり\nカノジョは女の子らしい方が\nいい:
▲主人公＊▲.
Hey, do you think a
girlfriend should be girly,
too？
translations.友達のカレシがそう言って\nたって……だから、\nアンタはどうなのかなって。:
My friend said her boyfriend
told her that... so I
wondered what you thought.
translations.……アンタ以外がそう言ったら、\n“てきとーなこと言うな！”って\n蹴ってるね。:
...If anyone else said that,
I'd kick them and tell them
to quit making stuff up.
translations.でもアンタはほんとにリンコの事\nわかってて言ってくれてるから\n……うれしい。:
But since it's you, I know
you really get me when you
say it... so I'm happy.
translations.そっか……ならいいや。\nもう気にしない！:
Right... Okay, good.
I won't worry about it
anymore!
translations.駅前に新しいアイスクリーム屋が\n出来たんだって。\nうちのクラスの女子が騒いで:
Heard a new ice cream shop
opened by the station.
The girls in my class were
making a big fuss about it.
translations.あ、知ってる！ 歌ったり、\n踊ったりパフォーマンス\nしてくれるとこでしょ。:
Oh, I know that place! It's
the one where they sing and
dance while serving you,
right？
translations.そうそう、行ってみたいな。:
Yeah, that's it. I kind of
want to check it out.
translations.でも、\n人気でかなり並ぶらしいよ？:
I heard it's super popular
and has a huge line, though？
translations.しばらくして、\n落ち着いてから行くか:
Let's wait till the hype
dies down.
translations.よーし、並ぶか！: All right, let's get in line!
translations.そうだね、流行ものに\nすぐ飛びつくのって、\nちょっとヤだし。\n何時間も並ぶ:
Yeah. I don't really like
jumping straight on trends
anyway.
If I have to wait for hours,
I'd rather just buy ice cream
at a convenience store.
translations.え？ 並ぶんだ。悪いね～？\n……冗談だってば。２人なら\n並んでる時間も楽しい:
Huh？ You'll line up for me？
Aw, thanks.
...I'm kidding. If we're
together, even waiting in
line might be fun.
translations.お気に入りのワンピが\nきつくなっちゃった。\nショック。:
My favorite dress got too
tight on me.
What a shock.
translations.んー、\n残念だけどしょうがないよ。:
Hmm, that's a shame,
but what can you do.
translations.それ、前にアンタが\nほめてくれたやつだから。\n思い出もあるのに……。:
It's the one you complimented
me on before. We had
memories with it, too...
translations.成長の証だから、喜べって！:
It's proof you're growing,
so be happy!
translations.まあ、そっか。\n着れなくなっても、\n残してはおけるしね！:
Well, I guess so.
Even if I can't wear it,
I can still keep it!
translations.……ほんとポジティブ。言った\nからには、ちゃんと実行してよ？\nこれでも期待し:
...You're seriously positive.
Since you said it, you better
follow through, okay？
I'm actually counting on it.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nあのさ、ラブレターの\n書き方って知ってる？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Hey, do you know how to
write a love letter？
translations.友達がさ、告白したいんだけど、\n直接は恥ずかしくて\n無理なんだって。:
A friend of mine wants to
confess, but says she's too
embarrassed to do it in person.
translations.その子が自分で考えた方がいい:
She should figure it out
for herself.
translations.直接告白がいい、\n▲小早川＊▲みたいに:
In person is better,
like you did, ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.だよね。うん、わかってる。\n一応聞いただけ、\nやっぱりそう言ってみるよ。:
Right？ Yeah, I know.
I was just asking in case.
I'll tell her that after all.
translations.!?\nリンコは関係ないでしょ！\n……バカじゃん。:
!？
This isn't about me!
...You're such an idiot.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\n駅前のゲーセンに新しい\n格ゲー入ったの知ってる？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Did you know the arcade by
the station got a new
fighting game？
translations.そんなことじゃ、\nリンコのカレシ失格だよ？\nいい？ 新しくなったのは\nガー:
Keep that up and you'll lose
your spot as my boyfriend.
Listen up. What's new is the
guard cancel...
Are you even listening？
translations.ね。もしかして格ゲー、嫌い？\nイヤなら、\nもう話さないけど……。:
Hey. Do you hate fighting
games or something？
If you don't like them,
I'll stop talking about it...
translations.そこまで興味が\nあるわけじゃないから:
I'm just not all that
into them.
translations.好きだけど、\n話が専門的すぎて……:
I like them, but you're
getting way too technical...
translations.たしかにリンコに\n負けっぱなしじゃ、\n面白くないよね。:
True, it's probably no fun
when you do nothing but
lose to me.
translations.よし決まり、特訓しよ？\nそうすればもっと興味沸くって！:
All right, it's settled. Let's
do some special training!
Then you'll get more into it!
translations.なんだ、ただの修行不足じゃん。\nしょうがないな、特訓して\nあげるからさ。とり:
Oh, so you just need more
practice. Fine then, I'll
train you myself. For now, we're
playing this new one nonstop.
translations.体育でソフトボール投げ\nやるんだけど。\nそしたら友達が、\nリンコは１０メー:
We're doing the softball
throw in PE.
And my friend goes and says
I probably can't throw it
more than ten meters.
translations.小学生だって\nもっと投げるだろ……。:
Even a grade schooler
can throw farther than that...
translations.でしょ？\nいくら運動が苦手だからって、\nリンコのこと、甘くみすぎ。\nこうな:
Right？
Just because I'm bad at sports
doesn't mean she can underestimate
me like that. Now I really
have to get serious.
translations.お、珍しくやる気だな！: Oh, rare to see you fired up!
translations.好記録で見返してやれ！:
Get a great score and
show her!
translations.そう、珍しくね。\nその子のこと見返したら、\n通常モードでダラっとやるから。:
Yeah, for once.
Once I show her up, I'm going
right back to slacking off
like usual.
translations.……そう言われると、ちょっと\n自信なくなってきた。あのさ\n……練習つきあって:
...When you put it like that,
I'm starting to lose confidence.
Hey... will you help me
practice？
translations.お母さんが、少しの間だけ\n弟つれて実家に帰ることに\nなってさ。\nそれで、リ:
My mom's taking my little
brother back to her parents'
place for a little while.
So in the heat of the moment,
I declared I'd take care of
all the housework myself.
translations.▲小早川＊▲って家事、\nそんなにできたっけ……？:
Wait, can you even do
that much housework, ▲小早川＊▲...？
translations.……たぶん、できるはず。\nま、お父さんは、リンコはなにも\nしなくていいって言:
...I probably can.
Well, my dad says I don't
have to do anything, though.
translations.これを機に花嫁修業だな！:
Take this chance to do
some bridal training!
translations.その言い方、\nムカッとくるんですけど。\n……でもまあ、まずは\n洗濯くらいか:
The way you said that
kind of ticks me off.
...Still, maybe I'll start
with the laundry or something.
Cooking, though...
translations.……なんか期待してる？\nでもさ、花嫁修業って言葉、\n前時代的だと思わない？:
...Are you getting your hopes
up or something？ Besides,
don't you think 'bridal training'
sounds kind of outdated？
translations.なんだよ急に。\n●、何かしたか？:
Why so sudden？
Did ● do something wrong？
translations.別に何も。\nやましいことがあったら、\nボロ出すかなって思っただけ。:
Nothing, really.
I just figured if you had a
guilty conscience, you might
give yourself away.
translations.ふーん、２回目か。: Hmm, on the second try, huh.
translations.なんかね、\n何度目で名前を呼び返すかで\n愛情の深さがわかるんだってさ。\nほ:
They say how many tries it
takes you to say my name back
shows how much you care.
Not sure if it's true, though.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nあのさ、自分の名前の由来って、\n気にしたりした？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Say, have you ever wondered
where your name came from？
translations.気になって、\n親に聞いたことがあるな:
I got curious and asked
my parents about it once.
translations.ふーん、\n男子ってそういうもの？:
Huh.
Is that just how guys are？
translations.へへ、じゃあさ、教えてよ。\n何々？:
Hehe, tell me, then.
What's the story？
translations.▲小早川＊▲、\nちょっと●のこと\n呼んでみてよ。:
▲小早川＊▲,
try calling me ●
for a second.
translations.はいはい、\nそんなことだろうと思った。:
Yeah, yeah.
I figured as much.
translations.何も言わずに呼んであげる\nリンコはやさしいね。\n▲主人公＊▲。:
Pretty nice of me to just
say it without asking why,
huh？ ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.なにそれ、バカップルごっこ？\nたまにそういうこと\nしたがるよねー。男の習性？:
What's this, playing the
sappy couple？ You like doing
that sometimes. Is it a
guy thing？
translations.コラ！居眠りしちゃダメだぞ。ふふ: Hey! No dozing off allowed. Hehe.
translations.今日もはりきって、ね？: Let's give it our best today, okay？
translations.今日もネネが一緒なのだ: Nene's right here with you today too!
translations.今日も一日笑顔でね？: Keep smiling all day today, okay？
translations.午後もこのままの～んびりいこう？: Let's take it nice and easy this afternoon too, okay？
translations.またメールしていい？: Mind if I text you again later？
translations.明日もまたがんばろー！: Let's do our best tomorrow too!
translations.お風呂入ってこよっと: Think I'll go take a bath.
translations.これから、お風呂▼: About to hop in the bath▼
translations.休みだからって、お寝坊さんはダメよ？: Just 'cause it's a day off doesn't mean you can sleep in, okay？
translations.休みでも、昼まで寝てるなんて許さないからね？: Day off or not, I won't let you get away with sleeping till noon, okay？
translations.休みの日なのに、いつも通り早く起きちゃうことってない？私はたまにあるんだよね: Ever wake up early like usual even on a day off？ That happens to me sometimes.
translations.ちゃんと時間通りに起きられた？: Did you manage to wake up on time？
translations.今朝はちゃんと起きられた？: Did you get up okay this morning？
translations.遅刻なんてしたら、私が許しませんからね？: If you're late, you'll have me to answer to, okay？
translations.寝ぼけた顔で外に出ちゃ、ダメよ？: Don't go heading out still looking half-asleep, okay？
translations.春は起きるの辛いね、がんばって起きて！: It's so hard getting up in the spring, huh. Come on, up and at 'em!
translations.ねむいけど、がんばって起きる: I'm so sleepy, but I'm forcing myself up.
translations.昨日も暑かったね。: Yesterday was another hot one, huh.
translations.昨日はあんまり寝られなかったな。: I didn't get much sleep last night.
translations.▲主人公＊▲もいつまでも寝てたらダメよ？: You can't just stay in bed forever either, ▲主人公＊▲, okay？
translations.いつまでも薄着で寝てると風邪ひいちゃうよ？: If you keep sleeping in such light clothes, you're gonna catch a cold, you know？
translations.布団から出るの辛いけど、早く支度しないと遅刻しちゃうからね？: I know it's tough getting out of bed, but hurry up and get ready or you'll be late, okay？
translations.寒いけど、ちゃんとすぐ起きられたら褒めてあげるから。ね？: I know it's cold, but if you get right up, I'll give you lots of praise. Okay？
translations.カノジョからのおはようメールってやっぱりうれしいのかな？私は▲主人公＊▲からもら: Does getting a morning text from your girlfriend make you happy？ 'Cause it always makes me happy getting one from you, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.ほんとは▲主人公＊▲のキスで目覚めたかったな▼: I really wanted to wake up to your kiss, ▲主人公＊▲▼
translations.今日は起きるの大変だったなぁ。▲主人公＊▲はどう？: Getting out of bed was rough today. How about you, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.たまにど～しても起きられないことって、あるよね。でも、二度寝はダメよ？: Some days you just can't get out of bed no matter what, huh. Still, no going back to sleep, okay？
translations.たまには運動した方がいいのかな、って思うけど。難しいね、色々と。: Sometimes I feel like I should work out a little, but it's easier said than done.
translations.▲主人公＊▲のクラスって、宿題多い？こっちは結構大変かも: Does your class get a lot of homework, ▲主人公＊▲？ Mine's pretty rough right now.
translations.今ね、窓の外に飛行機雲が出てるよ。そっちからも見える？: There's a contrail outside my window right now. Can you see it from over there？
translations.私ね、ノートとるのは得意なんだけど、テストは思ったほどできないんだよね。どうして: I'm really good at taking notes, but I never do as well on tests as I think I will. I wonder why.
translations.今クラスの友達と一緒に雑誌読んでたの。「カレを誘惑する１０の小悪魔テクニック」だ: I was just reading a magazine with a friend in class. "10 Little Devil Tricks to Tempt Your Boyfriend," huh... Maybe I'll try them out？
translations.たまに口がさびしくなっちゃうの。学校じゃパクパクは食べにくいし、やっぱり飴持って: Sometimes I just want something to snack on. It's hard to really eat at school, so keeping some candy on you comes in handy, you know？
translations.同じクラスにカップルがいるんだけど、休み時間になると教室でイチャイチャし始めるの: There's a couple in my class, and every break they start flirting right in the classroom. Must be nice.
translations.クラスに寝ぐせ付いてる男の子がいる。▲主人公＊▲は大丈夫だよね？: A boy in my class has bedhead today. Yours is fine, right, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.こんな季節は、授業を抜け出して屋上でお昼寝でもしたら気持ちいいかな。そんな悪いこ: In weather like this, skipping class to nap on the roof sounds so nice. Not that I could ever be that bad, though.
translations.今日は寝てる人多いなぁ。そっちも似たような感じかな: So many people are sleeping in class today. I wonder if it's the same over there.
translations.はぁ、あつい。暑くても、男の子は気楽に服が脱げていいなぁ: Phew, it's hot. Guys have it nice being able to just take layers off when it's hot out.
translations.あつーい……デキシーズだったら常に空調きいてるけど、学校だとそうはいかないもんね: So hot... Dixies always has the AC running, but no such luck at school.
translations.秋の通学路って、好きだな。風景が素敵だし、気候も気持ちいいしね: I really like the walk to school in the fall. The scenery's lovely, and the weather feels so nice.
translations.読書の秋。▲主人公＊▲は何か読んでる？: Fall is the season for reading. Are you reading anything, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.今日は帰りも寒そうだね。急いで帰ろっと: Looks like it'll be cold on the way home today too. I'm gonna hurry straight back.
translations.これだけ寒いと、デキシーズにもあまりお客さん来ないかな: When it's this cold, I wonder if Dixies will be pretty slow too.
translations.▲主人公＊▲にメール打ってると、みんなよくのぞいてくるの。もちろん見せないよ？: Whenever I'm texting you, ▲主人公＊▲, everyone tries to peek at my screen. I don't let them see, of course.
translations.そういえば最近、友達からよく「前よりキレイになった」って言われるんだけど……▲主: Come to think of it, my friends keep telling me I've gotten prettier lately... Think that's because of you, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.そういえば最近、友達から「前より色っぽくなった」って言われるんだけど、ほんとかな: Come to think of it, my friends have been telling me I look more alluring lately. I wonder if that's true.
translations.クラスの男の子たちが、下級生の女の子で誰が可愛いかって話してる。あの子たちは年下: The boys in my class are talking about which underclassman girls are cute. I wonder if they prefer younger girls.
translations.午前中の授業って、私は好きかな。お昼は眠くなっちゃうもん: I think I like morning classes better. I always get sleepy in the afternoon.
translations.抜き打ちの小テストで１００点取っちゃった♪: I just got a 100 on a pop quiz♪
translations.危ない。携帯触ってたら、先生に見つかりそうになっちゃった: That was close. The teacher almost caught me on my phone.
translations.今日は新しいシャーペンなんだ♪: I'm using a new mechanical pencil today♪
translations.ふふ、ノートを新しくしてみました♪: Hehe, just started a fresh new notebook♪
translations.自習になっちゃった。ヒマだなぁ: Class turned into study hall. I'm bored.
translations.勉強きちんとすれば、それだけ放課後が楽しくなるよ。: The harder you study now, the more fun you'll have after school.
translations.なんだか春って授業に身が入らないのよね。これってただの言い訳かな: I just can't seem to focus on class in the spring. Maybe that's just an excuse, though.
translations.眠いなぁ。春のせいにしちゃお: So sleepy. I'm just gonna blame it on spring.
translations.暑い日こそ、だらけずにシャキっとしよ？: Hot days are when we really need to stay sharp and not slack off, right？
translations.汗で体冷やさないようにね: Make sure your sweat doesn't give you a chill.
translations.秋だからかな、お腹空いちゃった。授業終わったら、隠してたお菓子食べちゃお♪: Maybe it's the autumn air, but I'm starving. Once class is over, I'm breaking into my secret snack stash♪
translations.教室の窓から見る秋の風景って、なんだか切ないね。: Looking out the classroom window in the fall feels kind of bittersweet.
translations.この寒い日に外で体育、やだよぉ: Having PE outside on a cold day like this is the worst.
translations.[22]が流行ってるみたいだから、▲主人公＊▲も気を付けてね: Looks like [22] is going around, so be careful too, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.私って、一日に何回「▲主人公＊▲は今何してるかな」って考えてるんだろう。気にし過: I wonder how many times a day I catch myself thinking, "What's ▲主人公＊▲ up to right now？" Maybe I think about you too much.
translations.ねえねえ、褒めて？なんでかは秘密！: Hey, tell me I did good？ Why is a secret!
translations.こっちはみんな居眠り中、そろそろ先生に怒られちゃうかも: Everyone over here is dozing off. The teacher's probably gonna snap any minute now.
translations.次体育だぁ。なんとかがんばる: Ugh, P.E. is next. I'll try to survive somehow.
translations.授業でわからないところがあったんだけど、とりあえずそのままにしちゃった。ほんとは: There was something I didn't get in class, so I just left it for now. Probably shouldn't do that, huh.
translations.退屈してない？私はちょっとだけ。: Getting bored over there？ I am, just a little.
translations.授業わかんなーい: Totally lost in class right now.
translations.クラスの男の子たちがハシャぎ回ってる。▲主人公＊▲の方がよっぽど大人よね: The boys in my class are goofing around like crazy. You're way more mature than them, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.▲主人公＊▲と同じクラスだったら、休み時間も楽しいのになぁ: Breaks would be so much more fun if we were in the same class, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.女の子同士の手紙、気になる？: Curious about what girls write in notes to each other？
translations.さっき▲主人公＊▲のこと、見かけたよ。そっちはわかった？: Just saw you a minute ago, ▲主人公＊▲. Did you spot me too？
translations.フレーフレー！なんとなく: Hip hip hooray! Just felt like cheering you on.
translations.夏ってやっぱりくっつかれると、うっとうしい？私は、そんなことないんだけど: Does having someone cling to you in the summer get annoying？ I don't mind it at all, personally.
translations.葉っぱが舞ってる……そっちでも見えるかな: The leaves are swirling around outside... Wonder if you can see them from there too.
translations.怪奇小説を買っちゃいました: Just went and bought a horror novel.
translations.教室の空気が悪いなあ、換気しなきゃ: The air in the classroom is so stuffy. Really need to open a window.
translations.今日もさむ～い。お客様少ないかも: Sooo cold again today. Might be a slow day at work.
translations.クラスの友達と恋バナ中。▲主人公＊▲のことたくさん白状させられちゃった▼: Talking romance with friends in class. They made me spill so much about you, ▲主人公＊▲▼
translations.クラスの友達と一緒にオシャレの研究中。女の子は大変なんだから♪: Studying up on fashion with some friends in class. Being a girl is hard work, you know♪
translations.クラスには映画の話が通じる友達がいないのよね。それがちょっと不満かなぁ: Nobody in my class really gets my taste in movies. Kind of a bummer, honestly.
translations.テレビにタヌキが出てる。かわいー▼: There's a tanuki on TV. So cuuute▼
translations.テレビの音が大きいって怒られちゃった。はあ: Got told off for having the TV too loud. *sigh*
translations.ご飯食べながらテレビ観るのはお行儀悪いよね。気を付けてはいるんだけど……: Watching TV while eating is bad manners, huh. I try not to, though...
translations.クイズ番組観てるけど、私けっこうこういうの得意なんだよ？: Watching a quiz show right now. I'm actually pretty good at these, you know？
translations.[24]の料理って、なにが定番かな。献立考えてて: What's a classic dish for [24]？ Trying to figure out a menu.
translations.今日は深夜に面白い映画やるよ、もし起きてたら観てみて？: There's a really good movie on late tonight. Check it out if you're still up？
translations.休みの日に家で勉強するのって、無理よね……: Studying at home on a day off is just impossible, huh...
translations.近所の小さな男の子と一緒に遊んだよ。嫉妬しちゃう？: I was just playing with a little boy from the neighborhood. Jealous？
translations.[24]だからって、寝坊はダメ！: No sleeping in just because it's [24]!
translations.あったかくなったけど、窓開けて寝ないようにね？: It's gotten warmer out, but don't go sleeping with the window open, okay？
translations.暑くてもしっかり食べなきゃダメよ？: Even when it's hot out, you still have to eat properly, okay？
translations.最近、[22]が流行ってるみたいだから、気を付けてね？: Sounds like [22] is going around lately, so take care of yourself, okay？
translations.寒いね、お互い風邪には気をつけようね: Chilly out, huh. Let's both be careful not to catch a cold.
translations.食欲の秋、はあユーウツ: My fall appetite is in full swing... *sigh* Such a struggle.
translations.さむーい。▲主人公＊▲は外出るとき気を付けてね？: Sooo cold. Bundle up when you go out, okay, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.[24]は、街のイルミネーションがきれいよね。一緒に観たいな: The city lights look so pretty in [24]. I'd love to see them with you.
translations.友達にあなたのことよく聞かれるけど……私、そういうとき隠せないのよね～: My friends ask me about you all the time... and I'm terrible at keeping secrets like that~
translations.▲主人公＊▲に会いたいな……。ごめん、困らせちゃうよね: I really want to see you, ▲主人公＊▲... Sorry, I know that puts you on the spot.
translations.今日はずーっとテレビ観てようかな……: Think I might just watch TV all day today...
translations.今日、宿題あった？: Did you have any homework today？
translations.今日の晩御飯は気合入れよっと♪: Gonna go all out making dinner tonight♪
translations.洗濯しなきゃ……楽しんでやればすぐ済むかな: Gotta do the laundry... Maybe it'll go by quick if I try having fun with it.
translations.今日の献立は……なんでしょー？: Guess what's on the menu tonight...？
translations.おかず作り過ぎちゃった。隣に住んでれば、すぐに持っていけるのに: I made way too many side dishes. Wish we lived next door so I could bring some right over.
translations.尊敬してる人っている？私は……うーん、誰だろう: Is there anyone you really look up to？ As for me... hmm, I wonder.
translations.なにしてる？私はベランダの掃除しようかなって: What're you up to？ I'm thinking of cleaning the balcony.
translations.ねえ。部屋、散らかしたりしてない？: Hey. You're not letting your room get messy, are you？
translations.大量に洗濯できると気持ちいいよね。逆に雨のときはユーウツ: Doing a huge load of laundry feels so good. Rainy days are such a bummer, though.
translations.[24]は、なにか部屋に花が欲しくなるよね: [24] makes you want to put some flowers in your room, doesn't it？
translations.料理、失敗しちゃった。[24]だから眠くて……は言い訳か: Messed up my cooking. Being sleepy because it's [24]... is a lame excuse, huh.
translations.花瓶の水かえるの忘れてダメにしちゃった……はあ: Forgot to change the water in the vase and ruined the flowers... *sigh*
translations.これだけ暑いと食欲も落ちちゃうなぁ。でもちゃんと食べないと体に悪いもんね、工夫し: This heat really kills my appetite. Gotta eat right to stay healthy though, so I'll get creative with it.
translations.将来は広い庭のある家に住めたらいいよね、やっぱり: Living in a house with a big yard someday really would be nice, wouldn't it？
translations.あーん、やっぱりご飯食べ過ぎちゃった！これからはダイエットの秋！: Aw man, I ate way too much again! Looks like this autumn's gonna be all about dieting!
translations.風邪はひいて欲しくないけど、もしものときは看病してあげるからね▼: I don't want you catching a cold, but if you do, I'll come nurse you back to health▼
translations.冬になると、気づくと毎日鍋料理作っちゃう。豆乳にキムチにおでんに……色々あるもん: Once winter hits, I end up making hot pot every single day without realizing it. Soy milk, kimchi, oden... there're so many kinds.
translations.今日は家事をがんばる日！って決めたの: I've decided today's the day I work extra hard on chores!
translations.今日の晩御飯は自信作！カレシとしても鼻が高くなるできだよ？: Tonight's dinner turned out amazing! It's good enough to make you a proud boyfriend, you know？
translations.あー、今日の晩御飯は失敗……はあ: Ugh, tonight's dinner was a bust... *sigh*
translations.今日は掃除をがんばる日。キレイにしちゃうぞ～: Today's a big cleaning day. Gonna make everything spotless~
translations.今日も▲主人公＊▲がいるから私はハッピー♪: I'm happy today too because I have ▲主人公＊▲♪
translations.夜だから▲主人公＊▲に会えないのって、ちょっと理不尽だと思わない？: Don't you think it's a little unfair that I can't see ▲主人公＊▲ just because it's nighttime？
translations.あーん、宿題おわんなーい！: Ugh, this homework is never gonna end!
translations.今日はいつになく、人のフォローばかりしてた気がする。でもそんなにイヤじゃないの、: Feels like I spent all day covering for people today. I don't really mind it though, maybe because I have ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.▲主人公＊▲、あまり夜更かししないでね？: ▲主人公＊▲, don't stay up too late, okay？
translations.宿題終わらなくてこんな時間……ねむいよ～: Homework took forever and now look at the time... So sleepy~
translations.今ね、もうほとんど眠りかけてたのにガバッ！って起きちゃった: I was just about to fall asleep, and then I suddenly bolted wide awake!
translations.あったかくなったね。でも窓開けて寝たらダメだよ: It's gotten so warm out. Don't sleep with the window open, though!
translations.[24]のお布団ってきもちいい～: My futon feels so nice in [24]~
translations.寝苦しい季節、体調には気を付けてね: It's that time of year when it's tough to sleep, so take care of yourself.
translations.今日は暑いね……すぐ汗かいちゃう: It's so hot today... I start sweating right away.
translations.虫の鳴き声って、なんだか眠くなるかも: Listening to the bugs chirp kinda makes me sleepy.
translations.秋の夜長……夜更かししていいってことじゃないよね: Long autumn nights... That's not an excuse to stay up late, right？
translations.寒いね。風邪ひかないようにね？: It's cold out. Don't catch a cold, okay？
translations.今日はあったかくして、早めに寝よ？私もそうするから: Bundle up warm and go to bed early tonight, okay？ I'm gonna do the same.
translations.今日も１日▲主人公＊▲のことが大好きでした▼なんてね: I loved ▲主人公＊▲ all day today too▼ Hehe, just saying.
translations.おやすみのキス。ほんとは直接したいのにな: Here's a goodnight kiss. Wish I could give it to you in person, though.
translations.たくさん働くと気持ちよく眠れるよね？: You really sleep so well after working hard, huh？
translations.私はもう寝るね。ばいば～い: I'm heading to bed now. Bye-bye~
translations.明日も一緒にがんばろ～: Let's both do our best tomorrow too~
translations.寝付けないなあ、最近多いかも: Can't fall asleep... Been happening a lot lately.
translations.宿題難しいなあ、そっちの学年はどうなのかな: This homework is tough... Wonder how it is for your grade.
translations.今日はまだしばらく起きてよっかな: Think I'll stay up a little longer tonight.
translations.会いたい……会いたいな▼: I miss you... Really want to see you ▼
translations.特に用事はないんだけど、メールでーす: Nothing in particular, just felt like texting you~
translations.今日は楽しい一日でした。明日もそうなるようがんばる: Had a fun day today. Gonna try and make tomorrow great too.
translations.珍しく早く寝ようとしたけど……やっぱり目が覚めてダメでした: Tried going to bed early for once... ended up wide awake anyway.
translations.寝坊しちゃダメだよ？▲主人公＊▲は、私を起こしてくれなきゃ: Don't oversleep, okay？ ▲主人公＊▲, you have to wake me up.
translations.▲主人公＊▲、まだ起きてる？先に夢の世界で待ってまーす: ▲主人公＊▲, still awake？ I'll be waiting for you in dreamland~
translations.暑いね、だからってくっついちゃダメっていうことはないでしょ？: It's hot out, yeah, but that doesn't mean we can't cuddle, right？
translations.あまり薄着して寝ると風邪ひいちゃうから気を付けてね: Be careful not to sleep in too little or you'll catch a cold, okay？
translations.テレビで映画観てたらこんな時間。そろそろ寝ようかな……: Got caught up watching a movie on TV and look at the time. Should probably sleep soon...
translations.夜食食べちゃった……うーん、どうしよう: I caved and ate a late-night snack... Ugh, what do I do...
translations.毎日寒いね。こんなときはやっぱりあなたに会いたいな: It's so cold every day. Weather like this really makes me want to see you.
translations.▲主人公＊▲？ネネはさびしいですよー: ▲主人公＊▲？ Your Nene is lonely over here~
translations.夜は嫌いじゃないけど、あなたに会えないのはイヤ: I don't mind the night, I just hate not being able to see you.
translations.あのね……だいすきだよ♪: Hey, guess what... I love you♪
translations.▲主人公＊▲が今考えてること当てます……ネネちゃん大好き！どう？: Bet I know what ▲主人公＊▲'s thinking right now... 'I love Nene!' Well, am I right？
translations.今日も一日がんばった。うん、充実してる感じする: Worked hard again today. Yeah, feels like a really fulfilling day.
translations.今日はお客さん少なくて助かるなぁ。いつもこうだと、退屈だけどね: Nice and slow at work today, thank goodness. Though it'd get boring if it were always like this.
translations.今日はお客さん多くて忙しいよぉ。デキシーズって結構客入りの波が激しいよね、大丈夫: So many customers today, I'm swamped. Dixie's really goes from dead to packed, huh... Hope the place is doing okay.
translations.今日の店長、すごく機嫌良さそう。何があったんだろ？: The manager's in a super good mood today. Wonder what happened？
translations.今日の店長、すごく機嫌悪そう。みんな近づかないようにしてるよ: The manager looks super grumpy today. Everyone's steering clear.
translations.スタッフの子たちが休憩室にファッション雑誌置いてくれるから、助かっちゃうな♪女子: Some of the staff leave fashion magazines in the break room, which is such a treat♪ That's the secret to upping my girl power.
translations.外掃除終わり！汗かいちゃったけど、着替え持ってきて良かった♪: Done cleaning outside! Worked up a sweat, so I'm glad I brought a change of clothes♪
translations.春は限定デザートが多くて、仕事中でも気になっちゃうな。男の子はそうでもないのかな: There are so many seasonal desserts in spring, they distract me even at work. Guess guys don't care as much？
translations.春はね、よくデキシーズに行くとき遠回りするの。だってお散歩したい季節じゃない？: In the spring, I often take the long way to Dixie's. It's just the perfect season for a walk, don't you think？
translations.夏はドリンクバーの中身がすぐなくなっちゃうから、▲主人公＊▲も気を付けておいてね: The drink bar runs out super fast in the summer, so keep an eye on it too, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.近くでお祭りがあるときはお店が大変なことになるからね、覚悟しておいて？: The restaurant gets crazy whenever there's a festival nearby, so brace yourself, okay？
translations.さっき落ち葉で滑って転びそうになっちゃった。恥ずかしかったよー: I just slipped on some fallen leaves and almost wiped out. That was so embarrassing~
translations.秋は季節限定メニューが多くて大変。結構間違える子が多いからフォローしないと: All the seasonal items in fall make things tough. A lot of the staff mix them up, so I've gotta help cover for them.
translations.冬の限定メニューは調理が大変。オーダー重なると辛いけど、気を付けてね: The winter specials are a pain to cook. It gets rough when orders pile up, so hang in there, okay？
translations.今日は外の掃除なんだけど、きっと寒いよね……: I'm on outdoor cleaning duty today, and I just know it's gonna be freezing...
translations.私のバイトの制服姿、すき？: Do you like how I look in my work uniform？
translations.恋人同士で一緒のバイト先って、なんだかうれしい、ね▼: Working at the same place as my boyfriend makes me kinda happy, y'know▼
translations.▲主人公＊▲のバイトの制服姿、かっこいいよ▼: ▲主人公＊▲, you look really cool in your work uniform▼
translations.今日はシフト組みのミスで、スタッフ入れ過ぎちゃったみたい。店長は悔しがってたけど: Looks like a scheduling mix-up left us overstaffed today. The manager's kicking himself, but it makes the shift easier for us, so I can't complain.
translations.今日、スタッフが２人も病欠だって。きっと修羅場が起きるよ？: Two people called in sick today. I bet work's gonna be a total madhouse.
translations.今日の店長、すごく落ち込んでるみたい。本部から何か言われたのかな？: The manager seems really down today. Wonder if corporate said something to him？
translations.▲主人公＊▲、ヒマしてない？ぼーっとする時間も大切だけど、ずっとそうだともったい: You bored, ▲主人公＊▲？ Zoning out is nice and all, but it's a waste if you do it all day.
translations.たまに口がさびしくなっちゃうの。やっぱり飴持ってると、便利だよ？: Sometimes I just want something in my mouth. Having hard candy on you really comes in handy, you know？
translations.あのね、メールで送る内容わすれちゃった。きっとたいしたことじゃないと思うんだけど: So... I totally forgot what I was gonna text you. Probably wasn't anything important, though.
translations.毎日が楽しいと、１日がすぐ終わっちゃうのが寂しいな。: When every day is this much fun, it's kind of sad how fast the day flies by.
translations.今日は珍しく店長に怒られちゃった。: Got lectured by the manager today, which is rare for me.
translations.今日はお客様にたくさんほめられちゃった。: Got lots of compliments from customers today.
translations.例えばバイトも宿題もない日って、今日はなんでもできる！って気になるんだけど、なぜ: On days with no work or homework, I always feel like I can do anything! And yet the day's somehow over before I know it. Funny how that works.
translations.デキシーズの掃除、ついついやりすぎちゃった。一度気になると、もうやらずにはいられ: I got a little carried away cleaning at Dixies. Once a spot starts bugging me, I just can't leave it alone.
translations.バイトがない日って、あー楽だなーって思うんだけど。いざ暇だと落ち着かなかったり、: Whenever I have a day off work, I think how nice and easy it'll be. Then when I'm actually free, I get restless and can't fall asleep at night. Can't win, huh？
translations.テレビのドキュメンタリーでね、勤労少女の特集だって。私もそうなのかなあ？: There's a TV documentary on right now about hard-working teen girls. Wonder if I count as one？
translations.洗濯物がきれいにたためると、ちょっと達成感ない？▲主人公＊▲はわかるかな？: Doesn't folding laundry nice and neat feel kinda rewarding？ Do you get what I mean, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.今日作ったご飯、自信作！あーあ、▲主人公＊▲にも食べさせたかったな。: Dinner turned out amazing tonight! Man, I wish you could've tried some, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.なんだか眠いんだけど、今寝ちゃうと、中途半端だよね。: I'm kinda sleepy, but it's such an awkward time to go to bed right now.
translations.ちょっと食欲ないな、お菓子食べ過ぎちゃったのかも……。: Not really hungry right now. Might've eaten too many snacks...
translations.今夜の洋画、チェックしてる？: Are you watching the movie on TV tonight？
translations.今日は家事、たくさんがんばった！えらい？: I got so much housework done today! Aren't you proud of me？
translations.ねむいよー、でも今やってる映画が面白くて眠れないよー。: I'm so sleepy, but the movie on right now is way too good to go to bed.
translations.今テレビにとわの市が出てるよ？: Hey, Towano City is on TV right now!
translations.んー！今日はなんだか▲主人公＊▲の夢が見られる気がする！: Mmm! I have a feeling I'm gonna dream about you tonight, ▲主人公＊▲!
translations.今日も一日お疲れさまです。: Hope you had a good day today.
translations.お布団の中から送信！: Texting you from under the covers!
translations.明日からまたがんばろ。もちろん二人でね？: Let's do our best again tomorrow. Together, okay？
translations.今日は入浴剤入れちゃおっと♪: Think I'll use some bath salts tonight♪
translations.私はかなり長く入っちゃうんだよね: I always end up staying in the tub forever.
translations.人間、こういう凡ミスってなくならないよね: Guess everyone makes silly mistakes like that sometimes.
translations.これって、この仕事のやりがいのひとつだよね: It's one of the things that makes this job so rewarding.
translations.子供もカワイイけど、やっぱり▲主人公＊▲が一番よね▼: Kids are cute and all, but you're still my favorite, ▲主人公＊▲▼
translations.ふふ、ちゃんと授業も聞きます: Hehe, don't worry, I'll pay attention in class too.
translations.おはよう[32]気持ちの良い朝だね。: Good morning[32] Such a nice morning today.
translations.モーニングコールされちゃった。おはよ[32]: Guess you're my wake-up call today. Morning[32]
translations.忘れ物しないようにね？: Make sure you don't forget anything, okay？
translations.[24]って感じの朝だね♪: It's a real [24] kind of morning♪
translations.ちょっとお散歩してこようかな♪: Think I might go for a little walk♪
translations.お休みだって、ちゃんと計画的に行動しないとね。: Even on a day off, it's good to have a plan.
translations.テレビに出てきたワンちゃんかわいい♪: The dog on TV right now is so cute♪
translations.朝はやっぱり白いご飯とお味噌汁よね。: Nothing beats white rice and miso soup in the morning.
translations.お散歩すると春のいぶきを感じるよ。: You can really feel spring in the air when you go for a walk.
translations.実はまだちょっと眠いんだ。この季節はいくらでも寝られるよね。: Honestly, I'm still a little sleepy. I could sleep forever this time of year.
translations.寝汗かいてるんじゃない？シャワーでスッキリしようね。: Bet you worked up a sweat sleeping. A quick shower'll freshen you right up.
translations.暑いからってエアコンばっかり使っちゃダメだよ。: Don't just blast the AC all day even if it's hot, okay？
translations.この時期って、朝ごはんも美味しいんだよね。: Even breakfast tastes extra good this time of year.
translations.なんだか、すっごく寝ちゃったな。: Man, I really slept a ton.
translations.つい2度寝しそうになっちゃうけど、ふふ[32]: I'm really tempted to go back to sleep, hehe[32]
translations.新聞とりに外に出たら、息が白かったよ: I went out to get the paper and could see my breath.
translations.うん、今日もがんばろっと！: Alright, gonna do my best today too!
translations.今日もがんばろうね。: Let's both do our best today.
translations.もうこんな時間かぁ[32]: Can't believe it's this late already[32]
translations.うん、もう寝ないとね[32]: Yeah, time to get some sleep[32]
translations.私も寝るね。: I'm gonna head to bed too.
translations.充実した1日だったかな？: Did you have a good, full day？
translations.いい夢が見られるといいな。: Hoping for some sweet dreams tonight.
translations.実はもう眠さの限界だったの。: Honestly, I can barely keep my eyes open.
translations.有意義な休日だったかな？: Did you make the most of your day off？
translations.▲主人公＊▲も寝なきゃダメだぞ！: You need to go to sleep too, ▲主人公＊▲!
translations.お腹出して寝ちゃダメだよ？: Don't sleep with your stomach uncovered, okay？
translations.寝坊しないようにしなきゃね。: Better make sure we don't oversleep.
translations.この時期、布団の種類に悩むよね。: It's hard to know what kind of blankets to use this time of year.
translations.しっかり干したから、お布団から太陽の香りがするよ。: I aired out my futon today, so it smells like sunshine.
translations.エアコンつけたまま寝ると、夏風邪ひいちゃうから気をつけてね。: Be careful not to leave the AC on all night, or you'll catch a summer cold.
translations.勉強してたらいつのまにかこんな時間かぁ。: I got caught up studying and lost track of time.
translations.鈴虫がやさしく鳴いてるね。: The crickets are chirping so softly tonight.
translations.お布団冷たいのイヤだから、布団乾燥機使っちゃおっと。: I hate getting into a cold bed, so I'm gonna use the futon warmer.
translations.ふふ、お布団あったかーい。: Hehe, my futon is so nice and toasty.
translations.授業中だぞ[32]: Class is going on, you know[32]
translations.ちゃんと授業に集中してるよ: I'm actually paying attention in class, you know.
translations.実はちょっと眠かったんだ。: Honestly, I was getting a little sleepy.
translations.他にも隠れてメールしてる人、いるけどね。: Though plenty of other people are sneaking texts too.
translations.休憩時間まで待てないの？ワガママねぇ。: Can't wait until break？ You're so impatient.
translations.たまにはいいけど、何度もメールしちゃダメだよ？: Once in a while is fine, just don't text me over and over, okay？
translations.実は▲主人公＊▲へのメールを打ってたの。びっくりしちゃった。: I was actually just typing a text to you, ▲主人公＊▲. You surprised me.
translations.先生の言うこと、ちゃんと聞いてる？: Are you actually listening to the teacher？
translations.今日の授業は試験に出そうね。しっかりチェックしなきゃ！: Looks like today's lesson will be on the exam. Better take good notes!
translations.あったかいからウトウトしてたんじゃない？: It's so warm out, bet you were nodding off, huh？
translations.春の陽気で、ぼーっとしてる人が多いかも。そっちはどう？: Lots of people seem spaced out with this nice spring weather. How about over there？
translations.早く夏休みになればいいのにね[32]: I wish summer vacation would hurry up and get here[32]
translations.あついよぉ～。プールの授業まだかな？: It's so hoooot. Is it time for pool class yet？
translations.この季節は集中できるよね。: It's so easy to focus this time of year, isn't it.
translations.頭をフル回転させると、お腹すかない？: Doesn't working your brain this hard make you hungry？
translations.手が冷たいよ。袖の中にいれちゃおっと[32]: My hands are freezing. Think I'll tuck them inside my sleeves[32]
translations.コート着たまま授業受けちゃダメなのかなあ？: I wonder if they'd let me keep my coat on during class？
translations.授業中のメールはほどほどにね[32]: Take it easy on the texting during class, okay[32]
translations.こっそりメールするのってドキドキ[32]: Sneaking texts like this gets my heart racing[32]
translations.あ、先生コッチきた！じゃあね[32]: Oh, the teacher's coming this way! Talk to you later[32]
translations.あ、返事遅れた？お風呂に入ってたの。: Oh, sorry for the late reply! I was in the bath.
translations.湯上りネネさんで～す[32]: Fresh out of the bath Nene here[32]
translations.もう少し起きてるつもり。: I'm planning to stay up a little longer.
translations.お肌の手入れをしないとね[32]: Gotta take care of my skin now[32]
translations.▲主人公＊▲はもうお風呂入った？: Did you take a bath yet, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.▲主人公＊▲は何してたの？: What were you up to, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.隠れた部分もしっかり洗わないとね。: Gotta make sure to wash all the hard-to-reach places too.
translations.▲主人公＊▲はどんなシャンプー使ってるの？: What kind of shampoo do you use, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.▲主人公＊▲ってリンスやコンディショナーは使うの？: Do you use conditioner or anything, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.ついつい長湯しちゃったな。: Ended up soaking in the tub way too long.
translations.今日は若葉の香りの入浴剤。季節感あるよね。: Used young-leaf scented bath salts today. Feels right for the season, huh.
translations.入浴剤の代わりにお庭で摘んだお花を浮かべてみました[32]: Instead of bath salts, I tried floating some flowers I picked from the garden[32]
translations.あえてものすごく熱いお湯に入ってみたよ。ちょっとしたサウナ気分[32]: I made the bath super hot on purpose. Felt like a mini sauna[32]
translations.水風呂にしてみました。なんか逆に体がぽかぽかするかも。: I tried taking a cold bath. Weirdly enough, I actually feel warmer now.
translations.今日は半身浴で1時間くらい入ってたんだ。: I soaked waist-deep for about an hour today.
translations.▲主人公＊▲って、お風呂で本を読む？: Do you ever read in the bath, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.ちょっと童心に返って、浴槽に潜ってみたの。子供っぽいかな？: I felt like a kid again and dunked my head under the water. Pretty childish, huh？
translations.長湯しちゃった。今日は早めに寝よっと。: I stayed in way too long. Think I'll head to bed early tonight.
translations.洗濯したてのパジャマは気持ちいいな[32]: Freshly washed pajamas feel so nice[32]
translations.ふう、マッサージして欲しいな。なんちゃって[32]: Phew, I could really go for a massage right now. Just kidding[32]
translations.ご飯でした。: I was right in the middle of eating.
translations.食事してたんだ。: I was just having a bite to eat.
translations.食事中のメールはマナー違反だからね。食べ終わってからメールしたの。: Texting at the table is bad manners, so I waited till I was done.
translations.食べてる途中にメールを見ると、集中できなくて消化に悪そうだよね。: Checking texts while eating makes it hard to focus on your food. Probably bad for digestion, too.
translations.▲主人公＊▲はどうしてるの？もうご飯食べた？: What are you up to, ▲主人公＊▲？ Did you eat yet？
translations.今日の献立は私が作りました[32]: I made everything on the menu today[32]
translations.今日はお父さんが[35]を作ってくれたんだよ。: My dad made [35] for us today.
translations.いつか▲主人公＊▲を我が家のディナーに招待したいな[32]: I'd love to invite you over for dinner at my place sometime, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.春にしか食べられないお野菜がたくさんあるんだよ。: There are so many veggies you can only get in the spring.
translations.サラダに春野菜をたくさん使ってみました♪: I put lots of spring veggies in the salad♪
translations.夏は食欲無くなるって言うけど、私は食べちゃうんだよね。ダイエットしなきゃ！: People say they lose their appetite in the summer, but I still eat plenty. I need to go on a diet!
translations.夏といえばそうめんよね。そういえば、流しそうめんてやったことある？: Summer's all about somen noodles. By the way, have you ever tried nagashi somen？
translations.秋はなんでも美味しくて、つい食べ過ぎちゃうよね。ガマンガマン！: Everything tastes so good in the fall, it's easy to overeat. Gotta hold back!
translations.鍋の美味しい季節だよね♪: It's the perfect season for hot pot♪
translations.今日はクラスのみんなでお弁当の交換会。私のお弁当、評判よかったよ: Everyone in class swapped bentos today. Mine was a big hit.
translations.今日はお弁当じゃないから、学食でおそば食べたよ。: I didn't bring a bento today, so I had soba at the school cafeteria.
translations.▲主人公＊▲は何を食べてるのかな？: I wonder what you're having, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.そういえば、▲主人公＊▲って料理作れるの？: Come to think of it, do you know how to cook, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.デザートは何にしよっかな～♪: Now, what should I have for dessert~♪
translations.午後もがんばろっと: Time to do my best this afternoon, too.
translations.ごちそうさま[32]洗い物しなきゃ！: All done eating[32] Now I've gotta do the dishes!
translations.今はお勉強してるよ。: I'm doing some studying right now.
translations.勉強中です。1人だと寂しいな[32]: Studying right now. Kinda lonely doing it by myself[32]
translations.ふう、一息つこうかな。: Phew, think I'll take a little break.
translations.▲主人公＊▲はもう宿題終わったの？: Did you finish your homework already, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.ちょうど休憩しようかと思ってたの、良いタイミングのメールだったわ[32]: I was just thinking of taking a break. Great timing on the text[32]
translations.宿題以外にもちゃんと勉強しないとね。私3年生だし。: I really need to study beyond just homework, too. I am a third-year, after all.
translations.▲主人公＊▲もお勉強中かな？: Are you studying right now too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.お休みでも、勉強は大切だよ。: Even on days off, it's important to keep up with studying.
translations.宿題は出てないんだけど、ちょっとわかりにくかった授業の復習をしてるの。: We didn't get any homework, so I'm just reviewing a class that was a little hard to follow.
translations.苦手な教科はある？おねえさんが個人授業してあげよっか[32]: Got any subjects you're bad at？ I can give you a private lesson if you want[32]
translations.▲主人公＊▲は勉強してる？遊んでばっかじゃダメだよ？: Are you getting your studying done, ▲主人公＊▲？ You can't just goof off all the time, okay？
translations.ちょっと疲れたから、お散歩してこようかな。: I'm a little tired, so I think I'll go for a walk.
translations.▲主人公＊▲はちゃんと授業理解してる？今が大事な時だよ？: Are you keeping up with your classes, ▲主人公＊▲？ Now's a really important time, okay？
translations.頭が疲れたら、甘いものが良いんだよ。だからアイスを食べます！: Sweets are great when your brain's tired. Which means it's ice cream time!
translations.アイスレモンティーを飲んで、ちょっとリフレッシュ[32]: Refreshing myself with some iced lemon tea[32]
translations.さっき晩御飯たべたのに、お腹へってきちゃった。: I just had dinner a little while ago, and I'm already getting hungry again.
translations.やっぱり秋は、お勉強がはかどるなぁ。: Autumn really is the best season for getting studying done.
translations.あったかくしすぎると眠くなるし、寒いと効率落ちるのよね。: If the room's too warm I get sleepy, and if it's too cold I can't focus.
translations.▲主人公＊▲も風邪引かないように、あったかいカッコで勉強しようね。: Make sure you dress warm while you study so you don't catch a cold, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.ちょっと難問に悩んでます。参考書の答えみようかなあ……。: Stuck on a really tough problem. Tempted to peek at the answer key...
translations.今度一緒に勉強会しよっか？わからないところは教えてあげるから[32]: Wanna study together sometime？ I can help you with whatever you're stuck on[32]
translations.あと一息、がんばるぞー♪: Almost done, just gotta push through♪
translations.教室の外が騒がしいな。なんだろう？: It's pretty noisy outside the classroom. Wonder what's going on？
translations.お母さんが食器割っちゃったみたい。ちょっと手伝ってくるね。: Sounds like Mom just broke a dish. Gonna go help her clean it up.
translations.あくびしてるとこ、男子にみられちゃった。恥かしい！: One of the guys in class just caught me yawning. So embarrassing!
translations.やだっもう夕方？早いなぁ。: No way, it's evening already？ Time flies.
translations.あっというまに、こんな時間かぁ。: Can't believe how fast the time went by.
translations.あ、メールだ。今日はお掃除してたよ[32]: Oh, a text. I spent today cleaning[32]
translations.今日は家族みんなのんびりしてます。: The whole family's just taking it easy today.
translations.お部屋の模様替えをしようか悩んでるトコ。: Trying to decide if I should rearrange my room.
translations.あれ？今日は何してたんだっけ？: Wait, what did I even do today？
translations.夜になっちゃった。今日は1日過ぎるの早かったなあ。: It's night already. Today really flew by.
translations.テレビでネイチャー番組やってたから、ずっと見てた。かわいい動物がたくさんだよ[3: A nature show came on TV, so I've been watching that. So many cute animals[32]
translations.テレビでやってたダイエット体操をやってみてるところ。結構キツいなあ。: Trying out a workout routine I saw on TV. It's actually pretty tough.
translations.▲主人公＊▲のコト考えてたよ[32]: I was just thinking about you, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.料理の新しい味付けについて、いろいろ考えてたの。: I was brainstorming some new ways to season my cooking.
translations.アルバイトの日だよ。今は休憩タイム。: I have work today. On my break right now.
translations.今日はバイト。ちょうど休憩時間になったとこだよ。: Working today. My break just started.
translations.ふう、ちょっと一息。今日はアルバイトだよ。: Phew, taking a little breather. I'm at work today.
translations.あ、ちょっと忙しいから、少しだけね。: Oh, it's a bit busy right now, so I can't chat long.
translations.今日はお客さんが途切れないなあ。: The customers just keep coming today.
translations.店長は新しいアルバイトの面接中みたい。: Looks like the manager is interviewing a new part-timer.
translations.お子様連れのお客様が多くて、お店の中を走り回ってるよ。: Lots of families here today. Kids are running all over the restaurant.
translations.新メニューで厨房がちょっと大変みたい。: Sounds like the kitchen's having a rough time with the new menu.
translations.今日はイチゴパフェが大人気みたいね。: The strawberry parfait is a big hit today.
translations.エアコンの調子が悪いのかな、フロアがちょっと暑いよ。: I think the AC might be acting up. It's a little warm out on the floor.
translations.今日は女子グループがたくさんで、とっても華やかだよ。: Lots of groups of girls in today. Really livens up the place.
translations.秋の炊き込みごはんメニューが人気ね。: Our autumn seasoned rice dishes are really popular right now.
translations.お客様に配膳するとき、お腹が鳴ると恥かしいよね、ふふっ。: It's so embarrassing when my stomach growls while serving a table, hehe.
translations.洗い場の水が冷たいよぉ！: The water at the dish station is freezing!
translations.今日はバイト休んだ子がいて大忙しだよ。: Someone called in sick today, so we're super slammed.
translations.仕事中はメール見れないからね。: I can't check my texts while I'm on the clock, okay？
translations.あ、▲主人公＊▲、次いつだっけ？: Oh, ▲主人公＊▲, when's your next shift again？
translations.ふう、じゃあお仕事再開っと[32]: Phew, alright, back to work I go[32]
translations.そうねえ、今日は疲れてるかも。: Hmm, I think I might be a little tired today.
translations.元気！とは言えないかもね。: I wouldn't exactly say I'm full of energy.
translations.今日は体が軽いな[32]: I'm feeling really light on my feet today[32]
translations.何か気分転換できるような事、ないかなあ？: I wonder if there's anything good for a change of pace？
translations.少し休めば元気になると思うから、心配しないでね。: I'm sure I'll feel better after a little rest, so don't worry.
translations.人間だもの、そんな日もあるよね。: Hey, we're only human. Everyone has days like that.
translations.ちょうど気分転換になったよ。ありがと[32]: That was just the distraction I needed. Thanks[32]
translations.なにか面白いニュースない？: Got any interesting news for me？
translations.▲主人公＊▲に会いたいな。: I really want to see you, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.ふふっ、なんかヘンな質問だね。: Hehe, that's kind of a funny question.
translations.そういう▲主人公＊▲は元気かな？: What about you, ▲主人公＊▲？ Doing okay？
translations.元気もりもり！ってちょっとオバさんぽいかな？: Fit as a fiddle! ...Does saying that make me sound old？
translations.▲主人公＊▲と一緒なら、私はいつだって元気だよ[32]: As long as I'm with you, ▲主人公＊▲, I'm always doing great[32]
translations.わざわざこんなメールを出すって事は、もしかして元気ないの？: Sending a text like this out of nowhere... Are you the one feeling down？
translations.▲主人公＊▲のやさしさをみんなにわけてあげたいな[32]: I wish I could share how sweet you are with everyone, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.私の元気、▲主人公＊▲にも差し入れしてあげよっか？: Want me to bring you some of my energy too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.なんだか絶好調！って感じよ。ふふっ[32]: Feels like I'm at the top of my game! Hehe[32]
translations.早く▲主人公＊▲に会いたいよ[32]: I can't wait to see you, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.でも、ありがと。うれしいよ。: Still, thanks. That makes me happy.
translations.私のこと、思い出しちゃった？: Were you just thinking about me？
translations.嬉しいけど、ちょっと驚いたな。: That makes me happy, though it caught me a little off guard.
translations.ふふ、たまにはこんなメールも嬉しいな。: Hehe, getting a text like this once in a while is really nice.
translations.私も大好きだよ[32]: I love you so much too[32]
translations.ちょうど私も、▲主人公＊▲のこと考えてたんだよ。: I was actually just thinking about you too, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.だから、私からも言うね。スキ[32]: So I'll say it back. Love you[32]
translations.だから、早く会いたいな。: Makes me want to see you real soon.
translations.ううん、私のほうがきっと、▲主人公＊▲のこと 大好きだよ[32]: No way, I definitely love you way more, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.でも、それだけじゃ足りないな。もっと言ってみて[32]: That's not quite enough, though. Say it some more[32]
translations.永久保存のフォルダにコピーしときました[32]: Copied that straight into my "keep forever" folder[32]
translations.言葉にしなくても解ってることだけど、言葉にするともっと嬉しいね[32]: I know it even without you saying it, but putting it into words makes me even happier[32]
translations.そんなこと言うから、すぐに会いたくなっちゃったよ[32]: When you say stuff like that, it makes me want to see you right now[32]
translations.いつも▲主人公＊▲と一緒で、とっても幸せ[32]: Being with you all the time makes me so happy, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.……言葉だけじゃない証拠が欲しいな。わかってるでしょ？ふふふっ[32]: ...I want more than just words as proof, though. You know what I mean, right？ Hehehe[32]
translations.▲主人公＊▲のこと、知れば知るほど好きになっていくみたい[32]: The more I get to know you, ▲主人公＊▲, the more I fall for you[32]
translations.私も会いたい[32]: I want to see you too[32]
translations.私も同じ気持ちだよ[32]: I feel the exact same way[32]
translations.今は……ちょっと無理かな？: Right now might be... a little tough？
translations.急に言われると……ちょっと困るな。: It's a little hard when you ask so suddenly...
translations.時間あるかなあ？: I wonder if I have time？
translations.今すぐに？いいけど……どこで会おうか？: Right now？ Sure, but... where should we meet？
translations.なにか話したい事あるのかな？: Is there something you wanted to talk about？
translations.そうね、時間が合えばいいけど。: Yeah, if our schedules line up, that'd be nice.
translations.会えるんだったら、いつでも会いたいもの。: If we can, I'd love to see you anytime.
translations.うふふっ、甘えていいかな？: Hehe, mind if I let you spoil me？
translations.学校もアルバイトも一緒なんだもん、会おうと思えばすぐに会えるよね。: We go to the same school and work at the same place, so we can see each other whenever we want.
translations.そんな事言うから、私もその気になってきちゃった。いつ会えるかなあ？: When you say things like that, it makes me want to see you too. When can we meet up？
translations.善は急げっていうよね。すぐに会いたいな[32]: No time like the present, right？ I wanna see you right away[32]
translations.メールって凄いよね。いつでもお互いの気持ちを確かめあえるんだもん。でも、やっぱり: Texting is amazing, isn't it？ We can check in on how we feel anytime. Still, I really want to see you and talk in person.
translations.ちょうど▲主人公＊▲の事考えてたんだもん[32]: I was just thinking about you too, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.▲主人公＊▲も私のことで、胸がいっぱいなんだね、私も同じだよ[32]: Sounds like I'm all you can think about, ▲主人公＊▲. I feel the exact same way[32]
translations.今すぐに会っちゃおうか[32]: Should we meet up right now？[32]
translations.今すぐ会いたいの[32]: I want to see you right now[32]
translations.あのね、我慢できない[32]: You know, I just can't wait[32]
translations.仕方ないよね。: I guess it can't be helped.
translations.じゃあしばらく会えないのかな？: Does that mean we won't be able to see each other for a while？
translations.無茶しないでね。: Don't push yourself too hard, okay？
translations.睡眠と食事はしっかりとろうね。: Make sure you get plenty of food and sleep, okay？
translations.私も何かしよっかな。: Maybe I'll find something to do too.
translations.忙しいんじゃ会えなくてもしょうがないか。: If you're busy, I guess we can't really hang out.
translations.何に忙しいんだろう？きいちゃダメ？: What's keeping you so busy？ Am I allowed to ask？
translations.１つ１つ丁寧に対処すれば、きっと大丈夫だよ。: Just take things one step at a time and you'll be fine.
translations.忙しいってことは、私とのデートは後回し？: If you're busy, does that mean dates with me are on the back burner？
translations.忙しいのは良いことだと思うよ。がんばって！: I think keeping busy is a good thing. Hang in there!
translations.私も何かをがんばっちゃおうかな。: Maybe I'll find something to work hard on too.
translations.えらいぞー！さすがネネちゃんのカレシだね[32]: Way to go! That's Nene's boyfriend for you[32]
translations.▲主人公＊▲のがんばる姿、見たいな？: I'd love to see you hard at work, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.からだはこわさないようにね、応援してるから。: Just don't make yourself sick, okay？ I'm rooting for you.
translations.ケガだけには気をつけてね。: Just be careful not to get hurt, okay？
translations.でも、そんなときでもメールくれるなんて、うれしいな。: Still, it makes me happy you took the time to text me anyway.
translations.でも、あんまり会えなくなるのかなあ？寂しいよ。: Does this mean I won't get to see you much, though？ I'll miss you.
translations.なにか私に手伝えることあるかなあ？何でも言ってね。: Is there anything I can do to help？ Just say the word.
translations.忙しくなくなったら、たくさんデートしようね。私それまで我慢する！: Once things calm down for you, let's go on lots of dates. I'll be patient until then!
translations.……でも、やっぱり会えなくなるのはさみしいから、時々でいいからデートしようね[3: ...Still, I'll really miss not seeing you, so let's go on dates every now and then, okay？[32]
translations.そんなときはね……寝ちゃお！ふふっ: When you feel like that... just take a nap! Hehe.
translations.宿題はもうやったの？: Have you done your homework yet？
translations.お掃除なんかどうかな？めんどくさい？: How about doing some cleaning？ Or is that too much trouble？
translations.そんな時はスポーツなんてどうかしら？: How about playing some sports at times like that？
translations.たまにはダラダラするのも良いと思うよ。: I think it's nice to just laze around every now and then.
translations.本棚の整理なんてどうかな？いい時間つぶしになるよ。: How about organizing your bookshelf？ It's a great way to pass the time.
translations.▲主人公＊▲もたまにはお料理作ってみるなんて、どうかな？: Why don't you try cooking something for a change, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.でも、そんな時だからこそ、自分のことを見つめなおせるかも……って、偉そうなこと言: Maybe times like these are a good chance to reflect on yourself... Haha, listen to me trying to sound all wise♪
translations.そうねえ、一人で出来る遊び……何があるかなあ？: Let's see, something fun you can do on your own... What is there？
translations.だったら私にたくさんメールしてね[32]: Then send me lots of texts[32]
translations.あなたの顔が目に浮かぶわ[32]: I can picture the look on your face right now[32]
translations.お互いに時間あるんだから、デートしたいな～[32]: Since we both have free time, I wish we could go on a date~[32]
translations.ヒマな時は▲主人公＊▲の事考えてるよ。あなたは？: Whenever I'm free, I'm thinking about you, ▲主人公＊▲. What about you？
translations.▲主人公＊▲のメールでちょっとヒマじゃなくなったかも。ふふっ[32]: Getting your text made me a little less bored, ▲主人公＊▲. Hehe[32]
translations.こんなことまで相性がいいんだね、私たち[32]: We're even on the same wavelength with stuff like this, huh？[32]
translations.どこかに遊びに行く計画を立てようよ。: Let's make plans to go hang out somewhere.
translations.私のどこが好きか、１０個言ってみて[32]: Try naming 10 things you like about me[32]
translations.10秒間で何回「スキ」って言えるか試してみて。なんちゃって[32]: See how many times you can say "I love you" in 10 seconds. Just kidding[32]
translations.今からテレパシーを送るから、なんて言ったか当ててみて[32]: I'm sending you a telepathic message right now, so try and guess what I said[32]
translations.私にも分けて欲しいな。: I wish you'd share some of that with me.
translations.何があったんだろ、今度聞かせてね。: I wonder what happened. Tell me all about it next time.
translations.半分分けて欲しいな。: I wish you'd share half of that with me.
translations.なんか嫉妬しちゃうな。あ……こういう時って嫉妬で合ってるのかな？: Makes me a little jealous. Wait... is "jealous" even the right word here？
translations.私はちょっと気になることあって、スッキリしないんだよね。: I've got something on my mind, so I'm feeling a little off.
translations.私にその元気を注入して欲しいな。: I need you to give me some of that energy.
translations.なになに？何か美味しいもの食べたの？: Wait, what？ Did you eat something delicious？
translations.私はもう、今日は寝ちゃおうかな……。: I think I might just go to bed early today...
translations.なんだろ？教えてよ、テストで良い点とったとか？: What is it？ Tell me! Did you get a good grade on a test or something？
translations.私だって……えーと……今日はそうでもなかったかな？: Hey, I had a good day too... Um... okay, maybe not so much today？
translations.▲主人公＊▲が楽しそうだから、私もだんだん元気になってきたよ。: Seeing you so happy is starting to cheer me up too, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.焼肉かな～？お寿司かな～？: Was it barbecue~？ Or maybe sushi~？
translations.私もいいことあったんだ。アルバイトで店長に褒められたの♪: Something good happened to me too. My manager praised me at work♪
translations.私まで楽しくなってきちゃったよ。: Now I'm starting to feel happy too.
translations.あら、自慢？私だって気分いいことあったもん！: Oh, bragging, are we？ Something nice happened to me too, you know!
translations.ふふ、子供っぽい[32]でもそんな所も好き[32]: Hehe, you're like a little kid[32] But I love that about you too[32]
translations.うふふ、だって▲主人公＊▲からメール来たもん[32]: Hehe, 'cause I got a text from you, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.今度のデートでそのお話しようね[32]: Let's talk all about it on our next date[32]
translations.私もちょうど今そんな気分なの。奇遇ね[32]: I was just feeling the same way. What a coincidence[32]
translations.▲主人公＊▲がそういう事いうと、私までちょっとブルーになるな。: When you say things like that, ▲主人公＊▲, it makes me feel a little blue too.
translations.そんな時は気分転換！河原に行って大きな声出すなんてどうかな？: You need a change of pace! How about going to the riverbank and shouting it all out？
translations.あなたが落ち込んでると、私までそんな気分になってきちゃうよ。: When you're feeling down, it starts rubbing off on me too.
translations.……って言われると、逆に元気でなくなるって聞いたことあるな。頑張らないで！: ...Though I've heard being told that actually makes you feel worse. Don't push yourself!
translations.Heaven helps those who help themselves.だ: Heaven helps those who help themselves, you know!
translations.私、力になれるかな？: Is there anything I can do to help？
translations.元気があれば何でも出来る！ってテレビで誰かが言ってたよ。: Someone on TV said as long as you've got your spirits up, you can do anything!
translations.私が応援してあげる！フレー！フレー！▲主人公＊▲！！: I'm cheering for you! Go, go, ▲主人公＊▲!!
translations.何か栄養のあるもの食べれば元気でるよ。私が作ってあげようか？: Eating something nutritious will perk you right up. Want me to make you something？
translations.キスしたら元気になるよね[32]: I bet a kiss would perk you up[32]
translations.今近くにいれば、すぐ会いに行くのに。: If I were nearby right now, I'd come see you right away.
translations.私がいつでも一緒にいられるように、ぬいぐるみネネちゃんを作ろうかな[32]: Maybe I should make a plushie Nene-chan so I can always be with you[32]
translations.今からテレパシーで送るね。▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼届いた？: Sending it to you by telepathy right now. ▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼ Did you get it？
translations.若いんだから、困難には全力で立ち向かわないとね！: You're still young, so you've gotta face tough times head-on!
translations.くじけそうになったら、私が励ましてあげるから、もっとガンバろ[32]: If you feel like giving up, I'll be right here to cheer you on, so hang in there a little longer[32]
translations.私もちょっとイヤな事あったけど、そんな事言ってる場合じゃないよね！: I had something a little annoying happen too, but now's not the time to complain about that!
translations.疲れたら私が癒してあげるから、ガンバって！: If you get tired, I'll help you unwind, so hang in there!
translations.しっかり休んで元気になったらデートしようね。: Get plenty of rest, and once you're feeling better, let's go on a date.
translations.何に疲れたの？まさか私のせいじゃないよね？: What tired you out so much？ Don't tell me it's because of me？
translations.はいはい、いい子いい子、なでなで。: There, there, good boy. Pat, pat.
translations.無理してるのかな？ほどほどにね。: Are you pushing yourself too hard？ Don't overdo it, okay.
translations.高い栄養ドリンクを飲んじゃおう！たまにはいいかもね。: Let's get you one of those pricey energy drinks! Couldn't hurt every once in a while.
translations.疲れたときはしっかり寝ることだよ。子守唄を歌ってあげようか？: The best thing when you're tired is a good night's sleep. Want me to sing you a lullaby？
translations.お姉さんが悩みを聴いてあげましょうか？: Want to tell big sis what's bothering you？
translations.そんなに疲れるような事ってなんだろ？今度聞かせてね。: I wonder what could've tired you out that much？ Tell me all about it next time.
translations.疲れてるだけなら大丈夫。すぐ回復するよ。: If you're just tired, you'll be fine. You'll bounce right back.
translations.でも大丈夫、メールしてくる元気があるんだもん。すぐ元気になるって！: Still, you had enough energy to text me, so you'll be fine. You'll bounce right back!
translations.たまには疲れるようなことしないと、強くなれないんだよ。だから平気！: You won't get any stronger if you don't wear yourself out once in a while. So you'll be fine!
translations.疲れはガンバった証拠だよ[32]: Being tired is proof you gave it your all[32]
translations.デートまでには元気出そう？: Try to get your energy back in time for our date, okay？
translations.疲れなんてすぐに回復しちゃうよ。男の子だもん！: You'll shake that tiredness off in no time. You're a guy, after all!
translations.疲れてるのにメールありがと[32]元気になったらデートしようね[32]: Thanks for texting me even when you're tired[32] Let's go on a date once you have your energy back[32]
translations.今度スタミナがつく料理を食べさせてあげるね[32]: I'll cook you something to boost your stamina next time[32]
translations.癒しの歌を歌ってあげるよ。象だって一発で熟睡しちゃうんだから！: I'll sing you a soothing song. It's strong enough to put an elephant right to sleep!
translations.じゃあ今度マッサージしてあげる。お父さんがね、私のマッサージ上手いって♪: Then I'll give you a massage next time. My dad says I give great massages♪
translations.回復魔法をかけてあげるね。ぽんぽっこぽっこりん！ぽんこっこり～～ん♪: I'll cast a healing spell on you. Pon-pokko-pokkorin! Pon-kokkoriiiin♪
translations.おはよ▼あ～、ハートとかつけちゃったよ: Morning▼ Ugh, can't believe I added a heart.
translations.▲凛▲からのおはようだよ？: You got a "good morning" from ▲凛▲, y'know？
translations.▲主人公＊▲！だ～いすき▼なんてメール送る女って、どうかと思うよね: ▲主人公＊▲! I looove you▼ ...Girls who send texts like that have issues, right？
translations.今日もてきとーにがんばる: Gonna just coast through today too.
translations.▲凛▲、今日もがんばる: ▲凛▲'s gonna do her best today too.
translations.今日もてきとーにがんばってこ: Let's just take it easy today too.
translations.午後もてきとーに: Take it easy this afternoon too.
translations.明日もてきとうに生きる！: Time to just coast through tomorrow too!
translations.▲凛▲は、これからお風呂。想像しないこと: ▲凛▲'s about to take a bath. Don't go picturing it.
translations.休日の朝は気分がいいね: Mornings on a day off feel so nice.
translations.休みなのに早く目がさめた。損した: Woke up early on my day off. Feel totally cheated.
translations.さて、今日は何しよっかな: Now then, what should I do today？
translations.今日学校休みになんないかな。: Wonder if school'll get canceled today.
translations.▲凛▲低血圧だから、朝辛い……: ▲凛▲ has low blood pressure, so mornings are rough...
translations.あ～学校行きたくない！: Ugh, I don't wanna go to school!
translations.まだしばらく寝てたい……。: I wanna stay in bed a while longer...
translations.また寝るね。ポカポカしてるし。ダメ？: Going back to sleep. It's nice and warm. Is that okay？
translations.眠いのに、暑くて寝てらんないよ: I'm sleepy, but it's way too hot to sleep.
translations.お腹痛い。昨日アイス２本食べたからかな: My stomach hurts. Maybe 'cause I had two ice creams yesterday.
translations.芸術の秋の目覚めはパンクに限るね: Autumn's the season for the arts, so nothing beats waking up to punk.
translations.だんだん布団から出るのが辛くなってくるね: It's getting harder and harder to get out of bed.
translations.寒くて布団から出らんないよ～: It's too cold to get out from under the covers...
translations.カノジョのメールで起きられるなんてさ、いい身分だよね、▲主人公＊▲も: Getting woken up by a text from your girlfriend... You've got it pretty good, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.今日はいいことあるかな。▲主人公＊▲もさ、善処してよ: Hope something good happens today. See what you can do about that, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.今日は外で鳴いてたネコの声で目がさめた。最高の目覚ましだね: A cat meowing outside woke me up today. Best alarm clock ever.
translations.今日の▲凛▲はなんかすごいことできそうな気がする。気だけかもしれないけど: Feels like ▲凛▲ can do something amazing today. Might just be in my head, though.
translations.朝から頭はたらかないっつーの。: My brain seriously doesn't work this early.
translations.朝から体育とか、ほんとカンベンしてほしい: P.E. first thing in the morning？ Give me a break.
translations.全校朝礼ってさ、ビデオ放送でよくない？: Couldn't they just do the morning assembly over video？
translations.プレイヤーの充電切れた、最悪！: My music player died. The worst!
translations.思いっきりあくびすると、ちょっと眠気さめない？: Doesn't letting out a huge yawn wake you up a little？
translations.調子どう？こっちはボチボチ。: How's it going？ So-so over here.
translations.今から、▲凛▲は羊を数えてみようと思う: ▲凛▲ is gonna try counting sheep now.
translations.[24]ってさ、なんでこんな眠いの: Why does [24] make me so sleepy？
translations.[24]はのどかだね。これで授業さえなければ: [24] is so peaceful. If only we didn't have class.
translations.もうだめ。この暑さの中、学校来るだけで１日の体力使いきったし: I'm done. Just getting to school in this heat used up all my energy for the day.
translations.▲凛▲が偉くなったらさ、まず最初に全学校の全教室にクーラーを入れる法律を作るね: When ▲凛▲ gets to be in charge, the very first law I'm passing is A/C in every classroom in every school.
translations.食欲の[24]とか陳腐なこと言いたくないけど、お腹空いた。図書室にポテチ常備した: Hate to use the '[24] appetite' cliche, but I'm starving. Think I'd get in trouble for stashing chips in the library？
translations.芸術の[24]だからね、▲凛▲のロック魂に火がついてるよ: Since [24] is the season of the arts, ▲凛▲'s rock soul is on fire.
translations.学校来るときに枯れ葉で肌切っちゃった、最悪: Got a cut from a dead leaf on the way to school. The worst.
translations.今日の体育、球技って……。やだ、スキーがいい！: Ball games in P.E. today... Ugh, I'd rather go skiing!
translations.▲主人公＊▲のいない教室って退屈。: A classroom without ▲主人公＊▲ is boring.
translations.やっぱ▲凛▲のメールってさ、そっけないのかな。でも、どう書けばいいかわかんないし: Guess ▲凛▲'s texts really do come off blunt. I don't know how else to write them, though.
translations.▲凛▲のメールってさ、やっぱそっけないのかな。でも妙にハシャいだ文章書くのも無理: Guess ▲凛▲'s texts really are kinda blunt. No way I can write all bubbly and hyper, though, so just bear with it.
translations.教室でヒットチャートの話するのは別にいいんだけどさ。ロック聴く人間が一人もいない: I don't care if people talk about the pop charts in class, but how does not a single person here listen to rock？
translations.午前中の授業ってさ、集中できないんだよね。頭が完全に起きてなくてさ: I just can't focus in morning classes. My brain's not all the way awake yet.
translations.最悪、今日の先生機嫌悪い。居眠りしたら怒られるかな: Ugh, the teacher's in a bad mood today. Think I'll get yelled at if I doze off？
translations.連続であてられた、しかも数学と化学。わかるわけないっつーの: Got called on twice in a row, and in math and chemistry. Like I'd ever know the answers.
translations.一日は長いね、どうしよ。: Days are so long. What am I gonna do.
translations.午後の授業ってさ、集中できないんだよね。昼食べたら眠くなるじゃん: I just can't focus in afternoon classes. You always get sleepy after lunch, right？
translations.なんとなく消化不良の日ってあるよね: Some days just feel kinda unsatisfying, don't they？
translations.授業早く終わんないかな: Wish class would just end already.
translations.寝過ぎるとさ、頭痛くなるよね。だから、てきとーに寝ることにしたよ: Sleeping too much gives you a headache, right？ So I'm just gonna nap in moderation.
translations.春だねぇ。周りも結構寝てるし、そこに▲凛▲が一人加わったところで問題ないじゃんね: Sure feels like spring. Plenty of people around me are asleep anyway, so what's the harm if ▲凛▲ joins in？ Anyway, night.
translations.春はさ、授業サボって屋上で寝るのが一番気持ちいいんだよね: In spring, nothing beats skipping class to nap on the roof.
translations.あつい！あつい！あつい！男は服の上から水を掛けてる……▲凛▲もやりたい！: Hot! Hot! Hot! The guys are pouring water right over their clothes... ▲凛▲ wants to do that too!
translations.外に枯葉が舞ってる。ジャジィだね: Dead leaves are swirling around outside. Pretty jazzy.
translations.芸術の秋だから美術の補習だってさ、冗談じゃないっつーの。至高の芸術は音楽でしょ？: Extra art class just 'cause it's 'autumn of the arts'？ Give me a break. Music is the supreme art form, right？
translations.▲凛▲は暑いの苦手だけど、だからって寒いのが平気ってわけでもないし。もう外に出た: ▲凛▲ can't stand the heat, but that doesn't mean the cold is okay either. I don't wanna go outside anymore...
translations.寒いから、ぜんっぜん集中出来ない。もともと集中してたかは、あやしいけどさ: It's so cold I can't focus at all. Not that I was really focusing to begin with, though.
translations.授業中だけどメールしてみる。▲凛▲からのメールうれしい？: In the middle of class, but figured I'd text you. Happy to get a text from ▲凛▲？
translations.▲主人公＊▲が同学年だったら、宿題見せてもらえるのに。あ、ノート渡せばやってくれ: If ▲主人公＊▲ were in my grade, I could copy your homework. Oh, if I hand over my notebook, will you do it for me？
translations.教科書がネコの写真集になればいいのににゃ: I wish my textbooks were just photo books of cats. Meow.
translations.休み時間になるとハシャぎ出すのってなんなの？: What's with everyone getting so rowdy the second break starts？
translations.たまに眺めるんだよね、ネコの写真集。でも生のネコ見たいな: I flip through cat photo books sometimes. I'd rather see a real cat, though.
translations.今、何が見えてる？とかさ、別に意味はないんだけど。: What are you looking at right now？ ...Doesn't mean anything, just asking.
translations.今日の帰りはどこ寄ろうかな: Wonder where I should stop by on the way home today.
translations.クラスの女子はカレシと好きな男の話ばっか。: All the girls in my class ever talk about are their boyfriends and crushes.
translations.さっき廊下で▲主人公＊▲のこと、見かけたよ。何してたの？: I saw you in the hall earlier, ▲主人公＊▲. What were you up to？
translations.暑くもなく寒くもなく、一番いい季節だね。だからって勉強する気はおきないけど: Not too hot, not too cold. Best season of the year. Still doesn't make me feel like studying, though.
translations.春って過ごしやすいのはいいんだけど、いまいちロックじゃないよね。のどかでさ: Spring is nice and comfortable, sure, but it's not very rock 'n' roll, is it？ Way too peaceful.
translations.どうしよ、暑くてやる気でない。もともと勉強する気はなかったけど: Man, it's too hot to do anything. Not that I was gonna study anyway.
translations.帰り道の暑さを想像すると……はぁ: Just thinking about how hot the walk home is gonna be... Ugh.
translations.秋は物悲しい季節、なんて陳腐な表現だよね: Calling autumn a melancholy season is such a cliche, isn't it？
translations.読書の秋とかいうけど、冬の方が部屋にこもって本読むイメージじゃんね。なんとなく: People say autumn's the season for reading, but winter feels way more like holing up in your room with a book. Just saying.
translations.暖房ついた教室で寝るなっていう方が無理じゃん？: How do they expect us not to fall asleep in a heated classroom？
translations.はぁ、帰り道も寒そう……: Sigh... The walk home looks freezing.
translations.わざわざ休み時間を割いてメールくれる優しいカノジョでよかったね。: Aren't you lucky to have a sweet girlfriend who takes time out of her break to text you.
translations.あのさ、教室でイチャつく人間ってどう思う？別に▲凛▲はそんなことしたくないんだけ: Hey, what do you think of people who flirt in class？ Not that I want to do that with you or anything, ▲凛▲. We're not even in the same classroom.
translations.なんかクラスメートに雑誌読まされた。「カレを誘惑する１０の小悪魔テクニック」だっ: A classmate made me read this magazine. '10 Little Devil Tricks to Seduce Your Man,' apparently.
translations.あれ、今日って何かまともなことしたっけ？って思う日ない？時間盗まれたような感覚。: Ever have those days where you wonder if you got anything worthwhile done at all？ Feels like someone stole my time.
translations.テレビ点けてみ、面白いのやってる: Turn on the TV, there's something good on.
translations.そういや宿題あったんだよね。別にやんなくてもいっか: Oh yeah, we had homework. Eh, guess I don't really need to do it.
translations.夜はスピーカーで音楽聴けないけどさ、ヘッドフォンも結構好きなんだよね。音の分離が: I can't play music on my speakers at night, but I actually really like headphones too. The sound separation's great.
translations.今読み始めた本が面白いからさ、今夜中に読破してやるんだ: This book I just started is really good. I'm gonna finish the whole thing tonight.
translations.ずっとパジャマ着てたらお母さんに怒られた。このままが楽なのに: Mom got mad at me for staying in my pajamas all day. It's way more comfortable like this, though.
translations.なんかお父さんがさ、学校であったこととかよく聞いてくるようになったんだよね。前は: For some reason, my dad's been asking me a lot about how school's going lately. He never used to do that.
translations.弟と遊ぼうと思ったのに、外に遊びに行っちゃった。子供は元気だね: I was gonna hang out with my little brother, but he ran off to play outside. Kids sure have a lot of energy.
translations.▲主人公＊▲って、休みは家で何してんの？: What do you usually do at home on days off, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.今やってるバラエティのジングルにデスジャビの曲が使われてた。たまにこういうのがあ: A variety show on right now just used a Death Jabi song for a jingle. It's fun catching little things like that sometimes.
translations.春限定ポテチの、さくらんぼ味がさ。ゲテモノかと思いきや妙にクセになるんだよね。甘: Those spring-limited cherry potato chips... I thought they'd be a total gimmick, but they're weirdly addictive. That sweet-and-salty flavor keeps you coming back.
translations.今頃、夏フェスの番組やってる。行きたいけど、面倒じゃんね: There's a show about summer music festivals on right now. I wanna go, but it's kind of a hassle, you know？
translations.お腹痛い。今日アイス２本食べたからかな: My stomach hurts. Maybe 'cause I ate two ice cream bars today.
translations.虫の鳴き声がうるさい……: The bugs outside are so loud...
translations.最近たまに寒いけどさ、風邪なんてひかないでよ。: It's been getting chilly on and off lately. Don't go catching a cold on me.
translations.テレビでスキーの特集やってる。寒いのはヤだけど、滑りたいな: There's a special on skiing on TV. I hate the cold, but I kinda wanna hit the slopes.
translations.今日は寒いから弟と一緒に寝ようかな。一緒に布団入るとさ、あったかいんだよね: It's cold today, so maybe I'll sleep with my little brother. Sharing a futon is super warm, you know.
translations.ヒマ～。ま、ヒマなのはいいことだ。▲主人公＊▲のことでも考えてよ: So bored... Well, having nothing to do is a good thing. Guess I'll just think about you, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.やっぱ自分の部屋が落ち着く。▲主人公＊▲の隣の次くらいには: My room really is the most relaxing place to be. Right after being next to you, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.外からネコの鳴き声が聞こえる。見に行こっかな: I hear a cat meowing outside. Maybe I'll go take a look.
translations.つまんない番組ばっか。なんか面白いことない？: Nothing good on TV. Got anything interesting going on？
translations.年頃の娘としてはさ、家事とか手伝った方がいいのかな: As a girl my age, think I should help out with chores more？
translations.お母さんがさ、晩御飯の準備手伝えって。上手くできるかな……: Mom told me to help with dinner. Hope I don't mess it up...
translations.弟がお母さんに怒られて泣いちゃってさ、▲凛▲がフォロー中。こうやって頼られるの、: Mom yelled at my little brother and made him cry, so ▲凛▲ is on comfort duty. Feels nice being relied on as his big sister, though.
translations.たまには、晩御飯の準備手伝ってこよっかな: Maybe I'll go help out with dinner for a change.
translations.昼間に家にいるとさ、爆音で音楽聴けるからいいよね。アイロンがけ手伝わされたけど: Being home during the day is great since I can blast my music. Got roped into helping with the ironing, though.
translations.洗濯機がこわれた。こわしたんじゃないよ、こわれたんだよ: The washing machine broke. I didn't break it, it just broke.
translations.お母さんがドラマ見て興奮してる。掃除の途中なのに: Mom's getting all worked up over some TV drama. Right in the middle of cleaning, too.
translations.眠い。弟と昼寝しよ。掃除の途中だけど: Sleepy. Gonna take a nap with my little brother. Even though I'm in the middle of cleaning.
translations.今日のご飯なんだろ。あんまり嫌いなものないといいけど: Wonder what's for dinner tonight. Hope it's not full of stuff I hate.
translations.暑い…何か食べよ。サラダくらい簡単に作れるつーの: So hot... Gonna go eat something. Hey, even I can throw a salad together.
translations.近所のゴミ収集所が凄い事になってた。あれはロックだね: The neighborhood trash spot was a total disaster zone. Pretty rock 'n' roll, honestly.
translations.秋の夕暮れってさ、詩的だよね。▲主人公＊▲には難しいかもしんないけど: Autumn sunsets are pretty poetic, huh. Might be a little over your head though, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.本を読みながらコロコロとゴミ取りしてたら、▲凛▲の周りだけキレイになったよ: I was rolling the lint roller around while reading, and now only the spot right around ▲凛▲ is clean.
translations.暑いときには熱いものを食べるのがいいとか言うけど、逆はないよね。なんでだろ: People say you should eat hot food when it's hot out, but nobody ever says the reverse. Wonder why.
translations.宿題やるの忘れてた。まぁいっか: Forgot to do my homework. Oh well.
translations.弟をお風呂に入れてきたよ。次は▲主人公＊▲の番かな？なんてね、冗談だけど: Just gave my little brother a bath. Guess ▲主人公＊▲ is up next？ Just kidding.
translations.あと何年したらさ、夜も一緒にいられるんだろね。: Wonder how many more years until we can stay together at night, too.
translations.あのさ、宿題とかやった？こっちのことは聞かないでほしいんだけど: Hey, did you do the homework？ And don't ask if I did mine.
translations.年頃の娘としてはさ、もっと家事の手伝いとかすべき？する気ないけど: As a girl my age, should I be helping out with chores more？ Not that I'm gonna.
translations.▲主人公＊▲のおかげでさ、これでも▲凛▲は毎日幸せだよ。ありがと: Thanks to you, ▲主人公＊▲, even ▲凛▲ gets to be happy every day. Thanks.
translations.布団の中から▲主人公＊▲に送信: Texting ▲主人公＊▲ from under the covers.
translations.今日も▲凛▲の一日は▲主人公＊▲とのメールで終わり！: Another day for ▲凛▲ ends with texting ▲主人公＊▲!
translations.▲主人公＊▲もあんまり夜更かししないでよ: Don't stay up too late either, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.きっと明日は早起きするから。たぶん: I'm definitely getting up early tomorrow. Probably.
translations.まだ眠くないんだけど、そろそろ寝ないと明日辛いよね。: I'm not sleepy yet, but tomorrow's gonna be rough if I don't go to bed soon.
translations.これだけ布団が気持ちいと、寝坊しない自信はないかも: My bed feels so good right now, I can't promise I won't oversleep.
translations.今日は弟が一緒に寝ようってさ。嬉しいんだけど、今の季節は暑いのがね……: My little brother wants to sleep together tonight. It's sweet and all, just kinda hot this time of year...
translations.でもこれだけ暑いと、すぐには寝られないかも: When it's this hot out, though, I don't think I'll fall asleep right away.
translations.虫がうーるーさーいーーーーー: The bugs outside are soooooo loud.
translations.まだあんま眠くないけど、寒いからもう寝る: Not really sleepy yet, but it's cold so I'm going to bed.
translations.いまから▲凛▲は冬眠に入りまーす: ▲凛▲ is officially going into hibernation now.
translations.▲主人公＊▲が風邪ひいて▲凛▲にうつされたらたまんないからさ、ちゃんとあったかく: I don't want ▲主人公＊▲ catching a cold and giving it to ▲凛▲, so bundle up tonight, okay？
translations.隣に▲主人公＊▲が居てくれたらなー、なんてね: Wish ▲主人公＊▲ was right here next to me... Just kidding.
translations.おやすみのチュッ▼とかさ、ほんとにやってる人いんのかな: Do people actually do that whole 'goodnight kiss ▼' thing in real life？
translations.▲凛▲さ、夢覚えてることってあんまりないんだよね。▲主人公＊▲が出てても忘れてる: ▲凛▲ rarely remembers her dreams. Even if you were in one, ▲主人公＊▲, I might've forgotten. Too bad.
translations.▲凛▲は今日もがんばった。ほんとがんばった。だから寝る: ▲凛▲ worked hard today too. Really hard. So I'm going to sleep.
translations.なんかそんな気分だから言っとくけど。▲凛▲、▲主人公＊▲のこと好きだよ。: Just saying this 'cause I feel like it. ▲凛▲ really likes you, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.▲凛▲なかなか寝付けないよ、▲主人公＊▲: ▲凛▲ can't seem to fall asleep, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.お父さん寝ちゃった。我が家の夜は▲凛▲のものだね。: Dad fell asleep. Tonight, the house belongs to ▲凛▲.
translations.弟の部屋まで寝顔見に行っちゃった。天使みたいにカワイイよ: I went to my little brother's room just to see him sleeping. He's cute as an angel.
translations.アイタイ。ん……やっぱいいや: Wanna see you. Mm... actually, never mind.
translations.まだ起きてる？特に用事はないんだけど、メールに付き合ってよ: Still up？ I don't really need anything, just text with me for a bit.
translations.今日の休みはどうだった？充実してた？: How was your day off today？ Was it a good one？
translations.今日中に読みたい本があったんだけど、ちょっと厳しそう。明日に持ち越すか: There was a book I wanted to finish today, but it's looking tough. Guess I'll save it for tomorrow.
translations.▲凛▲寝坊したら、▲主人公＊▲起こしにきていいよ: If ▲凛▲ oversleeps, you can come wake me up, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.深夜ラジオさ、たまにレアな曲が流れるから面白いよね。聞きながら眠っちゃったりもす: Late-night radio is great since they play rare songs sometimes. Though I end up falling asleep to it too.
translations.▲主人公＊▲もさ、こんなに暑いけど、▲凛▲とくっついて寝たい？そんなまさかね: Hey, ▲主人公＊▲, even in this heat, do you still wanna cuddle up with ▲凛▲ to sleep？ Yeah, right.
translations.コンビニ行きたいんだけど、さすがにこの時間じゃ怒られるか。子供は損だね、ほんと: I wanna go to the convenience store, but I'd definitely get in trouble this late. Being a kid really sucks.
translations.やっぱり夜食はポテチに限るね。うずしお味ならモアベター: Nothing beats potato chips for a late-night snack. Sea salt flavor is even better.
translations.別にお願いじゃないんだけどさ、寒いときは、あっためてほしいんだよ: It's not like I'm begging or anything, but when it's cold, I want you to warm me up.
translations.さむいー。▲主人公＊▲なんとかして: So coooold. Do something about it, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.▲主人公＊▲も一人で部屋にいるときってさ、やっぱ▲凛▲のこと考えたりする？: When you're alone in your room too, ▲主人公＊▲, do you end up thinking about ▲凛▲？
translations.▲主人公＊▲の夢に出てあげよっか？: Want me to show up in your dreams, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.早く明日にならないかな: I wish tomorrow would hurry up and get here.
translations.コンビニと▲主人公＊▲が居ればいい。と思う: All I need is a convenience store and ▲主人公＊▲. I think.
translations.▲凛▲のカード、貸出冊数の上限きちゃったから、勝手に▲主人公＊▲のカード使わせて: ▲凛▲'s library card hit the checkout limit, so I'm helping myself to yours, ▲主人公＊▲. Thanks.
translations.図書室でおしゃべりしてる女子の集団を注意しに行ったらさ、やっぱりホレたハレたの話: I went to shush a group of girls chatting in the library, and sure enough, they were gossiping about crushes.
translations.そういや図書室から借りてまだ読んでない本があったんだよね、片付けないと: Come to think of it, I still have a library book I haven't read yet. Need to get through that.
translations.また図書室のアンケートＢＯＸにゴミ入れてるやつがいるし: Someone put trash in the library suggestion box again, seriously.
translations.たまには部屋でゆっくり本読みたいね、家族にも邪魔されずにさ。▲主人公＊▲ならいい: Sometimes I just want to read in my room in peace, without my family bugging me. ▲主人公＊▲ gets a pass, though.
translations.休みの日はさ、ぼけーーっと過ごすのが一番。ただ、▲主人公＊▲とのデートは特別だけ: Days off are best spent totally zoning out. A date with ▲主人公＊▲ is an exception, though.
translations.そういや図書委員の仕事持ち帰ってたんだけど、やっぱめんどくさいから学校でやればい: Oh yeah, I brought some library committee work home, but it's a pain so I might as well just do it at school.
translations.休みの日には１冊ぐらい本読んでおきたいよね: I like to finish at least one book on a day off.
translations.先生が秋だけじゃなくて「春の読書週間」も作ろうってさ。結局いつでもいいわけだ: The teacher wants to start a 'Spring Reading Week' too, not just autumn. Guess any season works at this point.
translations.図書室に寝に来てるやつってなんなの？家帰って寝ろっつーの: What's with people coming to the library just to sleep？ Go home and sleep, seriously.
translations.図書室に涼みに来てる連中が多くてヤになる。喫茶店じゃないっつーの: I'm sick of all the people coming to the library just to beat the heat. It's not a cafe, seriously.
translations.外では運動部が汗流してるね……。この暑いのに、よくやる: The sports clubs are out there sweating away... I don't know how they do it in this heat.
translations.本がたくさんあって、音楽が聴けて、あとはこれでポテチがあれば完璧なんだけど。図書: Tons of books, music to listen to... if I had potato chips right now, it'd be perfect. Too bad there's no food or drink in the library.
translations.ウチの図書室って、秋の間ずっと「秋の読書週間」やってるよね。もう週間じゃないじゃ: Our library runs 'Autumn Reading Week' all autumn long. That's not even a week anymore.
translations.図書室にコタツ欲しい、▲凛▲専用のやつ。一応、▲主人公＊▲にも使わせてあげるけど: I want a kotatsu in the library, reserved just for ▲凛▲. I suppose I'd let ▲主人公＊▲ use it too, though.
translations.今月の推薦図書、珍しく面白かった。どうせヒマだろうから、読んでみたら？: This month's recommended book was actually good for once. You're probably bored anyway, so why not read it？
translations.▲凛▲もさ、もっと可愛くすべきだと思うの。別におかしな本読んだからじゃないよ: I think ▲凛▲ should try being a bit cuter too. And no, it's not because I read some weird book.
translations.▲凛▲もさ、たま～には勤労精神を発揮するわけ。えらいっしょ: Even ▲凛▲ shows a little work ethic every once in a while. Pretty impressive, right？
translations.本に囲まれる生活。これで授業がなければね。: A life surrounded by books. Now if only there were no classes.
translations.おはよ[32]珍しくスッキリ起きた。: Morning[32] Woke up feeling refreshed for once.
translations.あ～頭ボサボサ。直さないと。: Ugh, total bedhead. Gotta fix it.
translations.朝ごはん……食欲イマイチ。: Breakfast... Don't really have an appetite.
translations.とりあえず今日は……読みかけの本を読む。: Plan for today... reading the book I'm halfway through.
translations.朝ごはんは、ポテチでいいや。春限定のやつ。: Chips are fine for breakfast. The limited-edition spring ones.
translations.春は何でこんなに眠いんだろう……。: Why does spring make me so sleepy...？
translations.はあ～▲主人公＊▲は朝から元気だねえ。: Man, you sure have a lot of energy this early, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.シャワーあびて目を覚まそう。: Gonna take a shower to wake myself up.
translations.めずらしくスパっと起きた。おはよ。: Woke right up for once. Morning.
translations.布団から出られない……とりあえずオハヨ。: Can't get out of bed... Anyway, morning.
translations.さむさむさむ！▲主人公＊▲暖めに来て。: Cold, cold, cold! Come warm me up, ▲主人公＊▲.
