translations.……やっぱりもう1回寝ようかな……。: ...Maybe I'll go back to sleep after all...
translations.▲凛▲もそろそろ寝ようかな。: Maybe ▲凛▲ should head to bed soon, too.
translations.ちょうど1冊読み終わったところだったしね。: I just finished reading a book anyway.
translations.ちょうど▲主人公＊▲にメール書きかけてたとこだった。: I was just in the middle of writing you a text, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.ああ、まぶたが……重い……。: Ugh, my eyelids... are so heavy...
translations.今日に点数を付けるとしたら何点くらい？: If you had to score today, what would you give it？
translations.次の休みは一緒にあそぼ。: Let's hang out on our next day off.
translations.今朝はたっぷり寝たから朝まで起きてても……でも眠いわ。: I slept plenty this morning so I could stay up all night... Nope, still sleepy.
translations.今日は快と遊んで、なんか疲れた。: Played with Kai today. Kinda wiped out.
translations.実はすでに布団の中にいるのさ。: Truth is, I'm already in bed.
translations.布団てさ、見るだけで眠くなるよね。: Just looking at my bed makes me sleepy.
translations.夜になると結構涼しくて助かる。: Glad it cools down so much at night.
translations.夏は夜が短いから、そろそろ寝ようかな。: Summer nights are short, so I might head to bed soon.
translations.急に寒くなる夜もあるからさ、お腹出して寝ないように。: Some nights get cold all of a sudden, so don't sleep with your stomach uncovered.
translations.秋は眠いよねえ、年中眠いけどさ。: Fall makes you so sleepy, huh. Though I'm sleepy all year round.
translations.ちょっとウトウトしてた。さぶっ？: I was dozing off a bit. Brrr, it's cold？
translations.ああ～布団の暖かさがたまんない。: Man, this warm futon feels too good.
translations.今夜は▲主人公＊▲の夢、見れるかな？: Wonder if I'll dream about ▲主人公＊▲ tonight？
translations.授業中のメールはほどほどに。: Go easy on the texting during class.
translations.ちょっと居眠りしてたかも。: Might've dozed off for a bit.
translations.そっち、今なんの授業？: What class do you have right now？
translations.あーはやく学校終わって遊びに行きたいよ。: Ugh, I wish school would end already so I could go hang out.
translations.授業中。こういうのって社会に出て役立つのかねぇ？: In class. Think any of this stuff actually helps in the real world？
translations.お勉強中。今日の授業はおもしろいな。: Studying. Today's class is actually pretty interesting.
translations.授業中だっつーの！: I'm in the middle of class here!
translations.教室暑い～、うちわがほしいよ。: It's so hot in this classroom. Wish I had a fan.
translations.あー、プールの授業まだかなあ……: Man, isn't it time for pool class yet...
translations.教室に蜂が入ってきて大騒ぎ。▲凛▲は一番に逃げたよ。: A bee flew into the classroom and everyone freaked out. ▲凛▲ was the first to bolt.
translations.秋の授業は長いね。: Classes feel so long in the fall.
translations.さむさむ～！なんかあったまる方法ないかな？: Freezing! Isn't there some way to warm up？
translations.そういう▲主人公＊▲はどうなのさ、授業に集中してる？: What about you, ▲主人公＊▲？ Actually paying attention in class？
translations.眠気覚ましに、たまにメールしてよね。: Text me every now and then to keep me awake, okay.
translations.他にもメールしてる子いるねえ。: Looks like I'm not the only one texting in class.
translations.おっと！先生が横を通過！ヤバかった～: Whoa! Teacher just walked right past me! That was close.
translations.何って、お風呂入ってたんだよ。: What do you mean what？ I was in the bath.
translations.女を磨いてたトコ。お風呂でね、: Just working on my charm. In the bath, I mean.
translations.今お風呂中。ケータイ壊れないかちょっと心配。: In the bath right now. Kinda worried I'll break my phone.
translations.▲主人公＊▲ってさ、お風呂好きなほう？: Hey ▲主人公＊▲, do you like taking baths？
translations.快が乱入しようとしたんで、撃退してやった。: Kai tried barging in, so I fought him off.
translations.風呂はいいよね～1人でのんびり出来るし。: Baths are great. Nice to just relax all by myself.
translations.1日の疲れをリセット中なのさ。: Just resetting after a long day.
translations.今日はシャワーでさっさと済ませたよ: Just took a quick shower today.
translations.今日は湯船にゆっくりつかったよ。: Took a nice, long soak in the tub today.
translations.▲凛▲のお風呂想像して、コーフンする？: Does picturing ▲凛▲ in the bath get you worked up？
translations.▲主人公＊▲てさ、入浴剤使うほう？: Hey ▲主人公＊▲, do you ever use bath salts？
translations.今日は湯船につかったまま寝ちゃった。: Fell asleep right in the tub today.
translations.汗をかいたら、やっぱりお風呂かな。: After working up a sweat, a bath really hits the spot.
translations.今日は暑かったんで水風呂にしてみた。: It was hot today, so I tried taking a cold bath.
translations.お風呂で読んでた本が面白くて、思わず長風呂。: The book I was reading in the tub was so good I ended up staying in way too long.
translations.お風呂で歌うと、上手くなった気がするのは何でだろ？: Why does singing in the bath always make you feel like you've gotten better at it？
translations.▲凛▲が最後かと思ってお湯を抜いたら、まだお母さんが入ってなかったよ。: I drained the tub thinking ▲凛▲ was the last one, but Mom hadn't taken her bath yet.
translations.湯船にいきおいよく入ったら、お湯が超熱かった！煮えるとこだったよ。: I jumped right into the tub and the water was super hot! I almost boiled alive.
translations.こんど一緒にお風呂……って言ったら、エロいこと想像する？: If I said let's take a bath together sometime... would you get dirty thoughts？
translations.そんなわけで、今日はもう寝る。: Anyway, I'm going to bed for the night.
translations.何って、ごはん食べてるよ。: What am I doing？ I'm eating.
translations.ちょうどごはん食べてるとこ。: I'm right in the middle of eating.
translations.昼だから、昼ごはんを食べてる。: It's noon, so I'm eating lunch.
translations.ごはん食べながらのメールは打ちにくいな。: It's hard to type out a text while eating.
translations.冷蔵庫に高いアイスが1個だけある。今から奪い合いだ。: There's just one expensive ice cream in the fridge. Time to fight over it.
translations.今日の料理は▲凛▲も手伝った。チョットだけどね。: Today ▲凛▲ helped with the cooking too. Just a little bit, though.
translations.メールしてたらお父さんに怒られたよ。: Dad got mad at me for texting.
translations.▲主人公＊▲も一緒に食べたい？: Do you want to eat together too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.ところでアスパラって好き？: By the way, do you like asparagus？
translations.暑いとあんまり食欲わかないなあ。: I don't really have much of an appetite when it's hot out.
translations.デザートのアイス2個目。へっへ～！: On my second ice cream for dessert. Heheh!
translations.秋といえば[35]だね。: When it comes to fall, it has to be [35].
translations.冬といえば、[35]。: When it comes to winter, it's all about [35].
translations.今日は寄せ鍋だった。▲主人公＊▲は何鍋が好き？: We had yosenabe today. What kind of hot pot do you like, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.めずらしく学食でカレー食べてる。: I'm eating curry in the school cafeteria for a change.
translations.今日のお昼は購買部で買ったメロンパンと牛乳。: Lunch today is melon bread and milk from the school store.
translations.今日は手抜きでカップめん。: Taking it easy today with cup noodles.
translations.おなか一杯になると眠くなるんだよね。: Getting full always makes me sleepy.
translations.とりあえず、食べるほうに集中。: For now, I'm going to focus on eating.
translations.食べ終わったらちゃんと歯を磨くこと。: Make sure you brush your teeth after you finish eating.
translations.宿題が出てるんで、さっさと片付けてるとこ。: We got homework, so I'm knocking it out right now.
translations.ふう、ちょっと休憩すっかな。: Phew, think I'll take a little break.
translations.▲主人公＊▲は何してんの？: What are you up to, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.▲主人公＊▲も▲凛▲を見習え。: ▲主人公＊▲, you should be more like ▲凛▲.
translations.学生の本分だからねえ、ちゃんとやるよ……たまには。: It's a student's duty, after all. I do study properly... sometimes.
translations.さっさと終わらせて、読みかけの本を読むよ。: I'm gonna knock this out fast and get back to the book I'm reading.
translations.今日はなんか、めんどくさい宿題だなあ。: Today's homework is kind of a pain.
translations.▲主人公＊▲上級生なんだから、家庭教師してよ。: ▲主人公＊▲, you're an upperclassman, so tutor me.
translations.▲主人公＊▲は[40]って得意？: ▲主人公＊▲, are you any good at [40]？
translations.あーもう眠いわ。一回寝てからやろうかな。: Ugh, I'm so sleepy. Maybe I'll take a nap first and do it later.
translations.ゲームやりたいけど、とりあえずもーちょっとがんばる。: I wanna play games, but I'll power through a little longer for now.
translations.1問解くたびにクッキー1枚食べる……とかにしたら太るかな。: If I eat a cookie after every problem I solve... think I'll get fat？
translations.集中するためにエアコンつけてるよ。: I've got the AC on so I can focus.
translations.脳を働かせるには、糖分がいいんだよね。: Sugar's good for getting your brain working, you know.
translations.ラジオ聴きながら[40]の宿題中。: Doing my [40] homework while listening to the radio.
translations.コタツで勉強してると、いつの間にか寝てるよね。: Whenever you study at the kotatsu, you end up falling asleep before you know it.
translations.寒いんで服を7枚着てみた。▲凛▲ぬいぐるみみたいだよ。: It's cold, so I tried putting on 7 layers. Makes ▲凛▲ look like a stuffed animal.
translations.▲主人公＊▲と一緒に勉強できれば楽しいのにな[32]: It'd be fun if I could study with you, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.もーちょっとだからガンバるか……。: Almost done, so I guess I'll push through...
translations.ふぁ～！今日何回目のあくびだろう。: *Yaaawn*! Wonder how many times I've yawned today.
translations.低血圧に朝はしんどいよ。: Mornings are rough when you have low blood pressure.
translations.石を蹴りながら歩くのって時間かかるな。: Walking while kicking a rock along really takes forever.
translations.今日は快にたたき起こされた。: Kai dragged me out of bed today.
translations.今日も半分終わりか。: Guess the day's half over already.
translations.今日の学校もだいたい終わり: School's pretty much done for today.
translations.ふう、やっと目がさめてきた。そろそろ本気出そうかな。: Phew, I'm finally waking up. Guess I'll start getting serious soon.
translations.ようやく、今日の一日も終わりだね。: Today's finally coming to an end, huh.
translations.さて、今日は何しよっかな。: All right, what should I do today？
translations.せっかくの休みの日がもうすぐ終わるなあ。毎日休みならいいのに。: My day off is almost over already. Wish every day was a day off.
translations.▲凛▲さ、猫飼いたい。10匹くらい。: You know, ▲凛▲ wants to get a cat. Like, ten of 'em.
translations.あ！CD落としたらケースにヒビが入った！: Ah! I dropped my CD and the case cracked!
translations.今、なんかいいメロディが浮かんだ。作曲ってどうやるんだろう。: A pretty good melody just came to me. Wonder how you go about writing a song.
translations.レシピに縛られるのもいやだから、こんど自由に作ってみようかな。創作料理ってやつ？: I hate being tied down to a recipe, so maybe I'll try just winging it next time. Creative cooking, I guess？
translations.何って、今日は図書委員会。: What do you mean？ It's library committee today.
translations.委員会の打ち合わせ。▲主人公＊▲なんで来てないの？: A committee meeting. Why aren't you here, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.今日の議題は図書の電子化について。なんかハイテクだね。: Today's topic is digitizing the books. Kind of high-tech, huh.
translations.議論が白熱……は、してないなあ。: The discussion is really heating up... or not.
translations.今日はなんか、盛り上がってるな。: Things are kind of lively today.
translations.今日は古い書籍の寄付についてのミーティング中: In a meeting about donating old books today.
translations.今日は読書エリアのレイアウトについてミーティング。: Having a meeting about the reading area layout today.
translations.夏休みの長期貸し出しルールについてミーティング中。: In a meeting about long-term loan rules for summer break.
translations.暑いなあ。はやく終わらないかな。: It's so hot. I wish this would end already.
translations.図書室の利用マナーについてミーティング中。: In a meeting about library etiquette.
translations.最近、本の貸し出しが減ってるみたい。嘆かわしいなあ。: Looks like fewer books are getting checked out lately. What a shame.
translations.新学期向けの図書購入について打ち合わせ中。: In a meeting about buying books for the new term.
translations.来年度はブルーレイディスクも増やすみたい。もっと米文学とか入れて欲しいのにな。: Looks like they're adding more Blu-rays next year. I wish they'd get more American literature instead.
translations.▲主人公＊▲も参加しなよ。: You should join in too, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.今日はもう終わるみたい。: Looks like we're wrapping up for today.
translations.今日は休んでる委員が多いな。: A lot of committee members are absent today.
translations.あーなんか、体だるい。: Ugh, I feel kind of sluggish.
translations.良いか悪いかでいうと、悪い方。: If I had to say good or bad, I'd say bad.
translations.良いか悪いかでいうと、良い方。: If I had to say good or bad, I'd say good.
translations.学校休もうかなあ。どうしよ。: Maybe I'll take the day off school. Not sure what to do.
translations.もーちょっとしたら元気出るかも: I might feel better in a little bit.
translations.熱は無いみたいだけど。: Doesn't seem like I have a fever, though.
translations.メール打つのもちょっとしんどい。: Even texting is a little tiring right now.
translations.朝はまあ、こんなもんだけどね。: Well, I'm always like this in the morning, though.
translations.あーなんか面白いことない？: Ugh, isn't there anything fun going on？
translations.▲主人公＊▲に会ったら元気になるかな？: Think I'd feel better if I saw you, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.なんか美味しいもの食べたら、もっと元気になるかも。: Maybe I'll feel even better if I eat something good.
translations.なんかいい曲聴いたら、もっと元気になるかも。: Maybe I'll feel even better if I listen to a good song.
translations.▲主人公＊▲のメールでちょっと元気出たかも。: Your text cheered me up a little, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.テレビで見た占いもわりと良かったしね。: My horoscope on TV was pretty good, too.
translations.▲主人公＊▲からたくさんメール貰えれば、もっと元気になるかもね[32]: Getting lots of texts from you might make me feel even better, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.格ゲーの勝率も最近いいんだよね。: My win rate in fighting games has been pretty good lately, too.
translations.偶然みつけた小説がおもしろくてさ。今度貸してあげる。: I stumbled across a really good novel. I'll lend it to you sometime.
translations.そういう▲主人公＊▲はハッピー？: What about you, ▲主人公＊▲？ Are you happy？
translations.朝ごはんもいっぱい食べたし、パワー全開かも[32]: I ate a big breakfast too, so I think I'm at full power[32]
translations.朝から猫をたくさん撫でたしね。: Plus I got to pet a lot of cats this morning.
translations.いまなら[41]三杯食べられそう。: I feel like I could eat three bowls of [41] right now.
translations.どした？▲凛▲が怒ってるとか思った？: What's wrong？ Did you think ▲凛▲ was mad at you？
translations.こういうメール、時々はいいけど、しつこいのは減点だから。: Texts like this are nice once in a while, but don't overdo it or you'll lose points.
translations.まあ、悪い気はしないよ。▲凛▲も▲主人公＊▲のことスキ。: Well, I don't mind hearing it. ▲凛▲ likes ▲主人公＊▲ too.
translations.次は直接、▲主人公＊▲の口で言って。: Next time, say it to me in person, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.ちょうど気分がふさいでたんだけど、▲主人公＊▲のメールでちょっと元気出た。: I was actually feeling a bit down, so getting a text from ▲主人公＊▲ cheered me up a little.
translations.メール見たら、なんか会いたくなってきた。: Seeing your text kinda makes me want to see you.
translations.きっと▲凛▲も同じくらい▲主人公＊▲のことがスキ。: I'm sure ▲凛▲ likes ▲主人公＊▲ just as much.
translations.▲凛▲はそれほどでも……なんて言うと思った？うそうそ、大好き[32]: Did you think ▲凛▲ was gonna say "not that much..."？ Just kidding, I love you[32]
translations.メールが来るような気がしてたんだよね。LOVEメールがさ[32]: I had a feeling I'd get a text from you. A love text, that is[32]
translations.あなたの声で聴きたいな、そのセリフ[32]: I wanna hear you say that line out loud[32]
translations.油断してたから、ちょっと顔がにやけちゃったよ。誰かに見られてないかな？: You caught me off guard and made me grin. Hope nobody saw me？
translations.そんな事言うから会いたくなったよ。会えるかな？: Saying stuff like that makes me wanna see you. Think we can meet up？
translations.キス……したいな。今すぐ[32]: I wanna... kiss you. Right now[32]
translations.キス……しようよ。いますぐに会いたいな[32]: Let's... kiss. I really wanna see you right now[32]
translations.会いたいかも。: I think I wanna see you.
translations.▲主人公＊▲に会えば元気でるかな？: Think seeing ▲主人公＊▲ will cheer me up？
translations.会いたいか会いたくないかで言えば、会いたいかな？: If I had to choose between wanting to see you or not, I guess I do？
translations.時間あるなら、どっかで会う？: If you've got time, wanna meet up somewhere？
translations.今から会えるかな？: Can we meet up right now？
translations.▲凛▲はそうでもない……ウソウソ[32]: ▲凛▲ can't say the same... Just kidding[32]
translations.いつでも会えるってわかってるのにね。: Even though we know we can see each other anytime.
translations.今からダッシュで行けば、何分くらいで会えるかなあ？: If I dash over right now, how many minutes till we can meet？
translations.じゃあさ、今すぐに会いたい！: Then I wanna see you right now!
translations.すぐに会えるかなあ？: Think we can see each other soon？
translations.▲凛▲もちょうど▲主人公＊▲の事考えてたよ。: ▲凛▲ was just thinking about ▲主人公＊▲, too.
translations.それは▲凛▲から言おうと思ってたのにぃ[32]: ▲凛▲ was gonna say that first, though[32]
translations.ホント？今すぐ会えるかな？: Really？ Can we meet up right now？
translations.今すぐ会いたい[32]: I wanna see you right now[32]
translations.会ってさ……その……キスしたいな[32]: I wanna see you and... um... kiss[32]
translations.忙しいなら仕方ないね。: Can't be helped if you're busy.
translations.まあ、連絡なしで無視されるよりいいけどさ。: Well, beats getting ignored without a word, I guess.
translations.とりあえず待ってる。メールはいいんだよね。: I'll wait for now. Texting is still okay, right？
translations.▲凛▲も暇なわけじゃないから、いいけど。: It's not like ▲凛▲ had nothing to do either, so whatever.
translations.何で忙しいのかは聞かないけどさ、無理しないようにね。: I won't ask what's keeping you busy, just don't overdo it.
translations.そんなこと言わないでさ、なんとか時間作って遊ぼうよ。: Don't say that. Make some time somehow and let's hang out.
translations.時間が出来たらデートできる？: Can we go on a date once you have time？
translations.じゃあ▲凛▲も忙しくなろっと: Guess ▲凛▲ will keep busy too, then.
translations.会えないんだったら、その間何かやること考えよっと。: If we can't meet up, I'll figure out something else to do in the meantime.
translations.じゃあ、しばらく会えない？そんなに忙しい？: So we can't see each other for a while？ You're that busy？
translations.睡眠はしっかりとったほうがいいらしいよ。無理すんな。: They say you should make sure to get plenty of sleep. Don't push yourself.
translations.じゃあ、いつでもいいから時間ができたらデート。ね[32]: Then let's go on a date whenever you get some time. Okay[32]
translations.早く会えるように努力してね、▲凛▲応援してるから。: Work hard so we can see each other soon. ▲凛▲ will be cheering for you.
translations.電話やメールはいいよね？: Calls and texts are still okay, right？
translations.忙しくなくなるのはいつ？▲凛▲待ってるから: When will things calm down for you？ ▲凛▲ will be waiting.
translations.▲凛▲はそんなに忙しくもないから、いつでも声かけていいよ。: ▲凛▲ won't be all that busy, so just hit me up anytime.
translations.じゃあさ、1回のデートを濃密な感じにしようよ。だったら▲凛▲も我慢できるから。: Then let's make each date really count. That way ▲凛▲ can hold out.
translations.ちゃんとメールをくれただけで嬉しいよ。: I'm happy just that you took the time to text me.
translations.ヒマなときじゃないとメールしないとかだったら、カレシとして最悪。: If you only text me when you're bored, you're the worst boyfriend ever.
translations.若いんだから、なんかポジティブに動こうよ。▲凛▲はめんどうだけど。: You're young, so go do something constructive. ▲凛▲ can't be bothered, though.
translations.勉強でもしてれば？: Why don't you study or something？
translations.筋トレでもしてれば？: Why don't you work out or something？
translations.散歩でもしてくれば？: Why don't you go for a walk or something？
translations.全力で町内１周走ってくるといい。: You should go sprint a lap around the neighborhood.
translations.円周率の暗記でもしてれば？: Why don't you memorize pi or something？
translations.オススメのCDあるけど、貸そうか？: I've got a CD I recommend. Want to borrow it？
translations.青春の無駄遣いな気もするけど、そんな日もあっていいと思う。: Feels like a waste of youth, but I think it's fine to have days like that.
translations.デートにいく場所でも考えようよ。: Let's think of places to go on a date.
translations.一緒にゲームでもする？: Want to play a game together or something？
translations.▲主人公＊▲と会ってない時はヒマだね。: It's boring when I'm not with ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.よし、メールでいいなら付き合うよ。: Alright, I'll keep you company if texting is enough.
translations.そういうときはさ、デートのプランを考えればいいんじゃない？: At times like that, why not plan out a date？
translations.だから、いっぱいメールすればいいよ。▲凛▲に。: Then you should just send lots of texts. To ▲凛▲.
translations.もっとデートの約束をたくさんしておけばよかったね。: We should've made more plans for dates.
translations.じゃあさ、▲凛▲の好きなトコ、１０個言ってみてよ[32]: Then tell me 10 things you like about ▲凛▲[32]
translations.あーあ、はやく次のデートの日になればいいのに～。: Man, I wish our next date would hurry up and get here.
translations.▲凛▲わりと機嫌悪いんだけど。: ▲凛▲'s in kind of a bad mood, though.
translations.なんかニヤけてる▲主人公＊▲の顔が目に浮かぶ。: I can picture ▲主人公＊▲ grinning right now.
translations.あー▲凛▲もあやかりたいよ。: Man, I wish some of that luck would rub off on ▲凛▲.
translations.何かいいことあったの？: Did something good happen to you？
translations.今度会った時に聞いてあげるから、落ち着きなさい。: Calm down. I'll hear you out next time we meet.
translations.かわいいネコでも見つけた？: Did you spot a cute cat or something？
translations.▲凛▲が出てくる夢でも見た？: Did you have a dream with ▲凛▲ in it or something？
translations.▲主人公＊▲が楽しそうだと、▲凛▲もなんとなく気分いいよ。: When ▲主人公＊▲ seems happy, it kind of puts ▲凛▲ in a good mood too.
translations.ゲームでレアアイテムでも拾った？: Did you find a rare item in a game or something？
translations.アイスでアタリでも出た？: Did you get a winning popsicle stick or something？
translations.何を隠そう、▲凛▲も気分がいい: Truth be told, ▲凛▲ feels pretty good too.
translations.なんか子供っぽいメールだね。: That's kind of a childish text.
translations.いいなあ、▲凛▲も気分よくなりたい。: Must be nice. ▲凛▲ wants to be in a good mood too.
translations.そんなときは▲凛▲におまかせ。: When that happens, just leave it to ▲凛▲.
translations.まあそんな時もあるよ。元気だせ。: Well, we all have days like that. Cheer up.
translations.「少し」ならいいじゃん。「ものすごく」になったら相談にのるよ。: If it's just "a little," you're fine. Come talk to me if it turns into "a lot."
translations.なぐさめてほしい？: Want me to cheer you up？
translations.▲凛▲が相談にのろうか？: Want to talk to ▲凛▲ about it？
translations.困った時は▲凛▲の事を思い出せばダイジョブ。: Whenever you're in a bind, just think of ▲凛▲ and you'll be fine.
translations.不味いものでも食べた？: Did you eat something gross or what？
translations.そんな日もあるよ。気にしないことだね。: You get days like that. Best not to dwell on it.
translations.そういう時はネコ！いいネコスポットがあるから、今度教えるよ。: That calls for cats! I know a good cat spot, so I'll show you next time.
translations.人生は長いんだしさ、落ち込むこともあるよ。: Life's long. You're bound to feel down sometimes.
translations.心配だなあ。▲凛▲で力になれることある？: Now I'm worried. Is there anything ▲凛▲ can do to help？
translations.アンタがそういうこと言うから、▲凛▲もちょっと落ち込みそう。: Hearing you talk like that makes ▲凛▲ feel a little down too.
translations.そういう時は、美味しいモノを食べれば元気でるよ。: Eating something good always perks you up at times like that.
translations.いっしょにネコを撫でにいこうか？絶対に元気出るからさ。: Want to go pet some cats together？ That's guaranteed to cheer you up.
translations.▲凛▲を撫でさせてあげるよ。ニャーニャー[32]: I'll let you pet ▲凛▲. Meow, meow.[32]
translations.▲凛▲と初めてキスした時のことを思い出して……ほら、元気出てきた？: Think back to your first kiss with ▲凛▲... See？ Feeling better yet？
translations.元気が出る呪文、はぴかむりんくる～♪元気で～ろでろ[32]: Here's a magic spell to cheer you up: Happy-Come-Rinkle~♪ Feel bet~ter![32]
translations.もーしょうがないな。: Geez, what am I gonna do with you.
translations.元気出して行こうよ。: Come on, keep your chin up.
translations.弱音はいてもしょーがないっしょ。ガンバレ！: Whining isn't gonna help. Hang in there!
translations.何に疲れた？まさか▲凛▲？: What's got you so tired？ Not ▲凛▲, I hope？
translations.愚痴ですか、じゃあなぐさめてあげよう。よちよち。: Venting, huh？ Fine, I'll comfort you. There, there.
translations.なんか無理してる？: Are you pushing yourself too hard？
translations.そんなときはドーピング。栄養ドリンクをガブ飲みしてみ。: That calls for a little doping. Go chug an energy drink.
translations.寝るしかないよ。寝る子は元気！: Just go to sleep. Sleep is the best medicine!
translations.メールはいいから、お風呂入って寝ちゃいなさい！: Forget texting me, go take a bath and get to bed!
translations.たまにはのんびりするのも大事。寝ちゃえ！: It's important to take it easy sometimes. Go to sleep!
translations.疲れてるだけなら大丈夫。すぐ回復するって。: If you're just tired, you'll be fine. You'll bounce right back.
translations.▲凛▲も疲れてるけど、▲主人公＊▲のメールでちょっと元気出たよ。: ▲凛▲ is tired too, but getting a text from ▲主人公＊▲ cheered me up a little.
translations.疲れるのは良いことだよ。……たぶん。: Being tired is a good thing. ...Probably.
translations.疲れはガンバった証拠だからね。: Being tired just proves how hard you worked.
translations.デートまでにはパワー全開にして、遊びまくろうよ[32]: Get back to full power by our date so we can go all out.[32]
translations.元気があれば何でも出来る！って、偉い人が言ってた。: "As long as you've got your spirits up, you can do anything!" Some famous guy said that.
translations.なんか手伝うことある？マッサージしてあげよっか？: Need help with anything？ Want me to give you a massage？
translations.疲れてるのにメールありがと[32]元気になったら▲凛▲とデートしようよ[32]: Thanks for texting even though you're tired[32] Once you feel better, take ▲凛▲ on a date[32]
translations.▲凛▲が肩もんであげようか？: Want ▲凛▲ to rub your shoulders for you？
translations.若いんだら、疲れなんて一晩寝れば吹き飛ぶよ。そしたらデートしよ[32]: You're young, so a good night's sleep will fix you right up. Then let's go on a date[32]
translations.回復魔法をかけてあげよう。はぴかむりんくる～♪ひーりんぐしゃわ～～～[32]: I'll cast a healing spell on you. Happy Come Rinkle~♪ Healing Shower~~~[32]
translations.ご機嫌いかが？なんて、かしこまってみました: How do you do？ Just trying to sound a little formal.
translations.今日も元気にいこ？: Let's have a great day today, okay？
translations.今日もマナカが一緒だよ？なんて: I'm right here with you today too, okay？ Just kidding.
translations.午後も元気にいこー！: Let's keep it up this afternoon too!
translations.また明日もがんばろ？: Let's do our best tomorrow too, okay？
translations.あとでメールちょうだいね: Send me a text later, okay？
translations.今日は早めにお風呂入っちゃおっと: Think I'll take an early bath tonight.
translations.お休みだけど、早く起きるのもいいよね: Even on a day off, waking up early feels nice, doesn't it？
translations.今日の▲主人公＊▲の運勢はどうかな？わたしはいい感じなの: Wonder how your luck is today, ▲主人公＊▲？ Mine's looking pretty good!
translations.今日の目覚めはどう？: How are you feeling this morning？
translations.遅刻しないように、時間にはゆとりをもってね: Give yourself plenty of time so you won't be late, okay？
translations.眠いときは、少し体を動かすといいよ？: When you're sleepy, moving around a bit really helps, you know？
translations.なんだかポカポカしてて、また眠っちゃいそう: It's so nice and warm, I feel like I'm gonna fall back asleep.
translations.窓をあけたら、お花のいい香りがしてきたよ: I opened the window and caught the nicest scent of flowers.
translations.気持ちよく汗をかくには、水分補給をしっかりね: Make sure you drink plenty of water if you're working up a sweat.
translations.昨日は寝苦しかったな、▲主人公＊▲は大丈夫だった？: It was so hard to sleep last night. Were you okay, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.眠りやすくなってきたから、うっかり眠りすぎちゃいそう: It's gotten so much easier to sleep lately, I might accidentally oversleep.
translations.もう寒くなってきたから、[22]には気をつけてね: It's getting cold out, so watch out for [22], okay？
translations.こんなにも寒いときは、…ううん、なんでもないっ！: When it's this cold out... Never mind, it's nothing!
translations.今日はちょっと眠たいな。昨日の夜▲主人公＊▲のこと考えてたから: I'm a little sleepy today. I was up thinking about you last night, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.わたしが今日起きて、一番最初に何したかわかる？このメール送ったんだよ: Guess what the very first thing I did when I woke up today was？ Sending you this text!
translations.気持ちがいい朝だね、いいことがありそうだよ？: What a nice morning. Feels like something good's going to happen, don't you think？
translations.二度寝なんかしちゃダメだよ？: Don't go falling back asleep, okay？
translations.朝ご飯食べてきた？お勉強がはかどるよ。集中、集中: Did you eat breakfast？ It really helps you study better. Time to focus!
translations.体育って好き？わたしは部活以外で体を動かすのも楽しくて好きだな: Do you like P.E.？ I think it's fun getting to move around outside of club practice too.
translations.今日は体育の授業があるから、気合入れちゃおっと: We have P.E. today, so I'm gonna give it my all!
translations.ちゃんと朝ご飯食べないと、４時間目でお腹が鳴らないかドキドキしちゃうね: If you don't eat a good breakfast, you spend all of 4th period worrying your stomach's gonna growl.
translations.[23]に、ファッション雑誌見せてもらったの。やっぱりお勉強しなくちゃね？: [23] let me look at her fashion magazine. Guess I really ought to study up on that too, huh？
translations.[23]にスキンケア教えてもらっちゃった。▲主人公＊▲も、教えてほしい？: [23] gave me some skincare tips. Want me to share them with you too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.今日はなんだか、お勉強がはかどるなぁ。昨日良く眠れたからかな？: I'm getting so much studying done today. Maybe it's because I slept so well last night？
translations.なんだかみんなソワソワしてる。[24]だもんね。しかたないよね。: Everyone seems kind of restless today. Well, it is [24], so I guess it's no wonder.
translations.鼻がムズムズする。[22]かな？それとも▲主人公＊▲が噂してるのかな？: My nose is tickling. Could it be [22]？ Or is ▲主人公＊▲ talking about me behind my back？
translations.教室で[25]がシャツ脱いじゃった。恥ずかしいなぁ: [25] just took his shirt off in the classroom. I don't know where to look...
translations.今日は家に帰ったらすぐシャワー浴びよ。▲主人公＊▲も汗かいたままにしちゃダメだよ: I'm taking a shower the second I get home today. Don't stay all sweaty either, okay, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.芸術の[24]だし、美術の授業がんばっちゃお？: Since [24] is the season for the arts, maybe I'll really put my heart into art class？
translations.食欲の[24]だし、家庭科の授業でお菓子作りたいな: [24] always gives me an appetite. I hope we get to make sweets in home ec!
translations.教室でもコート脱がない人が結構いるみたい。寒いもんね: Quite a few people aren't even taking their coats off in class. It really is cold.
translations.今日の体育はマラソンだよ。怪我しないように、ちゃんと準備運動しないとね: We're running long-distance in P.E. today. Gotta warm up properly so I don't get hurt.
translations.ねぇ、好きだよ▼学校ではこんなこと、口に出して言えないもんね？: Hey... I love you, ▼. I can't exactly say that out loud at school, right？
translations.[23]たちが、カレシの話題で盛り上がってるの。わたしも参加しちゃおうかな、なん: [23] and the girls are having a big talk about boyfriends. Maybe I should join in... just kidding.
translations.[25]たちが、好きなアイドルの話してる。▲主人公＊▲もそういうの、好きなのかな: [25] and the guys are talking about their favorite idols. Are you into that kind of thing too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.[25]たちが、理想のタイプの話で盛り上がってるみたい。▲主人公＊▲も、そういう: [25] and his friends are getting really into a talk about their ideal types. Does that stuff interest you too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.ねぇ、授業中にマンガ読んでる人がいる。[26,2]に見つかっちゃわないかな: Hey, someone's reading manga in the middle of class. I hope [26,2] doesn't catch them.
translations.授業中にメールするのってドキドキしちゃう。ほんとはいけないよね: Texting during class makes my heart race. We really shouldn't be doing this, huh.
translations.午前中の授業って特に集中できるよね。でも▲主人公＊▲にメールしてたら説得力ないか: It's so much easier to focus during morning classes. Though I guess saying that while texting ▲主人公＊▲ isn't very convincing.
translations.コラっ！よそ見は、いけませんよ！なんて、ビックリした？: Hey! Eyes front, mister! ...Just kidding. Did I scare you？
translations.新しいノートに書くのって気持ちいいよね: Writing in a brand-new notebook feels so nice, doesn't it？
translations.復習だけでもしておくの、おすすめだよ: Even just reviewing your notes makes a big difference. I really recommend it!
translations.犯人はあなたです！なんて。急でビックリした？: You're the culprit! ...Just kidding. Did I catch you off guard？
translations.お勉強がんばれば、その分放課後が楽しくなるよ。: The harder you study now, the more fun after school will be.
translations.今日はあったかくて気持ちいいね。学校抜け出して遊びに行きたいぐらい、なんて: It's so nice and warm today. Almost makes me want to skip school and go hang out... just kidding.
translations.今、ぼーっとしちゃってた。いけないいけない、集中しなくちゃ、ね？: I totally spaced out just now. Whoops, gotta stay focused, right？
translations.これだけ[19]と、外で思いっきり汗かくのも気持ちいいかも？: When it's this [19], working up a good sweat outside might actually feel pretty nice, huh？
translations.みんな朝からグッタリしてる。[19]もんね: Everyone looks wiped out already this morning. Well, it is [19].
translations.もうお腹空いてきちゃった。でもこれ、食欲の[24]のせいだからね？: I'm getting hungry already. I'm blaming it on my [24] appetite, okay？
translations.[24]って、一番お勉強がはかどる季節だと思わない？: Don't you think [24] is the best season for getting studying done？
translations.今日も[19]ね、うう、お勉強に集中できるかな: It's [19] again today. Ugh, I hope I can stay focused on my studies.
translations.[22]が流行ってるね。▲主人公＊▲も[22]には気を付けてね？: [22] is going around lately. Make sure you watch out for [22] too, ▲主人公＊▲, okay？
translations.▲主人公＊▲が隣の席なら、教科書忘れましたって、さりげなく近寄れるのにな。なんて: If you sat next to me, ▲主人公＊▲, I could say I forgot my textbook as an excuse to scoot closer... just kidding.
translations.今ね、あてられた問題解いたら[26,2]に褒められちゃった。▲主人公＊▲にも褒め: I got called on in class just now and [26,2] praised me for getting it right. I wouldn't mind some praise from ▲主人公＊▲ too... just kidding.
translations.こっちの教室、居眠りしてる人がたくさんいるの。そろそろ[26,2]が起こす頃かな: Lots of people are dozing off in my classroom. I bet [26,2] is gonna wake them up any minute now.
translations.今はのんびり……。午後もこんな感じかな: Just taking it easy right now... Wonder if the afternoon will be like this too.
translations.次の授業はマラソン。教室からわたしのこと見えるかな？: We have a long-distance run next period. Think you'll be able to see me from your classroom？
translations.ふぅ、ほんのちょっと息抜き。▲主人公＊▲は何してる？: Phew, just taking a quick breather. What are you up to, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.さっきの授業の公式、ちょっと難しかったな。帰ってから復習、復習: The formula from last period was a little tough. Gotta review it once I get home!
translations.教室でカレシと仲良さそうにしてる子がいる。うらやましくなんて、ないよ？: There's a girl in my class being all lovey-dovey with her boyfriend. Not that I'm jealous or anything, okay？
translations.今日は家に帰ったらお菓子作ろうかな。お腹空いたからじゃ、ないよ？: Maybe I'll bake some sweets when I get home today. And no, it's not just because I'm hungry!
translations.女の子同士で手紙のやり取りをしてるんだけど、▲主人公＊▲も欲しい？: Us girls have been passing notes to each other. Want me to write you one too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.さっき廊下で▲主人公＊▲のこと、見てたんだけど、気づいた？: I saw you in the hall earlier, ▲主人公＊▲. Did you notice me looking？
translations.今日、通学のとき、道路にタンポポが咲いてたのを見かけたんだけど、応援したくなっち: I saw a dandelion blooming right through the pavement on my way to school today. It made me wanna cheer it on!
translations.やっぱり教室にはクーラーが欲しいよね。[26,2]にお願いしてみようかな: We really need A/C in the classrooms. Maybe I'll try asking [26,2].
translations.水道の水がお湯になってる。太陽ってすごいね: The tap water is coming out warm! The sun really is amazing.
translations.窓の外に枯葉が舞ってる、あの葉っぱでおイモ焼いたら美味しいかな？: Dead leaves are blowing around outside the window. Wonder if roasted sweet potatoes would taste good cooked in those？
translations.恋愛小説を買ってみました。本当は推理小説が良かったんだけど、こういうのもいいよね: I bought a romance novel to try out. I actually wanted a mystery, but this kind of book is nice too.
translations.教室にストーブがあるのはいいけど、休み時間には換気もしないとね。そっちの教室は大: Having a heater in the classroom is nice, but we really need to air out the room between classes. Is your classroom doing okay？
translations.今日も寒そう。練習のとき大変かな: Looks like another cold day. Practice might be rough later.
translations.今のうちに宿題終わらせれば、放課後は▲主人公＊▲と遊べる、かな: If I finish my homework right now, maybe I can hang out with you after school, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.休み時間にメールばかりしてたら、ヘンかな。▲主人公＊▲に送ってるの、わかっちゃう: Is it weird if I'm constantly texting between classes？ Wonder if people can tell I'm texting you, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.休み時間になると、男の子って元気になるよね。▲主人公＊▲もかな？: Boys always get so lively the second class lets out. Are you like that too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.授業のノート、取り逃しちゃった。今度見せてね？: I missed some of the notes in class. Let me see yours sometime, okay？
translations.今やってるテレビにウサギさんが出てる。カワイイ▼: There's a little bunny on TV right now. It's so cute▼
translations.ずっとピアノ弾いてたらママに怒られちゃった。つい時間忘れちゃったの、ご近所迷惑だ: Mom scolded me for playing the piano too long. I totally lost track of time... Gotta be considerate of the neighbors.
translations.今パパがいないから、ママと二人でご飯食べながらテレビ観ちゃった。お行儀悪いけど、: Dad's not home right now, so Mom and I watched TV while eating dinner. It's bad manners, but it felt kinda thrilling and fun!
translations.パパとママと３人でクイズ番組観てるんだけど、わたしが一番成績がよかったんだよ？ふ: I'm watching a quiz show with Mom and Dad, and I got the most answers right! Hehe, Dad's so frustrated.
translations.[24]のお料理って、なにが思い付く？季節のお料理、作ってみたいな: What comes to mind when you think of [24] dishes？ I'd love to try cooking something seasonal.
translations.今日テレビでやってたテニスの試合、観た？すごかったね、わたしも練習しなきゃ！: Did you see the tennis match on TV today？ It was amazing! I need to get practicing too!
translations.お休みの日に家でお勉強するのって、おかしいのかな？: Is it weird to spend a day off studying at home？
translations.今日は患者さんのお孫さんが家に遊びに来たから、お医者さんごっこしたよ。▲主人公＊: A patient's grandkid came over today, so we played doctor together. Wanna play too, ▲主人公＊▲？ Just kidding!
translations.[24]だからって、寝坊しちゃダメだよ？: Don't sleep in just because it's [24], okay？
translations.あったかくなったけど、窓開けて寝ちゃダメだよ？: It's gotten warmer out, but don't fall asleep with your window open, okay？
translations.暑いからってあっさりしたものばかり食べてると、体によくないからね。気を付けて: Only eating light foods just because it's hot isn't good for you, you know. Make sure you eat right!
translations.最近、[22]の患者さんが増えてるから、▲主人公＊▲も気をつけてね: We've been getting more patients with [22] lately, so be careful too, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.もう寒くなってきたから、風邪には気を付けてね: It's starting to get cold out, so be careful not to catch a cold, okay？
translations.食欲の秋だね、食べすぎないようにしなきゃ。でも、たまには、ね？: Fall really does make everything taste better! I need to watch how much I eat... Though indulging once in a while is fine, right？
translations.このところ、[22]の患者さんが増えてきてるみたい。手洗いうがいは、しっかりね？: Looks like more patients have been coming in with [22] lately. Make sure you wash your hands and gargle, okay？
translations.[24]は、街のイルミネーションがきれいだよー。わたしもいつか見に行きたいな: The lights around town are so pretty in [24]! I'd love to go see them sometime.
translations.ママったらね、よく▲主人公＊▲のこと聞いてくるの。恥ずかしくて、全部は話せないよ: Mom keeps asking me about you, ▲主人公＊▲. It's too embarrassing to tell her everything, though.
translations.▲主人公＊▲に会いたいな。ねぇ、▲主人公＊▲はわたしに会いたくない？: I really wanna see you, ▲主人公＊▲. Hey, don't you wanna see me too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.あのね、昨日パパが書斎でお勉強してる隙にこっそりバラエティ番組観ちゃった♪: So yesterday, while Dad was busy in his study, I snuck off to watch a variety show♪
translations.今日は宿題あった？: Did we have any homework today？
translations.今日のお夕飯は、わたしが作るの。腕によりをかけてがんばっちゃう: I'm making dinner tonight. I'm going to give it everything I've got!
translations.おっ洗濯ー♪おっせんたくー♪なんて: La-la-laundry♪ La-la-laundry♪ Hehe, just being silly.
translations.お菓子焼いたんだけど、作りすぎちゃった。▲主人公＊▲食べてくれる？なんて: I baked some sweets, but I made too many. Will you help me eat them, ▲主人公＊▲？ Just kidding.
translations.ママはなんでもできてすごいな、わたしも追いつかなくっちゃ: Mom can do anything, she's amazing. I need to catch up to her!
translations.ママと一緒に庭のお手入れ。毎日お水をあげてたお花につぼみが出来たの。嬉しいな: Tending the garden with Mom. The flowers I've been watering every day finally have buds! I'm so happy.
translations.これから家のお掃除するの。▲主人公＊▲のお部屋はちゃんとキレイにしてる？: I'm about to clean the house. Are you keeping your room nice and tidy, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.良く晴れたときに、パーっとお洗濯物を干せると気持ちいいよね。雨の時は、お部屋がモ: It feels so good to hang out all the laundry on a sunny day. On rainy days, drying it inside makes the room all muggy, though.
translations.[24]は、スミレのお花がきれいなの。お庭のスミレもそろそろ咲きだしてるよ: Violets are so pretty in [24]. The ones in our garden are starting to bloom, too.
translations.お菓子作り、失敗しちゃった。[24]の陽気のせい？気をつけなくちゃ: I messed up the sweets I was making. Maybe I got carried away by the nice [24] weather？ I have to be more careful.
translations.お庭のお池にスイレンが咲いたよ。ぷっくりしていて可愛らしいの: The water lilies in our garden pond bloomed! They're so plump and cute.
translations.お庭にヒマワリが咲きました。まーっすぐ何を見つめてるんだろう、ね？: The sunflowers in our garden have bloomed. I wonder what they're staring so straight ahead at, don't you？
translations.[24]は、やっぱりコスモスがきれいだなぁ。お庭いっぱいに咲かせる計画中だよ: Cosmos really are so pretty in [24]. I'm planning to fill the whole garden with them!
translations.食べ物がおいしい季節だね。今日は何を作ろうかな: Everything tastes so good this time of year. I wonder what I should cook today.
translations.ケーキを作ってみたよ。雪をイメージしてマシュマロ乗せてみたけど、食べにくい…かも: I tried making a cake! I put marshmallows on top to look like snow, but it might be... a little hard to eat.
translations.何か創作レシピに挑戦したいな、良いアイデアがあったら教えてね、一緒につくろ？: I want to try coming up with my own recipe. Let me know if you have any good ideas—maybe we can make it together？
translations.今日もママのお手伝い。パパとママ、褒めてくれるかな？でも▲主人公＊▲に、いい子い: Helping Mom out again today. Wonder if Mom and Dad will praise me？ Though I'd be much happier if you patted my head and called me a good girl, ▲主人公＊▲. Hehe.
translations.今日のお夕飯、わたしが作ったんだけど、とっても美味しくできたの。▲主人公＊▲もカ: I made dinner tonight, and it turned out delicious! You'd rather have a girlfriend who's a good cook too, right, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.今日のお夕飯、わたしが作ったんだけど……失敗しちゃった。パパとママは美味しいって: I made dinner tonight, but... I messed it up. Mom and Dad said it was good, but I'm sure they were just being nice...
translations.今日はわたしがお掃除当番。いつもがんばってるママを助けないとね: It's my turn to clean today. Mom always works so hard, so I have to help her out.
translations.マナカは今日も▲主人公＊▲のおかげで幸せでした。なんて♪: Manaka had another happy day today, all thanks to ▲主人公＊▲. Hehe♪
translations.夜も……▲主人公＊▲がそばにいてくれたらいいのにな: I wish you could be with me at night too, ▲主人公＊▲...
translations.今日ね、星が良く見えるよ？それだけ、▲主人公＊▲に伝えたかったの: You can see the stars really clearly tonight! I just wanted to tell you that, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.マナカはもう寝ます: Manaka is going to bed now.
translations.今日もわたしの一日は▲主人公＊▲とのメールで終わり: Ending another day with a text to ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.▲主人公＊▲もあんまり夜更かししないでね？: Don't stay up too late either, okay, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.宿題が難しくて、こんな時間になっちゃった。▲主人公＊▲は大丈夫だった？: The homework was so hard, I didn't realize how late it got. Did you do okay with yours, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.わたしもうね、半分眠っちゃってるみたい……: I think I'm already half asleep...
translations.[24]のお布団って気持ちよくなっちゃうよね: Crawling into bed in [24] feels so good, doesn't it？
translations.寝苦しい季節だけど、体は冷やさないようにね？: It's that muggy time of year when it's hard to sleep, but careful not to let yourself get chilled, okay？
translations.今日は暑いね、寝汗かいちゃうかな……: It's so hot tonight. I'm probably going to sweat in my sleep...
translations.この季節、虫の鳴き声を聞いてるとすぐ眠れちゃうの: This time of year, listening to the crickets puts me right to sleep.
translations.秋の夜長っていうけど、わたしには満喫できないかも: People talk about enjoying the long autumn nights, but I don't think I can stay awake for them.
translations.寒いから、あまり夜更かしすると風邪ひいちゃうよ: It's cold out, so you'll catch a cold if you stay up too late.
translations.あったかくして、早めに寝てね？: Bundle up warm and go to bed early, okay？
translations.今夜は▲主人公＊▲の夢にお邪魔できないかな？なんて: I wonder if I can drop by your dreams tonight, ▲主人公＊▲？ Hehe.
translations.おやすみのキスしちゃう、ほんとは直接あげたいんだけどな。チュ▼: Here's a goodnight kiss, though I really wish I could give it to you in person. Mwah▼
translations.たくさん練習するとご飯も美味しいし、お風呂も気持ちいいし、ぐっすり眠れるよね: After a long practice, food tastes better, the bath feels great, and you sleep so well.
translations.わたしはもう寝る時間: Time for me to go to bed.
translations.今日もたくさんがんばった？そんなところも、大好きよ？明日は一緒にがんばりたいな？: Did you work hard today too？ That's one of the things I love about you. Let's do our best together tomorrow, okay？
translations.なんだか今日は寝付けないの、こんなことあまりないんだけど: For some reason I can't fall asleep tonight. That hardly ever happens to me.
translations.今日はね、まだ眠くないよ。まだしばらく起きてよっと、ふふ♪: I'm not sleepy yet tonight. Think I'll stay up a little longer. Hehe♪
translations.会いたいなあ……ね▼: I really want to see you... ▼
translations.まだ起きてる？特に用事はないんだけど、メールしたくなっちゃった: Still up？ No special reason, I just felt like texting you.
translations.今日は楽しい一日だった？明日からもがんばろうね: Did you have a fun day today？ Let's do our best tomorrow too.
translations.珍しく遅くまで起きてたら、ママからもう寝なさいって言われちゃった。: I stayed up late for once and Mom told me to go to bed already.
translations.[24]だからって、寝坊しちゃダメだよ？▲主人公＊▲は、わたしを起こしてくれる王: Even if it's [24], no sleeping in, okay？ You're my prince who wakes me up, ▲主人公＊▲!
translations.▲主人公＊▲はまだ起きてるの？夢の中で待ってるね▼: Are you still awake, ▲主人公＊▲？ I'll be waiting for you in my dreams ▼
translations.毎日暑いけど、恋人なんだからぴったりくっついて寝たいな。なんて、ちょっと大胆？: It's so hot every day, but since we're a couple, I still wanna cuddle close when we sleep. Is that a little bold？
translations.暑いからって、あまり薄着して寝ると風邪ひいちゃうからね？でも、風邪ひいちゃったら: Even if it's hot, don't sleep in too little or you'll catch a cold, okay？ Though if you do, maybe I'll come nurse you back to health？
translations.恋愛小説を読んでたら遅くなっちゃった。続きは夢で▲主人公＊▲と……かな？: I got caught up reading a romance novel and stayed up late. Maybe I'll continue it in my dreams with ▲主人公＊▲...？
translations.たまにならお夜食もいいよね？本当は良くないんだけど……、ナイショね▼: A late-night snack is okay once in a while, right？ I know I really shouldn't, though... Keep it a secret, okay ▼
translations.毎日寒いよね。こんなときはカレシにあっためてもらいたいな。なんて: It's so cold every day. Weather like this makes me want my boyfriend to warm me up. Just saying.
translations.▲主人公＊▲ー？マナカは寒くてふるえてますよー？ふふ♪: ▲主人公＊▲？ Manaka is shivering from the cold over here, you know？ Hehe♪
translations.早く夜でもお互い会えるようになればいいのにね、なんて: I wish we could hurry up and be old enough to see each other at night too. Just saying.
translations.▲主人公＊▲は今何考えてるのかな……。正解したらご褒美くれる？なんて: Wonder what ▲主人公＊▲ is thinking about right now... If I guess right, do I get a reward？ Just kidding.
translations.毎日一生懸命だと疲れるけど……それも楽しいね。一番は、▲主人公＊▲がいてくれるお: Giving it my all every day gets tiring... but that's fun too. Mostly thanks to having you around, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.▲主人公＊▲とダブルスしたいな。わたしの方は、いつでも準備できてるからね: I wanna play doubles with you, ▲主人公＊▲. I'm ready whenever you are!
translations.▲主人公＊▲が練習のお相手してくれるの、うれしいの: It makes me so happy having you as my practice partner, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.今日の練習は大変だったから、ぐっすり眠れそうだよ: Practice was tough today, so I think I'll sleep like a log.
translations.やっぱり男子の球を打ち返すのは難しい。わたし、もっとカウンターの練習した方がいい: Returning guys' shots really is tough. Maybe I should practice my counter shots more？
translations.▲主人公＊▲は、どのくらいの強さでガット張ってる？わたしは硬いほうが好きかな: How tight do you string your racket, ▲主人公＊▲？ I think I like mine on the firmer side.
translations.練習の後のシャワーは気持ちいいから、自主練しちゃいました♪: A shower after practice feels so good, I ended up doing some extra solo practice♪
translations.そろそろガット張り替えないとなぁ。▲主人公＊▲のラケットは大丈夫？: I need to get my racket restrung soon. How's yours holding up, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.パパとママに、新しいラケット買ってもらっちゃった♪お手伝いがんばろ？: Mom and Dad bought me a new racket♪ I better work hard helping out around the house!
translations.練習中に居眠りしてた１年生がいたの。[24]だからって、よく立ったまま寝られるよ: One of the first-years dozed off during practice. Even if it's [24], how do you fall asleep standing up？
translations.サーブに失敗して、花壇にボール入れちゃった……お花、大丈夫だったかな: I messed up a serve and hit the ball into the flower bed... I hope the flowers are okay.
translations.今日練習中に倒れちゃった子、大丈夫かな？わたしたちも体調管理しっかりね？: I hope the girl who collapsed during practice today is okay. We need to take good care of ourselves too, okay？
translations.今日は暑かったけど、スポーツ飲料飲んで気持ちよく汗かいちゃった。▲主人公＊▲にも: It was hot today, but I had a sports drink and worked up a great sweat. Want some too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.この季節、練習の後はすごくお腹空いちゃう。今日も食べすぎちゃうかも♪: This time of year, I get so hungry after practice. Might eat too much again today♪
translations.秋って、練習には一番いい季節かもしれないね: Fall might just be the best season for practice.
translations.ラケット握る手がかじかんじゃうね。はぁーはぁー: My hand gets so numb holding the racket. Haaah, haaah...
translations.練習で汗かいたらちゃんとタオルで拭かなきゃ、だよ？拭いてほしい？なんて: When you sweat at practice, make sure you wipe it off with a towel, okay？ Or do you want me to do it for you？ Just kidding.
translations.練習のあとは、マッサージしてほしいな、なんて: After practice, I kinda wish someone would give me a massage. Just saying.
translations.[23,3]のみんなから、▲主人公＊▲とのこと色々聞かれちゃった。みんなそういう: Everyone in the [23,3] asked me all sorts of things about me and you, ▲主人公＊▲. They all love that kind of talk.
translations.今日の練習はキツくって、みんな大変そう: Practice today was brutal. Everyone looks wiped out.
translations.[23,3]のみんなが、自分たちのカレシの話してる。わたしが混ざるのは、ちょっと: Everyone in the [23,3] is talking about their boyfriends. I think I'm a little too shy to join in.
translations.おはよう[32]ステキな朝ね。: Good morning[32] What a lovely morning.
translations.わたしはこれから朝のティータイムだよ♪: I'm about to have my morning tea♪
translations.▲主人公＊▲がメールくれたから、今日はいい日になりそう: Thanks to your text, ▲主人公＊▲, I think today's gonna be a great day.
translations.お休みだからって、お昼寝ばかりしてちゃダメだよ？: Just because it's a day off doesn't mean you can nap all day, okay？
translations.今朝はトーストにしよっかな。: I think I'll have toast this morning.
translations.外で小鳥さんの歌声が聴こえるよ。: I can hear the little birds singing outside.
translations.この季節は目覚めがとっても気持ちいいの。: Waking up feels so nice this time of year.
translations.暑くても▲主人公＊▲は元気だね♪: Even in this heat, you're still full of energy, ▲主人公＊▲♪
translations.シャワーあびてこよっと♪: Gonna go hop in the shower♪
translations.朝起きるのが少しつらくなってきたね。: It's getting a little harder to get out of bed in the morning, huh.
translations.起きてすぐ暖房つけちゃった。: I turned the heater on right as I woke up.
translations.今日もがんばろ？: Let's do our best today, okay？
translations.今日は夢、見られるかな。: I wonder if I'll have a dream tonight.
translations.でももうダメ、眠さの限界……: I can't stay awake anymore, I'm hitting my limit...
translations.あまり夜更かししないでね。: Don't stay up too late, okay.
translations.ふふ、お布団ぽっかぽか。: Hehe, my futon is nice and toasty.
translations.今日はお布団減らしちゃお。: Think I'll use fewer blankets tonight.
translations.まだ、セミの鳴き声がするけど……: I can still hear the cicadas outside, though...
translations.読書してたら、もうこんな時間になっちゃった。: I got caught up reading and lost track of the time.
translations.鈴虫の鳴き声いい感じ……: The crickets outside sound so nice...
translations.お布団入ったら冷たい。けど……: My bed is freezing when I first get in. Still...
translations.こら、授業中だよ[32]: Hey, we're in the middle of class[32]
translations.授業中にしょうがないなぁ、もう[32]: Texting during class？ What am I gonna do with you[32]
translations.ぼーっとして……ないもん。: I wasn't... spacing out or anything.
translations.こっそり腕のストレッチしちゃお。: Gonna sneak in a quick arm stretch.
translations.こんなときにメールする悪い子はおしおきだよ？: Bad boys who text at a time like this get punished, you know？
translations.春の陽気に負けないでね。: Don't let the warm spring weather make you sleepy.
translations.うとうとしてた……かも。: I might've been... nodding off a little.
translations.あついね？わたしはまだまだ大丈夫。: Hot, isn't it？ I'm still doing fine, though.
translations.夏の暑さに負けないでね。: Don't let the summer heat beat you.
translations.お勉強、はかどるはかどる。: Getting so much studying done today.
translations.お芋のことなんて、考えてないよ？: I'm not daydreaming about sweet potatoes, okay？
translations.さむいね？指が冷えちゃってペンが握れないよぅ。: Cold, isn't it？ My fingers are so cold I can barely hold my pen.
translations.冬の寒さに負けちゃダメなんだから。: You can't let the winter cold get the best of you.
translations.授業に集中しなきゃなのに、▲主人公＊▲ったら[32]: I'm supposed to be focusing on class, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.▲主人公＊▲とメールしたいって思ってたマナカも悪い子かも？: Maybe I'm a bad girl too for wanting to text you, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.こっそりメールするのも楽しいね[32]: Sneaking texts like this is kinda fun, isn't it[32]
translations.先生に見つからないようにね[32]: Make sure the teacher doesn't catch you[32]
translations.お風呂から上がったところ[32]: Just got out of the bath[32]
translations.今、お風呂上りで……その……: I just got out of the bath, and... um...
translations.お風呂上り、だ・よ[32]: Fresh out of the bath, just so you know[32]
translations.▲主人公＊▲はもうお風呂入ったのかな？: Have you taken your bath yet, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.▲主人公＊▲はお風呂これから？: Are you about to take a bath, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.部活の疲れもシャワーでスッキリ♪: A nice shower washed away all that practice fatigue♪
translations.やっぱり部活のあとはシャワーだね[32]: Nothing beats a shower after club practice[32]
translations.▲主人公＊▲もお風呂でサッパリとね？: Go freshen up in the bath too, okay, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.▲主人公＊▲もお風呂でサッパリ出来た？: Did you get all freshened up in the bath too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.ラベンダーの入浴剤の香りで、癒されちゃった♪: The lavender bath salts smelled so soothing♪
translations.次はどんな入浴剤にしよっか迷っちゃうなぁ。: I can't decide what bath salts to use next time.
translations.暑いから、ちょっとからだを冷ましてます[32]: It's hot, so I'm cooling off a little[32]
translations.入浴中に本を読むのって、おかしいかな？: Is it weird to read a book in the bath？
translations.つい、本を最後まで読んじゃった。: I got carried away and finished my whole book.
translations.湯冷めしないようにね。ちょこっと足にお水かけるといいよ？: Don't catch a chill after your bath. Splashing a little cold water on your feet helps, you know？
translations.とりあえず、パジャマ着てきます[32]またね[32]: Anyway, gonna go put my pajamas on[32] Talk to you later[32]
translations.よろしければ、お背中流しましょうか？なんて[32]: Would you like me to scrub your back for you？ Just kidding[32]
translations.今、お食事中なの[32]: I'm in the middle of a meal[32]
translations.パパに隠れてこっそりお返事メール。: Texting you back in secret so Dad doesn't see.
translations.パパにメールしていることバレませんように……: I hope Dad doesn't catch me texting...
translations.▲主人公＊▲はもうご飯食べたのかな: I wonder if you've already eaten, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.お食事中なのにメールなんて、お行儀悪くて、ごめんね。: Sorry for the bad manners, texting you during a meal.
translations.今日のご飯は、わたしの自信作です[32]: I'm really proud of how today's meal turned out[32]
translations.▲主人公＊▲も一緒にご飯食べたい？: Do you want to eat together too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.春はお野菜が甘くておいしいよ♪: Spring vegetables are so sweet and delicious♪
translations.夏は花火を見ながら、スイカを食べたいな。: In the summer, I want to eat watermelon while watching fireworks.
translations.食後のアイス食べてるよ、ぱくり♪: Having some ice cream for dessert. Yum♪
translations.秋はやっぱり[35]かな？: Nothing beats [35] in the fall, right？
translations.食べ過ぎないように気をつけなきゃ。: I need to be careful not to eat too much.
translations.寒いときに食べるアイスも、オススメだよ♪: Eating ice cream when it's cold out is really nice too♪
translations.今日は[23]に誘われて、学食にいるの。: [23] invited me to the school cafeteria today, so that's where I am.
translations.ドキドキしたけど、購買部にチャレンジしてみたの。焼きそばのパンが買えたよ♪: I was nervous, but I tried braving the school store. I managed to buy some yakisoba bread♪
translations.パンを焼いてみました。お紅茶と一緒にね[32]: I tried baking some bread. Having it with tea[32]
translations.パパに見つかると怒られちゃうから、またあとでね。: Dad'll get mad at me if he catches me, so I'll text you later.
translations.午後もがんばろ？: Let's do our best this afternoon too, okay？
translations.とりあえず、ごちそうさましなきゃ。またね。: Anyway, I should finish up my meal. Talk to you later.
translations.家庭教師のマナカです[32]なんて。: I'm Manaka, your private tutor[32] Just kidding.
translations.ちょっと休憩しよっと。: Think I'll take a little break.
translations.宿題は終わったかな？: Have you finished your homework yet？
translations.明日の予習もいいけど、メールもね。: Prepping for tomorrow's classes is good, too, but so is texting.
translations.復習も大切だからね。: Reviewing what we learned is important too, after all.
translations.お休みでも、しっかりね。: Even on days off, we have to keep at it.
translations.今回は宿題多くて大変。: We have so much homework this time, it's tough.
translations.お料理も、お勉強でいいよね？: Cooking counts as studying too, right？
translations.つい、眠くなっちゃうけど、そんなときこそ集中、集中♪: I can't help getting sleepy, but that's when I really need to focus, focus♪
translations.遊ぶのは宿題やってからだよ？: Homework first before having fun, okay？
translations.わたし、次の問題が解けたらアイスを食べるんだ♪: Once I solve this next problem, I'm treating myself to some ice cream♪
translations.暑さも忘れるくらい、集中出来ちゃった。: I got so focused that I completely forgot about the heat.
translations.お夜食は、ほどほどに、だよ？: Go easy on the late-night snacks, okay？
translations.コタツでぽかぽかしてると、眠くなっちゃいそう。: Getting all warm and cozy under the kotatsu is making me sleepy.
translations.ちゃんちゃんこって古いかな？▲主人公＊▲には見せられないけど。結構好きなの。: Is wearing a padded vest old-fashioned？ I could never let you see me in it, ▲主人公＊▲, but I actually really like mine.
translations.わたしのことも解いてみる？なんて。: Want to try figuring me out too？ Just kidding.
translations.▲主人公＊▲と一緒にお勉強したいな[32]: I wish I could study with you, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.わからないところがあったら、何でも聞いてね。: If there's anything you're stuck on, just ask me.
translations.何しよっかなぁ。: I wonder what I should do now.
translations.パパがめずらしくお寝坊さん。: Dad slept in today, for once.
translations.あくびなんかしてないよ？: I wasn't yawning or anything, okay？
translations.もう夕方だね、はやいなぁ。: It's evening already. The day went by so fast.
translations.あっというまに、こんな時間。: It got this late before I knew it.
translations.メールうれしいよ[32]: Your text made me really happy[32]
translations.一日の終わりって、お休みの日だと、より寂しく感じるよね。: The end of the day feels even lonelier when it's a day off, doesn't it？
translations.あ……あのウサギさん、かわいいな。: Oh... That little bunny is so cute.
translations.お勉強も楽しいよね？: Studying is pretty fun too, isn't it？
translations.ふと気づくと、テニスで頭がいっぱいなときってない？: Do you ever catch yourself with nothing but tennis on the brain？
translations.あまり関係ないかもしれないけど、わたしの作った料理食べて？なんて。: This might be kind of random, but will you try my cooking sometime？ Just kidding.
translations.少し早く目がさめたから、今日は朝のお散歩。気持ちいいよ。: I woke up a little early today, so I'm out for a morning walk. It feels great.
translations.部活中だよ[32]: I'm at club practice right now[32]
translations.あれ？今は部活中だよ[32]: Huh？ We're in the middle of club practice right now[32]
translations.練習中だよ[32]: I'm in the middle of practice[32]
translations.次は練習来てね？: Come to practice next time, okay？
translations.今日の練習は、基礎練がメインみたい。: Looks like today's practice is mostly basic drills.
translations.今日の練習、ちょっと物足りないかも。: Today's practice felt like it wasn't quite enough.
translations.もう、しょうがないなぁ[32]: Geez, what am I gonna do with you[32]
translations.▲主人公＊▲と、どこか行けばよかったかな、なんて[32]: Maybe I should've gone somewhere with you instead, ▲主人公＊▲... Just kidding[32]
translations.なんだか、からだがすごく軽い[32]: I feel so light on my feet today[32]
translations.もし、練習でおかしなところがあったら、教えてね。: If anything looked off during practice, let me know, okay.
translations.自主練しちゃおっかなって。: Thinking I might do some extra practice on my own.
translations.素振りだって、積み重ねが大事だよね。: Even with practice swings, consistency is what really counts.
translations.女の子が、筋力トレーニングって幻滅しちゃう？: Is it a turn-off for a girl to do strength training？
translations.でも、その前にラケットのメンテナンスしよ。: First, though, I should take care of my racket.
translations.春はみんな、のんびりだなぁ。: Everyone's so laid-back in the spring.
translations.さわやかにスポーツだよ[32]: Nothing like working up a fresh sweat[32]
translations.ちゃんとお水飲むんだよ？: Make sure you drink plenty of water, okay？
translations.秋は夕焼けがきれいだね。: The autumn sunsets are so pretty.
translations.いっぱい動くと、その分お腹が空いちゃうから、困っちゃう。: Moving around so much makes me really hungry, though.
translations.冬はいつもよりストレッチを長めにね。: You have to stretch longer than usual in the winter.
translations.みんな寒さで、あまりからだ動かない……かも？: Maybe everyone's too cold to move around much...？
translations.練習中でも、メールのお返事は書いちゃうの[32]: Even during practice, I can't help replying to your texts[32]
translations.練習中も、わたしをもっと見てね[32]: Watch me even closer during practice, okay[32]
translations.んー……調子よくないかも……: Hmm... I might be having an off day...
translations.ちょっと良くない……かな？: Not feeling the best today... I think？
translations.良くも悪くもないかな？なんて。: Could be better, could be worse, I guess？ Hehe.
translations.こんなときは、いつもと違うことして気分を変えよう、かな？: At times like this, maybe I should try something different for a change of pace？
translations.落ち込んでばかりじゃ、ダメよね。: I can't just mope around forever, right.
translations.でも、くよくよしてちゃ……ダメ。: Still, moping around won't do any good.
translations.ごめんね。こんなお返事で。: Sorry for sending a reply like this.
translations.気分転換にメール、かな？: Thought texting might be a nice change of pace, maybe？
translations.気分転換したいな？: Kind of want a change of pace？
translations.楽しいことをしなくちゃ、ね？: I just need to do something fun, right？
translations.▲主人公＊▲と会えたら、元気になれそう？: I think seeing you would cheer me up, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.たまには、息抜きしないとね。: You have to take a breather every now and then.
translations.息抜きしたいなー、なんて。: I really could use a break right now, haha.
translations.▲主人公＊▲とメールしてたら、もっと元気になれそう？なんて。: Texting with you might cheer me up even more, ▲主人公＊▲？ Hehe.
translations.元気なのは、▲主人公＊▲のおかげ、かな？: I think I have you to thank for my good mood, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.元気の源は▲主人公＊▲……だよ。: My source of energy is... you, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.メールありがとう。更に元気になっちゃった。: Thanks for the text. Now I feel even better.
translations.もっと元気にしてほしいな、なんて。: I want you to cheer me up even more, hehe.
translations.▲主人公＊▲からメールも貰えたし…[32]: Plus, I got a text from you, ▲主人公＊▲...[32]
translations.マナカの元気、わけてほしい？なんて[32]: Want Manaka to share some of her energy？ Hehe[32]
translations.今なら、何でも出来ちゃうかも[32]: I feel like I could do anything right now[32]
translations.今日もマナカは、▲主人公＊▲のおかげで元気いっぱい、なのでした[32]テヘ♪: And so, thanks to ▲主人公＊▲, Manaka is full of energy again today[32] Teehee♪
translations.ありがとう。うれしいな。: Thank you. That makes me so happy.
translations.やっぱり、好きって言われると安心するね。: It always makes me feel so reassured when you say you love me.
translations.急にどうしたの？でも嬉しいよ。: What brought that on all of a sudden？ I'm happy to hear it, though.
translations.でも、まだ足りないよ。もっと、もっと言って。: That's still not enough, though. Say it more, lots more.
translations.わたしもっと幸せになりたいな。: I want to be even happier.
translations.そんなこと言われたら、ついつい▲主人公＊▲のこと考えちゃうよ。: When you say things like that, I can't help thinking about you, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.好きって言ったら何してくれる？なんて。: If I say I love you, what'll you do for me？ Just kidding.
translations.嫌いなわけないじゃない。: Of course I don't dislike you.
translations.それだけ？なんて。テヘ♪: Is that all？ Just kidding. Hehe♪
translations.もう、恥ずかしいよ。でもすごく嬉しい。: Geez, you're making me blush. I'm really happy, though.
translations.何だか恥ずかしいね。でもおかしくないよね？: It's kind of embarrassing, isn't it？ That's not weird, right？
translations.直接言ってもらえた方が…ううん、やっぱり恥ずかしい。: I'd rather hear it in person... No, never mind, that's too embarrassing.
translations.▲主人公＊▲と一緒で、とっても幸せだよ[32]: I'm so happy being with you, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.スキスキスキって１０回言って？……はい、……チュ[32]: Say "I love you" 10 times？ ...Okay, here... Mwah[32]
translations.▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼……この気持ち、書ききれないよ[32]: ▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼▼... I can't put all these feelings into words[32]
translations.わたしも会いたい[32]: I want to see you too[32]
translations.マナカも会いたい[32]: I really want to see you too[32]
translations.今そんな気分じゃないの。: I'm not really in the mood right now.
translations.ごめんね。今、体調が良くないの。: Sorry. I'm not feeling too well right now.
translations.それも悪くないかもね？: That might not be a bad idea？
translations.気晴らしになるかなぁ？: Maybe a change of pace would do me good？
translations.そうだね、時間が合えばいいけど。: Yeah, hopefully our schedules line up.
translations.会いたくない、なんて。ウソ。会いたい。: I don't want to see you... Just kidding. I really do.
translations.もう、しょうがないんだから。: Geez, what am I going to do with you.
translations.会いたいって思ったときにすぐ会えるのが、恋人のいいところ、かな。: Being able to meet up right when we want to is the best part of being a couple, I think.
translations.善は急げ？間に合わなくなってもしらないよ？なんて。: Strike while the iron is hot, right？ Don't blame me if you're too late？ Just kidding.
translations.今すぐに、なんて。: Right this second, even. Just kidding.
translations.▲主人公＊▲のことばっかり、考えてた……: I've been thinking about nothing but you, ▲主人公＊▲...
translations.▲主人公＊▲もマナカのことで、頭いっぱいなんだね、おんなじだ[32]: Sounds like your head's full of me too, ▲主人公＊▲. Same here[32]
translations.すぐ会えるよね[32]: We can see each other soon, right[32]
translations.ね、会いたいの[32]: Hey, I really want to see you.[32]
translations.そんなときでも。: Even at a time like this.
translations.体調管理、しっかりね？: Take good care of yourself, okay？
translations.わたしも何かしよっかな。: Maybe I'll find something to do, too.
translations.落ち着いて行動、ね？: Just take it slow and steady, okay？
translations.周りをよく見て行動、だからね？: Pay attention to what's around you, okay？
translations.わたしもがんばっちゃうよ♪: I'm gonna give it my all, too♪
translations.ケガなんてしないでね、心配しちゃうよ。: Be careful not to get hurt, or I'll worry.
translations.忙しいってことは、マナカと会える時間が少なくなっちゃう。: If you're busy, that means less time for us to see each other.
translations.でも、またすぐ会えるって、マナカ待ってるね[32]: But I know we'll see each other soon, so I'll be waiting![32]
translations.でも、マナカにメールしてくれて、ありがとう[32]: Still, thank you for texting me![32]
translations.そのぶん、マナカはヒマですよー。なんて[32]: Meanwhile, I'm totally free over here! Just kidding.[32]
translations.そんなときはね、うーん。思いつかない。: When that happens, well... Hmm. I can't think of anything.
translations.▲主人公＊▲は宿題やった？: Did you do your homework, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.そうだ、お勉強しなきゃ。: Oh right, I need to study.
translations.わたしは今ね、本を読んでるの。▲主人公＊▲も読みたい？: I'm reading a book right now. Want to read it too, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.お散歩するとか？: How about going for a walk？
translations.素振りをすると、気がまぎれるかも？: Maybe doing some practice swings would take your mind off it？
translations.オススメの本があるけど、一緒に読もっか？なんて。: I have a book I recommend—wanna read it together？ Just kidding.
translations.教科はちがうかもしれないけど、これから一緒に宿題する？: We might have different subjects, but wanna do homework together now？
translations.もっとわたしにメールしても、いいよ？: You're welcome to text me some more, you know？
translations.▲主人公＊▲に会えないからかも？: Maybe it's because I can't see you, ▲主人公＊▲？
translations.メールありがとう。わたしがお相手してあげるね。: Thanks for the text. I'll keep you company!
translations.▲主人公＊▲からメールもらったから、少し退屈じゃなくなりそうかな？: Now that I got a text from you, ▲主人公＊▲, maybe I won't be so bored anymore？
translations.もっと、メールしよ？なんて。: Let's text some more, okay？ Just kidding.
translations.▲主人公＊▲からのメール待ってたの[32]: I was waiting for a text from you, ▲主人公＊▲.[32]
translations.ふふ、こういうの、少し恥ずかしいね[32]: Hehe, saying stuff like this is a little embarrassing.[32]
translations.マナカの隣は空いてますよー、なんて[32]: The spot next to me is wide open! Just kidding[32]
translations.ちょっと失敗続きで、やになっちゃう。: I just keep messing up lately. It's really getting to me.
translations.わたしにもわけて？: Share some of that with me？
translations.どうすれば気分よくなるかな？: What can I do to feel better？
translations.ちょっとスランプなの。: I'm in a bit of a slump.
translations.この前ね、部長に負けちゃった。: I lost to the club captain the other day.
translations.今日はちょっと眠いの。シャキっとしないとね。: I'm a little sleepy today. Gotta snap out of it.
translations.さては、かわいいウサギさんでも見つけたのかな？: Wait, did you spot a cute little bunny or something？
translations.練習試合に勝ったの？: Did you win a practice match？
translations.アイスでも食べたの？: Did you have some ice cream or something？
translations.わたしもこの前ね、男子部の部長に勝てたの！: I actually beat the boys' team captain the other day too!
translations.わたしもうれしくなってきちゃった。: Now I'm starting to feel happy too.
translations.最近、サービスエースいっぱい決めちゃった、わたしも調子いいみたい。: I've been landing tons of service aces lately. Looks like I'm on a roll too.
translations.わたしも最近、気分がいいかも♪: I've been in a pretty good mood lately too♪
translations.マナカも▲主人公＊▲と出会えてから、ずっとかもしれない[32]: Maybe I've felt that way ever since I met you too, ▲主人公＊▲[32]
translations.そんなことでメールするなんて、もう[32]: Texting me just to say that？ Geez[32]
translations.落ち込むこともあるけど……: I get down sometimes too, though...
translations.平気？わたしに出来ることある？: Are you okay？ Is there anything I can do？
translations.大丈夫？心配だよ？: Are you all right？ I'm worried about you.
translations.このままじゃいけないよね。: Can't just stay like this forever, right？
translations.▲主人公＊▲がそばに居てくれたら、安心なんだけどな。: I'd feel so much better if you were here with me, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.落ち込まないように、気分変えよう？: Let's try for a change of pace so we don't get down, okay？
translations.素振りしてこようかな？: Maybe I'll go do some practice swings？
translations.後ろ向きにばかり考えちゃ、ダメよ？: You can't just focus on the negative, okay？
translations.一緒にがんばろ？: Let's both do our best, okay？
translations.わたしは、力になれるかな？: I wonder if there's anything I can do to help？
translations.やっぱり、元気が一番だよね。: Staying upbeat really is what matters most, huh.
translations.楽しいことを、考えよう？: Let's think about happy things, okay？
translations.わたしは、▲主人公＊▲のいいところ、いっぱい知ってるよ？: I know tons of great things about you, ▲主人公＊▲.
translations.何かあったらわたしに言ってね。: If anything's wrong, just tell me, okay？
translations.もっとそばに居れたらいいのにな。: I wish I could be by your side more.
translations.▲主人公＊▲が幸せでいられますように……: I hope you stay happy, ▲主人公＊▲...
translations.▲主人公＊▲はいつも、わたしに勇気をくれるから……: Because you always give me courage, ▲主人公＊▲...
translations.ポジティブに、だよ？ネガティブなままじゃ前に進めないから、ね[32]: Stay positive, okay？ You can't move forward if you stay negative[32]
translations.マナカが、いい子いい子って、なぐさめてあげる[32]: I'll pat your head and make it all better[32]
translations.目に見えるものが全てじゃないよ？マナカがそばにいるよ[32]: There's more to things than meets the eye, you know？ I'm right here with you[32]
translations.前を見て、ほら、マナカが見える？なんて[32]: Look ahead! See, can you spot me？ Just kidding[32]
translations.いつも以上に、はりきっちゃった？: Did you go all out even more than usual？
translations.元気だして、いこ？: Come on, let's cheer up, okay？
translations.無理してない？: Are you pushing yourself too hard？
translations.無理しちゃダメだから、ね？: Don't push yourself too hard, okay？
translations.はやめに休んで、疲れをとろう？: Turn in early and get some rest, okay？
translations.栄養のあるもの食べてね。: Make sure you eat something nutritious.
translations.疲れたら、休んでもいいんだよ？: It's okay to take a break when you're tired, you know？
translations.無理は、からだに良くないから、ね？: Overdoing it isn't good for you, okay？
translations.今日もいっぱい、がんばった？: Did you work super hard today too？
translations.きっと精一杯がんばったんだよね。: I bet you gave it everything you had.
translations.わたしが力になれることがあったら、言ってね。: If there's anything I can do to help, just let me know.
translations.疲れてるのにメールありがとう。そういうマメなところ、マナカは好きだよ[32]: Thanks for texting me even though you're tired. I love how thoughtful you are[32]
translations.そんなときでも▲主人公＊▲はやさしいね。ゆっくり休んでね[32]: Even at times like this, you're still so sweet, ▲主人公＊▲. Get plenty of rest[32]
translations.マナカが癒してあげる[32]: I'll make you feel all better[32]
translations.マッサージしてあげよっか？なんて[32]: Want me to give you a massage？ Just kidding[32]
